Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Esau ŋa Basemat lɛ bii.
Esau ŋa Oholibama ni ji Zibeon bi Ana biyoo lɛ bi ni ekɛ Esau fɔ ji Yeush kɛ Yalam kɛ Kora.
Shĩai ni jɛ Esau mli nɛ: Elifaz we, Esau kromɔbi lɛ, Teman we kɛ Omar we kɛ Zefo we kɛ Kenaz we, kɛ Kora we kɛ Gatam we kɛ Amalek we.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Elifaz lumɛi yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Ada shwiei ji amɛ.
Shĩai ni jɛ Esau bi Reuel we lɛ mli nɛ: Nahat we kɛ Zera we kɛ Shama we kɛ Miza we.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Reuel lumɛi yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Esau ŋa Basemat shwiei ji amɛ.
Esau ŋa Oholibama we lɛ mli bii ji Yeush we kɛ Yalam we kɛ Kora we.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ana biyoo Oholibama ni ji Esau ŋa lɛ shwiei bii.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ Esau bii ji amɛ, ni amɛwei nɛ.
Esau lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Edom lɛ.
Seir Shwiei Seir ni ji Hornyo lɛ shĩa lɛ mli bii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ: Lotan we kɛ Shobal we kɛ Zibeon we kɛ Ana we, kɛ Dishon we kɛ Ezer we kɛ Dishan we.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Horbii ni ji Seir bii ni yɔɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ awei lɛ.
Lotan shwiei ji Hori kɛ Heman; ni Lotan nyɛmi yoo ji Timna.
Shobal shwiei ji Alvan kɛ Manahat kɛ Ebal kɛ Shefo kɛ Onam.
Zibeon bii ji Aia kɛ Ana.
Mɔ nɛ ji Ana lɛ ni yana nuhiŋmɛi ni mli edɔ la yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ be ni elɛɔ etsɛ Zibeon tejii lɛ.
Ana bii ji Dishon kɛ Oholibama.
Dishon bii ji Hemdan kɛ Eshban kɛ Itram kɛ Keran.
Ezer bii ji Bilhan kɛ Zaavan kɛ Akan.
Dishan bii ji Uz kɛ Aran.
Horbii awei nɛ: Lotan we kɛ Shobal we kɛ Zibeon we kɛ Ana we, kɛ Dishon we kɛ Ezer we kɛ Dishan we.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Horbii lɛ awei ni ye lumɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa yɛ Seir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Edom Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Mɛi ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dani awo maŋtsɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ nɛ: Beor bi Bela ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom, ni emaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Dinhaba.
Be ni Bela gbo lɛ, Yobab, Zera ni jɛ Bozra lɛ bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yobab gbo ni Husham ni jɛ Temanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Husham gbo ni Bedad bi Hadad ni ye Midian nɔ kunim yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Emaŋtsɛmaŋ gbɛi ji Avit.
Hadad gbo ni Samla ni jɛ Masreka lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Samla gbo ni Shaul ni jɛ Rehobot ni kã Eufrate faa lɛ he lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Shaul gbo ni Akbor bi Baal-Hanan lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Akbor bi Baal-Hanan gbo, ni Hadar baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Emaŋtsɛmaŋ gbɛi ji Pau; ni eŋa ji Mehetabel, Mezehab biyoo Matred bi lɛ.
Esau shwiei ji nɛkɛ Edombii nɛɛ: Timnabii, Alvabii, Yetetbii, Oholibamabii, Elabii, Pinonbii, Kenazbii, Temanbii, Mibzarbii, Magdielbii, Irambii.
Hei ni Edombii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko hi lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛi wo jɛi.
Esau nɔŋŋ ji Edom ni ji Edombii atsɛ lɛ.
Yosef kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ Yakob hi shi yɛ etsɛ gbɔtoo shikpɔŋ ni ji Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yakob weku lɛ he sane nɛ.
Be ni Yosef eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ, ewaa enyɛmimɛi ni ji etsɛ ŋamɛi Bilha kɛ Zilpa bii lɛ kɛkwɛɔ amɛtsɛ toi lɛ.
Yosef bafolɔɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anaa ehãa amɛtsɛ.
Yakob sumɔɔ Yosef fe ebii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ egbɔlɛ mli binuu ni.
Ekpɛ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo ko kɛ eniji kakadaji ehã Yosef.
Be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛtsɛ sumɔɔ Yosef fe amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛ lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ awie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa dɔŋŋ.
Be ko lɛ Yosef la lamɔ ko ni be ni egba enyɛmimɛi lɛ lamɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛɛ ni amɛnyɛɔ lɛ lɛ mli wo wu moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa lamɔ ni mila nɛɛ toi.
Wɔmiifimɔ ŋmãa kei yɛ ŋmɔshi; ni naa, miŋmãa ke lɛ te shi damɔ shi trɔmɔɔ, ni nyɛŋmãa kei lɛ babɔle miŋmãa ke lɛ, ni amɛkoto lɛ.” Enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aso osusuɔ akɛ obaatsɔ maŋtsɛ ni oye wɔnɔ lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛ lɛ fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ elamɔi kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni esaa ela lamɔ kroko hu, ni egba enyɛmimɛi lɛ ekɛɛ; “Naa, mila lamɔ ko ekoŋŋ.
Mila ni hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome bakoto mi.” Shi be ni egba etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ lamɔ lɛ, etsɛ kã ehiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni lamɔ ola nɛɛ?
Belɛ kotomɔ mi kɛ onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ aaaba abakoto bo lo?” Enyɛmimɛi lɛ bɛ lɛ amɛwo amɛmli; shi etsɛ kɛ wiemɔ lɛ to enakutsoŋ.
Ahɔ̃ɔ Yosef ni akɛ lɛ tee Ijipt Gbi ko be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ etee amɛkwɛɔ amɛtsɛ toi lɛ yɛ Shekem lɛ, Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Te onyɛmimɛi lɛ miikwɛ toi yɛ Shekem?
Ba ni matsu bo amɛŋɔɔ.” Ni Yosef here nɔ akɛ, “Naa mi, tsu mi.” Yakob kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni oyakwɛ akɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo koni obakɛɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni etsu Yosef kɛjɛ Hebron jɔɔ lɛ mli; ni Yosef ba Shekem.
Nuu ko na Yosef ni eetsomlo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni nuu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Miitao minyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Miikpa bo fai, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi he ni amɛlɛɔ amɛtoi lɛ yɛ.” Ni nuu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛje biɛ, shi minu ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Dotan.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef tiu enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni eyanina amɛ yɛ Dotan.
Shi be ni amɛna lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ ni enako ebɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛkpãŋ eyinɔ akɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Naa, lamɔiatsɛ lɛ baa lɛ.
Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ ni wɔshɛa lɛ wɔfɔ̃a bui lɛ eko mli, ni wɔkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kooloo fɔŋ ko eye lɛ,’ koni wɔkwɛ kɛji elamɔi lɛ aaaba mli.” Shi be ni Ruben nu yiŋ ni ato lɛ, akɛni eetao ni ejie lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa wɔgbea lɛ.” Ruben saa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashwiea lá shi, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ lɛ awoa bu nɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛkafea lɛ efɔŋ ko!” Ruben kɛɛ enɛ bɔ ni afee ni ejie lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ koni ekɛ lɛ ayahã etsɛ ekoŋŋ.
Be ni Yosef shɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpɔlɔ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo kɛ eniji kakadaji lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wo bu lɛ mli; shi bu folo ni, nu bɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛho amɛtara shi ni amɛbɔi niyeli.
Be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛna Ishmaelbii gbɛnyiɛlɔi aku ko ni jɛ Gilead miiba kɛ amɛyoomai ni tere tsofakɛŋmai kɛ gbonyowoo tsofa kɛ ohɛ ni jeɔ ŋma kɛmiiya Ijipt.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sɛɛ wɔɔna yɛ mli kɛji wɔgbe wɔnyɛmi lɛ ni wɔtsimɔ nɔ?
Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔhɔɔa lɛ wɔhã Ishmaelbii lɛ; shi nyɛkahãa wɔkɛ wɔnine miita ehe, ejaakɛ wɔnyɛmi kɛ wɔla ji lɛ.” Ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ bo lɛ toi.
Kɛkɛ ni Midia guɔyelɔi lɛ bashɛ jɛi; ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ jie Yosef yɛ bu lɛ mli; ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ amɛhã Ishmaelbii lɛ amɛhe jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Yosef tee Ijipt.
Shi be ni Ruben ku esɛɛ kɛba bu lɛ he ekoŋŋ lɛ, Yosef bɛ bu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Ruben gbala ehe atadei lɛ, ni eku esɛɛ kɛba enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ; “Gbekɛ lɛ bɛ jɛi; te mafee tɛŋŋ?” Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɔlɔ Yosef atade lɛ, ni amɛgbe too kpakpo ko ni amɛkɛ atade lɛ tsɔ la lɛ mli.
Ni amɛkɛ atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsu ni akɛyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛtsɛ; amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔna nii nɛɛ, kwɛmɔ akɛ obi lɛ atade lɛ ni loo jeee noŋ.” Ni Yakob yoo atade lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Mibi lɛ atade lɛ ni!
Kooloo kakawua ko eye lɛ; tserɛmɔ etserɛ Yosef mli nɛɛ?” Ni Yakob gbala ehe atade lɛ, ni ekɔ kpekpe emia ehɛ, ni eye ebi lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ gbii pii.
Ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ fɛɛ te shi koni amɛbashɛje emii, shi ekpɛlɛɛɛ miishɛjemɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ŋkɔmɔyeli mikɛaaya ayanina mibi lɛ yɛ gbohiiaje.” Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Yosef tsɛ tsɔ efo lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Midianbii lɛ eyahɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ Ijipt amɛhã Potifar ni ji Farao piafonyo kɛ eblafoiatsɛ lɛ.
Yuda kɛ Tamar Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yuda shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ ni eyahi Adullamnyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hira lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Yuda na Kanaannyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Shua lɛ biyoo ko yɛ jɛi; eŋɔ oblayoo lɛ efee eŋa.
Oblayoo lɛ na musu ni efɔ binuu.
Yuda wo gbekɛ lɛ Er.
Yoo lɛ na musu ekoŋŋ.
Efɔ binuu ni ewo lɛ Onan.
Esaa efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ ni ewo lɛ Shela.
Eyɛ Akzib be ni efɔ gbekɛ nuu lɛ.
Yuda ŋɔ yoo ehã Er, ebi kromɔ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ gbɛi ji Tamar.
Shi Er, Yuda kromɔ lɛ fee ehe gbɔmɔ fɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Yehowa gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ Onan akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ onyɛmi nuu lɛ ŋa lɛ akɛ kulayeli ŋa, koni owo shwiei ohã onyɛmi nuu lɛ.” Shi Onan le akɛ bii lɛ ebatsɔ̃ŋ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ etee enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ ŋɔɔ ekɛ lɛ yawɔ lɛ, ejieɔ ehe nu lɛ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ efiteɔ, koni ekahã enyɛmi lɛ miina shwiei.
Nɔ ni efee lɛ, efɔŋ ni yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbe Onan hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ eshaayoo Tamar akɛ, “Yaahi shi akɛ okulafo yɛ otsɛ we lɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mibi Shela lɛ aaada.” Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei akɛ Shela hu baagbo tamɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Tamar tee eyahi etsɛ we lɛ.
Yɛ mli aahu lɛ, Yuda ŋa Shua biyoo lɛ bagbo; ni be ni Yuda etse etsui eŋmɛ emli lɛ, ekɛ enaanyo Hira, Adullamnyo lɛ, yiŋ tee etoohetsɔi kulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Timna.
Ayakɛɛ Tamar akɛ, “Oshaanuu miiya Timna eyaku etoi lɛ ahe tsɔi.” Kɛkɛ ni Tamar jie ekulafeemɔ atadei lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ shi, ni ekɛ hiɛhaanɔ ha ehiɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe koni akayoo lɛ; ni eyata shi yɛ Enaim klotia, yɛ Timna gbɛ lɛ toi ejaakɛ ena akɛ Shela eda, shi kɛ̃lɛ aŋɔɔɔ lɛ, Tamar lɛ, ahãaa Shela gbãlã.
Be ni Yuda na Tamar lɛ, esusu akɛ yoo ajwamãŋ ko ni, ejaakɛ eha ehiɛ.
Yuda gba kɛtee eŋɔɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ toi, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã ni maba oŋɔɔ,” ejaakɛ eleee akɛ eshaayoo lɛ ni.
Tamar bi Yuda akɛ, “Mɛni obaahã mi koni okɛ mi ayawɔ?” Yuda to he akɛ, “Mahã amɔ too kpakpo bi ko yɛ toi lɛ ateŋ abahã bo.” Ni Tamar kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ kɛji okɛ nɔ ko aaato mi awaba kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooohã akɛ too lɛ aba lɛ.” Yuda bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mikɛto bo awaba lɛ?” Tamar to he akɛ, “Owolonaasɔomɔnɔ kɛ ehe kpãa lɛ kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛ nibii lɛ hã Tamar, ni etee ekɛ lɛ yawɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Tamar na musu, Tamar te shi, ni eyiŋ etee.
Eyajie ehiɛhaanɔ lɛ efɔ shi, ni ekɔ ekulafeemɔ atade lɛ ewo.
Yuda kɛ too kpakpo bi lɛ hã enaanyo Adullamnyo lɛ kɛtee koni eyahe ewabatoo nii lɛ yɛ Tamar dɛŋ; shi enaanyo lɛ enaaa Tamar.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebi maŋbii komɛi ni yɔɔ Enaim lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ ni ta Enaim gbɛ lɛ toi lɛ yɔɔ?” Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yoo ajwamãŋ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ.” Yuda naanyo lɛ ku esɛɛ eba Yuda ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minaaa lɛ, ni asaŋ jɛibii lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Yoo ajwamãŋ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’ ” Yuda kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã ni eŋɔ kɛya, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔhiɛ aaashwie shi.
Mihã okɛ too kpakpo bi lɛ tee, ni onaaa lɛ.” No sɛɛ aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ lɛ, abakɛɛ Yuda akɛ, “Oshaayoo Tamar eyabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni nɔ ni ena yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ mli ji akɛ ena musu.” Yuda fã akɛ, “Amɔ lɛ kɛje kpo koni ashã lɛ.” Be ni akɛ Tamar jeɔ kpo kɛbaa lɛ, etsu atee eshaanuu Yuda ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuu mɔ ni nibii ji enɛɛmɛi lɛ, lɛ mikɛna musu lɛ.” Asaŋ Tamar kɛɛ, “Kwɛmɔ akɛ oooyoo mɔ ni nibii ji wolonaasɔomɔnɔ nɛɛ kɛ ehe kpãa nɛɛ kɛ tso nɛɛ lo?” Yuda yoo nibii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Akɛni miŋɔɔɔ lɛ mihãaa mibi Shela lɛ esane ja.” Ni Yuda etaaa Tamar he dɔŋŋ.
Be ni shɛ Tamar fɔmɔ be lɛ, ana akɛ hãaji ni yɔɔ emusu mli lɛ.
Be ni efɔɔ lɛ, hãaji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome jie enine kɛje kpo, ni yoofɔlɔ lɛ mɔ mli.
Ekɛ kpãa tsuru fi nine lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔnɛ tsutsu ba.” Shi abifao lɛ su enine lɛ, kɛkɛ ni enyɛmi lɛ je kpo kɛba, ni yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ ogbu gbɛ kɛje kpo.” Ni awo gbekɛ lɛ Perez.
No sɛɛ lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ ni kpãa tsuru lɛ yɔɔ enineshi lɛ hu ba, ni awo lɛ Zera.
Yosef kɛ Potifar ŋa lɛ Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Yosef tee Ijipt, ni amɛyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ amɛhã Potifar, ni ji Farao piafonyo kɛ eblafoiatsɛ lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni ehã efee nɔbatsɛ.
Enuŋtsɔ Ijiptnyo lɛ we lɛ eyɔɔ.
Potifar na akɛ Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni ehãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yosef feɔ lɛ shwereɔ yɛ edɛŋ.
Enɛ hã Yosef na hiɛ yɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni lɛ esɔ̃mɔɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Potifar fee Yosef ewe lɛ nɔkwɛlɔ nukpa ni etu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo edɛŋ.
Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Ijiptnyo lɛ wo Yosef onukpa yɛ ewe lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa jɔɔ Ijiptnyo lɛ we lɛ yɛ Yosef hewɔ.
Yehowa jɔɔmɔ ba Ijiptnyo lɛ shĩa nii kɛ eŋmɔshi nii fɛɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Potifar tu enibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ, ni egbaaa ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he ja nɔ ni ebaaye kɛkɛ.
Kɛji ona Yosef lɛ ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Yɛ mli aahu lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋa lɛ kɛ hiŋmɛi ko bɔi Yosef kwɛmɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ mi abawɔ.” Ni Yosef ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ; shi ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ gbaaa ehe naa yɛ enɔ ko nɔ ko he yɛ shĩa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ etu enii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ewo midɛŋ.
Ehã mi hewalɛ yɛ shĩa nɛɛ nɔ tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ekãmãaa mi nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja bo pɛ kɛkɛ; ejaakɛ bo lɛ eŋa ji bo.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni mafee efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hu ni mafee esha mashi Nyɔŋmɔ hu?” Yoo lɛ hiɛ Yosef kɛ wiemɔ daa nɛɛ, shi Yosef eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ awɔ aloo ebɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ gbi lɛ eko lɛ, Yosef tee shĩa lɛ eyaatsu nii.
Shĩa lɛ mli bii lɛ ekoeko bɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ mɔ Yosef atade lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Okɛ mi abawɔ!” Shi Yosef shi etade lɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni ejo foi kɛje kpo.
Be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ Yosef eshi etade lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni ejo foi kɛje kpo lɛ, etsɛ eshiaŋ bii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbakwɛa nɔ ko!
Miwu eyaŋɔ Hebrinyo bi nɛɛ kɛba shĩa nɛɛ koni ebaye wɔhe fɛo.
Eba miŋɔɔ koni ekɛ mi abawɔ, ni mibolɔ waa.
Ni be ni ena akɛ miwo migbee nɔ miibolɔ waa lɛ, eshi etade lɛ efɔ̃ mimasɛi, ni ejo foi kɛje kpo.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ Yosef atade lɛ fɔ̃ emasɛi kɛyashi Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ ba shĩa.
Kɛkɛ ni eyajaje sane lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ewu lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋnuu Hebrinyo lɛ ni okɛba shĩa nɛɛ lɛ, eba ni ebahɔlɔ mi.
Shi be ni mibo waa lɛ, eshi etade lɛ ehã mi, ni ejo foi.” Be ni Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ nu sane ni eŋa lɛ jaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni onyɔŋnuu lɛ bafee mi nɛ” lɛ, emli wo la naakpa.
Ni Yosef nuŋtsɔ lɛ mɔ lɛ, ni eyawo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ he ni awoɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ gboklɛfoi atsuŋ yɛ lɛ, jɛi Yosef hi.
Shi Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ.
Ena lɛ mɔbɔ ni ehã ena hiɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ tu gboklɛfoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ tsu lɛ mli lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsuɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, Yosef ni kwɛɔ nɔ.
Gboklɛfoi akwɛlɔ lɛ gbaaa ehe naa yɛ nii ni etu ewo Yosef dɛŋ lɛ he, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ Yosef yɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ, Yehowa hãa eyeɔ omanye.
Yosef tsɔ̃ɔ gboklɛfoi lɛ alamɔi ashishi Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ lɛ tɔ̃ amɛnuŋtsɔ ni ji Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ.
Farao mli fu epiafoi enyɔ nɛɛ, ni ji edãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ, ni eyawo amɛ tsuŋ yɛ blafoiatsɛ lɛ shĩa yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli he ni akɛ Yosef ewo lɛ.
Blafoiatsɛ lɛ tu piafoi lɛ ewo Yosef dɛŋ ni ekwɛɔ amɛnɔ.
Piafoi enyɔ lɛ ye be kplaŋŋ yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Gbi ko nyɔɔŋ lɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛla, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ elamɔ, kɛ lamɔ lɛ shishi hu.
Be ni Yosef tee amɛŋɔɔ leebi lɛ, eyoo akɛ amɛfee mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebi Farao piafoi nɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ enuŋtsɔ shĩa lɛ mli lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfee mɔbɔmɔbɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛkɛ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Wɔla lamɔi komɛi, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ shishi.” Yosef kɛɛ, “Ani lamɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ lɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni?
Nyɛfainɛ, nyɛgbaa mi lamɔi lɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, daawolɔi anukpa lɛ gba Yosef elamɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mina ni waintso ko ma mihiɛ.
Egbala niji etɛ̃, amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni efimɔ afofro kpɔi, ni egba afofro, ni ewo wainyibii shabii ni etsu.
Mihiɛ Farao kpulu mli; ni mitserɛ wain yibii lɛ, ni miŋa miwo kpulu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mikɛ kpulu lɛ hã Farao.” Yosef kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa olamɔ lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ.
Niji etɛ̃ lɛ damɔ shi hã gbii etɛ̃.
Biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao aaajie bo yɛ tsuŋ, ni ekɛ bo aaayato ogbɛhe lɛ ekoŋŋ ni okɛ Farao kpulu lɛ aaawo edɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ofeɔ sa lɛ be ni bo ji edãawolɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji ehi ehã bo lɛ, miikpa bo fai koni okai mi, ni omli ahi ahã mi koni otsi mitã otsɔ̃ɔ Farao koni abajie mi yɛ tsu nɛɛŋ.
Shi ju aju mi yɛ Hebribii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni biɛ nɛɛ hu mifeko nɔ ko ni sa akɛ akɛ mi awo kpabuŋ nɛɛŋ.” Be ni abolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ na akɛ lamɔ lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ lɛ yɛ miishɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Mi hu mila lamɔ ko.
Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mina ni mitere bodobodo kɛntɛŋi etɛ̃.
Kɛntɛŋ ni ma yiteŋ tɔɔ lɛ, niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni ashãa ahãa Farao lɛ yɛ mli, ni loofɔji miiye yɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli yɛ miyiteŋ.” Yosef hã hetoo ni ekɛɛ, “Naa olamɔ lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ.
Kɛntɛŋi etɛ̃ lɛ damɔ shi hã gbii etɛ̃.
Biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao aaajie bo yɛ tsuŋ ni eeefo oyi ni ekɛ bo aaatsotsoro tso nɔ, ni loofɔji aaaye oheloo.” Ni eba mli akɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, Farao fɔmɔgbi ni.
Eŋmɛ etsuji fɛɛ okplɔ̃ ni ejie edãawolɔi anukpa lɛ kɛ ebolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ yɛ tsuŋ yɛ enukpai lɛ ahiɛ.
Ehã edãawolɔi anukpa lɛ yaye egbɛhe lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni lɛ ekɛ kpulu lɛ wo Farao dɛŋ.
Shi abolooshãlɔi anukpa lɛ, esɛŋ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef tsɔ̃ɔ amɛlamɔi lɛ ashishi lɛ.
Shi dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ eyakaiii Yosef; ehiɛ kpa enɔ.
Yosef tsɔ̃ɔ Farao lamɔ shishi Afii naakplɔi enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Farao la lamɔ ko.
Ela ni edamɔ Nilo faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa, tsinayei dukudukuu fɛɛfɛji kpawo fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli, ni amɛyabɔi niyeli yɛ faa naa glãi lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni tsina yei kpawo krokomɛi ni amɛtãra loo ni amɛhe efee nyaŋemɔ hu fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Amɛbadamɔ tsinai krokomɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Nilo faa lɛ naa.
Ni tsinai ni he yɔɔ nyaŋemɔ ni amɛtara loo lɛ ye tsinai kpawo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni amɛshwishwii dukudukuu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao hiɛ tsɛ̃.
Esaa ewɔ ni ela ekoŋŋ.
Lamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ena ni abele tso kome ekpɛ sɛɛbii kpawo ni eba kpokploo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, abele tso ni ekpɛ sɛɛbii kpawo ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree hu kwɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni abele sɛɛbii kpawo ni egbi kekree lɛ mii abele sɛɛbii ni eba kpokploo lɛ.
Farao hiɛ tsɛ̃ ni ena akɛ lamɔ ni.
Leebi lɛ etsui bɔ̃i yeli.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsu ayatsɛ Ijipt nifeelɔi lɛ kɛ nilelɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba, ni egba amɛ elamɔ lɛ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ Farao lamɔ lɛ shishi etsɔ̃ɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni dãawolɔ nukpa lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Mikai mitɔ̃mɔ ŋmɛnɛ.
Omli fu wɔ, otsuji lɛ, ni owo wɔ tsuŋ yɛ blafoiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ, mi kɛ abolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni wɔyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, mi kɛ lɛ fɛɛ la gbi ko nyɔɔŋ, wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ elamɔ kɛ lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Hebrinyo oblanyo ko ni ji blafoiatsɛ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ yɔɔ jɛi.
Wɔgba wɔlamɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ shishi, mɔ nɛ lamɔ kɛ eshishi, mɔ nɛ hu lamɔ kɛ eshishi.
Bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ shishi lɛ, eba mli nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Akɛ mita migbɛhe ekoŋŋ, ni abolooshãlɔ nukpa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, asɛŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Farao tsu ayatsɛ Yosef.
Ajie lɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi akpabuŋ lɛ mli oya kɛba; ni eshɛ eyi ni etsake etade, ni eba ebadamɔ Farao hiɛ.
Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Mila lamɔ ko, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ mi shishi atsɔ̃ɔ.
Minu ni akɛɛ yɛ ohe akɛ kɛji onu lamɔ ko lɛ, onyɛɔ shishi otsɔ̃ɔ.” Yosef here Farao nɔ akɛ, “Jeee mi mihewalɛ naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaahã Farao hetoo ni hi.” Kɛkɛ ni Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Milamɔ lɛ mli lɛ, midamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ naa, ni tsinayei fɛɛfɛji kpawo ni amɛshwishwii dukudukuu fã kpo kɛjɛ faa lɛ mli, ni amɛbɔi niyeli yɛ faa lɛ naa glãi lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni tsinayei krokomɛi kpawo hu nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛba; amɛnii yɛ mɔbɔ, amɛhe yɛ nyaŋemɔ naakpa ni amɛtãrãtãrãa loo, bɔ ni minako amɛhenɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Tsinai ni etara loo kɛ amɛhe nyaŋemɔ nɛɛ ye klɛŋklɛŋ tsinai kpawo ni eshwishwii lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛye amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛmusu etsɔ̃ɔɔ kwraa akɛ amɛye nɔ ko ejaakɛ amɛkã he amɛyɛ kanyakanya tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃.
Misaa mina yɛ lamɔ mli ni abele sɛɛbii kpokploo kpawo ba tso kome yi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, naa abele sɛɛbii kpawo ni ekwɛ̃.
Abele sɛɛbii nɛɛ, nii bɛ yi ni amɛyɛ legelege ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree.
Abeletsei legelegei nɛɛ mii abele sɛɛbii kpokplokpoo kpawo lɛ.
Migba lamɔ nɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nifeelɔi lɛ, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko naaa he nɔ ko ekɛɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Farao, lamɔi lɛ ekome ni.
Nyɔŋmɔ ejie nɔ ni ebaafee kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Farao.
Tsinai kpakpai kpawo lɛ damɔ shi hã afii kpakpai kpawo, ni abele sɛɛbii kpakpai kpawo lɛ hu damɔ shi hã afii kpakpai kpawo, lamɔ lɛ lamɔ kome ni.
Tsinai kpawo ni etarataraa loo ni he yɔɔ nyaŋemɔ ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ba lɛ, afii kpawo ni; ni abeletsei kpawo ni nɔ ko bɛ amɛsɛɛbii lɛ ayi ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ egbi amɛ kekree lɛ damɔ shi hã hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛɛ Farao akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɔ ni ebaafee lɛ.
Naa, afii kpawo miiba ni abaana niyenii babaoo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi no sɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo baaba, ni mɛi ahiɛ aaakpa ŋmãa kpɔtɔɔ ni ba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hɔmɔ lɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Hɔmɔ ni baanyiɛ sɛɛ aba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ haŋ akai ŋmãa kpɔtɔɔ ni ba lɛ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ enaa baawa naakpa.
Akɛni akɛ lamɔi srɔtoi enyɔ nɛɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ Farao nɔ koome lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo lɛ baaba mli lɛɛlɛŋ, ni etsɛŋ ni ebaaba mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ hã Farao atao mɔ ko ni hiɛ kã shi, ni ele nii koni ehã lɛ ekwɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hã Farao ato nɔkwɛlɔi krokomɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni afii kpawo ni niyenii baaba kpɔtɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, Farao aŋɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niyenii lɛ amlijaa enumɔ mli ekome eto.
Asaŋ hã ni nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ abua niyenii fɛɛ ni aaana yɛ nakai afii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ naa; amɛbua abele naa amɛto koni no afee niyenii ni akɛto yɛ maji lɛ amli.
Aŋɔ nakai niyenii lɛ ato sɛɛ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ hɔmɔ afii kpawo lɛ ni baaba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ koni hɔmɔ lɛ akakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ.” Ato Yosef Amralo yɛ Ijipt Wiemɔ lɛ sa Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ; ni Farao kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔɔnyɛ wɔna mɔ ko ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ yɔɔ emli tamɔ mɔnɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ejie enɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ, belɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni hiɛ kã shi ni le nii tamɔ bo.
Bo obaaye miwe lɛ nɔ, ni bo toi mimaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ aaabo; sɛi lɛ gbɛfaŋ pɛ mafe bo yɛ.” Farao saa ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Naa, miito bo amralo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Farao jie ewolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ yɛ ewao, ni ekɛwo Yosef wao; ewula lɛ kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo atadei ni ekɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ŋmɛ ekuɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ehã Yosef ta eshwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli ni abɔ oshe kɛnyiɛ Yosef hiɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkotoa lɛ!
Nyɛkotoa lɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, Farao wo Yosef Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ onukpa.
Asaŋ Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Mi Farao, mi mi ji Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baawo enine nɔ efee nɔ ko aloo efã enane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni jeee bo oŋmɛ gbɛ.” Farao wo Yosef Ijipt gbɛi akɛ Zafenat-Panea; ni eŋɔ Asenat, Heliopolis maŋ lɛ mli Osɔfo Potifera lɛ biyoo lɛ ehã lɛ gbãlã.
Ni Yosef fãa gbɛ eyakpaa Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yosef eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ be ni ebɔi Farao, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ.
Ni Yosef shiɔ Farao koi lɛ shi efãa gbɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Niyenii kpɔtɔɔ afii kpawo lɛ mli lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ ba niyenii babaoo kɛteke nɔ.
Yosef bua niyenii ni ba kpɔtɔɔ yɛ afii kpawo lɛ mli yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa, ni ekɛ niyenii to maji lɛ amli; maŋ fɛɛ maŋ lɛ, ekɛ niyenii ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmɔjiashi lɛ to jɛi nɔŋŋ.
Yosef bua abele babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia naa eto kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ̃ɔ abele lɛ naa buu ejaakɛ anyɛɛɛ eyikulɛ naa abu dɔŋŋ.
Dani hɔmɔ afii lɛ ba lɛ, Yosef efɔ bihii enyɔ.
Ekɛ Asenat, Heliopolis maŋ lɛ Osɔfo Potifera biyoo lɛ, fɔ amɛ.
Yosef wo ekromɔbi lɛ Manase ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mihiɛ ekpa mihaomɔ lɛ kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” Ewo mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ Efraim ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã miwo shwiei yɛ mimanehulu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Agbɛnɛ niyenii kpɔtɔɔ afii kpawo ni ba yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ sɛɛ bafo; ni hɔmɔyeli afii kpawo lɛ naa je, tamɔ bɔ ni Yosef ekɛɛ lɛ.
Hɔmɔ ba shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ nɔ; shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he lɛ niyenii yɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni hɔmɔ ba Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ fo tsɛ Farao ni ehã amɛ niyenii.
Farao kɛɛ Ijiptbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa Yosef ŋɔɔ, ni nɔ ni eeekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni hɔmɔ lɛ egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef gbele ŋmaatoohei lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ehɔ̃ɔ abele ehã Ijiptbii lɛ ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ mɛi jɛ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ kɛba Ijipt koni amɛbahe abele yɛ Yosef ŋɔɔ yɛ Ijipt ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ yahe abele yɛ Ijipt Be ni Yakob na le akɛ abele yɛ Ijipt lɛ, ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛkwɛkwɛɔ nyɛhiɛ gãagãa nɛkɛ?” Etee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, minu akɛ abele yɛ Ijipt; nyɛyaa jɛi ni nyɛyahea abele nyɛbahãa wɔ koni wɔyi ana wala ni wɔkagboi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef nyɛmimɛi ni ji etsɛbii nyɔŋma lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Ijipt koni amɛyahe abele.
Shi Yakob hãaa Benyamin, Yosef nyɛbi etsɛbi lɛ, kɛ etsɛbii krokomɛi lɛ aya, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Koni aleee nɔ osharã ko akayasharã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob bii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni ba abelehemɔ lɛ ateŋ; ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ eba Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu.
Yosef ji lumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni lɛ ehɔ̃ɔ abele ehãa mɛi fɛɛ.
Enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛbakoto lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
Yosef na enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni eyoo amɛ; shi ekɛ amɛ ye tamɔ gbɔi, ni etutu ehiɛ ewo amɛ.
Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛjɛ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Wɔjɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔba niyeniihemɔ.” Yosef yoo enyɛmimɛi lɛ, shi amɛ lɛ, amɛyooo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kai lamɔi ni ela yɛ amɛhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Saralɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛba ni nyɛbakwɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yayaiaŋ.” Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, dabi, shi moŋ niyenii hemɔ otsuji ba.
Nuu kome bii ji wɔ fɛɛ; anɔkwafoi ji wɔ; jeee saralɔi ji otsuji lɛ.” Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Dabi, nyɛba nyɛbaakwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yayaiaŋ.” Amɛto he akɛ, “Wɔ otsuji lɛ, nyɛmimɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ, nuu kome bii ji wɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; wɔteŋ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛ ŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; ni mɔ kome bɛ jeŋ.” Shi Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nɛ: Saralɔi ji nyɛ.
Nɔ ni akɛaana nyɛnɔkwale nɛ.
Mina Farao akɛ nyɛjeŋ biɛ nyɛyaŋ, ja nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ ebashɛ biɛ dã.
Nyɛtsua nyɛteŋ mɔ kome ni eyaŋɔa nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ kɛba be mli ni nyɛ lɛ awo nyɛ kpabuŋ lɛ, koni akɛkpa nyɛ wiemɔi lɛ shi akɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ lo; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mina Farao akɛ saralɔi ji nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ewo amɛ fɛɛ tsuŋ gbii etɛ̃.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea nɔ ni mibakɛɛ nɛɛ, koni nyɛyi ana wala, shi mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi.
Kɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa atsĩa nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome naa yɛ kpabuŋ lɛ mli, koni nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nyɛŋɔ abele kɛya yɛ hɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛshĩai lɛ hewɔ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ.
No akɛaana akɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, koni nyɛkagboi.” Amɛfee nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, wɔyeɔ fɔ yɛ wɔnyɛmi lɛ hewɔ akɛni wɔna bɔ ni esusuma hao ni ekpa wɔ fai aahu ni wɔbooo toi lɛ.
No hewɔ ni nɛkɛ haomɔ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ.” Ruben here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛkafea gbekɛ lɛ esha ko, ni nyɛbooo toi?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ela shi abiɔ nɛɛ!” Shi amɛleee akɛ Yosef enu nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ shishi ejaakɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni jieɔ enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef tsɔ̃ ehe kɛje amɛmasɛi ni eyafo.
Eku esɛɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛ amɛ bawie.
Ejie Simeon yɛ amɛteŋ ni efi lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Kanaan Kɛkɛ ni Yosef fã akɛ awo amɛkotokui lɛ amli abele obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika aku sɛɛ awo ekotoku mli ekoŋŋ.
Efã hu akɛ ahã amɛ gbɛ nɔ niyenii.
Ni afee nakai ahã amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛjatsui lɛ tere amɛtejii lɛ, ni amɛyi gbɛ.
Be ni amɛshɛ shitoohe ko ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome fɛne ekotoku naa ni ebaahã eteji niyenii lɛ, ena eshika lɛ kã abele lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Akpale mishika lɛ ahã mi, ni naa, no po yɔɔ mikotoku lɛ mli nɛɛ!” Enɛ hã amɛtsui fã kɛ hekpokpomɔ ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni ji enɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee wɔ nɛɛ?” Be ni amɛbashɛ amɛtsɛ Yakob ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛgba lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nuu lɛ ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ hãhã ehiɛ ewo wɔ, ni ebu wɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ saralɔi.
Shi wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ ‘Anɔkwafoi ji wɔ; jeee saralɔi ji wɔ.
Nyɛmimɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ji wɔ, nuu kome musuŋ bii ji wɔ, mɔ kome bɛ jeŋ, ni gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ wɔtsɛ ŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!’ Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni mikɛbaana akɛ anɔkwafoi ji nyɛ nɛ: nyɛshĩa nyɛteŋ mɔ kome nyɛhãa mi ni nyɛŋɔa abele yɛ hɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛshĩai amli lɛ hewɔ kɛyaa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ mibana akɛ jeee saralɔi ji nyɛ shi moŋ anɔkwafoi, koni majie nyɛnyɛmi lɛ mahã nyɛ ni nyɛye jara yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” Shi be ni amɛ jie amɛkotokui lɛ amli nii lɛ, naa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika ni afi kã ekotoku mli.
Be ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ fɛɛ na shika ni afimɔfimɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei.
Ni amɛtsɛ Yakob kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpakpaa mibii yɛ mihe, Yosef bɛ, ni Simeon bɛ, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ Benyamin hu kɛya.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ haomɔ eji kɛhã mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Ruben kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Kɛ mikɛ Benyamin ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ gbee mibihii enyɔ lɛ; bo lɛ tuu lɛ owo midɛŋ, ni mikɛ lɛ baaku sɛɛ abahã bo ekoŋŋ.” Shi Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibi lɛ kɛ nyɛ eyaŋ ejaakɛ enyɛmi lɛ egbo, ni lɛ ekome pɛ eshwɛ; kɛji oshara ko yasharã lɛ yɛ gbɛ ni nyɛyaanyiɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ he ni miyi eyɛ kɛshɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbaahã magbo kɛ awerɛhoo sɔŋŋ.”
Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Benyamin tee Ijipt Hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa lolo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛye amɛbele ni amɛkɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ etã lɛ, amɛtsɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ekoŋŋ, nyɛyahea niyenii fioo nyɛbahãa wɔ.” Shi Yuda kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuu lɛ gba mli kpoo ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ akɛ ja nyɛnyɛmi lɛ fata nyɛhe kɛba dã.’ Kɛji obaahã wɔnyɛmi lɛ afata wɔhe kɛya lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaaya wɔyahe niyenii lɛ wɔbahã bo; shi kɛji ohaŋ eya lɛ, no lɛ wɔyaŋ, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ akɛ ja nyɛnyɛmi lɛ fata nyɛhe kɛba dã.’ ” Ni Yakob kɛɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfee mi efɔŋ nɛkɛ akɛ nyɛtsi tã nyɛkɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ nyɛyɛ nyɛmi kroko hu lɛ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Nuu lɛ bi wɔ kɛ wɔweku he sane fitsofitso akɛ, ‘Ani nyɛtsɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo?
Ani nyɛyɛ nyɛminuu kroko hu?’ Ni wɔhã lɛ nɛkɛ sanebimɔi nɛɛ ahetoo.
Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔle akɛ eeekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi lɛ abaa’ lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ etsɛ Yakob akɛ, “Okɛ gbekɛ lɛ awo midɛŋ ni wɔyi mli kɛya, koni wɔ kɛ bo kɛ wɔbii bibii lɛ ayi ana wala, ni wɔkagboi.
Mikɛ miwala baato awaba yɛ enajiaŋ; bi eshi yɛ midɛŋ.
Kɛji mikɛ lɛ ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa bo ni ona lɛ kɛ ohiŋmɛi lɛ, no lɛ mi, maye eyi sɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ kɛjeee shi wɔshashao lɛ kulɛ benɛ wɔtee Ijipt wɔba shii enyɔ momo.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɛ Yakob kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni nyɛbaafee nɛ: nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai lɛ eko awoa nyɛjatsui amli koni nyɛkɛyakea nuu lɛ: gbonyowoo tsofa fioo, wo fioo, tso mli amã fioo, tsofakɛŋma, kɛ ohɛ ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ amitsrɔbi kɛ ŋmɛ.
Asaŋ shika ni nyɛkɛyaahe nii lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nakai toi enyɔ, ejaakɛ shika lɛ ni akɛwo nyɛkotokui amli lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛkɛku sɛɛ kɛya, benɛ ekolɛ hiɛ ni je nɔ.
Nyɛŋɔa nyɛnyɛmi lɛ hu, ni nyɛyia mli nyɛyaa nuu lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Aba mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ahã nuu lɛ musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, koni eŋmɛɛ nyɛnyɛmi mɔ kome lɛ kɛ Benyamin he ehã nyɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, kɛji aaakpakpaa mibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ mihe jiŋŋ, efeee nɔ ko.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob bii lɛ ŋɔ nikeenii lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ shika falɛ toi enyɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, kɛ Benyamin; ni amɛŋɔ shwie nɔ kɛtee Ijipt, ni amɛyashɛ Yosef hiɛ.
Be ni Yosef na Benyamin fata amɛhe lɛ, ekɛɛ ewe lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ aya shĩa, ni omɔ kooloo okɛfee niyenii oto, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ mi baaye nii shwane nɛɛ.” Nuu lɛ fee bɔ ni Yosef kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ tee shĩa lɛ.
Shi amɛshe gbeyei yɛ Yosef shĩa lɛ ni akɛ amɛ tee lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Shika lɛ ni aku sɛɛ akɛwo wɔkotokui lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ be ni wɔba lɛ hewɔ akɛ wɔ ba biɛ nɛɛ, koni etao sane eshi wɔ koni ekɛ wɔ aye koni eŋɔ wɔ efee enyɔji ni eshɔ̃ wɔtejii lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ Yosef we lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie yɛ shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi amɛkɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, wɔnuŋtsɔ, klɛŋklɛŋ be ni wɔbahe niyenii lɛ ni wɔyashɛ shitoohe ko ni wɔfɛne wɔkotokui lɛ anaa lɛ, naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika kã ebele lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli, wɔshika lɛ yɛ bɔ ni aŋmɛ lɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛhiɛ wɔdɛ̃ŋ kɛba ekoŋŋ.
Ni wɔkɛ shika kroko hu ehiɛ wɔdɛ̃ŋ kɛba kɛhã niyenii hemɔ.
Wɔleee mɔ ni kɛ wɔshika lɛ wo wɔkotokui lɛ amli.” Nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛnaa tsui; nyɛkashea gbeyei.
Eeefee akɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã nyɛto ahuu yɛ nyɛkotokui lɛ amli ejaakɛ nyɛshika lɛ minine shɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ejie Simeon ebahã amɛ.” Be ni sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ kɛ hii lɛ ba Yosef we lɛ, ehã amɛ nu ni amɛfɔ amɛnaji ahe; ni ehã amɛtejii lɛ niyenii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob bihii lɛ fee nikee nii ni amɛhiɛ lɛ klalo amɛto Yosef shĩabaa shwane lɛ ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ amɛ kɛ lɛ baaye nii yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Yosef ba shĩa lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bahã lɛ ni amɛkoto lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef bi amɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛtsɛ nuumo lɛ ni nyɛtsi etã lɛ, eyɛ jeŋ lolo?
Ani eyɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?” Amɛto he amɛkɛɛ, “Otsulɔ, wɔtsɛ lɛ, eyɛ jeŋ lolo, ni eyɛ jogbaŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛho amɛkula shi yɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef wo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ena enyɛmi Benyamin, enyɛ musuŋbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ani nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ ni nyɛtsi etã nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, lɛ nɛ lo?” Ni Yosef kɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ajɔɔ bo, mibi!” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef he fee oya koni eje kpo, ejaakɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni eetao he ko eyafo yɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebote esɛɛtsu lɛ mli, ni eyafo yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni efɔ ehiɛ ni eje kpo.
Emia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkɛ niyenii abamamɔa shi!” Akɛ enɔ eyimuu bama shi, ni ahã hii lɛ hu anɔ yimuuyimuu; ni ahã Ijiptbii lɛ hu ni kɛ Yosef yeɔ nii lɛ anɔ yimuuyimuu; ejaakɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Hebribii kaaa nine yɛ kã kome mli yeee nii; ejaakɛ Ijiptbii miihi no.
Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ batara ehiɛ, kromɔbi lɛ yɛ enukpa gbɛhe, ni gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yɛ egbekɛ gbɛhe lɛ, amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ.
Ajie niyenii kɛjɛ niyenii ni ma Yosef okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli ahã enyɛmimɛi lɛ; shi Benyamin nɔ lɛ fa fe amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ lɛ toi enumɔ.
Amɛkɛ Yosef ye nii, ni amɛkɛ lɛ nu nii, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ na miishɛɛ.
Yosef fá eshĩa lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, “Wo hii lɛ akotokui lɛ amli niyenii obɔ̃bɔ̃, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛtere, ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shika afɔ̃ ebele lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku mli, ni okɛ mikpulu ni ji mijwiɛtɛi kpulu lɛ afata abele shika lɛ he okɛfɔ̃ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ abele lɛ nɔ yɛ ekotoku lɛ mli.” Sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ fee bɔ ni Yosef kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Leebi be ni hiɛ gbele pɛ ni awo Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ agbɛ kɛ amɛtejii lɛ.
Be ni amɛshi maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛshɛko shɔŋŋ he ko kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ eshĩa lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni otiu gbɔmɛi lɛ ni kɛ oyanina amɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ efɔŋ eto ekpakpa najiaŋ nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba nyɛju minuŋtsɔ jwiɛtɛi kpulu lɛ?
No minuŋtsɔ kɛnuɔ dãa, ni asaŋ no ekɛklaa.
Nyɛfee efɔŋ naakpa akɛ nyɛfee enɛ.’ ” Be ni eyanina amɛ lɛ, eti nɛkɛ wiemɔi ni Yosef wie nɛɛ mli ehã amɛ.
Amɛhã hetoo akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ minuŋtsɔ wieɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ?
Kpaoo, otsuji nyɛŋ nɛkɛ nɔ ko afee.
Shika lɛ ni wɔna jwere wɔbele lɛ nɔ yɛ wɔkotokui lɛ amli lɛ, bɛ wɔkɛku sɛɛ kɛjɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛbahã bo; te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni wɔɔju jwiɛtɛi loo shika yɛ onuŋtsɔ lɛ shĩa mli hu?
Otsuji nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dɛŋ ni aaana yɛ lɛ, gbo eeegbo; ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃mɔ minuŋtsɔ nyɔji.” Ni sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Afee bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ lɛ; mɔ dɛŋ ni aaana yɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ minyɔŋ, shi nyɛ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ sɔ̃ ko ewulaŋ nyɛyi.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛtotoo amɛjatsui lɛ amɛmamɔ shi, ni amɛfɛnefɛnee amɛkotokui lɛ anaa.
Yosef sɔ̃ɔlɔ nukpa lɛ bɔi kpulu lɛ taomɔ kɛjɛ onukpa lɛ nɔ, ni eyagbe naa yɛ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ; ni eyana kpulu lɛ yɛ Benyamin kotoku lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ dɔlɛ gbalagbalaa amɛhe atadei; ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo ejatsu etere eteji, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni Yuda kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ bashɛ Yosef shĩa lɛ, Yosef yɛ jɛi lolo; ni amɛho amɛgbeegbee shikpɔŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni pam nyɛfee nɛɛ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ mi lɛ, ele klamɔ̃ lo?” Yuda here nɔ akɛ, “Mɛni wɔbaakɛɛ minuŋtsɔ?
Mɛɛ wiemɔ kwraa yɔɔ wɔnaa?
Aloo te wɔbaajie wɔnaa wɔhã tɛŋŋ?
Nyɔŋmɔ ena otsuji anɔsha lɛ; naa, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ minuŋtsɔ nyɔji, wɔ kɛ mɔ dɛŋ ni ana kpulu lɛ yɛ lɛ fɛɛ.” Shi Yosef kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpaoo!
Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃; mɔ dɛŋ ni ana kpulu lɛ yɛ lɛ, lɛ kɛkɛ eeetsɔ minyɔŋ; shi nyɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, nyɛyaa nyɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.” Yuda kpa Benyamin he fai Kɛkɛ ni Yuda tsi ebɛŋkɛ Yosef ni ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, minuŋtsɔ, hã otsulɔ awie nɔ kome pɛ, ni minuŋtsɔ abo mi toi ni kaahã omli wo otsulɔ la ejaakɛ otamɔ Farao diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.
Minuŋtsɔ bi etsuji akɛ, ‘Ani nyɛyɛ tsɛ loo nyɛmi nuu ko?’ Ni wɔkɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔyɛ tsɛ nuumo kɛ nyɛmi nuu gbekɛ ni ji wɔtsɛ nakutsoŋbi.
Gbekɛ nɛɛ enyɛbi lɛ egbo; ni lɛ ji enyɛbi koome ni eshwɛ; ni etsɛ sumɔɔ lɛ.’ Kɛkɛ ni okɛɛ otsuji akɛ, ‘Nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ kɛbaa koni mana lɛ kɛ mihiŋmɛi.’ Ni wɔkɛɛ minuŋtsɔ akɛ, ‘Gbekɛ lɛ nyɛŋ etsɛ eshi, ejaakɛ kɛji eshi etsɛ lɛ, etsɛ baagbo.’ Kɛkɛ ni okɛɛ otsuji akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmi gbekɛ nɛɛ baaa lɛ, nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ dɔŋŋ.’ “Be ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔtee mitsɛ, otsulɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, wɔgba lɛ wiemɔi ni minuŋtsɔ wie lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni wɔtsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛyaa ekoŋŋ ni nyɛyahea niyenii fioo ko nyɛbahãa wɔ’ lɛ, wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔnyɛŋ wɔya, shi kɛji wɔnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ fata wɔhe lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee; shi wɔnyɛŋ nuu lɛ hiɛ wɔna akɛ ja wɔnyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ fata wɔhe dã.’ Kɛkɛ ni mitsɛ, otsulɔ lɛ, kɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ miŋa Rahel, lɛ ekɛ mi fɔ bihii enyɔ; mɔ kome eshi mi ni mikɛɛ akɛ, tserɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kooloo ko etserɛ emli lɛ, ni minako lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛji nyɛŋɔ mɔ nɛ hu yɛ mihe kɛtee ni osharã ko yasharã lɛ lɛ, no lɛ he ni migbɔ kɛshɛ kɛ miyiteŋ waŋ nɛɛ, nyɛbaahã magbo kɛ awerɛhoo.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, kɛji mitee mitsɛ otsulɔ ŋɔɔ, ni gbekɛ lɛ fataaa wɔhe lɛ, akɛni ewala ji gbekɛ lɛ wala lɛ, kɛ ena akɛ gbekɛ lɛ bɛ wɔteŋ lɛ, eeetswa shi egbo; ni bɔ ni otsulɔ egbɔ kɛ eyiteŋ waŋ nɛɛ, otsuji aaahã egbo kɛ awerɛhoo.
Ejaakɛ otsulɔ kɛ ewala to mitsɛ awaba yɛ gbekɛ lɛ najiaŋ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mikɛ gbekɛ lɛ ekuuu sɛɛ ebahãaa bo lɛ, no lɛ no sɔ̃ lɛ atere mi yɛ mitsɛ hiɛ miwala bei abɔ fɛɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, ofainɛ, hã otsulɔ ahi biɛ akɛ minuŋtsɔ nyɔŋ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ najiaŋ koni ohã gbekɛ lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aku sɛɛ aya.
Ejaakɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ maku misɛɛ maya mitsɛ ŋɔɔ kɛji gbekɛ lɛ fataaa mihe hu?
Nɔ ni baafee mitsɛ lɛ minyɛŋ makwɛ kɛ mihiŋmɛi.”
Yosef tsɔ̃ɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ Agbɛnɛ Yosef nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ emia dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ ni efã ekɛɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aje kpo ashi mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ emasɛi be ni ejie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ejwa yaafo bɔ ni Ijiptbii lɛ kɛ Farao we lɛ mli bii lɛ tete nu he.
Ekɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mi Yosef nɛ.
Ani mitsɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo?” Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ahã ejaakɛ amɛ jijaa yɛ ehiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi koo!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi ji nyɛnyɛmi Yosef mɔ ni nyɛhɔɔ kɛba Ijipt lɛ.
Amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛkahãa edɔa nyɛ ni nyɛmli akawowoa nyɛhe la hu yɛ hɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhɔɔ mi kɛba biɛ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ni tsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛba biɛ koni atsɔ̃ minɔ ahere mɛi ayiwala.
Ejaakɛ afii enyɔ nɛ ni hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eshwɛ afii enumɔ hu lolo ni aduŋ nii ni akpãŋ nii hu.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ koni ahã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ ashwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni ahere nyɛteŋ mɛi babaoo ayiwala ahã nyɛ.
Belɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛhã mibaje biɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ ni; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mitsɔ̃ tamɔ nɔ ni Farao tsɛ ji mi, ni ewo mi ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nuŋtsɔ kɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔyelɔ.
Nyɛhe afea oya ni nyɛyaa mitsɛ ŋɔɔ nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni obi Yosef kɛɛ nɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ewo mi Ijipt fɛɛ nɔ nuŋtsɔ, ba miŋɔɔ; kaatsɛ.
Ba ni obahi Goshen kpokpai anɔ yɛ Ijipt, bɔ ni afee ni obɛŋkɛ mi, bo kɛ obii kɛ onabii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ; ni malɛ bo yɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ eshwɛ hɔmɔ afii lɛ enumɔ lolo ni baaba; koni bo, kɛ owebii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ akabaye ohia.’ “Ni naa, nyɛhiɛ tua, ni minyɛmi Benyamin hu hiɛ tua akɛ mi Yosef diɛŋtsɛ; mi kɛ nyɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛyagbaa mitsɛ bɔ ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Ijipt lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛna lɛ.
Nyɛhe afea oya koni nyɛkɛ mitsɛ aba biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef fua enyɛmi Benyamin ni ejwa yaafo, ni Benyamin hu fua lɛ ni lɛ hu ejwa yaafo.
Yosef saa eshwɔshwɔɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ anaa ni efo.
No sɛɛ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔi wiemɔ.
Be ni anu sane nɛɛ he yɛ Farao we lɛ akɛ Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ eba lɛ, eŋɔɔ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ anaa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ onyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ nɔ ni misumɔɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Nyɛfimɔa jatsui nyɛterea nyɛtejii lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyaŋɔa nyɛtsɛ kɛ nyɛbii kɛ nyɛhɔi kɛbaa.
Mibahã nyɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhi nɔ ni nyɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ.
Asaŋ ofã amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfea enɛ; nyɛŋɔa shwiilii kɛjɛa Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa yɛ nyɛbii kɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ ahewɔ koni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsɛ aba.
Nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe yɛ nyɛnibii ni nyɛbaashi hewɔ ejaakɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnɔ ni.’ ” Yakob bihii lɛ fee nakai; ni Yosef hã amɛ shwiilii yɛ Farao fãmɔ lɛ naa, ni ehã amɛ gbɛ nɔ niyenii hu.
Asaŋ ehã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetsakemɔ atade; shi Benyamin lɛ, ehã lɛ shika jwiɛtɛi kukuji ohai etɛ̃ kɛ hetsakemɔ atadei srɔtoi enumɔ.
Nibii ni ekɛmaje etsɛ Ataa lɛ nɛ: tejii nyɔŋma ni tere Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii kpakpai, kɛ tejiyei nyɔŋma ni tere abele kɛ aboloo ni etsɛ baaye yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ewo enyɛmimɛi lɛ gbɛ.
Be ni amɛyiɔ mli lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkayabea yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.” Ni amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛbakɛɛ amɛtsɛ akɛ, “Ataa, Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo, ni lɛ eyeɔ lumɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yakob yiŋ fee lɛ kɔshikɔshi ejaakɛ eheee amɛ eyeee.” Shi be ni amɛgba lɛ wiemɔ ni Yosef kɛ amɛ wie lɛ fɛɛ ni ena shwiilii ni Yosef hã koni akɛbaŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛtsɛ Yakob he tse lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Omanye sane!
Mibi Yosef yɛ jeŋ lolo!
Matee mayana ehiɛ dani magbo!”
Yakob kɛ eweku fɛɛ fã kɛtee Ijipt No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob fã kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni eba Beersheba.
Eshã afɔlei ehã etsɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob wie yɛ ninaa mli nyɔɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Yakob, Yakob!” Ni Yakob here nɔ akɛ, “Naa mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Kaashe Ijipt yaa gbeyei ejaakɛ mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ jeŋmaŋ kpeteŋkple yɛ jɛi.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mi kɛ amɛ aaatee Ijipt, ni mi kɛ oshwiei aaasaa aba ekoŋŋ; ni ooogbo ofɔ̃ Yosef tsitsiŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛshwie nɔ kɛjɛ Beersheba.
Ebihii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ, kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ tara shwiilii lɛ ni Farao hã akɛ akɛbaŋɔ lɛ Yakob lɛ amli.
Asaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛkooloi kɛ amɛnibii ni amɛna yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Ijipt, Yakob kɛ eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ; ebihii kɛ ebihii lɛ abihii kɛ ebiyei kɛ ebihii lɛ abiyei, eshwiei fɛɛ ekɛba Ijipt lɛ.
Yakob Shwiei lɛ Yakob shwiei ni ba Ijipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Yakob kɛ ebii lɛ: Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, ebihii ji Hanok kɛ Pallu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.
Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Shaul ni ji Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ.
Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Yuda bihii nɛ: Er kɛ Onan kɛ Shela kɛ Perez kɛ Zera, shi Er kɛ Onan gboi yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Perez bihii ji Hezron kɛ Hamul.
Isakar bihii nɛ: Tola kɛ Pua kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron.
Zebulon bihii nɛ: Sered kɛ Elon kɛ Yakleel.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Lea bihii kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Dina ni ekɛ Yakob fɔ yɛ Mesopotamia lɛ.
Yakob bii ni ekɛ Lea fɔ fɛɛ feɔ gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ.
Gad bihii nɛ: Zefon kɛ Hagi kɛ Shuni kɛ Ezbon kɛ Eri kɛ Arodi kɛ Areli.
Asher bihii nɛ: Imna kɛ Ishvah kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Sera.
Beria bihii ji Heber kɛ Malkiel.
Shwiei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa nɛɛ ji bii ni Yakob kɛ Zilpa, nyɔ́ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebiyoo Lea lɛ fɔ.
Yakob ŋa Rahel bihii ji Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Yosef hu fɔ bii yɛ Ijipt.
Ekɛ Osɔfo Potifera biyoo Asenat lɛ fɔ Manase kɛ Efraim.
Benyamin hu bii ji Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Ashbel kɛ Gera kɛ Naaman kɛ Ehi kɛ Rosh kɛ Mupim kɛ Hupim kɛ Ardi.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Rahel kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Dan bi nɛ: Hushim.
Naftali bii ji Yazeel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shillem.
Shwiei kpawo ni Yakob kɛ Bilha, nyɔ́ŋyoo lɛ ni Laban kɛhã ebi Rahel lɛ wo nɛ.
Yakob shwiei diɛŋtsɛ ni ekɛba Ijipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa, esoro ebihii lɛ aŋamɛi lɛ.
Yosef bihii ni afɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ ji bihii enyɔ.
Belɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni jɛ Yakob we lɛ ni amɛba Ijipt lɛ ayibɔ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Yakob kɛ ebii yɛ Ijipt Agbɛnɛ Yakob tsu Yuda kɛtsɔ ehiɛ kɛtee Yosef ŋɔɔ koni Yosef atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛya Goshen; ni amɛba Goshen.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef saa eshwiili ni eyiŋ etee koni eyakpee etsɛ Yakob yɛ Goshen; ni be ni Yosef na etsɛ lɛ, eloo lɛ atuu ni efo eshwie ekuɛ nɔ aahu.
Israel kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ ni mina ohiɛ akɛ oyɛ jeŋ lolo nɛɛ, kɛ migbo tete po miyajɔɔ mihe.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ akɛ, “Miiya Farao ŋɔɔ mayagba lɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan lɛ eba miŋɔɔ.
Gbɔmɛi lɛ tookwɛlɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛlɛɔ kooloi.
Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eba.’ Yosef kɛɛ, ‘Kɛ Farao aaabatsɛ nyɛ ni eeebi nyɛ akɛ, Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ?
lɛ’ nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Otsuji lɛɔ kooloi kɛjɛ wɔblahiaŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni ehã nyɛhi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ Ijiptbii nyaŋeɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji koolookwɛlɔ.’ ”
No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef yiŋ etee eyakɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Mitsɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ejɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba.
Amrɔ nɛɛ amɛyɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hala enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enumɔ ni ekɛ amɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ Farao.
Farao bi Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji nyɛnitsumɔ?” Amɛhã Farao hetoo akɛ, “Otsuji lɛ koolookwɛlɔi ji wɔ, wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.” Ni asaŋ amɛkɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Wɔba gbɔtoo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ otsuji kooloi lɛ naaa nii amɛye yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai ni ohã otsuji ahi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Farao kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ eba oŋɔɔ.
Naa, Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ, hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ahi shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ; hã amɛhi Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni kɛ ole amɛteŋ mɛi ni he esa yɛ koolookwɛmɔ mli lɛ, tuu mitsinai lɛ akwɛmɔ owo amɛdɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛ etsɛ Yakob ba ni ekɛ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Farao, ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao.
Agbɛnɛ Farao bi Yakob akɛ “Afii enyiɛ oye?” Ni Yakob hã hetoo akɛ, “Afii abɔ ni miye yɛ jeŋ shihilɛ mli ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Mifii lɛ faaa ko moŋ nɛ, shi hejaramɔ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛmli.
Eshɛɛɛ wala afii babaoo ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ ye yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Farao ni eje Farao hiɛ etee.
Ni Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ shihilɛhe.
Ehã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ebɛŋkɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rameses lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Farao efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ.
Yosef hã etsɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ niyenii yɛ amɛbii ayibɔ naa.
Hɔmɔ be lɛ Agbɛnɛ niyenii bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko ejaakɛ hɔmɔ lɛ naa ewa naakpa, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Ijipt kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ miihe amɛgboi kɛ hɔmɔ.
Ni Yosef bua shika ni mɛi ni jɛ Ijipt kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛbahe abele lɛ naa.
Ni Yosef kɛ shika nɛɛ ba Farao we lɛ mli.
Ni be ni shika fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tã lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ fɛɛ ba Yosef ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔ nii wɔye!
Shi mɛɛ hewɔ ni oookwɛ ni wɔɔgboi yɛ wɔshika ni etã hewɔ.” Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ni nyɛshika etã nɛɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ahãa mi ni mahã nyɛ niyenii yɛ nyɛkooloi lɛ anaa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛkooloi lɛ bahã Yosef ni ehã amɛ niyenii eŋɔ tsake okpɔŋɔi kɛ too kui kɛ tsina kui kɛ tejii.
Ni ehã amɛ niyenii ekɛhe amɛkooloi fɛɛ nakai afi lɛ.
Be ni nakai afi lɛ ho lɛ, amɛba Yosef ŋɔɔ yɛ afi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko atee wɔnuŋtsɔ, no ji akɛ, Wɔshika kɛ wɔkooloo kui lɛ fɛɛ etã; wɔkɛ fɛɛ ebahã wɔnuŋtsɔ; eshwɛko nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni onaa nɛɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔji pɛ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ oookwɛ ni wɔgboi ni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu aje wɔdɛŋ lɛ?
Ŋɔɔ niyenii ohe wɔ kɛ wɔshikpɔji lɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Farao nyɔji koni wɔshikpɔji lɛ hu atsɔ̃ enɔ.
Hã wɔ dumɔwui koni wɔyi ana wala ni wɔkagboi ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ batsɔ amaŋfɔ̃.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef he Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ehã Farao ejaakɛ Ijiptnyo fɛɛ Ijiptnyo hɔ̃ɔ eshikpɔŋ yɛ hɔmɔ waa ni yeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Farao nɔ̃; ni gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ enyɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ kɛkɛ ni eheee ejaakɛ amɛyɛ sisɛ̃ ni ato ni Farao hãa amɛ, ni sisɛ̃ nɛɛ amɛyeɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhɔ̃ɔɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mihe nyɛ kɛ nyɛshikpɔji lɛ mihã Farao.
Agbɛnɛ, naa dumɔwui!
Nyɛdua yɛ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ amli.
Kɛ shɛ nikpamɔbe lɛ, nyɛbaaja nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ mli enumɔ; Farao baaŋɔ ekome; ni nyɛbaaŋɔ ejwɛ lɛ.
No eko nyɛbaadu, ni no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛbaaye, no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛwebii baaye, ni no nɔŋŋ eko nyɛbii bibii lɛ baaye.” Maŋbii lɛ here Yosef nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Ohere wɔyiwala!
Kɛ ooosumɔ lɛ, hã wɔtsɔmɔ Farao nyɔji.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ŋɔ enɛ efee akpɔ efɔ̃ shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ aja ŋmɔshinii mli enumɔ ni Farao aŋɔ ekome.
Osɔfoi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ Farao nɔ.
Yakob naagbee shamaŋsheo ni ewo Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Goshen lɛ nɛ.
Israelbii nɛɛ nanaa shikpɔji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Yakob hi shi yɛ Ijipt afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
No hewɔ lɛ, afii abɔ ni Yakob ye ji afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpawo.
Be ni Yakob gbele be eshɛ etã lɛ, etsɛ ebi Yosef ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, okɛ onine abahɔ milagbaateŋ ni owo mi shi akɛ obaaye mi anɔkwa.
Kaafu mi yɛ Ijipt.
Shi moŋ kɛji migbo lɛ, wo mi kɛje Ijipt ni oyafu mi yɛ mitsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ.” Ni Yosef here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” Shi Yakob kɛɛ, “Kã mi kitã!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef kã lɛ kitã.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel ma eyi shi yɛ esaatso lɛ yitsogbɛ ni esɔle.
Yakob jɔɔ Efraim kɛ Manase Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Naa, otsɛ he miiye.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ŋɔ ebihii enyɔ ni ji Manase kɛ Efraim efata ehe kɛtee.
Ayakɛɛ Yakob akɛ, “Obi Yosef miiba oŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yakob mia ehiɛ ni ete shi eta saatso lɛ nɔ.
Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ Luz yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɔɔ mi ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, mahã ofɔ pii ni obaashwere, ni mahã oshwiei atsɔmɔ maji pii, ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaahã oshwiei ni aaaba yɛ osɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.’ ” Yakob tsa ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Obihii enyɔ ni ji Efraim kɛ Manase ni ofɔ yɛ Ijipt dani miba oŋɔɔ lɛ, minii ji amɛ.
Efraim kɛ Manase etsɔ̃mɔ mibii tamɔ Ruben kɛ Simeon nɔŋŋ; ni bii ni ooofɔ yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ afee bo onii; shi yɛ gboshiniiyeli gbɛfaŋ lɛ, aaabu amɛ ashi Efraim kɛ Manase nɔ.
Ejaakɛ be ni mijɛ Mesopotamia ni mibaa Kanaan lɛ, Rahel gbo shi mi yɛ gbɛ teŋ, be ni eshwɛ gbɛ kukuoo dani ashɛɔ Efrat lɛ, ni mifu lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ gbɛ ni yaa Efrat ni ji ŋmɛnɛ Betlehem lɛ he.” Be ni Yakob na Yosef bihii lɛ, ebi akɛ, “Namɛi nɛ?” Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Mibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã mi yɛ Ijipt lɛ nɛ.” Yakob kɛɛ, “Okɛ amɛ aba ni majɔɔ amɛ.” Shi gbɔlɛ ehã Yakob hiŋmɛii anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ.
Yosef tsi gbekɛbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etsɛ.
Yakob shwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa ni eloo amɛ atuu, ni ekɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Misusuko kɔkɔɔkɔ akɛ mana ohiɛ; ni naa, Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mina obii hu.” Agbɛnɛ Yosef hole gbekɛbii lɛ yɛ Yakob nakutsei anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Yosef mɔmɔ gbekɛbii enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli, Efraim ye Yakob abɛku nɔ, ni Manase ye Israel ninejurɔ nɔ, ni etsi amɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yakob.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kpã eninejurɔ mli ni ekɛŋmɛ Efraim ni ji gbekɛ lɛ yiteŋ, ni ekɛ ebɛku tsɔ̃ eninejurɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Manase ji kromɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob jɔɔ Yosef ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak sɔ̃mɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ekwɛ minɔ miwala gbii fɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, bɔfo ni jie mi kɛjɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ mli lɛ, ajɔɔ gbekɛbii nɛɛ.
Amɛhewɔ lɛ, migbɛi kɛ mitsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak agbɛi gboŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Amɛyi afa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Be ni Yosef na akɛ etsɛ kɛ eninejurɔ eŋmɛ Efraim yiteŋ lɛ, enaaa he miishɛɛ, ni ewo etsɛ nine nɔ koni ejie kɛjɛ Efraim yiteŋ kɛyaŋmɛ Manase yiteŋ.
Ni Yosef kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Jeee nakai ni Ataa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji kromɔbi; okɛ onine jurɔ aŋmɛ lɛ moŋ eyiteŋ.” Shi etsɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mibi, mile, mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ onukpa lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ maŋ kpele, ni eeetsɔ agbo; shi kɛ̃lɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpeteŋkple fe lɛ, ni eshwiei aaatsɔ majimaji babaoo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yakob jɔɔ gbekɛbii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ nyɛgbɛi Israelbii kɛaajɔɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ Efraim kɛ Manase.’ ” Belɛ Yakob ŋɔ onukpa gbɛhe lɛ ehã Efraim.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob kɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Naa, mi lɛ, migbele be eshɛ etã, shi nyɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni ekɛ nyɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛya nyɛblematsɛmɛi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Asaŋ, bo pɛ ji mɔ ni miŋɔ Shekem shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã, shi jeee onyɛmimɛi lɛ, nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛ miklante kɛ migãi shɔ̃ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛ̃ŋ lɛ.”
Yakob naagbee wiemɔi Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tsɛ ebii lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni magba nyɛ wɔsɛɛ saji ni baaba nyɛ nɔ: “Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛboa mi toi; nyɛ Yakob bihii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ Yakob toi!
“Ruben, bo ji mikromɔbi, miblahiaŋ be hewalɛ mli bi, mɔ ni fe fɛɛ yɛ gbɛnaa kɛ hewalɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Otamɔ nu hamahama ni damɔɔɔ he kome; ofeŋ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ okɛ mihemɔ wɔ, ni owo misaa he muji ni obule misaatso.
“Simeon kɛ Levi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni; amɛkɛ amɛklantei lɛ tsuɔ yiwalɛnii.
Mihiŋ amɛ jinatoo mli, ni mitaŋ amɛkpei amli.
Amɛmlifu mli lɛ, amɛgbe gbɔmɔ, ni amɛkɛ yiŋflɛflɛ fee tsinai akpaketsɛmɛi.
Alomɔ amɛmlifu, ejaakɛ enaa wa; alomɔ amɛmlila, ejaakɛ eyi wa.
Magbala amɛmli mawo Israel magbɛ amɛ mashwã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
“Yuda, onyɛmimɛi lɛ aaajie oyi.
Oooye ohenyɛlɔi anɔ; otsɛbii lɛ aaakoto bo!
Yuda lɛ, jata binuu ni; mibi yagbe milɛloo ni eku esɛɛ eeba!
Eedɛkɛ shi, eebumɔ shi tamɔ jata, tamɔ jatayoo; namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ ajije?
Maŋtsɛyeli ejeŋ Yuda dɛŋ, ni nɔyeli hu ejeŋ eshwiei adɛŋ; gbii abɔ ni jeŋmaji kɛ amɛ onia baa, ni amɛbaa amɛhe shi amɛhãa lɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ etejibi aaaŋmɔ wain tso, ekɛ etejiyoo bi aaaŋmɔ wain tso ni wa.
Ekɛ wain aaafɔ etade he, ekɛ wain tsuru fɔɔ aaafɔ ehebo he.
Ehiŋmɛii aaatsu fɔɔ fe wain, ni enyanyɔji aaayɛ futaa, fe fufɔ.
“Zebulon aaahi ŋshɔ naa; ni ehilɛhe aaatsɔ̃ lɛji adaamɔhe, ni ekɛ Sidon aaaje husu.
“Isakar lɛ, teji ni he wa ni, ni ebuɔ shi yɛ kooloi atsui ateŋ.
Enaa akɛ hejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ akɔnɔ.
Ni eŋɔɔ ekoto sɛɛ ehãa ni atere lɛ jatsu.
Ni anyɛɔ enɔ ni etsu nii tamɔ nyɔŋ.
“Dan aaatsɔ̃ lumɔ ehã emɛi lɛ ni amɛaatamɔ Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ.
Ni Dan aaatsɔ̃ onufu ni ble gbɛ toi, onaŋka ni naa yɔɔ ebɔɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ toi, ni ekɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔ nanetsitsi, ni enɔtalɔ lɛ kpaa gbeɔ shi.
“Yehowa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ, gbɛ miikwɛɔ nɛɛ!
“Gad lɛ ojotswalɔi asafo aaabatua lɛ, shi lɛ moŋ eeewo amɛ foi.
“Asher shikpɔŋ aaaba nii kpɔtɔɔ nii ni sa maŋtsɛ.
“Naftali lɛ ofrote ni foɔ shi kɛkɛ ni; ni enaa ŋɔɔ.
“Yosef lɛ, tso nine ni woɔ yibii ni, tso nine ni ma nuhiŋmɛi he, ni eniji kwɔlɔɔ gbogbo.
Gãitsɛ̃lɔi kɛ hiɛdɔɔ batua lɛ, ni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ lɛ gãi kɛ yiwalɛ.
Shi egãi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ kpɛŋŋ.
Eniji kɛ ekɔ̃ɔji ahe yɛ oya; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ni hã lɛ nakai hewalɛ lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔ lɛ ni ji Israel tɛsaa lɛ, gbɛi lɛ tsu enɛ.
Otsɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni aaaye abua bo.
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ baajɔɔ bo.
Lɛ eeejɔɔ bo kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ ŋwɛi kɛ jɔɔmɔi ni jɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nui lɛ amli.
Eeejɔɔ bo kɛ fufɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ, eeejɔɔ bo kɛ fɔmɔnii kpakpa.
Otsɛ jɔɔmɔi lɛ mli wa fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ, kɛ naanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ ajɔɔmɔi lɛ.
Jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ ashwie Yosef yiteŋ, eshwie lɛ mɔ ni ajie lɛ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ato afã lɛ pampam.
“Benyamin lɛ, klaŋ ni yɔɔ hahaaha ni.
Leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ emɔɔ emilɛloo ni eyeɔ.” Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ; ni wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛ wie be ni ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ jɔɔmɔ ni sa lɛ lɛ, no ekɛjɔɔ lɛ.
Yakob gbele kɛ efuu Yakob wo amɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ miiya mitsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Nyɛfũa mi nyɛfataa mitsɛmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ mli.
Tɛkplo nɛɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ, yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ abɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ, ni eŋɔ fee efuuhe lɛ.
Jɛi afu Abraham kɛ eŋa Sara yɛ; jɛi afu Isak kɛ eŋa Rebeka yɛ; ni jɛi mifu Lea hu yɛ.
Abɔɔ nɛɛ kɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ahe yɛ Hitbii lɛ adɛŋ.” Be ni Yakob ewo ebii lɛ kitãi nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, ebua enaji anaa eshwie saa lɛ nɔ, ni ebu enaa.
Afu lɛ afata emɛi lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yosef ho egbee etsɛ nɔ ni efo ni eshwɔ enaa.
Yosef fã etsuji tsofawolɔi lɛ akɛ amɛwo etsɛ tsofa, ni amɛwo lɛ.
Amɛkɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ wo lɛ tsofa lɛ; ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni ayeɔ kɛwoɔ tsofa lɛ ji no.
Ijiptbii lɛ fo Yakob gbii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Be ni afo Yakob agbe naa lɛ, Yosef kɛɛ Farao we lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛwoa Farao toi nɔ akɛ mitsɛ hã mikã lɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Naa, eshɛ migbele be; mibu lɛ ni mitsa mihã mihe yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi oyafu mi yɛ!’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mayato mitsɛ ni maku misɛɛ maba.” Farao to he akɛ, “Yaa ni oyafu otsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã okã lɛ kitã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yosef yiŋ etee ni eyafu etsɛ.
Farao tsuji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ewe onukpai lɛ kɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai fɛɛ kɛ Yosef shĩaŋbii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ fata ehe kɛtee; amɛbii kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛkɛ amɛshi yɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi hu kɛ Yosef tee; asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ tee lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛshɛ Atad abeleshaahe lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfee yara wulu yɛ jɛi; ni Yosef fo etsɛ gbii kpawo.
Be ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ni ji Kanaanbii lɛ na ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ yɛ Atad abeleshaahe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Abel-Mizraim, eshishi ji Ijiptbii Akɔmɔyeli.
Eyɛ Yordan sɛɛ.
Yakob bii lɛ ye amɛtsɛ kitã ni ewo amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛwo lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ Makpela abɔɔ lɛ mli tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Abɔɔ nɛɛ Abraham diɛŋtsɛ he kɛ tɛkplo lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Efron, Hitnyo lɛ, dɛŋ yɛ Mamre bokãgbɛ ni ekɛfee efuuhe lɛ.
Be ni Yosef efu etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ tee etsɛ fuu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ.
Yosef shɛje enyɛmimɛi lɛ amii Agbɛnɛ be ni Yosef nyɛmimɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛtsɛ egbo lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ekolɛ Yosef ebɛ wɔ ewo emli, ni eeetɔ ehe owele yɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ ni wɔfee lɛ lɛ hewɔ.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã ayakɛɛ Yosef akɛ, “Otsɛ wo kitã dani egbo akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ Yosef awie nɛ, Miikpa bo fai ni okɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ ejaakɛ amɛfee bo efɔŋ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔmiikpa bo fai ni okɛ otsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsuji lɛ atɔ̃mɔi lɛ afa amɛ!” Be ni amɛkɛ Yosef wie nɛkɛ lɛ, efo.
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ tee amɛyabumɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, otsuji ji wɔ!” Yosef kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Minyɛŋ maye Nyɔŋmɔ najiaŋ mafee nɔ ko.
Tsɛbelɛ, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛto nyɛyiŋ akɛ nyɛaafee mi efɔŋ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã etsɔ̃ nɔ kpakpa; bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ no nɔ ahere mɛi babaoo ayiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Mibalɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ.” Bɔ ni ehã enyɛmimɛi lɛ atsui ni eshɛje amɛmii nɛ.
Yosef gbele Yosef hi shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ.
Ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma.
Yosef na Efraim nanakansowai; ni Manase bi Makir bii lɛ hu afɔ amɛ ashwie eshuɔ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Yosef kɛɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Migbele be eshɛ; shi saramɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabasra nyɛ kɛ̃, ni eeekpala nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ ni ekã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi, Yakob bii, lɛ kã lɛ kitã ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ aaakai nyɛ kɛ̃.
Kɛ eeebajie nyɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea miwui lɛ kɛjea biɛ kɛya.” Be ni Yosef eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma lɛ egbo.
Amɛwo lɛ tsofa, ni akɛ lɛ wo adeka mli yɛ Ijipt.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbɛi “Eksodɔs” lɛ ni akɛtsɛɔ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ shishi ji “Shimɔ”, ni shimɔ ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye amɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ, he saji yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli.
.
Bɔ ni fee ni akpɔ̃ Hebribii lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ amɛ lɛ mli kɛ gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ kɛtee kɛyashɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he.
.
Kpãŋmɔ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãŋ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ ni amɛna mlai ni amɛkɛkura henilee yɛ maŋ shihilɛ kɛ jamɔ mli saji.
.
He ko ni ama koni maŋ lɛ aja yɛ jɛi lɛ he saji kɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi ni kɔɔ osɔfoi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ he.
Sane ni ta saji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ji gbɛ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ nɔ ekpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ ni yɔɔ nyɔŋyeli mli, kɛ bɔ ni ehã amɛbatsɔ̃ jaku kome ni na hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ amɛwɔsɛɛ shihilɛ mli baahi ahã amɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ titri ni he sane yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli ji Mose.
Lɛ ji mɔ pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hala akɛ enyiɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛya lɛ.
Wolo nɛɛ mli sane ni mɛi le fe ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ji Kitai Nyɔŋma lɛ.
Eyɛ Yitso lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Israelbii lɛ aheyeli yɛ Ijipt .—.
a. Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔji yɛ Ijipt .- b. Mose fɔmɔ kɛ edalɛ .—.
d. Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ .—.
e. Hehoo lɛ kɛ Ijiptshimɔ .—.
Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he .—.
Mla lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ lɛ .—.
Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ jamɔ he mlai .—.
Awa Israelbii lɛ yi yɛ Ijipt Yakob musuŋ bihii ni fata ehe kɛtee Ijipt lɛ agbɛii nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ ewe: Ruben kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda, Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Benyamin, Dan kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher.
Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Shi ebi Yosef lɛ, lɛ lɛ eyɛ Ijipt momo.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yosef kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ nakai yinɔbii lɛ fɛɛ bagboi.
Shi amɛshwiei, ni ji Israelbii lɛ, fɔfɔɔ ni amɛshwere babaoo.
Amɛyi bafa, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛyi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ hee ko ni leee Yosef baye Ijipt nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa, Israelbii lɛ ayi efa, ni amɛna hewalɛ hu fe wɔ.
Nyɛhãa wɔkɛ amɛ ayea ŋaa mli koni amɛyi akafa dɔŋŋ ni ebaba akɛ be ni ta ehe shi lɛ amɛyafata wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ moŋ ahe ni akɛ wɔ miiwu koni amɛjo foi kɛshi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ totoo nitsumɔ nɔkwɛlɔi yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ koni amɛkɛ nitsumɔi keketekeketei awa amɛ yi.
Israelbii mamɔ nitoo maji ni ji Pitom kɛ Rameses amɛhã Farao.
Shi babaoo ni Ijiptbii lɛ waa Israelbii lɛ yi lɛ, babaoo moŋ ni Israelbii lɛ ayi faa ni amɛshwereɔ ji no.
Enɛ hã Ijiptbii lɛ atsui su Israelbii lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ Israelbii lɛ nyɔji ahiɛmɔ shɛii.
Amɛhã amɛnaa su, ni amɛfo ntayaa, ni amɛtsu ŋmɔshi nitsumɔi srɔtoi, ni enɛ hã jeŋ shihilɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine.
Kɛkɛ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Shifra kɛ Pua, ni ji Hebriyei yoofɔlɔi lɛ, akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛtee Hebri yei lɛ fɔmɔ ni nyɛna yɛ sɛi ni yoofɔyoo lɛ taa nɔ efɔɔ lɛ shishi akɛ bi lɛ nuu ni lɛ, nyɛgbea lɛ; shi kɛji yoo ni lɛ ehi shi.” Shi yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni amɛfeee nɔ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, shi moŋ amɛhere gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayiwala.
Enɛ hã Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɛ yoofɔlɔi lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba ni nyɛhãa gbekɛbii hii lɛ ayi naa wala lɛ?” Yoofɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Ejaakɛ Hebriyei lɛ tamɔɔɔ Ijipt yei lɛ; amɛ lɛ amɛyɛ kamkam bɔ ni be ni yoofɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ eshɛɔ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ amɛfɔ momo.” -Akɛni yoofɔlɔi lɛ yashe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to amɛ ejurɔ, ni eduro amɛ bii.
Yɛ Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, amɛtee nɔ amɛshwere, ni amɛna hewalɛ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao wo emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Binuu fɛɛ binuu ni Hebri yoo aaafɔ lɛ nyɛshɛa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Nilo faa lɛ mli, shi biyoo lɛ nyɛhãa eyi ana wala.”
Mose fɔmɔ Be nɛɛ mli lɛ nuu ko ni jɛ Leviwe yaŋɔ Leviwe nɔŋŋ yoo ko.
Yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu.
Ena akɛ abifao lɛ he yɛ fɛo, hewɔ lɛ ekɛ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃.
Shi be ni eyanyɛɛɛ lɛ ekɛtee dɔŋŋ lɛ, etao adai kɛntɛŋ, ni ekɛ amã tsara he fɛɛ, ni ekɛ abifao lɛ ŋmɛ mli, ni eyashi lɛ ema glãi amli yɛ faa lɛ naa.
Belɛ abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ eekwɛ nɔ ni aaaba enɔ.
Farao biyoo ba ehejuu yɛ faa lɛ naa, ni eweyei lɛ miishara shi yɛ faa lɛ toi.
Kɛkɛ ni ehiŋmɛi gba kɛntɛŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ glãi lɛ ateŋ, ni etsu eweyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni eyawo kɛba.
Be ni Farao biyoo lɛ gbele naa lɛ, naa abifao kã mli ni eefo.
Emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ, “Hebribii lɛ abihii lɛ eko nɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni abifao lɛ nyɛmiyoo lɛ babi Farao biyoo lɛ akɛ, “Ani miyatsɛ Hebriyoo fufɔhãlɔ ko mibahã bo koni ehã lɛ fufɔ ehã bo lo?” Farao biyoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ!
Yaa!” Gbekɛyoo lɛ tee ni eyatsɛ abifao lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba.
Ni Farao biyoo lɛ kɛɛ yoo ni ayatsɛ kɛba lɛ akɛ, “Hemɔ abifao nɛɛ koni oyakwɛ lɛ ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ.” Ehe abifao lɛ kɛtee ni eyakwɛ lɛ.
Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, yoo lɛ kɛ lɛ tee eyahã Farao biyoo lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ Farao biyoo bi.
Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ mijie lɛ kɛjɛ nu mli.” Mose jo foi kɛtee Midian Mose bada.
Gbi ko lɛ etee eyasara emaŋbii Hebribii lɛ, ni eyana nii ni ahãa amɛtsuɔ lɛ.
Ehiŋmɛiŋ, ni Ijiptnyo ko tswa Mose nyɛmimɛi Hebribii lɛ eko nɔ.
Mose kwɛ ehe biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni be ni enaaa mɔ ko lɛ, egbe Ijiptnyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ tee shia mli.
Je tsɛre nɔ hu Mose tee eyasara enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa Hebribii enyɔ ni miinɔ.
Ebi mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni oyiɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo?” Mɔ ni eye sane fɔŋ lɛ hã Mose hetoo akɛ, “Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ?
Gbe otaoɔ ni ogbe mi tamɔ ogbe Ijiptnyo lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsui fã, ni ekɛɛ, “Ei, ana ale sane nɛɛ!” - Be ni Farao nu nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ lɛ, etao Mose egbe.
Shi Mose jo Farao naa foi kɛtee Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyahi jɛi.
Mose ta nubu ko naa, ni Yetro, ni ji Midian osɔfo lɛ, biyei kpawo lɛ ba jɛi koni amɛbasha nu amɛwo tsesei amli amɛhã amɛtsɛ toi lɛ ni amɛnu.
Shi tookwɛlɔi komɛi bashwie amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose te shi ni efã oblayei lɛ ahe, ni ehã amɛtoi lɛ nu ehã amɛ.
Be ni oblayei lɛ ba amɛtsɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛba mra nɛkɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?” Amɛ jie naa akɛ, “Ijiptnyo ko bajie wɔ yɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni esaa esha nu tete ehã toi lɛ amɛnu.” Yetro bi ebiyei lɛ akɛ, “Ni nɛgbɛ nuu lɛ yɔɔ?
Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshi lɛ?
Nyɛyatsɛa lɛ kɛba koni ebaye nii.” Mose kpɛlɛ̃, ni ekɛ Yetro hi shi.
Yetro kɛ ebiyoo Zipora hã Mose gbãlã.
Zipora fɔ binuu, ni Mose wo lɛ Gershom ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Mibato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.” Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ bagbo.
Ni Israelbii lɛ dɔmɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛfo amɛtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nu amɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ, ni ekai kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kpãŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛsane bakã etsui nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Mose Mose miikwɛ eshaanuu Yetro, Midian osɔfo lɛ, toi.
Gbi ko lɛ ekpala toi lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ anaigbɛ, ni eyaje Horeb, Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ lalilɛi, yɛ ŋmeitso ko mli.
Mose kwɛ ŋmeitso lɛ gãa ejaakɛ eetso nɛ, shi eshãaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ matsi mabɛŋkɛ ni mayakwɛ naakpɛɛ nii nɛɛ, nɔ hewɔ ni ŋmeitso lɛ eshãaa lɛ.” Be ni Yehowa na akɛ Mose miibɛŋkɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ, ejɛ ŋmeitso lɛ teŋ etsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mose, Mose!” Mose here nɔ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi!” Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaatsi oba dɔŋŋ!
Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ, shi he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.” Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi ji otsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsĩ ehiɛ, ejaakɛ eeshe gbeyei akɛ eeekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mina amanehulu mli ni miwebii lɛ yɔɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, ni minu ŋkɔmɔ blɔmɔ ni amɛbolɔɔ koni abahere amɛ yɛ amɛkpalalɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ hu.
Amɛnidɔɔ nii lɛ kã mitsui nɔ pam.
Naa, mikpeleke shi miba amɛ jiemɔ yɛ Ijiptbii lɛ adɛŋ, koni makpala amɛ kɛshi Ijipt kɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni da, ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni niyenii pii yɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ, he ni Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii yɔɔ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ akɔmɔyeli lɛ jwere mitoiŋ, ni mihiɛ tua bɔ ni Ijiptbii haoɔ amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ba ni matsu bo Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyajie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Ijipt.” Shi Mose kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mi, ni matee Farao ŋɔɔ ni mayajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt?” Nyɔŋmɔ to he akɛ, “Mi kɛ bo ni yaa lɛ, ni enɛ ji nɔ ni aaaye he odase akɛ mi mitsu bo lɛ.
Kɛji oyajie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt kɛba lɛ, nyɛbaa gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ he nyɛbajaa mi.” Ni Mose here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mitee Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ’, ni amɛaabi mi akɛ, ‘Te egbɛi hu?’ lɛ, te mikɛɛ amɛ tɛŋŋ?” Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mi ji mɔ ni mi ji.
Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji mɔ ni mi ji tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ.’ ” Asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ.
Migbɛi kwraa nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni no yinɔi fɛɛ kɛtsɛ mi.’ Yaa ni oyabua Israel onukpai lɛ anaa, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, ni ekɛɛ, Mikwɛ, ni mina nyɛ kɛ nɔ ni afeɔ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, ni miiwo shi akɛ majie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt amanehulu lɛ mli kɛya Kanaanbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ kpakpa ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
“Israel onukpai lɛ aaabo bo toi, ni okɛ amɛ aya Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ni wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ nyiɛmɔ koni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Shi mi lɛ mile akɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni nyɛya, ja anyɛ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, majie mihewalɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Ijipt, ni mikɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni mafee yɛ jɛi lɛ aaagbala Ijipt toi, ni no sɛɛ dani eeehã nyɛya.
“Ni mahã Ijiptbii ahiɛ asɔ nyɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni be ni nyɛaatee lɛ, nyɛyaŋ lɛ efolo.
Yoo fɛɛ yoo amala shika nii kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mamai yɛ Ijiptyoo ni ji ehe gbɔmɔ kɛ eshiaŋyoo dɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛwowoo nyɛbihii kɛ biyei.
No nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni nyɛaakpakpaa Ijiptbii lɛ ahe nii kɛaatee.”
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Mose naakpɛɛ hewalɛ Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, Israelbii lɛ heŋ mi amɛyeŋ, amɛboŋ mi toi hu, ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ejieko ehe kpo etsɔ̃ko bo.’ ” Ni Yehowa bi Mose akɛ, “Mɛni yɔɔ odɛ̃ŋ lɛ?” Ejie naa akɛ, “Tso.” Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ!” Mose shɛ tso lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, kɛkɛ ni tso lɛ tsɔ̃ onufu, ni Mose jo onufu lɛ naa foi kɛtee sɛɛ.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpã onine mli ni omɔ elei!” Mose kpã enine mli, ni emɔ onufu lɛ lei lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ tso ekoŋŋ yɛ edɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Enɛ amɛkɛaahe amɛye akɛ Yehowa, ni ji Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔɔ bo.” Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa.” Mose kɛ enine lɛ hɔ emiinaa, ni be ni ejie lɛ, naa nine lɛ ni hela ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie he fuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ onine ahɔ omiinaa ekoŋŋ.” Esaa ekɛ enine lɛ hɔ jɛi.
Be ni ejie lɛ, naa ehewolo lɛ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee, ni asaŋ amɛbooo bo toi yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ okadi lɛ naa lɛ, okadi ni ji enyɔ lɛ naa lɛ amɛaabo bo toi.
Shi kɛji amɛheee bo amɛyeee yɛ okadii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛbooo bo toi hu lɛ, no lɛ yɛɛ Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko ni ofɔse oshwie shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ, ni nu lɛ ni oyɛ yɛ faa lɛ mli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ.” Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Ofainɛ miNuŋtsɔ!
Minaa tseee kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe, ni kɛjɛ beyinɔ hu ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, wie nɛɛ fɛɛ, minaa tseko, ni mililɛi tsii.” Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ bɔ naabu hã gbɔmɔ?
Namɔ bɔ mumui loo toimulɔ, loo mɔ ni naa nii, loo shwilafo?
Ani jeee mi, Yehowa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ?
No hewɔ lɛ, yaa otsumɔ lɛ, shi mibawa bo kɛ wiemɔ, ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni owie.” Shi Mose here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, miNuŋtsɔ, tsu mɔ kroko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mli wo Mose la, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani onyɛmi Aaron, Levinyo lɛ, bɛ?
Mile akɛ enaa tse.
Ni ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ po enyiɛ gbɛ eeba ni ekɛ bo abakpe, ni kɛ ena bo lɛ eeenya ohe kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Bɔɔ lɛ amaniɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ.
Mibawa bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli, ni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee.
Aaron aaatsɔ̃ onaawielɔ yɛ okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni eeewie yɛ onajiaŋ, ni bo hu oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã lɛ.
Okɔ tso nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, no okɛbaafee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ.” Mose ku esɛɛ etee Ijipt Mose ku esɛɛ etee eshaanuu Yetro ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, hã maku misɛɛ maya Ijipt mayakwɛ akɛ minyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ wala mli lolo lo.” Yetro to he akɛ, “Yoo, yaa ni oba, gbɛ aŋmɛ ahã bo.” Mose yɛ Midian lolo ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ oya Ijipt, ejaakɛ mɛi ni tao bo agbe lɛ egboi.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋɔ eŋa kɛ ebihii lɛ etara teji nɔ, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛya Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ tso lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛji oyashɛ Ijipt lɛ kwɛmɔ ni naakpɛɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, ofee yɛ Farao hiɛ; shi mi lɛ mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni ehãŋ maŋ lɛ aya.
Okɛɛ Farao akɛ mi Yehowa mikɛɛ, ‘Mikromɔ binuu ji Israel, ni miikɛɛ bo akɛ, hã mibinuu lɛ aya, no lɛ naa, magbe okromɔ binuu lɛ.’ ” Amɛyashɛ shitoohe ko yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni Yehowa bahɛŋ Mose, ni eetao lɛ egbe.
Kɛkɛ ni Zipora kɔ tɛ kakla ni naa ba, ni ekɛfo ebinuu lɛ ketia; ekɛ loo ni efo lɛ sa Mose naji ahe, ni ekɛɛ, “Lá ayɛmforowu ji bo”.
Ketiafoo lɛ hewɔ ni Zipora kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Eji anɔkwale akɛ nuu ni feɔ hii anii ji bo” lɛ.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ Mose ayakpe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.” Aaron tee, ni ekɛ Mose yakpe yɛ Sinai, Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni eshwɔ enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose jaje wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsu lɛ lɛ, kɛ okadii fɛɛ hu ni efã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Aaron.
Ni Mose kɛ Aaron tee Ijipt, ni amɛyabua Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Aaron jaje wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie lɛ, ni Mose fee okadii lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ he lɛ ye.
Ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yehowa ekwɛ ni ena Israelbii lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛmamɔ amɛyitsei ashi ni amɛja.
Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ hiɛ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaye gbi jurɔ amɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.’ ” Farao bi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji nakai Yehowa lɛ hewɔ ni esa akɛ mabo lɛ toi, ni mahã Israel aya?
Mileee Yehowa ko, ni Israel hu mihãaa amɛya.” Mose kɛ Aaron to he akɛ, “Hebribii aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔmiikpa bo fai koni ohã wɔya gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni ekabatua wɔ kɛ gbele hela loo ta.” Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni bo Mose, kɛ Aaron, nyɛhãaa maŋbii lɛ ajwɛŋ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ?
Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nyɛnii!
Agbɛnɛ moŋ ni maŋ lɛ yi efa momo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhãa amɛjɔɔ amɛhe nɛɛ!” Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Farao wo Israelbii lɛ akpalalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa Israelbii lɛ jwɛi tamɔ tsutsu lɛ ni amɛkɛfo ntayaa lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Amɛya amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyatao jwɛi amɛhã amɛhe, shi ntayaa abɔ ni amɛfoɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa amɛfoa nakai nɔŋŋ, nyɛkatsea nɔ.
Amɛmiifee anihao hewɔ ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, ‘Hã wɔya ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!’ Ahã nitsumɔ lɛ anyɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ koni etɔ amɛ ni amɛkana hiɛ amɛbo lakamɔ wiemɔi atoi.” Israelbii lɛ akpalalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Farao kɛɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, ehãaa nyɛ jwɛi dɔŋŋ; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa jwɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaana eko yɛ; shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ atseŋ nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ dɛ̃rɛ̃.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii nitsulɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabuabua gbetselii anaa amɛkɛfee jwɛi.
Kpalalɔi lɛ tsirɛ Israelbii lɛ ayisɛɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛdaa gbi nitsumɔ lɛ naa tamɔ be mli ni ahãa amɛ jwɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni Farao kpalalɔi lɛ yi Israelbii ni afee amɛ nɔkwɛlɔi akɛto nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛgbeee daa gbi ntayai ni ato ahã nyɛ ni nyɛfo lɛ anaa tamɔ sa lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ tee Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyabolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane okɛyeɔ wɔ, otsuji nɛɛ?
Ahãaa wɔ jwɛi, shi akɛɛ doo wɔfo ntayaa kɛ̃.
Aayi wɔ yɛ no hewɔ, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ jɛ omaŋbii lɛ.” Farao here amɛnɔ ekɛɛ, “Hejɔ̃lɔi ni nyɛ ji hewɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Hã wɔya ni wɔyashã afɔle wɔhã Yehowa lɛ.’ Nyɛyaa nyɛyatsua nii lɛ moŋ.
Jwɛi ni ji jwɛi lɛ ahaŋ nyɛ eko, shi ntayai lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo nakai nɔŋŋ.” Israelbii lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ na akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ be ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsea nyɛdaa gbi ntayaa ni sa ni nyɛfo lɛ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ” lɛ.
Be ni amɛshi Farao ŋɔɔ amɛyaa lɛ, amɛyanina Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmiimɛ amɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Yehowa akojo nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛhã wɔsane eje Farao kɛ etsuji agugɔŋ fũ, ni nyɛwo amɛdɛ̃ŋ klante ni amɛkɛgbe wɔ.” Mose ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa eku esɛɛ etee Yehowa hiɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, mɛɛba moŋ ofee wɔ, omaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba kwraa otsu mi biɛ mɔ?
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miba mikɛ Farao bawie yɛ ogbɛi mli nɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ sɔŋŋ efeɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni jiemɔ hu ojieko amɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpaako obaana nɔ ni mibafee Farao.
Ja minineshiwalɛ naa dani eeehã Israelbii lɛ aya.
Anɔkwa, minineshiwalɛ naa hu dani eeeshwie amɛ kɛje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Mose Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, mi mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ.
Shi migbɛi Yehowa lɛ, mihãaa akɛ no ale mi.
Ni misaa mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋ akɛ mikɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ baahã amɛ, shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ hu, minu Israelbii ni Ijiptbii lɛ yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ akɔmɔyeli blɔmɔ lɛ he, ni mikai mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ mikɛɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, ni majie nyɛ, ni mawo Ijiptbii lɛ ajatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkuɛ nɔ, ni mahere nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli.
Mikɛ mihewalɛ aaakpɔ̃ nyɛ, ni no nɔŋŋ mikɛaagbala Ijiptbii lɛ atoi.
Maŋɔ nyɛ mafee mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt nyɔŋyeli lɛ mli lɛ.
Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ nɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa.’ ” Mose bɔ Israelbii lɛ amaniɛ, shi amɛbooo Mose toi yɛ amɛwerɛ ni eho amɛhe kɛ amɛnɔ nyɔŋyeli ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ayawie, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ aje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛya.” Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, Israelbii lɛ tete boko mi toi, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu; ni minaa hu tseee nɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie, ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛya Israelbii lɛ kɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, koni amɛyajie Israelbii lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mose kɛ Aaron wekukpãa Yakob, ni batsɔ̃ Israel lɛ, kromɔbi Ruben bihii nɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ruben wekui lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
Simeon bihii nɛ: Yemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Ohad kɛ Yakin kɛ Zohar kɛ Shaul, Kanaanyoo lɛ bi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Simeon wekui lɛ ayitsei.
Levi bihii nɛ: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa.
Levi ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Gershon bihii nɛ: Libni kɛ Shimei.
Amɛ hu amɛna wekui.
Kohat bihii nɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.
Kohat ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃.
Merari bihii nɛ: Maheli kɛ Mushi.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levi wekui lɛ ayitsei yɛ amɛfɔmɔ naa.
Amram ŋɔ enyɛkwɛ̃ Yokebed, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose.
Amram ye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Izhar bihii nɛ: Kora kɛ Nefeg kɛ Zikri.
Uziel bihii nɛ: Mishael kɛ Elzafan kɛ Sitri.
Aaron ŋɔ Aminadab biyoo Elisheba, ni ji Nahashon nyɛmiyoo lɛ.
Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Kora bihii nɛ: Asir kɛ Elkana kɛ Abiasaf.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kora wekui lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
Aaron bi Eleazar yaŋɔ Putiel biyoo ni ekɛ lɛ hi shi, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Finehas.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii awei kɛ shĩai lɛ ayitsei lɛ.
Aaron kɛ Mose nɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyajiea Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ” lɛ, amɛ amɛyabi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa fã Mose kɛ Aaron Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa.
Kɛɛmɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ.” Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, minaa tseee.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Farao aaabo mi toi hu.”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, miihã otsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ohã Farao, ni onyɛmi Aaron aaatsɔ̃ ogbalɔ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifã bo ni owie lɛ, kɛɛmɔ onyɛmi Aaron, ni lɛ ekɛ Farao awie koni eŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛya.
Shi mahã Farao akpliŋ etsui, ni okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii babaoo ni mafee yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eboŋ nyɛ toi.
No baahã mikɛ Ijipt aye kɛ joomɔ, ni magbala etoi, ni majie mimaŋ Israel kɛje Ijipt.
Kɛ migbala Ijiptbii lɛ atoi, ni mijie Israelbii lɛ kɛje amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no Ijiptbii kɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa.” Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni amɛkɛ Farao yawie nɛɛ lɛ, Mose eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni Aaron hu eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Aaron tso lɛ Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Kɛji Farao kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfea naakpɛɛ nɔ ko’ lɛ, no lɛ Mose, kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, ‘Kɔ otso lɛ ni okɛfɔ̃ shi yɛ Farao hiɛ; ni tso lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onufu.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron tee Farao ŋɔɔ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni Yehowa efã amɛ lɛ.
Aaron kɛ etso lɛ fɔ shi yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni tso lɛ tsɔ onufu.
Kɛkɛ ni Farao hu hã ayatsɛ nilelɔi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛba.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Ijipt ashwãifeelɔi lɛ.
Amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛkunyaayeli ŋai lɛ fee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ etso fɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni tsei lɛ tsɔmɔ onufui; shi Aaron tso lɛ mimii amɛtsei lɛ.
Shi Farao kpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Amanehului ba Ijipt nɔ Nu tsɔ la Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Farao tsui wa, ekpɛlɛɛɛ ni maŋ lɛ yaa.
Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ leebi.
Ebaaje kpo eya faa lɛ naa.
Kɔ tso lɛ ni tsɔ onufu lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oyadamɔ jɛi omɛ lɛ.
Okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa, ni ji Hebribii lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyaja mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni naa, okpɛ̃lɛko kɛbashi benɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ okɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ.
Naa, mikɛ tso ni mihiɛ yɛ midɛ̃ nɛɛ baatswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ baatsɔ̃ lá.
Nilo Faa lɛ mli loi baagboi, ni faa lɛ baasha bɔ ni Ijiptbii aaanyaŋe Nilo numɔ!’ ” Ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ, ‘Kɔ otso lɛ ni okpã onine mli yɛ Ijipt nu fɛɛ nu, ni ji fai kɛ nujɔi ni aje gbɛ agbala kɛ bukoi kɛ nu ni bua shi fɛɛ, nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ lá.
Nu ni yɔɔ tso kɛ tɛ gogai amli fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ lá.’ ” Mose kɛ Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ.
Aaron wo etso lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛtswa Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ yɛ Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ ni faa lɛ mli nu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ lá.
Loi ni yɔɔ faa lɛ mli lɛ gboi, ni faa lɛ sha bɔ ni Ijiptbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nilo mli nu amɛnu.
Lá sɔŋŋ ji Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Shi Ijipt ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ hu kɛ amɛkunyaayelɔi fee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hã Farao tee nɔ ekpliŋ etsui, ni ebooo Mose kɛ Aaron toi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ni Farao ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ, ni nɔ ni afee lɛ gbaaa enaa kwraa.
Ni Ijiptbii fɛɛ jejee nubui yɛ faa lɛ hewɔ koni amɛna nu amɛnu ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ Nilo mli nu amɛnu.
Ni be ni Yehowa ehã Nilo faa lɛ etsɔ̃ lá sɛɛ lɛ, gbii kpawo baho ni faa lɛ yɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Kɔkɔdenei ba Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaa Farao ŋɔɔ koni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ; hã mimaŋ lɛ aya ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ mi.
Shi kɛji okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni amɛya lɛ, mikɛ kɔkɔdenei baahao oshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Nilo Faa lɛ baawo kɔkɔdenei nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, ni kɔkɔdenei nɛɛ aaaba owe lɛ kɛ osa nɔ kɛshɛ osɛɛtsuŋ; amɛaaba otsuji ashĩai kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ateŋ kɛ nyɛflɔnɔi kɛ nyɛmã tsesei fɛɛ amli.
