“Omɔ too ojwɛni kome lɛ hu agbɛnɛ, ni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie eyiteŋ, ni ogbe too lɛ, ni okɛ too lá lɛ eko asa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ ebihii lɛ hu aninejurɔ toii anaa kɛ amɛninejurɔ kɛ nanejurɔ gɔŋtii anaa, ni okɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko kɛ mɔmufɔɔ mu lɛ hu eko ni okɛshwã Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni okɛshwã Aaron bihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, koni okɛfee Aaron kɛ ehewulamɔ nibii lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu kɛ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
“Jiemɔ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ emlinii ahe fɔ lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he, kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ hu, kɛ too lɛ ninejurɔ shuɔ (ejaakɛ osɔfowoo afɔle too ojwɛni ni), ni oŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ mã akpiti keeki ni awo mli fɔ kome, yɛ aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kafu ni maa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ lɛ mli, ni okɛwo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛfɔ̃ niyenii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni amɛkɛhãa mi, Yehowa.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohe nibii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃ ni oma fɛɛ naa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã ofata shãa afɔle lɛ he akɛ afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa; ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
“Too ojwɛni lɛ ni akɛshã Aaron osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, jiemɔ etsitsi lɛ koni ofɔ̃ otsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ afɔle ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã mi Yehowa ni.
Tsitsi nɛɛ afee ogbɛfaŋ nɔ.
“Agbɛnɛ too tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ ni afɔ̃ɔ akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ji loo ni ajie yɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfowoo afɔle lɛ, feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ gbɛnaanii ni akã shi daa ni sa akɛ Israelbii lɛ atuu ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eji osɔfo gbɛnaanii ni yɔɔ nii ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbaashã Yehowa toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ mli.
“Aaron hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atsɔ̃ ebihii lɛ anii yɛ egbele sɛɛ, ni no amɛwo kɛji aafɔ amɛ mu koni atuu osɔfoyeli lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ.
Ni Aaron binuu, mɔ ni baaye enajiaŋ akɛ osɔfonukpa, lɛ, ewo nibii nɛɛ gbii kpawo kɛji eeba Kpee Buu lɛ mli ebasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
“Oŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ loo lɛ koni ohoo yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ loo lɛ aye aboloo lɛ ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Amɛye nii ni akɛkpãtãa ni akɛwo amɛ osɔfo, ni asaŋ akɛfee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Mɔ folo ko akaye nii nɛɛ eko ejaakɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Kɛji osɔfowoo afɔle loo aboloo lɛ eko shwɛ ni je tsɛre nɔ lɛ, no lɛ akɛ la ashã; akaye ejaakɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
“Bɔ ni mifã bo nɛɛ, feemɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ nakai.
Gbii kpawo okɛwo amɛ osɔfo lɛ.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ omɔ tsina kome koni okɛshã afɔle ni okɛkpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ, ni okɛ kpãtãmɔ ni obaakpãtã nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akpala afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha, ni ofɔ latɛ lɛ mu koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Okɛ gbii kpawo akpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha hewɔ koni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaasa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ afee krɔŋkrɔŋ.” Daa gbi afɔle “Agbɛnɛ afɔle ni oshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nɛ: Daa gbi lɛ toobii enyɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Okɛ toobi kome ashã afɔle leebi, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã afɔle gbɛkɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ toobi lɛ okɛ ŋmaa mamu yiteremɔ kilo mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni akɛ fɔ ni ashi mli lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome akpɔtɔ afata he, kɛ wain lita mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome ni akɛshã afɔle lɛ.
Ni toobi kome lɛ hu okɛshã afɔle gbɛkɛ.
Okɛ niyenii kɛ dãa, tamɔ leebi nibii lɛ afalɛ nakai nɔŋŋ, afata he ni oshã, ni ahã eje ŋma.
Eji afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma lɛ.
Etsɔ̃ afɔle ni ashãa daa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ amli, yɛ mi Yehowa, mihiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Jɛi mikɛ nyɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni mikɛ bo awie yɛ.
Ni jɛi mikɛ Israelbii lɛ aaakpe yɛ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ he krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ minunyam lɛ hewɔ.
Mahã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ afee krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni asaŋ mafee Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi.
Ni mahi Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
Ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni mahi amɛteŋ lɛ; mi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Tsofakɛŋma latɛ lɛ “Oma latɛ ni ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ.
Akɛ tso afee.
Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu afee ninetalɔ kome, ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ aye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ afee ninetalɔi enyɔ.
Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ afee nɔ muu kome.
Okɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi aha he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe, kɛ ehe akloŋtoi lɛ hu, ni okɛ shika abaŋ latɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe.
Ofee shika gai enyɔɔnyɔ owo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei bloblobii ahɔlɔ gaii nɛɛ amli ni akɛwo.
Okɛ tso lɛ eko agbɔ tsei nɛɛ ni aha he shika.
Okɛ latɛ lɛ ama muhɔɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ, ni ji he ni mikɛ bo aaakpe yɛ lɛ, hiɛ.
Aaron ashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ.
Daa leebi kɛji etee kanei lɛ saamɔ hã suu lɛ, eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ; ni kɛji etee eyasu kanei lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, eshã tsofakɛŋma nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ nɔ.
Daa tsofakɛŋmashãa nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ akã shi ahã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ.
Akashã tsofakɛŋma ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ loo kooloo loo niyenii afɔle ko kwraa yɛ nɔ, ni akafɔse wain akɛ dãa afɔle ashwie nɔ.
Aaron kɛ kooloo ni akɛkpãtãa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ esha ni afee hewɔ lɛ lá lɛ akpa latɛ lɛ akloŋtoi lɛ ahe, ni ekɛkpãtã shi kome daa afi.
Efee kpãtãmɔ nii nɛɛ shi kome daa afi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ amli.
Eji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã mi, Yehowa.” Kpee Buu Shihilɛhe lɛ hetooyeli Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kanemɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni kɛ ona amɛyikulɛ lɛ, ohã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo eyi too yɛ ekpɔ̃mɔ̃ hewɔ ehã mi Yehowa, koni gbele hela akaba amɛteŋ kɛbakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ kanemɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ni too ni áye lɛ nɛ: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakane lɛ lɛ awo jwiɛtɛi shekel fã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shekel lɛ tsiimɔ naa akɛ shidaa afɔle ni akɛhãa mi, Yehowa.
(Shekel kome feo gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.)
Mɛi ni abaakane lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo mi, Yehowa, mitoo nɛɛ.
Kɛji aawo, mi Yehowa mitoo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛkpãtãa nyɛhãa nyɛwala lɛ, niiatsɛ akahã fe jwiɛtɛi shekel fã nɛɛ, ni ohiafo hu akahã nɔ ni shɛɛɛ nakai.
Hemɔ kpãtãmɔ too nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii adɛŋ ni akɛto koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nii, koni ehã Yehowa akai Israelbii lɛ daa ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ too lɛ miikpãtã Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛhã nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwala.” Akɔɔble okpolu lɛ Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Asaŋ okɛ akɔɔble afee okpolu.
Okɛ akɔɔble nɔŋŋ afee shimaa nɔ koni okpolu lɛ ama nɔ.
Okɛma Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni oyɛ nu owo mli koni Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe.
Kɛji amɛyaabote Kpee Buu lɛ mli aloo amɛyaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛbasɔ̃mɔ mi ni amɛshã afɔle ni akɛ la shãa amɛhã mi Yehowa lɛ, amɛfɔfɔlɔ amɛhe koni amɛkagboi.
Amɛfɔfɔlɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe koni amɛkagboi; ni enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ahã Aaron kɛ eshwiei yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ amli kɛya naanɔ.” Mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋma kpakpai nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: tso mli mu ni jeɔ ŋma shekel ohai enumɔ, kɛ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma nakai bɔ fã, ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kooŋkpãa ni jeɔ ŋma ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ kashia tso lɛ hu kiloi etɛ̃ ni aŋmɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa, kɛ mutso mu lita kome.
Futumɔ nibii nɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa, ni okɛfee mu, ni ji mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ.
Okɛ mu nɛɛ ashwã Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ, kɛ nibii nɛɛ hu: okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ ni yɔɔ nane ni ta shi lɛ.
Ofee enɛ koni okɛtsuu amɛhe ni ehã amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi, bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaasa amɛhe lɛ aaafee krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ofɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ mu, ni ofee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛye osɔfo amɛhã mi.
Ni okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, enɛ baafee mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛbaafɔ mɔ mu yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Akɛkafɔ mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ, ni nyɛkafea eko hu ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ afutu no lɛ.
Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni, ni ahi shi nakai ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafutu mu ko tamɔ no, aloo ekɛ mu nɛɛ eko aaasa mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ he lɛ atswa enaneshi tu.’ ” Tsofakɛŋma lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ eko: krɔbɔo kɛ onitsa kɛ galbano.
Tsofakɛŋmai nɛɛ okɛ mire ŋmiiŋmi afata he; ŋmɛɛ eko fɛɛ eko falɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni okɛfee tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa.
Awo mli ŋoo koni ekafite, ni afutu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ojeŋmafeelɔ futuɔ ojeŋma ehãa.
Emli atse, ni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Oshimɔ eko ni ebo mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni okɛ eko ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, he ni mikɛ bo aaakpe yɛ lɛ.
Tsofakɛŋma nɛɛ afee nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi ahã nyɛ.
Tsofakɛŋma ni obaafee nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkakwɛa bɔ ni afutu lɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ni nyɛmiifee eko nyɛmiihã nyɛhe.
Abu lɛ akɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ hã mi, Yehowa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee eko tamɔ no, ni eeeshã lɛ atswa enaneshi tu.”
Ŋaalɔi ni baama Kpee Buu lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, mije gbɛ mitsɛ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ ewo emli obɔ̃, ni miduro lɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ, koni ekɛye sama, ni ekɛŋa shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble ŋaa, ni ekɛfolɔ tɛi ni akɛtaraa nibii amli, ni ekɛkpɛ tso ni akɛtsuɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Ni naa, mi nɔŋŋ miŋɔ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mifata Bezaleel he.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiŋ lɛ, miduro amɛ ŋaa koni amɛnyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni miwo bo he kitã nɛɛ amɛtsu: Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ ni buɔ naa lɛ, kɛ Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ kanetso ni akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ akɔɔble okpolu lɛ.
Ni asaŋ amɛfee wulamɔ nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ ni ji Aaron, Osɔfo lɛ, hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nii ni amɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛfee mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni abaashã yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Amɛfee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni mi mifã bo lɛ.” Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Asaŋ mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nyɛyea, ejaakɛ eji okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kɛmiiya nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ hã nyɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabule gbi nɛɛ lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatswa enaneshi tu.
Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi kɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hã mi, Yehowa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ gbe aaagbe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ aye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, amɛye yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
Mi kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ okadi ji no kɛmiiya naanɔ; ejaakɛ gbii ekpaa, mi, Yehowa, mikɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ mijɔɔ mihe, ni miwo mitsui.’ ” Be ni Yehowa kɛ Mose ewie egbe naa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ tɛi enyɔ ni ji tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii ni lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ewao eŋma nii yɛ nɔ lɛ hã Mose.
Shika Tsinabi lɛ Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Mose eyatsɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpelekeee shi lɛ, amɛbua amɛhe naa, ni amɛtee Aaron ŋɔɔ amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni ofee nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpɔlɔa shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ atoiiaŋ lɛ nyɛbahãa mi.” Maŋ lɛ fɛɛ kpɔlɔ shika toiiaŋnii ni yɔɔ amɛtoiiaŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛbahã Aaron.
Aaron he toiiaŋnii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni esere fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaayeli dade tsu he nii, ni eshwie lɛ tsina.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!” Be ni Aaron na enɛ lɛ, ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ tsina lɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshiɛ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, aye gbijurɔ ahã Yehowa.” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋbii lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ niyenii afɔlei hu ba, ni maŋ lɛ ho tara shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii hu, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛte shi amɛshwɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, shi omaŋbii lɛ ni okɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ ewo amɛhe muji.
Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛje gbɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ shika efee tsinabi, ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛshã afɔlei hu amɛhã lɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ yɛ ehe ji, ‘Israel, naa wɔnyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ei!’ ” Yehowa tee nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mina nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ akɛ maŋ ko ni kuɛŋ ti.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã mimli awo la awo amɛ koni maplenee amɛ; shi bo lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple.” Mose kpa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, mɛɛba ni omli woɔ la woɔ omaŋ ni okɛ hewalɛ kpele kɛ nineshiwalɛ eyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ?
Mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ooohã Ijiptbii ana hegbɛ amɛwie akɛ, ‘Moaŋ yiŋ fɔŋ ni eto hewɔ eyajie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eplenee amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ Na tsui ohã amɛ, ni efɔŋ ni oto oyiŋ akɛ obaafee amɛ lɛ, okɛfa amɛ.
Kaimɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ okã amɛ kitã, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mahã nyɛshwiei afa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ he lɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii kɛya naanɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ efɔŋ ni kulɛ eto akɛ ebaafee Israelbii lɛ fa amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɔ ehe, ni eje gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma nii yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ninenaa nitsumɔ ji tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, ni nii ni aŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋma.
Be ni Yoshua nu akɛ aabɔ oshe hoo yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Aabolɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli tamɔ ta mli blɔmɔ.” Shi Mose here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nɔ he ni minuɔ lɛ, ejeee mɛi komɛi kunimyeli he oshebɔɔ, ni ejeee yaafo ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nine etsɔ̃ mɛi komɛi anɔ hu, shi moŋ lala ni aahere nɔ ni.” Ni amrɔ pɛ ni Mose bɛŋkɛ shitoohe lɛ ni ena tsina lɛ kɛ joo ni maŋ lɛ joɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni emli wo la, ni ekɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ tswia shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo tsina lɛ ni maŋbii lɛ efee lɛ, ni ekɛwo la mli ni eshã, ni egbɛlɛ lɛ mlumlu, ni ekɛshwã nu hiɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ nu.
Ni Mose bi Aaron akɛ, “Mɛni po maŋbii nɛɛ fee bo hewɔ ni ohã amɛfee esha kpele nɛkɛ?” Aaron jie enaa ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ mli akawo mi la.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ efɔŋ feemɔ.” Ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, “Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko ohã wɔ ni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛya, shi nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ, ni ji nuu ni yajie wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ koome ni efee lɛ.” Ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ shika nii lɛ ekpɔlɔ kɛba, ni amɛkpɔlɔ kɛba, ni mikɛwo la mli, ni etsɔ̃ tsina nɛɛ.” Be ni Mose na akɛ maŋ lɛ efee yuuyaa (ejaakɛ Aaron ehã amɛfee yuuyaa, ni amɛbɔ amɛhe ahora amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi) lɛ, eyadamɔ shitoohe lɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ebo etsɛ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ?
Mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Mose ŋɔɔ.
Ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nuu fɛɛ nuu akɔ eklante eŋmɔ, ni nyɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, kɛjɛ agbonaa kɛya agbonaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enyɛmi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe enaanyo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe ehe gbɔmɔ.’ ” Levibii lɛ fee bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Levibii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛhã Yehowa sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akɛni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ te shi ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi lɛ, Yehowa ejɔɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ.” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfee esha kpeteŋkple.
No hewɔ lɛ, makwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya Yehowa ŋɔɔ.
Eko lɛ eeebo mifaikpamɔ toi, ni eeeŋɔ nyɛhe esha lɛ efa nyɛ.” Ni Mose ku esɛɛ etee Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ao, maŋ nɛɛ efee esha kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ akɛ amɛfee shika amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.
Ofainɛ, okɛ amɛhe esha lɛ afa amɛ; shi kɛji ehiii nakai feemɔ lɛ no lɛ gbee mi moŋ migbɛi yɛ wolo ni oŋma omɛi agbɛii yɛ mli lɛ mli.” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni efee esha eshi mi lɛ, lɛ egbɛi magbe yɛ miwolo lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, yaa ni oyakpala maŋ lɛ kɛya he ni mi kɛ bo ewie he eto lɛ.
Naa, mibɔfo lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, shi moŋ kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela bote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛfee, ni Aaron fee shika tsina lɛ.
Israelbii fã kɛjɛ Sinai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yi mli ni oje biɛ, bo kɛ maŋ ni oyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba lɛ, kɛya shikpɔŋ ni mikã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ehe kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei mikɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baahã’ lɛ nɔ.
Mibatsu mibɔfo kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ, ni mashwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Nyɛmiiya shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni baa nii nɔ, shi mikɛ nyɛ enyiɛŋ kɛyaŋ, ejaakɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, koni moŋ mikayaplene nyɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.” Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ amɛye ŋkɔmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɔ̃ɔ jwinewoo.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ, ni kɛji mibaye hiŋmɛitswaa kome kɛkɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ mibaplene nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpɔlɔa jwinei lɛ yɛ nyɛhe koni makwɛ nɔ ni mafee yɛ nyɛhe.’ ” No hewɔ ni Israelbii lɛ jie amɛhe jwinei fɛɛ, ni amɛkpa woo kɛjɛ be ni amɛshi Horeb, ni ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ Kɛji Israelbii lɛ to shi lɛ Mose kɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa ni eyashiɔ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Kpee Buu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miitao Yehowa nii ebi lɛ, ejeɔ kpo kɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Be fɛɛ be ni Mose aaaje kpo kɛmiiya Buu lɛ he lɛ, maŋbii teteɔ shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ badamɔɔ ebuu shinaa shi, ni amɛhiɛɔ Mose yisɛɛ kwɛmɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ eboteɔ Buu lɛ mli.
Kɛji Mose bote Buu lɛ mli lɛ, atatu kutuu lɛ kpelekeɔ shi, ni ebadamɔɔ Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ.
Kɛ maŋ lɛ na atatu kutuu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi nakai lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ teɔ shi ni amɛmamɔɔ amɛyi shi, ni amɛjaa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ ebuu shinaa shi.
Yehowa kɛ Mose wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ.
Kɛji Mose ku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, etsulɔ Yoshua, Nun binuu oblanyo lɛ, lɛ lɛ eshiii Buu lɛ mli.
Yehowa wo shi akɛ ebaahi ewebii ateŋ Ni Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaaŋɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛya’ shi moŋ ohãko male mɔ ni obaatsu ni ekɛ mi aya.
Kɛ̃lɛ bo nɔŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mile bo jogbaŋŋ, ni miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ’.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, kɛji ona he miishɛɛ lɛ, hã male oyiŋtoo (yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe) bɔ ni afee ni male bo, koni masa ohiɛ.
Kaimɔ hu akɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ omaŋ ni.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mikɛ nyɛ aaatee ni mahã oye kunim.” Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ bo okɛ wɔ eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ kaaloo wɔ kɛmiijɛ biɛ kɛmiiya, ejaakɛ mɛni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oyɛ mi kɛ omaŋ nɛɛ he miishɛɛ akɛ ja tee ni okɛ wɔ aaatee lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ soro wɔ, ni ji mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nɔ ni okɛɛ nɛɛ hu mafee, ejaakɛ miyɛ ohe miishɛɛ, ni mile bo jogbaŋŋ.” Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛ nakai ni lɛ hã mana onunyam lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mibahã minunyam lɛ abaho yɛ ohiɛ, ni mibatsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi, Yehowa lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ.
Mibaduro mɔ ni mibaduro, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ ehe mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ.
Shi moŋ, onyɛŋ mihiɛ ona, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ mihiɛ ni eyi aaana wala.” Yehowa tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, tɛsaa ko yɛ mimasɛi yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, daamɔ jɛi.
Shi be mli ni minunyam lɛ hoɔ lɛ maŋɔ bo mawo tɛsaa lɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni mi kɛ minine aaatsi onɔ kɛyashi mibaho dã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ majie minine lɛ, ni ooona mikotosɛɛ gbɛ, shi mihiɛ lɛ no lɛ anaaa.”
Tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ krokomɛi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋnii lɛ koni maŋma klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii ni ojwara lɛ anɔ wiemɔi lɛ mawo nɔ.
Wɔ lɛ osaa ohe, ni oba Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ okɛ ohe abatsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafata ohe kɛmiiba lɛ, akana mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ni akana toi loo tsinai miiba abaye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋnii lɛ, ni ete shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu mli kɛbanina Mose, yɛ he ni edamɔ lɛ, ni Yehowa tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Yehowa batsɔ̃ Mose hiɛ kɛho, ni etsɛ ehe ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ lɛ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi, ni emli eyi kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwale babaoo lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ suɔmɔ hã mɛi akpei abɔ, ni ekɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ esha faa, shi ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ ko aye ehe tswaa, ni ewoɔ bii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anajiaŋ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Ni Mose he fee oya, ni ekoto shi, ni eja Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ona mihe miishɛɛ lɛ, miikpa bo fai akɛ Nuŋtsɔ ahi wɔteŋ kɛya, tsɛbelɛ gbɔmɛi ni kuɛŋ ti ji maŋ nɛɛ.
Okɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi kɛ wɔhe esha afa wɔ koni okɛ wɔ afee onɔ.” Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ ekoŋŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ.
Mibafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni ji nii ni eko bako dã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, loo yɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ, ni mɛi ateŋ ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛaana Yehowa nitsumɔ, ejaakɛ mi kɛ bo baatsu nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei.
Ye mlai ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ anɔ.
Naa, mibahã Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ajo nyɛnaa foi.
Kwɛmɔ ohe ni ahi koni okɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni nyɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋ koni no batsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã nyɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ, ni nyɛfitea amɛkrabatsai lɛ, ni nyɛfolɔa amɛ-Ashera lɛ wɔŋ koo lɛ nyɛshwiea.
“Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔ kroko ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni egbɛi ji ‘Awuŋã’ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni.
Ni nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ kɛji amɛmiija amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛshã amɛfɔle lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko aaatsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛaayaye amɛfɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã nyɛyaŋɔŋɔɔ amɛbiyei akɛ ŋamɛi nyɛhã nyɛbihii, ni kɛji amɛbiyei lɛ tee amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jamɔ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ aaanyiɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ amɛje misɛɛ, ni amɛaayaja ŋamɛi lɛ asɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
“Kaafee dade amãgã ko ohã ohe.
“Nyɛyea Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ; nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã.
Nyɛyea lɛ gbii kpawo, yɛ be ni ato ni ji Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Abib nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛshi Ijipt.
“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji nuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ minɔ ni, tsina ni jio, too ni jio.
Shi teji kromɔbi lɛ akɛ toobi akpɔ̃ lɛ, shi kɛji asumɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ no lɛ aku ekuɛŋ.
Okpɔ̃ bihii ateŋ kromɔbii fɛɛ.
“Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapue kɛ edɛ̃ folo yɛ mihiɛ.
“Atsu nii gbii ekpaa, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ajɔɔ he, humɔ be mli jio, nikpamɔ be mli jio, ajɔɔ he.
“Asaŋ nyɛyea Otsii Agbijurɔ lɛ, be mli ni akuɔ ŋmaa kpokploku lɛ, kɛ Ŋmaa naabuamɔkɛtoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ afi lɛ naagbee mli.
“Daa afi lɛ nyɛteŋ hii lɛ fɛɛ abapue yɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ mibashwie majimaji yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni malɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni daa afi shii etɛ̃, be mli ni nyɛba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ ekɔŋ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eeeta he.
“Akɛ masha aboloo akafata kooloo he akɛshã afɔle ahã mi; ni je hu akatsɛre Hehoo Gbijurɔ afɔle lɛ eko nɔ.
“Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni nyɛbaakpa lɛ, nyɛkɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ.
“Akahoo toobi kɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa wiemɔi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa mi kɛ bo kɛ Israel ekpãŋ yɛ.” Mose ye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ji Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ, eyeee nii lɛ enuuu nu hu.
Mose kpeleke shi kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ Be ni Mose jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi, ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, eleee kwraa akɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ehã ehiɛ miikpɛ.
Be ni Aaron kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ na Mose lɛ ehiɛ miikpɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Shi Mose tsɛ amɛ, ni Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni Mose kɛ amɛ wie.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni ewo amɛ kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni Mose kɛ maŋ lɛ wie egbe naa lɛ, ekɛ mama ko ha ehiɛ.
Kɛji Mose tee Yehowa hiɛ ekɛ lɛ yaawie lɛ, ekpaa mama nɛɛ yɛ hiɛ kɛyashiɔ ejeɔ kpo, ni ebakɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ naa Mose hiɛ akɛ eekpɛ, ni Mose saa ekɛ mama lɛ haa ehiɛ kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni eeetee ekoŋŋ ekɛ Yehowa ayawie.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ he akpɔi Mose bua Israelbii lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kitãi ni Yehowa ewo akɛ nyɛye nɔ nɛ; Aŋɔ gbii ekpaa akɛtsu nii, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ atsɔ̃ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã nyɛ, Yehowa hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɔŋŋ ni.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nii yɛ nɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ.
Nyɛkashɛrea la yɛ nyɛshihilɛhei lɛ eko eko mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.” Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nikee nii Mose kɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Naa nɔ ni Yehowa efã koni afee: Nyɛkɛ nikee nii abahãa Yehowa; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ akɛ ehã lɛ, lɛ ekɛ nikee abahã Yehowa: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble, kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo, kɛ abotia he tsɔi kɛ too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru kɛ nuŋgbee wolo kɛ tso.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane kɛ tsofai ni akɛfutuɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu mli lɛ.
Ekomɛi hu ji tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ.
Akɛ oniketɛi aba abake, nɔ ni akɛbaamɔ osɔfonukpa tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ kɛ ehewulamɔnii lɛ eko ni atsɛɔ lɛ efod lɛ mli.
Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii lɛ “Ni nyɛteŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni le ŋaa nitsumɔ lɛ eba ebawa kɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efã ni afee lɛ: nomɛi ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ebuu lɛ kɛ nɔ ni haa nɔ lɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ ehe mplaŋi lɛ kɛ emliblɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ.
Ekomɛi hu ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii, kɛ enaanɔ ni bu naa lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ ni tsĩɔ ehiɛ lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi ji tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ, kɛ ehe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ he muhɔi lɛ kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ amɛhe taŋkpei lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi hu nɛ: Osɔfoi lɛ ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni nomɛi ji Aaron ni ji Osɔfo lɛ hewulamɔ nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nikee ba Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ je Mose hiɛ ni amɛtee.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sane lɛ eta etsui mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ena he tsuijurɔ lɛ, hiɛ edɛŋ nikee ebahã Yehowa koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ ehe sɔ̃ɔmɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu ahe nii.
Hii kɛ yei fɛɛ ba ni amɛhiɛ tsitsinaatsɛɛ nii kɛ toiiaŋnii, kɛ waogai kɛ nineshi kpotiai, kɛ shika kɛ jwinei srɔtoi.
No ji mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ he tsuijurɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ shika nɔ ko ebahã Yehowa.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ kuŋtu bluu loo kuŋtu afaseo loo kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ loo klala fɛɛfɛo loo abotia he tsɔi loo too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru loo nuŋgbee wolo lɛ ekɛba.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni na jwiɛtɛi loo akɔɔble lɛ ekɛba akɛ Yehowa nikee nii, ni mɔ hu ni yɔɔ tso ni abaanyɛ akɛtsu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ ekɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni yei fɛɛ ni le kpãatsɛ̃mɔ kɛ amɛnine tsɛ̃ kpãa, ni amɛkɛ nii ni amɛtsɛ̃ lɛ ba, no ji kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa.
Yei fɛɛ ni he esa kɛ abotia hetsɔi kpãatsɛ̃mɔ lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ eko kɛba.
Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ oniketɛi kɛ ojarawatɛi krokomɛi ni akɛbaamɔmɔ efod lɛ kɛ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ amli lɛ ba; asaŋ amɛkɛ tsofai ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ ba.
Israelbii lɛ bake Yehowa nii yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni nu he yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ ehã nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛbake, koni akɛtsu nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ atsɔ̃ Mose nine nɔ atsu lɛ.
Ŋaalɔi ni baama Kpee Buu lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa eje gbɛ ekɔ Bezaleel, ni ji Hur bi Uri binuu lɛ ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ.
Eduro lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee ni akɛnyɛɔ ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ atsuɔ, koni ekɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble aŋa ŋai srɔtoi, ni efolɔ tɛi ni akɛtaraa nibii amli, asaŋ ni ekpɛ tso mli koni akɛtsu ŋaa nitsumɔi srɔtoi srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Asaŋ Yehowa kɛwo Bezaleel kɛ Ahisamak binuu Oholiab ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛŋ lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ŋaa nitsumɔi.
Eduro amɛ nilee koni amɛkɛŋa ŋai srɔtoi fɛɛ, tamɔ samayeli loo niloo kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa mliwoo nɛkɛ, kɛ mamaloo diɛŋtsɛ hu.
No ji amɛle nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni ŋaalɔ tsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ.”
Mose tee nɔ ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa eduro lɛ ŋaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛbaanyɛ nibii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛbaama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amɛfee lɛ, baatsu nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ bake nibii babaoo Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Bezaleel kɛ Oholiab kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni Yehowa eduro lɛ ŋaa, asaŋ ni eyɔɔ he tsui akɛ etsu nii lɛ eko lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbake Yehowa, yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ hã amɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ naa nibii lɛ miiba amɛkɛmiike daa leebi.
Enɛ hã ŋaalɔi lɛ ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii srɔtoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi enitsumɔ ni etsuɔ, ni amɛba amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ kɛ nibii ni fa fe nitsumɔ ni Yehowa efã ni atsu lɛ miiba.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose fã akɛ ashiɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli fɛɛ akɛ, “Nuu jio, yoo jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko akaba dɔŋŋ hã Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kɛbaa, ejaakɛ nibii ni ana lɛ fa aahu fe bɔ ni he ehia hã nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa Mɛi ni tsuɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ŋaa yɔɔ amɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ lɛ ŋɔ mamai nyɔŋma amɛkɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ klala yɛŋ futaa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee buu mamai nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ ŋaa ni mli wa ye kerubim samai amɛwo mli.
Mamai lɛ eko fɛɛ eko kɛlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Mamai nɛɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ kome.
Amɛkpɛ mamai lɛ enumɔ amɛtsara, eko tsa eko naa, kɛfee mama muu kome, ni amɛkpɛ mamai enumɔ krokomɛi lɛ hu amɛtsara, eko tsa eko naa kɛfee mama muu kome nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛkɛ kpãa bluu ŋmɔlɔ aflãi yɛ mama muu kome naa, ni amɛfee nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa.
Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome naa, kɛ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa.
Biɛ kɛ biɛ aflãi nɛɛ eko kɛ eko yɛ ŋlɛnɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika fee kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni amɛkɛ kpoji lɛ lala mamai muji enyɔ lɛ amɛtsa, ni buu mama lɛ tsɔ̃ nɔ muu kome.
Ni amɛkɛ abotia he tsɔi fee mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mamai lɛ ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Mamai nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsara mamai enumɔ aŋklo kɛ mamai ekpaa hu aŋklo.
Amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mamai enumɔ ni atsara afee emuu kome lɛ naa, ni amɛŋmɔlɔ aflãi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ mama muu kome lɛ hu naa.
Amɛfee akɔɔble kpoji nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni akɛlala aflãi lɛ atsara koni buu mama lɛ afee nɔ muu kome.
Amɛkɛ too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru fee nɔhaanɔ koni akɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ nuŋgbee wolo hu fee nɔhaanɔ kroko koni akɛha nɔ ato nɔ.
Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi ni mamɔ shi lɛ.
Mplaŋ kome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ yɛ nyanyɔji enyɔ koni anyɛ akɛtsa eko kɛ eko.
Nɛkɛ amɛfee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
Bɔ ni amɛmamɔ mplaŋi lɛ amɛhã nɛ: Mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi fee nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ amɛwo mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ nɔ enyɔ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, mplaŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ye jɛi, kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma enyɔ nɔ.
Ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, he ni ye anaigbɛ, lɛ mplaŋi ekpaa ye jɛi.
Amɛkɛ mplaŋi enyɔɔnyɔ jie Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Amɛhã koŋ kome mplaŋi enyɔ lɛ bɔ he kɛkɛ yɛ amɛshishigbɛ, shi atsa amɛ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ga lɛ yi.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee koji enyɔ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ana mplaŋi kpaanyɔ yɛ sɛɛgbɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛshishi jwiɛtɛi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa, mplaŋ fɛɛ mplaŋ ma shishi nibii enyɔ anɔ.
Ni amɛkɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee mlibɛlɛmɔnii enumɔ amɛhã mplaŋi ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kome, ni mplaŋi ni yɔɔ ŋmawuiaŋ kome lɛ hu na mlibɛlɛmɔnii enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Amɛhã mlibɛlɛmɔnii ni ye mplaŋi lɛ ateŋ lɛ kã shi emuu kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyagbe naa yɛ koŋ kome lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika shwie mplaŋi lɛ ahe, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee amɛhe gai ni akɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii baahɔlɔ mli lɛ, ni mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ hu amɛkɛ shika shwie he.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne fee muhɔɔ, ni akɛ ŋaa ni mli wa lo kerubim samai amɛwo mli.
Amɛkɛ tso lɛ eko fee akulashiŋi ejwɛ amɛto muhɔɔ lɛ he; amɛshwie akulashiŋi nɛɛ ahe shika, ni amɛkɛ shika nɔŋŋ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe kpoji lɛ, ni amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi fee nibii ejwɛ amɛwo akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu ni alo kɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta ni anyɛne, asaŋ ni akɛ abui elo nii ewo mli fee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ.
Amɛmamɔ akulashiŋi enumɔ kɛ amɛhe kpoji amɛhã shinaa lɛ naahaa mama lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika shwie akulashiŋi lɛ ayitsei lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ hu ahe, shi akɛ akɔɔble fee nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ.
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpɛɛ Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Eshwie adeka lɛ mli kɛ ehe fɛɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ adeka lɛ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe.
Efee shika gai ejwɛ eto adeka lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ.
Gai enyɔ ye afã kome, ni gai enyɔ hu ye afã kome lɛ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ nɔŋŋ eko gbɔlɔ tsei bloblobii, ni eshwie amɛhe shika; ekɛ tsei nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai ni yɔɔ adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ amli koni akɛwo.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Etswia shika ekɛfee kerubim enyɔ emamɔ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ anɔ.
Kerub kome yɛ koŋ kome, ni ekome hu yɛ koŋ kome lɛ.
Esɔo kerubim nɛɛ ekpɛtɛ naanɔ lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kerubim lɛ egbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni amɛkɛha naanɔ lɛ nɔ, ni kerub kome miikwɛ ekome hiɛ, asaŋ amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi kɛmiikwɛ naanɔ lɛ.
Okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Aboloo lɛ maa nɔ lɛ kpɛɛ Bezaleel kɛ tso lɛ eko kpɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Eshwie he shika ŋmiiŋmi, ni ekɛ shika baŋ naa fɛɛ kpula kɛkpe.
Asaŋ egbɔ tso blawa ni lɛɛmɔ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni ekɛkpɛtɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ toi kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Efee shika gai ejwɛ ewo okplɔ̃ lɛ naji ejwɛ lɛ ahe.
Gai nɛɛ ye tso blawa lɛ shishi tuuŋtu, ni nomɛi amli akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ hɔlɔ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ ni akɛbaawo okplɔ̃ lɛ, ni eshwie tsei lɛ ahe shika.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee okplɔ̃ lɛ he nibii ni ji plɛtei kɛ kpuji ni akɛbaashã wain afɔle lɛ.
Kanetso lɛ feemɔ Bezaleel kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia fee kanetso lɛ.
Etswia shika ŋmiiŋmi ekɛfee eshimaa tso lɛ kɛ eshishi nii ni emaa nɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehe tɔi lɛ kɛ ehe kpɔbii kɛ ehe fɔfɔi samai lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
Kanetso lɛ yɛ niji ekpaa: niji etɛ̃ ye afã kome nɛɛ, ni etɛ hu ye afã kroko lɛ.
Afã kome hiɛ tɔi etɛ̃ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi, tɔ fɛɛ tɔ kɛ ekpɔ kɛ efɔfɔi sama yɛ nine kome he.
Nakai sɔŋŋ afee niji ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni kanetso lɛ egbala lɛ.
Kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ tɔi ejwɛ ni afee amɛ tamɔ ŋmɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɔbii kɛ fɔfɔi samai.
Ni kpɔi mamɔ kanetso lɛ he, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ niji ekpaa lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kpɔ yɛ eshishi.
Tɔi lɛ kɛ fɔfɔi samai lɛ kɛ kpɔbii lɛ kɛ niji lɛ kɛ kanetso lɛ shimaatso lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia afee nɔ muu kome.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi nɔŋŋ fee kanetso lɛ he kanei kpawo lɛ kɛ ehe abɛɛlei lɛ kɛ ehe lagbee nii lɛ kɛ kanetso lɛ he aklotɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome fee kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ kpɛɛ Bezaleel kɛ akasia tso kpɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ninetalɔ kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi enyɔ.
Ehe akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsa akɛ nɔ muu kome.
Ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shwie latɛ lɛ he, eyiteŋ kɛ ehe fɛɛ kɛkpe kpula.
Efee shika gai enyɔnyɔ ewo latɛ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ shika ni akɛbaŋ naa lɛ shishi, koni akɛ tsei ahɔlɔ mli ni akɛwo latɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ tso gbɔlɔ tsei nɛɛ, ni ekɛ shika shwie he.
Mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ feemɔ Ekɛ ŋaa ni akɛfeɔ ojeŋma fee mu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ.
Shãa Afɔle latɛ lɛ kpɛɛ Bezaleel kɛ tso kpɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.
Latɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enumɔ; ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ, shi ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi etɛ̃.
Efee akloŋtoi emamɔ latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ anɔ.
Akloŋtoi lɛ kɛ latɛ lɛ fɛɛ fee nɔ muu kome, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha latɛ muu lɛ fɛɛ he.
Efee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ: kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ lajee nii lɛ.
Ehe nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɔɔble ekɛfee.
Efee akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ.
Efee gai ejwɛ ewo akɔɔble ntaŋ nɛɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ koni akɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ ahɔlɔ mli.
Ni ekɛ tso lɛ eko gbɔ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ, ni ekɛ akɔɔble ha he, ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii nɛɛ hɔlɔ gai lɛ amli yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ koni akɛwo.
Ŋmoŋmolo ekɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni gbɛ kã mli.
Akɔɔble okpolu lɛ feemɔ Bezaleel kɛ akɔɔble fee okpolu kɛ ehe akɔɔble nane ni ta shi koni akɛfɔflɔ he lɛ.
Akɔɔble ni akɛfee lɛ yei ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ashwishwɛi akɛfee.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kpo lɛ Bezaleel fee kpo ewo Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he.
Ewuoyigbɛ lɛ ekɛ klala kpakpa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha fee muhɔɔ eha jɛi.
Emamɔ muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.
Kpo lɛ he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ hu jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha.
Emamɔ akulashiŋi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.
Kpo lɛ he ni ye anaigbɛ lɛ jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ehe akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ amɛshishi nibii nyɔŋma ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmliblɛmɔ nii lɛ jwiɛtɛi ekɛfee.
Kpo lɛ he ni ye bokãgbɛ, ni ji ehiɛ lɛ, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Muhɔɔ ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ ha kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome, kɛjɛ agbo lɛ he kɛyashi kpo lɛ koŋ.
Muhɔɔ nɛɛ he akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Ni kpo lɛ hiɛgbɛ afã kome lɛ hu, jɛi muhɔɔ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, kɛ ehe akulashiŋi etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi nibii etɛ̃.
Muhɔɔ ni bɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ klala kpakpa akɛfee.
Kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ashishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ akɔɔble akɛfee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, ni amɛyiteŋhaa nii lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi nɔŋŋ fee nii ni akɛbele amɛteŋ lɛ.
Kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naahaa mama lɛ akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futaa ni anyɛne lo nii wo mli kɛ abui.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ hu ji ninetalɔi enyɔ tamɔ kpo lɛ nɔ muhɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Agbo lɛ hiɛ akulashiŋi ejwɛ kɛ amɛshishi akɔɔble nibii ejwɛ ni amɛmamɔ nɔ, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi feefee amɛhe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ hu he shiŋmlitsei ni bɔle lɛ kpula lɛ, akɔɔble akɛfee fɛɛ.
Dadei ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ Naa bɔ ni dadei srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛma Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ maa mli lɛ naa yakpa, be ni Mose fã Itamar, ni ji Aaron, osɔfo lɛ binuu lɛ, koni ekwɛ Levibii lɛ anɔ koni amɛbu fɛɛ naa lɛ.
Bezaleel, ni ji Hur ni jɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Uri bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni fee nibii ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ atsu lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni fata ehe ji Ahisamak ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi Oholiab, mɔ ni he esa kɛ ŋaayeli kɛ samajiemɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ ele bɔ ni akɛ kpãa bluu kɛ kpãa afaseo kɛ kpãa tsuru fɔɔ kɛ kpãa yɛŋ futafuta loɔ nii awoɔ mama mli lɛ.
Shika ŋmiiŋmi fɛɛ ni akɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ maa mli fɛɛ, ni ji shika ni akɛbake Yehowa lɛ, naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ shekel ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa.
Jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane lɛ hã lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai oha kɛ shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni aŋmɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nsɛnitɛ naa.
Be ni akane mɛi lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa.
Ajie jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli talentai oha ni akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ nibii ni muhɔɔ lɛ hu akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ.
Akɛfee nibii nɛɛ oha, ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ talenta kome feɔ akulashiŋ kome.
Ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel akpe kome ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ ni shwɛ lɛ fee akulashiŋi lɛ ahe gai lɛ kɛ amɛyitsei ahehaa nii lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ.
Akɔɔble fɛɛ ni abake lɛ naa yashiɔ talentai nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ shekel akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Ni no akɛfee nibii ni Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nibii lɛ fɛɛ.
No nɔŋŋ eko akɛfee nibii ni kpo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ nɔ kɛbɔle kpo lɛ kpula lɛ, kɛ nibii ni kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ hu mamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei fɛɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei hu ni bɔle kpo lɛ kɛkpe kpula lɛ.
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii lɛ feemɔ Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee hewulamɔ nibii ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa koni akɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛfee osɔfonukpa hewulamɔ nibii amɛhã Aaron tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa fee efod lɛ.
Ni amɛtswia shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ, ni amɛfolɔ lɛ kpãikpãi, ni akɛfee ŋaabii awo kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa lɛ mli.
Amɛfee mama hwĩahwĩabii ni baakã kɔŋ amɛkɛtsa efod lɛ koji enyɔ lɛ koni akɛŋmɔ efod lɛ.
Amɛkɛ ŋaa kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ nibii kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ eko fee efod lɛ mlifiinii lɛ; nibii nɛɛ ji kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa ni alo nii awo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ni amɛfolɔ oniketɛi, ni amɛkɛhɔlɔ shika gai amli ni amɛkpɛ Israel bihii lɛ agbɛii lɛ amɛwo tɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔ̃ŋ nɔ lɛ anɔ koni akɛkai Yakob bihii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Tsitsinɔhaa nii lɛ feemɔ Bezaleel kɛ ŋaa ni mli wa naakpa nakai nɔŋŋ fee tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni afee efod lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ekɛ kuŋtu wuɔfɔ kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ kɛ klala kpakpa fee.
Efee tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ koji ejwɛ, ni adɔ mli enyɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ye egbɔ: ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛto tɛi klɛmpɛi ejwɛ amɛmamɔ nɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ klɛmpɛ lɛ mli tɛi fee ojarawatɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ rubi kɛ topasiɔn kɛ garneto lɛ.
Klɛmpɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi lɛ fee ameldo kɛ safiro kɛ daiamɔnd.
Klɛmpɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi fee tekwais kɛ kalkedɔn kɛ amɛtisto, ni klɛmpɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli ojarawatɛi lɛ fee berilo kɛ onike kɛ yaspi.
Akɛ tɛi lɛ mamɔ shika gai amli.
Tɛi lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni tɛi nɛɛ agbɛii kɛ Yakob bihii lɛ agbɛii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nyiɛ yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ naa.
Akpɛ gbɛii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ sama awoɔ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ, tɛ fɛɛ tɛ kɛ egbɛi.
Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa, amɛkɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ naa.
Ni amɛfee shika gai hu enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ yiteŋgbɛ koji enyɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ lɛ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ lala gai enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ koji lɛ.
Kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ ni agbɔ tamɔ kpãa lɛ anaabui enyɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛlala shika ni asere kɛbɔle tɛi enyɔ lɛ ashishi lɛ, ni amɛkɛyaŋmɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ yɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Amɛfee shika gai enyɔ amɛwo tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ afã kome, ni adɔ awo shishigbɛ koni ekã efod lɛ nɔ koji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛsaa amɛfee shika gai krokomɛi enyɔ ni amɛkɛmamɔ efod lɛ he mama hwĩahwĩabii ni kãa kɔŋ nɔ lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshishigbɛ tsamɔhe, yɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ yiteŋgbɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ mama bluu fimɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ he gai lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ efod lɛ he gai lɛ, koni tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ akã efod lɛ mlifiinii fɛɛfɛo lɛ nɔ koni akɛje nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii krokomɛi lɛ feemɔ Akɛ mama bluu sɔŋŋ kpɛ efod lɛ shishi atade yuu lɛ.
Ajie kuɛ awo atade lɛ he, ni akɛ mama baŋ kuɛ lɛ naa kɛkpe koni ekagba.
Amɛkɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo fee kpɔbii kokrobii kɛbɔle atade lɛ naamuu lɛ kɛkpe.
Ni amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee ŋmɛji, ni amɛkɛ ŋmɛji nɛɛ folɔ kpɔbii kokrobii lɛ ateiaŋ yɛ atade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ naa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe nɛkɛ: shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome, shika ŋmɛlɛ kome kɛkɛ lɛ kpɔ kokroo kome aahu kɛbɔle atade yuu lɛ ni abaawo kɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ naamuu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm kɛkpe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa fɛɛfɛo lo flakai amɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.
Amɛkɛ klala kpakpa nɔŋŋ fee osɔfonukpa fai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi bibii afaii pɛmpɛbii lɛ kɛ tswakotoi lɛ hu.
Ni amɛkɛ klala kpakpa kɛ kuŋtu bluu kɛ kuŋtu afaseo kɛ kuŋtu tsuru fɔɔ fee mlifii nɔ lɛ, ni alo nii awo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Amɛkɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee nii ni taa osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋma wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛwo nɔ tamɔ aŋmaa nii yɛ wolonaasɔomɔ nɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfĩ kɛkpɛtɛ kuŋtu bluu nɔ, ni akɛta osɔfonukpa fai lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Nitsumɔ lɛ naagbee Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee agbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa ahã.
Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ Mose, no ji Buu lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ekpoji lɛ kɛ eplaŋi lɛ kɛ amɛmlibɛlɛmɔ nii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni amɛmamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ buu lɛ nɔhaa nii lɛ ni ji too ojwɛni wolo ni awo lɛ tsofa tsuru lɛ kɛ nuŋgbee wolo ni haa no nɔ lɛ, kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ amɛkɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enaanɔ lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ ehe tsɛnsii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ hu ba.
Nibii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, kɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi ji akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe akɔɔble ntaŋ ni kãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ latɛ lɛ he tsei bloblobii lɛ kɛ ehenii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ.
Ekrokomɛi hu ji kpo lɛ muhɔi lɛ kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he taŋkpei lɛ kɛ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ osɔfoi ahewulamɔ nibii fɛɛfɛji ni akɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Nomɛi ji Osɔfo Aaron hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu ahewulamɔ nibii ni amɛkɛbaasɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mose kwɛ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni naa, bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ amɛ.
Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shii kɛ enɔjɔɔmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, shii Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama mli, ni okɛ muhɔɔ lɛ atsĩ hiɛ.
Okɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ aya Buu lɛ mli, ni oto nibii ni sa akɛ amãmɔ nɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ omamɔ nɔ, ni okɛ kanetso lɛ aya mli, ni okɛ ehe kanei lɛ amãmɔ nɔ.
Okɛ shika latɛ ni akɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma lɛ ama Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ aha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa.
Agbɛnɛ okɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Okɛ okpolu lɛ ama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni okɛ nu awo mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, owo kpo lɛ oma shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ tswɛm, ni okɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ aha naa.
“Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ owo mu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ okɛfɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii lɛ fɛɛ koni okɛfee lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ofɔ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ni okɛfee latɛ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni etsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.
Ofɔ okpolu lɛ kɛ eshishitamɔ nii lɛ hu mu ni okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
“Agbɛnɛ okɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni okɛ nu aju amɛhe.
No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ hewulamɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ awula Aaron, ni ofɔ lɛ mu okɛfee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi.
Okɛ Aaron bihii lɛ hu aba ni okɛ flakai lɛ awo amɛ, ni ofɔ amɛ hu mu tamɔ ofɔ amɛtsɛ mu lɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi.
Amɛmufɔɔ nɛɛ aaahã osɔfoyeli atsɔ̃ amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei abihii anɔ kɛya naanɔ.” Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt lɛ enɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama shi.
Mose ji mɔ ni shi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ema shi.
Ekala nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ baamamɔ nɔ lɛ, etee mplaŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ bɛlɛ teiaŋ, kɛkɛ ni etee ekulashiŋi lɛ shi emamɔ shi.
Elɛɛ buu mama lɛ mli ekɛha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ lɛ ha nɔ to nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ni Mose kɛ tɛi ni aŋmala kitãi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ hɔlɔ Adeka lɛ he, ni ekɛ naanɔ lɛ bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eshi muhɔɔ lɛ ekɛtsi Adeka lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose wo okplɔ̃ lɛ ekɛyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli he ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ, yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ, kɛkɛ ni eto aboloo lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ eshwie nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ewo kanetso lɛ eyama Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ he ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehe kanei lɛ mamɔ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ shika tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ muhɔɔ lɛ kponɔgbɛ, ni eshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ mama lɛ ha Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Ekɛ shãa afɔle latɛ lɛ ma Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni eshã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle yɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Ewo okpolu lɛ ema Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ, ni ekɛ nu wo mli, ni no sɛɛ lɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛfɔflɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji ahe.
Kɛji amɛbaaya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni kɛji amɛbaabɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ amɛfɔfɔlɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ni Mose tee kpo lɛ shi ema shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ ha naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose gbe nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Atatu ni shi ema Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni atatu baha Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ yi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, Mose nyɛɛɛ ebote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ejaakɛ atatu lɛ eha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ hu eyi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃.
Israelbii lɛ agbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, kɛji atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛfãa kɛyaa amɛhiɛ; shi kɛji atatu lɛ wooo ehe nɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛfãaa kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni eeewo ehe nɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane, ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ atatu lɛ kpɛɔ la ni Israelbii lɛ naa gbɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Mlai srɔtoi ni awo yɛ jamɔ kɛ jamɔ mli gbɛjianɔtoi ahe ahã maŋbii kɛ osɔfoi ni kwɛɔ koni aye mlai lɛ anɔ yɛ blemablema Israelbii lɛ abeiaŋ ji saji ni yɔɔ Levitiko loo Jamɔ He Mlai Awolo lɛ mli.
Sane krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehe tse.
Atsɔ̃ɔ gbɛi anɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ webii atsɔ̃ aja Nyɔŋmɔ, asaŋ ni amɛhi shi, bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛ kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, teŋ ahi jogbaŋŋ daa.
Wiemɔ ko ni ale jogbaŋŋ yɛ Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, eyɛ Yitso .. Yesu tsɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ akɛ, “Kitã Wulu ni ji Enyɔ lɛ.” Ni no ji, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.” Mlijaramɔi Mlai ni kɔɔ afɔlei kɛ afɔleshaã he .—.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ osɔfowoo .—.
Mlai ni kɔɔ hetsemɔ kɛ he muji he .—.
Kpãtãmɔ Gbi lɛ .- Mlai ni kɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ yɛ jeŋshihilɛ kɛ jamɔ he .—.
Afɔle ni ashãa lɛ emuu Yehowa jɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli etsɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko miiba ekɛ kooloo abashã afɔle ehã mi, Yehowa, lɛ ekɛ etsinai lɛ loo etoi lɛ ateŋ eko abashã afɔle lɛ.
Kɛji tsina ekɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ, ehiɛ tsinanuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ebahã.
Ekɛ kooloo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni Yehowa ahe efɔle lɛ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ afɔleshãa kooloo lɛ yiteŋ, ni abaaŋɔ kooloo lɛ akɛshã afɔle ni akɛkpãtã ehe esha lɛ ahã lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ egbe tsinanuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koji ejwɛ lɛ he lɛ kɛkpe.
Mɔ lɛ akpɔ kooloo lɛ hewolo lɛ koni esaa loo lɛ.
Aaron bihii lɛ ato lai amɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛshɛre la lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛto loo ni asaa lɛ yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ amɛshwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nuu lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe; ni osɔfo lɛ ashã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shãa afɔle ni, afɔle ni akɛ la shãa kooloo lɛ fɛɛ ni.
Afɔle nɛɛ jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
“Shi kɛji too gwantɛŋ loo abotia mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ, ehiɛ gwantɛŋ nuu loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛba.
Egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ekooyigbɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ aba ni amɛkɛbashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Mɔ lɛ asaa loo lɛ; ni osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai be lɛ ato kooloo ni asaa lɛ: yitso lɛ kɛ emli fɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashwie lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi mɔ lɛ kɛ nu afɔ kooloo lɛ mlinii lɛ kɛ enaji lɛ ahe.
No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ni tsuɔ nii nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nomɛi hu baashi nɔ, ni eshã kooloo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
“Shi kɛji loofɔlɔ mɔ lɛ kɛbaa ebashã shãa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpo loo shĩa okpo pɛmpɛoo.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ abaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; etsɔ̃mɔ ni etse loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso, ni eshã loofɔlɔ lɛ loo lɛ, shi loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ atsere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Ejie loofɔlɔ lɛ kpɔŋɔshi kɛ emlinii lɛ koni eshɛrɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ ebokãgbɛ he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ.
Emɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ fiji lɛ amli koni egba loofɔlɔ lɛ mli, shi ekakpɔlɔ efiji lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã loofɔlɔ lɛ yɛ lai lɛ nɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shãa afɔle ni: afɔle ni ashãa fɛɛ ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.”
Niyenii afɔlei “Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ŋmãa miiba abashã afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, egbɛlɛ ŋmãa lɛ mã.
Ekɛ mu ashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma hu afata he; koni ekɛbahã Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ.
Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpiti mã lɛ kɛ mu lɛ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma lɛ fɛɛ koni ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ afɔle muu ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ.
Eji shãa afɔle, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni; eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ eko ni.
“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee ŋmãa nii ni ashã yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nɔ lɛ efee mã akpiti keeki ni akɛ mu wo mli ashã, loo mã akpiti akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mu ekpa hiɛ.
“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee nii ni ashãa yɛ looshãa dade nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efee nii ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu fee niyenii.
Akumɔ afɔle lɛ mli dukuduku, ni afɔse mu ashwie nɔ.
Niyenii afɔle ni.
“Kɛji afɔle lɛ yafee niyenii ni ashĩ yɛ ŋɛsu mli hu lɛ, afɔle lɛ afee niyenii ni akɛ mã akpiti kɛ mu fee.
Akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ nibii nɛɛ fee lɛ aba akɛ Yehowa nikeenii, ni akɛbahã osɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛya afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Osɔfo lɛ ajie niyenii afɔle lɛ mli eko, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle muu lɛ ni akɛbahã Yehowa he odaseyeli nɔ.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni shwɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni ashã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ ni.
Eji nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa mli eko ni.
“Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ko niyenii afɔle ko ni akɛ mã sha fee akabahãa Yehowa, ni nyɛkashãa nɔ ko ni mã sha loo wo yɔɔ mli akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛŋɔ nibii nɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ nii lɛ eko nyɛbahã Yehowa.
Shi moŋ akashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nii ni jeɔ ŋma.
Nyɛwoa nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ amli ŋoo.
Ŋoo ji nii ni yeɔ kpãŋmɔ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ he odase lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, akashi ŋoo sɛɛ yɛ nyɛniyenii afɔle fɛɛ mli.
Nyɛkɛ ŋoo afataa nyɛfɔlei fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaa he.
Kɛji niyenii afɔle ni akɛbaahã Yehowa fee ŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nibaanii lɛ mli eko lɛ, no lɛ afɔle lɛ afee abele kpokploku ni ashĩ mamu.
Akɛ mu ashwie nɔ, ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma afɔ̃ nɔ.
Niyenii afɔle ni.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã mamu lɛ he ni mu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛ mu lɛ kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni fata he lɛ hu fɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni akɛbahã lɛ he odaseyeli nɔ.
Eji afɔle ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa.”
Naanyobɔɔ afɔlei “Kɛji mɔ ko miiba ebashã toiŋjɔlɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ etsinai lɛ ateŋ eko, tsina lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Mɔ lɛ kɛ enine aŋmɛ tsina lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ abashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahãa Yehowa ji fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ.
Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni ashã: shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
“Kɛji mɔ lɛ miiba ebashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã Yehowa kɛ gwantɛŋi loo abotiai lɛ ateŋ eko lɛ, kooloo lɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, efee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Kɛji mɔ lɛ hiɛ gwantɛŋ kɛba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ, ni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ hiɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔle kooloo nɛɛ mli nibii ni sa akɛ ashãa ahã Yehowa ji emli fɔ lɛ kɛ elei muu ni ajie kɛjɛ ekotosɛɛ wu lɛ tɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ fɔ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ, kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni yɔɔ amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfo ni yɔɔ nitsumɔ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni aashã akɛhã Yehowa.
“Kɛji mɔ lɛ kɛ abotia ba afɔleshãa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛbahã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Kooloo lɛ mli nibii ni ekɛbaahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ, kɛ esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ajie loo nɛɛ akɛfata sabai lɛ ahe.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa kɛŋma akɛhã Yehowa.
Fɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni.
Israelbii akaye kooloo fɔ loo lá.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni nyɛaahi.”
Eshai ni hiɛ kãaa he ni afee he afɔlei Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃ akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa ewo lɛ eko nɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko be mli ni mɔ lɛ hiɛ kãaa he lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ: Kɛji Osɔfonukpa lɛ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, ni no ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ etɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe abashã ehe esha lɛ he afɔle ehã Yehowa.
Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛ enine afɔ̃ tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ ni egbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, koni ekɛ la lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ koji lɛ ahe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ ajie fɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ mli, ni ji fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ he lɛ; ejie esabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ hu ni ha amɛhe lɛ, kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ ekɛfata sabai lɛ ahe, tamɔ ajieɔ nibii nɛɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔleshãa tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ he lɛ, koni eshã fɛɛ yɛ shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi tsinanuu lɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ fɛɛ: eyitso kɛ enaji lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ, Osɔfonukpa lɛ awo tsinanuu muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛya he ko ni tse yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, he ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ he ko, koni eyashã yɛ lai nɔ yɛ jɛi.
He ni atsiɔ lamlu ashwieɔ lɛ, jɛi ashã afɔle nɛɛ yɛ.
Kɛji Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni tɔ̃ Yehowa kitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛfee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ amɛkɔɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ni amɛtɔ̃ lɛ sɛɛ hu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ eye sɔ̃ lɛ, kɛji ana ale esha tɔ̃mɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ kɛ tsina oblanyo ashã esha afɔle.
Akɛ tsina oblanyo lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsina lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni agbe tsina lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ aŋɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛbote Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ eko ashwã shii kpawo yɛ Muhɔɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ekɛ lá lɛ eko adiki tsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, lɛ koji lɛ ahe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi tsinanuu lɛ lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ shishi.
Tsinanuu lɛ fɔ lɛ ejie fɛɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ ni efee esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee tsinanuu nɛɛ hu loo lɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ koni akɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa amɛ.
Ewo tsinanuu lɛ loo lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni eshã tamɔ bɔ ni eshã lɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he esha tsina afɔle loo lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle ni.
Kɛji nɔyelɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃ lɛ, kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ekɛbashã afɔle.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.
Esha afɔle ni.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi la ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Eshã too kpakpo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei akooloi lɛ amli fɔ lɛ koni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.
Kɛji maŋbii lɛ kɛkɛ ateŋ mɔ ko tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ejaakɛ efee nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃ lɛ, kɛji ahã ele tɔ̃mɔ ni etɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ abotia yoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba ni ekɛbashã afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle too lɛ yiteŋ, ni egbe too lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ too lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ shidaa afɔlei akooloi amli fɔ lɛ, ni eshã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni eje ŋma ewo Yehowa, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ehã lɛ, ni akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ gwantɛŋ miiba abashã esha afɔle lɛ, ekɛ gwantɛŋyoo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe aba.
Ekɛ enine aŋmɛ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ yitso nɔ, ni egbe lɛ koni akɛshã esha afɔle yɛ he ni agbeɔ shãa afɔle kooloi lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ewao atsɔ esha afɔle kooloo lɛ lá lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lá lɛ adiki shãa afɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Ejie too lɛ mli fɔ lɛ fɛɛ tamɔ ajieɔ naanyobɔɔ afɔle gwantɛŋ lɛ mli fɔ lɛ koni eshã no kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa.
Ni osɔfo lɛ baakpãtã ahã lɛ, ni akɛ ehe esha lɛ baafa lɛ.
Saji amli ni esha afɔle he ehia yɛ Kɛji atsɛ mɔ ko odase yɛ sane ko he, ni emua enaa, ni ewieee, tsɛbelɛ ena aloo ele sane lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ efee esha, ni eye sɔ̃.
Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, ŋa mli kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, shĩa kooloo ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kooloo ni wamɔɔ ni he tseee ko gbonyo ni jio, kɛ ehiɛ kãaa he ni eta he tete lɛ, akɛni ebule ehe hewɔ lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
Aloo kɛji eta nɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni he tseee ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ he, ni eleee, shi kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, eye sɔ̃.
Kɛji mɔ ko eyakwɛɛɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekã kitã akɛ eeefee efɔŋ loo ekpakpa ko tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi kãa kitã ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he lɛ, kɛ fee sɛɛ ni ebale lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ eyeɔ sɔ̃ yɛ mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko ye sɔ̃ yɛ nii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ ni ekɛ esɔ̃ afɔle abahã Yehowa yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Ekɛ gwantɛŋ loo too abotia yoo aba, koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ too ehe lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ aba ebahã Yehowa akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ; okpo kome akɛ esha afɔle kɛ ekome hu akɛ shãa afɔle.
Ekɛ afɔlei enyɔ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ekɛ nɔ ni ji esha afɔle lɛ aba tsutsu.
Etsɔ̃mɔ loofɔlɔ lɛ yitso yɛ ekuɛ nɔ, shi ekatse kɛje nɔ.
Etsɔ esha afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Lá ni baashwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Afɔle ni akɛjieɔ esha kɛyaa ji no.
Loofɔlɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ekɛfee shãa afɔle yɛ gbɛnaa ni ato lɛ naa; koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ koni akɛfa lɛ.
Shi kɛji enyɛɛɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpobii enyɔ ehã lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mã kilo kome aba akɛ esha afɔle yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Ekɛ mu akawo mli, ni ekɛ ohɛ hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ esha afɔle ni.
Ekɛba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ atĩ ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ekɛfee afɔle lɛ mli eko ni akɛkaiɔ Yehowa yɛ afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ he, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ashãa ŋmãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ.
Esha afɔle ni.
Osɔfo lɛ afee nɛkɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ, ni akɛ esha ni efee yɛ enɛɛmɛi eko gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaafa lɛ.
Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Afɔlei ni akɛtoɔ mlai krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anajiaŋ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji oniai krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsuɔ ahãa Yehowa lɛ mɔ ko hãaa egbɛfaŋnɔ, ni no ehã eye sɔ̃ ni eleee lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã Yehowa nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni he bɛ kpa ko.
Too lɛ jara adamɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shika jara nɔ, ni akɛfee sɔ̃ afɔle.
Mɔ ni efee esha yɛ onia krɔŋkrɔŋ ko gbɛfaŋ lɛ ato onia ni ehãaa lɛ najiaŋ, ni ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he.
Ekɛhã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ akpãtã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle ahã lɛ, koni akɛ esha ni efee lɛ afa lɛ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha, ni efee nii ni Yehowa ewo he kitã akɛ akafee lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ ehiɛ kãaa he moŋ nɛ, shi eye sɔ̃, ni aaagbala etoii.
Emɔ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe yɛ etoi lɛ ateŋ.
Abu naa, ni ejara afee sɔ̃ afɔle jara, koni ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ esha ni efee ni eleee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛbaafa lɛ.
Sɔ̃ afɔle ji enɛ; ejaakɛ eye sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.”
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko fee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha yɛ tso ni etso yɛ nɔ ko ni enyɛmi Israelnyo kɛhã lɛ shitoo aloo ekɛto lɛ awaba, aloo eju enyɛmi lɛ nɔ ko, aloo etswa lɛ ojo, aloo ena nɔ ko ni elaaje ni ekã amale kitã akɛ enako lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaafee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɔmɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, efee esha.
Kɛ mɔ ko fee esha ni eye sɔ̃ lɛ, eto nɔ ni eju lɛ, loo nii ni ekɛ amimyeli shɔ̃ lɛ, loo nɔ ni akɛto lɛ awaba ni etso akɛ akɛ nɔ ko hãko lɛ, loo nii ni laaje ni eshiu nɔ lɛ, loo nɔ ko ni ekã he amale kitã lɛ, najiaŋ.
Esɔ̃ afɔle ni ekɛbaahã osɔfo lɛ ni akɛhã Yehowa lɛ nɛ: etoi lɛ ateŋ too ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ ehe; ejara afee bɔ ni bo oootsɔ̃ɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ aaafa lɛ.” Afɔlei ni ashãa amɛ emuu Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, “Fã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ shãa afɔle he mla nɛ.
Shãa afɔle lɛ ahi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni la ahi shishi kɛyashi leebi.
Osɔfo lɛ awo eklala flaka kɛ eklala tswakotoi lɛ koni eloo lamlu lɛ; shi la lɛ ni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ, eshi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi he ko.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ajie etadei lɛ koni ewo ekroko.
Ekɛ lamlu lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛyashwie he ko ni tse.
La lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ akã he atso daa; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko.
Daa leebi lɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ lai ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Eto shãa afɔle lɛ gbɛjianɔ eshwie nɔ ni eshã toiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei ahe fɔi lɛ yɛ nɔ.
La atso daa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; akahã egbo gbi ko gbi ko.” Ŋmãa afɔlei Ŋmãa afɔle lɛ he mla nɛ: “Aaron bihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome aŋɔ mã lɛ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛ ohɛ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɔkɔ kome ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Eji okadi kɛkɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ akɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ fɛɛ ehã Yehowa.
Afɔle nɛɛ ŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.
Afɔle lɛ nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye.
Afee lɛ mã akpiti keeki, ni aye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ, no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Aboloo akpiti nɛɛ ji osɔfoi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni mihã amɛ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi lɛ mli.
Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni, tamɔ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ.
Bei fɛɛ, yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ, nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ aye akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ ŋmãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ.” Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbi nɔ ni afɔɔ Aaron loo eshwie ko mu akɛ osɔfo lɛ, ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome aba abahã Yehowa tamɔ daa ŋmãa afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Akɛ fã aba leebi, ni akɛfã hu aba gbɛkɛ.
Akɛ mu ashi yɛ ŋɛsu mli.
Kɛ ebe lɛ, akumɔ mli dukuduku ni akɛba akɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni eŋma sa Yehowa hiɛ.
Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni baaye esɛɛ akɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ afee enɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ akpɔ ni kã shi kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ashã afɔle muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋmãa afɔle ni osɔfo lɛ shãa lɛ akaye eko; ashã emuu lɛ fɛɛ.” Esha afɔlei Yehowa fã Mose koni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ bɔ ni ashã esha afɔlei lɛ ahã.
He ni agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ agbe kooloo ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ yɛ ahã Yehowa.
Eji afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Osɔfo ni gbeɔ kooloo lɛ kɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aye loo lɛ.
Eye yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ; no ji yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni taa loo lɛ he lɛ aaatsɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Kɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko tsɛ̃ŋe shwie atade he lɛ, afɔ atade loo nɔ lɛ ni lá lɛ tsɛ̃ŋe shwie he lɛ he yɛ he ni tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Sũ gbɛ ni ahoo loo lɛ eko yɛ mli lɛ, ajwara; shi kɛ akɔɔble loo dadesɛŋ mli ahoo yɛ lɛ, asha mli ni akɛ nu ajale mli.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye loo lɛ eko; eji nɔ ko ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Shi esha afɔle fɛɛ esha afɔle ni akɛ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eko aaaba Kpe Buu lɛ mli ni akɛaakpãtã yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha ko hewɔ lɛ, akaye; ashã kɛ la.
Sɔ̃ afɔlei Sɔ̃ afɔle he mla nɛ.
Eji afɔle ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.
Kooloo ni akɛbaashã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ agbe lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kooloo lɛ lá lɛ afɔse ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ he.
Ajie efɔ lɛ fɛɛ, elei ni ewo fɔ lɛ, fɔ ni ha emlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ ni yɔɔ hɛ mli lɛ, kɛ fɔ ni ha amɛhe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsa mlɛbo lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ, koni akɛshã afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa.
Sɔ̃ afɔle ni.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni jɛ osɔfoi ateŋ aye eko; eye yɛ he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; afɔle ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ni.
Esha afɔle lɛ etamɔ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ; mla kome nɔŋŋ kã shi hã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ: osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛkpãtãa lɛ, enɔ ji loo lɛ.
Kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hewolo lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ nɔ ni.
Niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli aloo nɔ ni ashãa yɛ nishãa nɔ nɔ, loo nɔ ni ashĩɔ yɛ ŋɛsu mli lɛ, osɔfo ni shãa afɔle lɛ hãa Yehowa lɛ nɔ ni.
Shi niyenii afɔle fɛɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, awo mli mu jio, afee lɛ egbiŋ jio, Aaron shwiei osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni; aja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi na lɛ pɛ.
Naanyobɔɔ afɔlei Bɔ ni sa akɛ ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ahã Yehowa nɛ.
Kɛ afɔle lɛ shidaa afɔle ni lɛ, nibii ni akɛfata he ji keeki ni akɛ mã akpiti ni awo mli mu shã kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mã akpiti ni akpa hiɛ mu shã kɛ keeki ni akɛ mã ni mu enumɔ mli shã.
Kɛshi naanyobɔɔ shidaa afɔlei nɛɛ anɔ lɛ ekɛ keeki ni akɛ mãsha shã hu abashã afɔle.
Nii ni ekɛba lɛ, ejie fɛɛ mli ekomekome ehã, ni akɛfee nɔwomɔ afɔle ahã Yehowa; Osɔfo lɛ ni tsiɔ kooloo lɛ lá lɛ eshwieɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ ni.
Kooloo ni akɛshãa shidaa afɔle lɛ loo lɛ, aye gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; akashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.
Kɛji afɔle ni mɔ ko kɛba lɛ shiwoo afɔle ni, loo afɔle ni ekɛba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ aye loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi nɔ ni agbe kooloo lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ loo lɛ eko shwɛ lɛ, aye enɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Shi kɛji loo ni eshwɛ lɛ eko ye gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, ashã.
Kɛji gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ye loo lɛ eko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hereŋ mɔ ni kɛ afɔle lɛ ba lɛ.
Enaŋ he nyɔmɔwoo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Nihii nii ji loo lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye eko lɛ, eloo musu.
Loo ni nɔ ko ni he tseee aaasa he lɛ, akaye, ashã.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni he tse lɛ aye loo lɛ eko.
Shi mɔ ni he tseee ni eeeye naanyobɔɔ afɔle loo ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enaneshi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Asaŋ kɛ mɔ ko aaaye naanyobɔɔ afɔle nɛɛ eko, be mli ni eta nɔ ko ni he tseee he, gbɔmɔ ni he tseee he eta jio, kooloo ni he tseee he eta jio, nɔ kroko ni jio, aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛkayea fɔ ko fɔ ko; tsina fɔ jio, gwantɛŋ fɔ jio, too abotia fɔ jio, nyɛkayea.
Kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloo ni kooloo kroko etserɛ emli lɛ, aaanyɛ akɛ efɔ lɛ afee nɔ kroko; shi loo lɛ akaye.
Kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ efɔ lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye kooloo ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa lɛ eko lɛ aaatswa enane shi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.
He fɛɛ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛkayea lá ko lá ko, loofɔlɔ lá jio, kooloo naji ejwɛ tsɛ jio.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaku mla nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, aaatswa enaneshi tu kɛaaje emɛi ateŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, ajie afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni ji Yehowa nɔ krɛdɛɛ lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ehiɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ kɛba akɛ niyenii afɔle.
Akɛ kooloo lɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ etsitsi lɛ fɛɛ aba ni ekɛbahã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko hã Yehowa.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã fɔ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, shi tsitsi lɛ Aaron kɛ ebii osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Kooloo lɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ akɛhã osɔfo ni shãa naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ ehãa Yehowa lɛ.
Akɛhã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ titri ko.
Ejaakɛ kooloo lɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛgbɛ nanejurɔ lɛ mihe yɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ mihã osɔfoi ni ji Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa.
Enɛ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ mli nɔ ni akɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ gbi nɔ ni awoɔ amɛ osɔfo lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkɛhã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ koni efee amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ daa yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ esha afɔlei kɛ sɔ̃ afɔlei lɛ kɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei lɛ.
Enɛ he Yehowa wo Mose kitã yɛ gbi nɔ ni ewo Israelbii lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkɛ amɛfɔlei lɛ aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sinai ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Awo Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ osɔfoi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ofata ohe, ni oŋɔ atadei lɛ kɛ mɔ mufɔɔ mu lɛ kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ kɛ too ojwɛnii enyɔ lɛ kɛ mã akpiti kafu lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ naa.
Ni obua asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ naa.” Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ, ni ehã asafo lɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, no mibafee nɛɛ.” Mose hã Aaron kɛ ebii lɛ ba hiɛ, ni ekɛ nu ju amɛhe.
Ekɛ flaka lɛ wo Aaron, ni ekɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ emliteŋ.
Ekɛ atade yuu lɛ wo Aaron.
Ekɛ efod lɛ hu wo lɛ, ni ekɛ efod lɛ mlifii nɔ lɛ fĩ efod lɛ ekpɛtɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ tsitsinɔnii lɛ to nɔ, ni ekɛ Urim kɛ Tumim lɛ wo tsitsinɔnii lɛ kotoku lɛ mli.
Ekɛ yitsofii nɔ lɛ fĩ Aaron yitso, ni Mose kɛ shika fɛtɛfɛtɛ ni ji hiɛnaanii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ta yitsofii nɔ lɛ hiɛnaa.
Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose wo mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ.
Efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ mu koni efee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ekɛ mu lɛ eko shwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo ekɛfɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ he lɛ kɛ lalakã lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ema nɔ lɛ mu, koni efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.
Mose fɔse mufɔɔ mu lɛ eko eshwie Aaron yiteŋ, ni ekɛfɔ lɛ mu koni efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose hã Aaron bii lɛ ba hiɛ.
Ewo amɛ flakai; ekɛ amɛmlifĩinii lɛ fimɔ amɛmliteŋ, ni ekɛ amɛfaii lɛ bumɔ amɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ tsinanuu ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ ba.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie esha afɔle tsinanuu lɛ yiteŋ.
Mose gbe tsinanuu lɛ.
Ekɛ ewao tsɔ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛkpa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe kɛkpe, koni ekɛtsuu he.
Mose tsi lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Efee enɛ ekɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ehã Yehowa.
Mose jie fɔ lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi tsinanuu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ ewamɔ lɛ Mose kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ eyashã, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle ba.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ, ni Mose gbe lɛ.
Etsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kɛbɔle.
-Esaa too ojwɛni lɛ, ni ekɛ nu fɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni eshã yitso lɛ kɛ fɔ lɛ kɛ too muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Shãa afɔle nɛɛ niyenii afɔle ni; eŋma lɛ sa Yehowa hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ too ojwɛni ni ji enyɔ ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛji aawo osɔfo lɛ ba.
Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛniji shwie too ojwɛni lɛ yiteŋ, ni Mose gbe lɛ.
Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa Aaron ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Mose hã Aaron bihii lɛ hu ba.
Etsɔ lá lɛ eko esa amɛninejurɔ toi naa kɛ amɛninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ amɛnane gɔnti naa.
Kɛkɛ ni efɔse lá ni eshwɛ lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Mose ŋɔ fɔ kɛ lei lɛ ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ fɛɛ ni ha mlinii kɛ mlɛbo lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhe fɔ lɛ kɛ sɛɛ nanejurɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ aboloo kome yɛ mã akpiti kafu ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ mli, kɛ aboloo kome ni mu yɔɔ mli kɛ akpãanɔɔ kome, ni ekɛshwie fɔ lɛ kɛ shuɔ jurɔ lɛ nɔ.
Mose kɛ niyenii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ; ni efɔ̃ kɛtee kɛba akɛ afɔle ni afɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose saa he niyenii lɛ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ adɛŋ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ eshi shãa afɔlei ni ashãa fɛɛ emuu lɛ anɔ.
Eji osɔfowoo afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ahãa Yehowa, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ lɛ.
Mose kɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni lɛ tsitsi lɛ, ni ekɛshã afɔle ehã Yehowa akɛ nɔkee nɔ titri ko.
Mose ŋɔ osɔfowoo too ojwɛni tsitsi lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Mose ŋɔ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ eko kɛ lá ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ eko, ni ekɛshwã Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ enɛ fee Aaron kɛ etadei lɛ kɛ Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛtadei lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã Yehowa.
Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo lɛ ayaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni nyɛyahoa.
Nyɛyea loo lɛ kɛ aboloo ni yɔ kafu ni akɛ osɔfowoo afɔlei toɔ mli lɛ mli lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ.
Nyɛyea tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã akɛ, ‘Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aye lɛ.’ Loo kɛ aboloo ni aaashwɛ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshãa.
Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo ni akɛfeɔ nyɛ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ aaaho; ejaakɛ gbii kpawo akɛfeɔ osɔfowoo kusum lɛ.
Nɔ ni afee ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ afee koni akɛjie nyɛhe esha kɛya.
Nyɛhia Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii kpawo koni nyɛkɛfee nɔ ni Yehowa efã akɛ afee lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛfeee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi.
Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa wo mi kitã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ fee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose he kitã lɛ.
Aaron shã afɔle Gbi ni agbe osɔfowoo kusumi lɛ anaa lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Mose tsɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ.
Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ: “Ŋɔɔ tsinanuu fioo kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni kome hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ni okɛshã afɔle, ohã Yehowa.
Okɛ tsinanuu lɛ ashã esha afɔle ni okɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ashã shãa afɔle.
Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛŋɔ too ojwɛni amɛkɛshã esha afɔle; amɛkɛ tsinabi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ too gwantɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle; ni amɛkɛ tsinanuu kɛ too ojwɛni kɛ ŋmãa afɔle ni awo mli mu ashã naanyobɔɔ afɔle.
Amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.” Amɛkɛ nii ni Mose fã amɛ akɛ amɛkɛba lɛ ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛja Yehowa.
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa fã akɛ nyɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enunyam ni kpɛ kaŋkaŋ lɛ ajie ehe kpo atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Tsi obɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni oshã esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle ohã ohe koni okɛfɔ ohe esha kɛ maŋ lɛ he esha.
Oshã afɔle nɛɛ koni okɛfɔ maŋ lɛ he eshai, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo kitã lɛ.” Aaron tsi kɛtee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni egbe tsinanuu fioo lɛ ekɛshã esha afɔle ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ ba.
Aaron kɛ ewao tsɔ mli, ni ekɛdiki koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ.
Ni lá ni shwɛ lɛ etsi eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni eshã fɔ lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ mlɛbo lɛ he loo ni tsotsoro shi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kitã lɛ.
Shi kooloo lɛ kɛ hewolo lɛ eshã yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Mose gbe kooloo ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle lɛ hu.
Ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Amɛkɛ shãa afɔle lɛ hu bahã lɛ, loo ni ashãa lɛ kɛ yitso lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni efɔ mlinii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ ahe, ni ekɛshwie shãa afɔle ni jwere afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã fɛɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ maŋ lɛ afɔlei lɛ ba.
