Eŋɔ too kpakpo ni akɛbaashã maŋ lɛ he esha afɔle lɛ; egbe lɛ ni ekɛshã afɔle, tamɔ bɔ ni efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha afɔle lɛ.
Eŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛba, ni ekɛshã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ ba; ni ekpiti emli eko ekɔkɔ obɔ̃ ni ekɛfata shãa afɔle ni ashãa daa leebi lɛ he, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni egbe tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ ekɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔle ehã maŋ lɛ; ebihii lɛ kɛ lá lɛ bahã lɛ, ni ekɛshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too ojwɛni lɛ fɔi lɛ kɛ lei ni ewo fɔ lɛ kɛ fɔ ni ha mlinii lɛ ahe lɛ kɛ sabai lɛ kɛ loo ni tsotsoro mlɛbo lɛ he lɛ, Aaron kɛ fɛɛ shwie kooloi lɛ atsitsii lɛ anɔ, ni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ tsitsii lɛ kɛ sɛɛ ninejurɔ shuɔ naji lɛ hã Yehowa akɛ nikeenii titri ko, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ewo kitã lɛ.
Be ni Aaron eshã esha afɔle kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ maŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekpeleke shi.
Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛ Aaron bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛje kpo ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ.
Ni Yehowa anunyam ni kpɛɔ kaŋkaŋ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Trukaa lɛ Yehowa hã la ba ni ebashã shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ fɔi lɛ ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ, amɛbolɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
Nadab kɛ Abihu fee esha Shi Aaron bihii ni ji Nadab kɛ Abihu lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo elajee ŋɛsu, ni amɛkɛ la wo mli.
Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛshã amɛhã Yehowa; shi la ni amɛkɛshã lɛ bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jeee no he kitã Yehowa wo lɛ.
Yehowa hã la ba ebashã amɛ, ni amɛgboi yɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ be ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ mi lɛ esa akɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; majie minunyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.’ ” Shi Aaron mua enaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Mishael kɛ Elzafan, Aaron tsɛkwɛ Uziel bii lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ: “Nyɛbaa nyɛbaholea nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛjea He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.” Amɛba ni amɛbahole Aaron bihii lɛ kɛ amɛflakai ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ lɛ.
Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa nyɛyiteŋ fea tsaŋtsaŋ aloo nyɛgbalaa nyɛtadei kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ.
Kɛ nyɛfee nakai lɛ, nyɛbaagboi, ni Yehowa mli baawo maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ la.
Nyɛhãa nyɛwekumɛi, Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, afoa shãa ni Yehowa ehã la eshã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ni amɛgboi nɛɛ.
Nyɛkajea Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa hu ni nyɛbagboi, ejaakɛ akɛ Yehowa mufɔɔ mu lɛ efɔ nyɛ mu.” Amɛfee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Mlai ni awo Osɔfoi Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkanua wain loo dãa ni wa ko be mli ni nyɛyaa Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ.
Kɛ nyɛnu dãa lɛ, nyɛbaagboi.
Oshwiei fɛɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
Esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni kã nɔ ni he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni buleɔ mɔ teŋ; ni esa akɛ nyɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a Israelbii lɛ akpɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie he lɛ.” Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii ni eshwɛ ni ji Eleazar kɛ Itamar lɛ akɛ, “Niyenii afɔlei ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔlei ni ashã ahã Yehowa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛshãa mã akpiti aboloo ni nyɛyea yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he ejaakɛ afɔle nɛɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni fe fɛɛ ni.
Nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛgbɛnaanii ji niyenii afɔlei nɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ shãa afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa Yehowa lɛ asɛɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Yehowa kitã ni ewo mi.
Shi tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ ni akɛhãa Yehowa akɛ keenɔ lɛ nyɛyea yɛ he ko ni tse, bo kɛ obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ akɛ afɔlei nɛɛ ehã bo kɛ obii lɛ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaanii yɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔlei ni Israelbii lɛ shãa lɛ amli.
Akɛ tsitsi lɛ kɛ sɛɛ shuɔ lɛ afata fɔi lɛ ahe kɛba, be mli ni ashãa fɔi lɛ akɛ afɔle ahãa Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ.
Tsitsi lɛ kɛ shuɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii lɛ agbɛnaanii ni akɛhã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ ni.
Nakai ji bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afee.” Mose tao too ojwɛni ni akɛshãa esha afɔle lɛ aahu kɛyashi ena ele akɛ ashã momo.
Mose mli wo Eleazar kɛ Itamar Aaron bihii ni eshwɛ lɛ la ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛyeee esha afɔle lɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ?
Nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa ji afɔle lɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ koni nyɛkɛ kpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni nyɛjie maŋ lɛ he esha lɛ kɛya lɛ.
Akɛni akɛ too ojwɛni lɛ lá lɛ baaa Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛye afɔle lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ bɔ ni mifã lɛ.” Aaron to he ehã Mose akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ shã amɛhe esha afɔle kɛ amɛshãa afɔle lɛ ŋmɛnɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ oshara ebasharã mi nɛɛ.
Eji miye esha afɔle ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ ehi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ?” Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ena akɛ eja.
Kooloi ni aaanyɛ aye Yehowa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron wie koni amɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ ni amɛye nɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ nii ni nyɛye ji: nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbala mli aloo aja mli, ni asaŋ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛtaa.
-Shi nyɛkayea yooma kɛ afutuɔkɔ kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
Amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii, ni amɛtaa moŋ, shi agbalako amɛkoklotoi amli.
Nyɛkayea kplotoo, ejaakɛ ehe tseee.
Eyɛ koklotoi ni agbala mli moŋ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa.
Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ aloo; nyɛkataa amɛgbohii ahe hu, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
“Yɛ nu mli loi ateŋ lɛ, nyɛyea nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ kɛ fai amli fɛɛ.
Shi nii fɛɛ ni bɛ fiji kɛ totoi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli loo fai amli, bɔɔnii bibii ni ebua amɛhe naa tɔo kɛnyiɛ nu mli jio, bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ nu mli ni dara fe nomɛi jio, nyɛhia amɛ.
Nihiinii ji amɛ; nyɛkayea amɛloo, ni nyɛhia amɛgbohii lɛ tete.
Nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nu mli ni amɛbɛ fiji loo totoi lɛ, nii ni ahiɔ ni.
Yɛ loofɔji ateŋ lɛ, nii ni nyɛhia ni nyɛkayea nɛ: okropɔŋ kɛ akpaŋa kɛ ŋshɔŋ okropɔŋ kɛ laalɔɔ kɛ osansa henɔi srɔtoi lɛ kɛ kwãakwãalabite henɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ, kɛ duguma kɛ nyɔɔŋ akroma kɛ faanaa oka, kɛ akroma henɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ patu kɛ ŋshɔŋ patu, kɛ patu bibioo kɛ dɔkɔdɔkɔ kɛ kpokukpoku kɛ guŋ kɛ klitso kɛ ehenɔi srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ obleku kɛ aputupata.
“Kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni filikiɔ ni amɛwamɔɔ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛjwɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ nii ni yɔɔ shɔji enyɔɔnyɔ ni tsara amɛnane tokota nɔ ni amɛkɛtumɔɔ lɛ, nyɛyea.
Kooloi nɛɛ ji baalabii kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ, ligɔligɔ kɛ ehenɔi lɛ, kɛ agã kɛ ehenɔi, filikilɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ ni wamɔɔ ni amɛyɔɔ naji ejwɛɛjwɛ lɛ nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛhe tseee.
Ni enɛɛmɛi buleɔ nyɛ.
Kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛkɛbaabule nyɛhe.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa kooloi nɛɛ agbohii ahe lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɔ kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo he nɔ ko ehiɛ yɛ edɛ̃ lɛ, efɔ etadei lɛ ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koklotoi ni agbalako mli, ni asaŋ egɔiii nii ni eye momo lɛ, ehe tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata eko he lɛ, mɔ lɛ he tseee.
Kooloi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛniji nyiɛɔ yɛ kooloi naji ejwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi ateŋ lɛ, amɛhe tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni aaawo kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Nyɛbua kooloi nɛɛ akɛ kooloi ni ahe tseee.
“Kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ, nii ni he tseee ji obishi kɛ kwakwe kɛ odaaklɔ kɛ ehenɔi, kɛ mampam kɛ odiŋmɔlɔ kɛ tsunyɛ kɛ kɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ obosumaketeo.
Nyɛbua enɛɛmɛi akɛ nii ni he tseee yɛ kooloi ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa eko ni egbo he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko ni egbo aaagbee enɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ tso loo mama loo kooloo hewolo fee, loo kpekpe loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛkɛ ni akɛtsuɔ nii jio, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛwo nu mli.
Shi ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
No sɛɛ dani ehe aaatse.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ sũ fee ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko aaagbee mli lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ he tseee.
Ajwa sũnɔ ni nii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ.
Niyenii fɛɛ ni ayeɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ nu ni jɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli aaashwie nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anuɔ ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ sũnɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo aaagbee nɔ lɛ, ehe tseee.
Kɛ flɔnɔɔ loo latɛ nɔ egbee lɛ, akumɔ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee, ni nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ ni he tseee.
Shi kɛ nu hiŋmɛi loo dudɔ ni akɛ nu toɔ mli ni lɛ, no lɛ ehe tse; shi kɛ eko he aaasa kooloo gbonyo he lɛ, ehe tseee.
Kɛji kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ eko gbonyo gbee wu ni abaadu nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tse lolo.
Shi kɛ aafɔ dumɔnii lɛ yɛ nu mli, ni gbonyo lɛ gbee nɔ lɛ, wu lɛ he tseee.
“Kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ lɛ eko gbo lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa egbonyo lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ loo lɛ eko lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni woɔ kooloo lɛ gbonyo lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
“Kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ nii ni ahiɔ ni.
Kooloi fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ amɛmusu nɔ aloo amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ amɛnaji ejwɛ nɔ, aloo amɛyɔɔ naji piipii, kooloi bibii fɛɛ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea, ejaakɛ amɛbuleɔ mɔ.
Nyɛkayea koni nyɛkɛ no bule nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛwo nyɛhe muji.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛtoa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nibii ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ eko eko akabulea nyɛhe.
Mi ji Yehowa mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
“Belɛ enɛ ji mla ni kã shi yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɔ nu mli kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã ni nyiɛɔ ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ lɛ he.
Awo mla lɛ koni akɛna srɔto ni yɔɔ kooloi ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee teŋ, kɛ kooloi ni ayeɔ kɛ nii ni ayeee teŋ.”
Yei ahetsuumɔ yɛ bifɔmɔ sɛɛ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie koni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji yoo ko na musu, ni efɔ binuu lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo, tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ eyei aniifeemɔ be mli lɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, afo gbekɛ lɛ ketia.
Yoo lɛ aŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ ekata nɔ ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ he, ni ekaya Kpee Buu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbe ehetsuumɔ lɛ naa.
“Kɛ yoo ko fɔ biyoo lɛ, ehe tseee otsii enyɔ, tamɔ be ni efee yeianii lɛ.
Eŋɔ gbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsuu ehe, ni ekɛjie ehe lá muji lɛ.
“Kɛji gbii ni ekɛtsuɔ ehe lɛ, yɛ binuu loo biyoo hewɔ lɛ ho lɛ, ekɛ too gwantɛŋ bi ni eye afi aba abahã ni akɛshã shãa afɔle, kɛ shĩa okpo loo kosɛɛ okpo ni akɛshã esha afɔle.
Ekɛba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ afɔle lɛ aba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ekpãtã ehã yoo lɛ, koni ehe atse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã yoo ni fɔɔ nuu loo yoo lɛ.
“Shi kɛji yoo lɛ naaa too gwantɛŋbi yinii lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aba.
Akɛ ekome ashã shãa afɔle, koni akɛ ekome hu ashã esha afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ, ni ehe aaatse yɛ lá ni hoɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.”
Mlai ni kɔɔ hewolo nɔ helai ahe Yehowa kɛ mlai nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.
“Kɛji nɔ ko fũu yɛ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ loo fala ko loo gbɛ̃ ko, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ elɛɛ shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ kpiti hela lɛ, akɛ mɔ lɛ aba Osɔfo Aaron loo ebihii osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛ ekwɛ ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni; ni be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ helatsɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee.
Shi kɛji hewolo nɔ he ni akwɛ lɛ yɛ eyɛŋ ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle he lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ hu tsɔ̃ko eyɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ, ni kɛ hela lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ heloo lɛ hiɛ, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa aŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ekoŋŋ, ni kɛ hela lɛ elaaje, ni elɛɛko yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni he tse; hela lɛ gbɛ̃i ni.
Helatsɛ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, koni ehe atse.
Shi kɛji gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ ehewolo lɛ nɔ be ni osɔfo lɛ ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ ehe tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ ehe ayatsɔɔ osɔfo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ.
Kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni gbɛ̃i lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
“Kɛji kpiti shwie mɔ ko he lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ.
Kɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ ewo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni ehã jɛi tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni loo ŋmɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ ni efuu lɛ mli lɛ, belɛ kpiti momo yɔɔ ehewolo lɛ mli lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni he tseee ni.
Osɔfo lɛ akaŋa eyi, ejaakɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ ehe tseee.
Shi kɛji hela lɛ je kpo yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ naa kɛkɛ ji hela lɛ eshwie helatsɛ lɛ hewolo nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ eyiteŋ kɛyashi enaji ahe lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ hela lɛ eha ehewolo nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse.
Ni kɛ helatsɛ lɛ he fɛɛ eyɛ futaa lɛ, ehe tse.
Shi gbi nɔ ni aaana fala ŋmɔŋ yɛ helatsɛ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni kɛ ena lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛji fala lɛ tã, ni eesaa etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ ekoŋŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛ ena akɛ loo ŋmɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, helatsɛ lɛ he tse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
“Kɛji asane tsɛ̃ mɔ ko hewolo nɔ ni etã, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko yɛŋ bawo yɛ he ni asane lɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ yɛ lɛ, aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔo ba jɛi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ lɛ.
Kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni emli tsɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee; kpiti ebote asane lɛ mli.
Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ mli, ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ni enaa miilaaje lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Kɛji hela lɛ miilɛɛ shi fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ lɛ elɛɛɛ shi, ni eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ fladoku ni; asane lɛ shishi ni.
Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse.
“Kɛji la shã mɔ ko, ni la fala lɛ fee nɔ ko yɛŋ aloo nɔ ko yɛŋ ni etsuru fioo futu mli lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ.
Kɛji tsɔi ni yɔɔ la fala lɛ mli etsɔ̃ eyɛŋ, ni jɛi enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, belɛ kpiti ebote la fala lɛ mli.
Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛ osɔfo lɛ kwɛ lɛ, ni ena akɛ tsɔi yɛŋ bɛ fala lɛ mli ni jɛi enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ aŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi gbii kpawo.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ.
Kɛji fala lɛ elɛɛ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ fe bɔ ni kulɛ eyɔɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ kpiti ni.
Shi kɛji he ni hela lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni elɛɛko shi efatako he, shi moŋ enaa miilaaje lɛ, belɛ la fala lɛ kɛkɛ ni ehã jɛi efuu lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ helatsɛ lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ fala doku kɛkɛ ni.
“Kɛji fala fee nuu loo yoo ko yiteŋ loo etsɛŋ mli lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ.
Kɛji he ni fala lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle jɛi lɛ, ni tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ hwiaahwiaa ni ehiɛ wuɔfɔ su lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tseee; hela lɛ fafale ni; efeɔ yiteŋ loo tsɛŋ mli.
Kɛji be ni osɔfo lɛ kwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ena akɛ he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ lɛ enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ tsɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ bɛ ediŋ lɛ, eŋa helatsɛ lɛ yi ewo tsuŋ gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ asaa akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji fafale lɛ elɛko, ni tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su ekwɛ̃ko yɛ mli, ni fala lɛ enyɔko hewolo lɛ mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ahã mɔ lɛ ashɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ fe he ni fafale lɛ yɔɔ pɛ eshi.
Osɔfo lɛ aŋa mɔ lɛ yi awo tsuŋ gbii krokomɛi kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ fafale lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji elɛɛko ni enyɔko mli voo fe hewolo ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse.
Mɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe koni ehe atse.
Shi kɛji fafale lɛ elɛɛ, yɛ be ni akɛɛ akɛ mɔ lɛ he tse lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ helatsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji fafale lɛ esaa elɛɛ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ akɛ eeena tsɔi ni hiɛ wuɔfɔ su lo; nɔ ni kã shi faŋŋ kɛkɛ ji mɔ lɛ he tseee.
Shi kɛji ekwɛ lɛ esusuɔ akɛ fafale lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni tsɔi diŋ ekwɛ̃ yɛ mli lɛ, belɛ fafale lɛ etã.
Helatsɛ lɛ he etse; ni osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ ehe tse.
“Kɛji nii yɛji hãlãhãlã komɛi ba nuu loo yoo ko hewolo nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ.
Kɛji nibii yɛji hãlãhãlã nɛɛ ejeee shi jogbaŋŋ yɛ hewolo lɛ nɔ lɛ, belɛ aflimata eshwie mɔ lɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ; mɔ lɛ he tse.
“Kɛji nuu ko yi kpa yɛ eyisɛɛ lɛ, yikpataatsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse.
Kɛji ehiɛnaa gbɛ kɛkɛ eyi lɛ kpa yɛ lɛ, hiɛnaa kpataa tsɛ ji lɛ, shi ehe tse.
Shi kɛji nɔ ko yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo shwie eyiteŋ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, kpiti ji nɔ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ mɔ lɛ.
Kɛji osɔfo lɛ na fafale yɛŋ ni tsuɔ oo yɛ eyisɛɛ loo ehiɛnaa he ni ekpa lɛ, ni etamɔ kpiti yɛ hewolo nɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɛɛ akɛ eji mɔ ko ni he tseee yɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiteŋ lɛ hewɔ.
“Mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti lɛ egbala etadei, ni ehiɛ eyitso efolo.
Eha enaabu nɔ, ni ebolɔ akɛ, ‘Mihe tseee, mihe tseee!’ Gbii abɔ ni hela lɛ yɔɔ ehe lɛ, ehe tseee kwraa.
Ekome too ehi shi, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ ahi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
“Kɛji kpiti ekadi kuŋtu loo klala atade ko mli, aloo ekadi kuŋtu loo klala kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo kooloo wolo loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli, ni kadimɔ lɛ su eŋɔli loo etsuru yɛ atade loo kooloo wolo loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ, loo nɔ ko ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ kpiti he okadi ni; ni esa akɛ akɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ, ni ekɛ nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ ato gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ ekwɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛ yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo lɛ fee lɛ mli lɛ, belɛ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii eshwie he lɛ; ni nɔ mli ni ekadi lɛ he tseee.
Osɔfo lɛ ashã atade ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ, loo kpãi ni akɛlo kuŋtu loo klala atade lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee ni akadi mli lɛ; ejaakɛ eji kpiti ni fiteɔ nii; ni esa akɛ akɛ la ashã.
“Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ elɛɛko yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ, loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ afã akɛ afɔ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he, ni esaa eŋa eyi gbii kpawo ekoŋŋ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ akwɛ; ni kɛ ena akɛ kadimɔ lɛ su tsakeko be ni afɔ he sɛɛ, ni elɛko hu efatako he lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni kpiti lɛ ekadi mli lɛ he tseee.
Akɛ la ashã; hiɛgbɛ ekadi jio, sɛɛgbɛ jio, no kɔɔɔ he eko.
Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ kwɛ ni ena akɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miilaaje be ni afɔ he sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ etse he ni kadimɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ atade lɛ loo kooloo wolo lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ he.
Shi kɛji aana kadimɔ lɛ lolo yɛ atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo atade lɛ mli, loo nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ekadi nii lɛ mli lɛ miiku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ, akɛ la ashã nɔ ni mli ni ekadi lɛ.
Atade lɛ loo kpãi ni akɛlo lɛ loo kooloo wolo nɔ lɛ ni afɔ he lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ekadi mli lɛ je mli lɛ, afɔ he ekoŋŋ koni ehe atse.
“Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã kpiti ni eshwie kuŋtu loo odonti mama loo kpãi ni akɛloɔ mama lɛ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo wolo fee he lɛ.
Eji mla hu ni akɛnaa akɛ nɔ ni kpiti eshwie he lɛ he tse aloo ehe tseee.”
Mɔ ni eye hewolo nɔ hela hetsuumɔ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã lɛ.
Mlai nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni eye kpiti ni ehe etã hetsuumɔ.
Gbi nɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ehe etse lɛ, akɛ lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya nsra lɛ sɛɛ ni eyakwɛ lɛ.
Kɛji kpiti ni shwie helatsɛ lɛ etã yɛ ehe lɛ, osɔfo lɛ afã mɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ koni ekɛ loofɔji hiɛkãalɔi enyɔ ni he tse kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo aba.
Osɔfo lɛ afã ni agbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nu ŋmɔŋ yɔɔ mli nɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ amɔ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ.
Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ afata he ni ekɛ fɛɛ atsɔ loofɔlɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ kã ni nu yɔɔ mli lɛ lá lɛ mli.
Etsɔ la lɛ eshwã kpitiyelɔ ni abaatsuu ehe lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu ehe.
Eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ afɔ etadei lɛ ahe.
Eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi fɛɛ, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe koni ehe atse.
No sɛɛ lɛ, eba shitoohe lɛ mli, shi ekabote ebuu lɛ mli gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ esaa eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ekoŋŋ kɛ etsɛŋ kɛ ehiŋmɛi sɛɛ tsɔi kɛ ehe tsɔi fɛɛ.
Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe kɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu ewo mli kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome aba.
Osɔfo ni tsuuɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ he lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu shinaa lɛ naa.
Emɔ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ateŋ ekome ekɛbahã akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu, koni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko.
Egbe gwantɛŋbi lɛ yɛ he ni agbeɔ esha afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ yɛ lɛ, yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ jio, esha afɔle lɛ jio, fɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ nɔ ni; eji nɔ ko krɔŋkrɔŋ naakpa.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ awo mu lɛ ni efo eko ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli.
Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ mli lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni eshwɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa he ni akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ sa lɛ.
Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ koni osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã esha afɔle lɛ koni ekɛjie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ he muji lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ agbe too ni akɛ baashã shãa afɔle lɛ; no sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ashã shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛtsuu mɔ lɛ he; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.
Shi kɛ eji ohiafo ni enaaa enɛɛmɛi lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ gwantɛŋbi kome aba akɛ sɔ̃ afɔle, keenii titri ko ni akɛkpãtã ahã lɛ ni.
Ekɛ ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni awo mli mu hu aba akɛ niyenii afɔle, kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Asaŋ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba; emli eko fɛɛ eko ni enine aaashɛ nɔ.
Akɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni akɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle.
Ehetsuumɔ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ nibii nɛɛ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ gwantɛŋbi lɛ ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ kɛ mu lita mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ ni ekɛba Yehowa hiɛ akɛ keenii titri ko.
Osɔfo lɛ agbe gwantɛŋbi ni akɛshãa sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ.
Ekɛ toobi lɛ lá lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa.
Osɔfo lɛ afo mu lɛ eko awo enine abɛku kɔkɔ mli.
Ekɛ eninejurɔ wao atsɔ mu ni yɔɔ ebɛku lɛ eko eshwã shii kpawo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ mu ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ eko asa mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ ninejurɔ toi naa, kɛ eninejurɔ gɔnti naa, kɛ enanejurɔ gɔnti naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ akɛsa he ni lá ni akɛshã sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Mu ni eshwɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, efɔse eshwie mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yiteŋ, koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okpoi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni enine aaashɛ, kosɛɛ okpoi jio, shĩa okpoi jio, osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle efata niyenii afɔle lɛ he.
Efee enɛ ni ekɛkpãtã ehã mɔ ni atsuuɔ ehe lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni yeɔ kpiti ni enine shɛɛɛ nii ni akɛbaatsuu ehe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kpiti yɛ shĩai amli Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron.
Kɛ nyɛshɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛhã nyɛ ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni mihã kpiti shwie shĩa ko he yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nakai shĩa lɛ tsɛ lɛ aya ni eyakɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni nɔ ko tamɔ kpiti eshwie eshĩa lɛ he.
Osɔfo lɛ afã ni ajie shĩa lɛ mli nii kɛje kpo dani osɔfo lɛ abote shĩa lɛ mli ni eyakwɛ nɔ ni eshwie he lɛ.
Kɛji afeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ shĩa lɛ mli nii fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ nii ni he tseee.
Kɛ osɔfo lɛ yakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shĩa lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ, fɔji ŋɔlii kɛ etsuji ni, ni amɛmiikpe kɛmiibote gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ, no lɛ eje kpo ni eŋmɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ osɔfo lɛ aba ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji ekwɛ, ni ena akɛ fɔji lɛ elɛɛlɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ, no lɛ efã ni ajie tɛi ni hela lɛ eshwie he lɛ koni ashɛrɛ ashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tseee.
No sɛɛ lɛ, aŋmala shĩa lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ fɛɛ he kɛ kpe, ni akɛ su ni aŋmala lɛ ayashwie maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ he ko ni tseee.
Akɛ tɛi krokomɛi ahɔlɔ tɛi ni afamɔ lɛ anajiaŋ, ni akɛ su hee ama gbogboi lɛ ahe.
Kɛji hela lɛ ku sɛɛ eshwie gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ, ni eje shi faŋŋ yɛ he ni afamɔ tɛi lɛ ni aŋmala gbogboi lɛ ahe ni ama he yɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ aya ni eyakwɛ.
Kɛji ena akɛ nɔ ni eshwie shĩa lɛ he lɛ miilɛɛ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ hela ko ni tamɔ kpiti ni fiteɔ nii yɛ shĩa lɛ; shĩa lɛ he tseee.
Akumɔ shĩa lɛ ashwie shi, etɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ kɛ shĩa lɛ sũ lɛ fɛɛ, ni aloo kɛje maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashwie he ko ni tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli be mli ni ala agbo lɛ mli lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawɔ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe; ni mɔ ni aaaye nii yɛ shĩa lɛ afɔ etadei ahe.
Shi kɛji osɔfo lɛ ba shĩa lɛ ni ebakwɛ, ni ena akɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ ekuko esɛɛ eshwieko shĩa lɛ he kɛjɛ be ni ama shĩa lɛ he ekoŋŋ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, shĩa lɛ he tse, ejaakɛ nɔ ni shwie he lɛ etã kwraa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ loofɔji enyɔ kɛ tsenedru tso kɛ kpãa tsuru kɛ hisopo ashã esha afɔle kɛjwira shĩa lɛ.
Egbe loofɔji lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ kã ni nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu yɔɔ mli lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ fɛɛ atsɔ loofɔlɔ ni agbe lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu ni yɔɔ kã lɛ mli lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã shĩa lɛ shii kpawo.
Kɛ efee nɛkɛ lɛ, belɛ ekɛ loofɔlɔ lɛ lá lɛ kɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ kɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ kɛ tsenedru tso lɛ kɛ hisopo lɛ kɛ kpãa tsuru lɛ ejwra shĩa lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ eŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ he, yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa, koni efiliki kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Gbɛ nɔ ni osɔfo lɛ atsɔ kɛkpãtã ehã shĩa lɛ nɛ, koni shĩa lɛ he atse.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã hewolo nɔ helai srɔtoi ni tamɔ kpiti henɔ: -fala, fafale, loosule, gbɛ̃, fuumɔ kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli muji ni kaa mama mli kɛ gbogbo he mla.
Eji mla ni akɛnaa nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse; hela ni tamɔ kpiti kɛ ehenɔi ahe mla nɛ.
Gbɔmɔtso mli nu ni he tseee Yehowa kɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ hã Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛkɛhã Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛji nu miiho yɛ nuu ko nuutso mli lɛ, nu ni hoɔ lɛ he tseee.
Nu lɛ kã he eeho jio, nuutso lɛ etsi enaa ni ehã ekpa hoo jio, gbɔmɔ lɛ he tseee.
Saa fɛɛ saa ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ kãa nɔ lɛ he tseee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etaa nɔ lɛ he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa saa lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ sɛi nɔ lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni taa mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ tsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie mɔ ni he tse he lɛ, mɔ ni atsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwie ehe lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Sɛi ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ taa nɔ yɛ shwiili mli loo kooloo nɔ lɛ he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ ko ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ nɔ ko ni tamɔ nakai lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu ni efɔko edɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Sũ nii ni mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ aaata he lɛ, ajwa; ni tso nii fɛɛ tso nii ni eeeta he lɛ, akɛ nu afɔ mli.
Kɛji mɔ ni he hoɔ nu lɛ hela lɛ tã lɛ, emɛ gbii kpawo.
Efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hoɔ mli nu aju ehe; kɛkɛ lɛ ehe baatse.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi enyɔ aya Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa ni ekɛyahã osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ekome afee esha afɔle ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle, koni ekpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ nu ni hoɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji nuu ko shwie ehe shi lɛ, ekɛ nu aju ehe fɛɛ; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mama fɛɛ mama kɛ kooloo wolo fɛɛ kooloo wolo ni nu nɛɛ eko aaatee mli lɛ akɛ nu afɔ he; ni ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko wɔ, ni nuu lɛ henu je emli lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ nu aju amɛhe; amɛhe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji yoo ko fee yeianii ni ehe miiho lá lɛ, ehe tseee gbii kpawo.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa ehe lɛ he tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ he tseee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ hu he tseee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ lɛ saa he lɛ, afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko ta nɔ ko ni yɔɔ yoo lɛ saa nɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo lɛ na bɔlɛ ni lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ eko tee ehe lɛ, no lɛ ehe tseee gbii kpawo, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ he tseee.
Kɛji yoo ko he ho lá gbii pii be ni eshɛko etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ, aloo ehe ho lá yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ehe hoɔ la lɛ ehe tseee, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa gbii lɛ amli lɛ pɛ.
Saa fɛɛ saa ni ekã nɔ gbii abɔ ni ehe hoɔ lá lɛ tamɔ etsuiasɛɛyaa saa lɛ pɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eta nɔ lɛ he tseee tamɔ bɔ ni ehe tseee yɛ etsuiasɛɛyaa be lɛ mli lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee.
Efɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; ehe tseee kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji lá ni hoɔ yɛ yoo lɛ he lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, ekane gbii kpawo ehã ehe; no sɛɛ lɛ ehe aaatse.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ aba abahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ okpoi lɛ ateŋ ekome afee esha afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome hu afee shãa afɔle ni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe aaatse.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose koni ebɔ Israelbii lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe ni tseee lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkabule miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ni amɛbagboi.
Enɛ ji mla ni kã shi hã mɔ ni he hoɔ nu kɛ mɔ ni nu jeɔ emli ni no hãaa ehe atse.
Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã mɔ ni kɛ yoo ni miifee yeianii wɔɔ kɛ nuu ko ni kɛ yoo ni he tseee naa bɔlɛ.
Najiaŋtoo gbi Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Aaron bihii enyɔ ni kɛ la ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ tee Yehowa hiɛ ni amɛgboi lɛ agbele lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Okɛ onyɛmi Aaron awie koni ekabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmiiya muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, be fɛɛ be kɛkɛ, koni ekagbo, ejaakɛ mapue yɛ atatu mli yɛ naanɔ ni bu Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nii ni Aaron kɛbote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛ: tsinanuu oblanyo ni akɛfee esha afɔle kɛ ojwɛni ni akɛfee shãa afɔle.
“Aaron kɛ nu aju ehe, ni ewo klala flaka krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ klala tswakotoi lɛ.
Ekɛ klala mlifiinii lɛ afi emli, ni ekɛ klala tɔɔbaŋ afi eyitso.
Atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛ.
Israel asafo ku lɛ ahã Aaron too kpakpoi enyɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle, kɛ ojwɛni kome ni akɛbaafee eshãa afɔle.
Aaron kɛ tsinanuu ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ abashã esha afɔle kɛjie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai kɛ ewe lɛ he eshai.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ too kpakpoi enyɔ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Efɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki; oshiki kome hã Yehowa kɛ oshiki kome hã Azazel.
Aaron kɛ too kpakpo ni Yehowa oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ aba ni ekɛbashã esha afɔle.
Shi too kpakpo ni Azazel oshiki lɛ gbee enɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ ni kooloo lɛ hiɛ kã.
Eŋmɛɛ kooloo lɛ he ehã Azazel yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ koni ewo maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ kɛya.
“Aaron kɛ etsinanuu lɛ aba akɛ esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ, ni egbe.
Eloo ŋai kɛ la ŋɛsu obɔ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ tsofakɛŋma ni ashi bɔdɔbɔdɔ ekɔkɔi obɔbɔi enyɔ, ni ekɛbote muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Ekɛ ohɛ lɛ ashwie la lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ohɛ lɛ he lasu kumɔŋŋ lɛ baaha mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ ni bu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nɔ lɛ he, koni Aaron akana ni egbo.
Ekɛ ewao atsɔ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko koni ekɛshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ; ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko hu ni ekɛshwã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ shii kpawo.
“No sɛɛ lɛ, egbe too kpakpo ni ji maŋ lɛ nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ.
Ekɛ lá lɛ abote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni etsɔ eko eshwã mɔbɔnalɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛgbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ tsina lá lɛ fee lɛ.
Ni akɛjwira He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni tseee kɛ amɛtũatsemɔi kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Aaron afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Kpee Buu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ; efee yɛ amɛmuji nii lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni Aaron boteɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni eyakpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeje kpo.
Aaron akpãtã ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ ewe lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛya afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ he, ni etsuu he.
Ekɛ tsinanuu lɛ lá lɛ eko kɛ too kpakpo lɛ lá lɛ eko asra koji ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ eko eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ shii kpawo koni ekɛtsuu he efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
“Kɛ Aaron egbe He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ jwiramɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ aba.
Ekɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwie too kpakpo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejaje Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛmla tɔ̃mɔi ni ji amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ eshwie too kpakpo lɛ yiteŋ.
Etu lɛ ewo nuu ko ni mɛɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ dɛŋ koni eyaŋmɛɛ ehe ni eya ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Too kpakpo lɛ baatere amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛya ŋa nɔ he ko kplanaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ni jɛi nuu lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe yɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Aaron abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Ejie klala atadei ni ewo be ni ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ, ni eshi yɛ jɛi.
Eju ehe kɛ nu yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɔlɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ.
Eje kpo ni eyashã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ shãa afɔle kooloo lɛ koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋ lɛ hu.
Eshã fɔ ni yɔɔ esha afɔle lɛ he lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mɔ ni kɛ too kpakpo lɛ tee eya ŋmɛɛ ehe ehã Azazel lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe dani eba nsra lɛ mli.
Akɛ tsinanuu lɛ kɛ too kpakpo lɛ ni akɛshã esha afɔle lɛ ni akɛ amɛlá lɛ tee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛyakpãtã lɛ, aje nsra lɛ mli ni akɛ la ayashã.
Ashã amɛloo kɛ amɛhewoji kɛ amɛwamɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni yashã lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni ekɛ nu aju ehe; no sɛɛ fɛɛ dani eba shitoohe lɛ mli.” Kpãtãmɔ gbi wulu lɛ “Enɛ afee akpɔ ahã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ.
Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko, nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli bii jio, gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ jio.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ abaakpãtã ahã nyɛ koni akɛtsuu nyɛhe ni akɛhã nyɛhe atse yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu ni hã nyɛ.
Nyɛgbea nyɛhe hɔmɔ.
Akpɔ ni yɔɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.
Kusum ni abaafee kɛkpãtã lɛ, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu ni awo lɛ osɔfo koni eye etsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewo klala atadei ni ji atadei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni efee.
Ejwra He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekpãtã ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni kã shi hã nyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, koni akɛkpãtã ahã Israelbii lɛ daa afi shi kome yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ.” Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ kitã lɛ.
Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔ ko ji lá Yehowa fã Mose, koni ekɛ mlai ni abaatsi tã nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ.
“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ni gbeɔ tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli loo shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, eye lá yi sɔ̃.
Lá efɔse eshwie shi lɛ, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Yehowa bii anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mla nɛɛ oti ji akɛ kooloi ni Israelbii lɛ gbeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛkɛba ni amɛkɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa koni amɛgbe amɛkɛshã naanyobɔɔ afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa.
Osɔfo lɛ atsi lá lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eshã fɔ lɛ koni eje ŋma ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ akafee amɛhe mɛi ni yeee Yehowa anɔkwa ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa wɔji ni amɛnyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.
Enɛ atsɔ̃ akpɔ ni yɔɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ kɛ yinɔi fɛɛ ni baaba yɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii lɛ ni shãa shãa afɔle loo afɔle kroko ehãa Yehowa yɛ he kroko ni ekɛbaaa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii lɛ anɔ.
Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato Israelbii akaye loo lɛ mli lá, no lɛ majie mihiɛ maka nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni mi kɛ lɛ baafo takoŋ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, elá lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ, ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ afɔse lá lɛ fɛɛ ashwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjie maŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lá ni ji wala lɛ akɛjieɔ eshai yɛ gbɔmɔ he.
No hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato amɛ jio, amɛkaye loo ni lá yɔɔ mli lɛ.
“Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, kɛji eyagbɔbi ni egbe kooloo loo loofɔlɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ, efɔse elá lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ sũ atsi nɔ, ejaakɛ bɔɔ nii fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, amɛlá lɛ mli amɛwala yɔɔ; ni no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛkaye loo ko loo ko lá lɛ.
Bɔɔnɔ fɛɛ bɔɔnɔ lɛ elá mli ewala yɔɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lá lɛ abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.
“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele aloo kooloo ni kooloo awuyelɔ ko tserɛ emli lɛ, Israelnyo ji lɛ jio, gbɔ ni ebato Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji lɛ jio, efɔ etadei ahe ni ekɛnu aju ehe; ebaahi shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ dani ehe baatse.
Kɛji efɔɔɔ etadei ahe, ni ejuuu ehe lɛ, no lɛ esɔ̃ akã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.”
Nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ ni ahiɔ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie ni ekɛɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni nyɛhi tsutsu lɛ.
Asaŋ nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Amɛkusum lɛ nyɛkafea.
Nyɛyea mimlai kɛ migbɛjianɔtoi lɛ anɔ be fɛɛ be.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea migbɛjianɔtoi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nɔ ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni enaa wala lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.
Nuu ko nuu ko akabɛŋkɛ ewekunyo ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.
Okɛ onyɛ akawɔ ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi; onyɛ ni, kaahã ehiɛ miishwie shi.
Okɛ otsɛ ŋa akawɔ; obaashwie otsɛ hiɛ shi.
Okɛ onyɛmi yoo ni ji otsɛ loo onyɛ bi akawɔ; alɛ lɛ yɛ nyɛshĩa lɛ mli jio, shĩa kroko mli jio, okɛ lɛ akawɔ.
Okɛ obinuu biyoo loo obiyoo biyoo akawɔ.
Eji nɔ ko ni baashwie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ shi.
Okɛ otsɛ ŋa biyoo ni otsɛ fɔ lɛ akawɔ.
Onyɛmi yoo ni, ni esaaa akɛ ohãa ehiɛ shwieɔ shi.
Okɛ otsɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: otsɛ lá ji lɛ.
Okɛ onyɛ nyɛmi yoo akawɔ: onyɛ lá ji lɛ.
Kaabɛŋkɛ otsɛ nyɛmi nuu ŋa ni okɛshwie otsɛ hiɛ shi: onyɛkwɛ ni.
Okɛ onyɛmi nuu ŋa akawɔ: ebaahã onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ ashwie shi.
Okɛ onyɛmi nuu ŋa akawɔ ni okɛshwie onyɛmi nuu lɛ hiɛ shi.
Okɛ yoo kɛ ebiyoo fɛɛ akawɔ, ni asaŋ okaŋɔ obinuu biyoo loo ebiyoo lɛ biyoo ni okɛ lɛ yawɔ.
Yoo lɛ lá ji amɛ, ni jeŋba ni tamɔ nakai bɛ fɛo.
Kaaŋɔ oŋa nyɛmi yoo ofee oŋa bienyɛ; ni okɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ be mli ni oŋa hiɛ kã lolo.
“Kaaya yoo ŋɔɔ ni okɛ lɛ ayawɔ be mli ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ejaakɛ ehe tseee.
Okɛ onaanyo ŋa akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji.
Kaaŋmɛɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko he ohã ni akɛ lɛ ja Molek ni akɛ no wo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji.
Mi ji Yehowa.
Okɛ nuu akawɔ tamɔ okɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ; aahi.
Okɛ kooloo ko kooloo ko akawɔ ni okɛwo ohe muji.
Nakai nɔŋŋ esaaa akɛ yoo ko kɛ ehe hãa kooloo ko.
Nyɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko eko akawoa nyɛhe muji; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ jeŋmaji ni mibashwie mahã nyɛ lɛ kɛwoɔ amɛhe muji lɛ.
Gbɛ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni shikpɔŋ fee shikpɔŋ ni he tseee nɛ.
Mibagbala etoii yɛ enishaianii lɛ hewɔ, ni ebaafɛ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ eshwie.
-Mɛi ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ fee nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛkɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nihii nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko eko.
Maŋnyo jio, gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ jio, nyɛyea Yehowa mlai lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ anɔ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ hu eshwie tamɔ bɔ ni efɛ̃ jeŋmaŋ ni tsɔ nyɛhiɛ lɛ eshwie lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nɛkɛ nihiinii nɛɛ eko lɛ, abuŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɛi lɛ anɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea nii ni mifã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkafea kusumi ni ahiɔ ni afeɔ dani nyɛba lɛ, koni nyɛkɛkawo nyɛhe muji.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ kɛ jalɛ he mlai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose, ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashe enyɛ kɛ etsɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ; mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Nyɛkayanyiɛa yakayaka wɔji asɛɛ, ni nyɛkafea dade wɔji hu ni ashwie nyɛhã nyɛhe; mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛgbe kooloo nyɛkɛmiishã naanyobɔɔ afɔle lɛ, nyɛfea lɛ yɛ mlai ni awo yɛ he lɛ naa koni esa mihiɛ ni mahere.
Aye loo lɛ gbi ni ashã afɔle lɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ; shi nɔ ni baashwɛ kɛyaashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ la ashã, ejaakɛ ehe tseee; ni kɛ aye gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ loo lɛ eko lɛ, minaŋ afɔle lɛ he tsui.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ, etere musu, ejaakɛ ewo keenɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛmiihã Yehowa he muji, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ mimɛi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
“Kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshinii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa nii ni yɔɔ nyɛŋmɔji lɛ anaanaa lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa.
Ni nyɛkakpaa wain tsei lɛ ayibii hu fɛɛ kɛmɔɔ shi; ni wain yibii ni aaashwie shi lɛ hu nyɛkakɔlɔa.
Nyɛshĩa nyɛhãa ohiafoi kɛ gbɔi lɛ koni amɛbaye lɛ kpɛkpɛo.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Kaaju; kaashishiu onaanyo gbɔmɔ, kaalaka lɛ.
Kaakã kitã yɛ migbɛi mli ni okɛshishiu mɔ ko ni okɛwo oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he muji.
Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Kaaye onaanyo gbɔmɔ amim, ni kaatswa lɛ ojo.
Kaahã je miitsɛre apaafonyo nyɔmɔwoo nɔ.
Kaalomɔ toimulɔ, ni okɛ pampi akama shwilafo gbɛ nɔ ni eyatɛ; shi she oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Kaatsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ obu shi ni oye ohã ohiafo aloo ohiɛ shwie gbɔmɔ wulu hiɛ.
Kojomɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kaanyiɛ kɛmiiya kɛmiiba ni ooye osheku yɛ omaŋ lɛ mli; ni kaate shi oshi onaanyo gbɔmɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɔgbee sane fɔ̃ enɔ; mi ji Yehowa.
“Kaanyɛ onyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ otsui mli; shi kã lɛ blɛoo yɛ etɔ̃mɔ he koni okatere sɔ̃ ko bo diɛŋtsɛ hu.
Kaatɔ ohe owele, ni kaabɛ omaŋbii lɛ eko owo omli, shi suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.
“Nyɛyea mikpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Kaahã oshĩa kooloi srɔtoi miifutu amɛmiikwɔ.
Oŋmɔ mli hu kaafutu wui srɔtoi odu.
Ni kaawo atade ni akɛ klala kɛ kuŋtu futu lo.
“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nyɔŋyoo ko wɔ, ni nyɔŋyoo lɛ atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu kroko, shi nuu nɛɛ woko eyi nyɔmɔ koni yoo lɛ aye ehe lɛ, no lɛ abote sane lɛ mli.
Agbala yoo lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ toi, shi akagbe amɛ, ejaakɛ ahãko yoo lɛ aye ehe.
Shi nuu lɛ kɛ ojwɛni aba abahã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ ojwɛni ni ji sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ akpãtã ahã nuu lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ, ni akɛaafa lɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, yeli tso fɛɛ yeli tso ni nyɛaatɛo ni ayeɔ lɛ, nyɛbua eyibii lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni ehe tseee kɛyashi afii etɛ̃; akaye eyibii lɛ.
Shi afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ afee tso yibii lɛ fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ akɛ afɔle ni aashã ahã mi, Yehowa, kɛda mi shi.
Shi afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea yibii lɛ, koni nibaa nii afa babaoo ahã nyɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Nyɛkayea loo ni lá yɔɔ mli.
Nyɛkaklaa, ni nyɛkayea ŋkunyaa.
Nyɛkashɛa nyɛyitsei ahe, ni nyɛkakua nyɛtsɛŋ nɔ.
Nyɛkabamɔa nyɛhewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛyea gbonyo ko he ŋkɔmɔ; ni nyɛkayea sãmãi yɛ nyɛhewolo nɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa.
“Okɛ obiyoo akawɔ ni ohã etsɔ̃ yoo ajwamãŋ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bayi tɔ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ.
Nyɛyea mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni nyɛshea he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ gbeyei; mi ji Yehowa.
“Nyɛkanyiɛa okɔmfoi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai anɔ, koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe muji.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Ohiɛ asɔ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ, ni owo amɛ.
She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.
Mi ji Yehowa.
“Kɛ gbɔ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkawaa lɛ yi.
Nyɛhiɛa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbaahiɛ nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛsumɔa lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
“Nyɛkayea sane ni ejaaa yɛ nisusumɔ kɛ niŋmɛɛ kɛ nikaa mli.
Nyɛhiɛa nsɛnii kpakpai kɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛi kpakpai kɛ nisusumɔ nii kpakpai.
Mi ji Yehowa ni jie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea fɛɛ nɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa.”
Toigbele he toigbalamɔ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji Israelnyo loo gbɔ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ ebii lɛ eko aaahã ni akɛja Molek lɛ, agbe lɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ ebii ateŋ mɔ ko hã Molek, ni ekɛwo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ajaa mi yɛŋ lɛ he muji, ni eshwie migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ shi lɛ, mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ.
Shi kɛji mɛi ateŋ ni eyɔɔ lɛ ku amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ ni efee lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbeee lɛ lɛ, mi lɛ majie mihiɛ maka lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, shi amɛjaa Molek lɛ.
Mibuŋ amɛ mishiŋ miwebii anɔ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko yabi nii yɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ sisai aŋɔɔ lɛ, mate shi mawo lɛ, ni mibuŋ lɛ mishiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ akãa mimlai lɛ ahe ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ.
Etsɛ kɛ enyɛ elomɔ lɛ; esɔ̃ atere lɛ.
“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko ŋa ku gbãlã mli lɛ, agbe nuu gbãlãŋkulɔ kɛ yoo gbãlãŋkulɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nuu ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ eshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi.
Gbe agbe lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ eshaayoo ni ji ebinuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ eshaayoo lɛ fɛɛ; hiɛgbejianii amɛfee lɛ; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ nuu kroko wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ yoo wɔɔ lɛ, amɛfee nɔ ni ahiɔ; agbe amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ; ni amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko kɛ enyɛ fɛɛ efee eŋãmɛi lɛ, ashã amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ musu ni amɛbɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ kooloo ko wɔ lɛ, agbe lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛji yoo ko bɛŋkɛ kooloo ko, ni ekãa shi ehãa lɛ, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ wɔ lɛ, agbe yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ fɛɛ; amɛmusu atere amɛ.
“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi yoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔ lɛ, amɛfee hiɛgbejianii.
Atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ.
Nuu lɛ ni kɛ enyɛmi yoo ewɔ lɛ, esɔ̃ atere lɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ yoo ko ni etee tsuiasɛɛ wɔ lɛ, atswa amɛnaneshi tu kɛje amɛwekumɛi ateŋ.
“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛ nyɛmi yoo loo enyɛ nyɛmi yoo wɔ lɛ, eshwie mɔ ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ heloo kome hiɛ shi; amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ ŋa wɔ lɛ, eshwie etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ hiɛ shi; ekɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ, amɛsɔ̃ atere amɛ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ bi, ni ebaagbo.
Kɛji nuu ko kɛ enyɛmi nuu ŋa wɔ lɛ, amɛbaagboi ni amɛbɛ bi.
Nuu lɛ etsu hiɛgbejianii, ni eshwie enyɛmi lɛ hiɛ shi.
“Nyɛyea mimlai lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa ni nyɛyahi nɔ lɛ akafɛ̃ nyɛ eshwie.
Nyɛkakasea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akusumi ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.
Miishwie nɛkɛ wɔŋjalɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛya.
Amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ehã minyaŋe amɛ.
Shi miwo nyɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii nɛɛ he shi, ni mikɛbaahã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea srɔto yɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji ni he tse kɛ nii ni he tseee ateŋ.
Nyɛkayea kooloi loo loofɔji ni he tseee.
Mihã nyɛle akɛ amɛhe tseee; ni kɛ nyɛye lɛ nyɛhe baawo muji.
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛhãa mi pɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mihe tse.
Mijie nyɛ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ mito afã koni nyɛfee mi pɛ minɔ.
“Nyɛteŋ nuu loo yoo ni aaayabi nii yɛ sisa ŋɔɔ lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ enɛ lɛ egbele sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.”
Osɔfoi lɛ ahe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ Yehowa fã Mose ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi ni ji Aaron bihii lɛ akɛ, “Osɔfo ko akaya wekunyo ko kɛkɛ ni egbo yara nɔ ni ekɛwo ehe muji, belɛ ja enyɛ loo etsɛ loo ebinuu loo ebiyoo loo enyɛmi nuu loo enyɛmi yoo, ni ji oblayoo foro ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, koni ekɛbule ehe.
Ekaya mɔ ko ni gbãlã hewɔ efeɔ ewekunyo yara nɔ koni ekɛwo ehe muji.
“Osɔfo ko akakpɔ eyi, ni ekaku etsɛŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ ekabãmɔ ehewolo nɔ gbɛ̃i kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ afee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã mi, ni ekawo migbɛi lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ Yehowa afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa, ni ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aboloo lɛ, lɛ ekɛbahãa.
No hewɔ lɛ, efee ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Osɔfo ko akaŋɔ yoo ajwamãŋ ko loo yoo ni le nuu, loo yoo ni ewu eshwie lɛ, ejaakɛ miniyenii afɔle lɛ, osɔfo lɛ kɛbahãa mi; Osɔfo lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Nyɛbua osɔfo lɛ akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, ji mɔ ni mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kɛji osɔfo ko biyoo fee ehe ajwamãŋ lɛ, ewo etsɛ he muji; ashã lɛ ni egbo.
“Osɔfonukpa lɛ, mɔ ni afɔse mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ ashwie eyiteŋ ni awo lɛ osɔfo, ni ewo osɔfo atadei lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekahiɛ eyitso folo, ni ekagbala etadei hu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eeye ŋkɔmɔ.
-Afɔ lɛ mu ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi; no hewɔ lɛ, ekawo mishihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji; ni ekashi jɛi etee eyabote shĩa ko ni gbonyo ko kɛkɛ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ tete gbonyo kã mli.
Eŋɔ oblayoo foro.
Ekaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ loo mɔ ni le nuu loo yoo ajwamãŋ; shi moŋ eŋɔ oblayoo foro kɛjɛ etsɛ weku lɛ mli.
Efee enɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ eshwiei ni sa akɛ amɛfee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ahe baawo muji.
Mi ji Yehowa, ni mijɔɔ enɔ mifee lɛ osɔfonukpa.” Yehowa fã Mose, ni ekɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni eje kpa akaba, yɛ amɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli, ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi.
Mɔ ko ni kpa yɔɔ egbɔmɔtso he kɛ afɔle lɛ akaba; mɔ ni eshwila aloo etsɔ̃ɔ, loo eji gbɔmɔ akotia loo gbɔmɔ asaabu, loo mɔ ni enane loo enine eje kpa loo afutsɛ, loo mɔ ni tɛ kã ehiŋmɛi nɔ, loo mɔ ni he edɔ kpla loo mɔ ni egbɛi mli wui ejwra.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe yɛ osɔfo Aaron bihii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ ni ekɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ bahã mi.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nakai lɛ eeenyɛ eye aboloo ni ji nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ amli lɛ eko moŋ, shi muhɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he kɛkɛ ni ekaba, ni ekatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ kpa yɛ ehe.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekawo minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe muji, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Belɛ enɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Krɔŋkrɔŋ nii ji afɔlei lɛ Yehowa fã Mose, ni ekɛɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ: “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii lɛ tsuɔ he ni amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhãa mi lɛ he, koni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ akagbo.
Mi ji Yehowa.
Kɛji oshwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni he tseee tsi bɛŋkɛ afɔlei ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ etsuu he amɛjɔɔ nɔ amɛhã mi lɛ, abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ miwebii lɛ anɔ.
Mla nɛɛ kã shi hã yinɔi fɛɛ.
“Aaron shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye hewolo nɔ hela gbeyeigbeyei aloo ehe miiho nu akaye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ehe aaatse.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni taa nɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, loo nuu ni ehe nu jeɔ emli hoɔ, loo nuu ni taa waamɔnii ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, aloo etaa mɔ ko ni woɔ mɔ he muji he, loo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taa nibii nɛɛ eko he lɛ, ehe tseee kɛyashi hulu aaanyɔ shi.
Ni kɛ ejuko ehe lɛ ekaye nikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko.
Kɛ hulu enyɔ shi ni ehe tse lɛ, no sɛɛ dani eye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ eko, ejaakɛ nomɛi ji eŋmãa.
Ekaye kooloo ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele loo kooloi etserɛ lɛ.
Kɛji eye lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ mɔ ni he tseee; mi ji Yehowa.
“Osɔfoi fɛɛ aye mlai ni miwo nɛɛ anɔ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ amɛaatere sɔ̃, ni amɛaagboi yɛ mimlai krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anɔtɔ̃mɔ hewɔ; mi mifeɔ osɔfoi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
“Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko akaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbɔ loo apaafonyo ni ebato osɔfo gbɔ.
Shi nyɔŋ ni osɔfo lɛ he kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshika, aye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko; ni nyɔji ni afɔ amɛ yɛ osɔfo lɛ we lɛ kɛ lɛ aye eniyenii lɛ eko.
Kɛ osɔfo ko biyoo yagbã mɔ ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ekaye nii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli nɔ ni aje gbɛ ajie ato afã lɛ.
Shi kɛji osɔfo biyoo lɛ tsɔ̃ okulafo aloo ewu shwie lɛ, ni ebɛ bi, ni eku esɛɛ kɛba etsɛ we lɛ, tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, no lɛ eye etsɛ nii lɛ eko.
Mɔkpɔŋ ko mɔkpɔŋ ko kɛkɛ akaye eko.
“Kɛji mɔ ko ni jɛɛɛ osɔfoi aweku mli leee ehe be ni eyaye nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko lɛ, eto najiaŋ ni ekɛ mlijai enumɔ mli ekome ashi nɔ.
Osɔfoi lɛ akaŋmɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ gbɛ ni eye niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ eko.
Kɛji amɛŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛbaawo niyenii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛaatere tɔ̃mɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃, ni aaagbala amɛtoi, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa ni feɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Yehowa fã Mose koni ekɛ mlai nɛɛ ahã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, “Kɛji Israelnyo ko loo mɔ ko ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shãa afɔle miiba abahã Yehowa, shiwoo ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa nii jio, kooloo lɛ afee kooloo ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Bɔ ni afee ni esa Yehowa hiɛ ni ehe lɛ; kooloo lɛ afee tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia nuu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Kɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe ba lɛ, esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eheŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ naanyobɔɔ afɔle tamɔ akɛ tsina loo too, loo afɔle ni ewo he shi eto, loo afɔle ni eeshã yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, miiba abahã Yehowa lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko ahi kooloo lɛ he; esa akɛ efee kooloo ni eye emuu koni esa Yehowa hiɛ.
Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni eshwila aloo ehe ko eku, loo ehenii shɛɛɛ, loo fala ni hoɔ nu yɛ ehe, loo kpla loo ajitɔ eshwie ehe loo nɔ ko ewo yɛ ehewolo nɔ akaba akɛ nyɛkɛbaahã Yehowa koni akɛshã afɔle ahã lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji afɔle ni nyɛkɛba lɛ tsuijurɔ naa nyɛkɛba lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkɛ kooloo ni enine loo enane bɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ashã afɔle lɛ.
Shi kɛ afɔle ni nyɛwo he shi nyɛto nyɛshãa lɛ, no lɛ kooloo lɛ esaŋ Yehowa hiɛ ni eheŋ.
Nyɛkɛ kooloo ni ajwara aloo ashimɔ aloo atserɛ aloo afolɔ egbɛi akashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa.
Ni nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Nyɛkahea kooloi nɛɛ eko yɛ maŋsɛɛnyo dɛŋ ni nyɛkɛbahã Yehowa akɛ niyenii afɔle, ejaakɛ adebɔɔ mli kpa ko yɛ maŋsɛɛ kooloi nɛɛ ahe.
Eji kpa ni eka amɛhe, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa hiɛ.
-“Kɛji afɔ tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotiabi lɛ, akajie lɛ yɛ enyɛ he kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, esa hã niyenii afɔle shãa hã Yehowa.
Nyɛkagbea tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia kɛ ebi fɛɛ gbi kome.
Kɛji nyɛmiishã shidaa afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛyea ehe mlai lɛ anɔ, koni afɔle lɛ asa ehiɛ.
Nyɛyea loo lɛ fɛɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ; nyɛkashwɛa eko ni je tsɛre nɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛhiɛ ahiãa mikpɔi lɛ anɔ ni nyɛyea nɔ; mi ji Yehowa.
Nyɛkahãa migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ miigbo.
Esa akɛ Israelbii fɛɛ abu mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; mi ji Yehowa, ni mi mifeɔ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ; mi ji Yehowa.”
Jamɔ gbii juji lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ gbii juji ni, mi, Yehowa, mito akɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.
Atsu nii gbii ekpaa; shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaahi; akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja Yehowa gbii juji ni akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ kɛja lɛ nɛ.
Nyɛshiɛa eko fɛɛ eko kɛji ebe ni ato lɛ shɛ lɛ.” Hehoo kɛ Ma Akpiti Aboloo Gbijurɔ “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo gbi lɛ.
Ni gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ lɛ, no ji mã akpiti gbijurɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã gbii kpawo kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.
Gbii kpawo nɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa gbii kpawo.
Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa; shi akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpa enɔ ŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ abele tso kɛ eyinii lɛ abahãa osɔfo lɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ nikpamɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya kɛba akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ko ni nyɛsa Yehowa hiɛ.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ osɔfo lɛ baafɔ̃ afɔle nɛɛ.
Gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ nii afɔle lɛ baaba lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ gwantɛŋbi ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛbahãa Yehowa.
Ni niyenii afɔle ni afata kooloo lɛ he ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ, kiloi enyɔ, koni ashã ahã Yehowa koni eje ŋma ewo lɛ; ni dãa afɔle ni akɛfata he ji wain lita kome.
Ni kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔle lɛ aaabahã nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aboloo loo abele ni ashã loo abele fɔ ko akaya nyɛdaaŋ.
Akpɔ nɛɛ kã shi hã nyɛshwiei yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Ŋmãakpamɔ gbijurɔ lɛ “Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ ni ji gbi ni nyɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛku lɛ baahã Yehowa lɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni ji Hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ abele fɔ afɔle lɛ abahãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni akɛŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni awo mli yiisi shã ajɛa nyɛshĩai amli kɛbaa akɛ nyɛŋmɔshi klɛŋklɛŋ nikpamɔnii ni nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii kpawo ni amɛye afifii, ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ afata aboloi lɛ ahe.
Akɛ kooloi lɛ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa lɛ fɛɛ baafee shãa afɔle akɛhã Yehowa.
Afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa ni.
Asaŋ nyɛkɛ too kpakpo kome afea esha he faikpamɔ afɔle, koni nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni amɛye afifii lɛ afea shidaa afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ baaŋɔ aboloo lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii lɛ ehã koni afɔ̃ akɛ fɔ̃ɔ afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa nii krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Aŋɔ hã osɔfo lɛ akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Ashiɛ koni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛkpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja, ni akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.
Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
“Ni kɛji nyɛmiikpa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ, nyɛkakpaa ŋmɔ lɛ naanaanii lɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa; nakai nɔŋŋ hu onikpamɔnii lɛ amli kpɛkpɛbii lɛ hu kaakpɛte; shi moŋ ashi ahã ohiafo kɛ gbɔ koni amɛkɛbaye kpɛkpɛo.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Afi hee gbijurɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ, nyɛyea lɛ kpoo akɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbijurɔ.
Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ akɛ kaimɔ nɔ kɛshiɛ gbi lɛ, koni akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle abahãa Yehowa.” Kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji esha kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ.
Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ; asaŋ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ kpãtãmɔ gbi ni, koni akpãtã yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni waaa ehe yi kɛ hɔmɔ nakai gbi lɛ lɛ, akaneŋ lɛ ashiŋ emaŋbii anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ emaŋbii lɛ ateŋ.
Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.
Naanɔ akpɔ nɛ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi wulu nɛ hã nyɛ.
Nyɛwaa nyɛhe yi kɛ hɔmɔ kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi aahu kɛyaashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛnaashi ekoŋŋ.
Nyɛyea Hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ.” Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo ni kã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ ji Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ; aye gbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo ahã Yehowa.
Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛja; akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
Gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛŋ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛjaa ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle ni ashãa abaa abahãa Yehowa.
Kpee wulu diɛŋtsɛ gbi ni.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
“Enɛɛmɛi ji gbii juji ni Yehowa eto lɛ; ni kɛji eko shɛ lɛ nyɛshiɛa koni maŋ lɛ akpe kpei krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛja, asaŋ koni ashã niyenii afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei akɛhã Yehowa, eko fɛɛ eko yɛ egbi nɔ.
Esoro Yehowa Hejɔɔmɔgbii lɛ, dani esoro nyɛdaadaa nikeenii lɛ, ni esoro nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ hu ni nyɛkɛbahãa Yehowa.
“Nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, be ni nyɛkpa ŋmɔshinii nyɛgbe naa lɛ, nyɛjea shishi nyɛyea Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ kɛyashia gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi krɛdɛɛ ni.
Gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛhiɛa nyɛtsei anɔ aduawai kpakpai fɛɛfɛji kɛ tɛŋ bɛlɛo kɛ tsei flofloi aniji kɛ faa naa ŋɔi kɛbaa koni nyɛbanyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ gbii kpawo.
Nyɛkɛ gbii kpawo ayea gbijurɔ nɛɛ daa afi nyɛhãa Yehowa yɛ nyɔɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Eji naanɔ akpɔ hã nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ.
Nyɛhia asesei amli gbii kpawo.
Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo ahi asese mli, koni nyɛshwiei kɛna amɛle akɛ be ni miyakpala Israel kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asesei amli mihã amɛhi.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Belɛ bɔ ni Mose tsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ gbii juji ni Yehowa eto ehã amɛ akɛ amɛye lɛ nɛ.
Kanei lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Fã Israelbii akɛ amɛbahã bo mutso mu krɔŋŋ ni akɛ mutso ni ashimɔ fee koni akɛ mu lɛ asu Kpee Buu lɛ mli kane lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ahã kane lɛ ama nɔ be fɛɛ be.
Aaron akwɛ koni kane lɛ atso, kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ aahu kɛyashi daa jetsɛremɔ leebi, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ muhɔɔ ni fo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Enɛ afee naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛshwiei.
Aaron baakura kanei lɛ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi kanetsei lɛ anɔ, ni ebaakwɛ koni amɛtso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ be fɛɛ be.
Aboloo ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ “Okɛ ŋmãa mamu ashã aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, aboloo akwaabɔ kome aye ŋmãa mamu kilo kome.
Too aboloo lɛ srɛnɛɛ kui enyɔ yɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Aboloo ekpaa aye afã biɛ, ni aboloo ekpaa hu aye biɛ.
Okɛ krɔbɔo krɔŋŋ afata aboloo ku kome fɛɛ ku kome he, koni no afee kaimɔ nɔ ni akɛbahã akɛ afɔle ni ashã ahã Yehowa.
Daa Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Aaron ato aboloo nɛɛ eshwie okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Naanɔ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi hã Israelbii nɛ.
Aboloi lɛ atsɔ̃ Aaron kɛ eshwiei agbɛfaŋnɔ; ni amɛye nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle ni abashã akɛhã Yehowa mli nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.” Toigbalamɔ ni ja gbɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ Be ko lɛ Israelyoo ko binuu ni ekɛ Ijiptnyo ko fɔ lɛ kɛ Israelnyo ko yabe yɛ maŋ, yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Israelyoo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Shelomit, ni etsɛ ji Dibri ni jɛ Dan akutso lɛ mli lɛ.
Bei lɛ mli lɛ oblanyo lɛ bɔ musu elomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɔ lɛ kɛbahã Mose.
Atsi oblanyo lɛ naa kɛyashi Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni afee lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ mɔ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya esɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nu akɛ elomɔ lɛ kɛ amɛniji abashwie eyiteŋ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋtso muu lɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baalomɔ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ lɛ, emusu baabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ; mɔ ni baalomɔ Yehowa lɛ, gbe kɛ̃ aaagbe lɛ.
Gbɔ ni jio, maŋnyo ni jio, kɛji ena elomɔ Yehowa lɛ, maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.’ “Mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu agbe lɛ; ni mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ kroko kooloo lɛ, eto kooloo lɛ najiaŋ kɛ kooloo nɔŋŋ; akɛ kooloo ato kooloo najiaŋ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko pila enaanyo gbɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ hu apila lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ bɔ ni epila enaanyo lɛ koni akɛtse.
Kɛji eku enaanyo lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli wu lɛ, aku lɛ hu ewu akɛtse; kɛji hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, akɛ ehiŋmɛi atse, ni kɛji nyanyɔŋ ni lɛ, akɛ lɛ hu enyanyɔŋ atse.
Bɔ ni epila mɔ lɛ ehã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nɔŋŋ apila lɛ hu kɛtse.
Mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko kooloo ko lɛ, eto mɔ lɛ kooloo lɛ najiaŋ; shi mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ.
Mla koome nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ fɛɛ, gbɔ kɛ maŋnyo fɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie egbe naa lɛ, maŋbii lɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni lomɔ lɛ kɛje amɛshitoohe lɛ mli kɛtee esɛɛ, ni ayatswia lɛ tɛ yɛ jɛi ni egbo.
Belɛ kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ kusum Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa shikpɔŋ lɛ akãa shi efolo afi koni ekɛjɔɔ ehe akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa.
Nyɛhua shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛdua nyɛŋmɔshi nii afii ekpaa, ni nyɛkpɔlɔa nyɛwaintsei ahe, ni nyɛkpaa amɛyibii afii ekpaa hu; shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, aŋmɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ejɔɔ ehe kpoo, akɛ woo kɛhã Yehowa.
Akadu nii yɛ ŋmɔshi, ni akakpɔlɔ waintsei ahe hu.
Ŋmɔshinii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eeekwɛ̃ lɛ, akakpa ato; ni yibii ni waintsei ni akpɔlɔko amɛhe lɛ aaawo lɛ hu, akakpa ato.
Nakai afi lɛ eji hejɔɔmɔ afi hã shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ be nɛɛ mli niyenii ni baakwɛ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebaashɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɔji hii kɛ yei kɛ nyɛpaafoi kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ, kɛ nyɛshĩa kooloi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yeli aahu.
Niyenii fɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba lɛ aye.” Nikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ “Nyɛkanea shikpɔŋ lɛ hejɔɔmɔ afi nɛɛ toi kpawo, no ji afii kpawo kpawo toi kpawo.
Enɛ feɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nɛɛhu.
Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ, no ji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi lɛ.
Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛfo shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Gbi nɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɛfea afi ni ji afi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ashiɛ heyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã enɔ bii fɛɛ.
Etsɔ̃ nyamɔ afi ehã nyɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ko ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ, mɔ lɛ loo eshwie ko aku sɛɛ ayaŋɔ nii lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ aku esɛɛ eya ewekumɛi aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Nɛkɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɛɛ atsɔ nyamɔ afi ahã nyɛ.
Nyɛkadua nii yɛ enɔ; ni nyɛkakpaa niyenii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ nyɛtoa; asaŋ nyɛkakpaa nyɛwaintsei ni akpɔlɔɔɔ amɛhe lɛ anɔ yibii lɛ hu.
Nyamɔ afi ni, ni nyɛyea lɛ akɛ afi krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baaba ahã nyɛ lɛ, no nyɛyea.
“Nɛkɛ nyamɔ afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kulɛ ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eya ni eyaŋɔ enii ekoŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ohɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko ohã onyɛmi Israelnyo, aloo ohe shikpɔŋ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akamɔ enyɛmi lɛ loo eshishiu enyɛmi lɛ.
Adamɔ afii abɔ ni abaanyɛ ahu shikpɔŋ lɛ ni akpa enɔ nibaanii lɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ ashɛ nɔ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ he jara.
Kɛji afii lɛ fa lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ awa; ni kɛji afii lɛ faaa lɛ, no lɛ ejara lɛ aba shi, ejaakɛ afii lɛ amli nibaanii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo lɛ ji nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akashishiu enyɛmi; shi nyɛshea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ mli saji “Nyɛyea mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ ekpakpa, ni nyɛaahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba eniyenii, ni nyɛaaye nyɛtɔrɔ; ni nyɛaahi nɔ shweshweeshwe.
“Eko lɛ nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji wɔduŋ nii, ni wɔkpãŋ ŋmɔshinii wɔtoŋ yɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ mɛni wɔɔye mɔ?’ Naa, mibajɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ niyenii shi kome.
Belɛ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ be mli ni nyɛdu nii lɛ, nyɛbaaye blema niyenii ni nyɛkpa nyɛto lɛ kɛyaashi afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛaakpa enɔ nii ni nyɛdu lɛ.
Nikpɔ̃mɔ lɛ “Akafo shikpɔŋ yibaa ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ owura kosɛɛ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mi minɔ ni; ni nyɛ lɛ miwe kɛ mishĩa mli gbɔi kɛkɛ ji nyɛ.
“Nyɛŋmɛa shikpɔŋ kpɔ̃mɔ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu ni nyɛyaaŋɔ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he.
Kɛji efi onyɛmi Israelnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eehɔ̃ɔ egboshinii ko lɛ, ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ ebakpɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni enyɛmi lɛ hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ bɛ mɔ ko ni aaayakpɔ̃ nii lɛ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ amrɔmrɔ nɔŋŋ, shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ena edɛŋ bɔ ni shɛɔ nii ni ehɔɔ lɛ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ, no lɛ akane afii abɔ ni nii lɛ eye, kɛjɛ be ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa, koni mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ awo afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani wɔsɛɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ eku sɛɛ eŋɔ enii lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ nyɛɛɛ eyakpɔ̃ nii lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ ahi mɔ ni he nii lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ, ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ mli lɛ nihelɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ nii lɛ he, koni nɔtsɛ lɛ aŋɔ enii lɛ ekoŋŋ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko hɔ̃ɔ eshĩa ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he mli lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ kɛyashi enɔ afi naakplɔ ni ekpɔ̃ɔ shĩa lɛ.
Shi kɛji akpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa nɛɛ kɛyashi afi muu ho lɛ, no lɛ shĩa nɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni he shĩa lɛ kɛ eshwiei agboshinii kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Kɛji shɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ tete lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ he ehã mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi tsui ni yɔɔ akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe amli lɛ, abu amɛ tamɔ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Abaanyɛ akpɔ̃ amɛ be fɛɛ be; ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ amɛhe ahã tsutsu nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Shi yɛ Levibii amaji ni ahã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ amli shĩai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Levibii lɛ yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛkpɔ̃ɔ eko fɛɛ eko ni ahɔ̃ɔ be fɛɛ be.
Kɛji Levinyo ko kpɔ̃ɔɔ shĩa ko ni ehɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ aŋmɛɛ shĩa ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ Levibii amaŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ shĩai ni yɔɔ Levibii amaji lɛ amli lɛ, nomɛi ji Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnii ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Shi amɛmaji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akahɔ̃ɔ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni kɛmiiya naanɔ.” Shika ni akɛfaa ohiafoi “Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni enyɛɛɛ ehe ekwɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, omɔ mli ohã lɛ ni okwɛ lɛ; okɛ lɛ ahi shi akɛ gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo.
Kaahe lɛ nɔ ko he kpa, ni kaaŋmɛ nyɔmɔ ko ni ewoɔ bo nɔ; shi oshe oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei; ni oŋmɛ onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ gbɛ koni ehi omasɛi.
Kaahe lɛ oshika ni okɛfa lɛ lɛ he kpa; ni oniyenii ni ohãa lɛ lɛ hu kaaŋmɛ ejara nɔ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Nyɔji aheyeli “Kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ omasɛi ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã bo lɛ, okaye lɛ nyɔŋ, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ apaafonyo loo gbɔ ni ebadɔmɔ bo.
Esɔmɔ bo kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji eshɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi fɛɛ ashi oŋɔɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛwekumɛi ateŋ kɛ eseshibii anɔ mli ekoŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji amɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebɛ akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ nyɔŋ.
Okaye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ; shi oshe oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Kɛji nyɛmiitao wehii kɛ weyei, nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei lɛ, nyɛyahea amɛ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ amli.
Nyɛbaanyɛ hu ni nyɛhe nyɔji kɛjɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ abii ni afɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛgboshinii; ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛshi amɛ nyɛhã nyɛbii akɛ amɛgboshinii.
Amɛ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ, shi nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israel fɔmɔbii lɛ, amɛ lɛ, akaye amɛteŋ mɔ ko nɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
“Kɛji gbɔ ko loo mɔkpɔŋ ko ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ tsɔ̃ niiatsɛ; shi onyɛmi Israelnyo ni yɔɔ emasɛi lɛ ye ohia bɔ ni no hã ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã gbɔ loo mɔkpɔŋ lɛ loo gbɔ lɛ wekunyo ko lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hehɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hegbɛ yɛ lolo akɛ akpɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Esa akɛ enyɛmi nuu ko, loo etsɛkwɛ̃ loo etsɛ loo enyɛ nyɛmibi loo ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ kpaakpa aya ayakpɔ̃ lɛ, loo kɛji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ena nɔ ko lɛ, ekpɔ̃ ehe.
Ekɛ mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa kɛjɛ afi nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehe ehã lɛ lɛ, kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ; ni eyinii lɛ abu yɛ afii lɛ ayikulɛ naa.
Be ni eye yɛ mɔ ni ehe lɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, abu lɛ akɛ apaayeli be.
Kɛji eshwɛ afii pii dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ eyi shika ni ekɛbaakpɔ̃ ehe lɛ ada.
Kɛji eshwɛ afii fioo ko kɛkɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ po, mɔ ni he lɛ kɛ lɛ abu akɔntaa, koni akwɛ afii abɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, kɛna shika fioo ni sa akɛ ewo kɛkpɔ̃ ehe lɛ.
Mɔ ni he lɛ lɛ abu lɛ tamɔ apaafonyo ni miitsu afi nii yɛ ekɛ lɛ shihilɛ mli.
Enuŋtsɔ lɛ akaye enɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ naaa mɔ ko atsɔ̃ gbɛi nɛɛ eko nɔ ni ebakpɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ aŋmɛɛ ehe ni eye ehe, lɛ kɛ ebii ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ mitsuji ni; amɛ ji mitsuji ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Toiboo sɛɛ Jɔɔmɔi Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkafea amãgãi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni nyɛkɛ tɛ akamaa shiu ko, ni nyɛkakpɛa nɔ ko mfoniri yɛ tɛ mli hu nyɛkɛma shi yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkoto shi nyɛja lɛ, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea gbii juji ni mito lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ asɔa he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.
“Kɛji nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbu mikitãi lɛ, ni nyɛye amɛnɔ lɛ, mahã nu anɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ be ni sa mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo ahã nyɛ, ni ŋmɔshi tsei hu baawo yibii.
Nyɛbaakã he nyɛgbee ŋmãa ni nyɛku aahu kɛyaashi wainyibii tsemɔ be mli, ni nyɛbaahiɛ wainyibii tsemɔ nɛkɛ aahu kɛyashi nidumɔ be mli, ni nyɛaaye nyɛboloo nyɛtɔrɔ.
Nyɛaahi nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
“Mahã jeŋ ajɔ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛaakamɔ shi nyɛwɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ nyɛhe gbeyei.
Mahã kooloi fɔ̃ji atã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni awuŋ ta yɛ jɛi.
Nyɛaawo nyɛhenyɛlɔi foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klante naa.
Nyɛteiaŋ gbɔmɛi enumɔ kɛkɛ aaawo henyɛlɔi oha foi, ni nyɛmɛi oha hu aaawo henyɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma foi.
Nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ aaanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhiɛ yɛ klante naa.
Madro nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛwo shwiei ni nyɛyi afa; ni maye mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛhiɛ abele kukudabi ni nyɛto lɛ yeli mli ni abele kpokploku baapue, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaajie kukudabi lɛ kɛje kpo koni ana toohe ahã kpokploku lɛ.
Mahi nyɛteŋ yɛ miBuu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni minyaŋeŋ nyɛ.
Manyiɛ nyɛteŋ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛkahi shi akɛ amɛnyɔji dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Mikumɔ tsei ni akɛwo nyɛ apã lɛ, ni mihã nyɛnyiɛ ni apã kãaa nyɛkuɛ.” Toigbele he toigbalamɔ “Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi nɛɛ anɔ; ni kɛji nyɛkwa mikpɔi lɛ, ni nyɛnyaŋe mimlai lɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mi hu nɔ ni mibafee nyɛ nɛ: Mibahã tsuifãa saji abahɛŋ nyɛ trukaa, ni wɔlɔmɔ kɛ atridii ni hãa hiŋmɛi fiteɔ, ni etãa gbɔmɔtso loo baaye nyɛ.
Nyɛbaagbo deŋme yaka nyɛdu nii ejaakɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi moŋ baaba abaye.
Majie mihiɛ maka nyɛ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi baaye nyɛnɔ, ni mɛi ni hetsɛ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aaaye nyɛnɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ, ni nyɛbaawo foi be mli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ.
“Ni kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbooo mi toi lolo lɛ, no lɛ mibagbala nyɛtoi ekoŋŋ shii kpawo yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni maku nyɛhe ni nyɛwoɔ kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ lɛ naa, ni mahã ŋwɛi agbi tamɔ dade, ni nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ aaagbi tamɔ akɔɔble, ni nyɛaagbo yaka deŋme ejaakɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ niyenii, ni enɔ tsei lɛ hu woŋ yibii.
“Kɛji nyɛfeee nɔ ni mi mitaoɔ, ni nyɛtee nɔ nyɛbooo mi toi lɛ, mayanɔ magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa.
Maŋmɛɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ahe mawo nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbii, ni amɛbaakpãtã nyɛshĩa kooloi ahiɛ, ni amɛbaahã nyɛ nɔ agbɔ, bɔ ni nane baaje nyɛgbɛjegbɛi anɔ.
“Kɛji yɛ nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ nɛɛ hu fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsakeee, shi nyɛtee nɔ nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ, no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ, ni magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Mahã ta abanina nyɛ koni atsɔ̃ no nɔ kɛgbala nyɛtoi, kɛtɔ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mlikuu he owele.
Kɛji nyɛbua nyɛhe naa yɛ nyɛmaji wuji amli, yɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ hewɔ hu lɛ, mibahã gbele hela abote nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anine aaashɛ nyɛnɔ.
Mafo nyɛŋmãa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ sɛɛ lɛ; ni no baahã yei nyɔŋma ashã aboloo fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shãa lɛ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kome pɛ mli.
Aboloo lɛ hu abaaŋmɛ kɛ nsɛni ahã nyɛ nyɛye; ni nyɛaaye nɛ shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ.
“Ni kɛji yɛ enɛ fɛɛ hu sɛɛ lɛ nyɛbooo mi toi, shi nyɛfee nɔ ni mitaooo lɛ, no lɛ mi hu mate shi mawo nyɛ kɛ mlila, ni magbala nyɛtoi shii kpawo fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
“Hɔmɔ naa lɛ nyɛbaagbe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei, nyɛye.
Mibafite hei ni nyɛjaa yɛ, yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ ohɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ; ni mibashɛrɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ mashwie nyɛmãgãi ni akumɔ ashwie shi lɛ anɔ.
Mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei lɛ hu; ni mihereŋ nyɛtsofakɛŋma lɛ ŋma dɔŋŋ.
Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaabahi nɔ lɛ tete ahiɛ aaafee amɛ yaa.
Ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mahã ta abanina nyɛ, ni magbɛ nyɛ mashwã majimaji ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ anɔ.
Gbɔmɛi baatã yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i.
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miijɔɔ ehe ekɛtse ehejɔɔmɔ be ni nyɛshã nyɛshwie lɛ.
Belɛ ja nakai dani shikpɔŋ lɛ baana hegbɛ eye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ lɛ, belɛ ehejɔɔmɔ ni nyɛhã ŋmɛɛ lɛ be ni nyɛyɔɔ enɔ lɛ, no eyeɔ lɛ.
“Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ gbeyeilɔi feetɔi, mɛi ni baa ni etse kɛyaagbee shi gbɛɛmɔ kɛkɛ po baawo amɛ foi, ni amɛbaajo foi tamɔ ajoɔ klante naa foi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, mɔ ko kã mɔ ko nɔ tamɔ mɛi ni miijo klante naa foi gbeɔ shi, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko woko amɛ foi; ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ.
Nyɛaagboi yɛ maŋsɛɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni eeefee tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ emimii nyɛ.
Ni nyɛteŋ mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ, mligbigblimɔ sɔŋŋ baagbegbee nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu nyɛaagbigbli nyɛmli tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyaashi nyɛaagboi tamɔ amɛ.
“Shi kɛji amɛjaje amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfee amɛshi mi, kɛ bɔ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni mi mitaoɔ, ni no hewɔ hu mi hu mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mihã amɛyaje amɛhenyɛlɔi shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛtsui ni ekpiliŋ lɛ he jɔ, ni amɛba amɛhe shi, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibakai mi kɛ Yakob teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ mi kɛ Isak teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, kɛ mi kɛ Abraham teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu, ni mibakai amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ.
Shi ja amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi efolo ni ahuuu nɔ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ ana aye ehejɔɔmɔ be lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ja agbala amɛtoi kɛwo amɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe mikpɔi lɛ.
Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be mli ni amɛyɔɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ, ni minyaŋeŋ amɛ bɔ ni no baahã makpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi amɛhewɔ lɛ, mibakai mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni mijie yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, koni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.” Akpɔi kɛ kitãi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni ekã lɛ, Yehowa, kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ji enɛɛmɛi.
Nibii ni akɛkeɔ Yehowa ahe mlai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko je gbɛ, ni ewo shi krɛdɛɛ, ni ejɔɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi anɔ ekɛke Yehowa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ, jara ni abaawo yɛ amɛyi kɛkpɔ̃ amɛ nɛ: Nuu ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ, eyi jara afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Kɛji yoo ni lɛ, no lɛ eyi jara lɛ afee jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii enumɔ aahu kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.
Shi yɛ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔɔŋ kome aahu kɛyashi afii enumɔ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, awo nuu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ, kɛ yoo hu yi jara jwiɛtɛi shekeli etɛ̃.
Ni mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛyaa lɛ, nuu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ, yoo hu yi jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma.
“Kɛji mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ohiafo ni, ni enyɛɛɛ jara ni afo lɛ ewo lɛ, no lɛ ekpala gbɔmɔ ni ejɔɔ enɔ eke Yehowa lɛ kɛya osɔfo lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ awo egbɔmɔ lɛ yi jara.
Osɔfo lɛ adamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni wo shi lɛ aaana ahã nɔ kɛwo jara lɛ.
“Shi kɛji shĩa kooloo ji nɔ ni awo ehe shi ajɔɔ enɔ akɛhã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ, etsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mɔ ni wo shi lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ kooloo kroko toɔ najiaŋ aloo etsakeɔ; ekɛ kooloo kpakpa akato kooloo gbonyo najiaŋ lɛ, ekɛ kooloo gbonyo akatsake ekpakpa.
Kɛji ekɛ kooloo tee emomo lɛ tsakemɔ lɛ, no lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo momo lɛ kɛ kooloo hee ni ekɛba tsakemɔ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nii.
Shi kɛji kooloo lɛ yafee kooloo ni he tseee, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɛshãaa afɔle ahãaa Yehowa lɛ eko ni lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ aya osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akwɛ kpa ni yɔɔ kooloo lɛ he kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ koni ewo eyi jara.
Jara ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ, aŋɔ nɔ nakai.
Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ kooloo lɛ jara lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie kooloo lɛ yi jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ eshĩa nɔ eke Yehowa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akwɛ nibii ni hi kɛ nibii ni ehiii fɛɛ yɛ shĩa lɛ he koni ewo ejara; ni jara ni osɔfo lɛ baawo lɛ aŋɔ nɔ nakai.
Ni kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshĩa nɔ eke lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ eshĩa lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ shĩa lɛ jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo shĩa lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni shĩa lɛ baatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii nɔ ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akwɛ dumɔ wui ni shikpɔŋ lɛ yeɔ falɛ kɛwo shikpɔŋ lɛ jara.
Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara lɛ ji akoko kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛhe jwiɛtɛi shekel nyɔŋma.
Kɛji Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afiyeli lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ adamɔ jara bɔ ni awo lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛji afiyeli lɛ sɛɛ dani ejɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu afii abɔ ni eshwɛ dani eshɛɔ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi ekoŋŋ yɛ shika mli koni akɛtse jara ni awo lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ni jɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eke lɛ sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo nyɔmɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ.
Shi kɛji esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, aloo ehɔ̃ɔ ehã mɔ kroko ko lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ kpɔ̃mɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛji eshɛ Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ, ni aŋmɛɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he tete lɛ, ebaahi shi akɛ Yehowa nɔ, nɔ ko ni ajɔɔ nɔ owura kosɛɛ ake Yehowa; ebaatsɔ̃ osɔfo lɛ nɔ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko jɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni jeee gbo agbo ashi ahã lɛ, shi etse shika ekɛhe, nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ osɔfo lɛ abu shikpɔŋ lɛ jara lɛ naa kɛyashi Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ ehã mɔ lɛ, ni mɔ lɛ awo shika nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ akɛ shika lɛ ahã Yehowa akɛ enii yinii.
Ni Nikpɔ̃mɔ Afi lɛ nɔ lɛ akpale shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã mɔ dɛŋ ni ahe yɛ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji egboshinii.
“Tɛ nɔ ni adamɔ kɛwo jara fɛɛ jara afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ jwiɛtɛi tɛ lɛ naa; no ji akɛ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ afee shekel kome.
“Shi kooloi fɛɛ akromɔbii ni ji Yehowa nii momo lɛ, mɔ ko akajɔɔ eko nɔ ekɛmiike Yehowa: tsina ni jio, too ni jio, Yehowa nɔ ni momo.
Shi kɛji kooloi ni ahe tseee lɛ eko kromɔbi ni lɛ, no lɛ akpɔ̃ lɛ yɛ jara tɛ ni afo lɛ naa; ni akɛ eyi jara ni awo lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome ashwie jara ni awo lɛ nɔ kɛwo eyi nyɔmɔ.
Shi kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ kpɔ̃ɔɔ ekooloo lɛ, no lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ jara ni awo lɛ kɛkɛ naa.
“Shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ko yɔɔ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, shikpɔŋ ni agbo ashi ahã lɛ ni jio, ni ejɔɔ nɔ tswaa ekɛke Yehowa lɛ, akahɔ̃ɔ, ni akakpɔ̃ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ lɛ eji Yehowa nii kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa tete ni akɛ lɛ eke koni akpãtã ehiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, akakpɔ̃ lɛ; ana agbe lɛ kɛ̃.
“Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmãa ni jio, aduawai ni jio, amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni; nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Kɛji mɔ ko sumɔ akɛ ekpɔ̃ egbɛfaŋ nibii lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome agbe yi kɛwo nyɔmɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ji tsinai kɛ toi: no ji kooloi fɛɛ ni akpalaa amɛ lɛ amɛyikulɛ nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ eji Yehowa nɔ.
Akakpa mli akwɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ehi aloo ehiii; ni akatsake hu.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaatsake eko kɛ̃ lɛ, no lɛ no kɛ lɛ kooloo hee ni akɛbaatsake emomo lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baatsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; akakpɔ̃ kooloo lɛ.” Enɛɛmɛi ji kitãi ni Yehowa fã Mose yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Israelbii lɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Israelbii Agbɛfaa wolo lɛ gbaa saji ni ba amɛshihilɛ mli yɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ mli; kɛjɛ be ni Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he aahu kɛyashi amɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa.
