Israelbii lɛ anyiɛmɔ nɛɛ mli sane wulu ko ni ba lɛ ji kanemɔ ni Mose kane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he dani amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ aaafee yinɔ kome sɛɛ lɛ, akane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ ekoŋŋ.
No mli lɛ amɛyashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ maŋbii akanemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi maŋbii akanemɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yahi Kadesh Barnea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ amɛnyɛɛɛ jɛigbɛ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni awo amɛ ehe shi lɛ nɔ.
Amɛye afii babaoo yɛ Kadesh Barnea kpokpai anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã kɛtee Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii akutsei lɛ ekomɛi wa nɛkɛ Yordan Faa shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kwraa.
Shi akutsei krokomɛi lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii Agbɛfaa Wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ahe sane; gbɔmɛi ni kɛji amɛkɛ haomɔ kpe pɛ kɛkɛ lɛ gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛnijiaŋ eje wui nɔŋŋ.
Amɛtse Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose, ni ji gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ efã koni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ hiɛ atua.
Wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ye eshiwoo nɔ ehã, ni etee nɔ ekura ewebii lɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛ lɛ amɛgbede ni amɛgbo enɔ toi.
Egbaa wɔ bɔ ni Mose bo Nyɔŋmɔ toi kɛwula shi, kɛ bɔ ni esɔmɔ ejakumɛiabii lɛ ehã.
Mlijaramɔi Bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ saa amɛhe dani amɛfã yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he .—.
a. Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋbii Akanemɔ lɛ .—.
b. Mlai srɔtoi ni awowoi .—.
d. Hehoo Gbijurɔyeli ni ji Enyɔ lɛ .- Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he kɛtee Moab lɛ .—.
Saji ni ba yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ .—.
Gbɛfãa kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛtee Moab lɛ .- Yordan Faa lɛ foo he Akpɔi .—.
Israelbii ayikulɛ kanemɔ, klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkanea Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Aŋmala hii fɛɛ agbɛii kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa.
Bo kɛ Aaron akane mɛi lɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa.
Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli nuu kome ni ji onukpa yɛ etsɛmɛi awe afata nyɛhe.” Hii, akutseiaŋ onukpai, ni ahala akɛfata Mose kɛ Aaron he koni amɛtsu nii lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ fã Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ; ni Simeon akutso lɛ fã Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; ni Yuda akutso lɛ fã Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Isakar akutso lɛ fã Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ, ni Zebulon akutso lɛ fã Eliab, Helon bi lɛ; ni Efraim akutso lɛ, ni ji Yosef shwiei lɛ, fã Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ; ni Manase akutso, ni ji Yosef nɔŋŋ shwiei hu, fã Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ.
Benyamin akutso lɛ fã Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ; ni Dan akutso lɛ fã Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ; ni Asher akutso lɛ fã Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; Gad akutso lɛ fã Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ; ni Naftali akutso lɛ fã Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii, ni asaŋ amɛ ji amɛtsɛmɛi akutsei lɛ amli onukpai, ni ahala amɛ, ni afee amɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔ hii ni atsi amɛgbɛii atã nɛɛ amɛfata amɛhe, ni amɛbua Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋmala maŋbii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii ni akane amɛyibɔ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ, nakai efee, ni ekɛkane Israel asafo lɛ yikulɛ yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Akɛjɛ Ruben ni ji Israel kromɔbi lɛ bihii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔ, ni aŋmala hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni asaŋ amɛshɛ tayaa lɛ agbɛii ekomekome yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Rubenbii ayikulɛ ni ana ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Simeon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Ni Gad shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Yuda shwiei lɛ kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Ni Isakar shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Ni Zebulon shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Efraim shwiei lɛ, ni jɛ Yosef mli lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Manase shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Ni Benyamin shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Dan shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Ni Asher shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ni Naftali shwiei lɛ, kɛjɛ mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa nɔ kɛyashi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa, ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Israel maŋ onukpai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa ni wa Mose kɛ Aaron kɛkane amɛyikulɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ni akane amɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa akɛ mɛi ni eshɛ tayaa lɛ, amɛyikulɛ fee mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi Levibii lɛ akaneee amɛ ashiii akutsei krokomɛi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛji okane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ, okakane Levibii lɛ oshi nɔ.
Moŋ akɛ miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fata he lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ awo amɛdɛŋ.
Amɛ amɛtere Buu lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛkura Buu lɛ.
Ni kɛji ato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, amɛmãmɔ amɛwɔɔhei amɛkɛbɔle Buu lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.
Kɛji maŋ lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ afã Buu lɛ, ni kɛji shɛ be ni abaashi Buu lɛ, Levibii lɛ nɔŋŋ ashi.
Mɔ folo fɛɛ mɔ folo ni aaabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ agbe lɛ.
Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii fɛɛ ashi amɛbuui yɛ amɛsafo kuikui lɛ anaa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ buu ahi esafo shitoohe mli, ni asaŋ yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa shishi.
Shi Levibii lɛ ashishii amɛbui lɛ kɛbɔle miKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; amɛbu he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ folo ko akabɛŋkɛ Buu lɛ ni no yatsɛ mimlifu bahã Israelbii lɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee lɛ.
Bɔ ni akutsei lɛ jwereɔ shi yɛ shitoohe lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe ko lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi ebuu yɛ esafo shitoohe, yɛ etsɛmɛi awe aflaŋaa lɛ shishi.
Amãmɔ bui fɛɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe.
“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi baashi amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa; ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Ta ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Yudabii lɛ anɔ ji Isakarbii lɛ, ni amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ etsa Isakarbii lɛ hu anɔ, kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.
Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Amɛ esa akɛ amɛnyiɛ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ lɛ.
“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa.
Rubenbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ, ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Mɛi ni ashitoohe baatsa Rubenbii lɛ anɔ ji Simeon akutso lɛ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Gad akutso lɛ atsa Simeonbii lɛ hu anɔ.
Gadbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Reuel bi lɛ, ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Ruben aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Amɛ amɛ ji asafo ni ji enyɔ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.
“Kɛkɛ lɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Kpee Buu lɛ hu baafã kɛnyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee asafoi wuji enyɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Bɔ ni ato naa abato shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaato naa kɛfã nyiɛmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anyiɛ egbɛhe yɛ aflaŋaa shishi.
“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ anaigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa.
Efraimbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Manasebii lɛ atsa Efraim akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ hu atsa Manase akutso lɛ nɔ.
Benyaminbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Abidan, Gideoni bi lɛ, ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Efraim aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ oha.
Amɛ, amɛ ji asafo ni ji etɛ̃ ni baafã kɛji afã nyiɛmɔ.
“Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi lɛ baashi amɛbuui yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ kooyigbɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa.
Danbii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Asherbii lɛ atsa Dan akutso lɛ nɔ kɛ amɛsafoiatsɛ nukpa Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; ni eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Naftali akutso lɛ hu atsa Asherbii lɛ anɔ.
Naftalibii lɛ asafoiatsɛ nukpa ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Eta lɛ yikulɛ be ni akane mɛi lɛ ji mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Dan aflaŋaa lɛ shishi asafo lɛ fɛɛ yikulɛ yɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa ji mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai ekpaa.” Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni akane yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ anaa yɛ amɛshitoohei lɛ amli naa shiɔ mɛi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi akaneee Levibii lɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
Kɛji ashɛ shitoohe lɛ, amɛtoɔ shi yɛ amɛflaŋaai lɛ ashishi; ni kɛji amɛfã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ tsɛmɛiawei lɛ anaa.
Aaron musuŋbii lɛ Be mli ni Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bii ni Aaron kɛ Mose yɔɔ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Aaron bihii lɛ ji Nadab, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Aaron fɔ ebihii nɛɛ mu, ni ewo amɛ osɔfo koni amɛtsu osɔfoyeli nitsumɔ.
Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛhiɛ la ko ni he tseee kɛtee Yehowa hiɛ be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛshiii bii.
Eleazar kɛ Itamar pɛ sɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛtsɛ Aaron walabeiaŋ.
Ato Levibii lɛ akɛ osɔfoi lɛ awalɔi Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ Levi akutso lɛ kɛba ni owo amɛ yelikɛbualɔi, mɛi ni baawa Osɔfo Aaron yɛ esɔfoyeli nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛbaatsu nii amɛhã Osɔfo Aaron kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Amɛbaakwɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli saamɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛbaawa maŋbii foji lɛ kɛji amɛba koni amɛbaja yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
Ojɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.
Oŋɔ amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ kwraa ohã koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii osɔfoi lɛ.
Ojɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ ohã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ pɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ efee ehe osɔfo lɛ agbe lɛ.” Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, miŋɔ Levibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ mikɛmiito kromɔbii ni gbeleɔ musu naa yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ anajiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ etsɔ̃ minɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbi ni migbe Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kromɔbii fɛɛ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii akromɔbii fɛɛ anɔ mihã mihe, kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ kromɔbi nɔ kɛyashi shĩa kooloo kromɔbi nɔ.
Minii ji amɛ fɛɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa.” Levibii lɛ akanemɔ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai shiaŋa lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kanemɔ Levi we lɛ hii fɛɛ kɛjɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ kɛ amɛwekui anaa.” Mose kane amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni amɛgbɛii ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Gershon bihii lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui anaa ji Libni kɛ Shimei.
Kohat yɛ bihii ejwɛ; amɛgbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel, ni Merari bihii enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa ji Maheli kɛ Mushi.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii lɛ awekui lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Gershon shwiei lɛ ji Libnibii lɛ kɛ Shimeibii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Gershonbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ, akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ ni ji anaigbɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli wekunukpa lɛ ji Eliasaf, Lael bi lɛ.
Amɛ amɛdɛŋ atu nibii nɛɛ anɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kuramɔ awo: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛ buu lɛ yiteŋ nɔhaanɔ lɛ, kɛ eshinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ, kɛ kpo ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ he mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai lɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mama lɛ hu.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Kohat shwiei lɛ ji Amrambii lɛ kɛ Izeharbii lɛ kɛ Hebronbii lɛ kɛ Uzielbii lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Kohatbii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ ana mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Kohatbii awekui nɛɛ lɛ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ lɛ hã amɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpa lɛ ji Elizafan, Uziel bi lɛ.
Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ kanetso lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ muhɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Levibii lɛ anukpa fe fɛɛ ji Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron bi lɛ; ni lɛ ekwɛɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.
Merari shwiei lɛ ji Mahelibii lɛ kɛ Mushibii lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Meraribii lɛ.
Be ni akane amɛhii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ, ana mɛi akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Meraribii nɛɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ awekunukpa lɛ ji Zuriel, Abihail bi lɛ.
Ahã Meraribii nɛɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ koŋ nɔ kɛyaa kooyigbɛ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe koni amɛmãmɔ amɛbui lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nibii ni atu awo amɛdɛŋ ni amɛkwɛ nɔ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nibii ni ji mplaŋi lɛ kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛ amɛhe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ hã koni amɛkwɛ nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni baamãmɔ amɛbui yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni amɛkɛ jɛi afee amɛshihilɛhe ji Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.
He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ kusumi fɛɛ ni sa akɛ atsu ahã Israel maŋbii lɛ, amɛ esa akɛ amɛtsu.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛ ehe aaawo amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe lɛ.
Levibii hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayikulɛ shɛɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Levibii lɛ ye kromɔ bihii anajiaŋ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ŋmaa Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ; kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye nyɔŋ kome nɔ kɛyaa, agbɛii koni okane amɛyikulɛ, ni otse Levibii lɛ ohã mi, Yehowa, koni okɛ amɛ ato Israelbii kromɔ bihii lɛ fɛɛ anajiaŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ oŋɔ̃ Levibii ashĩa kooloi ohã mi koni okɛto Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔ bihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ.” Mose kane Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kromɔ bihii ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa agbɛii ni aŋma lɛ ayikulɛ fee mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii akromɔbihii fɛɛ anajiaŋ, ni ojɔɔ Levibii ashĩa kooloi anɔ ohã mi yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ashĩa kooloi akromɔbihii anajiaŋ.
Levibii lɛ minii ji amɛ.
Mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Israelbii akromɔbihii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ etɛ̃ ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpɔ̃ amɛ.
Hemɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ mɔ kome yi, shekel kome feɔ garai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Ni shika ni akɛbaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ nɔ nɛɛ lɛ okɛhã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose he shika ni awo akɛkpɔ̃ mɛi ni edɛŋ Levibii lɛ anɔ lɛ, yɛ Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Ena jwiɛtɛi shekeli akpe kome kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ; ni Mose kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ lɛ shika lɛ hã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ.
Kohatbii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kanemɔ Kohatbii ni yɔɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ.
Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Kohatbii lɛ anitsumɔ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ kɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.
“Kɛji maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ aya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyajie muhɔɔ ni tsiɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛ muhɔɔ nɛɛ aha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he.
No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ abotia hewolo aha muhɔɔ ni akɛha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ nɔ; ni yɛ no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ mama bluu krɔŋŋ alɛɛ Adeka lɛ nɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
“Amɛkɛ mama bluu aha okplɔ̃ ni akɛ Yehowa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛkɛ plɛtei lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛ tsofakɛŋma woɔ mli lɛ, kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ kpuji ni akɛ afɔleshãa dãa woɔ mli lɛ amãmɔ nɔ.
Be fɛɛ be lɛ aboloo amã okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ mli akɛha okplɔ̃ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ abotia hewolo alɛɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ lɛ nɔ; ni no hu sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
“Amɛkɔ mama bluu, ni amɛkɛha kanetso lɛ kɛ ehe kanei lɛ, kɛ lagbeenii lɛ, kɛ tsɛnsii tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akɛ mu ni akɛsuɔ kanei lɛ woɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahe.
No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛfi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛwo abotia wolo mli koni amɛkɛwo tso adeka ni akɛtereɔ lɛ mli.
“Shika afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, amɛlɛɛ mama bluu lɛ mli amɛkɛha nɔ, koni amɛkɛ abotia wolo aha mama bluu lɛ hu nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
Amɛfi tsɛnsii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo mama bluu mli; ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛfi nii lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛwo abotia hewolo mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛma nɔ ni akɛtereɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛloo lamlu fɛɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ mama afaseo aha latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ ashwie latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nibii nɛɛ ji lajee tsɛnsii lɛ, kɛ fakai lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ.
Akɛ abotia hewolo aha nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsei bloblobii ni akɛwoɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ahɔlɔ amɛfɔji lɛ amli.
Kɛji Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ eha Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Buu lɛ mli nibii lɛ hu fɛɛ ahe amɛgbe naa, ni maŋ lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, no mli dani Kohatbii lɛ abahole nibii lɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnine akata nibii lɛ eko he koni amɛkagboi.
Enɛɛmɛi ji Kpee Buu lɛ he nibii ni Kohatbii lɛ baatere lɛ.
“Nibii ni atu awo Osɔfo Eleazar, Aaron bi lɛ, dɛŋ koni ekwɛ nɔ ji mu ni akɛsuɔ kane lɛ, kɛ mu ni akɛfɔɔ mɔ mu lɛ kɛ daa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa Kohatbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ ashishi miibule yɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ, kɛtsɔ̃ gboimɔ ni amɛaagboi kɛji amɛmiibɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ nɔ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã amɛ koni amɛyi ana wala ji akɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ abote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Kohatbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji Kohatbii lɛ bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli ni amɛhiŋmɛi gba nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbaagboi.” Gershonbii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kanemɔ Gershonbii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ.
Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Jatsui ni Gershonbii lɛ atere ji: Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ mama ni haa Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abotia hewolo ni haa Buu lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, kɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa mama lɛ.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtere kpo lɛ ni bɔle Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ fɛɛ kpula lɛ mamai lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ agbo lɛ naa mamai lɛ, kɛ mamai nɛɛ ahe taŋkpei lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ amɛnitsumɔ ni.
Jatsu ni Gershonbii lɛ baatere kɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu lɛ, amɛbaafee yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ afãmɔ naa; ni nyɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui fɛɛ ni amɛbaatere lɛ baawo amɛdɛŋ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Gershonbii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.” Meraribii, Levibii lɛ, agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kanemɔ Meraribii lɛ hu ayikulɛ yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ.
Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Ni jatsui ni amɛbaatere kɛ amɛnitsumɔ fɛɛ ni amɛbaatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ ji Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mplaŋi lɛ, kɛ mlibɛlɛmɔnii lɛ, kɛ ekulashiŋi lɛ, kɛ nibii ni akulashiŋi lɛ mamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ kpo lɛ he akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii ni amɛmamɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɛ taŋkpei lɛ kɛ amɛhe nibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Ni nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ejatsu ni ebaatere lɛ gbɛi.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nitsumɔi ni Meraribii lɛ awekui lɛ baatsu yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he; ni mɔ ni baakwɛ amɛnɔ ji Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar.” Levibii lɛ ayikulɛ kanemɔ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ.
Aŋmã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ gbɛi koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Mɛi ni ana lɛ ayikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ be ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane Kohatbii hii lɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he lɛ.
Gershonbihii ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Gershonbii hii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ ayikulɛ nɛ.
Meraribihii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni akane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, koni amɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ, amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Meraribihii ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane yɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ naa lɛ nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Levibii hii fɛɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kane yɛ amɛwekui kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, kɛjɛ mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ etsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli loo Kpee Buu lɛ he loo jatsu teremɔ lɛ, amɛyikulɛ ji mɛi akpei kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Mose nine nɔ atsɔ̃ akane Levibii nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa, ni Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɔŋŋ adamɔ ni ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ kɛ ejatsu.
Mɛi ni ahe tseee Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛ jie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni miiye kpiti aloo ehe miiho nu aloo eta gbonyo he ekɛbule ehe yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ, nyɛjiea amɛ kɛyaa koni amɛkabule shitoohe lɛ he ni mihiɔ nyɛteŋ yɛ lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ fee nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose lɛ, ni amɛ jie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ato tɔ̃mɔ najiaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nuu ko loo yoo ko booo Yehowa toi, ni efee enaanyo esha, ni ekɛkwa Yehowa ni nakai mɔ lɛ ye fɔ lɛ, no lɛ ejaje esha ni efee lɛ, ni eto mɔ ni efee lɛ esha lɛ najiaŋ; asaŋ ekɛ nii ni ekɛtoɔ mɔ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ mlijaa enumɔ mli ekome afata he ehã mɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ egbo, ni anaaa ewekunyo ko ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ koni akɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ ahã mɔ lɛ lɛ, no lɛ najiaŋtoo nii lɛ atsɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni akɛhã osɔfo lɛ; esoro ojwɛni ni tɔ̃lɔ lɛ baahã koni akɛshã afɔle ekɛdãi efɔŋ ni efee lɛ.
Asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛaabahã akɛ amɛkɛbake Yehowa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, nii ni akɛaabahã lɛ lɛ, enɔ ni.” Kɛji nuu kɛɛ eŋa eje esɛɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nuu ko ŋa je esɛɛ, ni ehã nuu kroko kɛ lɛ bɔ, ni etɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ, shi eshiu ewu lɛ sane nɛɛ nɔ ejaakɛ odasefonyo bɛ he, ni asaŋ amɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ yoo lɛ ena ebule ehe loo kɛji awuŋayeli te shi yɛ nuu ko mli, ni eye eŋa he awuŋã lɛ, yoo lɛ ebule ehe jio, ebuleko ehe jio, nuu lɛ kɛ eŋa lɛ aba osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Nuu lɛ ahiɛ akoko mamu kilo kome hu kɛba.
Ekɛ mu akashwie mamu lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ krɔbɔo hu akafɔ̃ nɔ, ejaakɛ eji awuŋayeli he niyenii afɔle ni akɛmiitao anɔkwale lɛ ale.’ “Osɔfo lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba, ni ehã ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ nu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko awo su kpulu mli, ni ekpiti shikpɔŋ su yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ewo nu lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfo lɛ afɛne yoo lɛ yitsɔi yɛ eyiteŋ beiaŋ ni edamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ mamu, ni ji niyenii afɔle ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ, ahã yoo lɛ ni ehiɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ ahiɛ nu ni joɔ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni ekamɔ kitã eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔko, ni ojeko owu sɛɛ owoko ohe muji lɛ, no lɛ ohe aje loomɔ ni nu ni joɔ nɛɛ gbalaa kɛbaa lɛ mli; shi kɛji oje owu lɛ sɛɛ, ni nuu kroko kɛ bo ebɔ, ni owo ohe muji lɛ, (Osɔfo lɛ alomɔ yoo lɛ agbɛnɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ) no lɛ Yehowa ahã otsɔ̃ musumɔ ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛlomɔɔ, aloo akɛkãa kitã yɛ omaŋbii ateŋ.
Yehowa ahã oyoohe abɛ, ni omusu afuu.
Kɛji nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ bote omli lɛ, ehã omusu afũu, ni oyoohe abɛ.’ ” Yoo lɛ ahere osɔfo lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Amen.
Amen!” Osɔfo lɛ aŋmã loomɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɔ ko nɔ; no sɛɛ lɛ, efɔ niŋmaa lɛ ewo nu ni joɔ lɛ mli, ni ehã yoo lɛ anu nu ni joɔ ni gbalaa loomɔ kɛbaa lɛ, koni kɛji nu lɛ bote yoo lɛ mli lɛ epiŋ lɛ waa.
Dani yoo lɛ baanu nu lɛ, osɔfo lɛ ahe mamu ni ji niyenii afɔle lɛ ni akɛjieɔ mɔ shi lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ewo afɔle lɛ nɔ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Osɔfo lɛ akpiti niyenii afɔle lɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome, akɛ nɔ ni ekɛmiiye he odase, koni eshã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ ehã yoo lɛ anu nu lɛ.
Kɛji yoo lɛ eje ewu lɛ sɛɛ ekɛwo ehe muji lɛ, kɛji enu nu ni joɔ lɛ ni ebote emli lɛ, nu lɛ baahã epiŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni emusu baafũu, ni eyoohe baabɛ, ni lɛ yoo lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ musumɔ yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ.
Shi kɛji yoo lɛ ejeko ewu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baaje loomɔ lɛ mli, ni ebaawo shwiei.
Enɛ ji mla ni kɔɔ nuu awuŋayeli he lɛ.
Kɛji yoo je ewu sɛɛ ni ewo ehe muji, aloo nuu ye eŋa he awuŋã akɛ eje esɛɛ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aba koni yoo lɛ abadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni osɔfo lɛ atsu yoo lɛ he nii yɛ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ naa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nuu lɛ yeŋ sɔ̃ ko kwraa; shi yoo lɛ kɛji etɔ̃ lɛ no lɛ eyi sɔ̃ lɛ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ.
Nazirnyofeemɔ he mlai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘nuu fɛɛ nuu loo yoo fɛɛ yoo ni eje gbɛ ewo shi akɛ eeefee ehe Nazirnyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekanu wain loo dãa ni wa; ekanu vinega ni akɛ wainyibii loo dãa ni wa fee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ wainyibii fee lɛ ekanu; ni wainyibii ŋmɔŋ jio, nɔ ni aka lɛ egbiŋ jio, ekaye.
Bei abɔ fɛɛ ni etsɛɔ ehe Nazirnyo lɛ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ wain tso he nɔ ko fee.
Eyibii lɛ mli wui tete loo ehetoto po ekaye eko.’ “Kɛyaashi eeeye ebe ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa etã lɛ, ekaku eyi, ni yishɛɛ kakla naa akasa eyiteŋ.
Shiwoo lɛ fĩɔ lɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ kwraa ehã Yehowa lɛ.
Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ; ni eŋmɛ eyi kusuu.
Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ, ekaya gbonyo ko masɛi Kɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ loo enyɛmi nuu loo enyɛmi yoo tete gbo lɛ, ekaya gbonyo lɛ masɛi ni ekɛbule ehe, yɛ ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ ehã Yehowa lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni Nazirnyo ji lɛ lɛ, mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ hã Yehowa.
“Kɛji mɔ ko tswa shi egbo trukaa yɛ emasɛi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebule eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ, eshɛ eyi lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛtsuu ehe.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ehiɛ kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo okpoi bibii enyɔ ekɛbahã osɔfo lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ okpoi lɛ ekome koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ ekome lɛ hu ashã shãa afɔle koni ekɛkpãtã ehã lɛ; ejaakɛ gbonyo lɛ ewo ehe muji.
Nakai gbi lɛ, mɔ lɛ aku sɛɛ ejɔɔ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ehã Yehowa.
Esaa ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa ekoŋŋ ejaakɛ be ni ewo shi tsuutsu lɛ eho.
Ekɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi aba ekɛbashã fɔyeli he afɔle, ejaakɛ ebule ehe nɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhã be ni eye momo lɛ efee yaka.
“Kɛji Nazirnyo eye be ni ewo shi akɛ ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa egbe naa lɛ, nɔ ni afee nɛ: akɛ lɛ aba Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Ehiɛ edɛŋ toi etɛ̃ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ni akɛshã afɔle akɛhã Yehowa nɛkɛ: ekɛ gwantɛŋ binuu ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle, ni ekɛ gwantɛŋ yoo kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã esha he afɔle, ni ekɛ too ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shidaa afɔle.
Ehiɛ nibii nɛɛ hu efata kooloi lɛ ahe: aboloo ni akɛŋmãa mã akpiti ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛntɛŋ kome, kɛ akpãanɔɔ ni akɛ mamu muɛmuɛ fɛɛfɛo ni awo mli fɔ shã kɛ mã akpiti aboloo kekeree ni akpa hiɛ fɔ.
Ekɛ abele kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu ashi nɔ.
“Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ koni ekɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ shãa afɔle lɛ ehã Nazirnyo lɛ.
Ekɛ too ojwɛni lɛ afata mã akpiti aboloo kɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ he koni ekɛshã shidaa afɔle ekɛhã Yehowa.
Osɔfo lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ he niyenii kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ hu afata he.
Nazirnyo lɛ ashɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi ni eto kɛjɛ be ni ejɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, koni eloo eyitsɔi lɛ ewo la ni yɔɔ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ shishi lɛ mli.
“Kɛji loo lɛ be lɛ, osɔfo lɛ akɔ ojwɛni lɛ nine kome, ni ekɛfata kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli mã akpiti aboloo lɛ akwaabɔ kome kɛ akpiti akpãanɔɔ hu kome he koni ekɛwo Nazirnyo lɛ dɛŋ be ni eshɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ sɛɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ ahe afɔle lɛ ni efɔ̃ kɛya kɛba yɛ Yehowa hiɛ akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Nii nɛɛ ji nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhãa osɔfo lɛ kɛfataa too lɛ tsitsinaa lɛ kɛ eshuɔ lɛ he.
Agbɛnɛ Nazirnyo lɛ baanyɛ enu wain kɛjɛ enɛ sɛɛ.
“Mla kɛ kusum ni yɔɔ afɔle ni esa akɛ Nazirnyo, mɔ ni ewo shi kɛjɔɔ ehe nɔ ehã Yehowa, nɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ lɛ ewo shi fe tɛ ni afo afɔ̃ shi ahã Nazirnyo lɛ, no lɛ eye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ, ehã bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Osɔfoi adɛŋ Jɔɔmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ kɛji amɛmiijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, ni eto bo!
Yehowa atse ehiɛ ehã bo, ni eduro bo.
Yehowa ana bo mɔbɔ, ni ehã bo hejɔlɛ!’ “Kɛji amɛtsɛ migbɛi nɛkɛ amɛkɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ, mibajɔɔ maŋbii lɛ.”
Afɔlei ni maŋ onukpai lɛ ashã Gbi ni Mose gbe Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ efɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ fɛɛ mu ekɛtsuu amɛhe, ni asaŋ efɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii lɛ hu mu nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛfee fɛɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Maŋbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ni ji Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ anɔ onukpai, ni ji akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi, mɛi nɔŋŋ hu ni kwɛ maŋbii lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, hiɛ amɛdɛŋ nikeenii kɛba amɛkɛbahã Yehowa.
Nibii nɛɛ ji shwiilii ekpaa ni awo amɛ nibii obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; shwiilii lɛ, onukpai enyɔ anɔ ekome, ni tsinai lɛ mɔ kome nɔ ekome.
Amɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Hemɔ nibii ni amɛkɛba lɛ koni akɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii.
Ojara ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ naa.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ shwiilii kɛ nibii lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ hã Levibii lɛ.
Ehã Gershonbii lɛ shwiilii enyɔ kɛ tsinai hu ejwɛ, ni ehã Meraribii lɛ shwiilii ejwɛ kɛ tsinai hu kpaanyɔ.
Ekɛ nibii lɛ wo Osɔfo Aaron bi Itamar dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kui nɛɛ anɔ yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Shi Kohatbii lɛ shwiili jio, tsina jio, Mose hãaa amɛ eko ejaakɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni amɛkwɛɔ nɔ lɛ, kɔ̃ŋ nɔ atereɔ yɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ hiɛ nikeenii hu kɛba gbi ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu lɛ.
Be ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ ba lɛ amɛshã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Onukpai lɛ aba mɔ kome mɔ kome amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii lɛ abahã, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbi ni ato ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ koni akɛjɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛgbele naa.” Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ni kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã ji Nahashon ni eji Aminadab bi, ni lɛ ji Yuda akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ.
Enikeenii lɛ fee jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ koni akɛshã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle, kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle, kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ too ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Netanel ni ji Zuar bi, ni lɛ ji Isakar akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikee nii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle, kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle, kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ, nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Eliab ni eji Helon bi ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Zebulon akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni etsiimɔ ji kilo kome kɛ fã, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Eliab ni ji Helon bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elizur ni eji Shedeur shwie ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Ruben akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Elizur ni ji Shedeur bi lɛ nikee nii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Shelumiel ni eji Zurishadai bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Simeon akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ baha.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ; jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Shelumiel ni ji Zurishadai shwie lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Eliasaf ni eji Deuel shwie, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Gad akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikee nii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma, kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ too ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Eliasaf ni ji Deuel bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elishama ni eji Amihud bi ni lɛ ji Efraim akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ baashã shãa afɔle, kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Elishama ni ji Amihud bi lɛ nikee nii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gamaliel ni eji Pedazur bi ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Manase akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nsɛni tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle, kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bii enumɔ, ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Gamaliel ni ji Pedazur bi lɛ nikee nii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Abidan ni eji Gideoni bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Benyamin akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Abidan ni ji Gideoni bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahiezer ni eji Amishadai bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Dan akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛ lɛ baashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Ahiezer ni ji Amishadai bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ, Pagiel ni eji Okran bi, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji Asher akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛ amɛ baashã shãa afɔle kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Pagiel ni ji Okran bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ nɛ.
Gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahira ni eji Enan bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Naftali akutso lɛ mli bii anukpa lɛ kɛ enikeenii lɛ bahã.
Nibii ni ekɛba lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛte kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolu hu kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Plɛte lɛ kɛ okpolu lɛ fɛɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli fɔ ni akɛbaashã niyenii afɔle.
Nikeenii lɛ ekomɛi hu ji shika okpolu pɛmpɛoo kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ too gwantɛŋ binuu kome ni eye afi ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle; kɛ too kpakpo kome ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle kɛ kooloi nɛɛ hu ni akɛbaashã shidaa afɔle: tsinai enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enumɔ kɛ too kpakpoi enumɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii enumɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko eye afi.
Ahira, Enan bi lɛ nikeenii lɛ ji enɛ.
Nibii fɛɛ ni Israel akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛbahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgbele afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa gbi nɔ ni afɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mu kɛjɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɛ: jwiɛtɛi plɛtei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ jwiɛtɛi okpolui hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ shika tsɛnsii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Jwiɛtɛi plɛtei lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ okpolu fɛɛ okpolu ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Jwiɛtɛi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ tsiimɔ ji shekeli akpei enyɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ niŋmɛɛ tɛ naa.
Shika okpolui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛmli tsofakɛŋma obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋma, shika ŋmiiŋmi okpolui lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Tsinai ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shãa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Abahã ojwɛnii hu nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ too gwantɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle hu.
Abahã too kpakpoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ hu ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔle.
Kooloi fɛɛ ni akɛbahã koni akɛshã shidaa afɔle lɛ ayibɔ ji tsinai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ojwɛnii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ too kpakpoi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii ni eye afi nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Nibii nɛɛ akɛbahã koni akɛshã afɔle kɛgbele afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa be ni afɔ latɛ lɛ mu kɛtsuu he sɛɛ lɛ.
Be ni Mose bote Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni ekɛ Yehowa ayawie lɛ, enu Yehowa gbee ni ekɛ lɛ, Mose lɛ, miiwie kɛjɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ naanɔ lɛ nɔ gbɛ yɛ kerubim enyɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Akɛ kanetsei lɛ mamɔ̃ shi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Aaron akɛ kɛji ekɛ kanei lɛ miimamɔ kanetsei kpawo lɛ anɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ amãmɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.” Aaron fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ, ni ekɛ kanei lɛ mamɔ shi bɔ ni amɛbaakpɛ kɛya kanetso lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Bɔ ni kanetso lɛ yɔɔ ji akɛ atswia lɛ shika sɔŋŋ nii kɛjɛ eshitamɔnɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛmɔ ehe fɔfɔii lɛ aahu kɛyagbe naa emuu.
Bɔ ni nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Mose lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ afee kanetso lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Halamɔ Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ koni otsuu amɛhe.
Ni bɔ ni ofee amɛ ni otsuu amɛhe nɛ.
Okɛ nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ ashwã amɛnɔ; amɛshɛ amɛhe tsɔi fɛɛ kɛ kakla, ni amɛfɔ amɛtadei ahe koni amɛhe atse.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ohã amɛŋɔ tsina oblanyo, ni akɛ niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni awo mli mu afata he; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oŋɔ̃ tsina oblanyo kroko ni okɛshã esha he afɔle.
Ohã Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ababɔ gwa; ni ohã Levibii lɛ adamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ.
Israelbii asafo lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie Levibii lɛ ayitsei anɔ be mli ni ohã Levibii lɛ ebadamɔ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Aaron ajɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ahã mi, Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni jɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ mi.
Levibii lɛ kɛ amɛniji ashwie tsinahii lɛ ayiteŋ; ni okɛ ekome ashã esha he afɔle, ni okɛ ekome hu ashã shãa afɔle okɛhã Yehowa koni okɛkpãtã ohã Levibii lɛ.
“Jɔɔmɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ ohã mi koni amɛwa Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ, koni ojie Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ oto afã akɛ minɔ.
Otsuu amɛhe koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛba Kpee Buu lɛ mli amɛbasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi.
Ejaakɛ miiŋɔ amɛ kwraa yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ miihã mihe; mikɛ amɛ eto nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbeleɔ musu naa ni ji Israelbii akromɔbii lɛ anajiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni mitswia kromɔbii fɛɛ anii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mijɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi kɛ shĩa kooloo kromɔbi fɛɛ kromɔbi hu nɔ mihã mihe, ni mifee lɛ minɔ.
Levibii lɛ mikɛto Israelbii lɛ akromɔbii fɛɛ anajiaŋ ni mikɛ Levibii lɛ miihã Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ kwraa akɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ nikeenii koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli yɛ Israelbii lɛ anajiaŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkpãtã efɔŋ ni baaba maŋbii anɔ kɛji amɛbɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ jɔɔ Levibii lɛ anɔ amɛhã.
Bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai Israelbii lɛ fee Levibii lɛ.
Levibii lɛ tsu kusum kɛfɔ amɛhe eshai; amɛfɔfɔɔ amɛtadei ahe, ni Aaron jɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã akɛ keenii krɛdɛɛ hã Yehowa.
Asaŋ etsuu amɛhe hu.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Levibii lɛ tee Buu lɛ mli, ni amɛyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Aaron kɛ ebihii lɛ ashishi.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee yɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nakai efee amɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Levibii lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔtoo nɛ: Mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛyaa lɛ, amɛtsu nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni mɛi ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔ lɛ ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe.
Be nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyɛ amɛwa amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli; shi moŋ nitsumɔ ko akakã amɛnɔ.
Gbɛjianɔ ni oto ohã Levibii lɛ yɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛ.”
Hehoo gbijurɔyeli ni ji enyɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Mose wie yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni Israelbii lɛ aye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, nyɛyea gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ ebe ni ato lɛ mli; nyɛyea lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ koni amɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ; ni amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi, yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee.
Shi hii komɛi yata gbonyo he, ni amɛbule amɛhe; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ amɛye yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, hii nɛɛ ba Mose kɛ Aaron ŋɔɔ yɛ Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Amɛbakɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔyabule wɔhe kɛ gbonyo ko he ni wɔyata lɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ ni atsiɔ wɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔnikeenii akabahã Yehowa yɛ ebe ni eto lɛ mli tamɔ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ?” Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɛa kɛyashi Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi nɔ ni afee yɛ nyɛhewɔ.” Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko loo nyɛshwiei lɛ eko yata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe, aloo edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko tete lɛ, ebaanyɛ eye Hehoo lɛ ehã Yehowa kɛ̃.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbɛkɛnaashi.
Amɛkɛ mã akpiti kɛ shwie ni joɔ aye; amɛkashwɛ eko ni je tsɛre nɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkajwa kooloo ni agbe akɛye lɛ wui lɛ eko.
Amɛye Hehoo lɛ yɛ ehe akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Shi mɔ ni he tse, ni asaŋ edomko, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekwa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yeli lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ ehiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Yehowa nikeenii lɛ baaa ebahãaa yɛ be ni ato lɛ mli.
Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.’ “Ni kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ko bato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni eesumɔ akɛ eye Yehowa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, eye; shi eye yɛ Hehoo lɛ he akpɔ kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ anaa.
Akpɔ kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, gbɔ jio, mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio.” Atatu ni kpɛɔ kɛ la lɛ Gbi nɔ ni ashi Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amã shi lɛ, atatu lɛ baha nɔ.
Gbɛkɛ lɛ kɛ aakwɛ lɛ atatu lɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashiɔ leebi.
Ni nakai eyɔɔ daa; atatu lɛ haa Buu lɛ nɔ ni gbɛkɛ lɛ etsoɔ tamɔ la.
Be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ aaawo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ; ni he ni atatu lɛ aaayawa yɛ lɛ, jɛi Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛtoɔ shi hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ nɔŋŋ naa.
Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni atatu lɛ ma shi yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hiɔ shitoohe lɛ mli.
Kɛji atatu lɛ tsɛ akɛ amɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ boɔ Yehowa toi, ni amɛfãaa kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Bei komɛi lɛ atatu lɛ yeɔ gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni eba lɛ ehã lɛ, Israelbii lɛ toɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa nyiɛmɔ hu yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa.
Kɛji atatu lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ gbɛkɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ni ewo ehe nɔ leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fãa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eye gbi muu kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ hu, be fɛɛ be ni atatu lɛ woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ fãa.
Ni kɛ gbii enyɔ atatu lɛ ye yɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, nyɔŋ kome jio, be kakadaŋŋ jio, gbii abɔ ni eyɔɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ efãaa.
Shi kɛji ewo ehe nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛfã.
Amɛtoɔ shi yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa, ni amɛfãa yɛ Yehowa nɔŋŋ fãmɔ naa.
Amɛye Yehowa gbee nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ Mose nɔ efã amɛ akɛ amɛfee lɛ.
Jwiɛtɛi tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Okɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia afee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ koni akɛtsɛ asafo lɛ kɛkpe, ni asaŋ okɛhã amɛfã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ.
Kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ shikome ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ tsɛ naakpa lɛ, maŋbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa abakpe shi yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Shi kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kome kɛkɛ akpã lɛ, no lɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔɔ.
Kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ akɛbɔ oshe ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ afã.
Kɛ akpã kɛbɔ oshe nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ asafoi ni jwere wuoyigbɛ lɛ anɔ ni, amɛ amɛfã.
Belɛ kɛji aatao akɛ maŋ lɛ afã kɛshi shitoohe lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ kɛbɔ oshe.
Shi kɛji aatsɛ maŋ lɛ koni amɛnaa abakpe shi lɛ, akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni egbɛɛmɔ lɛ sɛɛ atsɛ, shi akɛkabɔ oshe.
Aaron bihii ni ji osɔfoi lɛ ji mɛi ni akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ.
“Gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ akpɔ ni akã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi nɛɛ akpãmɔ he ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ nɛ: Kɛji nyɛkɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni gbaa nyɛnaa miiwu yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ kɛbɔa oshe; ni mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibaye mabua nyɛ, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Asaŋ nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ yɛ gbii ni nyɛmiinya hu anɔ, kɛ gbii juji ni ato lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee shishijee gbi lɛ hu nɔ be mli ni nyɛshãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, ni maye mabua nyɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, atatu lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii asafo lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Atatu lɛ yawa yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ ji Israelbii lɛ aklɛŋklɛŋ fãa ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ yɛ fãmɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ efã amɛ lɛ naa.
Yudabii akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ tsutsu fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Nahashon, Aminadab bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Isakar akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Netanel, Zuar bi lɛ, ni mɔ ni ji Zebulon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliab, Helon bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni afã Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni Gershonbii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ, ni amɛ amɛtereɔ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu fã nyiɛmɔ.
Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Ruben akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elizur, Shedeur bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Simeon akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Shelumiel, Zurishadai bi lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji Gad akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Eliasaf, Deuel bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ ateŋ Kohatbii lɛ ni tereɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii lɛ fã.
Ashiɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ amãa shi dani asafo lɛ yashɛɔ he ni ayaato shi yɛ ehee lɛ.
Amɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Efraim akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Elishama, Amihud bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Manase akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Gamaliel, Pedazur bi lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji Benyamin akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Abidan, Gideon bi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Dan akutso lɛ aflaŋaa lɛ ni nyiɛɔ Israelbii asafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ fã, asafo nyiɛ asafo sɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahiezer, Amishadai bi lɛ.
Mɔ ni ji Asher akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Pagiel, Okran bi lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji Naftali akutso lɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Ahira, Enan bi lɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ toɔ naa fãa, asaŋ ni amɛnyiɛɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ anaa kɛji amɛshi shitoohe ko lɛ.
Be ni Israel asafoi lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ eŋa nyɛmi nuu Hobab, ni ji eshaanuu Yetro, Midiannyo lɛ, binuu lɛ akɛ, “Wɔmiifã kɛya he ni Yehowa wo wɔ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ.
Fatamɔ wɔhe ni wɔtee.
Yehowa ewo shi akɛ ebaahã Israel aye ejurɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔɔfee bo ejurɔ.” Shi Hobab here Mose nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ehiŋ mi yaa; shi moŋ matee mi diɛŋtsɛ mijaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ mimaŋbii aŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Hobab akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kaashi wɔ.
Gbii abɔ ni bo ole hei ni sa akɛ wɔtotoo shi yɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ wɔhiɛ.
Kɛji okɛ wɔ nyiɛ lɛ, ejurɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa aaafee wɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkɛaafee bo.” Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Sinai, ni ji Yehowa Gɔŋ lɛ he; ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃; ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ amɛshitoohe.
Be fɛɛ be ni amɛaafã nyiɛmɔ amɛshi amɛshitoohe ko lɛ Yehowa atatu lɛ haa amɛnɔ shwane.
Kɛji eshɛ be ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ baafã nyiɛmɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Wo ohe nɔ, Yehowa, koni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛ ashwã, koni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ ajo foi yɛ ohiɛ.” Ni kɛji Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miito shi lɛ, Mose kɛɔ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ, Yehowa, kɛba Israelbii akpeiakpei abɔ lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ.”
He ni atsɛ jɛi Tabera lɛ Yehowa toi gbe huhuuhu ni maŋbii lɛ wie tamɔ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni miina nɔ.
Be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli wo la ni ehã la here yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli ni ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ afãgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Mose, ni Mose kpa Yehowa fai, ni la lɛ gbo.
No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Tabera, ejaakɛ Yehowa la shã nii yɛ amɛteŋ.
Mose hala onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo Maŋsɛɛbii komɛi ni futu Israelbii lɛ, amɛsuɔmɔnaanii kwraa ji loo; ni no hewɔ lɛ, loo bɔ̃i amɛtsine baa; ni asaŋ, Israelbii lɛ hu bɔ̃i amɛmli gbigblimɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ po wɔɔna loo yɛ wɔye.
Loo ni jara waaa enyiɛ po wɔnaaa wɔye yɛ Ijipt?
Wɔkaiɔ kokumba kɛ waatrɛ kɛ shwie kɛ sabolai!
Shi naa wɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔtɔ biti, ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa wɔye akɛ ja nɛkɛ mana nɛɛ pɛ.” Mana nɛɛ tamɔ dumɔ wui bibiibii kɛ esu wuɔfɔ oo ko.
Maŋbii lɛ yakɔlɔɔ, ni amɛbawiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ nɔ, aloo amɛshiɔ yɛ fufuitso mli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ kukwɛi mli amɛkɛfeɔ niyenii, eŋɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ akpiti ni awo mli fɔ ŋɔɔmɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ be mli ni bɔ nyɔɔ shitoohe lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai be mli mana lɛ hu bashwieɔ shi.
Mose nu ni maŋbii lɛ miifofoi yɛ amɛwekui lɛ fɛɛ amli; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ damɔ ebuu shinaa naa.
Yehowa mli fu naakpa; ni sane lɛ eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Mose hu naa kwraa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni okɛ mi, otsulɔ, yeɔ kɛ joomɔ nɛɛ, ni oná mi mlifu?
Mɛɛba ni okɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ fɛɛ yi sɔ̃ etere mi nɛɛ?
Ani mi, mibɔ maŋ muu nɛɛ, aloo mi, mifɔ amɛ, hewɔ ni okɛɛ mi akɛ mihiɛ amɛ yɛ mikpɔkɔiaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bihiɛlɔ hiɛɔ bi abifao kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi yɛ he lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ maná loo yɛ mahã nɛkɛ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiifo amɛmiiwo mi akɛ mihã amɛ loo amɛye?
Mi kome too minyɛŋ maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ makura.
Nitsumɔ nɛɛ da fe mi.
Kɛji nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni okɛ mi baaye lɛ, no lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ koni ogbe mi moŋ nyɔŋlo koni mikana mihiɛnaanɔnii.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Halamɔ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo ni ji hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, ni okɛ amɛ aba miŋɔɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ he, ni ohã amɛdamɔ omasɛi.
Mibakpeleke shi mikɛ bo abawie yɛ jɛi, ni maŋɔ mumɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ eko mahã amɛ hu koni amɛwa bo kɛtere maŋ lɛ jatsu lɛ bɔ ni afee ni okome okatere.
Ni okɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, Nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ; shi nyɛbaana loo nyɛye.
Yehowa enu yaafo ni nyɛfo akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaahã wɔ loo ni wɔye, ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔyɔɔ Ijipt lɛ ehi moŋ ehã wɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛ loo ni nyɛye.’ Ni jeee gbi kome, loo gbii enyɔ, loo gbii enumɔ, loo gbii nyɔŋma, loo gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛkɛ nyɛbaaye loo nɛɛ; shi moŋ nyɔŋ kome muu sɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni loo lɛ baaje fu ewo nyɛ, ni ebaaje nyɛtsine.
Ejaakɛ nyɛgbe Yehowa ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni nyɛfo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔyɛ Ijipt moŋ kulɛ ehi.’ ” Shi Mose here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Maŋbii ni mikɛyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛɔ akpei ohai ekpaa, ni okɛɛ obaahã amɛ loo amɛye nyɔŋ kome sɔŋŋ.
Ani toi kɛ tsinai aaagbe ahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa aloo ŋshɔŋ loo fɛɛ abaaya ayahɛ abahã amɛ, ni eeeshɛ amɛnaa?” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Ani Yehowa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ nɔ lo?
Miwiemɔ lɛ aaaba mli jio, ebaŋ mli jio, obaana ŋmɛnɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose tee ni eyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Ebua maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ateŋ hii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ anaa, ni ehã amɛdamɔ shi kɛbɔle Kpee Buu lɛ he kɛkpe.
Ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu mli, ni ekɛ Mose bawie, ni eŋɔ mumɔ lɛ ni ekɛhã Mose lɛ eko ekɛhã onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ hu.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni mumɔ lɛ yi amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛgbagbai; shi kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgbaaa dɔŋŋ.
Maŋ onukpai ni Mose hala lɛ ateŋ hii enyɔ komɛi, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Eldad, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Medad, naaa afata maŋ onukpai lɛ ahe kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ he.
Kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ lɛ yi amɛ hu amɛnɔ, ni amɛgba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.
Ni oblanyo ko jo foi ni ebatsĩ tã etsɔ̃ɔ Mose akɛ Eldad kɛ Medad miigba yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli.
Enɛ hã Nun bi Yoshua ni ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛjɛ eblahiaŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, tsii amɛ gbɛ!” Shi Mose kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Mi oyeɔ awuŋã ohã nɛɛ?
Miná ni kulɛ Yehowa maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi, ni Yehowa fɔse emumɔ lɛ eshwie amɛnɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ mli.
Yehowa hã trakɔkɔi Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko tswa, ni eloo trakɔkɔi babaoo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛba ni ekɛ amɛ bashwie shitoohe lɛ mli kɛ ehewɔ fɛɛ kɛbɔle kpula bɔ ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee ninetalɔi enyɔ.
Ni nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ enyɔɔŋ lɛ mli kɛmɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ fɛɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ mɔmɔ trakɔkɔi lɛ.
Mɔ ni naaa kwraa lɛ ena loo ni tsiimɔ fee kiloi akpe.
Amɛgbɛ loo lɛ mli amɛka kɛbɔle shitoohe lɛ he kpula.
Ayeko loo nɛɛ atãko, ni Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã hela ko babote amɛteŋ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ naakpa.
Sane nɛɛ hã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Kibrot Hataava (eshishi ji Tsinebalɔi Agbonyobui), ejaakɛ jɛi ji he ni afu mɛi ni nii ba amɛtsine lɛ yɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã yɛ Kibrot Hataava kɛtee Hazerot, ni amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.
Agbala Miriam toi Miriam kɛ Aaron wie amɛshi Mose yɛ Kushyoo ko ni Mose yaŋɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ani Mose kome kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛwieɔ?
Ani wɔ hu ekɛ wɔ ewieko pɛŋ?” Yehowa nu Miriam kɛ Aaron wiemɔ nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ nuu Mose nɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwa, eji ehe humi fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni trukaa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam akɛ, “Nyɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjea kpo ni nyɛbaa Kpee Buu lɛ he.” Ni amɛyi etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpeleke shi yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli, ni ebadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni etsɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam.
Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ; ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi!
Kɛji gbalɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ ninaa nɔ mihãa eleɔ mi, ni wɔlamɔ mli mitsɔ̃ɔ mikɛ lɛ wieɔ.
Shi mitsulɔ Mose nɔ bɛ nakai.
Lɛ edɛŋ mitu mimaŋ Israel fɛɛ kuramɔ miwo.
No hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ wieɔ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ faŋŋ; shi jeee yɛ abɛbuai amli; ni enaa mi, Yehowa, misu.
Mɛɛba nyɛsheee gbeyei, ni nyɛwie nyɛshi mitsulɔ Mose lɛ?” Yehowa mli fu Aaron kɛ Miriam; ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni atatu kutuu lɛ jeɔ Buu lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Miriam ni hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ futaa oookɛɛ kpiti.
Aaron yaakwɛ Miriam lɛ, hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo eshwie ehe fɛɛ oookɛɛ kpiti.
Kɛkɛ ni Aaron kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, kaahã agbala wɔtoi yɛ kwashiaianii kɛ esha ni wɔfee nɛɛ hewɔ.
Kaahã obiyoo tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɔmɔ ni be mli ni enyɛ fɔɔ lɛ beebe lɛ egbo, ni eheloo fã ekpɔtɔ momo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ, tsa obiyoo.” Yehowa here Mose nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Miriam tsɛ fɛ̃ lajɔ̃ shwie Miriam hiɛ lɛ, ani ashwieko Miriam hiɛ shi kɛyashi gbii kpawo lo?
Ashwie Miriam kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ gbii kpawo; no sɛɛ dani ahã eba shitoohe lɛ mli.” Ashwie Miriam yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyashi gbii kpawo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ afã nyiɛmɔ kɛyashi aŋɔ Miriam kɛba shitoohe lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ fã yɛ Hazerot kɛtee, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Paran.
Mɛi yasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii Yehowa kɛ Mose wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsu hii koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛbaahã Israelbii lɛ.
Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ tsu mɔ kome ni eji onukpa yɛ amɛteŋ.” Mose ye Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii onukpai akɛ saralɔi kɛjɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni mɛi ni etsu lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Ruben akutso lɛ mɔ lɛ ji Shamua, Zakur bi lɛ; ni Simeon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Shafat, Hori bi lɛ; ni Yuda akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ.
Isakar akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Igal, Yosef bi lɛ; ni Efraim akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Hoshea, Nun bi lɛ; ni Benyamin akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Palti, Rafu bi lɛ.
Zebulon akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadiel, Sodi bi lɛ; ni Manase, Yosef bi lɛ, akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Gadi, Susi bi lɛ.
Dan akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Amiel, Gemali bi lɛ.
Asher akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Setur, Mikael bi lɛ; ni Naftali akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Nahebi, Vofsi bi lɛ, ni Gad akutso lɛ mli mɔ lɛ ji Geuel, Maki bi lɛ.
Hii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni Mose tsu koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsake Nun bi Hoshea lɛ gbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Yoshua.
Mose tsu bɔfoi nɛɛ koni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a kooyigbɛ nɛɛ kɛyaa Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ nyɛkwɔa gɔji lɛ, ni nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ nɔ, akɛ amɛhe wa aloo amɛhe waaa, akɛ amɛyi fa aloo amɛyi faaa.
Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ ehã, akɛ ehi aloo ehiii, akɛ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe aloo akrowai amli amɛyɔɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ, akɛ ebaa nii aloo ebaaa nii jogbaŋŋ, akɛ tsei yɛ nɔ aloo tsei bɛ nɔ.
Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtserɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ eko kɛbaa.” Nakai be mli lɛ eshɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wain yibii atsulɛ be.
Bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyasara Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi Rehob, he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ.
Bɔfoi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashɛ Hebron he ni Ahimanbii lɛ kɛ Sheshaibii lɛ kɛ Talmaibii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi gojogojoo ni, ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ni.
Ato Hebron maŋ lɛ afii kpawo dani ato Zoan maŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ bashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛfo wain tso nine kome kɛ enɔ yibii shao yɛ jɛi, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ wo yibii shao lɛ tsoŋ, ni amɛtere kɛba.
Amɛtserɛ akutui lɛ eko kɛ agbãmii lɛ hu eko kɛba.
Wain yibii shao ni Israelbii abɔfoi lɛ fo yɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ.
Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, saralɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ saramɔ lɛ amɛba.
Amɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Paran ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛbagba amɛ bɔ ni amɛyana nibii amɛhã, ni amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Amɛbɔ Mose amaniɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔtee shikpɔŋ ni otsu wɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ; ni anɔkwale ji akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo fɔ ni ebaa nii hu, ni enɔ tsei ayibii po nɛ.
Shi moŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛhe wa; ni amɛmaji lɛ atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ, ni maji lɛ dara naakpa hu; asaŋ wɔna Anakbii oblaŋi lɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Amalekbii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni Hitbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Kanaanbii lɛ kã ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ hu naa.” Shi Kaleb tswa bɔfoi lɛ anaa mã yɛ Mose hiɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kɛ̃ koni wɔyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ejaakɛ wɔbaanyɛ amɛnɔ kunim wɔye aahu.” Shi hii lɛ ni kɛ Kaleb tee amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnyɛŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ wɔdamɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe wɔ.” Hii lɛ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛyasara lɛ he sane lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi amɛhã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsara lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni egbo ni ebaaa nii ni enɔ bii ana aye; ni gbɔmɛi ni wɔna yɛ nɔ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni; ni wɔna Anakbii ashwiei, gbɔmɛi oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi hu yɛ jɛi.
Kɛji wɔkɛ wɔhe to amɛhe lɛ, wɔtamɔ agãi; ni nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu amɛnaa wɔ.”
Maŋbii lɛ wie huhuuhu Nakai gbi lɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ bolɔ, ni maŋ lɛ fo nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni amɛwie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔgboi moŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ po kulɛ bɛ ehi?
Mɛɛba Yehowa ekpala wɔ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ koni wɔbanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa koni aŋɔ wɔŋamɛi kɛ wɔbifabii anom nɛɛ?
Ani ehiii moŋ akɛ wɔkpale kɛya Ijipt ekoŋŋ?” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔwoa wɔteŋ mɔ ko onukpa koni enyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ni wɔku wɔsɛɛ kɛya Ijipt.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi yɛ Israelbii asafo ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, ni ji hii ni atsu ni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛkwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ lɛ, gbala amɛtadei; ni amɛkɛɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni wɔyakpa nɔ wɔsara wɔkwɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ kpakpa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni.
Kɛji Yehowa yɛ wɔhe tsui lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ wɔ aaayashɛ jɛi, ni eeeŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ ni hi ni baa nii lɛ ehã wɔ.
Shi moŋ Yehowa hiɛ atua kɛkɛ ni nyɛkatsea; ni asaŋ nyɛkashea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛshɛŋ wɔwaosɛɛkpelɔ tete; amɛkɔlɔ eje amɛnɔ momo; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” Asafo lɛ fɛɛ to amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia amɛ tɛ pɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ nɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Mose sɔle yɛ Maŋbii lɛ ahewɔ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ maŋ nɛɛ aaakwa mi kɛyashi?
Mɛni shwɛɔ dɔŋŋ dani amɛaahe minɔ amɛye yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee mikɛto amɛ okadii lɛ asɛɛ?
Mibahã gbele hela ababote amɛteŋ koni mikɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi mahã oshwiei atsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa fe maŋ nɛɛ.” Shi Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ baanu he, ejaakɛ amɛteŋ ojie maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ yɛ onineshiwalɛ naa, ni amɛaagba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ enu momo akɛ, bo Yehowa, okɛ wɔ yɛ, ni anaa bo faŋŋ kɛ faŋŋ kɛji atatu lɛ bashi edamɔ wɔnɔ; ni bo onyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ yɛ atatu kutuu mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okpãtã maŋ nɛɛ blublu hiɛ lɛ, majimaji ni enu ogbɛi he lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ ni Yehowa, onyɛɛɛ okɛ omaŋbii lɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni owo shi yɛ he akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, hewɔ ni oyaplenee amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, ofainɛ, hã wɔna ohewalɛ lɛ, ni ohã shi ni owo lɛ aba mli tamɔ okɛɛ oto lɛ akɛ, ‘Mi, Yehowa, mimli fuuu mra, ni mimɔbɔnalɛ hu fa; ni mikɛ tɔ̃mɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ faa; shi kɛ̃lɛ mihãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye, ni miwoɔ bii anyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete nɔ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ maŋ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ afa amɛ yɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni okɛfa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt aahu kɛbashi bianɛ lɛ.” Yehowa to he ehã Mose akɛ, “Mikɛfa amɛ bɔ ni obi lɛ.
Shi moŋ anɔkwale sane kome ji akɛ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni asaŋ mi, Yehowa, minunyam lɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni na minunyam la kaŋkaŋ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee yɛ Ijipt kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni nomɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ amɛka mi shii nyɔŋma sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo ehe shi mito akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni kwa mi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi akɛni soro mumɔ ni mitsulɔ Kaleb hiɛ, ni asaŋ eye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ ni etee ayasara lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ eshwiei anɔ.
Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ amrɔ nɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛtsɔ̃a Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyajea ŋa lɛ nɔ.” Yehowa gbala maŋ lɛ toi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ nɛɛ baawie huhuuhu amɛshi mi kɛyashi?
Huhuuhu lɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ shiɔ mi lɛ, minu fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, ‘Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, bɔ ni nyɛwie nyɛwo mitoiŋ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee nyɛ.
Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛbaagboi yɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa, ni wie huhuuhu shi mi lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ shɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛ koni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ.
Ni nyɛbii bibii lɛ ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, mibakpala amɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛkpoo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaale jɛi.
Nyɛ lɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛbaagboi yɛ.
Nyɛbii lɛ baatsomlo, ni amɛbaana nɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ kwamɔ ni nyɛkwa mi lɛ hewɔ, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛteŋ naagbee mɔ lɛ baagbo.
Gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ ni nyɛye nyɛkɛsara shikpɔŋ lɛ, emli gbi kome fɛɛ gbi kome baatsɔ afi ahã nyɛ, ni nyɛbaana nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ nyɛtoigbele lɛ hewɔ koni nyɛkɛna akɛ mikwa nyɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, minã miwie; ni anɔkwa, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee nɛkɛ asafo fɔŋ ni fee ekome wo mi nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ shiaŋa nɛɛ nɔ nyɛaagboi ni nyɛyi aaatã yɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ ni Mose tsu yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba ni amɛbatã shikpɔŋ lɛ he sane fɔŋ amɛkɛhã maŋ lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Yehowa lɛ, gbele hela fɔŋ ko bashi amɛnɔ, ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ amɛnajiaŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ni eshwɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, pɛ yɛ hii ni tee yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nigii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyi na wala.
Israelbii lɛ ka shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ Be ni Mose jaje wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ̃; ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa wɔ, wɔbaaya he ni Yehowa ewo shi yɛ he lɛ kɛ̃; ejaakɛ wɔfee esha!” Shi Mose here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛkuɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ nɛɛ?
Nyɛyeŋ omanye.
Nyɛkayaa, ejaakɛ Yehowa bɛ nyɛteŋ, koni nyɛkayanyɔnyɔi yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ baakpe, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛ, ejaakɛ gbii abɔ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hu fiŋ nyɛsɛɛ.” Shi maŋbii lɛ shi amɛtsitsi, ni amɛkã akɛ amɛaakwɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Mose fɛɛ shiii shitoohe lɛ mli kɛyaaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ kpeleke shi, ni amɛbaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛshwie amɛ aahu kɛtee Horma tɔ̃ɔ.
Afɔleshãa he mlai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛkɛ tsina loo too baashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, shãa afɔle ni jio, gbee afɔle ni jio, afɔle ni akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ ni jio, tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ni jio, nyɛgbii juji ni ato lɛ eko nɔ afɔle ni jio, afɔle lɛ ŋma asa mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ.
Mɔ ni baashã afɔle lɛ ekɛ niyenii hu afata kooloo lɛ he kɛba.
Niyenii nɛɛ afee ŋmãa mamu kilo kome ni akɛ mu lita kome efutu mli, kɛ wain hu lita kome.
Akɛ nibii nɛɛ afata toobi kome ni akɛbaashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle lɛ he.
Kɛji akɛ ojwɛni baashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ ŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni akɛ mu lita kome kɛ fã efutu mli afee kooloo lɛ he niyenii afɔle lɛ; ni akɛ wain lita kome kɛ fã afata he koni afɔle lɛ ŋma lɛ asa mihiɛ.
Shi kɛji akɛ tsina oblanyo baashã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle akɛ akɛmiiye shiwoo ko nɔ loo akɛ shidaa afɔle akɛhã mi, Yehowa, lɛ, no lɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛfata tsina oblanyo lɛ he lɛ afee ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ ni akɛ mu litai enyɔ efutu mli; ni akɛ wain litai enyɔ hu afata he.
Afɔle ni akɛ la shãa hãa mi Yehowa, ni misumɔɔ eŋma ji enɛ.’ “Niyenii ni afata tsinanuu fɛɛ tsinanuu, loo ojwɛni fɛɛ ojwɛni, loo gwantɛŋbi fɛɛ gwantɛŋbi loo abotiabi fɛɛ abotiabi he nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kooloi abɔ ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ eko fɛɛ eko he niyenii afɔle ni ato lɛ afata he yɛ amɛyibɔ lɛ naa.
Israel fɔmɔbi fɛɛ fɔmɔbi afee enɛ kɛji eba ebaashã niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa.
Kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ aloo ebadɔmɔ nyɛ kwraa miisumɔ akɛ eshã afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa, bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ hu efee.
Gbɛjianɔtoo kome baakã shi ahã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ni ekã shi akɛ naanɔ akpɔ ahã nyɛ, Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato nyɛ gbɔ lɛ fɛɛ ashwiei.
Israelnyo kɛ mɔkpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ pɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mla kome kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo kome baahi shi ahã nyɛ Israel fɔmɔbii kɛ gbɔ ni ebato nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ.” Yehowa kɛ Mose wie akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛ nyɛ yaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ni nyɛaana nyɛye lɛ, nyɛkɛ eko ashãa afɔle nyɛhãa mi, Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛkpokploku mã lɛ eko ashãa aboloo nyɛhãa mi akɛ nɔwomɔ afɔle.
Bɔ ni nyɛshãa ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ he afɔle lɛ, nakai nyɛshã enɛ hu.
Nyɛbaashã kpokploku mã aboloo afɔle nɛɛ nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛyinɔi fɛɛ mli.
“Kɛji nyɛtɔ̃ ni nyɛyeee kitãi nɛɛ ni Yehowa ewo Mose lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo nyɛ, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Yehowa wo nakai mlai lɛ, kɛyashi nyɛyinɔi ayinɔi blublu anɔ lɛ, ni atɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ ko, yɛ leee ni asafo lɛ leee hewɔ lɛ, no lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ amɛdɛŋ tsina oblanyo kome koni amɛkɛshã shãa afɔle amɛkɛhã mi, akɛ afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ mi, Yehowa.
Akɛ niyenii kɛ dãa afɔle hu bɔ ni afo akɛ kusum lɛ afata he.
Too kpakpo kome hu afata he koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã ahã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ kãaa he, ni asaŋ, tɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle ni akɛhãa Yehowa lɛ.
Akɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ aaafa Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato amɛ lɛ hu ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shi nɔ ni atɔ̃ lɛ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko fee esha ni ehiɛ kãaa he lɛ, no lɛ ekɛ abotiayoo ni eye afi aba koni akɛshã esha lɛ hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
Osɔfo lɛ akpãtã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ehã mɔ ni efee esha lɛ ni akɛaafa lɛ.
Mla kome akã shi ahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, mɔkpɔŋ ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni jio.
“Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ kã he ni efee nɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, Israel fɔmɔbi ni jio, gbɔ ni jio, ebɔ musu ejaakɛ ekwɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nakai mɔ lɛ gbe agbe lɛ; ejaakɛ ebuuu Yehowa wiemɔ, ni etɔ̃ ekitã nɔ.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ agbe lɛ koni emusu atere lɛ.” Nuu ko tɔ̃ hejɔɔmɔ gbi mla nɔ Be ko be mli ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ, ayana nuu ko ni etee eelɛ lai yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni yana nuu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛba Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Awo nuu lɛ tsuŋ ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ anako nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni sa akɛ afee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Agbe nuu lɛ.
Akɛ lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni agbe lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpala nuu lɛ kɛtee shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛi, ni agbe lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ afee lɛ.
Atade naa ahwanya he mlai Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛfee ahwanyai amɛwo amɛtadei akoji anaa, ni akɛ kpãa bluu amɔ̃mɔ̃ amɛ.
Yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ bii afee nakai.
Ahwanyai nɛɛ atsɔ̃ kaimɔnii; ni be fɛɛ be ni hiŋmɛi aaagba nɔ lɛ ehã nyɛkai Yehowa kitãi lɛ fɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkanyiɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi akɔnɔ nibii lɛ asɛɛ, nibii asɛɛ ni nyɛyadiɔ ni nyɛkɛkwaa Yehowa lɛ.
Ahwanyai lɛ baakai nyɛ mikitãi lɛ koni nyɛye nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi nyɛhã mi, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.”
Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram tse atua Izehar bi Kora, ni eji Kohat nabi, ni asaŋ eji Levi nanakansowa lɛ na Ruben akutso lɛ mli gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ komɛi shi enɔ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliab bii lɛ, kɛ On, Pelet bi lɛ.
Amɛte shi amɛwo Mose.
Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni ji asafo lɛ mli onukpai kɛ hiɛnaanɔbii ni yɔɔ gbɛi komɛi hu fata amɛhe.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kpe amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ asafo muu lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ.
Mɛɛba ni nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Yehowa asafo lɛ nɔ mɔ?” Be ni Mose nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni esɔle.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Kora kɛ asafo lɛ ni ekɛba lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔ ni ji wɔ leebi lɛ Yehowa baahã ale mɔ ni ji enɔ; mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ, lɛ ebaahã ebɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Nɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Kora, bo kɛ osafo lɛ nyɛkɔlɔa lajee tsɛnsii; nyɛjea la nyɛwoa amɛmli kɛbaa wɔ, koni nyɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma abashwiea nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Jɛi wɔbaana yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa aaaŋɔ̃ lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ̃ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Nyɛmiitsɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃, nyɛ Levibii.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi koo, nyɛ Levibii!
Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ etse nyɛ yɛ Israel asafo lɛ he, ni ehãa nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛbɛŋkɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛtsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nii; ni asaŋ nyɛdamɔɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ, aso no faaa hãaa nyɛ lo?
Yehowa ehã bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ lɛ; ni fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmiitao osɔfoyeli lɛ hu nyɛfata he?
Naa, kpee ni bo kɛ osafo lɛ bakpe nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa he nyɛkpe nyɛwo lɛ, ni huhuuhu ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ Aaron lɛ, Yehowa moŋ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsu koni ayatsɛ Datan kɛ Abiram, Eliabbii lɛ, kɛba.
Shi amɛhã hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaaa he ko he ko!
Kɛji obakpala wɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ, ni obaagbegbee wɔ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no kɛkɛ faaa hãaa bo; shi no sɛɛ hu lɛ ootao akɛ oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ wɔnɔ lo?
Asaŋ jeee shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ewo fɔ nɔ okɛ wɔ ba; ni obahãko wɔ ŋmɔji kɛ wain tromi akɛ wɔgboshinii.
Obaakã he ni olaka wɔ sɔŋŋ nakai?
Wɔbaaa hekoheko!” Sane lɛ wo Mose mli la naakpa; ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Kaahe amɛfɔlei lɛ.
Mishɔ̃ko amɛteŋ mɔ ko teji yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miyeko amɛteŋ mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko!” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Kora akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ osafo lɛ fɛɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ.
Bo kɛ amɛ kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, bo kɛ osafoŋbii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Aaron hu, akɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma awo mli koni nyɛkɛba Yehowa hiɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ elajee tsɛnsi, ni eje la ewo mli; ni ekɛ tsofakɛŋma shwie nɔ, ni amɛkɛba amɛbadamɔ shi yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, amɛ kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron fɛɛ.
Kora bua maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa ewo Mose kɛ Aaron; amɛbabɔ gwa yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Mose.
Yehowa anunyam la lɛ pue trukaa yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe yɛ nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.” Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ, heloo fɛɛ awala jɛɛhe!
Aso mɔ kome aaafee esha, ni okɛ ehe nu aaaju maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he lo?” Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ maŋ muu lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shihilɛhei lɛ ahe kɛya sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.’ ” Mose te shi, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Datan kɛ Abiram ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛtee.
Mose kɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe oya kɛjea nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nɛɛ abui lɛ ahe kɛyaa sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni nyɛkataa amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko he koni akakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.” Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã asafo lɛ gbala amɛhe shi kɛshi Kora kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram bui lɛ ahe kɛtee sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Datan kɛ Abiram je kpo amɛbadamɔ amɛbui lɛ ashinai lɛ ashi, ni amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛbifabii lɛ fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe.
Mose kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibatsu nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni mifeɔ lɛ, shi jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ mito miyiŋ ni mifeɔ.
Kɛji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gboi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ, aloo amɛkɛ osharã ko kpe ni eji adesã he nɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsu mi nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ tsumɔ.
Shi kɛji Yehowa fee nɔ ko ni bako dã, ni shikpɔŋ gba ni emĩ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ebuuu Yehowa.” Mose naa ni nyɔ shi nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba yɛ Datan kɛ Abiram shishi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ hɔi kɛ Kora hu webii lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɔ bu lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ mi amɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni gba lɛ bashi hiɛ ni etsa ekoŋŋ, ni emii amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛhiɛkpãtã kwrakwra yɛ amɛjakumɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Bolɔmɔ ni amɛbolɔ lɛ hã Israelbii fɛɛ ni ewo shi yɛ jɛi kɛkpe lɛ jojoo foi, ni amɛ hu amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Akakwɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ bamii wɔ hu.” Yehowa hã la bayi hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ ni kɛ tsofakɛŋma ba Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ ni eshã amɛ wɛɛ.
