Lajee tsɛnsii lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Eleazar, Osɔfo Aaron binuu lɛ, akɛ ehole lajee tsɛnsii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ ni eshã lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛ amɛmli la lɛ eshwã kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsɛnsii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, No hewɔ lɛ, atswia hii nɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛwala wo esha lɛ he nyɔmɔ lɛ, atsɛnsii lɛ tɛtɛrɛbii, ni akɛha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ okadi ehã Israelbii fɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Eleazar kɔlɔ akɔɔble lajee tsɛnsii lɛ ni hii lɛ ni la lɛ shã lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni atswia akɛfee afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hehaanii, koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni jeee Aaron shwie ko akatsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ akɛ ebaashã tsofakɛŋma ekɛhã Yehowa, koni ekabatsɔ̃ tamɔ Kora kɛ esafo lɛ.
Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Aaron here maŋbii lɛ ayiwala Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ saa wie huhuuhu amɛshi Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbe Yehowa webii.” Be ni maŋbii lɛ anaa ebabua kɛbaaya ayanina Mose kɛ Aaron lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛkwɛ Kpee Buu lɛ, ni naa, atatu kutuu lɛ ebaha Buu lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa anunyam la lɛ epue.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛ Aaron badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ, ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjea nɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ he kɛyaa sɛɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.” Shi Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni Mose kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Kɔ olajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni oje afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko owo mli, ni okɛ tsofakɛŋma ashwie nɔ, ni okɛya asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ mramra okɛyakpãtã ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mlifu ete shi momo, ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛ kpãtãmɔ.” Aaron fee bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Ekɔ elajee tsɛnsi lɛ, ni ekɛjo foi kɛtee maŋbii lɛ ateŋ.
Eyanina ni gbele hela lɛ ebɔ̃i mɛi ahiɛkpãtãmɔ momo.
Eshã tsofakɛŋma lɛ, ni ekɛkpãtã ehã maŋbii lɛ.
Aaron damɔ gbohii lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Gbɔmɛi ni gbele hela lɛ gbe lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai kpawo, soro mɛi ni gboi yɛ Kora sane lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Be ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo lɛ, Aaron ku esɛɛ kɛba Mose ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Aaron dɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ abahã bo dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso kome.
Ŋmãa akutso fɛɛ akutso gbɛi yɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso ni ekɛba lɛ he; ni oŋmã Aaron gbɛi yɛ tso ni Levibii kɛba lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ lɛ ebaana dɛhiɛmɔtso kome.
Kɔlɔmɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ kɛya Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni okɛyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ he ni mi kɛ bo kpeɔ yɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ji mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, edɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ baagba afofro; ni mikɛ enɛ baahã huhuuhu ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ amɛshiɔ nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose bi Israelbii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ bahã lɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso komekome yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa.
Fɛɛ fee dɛhiɛmɔtsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni akɛ Aaron tso lɛ hu fata he.
Mose kɛ tsei lɛ tee eyashwie Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Mose tee Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ, naa Aaron tso lɛ ni ji Levibii awe lɛ tso lɛ ni efrɔke ni egba afofro, ni ewo yibii hu.
Mose loo tsei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛje kpo kɛba Israelbii lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛbatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni akutsotsɛ fɛɛ akutsotsɛ kɔ etso.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kpalemɔ ni okɛ Aaron tso lɛ ayafɔ̃ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ ekoŋŋ koni akɛto okadi ahã toigbolɔi lɛ bɔ ni afee ni huhuuhu ni amɛwieɔ amɛshiɔ mi lɛ sɛɛ afo, koni amɛkagboi.” Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiplene, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!
Wɔ bluublu wɔhiɛ miikpãtã.
Kɛji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ baagbo lɛ, belɛ no lɛ wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, gboimɔ wɔgboi lɛ!”
Osɔfoi anitsumɔi kɛ Levibii hu anitsumɔi Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Bo kɛ obihii kɛ Levibii fɛɛ ji mɛi ayi ni sɔ̃ baatere kɛji abɔ musu yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi yɛ osɔfo nitsumɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ baatere sɔ̃ kɛji tɔ̃mɔ ko ba.
Ŋɔɔ onyɛmimɛi, Levibii ni ji otsɛ akutso lɛ mli bii lɛ, ofata ohe koni amɛwa bo be ni bo kɛ obii lɛ tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛsɔ̃mɔ kɛtsu Kpee Buu lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ yɛ oshishi; shi amɛkabɛŋkɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ akagboi.
Amɛ, amɛfata ohe koni amɛtsu amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Kpee Buu lɛŋ lɛ: shi moŋ mɔ ko ni jeee Levinyo akabɛŋkɛ nyɛ ni ebatsu jɛi nitsumɔ lɛ eko.
Bo kɛ obii lɛ pɛ akwɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bɔ ni afee ni mimli akafu Israelbii lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni naa, mijie nyɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ateŋ, ni mikɛ amɛ eke nyɛ akɛ mi, Yehowa, minikeenii, koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Shi bo kɛ obihii lɛ pɛ asɔ̃mɔ akɛ osɔfoi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛ muhɔɔ lɛ mligbɛ hu.
Miŋɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ mihã nyɛ akɛ sɔɔ̃mɔ ni aŋɔ ke.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ejeee osɔfo ni eeebɛŋkɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ.” Osɔfoi agbɛnaanii Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Naa, nibii ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle lɛ, amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ni ashãaa lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mikɛke bo kɛ obihii osɔfoi lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Afɔlei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ amli nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ afɔleshãa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni.
Nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbakeɔ mi akɛ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, niyenii afɔle ni jio, esha he afɔle ni jio, sɔ̃yeli he afɔle ni jio, mijɔɔ nɔ tswaa mikɛke bo kɛ oshwiei.
Nyɛyea nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu aaanyɛ aye eko; nyɛbua lɛ akɛ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
“Mikɛ nibii ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahã mi akɛ shidaa afɔle lɛ hu eke nyɛ, ni ji bo kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, akɛ amɛgbɛnaanii kɛmiiya naanɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
“Miijɔɔ mu kɛ wain kɛ klɛŋklɛŋ abele ni akuɔ lɛ mli ekpakpa fe fɛɛ ni Israelbii kɛbahãa mi Yehowa nɔ mihã bo.
Klɛŋklɛŋ aduawai ni amɛtseɔ yɛ amɛŋmɔji amli ni amɛkɛhãa mi Yehowa lɛ, onɔ ni.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ehe tse yɛ oshwiei ateŋ lɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ajɔɔ nɔ akɛke mi yɛ Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ onɔ.
“Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbeleɔ musu naa ni akɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, mijɔɔ enɔ mihã nyɛ.
Shi gbɔmɔ kromɔbi lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ lɛ; kooloi ni he tseee lɛ ohã akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛji amɛye nyɔŋ kome lɛ, jara ni akɛkpɔ̃ amɛ ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ jwiɛtɛi jara naa.
Shekel kome feɔ gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Shi tsina loo gwantɛŋ loo abotia kromɔbi lɛ, okahã akpɔ̃ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛhe tse; amɛ okɛshã afɔle okɛhã mi.
Okɛ amɛlá lɛ ashwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni oshã amɛmli fɔ lɛ koni efee afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Amɛloo lɛ nyɛnɔ ni tamɔ bɔ ni kooloi krokomɛi ni akɛshãa afɔle atsitsinaa kɛ ninejurɔ shuɔji lɛ feɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ.
“Nibii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛbahãa mi akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ miijɔɔ fɛɛ nɔ miihã bo kɛ oshwiei hii kɛ yei fɛɛ akɛ amɛgbɛnaanii ni kã shi daa.
Kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ bo kɛ oshwiei ekpãŋ nɛɛ akuŋ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Aaron akɛ, “Onaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ onaŋ shikpɔŋ ni abaaja lɛ eko.
Mi, Yehowa, mi ji ogbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ ogboshinii ni he hiaa bo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.” Nɔ ni ahã Levibii lɛ “Too fɛɛ too ni ji nii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ni awoɔ yɛ Israel ni akɛbahãa mi lɛ, mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ gboshinii yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ kɛtsuɔ Kpee Buu lɛ he nii lɛ hewɔ.
Ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ akabɛŋkɛ Kpee Buu lɛ dɔŋŋ koni amɛkabaloo musu ni amɛgboi.
Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni baatsu Kpee Buu lɛ he nii; ni kɛji nɔ ko tɔ̃ yɛ he lɛ sɔ̃yeli lɛ tere amɛ.
Akpɔ nɛɛ akã shi daa ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei.
Levibii lɛ, amɛnaŋ gboshinii ko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni Israelbii woɔ akɛ too ni amɛkɛbahãa mi Yehowa akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ, mikɛhã Levibii lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii.
Enɛ hewɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛnaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.” Too ni Levibii lɛ baawo Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛnine shɛ nibii mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ni mibi Israelbii koni amɛwo amɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛjiea mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome nɛɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma kome koni nyɛkɛbahãa, mi Yehowa, akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ.
Ni abaabu nyɛfɔle krɛdɛɛ nɛɛ tamɔ abuɔ okwaafonyo ŋmãa hee kɛ wain hee ni ekɛbashãa afɔle lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛbashã afɔle nyɛhã Yehowa kɛjɛ nyɛmlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome ni nyɛheɔ kɛjɛɔ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɛŋɔa afɔle nɛɛ nyɛhãa Osɔfo Aaron.
Nyɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ amli nii kpakpa ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ashãa afɔle krɛdɛɛ lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Levibii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii lɛ amli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle lɛ, nyɛŋɔa nibii fɛɛ ni shwɛɔ yɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ okwaafonyo ŋɔɔ eŋmɔshi nii loo wain ni shwɛɔ lɛ akɛ enɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayea nii ni shwɛɔ hãa nyɛ nɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ nyɛnii ni nyɛtsuɔ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo ni.
Nyɛyeee sɔ̃ ko yɛ no hewɔ, kɛji nyɛna nyɛkɛ nii lɛ mli nii kpakpa fe fɛɛ lɛ eshã afɔle momo lɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ koni nyɛkabule nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni Israelbii kɛbahãa Yehowa lɛ koni nyɛbagboi.’ ”
Tsinayoo tsuru lamlu lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ, “Akpɔ ni mi, Yehowa, miwoɔ nɛ: Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛbahã bo tsinayoo tsuru ni kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ehe, ni asaŋ akɛ apã woko lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ tsuko nii dã.
Akɛ tsina lɛ ahã Osɔfo Eleazar, ni ekɛ kooloo lɛ aje kpo kɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni agbe kooloo lɛ yɛ Eleazar hiɛ.
Osɔfo Eleazar asɔo tsina lɛ lá lɛ eko, ni ekɛ ewao atsɔ lá lɛ mli ni etsɛŋe lá lɛ eshwã Kpee Buu lɛ naagbɛ shii kpawo.
Ama tsinayoo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa la koni ashã lɛ kɛ ehewolo lɛ kɛ eloo lɛ kɛ elá lɛ kɛ ewamɔ fɛɛ.
Osɔfo lɛ akɔlɔ tsenedru tso kɛ hisopo tso kɛ kpãa tsuru koni efɔ̃ ewo la ni akɛshãa tsinayoo lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ afɔ etadei ahe, ni eju ehe dani ebote maŋbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli.
Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ osɔfo lɛ he tseee aahu kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Mɔ ni shã tsina lɛ hu afɔ etadei ahe, ni eju ehe.
Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ko ni he tse aloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ, ni ekɛya shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni tse koni akɛ lamlu lɛ ayato jɛi.
Akɛ lamlu nɛɛ awo nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he akɛdãiɔ esha ni afee yɛ Israel lɛ mli.
Enɛ ji hetsuumɔ afɔle.
Lɛ mɔ ni ebaaloo tsinayoo lɛ lamlu lɛ hu, ebaafɔ etadei ahe.
Lɛ hu ehe tseee kɛyaashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Akpɔ nɛɛ baakã shi daa ahã Israelbii kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni ebato amɛ gbɔ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni eyata gbonyo he “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbii kpawo.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aju nu ni akɛtsuɔ mɔ he lɛ eko, yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, ni ehe aaatse.
Shi kɛji ejuuu nu lɛ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ etsuuko ehe ni ehe tseŋ.
Mɔ ni aaata gbonyo ko he ni etsuuu ehe lɛ, eebule Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni abuŋ lɛ ashiŋ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ejuko nu ni akɛtsuɔ he lɛ ekɛdãiko ehe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekã muji lɛ mli lolo.
“Kɛji mɔ ko gbo yɛ buu mli lɛ, ehe mla ni kã shi nɛ: mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli be ni mɔ lɛ nyɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatee buu lɛ mli lɛ ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbii kpawo; asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ buu lɛ mli ni abuko naa lɛ abule lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baata mɔ ko ni enyɔ yɛ klante naa gbonyo he, loo mɔ ni egbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyo aloo eeeta gbonyo wu loo gbonyobu ko he yɛ jwɛiaŋ lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
“Bɔ ni atsɔ̃ atsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he nɛ: akpiti tsina tsuru ni ashã lɛ lamlu lɛ eko awo nɔ̃ mli, ni ayɛ faa ni hoɔ mli nu awo lamlu lɛ he.
Mɔ ko ni ehe tse kɛ hisopo atsɔ nu kɛ lamlu lɛ mli koni ekɛshwã buu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi kɛ mɛi hu ni tee mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ nu nɛɛ ashwã mɔ ni eyata mɔ ni nyɔ yɛ klante naa gbonyo he loo mɔ ni gbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele gbonyo he loo gbonyowu loo gbonyobu he lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ ni he tse lɛ kɛ nu nɛɛ baashwã mɔ ni he tseee lɛ nɔ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ ebaatsuu mɔ ni ebule ehe lɛ he; ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafɔ etadei lɛ ahe, ni ebaaju ehe, ni gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ mɔ ni kulɛ ehe tseee lɛ he aaatse.
“Shi mɔ ni ebule ehe, shi etsuuu ehe koni ekɛfɔ ehe muji lɛ, abaashwie lɛ yɛ asafo lɛ mli, ejaakɛ eebule Yehowa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ejuko nu ni akɛtsuɔ he lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekã muji lɛ mli lolo.
Akpɔ nɛɛ akã shi ahã Israelbii lɛ daa.
Mɔ ni kɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ shwãa lɛ, lɛ hu efɔ etadei lɛ ahe; ni mɔ ni aaata hetsuumɔ nu lɛ he lɛ, ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mɔ ni ebule ehe aaata he lɛ, ebule nɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni aaata nii ni abule he lɛ, lɛ hu ebule ehe kɛyaashi gbɛkɛ.”
Saji ni ba yɛ Kadesh Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛto shi yɛ Kadesh.
Biɛ Miriam gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ.
Nu bɛ shitoohe nɛɛ hã maŋ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ bakpe amɛwo Mose kɛ Aaron he.
Amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔgboi tamɔ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ gboi yɛ Yehowa Buu lɛ hiɛ moŋ kulɛ bɛ ehi: Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ wɔ, Yehowa asafo lɛ, ebaŋa nɛɛ nɔ?
Ani jeee koni wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi fɛɛ wɔbagboi yɛ biɛ?
Ni mɛni hewɔ nyɛkpala wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba shikpɔŋ gbonyo tamɔ enɛ nɔ?
Shikpɔŋ gbonyo ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni agbãmi kɛ waintso kɛ akutu ko bɛ enɔ he ko he ko; ni nu ni anuɔ tete po bɛ nɔ?” Mose kɛ Aaron je gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi; kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ pue yɛ amɛnɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɔ tso lɛ, ni, bo kɛ onyɛmi Aaron, nyɛbuaa asafo lɛ naa, ni okɛ tɛsaa ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ awie yɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ ehã nu ni yɔɔ emli lɛ atue.
Nu baajɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli aba ahã maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ koni amɛnu.” Mose kɔ tso lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Mose kɛ Aaron bua maŋ lɛ naa yɛ tɛsaa lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi koo, nyɛ atuatselɔi!
Ani wɔhã nu ajɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ mli ahã nyɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo enine nɔ, ni ekɛ etso lɛ tswa tɛsaa lɛ shii enyɔ, kɛkɛ ni nu tue babaoo, ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛkooloi lɛ na nu amɛnu.
Shi Yehowa kã Mose kɛ Aaron hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Akɛni nyɛheee minɔ nyɛyeee koni nyɛhã maŋbii lɛ ana mihewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ kpele lɛ, nyɛkɛ asafo nɛɛ eyaŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.” Awo nu lɛ gbɛi akɛ Meriba nu lɛ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa taa naa yɛ jɛi, shi Yehowa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Edom Maŋtsɛ eŋmɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ Ni Mose tsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ Kadesh kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni onyɛmimɛi Israelbii kɛɛ nɛ: Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole, amanehului fɛɛ ni wɔna: bɔ ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ tee Ijipt, kɛ bɔ ni wɔhi shi yɛ Ijipt be kplaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ bɔ ni Ijiptbii fee wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ niseniianii aahu.
Wɔfo wɔtsɛ Yehowa, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni etsu bɔfo ni ebajie wɔ kɛje Ijipt.
Wɔbashɛ Kadesh amrɔ nɛɛ, ni ji maŋ ni yɔɔ ohusu lɛ naa kpaakpa.
Ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ.
Wɔyaŋ ŋmɔji loo wain tromi amli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu.
Tɛmpɔŋ wulu lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ.” Shi Edombii lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Dabida!
Nyɛkabatsɔ̃a wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔbaafã ta wɔwo nyɛ.” Israelbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ.
Kɛji wɔ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ aaanu nyɛnu lɛ eko po lɛ, wɔbaawo nyɛ nyɔmɔ.
Sane ko bɛ sɛɛ fe akɛ wɔmiitao wɔfo mli kpoo kɛkɛ.” Edombii lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ!” Ni amɛfã ta kpeteŋkple kɛyasa Israelbii lɛ anaa.
Akɛni Edombii lɛ eyaŋmɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ gbɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyatsɔ̃ he kroko.
Aaron gbele Israelbii asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Kadesh, ni amɛba Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he, yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Aaron yɛ jɛi akɛ, “Aaron naji enyɔ yiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɔ; ebaagbo ejaakɛ nyɛbooo mi toi be ni nyɛyɔɔ Meriba lɛ.
Ŋɔ̃ɔ Aaron kɛ ebinuu Eleazar koni okɛ amɛ aya Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jiemɔ osɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni okɛwo ebinuu Eleazar.
Aaron baagbo yɛ jɛi.” Ni Mose fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Amɛkwɔ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni Mose jie osɔfoyeli atadei lɛ yɛ Aaron he, ni ekɛwo Aaron binuu Eleazar.
Ni Aaron gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni Mose kɛ Eleazar kpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israel asafo tso muu lɛ fɛɛ na akɛ Aaron eje jeŋ lɛ, amɛfo Aaron gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Israelbii ye Kanaanbii anɔ kunim Be ni Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni gbɛi ji Arad lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ etsɔ̃ Atarim gbɛ kɛmiiba lɛ, efã ta kɛtee eyatua Israelbii lɛ, ni eŋɔ mɛi komɛi nom, Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wo Yehowa shi, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ; “Kɛji ooohã wɔye gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaakpãtã amɛmaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu.” Yehowa bo Israelbii lɛ atoi, ni ehã amɛye Kanaanbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛkpãtã Kanaanbii amaji lɛ ahiɛ butubutu, ni amɛwo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Horma (eshishi ji niihiɛkpãtãmɔ.)
Akɔɔble onufu lɛ Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛtsɔ̃ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naagbɛ, he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Akaba Ble lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛtswa Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛfɔ̃.
Nyiɛmɔ lɛ je Israelbii lɛ atsine yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba kwraa po nyɛjie wɔ yɛ Ijipt koni wɔbagboi yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ nɛɛ?
Niyenii bɛ lɛ, nu hu bɛ; niyenii gbonyogbonyo nɛɛ yeli eje wɔtsine.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã onufui ni anaa jaraa babote Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii gboi.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ba Mose ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔfee esha akɛ wɔwie wɔshi Yehowa kɛ bo fɛɛ.
Kpa Yehowa fai ohã wɔ koni ejie onufui nɛɛ kɛje wɔteŋ.” Mose kpa fai lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Okɛ dade ni kpɛlɛɔ afee onufu ni okɛtsotsoro tso bloblo nɔ, ni okɛma shi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, kɛji ewo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ onufu lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ lɛ, eyi baana wala.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ akɔɔble fee onufu, ni ekɛtsotsoro tso bloblo nɔ ni ekɛma shi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni onufui lɛ eko ekɔ̃ lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɔ akɔɔble onufu lɛ, ni eyi naa wala.
Israelbii lɛ yashɛ Moabbii ajɔɔ lɛ mli Israelbii lɛ fã ekoŋŋ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Obot.
Kɛjɛ Obot lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa ni kã Moabbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛfã ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Zered Jɔɔ lɛ mli; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yato shi yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ŋa kplanaa ni kã shi aahu kɛyaboteɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ.
Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii kɛ Amorbii lɛ ahusu.
No hewɔ lɛ, aŋmã yɛ Yehowa Tai Ahe Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Wɔtsɔ̃ Waheb yɛ Sufa, kɛ Arnon Faa lɛ jɔi lɛ amli, kɛ gɔji lɛ hu ni amɛjɔi lɛ yaa kɛyashɛɔ Ar maŋ lɛ shikãmɔhe lɛ anɔ ni ji Moab kpokpai lɛ ahusu lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kooyigbɛ ni amɛyato shi yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Nubuianaa, he ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ akɛ, “Buamɔ maŋbii lɛ anaa, ni mahã amɛ nu koni amɛnu” lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ: “Nubu, hã nu atue, ni wɔɔɔbɔ oshe kɛhere lɛ atuu!
Nubu ni lumɛi lɛ tsa, ni maŋ abladei je kɛ amɛtsii kɛ amɛdɛhiɛmɔ tsei lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ shi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛtee Matana, ni be ni amɛfã yɛ jɛi hu lɛ amɛtee Nahaliel, ni amɛjɛ Nahaliel kɛtee Bamot.
Kɛjɛ Bamot lɛ amɛtee jɔɔ lɛ ni kã Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ mli yɛ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi.
Kɛjɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ yiteŋ lɛ anaa shiaŋa kplanaa lɛ.
Aye Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Maŋtsɛ Og fɛɛ nɔ kunim Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ŋɔ̃ɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho kɛkɛ.
Wɔgbaŋ ŋmɔ ko loo waintrom ko mli lɛ, wɔnuŋ nubui lɛ amli nu lɛ eko hu.
Maŋtsɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku kɛyaashi wɔɔɔfo mli yɛ okpokpai lɛ anɔ.” Shi Maŋtsɛ Sihon ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ akɛ Israelbii lɛ atsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebua etabilɔi anaa, ni efã ta kɛyanina Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yahaz ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ wu.
Shi Israelbii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Amorbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashwie Yabok Faa lɛ naa, ni ji Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ Amonbii lɛ etswa gbogboi yɛ amɛhusu lɛ naa.
Ni Israelbii lɛ shɔ̃ Amorbii amaŋ ni ji Heshbon lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛhi mli.
Heshbon ji Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon lɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ.
Sihon kɛ tsutsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ wu ni eshɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ kɛbashi Arnon Faa lɛ naa.
No hewɔ ni alaa akɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa Heshbon, nyɛhãa atswaa; asaa atswa Maŋtsɛ Sihon maŋ lɛ ama shi.
Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ, Heshbon maŋ nɛɛ mli Sihon tabilɔi fã kɛjɛ oookɛɛ la.
Kɛyakpãtã Moab Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ kɛ Arnon gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo, bo Moab!
Nyɛgbe nyɛjeŋ naa, nyɛ Kemosh jalɔi.
Ehã ebihii lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi, ni ebiyei lɛ hu etsɔ̃mɔ Amor Maŋtsɛ Sihon nomii.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshwiei ahiɛ ekpãtã kɛjɛ Heshbon aahu kɛyashwie Dibon tɔ̃ɔ; kɛjɛ Nashim kɛtee Nofa yɛ Medeba masɛi.” Bɔ ni fee ni Israelbii lɛ hi Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ.
Mose tsu mɛi ni amɛtee amɛyasara Yazer maŋ lɛ amɛba; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ yatua maŋ lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii ni yɔɔ jɛi momo sa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ dɔ amɛyi, ni amɛyi Bashan gbɛ.
Bashan maŋtsɛ Og fã ta, lɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu yɛ Edrei.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kaashe lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ miwo odɛ̃ŋ.
Obaaye enɔ kunim, koni ofee lɛ bɔ ni ofee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ye lumɔ yɛ Heshbon lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ gbe Maŋtsɛ Og kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni ashiii gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ; ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi nɔ.
Moab Maŋtsɛ tsu ayatsɛ Balaam abahã lɛ Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee ni kã Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, ena enu nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ efee Amorbii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayifalɛ hu; ni no hewɔ lɛ, lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ she gbeyei naakpa.
Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi mɔ Moabbii lɛ.
Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ Midian maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ataamɛi, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni baa kɛ ta nɛɛ baakpãtã nibii ni yɔɔ wɔkpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ tsina kpeɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak tsu bɔfoi akɛ amɛya Petor ni kã Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ Amawo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ koni amɛyakpee Balaam, Beor bi lɛ amɛbahã lɛ.
Wiemɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛyahã Balaam ji, “Naa, mɛi komɛi, jaku muu, efã kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Ni miwieɔ nɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛ biɛ amɛtã, mihiɛ tua amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ba nɔŋŋ, shi amɛyi fa fe wɔ, koni obalomɔ amɛ ohã mi akɛ aleenɔ minine aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ koni mashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lo.
Mile akɛ kɛji ojɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji olomɔ mɔ ko hu lɛ, loomɔ baa mɔ lɛ nɔ.” Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Midian onukpai lɛ yi mli amɛtee; ni amɛhiɛ klamɔ nyɔmɔwoo shika kɛtee.
Be ni amɛyashɛ Balaam ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ wiemɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Balak kɛtsu amɛ lɛ hã lɛ.
Balaam kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ lɛ mibaba mibakɛɛ nyɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Moab onukpai lɛ kɛ Balaam hi shi gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ba Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hii yɔɔ oŋɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?” Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, tsu amɛ miŋɔ̃ɔ akɛ maŋ muu ko, ni jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba, ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ mibalomɔ amɛ mihã lɛ koni enyɛ amɛ ekɛwu, ni eshwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Okɛ bɔfoi lɛ akaya tsɛmɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ okalomɔ nakai mɛi lɛ hu, ejaakɛ mɛi ni mijɔɔ amɛ ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balaam tee Balak bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa nyɛmaŋ.
Yehowa ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ehãaa mi akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aya.” Kɛkɛ ni Moab onukpai lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba Balak ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Balaam ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eba otsɛmɔ lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ Balak saa tsu bɔfoi ni ahiɛ tsii, asaŋ ni amɛyi fa fe tsutsubii lɛ; ni amɛtee Balaam ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, ni okahã nɔ ko nɔ ko miitsi bo tsɛmɔ lɛ baa gbɛ!
Ejaakɛ mibawo ohiɛ nyam babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ mi lɛ, mibafee; no hewɔ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba koni obalomɔ mɛi ni ebaje nɛɛ ohã mi kɛkɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ kɛ kpo obɔ̃ tete eke mi po, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔ sɛɛ ni mafee nɔ ko ni fe aloo nɔ ko ni shɛɛɛ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ mi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, nyɛ hu, nyɛwɔa biɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ tamɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ koni mabo nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ toi.” Nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Kɛji tsɛmɔ kɛkɛ hii nɛɛ ba bo tsɛmɔ lɛ, saamɔ ohe koni okɛ amɛ aya; shi moŋ nɔ pɛ ni makɛɛ bo lɛ no ofee.” No hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Balaam wo eteji nɔ nii, ni ekɛ Moab onukpai lɛ yi mli ni amɛtee.
Balaam kɛ eteji lɛ Shi Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la akɛ Balaam miiya tsɛmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Balaam ta eteji lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ni eblahii enyɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ badamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ koni esa enaa.
Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni egbala eklante ehiɛ edɛŋ lɛ, ewi gbɛ lɛ, ni eyanyiɛ ŋa lɛ mli.
Balaam yi teji lɛ koni ekɛdɔ eyi kɛba gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tee ni eyadamɔ gbɛ leleoo ko ni kã waintromi ateŋ lɛ nɔ; gbogbo yɛ gbɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni emia Balaam nane ekpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi teji lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ saa etsi kɛtee ehiɛ, ni eyasa Balaam naa yɛ nififiaŋ he ko, he ni gbɛ bɛ ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he kɛyaa ninejurɔgbɛ loo abɛkugbɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni teji lɛ na Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, eho ebu shi.
Balaam mli wo la ni ebɔ̃i teji lɛ yii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã teji lɛ wie, ni ebi Balaam akɛ, “Mɛni mifee bo hewɔ ni oyi mi shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ?” Balaam here teji lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ oofee mi buulu.
Eji mihiɛ klante kulɛ benɛ migbe bo momo.” Teji lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ani jeee mi ji oteji ni otaa minɔ daa nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ?
Ani mifee bo nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã lo?” Balaam jie naa akɛ, “Dabida!” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gbele Balaam hiŋmɛii, ni ena Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛ eklante ni egbala ehiɛ edɛŋ.
Balaam mã eyi shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni oyi oteji lɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛɛ?
Naa, miba koni mibasa onaa, ejaakɛ nyiɛmɔ nɔ ni onyiɛ nɛɛ ejaaa yɛ mihiɛ.
Teji lɛ na mi, ni ewi ehe kɛje mihiɛ shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ.
Ewiii ehe kɛjeee mihiɛ kulɛ, benɛ migbe bo momo, ni mihere teji lɛ kɛkɛ yiwala.” Balaam hã Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mifee esha; ejaakɛ mileee kwraa akɛ oba oosa minaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji minyiɛmɔ nɛɛ esaaa ohiɛ lɛ, maku misɛɛ mɔ.” Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Okɛ hii lɛ aya kɛkɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni mikɛ bo aaawie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ owie.” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Balak bɔfoi lɛ tsa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee.
Maŋtsɛ Balak here Balaam atuu Be ni Balak nu akɛ Balaam miiba etsɛmɔ lɛ, eyi mli kɛtee lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ Ar, ni ji Moabbii amaŋ ko ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ naa lɛ mli.
Arnon Faa nɛɛ ji Moabbii ahusu.
Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ani jeee tsu mitsu kpɛkpɛ̃ɛkpɛ akɛ abatsɛ bo kɛba?
Mɛɛba obaaa klɛŋklɛŋ tsɛmɔ lɛ?
Ani osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ bo majuro bɔ ni sa lo?” Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Naa mi; miba.
Shi moŋ, mɛɛ hewalɛ miyɔɔ?
Wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛbaawo minaa lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mawie.” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛ Balak shwie nɔ kɛba maŋ ni gbɛi ji Huzot lɛ mli; ni Balak kɛ tsinai kɛ toi shã afɔle yɛ jɛi, ni ehã ayahã Balaam kɛ onukpai ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ afɔleshãa loo lɛ eko.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Balak tsɛ Balaam fata ehe, ni amɛkwɔ Baal Gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ; ni Balaam jɛ jɛi ni ena Israelbii asafo muu lɛ ayifalɛ.
Balaam klɛŋklɛŋ gbalɛ Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mãamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo.” Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ ni lɛ kɛ Balaam shã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Yaadamɔ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni maya akɛ aleee nɔ mikɛ Yehowa aaakpe lo.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ, mibaba mibakɛɛ bo.” Kɛkɛ ni eyi mli etee gɔŋ kpataa ko nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Balaam kpe, ni Balaam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Mimamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo, ni mishã tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni hu kome yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.” Ni Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ wo Balaam naa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ.” Be ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba Balak ŋɔɔ lɛ, Balak kɛ Moab lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔi gbaa ekɛɛ, “Moab Maŋtsɛ Balak yaŋɔ mi kɛjɛ Siria, yɛ bokã gɔji lɛ anɔ ekɛɛ: ‘Ba, baalomɔ Yakob; Baalomɔ Israelbii ohã mi!’ Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ malomɔ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔko lɛ hu?
Te aaafe tɛŋŋ mashwe musu mahã mɔ ko be ni Yehowa ekɛko nakai?
Tɛsai ayiteŋ mijɛ mina amɛ; ni gɔŋkpɔi anɔ mijɛ mikwɛ amɛ akɛ maŋ ni amɛkome too amɛyɔɔ.
Amɛle akɛ ajɔɔ amɛ fe maji fɛɛ.
Israel shwiei ayikulɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu, Amɛyi fa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane.
Hã magbo jalɔi agbele koni minaagbee atamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Te okɛ mi yeɔ tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?
Miyaŋɔ bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, shi jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ nɛɛ!” Balaam here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ani esaaa akɛ makwɛ jogbaŋŋ koni mawie nɔ ni Yehowa kɛwo minaa lɛ?” Balaam gbalɛ ni ji Enyɔ Agbɛnɛ Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ba ni wɔtee he kroko, he ni ooona Israelbii lɛ yɛ.
Obaana amɛfã ko kɛkɛ; onaŋ amɛ fɛɛ; koni olomɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi.” Balak kɛ Balaam tee Zofim ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ, ni eyamãmɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ jɛi, ni ekɛ tsinanuu komekome kɛ ojwɛni hu komekome shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Baadamɔ biɛ yɛ oshãa afɔle lɛ he, koni matsi kɛya hiɛ fioo koni mikɛ Yehowa ayakpe.” Yehowa kɛ Balaam kpe, ni ekɛ wiemɔ wo enaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ kɛya Balak ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ bo lɛ.” Ni Balaam ku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebanina Balak kɛ Moab onukpai lɛ fɛɛ damɔ Balak shãa afɔle lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Balak bi Balaam akɛ, “Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ?” Balaam wo egbee nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi, Balak, ni obo mi toi; Zipor binuu, feemɔ toi ohã mi.
Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ni eeemale, aloo gbɔmɔ ni eeeshwa ehe yɛ nɔ ni efee hewɔ.
Mɛni ekɛɛ dã ni efeee; aloo ewo ehe shi ni eyeee nɔ?
Naa, jɔɔmɔ efã mi akɛ mijɔɔ; Ena ejɔɔ amɛ momo, ni minyɛŋ hiɛ matsake Minaaa akɛ osharã ko basharã Israel, aloo Israel he baajara lɛ.
Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ yɛ; lɛ amɛbɔɔ oshe amɛhãa akɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie amɛ kɛje Ijipt; amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he wa oookɛɛ wuo.
Ŋkunyaa ko nyɛŋ Israel, ni klamɔ ko hu mɔŋ lɛ.
Odase ni abaaye yɛ Israel he ji akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ.’ Naa, Israel teɔ shi tamɔ jata yoo; ni ewoɔ ehe nɔ tamɔ jata nuu.
Ebuuu shi, ja egbe ni eye, ni enu mɛi ni egbegbee alá etã dã.” Kɛkɛ ni Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Kaalomɔ amɛ, ni kaajɔɔ amɛ hu.” Shi Balaam here Balak nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no mibafee lo?” Balaam gbalɛ ni ji Etɛ̃ lɛ Balak kɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ hã wɔya he kroko.
Eko lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaana he tsui, ni eeeŋmɛ bo gbɛ akɛ olomɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ jɛi ohã mi.” Ni Balak kɛ Balaam shwie nɔ kɛtee Poer Gɔŋ ni kwɛɔ shiaŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ lɛ yiteŋ.
Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mãamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi kpawo yɛ biɛ ohã mi; ni obahã mi tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo yɛ biɛ.” Balak fee nɔ ni Balaam kɛɛ lɛ lɛ; ni Balak kɛ tsinanuu kɛ ojwɛni shã afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Shi Balaam eyɔse akɛ Yehowa suɔmɔ naa ji akɛ ejɔɔ Israelbii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, eyaaa tamɔ bei krokomɛi lɛ akɛ eyaatao okadii.
Shi moŋ ewo ehiɛ nɔ, ni ekwɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Ena Israelbii lɛ ni amɛjwere shi yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ bayi Balaam nɔ, ni ewo enaa nɔ, ni egba ekɛɛ akɛ, “Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, ninaa nɛ, nuu ninalɔ lɛ ninaa nɛ, mɔ ni nuɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ ni enaa ninaa ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, mɔ ni buɔ shi, shi enaa nii lɛ.
Kwɛ bɔ ni Israel bui lɛ yɔɔ fɛo!
Israel shihilɛhei amli yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ faa he jɔi ni elɛɛ shi oookɛɛ faa toi abɔi, tamɔ tsei fɛɛfɛji ni Yehowa tɛo oookɛɛ faa toi tsenedrutsei.
Nu aaajɛ onubui amli, Israel, ashwie shi ni oshwiei kɛaadu nii.
Omaŋtsɛ lɛ baaje agbo fe Maŋtsɛ Agag, ni aaawo emaŋtsɛyeli nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ yajie amɛ yɛ Ijipt, ni amɛhe wa tamɔ wuo.
Amɛbaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ amaji anɔ, ni amɛbaajwara amɛwui wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛgãii lɛ baatsɛ̃rɛ amɛ.
Edɛke shi; ebu shi tamɔ jata, tamɔ jatayoo; namɔ aaatsiɛ lɛ?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɔɔ bo lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lomɔɔ bo lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ.” Balak kɛ mlifu tswa edɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ Balaam akɛ, “Miyakpee bo kɛba koni obalomɔ mihenyɛlɔi ohã mi lɛ, jɔɔmɔ sɔŋŋ moŋ ojɔɔ amɛ shii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kuu osɛɛ ni oya omaŋ.
Mito miyiŋ akɛ majuro bo; shi Yehowa etsi juromɔ ni majuro bo lɛ naa.” Balaam kɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ obɔfoi ni otsu amɛ miŋɔɔ lɛ tete akɛ, ‘Naa, kɛji Balak ŋɔ̃ ewe lɛ mli shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi tsu obɔ̃ tete eke mi lɛ, minyɛŋ maje Yehowa wiemɔ sɛɛ koni mato miyiŋ mafee nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko.
Nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ lɛ no nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mawie.’ ” Balaam naagbee gbalɛ Balaam tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Balak akɛ, “Mi lɛ miiya mimaŋ, shi dani mashwie nɔ lɛ, mibatswa bo adafi yɛ nɔ ni Israel maŋ nɛɛ baafee omaŋ lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko he.” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam wo enaa nɔ, ni ebɔ̃i gbaa ekɛɛ, “Balaam, Beor binuu lɛ, ninaa nɛ.
Nɔ ni mɔ ni agbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Mɔ ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ, ni eleɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ yiŋtoi lɛ, ni Ofe lɛ jieɔ ninai etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, ni ehiɛ bu shi, shi enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ: Miina Israel, shi jeee bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ minaa lɛ, shi eyɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ŋulami ko baaje yɛ Yakob, Maŋtsɛ tso ko baate shi yɛ Israel, ni ebaatswia Moab hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anii, ni ebaaye Set shwiei lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Ebaaye Edom nɔ, ni eeeye Seir hu nɔ, eeeye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ hu anɔ ni eeeŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ be mli ni Israel yeɔ kunim lɛ.
Israel jaku baanaanaa amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ, ni eeekpãtã mɛi ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ amli lɛ ahiɛ.’ ” Agbɛnɛ Balaam na Amalekbii lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ gbalɛ lɛ kɛtee amɛnɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Amalek ji majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ; shi naagbee mli aahu lɛ, ehiɛ baakpãtã kwraa.” Balaam na Kenbii lɛ hu yɛ ninaa lɛ mli, ni egba yɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe tamɔ loofɔlɔ tsu ni mã tɛsaa nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ Kenbii ahiɛ baakpãtã ni etsɛŋ ni Asiria aaaŋɔ̃ bo nom.” Balaam tee nɔ ni egba gbalɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, namɔ aaahi walaŋ, ni ena be ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee nii nɛɛ?
Akɛ ta lɛji aaajɛ Kipro aba ni aaabaye Asiria kɛ Eber nɔ.
Shi tatsɛmɛi nɛɛ hu ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛya naanɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Balaam yi mli, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ, ni Balak hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee ejɛɛhe.
Israelbii lɛ ashihilɛ yɛ Peor kpokpai anɔ Be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ Shitim, Akasia tso Jɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ, amɛhii lɛ kɛ Moab yei lɛ bɔ̃i ajwamãŋbɔɔ.
Moab yei lɛ kpeɔ Israelhii lɛ kɛyaa hei ni amɛshãa afɔlei amɛkɛhãa amɛmaŋ wɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni Israelhii lɛ yayeɔ afɔleshãa niyenii lɛ eko, ni amɛjaa Moabbii lɛ awɔji lɛ hu.
Ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Peor lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli wo la, ni ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ̃ɔmɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ koni agbe amɛ shwane ketekete yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ; bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa mli ni efu Israel fe nine lɛ sɛɛ afo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekutso lɛ mli nuu fɛɛ nuu ni etsɔ̃ ehe jemawɔŋ Peor jalɔ lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ ateŋ nuu ko tee eyakpala Midianyoo ko ni ekɛ lɛ tee ebuu lɛ mli yɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, be mli ni Mose kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ.
Be ni Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar binuu Finehas na nifeemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ete shi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, ni eyakɔ akplɔ ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni etiu Israelnyo lɛ kɛtee buu lɛ mli, ni eyadu Israelnyo lɛ kɛ Midianyoo lɛ fɛɛ akplɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amɛmli kɛyaje kpo.
Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni gbele hela lɛ ni miikpãtã Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Shi nakai be mli lɛ hela lɛ egbe mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ momo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mihe awuŋã ni Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar binuu Finehas ye etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ, ekɛku mimli ni efu Israelbii lɛ anaa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mipleneee amɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Finehas akɛ, ‘Miŋɔ̃ mihejɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mihã lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni mijɔɔ osɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ mihã lɛ kɛ eshwiei kɛmiiya naanɔ, ejaakɛ eye awuŋã yɛ mi, mihewɔ, ni ehã akɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni maŋ lɛ tɔ̃ lɛ efa amɛ.’ ” Israelnyo lɛ ni agbe lɛ kɛ Midianyoo lɛ, egbɛi ji Zimri; ni etsɛ ji Salu, Simeonbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ eko mli onukpa ni.
Ni Midianyoo lɛ ni agbe lɛ gbɛi ji Kozbi; etsɛ gbɛi ji Zur, Midianbii awekui lɛ eko mli onukpa ni.
Yehowa fã Mose akɛ, “Nyɛfãa ta kɛyatuaa Midianbii lɛ koni nyɛplene amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛfee nyɛ efɔŋ kɛ lakamɔ ni amɛlaka nyɛ yɛ jemawɔŋ Peor lɛ jamɔ sane lɛ mli, agbɛnɛ amɛlaka nyɛ yɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Midian onukpa ko biyoo Kozbi sane lɛ mli.
Lɛ ji Midianyoo lɛ ni agbe lɛ yɛ gbele hela gbi lɛ nɔ yɛ Peor lɛ.”
Maŋbii akanemɔ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ Gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Aaron binuu Eleazar akɛ, “Nyɛkanea Israelbii asafo muu lɛ mli hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa ayikulɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa, no ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshɛ tayaa yɛ Israel lɛ.” Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko akɛ, “Nyɛkanea maŋbii lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa”, bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ efee lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ni shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ayikulɛ baa nɛ: Ruben ni ji Yakob kromɔbi lɛ shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai ji Hanokwe kɛ Paluwe, kɛ Hezronwe kɛ Karmiwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Rubenbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛteŋ hii ni akane lɛ anaa shɛ akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Palu bi ji Eliab, ni Eliab bihii ji Nemuel kɛ Datan kɛ Abiram.
Datan kɛ Abiram nɛɛ ji hii komɛi ni maŋbii lɛ hala kɛjɛ asafo lɛ mli, ni amɛtse Mose kɛ Aaron hiɛ atua, ni asaŋ amɛyafata Kora sɛɛbii lɛ ahe kɛte shi amɛshi Yehowa lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ gba ni emĩ amɛ kɛ Kora fɛɛ kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ hu, be ni la lɛ je ni eshã hii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ koni akɛto okadi lɛ.
Shi moŋ Kora diɛŋtsɛ musuŋbihii lɛ gboiii.
Simeon akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Nemuelwe kɛ Yaminwe kɛ Yakinwe, kɛ Zerawe kɛ Shaulwe, Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Simeonbii awekui lɛ; ni amɛyikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Gad shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Zefonwe kɛ Hagiwe kɛ Shuniwe, kɛ Ozniwe kɛ Eriwe, kɛ Arodwe kɛ Areliwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Gadbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛyibɔ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Yuda bihii ji Er kɛ Onan; shi Er kɛ Onan gboi yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yuda shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Shelawe kɛ Perezwe.
Perezwe hiɛ Hezronwe kɛ Hamulwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yudabii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Isakar shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Tolawe kɛ Puvawe, kɛ Yashubwe kɛ Shimronwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Isakarbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli bii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai etɛ̃.
Zebulon shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Seredwe kɛ Elonwe kɛ Yahleelwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Zebulonbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Yosef shwiei lɛ akutsei ji Manase kɛ Efraim ni ji ebihii enyɔ lɛ.
Manase shwiei lɛ nɛ: Manase fɔ Makir, ni Makir hu fɔ Gilead.
Shĩai ni jɛ Gilead mli lɛ ji Yezerwe kɛ Helekwe, kɛ Asrielwe kɛ Shekemwe, kɛ Shemidawe kɛ Heferwe.
Hefer bi ji Zelofehad, shi Zelofehad fɔɔɔ bihii fe yei sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efɔ; ni Zelofehad biyei lɛ agbɛii ji Mahala kɛ Noa, kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Tirza.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Manasebii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai kpawo.
Efraim shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Shutelawe kɛ Bekerwe kɛ Tahanwe, kɛ Eranwe ni jɛ Shutelawe lɛ mli lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Efraimbii lɛ awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Yosef shwiei lɛ ashĩai ji shĩai nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Benyamin shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Belawe kɛ Ashbelwe kɛ Ahiramwe, kɛ Shefufamwe kɛ Hufamwe, kɛ Ardwe kɛ Naamanwe ni amɛjɛ Belawe mli lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Benyaminbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Dan shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩa lɛ ji Shuhamwe, ni emli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Asher shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Imnawe kɛ Ishwiwe kɛ Beriawe.
Beriawe kɔkrɔɔ hiɛ Heberwe kɛ Malkielwe.
Asher fɔ biyoo ni egbɛi ji Sera.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Asherbii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
Naftali shwiei lɛ akutso lɛ mli shĩai lɛ ji Yahzeelwe kɛ Guniwe, kɛ Yerwe kɛ Shilemwe.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Naftalibii awekui lɛ, ni amɛmli hii ni akane lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ kɛ ohai ejwɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii ni akane fɛɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ ekome kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Jaa shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã akutsei lɛ yɛ amɛmli gbɔmɛi lɛ ayikulɛ naa.” Mɛi ni yi fa lɛ, ohã amɛ shikpɔŋ agbo; ni mɛi ni yi faaa lɛ ana shikpɔŋ bibioo.
Akutso fɛɛ akutso ana shikpɔŋ yɛ emlibii lɛ ayikulɛ naa.
Shi moŋ afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ akutsei lɛ ashikwɛ̃ɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛii anaa, shĩa fɛɛ shĩa baana egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Mɛi ni yi fa kɛ mɛi ni yi faaa fɛɛ lɛ, afɔ oshiki koni akɛja amɛgbɛfaŋnii lɛ ahã amɛ.
Yɛ Levi shwiei agbɛfaŋ lɛ, amɛshĩai wuji ni akane lɛ amɛmli bii ji Gershonwe kɛ Kohatwe kɛ Merariwe.
Shĩai bibii ni jɛ ewuji nɛɛ amli lɛ ji Libniwe kɛ Hebronwe kɛ Maheliwe kɛ Mushiwe kɛ Korawe.
Kohat fɔ Amram, mɔ ni kɛ Levi biyoo Yokebed, mɔ ni efɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, hi shi akɛ eŋa lɛ.
Amran kɛ Yokebed fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo Miriam.
Ni Aaron fɔ Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Shi Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi be ni amɛkɛ la ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yashã afɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.
Levibii lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ ni akane, ni ji mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ nyɔŋ kome kɛyaa lɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Akaneee Levibii ayikulɛ nɛɛ ashiii Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛ Levibii lɛ ahãaa amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ayikulɛ nɛɛ ji nɔ ni Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar na be ni amɛkane Israelbii lɛ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.
Mɛi abɔ ni Mose kɛ Aaron kane be ni amɛkane Israelbii lɛ ayikulɛ yɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, ateŋ mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ mɛi ni akane ehee nɛɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe akɛ gboimɔ amɛaagboi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni shwɛ ji Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛkɛ.
Zelofehad biyei lɛ Zelofehad biyei enumɔ ni amɛgbɛii ji Mahela kɛ Noa kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Tirza ni amɛ ji Hefer nabii kɛ Gilead nanakansowai kɛ Makir nanashishiui, ni asaŋ amɛ ji Manase nanadadaoi kɛ Yosef hu nanakɔkrɔdɔi lɛ, ho damɔ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsɛ Zelofehad gbo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; efataaa Kora kɛ esɛɛbii ni te shi amɛshi Yehowa lɛ ahe.
Egbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha hewɔ ni efɔɔɔ bihii.
Mɛɛba ni agbeɔ wɔtsɛ gbɛi yɛ etsɛmɛi awe lɛ mli?
Binuu ni enaaa lɛ hewɔŋ lo?
Nyɛhãa wɔ, wɔ hu wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ wɔtsɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ!” Mose kɛ Zelofehad biyei lɛ asane lɛ yafɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Nɔ ni Zelofehad biyei lɛ biɔ lɛ eja.
Hã amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛtsɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛ, amɛye amɛtsɛ gboshinii.
Okɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nuu ko gbo ni ebɛ binuu lɛ, no lɛ ebiyoo aye egboshinii.
Kɛji ebɛ biyoo lɛ, no lɛ enyɛmimɛi hii aye egboshinii.
Kɛji ebɛ nyɛmimɛi hii hu lɛ, etsɛ nyɛmimɛi hii aye egboshinii.
Kɛji etsɛ bɛ nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ, no lɛ ewekunyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ yɛ weku mli aye egboshinii lɛ.
Enɛ ji mla ni akã shi ahã Israelbii bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mifã bo lɛ.” Aŋɔ Yoshua koni eye Mose sɛɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kwɔɔ Abarim Gɔŋ nɛɛ kɛya eyiteŋ koni okwɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛji okwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ogbe naa lɛ, bo hu obaagbo tamɔ onyɛmi Aaron, ejaakɛ nyɛku migbee nɔ yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni maŋ muu lɛ wie amɛshi mi, ni kulɛ sa akɛ nyɛhã amɛna mihewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ kpele lɛ, koni amɛshe mi gbeyei yɛ Meriba lɛ, nyɛfeee nakai.” (Meriba nɛɛ ji nu hiŋmɛi ni tue hã Israelbii lɛ yɛ Kadesh yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.)
Mose kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Yehowa, bɔɔnii fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ, fãa nuu hiɛnyiɛlɔ ohã maŋ lɛ, mɔ ni baanyɛ amɛnɔ ekwɛ, asaŋ ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛya ta kɛba bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa asafo lɛ akatsɔ̃ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ.” Yehowa hã Mose hetoo akɛ, “Ŋɔ̃ɔ Nun binuu Yoshua lɛ, nuu hiɛwalɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ emli lɛ koni okɛ oniji ashwie enɔ, ni okɛ lɛ adamɔ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni otu nitsumɔ lɛ owo edɛŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni baaye osɛɛ; asaŋ ni ohã lɛ hewalɛ ni oyɔɔ lɛ eko bɔ ni afee ni Israelbii asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ abo lɛ toi.
Ebo Osɔfo Eleazar toi be fɛɛ be.
Eya eŋɔ̃ɔ, ni ebaafɔ̃ Urim lɛ koni ekɛbi mi nii ehã lɛ yɛ mihiɛ.
Lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ ayaakɛbaa mli lɛ, amɛbo Osɔfo Eleazar wiemɔ toi.” Mose fee nɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ efee lɛ.
Eŋɔ Yoshua ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ, ni etu nitsumɔ lɛ ewo edɛŋ akɛ mɔ ni baaye esɛɛ taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Afɔlei ni ashãa daa gbi Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛhiɛ ahi minikeenii ni ji niyenii afɔle ni akɛ la shãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ mi lɛ nɔ koni amɛkɛbahã mi kɛji afɔle hãmɔ be shɛ lɛ.
“Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ ahã gwantɛŋbii enyɔ ni eye afiafi asaŋ ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe koni akɛshã afɔle ahã mi.
Oshã gwantɛŋbi kome leebi, ni oshã ekome hu gbɛkɛnaashi.
Akɛ ŋmãa kilo kome ni akɛ fɔ kpakpa ni ashi mli lita kome ekpɔtɔ afata he.
Daa gbi afɔle ni ashã ji enɛ tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ la shã be ni ayɔɔ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Enɛ ji niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Dãa afɔle lita kome afata gwantɛŋbi kome he, koni ofɔse dãa lɛ oshwie shi yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ okɛhã Yehowa.
Gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ oshã gwantɛŋbi kome lɛ hu; ni no hu akɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle afata he tamɔ leebi nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ koni efee afɔle ni ashãa ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa.” Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ afɔle “Daa Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ okɛ gwantɛŋi enyɔ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛhe niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu kiloi enyɔ ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ abashã afɔle; dãa afɔle hu afata he.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ afɔle nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe dãa afɔle lɛ.” Nyɔŋ hee klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ afɔle “Nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛshãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashãa.
Niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: tsinanuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ, ni gwantɛŋbi kome lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Shãa afɔlei nɛɛ eji niyenii afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Yɛ dãa afɔle lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ tsinanuu kome he dãa ji wain litai enyɔ; ojwɛni kome he dãa ji wain lita kome kɛ fã; ni gwantɛŋbi he dãa ji wain lita kome.
Afi mli nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, afɔle ni ashã lɛ he mla ji enɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle akɛhã Yehowa; dani soro daa gbi afɔle kɛ ehe dãa afɔle ni sa akɛ ashã lɛ hu.” Mã akpiti aboloo gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ afɔle “Afi lɛŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ji Yehowa Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbijurɔ ni.
Aye aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã kɛjɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Gbijurɔ nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ akpe kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni aja Yehowa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔlei ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: tsinanuu lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni kome lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ, ni gwantɛŋbi kome lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too kpakpo kome hu ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi leebi afɔle lɛ hu.
Nyɛfea nakai daa gbi kɛyashi gbii kpawo; niyenii afɔle ni, ni ejeɔ ŋma ewoɔ Yehowa.
Soro no, ni soro daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ hu.
Ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa Yehowa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ.” Ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ afɔle “Klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ gbijurɔyeli lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛkɛ ŋmaaŋmɔŋ ni nyɛku baa ni nyɛkɛbaashã afɔle nyɛkɛhã Yehowa lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa.
Gbi lɛ akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa; shi nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii enyɔ kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi lɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: tsinanuu kome he niyenii afee mamu kiloi etɛ̃; ni ojwɛni kome he niyenii afee mamu kiloi enyɔ, ni gwantɛŋbi kome he niyenii afee mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too kpakpo kome hu ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi afɔle ni kã shi lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔle lɛ hu pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa koni kpa ko kpa ko akahi afɔlei lɛ ahe.”
Afi shishijee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ afɔle Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa Yehowa.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛtɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ kpãmɔ gbi ni; ni nyɛkɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashãa shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi nɛɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: tsinanuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ; ni gwantɛŋbii kpawo lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã nyɔŋ hee shãa afɔle kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ hu.
Eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe dãa afɔle bɔ ni afo aŋmɛ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Niyenii afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa ni.
Kpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ afɔle “Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa.
Nyɛhia ŋmãa, ni nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ gbi lɛ nɔ; shi nyɛkɛ tsina oblanyo kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Kooloi lɛ ahe niyenii afɔle hu ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ji enɛ: tsinanuu lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃, ni ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ; ni gwantɛŋbii kpawo lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko lɛ mamu kilo komekome.
Asaŋ no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle koni akɛkpãtã ahã maŋ lɛ.
Ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ hu kɛ ehe dãa afɔlei lɛ.
Asesei agbijurɔyeli lɛ he afɔle “Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛjaa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; shi nyɛyea gbijurɔ nyɛhãa mi gbii kpawo.
Klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsinai oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle ni ji ŋmãa mamu ni akɛ fɔ ekpɔtɔ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ahe nɛ: tsinanuu kome lɛ mamu kiloi etɛ̃; ojwɛni lɛ mamu kiloi enyɔ, ni gwantɛŋ binuu kome lɛ mamu kilo kome.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔle lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsinai oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Ni niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nyɔŋma kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle.
No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii nɛɛhu kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni eye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsinai lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle.
No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔle lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii kpaanyɔ kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni akɛfata tsina bihii lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
No sɛɛ hu akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle.
Ashã daa gbi afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tsina oblahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii enyɔ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle lɛ.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛfata tsinai oblahii lɛ kɛ ojwɛnii lɛ kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha he faikpamɔ afɔle.
No sɛɛ hu ashã daa gbi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkpea kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛjaa; nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko ni wa yɛ nɔ; shi nyɛkɛ tsinanuu kome kɛ ojwɛni kome kɛ gwantɛŋ bihii kpawo ni amɛye afifi ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã shãa afɔle ni jeɔ ŋma woɔ Yehowa.
Niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ ni akɛfata kooloi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko he afee bɔ ni afo afɔ̃ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ too kpakpo kome ashã esha hefaikpamɔ afɔle.
No sɛɛ hu ashã daa shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ ehe niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛhe dãa afɔlei lɛ hu.
“Afɔlei ni nyɛshã nyɛkɛhã Yehowa yɛ nyɛgbii juji ni ato lɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ.
Esoro shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ni nyɛshãa yɛ shiwoo naa loo suɔmɔ naa lɛ.” Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Shiwoo he mlai Mose kɛɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mlai ni Yehowa ewo nɛ: ‘Kɛji mɔ ko wo Yehowa shi, aloo ekã kitã ekɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ekaku shiwoo lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nɔ ni eje enaa ni ewie lɛ ja ena efee nakai.’ ‘Kɛji oblayoo ni eyako gbãlã wo Yehowa shi, aloo ewo shi kɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ, be mli ni eyɔɔ etsɛ we, ni etsɛ nu shi ni oblayoo lɛ ewo lɛ, kɛ nɔfeemɔ ni etsiɔ ehe naa yɛ he lɛ he, ni etsɛ lɛ eteee shi eshiii shiwoo lɛ, no lɛ oblayoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ fĩɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ni etsiɔ ehe naa yɛ he lɛ hu ja eye nɔ.
Shi kɛji gbi nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ tsɛ nu oblayoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ he nɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ebɛ akɛ oblayoo lɛ aaaye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ; ni Yehowa kɛbaafa lɛ ejaakɛ etsɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ.’ ‘Kɛji oblayoo lɛ ewo shi momo dani etee gbãlã, ejwɛŋ he dani ewo shi lɛ jio, esha ehe efee jio, aloo ekã kitã ekɛtsi ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ ni ewu lɛ nu shiwoi lɛ ahe, shi gbi ni enu he lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ekɛɛɛ oblayoo lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ esa akɛ oblayoo lɛ aye eshiwoi lɛ anɔ, ni ehe naa ni etsi lɛ hu fĩɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji gbi nɔ ni yoo wu lɛ na enu shiwoi lɛ ahe lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ efo eshiwoo lɛ kɛ ehe naa ni etsi lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni Yehowa kɛbaafa lɛ.’ ‘Kɛji yoo okulafo loo yoo ni ekɛ ewu teŋ etse ewo shi aloo ekã kitã ekɛtsi ehe naa yɛ nɔ ko feemɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ ja eye nɔ.’ ‘Shi kɛji yoo nɛɛ wo shi aloo ekã kitã kɛtsi ehe naa be mli ni eyɔɔ ewu we lɛ, ni ewu lɛ nu he, shi ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko yɛ he, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, ja yoo nɛɛ ye eshiwoo lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ hu ja eye nɔ.
Shi kɛji ewu lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ shi ni yoo lɛ wo lɛ nɔ, gbi nɔ ni enu he lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ yoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yoo lɛ tsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ egbo, ejaakɛ ewu lɛ etswa efɔ̃, ni Yehowa kɛbaafa yoo lɛ.
Shi fɛɛ shi ni yoo baawo kɛ kitã fɛɛ kitã ni yoo ekã ni ekɛtsi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe naa lɛ, ewu ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɔ nɔ ehãa lɛ aloo etswaa efɔ̃ɔ.
Shi kɛji yoo lɛ wu lɛ nu eŋa lɛ shiwoo lɛ he, ni ekɛɛɛ he nɔ ko kwraa kɛyashi jetsɛre nɔ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ yoo lɛ shiwoo lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni etsi ehe naa yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni esa akɛ yoo lɛ aye nɔ.
Nuu lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ shiwoo lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ gbi ni enu he lɛ, ekɛɛɛ he nɔ ko.
Shi kɛji ete shi fee sɛɛ eshi akɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni sɔ̃ lɛ baatere.’ ” Enɛɛmɛi ji shiwoo he mlai ni Yehowa wo kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ yɛ yoo ni etee gbãlã ni eyɔɔ ewu we kɛ yoo ni eyako gbãlã ni yɔɔ etsɛ we he.
Israel kɛ Midian wu ta Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Yaatɔ Israelbii ahe owele yɛ Midianbii lɛ anɔ.
Oweletɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ obaagbo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ hii lɛ asaa amɛhe ahã tayaa, koni amɛkɛ Midianbii lɛ ayawu, ejaakɛ Yehowa baatɔ ehe owele yɛ amɛnɔ.
Israel akutso fɛɛ akutso ahã tabilɔi akpe koni amɛya ta lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, akutso fɛɛ akutso famɔ tabilɔi akpe ehã, ni ana tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni baaya ayawu ta lɛ.
Mose wo tabilɔi nɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee ta lɛ; amɛkɛ Osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas tee; ehiɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi ni akɛbɔɔ oshe lɛ.
Israelbii kɛ Midianbii lɛ wu tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã Mose lɛ, ni amɛgbe Midian hii fɛɛ; amɛgbe Midian majiatsɛmɛi enumɔ ni ji Evi kɛ Rekem kɛ Zur kɛ Hur kɛ Reba fɛɛ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Amɛgbe Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, hu kɛ klante.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ̃ Midian yei kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ nom, ni amɛha Midianbii atsinai kɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛhe nibii fɛɛ hu; asaŋ amɛmãmɔ Midianbii lɛ amaji kɛ bui ni amɛmãmɔ ni amɛyɔɔ mli fɛɛ anaa la, ni amɛshã.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ ta lɛ mli nibii ni amɛha lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nomii lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ ba, ni amɛkɛba Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Israelbii asafo lɛ ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Tabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ je kpo yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli, ni amɛyakpee tabilɔi lɛ yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Mose mli fu tabilɔi onukpai lɛ ni jɛ ta lɛ kɛba lɛ, ni ji mɛi akpe ku kɛ mɛi oha ku anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛhã yei nɛɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ wala mli kɛbashi benɛ?
Naa, Mɛnɛɛmɛi nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ Balaam ŋaawoo nɔ, ni amɛhã Israelbii tɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni amɛkwa lɛ yɛ Peor sane lɛ mli lɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ ni gbele hela bote Yehowa asafo lɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea gbekɛbii lɛ ateŋ nuu fɛɛ nuu, ni nyɛgbea yei lɛ ateŋ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni le nuu hu; shi gbekɛbii yei fɛɛ ni leko nuu lɛ nyɛshĩa amɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni egbe mɔ ko, aloo eta mɔ ko ni enyɔ gbonyo he lɛ, ehi shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, nyɛ kɛ nomii ni nyɛkɛba lɛ fɛɛ.
Asaŋ mama fɛɛ mama kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ kooloo he wolo loo abotia he tsɔi loo tso fee lɛ nyɛtsuua he.” Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Eleazar kɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ ni tee ta lɛ akɛ, “Mla ni Yehowa wo Mose nɛ: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ sanyaa kɛ sumui, no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yaa la mli lɛ, nyɛkɛwoa la mli koni ehe atse; shi no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ hu eko atsuu he.
Shi nii ni eyaaa la mli lɛ, nyɛkɛ hetsuumɔ nu lɛ kɛkɛ atsuua he.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛfɔa nyɛtadei lɛ ahe koni nyɛhe atse; ni no sɛɛ dani nyɛba shitoohe lɛ mli.” Ta mli nibii ni aha lɛ jaa Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Bo kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ akutsei lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ, nyɛkanea ta lɛ mli nomŋɔɔnii fɛɛ ni ana kɛba lɛ, gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, aja nii lɛ mli enyɔ; akɛ fã kome ahã tabilɔi ni tee ta lɛ, koni akɛ fã kroko lɛ hu ahã maŋbii lɛ.
Ahe nibii ni yaa tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ anɔ too koni akɛhã Yehowa.
Nomii lɛ ni jio, tsinai lɛ ni jio, tejii lɛ ni jio, toi lɛ ni jio, ojie ohai enumɔ fɛɛ ohai enumɔ nɔ ekome, koni okɛhã Osɔfo Eleazar akɛ afɔle ni amɛkɛmiihã.
Fã ni yaa Israel maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nomii lɛ ni jio, tsinai lɛ ni jio, tejii lɛ ni jio, toi lɛ ni jio, ojie nyɔŋmai enumɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ ekome koni okɛhã Levibii lɛ ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Ta lɛ mli nii ni tabilɔi lɛ ha lɛ mli nii ni shwɛ ni tabilɔi lɛ kɛba ji gwantɛŋi akpei ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ, kɛ tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ, kɛ tejii akpei nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekome, kɛ nomii oblayei ni leko nuu akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ.
Nɔ ni tabilɔi ni tee ta lɛ na yɛ nibii nɛɛ amli ji gwantɛŋi akpei ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ, ni ajie amɛmli gwantɛŋi ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ akɛ too ni atsu akɛhã Yehowa.
Tsinai lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛna lɛ yibɔ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa, ni ejie amɛmli nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enyɔ akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
Tejii lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛna lɛ yibɔ akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ; ni ajie amɛmli nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekome akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
Ni oblayei nomii lɛ ayibɔ ni amɛna ji akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa; ni ajie amɛmli nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ akɛ too akɛhã Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Mose ŋɔ̃ nibii lɛ anɔ toi ni aye nɛɛ ehã Osɔfo Eleazar akɛ afɔle krɛdɛɛ ni ashã akɛhã Yehowa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ, Mose lɛ, akɛ efee lɛ.
Ta lɛ mli nii ni Mose he yɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ ekɛhã koni etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ asafo lɛ nɔ lɛ fee toi akpei ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enumɔ; kɛ tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa, kɛ tejii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ohai enumɔ, kɛ oblayei nomii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.
Nii ni ba Israel maŋbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ nɛɛ lɛ, Mose ŋɔ̃ gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ kooloi lɛ hu amli nyɔŋmai enumɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ mli ekomekome, ni ekɛhã Levibii lɛ ni tsuɔ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni tabilɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni tee ta lɛ ni kwɛɔ mɛi akpekpe kɛ mɛi ohaha akui anɔ lɛ ba Mose ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, wɔkane tabilɔi ni wɔhiɛ lɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa ekaaa ta lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, shika tsuru nibii ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ na yɛ ta lɛ mli, shikanii ni ji naneshinii kɛ nineshi gai kɛ niianaasɔomɔnii kɛ toiiaŋnii kɛ kuɛnii, lɛ wɔkɛba wɔkɛbake Yehowa koni akɛkpãtã ahã wɔsusumai yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.” Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika tsuru nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Shika nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛba akɛ keenii lɛ feɔ shekeli akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi tabilɔ fɛɛ tabilɔ ha nii hã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hu.
Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar he shika lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛkɛtee Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni etsɔ̃ kaimɔnɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Akutsei ni hi Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ yɛ kooloi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛna akɛ Yazer kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ lɛ, amɛbakɛɛ Mose kɛ Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Atarot kɛ Dibon kɛ Yazer kɛ Nimra kɛ Heshbon kɛ Eleale kɛ Sebam kɛ Nebo kɛ Beon, ni ji shikpɔji ni Yehowa hã Israelbii ye amɛnɔ bii lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ hi hã kooloolɛɛ, ni wɔyɛ kooloi babaoo.
Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa wɔ akɛ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Nyɛkɛ wɔ akafoa Yordan lɛ kɛmiiya esɛɛ akɛ wɔyahi jɛi.” Mose here Gad hii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aya ni amɛyawu ta be mli ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛtara shi yɛ biɛ lo?
Mɛɛba nyɛfãa Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkafo Yordan lɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ji bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi fee be ni mitsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛbashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛna jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbafã Israelbii lɛ atsui koni amɛkaya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa mli wo la nakai gbi lɛ, ekã kitã ekɛɛ, ‘Hii ni shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeko mi anɔkwa kɛwulako shi, ja Keniznyo Yefune binuu Kaleb lɛ kɛ Nun binuu Yoshua lɛ.
Amɛ lɛ amɛye mi anɔkwa kɛwula shi.’ Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ, ni ehã amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛyashi yinɔbii ni gbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ fɛɛ gboi.
Amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ nyɛbaye nyɛtsɛmɛi hii toigbolɔi lɛ anajiaŋ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba Israel nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ?
Kɛji nyɛkwa Yehowa lɛ, lɛ hu eeekwa maŋ lɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni belɛ nyɛaakpãtã Israel maŋ muu nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.” Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔmiitao akɛ wɔmãmɔ kooloi atsui kɛkɛ wɔhã wɔkooloi lɛ, ni wɔto maji hu wɔhã wɔbii abifabii lɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔsaa wɔhe kɛhã tawuu, ni wɔbaanyiɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛwu ta lɛ kɛyashi wɔkɛ amɛ aaayashɛ amɛ hu amɛshitoohe.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ wɔmiitao akɛ wɔbii lɛ ahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli.
Wɔkuŋ wɔsɛɛ kɛbaŋ wɔshĩai amli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Israel akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko aaana egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ.
Wɔkɛ amɛ epeleŋ shikpɔŋ ko he yɛ Yordan lɛ sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaa fɛɛ, ejaakɛ wɔ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ ebaje Yordan lɛ biɛgbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ nɛɛ.” Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛaafee nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛyaa ta.
Nyɛteŋ tabilɔ fɛɛ tabilɔ afo Yordan Faa lɛ koni ekɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaaye ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ, ni eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba, ni nyɛaaye bem yɛ Yehowa kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ, ni Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛyeee nyɛshiwoo lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaana nyɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he toigbalamɔ.
Nyɛmãmɔa tsui nyɛhãa nyɛbii lɛ, ni nyɛmãmɔa kooloi atsui nyɛhãa nyɛkooloi lɛ; ni shi ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaa ewo lɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ.” Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wɔnuŋtsɔ, bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ wɔbaafee nakai.
Wɔbii abifabii lɛ kɛ wɔŋamɛi lɛ kɛ wɔkooloi lɛ fɛɛ baahi Gilead maji lɛ amli; shi wɔ, hii lɛ, wɔsaa wɔhe, ni wɔbaanyiɛ Yehowa sɛɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose wo Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun bi Yoshua kɛ Israel akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ ahewɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaafo Yordan lɛ, ni amɛteŋ hii fɛɛ aaawa nyɛ kɛwu ta lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni nyɛaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ ahãa amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Shi kɛji amɛhii lɛ emiaaa koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ afo Yordan lɛ kɛyawu ta lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaana yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ eko kɛkɛ nyɛhãa amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gad hii lɛ kɛ Ruben hii lɛ here Mose nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ nakai otsuji baafee.
Wɔbaamia kɛfo Yordan lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛya Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni wɔna yɛ biɛ nɛɛ, yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ahi shi ahã wɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ shikpɔji kɛ maji ni yɔɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og hu shishi lɛ fɛɛ hã Gadbii lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Yosef bi Manase shwiei akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Gadbii lɛ saa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛwaje amɛ lɛ amli tsui lɛ.
Dibon kɛ Atarot kɛ Aroer, kɛ Atrot-Shofan kɛ Yazer kɛ Yogbeha, kɛ Bet-Nimra kɛ Bet-Haran.
Amɛmãmɔ kooloi atsui hu yɛ amɛmli.
Rubenbii lɛ saa tsui ni yɔɔ maji nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛmãmɔ: Heshbon kɛ Eleale kɛ Kiriataim, kɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon, maŋ ni amɛtsake egbɛi lɛ, kɛ Shibma.
Amɛwowoo maji ni amɛsaa nɛɛ fɛɛ gbɛii hei.
Manase binuu Makir shwiei lɛ fã ta kɛtee, ni amɛyatua Gilead, ni amɛshɔ̃ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɔɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eha Manase bi Makir shwiei lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi.
Manase binuu Yair hu tee ni eyatua Amorbii akrowai komɛi, ni eshɔ̃, ni ewo jɛi akɛ, “Yair Akrowai.” Noba hu tee eyatua Kenat maŋ lɛ kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, ni eshɔ̃ fɛɛ, ni ekɛ egbɛi “Noba” lɛ wo maŋ lɛ.
Gbɛ ni afã kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛtee Moab lɛ Be ni Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa kɛ Mose kɛ Aaron akɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, hei ni amɛtotoo shi yɛ yɛ amɛgbɛfãa lɛŋ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ.
Mose ŋmã he fɛɛ he ni yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ ayiɔ mli yɛ lɛ, kɛ he fɛɛ he ni atoɔ shi yɛ lɛ hu gbɛi; ni nomɛi baa nɛɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Rameses yɛ afi lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ, ni ji Hehoo gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ.
Ijiptbii lɛ miikwɛ Israelbii lɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛfã yɛ Yehowa hewalɛ naa.
No mli lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ miifufuu amɛkromɔbii fɛɛ ni Yehowa egbe lɛ agbohii lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ nɛkɛ gbele nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eyɛ hewalɛ fe Ijiptbii awɔji lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Rameses, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Sukot.
Amɛfã kɛjɛ Sukot ni amɛyato shi yɛ Etam yɛ shiaŋa lɛ naa.
Amɛfã yɛ Etam, ni amɛdɔ amɛyi kɛtee Pi-Hahirot ni yɔɔ Baal-Zefon bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Migdol masɛi.
Amɛshi Pi-Hahirot ni amɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ kɛyashɛ Shur Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛ lɛ amɛto shi yɛ Mara.
Be ni amɛfã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Mara lɛ amɛyanina nubui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amitsrɔbi tsei hu nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Elim; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛto shi yɛ jɛi.
Amɛfã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Elim ni amɛyato shi yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
Ni amɛshi Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa lɛ, amɛyato shi yɛ Sin Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Dofka.
Amɛshi Dofka kɛtee Alush; be ni amɛjɛ Alush lɛ, amɛyawa yɛ Refidim; amɛnaaa nu amɛnu yɛ jɛi.
Kɛjɛ Refidim lɛ hei ni Israelbii lɛ totoo shi yɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ Sinai Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ Kibrot Hataava; kɛkɛ lɛ Hazerot; kɛkɛ lɛ Ritma; kɛkɛ lɛ Rimon Perez; kɛkɛ lɛ Libna; kɛkɛ lɛ Risa; kɛkɛ lɛ Kehelata; kɛkɛ lɛ Shefer Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ Harada; kɛkɛ lɛ Makelot; kɛkɛ lɛ Tahat; kɛkɛ lɛ Tera; kɛkɛ lɛ Milka; kɛkɛ lɛ Hashmona; kɛkɛ lɛ Moserot; kɛkɛ lɛ Bene Yaakan; kɛkɛ lɛ Hor Hagidgad; kɛkɛ lɛ Yotbata; kɛkɛ lɛ Abrona; kɛkɛ lɛ Ezion Geber; kɛkɛ lɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, no ji Kadesh; kɛkɛ lɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he yɛ Edombii ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ naa.
Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ Osɔfo Aaron kwɔ kɛtee Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shimɔ sɛɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Aaron eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃, be ni egbo yɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Arad maŋtsɛ ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ miiba.
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Zalmona; ni kɛjɛ Zalmona lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Punon.
Kɛjɛ Punon lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Obot; ni kɛjɛ Obot lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim ni ji maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛfã kɛjɛ Abarim lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Dibon Gad; ni kɛjɛ Dibon Gad lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Almon Diblataim ni kɛjɛ Almon Diblataim lɛ amɛyato shi yɛ Abarim Gɔŋ lɛ he yɛ Nebo Gɔŋ lɛ masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã yɛ Abarim Gɔŋ lɛ he ni amɛyato shi yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ.
Israelbii lɛ to shi yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni amɛjwere shi kɛjɛ Bet Yeshimot aahu kɛyashi Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Akpɔi ni awo Israelbii lɛ dani amɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɔ; ni nyɛkpãtãa amɛtɛ shiui lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛmãgãi ni ashwie lɛ hu fɛɛ ahiɛ; asaŋ nyɛfitea hei ni amɛjaa amɛwɔji lɛ yɛ lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Nyɛŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ koni nyɛhia nɔ, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ nɔ mihã nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ.
Nyɛfɔa oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã nyɛkutsei lɛ.
Akutso ni yi fa lɛ, ena shikpɔŋ agbo; ni akutso ni yi faaa lɛ ena shikpɔŋ fioo.
Bɔ ni oshiki lɛ baagbee shi ehã lɛ, nakai naa aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã akutso fɛɛ akutso.
Shi naa, kɛji nyɛshwieee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛjeee nyɛteŋ lɛ, no lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi ni nyɛbaashi lɛ baagba nyɛnaa tamɔ aklatii ni miitsulɔ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ kɛ ŋmei yɛ nyɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni amɛbaahao nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛshwieee amɛ lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mito ni mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mibafee nyɛ hu.”
Shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Wo Israelbii lɛ kitã ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛyashɛ Kanaan ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mijɔɔ edalɛ tso muu fɛɛ nɔ akɛ mikɛmiihã nyɛ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ehusui lɛ baafee ji nɛkɛ.
Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ baakã shi kɛjɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaanyiɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛwuoyigbɛ husu lɛ baajɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ naagbee gbɛ, ni ebaadɔ eyi kɛya wuoyigbɛ Akrabim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ efo mli kɛtsɔ Zin kɛtee wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Kadesh Barnea.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ baadɔ eyi eŋmɛ kooyi anaigbɛ kɛtsɔ Hazar Adar kɛya Azmon.
Husu lɛ baadɔ eyi yɛ Azmon kɛyanina Ijipt husu lɛ naa jɔɔ lɛ, ni enaa baaya eyatã yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Nyɛnaigbɛ husu lɛ ji Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ kɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ.
“Nyɛkooyigbɛ husu lɛ nyɛbaajie kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ; ni ebaajɛ jɛi hu kɛyamɔ Hamat, koni etsa nɔ kɛya Zedad, kɛyashɛ Zifron; ni ebaanyiɛ nɔ koni enaa ayatã yɛ Hazar Enan.
Enɛ baafee nyɛkooyigbɛ husu.
“Nyɛbaakadi nyɛbokãgbɛ husu lɛ kɛjɛ Hazar Enan kɛyamɔ Shefam; ni husu lɛ baatsa nɔ kɛjɛ Shefam koni ekpeleke shi kɛya Harbel yɛ Ain bokãgbɛ.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ enyiɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyanina Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ yɛ ebokãgbɛ; etsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ koni enaa ayatã yɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe husui ni bɔle lɛ kpula lɛ nɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ ni nyɛbaafɔ̃ oshiki kɛja nyɛhã nyɛhe lɛ nɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã akutsei nɛɛhu kɛ fã lɛ.
Rubenbii akutso lɛ kɛ Gadbii akutso lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã lɛ ena amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa momo, yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ.” Onukpai ni kwɛ Shikpɔŋ lɛ jaa lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Hii ni aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã maŋbii lɛ ji Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun binuu Yoshua.
Shi ŋɔɔ lumɔ kome yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli koni amɛwa kɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ.” Lumɛi ni aŋɔ yɛ akutsei lɛ amli lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Yudabii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ; Simeonbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Shelumiel, Amihud bi lɛ, ni Benyaminbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Elidad, Kision bi lɛ.
Danbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Buki, Yogli bi lɛ, Manasebii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Haniel, Efod bi lɛ; ni Efraimbii akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Kemuel, Shiftan bi lɛ, Zebulonbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Elizafan, Parnak bi lɛ, Isakarbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Paltiel, Azan bi lɛ, ni Asherbii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Ahihud, Shelomi bi lɛ, ni Naftalibii lɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ ŋɔɔ Pedahel, Amihud bi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji hii ni Yehowa fã akɛ amɛja Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã Israelbii lɛ.
Maji ni akɛhã Levibii lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛhala maji komɛi yɛ shikpɔji ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ anɔ amɛkɛhã Levibii lɛ koni amɛhi mli; asaŋ amɛhã Levibii lɛ shikpɔji hu yɛ maji lɛ ahe koni amɛkɛlɛ kooloo.
Maji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ Levibii lɛ ashihilɛhei, ni maji lɛ ahe shikpɔji lɛ akamɔ shi koni amɛkooloi fɛɛ ana nii aye yɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ ahe shikpɔji ni nyɛkɛbaahã Levibii lɛ ajɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he kɛya sɛɛgbɛ kɛyashi ninetalɔi akpe jɛkɛmɔ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.
No hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni ekɛlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi akpei enyɔ baakã shi yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni nakai jekɛmɔ nɔŋŋ baakã shi yɛ ewuoyigbɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ enaigbɛ kɛ nakai jekɛmɔ nɔŋŋ yɛ ekooyigbɛ fɛɛ, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakã shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ.
Shikpɔŋ ni baakã maŋ lɛ he ahã Levibii lɛ dalɛ nɛ.
Nyɛhãa Levibii lɛ maji ekpaa koni amɛkɛfee abobaahe maji, hei ni mɔ ko ni egbe gbɔmɔ be mli ni ehiɛ kãaa he lɛ baajo foi kɛya eyaba abo yɛ.
Nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ nyɛhãa Levibii lɛ maji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ hu koni maji fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaahã Levibii lɛ afee nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Maji abɔ ni abaahe yɛ Israelbii akutso ko mli koni akɛhã Levibii lɛ, ebaakwɛ nakai akutso lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ.
Akutso ni eshikpɔŋ fa lɛ ehã maji babaoo, ni akutso ni eshikpɔŋ faaa lɛ ehã maji fioo.” Abobaa maji lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhalaa maji nyɛkɛfea abobaa maji koni mɔ ko ni egbe mɔ ko ni jeee gbɛ eje ajo foi kɛya jɛi ni eyaba abo.
Maji nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ hei ni aaayaba abo yɛ kɛje mɔ ni taoɔ lá he owele etɔ dɛŋ.
Akagbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ akɛ ja akɛ lɛ eba asafo lɛ hiɛ ni akojo lɛ dã.
Maji ni nyɛbaahala nyɛkɛfee abobaa maji lɛ ayikulɛ afee ekpaa.
Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ sɛɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ hu yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛfee amɛ abobaa maji.
Nɛkɛ maji ekpaa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ abobaa maji ahã nyɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ gbɔi ni ebato nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni ebadɔmɔ nyɛ kwraa hu fɛɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko be mli ni jeee gbɛ eje lɛ ajo foi kɛya jɛi eyaba abo.
“Shi kɛji mɔ ko kɛ dade tswa mɔ ko ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ tɛ ni aaanyɛ gbɔmɔ agbe, ni ekɛ tɛ lɛ tswa mɔ ko, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, tɛtswalɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ tso ni aaanyɛ gbɔmɔ agbe, ni ekɛtswa mɔ ko, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Mɔ ni agbe lɛ wekunyo yɛ hegbɛ ni etɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ lá lɛ he owele.
He fɛɛ he ni ekɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaakpe yɛ lɛ, egbe lɛ.
“Kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ mɔ ko, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eyawo mɔ lɛ ka, ni etsu mɔ lɛ nɔ, aloo etsi lɛ egbee shi, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo, aloo egba mɔ lɛ ma, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, gbɔmɔ ni gba mɔ lɛ ma lɛ egbe gbɔmɔ, ni esa akɛ lɛ hu agbe lɛ.
Mɔ ni agbe lɛ wekunyo yɛ hegbɛ ni etɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ lá lɛ he owele.
He fɛɛ he ni ekɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaakpe yɛ lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbeɔ lɛ.
“Shi kɛji osharã naa ni mɔ ko gbe mɔ ko be mli ni ebɛ mɔ lɛ mli esha eto, etsi lɛ egbee shi jio, efɔ̃ nɔ ko ekɛtswa mɔ lɛ jio; aloo mɔ ko fɔ̃ tɛ be mli ni enaaa mɔ ko, shi fee sɛɛ lɛ tɛ lɛ tee eyatswa mɔ ko ni egbe lɛ be mli ni ekɛgbɔmɔ nɛɛ bɛ bei ko, eto ni ejeee ehenyɛlɔ, ni etaooo lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, no lɛ yɛ mlai nɛɛ anaa lɛ asafo lɛ akojo mɔ ni tswa mɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ lá he oweletɔlɔ lɛ teŋ.
Asafo lɛ ahere gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ lá oweletɔlɔ lɛ dɛŋ koni ahã gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ maŋ he ni ejo foi kɛtee eyaba abo yɛ lɛ mli, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu akɛ osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni eyaba abo lɛ aaagbo.
Shi kɛji eshɛ be ko ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ shi abobaa maŋ lɛ mli he ni etee eyaba abo yɛ lɛ husu nɔ ni lá he oweletɔlɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ yakpe yɛ maŋ lɛ husu lɛ sɛɛ, ni egbe lɛ lɛ, oweletɔlɔ lɛ yeee gbɔmɔ nɛɛ lá yi sɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ ahi abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni eyabɔ abo lɛ aaagbo.
No sɛɛ dani gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɔɔ hegbɛ ni ekuɔ esɛɛ eyaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni ejo foi eshi lɛ.
Mlai nɛɛ akã shi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei ayinɔi fɛɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni nyɛaayahi.
“Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akɛ sane eshi lɛ akɛ egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, adamɔ odasefoi kɛjɛ mɛi enyɔ loo nɔ nɔ kɛyaa anaa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu lɛ gbele fɔ.
Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome too naa wiemɔ nɔ akɛbu mɔ ko gbele fɔ.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni abu lɛ gbelefɔ lɛ ja agbe lɛ.
Akaŋmɛ gbɛ ni ewo shika ko kwraa ekɛkpɔ̃ ehe kɛje gbele lɛ mli.
Asaŋ akahe shika ko yɛ mɔgbelɔ ni ejo foi eyaba abo yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ dɛŋ akɛ ehekpɔ̃mɔ nii, bɔ ni afee ni ekanyɛ eku esɛɛ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ beyinɔ ni osɔfonukpa mɔ yinɔ ni eyaba abo lɛ nako agbo, koni nyɛkabule shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ lashishwiemɔ buleɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ; ni nɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni akɛdãiɔ shikpɔŋ ni ashwie lá shi yɛ nɔ, akɛ ja mɔ ni shwie lá shi lɛ nɔŋŋ lá.
Nyɛkabulea shikpɔŋ ni mi kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miyɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.”
Yeigbãyei agbɛfaŋnii Yosef bi Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ atsɛmɛi ashĩai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ akutseiaŋ onukpai lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa fã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfɔ̃ oshiki koni nyɛkɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã Israelbii lɛ.
Asaŋ efã hu akɛ nyɛkɛ wɔnyɛmi Zelofehad gbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ ahã ebiyei lɛ.
Belɛ kɛji biyei nɛɛ kɛ Israel hii ni jɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli yabote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, abaajie amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni abaahã wɔ lɛ mli koni akɛfata amɛwumɛi lɛ atsɛmɛi agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he; enɛ baahã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji eshɛ Israelbii aNyamɔ Afiyeli be lɛ abaaŋɔ nɛkɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ nɛɛ afata akutsei ni amɛtee gbãlã yɛ mli lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ he, ni ebaaje wɔtsɛmɛi agbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli kwraa.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Mose wo Israelbii lɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yosef bi Manase shwiei akutso lɛ kɛɛ lɛ eja.
Kitã ni Yehowa woɔ yɛ Zelofehad biyei lɛ ahewɔ nɛ: Zelofehad biyei lɛ yɛ hegbɛ aahu akɛ amɛkɛ hii fɛɛ hii ni amɛsumɔɔ boteɔ gbãlãshihilɛ mli moŋ, shi esa akɛ hii lɛ ajɛ amɛtsɛmɛi akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ eko mli, bɔ ni afee ni Israelbii akutso gbɛfaŋnii akaje akutso kome dɛŋ kɛmiiya akutso kroko dɛŋ; shi moŋ Israelnyo gbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ ebaafata etsɛmɛi awe gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko lɛ he.
Biyoo fɛɛ biyoo ni naa Israel akutso ko mli gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ, esa akɛ egbã etsɛ akutso lɛ mli nuu, bɔ ni afee ni Israelbii ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ ahi ekutso lɛ dɛŋ be fɛɛ be, koni gboshinii akajɛ akutso kome dɛŋ kɛmiiya akutso kroko dɛŋ; shi moŋ akutso fɛɛ akutso mli gboshinii ahi edɛŋ daa.” Zelofehad biyei lɛ ye nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose lɛ nɔ, ni Mahela kɛ Tirza kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Noa, ni ji Zelofehad biyei lɛ, kɛ amɛtsɛkwɛmɛi abihii saŋŋ bote gbãlãshihilɛ mli.
Amɛwumɛi lɛ fɛɛ jɛ Yosef bi Manase shwiei awekui lɛ amli; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛgboshinii lɛ ka amɛtsɛ weku lɛ akutso lɛ mli.
Mlai kɛ akpɔi ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo Israelbii lɛ be mli ni amɛyɔɔ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan lɛ naa yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Mla Mlitii Wolo lɛ kɔɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ wie yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe.
Israelbii lɛ efã gbɛ kakadaŋŋ kɛtsɔ̃ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛbashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni eshwɛ ji amɛbaabote Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Saji otii ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi nɛ: .
Mose kai Israelbii lɛ saji ni ba amɛnɔ yɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni eho lɛ mli lɛ.
Ebi maŋbii lɛ koni amɛkai bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛfo shiaŋa lɛ, koni amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi ni amɛkaje esɛɛ.
.
Mose ku sɛɛ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wie Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ he, ni eti Klɛŋklɛŋ Kitã lɛ mli ehã maŋ lɛ akɛ amɛja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ koome pɛ.
Ekai amɛ mlai srɔtoi lɛ hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ amɛyahi shi yɛ shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã.
.
