Mose kai maŋbii lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ ekpãŋ lɛ, ni asaŋ ekɛfɔ̃ maŋ lɛ hiɛ akɛ amɛsaa amɛhe kɛhã kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔyeli.
.
Ato Yoshua Mose sɛɛmɔ, mɔ ni baanyiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ahiɛ.
Be ni Mose ela ekɛkafo Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwayeli, ni ejɔɔ Israel akutsei lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, egbo yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Wolo lɛ mli sane titri lɛ ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehere maŋ ni eŋɔ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii lɛ ayiwala, ni esumɔ amɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ maŋbii nɛɛ hu agbɛfaŋ nitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛ hu amɛkai enɛ, ni amɛsumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛbo lɛ toi bɔ ni afee ni amɛyi ana wala ni jɔɔmɔ ahi amɛnɔ daa.
Oti fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ anaa yɛ Yitso .- lɛ mli.
Be ni Yesu ba lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ ji kitãi lɛ ateŋ ewulu fe fɛɛ.
No ji akɛ, “Okɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ ohewalɛ fɛɛ asumɔ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Mlijaramɔi Mose Klɛŋklɛŋ wiemɔi lɛ .—.
Mose wiemɔi ni ji Enyɔ lɛ .—.
a. Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ .—.
b. Mlai kɛ akpɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ srɔtoi .—.
Kanaan botemɔ he mlai .—.
Ati Kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli .—.
Mose naagbee wiemɔi .—.
Mose gbele .-
Saji ni ba yɛ Horeb lɛ Mose kɛ Israel fɛɛ wie Wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ, yɛ ŋa kplenee ni kã Suf maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ŋa nɛɛ kã Paran maŋ lɛ kɛ Tofel kɛ Laban kɛ Hazerot kɛ Dizahab maji lɛ ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he kɛtsɔ̃ Edom Gɔŋ lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛtee Kadesh Barnea lɛ, gbii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome gbɛnyiɛmɔ ni.
Afi ni ji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ wie wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa efã lɛ akɛ ekɛ amɛ awie lɛ.
No mli lɛ Mose egbe Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon, mɔ ni ye lumɔ yɛ Heshbon lɛ, kɛ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og, mɔ ni ye lumɔ yɛ Ashtarot kɛ Edrei lɛ momo.
Mose bɔi mlai lɛ anaatsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ Yordan bokãgbɛ yɛ Moab Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ wɔ yɛ Horeb Gɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni nyɛhi nɛkɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ he lɛ efa.
Nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛfãa kɛyaa Amorbii agɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ hei fɛɛ ni bɛŋkɛ jɛi lɛ nɔ.
Hei nɛɛ ji Yordan Jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa, kɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Lebanon aahu kɛyamɔ faa wulu ni ji Eufrate lɛ naa.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ mikɛfɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔa!
Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei.’ ” Mose to kojolɔi Mose kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Be ni wɔyɔɔ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lolo lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mi kome minyɛŋ nyɛsaji lɛ makura dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛyi efa, ni ŋmɛnɛ nyɛyikulɛ tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii.
Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛyi afa bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ toi akpei abɔ; ni ejɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.
Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni mi koome manyɛ nyɛhaomɔi kɛ nyɛteŋ saji fɛɛ makura hu?
Nyɛfamɔa hii ni le nii, ni nuɔ nii ashishi, asaŋ ni amɛkpa jeŋ shi, yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ anaa koni mato amɛ nyɛnukpai.’ Ni nyɛhere nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni okɛɛ wɔfee nɛɛ, ehi!’ Kɛkɛ ni miŋɔ nyɛkutsei lɛ amli hii ni le nii, ni yɔɔ gbɛi hu ni nyɛfamɔ lɛ, ni miwo amɛ onukpai mihã nyɛ, mɛi akpeakpe kui kɛ mɛi ohaoha kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmanyɔŋma kui anɔkwɛlɔi kɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ anɔkwɛlɔi hu.
“Miwo nyɛkojolɔi lɛ kitã nakai be lɛ mli, ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkuraa saji ni aaaba nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ ni nyɛkojoa mɔ kɛ enyɛmi teŋ loo maŋnyo kɛ gbɔ teŋ sane yɛ jalɛ naa.
Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkɛkojoa; nyɛboa mɔ bibioo kɛ mɔ wulu fɛɛ toi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni nyɛkashea gbɔmɔ hiɛ sanekɛɛmɔ gbeyei, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni baakudɔ nyɛ kɛkojo.
Shi sane ni mli wa tsɔ̃ hã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa mi koni maye.’ Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni sa akɛ nyɛfee.” Atsu mɛi kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ “Wɔfã kɛjɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he, ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã wɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ shiaŋa ni nɔ yɔɔ gbeyei, tamɔ nyɛna lɛ, nɔ yɛ gbɛ ni yaa Amorbii agɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔbashɛ Kadesh Barnea.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛshɛ Amorbii agɔji shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛmiihã wɔ lɛ nɔ.
Naa shikpɔŋ lɛ, no Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛfɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuii akafãa hu.’ “Kɛkɛ ni nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ mi, ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Hã wɔtsu hii komɛi kɛtsɔ̃ wɔhiɛ ni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ koni amɛbagba wɔ he ni wɔtsɔ̃ kɛya kɛ maji ni wɔyaanina lɛ hu ahe sane.’ “Wiemɔ lɛ sa mihiɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, miŋɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, akutso fɛɛ akutso mli lɛ mɔ kome, ni mitsu amɛ.
Amɛyi mli, ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee aahu kɛyashɛ Eshkol Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛyasara jɛi.
Amɛtserɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aduawai lɛ eko amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛkpeleke shi kɛba, ni amɛbagba wɔ akɛ, ‘Shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa wɔ lɛ, ehi.’ “Shi nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua, ni nyɛyayeee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yaa.
Nyɛwie huhuuhu yɛ nyɛbui lɛ amli, ni nyɛkɛɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛɛ ni Yehowa nyɛɔ wɔ lɛ hewɔ ni eyajie wɔ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba koni ekɛ wɔ abahã Amorbii lɛ koni amɛkpãtã wɔhiɛ.
Nɛgbɛ wɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛya?’ Wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ ehã wɔtsui efã, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Gbɔmɛi lɛ dara ni amɛkwɔlɔ fe wɔ; amɛmaji lɛ hu dara, ni atswa gbogboi ni kwɔlɔ kɛyashi ŋwɛi awowoo amɛhe; ni wɔna Anakbii tete yɛ jɛi.’ “Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkahãa ŋmiŋmi miimɔmɔa nyɛ, ni nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei hu.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ, baawu ehã nyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni efee ehã nyɛ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiaŋ, yɛ Ijipt, kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛna bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyɛmli kɛyashi nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nuu hiɛɔ ebi yɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ lɛ.’ Shi nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyaheee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛyeee, tsɛbelɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ enyiɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ la koni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ he gbɛ ni nyɛtsɔ̃, ni shwane lɛ enyiɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ atatu.” Yehowa gbala Israel toi “Yehowa nu wiemɔi ni nyɛwiewie lɛ, ni ewo lɛ mlifu, ni ekã kitã ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ yinɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko enaŋ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, pɛ ni aaana jɛi, ni lɛ kɛ eshwiei nɔŋŋ mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni eyasara lɛ baahã, ejaakɛ eye mi anɔkwa kɛmɔ shi.’ Mi hu, nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu mi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bo Mose, bo hu oshɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, mɔ ni waa bo lɛ ji mɔ ni baaya ayashɛ jɛi.
Wo lɛ hewalɛ ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni baanyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Asaŋ nyɛbifabii ni ji nyɛbii ni nako ale ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ lɛ, mɛi ni nyɛkɛɛ abaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, amɛ amɛbaayashɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛ mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baahã, ni amɛbaaŋɔ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi koni nyɛtsɔ̃a Akaba Bele lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.’ “Kɛkɛ ni nyɛhere nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Wɔgbo Yehowa nɔ toi; wɔɔtee koni wɔyawu tamɔ bɔ pɛ ni Yehowa fã akɛ wɔfee lɛ.’ Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mia kɛ etawuu nii, ejaakɛ efee nyɛ akɛ gɔŋ nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ tuamɔ lɛ shwɛmɔ nɔ ko ni.
“Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ nyɛkayaa ni nyɛyawua, koni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akaye nyɛnɔ ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ eyaŋ.’ Ni mikɛɛ nyɛ hu, shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛtse Yehowa hiɛ atua, ni nyɛfee ntɛŋ kɛkwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ nakai gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ je kpo, ni amɛ kɛ nyɛ bakpe, ni amɛshwie nyɛ, tamɔ wobii shwieɔ mɔ lɛ, ni amɛtswia nyɛ nii kɛjɛ Edom aahu kɛyashi Horma.
Ni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba, ni nyɛbafo nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa shi Yehowa kwɛɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, efooo nyɛdaaŋ hu.” Afii ni aye yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛye gbii babaoo yɛ Kadesh bɔ ni nyɛle momo lɛ.
“Kɛkɛ ni wɔdɔ wɔyi kɛtsɔ̃ Akaba Bele lɛ he gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyabote shiaŋa lɛ mli bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ afee lɛ.
Wɔye gbii babaoo ni wɔmiilɔgɔ shi kɛmiibɔle Edom Gɔŋ lɛ.
“Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni nyɛbɔle shi yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ he lɛ efa; nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhiɛ nyɛhãa kooyigbɛ agbɛnɛ.
Ni obɔ maŋ lɛ kɔkɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nyɛyaatsɔ̃ nyɛnyɛmimɛi, Esau shwiei, ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ.
Amɛbaashe nyɛ gbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, ni nyɛkɛ amɛ akawua ejaakɛ mikɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ he ko he ko haŋ nyɛ.
Mihaŋ nyɛ shikpɔŋ nanemaahe kome tete nɛkɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ mikɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã Esau akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Nyɛkɔa shika nyɛkɛhea niyenii tete yɛ amɛdɛ̃ dani nyɛyea, ni nu ni nyɛbaanu hu nyɛkɔa shika nyɛkɛhea yɛ amɛdɛ̃.’ “Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ nyɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtsu mli; ni ebaa nyɛyi yɛ nyɛgbɛnyiɛmɔ mli yɛ nɛkɛ shiaŋa kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ.
Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni hia nyɛ.
‘Wɔtsa wɔ nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ; shi wɔshi gbɛ ni jɛ Elat kɛ Eziongeber kɛyaa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ he lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni wɔtswa wɔnyɛmimɛi Esau shwiei ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ hu wɔfɔ̃; ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔhiɛ wɔhã Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ.’ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Nyɛkagbaa Moabbii lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ mikɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko kwraa haŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛhã Ar, Lot shwiei lɛ, akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.’ ” “Shi moŋ nyɛtea shi ni nyɛfoa Zered Faa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyafo Zered Faa lɛ.
Be ni wɔye yɛ gbɛteŋ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni wɔshi Kadesh Barnea kɛyashi wɔfo Zered Faa lɛ fee afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Nakai be mli lɛ tsutsu yinɔ tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ egboi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa kã kitã lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa nine kã amɛnɔ, ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛyashi amɛ fɛɛ amɛtã yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
“Be ni tsutsu tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ gboi lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, nyɛbaatsɔ̃ Moabbii lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ kɛho yɛ Ar maŋ lɛ masɛi.
Kɛji nyɛyashɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkagbaa Amonbii lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkɛ amɛ akawua ta ko hu, ejaakɛ mikɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ he ko kwraa haŋ nyɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.’ ” “Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyia mli, ni nyɛyafoa Arnon Faa lɛ.
Naa, mijɔɔ Heshbon maŋtsɛ Sihon, Amornyo lɛ, kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hu fɛɛ nɔ mihã nyɛ.
Nyɛyatuaa lɛ koni nyɛbɔi shikpɔŋ lɛ shɔ̃mɔ.
Kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei amɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jeŋ fɛɛ; amɛaanu nyɛhe, amɛtsui aaafã, ni amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛji atsi nyɛtã.
Israel ye Maŋtsɛ Sihon nɔ kunim “Mitsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ Kedemot ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛtee Maŋtsɛ Sihon ŋɔɔ yɛ Heshbon kɛ naajɔlɛ wiemɔ akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho.
Gbɛjegbɛ lɛ kɛkɛ nɔ wɔbaanyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ; wɔgbaŋ ninejurɔgbɛ lɛ, wɔgbaŋ abɛku hu.
Niyenii ni wɔbaaye lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahã wɔ koni wɔhe kɛ shika, ni nu hu ni wɔbaanu lɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahã wɔ koni wɔhe.
Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔbaa bo ji akɛ oŋmɛ wɔ gbɛ koni wɔfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi wɔɔfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛbote shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛaahã wɔ lɛ mli.
Nakai ji bɔ ni Esau shwiei ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ kɛ Moabbii ni yɔɔ Ar lɛ hu fee amɛhã wɔ.’ “Shi Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ akɛ wɔtsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã ekuɛŋ ti, ni ekpliŋ etsui bɔ ni afee ni wɔ kɛ lɛ awu ni wɔye enɔ kunim tamɔ eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
“Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, mibɔ̃i Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔjɔɔmɔ kɛ bo hãmɔ; bɔ̃imɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shɔ̃mɔ koni nyɛhi nɔ.’ Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ fã kɛba koni amɛ kɛ wɔ abawu yɛ Yahaz maŋ lɛ masɛi.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Sihon nɔ ehã wɔ, ni wɔgbe lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Wɔŋɔ emaji fɛɛ nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni wɔkpãtã maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii fɛɛ ahiɛ; wɔshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Wɔloo kooloi lɛ wɔhã wɔhe akɛ haanii kɛ maji ni wɔŋɔŋɔɔ lɛ amli nibii hu.
Kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ toi, kɛ maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ jɔɔ lɛ teŋ kɛyashi Gilead maŋ lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, maŋ ko maŋ ko bɛ ni wɔyeee enɔ kunim.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jɔɔ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ ehã wɔ.
Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ pɛ he wɔyataaa, no ji Yabok Faa lɛ hewɔhewɔ shikpɔji lɛ, kɛ gɔji ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji lɛ, kɛ he fɛɛ he ni Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ wɔ kɔkɔ akɛ wɔkata he lɛ.”
Israel ye Maŋtsɛ Og nɔ kunim “Agbɛnɛ wɔdɔ wɔyi, ni wɔyi Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ fã kɛba koni amɛ kɛ wɔ abawu yɛ Edrei maŋ lɛ masɛi.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Nyɛkashea Og gbeyei, ejaakɛ mijɔɔ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ mihã nyɛ koni nyɛfee amɛ tamɔ nyɛfee Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ni hi Heshbon lɛ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã wɔye Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og hu kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim, ni wɔgbe amɛ kɛyashi eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Wɔshɔ̃ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Og shishi, maŋ ko maŋ ko bɛ ni wɔshɔ̃ɔɔ.
Wɔshɔ̃ maji nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ ni feɔ Argob kpokpai tso muu fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og shishi lɛ.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, atswatswaa gbogboi ni kwɔlɔ awowoo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ, ni agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi tara amɛnaa.
Wɔshɔ̃ maji babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni gbogboi bɛ amɛhe hu.
Bɔ ni wɔkɛ Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon ye lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔkpãtã maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ emli hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Wɔmɔmɔ kooloi fɛɛ, ni wɔha maŋbii lɛ anibii wɔhã wɔhe.
“Belɛ wɔshɔ̃ nakai be lɛ mli shikpɔji ni yɔɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ashishi, yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Wɔshɔ̃ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashi Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.
(Hermon Gɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ, Sidonbii lɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Sirion, ni Amorbii lɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Senir.)
Wɔshɔ̃ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og nɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ: maji fɛɛ ni jwere gɔji ayiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ nii ni yɔɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, kɛ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛtee bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyanina maji ni ji Salka kɛ Edrei lɛ.” (Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og nɛɛ, lɛ ji Refaimbii ashwiei lɛ ateŋ naagbeemɔ ni eshwɛ.
Esaatso lɛ dade saatso ni, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nɛɛhu kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Dade saatso nɛɛ yɛ Amonbii amaŋ ni ji Raba kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.)
Akutsei ni to shi yɛ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ “Be ni wɔŋɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã Aroer maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Arnon Faa lɛ naa lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ, kɛ Gilead gɔji ayiteŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ fã hu, kɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛnɔ lɛ, hã Rubenbii akutso lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ akutso lɛ.
Ni mikɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ fã ni shwɛ lɛ kɛ Bashan fɛɛ, he ni Og ye elumɔ yɛ lɛ, ni ji Argob shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, hã Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome.” “Mikɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hã Makir shwiei ni yɔɔ Manasebii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ akutsei lɛ mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni kã kɛjɛ Gilead kɛyashi Arnon Faa lɛ naa lɛ hã amɛ.
Faa lɛ teŋ ji amɛhusu yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni amɛkooyigbɛ husu yafee Yabok Faa lɛ, ni faa nɛɛ fã ko fee Amonbii ahusu.
Yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ yamɔɔ Yordan Faa lɛ; ejɛɔ Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ he yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛhoɔ kɛyamɔɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, kɛtseɔ mli kɛyaa Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi yɛ bokãgbɛ.
“Mikɛɛ nyɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nɛkɛ Yordan bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ.
Nyɛteŋ tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ amia koni nyɛnyiɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Nyɛŋamɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛbii lɛ kɛ nyɛkooloi lɛ baahi shi yɛ maji ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ amli (ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛyɛ kooloi babaoo).
Nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ baaya kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aaajɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛnine aaashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa amɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ.
No sɛɛ dani nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba egbɛfaŋnɔ ni mikɛhã lɛ lɛ nɔ.’ “Ni Yoshua hu, mikɛɛ lɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Ona kɛ ohiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efee nɛkɛ maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛbaaya nyɛyanina amɛshikpɔji lɛ.
Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni wuɔ ta lɛ hãa nyɛ.’ Ahãaa Mose ayashɛ Kanaan “Mikpa Yehowa fai nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, ogbojee kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ eshishi kɛkɛ oje ojieɔ otsɔ̃ɔ otsulɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ dɔŋŋ, yɛ ŋwɛi jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jio, ni aaanyɛ hewalɛ naa nibii wuji ni otsu nɛɛ etsu?
Ofainɛ, hã mi hu mafo mli kɛya mayana shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni yɔɔ Yordan anaigbɛ lɛ, nakai gɔji ashikpɔŋ kpakpa lɛ kɛ Lebanon hu.’ “Nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa mli fu mi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebooo mi toi.
Shi moŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Efa; okɛ mi akawie nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ he dɔŋŋ.
Kwɔɔ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ kɛya eyiteŋ, koni owo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ anaigbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ, ni obaana shikpɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ ofoŋ nɛkɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ.
Wo Yoshua kitã; ni owo lɛ ekãa kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ ejaakɛ lɛ ebaanyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛya kɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni obaana lɛ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhi shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Betpeor maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.”
Mose bi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛye mlai lɛ anɔ Agbɛnɛ Mose kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea akpɔi kɛ mlai ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ anɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nɔ ko akafataa mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ ahe, ni asaŋ nyɛkajiea nɔ ko yɛ mli hu.
Nyɛyea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɛna kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii nɔ ni Yehowa fee yɛ Peor Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ja Baal lɛ, Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã ehiɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ; shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, anɔkwa lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛyi ena wala kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
“Naa, mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fã akɛ mifee lɛ, koni nyɛye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛyea nɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ ejaakɛ no nɔŋŋ baahã nyɛnilee kɛ nyɛhiɛshikamɔ abakã shi faŋŋ yɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛji amɛnu nɛkɛ akpɔi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa akɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ le nii, ni amɛnuɔ nii ashishi; maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛ.’ “Ejaakɛ mɛɛ maŋ wulu kroko yɔɔ dɔŋŋ ni yɔɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛŋkɛɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɛŋkɛɔ wɔ be fɛɛ be ni wɔɔtsɛ lɛ lɛ?
Ni mɛɛ maŋ wulu kroko yɔɔ dɔŋŋ ni yɔɔ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni ja tamɔ nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ ni mikɛshwieɔ nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ?
Shi moŋ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia kɛkɛ koni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhiɛ akaje nibii ni nyɛna kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii nɛɛ anɔ nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni nyɛgbaa nyɛbii kɛ nyɛnabii lɛ, titri lɛ, sane ni ba gbi ni nyɛdamɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, be ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Buamɔ maŋ lɛ naa ohã mi, shi miitao akɛ mahã amɛnu nɔ ni makɛɛ koni amɛkɛkase mi gbeyeishemɔ gbii abɔ ni amɛyɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛgba amɛbii hu.’ “Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii lɛ bɔ ni nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ, ni nyɛbadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ shishi, kɛ bɔ ni gɔŋ lɛ here kɛ la kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni atatu kpii ko ha gɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kpula.
Nyɛgbaa amɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ la lɛ mli; bɔ ni nyɛnu wiemɔi lɛ shi nyɛnaaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kwraa, fe akɛ egbee lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛnu; bɔ ni egbala ekpãŋmɔ lɛ mli etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni efã akɛ nyɛye nɔ, no ji kitãi nyɔŋma lɛ ni eŋmala ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ anɔ lɛ.
Yehowa wo mi kitã yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ mli kɛya ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Abɔ kɔkɔ akɛ akakwa Nyɔŋmɔ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nyɛhenɔ ni ahia.
Kɛji gbi nɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ mli ekɛ nyɛ wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, nyɛnaaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkafee amãgã ko ni tamɔ nuu loo yoo henɔ nyɛhã nyɛhe, koni nyɛtɔ̃.
Kooloo naji ejwɛtsɛ jio, loofɔlɔ jio, waamɔ kooloo jio, nu mli loo jio, nyɛkafea eko eko henɔ.
Kɛji nyɛwo nyɛhiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni nyɛkwɛ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii lɛ ni ji ŋwɛiniiaŋ nibii lɛ, nyɛkahãa amɛgbalaa nyɛ ni nyɛjaa amɛ, ni nyɛsɔmɔa amɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, saa nomɛi eto ehã maji krokomɛi lɛ koni amɛ, amɛja nomɛi.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, kɛje dade flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli, koni nyɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛhewɔ lɛ Yehowa na mi mlifu, ni ewo shi akɛ mifoŋ Yordan Faa lɛ, ni miyaŋ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mibagbo yɛ biɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni mifoŋ Yordan lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafo faa lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔ nakai shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhenɔ ni ahia koni nyɛhiɛ akaje kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyafee nɔ ko henɔ amãgã tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, egu nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etamɔ la grigri ni shãa nii wɛɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni.
“Kɛji nyɛfɔ bii ni nyɛna nabii tete, ni nyɛgbɔlɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi nyɛyeee anɔkwa, ni nyɛfee nɔ ko henɔ amãgã, ni nyɛkɛfee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, ni nyɛwo emli la lɛ, no lɛ miitsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ koni amɛye odase amɛshi nyɛ akɛ etsɛŋ ni aaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛbaafo Yordan lɛ kɛya ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛyeŋ be ko yɛ nɔ ni abaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ kwrakwra.
Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã maji krokomɛi anɔ, ni nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ yɛ maji ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã kɛaatee lɛ anɔ.
“Nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi ni ji tsei kɛ tɛi ni gbɔmɔ kɛ enine fee; amɛnaaa nii lɛ, amɛnuuu nii hu, amɛyeee nii, ni amɛnuuu nii fu hu.
Nyɛbaaye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, he kumai yɛ jɛi; ni kɛji nyɛtao esɛɛgbɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛbaana lɛ.
“Kɛji enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛyɛ nɔnaa mli lɛ, nakai gbii lɛ amli nyɛaakpale kɛba Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛaabo lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋtsɔlɔ ji lɛ; ekwaŋ nyɛ, ni asaŋ ekpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ; ni ehiɛ kpaŋ kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni ekã he kitã ehã amɛ lɛ.
“Nyɛbia blema gbii ni eho dani afɔ nyɛ lɛ mli sane akɛ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ko kpeteŋkple tamɔ nɛkɛ sane eba dã lo?
Aloo nyɛbia kɛjɛa ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome kɛyashia ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome hu akɛ anu sane ko ni tamɔ enɛ dã lo?
Ani maŋ ko nɔ bii enu nyɔŋmɔ ko gbee ni miiwie kɛmiijɛ la mli yɛ amɛhiɛ dã, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛnu, ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ?
Aloo nyɛnu nyɔŋmɔ ko eka dã akɛ eeeya maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyakpɔ̃ mɛi komɛi kɛje nakai maŋ lɛ mli ni ebafee mɛi lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ kai kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii, kɛ ta kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kpeteŋkple nɔ efee ehã nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ lɛ?
Ahã nyɛna nibii nɛɛ koni nyɛkɛle akɛ Yehowa koome ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni lɛ esɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ ehã nyɛnu egbee kɛjɛ koni ekɛtsɔse nyɛ; ni ehã nyɛna ela kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛnu ewiemɔ kɛjɛ la mli.
Ni akɛni esumɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eŋɔ amɛshwiei ni ba yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt.
Eshwie maji wuji ni ahe wa kwraa fe nyɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ekɛ nyɛ aba ni eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛtoa nyɛyiŋ, akɛ Yehowa ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; lɛ esɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Yehowa akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii ni baa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ.” Abobaa maji ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Mose hala maji etɛ̃ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, akɛ abobaa maji koni gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni enine eyakpa yɛ enaanyo nɔ, be mli ni jeee nyɛɛ ni enyɛɔ mɔ lɛ eto momo hewɔ, ajo foi kɛya maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli koni ekɛhere eyiwala.
Eŋɔ Bezor maŋ ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ shikpɔŋ trɛnɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhã Rubenbii lɛ; ni eŋɔ Ramot yɛ Gilead ekɛhã Gadbii lɛ, ni eŋɔ Golan yɛ Bashan ekɛhã Manasebii lɛ.
Mose tsɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ naa Nyɔŋmɔ mlai ni Mose kɛshwie Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ nɛ: no mɛi odaseyeli saji kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii be ni amɛjɛ Ijipt amɛbaa, ni amɛbashɛ jɔɔ ni kã Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli, yɛ Betpeor maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ yɛ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni hi Heshbon, mɔ ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ye enɔ kunim, be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt amɛbaa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ shɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Sihon shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshɔ̃ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og ni ji Amorbii amaŋtsɛ kroko ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ hu shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ ni kã Arnon Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ toi kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi Sirion ni ji Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Ŋa kplenee lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ kɛyanina Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ, kɛtee bokãgbɛ kɛyashi Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi fɛɛ fata shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he.
Kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ Mose tsɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛboa akpɔi kɛ mlai ni mibajaje mawo nyɛtoiiaŋ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ toi; nyɛkasea ni nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛye nɔ.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔ kpãŋ yɛ Sinai.
Jeee wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛkpãŋ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wala mli ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, wɔ ekɛkpãŋ lɛ.
Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ nyɛ wie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Mi lɛ, nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, midamɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛ teŋ koni majaje Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ejaakɛ la lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛshe gbeyei, ni nyɛkwɔɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ.
“Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mi mijie bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
“‘Kaana nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko yɛ misɛɛ.
“‘Kaafee amãgã ko ni ji nɔ ko ni tamɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi loo nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo nii ni yɔɔ nu mli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi henɔ ohã ohe.
Kaaja nibii nɛɛ, ni kaasɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ji mi; ni miwoɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii nyɔmɔ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ atɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, kɛyashiɔ yinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛ yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ nɔ.
Shi mɛi akpei abɔ fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ mi, ni amɛyeɔ mikitãi anɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ amɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ni minaa amɛ mɔbɔ hu.’ “Kaahiɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli yakayaka; ejaakɛ Yehowa ebuŋ mɔ ni hiɛɔ egbɛi mli yakayaka lɛ bem.
“Buu hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni oye lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo bo kitã lɛ.
Otsu nii gbii ekpaa, ni ofee onii fɛɛ, shi gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni hã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
No nɔ lɛ okatsu nɔ ko, bo jio, obinuu jio, obiyoo jio, owenuu jio, oweyoo jio, otsinanuu jio, oteji jio, oshĩa kooloo kroko jio, loo gbɔ ni yɔɔ ogboi lɛ amli; bɔ ni afee ni bo kɛ otsuji hii kɛ otsuji yei ajɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ bo nɔŋŋ.
Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ hu nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nineshiwalɛ yakpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
No hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ kitã akɛ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
“Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo bo kitã lɛ, koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ; asaŋ koni ahi ahã bo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
“Kaagbe gbɔmɔ.
“Kaafite gbãlã.
“Kaaju.
“Kaaye amale odase yɛ onaanyo he.
“‘Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ onaanyo nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ; eŋa jio, eshĩa jio, eshikpɔŋ jio, ewenuu jio, eweyoo jio, etsina jio, eteji jio, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji onaanyo nɔ nɔ.’ “Nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ Yehowa kɛ gbee ni wa jɛ la lɛ kɛ atatu kpii lɛ mli ewo nyɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ nɔ ko fataaa he.
Kɛkɛ ni eŋma ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛhã mi.” Maŋbii lɛ she gbeyei “Be ni nyɛnu gbee lɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kpii lɛ mli, be mli ni gɔŋ lɛ tsoɔ kɛ la lɛ, nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ mi, nyɛ kɛ akutseiatsɛmɛi kɛ nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã wɔna enunyam kɛ egbojee, ni ehã wɔnu egbee hu kɛjɛ la lɛ mli.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔna wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ adesa wieɔ, ni mɔ lɛ yi naa wala kɛ̃.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ mɛni hewɔ wɔɔgboi?
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ la kpeteŋkple nɛɛ aaaŋala wɔ wɛɛ.
Wɔbaagboi kɛji wɔnu Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee ekoŋŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ gbɔmɔ adesa enu Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ gbee ni miiwie kɛjɛ la teŋ tamɔ wɔnu nɛɛ, ni eyi ena wala dã?
No hewɔ lɛ, bo tsi obɛŋkɛ Yehowa koni obo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaakɛɛ lɛ toi ni obakɛɛ wɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ bo aaawie.
Wɔbaabo toi, ni wɔbaafee hu.’ “Be ni nyɛkɛ mi wie nɛkɛ lɛ, Yehowa nu wiemɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Minu wiemɔi ni maŋbii lɛ kɛ bo wie lɛ; amɛgbee lɛ ja.
Mina ni kulɛ amɛyɛ nɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ daa koni amɛkɛye mikitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ehi ehã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei kɛya naanɔ.
Yaa ni oyakɛɛ amɛ koni amɛkpale kɛya amɛbui lɛ amli.
Shi bo lɛ, daamɔ biɛ yɛ mimasɛi, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo kitãi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ fɛɛ, koni oyatsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ akɛ amɛye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa amɛ akɛ amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛye kitãi ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nyɛkagbaa kɛyaa ninejurɔgbɛ, ni nyɛkagbaa kɛyaa abɛkugbɛ hu.
Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, koni nyɛna wala yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.”
Kitã Wulu lɛ “Agbɛnɛ kitãi lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kɛ mlai lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fã akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ nɛ, koni nyɛyaye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei awala gbii abɔ fɛɛ mli lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei ni nyɛye akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nɔ koni ahi ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛshwere yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.
“Bo toi, Israel!
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ekoome ji Yehowa.
Suɔmɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ omumɔ fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akã otsui nɔ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ obii fitsofitso.
Owie he be mli ni ota shi yɛ oshĩaŋ; owie he be mli ni onyiɛ gbɛteŋ; owie he be mli ni ojɔɔ ohe kɛ be mli ni otsuɔ nii.
Asaŋ okɛfi onineshi kɛ ohiɛŋtso nɔ hu akɛ hekaimɔ okadi, Oŋma yɛ oshĩa lɛ shinaatsei lɛ kɛ agboi lɛ ahe hu.” Toigbele he kɔkɔbɔɔ “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob, he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ maji wuji fɛɛfɛji ni jeee nyɛ nyɛto; shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ shĩai ni amɛmli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nibii kpakpai ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtsu nyɛwo amɛmli; shikpɔŋ kɛ nubui ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtsatsaai, kɛ wain tromi kɛ mutsei ni jeee nyɛ nyɛtɛo, kɛji nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe nɔ ni ahĩa koni nyɛhiɛ akajea Yehowa, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ, nɔ.
Nyɛshea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei; lɛ ekoome nyɛjaa, ni lɛ pɛ egbɛi nyɛkɛkãa kitã.
Nyɛkayasɔmɔa nɔ kroko yɛ lɛ esɛɛ, ni ji majimaji ni jwere nyɛmasɛi lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, eyeɔ awuŋã, koni emli akawo nyɛ la, ni ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Nyɛkakaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛka lɛ yɛ Masa lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛyea ehe saji lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ ni ewoɔ nyɛ lɛ anɔ; ni nyɛfea nɔ ni ja ni hi hu, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã nyɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he shi lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ shwiemɔ ni nyɛbaashwie nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi lɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ wɔ ko loo wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, ‘Te odaseyeli saji kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ lɛ shishi hu lɛ’, no lɛ nyɛkɛa nyɛbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Sa ko lɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ ye wɔ nyɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa kɛ nineshiwalɛ bajie wɔ kɛje Ijipt.
Yehowa fee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei eshi Ijipt kɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ewebii fɛɛ yɛ wɔhiɛ, ni ejie wɔ kɛje nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ekɛ wɔ aba ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi yɛ he lɛ abahã wɔ.
Ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo wɔ kitã akɛ wɔye nɛkɛ akpɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni wɔshe lɛ gbeyei bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã wɔ daa nɛɛ, koni wɔyi ana wala tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛji wɔjwɛŋ nɔ, ni wɔye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã wɔ lɛ no aaahã wɔsa ehiɛ.’
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ Webii lɛ “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ baaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ebaashwie maji kpawo ni dara, asaŋ ni amɛhe wa fe nyɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Hitbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii amaji lɛ.
Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛwo nyɛdɛŋ nɛkɛ lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ kwraa.
Nyɛ kɛ amɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko, ni asaŋ nyɛkanaa amɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɛkɛ amɛ akabotea gbãlãshihilɛ mli; nyɛkɛ nyɛbiyei akahãa amɛbihii gbãlã lɛ, nyɛkaŋɔa amɛbiyei nyɛhãa nyɛbihii hu gbãlã.
Ejaakɛ amɛbiyei lɛ aaahã nyɛbihii lɛ akpale yɛ misɛɛ ni amɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Enɛ baahã Yehowa mli awo nyɛ la, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ.
Bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aye ahã moŋ nɛ: amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ nyɛkumɔa, ni amɛshiui ni amɛmamɔ lɛ nyɛjwaraa, ni amɛwɔŋkoi lɛ nyɛgbaa nyɛshwiea shi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ nyɛmamɔa amɛnaa la nyɛshãa.
“Nyɛfea nakai ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ nyɛ ehã ehe akɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Eje gbɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛtsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii krɛdɛɛ.
Jeee fa ni nyɛyi fa fe maji fɛɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa sumɔ nyɛ, ni eŋɔ nyɛ akɛ ewebii lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ moŋ po ji mɛi komɛi ni nyɛyi faaa kwraa yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ.
Shi moŋ suɔmɔ ni esumɔɔ nyɛ hewɔ, shi bɔ ni afee ni eye shi ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nineshiwalɛ jie nyɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje nyɔŋ ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo, mɔ ni yeɔ shi ni ewo nɔ, asaŋ ni esuɔmɔ tsakeee yɛ mɛi ni esumɔɔ ni amɛyeɔ ekitãi anɔ kɛyashiɔ amɛshwiei ni ji akpe lɛ ayinɔ tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ, egbalaa amɛtoi, ni amɛnaa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi; ekɛ mɔ ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ toigbalamɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ shi; shi efeɔ, ni mɔ lɛ naa.
No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi kɛ akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛyea nɔ.” Toiboo sɛɛ jɔɔmɔi “Kɛji nyɛbo nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ toi, ni nyɛye nɔ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baaye kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaasumɔ nyɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ.
Ebaasumɔ nyɛ, ni ebaajɔɔ nyɛ, ni ebaahã nyɛyi afa.
Ebaajɔɔ nyɛmusuŋbii hu kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii bɔ ni nyɛbele kɛ nyɛwaintsei kɛ mu kɛ nyɛtsinai kɛ nyɛtoi baashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
Aaajɔɔ nyɛ fe jeŋ maji fɛɛ; nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛkooloo ko hu ehiŋ shi ni efɔŋ.
Ni Yehowa baajie helai fɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ; ehaŋ Ijipt helai fɔ̃ji lɛ eko kwraa aye nyɛ; shi moŋ ebaahã helai nɛɛ aye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Maji fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatu awo nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ni nyɛkajaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã nyɛdu tsɔne.
“Nyɛkakɛa nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Maji nɛɛ ayi fa fe wɔ; te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔnyɛ amɛ wɔshwie lɛ?’ Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkaia helai wuji kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ.
Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baafee maji fɛɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛsheɔ amɛ gbeyei lɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã sosomootii ababote amɛteŋ kɛbahao amɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛteiaŋ mɛi ni baajo nyɛnaa foi amɛyatee amɛhe lɛ tete ahiɛ aaakpãtã.
Nyɛtsui akafãa yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ji mɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ.
Shi fiofio ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baashwie maji nɛɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ.
Nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛkpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ shi kome, no lɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi lɛ ayi baafa fe nine awo nyɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatu amɛ awo nyɛdɛŋ, ni ebaahã amɛ jijaa jijaamɔ wulu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ebaatu maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ewo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛaagbe amɛ, ni amɛgbɛii baalaaje yɛ jeŋ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Nyɛmamɔa amɛnyɔŋmɔi ni ji amãgãi lɛ anaa la nyɛshãa.
Nyɛhiɛ akakɔ̃a jwiɛtɛi loo shika ni yɔɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe lɛ anɔ ni nyɛŋɔ eko nyɛhã nyɛhe, koni no akafee kaa miihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ musu nii ni hã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ musu nii ko akayaa nyɛshĩai amli ni no hã nyɛloo musu tamɔ nii lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Nyaŋemɔ nyɛnyaŋea, ni hi nyɛhia amɛ, ejaakɛ alomɔ amɛ.
Shikpɔŋ Kpakpa ni ayaaŋɔ lɛ “Kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ.
Nyɛkaia gbɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ tsɔ̃ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ nɛɛ mli lɛ, koni ekɛhã nyɛhumi shi, ni asaŋ koni etsɔ̃ nɔ ekɛka nyɛ ekwɛ ni ekɛle nɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ nyɛaaye ekitãi lɛ anɔ lo, aloo nyɛyeŋ nɔ.
Ehã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni ehã nyɛhumi shi; ni ehã nyɛ mana ni nyɛye, niyenii ko ni nyɛleee, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi hu tete leee nɔ ni ji lɛ, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ jeee aboloo pɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala, shi moŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Yehowa daaŋ lɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala.
Nɛkɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ nyɛtadei tserɛɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛnaji efuufuu hu.
Belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miitsɔse nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ tsɔseɔ ebi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ miiya shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ fai kɛ kpaakpoi kɛ shikpɔŋ nu ni tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi kɛ gɔji amli; shikpɔŋ ni ebaa ŋmãa kɛ abele kɛ wainyibii kɛ agbãmi kɛ akutu kɛ mutso kɛ wo hu.
Daaŋŋmãa ni nyɛaaye he esɛŋ, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Dade yɛ emli tɛi lɛ amli; ni nyɛaana akɔɔble hu nyɛtsa yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ amli.
Nyɛbaaye nii nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛbaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Hiɛ akakpa Yehowa nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ “Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia koni nyɛhiɛ akakpa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni no hã nyɛyeee ekitãi kɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛna nii nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, ni nyɛmamɔ shĩai fɛɛfɛji nyɛhi mli, ni nyɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛ nyɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ nyɛshika kɛ nyɛnibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ shwere lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkawo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ miikpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Lɛ mɔ ni ejie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni kpala nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ shiaŋa kpeteŋkple ni nɔ yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ nɔ lɛ, he ni onufui ni naa jaraa kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi kɛ nu hɔmɔ yɔɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ehã nu tue kɛjɛ tswɛrɛbo tɛsaa mli hã nyɛ, ni nyɛna nyɛnu; ni ekɛ mana ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee lɛ, lɛ nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ koni ehã nyɛhumi shi, ni asaŋ koni ekɛka nyɛ ekwɛ, koni naagbee mli lɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni nyɛkakɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiŋ yɛ he akɛ, ‘Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ naa hã wɔshwere nɛkɛ nɛɛ.’ Shi moŋ nyɛkaia akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni duro nyɛ hewalɛ ni nyɛkɛna nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, koni ehã ekpãŋmɔ ni ekã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ ama shi, tamɔ nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Shi naa, kɛji nyɛhiɛ je Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ, ni nyɛshi lɛ sɛɛ, ni nyɛtee nyɛyasɔmɔ ni nyɛja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, no lɛ, miigba mli kpoo miikɛɛ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ kpãtãmɔ kɛ̃ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Bɔ ni Yehowa baahã maji ni nyɛkɛaakpe lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã kɛji nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ toi lɛ.”
Maŋ lɛ gbo toi “Nyɛboa toi, Israelbii!
Nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔji yɛ maji ni dara, ni asaŋ amɛhe wa hu fe nyɛ adɛŋ, shikpɔji kɛ amɛnɔ maji wuji kɛ amɛhe gbogboi ni atswa kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ akɛwaje amɛ.
Shikpɔji nɛɛ anɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ dara ni amɛkwɔlɔ hu.
Anakbii lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni tamɔ nyɛle momo lɛ, nyɛnuɔ akɛ akɛɔ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Namɔ baanyɛ Anakbii lɛ ahiɛ adamɔ?’ Shi moŋ nyɛnaa nyɛlea ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ni nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛyaa lɛ etamɔ la grigri ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.
Lɛ ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ebaaye amɛnɔ, ni ebaajɔɔ amɛhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛshwie amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ oya tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi eto momo lɛ.
“Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eshwie amɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛkakɛa yɛ nyɛtsuiŋ akɛ, ‘Ja ni wɔja hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ ba koni wɔbaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ.’ Dabida!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa baashwie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Jeee nyɛjalɛ loo nyɛtsuiŋ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ hewɔ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ; shi moŋ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miishwie amɛ kɛje nyɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ hewɔ, bɔ ni afee ni, shi ni lɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob lɛ ema nɔ mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ jeee nyɛjalɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɛɛ hãa nyɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ tuuŋtu lɛ maŋ ni kuɛŋ ti ji nyɛ.
“Nyɛkaia, ni nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ, bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛwo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mlifu nyɛhã be mli ni nyɛyɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ.
Nyɛwo Yehowa mli la yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he hu, ni emli fu nyɛ, ni kulɛ eehe nyɛhiɛ ekpãtã.
Be ni mikwɔ gɔŋ lɛ koni miyahe tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ; mihi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; miyeee nii lɛ, minuuu nu hu.
Ni Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ hã mi, nɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewao eŋma wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ, wiemɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ ekɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbi nɔ ni maŋ lɛ kpe kpee wulu lɛ.
Shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ anaagbee lɛ, Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ, hã mi.
“Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kpelekemɔ shi oya ni oya, ejaakɛ omaŋbii lɛ ni okpala kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ eye sane fɔŋ.
Yeee be ko kwraa nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkwa bɔ ni miwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛhi shi amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛshwie amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.’ “Yehowa kɛɛ hu akɛ, ‘Mikwɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ aahu, ni mina akɛ amɛkuɛŋ ti.
No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni mabule amɛshishi kwraa yɛ je lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, mahã oshwiei ashwere ni efɛo ni etsɔ̃ jaku ni da, ni yɛ hewalɛ fe amɛ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke gɔŋ lɛ, ni mihiɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni aŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ.
Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ miitso kɛ la.
Ni mikwɛ, ni naa nyɛfee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi esha; nyɛfee tsina ni ashwie; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛkpale kɛjɛ gbɛ ni Yehowa ewo nyɛ he kitã lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni mihiɛ kɛ miniji enyɔ lɛ tswia shi, ni mijwara amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mitee ekoŋŋ, ni miyagbee shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Miye nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni miyeee nii lɛ, minuuu nu hu, yɛ nyɛtoigbele kɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee Yehowa ni nyɛkɛwo emli la lɛ hewɔ.
Mishe gbeyei akɛ Yehowa kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee kralo akɛ ebaafee nakai.
Shi naagbee lɛ Yehowa bo mi toi nakai be lɛ hu.
Yehowa mli fu Aaron hu jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, bɔ ni he eheɔ lɛ egbe nɛɛ.
Shi mikpa fai mihã Aaron hu.
Kɛkɛ ni miwo tsina amãgã ni nyɛshwie lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, ni mishã, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ mishimɔ, ni miwiɛ lɛ kɛyashi efee munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ mlu, ni mitsi mlu nɛɛ mishwie faa ni jɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ hoɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛku sɛɛ nyɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Tabera kɛ Masa kɛ Kibrot Hataava fɛɛ.
Ni be ni Yehowa wo nyɛ gbɛ yɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ nyɛya koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni ekɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛŋɔ lɛ, no mli hu nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua, ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee, ni nyɛbooo lɛ toi hu.
Yehowa hiɛ atua sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nyɛtseɔ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni mile nyɛ lɛ.
“Miho mikã shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ.
Mikpa Yehowa fai mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakpãtã bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi lɛ, ni ji gbɔmɛi ni oyakpɔ̃ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Kwɛmɔ otsuji Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ahewɔ; kaadi gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akuɛŋtilɛ loo amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ nishaianii lɛ asɛɛ,’ koni shikpɔŋ ni oyakpɔ̃ wɔ kɛje nɔ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ ni Yehowa nyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo amɛ shi yɛ he lɛ nɔ, kɛ agbɛnɛ hu nyɛ ni enyɛɔ amɛ moŋ hewɔ ni eyakpala amɛ kɛtee lɛ, koni eyagbe amɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi ni oje gbɛ oŋɔ ji amɛ, ni oyakpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.’
Aŋma Kitãi lɛ ahã Mose ekoŋŋ “Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ ni tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ tɛi lɛ; asaŋ okɛ tso akpɛ adeka.
Kɔlɔmɔ tɛi lɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mibasaa maŋma wiemɔi ni yɔɔ tsutsu tɛi lɛ ni ojwara lɛ anɔ lɛ mawo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii nɛɛ anɔ ni okɛ tɛi lɛ ato adeka lɛ mli.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, mikpɛ tso adeka ko, ni miko tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ tamɔ tsutsu tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mihole tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ mihiɛ kɛkwɔ gɔŋ lɛ.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fee klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, eŋma kitãi Nyɔŋma lɛ ewo tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ anɔ.
Kitãi nɛɛ ji wiemɔ ni Yehowa jɛ la lɛ teŋ ekɛ nyɛ wie kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbi nɔ ni maŋ lɛ kpe kpee wulu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ hã mi, ni mitsɔ̃ mihe, ni mikpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã akɛ mifee lɛ, mikɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ bawo adeka lɛ ni mikpɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛyɛ mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.” “Mihi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Yehowa bo mi toi nakai be lɛ mli hu, ni eŋɔ nɔ akɛ ekpãtãaa nyɛhiɛ dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa ni oyanyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛya ni amɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ.’ ” Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ Israel, mɛni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, taoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ dɔŋŋ fe akɛ nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyea Yehowa kitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi ni miwo nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ koni ahi ahã nyɛ.
Naa, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ enɔ ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ hu enɔ ni.
Kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa na suɔmɔ krɛdɛɛ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni eŋɔ nyɛ, ni ji amɛshwiei lɛ, yɛ maji fɛɛ ateŋ; ni nakai ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkpliŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkafea nyɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi anuŋtsɔ; lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe ni je agbo, ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ; mɔ ni kwɛɛɛ hiɛiaŋ, ni asaŋ eheee nyɔɔŋnii lɛ.
Eyeɔ awusã kɛ okulafo sane ehãa amɛ, ni edɔɔ gbɔ he, ni ehãa amɛ nɔ ni amɛaaye kɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛaahã amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdɔa gbɔ he ejaakɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyato gbɔ pɛŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛshea Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ; nyɛkpɛtɛa ehe, ni lɛ egbɛi lɛ pɛ nyɛkɛkã kitã.
Nyɛjiea eyi ejaakɛ lɛ ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni asaŋ nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni etsu ehã nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ni tee Ijipt lɛ ayikulɛ ji gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo; shi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛyi efa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii.”
Yehowa agbojee “No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛye egbei kɛ ekpɔi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ daa nɛɛ.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nyɛkaia tsɔsemɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔse nyɛ lɛ, kɛ egbojee lɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛbii ni amɛnako aloo amɛleko nibii nɛɛ ji mɛi ni mikɛ wieɔ nɛɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛle okadii ni efee kɛ nibii ni efee Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ.
Nyɛna nɔ ni Yehowa fee Ijiptbii ata lɛ kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ; bɔ ni ehã Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ baha amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtã be mli ni amɛtiuɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛle nibii ni Yehowa tsu ehã nyɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi beyinɔ ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkaiɔ nɔ ni efee Datan kɛ Abiram ni ji Ruben bi Eliab bii lɛ.
Nyɛ Israel fɛɛ, nyɛhiɛ ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi amɛ kɛ amɛshiaŋbii kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛtsuji kɛ amɛkooloi fɛɛ hu.
Nyɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi na nibii wuji nɛɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu lɛ.” Shiwoo Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔɔmɔi “No hewɔ lɛ, kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe awa koni nyɛnyɛ nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ mli kɛya nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ; asaŋ koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ etamɔɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ, he ni nyɛjɛ lɛ, he ni kɛji nyɛdu nii lɛ ja nyɛkɔ nyɛnane nyɛyashwie dumɔ nii lɛ nɔ nu dã, tamɔ afeɔ abɔɔ mli nii lɛ.
Shi moŋ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ, gɔji kɛ jɔi ashikpɔŋ ni; ni nu nɛɔ nɔ; eji shikpɔŋ ko ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baa yi, ni ehiŋmɛi yɛ he afi muu lɛ fɛɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛye kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ hu asɔmɔ lɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ebaahã nu anɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ebe mli, Agbiɛnaa kɛ Gbo fɛɛ, koni nyɛbele kɛ nyɛwaintso yibii kɛ mutso mu aba ahã nyɛ ni nyɛkpa.
Ŋa nɔ jwɛi afu ahã nyɛkooloi.
Nyɛbaana nii nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia, bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ko akalaka nyɛ ni nyɛkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛja amɛ.
Kɛji nyɛfee nɛkɛ nɔ ko lɛ, Yehowa mli baafu nyɛ, ni ebaatsi nu naa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baŋ nii, ni nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã oya yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miwiemɔi lɛ atoa nyɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ nyɛmumɔ mli; nyɛkɛfimɔa nyɛnijiashi kɛ nyɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ akɛ hekaimɔ nii.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbii; nyɛwiea he be ni nyɛtara shi yɛ shĩateŋ kɛ be ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ, kɛ be ni nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ be ni nyɛtsuɔ nii fɛɛ.
Nyɛŋmaa yɛ nyɛshĩai lɛ ashinaatsei lɛ kɛ nyɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ hu ahe, koni nyɛwala kɛ nyɛbii lɛ hu awala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa wo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛye nɔ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛhi shi pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛtɛ ehe lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa baashwie maji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛbaashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ maji ni dara ni amɛhe wa fe nyɛ ashikpɔji yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ akɛ nyɛnɔ.
He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane aaasa lɛ jɛi aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ.
Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baajɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, kɛyanina Lebanon gɔji lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ; ni ebaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ anaigbɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ nyɛhe gbeyei amɔmɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛaayashɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ adamɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ.
“Naa, mikɛ jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ miishwie nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Ebaafee jɔɔmɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ; shi eeefee loomɔ ehã nyɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ; kɛji nyɛyahiii shi bɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ nyɛhi shi lɛ, ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee sa lɛ.
Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, daamɔ Gerizim Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ koni ojaje nɔ ni ji jɔɔmɔ lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ; ni loomɔ lɛ odamɔ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ ojaje otsɔ̃ɔ.
(Gɔji enyɔ nɛɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ anaigbɛ yɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ More tsei lɛ amasɛi yɛ Gilgal maŋ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ).
Ejaakɛ nyɛbaafo Yordan lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛtee nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni nyɛhi nɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛye akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mlai lɛ hu fɛɛ ni mikɛshwieɔ nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.
Jamɔhe Koome “Akpɔi kɛ mlai ni nyɛjwɛŋ nɔ nyɛye nɔ gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɛ.
Fitemɔ nyɛfitea hei fɛɛ ni maji ni nyɛyaashwie lɛ jaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ jio gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ jio, tsei kusukusuu lɛ fɛɛ ashishi jio.
Nyɛkumɔa amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ shiui ni amɛkɛ tɛi emamɔ lɛ nyɛshwiea; ni amɛ, Ashera, wɔŋ koi lɛ nyɛshãa; amɛtso amãgãi lɛ nyɛfolɔa mli nyɛshwiea shi, koni akaja amɛ yɛ hei nɛɛ dɔŋŋ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ.
“Shi bɔ ni amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee nakai nyɛbaaja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ.
Shi moŋ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baaŋɔ yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ fɛɛ mli akɛ jɛi afee eshihilɛhe kɛ he ni aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nyɛyaa.
Nyɛkɛ kooloi ni agbeɔ akɛ afɔle kɛ afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ kɛ ekrokomɛi lɛ, nyɛnibii amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛshiwoo afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa nikeenii lɛ kɛ nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai akromɔbii lɛ, ayaa jɛi.
Nyɛyea nii lɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ jɛi, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛshĩaŋbii fɛɛ amii ashɛ nyɛhe yɛ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔ nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
“Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, nyɛkafea tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ; bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛnako nyɛshɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, he ni nyɛbaana hejɔlɛ yɛ lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baahã nyɛfee shweshweeshwe bɔ ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi ni baabɔle nyɛ kɛkpe lɛ gbaŋ nyɛnaa, ni nyɛhe baajɔ nyɛ.
Nakai be lɛ, he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, jɛi nyɛkɛ nibii fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã yɛ he lɛ ayaa.
Nibii nɛɛ ji kooloi ni agbeɔ akɛ nyɛfɔlei kɛ afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwo Yehowa shi yɛ he lɛ.
Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ agbaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko ahaŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia koni nyɛkayashãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ ni nyɛaana, akɛ ja he pɛ ni Yehowa baaŋɔ yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ ateŋ ekome mli lɛ.
Jɛi pɛ nyɛshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ; ni jɛi nyɛfee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ yɛ.
“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛgbeɔ nyɛkooloi ni Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, kɛduro nyɛ lɛ nyɛyeɔ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli.
Mɔ ni he tse kɛ mɔ ni he tseee fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye tamɔ baayelɔ loo ofrote nɛkɛ.
Shi moŋ loo lɛ mli lá lɛ eko kɛkɛ ni nyɛkayea; nyɛtsia no nyɛshwiea tamɔ nu.
Nii ni nyɛkɛmiishã afɔle lɛ, nyɛkayea eko yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ eko kwraa mli.
Nyɛbele jio, nyɛwain jio, nyɛmu mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ jio, nyɛtoi loo nyɛtsinai akromɔbii lɛ jio, nii ni nyɛkɛwo shi lɛ jio, nyɛtsuijurɔnaa nikeenii lɛ jio, niyenii afɔlei lɛ jio nyɛkayea yɛ nyɛmaji amli.
He pɛ ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ aye afɔlei lɛ yɛ kɛkɛ ji Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ he ni lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛaatsu lɛ hewɔ.
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ nyɛshikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛhiɛ akakpaa Levibii lɛ anɔ.
“Kɛji be ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, elɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi lɛ, ni eba nyɛtsine akɛ nyɛye loo lɛ, nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛyeɔ loo bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ.
Kɛji nyɛmaji lɛ kɛ he koome ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛgbea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ ni Yehowa kɛduro nyɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli, koni nyɛye bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ.
Mɔ ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni he tse fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye tamɔ baayelɔ loo ofrote nɛkɛ, shi moŋ nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛkaye loo lɛ lá lɛ eko; ejaakɛ lá lɛ wala ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkayea wala lɛ kɛ loo lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛkayea lá lɛ; atsi ashwie tamɔ nu.
Nyɛkayea la lɛ bɔ ni afee ni kɛji nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ahi ahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ.
Shi nyɛnikeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ nyɛshiwoonii lɛ, nyɛkɛyaa he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, koni kooloo afɔle ni ashãa lɛ loo lɛ kɛ lá lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛshã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ; shi loo lɛ nyɛyea.
Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaahi ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ kɛya naanɔ, kɛ nyɛfee nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ lɛ.
Amãgãjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhi nɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni be ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni nyɛyadu tsɔne, ni nyɛkabia amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahe sane ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Te amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛhãa tɛŋŋ,’ ni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai.
Nyɛkajaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ amɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ, nomɛi moŋ amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Amɛgbeɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei tete amɛkɛshãa afɔle amɛhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
“Nyɛyea nibii fɛɛ ni miwo nyɛ he kitã lɛ anɔ; nyɛkɛ nɔ ko akafataa he, ni nyɛkajiea nɔ ko hu yɛ mli.
“Kɛji gbalɔ ko loo mɔ ko ni laa lamɔi te shi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ okadi loo naakpɛɛ nɔ ko miiba, ni okadi lɛ loo naakpɛɛ nɔ lɛ na ba mli anɔkwaleŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛɛ ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee koni nyɛsɔmɔ amɛ lɛ, nyɛkaboa nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo lamɔ shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ toi; ejaakɛ kaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛkaa nyɛ lɛ.
Eetao ena akɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ fɛɛ miisumɔ lɛ Yehowa lɛ lo.
Nyɛjaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei; nyɛyea ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi; nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ, ni lɛ ehe nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akpɛtɛa.
Shi nakai gbalɔ lɛ loo mɔ ni laa lamɔi lɛ agbe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛtse Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli lɛ, hiɛ̃ atua.
Eetao akɛ nyɛkahi shi bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ kitã akɛ nyɛfee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛgbe lɛ koni nyɛjie nakai su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.’ “Onyɛmi ni ji onyɛ musuŋbi, loo obinuu, loo obiyoo, loo oŋa ni kãa osɛɛ, loo oshieŋtsɛ ko ni okɛ lɛ shɛɔ hulu wɔɔ aaalaka bo akɛ ohã nyɛya ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee lɛ, maji ni bɔle nyɛ kpaakpa lɛ kɛ maji ni kɛ nyɛteŋ jɛkɛ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ biɛ kɛyashi biɛ lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, kaakpɛlɛ̃, ni kaabo lɛ toi hu, kaana lɛ mɔbɔ, okabaa eyi, ni okatee enɔ hu, shi moŋ ogbe lɛ.
Bo tsutsu otswa lɛ tɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi.
Atswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo, ejaakɛ eetao akɛ akpala nyɛ kɛje Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ.
No baahã Israel muu fɛɛ anu nɔ ni eba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei koni akaye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ.
“Kɛji nyɛaanu yɛ maji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ ni nyɛhi amɛmli lɛ eko he akɛ nyɛteŋ hii yakagbɔmɛi komɛi ete shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛlaka maŋ lɛ mli bii, ni amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee lɛ, nyɛtaoa sane nɛɛ mli fitsofitso.
Kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ abɔ nɛkɛ musu yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛfãa klante yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ anɔ; nyɛgbea gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ.
Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ mli nibii fɛɛ ni ji haanii lɛ naa nyɛbuaa shi, yɛ maŋ blohu lɛ mli koni nyɛma maŋ lɛ kɛ haanii lɛ fɛɛ naa la nyɛshãa akɛ shãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Akasaa maŋ lɛ ama dɔŋŋ koni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.
Nyɛkaŋɔa musunii lɛ eko kwraa nyɛtoa nyɛhãa nyɛhe bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa afo emlifu ni naa wa lɛ sɛɛ.
Eeena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni eeehã nyɛyi afa tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛbo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛye ekitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.”
Nɔ ni akafee yɛ yarafeemɔ mli “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bii ji nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛmiiye mɔ ko ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛkafolɔa nyɛhe gbɛ̃i, ni nyɛkashɛa nyɛhiɛnaa yɛ gbonyo lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa je gbɛ eŋɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ ateŋ ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Kooloi ni aye kɛ nii akaye “Nyɛkayea nɔ ko nɔ ko ni Yehowa ekɛɛ akɛ ehe tseee.
Kooloi ni nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nɛ: tsina kɛ gwantɛŋ kɛ abotia, kɛ ofrote kɛ baayelɔ kɛ odabɔ kɛ soŋai kɛ duŋ kɛ wuo kɛ otrɔ̃ŋ.
Kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye.
Shi nyɛkayea kooloo ko kooloo ko ja eyɛ kokloto ni agba mli, ni asaŋ egɔiɔ eniyenii, ni esaa etaa ni emiɔ ekoŋŋ.
Kooloi tamɔ yooma kɛ kpɛŋkplɛ kɛ afutuɔkɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛgɔiɔ amɛniyenii ni amɛsaa amɛtaa amɛmiɔ ekoŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi agbalako amɛkoklotoi amli lɛ, amɛhe tseee hãaa nyɛ.
Nyɛkayea kplotoo hu ejaakɛ agba enane kokloto mli enyɔ moŋ nɛ, shi egɔiii eniyenii etaaa.
Nyɛkayea kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko loo; ni kɛji agbe eko lɛ ehe tete po nyɛkataa.
“Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nu mli loo fɛɛ loo ni yɔɔ fiji ni eyɛ totoi hu yɛ ehe.
Shi nɔ ni bɛ fiji ni totoi hu bɛ ehe lɛ nyɛkayea; ehe tseee hã nyɛ.
“Loofɔji fɛɛ ni he tse lɛ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye.
Shi enɛɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkayea: okropɔŋ kɛ akpaŋa kɛ ŋshɔŋ akroma, kɛ oka kɛ laalɔɔ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Loofɔji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji kwãakwãalabite henɔi fɛɛ, kɛ duguma kɛ patu kɛ yaalai kɛ akroma kɛ amɛhenɔi fɛɛ.
Ekrokomɛi ji omiɔhɔɔ henɔi lɛ, kɛ kpokukpoku kɛ guŋ kɛ oka, kɛ gɔ̃dɔ̃ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ, kɛ obleku kɛ aputupata.
“Kooloi nyɛ́ŋɛ́nyɛ́ŋɛ́ ni filikiɔ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛhe tseee, nyɛkayea.
Kooloi ni filikiɔ ni he tse fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea.
“Nyɛkayea kooloo ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo.
Aaanyɛ akɛ kooloo lɛ ahã gbɔ ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli koni eye, aloo ahɔ̃ɔ ahã gbɔ kroko ko, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ji nyɛ.
“Nyɛkahoa toobi kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ enyɛ fufɔ mli nu.” Mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ he mla “Nyɛjiea nyɛŋmɔshi nii mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome daa afi; ni nyɛkɛyaa he koome ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɛyayea nyɛtoi kɛ nyɛtsinai akromɔbii kɛ nyɛbele kɛ nyɛmu ni nyɛnu nyɛwain mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, koni nyɛkɛkase Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛji mɔ oshihilɛhe kɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ teŋ jɛkɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni owoŋ oŋmɔshi nii lɛ mli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ teremɔ kɛ jɛiyaa lɛ, no lɛ hɔɔmɔ ŋmɔshinii lɛ koni okɛ shika lɛ ahiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Okɛ shika nɛɛ ahe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa otsine, too loo jio, tsina loo jio, wain jio, dãa ni wa jio, koni bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ aye yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ jɛi ni nyɛmii ashɛ nyɛhe.
“Nyɛkashĩa Levibii ni nyɛkɛyɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ ahãaa amɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ loo gboshinii ko.
Daa afii etɛ̃ naagbee lɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛŋmɔshi nii lɛ amli mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekomei lɛ fɛɛ anaa nyɛtoa yɛ nyɛmaji amli.
Nyɛkɛ niyenii nɛɛ eko ahãa Levibii lɛ ni ahãaa amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ko lɛ, kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusai kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ koni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ; ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ.”
Heyeli Afi lɛ “Daa afii kpawo lɛ heyeli afi ni.
Bɔ ni afee yɛ afi lɛ nɔ nɛ: Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efa enyɛmi Israelnyo nɔ ko lɛ, ekɛ nɔ lɛ ake mɔ lɛ; ekabi nɔ lɛ shi yɛ enaanyo loo enyɛmi lɛ dɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa efã akɛ ahã mɛi fɛɛ aye amɛhe.
Kɛji mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ ahe yɛ edɛŋ, shi kɛji onyɛmi Israelnyo ni lɛ, no lɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ edɛŋ lɛ okɛke lɛ.
“Ohiafo kome nɛkɛ ehiŋ nyɛteŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baajɔɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ, koni nyɛŋɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi kɛkɛ, ni nyɛaajwɛŋ nɔ nyɛye kitã fɛɛ kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi eto lɛ.
Nyɛbaafala maji babaoo nii, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ; nyɛaaye maji babaoo anɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ maŋ ko yeŋ nyɛnɔ.
“Kɛji nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ko miiye ohia yɛ maŋ ko mli yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, akawa lɛ yi, musuŋ akajoo yɛ nyɛmi ohiafo lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ odɛ̃ŋ akpɔ ahã lɛ, ni ofa lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehia lɛ bɔ ni efĩ lɛ ehã lɛ naa.
Kwɛmɔ koni jwɛŋmɔ gbonyo akaba oyiŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Afi ni ji kpawo ni ji heyeli afi lɛ eshɛ etã’ hewɔ lɛ, otũ ohiɛ owo onyɛmi ohiafo lɛ, ni ohãaa lɛ nɔ ni ebaa ebafa lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛmi ohiafo nɛɛ fo etsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eeebu bo fɔ.
Shi moŋ hã lɛ nii lɛ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ onitsumɔi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine aaata he lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, ohiafo kpãŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ, akɛ nyɛdɛŋ akpɔ ahã nyɛmi Israelnyo ohiafo ni efĩ lɛ yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni akɛ nyɔji aye ahã “Kɛji ahɔ̃ɔ onyɛmi Hebrinyo ahã bo lɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, esɔmɔ bo afii ekpaa; afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, oŋmɛɛ ehe koni eye ehe tswaa.
Shi kɛji oŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa lɛ, kaahã eeya kɛ edɛ̃ folo.
Shi moŋ okɛ otoi lɛ kɛ obele lɛ kɛ owain lɛ eko awo lɛ gbɛ.
Okwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɔɔ bo lɛ nɔ koni ohã lɛ nii lɛ bɔ ni sa ni okɛwo lɛ gbɛ.
Kaimɔ akɛ bo hu kulɛ nyɔŋ ji bo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa kpɔ̃ bo.
No hewɔ ni miwoɔ bo nɛkɛ kitã nɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ esumɔɔɔ akɛ eshi bo, akɛni esumɔɔ bo kɛ owe lɛ ejaakɛ eyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ, no lɛ ŋɔɔ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛba shinaa lɛ naa, ni akɔ fitii ni akɛgbu nyɔŋ lɛ toi.
Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ onyɔŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ afee yoo nyɔŋ hu.
Omusuŋ akashã bo akɛ oooŋmɛɛ nyɔŋ he koni eye ehe tswaa, ejaakɛ ekome lɛ, etsu apaafoi enyɔ anitsumɔ ehã bo afii ekpaa nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔ bo yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ mli.
Toi kɛ Tsinai akromɔbii “Nyɛjɔa nyɛtoi lɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ hu akromɔbii hii fɛɛ ni aaafɔ lɛ anɔ nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ tsinai akromɔbii lɛ akatsua nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni nyɛtoi akromɔbii lɛ hu nyɛkakua amɛhe tsɔi.
Nyɛ kɛ nyɛwekui kɛ nyɛwebii baaya he ni Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ daa afi koni nyɛyagbe kooloi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛye yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi kɛji kpa ko yɛ kooloo ko he lɛ, akpake ni jio, shwilamɔ ni jio, kpa fɛɛ kpa ni eji lɛ, nyɛkɛ no akashãa afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛye nakai kooloo lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli tamɔ nyɛyeɔ soŋai loo ofrote nɛkɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni he tse fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye eko.
Kooloo lɛ mli lá lɛ moŋ kɛkɛ nyɛkaye; nyɛtsia lá lɛ nyɛshwiea tamɔ atsiɔ nu ashwieɔ shi.”
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ “Nyɛhiɛ ahia Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ nyɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Abib nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni nyɛgbea too kɛ tsina akɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ afɔle nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ masha nii akayea Hehoo niyenii lɛ.
Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo gbii kpawo akɛ amanehulu aboloo, ejaakɛ nyɛshi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejojomɔ.
Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo nɛɛ koni nyɛwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛkai gbi ni nyɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Akana mashanii ko yɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko gbii kpawo lɛ fɛɛ.
Asaŋ kooloo ni agbe akɛshã afɔle lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛ lɛ, loo lɛ, akahã je miitsɛre eko nɔ.
“Nyɛkayea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛmaji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ eko eko mli, akɛ ja yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Jɛi nyɛgbe Hehoo afɔle kooloo lɛ yɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi mli be ni hulu yaanyɔ shi lɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa mli nyɛshi Ijipt.
Nyɛhoa kooloo lɛ, ni nyɛyea yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa nyɛshĩaiaŋ.
Nyɛyea ma akpiti aboloo lɛ gbii ekpaa, ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, akpe kpee wulu akɛja Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Akatsu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ.” Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔyeli “Nyɛkanea otsii kpawo kɛjɛ be mli ni abɔiɔ abelekuu lɛ, koni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuijurɔ naa nikeenii ayea otsii agbijurɔ lɛ nyɛkɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eduro bo ehã lɛ naa.
Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli kɛ maŋsɛɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ.
Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛyatsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ Ijipt, ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni nyɛyea akpɔi nɛɛ anɔ.” Asesei Agbijurɔyeli “Kɛji nyɛkɛ nyɛbele ni nyɛkpa lɛ kɛ nyɛwain ni nyɛŋa lɛ eto sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛyea Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo.
Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ kɛ miishɛɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei kɛ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ Levibii kɛ maŋsɛɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi hu ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ.
Nyɛyea gbijurɔ nɛɛ gbii kpawo nyɛkɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nyɛnine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
“Afi fɛɛ afi mli lɛ nyɛteŋ hii fɛɛ abapuea yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ shii etɛ̃, yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Bei nɛɛ ji Ma Akpiti Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Nikpamɔ Gbijurɔ be lɛ kɛ Asesei Agbijurɔ be lɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akabapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ kɛ edɛ̃ folo; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni eeenyɛ.
Ekwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejɔɔ lɛ ehã koni ehã nikee bɔ ni eeenyɛ.
“Nyɛwoa kojolɔi kɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi yɛ nyɛmaji fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hãa nyɛ lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ anaa, koni amɛkojo maŋbii ateŋ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Amɛkaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane; amɛkakwɛ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛkahe nyɔɔŋnii hu, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋniihemɔ shwilaa nilelɔi tete po ahiŋmɛi, ni ehãa atsɔ̃ɔ jalɔ sane hiɛ abuɔ shi.
Naa, nyɛyea jalɛ sane pɛ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
“Kaatɛo tsei ni okɛfee wɔŋ koo ofata Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ ni nyɛbaama lɛ he.
Asaŋ nyɛkamaa shiu ko shiu ko ni ji nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɔ lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe.”
“Nyɛkaŋɔa tsina loo too ni kpa ko yɔɔ ehe nyɛkɛshãa afɔle nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eehi nakai kooloo.
“Kɛji ana nuu ko loo yoo ko yɛ nyɛmaji ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hãa nyɛ lɛ eko mli ni eku Yehowa kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni nii ni migu nyɛ lɛ, etee eyafee, tamɔ akɛ etee eyaja, ni esɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, loo hulu, loo nyɔɔŋtsere loo ŋulamii lɛ eko, ni abatswa nyɛ adafi lɛ, nyɛtaoa sane lɛ mli fitsofitso.
Kɛji nyɛna akɛ eyɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ yɛ Israel lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ajea kpo kɛjea maŋ lɛ mli kɛya maŋ agbo lɛ sɛɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, koni nyɛtswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo.
Shi moŋ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ odaseyeli nɔ adamɔ agbe lɛ; akadamɔ odasefonyo kome wiemɔ nɔ agbe lɛ.
Odasefoi lɛ tsuutsu atswa gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tɛ; ni no sɛɛ dani maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi ni egbo.
Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
“Kɛji sane ni kɔɔ gbɔmɔgbee loo niiaheplemɔ loo awuyeli he ba, ni naataamɔ te shi yɛ sane lɛ yeli mli lɛ, nakai maŋ lɛ mli kojolɔi lɛ kɛ sane lɛ aya he ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, koni amɛkɛ sane lɛ ayafɔ̃ Levibii osɔfoi lɛ kɛ kojolɔ hu ni yɔɔ jɛi nakai be lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ koni amɛkojo.
Bɔ ni amɛaagbe sane lɛ naa amɛhã, yɛ he ni Yehowa eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛŋɔa lɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa bɔ ni amɛaabua sane lɛ he amɛhã lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛnyiɛa gbɛjianɔ ni amɛaato amɛhã nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛkatsakea amɛsanebuamɔ lɛ hiɛ; bɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nakai nyɛfea.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaje gbɛ eshi etsitsi etse kojolɔ lɛ loo osɔfo ni yɔɔ jɛi esɔmɔɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ atua lɛ, esa akɛ agbe lɛ koni akɛgu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii ateŋ.
Kɛ afee nakai lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baanu he, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei, ni mɔ ko ekaŋ asa akɛ eeeye etsui naa sane nakai dɔŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛyeli he Akpɔi “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfee nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛhe shi yɛ nɔ lɛ, eeeba nyɛsusumɔ mli akɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ nyɛhã nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ efee lɛ.
Nyɛaanyɛ nyɛwo maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi efee mɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni jie lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Mɔ lɛ afee nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo.
Nyɛkawoa gbɔ ni ejeee Israelnyo nyɛmaŋtsɛ.
Shi moŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ akahi okpɔŋɔi pii; asaŋ ekawo maŋbii lɛ gbɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahe okpɔŋɔi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛkaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Agbɛnɛ hu maŋtsɛ lɛ akaŋɔ yei pii; ni ekadi shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi sɛɛ tuutu hu koni ekaje Yehowa sɛɛ.
“Kɛji maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bata maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlai nɛɛ anɔ wolo lɛ ni yɔɔ Levibii osɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ nɔ, koni eŋma nakai wolo lɛ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kome ehã ehe.
Wolo lɛ ahi eŋɔɔ, ni ekane ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ekase Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; ni asaŋ eye mlai kɛ akpɔi nɛɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
No ji nɔ ni baahã maŋtsɛ nɛɛ akawo ehe nɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni no hã ekwa kitãi lɛ eko ni egba kɛtee ninejurɔ loo abɛku.
Enɛ baahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei hu amaŋtsɛyeli sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ Israel.”
Osɔfoi agbɛfaŋnɔ “Levibii ni ji osɔfoi akutso lɛ, akahã amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ji afɔlei ni ashãa ahãa mi, Yehowa, akɛ migbɛnaanii lɛ.
Mijɔɔ no nɔ mihã amɛ koni amɛye.
Akahã amɛ shikpɔŋ ni abaaja lɛ eko tamɔ abaahã amɛnyɛmimɛi akutsei krokomɛi lɛ.
Mi ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo amɛ shi lɛ.
“Kɛji akɛ tsina loo too bashã afɔle lɛ, akɛ kooloo lɛ nine lɛ kɛ kadaa lɛ kɛ musuŋ kotoku lɛ ahã osɔfoi lɛ akɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaanɔ ni yɔɔ afɔle lɛ mli.
Klɛŋklɛŋ obele ni obaaku kɛ owain kɛ omu klɛŋklɛŋ ni oooŋa kɛ otoi ahetsɔi ni oooku lɛ okɛhã osɔfoi lɛ tsuutsu.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ Levi kɛjɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni lɛ kɛ eshwiei lɛ asɔmɔ yɛ ehiɛ akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ.
“Levinyo ni miisumɔ baanyɛ eshi Israel maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ koni eya he ni Yehowa eto akɛ aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, esɔmɔ Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ osɔfo tamɔ enyɛmimɛi Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ekɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa niyenii lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; shi nii ni eeena kɛjɛ etsɛmɛiawe lɛ ekome enɔ ni.
Wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ “Kɛji nyɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkakasea jɛibii lɛ amusubɔɔ nii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akagbe ebinuu loo ebiyoo ekɛshã afɔle; akana klamɔfonyo loo ashwãifeelɔ loo okɔmfo loo ŋkunyaayelɔ loo hoŋkpãatsɛ loo sisatsɛlɔ loo ayɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ nii nɛɛ ateŋ eko lɛ; ni no hewɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ nyɛhe.
Awo Gbalɔ he shi “Maji anɔ bii ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛboɔ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi atoi; shi nyɛ lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛfee nakai nɔ ko.
“Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi yɛ nyɛ nyɛteŋ, ni lɛ toi esa akɛ nyɛbo.
“Gbi ni akpe yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛkpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔnyɛŋ wɔnu Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ gbee aloo wɔna enunyam ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram lɛ dɔŋŋ koni wɔkagboi.’ Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Amɛwiemɔ lɛ ja naakpa.
Mibatee gbalɔ ko shi tamɔ bo mahã amɛ, yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã lɛ akɛ ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni booo wiemɔi ni ebaawie yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ toi lɛ, mibagbala mɔ lɛ toi yɛ no hewɔ.
Shi gbalɔ ni aaato lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ni ewie wiemɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli, be mli ni jeee mi mifã lɛ akɛ ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ, ja agbe lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ gbalɔ ko ni aaawie yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi agbɛi amli hu agbe lɛ.’ “Nyɛaabi nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔle gbalɛ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ hu?’ Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ kɛji gbalɔ ko wie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, ni gbalɛ lɛ baaa mli loo ebɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ jeee Yehowa dɛŋ nakai wiemɔ lɛ jɛ.
Gbalɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni to eyiŋ ni ewie, ni no hewɔ lɛ, kaashe nakai gbalɔ lɛ gbeyei.”
Abobaa Maji lɛ “Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãtã maji anɔ bii lɛ ni eŋɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ amɛmaji lɛ kɛ amɛshĩai lɛ ni nyɛhi mli lɛ, -nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa.
Nyɛjaa shikpɔŋ tso muu ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli etɛ̃.
Nyɛhalaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ nyɛtoa bɔ ni afee ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, enyɛ ejo foi oya kɛya jɛi eyaba abo.
“Mla ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni aaajo foi kɛya abobaa maŋ ko mli koni ehere eyiwala lɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni nine aaayakpa yɛ enaanyo nɔ, be mli ni jeee akɛ ebɛ mɔ lɛ ewo emli momo sa lɛ, ejo foi kɛya abobaa maji lɛ eko mli, koni efee shweshweeshwe.
Wɔŋɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛyi enyɔ nyɛtee koo ko mli nyɛyaafo tso, ni be ni nyɛ teŋ mɔ kome wo elema lɛ nɔ koni efo tso lɛ, lema lɛ fã yɛ etso lɛ he, ni eyatswa mɔ kome ni egbe lɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaanyɛ ajo foi kɛya maŋ nɛɛ eko mli, ni eyi aaana wala.
Ejaakɛ kɛji abobaa maŋ kome too ayɔɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli baajekɛ, ni mɔ ni agbe lɛ lɛ wekunyo ni baatɔ mɔ ni egbo lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ, baatiu gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ, be mli ni etsui he ejɔko, ni kɛji eyanina lɛ lɛ, eeetswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ; tsɛbelɛ esaaa akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ agbo, ejaakɛ enyɛko mɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ etoko.
No hewɔ ni mifãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛhala maji etɛ̃ nyɛto lɛ.
-“Nyɛhalaa maji etɛ̃ krokomɛi hu nyɛkɛfataa abobaa maji etɛ lɛ ahe kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛɛ nyɛhusui lɛ amli ehã nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi yɛ he akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ fɛɛ hã nyɛ lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛye nɛkɛ kitãi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni kitãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, ni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Nyɛfea enɛ koni akashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yakatswaa yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaye lá yi sɔ̃.
“Shi kɛji mɔ ko miinyɛ enyɛmi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eyawo enyɛmi lɛ ka, ni etua lɛ, ni etswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ, ni mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ mli egbo, ni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee nɛkɛ abobaa maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ, gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ atsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ yɛ abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛba.
Kɛji akɛ lɛ ba lɛ onukpai lɛ atu lɛ awo mɔ ni esa akɛ etɔ lá he owele lɛ dɛŋ koni egbe gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ.
Akana lɛ mɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ajie mɔ ni eye bem lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ, koni ahi ahã nyɛ.
Blema husui lɛ “Kaajie onaanyo kɛ bo teŋ husu nɔ okadi ni blemabii lɛ eto jeeŋmɔ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa nyɛ koni etsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Odaseyeli he akpɔi “Akadamɔ odasefonyo kome naa wiemɔ nɔ abu mɔ ko fɔ.
Esa akɛ ana odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ anaa wiemɔ dani adamɔ no nɔ kɛbu fɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko to yiŋ sha yɛ enaanyo he, ni ekata sane efɔ̃ enaanyo lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛi enyɔ ni sane kã amɛteŋ lɛ aba osɔfoi kɛ kojolɔi ni tsuɔ nii nakai be lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yehowa jamɔhe lɛ.
Kojolɔi lɛ atao sane lɛ mli fitsofitso.
Kɛji ana akɛ sanetsɛ lɛ je gbɛ ekata sane efɔ̃ enyɛmi lɛ nɔ yaka, ni eye amale odase eshi enyɛmi lɛ, afee lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni etao akɛ afee enyɛmi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Mɛi krokomɛi baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni ebaahã amɛshe gbeyei, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeŋ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ eko yɛ nyɛteŋ dɔŋŋ.” Akana mɔbɔ kwraa; akɛ wala atse wala; akɛ hiŋmɛi atse hiŋmɛi; akɛ nyanyɔŋ atse nyanyɔŋ; akɛ nine atse nine, ni akɛ nane atse nane.
Tawuu he akpɔi “Kɛji nyɛmiiya nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu ta, ni nyɛna amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu shwiilii kɛ tabilɔi babaoo ni ayi fa fe nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni yakpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.
Kɛji be lɛ shɛ ni nyɛbaabɔ̃i ta lɛ wuumɔ lɛ, osɔfo lɛ aje kpo kɛba koni ekɛ tabilɔi lɛ abawie, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Hiiabii Israelbii, nyɛboa toi!
Ta ebanina nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaakpe.
Nyɛtsui akafãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛhe akakpokpoa; nyɛkahãa ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔa nyɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yaa ta lɛ koni ekɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayawu ahã nyɛ koni nyɛye kunim.’ “Osɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni ema tsu hee ni egbeleko naa lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baagbele tsu lɛ naa.
Mɔ hu ni efee waintrom hee, shi ebɔiko emli yibii yeli lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaye trom lɛ mli nii lɛ.
Ni mɔ hu ni etsɛ yoo he baa, shi eyaŋɔko yoo lɛ, lɛ hu eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe, ejaakɛ kɛji eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, mɔ kroko moŋ ni baaŋɔ yoo lɛ.’ “Asaŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni miishe gbeyei, ni etsui efã lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛya ewe koni ekahã enyɛmimɛi tabilɔi krokomɛi lɛ atsui miifã tamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.’ Kɛji asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ wie gbe naa lɛ, afãmɔ tatsɛmɛi ni amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ ahiɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛyanina maŋ ko ni nyɛbaatua maŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃a hiɛ koni nyɛbia maŋbii lɛ kɛji amɛmiisumɔ hejɔlɛ loo ta.
Kɛji ahã nyɛ naajɔlɛ hetoo, ni agbele maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛnyɛa amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛsɔmɔ nyɛ.
Shi kɛji maŋ lɛ kɔɔɔ hejɔlɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ ta lɛ, no lɛ nyɛsaa maŋ lɛ yi.
Kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛye maŋ lɛ nɔ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛgbea emli hii fɛɛ.
Shi maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ, no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, nyɛŋɔa akɛ ta mli nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛduro nyɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nyɛkɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji krokomɛi ni kɛ nyɛteŋ jɛkɛ pii anɔ lɛ aye ahã.
“Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea amɛmaji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛbulea amɛshishi wɛɛ, ni ji Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efã nyɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ.
Nyɛgbea amɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ musubɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛkɛjaa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ koni nyɛkafee esha nyɛshi Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.
“Kɛji nyɛkɛ maŋ ko miiwu ni nyɛsa maŋ lɛ yi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛŋɔ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yisamɔ lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ ehã lɛ, nyɛkafolɔa maŋ lɛ yeli tsei nyɛshwiea, ejaakɛ tsei nɛɛ ayibii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ nyɛbaana nyɛye.
Ani tsei lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni nyɛkɛna ta lɛ lo?
Shi moŋ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛfolɔ tsei ni ayeee amɛyibii lɛ koni nyɛkɛfee tawuu nibii koni nyɛkɛsa maŋ lɛ yi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaye maŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Mɔ ko ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ “Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni agbe lɛ afɔ̃ ŋa nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni aleee mɔ ni gbe lɛ lɛ, nyɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ aya, ni amɛyasusu he ni agbe gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ kɛ maji ni yɔɔ jɛiniiaŋ lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko jekɛmɔ.
Maŋ ni kɛ gbonyo lɛ bɛŋkɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ amɔ tsina oblayoo ni akɛtsuko nii dã.
Amɛkpala tsina lɛ kɛya jɔɔ ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, he ni ahuko ni aduko nii yɛ dã.
Amɛkũ tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɛi.
Osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ, atsi aba ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni Yehowa ehala akɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkojo bei loo mɔnɔtswaa sane fɛɛ sane yɛ egbɛi mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ maŋ ni bɛŋkɛ gbonyo lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ afɔ amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwie tsina oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ aku tsina lɛ kuɛ mli yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nakai be mli lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Jeee wɔ ni wɔshwie lá nɛɛ shi, ni asaŋ wɔleee mɔ hu ni gbe lɛ.
Yehowa, ofainɛ, ona omaŋ Israel ni oyakpɔ̃ lɛ mɔbɔ koni okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ lá shi ni ashwie yaka nɛɛ sɔ̃ akatere Israel.’ Nyɛtsɔ̃a nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ koni nyɛfea nɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ afee lɛ koni nyɛkɛjie mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ lɛ lá yi sɔ̃ kɛje Israel nɔ.” Ta mli yei nomii “Kɛji otee ta, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã oye ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni omɔ nomi, ni yoo fɛɛfɛo ko yɛ nomii lɛ ateŋ, ni oosumɔ lɛ, ni otao akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee oŋa lɛ, no lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ aya owe, ni ohã eshɛ eyi, ni ejie ewaobii anaa; ni etsake ehe nom atade lɛ.
Yoo lɛ ahi owe lɛ, ni efo etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛyashi nyɔŋ kome.
No sɛɛ dani oŋɔ yoo lɛ koni otsɔ̃ ewu, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ oŋa.
Kɛji eshɛ be ko ni osumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ oŋmɛɛ yoo lɛ he koni eye ehe tswaa, koni eya he ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
Obɛ hegbɛ akɛ ohɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ oheɔ shika, ni okaye lɛ nyɔŋ hu ejaakɛ ona ota ehe.” Binuu kromɔ gbɛnaa nɔ “Kɛji nuu ko yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, ni esumɔɔ mɔ kome lɛ, shi esumɔɔɔ mɔ kome; ni ekɛ yei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ fɔ bihii, shi eŋa ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji kromɔbi lɛ, kɛji shɛ be, ni ebaaja egboshinii ehã ebii lɛ, ebɛ hegbɛ akɛ eŋɔɔ yoo ni esumɔɔ esane lɛ binuu akɛ ekromɔ binuu yɛ yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ najiaŋ.
