Yoo ni esumɔɔɔ esane lɛ binuu lɛ ji ekromɔbi, ni lɛ eŋɔ egboshinii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai lɛ toi enyɔ lɛ ehã akɛ kromɔbi gbɛnaa nɔ.” Bi toigbolɔ he akpɔ “Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ binuu toigbolɔ kɛ atuatselɔ, bi ni booo efɔlɔi atoi, tsɛbelɛ amɛmiikã lɛ nɔŋŋ, shi ebooo toi lɛ, no lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛya amɛmaŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ koishi.
Amɛkɛɛ maŋ lɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔbi nɛɛ toigbolɔ kɛ atuatselɔ ni, ebooo wɔ toi lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋtswi ebɔɔ, ni etɔɔ dãa hu.’ Maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ atswia lɛ tɛi koni egbo bɔ ni afee ni akɛjie su fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Israel fɛɛ baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ, ni amɛbaashe gbeyei.” Mlai srɔtoi “Kɛji abu efɔŋfeelɔ ko gbele fɔ, ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ lɛ, akahã egbonyo lɛ miihi tso lɛ nɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ.
Afu mɔ lɛ gbi nɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ kã enɔ koni nyɛkabule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhã nyɛ lɛ.”
“Kɛji ona onyɛmi tsina loo etoo ni edu gbɛ lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã; shi moŋ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛku sɛɛ oyahã onyɛmi lɛ.
Kɛji nɔtsɛ lɛ shĩa bɛŋkɛɛɛ bo, aloo oleee lɛ lɛ, no lɛ kplamɔ kooloo lɛ kɛya bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni kooloo lɛ ahi oŋɔɔ kɛyashi nɔtsɛ lɛ aaababi shi, ni okɛ enii aku sɛɛ ahã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ofee onyɛmi teji loo etade loo enɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje ni ooona; okaho he ni otee.
“Kɛji ona onyɛmi teji loo etsina ni egbee shi lɛ, kaaho ehe ni otee; shi moŋ ye obua koni awo kooloo lɛ nɔ adamɔ shi.
“Yoo akawo hii atade, ni nuu akawo yei atade ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɔ ni feɔ nakai.
“Kɛji ona loofɔlɔ tsu, eyɛ tso nɔ jio, eyɛ shikpɔŋ jio, ni loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ bu ebii lɛ loo ewɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ mli lɛ, kaamɔ loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee.
Obaanyɛ omɔmɔ loofɔlɔ bii lɛ ni oŋmɛɛ loofɔlɔ nyɛ lɛ he, ni ebaahi ehã bo, ni owala sɛɛ baatsɛ hu.
“Kɛji oma tsu hee lɛ, foo afabaŋ okɛbɔle tsu lɛ yiteŋ naabu fɔfɔoo lɛ, koni mɔ ko akaje tsu lɛ yiteŋ ebagbee shi ni obaye elá yi sɔ̃.
“Kaadu nɔ kroko ofutu wain yɛ owain trom mli; no lɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ kwa, wain yibii lɛ ni jio, nii ni odu ofutu lɛ lɛ ni jio, baatsɔ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni fɛɛ baaŋmɛɛ bo.
“Kaatsa tsina kɛ teji fɛɛ okɛhu.
“Kaawo atade ni akɛ odonti kpãa kɛ kuntu kpãa lo lɛ asaasaa.
“Feemɔ ahwanya owo otade koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe.
Oblayoo foro hemujiwoo he mlai “Kɛji nuu yaŋɔ yoo, ni be ni ekɛ lɛ ena bɔlɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ esumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, efolɔ hiɛgbeji asaji eshwie yoo lɛ nɔ akɛ be ni ekɛ lɛ bɔ lɛ enaaa lɛ akɛ oblayoo foro lɛ, no lɛ oblayoo foro lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ akɔ okadi ni yeɔ he odase akɛ amɛbi lɛ oblayoo foro ni lɛ, kɛya onukpai lɛ ahiɛ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi.
Oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ akɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, ‘Mikɛ mibiyoo nɛɛ hã nuu nɛɛ gbãlã; shi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ etaooo lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, efolɔ heguɔgbee saji eshwie mibiyoo lɛ nɔ akɛ enaaa lɛ oblayoo foro.
Shi naa okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mibiyoo lɛ oblayoo foro ni.’ No sɛɛ lɛ, fɔlɔi lɛ alɛɛ mama lɛ mli amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ amɔ nuu lɛ koni agwao lɛ.
Gwaomɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agbe lɛ shika gbele jwiɛtɛi shekeli oha; ni akɛ shika nɛɛ ahã oblayoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ewo Israel fɔmɔbi oblayoo foro lɛ he muji yakatswaa.
Yoo lɛ atsa nɔ ni ekɛ nuu lɛ ahi shi akɛ eŋa; ni nuu lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ yoo nɛɛ kɛyaashi lɛ nuu lɛ aaashi jeŋ.
“Shi kɛji sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ nuu lɛ enaaa oblayoo lɛ akɛ oblayoo foro lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ akpala oblayoo lɛ kɛya etsɛ agbo naa, koni maŋ lɛ mli hii atswia oblayoo lɛ tɛi ni egbo, ejaakɛ efee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel akɛ ele nuu dani eshi etsɛ we lɛ etee gbãlã.
Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaajie su fɔŋ nɛɛ kɛje nyɛteŋ.
“Kɛji ana nuu ko ni ekɛ mɔ ko ŋa miina bɔlɛ lɛ, agbe nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ koni akɛgu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ Israel.
“Kɛji atsɛ oblayoo foro ko he baa, ni nuu kroko kɛ lɛ kpe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkpalaa nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛyaa nakai maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa koni atswia amɛ tɛi yɛ jɛi ni amɛgboi.
Yoo lɛ sa gbele ejaakɛ maŋ teŋ eyɔɔ, ni ebaanyɛ ebo etsɛ; shi ebooo; nuu lɛ hu sa gbele ejaakɛ efite enaanyo ŋa.
Kɛtsɔ̃ nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbaagu su fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
“Shi kɛji ŋa mli nuu lɛ na oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ, ni nuu lɛ mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe nuu lɛ kome pɛ.
Oblayoo lɛ, akafee lɛ nɔ ko ejaakɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko ni sa akɛ agbe lɛ yɛ no hewɔ.
Bɔ ni mɔ ko teɔ shi etuaa enaanyo ni egbeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ nuu lɛ mɔ oblayoo ni atsɛ ehe baa lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ; ni oblayoo lɛ bolɔ, shi mɔ ko bɛ jɛi ni aaahere lɛ.
“Kɛji nuu ko kɛ oblayoo foro ni mɔ ko etsɛko ehe baa kpe, ni emɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ, nuu lɛ awo oblayoo foro yinii, ni ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ehã oblayoo foro lɛ tsɛ.
Yoo lɛ atsɔ̃ nuu lɛ ŋa, ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ni nyɛ oblayoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ lɛ; asaŋ nuu lɛ wala beiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ enyɛŋ yoo nɛɛ eshwie gbi ko gbi ko.
“Nuu ko nuu ko bɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ etsɛ ŋa loo etsɛ hemɔ naa bɔlɛ, koni ekɛshwie etsɛ hiɛ shi.”
Mɛi ni jeee Yehowa webii “Nuu ni afo enuutso aloo asa lɛ lɛ, ekaya Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
“Ajwamãŋbi ko akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli; ni eshwiei kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
“Amonnyo loo Moabnyo akaba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ bii tete amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akaba gwabɔɔ lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko; ejaakɛ be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt ni nyɛbaa lɛ, amɛhiɛɛɛ niyenii kɛ nu amɛkɛbakpeee nyɛ, shi moŋ amɛyabɔ Beor binuu Balaam apaa kɛjɛ Petor yɛ Mesopotamia akɛ ebalomɔ nyɛ.
Shi Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, booo Balaam toi, shi moŋ ehã loomɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miisumɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛkataoa amɛ ekpakpa loo ejurɔyeli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
“Nyɛkanyaŋea Edombii ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi ji amɛ, ni nyɛkanyaŋea Ijiptbii hu ejaakɛ nyɛyato gbɔ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛŋ.
Amɛshwiei ayinɔ ni ji etɛ̃ kɛyaa lɛ nɔ bii baanyɛ amɛba Yehowa gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Muji akahi tabilɔi ahe “Kɛji nyɛfã ta ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi yaawu ni nyɛyato shi yɛ he ko lɛ, nyɛlea nyɛhenɔ kwɛmɔ koni nyɛkafee nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko.
Kɛji muji ba nuu ko he yɛ shitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ eshwie ehe shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ aje shitoohe lɛ mli koni eyahi sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Gbɛkɛnaashi mli lɛ ekɛ nu aju ehe, ni kɛ hulu nyɔ shi lɛ eku esɛɛ eba shitoohe lɛ mli.
“Ato he ko akɛ kuŋtso yɛ shitoohe lɛ sɛɛ koni aya jɛi.
Mɔ ni miiya kuŋtso nɔ ahiɛ tso hu afata etawuu nii he.
Ekɛ tso nɛɛ atsa bu koni esɔ̃ nɔ; ni kɛji egbe naa lɛ etsi wamɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa, nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ jɛi bɔ ni afee ni ebu nyɛhe, ni asaŋ ehã nyɛye nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim.
No hewɔ lɛ, muji nɔ ko akahi shitoohe lɛ mli koni ehã Yehowa kpa yɛ nyɛsɛɛ.” Mlai krokomɛi “Kɛji nyɔŋ ko jo foi yɛ enuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ebaba Israelbii abo lɛ, akakpale nyɔŋ lɛ ayahã enuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhãa ekɛ nyɛ ahia shi yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ mli; ni nyɛkayea lɛ nyɔŋ.
“Israel fɔmɔbi, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, akafee ehe jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamãŋbɔlɔ.
Nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli shika akabahã yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ mli yɛ eshiwoo ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi jamɔhe lɛ mli ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ.
“Kɛji ofa onyɛmi Israelnyo shika loo niyenii loo nɔ ko ni aheɔ ehe kpa lɛ, lɛ lɛ kaahe lɛ nii lɛ he kpa.
Mɔkpɔŋ lɛ, hemɔ lɛ nii lɛ he kpa; shi Israelnyo lɛ kaahe lɛ nii he kpa.
Nyɛyea mla nɛɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baajɔɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaatsu nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
“Kɛji owo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi lɛ kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli lɛ sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, baabi bo nyɔmɔ yɛ shiwoo lɛ he; ni no aaafee esha ehã bo.
Ejeee tɔ̃mɔ kɛji owooo Yehowa shi; shi kɛji ona owo shi lɛ, esa akɛ ojwɛŋ nɔ koni oye shiwoo lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni owo Yehowa shi yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ.
“Kɛji otee onaanyo waintrom mli lɛ, obaanyɛ oye wain yibii lɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ; shi moŋ okatse yibii lɛ eko owo onii amli akɛ okɛmiiya shĩa.
Kɛji oyabote onaanyo ŋmaaŋmɔ mli lɛ, obaanyɛ okɛ onine aku ŋmaa lɛ eko ni okpe bɔ ni ooonyɛ, shi okɛ nikpamɔ kakla akakpa ŋmaa lɛ.”
Gbãlãmligbalamɔ kɛ gbãlãmlibotemɔ ekoŋŋ “Kɛji nuu ko ŋɔ yoo ko efee eŋa, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ nuu nɛɛ naaa yoo lɛ he miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena hiɛgbejianii ko yɛ yoo lɛ he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eŋma mligbalamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ, ni yoo nɛɛ tee ni eyagbã nuu kroko, ni sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ hu eyasumɔɔɔ yoo lɛ, ni lɛ hu eŋma mligbalamɔ wolo ekɛwo yoo lɛ dɛŋ, ni ehã eje ewe lɛ, aloo sɛɛkpee wu nɛɛ gbo lɛ, no lɛ yoo nɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ wu ni shwie lɛ lɛ aka ŋɔ yoo lɛ ekɛmiifee eŋa ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ abule yoo lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ miihi nɛkɛ gbãlãshihilɛ.
Nyɛkafea nɛkɛ esha ni nyɛkɛmiibule shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.
Mlai krokomɛi “Kɛji nuu ko kpee yoo hee lɛ, ekaya ta; ni akɛ nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko akafɔ̃ enɔ akɛ etsu.
Ahã eye ehe afi naakplɔ yɛ eshĩa teŋ koni ehã eŋa ni ekpee lɛ mii ashɛ ehe.
“Mɔ ko akahe enaanyo wiɛ loo wiɛbi akɛ awabatoonɔ, ejaakɛ kɛji efee nakai lɛ belɛ gbɔmɔ wala eheɔ akɛ awaba lɛ.
“Kɛji ana mɔ ko ni eju enyɛmi Israelnyo, ni eeye lɛ nyɔŋ aloo eyahɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ, agbe nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ koni akɛgu nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
“Kɛji hewolo nɔ hela gbonyo ko mɔ mɔ ko lɛ, ekwɛ ni ahi, ni ejwɛŋ nɔ, ni efee bɔ ni osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ efee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ, ni nyɛfea bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ osɔfoi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Miriam yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ.
“Kɛji ofa onaanyo ko nɔ ko lɛ, kaatiu lɛ kɛtee eshĩa mli koni oyahe nɔ ni ekɛbaato bo awaba lɛ; shi moŋ daamɔ agbo naa, ni mɔ ni okɛ nii lɛ efa lɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni ekɛtoɔ awaba lɛ baaje kpo ekɛbahã bo.
Kɛji ohiafo ji lɛ lɛ kaahã ehebo lɛ hi oŋɔɔ ni obu kɛwɔ ni je tsɛre nɔ.
Kpalemɔ ohã lɛ kɛji hulu yaanyɔ shi, bɔ ni afee ni ohiafo lɛ ana ehebo lɛ ebu kɛwɔ koni eda bo shi; ni osane baasa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
“Kaawa apaafonyo ohiafo ni efĩ lɛ yi.
Nyɛnyɛmi Israelnyo ni jio, gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ ateŋ eko ni jio, akawa lɛ yi.
Wo lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ apaa ni obɔ lɛ lɛ he nyɔmɔ dani hulu anyɔ shi (ejaakɛ ohiafo ji lɛ, ni nakai nyɔmɔwoo lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔleɔ), koni ekafo etsɛ Yehowa ewo bo, ni no tsɔ̃ esha ehã bo.
“Tsɛmɛi akagbo bii ayi gbele, ni bii hu akagbo tsɛmɛi ayi gbele; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ agbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔŋ ni efee hewɔ.
“Kaatsɔ̃ gbɔ loo awusã sane hiɛ obu shi; ni kaahe okulafo hebo akɛ awaba.
Shi nyɛkaia akɛ aye nyɛ nyɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛje jɛi; no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitã nɛɛ koni nyɛye nɔ lɛ.
“Kɛji okpa oŋmɔshinii, ni ohiɛ kpa ke kome nɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛŋ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ oyawo; shi moŋ oshi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛji otse omutso yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaku osɛɛ okpa niji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ otserɛ nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ; shi nomɛi ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.
Kɛji otse owaintrom mli yibii sɛɛ lɛ, kaaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ trom lɛ mli dɔŋŋ; shi yibii ni eshwɛ kpɛkpɛo lɛ ohã gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo.
Nyɛkaia akɛ nyɔji ji nyɛ yɛ Ijipt, ni no hewɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛ kitãi akɛ nyɛfee nɛkɛ lɛ.”
“Kɛji mɛi enyɔ miibe, ni amɛkɛ amɛsane lɛ tee kojomɔhe koni akojo lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ bem lɛ abu lɛ bem, ni mɔ ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ abu lɛ fɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ sa yii lɛ, kojolɔ lɛ ahã abu lɛ shi koni ayi lɛ kpãa, yɛ lɛ kojolɔ lɛ ehiɛ, yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ naa.
Kɛji efa aahu lɛ atswa lɛ kpãa nyɔŋmai ejwɛ; akateke nɔ, no lɛ ashwie onyɛmi Israelnyo lɛ hiɛ shi yɛ ohiɛ.
“Tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ akawo enaabu kotoku.
Nɔ ni afee ahã nyɛmi ni egbo “Kɛji nyɛmimɛi hii enyɔ hi shi yɛ he kome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome gbo ni ebɛ binuu lɛ, mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ akashi weku lɛ mli eyagbã mɔkpɔŋ.
Ewu ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ gbɛnaa ji akɛ eŋɔ yoo lɛ akɛ eŋa koni etsu wu gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ.
Kromɔ binuu ni yoo nɛɛ aaafɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ nuu ni egbo lɛ bi kɛ niyelɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ eŋɔɔ enyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ, no lɛ enyɛminuu lɛ ŋa lɛ aya maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Miwu nyɛmi nuu lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ mi awo shwie ahã enyɛmi nuu lɛ koni enyɛmi lɛ gbɛi akalaaje yɛ Israel; esumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ wu nyɛminuu gbɛnaanii ehãa mi.’ Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ atsɛ mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ, koni amɛ kɛ lɛ awie he.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ma nɔ mi ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Misumɔɔɔ akɛ maŋɔ lɛ akɛ ŋa lɛ’, no lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ nyɛmi nuu lɛ okulafo lɛ atsi abɛŋkɛ ewu lɛ nyɛminuu lɛ yɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni ejie nuu lɛ tokota nane kome yɛ ehe, ni efɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie nuu lɛ hiɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni sa nuu ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ esaa enyɛminuu we nɛ.’ Ni nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ abaatsɛ ewe yɛ Israel akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni ajie etokota we’.
Mlai krokomɛi “Kɛji hii miinɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ŋa tsi ebɛŋkɛ koni ebahere ewu lɛ yɛ enaanyo ni enine etsɔ̃ ewu lɛ nɔ dɛŋ, ni yoo nɛɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ nuu kome lɛ nuutso lɛ, afo yoo nɛɛ nine lɛ; akana yoo lɛ mɔbɔ ko kwraa.
“Kaato nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi enyɔ, nɔ ni shɛɔ kɛ nɔ ni shɛɛɛ yɛ oflɔtɔ mli; ni kaato susumɔ nii hu srɔtoi enyɔ yɛ shĩa, nɔ ni da kɛ nɔ ni edaaa.
Nyɛhãa nsɛnitɛ kɛ susumɔ nii lɛ ashɛa shishiishi koni nyɛwala sɛɛ atsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miihi mɛi fɛɛ ni shishiuɔ mɔ.
“Nyɛkaia nɔ ni Amalekbii lɛ fee nyɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni nyɛjɛ Ijipt nyɛbaa lɛ, bɔ ni amɛyasheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ ni amɛtua nyɛ, be ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛtɔ biti lɛ, ni amɛgbegbee nyɛsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, nyɛbulea Amalekbii lɛ ashishi kwraa koni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ.
Nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ.”
Ŋmãakpamɔ “Kɛji oyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhãa bo akɛ onɔ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ohi nɔ lɛ, okɛ klɛŋklɛŋnii ni obaakpa, yɛ oŋmɔ mli yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa eŋɔ ehã bo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eko awo kɛntɛŋ mli koni okɛya he koome ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Yaa osɔfo ni tsuɔ jɛi nii nakai be mli lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ mibashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe shi akɛ ekɛbaahã wɔ lɛ nɔ.’ “Kɛkɛ lɛ Osɔfo lɛ baahe kɛntɛŋ lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, koni ekɛma Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Aramnyo ni ebɔ ko ji mitsɛ; ekɛ mɛi fioo ko tee Ijipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ jɛi.
Shi eshwiei ayi bafa, ni etsɔ̃ maŋ kpeteŋkple ni he wa yɛ jɛi.
Shi Ijiptbii lɛ hiɛ wɔ soisoi, ni amɛwa wɔ yi, ni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni wɔbolɔ wɔtsɛ Yehowa, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebo wɔ toi, ni ena bɔ ni ahaoɔ wɔ lɛ kɛ deŋme ni wɔgboɔ lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ayeɔ wɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bakpɔ̃ wɔ yɛ Ijipt yɛ ehewalɛ kɛ enineshiwalɛ naa.
Ehã naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei nibii ba, ni ekɛto okadi.
Ni ekɛ wɔ eba biɛ nɛɛ, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ hã wɔ, shikpɔŋ ni ewo fɔ ni baa nii babaoo lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni bo, Yehowa, okɛhã mi lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔshi nii ni mikpa lɛ eko eba.’ “Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ okɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ ama Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni oja yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ hiɛ.
Onya nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eduro bo lɛ he, bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii kɛ Levibii kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ.
“Afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni ji mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome hãmɔ afi lɛ, kɛji okɛ oŋmɔshi nii mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ ehã Levibii lɛ kɛ gbɔi lɛ kɛ awusãi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ ogbe naa, koni amɛna nii amɛye yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, yaakɛɛ yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ akɛ, ‘Mijie nii krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ minii mli yɛ miwe lɛ, ni mikɛhã Levibii kɛ gbɔi kɛ awusãi kɛ okulafoi bɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ.
Mitɔ̃ko okitãi lɛ eko nɔ, ni mihiɛ hu kpako kitã ko nɔ.
Miyeko nii nɛɛ ni mijie lɛ eko yɛ mikɔmɔyeli beiaŋ lɛ, mifiteko nii lɛ eko be ni mibule mihe lɛ, mikɛ eko hu eshãko afɔle mihãko gbonyo ko.
Miye Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee nɔ, ni mifee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo mi shi akɛ mifee lɛ.
Jɛɛ oshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni okwɛ koni ojɔɔ omaŋ Israel kɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni okɛhã wɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni okã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã lɛ.’ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ webii “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miiwo bo kitã akɛ oye ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ koni okɛ otsui kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ aye nɔ.
Ogba mli kpoo ŋmɛnɛ okɛɛ Yehowa akɛ lɛ ji oNyɔŋmɔ, ni obaaba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, ni obaaye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ, ni obaabo lɛ toi.
Yehowa hu egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji bo tamɔ bɔ ni ewo bo shi lɛ, ni eebi bo koni oye ekitãi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni yɛ yijiemɔ kɛ gbɛi kɛ anunyam gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Israel agbojee akwɔ fe maji fɛɛ agbojee yɛ je lɛ mli.
Oootsɔ̃ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ Mlai ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi anɔ Agbɛnɛ Mose kpã ewo maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ, yɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni gbi nɔ ni nyɛaafo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛholea tɛi kpelei nyɛmamɔa shi, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee trotro, koni nyɛŋmã nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛwo amɛnɔ, ni nyɛkɛya shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi eto lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛi ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ amãmɔa shi yɛ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛmaa hiɛ ni amɛnɔ afee trotro.
Nyɛmaa afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ tɛi ni akɛ dade naa esako amɛhe dã, ejaakɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni amaa akɛhã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni dade naa esako he ama.
Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ nyɛkɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛshãa shidaa afɔlei lɛ hu yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛyea nii yɛ jɛi koni nyɛnyaa yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.
Ni nyɛŋmaa nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ, koni amɛje shi faŋŋ yɛ tɛi lɛ anɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose kɛɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ osɔfoi ni ji Levibii lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛfea diŋŋ ni nyɛboa toi.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ maŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛyea ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nɔ.” Toigbele he Loomɔi Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Mose fã Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ, akutsei nɛɛ adamɔ Gerizim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛjɔɔ maŋ lɛ: Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Yosef kɛ Benyamin.
Ni akutsei nɛɛ hu adamɔ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛlomɔ: Ruben kɛ Gad kɛ Asher kɛ Zebulon kɛ Dan kɛ Naftali.
Ni Levibii lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛɛ Israel muu fɛɛ akɛ, “‘Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaalɔ nilee nɔ ekɛ su loo tso loo dade feɔ amãgã ni ejaa lɛ yɛ teemɔŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “Alomɔ mɔ ni wooo etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni tsiɔ lɛ kɛ enaanyo teŋ husu nɔ okadi kɛyaa sɛɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni hãa shwilafo duɔ gbɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɔ kɛ awusã kɛ okulafo sane hiɛ ebuɔ shi.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ewo etsɛ hiɛ mama nɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi loo enyɛbi wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ eshaayoo ni ji eŋa nyɛ wɔɔ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ yɛ teemɔŋ lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni eyagbe mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ “‘Alomɔ mɔ ni yeee nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ anɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehaŋ mlai lɛ ama shi lɛ.’ Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Amen!’ ”
Toiboo he Jɔɔmɔi “Kɛji ooobo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni ooojwɛŋ nɔ, ni oooye kitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baawo onɔ gojoo fe shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ.
Obaana Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni jɔɔmɔi nɛɛ aaanina bo yɛ he fɛɛ he kɛji ooobo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi.
“Aaajɔɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaajɔɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
“Aaajɔɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ oshĩaŋ kooloi abii kɛ otoi kɛ otsinai abii fɛɛ.
“Aaajɔɔ okɛntɛŋ ni okɛyakpaa nii lɛ kɛ otsese hu.
“Aaajɔɔ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ.
“Yehowa aaahã oplene ohenyɛlɔi ni aaabatua bo.
Amɛaanyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛaabatua bo, shi amɛaatsɔ̃ gbɛi kpawo nɔ amɛaajo foi kɛaaje ohiɛ.
“Yehowa aaajɔɔ onitsumɔ, ni eeehã oboŋoi ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛ onine taa he aaashwere; ni eeejɔɔ bo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
“Yehowa aaaŋɔ bo, Israel, akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã bo kitã lɛ, kɛji oye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ.
No lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaana akɛ Yehowa kɛ egbɛi ewo bo akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ, ni amɛbaashe bo gbeyei.
Yehowa baahã oshwere babaoo.
Omusuŋ bii kɛ okooloi abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ewo otsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã bo lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa aaagbele eŋwɛi niikpakpai anaa ehã bo; eeehã nu anɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ be ni sa mli; eeejɔɔ onine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ nɔ; ooona nii, ni ooofala maji pii nii, shi bo lɛ ofaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko dɛŋ.
-Kɛji oooye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi lɛ, ni ji kitãi ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ni oookwɛ ni oooye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, asaŋ kɛji okplaŋ kɛjeŋ kitã ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ eko he, ni ogbaŋ ninejurɔ loo abɛku, ni oyanyiɛŋ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni oyajaŋ amɛ lɛ, Yehowa aaafee bo yitso, shi jeee lei; onɔ sɔŋŋ ebaawo, ni ebaŋ bo shi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Toigbele yibii “Shi kɛji aaaba mli akɛ obooo Yehowa toi ni ojwɛŋŋ nɔ ni oye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ miimɛ bo: “Aaalomɔ bo yɛ maŋ, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ ŋmɔshi hu.
“Aaalomɔ okɛntɛŋ kɛ otsese hu.
“Aaalomɔ omusuŋ bii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ otsinai abii kɛ otoi abii.
“Aaalomɔ bo yɛ oyaa mli, ni aaalomɔ bo yɛ obaa mli hu.
“Yehowa aaalomɔ bo, ni eeehã ojijaa, ni onijiaŋ aaaje wui yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofee mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaafite bo, ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã oya mli yɛ nibii fɔ̃ji ni ofee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ okwa Yehowa.
Yehowa aaahã oye gbele hela kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni oyaa koni oyaŋɔ okɛfee onɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa aaahã oye wɔlɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ atridii kɛ fuumɔ hela; ebaahã jeŋ adɔ waa, ni nu enɛŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ tamɔ la aaatswa, ni nibii aaaŋala.
Nibii nɛɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ oyiteŋ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ akɔɔble, ni shikpɔŋ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ dade.
Yehowa aaahã shia kɛ mlu atsɔ̃ onu ni aaanɛ ahã bo; amɛaajɛ ŋwɛi amɛbayi bo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
“Yehowa aaahã henyɛlɔi aye onɔ.
Ooonyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ kɛyatua amɛ; shi gbɛi kpawo nɔ oootsɔ̃ ojo foi kɛje amɛhiɛ.
Osane lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelihei fɛɛ atsui afã.
Ogbonyo aaatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, ni onaŋ mɔ ko po ashwie amɛ kɛje ohe.
Yehowa aaahã asanei ni ye Ijiptbii lɛ eko kɛ fala kɛ abuasha kɛ kpla ni ehiii tsamɔ aye bo.
Yehowa aaahã oye sɛkɛ, ni oooshwila, ni oyiŋ baakã bo.
Ooogbugbuu shi shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ shwilafo ni yɔɔ duŋ mli be fɛɛ be.
Obaatsɔ ogbutsɛ, ni onɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa shwereŋ, ni aaahi bo nyɔŋyeli kɛ ojotswaa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ daa nɛɛ, ni onaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni aaahere bo.
“Oootsɛ yoo he baa, shi nuu kroko moŋ ni kɛ lɛ aaawɔ; oooma tsu, shi owɔŋ mli; ni ooofee waintrom, shi oyeŋ emli yibii.
Ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ otsina agbe, shi onaŋ eloo lɛ eko oye, ni ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaamɔ oteji akranaŋ naa kɛya, ni akpaleŋ lɛ abahaŋ bo dɔŋŋ.
Abaahã ohenyɛlɔi abamɔmɔ otoi kɛya, ni onaŋ mɔ ko abahere bo.
Abaaŋɔ obihii kɛ obiyei akɛ nomii ahã mɛi kpɔ̃ji be mli ni oona kɛ ohiŋmɛi nɔŋŋ, ni obaakwɛ amɛsɛɛkuu gbɛ kɛ tɔlɛ daa gbi; shi onyɛŋ he nɔ ko ofee.
Maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni oleee kwrakwra aaaba ebaloo oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛ nii ni otsu oto fɛɛ kɛya eyaye.
Yi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaawa bo, ni shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ aaashwishwia bo daa nɛɛ, ni ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni ooona lɛ aaaye bo sɛkɛ.
Yehowa aaahã asanei ni anaa jaraa ni ehiii tsamɔ atsɛ̃rɛ onakutsei anaa kɛ oshuɔji ahe; ebaatsɛ̃rɛ kɛjɛ oyiteŋ aahu kɛyashi onaneshi.
“Yehowa aaakpala bo kɛ omaŋtsɛ ni oto ohã ohe lɛ fɛɛ kɛaatee maŋsɛɛ maŋ ko ni bo loo otsɛmɛi leee mli; jɛi oooyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ fee yɛ.
Oootsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ kɛ naakpɛɛ nɔ ni akɛbaabu abɛ yɛ maji amli he ni Yehowa kɛ bo aaatee lɛ.
“Okɛ dumɔ wui babaoo baaya oyadu yɛ ŋmɔ mli, shi nii fioo pɛ obaana okpa kɛba, ejaakɛ baalabii aaaye tsiimɔ.
Ooofee waintromi, ni obaakura amɛ, shi onaŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko onu lɛ, onaŋ amɛmli yibii lɛ eko hu oye, ejaakɛ gɔgɔmii aaaye.
Obaahi mutsei yɛ okpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ, shi onaŋ mutso mu okpa, ejaakɛ omutsei lɛ ayibii lɛ aaakpala be mli ni amɛsrako.
Ooofɔ bihii kɛ biyei nɛ, shi ohiŋ bi, ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ nom.
Otsei lɛ kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii lɛ baalabii aaaye fɛɛ.
“Gbɔ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛ agbojee aaakwɔ fe ogbojee, shi bo lɛ ogbojee lɛ aaaba shi daa.
Lɛ lɛ ebaana nii efa bo, shi bo lɛ onaŋ nɔ ko ofa lɛ; eeetsɔ̃ yitso, ni bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ lei.
“Naa, nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba onɔ, ni amɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni amɛaanina bo yɛ hei fɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã, ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbee toi, ni oyeee ekitãi ni ewo bo lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaatsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ okadi amɛhã bo kɛ oshwiei kɛaatee naanɔ, “Ejaakɛ yɛ nii ni Yehowa jɔɔmɔ hã ona babaoo lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ jaaa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kumai kɛ yayai kɛ hiamɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli aaasɔmɔ ohenyɛlɔi ni Yehowa baahã abatua bo lɛ.
Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ kɛ dade apã aaawo okuɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã ohiɛ.
Yehowa kɛ maŋ ko aaajɛ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehe, abatua bo trukaa, shwim tamɔ okropɔŋ filikiɔ, maŋ ko ni onuuu amɛwiemɔ, maŋ ni hiɛ yɔɔ kramakrama; amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpa hiɛiaŋ lɛ, amɛnaaa gbekɛ mɔbɔ hu.
Amɛbaaye otsinai abii kɛ oŋmɔshi nibaanii kɛyaashi aaakpãtã ohiɛ; amɛshiŋ abele loo wain loo mu loo otsinabii loo otoobii lɛ eko amɛhaŋ bo kɛyaashi amɛaakpãtã ohiɛ.
Amɛaasa oyi amɛwo omaji lɛ fɛɛ amli kɛyashi omaji lɛ ahe gbogboi grɔŋŋi ni awaje, ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, amɛaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa bo lɛ nɔ.
“Hiamɔ ni ohenyɛlɔi aaahã ahia bo, be mli ni asa oyi lɛ hewɔ lɛ oooye bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii, obihii kɛ obiyei, ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã bo lɛ aloo.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛteŋ nuu ni he jɔ, asaŋ ni ekpaaa niiaŋ po musuŋ aaajoo yɛ enyɛmi kɛ eŋa ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋbii ateŋ mɔ ni eshwɛ ehã lɛ tete nɔ, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehaŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko abi lɛ loo ni eyeɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ oyi ni asa kɛ fimɔ ni ohenyɛlɔ ehã efi bo yɛ omaji fɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, obɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛteŋ yoo ni he jɔ ni alɛ lɛ fɔfɔɔle, mɔ ni ekaŋ akɛ eeenyiɛ enane folo ejaakɛ eyɛ wɔrɔmii kɛ bɔdɔbii, musuŋ aaajoo yɛ ewu ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛ emusuŋ binuu kɛ emusuŋ biyoo fɛɛ hu nɔ.
Ebaaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi ni efɔ eŋmɔŋ sɛɛnii kɛ emusuŋ bii nigii, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he esɛ̃ yɛ omaji lɛ ayi ni ohenyɛlɔ esa kɛ fimɔ ni efi bo lɛ hewɔ.
“Kɛji okwɛɛɛ ni ahi koni oye nɛkɛ mlai ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni oooshe Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi ni yɔɔ nyam kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa aaahã helai ni anaa wa abaye bo kɛ oshwiei, helai ni anaa wa, asaŋ ni amɛsɛɛ efooo.
Eeehã helai lɛ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei, nɔ ni ona Ijiptbii ye eko lɛ aye bo; ni helai nɛɛ baaka ohe.
Hela fɛɛ hela kɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ hu ni atsĩko tã yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa aaahã eko aye bo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ohiɛ aaakpãtã.
Tsɛbelɛ sa lɛ nyɛyi fa tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii, shi nyɛyi fioo kɛkɛ aaashwɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.
Bɔ ni Yehowa nya he akɛ efee nyɛ ejurɔ koni ehã nyɛyi afa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeenya he akɛ ekpãtã nyɛhiɛ koni efite nyɛ, ni aaashwie nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
“Ni Yehowa aaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, kɛjɛ je lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi naagbeehe kome hu, ni nyɛbaaya nyɛyaja tso kɛ tɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛ loo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ leee.
Onaŋ hejɔlɛ, ni asaŋ onaŋ nanemaahe hu yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ; aaahã otsui afã, ni ooofee yeyeeye kɛ tsuiyeli yɛ jɛi; oyiŋ aaafee bo kɔshikɔshi yɛ owala he, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔ bo, ni oleŋ kɛji oyi aaana wala lo.
Leebi lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je ena’, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina ni je etsɛre’.
Obaakɛɛ nɛkɛ yɛ ŋmiŋmi ni emɔ bo kɛ ohiɛnaanɔ nii ni onaa lɛ ahewɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛ nyɛ aaawo lɛji amli kɛaaya Ijipt ekoŋŋ, tsɛbelɛ eji gbɛ ko ni ewo nyɛ he shi akɛ nyɛfaŋ dɔŋŋ; ni nyɛaahɔ̃hɔ̃ɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛhã nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ akɛ nyɔji hii kɛ nyɔji yei, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko heŋ nyɛ tete.”
Yehowa kɛ Israel kpãŋ yɛ Moab Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose akɛ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ akpãŋ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi nɛ; esoro kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii kpãŋ yɛ Horeb Gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ.
Mose tsɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa fee Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛna haomɔi kpelei lɛ kɛ okadii lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii wuji lɛ; shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa hãko nyɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛkɛaanu nɔ ni ba lɛ shishi, loo hiŋmɛii ni nyɛkɛaana nii loo toii ni nyɛkɛaanu nii.
Mi mikpala nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛtadei esuuu yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛtokotai hu tserɛɛɛ yɛ nyɛnaji.
Nyɛhiɛɛɛ aboloo lɛ, nyɛhiɛɛɛ wain loo dãa ni wa; shi Yehowa hã nyɛ nyɛhehiamɔnii fɛɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ lɛ ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni nyɛbashɛ biɛ lɛ, Heshbon Maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og fã ta kɛba amɛkɛ wɔ bawu; shi wɔye amɛnɔ kunim, ni wɔŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔjara shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔhã Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ koni nyɛye nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛshwere yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ mli.
“Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛdamɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ, nyɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ nyɛkutsei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, kɛ nyɛmaŋ nitsulɔi lɛ, kɛ nyɛ Israel maŋ lɛ mli hii fɛɛ, kɛ nyɛbii bibii lɛ, kɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ, kɛ gbɔi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nyɛshitoohei lɛ amli lɛ, laiyalɔi kɛ faaŋyalɔi fɛɛ.
Nyɛba ŋmɛnɛ koni nyɛ kɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, abote kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kãa nyɛ he kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ mli, koni ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, Yehowa ama nɔ mi akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ji nyɛ, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi momo sa, be ni ekã nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kitã lɛ.
Shi jeee nyɛ kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛkpãŋ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ wɔ kɛ mɔ hu ni bɛ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ miikpãŋ nakai nɔŋŋ.
“Nyɛle bɔ ni wɔhi shi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔhã, kɛ bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ majimaji ateŋ kɛba lɛ.
Nyɛna maji nɛɛ amusubɔɔ nibii ni ji amɛmãgãi ni akɛ tso kɛ tɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fee ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛteŋ nuu ko loo yoo ko loo weku ko loo akutso ko yiŋ akatsɔ̃ ŋmɛnɛ ni ekpale yɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni etee eyaja nakai maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ; no lɛ nakai mɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso shishifã ni woɔ tsoyibii ni joɔ kɛ emli ebɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ baahã ehe tsui kɛji enu kitã ni ji kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaakɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Mikpliŋ mitsui kɛmiifee nɔ ni mi misumɔɔ moŋ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mibaye mihe.’ Enɛ baahã mɔ kpakpa kɛ mɔ fɔŋ hu fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã.
Yehowa kɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ he ekeŋ lɛ, shi moŋ Yehowa mlifu kɛ ewuŋayeli aaate shi awo lɛ, ni loomɔi fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ aaababua gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yiteŋ kɛyashi Yehowa baagbe egbɛi yɛ je lɛ mli.
Yehowa kɛ ehiɛ aaaka lɛ dikadika yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli, yɛ nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli loomɔi ni yɔɔ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anaa.
“Wɔsɛɛ yinɔbii, ni ji nyɛshwiei ni aaaba yɛ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ni aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaawie he kɛji amɛna haomɔi kɛ helai ni Yehowa ehã eba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛaana bɔ ni swɔɔ kɛ ŋoo egbe shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ, ni ehiii enɔ nidumɔ, ni ebaaa nii, ni jwɛi tete ekwɛ̃ɛɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛaana akɛ efite tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ Adama kɛ Zeboim maji lɛ ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emlila naa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ majimaji fɛɛ aaabi akɛ, ‘Mɛni ba ni Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?
Mɛni kɛ mlifu ni naa wa nɛkɛ ba?’ Hetoo ni mɛi aaahã ji akɛ, ‘Ejɛ kwamɔ ni amɛkwa kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛ kpãŋ be mli ni eyakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛtee ni amɛyajajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, asaŋ ni Yehowa ewo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkaja amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ehã loomɔi fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ babua enɔ bii lɛ ayiteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa gri, ni efã amɛ yɛ emlifu kɛ emlila lɛ naa, ni eshɛrɛ amɛ eshwie maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.’ “Teemɔŋ nibii lɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koome nɔ ni; shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ pɛ, nɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔye mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ kwa nɔ.”
Nɔ ni baahã kpãtãmɔ kɛ jɔɔmɔ aba “Mikɛ saji nɛɛ ni ji jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ miishwie nyɛhiɛ; kɛ ena eba nyɛnɔ beiaŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ maji anɔ fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eshwie nyɛ kɛtee lɛ, ni nyɛaakai nɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ, ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii nyɛaakpale kɛba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ aaaye egbee nɔ, bɔ ni miwo nyɛ kitã ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaana nyɛ mɔbɔ ekoŋŋ.
Emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ, ni eeeku sɛɛ ebua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ majimaji anɔ hei fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, egbɛ nyɛ eshwã lɛ kɛaaba.
Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eeeshɛrɛ amɛ ashwie je lɛ mli naagbeehei tete po lɛ, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaabaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje jɛi kɛaaba.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛbaŋɔ.
Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere, ni nyɛyi aaafa hu fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei hu atsake nyɛtsui bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni nyɛyi ana wala.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nɛkɛ loomɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ abashwie nyɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ nyɛhetsɛ̃lɔi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ anɔ; ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛaaku sɛɛ nyɛbo Yehowa toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi fɛɛ ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ anɔ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã nyɛnine naa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ashwere, ni nyɛmusuŋ bii kɛ nyɛtsinai abii kɛ nyɛŋmɔshi nibaanii fɛɛ hu ashwere babaoo ahã nyɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa aaana nyɛhe miishɛɛ ni eeehã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ena nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.
Ebaafee nakai kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛaakpale kɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛaaba Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ lɛ.
“Kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko ni wa tsɔ̃ hã nyɛ, ni ebɛ shɔŋŋ hu.
Jeee ŋwɛi eyɔɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘namɔ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi ahã wɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?’ Ni jeee ŋshɔ sɛɛ hu eyɔɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘namɔ aaafo ŋshɔ koni eyaŋɔ ekɛbahã wɔ, ni wɔnu ni wɔye nɔ?’ Dabida, wiemɔ lɛ bɛŋkɛ nyɛ kpaakpa; eyɛ nyɛdaaŋ ni eyɛ nyɛtsuii amli hu, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nɔ nyɛye aahu.
“Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ wala kɛ gbele kɛ ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.
Kɛji nyɛaaye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitãi ni miwoɔ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛaaba nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ, ni nyɛaaye ekitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ kɛ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛyi aaana wala.
Nyɛyi aaafa, ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaajɔɔ nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛtsui yagba afã, ni nyɛgbo toi, ni alaka nyɛ, ni nyɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛsɔmɔ amɛ lɛ, no lɛ miigba mli kpoo miikɛɛ nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã, ni nyɛwala sɛɛ etsɛŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Miitsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ koni amɛbaye he odase akɛ mikɛ wala kɛ gbele, kɛ jɔɔmɔ kɛ loomɔ hu eshwie nyɛhiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɔa wala bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ ayi ana wala.
Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛboa lɛ toi, ni nyɛkpɛtɛa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ no aaahã nyɛyi ana wala ni nyɛtsɛ yɛ jeŋ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa kã nyɛtsɛmɛi Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob he kitã akɛ ekɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ.”
Yoshua ye Mose sɛɛ akɛ Hiɛnyiɛlɔ Mose tee nɔ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; minyɛɛɛ yaakɛbaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ Yehowa, ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ofoŋ nɛkɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ’.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ aaanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛfo faa lɛ; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaakpãtã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ koni nyɛŋɔ.
Yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, Yoshua aaanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ kɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ.
Yehowa aaafee maji lɛ bɔ pɛ ni efee Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi Sihon kɛ Og kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ be ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Yehowa aaatu amɛ awo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛfee amɛ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛfee amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nyɛhe awaa, ni nyɛfea ekãa; nyɛkashea gbeyei lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa hu yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ nyiɛ kɛyaa lɛ; eshiŋ nyɛ, ni ekwaŋ nyɛ hu.” Kɛkɛ ni Mose tsɛ Yoshua kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, “Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ bo okɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he shi akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ, ni bo nɔŋŋ oooja shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Yehowa ji mɔ ni aaanyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya; ni ekɛ bo aaahi shi; ehaŋ onine anyɛ shi lɛ, eshiŋ bo hu.
Kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu.” Akane Mla Wolo lɛ shi kome daa afii kpawo Kɛkɛ ni Mose ŋma mla lɛ ewo wolo mli, ni ekɛhã osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levi shwiei, mɛi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, kɛ Israelbii lɛ amaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ.
Mose kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Daa afii kpawo naagbee, ni ji heyeli be ni akɛ nyɔmɔ keɔ lɛ, kɛji eshɛ Asesei Agbijurɔyeli lɛ, be ni Israel maŋtso muu fɛɛ ebapue yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ yɛ he ni lɛ eŋɔ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ lɛ, akane nɛkɛ mlai nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ awo amɛtoiiaŋ.
Abua maŋ lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ, koni amɛbo mlai lɛ atoi ni amɛkase bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei koni amɛjwɛŋ nɔ ni amɛye mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛbii hu ni leee mlai nɛɛ amɛto lɛ akase ni amɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei bei abɔ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyaafo Yordan Faa lɛ ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Naagbee fãmɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, ogbele be eshɛ etã.
Tsɛ Yoshua kɛba koni bo, okɛ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli koni matu nitsumɔ lɛ mawo edɛŋ.” Mose kɛ Yoshua tee, ni amɛyadamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ mli.
Yehowa bapue yɛ Buu lɛ mli yɛ atatu kutuu mli, ni atatu lɛ badamɔ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Naa, eshwɛ fioo ni obaagbo, ni ogbele sɛɛ lɛ maŋ nɛɛ baakwa mi, ni amɛbaaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni amɛyaanina yɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛbaakwa mi, ni amɛaaku kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛji eba mli nakai lɛ mimli aaawo amɛ la yɛ nakai be lɛ mli; ni mibakwa amɛ, ni mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ, ni aaaye amɛnɔ.
Saji fɔ̃ji babaoo kɛ haomɔi baaba amɛnɔ, ni ebaahã amɛbi yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kwɛɛ jeee Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni bɛ wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ hewɔ ni nɛkɛ nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?’ Anɔkwa, nakai be lɛŋ lɛ mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
“No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ŋmaa nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.
Lala lɛ ahi amɛdaaŋ.
Enɛ baaye mi kɛ Israelbii ateŋ odase.
Ejaakɛ kɛji mikɛ amɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni mikã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛna nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛshwishwii lɛ, amɛbaakpale kɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛaaya amɛyasɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaagbe mihe guɔ moŋ, ni amɛaaku mi kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛji saji fɔ̃ji kɛ hejaramɔ babaoo eba amɛnɔ lɛ, lala nɛɛ aaaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase, ejaakɛ amɛshwiei ahiɛ kpaŋ lala nɛɛ nɔ, ni lala lɛ aaahi amɛdaaŋ daa.
Amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ po, dani mikɛ amɛ aaaya ayashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mile yiŋ ni amɛtoɔ momo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mose ŋma nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tu nitsumɔ lɛ ewo Yoshua, Nun binuu lɛ, dɛŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa, ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ baaya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo he shi akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ; mikɛ bo baahi shi.” Be ni Mose eŋma mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ewo wolo mli egbe naa owura kosɛɛ lɛ, Mose fã Levibii osɔfoi ni tereɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛŋmɛa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi koni eye nyɛhe odase yɛ jɛi.
Mile bɔ ni nyɛtseɔ atua kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkuɛŋ ti hã hu.
Nyɛmiitse Yehowa hiɛ atua amrɔ nɛɛ po ni mihiɛ kã ni mi kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, shi migbele sɛɛ lɛ te aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ?
Nyɛtsɛa nyɛkutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋ nitsulɔi onukpai lɛ hu kɛbaa miŋɔɔ bɔ ni afee ni mawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ mawo amɛtoii amli koni matsɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ koni amɛbaye mi kɛ amɛteŋ odase.
Ejaakɛ mile faŋŋ akɛ migbele sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafite kwraa, ni nyɛbaŋ nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔsɛɛ aahu lɛ, efɔŋ ji nɔ ni baaba nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaafee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii baawo emli la.” Mose Lala lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Mose wie nɛkɛ lala ni baa nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ewo Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ kɛyashi egbe naa.
“Ŋwɛi, bo mi toi, shi mibawie; ni Shikpɔŋ, bo minaa wiemɔi nɛɛ toi.
Mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ aaashwie shi tamɔ nu ni miinɛ, ni eeenyɔ tamɔ bɔ, tamɔ futufuli ni miishwã jwɛfɔ nɔ, tamɔ nu kulibii yɛ bai anɔ.
Mibajie Yehowa gbɛi yi!
Nyɛwoa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam!
“Tɛsaa ji lɛ, enitsumɔ hi pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efeɔ lɛ ja.
Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo ji lɛ; nɔ sha ko bɛ ehe; jalɔ kɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.
Shi nyɛyeee lɛ anɔkwa; no hewɔ lɛ, jeee ebii ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, yɛ nyɛhe kpa hewɔ; yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ ni eje eŋɛlɛnɔ ji nyɛ.
Aso Yehowa shidaa moŋ nɛ, kwashiai ni bɛ yitseiaŋ?
Aso jeee lɛ ji nyɛtsɛ, mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ, mɔ ni fee nyɛ mɛi komɛi, ni ehã nyɛnane mɔ shi lɛ?
“Nyɛkaia blema jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa yinɔi ni eho lɛ ahe; nyɛbia nyɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛaagba nyɛ, kɛ nyɛnukpai lɛ hu, ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ.
Be ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ ja shikpɔŋ lɛ ekɛhã jeŋ majimaji lɛ, ni egbala adesai abii amli lɛ, ejie maji lɛ ahusui eshwie shi faŋŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ayibɔ naa.
Yehowa ŋɔ Yakob akɛ gboshinii ni ena; ejaakɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ ji emaŋbii lɛ.
“Ena lɛ yɛ shiaŋa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, yɛ ŋa olɛŋɛlɛ shwaŋŋ ko nɔ.
Ebu ehe, ni ekura lɛ hu; ebaa eyi tamɔ ehiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.
Bɔ ni okropɔŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ebii filikimɔ, ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ ekɛsɔoɔ amɛ, ni ehiɛɔ amɛ koni amɛkagbee shi lɛ, nakai Yehowa koome nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ, ni maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko fataaa ehe.
“Ehã Israel ye gɔji anɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; Israel ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ.
Ena wo kɛjɛ tɛsai amli, ni emutsei shwere yɛ tɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Tsinai kɛ gwantɛŋi hã fufɔ ni efĩ; egwaŋtɛŋ yei kɛ gwantɛŋ hii shwishwii kɛ fɔ tamɔ Bashan tsinai kɛ abotiai; ni enu wain kpakpa.
“Yehowa webii lɛ shwere, shi amɛtse atua; amɛshwishwii, ni amɛhe wa, ni amɛhe shamɔ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ moŋ, ni amɛbuuu Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ.
Amɛtee Yehowa awuŋayeli shi kɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛja lɛ, ni esha ni amɛfee hewɔ lɛ amɛwo lɛ mlifu.
Amɛshã afɔlei amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi ni jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko, nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛleee, kɛ nyɔŋmɔi hei ni akɛba etsɛko, nii ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ sheko amɛ gbeyei dã.
Nyɛbuuu Tɛsaa ni babɔ nyɛ ade lɛ, ni nyɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
“Be ni Yehowa na enɛ lɛ, enyaŋe ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ, yɛ emli la ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mifeŋ amɛ ejurɔ ko dɔŋŋ.’ Makwɛ bɔ ni amɛnaagbee baatamɔ ahã, ejaakɛ yinɔbii toigbolɔi ji amɛ, bii ni yeee anɔkwa.
Amɛhã miye nɔ ni jeee nyɔŋmɔ he awuŋã yakatswaa; amɛwo mimli la kɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mahã amɛye maŋ ko ni bɛ nɔ ko mli he awuŋã.
Mahã amɛmli awo la yɛ kwashiai amaŋ ko hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ mimlifu ehã la ko ehere, ni eetso kɛmiiya gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ; ebaashã je lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii, ni ebaashã gɔji lɛ ashishitoi diɛŋtsɛ.
“Maloo haomɔi mabua amɛyiteŋ, matserɛ̃ amɛ gãii ni miyɔɔ.
Hɔmɔ baahã amɛtã loo, ni jeŋ dɔlɛ kɛ hela baagbe amɛ.
Mawo kooloi kakawuai agbɛ koni amɛbatua amɛ, kɛ onufui kɛ amɛnaa ebɔɔ hu gbɛ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Klante aaanu lá yɛ blohui amli, ni piai amli baafee gbeyei.
Ebaakpãtã oblanyo kɛ oblayoo kɛ bi fufɔoo kɛ wajiatsɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Kulɛ makɛɛ akɛ, ‘Magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya shɔŋŋ, ni mahã hiɛ akpa amɛnɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.’ Shi mishe gbeyei akɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aaashwã ni amɛaaŋɔ nɔ ni eba lɛ ekroko ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔ ni wɔye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, jeee Yehowa ni fee amɛ enɛ.’ “Israel jeee ehe maŋ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ; ni sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ebɔ amɛ.
Eji amɛle nii kulɛ amɛaanu nɔ ni ba lɛ shishi, ni amɛaayoo bɔ ni amɛnaagbee mli aaabatamɔ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ kome kɛkɛ woɔ mɛi akpe foiŋ, ni gbɔmɛi enyɔ kɛkɛ hu woɔ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma foiŋ?
Nɔ ni kɛba ji amɛTɛsaa lɛ ekwa amɛ, ni Yehowa eŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã.
Ejaakɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yeɔ enɛ he odase akɛ amɛtɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔɔɔ wɔTɛsaa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeŋ ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba lɛ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora jeŋba lɛ; amɛjeŋba fɛɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni amɛyibii miijoo pam; amɛwain lɛ shikpãi ebɔɔ ni, tamɔ blikã naa ebɔɔ pɛ.
“Mikɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eto; mikɛŋmɛ shi, ni eemɛ amɛ.
Oweletɔɔ kɛ toigbalamɔ lɛ, mi minɔ ni; amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ miiba shwiaa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa baafã ewebii ahe; ebaana amɛ mɔbɔ kɛji ena akɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ etã, ni eshwɛko mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa, mɔ ni hiɛ ehe jio, nyɔŋ jio.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa baabi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ tɛsaa, amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ; nibii ni amɛkɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛmiishã afɔle lɛ amli fɔi lɛ hã, ni amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi amɛhã amɛ akɛ amɛnu lɛ?
Amɛba amɛbaye amɛbua amɛ, amɛbafã amɛhe koo!
“‘Te nyɛna akɛ Mi nɔŋŋ ji Mi, ni misɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ?
Migbeɔ, ni mihãa wala, mipilaa mɔ, ni mitsaa mɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko ashɔ̃ yɛ mi midɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ miiwo minine nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, miyɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ, kɛji mijɔ miklante lɛ naa, ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ ni miwo jalɛ saneyeli nɔ lɛ, mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibagbala mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ toi.
Lá baawu migãimlibii ahe, ni miklante lɛ baaye loo.
Lá baatsere yɛ migãimlibii anaa, ni miklante baagbe mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ.
Minaŋ mɔ ni egba ewo mi mɔbɔ, pilafo lɛ kɛ nomi fɛɛ yeŋ amɛhe.’ “Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛkɛ Yehowa webii lɛ anyaa, ejaakɛ etɔ etsuji alá he owele, ni etɔ ehe owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii atɔ̃mɔi efa amɛ.” Mose kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ba, ni amɛbakane lala nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Israelbii lɛ atoiiaŋ.
Mose naagbee wiemɔ Be ni Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ewie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ egbe naa lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akãa nyɛtsui nɔ; ni nyɛkpãa nyɛwoa nyɛbii atoiiaŋ koni amɛjwɛŋ nɛkɛ mla nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛye nɔ; ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ jeee wiemɔi foji hã nyɛ, shi moŋ nyɛwala diɛŋtsɛ ni; ni no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwala sɛɛ aaatsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ kɛyaa ni nyɛyaŋɔ lɛ nɔ.” Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Kwɔɔ Abarim gɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ji Nebo Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ekwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, koni okwɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
Obaagbo yɛ nakai gɔŋ ni obaakwɔ lɛ nɔ koni oyanina omɛi lɛ tamɔ onyɛmi Aaron gbo yɛ Hor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyanina emɛi lɛ, ejaakɛ, bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkwa mi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he yɛ Kadesh, yɛ Zin ŋa lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ nyɛwooo mihiɛ nyam akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Obaana shikpɔŋ lɛ kã ohiɛ moŋ nɛ; shi ya ni oyaŋ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhãa Israelbii lɛ nɔ.”
Mose jɔɔ Israel Akutsei lɛ Jɔɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose kɛjɔɔ Israelbii lɛ dani egbo lɛ nɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpɛ kɛjɛ Edom eshwie wɔnɔ; ekpɛ kɛjɛ Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi akpei nyɔŋma lɛ aŋɔɔ kɛ la plamplam ni ma eninejurɔ nɔ.
“Anɔkwa, edɔɔ emɛi ahe, ehiɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔkula enaji anaa ni wɔmiibo egbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.
Wɔyeɔ Mla lɛ ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ no ji Yakob shwiei agboshinii.
Belɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel be ni maŋbii babua amɛhe naa ni Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ naa kpe shi lɛ.
Mose kɛɛ yɛ Ruben akutso lɛ he akɛ, ‘Ruben yi ana wala, eshishi akabule; emli hii anɔ akagbɔ.’ ” Ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Yehowa, bo Yuda toi; kplamɔ lɛ kɛbafata akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Nuŋtsɔ, bo diɛŋtsɛ wuu ohã Yuda koni oye obua lɛ ni enyɛ ehenyɛlɔi ekɛwu.” Ekɛɛ yɛ Levi akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Bo Yehowa, hã Urim kɛ Tumim ajie osuɔmɔnaa nii kpo atsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji Levibii lɛ anɔ.
Oka amɛ okwɛ yɛ Masa, ni okɛ amɛ taa naa yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.
Amɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛtsɛ kɛ amɛnyɛ he akɛ, ‘Wɔbuuu amɛ, ni amɛkwa amɛnyɛmimɛi, ni amɛshi amɛmusuŋbii asɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmɔ owiemɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛye okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ɔ Yakob shwiei okpɔi lɛ, kɛ Israel omla lɛ.
Amɛ amɛbaashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ kɛ shãa afɔle muu yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.’ Ao!
Yehowa, jɔɔmɔ Levi shwiei lɛ, ni amɛninenaa nitsumɔ asa ohiɛ; tswiamɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ amɛ lɛ nii, koni amɛkanyɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.” Mose kɛɛ yɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ehiɔ Yehowa masɛi shweshweeshwe.
Ebuɔ ehe gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpɔkɔiaŋ ji ekamɔhe.” Mose kɛɛ yɛ Yosef akutso lɛ he akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ bɔ, ŋwɛi nikeenii ni jara wa fe fɛɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi nu hu.
Yehowa ajɔɔ Yosef kɛ tsoyibii kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ ejɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔshinii kpakpai babaoo ni baa yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ehã ŋmɔshinii kpakpai akwɛ̃ yɛ eblema gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni naanɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu aba nii babaoo.
Yehowa ajɔɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ koni eba nii babaoo, bɔ ni shikpɔŋ nyɛɔ ebaa nii.
Mɔ ni hi ŋmeitso lɛ mli lɛ ana Yosef akutso lɛ he miishɛɛ.
Akɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aduro Yosef; jɔɔmɔ aba ekekre ni fi eyitso lɛ nɔ, Lɛ mɔ ni ji lumɔ yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Yosef kromɔbi lɛ je agbo tamɔ tsinanuu; ni ekoji ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ tsinanuu nɔ; nomɛi ji Efraim mɛi akpei nyɔŋma, kɛ Manase akpei nyɔŋma ni amɛkɛbaashimɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛaatsirɛ amɛ kɛaatee jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ yɛ Zebulon akutso lɛ he akɛ: “Zebulon, nya yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ jarayeli hewɔ; ni bo Isakar hu, nya onii ni ona yɛ shĩa lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛaatsɛ mɛi kɛaaya amɛgɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ: jɛi amɛaashã afɔlei ni sa yɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna nii kɛjɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛna shĩa mli jwetri ni akɛtee lɛ hu.” Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Gad akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Akafo Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni lɛɔ Gad husui lɛ amli lɛ.
Gad bu shi tamɔ jata ni miiwɔ, ni etserɛɔ mɛi aniji, ni ekpɔɔ yitso heloo.
Ekɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ ehã ehe, ejaakɛ jɛi tatsɛ gbɛnaa shikpɔŋ ni afo ato lɛ kã.
Kɛkɛ ni eba maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni ebafata Israel he, ni akɛ Yehowa mlai lɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ kojo maŋ lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa.” Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Dan akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Dan lɛ jatabi ni tumɔɔ kɛjɛ Bashan ni.” Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Naftali akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Naftali, bo lɛ aduro bo naakpa, Yehowa ejɔɔ bo jogbaŋŋ; ŋɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ ofee onɔ.” Nɔ ni Mose kɛɛ yɛ Asher akutso lɛ he nɛ: “Ajɔɔ Asher fe fɛɛ yɛ bii ateŋ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaasumɔ esane; ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ aaashwere kɛ mu tso.
Akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble adabãi aaalalaa omaŋ agboi asɛɛ; ni bɔ ni ogbii falɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ohewalɛ aaahi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekɛ agbojee tsɔ̃ɔ atatuiaŋ kɛbayeɔ ebuaa bo lɛ.
Naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji obobaahe, ni enaanɔ niji lɛ hiɛ omli.
Eshwie henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛje ohiɛ, ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ’.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ, aaahi shi shweshweeshwe.
Yakob nubu lɛ aaahi shikpɔŋ ni abele kɛ wain pii baa yɛ nɔ, ni ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Israel, omii ashɛ ohe!
Namɔ tamɔ bo, maŋ ni Yehowa ehere oyiwala?
Mɔ ni ji oyelikɛbuamɔ tsɛŋ kɛ okunimyeli klante lɛ?
Ohenyɛlɔi aaashwie amɛnaa shi amɛhã bo, ni obaanaanaa amɛhei grɔŋŋi lɛ anɔ.”
Mose Gbele Kɛkɛ ni Mose jɛ Moab ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekwɔ Nebo Gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ ni kwɛɔ Yeriko maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ.
Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛjɛ Gilead kɛyashi Dan, kɛ Naftali fɛɛ, kɛ Efraim kɛ Manase shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashwie Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ anaigbɛ.
Ekɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, kɛ Yeriko ni ji tɛŋmaŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋa kplenee lɛ kɛyashi Zoar tɔ̃ɔ?
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni miwo Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob shi yɛ he akɛ, ‘Mikɛbaahã nyɛshwiei’ lɛ, no nɛ.
Mihã ona kɛ ohiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, shi jɛi ni oyaŋ.” Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbo yɛ jɛi yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa; ni Yehowa fu Mose yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Betpeor ŋlɛnɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa leee Mose saŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Mose eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ be ni egbo lɛ; no mli lɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ efeko lɛ tuutuu lɛ, egbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ hu nɔ gbɔko.
Israelbii lɛ fo Mose gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ yɛ Moab ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ, dani amɛkɛgbe Mose yarafeemɔ kɛ lɛ fomɔ lɛ naa.
Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee mumɔ, ejaakɛ Mose kɛ eniji eshwie enɔ ejɔɔ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bo Yoshua toi, ni amɛfee tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã Mose lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko eteko shi dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel tamɔ Mose mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko hu efeko okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii tamɔ nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu Mose ni eyafee yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko hu bako ni eyɛ hewalɛ kpele, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii tamɔ Mose fee yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ lɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Yoshua wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ gbaa tai srɔtoi ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yoshua akɛ tatsɛ lɛ wu.
Yoshua ji mɔ ni baye Mose sɛɛ akɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛyatua Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ.
Wolo lɛ mli saji wuji lɛ ekomɛi ji Israelbii lɛ Yordan Faa lɛ foo lɛ, kɛ Yeriko maŋ lɛ nɔ kunimyeli lɛ, kɛ ta ni awu yɛ Ai maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, kɛ blema kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii, Israelbii, lɛ kpãŋ lɛ hiɛtsiɛmɔ lɛ.
Ŋmalɛ ko ni yɔɔ Yoshua wolo lɛ mli ni mɛi le jogbaŋŋ ji, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɔa mɔ ni nyɛaasɔmɔ; … shi mi lɛ, mi kɛ miwe lɛ wɔbaasɔmɔ Yehowa.” Mlijaramɔi Aŋɔ Kanaan Shikpɔŋ lɛ .—.
Aja Kanaan Shikpɔŋ lɛ .—.
a. Yordan Bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ .- b. Yordan Anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ .—.
d. Abobaa Maji lɛ .- e. Levibii lɛ amaji lɛ .- Yordan Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ kpale kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ .- Yoshua shɛɛyeli wiemɔ .- Atsĩɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Shekem .-
Nyɔŋmɔ fã Yoshua akɛ eŋɔ̃ Kanaan Yehowa tsulɔ Mose gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Mose sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mitsulɔ Mose egbo, no hewɔ lɛ, saamɔ ohe koni bo kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ afo Yordan Faa nɛɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikɛhãa amɛ lɛ nɔ.
He fɛɛ he ni nyɛnane shi aaasa lɛ mikɛhã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo minaa shi mihã Mose lɛ.
“Nyɛhusu ji kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛ nɛkɛ Lebanon gɔji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi faa wulu ni ji Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, kɛtsɔ̃ Hitbii ashikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa yɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ adamɔ owalagbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo aaahi shi; mishiŋ bo, ni mikwaŋ bo hu.
Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa; ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni mikã maŋbii nɛɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ehe kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, bo obaahã etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
“Bo lɛ wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ; asaŋ ojwɛŋ nɔ, ni oye mla ni mitsulɔ Mose wo bo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Kaagba afã kɛmiiya ninejurɔ loo abɛku bɔ ni afee ni oye omanye yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ mli.
Kaahã nɛkɛ Mla Wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ miikpa yɛ odaaŋ; shi jwɛŋmɔ he be fɛɛ be, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane, ni ojwɛŋ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ni ofee bɔ ni aŋma yɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ejaakɛ no baahã oshwere.
Ani jeee mi mifã bo?
Wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa.
Kaahã ŋmiŋmi miimɔ bo, ni asaŋ otsui akafã ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mifĩ osɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” Yoshua tsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ nɔ ni afee Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua fã maŋ lɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkpaa maŋ lɛŋ koni nyɛwoa maŋbii lɛ shi.
Nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtaoa gbɛ nɔ niyenii nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, nyɛbaafo Yordan Faa nɛɛ koni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa nyɛ akɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.’ ” Agbɛnɛ Yoshua kɛɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkaia wiemɔ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛ nyɛ wie akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛ he ko ni nyɛaajɔɔ nyɛhe yɛ; ni ekɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baake nyɛ.
Nyɛbaashi nyɛŋamɛi kɛ nyɛbifabii kɛ nyɛkooloi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Mose kɛhã nyɛ yɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ; shi nyɛteŋ hii fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa amia kɛnyiɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ahiɛ koni nyɛye nyɛbua amɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu ana he ko ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ehã nyɛjɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, be mli ni amɛ hu shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhãa amɛ lɛ aaashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.
No sɛɛ dani nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã nyɛ yɛ Yordan Faa nɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbahi nɔ.” Maŋbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yoshua amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni owo wɔ ehe kitã lɛ wɔɔfee, ni he fɛɛ he ni oootsu wɔ lɛ wɔɔtee.
Bɔ ni wɔbo Mose toi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔɔbo bo hu toi.
Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, kɛ bo ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ Mose hi shi lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatse ohiɛ atua, ni efeee nɔ ni ofã akɛ efee lɛ, aaagbe lɛ.
Bo lɛ wajemɔ ohe ni ofee ekãa jogbaŋŋ kɛkɛ.”
Yoshua tsu mɛi amɛyasara Yeriko Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, tsu hii enyɔ nigii kɛjɛ Shitim koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛbaa, shi titri lɛ Yeriko.” Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyato yoo ajwamãŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Rahab lɛ we.
Ni atee ayakɛɛ Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii komɛi eba biɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni amɛbasara shikpɔŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu kɛtee Rahab ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jiemɔ hii lɛ ni ba oŋɔɔ ni amɛbato owe lɛ kɛba, ejaakɛ amɛba koni amɛbasara shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.” Shi Rahab kɛ hii enyɔ lɛ tee, ni ekɛɛ bɔfoi ni atsu lɛ akɛ, “Eji anɔkwale akɛ hii komɛi ba miŋɔɔ; shi mileee he ni amɛjɛ.
Be ni je na ni abaaŋã maŋ agbo lɛ, kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ je kpo; shi moŋ mileee he ni amɛtee; nyɛtiua amɛ mramra, ni nyɛbaanina amɛ.” Shi no mli lɛ Rahab eŋɔ̃ egbɔi lɛ eyatee yɛ gblɔ́ ni akɛ feɔ kpãa ni eka yɛ etsu lɛ yiteŋ lɛ shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ tiu hii lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Faa lɛ naagbɛ kɛtee faafoohe lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Amrɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ je kpo pɛ, ni aŋã maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ.
Rahab gbɔi enyɔ lɛ nako amɛkamɔ shi, ni etee amɛŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã nyɛ, ni nyɛhe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ wɔmaŋbii fɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ejijaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ; ejaakɛ wɔnu bɔ ni Yehowa hã Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli nu lɛ gbi yɛ nyɛhiɛ be ni nyɛshi Ijipt lɛ.
Asaŋ wɔnu bɔ ni nyɛfee Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ, ni ji Sihon kɛ Og, ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ musumusu nyɛhã lɛ.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔnu saji nɛɛ lɛ, wɔtsui fã, ni shi ofɔ̃ shi nuu fɛɛ nuu nɔ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, nyɛkɛ Yehowa akãa mi kitã akɛ gbii abɔ ni mifee nyɛ ejurɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛbaafee mitsɛ we lɛ ejurɔ nakai nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛbaato mi okadi krɛdɛɛ ko, ni nyɛbaahere mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi hii kɛ minyɛmimɛi yei kɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ ayiwala koni nyɛjie wɔ kɛje gbele mli.” Hii lɛ wo Rahab shi amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔwala lɛ owala ni.
Kɛji nyɛjieee wɔ shi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hã wɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ bo aaaye yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ anɔkwale naa.” Kɛkɛ ni Rahab shiu hii lɛ kɛ taŋkpee kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ mli kɛyimɔ shi, ejaakɛ Rahab shĩa lɛ ama akpɛtɛ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ, ni jɛi Rahab yɔɔ.
Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ koni mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛyatao nyɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛ akakpe.
Nyɛtea nyɛhe yɛ jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni etiu nyɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba; no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi gbɛ nyɛya.” Hii lɛ kɛɛ Rahab akɛ, “Wɔbaaye kitã ni ohã wɔkã bo nɛɛ nɔ.
Naa, kɛji wɔbashɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, okɛ kpãa tsuru faa nɛɛ afi samflɛ ni okɛ wɔ tsɔ̃ mli kɛyimɔ shi lɛ he.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ ohã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ otsɛ we lɛŋ bii fɛɛ ababua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ owe lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaaje kpo yɛ owe lɛŋ ayi blohu lɛŋ lɛ, mɔ lɛ lá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ, ni eyi sɔ̃ ko tereee wɔ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko yɛ oŋɔɔ yɛ owe lɛŋ, ni mɔ ko nine ta ehe lɛ, no lɛ no sɔ̃ lɛ atere wɔ.
Shi kɛji oyajie wɔ shi lɛ, no lɛ wɔhe eje kitã ni ohã wɔkã bo nɛɛ mli.” Rahab kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ nɛɛ aba mli nakai.” Kɛkɛ ni ewo hii lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee; ni Rahab fĩ kpãa tsuru lɛ etsotsoro samflɛ lɛ he.
Hii lɛ shwie nɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni amɛhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃ kɛyashi mɛi ni atsu akɛ amɛtiu amɛ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba.
Mɛi ni tiu hii lɛ tao Israelbii ni atsu lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, shi amɛnaaa amɛhe okadi ko kwraa.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii abɔfoi enyɔ lɛ kpeleke gɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛfo Yordan lɛ kɛba Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ saji ni ba amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Yehowa etu shikpɔŋ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ejijaa yɛ wɔhewɔ.”
Israelbii lɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛ̃ɛ fã kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ, ni amɛba Yordan Faa lɛ naa.
Amɛwɔ yɛ jɛi dani amɛfo faa lɛ.
Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kpa shitoohe lɛ mli, ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ shi amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛna osɔfoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ, tere Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛho pɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfãa kɛjɛa hei ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ koni nyɛnyiɛa sɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna he ni gbɛ lɛ kã, ejaakɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ko gbɛ nɛɛ nɔ dã.
Kɛ̃lɛ gbɛ akã nyɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ teŋ, gbɛ ni kɛji asusu lɛ aaafee ninetalɔi akpei enyɔ; nyɛkabɛŋkɛa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.” Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsua nyɛhe ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ Yehowa baafee naakpɛɛ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ.” Ni ekɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ koni nyɛkɛnyiɛa maŋ lɛ hiɛ.” Osɔfoi lɛ wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Mibabɔ̃i ohiɛ nyamwoo kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ bɔ ni mikɛ Mose hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛ bo hu baahi shi.
Wo osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛyanina Yordan Faa lɛ, nyɛwaa nyɛdamɔa faa lɛ mli.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsɛ maŋbii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ koni nyɛbaboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi.” Be ni maŋbii lɛ tsi ba lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ nyɛkɛaale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akɛ shwiemɔ eeeshwie Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ kɛaaje nyɛhiɛ.
Naa, shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miitsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiho kɛmiiya Yordan mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhalaa hii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛa Israel akutsei lɛ amli, no ji akutso fɛɛ akutso ahã nuu kome.
Ni naa, amrɔ pɛ ni osɔfoi ni tere Yehowa, ni ji shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, Adeka lɛ anaji aaasa Yordan mli nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ aaakpa hoo, ni nu ni jɛɔ yiteŋgbɛ baa lɛ baawa, ni eeema shi tamɔ gbogbo.” Lɛɛlɛŋ be ni maŋbii lɛ famɔ amɛbui lɛ koni amɛyafo Yordan lɛ, ni osɔfoi tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛnyiɛ amɛhiɛ, ni mɛi ni tere Adeka lɛ bashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji na sa nu lɛ mli pɛ (ejaakɛ Yordan lɛ jeɔ ŋã nikpamɔ be mli fɛɛ), kɛkɛ ni nu ni jɛ yiteŋgbɛ baa lɛ wa, ni ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, yɛ Adam ni ji maŋ ko ni bɛŋkɛ Zaretan lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni nu ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaboteɔ Araba ŋshɔ, ni ji Ŋoo Ŋshɔ, lɛ mli lɛ tã, ni esɛɛ fo kwraa.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fo faa lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋlɛnɔ tuuŋtu.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfoɔ faa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ wa damɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ tuuŋtu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ fo faa lɛ tã.
Yoshua mãmɔ kaimɔ tɛi Be ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ efo Yordan Faa lɛ etã lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Halamɔ hii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ nuu kome, koni ofã amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛholea tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ koni nyɛtere kɛfo mli kɛya he ni nyɛyaato ŋmɛnɛ gbɛkɛ nɛɛ, nyɛkɛyamãmɔ shi yɛ jɛi.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsɛ hii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ehala yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, akutso fɛɛ akutso lɛ eŋɔ̃ nuu kome yɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a Yehowa Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛyaa Yordan teŋ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo tɛ kome atswa ekɔŋ yɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa.
Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ koni wɔsɛɛ ko kɛji nyɛbii bi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Te nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ ashishi hu lɛ,’ nyɛjie naa nyɛhã amɛ akɛ, ‘Yordan Faa lɛŋ nu lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ be ni akɛfo Yordan lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, tɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ kaimɔ nɔ ahã Israelbii kɛya naanɔ.” Israelbii lɛ fee bɔ ni Yoshua fã amɛ lɛ: amɛhole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ teŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ akutsei lɛ ayibɔ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua lɛ.
Amɛtere tɛi nɛɛ kɛba he ni Israelbii lɛ to shi yɛ gbi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ tɛi lɛ bamãmɔ shi yɛ jɛi.
Yoshua diɛŋtsɛ hu hole tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ komɛi emãmɔ shi yɛ Yordan teŋ he ni osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ anaji mãmɔ lɛ.
Tɛi nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ wa damɔ shi yɛ Yordan teŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fã Yoshua akɛ ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ koni afee lɛ naa, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose fã Yoshua lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ahe fee oya kɛfo faa lɛ.
Be ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ efo faa lɛ etã lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu fo, kɛkɛ ni amɛyi maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã lɛ mĩa kɛnyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛfo mli tamɔ bɔ ni Mose fã amɛ lɛ.
Hii aaafee akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni esaa amɛhe kɛhã ta nyiɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛtee ta yɛ Yeriko ŋã kplanaa lɛ nɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ Yehowa wo Yoshua hiɛ nyam etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii fɛɛ, ni amɛshe Yoshua gbeyei ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ tamɔ amɛshe Mose gbeyei lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Fã osɔfoi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ akɛ amɛje Yordan Faa lɛ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua fã osɔfoi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea Yordan lɛ mli!” Be ni osɔfoi lɛ ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ je Yordan lɛ mli, ni amɛnaji sa shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni Yordan mli nu lɛ yiridi kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni esram nɔ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ fo Yordan lɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Gilgal yɛ Yeriko bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ.
Yoshua kɛ tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ahole yɛ Yordan lɛ mli lɛ mãmɔ shi yɛ Gilgal nɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbii aaabi nyɛ wɔsɛɛ ko akɛ, ‘Te nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ ashishi hu lɛ,’ nyɛgbaa nyɛbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Israel nyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo Yordan nɛɛ,’ ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ hã Yordan mli nu lɛ gbi hã nyɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛfo nyɛtã tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fee Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ, be ni ehã egbi ehã wɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔfo wɔtã lɛ, koni je lɛŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Yehowa yɛ hewalɛ, koni nyɛshe Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei kɛya naanɔ.”
Be ni Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan sɛɛ yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii amaŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaa lɛ nu akɛ Yehowa hã Yordan lɛ mli nu lɛ gbi kɛyashi Israelbii lɛ fo faa lɛ tã lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mli ekãa laaje yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ.
Afo Israel hii lɛ ketia yɛ Gilgal Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Feemɔ tɛ kaklai koni ofolɔ Israelbii lɛ ketia.” Yoshua fee tɛ kaklai lɛ, ni ekɛfolɔ Israelbii ketia yɛ Gibeat Haaralot (eshishi ji Ketia Foohe).
Nɔ hewɔ ni Yoshua folɔ Israelbii lɛ ketia lɛ nɛ: Israelbii ni shi Ijipt lɛ ateŋ hii fɛɛ, ni ji tabilɔi lɛ, egboi yɛ gbɛteŋ yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ be ni ajɛ Ijipt abaa lɛ.
Hii fɛɛ ni shi Ijipt lɛ afolɔ amɛ ketia momo; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni afɔ yɛ gbɛteŋ be ni ajɛ Ijipt abaa lɛ, afolɔko amɛ ketia.
Israelbii nyiɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ kɛyashi maŋ lɛ mli hii tabilɔi ni fata he be ni ashi Ijipt lɛ fɛɛ gboi, ejaakɛ amɛbooo Yehowa toi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kã amɛ kitã akɛ ehaŋ amɛna shikpɔŋ lɛ ni, lɛ, Yehowa ekã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ehe kitã akɛ ekɛbaahã amɛ lɛ, ni ji shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ hii nɛɛ abii ni ebaye amɛsɛɛ lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni Yoshua fo amɛ ketia nɛɛ, ejaakɛ foolɔi ji amɛ, akɛni afolɔko amɛ ketia lɛ.
Be ni afo maŋ lɛŋ hii fɛɛ ketia lɛ agbe naa lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ hi shi yɛ shitoohe ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ kɛyashi hii lɛ ahe tã.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, mifɔ nyɛhe muji ni awo yɛ Ijipt lɛ mishwie.” No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ shitoohe nɛɛ akɛ Gilgal kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ Gilgal lɛ, amɛye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɛkɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋã kplanaa lɛ nɔ.
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ gbi lɛ tuuŋtu nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii: amɛye ma akpiti aboloo kɛ abele fɔ ni ashã.
Ni gbi ni amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ eko lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ pɛ kɛkɛ ni mana lɛ sɛɛ fo, ni Israelbii lɛ naaa mana dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii ji nii ni amɛye nakai afi lɛ nɔ.
Yoshua kɛ Nuu ni hiɛ tayaa kakla lɛ Be ni Yoshua ebɛŋkɛ Yeriko lɛ, gbi ko trukaa eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa nuu ko damɔ ehiɛ ni egbala eklante ehiɛ.
Yoshua tsi bɛŋkɛ nuu lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Wɔgbɛfaŋ oyɔɔ aloo wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ?” Nuu lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Dabi; miba akɛ Yehowa ta lɛ nɔ tatsɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eja lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni minuŋtsɔ kɛɔ etsulɔ?” Yehowa ta lɛ nɔ tatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Jiemɔ otokota lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.” Ni Yoshua fee nakai.
Aye Yeriko nɔ kunim Be nɛɛ mli lɛ aŋã Yeriko maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa kpɛŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahewɔ: mɔ ko mɔ ko ejɛɛɛ mli ejeee kpo lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu eyaaa mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Naa, mibahã oye Yeriko kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ehii kãkãlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim.
Bo kɛ hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔlea Yeriko maŋ lɛ kɛkpea, shi kome daa gbi.
Nyɛfea nakai kɛyashia gbii ekpaa.
Osɔfoi kpawo ahiɛ bɛji kpawo ni akɛ ojwɛni akloŋto fee kɛnyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛbɔlea maŋ lɛ shii kpawo be mli ni osɔfoi lɛ miikpã bɛji lɛ.
Kɛji amɛkpã ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji lɛ, ni nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔ lɛ ni esɛɛ tsɛ kakadaŋŋ lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ abɔ oshe waa, ni maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ baagbee shi shwɛtɛɛ, koni Israel tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli.” Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, tsɛ osɔfoi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni nyɛhãa osɔfoi kpawo ahiɛa ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji kɛnyiɛa Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.” Ni Yoshua kɛɛ maŋ lɛ hu akɛ, “Nyɛfãa kɛhoa, ni nyɛbɔlea maŋ lɛ kɛkpea, ni nyɛhãa tabilɔi lɛ anyiɛa Yehowa Adeka lɛ hiɛ.” Be ni Yoshua kɛ maŋ lɛ wie lɛ, osɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji kpawo lɛ fo mli kɛho yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛyi hiɛ, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji lɛ, ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Tabilɔi lɛ nyiɛ osɔfoi ni kpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni tabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ sɛɛ.
Be ni anyiɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ belɛ aakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ.
Shi Yoshua wo maŋ lɛ shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkabɔa oshe, ni nyɛkahãa anua nyɛhe ni nyɛmiiwie kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛbɔ oshe lɛ; no dani nyɛbɔ oshe.” Yoshua hã akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bɔle Yeriko maŋ lɛ shi kome, ni asafo lɛ ba amɛshitoohe lɛ mli, ni amɛbawɔ jɛi.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni osɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛɔ ojwɛni akloŋto bɛji lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ lɛ, yi mli ni amɛmiikpã bɛji lɛ; hii tabilɔi lɛ nyiɛ osɔfoi ni kpãa bɛji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ta ni nyiɛɔ sɛɛ lɛ nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ sɛɛ.
Be mli ni anyiɛ kɛyaa lɛ belɛ aakpã bɛji lɛ.
Gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ hu Israelbii lɛ bɔle maŋ lɛ shi kome kɛkɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ amɛfee kɛyashi gbii ekpaa.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, asafo lɛ te shi mra hiɛ futɛfutɛ mli be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ, ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ daa lɛ shii kpawo.
Nakai gbi lɛ kɛkɛ nɔ lɛ amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ shii kpawo.
Shibɔlemɔ nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ be ni osɔfoi lɛ ekpã bɛji lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbɔa oshe!
Shi Yehowa kɛ maŋ lɛ eke nyɛ tswaa.
Maŋ lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, akpãtã hiɛ ahã Yehowa, ja Rahab, yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ eŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ ewe lɛ; amɛ kɛkɛ yi abaa, ejaakɛ Rahab ji mɔ ni kɛ bɔfoi lɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ tee.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia kɛkɛ yɛ musunii lɛ ahewɔ, koni nyɛkakɔa eko ni nyɛkɛloo musu koni kɛtsɔ̃ no nɔ lɛ nyɛhã Israel asafo muu lɛ hu loo musu, ni ehã amane ba Israel nɔ.
Shi moŋ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ shika fɛɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ akɔɔble loo dade fee lɛ, ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Yehowa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, aloo ni akɛba Yehowa nitoohe lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ bɔ oshe, ni akpã bɛji lɛ.
Be ni asafoi lɛ nu bɛji lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, amɛbɔ oshe kpeteŋkple.
Kɛkɛ ni Yeriko maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ gbee shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote maŋ lɛ mli, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛŋɔ̃ maŋ lɛ.
Amɛkpãtã maŋ lɛŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hiɛ yɛ klante naa, hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai, kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejii fɛɛ.
Yoshua kɛɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ni etsu kɛtee amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ shĩa lɛ koni nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ kɛ ehe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ eŋɔ̃ɔ kɛjea kpo tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkã lɛ kitã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, oblahii lɛ ni tee nigii amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ bote maŋ lɛŋ, ni amɛyaŋɔ Rahab kɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ ewekumɛi fɛɛ kɛje kpo kɛba, ni ahã amɛ he ko ni amɛhi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ sɛɛ.
Israelbii lɛ shã Yeriko maŋ lɛ kɛ emli nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ja jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ nibii ni akɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade fee kɛkɛ.
Nomɛi lɛ amɛtee amɛkɛyawo Yehowa we lɛ nitoohe lɛ.
Yoshua here Rahab, yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ, kɛ etsɛ we lɛ kɛ emɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, ni Rahab yahi Israelbii ateŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ bɔfoi ni Yoshua tsu, ni amɛyasara Yeriko lɛ tee.
Ni Yoshua kã amɛ kitã yɛ nakai be lɛ mli akɛ, “Mɔ ni aaate shi akɛ ebaasaa Yeriko maŋ nɛɛ ema lɛ, alomɔ lɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ekɛ ekromɔbi wala baatse nitsumɔ lɛ shishitoo, ni ekɛ ebi sɛɛkpelɔ wala baatse maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ taramɔ.” Yehowa bu Yoshua he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, egbɛi hehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Akan bɔ musu Israelbii lɛ tɔ̃, ni amɛyayeee kɔkɔ ni abɔ amɛ yɛ musunii lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Akan, ni ji Zabdi bi Karmi bi lɛ, ni jɛ Zera we yɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ lɛ, kɔlɔ musunii lɛ eko.
Enɛ hã Yehowa mli fu Israelbii lɛ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua tsu hii kɛjɛ Yeriko koni amɛya Ai maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Betaven masɛi yɛ Betel bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasaraa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛkwɛa.” Hii nɛɛ tee ni amɛyasara Ai, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛbakɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Kaahã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miiya; wo hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ kɛkɛ gbɛ kɛya ni amɛyatua Ai.
Kaahao maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛya ejaakɛ Aibii lɛ ayi faaa kwraa.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ ateŋ hii aaafee akpei etɛ̃ kɛkɛ yi mli kɛtee, shi amɛyanyɛɛɛ Aibii lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ.
Aibii lɛ gbe Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa.
Aibii lɛ wo Israelbii lɛ foi kɛjɛ Ai maŋ agbo lɛ naa kɛtee Shebarim, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ be ni amɛkpelekeɔ jɔɔ lɛ.
Sane nɛɛ hã Israelbii lɛ atsui fã, ni amɛhe jɔ tamɔ nu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kɛ dɔlɛ gbala amɛhe atadei, ni amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛi bumɔ shi yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ; ni Yoshua kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛni hewɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fo Yordan lɛ kɛba?
Koni okɛ wɔ abawo Amorbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛkpãtã wɔhiɛ?
Wɔle nɛkɛ kulɛ wɔkpɛ̃lɛ ni wɔhi Yordan lɛ sɛɛ kɛkɛ.
Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, te makɛɛ tɛŋŋ be ni Israel enaa sɛɛsɛɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ baanu he, ni amɛaaba amɛbabɔle wɔ kpula, ni amɛbaakpãtã wɔhiɛ butuu.
No hewɔ lɛ, te ofeɔ tɛŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ hu?” Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Tee shi; mɛni hewɔ ni okɛ ohiɛ ebu shi?
Naa, Israel etɔ̃ minɔ; amɛgbo toi, ni kɔkɔ ni mibɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛyayeee nɔ, ni amɛkɔlɔ musunii lɛ eko tete amɛkɛfutu amɛnibii amli; ni asaŋ amɛju, ni amɛmale hu.
“No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ahiɛ amɛdamɔ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã amɛhenyɛlɔi, ejaakɛ amɛloo musu.
Mikɛ nyɛ ehiŋ shi dɔŋŋ ja nyɛjie musunii lɛ yɛ nyɛnibii amli nyɛshwie.
Tee shi; tsuumɔ maŋbii lɛ ahe.
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsua nyɛhe nyɛkɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ nyɛtoa wɔ’, ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Israelbii, nyɛkɔlɔ musu nibii lɛ eko, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ nyɛdamɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaajie musunii lɛ nyɛshwie.’ Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ leebi lɛ, nyɛbaato kɛho yɛ akutsei lɛ anaa.
Akutso ni Yehowa baatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ebaato kɛho yɛ emli wekui lɛ anaa; ni weku ni Yehowa baatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ebaato kɛho yɛ emli shĩaishĩai lɛ anaa; ni shĩa ni Yehowa baatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli bii lɛ baato kɛho ekome kome.
Mɔ ni Yehowa baamɔ lɛ akɛ lɛ edɛŋ musu nii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, abaashã lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ejaakɛ etɔ̃ Yehowa kitã nɔ, ni asaŋ efee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa ni ehã Israelbii lɛ to kɛbaho yɛ akutseiakutsei anaa, ni amɔ Yuda akutso lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua hã Yuda akutso lɛ to kɛbaho, ni amɔ Zerabii aweku lɛ.
Ehã Zerabii lɛ to kɛbaho yɛ shĩaishĩai anaa, ni amɔ Zabdi shĩa lɛ.
Be ni ehã Zabdi hii lɛ to kɛbaho ekomekome lɛ, amɔ Karmin bi Akan ni ji Zabdi nabi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛɛ Akan akɛ, “Mibi, wo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, ni asaŋ jiemɔ eyi.
Jajemɔ otsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni ofee; kaashiu mi sane nɔ.” Akan to he ehã Yoshua akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, mifee esha mishi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mina Babilon mama fɛɛfɛo ko kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli ohai enyɔ kɛ agbɛnɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi antɛle kome ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ ofɔ̃yeli nibii lɛ ateŋ; mihiɛ kɔ̃ nibii nɛɛ anɔ, ni mikɔlɔ.
Mikɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ hɔ nibii nɛɛ ashishi, ni mifu fɛɛ yɛ mibuu lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.” Yoshua tsu bɔfoi, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Akan buu lɛ mli, ni lɛɛlɛŋ amɛyana nibii lɛ ni akɛtee yɛ buu lɛ mli, ni jwiɛtɛi lɛ hɔ shishi.
Bɔfoi lɛ famɔ nibii lɛ, ni amɛkɛbahã Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ, ni akɛ nibii lɛ shwie Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ mɔ Akan, Zeranyo lɛ, ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ mama lɛ kɛ shika antɛle lɛ kɛ ebihii kɛ ebiyei kɛ agbɛnɛ etoi kɛ etsinai kɛ etejii kɛ ebuu lɛ, no ji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ, fɛɛ fata ehe ni akpala amɛ kɛtee Akor Jɔɔ lɛŋ.
Be ni ayashɛ jɛi lɛ Yoshua kɛɛ Akan akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ogba wɔnaa nɛkɛ?
Yehowa hu baahao bo ŋmɛnɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ tswia Akan tɛ, ni ama enaa la ni ashã lɛ.
Asafo lɛ loo tɛ amɛkɛbua Akan nɔ, ni tɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni ma shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ sɛɛ fo.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Amanehulu Jɔɔ.
Akpãtã Ai maŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã!
Ŋɔ̃ɔ tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ ofata ohe koni nyɛfã ta kɛya Ai.
Naa, mibahã nyɛye Ai maŋtsɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim.
Feemɔ Ai maŋ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ tamɔ ofee Yeriko kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛha maŋ lɛŋ nibii kɛ kooloi lɛ.
Nyɛwoa maŋ lɛ ka yɛ esɛɛgbɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fã koni amɛ kɛ Aibii lɛ ayawu lɛ, Yoshua hala hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni ewo amɛ gbɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni efã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyawoa maŋ lɛ ka yɛ esɛɛgbɛ; nyɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ akajekɛa tsɔ̃ ko.
Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛfea kralo ŋmɛlɛtswaa fɛɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa.
Shi mi lɛ mi kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimasɛi lɛ, wɔbaatsi wɔbɛŋkɛ Ai maŋ lɛ.
Kɛji Aibii lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ amɛmaŋ lɛŋ koni amɛkɛ wɔ abakpe lɛ, tamɔ wɔfee nyɛsɛɛ lɛ, wɔbaanaanaa sɛɛsɛɛ tamɔ nɔ ni wɔmiijo amɛnaa foi.
Kɛfee nakai lɛ amɛbaatiu wɔ, kɛyaashi wɔɔgbala amɛ kɛshi maŋ lɛ; ni nɔ ni amɛbaakɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Naa, wɔnaa foi amɛjoɔ ekoŋŋ tamɔ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ.’ Wɔ lɛ, wɔbaakwa wɔjo amɛnaa foi; shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbaafamɔ kpo yɛ he ni nyɛwo ka lɛ yɛ lɛ koni nyɛbaŋɔ Ai maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahã nyɛye maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
Kɛji nyɛnine shɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛmaa maŋ lɛ naa la, koni nyɛfea lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ.
Naa, kitã miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua wo hii tabilɔi kãkãlɔi ni ehala lɛ gbɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyawo ka lɛ yɛ Betel kɛ Ai teŋ, yɛ Ai anaigbɛ.
Yoshua te shi leebi maŋkpa, ni ebua maŋbii lɛ anaa.
Kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ yi maŋ lɛ hiɛ kɛmiiya Ai.
Tabilɔi fɛɛ ni kɛ Yoshua nyiɛ lɛ fã, ni amɛtee aahu kɛyashi amɛbɛŋkɛ Ai maŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛwa yɛ Ai kooyigbɛ he ko; ni jɔɔ kã amɛ kɛ Ai teŋ.
Yoshua hala hii aaafee akpei enumɔ, ni ehã amɛyawo ka yɛ Betel kɛ Ai teŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ anaigbɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ gba ta lɛ amɛhã lɛ nɛ: amɛtabilɔi lɛ tsiimɔ jwere Ai maŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ, ni fãbii ni ji sɛɛbii lɛ ewo ka yɛ Ai anaigbɛ.
Yoshua kpeleke shi kɛtee jɔɔ lɛŋ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛŋ nɔŋŋ.
Be ni Ai maŋtsɛ lɛ na ta ni Israelbii lɛ egba lɛ, lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ fɛɛ ni ji maŋ lɛŋ hii lɛ ahe fee oya, ni amɛfã mra kɛtee Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ abakpe yɛ ŋã kplanaa lɛ nɔ; shi eleee kwraa akɛ awo lɛ ka yɛ maŋ lɛ sɛɛ gbɛ.
Be ni awuɔ ta lɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kwa tamɔ nɔ ni Aibii anine etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ nine atsɛ Ai maŋ lɛŋ bii lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛtiu Israelbii lɛ.
Be ni amɛtiuɔ Yoshua kɛ ewebii lɛ belɛ Israelbii lɛ miigbala amɛhe shi kɛmiishi amɛmaŋ lɛ.
Eshwɛɛɛ nuu kome nɛkɛ yɛ Ai ni eyaaa eyanyiɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛ eko.
Amɛshi amɛmaŋ lɛ amɛŋmɛ shi butuu, ni amɛtiu Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Okɛ akplɔ ni ohiɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ Ai gbɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ maŋ lɛ ehã bo.” Yoshua kɛ akplɔ ni ehiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Ai gbɛ.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Yoshua kpã enine mli lɛ, Israelbii tabilɔi lɛ ni eyawo ka lɛ tetee shi kɛjɛ hei ni amɛteetee amɛhe yɛ lɛ, ni amɛwowoo foi kɛyabote Ai maŋ lɛŋ, ni amɛŋɔ̃ maŋ lɛ.
Oya nɔŋŋ ni amɛma maŋ lɛ naa la.
Be ni Ai hii lɛ yaakwɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ amɛna akɛ lasu miifã yɛ amɛmaŋ lɛŋ kɛmiiya ŋwɛi.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ni kwa wo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo Aibii lɛ; ehiii Aibii lɛ foijee kɛmiitsɔ̃ biɛ loo biɛ.
Be ni Yoshua kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ na akɛ kawolɔi lɛ eŋɔ̃ maŋ lɛ, ni asaŋ amɛma enaa la lɛ, amɛfo amɛhe kɛtua Ai hii lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Israel tabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu fã kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛŋ amɛbatua Aibii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ wo Aibii lɛ teŋ; mɛi komɛi yɛ amɛbiɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu yɛ amɛbiɛ, ni amɛgbe Aibii lɛ kɛyashi eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ gbɔmɔ kome ni hiɛ kã aloo ni ena gbɛ ejo foi.
Israel tabilɔi lɛ mɔ Ai maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛkãalɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bahã Yoshua.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ egbe Aibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ he ni Aibii lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, (no ji amɛhã Aibii fɛɛ nyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa) amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Ai maŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛbagbe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni yɔɔ jɛi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɔnyɔi nakai gbi lɛ nɔ, ni ji hii kɛ yei, fee gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, no ji Ai maŋ muu lɛŋ bii fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yoshua esuuu enine ni hiɛ akplɔ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ Ai maŋ lɛŋ gbɛ lɛ kɛyashi agbe Aibii fɛɛ.
Kitã ni Yehowa ewo Yoshua hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ha maŋ lɛ mli kooloi kɛ nibii fɛɛ.
Yoshua shã Ai maŋ lɛ, ni ehã etsɔ̃ naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃.
Esɛŋ Ai maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ tso ko nɔ kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi hulu lɛ shinyɔɔ be mli dani Yoshua fã, ni ayajie maŋtsɛ lɛ gbonyo lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ, ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Ato tɛ ashwie Ai maŋtsɛ lɛ gbonyo lɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni ma shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Akane Mla Wolo lɛ yɛ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ he Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa.
