Emã latɛ lɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose wo Israelbii lɛ ehe kitã lɛ, no ji bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ: “Afɔleshãa latɛ ni akɛ tɛi muji ni ŋaalɔ dade naa esako he dã ma.” Israelbii lɛ shã shãa afɔlei yɛ nɔ amɛkɛhã Yehowa, ni amɛshã shidaa afɔlei hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kwɛ mlai ni Mose eŋma lɛ nɔ, ni eŋma mlai lɛ ahenɔ ewo tɛi anɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel muu fɛɛ, ni ji gbɔi kɛ Israel fɔmɔbii fɛɛ, kɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ yabua shi yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ, yɛ Levibii osɔfoi ni tereɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ahiɛ.
Israel fã jwere Gerizim Gɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni fã hu jwere Ebal Gɔŋ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose ewo amɛ kitã eto akɛ afee kɛji abaajɔɔ Israelbii lɛ.
Be ni maŋ lɛ ebabua shi lɛ, Yoshua kane mla lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ bluublu, no ji jɔɔmɔi lɛ kɛ loomɔi hu, bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Wiemɔ ko kwraa bɛ nibii ni Mose ewo amɛ he kitã lɛ fɛɛ mli ni Yoshua kaneee yɛ Israel asafo lɛ, ni ji hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ, fɛɛ ahiɛ etsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.
Gibeonbii lɛ laka Yoshua Majiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ nu Israelbii akunimyeli sane lɛ.
Amɛ ji mɛi ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ gɔji lɛ ajɔi lɛ amli kɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa maji ni yɔɔ aahu kɛyashi Lebanon lɛ.
Majiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ ji Hitbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Kanaanbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii amajiatsɛmɛi lɛ.
Amɛbua amɛhe naa amɛfee ekome koni amɛkɛ Yoshua kɛ Israel abawu ta.
Shi Gibeonbii lɛ, be ni amɛnu nɔ ni Yoshua efee Yeriko kɛ Ai lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛto ŋaa.
Amɛtao gbɛ nɔ niyenii, ni amɛloo kpekpei memeji kɛ wain wolo tɔi memeji ni asaŋ egbalagbalai ni etserɛtserɛi, ni atratrai amɛkɛtere tejii.
Amɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ, amɛwowoo tokotai memeji ni atsaratsrai kɛ atadei memeji hu.
Gbɛ nɔ niyenii ni amɛhiɛ lɛ tete egbi, ni asaŋ efufuui.
Ni amɛyi mli amɛtee Yoshua ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ yɛ Gilgal, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ kɛ Israelhii lɛ akɛ, “Maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko wɔjɛ wɔbaa nɛɛ; ni wɔba koni nyɛ kɛ wɔ akpãŋ ni wɔfee ekome.” Israel hii lɛ kɛɛ Gibeonbii ni eba amɛŋɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ, “Akakwɛ ni wɔmasɛi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛyɔɔ.
Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni wɔ kɛ nyɛ kpãŋɔ, ni wɔfeɔ ekome lɛ.” Gibeonbii lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Wɔyɛ oshishi.” Yoshua bi amɛ akɛ, “Namɛi ji nyɛ; ni nɛgbɛ hu nyɛjɛ?” Amɛ jie Yoshua naa akɛ, “Maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ otsuji jɛ baa nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hewɔ.
Wɔnu ehe sane, ni ji nibii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Ijipt lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni efee Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni ji Heshbon maŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashan maŋtsɛ Og, ni hi Ashtarot lɛ.
Enɛ hã wɔmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ wo wɔ gbɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Nyɛtaoa gbɛ nɔ niyenii, ni nyɛyaa koni nyɛkɛ amɛ ayakpea yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, wɔyɛ nyɛshishi; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ wɔ akpãŋa.’ Naa bɔ ni aboloo ni wɔhiɛ lɛ efee.
Afã aboloo lɛ oheo nɔŋŋ ni wɔkɛyi gbɛ koni wɔbaye yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; shi naa no; egbi ni asaŋ efu tete.
Nɛkɛ wain wolo tɔi nɛɛ hu ehei ni, be ni wɔwowoo amɛmli wain lɛ; shi naa amɛ ni amɛgbalagbalaa; ni wɔtadei kɛ tokotai lɛ hu etserɛtserɛi yɛ gbɛ ni wɔnyiɛ ni jɛkɛ tsɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ ye Gibeonbii lɛ aniyenii lɛ eko be mli ni amɛbiii Yehowa koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee.
Yoshua here Gibeonbii nɛɛ atuu, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ hu akɛ Israel efeŋ amɛ, Gibeonbii lɛ, efɔŋ ko.
Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ kã Gibeonbii lɛ abɔfoi lɛ kitã akɛ amɛaaye kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ Gibeonbii lɛ ekpãŋ gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ nu akɛ amɛkɛ Gibeonbii lɛ jekɛɛɛ; amɛyɛ amɛkpokpai anɔ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã nyiɛmɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛyanina amɛmaji lɛ ni ji Gibeon kɛ Kefira kɛ Beerot kɛ Kiriat Yearim.
Shi Israelbii lɛ pleneee amɛ ejaakɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã amɛ kitã.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi maŋ onukpai lɛ.
Shi maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna wɔkɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã amɛ kitã, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ amɛhe wɔta.
Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni wɔɔfee amɛ ji wɔkɛ amɛhe ake amɛ bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ mli akafu wɔ yɛ kitã ni wɔkã amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ tee nɔ amɛkɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, akagbe amɛ, shi moŋ ahã amɛya lai kɛ faaŋ amɛhã Israel asafo lɛ fɛɛ.” Ŋãa ni lumɛi lɛ wo nɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua hã atsɛ Gibeonbii lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni nyɛlaka wɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔ kɛ nyɛteŋ jɛkɛ naakpa lɛ?’ Asomoaŋ wɔmasɛi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛyɔɔ?
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛlomɔ nyɛhe, ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛteŋ nyɔji baajɛ aya lai kɛ faaŋ kɛba miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ.” Gibeonbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yoshua akɛ, “Agba otsuji bɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo etsulɔ Mose shi akɛ ekɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baahã nyɛ, ni ebaakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ ehã nyɛ.
Sane nɛɛ hã wɔshe gbeyei; ni no hã wɔye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ.
Amrɔ nɛɛ wɔyɛ odɛ̃ŋ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ja yɛ ohiɛ akɛ ofee wɔ lɛ feemɔ.” Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Yoshua fee ni ekɛjie Gibeonbii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛkagbe amɛ.
Shi moŋ kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ Yoshua fee Gibeonbii nɛɛ lailɛlɔi kɛ faaŋyalɔi ehã Israelbii lɛ.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyaa lai kɛ faaŋ kɛbaa ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Aye Amorbii anɔ kunim Yerusalɛm maŋtsɛ Adonizedek nu akɛ Yoshua eye Ai maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim, ni ekpãtã hiɛ butubutu, ni asaŋ efee Ai kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni efee Yeriko kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ enu hu akɛ Gibeonbii lɛ etee amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ eyakpãŋ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛ efee ekome, ni amɛfutu amɛ tete amɛ kɛ amɛ yɛ.
Be ni Adonizedek nu saji nɛɛ lɛ amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Eshishi ji akɛ maŋ wulu ji Gibeon; etamɔ maŋtsɛmaji lɛ eko nɔŋŋ, ni eda po fe Ai, asaŋ emli hii lɛ kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.
Enɛ hã Yerusalɛm maŋtsɛ Adonizedek tsu kɛtee Hebron maŋtsɛ Hoham kɛ Yarmut maŋtsɛ Piram kɛ Lakish maŋtsɛ Yafia kɛ Eglon maŋtsɛ Debir ŋɔɔ, ni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa nyɛbafataa mihe koni wɔyatua Gibeon shikpɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ eyafee ekome.” No hewɔ lɛ, Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ nɛɛ, ni ji Yerusalɛm maŋtsɛ kɛ Hebron maŋtsɛ kɛ Yarmut maŋtsɛ kɛ Lakish maŋtsɛ kɛ Eglon maŋtsɛ bua amɛtabilɔi lɛ anaa, kɛkɛ ni amɛto ta kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Gibeonbii ayawu; ni amɛyagba ta kɛbɔle Gibeon maŋ lɛ he.
Enɛ hã Gibeon hii lɛ tsu mɛi Yoshua ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ eshitoohe lɛ yɛ Gilgal, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ ebua amɛhe naa ewo wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ba mra koni obaye obua wɔ.
Kaaŋmɛɛ wɔhe ohã amɛ, shi otsuji ji wɔ.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israel tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛta lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Gilgal kɛtee.
Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Kaashe Amorbii lɛ gbeyei ejaakɛ mijɔɔ amɛnɔ momo mihã bo; amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ ohiɛ edamɔ.” Yoshua kɛ etabilɔi lɛ nyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Gilgal, ni amɛbahɛ̃ŋ Amorbii lɛ.
Yehowa hã Amorbii lɛ jijaa yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ gbe amɛ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Gibeon.
Asaŋ amɛnyiɛ Amorbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Bet Horon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ kɛyashi Azeka kɛ Makeda tɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni Amorbii lɛ joɔ Israelbii lɛ anaa foi kɛkpelekeɔ Bet Horon Gɔŋ lɛ, Yehowa hã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji jɛ ŋwɛi bashwie Amorbii lɛ anɔ aahu kɛyashi Azeka, ni amɛgboi.
Mɛi abɔ ni tɛi nɛɛ gbe lɛ ayi fa kwraa fe mɛi ni gboi yɛ Israelbii lɛ aklante naa.
Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa hã Israelbii lɛ ye Amorbii lɛ anɔ kunim nɛɛ lɛ, Yoshua kɛ Yehowa wie yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Hulu, wa odamɔ shi yɛ Gibeon!
Nyɔɔŋtsere bo hu wa yɛ Ayalon Jɔɔ lɛŋ!” Hulu lɛ wa lɛɛlɛŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ hu wa kɛyashi Israelbii lɛ tɔ amɛhe owele amɛgbe naa yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.
Aŋma sane nɛɛ yɛ Yashar Wolo lɛ mli.
Hulu wa edamɔ shi yɛ ŋwɛi aaafee gbi muu ni eyeee oyai ni eyanyɔ shi.
Nakai gbi lɛ henɔ bako pɛŋ dã, ni kɛjɛ no sɛɛ hu eko bako dɔŋŋ ni Yehowa ebo gbɔmɔ toi nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ gbi lɛ Yehowa wu Israel ta lɛ ehã lɛ.
Ta nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛŋ yɛ Gilgal.
Yoshua mɔmɔ Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ jo foi yɛ ta lɛŋ, ni amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ tɛkplo ko ni yɔɔ Makeda lɛ mli.
Abatswa Yoshua adafi akɛ, “Ayana Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ ni amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Makeda lɛ mli.” No ni Yoshua fã akɛ, “Nyɛyakokloa tɛi kpeteŋkplei nyɛtsimɔa tɛkplo lɛ naa, ni nyɛshĩa hii yɛ jɛi koni amɛbu maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ahe.
No sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛkadamɔa shi; nyɛtiua henyɛlɔi lɛ, ni nyɛjɛa amɛsɛɛgbɛ nyɛtswiaa amɛ nii.
Nyɛkaŋmɛa amɛ gbɛ ni amɛyabote amɛmaji lɛ amli, ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim momo.” Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi Amorbii lɛ kɛyashi amɛyi tã; shi mɛi ni na gbɛ jo foi lɛ yabote maji ni atswa gbogbo kɛfofoo amɛhe lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ shweshweeshwe kɛba Yoshua ŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Makeda shitoohe lɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko etswaaa esɛŋ eshiii Israelbii lɛ.
Yoshua fã ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbelea tɛkplo lɛ naa koni nyɛkɛ nakai maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ abahãa mi.” Afee bɔ ni Yoshua fã lɛ; ajie nakai maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli kɛje kpo abahã lɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ji Yerusalɛm maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Hebron maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Yarmut maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Lakish maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Eglon maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Be ni akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ je kpo kɛba Yoshua ŋɔ̃ɔ lɛ, Yoshua tsɛ Israel hii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ tabilɔi ni kɛ lɛ tee ta lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛbaa koni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji abamãmɔa nɛkɛ maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ akuɛi anɔ.” Asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaji bamãmɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ akuɛi anɔ.
Yoshua tee nɔ, ni ekɛɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuii hu akafãa; nyɛfea kakaaka kɛ ekãa fɛɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Yehowa baafee nyɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛbaawu lɛ.” No sɛɛ lɛ, Yoshua tswia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ nii, ni egbe amɛ; ni ekɛ amɛgbohii lɛ tsotsoro shi yɛ tsei enumɔ anɔ.
Gbohii nɛɛ tsotsoro tsei lɛ anɔ kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi be ni hulu yaanyɔ shi dani Yoshua hã ajie amɛ yɛ tsei lɛ anɔ, ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie tɛkplo lɛ ni amɛyatee yɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni akoklo tɛi kpeteŋkplei akɛtsi tɛkplo lɛ naa; ni eyɛ nakai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yoshua shɔ̃ Amorbii ashikpɔji krokomɛi hu Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yoshua yatua Makeda maŋ lɛ, ni egbe emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli bii fɛɛ; eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Efee Makeda maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni efee Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tse mli kɛjɛ Makeda kɛtee Libna, ni eyatua Libna maŋ lɛ hu.
Yehowa jɔɔ Libna kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ehã Yoshua, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim.
Yoshua kɛ klante kpãtã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Libna lɛ ahiɛ.
Efee Libna maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni efee Yeriko maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tse mli kɛjɛ Libna kɛtee Lakish, ni amɛyagba ta kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he, ni amɛtua maŋ lɛ.
Yehowa jɔɔ Lakish nɔ ehã Yoshua, ni gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eye nɔ kunim, ni Yoshua shɔ̃ maŋ lɛ.
Ekɛ klante kpãtã maŋ lɛ kɛ emli gbɔmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efee Libna lɛ.
No be lɛ mli ni Gezer maŋtsɛ Horam fã ta kɛba, ni ebawa Lakishbii lɛ.
Shi Yoshua gbe lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ kɛyashi eshwɛɛɛ Gezer tabilɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tse mli kɛjɛ Lakish kɛtee Eglon, ni amɛyagba ta kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he, ni amɛtua Eglonbii lɛ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛ wu.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ̃ maŋ lɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfite maŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klante kpãtã emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni efee Lakish lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Eglon kɛtee Hebron, ni amɛyatua maŋ lɛ ni amɛ kɛ amɛ wu.
Amɛshɔ̃ Hebron, ni amɛkɛ klante kpãtã Hebron maŋtsɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ akrowai lɛ hu fɛɛ amli bii ahiɛ butuu.
Eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Eglon lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ekpãtã maŋ lɛ kɛ emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Debir, ni amɛbatua maŋ lɛ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛ wu.
Eye maŋ lɛ kɛ emli maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ akrowai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Amɛkɛ klante kpãtã maji lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ahiɛ butuu.
Eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Bɔ ni Yoshua fee Hebron kɛ Libna kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee Debir kɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua ye shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim: kɛjɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛbote jɔi lɛ amli aahu kɛyashwie ŋmeŋmei lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.
Yoshua ye maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim bɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ; ekpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hiɛ butuu tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ efã lɛ.
Yoshua ye maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea kɛtee Gaza, kɛmɔ Goshen shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ aahu kɛtee Gibeon tɔ̃ɔ.
Ta shi kome ni Yoshua fã lɛ, ekɛye shikpɔji nɛɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim ejaakɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni wu tai lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ mli yɛ Gilgal.
Yoshua ye Maŋtsɛ Yabin kɛ ehefatalɔi lɛ anɔ kunim Be ni Hazor maŋtsɛ Yabin nu kunim ni Israelbii lɛ eye lɛ he lɛ, etsu maŋtsɛmɛi srɔtoi nɛɛ aŋɔɔ: Madom maŋtsɛ Yobab kɛ Shimron maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Ashkaf maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Yordan jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ ashishi lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Dor ŋshɔnaa yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ.
Etsu Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Hivbii ni yɔɔ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ shishi yɛ Mizpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hu aŋɔ̃ɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ fã kɛba kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ ta shwiilii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Amɛyi fa babaoo oookɛɛ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Merom Faa lɛ naa koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Kaashe amɛ gbeyei ejaakɛ wɔ be ni aaashɛ nɛkɛ be mli lɛ mahã amɛ fɛɛ amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ Israelbii ahiɛ.
Nyɛfolɔa amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ ananesɛɛ fãi lɛ, ni nyɛshãa amɛta shwiilii lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ bahɛ̃ŋ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ Merom Faa lɛ toi.
Yehowa jɔɔ henyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ ehã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛye amɛnɔ kunim.
Israelbii lɛ gbe amɛ, ni asaŋ amɛtiu amɛ kɛtee Sidon kɛ Misrefot Maim tɔ̃ɔ.
Yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ tiu henyɛlɔi lɛ kɛyashɛ Mizpa Jɔɔ lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ kɛyashi eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Yoshua fee henyɛlɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ akɛ efee lɛ: efolɔ amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ ananesɛɛ fãi lɛ, ni eshã amɛta shwiilii lɛ hu.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoshua ku esɛɛ kɛtee, ni eyaŋɔ̃ Hazor maŋ lɛ, ni egbe emli maŋtsɛ lɛ ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ Hazor ji jɛi kpokpai lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛyelihei lɛ fɛɛ kwa yitso.
Israelbii lɛ kɛ klante gbe Hazor mli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Eshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ma Hazor maŋ lɛ naa la, ni amɛshã.
Yoshua ŋɔ̃ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ, ni emɔ̃mɔ amɛmli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu, ni akɛ klante gbe amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsulɔ, Mose fã lɛ.
Shi maji fɛɛ ni jwere ŋmeŋmei anɔ lɛ, Yoshua eshãaa amɛmli ekoeko akɛ ja Hazor pɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ha maji lɛ amli bii lɛ anibii fɛɛ kɛ amɛkooloi hu amɛhã amɛhe.
Asaŋ amɛkɛ klante gbe maji lɛ amli gbɔmɛi kɛyashi amɛkpãtã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ; amɛshwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa wo etsulɔ Mose kitã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Mose hu wo Yoshua kitã lɛ, ni nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yoshua fee.
Nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa wo he kitã lɛ, Yoshua shiii mli ekoeko ni etsuuu he nii.
Shikpɔŋ ni Yoshua shɔ̃ lɛ Yoshua shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ji gɔji lɛ anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Goshen shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ amɛjɔɔ mli shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni Yoshua shɔ̃ lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ Halak Gɔŋ lɛ ni woɔ ehe nɔ kɛyaa Seir kpokpai anɔ lɛ he kɛyashi Baal-Gad, yɛ Lebanon Jɔɔ lɛ mli, yɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ shishi.
Yoshua mɔ̃mɔ shikpɔji nɛɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, ni etswia amɛ nii, ni egbe amɛ.
Yoshua kɛ nɛkɛ maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ wu ta be babaoo.
Kɛjɛ Hivbii ni ji Gibeonbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, maŋ ko maŋ ko kwraa bɛ ni emli bii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãŋ kɛfee ekome.
No hewɔ lɛ, maji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ta Israelbii lɛ wu ni amɛkɛna.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ, akɛ ehã maji lɛ amli bii lɛ kpliŋ amɛtsui, bɔ ni afee ni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ awu ta koni atsɔ̃ no nɔ amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã Mose lɛ.
Yoshua fã ta nakai be lɛ mli, ni etee eyabule Anakbii lɛ ashwiei lɛ shishi yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni ji Hebron kɛ Debir kɛ Anab kɛ Yuda gɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ kɛ Israel gɔji lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ.
Ekpãtã amɛ kɛ amɛmaji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ butuu.
Anakbii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ eshwɛɛɛ hiɛkãalɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gaza kɛ Gat kɛ Ashdod pɛ ji hei ni eshwɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ.
Yoshua ŋɔ̃ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ Mose eto lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ni Yoshua ja shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã Israel akutsei lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ koni amɛhi nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ taitai lɛ asɛɛ fo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni Mose ye amɛnɔ kunim Israelbii lɛ ye maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛŋɔ̃ amɛshikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyanina Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ni hi shi yɛ Heshbon lɛ.
Emaŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ eko ji kɛjɛ Aroer (ni kã Yordan Jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naa lɛ) kɛmɔ Arnon Jɔɔ lɛ teŋ maŋ lɛ kɛyanina Yabok Faa lɛ ni ji Amonbii lɛ ahusu lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ feɔ Gilead shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fã.
Maŋtsɛ Sihon nɛɛ nɔŋŋ shikpɔŋ ji Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli shikpɔŋ ni kã shi kɛjɛ Bet Yeshimot wuoyi (yɛ Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ bokãgbɛ) kɛyashwie Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ kome ko hu ji Bashan Maŋtsɛ Og.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo ni shwɛ lɛ ateŋ eko ji lɛ.
Eye emaŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Ashtarot kɛ Edrei, ni enɔyeli shikpɔji lɛ ekomɛi ji Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Salka kɛ Bashan muu fɛɛ kɛyashi Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Maakatbii lɛ ahusui lɛ anaa.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eshikpɔŋ ji Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ fã ni kã shi kɛyashi Heshbon maŋtsɛ Sihon husu lɛ naa lɛ.
Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛ Israelbii lɛ ye maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ anɔ kunim, ni Mose kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ashikpɔji lɛ hã Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã akɛ amɛnɔ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni Yoshua ye amɛnɔ kunim Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ ye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ anɔ kunim; no ji maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Yordan anaigbɛ kɛjɛ Baal-Gad, yɛ Lebanon Jɔɔ lɛ mli, kɛyanina Halak Gɔŋ lɛ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ Edom masɛi.
Yoshua jara maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ashikpɔji lɛ eha Israel akutsei lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Shikpɔji ni ajara nɛɛ ekomɛi ji gɔji anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ, kɛ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ, ni ji wuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Jebusbii lɛ hi.
Israelbii lɛ ye maŋtsɛmɛi ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ anɔ kunim: Yeriko maŋtsɛ kɛ Ai ni bɛŋkɛ Betel maŋtsɛ, kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋtsɛ kɛ Hebron maŋtsɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Yarmut maŋtsɛ kɛ Lakish maŋtsɛ, kɛ Eglon maŋtsɛ kɛ Gezer maŋtsɛ; agbɛnɛ kɛ Debir maŋtsɛ kɛ Geder maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Horma maŋtsɛ kɛ Arad maŋtsɛ, kɛ Libna maŋtsɛ, kɛ Adullam maŋtsɛ, kɛ Makeda maŋtsɛ kɛ Betel maŋtsɛ, kɛ Tapua maŋtsɛ kɛ Hefer maŋtsɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Afek maŋtsɛ kɛ Lasharon maŋtsɛ, kɛ Madon maŋtsɛ kɛ Hazor maŋtsɛ, kɛ Shimron Meron maŋtsɛ kɛ Akshaf maŋtsɛ; agbɛnɛ kɛ Taanak maŋtsɛ kɛ Megido maŋtsɛ, kɛ Kedesh maŋtsɛ, kɛ Yokneam maŋtsɛ ni yɔɔ Karmel shishi lɛ, kɛ Dor maŋtsɛ ni hi Nafat Dor lɛ kɛ Goiim (ni yɔɔ Galilea lɛ) maŋtsɛ, kɛ Tirza maŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome.
Shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ ni abaaŋɔ Be ni Yoshua egbɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ogbɔ, ni oye afii pii; shi shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ lolo ni sa akɛ aŋɔ lɛ fa.
Shikpɔji ni eshwɛ lɛ ji enɛɛmɛi: Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Geshurbii lɛ hu anɔ lɛ, ni ji kɛjɛ Shihor Faa lɛ naa, yɛ Ijipt bokãgbɛ lɛ, kɛtee kɛyashi Ekron husu lɛ naa, he ni abuɔ akɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Filistibii lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ ni ji Gaza maŋtsɛ kɛ Ashdod maŋtsɛ kɛ Ashkelon maŋtsɛ kɛ Gat maŋtsɛ kɛ Ekron maŋtsɛ yɛ jɛi, kɛ Avimbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ hu.
Yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Meara, ni ji Sidonbii anɔ mli lɛ, kɛyashi Afek kɛ Amorbii ahusu lɛ naa fata he.
Ekomɛi hu ji Giblibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Lebanon muu fɛɛ kɛtee bokãgbɛ, kɛjɛ Balgad yɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛyashi he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Hamat lɛ.
Sidonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ ni kã shi kɛjɛ Lebanon gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyashi Misrefot Maim lɛ hu fata he.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mibashwie gbɔmɛi nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Bo lɛ fɔ̃ɔ oshiki kɛkɛ koni okɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ ohã Israelbii lɛ koni etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mifã bo lɛ.
Jaa shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ohã Israel akutsei nɛɛhu lɛ kɛ Manase akutso lɛ fã ni eshwɛ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.” Bɔ ni aja shikpɔŋ ni kã Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ ahã Manase akutso lɛ fã kome kɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ ena amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ momo yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã amɛ lɛ.
Amɛna kɛjɛ Aroer, ni ji Arnon Jɔɔ lɛ naa shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ maŋ wulu ni kã jɔɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, kɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Medeba aahu kɛyashi Dibon.
Agbɛnɛ amɛna Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ye emaŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Heshbon lɛ shishi maji lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashi Amonbii lɛ ahusu lɛ nɔ.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ Gilead kɛ Geshurbii kɛ Maakatbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Bashan fɛɛ kɛyashi Salka hu hã.
Akɛ Maŋtsɛ Og maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji lɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ fɛɛ shi nɔ hã amɛ, ejaakɛ Og ji Ashtarot kɛ Edrei nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Lɛ ji hii oblaŋi gojogojoo ni Mose ye amɛnɔ kunim ni eshwie amɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni shwɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ eshwieee Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Maakatbii lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Maakatbii lɛ futu Israelbii lɛ kɛhi shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Levibii akutso lɛ kɛkɛ ni Mose hãaa amɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Afɔlei ni akɛ la shãa akɛhãa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji Levibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni ahã amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ekɛɛ amɛ eto lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Rubenbii lɛ Mose hã Rubenbii akutso lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ji Aroer, ni ji Arnon Jɔɔ lɛ, kɛ maŋ wulu lɛ ni kã jɔɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, kɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Medeba lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ Heshbon kɛ eshishi maji lɛ fɛɛ ni jwere gɔŋ yiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Dibon kɛ Bamot-Baal kɛ Bet-Baal-Meon, kɛ Yahaz kɛ Kedemot kɛ Mefaat, kɛ Kiriataim kɛ Sibma kɛ Zeret-Shahar ni kã jɔɔ lɛ he gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Bet-Peor kɛ Pisga Gɔŋ lɛ hiɛshi shikpɔji lɛ kɛ Bet-Yeshimot.
Maji lɛ fɛɛ ni jwere gɔŋ yiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Heshbon lɛ shikpɔji lɛ hu fɛɛ baje Rubenbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mose ji mɔ ni ye Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon nɛɛ nɔ kunim.
Eye Midian lumɛi Evi kɛ Rekem kɛ Zur kɛ Hur kɛ Reba, ni ji Maŋtsɛ Sihon shishi lumɛi ni hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Israelbii lɛ gbe Bileam, Beor bi lɛ, ni ji klamɔ lɛ, hu amɛshi mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yordan Faa lɛ tsɔ̃ Rubenbii lɛ ahusu, ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ emli maji kɛ akrowai lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Rubenbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Gadbii lɛ Mose hã Gadbii lɛ hu shikpɔŋ lɛ eko akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Ehã amɛ kɛjɛ Yazer shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ kɛmɔ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ fã kɛyashi Aroer ni kã Raba bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ kɛjɛ Heshbon kɛyashi Ramat Mizpa kɛ Betonim hu hã amɛ nɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ hu ehã amɛ kɛjɛ Mahanaim kɛyashi Debir husu lɛ nɔ, kɛ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli maji lɛ, ni ji Bet Haram kɛ Bet Nimra kɛ Sukot kɛ Zafon kɛ Heshbon maŋtsɛ Sihon shikpɔji ni eshwɛ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ Yordan lɛ naa akɛ husu kɛtee Galilea Kpaakpo lɛ shishigbɛ he ni kpaakpo lɛ naa yatãa yɛ lɛ yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ maji wuji kɛ akrowai fɛɛ ni Gadbii lɛ na yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Manasebii yɛ Bokãgbɛ lɛ Mose hã Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ koni etsɔ̃ akutso nɛɛ mli wekui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ Mahanaim; ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɔɔ Bashan shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ji Bashan maŋtsɛ Og shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Yair maji nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ fã kɛ agbɛnɛ Ashtarot kɛ Edrei, ni ji Bashan maŋtsɛ Og maŋtsɛyelihe lɛ mli maji wuji lɛ.
Akɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ hã Manase bi Makir shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa akɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã lɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ.
Belɛ nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Mose ja Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋã kplanaa ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ Yeriko bokãgbɛ lɛ, ehã Israelbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
Shi Levibii lɛ Mose hãaa amɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko.
Amɛ lɛ afɔlei ni akɛbahãa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.
Nakai ji bɔ ni Mose hã amɛnu shishi.
Bɔ ni aja Shikpɔŋ ni kã Yordan Anaigbɛ lɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnii ni amɛna yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Israelbii lɛ akutseiatsɛmɛi onukpai lɛ tsɔ̃ ja hã amɛ nɛ.
Oshiki ji nɔ ni afɔ̃ akɛja akutsei nɛɛhu kɛ fã lɛ agbɛfaŋnii lɛ ahã amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo amɛ ehe kitã lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Mose ehã akutsei enyɔ kɛ fã lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ momo yɛ Yordan lɛ sɛɛ.
Shi Levibii lɛ, amɛ lɛ, ehãaa amɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ko yɛ nii ni aja lɛ mli.
Akutsei enyɔ jɛ Yosef mli; amɛ ji Manase kɛ Efraim.
Ahãaa Levibii lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ pɔtɛ̃ɛ ko akɛ ja maji ni amɛaahi amɛmli kɛ maji lɛ ahe shikpɔji ni amɛkooloi ana nɔ jwɛi amɛye, ni amɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ hu amɛaana nɔ nii amɛye.
Bɔ ni Yehowa wo Mose kitã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii lɛ fee kɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe.
Akɛ Hebron hã Kaleb Gbi ko lɛ Yuda akutso lɛŋ bii lɛ ba Yoshua ŋɔɔ yɛ Gilgal; ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ji Kaleb, Keniznyo, Yefune bi lɛ, kɛ sane bafɔ̃ Yoshua hiɛ akɛ, “Oookai wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose wie yɛ mihewɔ, kɛ bo hu ohewɔ, yɛ Kadesh Barnea lɛ.
Miye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ be ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose tsu mi kɛjɛ Kadesh Barnea akɛ miyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Miku misɛɛ mibabɔ lɛ nɔ ni miyana anɔkwale mli kɛjɛ mitsuiŋ.
Nyɛmimɛi lɛ ni kɛ mi tee lɛ bafã maŋ lɛ tsui; shi mi lɛ mibo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi kɛwula shi.
Enɛ hã Mose kã kitã nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, shikpɔŋ lɛ ni onane eyanyiɛ nɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ bo kɛ obii agbɛfaŋnɔ kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ obo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ toi kɛwula shi.’ Yehowa ehã miyi ena wala, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni ekɛ Mose wie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ, be ni Israelbii lɛ nyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ miye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ miyɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ tamɔ miyɔɔ be ni Mose tsu mi lɛ.
Tawuu gbɛfaŋ ni jio, yaakɛbaa kɛkɛ gbɛfaŋ ni jio, hewalɛ ni miyɔɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nakai hewalɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ okɛ nɛkɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã mi, nɔ ni Yehowa wo shi yɛ he nakai gbi lɛ.
Nakai bo diɛŋtsɛ onu kɛ otoi akɛ Anakbii lɛ ji mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi yɛ maji wuji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe akɛwaje amɛ lɛ mli.
Eko lɛ Yehowa aaaye abua mi koni mashwie amɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua jɔɔ Kaleb, ni ekɛ Hebron hã Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Hebron tsɔ̃ Kaleb, Yefune, Keniznyo lɛ bi lɛ, gbɛfaŋ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ejaakɛ ebo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi kɛwula shi.
Sa lɛ Hebron gbɛi ji Kiriat Arba, eshishi ji Arba maŋ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Yudabii lɛ Shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Yudabii lɛ akutso lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ, ekã shi kɛtee aahu kɛyashɛ Edom husu lɛ nɔ yɛ Zin ŋã lɛ wuoyigbɛ naagbeehe fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Amɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ jɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ naagbeehe lɛ, yɛ ble ni kã wuoyigbɛ lɛ naa, ni etsɔ̃ Akrabim gɔji ateŋ gbɛ lɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Zin kɛyaje Kadesh Barnea wuoyigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni husu lɛ sharã Hezron he kɛtee Adar, ni elɔgɔ kɛtee Karka.
Kɛjɛ biɛ lɛ husu lɛ tsɔ̃ Azmon kɛtee Ijipt faa lɛ naa, ni enaa yatã yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Enɛ ji Yudabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ husu lɛ ji Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ kɛlɛ kɛyashi he ni Yordan lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ lɛ.
Kooyigbɛ husu lɛ jɛ ble ni yɔɔ he ni Yordan lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ biɛ lɛ husu lɛ tee Bet Hogla; kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ Bet Araba Kooyigbɛ kɛtee Ruben bi Bohan tɛ lɛ he.
Husu lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ Akor Jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee Debir, ni edɔ eyi kɛtsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ kɛtee Gilgal ni kwɛɔ Adumim gɔji ateŋ gbɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ jɔɔ lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ husu lɛ sharã Enshemesh nuhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe, ni ekɛ enaa yawo Rogel Nubu lɛ mli.
Husu lɛ tsa nɔ ekoŋŋ kɛtsɔ̃ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli, yɛ gɔŋ ni Yebusbii amaŋ ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ mã nɔ lɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni ewo ehe nɔ kɛtee gɔŋ ni ye Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ anaigbɛ, yɛ he ni Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ naa yatãa yɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ husu lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ kɛtee Neftoa Nuhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ etse mli kɛtsɔ̃ Efrom Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ahe, ni edɔ eyi kɛtee Baala, ni ji Kiriat-Yearim.
Elɔgɔ kɛjɛ Baala kɛtsɔ̃ anaigbɛ yɛ Edom gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ he kɛtee Yearim Gɔŋ lɛ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kesalon hu lɛ, kooyigbɛ.
Ekpeleke shi kɛtee Bet Shemesh, ni esharã Timna he kɛho.
Husu lɛ tse mli, ni enyiɛ gɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Ekron kooyigbɛ lɛ masɛi kɛtee Shikeron.
No sɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ Baala Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaje Yamnia, ni enaa yamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Ŋshɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji Yudabii lɛ anaigbɛ husu lɛ.
Enɛ ji Yudabii lɛ awekui lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ husu.
Kaleb ye Hebron Kɛ Debir nɔ kunim Yoshua hã Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ Yudabii lɛ ateŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ, Yoshua lɛ.
Maŋ ni eha Kaleb lɛ ji Hebron, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kiriat Arba hu lɛ.
Anak nɛɛ, etsɛ gbɛi akɛwo Kiriat Arba nɛɛ.
Kaleb shwie Anak shwiei etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ji Sheshai kɛ Ahiman kɛ Talmai, kɛje Hebron.
Kɛkɛ ni Kaleb fã kɛjɛ Hebron, ni etee ekɛ Debirbii lɛ yawu.
Sa lɛ Debir gbɛi ji Kiriat Sefer.
Kaleb wo shi ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni aaanyɛ ayatua Kiriat Sefer, ni eshɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mikɛ mibiyoo Aksa baahã lɛ gbãlã.” Kɛkɛ ni Kaleb nɔŋŋ nyɛmi nuu gbekɛ Kenaz Otniel fã ta kɛtee ni eyaŋɔ Debir maŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Kaleb kɛ ebiyoo Aksa ha Otniel gbãlã.
Be ni Aksa tee ewu Otniel ŋɔɔ lɛ, Otniel wo Aksa yiŋ akɛ ebi etsɛ Kaleb koni efo shikpɔŋ ko ehã lɛ.
Be ni Aksa shɛ etsɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ejɛ teji ni eta nɔ lɛ nɔ eyi shi lɛ, Kaleb bi lɛ akɛ, “Aksa, mɛni he hiaa bo?” Aksa jie naa akɛ, “Oha mi shikpɔŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ; ha mi nubui hu ofata he akɛ gbɛwoo nii.” Kɛkɛ ni Kaleb ha Aksa nubui ni yɔɔ gɔŋ nɔ kɛ nubui ni yɔɔ jɔɔ mli hu.
Yudabii lɛ amaji wuji lɛ Yudabii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ maji ni ahã amɛ lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ.
Yudabii lɛ akutso lɛ mli bii lɛ, amɛmaji wuji ni yaye wuoyigbɛ kwraa, kɛyaa Edom husu lɛ naa, ji Kabzeel kɛ Eder kɛ Yagur, kɛ Kina kɛ Dimona kɛ Adada, kɛ Kedesh kɛ Hazor kɛ Itnan.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Zif kɛ Telem kɛ Bealot, kɛ Hazor Hadata kɛ Keriot Hezron ni ji Hazor, kɛ Amam kɛ Shema kɛ Molada.
Maji lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji Hazar Gada kɛ Heshmon kɛ Bet Pelet, kɛ Hazar Shual kɛ Beersheba kɛ Biziotia, kɛ Baala kɛ Yim kɛ Ezem.
Yudabii lɛ nɔŋŋ amaji wuji krokomɛi hu ji Eltolad kɛ Kesil kɛ Horma, kɛ Ziklag kɛ Madmana kɛ Sansana, agbɛnɛ kɛ Lebaot kɛ Shilhim kɛ Ain kɛ Rimon.
Maji lɛ fɛɛ fee nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ amɛhe akrowai hu.
Ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ maji lɛ ji Eshtaol kɛ Zora kɛ Ashna, Zanoa kɛ En-Ganim kɛ Tapua kɛ Enam, kɛ Yarmut kɛ Adullam kɛ Soko kɛ Azeka, kɛ Shaaraim kɛ Aditaim kɛ Gedera kɛ Gederotaim.
Enɛɛmɛi feɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Ŋa nɔ maji lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji Zenan kɛ Hadasha kɛ Migdal-Gad, kɛ Dilan kɛ Mizpa kɛ Yokte-El, kɛ Lakish kɛ Bozkat kɛ Eglon, kɛ Kabon kɛ Lakmas kɛ Kitlish, kɛ Gederot kɛ Bet-Dagon kɛ Naama kɛ Makeda: maji nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ hu jwere ŋa nɔ: Libna kɛ Eter kɛ Ashim, kɛ Ifta kɛ Ashna kɛ Nezib, kɛ Keila kɛ Akzib kɛ Maresha: maji nɛɛhu kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji krokomɛi hu ni jwere ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji Ekron kɛ ehe maji kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ; ejwere shi kɛjɛ Ekron diɛŋtsɛ aahu kɛyanina Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ, maji wuji kɛ maji bibii fɛɛ, kɛ maji kɛ akrowai ni yɔɔ Ashdod masɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Ashdod kɛ ehe maji kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ, kɛ Gaza hu kɛ ehe maji kɛ ehe akrowai kɛyashi Ijipt faa lɛ naa kɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ hu naa lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gɔji anɔ maji lɛ ekomɛi ji Shamir kɛ Yatir kɛ Soko, kɛ Dana kɛ Kiriat-Sana, ni ji Debir, kɛ Anab kɛ Eshtemo kɛ Anim, kɛ Goshen kɛ Holon kɛ Gilo: maji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji krokomɛi hu ji Arab kɛ Duma kɛ Eshean, kɛ Yanum kɛ Bet-Tapua kɛ Afeka, kɛ Humta kɛ Kiriat-Arba, ni ji Hebron, kɛ Zior: maji nɛɛhu kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji krokomɛi hu ji Maon kɛ Karmel kɛ Zif kɛ Yuta, kɛ Yezreel kɛ Yokdeam kɛ Zanoa, kɛ Kain kɛ Gibea kɛ Timna: maji nyɔŋma kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Halhul kɛ Bet-Zur kɛ Gedor, kɛ Maarat kɛ Bet-Anot kɛ Eltekon: maji ekpaa kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji komɛi hu ji Kiriat-Baal, ni ji Kiriat-Yearim kɛ Raba: maji enyɔ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ diɛŋtsɛ maji lɛ ji Bet-Araba kɛ Midin kɛ Sekaka, kɛ Nibshan kɛ Ŋoomaŋ kɛ En-Gedi: maji ekpaa kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Shi Yudabii lɛ eyanyɛɛɛ Yebusbii, ni ji mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ amɛshwie.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yebusbii lɛ futu Yudabii lɛ kɛhi Yerusalɛm kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ yɛ Anaigbɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ lɛ husu kã shi kɛjɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa he ko ni kɛ Yeriko jekɛɛɛ.
Husu lɛ jɛ nuhiŋmɛii ni yɔɔ Yeriko bokãgbɛ lɛ ahe kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛjɛ Yeriko lɛ husu lɛ tsɔ̃ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛtee Betel, ni kɛjɛ Betel lɛ etee Luz dani etse mli kɛtee Atarot Adar, ni ji Arkibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ema eyi shi kɛtsɔ̃ anaigbɛ kɛbote Yafletbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtee aahu ni eyabote Bet-Horon shikpɔŋ lɛ hu mli yɛ eshishigbɛ naagbeehe lɛ kɛyashɛ Gezer, ni enaa yamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ji nɔ ni akɛhã Yosef bii Manase kɛ Efraim shwiei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Efraimbii kɔkrɔɔ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ Shikpɔŋ ni ahã Efraimbii lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ ji enɛ: Yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ amɛhusu ji kɛjɛ Atarot-Adar kɛyashi Bet-Horon yiteŋgbɛ he ko.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ yamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ husu lɛ yawa Mikmetat, ni edɔ eyi kɛtsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ kɛtee Taanat-Shilo; kɛkɛ ni etse mli kɛtee Yanoha yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Kɛjɛ Yanoha lɛ, husu lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Atarot kɛ Naara, ni esharã Yeriko kɛyamɔ Yordan lɛ.
Husu lɛ jɛ Tapua kɛtee Kanaan faa lɛ naa yɛ anaigbɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni Efraimbii lɛ na yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ nɛ.
Ahã amɛ maji hu kɛ amɛhe akrowai hu afata he yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Manasebii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi Efraimbii lɛ eshwieee Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ Gezer lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Kanaanbii nɛɛ kɛ Efraimbii lɛ futu kɛhi shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; ni Kanaanbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ Efraimbii lɛ.
Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ kɔkrɔɔ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ Ahã Manase akutso lɛ fã kome ni eshwɛ lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ejaakɛ Manase ji Yosef kromɔbi.
Manase kromɔbi Mikir, ni ji Gilead tsɛ lɛ, akɛ Gilead kɛ Bashan hã lɛ ejaakɛ tawulɔ kpanaa ji lɛ.
Manasebii ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ hu na amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Amɛ ji Abiezerbii lɛ kɛ Helekbii lɛ kɛ Asrielbii lɛ kɛ Shekembii lɛ kɛ Heferbii lɛ kɛ Shemidabii lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Yosef bi Manase musuŋ bihii lɛ awekui lɛ.
Shi Manase bi Makir bi Gilead bi Hefer bi Zelofehad eyafɔɔɔ bihii, yei sɔŋŋ efɔ.
Ebiyei lɛ agbɛii ji Mala kɛ Noa kɛ Hogla kɛ Milka kɛ Tirza.
Zelofehad biyei nɛɛ ba Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun bi Yoshua kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛkɛ sane bafɔ̃ amɛhiɛ akɛ, “Yehowa wo kitã akɛ ahã wɔ hu, wɔ kɔkrɔɔ, wɔshikpɔŋ tamɔ ahã wɔnyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, ahã Zelofehad biyei lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛtsɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni Manase shwiei lɛ na shikpɔji nyɔŋma, soro Gilead kɛ Bashan shikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ sɛɛ lɛ.
Akɛni Manase biyei lɛ na amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ, ni ebihii lɛ hu na amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ hewɔ lɛ akɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hã Manasebii ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ amɛ hu amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Manasebii lɛ ahusu lɛ, ekã shi kɛjɛ Asher kɛtee Mikmetat ni yɔɔ Shekem bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Husu lɛ tsa nɔ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ kɛyanina En-Tapuabii lɛ, ni ekɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ eshi nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ nɔ ni Tapua yɔɔ lɛ Manasebii lɛ anɔ ni; shi Tapua maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ akɛhã Efraimbii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ husu lɛ mã eyi shi kɛtee Kana faa lɛ naa.
Maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ faa nɛɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ Efraimbii amaji ni; tsɛbelɛ amɛyɛ Manasebii ashikpɔŋ nɔ.
Manasebii ahusu lɛ tse mli kɛnyiɛ faa lɛ kooyigbɛ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Belɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã wuoyigbɛ lɛ Efraimbii anɔ ni; ni Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ fee amɛhusu yɛ anaigbɛ.
Manasebii lɛ kɛ Asherbii lɛ je husu yɛ kooyi anaigbɛ, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛkɛ Isakarbii lɛ je husu yɛ kooyi anaigbɛ.
Akɛ Isakarbii lɛ kɛ Asherbii lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji komɛi hã Manasebii lɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Bet-Sham kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ kɛ Ibleam kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ kɛ Dorbii akrowai lɛ kɛ En-Dorbii kɛ amɛ akrowai lɛ kɛ Taanak kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ kɛ Megidobii kɛ amɛ akrowai lɛ (nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Nafat).
Shi Manasebii lɛ eyanyɛɛɛ Kanaanbii ni ji mɛi ni yɔɔ maji nɛɛ amli momo sa lɛ amɛshwie; ni no hewɔ lɛ, Kanaanbii lɛ tee nɔ, ni amɛhi maji nɛɛ amli.
Shi be ni Israelbii lɛ ahe bawa tete lɛ, amɛshwieee Kanaanbii lɛ; shi moŋ Israelbii lɛ ye amɛ nyɔŋ.
Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ bi shikpɔŋ lɛ eko amɛfata he Yosef shwiei lɛ bi Yoshua akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ofo shikpɔŋ kome pɛ kɛkɛ ohã wɔ akɛ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ be mli ni wɔyi fa babaoo, ni Yehowa ehã wɔshwere lɛ?” Yoshua to he akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyi fa tsɔ̃, ni Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ edaaa hãaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛyaa Perizbii lɛ kɛ Refaimbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛyagbaa koo ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ eko, ni nyɛtoa maŋ yɛ jɛi nyɛhia mli.” Yosef shwiei lɛ jie naa akɛ, “gɔji lɛ anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ edaaa hãaa wɔ moŋ nɛ, shi Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ yɛ dade tayaa shwiilii; mɛi ni yɔɔ Bet-Shean kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ amli lɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ hu fɛɛ yɛ eko.” Yoshua kɛɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ, ni ji Efraimbii kɛ Manasebii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyi fa babaoo, ni nyɛyɛ hewalɛ naakpa hu; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaana fe shikpɔŋ kome lɛ, ejaakɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ afata he.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛgbaa koo ni yɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛyashi he ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛkɛ ehusu lɛ ayashi, koni nyɛkɔ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ Kanaanbii lɛ yɛ dade tayaa shwiilii, ni amɛhe wa moŋ nɛ, shi amɛnyɛŋ nyɛhiɛ amɛdamɔ.”
Aja Shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ lɛ hu Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ Shilo, ni amɛshi Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ shikpɔŋ ni Israelbii lɛ eŋɔ̃ lɛ kã shi yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni eshwɛ Israelbii lɛ akutsei lɛ ateŋ kpawo lolo ni amɛ lɛ ahãko amɛ amɛshikpɔŋ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaashashao shi kɛyashi dani nyɛ nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa, nyɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛhã nyɛ lɛ?
Akutso fɛɛ akutso afamɔ hii etɛ̃ koni matsu amɛ koni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ koni amɛmɔmɔ shikpɔji ni amɛaasumɔ akɛ akɛhã amɛkutsei lɛ, ni amɛŋma bɔ ni shikpɔji lɛ yɔɔ amɛkɛbahã mi.
Abaagbala shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ mli kpawo.
Yudabii lɛ baaya nɔ koni amɛhi shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ momo sa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ; ni Yosef shwiei lɛ hu baaya nɔ amɛhi amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛjaraa shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ mli kpawo koni nyɛŋma bɔ ni husui lɛ ashikamɔ yɔɔ hãa nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ, koni mafɔ̃ oshiki mabi Yehowa nii mahã nyɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ akɔlɔ shikpɔji lɛ ahã.
Shi Levibii ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛnaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ji osɔfoyeli kɛhã Yehowa.
Gad akutso lɛ kɛ Ruben akutso lɛ kɛ Manasebii ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ, amɛna amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ momo yɛ Yordan lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ bokãgbɛ, he ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã amɛ lɛ.” Dani hii ni afamɔ koni amɛyaŋma shikpɔŋ lɛ he sane kɛba lɛ yi mli amɛtee lɛ, Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa koni nyɛyakpaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni nyɛŋma ehe sane, ni nyɛkɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba miŋɔ̃ɔ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ mafɔ̃ oshiki mabi Yehowa nii yɛ nyɛhewɔ yɛ Shilo nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni hii lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋma amɛwo wolo mli bɔ ni amɛjara shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kpawo lɛ amɛhã yɛ maji ni jwere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anaa, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yoshua ŋɔɔ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ yɛ Shilo, ni Yoshua fɔ̃ oshiki ni ekɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ eha amɛ, akutso fɛɛ akutso na egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ Klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Benyaminbii akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ anɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ kã Yudabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yosefbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ.
Benyaminbii nɛɛ akooyigbɛ husu lɛ jɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa ni ekwɔ kɛtsɔ̃ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛtee anaigbɛ kɛyamɔ Bet-Aven shiaŋa lɛ.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ kɛyashãrã Luz he (no nɔŋŋ ji Betel), ni etse mli kɛtee Atarot-Adar, yɛ gɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Jɔɔŋgbɛ Bet-Horon wuoyigbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Husu lɛ lɔgɔ ehe yɛ gɔŋ ni ye wuoyigbɛ ni ekwɛɔ Bet-Horon hiɛ lɛ nɔ, ni enaa yatã yɛ Kiriat-Baal, ni ji Kiriat-Yearim, Yudabii amaŋ lɛ.
Enɛ ji Benyaminbii lɛ anaigbɛ husu lɛ.
Amɛwuoyigbɛ husu lɛ jɛ Kiriat-Yearim kpokpai anɔ, ni etee anaigbɛ kɛyashi Neftoa Nuhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe.
Husu lɛ kpeleke shi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ ni kwɛɔ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ shishi, yɛ ekooyigbɛ he ni Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ naa yatãa yɛ lɛ.
Husu lɛ nyɔ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli agbɛnɛ, ni etsɔ̃ Yebusbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ kɛtee En-Rogel Nubu lɛ naa.
Egba kɛyi kooyigbɛ kɛjɛ biɛ kɛyamɔ En-Shemesh; ni etse mli kɛtee Gelilot ni yɔɔ Adumim Gɔŋ kɛ Gɔŋ teŋ gbɛ lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ekpeleke shi kɛtee Ruben bi Bohan Tɛ lɛ he.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ sharã Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ kooyigbɛ kɛho kɛbote jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Husu lɛ tse mli, ni eyaje Bet-Hogla masɛi yɛ ekooyigbɛ, ni enaa yatã yɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ kooyigbɛ ble lɛ mli he ni Yordan lɛ naa yatãa yɛ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni Benyaminbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ husu lɛ kã shi hã lɛ nɛ.
Belɛ Yordan Faa lɛ ji amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ husu yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ehe husui lɛ kamɔ shi hã.
Naa maji ni akɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ: Yeriko kɛ Bet-Hogla kɛ Emek-Keziz, kɛ Bet-Araba kɛ Zemariam kɛ Betel, kɛ Avim kɛ Para kɛ Ofra.
Ekomɛi hu ji Kefar-Amonai kɛ Ofni kɛ Geba ni hiɛ maji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ, kɛ Gibeon kɛ Rama kɛ Beerot, kɛ Mizpe kɛ Kefira kɛ Moza.
Maji lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji Rekem kɛ Irpeel kɛ Tarala, kɛ Zela kɛ Elef kɛ Yebus, ni ji Yerusalɛm, kɛ Gibea kɛ Kiriat-Yearim.
Maji fɛɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ na ji maji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Enɛ ji Benyaminbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni ahã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Simeonbii lɛ Oshiki ni ji enyɔ ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Simeonbii akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ bote shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Yudabii lɛ mli.
Maji ni Simeonbii lɛ na yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ ekomɛi ji Beersheba kɛ Sheba kɛ Molada, kɛ Hazar Shual kɛ Bala kɛ Ezem, kɛ Eltolad kɛ Betul kɛ Horma, kɛ Ziklag kɛ Bet-Markabot kɛ Hazar-Susa, kɛ Bet-Lebaot kɛ Sharuhem; fɛɛ fee maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Ain kɛ Rimon kɛ Eter kɛ Ashan, maji ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Akrowai fɛɛ ni jwere maji nɛɛ ahe kɛtee Baalat-Beer, ni ji Rama ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ, shi nɔ.
Enɛ ji Simeonbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ.
Simeonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ nɛɛ lɛ, afo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Yudabii lɛ he, ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ fa tsɔ̃ hã amɛ, ni no hewɔ ni akɛ eko hã Simeonbii lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Zebulonbii lɛ Oshiki ni ji etɛ̃ ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Zebulonbii akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ, ehusu tee aahu kɛyashɛ Sarid.
Husu nɛɛ tee anaigbɛ kɛyashɛ Marala kɛ Dabeshet, ni eyashɛ faa ni kã Yokneam bokãgbɛ lɛ naa.
Edɔ eyi yɛ Sarid efɔ̃ bokãgbɛ kɛtee Krislot-Tabor husu lɛ he, ni etsa nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Daberat kɛyashɛ Yafia.
Kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ husu lɛ tse mli kɛtsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ kɛyanina Gat-Hefer kɛ Et-Kazin.
Etse mli ekoŋŋ kɛtee Rimon, kɛkɛ ni edɔ eyi kɛtee Neah.
Husu lɛ dɔ ehe yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛtee Hanaton, ni etsa nɔ kɛtee ni enaa yatã yɛ Ifta-El Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Zebulonbii nɛɛ nɔ maji lɛ ekomɛi ji Katat kɛ Nahalal kɛ Shimron kɛ Idala kɛ Betlehem.
Maji lɛ fɛɛ fee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Nɛkɛ maji kɛ akrowai nɛɛ yɛ Zebulonbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa lɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Isakarbii lɛ Oshiki ni ji ejwɛ ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Isakarbii akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ maji ji Yezreel kɛ Kesulot kɛ Shunem, kɛ Hafaraim kɛ Shion kɛ Anaharat, kɛ Rabit kɛ Kishion kɛ Ebez.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Remet kɛ En-Ganim kɛ En-Hada kɛ Bet-Pazez.
Isakarbii lɛ ahusu lɛ tsɔ̃ Tabor kɛ Shahazuma kɛ Bet-Shemesh hu, ni enaa yatã yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa.
Amɛna maji nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ yɛ Isakarbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa lɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Asherbii lɛ Oshiki ni ji enumɔ ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Asherbii lɛ akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ekomɛi ji Helkat kɛ Hali kɛ Beten kɛ Akshaf, kɛ Alamelek kɛ Amad kɛ Mishal.
Yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ yashɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ he kɛ Shihor-Libnat.
Kɛkɛ ni husu lɛ dɔ eyi eŋmɛ bokãgbɛ kɛtee Bet-Dagon.
Etse mli yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛtee Zebulon kɛ Ifta-El Jɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛtee Bet-Emek kɛ Neiel.
Etsa nɔ ekoŋŋ kɛtee kooyigbɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛyanina Kabul, kɛ Ekron kɛ Rehob kɛ Hamon kɛ Kana kɛyashi Sidon.
Husu lɛ dɔ eyi agbɛnɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Rama kɛtee Tiro, ni ji maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he kpula kɛkpe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni edɔ kɛtee Hosa, ni etsa nɔ kɛtee ni enaa yatã yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Asherbii ashikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ maji krokomɛi hu ji Malahab kɛ Akzib kɛ Uma kɛ Afek kɛ Rehob.
Asherbii lɛ na maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Nɛkɛ maji kɛ amɛhe akrowai nɛɛ ji Asherbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Naftalibii lɛ Oshiki ni ji ekpaa ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Naftalibii lɛ akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ husu kã shi kɛjɛ Helef kɛ Zaananim koo lɛ naa kɛtee Adami-Nekeb yɛ Yamnia kɛ Lakum, ni eyamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ.
Husu lɛ jɛ jɛi ni etsɔ̃ anaigbɛ kɛtee Aznot-Tabor, ni ekɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ahusu lɛ yatsa yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni ekɛ Yudabii lɛ ahusu lɛ hu yatsa yɛ Yordan lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ, kɛkɛ ni etsa nɔ kɛtee Hukok.
Naftalibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛwaje amɛ lɛ ekomɛi ji Zidin kɛ Rakat kɛ Kineret, kɛ Adama kɛ Rama kɛ Hazor, kɛ Kedesh kɛ Edrel kɛ En-Hazor.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Yiron kɛ Migdal-El kɛ Horem kɛ Bet-Anat kɛ Bet-Shemesh.
Fɛɛ fee maji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu kɛ amɛhe akrowai.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ ji Naftalibii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni ahã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Danbii lɛ Oshiki ni ji kpawo ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Danbii lɛ akutso lɛ wekui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ekomɛi ji Zora kɛ Eshtaol kɛ Irshemesh, kɛ Shaalbim kɛ Ayalon kɛ Itla, kɛ Elon kɛ Timnat kɛ Ekron, kɛ Elteke kɛ Gibeton kɛ Baalat, kɛ Yehud kɛ Bene-Berak kɛ Gat-Rimon.
Maji lɛ ekrokomɛi ji Me-Yarkon kɛ Rakon kɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã Yopa he lɛ.
Be ni Danbii lɛ ahusu lɛ laaje amɛ lɛ, amɛto ta kɛtee ni amɛyatua Laish maŋ lɛ.
Amɛye Laishbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ̃ amɛmaŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi mli.
Amɛtsake maŋ lɛ gbɛi Laish lɛ, ni amɛwo jɛi Dan, ni ji amɛblema tsɛ, mɔ mli ni amɛjɛ, lɛ gbɛi.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe akrowai lɛ ji Danbii lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ ni ahã amɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Naagbee Shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã Be ni Israelbii lɛ ejara shikpɔŋ ni agbala lɛ amɛhã akutseiakutsei lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, afo shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ nii ni aja momo lɛ he, ni akɛhã Nun bi Yoshua akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Yoshua bi akɛ akɛ Timnat-Sera ni yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni akɛhã lɛ yɛ Yehowa famɔ naa.
Yoshua saa maŋ lɛ koni ehi jɛi.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Osɔfo Eleazar kɛ Nun bi Yoshua kɛ Israel akutsei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ damɔ oshiki ni amɛfɔ̃, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ naa, yɛ Shilo, lɛ nɔ kɛja shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã Israelbii lɛ awekui lɛ.
Abobaa Maji lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛhalaa maji ni nyɛfea amɛ abobaa maji nyɛtoa, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ Mose nɔ mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ, koni mɔ ni egbe gbɔmɔ, ni ehiɛ kãaa he ni efee, aloo jeee gbɛ eje lɛ, ajo foi kɛya jɛi koni eyaba abo.
Maji nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ hei ni aaayaba abo yɛ kɛje mɔ ni taoɔ lá he owele atɔ dɛŋ.
Mɔ ni aaajo foi kɛaatee nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ eko mli lɛ, eyajaje esane lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nakai maŋ lɛŋ onukpai lɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ naa kojomɔhe lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ amɔ emli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli, ni ahã lɛ shihilɛhe koni ekɛ amɛ ahi shi.
Kɛji mɛi ni taoɔ owele atɔ lɛ tiu gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, onukpai lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni ebaba abo lɛ akahã oweletɔlɔ lɛ ejaakɛ jeee gbɛ eje egbe enaanyo lɛ, ni asaŋ enyɛɛɛ lɛ etooo.
Abobalɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ nakai abobaa maŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaatsɛ lɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ, ni aaaye esane lɛ, asaŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ hu ni osɔfonukpa ni yɔɔ be mli ni ebaba abo lɛ aaagbo.
No sɛɛ dani gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ aaanyɛ aku esɛɛ aya ewe kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni ejo foi kɛjɛ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hala maji ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ to akɛ abobaa maji: Kadesh yɛ Galilea yɛ Naftali gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ Shekem yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ Kiriat-Arba, ni ji Hebron, ni yɔɔ Yuda gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ amɛkɔ Bezer ni kã Yeriko bokãgbɛ shiaŋa trɛnɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ Rubenbii lɛ akutso lɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛkɔ Ramot ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ yɛ Gadbii anɔ mli; amɛkɔ Golan ni yɔɔ Bashan yɛ Manasebii anɔ mli.
Ahala maji nɛɛ ato ahã Israelbii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi hu ni ebato amɛ lɛ akɛ abobaa maji koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe mɔ ko ni jeee gbɛ eje lɛ, ajo foi kɛya eko mli eyaba abo, koni mɔ ni taoɔ lá he owele atɔ lɛ nine akashɛ mɔ ni egbe gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ; asaŋ koni gbɔmɔgbelɔ nɛɛ ahi abobaahe lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaatsɛ lɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ ni aaabote esane lɛ mli.
Maji ni akɛhã Levibii lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ tee ni amɛyana Eleazar, osɔfo lɛ, kɛ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, kɛ Israel akutsei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ hu.
Ni Levibii lɛ kɛɛ amɛ yɛ Shilo yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ, ni efã akɛ ahã wɔ maji kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji ni wɔkooloi aaaye nii yɛ nɔ koni wɔhi amɛmli.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɔlɔ maji kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ shikpɔji ni ajara ahã akutsei lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ lɛ amli, ni amɛkɛhã Levibii lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ.
Oshiki ni afɔ̃ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ gbee Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ji Kohat shwiei lɛ awekui lɛ anɔ.
Osɔfo Aaron diɛŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ ahã amɛ maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Simeonbii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔji lɛ amli.
Kohatbii awekui ni shwɛ lɛ amɛna maji yɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Danbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔji lɛ amli.
Gershonbii lɛ na maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Isakarbii akutso lɛ kɛ Naftalibii akutso lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔji lɛ amli yɛ oshiki ni afɔ̃ naa.
Meraribii awekui lɛ na maji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Rubenbii akutso lɛ kɛ Gadbii akutso lɛ kɛ Zebulonbii akutso lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔji lɛ amli.
Israelbii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ hã Levibii lɛ yɛ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ Mose nɔ efã akɛ afee lɛ.
Maji ni aŋɔ yɛ Yudabii lɛ akutso lɛ kɛ Simeonbii lɛ akutso lɛ hu shikpɔji lɛ amli lɛ, akɛhã Levibii lɛ ateŋ Kohatbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ji Aaron tuuŋtu shwiei lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛnɔ oshiki ni afɔ̃ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ gbee.
Akɛ Kiriat-Arba, ni ji Anaktsɛ Arba maŋ lɛ, hã amɛ kɛ ehe shikpɔji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ.
Maŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji Hebron ni yɔɔ Yuda gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Nakai be mli lɛ akɛ maŋ wulu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he ŋmɔji kɛ akrowai lɛ ehã Yefune bi Kaleb momo akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Akɛ maji nɛɛhu kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji fata Hebron ni ji gbɔmɔgbelɔ abobaa maŋ lɛ he, ni akɛhã Aaron, osɔfo lɛ, shwiei lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Libna kɛ Yatir kɛ Eshtemoa, kɛ Holon kɛ Debir, kɛ Ain kɛ Yuta kɛ Bet-Shemesh.
Aŋɔ̃ maji nɛɛhu nɛɛ yɛ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Simeonbii lɛ akutsei enyɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ shikpɔji lɛ amli.
Aŋɔ̃ maji ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni akɛhã Levibii lɛ: Gibeon kɛ Geba, kɛ Anatot kɛ Almon.
Maji fɛɛ ni Osɔfo Aaron shwiei ni ji osɔfoi lɛ na lɛ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Kohatbii lɛ awekui ni shwɛ yɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, aŋɔ̃ Efraimbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli maji komɛi, ni akɛhã amɛ.
Ahã amɛ maji nɛɛ: Shekem, ni ji abobaa maŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Gezer, kɛ Kibzaim kɛ Bet-Horon.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ akɔlɔ maji ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ Danbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛhã amɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Elteke kɛ Gibeton, kɛ Ayalon kɛ Gat-Rimon.
Agbɛnɛ akɔlɔ Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji enyɔ, ni ji Taanak kɛ Gat-Rimon, kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji, ni akɛhã Kohatbii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, maji fɛɛ ni akɛhã Kohatbii lɛ awekui ni shwɛ lɛ fee nyɔŋma kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ji Gershon shwiei awekui lɛ aŋɔ̃ maji enyɔ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni akɛhã amɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Golan, gbɔmɔgbelɔ abobaa maŋ lɛ, ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ, kɛ Beeshtera.
Aŋɔ̃ maji ejwɛ hu kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ Isakarbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni akɛhã Gershonbii lɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Kishon kɛ Daberat, kɛ Yarmut kɛ En-Ganim.
No sɛɛ lɛ, akɔlɔ maji ejwɛ hu kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji yɛ Asherbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni akɛhã Gershonbii lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Mishal kɛ Abdon, kɛ Helkat kɛ Rehob.
Aŋɔ̃ Naftalibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji etɛ̃ hu kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji, ni akɛhã Gershonbii lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Kedesh, ni ji gbɔmɔgbelɔ abobaa maŋ ni yɔɔ Galilea lɛ, kɛ Hamot-Dor kɛ Kartan.
No hewɔ lɛ, maji fɛɛ ni Gershonbii lɛ awekui srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ na fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ji Merari shwiei lɛ, ahã amɛ Zebulonbii akutso lɛ gbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji.
Maji nɛɛ ji Yokneam kɛ Karta, kɛ Dimna kɛ Nahalal.
Aŋɔ̃ Rubenbii akutso lɛ gbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ejwɛ hu kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji, ni akɛhã Meraribii lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Bezer kɛ Yahaz, kɛ Kedemot kɛ Mefaat.
Ni kɛjɛ Gadbii akutso lɛ gbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahã Meraribii lɛ maji ejwɛ ni agbɛii baa nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji: Ramot ni ji gbɔmɔgbelɔ abobaa maŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ kɛ Mahanaim, kɛ Heshbon kɛ Yazer.
No hewɔ lɛ, maji fɛɛ ni Meraribii lɛ awekui srɔtoi lɛ, ni ji Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, na fee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Belɛ ahã Levibii lɛ fɛɛ maji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu ni Israelbii lɛ baŋɔ kɛfee amɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛ ehe shikpɔŋ ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ekã he kitã akɛ akɛbaahã Israelbii lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ hã Israelbii lɛ, ni be ni amɛshɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛhi nɔ kwraa.
Yehowa hã amɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he tamɔ bɔ ni ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ amɛhiɛ adamɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa hã amɛye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.
Nibii juji fɛɛ ni Yehowa wo Israel we lɛ shi yɛ he lɛ, amɛmli ekome folo nɛkɛ eyafeee yaka; fɛɛ kwa ba mli.
Yoshua wo Akutsei ni yaahi Yordan lɛ Bokãgbɛ lɛ gbɛ Agbɛnɛ Yoshua tsɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ akutso lɛ fã kome lɛ kɛbakpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛye kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose wo nyɛ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛbo mi toi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfee gbɛfaŋ.
Nyɛshiko nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ gbii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ; ni nyɛkwɛ ni nyɛye Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wiemɔ lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ahe ejɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo amɛ shi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ ni nyɛyaa nyɛshikpɔŋ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose kɛhã nyɛ momo, yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ, akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe nɔ jogbaŋŋ ni ahia koni nyɛye kitãi kɛ mlai lɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose wo nyɛ lɛ anɔ.
No ji akɛ nyɛsumɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii, ni nyɛye ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛye lɛ anɔkwa, ni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛtsui kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua jɔɔ amɛ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛ amɛtee amɛshĩai amli.
Mose hã Manasebii lɛ akutso lɛ fã kome lɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ Bashan yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ; shi Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome ni shwɛ lɛ Yoshua hã amɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi akutsei lɛ ateŋ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ anaigbɛ.
Be ni Yoshua woɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gbɛ koni amɛya amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ: “Nyɛmiiku nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shĩa kɛ nyɛdɛŋnii babaoo ni nyɛna: tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ mamai pii.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ayajaa nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anibii ni nyɛna lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ akutsei lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ gbala mli yɛ Shilo, yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛya Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ji amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ ni efã kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ naa lɛ nɔ.
Yordan lɛ naa Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ Be ni amɛbashɛ Yordan niiaŋ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi Yordan naa.
Afɔleshãa latɛ kpeteŋkple ni sa kwɛmɔ.
Ayagba Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛtara lo?
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ akutso lɛ fã lɛ ema afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Gelilot yɛ Yordan lɛ naa yɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Be ni Israelbii krokomɛi lɛ nu sane nɛɛ lɛ, amɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpe yɛ Shilo, ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛkɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ akutso lɛ fã kome lɛ yaawu.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tsu Osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas kɛtee Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ahã lumɛi nyɔŋma komɛi fata Finehas he kɛtee tsumɔ nɛɛ.
No ji akɛ Israelbii lɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso hã lumɔ kome, ni lumɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yafee wekunukpa hu yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Amɛtee Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii kɛ Manasebii lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyawie Yehowa webii lɛ anaa, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni nyɛtɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nɛɛ?
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛfɔleshãa latɛ ni nyɛma agbɛnɛ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛkwa Yehowa, ni nyɛtse ehiɛ atua.
Aso amanehulu ni wɔna yɛ esha ni afee yɛ Peor lɛ hewɔ ni kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ tete wɔhe ejeko nakai esha lɛ mli, tsɛbelɛ wɔna esɛɛ amanehulu lɛ, no kɛkɛ faaa hãaa wɔ, hewɔ ni nyɛkpaleɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ nɛɛ?
Kɛji nyɛtse Yehowa hiɛ atua ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, wɔ lɛ, lɛ hu emli aaafu Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛji nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã nyɛ lɛ nɔ tseee lɛ, no lɛ nyɛfoa mli kɛbaa Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, koni nyɛbaŋɔa shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ wɔteŋ akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa kɛkɛ ni nyɛkatsea Yehowa hiɛ atua, ni nyɛkatsea wɔ hu wɔhiɛ atua koni kɛjɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛma nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛfɔleshãa latɛ kroko nyɛhã nyɛhe.
Be ni Zera bi Akan yata musunii he lɛ, ani jeee Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ Yehowa mli fu lo?
Bɛjeee lɛ ekome kɛkɛ ehiɛ kpãtã yɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ hewɔ?” Kɛkɛ ni Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã lɛ hã Israelbii aweku nukpai lɛ hetoo amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ofe Koome, Nyɔŋmɔ Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ele wɔyitsoŋ eto, nɔ̃ hewɔ ni wɔfee nakai; no hewɔ lɛ, Israel hu ana ale.
Kɛji Yehowa hiɛ atua ni wɔtse, aloo ŋmɛɛmɔ ni wɔŋmɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ emli lɛ he, hewɔ ni wɔfee nɔ ni wɔfee nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ wɔhe akakea wɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ wɔma afɔleshãa latɛ bɔ ni afee ni wɔkpa Yehowa jamɔ.
Aloo kɛji wɔma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koni wɔkɛshã shãa afɔle loo niyenii afɔle loo shidaa afɔle lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ atɔ he owele.
Jeee nakai kwraa ji sane lɛ.
Nɔ moŋ ni hã wɔfee nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ji akɛ wɔshe gbeyei akɛ wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ, nyɛbii aaanyɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔbii akɛ, ‘Mɛni nyɛ hu nyɛkɔɔ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, he?
Nyɛle akɛ mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yordan fo wɔ kɛ nyɛ, Rubenbii kɛ Gadbii, teŋ husu lɛ?
Nyɛkɔɔɔ Yehowa he nɔ ko.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛbii baahã wɔbii akpa Yehowa jamɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ jɛ ni wɔkɛɛ wɔhe akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔmãa afɔleshãa latɛ ko, jeee koni wɔkɛshã shãa afɔle loo gbee afɔle, shi moŋ koni eye he odase yɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ teŋ, asaŋ kɛ wɔshwiei kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛshwiei ateŋ akɛ wɔshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ gbee afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei wɔkɛsɔ̃mɔɔ Yehowa kɛji wɔmiija lɛ yɛ Shihilɛhe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.’ No baahã wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ nyɛbii ebakɛŋ wɔbii akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɔɔɔ Yehowa he nɔ ko.’ Wɔyiŋtoo ji akɛ kɛji aleee nɔ ni wɔsɛɛ ko aaakɛɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ loo wɔshwiei nakai lɛ, wɔnaa ni wɔbaajie ji, ‘Nyɛkwɛa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ henɔ ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ma, jeee yɛ shãa afɔle hewɔ, ni asaŋ jeee yɛ gbee afɔle hu hewɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni eye wɔ kɛ nyɛ teŋ odase.’ Enɛ akagbale wɔ fɔ̃ŋfɔ akɛ wɔɔtse Yehowa hiɛ atua, ni wɔkpale yɛ Yehowa sɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni wɔshi Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni ma eKpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ sɛɛ; ni wɔma afɔleshãa latɛ kroko, ni wɔshã shãa afɔle loo niyenii afɔle loo gbee afɔle yɛ nɔ.” Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii akutso lɛ fã kome lɛ naajiemɔ lɛ sa Finehas kɛ Israel asafo lɛ mli lumɛi nyɔŋma lɛ, ni ji Israelbii aweku nukpai ni fata Finehas he kɛba lɛ, ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Finehas, Osɔfo Eleazar bi lɛ, kɛɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna wɔle ŋmɛnɛ akɛ nyɛ kɛ wɔ fɛɛ hiɛ Yehowa jamɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ nyɛtɔ̃ko Yehowa nɔ kɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhere Israel yɛ etoi ni kulɛ Yehowa baagbala lɛ mli.” Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Osɔfo Eleazar bi Finehas kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ gbala mli yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Israelbii lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbabɔ amɛ amaniɛ.
Israelbii lɛ nya amaniɛ lɛ he, ni amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.
No sɛɛ lɛ, amɛwieee he dɔŋŋ akɛ amɛmiifã ta koni amɛkɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ ayawu koni amɛkpãtã shikpɔŋ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ ji odaseyeli nɔ hã wɔ akɛ Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ gbɛi akɛ, “Odasefonyo.”
Yoshua kɛ Israelbii lɛ ye shɛɛ Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ be ni Yoshua egbɔ kotokoto, ni Israelbii lɛ ahenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle amɛ ekpa amɛnaagbamɔ lɛ, Yoshua fɔ̃ nine etsɛ Israel tso muu fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Maŋ onukpai kɛ weku nukpai kɛ kojolɔi kɛ maŋ nitsulɔi fɛɛ ba, ni Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ migbɔ.
Te nyɛna nii fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, efee majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ?
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ewu nyɛtai lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Maji ni eshwɛ lɛ mija momo mihã nyɛkutsei lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii koni akɛshi maji ni miye amɛnɔ kɛjɛ Yordan lɛ naa kɛyashi Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ anɔ.
Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baashwie maji nɛɛ amli bii lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ; ebaahã amɛjo nyɛnaa foi, ni nyɛbaaŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewo nyɛ shi eto lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfĩa shi jogbaŋŋ, nyɛyea nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mose Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ nɔ koni nyɛkɛba nyɛjeŋ hu.
Nyɛkagbaa kɛmiiya abɛku hu, bɔ ni afee ni maji krokomɛi anɔ bii ni ashi futu nyɛ lɛ asu ko akabagbale nyɛ ni nyɛmiitsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ agbɛii nyɛkɛmiikã kitã, aloo ni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, aloo nyɛja amɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛkpɛtɛa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã maji wuji ni ahe wa ejo nyɛnaa foi, ni maŋ ko nyɛko nyɛhiɛ adamɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nyɛteŋ gbɔmɔ kome aaashwie mɛi akpe kɛ foi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni wuɔ nyɛta lɛ ehãa nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo nyɛ shi eto lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛsumɔ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ naa, kɛji nyɛfeee nakai, shi moŋ nyɛkwa lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe yabɔ maji ni anɔ bii ni eshwɛ futu nyɛteŋ nɛɛ ahe, ni nyɛ kɛ amɛ botebotee gbãlãshihilɛ mli, ni nyɛkɛ amɛyei hihii shi, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ nyɛyei hihii shi lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea faŋŋ akɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eyaŋ nɔ ehaŋ maji nɛɛ ajo nyɛnaa foi dɔŋŋ.
Moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ tsɔne loo akpa ni atsɔ̃ ato nyɛ, loo tamɔ kpelebii ni akɛmiiyi nyɛ ŋmawuiaŋ, loo tamɔ ŋmei ni miitsurɔ nyɛhiŋmɛiiaŋ; ni nii nɛɛ baaya nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
“Eshɛ be ni mibaya jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ yaahe agbɛnɛ.
Nyɛle anɔkwale mli yɛ nyɛtsuii amli krɛdɛɛ akɛ nɔ kpakpa ko kwraa bɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ shi akɛ ebaafee ehã nyɛ ni efeko ehako nyɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eba mli, ni ekome folo nɛkɛ efeko yaka.
Bɔ ni nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, wo nyɛ amɛhe shi lɛ eba mli eha nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Yehowa aaahã nibii fɔ̃ji fɛɛ hu aba nyɛnɔ kɛaatee beyinɔ ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni lɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔŋŋ kɛhã nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛtɔ̃ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kpãŋmɔ ni ewo nyɛ ehe kitã lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛtee nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa mli aaawo la awo nyɛ; ni oya ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ekɛhã nyɛ nɛɛ nɔ.”
Yoshua tsa eshɛɛyeli lɛ nɔ yɛ Shekem Yoshua bua Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛba Shekem.
Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ weku nukpai lɛ kɛ kojolɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ nitsulɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛbadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ, ‘Teteete lɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hi.
Jɛi ji he ni Tera, ni ji Abraham kɛ Nahor tsɛ, hi ni amɛja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Miyaŋɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ Abraham kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ, ni mihã ekpa Kanaan shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni mihã ewo shwiei babaoo.
Miduro lɛ Isak, ni miduro Isak hu Yakob kɛ Esau.
Mikɛ Seir Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hã Esau akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ; shi Yakob kɛ ebii lɛ amɛ lɛ amɛyaje Ijipt.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ mitsu Mose kɛ Aaron, ni mikɛ nibii ni mifee yɛ Ijiptbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hao Ijiptbii lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, mijie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt.
Be ni mijie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ Ijipt lɛ, Ijiptbii lɛ tiu amɛ kɛ ta shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtaralɔi kɛba Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛ duŋ kpii fo nyɛ kɛ Ijiptbii lɛ ateŋ; asaŋ ehã ŋshɔ lɛ yi, ni eha Ijiptbii lɛ anɔ.
Nyɛna nɔ ni mifee Ijiptbii lɛ kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛi.
Nyɛhi ŋã lɛ nɔ be babaoo.
“‘Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ Amorbii ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ nyɛ wu, ni mijɔɔ amɛnɔ mihã nyɛ, ni nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim, ni nyɛŋɔ̃ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mikpãtã amɛhiɛ beiaŋ ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛbaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Moab maŋtsɛ Balak, Zipor bi lɛ, fã ta koni ekɛ Israel abawu.
Etsu ayakpee Balaam, Beor bi lɛ, kɛba akɛ ebalomɔ nyɛ.
Shi mibooo lɛ toi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ moŋ ejɔɔ nyɛ; ni mikɛjie nyɛ yɛ Balak dɛŋ.
No sɛɛ ni nyɛfo Yordan lɛ, ni nyɛba Yeriko.
Yeriko lumɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛ wu, ni nakai nɔŋŋ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ hu kɛ nyɛ wu; shi mihã nyɛye amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ kunim.
Mitsu sosomootii kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ, ni amɛshwie Amorbii amaŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ; shi jeee nyɛklante loo gãi naa foi amɛjo lɛ.
Mikɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛtsuko enɔ nii hã nyɛ, nyɛmiiye emli ŋɔɔmɔ; mikɛ maji hu ni jeee nyɛ ni nyɛto hã nyɛ, ni nyɛyɛ amɛmli.
Nyɛmiiye wain tromi kɛ mutso ŋmɔji ni jeee nyɛ ni nyɛhu amli nii.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshea Yehowa gbeyei, ni nyɛjiea nyɛyitsoŋ nyɛsɔ̃mɔa lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli; nyɛkwaa nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛtsɛmɛi atsɛmɛi lɛ sɔ̃mɔ yɛ Mesopotamia kɛ Ijipt hu lɛ koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa.
Kɛji esaaa nyɛhiɛ akɛ nyɛaasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa lɛ, no lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ nyɛkɔa mɔ ni nyɛaasɔ̃mɔ, nyɔŋmɔi ni nyɛtsɛmɛi atsɛmɛi lɛ sɔ̃mɔ yɛ Mesopotamia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ni jio, Amorbii ni nyɛyɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ nɛɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni jio, nyɛkɔa; shi mi lɛ, mi kɛ miwe lɛ wɔbaasɔmɔ Yehowa.” Maŋbii lɛ to he, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ akagbale wɔ fɔ̃ŋfɔ akɛ wɔɔshi Yehowa sɛɛ koni wɔyasɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni jie wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye wɔ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ.
Efee okadii wuji etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, asaŋ ebaa wɔyi yɛ gbɛi ni wɔfãfãa fɛɛ mli kɛtsɔ̃ majimaji ateŋ kɛho.
Yehowa shwie Amorbii lɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bluublu yɛ wɔhiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ.” Shi Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnyɛŋ Yehowa nyɛsɔ̃mɔ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni; ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ji lɛ, ni ekɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛhe eshai ekeŋ nyɛ.
Yɛ mli akɛ Yehowa efee nyɛ ejurɔ kɛho; shi kɛji nyɛshi lɛ esɛɛ, ni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, no lɛ eeete shi ewo nyɛ, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ kɛmɔ shi.” Maŋbii lɛ here Yoshua nɔ akɛ, “Dabi!
Yehowa nɔŋŋ wɔbaasɔmɔ.” Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ ji midasefoi mɔ akɛ nyɛkɔ Yehowa akɛ mɔ ni nyɛbaasɔ̃mɔ.” Maŋbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Wɔmiiye he odase.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua kɛɛ amɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋmɛa maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛhiɛhiɛ lɛ ahe mɔ koni nyɛjie nyɛyitsoŋ fɛɛ nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ here Yoshua nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ, ni lɛ toi wɔɔbo!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yoshua kɛ maŋbii lɛ kpãŋ nakai gbi lɛ, ni ewo maŋ lɛ akpɔ kɛ mla fɛɛ yɛ Shekem.
Yoshua ŋmã saji nɛɛ fɛɛ ewo Nyɔŋmɔ Mla Wolo lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni ewo tɛ kpeteŋkple ko ema tso wulu ni ma Yehowa Kpeehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ shishi.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoshua kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ tɛ nɛɛ aye wɔhe odase ejaakɛ enu wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ wie lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, eeeye odase eshi nyɛ koni nyɛkakpa yɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoshua wo maŋbii lɛ gbɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Yoshua kɛ Eleazar gbele Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yehowa tsulɔ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, gbo be ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma.
Afu lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Timnat-Sera ni yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ Gaash Gɔŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ Yehowa yɛ Yoshua wala be mli fɛɛ, kɛ Yoshua gbele sɛɛ be mli fɛɛ, be ni onukpai hu ni le nibii ni Yehowa efee ehã Israel lɛ yɔɔ walaŋ lɛ.
Yosef gbonyo wui lɛ ni Israelbii lɛ wo kɛje Ijipt lɛ, amɛbafu yɛ Shekem yɛ shikpɔŋ kuku ko ni Yakob he lɛ jwiɛtɛi kukuji oha yɛ Shekemtsɛ Hamor bii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ Yosef shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Aaron bi Eleazar hu gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Gibea, ni ji maŋ ni akɛhã ebi Finehas yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ mli.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Kojolɔi aloo Hiɛnyiɛlɔi Awolo lɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli ji saji ni ba yɛ Israel, be mli ni Israelbii lɛ bɛ mla lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ ekã be ni Israelbii yatua Kanaan kɛ be ni abɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel lɛ teŋ.
Saji ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɔɔ ekãa nitsumɔi ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ “Kojolɔi” lɛ tsu.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ateŋ mɛi kpotoo lɛ ta hiɛnyiɛlɔi moŋ ji amɛ fe Maŋnɔyelɔi bɔ ni anuɔ gbɛi lɛ shishi yɛ mla mli lɛ.
Hiɛnyiɛlɔi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni ale lɛ jogbaŋŋ fe mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ji Samson.
Wɔnaa ehe sane yɛ wolo lɛ yitsei - lɛ amli.
Nɔ ni wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wɔji akɛ Israelbii ashweshweeshwefeemɔ damɔ anɔkwa ni ayeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; shi anɔkwa ni ayeee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛ mɔ yaa amanehulu ni naa wa mli.
Asaŋ wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ yeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa ni amanehulu ba amɛnɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ esaa ehe akɛ ebaahere amɛyiwala kɛji amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛtao esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Saji ni ba kɛyashi Yoshua gbele .—.
Israel Kojolɔi aloo Hiɛnyiɛlɔi .—.
Saji srɔtoi ni ba .—.
Yuda kɛ Simeon akutsei lɛ mɔ Adonibezek Be ni Yoshua egbo sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bi Yehowa akɛ, “Mɛɛ akutso tsutsu afã yɛ wɔteŋ ni ekɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ayawu?” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yuda tsutsu afã; mibahã eye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yuda kɛɛ enyɛmi Simeon akɛ, “Okɛ mi afã kɛya shikpɔŋ ni ji migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ ni wɔkɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ayawu, ni mi hu mikɛ bo aaatee onɔ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda kɛ Simeon fã kɛtee.
Yehowa hã amɛye Kanaanbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛye mɛi akpei nyɔŋma anɔ kunim yɛ Bezek.
Amɛyanina Adonibezek yɛ Bezek.
Amɛkɛ lɛ wu, ni amɛye Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Perizbii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Adonibezek jo foi; shi amɛtiu lɛ, ni amɛyamɔ lɛ.
Amɛfolɔ enine gɔntii kɛ enane gɔntii.
Adonibezek kɛɛ: “Maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo ni afolɔ amɛnine gɔntii lɛ kɛ amɛnane gɔntii lɛ kɔlɔ niyenii fufuji yɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ shishi.
Bɔ ni mifee lɛ, nakai pɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee mi eto najiaŋ nɛɛ.” Amɛkɛ Adonibezek ba Yerusalɛm, ni ebagbo yɛ jɛi.
Yuda akutso lɛ ye Yerusalɛm kɛ Hebron nɔ kunim Yuda akutso lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ bawu.
Amɛŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ klante gbe emli bii lɛ, ni amɛma maŋ lɛ naa la.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Yudabii lɛ fã koni amɛkɛ Kanaanbii lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ keketee lɛ nɔ lɛ ayawu.
Yudabii lɛ fã kɛyanina Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ.
Shi sa lɛ Hebron gbɛi ji Kiriat-Arba.
Yudabii lɛ ye Sheshaibii kɛ Ahimanbii kɛ Talmaibii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Otniel ŋɔ Debir maŋ lɛ Yudabii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Hebron kɛyanina Debirbii lɛ.
Shi Debir lɛ, sa lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Kiriat-Sefer.
Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kaleb lɛ kɛɛ: “Mɔ ni aaayatua Kiriat-Sefer ni eeeŋɔ maŋ lɛ, mikɛ mibiyoo Aksa baahã lɛ gbãlã.” Otniel, Kaleb nyɛmi gbekɛ Kenaz bi lɛ, yaŋɔ maŋ lɛ; ni Kaleb kɛ ebiyoo Aksa lɛ hã lɛ gbãlã.
Be ni Aksa tee ewu Otniel ŋɔɔ lɛ, Otniel wo eyiŋ akɛ ebi etsɛ shikpɔŋ ko.
Be ni Aksa shɛ etsɛ ŋɔɔ ni ejɛ teji ni eta nɔ lɛ nɔ eyi shi lɛ, etsɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Aksa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã mi gbɛwoo nii; akɛni ohã mi wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ keketee lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, hã mi nubui hu.” No hewɔ lɛ, Kaleb hã lɛ nubui ni yɔɔ gɔŋ nɔ kɛ nubui ni yɔɔ jɔɔ mli hu.
Kunim ni Yuda kɛ Benyamin akutsei lɛ ye Mose shaanuu Kennyo lɛ shwiei kɛ Yudabii lɛ yiŋ kɛjɛ Yeriko tɛ̃ŋ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba Yuda ŋã lɛ ni yɔɔ Arad wuoyigbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtee amɛkɛ jɛi bii lɛ yahi shi.
Yudabii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Simeonbii lɛ fã kɛtee amɛyaye Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ Zefat lɛ nɔ kunim, ni amɛfite maŋ lɛ butuu.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo maŋ lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Horma.
Asaŋ Yuda yaŋɔ Gaza kɛ ehe shikpɔji lɛ kɛ Ashkelon kɛ ehe shikpɔji lɛ kɛ Ekron kɛ ehe shikpɔji lɛ.
Yehowa wa Yuda, ni Yuda shwie gɔji anɔ bii lɛ.
Shi Yuda nyɛɛɛ eshwie jɔɔ lɛ mli bii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ dade shwiilii.
Akɛ Hebron hã Kaleb tamɔ bɔ ni Mose ekɛɛ lɛ, ni Kaleb shwie Anakbii etɛ̃ lɛ kɛje jɛi.
Shi Benyaminbii lɛ eshwieee Yebusbii ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ hi Yerusalɛm kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Efraim kɛ Manase akutsei lɛ ŋɔ Betel Efraim kɛ Manase yatua Betel, ni Yehowa ye ebua amɛ.
Amɛtsu ayasara Betel maŋ, ni sa lɛ egbɛi ji Luz lɛ.
Saralɔi lɛ na nuu ko ni jɛ maŋ lɛ mli miiba, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ gbɛ ni akɛboteɔ maŋ lɛ mli, ni wɔkɛ bo baaye yɛ mlijɔlɛ naa.” Etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ ni akɛboteɔ maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛgbe maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ; shi amɛshi nuu lɛ kɛ eŋã kɛ ebii fɛɛ.
Nuu lɛ yiŋ etee Hitbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyato maŋ yɛ jɛi.
Etsɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi akɛ Luz, ni no ji maŋ lɛ gbɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Mɛi ni Israelbii lɛ eshwieee Manase akutso lɛ eshwieee Bet-Shean kɛ ehe maji lɛ amli bii lɛ, kɛ Taanak kɛ ehe maji lɛ amli bii lɛ, kɛ Dor kɛ ehe maji lɛ amli bii lɛ kɛ Ibeam kɛ ehe maji lɛ amli bii lɛ, kɛ Megido kɛ ehe maji lɛ amli bii lɛ.
Kanaanbii nɛɛ kã he hi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na hewalɛ lɛ, amɛhã Kanaanbii lɛ sɔmɔ amɛ, shi shwiemɔ kɛkɛ ni amɛshwieee amɛ.
Efraim akutso lɛ eshwieee Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ Gezer lɛ, shi moŋ Kanaanbii lɛ hi amɛteŋ yɛ jɛi.
Zebulon akutso lɛ eshwieee Kitronbii lɛ kɛ Nahalalbii lɛ, shi moŋ Kanaanbii nɛɛ hi amɛteŋ, ni amɛhã Kanaanbii lɛ sɔmɔ amɛ.
Asher akutso lɛ eshwieee Akonbii lɛ kɛ Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Ahelabbii kɛ Akzibbii kɛ Helbabii kɛ Afekbii kɛ Rehobbii lɛ, shi Asherbii lɛ hi Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ amɛshwieee Kanaanbii lɛ.
Naftali akutso lɛ eshwieee Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ kɛ Bet-Anatbii lɛ, shi amɛbahi Kanaanbii nɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ, ni Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ kɛ Bet-Anatbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Amorbii lɛ tsi Danbii lɛ kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhãaa Danbii lɛ akpeleke shi kɛba jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Amorbii lɛ kã he amɛhi Heres gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Aiyalon kɛ Shalbim; shi Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ anine shi wa yɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhã Amorbii lɛ sɔmɔ amɛ.
Amorbii lɛ ahusu lɛ jɛ Akrabim ŋmeŋme lɛ he yɛ Sela kɛtee yiteŋgbɛ.
Yehowa bɔfo yɛ Bokim Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo jɛ Gilgal kɛba Bokim ni ebakɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt ni mikɛ nyɛ ba shikpɔŋ ni mikã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛɛ: ‘Mikuŋ mikpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli gbi ko gbi ko, ni nyɛ hu nyɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ akakpãŋa kpãŋmɔ ko; amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ nyɛkumɔa.’ Shi nyɛbooo mifãmɔ lɛ toi.
Mɛni nyɛfee nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mi hu nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji mishwieŋ amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, shi moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne.” Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ wie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ lɛ, maŋ lɛ wo yara amɛfo.
Amɛwo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Bokim, ni amɛshã shãa afɔlei amɛhã Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
Yoshua gbele Agbɛnɛ be ni Yoshua wo maŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ayaŋɔ egbɛfaŋnɔ.
Maŋ lɛ sɔmɔ Yehowa gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni Yoshua yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni onukpai ni hi shi yɛ Yoshua gbele sɛɛ ni amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi wuji fɛɛ ni etsu ehã Israel lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Yehowa tsulɔ Yoshua, Nun bi lɛ, gbo be ni eye afii oha kɛ nyɔŋma.
Afu lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Timnat-Heres yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ yɛ Gaash gɔŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ.
Nakai yinɔbii lɛ hu fɛɛ gboi, ni yinɔ kroko ba yɛ amɛsɛɛ ni amɛleee Yehowa aloo nitsumɔi ni etsu ehã Israel lɛ.
Israel fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa jamɔ Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Amɛkwa Yehowa, amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni ji amɛhewɔhewɔ maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ asɛɛ.
Ni amɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Ni amɛfɔ̃ɔ Yehowa jamɔ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Astarte nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli wo Israelbii lɛ la ni ehã ofɔ̃yelɔi baye amɛ ofɔ̃.
Asaŋ ekɛ Israelbii lɛ wo amɛhenyɛlɔi ni bɔle amɛ kɛkpe lɛ ahewalɛ shishi, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ dɔŋŋ.
He fɛɛ he ni Israelbii lɛ aaafã ta kɛaatee lɛ, Yehowa kɛ amɛ yeɔ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ kɛ bɔ ni ekã amɛ kitã lɛ.
Enɛ hã efi Israelbii lɛ waa naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tee ta hiɛnyiɛlɔi ashi.
Amɛ amɛhereɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni bahaa amɛnibii kɛyaa lɛ adɛŋ.
Shi amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ hu amɛbooo amɛ toi, ejaakɛ amɛjeɔ Yehowa sɛɛ amɛyanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ ni amɛjaa amɛ.
Etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ amɛŋmɛɛ shihilɛ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hi ni amɛye Yehowa kitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ he; amɛ lɛ amɛyeee kitãi lɛ anɔ.
Be fɛɛ be ni Yehowa aaatee hiɛnyiɛlɔi ashi ehã Israelbii lɛ, Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ni amɛhereɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ ŋtsɔi ni Israelbii lɛ dɔmɔɔ yɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi kɛ mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ dɔɔ Yehowa.
Shi kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ gbo pɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛjeŋba fiteɔ fe amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete yɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɛɔ ni amɛsɔmɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛjaa amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ, ni amɛkpaaa amɛkuɛŋtimɔ jeŋba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli woɔ la woɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Akɛni nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ etɔ̃ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni miwo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akitã yɛ he lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbooo mi toi hewɔ lɛ mi hu kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ mishwieŋ jeŋmaji ni shwɛ be ni Yoshua gbo lɛ eko eko yɛ amɛhiɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛ maji nɛɛ baaka Israel makwɛ akɛ amɛaajwɛŋ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ akɛ amɛhi shi lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jwɛŋ nɔ lɛ lo, aloo amɛ lɛ amɛfeŋ nakai.” No hewɔ ni Yehowa shi nakai jeŋmaji lɛ, ni eshwieee amɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ, ni ehãaa Yoshua aye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ.
Jeŋmaji ni ashi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa shi jeŋmaji komɛi koni ekɛka Israelbii fɛɛ ni leee Kanaan tai lɛ ahe nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ ekwɛ.
Efee enɛ bɔ ni afee kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ayinɔi lɛ, titri lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi ni wuko ta dã lɛ, ale ta he nɔ ko ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tawuu.
Jeŋmaji ni ashi lɛ ji Filistibii alumɛi enumɔ lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Hivbii ni yɔɔ Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ Baal-Hermon gɔŋ lɛ he kɛyashi he ni gɔji ateŋ gbɛ ni akɛyaa Hamat lɛ kã lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ashi jeŋmaji nɛɛ ni akɛ amɛ aka Israelbii lɛ akwɛ akɛ amɛaaye Yehowa kitãi ni etsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lo.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hi Kanaanbii lɛ kɛ Hitbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii kɛ Perizbii lɛ kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ateŋ.
Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ abiyei; amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛbiyei hãahãa Israelbii lɛ abihii agbãla; ni Israelbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ jeŋmaji nɛɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Otniel Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa.
Amɛhiɛ kpa Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Ashera nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli wo Israelbii lɛ ala, ni ehã Mesopotamia maŋtsɛ Kushan-Rishataim ye amɛnɔ kunim ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ afii kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ bolɔ tsɛ Yehowa, ni etee herelɔ ko shi ehã amɛ, ni ehere amɛ.
Lɛ ji Otniel, Kaleb nyɛmi gbekɛ Kenaz bi lɛ.
Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Otniel nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ.
Efã ta, ni Yehowa hã enine tsɔ̃ Mesopotamia maŋtsɛ Kushan Rishataim lɛ nɔ ni eye enɔ kunim.
No hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Otniel, Kenaz bi lɛ gbo.
Ehud Israelbii lɛ saa fee efɔŋ ekoŋŋ amɛshi Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon na hewalɛ fe Israelbii lɛ.
Eglon bua Amonbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ anaa eshi enɔ, ni eba ebaye Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ ta mli.
Eŋɔ Yeriko, tɛŋ maŋ lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ sɔ̃mɔ Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ bolɔ tsɛ Yehowa, ni etee yiwalaherelɔ shi ehã amɛ.
Lɛ ji Ehud, Gera Benyaminnyo lɛ bi lɛ, abɛkulɔ ni.
Israelbii lɛ tsu lɛ ekɛ nikeenii tee yahã Moab maŋtsɛ Eglon.
Ehud sɔ̃ klante kɛ enaa nta.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome.
Ehud kɛfi enanejurɔ shuɔ yɛ etade lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ nikeenii lɛ yahã Eglon, Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ eshwi naakpa.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Ehud kɛ nikeenii lɛ ehã Eglon etã lɛ, Ehud wo mɛi ni tere nikeenii lɛ agbɛ ni amɛtee.
Shi Ehud diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eku esɛɛ yɛ he ni tɛ amãgãi ni yɔɔ Gilgal lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Ni ebakɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, miyɛ teemɔŋ sane ko ni mibagba bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Eglon kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea kpo nyɛshia wɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Eglon tsuji lɛ fɛɛ gbala amɛhe shi.
Be ni Eglon kometoo ta shi yɛ eŋwɛitsu ni ehereɔ kɔɔyɔɔ yɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ, Ehud tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ Eglon akɛ, “Mihiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko ni mibakɛɛ bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Eglon te shi yɛ esɛi lɛ nɔ.
Ehud kpã enine abɛku lɛ mli, ni efã klante lɛ yɛ nanejurɔ shuɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛdu Eglon musuŋ.
Klante lɛ tso lɛ nyiɛ dade lɛ sɛɛ kɛbote emusuŋ.
Fɔ batsĩ dade lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ Ehud gbalaaa klante lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ Eglon musu mli, shi klante lɛ yaje kpo yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ehud je kpo kɛtee ablanaa lɛ nɔ.
Eŋãmɔ shinai lɛ ewo Eglon yi, ni eŋmɛlɛ mli.
Be ni Ehud eje kpo etee lɛ, tsuji lɛ ba; ni be ni amɛna akɛ aŋãmɔ ŋwɛitsu lɛ shinai lɛ amɛsusu akɛ, “Benɛ etee niiasɛɛ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔheremɔ tsu lɛ mli.” Amɛmɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he dɔŋŋ.
Shi be ni egbeleee shinai lɛ lolo lɛ, amɛyakɔ samfee lɛ.
Be ni amɛgbele shinai lɛ, naa amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kã shikpɔŋ ni egbo!
Be ni amɛlilaa shi lɛ Ehud ejo foi etee momo.
Efoŋ yɛ tɛ amãgãi lɛ ahe, ni ejo foi kɛtee Seira.
Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, ekpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛjɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baahã nyɛye nyɛhenyɛlɔi Moabbii lɛ anɔ kunim.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkpeleke shi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Amɛŋɔ Yordan faafoohei ni atsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛyaa Moab lɛ, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni efoɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ gbe Moabbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi aaafee akpei nyɔŋma, hii hewalɔi sɔŋŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko naaa hegbɛ ajo foi.
Nakai gbi lɛ aba Moab shi awo Israel shishi.
Enɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Shamgar Hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni ba ye Ehud sɛɛ ji Shamgar, Anat bi lɛ.
Ekɛ tsinakplamɔ tso gbe Filistibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai ekpaa, ni lɛ hu ekɛhere Israelbii lɛ.
Debora kɛ Barak Ehud gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ ekoŋŋ amɛshi Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã Yabin, Kanaan maŋtsɛ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Hazor lɛ, ye amɛnɔ kunim.
Etatsɛ ji Sisera, ni yɔɔ Jeŋmaji Haroshet lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa koni eye ebua amɛ, ejaakɛ Yabin yɛ dade tayaa shwiilii ohai nɛɛhu, ni ewa Israelbii lɛ ayi waa naakpa afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ.
