Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, gbalɔ yoo Debora, Lapidot ŋã lɛ, ji Israelbii lɛ akojolɔ.
He ni etaa ji tɛŋtso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Debora tɛŋtso lɛ shishi yɛ Rama kɛ Betel teŋ, yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Israelbii lɛ yaa eŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi ni eyeɔ amɛteŋ saji ehãa amɛ.
Debora tsu ayakpee Barak, Abinoam bi lɛ, kɛjɛ Kadesh ni yɔɔ Naftali lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Fãmɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fãa bo nɛ: ‘Yaaŋɔ hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛjɛ Naftalibii kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ateŋ ni ofã ta kɛya Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Makpala Sisera, Yabin tatsɛ lɛ, kɛ eshwiilii kɛ etabilɔi babaoo lɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ yɛ Keshon Faa lɛ naa, ni mibahã oye enɔ kunim.’ ” Barak kɛɛ Debora akɛ, “Kɛji okɛ mi aaatee lɛ, no lɛ matee; shi kɛji okɛ mi eyaaa lɛ, no lɛ miyaaa.” Debora kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ bo aaatee, kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni oyaa oyatsu nɛɛ mli anunyam lɛ efeŋ onɔ; ejaakɛ yoo ko ji mɔ ni Yehowa baahã eye Sisera nɔ kunim.” Kɛkɛ ni Debora te shi ni ekɛ Barak tee Kadesh.
Barak hã ayakpee Zebulonbii kɛ Naftalibii kɛba Kadesh; ni hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ lɛ ka nane kɛtee.
Debora hu kɛlɛ tee.
Shi Heber, Kennyo lɛ, etse ehe yɛ Kenbii ni ji Mose shaanuu Hobab shwiei lɛ ahe, ni eyashi ebuu lɛ yɛ tso kpele ni ma Zaananim ni yɔɔ Kadesh masɛi lɛ he tɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni ayatswa Sisera adafi akɛ Barak, Abinoam bi lɛ, efã ta kɛtee Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Sisera bua edade tayaa shwiilii ohai nɛɛhu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋbii amaŋ Haroshet kɛba Kishon Faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Debora kɛɛ Barak akɛ, “Tee shi, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ ji gbi ni Yehowa baahã oye Sisera nɔ kunim.
Ani jeee Yehowa efã kɛnyiɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, Barak kpeleke shi kɛjɛ Tabor gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hii akpei nyɔŋma lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yehowa hã Sisera kɛ eta lɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ Barak klante naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Sisera yi shi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli, ni ejo foi yɛ enane naa.
Barak kɛ emɛi lɛ tiu shwiilii lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ kɛtee Jeŋbii amaŋ Haroshet lɛ, ni Sisera tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa; eshwɛɛɛ mɔ kome nɛkɛ folo.
Shi Sisera jo foi yɛ enane naa kɛtee Yael, Kennyo Heber ŋã lɛ buu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ Yabin, Hazor maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Heber, Kennyo lɛ, we lɛ teŋ.
Yael je kpo ekɛ Sisera yakpe ni ekɛɛ Sisera akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, gba kɛba miŋɔɔ; kaashe gbeyei!” No hewɔ lɛ, Sisera gba kɛtee Heber ŋã lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ buu lɛ mli, ni Yael kɛ saanɔ bo ha Sisera nɔ.
Sisera kɛɛ Yael akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni ohã mi nu fioo manu, shi kumai miiye mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Heber ŋã lɛ gbele fufɔ wolotɔ naa, ni ehã lɛ eko enu.
Kɛkɛ ni eha Sisera nɔ.
Sisera kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Daamɔ buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebi bo akɛ, ‘Ani mɔ ko yɛ biɛ lo?
lɛ, okɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ, Dabi!’ ” Shi Yael, Heber ŋã lɛ, kɔ buu he shiŋmlitso, ni ekɔ hamle ehiɛ edɛŋ.
Edɛke shi kɛtee Sisera ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ yaka etoi shi kɛyamɔ shikpɔŋ, ejaakɛ etɔ Sisera ni ewɔ vii.
No hewɔ lɛ, Sisera gbo.
Be ni Barak tiuɔ Sisera lɛ, Yael je kpo ekɛ Barak yakpe ni ekɛɛ Barak akɛ, “Ba, ni mikɛ nuu lɛ ni otaoɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ bo.” Be ni Barak tee Yael buu lɛ mli lɛ, naa Sisera ni ekã shi ni egbo, ni shiŋmlitso lɛ tsɛkɛ etoi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã Israelbii lɛ ye Kanaan maŋtsɛ Yabin nɔ kunim.
Israelbii lɛ hãaa Yabin, Kanaan maŋtsɛ lɛ, ana mumɔ he kɛ ta kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Debora kɛ Barak Lala Kɛkɛ ni Debora kɛ Barak, Abinoam binuu lɛ, la nɛkɛ lala nɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Akɛni tatsɛmɛi nyiɛ Israel ta lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛboa toi!
Nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi!
Nyɛfea toi!
Nyɛ lumɛi!
La mala, saŋku matswa mahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa.
Yehowa, be ni ojɛ Seir obaa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ŋwɛi tsere nu shwie shi, Be ni ofã nyiɛmɔ kɛjɛ Edom ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ!
Hɛɛ, nu tue kɛjɛ atatuiaŋ shwie shi.
Gɔji lɛ hoso yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu Sinai fee yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.
“Shamgar, Anat bi lɛ, yinɔ, Yael be lɛ mli lɛ, jarayeli gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã efolo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi juɔ shi nyiɛɔ.
Mɛi ahe sɛ̃ yɛ Israel maji lɛ amli.
Amɛhe sɛ̃ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni bo Debora, ote shi akɛ Nyɛ Awo yɛ Israel.
Amɛhala nyɔŋmɔi hei, kɛkɛ ni ta shɛ agboi lɛ anaa, Anãaa tsɛŋ loo akplɔ ko yɛ hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ dɛŋ yɛ Israel.
Mina Israel tatsɛmɛi lɛ ahe tsui, kɛ mɛi ni here amɛhe yɛ tsuijurɔ naa, yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
“Nyɛgbaa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtara tejii yɛji anɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtara kuŋtui fɛɛfɛji anɔ, kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni atswaa saŋku yɛ nuyɛɛhei lɛ, amɛaagba Yehowa kunim lɛ, Israel okwaafoi akunim lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mɛi lɛ kpeleke shi kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli.
Tee shi, Debora!
Tee shi!
Wo ohe nɔ, Barak, okɛ onomii lɛ aya, Tee shi, tee shi, la lala ko, bo Abinoam bi!
Kɛkɛ ni abladei lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kpeleke shi.
Yehowa mɛi lɛ kpeleke shi yɛ Yehowa hewɔ amɛyanina kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Efraim amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ kɛtee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni bo Benyamin, amɛnyiɛ bo kɛ owekumɛi lɛ asɛɛ, Tatsɛmɛi lɛ kpeleke shi kɛjɛ Makir kɛba, ni Zebulon ji he ni tatsɛmɛi nukpai lɛ jɛ kɛba.
Isakar lumɛi lɛ fata Debora he kɛba, Isakar ni yeɔ Barak anɔkwa, amɛsha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kpaakpa kɛtee jɔɔ lɛ mli; shi Ruben mli egba.
Amɛyiŋ fee amɛ kɔshikɔshi.
Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ amɛfee akɛ amɛmiiba.
Mɛɛba omɛɔ yɛ too kui lɛ ateŋ, ni oboɔ blɛ ni akɛtsɛɔ toi lɛ toi?
Ruben akutso lɛ mli egba, amɛyiŋ fee amɛ kɔshikɔshi.
Gilead ta shi yɛ Yordan sɛɛ, Mɛɛba Dan mɛɔ yɛ lɛji lɛ amli?
Asher esɛ̃ koniŋŋ kɛta ŋshɔ lɛ naa, eta ŋshɔ blei lɛ anaa.
Zebulon ji maŋ ni kɛ ehe wo osharã kɛ gbele mli, Naftali hu nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
“Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ba amɛbawu ta.
Amɛkɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ bawu yɛ Taanak yɛ Megido fai lɛ anaa; shi amɛnaaa jwiɛtɛi ko amɛhã.
Ŋulamii jɛ ŋwɛi wu, Amɛjɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ amɛkɛ Sisera wu.
Kishon Faa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee, Faa ni keɔ kɛbaa, Kishon Faa lɛ.
Misusuma, fãa nyiɛmɔ kɛ hewalɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni okpɔŋɔ akoklotoi lɛ shimɔ shi waa, kɛ hurumɔ ni ekpɔŋɔi lɛ huruɔ kɛ foi lɛ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Nyɛlomɔa Meroz, nyɛlomɔa emli bii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbafataaa Yehowa he, amɛbafataaa Yehowa he yɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ.’ Ajɔɔ Yael yɛ yei fɛɛ ateŋ, Kennyo, Heber ŋã lɛ.
Ajɔɔ lɛ fe yei ni hiɔ bui amli lɛ fɛɛ.
Eba nu, ni ehã lɛ fufɔ.
Ekɛ fufɔ hiɛ fɔ bahã lɛ, yɛ abladei akpulu mli.
Ekpã enine mli ekɔ shiŋmlitso.
Ekɛ eninejurɔ kɔ nitsulɔi ahamle, ni ekɛka etoi shi.
Etswa Sisera nɔ ni ejwara eyitso wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ; Eyrɔde, ni egbee shi, Ekã shi ni etsiii ehe yɛ Yael naji anaa; enaji anaa eyrɔde yɛ, ni egbee shi lɛ.
He ni eyrɔde yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ ni enyɔ.
“Sisera nyɛ miifili samflɛ lɛ mli, eekwɛ nii kɛmiitsɔ̃ samflɛ fɔji lɛ amli.
Mɛɛba eshwiilii lɛ baa lɛ sɛɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba ekpɔŋɔi lɛ akoklotoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ ekpe sɛɛ nɛkɛ?
Yei ni yɔɔ ehe lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ to he hã lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eto he ehã ehe akɛ ‘Amɛna haanii ko kɛ̃ ni amɛmiija, nuu fɛɛ nuu aaana oblayoo kome loo enyɔ tete; blɛ mi, Sisera, hu mana haanii lɛ amli mamai ni awo amɛ tsofa?
Mamai enyɔ ni awo amɛ tsofa, ni alo nii awo mli koni mikɛha mikuɛ?’ Yehowa, bɔ nɔŋŋ ni ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã nɛ!
Shi mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo lɛ aaatãmɔ hulu, be ni eteɔ shi yɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ.” No sɛɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Gideon Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehã Midianbii ye Israelbii lɛ anɔ afii kpawo.
Midianbii lɛ anineshi wa naakpa yɛ Israelbii lɛ anɔ.
Midianbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tao bui yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ tɛkploi kɛ mɔji amɛhã amɛhe.
Kɛji Israelbii lɛ du nii lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Midianbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokãgbɛbii lɛ efã kɛbatua amɛ.
Amɛbɔɔ nsra amɛwoɔ Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛfiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii lɛ kɛyashiɔ Gaza kpokpai anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Amɛshiii niyenii ko aloo too loo tsina loo teji yɛ Israel.
Ejaakɛ amɛbaa kɛ amɛkooloi kɛ amɛbuui.
Amɛbaa babaoo tamɔ baalabii; ni amɛ kɛ amɛyoomai lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ akane.
Amɛbaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbakpãtãa hiɛ.
Midianbii lɛ hã Israelbii lɛ ahewalɛ nɔ gbɔ kwraa.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa.
Be ni amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ Yehowa yɛ Midianbii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ko kɛba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Miŋɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba, ni mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɔŋyeli mli.
Ni mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijiptbii lɛ adɛŋ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ adɛŋ; ni mishwie amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni miŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mihã nyɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mi ji Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi nyɛkashea Amorbii ni yɔɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ agbeyei.’ Shi nyɛbooo migbee toi.” Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ba ebata Yoash, Abiezernyo lɛ, blɔfo yɔɔyitso ni yɔɔ Ofra lɛ shishi.
Nakai be lɛ, Yoash bi Gideon lɛ miigbee ŋmãa yɛ wainbu mli, bɔ ni afee ni Midianbii lɛ akana.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Gideon ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo nuu kãkãlɔ, Yehowa kɛ bo yɛ.” Gideon kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, minuŋtsɔ, kɛ Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?
Nɛgbɛ enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gbaa wɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ani jeee Ijipt Yehowa jie wɔ kɛjɛ’ lɛ yɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ Yehowa eshɛ wɔ efɔ̃, ni eŋmɛɛ wɔhe ehã Midianbii lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã Gideon ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa kɛ ohewalɛ nɛɛ koni oyahere Israel yɛ Midianbii lɛ adɛŋ!
Mi ji mɔ ni tsuɔ bo lɛ?” Gideon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, minuŋtsɔ, te mafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ mahere Israel lɛ?
Naa, miweku lɛ ji weku ni bɛ hewalɛ fe fɛɛ yɛ Manase, ni mi, mi ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ mitsɛ we lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mibaye mabua bo, ni ooogbe Midianbii lɛ butuu tamɔ agbeɔ mɔ kome.” Gideon kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛ ona mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ, no lɛ hã mi okadi ko akɛ bo okɛ mi wieɔ nɛɛ.
Ofainɛ, kaaje biɛ kɛyashi be ni maba mikɛ nikeenii aaabama ohiɛ.” Yehowa to he akɛ; “Mahi shi kɛyashi be ni oooku osɛɛ oba.” No hewɔ lɛ, Gideon tee ni eyasaa abotiabi.
Ekɛ ma kiloi nyɔŋma fee akpiti.
Ekɛ loo lɛ wo kafu mli ni ekɛ ehe nu lɛ wo kukwɛi mli.
Ekɛ je kpo kɛba bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ tso lɛ shishi, ni ekɛbama ehiɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Okɛ loo lɛ kɛ akpiti lɛ ashwie tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni ofɔse ehe nu lɛ oshwie nɔ.” Gideon fee nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kpã edɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tso lɛ naabu sa loo lɛ kɛ akpiti lɛ he.
La jɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli ni ebashã loo lɛ kɛ akpiti lɛ wɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ laaje yɛ Gideon hiɛ.
Be ni Gideon yoo akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ei!
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ!
Yehowa bɔfo pam mina hiɛ kɛ hiɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ!” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Na tsui, kaashe gbeyei, ogboŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa, ni etsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ji hejɔlɛ.” Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ Ofra ni ji Abiezerbii anɔ lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Yaaŋɔ otsɛ tsinanuu nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, ni eye afii kpawo lɛ, koni oyakumɔ Baal afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji otsɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ foo nyɔŋmɔ yoo Ashera tso ni ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi lɛ.
Maa afɔleshãa latɛ ohã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ tɛsaa ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ yiteŋ.
Too tɛi ni okɛbaama lɛ gbɛjianɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ ato lɛ; koni oŋɔ tsinanuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, ni okɛshã shãa afɔle.
Okɛ Ashera tso ni obaafo lɛ afee lai ni okɛshã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Gideon ŋɔ etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma, ni efee bɔ ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ.
Shi akɛni eeshe etsɛ we lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ agbeyei hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ efee nii nɛɛ shwane, shi moŋ nyɔɔŋ efee.
Shi be ni maŋbii lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa lɛ, naa Baal afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni akumɔ ashwie shi; afo Ashera tso ni ma emasɛi lɛ, ni akɛ tsinanuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ eshã shãa afɔle yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ama lɛ nɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ ye nɛkɛ sane?” Be ni amɛtao mli ni amɛbi mli lɛ, akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, ji mɔ ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Yoash akɛ, “Jiemɔ obi lɛ kɛba ni agbe lɛ; ejaakɛ ekumɔ Baal afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni efo Ashera tso ni ma emasɛi lɛ.” Shi Yoash bi mɛi fɛɛ ni ebakpe ewo ehe lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ nyɛbaabe nyɛhã Baal lo?
Aloo nyɛ, nyɛbaafã Baal he?
Mɔ ni baabe ahã Baal lɛ, aaagbe lɛ dani je aaatsɛre.
Kɛ nyɔŋmɔ ji Baal lɛ efã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ efɔleshãa latɛ ni akumɔ lɛ hewɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ awo Gideon gbɛi akɛ, “Yerubaal”, eshishi ji “Baal kɛ lɛ atswa, ejaakɛ ekumɔ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Midianbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokãgbɛbii lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa.
Amɛfo Yordan Faa lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Yezreel jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shi Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Gideon nɔ.
Gideon kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ekɛtsɛ Abiezerbii lɛ koni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Etsu mɛi kɛtee Manase fɛɛ ni ayakpee amɛ hu koni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Etsu kɛtee Asher kɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali; ni amɛba koni amɛkɛ lɛ abakpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Kɛji minine nɔ obaatsɔ ohere Israel tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ gwantɛŋ wolo baaha ŋmãashaahe lɛ.
Kɛji bɔ nyɔ wolo lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ nɔ, shi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ egbi lɛ, no lɛ mana male akɛ minine nɔ obaatsɔ ohere Israel tamɔ bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” Eba mli nakai.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Gideon te shi leebi mra.
Eŋã toowolo lɛ mli, ni nu ni eŋã yɛ mli lɛ fee tsene obɔ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Omli akafu mi; mawie shi kome nɛɛ pɛ.
Miikpa bo fai, hã maka shi kome hu makwɛ: hã wolo lɛ kɛkɛ agbi, shi bɔ anyɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ hã eba mli nakai yɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli; wolo lɛ kɛkɛ gbi, shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ bɔ enyɔ.
Gideon ye Midianbii anɔ kunim Kɛkɛ ni Yerubaal ni ji Gideon lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ te shi leebi maaŋkpa, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Harod nubu lɛ naa.
Midianbii atabilɔi lɛ jwere jɔɔ lɛ ni kã More gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ mli.
Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Mɛi ni fata ohe lɛ ayi fa tsɔ̃ hã mi bɔ ni matsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mahã oye Midianbii lɛ anɔ kunim, koni Israel akabashwã etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ, ‘Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ mikɛhere miyiwala.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, hã ashiɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ toiŋ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ gbeyei ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ eya shĩa.’ ” Gideon ka amɛ ekwɛ ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ku amɛsɛɛ, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma hi shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Mɛi lɛ ayi fa tsɔ̃ lolo.
Okɛ amɛ akpeleke shi kɛya nu lɛ he, ni maka amɛ yɛ jɛi mahã bo.
Mɔ ni makɛɛ bo yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Okɛ mɔnɛ akaya lɛ,’ okɛ lɛ akaya.” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ mɛi lɛ kpeleke shi kɛtee nu lɛ he.
Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi aaalɛmɔ nu lɛ tamɔ gbei lɛmɔɔ nu lɛ, akɛ lɛ adamɔ afã; ni nakai nɔŋŋ ofee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakula enakutsei anaa ni eeenu nu lɛ.” Mɛi ni kɛ amɛnine to amɛnaa ni amɛlɛmɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ ji mɛi ohai etɛ̃; shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ kula amɛnakutsei anaa amɛnu nu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Hii ohai etɛ̃ ni lɛmɔ nu lɛ mikɛaahere nyɛ, ni mahã nyɛye Midian nɔ kunim; shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ aya; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya eshĩa.” No hewɔ lɛ, Gideon he nu kpuji lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ yɛ mɛi ni hiɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
Ewo amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛ kɛtee ebuu mli; shi ehã hii ohai etɛ̃ lɛ hi shi.
Midian nsra lɛ yɛ Gideon shishigbɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Tee shi ni okpeleke shi oyatua Midian nsra lɛ, ejaakɛ mibahã oye amɛnɔ kunim.
Shi kɛji ooshe gbeyei akɛ oooyatua amɛ lɛ, no lɛ, kɛ otsulɔ Pura akpeleke shi kɛya nsra lɛ mli, koni oyabo nii ni amɛwieɔ lɛ toi; kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ lɛ ooona ekãa kɛkpeleke shi kɛyatua nsra lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ etsulɔ Pura kpeleke shi kɛtee tabilɔi ni yɔɔ nsra lɛŋ lɛ amasɛi kpaakpa.
Shi Midianbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii kɛ bokãgbɛbii lɛ fɛɛ bua jɔɔ lɛ mli babaoo tamɔ baalabii.
Amɛyoomai lɛ aleee amɛyibɔ; amɛyifalɛ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Be ni Gideon shɛ jɛi lɛ, naa mɔ ko ni eegba enaanyo ko lamɔ ni ela.
Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ kɛɛ: “Naa, mila lamɔ ko.
Mila ni aboloo akwaabɔ ko koklo kɛba Midian nsra lɛ mli kɛbanina buu ko.
Ebatswa buu lɛ, ni etoo lɛ ebu shi, ni buu lɛ butu kwraa eshwie shi.” Enaanyo lɛ to he hã lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni, Yoash, Israelnyo lɛ, bi Gideon lɛ klante lɛ ni.
Nyɔŋmɔ eto akɛ Gideon aye Midian ta lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim.” Be ni Gideon nu lamɔ ni agba lɛ kɛ eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, eho ekula shi ni esɔle.
Kɛkɛ ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee Israelbii lɛ nsra lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ nyɛbaaye Midian ta lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim.” Eja hii ohai etɛ̃ lɛ mli kui etɛ, ni ekɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛ kpulu ni kɔti hɔ mli hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ edɛŋ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa mi ni nyɛfea bɔ ni mafee lɛ.
Kɛ miyashɛ nsra lɛ naa lɛ, bɔ ni mafee lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ.
Kɛ mikɛ mɛi ni fata mihe lɛ kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ kɛbɔlea Midian nsra lɛ fɛɛ, ni nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Kɛhã Yehowa kɛ Gideon!’ ” Gideon kɛ hii oha ni fata ehe lɛ yashɛ Midian nsra lɛ naa nyɔɔŋteŋ buube lɛ shishijee mli be ni amɛtsake bulɔi lɛ sɛɛ pɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon kɛ ewebii lɛ kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ, ni amɛjwara kpuji ni amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kui etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ kpãkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ, ni amɛjwara kpuji lɛ.
Amɛhiɛ kɔtii lɛ yɛ amɛbɛku kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ yɛ amɛninejurɔ.
Amɛkpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi lɛ, ni amɛbɔ oshe akɛ, “Yehowa kɛ Gideon klante!” Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ damɔ egbɛhe kɛbɔle Midian nsra lɛ kpula.
Midian ta lɛ bu, ni amɛjo foi kɛ blɔmɔ.
Be ni akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi ohai etɛ̃ lɛ, Yehowa hã Midianbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ dɔ eklante eto enyɛmi nɔ yɛ nsra muu lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Midian ta muu lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kɛtee Bet-Shita ni yɔɔ kɛyaa Zerera gbɛ lɛ, kɛtee Abel-Mehola ni yɔɔ Tabat masɛi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ayatsɛ Israel hii lɛ kɛjɛ Naftali kɛ Asher kɛ Manase fɛɛ, ni amɛtiu Midianbii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Gideon tsu mɛi kɛtee Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ ayakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkpelekea shi ni nyɛkɛ Midianbii lɛ abakpea.
Nyɛtsimɔa faafoohei gbɛi lɛ kɛyashia Bet-Bara kɛ Yordan naa.” No hewɔ lɛ, ayakpee Efraim hii lɛ fɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛtsimɔ gbɛi ni akɛyaa fai lɛ anaa kɛyashi Bet-Bara kɛ Yordan naa.
Amɛmɔmɔ Oreb kɛ Zeeb, Midian lumɛi enyɔ lɛ.
Amɛgbe Oreb yɛ Oreb tɛsaa lɛ he, ni amɛgbe Zeeb yɛ Zeeb wain bu lɛ he.
Amɛnyiɛ Midianbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ Oreb kɛ Zeeb yitsei lɛ bahã Gideon yɛ Yordan faa lɛ sɛɛ.
Aye Midianbii anɔ kunim agbe naa Kɛkɛ ni Efraim hii lɛ bi Gideon akɛ, “Mɛɛba oye wɔ nɛkɛ sane akɛ obakpeee wɔ be ni ofãa ni okɛ Midian ayawu lɛ?” Amɛ kɛ lɛ wie he nyanyaanya.
Gideon kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee ni ekɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ ye egbɔ?
Fioo po ni nyɛ, Efraim, nyɛfee lɛ, efe nɔ ni mikɛ miweku muu fɛɛ efee lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ nyɛgbe Midian lumɛi ni ji Oreb kɛ Zeeb.
Mɛni minyɛ mifee ni ekɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ ye egbɔ?” Nɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛmlifu lɛ naa ba shi.
Gideon kɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ shɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa, ni amɛfo.
Etɔ amɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyiɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ lolo.
No hewɔ lɛ, Gideon kɛɛ Sukotbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛhãa hii ni mikɛnyiɛ nɛɛ aboloo akwaabɔi nyɛhãa mi, ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ, ni minyiɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, Midian maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, asɛɛ.” Shi Sukot onukpai lɛ to he akɛ, “Ani onine eshɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ momo hewɔ ni wɔhã otabilɔi lɛ aboloo lɛ lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, Gideon kɛɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ!
Kɛji Yehowa hã minine shɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mikɛ ŋã mli ŋmeii kɛ aklatii baayi nyɛ ni nyɛheloo baafamɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon fã kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtee Penuel.
Ekɛ Penuelbii wie tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ Sukotbii wie lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni Penuelbii lɛ to he hã lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Sukotbii lɛ to he lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Penuelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji miye omanye ni miba lɛ, makumɔ nyɛmɔɔ nɛɛ.” Shi Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛ tabilɔi aaafee hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ yɛ Karkor.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi pɛ ni eshwɛ yɛ bokãgbɛbii ata lɛ fɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tabilɔi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ enyɔnyɔi.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon tsɔ̃ gbɛ ni gbɛfalɔi aku nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ Noba kɛ Yagbeha bokãgbɛ, ni eyahɛŋ henyɛlɔi lɛ trukaa.
Zeba kɛ Zalmuna jo foi; shi Gideon tiu amɛ.
Eyamɔmɔ Midian maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ni ji Zeba kɛ Zalmuna lɛ, ni egbɛ amɛta muu lɛ fɛɛ eshwã.
Kɛkɛ ni Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli.
Etsɔ̃ Heres ŋmeŋme lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Emɔ Sukot oblanyo ko, ni ehã eŋmã Sukot nɔyelɔi kɛ emli onukpai lɛ agbɛii ehã lɛ, hii nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ kpawo.
Gideon banina Sukotbii lɛ, ni ekɛɛ: “Naa, Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɛ!
Amɛhewɔ nyɛye mihe fɛo akɛ, ‘Ani onine eshɛ Zeba kɛ Zalmuna nɔ momo hewɔ ni wɔhãa otabilɔi ni etɔ amɛ lɛ aboloo lɛ lo?’ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon mɔmɔ Sukot maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋã mli ŋmeii kɛ aklatii yi amɛ waa.
Penuel mɔɔ lɛ hu Gideon kumɔ, ni egbe maŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Gideon bi Zeba kɛ Zalmuna akɛ, “Hii ni nyɛgbe yɛ Tabor lɛ, te amɛsubaŋ yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Amɛtamɔ bo pɛ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛtamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi abii.” Gideon kɛɛ: “Minyɛmimɛi ni; minyɛ musuŋbii ji amɛ.
Anɔkwale, mina Yehowa akɛ eji nyɛgbeee amɛ kulɛ migbeŋ nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ekromɔbi Yeter akɛ, “Tee shi ni ogbe amɛ!” Shi oblanyo lɛ gbalaaa eklante lɛ; eeshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ edako.
Kɛkɛ ni Zeba kɛ Zalmuna kɛɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ tee shi ni ogbe wɔ, ejaakɛ ja nuu ni nyɛɔ nuu nii etsuɔ,” Kɛkɛ ni Gideon te shi ni egbe Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, ni ejie kuɛnii ni afee amɛ nyɔɔŋtsere fãfãi ni yɔɔ amɛyoomai lɛ akuɛ lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Gideon akɛ, “Ye wɔnɔ, bo kɛ obi kɛ onabi fɛɛ, ejaakɛ ohere wɔ yɛ Midianbii lɛ adɛŋ.” Shi Gideon kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miyeŋ nyɛnɔ, ni mibi hu yeŋ nyɛnɔ; Yehowa aaaye nyɛnɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Mibabi nyɛ nɔ ko; no ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ shika toiiaŋnii ni eha lɛ ahã mi!” (Ejaakɛ akɛni Ishmaelbii ji Midianbii lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo shika toiiaŋnii).
Israelbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Wɔkɛaahã kɛ miishɛɛ.” Amɛkɛ mama lɛɛ shi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shɛrɛ shika toiiaŋnii ni eha lɛ eshwie nɔ.
Shika toiiaŋnii lɛ ni Gideon bi lɛ, etsiimɔ ji shika ŋmiiŋmi shekeli akpe kome kɛ ohai kpawo, soro jwinei ni afee amɛ nyɔɔŋtsere fãfãi kɛ toiiaŋnii kɛ afaseo atadei ni Midian maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ wowoo lɛ, kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ni yɔɔ amɛyoomai lɛ akuɛi lɛ.
Gideon kɛ shika nɛɛ fee efod, ni ekɛto emaŋ ni ji Ofra lɛ mli.
Ni Israelbii fɛɛ kwa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtee jɛi ni amɛyaja efod lɛ.
Enɛ tsɔ̃ tsɔne ehã Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ.
Bɔ ni fee ni aba Midian shi ahã Israel nɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Midianbii wooo amɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Gideon wala be mli.
Gideon gbele Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, yi mli etee eyahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋbii, ejaakɛ eŋɔ yei pii.
Ehemɔ ni yɔɔ Shekem lɛ, lɛ hu ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu.
Ewo gbekɛ lɛ Abimelek.
Gideon, Yoash bi lɛ, gbɔ kotokoto dani egbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ Yoash fuuhe lɛ yɛ Ofra ni ji Abiezerbii akrowa lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Gideon egbo sɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ Baal-Berit fee amɛnyɔŋmɔ.
Amɛkaiii Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ adɛŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Asaŋ amɛfeee Yerubaal ni ji Gideon lɛ we lɛ ejurɔ ko tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ lɛ efee Israel lɛ.
Abimelek Agbɛnɛ Abimelek, Yerubaal bi lɛ, yiŋ etee enyɛ nyɛmimɛi, aŋɔɔ yɛ Shekem maŋ lɛ mli.
Ekɛ amɛ kɛ enyɛ tsɛ we lɛ weku lɛ fɛɛ yawie ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛbia yɛ Shekembii fɛɛ ahiɛ akɛ, ‘Te emli nɔ ni hi hã nyɛ hu?
Akɛ Yerubaal bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ fɛɛ aye nyɛnɔ, aloo mɔ kome kɛkɛ aye nyɛnɔ?’ Nyɛkaia hu akɛ, mi lɛ, nyɛheloo kɛ lá ji mi.” Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ amɛhã lɛ yɛ Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ atoiŋ.
Shekembii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ esa akɛ amɛnyiɛ Abimelek sɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnyɛmi ni.” Amɛŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛjɛ Baal-Berit we lɛ amɛhã lɛ.
Abimelek kɛ shika nɛɛ bɔ yakayaka gbɔmɛi yibulɔi apaa koni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Etee etsɛ we lɛ yɛ Ofra, ni eyagbe Gideon bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ ni ji enyɛmimɛi lɛ, yɛ tɛ kome nɔ.
Shi Yotam ni ji Gideon nakutsoŋbi lɛ kome pɛ shwɛ, ejaakɛ etee ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Milo we lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi ni amɛtee amɛyawo Abimelek maŋtsɛ yɛ kaimɔ tso kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ Shekem lɛ shishi.
Be ni ayagba Yotam lɛ, eyiŋ etee eyadamɔ Gerizim gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ ni ebo ekɛɛ Shekembii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa mi toi, nyɛ Shekembii, koni Nyɔŋmɔ hu abo nyɛ toi.
Gbi ko lɛ tsei yiŋ tee koni amɛyafɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mu ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ.
Amɛkɛɛ mutso akɛ, ‘Ye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ.’ Shi mutso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Ani mihã mimu ni akɛwoɔ nyɔŋmɔi kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam lɛ abɔ mi ni miyaye tsei anɔ lo?’ Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ yakɛɛ agbãmitso akɛ, ‘Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ.’ Shi agbãmitso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Ani mihã miŋɔɔmɔ kɛ miyibii kpakpai lɛ abɔ mi ni miyaye tsei anɔ lo?’ Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ yakɛɛ waintso akɛ, ‘Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ, maŋtsɛ.’ Shi waintso kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Ani mihã midãa ni shɛjeɔ nyɔŋmɔi kɛ gbɔmɛi amii lɛ abɔ mi, ni mayaye tsei anɔ lo?’ Kɛkɛ ni tsei lɛ fɛɛ yakɛɛ ŋmeitso akɛ, ‘Bo lɛ ba ni obaye wɔnɔ mɔ.’ Shi ŋmeitso kɛɛ tsei lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛmiiwo mi maŋtsɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaa nyɛbabaa abo yɛ mishishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ la ajɛ ŋmeitso mli ni eyashã Lebanon tsenedrui lɛ.’ ” Yotam tee nɔ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyɛwo Abimelek lɛ, ani anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ sane nyɛye lɛ?
Ani ekpakpa nyɛfee Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ?
Ani nii ni Gideon tsu ehã nyɛ lɛ nyɛto lɛ najiaŋ bɔ ni sa?
Ejaakɛ mitsɛ wu hã nyɛ; ekɛ ehe wo osharã mli, ni ekɛjie nyɛ yɛ Midianbii adɛŋ.
Shi ŋmɛnɛ nyɛte shi nyɛwo mitsɛ we lɛ, ni nyɛgbe ebihii lɛ, mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo sɔŋŋ, yɛ tɛ kome nɔ; ni nyɛwo Abimelek, eweyoo bi lɛ, Shekembii amaŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛmi ji lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ sane nyɛye Gideon kɛ ewe lɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛnyaa Abimelek he, ni lɛ hu enya nyɛhe.
Shi kɛjeee nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ la ajɛ Abimelek mli ni eyashã Shekembii lɛ kɛ Milo we lɛ; asaŋ la ajɛ Shekembii lɛ amli kɛ Milo we lɛ ni eyashã Abimelek.” Shi akɛni Yotam miishe enyɛmi Abimelek gbeyei hewɔ lɛ Yotam jo foi, ni egbala ehe shi kɛtee Beer, ni eyahi jɛi.
Abimelek ye Israelbii anɔ afii etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã nyɛɛ ba Abimelek kɛ Shekembii lɛ ateŋ; Shekembii lɛ yeee Abimelek anɔkwa.
Afee enɛ bɔ ni afee koni gbe ni agbe Gideon musuŋbii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, agbala amɛnyɛmi Abimelek, kɛ Shekembii lɛ atoi yɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛwo Abimelek hewalɛ ni egbe enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Shekembii lɛ to kawolɔi yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ koni amɛwo Abimelek ka.
Kawolɔi nɛɛ shɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ anii yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Ayagba Abimelek.
Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba Shekem, ni Shekembii lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Amɛje kpo kɛtee amɛŋmɔji ashi.
Amɛkpa amɛwaintromi lɛ amli yibii ni amɛŋã wain lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛye gbijurɔ.
Amɛtee amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ.
Amɛyeyee nii; amɛnunuu dãi, ni amɛye Abimelek he fɛo.
Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, kɛɛ: “Namɔ ji Abimelek, ni namɛi ji wɔ Shekembii ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ?
Ani Gideon bi lɛ kɛ esafoiatsɛ Zebul lɛ, jeee Hamor ni to Shekem lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ be ko ni eho?
Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ esa akɛ wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ lɛ?
Mina ni maŋ nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ ni kulɛ makpa Abimelek.
Makɛɛ Abimelek akɛ, ‘Hã ota lɛ yi afa, ni ofã kɛba.’ ” Be ni Zebul, maŋ lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ, nu Ebed bi Gaal wiemɔi lɛ, emli wo la, ni etsu mɛi kɛtee Abimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Aruma ekɛɛ, “Ebed bi Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ eba Shekem, ni amɛmiiwo maŋ lɛ yiŋ ni amɛte shi amɛwo bo.
No hewɔ lɛ, tee shi nyɔɔŋ, bo kɛ omɛi lɛ, ni oyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Leebi, kɛ hulu te shi pɛ, tee shi mra ni obatua maŋ lɛ.
Kɛji Gaal kɛ emɛi lɛ je kpo banina bo lɛ, feemɔ amɛ bɔ ni ooonyɛ.” Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ.
Amɛjara amɛmli kui ejwɛ, ni amɛwo Shekem he ka.
Kɛkɛ ni Gaal, Ebed bi lɛ, je kpo, ni eyadamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ kawoohe lɛ.
Gaal na mɛi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ miikpeleke shi.” Zebul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gɔji lɛ asusuma onaa tamɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ.” Shi Gaal wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbɔmɛi miijɛ gɔŋ lɛ teŋ miikpeleke shi kɛmiiba, ni ku kome jɛ klamɔfoi atso kpele lɛ he gbɛ kɛmiiba.” Kɛkɛ ni Zebul bi Gaal akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ onaabu ni okɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Namɔ ji Abimelek ni wɔsɔmɔɔ lɛ’ lɛ yɔɔ?
Ani jeee gbɔmɛi lɛ ni ojɛɔ amɛ lɛ nɛ?
Agbɛnɛ jee kpo ni okɛ amɛ ayawu.” Kɛkɛ ni Gaal je kpo kɛnyiɛ Shekembii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ Abimelek bawu.
Shi Abimelek wo Gaal foi, ni enyiɛ Gaal sɛɛ.
Apilapilai, ni mɛi babaoo nyɔnyɔɔi aahu kɛyashi maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa tete.
Abimelek hi Aruma; ni Zebul shwie Gaal kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛje Shekem ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehiii amɛ jɛihilɛ dɔŋŋ.
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋbii lɛ je kpo kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Ayagba Abimelek.
Hewɔ lɛ eŋɔ emɛi lɛ, ni ejara amɛmli kui etɛ̃.
Eyawo ka yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋbii lɛ ni amɛmiije kpo kɛmiijɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Abimelek te shi wo amɛ, ni etswia amɛ nii.
Abimelek kɛ ku ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛtee amɛhiɛ ni amɛyadamɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni kui krokomɛi enyɔ lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Shekembii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe Shekembii lɛ fɛɛ.
Abimelek kɛ Shekem maŋ lɛ wu nakai gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Egbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ.
Ebutu maŋ lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋoo shwã mli.
Be ni Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛyabote El-Berit we lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Ayagba Abimelek akɛ Shekem mɔɔ lɛ mli hii lɛ fɛɛ eyabua amɛhe naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek kɛ emɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwɔ Zalmon gɔŋ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ.
Abimelek kɔ lema ehiɛ edɛ̃.
Eyafo tso nine ko, ni ewo etswa ekoŋ.
Ekɛɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni nyɛna ni mifee nɛɛ, nyɛhe afea oya ni nyɛfea nakai.” No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yafo tso nine, ni amɛkɛnyiɛ Abimelek sɛɛ.
Amɛkɛbashwie mɔɔ lɛ he ni amɛma mɔɔ lɛ naa la.
Gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, hii kɛ yei aaafee akpe lɛ fɛɛ hu gboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Abimelek yiŋ etee Tebez.
Eyabɔ nsra ewo maŋ lɛ he, ni eŋɔ.
Shi mɔɔ ni wa ko yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, ni maŋbii lɛ jo foi kɛtee jɛi, hii kɛ yei fɛɛ.
Amɛŋã amɛyi, ni amɛkwɔ mɔɔ lɛ kɛtee eyiteŋ.
Abimelek ba, ni ebatua mɔɔ lɛ.
Etsi ebɛŋkɛ mɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ koni ema mɔɔ lɛ naa la.
Shi yoo ko ŋmɛɛ wiɛbi he etswa Abimelek yiteŋ, ni ejwa Abimelek yitsoŋoŋo lɛ.
Oya nɔŋŋ ni Abimelek tsɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ lɛ Abimelek lɛ etawuunii lɛ, ni efã oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Gbalamɔ oklante ni ogbe mi, koni akakɛɛ yɛ mihe akɛ, ‘Yoo po gbe lɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, oblanyo lɛ tsu Abimelek nɔ, ni egbo.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Abimelek enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yiŋ etee emaŋ.
Efɔŋ ni Abimelek fee etsɛ akɛ egbe etsɛ lɛ bii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo he nyɔmɔ nɛ.
Asaŋ efɔŋ ni Shekembii fee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbala amɛtoi yɛ fɛɛ he; ni Yotam Gideon bi lɛ, loomɔ lɛ ba amɛnɔ.
Tola Abimelek sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni ehere Israelbii lɛ ji Tola, Isarkanyo lɛ.
Dodo bi Pua bi ji lɛ.
Ehi Shamir yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃, ni egbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ Shamir.
Yair Tola sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ni te shi akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ ji Yair, Gileadnyo lɛ.
Enyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃; amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ eteji ni etaa nɔ.
Amɛyɛ maji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Atsɛɔ maji nɛɛ Yair akrowai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yair gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Kamon.
Yefta Israelbii lɛ fee efɔŋ amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ.
Amɛyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ Astarte nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ji Siriabii kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛsɔmɔɔɔ lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni ehã Filistibii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ye Israel nɔ.
Filistibii kɛ Amonbii nɛɛ hao Israelbii lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i amɛ nyɔŋyeli yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ.
Amɛye Israelbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan sɛɛ yɛ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ hu Amonbii lɛ bafo Yordan koni amɛkɛ Yuda kɛ Benyamin we lɛ kɛ Efraim abawu.
Enɛ hã Israelbii lɛ fee yeyeeye naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa amɛkɛɛ: “Wɔfee esha wɔshi bo; ejaakɛ wɔkwa bo, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni wɔyasɔmɔ Baal nyɔŋmɔi lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Be ni nyɛbolɔ nyɛtsɛ mi lɛ, ani jeee mi mihere nyɛ yɛ Ijiptbii kɛ Amorbii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Filistibii kɛ Sidonbii kɛ Amalekbii kɛ Midianbii ni wa nyɛ yi lɛ adɛŋ?
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa mi, ni nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mihereŋ nyɛyiwala dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛyaa nyɛyabolɔa nyɛtsɛa nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni nyɛhala lɛ; amɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ amanehulu be nɛɛ mli.” Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Wɔfee esha; bo lɛ feemɔ wɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa ohiɛ; shi ofainɛ ni ojie wɔ ŋmɛnɛ kɛkɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ jie nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ amɛshwie, ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa.
Amɛnii fee Yehowa mɔbɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Amonbii lɛ hoo ta ni amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Gilead.
Israelbii hu bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Mizpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Gilead maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ ji nuu ni kɛ Amonbii lɛ aaababɔ̃i wuu?
Lɛ eeefee Gileadbii fɛɛ anukpa.”
Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ, tawulɔ kãkãlɔ ji lɛ; shi yoo ajwamãŋ ko bi ni.
Yefta lɛ etsɛ ji Gilead.
Gilead kɛ eŋã diɛŋtsɛ hu yɛ bihii krokomɛi.
Be ni bii nɛɛ badara lɛ, amɛshwie Yefta, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oyeŋ gboshinii yɛ wɔtsɛ we lɛ, ejaakɛ yoo kroko bi ji bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Yefta jo foi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyahi Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yakayaka gbɔmɛi komɛi bua amɛhe naa amɛyafata Yefta he, ni amɛkɛ lɛ fãa ta, amɛyayeɔ ojo.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Amonbii lɛ fã ta wo Israel.
Ni fee nakai lɛ, Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ amɛtee amɛyaŋɔ Yefta yɛ Tob shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Amɛkɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Ba ni obaye asafoiatsɛ ohã wɔ ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu.” Shi Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee nyɛ nyɛhe tsɛ̃ mi, ni nyɛshwie mi yɛ mitsɛ we lɛ?
Mɛɛ hewɔ ni agbɛnɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ lɛ?” Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “No hewɔ moŋ ni wɔgba wɔtua bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, koni okɛ wɔ aya ni wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu, ni otsɔ̃ wɔ Gileadbii fɛɛ wɔnukpa.” Yefta kɛɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi na ku sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔkɛ Amonbii lɛ yawu, ni Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, mi, mibaye nyɛnɔ.” Gilead onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Yehowa afee wɔ kɛ bo teŋ odase akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ wɔɔɔye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yefta kɛ Gilead onukpai lɛ yiŋ tee, ni maŋ lɛ wo lɛ onukpa kɛ asafoiatsɛ amɛhã maŋ lɛ.
Ni Yefta yawie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yefta tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane okɛ mi yɔɔ hewɔ ni obaa minɔ ni okɛ mimaŋ lɛ abawu nɛɛ?” Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ hã bɔfoi ni atsu lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ejaakɛ be ni Israel jɛ Ijipt baa lɛ, ekɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yabok Faa lɛ kɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he; no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ minii aku sɛɛ ahã mi kpoo!” Yefta saa tsu mɛi kɛtee Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yefta kɛɛ nɛ: Israelbii kɔko Moabbii loo Amonbii ashikpɔŋ ko; shi moŋ be ni Israelbii jɛ Ijipt amɛbaa lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa, ni amɛba Kadesh.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsu mɛi kɛtee Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛho.’ Shi Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ.
Amɛtsu Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, shi ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ hi shi yɛ Kadesh.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ ŋã lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyalɔgɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛyashɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Shi amɛboteee Moab shikpɔŋ mli, ejaakɛ Arnon Faa lɛ ji Moab husu.
Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon ni ji Heshbon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsɔ̃ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni wɔyaa nɔ lɛ nɔ.’ Shi Sihon yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe bɔ ni eeehã amɛtsɔ̃ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Sihon bua emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Eyabɔ nsra yɛ Yahaz, ni ekɛ Israel wu.
Shi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hã Israelbii lɛ ye Sihon kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ ŋɔ Amorbii ashikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ.
Amɛŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Arnon Faa lɛ he kɛyashi Yabok Faa lɛ he; amɛŋɔ kɛjɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Yordan naa tɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, belɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Amorbii lɛ adɛŋ ehã emaŋ Israel; ni bo otaoɔ ni oŋɔ nɛɛ?
Ani nɔ ni onyɔŋmɔ Kemosh kɛhã bo akɛ onɔ lɛ, oŋɔɔɔ?
Wɔ hu, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã wɔ lɛ, wɔɔŋɔ akɛ wɔnɔ.
Aso oyɛ hewalɛ fe Balak, Zipor bi lɛ ni ji Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ?
Ani ekɛ Israel epele nii ahe pɛŋ aloo ekɛ amɛ ewu pɛŋ?
Israel ehi Heshbon kɛ Aroer kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ kɛ majimaji ni jwere Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ amli afii ohai etɛ̃.
Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛshɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛnii nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, mifeko bo efɔŋ ko; shi bo moŋ ni ofeɔ mi efɔŋ akɛ ofã ta kɛba minɔ.
Yehowa ni ji kojolɔ lɛ akojo Israelbii kɛ Amonbii ateŋ sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ wiemɔ ni Yefta kɛtsu eŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Yefta nɔ.
Yefta tsɔ̃ Gilead kɛ Manase kɛfoŋ kɛtee Mizpa yɛ Gilead, ni efoŋ yɛ Mizpa kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ.
Yefta wo Yehowa shi ni ekɛɛ: “Kɛji ooohã maye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, no lɛ, kɛ miyaye omanye ni miku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Amonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ miiba lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ miwe lɛ agbo lɛ mli aaaba kpee mi lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ni mikɛ lɛ aaafee shãa afɔle.” Kɛkɛ ni Yefta fã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ayawu.
Yehowa hã eye amɛnɔ kunim, ni Yefta tswia amɛ nii ni egbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Aroer aahu kɛtsɔ̃ Minit kpokpai anɔ, he ni maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɔɔ lɛ, aahu kɛtee Abel-Keramim.
Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni Israelbii lɛ ye Amonbii lɛ anɔ kunim.
Yefta Biyoo lɛ Be ni Yefta ku esɛɛ kɛbaa ewe lɛ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, naa, ebiyoo lɛ je kpo kɛ fabii kɛ joi kɛba koni ebakpee lɛ.
Yefta bi koome pɛ ji lɛ; esɛɛ lɛ ebɛ binuu lɛ, ebɛ biyoo hu.
Be ni Yefta na lɛ lɛ, egbala ehe atadei, ni ekɛɛ: “Ao mibi, ohã mihe ejɔ̃ mihe naakpa; bo pam ohã oshara bashara mi nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ miwo Yehowa shi, ni minyɛŋ minaa makpale.” Ebiyoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ, owo Yehowa shi, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa tɔ ohe owele yɛ ohenyɛlɔi ni ji Amonbii lɛ anɔ nɛɛ, feemɔ mi bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni owo shi lɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ enɛ pɛ ohã mi.
Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ kɛyashi biɛ nyɔji enyɔ, koni maya mikɛ minanemɛi lɛ ayakpa shi yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ maye ŋkɔmɔ akɛ oblayoo foro.” Etsɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa!” Ni ewo lɛ gbɛ eyaye nyɔji enyɔ.
Ekɛ enanemɛi lɛ tee eyaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ akɛ ebaagbo oblayoo foro.
Nyɔji enyɔ lɛ naagbee lɛ, eku esɛɛ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni Yefta fee ebiyoo lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ, ni ebiyoo lɛ gbo akɛ oblayoo foro.
Enɛ tsɔ̃ kusum yɛ Israel, akɛ daa afi lɛ Israel oblayei yaa amɛyayeɔ gbii ejwɛ amɛkɛyeɔ Yefta Gileadnyo lɛ biyoo lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.
Yefta kɛ Efraimbii lɛ Efraim hii lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛhã ta.
Amɛfo mli kɛtee Zafon ni amɛyakɛɛ Yefta akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ be ni ofã ni okɛ Amonbii lɛ yaa ayawu lɛ, obakpeee wɔ ni wɔkɛ bo aya lɛ?
Wɔkɛ la baashã oshĩa lɛ wɔshwie oyiteŋ.” Yefta kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ mimaŋbii lɛ, bei ni mli wa ba wɔ kɛ Amonbii lɛ ateŋ, shi be ni mitsɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛbahereee mi yɛ Amonbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Be ni mina akɛ nyɛhereŋ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe wo osharã mli, ni mifã kɛyanina Amonbii lɛ.
Yehowa hã miye amɛnɔ kunim.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba minɔ ŋmɛnɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi abawu lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Yefta bua Gileadhii lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛ Efraimbii lɛ wu, ni amɛye Efraimbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Gileadbii lɛ, kobɔfoi ni bafata Efraimbii kɛ Manasebii ahe ji nyɛ.” Gileadbii tsĩ Efraimbii lɛ gbɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Kɛji Efraimbii ni ejo foi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ akɛ, “hã mafo faa lɛ,” Gileadbii biɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ani Efraimnyo ji bo lo?” Ni kɛ ekɛɛ “Dabi” lɛ, Gileadbii lɛ kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ kɛɛmɔ, ‘Shibolet’; ni kɛ enyɛɛɛ etsɛ wiemɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni ekɛɛ ‘Sibolet’ ” lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbeɔ lɛ yɛ hei ni afoɔ Yordan Faa lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Efraimbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi.
Yefta nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii ekpaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yefta, Gileadnyo lɛ gbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Gilead.
Ibzan, Elon kɛ Abdon Yefta sɛɛ lɛ, Ibzan ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ ji hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ biyei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ.
Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ bahã gbãlã yɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli, ni eyaŋɔ yei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛjɛ akutsei krokomɛi amli ebahã ebihii lɛ.
Ibzan nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpawo; kɛkɛ ni egbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ Betlehem.
Ibzan sɛɛ lɛ, Elon ni jɛ Zebulon lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ.
Enyiɛ amɛhiɛ afii nyɔŋma; kɛkɛ ni egbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Ayalon yɛ Zebulon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Elon sɛɛ lɛ, Abdon ni ji Hilel ni jɛ Piraton lɛ bi lɛ ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Israel hiɛ.
Eyɛ bihii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ nabii hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Ebii kɛ enabii nɛɛ taraa tejii nyɔŋmai kpawo anɔ.
Abdon nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abdon, Hilel ni ji Piratonnyo lɛ bi lɛ gbo.
Afu lɛ yɛ Piraton yɛ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Amalekbii agɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Samson fɔmɔ Israelbii lɛ fee esha amɛshi Yehowa ekoŋŋ, ni Yehowa hã Filistibii ye amɛnɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Nuu ko yɛ Zora ni ejɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli.
Egbɛi ji Manoa.
Eŋã lɛ kene ji lɛ, ni ebɛ bi.
Yehowa bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kene ji bo, ni obɛ bi; shi agbɛnɛ obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ le ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ.
Kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa, ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee hu.
Ejaakɛ naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu.
Asooyi naa akasa eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe.
Lɛ ebaabɔi Israelbii lɛ heremɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ ewu akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ko ba miŋɔɔ.
Ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei naakpa.
Shi mibiii lɛ he ni ejɛ, ni lɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔɔ mi egbɛi.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Naa, obaana musu, ni obaafɔ binuu; no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ, kaanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa; ni kaaye nɔ ko ni he tseee; ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ baafee mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ musuŋ beebe kɛyashi gbi ni eeegbo.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Manoa kpa Yehowa fai ni ekɛɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, hã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni otsu lɛ aba wɔŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ gbekɛ lɛ ni abaafɔ lɛ wɔhã.” Nyɔŋmɔ fee nɔ ni Manoa bi lɛ ehã lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo lɛ ba yoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ be ni eta shi yɛ ŋmɔ mli; shi ewu Manoa bɛ jɛi.
Yoo lɛ he fee oya, ni esha foi eyakɛɛ ewu lɛ akɛ, “Naa nuu lɛ ni ba miŋɔɔ nyɛsɛɛ lɛ ebajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Manoa te shi ni enyiɛ eŋã lɛ sɛɛ ni ebanina nuu lɛ.
Ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji nuu lɛ ni kɛ yoo nɛɛ bawie lɛ?” Nuu lɛ to he akɛ, “Miŋ.” Manoa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, te gbekɛ lɛ shihilɛ baatamɔ ahã tɛŋŋ, ni mɛni ebaafee?” Yehowa bɔfo lɛ to he akɛ, “Nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ yoo lɛ, ehiɛ ahi ehe nɔ yɛ he.
Ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni jɛɔ waintso mli, ni asaŋ ekanu wain loo dãa ko ni wa.
Asaŋ ekaye nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee.
Nibii fɛɛ ni miwo lɛ he kitã lɛ eye nɔ.” Manoa kɛɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã wɔtsi onaa fioo, ni wɔkɛ too abotiabi afee niyenii ahã bo.” Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, “Kɛji otsi minaa tete po, miyeŋ niyenii lɛ eko; shi kɛji shãa afɔle obaashã lɛ, no lɛ shãa ohã Yehowa.” Manoa leee akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, Manoa bi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Te atsɛɔ bo tɛŋŋ?
Koni kɛ owiemɔi lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ni wɔwo ohiɛ nyam.” Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Manoa akɛ, “Mɛɛba obiɔ migbɛi?
Migbɛi lɛ, naakpɛɛ gbɛi ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, Manoa ŋɔ too abotiabi ni ekɛ no kɛ ŋmãa afɔle shã afɔle yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa mɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛnii lɛ.
Be ni lalilɛi lɛ te shi kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lalilɛi lɛ mli ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ na kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ebajieee ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ Manoa kɛ eŋã lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Manoa na le akɛ Yehowa bɔfo ni.
Manoa kɛɛ eŋã lɛ akɛ, “Gboimɔ wɔbaagboi lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔna Nyɔŋmɔ.” Shi eŋã lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Eji Yehowa miitao wɔ egbe kulɛ eheŋ wɔdɛŋ shãa afɔle kɛ ŋmãa afɔle lɛ, ni asaŋ kulɛ etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni ejieŋ saji ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi kpo etsɔ̃ŋ wɔ.” Yoo lɛ fɔ binuu, ni ewo lɛ Samson.
Gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni Yehowa jɔɔ lɛ.
Yehowa Mumɔ bɔ̃i Samson nɔ baa be ni eyɔɔ Dan Shitoohe lɛ, yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ lɛ.
Samson kɛ Timna yoo lɛ Samson yiŋ etee Timna ni eyana yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni eji Filistibii lɛ eko.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Miyana Filisti oblayoo ko yɛ Timna; nyɛyaŋɔa lɛ nyɛbahãa mi ni mikɛ lɛ afea miŋã.” Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aso yoo ko yoo ko bɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ abiyei lɛ ateŋ aloo wɔjakubii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ hewɔ ni esa akɛ oyaŋɔ yoo yɛ Filistibii foolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ?” Shi Samson kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Yaaŋɔ lɛ obahã mi, ejaakɛ lɛ misumɔɔ.” Shi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ leee akɛ Yehowa dɛŋ jɛ ni Filistibii lɛ ahe gbɛ Yehowa taoɔ, ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Filistibii lɛ yeɔ Israel nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ yiŋ kɛtee Timna.
Amɛshɛ Timna waintromi lɛ ahe; kɛkɛ ni jata oblanyo ko bɔ̃i huumɔ kɛ Samson woo.
Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ba Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, ni Samson tserɛ jata lɛ mli tamɔ atserɛɔ too abotiabi mli, tsɛ ehiɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ.
Shi Samson ekɛɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ.
Samson kɛ yoo lɛ yawie, ni yoo lɛ sane sa Samson hiɛ naakpa.
Be fioo sɛɛ lɛ Samson tee ni eyaŋɔ yoo lɛ.
Be ni eyaa lɛ egba koni eyakwɛ jata gbonyo lɛ, ni eyana akɛ wobii asafo eto wo yɛ jata lɛ musuŋ.
Samson jie wo lɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, ni ehiɛ yeli kɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ebanina etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni ehã amɛ eko amɛye; shi ekɛɛɛ amɛ akɛ jata gbonyo lɛ musuŋ ejie wo lɛ yɛ.
Etsɛ yiŋ etee ni eyana yoo lɛ; ni Samson ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ nakai oblahii lɛ feɔ.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛyaŋɔ oblahii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛbafata ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibagba nyɛ ajenu ko.
Kɛ nyɛaanyɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nɛkɛ gbii kpawo ni akɛŋmɛɔ ayɛmforo okplɔ̃ nɛɛ mli, ni nyɛaana nɔ ni ji lɛ, no lɛ mibahã nyɛ shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ mi shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbaahã mi shikpɔŋ boi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ hewulamɔ atadei hu nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gba ojenu lɛ ni wɔbo toi.” Kɛkɛ ni Samson kɛɛ akɛ, “Niyenii jɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ mli; Ŋɔɔmɔ jɛ hewalɔ lɛ mli.” Gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ baho ni amɛnyɛko ajenu lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ Samson ŋã lɛ akɛ, “Lakamɔ owu lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bo ajenu lɛ shishi; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔɔshã bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ.
Aso nyɛkpee wɔ kɛba biɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃ wɔdɛŋ nii?” Kɛkɛ ni Samson ŋã lɛ fo wo lɛ ni ekɛɛ: “Onyɛɔ mi; osumɔɔɔ mi.
Ogba mijakubii ajenu, shi otsɔ̃ɔɔ mi shishi.” Shi Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ; “Mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ tete po mitsɔ̃ko amɛ shishi, ni bo mibatsɔ̃ɔ lo?” Yoo lɛ fo wo Samson gbii kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ni aŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ; ni gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ Samson tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋã lɛ miiye etsui.
Kɛkɛ ni eŋã lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ ejakubii lɛ ajenu lɛ shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, hulu nako anyɔ shi ni maŋ lɛ mli hii lɛ kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Mɛni ŋɔɔ fe wo?
Mɛni he wa fe jata?” Samson hã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mitsina oblayoo lɛ huuu jikulɛ Nyɛnaŋ mijenu lɛ shishi.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã mumɔ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kpele.
Eyiŋ etee Ashkelon, ni eyagbe maŋ lɛ mli hii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Ejie amɛhe nibii, ni ekɛ hewulamɔ atadei lɛ yahã mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ ajenu lɛ shishi lɛ.
Samson mli fu waa ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee etsɛ we lɛ.
Ni akɛ eŋã lɛ hã enaanyo ni ekɛbɔɔ.
Be fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ, Samson hiɛ abotiabi kɛtee eyaasara eŋã lɛ yɛ ŋmãakuu be lɛ mli.
Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Matee miŋã ŋɔɔ yɛ sɛɛtsu lɛ mli.” Shi eŋã lɛ tsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ ni eya tsu lɛ mli.
Ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Anɔkwale mli lɛ, misusu akɛ osumɔɔɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ hã onaanyo lɛ.
Bɛ enyɛmi gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo fe lɛ?
Ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ enajiaŋ.” Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛji mifee Filistibii lɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛsɔ̃ ko wulaaa miyiteŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Samson yiŋ etee, ni eyamɔmɔ osɔi ohai etɛ̃, ni ekɔlɔ kɔtii.
Ekɛ osɔi lɛ aleii tsara enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ekɛ kɔti wo lei kɛ lei tsamɔhe lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni ema kɔtii lɛ anaa la, ni eŋmɛɛ osɔi lɛ ahe ewo Filistibii lɛ aŋmãa ni mamɔ shi lɛ mli, ni Samson shã ŋmãa kei lɛ kɛ ŋmãa ni mamɔ shi kɛ mutsei abɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Filistibii lɛ bi akɛ, “Namɔ po ni fee enɛ?” Akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Samson, Timnanyo lɛ shaanuu lɛ, ni, ejaakɛ eshaanuu lɛ eŋɔ eŋã lɛ ehã Samson naanyo lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyashã yoo lɛ kɛ etsɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Samson kɛɛ Filistibii lɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛfee nɛ?
Mina mitsɛ nane akɛ ja mitɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛnɔ dani mafɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni etswia amɛgbeji kɛ amɛshuɔji anii ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni eyiŋ etee eyahi tɛkplo ko mli yɛ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli.
Samson ye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim Filistibii lɛ ba amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Yuda, ni amɛyatua Lehi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda hii lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfã kɛba wɔnɔ nɛɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Samson fĩi wɔba nɛɛ, koni bɔ ni efee wɔ lɛ, wɔfee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda hii akpei etɛ̃ yiŋ amɛtee tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Etam tɛsaa lɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛyakɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Ani oleee akɛ Filistibii lɛ amɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni yeɔ wɔnɔ lo?
Hewɔ lɛ, mɛni ofee wɔ nɛɛ?” Eto he akɛ, “Bɔ ni amɛfee mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mifee amɛ lɛ.” Yuda hii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo fĩi wɔba nɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ bo ayawo Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.” Samson kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkãa mi kitã akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbeŋ mi.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabi, fĩi kɛkɛ wɔbaafĩ bo, koni wɔkɛ bo ayawo amɛdɛŋ; shi gbee lɛ wɔgbeŋ bo.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfĩ lɛ kɛ taŋkpei hei enyɔ, ni amɛ jie lɛ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛ mli kɛje kpo.
Be ni eshɛ Lehi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ bɔ oshe amɛkɛ lɛ bakpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bayi Samson nɔ kɛ hewalɛ kpele, ni taŋkpei lɛ ni yɔɔ eniji lɛ tsɔmɔ tamɔ odonti ni akɛ la esa he, ni taŋkpei lɛ tserɛ yɛ eniji.
Kɛkɛ ni ena teji kadaa ŋmɔŋ ko.
Ekpã enine mli ekɔ, ni ekɛgbe hii akpe.
No hewɔ lɛ, Samson kɛɛ: “Teji kadaa mikɛgbe amɛ mibua shi; gbohii jwere gbohii anɔ, Teji kadaa mikɛgbe hii akpe.” Be ni ewie egbe naa lɛ, eshɛ kadaa ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ lɛ efɔ̃; ni awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Ramat-Lehi.
Kɛkɛ ni kumai ye Samson waa naakpa.
Ebo etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, “Otsɔ̃ otsulɔ nine nɔ otsu yiwalaheremɔ nitsumɔ kpele nɛɛ; ni mɛɛba ni magbo kɛ kumai moŋ ni magbee foolɔi nɛɛ adɛŋ?” Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko ni enyɔ yɛ Lehi lɛ gba, ni nu tue kɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson nu.
Ni be ni enu nu lɛ emumɔ ku esɛɛ eba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ En-Hakoree.
Eyɛ Lehi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ be ni Filistibii yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.
Samson yɛ Gaza Samson yiŋ etee Filistibii amaŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gaza lɛ mli.
Eyana yoo ajwamãŋ ko yɛ jɛi, ni etee eyawɔ eŋɔɔ.
Ayagba Gazabii lɛ akɛ, “Samson eba biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛsa eyi, ni amɛwo lɛ ka nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Amɛsɛ̃ koniŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ: “Nyɛhãa wɔmɛa kɛyashi je aaatsɛre koni wɔgbe lɛ.” Shi Samson kã shi kɛyashi nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni ete shi nyɔɔŋ te lɛ mli.
Emɔmɔ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ shinai lɛ kɛ shinaatsei enyɔ lɛ amli, ni efã kɛ esɛɛlaa adabaŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛtswa ekɔŋ, ni etere kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ Hebron hiɛ lɛ yiteŋ.
Samson kɛ Delila Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Samson tsui mɔ yoo ko yɛ Sorek jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Egbɛi ji Delila.
Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba Delila ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lakamɔ lɛ ni ona nɔ mli ni ehewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔɔnyɛ lɛ wɔmɔ koni wɔfĩ lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ ehe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaahã bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha.” No hewɔ lɛ, Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo ni anyɛ ohe ajɔɔ.” Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji amɛkɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo fĩ mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ kɛ kpãi hei ŋmɔji kawekawee kpawo bahã Delila, ni ekɛfĩ Samson.
Shi Delila yɛ mɛi ni ewo antɛo yɛ pia lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ kpãi lɛ amli tamɔ anaanu kpãa hwiãa tseɔ kɛ esa la he lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Samson hewalɛ lɛ teemɔŋ sane lɛ ejeee kpo.
Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Naa, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ nɛɛ, ni olaka mi.
Ofainɛ, agbɛnɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo.” Samson kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji amɛkɛ taŋkpee kpãi hei ni akɛtsuko nɔ ko dã fĩ mi lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Delila ŋɔ taŋkpee kpãi hei ekɛfĩ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ!” Shi mɛi ni ewo antɛo lɛ yɛ pia lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson tserɛ taŋkpee kpãi lɛ yɛ eniji oookɛɛ kpãa hwiãa ko kɛkɛ ni.
Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ, mihe fɛo sɔŋŋ oyeɔ, ni olakaa mi.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni aaafee afĩ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ Delila akɛ, “Kɛji omɔmɔ miyitsɔi akuklu kpawo lɛ ofĩ, ni okɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ lɛ, no dani magbɔjɔ, ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Samson ewɔ lɛ, Delila mɔmɔ Samson, yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ efĩ, ni ekɛ piŋ mɔ lɛ kpɛŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Shi Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli, ni efã piŋ lɛ yɛ eyitsɔi lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, Delila kɛɛ Samson akɛ, “Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ oosumɔ mi be ni otsui bɛ mihe lɛ?
Shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ nɛ ni olakaa mi, ni otsɔ̃ko mi nɔ mli ni ohewalɛ kpele lɛ yɔɔ.” Bɔ ni Delila yeɔ Samson tsui sɔŋŋ daa gbi kɛ ewiemɔi lɛ, ni ehiɛ Samson doo lɛ, ehã jeŋshihilɛ po je Samson tsine.
No hewɔ lɛ, egba Delila eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Asooyi naa esako miyiteŋ pɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe.
Kɛji ashɛ miyi lɛ, no dani mihewalɛ lɛ aaaje mimli, ni magbɔjɔ ni matamɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ.” Be ni Delila na akɛ Samson egba lɛ eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ lɛ, etsu koni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛba; ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa shi kome nɛɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba mi eyitsoŋ sane fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii alumɛi lɛ ba.
Amɛhiɛ shika lɛ kɛba.
Delila wɔle Samson be ni Samson yitso kã enakutsei anɔ.
Etsɛ nuu ko, ehã ebashɛ Samson yitsɔi akuklui kpawo lɛ, ni ehewalɛ lɛ je emli.
Kɛkɛ ni Delila kɛɛ “Samson, Filistibii lɛ eshwie onɔ.” Samson hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ ewɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Maje kpo tamɔ tsutsu lɛ ni mahoso mihe.” Shi eleee akɛ Yehowa ekpa yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ mɔ lɛ ni amɛfamɔ ehiŋmɛii.
Amɛkɛ lɛ tee Gaza.
Amɛkɛ akɔɔble gboklɛi enyɔ wo lɛ, ni amɛhãa ewiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli.
Shi eyitsɔi ni ashɛ lɛ, bɔ̃i tsaa ekoŋŋ.
Samson gbele Eba mli akɛ Filistibii alumɛi lɛ babua amɛhe naa koni amɛshã afɔle kpele amɛhã amɛnyɔŋmɔ Dagon lɛ, koni amɛnya, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye wɔhenyɛlɔ Samson lɛ nɔ kunim.” Be ni Filistibii lɛ na Samson lɛ, amɛ jie amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔhenyɛlɔ ni ekpãtã wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni egbegbee wɔteŋ mɛi babaoo lɛ, wɔnyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehã wɔye enɔ kunim.” Be ni amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa Samson kɛbaa ni ebajie wɔhiɛtserɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyatsɛ Samson yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli, koni ebajie amɛhiɛtserɛ.
Amɛhã edamɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ateŋ.
Samson kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ enineshi lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛ̃ɛ mi gbɛ ni matara akulashiŋi ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ ahe makwɛ, ni makpasa amɛ.” Agbɛnɛ shĩa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ hii kɛ yei.
Filistibii alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ jɛi; ni hii kɛ yei aaafee akpei etɛ̃ yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ amɛmiikwɛ bɔ ni Samson jieɔ mɛi ahiɛtserɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samson tsɛ Yehowa ni ekɛɛ, “Ao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai, kaimɔ mi ni ohã mi hewalɛ shi kome nɛɛ kɛkɛ.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã matɔ mihiŋmɛii enyɔ nɛɛ he owele shi kome yɛ Filistibii lɛ anɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Samson mɔmɔ teŋ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ni tsu lɛ ma nɔ lɛ mli; ekɛ eninejurɔ mɔ ekome mli, ni ekɛ ebɛku hu mɔ ekome mli.
Ekɛ etsiimɔ ŋmɛ amɛnɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Hã mi kɛ Filistibii lɛ agboi.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsi akulashiŋi lɛ, ni shĩa lɛ wule shwie lumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni Samson gbe yɛ egbele mli lɛ ayi fa fe mɛi ni egbe be ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyawo lɛ.
Amɛkɛ lɛ ba amɛbafu lɛ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol teŋ yɛ etsɛ Manoa fuuhe lɛ.
Samson nyiɛ Israel hiɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Mika wɔji lɛ Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mika hi shi yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kome kɛ oha lɛ ni awo yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, nɔ ni olomɔ yɛ he ni owie he hu yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, naa, eyɛ midɛŋ; mi miwo.” Enyɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo mibi.” Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe kɛ oha lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ kɛɛ, “Mijie jwiɛtɛi nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ, ni mijɔɔ nɔ mihã Yehowa yɛ mibi lɛ hewɔ; akɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; enɛ hewɔ lɛ mikɛmiiku sɛɛ mahã bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ ku sɛɛ hã enyɛ.
Enyɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli kukuji ohai enyɔ hã nishwielɔ, koni ekɛfee amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ nɔ ni ashwie; ni akɛba Mika we lɛ.
Nuu Mika nɛɛ yɛ he ko ni ejaa yɛ.
Efee amãgã ni akɛgbaa kɛ wɔji; ni ewo ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome osɔfo koni eye osɔfo ehã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni sa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ.
Ejɛ Yuda weku lɛ mli; Levinyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Betlehem.
Oblanyo nɛɛ fã yɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ koni eyahi he fɛɛ he ni eeena.
Egbɛfãa lɛ mli lɛ, eyaje Mika we lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Mika bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?” Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Levinyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ.
Miiya miyahi he fɛɛ he ni mina.” Mika kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ mi abahi shi ni otsɔ̃ ŋaawolɔ kɛ osɔfo ohã mi.
Daa afi naakplɔ lɛ, mahã bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ atade kɛ oniyenii.” Levinyo lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ Mika aaahi shi, ni ekɛ Mika hi shi tamɔ ebihii lɛ eko.
Mika wo oblanyo lɛ osɔfo, ni oblanyo lɛ tsɔ̃ Mika osɔfo, ni ehi Mika we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, “Kpaako mina mile akɛ Yehowa baahã mashwere, ejaakɛ mina Levinyo akɛ osɔfo.”
Mika kɛ Dan akutso lɛ Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel.
Nakai be lɛ mli hu lɛ Dan akutso lɛ miitao amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ko amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛyahi nɔ; ejaakɛ kɛbashi nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛnako amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Danbii lɛ tsu hii kãkãlɔi enumɔ kɛjɛ amɛweku lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol, koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ shi.
Amɛkɛɛ mɛi ni atsu lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakpaa shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ shi.” Amɛba Mika shĩa lɛ yɛ Efraim gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbawɔ jɛi.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Mika shĩa lɛ, oblanyo lɛ wiemɔ hã amɛyoo akɛ Levinyo ji lɛ.
Amɛgba kɛtee shĩa lɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ kɛ bo ba biɛ?
Mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ?
Mɛni otsuɔ yɛ biɛ?” Oblanyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Mika kɛ mi eye efua, ni ebɔ mi apaa koni maye osɔfo mahã lɛ.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni obi Nyɔŋmɔ ohã wɔ bɔ ni afee ni wɔle akɛ wɔgbɛ ni wɔnyiɛ nɛɛ aaafee omanye lo?” Osɔfo lɛ to he hã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa kɛ omanye.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã nyɛhe yɛ gbɛ ni nyɛnyiɛ nɛɛ mli!” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ kɛshwie nɔ kɛtee Laish.
Amɛna jɛibii lɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ shweshweeshwe amɛhã, tamɔ Sidonbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ kpoo ni amɛyiŋ efeee amɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ mɔ ko he lɛ.
Nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni he hiaa amɛ; niiatsɛmɛi ji amɛ.
Amɛkɛ Sidonbii lɛ ateŋ jɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ sharamɔ.
Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛyana tɛŋŋ?” Mɛi ni atsu lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛtea shi ni wɔyaa wɔyatua amɛ, ejaakɛ wɔyana shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ehi naakpa.
Mɛni nyɛtara shi nyɛfeɔ?
Nyɛkashashaoa shi kwraa ni nyɛya nyɛyaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛfea nyɛnɔ.
Kɛ nyɛtee lɛ, nyɛbaaya nyɛyanina gbɔmɛi ni kwɛɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ko gbɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni da ni.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã nyɛ.
Eji he ko ni shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nibii fɛɛ mli ekoeko he bɛ ona yɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni hii ohai ekpaa ni jɛ Danbii aweku lɛ mli ni emia kɛ tawuunii fã kɛjɛ Zora kɛ Eshtaol, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyabɔ nsra yɛ Kiriat-Yearim yɛ Yuda.
No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Dan Shitoohe kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Eyɛ Kiriat-Yearim anaigbɛ.
Amɛfo mli yɛ jɛi kɛtee Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛba Mika shĩa lɛ masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni hii enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasara Laish shikpɔŋ lɛ bi amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛle akɛ shĩai nɛɛ ateŋ eko mli lɛ efod kɛ wɔji kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie yɛ mli lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ ni nyɛaafee.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgba jɛi; ni amɛba Levinyo oblanyo lɛ shĩa ni ji Mika shĩa lɛ, Amɛŋã oblanyo lɛ.
Ni Danbii mɛi ohai ekpaa lɛ ni emia kɛ amɛtawuu nii lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa.
Ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ ni tee yasara shikpɔŋ lɛ bote shĩa lɛ mli ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
Be ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ bote Mika shĩa lɛ ni amɛyahole amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ kɛ efod lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ amãgã ni ashwie lɛ, osɔfo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ diŋŋ; okɛ onine ato onaabu, ni obaho ni wɔtee koni oyatsɔ̃ wɔŋaawolɔ kɛ wɔsɔfo.
Te emli nɔ ni hi hã bo lɛ, akɛ oooye osɔfo ohã gbɔmɔ kome we aloo akɛ oooye ohã Israel muu fɛɛ?” Sane lɛ ŋɔɔ osɔfo lɛ naa.
Ehole amãgã ni akɛgbaa lɛ kɛ wɔji lɛ kɛ efod ni akpɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba mɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
Amɛhã gbekɛbii lɛ kɛ shĩa kooloi lɛ kɛ nibii lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛgbɛ.
Be ni amɛkɛ Mika shĩai lɛ teŋ gbɛ ejekɛ lɛ, abo atsɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shĩai ni bɛŋkɛ Mika shĩa lɛ amli lɛ, ni amɛtiu Danbii lɛ.
Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Danbii lɛ ayisɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbi Mika akɛ, “Mɛni feɔ bo hewɔ ni okɛ gbɔmɛi babaoo baa nɛɛ?” Mika to he akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔ minyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni mifee lɛ kɛ osɔfo lɛ, kɛmiiya; mɛni eshwɛ mi dɔŋŋ?
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛbiɔ mi akɛ, ‘Mɛni feɔ bo’ lɛ?” Danbii lɛ kɛɛ Mika akɛ, “Kaahã anu ogbee yɛ wɔteŋ ni mlilatsɛmɛi nɛɛ miitsɛ̃ kɛmiiba onɔ ni amɛbakpãtã bo kɛ owe lɛ mli bii ahiɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Danbii lɛ kɛshwie nɔ.
Be ni Mika na akɛ amɛhe wa fe lɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee eshĩa.
Danbii lɛ ŋɔ nibii ni Mika efee lɛ kɛ esɔfo lɛ, ni amɛtee Laish.
Emli bii lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ kpoo ni amɛkwɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko gbɛ ji amɛ; shi Danbii lɛ kɛ klante gbe amɛ ni amɛshã maŋ lɛ.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni hereɔ Laishbii lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ Sidon jɛkɛ ni amɛ Laishbii lɛ, amɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ.
Laish maŋ lɛ kã Bet-Rehob jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Danbii lɛ saa to maŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi mli.
Amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Dan ni ji Yakob bi lɛ gbɛi Dan lɛ wo maŋ lɛ.
Shi sa lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Laish.
Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ lɛ ma shi hã amɛhe.
Yonatan, Mose bi Gershom bi lɛ, kɛ ebihii lɛ ye osɔfo hã Dan akutso lɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nom lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Danbii lɛ kɛ amãgã ni akpɛ ni Mika fee lɛ ma shi hã amɛhe gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ yɔɔ Shilo lɛ.
Levinyo ko kɛ ehemɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli be ni maŋtsɛ bɛ Israel lɛ, Levinyo ko yato gbɔ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ he ko shɔŋŋ.
Ekɛ yoo ko ni jɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda lɛ fee hemɔ.
Shi yoo lɛ mlifu nuu lɛ ni eshi nuu lɛ etee etsɛ we yɛ Betlehem Yuda, ni eyaye nyɔji ejwɛ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ yiŋ etee koni eyatiu esɛɛ ni ekɛ lɛ awie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa koni ekpala lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ.
Nuu lɛ kɛ etsulɔ kɛ tejii enyɔ tee.
Be ni Levinyo lɛ yashɛ yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ we lɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ na lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Shaanuu lɛ tsĩ Levinyo lɛ naa, ni Levinyo lɛ kɛ shaanuu lɛ hi shi gbii etɛ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko ni amɛhi shi yɛ jɛi.
Gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni Levinyo lɛ miitao eyi mli, kɛkɛ ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ aboloo atrɔma kome ko asa onaa koni no sɛɛ dani nyɛyi mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, hii enyɔ lɛ ho amɛtara shi, ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko.
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshaanuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ ni owɔ biɛ ŋmɛnɛ hu ni omii ashɛ ohe!” Be ni nuu lɛ te shi ni ebaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ tsĩ enaa, ni ewɔ jɛi ekoŋŋ.
Gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nuu lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa ni ebaaya, kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wo onaa nɔ ko dã.
Hii shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi.” No hewɔ lɛ, shaahiimɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ye nii.
Be ni nuu lɛ kɛ ehemɔ lɛ kɛ etsulɔ lɛ te shi ni amɛbaayi mli lɛ, eshaanuu lɛ ni ji yoo lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amrɔ nɛɛ, je ena etã, nyɛwɔa; duŋ baawo nɔŋŋ.
Wɔ biɛ ni omii ashɛ ohe, koni nyɛte shi maŋkɛ mra ni nyɛyi mli, ni oya omaŋ.” Shi nuu lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni ewɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ete shi ni eyi mli.
Ebɛŋkɛ Yebus ni ji Yerusalɛm ŋlɛnɔ.
Ekɛ ehemɔ lɛ nyiɛ kɛ tejii enyɔ ni awo amɛnɔ nii.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yebus lɛ, je ena etã.
No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni wɔgba kɛya Yebusbii amaŋ nɛɛ mli ni wɔyawɔ jɛi.” -Shi enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔgbaŋ kɛyaŋ mɛi kpɔji amaŋ ko mli, maŋ ni jeee Israelbii amaŋ.
Shi moŋ wɔbaafoŋ kɛya Gibea.” Ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsi wɔshɛ wɔhiɛgbɛ he ko ni wɔyawɔ Gibea loo Rama.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfoŋ kɛtee amɛhiɛ.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Gibea ni ji Benyaminbii amaŋ lɛ lɛ, hulu nyɔ shi wo amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgba Gibea koni amɛyawɔ jɛi.
Be ni amɛshɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Levinyo lɛ ho eta maŋ lɛ blohuŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ amɛ kɛyaaa eshĩa koni amɛyawɔ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa nuumo ko ni eyatsu nii yɛ eŋmɔ mli ni eku esɛɛ eeba gbɛkɛnaashi mli.
Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ nyo ji lɛ, ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ mli.
Gibeabii lɛ Benyaminbii ni.
Be ni nuumo lɛ yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena nuu gbɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ yɛ blohu lɛ mli.
Nuumo lɛ bi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyaa, ni nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Levinyo lɛ to he akɛ, “Wɔjɛ Betlehem ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ; wɔmiifo mli kɛya Efraim gɔji lɛ asɛɛgbɛ shɔŋŋ.
Efraimnyo ji mi.
Mitee Betlehem yɛ Yuda, shi mimaŋ miyaa nɛɛ; ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ mi kɛyaaa eshĩa.
Shi wɔyɛ jwɛi kɛ niyenii hã wɔtejii lɛ, ni aboloo hu yɛ hã mi kɛ oblayoo lɛ kɛ oblanyo lɛ ni fata wɔhe lɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehĩaaa wɔ.” Nuumo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Oba kɛ omanye.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he aaahia bo lɛ, mahã bo; blohu lɛ mli kɛkɛ ni okawɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, nuumo lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee eshĩa.
Ehã tejii lɛ anii.
Gbɔi lɛ fɔfɔɔ amɛnaji ahe; ni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nɔ ko.
Shi be ni amɛmii eshɛ amɛhe lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli bii komɛi ni ji hii yakagbɔmɛi babɔle shĩa lɛ kɛkpe.
Amɛshimɔ shinaa lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ shĩatsɛ ni ji nuumo lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ nuu lɛ ni bato oshĩa lɛ aje kpo kɛba ni wɔkɛ lɛ awɔ.” Shi nuumo lɛ ni ji shĩatsɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Dabida, minyɛmimɛi!
Nyɛkafea efɔŋ ni tamɔ enɛ; akɛni nuu nɛɛ ebato mishĩa nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛkafea nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ.
Naa, mibi oblayoo foro kɛ nuu lɛ hu hemɔ.
Mikɛ amɛ moŋ baaje kpo kɛba ni nyɛfite amɛ ni nyɛfee amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; shi nuu nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkafea lɛ nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ.” Shi hii lɛ booo lɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Levinyo lɛ ŋɔ ehemɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ je kpo kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ blohu lɛ mli.
Amɛnyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛ lɛ wɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ niseniianii nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni be ni je bɔi tsɛremɔ lɛ, amɛŋmɛ̃ɛ ehe.
Hiɛfutɛfutɛ mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ba ni ebaho ebu shi yɛ nuumo lɛ shĩa lɛ he ni ewu lɛ yɔɔ lɛ shinaa lɛ shi kɛyashi be ni hiɛ gbele.
Be ni ewu lɛ te shi leebi ni egbele shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ ni ebaaje kpo eya lɛ, naa yoo lɛ ni ji ehemɔ lɛ bu shi yɛ shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi, ni eniji jwere kpoku lɛ nɔ.
Ewu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni wɔtee” shi fɛɛ lɛ kranaa.
Kɛkɛ ni ewu lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ eŋmɛ eteji lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛshwie nɔ kɛtee emaŋ.
Be ni eshɛ ewe lɛ, ekɔ kakla, ni emɔ ehemɔ lɛ mli, ni efolɔ emli yɛ etalɔi lɛ anɔ kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ehã akɛtee akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amli akɛyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Afeko nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã ni asaŋ anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko dã kɛjɛ gbi ni Israelbii jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Nyɛsusua he, nyɛwoa he ŋaa, nyɛwiea he.”
Israel saa ehe hã ta Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan yɛ kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi Beersheba yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ fã kɛba.
Amɛbabua amɛhe naa amɛfee asafo kpele kome yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa.
Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli onukpai lɛ badamɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Asafo lɛ yibɔ ji, hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ, mɛi akpei ohai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ ni le tawuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ nu he akɛ Israelbii lɛ efã kɛtee Mizpa.
Agbɛnɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ bɔ ni fee ni aye nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ.” Levinyo lɛ ni ji yoo ni agbe lɛ wu lɛ hã hetoo ni ekɛɛ, “Mikɛ mihemɔ ba Benyaminbii amaŋ ni ji Gibea koni wɔbawɔ jɛi.
Gibea hii lɛ te shi wo mi, ni amɛgba nyɔɔŋ amɛbɔle shĩa ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe.
Amɛgbɔnyɔ mihemɔ lɛ aahu ni egbo.
Miwo mihemɔ lɛ, ni mifolɔ emli dukuduku ni mikɛmaje Israelbii ashikpɔŋ ni ji amɛgboshinii lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ Benyaminbii ebɔ musu ni amɛfee hiɛgbejianii yɛ Israel.
Naa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ nɛ.
Mɛni nyɛkɛɔ; nyɛwoa he ŋaa!” Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi damɔ shi tamɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ebuu mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ ko ekuŋ esɛɛ eyaŋ eshĩa.
Shi nɔ ni wɔbaafee ji akɛ wɔbaafɔ̃ oshiki koni wɔkɛna bɔ ni wɔbaatua lɛ wɔhã.
Wɔbaajie hii nyɔŋma yɛ mɛi oha fɛɛ oha mli, hii oha yɛ akpe fɛɛ akpe mli, hii akpe yɛ akpei nyɔŋma fɛɛ akpei nyɔŋma mli kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli koni amɛyaŋɔ niyenii amɛbahã maŋ lɛ.
Ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaya amɛyagbala Gibeabii atoi yɛ hiɛgbejianii ni amɛtsu yɛ Israel lɛ hewɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ fĩ tɔo, ni amɛfee jwɛŋmɔ kome amɛwo Gibea maŋ lɛ.
Israel akutsei lɛ tsu mɛi kɛtee Benyamin akutso muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ yiŋsha sane pam aye yɛ nyɛteŋ nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛjiea hii, yakagbɔmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Gibea lɛ kɛbaa, koni wɔgbea amɛ ni wɔkɛjie nɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ Israel.” Shi Benyaminbii lɛ booo amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ atoi.
Shi moŋ amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛjɛ maji lɛ amli kɛtee Gibea, koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu.
Nakai gbi lɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bua hii tawulɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa naa kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli; esoro hii ohai kpawo ni jɛ Gibea ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ.
Hii abɛkulɔi ji amɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɛɔ yitsɔi gaŋŋ kome akromia efɔ̃ɔ ni eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ.
Kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ bɛ mli lɛ, Israel tabilɔi lɛ anaa shiɔ hii akpei ohai ejwɛ ni emĩa kɛ klante; ni atsɔse amɛ jogbaŋŋ hã tawuu.
Ta ni afã ashi Benyaminbii lɛ Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel, ni amɛyabi Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ŋaawoo akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ tsutsu afã kɛya ni ekɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu?” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yuda tsutsu afã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi leebi ni amɛyabɔ nsra amɛwo Gibea.
Amɛfã kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu.
Israelbii lɛ gba ta wo Benyaminbii lɛ yɛ Gibea.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ fã kpo kɛjɛ Gibea, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ahiɛ kɛmɔ shi kwraa nakai gbi lɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ na ekãa, ni amɛgba ta lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ he ni amɛgba yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee ni amɛyafo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ, ni amɛbi Yehowa nii akɛ, “Ani wɔtsi wɔbɛŋkɛ ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi, Benyaminbii lɛ, ayawu?” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfãa ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ayawua.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Benyaminbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Gibea gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpãtã Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ni ji ta muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel ni amɛyafo.
Amɛho amɛtara shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛhi ŋmãa nakai gbi lɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Amɛshãshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ji Finehas, Aaron bi Eleazar bi lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ bi Yehowa akɛ, “Ani wɔfã ekoŋŋ ni wɔkɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ ayawu aloo wɔfɔ̃ɔ?” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛfãa kɛyaa, ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛye amɛnɔ kunim.” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ to kawolɔi kɛbɔle Gibea kɛkpe.
Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fã kɛyanina Benyaminbii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛgba ta amɛwo Gibea tamɔ tsutsu lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ fã kpo kɛbanina Israelbii lɛ.
Agbala Benyaminbii lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã kɛyaa Betel kɛ nɔ ni kã kɛyaa Gibea yɛ ŋã lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛgbe Israel hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Benyaminbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Wɔgbɛ amɛta lɛ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ nɔŋŋ.” Shi Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔjoa foi ni wɔkɛgbala amɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ fɛɛ tetee shi yɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ ni amɛyagba ta yɛ Baal-Tamar.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii ni ewo ka lɛ fãfãa kpo kɛjɛ amɛgbɛhei lɛ yɛ Gibea anaigbɛ; ni hii akpei nyɔŋma ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ kɛjɛ Israel fɛɛ lɛ te shi wo Gibea.
Ta lɛ mli bawa po ni ehiii; shi Benyaminbii lɛ leee akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ etã.
Yehowa hã Israelbii lɛ ye amɛnɔ kunim.
Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãtã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ oha hiɛ; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii tawulɔi sɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ na faŋŋ akɛ aye amɛnɔ.
Bɔ ni Israelbii fee ye kunim Akɛni Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kã mɛi ni amɛhã amɛwo ka kɛbɔle Gibea lɛ anɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ amɛhã Benyaminbii lɛ.
Hii ni ewo ka lɛ he fee oya, ni amɛtsɛ̃ kɛba Gibea nɔ.
Amɛgba amɛyi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ klante gbe maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi okadi ni Israel hii lɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ eto yɛ amɛteŋ ji akɛ kɛ kawolɔi lɛ na lasu te shi kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli akɛ okadi lɛ, Israelbii lɛ adɔ amɛyi kɛjɛ ta lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ebɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ ateŋ hii aaafee nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ nitswiamɔ kɛ amɛgbee, ni amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnine etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ba yɛ tsutsu ta lɛ mli lɛ.” Shi be ni lasu kutuu lɛ bɔ̃i shitee kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ ŋwɛiyaa lɛ, Benyaminbii lɛ kwɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛna akɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miitso kɛmiiya ŋwɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel hii lɛ dɔ amɛhe.
Ŋmiŋmi mɔ Benyamin hii lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ sane fɔŋ eye amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛ̃hã Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ; shi ta lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fã nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛbote Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛgbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ sa Benyaminbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyiɛ Benyaminbii lɛ asɛɛ kɛyashi Noha.
Amɛnaanaa Benyaminbii lɛ anɔ aahu kɛyashi Gibea ŋlɛnɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ hii akpei nyɔŋma-kɛ-kpaanyɔ nyɔnyɔɔi; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.
Mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛyaa Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he gbɛ lɛ.
Agbe amɛteŋ hii akpei enumɔ yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ; anyiɛ amɛsɛɛ waa kɛtee Gidom, ni asaa agbe amɛteŋ hii akpei enyɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɔ nakai gbi lɛ yɛ Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ ji hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ tawulɔi kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ni.
Shi hii ohai ekpaa pɛ tse yɛ ta lɛ naa, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee ŋã lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛtee Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he.
Amɛhi jɛi nyɔji ejwɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo Benyaminbii krokomɛi lɛ.
Amɛkɛ klante gbegbee Benyaminbii lɛ; amɛgbe gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli kɛ kooloi fɛɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baje amɛgbɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyanina lɛ, amɛmamɔ fɛɛ naa la.
Ŋamɛi ni Benyamin akutso lɛ na Agbɛnɛ Israel hii lɛ ekãmɔ kitãi yɛ Mizpa akɛ, “Wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ebiyoo akahã Benyaminnyo gbãlã.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Betel.
Amɛhi shi yɛ jɛi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ.
Amɛfo waa kɛ dɔlɛ amɛkɛɛ: “Ao Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba enɛ ba yɛ Israel akɛ ŋmɛnɛ akutso kome elaaje yɛ Israel?” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ te shi maŋkɛ mra, ni amɛma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛshã shãa afɔlei kɛ hejɔlɛ afɔlei.
Israelbii lɛ bi akɛ, “Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ, te akutso ni fataaa Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he kɛbaaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ amɛkã kitã wulu akɛ mɔ ni baaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ, ‘Gbe agbe lɛ.’ ” Benyaminhii lɛ anii fee amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ atse akutso kome yɛ Israel he ashɛ afɔ̃.
Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ hu ni wɔna ŋamɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni wɔkã Yehowa kitã akɛ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei haŋ Benyaminbii gbãlã nɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛɛ, “Te Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni lɛ lɛ ebɛ mli ni atee Yehowa ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa lɛ?” Ana akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko jɛɛɛ Yabesh ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ baaa nsra lɛ mli kɛ kpee wulu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni akane maŋ lɛ, ana akɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ folo bɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, kpee lɛ tsu hii ni feɔ ekãa fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni amɛfã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ kɛ klante, yei kɛ hii fɛɛ hu.
Bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ: Hii fɛɛ kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo ni le nuu lɛ, nyɛkpãtãa amɛhiɛ butubutu.” Mɛi ni atsu lɛ yana oblayei froi ohai ejwɛ yɛ Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ ateŋ ni leko nuu, ni amɛkɛ oblayei nɛɛ ba nsra lɛ mli yɛ Shilo ni yɔɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni kpee muu lɛ fɛɛ tsu akɛ wiemɔ yahã Benyaminbii ni yɔɔ Rimon tɛsaa lɛ he lɛ akɛ akɛ amɛ ekpãtã.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛba nakai be lɛ mli, ni akɛ yei ni ahere amɛyiwala yɛ Yabesh-Gilead yei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã amɛ gbãlã; shi no tete lɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛ.
Benyaminbii lɛ anii fee maŋ lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã mligbalamɔ eba Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kpee lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛɛ, “Te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔna ŋamɛi wɔhã mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, akɛni akpãtã Benyamin yei lɛ ahiɛ nɛɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Esa akɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko ahi shi ahã Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni yi na wala lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akutso ko seshi akabule yɛ Israel.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ wɔbiyei lɛ ahã amɛ gbãlã, ejaakɛ Israelbii ekã kitã akɛ, ‘Alomɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ yoo ko ahã gbãlã yɛ Benyamin.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ: “Daa afi lɛ ayeɔ Yehowa gbijurɔ yɛ Shilo.
Shilo kã Betel kooyigbɛ kɛ Lebona wuoyigbɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni kã kɛjɛ Betel kɛyaa Shekem lɛ bokãgbɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfã Benyaminbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyatea yɛ waintromi lɛ amli.
Kɛji Shilo oblayei lɛ je kpo ba amɛbajo lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛfãa kpo kɛjɛa waintromi lɛ amli kɛbaa koni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abamɔ eŋã yɛ Shilo oblayei lɛ ateŋ, koni nyɛkɛ amɛ aya Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni kɛji amɛtsɛmɛi loo amɛnyɛmimɛi ba nyɛŋɔɔ amɛkɛ nyɛ babe lɛ, nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkwɛa wɔhewɔ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ ahãa wɔ; ejaakɛ jeee ta mli wɔshɔ̃ amɛ yɛ, yɛ nyɛdɛŋ koni wɔkɛ amɛ afee wɔŋamɛi; ni asaŋ jeee nyɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ hã wɔ ni eeeba lɛ akɛ nyɛaatere wɔyi sɔ̃ ko.’ ” Benyaminbii lɛ fee nakai.
Amɛmɔmɔ ŋamɛi yɛ amɛyikulɛ naa yɛ mɛi ni bajo lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Amɛsaa maji lɛ amɛmamɔ, ni amɛhi mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hu shi jɛi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ku esɛɛ kɛtee ekutso kɛ eweku mli, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Israel; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ feɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Rut wolo ni gbaa wɔ hejɔlɛ be mli sane lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Hiɛnyiɛlɔi aloo Kojolɔi lɛ abe mli.
Be nɛɛ mli eyi obɔ kɛ haomɔ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Rut ni ji Moabyoo lɛ kɛ Israelnyo ko hi shi.
Be ni Rut wu lɛ gbo lɛ ejie suɔmɔ kple ko kpo etsɔɔ eshaayoo Naomi.
Ni eŋɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ etsui fɛɛ.
Naagbee lɛ ena wu yɛ ewu ni gbo lɛ wekumɛi ateŋ.
Ni kɛtsɔ nɛkɛ gbala nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Rut tsɔ Israelbii amaŋtsɛ kpanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ David lɛ nanakansowa.
Kojolɔi Awolo lɛ mli saji lɛ gbaa wɔ jaramɔ ni baa kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ maŋbii kwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Rut wolo lɛ tsɔɔ wɔ jɔɔmɔi ni Moabyoo ni ji gbɔ yɛ Israel lɛ na kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Ene ha etsɔ heyelɔi lɛ ateŋ ekome yɛ Israel.
Mlijaramɔi Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛba Betlehem ni Rut fata ehe .- Rut kɛ Boaz kpe .—.
Boaz kpee Rut .-
Elimelek kɛ eŋa kɛ bii tee Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Be ko, be ni Israelbii nako ana maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, hɔmɔ ko ba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hɔmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ nuu ko fã kɛjɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda, ni eyiŋ etee eyato gbɔ yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebihii enyɔ.
Nuu lɛ gbɛi ji Elimelek, eŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Naomi, ni ebihii lɛ hu agbɛii ji Malon kɛ Kilion.
Amɛjɛ Efrata akutso lɛŋ.
Naomi wu, Elimelek, gbo ni ebashwɛ Naomi kɛ ebihii enyɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Bihii nɛɛ ŋɔ Moabyei.
Yei nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbɛi ji Orpa, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Rut.
Amɛhi jɛi aaafee afii nyɔŋma.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Malon kɛ Kilion hu gboi, ni ebashwɛ yoo okulafo lɛ kɛkɛ; ebɛ wu lɛ, ebɛ bii hu.
Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛtee Betlehem -Naomi nu yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ Yehowa ebaduro emaŋ Israel niyenii.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ eshaayei lɛ yiŋ kɛmiiku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya Yuda.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, Naomi kɛɛ eshaayei enyɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa; nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya enyɛ we.
Yehowa afee nyɛ ejurɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee mi kɛ gbohii lɛ ejurɔ lɛ.
Ehã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana he ko eta yɛ ewu we.” Ni eshwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa, ni ekɛ amɛye shɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛjwa yaafo.
Ni amɛkɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Dabi, shi wɔkɛ bo aaatee omaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ moŋ.” Shi Naomi kɛɛ, “Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, mibii!
Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ mi aaatee?
Ani bihii yɛ mimusuŋ lolo ni amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ nyɛwumɛi?
Mibii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa, ejaakɛ migbɔ tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mikɛ nuu aaayahi shi.
Ni kɛji mikɛɛ miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ tete, ni maya nuu ko ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ koni mafɔ bihii tete lɛ, aso no hewɔ ni nyɛaamɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaadara?
Aloo no hewɔ ni nyɛaatsi nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛkɛ nuu ehiŋ shi?
Dabi, mibii!
Shi nyɛsane miidɔ mi naakpa; ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛjwa yaafo ekoŋŋ.
Ni Orpa shwɔ eshaayoo lɛ naa, ni eku esɛɛ; shi Rut lɛ, lɛ lɛ ekpɛtɛ Naomi lolo.
Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Naa, obienyɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ etee emaŋ kɛ esɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Kuu osɛɛ ni otiu lɛ.” Shi Rut to he akɛ, “Kaahiɛ mi doo akɛ mishi bo, ni miku misɛɛ ni mifɔ̃ɔ osɛɛnyiɛmɔ!
Shi he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ matee, ni he ni oooyahi lɛ jɛi mahi.
Omaŋ aaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni oNyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ mi hu miNyɔŋmɔ.
He ni ooogbo yɛ lɛ jɛi magbo yɛ, ni he ni aaafũ bo yɛ lɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu mi yɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi aye ni ekɛ mi aye ekoŋŋ, kɛjeee gbele kɛkɛ aaagbala mi kɛ bo teŋ fĩi.” Agbɛnɛ be ni Naomi na akɛ Rut eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaatee lɛ, efɔ̃ɔ Rut kɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wieɔ lɛ he wiemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛkɛshwie nɔ ekoŋŋ, kɛyashi amɛshɛ Betlehem.
Be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ bu, ni yei lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Naomi kɛ̃ nɛ?” Shi ehere amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkatsɛa mi Naomi dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛtsɛa mi Mara, ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ tsɔ̃.
Mitee obɔ̃, shi Yehowa kɛ mi eku sɛɛ kɛba efolo.
Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ mi Naomi, mi ni Yehowa kɛ mi eye kɛ joomɔ, ni Ofe lɛ eshwishwia mi shi lɛ?” Bɔ ni Naomi ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba nɛ, lɛ kɛ eshaayoo Rut, Moabyoo lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛba Betlehem lɛ abɔi akoko foo.
Rut yaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ Boaz ŋmɔshi Shi Naomi wu Elimelek yɛ wekunyo niiatsɛ ko.
Egbɛi ji Boaz.
Be ko lɛ Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Hã maya ŋmɔji lɛ amli mayanyiɛ mɔ ni aaana mi mɔbɔ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ koni maye akoko kpɛkpɛo.” Naomi kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oba oŋ, mibi.” Rut tee ni eyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɛi ni foɔ akoko lɛ asɛɛ yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli.
Ni eba mli akɛ eyaje Boaz, Elimelek wekunyo lɛ, ŋmɔshi.
Boaz jɛ Betlehem eba, ni ehã nikpalɔi lɛ aekoo ekɛɛ, “Yehowa kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!” Ni amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo!” Kɛkɛ ni Boaz bi etsulɔ ni ekɛto enikpalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ oblayoo nɛ?” Tsulɔ lɛ to he akɛ, “Moab oblayoo lɛ ni kɛ Naomi jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ ni.
Ebakɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, hã manyiɛ akoko kei lɛ ateŋ yɛ nikpalɔi lɛ asɛɛ maye kpɛkpɛo koni mabua naa.’ Ni kɛjɛ leebi tɔ̃ɔ ni eba lɛ, ejɔko ehe kwraa kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Mibi yoo, oobo toi?
Kaaya ni oyaye kpɛkpɛo yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi, ni asaŋ okaje biɛ nɛɛ hu; shi moŋ kpɛtɛmɔ miblayei lɛ ahe yɛ biɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ohiɛ ahi ŋmɔ ni amɛfoɔ akoko lɛ yɛ mli lɛ nɔ koni onyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Miwo miblahii lɛ kitã akɛ mɔ ko akagba onaa.
Kɛ kumai miiye bo lɛ, yaa gbɛi lɛ ahe koni oyanu nu ni oblahii lɛ eyayɛ lɛ eko.” Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekula shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni omli ejɔ ehã mi, ni otseɔ ohiɛ ohãa mi, mi mɔkpɔŋ nɛɛ?” Boaz to he ehã lɛ akɛ, “Nii ni ofee ohã oshaayoo lɛ yɛ owu gbele lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, agba mi fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ ni oshi otsɛ kɛ onyɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni afɔ bo yɛ nɔ lɛ, ni oyiŋ kɛba mɛi ni oleee oto sa aŋɔɔ.
Yehowa ato bo nii ni otsu lɛ najiaŋ.
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ abo ni obaba nɛɛ ato bo najiaŋ shishiishi.” Kɛkɛ ni Rut kɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, omli jɔ hã mi, ejaakɛ oshɛje mimii, ni okɛ oweyoo ewie yɛ mlihilɛ naa, tsɛbelɛ mi kɛ oweyei lɛ ekoeko tete yeee hegbɔ.” Be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Tsi oba biɛ koni obaye aboloo lɛ eko ni bo hu okɛ otrɔma lɛ atsɔ wain lɛ mli eko.” Ni Rut ba ebata nikpalɔi lɛ amasɛi; ni Boaz hã lɛ abelefɔ ni ashĩ lɛ eko, ni ekpe, ni etɔ, ni eshwɛ eko.
Be ni Rut te shi eyaaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ, Boaz wo eblahii lɛ shi akɛ, “Nyɛhãa eyea kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ kei ni afĩmɔ lɛ ateŋ hu; nyɛkanyafia lɛ.
Asaŋ nyɛfamɔa akoko lɛ eko yɛ kei lɛ amli nyɛshwiea shi nyɛhãa lɛ koni eye lɛ kpɛkpɛo; ni nyɛkawiea ehiɛ.” Rut ye kpɛkpɛo yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi.
Egbee kpɛkpɛo ni eye lɛ, ni ena yiteremɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋma tsiimɔ.
Ewo kɛtee maŋ lɛŋ, ni ekɛ kpɛkpɛo ni eyaye lɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ eshaayoo lɛ.
Rut jie niyenii ni eye etɔ ni shwɛ lɛ ehã eshaayoo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Naomi bi Rut akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyatsu nii yɛ?
