Namɔ ŋmɔshi otee oyaye kpɛkpɛo lɛ yɛ ŋmɛnɛ?
Mɔ ni tse ehiɛ ehã bo lɛ, aaajɔɔ lɛ.” Rut gba eshaayoo lɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni eyatsu nii yɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuu ni miyatsu nii yɛ eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ gbɛi ji Boaz.” Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, mɔ ni hãko emɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ.” Naomi tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuu lɛ wɔwekunyo ni; weku lɛ mli mɛi ni aaanyɛ akwɛ wɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Rut, Moabyoo lɛ, kɛɛ, “Belɛ no hewɔ esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kpɛtɛmɔ mipaafoi lɛ ahe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaagbe minikpamɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ.’ ” Ni Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, “Ehi, mibi, akɛ okɛ Boaz oblayei lɛ anyiɛ koni akagba onaa yɛ mɔ kroko ŋmɔshi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Rut kpɛtɛ Boaz oblayei nitsulɔi lɛ ahe, ni eye kpɛkpɛo lɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe akoko kɛ ŋmãa fɛɛ kpamɔ naa.
Rut tee nɔ ekɛ eshaayoo lɛ hi shi.
Naomi wo Rut ŋaa Gbi ko lɛ Naomi kɛɛ eshaayoo Rut akɛ, “Mibi, jeee ja mitao he ko mihã bo ota ni ahi ahã bo?
Boaz mɔ ni okɛ eblayei lɛ yatsu nii lɛ, wɔwekunyo ni.
Naa, eesha ekoko gbɛkɛnaashi nɛɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, juu ohe, ni okpa mu, ni owo otade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛya ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
Shi moŋ kaahã nuu lɛ miiyoo bo kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeye nii, ni eeenu nɔ ko dã.
Shi kɛ eyakã shi lɛ kadimɔ eshikamɔhe lɛ, ni oya oyakpa mama lɛ yɛ enane he, ni oho okã shi; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee.” Rut kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Nɔ ni okɛɛ mi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mafee.” Kɛkɛ ni Rut yiŋ etee ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, ni eyafee bɔ ni eshaayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Boaz eye nii, ni enu nɔ ko, ni emii eshɛ ehe lɛ, etee eyakã shi yɛ akoko ku lɛ sɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Rut dɛke shi, ni eyakpa mama lɛ yɛ Boaz nane he, ni eho ekã shi.
Ni nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ Boaz hɛle shi, ni etsɔ̃ ehe, ni naa, yoo ko kã enajiaŋshi.
Ni Boaz bi akɛ, “Bo namɔŋ?” Ni Rut kɛɛ, “Mi oweyoo Rut ni.
Ofainɛ, haa mi omama lɛ eko; ejaakɛ weku lɛ mli niyelɔ ji bo.” Boaz here nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, mibiyoo.
Ejurɔ ni ofee sɛɛkpee nɛɛ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ tete akɛ onyiɛɛɛ oblahii asɛɛ, niiatsɛmɛi jio, ohiafoi jio.
Ni agbɛnɛ, mibiyoo, kaashe gbeyei.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ mafee mahã bo, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ le akɛ yoo kpakpa ji bo.
Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ owu lɛ wekunyo ni aaanyɛ aŋɔ bo ji mi moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ niyelɔ lɛ eko yɛ ni eyeɔ dani mi miyeɔ.
Hii shi ni je atsɛre.
Kɛji je tsɛre ni eeefee niyelɔ gbɛnaanii lɛ ehã bo lɛ, ehi; shi kɛji esumɔɔɔ akɛ efee lɛ, no lɛ gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ mafee.
Kã shi ni je atsɛre.” Kɛkɛ ni Rut ho ekã Boaz najiashi kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ.
Ni ete shi dani hiɛ gbele bɔ ni aaanyɛ mɔ ayoo.
Shi Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Kaahã mɔ ko le akɛ yoo ko eba ŋmãagbeemɔhe nɛɛ.” Boaz kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Okɛ mama ni okɛha oyiteŋ lɛ aba, ni olɛɛ mii.” Rut kɛ mama lɛ ba, ni elɛɛ mli, ni Boaz ka akoko susumɔ tsenei ekpaa ni etsiimɔ aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ewo mli, ni ekɛtere Rut, ni ekɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni Rut yashɛ eshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, eshaayoo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?” Rut gba lɛ nɔ ni Boaz fee hã lɛ lɛ fɛɛ; asaŋ Rut kɛɛ akɛ, “Ehã mi akoko tsenei ekpaa nɛɛ ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ ni okɛ odɛ̃ folo yaa oshaayoo lɛ ŋɔɔ.’ ” Ni Naomi kɛɛ Rut akɛ, “Mɛɛ mibi, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ooona bɔ ni sane lɛ naa aaayakpa; ejaakɛ nuu lɛ ejɔŋ ehe ja ena sane lɛ naa ŋmɛnɛ.”
Boaz ŋɔ Rut Boaz tee maŋ agbo lɛ naa ni ji amɛkoishi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ naa niyelɔ lɛ ni Boaz tsi etã lɛ miiho.
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmi nuu, ofainɛ, baata shi fioo.” Ni eba ebata shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz tsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfai nɛ, nyɛbataraa shi fioo.” Amɛbatara shi.
Ni Boaz kɛɛ niyelɔ lɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔŋ kuku ni ji wɔnyɛmi Elimelek shikpɔŋ lɛ, Naomi ni jɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ba lɛ miihɔ̃ɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ mikɛɛ mawo otoi nɔ koni ohe yɛ mɛi ni tara biɛ nɛɛ kɛ mimaŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛ ooosumɔ ni oye mɔ ni egbo lɛ nii lɛ wiemɔ, ni kɛji osumɔɔɔ hu hã male; ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eyeɔ nii lɛ fe bo; ni osɛɛ dani mi.” Niyelɔ lɛ jie naa ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, masumɔ maye.” Boaz kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbi nɔ ni oooŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ lɛ, belɛ ooŋɔ Rut, Moabyoo lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ ŋa lɛ hu oofata he nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii lɛ he.” Kɛkɛ ni niyelɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Minyɛŋ maye nii lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji miye lɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ baaba, mi diɛŋtsɛ migboshiniiyeli mli.
Ŋɔɔ migbɛnaanii lɛ ohã ohe.” Blema lɛ kɛji abaaye mɔ ko nii aloo aahɔ̃ɔ nɔ ko yɛ Israel lɛ, nɔ ni akɛmaa nɔ aduatsɔ nɛ: Mɔ ni ŋmɛɔ nii ahe lɛ aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ jieɔ etokota ehãa mɔ ni ŋɔɔ nii lɛ.
Enɛ akɛyeɔ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ aloo ahe lɛ he odase yɛ Israel.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni niyelɔ lɛ kɛɛ Boaz akɛ eye nii lɛ, niyelɔ lɛ jie etokota ekɛhã Boaz.
Kɛkɛ ni Boaz kɛɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “nyɛ ji midasefoi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ miŋɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Elimelek nɔ, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Kilion kɛ Malon nɔ lɛ yɛ Naomi dɛŋ.
Asaŋ Rut, Moabyoo, ni ji Malon ŋa lɛ hu miiŋɔ lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ miŋa, koni mɔ ni egbo lɛ gbɛi akagbo yɛ egboshinii he, ni egbɛi akalaaje yɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ kɛ emaŋ koishi hu, nyɛ ji odasefoi ŋmɛnɛ.” Ni maŋbii ni yɔɔ maŋ koi lɛ shi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔji odasefoi!
Yehowa ahã yoo lɛ ni baa owe lɛ atamɔ Rahel kɛ Lea ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ mli Israel we lɛ jɛ lɛ.
Otsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ agbo yɛ Efrata, ni ogbɛi ahehe yɛ Betlehem.
Ni shwiei ni Yehowa aaahã oblayoo nɛɛ awo ahã bo lɛ, ahã owe lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Tamar kɛ Yuda bi Perez we.” Boaz shwiei Boaz ŋɔ Rut ni etsɔ̃ eŋa; ni Boaz ta Rut he, ni Yehowa hã ena musu ni efɔ binuu.
Ni maŋ lɛŋ yei lɛ kɛɛ Naomi akɛ, “Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa!
Ejaakɛ ehã bo gboshiniiyelɔ kɛ nabi ŋmɛnɛ.
Ehã gbɛkɛ lɛ gbɛi ahehe yɛ Israel.
Gbekɛ nɛɛ, eeehã owala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni eeekwɛ bo yɛ ogbɔlɛ mli; ejaakɛ oshaayoo ni sumɔɔ bo, ni ehi hã bo fe bihii kpawo tete lɛ, ni fɔ lɛ.” Ni Naomi he abifao lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni etsɔ̃ abifao lɛ kwɛlɔ.
Ni Naomi kuuŋyei lɛ nya amɛkɛɛ, “Afɔ binuu ahã Naomi eei!” Ni amɛwo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Obed.
Obed nɛɛ lɛ efɔ Ishai, ni Ishai hu fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
Agbɛnɛ Perez shwiei nɛ: Perez fɔ Hezron.
Hezron fɔ Ram; Ram fɔ Aminadab.
Aminadab fɔ Nahashon; Nahashon fɔ Salmon, ni Salmon fɔ Boaz; Boaz fɔ Obed.
Obed fɔ Ishai, ni Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Samuel Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo lɛ mli saji lɛ kɔɔ Israel blema saji ni ba kɛjɛ Kojolɔi, ni ji maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, abe lɛ kɛyashi Israelbii bɔi maŋtsɛtoo.
Tsakemɔ nɛɛ ni ba Israelbii amaŋnɔkwɛmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo mli nɛɛ kɔ mɛi etɛ̃ krɛdɛɛ komɛi ahe.
Amɛ ji Samuel, maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi wuji lɛ anaagbee mɔ lɛ, kɛ Saul, Israel klɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ David.
Dani David baye maŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ Samuel kɛ Saul fɛɛ eshãrã aahu.
Wolo nɛɛ mli sane oti lɛ tamɔ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli blema saji krokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No ji akɛ kɛji abo Nyɔŋmɔ toi lɛ shweremɔ kɛ shade baa, ni kɛji agbo Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi lɛ piŋmɔ nyiɛɔ sɛɛ.
Yehowa fee enɛ faŋŋ ehã Osɔfo Eli be ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni buɔ mi lɛ mibawo amɛhiɛ nyam; shi mɛi ni ebuuu mi lɛ, abuŋ amɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko” lɛ.
Ejeɔ kpo faŋŋ hu yɛ saji lɛ amli akɛ mɛi ayiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ ekpakpa ko yɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni babla Israelbii ashihilɛ lɛ he.
Israelbii ŋɔ Yehowa akɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ pɔ̃tɛɛ, shi akɛni Israelbii lɛ bi hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔ mɔ ko ehã amɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, sane oti lɛ ji akɛ Israelbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ ni jio, maŋbii lɛ ni jio, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shishi.
Yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlai anaa lɛ, esa akɛ abaa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ agbɛnai yi, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi fɛɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Samuel akɛ Israel maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔ .—.
Saul too akɛ maŋtsɛ .—.
Saul maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee .—.
David kɛ Saul .—.
Saul gbele kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe saji .-
Elkana kɛ eweku yɛ Shilo Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Rama yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Egbɛi ji Elkana, ni etsɛ gbɛi ji Yeroham.
Zuf bi Tohu bi Elihu bi ji Elkana nɛɛ.
Elkana yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, mɔ kome gbɛi ji Hana, ni mɔ kome lɛ hu gbɛi ji Penina.
Penina yɛ bii shi Hana bɛ bi.
Daa afi lɛ Elkana yaa Shilo eyasɔleɔ ni eshãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa ni ji Taiatsɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, ni ji Hofni kɛ Finehas, miiye osɔfoi kɛha Yehowa yɛ Shilo.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi ni Elkana baaya eyashã afɔle lɛ, ehãa eŋa Penina kɛ Penina bihii lɛ kɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ loo kukuli.
Shi Hana lɛ eyɛ mli akɛ Elkana sumɔɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi loo kukuli kome nɔŋŋ ehãa lɛ hu, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãko lɛ bi.
Enɛ hãa Hana bienyɛ Penina kɛ fɔmɔ yeɔ Hana he fɛo, ni ekɛwoɔ emli la naakpa bɔ ni ehãa Hana gbigbliɔ emli akɛ Yehowa etsi efɔmɔ naa.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni nibii tee nɔ daa afi.
Shii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ, ebienyɛ Penina yeɔ ehe fɛo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ efeɔ Hana yaafo, ni eyeee nii.
Kɛfee nakai lɛ ewu Elkana kɛɔ Hana akɛ, “Hana, mɛɛba ni ofoɔ ni asaŋ oyeee nii?
Mɛɛba ni oyeɔ otsui?
Mihiii hãaa bo fe musuŋ bihii nyɔŋma?” Hana kɛ Eli -Be ko be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nɔ ko yɛ Shilo sɛɛ lɛ, Hana te shi ni ewerɛ eho ehe naakpa.
Ni efo waa be ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ Yehowa lɛ.
Nakai beiaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ Osɔfo Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaatso lɛ masɛi.
Hana wo shi ekɛɛ, “Yehowa Taiatsɛ, kɛji oookwɛ mi, oweyoo, mimanehulu nɛɛ, ni oookai mi, ni ohiɛ kpaŋ mi, oweyoo, nɔ shi moŋ ooohã mi, oweyoo, binuu lɛ, no lɛ majɔɔ enɔ mahã bo, Yehowa, ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni asooyi naa esaŋ eyiteŋ.” Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Hana hiɛ sɔlemɔ lɛ aahu yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Eli kwɛ enaabu.
Shi Hana miiwie yɛ etsui mli.
Anuuu egbee akɛ fe enaabu kɛkɛ ni tsɔmɔɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Eli susu akɛ dãa Hana etɔ.
Ni Eli kɛɛ Hana akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni oootɔ dãa kɛyashi?
Hã ni owain lɛ atserɛ yɛ ohiɛ.” Shi Hana here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida, minuŋtsɔ, mi ji yoo ko ni miwerɛ eho mihe naakpa.
Minuko wain loo dãa ko ni wa; shi moŋ miifɔse mitsui mli awerɛho sane mashwie Yehowa hiɛ.
Kaabu mi, oweyoo akɛ yoo yakagbɔmɔ ko shi mikɔmɔ kɛ mlila ni awoɔ sɔŋŋ naa miwieɔ yɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ nɛɛ.” Eli to he hã Hana ekɛɛ, “Omanye abla bo, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahã bo nii ni obi lɛ lɛ.” Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ohã misane nɛɛ akã otsui nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Hana yiŋ etee, ni agbɛnɛ eyatao nɔ ko eye, ni ehiɛ efeee tɔtɔɔtɔ dɔŋŋ.
Samuel fɔmɔ kɛ enɔjɔɔmɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Elkana kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ kɛ ebii lɛ te shi leebi maŋkpa, be ni amɛtee amɛyaja Yehowa sɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Rama.
Elkana kɛ eŋa Hana yawɔ, ni Yehowa mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, be ni shɛɔ afi naakplɔ lɛ Hana ena musu, ni efɔ binuu.
Hana wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ Samuel, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ miba lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.” Be ni afi shɛ lɛ, Elkana kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ tee koni amɛyashã daa afi naakplɔ afɔle yɛ shi krɛdɛɛ ni ewo lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Hana eyaaa eko ejaakɛ ekɛɛ ewu Elkana akɛ, “Mamɛ kɛyashi matse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ dani mikɛ lɛ ayapue yɛ Yehowa hiɛ koni ehi jɛi kwraa.” Elkana to he ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ.
Hii shi kɛyashi oootse abifao lɛ fufɔ.
Yehowa ahã eshiwoo lɛ aba mli kɛkɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Hana hi shi, ni ekwɛ abifao lɛ kɛyashi etse lɛ fufɔ lɛ.
Be ni Hana tse gbekɛ lɛ fufɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ tee Yehowa we lɛ yɛ Shilo, ni ehiɛ edɛŋ tsinanuu ni eye afii etɛ̃ kɛ ŋmaa mamu kiloi nyɔŋma kɛ wain tɔ kome.
Nakai be mli tete lɛ Samuel edako.
Agbe tsinanuu lɛ, ni akɛ gbekɛnuu fioo lɛ ba Eli ŋɔɔ, ni Hana kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ookai mi.
Mi ji yoo lɛ ni badamɔ omasɛi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ nyɛsɛɛ ko, ni ebakpa Yehowa fai ni eba lɛ nii lɛ.
Gbekɛ nɛɛ he fai mibakpa lɛ, ni Yehowa ehã mi nɔ ni mibaba lɛ lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, miijɔɔ enɔ kwraa miihã Yehowa.
Mikɛ lɛ miike Yehowa ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛja Yehowa yɛ jɛi.
Hana sɔle Kɛkɛ ni Hana sɔle yɛ jɛi ni ekɛɛ “Yehowa, ohã mimli efili mi, ni minyɛ mihiɛ nɔ miwo.
Mibaŋmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ ohere mi.
“Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko bɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa, osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; Mɔ ko bɛ hewalɛ tamɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkawiea kɛ henɔwomɔ nɛkɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɛkawiea kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nilelɔ ni, ni lɛ ekojoɔ adesai anifeemɔnii.
Kãkãlɔi lɛ agãitsei lɛ ekumɔ, ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ ena hewalɛ.
Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛyeɔ nii amɛtɔrɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiiye apaa yɛ daaŋ ŋmãa hewɔ, ni mɛi ni kulɛ amɛwɔɔ hɔmɔ lɛ, amɛwɔɔɔ hɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
Naa, kene lɛ efɔ kpawo, ni biianyɛ lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ mɔ kome mɔ.
Yehowa ni gbeɔ mɔ, ni etsiɛɔ mɔ hiɛ hu; ehãa ayaa gbohiiaje, ni ehãa akpaleɔ abaa ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa ni hãa ayeɔ ohia, ni ehãa anaa nii hu; Lɛ ebaa mɔ shi, asaŋ lɛ ewoɔ mɔ nɔ hu.
Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli, ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ yɛ tumo nɔ, koni amɛ kɛ abladei atara shi, ni amɛna sɛii ni yɔɔ nyam anɔ amɛtara, ejaakɛ je lɛ shishitoo lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ etswa je lɛ ema nɔ.
Eeebaa enɔkwafoi lɛ ayi, shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ duŋ mli, ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hewalɛ naa eyeɔ kunim yɛ.
Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ, aaakumɔ amɛ dukuduku ashwie shi; eeehã ŋwɛi ashimɔ awo amɛ; Yehowa ji je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ; ebaahã emaŋtsɛ lɛ ana hewalɛ, ni emɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ eeehã eye kunim.” Kɛkɛ ni Elkana ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ yɛ Rama, ni eshi gbekɛnuu fioo, Samuel, lɛ koni esɔmɔ Yehowa yɛ Osɔfo Eli shishi.
Osɔfo Eli bihii lɛ Osɔfo Eli bihii lɛ yafee amɛhe yakagbɔmɛi, ni amɛbuu Yehowa, loo osɔfoi lɛ agbɛnaanii ni sa akɛ amɛhe yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.
Nɔ ni afeɔ ji akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ba afɔleshãa lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ baa, be mli ni ahoɔ loo lɛ, ni ehiɛ faka kɛ enyanyɔji etɛ̃.
Tsulɔ lɛ kɛ faka lɛ tsuɔ loo ni ahoɔ lɛ yɛ tsɛnsi loo dadesɛŋ loo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni loo fɛɛ loo ni faka lɛ baatsu kɛje kpo lɛ osɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Nɛkɛ afeɔ Israelbii fɛɛ ni yaa afɔleshãa yɛ Shilo lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ be mli ni anako ashã loo lɛ mli fɔ lɛ tete lɛ, osɔfo lɛ tsulɔ lɛ baa ni ebakɛɔ mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ akɛ, “Jiemɔ loo ohã ni ayashã ahã osɔfo lɛ ejaakɛ esumɔɔɔ loo ni ahoo lɛ, eetao loo lɛ eŋmɔŋ.” Kɛji mɔ ni shãa afɔle lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ koni ashã fɔ lɛ dã; no sɛɛ koni ojie loo lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ” lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ toɔ he akɛ, “Dabida, jiemɔ loo lɛ ohã nɔŋŋ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ majie loo lɛ ekãa naa.” No hewɔ lɛ, Eli bihii lɛ anɔsha lɛ da yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ eyasɔɔɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa Yehowa lɛ.
Samuel yɛ Shilo Samuel sɔmɔɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ewoɔ tsitsinɔhaanii ni akɛ klala kpɛ, ni efiɔ emliteŋ.
Enyɛ kpɛɔ atade yuu pɛmpɛoo ko, ni ekɛbahãa Samuel koni ewo kɛji ekɛ ewu ba daa afi afɔleshãa lɛ.
Kɛji amɛba lɛ, Eli jɔɔ Elkana kɛ eŋa lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa ahã yoo nɛɛ awo shwiei ahã bo yɛ ebi nɛɛ ni ejɔɔ enɔ ehã Yehowa hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛmaŋ.
Yehowa jɔɔ Hana, ni efɔ Samuel sɛɛ bihii etɛ̃ kɛ biyei enyɔ hu.
Ni oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Eli kɛ ebihii lɛ Eli egbɔ naakpa; ni ababɔɔ lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ebihii lɛ feɔ Israelbii lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yei ni batsuɔ nii yɛ Kpee Buu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ wɔɔ.
No ni Eli kɛɛ ebihii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ saji?
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miiwie nibii gbohii ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ ahe, ni miinu.
Nyɛkafea nakai kɔkɔɔkɔ, mibii.
Saji ni minuɔ yɛ Yehowa webii anaa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ, ehiii.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ fee enyɛmi gbɔmɔ esha lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ; shi kɛji gbɔmɔ fee esha eshi Yehowa lɛ, namɔ po ni aaakpa fai ahã lɛ?” Shi oblahii lɛ eyabooo amɛtsɛ, Eli, toi ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ ebaagbe amɛ.
Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ bada ni esane sa gbɔmɛi kɛ Yehowa fɛɛ hiɛ.
Agba ashi Eli weku Gbalɔ ko ba Eli ŋɔɔ be ko ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Mijie mihe mitsɔ̃ɔ otsɛ we lɛ be mli ni amɛyɔɔ Ijipt akɛ Farao nyɔji lɛ.
Ni miŋɔ otsɛ we lɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ koni eye osɔfo ehã mi, ni esɔmɔ mi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa, ni eshã tsofakɛŋma ehã mi, ni ewo efod lɛ kɛsɔmɔ mi.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, miŋɔ afɔlei fɛɛ ni akɛ la shãa mihã lɛ.
Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ mi hu migbɛfaŋnii ni yɔɔ gbee afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ amli lɛ anɔ, be mli ni miwo nyɛ he kitã; ni obuɔ obihii lɛ moŋ fe mi, ni nyɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ afɔle fɛɛ afɔle mli nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ lɛɔ nyɛ moŋ nyɛhe lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛi awe lɛ ni baasɔ̃mɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi kɛya naanɔ, shi agbɛnɛ miigbala nakai shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ mi lɛ, mawo amɛhiɛ nyam: shi mɛi ni ebuuu mi lɛ, abuŋ amɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Naa, be lɛ miiba, ni mibagbe owe lɛ kɛ otsɛmɛiawe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ koni akana nuumo yɛ oweku mli.
Ni okɛ hejaramɔ baana shweremɔ ni abaahã Israel ashwere lɛ: shi owe lɛ nuumo ehiŋ mli kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ni owekunyo ni mahã ashwɛ ni esɔmɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ naa lɛ tete, ehiŋmɛii baajwara, ni ebaaye awerɛho kɛteke nɔ; ni shwiei fɛɛ ni abaawo yɛ owe lɛ baagbo akranaŋ naa gbele.
Nɔ ni baaba obihii enyɔ lɛ, Hofni kɛ Finehas, nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi ahã bo.
No ji akɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaagboi gbi kome.
Matee osɔfo anɔkwafo ko shi mahã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, mɔ ni baafee miyiŋtoo kɛ mitsuinaanii, ni mahã ewo shwiei ni shishi etaŋ, mɛi ni baasɔ̃mɔ yɛ mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ hiɛ daa.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mahã ashwɛ yɛ owe lɛ aaaba abakoto gbɔmɔ nɛɛ koni ebaba edɛŋ jwiɛtɛi loo aboloo akwaabɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Miikpa bo fai ni ohã mi osɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eko matsu bɔ ni afee ni mana midaaŋ ŋmaa kɛkɛ.’ ”
Yehowa jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Samuel Oblanyo fioo, Samuel, lɛ sɔmɔɔ Yehowa yɛ Eli shishi.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ daaŋwiemɔ he efɔɔɔ kaa; asaŋ afɔɔɔ ninaa hu namɔ.
Gbi ko lɛ Eli kã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ; no mli lɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ ebɔ̃i haa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaaa nii jogbaŋŋ; ni Yehowa kane lɛ ma nɔ lolo ni enako egbo, ni Samuel hu kã shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli he ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsɛ Samuel ekɛɛ, “Samuel!
Samuel!” Ehere nɔ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, Naa mi!” Samuel sha foi kɛtee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Shi Eli kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Samuel tee ni eyakã shi.
Yehowa saa tsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Samuel!” Samuel te shi ni etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi; minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛko bo, mibi; kuu osɛɛ ni oyakã shi ekoŋŋ.” Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Samuel nako ale Yehowa ni asaŋ Yehowa kɛ lɛ ewieko dã.
Yehowa saa etsɛ Samuel nɔ ni tĩa shii etɛ̃; ni Samuel te shi etee Eli ŋɔɔ eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi, minu akɛ ootsɛ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Eli bayoo sɛɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ Yehowa ni tsɛɔ oblanyo fioo lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Yaakã shi; kɛji atsɛ bo ekoŋŋ lɛ, heremɔ nɔ akɛ, ‘Wiemɔ Yehowa, shi mi, otsulɔ, miibo bo toi!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel tee eyakã shi yɛ ewɔɔhe lɛ.
Yehowa ba ni ebadamɔ shi, ni etsɛ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ akɛ, “Samuel!
Samuel!” Samuel here nɔ akɛ, “Wiemɔ, shi otsulɔ miibo toi.” Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Naa, mibafee nɔ titri ko yɛ Israel, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ he aajɔ̃ ehe.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ mahã nibii fɛɛ ni miwie yɛ Eli we lɛ he lɛ aba mli kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyashi naagbee.
Mikɛɛ lɛ mito akɛ mibagbala ewe lɛ toi kɛya naanɔ yɛ nɔ sha ni ele lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ebihii lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi, Nyɔŋmɔ, shi etutuuu ehiɛ ewooo amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikã Eli we lɛ he kitã akɛ kɛji akɛ gbee afɔle loo niyenii afɔle ko aaakpãta Eli we lɛ nɔ sha lɛ kɛyashi naanɔ fĩi.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel ho ekã shi kɛyashi je tsɛre ni egbele Yehowa we lɛ shinai lɛ.
Samuel she he gbeyei akɛ eeegba Eli ninaa lɛ.
Shi Eli tsɛ Samuel ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mibi Samuel,” Ehere nɔ akɛ, “Naa mi.” Eli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni Yehowa kɛɛ bo lɛ?
Kaashiu mi nɔ.
Kɛji oshiu mi wiemɔi fɛɛ ni ekɛ bo wie lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbala otoi yɛ no hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel gba Eli nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eshiuuu lɛ sane lɛ eko nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Eli to he ekɛɛ, “Lɛ ji Yehowa, nɔ ni hi yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ efee!” Samuel bada, ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni ehãaa Samuel naa wiemɔ ko afee yaka.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba, na le akɛ Samuel lɛ Yehowa gbalɔ anɔkwafo ni.
Yehowa kã he etsɔ̃ɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ejieɔ ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Samuel yɛ Shilo.
Ni kɛji Samuel wie lɛ, Israel fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi.
Ashɔ̃ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ Filistibii lɛ fã ta koni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ ayawu.
Israelbii lɛ yagba ta yɛ Ebenezer, ni Filistibii lɛ hu gba ta yɛ Afek.
Filistibii lɛ gba wo Israelbii lɛ, ni be ni akɛ ta lɛ lɛɛ shi lɛ, Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni Israel tabilɔi aaafee akpei ejwɛ nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba amɛshitoohe lɛ, Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni Yehowa ŋmɛ gbɛ ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ wɔnɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛkɛ?
Nyɛhãa ni wɔyaŋɔa Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Shilo kɛbaa biɛ koni ebahi wɔteŋ, koni ehere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, atsu atee Shilo, ni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ enɔ kerubim lɛ, ni ji Yehowa sɛ̃i lɛ, kɛba.
Hofni kɛ Finehas, ni ji Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, fata he ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bashɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe waa bɔ ni ehã shikpɔŋ hoso.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu oshebɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi akɛ, “Mɛɛ oshe abɔɔ waa yɛ Hebribii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli nɛkɛ nɛɛ?” Be ni amɛbana amɛle akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ebashɛ Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ mli lɛ, Filistibii lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Jemawɔŋ ko eba amɛta lɛ mli.
Sane eye wɔ ei!
Nɛkɛ nɔ ko bako dã.
Sane eye wɔ!
Namɔ po aaajie wɔ yɛ jemawɔji ni ahe yɔɔ gbeyei nɛɛ adɛŋ?
Jemawɔji nɛɛ ni hã haomɔ ba Ijiptbii lɛ anɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛwajea nyɛhe, Filistibii, ni nyɛfea hii koni nyɛkatsɔmɔ Hebribii lɛ anyɔji tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛye amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.” Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Filistibii lɛ wu ta lɛ ekãa naa, ni amɛye Israelbii lɛ anɔ kunim, ni Israelbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee amɛbuui amli.
Agbe mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ Israel tabilɔi aaafee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni nyiɛɔ amɛnane nɔ nyɔnyɔɔi.
Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃, ni Hofni kɛ Finehas, Eli bihii enyɔ lɛ, nyɔ.
Eli gbele Benyaminnyo ko jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛba Shilo nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ atade ni etserɛ kɛ eyiteŋ su.
Nuu nɛɛ bashɛ shi be mli ni Eli ta sɛ̃i nɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa ni eesra, ejaakɛ etsui enyɔɔɔ emli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ.
Nuu lɛ bote maŋ lɛŋ ni be ni ebabɔ amaniɛ ni ekɛjɛ ta lɛ naa lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ wo yara.
Be ni Eli nu blɔmɔ hoo lɛ ebi akɛ, “Te blɔmɔ ni abolɔɔ hoo nɛɛ shishi hu?” Nuu lɛ sha ehe ni ebabɔ Eli amaniɛ lɛ.
No mli lɛ Eli eye afii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha, ni enaaa nii ekpakpa ko.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ Eli akɛ, “Mi ji mɔ ni jɛ ta lɛ naa ba lɛ, ni ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ mijo foi yɛ ta lɛ naa.” Kɛkɛ ni Eli bi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Ni te emli tamɔ tɛŋŋ, mibi?” Bɔfo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ enyɔ.
Obihii, Hofni kɛ Finehas hu enyɔ, ni asaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ashɔ̃.” Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tã ni atsi nɛkɛ pɛ ni Eli kpa yɛ esɛi lɛ nɔ eyagbee esɛɛgbɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ he, ni ekuɛŋ wu kũ, ni egbo, ejaakɛ egbɔ ni egbɔmɔtso tsii.
Nakai be mli lɛ Eli ekwɛ Israelbii anɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Finehas ŋa lɛ hu gbele Eli shaayoo, ni ji Finehas ŋa lɛ, hiɛ musu, ni eshɛ efɔmɔ be etã.
Be ni yoo lɛ nu amaniɛ lɛ akɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ hu egboi lɛ, fɔmɔ ta ehe amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni eho esɔ̃ shi ni efɔ.
Be ni yoofɔyoo lɛ heɔ egbo yɛ fɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, yei ni yɔɔ emasɛi ni amɛwaa lɛ kɛ fɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, shi ofɔ binuu.” Shi efooo mli, asaŋ ekɛ ejwɛŋmɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ.
Ewo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, “Ikabod,” ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel nyam etã,” hewɔ lɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee, ni asaŋ eshaanuu lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ egboi.
Esaa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel nyam etã, ejaakɛ ashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.”
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ Be ni Filistibii lɛ shɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, amɛwo kɛjɛ Ebenezer kɛtee Ashdod, ni amɛkɛtee nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛyɔɔ ni egbɛi ji Dagon lɛ we lɛ, ni amɛkɛyama Dagon amãgã lɛ masɛi.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maŋkpa be ni Ashdodbii te shi lɛ, naa, Dagon amãgã lɛ ni ekpa egbee shi, ni ehiɛ bu shikpɔŋ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Ashdodbii lɛ wo Dagon amãgã lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ma emaahe lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi maaŋkpa be ni Ashdodbii lɛ te shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, naa, Dagon ekpa egbee shi ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ bu shikpɔŋ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
Eyitso kɛ eniji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ hu etserɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛjwere kpoku lɛ nɔ.
Dagon amãgã kuku lɛ kɛkɛ eshwɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni Dagon wulɔmɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni boteɔ Dagon we lɛ, enaaa Dagon kpoku lɛ nɔ yɛ Ashdod kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ.
Yehowa piŋ Ashdodbii lɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ehã abua fuufuu amɛ, ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ yɛ Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ ekpokpai anɔ fɛɛ.
Be ni Ashdod hii lɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Akahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ miihi wɔŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ kɛ wɔnyɔŋmɔ Dagon fɛɛ miiye kɛ joomɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsu ni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Te wɔfee Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tɛŋŋ?” Lumɛi lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Awo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Gat.” No hewɔ lɛ, awo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Gat.
Be ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ eyashɛ Gat sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ abua piŋ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ, ni ekɛgbala Gatbii atoi, ni enɛ hã amɛ jijaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã awo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Ekron.
Shi be ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yashɛ jɛi lɛ, Ekronbii lɛ bolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ eba wɔŋɔɔ koni ebagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsu ni ayakpee Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ akua sɛɛ kɛyaa he ni ejɛ koni ekabagbe wɔ kɛ wɔbii.” Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa ni yɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ miiye kɛ joomɔ ni naa wa yɛ jɛi.
Mɛi ni gboiii lɛ abua fuufuu amɛ, ni maŋ lɛ bolɔ waa amɛtsɛ akɛ ahere amɛ.
Akpale Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ye nyɔji kpawo yɛ Filistibii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ kpee amɛsɔfoi kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nii ni amɛgbaa lɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Te wɔfee Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tɛŋŋ?
Nyɛtsɔa wɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ wɔkɛfata adeka lɛ he ni wɔkɛku sɛɛ kɛya he ni ejɛ.” Osɔfoi lɛ to he akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛmiikpale Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛya lɛ, nyɛkahãa akɛ adeka lɛ miiyaa efolo.
Ja nyɛkɛ afɔle fata he kɛtee nyɛyahã Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ akɛ nyɛye sɔ̃; no dani nyɛhe aaatã, ni asaŋ nyɛaale nɔ hewɔ ni ekpako nyɛ piŋmɔ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ bi akɛ, “Mɛni ji sɔ̃yeli afɔle ni wɔkɛyahã lɛ?” Osɔfoi lɛ jie naa akɛ, “Abua ni fũufuu nyɛ lɛ henɔ nibii enumɔ ni akɛ shika fee, kɛ kwakwei hu enumɔ ni akɛ shika fee yɛ Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayikulɛ naa, ejaakɛ hela kometoo lɛ nɔŋŋ ye nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea abua ni fũufuu nyɛ lɛ henɔ kɛ kwakwei ni bafite nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ henɔ okadii, asaŋ nyɛwoa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eko lɛ eeegbɔjɔ piŋmɔ lɛ mli ehã nyɛ kɛ nyɛjemawɔji lɛ kɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hu.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ nyɛkpliŋ nyɛtsui tamɔ Ijiptbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fee lɛ?
Kwɛ, be ni ehã amɛna amɛnii ni amɛleee sɛɛ lɛ, bɛ amɛŋmɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ni amɛtee?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea shwiili hee; nyɛmɔa tsinayei enyɔ ni aaye amɛ fufɔ lolo, asaŋ ni apã eyako amɛkuɛ dã, ni nyɛfimɔa amɛ nyɛwo shwiili lɛ naa.
Amɔmɔ tsinabii lɛ yɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ ahe kɛya shĩa.
No sɛɛ lɛ, awo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama shwiili lɛ nɔ.
Ato shika nibii ni akɛyaahã Yehowa akɛ sɔ̃yeli he afɔle lɛ awo adeka fioo mli, ni akɛma Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi, ni nyɛjie lɛ gbɛ ni eya.
Nyɛkwɛa eyisɛɛ.
Kɛji adeka lɛ wo ehiɛ ema lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ kɛtee Bet-Shemesh lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni ye wɔ awui kpeteŋkple nɛɛ lɛ; shi kɛji shwiili lɛ eyaaa jɛi lɛ belɛ wɔna wɔle akɛ jeee Yehowa piŋ wɔ lɛ, shi osharã ko kɛkɛ ni basharã wɔ.” Amɛfee bɔ ni akɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Amɛmɔmɔ tsinayei enyɔ ni aaye amɛfufɔ lolo, ni amɛfimɔ amɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ naa, ni amɛŋa amɛbii lɛ ayi yɛ shĩa.
Amɛwo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ amɛma shwiili lɛ nɔ ni amɛwo adeka lɛ ni amɛto shika kwakwei lɛ kɛ shika abua lɛ amɛwo mli lɛ hu amɛma shwiili lɛ nɔ.
Tsinai lɛ yi tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo amɛyi amɛma Bet-Shemesh tɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni amɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ belɛ tsinai lɛ miibolɔ.
Amɛgbaaa ninejurɔ lɛ, amɛgbaaa abɛku hu.
Filistibii alumɛi lɛ nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛ shwiili lɛ sɛɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Bet-Shemesh husu lɛ nɔ.
Bet-Shemeshbii miiku ŋmãa nɛkɛ be mli yɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛyaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ; amɛnya jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Shwiili lɛ babote Yoshua ni jɛ Bet-Shemesh lɛ ŋmɔshi, ni ebawa yɛ tɛ wulu ko ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ masɛi.
Ŋmɔ lɛ shi bii lɛ gbala shwiili lɛ tsei lɛ amli ni amɛkɛ tsinai lɛ shã shãafɔle amɛhã Yehowa.
Levibii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ adeka ni ma emasɛi ni shika nibii lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ hu, ni amɛkɛmamɔ tɛ wulu lɛ nɔ.
Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ shãshãa afɔlei, ni amɛgbegbee kooloi hu amɛkɛshã afɔlei amɛkɛhã Yehowa nakai gbi lɛ.
Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ na nɔ ni afee lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Ekron nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Abua ni fuufuu Filistibii lɛ henɔ shika nii ni Filistibii lɛ fee lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛyahã Yehowa akɛ amɛsɔ̃yeli he afɔle yɛ maji lɛ agbɛii amli nɛ: Ashdod nɔ ekome, kɛ Gaza nɔ ekome, kɛ Ashkelon nɔ ekome.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ shika kwakwei lɛ hu yahã yɛ Filistibii lɛ amaji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛmɛi enumɔ lɛ ashishi lɛ ayikulɛ naa.
Maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe kɛ akrowai fɛɛ shi nɔ.
Tɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ma nɔ yɛ Yoshua, Bet-Shemeshnyo lɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ yɛ jɛi eeye sane nɛɛ he odase kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yehowa gbe Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo komɛi, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiŋmɛii yakwɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
Enɛ hã maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ye awerɛho ejaakɛ Yehowa eplenee mɛi babaoo.
Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Kiriat Yearim Sane nɛɛ hã BetShemeshbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ; “Namɔ po aaanyɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ hiɛ adamɔ?
Ni kɛ adeka lɛ jɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ, namɛi aŋɔɔ po eeeya?” Kɛkɛ ni Bet-Shemeshbii lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Kiriat-Yearimbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, Filistibii lɛ ekpale Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ amɛkɛbahã wɔ.
Nyɛbaŋɔa kɛyaa.”
No hewɔ lɛ, Kiriat-Yearimbii lɛ bawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni amɛkɛtee Abinadab we lɛ ni ma Kiriat-Yearim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; ni amɛwo Abinadab bi Eleazar osɔfo koni ebu Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he.
Samuel kwɛ Israel nɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ tsɛ yɛ Kiriat-Yearim, ejaakɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ yɛ jɛi, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni akɛ lɛ yashɛ jɛi lɛ, ni Israel fɛɛ ye Yehowa he kumai.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛmiikpale kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛjiea maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji lɛ kɛ Astarte amãgãi lɛ hu ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ nyɛsherɛa nyɛshwiea koni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahãa Yehowa kwraa; asaŋ koni nyɛsɔmɔ ekome too; ni lɛ hu eeejie nyɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.” Israelbii lɛ damɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ ni amɛ jie Baal kɛ Astarte amãgãi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ amɛsherɛ amɛshwie, ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa kome pɛ.
Samuel kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa, ni masɔle makpa Yehowa fai mahã nyɛ.” Israelbii lɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa.
Amɛyɛ nu amɛshwie shi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛhi ŋmãa nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.” Ni Samuel hi Mizpa, ni ekojo Israelbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ Mizpa lɛ, Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fã ta koni amɛbatua Israelbii lɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ nu ta ni Filistibii lɛ efã lɛ he lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei, ni amɛkɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Yaa nɔ ni otsɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ohã wɔ koni ehere wɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel ŋɔ too gwantɛŋbi ni atseko lɛ fufɔ, ni eshã lɛ emuu akɛ shãa afɔle ekɛhã Yehowa.
Ni Samuel sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai ehã Israelbii lɛ, ni Yehowa here lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Samuel shãa afɔle lɛ, Filistibii lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ koni amɛbatua Israelbii lɛ.
Shi Yehowa hã ŋwɛi shimɔ gbeyeigbeyei wo Filistibii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ni ehã amɛhiɛ bɔ, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ amɛdamɔ.
Israelbii lɛ fã kɛjɛ Mizpa ni amɛnyiɛ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ ni amɛtswia amɛ nii aahu kɛyashɛ Bet-Kar jɔɔŋgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel wo tɛ ekɛma shi yɛ Mizpa kɛ Shem teŋ, ni ewo lɛ gbɛi akɛ “Ebenezer” ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, “Biɛ Yehowa eye ebua wɔ kɛbashi.” Aye Filistibii lɛ anɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛnaji enyɔ nɛkɛ yiii Israelbii lɛ akpokpai lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni Samuel yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ Filistibii lɛ agbɛ koni amɛbatua Israel.
Maji fɛɛ ni Filistibii lɛ eshɔ̃ yɛ Israelbii lɛ adeŋ lɛ, amɛkpale fɛɛ amɛhã Israel ekoŋŋ, kɛjɛ Ekron aahu kɛyashwie Gat.
Israel nine shɛ eshikpɔji fɛɛ hu ni yaje Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni toiŋjɔlɛ ba Israelbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ hu ateŋ.
Samuel kwɛ Israel nɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni daa afi lɛ efãa gbɛ eyasaraa Betel kɛ Gilgal kɛ Mizpa, ni ekojoɔ sajisaji ni eba hei nɛɛ, ni ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛbaa Rama, ejaakɛ jɛi ewe yɔɔ; ni jɛi hu ekwɛɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ.
Samuel ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Rama ehã Yehowa.
Israelbii bi akɛ ahã amɛ Maŋtsɛ Be ni Samuel gbɔ lɛ ewo ebihii lɛ kojolɔi ni amɛkojoɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ saji yɛ Israel.
Ekromɔbi ni gbɛi ji Yoel lɛ, kɛ lɛ esɛɛho ni gbɛi ji Abia lɛ ji nɔyelɔi ni ekɛto Beersheba.
Shi Samuel bihii lɛ eyakɔɔɔ amɛtsɛ jeŋba kwraa.
Amɛyadi ninamɔ sɛɛ ni amɛhehee nyɔɔŋnii, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ saji ahiɛ amɛbumɔ shi.
Enɛ hã Israel maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛba Samuel ŋɔɔ yɛ Rama, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amrɔ nɛɛ ogbɔ, ni obihii lɛ eyakɔɔɔ ojeŋba.
No hewɔ lɛ, wo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ koni lɛ ekwɛ wɔnɔ tamɔ eyɔɔ yɛ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ anɔ lɛ.” Sane lɛ eyaŋɔɔɔ Samuel naa akɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔ maŋtsɛ ni ekwɛ wɔnɔ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Samuel sɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Nibii fɛɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɔ bo lɛ, feemɔ ohã amɛ; ejaakɛ jeee bo amɛkwa; shi mi moŋ amɛkwa akɛ mikaye amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Bɔ pɛ ni amɛfee mi kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, ni amɛkwa mi ni amɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfeɔ bo hu nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo amɛ toi; shi kɛ̃lɛ gba mli kpoo okɛɛ amɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nibii ni mɔ ni baaye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ baatao yɛ amɛdɛŋ.” Samuel gba maŋbii ni biɔ lɛ koni ewo maŋtsɛ ehã amɛ lɛ nɔ ni Yehowa wie lɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ni baaye nyɛnɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ baaye ehã nɛ: Ebaaŋɔ nyɛbihii lɛ, ni ebaahã amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ahi eshwiilii ahe, ni mɛi komɛi akwɛ ekpɔŋɔi, ni mɛi komɛi ajojoo foi kɛnyiɛ eshwiilii ahiɛ.
Ebaawo mɛi komɛi asafoiatsɛmɛi ehã mɛi akpekpei kui kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ kui ehã ehe.
Ebaahã mɛi komɛi ahu eŋmɔji amɛhã lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu akpa eŋmɔshinii, ni mɛi komɛi atswia etawuunii kɛ eshwiilii ahe nii.
Nyɛbiyei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, ebaafee mɛi komɛi tsofakɛŋma futulɔi, kɛ mɛi komɛi nihoolɔi kɛ mɛi komɛi hu aboloo shãlɔi.
Ebaashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛŋmɔji kɛ nyɛwain abɔi kpakpai kɛ nyɛmutsei ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛbaahã etsuji.
Kɛji nyɛkpa ŋmɔshi ŋmãa kɛ nyɛwain abɔi amli nii lɛ hu, ebaaŋɔ amɛmlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome ni ekɛbaahã epiafoi kɛ etsuji.
Ebaashɔ̃ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei kɛ nyɛblahii fɛɛfɛji kɛ nyɛtsinai kɛ nyɛteji kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ koni amɛyatsu lɛ enii amɛhã lɛ.
Ebaaŋɔ nyɛtooi amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome ehã ehe, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ enyɔji.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaafo shi Yehowa efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ Samuel toiboo, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnu; shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ja wɔna maŋtsɛ ni eye wɔnɔ kɛ̃, koni wɔ hu wɔtamɔ majimaji fɛɛ akɛ wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ, ni lɛ ekwɛɔ wɔnɔ, koni asaŋ kɛ ta ba lɛ enyiɛ wɔhiɛ kɛ wu tai lɛ ehã wɔ.” Be ni Samuel nu hetoo ni maŋbii lɛ hã lɛ ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Bo amɛ toi, ni owo maŋtsɛ ohã amɛ.” Samuel kɛɛ Israel hii lɛ agbɛnɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ!
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.”
Saul kɛ Samuel Benyamin nuu niiatsɛ ko hi shi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kish.
Etsɛ gbɛi ji Abiel, Benyaminnyo Afia bi Bekorat bi Zeror lɛ bi ni.
Kish nɛɛ yɛ binuu, oblanyo nɛɛ he yɛ fɛo yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ; ni kɛjɛ ekɔŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ oblanyo lɛ kwɔ fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ Israel.
Saul tsɛ Kish tejii laaje.
Kɛkɛ ni Kish kɛɛ ebi Saul akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ofata ohe koni oya oyatao tejii lɛ.” Saul kɛ tsulɔ lɛ yakpa Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛyaje Shalisha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛmiitao kooloi lɛ, shi amɛnaaa amɛ.
Amɛyakpa Shaalim shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi amɛnaaa amɛ; kɛkɛ ni amɛtee Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ; shi amɛnaaa tejii lɛ.
Be ni Saul kɛ tsulɔ lɛ yashɛ Zuf shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni fata ehe lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔya shĩa; kɛjeee nakai lɛ mitsɛ aaafɔ̃ɔ tejii lɛ ahe jwɛŋmɔ, ni etsui baaye yɛ wɔ moŋ wɔhe.” Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Ole?
Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ko yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli ni abuɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni egbaa lɛ baa mli; hã wɔtee wɔyana lɛ; eko lɛ eeegba wɔ nyiɛmɔ ni wɔnyiɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko.” Saul kɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nɛkɛ wɔhiɛ ni kɛ wɔtee ni wɔkɛbaayahã nuu lɛ?
Aboloo ni yɔɔ wɔkotokui amli lɛ hu etã.
Mɛni dɔŋŋ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛaatee wɔyake Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔ lɛ?” Oblanyo lɛ hã Saul hetoo ekɛɛ, “Mihiɛ jwiɛtɛi shekel mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome yɛ biɛ; mikɛbaahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbalɔ lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ he ni wɔtsɔ̃.” (Sa lɛ kɛji mɔ ko yaabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ, bɔ ni akɛɔ yɛ Israel ji “Wɔtee ninalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Ejaakɛ mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ gbalɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ lɛ sa lɛ ninalɔ atsɛɔ lɛ.)
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ!
Hã wɔtee.” Ni amɛyi mli kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛhereɔ ŋmeŋme lɛ kɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛkɛ oblayei komɛi kpe ni amɛmiiya amɛyayɛ nu, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfai nɛ!
Ninalɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lo?” Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Eyɛ.
Naa, lɛ eyaa yɛ nyɛhiɛ nɔŋŋ nɛɛ.
Nyɛhe afea oya.
Amrɔ nɛɛ ebashɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ miishã afɔle ŋmɛnɛ yɛ jamɔhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋ lɛ mli botemɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛaana lɛ dani eya gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyaye nii.
Ja eyashɛ shi dani maŋbii lɛ baaye nii lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajɔɔ niyenii lɛ nɔ dani mɛi ni akpee lɛ aye.
Nyɛyaa oya, ejaakɛ be mli nɔŋŋ ni nyɛnine aaashɛ enɔ nɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Saul kɛ etsulɔ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛboteɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ amɛna Samuel ni eeya jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ lɛ kpe.
Gbi ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ dani Saul ba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa ekɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Wɔ benɛ mli lɛ mibatsu nuu ko ni jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli oŋɔɔ koni ofɔ lɛ mu, ni owo lɛ mimaŋ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Lɛ ebaahere mimaŋbii lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.
Mina amɛnɔnaa lɛ, ni minu tsɛmɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ koni ahere amɛ lɛ.” Be ni Samuel na Saul lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ “Mɔ he ni mi kɛ bo wie lɛ nɛ.
Mɔnɛ ji mɔ ni baaye mimaŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Saul kɛ Samuel kpe yɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa, kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi ninalɔ lɛ shĩa lɛ.” Samuel here Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Mi ni.
Tsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛya gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi baaye nii ŋmɛnɛ; wɔ leebi lɛ mawo bo gbɛ, ni magba bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbaa ojwɛŋmɔ naa lɛ.
Kɛ ka nyɛtejii lɛ ni laaje ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, kaaye otsui, ejaakɛ ana amɛ.
Namɔ ole ni Israel shweɔ amrɔ nɛɛ fe bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ?” Saul here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Benyaminnyo ji mi, no hewɔ lɛ, mijɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ lɛ mli; ni Benyamin akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ ateŋ humi fe fɛɛ mli mijɛ?
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ mi enɛ nɛɛ lɛ?” Saul nyiɛ Samuel kɛ etsulɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛtee niyelihe asa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛyatara mɛi aaashɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni akpee amɛ niyeli lɛ ayitso.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ nihoolɔ lɛ akɛ, “Loo lɛ ni mikɛhã bo shitoo ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ okɛto afã lɛ, kɛba.” Nihoolɔ lɛ yawo loo shuɔ lɛ kɛba ni ekɛbama Saul hiɛ.
Ni Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Nɔ ni akɛsara osɛɛ nɛ.
Ye, ejaakɛ bo ohewɔ akɛto koni kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛ lɛ okɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ afutu aye nii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Saul kɛ Samuel ye nii nakai gbi lɛ.
Be ni amɛshi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkpeleke shi kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, afee saa yɛ shĩa lɛ yiteŋ ahã Saul, ni ekã jɛi ewɔ.
Enɔ maŋkɛ mra be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ lɛ, Samuel tsɛ Saul yɛ shĩa lɛ yiteŋ ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oba koni mawo bo gbɛ ni oya.” Saul te shi, ni lɛ kɛ Samuel fɛɛ je kpo amɛyi tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛɔ maŋ lɛ klotia lɛ Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ tsulɔ lɛ koni ebaho eyi wɔhiɛ koni ekitee.
Kɛji eyi hiɛ ni eekitee lɛ, bo lɛ owa ni omɛ shrao koni magba bo nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ bo kɛɛmɔ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel jie mu kɛ tɔ ko, ni efɔse mu lɛ eshwie Saul yiteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni eshwɔ Saul naa ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa efɔ bo mu koni oye ewebii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛlumɔ, koni ohere amɛ yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ni ebɔle amɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
Ni okadi ni atoɔ bo yɛ he akɛ Yehowa efɔ bo mu koni oye emɛi lɛ anɔ lumɔ nɛ.
Kɛji okɛ mi gbala mli ŋmɛnɛ ni ooya lɛ, okɛ hii enyɔ komɛi baakpe yɛ Rahel saŋ lɛ he yɛ Zelza, yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Tejii lɛ ni otee amɛtaomɔ lɛ ana amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, otsɛ efɔ̃ɔ tejii lɛ ahe jwɛŋmɔ, ni etsui miiye yɛ ohewɔ.’ Eekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Te mafee tɛŋŋ yɛ mibi lɛ hewɔ hu?’ Kɛji oshi jɛi lɛ obaaya ohiɛ aahu kɛyashi oooyashɛ Tabor odum kpeteŋkple lɛ he.
Hii etɛ̃ komɛi ni miiya Betel ayashã afɔle ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo baakpe yɛ jɛi.
Amɛteŋ mɔ kome hiɛ abotiabii etɛ̃, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ aboloo akwaabɔi etɛ̃, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ wain wolo tɔ kome.
Amɛbaafala bo, ni amɛbaahã bo aboloo akwaabɔi enyɔ; hemɔ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, obaaya oyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Gibea he ni Filistibii asraafoi yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛji obɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ, okɛ gbalɔi asafo ku baakpe ni amɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛmiikpeleke shi, ni akɛ obenta kɛ milɛ kɛ blɛ kɛ saŋku nyiɛ amɛhiɛ, ni asaŋ amɛmiigba.
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ baatsi bo, ni obaaya oyashi gbalɔi nɛɛ anɔ kɛgba, ni obaatsɔ gbɔmɔ kroko kwraa.
Kɛji okadii nɛɛ ba mli nakai hã bo lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaaje ogbɛfaŋ lɛ ofee ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni baakpala bo.
No sɛɛ lɛ, otsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛya Gilgal.
Miiba jɛi ni mibashã shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei.
Hii shi yɛ jɛi ni omɛ gbii kpawo kɛyashi mibaba mibanina bo, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee.” Be ni Saul tsɔ̃ ehe ni eshi Samuel lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsake Saul tsui.
Okadii lɛ fɛɛ ba mli nakai gbi lɛ.
Saul kɛ oblanyo tsulɔ lɛ yashɛ Gibea pɛ, ni gbalɔi asafo ku ko kɛ Saul bakpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ bayi Saul nɔ, ni eyashi gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ni ekɛ amɛ gba.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni le Saul sa ni asaŋ amɛna akɛ ekɛ gbalɔi lɛ miigba lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni feɔ Kish bi lɛ nɛɛ?
Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ lo?” Maŋ lɛ mli nyo ko here nɔ akɛ, “Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, namɛi po ji amɛtsɛmɛi?” Bɔ ni fee ni ana abɛ akɛ, “Mɛni, Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ lo” lɛ nɛ.
Be ni Saul egba etã lɛ, etee afɔleshãahe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Saul tsɛkwɛ ko bi Saul kɛ eblanyo tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛjɛ?” Saul jie naa akɛ, “Wɔtee tejii ataomɔ, ni be ni wɔyanaaa amɛ lɛ wɔtee Samuel ŋɔɔ.” Saul tsɛkwɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbaa mi nɔ ni Samuel kɛɛ nyɛ.” Saul kɛɛ etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ akɛ, “Ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ ana tejii lɛ.” Shi Saul egbaaa etsɛkwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ ni Samuel kɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ ni ebaye lɛ he lɛ.
Ato Saul Maŋtsɛ Samuel kpee Israelbii lɛ kɛba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Mizpa, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mi, mikpala Israel kɛje Ijipt, ni mijie nyɛ yɛ Ijiptbii adɛŋ kɛ majimaji ni gba nyɛnaa lɛ hu adɛŋ.
Shi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛkwa mi, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni hereɔ nyɛyiwala kɛjeɔ nyɛmanehului kɛ nyɛfimɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɛ dabida, shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mito maŋtsɛ mihã nyɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛtoa kɛbaa mi Yehowa mihiɛ yɛ nyɛkutsei kɛ nyɛshĩai anaa.” Samuel hã Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ tsi ba ekomekome, ni oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ yagbee Benyamin akutso lɛ nɔ.
Ehã Benyamin akutso lɛ tsi ba yɛ amɛwekui anaa, ni oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ yagbee Matribii awe lɛ nɔ.
Naagbee lɛ ehã Matribii awe lɛ mli hii lɛ tsi ba ekomekome, ni oshiku ni afɔ̃ lɛ yagbee Kish bi Saul nɔ.
Shi be ni atao lɛ lɛ, anaaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, aku sɛɛ ni abi Yehowa nii ekoŋŋ akɛɛ, “Ani gbɔmɔ lɛ hu ba biɛ lo?” Yehowa to he akɛ, “Naa, eyateee ehe yɛ jatsui lɛ ateŋ.” Oya ni asha foi ni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba.
Be ni Saul badamɔ mɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ekwɔ fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ ekɔŋ kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛna mɔ ni Yehowa eŋɔ lɛ?
Mɔ ko mɔ kɔ kɛ lɛ yeee egbɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ.” Agbɛnɛ Samuel gba maŋ lɛ nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ baatsu ahã amɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛgbɛnaanii ni amɛbaatsu amɛhã maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Samuel ŋmala nibii lɛ fɛɛ ewo wolo mli, ni ekɛŋmɛ Yehowa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel wo maŋ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshĩa.
Saul hu tee ewe lɛ yɛ Gibea, ni hii kakabãŋi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsake amɛtsuii fata ehe kɛtee.
Shi hii yakagbɔmɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔnɛ nɛɛ aaahere wɔyiwala lɛ?” Amɛgbe Saul he guɔ, ni amɛbakeee lɛ nɔ ko.
Shi Saul ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko.
Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash fã ta kɛba, ni ebasa Yabesh yɛ Gilead maŋbii lɛ ayi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yabesh hii lɛ tsu ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nahash akɛ, “Okɛ wɔ akpãŋ ni wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ bo.” Shi Nahash, Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, hã amɛ hetoo ekɛɛ, “Dani mikɛ nyɛ aaakpãŋ ni wɔfee ekome lɛ, ja nyɛhã mifamɔ nyɛninejurɔ hiŋmɛii fɛɛ yɛ nyɛyitsei ahe koni kpa ni nyɛbaaje lɛ ahã Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ashwie shi.” Yabesh maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ Nahash akɛ, “Hã wɔ gbii kpawo.
Wɔbaatsu bɔfoi kɛya Israel maji fɛɛ anɔ.
Kɛji ayanaaa mɔ ko abahere wɔ lɛ koni wɔkɛ wɔhe abahã bo.” Be ni Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ yashɛ maŋ ni ji Gibea, he ni Saul yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛbɔ amɛmaniɛ lɛ, maŋtso muu lɛ wo yara.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul miikpala tsinai kɛjɛ ŋa nɔ kɛmiiba shĩa, ni ebi mɔ ko akɛ, “Mɛni eba ni awo yara nɛkɛ nɛɛ?” Ni abɔ lɛ amaniɛ ni Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ kɛba lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ wo Saul ekãa titri ko be ni enu amaniɛ lɛ, asaŋ emli hu wo la naakpa.
Emɔmɔ tsinai enyɔ egbe, ni efolɔ amɛmli bibiibii, ni ekɛtsu Yabesh bɔfoi lɛ akɛ amɛkɛyakpa Israel majimaji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni wiemɔ ni fata he ji akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efãaa ta kɛbaaa ebawaaa Saul kɛ Samuel lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaafee mɔ lɛ tsinai lɛ.” Israelbii lɛ she nɔ ni Yehowa aaafee amɛ lɛ he gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eshwɛɛɛ nuu kome ni emĩaaa kɛyaaa ta lɛ eko.
Saul hã Israel naa yakpe shi yɛ Bezek, ni be ni ekane amɛ lɛ amɛyibɔ fee akpei ohai etɛ̃, ni Yuda kɔkrɔɔ hii ayibɔ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul shɛ bɔfoi lɛ ni atsu kɛba lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Yabeshbii yɛ Gilead akɛ, ‘Wɔ be ni hulu kɛɛ edamɔɔ lɛ ahere nyɛyiwala.’ ” Be ni bɔfoi lɛ babɔ Yabeshbii lɛ amaniɛ lɛ amɛtsui nyɔ amɛmli, ni amɛhã ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nahash akɛ, “Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe baaba abahã nyɛ koni nyɛfee wɔ bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ.” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Saul ja etabilɔi lɛ amli kui etɛ̃, ni amɛyatua Amonbii lɛ maŋkɛ hima mli, yɛ amɛnsra lɛ mli, ni amɛtswia amɛ nii kɛyashi shwane fintiŋŋ.
Amonbii ni je gbele mli lɛ gbɛ shwã bɔ ni onaŋ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ nɛkɛ yɛ he kome.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nakai mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ Saul hu ni baaye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?
Akɛ amɛ aba ni wɔgbe amɛ!’ ” Shi Saul to he ekɛɛ, “Ashwieŋ la shi ŋmɛnɛ, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ Yehowa ehere Israel yiwala.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni wɔtea Gilgal koni wɔsaa wɔwo Saul maŋtsɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ loo mli kɛtee Gilgal, ni amɛyawo Saul maŋtsɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛshãshãa shidaa afɔlei yɛ jɛi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni Saul kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nya jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Wiemɔ ni Samuel wie ni ekɛ maŋbii lɛ ye shɛɛ Samuel kɛɛ Israel fɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni nyɛbi mi lɛ mifee, ni miwo maŋtsɛ mihã nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ nyiɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
Mi lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ migbɔ ni miyi eyɛ, ni mibihii lɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ.
Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Mi nɛ; nyɛyea odase nyɛshia mi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ emɔ̃ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hu hiɛ.
Namɔ tsina mishɔ̃, ni namɔ teji mishɔ̃?
Aloo namɔ ojo mitswa, aloo namɔ yi miwa?
Ni namɔ dɛŋ mihe nyɔɔŋnii yɛ koni maku mihiɛ mafɔ esane nɔ?
Nyɛwiea koo, koni mato nyɛ najiaŋ.” Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Otswako wɔ ojo lɛ, owako wɔ yi lɛ, oshɔ̃ko mɔ ko dɛŋ nɔ ko hu.” Samuel to he ni ekɛɛ, “Yehowa ji midasefonyo mɔ, ni emɔ̃ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hu miiye he odase ŋmɛnɛ akɛ mɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ midɛŋ.” Amɛto he akɛ, “Lɛ ji odasefonyo lɛɛlɛŋ.” Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ji odasefonyo lɛɛlɛŋ, lɛ mɔ ni ehala Mose kɛ Aaron ni ejie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛdamɔa shi nyɛmɛa koni mi kɛ nyɛ akojoa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ekɛhere nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni Yakob tee Ijipt ni Ijiptbii lɛ yeɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anyɔŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa tsu Mose kɛ Aaron ni amɛyajie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɛ Ijipt kɛba, ni amɛhã amɛbahi biɛ nɛɛ.
Shi nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ kpa Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã, ni Hazor Maŋtsɛ Yabin tatsɛ Sisera lɛ, kɛ Filistibii lɛ hu kɛ Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ hu kɛ amɛ wuwuu tai, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ye nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ.
Enɛ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ, ‘Wɔfee esha, ejaakɛ wɔkwa bo, Yehowa, ni wɔyasɔmɔ Baali kɛ Astarte moŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ heremɔ wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni wɔbaasɔmɔ bo.’ No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa tsu Gideon (ni ji Yerubaal) kɛ Barak kɛ Yefta kɛ mi Samuel hu, ni etsɔ̃ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ ehere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ yɛ hei fɛɛ; kɛkɛ ni nyɛhi shi shweshweeshwe.
Shi be ni nyɛna akɛ Nahash, Amonbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ, efã nyɛyi nɔ ta lɛ, nyɛkɛɛ mi akɛ ‘Dabi, wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ; ja wɔna maŋtsɛ ni eye wɔnɔ,’ tsɛbelɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ji nyɛmaŋtsɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, naa, maŋtsɛ lɛ ni nyɛtao ni nyɛbi lɛ, ahã nyɛ.
Naa, Yehowa ewo maŋtsɛ ehã nyɛ.
Kɛji nyɛaashe Yehowa gbeyei, ni nyɛaasɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛaaye egbee nɔ, ni nyɛtseŋ ekitã lɛ hiɛ atua, ni asaŋ nyɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni yeɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaanyiɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛjeŋ baaja ahã nyɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛyayeee Yehowa gbee nɔ; shi nyɛtse ekitã lɛ hiɛ atua lɛ no lɛ Yehowa baagbala nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkwɛa naakpɛɛ nɔ ko ni Yehowa baafee.
Ani jeee ŋmãakuu be mli ji ŋmɛnɛ?
Ojogbaŋŋ!
Mibasɔle matsɛ Yehowa koni ehã ŋwɛi ashimɔ, ni nu hu anɛ koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛshi Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyɛbi akɛ ahã nyɛ lɛ, eda naakpa.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel sɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni ehã ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni nu nɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ she Yehowa kɛ Samuel gbeyei.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpa Samuel fai amɛkɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, kpa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ohã wɔ otsuji koni wɔkagboi, ejaakɛ eshai fɛɛ ni wɔfee sa lɛ wɔfee eko hu wɔfata he akɛ wɔbi akɛ ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.” Shi Samuel kɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛna nyɛfee nɛkɛ nɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkakpalea kɛjea Yehowa sɛɛ, shi moŋ nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ.
Nyɛkagbaa afã kɛyanyiɛ yaka nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni asaŋ nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ahere lɛ asɛɛ; ejaakɛ yaka nibii ni.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ nyɛ yɛ egbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ esa ehiɛ hu akɛ ekɛ nyɛ afee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Mi hu enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ akɛ makpa sɔlemɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ ni mikɛfee esha mishi Yehowa.
Shi moŋ mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ja ni sa akɛ nyɛfee.
Nyɛshea Yehowa kɛkɛ gbeyei; asaŋ nyɛsɔmɔa lɛ yɛ anɔkwayeli mli kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ.
Nyɛkaia nibii wuji abɔ ni etsu ehã nyɛ lɛ.
Shi naa, kɛji nyɛkã he nyɛfee nifɔɔjianii lɛ, no lɛ aaabɛɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ fɛɛ ashwie.”
Israel kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu Saul eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ be ni ebɔ̃i Israel nɔ yeli akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ lɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Saul hala hii tabilɔi akpei etɛ̃ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Ekɛ hii tabilɔi nɛɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei enyɔ hi Mikmash yɛ Betel yɛ gɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛteŋ akpe hu kɛ Yonatan hi Gibea yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Israel hii ni shwɛ lɛ Saul wo amɛ gbɛ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshĩa.
Yonatan yatua Filistibii asraafoi aku ko ni yɔɔ Gibea lɛ, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim.
Filistibii lɛ nu sane nɛɛ he, no hewɔ lɛ, Saul tsu koni ayakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ashiɛ kɛtsɛ ta yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, koni akɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, Hebribii!
Naa, Saul eyaye Filistibii asraafoi aku ko nɔ kunim, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Filistibii lɛ ekã kɛbaaye wie!” Israelbii here tsɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtiu Saul yɛ Gilgal.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ bua amɛhe naa koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ abawu.
Amɛhiɛ ta shwiilii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpei ekpaa kɛ asraafoi ni yifalɛ oookɛɛ ŋshɔnaa shia; ni amɛfã ta kɛgba, ni amɛbabɔ nsra yɛ Mikmash yɛ Bet-Aven bokãgbɛ.
Be ni Israel hii lɛ na akɛ nine miitao akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ (ejaakɛ ta lɛ miinyɛ amɛ) lɛ, mɛi yateetee amɛhe yɛ tɛkploi kɛ bui kɛ tɛsai kɛ gbonyobui kɛ nubui amli, ni mɛi komɛi hu jo foi amɛyafo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛtee Gad kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Saul yɛ Gilgal lolo, ni mɛi ni ena nyiɛ esɛɛ lolo fɛɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.
Saul mɛ Samuel gbii kpawo, ni ji be ni Samuel to lɛ lɛ; shi Samuel eyashɛɛɛ shi, ni maŋ lɛ hu miijwa kɛmiishi Saul.
Enɛ hã Saul fã akɛ, “Akɛ shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ abahã mi yɛ biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul shã afɔle lɛ.
Shi afɔle lɛ ni eshã egbe naa pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa Samuel ni ebashɛ shi.
Saul tee ni ekɛ Samuel yakpe ni efala lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Saul akɛ, “Kwɛ, mɛni ofee nɛɛ?” Saul jie enaa akɛ, “Be ni mina akɛ maŋ lɛ miijwa kɛmiishi mi, ni gbi ni oto lɛ ebaho fɛɛ ni obashɛko shi, ni asaŋ Filistibii lɛ anaa ebakpe shi yɛ Mikmash lɛ, nɔ ni misusu ji akɛ Filistibii lɛ baaba abatua mi yɛ Gilgal, be mli ni mibiko Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, fimɔ naa lɛ, mimia mihiɛ, ni mishã afɔle lɛ.” Samuel to he ehã Saul akɛ, “Oye gbekɛbii asane pam.
Oyeko kitã ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wo bo lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ kpaako Yehowa baawaje omaŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel nɔ ema shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Yehowa ŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui naa gbɔmɔ ni ewo lɛ emaŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ; mɛni hewɔ lɛ oyayeee kitã ni Yehowa wo bo lɛ nɔ.” Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul shi Gilgal ni etee Geba yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ekane hii tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ, ena mɛi aaafee ohai ekpaa.
Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛ tabilɔi ni fata amɛhe lɛ wa yɛ Geba, yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ ewo shi yɛ Mikmash.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ wo asafoi etɛ̃ agbɛ kɛjɛ amɛta lɛ mli koni amɛyatua Israelbii lɛ koni amɛha amɛnii.
Ku kome tsɔ̃ Ofra gbɛ kɛtee Shual shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ku kome hu tsɔ̃ Bet-Horon gbɛ, ni ku kome ko hu tsɔ̃ husu lɛ ni kwɛɔ Zeboim Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ sɔ̃lɔ kome nɛkɛ bɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko, ejaakɛ Filistibii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji afeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ Hebribii lɛ aaasɔ̃ klantei kɛ akplɔi ato amɛhe.” Belɛ Filistibii lɛ aŋɔɔ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ni eyajɔɔ etsina kɔi kɛ shitsaa kɔi kɛ lema kɛ jwɛifoo kakla fɛɛ naa.
Aheɔ amɛ nɔ ko fioo ko kɛji ajɔ tsina kɔi loo shitsaa kɔi naa.
Shi kɛji ajɔ tsinakplamɔ dade naa lɛ, aheɔ jwiɛtɛi shekel kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ ni kɛhã lema lɛ naajɔɔ lɛ aheɔ shekel kome mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbi ni atswa ta lɛ, anaaa Saul kɛ Yonatan sɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ni ehiɛ klante loo akplɔ, fe Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛkɛ ni amɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ eko.
Filistibii lɛ wo asraafoi aku gbɛ kɛtee Mikmash jɔɔ lɛ mli koni amɛyabu jɛi tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ he.
Ekãa ni Yonatan fee Gbi ko lɛ Saul bi Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ etawuunii lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni wɔfo mli wɔyahɛŋ Filistibii asraafoi ni yɔɔ amɛsra lɛ mli yɛ jɛi lɛ.” Shi Yonatan wooo etsɛ Saul toi nɔ.
Be nɛɛ lɛ Saul ebawa yɛ aduawa tso ni yɔɔ Migron lɛ shishi yɛ Gibea kpokpai anɔ.
Tabilɔi ni fata ehe ayifalɛ aaafee ohai ekpaa, ni Ahia ji mɔ ni wo efod lɛ.
Osɔfo Eli, mɔ ni ye Yehowa osɔfo yɛ Shilo lɛ, bi Finehas bi Ikabod nyɛmi Ahitub bi ji Ahia nɛɛ.
Shi maŋ lɛ leee kwrakwra akɛ Yonatan eje amɛteŋ etee he ko.
Gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe he ni Yonatan tao akɛ etsɔ̃ kɛyatua Filistibii asraafoi lɛ, tɛsai enyɔ komɛi ewo lɛ teŋ.
Tɛi ni yɔɔ tɛsai nɛɛ amli lɛ anaa eje kpo vɛŋŋvɛŋŋ.
Ekome ye afã kroko, ni ekome hu yɛ afã kome nɛɛ.
Ekome gbɛi ji Bozez, ni ekome hu gbɛi ji Sene.
Ekome ye kooyigbɛ yɛ Mikmash gbɛ, ni ekome lɛ hu ye wuoyigbɛ yɛ Gibagbɛ.
Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛ edama lɛ akɛ, “Wɔfo mli wɔtee wɔyahɛŋ foolɔi nɛɛ asraafoi lɛ; shi eko lɛ Yehowa aaaye abua wɔ ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii Yehowa naa akɛ ekɛ mɛi pii loo mɛi fioo aaahere yiwala.” Oblanyo lɛ ni hiɛ tawuunii lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni oookɛɛ; mi kɛ bo, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ.” Yonatan kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ; wɔbaafo mli kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni wɔbajie wɔhe kpo koni amɛna wɔ.
Kɛji no sɛɛ ni amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛmɛa, shi wɔmiiba wɔkɛ nyɛ abakpe’ lɛ, wɔbaawa wɔdamɔ wɔnajiaŋ.
Shi kɛji amɛkɛɛ wɔ akɛ ‘Nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaa’ lɛ, no lɛ wɔbaaya wɔyanina amɛ, ejaakɛ no ji okadi akɛ Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ewo wɔdɛŋ koni wɔye amɛnɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ edama hiɛlɔ lɛ fɛɛ jie amɛhe kpo ni amɛhã Filistibii asraafoi lɛ na amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa, Hebribii lɛ miifamɔ kpo kɛjɛ bui amli hei ni amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ lɛ.” Ni Filistibii asraafoi lɛ bo tsɛ Yonatan kɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ edama lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaa!
Wɔbaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ edama lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ, shi Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ewo Israel dɛŋ.” Yonatan nyiɛ yɛ eniji kɛ enaji anɔ kɛkwɔ tɛsaa lɛ, ni etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ hu fee nakai nɔŋŋ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yonatan yatua Filistibii lɛ ni eku mɛi fɛɛ ni baje hiɛ lɛ eshwie shi, bɛlɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ hu miigbe mɛi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ klante ni Yonatan tse nɛɛ mli lɛ, lɛ kɛ tawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ana gbohii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ hɛkta kome dalɛ mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome fɛɛ ekome nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Filistibii ni yɔɔ nsra lɛ mli kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛ maji fɛɛ amli fɛɛ jijaa, ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ asraafoi ni yɔ nsra lɛ mli lɛ kɛ mɛi ni tee amɛyaaye ofɔ̃ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ hu hoso, ni ehã jijaamɔ lɛ mli wo wu.
Aye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim Saul sɛɛ tabilɔi ni ahã amɛbuɔ yɛ Gibea yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yaakwɛ lɛ naa Filistibii lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã kɛmiiya kɛmiiba.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ esɛɛbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkanea mɛi lɛ koni wɔkɛtao mɔ ni eje wɔteŋ.” Be ni akane mɛi lɛ, Yonatan kɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni bɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Ni Saul kɛɛ Ahia, osɔfo lɛ, akɛ, “Yaawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba biɛ.” Nɛkɛ beiaŋ lɛ he fɛɛ he ni Israelbii lɛ yaa lɛ amɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yaa.
Saul kɛ osɔfo lɛ hiɛ wiemɔ ni hoofeemɔ lɛ naa bawa yɛ Filistibii lɛ ansra lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ osɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Ahi shi dã!” Saul kɛ tabilɔi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ mia ni agbɛnɛ amɛfã kɛtee ta lɛ naa.
Amɛyanina ni Filistinyo klante kã enyɛmi Filistinyo nɔŋŋ nɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hiɛ etsɔ̃ ebu shi efee basaa.
Hebribii ni kɛ Filistibii lɛ yɔɔ sa, asaŋ ni amɛshi Filistibii lɛ anɔ kɛba ta lɛ naa lɛ, kpa amɛhe ni amɛyafata Israelbii lɛ ni kɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan nyiɛ lɛ ahe.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu Israelbii ni jojoo foi amɛyateetee yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ hu fee.
Be ni amɛnu akɛ Filistibii lɛ miijo foi yɛ ta lɛ naa lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbafata he ni anyiɛ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ waa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa here Israel nakai gbi lɛ.
Atswa ta lɛ aahu kɛho Bet-aven maŋ lɛ he.
Ta lɛ sɛɛ saji Israelbii tabilɔi lɛ na nɔ kɛ hɔmɔ nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ Saul kã maŋ lɛ kitã akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasa enaa nɔ ko dani je aaana ni matɔ mihe owele yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ magbe naa lɛ, loomɔ aaalomɔ mɔ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbi muu lɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kwraa esaaa enaa nɔ ko.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ yashɛ koo ko mli, ni wo jwere shikpɔŋ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni tabilɔi lɛ shɛ koo nɛɛ mli lɛ, wo tsereɔ shwieɔ shi nɛɛ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ ewao esaaa eko wooo edaaŋ, ejaakɛ tabilɔi lɛ miishe gbeyei yɛ kitã lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛni Yonatan nuuu be ni etsɛ kãa maŋ lɛ kitã lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ tso ni ehiɛ lɛ naa tsɔ wo agbaku lɛ mli, ni eye wo lɛ eko, kɛkɛ ni ekpɔiaŋ tse lɛ.
Shi tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, “Otsɛ kã maŋ lɛ kitã veveeve akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasa enaa nɔ ko ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, loomɔ kɛ̃ aaalomɔ lɛ; ni no ji biti ni maŋbii lɛ etɔ kɛ hɔmɔ nɛɛ.’ ” Yonatan to he akɛ, “Mitsɛ egba maŋ lɛ naa pam, ejaakɛ wo nɛɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni mikɛsa minaa lɛ, nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni mikpɔiaŋ etse mi.
Eji ŋmɛnɛ lɛ maŋbii lɛ yeyee amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anibii ni amɛna ni ashishii lɛ eko, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ kɛkɛ kulɛ, aso agbeŋ Filistibii lɛ fɛɛ nɛkɛ aahu?” Nakai gbi lɛ Israelbii lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Mikmash aahu kɛyashi Ayalon.
Ni etɔ Israelbii lɛ butuu.
Amɛbɔi nihaa, ni amɛmɔmɔ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tsinabii fɛɛ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛ yɛ amɛnajiaŋ nɔŋŋ, ni amɛye loo lɛ be mli ni loo lɛ mli lá fɛɛ tsereko.
Ayabɔ Saul amaniɛ akɛ, “Naa, maŋbii lɛ miitɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiiye loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko.” Saul here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛnɔkwayeli faaa!
Nyɛkokloa tɛ kpeteŋkple nyɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ!” Saul tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbɛa nyɛshwãa maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ etsina loo etoo lɛ aba ni ebagbe lɛ yɛ biɛ ni eye, shi akaye loo lɛ be mli ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko koni nyɛkɛmiitɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mɔ etsina kɛba, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni amɛbagbegbee kooloi lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni Saul mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi ehã Yehowa.
No ji klɛŋklɛŋ afɔleshãa latɛ ni Saul mã ehã Yehowa.
Enɛ sɛɛ ni Saul kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa koni wɔyatuaa Filistibii lɛ nyɔɔŋ koni wɔgbe amɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ wɛlɛŋŋ; ni wɔkashi amɛteŋ hiɛkãalɔ kome nɛkɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Bɔ ni oookɛɛ.” Shi osɔfo lɛ hu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbia Nyɔŋmɔ nii dã.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Saul bi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ekɛɛ, “Miyatua Filistibii lɛ lo?
Obaahã Israel aye amɛnɔ kunim lo?” Shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa Saul hetoo nakai gbi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Saul tsu atsɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ abahã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbataoa mli akɛ nyɛaana he ni ajɛ afee esha ni ebaje kpo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lo?
Mina Yehowa, Israel yiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛji mibi Yonatan tete ni fee esha nɛɛ lɛ ja egbo.” Shi tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hãaa hetoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaaye afã kome, ni mi kɛ mibi Yonatan hu baaye afã kome.” Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Bɔ ni oookɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba ni ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ohãaa otsulɔ hetoo?
Kɛji esha lɛ mi, loo mibi Yonatan ni fee lɛ, hã Urim atsɔ̃ɔ; shi kɛji owebii Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ajɛ ni afee esha lɛ, no lɛ hã Tumim atsɔ̃ɔ.” Oshiki lɛ gbee Saul kɛ Yonatan nɔ, ni maŋbii lɛ ahe je mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a oshiki lɛ yɛ mi kɛ mibi Yonatan nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, “Gbaa mi nɔ pɔtɛɛ ni ofee lɛ.” Yonatan gba Saul sane lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mikɛ tso ko ni mihiɛ sa wo fioo, ni mikɛsa minaa.
Naa mi, mifee kralo, abaanyɛ agbe mi.” Saul to he ekɛɛ, “Kɛji mihãaa ogbo fii, Yonatan, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni egbe mi ekoŋŋ.” Shi maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Yonatan baagbo lo?
Lɛ mɔ ni eye kunim kpeteŋkple nɛkɛ nɛɛ ehã Israel lɛ?
Akaba mli nakai!
Wɔna Yehowa akɛ Yonatan yiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ efaŋ egbeŋ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ lɛ tsu nɔ ni etsu ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.” Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni maŋbii lɛ here Yonatan yiwala kɛje gbele mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul fɔ̃ɔ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ; ni Filistibii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ anɔ.
Saul maŋtsɛyeli kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii lɛ Be ni Saul batsɔ̃ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekɛ Israel henyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni ebɔle Israel kɛkpe lɛ wu.
Ekɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ kɛ Edombii lɛ kɛ Zoba maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ fɛɛ wuwuu tai.
Ni he fɛɛ he ni Saul tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ eyeɔ kunim.
Saul fee ekãa jogbaŋŋ ni ekɛye Amalekbii lɛ anɔ kunim ni ekɛhere Israelbii lɛ yɛ mɛi ni batuaa amɛ kɛbahaa amɛnii lɛ adɛŋ.
Saul musuŋ bihii lɛ ji Yonatan kɛ Ishvi kɛ Malkishua; ni ebiyei enyɔ lɛ hu agbɛii ji Merab, onukpa lɛ, kɛ Mikal ni ji gbekɛ lɛ.
Saul ŋa lɛ gbɛi ji Ahinoam, Ahimaaz biyoo lɛ.
Etatsɛ nukpa fe fɛɛ ji Abner.
Saul tsɛkwɛ Ner bi ji lɛ.
Saul tsɛ Kish kɛ Abner hu tsɛ Ner lɛ Abiel bihii ji amɛ.
Saul yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Israelbii kɛ Filistibii ateŋ ejɔɔɔ kɛ taitai ni naa wa sɔŋŋ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Saul na nuu hiɛwalɔ loo kãkãlɔ pɛ, eŋɔ lɛ efata tabilɔi ni buɔ ehe lɛ ahe.
Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Israelbii wu ta Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Mi ji mɔ ni Yehowa tsu koni mibafɔ bo mu kɛwo bo emaŋ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi.” Yehowa ni ji Tatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibagbala Amalekbii lɛ atoi yɛ shi ni amɛte amɛwo Israel be mli ni Israel jɛ Ijipt ebaa lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, yaa ni oyatua Amalekbii lɛ, ni okpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Okɛ amɛhe akake amɛ, shi ogbe amɛ, nuu ni jio, abifao ni kã fufɔ naa ni jio, tsina ni jio, yooma ni jio, teji ni jio, ogbe fɛɛ.” No ni Saul hã akpee maŋbii lɛ kɛba, ni akane amɛyibɔ yɛ Telem.
Ana hii ni nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ akpei ohai enyɔ; kɛ Yuda kɔkrɔɔ hii akpei nyɔŋma ashi nɔ.
Saul kɛ tabilɔi lɛ fã kɛba Amalekbii amaŋ wulu lɛ niiaŋ, ni ebawo ka yɛ maŋ lɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛ shɛɛ maje Kenbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Nyɛshia Amalekbii lɛ ateŋ nyɛyaa koni mikakpãtã nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ejurɔ, be ni amɛjɛ Ijipt amɛbaa lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Kenbii lɛ shi Amalekbii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtee.
Saul kɛ Amalekbii lɛ wu, ni eplenee amɛ kɛjɛ Hawila aahu kɛyashi Shur ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Emɔ Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ Agag hiɛkãalɔ; shi agbe emaŋbii lɛ blublu.
Saul kɛ etabilɔi lɛ baa Agag yi.
Asaŋ amɛbaa toi kɛ tsinai kɛ tsinabii kɛ gwantɛŋi abii lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yi; ni amɛkpãtãaa amɛhiɛ; shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kpakpa ko, aloo ni abɛ he nɔ ko feemɔ lɛ amɛkpãtã hiɛ.
Akpoo Saul akɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehowa kɛ Samuel wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mishwa mihe akɛ miwo Saul maŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ ekpale yɛ misɛɛ, ni eyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ.” Sane lɛ fee Samuel mlifu, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Ni Samuel te shi enɔjetsɛremɔ maŋkɛ mra koni enine ayashɛ Saul nɔ leebi.
No mli lɛ abatswa Samuel adafi akɛ, “Saul ba Karmel, ni ebama shiu koni akɛkai kunim ni eye lɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ etee Gilgal.” Be ni Samuel yashɛ Saul ŋɔɔ lɛ, Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ bo!
Miye Yehowa famɔ lɛ nɔ.” Samuel bi Saul akɛ, “Ni mɛni ji toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ abolɔmɔ ni jwere mitoiŋ nɛɛ mɔ?” Saul jie naa ekɛɛ, “Amalekbii lɛ aŋɔɔ akɛjɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ baa toi kɛ tsinai lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ ayi koni amɛkɛbashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ; shi nibii ni shwɛ lɛ wɔkpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ.” Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Mɛɛ!
Magba bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ.” Saul to he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Wiemɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ onaa ohe akɛ mɔ folo ko kɛkɛ; shi ani jeee bo ji Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ atsɛ?
Yehowa fɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ, ni Yehowa tsu bo, ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Yaa koni oyaplenee Amalekbii eshafeelɔi lɛ.
Okɛ amɛ awu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oookpãtã amɛhiɛ kwrakwra.’ Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni oyabooo Yehowa toi, ni otee oyaha ofɔ̃yeli nii, ni okɛtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ nɛɛ?” Saul here Samuel nɔ akɛ, “Mibo Yehowa toi.
Mimɔ Agag, Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛba; ni Amalekbii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikpãtã amɛhiɛ musumusu.
Shi tabilɔi lɛ ŋɔ ofɔ̃yeli nibii lɛ amli toi kɛ tsinai ni kulɛ sa amɛhiɛ kpãtãmɔ lɛ ateŋ kooloi kpakpai fe fɛɛ lɛ koni amɛkɛbashã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ yɛ Gilgal.” Shi Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Ani Yehowa nyaa shãa afɔlei kɛ gbee afɔlei ahe fe ni abaabo lɛ toi lo?
Naa, toiboo hi fe afɔleshãa, ni ehi fe toi agboi amli fɔ.
Ejaakɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ esha ni tamɔ klamɔ nɔŋŋ, ni kuɛŋtimɔ lɛ esha ni tamɔ amãgãjamɔ nɔŋŋ.
Akɛni okwa Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, lɛ hu ekwa bo maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli.” Saul kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Mifee esha, ejaakɛ mitɔ̃ Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ kɛ bo hu owiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ miyashe tabilɔi lɛ agbeyei ni miyabo amɛnaawiemɔ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ miikpa bo fai, koni okɛ mihe esha lɛ afa mi, ni okɛ mi aku osɛɛ kɛya koni mayaja Yehowa.” Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Mikɛ bo ekuŋ sɛɛ kɛyajaŋ ejaakɛ oyayeee fãmɔ ni Yehowa fã bo lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hu ekwa bo maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli yɛ Israel.” Be ni Samuel tsɔ̃ ehe koni eya lɛ, Saul mɔ Samuel atade lɛ naamuu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni atade lɛ gba.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Yehowa shɔ̃ Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ni ekɛhã onaanyo ni hi fe bo.
Naa, Israel Anunyamtsɛ lɛ emaleŋ ni eshwaŋ ehe hu ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ji lɛ, ni eeeshwa ehe.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ akɛ, “Mifee esha; shi kɛ̃lɛ wo mihiɛ nyam yɛ mimaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ mi aku sɛɛ kɛya ni mayaja Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Samuel ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Saul tee, ni Saul yaja Yehowa yɛ Gilgal.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ Agag, Amalekbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ.” Agag bashɛ Samuel hiɛ kɛ ehiɛ miishɛɛmiishɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, “Ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ benɛ ejie gbele sane yɛ eyiŋ.” Shi Samuel kɛɛ Agag akɛ, “Bɔ ni oklante hã yei etsɔmɔ yei ni bɛ bii lɛ, nakai bo hu onyɛ baatsɔ̃ yoo ni bɛ bi yɛ enanemɛi yei ateŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bamɔ Agag kɛ klante, ni efolɔ emli dukuduku yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ yɛ Gilgal.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel yi mli etee Rama, ni Saul hu yi mli ni etee ewe yɛ Gibea.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Samuel kɛ ehiŋmɛitsei enyɔ nɛkɛ enaaa Saul dɔŋŋ aahu kɛyashi Saul gbo; shi Samuel ye Saul he ŋkɔmɔ.
Ni Yehowa shwa ehe akɛ ewo Saul Israel maŋtsɛ.
Afɔ David mu akɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni oooye Saul he ŋkɔmɔ kɛyashi, be mli ni ona ole akɛ mikwa lɛ Israel maŋtsɛyeli?
Wo okoŋ lɛ mli mu obɔ̃; mibatsu bo Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, ŋɔɔ ejaakɛ miŋɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ ebihii lɛ ateŋ mihã mihe.” Samuel to he ekɛɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ matee tsumɔ nɛɛ hu?
Kɛji Saul nu he lɛ eeegbe mi.” Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ tsinabi ohiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya, ni oyakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miba mibashã afɔle mahã Yehowa.’ Kpeemɔ Yeshai kɛba afɔleshãahe lɛ, ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ofee koni ofɔ mɔ ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ mu ohã mi.” Samuel fee nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Be ni eshɛ Betlehem lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛ Samuel bakpe kɛ hekpokpomɔ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ baa oba nɛɛ lo?” Samuel jie naa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ baa miba!
Miba mibashã afɔle mahã Yehowa.
Nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, ni nyɛ kɛ mi ayaa afɔle lɛ shãa.” Etsuu Yeshai kɛ ebihii lɛ ahe, ni ekpee amɛ kɛtee afɔleshãahe lɛ.
Be ni Yeshai kɛ ebihii lɛ ba ni Samuel na Yeshai bi Eliab lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, “Mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ damɔ Yehowa hiɛ nɛɛ.” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Kaahã ehiɛŋtso loo ekwɔlɛ nyɛnyereŋŋ lɛ miilaka bo.
Jeee bɔ ni gbɔmɔ adesa kwɛɔ nii Yehowa kwɛɔ nii.
Gbɔmɔ adesa kwɛɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ nii ekɛyeɔ sane, shi Yehowa lɛ kwɛɔ tsuiŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeshai tsɛ ebi Abinadab ni ehã etsɔ̃ Samuel hiɛ kɛho.
Shi Samuel kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔnɛ hu Yehowa eŋɔko lɛ.” No sɛɛ lɛ, Yeshai hã ebi Shama hu baho; shi Samuel kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mɔnɛ hu Yehowa eŋɔko lɛ.” Yeshai hã ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɛi kpawo baho yɛ Samuel hiɛ; shi Samuel kɛɛ Yeshai akɛ, “Yehowa eŋɔko obii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Yeshai akɛ, “Ani, oblahii lɛ fɛɛ nɛ?” Yeshai to he akɛ, “Eshwɛ amɛteŋ gbekɛ kwraa fe fɛɛ lɛ; amrɔ nɛɛ eekwɛ mitoi lɛ.” Samuel kɛɛ Yeshai akɛ, “Tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba, ejaakɛ wɔwoŋ afɔle lɛ shãa ja ebashɛ biɛ dã.” Yeshai tsu ni ayaŋɔ ebi gbekɛ lɛ kɛba: etsuɔ fioo, ni ehiŋmɛii yɛ fɛo; anɔkwa ehe yɛ fɛo.
Yehowa kɛɛ Samuel akɛ, “Tee shi ni ofɔ oblanyo lɛ mu, ejaakɛ lɛ nɛ.” Samuel wo mu kɛ koŋ lɛ, ni efɔ David mu yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa mumɔ lɛ yi David nɔ!
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Rama.
David yɛ Saul we lɛ mli Yehowa mumɔ lɛ je Saul nɔ agbɛnɛ, ni Yehowa hãa mumɔ fɔŋ ko moŋ bahaoɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Saul tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔsusuɔ akɛ mumɔ fɔŋ ko ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã haoɔ bo nɛɛ.
Ofãa wɔ otsuji ni damɔ ohiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kulɛ, wɔɔɔya wɔyatao mɔ ko ni he esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ saŋkutswaa kɛba koni kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ bayi onɔ lɛ, etswa saŋku lɛ koni ahi ahã bo.” Saul kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyataoa mɔ ko ni le saŋkutswaa jogbaŋŋ nyɛhãa mi, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa.” Oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mile Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, binuu ko ni ehe esa kɛ saŋkutswaa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ; oblanyo kãkãlɔ ni sheee ta naa gbeyei, ni ele mɔ kɛ wiemɔ, ni ehe hu yɛ fɛo, ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Saul tsu bɔfoi kɛ wiemɔ kɛtee Yeshai ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Hã obi David lɛ ni kwɛɔ otoi lɛ abana mi.” Yeshai kɛ aboloo kɛ wain ni yɔɔ kooloo wolo tɔ mli kɛ abotiabi tere teji, ni ekɛhã David koni ekɛyahã Saul.
David yashɛ Saul ŋɔɔ, ni ebɔi lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Saul basumɔ David sane bɔ sɔŋŋ ni efee lɛ etawuuniihiɛlɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Saul kɛ shɛɛ maje ayahã Yeshai akɛ, “Hã David ahi biɛ kwraa, ni esɔmɔ mi ejaakɛ miisumɔ esane.” Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ aba Saul nɔ lɛ, David tswaa saŋku lɛ, ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jeɔ Saul nɔ; ni Saul he jɔɔ lɛ, ni ehiɔ ehãa lɛ.
Goliat tswa Israel mpoa Filistibii lɛ bua amɛtabilɔi lɛ anaa hã ta, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Soko, ni ji Yudabii amaŋ ko, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Efes-Damim yɛ Soko kɛ Azeka teŋ.
Saul kɛ Israel hii lɛ hu bua amɛhe naa kɛkpe, ni amɛgba ta amɛwo Filistibii lɛ, ni amɛmiikwɛ Filistibii lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Filistibii lɛ jwere gɔŋ kome ko hiɛshi, ni Israelbii lɛ hu jwere gɔŋ kroko ko hu hiɛshi, ni jɔɔ kã amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu tatsɛlɔ ko jɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ eje kpo koni ebatsɛ ta.
Atsɛɔ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ Goliat ni ejɛ Gat.
Ekwɔlɛ feɔ ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Ebu akɔɔble fai ni ewo akɔɔble dama ni edama lɛ tsiimɔ ji akɔɔble shekeli akpei enumɔ.
Ewo akɔɔble tswakoto ni etsimɔ enaji ahe, ni akɔɔble fitii bloblo ko ble ekɔji asɛɛ.
Akplɔ ni hiɛ edɛ lɛ tilɛ tamɔ tso ni bleɔ mamaloo tsɔne yiteŋ tilɛ, ni ekpɔlɔ nɛɛ yitso dade tsiimɔ ji shekeli ohai ekpaa; ni mɔ ni hiɛɔ etsɛŋ lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ.
Goliat baho edamɔ shi, ni ebo etsɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛba nyɛbagba sa kɛbaatswa ta?
Filistinyo ji mi, ni nyɛ hu Saul tsuji ji nyɛ?
Nyɛfãa nuu kome ni ekpeleke jɔɔ lɛ ni edamɔ nyɛnaa koni ekɛ mi abakpe.
Kɛji enyɛ mi ekɛnɔ ni egbe mi lɛ, wɔɔɔtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsuji.
Shi kɛji mi minyɛ lɛ migbe lɛ, no lɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ wɔtsuji koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ wɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Filistinyo lɛ kɛɛ, “Miitswa Israel ta lɛ mpoa ŋmɛnɛ!
Nyɛfãa nuu kɛbaa koni ekɛ mi abanɔ.” Be ni Saul kɛ Israelbii lɛ nu Filistinyo nɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ, ŋmiŋmi diɛŋtsɛ mɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
David yɛ Saul tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ Efraimnyo ko ni jɛ Betlehem yɛ Yuda ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yeshai lɛ bi ji David.
Yeshai nɛɛ yɛ bihii kpaanyɔ, Saul yinɔ lɛ Yeshai egbɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Ebihii onukpai etɛ̃ lɛ nyiɛ Saul sɛɛ kɛtee ta lɛ.
Bihii etɛ̃ nɛɛ ni tee ta lɛ agbɛii ji: Eliab, ni ji kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ esɛɛho Abinadab kɛ lɛ hu esɛɛho Shama.
David ji Yeshai bii lɛ ateŋ gbekɛ kwraa.
Be ni ebihii Onukpai etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ Saul tee ta lɛ, kɛfee lɛ David jɛɔ Saul ŋɔɔ ni eyaa eyakwɛɔ etsɛ toi lɛ fioo yɛ Betlehem ni ekuɔ esɛɛ ebaa.
Filistinyo lɛ jeɔ kpo daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, ni ebadamɔɔ shi ni etsɛɔ Israelbii lɛ ŋa nɔ.
Efee nakai gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.
Gbi ko lɛ Yeshai kɛɛ ebi David akɛ, “Hemɔ mamu kiloi nyɔŋma nɛɛ kɛ aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma nɛɛ ni osha ohe oya nsra lɛ mli okɛyahã onyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Okɛ keesui nyɔŋma nɛɛ hu ahã asraafoi akpetsɛ lɛ, mɔ shishi ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ.
Okwɛ bɔ ni onyɛmimɛi lɛ yɔɔ, ni okɛ amɛhe okadi ko aba ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ona amɛ, ni asaŋ amɛyɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Saul kɛ amɛ kɛ Israel tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ela Jɔɔ lɛ mli amɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ miiwu.” David te shi leebi maaŋkpa, ni etu toi lɛ ewo tookwɛlɔ ko dɛŋ ni ewo niyenii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni eshwie nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Yeshai fã lɛ lɛ.
Ebashɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ be mli ni tabilɔi lɛ efã, ni amɛmiibɔ oshe kɛmiiya ta lɛ naa.
Israelbii lɛ ata lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ hu ata lɛ tsi ba, ni ta miikwɛ ta hiɛ.
David shi ejatsu lɛ ehã mɔ ni kwɛɔ tabilɔi lɛ ajatsui lɛ anɔ lɛ, ni esha foi kɛbote tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ, ni eyaŋa enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.
Ekɛ amɛ hiɛ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni nuu tatsɛ kpanaa ko jɛ Filistibii ata lɛ mli ebadamɔ shi, ni ebabɔ̃i Israelbii lɛ mpoatswaa tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ.
David nu wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ.
Be ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ na Goliat lɛ amɛjo foi ejaakɛ gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ naakpa.
Wiemɔ fo shi fee sɛɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛmiina nuu lɛ ni efã kpo lɛ, eeba ebabɔ Israel ahora.
Naa, mɔ ni baanyɛ lɛ egbe lɛ maŋtsɛ baahã mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ niiatsɛ wulu, asaŋ maŋtsɛ kɛ ebiyoo baahã lɛ gbãlã; no sɛɛ hu lɛ abaahã lɛ kɛ eweku fɛɛ akpa toowoo yɛ Israel.” David bihii komɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni akɛɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni aaagbe Filistinyo nɛɛ koni ekpa ahora ni ebɔɔ Israel nɛɛ?
Kwɛ Filistinyo foolɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ebɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tai lɛ ahora?” Hii lɛ here David nɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ ni akɛɛ abaafee ahã mɔ ni aaagbe Filistinyo lɛ.
Shi Eliab, David nyɛminukpa lɛ, nu be ni David kɛ hii lɛ wieɔ lɛ, ni Eliab mli wo la wo David ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛni feemɔ oba yɛ biɛ?
Namɔ oshi toi fioo lɛ ohã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ?
Ona onukpaianii ni ofeɔ lɛ?
Te ta lɛ kwɛmɔ hewɔ oba nɛɛ?” David jie enaa ekɛɛ, “Mɛni mifee?
Jeee sane kɛkɛ mibi?” David shi enyɛmi lɛ sɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehe ekɛ mɔ kroko wie.
Ebi sane kome lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni hetoo koome lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ahã lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Be ni anu wiemɔ ni David wie lɛ, ayabɔ Saul amaniɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul tsu ni ayaŋɔ David abahã lɛ.
David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Mɔ ko mɔ ko tsui akafã yɛ nuu nɛɛ hewɔ.
Otsulɔ aaatee ekɛ nɛkɛ Filistinyo nɛɛ ayakpe.” Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, “Onyɛŋ Filistinyo nɛɛ hiɛ odamɔ, ejaakɛ bo lɛ gbekɛ kɛkɛ ji bo, shi lɛ lɛ ewu ta aahu kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.” Shi David here Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ kwɛɔ etsɛ toi.
Be fɛɛ be ni jata loo oshishibrishi ko aaabamɔ toi lɛ ateŋ toobi ko lɛ, mitiuɔ kooloo lɛ miyatswaa lɛ nɔ, ni mishɔ̃ɔ toobi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ.
Kɛji jata loo oshishibrishi lɛ te shi ewo mi lɛ, mimɔɔ etsɛŋ, ni mitswiaa lɛ nii, ni migbeɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ, jata kɛ oshishibrishi po migbe amɛ.
Akɛni nɛkɛ Filistinyo foolɔ nɛɛ miibɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tai lɛ ahora hewɔ lɛ, eeena nɔ ni kooloi lɛ na yɛ midɛŋ lɛ eko.
Yehowa, mɔ ni jie mi yɛ jata kɛ oshishibrishi daaŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeejie mi yɛ Filistinyo nɛɛ dɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ!
Yaa, ni Yehowa aye abua bo.” Saul kɛ edade atade lɛ wo David, ni ekɛ akɔɔble fai lɛ bu lɛ, ni ewo lɛ dama eshwie atade lɛ nɔ.
David ŋmɔ Saul tawuu klante lɛ yɛ atade lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni David ka nyiɛmɔ lɛ eyanyɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ ewoko nakai atade dã.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Minyɛŋ mawo nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ mikɛyanɔ, ejaakɛ mikako eko mikwɛko dã.” No hewɔ lɛ, David jie nibii lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ edɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ ehiɛ, ni etee faa lɛ naa eyahala fɔbitɛi enumɔ ekɛwo tookwɛlɔi akotoku ni etsotsoro lɛ mli; asaŋ ejie ekromia lɛ ehiɛ, ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ Filistinyo lɛ.
Filistinyo lɛ hu tsi eba, ni ebabɛŋkɛ David.
Be ni Filistinyo lɛ fɔ̃ ehiɛ ni ena David lɛ, ebuuu lɛ, ejaakɛ ena lɛ akɛ oblanyo fioo kɛkɛ ni tsuɔ oo, kɛ ehiɛ fɛo.
Ebi David akɛ, “Ani gbee ji mi hewɔ ni ohiɛ tso kɛbaa minɔ lɛ?” Be ni Goliat etsɛ esɛɛ jemawɔŋ ekɛlomɔ David sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ David akɛ, “Ba!
Bo lɛ shɛ biɛ; mikɛ oloo baahã loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi ni amɛye.” David to he ehã Filistinyo lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ ooba minɔ kɛ klante kɛ akplɔ kɛ tsɛŋ; shi mi lɛ mikɛ bo miiba abakpe yɛ Yehowa ni ji Tatsɛ lɛ, Israel tai ni obɔɔ amɛ ahora lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baahã maye onɔ kunim, ni mafo oyi, ni mikɛ Filistibii ata lɛ mli gbohii lɛ baahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi kakawuai koni amɛye, koni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ Israel.
Asaŋ asafo ni ekpe nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛaana ale akɛ jeee klante loo akplɔ Yehowa kɛhereɔ mɔ yiwala, ejaakɛ ta lɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ji mɔ ni wuɔ, ni ebaaŋɔ nyɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.” Be ni Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ bɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ kɛbaa koni ekɛ David abakpe lɛ, David he fee oya, ni esha foi kɛtee tagbamɔhe lɛ koni enina Goliat yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ enine wo ekotoku lɛ mli, ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia lɛ mli ni efɔ̃.
Tɛ lɛ yatswa Goliat hiɛnaa ni ebote ehiɛŋtso mli; kɛkɛ ni Goliat gbee shi, ni ehiɛ yabu shi.
Belɛ David kɛ akromia kɛ tɛ ye Goliat nɔ, ni egbe lɛ tsɛbelɛ ehiɛɛɛ klante po.
David sha foi oya, ni eyaho edamɔ Goliat nɔ; emɔ Goliat klante lɛ egbala yɛ ehebo lɛ mli ni ekɛfo Goliat yi.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ na akɛ agbe amɛtatsɛ ni tsɛɔ Israel ŋa nɔ lɛ, amɛjo foi.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel kɛ Yuda hii lɛ bɔ oshe, ni amɛtiu Filistibii lɛ kɛ foi.
Amɛnyiɛ Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ kɛyashi Gat kɛ Ekron agboi lɛ anaa.
Gbi lɛ Filistibii pilafoi jwere shi kɛjɛ Shaaraim aahu kɛyashi Gat kɛ Ekron fɛɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Filistibii lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba lɛ, amɛbaha Filistibii lɛ anibii yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ mli.
David kɔ Goliat yitso lɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm; shi Goliat tawuu dade dama lɛ, David hã ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine nɔ yɛ ebuu lɛ mli.
Akɛ David tsɔ̃ɔ Saul Be ni Saul kwɛɔ David yisɛɛ be ni eyaa koni ekɛ Goliat ayakpe lɛ, ebi tatsɛ Abner akɛ, “Abner, namɔ bi ji nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ?” Abner to he akɛ, “Nii, mina onane akɛ mileee,” Saul kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaabi mɔ bi ni ji oblanyo lɛ.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, be ni David eyagbe Goliat ni eku esɛɛ ebaa lɛ, Abner kɛ lɛ tee Saul hiɛ, ni David hiɛ Goliat yitso lɛ.
Saul bi David akɛ, “Namɔ bi ji bo, oblanyo?” David jie lɛ naa ekɛɛ, “Otsulɔ Yeshai, Betlehemnyo lɛ, bi ji mi.”
Be ni Saul kɛ David ewie egbe naa sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan bana David he miishɛɛ, ni esumɔ David tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Saul hu ŋɔ David nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ David aku esɛɛ kɛya etsɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Yonatan sumɔ David tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ David bɔ naanyo ni amɛkpãŋ.
Enɛ hã Yonatan jie ehe nibii ni ekɛwula David, ekɛ etade lɛ kɛ edama lɛ kɛ eklante lɛ kɛ egãi lɛ kɛ emlifiinɔ lɛ hã lɛ.
Tai fɛɛ ni Saul tsu David wuu lɛ, etee eba kɛ omanye; ni no hewɔ lɛ, Saul fee David etatsɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ kome, amɛ ji nɔ ko ni sa Israel hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Saul tsuji lɛ tete fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Saul ye David he awuŋã Be ni David egbe Filistinyo Goliat lɛ, ni Israel tabilɔi lɛ eku amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa shĩa lɛ, Israel yei lɛ jɛjɛɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli amɛkɛ lala kɛ joo bakpee Maŋtsɛ Saul.
Amɛhiɛ fa bii kɛ ŋoŋoi kɛ miji; ni amɛnya; ni amɛla be mli ni amɛnyaa lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Saul egbe akpekpei abɔ, shi David egbe akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ.” Wiemɔ nɛɛ eyaŋɔɔɔ Saul naa kwraa ni emli wo la, ni wiemɔ ni je enaa ji, “Ei!
Akɛɛ David egbe gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ, shi mi lɛ akpeii amli kɛkɛ.
Mɛni shwɛɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ mɔ fe maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔtamɔ?” Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Saul jie ehiɛ eka David.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ, be mli ni David tswaa saŋku ehãa Saul tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ daa gbi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã mumɔ fɔŋ ko bayi Saul nɔ, ni egri yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
No mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul akplɔ lɛ hiɛ edɛ̃.
Saul ekɛɛ yɛ eyitsoŋ akɛ, “Matsu David akplɔ lɛ,” shi David wi ehe shii enyɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehe je mli.
Agbɛnɛ Saul she David gbeyei, ejaakɛ ena akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ David yɛ, shi lɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa lɛ.
Enɛ hã Saul jie David yɛ emasɛi, ni ewo lɛ tabilɔi akpe atsɛ.
David nyiɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee taitai kɛba; ni eko fɛɛ eko mli lɛ David yayeɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ.
Be ni Saul na kunim wuji ni David yeɔ lɛ, gbeyei ni esheɔ David lɛ mli bawo wu.
Shi Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ sumɔ David sane ojogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaa ta ni ekɛ amɛbaa kɛ omanye.
David ŋɔ Saul biyoo ŋa Saul wo David shi akɛ, “Bɛ ona mibiyoo nukpa Merab lɛ?
Mikɛ lɛ baahã bo gbãlã kɛji ooofee ekãa kɛkɛ ni okɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ aaawu ahã mi lɛ.” Saul susumɔ ji akɛ, lɛ tuuŋtu lɛ, ekɛ enine etaŋ David he, shi Filistibii lɛ ji mɛi ni baagbe David ahã lɛ yɛ tai lɛ eko mli.
David kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Namɔ ji mi, ni namɛi ji miwekumɛi kɛ mitsɛ weku lɛ yɛ Israel, ni matsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu?” Be ni shɛ be ni esa akɛ akɛ Saul biyoo, Merab, ahã David gbãlã lɛ, akɛ Merab hã Adriel, Meholatnyo lɛ, moŋ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Saul biyoo ni gbɛi ji Mikal lɛ miisumɔ David.
Be ni atswa Saul adafi akɛ Mikal miisumɔ David lɛ ena mishɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ “Yiɛ!
Mikɛ Mikal baahã lɛ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ akpa ehã lɛ, koni Filistibii lɛ anine agbe lɛ ahã mi.” Enɛ hã Saul wo David shi nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ obaatsɔ mishaanuu.” Saul fã etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnaa David yɛ teemɔ mli, ni nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ ohe mishɛɛ, ni etsuji lɛ fɛɛ hu sumɔɔ osane lɛ, mɛɛba ni okɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ biyoo ehiii shi ni otsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu?’ ” Be ni Saul tsuji lɛ kɛ David yawie wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, David kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Kolɛ nyɛkɛɛ benɛ maŋtsɛ shaanuu tsɔ̃mɔ lɛ shwɛmɔ sane ni?
