Mi hu nɛ, ohiafobi humi ni mijeee mɔ ko.” Saul tsuji lɛ yabɔ lɛ hetoo ni David hã amɛ lɛ.
Shi Saul tsu amɛ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa David akɛ aheee Mikal yinii ko kwraa fe Filistibii lɛ afoo naa loo komekomei oha kɛkɛ, koni akɛtɔ maŋtsɛ he owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.” Saul susumɔ ji akɛ foo naa loo lɛ taomɔ nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni Filistibii lɛ anine baagbe David.
Be ni Saul tsuji lɛ yabɔ David amaniɛ lɛ, emii shɛ ehe akɛ ebatsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni eshwɛ fioo ni gbi lɛ shɛɔ lɛ, David yiŋ etee, lɛ kɛ eshishi tabilɔi lɛ, ni eyagbe Filistibii ohai enyɔ, ni efolɔ amɛfoo naa loi lɛ kɛba, ni ebakane ehã Maŋtsɛ Saul bɔ ni afee kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ shaanuu.
No hewɔ lɛ, Saul kɛ ebiyoo Mikal hã David gbãlã.
Shi be ni Saul kɛ ehiŋmɛi ŋmɛ shi ni ena akɛ Yehowa miibu David he, ni asaŋ akɛ Israel fɛɛ miisumɔ David sane lɛ, gbeyei ni Saul sheɔ David lɛ mli bawa fe tsuutsu ko lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul tsɔ̃ David henyɛlɔ kwraa.
Be nɛɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi fãfãa tai; shi be fɛɛ be ni amɛaafã ta lɛ, David yeɔ Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim fe Saul tsuji krokomɛi fɛɛ.
Enɛ hã David gbɛi hehe naakpa.
Saul hao David Saul wo ebi Yonatan kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ ayitsoŋ akɛ amɛgbe David kɛji nine shɛ enɔ.
Shi akɛni Saul bi Yonatan sumɔɔ David sane hewɔ lɛ Yonatan yatswa David adafi akɛ, “Naa, mitsɛ Saul miitao bo egbe.
No hewɔ lɛ, ole ohenɔ kwɛmɔ wɔ leebi.
Otao nififiaŋ he ko koni oyatee ohe yɛ jɛi.
Mi lɛ mibaya mitsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, he ni oyɔɔ lɛ, koni mi kɛ lɛ ayawie ohe.
Bɔ ni mibana lɛ mahã ole.” Yonatan tee ni eyana etsɛ Saul ni ewie ehã David, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kwɛmɔ koni okafee otsulɔ David esha ko, ejaakɛ efeko bo esha ko kwraa; ni asaŋ nibii fɛɛ ni etsu lɛ he eba sɛɛnamɔ ehã bo.
Edɔɔɔ ewala he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etee ni ekɛ Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ, yakpe, ni egbe lɛ, ni Yehowa hã Israel fɛɛ ye kunim kpeteŋkple.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ona kunim ni eye lɛ, ni onya he.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ ofee mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ esha, ni ogbe David yakatswaa lɛ?” Saul bo ebi Yonatan toi, ni Saul kã kitã ekɛɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ agbeŋ David.” Enɛ hã Yonatan tee ni eyatsɛ David yɛ eteemɔhe lɛ; ni be ni egba lɛ nɔ ni etee nɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ David ba Saul ŋɔɔ, ni David ku sɛɛ ebahi Saul ŋɔɔ ni esɔmɔ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Yɛ mli aahu lɛ ta ba ekoŋŋ.
David fã kɛtee eyawu ta lɛ, ni eye Filistibii lɛ anɔ butuu, ni amɛjo foi yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa hã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ bayi Saul nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Gbi nɛɛ lɛ Saul hiɛ akplɔ kɛta shi yɛ ewe lɛ mli, ni David miitswa kpãa saŋku lɛ eehã lɛ.
Saul ka akɛ etsu David akplɔ lɛ kɛmɔ gbogbo lɛ, shi David sha ehe, ni akplɔ lɛ yatsɛkɛ gbogbo lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni David jo foi, ni eje Saul dɛŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, Saul wo mɛi agbɛ akɛ amɛyawo David ka yɛ ewe lɛ bɔ ni afee koni lɛ Saul lɛ, enine ashɛ David nɔ enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi koni egbe lɛ.
Shi David ŋa, Mikal, wo David ŋaa ekɛɛ, “Kɛji ohereee oyiwala ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, wɔ lɛ abaagbe bo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mikal shi David kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ mli kɛyi shi ni David jo foi etee, ni eje Saul dɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Mikal wo nɔ ko ni agbɔ lɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔ efɔ̃ David saatso lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔ lɛ yitso tsɔle abotia he tsɔi sune lɛ, ni eha nɔ lɛ mama.
Be ni Saul bɔfoi ni etsu akɛ amɛyamɔ David amɛbahã lɛ lɛ shɛ David we lɛ mli lɛ, Mikal kɛɛ bɔfoi lɛ akɛ David naaa hetselɛ.
Shi Saul saa wo bɔfoi lɛ agbɛ ekoŋŋ kɛtee David we lɛ akɛ amɛyana lɛ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi; ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa lɛ kɛ saa lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi koni magbe lɛ.” Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ba lɛ amɛbanina amãgã ni tsɔle abotia he tsɔi sune kã David saatso lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ hã Saul bi Mikal akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni olaka mi nɛkɛ, ni ojie mihenyɛlɔ lɛ gbɛ etee, ni ohã eje midɛŋ nɛɛ?” Mikal hã Saul hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ewo mi shi ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji owaaa mi koni majo foi lɛ, no lɛ magbe bo.’ ” Be ni David jo foi lɛ eba Samuel ŋɔɔ yɛ Rama, ni ebagba lɛ saji fɛɛ ni Saul kɛye lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Samuel fɛɛ tee ni amɛyahi Naiot.
Ayatswa Saul adafi akɛ, “Naa, David yɛ Naiot yɛ Rama.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul wo bɔfoi agbɛ koni amɛyamɔ David kɛba.
Be ni bɔfoi nɛɛ yashɛ Naiot ni amɛyanina Samuel damɔ gbalɔi aku lɛ naa akɛ amɛnukpa ni amɛmiigba lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bayi bɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni amɛ hu amɛbɔi gbaa.
Ababɔ Saul amaniɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, esaa etsu bɔfoi krokomɛi; shi amɛ hu amɛyashi gbalɔi lɛ anɔ.
Saul ku sɛɛ etsu bɔfoi ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ nɔ; shi amɛ hu amɛyatsɔ̃mɔ gbalɔi nakai nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul diɛŋtsɛ yi mli ni etee Rama.
Be ni eyashɛ nubu wulu ni yɔɔ Seku lɛ he lɛ, ebi David kɛ Samuel shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ji he ni Samuel kɛ David yɔɔ lɛ?” Mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Amɛyɛ Naiot yɛ Rama.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul shwie nɔ kɛjɛ Seku ni eeya Naiot yɛ Rama; shi Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ yi lɛ hu enɔ, ni ehiɛ gbaa yɛ gbɛteŋ aahu kɛyashi eyashɛ Naiot yɛ Rama.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul hu kpɔlɔ ehe atadei lɛ ni egba yɛ Samuel hiɛ; ni ekã shi kɛ ehe folo nakai gbi lɛ shwane muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ kɛ nyɔɔŋ muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ.
Bɔ ni fee ni abɔi kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Mɛni, Saul hu etsɔ̃ gbalɔ hu?” lɛ nɛ.
Yonatan ye ebua David Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ David jo foi yɛ Naiot yɛ Rama kɛba Yonatan ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee?
Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ mitɔ̃, ni mɛɛ esha po mifee otsɛ hewɔ ni etaoɔ mi egbe nɛɛ?” Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Mɛɛ nakai hu ni akɛ abaagbe bo?
Nɔ ko bɛ ni mitsɛ baafee ni ewooo mitoi nɔ, nɔ wulu ni jio, nɔ bibioo ni jio.
Mɛni hewɔ mitsɛ kɛ sane nɛɛ baatee mi?
Ebɛ mli nakai.” Shi David to he ekɛɛ, “Otsɛ le faŋŋ bɔ ni osumɔɔ misane, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eyiŋtoo ji akɛ okale, no lɛ sane lɛ baadɔ bo.
Mina Yehowa kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ hu akɛ ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mikɛ gbele teŋ jekɛɛɛ.” Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ, ni mafee mahã bo.” David kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ nyɔŋ hee baaje, ni kulɛ esa akɛ mikɛ maŋtsɛ ayata shi aye nii; shi ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya ni mayatee mihe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi biɛ gbii etɛ̃ gbɛkɛ.
Kɛji otsɛ bi mishi lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘David bi mi gbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ akɛ eesha foi eya emaŋ Betlehem nɔŋŋ ni eba, ejaakɛ eweku fɛɛ miishã daa afi afɔle yɛ jɛi.’ Kɛji eto he akɛ ‘Ojogbaŋŋ,’ lɛ; no lɛ miye mihe.
Shi kɛji emli fu lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee mi efɔŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ mi ejurɔ nɛɛ, yɛ kpãŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni okɛ mi ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji miyeɔ fɔ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ gbee mi; ejaakɛ mɛɛ hewɔ ni okɛ mi aaayahã otsɛ?” Yonatan kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃.
Kɛji efo mitoi naa kɛkɛ po akɛ mitsɛ etswa fai shi akɛ ebaafee bo efɔŋ lɛ, ani mikɛŋ bo?” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yonatan akɛ, “Kɛji aleee nɔ ni otsɛ aaaŋmɛ bo naa sha lɛ, namɔ po aaahã male?” Yonatan to he ekɛɛ, “Ba ni wɔtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi mli, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ, ni amɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛyashɛ jɛi lɛ, Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaaye mi odase.
Kɛji mita mitsɛ yitso he mikwɛ, ni mina akɛ eyɛ ohe tsuijurɔ lɛ matsu oŋɔɔ wɔ, loo wɔsɛɛ, nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ, koni abawo otoi nɔ.
Shi kɛji mitsɛ eto eyiŋ doo akɛ efɔŋ nɔŋŋ ebafee bo, ni mihãaa ole koni ojo foi oya shweshweeshwe lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa awo mi he nyɔmɔ kɛteke nɔ.
Yehowa kɛ bo ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛ mitsɛ ehi shi lɛ.
Wɔsɛɛ ko kɛji miyɛ wala mli lolo lɛ, omli ahi ahã mi yɛ Yehowa suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ lɛ naa, ni kɛji migbo lɛ, ohiɛ akakpa nɔ koni ofee mishwiei ejurɔ kɛya naanɔ.
Be ni Yehowa aaakpãtã ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, David we lɛ hiɛ akakpa Yonatan nɔ.
Yehowa aaatɔ David he owele yɛ David henyɛlɔi anɔ.” Yonatan hã David saa kã lɛ kitã ekoŋŋ akɛ ehiɛ akakpa amɛteŋ suɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yonatan sumɔɔ David tamɔ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ nyɔŋ hee baaje, ni aaabi oshi, ejaakɛ osɛi lɛ nɔ baakã efolo.
Ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ abaakɔ sɛɛ fe nine akɛ obɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ yaa ni oyatee ohe yɛ tɛi ni bua shi yɛ jɛi lɛ ahe he ni oyatee ohe yɛ be ni sane nɛɛ tsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ.
Mibatserɛ̃ gãii etɛ̃ mawo tɛi lɛ amasɛi gbɛ oookɛɛ mitsɛ̃ nɔ ko pɔtɛɛ ko gãi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mibatsu oblanyo fioo ko, ni makɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Yaatao gãii lɛ kɛba.’ Kɛji mikɛshi sɛɛ fee sɛɛ akɛ, ‘Okwɛɛɛ, gãii lɛ yɛ obiɛgbɛ moŋ, kɔlɔmɔ kɛba lɛ,’ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ oba, ejaakɛ mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ sane fɔŋ ko yeŋ bo, ni obaafee shweshweeshwe.
Shi kɛji mikɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, ‘Okwɛɛɛ?
Gãii lɛ eteke bo’ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ojo foi ni oya, ejaakɛ Yehowa ejie bo gbɛ.
Yehowa ji mi kɛ bo teŋ odase yɛ shii ni wɔwoowoo wɔhe nɛɛ he kɛmiiya naanɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David yatee ehe yɛ ŋa lɛ mli.
Be ni nyɔŋ hee lɛ je lɛ Maŋtsɛ Saul ba niyenii lɛ ashi.
Eta esɛ̃i ni maa gbogbo lɛ he lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni etaa daa lɛ, ni Yonatan ta ehiɛ tuuŋtu, ni Abner ta Saul masɛi.
David tamɔhe lɛ kã efolo; shi Saul ekɛɛɛ nɔ ko nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ esusumɔ ji, “Sane ko eba David nɔ, ni etsuuko ehe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehe tseee.” Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ji nyɔŋ hee lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji gbii enyɔ lɛ, be ni David tamɔhe lɛ kã efolo ekoŋŋ lɛ, Saul bi Yonatan akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ Yeshai bi lɛ bako niyeli nyɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?” Yonatan here Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “David bi mi gbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ koni eya Betlehem ni eba.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya maba, ejaakɛ wɔweku lɛ miishã afɔle yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni minyɛminuu lɛ eshɛ mi akɛ miba.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji oosumɔ misane lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ hã maya ni mayasara minyɛmimɛi lɛ maba.’ Enɛ hewɔ ni ebako maŋtsɛ okplɔŋmɛɛ lɛ shishi nɛɛ.” Saul mli fu wo Yonatan naakpa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbee yoo yakagbɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ atuatselɔ bi ni tamɔ bo!
Okɛ Yeshai bi lɛ miibɔ, ni okɛmiiwo bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ onyɛ fɛɛ hiɛ mama nɔ yɛ maŋ.
Naa, gbii abɔ ni Yeshai bi nɛɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ni jio, omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni jio, eko fɛɛ eko yi etɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ abahã mi ejaakɛ ja egbo.” Yonatan here etsɛ Saul nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ sa akɛ egbo?
Mɛni efee?” Shi kometoo lɛ Saul fɔ̃ ekpɔlɔ lɛ, ni kulɛ ekɛmiitsu Yonatan koni egbe lɛ.
Enɛ Yonatan kɛna akɛ etsɛ eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ ebaagbe David.
Yonatan te shi kɛ mlifu ni naa wa kɛshi okplɔ̃ lɛ shi; ni nakai gbi lɛ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yonatan yeee nii lɛ eko, ejaakɛ David sane miidɔ lɛ tsɔ̃, ni asaŋ akɛ etsɛ Saul ewo lɛ Yonatan lɛ hiɛgbele nɛkɛ.
Gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Yonatan tee ŋa lɛ nɔ bɔ ni ato lɛ, ni ekɛ oblanyo fioo ko nyiɛ.
Yonatan kɛɛ oblanyo fioo lɛ akɛ, “Sha foi koni oyatao gãii ni matserɛ̃ lɛ kɛba.” Be mli ni oblanyo lɛ hiɛ foi kɛyaa lɛ Yonatan tsɛ̃ gãi kroko kɛteke lɛ.
Ni be ni oblanyo lɛ yashɛ he ni gãi lɛ yagbee lɛ, Yonatan bo ni ekɛɛ oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Okwɛɛɛ?
Gãi lɛ eteke bo!
Feemɔ mramra, ohe afee oya, kaadamɔ shi!” Oblanyo lɛ yakɔlɔ gãii lɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Anɔkwa, oblanyo lɛ leee nɔ ni afee lɛ shishi kwraa.
Yonatan kɛ David kɛkɛ ni le.
Yonatan kɛ enibii lɛ hã oblanyo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Baaho, ni okɛya maŋ lɛŋ.” Oblanyo lɛ tee nɔŋŋ pɛ kɛkɛ ni David fã kpo kɛjɛ tɛi ni bua shi lɛ ahe, ni ekɛ ehiɛ babu shi ni ekoto Yonatan shii etɛ̃.
Be ni David kɛ Yonatan eshwɔshwɔɔ amɛnaa sɛɛ lɛ, amɛwo yara amɛfo aahu kɛyashi David nɔ teke nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Anyɛmi, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔkamɔ wɔhe kitã yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli akɛ, ‘Yehowa aye abua mi kɛ bo, kɛ mishwiei kɛ bo hu oshwiei kɛya naanɔ’ lɛ, yaaba jogbaŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni David tsɔ̃ ehe ni etee, ni Yonatan hu ku esɛɛ etee maŋ lɛ mli.
David jo Saul naa foi David ba Osɔfo Ahimelek ŋɔɔ yɛ Nob maŋ lɛ mli.
Ahimelek kɛ hekpokpomɔ bakpee David ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni okome too onyiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko fataaa ohe lɛ?” David kɛɛ Osɔfo Ahimelek akɛ, “Minyiɛ maŋtsɛ tsumɔ ko nɔ.
Ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ, ‘Kaahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miile nɔ tsumɔ ni mitsu bo nɛɛ kɛ kitã hu ni miwo bo yɛ he lɛ.’ Oblahii ni mikɛyaa lɛ, mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ he ko ni amɛ kɛ mi akpe yɛ.
Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ onine nɔ?
Hã mi aboloo akwaabɔi enumɔ loo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooona koni mikɛhiɛ midɛŋ.” Osɔfo Ahimelek here David nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibɛ aboloo ko kwraa yɛ biɛ fe aboloo krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kɛji oblahii lɛ eko etako yoo he lɛ no lɛ sane ko bɛ he.” David to he ehã osɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔtako yoo he tamɔ bɔ ni kɛji wɔnyiɛ tsumɔ folo po nɔ ni wɔtaaa yoo he lɛ.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni kɛji oblahii lɛ nyiɛ ŋmɛnɛ tsumɔ wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛhiɛŋ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ aboloo krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hã David, ejaakɛ aboloo ko aboloo ko bɛ enine nɔ akɛ ja aboloo ni akɛmãa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, nɔ ni kɛji ajie yɛ jɛi lɛ ja akɛ aboloo kla to emomo lɛ najiaŋ nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ.
Gbi nɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ Saul tookwɛlɔ nukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, yɛ jɛi ni atsi enaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
David kɛɛ Osɔfo Ahimelek akɛ, “Obɛ klante loo akplɔ ko yɛ onine nɔ?
Maŋtsɛ tsumɔ lɛ yafee kplakpla, ni no hewɔ lɛ, miklante lɛ jio, mikpɔlɔ lɛ jio, mikɔɔɔ ekoeko mihiɛɛɛ midɛŋ kɛbaaa.” Osɔfo Ahimelek jie naa ekɛɛ, “Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ ni ogbe yɛ Ela Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ klante lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Ekã tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ sɛɛ ni abla he.
Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ no lɛ kɔ, ejaakɛ no sɛɛ lɛ klante kroko ko bɛ biɛ dɔŋŋ.” Ni David to he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɔ bɛ po; kɔ ohã mi.” David shi Nob maŋ lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ; eejo Saul naa foi; ni etee Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish ŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Akish tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, jeee David lɛ ni etsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ?” Jeee mɔ nɛ he lala alaa akɛjoɔ akɛ, “Saul egbe akpei, ni David egbe akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ lɛ?” Wiemɔ nɛɛ hã David hɛle shi, ni ebɔ̃i Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish gbeyeishemɔ naakpa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, David tsake enifeemɔ yɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Ekwa eye sɛkɛ, ni efee enii oookɛɛ sɛkɛyelɔ kɛji ahiɛ emli.
Eŋmala nii yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã lajɔ̃ tete wu etsɛ̃ŋ mli kpɔtɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Akish bi etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, gbɔmɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eye sɛkɛ lɛ mɛni nyɛkɛ lɛ baa abahã mi afee?
Sɛkɛyelɔi ahe miihia mi hewɔ ni nyɛyakpala mɔnɛ nɛɛ kɛba koni ebafee sɛkɛyelɔi anii etsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ?
Aso esa kwraa akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛkɛ hiɔ miwe nɛɛ mli tete?”
Agbe osɔfoi David shi Gat maŋ lɛ mli, ni ejo foi kɛtee eyahi Adullam tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ etsɛ we lɛ fɛɛ na le lɛ, amɛtee eŋɔɔ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni aawa amɛ yi kɛ mɛi hu ni hiɛhiɛ nyɔji kɛ mɛi fɛɛ hu ni bɛ shihilɛ he miishɛɛ lɛ bua amɛhe naa ni amɛyafata David he.
Kɛkɛ ni David batsɔ̃ amɛsafoiatsɛ.
Hii aaafee ohai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ ni bafata David he nɛɛ.
David shi Adullam tɛkplo lɛ mli ni etee Mizpa yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyakɛɛ Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ afã kɛba ni amɛbahi nyɛŋɔɔ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni male bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaato mi ahã.” No hewɔ lɛ, David shi efɔlɔi lɛ ehã Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni efɔlɔi lɛ hi Moab Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni David yɔɔ tɛkplo lɛ mli lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ gbalɔ lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gad lɛ ba, ni ebakɛɛ David akɛ, “Kaahi tɛkplo nɛɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
Shi biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David shi tɛkplo lɛ mli ni etee eyahi Heret koo lɛ mli.
Gbi nɛɛ Saul yɛ Gibea, ni eta shi yɛ tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ tamariske tso lɛ shishi yɛ gɔŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ; ehiɛ ekpɔlɔ yɛ edɛŋ, ni etsuji lɛ ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ ayana he ni David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ etsuji ni damɔ ehe lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiibo toi, nyɛ Benyaminbii!
Ani Yeshai bi lɛ baahã nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋmɔji kɛ waintromii hu; aloo eeewo nyɛ mɛi akpekpe akui kɛ mɛi ohaohai akui asafoiatsɛmɛi hu, hewɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛkpãŋ miyi nɔ lɛ?
Te mɔ ko ejeee nyɛteŋ ebawooo mitoi nɔ akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mimusuŋbi lɛ kɛ Yeshai bi lɛ efee ekome?
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nyɛteŋ ni misane dɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni eeewo mitoi nɔ akɛ mimusuŋbi lɛ ewo mitsulɔ lɛ yiŋ koni ete shi ewo mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ?” Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, damɔ Saul tsuji lɛ amasɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mina Yeshai bi lɛ yɛ Nob ni eba Osɔfo Ahimelek, Ahitub bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni Ahimelek bi Yehowa nii ehã lɛ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnɔ niyenii, ni asaŋ ekɛ Goliat, Filistinyo lɛ, klante lɛ hu ehã lɛ.” Enɛ hã Saul tsu koni ayakpee Ahimelek, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ etsɛ we lɛ mli bii ni amɛ nɔŋŋ ji osɔfoi ni yɔɔ Nob lɛ fɛɛ abahã lɛ.
Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ bashɛ Maŋtsɛ Saul hiɛ lɛ, Saul kɛɛ akɛ, “Oobo toi lo, Ahitub bi?” Ahimelek here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, minuŋtsɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Saul bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni, bo kɛ Yeshai bi lɛ, nyɛkpãŋ miyi nɔ, ni ohã lɛ niyenii, ni asaŋ owo edɛŋ klante, ni obi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ohã lɛ, ni no hewɔ ni ete shi ewo mi, ni ewo mi ka bɔ ni nyɛnaa ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ?” Ahimelek to he ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nɔ ni mile ji akɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko bɛ ni eji ehe anɔkwafo tamɔ David.
Maŋtsɛ shaanuu ji lɛ, ni agbɛnɛ maŋtsɛ he bulɔi lɛ asafoiatsɛ ji lɛ, ni awoɔ lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Jeee ŋmɛnɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni mibi Nyɔŋmɔ nii mihã David.
Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ akɛ Maŋtsɛ kɛ sane aaafɔ̃ mi, etsulɔ, loo mitsɛ we lɛ mli mɔ ko kwraa nɔ, ejaakɛ mileee sane nɛɛ he nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa.” Shi Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ahimelek, ja agbe bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã ehebulɔi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe ni nyɛgbea Yehowa osɔfoi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛwa David eko.
Amɛna amɛle akɛ David miijo foi, shi amɛbawooo mitoi nɔ shi maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛawo amɛnine nɔ amɛtswia osɔfo lɛ nii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Saul fã Doeg ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbee osɔfoi nɛɛ!” Ni lɛɛlɛŋ, Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, tsɔ̃ ehe ni edɔ klante eto osɔfoi lɛ anɔ; ni nakai gbi lɛ egbe osɔfoi ni ji mɛi ni woɔ tsitsinɔhaanii lɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ sɔŋŋ.
Saul hã akɛ klante kpãtã Nob maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; agbe hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii kɛ tsinai kɛ teji kɛ toi fɛɛ.
Shi Ahitub bi Ahimelek bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abiatar lɛ he je mli, ni ejo foi etee David ŋɔɔ, ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ Saul egbe Yehowa osɔfoi lɛ.
David kɛɛ Abiatar akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ beebe, be ni mina Doeg, Edomnyo lɛ, yɛ Nob lɛ pɛ ni mina akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ lɛ ebaaya eyakɛɛ Saul.
Mi ejɛ ni otsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ egboi nɛɛ.
Okɛ mi ahi shi; ni okashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɔ ni taoɔ mi egbe lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etaoɔ bo hu egbe nɛɛ; shi kɛji oyɛ mimasɛi lɛ oyɛ shweshweeshwe.”
Abagba David akɛ Filistibii lɛ eyatua Keila maŋ lɛ, ni amɛmiiha ŋmaa ni yɔɔ ŋmashaahei lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, David bi Yehowa nii akɛ, “Ani miya ni miyatua Filistibii lɛ kɛhere Keila lo?” Yehowa here David nɔ ekɛɛ, “Yaa ni oyatua Filistibii lɛ ni ohere Keila.” Shi David webii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ po lɛ, wɔmiishe gbeyei, aahu ni wɔtee Keila wɔkɛɛ wɔkɛ Filistibii atai lɛ yaawu.” Enɛ hã David ku sɛɛ ni ebi Yehowa nii ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa Keila lɛ, shi mibahã oye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim.” No hewɔ lɛ, David kɛ ewebii lɛ fã kɛtee Keila ni amɛkɛ Filistibii lɛ yawu, ni amɛgbe Filistibii lɛ butuu, ni amɛloo Filistibii lɛ akooloi kɛtee.
Bɔ ni fee ni David here Keilabii ayiwala nɛ.
Be mli ni Ahimelek bi Abiatar jo foi kɛtee David ŋɔɔ yɛ Keila lɛ ehiɛ efod lɛ kɛtee.
Be ni ayagba Saul akɛ David yɛ Keila lɛ, nɔ ni Saul kɛɛ ji akɛ “Nyɔŋmɔ ejie David ewo midɛŋ, ejaakɛ akɛni eyabote maŋ ni agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi tara naa mli nɛɛ lɛ, esa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yi.” Ni Saul tsɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ kɛkpe koni amɛfã ta kɛya Keila ni amɛyasa David kɛ ewebii lɛ ayi.
Be ni David na le akɛ Saul miito ehe yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar akɛ, “Kɔ efod lɛ kɛba.” Be ni Abiatar kɛ efod lɛ ba lɛ, David bi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, otsulɔ enu akɛ Saul miitao aba Keila koni ebakpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ mi mihewɔ.
Ani Keilabii baajie mi awo edɛŋ lo?
Ani Saul baana aba lɛɛlɛŋ?
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, otsulɔ miikpa bo fai koni ohã male enɛ.” Ni David bi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Ani Keilabii lɛ aaajie mi kɛ miwebii lɛ amɛwo Saul dɛŋ lo?” Yehowa here nɔ akɛ, “Amɛbaajie nyɛ amɛhã Saul.” Ni fee nakai lɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii aaafee mɛi ohai ekpaa lɛ ye amɛhe oyai ni amɛshi Keila.
Amɛyiŋ amɛtee he fɛɛ he ni amɛna.
Ayagba Saul akɛ David ejo foi yɛ Keila, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Saul efãaa ta lɛ.
David yahi gɔji lɛ anɔ Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ David yabɔ ehe agwaa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ tɛkploi lɛ amli yɛ Zif Ŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ Saul miitao David, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa enine ashɛ David nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ David she gbeyei ejaakɛ ena akɛ Saul eba ebaatao lɛ koni egbe lɛ.
David yɛ Zif Ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Horesh niiaŋ, ni Saul bi Yonatan tiu lɛ kɛtee jɛi, ni eyawo David hewalɛ koni ekɛ ehiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Yonatan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mitsɛ Saul nine shɛŋ onɔ.
Ele enɛ faŋŋ akɛ bo obaaye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni mi matsɔ̃ osɛɛmɔ.” David kɛ Yonatan kamɔ amɛhe kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi mli, ni no sɛɛ lɛ Yonatan ku esɛɛ etee shĩa; shi David tee nɔ ehi Horesh.
Kɛkɛ ni Zif hii komɛi yakɛɛ Saul yɛ Gibea akɛ, “Naa, David ebatee yɛ wɔŋɔɔ yɛ Horesh tɛkploi lɛ amli yɛ Hakila Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yuda shiaŋa lɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Maŋtsɛ, wɔle akɛ otsui miishwe tsɔ̃ koni onine ashɛ enɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ba, ni wɔbaaŋɔ lɛ wɔhã bo.” Saul kɛɛ Zif hii nɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛnu he nyɛhã mi.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛyaa, ni nyɛyataoa esaji amli jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛtaoa nyɛlea hei pɔtɛɛ ni eshwɛɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ hu ni ena lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛ ehiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, ejaakɛ ahã mile akɛ ele ŋaa naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyataoa hei pɔtɛɛ ni eteɔteɔ ehe yɛ lɛ, ni nyɛbaa nyɛbakɛa mi; ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya.
Anɔkwa, kɛji David yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ no lɛ matao lɛ fitsofitso kɛkpa Yuda muu fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ Zif hii lɛ shi Saul, ni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee Zif.
Nakai be mli lɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɛ Maon shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ jɔɔ ko ni ye Yuda shiaŋa lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ mli.
Be ni Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ yiŋ amɛtee koni amɛyatao David lɛ, abatswa David adafi, ni no hewɔ lɛ, David shi jɔɔ lɛ mli kɛtee Maon tɛsaa lɛ mli yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Saul na ele enɛ, kɛkɛ ni etiu David kɛtee Maon shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ nyiɛ gɔŋ lɛ biɛgbɛ lɛ, David kɛ ewebii lɛ hu nyiɛ gɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni David he miitswa shi koni eshi gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ fiofio lɛ Saul kɛ ewebii lɛ miibɛŋkɛ amɛ koni amɛbamɔmɔ amɛ.
Shi bɔfo ko ba trukaa ebakɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Akɛɛ oye ohe oyai ni oba, shi Filistibii lɛ ebatua shikpɔŋ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Saul je David sɛɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yawu.
Sane nɛɛ hã awo nakai kpɔ lɛ mli gbɛi akɛ, “Foijee Tɛsaa.” Kɛkɛ ni David shi Maon, ni etee eyahi En-Gedi tɛkploi lɛ amli.
David kɛ Saul he ke lɛ Be ni Saul kɛ Filistibii lɛ eyawu ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, abatswa lɛ adafi akɛ, “Naa, David yɛ En-Gedi Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul hala Israel tabilɔi fɛɛ amli hii akpei etɛ̃, ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee koni eyatao David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ yɛ Duji Atɛsai lɛ nɔ.
Amɛyashɛ tɛkplo ko he yɛ toi atsui komɛi ahe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni Saul tee niiaŋ yɛ tɛkplo nɛɛ mli.
Asomoaŋ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ eyatee yɛ tɛkplo kometoo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ sɛɛgbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David webii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shi ni Yehowa wo bo akɛ, ‘Majie ohenyɛlɔ lɛ mawo odɛ̃ŋ koni ofee lɛ bɔ ni osumɔɔ’ lɛ no eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David te shi, ni etee ni eyafo Saul atade lɛ naabu nigii.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ David henilee bɔi lɛ haomɔ yɛ Saul atade lɛ naabu ni eyafo lɛ hewɔ.
Enɛ hã David kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa akahã enɛ miigbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ akɛ mawo minine nɔ yɛ minuŋtsɔ, mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ, nɔ.
Esaaa akɛ minine saa ehe ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ewo lɛ maŋtsɛ ni.” David kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɔɔ ewebii lɛ ahe, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛtua Saul.
Saul te shi eshi tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni eyi egbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David hu je kpo yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni eyabo Saul yisɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, Maŋtsɛ!” Be ni Saul fo ehe ni ekwɛ esɛɛ lɛ, David kɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni ekoto Saul, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni oboɔ mɛi anaa toi akɛ mi David, miitao bo efɔŋ lɛ?
Bɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ ona kɛ ohiŋmɛi tsei enyɔ bɔ ni Yehowa jie bo wo midɛŋ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli?
Mɛi kɛɛ mi akɛ migbe bo; shi mikɛ ohe ke bo.
Nɔ moŋ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Mikɛ minine esaŋ minuŋtsɔ he ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu ni.’ Mitsɛ Ataa, Okwɛɛɛ?
Otade lɛ naabu ko ni mifo lɛ mihiɛ nɛɛ.
Akɛ mifo otade lɛ naabu, ni mitswaaa bo nɔ migbeee bo lɛ, no aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo koni ona ole akɛ mibɛ ohe yiŋtoo fɔŋ ko.
Mifeko bo esha ko, shi kɛ̃lɛ bo lɛ gbɔbimɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ogbɔbiɔ mi koni ogbe mi.
Mikɛ misane lɛ fɛɛ ehã Yehowa koni eye ehã mi; ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaatɔ mihe owele yɛ onɔ; shi mi ni ji mi lɛ, mikɛ minine esaŋ ohe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Onukpai buɔ abɛ akɛ ‘Mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ nɔ fɔŋ jɛɔ, shi mi lɛ minine esaŋ ohe.
Ni namɔ sɛɛ po Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efã kɛnyiɛ nɛɛ?
Namɔ po otiuɔ nɛɛ?
Gbee gbonyo ni; oflikiti ni!
Yehowa aaaye misane lɛ ehã mi, ni eeekojo mi kɛ bo teŋ, ni eejie mi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ?” Be ni David kɛ Saul wie nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, Saul bi lɛ akɛ, “Bo nɔŋŋ ogbee minuɔ nɛɛ, mibi David?” Kɛkɛ ni Saul jwa yaafo, ni ekɛɛ David akɛ, “Oja fe mi, ejaakɛ be mli ni ofeɔ mi ekpakpa lɛ belɛ mi lɛ miifee bo efɔŋ moŋ kɛmiito bo najiaŋ.
Otsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ ekpakpa otaoɔ mi, akɛni Yehowa tu mi wo odɛ̃ŋ shi ogbeee mi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ hu nine shɛɔ ehenyɛlɔ nɔ ni ekɛ ehe keɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaafee bo ejurɔ yɛ nɔ ni ofee ohã mi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ efee faŋŋ ehã mi akɛ bo kɛ̃ obaaba obaye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baahe shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ Yehowa akã mi kitã akɛ ogbeŋ mishwiei ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ bɔ ni afee ni migbɛi akalaaje.” David kã Saul kitã ni ebi lɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Saul yiŋ etee ewe; shi David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Samuel gbele Samuel gbo, ni Israel fɛɛ ba bafo lɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ mli yɛ Rama.
David kɛ Abigail Samuel fuu sɛɛ lɛ, David kpeleke shi kɛtee Paran shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Nuu ko hi shi yɛ Moan, shi enitsumɔhe yɛ Karmel.
Niiatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ; eyɛ too gwantɛŋi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ abotiai hu akpe, ni eeku etoi lɛ ahe tsɔi be nɛɛ mli yɛ Karmel.
Atsɛɔ nuu nɛɛ Nabal, ni eŋa gbɛi ji Abigail.
Yoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ, ni eyɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu naakpa; shi ewu Nabal lɛ yitsoŋ wa, ni ehiɛ kãaa shi.
Kaleb shwie ji Nabal nɛɛ.
David nu yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ Nabal miiku etoi ahetsɔi.
No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ oblahii nyɔŋma, ni etsu amɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa Nabal ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel, ni nyɛyaŋaa lɛ nyɛhãa mi; nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, Miihã lɛ omanye!
Omanye abla lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Minu akɛ aba aaku otoi lɛ ahetsɔi.
Otookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ wɔbahi shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔfeee amɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛnɔ ko nɔ ko elaajeee gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ Karmel lɛ.
Bo lɛ bi oblahii lɛ, ni amɛbaagba bo.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, kwɛmɔ miblahii lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ wɔba yɛ gbi kpakpa nɔ be ni ooŋmɛ okplɔ̃.
Ofainɛ, ohã otsuji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oyɔɔ yɛ onine nɔ lɛ eko koni okɛmaje obi David.” Be ni David oblahii lɛ yashɛ, ni amɛkɛ David shɛɛ lɛ hã Nabal ni amɛmɛɔ hetoo lɛ, Nabal hetoo ni ehã amɛ ji akɛ, “Namɔ ji nakai David lɛ?
Namɔ ji Israel lɛ?
Tsuji ni ejojoo foi amɛshi amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi efa gbii etɛ̃ nɛɛ.
Ani nyɛmiikɛɛ mi akɛ miboloo kɛ minu kɛ miloo ni migbe, ni mikɛbaahã mɛi ni eba ni amɛkuɔ toi ahetsɔi lɛ, mikɛhã mɛi komɛi hu ni mileee he ni amɛjɛ bɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni David oblahii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛtee koni amɛyabɔ David amaniɛ.
Amaniɛ lɛ hã David kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɔ eklante eŋmɔ.” Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋmɔ eklante, ni David hu ŋmɔ eklante.
Kɛkɛ ni eyi mli kɛ esɛɛ hii ohai ejwɛ, be mli ni ashi hii ohai enyɔ yɛ sɛɛ koni amɛbu nibii ni asafo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ahe.
Be ni oblahii ni David tsu lɛ eshi Nabal ŋɔɔ amɛtee lɛ, Nabal oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bɔ Nabal ŋa Abigail amaniɛ ekɛɛ, “Naa, David tsu bɔfoi kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba wɔnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ amɛbahã lɛ omanye, shi wɔnuŋtsɔ gri ni ebolɔ ewo bɔfoi lɛ.
Anɔkwa, be ni wɔyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ David webii nɛɛ amli hi hã wɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni wɔ kɛ amɛ hi shi lɛ, amɛfeee wɔ efɔŋ ko lɛ, amɛkɔɔɔ wɔnɔ ko nɔ ko.
Moŋ bei fɛɛ ni wɔ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ ni wɔlɛɔ toi lɛ, amɛbu wɔhe shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ni osusu sane nɛɛ he, ni okwɛ bɔ ni obaafee, ejaakɛ ashwã wɔnuŋtsɔ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ ayinɔ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ole lɛ, wɔnuŋtsɔ feɔ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ bɔ ni ehiii lɛ sane kɛɛmɔ.” Abigail he fee oya, ni ekɔlɔ aboloo akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ, ni ekɛfata wain wolo tɔi enyɔ, kɛ too gwantɛŋi enumɔ ni asaa momo, kɛ mamu okpolui enumɔ, kɛ wain yibii ni aka ni egbi shabii oha, kɛ agbãmi ni abɔlɔ lɛ akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ ahe, ni afi fɛɛ jatsu ni ekɛtere tejii, ni asaŋ ewo eblahii komɛi agbɛ kɛ jatsu lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔa mihiɛ nyɛkitea; minyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɔŋŋ.” Shi etsiii tã ekɛɛɛ ewu Nabal.
Abigail ta teji nɔ kɛmiiya, ni be ni elɔgɔ gɔŋ lɛ kɔŋtɔ̃ ko nɔŋŋ pɛ, naa David kɛ ewebii lɛ hu ni miiba.
Kɛkɛ ni Abigail kɛ amɛ yakpe.
Nakai be mli lɛ David ekɛɛ momo sa akɛ, “Yakatswaa po mibaa nibii ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ yi mihã lɛ, ni amɛmli ekoeko elaajeee lɛ.
Ekpakpa ni mifee lɛ lɛ, mishidaa ji enɛ?
Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi kɛji wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ mishi ewebii lɛ ateŋ nuu kome nɛkɛ hiɛkãalɔ yɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ.” Be ni Abigail na David lɛ ehe fee oya ni eje eteji lɛ nɔ eyi shi, ni eyabu shi yɛ David hiɛ ni ekoto lɛ.
Abigail ho gbee David naji anaa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, minuŋtsɔ, kaadi nɛkɛ nuu kwashia Nabal nɛɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ eetsu egbɛi lɛ he nii.
Gbɛi ni awo lɛ ji Nabal, ni lɛɛlɛŋ kwashiai asane pɛ eyeɔ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ, mi lɛ, oblahii lɛ ni minuŋtsɔ tsu lɛ, minaaa amɛ kwraa.
Minuŋtsɔ, mina Yehowa kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ hu akɛ beiaŋ ni Yehowa etsi onaa koni okaye lá ko yi sɔ̃, asaŋ ni okɛ onine akatɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe owele lɛ, ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ bo efɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai tamɔ Nabal.
Agbɛnɛ, minuŋtsɔ, naa nikeenii ni otsulɔ yoo kɛba koni okɛhã oblahii ni nyiɛ osɛɛ lɛ.
Ofainɛ, okɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni mitɔ̃ lɛ afa mi.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahã owe aye ejurɔ, ni ehe shi, ejaakɛ minuŋtsɔ miiwu Yehowa tai lɛ ehã lɛ, ni akana nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko yɛ ogbɛfaŋ owala be fɛɛ.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa ko aaate shi awo bo, ni enyiɛ osɛɛ akɛ bo nɔŋŋ etaoɔ egbe lɛ, no lɛ, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaafi minuŋtsɔ wala afata mɛi ni yɔɔ wala lɛ ahe ato Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, Yehowa aaasherɛ amɛ ashwie shwiaa tamɔ afɔ̃ɔ akromia mli tɛ.
Kɛji be lɛ shɛ, ni Yehowa fee nibii juji lɛ fɛɛ ni ewo amɛhe shi eto lɛ ehã minuŋtsɔ, ni ewo bo Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, efeŋ minuŋtsɔ dɔlɛ, ni ojwɛŋmɔ hu gbaŋ onaa akɛ oshwie lá shi yakatswaa aloo akɛ minuŋtsɔ tɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe owele.
Kɛji Yehowa na fee bo ejurɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ofainɛ, ohiɛ akakpa oweyoo nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni David here Abigail nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, lɛ mɔ ni tsu bo koni okɛ mi abakpe ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ yi; Nyɔŋmɔ yiwala dɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛshikamɔ nɛɛ hewɔ; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oyiwala dɔŋŋ akɛ otsi minaa ŋmɛnɛ koni mikaye lá ko yi sɔ̃, ni asaŋ mikatɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe owele.
Anɔkwa, mina Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tsi minaa ni mifeko bo efɔŋ ko nɛɛ, akɛ eji ohe efeee oya koni okɛ mi abakpe kulɛ wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ eshwɛŋ nuu kome nɛkɛ hiɛkãalɔ ehaŋ Nabal!” Kɛkɛ ni David mɔ nikeenii ni Abigail kɛba lɛ mli, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ!
Kuu osɛɛ ni oya shĩa kɛ omanye.
Minu nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, ni mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ nɔ.” Be ni Abigail ku esɛɛ ni eshɛɔ shĩa lɛ Nabal eŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ewe lɛ mli tamɔ maŋtsɛ.
Nabal mii eshɛ ehe fe nine, ni etɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Abigail ebɔɔɔ lɛ amaniɛ ko kɛyashi je tsɛre nɔ leebi, be mli ni wain lɛ etserɛ yɛ ehiɛ lɛ.
Be ni Nabal ŋa Abigail gba lɛ nibii ni tee nɔ lɛ, Nabal tsui sɔŋŋ ni fã lɛ hã eniji kɛ enaji fɛɛ gboi amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ ehe.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ aaafee gbii nyɔŋma lɛ Yehowa tswa Nabal nɔ ni egbo.
Be ni David nu akɛ Nabal egbo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ ji akɛ, “Yehowa yiwala dɔŋŋ.
Etɔ ahora ni Nabal bɔ mi lɛ he owele ehã mi, ni asaŋ etsĩ mi, etsulɔ, naa hu koni mikayafee nɔ fɔŋ.
Yehowa ehã Nabal musu ebua eyiteŋ.” David tsu fee sɛɛ atee akɛ Abigail yawie koni ekɛ lɛ afee eŋa.
David tsuji lɛ ba Abigail ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “David tsu wɔ oŋɔɔ akɛ wɔbaŋɔ bo wɔhã lɛ akɛ eŋa.” Abigail te shi, ni ekoto tsuji lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnuŋtsɔ weyoo ji mi, ni mifee kralo tsɔ̃ akɛ mafɔ minuŋtsɔ tsuji anaji ahe.” No sɛɛ lɛ, Abigail yaho eta teji nɔ; kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ eblayei enumɔ komɛi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ yi David tsuji lɛ asɛɛ kɛtee, ni Abigail yatsɔ David ŋa.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Ahinoam, ni jɛ Yezreel lɛ, hu hi shi; ni yei enyɔ nɛɛ ni ji Abigail kɛ Ahinoam, tsɔ̃mɔ David ŋamɛi.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Saul kɛ ebiyoo Mikal, David klɛŋklɛŋ ŋa lɛ, ehã Palti, ni ji Laish ni jɛ Galim lɛ binuu, gbãlã.
David kɛ Saul he ke lɛ ekoŋŋ Zifbii komɛi ba Saul ŋɔɔ yɛ Gibea amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, David ebatee ehe yɛ Hakila Gɔŋkpɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda ŋa kplanaa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Saul hala Israel hii akpei etɛ̃, ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee Zif ŋa lɛ nɔ koni eyatao David.
Saul yato shi yɛ Hakila Gɔŋkpɔ ni yɔɔ gbɛ ni kã Yuda ŋa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ he lɛ nɔ.
Shi David tee nɔ ehi shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni enu yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ Saul enyiɛ esɛɛ kɛba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu mɛi kɛtee amɛyasara amɛkwɛ akɛ Saul eba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛɛlɛŋ lo.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ David diɛŋtsɛ tee Saul shitoohe lɛ, ni eyana he pɔtɛɛ ni Saul kɛ etatsɛ Abner, Nerbi lɛ, kãmɔ.
Saul kã shi ewɔ, ni ewebii tabilɔi ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni David bi Ahimelek, Hitnyo lɛ, kɛ Zeruia bi Abishai, Yoab nyɛminuu lɛ, akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ mi aaatee Saul shitoohe lɛ mli?” Abishai here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mi kɛ bo aaatee!” No hewɔ lɛ, David kɛ Abishai tee Saul tabilɔi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛyanina Saul ni ekã ewebii lɛ ateŋ ewɔ, ni ekpɔlɔ lɛ tsɛkɛ shi yɛ eyitsogbɛ; ni Abner kɛ tabilɔi lɛ kãmɔ ehewɔ kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Abishai kɛɛ David akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ejie ohenyɛlɔ lɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ ŋmɛnɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ hã matsu lɛ akplɔ lɛ shi koome kɛmɔ shikpɔŋ nyɔŋlo, mihaŋ etia shii enyɔ.” Shi David kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, “Kaakpãtã ehiɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baawo enine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu nɔ ni mɔ lɛ aaaŋɔ ehe aye.” David kɛɛ Abishai ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni aaatswa Saul nɔ, aloo ebe baashɛ ni eeegbo, aloo eeetee ta ni eeeyanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Yehowa akpa ashwie akɛ mi mawo minine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni lɛ Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ nɔ.
Bo lɛ fãa akplɔ lɛ ni tsɛkɛ shi yɛ eyitsogbɛ lɛ, ni owo nu kɛ kpulu lɛ kɛkɛ ni wɔtee.” Kɛkɛ ni David kɔ akplɔ lɛ ni ewo nu kpulu lɛ yɛ Saul yiteŋgbɛ, ni amɛje jɛi amɛtee.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko enaaa amɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ hu etsɛ̃ɛɛ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu leee.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ewɔ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni tsii enyɔ amɛnɔ.
Be ni David etse mli kɛtee eyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, he ni gbɛ shwaŋŋ kã ekɛ Saul teŋ lɛ, ebolɔ etsɛ Saul tabilɔi lɛ kɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ohereee nɔ lo, Abner?” Abner here nɔ akɛ, “Bo namɔ obolɔɔ otsimɔɔ maŋtsɛ toi lɛ?” David here Abner nɔ akɛ, “Abner, kwɛɛ, jeee mikɛɛ bo ji hii fɛɛ amli nuu yɛ Israel lɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni obuuu onuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he, ni mɔ ko jɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ ba ni kulɛ ebaakpãtã onuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ?
Ofeee ni ahi kwraa!
Mina Yehowa akɛ nyɛsa gbele, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛbu nyɛnuŋtsɔ, ni ji gbɔmɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu, lɛ he.
Agbɛnɛ, kwɛ nɛgbɛ maŋtsɛ akplɔ lɛ kɛ enu kɛ kpulu ni ma eyitsogbɛ lɛ yɔɔ?” Saul yoo David gbee ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibi David, bo owieɔ lɛ?” David here nɔ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, mi ni.
Shi mɛɛba ni minuŋtsɔ nyiɛ etsulɔ sɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?
Mɛni mifee; mɛɛ efɔŋ po mifee?
Taflatsɛ, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ abo nɔ ni etsulɔ yɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi fioo.
Kɛji Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni etee bo shi ewo mi lɛ, mibashã he afɔle kɛkpa he fai.
Shi kɛji gbɔmɛi adesai abii ni ehã ote shi owo mi lɛ, no lɛ Yehowa aaawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛshwie mi ŋmɛnɛ akɛ mikahi Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ miya ni miyasɔmɔ jemawɔji.
Kɛji magbo po lɛ, kaahã migbo yɛ he ko ni jeee Yehowa shikpɔŋ nɔ, ejaakɛ naa Israel maŋtsɛ eba mi oflikiti taomɔ tamɔ agbɔbiɔ afi yɛ gɔji anɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul here nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mifee efɔŋ!
Mibi David, kpalemɔ ni oba.
Mifeŋ bo efɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ miwala jara wa hã bo.
Miye kwashiai asane lɛɛlɛŋ, ni mitɔ̃ fe nine.” David to he ehã Saul akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, naa okpɔlɔ lɛ.
Hã oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome aba ni ebaŋɔ.
Yehowa woɔ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ejalɛ kɛ enɔkwayeli naa.
Yehowa tu bo ewo midɛŋ ŋmɛnɛ, shi mi ni misumɔɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ minine nɔ yɛ mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ nɔ.
Bɔ ni mikɛ ohe ke bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu Yehowa aaabaa miwala yi, ni eeejie mi yɛ nɔnai fɛɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ David akɛ, “Mibi David, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ aaajɔɔ bo.
Oootsu nibii wuji, ni oooye fɛɛ mli kunim.” Kɛkɛ ni David yiŋ etee, ni Saul hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee ejɛɛhe lɛ.
David yɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ David kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mihiɛ nɛkɛ aahu ni Saul nine aaashɛ minɔ gbi ko, ni eeegbe mi.
Nɔ pɛ ni sa mi feemɔ agbɛnɛ ji akɛ majo foi kɛya Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No baahã Saul nijiaŋ aje wui, ni ebaafɔ̃ɔ mi gbɔbimɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni maye mihe.” Enɛ hã David kɛ ewebii hii ohai ekpaa ni fata ehe lɛ shwie nɔ kɛtee Maok bi Akish, Gat maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
David kɛ ewebii lɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi enyɔ, ni ji Ahinoam, Yezreel yoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail, Karmel yoo lɛ ni ji Nabal okulafo, lɛ.
Be ni Saul na le akɛ David ejo foi kɛtee Gat lɛ, Saul kpa David sɛɛ tiumɔ.
David kɛɛ Akish akɛ, “Kɛji ona mihe tsuijurɔ lɛ hã mi he ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ maji lɛ eko mli koni mayahi jɛi, ejaakɛ efeee mi akɛ ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ aaahi maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ mli.” Akish damɔ David wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ ni ekɛ Ziklag hã David nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Biɛ tsɔ̃ ni Ziklag maŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi anɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
David hi shi afi kɛ nyɔji ejwɛ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ David kɛ ewebii lɛ fãa, ni amɛyatuaa Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Girzibii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii ejaakɛ amɛ amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Shur aahu kɛyashwie Ijipt kɛjɛ sa.
David yatuaa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni egbeɔ hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, ni eloɔ amɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛ tejii kɛ yoomai kɛ atadei hu, kɛkɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛba Akish ŋɔɔ.
Kɛji Akish bi David akɛ, “Ni namɛi ofɔ̃ nyɛyaye ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?” David kɛɔ Akish akɛ, “Wɔyatua Yudabii lɛ awuoyigbɛ, aloo Wɔyatua Yerameelbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ lɛ, aloo Wɔyatua Kenbii lɛ awuoyigbɛ lɛ.” Kɛji David tee ofɔ̃yeli lɛ, nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, David shiii mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ koni akabagba yɛ Gat akɛ, “Nɛkɛ kɛ nɛkɛ ji nɔ ni David feɔ.” Bɔ ni David hi shi nɛ, bei abɔ fɛɛ ni eye yɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Akish he David eye, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Bɔ ni ehã esane eje emaŋ Israelbii amɛtsine hewɔ lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi daa.”
Yɛ mli aahu lɛ Filistibii lɛ tsɛ ta.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbuabua amɛtai lɛ anaa koni amɛkɛ Israel ayawu.
Ni Akish kɛɛ David akɛ, “Na ole akɛ bo kɛ owebii lɛ baashi mitabilɔi lɛ anɔ kɛya ta nɛɛ.” David to he ehã Akish akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, obaana nɔ ni otsulɔ baatsu.” Akish kɛɛ David akɛ, “Mo!
Mibafee bo mihebulɔ owalabe fɛɛ.” Saul tee eyafee nii Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Samuel egbo, ni Israel fɛɛ efo lɛ, ni afu lɛ yɛ Rama, ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli, ni Saul eshwie mɛi ni feɔ nii kɛ klamɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Filistibii atai lɛ bua amɛhe naa ni amɛfã ta kɛba Shunem ni amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi.
Saul hu bua Israel tai lɛ anaa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛba Gilboa amɛbato shi yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Saul na Filistibii lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ eshe gbeyei, ni etsui fã naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Saul tee eyabi Yehowa nii.
Shi yɛ lamɔ mli jio, yɛ Urim lɛ naa jio, yɛ gbalɔi anaa jio, Yehowa efooo Saul daaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul fã etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyataoa yoo okɔmfo ko nyɛhãa mi koni maya eŋɔɔ mayabi nii.” Etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yoo okɔmfo ko yɛ Endor.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul bakɔlɔ atadei komɛi kɛkɛ ewo ekɛtsake ehe koni akayoo lɛ, ni ekɛ hii enyɔ komɛi fata ehe, ni eyiŋ etee yoo okɔmfo lɛ ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ.
Saul kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Miitao koni ofee nii ohã mi, ni otsɛ mɔ tã ni matsi mahã bo lɛ ohã mi.” Yoo lɛ to he akɛ, “Bɛ ole nɔ sane ni Maŋtsɛ Saul eye kɛho lɛ fɛɛ, bɔ ni ekpãtã okɔmfoi kɛ klamɔfoi ahiɛ ehã yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ?
Mɛɛba ni oba otsɔ̃ɔ mi tsɔne koni ohã agbe mi nɛɛ?” Shi Saul kã yoo okɔmfo lɛ kitã ekɛɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ onaŋ amane ko amane ko yɛ nɔ ni obaatsu ohã mi nɛɛ hewɔ.” Yoo lɛ bi Saul akɛ, “Namɔ mitsɛ mihã bo lɛ?” Saul to he akɛ, “Tsɛ Samuel ohã mi.” Be ni yoo okɔmfo lɛ na Samuel susuma lɛ, ebo waa ni ekɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Mɛɛba olaka mi nakai?
Maŋtsɛ Saul ji bo.” Saul kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei.
Mɛni onaa?” Yoo lɛ jie naa akɛ, “Mina sisa ko ni miifã kpo kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ kɛmiiba.” Ni Saul bi lɛ akɛ, “Te esu hu?” Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Nuumo ko ni baa lɛ; ewo atade yuu ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Saul yoo akɛ Samuel ni, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto sisa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samuel bi Saul akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ obagba minaa kɛ tsɛmɔ ni obatsɛ mi nɛɛ?” Saul jie naa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Efi mi naakpa.
Filistibii lɛ kɛ mi jwere ta nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hu eje misɛɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni yɛ gbalɔi anaa jio, yɛ lamɔ mli jio, Nyɔŋmɔ efooo midaaŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni mibatsɛ bo nɛɛ koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni mifee.” Samuel kɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Kɛji Yehowa eje osɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, mɛɛba oba obiɔ mi nii?
Yehowa tsɔ̃ minɔ ewo bo shi, ni no he nii etsu lɛ.
Eshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ekɛhã omaŋnyo David.
Ejaakɛ obooo Yehowa gbee toi; ni emli ni fu Amalek waa lɛ oyatsuuu he nii ohãaa lɛ.
No hewɔ ni Yehowa feɔ bo nɔ ni efeɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Fɛɛ ayakã, Yehowa baahã Filistibii lɛ aye bo kɛ Israel fɛɛ nɔ kunim.
Wɔ ni ji wɔ lɛ, bo kɛ obihii baaba abashɛ gbohiiaje he ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ, ni Filistibii lɛ baaye Israel ta lɛ hu nɔ kunim.” Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ Saul flɛo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi egbee shi ejaakɛ gbeyei wulu mɔ lɛ yɛ Samuel naa wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Egbɔjɔ bliboo hu, ejaakɛ eyeko nɔ ko nɔ ko shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Fee sɛɛ be ni yoo okɔmfo lɛ tsi ebɛŋkɛ Saul, ni ena akɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Saul akɛ, “Oweyoo bo bo toi bianɛ, ni mikɛ mihe wo osharã mli, ni mifee nɔ ni obi mi akɛ mifee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, agbɛnɛ bo hu bo oweyoo toi.
Mahã bo niyenii fioo ko ni oye bɔ ni afee ni ona hewalɛ okɛnyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ.” Saul ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Miyeee.” Shi Saul tsuji lɛ kɛ yoo okɔmfo lɛ fɛɛ nyɛ Saul nɔ; ni naagbee mli lɛ ebo amɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Saul te shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni eho eta saa lɛ nɔ.
Oya nɔŋŋ ni yoo lɛ mɔ etsinabi ko ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ni egbe lɛ; ni ekpɔtɔ mamu ekɛshã mã akpiti aboloo.
Ekɛ niyenii nɛɛ bama Saul kɛ etsuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛye.
Niyeli lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Saul kɛ etsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛtee nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ.
Filistibii lɛ kwa David Filistibii lɛ bua amɛtai lɛ anaa yɛ Afek.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ nubu ko ni yɔɔ Yezreel lɛ masɛi.
Be ni Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ to kɛho kɛ amɛtabilɔi ohahai kɛ akpekpei lɛ, ana David hu kɛ ewebii lɛ shi Akish tabilɔi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛnyiɛ asafoiasafoi lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ.
Enɛ hã Filistibii lɛ atatsɛmɛi lɛ bi akɛ, “Mɛni nɛkɛ Hebribii nɛɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ?” Akish hã Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Israel maŋtsɛ Saul tsulɔ David lɛ nɛ; ni afii abɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mi yɔɔ.
Kɛjɛ ni eshi Saul kɛbaje miŋɔɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ minako tɔ̃mɔ ko kwraa yɛ ehe.” Shi Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ amli fu Akish naakpa, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛ, ni ohã eku esɛɛ eya maŋ ni ohã lɛ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ.
Wɔnyɛŋ wɔ kɛ lɛ aya ta nɛɛ naa koni ekayatsɔ̃ ehe moŋ ewo wɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Mɛni osusuɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛ aaakpãtã enuŋtsɔ ni etɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, fe wɔwebii ni yɔɔ biɛ nɛɛ ayitsei?” Kolɛ jeee nɛkɛ David nɛɛ he lala amɛwoɔ ni ahereɔ nɔ yɛ joi amli akɛ, “Saul egbe ekpekpei lɛ; shi David egbe akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai lɛ?” Akish tsɛ David, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ejaakɛ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni obaje miŋɔɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, minako nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ ohe.
Kulɛ misumɔ akɛ oshi minɔ kɛya ta nɛɛ naa, shi maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ nyãaa ohe.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, kuu osɛɛ ni oya shĩa; ni oya yɛ hejɔlɛ mli hu koni okawo Filistibii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ mlifu moŋ.” David kɛɛ Akish akɛ, “Shi mɛni kwraa ji nɔ ni mifee?
Mɛni, aleee nɔ, ona yɛ mihe kɛjɛ gbi ni mikɛ bo bahi shi aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, hewɔ ni mikɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ akaya, koni mikɛ ohenyɛlɔi yawu lɛ?” Akish here David nɔ akɛ, “Mi mihiɛ lɛ, mile akɛ ohi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo; shi Filistibii atatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛɛ okashi amɛnɔ kɛtee ta lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtea shi wɔ leebi maŋkpa, bo kɛ owebii lɛ ni fata ohe kɛba lɛ, koni jeŋ ni aaatse pɛ nyɛyia mli kɛkua nyɛsɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David kɛ ewebii lɛ te shi leebi mra, ni amɛyiŋ koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni Filistibii atai lɛ hu fã koni amɛya Yezreel.
David kɛ Amalekbii lɛ wu ta Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ be ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ bashɛ Ziklag lɛ, amɛyanina akɛ Amalekbii lɛ ebatua Yuda wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Ziklag hu, ni amɛwo Ziklag mli la amɛshã maŋ lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ emli yei blublu kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ gbekɛbii anɔ aahu kɛyashi onukpai anɔ fɛɛ.
Amɛgbeee mɔ ko mɔ ko fe akɛ amɛloo amɛ fɛɛ kɛtee be ni amɛshiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ shɛɔ shi lɛ ashã maŋ lɛ, ni aŋɔ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei fɛɛ nom kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ ewebii ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ wo yara, ni amɛfo kɛyashi etɔ amɛ bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfo dɔŋŋ.
David ŋamɛi enyɔ lɛ, ni ji Ahinoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail Nabal Karmelnyo lɛ ŋa okulafo lɛ, hu Amalekbii lɛ ŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.
Sane wulu bakã David nɔ, ni ehe jara lɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ ewebii lɛ kɛɛ amɛbaatswia lɛ tɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ musuŋ miishã lɛ yɛ ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ ahewɔ.
Shi Yehowa, David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, waje David ni ewo lɛ hewalɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar, ni ji Ahimelek bi lɛ akɛ, “Yaakɔ nɔ ni akɛbiɔ nii lɛ obahã mi.” Abiatar kɛ nii lɛ bahã David.
Kɛkɛ ni David bi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, “Mitiu gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lo?” Yehowa hã hetoo akɛ, “Tiumɔ amɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ obaaya oyanina amɛ yɛ gbɛteŋ, ni onine baashɛ nyɛgbɔmɛi lɛ anɔ shweshweeshwe.” No hewɔ lɛ, David kɛ hii ohai ekpaa ni fata ehe lɛ yi gbɛ.
Be ni amɛshɛ Besor Faa lɛ naa lɛ, esɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni emiii akɛ amɛaafo faa lɛ, ashi amɛ yɛ jɛi, ni David kɛ hii ohai ejwɛ tiu Amalekbii ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ.
Eshi hii ohai enyɔ yɛ faa lɛ naa ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ bliboo bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ Besor Faa lɛ amɛfo.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ, David webii lɛ na Ijiptnyo oblanyo fioo ko yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ batsɔ̃ɔ David.
Ahã oblanyo nɛɛ niyenii eye, kɛ nu hu ni enu; ni asaŋ ahã lɛ agbãmi kɛ wainyibii shabii enyɔ hu.
Be ni eye nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ oblanyo nɛɛ eye gbii etɛ̃ ni nɔ ko eyako edaaŋ, niyenii jio, nu jio.
Agbɛnɛ David bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ bi ji bo; ni nɛgbɛ hu ojɛ?” Oblanyo lɛ jie naa akɛ, “Ijiptnyo bi ji mi.
Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ ni minuŋtsɔ lɛ shi mi eŋmɛ shi ni etee, ejaakɛ hela bamɔ mi.
Wɔtee wɔyatua shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Keretibii lɛ awuoyigbɛ he ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Kalebbii hu awuoyigbɛ, ni wɔma Ziklag maŋ lɛ naa la wɔshã.” David bi oblanyo lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛɛ oyatsɔ̃ɔ mi ofɔ̃yelɔi nɛɛ lɛ, obaaya lo?” Oblanyo lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akã mi kitã akɛ ogbeŋ mi, ni asaŋ okpaleŋ mi ohaŋ minuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ bo baaya miyatsɔ̃ɔ bo ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ.” Be ni oblanyo lɛ kɛ David tee lɛ ayanina ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã he ni amɛyato shi yɛ lɛ fɛɛ, ni aayeyee nii, ni aanunuu dãi, ni aajojoo yɛ nibii babaoo ni amɛyahahaa yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛshwie amɛnɔ, ni egbe amɛ kɛjɛ hulushinyɔɔ mli aahu kɛyashi enɔ jetsɛremɔ gbɛkɛ mli.
Amalekbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ejeee gbele mli fe oblahii ohai ejwɛ komɛi ni shara yoomai ni amɛtara nɔ kɛjo foi lɛ.
David nine shɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Amalekbii lɛ baloo kɛtee lɛ anɔ, kɛ eŋãmɛi enyɔ lɛ hu.
Nibii ni Amalekbii lɛ baloo lɛ ateŋ eko kwraa elaajeee.
Nɔ bibioo ni jio, nɔ wulu ni jio, binuu ni jio, bo biyoo ni jio, David nine shɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nɔ kɛba.
Ni David loo toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Amalekbii anine nɔ lɛ, ni akpala kooloi nɛɛ kɛnyiɛ hiɛ belɛ aapai aakɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ David ofɔ̃yelinii nɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David bashɛ hii ohai enyɔ lɛ ni bɔ ni etɔ amɛ bliboo hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ David sɛɛ amɛnyiɛ kɛtiu Amalekbii ofɔ̃yelɔi lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, David hã amɛhi shi yɛ Besor Faa lɛ naa lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fã kɛbakpee David kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ.
Be ni David bɛŋkɛ amɛ lɛ ehã amɛ “Sɛɛ fɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni kɛ David tee lɛ ateŋ yitsoŋwalɔi kɛ yakagbɔmɛi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni amɛbɛ mli ni wɔtee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nibii ni wɔyashɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, amɛnɔ bɛ mli fe mɔ oŋa kɛ obii ni obaanyɛ obakpala amɛ kɛya kɛkɛ.” Shi David here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji Yehowa ebu wɔhe, ni ehã wɔye mɛi ni batua wɔ lɛ anɔ kunim lɛ, nyɛkafea nakai yɛ nii ni Yehowa ehã wɔ lɛ he.
Ni namɔ po aaabu nyɛ bem yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli?
Naa, bɔ ni mɔ ni tee ta lɛ baana akɛ egbɛnaa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni bu nibii ahe yɛ sɛɛ hu baana akɛ egbɛnaa.
Abaaja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ David wiemɔ nɛɛ tsɔ̃ akpɔ kɛ mla ehã Israelbii, ni ekã shi nakai kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Be ni David bashɛ Ziklag lɛ, etsu akɛ nibii ni eyaye amɛ ofɔ̃ lɛ eko tee ayake Yuda maŋ onukpai fɛɛ ni ji ehe gbɔmɛi kpakpai lɛ kɛ shɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miyaye ofɔ yɛ Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛbake nyɛ nɛ.” Aja nibii nɛɛ ahã maŋ onukpai ni yɔɔ Betel kɛ Rama yɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛ Yatir, kɛ Aroer kɛ Sifmot kɛ Eshtemoa, kɛ Rakal kɛ Yerameelbii kɛ Kenbii lɛ hu amaji lɛ amli lɛ.
Ahã onukpai ni yɔɔ Horma kɛ Borashan kɛ Atak kɛ Hebron fɛɛ eko.
David tsu akɛ nikee tee hei fɛɛ ni lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ enyiɛnyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ.
Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ agbele Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ wu ta, ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ amɛshwie Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Filistibii lɛ nyiɛ Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ asɛɛ waa.
Amɛnine shɛ Saul bihii Yonatan kɛ Abinadab kɛ Malkishua nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Akɛ ta lɛ nina Saul kpaakpa.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ na Saul, ni amɛtsɛ̃ lɛ gãi, ni apila lɛ ablaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ etawuunii lɛ akɛ, “Gbalamɔ oklante lɛ, ni okɛdu mi bɔ ni afee ni foolɔi nɛɛ akaba amɛbagbe mi, ni amɛfee mi niseniianii.” Shi oblanyo lɛ emiii nakai feemɔ ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ naakpa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Saul gbala lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eklante lɛ, ni eho egbee nɔ.
Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ Saul egbo lɛ, lɛ hu eho egbee eklante lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ Saul fɛɛ gbo.
Bɔ ni Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ kɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ Saul tawuunii lɛ kɛ Saul he gbɔmɛi fɛɛ gboi shi kome yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɛ.
Be ni Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ na akɛ, Israelbii lɛ ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni asaŋ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ egboi lɛ, amɛjojoo foi amɛshishii amɛmaji amɛshwie shi, ni Filistibii lɛ baŋɔ maji lɛ ni amɛhi mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Filistibii lɛ ba ta lɛ mli gbohii lɛ ahe nii kpɔlɔmɔ lɛ, naa Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛfo Saul yi, ni amɛkpɔlɔ ehenii yɛ ehe, ni atsu bɔfoi koni amɛyakpa Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpula, ni amɛyashiɛ ta lɛ mli sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ yɛ amɛjemawɔji fɛɛ anaa, kɛ maŋbii hu.
Filistibii lɛ kɛ Saul tawuunii lɛ tee yato jemawɔŋ Astarte we lɛ, ni egbonyo lɛ amɛkɛyatsotsoro Bet-Shan maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ he.
Shi be ni Yabeshbii ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ nu bɔ ni Filistibii lɛ efee Saul lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli hii kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ te shi, ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛtee, ni amɛyajie Saul gbonyo lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu agbohii lɛ yɛ Bet-Shan gbogbo lɛ he, ni amɛkɛba Yebesh amɛbashã.
Amɛloo gbohii lɛ awui lɛ, ni amɛfu yɛ tso ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ tamariske tso ni yɔɔ Yabesh lɛ shishi, ni maŋ lɛ hi ŋmaa gbii kpawo.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Samuel Wolo ni ji Enyɔ lɛ, Samuel Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo lɛ nɔtsamɔ ni; ni nɔ he krɛdɛɛ ni ewieɔ ji David maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Shishijee mli lɛ David ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda pɛ ; shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ebatsɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ hu maŋtsɛ .
Wolo lɛ gba sane lɛ fitsofitso.
Egba nɔ ni David fee be ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaalɛɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni ena shifimɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ eshĩateŋ kɛ maŋsɛɛ henyɛlɔi fɛɛ ple saŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Wɔnaa David akɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni heɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ eyeɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni esɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hu; asaŋ emaŋbii fĩ esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ.
Shi wɔnaa David akɛ mɔ ko hu ni emusuŋ eshãaa lɛ kwraa kɛji eetɔ owele; asaŋ kɛji eetao nɔ ko lɛ, egbaaa enaa akɛ eeefee esha po ni ekɛna.
Shi be ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbalɔ Natan kɛ esha ni David efee lɛ yafɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ, David kplɛ̃ nɔ akɛ efee efɔŋ, ni ekplɛ̃ etoi ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ baagbla lɛ nɔ akɛ esa.
David shihilɛ kɛ emɔdɛŋbɔɔ sa Israelbii ahiɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni afii komɛi asɛɛ, be mli ni amɛjaku lɛ yɔɔ hejramɔ mli ni amɛtao maŋtsɛ lɛ, ehã maŋbii lɛ bi akɛ atao mɔ ko ni “jɛ David mli” koni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ ahã amɛ.
Amɛmiitao mɔ ko ni eji David shwie ni baahi shi tamɔ David koni ebaye maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi David maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda .—.
David maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel .—.
a. Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee .—.
b. David kɛ Batsheba .—.
d. Naagbai .—.
e. Naagbee afii lɛ .—.
David nu akɛ Saul egbo Saul gbele sɛɛ be ni David ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta ni efã kɛyaplene Amalekbii lɛ eba lɛ, ebahi shi gbii enyɔ yɛ Ziklag.
Ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Saul tabilɔi lɛ eko kɛ ehe atade ni etserɛ kɛ eyiteŋ hu mlu ba David ŋɔɔ kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa.
Be ni nuu lɛ shɛ David hiɛ lɛ eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto David.
David bi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ obaa nɛɛ?” Nuu lɛ to he akɛ, “Israel nsra lɛ mli mijo foi kɛjɛ kɛbaa nɛɛ.” David saa ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Te nibii amli tamɔ tɛŋŋ?
Gbaa mi.” Nuu lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔtabilɔi lɛ ejo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; agboi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan fɛɛ enyɔnyɔi.” David bi oblanyo lɛ ni gbaa lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, “Te ofee tɛŋŋ ole akɛ Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan egboi hu?” Oblanyo lɛ hã David hetoo ni ekɛɛ, “Heniianaa ni miyaje Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni miyanina Saul ni ebu ekpɔlɔ lɛ nɔ, be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ ashwiilii lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ lɛ waa lɛ.
Be ni Saul fo ehe ekwɛ esɛɛ ni ena mi lɛ, etsɛ mi; ni mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, naa mi.’ Ebi mi akɛ, ‘Bo namɔ ni?’ Mijie naa akɛ, ‘Ofainɛ, Amaleknyo ji mi’.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Tsi oba ni obagbe mi, ejaakɛ ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, tsɛ wala fioo yɛ mimli’.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitsi mibɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni migbe lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ eshigbeemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eyi naŋ wala.
No sɛɛ lɛ, mijie maŋtsɛ akekre ni fi eyitso lɛ kɛ ga ni ewo yɛ ekɔŋ lɛ, ni mikɛba mikɛbaahã bo, minuŋtsɔ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David mɔ ehe atade lɛ mli, ni egbala lɛ yɛ ewerɛ sɔŋŋ ni eho ehe naa.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ hu fee nakai, ni amɛye ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛwo yara, ni amɛfo, ni amɛhi ŋmaa kɛyashi gbɛkɛ yɛ Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan kɛ Yehowa maŋbii ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ ahewɔ.
David bi oblanyo lɛ ni gbaa lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyo ji bo?” Oblanyo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Gbɔ ni ji Amaleknyo ko bi ji mi.” Kɛkɛ ni David bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni osheee gbeyei, shi onyɛ owo onine nɔ, ni okɛkpãtã mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ hiɛ nɛɛ?” Amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ oblahiabii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ, “Tswaa lɛ nɔ ni ogbe lɛ.” Ni etswa oblanyo lɛ nɔ, ni egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ, “Oyi sɔ̃ atere bo diɛŋtsɛ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ onaabu eye odase eshi bo, ejaakɛ okɛɛ, ‘Migbe mɔ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ.’ ” David fo Saul kɛ Yonatan Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ lala nɛɛ fo Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan, ni efã akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ Yudabii lɛ lala nɛɛ.
(Aŋmã lala nɛɛ yɛ Yashar Wolo lɛ mli).
“Ao Israel, onunyam lɛ, ehiɛ akpãtã yɛ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ nɛɛ.
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi nɛɛ?
Nyɛkayagbaa enɛ yɛ Gat; akatsi enɛ tã yɛ Ashkelon blohuiaŋ koni Filistibii lɛ abiyei lɛ akanya, ni foolɔi lɛ abiyei lɛ miitumɔ.
“Nyɛ Gilboa gɔji, bɔ loo nu akanɛ nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnɔ ŋmɔji aŋala.
Ejaakɛ jɛi abule kãkãlɔi lɛ atsɛŋi lɛ yɛ, kɛ Saul tsɛŋ lɛ po, ejaakɛ afɔŋ he mu dɔŋŋ.
Mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔ lɛ ala lɛ kɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ hu afɔ lɛ Yonatan gãi lɛ ekuuu esɛɛ efolo kɛjɛɛɛ he; ni Saul klante lɛ hu gbe henyɛlɔi lɛ.
“Asumɔ Saul kɛ Yonatan amɛwala be mli, ni amɛhe yɛ fɛo.
Amɛgbele mli tete, amɛmli gbalaaa; amɛhe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ po, ni amɛhe wa hu fe jata.
“Nyɛ Israel biyei, nyɛfoa Saul, mɔ ni bumɔ nyɛ mamai tsuji fɛɛfɛji, ni ehã nyɛ shika jwinei nyɛshwie nyɛtadei anɔ lɛ.
“Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi yɛ ta teŋ tuuŋtu nɛɛ hu?
Agbe Yonatan yɛ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
“Osane miidɔ mi, minyɛmi Yonatan; osane eŋɔɔ minaa kɛho.
Osuɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ, efe yei asuɔmɔ tete.
“Te aye tɛŋŋ ni kãkãlɔi enyɔnyɔi ni tawuunii hu ahiɛ ekpãtã nɛɛ?”
Awo David Yuda Maŋtsɛ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David yabi Yehowa nii akɛ, “Ani miya ni miyaŋɔ Yuda maji lɛ eko lo?” Yehowa hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yaa!” David bi akɛ, “Mɛɛ maŋ nɔ miya?” Yehowa to he akɛ, “Yaa Hebron.” No hewɔ lɛ, David yiŋ kɛtee Hebron, lɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi enyɔ lɛ, Ahinoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ, kɛ Abigail ni ji Nabal Karmelnyo lɛ okulafo lɛ.
David kɛ hii tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ hu tee, ni amɛyahi Hebron maji lɛ amli.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yuda hii lɛ ba Hebron amɛbafɔ David mu kɛwo lɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ.
Be ni agba David akɛ Yabesh Gileadbii lɛ ji mɛi ni fu Saul gbonyo lɛ, David tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ayakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛfu nyɛnuŋtsɔ Saul nyɛkɛfee lɛ ejurɔ nɛkɛ.
Yehowa asumɔ nyɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni bɛ naagbee, ni eye nyɛ anɔkwa; ni mi hu mafee nyɛ ejurɔ mato najiaŋ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe, ni nyɛfea ekãa, ejaakɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ Saul egbo, ni Yuda akutso lɛ ebafɔ mi mu kɛwo mi amɛmaŋtsɛ.” Awo Ishboshet Israel Maŋtsɛ Saul tatsɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, mɔ ni Saul bi Ishboshet kɛjo foi kɛtee Mahanaim, ni jɛi eyawo lɛ Gilead kɛ Ashur kɛ Yezreel kɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ.
Saul bi Ishboshet eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebɔi maŋtsɛyeli; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ.
Yuda akutso lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ nyiɛ David sɛɛ.
David ye Yuda maŋtsɛ yɛ Hebron afii kpawo kɛ nyɔji ekpaa.
Israel kɛ Yuda wu Abner, Ner bi lɛ, kɛ Saul bi Ishboshet tsuji lɛ jɛ Mahanaim ni amɛba Gibeon.
Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, hu kɛ David tsuji lɛ fã, ni amɛkɛ Ishboshet tsuji lɛ yakpe yɛ Gibeon kpaakpo lɛ naa.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi bua kpaakpo lɛ he afã kome nɛɛ, ni Mɛnɛɛmɛi hu bua kpaakpo lɛ he afã kome nɛɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Abner kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ hã oblahiabii lɛ aba amɛbaka amɛ kpɔiaŋ yɛ wɔhiɛ.” Yoab here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, amɛmiiba.” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ jɛ Benyaminbii, ni ji Saul bi Ishboshet sɛɛbii, lɛ ateŋ ni amɛ kɛ David tabilɔi lɛ hu ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yaka amɛkpɔiaŋ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mɔ ehenyɛlɔ yitso, ni edu ehenyɛlɔ lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kakla, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛyashwie shi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi shi kome.
No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ Gibeon kpɔ nɛɛ mli he ni sane nɛɛ ba yɛ lɛ akɛ “Kakla Ŋa nɔ.” Ta ni awu gbi lɛ mli yawa naakpa, ni David tsuji lɛ wo Abner kɛ Israelbii lɛ afoi.
Zeruia bihii etɛ̃, Yoab kɛ Abishai kɛ Asahel, yɛ ta lɛ naa gbi lɛ.
Ni Asahel, amɛteŋ mɔ ni joɔ foi tamɔ ŋa nɔ soŋai lɛ, kɔlɔ foi eshwie Abner sɛɛ, ni ejeee Abner sɛɛ egbaaa ninejurɔgbɛ loo abɛkugbɛ.
Abner kwɛ esɛɛ kɛkɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, Asahel, bo ni?” Asahel here nɔ akɛ, “Hɛɛ!
Mi ni.” Abner kɛɛ Asahel akɛ, “Gba oninejurɔ gbɛ loo obɛkugbɛ koni omɔ oblahiabii lɛ moŋ eko koni oshɔ̃ etawuunii yɛ edɛŋ.” Shi Asahel ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ekpale yɛ Abner sɛɛ.
Abner ku sɛɛ ekɛɛ Asahel akɛ, “Kpalemɔ ni oku osɛɛ ni oya.
Mɛɛba ni obaahã minine akpa yɛ onɔ nɛɛ?
Te mafee tɛŋŋ mawo mihiɛ nɔ yɛ onyɛmi Yoab hiɛ hu kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ?” Shi Asahel emiii akɛ ejeɔ Abner sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Abner kɛ ekpɔlɔ lɛ shishi gbu Asahel musu, ni akplɔ lɛ yafã kpo yɛ Asahel sɛɛ, kɛkɛ ni Asahel gbee shi, ni egbo yɛ enajiaŋ nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni bashɛɔ he ni Asahel gbonyo lɛ kã lɛ waa damɔɔ shi.
Shi Yoab kɛ Abishai nyiɛ Abner sɛɛ aahu kɛyashi amɛyashɛ Ama Gɔŋkpɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Gia bokãgbɛ, yɛ Gibeon ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ he; kɛkɛ ni hulu nyɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Benyaminbii lɛ bua amɛhe naa akɛ asafo ku, ni amɛbafata Abner he, ni amɛyadamɔ gɔŋ ko yiteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Abner bo etsɛ Yoab, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aso nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ wɔɔhã klante aye awui lo?
Oleee akɛ kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ joomɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni baaba lo?
Mɛɛ be nɔŋŋ omɛɔ dani ofã owebii lɛ koni amɛfɔ̃ɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ?” Yoab hã Abner hetoo ekɛɛ, “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ kɛjeee wiemɔ ni owie nɛɛ hewɔ ni kulɛ ja wɔ leebi dani miwebii lɛ baafɔ̃ɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab hã akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni ewebii lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ, ni asaŋ amɛkpa amɛ kɛ ta lɛ wuu.
Abner kɛ ewebii lɛ nyiɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛyafo Yordan lɛ, ni amɛtsa nyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ leebi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛba Mahanaim.
Be ni Yoab ekpa Abner kɛ ewebii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ, ni ebua ewebii lɛ anaa lɛ, ena akɛ eshwɛ Asahel kɛ David webii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu.
Shi David tsuji lɛ gbe Benyaminbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Amɛwo Asahel gbonyo lɛ, ni amɛyato lɛ yɛ ewekumɛi afũuhe ni yɔɔ Betlehem lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Yoab kɛ ewebii lɛ tsa nɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛreɔ wɛlɛŋŋ lɛ amɛyashɛ Hebron.
Saul we lɛ kɛ David we lɛ wu ta be babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
David hewalɛ tee nɔ shwere; shi Saul we lɛ, gbɔjɔmɔ moŋ etee nɔ egbɔjɔ.
David Musuŋbihii lɛ David fɔ bihii ekpaa yɛ Hebron.
Kromɔbi lɛ ji Amnon, mɔ ni ekɛ Ahinoam, Yezreelyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Kileab, mɔ ni ekɛ Abigail Karmelnyo Nabal okulafo lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Binuu ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Absalom mɔ ni ekɛ Geshar Maŋtsɛ Talmai biyoo Maaka fɔ lɛ.
Binuu ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Adonia, mɔ ni ekɛ Hagit fɔ lɛ; binuu ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Shefatia, mɔ ni ekɛ Abital fɔ lɛ; ni binuu ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Itream, mɔ ni ekɛ Egla fɔ lɛ.
Bihii ni David fɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ nɛ.
Abner bafata David he Be ni Saul we lɛ kɛ David we lɛ wuɔ ta lɛ, Abner bana hewalɛ yɛ Saul we lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Saul yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Rizpa, ni atsɛɔ etsɛ Aia.
Gbi ko lɛ Ishboshet bi Abner sane yɛ Rizpa nɛɛ he ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛba ni oyata mitsɛ hemɔ lɛ he lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Abner mli fu naakpa yɛ sane ni Ishboshet bi lɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Ishboshet akɛ, “Te osusuɔ yɛ mihe tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?
Akɛ miyɛ Yuda sɛɛ?
Mi ni misɔmɔ otsɛ Saul we lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ enanemɛi fɛɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni miŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ ni David anyɛ nyɛnɔ kunim eye lɛ, sane ni ofoɔ oŋmɛɔ minɔ yɛ yoo hewɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɛ?
Ojogbaŋŋ!
Mi Abner, Nyɔŋmɔ agbe, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ kɛji mihãaa shi ni Yehowa wo David lɛ aba mli fĩi, akɛ ebaahe maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Saul we lɛ dɛŋ, ni ebaahã David maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahe shi akɛ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba.” Ishboshet nyɛɛɛ he eko eto dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ eeshe Abner gbeyei.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abner tsu bɔfoi kɛtee David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron kɛ shɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ osusuɔ akɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ?
Hã ni wɔkpãŋ wɔfee ekome, ni magbala Israel fɛɛ mibawo oshishi.” David hã shɛɛ lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, mi kɛ bo baakpãŋ; shi ja otsu nɔ kome nɛɛ dã: ni no ji akɛ kɛji ooba obana mi lɛ, okɛ Saul biyoo Mikal lɛ aba, kɛjeee nakai lɛ onaŋ mihiɛ.” David saa je gbɛ etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Saul bi Ishboshet ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ akɛ, “Miitao miŋa Mikal, mɔ ni mikɛ Filistibii afoonaa loi oha hã esɛɛnii lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ishboshet tsu ni ayakpala Mikal yɛ ewu Paltiel, Laish bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
Ni Mikal wu lɛ fo kɛnyiɛ Mikal sɛɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Bahurim.
Be ni eyashɛ jɛi lɛ Abner kɛɛ Paltiel akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ ni oya!” Kɛkɛ ni eku esɛɛ ni etee.
Kɛkɛ ni Abner kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ tee ajina, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ kulɛ nyɛmiitao David ni eye nyɛmaŋtsɛ?
Be lɛ eshɛ nɛɛ; nyɛtsua he nii ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo shi yɛ David he akɛ, ‘Mitsulɔ David nine nɔ matsɔ̃ mahere mimaŋ Israel yiwala yɛ Filistibii kɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ adɛŋ.’ ” Abner kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ hu yawie; ni no sɛɛ lɛ eŋɔ shwie nɔ, ni etee eyabɔ David amaniɛ, yɛ Hebron, nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ eto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛbafee lɛ.
Be ni Abner bashɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ, David ŋmɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni fata ehe kɛba lɛ fɛɛ okplɔ̃.
Abner kɛɛ David akɛ, “Mibaya agbɛnɛ koni mayabua Israel fɛɛ naa mahã minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, koni amɛ kɛ bo abakpãŋ kɛfee ekome, koni oye amɛmaŋtsɛ bɔ ni oshweɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David jie Abner gbɛ, ni eshi etee shweshweeshwe.
Abner gbele Shi be fioo ko sɛɛ lɛ Yoab kɛ David tsuji lɛ jɛ ojoyeli amɛba kɛ nibii babaoo ni amɛyaha.
No mli lɛ Abner bɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ejaakɛ David ejie lɛ gbɛ eshi etee shweshweeshwe.
Be ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni kɛ lɛ tee lɛ fɛɛ ebato shi sɛɛ lɛ, agba Yoab akɛ, “Ner bi Abner ba maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ, ni maŋtsɛ eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni etee shweshweeshwe.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, mɛni ofee nɛɛ?
Abner ba biɛ ni oŋmɛɛ ehe ni etee?
Ole Ner bi Abner oto?
Eba bo lakamɔ kɛkɛ koni ele oyaa kɛ obaa mli, asaŋ ni ele onibii amli hu.” Be ni Yoab shi David eba sɛɛ lɛ, eyatsu bɔfoi koni amɛtiu Abner ni amɛyatsɛ eyisɛɛ amɛhã lɛ.
Bɔfoi lɛ yanina Abner yɛ Siria nubu lɛ he, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba.
Shi enɛ fɛɛ lɛ, David leee he nɔ ko.
Be ni Abner ku esɛɛ ebashɛ Hebron lɛ, Yoab tsɛ lɛ kɛtee afãgbɛ yɛ maŋ koi lɛ shi akɛ ekɛ lɛ yaato ajina.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab du Abner musuŋ kakla ni enyɔ yɛ enajiaŋ, ni Yoab kɛtɔ enyɛminuu Asahel lá lɛ he owele.
Be ni fee sɛɛ ni David nu nɔ ni eba lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, wɔyeee Ner bi Abner lá yi sɔ̃ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Elá lɛ abua Yoab kɛ etsɛ we lɛ yiteŋ, ni mɔ ni he hoɔ lá loo kpitiyelɔ loo mɔ ni ekumɔ ni ja ehiɛ tso dani ehiɔ lɛ nyiɛmɔ, loo mɔ ni gboɔ klante naa gbele loo hɔmɔwɔlɔ akakpa yɛ Yoab sateŋ.” Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Yoab kɛ enyɛmi Abishai tsɔ ni amɛgbe Abner ejaakɛ egbe amɛnyɛminuu Asahel yɛ Gibeon ta lɛ mli.
Abner Fũu David fã Yoab kɛ ewebii lɛ fɛɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbalaa nyɛhe atadei, ni nyɛbua kpekpe nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa.” Maŋtsɛ David nyiɛ Abner gbonyo adeka lɛ sɛɛ.
Ato Abner yɛ Hebron.
Be ni ayɔɔ gbonyobu lɛ naa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David fo Abner, ni ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu wo yara amɛfo.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ lala fo Abner, ni ekɛɛ, “Esa akɛ Abner anyɔ tamɔ yakagbɔmɔ nyɔɔ lo?
Afimɔko oniji lɛ, awoko onaji gboklɛ hu.
Bɔ ni mɛi nyɔɔ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ lɛ, nakai onyɔ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lɛ saa wo yara ni amɛfo Abner aahu.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tutɔ David gbi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ eye nii, shi Maŋtsɛ David kã kitã ekɛɛ, “Kɛji misa minaa aboloo loo nɔ ko dani hulu nyɔ shi fĩĩ, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi nyɔmɔ.” Maŋ lɛ yoo nɔ ni David fee lɛ sɛɛ, ni esa amɛhiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ saa amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Enɛ hã maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel hu fɛɛ na le akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ nine bɛ Abner, Ner bi lɛ, gbele lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee akɛ lumɔ kɛ gbɔmɔ wulu ko enyɔ ŋmɛnɛ yɛ Israel lo?
Afɔ mi mu awo mi Israel Maŋtsɛ moŋ nɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ nɛkɛ Zeruia bihii nɛɛ asane lɛ ebaje mi ablaŋ, ni ehiii mi nɔ ko feemɔ.
Yehowa awo efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ enɔfɔŋ lɛ naa!”
Ishboshet gbele Be ni Saul bi Ishboshet nu akɛ Abner egbo yɛ Hebron lɛ, enijiaŋ je wui; ni Israel muu fɛɛ hu fee yɔɔ.
Ishboshet yɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi enyɔ komɛi ni amɛ kɛ mɛi yaa amɛyayeɔ ofɔ̃ kɛbaa.
Mɔ kome gbɛi ji Baana, ni mɔ kome hu gbɛi ji Rekab.
Amɛtsɛ ji Rimon, Benyaminnyo ni jɛ Beerot lɛ Saul binuu Yonatan yɛ binuu ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa.
Gbekɛ nuu nɛɛ eye afii enumɔ be ni Saul kɛ Yonatan gbele lɛ he sane lɛ bashɛ Yezreel.
Kɛkɛ ni oblayoo ni kwɛɔ gbekɛ lɛ wo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ jo foi.
Shi be ni oblayoo lɛ yeɔ oyai kɛjoɔ foi lɛ, gbekɛ nuu nɛɛ gbee shi, ni enaji kumɔ.
Gbekɛnuu nɛɛ gbɛi ji Mefiboshet.
Rekab kɛ Baana, ni ji Beerotnyo Rimon bihii lɛ, yi mli kɛtee Ishboshet we lɛ.
Amɛshɛ jɛi shwane fintiŋŋ be mli ni Ishboshet kã shi ewɔɔ eshwane wɔ lɛ.
Yoo ni buɔ shĩa lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ miisha ŋmãa mli nɔŋŋ ni wɔ sha lɛ ni ewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Rekab kɛ enyɛminuu Baana shara ehe kɛbote shĩa lɛ mli.
Amɛyanina Ishboshet ni ekã esaa nɔ yɛ epia lɛ mli ewɔ; kɛkɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ, ni amɛfo eyitso.
Amɛkɔ Ishboshet yitso lɛ; ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron.
Amɛbakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Ohenyɛlɔ Saul ni tao bo egbe lɛ, ebi Ishboshet lɛ yitso nɛ.
Yehowa etɔ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ he owele ŋmɛnɛ yɛ Saul kɛ eshwiei anɔ.” Shi hetoo ni David hã Rekab kɛ enyɛminuu Baana, ni ji Beerotnyo Rimon bihii lɛ, ji “Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni ebaa miyi yɛ fimɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ, be ni mɔ ko ba ebagba mi akɛ ‘Naa, Saul egbo,’ ni eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eba ebagba mi sane kpakpa ko lɛ, mimɔ lɛ, ni migbe lɛ yɛ Ziklag, ni mikɛ no wo lɛ nyɔmɔ.
Enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni kɛji gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji etee amɛyagbe jalɔ yɛ wɔmli, yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩa teŋ, ni mibiŋ elá shi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?” Kɛkɛ ni David fã eblahii lɛ, ni amɛgbe Rekab kɛ Baana, ni amɛfolɔ amɛniji kɛ amɛnaji, ni amɛkɛtsotsro kpaakpo ni yɔɔ Hebron lɛ masɛi.
Ni amɛkɔ Ishboshet yitso lɛ, ni amɛyafu yɛ he ni afu Abner yɛ lɛ, yɛ Hebron.
David tsɔ̃ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔ kɛ bo jɛ lá kome.
Nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ be ni Saul yeɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, bo ji tatsɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ kɛtee kɛba, asaŋ Yehowa wo bo shi akɛ ‘Bo oootsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ amɛlumɔ.’ ” Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ David mu, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Be ni David bɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Eye Yuda kɔkrɔɔ maŋtsɛ afii kpawo kɛ nyɔji ekpaa, ni eye Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ ewebii lɛ fã ta kɛyanina Yebusbii ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Yebusbii nɛɛ asusumɔ ji akɛ David nyɛŋ maŋ lɛ eshɔ̃, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛtswa David mpoa akɛ, “Onyɛŋ biɛ oba; shwilafoi kɛ akpakei sɔŋŋ baashwie bo.” Shi David na eshɔ̃ Zion Mɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃, ni ewo jɛi gbɛi David Maŋ agbɛnɛ.
David kɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ biɛ ni etaooo Yebusbii lɛ asane tamɔ bɔ ni mi, David, minyɛɔ amɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ena ni etswia amɛ nii?
Mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ nujɔɔ lɛ mli koni eyatswia shwilafoi lɛ kɛ akpakei lɛ anii ni egbe amɛ.” Sane nɛɛ hewɔ akɛɔ akɛ, “Shwilafoi kɛ akpakei baaa Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.” David kɛ Zion fee eshihilɛhe, ni ewo jɛi gbɛi akɛ David Maŋ.
Esaa etswa maŋ lɛ ehee, kɛjɛ Milo lɛ he kɛba mli gbɛ ekɛbabɔle mɔɔ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe.
David hewalɛ tee nɔ eshwere ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, fĩ esɛɛ.
Tiro maŋtsɛ Hiram wo kapintafoi kɛ tɛ gbogbotswalɔi agbɛ, ni amɛkɛ tsenedru tsei ba, ni amɛkɛbama maŋtsɛ we amɛhã David.
David na akɛ Yehowa ewo emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ gojoo yɛ Yehowa maŋ Israel lɛ hewɔ.
Be ni David efã kɛjɛ Hebron kɛba Yerusalɛm sɛɛ lɛ, esaa eŋɔ hemɛi, ni ekpeekpee yei efata eŋãmɛi lɛ ahe, ni efɔ bihii kɛ biyei efata ebii krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Bii ni David fɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm ji Shamua kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon kɛ Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Nefeg kɛ Yafia, kɛ Elishama kɛ Eliada kɛ Elifelet.
David ye Filistibii anɔ kunim Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ awo David Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Filistibii fɛɛ fã ta akɛ amɛyaamɔ David.
Shi David nu he, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etee ehe yɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Filistibii lɛ ba, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛha jɛi fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David yabi Yehowa nii ekɛɛ, “Ani mifã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ lo?
Ooohã maye amɛnɔ kunim lo?” Yehowa here David nɔ akɛ, “Fãa ta okɛyanina amɛ, ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mahã oye amɛnɔ kunim.” No hewɔ lɛ, David fã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ yɛ Baal-Perazim, (eshishi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni gbaa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ mli) ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ jɛi.
David kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa etsɔ̃ minine nɔ egba kɛtsɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ tamɔ nu ni eje ŋa gbaa lɛ.” No hewɔ ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Baal-Perazim lɛ.
Filistibii lɛ shi amɛmãgãi lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛjo foi, ni David kɛ ewebii lɛ loo amãgãi lɛ kɛtee.
Shi Filistibii lɛ fã ta kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Efraim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni David tee eyabi Yehowa nii lɛ, hetoo ni ehã lɛ ji akɛ, “Kaafã ta lɛ kɛyatua amɛ kɛjɛ biɛ, shi lɔgɔmɔ kɛyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ, koni ojɛ Balsam tsei lɛ aŋlɛnɔ obatua amɛ.
Kɛ onu gbɛɛmɔ yɛ Balsam tsei lɛ ayiteŋ tamɔ naneshi gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ohe afee oya ni otua amɛ, ejaakɛ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miyi ohiɛ miyatswia Filistibii lɛ atabilɔi lɛ anii.” David fee bɔ ni Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ, ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ Geba aahu kɛyashwie Gezer.
Akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba Yerusalɛm David bua Israel hii kãkãlɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe ekoŋŋ.
Ena gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Baala maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Akɛ Yehowa Ofe ni elumɔyeli sɛi lɛ ma kerubim lɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi ewo adeka lɛ.
Amɛyawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Abinadab we lɛ ni yɔɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛma shwiili hee ko nɔ.
Abinadab bihii, Uza kɛ Ahio, kudɔ shwiili hee ni adeka lɛ ma nɔ lɛ.
Ni Ahio nyiɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
David kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nya kɛ lalai kɛ saŋkui kɛ obentai kɛ fabii kɛ miji kɛ ŋoŋoi amɛkɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ.
Be ni ashɛ Nakon ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, tsinai lɛ tɛ ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpa ni eyaagbee shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Uza kpã enine mli ni ekɛmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
Yehowa mli wo Uza la, ni etswa lɛ nɔ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ enine ni ekɛta Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he lɛ hewɔ, ni Uza gbo yɛ enajiaŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛ jɛi Perez-Uza kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Sane lɛ dɔ David akɛ Yehowa kɛ Uza ye kɛ joomɔ nakai.
David she Yehowa gbeyei nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ mato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu?” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, David sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yaa Yerusalɛm.
No hewɔ lɛ, David wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛgba afã kɛtee Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ.
Ato Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ mli nyɔji etɛ̃, ni Yehowa jɔɔ Obed-Edom kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ.
Abagba Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa ejɔɔ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David tee, ni eyawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm kɛ nyamɔ.
Kɛji mɛi ni tere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ famɔ amɛnaji shii ekpaa lɛ, David gbeɔ tsina kɛ too ni ewo fɔ ekɛshãa afɔle.
David jo kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ ekɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni emia kɛ klala efod pɛ.
Lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ kɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Be ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ shɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, bu samflɛ naa, ni ena Maŋtsɛ David ni eehuru ni eejo kɛmiiwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni David he fee Mikal hiɛgbele.
Ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ba, ni akɛyama gbɛhe ni ato ahã lɛ yɛ buu ni David eshi ehã lɛ lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David shã afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei ehã Yehowa.
Be ni David egbe shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ashãa naa lɛ, ejɔɔ maŋbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa Ofe lɛ gbɛi mli, ni eja maŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ji Israel asafo muu lɛ mli hii kɛ yei fɛɛ, niyenii.
Ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ loo kukuli kome kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi akwaabɔ kome.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ mli, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.
Ni be ni David yiŋ etee ewe lɛ ni eyahã sɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, je kpo ekɛ lɛ bakpe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aso nyam pi Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wo ehiɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ kɛ ehe bo ni ejie yɛ etsuji kɛ eweyei ahiɛ tamɔ mɛi ni ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa feɔ lɛ!” Shi David hã Mikal hetoo, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Yehowa, mɔ ni shi otsɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ ni ebaŋɔ mi, ni ewo mi Israel, ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ, nɔ lumɔ lɛ, lɛ ehiɛ nyam mijo mikɛwo lɛ; ni majo ŋmɛnɛ, ni majo wɔ mikɛwo ehiɛ nyam.
Maya nɔ moŋ mawo mihe hiɛgbele fe tsutsu lɛ yɛ bo ohiɛ; shi weyei lɛ ni otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛ lɛ nyam moŋ mihiɛ aaaba yɛ amɛhiɛ.” Mikal, Saul biyoo lɛ, naaa bi kɛyashi egbo.
Shɛɛ ni Natan kɛhã David lɛ Be ni Maŋtsɛ David eyahi emɔɔ lɛ mli, ni Yehowa ehã ena hejɔlɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, etsɛ gbalɔ Natan ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɛ oona akɛ, mi lɛ, mina tsenedru tsu mli mikã be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ buu mli?” Natan hã Maŋtsɛ David hetoo akɛ, “Feemɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã otsui nɔ akɛ ofee lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa fi osɛɛ.” Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ mitsulɔ David akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: Bo omaa tsu ohãa mi mahi mli?
Kɛjɛ be nɔ ni miyakpala Israelbii yɛ Ijipt aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mihiko tsu mli dã, fe buu mli sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ miyɔɔ.
Hei fɛɛ ni mikɛ Israel fɛɛ enyiɛnyiɛ lɛ, mibiko Israel maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni mifãa amɛ akɛ amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko yɛ he ko pɛŋ akɛ mɛɛba po ni nyɛmako tsenedru tsu nyɛhãko mi lɛ?’ “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mitsulɔ David akɛ, mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Too okpalaa, ni miŋɔ bo, ni mifee bo Israel nɔyelɔ, ni he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ mifata ohe, ni miplenee ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni mihã ona gbɛi kpeteŋkple tamɔ gbɔmɛi wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mato he ko mahã mimaŋ Israel koni amɛyahi jɛi akɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ mli, he ni agbaŋ amɛnaa yɛ dɔŋŋ, ni yiwalɔi haoŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa, be ni mito hiɛnyiɛlɔi koni amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ.
Ni mahã ohe ajɔ bo yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ.
Asaŋ mi, Yehowa, miiwo bo shi akɛ mibahã owo shwiei babaoo, ni ogbele sɛɛ lɛ matee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ oshwiei lɛ amli akɛ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama Sɔlemɔ we ehã mi ni mahã emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Mibatsɔ̃ etsɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ mibi.
Kɛji efee nɔ fɔŋ lɛ mibagbala etoi tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ gbalaa ebi toi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mimɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ efoŋ yɛ egbɛfaŋ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã mimɔbɔnalɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Saul gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɔ ni mikpa lɛ ni obaye esɛɛ lɛ.
Mibahã owe lɛ kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ ama shi shiŋŋ daa kɛaatee naanɔ; omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ baama shi shiŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.’ ” Natan gba David wiemɔi nɛɛ kɛ ninaa nɛɛ bɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
David sɔle eda shi Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David bote Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eho eta shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, namɔ ji mi, ni mɛni mli miwe lɛ yɔɔ hewɔ ni ohiɛ mi kɛbashi be nɛ nɛɛ?
Ni kɛ̃lɛ enɛ jeee nɔ ko srɔto ko hã bo, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Otsɔ̃ɔ wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ nibii ni baaba, mi otsulɔ, miwe lɛ nɔ hu.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ mi shwiei ni mawo.
Mɛni po yɔɔ mi David minaa ni makɛɛ dɔŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ole mi, otsulɔ.
Shi ni owo lɛ, akɛ ni eji bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔmɔnaa hewɔ lɛ, ofee nibii wuji nɛɛ fɛɛ koni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi, otsulɔ, nii.
Anɔkwa, oda kpeteŋkple, Ofe, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ bo yeee egbɔ, ni asaŋ yɛ nii fɛɛ ni wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi lɛ naa lɛ, osɛɛ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.
Mɛɛ maŋ kroko ko yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni etamɔ omaŋ Israel, ni ji maŋ ni bo Nyɔŋmɔ otee oyakpɔ̃ amɛ; ni ofee amɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owebii, ni okɛhe gbɛi, ni otsu nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ohã amɛ, akɛ ogbɛ maŋ muu kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ oshwã yɛ amɛhiɛ?
Oma omaŋ Israel nɔ mi akɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni bo Yehowa otsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
“Agbɛnɛ, Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ, maa shi ni owo yɛ mi, otsulɔ, kɛ ewe lɛ he lɛ nɔ mi kɛya naanɔ; ofee nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, ni ogbɛi lɛ aaada kpeteŋkple, ni aaakɛɛ kɛya naanɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Israel;’ ni mi otsulɔ David we lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ.
Akɛ bo Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ojie nii nɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi otsulɔ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mahã oshwiei atsɔmɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ,’ no hã mi, otsulɔ, mina ekãa misɔle nɛkɛ sɔlemɔ nɛɛ.
“Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ni okɛ nɔ kpakpa nɛɛ ewo otsulɔ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, na he tsui koni ojɔɔ otsulɔ we lɛ bɔ ni afee ni miwe lɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, owo shi, ni jɔɔmɔ lɛ aaahi mishwiei lɛ anɔ kɛya naanɔ.”
Tai amli kunim ni David ye lɛ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eshɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David ye Moabbii lɛ hu anɔ kunim.
Ehã Moabbii ni amɔmɔ lɛ kamɔ shikpɔŋ.
Ni kɛji ekɛ susumɔ kpãa susu gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni ena kpãi enyɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ ehã agbe amɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ esusu kpãa kome, kɛkɛ lɛ ehã amɛyi ena wala.
Moabbii lɛ tsɔmɔ David tsuji, ni amɛtsu onia amɛhã lɛ.
David ye Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer, Rehob bi lɛ, hu nɔ kunim, be ni Hadadezer yiŋ etee akɛ eyaapele hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ he lɛ.
David mɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer hii okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpe kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ tabilɔi nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
David folɔ okpɔŋɔi ni gbalaa shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ anaji asɛɛ fãi, shi eshi okpɔŋɔi lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi bɔ ni baahi ahã tayaa shwiilii oha.
Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ ba koni amɛbawa Zoba maŋtsɛ Hadadezer; shi David gbe Siriabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David shi asraafoi eto Siriabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Siriabii lɛ tsɔmɔ David tsuji, ni etsũ amɛ onia.
Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he.
David shɔ̃ shika tsɛŋi ni Hadadezer tsuji lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba Yerusalɛm; asaŋ eloo akɔɔble babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Beta kɛ Berotai, maji ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ.
Be ni Toi, Hamat maŋtsɛ lɛ, nu akɛ David eye Hadadezer ta tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu ebi, Yoram, Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ koni eyaŋa lɛ ni ehã lɛ aekoo ehã lɛ, yɛ Hadadezer nɔ kunim ni eye lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer kɛ Toi lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe wuwuu tai saŋŋ.
Yoram hiɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii kɛ akɔɔble nibii ekɛbake David.
Maŋtsɛ David jɔɔ nibii nɛɛ hu anɔ eke akɛ akɛsɔmɔ Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni ejɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni eshɔ̃ kɛjɛ majimaji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ amli kɛba lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maji lɛ ji Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Filisti kɛ Amalek.
Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer, Rehob bi lɛ, nibii ni ashɔ̃ lɛ ekomɛi hu fata he.
David gbɛi hehee kɛteke nɔ.
Be ni eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ ta lɛ ebaa lɛ, eyagbe Edombii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David shi asraafoi eto Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni Edombii fɛɛ tsɔmɔ David tsuji.
Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he.
David ye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni eye jalɛ sane ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ akɛ Zeruia lɛ, ji David tatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ; ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ woloŋmalɔ; ni Zadok, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ Ahimelek, Abiatar bi lɛ, amɛ ji osɔfoi; ni Seraia ji maŋtsɛ we woloŋmalɔ.
Ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji tabilɔi ni buɔ David he tuuŋtu lɛ atsɛ, ni David bihii lɛ miisɔmɔ akɛ osɔfoi.
David fee Mefiboshet ejurɔ Gbi ko lɛ David bi akɛ, “Ani Saul shwie ko kwraa yɛ jeŋ lolo lo?
Masumɔ akɛ mafee mɔ lɛ ejurɔ yɛ Yonatan hewɔ.” Tsulɔ ko yɛ Saul we lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ziba, ni ayatsɛ lɛ abahã David.
Be ni Ziba ba lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Ziba lɛ?” Ziba jie naa akɛ, “Ofainɛ, mi ni.” Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani Saul shwie ko kwraa yɛ jeŋ lolo, koni mafee mɔ lɛ ejurɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lo?” Ziba to he ekɛɛ, “Yonatan musuŋ binuu ko yɛ lolo, ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?” Ziba here nɔ akɛ, “Eyɛ Amiel bi Makir we lɛ yɛ Lo-Debar.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David tsu atee koni ayaŋɔ Yonatan musuŋ binuu lɛ yɛ Amiel bi Makir we lɛ yɛ Lo-Debar kɛba.
Be ni Mefiboshet, Yonatan binuu ni ji Saul nabi lɛ, shɛ David ŋɔɔ lɛ, eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eŋa David.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mefiboshet,” ni Mefiboshet here nɔ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, naa mi.” David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei!
Miyɛ ejurɔ ni mafee bo yɛ otsɛ Yonatan hewɔ.
Mibakpale onii Saul shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ mahã bo; ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ obaata mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he, ni okɛ mi baaye nii daa.” Kɛkɛ ni Mefiboshet koto David ni ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, namɔ po ji mi, otsulɔ, ni tamɔ gbee gbonyo nɛɛ, ni ona mihe tsuijurɔ nɛkɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ Ziba, Saul tsulɔ lɛ; ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, miikpale nibii ni ji Saul kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nii lɛ miihã Mefiboshet, onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ obii lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ baahu shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni okpa enɔ nii ohã onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ we lɛ koni amɛna nii amɛye.
Shi moŋ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ Mefiboshet, onuŋtsɔ nabi lɛ, kɛ mi aaata okplɔ̃ he be fɛɛ be ni wɔye nii.” (Ziba nɛɛ yɛ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ tsuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ.)
Kɛkɛ ni Ziba here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mibafee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ efã etsulɔ akɛ efee lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Mefiboshet kɛ David ta okplɔ̃ he ye nii tamɔ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Mefiboshet yɛ binuu fioo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mika.
Ziba shĩa lɛ mli bii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ Mefiboshet tsuji.
Mefiboshet ni enaji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ eje kpa lɛ, hi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni eyeɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
