David ye Amonbii lɛ kɛ Siriabii lɛ anɔ kunim Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash gbo, ni ebi Hanun baye esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David to eyiŋ akɛ ebaajie mlihilɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Hanun tamɔ bɔ ni Hanun tsɛ Nahash mli hi hã lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu etsuji akɛ amɛyahã Hanun kpoo amɛhã lɛ, yɛ etsɛ gbele lɛ hewɔ.
Be ni David tsuji lɛ yashɛ Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Amonbii alumɛi lɛ wo amɛnuŋtsɔ Hanun yiŋ akɛ, “Naa, tsumɔ ni David etsu kɛba ni abahã bo kpoo nɛɛ lɛ, kaasusu akɛ ekɛmiiwo otsɛ hiɛ nyam.
Maŋ lɛ saramɔ kɛ eshikpamɔ moŋ hewɔ ni David tsu bɔfoi kɛba nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enyɛ maŋ lɛ ebaŋɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Hanun mɔmɔ David bɔfoi lɛ, ni eshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋi fãfãafãi, ni no sɛɛ lɛ efolɔ amɛtadei lɛ anɔ yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu kɛbata amɛjoŋkui anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ejie bɔfoi lɛ agbɛ amɛtee.
Be ni David nu nɔ ni eba lɛ, etsu ni akɛ bɔfoi lɛ yakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ, ejaakɛ abɔ amɛ ahora fe nine.
Ekɛ shɛɛ maje yahã amɛ akɛ amɛwa Yeriko kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛtsɛŋi lɛ aaatsa dani amɛba shĩa.
Amonbii lɛ na akɛ amɛyata David he.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsu kɛtee ni ayabɔ Siriabii tabilɔi ni nyiɛɔ nane akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ apaa kɛjɛ Bet-Rehob kɛ Zoba.
Amɛyabɔ Maaka maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi akpe kɛ Tob tabilɔi hu akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ apaa.
Be ni David nu lɛ, ewo Yoab kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ata lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee koni amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ ayawu.
Amonbii lɛ je kpo, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ amɛmaŋ, Raba, agbo lɛ naa.
Shi Siriabii lɛ ni jɛ Zoba kɛ Rehob lɛ kɛ Tob hii lɛ kɛ Maaka hii lɛ sɔŋŋ tse amɛhe, ni amɛgba amɛta lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoab na akɛ agba ta awo lɛ yɛ esɛɛ kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ehala Israel tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ekomɛi, ni ehã amɛgba ta koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ akpe.
No sɛɛ lɛ, etu etabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ ewo enyɛmi Abishai dɛŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ gba ta koni amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ akpe.
Ekɛɛ Abishai akɛ, “Kɛ ona akɛ Siriabii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ minɔ lɛ koni oba ni obaye obua mi; ni mi hu kɛji mina akɛ Amonbii lɛ anine miitsɔ onɔ lɛ, mibaba mibaye mabua bo.
Feemɔ ekãa, ni hã wɔ fɛɛ wɔfee nuu yɛ wɔmaŋbii kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maji lɛ ahewɔ, ni Yehowa aaahã nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ aba mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Siriabii lɛ, shi Siriabii lɛ jo foi yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Be ni Amonbii lɛ na akɛ Siriabii lɛ ejo foi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛjo Abishai naa foi, ni amɛyabote maŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ Amonbii lɛ kɛ ta lɛ wuumɔ, ni eba Yerusalɛm.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ na akɛ Israelbii lɛ eye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛbua amɛtabilɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe.
Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tsu kɛtee koni ayaŋɔ Siriabii lɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛba.
Ni amɛba Helam ni Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tatsɛ Shobak lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ.
Be ni David na ele lɛ, ebua Israel tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ekɛ amɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ, ni etee Helam.
Siriabii lɛ gba ta wo David, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wu.
Siriabii lɛ jo foi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, shi David gbe Siriabii atayaa shwiiliiatsɛmɛi ohai kpawo kɛ okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
David pila Shobak, Siriabii atatsɛ lɛ, ni enyɔ yɛ ta lɛ naa.
Be ni maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ na akɛ Israel eye amɛnɔ lɛ, amɛ kɛ Israel bakpãtã, ni amɛsɔmɔ Israel.
Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ she gbeyei akɛ amɛaate shi amɛyaye amɛbua Amonbii lɛ.
David kɛ Batsheba Afi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ, be ni maŋtsɛmɛi fãa ta lɛ, David wo Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ Israel tabilɔi gbɛ, ni amɛyakpãtã Amonbii lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛyasa Raba maŋ lɛ yi; shi David diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ehi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Gbi ko gbɛkɛnaashi blɛoo mli lɛ, David ete shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli, ni eeshara shi yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni ejɛ jɛi ni ena yoo ko ni miiju ehe.
Kɛji okwɛ yoo nɛɛ lɛ ehe yɛ fɛo jogbaŋŋ naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu koni atao mɔ ni yoo lɛ ji.
Abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ Eliam biyoo ni; atsɛɔ lɛ Batsheba, Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, ŋa ji lɛ.
David tsu bɔfoi ni ayaŋɔ Batsheba abahã lɛ.
Akɛ yoo lɛ ba David ŋɔɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ.
(Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Batsheba etee tsuiasɛɛ ni etsuu ehe egbe naa.)
Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ.
Batsheba na akɛ ena musu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etsu ayakɛɛ David akɛ ehiɛ musu.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atee Yoab ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, abana mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yoab hã Uria ba David ŋɔɔ.
Be ni Uria ba lɛ David bi lɛ bɔ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi lɛ yɔɔ, kɛ bɔ ni ta lɛ hu yaa nɔ hãa.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David kɛɛ Uria akɛ, “Yaa owe lɛ, ni oyawo otsui.” Be ni Uria shi maŋtsɛ we lɛ, David tsu akɛ akɛ nikee ayahã Uria.
Shi Uria eyaaa ewe lɛ, shi moŋ lɛ ekɛ etabilɔi ni buɔ ehe ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ fɛɛ yawɔ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ koi lɛ shi.
Be ni David na nu akɛ Uria eyaaa ewe lɛ, David bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee gbɛ ojɛ oba nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba oyaaa owe lɛ?” Uria jie naa akɛ, “Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ miiwɔ bui amli, ni minuŋtsɔ tatsɛ Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ jwere ŋa nɔ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni mi lɛ miyaa miwe ni miyayeɔ nii, ni minuɔ dãa, ni mi kɛ miŋa wɔɔ hu?
Mina onane akɛ miwoŋ nɛkɛ nɔ ko feemɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Uria akɛ, “Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, hii biɛ ŋmɛnɛ hu mɔ koni wɔ lɛ mawo bo gbɛ ni oya.” No hewɔ lɛ, Uria hi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm nakai gbi lɛ kɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ hu.
Ni David tsu ayatsɛ Uria kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛ lɛ ta okplɔ̃ he amɛye nii.
Ehã Uria nu dãa ni etɔ, shi nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ hu lɛ Uria kɛ etabilɔi ni buɔ ehe lɛ wɔ maŋtsɛ koi lɛ shi, ni eyaaa ewe lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ David ŋma Yoab wolo, ni ekɛtsu Uria ekɛtee eyahã lɛ.
David ŋma yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Hã Uria adamɔ ta lɛ naa yɛ he ni wa fe fɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛgbalaa nyɛhe shi nyɛshĩa lɛ koni nine atsɔ̃ enɔ ni agbe lɛ.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, be mli ni Yoab foɔ sa ewoɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ, ehã Uria damɔ he ni ele akɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahii kakabãi yɔɔ lɛ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ Yoab bawu; David tsuji lɛ ekomɛi nyɔnyɔɔ, Uria Hitnyo lɛ hu nyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tsu koni ayabɔ Maŋtsɛ David ta lɛ mli amaniɛ fɛɛ tswɛm.
Ewo bɔfo lɛ shi akɛ, “Kɛji obɔ maŋtsɛ ta lɛ mli amaniɛ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ogbe naa, ni aleee nɔ emli aaafu, ni eeebi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛkɛ ta lɛ bɛŋkɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ kpaakpa lɛ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ amɛbaajɛ maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ nyɛ gãi?
Nyɛkaiii Gideon bi Abimelek gbele lɛ akɛ yoo ni jɛ maŋ gbogbo nɔ ekɛ wiɛbi tswa eyiteŋ yɛ Tebez ni egbo lɛ?
Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛtsi nyɛbɛŋkɛ amɛmaŋ gbogbo lɛ nakai lɛ?’ Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ bi bo nɛkɛ lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Otsulɔ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, hu enyɔ.’ ” Bɔfo lɛ yiŋ eba, ni ehã wiemɔ ni Yoab kɛtsu lɛ lɛ shɛ David dɛŋ.
Ebakɛɛ David akɛ, “Henyɛlɔi lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli koni amɛkɛ wɔ abawu yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; shi wɔnine tsɔ amɛnɔ, ni wɔshwie amɛ kɛyashi maŋ agbo lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ.
Jɛi ni gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ jɛ maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ otsuji agãi, ni maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ekomɛi gboi.
Otsulɔ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ hu egbo.” David kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Yaakɛɛ Yoab akɛ ekahã sane nɛɛ mihao lɛ, ejaakɛ klante yɔɔ nɛɛ ekpaaa mɔ hiɛ ni ekpãtãa.
Ehã maŋ lɛ nitswiamɔ lɛ mli awa moŋ koni eye nɔ.
Yaawo lɛ hewalɛ.” Be ni Uria ŋa, Batsheba, nu akɛ ewu Uria egbo lɛ, efo ewu lɛ.
Be ni Batsheba eye ŋkɔmɔ egbe naa lɛ, David tsu ni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni etsɔ eŋa.
Batsheba kɛ David fɔ binuu.
Shi sane ni David ye nɛɛ eŋɔɔɔ Yehowa naa.
Natan wiemɔ hã David shwa ehe Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tsu Natan David ŋɔɔ; ni Natan ba ni ebakɛɛ David akɛ, “Hii enyɔ komɛi hi maŋ ko nɔ be ko.
Amɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ niiatsɛ ni, ni mɔ kome lɛ ohiafo ni.
Niiatsɛ lɛ yɛ toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, shi ohiafo lɛ bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe gwantɛŋbi yoo bibioo kome pɛ ni eyahe.
Elɛ ekooloo nɛɛ ni ekɛ eshĩaŋ gbekɛbii lɛ fɛɛ badara.
Niyenii ni eyeɔ lɛ, no eko ehãa toobi lɛ, ni ekɛ toobi lɛ nuɔ kpulu kome naa nu; ni kɛfee lɛ ewoɔ lɛ eŋmɛɔ ekpɔkɔiaŋ.
Toobi lɛ tamɔ biyoo hã lɛ.
Be ko lɛ gbɔ ko bato nuu niiatsɛ lɛ; shi akɛ ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ emɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etoo loo etsinai lɛ eko ni egbe ehã egbɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eshi ekooloi lɛ asɛɛ, ni eyamɔ ohiafo lɛ gwantɛŋbi lɛ moŋ, ni egbe ehã egbɔ ni ebato lɛ lɛ.” David mli fu niiatsɛ lɛ naakpa, ni ekɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ, nuu ni ye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ lɛ esa gbele, ni esa akɛ eto toobi lɛ najiaŋ toi ejwɛ, akɛni enyɛ eye ohiafo lɛ nɛkɛ sane, ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Natan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Bo ji nakai nuu lɛ.
Ni naa nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ, ‘Miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ, ni mihere oyiwala yɛ Saul dɛŋ; asaŋ ni mikɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ hã bo, ni mihã otsɔ̃ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Eji enɛɛmɛi faaa kulɛ mafata he mahã bo.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni oku, mi Yehowa, migbee nɔ, ni ofee efɔŋ nɛɛ?
Ogbe Uria, Hitnyo lɛ.
Ohã Amonbii lɛ gbe lɛ, kɛkɛ ni oŋɔ eŋa lɛ ofee oŋa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, bo hu kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ klante naa gbele kpãŋ yɛ oshwiei ateŋ, ejaakɛ obuuu mi, ni oŋɔ Uria Hitnyo lɛ ŋa lɛ ofee oŋa.
Miiwo bo shi!
Mahã gbɔmɔ ajɛ bo nɔŋŋ owe lɛ mli ate shi awo bo; ni ohiɛ tua ookwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni mashɔ oŋamɛi lɛ mahã owekunyo, ni ekɛ oŋamɛi lɛ baawɔ shwane fintiŋŋ.
Bo lɛ otee ohe, ni ofee esha lɛ, shi mi lɛ mibafee nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ yɛ Israel fɛɛ hiɛ shwane fintiŋŋ?’ ” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Mifee Yehowa shishi esha,” Natan to he ni ekɛɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa hu kɛ esha ni ofee lɛ efa bo, ni ogboŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ akɛ obuuu Yehowa yɛ nɔ ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, bi lɛ ni abaafɔ ahã bo lɛ yi naŋ wala; gbo eeegbo.” Kɛkɛ ni Natan shi David ni etee ewe.
Batsheba bi gbo Yehowa hã hela shi bi lɛ ni Uria ŋa lɛ kɛ David fɔ lɛ nɔ, ni gbekɛ lɛ he ye waa naakpa.
David sɔle ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai ehã gbekɛ lɛ koni ehe awa lɛ; David hi ŋmaa, ni eho ekã shikpɔŋ yɛ etsu lɛ mli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ewe lɛ mli onukpai lɛ tee koni amɛyawo enɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ, shi David ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ, ni nii hu emiii akɛ eye.
Gbi ni hela lɛ na otsi lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ gbo; shi David tsuji lɛ she gbeyei akɛ amɛaakɛɛ lɛ gbekɛ lɛ gbele lɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lolo po lɛ, wɔkɛ lɛ wie lɛ ebooo wɔ toi.
Te wɔɔɔfee tɛŋŋ wɔkɛɛ lɛ akɛ gbekɛ lɛ egbo hu?
Kɛji akwɛɛɛ ni ahi lɛ eeefee ehe efɔŋ ko.” Shi be ni David na bɔ ni etsuji lɛ wieɔ ablɛbi lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni eyoo sɛɛ akɛ gbekɛ lɛ egbo.
No hewɔ lɛ, David bi etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Gbekɛ lɛ egbo, bɛɛ?” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Egbo”.
Kɛkɛ ni David te shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni eju ehe, ni ekpa mu, ni eshwã eyi; kɛkɛ ni etsake etadei lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Yehowa we lɛ, ni eyasɔle.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David ba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ mli; ni be ni ebi niyenii shi ni akɛ eko bama ehiɛ lɛ, eye.
David tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔnuuu bo shishi!
Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, ohi ŋmaa, ni ofo ohã lɛ; shi ni egbo moŋ lɛ ni oyeɔ nii nɛɛ?” David kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be ni gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ kã lolo lɛ, mihi ŋmãa ni mifo, ejaakɛ misusumɔ ji akɛ eko lɛ Yehowa aaana mi mɔbɔ, ni eeehã gbekɛ lɛ yi ana wala; shi agbɛnɛ ni ena egbo lɛ, mɛni mahi ŋmãa mafee?
Manyɛ mahã eba wala mli ekoŋŋ?
Mi moŋ maya he ni eyɔɔ lɛ; shi lɛ lɛ ekpaleŋ ebaŋ miŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.” David shɛje eŋa Batsheba mii; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ na bɔlɛ ni Batsheba fɔ binuu, ni David wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Solomon.
Yehowa na gbekɛ lɛ he tsui, ni etsu Natan gbalɔ lɛ kɛtee ni eyawo gbekɛ lɛ gbɛi “Yedidia” ehã Yehowa.
David yaŋɔ Raba maŋ lɛ Ni Yoab fã ta kɛyatua Amonbii amaŋ wulu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Raba lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛwu; ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tsu bɔfoi David ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ: “Miyatua Rababii, ni miŋɔ maŋ lɛ he ni amɛnaa nu kɛjɛɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ buamɔ maŋ lɛ tabilɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ anaa, koni okɛ amɛ abatua amɛmaŋ wulu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni oŋɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mi mikayaŋɔ ni akɛ migbɛi wo maŋ lɛ.” Enɛ hã David bua etabilɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ amɛ fã kɛtee eyatua Raba ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David jie shika maŋtsɛ fai ni akɛbu Amonbii ajemawɔŋ Molek lɛ shiu lɛ, ni ekɛbu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyitso.
Maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ tsiimɔ aaafee talenta kome, ni ojarawatɛ ko hɔ mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, eloo maŋ lɛ mli nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Maŋbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ehã amɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛkɛ saalai kɛ kɔi kɛ lema atsu; asaŋ enyɛ amɛnɔ hu ni amɛfo ntayaa amɛhã lɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ekɛ Amonbii amaji lɛ fɛɛ ye ehã.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm.
Amnon kɛ Tamar David binuu Absalom yɛ nyɛbiyoo fɛɛfɛo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tamar.
David binuu kroko ni gbɛi ji Amnon lɛ basumɔ Tamar.
Amnon sumɔ enyɛmi yoo nɛɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni suɔmɔ lɛ wo lɛ hela tete, ejaakɛ Amnon leee gbɛ koome nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ ni enine aaashɛ Tamar nɔ, ejaakɛ Tamar lɛ oblayoo foro ni.
Amnon yɛ naanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yonadab, ni ji David nyɛmi nuu, Shimea, lɛ binuu.
Mɔlakalɔ jogbaŋŋ ji Yonadab nɛɛ.
Yonadab bi Amnon akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni bo maŋtsɛbi muu lɛ otãa loo gbi fɛɛ gbi nɛɛ?
Ogbaaa mi nɔ ni gbaa onaa?” Amnon jie naa ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ Tamar, minyɛmi Absalom nyɛbiyoo lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yonadab kɛɛ Amnon akɛ, “Yaahɔ osaa mli, ni okwa akɛ ohe miiye; ni kɛji otsɛ ba bo saramɔ lɛ okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ataa, ofainɛ ni ohã minyɛmiyoo Tamar aba ni ebafee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enine naa niyenii yɛ mihiɛ ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni maye.’ ” Amnon tee eyakã shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ekwa akɛ ehe miiye.
Be ni etsɛ, Maŋtsɛ David, ba lɛ saramɔ lɛ, Amnon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, ofainɛ ni ohã minyɛmi yoo Tamar aba ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebashã aboloi enyɔ oo ko yɛ mihiɛ ni ehiɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni maye.” Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atee Tamar ŋɔɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa onyɛmi Amnon we lɛ koni oyafee niyenii fioo ko ohã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Tamar yiŋ etee enyɛmi Amnon we lɛ, ni eyanina lɛ ni ekã saa nɔ.
Tamar tĩ ma, ni ekpɔtɔ ekɛfee niyenii lɛ be mli ni Amnon miikwɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni eshã aboloo lɛ.
Amnon miikwɛ nɔŋŋ ni Tamar wo nishãa tsɛnsi lɛ ni etsɔ̃ niyenii lɛ yɛ mli ehã lɛ.
Amnon ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ yeli, shi moŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi mimasɛi.” Ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ je kpo yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Amnon kɛɛ Tamar akɛ, “Okɛ niyenii lɛ aba pia lɛ mli koni ohiɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni maye.” Tamar wo aboloo ni eshã lɛ kɛtee enyɛmi Amnon ŋɔɔ yɛ pia lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Tamar tsi bɛŋkɛ Amnon kɛ niyenii lɛ koni eye lɛ, Amnon mɔ Tamar mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo, hã ni wɔna bɔlɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Tamar kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabida, minyɛmi nuu!
Kaamɔ mi akranaŋ naa, ejaakɛ aahi nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israel!
Kaafee nɛkɛ hiɛgbejianii nɛɛ!
Bo lɛ oootsɔ̃ tamɔ Israel hii yakagbɔmɛi lɛ eko kɛkɛ, shi mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ po mi kɛ nɛkɛ hiɛgbele nɛɛ aaatee?
Shi moŋ okɛ maŋtsɛ ayawie he, ni mile akɛ ekɛ mi baahã bo aahu.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ Amnon booo Tamar toi, ni akɛni ehe wa fe Tamar hewɔ lɛ, emɔ lɛ akranaŋ naa, ni ekɛ lɛ wɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Amnon he tsɛ̃ Tamar waa bɔ ni hetsɛ̃ lɛ naa yawa fe suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ Tamar lɛ; ni ekɛɛ Tamar akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya.” Tamar kɛɛ Amnon akɛ, “Dabida, kaafee mi nakai, ejaakɛ shwiemɔ ni oshwieɔ mi nɛɛ moŋ ji efɔŋ ni naa wa fe klɛŋklɛŋ efɔŋ ni ofee mi lɛ.” Shi Amnon booo lɛ toi; shi moŋ etsɛ oblanyo ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shwiemɔ yoo nɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ kɛje kpo, ni ola shinaa lɛ sɛɛ.” Tsulɔ lɛ shwie Tamar kɛje kpo, ni ela shinaa lɛ sɛɛ.
Tamar wo atade wuyaa kɛ ehe niji kakadaji; blema lɛ no ji maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei froi atade.
Kɛkɛ ni Tamar loo lamlu eshwie eyiteŋ, ni egbala atade wuyaa fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ, ni ekɔlɔ eniji eshwie eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ yaafo gegeege kɛtee.
Enyɛmi Absalom bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani onyɛmi Amnon eta ohe lo?
Minyɛmi yoo!
Kaahã enɛ miiye otsui tsɔ̃, shi moŋ feemɔ dioo; ni kaagba mɔ ko, ejaakɛ onyɛmi ni.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Tamar wa enyɛmi Absalom we lɛ, ni ewo ehe tsuŋ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David nu saji fɛɛ ni eba lɛ he lɛ, emli wo la naakpa.
Absalom nyɛ Amnon waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ enyɛbiyoo Tamar ni Amnon mɔ lɛ lɛ hewɔ; shi moŋ ejieee dɔlɛ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ Amnon.
Absalom tɔ owele Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ afii enyɔ lɛ, aaku Absalom toi ahetsɔi yɛ Baal-Hazor ni bɛŋkɛ Efraim maŋ lɛ, ni ekpee maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛba jɛi.
Absalom ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, aaku mitoi ahetsɔi.
Ofainɛ koni Nii kɛ etsuji lɛ abafata mihe kɛnya yɛ jɛi.” Maŋtsɛ David here Absalom nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida, mibi!
Kɛji wɔ fɛɛ wɔba lɛ, ebaafee tɔlɛ kɛ naagba tsɔ̃ ehã bo.” Absalom fi nɔ doo akɛ eekpee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, shi Maŋtsɛ David ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ; shi moŋ ejɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nakai lɛ, ofainɛ, hã minyɛmi Amnon kɛ wɔ aya mɔ.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ekɛ bo aya?” Absalom hiɛ sane lɛ mli aahu ni naagbee lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋmɛ gbɛ, ni Amnon kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Absalom tee.
Absalom kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Kɛfee lɛ nyɛkwɛa Amnon, kɛji nyɛna akɛ wain lɛ ehã emli efili lɛ, ni mifã akɛ atswa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea lɛ.
Nyɛkashea gbeyei ejaakɛ mi mifã nyɛ.
Nyɛfea ekãa; nyɛfea hii!” Absalom tsuji lɛ ye efãmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛgbe Amnon.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ bihii krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ho tara amɛtejiokpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛjo foi.
Maŋtsɛbii lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lolo, ni abatswa David adafi akɛ, “Shi ota?
Absalom egbe obihii lɛ fɛɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ eshwɛko!” Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni Maŋtsɛ David ho edamɔ shi, ni egbala atadei lɛ yɛ ehe, ni eho ekã shikpɔŋ.
Etsuji fɛɛ ni damɔ emasɛi nakai be lɛ gbalagbalaa amɛ hu amɛtadei.
Kɛkɛ ni David nyɛmi nuu, Shimea, bi Yonadab kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Nii, agbeko obihii lɛ fɛɛ.
Amnon kome kɛkɛ agbe, ejaakɛ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni Amnon mɔ Absalom nyɛbiyoo Tamar, ni efite lɛ lɛ beebe, ni Absalom to eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee nɛkɛ nɔ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, kaahe sane nɛɛ oye akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ fɛɛ ni egboi lɛ, ejaakɛ Amnon kome kɛkɛ ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ.” Ni fee nakai lɛ Absalom jo foi.
Shi trukaa lɛ oblanyo tabilɔ ni miibu lɛ yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena mɛi babaoo ni miiba yɛ Horonaim gbɛ lɛ nɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.
Etee ni eyagba Maŋtsɛ David nɔ ni ena lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonadab kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Naa, maŋtsɛbii lɛ miiba.
Bɔ ni otsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ ni.” Yonadab naa ni nyɔ shi nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ, naa maŋtsɛbii lɛ ni amɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo yara, ni Maŋtsɛ David hu kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ wo yara amɛfo aahu.
- Be ni Absalom jo foi lɛ, etee Geshur maŋtsɛ Talmai, ni ji Amihud bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ yahi shi afii etɛ̃.
David ye ebinuu Absalom he awerɛho daa gbi.
Ni eshwe Absalom; shi Amnon gbɛfaŋ lɛ, David tse etsui eŋmɛ emli ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ egbo momo.
Yoab wa ni Absalom ku esɛɛ eba shĩa Be ni Zeruia bi Yoab na bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui yeɔ yɛ Absalom he ehãa lɛ, etsu atee Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli ayaŋɔ yoo nilelɔ ko abahã lɛ.
Yoab kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Kwaa ni otsɔ̃ ohe ŋkɔmɔyelɔ.
Otao yalafeemɔ bo obu, ni okakpa mu, koni ofee ohe tamɔ yoo ni eeye emɔ ko ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ be babaoo; ni oya Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ bɔ ni makɛɛ bo nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ta wiemɔi lɛ ewo yoo lɛ naa.
Be ni Tekoayoo lɛ yashɛ Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ lɛ, eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nii, ofainɛ ni oye obua mi.” David bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji osane lɛ?” Yoo lɛ jie naa akɛ, “Miwu egbo, ni eshi mi okulafo.
Oweyoo bihii enyɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ be yɛ ŋa nɔ; ni akɛni mɔ ko bɛ jɛi ni aaakpãtã amɛ hewɔ lɛ, mɔ kome tswa mɔ kome nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Amrɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ weku lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ete shi ewo mi.
Amɛkɛɛ mijie binuu ni tswa enyɛmi lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ lɛ mihã amɛ, koni amɛgbe lɛ kɛtɔ enyɛmi ni egbe lɛ he owele.
Be lɛ amɛbaakpãtã mibiiatsɛ lɛ niyelɔ lɛ hu hiɛ.
Ni kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, amɛbaahã mihiɛnɔkãmɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ atã, ni miwu lɛ hu gbɛi loo eseshi baalaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, bo lɛ yaa owe lɛ; ni matsu osane lɛ he nii.” Tekoayoo lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kɛji tɔ̃mɔ ko aaaba lɛ, ekã mi kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ nɔ.
Sɔ̃ ko sɔ̃ ko akawula maŋtsɛ kɛ eshwiei ayiteŋ.” Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ bo aaawie nɔ ko lɛ, okɛ mɔ lɛ aba miŋɔɔ; ni kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ mɔ lɛ etaŋ ohe dɔŋŋ.” Tekoayoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ, ni okpa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai koni mɔ ni taoɔ etɔ mibi lɛ lá lɛ he owele lɛ yiŋ atsake koni ekashwie mibi ni eshwɛ lɛ lá shi.” Maŋtsɛ David to he ekɛɛ, “Mina Yehowa akɛ kɛji obi lɛ yiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ nyɔ shi fĩĩ.” Yoo lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni oŋmɛ oweyoo gbɛ koni ekɛɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ nɔ ko.” Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Wiemɔ”.
Kɛkɛ ni Tekoayoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba mɔ ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ yeɔ nɛkɛ sane?
Bɔ ni obua sane lɛ he ohã nɛɛ lɛ, belɛ gbii abɔ ni maŋtsɛ eyakpalako ebi ni enyɔ kooŋ lɛ kɛbako lɛ, maŋtsɛ miibu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ ehe fɔ mɔ.
Gbele kã shi hã wɔ fɛɛ, ni ehãa wɔtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nu ni atsi ashwie shikpɔŋ, ni ehiii loomɔ dɔŋŋ.
Shi mɔ ni toɔ gbɛjianɔ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni enyɔ kooŋ aba shĩa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ egbeee lɛ.
Nii, nɔ hewɔ ni miba mikɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ bawie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ maŋbii lɛ wo mihe gbeyei.
Enɛ hã mito miyiŋ akɛ maya mikɛ maŋtsɛ ayawie akɛ aleenɔ eeefee nɔ ni mi, otsulɔyoo, aaabi lɛ lɛ lo.
Ejaakɛ mile faŋŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ aaabo mi toi, ni eeejie mi yɛ nuu ni taoɔ akɛ ejie mi kɛ mibi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã ewebii lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Mina hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ hetoo ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ aaahã mi lɛ baahã mitsui anyɔ mimli, ejaakɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, ni enaa nɔ kpakpa kɛ nɔ gbonyo.
Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ bo.” Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Tekoayoo lɛ akɛ, “Sane ni mibabi bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, gbaa mi anɔkwale ni yɔɔ mli.” Yoo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ awie.” Maŋtsɛ David bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni obafee nɛɛ lɛ, Yoab nine yɛ mli lo?” Yoo lɛ jie sane lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, “Mina minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ akɛ anɔkwale lɛ shishiishi owie lɛ.
Otsulɔ Yoab ni tsu mi, asaŋ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eta wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ewo minaa.
Otsulɔ Yoab to ŋaa nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni atsake sane lɛ hiɛ.
Shi akɛni minuŋtsɔ le nii tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hewɔ lɛ, ele nibii fɛɛ ni yaa nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ mikpɛ̃lɛ̃; no hewɔ lɛ, yaa koni okɛ Absalom aba.” Ni Yoab ho egbee shi ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David, ni eda lɛ shi ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋmɛnɛ mi, otsulɔ, ena ele akɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ ejaakɛ, maŋtsɛ, ofee nɔ ni mibi lɛ ohã mi.” Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yoab te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Geshur, ni eyaŋɔ Absalom kɛba Yerusalɛm.
Be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David hã wiemɔ akɛ, “Eya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ mli eyahi jɛi.
Mitaooo ehiɛ mana.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Absalom gba kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩa lɛ, ni enaaa maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
David kɛ Absalom kpãtã Nuu ko nuu ko bɛ Israel fɛɛ ni ekɛ Absalom ye egbɔ yɛ hefɛo gbɛfaŋ.
Kɛjɛ enaneshi aahu kɛyashi epampam lɛ, kpa kome nɛkɛ bɛ ehe.
Kɛji eku eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ eyiteŋ tsɔi lɛ shekeli ohai enyɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ nsɛnitɛ naa.
(Ejaakɛ yitsɔi lɛ tsiɔ yɛ enɔ dani ekuɔ; ni daa afi dani ekuɔ) Absalom fɔ bihii etɛ̃ kɛ yoo kome ni atsɛ lɛ Tamar; ni eji yoo ko ni he yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Absalom ye afii enyɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm ni enaaa Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ nɛkɛ.
Enɛ hã Absalom tsu atsɛ Yoab ahã lɛ koni etsu lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi Yoab sumɔɔɔ akɛ eyaa.
Absalom ku sɛɛ etsu atsɛ Yoab nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, shi no hu Yoab eyaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Absalom kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛna Yoab ŋmɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ minɔ lɛ masɛi lɛ, nyɛyaa, ni nyɛyamaa akoko ni yɔɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa la.” Absalom tsuji lɛ tee ni amɛyama ŋmɔ lɛ naa la.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab tee eyanina Absalom yɛ eshĩa lɛ mli, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni otsuji lɛ yama miŋmɔ lɛ naa la lɛ?” Absalom jie naa akɛ, “Akɛni mitsu ni atsɛ bo ahã mi, ni obaaa lɛ hewɔ.
Miitao bo matsu maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ koni oyabi lɛ ohã mi nɔ hewɔ kwraa ni mishi Geshur kɛba lɛ.
Miyɛ jɛi lolo kulɛ, bɛ no moŋ hi hã mi?” Absalom tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Yaatsu he nii ohã mi koni mana maŋtsɛ hiɛ.
Kɛji mitɔ̃ enɔ lɛ koni egbe mi.” Yoab tee eyana maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ebɔ lɛ amaniɛ; ni Maŋtsɛ David tsu ayatsɛ Absalom.
Be ni Absalom shɛ shi lɛ eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David.
Maŋtsɛ David shwɔ Absalom naa ekɛhere lɛ atuu.
Absalom to eyiŋ akɛ ebaatse atua Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Absalom to shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi ehã ehe; ni esaa hii tabilɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ eto koni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Eteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra, ni eyadamɔɔ gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa maŋ agbo lɛ naa lɛ toi.
Ni kɛji ena mɔ ko ni ehiɛ bei sane ko kɛmiiba koni maŋtsɛ lɛ akwɛ ahã lɛ lɛ, Absalom tsɛɔ mɔ lɛ, ni ebiɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ maŋ nɔ ojɛ?” Kɛji mɔ lɛ to he, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɔ Israel akutso mli ni ejɛ lɛ, Absalom kɛɔ mɔ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwa, osane yɛ mli, ni eja hu; shi naa, mɔ ko bɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he ni aaabo bo toi.” Asaŋ Absalom kɛɔ kɛshiɔ nɔ akɛ, “Mina ni kulɛ awo mi kojolɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko hiɛ esane ekɛbahã mi lɛ, makwɛ koni aye mɔ lɛ sane lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa.” Kɛ mɔ ni Absalom kɛwieɔ lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ koni ekoto Absalom lɛ, Absalom kpãa enine mli, ni emɔɔ mɔ lɛ mli, ni eshwɔɔ enaa.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Absalom fee egbe Israelbii fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛsane baa yeli yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ yitso, ni ekɛkpala Israelbii fɛɛ eshwie esɛɛ akɛ lɛ ji amɛgbɔmɔ kpakpa, ni ehã Israel hii fɛɛ kɛ amɛyitso hã lɛ.
Afii ejwɛ baho; kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni oŋmɛ mi gbɛ koni maya Hebron mayaye shi ko ni miwo Yehowa lɛ nɔ maba.
Ejaakɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ Geshur yɛ Siria lɛ, miwo Yehowa shi akɛ kɛji ekɛ mi aaatee Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ lɛ no lɛ maba Hebron mi diɛŋtsɛ mabaja lɛ, ni mashã afɔle mahã lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, “Yaa, okɛ gbɛnyiɛmɔ jurɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, ete shi, ni etee Hebron.
Kɛkɛ ni Absalom tsu bɔfoi nigii kɛtee amɛyanyiɛ Israelbii akutsei lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni amɛwo amɛyiŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛnu ni aakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ pɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Absalom etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ yɛ Hebron.’ ” Absalom kpee hii ohai enyɔ efata ehe kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee kusum ni eyaatsu lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ, tee kɛkɛ amɛtee; amɛleee mli eko kwraa nɔ nyiɛmɔ ni akɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ.
Be mli ni Absalom shãa afɔlei lɛ, etsu ayatsɛ Ahitofel, Gilonyo lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David ŋaawolɔ, yɛ emaŋ Gilo lɛ abahã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ he yiŋ fɔŋ ni etoɔ lɛ mli bawa, ni Absalom sɛɛbii lɛ ayi bafa jogbaŋŋ.
David jo foi yɛ Yerusalɛm Bɔfo ko batswa David adafi ekɛɛ, “Israelbii atsui emɔ Absalom.” Enɛ hã David kɛɛ etsuji fɛɛ ni ekɛyɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjoa foi, kɛjeee nakai lɛ wɔjeŋ Absalom dɛŋ!
Nyɛfea mramra ni wɔtea koni ekabanina wɔ trukaa koni ehã sane fɔŋ baye wɔ, ni ebagbe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.” Maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ baakɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛshwie nɔ, lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ, ja ehemɛi yei nyɔŋma komɛi ni eshi koni amɛkwɛ shĩa lɛ pɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ fã ni amɛshiɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛyawa yɛ tsu ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ klotia lɛ masɛi, ni etsuji ni ji Keretifoi lɛ kɛ Peletifoi lɛ fɛɛ to kɛbatsɔ̃ emasɛi kɛho.
Be ni Gatbii hii ohai ekpaa lɛ ni nyiɛ Maŋtsɛ David sɛɛ kɛjɛ Gat kɛba lɛ hu hoɔ kɛyi ehiɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Itai, Gatbii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔnukpa lɛ, akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni bo hu okɛ wɔ yaa?
Kuu osɛɛ moŋ ni okɛ maŋtsɛ hee lɛ ayahi shi, ejaakɛ gbɔ ni ebabɔ mɔfro ji bo.
Kolɛ gbii enyiɛ nɛ ni obadɔmɔ wɔ, hewɔ ni mahã okɛ wɔ aya ni oyatsomlo, be mli hu ni he pɔtɛɛ po ni miyaa lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mileee lɛ?
Kuu osɛɛ ni okɛ owebii lɛ aya, ni Yehowa aaana bo mɔbɔ; asaŋ eeeye bo anɔkwa hu.” Shi Itai here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mina Yehowa, ni mina minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ nane hu akɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ, gbele mli jio, wala mli jio, mi kɛ bo aaatee.” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Itai akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, ba ni obaho”.
Kɛkɛ ni Itai, Gatnyo lɛ kɛ esɛɛ hii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛhɔi fɛɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ baho.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ wo yara amɛfo be ni David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fã kɛhoɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ yafo Kidron Faa lɛ, ni amɛwo amɛyi amɛma ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Osɔfo Abiatar ba; ni Osɔfo Zadok hu shɛ shi ni Levibii lɛ fɛɛ fata he ni amɛtere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ; ni ato Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ama shi kɛyashi maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ je maŋ lɛ mli ho amɛgbe naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Zadok akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ okɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ aya maŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛji Yehowa miisumɔ lɛ no lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko kɛ̃, eeehã maku misɛɛ koni maba mabana Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ etoohe lɛ mli fɛɛ ekoŋŋ; shi kɛji jeee esuɔmɔ naa ji nakai lɛ miyɛ edɛŋ, bɔ ni eeeto mi kɛkɛ.” David tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Zadok akɛ, “Ole nɔ ko?
Ŋɔɔ obi Ahimaaz kɛ Abiatar bi Yonatan, ofata ohe kɛku sɛɛ kɛya maŋ lɛ mli.
Mibamɛ yɛ faafoohe lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni minine aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ adafitswaa ko nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Zadok kɛ Abiatar wo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm, ni amɛyahi jɛi.
Maŋtsɛ David kwɔ Mu Gɔŋ lɛ ni yaafonu jwere ehiɛ, ni eha eyiteŋ, ni asaŋ enyiɛ enane folo.
Ni esɛɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ hu eha eyiteŋ; ni be ni amɛyaa lɛ amɛmiifo.
Ni mɔ ko bagba Maŋtsɛ David akɛ Ahitofel hu shi maŋjwalɔi lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni ekɛɛ, “Oo, Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, hã ŋaa fɛɛ ŋaa ni Ahitofel baawo lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai aŋaa.” Be ni David shɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ he ni ajaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ lɛ, ekɛ Hushai, enaanyo Arkinyo lɛ, kpe kɛ ehe atade ni egbala, asaŋ kɛ eyiteŋ fɛɛ mlu.
David kɛɛ Hushai akɛ, “Minaŋ ohe sɛɛ ko kɛji okɛ mi tee; shi kɛji moŋ oku osɛɛ otee maŋ lɛ mli, ni oyakɛɛ Absalom akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ, otsulɔ ji mi; nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ otsɛ tsulɔ ji mi;’ shi agbɛnɛ lɛ mitsɔ̃ otsulɔ lɛ, jɛi baatsɔ̃ ni ooonyɛ ofite ŋaa ni Ahitofel aaawo Absalom lɛ.
Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Sane fɛɛ sane ni ooonu kɛaajɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, obɔ amɛ.
Naa, amɛbihii enyɔ, ni ji Zadok bi Ahimaaz kɛ Abiatar bi Yonatan, yɛ jɛi.
Okɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni ooonu lɛ atsu amɛ koni amɛkɛbahã mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, David naanyo Hushai ku esɛɛ, ni etee maŋ lɛ mli; ni ekɛ Absalom Yerusalɛm shɛɛ yafee pɛ.
David kɛ Ziba David efo mli yɛ gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ fioo kɛmiiya kɛkɛ ni Ziba, Mefiboshet tsulɔ lɛ, kɛ lɛ bakpe trukaa ni ehiɛ tejii enyɔ ni tere aboloo akwaabɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi shabii oha, kɛ agbãmi ŋmɔŋ shabii oha, kɛ wain wolotɔ kome.
Maŋtsɛ David bi Ziba akɛ, “Mɛni okɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ yaafee?” Ziba jie naa ni ekɛɛ, “Tejii lɛ, koni akɛhã maŋtsɛ weku lɛ ni amɛtara nɔ; ni aboloo lɛ kɛ tsei ayibii lɛ, akɛyahã oblahii lɛ ni amɛye, ni wain lɛ, kɛji etɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni ahã mɔ lɛ eko ni enu.” Kɛkɛ ni David bi Ziba akɛ, “Ni nɛgbɛ onuŋtsɔ bi Mefiboshet yɔɔ?” Ziba here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Eyɛ Yerusalɛm ejaakɛ esusumɔ ji akɛ Israelbii baakpale enii, Saul, maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã lɛ agbɛnɛ.” David kɛɛ Ziba akɛ, “Naa, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji Mefiboshet nii lɛ, fɛɛ etsɔ̃ onɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Ziba here nɔ akɛ, “Miyɛ odɛ̃ŋ Maŋtsɛ; omɔbɔnalɛ gbɛ kɛkɛ mikwɛɔ.” Be ni Maŋtsɛ David shɛ Bahurim akrowa lɛ, Saul wekunyo ko ni egbɛi ji Shimei ni atsɛɔ etsɛ akɛ Gera lɛ je kpo ekɛ David bakpe, ni be ni ebaa fɛɛ lɛ, belɛ eelomɔ Maŋtsɛ David.
Etswia David kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ tɛi, tsɛbelɛ tabilɔi hii kakabãi ebɔle David he yɛ eninejurɔ kɛ ebɛku fɛɛ.
Shimei lomɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Jee jɛi ni oya!
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ!
Yakagbɔmɔ!
Yehowa miiwo bo Saul wekumɛi alá shi ni oshwie lɛ fɛɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Obashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Saul dɛŋ, ni Yehowa hu eshɔ̃ ekɛhã obinuu Absalom.
Bɛ ona akɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ni oji hewɔ lɛ ohiɛ ekpãtã?” Kɛkɛ ni Abishai, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, kɛɛ David akɛ, “Nii, mɛɛ hewɔ oŋmɛ gbee nɛɛ gbɛ, ni elomɔ bo?
Ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya mayafo eyitso.” Shi David kɛɛ Abishai kɛ enyɛbi Yoab akɛ, “Nyɛhe sane ko mɛ?
Kɛji eelomɔ mi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ koni ebafee nakai lɛ, namɔ yɔɔ hegbɛ ni ebiɔ he sane ko?” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Abishai kɛ lɛ David etsuji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mimusuŋbi miitao mi egbe lɛ, mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ nɔ ni Benyaminnyo nɛɛ feɔ lɛ afee nyɛ naakpɛɛ?
Nyɛŋmɛa ehe ni elomɔa, ejaakɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ koni ebafee.
Eko lɛ Yehowa aaana mi mɔbɔ yɛ mimanehulu nɛɛ hewɔ, ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa moŋ aaato mi loomɔ ni elomɔɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ najiaŋ.” David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ tsa amɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni amɛyaa lɛ belɛ Shimei hu nyiɛ David ŋlɛnɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eelomɔ lɛ, asaŋ eetswia lɛ tɛi, ni eegbɛ mlu eewo ehe hu.
Etɔ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ bliboo be ni amɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Amɛwa, ni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe yɛ jɛi.
Absalom yɛ Yerusalɛm Absalom kɛ Israel hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ esɛɛ lɛ bashɛ Yerusalɛm.
Ahitofel fata amɛhe.
Be ni David naanyo Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ, kɛ Absalom kpe lɛ Hushai ŋa lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nii, hã manye.” Shi Absalom bi Hushai akɛ, “Aso bɔ ni akɛ naanyo nyiɛɔ nɛ?
Mɛɛba ni okɛ onaanyo lɛ eyaaa lɛ?” Hushai jie naa ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ nakai hu ni?
Mɔ ni Yehowa kɛ maŋbii nɛɛ kɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ehala lɛ, lɛ egbɛfaŋ miyɔɔ, ni lɛ mikɛyaa.
Nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, namɔ po esa akɛ misɔmɔɔ yɛ minuŋtsɔ bi sɛɛ?
Bɔ ni misɔmɔ otsɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ masɔmɔ bo hu.” Kɛkɛ ni Absalom kɛɛ Ahitofel akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, wo mi ŋaa.
Mɛni feemɔ wɔyɔɔ?” Ahitofel kɛɛ Absalom akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ otsɛ hemɛi lɛ ni eshi yɛ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkwɛ shĩa lɛ ayawɔ, koni okɛhã Israel muu fɛɛ ana ale akɛ okɛ otsɛ teŋ etse.
No baahã hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ osɛɛ lɛ ahe awa amɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, ashi buu yɛ tsu lɛ yiteŋ ahã Absalom, ni ekɛ etsɛ hemɛi lɛ wɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ ŋaa fɛɛ ŋaa ni Ahitofel aaawo lɛ, aŋɔɔ lɛ tamɔ nii ni atee ayabi Nyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ ni David kɛ Absalom fɛɛ buɔ eŋaawoo lɛ.
Hushai wo Absalom ŋaa gbonyo Ahitofel kɛɛ Absalom akɛ, “Hã mahala hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ koni mi kɛ amɛ atiu David nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ.
Maya mayatua lɛ be ni etɔ lɛ, ni enijiaŋ eje wui lɛ.
Etsui baafã, ni maŋbii fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ aaajo foi ashi lɛ; magbe lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni mikɛ maŋbii ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ aaaku sɛɛ abahã bo tamɔ ayɛmforo ni akɛ lɛ miiya ayahã ewu.
Gbɔmɔ kome kɛkɛ gbele otaoɔ, ni maŋbii fɛɛ atoiŋ aaajɔ amɛ.” Ŋaawoo nɛɛ sa Absalom kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Shi Absalom kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛtsɛa Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ, hu kɛbaa koni wɔbo nɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ hu enaa toi.” Be ni Hushai ba Absalom ŋɔɔ lɛ, Absalom kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋaa ni Ahitofel ewo nɛ, ani wɔye nɔ lo?
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?” Hushai hã Absalom hetoo ni ekɛɛ, “Ŋaa ni Ahitofel wo ŋmɛnɛ lɛ ehiii.
Ole akɛ otsɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ tabilɔi hii kakabãi ji amɛ, ni amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhiɛ edɔ tamɔ oshishibrishi yoofɔyoo ni ayaju ebii yɛ ehe yɛ jwɛiaŋ.
Ole hu akɛ otsɛ lɛ tatsɛ kpanaa ni, ni ekɛ maŋbii lɛ ehiŋ he kome nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ.
Naa, amrɔ nɛɛ eeeyatee ehe yɛ tɛkplo ko mli loo he ko.
Kɛji anu akɛ David etua owebii lɛ, nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu sane lɛ baakɛɛ kɛkɛ ji akɛ, ‘Agbe Absalom webii lɛ bluublu.’ Kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ mɔ po ni eji kãkãlɔ, ni etsui wa tamɔ jata tsui lɛ, etsui baafã, ni ehe baajɔ, ejaakɛ Israel fɛɛ le akɛ otsɛ lɛ nuu kakabãa ji lɛ, ni hii ni fata ehe lɛ hu kãkãlɔi ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, ŋaa ni miwoɔ ji akɛ obua Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa, kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba, amɛyi baafa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oya ta lɛ eko.
Ni wɔbaatiu David kɛya he fɛɛ he ni eyɔɔ, ni be ni eeehɛle shi lɛ wɔɔɔshwie enɔ tamɔ bɔ nyɔɔ lɛ, ni lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ.
Kɛji eeeba lɛ akɛ eeegbala ehe shi kɛaayabote maŋ ko mli lɛ, wɔwebii lɛ fɛɛ baaya ayakɔlɔ taŋkpei, ni wɔkɛbaashãtã maŋ lɛ wɔyawo jɔɔ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni anaŋ fɔbitɛ kome nɛkɛ yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli.” Absalom kɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Hushai, Arkinyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ hi fe Ahitofel nɔ lɛ.” Ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ akaye Ahitofel ŋaawoo kpakpa lɛ nɔ bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa ahã nɔ fɔŋ aba Absalom nɔ.
Atswa David adafi, ni ejo foi Kɛkɛ ni Hushai tee, ni eyabɔ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar nɔ ŋaa ni Ahitofel wo Absalom kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ, kɛ nɔ ŋaa ni lɛ, Hushai lɛ, hu ewo lɛ; ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsua koni aya mramra ni ayakɛɛ David akɛ ekawɔ faafoohei lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ, shi moŋ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efo faa lɛ kɛya sɛɛ koni nine akabashɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ ni agbe amɛ.” Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Osɔfo Abiatar bi Yonatan kɛ Osɔfo Zadok bi Ahimaaz etee amɛhe yɛ Rogel nubu lɛ he, yɛ Yerusalɛm klotia, ni kɛfee lɛ atsuɔ oblayoo ko kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ wiemɔ yahãa amɛ, ni amɛkɛyahãa Maŋtsɛ David.
Bɔ ni afee ni akana amɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz eyaaa maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ oblanyo ko na amɛ gbi ko, ni etee eyakɛɛ Absalom.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛsha amɛhe oyaoya kɛyabote nuu ko shĩa yɛ Bahurim.
Nuu lɛ yɛ nubu ko yɛ ekpo lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyabote mli.
Nuu lɛ ŋa kɔ mama, ni ekɛha bu lɛ naa, kɛkɛ ni egbɛ ŋmaa mli eka mama lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɔɔɔ sɛɛ.
Be ni Absalom tsuji lɛ bashɛ yoo lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ shĩa lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz yɔɔ.” Yoo lɛ jie naa ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Amɛfo faa nine lɛ kɛtee.” Hii lɛ tiu amɛ, ni amɛyatao amɛ, shi be ni amɛnaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛbaho Yerusalɛm.
Be ni Absalom tsuji lɛ ebaho amɛtee sɛɛ lɛ, Yonatan kɛ Ahimaaz je kpo yɛ nubu lɛ mli, ni amɛyi mli amɛtee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ amɛyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ, “Ŋaa ni Ahitofel ewo yɛ ohe nɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ohe afee oya ni ofo faa lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ te shi, ni amɛyafo Yordan Faa lɛ; ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛreɔ lɛ eshwɛko amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ ni efoko Yordan.
Be ni Ahitofel na akɛ ayeee ŋaa ni ewo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo eteji nɔ nii, kɛkɛ ni eshi kɛtee emaŋ; ni be ni eto enibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ lɛ, eyawo esɛ̃ kpãa, ni egbe ehe.
Afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ gbonyo fuuhe lɛ mli.
David eshɛ Mahanaim momo dani Absalom kɛ Israelbii fɛɛ fo Yordan lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Absalom efee Amasa etatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ.
Amasa nɛɛ Ishmaelnyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yeter lɛ kɛ Yoabnyo Zeruia nyɛmi yoo Nahash biyoo Abigail fɔ lɛ.
Absalom kɛ ewebii lɛ yato shi yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni David yashɛ Mahanaim lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ: Shobi, ni ji Nahash ni jɛ Amonbii amaŋ Raba lɛ mli lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Makir, ni ji Amiel ni jɛ Lo-Debar lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ agbɛnɛ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ ni jɛ Rogelim lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Amɛhiɛ sai kɛ kã kɛ kukwɛii kɛ ŋmãa kɛ akoko kɛ ŋmãa ni awiɛ kɛ ma kɛ abele kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ ni ashĩ, kɛ wo kɛ butru kɛ too kɛ tsina keesui, ni amɛkɛbahã David kɛ ewebii ni fata ehe lɛ koni amɛye, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ etɔ amɛ, ni hɔmɔ kɛ kumai hu fɛɛ eye amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Aye Absalom nɔ kunim, ni agbe lɛ Maŋtsɛ David kane tabilɔi ni fata ehe lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ejara amɛmli mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi oha akui, ni eto ku fɛɛ ku nɔ tatsɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, eja eta tso muu lɛ fɛɛ mli etɛ̃.
Ekɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ nɛɛ mli ekome wo Yoab shishi, ni ekɛ ekome hu wo Abishai, Zeruia bi Yoab nyɛmi lɛ shishi, ni ekɛ ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ wo Itai, Gatnyo lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ hu mikɛ nyɛ miiya.” Shi tabilɔi lɛ here David nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Dabida!
Okɛ wɔ akaya ta lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji wɔjo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ amɛgbaŋ amɛhe naa yɛ wɔhe; ni kɛji agbe wɔyibɔ nɛɛ fã tete lɛ, amɛtsɛŋ lɛ nɔ ko.
Shi bo lɛ ojara wa tamɔ wɔyi akpei nyɔŋma.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehi moŋ akɛ ohi shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ojɛ biɛ oye obua wɔ.” Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no mafee.” Kɛkɛ ni David yadamɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi, ni etabilɔi lɛ to kɛbaho yɛ mɛi akpe akui kɛ mɛi oha akui anaa.
Maŋtsɛ David wo Yoab kɛ Abishai kɛ Itai kitã ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa mihewɔ, koni nyɛkɛ oblanyo Absalom lɛ ayea blɛoo.” Tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ nu kitã ni Maŋtsɛ David wo tatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Absalom he lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David webii lɛ fã kɛba ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ Israelbii lɛ bakpe.
Awu ta lɛ yɛ Efraim koo lɛ mli.
David webii lɛ ye Israelbii lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi, ni nakai gbi lɛ aplene Israelbii lɛ fe nine, mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɔŋŋ nyɔ yɛ jɛi.
Ta lɛ gbɛ shwã jɛi kpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ, ni koo lɛ kpãtã gbɔmɛi ahiɛ kwraa fe klante tete.
Absalom kɛ David tabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi yakpe trukaa.
Absalom ta tejiokpɔŋɔ nɔ; ni etee eyatsɔ̃ blɔfo yɔɔyi tso wulu ko shishi, kɛkɛ ni eyitso yaka tso lɛ niji ni ebu kusuu lɛ amli, kɛkɛ ni tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ sha kɛje Absalom shishi etee, ni eshi Absalom ni etsotsoro ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ.
David webii lɛ eko na Absalom, ni etee eyakɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Miyana Absalom tsotsoro shi yɛ blɔfo yɔɔyi tso ko nɔ.” Yoab kɛɛ mɔ ni bagba lɛ sane lɛ akɛ, “Ona lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ?
Ni mɛɛba ogbeee lɛ yɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ.
Kulɛ make bo jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma kɛ mlifiinɔ ko hu.” Shi nuu lɛ to he akɛ, “Kpaoo!
Kɛji akane jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe tete po awo midɛŋ lɛ, miwoŋ minine nɔ mitswaŋ maŋtsɛbi lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔtoiŋ ni Maŋtsɛ David wo bo kɛ Abishai kɛ Itai fɛɛ akpɔ akɛ, ‘Mi mihewɔ lɛ nyɛkwɛa koni mɔ ko nine akata oblanyo, Absalom, lɛ he.’ Kɛji migbo maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ toi, ni migbe Absalom lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ baana ele kɛ̃, ejaakɛ sane ko kwraa bɛ ni enaaa ele; ni ofaŋ mihe.” Yoab to he akɛ, “Miifite be po!” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɔlɔ akplɔi etɛ̃, ni etee ekɛyatsulɔ Absalom tsuiŋ be mli ni ehiɛ kã lolo yɛ yɔɔyi tso lɛ nɔ.
Oblahii nyɔŋma ni hiɛɔ Yoab tawuu nibii lɛ babɔle Absalom kɛkpe, ni amɛtswia lɛ nii, ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab hã akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni akpa ta lɛ wuu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etabilɔi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ asɛɛnyiɛmɔ.
Ajie Absalom gbonyo lɛ, ni ashɛ afɔ̃ bu agbo ko mli yɛ koo lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛto tɛ amɛshwie enɔ aahu ni etsɔ̃ ku kpeteŋkple.
Israelbii lɛ jo foi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.
Be ni Absalom yɔɔ wala mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ema shiu ko yɛ Maŋtsɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli akɛ akɛkai lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛɛ ebɛ binuu ni baafɔ ewo lɛ koni egbɛi akagbo.
Absalom kɛ egbɛi wo shiu nɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ atsɛɔ shiu lɛ akɛ Absalom Kaimɔ shiu.
Abakɛɛ David Absalom gbele Kɛkɛ ni Ahimaaz, Zadok bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Hã ni masha foi maya mayabɔ maŋtsɛ amaniɛ akɛ Yehowa ehere eyiwala yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.” Yoab here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida, jeee bo obaaya ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ oyabɔ amaniɛ.
Gbi kroko jiŋŋ, oooya oyabɔ amaniɛ; ŋmɛnɛ lɛ oyabɔŋ amaniɛ ejaakɛ maŋtsɛbi ni enyɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛɛ enyɔŋ, Kushnyo lɛ, akɛ, “Yaa ni oyagba maŋtsɛ nɔ ni ona.” Kushnyo lɛ koto Yoab kɛkɛ ni ewo foi kɛtee.
Shi Ahimaaz, Zadok bi lɛ, fi nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Hã ni mi hu maya ni mayabɔ amaniɛ; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaaba lɛ eba!” Yoab here Ahimaaz nɔ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ osumɔɔ doo akɛ bo hu obaaya oyabɔ amaniɛ lɛ?
Naa, aekoo ko bɛ ni abaahã bo yɛ he!” Ahimaaz to he akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baaba lɛ, eba!
Miisumɔ akɛ mi hu maya.” Yoab to he akɛ, “Yaa mɔ!” No hewɔ lɛ, Ahimaaz wo foi kɛyi Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni eyaho Kushnyo lɛ he.
Shi Maŋtsɛ David ta shi yɛ maŋ agboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koi lɛ shi; ni mɔ ni buɔ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee maŋ gbogbo lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ yiteŋ.
Eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, naa nuu ko hiɛ foi ekome too kɛmiiba.
Bulɔ lɛ bo etsɛ, ni ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ bulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji ekome too ni lɛ, belɛ no lɛ atsu lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ sane.” Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ baa aahu kɛyashi ebɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ.
Shi bulɔ lɛ na nuu kroko ko hu ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiba.
Kɛkɛ ni ebo etsɛ agbonaa bulɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, nuu kroko ko hu hiɛ foi ekome too kɛmiiba.” Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ akɛ, “Lɛ hu ehiɛ miishɛɛ sane kɛmiiba.” Bulɔ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni nyiɛ hiɛ lɛ foijee tamɔ Osɔfo Zadok bi Ahimaaz foijee pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Maŋtsɛ David to he, ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ni; ni ehiɛ sane kpakpa kɛmiiba.” Ahimaaz bo ni ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Wɔye omanye eei!” Kɛkɛ ni eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ada Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shi akɛ ehã oye mɛi ni te shi amɛwo bo, maŋtsɛ, lɛ anɔ kunim.” Maŋtsɛ David bi akɛ, “Ani oblanyo Absalom lɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?” Ahimaaz jie naa akɛ, “Ofainɛ, be ni Yoab tsu mi otsulɔ lɛ, mi lɛ mina ni aafee gidigidi ko; shi moŋ minaaa male nɔ ni eba.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, bo lɛ tsi ohe oyadamɔ afã dã.” No hewɔ lɛ, etsi ehe ni eyadamɔ afã.
Ni naa, Kushnyo lɛ ni atsu lɛ hu ba.
Ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, mihiɛ miishɛɛ sane kɛba; ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ Yehowa ehã oye mɛi ni te shi amɛwo bo lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim.” Maŋtsɛ David bi Kushnyo lɛ akɛ, “Ani oblanyo Absalom lɛ yɛ jogbaŋŋ lo?” Kushnyo lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mina ni nɔ ni eba enɔ lɛ kulɛ nakai nɔ ko aba ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni te shi amɛwo bo lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” Amaniɛ lɛ hã Maŋtsɛ David jijaa.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ kɛtee pia ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ yiteŋ lɛ mli, ni eyafo.
Be ni eyaa lɛ, efo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Mibi oo!
Mibi Absalom!
Mibi Absalom eei!
Mina ni kulɛ, mibi, mi moŋ migbo yɛ onajiaŋ nɛɛ.
Absalom mibi oo, mibi.”
Yoab kã David hiɛ Ayagba Yoab akɛ Maŋtsɛ David ewo yara eefo yɛ Absalom hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kunimyeli nyamɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli moŋ ehã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nakai gbi lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ ebinuu lɛ hewɔ.
Enɛ hã maŋbii lɛ ju shi kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli liɔɔliɔɔ tamɔ tabilɔi ni aye amɛnɔ ni amɛjo foi yɛ ta naa kɛba shĩa.
Maŋtsɛ David ha ehiɛ, kɛkɛ ni ebo waa, “Ao!
Mibi Absalom eei!
Ao!
Mibi, mibi Absalom!” Yoab ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, owo otabilɔi fɛɛ ni here bo kɛ obihii lɛ kɛ obiyei lɛ kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ohemɛi lɛ ayiwala lɛ hiɛgbele pam ŋmɛnɛ; ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ moŋ, ni onyɛɔ osuɔlɔi lɛ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ akɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi lɛ awala jeee fɛifɛi yɛ ohiɛ.
Bɔ ni minaa sane lɛ ji akɛ Absalom yɛ wala mli, ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔgboi ŋmɛnɛ kulɛ eŋɔɔ onaa!
Wo ohe nɔ, agbɛnɛ, ni oje kpo, ni oyashɛje otabilɔi lɛ amii.
Ejaakɛ kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mina Yehowa akɛ, wɔ be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eshi bo.
Ni kɛ eba lɛ nakai lɛ, amanehulu ni ekɛbaaba onɔ lɛ, onako ehenɔ pɛŋ kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.” Maŋtsɛ David wo ehe nɔ, ni etee eyata maŋ agboi lɛ ateŋ koi lɛ shi.
Be ni etabilɔi lɛ nu akɛ ebata koi lɛ shi lɛ, amɛtee amɛyabua ehe.
David ku esɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ ejojoo foi kɛtee amɛshĩai, ni amɛmli efu amɛkutseiaŋ onukpai lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ David lɛ, lɛ ejie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehere wɔ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ; shi moŋ agbɛnɛ ejo Absalom naa foi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Absalom lɛ hu ni wɔwo lɛ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, lɛ eyagbo yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ.
Mɛɛba Maŋtsɛ lɛ kplamɔ kɛbaa lɛ nyɛwieee he lɛ?” Be ni David na enu nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ wieɔ lɛ, etsu ayakɛɛ Osɔfoi Zadok kɛ Abiatar akɛ amɛyakɛɛ Yuda maŋ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni nyɛ moŋ nyɛkpe sɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kplamɔ mli kɛ ewe lɛ mli baa nɛɛ?
Israelbii fɛɛ adaaŋ gbee ebashɛ midɛŋ.
Mɛɛba ni nyɛ ni ji minyɛmimɛi ni mi kɛ nyɛ laŋmɔ kpãa kome lɛ, nyɛ moŋ nyɛkpe sɛɛ yɛ mikpalamɔ kɛbaa mli nɛɛ?” Asaŋ David shɛ amɛ koni amɛyakɛɛ Amasa akɛ, “Miwekunyo ji bo, kɛji mitooo bo mitatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi nyɔmɔ.” Maŋtsɛ David wiemɔ hã Yudabii fɛɛ atsui mɔ lɛ; hewɔ lɛ amɛtsu ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David ku esɛɛ eba Yordan lɛ naa, ni Yuda hii lɛ ba Gilgal koni amɛbakpee lɛ ni akɛ lɛ afo faa lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Benyaminnyo, Gera, ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ binuu Shimei, ye ehe oyai, ni ekɛ Yuda hii lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Yordan naa koni ekɛ Maŋtsɛ David abakpe.
Benyaminhii akpe fata ehe.
Ziba, Saul we lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, kɛ ebihii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ etsuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ hu ba.
Ni amɛbashɛ Yordan lɛ naa be mli ni Maŋtsɛ David shɛko shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛfo faa lɛ kɛtee faa lɛ sɛɛ koni amɛ jie maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ faa, koni amɛkɛsa Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ.
David kɛ Shimei he ke lɛ Maŋtsɛ David efee kralo kɛbaabote faafoo lɛlɛ lɛ mli pɛ, kɛkɛ ni Shimei, Gera binuu lɛ, ho ekula enaji anaa, ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, ni ohiɛ akpa efɔŋ ni mifee bo gbi ni oshiɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ nɔ.
Kɛ onane ashushua nɔ kwraa koni okakai dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ, ofainɛ, mile faŋŋ akɛ mifee esha; ni no hewɔ ni naa, mi ji mɔ tsuutsu ni jɛ kooyi akutsei lɛ amli miba bo kpeemɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.” Shi Zeruia bi Abishai here Shimei wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Loomɔ ni Shimei lomɔ mɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, esa gbele.” Shi David to he ni ekɛɛ Zeruia bi Abishai kɛ enyɛmi Yoab akɛ, “Nyɛhe sane ko mɛ?
Nyɛkawoa minajiaŋ.
Ani ŋmɛnɛ ni mitsɔ̃ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ani abaagbe Israelnyo lo?” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Shimei akɛ, “Agbeŋ bo!” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kã Shimei kitã.
David na Mefiboshet mɔbɔ Mefiboshet, Saul nabi lɛ hu ba ebakpee maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ shi Yerusalɛm lɛ, Mefiboshet fɔko enaji ahe dã lɛ, eshɛko etsɛŋ lɛ, etadei hu efɔko he dã, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ etee kɛbashi gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ eba shweshweeshwe lɛ.
Be ni Mefiboshet bashɛ shi kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm koni ebakpee maŋtsɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, “Mefiboshet, mɛɛba ni ofataaa mihe kɛyaaa lɛ?” Mefiboshet jie naa akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ole akɛ akpaketsɛ ji mi.
Mikɛɛ mitsulɔ lɛ akɛ ewo teji nɔ nii ehã mi koni mata nɔ ni mikɛ bo aya, shi elaka mi kɛ̃, ni ebafo minaa moŋ efite mi ehã maŋtsɛ.
Shi maŋtsɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, no hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ odɛ̃ŋ, bɔ ni ooofee mi.
Kulɛ esa akɛ ogbeɔ mitsɛ we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ, shi ohã mibafata mɛi ni yeɔ nii yɛ okplɔ̃ he lɛ ahe.
Mɛɛ ejurɔ mitaoɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ dɛŋ dɔŋŋ?” Shi Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, “Kaawie dɔŋŋ!
Nɔ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ Ziba kɛ bo baaja Saul gboshinii lɛ.” Mefiboshet here nɔ akɛ, “Ebaanyɛ fɛɛ tete eŋɔ.
Akɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ ebashɛ ewe lɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ, no kɛkɛ fa hã mi.” David na Barzilai mɔbɔ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ, jɛ Rogelim eba koni ebakwɛ Maŋtsɛ David yisɛɛ.
Ejie Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa koni ewa lɛ ni efo faa lɛ.
Barzilai egbɔ naakpa, eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.
Niiatsɛ kpanaa ji lɛ, ni be mli ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ Mahanaim lɛ, ebahãa lɛ niyenii.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔtee Yerusalɛm koni mayakwɛ bo yɛ miwe lɛ.” Shi Barzilai to he ehã Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, gbii enyiɛ po eshwɛ mi, hewɔ ni mikɛ bo aaatee Yerusalɛm.
Afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ miye nɛɛ, ni amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ ko efeee mi akɔnɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nii diɛŋtsɛ po ni miyeɔ jio aloo nii ni minuɔ jio, minuuu ŋɔɔmɔ ko he dɔŋŋ; ni kɛji nuu loo yoo miila po, minuuu kwraa.
Jatsu moŋ miyatsɔ̃ mahã minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ.
Miyiŋtoo kɛkɛ ji akɛ miiba mibakwɛ minuŋtsɔ yisɛɛ koni efo Yordan lɛ koni mi kɛ lɛ aya hiɛ fioo kɛkɛ.
Mɛɛba ni maŋtsɛ aaato mi najiaŋ?
Ofainɛ, hã maku misɛɛ maya koni miyagbo yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ, ni afu mi yɛ mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ mlishi.
Naa, mibinuu Kimham moŋ.
Maŋtsɛ aŋɔ lɛ kɛya ni eyasɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ koni Nii afee lɛ ejurɔ bɔ ni Nii sumɔɔ.” Maŋtsɛ David here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mi kɛ Kimham baaya, ni mafee lɛ ejurɔ ni baasa ohiɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi mi lɛ mafee mahã bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David shwɔ Barzilai naa, ni ejɔɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ, kɛkɛ ni Barzilai hu ku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋ.
Yudabii kɛ Israelbii taa naa Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israelbii fã ni yakpa lɛ gbɛ lɛ yiŋ kɛtee Gilgal.
Kimham fata ehe kɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, mɛɛba wɔnyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ kɛkɛ ni ba amɛbakpee bo, ni amɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛfo maŋtsɛ kɛ ebii kɛ hɔi kɛ esɛɛbii lɛ fɛɛ faa lɛ?” Yudahii lɛ here Israelbii lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ wɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ jɛ weku kome.
Mɛɛba ni enɛ feɔ nyɛ mlifu?
Mɛni nyɛle ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ehã wɔ wɔye, aloo ni eke wɔ?” Israelbii lɛ to he amɛhã Yudabii lɛ akɛ, “Gbɛnaa nii ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David gbɛfaŋ lɛ, wɔyɛ nakai toi nyɔŋma yɛ egbɛfaŋ.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛbuuu wɔ.
Kwɛ jeee wɔ tsuutsu moŋ wɔwo ŋaa akɛ ayaŋɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛba lɛ?” Shi Yudabii lɛ anaa yawa fe Israelbii lɛ yɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
Sheba hã atse atua Nuu yakagbɔmɔ ko baje Gilgal.
Atsɛɔ lɛ Sheba, ni etsɛ gbɛi ji Bikri, Benyaminnyo lɛ.
Sheba kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ebo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Israel eei!
Wɔbɛ gbɛnaa ko yɛ David gbɛfaŋ.
Wɔ kɛ Ishai bi lɛ ejaaa nɔ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ewe.” Kɛkɛ ni Israelhii lɛ kpa yɛ David sɛɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Bikri bi Sheba sɛɛ.
Shi Yudahii lɛ kpɛtɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ Yordan naa aahu kɛyashɛ Yerusalɛm.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ David bashɛ ewe lɛ mli yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ehã akɛ yei nyɔŋma ni ji ehemɛi lɛ ni eshi, akɛ amɛkwɛ shĩa lɛ, yato he ko banee, ni atsi amɛna awo shĩa ko mli.
Elɛ amɛ, shi eyaaa amɛmasɛi, ni ehã amɛhi shi tamɔ okulafoi kɛyashi amɛgbele be.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Amasa akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakpee Yudahii fɛɛ obahã mi yɛ biɛ gbii etɛ̃ mli; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu oba biɛ eko.” Amasa yiŋ etee koni eyakpee Yudahii lɛ ebahã maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi eyatsɛ fe be ni ato lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, “Etamɔ nɔ ni Bikri bi Sheba baagba wɔnaa fe Absalom tete.
Ŋɔɔ mitabilɔi lɛ, ni nyɛtiua lɛ koni ekayana maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli eyabote ni etsɔ̃ jɛi eje wɔdɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Abishai kɛ Yoab kɛ tabilɔi lɛ ni ji Keretifoi lɛ kɛ Peletifoi lɛ ni buɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ, kɛ hii kakabãi lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm koni amɛyatiu Sheba, Bikri bi lɛ.
Be ni amɛyaa ni amɛyashɛ tɛkplo ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ he lɛ, Amasa kɛ amɛ bakpe.
No mli lɛ Yoab emia kɛ tawuu atade.
Afi atade ni ewo lɛ mli, ni klante fi nɔ yɛ ehɛ.
Klante lɛ je ehebo lɛ mli egbee shi, be ni Yoab tsiɔ ebɛŋkɛɔ Amasa lɛ.
Yoab ŋa Amasa akɛ, “Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ, anyɛmi nuu?” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ eninejurɔ mɔ Amasa tsɛŋ mli koni eshwɔ enaa.
Amasa enaaa akɛ Yoab hiɛ klante yɛ edɛŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yoab kɛ klante lɛ du Amasa musuŋ ni Amasa musuŋnii tue shwie shi.
Eduuu lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ enyɛmi Abishai tsa amɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛtiu Sheba, Bikri bi lɛ.
Oblahii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Yoab shishi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko ho yadamɔ Amasa gbonyo lɛ masɛi, ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ Yoab kɛ David sɛɛ lɛ, eyi Yoab sɛɛ.” Belɛ Amasa gbonyo lɛ kã shi ni lá ewu ehe kpɔtɔɔ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ ni ehiɛ gbaa enɔ lɛ, ewaa edamɔɔ shi.
Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bashɛɔ gbonyo lɛ he yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ waa damɔɔ shi lɛ, ewo Amasa kɛjɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ mama ha enɔ.
Be ni ajie gbonyo lɛ kɛje gbejegbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ loo mli kɛnyiɛ Yoab sɛɛ kɛtiu Sheba, Bikri bi lɛ.
Sheba tsɔ̃ Israel akutsei lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛho, ni be ni eyashɛ Abel Bet-Maaka lɛ, Bikribii lɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ kɛbabote maŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab shishi tabilɔi lɛ basa Sheba yi amɛwo Abel Bet-Maaka maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛkɛ su tswa kpoku ni ekwɔlɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ kwɔlɛ ye hegbɔ.
Asaŋ amɛshimɔshimɔɔ gbogbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu koni amɛwule lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Shi yoo nilelɔ ko bo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛboa toi!
Nyɛboa toi!
Nyɛtsɛa Yoab nyɛhãa mi koni mi kɛ lɛ awiea.” Yoab tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Bo ji Yoab lɛ?” Yoab here nɔ akɛ, “Mi ni.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni obo mi toi.” Yoab kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miibo bo toi.” Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Sa lɛ kɛji anaaa sane ko naa lɛ bɔ ni akɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Aya Abel ni ayabi?’ Ejaakɛ Israel maji ni sumɔɔ hejɔlɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli lɛ ateŋ eko ji Abel.
Oba ootao okpãtã maŋ ni ji biianyɛ hã Israel lɛ hiɛ.
Mɛɛba ni obaakpãtã Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ nii ahiɛ nɛɛ?” Yoab here yoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Kpaoo!
Enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ makpãtã nyɛmaŋ lɛ hiɛ?
Jeee nakai nyiɛmɔ kwraa wɔnyiɛ.
Sane lɛ moŋ ji akɛ nuu ko ni jɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sheba, Bikri binuu lɛ, ete shi ewo Maŋtsɛ David.
Nyɛjiea lɛ nyɛhãa wɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ wɔbaashi nyɛmaŋ lɛ ni wɔya.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Kɛfee lɛ abaafɔ̃ eyitso kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ ahã bo.” Yoo lɛ tee ekɛ sane lɛ yafɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni ehã amɛfo Sheba yitso, ni afɔ̃ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ ahã Yoab.
Enɛ hã Yoab kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni etabilɔi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ tuamɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshĩa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ eba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
David tsuji lɛ Agbɛnɛ Yoab ji Israel fɛɛ tatsɛnukpa, ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji Keretifoi kɛ Peletifoi ni ji maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ atsɛ.
Adoniram ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ, ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, buɔ nibii ahe akɔntaa.
Sheva ji woloŋmalɔ, ni Zadok kɛ Abiatar ji osɔfoi, ni David osɔfo kroko hu ji Ira, Yairnyo lɛ.
Agbe Saul shwiei David yinɔ lɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa ko ba afii nɔtonɔto shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hã David tee ni eyabi Yehowa nii.
Yehowa kɛɛ David akɛ, “Enɛ fɛɛ jɛ Saul kɛ ewe lɛ yɛ Gibeonbii lɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ hewɔ.” Gibeonbii nɛɛ, jeee Israelbii ni, shi moŋ Amorbii ni shwɛ ji amɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ekã amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkpãtãŋ amɛhiɛ, shi be ni Saul hiɛ dɔ yɛ Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, kulɛ eetao ekpãtã amɛhiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, David tsɛ Gibeonbii lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee mihã nyɛ, ni mɛni mikɛkpãtã nyɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛjɔɔ Yehowa webii lɛ?” Gibeonbii lɛ hã hetoo ni amɛkɛɛ, “Sane ni kã wɔ kɛ Saul kɛ ewe lɛ teŋ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛ jwiɛtɛi loo shika akpãtã, ni asaŋ jeee akɛ wɔmiitao Israelnyo ko lá shi wɔshwie.” David bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mɔ nyɛtaoɔ ni mafee mahã nyɛ?” Gibeonbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Saul tao akɛ ekpãtã wɔhiɛ kɛbule wɔshishi kwraa yɛ Israel, No hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ eshwiei amli hii kpawo ohã wɔ koni wɔyasɛŋ amɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Gibea, yɛ Saul, mɔ ni Yehowa wo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli.” Maŋtsɛ David to he ni ekɛɛ, “Mibahã nyɛ mɛi lɛ.” Kitã ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Saul bi Yonatan kãmɔ amɛhe lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David shi Yonatan bi Mefiboshet, ni ji Saul nabi lɛ, sɛɛ, ni eŋɔ mɛi nɛɛ: Armoni kɛ Mefiboshet ni ji bihii enyɔ ni Aia biyoo Rizpa kɛ Saul fɔ lɛ, kɛ bihii enumɔ hu ni Saul biyoo Merah kɛ Adriel, Meholatnyo Barzilai bi lɛ, fɔ lɛ.
David kɛ amɛ wo Gibeonbii lɛ adɛŋ, ni Gibeonbii lɛ sɛŋ amɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi shi kome.
Ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ shishijee be mli asɛŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; no mli lɛ abɔi akoko foo.
Kɛkɛ ni Aia biyoo, Rizpa, Saul hemɔ lɛ, kɔ kpekpe ni eshi lɛ buu eha enɔ yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ he ni gbohii lɛ jwere lɛ, kɛjɛ nikpamɔ shishijee be lɛ mli kɛyashi be ni nu bɔi nɛmɔ kɛ amɛnɔshwiemɔ.
Shwane lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni loofɔji abasɔmɔ gbohii lɛ anɔ, ni nyɔɔŋ hu eshwieɔ ŋaŋ kooloi yɛ amɛhe.
Be ni David nu nɔ ni Rizpa efee lɛ, etee ni eyaŋɔ Saul wui lɛ kɛ Yonatan hu wui lɛ yɛ Yabesh Gileadbii lɛ adɛŋ kɛba.
Ejaakɛ gbi ni Filistibii lɛ gbe Saul yɛ Gilboa lɛ, amɛkɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan gbohii lɛ ba, ni amɛkɛbatsotsro shi yɛ Bet-Shan blohu lɛ mli; ni Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ baju gbohii lɛ kɛtee.
David yaŋɔ Saul kɛ ebi Yonatan wui lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba, ni ekɛbafata Saul shwiei amli hii kpawo lɛ ni asɛŋ lɛ awui lɛ ahe.
Akɛ Saul kɛ Yonatan wui lɛ tee, ni ayafu yɛ Saul tsɛ Kish fuuhe lɛ, yɛ Zela yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Afee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ efã lɛ.
No sɛɛ dani Nyɔŋmɔ bo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ afai ni amɛkpa amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ toi.
Tai ni akɛ Filistibii oblaŋi gojogojoo wu lɛ Ta te shi yɛ Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ ekoŋŋ, ni David kɛ etabilɔi fã, ni amɛtee amɛkɛ Filistibii yawu.
Nɔmɔ lɛ dɛŋ David, ni be ni akɛshɛ he ko lɛ David tɔ biti.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu oblaŋ gojoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ishbi-Benob lɛ fã kɛba kɛ yiŋtoo akɛ ebaagbe David.
Edɛŋ akplɔ tsiimɔ ji akɔɔble shekeli ohai etɛ̃, ni klante hee ŋmɔ ehɛ.
Shi Abishai, ni ji Zeruia bi lɛ, bahere David.
Ebatswa Filistinyo lɛ nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Jɛi ni David tabilɔi lɛ hã David kã amɛ kitã akɛ efataŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ ta dɔŋŋ.
Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ wɔ akaya ta dɔŋŋ koni okabahã Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ miitã.” Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu ta ekoŋŋ yɛ Gob.
Ta nɛɛ mli ni Sibekai, Hushanyo lɛ, gbe hii oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ashwiei lɛ ateŋ eko ni gbɛi ji Saf lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ku sɛɛ amɛwu ta yɛ Gob ekoŋŋ.
No mli Elhanan, ni ji Betlehemnyo Yaare-Oregim bi lɛ, gbe Goliat, Gatnyo lɛ ni ekpɔlɔ mlitso ti tamɔ mamalolɔ agba tso tilɛ lɛ.
Awu ta ko hu yɛ Gat, ni nuu ko kɛ enine kɛ enane waobii ekpaaekpaa ba ta lɛ eko.
Nuu nɛɛ tswa Israelbii lɛ mpoa, kɛkɛ ni Yonatan, ni ji David nyɛmi Shimei bi lɛ, tswa lɛ nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo ni hi shi yɛ Gat lɛ ashwiei ji oblaŋi ejwɛ nɛɛ ni David kɛ tabilɔi lɛ gbe lɛ.
David kunimyeli lala lɛ Be ni Yehowa jie David yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Saul hu dɛŋ lɛ, David la lala nɛɛ: Yehowa ji mitɛsaa, kɛ mimɔɔ kɛ miherelɔ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mitɛsaa, mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ.
Ebuɔ mihe tamɔ tsɛŋ, ni efãa mihe, ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe.
Lɛ ji miyiwalaherelɔ ni buɔ mihe, ni hereɔ mi kɛjɛɔ nɔnaa mli.
Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ, ni ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Ajie Yehowa yi!
Gbele ŋshɔkei bɔle mi kɛkpe, ni fai fɔ̃ji wo mihe gbeyei.
Gbohiiaje kpãi bɔle mi kɛkpe, ni gbele tsɔ̃ mi tsɔne.
Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mibo mitsɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ejɛ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni enu migbee; mibolɔmɔ lɛ yashɛ etoiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso; ni ekpokpo, ŋwɛi shishitoi lɛ hu hoso, ni amɛkpokpo ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.
Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli, ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ; ŋai ni miitsɛ̃ hu jɛ edaaŋ.
Egba ŋwɛi mli, ni ekpeleke shi, Yehowa hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi, ni eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni duŋ kpii yɛ enaneshi.
Eta Kerub nɔ, ni efiliki; ana lɛ ni eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ.
Ekɛ duŋ kpii ha ehe, ni atatui kpiikpii ni eyi kɛ nu bɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Ŋai ni miitso kpɛlɛ la kɛjɛ ehiɛ ni kpɛɔ hɛŋŋ lɛ mli.
Yehowa gbee shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi; Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ wo egbeeŋ.
Etsɛ̃rɛ egãii lɛ ekɛgbɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ eshwã; ni ekɛ srawa hu wo amɛ foi.
Kɛkɛ ni ana ŋshɔ shishi kã shi, ni agbele je lɛ shishitoo atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ, be ni Yehowa kã ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ mlifu bolɔ ewo amɛ lɛ.
Yehowa jɛ ŋwɛi ekpã enine mli emɔ mimli, ni esha mi kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa lɛ adɛŋ; kɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ hu adɛŋ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa tsɔ̃ fe mi.
Amɛbatua mi yɛ amanehulu be mli, shi Yehowa bu mihe.
Ejie mi yɛ osharã mli, ni ehere mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ.
Yehowa duro mi, ejaakɛ mifee nii ni ja; ni ejɔɔ mi, ejaakɛ mifeko efɔŋ ko.
Miye Yehowa mlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mishiko miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mitɔ̃ko ekpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ele akɛ fɔbuu ko bɛ mihe, ni ele akɛ miwi mihe kɛje nɔ fɔŋ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa fee mi ejurɔ yɛ mijalɛ naa, yɛ fɔbuu ko ni bɛ mihe lɛ naa.
Mɛi ni yeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ bo hu oyeɔ amɛ anɔkwa; ni mɔ ni fɔbuu ko bɛ ehe lɛ naa bo akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu.
Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, okɛ ohe tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni he tse; shi mɔ ni yi wa lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.
Ohereɔ humii ayiwala, shi henɔwolɔi lɛ obaa amɛ shi.
Yehowa, lɛɛlɛŋ bo ji kane, ni miNyɔŋmɔ hãa minaa nii yɛ duŋ mli.
Anɔkwa, bo ohewalɛ mikɛyeɔ henyɛlɔi anɔ, ni miNyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ mikɛhuruɔ henyɛlɔ gbogbo.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, shwamɔ ko bɛ enifeemɔ he; ni ewooo shi ni efee yaka.
Etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ tsɛŋ ehãa mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Yehowa pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji wɔhefãlɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mibobaa mɔɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ji lɛ; ehãa migbɛ jaa hãa mi.
Ehãa minajiaŋ waa tamɔ ofrote, ni ebaa miyi yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu, koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi matsɛ̃.
Yehowa, obaa miyi, ni ohere mi; oyelikɛbuamɔ ehã mitsɔ̃ mɔ wulu.
Ohã mi foijeehei babaoo, ni migbeko shi pɛŋ.
Mitiuɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni mikpãtãa amɛhiɛ, ni mikpaleee kɛyashi mipleneɔ amɛ.
Mitswiaa amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ minaji ashi.
Ejaakɛ omiaa mi kɛhã tawuu; ohãa mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ minaji ashi.
Ohãa mihenyɛlɔi joɔ minaa foi, ni mikpãtãa mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛkwɛ gbɛ, shi yiwalaheremɔ ko bɛ; amɛkwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.
Mishimɔ amɛ muɛmuɛ tamɔ mlu; minaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ gbɛteŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Ojie mi yɛ mimaŋ maŋsɔi amli, ni obaa miyi akɛ majimaji anɔ maŋtsɛ; ni mɛi kpɔji ni mileee tete ebatsɔ̃ mishishibii agbɛnɛ.
Maŋsɛɛbii kotoɔ mi, ni kɛ miwie lɛ amɛboɔ mi toi.
Maŋsɛɛbii lɛ anijiaŋ je wui, ni amɛshi amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛba kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Yehowa hiɛ kã!
Ajie mihefãlɔ lɛ yi!
Akafo Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji miyiwalaherelɔ lɛ agbojee.
Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔ mihe owele ni eba maji ashi ewo mishishi, asaŋ ni ehere mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ lɛ.
Yehowa, owoɔ mi otaa mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayiteŋ, ni obaa miyi kɛjɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, majie oyi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ɔ majimaji lɛ; mala makafo bo.
Ohã maŋtsɛ lɛ eye kunim wuji yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni osumɔɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu owo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni ji David kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ kɛyaa naanɔ.
David naagbee wiemɔi David, Ishai bi lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo lɛ, mɔ hu ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehala ni eto lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, folɔ lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã Israel.
Wiemɔi nɛɛ ji enaagbee wiemɔi.
Yehowa mumɔ lɛ tsɔɔ minɔ ewieɔ; ewiemɔ kã mililɛi nɔ.
Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ena ewie; Israel hebulɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɔ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni eyeɔ nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ naa lɛ, etamɔ leebi hulu ni tsoɔ yɛ nunɛmɔ sɛɛ, be ni oblɔtu bɛ; etamɔ nu ni hãa jwɛifɔ kwɛɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ.” Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baajɔɔ miwe lɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ mi ekpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, kpãŋmɔ ko ni akuŋ mli, shiwoo ko ni atsakeŋ hiɛ.
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ baahã mi yelikɛbuamɔ ni he ehia, kɛ mitaomɔ nii fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, amɛtamɔ ŋmei ni ashɛrɛ ashwie; anyɛɛɛ akɛ nine folo ata amɛhe; mɔ ni aaata amɛhe lɛ, ja ehiɛ dade kɛ akplɔ; ni akɛ la shãa amɛ wɛɛ.
David Tabilɔi Kakabãi lɛ David tabilɔi kakabãi lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ji Yosheb-bashebet, Takemonnyo lɛ, mɔ ni ji “kakabãi etɛ̃” lɛ ateŋ onukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Ewo ekpɔlɔ nɔ lɛ ekɛgbe mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ ta kome mli.
Esɛɛmɔ yɛ hii kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ ji Eleazar, Dodo Ahohinyo lɛ, bi lɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ efata David he, ni amɛtswa Filistibii ni ebabua shi akɛ amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ baawu lɛ mpoa.
Israelbii lɛ naa sɛɛsɛɛ, shi edamɔ shi akɛ nuu, ni ekpee ta lɛ naa, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ aahu kɛyashi ekɔ̃ji gboi yɛ ehe bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehiii lɛ eklante lɛ nɔwomɔ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa ye kunim kpeteŋkple nakai gbi lɛ ehã Israelbii lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii lɛ ba he ni Eleazar wu ta lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni amɛbakpɔlɔ gbohii lɛ ahe nibii kɛtee.
Hii Kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Shama, Agee, Hararnyo lɛ, bi lɛ.
Filistibii lɛ babua shi yɛ Lehi, he ni shikpɔŋ ko ni akɛdu akwɛŋ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israelbii lɛ jo Filistibii lɛ anaa foi.
Shi Shama ho edamɔ shi yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni egbe Filistibii lɛ ekɛfã ŋmɔ lɛ he.
Ni Yehowa ye kunim kpele ehã Israelbii lɛ nakai gbi lɛ.
Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni abɔiɔ ŋmɔshi nikpamɔ lɛ, Israel hii kakabãi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ Adullam tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Nakai be mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ efã ta kɛba, ni amɛbato shi yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
No mli lɛ David yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli, ni Filistibii asraafoi lɛ ebaŋɔ Betlehem.
David shwe shĩa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ po mana koni eya Betlehem eyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu ebahã mi manu?” Kɛkɛ ni hii kakabãi etɛ̃ nɛɛ gba kɛtsɔ̃ Filistibii atabilɔi lɛ ateŋ ekãa naa kɛho, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu, ni amɛkɛbahã David.
David enuuu, shi moŋ efɔse eshwie shikpɔŋ akɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛmiishã afɔle ehã Yehowa; ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ manu nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ, ejaakɛ yɛ gbɛ ko nɔ lɛ, hii lɛ ni shã amɛhe afɔle lɛ alá ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, David enuuu nu lɛ.
Ekãa naa nibii krokomɛi ni hii Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ tsu lɛ nɛ.
Abishai, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛ ji Zeruia lɛ, ji hii kakabãi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ anukpa.
Ekɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛ edɛŋ akplɔ gbe amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm.
Enɛ hã ena gbɛi yɛ hii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ.
Egbɛi hehe fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ amɛnukpa, shi moŋ eninaaa kakabãi etɛ̃ lɛ.
Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ni jɛ Kabzeel lɛ, lɛ hu hii kakabãi lɛ eko ni; ni efee ekãa naa nibii srɔtoi wuji babaoo.
Eko ji akɛ egbe Moabbii tabilɔi enyɔ komɛi.
Be ko hu lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛtee, ni eyagbe jata yɛ bu ko mli yɛ snoo be mli.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ esaa egbe Ijiptnyo nyɛnyreŋŋ ko ni hiɛ akplɔ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛmiifã ehe.
Shi Benaia hiɛ tso, ni ekɛyatua Ijiptnyo lɛ, ni eshɔ̃ akplɔ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni ekɛ Ijiptnyo lɛ nɔŋŋ akplɔ lɛ gbe lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ fee, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii kãkãlɔi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ.
Ena gbɛi jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ, shi eninaaa Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ.
David wo lɛ ehebulɔi lɛ anukpa.
Hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni shwɛɔ lɛ ji Asahel, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Elhanan, Dodo ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ bi lɛ.
Kɛ Shama kɛ Elika ni amɛjɛ Harod lɛ, kɛ Helez Peletnyo lɛ kɛ Ira, Ikesh ni jɛ Tekoa lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Abiezer ni jɛ Anatot lɛ, kɛ Mebunai ni jɛ Husha lɛ, kɛ Zalmon ni jɛ Ahoh lɛ, kɛ Maharai ni jɛ Netofa lɛ kɛ Heleb, Baana ni jɛ Netofa lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Itai, Rabai ni jɛ Gibea yɛ Benyamin lɛ; Benaia ni jɛ Piraton lɛ, kɛ Hidai ni jɛ Gaash faa lɛ he jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Abi-Albon ni jɛ Araba lɛ, kɛ Azmavet ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ kɛ Eliaba ni jɛ Shaalbon lɛ, kɛ Yashen bihii lɛ kɛ Yonatan kɛ Shama ni jɛ Harar lɛ, kɛ Ahiam, Sharar ni jɛ Harar lɛ bi, lɛ kɛ Elifelet, Ahasbai ni jɛ Maaka lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Elaim, Ahitofel ni jɛ Gilon lɛ bi lɛ; Hezro ni jɛ Karmel lɛ, kɛ Paarai ni jɛ Arbi lɛ kɛ Igal, Natan bi lɛ ni jɛ Zoba lɛ bi lɛ, kɛ Bani ni jɛ Gad lɛ kɛ Zelek ni jɛ Amon lɛ, kɛ Naharai ni jɛ Beerot lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛɔ Zeruia bi Yoab tawuunii lɛ, kɛ Ira kɛ Gareb ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛjɛ Yatri lɛ, kɛ Uria Hitnyo lɛ.
Tabilɔi kãkãlɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ feɔ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
David hã akane maŋbii ayikulɛ Yehowa mli bafu Israelbii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni etsɔ̃ David nɔ, ni egbala amɛtoi.
Yehowa kɛɛ David akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakane Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yoab ni ji etatsɛnukpa lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ tabilɔi anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ ayakpa Israelbii akutsei lɛ fɛɛ amli, kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashi Beersheba, koni nyɛkane maŋbii lɛ nyɛhã mi koni male amɛyikulɛ.” Shi Yoab here Maŋtsɛ David nɔ akɛ, “Nii, Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaahã maŋbii ayikulɛ ŋmɛnɛ aku abɔ he nakai toi oha, ni enɛ aaanyɛ aba mli yɛ miNuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ yinɔ hu.
Shi mɛni eba hewɔ ni Nii taoɔ ekane maŋ lɛ nɛɛ?” Shi maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Yoab kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ye ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yoab kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ shi Maŋtsɛ David hiɛ amɛtee koni amɛyakane Israelbii lɛ.
Amɛyafo Yordan Faa lɛ, ni amɛyato shi yɛ Aroer, ni ji maŋ ni kã Gad Faa lɛ jɔɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Amɛjɛ jɛi amɛtee kooyigbɛ kɛyashɛ Yazer.
Amɛtsa nɔ kɛtee Gilead kɛ Kadesh yɛ Hitbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtee Dan, ni kɛjɛ jɛi lɛ amɛdɔ amɛyi amɛfɔ̃ anaigbɛ kɛtee Sidon.
Amɛyi wuoyigbɛ agbɛnɛ kɛtee Tiro, ni ji maŋ ni awaje yɛ ta hewɔ lɛ, kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Kanaanbii lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni amɛyagbe naa yɛ Beersheba yɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɛ Yerusalɛm nyɔji nɛɛhu kɛ gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ sɛɛ, be mli ni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yoab kɛ maŋbii ni ayakane lɛ ayibɔ lɛ bahã Maŋtsɛ David.
Ana hii hiɛwalɔi ni eshɛ tayaa akpei ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ Israel kɛ hii akpei ohai enumɔ hu yɛ Yuda.
Shi be ni David ekane maŋbii lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ehenilee bɔi enaagbamɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mifee esha kpele akɛ mifee nɛkɛ nɔ ko.
Ofainɛ ni okɛfa mi, ejaakɛ miye kwashiai asane naakpa!” -Yehowa kɛɛ Gad, ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ David he lɛ, akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ mikɛ nibii etɛ̃ miishwie ehiɛ ni ekɔ mli ekome koni mafee mahã lɛ.” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni David te shi lɛ, Gad yanina lɛ, ni ebɔ lɛ amaniɛ, asaŋ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te amɛteŋ nɔ ni okɔɔ lɛ?
Akɛ hɔmɔ aba oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii etɛ̃, aloo ohenyɛlɔi anyiɛ osɛɛ ni ojo amɛnaa foi nyɔji etɛ̃, aloo gbele hela abayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii etɛ̃?
Susumɔ he okwɛ, koni ohã mi hetoo ni mikɛyahã mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.” David hã Gad hetoo akɛ, “Sane lɛ wa hã mi naakpa.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ misumɔŋ akɛ mayaje gbɔmɔ adesa dɛŋ.
Wɔyɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, emɔbɔnalɛ fa.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela babote Israelbii ateŋ kɛjɛ gbi lɛ leebi lɛ kɛyashi be ni ato lɛ.
Kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba lɛ hela nɛɛ gbe mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Shi be ni bɔfo ni kpãtãa maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ yaata Yerusalɛm he lɛ, Yehowa tsake ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni eba maŋbii lɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni ekɛɛ bɔfo ni gbeɔ mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Efa, kɛwa biɛ!” No be lɛ mli lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ yɛ Arauna, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmaa gbeemɔhe lɛ.
Be ni David na bɔfo lɛ ni tswiaa maŋbii lɛ anii lɛ, David kɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Naa, mi mifee esha lɛ; ni mi mitɔ̃ lɛ, shi gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ toi humii nɛɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛfeko nɔ ko.
Ofainɛ, gbalamɔ mi kɛ mitsɛ we lɛ moŋ toi.” Nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ Gad ba David ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyama afɔleshãa latɛ ohã Yehowa yɛ Arauna, Yebusnyo lɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.” David ye Yehowa famɔ lɛ nɔ, ni eyiŋ etee yɛ Gad wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Be ni Arauna yaakwɛ lɛ, ena Maŋtsɛ David kɛ etsuji miiba eŋɔɔgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Arauna je kpo, ni eho egbee shi, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto Maŋtsɛ David, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni kɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ baa etsulɔ ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” David kɛɛ Arauna akɛ, “Miba oŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ hemɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi mahã Yehowa koni gbele hela ni ebabote maŋbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ sɛɛ afo.” Arauna to he ehã David akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ koni okɛshã afɔle fɛɛ afɔle ni sa yɛ ohiɛ ohã Yehowa.
Naa tsinai koni akɛshã afɔle lɛ, kɛ tsinai akɔŋtsei koni akɛfee lai.
Mikɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ehã maŋtsɛ tswaa.” No sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahe ofɔle lɛ.” Shi David here Arauna nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabida!
Mibahe, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mikɛ nɔ ko ni mina lɛ yaka akashã afɔle mihã Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David he ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ kɛ tsinai lɛ jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ nɔ ehã Yehowa, ni eshã shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa bo fai ni akpa lɛ ahã Israelbii lɛ toi, kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo yɛ Israel.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Kulɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi ahe saji lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ wolo kpo kome mli; shi ana akɛ wolo kpo kome nɛɛ lɛ, eda kwraa tsɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ abaja wolo lɛ mli enyɔ; kɛkɛ ni abana Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo kɛ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo Ni Ji Enyɔ lɛ.
Woji enyɔ nɛɛ yaa nɔ gbaa Israel jaku lɛ blema saji.
Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo lɛ mli saji lɛ aja mli etɛ̃.
Klɛŋklɛŋ Mlijaa lɛ ji yitsei -; nomɛi gbaa Maŋtsɛ David naagbee wala he sane kɛ bɔ ni fee ni ebi Solomon baye esɛɛ akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Mlijaa ni ji Enyɔ lɛ ji yitsei -; ni nomɛi gbaa Solomon maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli saji: bɔ ni egbɛi hehee shi kɛ bɔ ni ena nii ehã.
Mlijaa ni ji Enyɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli lɛ agbaa wɔ bɔ ni Solomon fee ema Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ehã Yehowa.
Mlijaa ni ji Etɛ̃ lɛ ni ji Yitsei - gbaa wɔ saji ni ba yɛ Solomon gbele sɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji akɛ Kooyigbɛ akutsei lɛ tse Solomon bi Rehoboam hiɛ atuã, kɛkɛ ni enɛ hã Israel jaku lɛ mli gba enyɔ.
Ana Yuda jaku yɛ Wuoyigbɛ, ni ana Israel jaku yɛ Kooyigbɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo lɛ mlijaa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbaa wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛyelihei enyɔ nɛɛ ahe sane.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia ahe saji lɛ muɔ wolo nɛɛ naa.
Maŋtsɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ ni he sane yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, enɔkwa ni eye aloo eyeee Yehowa lɛ nɔ adamɔɔ akɛyeɔ ehe odase akɛ eji maŋtsɛ kpakpa aloo eji maŋtsɛ gbonyo.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ ye anɔkwa ni eye Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, ajieɔ eyi akɛ maŋtsɛ kpakpa ji lɛ.
Shi kɛji eyayeee Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ nɔ, ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, akɛɔ akɛ maŋtsɛ gbonyo ji lɛ, Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ abu amɛ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi gbohii, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni amɛja amãgãi.
Shi Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo lɛ, abu amɛ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kpakpai, ejaakɛ amɛkɔ amɛblema Maŋtsɛ David nane, ni amɛja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo lɛ gbaa Gbalɔ Elia hu he saji komɛi ni ale jogbaŋŋ lɛ: Elia mɔ ni kã Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Maŋnyɛ Yezebel ni ye lumɔ yɛ Israel lɛ.
Elia bɔ Israelbii lɛ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi amɛkaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Elia tao koni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, lɛ ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ etsɛ jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ akɛ ekɛ Yehowa abashi mple yɛ ŋa nɔ koni akwɛ.
No ji akɛ Elia kɛ Baal gbalɔi lɛ shi mple akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashã afɔle ahã enyɔŋmɔ.
Mpleshii lɛ ji akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa esuŋ la ekɛsɔoŋ afɔleshãa laitsei lɛ anaa.
Shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɛ enyɔŋmɔ lɛ koni ehã lai lɛ ahere kɛ la, be mli ni gbɔmɔ ko kɛ la sɔoko laitsei lɛ anaa; ni nyɔŋmɔ ni baahã lai lɛ atso kɛ la lɛ, lɛ ji nyɔŋmɔ.
Kɛji Baal ji mɔ ni baahã laitsei lɛ ahere kɛ la lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ; ni kɛji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni baanyɛ ni ehã laitsei lɛ ahere kɛ la lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ.
Mɔ ni baanyɛ ehã laitsei lɛ ahere kɛ la lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni sa akɛ aja lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi David maŋtsɛyeli naagbee .—.
Solomon batsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ .- Solomon maŋtsɛyeli .—.
a. Shishijee afii lɛ .—.
b. Ama Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ .—.
d. Naagbee afii lɛ .—.
Maŋtsɛyeli ni mli egba lɛ .—.
a. Kooyi Akutsei lɛ atuatsemɔ .—.
b. Yuda kɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ .—.
d. Gbalɔ Elia .—.
e. Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab .—.
ɛ. Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia .-
Maŋtsɛ David gbɔlɛbeiaŋ Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ David egbɔ kotokoto.
Tsɛbelɛ etsuji kɛ kuntui pii haa ehe moŋ nɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ ehe edɔɔɔ la.
No hewɔ lɛ, etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, hã ni wɔyatao oblayoo foro ko wɔbahã Nii, ni esɔmɔ Nii.
Ebaakã Nii mlishi koni Maŋtsɛ he adɔ la.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyatao oblayoo fɛɛfɛo yɛ Israel kpokpai anɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi amɛyana Abishag, Shunam oblayoo ko, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bahã Maŋtsɛ David.
Oblayoo lɛ he yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Ekwɛ maŋtsɛ, ni esɔmɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Abishag naaa nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ.
Adonia tao ni eye maŋtsɛ - Adonia, David kɛ Hagit bi lɛ, Absalom sɛɛho ni; ni ehe yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Be ko lɛ Adonia wo ehe nɔ kɛ shwãa akɛ “Mi, mibaye maŋtsɛ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, etao shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni buɔ ehe.
Etsɛ Maŋtsɛ David kãko lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi?” Adonia kɛ Yoab, Zeruia bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kpãŋ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yoab kɛ Abiatar kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ amɛaaye amɛbua lɛ koni eye maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Shi Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia kɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ Shimei kɛ Rei kɛ hii kakabãi ni buɔ Maŋtsɛ David he lɛ bɛ Adonia sɛɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ Adonia yagbegbee toi kɛ tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ yɛ Onufu Tɛsaa lɛ ni bɛŋkɛ Rogel Nubu lɛ he.
Ekpee enyɛmimɛi maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yuda hii kãkãlɔi ni ji Maŋtsɛ David tsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee jɛi.
Shi moŋ Adonia ekpeee Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Benaia, David hebulɔi lɛ, kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi Solomon kɛyaaa jɛi.
Awo Solomon Maŋtsɛ Be ni Natan nu nii nɛɛ he lɛ, eyabi Solomon nyɛ, Batsheba akɛ, “Ani onu akɛ Adonia, Hagit bi lɛ, ewo ehe maŋtsɛ, ni wɔnuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ David leee he eko lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ba ni mawo bo ŋaa, bɔ ni afee ni okɛhere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ obi Solomon yiwala.
Yiŋ ni oya Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii, ani jeee bo okã oweyoo kitã akɛ obi Solomon ni baata mimaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni Adonia moŋ yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛɛ?’ ” Ni Natan tee nɔ akɛ, “Be ni okɛ maŋtsɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, mi hu manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛba mli ni mibamã owiemɔ lɛ nɔ mí.” Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba yiŋ etee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ pia lɛ mli.
Nakai be mli lɛ, akɛni Maŋtsɛ David egbɔ kotokoto hewɔ lɛ, Abishag, Shunamyoo lɛ, ji mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ.
Batsheba bakoto Maŋtsɛ David; ni Maŋtsɛ David bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Ni Batsheba kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, bo okã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kitã akɛ, ‘Mibi Solomon baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ, ni lɛ ebaata misɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.’ Shi amrɔ nɛɛ naa, awo Adonia maŋtsɛ ni bo, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, oleee he eko!
Ni egbe tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ babaoo, ni ekpee maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ tatsɛ Yoab, shi otsulɔ Solomon lɛ ekpeee lɛ eko!
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ, Nii, bo gbɛ Israel fɛɛ kwɛɔ akɛ oootsɔ̃ɔ amɛ mɔ ni baata minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛji ogbo sɛɛ.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ aaaba mli akɛ be ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ etsɔ̃ esɛɛ lɛ, aaabu mi kɛ mibi Solomon gbɔmɛi gbohii, ni amɛaagbe wɔ.” Ni naa, be ni Batsheba wieɔ lolo lɛ, gbalɔ Natan hu ebashɛ jɛi.
Ni ayakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, “Gbalɔ Natan eba jɛi!” Ni Natan bakoto maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, ani bo okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Adonia aye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ, ni eta misɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ?’ Ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ eyiŋ etee, ni eyagbe tsinai kɛ kooloi ni ewo fɔ kɛ toi babaoo; ni ekpee maŋtsɛbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ ta lɛ nɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Abiatar; ni naa, amɛtara ehiɛ amɛmiiyeyee nii, ni amɛmiinunuu dãi.
Ni amɛmiibɔ oshe akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ Adonia yi ana wala.’ Shi mi, otsulɔ lɛ, kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Yehoiada bi Benaia lɛ ekpeee wɔ.
Ani minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ le nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ, ni ohãaa otsuji ana ale mɔ ni baata minuŋtsɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ osɛɛ lo?” Solomon baye Maŋtsɛ Maŋtsɛ David to he akɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa Batsheba nyɛhãa mi!” Ni Batsheba ba, ni ebadamɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ Batsheba akɛ, “Miwo bo shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ misusuma kɛjɛ amanehului fɛɛ mli lɛ hiɛ.
Mikã bo, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã akɛ obi Solomon baaye maŋtsɛ yɛ misɛɛ, ni lɛ ebaata mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ minajiaŋ lɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mimãa nɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ hu.” Kɛkɛ ni Batsheba kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ekoto maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia nyɛhãa mi!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni David kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa mitsuji lɛ nyɛfataa nyɛhe, ni nyɛkɛ mibi Solomon ataa mi diɛŋtsɛ mitejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ ayaa Gihon faa lɛ naa.
Ni Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan afɔ lɛ mu yɛ jɛi awo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni nyɛbɔa oshe akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ Solomon yi ana wala.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛbaa.
Ni kɛji eba lɛ, ebata mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ minajiaŋ, ni lɛ mito lumɔ koni eye Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Benaia kɛɛ, “Amen!
Yehowa, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ahã aba mli nakai!
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ hi shi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ misɔlemɔ ji akɛ ekɛ Solomon ahi shi, ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ kpele fe bo!” No hewɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Zadok kɛ gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoida bi Benaia kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ wó Solomon amɛta Maŋtsɛ David tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ lɛ tee Gihon faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Zadok yawo koŋ kɛ emli mu lɛ kɛjɛ Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛbafɔ Solomon kɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ.
Ni amɛkpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni maŋbii ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ oshe akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Solomon yi ana wala!” Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpãkpãa bɛji ni amɛnyiɛ Solomon sɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ kpele kɛba maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni amɛhoofeemɔ lɛ hã shikpɔŋ hoso waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni be ni Adonia kɛ emɛi lɛ eye nii lɛ etã lɛ, Adonia kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekpee ni yɔɔ eŋɔɔ lɛ nu hoofeemɔ lɛ he.
Be ni Yoab nu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ebi akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ afeɔ hoo kɛ bolɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli nɛkɛ?” Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo ni enaa enyɔko shi lɛ, naa, Osɔfo Abiatar bi Yonatan ni eba jɛi; ni Adonia kɛɛ, “Ba, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji bo, ni sane kpakpa okɛbaa.” Yonatan to he ehã lɛ akɛ, “Dabida, wɔnuŋtsɔ David ewo Solomon maŋtsɛ!
Bɔ ni eba lɛ nɛ.
Maŋtsɛ David hã Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan kɛ Yehoiada bi Benaia kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ Solomon tee Gihon faa lɛ naa ni eta maŋtsɛ tejiokpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Gbalɔ Natan efɔ lɛ mu amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli.
No ji bolɔmɔ kɛ nyamɔ ni nyɛnu he lɛ.
Awo Solomon maŋtsɛ ata etsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Ni asaŋ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ ba, ni amɛjɔɔ wɔnuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ David akɛ, ‘oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ahã Solomon gbɛi ahehee shi fe ogbɛi lɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli mli alɛɛ fe onɔ lɛ.’ Maŋtsɛ David kã esaa lɛ nɔ nakai be lɛ mli, ni ema eyi shi ni ekɛɛ, ‘Ajie, Yehowa, wɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, lɛ mɔ ni ehã mɔ kome yɛ mimusuŋbii lɛ ateŋ ebata misɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ; ni mihiŋmɛi enã!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Adonia kɛ maŋ ni ekpee lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛtetee shi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔ egbɛ.
Adonia diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eshe gbeyei, hewɔ lɛ etee kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he aklontoi lɛ amli koni akagbe lɛ.
Ayagba Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, “Naa, Adonia miishe bo gbeyei, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ aklontoi lɛ amli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋtsɛ Solomon akã kitã akɛ ekɛ klante egbeŋ mi.’ ” Ni Solomon kɛɛ, “Kɛji efee ehe gbɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ eyiteŋtsɔi kome nɛkɛ enyɔŋ shikpɔŋ; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, no lɛ ebaagbo.” Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ayaŋɔ Adonia kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛba; ni eba ebakoto Maŋtsɛ Solomon.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa owe!”
David wo Solomon ŋaa Be ni eshwɛ fioo ni Maŋtsɛ David baagbo lɛ, ewo ebi Solomon ŋaa akɛ, “Mibi, eshwɛ fioo pɛ ni magbo tamɔ bɔ ni adesai fɛɛ gboiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa taakɛ nuu.
Ye Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ, ni oba ojeŋ ni oye ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ emlai kɛ edasei lɛ anɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mose mla lɛ mli lɛ, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ofeɔ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa lɛ oye omanye.
Kɛkɛ lɛ shi ni Yehowa wo mi lɛ baaba mli.
No ji, ‘Kɛji oshwiei lɛ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ kɛ amɛsusuma fɛɛ aaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛaaye mi anɔkwa lɛ, no lɛ nuu ni aaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel ebɔŋ bo.’ “Solomon, ohiɛ akakpa nɔ ni Zerua bi Yoab fee mi lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni egbe Israel tatsɛmɛi enyɔ.
