Ner bi Abner kɛ Yeter bi Amasa, kɛtɔ ta mli lá shi ni ashwie he owele, be mli ni ta bɛ lɛ.
Etɔ̃, ni no hewɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ aye yɛ onilee naa bɔ ni sa ohiɛ pɛ.
Shi moŋ kaahã ekɛ eyiteŋ waji miikpeleke shi kɛmiiya gbohiiaje yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
“Feemɔ Barzilai, Gileadnyo lɛ, bii lɛ ejurɔ koni ohã amɛye nii yɛ okplɔ̃ he, ejaakɛ amɛwa mi be ni mijo onyɛmi Absalom naa foi lɛ.
Ni naa, mɔ kroko hu ji Gera bi Shimei, ni jɛ Bahurim lɛ.
Lɛ lɛ elomɔ mi dikadika gbi ni mitee Mahanaim lɛ.
Shi fee sɛɛ be ni ekɛ mi bakpe yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛ Yehowa gbɛi kã kitã akɛ, ‘Migbeŋ bo kɛ klante!’ Shi bo lɛ kaahã ni eye ehe.
Nilelɔ ji bo; ni ole bɔ pɛ ni ooofee lɛ; egbɔ moŋ nɛ, shi ohã ni agbe lɛ kɛ eyiteŋ waŋ lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ David gbele David gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Gbii abɔ ni David kɛye maŋtsɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii kpawo yɛ Hebron; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Ebi Solomon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi kpɛŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Adonia gbele Gbi ko lɛ Hagit bi Adonia ba Solomon nyɛ Batsheba ŋɔɔ.
Ni Batsheba bi Adonia akɛ, “Ani oba yɛ hejɔlɛ mli lo?” Ni Adonia kɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, hejɔlɛ mli miba.
Asaŋ miyɛ sane ko ni mi mibakɛɛ bo.” Ni Batsheba kɛɛ Adonia akɛ, “Mɛni sane ni; wiemɔ!” Ni Adonia kɛɛ, “Ole akɛ kulɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ minɔ ni; ni Israel fɛɛ hiɛ kã minɔ akɛ mi mibaye maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ ehã he kroko, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ etsɔ̃ minyɛmi lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ kome pɛ kɛkɛ he fai mikpaa bo; kaakãmã mi!” Ni Batsheba kɛɛ, “Wiemɔ!” Ni Adonia kɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, okɛ minyɛmi Maŋtsɛ Solomon awie, ejaakɛ mile akɛ ekamaŋ bo, koni ekɛ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, ahã mi gbãlã.” Ni Batsheba kɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, mi kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ baawie ahã bo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Batsheba tee Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ yawie ehã Adonia.
Be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ na enyɛ Batsheba lɛ, ete shi ekɛ lɛ yakpe, ni ekoto lɛ; kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ho eta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ehã ayawo sɛ̃i kroko abahã enyɛ lɛ, ni eta maŋtsɛ ninejurɔgbɛ.
Ni Batsheba kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, “Nɔ ko bibioo ko mibaba bo nɛɛ; kaakãmã mi.” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Bi mi, nyɛ awo, ni mikãmãŋ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Hã aŋɔ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, ahã onyɛmi Adonia gbãlã.” Maŋtsɛ Solomon to he akɛ, “Shi mɛɛba obiɔ Abishag, Shunam yoo lɛ, shi ohã Adonia?
Bi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hu ohã lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ji minyɛmi nukpa.
Mɛɛba obiii nɔ ko ohãaa Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ Zerua bi Yoab hu.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kã Yehowa kitã ekɛɛ, “Kɛji wiemɔ ni Adonia wie nɛɛ lɛ jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma ewie eshi fii, Nyɔŋmɔ awo mi he nyɔmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni ehã mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ emã shi kpɛŋŋ, ni eŋɔ mi eta mitsɛ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli ehã mi kɛ mishwiei taakɛ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ, ja agbe Adonia ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu Yehoiada bi Benaia kɛtee ni eyatswa Adonia nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Ashwie Abiatar Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ Osɔfo Abiatar akɛ, “Yaa Anatot yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; kulɛ osa gbele; shi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ migbeee bo, ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni otere Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛnyiɛ mitsɛ David hiɛ, ni ona mitsɛ amanehului ni ena lɛ eko.
Shi moŋ mihaŋ ni oye Osɔfo dɔŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Eli we lɛ he yɛ Shilo lɛ aba mli.” Agbe Yoab Yoab waaa Absalom shi moŋ ewa Adonia.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni enu akɛ Adonia egbo lɛ ejo foi kɛtee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eyamɔmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he aklontoi lɛ amli.
Ni ayagba Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ Yoab ejo foi kɛtee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli; ni naa, eyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon tsu Yehoiada bi Benaia ekɛɛ, “Yaa ni oyagbe lɛ.” Ni Benaia tee Yehowa Buu lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ Yoab akɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, jee kpo.” Shi Yoab kɛɛ, “Dabida, shi biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ magbo yɛ!” Ni Benaia yakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ bɔ ni Yoab kɛɛ nɛ, ni hetoo ni ehã mi nɛ.
Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaafee bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ; tswaa lɛ nɔ koni ogbe lɛ, ni ofu lɛ; koni okɛtɔ la ni Yoab fɔse shwie shi yakatswaa, yɛ mi kɛ mitsɛ we, lɛ he owele.
Yehowa ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá abua eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ klante gbe mɛi enyɔ be ni mitsɛ David leee he nɔ ko.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni ji jalɔi kɛ mɛi kpakpai fe lɛ.
Amɛ ji Abner, Ner bi lɛ, Israel Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yeter bi Amasa, Yuda tatsɛ lɛ.
Amɛlá abua Yoab kɛ eshwiei ayiteŋ kɛya naanɔ; shi Yehowa ajɔɔ David we lɛ, eshwiei kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ kɛya naanɔ!” Yehoiada bi Benaia yiŋ etee Yehowa Buu lɛ mli, ni eyagbe Yoab, ni afu lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔ Yehoiada bi Benaia efee tatsɛ yɛ Yoab najiaŋ, ni eŋɔ Zadok efee Osɔfo yɛ Abiatar najiaŋ.
Agbe Shimei Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ayatsɛ Shimei kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maa tsu ohã ohe yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ohi jɛi; ni okaje jɛi kɛmiiya he ko he ko.
Ejaakɛ gbi nɔ ni oooje kpo oyafo Kidron faa lɛ, na ole akɛ gbo obaagbo, olá abua bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiteŋ!” Ni Shimei kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wiemɔ lɛ hi; bɔ ni minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ kɛɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ otsulɔ baafee.” Ni Shimei hi Yerusalɛm gbii kplaŋŋ.
Afii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ Shimei tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ jo foi kɛtee Gat Maŋtsɛ Akish, Maaka bi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni atswa Shimei adafi akɛ, “Naa onyɔji lɛ yɛ Gat.” Be ni Shimei nu enɛ lɛ ewo eteji nɔ nii, ni eyiŋ etee Akish ŋɔɔ yɛ Gat ni eyatao enyɔji lɛ.
Ni Shimei tee eyakpala etsuji lɛ kɛjɛ Gat kɛba.
Mɔ ko yabɔ Maŋtsɛ Solomon amaniɛ akɛ Shimei eyiŋ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Gat, ni eku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ayatsɛ Shimei kɛba.
Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te mitsɛ́ Yehowa mikɛkã bo kitã akɛ gbi nɔ ni oooje kpo ni oooyanyiɛ kɛaatee he ko lɛ, na ole akɛ gbo ooogbo lɛ?
Okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Wiemɔ lɛ hi, minu!’ Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ oyeee Yehowa kitã lɛ kɛ akpɔ ni miwo bo lɛ nɔ?
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Shimei akɛ, ‘Ole efɔŋ fɛɛ ni ohiɛ kã he ni ofee mitsɛ David lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa ahã efɔŋ ni ofee lɛ aku sɛɛ abua bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiteŋ.
Shi Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ni mitsɛ David sɛ̃i lɛ aaama shi shiŋŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã Yehoida bi Benaia, ni eje kpo ni eyagbe Shimei.
Ni maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ Solomon dɛŋ.
Solomon kpa nilee he fai Solomon kɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ Farao fee shaanuu, ni Solomon kpee Farao biyoo.
Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ kɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm he gbogboi lɛ atswaa naa.
Nakai be mli lɛ akɛni amako tsu ahãko Yehowa hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shã afɔle yɛ wɔŋkoi lɛ amli.
Solomon sumɔɔ Yehowa, ni enyiɛ etsɛ David tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; shi Solomon hu shã afɔle kɛ tsofakɛŋma yɛ jemawɔji ajamɔhei lɛ.
Afɔleshãa latɛ wulu fe fɛɛ lɛ Gibeon eyɔɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, Solomon yiŋ etee koni eyashã afɔle yɛ jɛi.
Solomon eshã afɔle fe shii akpe yɛ nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ be ni eyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ lamɔ mli.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ ni otaoɔ ni mahã bo!” Ni Solomon kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofee mitsɛ David ejurɔ, ni osumɔ lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kpele, ejaakɛ eye bo anɔkwa; eja, ni ekɛ bo hi shi kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ.
Ni bo hu osumɔ lɛ, ni ohã lɛ binuu koni eta esɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Ni amrɔ nɛɛ, Ao Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, owo mi, otsulɔ, maŋtsɛ yɛ mitsɛ sɛɛ.
Gbekɛ bibioo kɛ minaa fufɔ sã kɛkɛ ji mi, ni mileee maŋnɔyeli.
Shi esa akɛ maye omaŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala, maŋ ni amɛfa babaoo bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane tete lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, dromɔ mi, otsulɔ, nilee koni mikɛye omaŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ jalɛ mli.
Hã mayoo srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ehiii teŋ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ maye omaŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ hu?” Ni nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ akɛ Solomon bi enɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛni obi enɛ, shi obiii ni ahã bo wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ, ni asaŋ obiii ninamɔ ohãaa ohe, ni osaa obiii ohenyɛlɔi agbele; shi moŋ obi ni ahã bo jwɛŋmɔ kɛ niiasɛɛyoomɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ehiŋ shi ni aaale nii tamɔ bo, ni mɔ ko hu baŋ yɛ osɛɛ ni aaatamɔ bo.
Ni asaŋ nɔ ni obiko tete hu maŋɔ mafata he mahã bo; ninamɔ kɛ anunyam fɛɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ fɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ bo yeŋ hegbɔ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Kɛ ooobo mi toi, ni oooye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni otsɛ David fee lɛ, no lɛ mahã ni otsɛ yɛ jeŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Solomon hiɛ tsɛ̃, ni naa lamɔ ni.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ ewie yɛ mli.
Eba Yerusalɛm, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni eshã shãa afɔle.
No sɛɛ lɛ, eŋmɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ okplɔ̃.
Solomon bu atɛŋ Gbi ko lɛ yei ajwamãŋi enyɔ komɛi badamɔ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hiɛ.
Ni yei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ, mi kɛ nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ tsu kome mli yɛ shĩa kome mli.
Ni mifɔ bi yɛ shĩa lɛ mli.
Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eba mli akɛ nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ hu bafɔ; wɔyi enyɔ nɛɛ pɛ wɔyɔɔ shĩa lɛ mli.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko fataaa wɔhe yɛ shĩa lɛ mli.
Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ binuu lɛ bagbo, ejaakɛ eyakã enɔ.
Ni nyɔɔŋteŋ be ni mi oweyoo, miwɔ lɛ, ete shi, ni ebawo mibi nuu lɛ yɛ mimasɛi, ni eŋɔ lɛ eyawo emlishi, ni ewo ebi nuu ni egbo lɛ ebawo mimlishi.
Be ni mite shi leebi ni mibahã mibi lɛ fufɔ lɛ, naa, egbo!
Shi be ni je tsɛre ni mikwɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, mina akɛ jeee mibi ni mifɔ lɛ ni.” Ni yoo kroko lɛ hu kɛɛ, “Dabi, mibi ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ni bo obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ.” Yoo mɔ ni wie klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ bo akɛ, “Dabida, mɔ ni egbo lɛ ji obi lɛ!
Mɔ ni egbo lɛ ji obi lɛ, mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ ji mibi lɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i naataamɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ kome kɛɛ, ‘Mibi ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ni obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ.’ Ni mɔ kome hu kɛɛ, ‘Dabi, shi obi ji mɔ ni egbo lɛ, ni mibi ji mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ.’ ” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbahãa mi klante!” Ni akɛ klante bahã maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛjaa bi hiɛkãalɔ lɛ mli enyɔ, ni nyɛŋɔa fã nyɛhãa mɔ kome, ni akɛ fã ni eshwɛ lɛ ahã mɔ kome!” Kɛkɛ ni yoo mɔ bi ni ji hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bo akɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, mimusuŋ miishã mi yɛ mibi lɛ he.
Ofainɛ, ŋɔɔ bi hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ohã lɛ; akagbe lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ!” Shi mɔ kome lɛ kɛɛ, “Akɛ lɛ akahã wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, aja emli enyɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Solomon kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkagbea lɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa bi hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nyɛhãa yoo mɔ ni wie klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ji bi lɛ nyɛ!” Be ni Israelbii fɛɛ nu bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon bua sane nɛɛ he ehã lɛ, amɛkɛ bulɛ kpele hã maŋtsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee yɛ emli, ni no hã enyɛ nɛkɛ kojomɔ ekojo!
Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsuji lɛ Solomon ye Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Ni etsuji nukpai ni eyɔɔ nɛ: Zadok bi Azaria ji osɔfo.
Elihoref kɛ Ahia, Shisha bii lɛ, ji woloŋmalɔi; Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji sajiaŋmlãlɔ.
Yehoiada bi Benaia ji tatsɛnukpa; ni Zadok kɛ Abiatar ji osɔfoi.
Natan bi Azaria lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ kpokpai anɔ tsuji lɛ anɔ; Natan bi Zabud lɛ ji Osɔfo kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ naanyo.
Ahishar kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ; ni Abda bi Adoniram lɛ kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hala nitsulɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɛ Israel maŋ fɛɛ.
Amɛ amɛkɛ niyenii baa maŋtsɛ we lɛ daa afi.
Daa afi mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ nyɔɔŋ nɔ ni ekɛ niyenii baa.
Amɛgbɛii nɛ: Ben-Hur yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ben-Deker kwɛɔ Makaz kɛ Shaalbim kɛ Bet-Shemash kɛ Elon-Bet-Hanan.
Ben-Hesed kwɛɔ Arubot, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekwɛɔ Soko kɛ Hefer shikpɔji lɛ.
Ben-Abinadab kwɛɔ Nafat-Dor.
Eŋa ji Tafat, Solomon biyoo lɛ.
Ahilud bi Baana kwɛɔ Taanak kɛ Megido kɛ Bet-Shean yɛ Zaretan masɛi yɛ Yezreel ŋshɔnaa gbɛ, kɛjɛ Bet-Shean kɛyashwie Abel-Mehola kɛ Yokmeam sɛɛ.
Ben-Geber kwɛɔ Ramot-Gilead, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekwɛɔ akrowai komɛi ni ji Manase bi Yair nɔ lɛ anɔ, nɔ ní yɔɔ Gilead lɛ.
Ekwɛɔ Argob kpokpai ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ.
Maji nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ amɛhe gbogboi kɛ shinai ni akɔɔble adabaŋi yɔɔ he ni.
Ido bi Ahinadab kwɛɔ Mahanaim.
Ahimaaz kwɛɔ Naftali.
Ekpee Basemat, Solomon biyoo lɛ.
Hushai bi Baana kwɛɔ Asher kɛ Bealot.
Parua bi Yoshafat kwɛɔ Isakar.
Ela bi Shimei kwɛɔ Benyamin.
Ur bi Geber kwɛɔ Gilead he ni Amorbii amaŋtsɛ Sihon kɛ Bashanbii amaŋtsɛ Og hi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ko yɛ ni kwɛɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Solomon Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ dalɛ Yuda kɛ Israel yi fa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Amɛyeyeɔ nii, ni amɛnunuɔ dãi, ni amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.
Solomon ye maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ nɔ lumɔ kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, kɛ Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie Ijipt husui lɛ anɔ.
Amɛtsu onia amɛhã Solomon, ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Solomon gbi kome jenamɔ niyenii ji ashikishaŋ litai akpei enumɔ kɛ ŋmãa mamu litai akpei nyɔŋma.
Tsinai ni ewo fɔ nyɔŋma kɛ tsinai nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni jɛ ŋa nɔ lɛɛhei, kɛ toi oha ni fata he.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ ofrotei kɛ soŋai kɛ baayelɔ kɛ loofɔji ni ewo fɔ shi nɔ.
Solomon ye shikpɔji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ, kɛjɛ Tifsa aahu kɛyashwie Gaza, lɛ nɔ.
Eye maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Solomon na toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ ehewɔhewɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli.
Ni Solomon yinɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Yuda kɛ Israel hi shi shweshweeshwe.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hi shi yɛ ewain tso kɛ egbami tso shishi kɛjɛ Dan aahu kɛyashwie Beersheba.
Solomon yɛ okpɔŋɔiatsui akpei ejwɛ kɛhã eshwiilii lɛ, kɛ okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni kwɛɔ Solomon niyenii anɔ lɛ kɛ niyenii baa daa kɛhã mɛi ni bayeɔ nii yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Mɔ kome yɛ nyɔɔŋ kome nɔ.
Ni amɛhãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko he ahia.
Amɛkɛ akoko kɛ jwɛi hu ni akɛbaahã okpɔŋɔi kɛ kooloi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ baa, bɔ ni afo tɛ ahã amɛ lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hã Solomon jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ kpele diɛŋtsɛ.
Solomon le nii fe nilelɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Bokã kɛ Ijipt lɛ fɛɛ.
Ele nii fe jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ele nii fe Etan, Ezrahinyo lɛ kɛ Heman kɛ Kalkol kɛ Darda, Mahol bii lɛ.
Solomon gbɛi hehee yɛ jeŋ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛkpe.
Ni Solomon bu abɛi akpei etɛ̃; ni elalai anaa ji akpe kɛ enumɔ.
Ewie tsei ahe, kɛjɛ tsenedru tso ni yɔɔ Lebanon nɔ aahu kɛyashi tsei bibii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gbogboi anɔ ahe.
Ewie kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ waamɔ nii kɛ nuŋloi hu ahe.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nu Solomon nilee lɛ he, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã mɛi ba, ni amɛbabo Solomon naa wiemɔ toi.
Solomon saa ehe kɛhã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mãa Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ, naanyo ji Maŋtsɛ David yɛ ewala beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Be ni Hiram nu akɛ afɔ Solomon mu awo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ David sɛɛ lɛ, etsu etsuji kɛba Solomon ŋɔɔ.
Solomon hu tsu akɛ wiemɔ yahã Maŋtsɛ Hiram akɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ ole bɔ ni mitsɛ David shwe akɛ emã tsu ehã Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jamɔ; shi henyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ gba enaa kɛ taitai, hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ tsu lɛ emã.
Shi agbɛnɛ Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã mikoji anɔ ejɔ mi; henyɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ, osharã ko hu bɛ.
Yehowa wo mitsɛ David shi akɛ, ‘Obi mɔ ni maŋɔ ta osɛi lɛ nɔ yɛ osɛɛ lɛ, lɛ eeema tsu ehã mi.’ Hewɔ lɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mamã nakai tsu lɛ mahã Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ tsu koni omɛi lɛ ayatoo tsenedru tsei yɛ Lebanon ahã mi; bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ooohe mi lɛ mawo akɛ apaafoi lɛ anyɔmɔwo.
Mahã mitsuji lɛ tete abafata amɛhe.
Ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ole akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ wɔteŋ ni le tsotoomɔ tamɔ Sidonbii.” Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Hiram nu Maŋtsɛ Solomon wiemɔi lɛ, ena miishɛɛ babaoo ni ekɛɛ, “Ajie Yehowa yi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, akɛ ehã David bi nilelɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ ni baaye nɛkɛ maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɔ.” Ni Hiram tsu abakɛɛ Solomon akɛ, “Minu oshɛɛ ni oshɛ mi lɛ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ mafee.
Mahã bo tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo lɛ.
Mitsuji lɛ aaaŋɔ tsei lɛ kɛjɛ Lebanon kɛba ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni mahã afimɔ amɛ atsara kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛyashwie he ni oootsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Mahã afɛne amɛ yɛ jɛi, koni ohã abahole kɛya.
Nɔ pɛ ni mitaoɔ ni ofee ji akɛ ohã minitsulɔi lɛ niyenii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Hiram hã Solomon tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni Solomon hã Hiram ŋmãa ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ mu tɔi litai ohai ejwɛ ni ji Hiram webii lɛ niyenii daa afi.
Ni Yehowa hã Solomon nilee tamɔ bɔ ni ewo lɛ shi lɛ; hejɔlɛ hi Hiram kɛ Solomon teŋ.
Ni amɛkɛ amɛhe kpãŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon fã mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ Israel maŋ fɛɛ mli koni amɛya ni amɛyatoo tsei yɛ Lebanon.
Aduram ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ amɛnɔ.
Aja mɛi lɛ amli kui etɛ̃.
Mɛi akpei nyɔŋma yaa amɛyayeɔ nyɔŋ kome yɛ Lebanon, ni amɛbayeɔ nyɔji enyɔ yɛ shĩa.
Solomon yɛ jatsuterelɔi akpei kpawo kɛ tɛgbalɔi akpei kpaanyɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Solomon yɛ mɛi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai etɛ̃ ni kwɛɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni Solomon fã amɛ, ni amɛgbala tɛi agboi kɛba, tɛi ni jara wa koni akɛto shĩa lɛ shishi.
Ni Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ kɛ Hiram nitsulɔi lɛ kɛ Giblibii lɛ ko tɛi lɛ, ni amɛsaa tsei kɛ tɛi lɛ koni akɛma tsu lɛ.
Solomon mã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ bɔi Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zif lɛ nɔ.
Nakai beiaŋ lɛ Solomon eye maŋtsɛ afii ejwɛ.
Israelbii lɛ shi Ijipt nɛɛ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ nɛ.
Solomon tsu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Koi ko ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kã Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.
Afee samfɛji awo tsu lɛ he.
Samfɛji nɛɛ lɛɛ yɛ mligbɛ fe ekponɔ gbɛ.
Amãmɔ ŋwɛi tsui sɔɔdoi etɛ̃ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ sɛɛ kɛ ekoŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ kɛ fioo.
Tsui ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ kwraa lɛ ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Nii ni yɔɔ teŋ lɛ, ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa, ni nii ni yɔɔ yiteŋ kwraa lɛ, ekome lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi kpawo.
Afee kpokui yɛ tsu lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpe, bɔ ni afee ni nɔsɛŋmɔ mplaŋi lɛ akabote tsu lɛ gbogboi lɛ amli.
Tɛi ni akɛmã tsu lɛ ako fɛɛ yɛ tɛgbamɔ he lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akanu hamle loo lema loo dade ko naa he be ni amãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Tsu ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ kwraa lɛ shinaa lɛ naa kã Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, no ji wuoyigbɛ; ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi lɔgɔligi lɔgɔligi ko kɛyaa teŋ pia lɛ kɛ pia ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli.
Solomon tswa tsu lɛ egbe naa, ni ekɛ tsenedru mplaŋi kɛ sɛsɛo ŋmoŋmolo sɛŋ nɔ.
Ŋwɛi tsui etɛ̃ ni amãmɔ kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ni akɛ tsenedru tso mɔmɔ amɛ akpɛtɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, “Tsu ni omãa nɛɛ, kɛji oooye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni oooto mikitãi lɛ fɛɛ, ni oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ mafee nɔ ni miwo otsɛ David shi yɛ he lɛ mahã bo.
Mahi shi yɛ nyɛ Israelbii ateŋ.
Mikwaŋ mimaŋ Israel kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Bɔ ni Solomon fee ema tsu lɛ nɛ.
Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mlisaamɔ Akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmolo ha tsu lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe, kɛjɛ shishi kɛyashi ŋwɛi nɔsɛŋmɔ tsei lɛ anaa.
Ni akɛ sɛsɛo ka Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ amã no yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Ni akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmolo fo ekɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ teŋ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
Ni tsu ni ji Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni eyɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Tsenedru ŋmoŋmolo ni akɛha tsu lɛ mli lɛ ayeyee fɔfɔi kɛ akpaki sãmãi awo he.
Ŋmoŋmolo lɛ eha tɛi lɛ anɔ, hewɔ lɛ anaaa tɛi lɛ ekome nɛkɛ.
Tsu ni amã yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mligbɛ kwraa lɛ jɛi akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mã.
Tsu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, elɛɛmɔ hu ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi eha tsu lɛ mli fɛɛ; shi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmolo akɛha he.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha tsu lɛ hu mli.
Ni akɛ shika kɔ̃sɔŋkɔ̃sɔi fo afabaŋ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ tsu lɛ hiɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni shĩa lɛ aye emuu hewɔ lɛ, asaa akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha mli fɛɛ.
Aha afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ tete ni yɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Ni akɛ mutso gbɔ kerubim enyɔ ni kwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma awo He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kerub fine kome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, fiji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.
Ni kerub kroko lɛ hu fine lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.
Kerubim enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ adaramɔ kome kɛ su kome.
Kerub kome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni ekroko lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Solomon kɛ kerubim nɛɛ wo mligbɛ tsu lɛ teŋ: kerubim lɛ egbɛgbɛɛ amɛfijiaŋ, bɔ ni ekome fine saa gbogbo kome he, ni kerub kroko lɛ fine saa gbogbo kroko lɛ he.
Amɛfiji lɛ kpeɔ yɛ tsu lɛ teŋ.
Ni akɛ shika eha kerubim lɛ ahe.
Ni aye kerubim kɛ tɛŋ kɛ fɔfɔii ni egblegblee sãmãi yɛ shĩa lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe, yɛ mligbɛ kɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ fɛɛ.
Ni shĩa lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi eka mli.
Akɛ mutso shinaa nta ta He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa.
Shinaa lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ tsei enyɔ lɛ kpeɔ yɛ shinaa lɛ yiteŋ.
Ni mutso shinaa nta nɛɛ aye kerubim kɛ tɛŋi kɛ fɔfɔii ni egblegblee sãmãi yɛ amɛhe.
Ni akɛ shika eha fɛɛ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akɛ mutso kpɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naagbɛ shinaa lɛ ŋmawuiaŋ tsei lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ.
Akɛ sɛsɛo kpɛ shinaa nta; ni shinaa fiji enyɔ lɛ adɔrɔɔ, ni shinaa kroko lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hu adɔrɔɔ.
Ni aye kerubim kɛ tɛŋi kɛ fɔfɔii ni egblegblee sãmãi awo he; ni akɛ shika eha he fɛɛ.
Ni akɛ tɛ ni ako kɛ tsenedru mplaŋi mã mligbɛ kpo lɛ.
Kɛ atswa tɛ klɛmpɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, akɛ tsenedru mplaŋ klɛmpɛ kome foɔ mli.
Solomon maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ Zif nyɔŋ ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ, ato Yehowa we lɛ shishi.
Ni afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, yɛ Bul nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ agbe Yehowa shĩa lɛ kɛ ehewɔ nibii lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Bɔ ni ato ehe gbɛjianɔ lɛ nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amã lɛ.
Afii kpawo akɛmã tsu lɛ.
Solomon mã Maŋtsɛwe lɛ Solomon mã maŋtsɛwe ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Ekɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ mã fɛɛ egbe naa.
- Emã Asa ko ni akɛ Lebanon tsenedru tso eha mli fɛɛ.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ; ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Amã yɛ akulashiŋi koji ejwɛ anɔ.
Koŋ kome hiɛ akulashiŋi nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɔoɔ akpalei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ.
Ni akɛ tsenedru ŋmoŋmolo esɛŋ tsu nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni gbogboi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ samfɛji etɛ̃tɛ̃ɛtɛ̃.
Eko miikwɛ eko hiɛ.
Shinai etɛ̃tɛ̃ɛtɛ̃ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ kɛyaa asa wulu lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Eko miikwɛ eko hiɛ.
Akɛ akulashiŋi efee koi ko, ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Ni akpãtãŋ leleoo ko ble asa lɛ hiɛ ni aha nɔ.
Solomon maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ, emã kojomɔ asa lɛ nɔ, he ni ayeɔ sane yɛ lɛ.
Akɛ tsenedru tso eka mli fɛɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
Solomon diɛŋtsɛ shĩa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaahi mli lɛ yɛ kpo kroko nɔ, yɛ kojomɔ asa lɛ sɛɛ.
Amã lɛ tamɔ kojomɔ asa lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni Solomon mã shĩa hu ehã eŋa ni ji Farao biyoo lɛ.
Shĩa nɛɛ tamɔ enɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Tsui nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ asa wulu lɛ, akɛ tɛi ni jara wa, tɛi ni asusu ni ako, ni amɛsɛɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɛ akpalala esaa he.
Akɛka mli kɛjɛ shishi kɛyashi sɔɔdoi lɛ anaa tɔ̃ɔ.
Afee lɛ nakai kɛjɛ Yehowa agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi kpo wulu lɛ nɔ.
Ni shishitoo lɛ, tɛi ni jara wa sɔŋŋ ni.
Amɛdara kpelekplei diɛŋtsɛ.
Tɛi lɛ ekomɛi akɛlɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi kpaanyɔ, ni ekomɛi hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.
Tɛi ni jara wa ni asusu ni ako ni; tsenedru tso akɛtswa nɔ.
Ni kpo wulu bɔle he kɛkpe.
Be ni atswaa lɛ, kɛji atswa tɛ ni ako klɛmpɛi etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ akɛ tsenedru mplaŋ klɛmpɛ kome efɔ̃ nɔ dani atswaa ekroko hu.
Nakai nɔŋŋ afee Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ kɛ shĩa lɛ he koi lɛ hu.
Huram nitsumɔ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsu ni ayaŋɔ Huram kɛjɛ Tiro kɛba.
Yoo okulafo ko ni jɛ Naftali akutso lɛ mli lɛ bi nuu ji lɛ; shi etsɛ lɛ Tironyo ni.
Eji akɔɔble ŋaalɔ ni nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ ŋaa eyi lɛ obɔ̃.
Akɔɔble nitsumɔ mli lɛ ehe esa po ni ehiii.
Lɛ eba Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ, ni ebatsu enii lɛ fɛɛ ehã lɛ.
Huram fee akɔɔble akulashiŋi enyɔ emãmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ; ni emlitilɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni eshwie akɔɔble yiteŋ kpɔi enyɔ; ni ekɛmãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ.
Ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ni ntaŋi ni alo, kɛ fɔfɔii akekrei ni agbɔ tamɔ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi yɛ kpɔi ni yɔɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe; kpawo yɛ kpɔ kome he, ni kpawo yɛ kpɔ kome hu he.
Ni afee kpɔbii kokrobii klɛmpɛi enyɔ awo ntaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe; ni akɛha akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ni kpɔi ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ yɛ koi lɛ shi lɛ afee amɛ tamɔ fɔfɔii.
Amɛkwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Ni yiteiaŋ kpɔi lɛ yɛ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ayiteiaŋ tamɔ akpakii, ni amɛyɛ ntaŋ lɛ sɛɛ.
Kpɔbii kokrobii lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ; ni ato amɛ srɛnɛɛ yɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ahe.
Huram kɛ akulashiŋi enyɔ nɛɛ mãmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ koi lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Ni ninejurɔgbɛ akulashiŋ lɛ awo lɛ Yakin; ni nɔ ni yɔɔ abɛkugbɛ lɛ awo lɛ Boaz.
Afee akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ tamɔ fɔfɔii ni egba.
Bɔ ni agbe akulashiŋi lɛ ahe nitsumɔi lɛ anaa nɛ.
Akɔɔble Gbudugbaŋ lɛ Huram fee akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ.
Emlikwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma; ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ekutruku mli kɛbɔle lɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Akɛ akɔɔble fee akpakii kɛbɔle gbudugbaŋ lɛ toi.
Ninetalɔ kome hiɛ nyɔŋma.
Ato amɛ srɛnɛi enyɔ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ nɛɛ mã akɔɔble tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akotosɛɛ.
Etɛ̃ miikwɛ kooyigbɛ; ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ anaigbɛ, ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ wuoyigbɛ ni etɛ̃ miikwɛ bokãgbɛ; shi amɛsɛɛgbɛ eyaje mligbɛ.
Etilɛ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ.
Ni afee enaabu tamɔ kpulu naabu, tamɔ oflɔ fɔfɔi ni egbele enaa; eyeɔ nu litai aaafee akpei ejwɛ.
Akɔɔble shwiilii lɛ Huram kɛ akɔɔble fee shwiilii bibii nyɔŋma.
Ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ, elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃.
Bɔ ni afee shwiilii lɛ nɛ.
Amɛyɛ naabaŋmɔnii ni afee akpɛtɛ shwiilii lɛ.
Ni naabaŋmɔnii nɛɛ, afee jatai kɛ tsinai kɛ kerubim amãgãi yɛ nɔ.
Afee fɔfɔii hu yɛ he.
Shwiili fɛɛ shwiili yɛ akɔɔble kokolontoi ejwɛ kɛ akɔɔble kokolonto mlitsei.
Ni waomɔnii mãmɔ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni waomɔnii lɛ asɔo akpɛtɛ gbudugbaŋ lɛ; afee fɔfɔi akekre sãmãi awo fɛɛ he.
Ni kuɛ ni mã naabumɔ nɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome.
Ni eyiteŋgbɛ lɛ atɛ̃ mli tamɔ sɛ̃i.
Ni emlikwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni aye sãmãi yɛ he kɛkpe.
Kokolontoi ejwɛ yɛ naabaŋmɔnii lɛ shishi.
Amɛkwɔlɔmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã.
Ni kokolontoi lɛ afee amɛ tamɔ shwiili naji.
Naji lɛ anaabaŋmɔ nii lɛ kɛ naji lɛ amlitsei lɛ kɛ naji lɛ amliblɛmɔtsei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɔɔble akɛfee.
Ni shwiili fɛɛ shwiili yɛ waomɔnii yɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ he.
Ni asɔo akpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ yɛ shishigbɛ.
Ni shwiili lɛ yiteŋ lɛ afee naabaŋmɔ nii ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ fã.
Ni nɔbumɔ nɔ lɛ kɛ waomɔnii lɛ asɔo akpɛtɛ.
Ni waomɔnɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ naabaŋmɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, kerubim kɛ jatai kɛ tɛŋ sãmãi yɛ nɔ, bɔ ni aaaho nɔ.
Ni akɛ fɔfɔi akekre ebɔle amɛ kɛkpe.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee shwiilii nyɔŋma lɛ: amɛ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, amɛsu kɛ amɛdaramɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Huram fee akɔɔble botokui nyɔŋma.
Shwiili fɛɛ shwiili nɔ ekome.
Botoku kome mli lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Ni eyeɔ nu litai ohai kpaanyɔ.
Ekɛ shwiilii enumɔ mãmɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ; ni ekɛ enumɔ hu mamɔ ekooyigbɛ.
Ekɛ gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ ma Sɔlemɔ we lɛ wuoyi bokãgbɛ.
Huram fee gbɛi kɛ jwɛiloomɔnii kɛ lalakãi.
Huram gbe nitsumɔ ni etsu ehã Maŋtsɛ Solomon yɛ Yehowa we lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Nibii ni afee yɛ shĩa lɛ mli Nibii ni Huram fee lɛ nɛ: Akulashiŋi enyɔ kɛ kpɔi kokrobii enyɔ ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ ayiteiaŋ.
Efee ntaŋi ni akɛha kpɔi kokrobii enyɔ ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe.
Ni efee ntaŋi enyɔ lɛ ahe kpɔbii kokrobii ohai ejwɛ: kpɔbii kokrobii srɛnɛi enyɔ yɛ ntaŋ kome he.
Afee enɛɛmɛi akɛha kpɔbii kokrobii ni mãmɔ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ lɛ ahe.
Huram fee shwiilii nyɔŋma kɛ botokui nyɔŋma ni mãmɔ shwiilii lɛ anɔ.
Efee gbudugbaŋ agbo kome kɛ tsina amãgãi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni emã nɔ.
Huram fee gbɛ́i kɛ jwɛiloomɔnii kɛ lalakãi.
Nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ akɔɔble ni atsuu he kaŋkaŋ akɛfee ahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon koni akɛsaa Yehowa shĩa lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã afee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ Yordan ŋa lɛ nɔ, yɛ shiku shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Sukot kɛ Zaretan teŋ lɛ mli.
Nibii lɛ ayifalɛ sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, Solomon eŋmɛɛɛ koni ena eyikulɛ.
Akɔɔble lɛ hu aleee naa.
Solomon fã, ni afee shika nibii hu awo Yehowa we lɛ.
Nibii nɛɛ ji: Shika afɔleshãa latɛ kɛ shika okplɔ̃ ni akɛ hiɛmaa aboloo lɛ mãa nɔ lɛ.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kanetsei ni mãmɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, enumɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni enumɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ.
Akɛ shika fee fɔfɔii lɛ kɛ kanei lɛ kɛ abɛɛlei lɛ hu.
Akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi fee kãi kɛ lalakãi kɛ likɔlikɔi kɛ lajee ŋɛsui; He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ asɛɛ sai lɛ hu shika akɛfee.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbe Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ̃ nibii fɛɛ ni etsɛ David ejɔɔ nɔ eke, ni ji jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ kɛba ekɛbato Yehowa we lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli.
Awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli Kɛkɛ ni Solomon bua Israel akutsei kɛ wekui onukpai lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ alumɛi lɛ anaa kɛkpe yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ eŋɔɔ, koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛjɛ Zion ni ji David maŋ lɛ mli kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.
Israelbii fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Maŋtsɛ Solomon ŋɔɔ.
Afee enɛ be ni ayeɔ Asesei Agbijurɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ ni ji Etanim nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Israel onukpai lɛ bua amɛhe naa lɛ, Osɔfoi lɛ bawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hole Kpee Buu lɛ mli nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ni ebuabua amɛhe naa lɛ ho damɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛgbegbee toi kɛ tsinai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni anyɛɛɛ naa abu aloo akane amɛyibɔ tete, ni akɛshã afɔle.
Ni Osɔfoi lɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee, ni amɛkɛyama egbɛhe yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli yɛ kerubim lɛ afiji ashishi.
Ni amɛfiji ni amɛgbɛ mli lɛ ha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ ehe tsei lɛ ni akɛwoɔ adeka lɛ anɔ.
Tsei lɛ kɛlɛ bɔ ni anaa amɛnaabui kɛji mɔ ko damɔ Kpee Buu lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Shi anaaa yɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Tsei nɛɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ Adeka lɛ mli akɛ ja tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ ni Mose ŋɔ to mli yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii lɛ kpãŋ yɛ, be ni amɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbaa lɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni osɔfoi lɛ je He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ, atatu bayi Yehowa We lɛ mli.
Ebayi Yehowa We lɛ mli bɔ ni osɔfoi lɛ nyɛɛɛ shi adamɔ tete ni amɛsɔmɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ eyi Yehowa We lɛ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon sɔle ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Duŋ kpii mli mahi.’ Agbɛnɛ mimã tsu mihã bo ni ohi mli, he ni ohi kɛya naanɔ!” Solomon kɛ maŋ lɛ wie Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ damɔ shi, kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã amɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ fɛɛ.
Ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wo mitsɛ David shi, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ehã eshiwoo lɛ eba mli.
Nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni miyajie mimaŋ Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba nɛɛ, mihalako maŋ ko maŋ ko yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ ni emã tsu koni aja mi yɛ mli.
Shi mikɔ bo David pɛ koni oye mimaŋ Israel nɔ.’ Mitsɛ David to eyiŋ akɛ eeema tsu ehã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɛ jɛi.
Shi Yehowa kɛ mitsɛ David wie akɛ, ‘Ehi akɛ oto oyiŋ akɛ obaama shĩa ohã mi, ni ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oto oyiŋ nakai.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bo ooomã tsu lɛ; shi moŋ omusuŋ bi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni eeemã tsu ehã mi koni aja mi yɛ jɛi.’ “Ni amrɔ nɛɛ, Yehowa ehã ewiemɔ lɛ eba mli, ejaakɛ miye mitsɛ najiaŋ, ni mibata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa wo shi lɛ.
Ni mimã tsu lɛ mihã Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni aja lɛ yɛ jɛi; ni mito he ko hu yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli mihã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, nɔ mli ni tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii enyɔ lɛ, tɛi ni aŋmã kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni amɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbaa, yɛ nɔ lɛ”.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon Sɔlemɔ Solomon ho edamɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, ni egbɛ enijiaŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ!
Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ŋwɛi yɛ yiteŋ gbɛ loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ shishigbɛ ni tamɔ bo, ni otoɔ kpãŋmɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ohãa otsuji ni boɔ bo toi kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ.
Oye shi ni owo mitsɛ, David, otsulɔ lɛ nɔ.
Okɛ onaabu wie, ni oto he nine pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ohã eba mli, taakɛ eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai koni oye oshi hu ni owo mitsɛ David, otsulɔ, lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni owie akɛ, ‘Nuu ni aaata Israel Maŋtsɛ Sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ ebɔŋ bo yɛ mihiɛ, kɛji obii lɛ aaale amɛhenɔkwɛmɔ, ni amɛba amɛjeŋ yɛ mihiɛ, taakɛ oba ojeŋ yɛ mihiɛ lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai, hã shi ni owo mitsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, fɛɛ aba mli.
“Aso bo Nyɔŋmɔ, ooobahi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lo!
Naa, ŋwɛi kɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi nyɛɛɛ bo ato, aahu ni Sɔlemɔtsu bibioo nɛɛ ni mimã nɛɛ!
Shi kɛ̃lɛ hã otsulɔ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ lɛ asa ohiɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, koni obo bolɔmɔ ni mi, otsulɔ, mibolɔɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ ni misɔleɔ yɛ ohiɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ toi.
Ofainɛ, ohiŋmɛi ahi nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ he nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane, he ni okɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, ‘Migbɛi aaahi jɛi lɛ’, koni obo mi, otsulɔ, mifai ni mikpaa bo yɛ biɛ nɛɛ toi.
Ni obo mi, otsulɔ, kɛ omaŋ Israel fai ni amɛaakpa bo yɛ biɛ lɛ toi, ni onu yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni kɛji onu lɛ oŋɔ fa!
“Kɛji mɔ ko fee enaanyo esha, ni ahã lɛ kitã ni ekã yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ hiɛ yɛ shĩa nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ bo toi yɛ ŋwɛi koni okojo otsuji lɛ; buu atɛŋ, mɔ ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ buu lɛ fɔ, ni enii abua eyiteŋ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ bem, lɛ buu lɛ bem ni eŋɔ ehe eye tswaa.
Kɛji omaŋ Israel henyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ yɛ esha ko ni amɛfee amɛshi bo hewɔ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbakpa eshaifaa he fai, yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ bo toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni oŋɔ omaŋ Israel he esha lɛ ofa amɛ, ni oŋɔ amɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔ hã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
“Kɛji omaŋ Israelbii fee esha, ni no hewɔ otsi nunɛmɔ naa, ni omaŋbii lɛ basɔle yɛ biɛ, ni amɛbo amɛtsɛ bo, ni amɛshwa amɛhe yɛ piŋmɔ ni opiŋ amɛ hewɔ lɛ, no lɛ bo toi koni oŋɔ otsuji kɛ omaŋ lɛ he esha lɛ ofa amɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ kpakpa feemɔ, ní ohã nu anɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔ hã omaŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Kɛji hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji gbele hela ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji aharabata kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ŋala nii ni adu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle lɛ, bo toi.
Kɛji baalabii baye nii lɛ jio, no hu bo amɛ toi.
Kɛji omaŋbii ahenyɛlɔi basa amɛyi wo amɛmaji amli yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ, loo gbele hela ko ba lɛ, no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ toi.
Sɔlemɔ fɛɛ sɔlemɔ ni aaasɔle, fai fɛɛ fai ni aaakpa bo yɛ shĩa nɛɛ, mɔ kome mɔ kome ni jio, mɛi kutuu ni jio, aloo omaŋ Israel fɛɛ ni fee esha jio, kɛ mɛi ni le nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã amɛtsui nɔ, ni amɛbagbɛ amɛnijiaŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛkɛ shĩa nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ bo amɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ koni oŋɔ fa.
Ni oye obua mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔnii anaa, ejaakɛ bo okome too pɛ ole gbɔmɛi adesai atsuiiaŋ.
Okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe bo gbeyei, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni oŋɔ hã wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
“Ni gbɔ tete ni jɛɛɛ omaŋ Israelbii ateŋ, shi moŋ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ eeejɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ eba, ejaakɛ maŋsɛɛbii aaanu ogbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ nii wuji ni ofee he, ni eeebashã afɔle yɛ nɛkɛ shĩa nɛɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ bo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni ofee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni gbɔ lɛ boɔ tsɛɔ bo yɛ he lɛ ohã lɛ.
Enɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ ale ogbɛi lɛ koni amɛja bo tamɔ omaŋ Israelbii feɔ lɛ.
Ni amɛsaa amɛaana amɛle akɛ ogbɛi aŋɔ wo nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni mimã kɛhã ojamɔ nɛɛ.
Kɛji ohã omaŋ lɛ fã ta koni amɛkɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ayawu, ni amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ, shi amɛhiɛ miikwɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mimã mihã bo nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ toi yɛ oŋwɛi ni ohã amɛye kunim.
“Kɛji amɛfee esha amɛshi bo, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni efeee esha, ni omli fu amɛ, ni ohã amɛhenyɛlɔi ye amɛnɔ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee henyɛlɔi lɛ ashikpɔŋ nɔ, shɔŋŋ ni jio, kpaakpa ni jio, ni amɛshwa amɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛjaje amɛtɔ̃mɔi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ bo, ni amɛkpa bo fai lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, bo amɛsɔlemɔ lɛ toi.
Kɛji amɛshwa amɛhe anɔkwale mli yɛ nakai nomŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛsɔle be ni amɛmiikwɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛhã amɛblematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni mimã mihã bo nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ bo amɛsɔlemɔ kɛ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ toi yɛ oŋwɛi ni ji oshihilɛhe lɛ, ni oye obua amɛ.
Ni ŋɔɔ ofa omaŋ ni efee esha lɛ eshi bo kɛ efɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ.
Hã amɛnomŋɔlɔi lɛ amusuŋ atsɔ̃ amɛ yɛ amɛhe ni amɛna amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ omaŋ kɛ onii ni ojie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ dade flɔnɔɔ mli, ji amɛ.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋ Israelbii, ni obo amɛ toi be fɛɛ be ni amɛaabolɔ amɛtsɛ bo lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, oŋɔ amɛ ohã ohe, ni okɛ amɛ fee omaŋ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, taakɛ owo shi kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ, be ni ojie wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ.” Naagbee sɔlemɔ Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon egbe sɔlemɔ kɛ fai ni ekpa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, ete shi kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, he ni ekũla ni egbɛ enijiaŋ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ lɛ.
Eho edamɔ shi, ni eba Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ehã Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Ajie Yehowa, mɔ ni ehã emaŋ Israel toiŋjɔlɛ taakɛ bɔ ni ewo shi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Eshiwoi kpakpai fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Mose nɔ ewo lɛ, emli wiemɔ lɛ ekome folo nɛkɛ efeko yaka.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔ ahi shi, taakɛ bɔ ni ekɛ wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ hi shi lɛ.
Ekashi wɔ, ni esaa ekakwa wɔ hu.
Ehã ni wɔbo lɛ toi kɛ wɔtsui fɛɛ, koni wɔhi shi bɔ ni etaoɔ.
Wɔye ekitãi kɛ emlai ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ ahi misɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔi nɛɛ anɔ, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, koni eye ebua mi, etsulɔ, kɛ emaŋ Israel be fɛɛ be ni nɔ ko aaahia wɔ lɛ.
Enɛ baahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Yehowa pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ he ko dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛ Yehowa webii, nyɛyea Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa, nyɛyea ekpɔi kɛ ekitãi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.” Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ nɔjɔɔmɔ -Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ shã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa: tsinai akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ toi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ, ni amɛkɛgbele Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋtsɛ jɔɔ kpo lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nɔ efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ejaakɛ jɛi eshã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ kooloo muu afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ afɔi lɛ yɛ.
Efee nakai ejaakɛ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ ni mã Yehowa hiɛ lɛ edaaa, bɔ ni shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ ahe fɔi lɛ aaaho nɔ.
Solomon kɛ Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ ye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ gbii kpawo.
Asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ ba kɛjɛ Hamat niiaŋ yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ Ijipt niiaŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ fɛɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Solomon wo asafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ amɛtee.
Amɛ jie eyi, ni amɛtee shĩa kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee etsulɔ David kɛ emaŋ Israel lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Solomon ekoŋŋ Be ni Solomon egbe Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ shĩa lɛ mãa kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Solomon taoɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ efee lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, Yehowa bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Solomon, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Gibeon lɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minu osɔlemɔ kɛ ofai ni okpa yɛ mihiɛ lɛ.
Mitsuu Sɔlemɔ we ni omã nɛɛ he, koni aja mi yɛ jɛi kɛya naanɔ.
Mihiŋmɛi kɛ mitsui aaahi he daa.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛji oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni otsɛ David fee yɛ tsuijurɔ kɛ jalɛ mli, ni oooye mlai kɛ mikpɔi kɛ mikitãi ni miwo bo lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ, no lɛ maye shi ni miwo otsɛ David lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Bo oshwiei amli aaajɛ aye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ daa’ lɛ.
Shi kɛji bo loo oshwiei kpale kɛje misɛɛ, ni nyɛyeee mikitãi kɛ mikpɔi ni mikɛshwie nyɛhiɛ lɛ anɔ, shi nyɛaaya nyɛyasɔmɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ, no lɛ makpãtã Israel hiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ ni miŋɔ hã amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Makwa nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ ni mifee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ mihã mihe akɛ jɛi aaaja mi yɛ lɛ.
Mɛi aaaye Israel he fɛo, ni eeetsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ yɛ maji krokomɛi ateŋ.
Nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ baabutu kwraa, bɔ ni kɛji mɔ ko baho ni ena lɛ, ehe baajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeebo, ‘tsiaa!’ Mɛi aaabi akɛ, ‘Te eba tɛŋŋ ni Yehowa fee shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ nɛkɛ?’ Ni aaahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛnya nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ahe, ni amɛja amɛ, ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ Yehowa hã nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ eba amɛnɔ lɛ.’ ” Solomon kɛ Hiram Kpãŋmɔ Solomon ye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ ekɛmamɔ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Akɛni Tiro maŋtsɛ Hiram lɛ bahã Solomon tsenedru tsei kɛ sɛsɛo kɛ shika, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ, hewɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hu hã Hiram maji wuji nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Galilea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni Hiram jɛ Tiro ebakwɛ maji ni Solomon kɛhã lɛ lɛ, eyasumɔɔɔ maji lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, “Minyɛmi, mɛɛ maji okɛhã mi nɛɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, Hiram tsɛ maji lɛ “Kabul” kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi Hiram emaje Maŋtsɛ Solomon shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Nibii krokomɛi ni Solomon fee Bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon nyɛ maŋbii lɛ anɔ kɛmã Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ekɛ nɔnyɛɛ saa shikpɔŋ ni kã Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni etswa jɛi gbogbo lɛ kɛ Hazor kɛ Megido kɛ Gezer maji wuji lɛ hu.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ fã ta eyatua Gezer, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni eshã maŋ lɛ, ni egbe Kanaanbii ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ ehã ebiyoo ni ji Solomon ŋa lɛ akɛ gbãlãyaa nikee.
No hewɔ lɛ, Solomon saa maŋ lɛ emã.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ nɔnyɛɛ mã Gezer kɛ Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Jɔɔŋgbɛ lɛ, kɛ Baalat kɛ Tamar ni yɔɔ Yuda ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon saa emãmɔ maji ni akɛ enibii toɔ amɛmli lɛ fɛɛ: maji ni atoɔ etayaa shwiilii kɛ maji ni ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi yɔɔ amɛmli, kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwe akɛ emamɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Lebanon kɛ hei ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Amorbii kɛ Hitbii kɛ Perizbii kɛ Hivbii kɛ Yebusbii lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ ni jeee Israelbii ji amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛshwiei ni shwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni Israelbii lɛ kpãtãaa amɛhiɛ lɛ ji mɛi ni Solomon nyɛ amɛnɔ kɛtsu nii, ni nakai nyɔji amɛ ji kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi Israelbii lɛ Solomon eŋɔɔɔ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko efeee enyɔŋ, ejaakɛ amɛ amɛ ji esraafoi kɛ elumɛi kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ eshwiiliiatsɛmɛi kɛ ekpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi.
Nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ onukpai ni kwɛɔ Solomon nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji mɛi ohai enumɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi Ijipt maŋtsɛbi yoo lɛ shi David maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eshĩa ni Solomon emã ehã lɛ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon saa shikpɔŋ ni kã Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Afi kome mli lɛ, Solomon shãa afɔlei srɔtoi etɛ̃: eshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni emã ehã Yehowa lɛ nɔ; ni eshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ nɔ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ nɔ.
Belɛ egbe Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mãa lɛ naa.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpɛ lɛji babaoo yɛ Ezion-Geber ni bɛŋkɛ Elat yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hiram famɔ emlakui ni he esa kɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ nitsumɔ, ni amɛkɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsuji lɛ yatsu nii yɛ lɛji lɛ amli.
Amɛtee Ofir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyaŋɔ shika ni tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni amɛkɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon.
Maŋnyɛ Sheba yasara Maŋtsɛ Solomon Be ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ nu bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbɛi ehehee yɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm, koni eyaka lɛ kɛ saji ni mli wa naakpa.
Maŋnyɛ Sheba kɛ asafo yuu diɛŋtsɛ ba Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Ekɛ yoomai ni tere tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ shika babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa ba.
Be ni ebashɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon hiɛ lɛ, ebibii Maŋtsɛ lɛ saji babaoo ni ba eyitsoŋ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã lɛ saji lɛ fɛɛ hetoo, ni eshwɛɛɛ nibimɔ ko ni enyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ehã.
Be ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ na Maŋtsɛ Solomon nilee kɛ shĩa ni ema lɛ kɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ nɔ niyenii kɛ elumɛi ashitaramɔ kɛ bɔ ni etsuji ni wo atadei fɛɛfɛji sɔmɔɔ yɛ niyeniiashi, kɛ shãa afɔlei ni eshãa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ehe jɔ̃ ehe naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Sheba maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon akɛ, “Ohe saji kɛ onilee ni minu he yɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Kulɛ miheee miyeee kɛyashi miba, ni mibana kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛii nɛɛ.
Ni naa, jeee emli fã tete agba mi lɛ; onilee kɛ oshweremɔ lɛ fa aahu fe yijiemɔ ni minu lɛ tete.
Ajɔɔ oŋamɛi kɛ otsuji nɛɛ ni sɔmɔɔ bo ni amɛboɔ onilee wiemɔi lɛ atoi daa lɛ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ena ohe tsuijurɔ, ni ekɛ bo eta Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa sumɔɔ Israel kɛmiiya naanɔ.
No hewɔ ni ewo bo maŋtsɛ lɛ koni okojo ni oye jalɛ sane.” Agbɛnɛ Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ hã Maŋtsɛ Solomon shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ tsofaikɛŋma pii diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa.
Kɛjɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ akɛ tsofaikɛŋma lɛ eko bako dɔŋŋ ni fa babaoo tamɔ nɔ ni Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ.
Asaŋ Hiram lɛji babaoo lɛ hu ni kɛ shika jɛɔ Ofir baa lɛ kɛ tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa jɛ Ofir ba.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ tsei lɛ folɔ afabaŋi ewo Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he.
Eŋɔ eko ekɛfee saŋkui kɛ bɛji ehã lalatsɛmɛi lɛ.
Akɛ almugtsei nɛɛ eko bako Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ ni hi, ni anako eko dɔŋŋ hu tamɔ nɔ ni akɛba lɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã Sheba Maŋnyɛ lɛ nii ni etaoɔ kɛ nii ni ebi lɛ fɛɛ, dani esoro nii ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã Maŋnyɛ Sheba yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋnyɛ Sheba kɛ etsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nii ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon yɔɔ Agbɛnɛ afi kome mli lɛ shika ni akɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Solomon lɛ tsiimɔ ji talentai ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.
Esoro shika hu ni jɛɔ jarayelɔi lɛ kɛ guɔyelɔi lɛ kɛ Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ adɛŋ akɛ too ni amɛwoɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee tsɛŋi wuji ohai enyɔ, ni ehã akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni atswia ni tsiimɔ ji shekeli ohai ekpaa ha tsɛŋ kome he.
Efee tsɛŋi bibii ohai etɛ̃, ni akɛ shika ni atswia ni eko fɛɛ eko tsiimɔ ji kiloi enyɔ ha tsɛŋi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko he.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hã aŋɔ fɛɛ ayato Lebanon Koo Asa lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ shuɔ wu fee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i kpeteŋkple ko, ni ekɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ha he.
Akwɔɔ atrakpoi ekpaa kɛshɛɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kpasamɔhe lɛ yiteŋ lɛ, afee lɛ kutruku; ni sɛ̃i lɛ shitamɔhe lɛ, he ko yɛ sɛ̃i lɛ biɛ kɛ ebiɛ ni akɛ niji shwieɔ nɔ; ni jatai enyɔ damɔ he ni akɛ niji shwieɔ lɛ masɛi.
Ni jatai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ atrakpoi ekpaa lɛ anɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i ko kwraa bɛ maŋtsɛyelihe ko ni tamɔ no.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpuji fɛɛ ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ, shika sɔŋŋ akɛfee; ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Lebanon Koo Asa lɛ nɔ lɛ, shika ŋmiiŋmi ni; jwiɛtɛi bɛ mli ejaakɛ abuuu no fɛifɛi yɛ Solomon bei amli.
Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Tarshish lɛji babaoo yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ fata Hiram lɛji lɛ ahe.
Ni daa afii etɛ̃ lɛ, elɛji lɛ baa shi kome amɛkɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shuɔ wu kɛ ofoi kɛ aduji kɛ mɛleoi baa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Solomon tsɔ̃ kpanaa yɛ ninamɔ kɛ nilee mli fe maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni jeŋ fɛɛ tao akɛ amɛbana lɛ koni amɛbo enilee ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã lɛ lɛ toi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ba lɛ hiɛ keenii ko kɛba; jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii, atadei wuyawuyaa kɛ tawuu nii kɛ tsofakɛŋmai kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi.
Daa afi akɛ nibii nɛɛ baa.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon bua tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anaa, ni ena tayaa shwiilii akpe kɛ ohai ejwɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpeinyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Eŋɔ amɛteiaŋ mɛi komɛi eto shwiilii amaji lɛ amli, ni eŋɔ mɛi komɛi eto ehe yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon hã jwiɛtɛi bu aahu bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi tsɔ̃ tamɔ tɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm; nakai nɔŋŋ tsenedru tsei hu fa babaoo tamɔ sikamore tsei yɛ Shefela jɔɔ lɛ he.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa ashɛɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛjɛɔ Ijipt kɛ Kilikia; maŋtsɛ lɛ jarayelɔi lɛ yaheɔ lɛ ofoo.
Jarayelɔi lɛ yaheɔ tayaa shwiilii ni ekome jara ji jwiɛtɛi shekeli ohai ekpaa; ni aheɔ okpɔŋɔ kome hu jwiɛtɛi shekeli oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛjɛɔ Ijipt.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ jarayelɔi nɛɛ anine nɔ nɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ni Hitbii amaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Siriabii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ naa tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ekomɛi amɛheɔ.
Solomon gbo Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi Maŋtsɛ Solomon sumɔ maŋsɛɛ yei pii yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ sɛɛ.
Ekɛ maŋsɛɛ yei ni jɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Edom kɛ Sidon kɛ Hit shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ hi shi.
Tsɛbelɛ Yehowa ekã Israelbii akitã ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei akabotea gbãlãshihilɛ mli, ejaakɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, amɛaalaka nyɛ koni nyɛyaja amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.” Solomon yasumɔ nɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei nɛɛ moŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kpee maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei ohai kpawo ni eto hemɛi ohai etɛ̃.
Ni nɛkɛ maŋsɛɛ yei nɛɛ hã ekpa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Be ni Solomon gbɔ lɛ, eŋãmɛi lɛ etsake lɛ kwraa, ni ekpa yɛ Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni eyayeee Yehowa anɔkwa tamɔ etsɛ David fee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Solomon yaja Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek, Amonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ, ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Solomon fee nɔ ni ji efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni eyeee Yehowa anɔkwa kɛwulaaa shi tamɔ etsɛ David.
Kɛkɛ ni Solomon mã jamɔhe ehã Kemosh, Moabbii anyɔŋmɔ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek ni ji Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ ni Yehowa hiɔ lɛ hu, yɛ Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ.
Ni efee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã eŋãmɛi fɛɛ hu ni jɛ majiasɛɛ, mɛi ni shãa tsofakɛŋma kɛ afɔlei hu amɛhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa mli fu Solomon, ejaakɛ eje lɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛ: Yehowa mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ shii enyɔ sɔŋŋ lɛ.
Yehowa ewo lɛ enɛ he kitã akɛ ekaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi; shi Solomon yeee kitã ni Yehowa wo lɛ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Solomon akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni oyeee mikpãŋmɔ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ ni miwo bo lɛ anɔ lɛ, shɔ̃ kɛ̃ mashɔ̃ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, ni mikɛaahã otsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, otsɛ David hewɔ lɛ mifeŋ enɛ yɛ oyinɔ; shi obi ni maŋɔ mahã lɛ dɛŋ mashɔ̃ yɛ.
Asaŋ mishɔŋ omaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛyaŋ; maŋɔ akutso kome mahã obi lɛ, yɛ mitsulɔ David kɛ Yerusalɛm ni mihala lɛ hewɔ.” Solomon Henyɛlɔi Lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa tee henyɛlɔ ko shi ewo Solomon; lɛ ji Hadad, Edomnyo lɛ; ejɛ Edom odehei aweku mli.
Ejaakɛ David kɛ Edom na ta, ni eye Edom nɔ.
Be ni agbe ta lɛ naa lɛ Yoab, David tatsɛ lɛ, tee Edom koni eyafu gbohii lɛ.
Yoab kɛ esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ hi Edom nyɔji ekpaa, ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yoab gbe hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Edom.
Shi Hadad kɛ Edombii komɛi ni ji etsɛ tsuji lɛ jo foi kɛtee Ijipt.
No mli lɛ oblanyo fioo ji Hadad.
Amɛfã kɛjɛ Midian kɛtee Paran.
Ni amɛŋɔ mɛi komɛi kɛjɛ Paran amɛfata amɛhe kɛtee Ijipt, ni amɛtee Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Hadad shihilɛhe, ni eto niyenii ehã lɛ, ni esaa ehã lɛ shikpɔŋ hu.
Hadad sane sa Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ jogbaŋŋ aahu po ni eŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa ni ji Maŋnyɛ Tapene lɛ nyɛmi yoo ehã Hadad gbãlã.
Hadad kɛ Tapene nyɛmi yoo lɛ fɔ ebi nuu Genubat.
Tapene tse Genubat fufɔ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli; ni Genubat kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ hi shi yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Be ni Hadad yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ, enu akɛ David egbo, ni etatsɛ Yoab lɛ hu egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni Hadad yakɛɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya mi diɛŋtsɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hadad akɛ, “Mɛni po he hiaa bo yɛ biɛ hewɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ oya bo diɛŋtsɛ oshikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ?” Hadad hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehĩaaa mi, shi kɛ̃lɛ, ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni maya.” Rezon tsɔ̃ Solomon henyɛlɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tee henyɛlɔ kroko shi ewo Solomon.
Lɛ ji Eliada bi Rezon, mɔ ni jo foi kɛjɛ enuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer ni jɛ Zoba lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.
Rezon bua hii atuatselɔi anaa efata ehe, ni etsɔ̃ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, David eye Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer ni jɛ Zoba nɔ kunim; ni egbe ewebii Siriabii lɛ.
Rezon kɛ ewebii lɛ tee Damasko, ni amɛyahi jɛi, ni ewebii lɛ wo lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
Etsɔ̃ Israel henyɛlɔ yɛ Solomon yinɔ beiaŋ fɛɛ, ni egba Solomon naa babaoo tamɔ bɔ ni Hadad fee lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ wo Yeroboam shi Mɔ ko hu ni te shi wo Maŋtsɛ Solomon ji etsulɔ Yeroboam, ni ji Nebat, Efraimnyo ko ni jɛ Zereda, bi lɛ.
Yeroboam nyɛ ji Zerua, yoo okulafo ko.
Nɔ ni kɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ ba nɛ.
Solomon miisaa eetswa Milo ni ji Yerusalɛm gbogbo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Gbogbo nɛɛ ni yɔɔ etsɛ maŋ lɛ he lɛ he ko ekumɔ.
Solomon yoo akɛ nɛkɛ nuu Yeroboam nɛɛ lɛ, etsuɔ nii waa, hewɔ lɛ ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ nitsulɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Manase kɛ Efraimwe lɛ anɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli gbi ko be ni Yeroboam shiɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, gbalɔ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, yanina lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Gbalɔ Ahia wo atade hee kaŋŋ ko.
Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ pɛ amɛyɔɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ahia mɔ etade hee ni ewo lɛ, ni etserɛ mli bibiibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yeroboam akɛ, “Kɔlɔmɔ kukuji nyɔŋma ohã ohe, ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Solomon dɛŋ, ni maŋɔ akutsei nyɔŋma maha bo.
Mitsulɔ David hewɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm, maŋ ni mikɔ kɛjɛ Israel akutsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hu hewɔ lɛ, Solomon baaye akutso kome nɔ.
Mibafee enɛ, ejaakɛ Solomon ekwa mi, eyaja Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ anyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Kemosh, Moab nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ Molek, Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ koni efee jalɛnii ni sa mihiɛ ni eye mikpɔi kɛ mimlai lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ David fee lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mishɔŋ maŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ; shi moŋ mahã eye lumɔ ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Mafee enɛ yɛ mitsulɔ David mɔ ni mihala ni eye mikitãi kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Mashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ Solomon bi dɛŋ, ni maŋɔ emli akutsei nyɔŋma mahã bo.
Shi maŋɔ akutso kome mahã ebi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni David shwie ko ahi shi ahã lɛ daa yɛ mihiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, maŋ ni mikɔ mihã mihe koni aja mi yɛ jɛi lɛ.
Yeroboam, mibawo bo maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel ni oye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ.
Kɛji ooobo mi toi, ni oooye kitãi ni miwoɔ bo lɛ nɔ, ni oooba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni ooofee nɔ ni ja yɛ mihiɛ, ni oooye mikpɔi kɛ mikitãi lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mitsulɔ David fee lɛ, no lɛ mi kɛ bo aaahi shi; mawo bo Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã oshwiei aye lumɔ yɛ osɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee mihã David lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, magbala David shwiei lɛ atoi; shi jeee kɛmiiya naanɔ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Solomon tao Yeroboam egbe, shi Yeroboam jo foi oya kɛtee Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak ŋɔɔ, ni eyahi jɛi aahu kɛyashi Solomon gbo.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon gbele Agbɛnɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Solomon fee kɛ enitsumɔ kɛ enilee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Solomon he Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Bei abɔ ni Solomon ye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm ji afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Solomon gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛ David maŋ lɛ mli, ni ebi Rehoboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Kooyigbɛ akutsei lɛ tse amɛhe Rehoboam yiŋ etee Shekem ejaakɛ Israel fɛɛ eba Shekem koni amɛbawo lɛ maŋtsɛ.
Be ni Nebat bi, Yeroboam, mɔ ni jo foi yɛ Maŋtsɛ Solomon naa etee eyatee ehe yɛ Ijipt lɛ, nu sane nɛɛ he lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt eba.
Maŋbii ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ akutsei lɛ amli tsu koni ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam kɛ Israel asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ ba, ni amɛbakɛɛ Rehoboam akɛ “Otsɛ Solomon hã wɔtsu nii keketee diɛŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ooogbɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ deŋmegbomɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔsɔ̃mɔ bo, ni wɔɔfee nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ.” Rehoboam kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa dã; ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbahe hetoo.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ shi lɛ amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam bi ŋaawoo kɛjɛ onukpai ni sɔ̃mɔ etsɛ Solomon, be ni eyɔɔ jeŋ lolo lɛ adɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ ŋaa nyɛwoɔ mi yɛ sane ni maŋbii nɛɛ ebabi mi lɛ hetoo he?” Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Kɛji ooofee ohe tsulɔ ohã nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ, ni ooosɔ̃mɔ, ni ooobo amɛtoi, ni okɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ tsuijurɔ naa lɛ, no lɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ otsuji kɛya naanɔ.” Shi Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam kwa onukpai lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ, ni ekɛ oblahii ni ji etipɛŋfoi ni ekɛje nɔ ni agbɛnɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ moŋ tee ajina.
Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ ŋaa nyɛ hu nyɛwoɔ ni wɔkɛhã maŋbii nɛɛ ni bakɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Feemɔ jatsu kɛ tsiimɔ ni otsɛ kɛtere wɔ lɛ huyɛɛ ohã wɔ lɛ?’ ” Ni oblahii ni ji etipɛŋfoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋbii lɛ ni kɛ bo bawie akɛ, ‘Otsɛ kɛ jatsu ni tsii diɛŋtsɛ tere wɔ, shi bo lɛ feemɔ jatsu lɛ huyɛɛ ohã wɔ lɛ’, bɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ nɛ, ‘Miwao sɛɛkpelɔ ti fe mitsɛ hɛ.
Agbɛnɛ eyɛ mli akɛ mitsɛ hã nyɛtsu nii keketee moŋ nɛ, shi mi lɛ, mahã nyɛtsu nii keketee fe nakai.
Mitsɛ kɛ kpelebii yi nyɛ, shi mi lɛ, mikɛ dade kpelebi baayi nyɛ!’ ” Gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ Yeroboam kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ba Rehoboam ŋɔɔ taakɛ bɔ ni Rehoboam eto amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa dã, ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛba miŋɔɔ koni nyɛbahe hetoo” lɛ.
Rehoboam hã maŋ lɛ hetoo gbonyo.
Ekwa ŋaa ni onukpai lɛ wo lɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ oblahii lɛ aŋaa ni amɛwo lɛ lɛ naa akɛ, “Miwao sɛɛkpelɔ ti fe mitsɛ hɛ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ mitsɛ hã nyɛtsu nii keketee moŋ nɛ, shi mi lɛ, mahã nyɛtsu nii keketee fe nakai.
Mitsɛ kɛ kpelebii yi nyɛ, shi mi lɛ, mikɛ dade kpelebii baayi nyɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam booo maŋbii lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ sane lɛ jɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Yehowa ahã ewiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, nɔ ni ekɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam wie lɛ aba mli.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ na akɛ Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam eŋɔɔɔ onukpai lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ, maŋbii lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ani wɔyeɔ David gboshinii ko lo?
Wɔyeee Yishai bi David nii.
Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔshĩai amli.
Rehoboam, agbɛnɛ kwɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe nɔ!” Hewɔ lɛ Israelbii lɛ yiŋ kɛtee amɛshĩai amli.
Shi Rehoboam ye Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yuda kpokpai anɔ maji lɛ amli lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛ.
Shi Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam tsu Adoram, mɔ ni kwɛɔ nitsulɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛtee Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ; shi amɛtswia lɛ tɛi, ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam he fee oya, ni ebote etayaa shwiili mli, ni ejo foi kɛtee Yerusalɛm.
Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ, Israel Kooyigbɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tse David we lɛ hiɛ atua kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Be ni Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ Yeroboam eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛtsu ayaŋɔ lɛ kɛba Israel asafo muu ni ekpe hiɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni nyiɛ David we lɛ sɛɛ akɛ ja Yuda akutso lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.
Shemaia gbalɛ lɛ Be ni Rehoboam yashɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ebua hii tawulɔi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ naa kɛjɛ Yuda we lɛ kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli koni amɛkɛ Israel we lɛ ayawu, koni amɛshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ amɛhã Solomon bi Rehoboam ekoŋŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Shemaia, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, wie akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam, Solomon bi lɛ, kɛ Yuda we lɛ kɛ Benyamin we lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.
‘Nyɛkayaa, ni asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ akawua.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aku esɛɛ eya ewe; ejaakɛ midɛŋ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Rehoboam kɛ Yudabii kɛ Benyaminbii kɛ maŋbii lɛ bo Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee amɛshĩai ekoŋŋ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Yeroboam fee shika tsinabii Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam yato Shekem yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eyahi jɛi.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ejɛ jɛi ni eyato Penuel hu.
-Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Bɔ ni nibii yaa lɛ nɛɛ, kɛji mimaŋbii lɛ aaakã he ayaja Yehowa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, no lɛ maŋbii nɛɛ atsui aaatsɔ̃, ni amɛaagbe mi amɛhã amɛnuŋtsɔ Rehoboam, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, koni maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aku sɛɛ aya David we lɛ ekoŋŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ejwɛŋ sane lɛ he sɛɛ lɛ, efee shika tsinabii amãgãi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Shii abɔ ni nyɛyaa Yerusalɛm nyɛyajaa lɛ efa.
Ao Israel, naa onyɔŋmɔi ni yajie bo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ!” Ni eŋɔ shika tsinabii amãgãi lɛ ateŋ ekome emã Betel, ni ekɛ ekome hu mã Dan.
Kɛkɛ ni enɛ tsɔ̃ esha ehã maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyajaa amãgã ni akɛmã Betel lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akɛma Dan tɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu.
Yeroboam mamɔ shĩai yɛ he grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni eŋɔɔ mɛi kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ mli he fɛɛ he kɛkɛ, ni ewoɔ amɛ osɔfoi, tsɛbelɛ amɛjɛɛɛ Leviwe lɛ.
Yeroboam to jamɔ gbijurɔ hee ko yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ jamɔ gbijurɔ ni ayeɔ yɛ Yuda lɛ, ni eshã afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Eshã afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni efee yɛ Betel lɛ nɔ ehã shika tsinabi amãgã ni efee lɛ.
Ni ekɛ osɔfoi ni ewowoo lɛ to hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni efee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni lɛ pɛ eto lɛ nɔ lɛ, etee eyashã afɔle yɛ Betel yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ni efee lɛ nɔ.
Eto gbijurɔ nɛɛ ehã Israel, no hewɔ ni etee eyashã tsofakɛŋma yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbalɔ ko wie eshi Betel afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ Be ni Yeroboam damɔ shi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi yɛ Betel koni eshã tsofakɛŋma lɛ, Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ko kɛjɛ Yuda kɛba Betel.
Yɛ Yehowa famɔ naa lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ gba eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Ao afɔleshãa latɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ, naa, abaafɔ binuu ko yɛ David we lɛ, ni aaatsɛ egbɛi Yosia.
Lɛ ebaagbe osɔfoi ni shãa afɔlei yɛ onɔ lɛ, ni gbɔmɛi awui tete lɛ eeeshã yɛ onɔ.” Ni gbalɔ lɛ to okadi yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ji okadi ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ gbalɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɛ.
Afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ abaawule lɛ ashwie shi, ni enɔ lamlu lɛ akɛbaashwã.” Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam nu gbalɛ wiemɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɛ Betel lɛ, Yeroboam kpã enine mli kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ gbalɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɔa nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ!” Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enine ni ekpã mli lɛ shɔ̃ kɛkree, ni enyɛɛɛ esu dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ wule, ni lamlu ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã tamɔ okadi ni gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kpa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ni osɔle ohã mi koni atsa minine lɛ ahã mi ekoŋŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ kpa Yehowa fai, ni atsa maŋtsɛ lɛ nine lɛ ahã lɛ, ni enine lɛ ba eblema ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ba koni wɔtee shĩa ni oyaye nɔ ko, ni make bo nɔ ko.” Shi gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji okɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fã aaahã mi tete po lɛ, mi kɛ bo eyaŋ, ni asaŋ miyeŋ nii, ni minuŋ nɔ ko yɛ biɛ.
Ejaakɛ nakai Yehowa wiemɔ fã mi akɛ, kaaye nɔ ko, ni kaanu nu, ni gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛtee lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ no nɔŋŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ kɛba.” No hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee, ni ekuuu esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔɔ gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba Betel lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Betel gbalɔ nuumo lɛ Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ nuumo ko hi shi yɛ Betel.
Ebihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome bagba lɛ nii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ etsu yɛ Betel nakai gbi lɛ; egba lɛ wiemɔ ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ Yeroboam wie lɛ hu.
Nuumo lɛ bi akɛ, “Be ni eshi jɛi lɛ nɛgbɛ etsɔ̃?” Ni ebii lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda kɛba lɛ tsɔ̃ lɛ.
Nuumo lɛ kɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa teji nɔ nii nyɛhãa mi.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo teji nɔ nii amɛhã lɛ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Nuumo gbalɔ lɛ tiu Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ, ni eyanina lɛ ni eta tso agbo ko shishi.
Ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda ba lɛ?” Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi ni.” Gbalɔ nuumo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ba wɔtee shĩa ni oyaye nii.” Shi gbalɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minyɛŋ misɛɛ maku ni mikɛ bo aya, ni asaŋ mi kɛ bo yeŋ nii, ni mi kɛ bo enuŋ nu yɛ biɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa wo mi kitã akɛ, kaaye nii, ni kaanu nɔ ko hu yɛ jɛi, asaŋ kaatsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛtee lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ nuumo ni jɛ Betel lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi hu gbalɔ ji mi tamɔ bo nɔŋŋ, ni Yehowa fã ebɔfo, ni ekɛ mi bawie akɛ, yaakpale lɛ ni okɛ lɛ aba shĩa koni ebaye nii ni enu nu.” Shi gbalɔ nuumo lɛ miimale.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ kɛ gbalɔ nuumo lɛ tee ni eyaye nii yɛ ewe lɛ, ni enu nii.
Be ni amɛtara okplɔ̃ lɛ he amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ gbalɔ nuumo lɛ ni yakpale Yuda gbalɔ lɛ kɛba lɛ nɔ, ni egba ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ni jɛ Yuda eba lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛni obooo Yehowa wiemɔ toi, ni oyeee kitã ni Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wo bo lɛ nɔ,’ ni oku osɛɛ oba obaye nii, ni onu nii, yɛ he ni ekɛɛ bo yɛ he akɛ, ‘Kaaye nii, ni kaanu nɔ ko hu yɛ jɛi,’ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni ogbonyo eyaŋ otsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ.” Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eye nii ni enu nii sɛɛ lɛ, gbalɔ nuumo lɛ wo teji lɛ nɔ nii ehã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ ni jɛ Yuda lɛ yiŋ etee; shi be ni eyaa lɛ jata ko kɛ lɛ bakpe ni egbe lɛ.
Egbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni teji lɛ kɛ jata lɛ damɔ emasɛi.
Mɛi komɛi ni batsɔ̃ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ na gbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni jata lɛ damɔ gbonyo lɛ masɛi.
Ni amɛba amɛbagba yɛ Betel maŋ lɛ mli he ni gbalɔ nuumo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Be ni gbalɔ nuumo lɛ ni yakpale lɛ kɛjɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ nu sane lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni yabooo Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ ni; no hewɔ ni Yehowa jie jata ewo ehe lɛ, ni etserɛ emli, ni egbe lɛ yɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie lɛ naa nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa teji nɔ nii nyɛhãa mi.” Ni amɛwo enɔ nii.
Kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ etee, ni eyana gbonyo lɛ kã gbɛ lɛ nɔ; teji lɛ kɛ jata lɛ damɔ gbonyo lɛ masɛi; jata lɛ yeko gbonyo lɛ, ni esaa etserɛko teji lɛ.
Gbalɔ nuumo lɛ wo Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ teji lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba emaŋ lɛ mli koni amɛbafo lɛ ni amɛfu lɛ.
Eto gbonyo lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu mli; ni amɛfo lɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo, minyɛmi nuu!” Agbɛnɛ be ni efu gbonyo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebii lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji migbo lɛ nyɛfua mi yɛ bu ni afu Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ yɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ mli; nyɛtoa miwui lɛ yɛ ewui lɛ amasɛi; ejaakɛ wiemɔi ni Yehowa fã lɛ koni ewie eshi afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ Betel lɛ kɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria maji lɛ anɔ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ baaba mli kɛ̃.” Esha kpele ni Yeroboam fee lɛ Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam efɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋ ni efeɔ lɛ feemɔ, shi moŋ eŋɔ mɛi komɛi kɛkɛ, ni ewo amɛ hei grɔŋŋi jamɔhei lɛ osɔfoi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ eye osɔfo lɛ, ewoɔ lɛ osɔfo.
Nɛkɛ enifeemɔ nɛɛ batsɔ̃ esha kpele ehã Yeroboam we lɛ.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni hã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbee shi.
Yeroboam bi nuu gbele Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yeroboam bi Abia he baye.
Yeroboam kɛɛ eŋa akɛ, “Tee shi, tsakemɔ ohe koni akayoo bo akɛ bo ji Yeroboam ŋa lɛ; yaa Shilo, ejaakɛ gbalɔ Ahia ni wie yɛ mihe akɛ mibaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel lɛ jɛi eyɔɔ.
Oŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔi nyɔŋma kɛ keeki kɛ wo atuŋkpã kome ohiɛ odɛ̃ kɛya eŋɔɔ.
Yaabi lɛ nɔ ni baaba gbekɛ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni ebaagba bo.” Yeroboam ŋa lɛ fee nakai, ni etee Shilo, ni eba Ahia we lɛ.
Shi Ahia enaaa nii, ejaakɛ gbɔlɛ ehã ehiŋmɛii anɔ eha.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ Ahia akɛ, “Naa, Yeroboam ŋa lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ ebabi nii yɛ ebi nuu lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ lɛ he miiye.
Kɛji eba lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.” Be ni Yeroboam ŋa lɛ bashɛ jɛi lɛ, etsake ehe tamɔ yoo kroko.
Shi be ni eshɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni Ahia nu enaneshi gbɛɛmɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ba mli, Yeroboam ŋa!
Mɛɛba otsake ohe tamɔ mɔ kroko nɛɛ?
Naa, atsu mi oŋɔɔ kɛ sane ko ni wa.
Yaa, ni oyakɛɛ Yeroboam akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mikɔ bo pɛ yɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ, ni miwo bo maŋtsɛ.
Mishɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tete yɛ David we lɛ dɛŋ mihã bo; shi kɛ̃lɛ otamɔɔɔ mitsulɔ David ni eye mikitãi anɔ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ kɛ etsui fɛɛ lɛ.
Efee nɔ ni sa sɔŋŋ yɛ mihiɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ofee efɔŋ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ohiɛ lɛ.
Oto oyiŋ, ni oyafee nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi kɛ amãgãi ni ashwie ohã ohe, ni okɛwo mimli la; ni mi lɛ oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ osɛɛ kwa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã sane fɔŋ aye Yereboam we lɛ.
Maplene Yereboam we lɛ mli nuu fɛɛ nuu hiɛ yɛ Israel: nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ.
Makpãtã Yeroboam we lɛ hiɛ kwraa tamɔ abɛɔ wamɔ, ni awoɔ mli la yɛ tumo nɔ ashãa kɛyashiɔ beyinɔ ni fɛɛ shãa wɛɛ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Yeroboam nɔ mli ni aaagbo lɛ gbei aaaye lɛ, ni kɛji emɔ ko gbo yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ akpãŋai baaye lɛ, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Ahia tee nɔ ekɛɛ Yeroboam ŋa lɛ akɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ oya owe.
Onane ni aaayi omaŋ lɛ mli pɛ, obi lɛ baagbo.
Israel fɛɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaafu lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ pɛ ejɛ Yeroboam we lɛ mli ni aaafu lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ pɛ emli ana nɔ kpakpa ko yɛ yɛ Yeroboam we lɛ ni sa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Asaŋ Yehowa baatee maŋtsɛ ko shi ahã ehe yɛ Israel, mɔ ni baakpãtã Yeroboam we lɛ hiɛ ŋmɛnɛ, amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.
Yehowa aaatswia Israel nii, tamɔ ahosoɔ glã yɛ faa mli lɛ, ni eeefã Israel kɛjɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni ekɛhã etsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa baagbɛ amɛ eshwã Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfee Ashera wɔŋ lɛ amãgãi, ni amɛkɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Yehowa baakwa Israel yɛ eshai ni Yeroboam fee lɛ hewɔ, yɛ eshai ni ekɛhã Israel fɛɛ fee lɛ hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeroboam ŋa lɛ te shi, ni eyi mli etee Tirza.
Be ni eshɛ shĩa lɛ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ lɛ gbo.
Israel fɛɛ fo lɛ, ni amɛfu lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ etsulɔ gbalɔ Ahia nɔ lɛ.
Yeroboam Gbele Agbɛnɛ Yeroboam he saji fɛɛ, nii ni efee, bɔ ni ewu tai kɛ bɔ ni eye maŋtsɛ ehã lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yeroboam ye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Egbo, ni afu lɛ, ni ebi Nadab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam Solomon bi Rehoboam ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda.
Rehoboam eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Yerusalɛm nɛɛ ji maŋ ni Yehowa kɔ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ jɛi aja lɛ yɛ.
Rehoboam nyɛ gbɛi ji Naama, ni Amonyoo ji lɛ.
Yudabii lɛ fee esha shi Yehowa, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe eshai ni amɛfee lɛ hã Yehowa ye awuŋã.
Eshai ni amɛfee lɛ fa kwraa fe nii ni amɛblematsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛmãmɔ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi amɛhã amɛhe; amɛkɛ tɛi mãmɔ shiui kɛ Ashera amãgãi, ni amɛjaa yɛ gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi.
Nɔ ni fe fɛɛ ji akɛ, hii kɛ yei yɛ jɛi ni kɛ amɛhe bɔɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jamɔhei lɛ.
Yudabii lɛ fee hiɛgbejianii ni jeŋmaji abii ni Yehowa shwie yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ fee lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Shishak fã ta ebatua Yerusalɛm.
Ebaloo Yehowa we lɛ mli jwetri lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli jwetri lɛ; eloo fɛɛ kwa kɛtee.
Esaa eloo shika tsɛŋi lɛ ni Solomon fee lɛ kɛtee.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Rehoboam hã afee akɔɔble tsɛŋi eto najiaŋ, ni etu fɛɛ ewo bulɔi ni buɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ.
Be fɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yaa Yehowa we lɛ bulɔi lɛ hiɛɔ tsɛŋi lɛ, ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ amɛkɛkuɔ sɛɛ amɛkɛyatoɔ bulɔi lɛ atsu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Rehoboam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Nakai bei lɛ amli fɛɛ lɛ Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam kɛ amɛhe wu ta be fɛɛ be.
Rehoboam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe ni yɔɔ David maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Naama, Amonyoo lɛ.
Ni ebi Abia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Abia Be ni Nebat bi Yeroboam eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ Israel lɛ, no mli Abia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Maaka, Abishalom biyoo lɛ.
Eshai ni etsɛ fee kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ lɛ hu efee, ni eyeee Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ David ye anɔkwa lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ David hewɔ lɛ Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hã Abia binuu ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm koni ehã Yerusalɛm ahi shi shweshweeshwe.
Yehowa fee enɛ, ejaakɛ David fee nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, ni egbaaa afã yɛ kitãi ni ewo lɛ lɛ eko eko he ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ, akɛ ja yɛ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, sane lɛ mli pɛ.
Ta ni te shi yɛ Rehoboam kɛ Yeroboam teŋ lɛ tsa nɔ aahu yɛ Abia maŋtsɛyeli beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Abia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Abia gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli, ni ebi Asa baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa Be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Israel sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli Asa bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enaa gbɛi ji Maaka, Abishalom biyoo lɛ.
Asa fee nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛ David fee lɛ.
Eshwie hii kɛ yei fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛhe bɔɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jamɔhei lɛ fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejie amãgãi ni etsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Asa kpa enyɛ Maaka tete maŋnyɛyeli; ejaakɛ enyɛ nɛɛ fee Ashera amãgã ko ni eji nihii nii.
Asa folɔ tso amãgã lɛ mli, ni eyashã yɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Yɛ mli akɛ Asa fiteee jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eye Yehowa anɔkwa ewala bei abɔ fɛɛ.
Nibii fɛɛ ni etsɛ Abia fee, kɛ nii ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu efee ni atsuu he yɛ tsuijurɔ naa ahã Yehowa lɛ, eyaloo kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ: jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsɛnsii fɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha Maŋtsɛyeli beiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ ta kã amɛteŋ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha fã ta kɛbatua Yuda, ni eŋɔ Rama.
Kɛkɛ ni etswa gbogbo ewo Rama he bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akaje kpo kɛmiiya Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa ŋɔɔ aloo eeje eŋɔɔ kɛmiiba.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Asa loo shika fɛɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Yehowa We lɛ nitoohe lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ nitoohe lɛ hu; etu ewo etsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni etsu amɛ kɛtee Damasko koni akɛyahã Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad, Tabrimon bi, ni eji Hezion nabi lɛ.
Wiemɔ ni fata he ji: “Hã kpãŋmɔ ko akã mi kɛ bo teŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ekã mitsɛ kɛ otsɛ teŋ lɛ.
Naa, miimaje jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika nikeenii.
Yaa ni oyaku kpãŋmɔ ni kã okɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha teŋ lɛ mli, koni ejie etabilɔi lɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ben-Hadad kpɛlɛ̃ Maŋtsɛ Asa wiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etsu etatsɛmɛi kɛtee ni amɛyatua Israel maji lɛ.
Tatsɛmɛi lɛ ŋɔ maji nɛɛ: Yion kɛ Dan kɛ Abel-Bet-Maaka kɛ shikpɔŋ ni bɛŋkɛ Galilea kpaakpo lɛ kɛ Naftali kpokpai anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Baasha nu nɔ ni eba lɛ he lɛ, efɔ̃ɔ gbogbo lɛ tswaa kɛ Rama he woo, ni etee eyahi shi yɛ Tirza.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Asa hã ashiɛ yɛ Yuda fɛɛ, ashiii mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ mli.
Maŋbii lɛ tee Rama ni amɛyaloo Rama tɛi lɛ kɛ mplaŋi lɛ ni Baasha kɛtswaa gbogbo ewo Rama he lɛ kɛba.
Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ yawaje Geba, ni yɔɔ Benyamin kpokpai anɔ lɛ kɛ Mizpa.
Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Asa he saji fɛɛ ni eshwɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee, kɛ nii fɛɛ kɛ maji ni ewajewaje lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Asaji Awolo lɛ mli.
Shi egbɔlɛ be mli lɛ, nane hela ko kumɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Asa gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ yɛ eblematsɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni ebinuu Yehoshafat baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Nadab Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa eye afii enyɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam bi Nadab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel afii enyɔ.
Efee efɔŋ tamɔ etsɛ ni nyiɛ ehiɛ lɛ fee ni ekɛhã Israel fee esha lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Ahia ni jɛ Isakar akutso lɛ mli lɛ binuu Baasha kpãŋ Nadab yinɔ, ni etswa Nadab nɔ ni egbe lɛ.
No bei amli lɛ Nadab kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ eyasa Gibeton ni yɔɔ Filistia lɛ yi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Baasha gbe Nadab be ni Asa eye maŋtsɛ afii etɛ̃ yɛ Yuda.
Kɛkɛ ni lɛ Baasha lɛ ebaye Nadab sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Baasha baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, egbe Yeroboam we lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwɛɛɛ ni muɔ tete yɛ Yeroboam we lɛ.
Efee enɛ koni wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie kɛtsɔ̃ etsulɔ Ahia, Shilonyo lɛ, nɔ lɛ aba mli.
Eba mli nɛkɛ ejaakɛ Yeroboam fee eshai eshi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ no hã Israel fɛɛ hu fee esha kɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Agbɛnɛ Nadab he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni ta kã Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha teŋ amɛwala beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa ye afii etɛ̃ yɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli Ahia bi Baasha babɔ̃i Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Tirza; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; eba ejeŋ gbonyo tamɔ Yeroboam ni hã Israel fɛɛ fee esha lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ Hanani bi Yehu wie, ni ekɛ shɛɛ nɛɛ hã lɛ akɛ ekɛyahã Israel Maŋtsɛ Baasha: “Kulɛ ojeee mɔ ko, shi miwo onɔ kɛjɛ mlu mli, ni mifee bo lumɔ kɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ yɛ mimaŋ Israel.
Oyakɔ Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ, ni ohã mimaŋ Israel fee esha, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ wo mimli la.
Hewɔ lɛ mibabɛɛ Baasha kɛ ewe lɛ mashwie, ni mibafee ewe lɛ tamɔ mifee Nebat bi Yeroboam we lɛ lɛ.
Baasha wekunyo fɛɛ wekunyo ni aaagbo yɛ maŋ lɛ, gbei aaaye egbonyo lɛ; ni ewekunyo ni aaagbo yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi loofɔji aaaye eloo.” Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Baasha fee kɛ ekãa nibii hu ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Baasha gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Tirza; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ela baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛshiɔ Baasha kɛ ewe lɛ akɛtsɔ̃ Hanani bi Yehu nɔ, yɛ eshai ni Baasha fee eshi Yehowa lɛ ahewɔ.
Baasha wo Yehowa mli la, jeee yɛ nibii fɔ̃ji ni efee, tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam efee kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ momo lɛ kɛkɛ ahewɔ, shi moŋ akɛ egbe Yeroboam we lɛ mlibii fɛɛ lɛ.
Ela ye Israel Maŋtsɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Baasha musuŋ binuu Ela bɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Tirza.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ.
Shi etsulɔ Zimri, etayaa shwiili lɛ amlijaa fã kome ko nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ, kpãŋ eyinɔ.
Gbi ko be ni Maŋtsɛ Ela etɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ yɛ etsulɔ Arza, mɔ ni kwɛɔ Tirza maŋtsɛwe lɛ nɔ lɛ we lɛ mli lɛ, Zimri bote Arza we lɛ mli, ni eyatswa Maŋtsɛ Ela nɔ, ni egbe lɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ sane nɛɛ ba.
Kɛkɛ ni Zimri baye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Ela sɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni shɛ Zimri dɛŋ nɔŋŋ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni egbe Baasha we lɛ mlibii fɛɛ, eshiii Baasha we lɛ mli nuu kome nɛkɛ; egbe kɛ Baasha nanemɛi tete hu.
Belɛ Zimri kpãtã Baasha we lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm hiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ gbalɔ Yehu nɔ ewie eshi Baasha, yɛ eshai fɛɛ ni Baasha fee kɛ eshai ni ebi Ela hu fee, ni amɛkɛhã Israel fee esha, ni amɛkɛ amãgãjamɔ wo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la lɛ hewɔ.
Nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni Ela fee kɛ ehe saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Zimri Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zimri bata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ Tirza.
Eye maŋtsɛ gbii kpawo.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Israel tabilɔi esa Filistibii amaŋ Gibeton lɛ yi.
Gbi ni tabilɔi lɛ nu akɛ Zimri etee Maŋtsɛ Ela yinɔ apam, ni egbe lɛ lɛ, Israel tso muu fɛɛ wo Omri ni ji tabilɔi lɛ atsɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ ta lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Omri fã kɛjɛ Gibeton kɛba ni Israel fɛɛ fata ehe, ni amɛbasa Tirza yi.
Be ni Zimri na akɛ aŋɔ maŋ lɛ, eyabote maŋtsɛwe lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli kɛkɛ ni ema maŋtsɛwe lɛ naa la, ni eshã shĩa lɛ eshwie enɔ, ni egbo.
Egbo yɛ eshai ni efee, kɛ efɔŋ ni efee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ ni ekɔ efɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔ, asaŋ kɛ efɔŋ ni efee ni ekɛhã Israel hu fee esha lɛ hewɔ.
Nibii krokomɛi ni Zimri fee kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ela yinɔ apam ni etee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Omri Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋ lɛ mli gba enyɔ; maŋ lɛ fã kome yɛ Ginat bi Tibni lɛ sɛɛ akɛ lɛ eye maŋtsɛ, ni fã hu yɛ Omri sɛɛ.
Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ Omri sɛɛ lɛ ye mɛi ni yɔɔ Ginat bi Tibni lɛ sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kunim.
Tibni nyɔ, ni Omri baye maŋtsɛ, yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Omri ye Israel maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Eye maŋtsɛ lɛ afii ekpaa yɛ Tirza.
Samaria tsɔ̃ Israel Maŋtsɛ maŋ Omri tse jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpei ekpaa, ni ekɛhe Samaria gɔŋ lɛ yɛ mɔ ko ni egbɛi ji Shemer lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Omri to maŋ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ewo maŋ lɛ Samaria, yɛ gɔŋ lɛ tsɛ Shemer gbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Ewaje maŋ lɛ.
Omri fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ.
Efee esha fe maŋtsɛmɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ ebakɔ Nebat bi Yeroboam jeŋba lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ehã maŋbii lɛ bote eshafeemɔ kɛ amãgãjamɔ mli, nifeemɔ ni woɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli la lɛ.
Omri he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni efee, kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Omri gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ahab baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Ahab ye Israel Maŋtsɛ Ato Omri bi Ahab maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Asa maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Ahab ye Israel maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Omri bi Ahab fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ fe maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ.
Akɛni eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee lɛ jeee fɛifɛi yɛ Ahab hiɛ hewɔ lɛ, etee nɔ, ni eyaŋɔ Sidonbii amaŋtsɛ Etbaal biyoo Yezebel lɛ akɛ ŋa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Ahab tee ni eyaja, ni esɔ̃mɔ Baal.
Emã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ehã Baal.
No sɛɛ hu eshɔ̃ jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera lɛ amãgã ema shi.
Ahab wo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la waa fe Israel maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛho.
Ahab yinɔ ni Hiel, Betelnyo lɛ, yasaa etswa Yeriko maŋ lɛ mli tsui koikoi lɛ.
Hiel kromɔbi ni egbɛi ji Abiram lɛ nyɔ yɛ Yeriko saamɔ lɛ shishitoo mli, ni ebi sɛɛkpelɔ Segub hu nyɔ be mli ni ataraa maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ.
Sane nɛɛ ba mli nɛkɛ taakɛ Yehowa etsɔ̃ Nunbi Yoshua nɔ egba eto momo lɛ.
Elia gba akɛ abaaye nuhɔmɔ Gbalɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Elia, Tishbinyo ni ejɛ Gilead, lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo, yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli akɛ bɔ enyɔŋ, ni nu hu enɛŋ kɛyashi biɛ afii enyɔ loo afii etɛ̃, bɛja mi, miwie dã.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Shi biɛ nɛɛ koni oya bokãgbɛ oyatee ohe yɛ Kerit faa nine lɛ masɛi yɛ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Obaana faa nine lɛ mli nu onu, ni mifã kwãakwãalabitei koni amɛlɛ bo yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Elia ye Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ nɔ: eyi mli, ni etee eyahi Kerit faa nine lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ he.
Kwãakwãalabitei lɛ yahãa lɛ aboloo kɛ loo daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, ni faa lɛ mli nu lɛ ji nu ni enuɔ.
Shi be ko sɛɛ lɛ, faa lɛ baŋala, ejaakɛ nu enɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Elia kɛ Zarefat Okulafo lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa Zarefat, Sidonbii amaŋ lɛ mli, koni oyahi jɛi.
Mifã yoo okulafo ko koni elɛ bo yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Elia yi mli, ni etee Zarefat.
Be ni eshɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, ena yoo okulafo ko yɛ jɛi ni eebua lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii anaa.
Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni ohã mi nu fioo manu.” Be ni yoo lɛ yaa koni eyayɛ nu lɛ, Elia tsɛ eyisɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ ni oŋɔ aboloo atrɔma ko ohiɛ odɛ̃ obahã mi.” Yoo okulafo lɛ to he akɛ, “Mina Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ mibɛ aboloo kuku nɛkɛ.
Nɔ pɛ ni miyɔɔ ji mamu dɛ̃ kɔkɔ obɔ̃ kome pɛ yɛ gbɛ mli, kɛ mu fioo yɛ tɔ mli.
Miilɛ lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii enyɔ oo ko koni mikɛyashã aboloo mahã mi kɛ mibi lɛ koni wɔye; no sɛɛ lɛ wɔɔgboi kɛ hɔmɔ.” Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei!
Yaa koni oyafee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ.
Shi moŋ ŋɔɔ mamu lɛ eko okɛshã aboloo fioo ko obahã mi tsuutsu dã; no sɛɛ dani ofee bo kɛ obi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mamu kɛ gbɛ lɛ etaŋ, ni mu kɛ tɔ lɛ hu etaŋ aahu kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni Yehowa aaahã nu abanɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” Yoo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafee bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ ni Elia kɛɛ lɛ lɛ; ni Elia kɛ yoo lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ na nii amɛye gbii kplaŋŋ.
Taakɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mamu kɛ gbɛ lɛ etãaa, ni mu kɛ tɔ lɛ hu etãaa.
Elia tsiɛ̃ Okulafo lɛ Binuu hiɛ Nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, yoo lɛ ni ji shĩanyɛ lɛ, binuu lɛ he baye; ehela lɛ mli wo wu, ni naagbee lɛ egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Ao Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, mɛni mifee bo!
Obato mi koni akai efɔŋ ni mifee, koni agbe mibinuu lɛ lo?” Elia kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ obi lɛ ahã mi!” Elia he gbekɛ lɛ yɛ yoo lɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ; kɛkɛ ni ehiɛ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi tsu lɛ mli he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ gbekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esaa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia bo etsɛ Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ!
Aso yoo okulafo ni mibato eŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu okɛyeɔ sane kɛ joomɔ nɛkɛ, ni ogbeɔ ebi lɛ nɛɛ?” Elia ho ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ shii etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni ebo waa etsɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ!
Miikpa bo fai; hã gbekɛ nɛɛ mumɔ akpale aba emli ekoŋŋ koni ehiɛ atsɛ̃!” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bo Elia faikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni gbekɛ lɛ mumɔ kpale kɛba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ehiɛ tsɛ̃.
Agbɛnɛ Elia wo gbekɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tsu lɛ mli kɛba shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ bahã enyɛ lɛ; ni Elia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa obi lɛ; eyi ena wala.” Yoo lɛ here Elia nɔ ekɛɛ, “Kpaako mina mile akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji bo lɛɛlɛŋ, ni asaŋ Yehowa wieɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ onɔ!”
Elia kɛ Ahab kpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ Be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, yɛ nuhɔmɔ lɛ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Elia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ Ahab, ni mahã nu anɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Elia yi mli etee koni ekɛ ehe ayatsɔ̃ɔ Ahab.
Hɔmɔ lɛ naa wa naakpa yɛ Samaria.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Obadia ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ nɔ.
Obadia ji gbɔmɔ ko ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei naakpa, ejaakɛ be ni Yezebel kpãtãa gbalɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, Obadia ŋɔ gbalɔi oha, ni ekɛ amɛ tee tɛkploi enyɔ amli, mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ, ni ekɛ aboloo kɛ nu lɛ amɛ.
Ahab kɛɛ Obadia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ ni nuhiŋmɛii kɛ jɔi yɔɔ akɛ eko lɛ wɔɔna jwɛi yɛ he ko koni wɔkɛhere okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayiwala, koni shĩa kooloi fɛɛ akaŋmɛɛ wɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛ Obadia ja shikpɔŋ lɛ mli enyɔ amɛhã amɛhe, koni amɛyakpa nɔ kɛho.
Be ni Obadia nyiɛ gbɛ eyaa lɛ, ekɛ Elia yakpe trukaa.
Be ni Obadia yoo Elia lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo, minuŋtsɔ Elia, nɛ?” Elia here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mi ni!
Yaa koni oyakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, Naa, Elia yɛ biɛ!” Obadia to he akɛ, “Mɛɛ efɔŋ mifee hewɔ ni okɛ otsulɔ woɔ nɛkɛ haomɔ mli nɛɛ?
Mina Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ maŋ ko maŋ ko loo nɔyelihe ko nɔyelihe ko kwraa bɛ jeŋ ni minuŋtsɔ tsuko kɛyako jɛi akɛ ayatao bo ahã lɛ.
Kɛji he ko bii kɛ wiemɔ ba akɛ, ‘Ebɛ biɛ lɛ,’ ehãa nakai maŋtsɛyeli loo maŋ lɛ kãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛnako bo lɛɛlɛŋ.
