Shi ŋmɛnɛ, naa bo ni ookɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ akɛ, naa, Elia yɛ biɛ.’ Amrɔ pɛ ni mibashi bo matee lɛ, Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ aaabakpla bo kɛya he ko ni mileee.
Kɛji mitee miyakɛɛ Ahab, ni eba, ni ebaninaaa bo lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, ebaagbe mi.
Kaimɔ akɛ Yehowa jalɔ ji otsulɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe.
Ani agbako minuŋtsɔ nɔ ni mifee be ni Yezebel gbe Yehowa gbalɔi lɛ, bɔ ni miŋɔ gbalɔi oha mitee tɛkploi amli, nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔ, ni milɛ amɛ kɛ aboloo kɛ nu lɛ?
Ni agbɛnɛ ŋmɛnɛ ookɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa ni oyakɛɛ onuŋtsɔ akɛ, naa, Elia yɛ biɛ.’ Ebaagbe mi!” Elia hã hetoo ekɛɛ, “Mina Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ, Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛ mihe baatsɔ̃ɔ Ahab ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Obadia yi mli etee, ni eyabɔ Ahab amaniɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahab yiŋ koni ekɛ Elia ayakpe.
Be ni Ahab na Elia lɛ, Ahab kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo Israel haolɔ lɛ, bo nɛ?” Elia to he ekɛɛ, “Mihaoko Israel!
Bo kɛ otsɛ we lɛ moŋ ni ehao Israel, ejaakɛ nyɛkwa Yehowa kitãi lɛ, ni nyɛtee nyɛmiija Baal moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ tsu koni ayabua Israel fɛɛ naa abahã mi yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ: Baal gbalɔi ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛ Ashera gbalɔi ohai ejwɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nii yɛ Yezebel okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ hu fɛɛ aba.” Elia ye Baal gbalɔi lɛ anɔ kunim No hewɔ lɛ, Ahab tsu atee, ni ayatsɛ Israelbii fɛɛ kɛba; asaŋ ebua gbalɔi lɛ hu anaa kɛbakpe yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia tsi ebɛŋkɛ asafo muu ni ewo shi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛyiŋ aaafee nyɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛyashi yɛ saji enyɔ nɛɛ ahe?
Kɛji Yehowa ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ, ni kɛji Baal ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nyɛjaa lɛ.” Shi maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko etswaaa esɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Mi, mi koome too pɛ ji Yehowa gbalɔ ni eshwɛ, shi Baal gbalɔi lɛ ayibɔ ji hii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Abahã wɔ tsinahii enyɔ.
Baal webii lɛ amɔ tsinai lɛ ateŋ ekome, nɔ ni amɛ amɛsumɔɔ amɛhã amɛhe; amɛgbe tsina lɛ koni amɛfolɔ emli dukuduku, ni amɛkɛ loo lɛ ashwie lai nɔ; shi moŋ amɛkawo eshishi la.
Mi hu masaa tsinanuu kome lɛ, koni mikɛ eloo lɛ ashwie lai nɔ; ni mi hu miwoŋ minɔ lɛ shishi la.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nyɛsɔlea nyɛtsɛa nyɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masɔle matsɛ Yehowa; amɛteŋ mɔ ni kɛ la baahere tsɛmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.” Maŋbii lɛ here nɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Eja nakai!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Baal gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɔa tsinahii lɛ ateŋ ekome nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni nyɛ tsuutsu nyɛsaa nyɛkooloo lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛyi fa; no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛsɔlea kɛtsɛa nyɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛkasɔa lai lɛ naa la.” No hewɔ lɛ, Baal gbalɔi lɛ mɔ tsinanuu ni akɛhã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa, ni amɛsɔle kɛ blɔmɔ amɛtsɛ Baal kɛjɛ leebileebi aahu kɛyashi shwane fintiŋŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Baal, heremɔ wɔ nɔ!” Amɛtumɔ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni amɛmã lɛ, shi anuuu gbee ko lɛ, nɔheremɔ ko hu jɛɛɛ he ko baaa.
Shwane mli lɛ Elia ye Baal gbalɔi lɛ ahe fɛo, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛbolɔa waa, ejaakɛ nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ!
Eko lɛ benɛ eeshwie eyiŋ, aloo eje kpo, aloo edom, aloo eko lɛ ewɔ koni ehiɛ atsɛ̃.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbalɔi lɛ bolɔ waa fe tsuutsu lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kakla kɛ klante folɔflɔɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛkusum naa kɛyashi lá bɔ̃i hoo yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛtee nɔ kɛ blɔmɔ hoo lɛ kɛyashi eshɛ shwane niyenii afɔleshãa be; shi fɛɛ lɛ gbee ko ejijeee lɛ, hetoo ko baaa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi.” Maŋ lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia saa Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ ni ekumɔ lɛ.
Elia kɔlɔ tɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, yɛ Yakob, mɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Abaatsɛ bo Israel” lɛ bii lɛ akutsei lɛ ayikulɛ naa, ni ekɛ tɛi lɛ mã afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.
No sɛɛ lɛ, etsa bu ni baaye nu litai nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kpula.
Kɛkɛ ni eto lai lɛ eshwie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni efolɔ tsinanuu lɛ mli, ni ekɛshwie lai lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛa nu gbɛi obɔ̃bɔ̃i ejwɛ nyɛbashwiea shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ lai lɛ nɔ.” Be ni afee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, Elia saa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa etĩaa shii enyɔ.” Ahã nu lɛ tĩa shii enyɔ lɛ, shi Elia kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa etĩaa shii etɛ̃.” Ahã nu lɛ tĩa shii etɛ̃ lɛ.
Nu lɛ tsere kɛnyiɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he kɛbote latɛ lɛ he bu lɛ mli; bu lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ nu lɛ.
Shwane niyenii afɔle be lɛ, Gbalɔ Elia tsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “Ao Yehowa, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, hã ana ale ŋmɛnɛ akɛ bo ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, asaŋ akɛ bo otsulɔ ji mi, ni owiemɔ naa mifeɔ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ.
Heremɔ mi nɔ!
Ao Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, koni maŋ nɛɛ kɛna ale akɛ bo, Yehowa, ji Nyɔŋmɔ; ni asaŋ akɛ bo nɔŋŋ oŋɔɔ amɛtsuii ekpale kɛba ekoŋŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hã la gba kɛbabote afɔle lɛ mli, ni eshã afɔle lɛ kɛ lai lɛ kɛ tɛi lɛ kɛ su lɛ, ni nu lɛ tete ni yɔɔ bu ni bɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli lɛ ŋala wɛɛ.
Be ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ bumɔ shi, ni amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ!
Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia fã maŋbii lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛmɔmɔa Baal gbalɔi lɛ; akahã amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛkɛ miijo foi!” Amɔmɔ Baal gbalɔi lɛ, ni Elia ŋɔ amɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛtee Kishon Faa lɛ naa, ni eyagbe amɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nuhɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ fo Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa koni oyaye nii ni onu nɔ ko ejaakɛ minu nugbɔ shiimɔ he kɛmiiba.” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab yi mli etee koni eyaye nii, asaŋ ni enu nɔ ko; shi Elia kwɔ kɛtee Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ; edɔ emli, ni ekɛ eyitso hɔ enakutsei ateŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɔɔ kɛya gɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni okwɛ ŋshɔŋgbɛ.” Tsulɔ lɛ tee eba, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ.
“Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ jɛi gbɛ.” Elia kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa shii kpawo ni oyakwɛ.” Shii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Naa, atatu bibioo ko ni edaaa fe gbɔmɔ nine miite shi kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yaakɛɛ Ahab akɛ, ‘Saamɔ otayaa shwiili lɛ koni okpeleke shi koni nu lɛ akatsi onaa.’ ” Yeee be ko nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni ŋwɛi dĩ tũu kɛ atatui; kɔɔyɔɔ fã; nu nɛ tsoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ahab fã kɛ tayaa shwiili kɛtee Yezreel.
Shi Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi Elia nɔ; kɛkɛ ni emĩa, ni ewo foi kɛyi Ahab hiɛ kɛtee Yezreel tɔ̃ɔ.
Elia jo Yezebel naa foi Ahab bagba eŋa Yezebel nibii fɛɛ ni Elia efee lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ ekɛ klante gbe gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel tsu bɔfo kɛtee Elia ŋɔɔ ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ atswa mi nɔ koni magbo kɛji wɔ benɛ yinɔ lɛ mifeko bo bɔ ni ofee gbalɔi lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Elia she gbeyei, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ete shi, ni ejo foi koni ehere esusuma yiwala.
Etee Beersheba yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eshi etsulɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni ekome enyiɛ gbi kome jenamɔ gbɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Eyata shi yɛ tso kusuu ko shishi, ni ebɔ̃i gbele shwee.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, efa agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ mihiii fe mitsɛmɛi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni eho ekã tso kusuu lɛ shishi, ni ewɔ.
Trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo ko bata ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi koni oye nii!” Elia kwɛ ehe, ni ena aboloo ni ashã yɛ tɛi ni edɔ anɔ kɛ kpulu kɛ nu ma eyitsogbɛ.
Eye nii lɛ, ni enu nu lɛ, kɛkɛ ni eho ekã shi ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ; ebata ehe, ni ekɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Tee shi ni oye nii, kɛjeee nakai lɛ, gbɛfãa lɛ baadɛŋ bo tsɔ̃.” Kɛkɛ ni Elia te shi, ni eye nii, ni enu nu eshwie nɔ.
Niyenii nɛɛ mli hewalɛ lɛ ji nɔ ni hã enyɛ enyiɛ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ Horeb lɛ he.
Eyashɛ tɛkplo ko he yɛ jɛi, ni ewɔ jɛi nakai gbi lɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ.
Trukaa lɛ Yehowa bi lɛ yɛ jɛi akɛ, “Elia, mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ?” Elia to he ekɛɛ, “Miye Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, he awuŋã kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ekwa Bo kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klante egbe ogbalɔi lɛ hu, ni mi, mi pɛ eshwɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi hu amɛgbe.” Elia kɛ Yehowa kpe yɛ Horeb Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Jee kpo koni oyadamɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa baaho.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa baho: ahum ni naa wa ko tswa, ni egbala gɔji, ni ejwra tɛsai kɛnyiɛ Yehowa hiɛ; shi Yehowa bɛ ahum lɛ mli.
Ahum lɛ sɛɛ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso, shi Yehowa bɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ lɛ mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ hosomɔ sɛɛ lɛ, la je; shi Yehowa bɛ la lɛ mli; ni la lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ nyrakee ko gbɛɛ kɛho.
Be ni Elia nu gbɛɛmɔ nyrakee lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ hɔ etade yuu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo, ni eyadamɔ tɛkplo lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko bi lɛ akɛ, “Elia, mɛni ofeɔ yɛ biɛ?” Elia jie enaa ekɛɛ, “Miye Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, he awuŋã kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ekwa Bo kɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klante egbe ogbalɔi lɛ hu ni mi pɛ eshwɛ, ni amɛmiitao mi hu amɛgbe.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia akɛ.
“Kuu osɛɛ ni oya Damasko ŋa lɛ nɔ; otsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli, koni ofɔ Hazael mu okɛwo lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ofɔ Nimshi bi Yehu hu mu okɛwo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ, asaŋ ofɔ Shafat ni jɛ Abel-Mehola lɛ bi Elisha lɛ mu kɛwo lɛ gbalɔ, mɔ ni baaye onajiaŋ.
Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaje Hazael klante naa gbele mli lɛ, Yehu baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni baaje Yehu klante naa gbele mli lɛ, Elisha baagbe lɛ.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mashwɛ hiɛkãalɔi akpei kpawo yɛ Israel, mɛi fɛɛ ni kulako shi amɛjako amãgã Baal kɛ mɛi hu ni shɔko amãgã lɛ naa lɛ.” Elisha tsɛmɔ Elia shi jɛi; eyanina Shafat bi Elisha ni eekwɛ tsinai ntai ni miihu nɔ.
Tsinai ntai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nyiɛ ehiɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ naagbee tsinai nta lɛ miihu.
Be ni Elia hoɔ Elisha he lɛ, ejie etade yuu ni ewo lɛ, ni ekɛwo Elisha.
Elisha shi tsinai lɛ, ni esha foi kɛyi Elia sɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã maya koni mayashɔ mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ naa koni mikɛ amɛ aye shɛɛ dani mabanyiɛ osɛɛ.” Elia to he ekɛɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ koni oya, shi moŋ ohiɛ ahi nɔ ni mifee bo lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha ku esɛɛ, ni eyamɔmɔ tsinai nta ni ekɛhuɔ lɛ, ni egbe amɛ, ni ekɛ tsinai lɛ akuɛŋtsei lɛ fee lai, ni ekɛhoo amɛloo lɛ.
Ekɛ loo lɛ hã maŋbii ni ekɛ amɛ tsuɔ nii lɛ, ni amɛye.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee, ni eyanyiɛ Elia sɛɛ akɛ etsulɔ.
Ta ba Israel kɛ Siria teŋ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua etabilɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkpe.
Ena maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ krokomɛi hu kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shiwiilii fata ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni efã kɛba, ni ebawo Samaria maŋ lɛ he ka, ni eyatua maŋ lɛ.
Etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli, ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad kɛɛ oŋɔ ojwiɛtɛi kɛ oshika kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ obii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ obahã lɛ akɛ enɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab to he ekɛɛ.
“Nyɛyakɛa minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad akɛ mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ebaanyɛ ebaŋɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hu ni miyɔɔ.” Bɔfoi lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbakɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Naa bɔ ni Ben-Hadad kɛɛ, mitsu aba oŋɔɔ akɛ oŋɔ ojwiɛtɛi kɛ oshika kɛ oŋamɛi kɛ obii lɛ ohã mi; kɛ̃lɛ wɔ nɛkɛ be mli lɛ, mibatsu mitsuji oŋɔɔ koni amɛbakpa owe lɛ kɛ otsuji lɛ awei lɛ amli, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aaasa amɛhiɛ lɛ, amɛŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃ kɛba.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab tsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛkwɛ lɛ nyɛbaana akɛ sane fɔŋ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ taoɔ ekɛye mi nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ etsu kɛba miŋɔɔ akɛ miŋɔ miŋamɛi kɛ mibii kɛ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika mihã lɛ, ni mikamãaa lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni onukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Kaafo mli, ni kaakpɛlɛ̃ hu.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ahab kɛɛ Ben-Hadad bɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ nibii fɛɛ hewɔ ni otsu otsulɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mibafee; shi enɛ lɛ minyɛŋ mafee.” Bɔfoi lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛyabɔ Ben-Hadad amaniɛ.
Ben-Hadad saa etsu Ahab ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛ tabilɔi bɔ ni sa baaa koni abakpãtã omaŋ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛloo emli mlu lɛ tete amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ̃ kɛya fĩi, no lɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ atswa mi nɔ amɛgbe mi.” Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ hã hetoo ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad akɛ, tabilɔ kpakpa lɛ, ta sɛɛ dani eshwãa, shi jeee be ni ajeko shishi.” Ben-Hadad nine shɛ Ahab shɛɛ lɛ nɔ be mli ni lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi ni fata ehe kɛfã ta lɛ miinu dãa yɛ amɛbuui lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni efã esɛɛ tabilɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛgbaa sa!” Ni amɛgba sa amɛwo maŋ lɛ he.
Nakai be mli nɔŋŋ ni gbalɔ ko ba Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ: ‘Te ona asafo kpekpeŋkpekpeŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ?
Naa, mibahã oye amɛnɔ kunim ŋmɛnɛ, koni ona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa.’ ” Ahab bi akɛ, “Namɔ baanyiɛ hiɛ kɛyatua amɛ?” Gbalɔ lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oblahiiabii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ kpokpai anɔ amralofoi lɛ ashishi lɛ ji mɛi ni anyiɛ hiɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab bi akɛ, “Namɔ baatsɛ ta lɛ?” Gbalɔ lɛ to he akɛ, “Bo ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Ahab bua oblahiiabii tabilɔi ni yɔɔ kpokpai anɔ amralofoi lɛ ashishi lɛ anaa.
Amɛyibɔ fee ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ.
Mɛi nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Ahab bua mɛi fɛɛ ni ji Israelbii lɛ anaa; amɛyibɔ fee akpei kpawo.
Israelbii ata lɛ fã shwane fintiŋŋ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Ben-Hadad kɛ ewalɔi maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ miitɔ dãa yɛ amɛbuui lɛ amli.
Amralofoi lɛ ashishi oblahiiabii tabilɔi lɛ tsutsu ni fã.
Saralɔi ni Ben-Hadad etsu sa lɛ babɔ lɛ amaniɛ akɛ, “Hii komɛi miiba kɛjɛ Samaria.” Ben-Hadad kɛɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ hewɔ amɛbaa jio, ta hewɔ amɛbaa jio, nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãalɔi.” Amralofoi lɛ ashishi oblahiiabii tabilɔi lɛ ni nyiɛ hiɛ, ni ta ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbe Siria tabilɔ ni ekɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii lɛ jo foi, be mli ni Israelbii lɛ miitiu amɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Shi Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad kɛ ekpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi komɛi ho tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛjo foi.
Maŋtsɛ Ahab je kpo kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa, ni ekpãtã Siria okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii lɛ ahiɛ; ekpãtã Siriabii lɛ ahiɛ butuu naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ tee Maŋtsɛ Ahab ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni oyasaa ohe oto.
Ojwɛŋ nɔ ni eba lɛ he, ejaakɛ wɔsɛɛ afi nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baaba ebatua bo.” Aye Siriabii anɔ kunim Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Israelbii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ gɔji anɔ nyɔŋmɔi ni, no hewɔ ni amɛnine tsɔ̃ wɔnɔ lɛ.
Shi hã wɔkɛ amɛ awu yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ, koni okwɛ akɛ wɔnine tsɔŋ amɛnɔ lo?
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni ofee nɛ: Tsakemɔ maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ tatsɛmɛi agbɛhei lɛ, koni okɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ato amɛnajiaŋ yɛ jɛi.
No sɛɛ lɛ, obua tabilɔi ni falɛ shɛɔ ta ni hiɛ kpãtã lɛ naa, kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii abɔ tamɔ tsutsu nibii lɛ afalɛ lɛ, koni wɔ kɛ Israelbii lɛ awu yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ, koni okwɛ akɛ wɔnine tsɔŋ amɛnɔ lo.” Ben-Hadad bo etsuji lɛ agbee toi, ni efee bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ.
Be ni eshɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, Ben-Hadad bua Siria tabilɔi anaa, kɛkɛ ni efã kɛba Afek koni ebatua Israelbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni abua Israelbii lɛ hu anaa.
Amɛtao niyenii amɛkɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛ hu amɛfã koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ ayakpe.
Israelbii lɛ yato shi kui enyɔ bɔ ni amɛmiikwɛ Siriabii lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Israelbii lɛ afalɛ tamɔ too kui bibii enyɔ; shi Siriabii lɛ eyi ŋa lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Gbalɔ ko yanina Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, akɛni Siriabii lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ gɔji anɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee jɔiaŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mibahã oye asafo kpekpeŋkpekpeŋ nɛɛ nɔ kunim, koni nyɛkɛna nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ.” Asafoi enyɔ lɛ jwere shi gbii kpawo bɔ ni mɔnɛ miikwɛ mɔnɛ hiɛ.
Gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, akɛ ta lɛ yakũa naa, ni Israelbii lɛ gbe Siria tabilɔi nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei oha gbi kome jenamɔ.
Siria tabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ jo foi kɛbote Afek maŋ lɛ mli; shi maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ wule eshwie tabilɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo nɔ.
Ben-Hadad jo foi kɛjɛ ta lɛ naa kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyatee ehe yɛ pia ko mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔna wɔnu akɛ Israel we lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi mɔbɔnalɔi ji amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã wɔkɔlɔ kpekpe wɔŋmɔlɔ wɔhɛ, koni wɔkɛ taŋkpee hu afimɔ wɔyitsei koni wɔya Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ekolɛ eeehere oyiwala.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ kɛ kpekpe ŋmɔlɔ amɛhɛ, ni amɛkɛ taŋkpee fimɔ amɛyitsei, ni amɛba Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad kɛɛ, ‘Miikpa bo fai; hã miyi ana wala.’ ” Ahab bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani ehiɛ kã lolo?
Etamɔ minyɛmi pɛ!” Ben-Hadad tsuji lɛ eka amɛtoi kɛmiibo Ahab naa toi; no hewɔ lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ ni amɛtse naa akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ onyɛmi ji Ben-Hadad.” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa koni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa!” No hewɔ lɛ, Ben-Hadad je kpo kɛba Ahab ŋɔɔ.
Ahab hã Ben-Hadad kwɔ etayaa shwiili lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ben-Hadad kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Maji ni mitsɛ shɔ̃ yɛ otsɛ dɛŋ lɛ mibadãi mahã bo.
Obaanyɛ hu obafo jara yɛ Damasko ohã ohe, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɛ bafee yɛ Samaria lɛ.” Ahab dãi sɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi hu miidãmɔ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ miiŋmɛɛ ohe.” Amɛkpãŋ yɛ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni Ahab jie Ben-Hadad gbɛ.
Gbalɔ ko bu Ahab fɔ Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, gbalɔi abii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kɛɛ enaanyo gbalɔi abii lɛ nɔŋŋ eko akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!” Shi enaanyo lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni etswa lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbalɔ bi lɛ kɛɛ enaanyo lɛ akɛ, “Akɛni obooo Yehowa gbee toi hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni oooshi mi lɛ jata aaagbe bo.” Be ni enaanyo nɛɛ kɛ lɛ egbɛ mli ni eyaa lɛ jata ko yatua enaanyo lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.
Gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ na nuu kroko ko, ni ekɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, tswaa mi nɔ!” Mɔ lɛ tswa lɛ nɔ, ni epila lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ tee, ni eyadamɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ eemɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoo mli.
No mli lɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ yitsofii nɔ efĩ ehiɛsɛɛ ekɛtsake ehe.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab hoɔ lɛ, gbalɔ lɛ bo etsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ tee ta lɛ eko.
Ta lɛ mli lɛ tabilɔ ko kɛ henyɛlɔ ko ni emɔ bahã mi shitoo, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Okɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ ato.
Kɛji ejo foi lɛ, no lɛ okɛ owala baatse, aloo obaawo eyi nyɔmɔ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome.’ Shi be ni otsulɔ hiɛ edɔ yɛ nibii krokomɛi ahe lɛ, nuu lɛ jo foi.” Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ akɛ, “Obu atɛŋ lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ja ona owo shika lɛ.” Gbalɔ lɛ he fee oya nɔŋŋ ni ekpɔ yitsofii nɔ lɛ yɛ ehiɛsɛɛ.
Jɛi ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ yoo lɛ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ eko ni.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Akɛni oŋmɛɛ mɔ ni mijɔɔ enɔ mihã bo koni ogbe lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe baatse yɛ enajiaŋ kɛ omaŋ lɛ hu yɛ emaŋ lɛ najiaŋ.’ ” Maŋtsɛ Ahab yiŋ etee ewe yɛ Samaria be mli ni efee gblinii, asaŋ ni ehao hu.
Nabot waintrom lɛ Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ sane ko hu ni ba nɛ.
Nuu ko ni egbɛi ji Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, yɛ waintrom yɛ Yezreel.
Waintrom nɛɛ yɛ Samaria Maŋtsɛ Ahab mɔɔ lɛ masɛi kpaakpa.
Gbi ko lɛ Ahab kɛɛ Nabot akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi koni mikɛfee ameo kɛ shitɔ kɛ amɛhenɔi lɛ abɔɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ miwe nɛɛ; mikɛ waintrom ni hi fe onɔ lɛ baato bo najiaŋ, aloo kɛji ooosumɔ lɛ, mawo bo nyɔmɔ kɛji oootsɔ̃ɔ mi ejara.” Shi Nabot kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Yehowa akahã enɛ miigbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ maŋɔ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ mahã bo.” Ahab ku esɛɛ etee ewe lɛ ni efee gblinii, ni emli ewo la yɛ wiemɔ ni Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, kɛ lɛ wie lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ.
“Mikɛ mitsɛmɛi agboshinii lɛ haŋ bo.” Eho ekã esaa nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbogbo, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ niyeli.
Eŋa Yezebel ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ofee gblinii nɛkɛ, ni oyee nii nɛɛ?” Ahab here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ mikɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, wie ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ŋɔɔ owaintrom lɛ ohã mi, ni mahe, aloo kɛji oosumɔ lɛ mikɛ waintrom kroko aaato bo no najiaŋ.’ Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, mikɛ miwaintrom lɛ hãaa bo.” Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Aso maŋtsɛ kɛ̃ oyeɔ yɛ Israel nɛɛ?
Tee shi ni oye nii, ni ona tsui.
Mi, mahã onine ashɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, waintrom lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yezebel ŋma woji yɛ Ahab gbɛi mli, ni ekɛ Ahab wolonaasɔomɔnɔ lɛ sɔo woji lɛ anaa, kɛkɛ ni ekɛmaje Yezreel maŋ onukpai kɛ abladei ni kɛ Nabot yɔɔ jɛi lɛ.
Eŋma yɛ woji lɛ amli akɛ, “Nyɛshiɛa akɛ ahĩ ŋmãa; no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛa maŋbii lɛ kpee, ni nyɛhãa Nabot ataa kpee lɛ yitso; ni nyɛhãa hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ ataraa shi ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ, koni amɛye odase amɛshi lɛ akɛ, ‘Olomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ.’ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ akpala lɛ kɛje kpo koni ayatswia lɛ tɛ ni egbo.” Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ kɛ abladei lɛ ye wiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo ni Yezebel kɛmaje amɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Amɛshiɛ akɛ ahĩ ŋmãa, ni amɛhã Nabot yata kpee ni atsɛ lɛ yitso.
Amɛhã hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ komɛi sɛ̃i, ni amɛmiikwɛ Nabot hiɛ.
Hii yakagbɔmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ kɛ sane shi Nabot yɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ akɛ Nabot lomɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kpala Nabot kɛshi maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni atsu ayakɛɛ Yezebel akɛ, “Atswia Nabot tɛ agbe lɛ.” Shɛɛ lɛ ni shɛ Yezebel dɛŋ nɔŋŋ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Tee shi koni oyaŋɔ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, abɔɔ lɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ekɛaahã bo ni ohe kɛ shika lɛ, ejaakɛ Nabot egbo.” Be ni Ahab nu akɛ Nabot egbo lɛ, oya nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni Ahab ŋɔ shwie nɔ kɛmiiya Yezreel koni eyaŋɔ abɔɔ lɛ.
Elia tsɔ̃ɔ fɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu Ahab Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, “Yaa koni okɛ Ahab, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Samaria lɛ ayakpe.
Naa, eyɛ Nabot waintrom lɛ mli; etee akɛ eyaaŋɔ trom lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ei Ahab, ogbe gbɔmɔ lɛ, koni oŋɔ enii lɛ okɛfee onɔ bɛɛ?’ Kɛɛmɔ lɛ ofata he akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: He ni gbei lɛmɔ Nabot lá yɛ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ gbei aaalɛmɔ bo hu olá yɛ.’ ” Be ni Ahab na Elia lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ei mihenyɛlɔ, bo onine egbe mi nɛɛ.” Elia here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Minine egbe bo lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ ohã efɔŋfeemɔ eŋɔ bo nom yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ bo: ‘Mahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ, mibaplene bo kɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ni okɛyɔɔ weku yɛ Israel, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ.
Mafee owe lɛ tamɔ mifee Nebat bi Yeroboam we lɛ kɛ Ahia bi Baasha hu we lɛ, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu, ni ohã Israel efee esha.’ Ni yɛ Yezebel hu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ ‘Gbei baaye eloo yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.’ Kɛji owekunyo ko gbo yɛ maŋ lɛ, gbei aaaye eloo, ni owekunyo ni aaayagbo yɛ ŋa nɔ lɛ, loofɔji aaaye eloo.” Be ni Ahab nu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, egbala etadei lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni ehi ŋmãa, ni ebuɔ kpekpe lɛ tete kɛwɔɔ, ni eyaa ni ebaa ni efee gblinii.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, “Ona bɔ ni Ahab humiɔ shi yɛ mihiɛ agbɛnɛ?
Akɛni eba ehe shi yɛ mihiɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihaŋ efɔŋ lɛ aba yɛ eyinɔ nɛɛ; ebi yinɔ moŋ ni mahã efɔŋ lɛ aba ewe lɛ nɔ yɛ.”
Gbalɔ Mikaia bɔ Ahab kɔkɔ Israel kɛ Siria hi shi afii etɛ̃ ni ta ko kwraa bɛ amɛteŋ.
Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yiŋ etee eyasara Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab.
Ahab kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛle akɛ Ramot-Gilead lɛ wɔnɔ ni?
Ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔtara shi, ni wɔfeee he eko koni wɔshɔ̃ yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ?” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab bi Yehoshafat akɛ, “Bɛ okɛ mi aaatee koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead?” Yehoshafat kɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Mi nɔŋŋ ji bo; mimaŋbii lɛ omaŋbii ni, mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni.” Shi Yehoshafat kɛshi nɔ akɛ, “Shi, wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔbi Yehowa daaŋ gbee dã.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab bua gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛkpe, amɛyi aaafee ohai ejwɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Miya miyatua Ramot-Gilead lo, aloo mikaya?” Gbalɔi lɛ to he akɛ, “Yaa, ni Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo odɛ̃ŋ.” Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, koni wɔyabi nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?” Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Mɔ kome ko yɛ, ni kulɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔyabi Yehowa daaŋ gbee yɛ eŋɔɔ.
Lɛ ji Imla bi Mikaia lɛ; shi moŋ misumɔɔɔ esane, ejaakɛ egbako gbalɛ kpakpa ko yɛ mihe dã, fe akɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ gbalɛ gbonyo.” Shi Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ, “Nii akakɛɛ nakai!” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab tsɛ piafonyo ko, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni okɛ Imla bi Mikaia lɛ ashɛ biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ!” Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat ewula kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi atadei kɛtara amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ, yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe ni yɔɔ Samaria agbo lɛ naa kpataa lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ni ji Kenaana bi Zedekia lɛ fee dade akloŋtoi, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Ahab akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Enɛɛmɛi okɛbaashimɔ Siriabii lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oookpãtã amɛhiɛ.’ ” Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ miigba gbalɛ koome akɛ: “Yaa koni oyatua Ramot-Gilead, ni obaaye omanye, ejaakɛ Yehowa baatu maŋ lɛ ewo maŋtsɛ dɛŋ.” Mikaia gba musu gbalɛ Bɔfo ni tee Mikaia tsɛmɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naabu kome egba gbalɛ kpakpa ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã ogbalɛ lɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome pɛ nɔ afee pɛ.” Shi Mikaia to he akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa aaakɛɛ mi lɛ, no mawie.” Be ni Mikaia shɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab hiɛ lɛ, Ahab bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat aya koni wɔyatua Ramot-Gilead, aloo wɔkaya?” Mikaia here nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa; nyɛbaaye omanye.
Yehowa baajɔɔ maŋ lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛ.” Shi Ahab kɛɛ Mikaia akɛ, “Shii enyiɛ po mahã okã mi kitã akɛ, kɛji okɛ mi miiwie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, okagba mi nɔ kroko fe anɔkwale lɛ kɛkɛ?” Mikaia to he akɛ, “Miina Israel tabilɔi lɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ toi ni bɛ kpalalɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hii nɛɛ bɛ nuŋtsɔ; hã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aku esɛɛ eya shĩa yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ egbaŋ gbalɛ jurɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ mihe, fe efɔŋ pɛ?” Mikaia tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ bo Yehowa naa wiemɔ toi!
Mina Yehowa ta emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebɔfoi asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ emasɛi yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ kɛ ebɛku nɔ.
Ni Yehowa bi akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaayalaka Ahab koni eya ni eyanyɔ yɛ Ramot-Gilead?’ ” Bɔfoi lɛ ekomɛi kɛɛ nɛkɛ, be mli ni mɛi komɛi hu miikɛɛ nɔ kroko.
Ahiɛ nakai aahu kɛyashi mumɔ ko je kpo kɛbadamɔ Yehowa hiɛ; ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi maya mayalaka lɛ.” Ni Yehowa bi lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ?” Mumɔ lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Maya, ni mibatsɔ̃ amale mumɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni oyalaka lɛ; onine baashɛ enɔ.” Ni Mikaia mu ewiemɔ lɛ naa nɛkɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni eba lɛ.
Yehowa ehã ogbalɔi nɛɛ egba amale gbalɛ amɛkɛlaka bo.
Shi lɛ lɛ eto akɛ okɛ amanehulu baaya ayakpe!” Kɛkɛ ni Kenaana bi Zedekia, gbalɔ lɛ, tsi bɛŋkɛ Mikaia, ni egba Mikaia hiɛ mã, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ be nɛ ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ je minɔ, ni ekɛ bo bawie?” Mikaia to he akɛ, “Gbi ni obaajɛ pia kome mli kɛya pia kroko mli ni oootee ohe lɛ, gbi lɛ nɔ ooona ole.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahab fã etsulɔ ko ekɛɛ, “Mɔ Mikaia koni okɛ lɛ ayawo Amon maŋ lɛ amralo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛbi Yoash dɛŋ.” Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Nyɛwoa lɛ tsuŋ, ni ahã lɛ aboloo fioo kɛ nu fioo pɛ daa gbi akɛ eniyenii kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maya mayaye omanye maba.’ ” Shi Mikaia kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji otee, ni oyaye omanye, ni oba fĩi, belɛ jeee Yehowa ni tsɔ̃ minɔ wie lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ toi.” Ahab gbele Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat fã kɛtee koni amɛyatua Ramot-Gilead.
Ahab kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Mibatsake mihe kɛya ta lɛ naa; shi bo lɛ wulamɔ kɛ obladei atadei lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ahab tsake ehe kɛtee ta lɛ naa.
Shi Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo etayaa shwiilii lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, mɔ wulu ni jio, mɔ bibioo ni jio, akawua akɛ ja Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ pɛ kɛkɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Siria asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na Yehoshafat lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ pi nɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛgba kɛtee koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayawu.
Shi Yehoshafat bolɔ, kɛkɛ ni ayoo lɛ.
Be ni shwiilii lɛ anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ na akɛ jeee Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ni lɛ, amɛkpa esɛɛnyiɛmɔ.
Shi Siria asraafonyo ko gãi ni etsɛ̃ ni jeee gbɛ eje etsɛ̃ lɛ yatsu Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ trukaa, yɛ eŋwɛigbɛ dama lɛ kɛ shishigbɛ dama lɛ kpeehe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ eshwiili kudɔlɔ lɛ akɛ, “Dɔɔ oyi koni okɛ mi aje ta lɛ naa, shi mipila.” Ta lɛ mli wa pam nakai gbi lɛ; ni ahiɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ mli kɛdamɔ shi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Siriabii ahiɛ; lá ni jɛ epilamɔ lɛ mli lɛ bua shwiili lɛ mli; egbo gbɛkɛnaashi mli.
Hulushinyɔɔ mli lɛ, ashiɛ yɛ ta lɛ naa akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya eshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛ emaŋ.” Belɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahab nyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli, ni akɛ egbonyo lɛ ba Samaria, ni abafu lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ayafɔ Ahab shwiili lɛ he yɛ Samaria kpaakpo lɛ naa, ni gbei yalɛmɔ Ahab lá lɛ, ni yei ajwamãŋi yaju amɛhe yɛ mli taakɛ Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ahab he saji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ shuɔ wu tsu ko ni ema kɛ maji fɛɛ ni eto lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, ebi Ahazia baye esɛɛ akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli Asa bi Yehoshafat bɔ̃i Yuda maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yehoshafat eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ ji Shilhi biyoo ni egbɛi ji Azuba lɛ.
Yehoshafat ba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ tamɔ etsɛ Asa.
Efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi moŋ efiteee jemawɔji ajamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ tee nɔ amɛshã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋma yɛ hei nɛɛ.
Yehoshafat kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab kpãŋ, ni amɛhi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehoshafat he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee kɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ ewuwuu tai ehã lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Eshwie hii kɛ yei ajwamãŋbɔlɔi ni ashi yɛ etsɛ Asa yinɔ, yɛ jemawɔji afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anaa lɛ fɛɛ kɛje jɛi.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ maŋtsɛ ko bɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amralo ko ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ najiaŋ yɔɔ jɛi.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kpɛ Tarshishbii alɛlɛ henɔi komɛi koni akɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ kɛya Ofir yɛ jɛi shika tsuru hewɔ; shi ayanyɛɛɛ akɛya, ejaakɛ lɛji lɛ jwara yɛ Ezion-Geber.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, Ahab bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yehoshafat akɛ, “Hã otsuji lɛ abashi mitsuji lɛ anɔ yɛ lɛji lɛ amli.” Shi Yehoshafat eyakpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ.
Yehoshafat gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ebi Yehoram baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Ahazia baye Israel maŋtsɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Ekɔ etsɛ Ahab kɛ enyɛ Yezebel yitsoŋwalɛ jeŋba lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛ Nebat bi Yeroboam, mɔ ni hã Israel fee esha lɛ, hu jeŋba lɛ.
Esɔ̃mɔ, ni eja Baal, ni ewo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mli la tamɔ etsɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo ni ji Enyɔ lɛ, tsaa Israelbii amaŋtsɛyelii enyɔ lɛ ahe sane lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛɔ he ni Klɛŋklɛŋ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo lɛ kɛ saji lɛ yawa lɛ.
Aaanyɛ aja wolo lɛ mli enyɔ.
.
Israel maŋtsɛyelii enyɔ lɛ ahe saji, kɛjɛ afii ohai nɛɛhu Dani afɔ Kristo aahu kɛmɔ Samaria nomŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛyashi Israel Kooyi Jaku lɛ naagbee yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo.
.
Yuda Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kɛjɛ Israel Kooyi Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shigbeemɔ lɛ kɛmɔ be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baye Yerusalɛm nɔ, asaŋ ni ekpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo mli lɛ.
Naagbee sane ni muɔ wolo lɛ naa ji Gedalia, mɔ ni Babilonbii to lɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amralo lɛ, he sane kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin heŋmɛɛmɔ akɛ gboklɛfonyo kɛje kpabuŋ yɛ Babilon.
Oshrãi nɛɛ bashrã Israel kɛ Yudabii lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ eyayeee Naa Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.
Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãmɔ kɛ Yudabii babaoo nomŋɔɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ Yuda Jaku lɛ blema saji wuji lɛ ateŋ ekome.
Gbalɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ehe sane yɔɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awolo ni ji Enyɔ lɛ mli ji Elisha mɔ ni ye Gbalɔ Elia sɛɛ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Jaku ni mli egba lɛ .—.
a. Gbalɔ Elisha .—.
b. Yuda kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ .—.
d. Samaria Butumɔ .- Yuda Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ .—.
a. Kɛjɛ Hezekia kɛyashi Yosia yinɔ .—.
b. Yosia Maŋtsɛyeli .—.
d. Yuda Naagbee Maŋtsɛmɛi .—.
e. Yerusalɛm Butumɔ .-
Gbalɔ Elia kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ tse Israel hiɛ atua.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahazia, jɛ eŋwɛi asa ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ samflɛ mli eyagbee shi, ni epila waa.
No hewɔ lɛ, etsu bɔfoi koni amɛyabi Baal-Zebub, Filistibii anyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ Ekron lɛ nii akɛ, “Ani hela ni yeɔ mi nɛɛ, mana hewalɛ lo?” Shi Yehowa bɔfo lɛ fã Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya koni okɛ Samaria maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ ayakpe, ni obi amɛ akɛ, ‘Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni nyɛyaa nyɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?’ No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Elia yiŋ etee taakɛ Yehowa fã lɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ?” Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nuu ko kɛ wɔ bakpe, ni ekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛyaa maŋtsɛ ni tsu nyɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛyakɛa lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, aso Nyɔŋmɔ ko ni bɛ Israel hewɔ ni otsuɔ koni ayabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ” Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Nuu ni kɛ nyɛ bakpe ni ekɛ nyɛ wie nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, te esu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?” Amɛhã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔiatsɛ ni.
Ewo atade wuyaa, ni ekɛ kooloo hewolo efi emliteŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ ni”.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu asafoiatsɛ ni yeɔ mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ anɔ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ, kɛtee koni amɛyaŋɔ Elia kɛba.
Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ emɛi lɛ tee Elia ŋɔɔ; amɛyana lɛ ní eta shi yɛ gɔŋ ko yiteŋ.
Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Maŋtsɛ kɛɛ okpeleke shi ni oba!” Shi Elia kɛɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi koni ebashã bo kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoiatsɛ kroko kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee Elia ŋɔɔ.
Asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eyakɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Maŋtsɛ efã bo akɛ okpeleke shi ni oba nɔŋŋ.” Shi Elia hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji mi lɛ, no lɛ, la ajɛ ŋwɛi ayi shi, ni ebashã bo kɛ omɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni la jɛ ŋwɛi yi shi, ni ebashã lɛ kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ saa etsu asafoiatsɛ kroko hu kɛ emɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ hu, nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ nɔ.
Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Etee eyakula shi yɛ enakutsei anaa yɛ Elia hiɛ, ni ekpa lɛ fai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, miikpa bo fai, naa mi kɛ otsuji nɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Naa, la ejɛ ŋwɛi ebayi shi, ni ebashã klɛŋklɛŋ asafoiatsɛmɛi enyɔ lɛ kɛ amɛmɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔi lɛ fɛɛ; shi agbɛnɛ, mi lɛ, naa mi mɔbɔ, hã misusuma jara awa yɛ ohiɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Elia akɛ, “Okɛ lɛ akpeleke shi kɛya, kaashe lɛ gbeyei!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia te shi, ni ekɛ lɛ tee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛ nɔ kɛ̃ ni otsu bɔfoi kɛtee koni amɛyabi nii yɛ Baal-Zebub, Ekron nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ Israel ni aaabi edaaŋ gbee, hewɔ lɛ oteŋ shi yɛ hela saa ni okã nɔ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ, gbo kɛ̃ obaagbo.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ Ahazia gbo yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni Elia wie lɛ naa; ni akɛni Ahazia bɛ bi kwraa hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmi Yoram baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoram ni ji Yehoshafat bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ nibii fɛɛ ni maŋtsɛ Ahazia fee lɛ, aŋmã fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Aŋɔ Elia kɛtee ŋwɛi Agbɛnɛ be bashɛ ní Yehowa baaŋɔ Elia kɛya ŋwɛi yɛ lasuogbele mli.
Elia kɛ Elisha nyiɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ Gilgal; ni be ni amɛyaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Betel.” Shi Elisha to he akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi mli kɛtee Betel.
Gbalɔi aku ko ni yɔɔ Betel lɛ mli bii lɛ je kpo kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?” Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi hu mile; nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Elisha, mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yeriko.” Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiii bo!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛba Yeriko.
Gbalɔi aku ko ni yɔɔ Yeriko lɛ mli bii lɛ ba Elisha ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani ole akɛ ŋmɛnɛ Yehowa baaŋɔ onuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya?” Ni ehã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi hu mile, nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ kɛkɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Mɛɛ yɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu mi Yordan Faa lɛ naa.” Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛ kã ni bo hu ohiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo.” Hewɔ lɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi mli kɛtee.
Ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, yadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, shi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛdamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elia jie etade yuu lɛ ni ekota, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ mli gba kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo faa lɛ.
Be ni amɛfo faa lɛ kɛtee faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ ni osumɔɔ ni mafee mahã bo, dani aŋɔ mi kɛje oŋɔɔ kɛya.” Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Hã mana omumɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ eko bɔ ni aaaha matsɔ mɔ ni baaye onajiaŋ.” Elia kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Obi nɔ ko ni wa naakpa, shi kɛ̃lɛ kɛji oona mi ni aawo mi kɛmiije oŋɔɔ kɛya lɛ, no lɛ aaaba mli nakai ahã bo; shi kɛji onaaa mi lɛ, no lɛ onine shɛŋ nɔ.” Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa ni amɛwieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, la shwiili kɛ la okpɔŋɔi ba, ni amɛbagbala Elia kɛ Elisha teŋ.
Ni Elia tsɔ̃ lasuogbele lɛ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi.
Elisha na nii nɛɛ, ni ebo etsɛ Elia akɛ, “Mitsɛ, mitsɛ!
Israel hefãlɔ kpele!
Ao, tee otee lɛ?” Ni enɛ sɛɛ lɛ enaaa Elia dɔŋŋ.
Ni emɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etade yuu lɛ mli ni etse mli enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade lɛ ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni eku esɛɛ, ni eyadamɔ Yordan Faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔ Elia atade ni je ehe egbee shi lɛ, ni ekɛtswa nu lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, Elia Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yɔɔ?” Ni be ni ekɛ atade lɛ tswa nu lɛ mli lɛ, nu lɛ mli gba enyɔ, kɛtee biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Ni Elisha tsɔ̃ mli kɛho.
Be ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni jɛ Yeriko lɛ ni damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Elia mumɔ lɛ ebayi Elisha nɔ.” Amɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkoto lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ lɛ, naa wɔ otsuji hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ yɛ omasɛi, wɔmiikpa bo fai, hã wɔya ni wɔyatao onuŋtsɔ lɛ; eko lɛ aleee nɔ, Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ewo lɛ kɛtee, ni eyashɛ lɛ efɔ̃ gɔji lɛ eko nɔ aloo jɔi lɛ eko mli.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Dabida, nyɛkatsũa kɛyaa.” Shi be ni amɛhiɛ enaagbamɔ aahu ni efee lɛ ahuntoo lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsũa kɛyaa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsũ hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛtee, ni amɛyatao lɛ gbii etɛ̃, shi amɛnaaa lɛ.
Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Elisha ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Yeriko, he ni emɛɔ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛkaya lo?” Elisha naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ Agbɛnɛ hii komɛi ní jɛ Yeriko maŋ lɛ mli tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, maŋ nɛɛ kãmɔhe lɛ hi moŋ nɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni, bo wɔnuŋtsɔ, onaa nɛɛ; shi nu lɛ ehiii, ni ehã asharãkeɔ bii, asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ hãaa niyenii aba.” Ni efã mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ ŋoo awoa kã hee mli ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi.” Ni amɛkɛbahã lɛ.
Ni etee nuhiŋmɛi lɛ he, ni eyatsi ŋoo lɛ ewo mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifee nu nɛɛ krɔŋŋ, ni ehaŋ gbele loo sharakemɔ aba dɔŋŋ.’ ” Ni nakai nu lɛ fee krɔŋŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, yɛ Elisha wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha jɛ Yeriko eeya Betel; ni be ni eyaa lɛ, gbekɛbii hii bibii komɛi jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbaye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya!
Yiteŋ kpataatsɛ, jee biɛ ní oya!” Elisha tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ Yehowa gbɛi lomɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni oshishibrishi yei enyɔ jɛ koo lɛ mli ba, ni amɛbatserɛ gbekɛbii hii lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Elisha tee Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ejɛ jɛi kɛtee Samaria.
Israel kɛ Moab ta lɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ, Yehoshafat maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahab bi Yehoram baye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Efee esha eshi Yehowa, shi kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ Yezebel nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, ekumɔ Baal amãgãi lɛ ni etsɛ fee lɛ eshwie shi.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ esha ni klɛŋklɛŋ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, fee lɛ, nakai esha lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ hu efee, ejaakɛ ehã Israel fee esha, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekpaleee.
Moab maŋtsɛ Mesha lɛ lɛɔ toi, ni daa afi lɛ eyahãa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ too gwantɛŋ bii akpei oha kɛ too ojwɛnii akpei oha ahe tsɔi akɛ daa afi too ni ewoɔ ehãa lɛ.
Shi be ni Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab gbo lɛ, Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua.
No hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yehoram fã kɛjɛ Samaria ni eyabua etabilɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu ayakɛɛ Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ etse mihiɛ atua; ani ooofata mihe ni mikɛ Moabbii lɛ ayawu lo?” Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat hã hetoo akɛ, “Matee; mi nɔŋŋ ji bo, mimaŋ lɛ omaŋ ni, ni mikpɔŋɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔɔɔtsɔ̃ kɛtua amɛ lɛ?” Yehoram hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Wɔbaatsɔ̃ Edom ŋa lɛ nɔ gbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ yiŋ amɛtee.
Amɛkpa shi gbii kpawo, ni anaaa nu ahã tabilɔi lɛ kɛ kooloi ni amɛkɛnyiɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ, koni etu wɔ ewo Moabbii adɛŋ!” Shi Yehoshafat bi akɛ, “Ani Yehowa gbalɔ ko bɛ biɛ nɛɛ ni wɔɔtee wɔyabi Yehowa nii yɛ eŋɔɔ?” Kɛkɛ ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ ni fɔse nu shwie Elia niji anɔ lɛ, yɛ biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehoshafat kɛɛ akɛ “Yehowa gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat lɛ kɛ Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ tee Elisha ŋɔɔ.
Ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ?
Yaa koni oyabi otsɛ gbalɔi kɛ onyɛ gbalɔi lɛ anii.” Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoshafat here nɔ akɛ, “Dabida, ejaakɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni etsɛ wɔ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ kɛbakpe koni etu wɔ ewo Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.” Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa, tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ hiɛ kã nɛɛ, eji jeee Yehoshafat, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛaŋ mihiɛ shwieɔ kulɛ, mikwɛŋ bo hiŋmɛileishi po, aahu ni makwɛ ohiɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛyaŋɔa saŋkutswalɔ ko nyɛbahãa mi”.
Agbɛnɛ be ni saŋkutswalɔ lɛ tswaa esaŋku lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ bayi Elisha nɔ; ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛtsaa bui yɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ mli fɛɛ.
Nyɛnaŋ ahum, ni asaŋ nyɛnaŋ nunɛmɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔ nɛɛ baayi tɔ kɛ nu, koni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsinai lɛ kɛ nyɛlɛɛ kooloi lɛ fɛɛ anu.’ ” Elisha tee nɔ akɛ, “Shi enɛ tete lɛ ejeee nɔ ko ni wa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; asaŋ ebaatu Moabbii lɛ hu ewo nyɛdɛŋ; ni nyɛaaye maŋ wulu fɛɛ maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he, kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ fɛo nɔ, ni nyɛaatoo tso kpakpa fɛɛ tso kpakpa, ni nyɛaatsimɔ nubu fɛɛ nubu, ni nyɛkɛ tɛi aaafite amɛshikpɔŋ kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ.” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi afɔle shãa be mli lɛ, naa nu jɛ Edom gbɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ nu.
Be ni Moabbii lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ lɛ efã kɛmiiba ni amɛkɛ amɛ abawu lɛ, ayabua mɛi fɛɛ ni eshɛ tayaa, kɛjɛ oblahii anɔ kɛyashi onukpai anɔ, anaa kɛba, ni akɛ amɛ badamɔ husu lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni amɛte shi leebi maŋkpa, ni hulu miikpɛ yɛ nui lɛ anɔ lɛ, Moabbii lɛ na nu lɛ ni yɔɔ amɛhiɛ lɛ akɛ eetsu faa tamɔ lá.
Ni Moabbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Lá nɛ; maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ewuwui, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔyahaa amɛshitoohe lɛ mli nii.” Shi be ni Moabbii lɛ shɛ Israelbii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ te shi, ni amɛtua Moabbii lɛ, ni amɛtswia amɛ nii; ni Moabbii lɛ jo foi kɛje Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ bote Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛgbegbee Moabbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbutu maji wuji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kpakpa fɛɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ lɛ, Israelnyo fɛɛ Israelnyo shɛ etɛ efɔ̃ nɔ kɛyashi shikpɔji lɛ anɔ yi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ tɛ.
Amɛtsimɔ nubui fɛɛ; ni amɛtoo tsei kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ.
Naagbee lɛ, maŋ wulu ni ashi pɛ ji Kir-Heres; kɛkɛ ni akromiafɔ̃lɔi lɛ yabɔle maŋ lɛ ni amɛŋɔ.
Be ni Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ na akɛ ta lɛ naa wa tsɔ̃ hã lɛ lɛ, eŋɔ hii ohai kpawo ni hiɛ klante efata ehe, koni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ henyɛlɔi lɛ ata lɛ mli kɛjo foi kɛya Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ ebi nuu ni ji ekromɔbi, ni kulɛ ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ shã shãa afɔle yɛ gbogbo lɛ nɔ, ehã Moabbii anyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Enɛ wo Israelbii lɛ ahe gbeyei ni amɛgbala amɛhe shi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Elisha ye ebua yoo ohiafo okulafo ko Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ŋa okulafo tee Elisha ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, naa, otsulɔ ni ji miwu lɛ egbo, ni ole akɛ esheɔ Yehowa gbeyei.
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mɔ ko ni miwu lɛ hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ ebamɔmɔ mibihii lɛ kɛtee eyafee amɛ enyɔji.” Elisha bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mifee mihã bo?
Kɛɛmɔ mi.
Mɛni oyɔɔ yɛ shĩa?” Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ yoo bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ shĩa, akɛ ja mu tɔ kometoo pɛ kɛkɛ.” Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa akutso lɛ mli bii fɛɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyamala gbɛi foji babaoo, bɔ ni ooonyɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ yaa shĩa lɛ mli koni oŋa shinaa lɛ owo bo kɛ obii lɛ ayi; koni obɔ̃i mu lɛ fɔsemɔ kɛwo gbɛi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kɛji eko yi obɔ̃ lɛ, wo oma sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni yoo okulafo lɛ shi gbalɔ Elisha, ni etee eyaŋa shinaa lɛ ewo ekɛ ebihii lɛ ayi.
Ni be ni amɛholeɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛbaa lɛ, belɛ eefɔse mu lɛ eewowoo amɛmli.
Be ni gbɛi lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ, ekɛɛ ebi nuu lɛ akɛ, “Wo gbɛ kroko hu kɛba!” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ eko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni mu lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Yoo okulafo lɛ tee Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ ni eyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ.
Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ mu lɛ koni okɛwo onyɔmɔ lɛ; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, okɛ obihii lɛ, nyɛkɛkwɛa nyɛhe.” Elisha kɛ Shunem yoo niiatsɛ lɛ Gbi ko lɛ Elisha tee Shunem; yoo niiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi.
Yoo nɛɛ kpee Elisha kɛtee ewe lɛ koni ebaye nii.
No hewɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni Elisha tsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛhoɔ lɛ, egbaleɔ jɛi eyayeɔ nii.
Yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ ewu akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ, miyoo akɛ nuu nɛɛ ni batsɔ̃ɔ wɔŋɔɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Hã wɔma gbogbo tsu fioo ko, ni wɔkɛ saatso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ sɛi kɛ kane amãmɔ mli ahã lɛ, koni be fɛɛ be kɛji eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ ebahi jɛi.” Gbi ko lɛ Elisha ku esɛɛ kɛba Shunem, ni etee tsu lɛ mli, ni eyajɔɔ ehe yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ, “Yaatsɛ Shunem yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni be ni eyatsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba lɛ, yoo lɛ badamɔ Elisha hiɛ.
Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ yoo lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ogba ohe naa yɛ wɔhewɔ; mɛni ooosumɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo?
Ani oyɛ sane ko ni ooosumɔ akɛ ayakɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ loo asraafoiatsɛ lɛ lo?’ ” Yoo lɛ hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋbii ateŋ miyɔɔ lɛ, ni nɔ ko he ehiaaa mi.” Elisha bi Gehazi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni afee ahã lɛ mɔ?” Gehazi to he akɛ, “Ebɛ binuu, ni ewu hu egbɔ.” Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Tsɛ yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etsɛ lɛ, ni ebadamɔ shinaa lɛ shi.
Elisha kɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ afi naakplɔ benɛ lɛ, ooohiɛ binuu yɛ okpɔkɔiaŋ.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Dabida minuŋtsɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ ji bo, kaalaka mi.” Be ni shɛ afi naakplɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu tamɔ bɔ ni Elisha ekɛɛ lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be ni gbekɛ lɛ bada lɛ, gbi ko lɛ etee etsɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋmãakulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Trukaa lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ bolɔ ekɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, “Miyitso miigba mi, miyitso miigba mi.” Etsɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo lɛ oyahã enyɛ!” Ni ewo lɛ eyahã enyɛ.
Gbekɛ lɛ ta enyɛ shuɔ nɔ kɛyashi shwane, ni egbo.
Ni ewo gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛtee eyafɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ saa lɛ nɔ, ni eŋa shinaa ewo eyi, ni eje kpo.
Ebo etsɛ ewu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ hã mi oblahii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ teji yei lɛ ateŋ ekome koni masha mihe maya Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ maba!
Ewu lɛ bi lɛ akɛ “Mɛni hewɔ otaoɔ ni oya eŋɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?” Ŋmɛnɛ jeee nyɔŋ hee, asaŋ ejeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi.
Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Kaaye otsui.” Ehã awo teji yoo lɛ nɔ nii ahã lɛ; kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Wo teji lɛ foi ni wɔtee; kaagbɔjɔ foijee lɛ mli yɛ mihewɔ, ja mikɛɛ bo akɛ ogbɔjɔ mli.” Ni eyi mli etee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ na lɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ Gehazi akɛ: “Naa, Shunamyoo lɛ baa lɛ.
“Sha foi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ koni okɛ lɛ ayakpe, ni obi lɛ akɛ: ‘Te oyɔɔ tɛŋŋ?
Te owu hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?
Te gbekɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ tɛŋŋ?’ ” Yoo lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ jogbaŋŋ!” Be ni Shunamyoo lɛ shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebamɔmɔ enaji amli.
Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi tsi bɛŋkɛ koni etsi lɛ kɛya sɛɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni emɔ mimli, ejaakɛ esusuma ehao naakpa yɛ emli; ni Yehowa kɛtee mi, ni ejieko etsɔ̃ko mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Shunamyoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ani mibaba bi nuu ko yɛ minuŋtsɔ dɛŋ?
Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ okalaka mi?” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Gehazi akɛ, “Miamɔ, ni okɔ midɛŋhiɛmɔtso lɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃, ni oya.
Kɛji okɛ mɔ ko kpe yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋa lɛ; ni kɛji mɔ ko ŋa bo lɛ, kaahere lɛ nɔ, ni oya ni okɛ mitso lɛ ayafɔ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Bei abɔ ni Yehowa hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɔɔ, ni bo hu oyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mishiŋ bo miyaŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛyi mli amɛtee.
Gehazi tsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ tso lɛ yafɔ̃ gbekɛ lɛ hiɛŋtso nɔ.
Shi gbekɛ lɛ ewieee, ni nɔ ko etsɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ wala yɛ emli.
Hewɔ lɛ Gehazi ku esɛɛ ni ekɛ Elisha yakpe, ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Gbekɛ lɛ hiɛ etsɛ̃ko.” Be ni Elisha bote shĩa lɛ mli lɛ, ena gbekɛ lɛ ni egbo lɛ kã esaa lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebote tsu lɛ mli, ni eŋa shinaa lɛ ewo amɛyi enyɔ lɛ amɛyi, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ saatso lɛ ni eyabu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛ enaabu bu enaabu nɔ; ni ekɛ ehiŋmɛii bumɔ ehiŋmɛii anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji hu shwie eniji anɔ, ni ekpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni gbekɛ lɛ he dɔ la.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, Elisha te shi, ni eshara shi kɛtee kɛba shi kome yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esaa eyakpã emli ebu gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Gbekɛ lɛ tsine shii kpawo, kɛkɛ ni egbele ehiŋmɛi.
Elisha tsɛ Gehazi kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɛ Shunam yoo lɛ kɛba.” Ni etee eyatsɛ lɛ kɛba.
Be ni yoo lɛ ba lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo obi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni eba, ni ebaho egbee Elisha najianaa, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi; no sɛɛ lɛ ewo ebi lɛ kɛje kpo.
Naakpɛɛ nibii enyɔ komɛi hu ni Elisha fee Be ni Elisha ku esɛɛ eba Gilgal ekoŋŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ hɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gbi ko be mli ni gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii tara shi lɛ, ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ kukwɛi wulu lɛ oma la nɔ, ni ohoo nii ohã gbalɔi nɛɛ.” Gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome je kpo etee ŋa nɔ koni eyatse shwie.
Eyana ŋa nɔ baa ko ni haa shi; ni etserɛ baa nɛɛ eko ewo emama naa obɔ̃; ebafolɔ mli ewo kukwɛi ni ma la lɛ nɔ lɛ mli; tsɛbelɛ amɛleee nɔ baa ni ji.
Amɛtsɔ niyenii lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye.
Be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, ebɔɔ yɛ niyenii lɛ mli.” Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ niyenii lɛ amɛye.
Elisha kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ mamu abaa!” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mamu lɛ wo kukwɛi lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɔa nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ni amɛyea.” Ni nɔ ko fɔŋ ko efeee amɛ.
Be kroko lɛ, nuu ko jɛ Baal-Shalishah ba ni ebahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, akoko kpokploku aboloi akwaabɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ abelefɔ hu yɛ kotoku mli.
Ni Elisha kɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ ohã gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ni amɛye.” Shi etsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani niyenii nɛɛ aaashɛ mɛi oha naa lo?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo lɛ, ŋɔɔ ohã mɛi lɛ ni amɛye!
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Amɛaaye aahu ni eko aaashwɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ lɛ ŋɔ niyenii lɛ ema amɛhiɛ, ni amɛye, ni eko shwɛ, yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Atsa Naaman kpitiyelɔ lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Naaman; gbɔmɔ wulu ji lɛ, ni enuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ buɔ lɛ ejaakɛ lɛ enɔ Yehowa tsɔ̃ ehã Siriabii lɛ ye kunim.
Eyɛŋ akɛ eji asraafonyo kãkãlɔ kpanaa nɛ, shi eeye kpiti.
Be ko lɛ, Siriabii lɛ yatua Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛŋɔ gbekɛ oblayoo fioo ko nom ni eyasɔ̃mɔ Naaman ŋa lɛ.
Gbi ko lɛ gbekɛ yoo lɛ kɛɛ ewula lɛ akɛ, “Mina ni minuŋtsɔ yaje gbalɔ ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ŋɔɔ, kulɛ eeetsa ekpiti lɛ ehã lɛ.” Be ni Naaman nu sane nɛɛ lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyagba lɛ nɔ ni oblayoo lɛ ni jɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ.
Ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Yaa mɔ!
Maŋma wolo mahã bo kɛyahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekel akpei ekpaa kɛ hewulamɔ atadei srɔtoi nyɔŋma kɛtee.
Ni ekɛ wolo lɛ yahã Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ miihã ole akɛ mi ji mɔ ni miwo Naaman gbɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ.
Eba koni otsa ekpiti lɛ ohã lɛ.” Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ kane wolo lɛ, egbala ehe atadei ni ekɛɛ, “Aso Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi ni migbeɔ mɔ, ni mihãa mɔ yi naa wala, hewɔ ni mɔnɛ tsuɔ miŋɔɔ akɛ mitsa mɔ ko kpiti mihã lɛ nɛɛ?
Nyɛjwɛŋa he nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛaana akɛ minaa bei kɛkɛ etaoɔ nɛɛ.” Shi be ni Elisha, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, nu akɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ egbala ehe atadei lɛ, etsu atee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ogbala ohe atadei lɛ?
Hã eba miŋɔɔ, ni eeena ele akɛ gbalɔ ko yɛ Israel.” No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kɛ ekpɔŋɔ kɛ eshwiilii lɛ ba ni amɛbadamɔ Elisha we lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Elisha tsu bɔfo ko kɛtee eŋɔɔ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaju ohe shii kpawo yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli ni aaatsa ohela lɛ ahã bo kwraa.” Shi Naaman mli fu ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ eeeje kpo kɛba miŋɔɔ ebadamɔ shi, ni eeetsɛ Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi, ni ekɛ enine aaahuu jɛi koni etsa kpiti lɛ.
Ani Abana Faa kɛ Farpar Faa ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, amɛhiii fe Israel fai lɛ fɛɛ lo?
Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, kulɛ mɛɛba mijuuu mihe yɛ nomɛi amli ni mihe tã mɔ?” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni eyi mli ni kulɛ eeya kɛ mlifu.
Shi etsuji lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ wie akɛ, “Ataa, ani nɔ ko wulu ko gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ ofee kulɛ, ofeŋ lo?
Aahuu moŋ ni ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Yaaju ohe kɛkɛ ni ohe atã lɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpeleke shi, ni ekɛ ehe yatsɔ Yordan Faa lɛ mli shii kpawo tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie lɛ, ni ehe tã, ni ehewolo nɔ bafee trotro ekoŋŋ tamɔ gbekɛ fioo hewolo.
Kɛkɛ ni Naaman ku esɛɛ eba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, lɛ kɛ emɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Eba ni ebadamɔ shi yɛ Elisha hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, kpaako mina mile akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ ni ohe otsulɔ dɛŋ nikeenii ko.” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ, hiɛ kã nɛɛ, miheee nɔ ko.” Ni enyɛ enɔ doo akɛ ehe kɛ̃, shi Elisha ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji oheee midɛŋ nikee lɛ, belɛ ofainɛ ni ohã ni ahã mi sũ, bɔ ni teji okpɔŋɔi enyɔ aaatere; ejaakɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ, mi otsulɔ, mishaŋ shãa afɔle loo afɔle kroko mihaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja Yehowa kɛkɛ.
Kɛji minuŋtsɔ tee Rimmon, Siria nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eyaaja lɛ, ekpasaa minine.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ lɛ koto shi eeja lɛ, esa akɛ mikɛ lɛ akoto shi eko yɛ Rimmon we lɛ.
Kɛji eeeba lɛ nakai lɛ, Yehowa aŋɔfa mi, otsulɔ.” Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Naaman yi gbɛ etee.
Naaman shɛko he ko shɔŋŋ ko kɛkɛ ni Gehazi, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa, minuŋtsɔ eŋɔ Naaman, Sirianyo nɛɛ, he eke lɛ, ni eheee nɔ ni ekɛba lɛ yɛ edɛŋ.
Akɛni Yehowa hiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, masha foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ koni mayahe nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi ŋɔ shwie Naaman sɛɛ.
Shi be ni Naaman na akɛ mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ eyi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli koni ekɛ lɛ ayakpe.
Naaman bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni eba?” Ni Gehazi hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Nɔ ko bako.
Minuŋtsɔ tsu mi koni mibakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ ejɛ Efraim gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba miŋɔɔ; ofainɛ ni ohã amɛ jwiɛtɛi talenta kome kɛ hewulamɔ atadei enyɔ.’ ” Naaman kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã ni mahã bo jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ koni okɛya!” Ni enyɛ enɔ, ni efimɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai enyɔ lɛ ewo kotokui enyɔ amli, kɛ hewulamɔ atadei fɛɛfɛji srɔtoi enyɔ lɛ.
Ni eŋɔ tere etsuji enyɔ kɛnyiɛ Gehazi hiɛ.
Shi be ni amɛshɛ gɔŋ ni Elisha yɔɔ nɔ lɛ he lɛ, Gehazi he kotokui lɛ yɛ Naaman tsuji lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekɛyato shĩa lɛ mli, ni ewo Naaman tsuji lɛ agbɛ, ni amɛtee.
Kɛkɛ ni etee eyadamɔ enuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Elisha bi lɛ akɛ, “Gehazi, nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Ni ehã hetoo akɛ, “Otsulɔ eyako he ko he ko.” Shi Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ oleee akɛ yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ miyɛ jɛi, be mli ni nuu lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ eshwiili lɛ mli ni ekɛ bo bakpe lɛ?
Ani be ni aŋɔɔ shika kɛ atadei kɛ mutsei kɛ waintromi kɛ too gwantɛŋi kɛ toi kɛ tsinai kɛ wehii kɛ weyei yɛ mɔ dɛŋ nɛ?
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Naaman kpiti lɛ aaatsɛŋe bo kɛ oshwiei fɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Ni eje ehiɛ eje kpo kɛ ehe kpiti sakoo tamɔ ayilɔ.
Lema ko he sane Gbi ko lɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, he ni wɔ owebii nɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lɛ, yɛ kplokotoo tsɔ̃ hã wɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ ŋmɛɛ wɔ gbɛ ní wɔya Yordan Faa lɛ naa wɔyafolɔ tsei ni wɔkɛbafee shihilɛhei wɔhã wɔhe yɛ jɛi.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa.” Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni okɛ wɔ otsuji aya.” Ni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi kɛ nyɛ baaya.” Hewɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ tee.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa lɛ amɛtootoo tsei lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome toɔ tso lɛ eko lɛ, dade lɛ fã yɛ lema lɛ yitso eyagbee nu lɛ mli.
Ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ, lema lɛ ma po ayama!” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha bi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyagbee lɛ?” Be ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jɛi lɛ, Elisha fo tso kuku ko ni eshɛ efɔ̃ jɛi, kɛkɛ ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni dade lɛ batɛo nu lɛ hiɛ.
Ni efã akɛ, “Yaakɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kpã enine mli ni ekɔ.
Aye Siria ta nɔ kunim Be ko lɛ ta te shi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etatsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋɔ, ni amɛkɔɔ he ni amɛkɛbaafee amɛshitoohe.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Elisha lɛ leɔ enɛ, ni etswaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ adafi akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni okatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛmiiho ejaakɛ Siriabii lɛ miiya jɛi.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ etsu kɛtee he ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ etswa lɛ he adafi lɛ.
Enɛ tee nɔ shii abɔ.
Enɛ ye Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ etsuji lɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛtsɔ̃ŋ mi wɔteŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lo?” Ni etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jeee wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ; shi moŋ, Elisha, gbalɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni gbaa Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔi ni owieɔ yɛ osɛɛtsu lɛ mli tete lɛ.” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyataoa he ni eyɔɔ, ni matsu ni ayamɔ lɛ kɛba.” Kɛkɛ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, eyɛ Dotan.” No hewɔ lɛ, etsu ta kpele kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛtee jɛi.
Amɛshɛ jɛi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.
Leebi maŋkpa lɛ, Elisha Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ te shi, ni eje kpo, ni ena Siria tabilɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii ni amɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.
Tsulɔ lɛ ku esɛɛ etee Elisha ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao minuŋtsɔ, te wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ?” Elisha here nɔ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ fa fe mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, gbelemɔ ehiŋmɛii ni ena nii!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele oblanyo lɛ hiŋmɛii ni ena nii; ni naa, gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ la shwiilii kɛbɔle Elisha he kɛkpe.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba Elisha mɔmɔ lɛ, Elisha kpa Yehowa fai akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwi la!” Ni amɛshwi la yɛ Elisha sɔlemɔ lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee gbɛ lɛ nɛ, ni jeee maŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ hu nɛ.
Nyɛnyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛ baaya nuu lɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Ni ekɛ amɛ tee Samaria tɔ̃ɔ.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛshɛ Samaria lɛ Elisha sɔle akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, gbelemɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiŋmɛii koni amɛna nii.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbele amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛna nii; ni naa, amɛna akɛ amɛyɛ Samaria.
Be ni Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ, ebi Elisha akɛ, “Mitsɛ, ani mitswia amɛ nii?
Ani migbe amɛ lo?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Dabida, kaatswia amɛ nii ni ogbe amɛ.
Ani mɛi po ni okɛ oklante kɛ ogãi yaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, ogbeɔ amɛ?
Ŋmɛɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ koni amɛye nii, ni amɛnu nii koni ohã amɛya amɛnuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃ kpele ko, ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ, ni amɛtee amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ Siriabii lɛ baaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbayeee ofɔ̃ dɔŋŋ!
Asa Samaria Yi Be kplaŋŋ ko sɛɛ lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bua eta lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni amɛfã kɛtee amɛyasa Samaria maŋ lɛ yi.
No hewɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba Samaria, aahu po ní ahɔ̃ɔ teji yitso jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, ni ahɔ̃ɔ okpo wamɔ okpolu mlijaa ejwɛ mli ekome jwiɛtɛi shekeli enumɔ.
Afɔɔ ŋaŋ sabolai tsɛmɔ ŋaŋ “okpo fee.” Agbɛnɛ eba lɛ akɛ be ni Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ sheraa shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ, yoo ko bolɔ kɛtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ, ye obua mi.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã ni Yehowa aye abua bo, te mafee tɛŋŋ maye mabua bo hu?
Ani mijɛ miŋmãagbeemɔhe loo mijɛ miwainbu mli?” Maŋtsɛ lɛ biyoo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni gbaa onaa?” Yoo lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ ŋmɛnɛ, koni wɔ lɛ, wɔye mi hu mibinuu lɛ.’ Kɛkɛ ni wɔhoo mibi lɛ, ni wɔye.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛ obinuu lɛ aba ni wɔye lɛ’; shi lɛ lɛ eŋɔ ebi lɛ etee.” Be ni Maŋtsɛ lɛ nu yoo lɛ wiemɔi lɛ, egbala etadei lɛ yɛ ehe; ni maŋbii ni bɛŋkɛ gbogbo lɛ he lɛ na akɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ wo kpekpe atade yɛ etadei ni ewo lɛ ashishi.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ agbe mi, ni esaa egbe mi ekoŋŋ, kɛji Elisha, Shafat bi lɛ, yitso tsa eyitso nɔ ŋmɛnɛ!” Ni etsu tsulɔ koni eyamɔ Elisha.
Shi no mli lɛ Elisha ta shi yɛ eshĩa lɛ ni onukpai komɛi ni ba lɛ saramɔ lɛ tara emasɛi.
Shi dani tsulɔ lɛ shɛɔ Elisha ŋɔɔ lɛ, Elisha kɛɛ onukpai lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛle akɛ nakai nuu mɔgbelɔ lɛ ewo mɔ gbɛ ni abafo miyitso lo?
Naa, kɛji tsulɔ lɛ ba lɛ, nyɛŋaa shinaa lɛ nyɛwoa eyi kpɛŋŋ ni ekaba mli.
Enuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛmiiba.” Be ni Elisha kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ bashɛ eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛ.
Mɛni mimɛɔ dɔŋŋ?
Mɛni feemɔ shwɛɔ mi dɔŋŋ?”
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Wɔ be nɛ mli lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.” Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpasaa enine lɛ here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ Elisha akɛ, “Naa, kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Na ooona kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Siria tabilɔi lɛ jo foi Hii kpitiyelɔi ejwɛ komɛi yɛ Samaria maŋ agbo lɛ naa.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ: “Mɛni hewɔ ni wɔɔɔtara biɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔɔɔgboi?” Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔmɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni wɔɔɔgboi yɛ jɛi.
Ni kɛji wɔtara biɛ hu gboimɔ nɔŋŋ wɔbaagboi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa; nyɛhãa wɔyagbea Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli moŋ; kɛji amɛhere wɔyi wala lɛ, wɔyi aaana wala; ni kɛji amɛgbe wɔ lɛ belɛ wɔɔgboi kɛkɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi, be ni hiɛ bɔ̃i tuutuu feemɔ lɛ, kpitiyelɔi lɛ te shi amɛtee Siriabii lɛ ata lɛ mli; shi be ni amɛshɛɔ jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ jɛi.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã Siriabii lɛ nu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi anane shi gbɛɛmɔi kɛ ta babaoo he; ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ eyabɔ Hitbii kɛ Ijiptbii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ apaa koni amɛkɛ wɔ abawu.” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbɛkɛnaashi be ni hiɛ feɔ tuutuu lɛ, amɛjo foi amɛshi amɛshitoohe lɛ: amɛshi amɛbuui kɛ amɛkpɔŋɔi kɛ amɛtejii fɛɛ.
Amɛjo foi koni amɛhere amɛyiwala.
Agbɛnɛ be ni nɛkɛ kpitiyelɔi nɛɛ shɛ shitoohe lɛ mli lɛ, amɛbote buu kome ko mli, ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãi; ni amɛloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ mamai, ni amɛkɛyatee.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛbabote buu kroko hu mli, ni amɛloo jɛi nii lɛ hu, ni amɛkɛyato.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɔ ni wɔfeɔ nɛɛ ejaaa.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, omanye gbi ni.
Shi moŋ kɛji wɔfee diŋŋ ni wɔmɛ kɛyashi jetsɛre leebi lɛ, wɔɔye sɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyaa ni wɔyabɔa amaniɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛshi Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ kɛtee Samaria.
Kɛkɛ ni kpitiyelɔi lɛ bo amɛtsɛ maŋ lɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔtee Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ; ni naa, anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko lɛ, anuuu mɔ ko mɔ ko he hu akɛ ja okpɔŋɔi ni afimɔ amɛ aŋmɔlɔ̃ shi; ni tejii lɛ hu ŋmɔlɔ shi; ni bui lɛ hu mamɔ shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Siriabii lɛ shi amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni agbonaabulɔi lɛ tswa adafi, kɛkɛ ni sane lɛ yashɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ yiŋtoo ni Siriabii nɛɛ kɛfee enɛ nɛɛ.
Amɛle akɛ hɔmɔ miiye wɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛje shitoohe lɛ mli amɛtee amɛyateetee amɛhe yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔbaaje maŋ lɛ mli wɔyatao niyenii, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaamɔmɔ wɔ hiɛkãalɔi koni amɛbote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli ni amɛŋɔ maŋ lɛ hu.” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, amɛtamɔ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua hii komɛi; amɛŋɔ okpɔŋɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ enumɔ kɛya jɛi koni amɛyakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu amɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔ shwiilii kɛtee Siria ta lɛ mli.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyakwɛa.” Ni amɛtiu amɛ kɛyashɛ Yordan Faa lɛ naa tɔ̃ɔ; ni naa, gbɛ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ eyi tɔ kɛ atadei kɛ nibiinibii ni Siria tabilɔi lɛ eshɛrɛ eshwie yɛ amɛoyaiyeli lɛ mli.
Bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba, ni amɛbabɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ amaniɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Samariabii lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛyaha Siriabii lɛ ashitoohe lɛ.
Ni yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, akɛ talenta kome he ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa yɛ Samaria.
Agbɛnɛ eba mli akɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ asafoiatsɛ, mɔ ni ekpasaa enine lɛ, eto maŋ wulu lɛ agbo lɛ naa akɛ agbonaakwɛlɔ nukpa.
Maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, taakɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, Elisha, kɛɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ benɛ beiaŋ lɛ akɛ talenta kome baahe ŋmãa mamu kiloi etɛ̃ aloo ashikishaŋ kiloi ekpaa, yɛ Samaria, yɛ nakai agbo lɛ naa lɛ,” nakai asafoiatsɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni here Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji Yehowa aaagbele samfɛji yɛ ŋwɛi po, ni ŋmãa aaanɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi ashwie shi lɛ, ani wiemɔ nɛɛ aaaba mli lo?” lɛ.
Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ooona kɛ ohiŋmɛii, shi oyeŋ eko kɔkɔɔkɔ lɛ.” Nakai nɔŋŋ eba enɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ naanaa enɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni egbo.
Shunemyoo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛba Agbɛnɛ, Elisha ekɛɛ yoo lɛ ni etsiɛ̃ ebi lɛ hiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ, ni oya koni oyato gbɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he ni ooona; ejaakɛ Yehowa baahã hɔmɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo.” No hewɔ lɛ, yoo lɛ te shi, ni efee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ lɛ wie lɛ.
Ekɛ ewe lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afii kpawo.
Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee mli lɛ, yoo lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni eyashɛ jɛi lɛ, etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyafo ewo enijiaŋ koni akpale eshĩa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ ahã lɛ.
Yoo lɛ yanina maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Gehazi, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, miiwie akɛ, “Gbaa mi nibii wuji fɛɛ ni Elisha efee lɛ.” Gehazi miigba maŋtsɛ lɛ bɔ ni Elisha tsɔ̃ etsĩɛ gbonyo hiɛ nɔŋŋ, kɛkɛ lɛ naa yoo lɛ ni etsĩɛ ebi hiɛ lɛ.
Ebafo ewo maŋtsɛ lɛ nijiaŋ yɛ eshĩa lɛ kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gehazi kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, yoo lɛ nɛ, ni ebi lɛ ni Elisha tsĩɛ ehiɛ lɛ hu nɛ.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi yoo lɛ, ni yoo lɛ gba lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã piafonyo ko ehã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dãimɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ji yoo nɛɛ nii lɛ ohã lɛ, kɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii fɛɛ ni ahɔ̃ɔ kɛjɛ afii kpawo nɛɛ ni eshi eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ.” Elisha kɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad Ni Elisha tee Damasko be mli ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad lɛ he miiye.
Be ni ayagba maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ,” maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hazael epiafoi lɛ eko akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ nikeenii ko ohiɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni okɛyahã Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ koni otsɔ̃ enɔ ni obi Yehowa nii akɛ, ‘Aleee nɔ, hela ni miyeɔ nɛɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi lo?’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Hazael tee Elisha ŋɔɔ.
Eŋɔ nikeenii ni ji Damasko nibii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ eko ehiɛ edɛ̃, yoomai nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yiteremɔ.
Be ni Hazael kɛ Elisha kpe lɛ, Hazael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Otsulɔ Ben-Hadad tsu mi oŋɔɔ koni mibabi bo akɛ ehe ni yeɔ nɛɛ lɛ eeena hewalɛ kɛ̃ lo?” Ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ohe baawa bo!’ Tsɛbelɛ, Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaagbo.” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tsu ehiŋmɛi eshwie Hazael nɔ gãa kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Hazael he bɔ̃i lɛ jaramɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni trukaa nɔŋŋ ni Elisha bɔ̃i yaafo.
Hazael bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ minuŋtsɔ foɔ nɛɛ?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Ejaakɛ mile nɔ efɔŋ ni bo obaafee Israelbii: amɛmɔji ni he wa lɛ obaamamɔ naa la, ni amɛblahii lɛ okɛ klante baagbe amɛ, ni amɛbii fufɔbii lɛ obaaŋɔ amɛ otswia shi, ni amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ obaagbalagbalaa amɛmli.” Kɛkɛ ni Hazael kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi, otsulɔ ni tamɔ gbee nɛɛ, namɔ ji lɛ ni eeetsu nɔ ko wulu ni tamɔ nɛkɛ?” Elisha hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ bo obaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Siria.” Ni Hazael ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Elisha ŋɔɔ kɛtee enuŋtsɔ Ben-Hadad ŋɔɔ; ni Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni Elisha kɛɛ bo?” Tsulɔ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Ekɛɛ mi akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ohe baawa bo!” Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Hazael kɔ saanɔbo, ni ekɛtsɔ nu mli, ni eŋɔ hã maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsui su aahu kɛyashi egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni Hazael baye Ben-Hadad sɛɛ akɛ Siria maŋtsɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoshafat bi Yehoram babɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ be ni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii kpaanyɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Eba ejeŋ gbonyogbonyo tamɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi lɛ; eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ejaakɛ Ahab biyoo ji eŋa, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtãa Yuda hiɛ yɛ etsulɔ David hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewo lɛ shi akɛ eeehã lɛ kɛ eshwiei atsɔ̃ kane ni baakudɔ Yuda kɛaatee naanɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoram yinɔ lɛ, Edom tse Yuda hiɛ atua, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwo maŋtsɛ amɛhã amɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehoram kɛ eta shwiilii lɛ fɛɛ foŋ kɛtee Zair.
Edombii lɛ gba kɛbɔle amɛ kɛkpe yɛ jɛi.
Shi Yehoram kɛ eshwiilii nɔtalɔi lɛ te shi nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛgba kɛtsɔ̃ Edombii ata lɛ mli, ni amɛjo foi, ni etabilɔi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtee amɛshĩaiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Edombii lɛ tse Yuda hiɛ atua kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni Libna maŋ wulu lɛ hu tse atua.
Shi Yehoram he saji kɛ nibii ni efee fɛɛ lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Yehoram gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni ebi Ahazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia Ahab bi Yoram, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ahazia Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda.
Ahazia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Eye maŋtsɛ afi kome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Atalia, Israel Maŋtsɛ Omri nabi lɛ.
Eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ, ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ Ahab we lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ bii lɛ ashaanuu ji lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahazia yafata Ahab bi Yoram he, ni amɛkɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael yawu yɛ Ramot-Gilead; ni Siriabii lɛ pila Yoram.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yoram ku esɛɛ kɛtee Yezreel koni ayatsa pilamɔ ni Siriabii pila lɛ lɛ yɛ Rama lɛ.
Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoram bi Ahazia tee Yezreel koni eyasara Yoram, ejaakɛ ehe miiye.
Afɔ Yehu mu kɛwo lɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Elisha tsɛ gbalɔi aku lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mĩamɔ, wo nɛkɛ mu kɛ tɔ nɛɛ ohiɛ odɛ̃ oya Ramot-Gilead.
Ni kɛji oshɛ jɛi lɛ taomɔ Yehu, Yehoshafat bi lɛ, ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ.
Ohã ete shi yɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ, koni okɛ lɛ abote sɛɛtsu mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ wo mu kɛ tɔ lɛ koni ofɔse oshwie eyiteŋ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, miiwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ!’ Kɛkɛ lɛ gbelemɔ shinaa lɛ ni ojo foi; kaashashao shi.” Kɛkɛ ni oblanyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ lɛ, yiŋ etee Ramot-Gilead.
Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, naa ta lɛ mli asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tara shi amɛkpe; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Asafoiatsɛ, mihiɛ sane ko mihã bo!” Ni Yehu bi akɛ, “Wɔteŋ namɔ okɛwieɔ lɛ?” Ni ehã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Bo, asafoiatsɛ Yehu tuuŋtu ni!” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu te shi ni amɛbote shĩa lɛ mli, ni oblanyo lɛ fɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yehu yiteŋ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifɔ bo mu kɛwo bo Yehowa maŋbii ni ji Israel maŋtsɛ.
Ni obaabutu onuŋtsɔ Ahab we lɛ, koni mikɛtɔ Yezebel kɛ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ alá, kɛ Yehowa tsuji lɛ fɛɛ alá he owele.
Ejaakɛ Ahab we lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã; ni maplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni yɔɔ Ahab we lɛ, nyɔŋ kɛ mɔ ni eye ehe fɛɛ, yɛ Israel.
Ni mafee Ahab we lɛ tamɔ mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, we lɛ, kɛ Baasha, Ahia bi lɛ we lɛ.
Ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko efuŋ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ lɛ gbele shinaa lɛ, ni ejo foi.
Be ni Yehu ku esɛɛ kɛba enuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi, lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔlɛ sane ni lo?
Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔnɛ sɛkɛyelɔ nɛɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle gbɔmɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ewiemɔ yɔɔ.” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ “Oolaka wɔ, gbaa wɔ nɔ ni ekɛɛ moŋ.” Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ekɛɛ mi nɛ; ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.
Mifɔ bo mu, miwo bo Israel maŋtsɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe fee oya, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jie etade, ni eŋɔ ha shi yɛ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛkpãkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛɛ, “Yehu eye maŋtsɛ!” Agbe Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram Kɛkɛ ni Yehu, Yehoshafat bi ni ji Nimshi nabi lɛ, kpãŋ Yoram yinɔ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Yoram kɛ Israel fɛɛ miibu Ramot-Gilead he, yɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Yoram eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yezreel koni eyatsa pilamɔi ni Siriabii lɛ pila lɛ lɛ, be ni ekɛ Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ yawu lɛ.
Ni Yehu kɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛ kɛ mi kɛɛmɔ ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko joa foi kɛmiijɛa maŋ lɛ mli ni eyagba yɛ Yezreel.” Ni Yehu ho ta shwiili mli ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yezreel ejaakɛ Yoram kã shi kɛ hela yɛ jɛi.
Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia eba eŋɔɔ ebaasara lɛ.
Bulɔ ko damɔ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ yɛ Yezreel; ena Yehu kɛ esafo ku lɛ ni amɛmiiba, ni ekɛɛ, “Miina asafo ku ko.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ akɛ, “Tsɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko ni otsu lɛ koni ekɛ amɛ ayakpe, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ko tee ni ekɛ Yehu yakpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe?
Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.” Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔ ni ji enyɔ kɛtee.
Be ni eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ sane nyɛkɛbaa lo?’ ” Ni Yehu to he akɛ, “Mɛni hejɔlɛ sane kɔɔ yɛ ohe?
Bo lɛ baanyiɛ misɛɛ ni wɔtee.” Bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ tsulɔ lɛ eyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ, shi ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.
Ni bulɔ lɛ kɛfata he akɛ, “Shwiili lɛ foiwoo tamɔ Yehu Nimshi nabi lɛ shwiili foiwoo, ejaakɛ ewoɔ shwiili foi tamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ”.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoram kɛɛ, “Nyɛfea mishwiili lɛ kralo.” Ni amɛfee eshwiili lɛ kralo.
Ni Yoram, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Ahazia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, je kpo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ta eshwiili mli; ni amɛ kɛ Yehu yakpe.
Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoram na Yehu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ “Yehu, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?” Yehu here nɔ akɛ, “Te baafee tɛŋŋ ni hejɔlɛ aba hu, bei abɔ ni ŋkunyaayeli kɛ wɔŋjamɔ ni onyɛ Yezebel bato shishi lɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Yoram tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ejo foi; ni be ni ejoɔ foi lɛ, ekɛɛ Ahazia akɛ, “Ahazia, atsɔ̃ wɔ akpa!” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɔ egãi lɛ ni eŋɔ tsɛ̃ Yoram kɔ̃ji ateŋ, ni gãi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yoram tsui mli kɛje kpo, ni egbee eshwiili lɛ mli.
Yehu kɛɛ esafoiatsɛ Bidikar akɛ, “Wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ Nabot, Yezreelnyo lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kaimɔ akɛ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ ni tara shwiili mli kɛnyiɛ etsɛ Ahab sɛɛ be ni Yehowa ŋɔ nɛkɛ toigbalamɔ nɛɛ efɔ̃ enɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nabot lá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛ ebii lɛ hu alá ni afɔse ashwie shi, ni mina nyɛ, lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mawo he nyɔmɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.’ Yehowa kɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wo lɛ oshɛ ofɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.” Agbe Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahazia na nɔ ni eba lɛ, ejo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Bet-Hagan gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu tiu lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛ hu nyɛtsɛ̃a lɛ gãi.” Ni atsɛ̃ lɛ gãi yɛ eshwiili lɛ mli yɛ Gur ŋmeŋme lɛ ni yɔɔ Ibleam masɛi lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni ejo foi kɛtee Megido, ni eyagbo yɛ jɛi, ni etsuji lɛ wo egbonyo lɛ amɛwo shwiili lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ efuuhe lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Ahazia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoram, Ahab bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Agbe Maŋnyɛ Yezebel Yehu ba Yezreel.
Be ni Yezebel nu he lɛ, ediki ehiŋmɛii asɛɛ, ni ehɔ eyi fɛɛfɛo, ni eyabu samflɛ naa, ni eekwɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli lɛ, Yezebel bi akɛ, “Zimri ni ogbe onuŋtsɔ, hejɔlɛ sane okɛbaa lo?” Yehu wo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛ samflɛ lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ, “Namɔ yɔɔ migbɛfaŋ?” Namɔ?
Ni piafoi enyɔ loo piafoi etɛ̃ ko gbo amɛyi naa shi amɛkwɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛshɛa nyɛfɔ̃a shikpɔŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛwo lɛ amɛtswa shi; ni elá lɛ eko tsɛŋe shwie gbogbo lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe.
Yehu kɛ eshwiili ni eta mli lɛ kɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ Yezebel gbonyo lɛ nɔ kɛho.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bote maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eyaye nii, ni enu nɔ ko eshwie nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakwɛa ni nyɛfua nɛkɛ yoo musumɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ biyoo ni.” Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee lɛ fuu; shi amɛnaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja eyitsoŋoŋo kɛ enaji kɛ enine kɔkɔi pɛ.
Be ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Yehu amaniɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa wiemɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia, Tishbinyo lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ nɛ: ‘Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbei baaye Yezebel loo yɛ, ni Yezebel gbonyo baatsɔ̃ tamɔ tumo nɔ wamɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Yezreel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yooo lɛ ni eeekɛɛ akɛ Yezebel nɛ.’ ”
Agbe Maŋtsɛ Ahab shwiei Ahab yɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Samaria.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu ŋmala woji ni etsu akɛtee Samaria akɛyahã maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ Ahab bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Amrɔ pɛ ni nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ aaashɛ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, akɛni nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu nii kɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he hu yɔɔ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni hi kɛ mɔ ni sa fe fɛɛ koni nyɛŋɔ lɛ nyɛta etsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛwu kɛhere nyɛnuŋtsɔ we lɛ.” Shi Samaria lumɛi lɛ she gbeyei naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, Maŋtsɛ Yoram kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahazia nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ adamɔ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ ehiɛ wɔdamɔ hu?” No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ bii lɛ atsɔselɔi lɛ hu tsu Yehu ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Otsuji ji wɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ wɔ lɛ wɔɔfee.
Wɔwooo mɔ ko mɔ ko maŋtsɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ lɛ, feemɔ kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu ŋmã wolo ni ji enyɔ eyahã amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyɛ migbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛfee kralo akɛ nyɛaabo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛŋɔa nyɛnuŋtsɔ bihii lɛ ayitsei ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ Yezreel wɔ́ aaafee nɛkɛ be mli pɛpɛɛpɛ.” Maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ ni tsɔseɔ amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ amɛyɔɔ.
Be ni wolo lɛ bashɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛmɔmɔ maŋtsɛ bihii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛŋɔ amɛyitsei lɛ amɛwo kɛntɛŋi amli, ni amɛtsu akɛyahã Yehu yɛ Yezreel.
Be ni bɔfo bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ ayitsei lɛ eba lɛ,” Yehu fã akɛ, “Nyɛtoa yitsei lɛ kui enyɔ yɛ agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi leebi.” Ni leebi lɛ, Yehu je kpo ebadamɔ shi yɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Naa, sɔ̃ ko tereee nyɛ.
Mi ji mɔ ni tee minuŋtsɔ yinɔ apam, ni migbe lɛ.
Shi namɔ gbegbee mɛnɛɛmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ hu?
Agbɛnɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ ni ewie yɛ Ahab we lɛ he lɛ, emli ekome folo efeŋ yaka, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee nɔ ni etsɔ̃ etsulɔ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehu gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Ahab we lɛ yɛ Yezreel lɛ: egbɔmɛi wuji lɛ kɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ emɔ ko mɔ ko.
Agbe Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi Yehu shi Yezreel, ni eyiŋ kɛmiiya Samaria.
Ni be ni eshɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Tookwɛlɔi Atoohetsɔikuuhe lɛ, Yehu na Maŋtsɛ Ahazia wekumɛi lɛ ekomɛi yɛ jɛi, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɛi ji nyɛ?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Ahazia wekumɛi ji wɔ, ni wɔmiiya wɔyasara maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ odehei krokomɛi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmɔmɔa amɛ hiɛkãalɔi!” Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi, ni amɛgbe amɛ yɛ Toohetsɔikuuhe bu lɛ he, hii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko.
Agbe Ahab weku ni eshwɛ fɛɛ Ni be ni eje jɛi eŋɔ shwie nɔ lɛ, ena Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, ni eeba ni ekɛ lɛ abakpe.
Yehu ŋa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani otsui mli tse hã mi tamɔ bɔ ni mitsui mli tse hã bo lɛ?” Ni Yohanadab hã lɛ hetoo akɛ, “Hɛɛ, nakai ni.” Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ taa midɛ̃.” Kɛkɛ ni eta edɛ̃; kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã ekwɔ shwiili lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ.
Yehu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni wɔtee koni oyakwɛ bɔ ni miyeɔ Yehowa he awuŋã mihãa.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu hã eta eshwiili lɛ mli.
Be ni Yehu shɛ Samaria lɛ, Yehu gbe Ahab weku fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni eshiii mɔ kome nɛkɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Elia nɔ ewie lɛ.
Agbe mɛi ni jaa Baal lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehu bua Samaria maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ahab sɔ̃mɔ Baal fioo ko kɛkɛ, shi Yehu baasɔ̃mɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ kɛwula shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛyakpea Baal gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛbahãa mi, akashwɛ mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miyɛ afɔle wulu ko ni mibashã mahã Baal.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baaa lɛ eyi naŋ wala.” Shi ŋaa Yehu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni afee ni ekpãtã Baal sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtoa gbi jurɔ wulu ko ni akɛja Baal.” No hewɔ lɛ, ato gbi lɛ.
Ni Yehu kɛ wiemɔ tsu akɛtee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Ni Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba ni eshwɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni baaa.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛba Baal we lɛ, ni Baal we lɛ yi obɔ̃ tɔ.
Ni Yehu fã mɔ ni kwɛɔ jamɔ atadei lɛ anɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yaajie atadei ohã Baal jalɔi lɛ fɛɛ!” Ni eyajie atadei lɛ ebahã amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, bote Baal we lɛ mli; ni ekɛɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia ni Yehowa jalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabafutu nyɛ yɛ biɛ, akɛ ja nyɛ Baal jalɔi lɛ kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehu kɛ Yehonadab tee koni amɛyashã afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei amɛhã Baal.
Shi Yehu eŋɔ hii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ eto kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛhã hii ni mikɛbawo nyɛteŋ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome jo foi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ni hã ejo foi lɛ kɛ ewala baatse.” Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshã shãa afɔle lɛ egbe naa lɛ, Yehu kɛɛ bulɔi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbea amɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko miije kpo!” Ni amɛgbe amɛ, ni bulɔi lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ hole amɛ ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie kpo lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Baal we lɛ pia mli, ni amɛyahole Baal we lɛ amãgãi lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyashã.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkumɔ Baal amãgã lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛsaa amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu amɛshwie shi, ni amɛkɛ Baal we lɛ fee kuŋtso kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Nɛkɛ Yehu fee, ni ekpãtã Baal hiɛ yɛ Israel.
Shi Yehu efɔ̃ɔɔ tsinabi amãgã ni Yeroboam, Nebal bi lɛ, kɛma Betel kɛ Dan, ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ jamɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yehu akɛ, “Ofee jogbaŋŋ kɛ feemɔ ni ofee nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni ofee Ahab we lɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ mitsui mli fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, oshwie aaata Israel sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛyashi yinɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehu ediii sɛɛ ni eye Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla lɛ nɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam fee ni ekɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ Israel nane lɛ feemɔ.
Yehu gbele Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dalɛ nɔ bɔ̃i gbɔmɔ.
Hazael ni jɛ Siria lɛ ye Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; kɛjɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he bokãgbɛ aahu kɛtee wuoyigbɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Aroer ni yɔɔ Arnon Faa lɛ he lɛ he.
No ji Gilead kɛ Bashan shikpɔji lɛ, he ni Gadbii kɛ Rubenbii kɛ Bokã Manasebii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Shi Yehu he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yehu gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria, ni ebi Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Ni afii abɔ ni Yehu ye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Yuda Maŋnyɛ Atalia Agbɛnɛ be ni Ahazia nyɛ Atalia na akɛ ebi lɛ egbo lɛ, ete shi ni ekpãtã maŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Shi Ahazia bi Yoash pɛ ji mɔ ni he je mli.
Kulɛ abaagbe lɛ hu kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, shi moŋ enyɛkwɛ̃ ni ji Yehosheba, ni ji maŋtsɛ Yehoram biyoo kɛ Ahazia nyɛmiyoo lɛ, here eyiwala.
Yehosheba ju shi, ni emɔ Yoash kɛ efufɔhãlɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ yatee sɛɛtsu ko mli yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni Atalia akana lɛ ni egbe lɛ.
Ni Yehosheba ŋɔ lɛ eyatee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ afii ekpaa, be mli ni Atalia yeɔ maŋnyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Shi afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Yehoiada tsu atee ni ayaŋɔ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hebulɔi lɛ abahã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ehã amɛkã lɛ kitã yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ bi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni efã amɛ akɛ bɔ ni nyɛfee nɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni baabɔ̃i amɛnitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afee maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi, ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ahi Sur Agbo lɛ naa; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ hu ahi agbo ni yɔɔ bulɔi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ naa, koni nyɛbu maŋtsɛ we lɛ he, ni nyɛfã he.
