Shi nyɛteŋ asafokui enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eyaŋ nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Ni nyɛbɔlea maŋtsɛ Yoash he kɛkpe, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabɛŋkɛ tabilɔi aku lɛ agbe lɛ.
Ni kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ miije kpo jio, eeba shĩa jio, nyɛhĩa ehe.” Ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fee bɔ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã amɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔ ewebii ni baaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni kpaa nitsumɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛba Osɔfo Yehoiada ŋɔɔ.
Ni osɔfo lɛ, ekɔlɔ akplɔi kɛ tsɛŋi ni ji maŋtsɛ David nii ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ ehã mɛi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ.
Ni bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etawuu nii yɛ edɛ̃ŋ, ni amɛdamɔ shi kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛtee maŋtsɛ we lɛ kooyigbɛ kɛbɔle afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he kɛkpe, koni amɛbu maŋtsɛ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehoiada jie maŋtsɛ bi, Yoash, lɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ akekre lɛ fi lɛ, ni eŋɔ kpãŋmɔ wolo ni maŋtsɛyeli he mlai yɔɔ mli lɛ ewo edɛŋ; ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu; ni maŋbii lɛ tswatswaa amɛdɛ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!” Be ni Maŋnyɛ Atalia nu bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he lɛ, eba maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Be ni eyaakwɛ lɛ, naa maŋtsɛ hee lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ naa akulashiŋ lɛ he, bɔ ni ji gbɛnaa lɛ; ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛkpãlɔi yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ masɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ miinya, ni amɛmiikpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Atalia gbala ehe atadei, ni ebolɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋjwaa sane nɛ, maŋjwaa sane nɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada fã asraafoi ohahai anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ Atalia ajea asraafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛyaa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanyiɛ esɛɛ ni aaaba lɛ shɔ̃mɔ lɛ nyɛgbea lɛ.” Ejaakɛ osɔfo lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Akagbe lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ mli kɛmiiya maŋtsɛ we lɛ; shi jɛi amɛgbe lɛ yɛ.
Yehoiada tsake nibii ahiɛ Ni osɔfo Yehoiada hã Maŋtsɛ Yoash kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Yehowa kpãŋ akɛ amɛbaaba amɛjeŋ akɛ Yehowa maŋ.
Ni ehã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ hu kpãŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ ni amɛyabote Baal we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔ Baal we lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Baal afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ emãgãi lɛ amɛkumɔ amɛ dukuduku; ni Mattan, ni ji Baal osɔfo lɛ, amɛgbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfo Yehoiada to gbɛjianɔ ni bulɔi abu Yehowa we lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛjɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛtsɔ Bulɔi Agbo lɛ naa gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛba maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni amɛhã eyata maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.
Akɛni agbe Atalia kɛ klante yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ mli jɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ.
Yoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda be ni eye afii kpawo.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehu maŋtsɛyeli yinɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni Yoash bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Zibia ni jɛ Beersheba lɛ.
Yoash fee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ bei abɔ fɛɛ ni ehi shi lɛ, ejaakɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeŋbii ajamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ akumɔɔɔ ashwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai yɛ jɛi lolo.
Yoash kɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Shika fɛɛ ni ajɔɔ nɔ ake ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ, ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ too ni sa akɛ ewo lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ shika ni mɔ ko jɛɔ etsui mli ekɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahe, yɛ mɔ ni lɛ ele lɛ dɛŋ, koni amɛkɛsaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni sa akɛ asaa lɛ.” Shi eba mli akɛ kɛbashi Yoash maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ esako Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hei ni ekumɔ lɛ eko eko kwraa lolo.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsɛ osɔfo Yehoiada kɛ osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsaaa Yehowa we lɛ tsu koi lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, nyɛkɛ shika ni nyɛheɔ lɛ akatoa dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ nyɛŋɔa nyɛhãa koni akɛsaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.” Osɔfoi lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ amɛheŋ shika yɛ maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni amɛsaŋ Yehowa we lɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni Osɔfo Yehoiada wo adeka ko, ni egbu enaanɔ lɛ mli folɔ, ni ekɛ adeka lɛ ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi.
Kɛji oobote Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ, adeka lɛ ye oninejurɔgbɛ; ni osɔfoi ni kwɛɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ shika fɛɛ ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛwoɔ mli.
Ni ebaa mli akɛ be fɛɛ be kɛji amɛna akɛ shika lɛ efa yɛ adeka lɛ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ baa, ni amɛbakaneɔ shika ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, ni amɛbafimɔɔ shika lɛ amɛwoɔ kotokui amli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛtuɔ shika ni ana lɛ amɛwoɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ; ni amɛ hu amɛkɛwoɔ kapintafoi kɛ tsumalɔi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Yehowa we lɛ anyɔmɔ.
Ni akɛ eko woɔ bliglɛfoi kɛ tɛkolɔi anyɔmɔ, ni akɛ eko heɔ mplaŋi kɛ tɛ ni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ tsukoi lɛ, ni akɛ eko woɔ nyɔmɔ ni abɔɔ yɛ shĩa lɛ saamɔ he lɛ.
Shi shika ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ aŋɔɔɔ no eko akɛfeee Yehowa we lɛ jwiɛtɛi kãi, lagbee nii, lalakãi, tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi aloo shika nii loo jwiɛtɛi nii krokomɛi; shi akɛhãa mɛi ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, koni akɛsaa Yehowa we lɛ.
Akɛni mɛi adɛŋ ni akɛ shika lɛ woɔ lɛ yeɔ anɔkwa hewɔ lɛ, ehe ehiaaa akɛ amɛbuɔ shika lɛ he akɔntaa ko.
Shi shika ni anaa kɛjɛɔ sɔ̃ afɔle kɛ esha afɔle lɛ mli lɛ, akɛ nomɛi baaa Yehowa we lɛ, nomɛi lɛ osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael fã ta kɛba, ni ekɛ Gat, maŋ wulu lɛ, bawu, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Shi be ni Hazael jie ehiɛ eka Yerusalɛm lɛ, Yoash, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi fɛɛ ni etsɛmɛi Yehoshafat kɛ Yehoram kɛ Ahazia, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ni eho lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ eke lɛ, kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, kɛ shika fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ hu, ni etsu akɛyahã Hazael, Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hazael shi Yerusalɛm sɛɛ ni etee.
Agbɛnɛ Yoash he saji kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ Yoash tsuji lɛ te shi, ni amɛkpãŋ eyi nɔ, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ he ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Milo lɛ, yɛ gbɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛyaa Sila lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni tswia lɛ nii ni egbo lɛ ji Yozakar, Shimeat bi lɛ kɛ Yehozabad, Shomer bi lɛ.
Ni amɛfu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yoash bi Amazia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoahaz Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash, Ahazia bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz, Yehu bi lɛ bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo.
Efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, hã Israel fee lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ efee, ni efɔ̃ɔɔ feemɔ.
Ni Yehowa mli wo Israel la, ni no hewɔ lɛ, daa nɛɛ Yehowa tuɔ amɛ ewoɔ Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael kɛ ebi Ben-Hadad dɛŋ.
Shi Yehoahaz kpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa bo lɛ toi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, ena bɔ ni Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ haoɔ Israel ehãa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jie herelɔ ko ehã, koni ebakpɔ̃ amɛ kɛje Siriabii lɛ adɛŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ hi amɛshĩai lɛ amli tamɔ tsutsu lɛ yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam we lɛ fee ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ; shi amɛkã he amɛfee eshai lɛ lolo; ni Ashera amãgã lɛ hu ma Samaria lolo.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz lɛ, asraafoi pɛ ni shwɛ hã lɛ ji okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ tayaa shwiilii nyɔŋma kɛ nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma; ejaakɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ eplene Israelbii lɛ, ni efee amɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ mlu.
Yehoahaz he saji kɛ nibii ni efee kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoahaz gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ yɛ Samaria; ni ebi Yehoash baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yoash yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehoash bɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria.
Eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.
Lɛ hu efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ fee, ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ, shi ekã he efee eshai lɛ lolo.
Ni Yoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee, kɛ ekãa ni efee yɛ ta ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia lɛ wu lɛ mli lɛ, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Yoash gbo ni ebi Yeroboam bata esɛ̃i lɛ nɔ.
Afu Yoash yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi.
Elisha gbele Agbɛnɛ, be ni hela ni baagbe gbalɔ Elisha lɛ mɔ lɛ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yoash tee eŋɔɔ eyasara lɛ.
Eyafo yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsɛ, mitsɛ!
Israel hefãlɔ kpele!” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɔ gãi kɛ emlibii kɛba!” Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɔ gãi kɛ emlibii kɛba eŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ta gãi lɛ!” Ni eta.
Ni Elisha ŋɔ eniji eshwie maŋtsɛ lɛ niji anɔ.
Ni Elisha kɛɛ, “Gbelemɔ bokãgbɛ samflɛ lɛ.” Ni egbele.
Ni Elisha kɛɛ “Tsɛ̃!” Ni etsɛ̃ gãi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Elisha kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kunimyeli gãimlibi kɛ Siria nɔ kunimyeli gãimlibi nɛ, ejaakɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii yɛ Afek kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooplene amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “kɔlɔmɔ gãimlibii lɛ.
Tsɛ̃rɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ gãi!” Ni etsɛ̃rɛ shii etɛ̃, ni ekpa.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli fu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Eji otsɛ̃rɛ shii enumɔ loo shii ekpaa kulɛ, no lɛ obaatswia Siriabii lɛ nii aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni oooplene amɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, shii etɛ̃ pɛ obaaye Siriabii anɔ kunim.” Kɛkɛ ni Elisha gbo, ni afu lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Moab ojoyeli tai lɛ batua Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ nakai afi lɛ mli.
Ni eba mli akɛ, gbi ko be ni amɛyaafu nuu ko lɛ, naa, amɛna ojoyeli ta ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshɛ nuu lɛ gbonyo amɛfɔ̃ Elisha gbonyo bu lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni amɛjo foi.
Ni be ni nuu lɛ gbonyo lɛ he yasa Elisha wui lɛ ahe pɛ, kɛkɛ ni gbonyo lɛ hiɛ tsɛ̃, ni ete shi edamɔ enaji anɔ.
Israel kɛ Siria wu ta Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael hao Israelbii yɛ Yehoahaz maŋtsɛyeli be mli fɛɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni etse ehiɛ ehã amɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kɛ Yakob kɛ Isak ekpãŋ lɛ hewɔ, ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ ehiɛ kpako emaŋ Israel lɛ nɔ kɛbashi benɛ.
Be ni Siria Maŋtsɛ Hazael gbo lɛ, ebi Ben-Hadad baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehoahaz bi lɛ, ye Ben-Hadad, Hazael bi lɛ, nɔ kunim shii etɛ̃, ni eshɔ̃ maji ni Hazael shɔ̃ yɛ etsɛ Yehoahaz dɛŋ yɛ ta mli lɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yoash bi Amazia, bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
Be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yehoadin, ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Efee Yehowa suɔmɔnaanii, kɛ̃lɛ etamɔɔɔ David, mɔ seshi mli ni ejɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni etsɛ Yoash fee lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ efee.
Ekumɔɔɔ wɔŋjamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ miishã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Amazia maŋtsɛyeli he shi lɛ, emɔmɔ tsuji ni gbe etsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni egbe amɛ.
Shi mɛi ni gbe etsɛ lɛ abii lɛ, egbeee amɛ; ejaakɛ edamɔ Yehowa Mla ni ewo yɛ Mose Wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Akagbe fɔlɔi yɛ amɛbii atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, ni asaŋ akagbe bii hu yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, efɔŋ ni eeefee lɛ, no he gbele lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo.” Amazia gbe Edombii asraafoi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni eŋɔ Sela maŋ wulu lɛ yɛ ta mli, ni ewo lɛ Yokteel kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
No mli Amazia tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash, Yehu bi Yehoahaz bi lɛ bi, ŋɔɔ ayatsɛ lɛ ŋa nɔ akɛ, “Ba ni wɔkpe nuu kɛ nuu.” Shi Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash tsu ayakɛɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia akɛ, “Naa, gbi ko lɛ ŋmei tso ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon tsu ayakɛɛ tsenedru tso ni yɔɔ Lebanon akɛ, ‘Ŋɔɔ obiyoo lɛ ohã mibinuu lɛ gbãlã.’ Ni ŋaŋ kooloo ko ni yɔɔ Lebanon lɛ baho, ni ebanaanaa ŋmei tso lɛ nɔ.
Ogbe Edombii, hewɔ lɛ no ehã oowo ohe nɔ.
Okɛ no ashwã; shi okɛ no awa owe lɛ.
Mɛɛba oshwɛɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ he, koni bo okɛ Yuda fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ?” Shi Amazia booo toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash fã kɛtee, ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia yakpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli yɛ Bet-Shemesh ni yɔɔ Yuda nɔ mli lɛ.
Israel ta lɛ ye Yuda ta lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ jo foi kɛtee ewe.
Ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash mɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, yɛ Bet-Shemesh, ni eŋɔ lɛ nom.
Ni eba Yerusalɛm, ni ebakumɔ Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ, kɛjɛ Efraim Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi Koŋ Agbo lɛ naa ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ohai ejwɛ.
Ni eloo shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohei lɛ kɛ nomii hu kɛku esɛɛ kɛtee Samaria.
Yehoash he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii ni efee lɛ, kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia wu ehã lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Yehoash gbo ni afu lɛ yɛ Samaria yɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ.
Ni ebi Yeroboam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia gbele Israel Maŋtsɛ Yehoash gbele sɛɛ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia hi shi eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Amazia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Atee Amazia yinɔ apam koni agbe lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm; no hewɔ lɛ, ejo foi etee Lakish maŋ wulu lɛ mli; shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ tiu lɛ kɛtee Lakish, ni ayagbe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni awo egbonyo lɛ afɔ̃ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni abafu lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ etsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ Azaria, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ Amazia sɛɛ.
Azaria ye Elat nɔ kunim, ni ekpɔ̃ maŋ lɛ ehã Yuda, yɛ etsɛ Amazia gbele sɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Yeroboam ni ji enyɔ lɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amazia, Yoash bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yeroboam, Israel Maŋtsɛ Yohoash bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekome.
Ni efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ni efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Yereboam, Nebat bi lɛ fee, ni no hã Israelbii fee esha lɛ.
Lɛ ehã Israel husui lɛ shɛ amɛdɛŋ ekoŋŋ, kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashi ŋa kplenee lɛ nɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ naa, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ etsulɔ Yona, Amitai bi gbalɔ ni jɛ Gat-Hefer lɛ, nɔ ewie lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa na akɛ Israel amanehulu ni enaa lɛ naa wa naakpa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni ji nyɔŋ aloo mɔ ni hiɛ ehe, ni aaaye abua Israel.
Shi akɛni Yehowa ekɛko akɛ eeegbe Israel gbɛi yɛ ŋwɛi shishi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ Yeroboam, Yoash bi lɛ, nine nɔ ehere amɛyiwala.
Agbɛnɛ Yeroboam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ ekãa ni efee kɛ bɔ ni ewuwuu tai kɛ bɔ ni eshɔ̃ Damasko kɛ Hamat lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yeroboam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ, ni ebi Zakaria baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Uzia Israel maŋtsɛ Yeroboam yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda maŋtsɛ Amazia bi Azaria, mɔ ni gbɛi kroko ji Uzia lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yekolia ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpa, be ni ebabɔi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Ni Azaria fee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Amazia fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ ekumɔɔɔ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai yɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.
Ni Yehowa kɛ hela fɔŋ piŋ maŋtsɛ Azaria, ni eye kpiti kɛyashi egbele gbi; aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ koni ehi maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Ni maŋtsɛ Azaria bi Yotam kwɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ Azaria he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Ni Azaria gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, kɛkɛ ni ebi Yotam baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Zakaria Yuda maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ Zakaria baye Israel nɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Samaria nyɔji ekpaa.
Zakaria efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebal bi Yeroboam fee ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ.
Ni Yabesh bi Shalum tee Maŋtsɛ Zakaria yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ yɛ maŋ hiɛ, kɛkɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Zakaria he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Belɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yehu wie akɛ, “Oshwiei lɛ aaata Israel sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ,” na ba mli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Shalum Yabesh bi Shalum baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Yuda maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔŋ kome yɛ Samaria.
Gadi bi Menahem yiŋ kɛjɛ Tirza kɛba Samaria, ni ebatswa Yabesh bi Shalum nɔ yɛ Samaria, ni egbe lɛ; kɛkɛ ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Shalum he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ apam ni etee lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Be ni Menahem jɛ Tirza eyaa lɛ, eyatswia Tapua kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli kɛ ekpokpaianɔbii fɛɛ nii; ejaakɛ amɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ he amɛhãaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, etswia amɛ nii, ni emli yeihɔlɔi lɛ egbalagbalaa amɛmli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Menahem Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gadi bi Menahem babɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma yɛ Samaria.
Shi efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.
Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser batua Israel, ni Menahem hã Tiglat Pileser jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe koni ewa lɛ ni ehã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi yɛ Israel.
Menahem tsu Israelbii lɛ too, niiatsɛmɛi wuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hã jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni akɛhã Tiglat Pileser, Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ, ni etuaaa Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Menahem he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Menahem gbo, ni afu lɛ, yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi, ni ebi Pekahia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Pekahia Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Menahem bi Pekahia bɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.
Ni Remalia bi Peka, ni ji Pekahia asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ, tee Pekahia yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ yɛ Samaria, yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Gilead hii nyɔŋmai enumɔ fata Peka he; kɛkɛ ni Peka ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Pekahia sɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Pekahia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ Remalia bi Peka bɔ̃i Israel nɔ maŋtsɛyeli, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ yɛ Samaria.
Efee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eshai ni Nebat bi Yeroboam fee, ni no hã Israelbii lɛ fee esha lɛ feemɔ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka yinɔ lɛ Tiglat-Pileser, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, fã ta kɛba Israel.
Ebaŋɔ Gilead kɛ Galilea shikpɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmli maji nɛɛ: Iyon, Abel-Bet-Maaka, Yanoa, Kedesh, Hazor.
Eŋɔ Naftali shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ Israelbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nom kɛtee Asiria.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yotam yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ela bi Hoshea tee Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ apam, ni etswa lɛ nɔ egbe lɛ, ni ebaye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Agbɛnɛ Peka he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, naa, aŋma yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yotam Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Azaria bi Yotam baye maŋtsɛ.
Ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yerusha, Zadok biyoo lɛ.
Efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; bɔ ni etsɛ Azaria fee lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ efee.
Kɛ̃lɛ ekumɔɔɔ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ eshwieee shi; maŋbii lɛ kã he amɛmiishã afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai yɛ jamɔhei ni yɔɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ lolo.
Yotam ji mɔ ni tswa Kooyigbɛ Agbo ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yotam he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli Yehowa hã Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, batua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Yotam gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Yerusalɛm; kɛkɛ ni ebi Ahaz baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Ahaz ye Yuda Maŋtsɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yotam bi Ahaz bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda.
No mli lɛ Ahaz eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa.
Efeee nɔ ni ja yɛ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ekɔɔɔ eblematsɛ David su kpakpa lɛ.
Efee esha fe Israel maŋtsɛmɛi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ lɛ tete.
Egbe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋbi ekɛshã afɔle ehã amãgãi, nɔ ko ni Yehowa hiɔ, ni no hã eshwie jeŋmajiabii lɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
Eshãshãa afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai yɛ amãgãi ajamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ kɛ gɔji anɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi hu.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Israel Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, fã ta, ni amɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm bawu.
Amɛbasa Ahaz yi, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ enɔ kunim amɛye.
Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Siria Maŋtsɛ Rezin saa eshɔ̃ Elat maŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni eshwie Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Edombii bahi jɛi, ni amɛyɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz tsu bɔfoi kɛtee Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pileser ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, “Otsulɔ kɛ obi ji mi.
Ba ni obahere mi yɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ni ete shi ewo mi lɛ, adɛŋ.” Ahaz ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohe lɛ mli hu, ni ekɛtsu ni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ Tiglat Pileser.
Tiglat Pileser fee nɔ ni Ahaz babi lɛ lɛ.
Efã ta eyatua Damasko, ni eye enɔ, ni egbe Maŋtsɛ Rezin, ni eŋɔ Damaskobii lɛ nom kɛtee Kir.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz yiŋ kɛtee Damasko koni ekɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ, Tiglat-Pileser ayakpe.
Ahaz yana afɔleshãa latɛ ko yɛ Damasko.
Ehã atɛŋ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ su, bɔ ni eyɔɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni ekɛtsu akɛyahã osɔfo Uria.
Ni Osɔfo Uria ma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni akɛmaje lɛ lɛ henɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ema egbe naa dani Maŋtsɛ Ahaz jɛ Damasko eba.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz jɛ Damasko eba lɛ, ebana afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ahaz tsi ebɛŋkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee ehe, ni eshã eshãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔlei yɛ nɔ, efɔse edãa afɔle lɛ eshwie nɔ, ni eŋɔ eshidaa afɔlei lɛ alá lɛ eshwã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, Ahaz tsi kɛje Yehowa we lɛ hiɛgbɛ he ni ema, yɛ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ Yehowa we lɛ teŋ lɛ, ni ekɛyama lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kooyigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fã Osɔfo Uria akɛ, “Mifɔleshãa latɛ wulu nɛɛ nɔ oshã afɔlei nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ: leebi shãa afɔle lɛ kɛ gbɛkɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ shãa afɔle kɛ eniyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shãa afɔlei lɛ, kɛ amɛniyenii afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛdãa afɔlei lɛ.
Oŋɔ shãa afɔlei alá lɛ kɛ afɔlei krokomɛi lɛ alá lɛ fɛɛ oshwã nɔ.
Shi akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, no ahi shi ahã mi koni mikɛbi Yehowa nii.” Osɔfo Uria fee bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Ahaz fãmɔ akɔɔble shwiili ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ anaji lɛ, ni ehole tsɛnsii ni mamɔɔ nɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ.
Ewo akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ lɛ hu yɛ akɔɔble tsinai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akotosɛɛ, ni eŋɔ ma tɛi ni akɛka shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ gbɛ ni aha eyiteŋ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli (ni maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ kɛboteɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ) kɛ maŋtsɛ tsɔ̃mɔhe ni yɔɔ agbonaa gbɛ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Ahaz tsɔ̃ amɛnaa ehã he kroko.
Agbɛnɛ Ahaz he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Egbo ni afu lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ amasɛi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ebi Hezekia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahaz yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ela bi Hoshea babɔ̃i Israel maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Samaria.
Ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nɛɛhu.
Efee esha yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, kɛ̃lɛ enɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ Israel maŋtsɛmɛi ni tsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser batua Israel, ni Hoshea tsɔ̃ Shalmaneser tsulɔ, ni daa afi lɛ Hoshea woɔ too ehãa lɛ.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ Hoshea kpa too lɛ woo, kɛkɛ ni eyabi So, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ koni etse atua.
Be ni Shalmaneser na le enɛ lɛ, etsu ayamɔ Hoshea, ni ewo lɛ tsuŋ.
Samaria Shigbeemɔ Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser fã ta ebatua Israel, ni ebasa Samaria yi afii etɛ̃.
Hoshea yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Samaria.
Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ Israelbii nom kɛtee Asiria; eŋɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛtee Hala maŋ wulu lɛ mli; ekɛ mɛi komɛi hu tee Habor Faa lɛ naa yɛ Gozan kpokpai anɔ; ekɛ mɛi komɛi hu tee Media maji wuji lɛ amli.
Samaria gbee shi, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ fee esha shi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ Farao, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ.
Amɛyanyiɛ jeŋmaji ni Yehowa shwie amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ akusumi lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛyaye Israel maŋtsɛmɛi srɔtoi lɛ akusumi ni amɛsɔ̃sɔ̃ɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ni Israelbii lɛ fee nii ni ejaaa gbɛ amɛshi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Amɛmamɔ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi amɛhã amɛhe yɛ amɛmajimaji lɛ fɛɛ amli, amɛmamɔ kɛjɛ bulɔi amɔɔ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ kɛtee maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ mli.
Ni amɛfee Ashera amãgãi, ni amɛfee wɔŋkoi yɛ gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi.
Ni amɛshãshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ jamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋmaji ni Yehowa shwie amɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ lɛ fee lɛ; ni amɛfee nibii fɔ̃ji amɛkɛwo Yehowa mlila.
Ni amɛja wɔji ni tsɛbelɛ Yehowa ewo amɛ shi yɛ he akɛ, “Nyɛkafea nɛkɛ nɔ ko” lɛ.
Yehowa tsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ ninalɔi lɛ anɔ, ni ebɔ Israel kɛ Yuda kɔkɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛgbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛyea mikitãi lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, kitãi fɛɛ ni mitsɔ̃ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni nyɛ hu gbalɔi lɛ kɛba hã nyɛ lɛ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi; amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ni heee Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛyeee lɛ.
Amɛkwa ekpɔi lɛ kɛ ekpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ, kɛ kɔkɔ ni ebɔ amɛ lɛ.
Amɛyaja yakayaka amãgãi, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ yaka gbɔmɛi; ni amɛyanyiɛ jeŋmaji ni ebɔle amɛ kɛkpe ni Yehowa ewo amɛ kitã yɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛkafee amɛnii tamɔ amɛ lɛ asɛɛ.
Ni amɛkwa Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ, ni amɛfee shika tsinabii enyɔ amãgã amɛhã amɛhe.
Amɛfee Ashera amãgã, ni amɛja ŋulamii, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Baal.
Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei amɛshãshãa afɔle amɛhã jemawɔji, amɛkala, ni amɛsaa amɛyeyee ŋkunyai.
Amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛhe amɛhã efɔŋfeemɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛkɛwo Yehowa mli la.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu Israel naakpa, ni ehã aŋɔ amɛ nom; eshwɛɛɛ akutso ko akutso ko akɛ ja Yuda akutso lɛ kɛkɛ.
Shi Yudabii lɛ hu yeee Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ amɛyanyiɛ Israelbii lɛ akusumi lɛ asɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kwa Israel kɛ Yuda shwiei lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehã amɛna amanehulu, ni egbala amɛtoi, ni etu amɛ ewo nihalɔi adɛŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ ehiɛ.
Be ni Yehowa tse Israel kɛjɛ Yuda he lɛ, Israelbii lɛ wo Yeroboam, Nebat bi lɛ, amɛmaŋtsɛ.
Yeroboam hã Israel je Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ehã amɛfee esha kpeteŋkple.
Israelbii lɛ yanyiɛ eshai ni Yeroboam fee lɛ nɔŋŋ sɛɛ, ni amɛkpaleee kɛjeee he, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa shwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ kwraa tamɔ bɔ ni ewie kɛtsɔ̃ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, aŋɔ Israelbii anom kɛje amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛtee Asiria, ni jɛi amɛyɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Asiriabii bahi shi yɛ Israel Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yaŋɔ mɛi kɛjɛ Babilon kɛ Kuta kɛ Ava kɛ Hamat kɛ Sefarwaim, ni ekɛ amɛ ba Israel; ni amɛbahi maji ni kulɛ Israelbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ hi lɛ.
Ni amɛŋɔ Samaria maŋ wulu lɛ hu amɛfata he.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni amɛbahi jɛi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, amɛjaaa Yehowa; no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã jatai yabote amɛteŋ, ni amɛgbegbee amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, ayakɛɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ bii ni oyaloo obato Israel maji lɛ amli lɛ, amɛleee shikpɔŋ ni amɛbato nɔ lɛ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, etsu jatai kɛba maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ni naa, amɛgbegbee maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi, ejaakɛ amɛleee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaa nii.” Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ fã akɛ, “Nyɛhãa osɔfoi ni nyɛyaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ayaa ni eyahi jɛi, koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Samaria kɛtee Asiria lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome tee, ni eyahi Betel, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni amɛja Yehowa amɛhã.
Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ bii ni aloo amɛ kɛtee Israel nɛɛ feefee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ amɛto jamɔhei grɔŋŋi ni Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ efee momo lɛ.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ bii kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔ lɛ to hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ.
Babilonbii lɛ fee Sukot Benot, ni Kutabii lɛ fee Nergal, ni Hamatbii lɛ fee Ashima, ni Avabii lɛ fee Nibhaz kɛ Tartak; ni Sefarwaimbii lɛ kɛ amɛmusuŋbii shãshãa afɔle amɛhãhãa amɛnyɔŋmɔi ni ji Adramelek kɛ Anamelek.
Amɛja amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfeɔ momo dani aŋɔ amɛ kɛba Israel lɛ.
Amɛja Yehowa hu, shi moŋ amɛhala amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi nɔŋŋ, ni amɛwo amɛ osɔfoi yɛ amɛjamɔ hei lɛ; ni osɔfoi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni shãa afɔlei amɛhãa maŋbii lɛ yɛ jamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛjaa Yehowa, ni asaŋ amɛjaa amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔmɔi lɛ hu, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni ayaloo amɛ kɛjɛ mli kɛba lɛ akusumi yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkã he amɛmiifee nakai kusumi lɛ lolo.
Amɛjaaa Yehowa kome pɛ kɛkɛ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi kɛ kitãi ni Yehowa wo Yakob shwiei lɛ anɔ.
Yakob mɔ ni Yehowa tsake egbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Israel lɛ.
Yehowa kɛ amɛ kpãŋ, ni ewo amɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni nyɛkakotoa amɛ hu, ni nyɛkasɔmɔa amɛ, ni nyɛkashãa afɔle nyɛhãa amɛ.
Shi moŋ nyɛjaa Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ hewalɛ kpele kpɔ̃ nyɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ.
Lɛ nyɛjaa, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛshãa afɔle nyɛhãa.
Ni akpɔi kɛ gbɛnaanii kɛ mla kɛ kitã ni eŋma ehã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛyea nɔ daa nɛɛ.
Nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Ni kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ.
Nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Nyɛjaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni lɛ ebaajie nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ adɛŋ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi, ni amɛkã he amɛfee amɛsá nii lɛ nɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ jeŋmaji nɛɛ ja Yehowa, shi amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛmãgãi lɛ hu.
Amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii hu, bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛfeɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea, Ela bi lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, Yuda Maŋtsɛ Ahaz bi Hezekia baye maŋtsɛ.
Hezekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ nɛɛhu yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Abi, Zakaria biyoo lɛ.
Ni efee nɔ ni ja yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛ David fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Lɛ efite hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, ni ekumɔ amãgãi lɛ, ni egba Ashera wɔŋkoo lɛ.
Ni ekumɔ akɔɔble onufu ni Mose fee lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛbashi nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ shãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa onufu lɛ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nehushtan.
Hezekia ŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ni baye nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ninaaa lɛ.
Eye Yehowa anɔkwa; ni ejeee Yehowa sɛɛ, ni eye kitãi ni Yehowa wo Mose lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ eyayeɔ omanye.
Etse Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua, ni esɔ̃mɔɔɔ lɛ.
Lɛ etswia Filistibii lɛ anii kɛyashwie Gaza kɛ ekpokpai lɛ anɔ tɔ̃ɔ, kɛjɛ akrowa bibioo nɔ kɛyashi maŋ wulu ni atswa gbogbo awo he nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea, Ela bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Shalmaneser fã batua Samaria ni ji Israel maŋ wulu lɛ.
Ni afii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji ekpaa, ni ji Israel Maŋtsɛ Hoshea yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, aŋɔ Samaria.
Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Israelbii lɛ nom kɛtee Asiria, ni eŋɔ amɛteiaŋ mɛi komɛi eyato Hala maŋ wulu lɛ mli, yɛ Habor Faa lɛ naa yɛ Gozan kpokpai lɛ nɔ; akɛ mɛi komɛi tee Media maji wuji lɛ amli hu.
Samaria gbee shi ejaakɛ amɛbooo Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi, ni amɛtɔ̃ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ kitãi fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsulɔ Mose wo amɛ lɛ nɔ; amɛbooo toi, ni amɛyeee nɔ hu.
Asiriabii lɛ wo Yerusalɛm he gbeyei Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib fã ebatua Yuda maji ni atswa gbogboi awo he lɛ fɛɛ, ni eŋɔ maji lɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsu ayakɛɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib yɛ Lakish akɛ, “Mitɔ̃, hewɔ lɛ ofainɛ ni oku osɛɛ oya, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooohe mi lɛ mawo.” Ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia abahã lɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai ohai etɛ̃ kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔ jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nitoohei lɛ ehã.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Hezekia kpɔlɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ shinai kɛ shinaatsei lɛ ahe shika nii ni lɛ Hezekia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ eŋɔ ha he lɛ, ni eŋɔ fɛɛ ehã Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu Tartan kɛ Rabsaris kɛ Rabshake kɛ ta babaoo kɛjɛ Lakish kɛtee Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Be ni amɛyashɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛyadamɔ ŋwɛigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ nujɔɔ lɛ masɛi, yɛ niiahefɔlɔi abɔɔ lɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni amɛtsɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Hilkia bi Eliakim ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa lɛ, kɛ Shibna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ Asaf bi Yoa ni ji maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, je kpo tee amɛŋɔɔ.
Rabshake kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple, ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mɛni nɔ kwraa po oŋɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ naafuu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji tawuu he ŋaatoo, loo no ji hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo?
Namɔ nɔ po ohiɛ kã, hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atua nɛɛ?
Naa, oŋɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Ijipt nɔ, nakai glã ni eku momo, ni kɛji akpasa lɛ ni egbuɔ mɔ dɛ̃ kɛjeɔ kpo lɛ.
Nakai Farao, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ.’ ” Shi kɛji nyɛaakɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ moŋ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ!
Ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia jie, ni ekɛɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ nɛɛ hiɛ nyɛjaa yɛ, yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ?’ ” Agbɛnɛ ba, koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ abata abasa, ni majie okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ mahã bo, akɛ ooona bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi otara amɛnɔ lo?
Te ooofee tɛŋŋ ohã minuŋtsɔ tsuji bibii lɛ ateŋ asafoiatsɛ kome atsɔ̃ esɛɛ ahã bo lɛ; kɛji bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ohiɛnɔkãmɔ fɛɛ yɛ Ijipt kɛ etayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ?
Asaŋ, ani osusuɔ akɛ mije Yehowa sɛɛ, ni mifã mibatua oshikpɔŋ lɛ ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ ni Yehowa leee he eko lo?
Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Fãa ni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Hilkia bi Eliakim kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Rabshake akɛ, “Ofainɛ, okɛ wɔ otsuji lɛ awie yɛ Arambii awiemɔ mli, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ; shi okɛ wɔ akawie Hebribii awiemɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ miibo toi.” Shi Rabshake kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani osusuɔ akɛ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi bo kɛ onuŋtsɔ pɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ?
Ani jeee hii lɛ ni tara gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu aŋɔɔ etsu mi, mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ akɛ ja amɛye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ ni amɛnu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshãmɔ lɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Rabshake ho edamɔ shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee waa yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Nyɛboa maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ gbee toi.
Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkahãa Hezekia milakaa nyɛ; ejaakɛ enyɛŋ ejie nyɛ kɛje midɛŋ.
Ni nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ akɛ, Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala kɛ̃, ni atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ!’ Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi!
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ mi abakpãtãa, ni nyɛjea kpo kɛbaa miŋɔɔ.
No dani nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye ewain tso kɛ egbami tso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanu enubu mli nu, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maba ni mabaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, abele kɛ wain shikpɔŋ, aboloo kɛ waintromi ashikpɔŋ, mutsei kɛ wo shikpɔŋ nɔ; ni nyɛyi aaana wala ni nyɛgboiŋ.
Ni nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi, kɛji eelaka nyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala lɛ.
Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ Sefarwaim kɛ Hena kɛ Iva nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala yɛ midɛŋ?
Te shikpɔji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala yɛ midɛŋ?
Ni mɛni hã nyɛsusuɔ akɛ Yehowa aaanyɛ ehere Yerusalɛm yiwala yɛ midɛŋ lɛ?’ ” Shi maŋbii lɛ etswaaa amɛsɛŋ, ni amɛfooo edaaŋ; ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ewo amɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkafoa edaaŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni Hilkia bi Eliakim, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Asaf bi Yoa ni ji maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtadei ni etserɛ, ni amɛyagba lɛ wiemɔi ni Rabshake, Asiria asafoiatsɛ lɛ, wie lɛ.
Hezekia yabi Yesaia dɛŋ ŋaawoo Eba mli akɛ be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ ekɛ dɔlɛ gbala etadei yɛ ehe, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eyiŋ etee Yehowa we lɛ.
Ni etsu Eliakim ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa lɛ kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ onukpai lɛ ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛtee gbalɔ Yesaia Amoz bi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Haomɔ kɛ jɛmɔ kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe ni ejwa ahoso, shi ebɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfɔɔ.
Eko lɛ Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ enu Rabshake wiemɔi fɛɛ ni enuŋtsɔ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛtsu lɛ koni ekɛbabɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ahora lɛ, ni Yehowa baakã ehiɛ yɛ wiemɔi ni Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ enu lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, sɔlemɔ okpa fai ohã wɔmaŋbii ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ lɛ.” Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsuji lɛ ba Yesaia ŋɔɔ lɛ, Yesaia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei yɛ wiemɔi ni onu ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbabɔ musu kɛshi mi lɛ hewɔ.
Naa, mikɛ mumɔ ko baawo emli, ni eeenu adafitswaa ko, ni eeeku esɛɛ kɛaatee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mahã enyɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” Asiriabii wo Hezekia he gbeyei ekoŋŋ Kɛkɛ ni Rabshake, Asiria asafoiatsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ, ni eyanina Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Libna maŋ wulu lɛ miiwu; ejaakɛ enu akɛ efã kɛjɛ Lakish kɛtee jɛi.
Be ni Asiriabii lɛ nu akɛ Ijipt ta ni Kush Maŋtsɛ Tirhaka nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ miiba abatua amɛ lɛ, esaa etsu bɔfoi kɛba Hezekia ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ; akɛ Bɔ ni nyɛyakɛɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nɛ, “Kaahã oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ohiɛ kã enɔ lɛ miilaka bo akɛ, ‘Akɛ Yerusalɛm woŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.’ Naa, bo diɛŋtsɛ onu nibii ni Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efee shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni ekpãtã amɛhiɛ butubutu lɛ; ni bo, ni ebaahere oyiwala lo?
Mitsɛmɛi lɛ kpãtã Gozanbii kɛ Haranbii kɛ Resefbii ashikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbe Betedenbii ni yɔɔ Telasar lɛ.
Ani amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ here amɛyiwala lo?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Arpad kɛ Sefarwaim kɛ Hena kɛ Ivah yɔɔ?” Be ni Hezekia he woji lɛ yɛ tsuji lɛ adɛŋ ni ekane lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ, ni Hezekia yagbele wolo lɛ mli efɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ni Hezekia yasɔle ekpa Yehowa fai akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, bo mɔ ni oyeɔ lumɔ yɛ kerubim lɛ anɔ, bo okome too ji Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Bo obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.
Gboo otoi shi ni obo mi toi.
Gbɛɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ Yehowa, ni okwɛ!
Onu wiemɔi ni Sankerib kɛtsu ni akɛbaye bo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ohe fɛo lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, eji anɔkwale lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efite jeŋ majimaji lɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ, ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛshwie la mli; ejaakɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ji nomɛi; shi moŋ gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni, tsei kɛ tɛi ni, no hewɔ ni amɛfite amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, bo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, miikpa bo fai, heremɔ wɔyiwala kɛjɛ edɛŋ, koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ana ale akɛ bo, Yehowa, okome too pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.” Yesaia wiemɔ ni akɛyahã Maŋtsɛ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Amoz bi Yesaia tsu kɛba Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.
Fai ni okpa mi yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ, minu.
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Sankerib he nɛ: Yerusalɛm, Zion biyoo oblayoo foro lɛ, gbeɔ ohe guɔ, eliɔ bo, eŋmɔɔ bo yɛ osɛɛ.
“Namɔ ahora obɔ, ni owie musubɔɔ wiemɔi oshi lɛ lɛ?
Namɔ obolɔ owo lɛ; ni namɔ ogbɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ owo lɛ?
Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni!
Obɔfoi lɛ anɔ otsɔ̃ ni obabɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahora, ni okɛɛ, ‘Mikɛ mita shwiilii ekwɔ kɛtee gɔji ayiteiaŋ kɛtee Lebanon sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mifolɔ emli tsenedru tsei ni kwɔlɔ lɛ kɛ emli sɛsɛoi ni hi lɛ mishwie shi, ni mibote ekoo hayii lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Mitsatsaa bui, ni minu maŋsɛɛ nui, mikɛ minanetsitsi hã Ijipt fai fɛɛ miimii.’ “Ani onuko akɛ nakai mifeɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe?
Nakai mito miyiŋ kɛjɛ blema beebe, nɔ ni miha eba mli ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
No ji akɛ akpãtã maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ ahiɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i koikoi, be mli ni amɛmli bii ahewalɛ etã, ni amɛtsui efã, ni amɛlului.
Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi kɛ baa fɔbii kɛ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi hu, loo abele tso ni edaaa, ni eŋala.
“Mile oshitee kɛ oshitamɔ kɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ kɛ ogrimɔ ni ogri owo mi lɛ hu.
Akɛni ogri owo mi, ni oshwãa lɛ ekwɔ kɛbashɛ mitoiŋ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ mikpoŋ baawo ogugɔŋ, ni mikɛ mimanyoflɛ baawo odaaŋ, ni mikpala bo kɛku sɛɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Ni enɛ baafee okadi ahã bo.
Afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛaaye nii ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkwɛ̃, ni afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli hu, nyɛaaye nii ni kwɛ̃ yɛ nomɛi asɛɛ lɛ; shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛdua nii ni nyɛkpaa; ni nyɛfea waintromi hu ni nyɛyea emli yibii.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ ni hiɛ kã yɛ Yuda we lɛ, amɛaatsɛ̃rɛ fãi ekoŋŋ kɛya su mli tɔ̃ɔ tamɔ waintso, ni amɛaawo yibii.
Ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ baashwɛ kɛaajɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Zion aba ni amɛhiɛ kã, ejaakɛ Yehowa eto akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ ebaafee enɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ lɛ he nɛ, ‘Ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni etsɛ̃ŋ gãi kuli kome gaŋŋ ewoŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli.
Ni asraafoi ni hiɛ tsɛŋi bɛŋkɛŋ maŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kotokui ni shia yɔɔ mli efeŋ tasu kɛsa maŋ lɛ yi.
Gbɛ ni etsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nɔ eeetsɔ̃ kɛaaku esɛɛ, ni ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã maŋ nɛɛ he, ni mahere eyiwala, yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiɛ nyam hewɔ, kɛ shi ni miwo mitsulɔ David lɛ hu hewɔ.’ ” Maŋtsɛ Sankerib gbele Ni eba mli akɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, Yehowa bɔfo ko tee Asiria asraafoi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli, ni eyagbe asraafoi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni je tsɛreɔ lɛ, naa amɛ ni amɛjwere shi ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ Sankerib shi jɛi kɛtee Nineve eyahi jɛi.
Ni eba mli akɛ gbi ko be ni ejaa yɛ enyɔŋmɔ Nisrok we lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emusuŋ bihii enyɔ, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer, yagbe lɛ kɛ klante, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Ararat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebinuu kroko, Esar-Hadon, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia heyeli kɛ ehewalɛnamɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, Hezekia he baye ni eehe egbo.
Ni gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Too owe lɛ gbɛjianɔ, ejaakɛ obaagbo, onaŋ hewalɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia tsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbogbo, ni ekpa Yehowa fai ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni misɔ̃mɔ bo, ni miye bo anɔkwa kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni mifee nɔ ni ja yɛ ohiɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fo waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni Yesaia kɛɛ ejeɔ kpo yɛ mɔɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ: “Kũu osɛɛ ni oyakɛɛ Hezekia, mimaŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ lɛ, akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa, otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, minu ofaikpamɔ lɛ, ni mina ohiɛ yaafonu lɛ; naa, mibatsa bo; ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, ooonyiɛ onane nɔ kɛaaya Yehowa we lɛ.
Maŋɔ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ mafata ogbii lɛ ahe.
Asaŋ mahere bo kɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ yiwala kɛaajɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.
Mafã maŋ nɛɛ he yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ kɛ shi ni miwo mitsulɔ David lɛ hu hewɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ agbãmi adufao abaa!
Aŋɔ eko akɛto asane lɛ nɔ, ni ehe baawa lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia bi Yesaia akɛ, “Mɛni ji okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa baatsa mi, ni biɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ manyɛ manyiɛ minane nɔ kɛya Yehowa we lɛ?” Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ aaafee okadi ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã bo, akɛ Yehowa baaye eshi ni ewo bo lɛ nɔ.
Ani ooosumɔ akɛ atrakpoi lɛ asusuma ni kã atswere lɛ nɔ lɛ atsi kɛya hiɛ nane fãamɔi nyɔŋma aloo eba sɛɛsɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma?” Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, “Ewaaa hãaa susuma lɛ akɛ eeeya hiɛhiɛ nane fãamɔi nyɔŋma lɛ, shi moŋ, hã susuma lɛ aba sɛɛsɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Yesaia sɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni Yehowa hã susuma ni etee hiɛhiɛ momo lɛ ba sɛɛsɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz atrakpoi lɛ anɔ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.
Tsuji ni jɛ Babilon lɛ Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi ni ji Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, nu akɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he miiye, hewɔ lɛ eŋma lɛ wolo, ni ekɛ nikeenii fata he ekɛtsu tsuji akɛyahã lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia here mɛi ni atsu eŋɔɔ lɛ atuu, ni eŋɔ ejwetri ni eyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ejwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsofakɛŋma, kɛ mui ni jara wa kɛ etawuu nibii lɛ atoohe fɛɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ewe lɛ loo enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ he ko he ko ni Hezekia kɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbalɔ Yesaia ba Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ kɛba, ni mɛni wiemɔ amɛkɛba?” Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, “Amɛjɛ Babilon tɔ̃ɔ kɛba.” Gbalɔ Yesaia bi akɛ, “Mɛni amɛna yɛ owe lɛ mli?” Ni Hezekia hã hetoo akɛ, “Amɛna nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ minitoohei lɛ ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Bo Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
‘Naa, gbii miiba, be ni abaaloo nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ owe lɛ kɛ nibii ni otsɛmɛi lɛ ebua naa eto kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛaatee Babilon, ni ashiŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko.’ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Asaŋ bo diɛŋtsɛ omusuŋbii lɛ ekomɛi tete lɛ, aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee; ni aaafee amɛ osaii ni baasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.” Hezekia nu Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ shishi akɛ, toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ shweshweeshwefeemɔ baaba yɛ lɛ Hezekia lɛ ebe mli; no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, “Yehowa wiemɔ ni owie lɛ, wiemɔ jurɔ ni.” Hezekia gbele Agbɛnɛ Hezekia he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ ekãa ni efee lɛ kɛ kpaakpo kɛ ehe nujɔɔ ni efee ni ekɛtsɛ nu kɛba Yerusalɛm lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Hezekia gbo, ni ebi Manase baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Manase Manase eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Yuda; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hefziba.
Nihii nii ni jeŋmaji lɛ fee ni Yehowa shwie amɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, nomɛi moŋ Manase fee.
Ejaakɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni etsɛ Hezekia fite lɛ esaa emamɔ ekoŋŋ.
Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni akɛshã afɔle ahã Baal; ni efee jemawɔŋ yoo Ashera amãgã tamɔ bɔ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Ahab fee lɛ.
Asaŋ Manase ja ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ, ni esɔ̃mɔ amɛ hu.
Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ehã jemawɔji yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, he ni Yehowa ekɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, “Yerusalɛm ji he ni aaaja mi yɛ” lɛ.
Emamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ehã ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi enyɔ lɛ anɔ.
Egbe emusuŋbi ekɛshã afɔle; ekala, ni eye ŋkunyaa; ni eto sisatsɛlɔi kɛ wɔjiatsɛmɛi.
Efee efɔɔji babaoo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ekɛwo Yehowa mli la.
Ekɛ jemawɔŋyoo Ashera lɛ amãgã ni efee lɛ yama Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, he ni Yehowa kɛ David kɛ Solomon wie yɛ he akɛ, “Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ ji he ni miŋɔ yɛ Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ akɛ he ni aja mi yɛ kɛya naanɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mihaŋ Israel afã enane kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni miŋɔ mihã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ, ni eyatsomlo dɔŋŋ; kɛji amɛjwɛŋ nɔ, ni amɛye kitãi fɛɛ ni miwo amɛ lɛ, kɛ mlai fɛɛ ni mitsulɔ Mose wo amɛ lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ.” Shi Israel booo toi; ni Manase laka amɛ, ni amɛfee efɔŋ fe jeŋmaji ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ tete.
Shi Yehowa tsɔ̃ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ewie akɛ, “Akɛni Manase, Yuda maŋtsɛ, tsu nɛkɛ nihiinii nɛɛ, ni efee efɔŋ fe nii ni Amorbii ni tsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fee lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekɛ ewɔji lɛ hã Yuda hu fee esha hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mikɛ nɔ fɔŋ baaba Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda nɔ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ etoii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ mli aaafee lɛ heŋŋ.’ Ni magbala Yerusalɛm toi tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Samaria lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Israel maŋtsɛ Ahab kɛ eshwiei lɛ.
Mabɛɛ Yerusalɛmbii fɛɛ mashwie tamɔ atsumɔɔ kã mli keŋkeŋ, ni atsɔ̃ɔ abuɔ shi lɛ.
Ni makwa miwebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ, ni matu amɛ mawo amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ nomii, ni aaaha amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛfee efɔŋ ni mihiɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛwowoo mimli la kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ je Ijipt lɛ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.” Ni asaŋ Manase kpãtã mɛi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ahiɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yerusalɛm he fɛɛ he yi tɔ kɛ la; dani esoro esha ni ehã Yuda fee, esha ni eji efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Manase he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni efee kɛ esha ni efee lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Manase gbo, ni afu lɛ yɛ Uza abɔɔ ni bɛŋkɛ maŋtsɛ shĩa lɛ mli; ni ebi Amon baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Amon Amon eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni eye maŋtsɛ afii enyɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Meshulemet; Haruz ni jɛ Yotba lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Lɛ hu eba ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ Manase ba ejeŋ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɛ ni etsɛ nyiɛ nɔ lɛ, lɛ hu enyiɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni esɔ̃mɔ wɔji ni etsɛ sɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni eja amɛ.
Ekwa Yehowa, etsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ebaaa ejeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ lɛ.
Ni Amon tsuji lɛ tee eyinɔ apam, ni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ.
Shi maŋbii lɛ gbe mɛi fɛɛ ni tee maŋtsɛ Amon yinɔ apam lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ wo ebi Yosia maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Amon he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nii ni efee lɛ, aŋma yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Afũ Amon yɛ efuuhe lɛ yɛ Uza trom lɛ mli; ni ebi Yosia baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia Yosia eye afi kpaanyɔ be ni ebɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli.
Eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Yedida, ni Adaia ni jɛ Bozkat lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yosia fee jalɛ nii ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, ni ekɔ eblematsɛ David nane.
Eshihilɛ mli lɛ, egbaaa ninejurɔ lɛ, egbaaa abɛku.
Ana Mla Wolo lɛ Ni eba mli akɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsu Azalia bi Shafan, Meshula nabi lɛ, mɔ ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ akɛ, “Yaa osɔfonukpa Hilkia ŋɔɔ, koni ekane shika ni akɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ ni shinaanaakwɛlɔi lɛ ebua naa kɛjɛ mɛi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ lɛ koni etu shika lɛ ewo nitsulɔi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nɔ lɛ adɛŋ, koni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã nitsulɔi ni saa Yehowa we lɛ.
Amɛ ji kapintafoi lɛ kɛ tsumalɔi lɛ kɛ gbogbotswalɔi lɛ, koni akɛ eko ahe mplaŋi kɛ tɛi ni ako koni akɛsaa shĩa lɛ.
Akahã amɛbu shika ni atuɔ awoɔ amɛdɛŋ lɛ he akɔntaa ko, ejaakɛ amɛyeɔ anɔkwa.” Be ni Shafan yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, Hilkia kɛ wolo ko hã lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miyana Mla Wolo lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.” Shafan kane wolo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, ba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ebagba lɛ akɛ, “Otsuji lɛ eyaŋɔ shika ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛtu amɛwo mɛi ni kwɛɔ Yehowa we lɛ nitsulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ.” Ni Shafan, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, tsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔfonukpa Hilkia kɛ wolo ko ehã mi.” Ni Shafan kane wolo lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia nu Mla Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ, ekɛ dɔlɛ gbala etadei yɛ ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã osɔfo Hilkia kɛ Shafan bi Ahikam, kɛ Mikaia bi Akbor, kɛ Shafan mɔ ni ji woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Asaia, maŋtsɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabia Yehowa nii nyɛhãa mi kɛ maŋbii lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɛkɛ wolo ni ana nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mli ni ewo la ewo wɔ nɛɛ naa wa naakpa, ejaakɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ booo wiemɔi ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ toi koni amɛye emli wiemɔi ni kɔɔ wɔhe lɛ anɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Osɔfo Hilkia kɛ Ahikam kɛ Akbor kɛ Shafan kɛ Asaia yiŋ amɛtee gbalɔyoo Hulda ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyabɔ lɛ amaniɛ.
Yerusalɛm akutso hee ko mli Hulda yɔɔ.
Hulda nɛɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ atadei ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lɛ nɔ.
Hulda kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, nyɛyakɛa maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu nyɛ miŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: ‘Naa, mahã nɔ fɔŋ aba biɛ nɛɛ kɛ biɛbii lɛ anɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ wolo ni Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ kane lɛ mli lɛ.
Akɛni amɛkwa mi, ni amɛyashã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ewo mimli la hewɔ lɛ, mimli baawo la awo Yerusalɛm naakpa.’ Shi bɔ ni nyɛyakɛɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu nyɛ akɛ nyɛyabi Yehowa nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɛ, ‘Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ.
Yɛ wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni onu lɛ hewɔ lɛ otsake otsui, ni oba ohe shi yɛ mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ, ni okɛ dɔlɛ gbala otadei yɛ ohe, ni okɛ dɔlɛ fo yɛ mihiɛ, be ni onu nɔ ni miwie yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ nɛɛ bii ahe akɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ loomɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu minu osɔlemɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã ogbo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni aaafu bo afata otsɛmɛi lɛ ahe, ni nɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni mahã aba biɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, ohiŋmɛii enaŋ ekoeko.’ ” Ni hii lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛbabɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia amaniɛ lɛ.
Yosia wi ehe kɛjɛ amãgãjamɔ he Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsu ni ayabua Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm onukpai lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛba eŋɔɔ.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia kɛ Yuda hii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ yiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kane kpãŋmɔ wolo lɛ ni ana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛtoiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ yadamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ashidaamɔhe lɛ, yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ekɛ Yehowa kpãŋ akɛ, ebaanyiɛ Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ebaaye emlai lɛ kɛ ekitãi lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ esusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ koni eye nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi ni aŋmã yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ wo shi akɛ amɛbaaye kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã Osɔfonukpa Hilkia kɛ eshishi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi lɛ akɛ amɛ jie nibii fɛɛ ni afee ni akɛjaa Baal kɛ Ashera kɛ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ kɛje Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia shã fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ sɛɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ; ni no sɛɛ lɛ aloo lamlu lɛ kɛtee Betel.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia shwie wulɔmɛi lɛ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ eto ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli kɛ hei ni bɔle Yerusalɛm kpula lɛ.
Eshwie mɛi hu ni shãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa Baal kɛ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋwɛi ŋulamii lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ jie Ashera amãgã lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Kidron jɔɔ lɛŋ, ni eyashã, ni eshimɔ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eloo ni ekɛyashwã maŋbii asaŋi lɛ anɔ.
Ni ekumɔ hii ni kɛ amɛhe ehã ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ atsui ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ eshwie shi.
Jɛi ji he ni yei lɛ loɔ atadei ni akɛjaa Ashera lɛ.
Ni eyaŋɔ osɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli kɛba, ni ebule jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ eshãshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ Geba kɛyashwie Beersheba.
Ekumɔ amãgãi ni bɛŋkɛ agbo lɛ ni maŋ amralo Yoshua fee lɛ eshwie shi.
Yoshua agbo nɛɛ yɛ maŋ agbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ abɛkugbɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ osɔfoi lɛ, aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he yɛ Yerusalɛm; shi moŋ aŋmɛɔ amɛ gbɛ amɛyeɔ akpiti aboloo ni akɛhãa amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ eko.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia bule Tofet, wɔŋjamɔhe ni yɔɔ Hinombii aJɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akagbe ebinuu loo ebiyoo ekɛshã afɔle ekɛhã wɔŋ Molek lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejie okpɔŋɔi ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ eto ni akɛjaa hulu lɛ kɛje Yehowa we lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Agbo nɛɛ bɛŋkɛ piafonyo Natan-Melek tsu lɛ.
Shi tayaa shwiilii lɛ ema naa la ni eshã.
Ni afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz ŋwɛitsu lɛ yiteŋ ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fee, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Manase fee yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi enyɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Yosia kumɔ eshwie shi, ni egbɛlɛ, ni eloo kɛjɛ jɛi, ni ekɛyawo Kidron Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Yosia bule jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon mamɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ, kɛ afɔleshãa latɛi ni yɔɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ ni akɛjaa Astarte, Sidonbii lɛ amãgã lɛ, kɛ Kemosh, Moabbii lɛ amãgã lɛ, kɛ Molek, Amonbii lɛ amãgã lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia kumɔ amãgãi lɛ, ni egba Ashera wɔŋkoi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi awui shwã jɛi.
Asaŋ afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ Betel jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ ni Nebat bi Yeroboam ni hã Israel fee esha lɛ fee lɛ, nakai afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ Yosia kumɔ shwie shi.
Eshã jamɔhe grɔŋŋ lɛ, ni eshimɔ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eshã Ashera amãgã lɛ hu.
Ni be ni Yosia tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena gbohii abui komɛi yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni etsu ayaloo wui lɛ kɛjɛ gbohii abui lɛ amli, ni ebashã yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛbule lɛ.
Efee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ wie be ko lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi akɛ, “Namɔ saŋ ji nɔ ni minaa nɛɛ?” Ni maŋ lɛŋ bii lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ Yuda ba ni ebagba nibii ni ofee Betel afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ eto lɛ, lɛ esaŋ ni.” Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa ehia shi nakai, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akata ewui lɛ ahe!” Ni amɛshi ewui lɛ, kɛ gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Samaria ba lɛ hu wui lɛ.
Ni jamɔhei grɔŋŋi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Samaria maji lɛ amli ni Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fee amɛkɛwo Yehowa mlila lɛ, Yosia kumɔ fɛɛ shwie shi, ni efee amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Betel lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni egbe jamɔhei grɔŋŋi lɛ awulɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eshã gbɔmɛi awui yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ.
Ni eku esɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm.
Maŋtsɛ Yosia ye Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ Yosia fã maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ kɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ayeko nakai Hehoo Gbijurɔ pɛŋ dã kɛjɛ kojolɔi ni kojo Israel lɛ ayinɔ, aahu kɛbashi Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ ayinɔ nɛɛ.” Shi, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aye Hehoo nɛɛ akɛwo Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Tsakemɔi krokomɛi ni Yosia fee Asaŋ Maŋtsɛ Yosia shwie sisatsɛlɔi lɛ kɛ klamɔfoi lɛ, ni ejie amãgãi kɛ wɔji kɛ wɔŋjamɔ nibii fɛɛ ni ana yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Efee enɛ koni wiemɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ ama shi, Mla Wolo lɛ ni Osɔfo Hilkia yana yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.
Maŋtsɛmɛi ni ye nɔ dani Yosia ba lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni ku esɛɛ kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ kɛ etsui muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ esusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ Mose Mla lɛ fɛɛ naa.
Ni maŋtsɛ ko hu eteko shi dɔŋŋ yɛ esɛɛ ni tamɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ emli ni efu Yuda lɛ he, yɛ mlilawoo nii fɛɛ ni Manase fee kɛwo emli la lɛ hewɔ.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibajie Yuda hu kɛje mihiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mijie Israel lɛ, ni makwa nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni mikɔ ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hu ni mikɛɛ yɛ he akɛ ‘Jɛi aja mi yɛ’ lɛ.” Yosia Maŋtsɛyeli naagbee Agbɛnɛ Yosia he saji ni eshwɛ kɛ nibii ni efee lɛ, aŋmala yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Be ni Yosia ji maŋtsɛ lɛ, Ijipt maŋtsɛ Neko fã eyatua Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Yosia bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ etsi Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa yɛ Megido, shi agbe Maŋtsɛ Yosia yɛ ta lɛ mli yɛ jɛi.
Ni etsuji lɛ ŋɔ egbonyo lɛ amɛwo tayaa shwiili mli, ni akɛ lɛ ku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbafu lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afũuhe lɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu mli.
Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ŋɔ Yosia bi Yehoahaz; ni amɛfɔ lɛ mu, ni amɛwo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ sɛɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoahaz Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoahaz baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃; ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Yehoahaz baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eblematsɛmɛi lɛ ekomɛi fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ fo, be ni Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Neko wo lɛ gboklɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ekahi lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yeli yɛ Yerusalɛm dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Neko hã Yuda wo jwiɛtɛi talentai oha, kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome akɛ too ehã Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Neko ŋɔ Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Eliakim ni ewo lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ etsɛ Yosia najiaŋ, ni etsake egbɛi; ni ewo lɛ Yehoiakim.
Shi Yehoahaz lɛ Maŋtsɛ Neko mɔ lɛ kɛtee Ijipt, ni jɛi eyagbo yɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim gba too ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ, ni ekɛna jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ ehã Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wo etoo ni agba ahã lɛ yɛ eninamɔ naa.
Be ni Yehoiakim bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Zebida.
Pedaia ni jɛ Ruma lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yehoiakim hu baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ eblematsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Be mli ni Yehoiakim yeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛbatua Yuda, ni eye enɔ; ni Yehoiakim sɔ̃mɔ lɛ afii etɛ̃.
Shi Yehoiakim tse Nebukadnezar hiɛ atua.
Ni Yehowa tsu Babilonbii atai lɛ kɛ Siriabii atai lɛ kɛ Moabbii atai lɛ kɛ Amonbii atai lɛ kɛbatua Yehoiakim koni amɛfite Yuda taakɛ Yehowa tsɔ̃ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba Yuda nɔ yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa koni ekɛjie Yudabii lɛ kɛje ehiɛ, yɛ eshai fɛɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Manase fee lɛ ahewɔ, titri lɛ yɛ mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko ni egbegbee amɛ lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Manase fɔse mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ ala babaoo eshwie shi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni Yehowa sumɔɔɔ ekɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ afa Manase.
Shi Yehoiakim he saji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, aŋmala fɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Yehoiakim gbo, ni afũ lɛ yɛ etsɛmɛi lɛ afũuhe lɛ; ni ebi Yehoiakin baye maŋtsɛ yɛ esɛɛ.
Saji nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ efãaa kɛ eta lɛ kɛjeee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyaaa he ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ eŋɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛ̃ɛ ni ji Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ Ijipt Faa lɛ naa aahu kɛyashi Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin Be ni Yehoiakin bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni eye maŋtsɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Nehushta, Elnatan ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Yehoiakin baaa ejeŋ ekpakpa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni etsɛ fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yehoiakin maŋtsɛyeli yinɔ lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛbatua Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbasa maŋ lɛ yi.
Be ni asaa maŋ lɛ yi lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar diɛŋtsɛ ba jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kɛ enyɛ kɛ ebii kɛ etsuji kɛ elumɛi kɛ epiafoi lɛ je kpo kɛtee, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eŋɔ Yehoiakin nom.
Ni eyaloo Yehowa we lɛ jwetri lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ jwetri lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee, ni ejwara shika nibii fɛɛ ni Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon efee yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli dukuduku eshwie, taakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie eto lɛ.
Ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛtee, amɛyibɔ ji akpei nyɔŋma.
Eloo ŋaalɔi kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu; eshiii mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ji ohiafoi lɛ kɛkɛ.
Nebukadnezar ŋɔ Yehoiakin kɛ enyɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi kɛ piafoi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni falɛ ji akpei kpawo, kɛ ŋaalɔi kɛ sɔ̃lɔi akpe lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ kãkãlɔi ni eshɛ tayaa ji amɛ.
Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar wo Yehoiakin tsɛkwɛ Matania ni jɛ Yuda lɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ Yehoiakin najiaŋ, shi etsake egbɛi, ni ewo lɛ Zedekia.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia Be ni Zedekia bɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ no mli lɛ eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo ji lɛ.
Zedekia fee efɔŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehoiakim fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yehowa mli fu Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hã eshwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ.
Yerusalɛm shigbeemɔ Zedekia tse Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ atua.
No hewɔ lɛ, eba mli akɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ fã kɛbatua Yerusalɛm, ni amɛsa maŋ lɛ yi, ni amɛmamɔ kpokui amɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Ni asa maŋ lɛ yi aahu kɛyashi Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Nakai afi lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni naa wa ba maŋ lɛŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ naaa nii amɛye.
Kɛkɛ ni agbu gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ mli, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi nyɔɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ agbo lɛ ni naa kã gbogboi enyɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ; tsɛbelɛ Babilonbii lɛ egba kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ kɛkpe.
Shi Babilonbii lɛ ata lɛ tiu maŋtsɛ Zedekia, ni amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ; ni etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ je ehe amɛgbɛ amɛshwã amɛshi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛmɔ Zedekia ni amɛkɛ lɛ yahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yɛ Ribla, ni akojo lɛ.
Zedekia hiŋmɛii jwere nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni agbe ebihii lɛ yɛ ehiɛ; ni Nebukadnezar hã ajwara Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni awo lɛ gboklɛi ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ Yɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan ni eji maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋaawolɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji maŋtsɛ lɛ asraafoiatsɛ lɛ, bote Yerusalɛm.
Ni ebashã Yehowa we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ fɛɛ, ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu lɛ ekɛ la shã butuu.
Ni Babilonbii lɛ ata lɛ fɛɛ ni fata asraafoiatsɛ lɛ he lɛ kumɔ Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛkɛ ni asraafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan ŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni ashi yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni tse amɛhe kɛtee Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛ asafo yuu lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon.
Shi asraafoiatsɛ lɛ shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ohiafoi kwraa lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ Yuda koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ waintromsaalɔi kɛ okwaafoi.
Ni akɔɔble akulashiŋi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ shwiilii lɛ kɛ akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, Babilonbii lɛ jwara amɛ dukuduku, ni amɛloo akɔɔble lɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Ni kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ kaklai lɛ kɛ atoi lɛ kɛ akɔɔble nibii lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ kɛtee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛ shika aloo jwiɛtɛi fee lɛ amɛkɔlɔ kɛtee.
Ŋɛsui lɛ kɛ lalakãi lɛ hu asraafoiatsɛ lɛ kɔlɔ fɛɛ kɛtee.
Shi akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ kɛ gbudugbaŋ kome lɛ shishi adekai lɛ ni maŋtsɛ Solomon fee ehã Yehowa we lɛ, nɛkɛ akɔɔble nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ aleee bɔ ni eŋmɛɔ.
Akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ akwɔlɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni eko yiteŋ kpɔ lɛ akɔɔble ni; ni kpɔ lɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃, ni alo ntaŋ akɛha akɔɔble kokrobii lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Aŋɔ Yudabii kɛtee Babilon Ni Nebuzaradan, asraafoiatsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Osɔfonukpa Seraia kɛ Zefania, esɛɛmɔ lɛ, kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi etɛ̃ lɛ anom efata he kɛtee.
Ni eŋɔ piafonyo ni kwɛɔ tabilɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛŋ.
Eŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi enumɔ ni ana amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ, kɛ tatsɛ ni buaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anaa kɛyaa ta lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ateŋ hii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nebuzaradan, asraafoiatsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ amɛ ni ekɛ amɛ yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Ribla.
Kɛkɛ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tswia amɛ nii ni egbe amɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, aŋɔ Yudabii lɛ nom kɛje amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yuda Amralo Gedalia Nebukadnezar, Babel maŋtsɛ lɛ, wo Gedalia, Ahikam bi ni ji Shafan nabi lɛ, amralo koni eye mɛi ni shwɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ lumɔ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni asraafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ kɛ amɛwebii lɛ nu akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo Gedalia amralo lɛ, amɛba Gedalia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa.
Mɛi ni ba lɛ ji Natania bi Ishmael kɛ Karea bi Yohanan kɛ Tanhumet bi Seraia, ni ji Netofatnyo lɛ, kɛ Yezania ni jɛ Maaka lɛ, kɛ amɛwebii lɛ.
Gedalia kãmɔ amɛ kɛ amɛwebii lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei yɛ Babilon tsuji lɛ ahewɔ, nyɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aaahi ahã nyɛ.” Shi eba mli akɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ Elishama bi Ishmael, ni eji Netania nabi lɛ ni ejɛ maŋtsɛ shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ba, ni amɛbatswia Gedalia nii ni egbo.
Amɛgbe Yudafoi kɛ Babilonbii ni kɛ Gedalia yɔɔ Mizpa lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ te shi, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ, amɛ kɛ asraafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee Ijipt; ejaakɛ amɛmiishe Babilonbii lɛ gbeyei.
Ajie Yehoiakin kɛje gboklɛfoi atsuŋ Ni eba mli akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin nomŋɔɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Ewil-merodak baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Babilon.
Ena Yuda maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin mɔbɔ ni ejie lɛ kɛje kpabu lɛŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Ewil-merodak kɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛhe ni kwɔ fe maŋtsɛmɛi krokomɛi ni kɛ Yehoiakin yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli yɛ Babilon lɛ anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehã Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kpa gboklɛfoi atade woo, ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ye nii daa, ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ hã ahãa Yehoiakin shika fioo ko daa koni ekɛhe ehewɔ nii.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Yinɔi Asaji Awoji lɛ gbaa saji ni agba momo yɛ Samuel kɛ Maŋtsɛmɛi Awoji lɛ amli lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi esoro yiŋtoo ni yɔɔ sɛɛ.
Yiŋtoi krɛdɛi enyɔ komɛi ahewɔ aŋma Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli he saji lɛ yɛ Yinɔi Asaji Awoji lɛ amli.
.
Atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ yɛ amanehului ni Israel kɛ Yuda akutsei lɛ na fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miitsɔ̃ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anɔ etsu eshiwoo lɛ he nii.
Mɔ ni ŋmã wolo lɛ kɛ nibii wuji ni David kɛ Solomon tsu lɛ miiye he odase akɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã Hebribii lɛ.
Nibii lɛ ekrokomɛi ji tsakemɔi ni Yehoshafat kɛ Hezekia kɛ Yosia kɛba lɛ kɛ anɔkwa ni maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi ye yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ mli.
.
Atsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni fee ni ababɔ̃i Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, kɛ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ ato osɔfo kɛ Levibii lɛ agbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe gbɛjianɔ ahã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Maŋtsɛ David klɛŋklɛŋ ji mɔ ni to Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli jamɔ lɛ kɛ ehe kusumi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ashishi.
Shi Solomon ji mɔ ni bama Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Wekukpãai srɔtoi .—.
Saul gbele .- David Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ .—.
a. Naagbai kɛ kunim ni eye .—.
b. Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa .—.
Kɛjɛ Adam yinɔ kɛbashi Abraham yinɔ Adam fɔ Set, ni Set hu fɔ Enosh, ni lɛ hu efɔ Kenan.
Kenan fɔ Mahalalel, ni Mahalalel hu fɔ Jared.
Jared fɔ Enok, ni lɛ hu efɔ Metusela mɔ ni fɔ Lamek ni lɛ hu efɔ Noa lɛ.
Noa fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Shem kɛ Ham kɛ Yafet.
Yafet fɔ bihii kpawo, amɛ ji Gomer kɛ Magog kɛ Madai kɛ Yavan kɛ Tubal kɛ Meshek kɛ Tiras.
Gomer shwiei ji Ashkenaz kɛ Rifat kɛ Togarma.
Yavan hu shwiei ji Elisha kɛ Tarshishbii kɛ Kiprobii kɛ Rodanimbii.
Ham, Noa bi lɛ, bihii ji Kush kɛ Ijipt kɛ Libia kɛ Kanaan, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Ham bi Kush lɛ eshwiei ji Seba kɛ Hawila kɛ Sabta kɛ Raama kɛ Sabteka.
Kush bi Raama shwiei ji Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Kush fɔ binuu ko ni atsɛ lɛ akɛ Nimrod.
Lɛ eje shishi efee ehe nuu kãkãlɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ham bi Ijipt lɛ eshwiei ji Lidiabii lɛ kɛ Anambii lɛ kɛ Lehabbii lɛ kɛ Naftubii lɛ kɛ Patrusbii lɛ kɛ Kaslubii lɛ kɛ Kretabii lɛ (mɛi amli ni Filistibii lɛ jɛ lɛ).
Ham bi Kanaan fɔ Sidon, ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Het, mɛi agbɛii ni akɛtsɛ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Kanaan nɔŋŋ shwiei ji Yebusbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ kɛ Girgashbii lɛ, kɛ Hivbii lɛ kɛ Arkibii lɛ kɛ Sinbii lɛ, kɛ Arvadbii lɛ kɛ Zemarbii lɛ kɛ Hamatbii lɛ.
Shem (Noa bi lɛ) bihii ji Elam kɛ Ashur kɛ Arpakshad kɛ Lud kɛ Aram kɛ Uz kɛ Hul kɛ Geter kɛ Meshek; ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ agbɛii akɛtsɛɔ amɛshwiei lɛ.
Shem bi Arpakshad fɔ Shela, ni lɛ hu efɔ Eber.
Eber nɛɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ.
Atsɛ mɔ kome akɛ Peleg, ejaakɛ efɔmɔ kɛ je lɛ mli bii ateŋ ni gba lɛ bakpe; ni atsɛ Eber bi kome lɛ hu akɛ Yoktan.
Yoktan shwiei ji Almodad kɛ Shelef kɛ Hazamawet kɛ Yera, kɛ Hadoram kɛ Uzal kɛ Dikla; kɛ Ebal kɛ Abimael kɛ Sheba, kɛ Ofir kɛ Hawila kɛ Yoba.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yoktan bii ni.
Bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ Shem nɔ kɛyashi Abram nɔ ji akɛ Shem fɔ Arpakshad, ni Arpakshad fɔ Shela, ni Shela fɔ Eber, ni Eber fɔ Peleg, ni Peleg fɔ Reu; ni Reu fɔ Serug, ni Serug fɔ Nahor, ni Nahor fɔ Tera, ni Tera fɔ Abram (ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abraham hu lɛ.)
Ishmael shwiei lɛ Abraham fɔ bihii enyɔ, Isak kɛ Ishmael.
Ishmael bihii lɛ agbɛi nɛ: Nebaiot, Ishmael kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Kedar kɛ Adbeel kɛ Mibsam kɛ Mishma kɛ Duma kɛ Masa kɛ Hadad kɛ Tema, kɛ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Kedema.
Abraham yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Ketura.
Abraham kɛ lɛ fɔ bihii ekpaa: Zimran kɛ Yokshan kɛ Medan kɛ Midian kɛ Ishbak kɛ Shua.
Yokshan fɔ bihii enyɔ: Sheba kɛ Dedan.
Midian fɔ bihii enumɔ: Efa kɛ Efer kɛ Hanok kɛ Abida kɛ Eldaa.
Shwiei ni jɛ Ketura mli ji mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ.
Esau shwiei lɛ Abraham bi Isak fɔ bihii enyɔ, Esau kɛ Yakob.
Esau bihii ji Elifaz kɛ Reuel kɛ Yeush kɛ Yalam kɛ Kora.
Esau bi Elifaz ji mɔ mli ni Teman kɛ Omar kɛ Zefi kɛ Gatam kɛ Kenaz kɛ Timna kɛ Amalek jɛ.
Reuel hu ji mɔ mli ni Nahat kɛ Zera kɛ Shama kɛ Miza jɛ.
Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ, Seir shwiei ni.
Seir bii ji Lotan kɛ Shobal kɛ Zibeon kɛ Ana kɛ Dishon kɛ Ezer kɛ Dishan.
Lotan fɔ Hori kɛ Homam.
Lotan yɛ nyɛmiyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Timna.
Shobal fɔ Alvan kɛ Manahat kɛ Ebal kɛ Shefi kɛ Onam.
Zebeon fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aia kɛ Ana.
Ana nɛɛ fɔ Dishon, mɔ ni fɔ Hamran kɛ Eshban kɛ Itran kɛ Keran lɛ.
Ezer fɔ Bilhan kɛ Zaavan kɛ Yaakan.
Ni Dishan fɔ Uz kɛ Aran.
Edom Maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ Naa bɔ ni ato naa ni aye maŋtsɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dani ato maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Bela, Boer bi lɛ ni emaŋ ji Dinhaba lɛ ji mɔ tsutsu ni ye maŋtsɛ.
Yobab, Zera bi lɛ ni jɛ Bozra lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Bela gbele sɛɛ.
Husham, ni jɛ Temanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yobab gbele sɛɛ.
Hadad, Bedad bi lɛ ni jɛ Abit lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hushan gbele sɛɛ.
Ekɛ Midianbii lɛ wu ta, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ Moab ŋã lɛ nɔ.
Samla ni jɛ Masreka baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Hadad gbele sɛɛ.
Shaul ni jɛ Rehobot ni kã faa lɛ naa lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Samla gbele sɛɛ.
Baal Hanan, Akbor bi lɛ, baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Shaul gbele sɛɛ.
Hadad ni emaŋ ji Pau lɛ baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Baal-Hanan gbele sɛɛ.
Hadad nɛɛ ŋa ji Mehetabel ni ji Me-Zahab biyoo Matred lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Edombii akutsei lɛ ji Timna kɛ Alva kɛ Yetet, kɛ Oholibama kɛ Ela kɛ Pinon, kɛ Kenaz kɛ Teman kɛ Mibzar, kɛ Magdiel kɛ Iram.
Yuda shwiei lɛ Yakob fɔ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, amɛ ji Ruben kɛ Simeon kɛ Levi kɛ Yuda kɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon, kɛ Dan kɛ Yosef kɛ Benyamin kɛ Naftali kɛ Gad kɛ Asher.
Yuda fɔ bihii enumɔ.
Ekɛ eŋa Bat-Shua, Kanaanyoo lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃, ni ji Er kɛ Onan kɛ Shela.
Yuda kromɔbi Er lɛ fee ehe gbɔmɔ fɔŋ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa gbe lɛ.
Yuda kɛ ebinuu ŋã Tamar lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ hu, Perez kɛ Zera.
Perez fɔ bihii enyɔ, Hezron kɛ Hamul.
Zera fɔ bihii enumɔ, Zimri kɛ Etan kɛ Heman kɛ Kalkol kɛ Darda.
Karmi ni jɛ Perez mli lɛ bi ko ni egbɛi ji Akar lɛ kɛ Israelbii wo amane mli be ni efee nɔ ni esaaa yɛ nihaanii ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Yehowa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Etan (Zera bi lɛ) fɔ binuu.
Binuu nɛɛ gbɛi ji Azaria.
Maŋtsɛ David wekukpãa Hezron fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yerameel kɛ Ram kɛ Kaleb.
Naa bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi hã kɛjɛ Ram nɔ kɛyashi Yeshai nɔ: Ram fɔ Aminadab, ni Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni ebatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kpanaa yɛ Yudabii ateŋ lɛ.
Nahashon fɔ Salma, ni Salma fɔ Boaz, ni Boaz fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Yeshai.
Yeshai fɔ bihii kpawo.
Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Eliab; kromɔbi lɛ sɛɛho lɛ ji Abinadab; ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Shimea; ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Netanel, ni ebi ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Radai.
Ozem ji ebi ni ji ekpaa lɛ, ni ebi ni ji kpawo lɛ ji David.
Yeshai fɔ biyei hu ni ji Zeruia kɛ Abigail.
Yeshai biyoo Zeruia nɛɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Abishai kɛ Yoab kɛ Asahel.
Ebiyoo Abigail kɛ Yeter, Ishmaelnyo, lɛ hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Amasa.
Hezron shwiei Hezron binuu Kaleb kɛ Yeriotyoo, Azuba, hi shi ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Yesher kɛ Shobab kɛ Ardon.
Azuba gbo, ni Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hur.
Hur fɔ Uri, ni Uri fɔ Bezaleel.
Be mli ni Hezron eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa lɛ, etee ni eyaŋɔ Makir biyoo ni ji Gilead nyɛmiyoo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Segub, Segub fɔ Yair mɔ ni ye Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ anɔ lumɔ lɛ.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ Geshurbii lɛ kɛ Arambii bashɔ̃ Kenat kɛ ehe maji kɛ akrowai aaashɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa yɛ Yair kɛ Gileadbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Gilead tsɛ Makir shwiei ji mɛi ni yɔɔ maji kɛ akrowai nɛɛ amli.
Be ni Hezron gbo lɛ, ebinuu Kaleb ŋɔ Efrat, etsɛ Hezron ŋa okulafo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ.
Yerameel shwiei lɛ Yerameel, Hezron kromɔbi lɛ fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ram, ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Buna kɛ Oren kɛ Ozem kɛ Ahia.
Yerameel yɛ ŋa kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Atra.
Ekɛ lɛ fɔ Onam.
Ram, Yerameel kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Maaz kɛ Yamin kɛ Eker.
Onam fɔ bihii enyɔ: Shamai kɛ Yada; ni Shamai hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Nadab kɛ Abishur.
Abishur nɛɛ ŋa gbɛi ji Abihail; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ahban kɛ Molid.
Nadad, Abishur nyɛminuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Seled kɛ Apaim.
Seled fɔɔɔ ni egbo.
Shi Apaim fɔ Ishi, ni Ishi fɔ Sheshan, ni Sheshan fɔ Ahlai.
Yada, Oman bi Shammai nyɛmi nuu lɛ, fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yeter kɛ Yonatan.
Yeter fɔɔɔ ni egbo.
Shi Yonatan fɔ bihii enyɔ: Pelet kɛ Zaza.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Yerameel shwiei sɔŋŋ ni.
Sheshan fɔɔɔ binuu; biyei sɔŋŋ efɔ.
Sheshan yɛ tsulɔ Ijiptnyo ko ni gbɛi ji Yarha.
Ekɛ ebiyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome hã etsulɔ Yarha nɛɛ gbãlã, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Atai.
Naa bɔ ni wekukpãa lɛ kã shi ha kɛjɛ Atai nɔ kɛyashi Elishama nɔ: Atai fɔ Natan, ni Natan fɔ Zabad.
Zabad fɔ Eflal ni Eflal fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Jehu, ni Jehu hu fɔ Azaria.
Azaria fɔ Helez, ni Helez fɔ Eleasa; ni Eleasa fɔ Sismai, ni Sismai hu fɔ Shalum ni Shalum fɔ Yekamia, ni Yekamia fɔ Elishama.
Kaleb shwiei krokomɛi Kaleb, Yerameel nyɛmi nuu lɛ, kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ eko hu kromɔ binuu ji Mesha.
Mesha fɔ Zif, ni Zif, fɔ Maresha, ni Maresha fɔ Hebron.
Hebron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Kora kɛ Tapua kɛ Rekem kɛ Shema.
Shema fɔ Raham, mɔ ni fɔ Yorkeam lɛ; ni Rekem fɔ Shamai.
Shamai fɔ Maon, ni Maon fɔ Bet-Zur.
Kaleb yɛ hemɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Efa; ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi etɛ̃, Haran kɛ Moza kɛ Gazez.
Haran hu fɔ binuu ni ewo lɛ Gazez.
Kaleb bii lɛ eko hu ni gbɛi ji Yadai lɛ fɔ bihii ekpaa: Regem kɛ Yoatam kɛ Geshan kɛ Pelet kɛ Efa kɛ Shaaf.
Kaleb yɛ hemɔ kroko hu ni gbɛi ji Maaka; ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, Sheber kɛ Tirhana.
Maaka nɛɛ kɛ Kaleb saa fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi, Shaaf mɔ ni to Madmana maŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛ Sheva mɔ ni to Makbena maŋ lɛ kɛ Gibea maŋ lɛ hu shishi lɛ.
Biyoo ni Kaleb fɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Aksa.
Kaleb shwiei krokomɛi agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Hur ji Kaleb kromɔ binuu; ekɛ eŋã Efrat lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Hur nɛɛ binuu Shobal ji mɔ ni to Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ.
Amɛbinuu ni ji enyɔ ji Salma mɔ ni to Betlehem maŋ lɛ; amɛbinuu ni ji etɛ̃ ji Haref mɔ ni to Bet-Gader maŋ lɛ.
Shobal, mɔ ni to Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ shwiei ji Haroebii lɛ, kɛ Menahot maŋ lɛ mli bii ayikulɛ fã ko, kɛ Itribii ni yɔɔ Kiriat-Yearim maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Putbii lɛ kɛ Shumatbii lɛ kɛ Mishrabii lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi amli Zora maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ kɛ Eshtaol maŋ lɛ hu mli bii lɛ jɛ.
Salma, mɔ ni to Betlehem lɛ, shwiei ji Netofatbii lɛ, Atarot-Bet-Yoabbii lɛ kɛ Zoribii ni ji Manahat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fã kome lɛ.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ woloŋmalɔi awekui komɛi hi shi yɛ Yabez maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛ ji Tiratbii lɛ kɛ Shimeatbii lɛ kɛ Sukatbii lɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ Kenbii ji amɛ, ni amɛjɛ Hamat mɔ ni to Rekab we lɛ shishi lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ David musuŋbii lɛ Maŋtsɛ David bihii ni efɔ yɛ Hebron lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ yɛ afii anaa: Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Amnon ni enyɛ ji Ahinoam ni jɛ Yezreel lɛ.
Ebi ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Daniel mɔ ni nyɛ ji Abigail ni jɛ Karmel lɛ.
Ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Absalom.
Absalom nyɛ ji Maaka Geshur Maŋtsɛ Talmai biyoo lɛ.
Ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Adonia ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Hagit lɛ.
Ebi ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Shefatia ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Abital lɛ; ni ebi ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Itream ni enyɛ gbɛi ji Egla lɛ.
David fɔ bihii ekpaa nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Hebron he ni eye maŋtsɛ yɛ afii kpawo kɛ fã lɛ.
Ebaye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ etɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm hu; ni efɔ bii babaoo yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Ekɛ Bat-Shua ni ji Ameiel biyoo lɛ fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Shimea kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon.
Maŋtsɛ David fɔ bihii krokomɛi nɛɛhu.
Amɛ ji Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Elpelet kɛ Noga kɛ Nefeg kɛ Yafia, kɛ Elishama kɛ Eliada kɛ Elifelet.
David kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɔ bihii krokomɛi hu yɛ ebihii nɛɛ asɛɛ.
Amɛnyɛmi yoo ji Tamar.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon shwiei lɛ Naa bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon shwiei lɛ wekukpãa lɛ kã shi kɛjɛ lɛ enɔ: Solomon fɔ Rehoboam, ni Rehoboam fɔ Abia, ni Abia fɔ Asa, ni Asa hu fɔ Yehoshafat.
Yehoshafat fɔ Yoram, ni Yoram fɔ Ahazia, ni Ahazia fɔ Yoash.
Yoash fɔ Amazia, ni Amazia fɔ Uzia, ni Uzia fɔ Yotam.
Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia, ni Hezekia fɔ Manase.
Manase fɔ Amon, ni Amon fɔ Yosia.
Yosia fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yohanan, Yehoiakim, Zedekia kɛ Yoahaz.
Ni Yehoiakim fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yehoiakin kɛ Zedekia.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin shwiei lɛ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin, mɔ ni Babilonbii lɛ ŋɔ lɛ nom lɛ, shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin fɔ bihii kpawo: Shealtiel, kɛ Malkiram, kɛ Pedaia kɛ Shenazar kɛ Yekamia kɛ Hoshama kɛ Nedabia.
Pedaia fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zerubabel kɛ Shimei.
Ni Zerubabel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Meshulam kɛ Hanania, kɛ yoo kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Shelomit.
Zerubabel fɔ bihii krokomɛi enumɔ hu: Hashuba kɛ Ohel kɛ Berekia kɛ Hasadia kɛ Yushab-Hesed.
Hanania fɔ bihii enyɔ: Pelatia kɛ Yeshaia.
Yeshaia fɔ Refaia, ni Refaia fɔ Arnan, ni Arnan fɔ Obadia, ni Obadia hu fɔ Shekania.
Shekania fɔ binuu kome ni ji Shemaia, ni Shemaia fɔ bihii enumɔ: Hatush kɛ Igal kɛ Baria kɛ Nearia kɛ Shabat.
Nearia fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Elioenai kɛ Hizkia kɛ Azrikam.
Elioenai fɔ bihii kpawo: Hodavia kɛ Eliashib kɛ Pelaia kɛ Akub kɛ Yohanan kɛ Delaia kɛ Anani.
Yuda shwiei lɛ Yuda shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nɛ: Perez kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi kɛ Hur kɛ Shobal.
Shobal fɔ Reaia, ni Reaia fɔ Yahat, ni Yahat fɔ Ahumai kɛ Lahad, mɛi ashwiei ni ji Zorabii lɛ.
Kaleb kɛ eŋa Efrat kromɔ binuu ji Hur mɔ ni shwiei yato Betlehem maŋ lɛ.
Hur fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Etam kɛ Penuel kɛ Ezer.
Etam fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yezreel kɛ Ishma kɛ Idbash kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hazelelponi.
Penuel ji mɔ ni to Gedor maŋ lɛ, ni Ezer hu ji mɔ ni to Husha maŋ lɛ.
Ashur mɔ ni to Tekoa maŋ lɛ yɛ ŋamɛi enyɔ, Hela kɛ Naara.
Naara kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahuzam kɛ Hefer kɛ Temeni kɛ Haahashtari.
Ni Hela hu kɛ Ashur fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Zeret kɛ Izohar kɛ Etnan.
Koz fɔ Anub kɛ Zobeba kɛ mɔ mli ni Harum bi Aharhel wekui lɛ jɛ lɛ.
Nuu ko ni gbɛi ji Yabez lɛ na gbɛi fe enyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ enyɛ wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yabez ejaakɛ enyɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Hejaramɔ mli mifɔ lɛ yɛ,” shi Yabez sɔle etsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ofainɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ojɔɔ mi ni olɛɛ mihusui lɛ amli oha mi, ni obu mihe, ni obaa miyi koni nɔ fɔŋ ko akafee mi.” Nyɔŋmɔ hã Yabez nɔ ni ebi lɛ.
Wekui krokomɛi Kɛlub, Shuha nyɛmi lɛ, fɔ Mehir.
Mehir fɔ Eshton, ni Eshton fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bet-Rafa kɛ Pasea kɛ Tehina.
Tehina ji mɔ ni to Nahash maŋ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ashwiei lɛ hi Reka maŋ lɛ mli.
Kenaz fɔ bihii enyɔ: Otniel kɛ Seraia.
Otniel hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Hatat kɛ Meonotai; ni Meonotai fɔ Ofra.
Seraia fɔ Yoab mɔ ni to Ge-Harashim, ni ji ŋaalɔi amaŋ lɛ.
Awo jɛi gbɛi nɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋaalɔi sɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni hi jɛi.
Kaleb, Yefune bi lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Iru kɛ Ela kɛ Naam.
Ela fɔ Kenaz.
Yehalelel fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Zif kɛ Zifa kɛ Tiria kɛ Asarel.
Ezra fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yeter kɛ Mered kɛ Efer kɛ Yalon.
Mered yaŋɔ Bitia, Ijipt maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ biyoo kome, Miriam, kɛ bihii enyɔ, Shamai kɛ Ishba.
Ishba nɛɛ ji mɔ ni to Eshtemoa maŋ lɛ shishi.
Mered yaŋɔ Yudayoo hu, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yered mɔ ni to Gedor maŋ lɛ, kɛ Heber mɔ ni to Soko maŋ lɛ, kɛ Yekutiel mɔ ni to Zanoa maŋ lɛ.
Hodia ŋɔ Naham nyɛmi yoo lɛ.
Shwiei ni amɛwo lɛ hu ashwiei ji Garmbii awekui ni hi Keila maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ Maakatbii awekui lɛ ni hi Eshtemoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shimon fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amnon kɛ Rina kɛ Ben-Hanan kɛ Tilon.
Ishi fɔ bihii enyɔ: Zohet kɛ Ben-Zohet.
Shela shwiei lɛ Shela, Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ shwiei ji Er, mɔ ni to Leka maŋ lɛ, kɛ Laada, mɔ ni to Maresha maŋ lɛ, kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo lolɔi awekui ni hi Bet-Ashbea maŋ lɛ mli lɛ; kɛ Yokim kɛ Kozeba maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ, kɛ Yoash kɛ Saraf, mɛi ni yaye onukpa yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbahi Betlehem lɛ (Blema sane nɛɛ etsɛ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ).
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tsu nii akɛ maŋtsɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔi, ni maji amli ni amɛhi ji Netaim kɛ Gedera.
Simeon shwiei lɛ Simeon fɔ bihii enumɔ: Nemuel kɛ Yamin kɛ Yarib kɛ Zera kɛ Shaul.
Shaul fɔ Shalum, ni Shalum fɔ Mibsam, ni Mibsam fɔ Mishma.
Mishma fɔ Hamuel, ni Hamuel fɔ Zakur, ni Zakur fɔ Shimei.
Shimei fɔ bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa kɛ biyei hu ekpaa.
Shi moŋ Shimei nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɔɔɔ pii, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛweku lɛ shwereee tamɔ Yudabii lɛ.
