Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David baye maŋtsɛ lɛ, maji amli ni Simeon shwiei lɛ hi ji Beersheba kɛ Molada kɛ Hazar-Shual, kɛ Bilha kɛ Ezem kɛ Tolad, kɛ Betuel kɛ Horma kɛ Ziklag, kɛ Bet-Markabot kɛ Hazar-Susim kɛ Bet-Biri kɛ Shaaraim.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛmaji enumɔ krokomɛi hu ji Etam kɛ Ain kɛ Rimon kɛ Token kɛ Ashan.
Soro amɛkrowai fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmaji nɛɛ ahe kɛyashi Baalat maŋ lɛ wuoyigbɛ anai lɛ.
Simeon shwiei lɛ ŋmala heihei ni amɛhi lɛ kɛ amɛwekui lɛ hu ahe saji amɛfɔ̃ shi.
Amɛwekui lɛ amli onukpai lɛ ji Meshobab kɛ Yamlek kɛ Yosha, Amazia bi lɛ, kɛ Yoel kɛ Yehu (ni ji Asiel bi Seraia bi Yoshibia bi lɛ); kɛ Elioenai kɛ Yaakoba kɛ Yeshohaia kɛ Asaia kɛ Adiel kɛ Yesimiel kɛ Benaia; kɛ Ziza, ni ji Shemaia bi Shimei bi Yedaia bi Alon bi Shifi bi lɛ.
Akɛ ni gbɔmɛi atã ni atsi nɛɛ ji amɛwekui lɛ amli onukpai, ni amɛwekui lɛ hu ayi miifa hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi mli kɛtee aahu kɛyanina Gedor maŋ lɛ ni amɛyatao jwɛifɔ amɛha amɛkooloi lɛ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ.
Ni amɛyana niyelihe kɛ enɔ jwɛifɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ ni hi hu; asaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ lɛɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni enɔ jɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ nɔ.
Sa ko lɛ Hambii ashwiei ji mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Shi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ lɛ, lumɛi atã ni atsi nɛɛ fã kɛtee Gedor, ni amɛyakpãtã jɛibii abuui lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbe Meunimbii ni amɛyanina yɛ jɛi lɛ, ni amɛshwie amɛ yɛ jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi nɔ ejaakɛ niyelihe yɛ jɛi hã amɛkooloi lɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Simeonbii lɛ nɔŋŋ ateŋ mɛi ohai enumɔ fã kɛtee Edom bokãgbɛ.
Asafoiatsɛmɛi ni nyiɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahiɛ ji Ishi bihii Pelatia kɛ Nearia kɛ Refaia kɛ Uziel.
Amɛyatua Amalekbii ashwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhi jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Ruben shwiei lɛ Naa Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ shwiei lɛ.
Ruben, Yakob kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Hanok kɛ Palu kɛ Hezron kɛ Karmi.
Naa Yoel shwiei lɛ nɛ: Yoel fɔ Shemaia, ni Shemaia fɔ Gog, ni Gog hu fɔ Shimei.
Shimei fɔ Mika, ni Mika fɔ Reaia, ni Reaia fɔ Baal, ni Baal fɔ Beera, mɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Tiglat-Pilneser baŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee be mli ni lɛ ji Rubenbii lɛ alumɔ lɛ.
Beera nyɛmimɛi agbɛii ni yɔɔ Rubenbii awekui ahe saji awojiaŋ ji Yeiel kɛ Zakaria, kɛ Bela, ni ji Yoel bi Shema bi Azaz bi lɛ.
Amɛkutso lɛ hi shi kɛjɛ Aroer maŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni kã shi kɛjɛ jɛi kɛtee kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashɛ Nebo kɛ Baal-Meon he.
Amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhi bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee aahu kɛyanina shiaŋa lɛ ni kã shi kɛtee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkooloi lɛ shwere yɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Saul yinɔ lɛ, Rubenbii lɛ fã ta, ni amɛyatua Hagribii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Gilead bokãgbɛ niiaŋ lɛ fɛɛ.
Gad shwiei lɛ Gadbii lɛ hi Rubenbii lɛ akooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji Bashan lɛ nɔ kɛtee bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyashi Salka maŋ lɛ he.
Amɛweku ni na gbɛi fe ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Bashan lɛ ji Yoel weku lɛ; weku ni nyiɛ no sɛɛ ji Shafam, ni wekui krokomɛi lɛ atsɛmɛi ji Yanai kɛ Shafat.
Amɛnyɛmimɛi Gadbii krokomɛi lɛ, yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ awei lɛ ayibɔ naa ji kpawo: Mikael kɛ Meshulam kɛ Sheba kɛ Yorai kɛ Yakan kɛ Zia kɛ Eber.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ Abihail, ni ji Buz bi Yado bi Yeshishai bi Mikael bi Gilead bi Yaroa bi Huri lɛ bi lɛ, shwiei ji amɛ.
Ni, Ahi, ni ji Guni bi Abdiel bi lɛ, ji wekui srɔtoi nɛɛ fɛɛ anɔ onukpa.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ hi Gilead kɛ Bashan kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ amli, kɛ Sharon jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ kɛyashwie amɛhusui lɛ anaa tɔ̃ɔ.
(Aŋmãla wekui nɛɛ ahe blema saji nɛɛ be mli ni Yotam yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.)
Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ atabilɔi Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni he esa jogbaŋŋ kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ klante kɛ gãi kɛ tawuu.
Amɛfã ta, ni amɛ kɛ Hagribii ni yɔɔ Yetur kɛ Nafish kɛ Nodad lɛ yawu.
Hagribii lɛ na mɛi yafata amɛhe yɛ ta mli, kɛ̃lɛ aye amɛ kɛ mɛi ni yafata amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim, ejaakɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ koni eye ebua amɛ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ bo amɛsɔlemɔ lɛ toi ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛloo Hagribii lɛ akooloi kɛtee: yoomai akpei ohai nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ toi hu akpei ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ tejii hu akpei oha.
Hagribii lɛ babaoo nyɔnyɔi ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa akɛ awu nakai ta lɛ.
Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛyashi be ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ hi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛyi babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Bashan aahu kɛtee kɛyashwie Baal-Hermon kɛ Senir Gɔŋkpɔ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ ji Efer kɛ Ishi kɛ Eliel kɛ Azriel; kɛ Yeremia kɛ Yodavia kɛ Yadiel.
Amɛ ji hii kãkãlɔi, ni amɛyɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awebii lɛ ateŋ.
Aŋɔ Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ nom Shi Bokãgbɛ Akutsei lɛ tɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛkwa lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ lɛ ajemawɔji lɛ jamɔ moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Pul (ni atsɛ lɛ Tiglat-Pilneser hu lɛ) ewo amɛhe, ni efã ta kɛbatua amɛ, ni ebaŋɔ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ nom, ni eloo amɛ kɛtee eyashwie Hala kɛ Habor kɛ Hara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Gozan Faa lɛ hu naa, ni amɛka jɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Osɔfonukpai lɛ awekukpãa Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.
Amram fɔ bihii enyɔ, Aaron kɛ Mose, kɛ biyoo kome ni ji Miriam.
Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadad kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Naa bɔ ni Eleazar shwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ jwere shi hã kɛjɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ: Eleazar fɔ Finehas, ni Finehas fɔ Abishua.
Abishua fɔ Buki, Buki fɔ Uzi.
Uzi fɔ Zerahia, ni Zerahia fɔ Meraiot.
Meraiot fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Ahimaaz.
Ahimaaz fɔ Azaria, ni Azaria fɔ Yohanan, ni Yohanan fɔ Azaria (mɔ ni ye osɔfo yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ma yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ mli lɛ).
Azaria nɛɛ fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Shalum.
Shalum fɔ Hilkia, ni Hilkia fɔ Azaria, ni Azaria fɔ Sheraia, ni Sheraia fɔ Yehozadak.
Be ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nine nɔ ni ehã aŋɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ nom lɛ, Yehozadak fata mɛi ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe kɛtee.
Levi shwiei krokomɛi Levi fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari.
Gershon bii ji Libni kɛ Shimei: Kohat bii ji Amram kɛ Izehar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel, ni Merari bii ji Maheli kɛ Mushi.
Ni bɔ ni Levibii lɛ awekui yɛ tsɛmɛi ayinɔi lɛ anaa jwere shi hã nɛ: Gershon nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Libni kɛ Yahat kɛ Zima; kɛkɛ lɛ, Yoa kɛ Ido kɛ Zera kɛ Yeaterai.
Kohat nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Aminadab kɛ Kora kɛ Asir; kɛkɛ lɛ Elkana kɛ Ebiasaf kɛ Asir, kɛ Tahat kɛ Uriel kɛkɛ lɛ Uzia kɛ Shaul.
Elkana fɔ bihii enyɔ: Amasai kɛ Ahimot.
Yɛ Ahimot nɔ mli lɛ eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi ji Elkana kɛ Zofai, kɛ Nahat, kɛ Eliab kɛ Yeroham kɛ Elkana.
Samuel fɔ bihii enyɔ: Yoel, ji kromɔbi, kɛ esɛɛho Abia.
Merari nɔ mli lɛ, eshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ji Maheli kɛ Libni kɛ Shimei kɛ Uza, kɛ Shimea kɛ Hagia kɛ Asaia.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lalanɔkwɛlɔi lɛ Mɛi yɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to koni amɛkwɛ lala ni alaa yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bama Yehowa we lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛto naa ni amɛsɔmɔ kɛ lala yɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon ma Yehowa We lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Amɛtsu amɛnii bɔ ni ato sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ ahã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Naa hii ni tsu lala he nitsumɔ nɛɛ eko lɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ eshwiei: Kohatbii anɔ mli lɛ Heman, ni ji Samuel bi Yoel bi lɛ, ji klɛŋklɛŋ lalatsɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni wekukpãa kã shi ha kɛyashi Yakob nɔ: Heman tsɛ ji Yoel, ni Yoel tsɛ ji Samuel.
Samuel tsɛ ji Elkana, ni Elkana tsɛ ji Yeroham; Yeroham tsɛ ji Eliel, ni Eliel tsɛ ji Toa.
Toa tsɛ ji Zuf; Zuf tsɛ ji Elkana; Elkana tsɛ ji Mahat, ni Mahat tsɛ ji Amasai.
Amasai tsɛ ji Elkana, ni Elkana tsɛ ji Yoel; Yoel tsɛ ji Azaria, ni Azaria tsɛ ji Zefania.
Zefania tsɛ ji Tahat; Tahat tsɛ ji Asir; Asir tsɛ ji Ebiasaf, ni Ebiasaf tsɛ ji Kora.
Kora tsɛ ji Izehar; Izehar tsɛ ji Kohat; Kohat tsɛ ji Levi, ni Levi tsɛ ji Yakob.
Asaf ji lalatsɛ ni ji enyɔ ni edamɔɔ ninejurɔ gbɛ lɛ; nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ewekukpãa kã shi hã kɛyashi Levi nɔ: Asaf tsɛ ji Berekia; ni Berekia tsɛ ji Shimea.
Shimea tsɛ ji Mikael; Mikael tsɛ ji Baseia, ni Baseia tsɛ ji Malkia.
Malkia tsɛ ji Etni; Etni tsɛ ji Zera, ni Zera tsɛ ji Adaia.
Adaia tsɛ ji Etan; Etan tsɛ ji Zima, ni Zima tsɛ ji Shimei.
Shimei tsɛ ji Yahat; Yahat tsɛ ji Gershon, ni Gershon tsɛ ji Levi.
Etan ni jɛ Merari weku lɛ mli, ni lɛ ji mɔ ni damɔɔ Heman abɛkugbɛ lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ewekukpãa kã shi kɛyashi Levi nɔ: Etan tsɛ ji Kishi; Kishi tsɛ ji Abdi, ni Abdi tsɛ ji Maluk.
Maluk tsɛ ji Hashabia; Hashabia tsɛ ji Amazia, ni Amazia tsɛ ji Hilkia.
Hilkia tsɛ ji Amzi; Amzi tsɛ ji Bani, ni Bani tsɛ ji Shemer.
Shemer tsɛ ji Mali; Mali tsɛ ji Mushi; Mushi tsɛ ji Merari, ni Merari tsɛ ji Levi.
Amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ, amɛ amɛdɛŋ akɛ Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli nitsumɔi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ wo.
Aaron shwiei lɛ Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ afɔlei lɛ yaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛyashãa.
Amɛnitsumɔ ji jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ; asaŋ amɛkpãtãa amɛhãa maŋ lɛ koni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ tɔ̃mɔ ni Israelbii etɔ̃ lɛ afa amɛ.
Amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi nɛɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose ewo he kitã lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Bɔ ni Aaron shwiei lɛ wekukpãa lɛ kã shi hã nɛ: Aaron fɔ Eleazar; Eleazar fɔ Finehas, ni Finehas fɔ Abishua.
Abishua fɔ Buki; Buki fɔ Uzi, ni Uzi fɔ Zerahia.
Zerahia fɔ Meraiot; Meraiot fɔ Amaria, ni Amaria fɔ Ahitub.
Ahitub fɔ Zadok, ni Zadok fɔ Ahimaaz.
Maji amli ni Levibii lɛ hi Maji amli ni Levibii lɛ hi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Aaron shwiei ni jɛ Kohat mli lɛ nɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi anɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee.
Akɛ Hebron ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hã amɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ he jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ hu; shi maŋ lɛ he ŋmɔji kɛ ekrowai lɛ akɛhã Yefune bi Kaleb.
Maji krokomɛi ni akɛhã Aaron shwiei lɛ ji Hebron, ni ji abobaa maŋ lɛ, kɛ Libna kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu, kɛ Yatir kɛ Eshtemoa kɛ maji nɛɛ ahe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
Maji lɛ ekomɛi hu ji Hilen kɛ Debir, kɛ Ashan kɛ Bet-Shemesh, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ.
Benyaminbii lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji ni akɛha Aaron shwiei lɛ ji Geba kɛ Alemet kɛ Anatot, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ kɛ ehe jwɛifɔ shikpɔŋ.
Maji ni akɛhã Kohat shwiei lɛ awekui lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛhi amɛmli lɛ ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Yɛ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ naa lɛ, ahã Kohatbii awekui ni eshwɛ lɛ maji nyɔŋma yɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Aŋɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ kɛjɛ Isakarbii lɛ kɛ Asherbii lɛ kɛ Naftalibii kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ Bashan lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ adɛŋ, ni akɛhã Gershon shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Ni akɔlɔ maji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛjɛ Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni akɛhã Merari shwiei lɛ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ Israelbii lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛhã Levibii lɛ maji koni amɛhi mli.
Afɔ̃ oshiki, ni adamɔ no nɔ ni akɛ Yuda kɛ Simeon kɛ Benyamin shikpɔji lɛ anɔ maji ni atsi amɛtã nɛɛ hã Levibii lɛ.
Ahã Kohatbii lɛ awekui lɛ ekomɛi maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji yɛ Efraimbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ ji Shekem, ni ji abobaa maŋ lɛ, ni yɔɔ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ kɛ Gezer, kɛ Yokmeam kɛ Bet-Horon kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ kɛ Aiyalon kɛ Gat-Rimon kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ.
Ni akɛ Anaigbɛ Manasebii hu amaji ni ji Aner kɛ Bileam kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji shi nɔ hã Kohatbii lɛ.
Naa maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛha Gershonbii awekui lɛ: Yɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Golan yɛ Bashan kɛ Ashtarot hã amɛ.
Yɛ Isakarbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Kedesh kɛ Daberat, kɛ Ramot kɛ Anem hã amɛ.
Yɛ Asherbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Mashal kɛ Abdon kɛ Hukok kɛ Rehob hã amɛ.
Yɛ Naftalibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ Kedesh yɛ Galilea kɛ Hamon kɛ Kiriataim hã amɛ.
Merari shwiei lɛ ateŋ wekui ni eshwɛ lɛ, maji kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji ni akɛhã amɛ yɛ Zebulonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ji Rimono kɛ Tabor.
Yɛ Rubenbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ, asaŋ yɛ Yeriko sɛɛ lɛ, ahã amɛ Bezer, ni kã gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛ Yaza, kɛ Kedemot kɛ Mefaat hu kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
Ni yɛ Gadbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahã amɛ Ramot, ni yɔɔ Gilead lɛ, kɛ Mahanaim, kɛ Heshbon kɛ Yazer kɛ amɛhe jwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
Isakar shwiei lɛ Isakar fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Tola kɛ Pua kɛ Yashub kɛ Shimron.
Tola fɔ bihii ekpaa: Uzi kɛ Refaia kɛ Yeriel kɛ Yahemai kɛ Ibsam kɛ Shemuel.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ Tola shwiei awekui lɛ anukpai, asaŋ kɛ tatsɛmɛi wuji hu.
Maŋtsɛ David yinɔ lɛ Tola shwiei nɛɛ ayibɔ ji akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Uzi fɔ bi kome, ni ji Izrahia.
Izrahia fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Mikael kɛ Obadia kɛ Yoel kɛ Ishia.
Uzi kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsɔmɔ wekui ayitsei.
Amɛŋɔŋɔɔ yei babaoo ni amɛfɔfɔɔ bii pii bɔ ni yinɔ lɛ eko nɔ lɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ hã hii tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ekpaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Isakar akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi ayikulɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpawo.
Benyamin kɛ Dan shwiei Benyamin fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Bela kɛ Beker kɛ Yediael.
Bela fɔ bihii enumɔ: Ezbon kɛ Uzi kɛ Uziel kɛ Yeremot kɛ Iri.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ akutso lɛ mli wekui amli onukpai, asaŋ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi hu; ni hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ amɛshwiei ateŋ.
Beker fɔ bihii nɛɛhu: Zemira kɛ Yoash kɛ Eliezer kɛ Elioenai kɛ Omri kɛ Yeremot kɛ Abia kɛ Anatot kɛ Alemet.
Be ni akane amɛshwiei ayibɔ yɛ amɛwekui anaa lɛ, ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ohai enyɔ.
Yediael fɔ binuu kome ni ji Bilhan; shi Bilhan fɔ bihii kpawo: Yeush kɛ Benyamin kɛ Ehud kɛ Kenaana kɛ Zetan kɛ Tarshish kɛ Ahishahar.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔmɔ akutso lɛ mli wekui lɛ amli onukpai, asaŋ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi hu.
Hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo kɛ ohai enyɔ yɛ amɛshwiei lɛ ateŋ.
Ir fɔ Shupim kɛ Hupim; ni Dan fɔ binuu kome ni ji Hushim.
Naftali shwiei lɛ Naftali fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yaziel kɛ Guni kɛ Yezer kɛ Shalum.
Ekɛ Bilha bii ni.
Manase shwiei lɛ Manase kɛ ehemɔ Aramyoo lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Asriel kɛ Makir mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Gilead tsɛ lɛ.
Makir ŋɔ yei ehã Hupim kɛ Shupim.
Makir yɛ nyɛmi yoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maaka.
Makir binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Zelofehad.
Zelofehad fɔ biyei sɔŋŋ.
Makir ŋa ji Maaka, ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Peresh kɛ Sheresh.
Peresh fɔ bihii enyɔ, Ulam kɛ Rakem; ni Ulam fɔ binuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Bedam.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Manase bi Makir bi Gilead shwiei lɛ.
Gilead nyɛmi yoo Hamoleket fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ishod kɛ Abiezer kɛ Mahela.
Shemida fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ahian kɛ Shekem kɛ Likhi kɛ Aniam.
Efraim shwiei lɛ Naa Efraim shwiei lɛ ayinɔiayinɔi lɛ jɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ: Efraim fɔ Shutela, ni Shutela fɔ Bered; Bered fɔ Tahat, ni Tahat fɔ Eleada, ni Eleada fɔ Tahat.
Tahat fɔ Zabad, ni Zabad fɔ Shutela.
Efraim fɔ bihii enyɔ krokomɛi efata Shutela he.
Amɛ ji Ezer kɛ Elead ni agbe amɛ be ni amɛtee amɛyaamɔmɔ Gatbii ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɔmɔbii lɛ atsinai ekãa naa lɛ.
Efraim, amɛtsɛ lɛ, ye amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba ni amɛbashɛje emii.
Kɛkɛ ni Efraim kɛ eŋã lɛ wɔ, ni yoo lɛ na musu, ni efɔ binuu.
Awo lɛ Beria yɛ amanehulu ni Efraim we lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.
Efraim fɔ biyoo ko ni gbɛi ji Sheera.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni to maji ni atsɛɔ amɛ Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Gɔŋ nɔ kɛ Bet-Horon ni yɔɔ Jɔɔŋ kɛ Uzen Sheera fɛɛ.
Efraim fɔ bi ko hu ni gbɛi ji Refa.
Refa nɛɛ fɔ Reshef; Reshef fɔ Tela, ni Tela fɔ Tahan; Tahan fɔ Ladan ni Ladan fɔ Amihud; ni Amihud fɔ Elishama.
Elishama fɔ Nun, ni Nun fɔ Yoshua.
Amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ ni ahã amɛ koni amɛhi nɔ lɛ, no nɔ Betel maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ aahu kɛyashi Naaran yɔɔ.
Yɛ anaigbɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ tee aahu kɛyashɛ Gezer maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ ahe.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Shekem maŋ wulu lɛ kɛ ehe maji lɛ kɛ Aya maŋ wulu kɛ ehe maji lɛ yɔɔ.
Manase shwiei lɛ adɛŋ maji wuji ejwɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛhe maji lɛ baje: Bet-Shan kɛ Taanak kɛ Megido kɛ Dor.
Nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ amli Yakob bi Yosef shwiei lɛ hi.
Asher shwiei lɛ Naa Asher shwiei lɛ: Asher fɔ bihii ejwɛ, Imna kɛ Ishva kɛ Ishvi kɛ Beria, kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome ni ji Sera.
Beria fɔ bihii enyɔ: Heber kɛ Malkiel mɔ ni to Birzait maŋ lɛ.
Heber fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yaflet kɛ Shomer kɛ Hotam kɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo kome, ni ji Shua.
Yaflet hu fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Pasak kɛ Bimhal kɛ Ashvat.
Yaflet nyɛmi nuu Shomer fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Roga kɛ Yehuba kɛ Aram.
Ni Shomer nyɛmi nuu Hotam fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Zofa kɛ Imna kɛ Shelesh kɛ Amal.
Zofa shwiei ji Sua kɛ Harnefer kɛ Shual kɛ Beri kɛ Imra, kɛ Bezer kɛ Hod kɛ Shama kɛ Shilsha kɛ Itran kɛ Beera.
Yeter shwiei ji Yefune kɛ Pispa kɛ Ara; ni Ula hu shwiei ji Ara kɛ Haniel kɛ Rizia.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Asher shwiei ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi ashĩai lɛ amli onukpai lɛ, hii kakabãi kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɛi, asaŋ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ ateŋ onukpai hu.
Asher shwiei nɛɛ hiɛ hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekpaa ni eshɛ tayaa.
Benyamin shwiei lɛ Benyamin fɔ bihii enumɔ.
Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Bela, ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ ji Ashbel; ebi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Ahara; ebi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Noha, ni ebi ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Rafa.
Bela shwiei ji Adar kɛ Gera kɛ Abihud, kɛ Abishua kɛ Naaman kɛ Ahoa, kɛ Gera kɛ Shefufan kɛ Huram.
-Naa Ehud shwiei lɛ.
Amɛ ji Naaman kɛ Ahia kɛ Gera.
Amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli wekui lɛ onukpai ji amɛ fɛɛ, ni kulɛ Geba amɛyɔɔ; shi abashwie amɛ akranaŋ naa kɛje jɛi, ni amɛtee amɛyabɔ mɔfro yɛ Manahat.
Gera, ni ji Uza kɛ Ahihud tsɛ, ji mɔ ni nyiɛ Geba hii lɛ ahiɛ kɛyabɔ mɔfro lɛ.
Be ni Shaharaim eshwie eŋãmɛi ni ji Hushim kɛ Baara lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, efɔ bii yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eŋɔ Hodesh efee eŋã, ni ekɛ lɛ fɔ bihii kpawo: Yobab kɛ Zibia kɛ Mesha kɛ Malkam, kɛ Yeuz kɛ Shakia kɛ Mirma.
Shaharaim bii lɛ nɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ weku mli onukpai.
Shaharaim kɛ Hushim hu fɔ bihii enyɔ, Abitub kɛ Elpaal.
Elpaal bihii ji Eber kɛ Misham kɛ Shemed mɔ ni to Ono kɛ Lod maji lɛ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle amɛhe lɛ.
Benyaminbii ni hi Gat kɛ Ayalon lɛ Beria kɛ Shema lɛ Ayalonbii lɛ awekui lɛ weku onukpai ji amɛ; amɛ ji mɛi ni shwie Gat maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ.
Beria shwiei lɛ ji Ahio kɛ Shashak kɛ Yeremot, kɛ Zebadia kɛ Arad kɛ Eder, kɛ Mikael kɛ Ishpa kɛ Yoha.
Benyaminbii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ Elpaal shwiei ji Zebadia kɛ Meshulam kɛ Hizki kɛ Heber, kɛ Ishmerai kɛ Izlia kɛ Yohab.
Shimei shwiei ji Yakim kɛ Zikri kɛ Zabdi, kɛ Elienai kɛ Ziletai kɛ Eliel, kɛ Adaia kɛ Beraia kɛ Shimrat.
Shashak shwiei ji Ishpan kɛ Eber kɛ Eliel, kɛ Abdon kɛ Zikri kɛ Hanan, kɛ Hanania kɛ Elam kɛ Antotia kɛ Ifdeia kɛ Penuel.
Yeroham shwiei ji Shamsherai kɛ Sheharia kɛ Atalia, kɛ Yaareshia kɛ Elia kɛ Zikri.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji wekui amli onukpai kɛ amɛshwiei ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Benyaminbii ni hi Gibeon kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ Yiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni ehi jɛi.
Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka, ni ekromɔbi ji Abdon.
Ebihii krokomɛi lɛ ji Zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab, kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zeker, kɛ Miklot ni ji Shimea tsɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalɛm yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi.
Maŋtsɛ Saul weku Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.
Yonatan fɔ Merib-Baal, ni Merib-Baal fɔ Mika.
Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz fɔ Yehoada, ni Yehoada fɔ bihii etɛ̃, Alemet kɛ Azmavet kɛ Zimri; ni Zimri fɔ Moza.
Moza fɔ Binea, ni Binea fɔ Rafa, ni Rafa fɔ Eleasa, ni Eleasa fɔ Azel.
Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.
Ni Azel nyɛmi nuu Eshek fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Ulam kɛ Yeush kɛ Elifelet.
Ulam bihii lɛ tsɔmɔ hii kãkãlɔi kɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi kpanakpanai; ni amɛbihii kɛ bihii abii lɛ ayibɔ fee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Benyaminbii ji Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni ku sɛɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ Akane Israelbii fɛɛ ayibɔ yɛ amɛwekui lɛ anaa.
Aŋmã mɛi akanemɔ nɛɛ he saji lɛ yɛ Israel Maŋtsɛmɛi Ayinɔ Saji Awolo lɛ mli.
Aŋɔ̃ Yudabii nom kɛtee Babilon; akɛgbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ.
Nomi lɛ ateŋ mɛi tsutsu ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛbahi amɛmaji amli ekoŋŋ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Israelbii kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ.
Nomi lɛ ateŋ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ kɛ Efraimbii lɛ kɛ Manasebii lɛ ekomɛi tee Yerusalɛm ni amɛyahi jɛi.
Yɛ Yudabii ni shi nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Utai, Imri bi Omri bi Amihud bi lɛ, ji Yuda bi Perez shwiei lɛ anukpa.
Ni yɛ Yuda bi Shela shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Asaia ji amɛnukpa.
Ni yɛ Yuda bi Zera shwiei lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Yeuel ji amɛnukpa.
Yudabii nɛɛ awei ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu hi Yerusalɛm.
Benyaminbii ni shi nɔ kɛyahi Yerusalɛm lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Salu, ni ji Hasenua bi Hodavia bi Meshulam bi lɛ, kɛ Ibneia, Yeroham bi lɛ, kɛ Ela, Mikri bi Uzi bi lɛ, kɛ Meshulam, Ibnia bi Reuel bi Shefatia bi lɛ.
Benyaminbii nɛɛ lɛ awei ohai nɛɛhu kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ ekpaa hi Yerusalɛm.
Amɛ mɛi ni atsi amɛtã nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ weku onukpai ni.
Osɔfoi ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ Osɔfoi lɛ ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji Yedaia kɛ Yehoiarib kɛ Yakin, kɛ Azaria, ni etsɛ ji Hilkia Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anukpa lɛ, asaŋ ni eji Ahitub bi Meraiot bi Zadok bi Meshulam bi lɛ, kɛ Adaia ni etsɛ ji Yeroham ni eji Pashur bi kɛ Malkiya seshinyo lɛ, kɛ Maasai ni etsɛ ji Adiel, ni eji Yahazera kɛ Meshulam kɛ Meshilemit kɛ Imer seshinyo lɛ.
Osɔfoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ wekunukpai ni, ni amɛ kɛ amɛwekumɛi ayikulɛ fee akpe kɛ ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa, ni amɛhe esa jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ amli.
Levibii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ Levibii ni hi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji Shemaia ni etsɛ ji Hashub, ni eji Azrikam kɛ Hashabia, ni jɛ Merari mli lɛ seshinyo lɛ, kɛ Bakbakar kɛ Heresh kɛ Galal kɛ Matania ni etsɛ ji Mika ni eseshibii komɛi ji Zikri kɛ Asaf lɛ, kɛ Obadia ni etsɛ ji Shemaia ni eseshibii ji Galal kɛ Yedutun lɛ, kɛ Berekia ni etsɛ ji Asa, ni eji Elkana ni hi Netofa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ shwie lɛ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hebulɔi ni hi Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hebulɔi ni hi Yerusalɛm ji Shalum kɛ Akub kɛ Talmon kɛ Ahiman kɛ amɛwekui lɛ amli bii.
Shalum ji amɛnukpa.
Kɛbashi nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni buɔ maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ naa yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Tsutsu ko lɛ kulɛ amɛbuɔ agboi ni yɔɔ Levibii ashihilɛhei lɛ anaa.
Shalum, ni ji Ebiasaf bi Kore bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kora shwiei lɛ amɛ amɛbuɔ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ he.
Ni Eleazar bi Finehas mɔ ni Yehowa ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛ amɛnɔ be ko mli.
Zakaria, Meshelemia bi lɛ, hu ji agbonaabulɔ yɛ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni ato akɛ agbonaabulɔi lɛ ayikulɛ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ahala amɛ yɛ amɛwekui anaa yɛ amɛkrowai amli.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Gbalɔ Samuel ji mɛi ni tu nitsumɔ nɛɛ wo gbɔmɛi nɛɛ atsɛmɛi beebe adɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ kɛ amɛshwiei ji mɛi ni buɔ Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ ni ji Buu lɛ ni ashi akɛ Yehowa We lɛ agboi lɛ anaa.
Agbo yɛ Shihilɛhe lɛ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ, ekooyigbɛ kɛ ewuoyigbɛ kɛ ebokãgbɛ kɛ enaigbɛ; ni agbo fɛɛ agbo yɛ agbonaabulɔnukpa.
Daa gbii kpawo lɛ agbonaabulɔi nɛɛ awekumɛi ni yɔɔ amɛkrowai lɛ amli lɛ baa, ni amɛbatsakeɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ.
Agbonaabulɔinukpai ejwɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ Levibii ji amɛ, ni amɛ amɛkwɛɔ nitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Amɛ amɛbuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nitoohei lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ ahe akɔntaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ masɛi amɛshihilɛhei yɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛbu Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ he, asaŋ ni amɛ gbele enaa agboi lɛ daa leebi.
Levibii krokomɛi lɛ Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu kwɛɔ tsɛnsii ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ.
Amɛnitsumɔ ji amɛkpa naa kɛ abahole kɛ kɛji akɛmiiba akɛbaato lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu kwɛɔ okpɔlɔi kɛ adekai kɛ tsɛnsii krɔŋkrɔŋi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Amɛkwɛɔ mamu kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ tsofakɛŋma kɛ krɔbɔo hu anɔ.
Shi osɔfoi abii lɛ ji mɛi ni futuɔ nibii srɔtoi ni akɛfeɔ tsofakɛŋma lɛ.
Levinyo ko ni gbɛi ji Matitia, Koranyo Shalum lɛ kromɔbi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ akpiti tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ ashãa nɔ.
Levibii lɛ anyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii lɛ hu ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Yehowa hiɛ daa hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ shãa nɔ.
Levibii wekui lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi anitsumɔ ji lamɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Wekui nɛɛ amli wekunukpai lɛ hi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ piai amli.
Akɛ nitsumɔ ko kwraa ejɛɛɛ sɛɛ gbaaa amɛnaa ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ lamɔ mli.
Mɛi atã ni atsi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ ji Levibii lɛ ashikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ kɛ amɛshwiei lɛ ayinɔi lɛ amli wekunukpai lɛ, ni amɛhi Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Saul seshi kɛ eshwiei Yeiel ji mɔ ni yato Gibeon maŋ lɛ, ni jɛi ehi.
Eŋã gbɛi ji Maaka.
Ekromɔbi lɛ gbɛi ji Abdon, ni ebihii krokomɛi ji Zur kɛ Kish kɛ Baal kɛ Ner kɛ Nadab, kɛ Gedor kɛ Ahio kɛ Zakaria kɛ Miklot.
Miklot fɔ Shimeam.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛ hu amɛshwiei hi Yerusalɛm yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Benyaminbii lɛ amasɛi.
Ner fɔ Kish, ni Kish fɔ Saul, ni Saul fɔ Yonatan kɛ Malkishua kɛ Abinadab kɛ Esh-Baal.
Yonatan fɔ Merib-Baal, ni Merib-Baal fɔ Mika.
Mika fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Piton kɛ Melek kɛ Tarea kɛ Ahaz.
Ahaz fɔ Yara, ni Yara fɔ bihii etɛ̃; Alemet kɛ Azmavet kɛ Zimri.
Zimri fɔ Moza.
Moza fɔ Binea, ni Binea fɔ Refaia, ni Refaia fɔ Eleasa, ni Eleasa fɔ Azel.
Azel fɔ bihii ekpaa: Azrikam kɛ Bokeru kɛ Ishmael kɛ Shearia kɛ Obadia kɛ Hanan.
Maŋtsɛ Saul gbele Filistibii lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ wu, ni Filistibii lɛ anine tsɔ̃ Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe Israelbii lɛ amɛshwie Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Israelbii lɛ jo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ; shi Filistibii lɛ tiu Israelbii lɛ kɛ Saul kɛ ebihii lɛ.
Amɛnine shɛ Saul bihii Yonatan kɛ Abinadab kɛ Malkishua nɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Akɛ ta lɛ nina Saul kpaakpa.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko yoo Saul, ni etsɛ̃ lɛ gãi, ni epila lɛ ablaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Saul kɛɛ oblanyo ni hiɛɔ etawuu nii lɛ akɛ, “Gbalamɔ oklante lɛ ni okɛdu mi bɔ ni afee ni foolɔi nɛɛ akaba amɛbagbe mi, ni amɛye mihe fɛo.” Shi oblanyo lɛ emiii nakai feemɔ, ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔ lɛ naakpa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Saul gbala lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eklante lɛ ni eho egbee nɔ.
Be ni oblanyo lɛ na akɛ Saul egbo lɛ, lɛ hu eho egbee eklante lɛ nɔ, ni egbo.
Belɛ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ gboi shi kome, kɛkɛ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Be ni Israelbii ni yɔɔ Yezreel Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ nu akɛ Israelbii lɛ ejo foi yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni asaŋ Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ enyɔnyɔi lɛ, amɛjojoo foi amɛshishii amɛmaji lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Filistibii lɛ baŋɔ maji lɛ ni amɛhi mli.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Filistibii lɛ ba gbohii lɛ ahe nibii kpɔlɔmɔ lɛ, amɛna Saul kɛ ebihii etɛ̃ lɛ agbohii lɛ jwere Gilboa Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛfo Saul yi, ni amɛkpɔlɔ edama lɛ yɛ ehe, ni atsu bɔfoi koni amɛyakpa Filistibii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpula, koni amɛyashiɛ ta lɛ mli omanye sane lɛ yɛ amɛwɔji fɛɛ anaa, ni asaŋ amɛshiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ hu.
Filistibii lɛ kɛ Saul tawuu nii lɛ tee yato amɛjemawɔŋ lɛ eko we, ni akɛ eyitso lɛ yatsotsoro amɛjemawɔŋ Dagon we lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Yabesh-Gileadbii lɛ fɛɛ nu bɔ ni Filistibii lɛ efee Saul lɛ, amɛteŋ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ tee ni amɛyawo Saul gbonyo lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ hu agbohii lɛ kɛba Yabesh, ni amɛbafu amɛ yɛ tso ko shishi, ni amɛhi ŋmãa gbii kpawo.
Anɔkwa ni Saul eyayeee lɛ hewɔ ni egbo lɛ.
Saul eyayeee Yehowa anɔkwa ejaakɛ eyayeee Yehowa kitãi lɛ anɔ ejaakɛ etee eyafee nii yɛ sisatsɛlɔ ŋɔɔ ekɛbi nii, be mli ni Yehowa moŋ nii esa akɛ ebi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa fo ewala sɛɛ, ni edãi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã Yeshai bi David.
David tsɔ̃ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Israel muu fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔ kɛ bo jɛ lá kome.
Nyɛsɛɛ ko be ni Maŋtsɛ Saul yeɔ wɔnɔ lɛ, bo ji tatsɛ ni nyiɛ Israelbii ahiɛ kɛtee kɛba, asaŋ Yehowa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wo bo shi akɛ, ‘Bo oootsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ amɛlumɔ.’ ” Israel onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ba Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Hebron, ni ekɛ amɛ kpãŋ; kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ David mu, ni amɛwo lɛ Israel maŋtsɛ bɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Samuel nɔ ewo shi eto lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ fã ta kɛtee kɛyanina Yerusalɛm.
Nakai be mli lɛ atsɛɔ Yerusalɛm akɛ Yebus.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shikwɛ̃ɛbii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ atsɛɔ amɛ Yebusbii.
Yebusbii lɛ tswa David mpoa akɛ, “Onyɛŋ biɛ oshɛ!” Shi David na eshɔ̃ Zion mɔɔ ni ji Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ̃; ni fee sɛɛ lɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.
David kɛɛ etabilɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ tsuutsu ni aaayatswia Yebusbii lɛ nii lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa kɛ lumɔ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ akɛ Zeruia lɛ, tsuutsu fã kɛtee eyatua Yebusbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ asafoiatsɛnukpa.
Ni akɛni Maŋtsɛ David etee eyahi Zion Mɔɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mɔɔ lɛ gbɛi batsɔ David Maŋ.
David saa etswa maŋ lɛ kɛjɛ he ni atsɛɔ akɛ Milo lɛ kpula kɛkpe, ni Yoab hu saa etswa he ni shwɛ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ kɛyaa lɛ, da kɛkɛ David hewalɛ lɛ daa, ejaakɛ Yehowa Ofe lɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ.
David tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ Hii kakabãi ni Maŋtsɛ David yɔɔ lɛ ateiaŋ onukpai, mɛi ni fi esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ Israel fɛɛ hu fata amɛhe ni awo David maŋtsɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi eto yɛ Israel he lɛ agbɛii kɛ amɛhe saji baa nɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ji Yashobeam, Hakemonnyo lɛ, mɔ hu ni ji hii kãkãlɔi etɛ̃ fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ.
Ewo ekpɔlɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛgbe mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ yɛ ta kome mli.
Esɛɛmɔ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ ji Eleazar, Ahohinyo, Dodo bi lɛ.
Lɛ ekɛ Maŋtsɛ David wu Pas-Damim ta lɛ be ni Filistibii lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi koni amɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ awu lɛ.
Be ni akɛ ta lɛ shɛ shikpɔŋ kuku ko ni yɔɔ jɛi ni akoko eyi nɔ obɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israelbii lɛ bɔ̃i foijee yɛ Filistibii lɛ ahiɛ.
Shi Eleazar nɛɛ ho edamɔ shi akɛ nuu, ni ekpee ta lɛ naa yɛ shikpɔŋ kuku lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu efã shikpɔŋ lɛ he, ni ekɛ esɛɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ.
Yehowa hã eye kunim kpeteŋkple.
Gbi ko lɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ mɛi etɛ̃ tee Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ yɛ Adullam Tɛkplo lɛ mli yɛ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ.
No mli lɛ Filistibii lɛ ebagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛfã ko eŋɔ Betlehem, ni amɛyɛ jɛi; David hu yɛ tɛkplo lɛ mli.
David hiɛ tsɔ̃ shĩa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ po mana ni eya Betlehem eyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu ebaha mi manu?” Kɛkɛ ni hii kãkãlɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ gba sa kɛtsɔ̃ Filistibii tabilɔi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ekãa naa kɛho, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nubu lɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem maŋ agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli nu, ni amɛkɛbahã David.
Shi David emiii nu lɛ numɔ; shi moŋ efɔse eshwie shikpɔŋ akɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛmiishã afɔle eha Yehowa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, enɛ akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ manu nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ.
Kɛji minu lɛ, hii nɛɛ alá minu lɛ ejaakɛ amɛshã amɛhe afɔle, ni amɛtee amɛyayɛ nu lɛ kɛba.” No hewɔ lɛ, David enuuu nu lɛ.
Abishai, Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, ji hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ anukpa.
Ekɛ hii ohai etɛ̃ nɔ, ni ekɛ edɛŋ akplɔ gbe fɛɛ, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ.
Egbɛi hehe fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ, ni etsɔ amɛnukpa; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ni jɛ Kabzeel lɛ, hu hii kãkãlɔi lɛ eko ni; ni efee ekãa naa nibii wuji srɔtoi babaoo.
Eko ji akɛ egbe Moabbii tabilɔi kpanakpanai enyɔ komɛi be ko.
Be ko hu lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛtee ni eyagbe jata yɛ bu ko mli yɛ snoo be mli.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eku sɛɛ egbe Ijiptnyo nyɛnyereŋŋ ko ni ekwɔlɛ fe mitai enyɔ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ akplɔ ni etilɛ tamɔ mamaloo agba tso tilɛ, ni eba koni ekɛ Benaia nɛɛ abanɔ.
Benaia hiɛ tso folo ni ekɛyatua Ijiptnyo lɛ; eshɔ̃ akplɔ lɛ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ hiɛ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni ekɛ Ijiptnyo lɛ nɔŋŋ akplɔ lɛ gbe lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni Yehoiada bi Benaia fee, ni ekɛna gbɛi yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Egbɛi hehe jogbaŋŋ yɛ hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ Kakabãi Etɛ̃ lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai Etɛ̃ lɛ ateŋ fãbii ni shwɛɔ lɛ ji Asahel, ni ji Yoab nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Elhanan, Dodo bi lɛ ni jɛ Betlehem lɛ, kɛ Shamot, Harornyo lɛ kɛ Helez, Peletnyo lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Ira, Tekoanyo, Ikesh bi lɛ, kɛ Abiezer, Anatotnyo lɛ, kɛ Sibekai, Hushatnyo lɛ, kɛ Ilai, Ahohinyo lɛ, kɛ Maharai, Netofatnyo lɛ, kɛ Heled, Netofatnyo Baana lɛ bi lɛ kɛ Itai, Ribai ni jɛ Benyaminbii amaŋ Gibea lɛ bi lɛ kɛ Benaia, Piratonnyo lɛ.
Hii kakabãi lɛ fãbii komɛi hu ji Hurai, ni jɛ Gaash fai lɛ anaa lɛ, kɛ Abiel, Arbatnyo lɛ, kɛ Azmavet, Baharumnyo lɛ, kɛ Eliaba, Shaalbonnyo lɛ, kɛ Hashem, Gizonnyo lɛ, kɛ Yonatan, Hararnyo Shage bi lɛ Ahiam, Hararnyo Sakar bi lɛ kɛ Elifal, Ur bi lɛ; kɛ Hefer, Mekerathnyo lɛ kɛ Ahia, Pelonnyo lɛ, kɛ Hezro, Karmelnyo lɛ kɛ Naarai, Ezbai bi lɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi ji Yoel, Natan nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Mibhar, Hagri bi lɛ; kɛ Zelek, Amonnyo lɛ, kɛ Naharai, Berotnyo lɛ ni hiɛɔ Zeruia bi Yoab tawuu nii lɛ; kɛ Ira, Itrinyo lɛ kɛ Gareb, Itrinyo lɛ; kɛ Uria, Hitnyo lɛ, kɛ Zabad, Ahlai bi lɛ; kɛ Adina, Shiza, Rubennyo lɛ bi lɛ ni eji Rubenbii asafoiatsɛ ni ehiɛ tabilɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ.
Hii kakabãi lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ji Hanan, Maaka bi lɛ, kɛ Yoshafat, Mitannyo lɛ, kɛ Uzia, Ashteratnyo lɛ kɛ Shama kɛ enyɛmi Yeiel, ni ji Aroernyo Hotam bihii lɛ; kɛ Yediael kɛ enyɛmi Yoha, Tizinyo Shimri bihii lɛ; kɛ Eliel, Mahavinyo lɛ, kɛ Yeribai kɛ enyɛmi Yoshavia ni ji Elnaam bihii lɛ kɛ Itma, Moabnyo lɛ, kɛ Eliel kɛ Obed kɛ Yaasiel, Mezobanyo lɛ.
Benyaminbii ni yafata David he tsutsu Be ni David yɔɔ Ziklag he ni eyatee ehe yɛ yɛ Saul, Kish bi lɛ, hewɔ lɛ, hii tabilɔi komɛi tee ni amɛyafata David he.
Hii nɛɛ shi tabilɔi kakabãi ni wa David yɛ ta mli lɛ anɔ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli he ni David hu jɛ lɛ.
Amɛhe esa bɔ ni amɛkɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ tsɛ̃ɔ gãi, ni amɛkɛtswaa aklomia hu.
Amɛnukpai ni kɛ amɛ ba ji Ahiezer, kɛ enyɛmi Yoash, ni ji Shemaa ni jɛ Gibea lɛ bihii lɛ.
Mɛi ni shi amɛnɔ lɛ ji Yeziel kɛ Pelet ni ji Azmavetbii; kɛ Beraka kɛ Yehu ni jɛ Anatot; kɛ Ishmaia ni jɛ Gibeon, nuu kãkãlɔ kpanaa ni eshi kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛnukpai lɛ eko lɛ, kɛ Yeremia kɛ Yahaziel kɛ Yohanan kɛ Yozabad ni amɛjɛ Gedera lɛ.
Fãbii hu ji Eluzai kɛ Yerimot kɛ Bealia kɛ Shemaria kɛ Shefatia ni jɛ Harof lɛ, kɛ Elkana kɛ Ishia kɛ Azareel kɛ Yoezer kɛ Yashobeam, Korabii lɛ, kɛ Yoela kɛ Zebadia, Yeroham ni jɛ Gedor lɛ bii lɛ.
Gadbii ni yafata David he Gadbii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi kãkãlɔi komɛi tse amɛhe kɛtee amɛyafata mɛi ni nyiɛ David sɛɛ lɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahe be mli ni David yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Hii nɛɛ ahe esa kɛ tsɛŋ kɛ akplɔ kɛ nɔmɔ, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama tamɔ jata hiɛ, ni amɛhe yɛ oya tamɔ gɔji anɔ soŋai.
Amɛnukpa ni kɛ amɛba ji Ezer; esɛɛmɔ ji Obadia; ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Eliab.
Mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Mishmana, ni mɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ ji Yeremia; mɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ ji Atai; mɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ ji Eliel.
Mɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ ji Yohanan; mɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ ji Elzabad; mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ ji Yeremia; ni mɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ ji Makbanai.
Tabilɔi lɛ amli asafoiatsɛmɛi ji Gadbii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ni ji bibioo lɛ enyɛɔ ekɛ mɛi oha kpeɔ; ni mɔ ni ji mɔ wulu lɛ ekɛ mɛi akpe kpeɔ.
Afi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ, be mli ni Yordan Faa lɛ eyi ni eje ŋa lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fo faa lɛ ni amɛyawo jɔi lɛ amli bii lɛ foi yɛ faa lɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Benyaminbii krokomɛi kɛ Yudabii yafata David he Asaŋ Benyaminbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi hu ba David ŋɔɔ yɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.
Ni David je kpo kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji hejɔlɛ nyiɛmɔ nyɛnyiɛ kɛba koni nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi lɛ, no lɛ miyɛ he tsui akɛ mi kɛ nyɛ aaafee ekome.
Shi kɛji nyɛba koni nyɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ, akɛni miyeko mɔ ko sane fɔŋ ko lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye misane lɛ eha mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ ba mɛi ni ba lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nɔ.
Egbɛi ji Amasai, mɔ ni fee sɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ hii Kakabãi Nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bo onii ji wɔ, David, ni ogbɛfaŋ wɔyɔɔ, Yeshai bi.
Omanye!
Hɛɛ, omanye aaabla bo; ni obualɔi lɛ anɔ̃ ji omanye: Ejaakɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa bo!” David here amɛ atuu, ni ewo amɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi yɛ etabilɔi lɛ anɔ.
Manasebii ni yafata David he Manasebii lɛ ateŋ hii tabilɔi komɛi tse amɛhe ni amɛbafata David he, be ni David kɛ Filistibii lɛ yaa koni amɛkɛ Saul ayawu lɛ.
Moŋ David naaa ewa Filistibii lɛ ta nɛɛ wuu, ejaakɛ Filistibii lɛ alumɛi lɛ tee ajina, ni amɛwo David gbɛ akɛ eku esɛɛ kɛya Ziklag ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji wɔleee feemɔ lɛ ekɛ wɔyitsei baaya ekɛyakpãtã enuŋtsɔ Saul.” Manase hii lɛ ni bafata David he be ni eku esɛɛ kɛyaa Ziklag lɛ ji Adna kɛ Yosabad kɛ Yediael kɛ Mikael kɛ Yozabad kɛ Elihu kɛ Ziletai.
Tabilɔi akpe kuikui asafoiatsɛmɛi ji amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ Manasebii ateŋ.
Amɛye amɛbua David ni ekɛ ojoyelɔi aku lɛ wu.
Hii kãkãlɔi saŋŋ ji amɛ, ni fee sɛɛ lɛ awo amɛ tatsɛmɛi.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ mɛi baa amɛbafataa David he.
Kɛkɛ ni David bana ta kpeteŋkple ni anyɛɛɛ akane.
David tabilɔi lɛ Be ni David yɔɔ Hebron lɛ, tabilɔi fɛɛ ni bafata he koni, tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo shi eto lɛ, atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ aŋɔ Saul maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã David lɛ ayikulɛ nɛ yɛ akutsei anaa: Yudabii ateŋ lɛ akpei ekpaa kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ amɛtsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi.
Simeonbii ateŋ lɛ hii kãkãlɔi akpei kpawo kɛ oha, Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ hii akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Yehoiada, ni ji Aaron we lɛ lumɔ lɛ, kɛ hii akpei etɛ̃ kɛ ohai kpawo ba; ni Zadok, oblanyo kãkãlɔ ko kɛ etsɛ we asafoiatsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ ba.
Benyaminbii, ni ji Saul nyɛmimɛi, ni bafata David he ji hii akpei etɛ̃, ejaakɛ Benyaminbii lɛ tsiimɔ yɛ Saul sɛɛ.
Efraimbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ohai kpaanyɔ, amɛba lɛ kuikui yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei anaa.
Anaigbɛ Manasebii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ ni aje gbɛ awo amɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛba ni amɛbawo David maŋtsɛ.
Isakarbii akutso lɛ mli onukpai ohai enyɔ kɛ amɛshishibii onukpai nɛɛ ji mɛi ni le nii ni sa akɛ Israel afee kɛ beyinɔ hu ni sa akɛ efee.
Zebulonbii afalɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni le tawuu jogbaŋŋ, asaŋ amɛle nibii srɔtoi kɛ tawuu hu.
Naftalibii lɛ fee asafoiatsɛmɛi tabilɔi onukpai akpe, kɛ amɛshishibii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo ni hiɛ tsɛŋi kɛ akplɔi.
Danbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛ ohai ekpaa ni emia hã ta.
Asherbii lɛ fee hii akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni ewula hã ta.
Akutsei lɛ ni yɔɔ Yordan bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni ji Rubenbii lɛ kɛ Gadbii lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Manasebii lɛ, ni bafata David he lɛ fee hii akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni le tawuu nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ hiɛmɔ kɛ tawuu.
Tabilɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ emia hã ta, ni amɛto kɛba Hebron kɛ yiŋtoo kome koni amɛbawo David Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ.
Amɛye gbii etɛ̃ yɛ David ŋɔɔ; ni amɛyeyee nii, ni amɛnunuu dãa, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ esara amɛsɛɛ.
Israelbii lɛ ananemɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛ bɛŋkɛ bake amɛ nii.
Ni ajɛ aahu ajɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ aba kɛ tejii kɛ yoomai kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ tsinai ni akɛ niyenii srɔtoi etere amɛ: mã kɛ agbãmi kɛ wain kɛ mu.
Amɛbake tsinai kɛ toi hu, ni agbe ni aye.
Amɛfee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ejaakɛ miishɛɛ eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛshi Kiriat-Yearim Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ tabilɔi akpe akuikui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi oha kui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ tee ajina.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David kɛɛ Israel gwabɔɔ muu lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji esa nyɛhiɛ, ni Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ suɔmɔ naa ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhãa wɔtsua kɛya wɔnyɛmimɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔji lɛ anɔ he fɛɛ he lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ni kɛ amɛyɔɔ yɛ amɛmaji kɛ amɛhe shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ hu aŋɔɔ, akɛ: amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛbashi wɔnɔ, koni wɔya wɔyawo wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni Saul yinɔ lɛ wɔshi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ.” Gwabɔɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ afee nakai ejaakɛ sane lɛ sa amɛhiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, David bua Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛbakpe, kɛjɛ Ijipt husu lɛ naa, yɛ wuoyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashwie he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa Lebo-Hamat lɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ, koni ayawo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Kiriat-Yearim kɛya Yerusalɛm.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ yiŋ kɛtee Baala maŋ lɛ mli ni ji Kiriat-Yearim yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ni akɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni elumɔyeli sɛ̃i lɛ ma kerubim lɛ anɔ lɛ, gbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi kɛba.
Amɛyawo Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Abinadab we lɛ, ni amɛkɛma shwiili hee ko nɔ, ni Uza kɛ Ahio ji mɛi ni kudɔ shwiili nɛɛ.
Ni David kɛ Israel muu fɛɛ nya kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ lalai kɛ saŋkui kɛ bɛji kɛ miji kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi amɛkɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Be ni amɛshɛ Kidon ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ, tsinai lɛ tɛ ni eha Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kpa kɛyaagbee shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Uza kpã enine mli ni emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli.
Yehowa mli fu Uza akɛ ekpã enine mli emɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ mli, ni Yehowa tswa Uza nɔ, ni egbo yɛ enajiaŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ masɛi.
Sane lɛ dɔ David akɛ Yehowa kɛ Uza ye kɛ joomɔ nakai.
Atsɛɔ he ni sane lɛ ba yɛ lɛ akɛ Perez-Uza kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
David she Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei nakai gbi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ mato Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hu?” Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, David hãaa akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ aya Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli; shi moŋ eha awo Adeka lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ afã kɛtee Obed-Edom, Gitnyo lɛ, we lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hi Obed-Edom bii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ eshĩa lɛ mli nyɔji etɛ̃; ni Yehowa jɔɔ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Nibii ni David fee yɛ Yerusalɛm Maŋtsɛ Hiram, Tiro maŋtsɛ, wo kapintafoi kɛ gbogbotswalɔi agbɛ, ni amɛkɛ tsenedrutsei ba koni amɛbama maŋtsɛ we amɛhã David.
Enɛ hã David na akɛ Yehowa ehã ehe shi akɛ Israel fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni asaŋ Yehowa ewo emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ gojoo yɛ Yehowa maŋ Israel.
David ŋɔŋɔɔ yei hei efata eŋãmɛi lɛ ahe yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni David fɔ bihii kɛ biyei efata ebii lɛ ahe.
Bii ni David fɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ji Shamua kɛ Shobab kɛ Natan kɛ Solomon; kɛ Ibhar kɛ Elishua kɛ Elpelet.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Noga kɛ Nefeg kɛ Yafia, kɛ Elishama kɛ Beeliada kɛ Elifelet.
David ye Filistibii lɛ anɔ kunim Be ni Filistibii lɛ nu akɛ afɔ David mu awo lɛ Israel muu lɛ fɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛfã ta kɛba akɛ amɛmiiba amɛbatua David.
Be ni David nu lɛ, efã ni ekɛ Filistibii lɛ yakpe.
Filistibii lɛ baye ofɔ̃ yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni David tee ni eyabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii akɛ, “Mifã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ lo?
Ooohã maye amɛnɔ kunim lo?” Yehowa here David nɔ akɛ, “Fãa ta lɛ kɛyanina amɛ ni mahã oye amɛnɔ kunim.” No hewɔ lɛ, David fã ta kɛyanina Filistibii lɛ yɛ Baal-Perazim, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim yɛ jɛi.
Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa etsɔ̃ minine nɔ egba kɛtsɔ̃ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ tamɔ nu ni eyi kɛsram nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛ jɛi akɛ Baal-Perazim.
Filistibii lɛ shi amɛmãgãi lɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛjo foi, ni David fã, ni ashã amãgãi lɛ.
Shi Filistibii lɛ fã ta kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
David bi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ekoŋŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafã ta kɛyatua amɛ kɛjɛ biɛ; shi moŋ lɔgɔmɔ amɛ kɛyaje amɛsɛɛgbɛ koni ojɛ Balsam tsei lɛ aŋlɛnɔ obatua amɛ.
Kɛ onu gbɛɛmɔ yɛ Balsam tsei lɛ ayiteŋ tamɔ naneshigbɛɛmɔ pɛ koni ofã kɛyashwie amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eyi ohiɛ kɛmiiya ayatswia Filistibii ata lɛ nii.” David fee bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ lɛ, ni Israelbii lɛ gbe Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Gibeon aahu kɛyashwie Gezer.
Ni David gbɛi hehe kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ; ni Yehowa hã David he ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ.
Asaa he ahã Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ womɔ David mamɔ tsui yɛ David Maŋ lɛ mli ehã ehe, asaŋ esaa he ko hu, ni eshi bui yɛ jɛi ehã Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Levibii lɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni baatere Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ ejaakɛ amɛ ji mɛi pɛ ni Yehowa ŋɔ̃ akɛ amɛ amɛta Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he, asaŋ akɛ amɛsɔmɔ lɛ kɛya naanɔ.” David kpee Israelbii fɛɛ, ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ Yerusalɛm koni ayawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba he ni asaa ato lɛ lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kpee Aaron bii lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ hu kɛba.
Uriel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi ni ji Kohatbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.
Asaia nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Meraribii ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba; Yoel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Gershonbii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ahiɛ kɛba; Shemaia nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Elizafanbii ohai enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba; Eliel nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Hebronbii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ahiɛ kɛba; ni Aminadab nyiɛ enyɛmimɛi Uzielbii oha kɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ahiɛ kɛba.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsɛ Osɔfo Abiatar kɛ Levibii lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi ekpaa lɛ, ni ji Uriel kɛ Asaia kɛ Yoel kɛ Shemaia kɛ Eliel kɛ Aminadab, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ nyɛ ji Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi lɛ ashĩai lɛ amli onukpai, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛtsuua nyɛhe nyɛfea nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ koni nyɛyawo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba he ni misaa mito lɛ lɛ.
Akɛni tsutsu lɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛtere Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ, ni jeee nakai ji ehe gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli fu wɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ tsuu amɛhe amɛfee amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ koni amɛyawo Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ.
Levibii lɛ kɛ tsei bloblobii lɛ wo adeka lɛ amɛtswa amɛkɔŋ bɔ ni Yehowa ewo kitã yɛ he kɛtsɔ̃ Mose nɔ lɛ.
David fã Levibii lɛ anukpai lɛ akɛ amɛhala amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ jooshwɛlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla, kɛ mɛi komɛi hu koni amɛkɛ obentai kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji ashwɛ joo kɛwo nifeemɔ lɛ he sɔlɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Levibii lɛ famɔ Heman, Yoel bi lɛ, kɛ ewekunyo Asaf, Berekia bi lɛ, kɛ Etan, Kushaia bi lɛ hu yɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ; ni amɛfamɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii nɛɛ hu koni amɛwa amɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Zakaria kɛ Yaaziel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uri kɛ Eliab kɛ Benaia, kɛ Maaseia kɛ Matitia kɛ Elifelehu kɛ Mikneia kɛ agbonaabulɔi Obed-Edom kɛ Yeiel.
Afamɔ Heman kɛ Asaf kɛ Etan lalawolɔi lɛ akɛ amɛ amɛtswa akɔɔble ŋmɛji, ni Zakaria kɛ Aziel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Uni kɛ Eliab kɛ Maaseia kɛ Benaia atswa obentai kɛ amɛgbee ŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃; ni Mititia kɛ Elifelehu kɛ Mikneia kɛ Obed-Edom kɛ Yeiel kɛ Azazia atswa saŋkui kɛ amɛgbee wulu lɛ.
Aŋɔ Kenania ni lɛ ji Levibii lɛ anukpa yɛ lala gbɛfaŋ lɛ akɛ ekwɛ joobilɔi lɛ kɛ lala lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ ele no mli fe mɔ fɛɛ mɔ; ni afãmɔ Berekia kɛ Elkana akɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hebulɔi.
Ahala Shebania kɛ Yoshafat kɛ Netanel kɛ Amasai kɛ Zakaria kɛ Benaia kɛ Eliezer, ni ji osɔfoi lɛ, koni amɛkpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛnyiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
Aha Obed-Edom kɛ Yehia hu fata Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hebulɔi lɛ ahe.
Awo Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Israel onukpai lɛ kɛ tabilɔi akpe kuikui anɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee koni amɛyawo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɛ Obed-Edom we lɛ kɛba kɛ nyamɔ.
Ni akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ye bua Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hewɔ lɛ, agbe tsina hii kpawo akɛshã afɔle.
David wo klala kpakpa atade, ni no eko atade nɔŋŋ Levibii ni tere Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ joobilɔi lɛ kɛ Kenania, ni ji joobilɔi lɛ atsɛ lɛ, hu wowoo.
David wo klala tsitsinɔhaanii hu.
Israel muu fɛɛ wo Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm be mli ni aabɔ oshe hoo ni aakpã koŋ bɛji kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni aatswia ŋmɛji kɛ saŋkui hu waa diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ shɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, Mikal, ni ji Saul biyoo lɛ, yabu samflɛ naa; ni be ni ena David ni eejo, ni eehuru lɛ David he fee lɛ hiɛgbele.
Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ bama buu lɛ ni David eshi ehã adeka lɛ mli, ni ashã shãa afɔlei ahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Be ni David eshã shãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ shidaa afɔlei lɛ egbe naa lɛ, etsɛ Yehowa gbɛi ni ekɛjɔɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni eja Israelbii lɛ fɛɛ nii.
Ehã nuu fɛɛ nuu kɛ yoo fɛɛ yoo aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛ loo kukuli kome kɛ wainyibii ni aka ni egbi.
David famɔ Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi koni amɛla kɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ kɛjie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi koni amɛda lɛ shi ni amɛkɛkafo lɛ.
Asaf ji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anukpa, ni esɛɛmɔ ji Zakaria.
Yehiel kɛ Shemiramot kɛ Yehiel kɛ Matitia kɛ Eliab kɛ Benaia kɛ Obed-Edom kɛ Yehiel baatswa saŋkui kɛ obentai lɛ, ni Asaf baatswa ŋmɛlɛ kɛ egbee ŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ lɛ.
Amɛteŋ osɔfoi enyɔ, ni ji Benaia kɛ Yahaziel, lɛ baakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ daa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ hiɛ.
Belɛ gbi nɛɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbi ni David kɛ hegbɛ lɛ hã Asaf kɛ enyɛmimɛi Levibii nɛɛ akɛ amɛla kɛkafo Yehowa.
Yijiemɔ lala Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi!
Nyɛshiɛa egbojee; nyɛhãa maji lɛ alea nibii ni etsu lɛ!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ; nyɛlaa kɛkafoa lɛ; nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ!
Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli!
Nyɛyabia Yehowa dɛŋ wamɔ; nyɛyaa ehiɛ nyɛyajaa lɛ daa!
Nyɛkaia naakpɛɛnii ni etsu lɛ; naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ mlai ni ewo lɛ.
Nyɛ etsulɔ Yakob shwiei, nyɛ Israel shwiei ni ji mɛi ni eŋɔ, Naa, lɛ ji Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ fɛɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ ahia enaanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔi ni ekɛwo yinɔi akpe shi lɛ anɔ, ni ji kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kpãŋ lɛ; kɛ kitã lɛ hu ni ekã Isak lɛ, ni ema nɔ aduatsɔ ehã Yakob akɛ akpɔ, kɛ Israel hu akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã akɛ ogbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii.” Be mli ni amɛyi faaa kwraa, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko mli, gbɔi ni miitsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ nɔ kɛmiiya maŋ nɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ kome nɔyeli mli kɛmiiya nɔyeli kroko mli lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni efee amɛ niseniianii; ebɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɔkɔ yɛ amɛhe, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkataa mɛi ni mifɔ amɛ mu lɛ ahe, nyɛkafea migbalɔi lɛ ano ko.” Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ!
Nyɛshiɛa edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ daa gbi.
Nyɛgbaa enunyam lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ kɛ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mɛi fɛɛ kwa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kpeteŋkple ni esa gbeyeishemɔ fe nyɔŋmɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amãgãi ni; Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi.
Woo kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe kɛkpe, ni hewalɛ kɛ miishɛɛ eyi eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, nyɛ akutsei fɛɛ; nyɛkafoa enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa anunyam ni sa egbɛi lɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛkɛ afɔle abaa; ni nyɛbaa ewe lɛ mli.
Nyɛkotoa Yehowa kɛ nyɛjamɔ atadei.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ.
Je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiŋ lɛ tsimɔ.
Ŋwɛi anya, ni shikpɔŋ mli afili lɛ; ni agba jeŋ maji lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!” Ŋshɔ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ ahuu, ni ŋã kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ emli abɔ oshe!
Kooŋ tsei aaala kɛ nyamɔ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, be mli ni ebaa ebaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Asaŋ nyɛkɛa akɛ, “Heremɔ wɔ, Ao wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛ Herelɔ, ni obua wɔnaa, ni ohere wɔ yɛ jeŋ maji lɛ adɛŋ, koni wɔda bo shi ni wɔkafo ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔshwã wɔfɔ̃ onɔ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Amen!” Ni amɛ jie Yehowa yi.
Kɛkɛ ni David shi Asaf kɛ enyɛmimɛi Levibii lɛ yɛ he ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛkwɛ jamɔ ni ajaa yɛ he ni Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nɔ daa, bɔ ni gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ jamɔ heɔ.
Asaŋ eshi Obed-Edom, Yedutun bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi Gatbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ koni amɛwa sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni ji Levibii lɛ.
Obed-Edom kɛ Hosa lɛ afee amɛ shinaanaakwɛlɔi.
David fã Osɔfo Zadok kɛ enyɛmimɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ, ni ekɛ jamɔ ni ayajaa Yehowa yɛ jamɔhe ni yɔɔ Gibeon lɛ wo amɛdɛŋ, koni amɛshã shãa afɔlei yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ, bɔ ni mla ni Yehowa ewo Israel lɛ kɛɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni ahala afata amɛhe ji Heman kɛ Yedutun kɛ mɛi krokomɛi hu ni aje gbɛ ahala amɛ akɛ amɛla kɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Heman kɛ Yedutun ji mɛi ni kwɛɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kɛ ŋmɛji kɛ amɛgbee ŋlɛ̃ŋlɛ̃ lɛ kɛ jooshwɛmɔ nibii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni akɛshwɛɔ joo kɛji aala yijiemɔ lala krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ni Yedutun bii lɛ ji mɛi ni afee amɛ agbonaabulɔi.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛlɛ mli, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee eshĩa.
Kɛkɛ ni David hu tee ewe eyanina eŋãmɛi kɛ ebii lɛ.
Natan kɛ David bawie Maŋtsɛ David tsu atsɛ gbalɔ Natan ahã lɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Bɛ oona, mi lɛ mina tsenedrutso tsu mli mikã be mli ni Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ moŋ yɛ buu mli.” Natan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Feemɔ nɔ ni kã otsui nɔ akɛ ofee lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ fi osɛɛ.” Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Natan akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ, jeee bo obaama tsu ohã mi koni mahi mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni miyakpala Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mihiko tsu mli dã, fe akɛ buui amli mihi kɛjɛ he kome kɛtee he kroko.
Hei fɛɛ ni mi kɛ Israel fɛɛ enyiɛ lɛ, mibiko Israel maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni mifã amɛ akɛ amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ he ko he ko pɛŋ akɛ, mɛɛba ni nyɛmako tsenedrutsu nyɛhako mi?’ “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mitsulɔ David akɛ, mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mi miŋɔ bo yɛ toi asɛɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ, ni mifee bo mimaŋ Israel nɔyelɔ, ni he fɛɛ he ni otee lɛ mifata ohe, ni miplenee ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni mihã ona gbɛi kpeteŋkple tamɔ gbɔmɛi wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mito he ko mihã mimaŋ Israel koni amɛyahi jɛi akɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnɔ mli, he ni agbaŋ amɛnaa yɛ dɔŋŋ, ni basabasa gbɔmɛi haoŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ tamɔ sa lɛ, be mli ni mito hiɛnyiɛlɔi koni amɛkura mimaŋ Israel lɛ.
Maha ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe ajɔ, ni asaŋ miiwo bo shi akɛ mibahã oshwiei ahe shi.
Ogbele sɛɛ lɛ matee mɔ ni jɛ omli shi akɛ maŋtsɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛyeli ama shi.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama tsu ehã mi lɛ, ni mahã emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Mibatsɔ̃ etsɛ, ni lɛ hu ebaatsɔ̃ mibi.
Mifoŋ suɔmɔ ni mikɛbaasumɔ lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ mifo misuɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Saul, mɔ ni mikpa lɛ ni oba oyeɔ esɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Shi mahã ekura mimaŋ Israel, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baama shi shiŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.’ ” Natan kɛɛ David nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ba yɛ ninaa lɛ mli lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
David sɔle ekɛda Nyɔŋmɔ shi Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David tee Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ mli, ni eyata shi ni esɔle ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ, namɔ ji mi, ni mɛni po mli miwe yɔɔ hewɔ ni okura mi kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ?
Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ jeee nɔ srɔto ko hã bo, Nyɔŋmɔ.
Otsɔ̃ɔ wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ hu nibii ni baaba miwe lɛ nɔ, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ; ni oobu mi tamɔ gbɔmɔ wulu ko.
Mɛni dɔŋŋ po yɔɔ minaa ni makɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ nyam ni owo nɛɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ole mi, otsulɔ momo.
Yehowa, gbɔmɔ he ni odɔɔ, kɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ osuɔmɔ naa ofee nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ koni ohã male nibii wuji ni oto ohã mi.
Yehowa, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni wɔnu naa lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ bo ye egbɔ, ni asaŋ osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ji nyɔŋmɔ ko.
Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ kɛ omaŋ Israel ye egbɔ akɛ maŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, oyakpɔ̃ yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli yɛ Ijipt ni ofee lɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ koni okɛ nibii wuji ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni otsu ohã amɛ lɛ ahe gbɛi?
Ofee Israel bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, hã shi ni owo yɛ mi, otsulɔ kɛ miwe lɛ, he lɛ aba mli bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ shishiishi kɛya naanɔ; ni ogbɛi lɛ aaada kpeteŋkple, ni aaakɛɛ kɛya naanɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Ni ooohã miwe lɛ ahe shi shiŋŋ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
MiNyɔŋmɔ, mi otsulɔ, toi nɔ ni owo akɛ obaahã ewe lɛ atsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmɛi awe lɛ, no hewɔ ni mina ekãa kɛsɔleɔ nɛkɛ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Yehowa, bo nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni okɛ nɛkɛ nɔ kpakpa nɛɛ ewo mi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, ni ojɔɔ mishwiei koni amɛsane asa ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni bo, Yehowa, ojɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.”
Tai amli kunim ni David ye Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ David kɛ Filistibii lɛ wu, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eshɔ̃ Gat maŋ lɛ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle lɛ lɛ yɛ Filistibii lɛ adɛŋ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David ye Moabbii lɛ hu anɔ kunim, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ etsuji, ni amɛtsuɔ onia amɛbahãa lɛ.
Asaŋ David fã ta ewo Siria Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer hu, ni eye enɔ kunim kɛyashwie Hamat tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer nɛɛ fã kɛtee akɛ eyaaŋɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ he shikpɔŋ lɛ ekɛwo eshishi.
David shɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tayaa shwiilii akpe, ni emɔmɔ tabilɔi okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi akpei kpawo kɛ nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
David folɔ shwiili naa okpɔŋɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaji asɛɛ fãi; shi eshi amɛteŋ bɔ ni baahia ahã shwiilii oha.
Kɛkɛ ni Siriabii ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ fã kɛba koni amɛbawa Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer yɛ ta lɛ mli, shi David gbe Siriabii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David jara asraafoi kuikui eto Siriabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Damasko, ni Siriabii lɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji, ni amɛtsuɔ onia amɛbahãa David.
Yehowa hã David ye kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃.
David shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ shika tsɛŋi ni Hadadezer tsuji lɛ hiɛhiɛ lɛ, ni ekɛba Yerusalɛm.
David loo akɔɔble babaoo hu diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Tibehat kɛ Kun, ni ji maji ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ, ni ekɛtee.
Solomon kɛ akɔɔble nɛɛ fee Sɔlemɔ we nutoo gbudugbaŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ akulashiŋi lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii krokomɛi.
Be ni Hamat Maŋtsɛ Tou nu akɛ David eye Hadadezer ta tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kunim lɛ, etsu ebinuu Yoram lɛ Maŋtsɛ David ŋɔɔ koni ebaŋa lɛ, ni ehã lɛ aekoo ehã lɛ, yɛ Hadadezer nɔ kunim ni eye lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Hadadezer kɛ Tou kɛ amɛhe ewuwuu tai saŋŋ.
Yoram hiɛ shika nibii kɛ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ akɔɔble nibii srɔtoi babaoo kɛba ekɛbake maŋtsɛ David.
Maŋtsɛ David jɔɔ nibii nɛɛ anɔ eke Yehowa, ni ekɛfata jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni eloo momo sa yɛ majimaji fɛɛ ni eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ amli kɛba lɛ he.
Maji nɛɛ ji Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amon kɛ Filistia kɛ Amalek.
Abishai ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, gbe Edombii akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Nii nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Abishai jara asraafoi kuikui eto Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Edombii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ David tsuji.
He fɛɛ he ni David tsɔ̃ lɛ Yehowa hã eye kunim.
David ye Israel fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye jalɛ sane ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Yoab, ni atsɛɔ enyɛ Zeruia lɛ, ji etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ; ni Yehoshafat, Ahilud bi lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ tuuŋtu woloŋmalɔ; ni Zadok, Ahitub bi lɛ, kɛ Ahimelek, Abiatar bi lɛ, amɛ ji osɔfoi; ni Shawesha ji woloŋmalɔ.
Benaia, Yehoiada bi lɛ, ji tabilɔi ni yɔɔ Maŋtsɛ David he kpaakpa lɛ atsɛ, ni David bihii lɛ ji maŋtsɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ onukpai.
David ye Amonbii kɛ Siriabii anɔ kunim Yɛ mli aahu lɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ Nahash gbo, ni ebinuu baye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ David to eyiŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibajie mlihilɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ Nahash bi Hanun, ejaakɛ etsɛ mli hi hã mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ David tsu tsuji kɛtee akɛ amɛyahã Hanun kpoo amɛhã lɛ yɛ etsɛ gbele lɛ hewɔ.
Be ni David tsuji lɛ tee Hanun ŋɔɔ yɛ Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahã lɛ kpoo lɛ, Amonbii lɛ alumɛi lɛ kɛɛ Hanun akɛ, “Naa, tsumɔ ni David etsu kɛba akɛ abahã bo kpoo nɛɛ lɛ kaasusu akɛ ekɛmiiwo otsɛ hiɛ nyam.
Maŋ lɛ saramɔ kɛ eshikpamɔ moŋ hewɔ ni David ewo etsuji gbɛ kɛba nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni enyɛ maŋ lɛ ebaŋɔ.” Enɛ ha Hanun mɔmɔ David tsuji lɛ, ni eshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋi fãfãafãi eshwie, ni no sɛɛ lɛ efolɔ amɛtadei lɛ anɔ yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu kɛbata amɛdukui anɔ, kɛkɛ ni ejie bɔfoi lɛ agbɛ ni amɛtee.
Be ni abagba David bɔ ni afee etsuji lɛ, etsu ni akɛ tsuji lɛ yakpe yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ abɔ amɛ ahora fe nine.
Ekɛ shɛɛ maje yahã amɛ akɛ amɛwa Yeriko kɛyashi amɛtsɛŋ lɛ aaatsa dani amɛba shĩa.
Hanun kɛ Amonbii lɛ na akɛ amɛyatsi David sɛ̃, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe tsu akɛtee ayabɔ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi apaa yɛ Mesopotamia kɛ Aram-Maaka kɛ Zoba yɛ Siriabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛbawa amɛ.
Shwiilii akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛ Maaka maŋtsɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ, mɛi apaa ni ayabɔ lɛ ba, ni amɛbagba ta yɛ Madeba maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Amonbii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu bua amɛhe naa kɛjɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli ni amɛ hu amɛbagba ta.
Be ni David nu lɛ ewo Yoab kɛ hii kãkãlɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ kɛtee.
Amonbii lɛ je kpo ni amɛbagba ta yɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Shi maŋtsɛmɛi ni ba Amonbii lɛ awamɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ tse amɛhe, ni amɛgba amɛta lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yoab na akɛ agba ta awo lɛ yɛ esɛɛ kɛ ehiɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ehala Israel tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi, ni ehã amɛgba ta koni amɛkɛ Siriabii lɛ akpe.
Etabilɔi ni shwɛ lɛ, etu amɛ fɛɛ ewo enyɛmi Abishai shishi.
Amɛ lɛ, amɛgba ta lɛ koni amɛkɛ Amonbii lɛ akpe.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛɛ Abishai akɛ, “Kɛji ona akɛ Siriabii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ minɔ lɛ, ni obaye obua mi; mi hu kɛji mina akɛ Amonbii lɛ anine miitsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ mibaba mibaye mabua bo.
Feemɔ ekãa ni ohã wɔfee hii yɛ wɔmaŋbii kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maji lɛ ahewɔ, ni Yehowa aaahã nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ aba mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Yoab kɛ tabilɔi ni yɔɔ eshishi lɛ tsɛ̃ kɛyanina Siriabii lɛ; shi Siriabii lɛ jo foi.
Be ni Amonbii lɛ na akɛ Siriabii lɛ ejo foi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛjo Abishai naa foi ni amɛyabote amɛmaŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yoab ku esɛɛ ni eba Yerusalɛm.
Be ni Siriabii lɛ na akɛ Israelbii lɛ eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛtsu bɔfoi ni ayaŋɔ Siriabii ni yɔɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛba.
Zoba Maŋtsɛ Hadadezer tatsɛ Shofak nyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛba.
Abagba David, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ebua Israel tabilɔi fɛɛ anaa kɛkɛ ni ekɛ amɛ fo Yordan Faa lɛ kɛbanina Siriabii lɛ, ni egba ta ewo amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni abɔ̃i wuu.
Shi Siriabii lɛ jo foi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ahiɛ.
David gbe Siriabii shwiilitsɛmɛi akpei kpawo kɛ tabilɔi nanenɔnyiɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, kɛ amɛtatsɛ Shofak hu.
Be ni maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ Hadadezer shishi lɛ na akɛ Israel eye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ, amɛ kɛ David bakpãtã, ni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ no sɛɛ lɛ amɛyaaa amɛyayeee amɛbuaaa Amonbii lɛ dɔŋŋ.
David yaŋɔ Raba maŋ lɛ Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ afi, be mli ni maŋtsɛmɛi fãa ta lɛ, Yoab ŋɔ Israel ta lɛ ni efã ta ewo Amonbii lɛ, ni ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Shi Maŋtsɛ David hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Yoab yagba ta kɛbɔle Raba maŋ lɛ, kɛkɛ ni etua maŋ lɛ, ni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
Maŋtsɛ shika fai ko yɛ ni akɛbuɔ Amonbii anyɔŋmɔ Molek lɛ shiu lɛ yitso.
Maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ tsiimɔ ji shika ŋmiiŋmi talenta kome, ni ojarawatɛ ko yɛ maŋtsɛ fai lɛ he.
David jie ojarawatɛ nɛɛ ni ekɛwo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛ fai lɛ he.
No sɛɛ lɛ, David loo Raba maŋ lɛ nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ kɛtee.
Asaŋ ekpala maŋbii lɛ kɛtee, ni ehã amɛ nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛhã lɛ kɛ saalai kɛ kɔi kɛ lema lɛ.
Bɔ ni David fee Amonbii amaji lɛ fɛɛ nɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm.
Tai ni David kɛ Filistibii gojogojoo lɛ wu Fee sɛɛ lɛ ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Gezer yɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ.
Sibekai, Hushanyo lɛ, gbe Sipai ni ji hii oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ashwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ ta nɛɛ mli, ni ekɛjɔɔ Filistibii lɛ ahe.
Ta te shi ekoŋŋ yɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Filistibii lɛ ateŋ; ni Elhanan, ni ji Yair bi lɛ, gbe Lahemi ni enyɛmi ji Goliat, Gatnyo lɛ ni ekpɔlɔ tso tilɛ tamɔ mamalolɔ agba tso tilɛ lɛ.
Awu ta ekoŋŋ yɛ Gat.
Nuu nyɛnyereŋŋ ko kɛ ewaabii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, enine waobii ekpaaekpaa kɛ enane waobii hu ekpaaekpaa, ba ta lɛ.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo lɛ ashwiei lɛ eko ji lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ tswa Israelbii lɛ mpoa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yonatan, ni ji David nyɛmi Shimea bi lɛ, tswa nuu lɛ nɔ ni egbe lɛ.
Hii oblaŋi gojogojoo ni hi shi yɛ Gat lɛ ashwiei ji gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ David kɛ etsuji lɛ anine naa.
David hã akane maŋbii ayikulɛ Yɛ mli aahu lɛ, satan te shi ewo Israel, ni ewo David yiŋ akɛ ekane Israel yikulɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Yoab kɛ tabilɔinukpai lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyakanea Israel maŋ muu fɛɛ, kɛjɛa Beersheba kɛyashia Dan nyɛhãa mi ni nyɛbakɛa mi koni male maŋbii lɛ ayikulɛ.” Shi Yoab kɛɛ David akɛ, “Yehowa ahã bɔ ni maŋ lɛ yifalɛ yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ aku abɔ he toi oha!
Shi minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, kwɛ jeee mikɛɛ bekɛ otsuji ji amɛ fɛɛ?
Mɛɛba mɔ ni minuŋtsɔ taoɔ akɛ afee nɛkɛ nɔ ko ni baahã Israel fɛɛ atɔ̃ nɛɛ?” Shi Maŋtsɛ David eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ehãaa Yoab.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yoab yiŋ etee, ni eyakpa Israel fɛɛ, ni eku esɛɛ eba Yerusalɛm, ni ekɛ maŋbii lɛ ayibɔ lɛ bahã David.
Ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpe toi akpe kɛ akpei oha yɛ Israel; ni ana hii ni eshɛ tayaa akpei ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo yɛ Yuda.
Shi Yoab kaneee Levibii lɛ kɛ Benyaminbii lɛ eshiii nɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ David ehã afee lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa.
Nɔ ni afee lɛ eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ naa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, egbala Israel toi.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Mitɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ kpele kɛ nii nɛɛ ni mifee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa bo fai ni okɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ afa mi, ejaakɛ miye kwashiai asane naakpa.” Yehowa kɛɛ Gad ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ David he lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ David akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛ nibii etɛ̃ miishwie ehiɛ; ekɔ amɛmli ekome, ni mafee mahã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Gad ba David ŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.
Okɔ amɛmli nɔ ni osumɔɔ: Kɛji hɔmɔ afii etɛ̃ ni jio, loo akɛ ohenyɛlɔi baanyiɛ osɛɛ, ni obaajo amɛnaa foi nyɔji etɛ̃ ni jio, loo akɛ Yehowa baawo etsi nɔ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ Israel nɔ, ni ehã gbele hela aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbii etɛ̃ koni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ akpãtã mɛi ahiɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni jio.
No hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ oyiŋ, ni ohã mi hetoo mikɛyahã mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.” David to he eha Gad akɛ, “Sane lɛ wa hã mi naakpa.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ misumɔŋ ni mayaje gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ.
Miyɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ emɔbɔnalɛ fa.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa hã gbele hela ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Israelbii ateŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai kpawo gboi.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛba koni ebafite Yerusalɛm.
Shi be ni bɔfo lɛ baabɔ̃i nifitemɔ lɛ, Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni abaafee maŋ lɛ hewɔ, kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ bɔfo ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Efa, agbɛnɛ suu onine.” Be nɛɛ mli lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ masɛi.
David yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ naa Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni klante hiɛ edɛŋ, ni ekpã enine mli yɛ Yerusalɛm nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛ maŋ onukpai ni ekɛ amɛ bumɔ kpekpe lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bu shi.
Ni David kɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Ataa, mi mifã akɛ ayakane maŋbii lɛ.
Mi ji mɔ ni etɔ̃ ni efee efɔŋ naakpa lɛ, shi jeee maŋbii nɛɛ; amɛleee he eko, ni amɛhe bɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, toigbalamɔ lɛ kɛgbala mi kɛ mitsɛwe lɛ toi koni omaŋbii lɛ aye amɛhe.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Gad akɛ ekɛɛ David akɛ eya koni eyama afɔleshãa latɛ ema he ni Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ehã Yehowa.
No hewɔ lɛ, David yiŋ etee yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ ni ekɛtsɔ̃ Gad nɔ lɛ naa.
Ornan kɛ ebihii ejwɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmãa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
Be ni Ornan fo ehe ni ehiɛ gba bɔfo lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebihii lɛ yatee.
David miiba Ornan ŋɔɔ, ni Ornan fo ehe ni ena David.
No hewɔ lɛ, eje kpo yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ ni ekoto David, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi.
Ni David kɛɛ Ornan akɛ, “Okɛ oŋmãagbeemɔhe nɛɛ ahã mi mahe, koni mama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ jɛi maha Yehowa, bɔ ni afee ni afo gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ ahã wɔ.
Mibawo bo nyɔmɔ shishiishi.” Ornan kɛɛ David akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ŋɔɔ ni ofee nɔ ni sa ohiɛ.
Naa, mikɛ tsinai lɛ miihã koni akɛshã afɔlei lɛ, ni mikɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe tsei lɛ hu miiha koni akɛfee lai; ni naa ŋmãa hu koni akɛfee niyenii afɔle.
Mikɛ fɛɛ miike!” Shi Maŋtsɛ David here Ornan nɔ akɛ, “Dabida!
Mahe mawo nyɔmɔ bɔ ni ji enaa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Miŋɔŋ nii ni ji onɔ mihaŋ Yehowa, ni asaŋ mikɛ nɔ ko ni mina lɛ yaka hu eshaŋ afɔle.” No hewɔ lɛ, David wo Ornan ŋmãagbeemɔhe shikpɔŋ lɛ he nyɔmɔ ni naa feɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi shekeli ohai ekpaa, ni ehe jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni David ma afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
Be ni ekɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ shidaa afɔlei eba sɛɛ lɛ, esɔle etsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here David nɔ, ni ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebasɔo afɔlei lɛ anaa la yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã bɔfo lɛ, ni ekɛ klante lɛ wo ehebo lɛ mli.
David na nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli akɛ Yehowa ehere lɛ nɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, eshã afɔlei yɛ Ornan, Yebusnyo lɛ, ŋmãagbeemɔhe lɛ.
No mli lɛ Gibeon ji he ni Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni Mose fee yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yɔɔ, ni jɛi ayajaa yɛ.
David nyɛɛɛ jɛi eya koni eyabi Nyɔŋmɔ nii ejaakɛ ŋmiŋmi emɔ lɛ yɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ klante lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ etsɔ̃ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We; ni biɛ Israel fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ baahi.” Bɔ ni asaa he ahã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ maa David fã akɛ abua gbɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa.
Ejara nitsumɔi ehã amɛ.
Tɛgbalɔi lɛ ehã amɛko tɛi ni akɛma Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
David hã nitsulɔi lɛ dade babaoo koni akɛfolɔ plɛkoobii kɛ klampii ahã agboi lɛ anaa shinai lɛ.
Ehã amɛ akɔɔble hu babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ aŋmɛ.
Asaŋ ehe tsenedrutsei babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane ejaakɛ Sidonbii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ baha Maŋtsɛ David tsenedru tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
David kɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mibi Solomon hiɛ fãko, asaŋ ehiɛ esako, ni tsu ni ebaama eha Yehowa lɛ, esa akɛ efee tsu kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ bɔ ni ehenɔ kɛ enyam bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko he ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, mato tsu lɛ maa he nibii mashwie shi mato lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, David to tsu lɛ he nibii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ eto dani egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni David tsu atsɛ ebi Solomon ahã lɛ, ni efã lɛ akɛ ema tsu eha Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ekɛɛ Solomon, ebi lɛ, akɛ, “Kulɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mama tsu koni mikɛwo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi hiɛ nyam.
Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Oshwie lá shi tsɔ̃, ni owuwuu tai wuji.
Kaama tsu ni okɛmiiwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam ejaakɛ oshwie lá shi babaoo yɛ mihiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsɔ̃.
Naa, obaafɔ binuu ko.
Toiŋjɔlɛ baaba yɛ eyinɔ, ejaakɛ maha ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahã ena toiŋjɔlɛ.
Abaatsɛ lɛ Solomon, ni mahã Israel ana toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ eyinɔ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni baama shihilɛhe kɛwo migbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ.
Ebaatsɔ̃ mibi, ni matsɔ̃ etsɛ; ni maha emaŋtsɛyeli ahe shi yɛ Israel kɛya naanɔ.’ ” “No hewɔ lɛ, mibi, Yehowa ajɔɔ bo koni onyɛ shihilɛhe lɛ oma oha Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ ohe lɛ.
Yehowa aduro bo nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛkɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji etu Israel ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, onyɛ maŋ lɛ nɔ okwɛ yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mla naa.
Kɛji ojwɛŋ nɔ ni oye akpɔi kɛ mlai ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Mose nɔ ewo Israel lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ oooshwere.
Ohe awa, ni ofee ekãa.
Okashe gbeyei, ni otsui akafã hu.
Naa, migbo deŋme misaa nibii nɛɛ mito miha Yehowa Shihilɛhe lɛ maa: shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpei oha, kɛ jwiɛtɛi hu ni tsiimɔ ji talentai akpe toi akpe, kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade ni anyɛɛɛ aŋmɛ tete, ejaakɛ amɛfa fe nine; tsei kɛ tɛi hu yɛ.
Shi obaatao nibii nɛɛ eko ogbe yi.
Oyɛ ŋaalɔi hu babaoo: tɛgbalɔi kɛ tsu tswalɔi kɛ kapintafoi kɛ ŋaalɔi krokomɛi babaoo ni anyɛɛɛ akane, ni ji shika ŋmiiŋmi kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade.
Tee shi ni owo nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ!
Yehowa aaaye abua bo!” Kɛkɛ ni David wo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ kitã akɛ amɛye amɛbua ebi Solomon.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni eha nyɛtoiŋ ejɔ nyɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ejaakɛ ehã miye majimaji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ bii anɔ kunim, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyɛ nyɛshishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ asɔmɔa Yehowa.
Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛmaa Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni akɛ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii kɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ fɛɛ abamamɔ tsu ni ama ni aja Yehowa yɛ jɛi lɛ mli.”
Be ni David egbɔ kotokoto lɛ, ewo ebi Solomon Israel maŋtsɛ.
Nitsumɔ ni ahã Levibii lɛ Maŋtsɛ David tsɛ Israel lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Ehã akane Levibii lɛ ateŋ hii ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛyaa fɛɛ.
Amɛyibɔ ni ana lɛ fee akpei nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo.
Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wo amɛteŋ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ adɛŋ.
Eto mɛi akpei ejwɛ akɛ agbonaabulɔi, ni eto mɛi akpei ejwɛ hu akɛ amɛ jie Yehowa yi kɛ jooshwɛmɔ nibii ni esaa eto koni akɛjie Yehowa yi lɛ.
David jara amɛmli kuikui yɛ Levi bihii ni ji Gershon kɛ Kohat kɛ Merari lɛ anaa.
Gershon fɔ bihii enyɔ: Ladan kɛ Shimei.
Ladan fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Yehiel kɛ Zetam kɛ Yoel.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Ladan shwiei awei lɛ anɔ onukpai lɛ.
(Shimei fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Shelomot kɛ Haziel kɛ Haran.)
Shimei fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Yahat kɛ Zina kɛ Yeush kɛ Beria.
Yahat ji kromɔbi, ni esɛɛho ji Zina; akɛni Yeush kɛ Beria eyafɔɔɔ bihii pii hewɔ lɛ akane amɛshwiei lɛ akɛ tsɛwe komeŋ bii.
Kohat fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Amram kɛ Ishar kɛ Hebron kɛ Uziel.
Amram, Kohat kromɔbi lɛ, fɔ Aaron kɛ Mose.
Ajie Aaron kɛ eshwiei lɛ ato akɛ mɛi krɛdɛɛ ni akwɛ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni akɛjaa lɛ anɔ kɛya naanɔ; asaŋ akɛ amɛ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma be mli ni ajaa Yehowa; ni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa, ni amɛjɔɔ mɛi yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.
Shi akane Mose, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ, shwiei lɛ ashi Levibii lɛ anɔ.
Mose fɔ bihii enyɔ, Gershom kɛ Eliezer.
Gershom shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa ji Shebuel.
Eliezer fɔ binuu kometoo pɛ ni ji Rehabia; shi Rehabia fɔ babaoo.
Izhar, Kohat binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ Shelomit.
Lɛ etsɔ̃ Izhar shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa.
Hebron, Kohat binuu ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Ekromɔbi lɛ ji Yeria; mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Amaria; mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ji Yahaziel, ni mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ ji Yekameam.
Uziel, Kohat binuu ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔ bihii enyɔ: Mika, kromɔbi lɛ, kɛ Yeshia, mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Merari fɔ bihii enyɔ: Mahli kɛ Mushi.
Mahli hu fɔ bihii enyɔ: Eleazar kɛ Kish; shi Eleazar gbo ni ebɛ binuu fe biyei kɛkɛ.
Kish bihii lɛ ŋɔ Eleazar biyei lɛ akɛ ŋamɛi.
Mushi, Merari binuu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, fɔ bihii etɛ̃: Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yeremot.
Levi shwiei ni akane amɛ yɛ amɛwei kɛ amɛshiãishiãi anaa lɛ nɛ.
Aŋmãla amɛgbɛii ekomekome; ni nuu fɛɛ nuu ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa lɛ, akɛ lɛ shi Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ David kɛɛ nɔ ko akɛ, “Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã emaŋ lɛ he ejɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛaahi Yerusalɛm kɛya naanɔ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehe ehĩaaa akɛ Levibii lɛ atere Yehowa Kpee Buu Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ ehe nibii ni akɛjaa lɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.” Yɛ Maŋtsɛ David naagbee gbɛjianɔtoi anaa lɛ, aŋmãla Levibii ni eye kɛjɛ afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛyaa agbɛii, ni ahã amɛ nitsumɔi ni baa nɛɛ akɛ amɛtsu: amɛwaa Aaron shwiei ni ji osɔfoi lɛ kɛji aaja yɛ Yehowa we lɛ; amɛsaa kpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ piai lɛ amli; amɛtsumɔɔ nibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ahe; amɛtsuɔ nitsumɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ ni kɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ mli sɔɔmɔ he; amɛkwɛɔ aboloo ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ he saji anɔ, kɛ mamu ni akɛbashãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, kɛ kaka ni akɛ ma akpiti shã lɛ, kɛ nibii ni ashã ni akɛbashãa afɔle lɛ, kɛ mamu ni akɛ mu efutu mli ni akɛbaashã afɔle lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ amɛ amɛŋmɛɔ ni amɛsusuɔ nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ ni akɛbaa afɔleshãa lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaa kɛdaa Yehowa shi; ni amɛkɛjieɔ eyi hu.
Be fɛɛ be ni aashã afɔle ahã Yehowa yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii anɔ loo yɛ nyɔji hei ajee mli kɛ gbii juji anɔ hu amɛ amɛlaa.
Ato Levibii ni be fɛɛ be lɛ amɛ amɛbaatsu nitsumɔi nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛsɔmɔ Yehowa.
Belɛ Levibii lɛ ji mɛi ni kwɛ Yehowa Kpee Buu lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nɔ; ni amɛ amɛwa Aaron shwiei ni ji amɛnyɛmimɛi osɔfoi lɛ, ni akɛsɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Nitsumɔi ni ahã osɔfoi lɛ Shĩaishĩai ni feɔ Aaron shwiei lɛ agbɛii baa nɛɛ: Aaron fɔ bihii ejwɛ: Nadab kɛ Abihu kɛ Eleazar kɛ Itamar.
Nadab kɛ Abihu gboi yɛ amɛtsɛ hiɛ, ni amɛshiii bii.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛmimɛi Eleazar kɛ Itamar baye osɔfo lɛ.
Zadok ni jɛ Eleazar shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ kɛ Ahimelek ni jɛ Itamar shwiei lɛ ateŋ lɛ wa Maŋtsɛ David ni ejara Aaron shwiei lɛ amli kuikui yɛ nitsumɔi ni ahã amɛ lɛ anaa.
Ana akɛ Eleazarbii lɛ ateŋ hii shĩaiaŋ onukpai lɛ ayi fa fe Itamarbii lɛ ateŋ hii shĩaiaŋ onukpai lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ajara Eleazarbii lɛ amli kui nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa, ni ajara Itamarbii lɛ mli kui kpaanyɔ.
Akɛni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lumɛi kɛ mumɔŋ lumɛi fɛɛ yɛ Eleazarbii lɛ kɛ Itamarbii lɛ ateŋ biɛ kɛ biɛ hewɔ lɛ, afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛja nitsumɔi lɛ ahã amɛ.
Kɛji afɔ̃ shi kome ahã Eleazarwe lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shi kome hu ahã Itamar we lɛ.
Ni Shemaia, Netanel bi lɛ, ni jɛ Levibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ji woloŋmalɔ mɔ ni ŋmala bɔ ni oshikifɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ tee nɔ hã.
Eŋmala nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Abiatar bi Ahimelek kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii ashĩaiaŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki lɛ gbee Yehoiarib nɔ; ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbee Yedaia nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Harim nɔ, ni ejwɛ lɛ gbee Seorim nɔ; nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ gbee Malkiya nɔ, ni ekpaa lɛ gbee Miyamin nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee Hakoz nɔ, ni kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Abia nɔ.
Nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Yeshua nɔ, ni nyɔŋma lɛ gbee Shekania nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Eliashib nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Yakim nɔ; nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Hupa nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Yeshebeab nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbee Bilga nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ gbee Imer nɔ; nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ gbee Hezir nɔ, ni nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Hapizez nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Petahia nɔ, ni nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ gbee Yehekel nɔ.
Nɔ ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Yakin nɔ, ni nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Gamul nɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Delaia nɔ, ni nɔ ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Maazia nɔ.
Bɔ ni ato gbɛjianɔ lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ nɛ: amɛyaa Yehowa we lɛ amɛyasɔmɔɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛ Aaron to he gbɛjianɔ yɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fãmɔ naa lɛ.
Levibii krokomɛi hu agbɛii Levibii lɛ ekomɛi hu amli onukpai lɛ agbɛii baa nɛ: Yehedeia ni jɛ Amram bi Shebael mli lɛ, Ishia, Rehabia shwiei lɛ ateŋ onukpa lɛ, Yahat, ni jɛ Izhar bi Shelomit mli lɛ.
Hebron bihii ejwɛ lɛ: Yeria, ni ji onukpa lɛ, kɛ Amaria mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ Yahaziel mɔ ni ji etɛ̃, kɛ Yekameam mɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ.
Shamir, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika mli lɛ.
Zakaria, ni jɛ Uziel bi Mika nyɛmi Ishia mli lɛ.
Mahli kɛ Mushi, Merari shwiei lɛ.
Beno kɛ Shoham kɛ Zakur kɛ Ibri, ni ji Merari shwiei ni jɛ Yaazia mli lɛ.
Eleazar, Mahli bi lɛ; shi lɛ lɛ ebɛ bihii.
Yerameel, Kish bi lɛ.
Mahli kɛ Eder kɛ Yerimot, Mushibii lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji Levibii abihii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi awei lɛ anaa.
Shĩa fɛɛ shĩa mli onukpa lɛ fã enyɛmimɛi gbekɛbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome efata ehe kɛfɔ̃ oshiki, ni amɛkɛkɔlɔ amɛgbɛfaŋ nitsumɔi lɛ tamɔ amɛnyɛmimɛi Aaronbii lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Amɛ hu amɛfee nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Osɔfo Zadok kɛ Ahimelek kɛ Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Levibii lɛ atsɛmɛi awei lɛ amli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli Joobilɔi lɛ Maŋtsɛ David kɛ Levibii lɛ ateiaŋ lumɛi lɛ hala mɛi komɛi yɛ Asafbii lɛ kɛ Hemanbii lɛ kɛ Yedutunbii lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛto amɛ akɛ amɛ amɛgba kɛji aaja, shi nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛmiitswa obenta kɛ saŋkui kɛ ŋmɛji, ni amɛmiikpã bɛji hu.
Mɛi ni ahala kɛ nitsumɔi hu ni ahã amɛ lɛ baa nɛɛ.
Asaf bihii ejwɛ lɛ: Zakur kɛ Yosef kɛ Netania kɛ Asharela.
Amɛyɛ amɛtsɛ Asaf shishi.
Lɛ lɛ eyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he, ni egbaa Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ wiemɔ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Yedutun bihii ekpaa lɛ: Gedalia kɛ Zeri kɛ Yeshaia kɛ Shimei kɛ Hashabia kɛ Matitia.
Amɛyɛ amɛtsɛ Yedutun shishi, ni amɛgbaa Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ wiemɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ, nakai be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛmiitswa obenta, ni amɛmiila kɛmiikafo, ni amɛkɛmiida Yehowa shi.
Heman bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ: Bukia kɛ Matania kɛ Uziel kɛ Shebuel kɛ Yerimot kɛ Hanania kɛ Hanani kɛ Eliata kɛ Gidalti kɛ Romamti-Ezer kɛ Yoshbekasha kɛ Maloti kɛ Hotir kɛ Mahaziot.
Nyɔŋmɔ duro Heman, maŋtsɛ gbalɔ lɛ, bihii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ biyei hu etɛ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Heman agbojee da tamɔ bɔ ni ewo he shi eto lɛ.
Heman bii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ eshishi, ni amɛtswaa ŋmɛji kɛ obentai yɛ Yehowa we amɛkɛwaa jamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli.
Shi Asaf kɛ Yedutun kɛ Heman lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shishi.
Gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ nɛɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni ekase Yehowa lalai lɛ lamɔ, asaŋ ni amɛhe esa jogbaŋŋ yɛ mli lɛ ayibɔ ji ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni afɔ̃ oshiki ni akɛjara nitsumɔi lɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ, gbekɛ kɛ onukpa, kɛ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ kaselɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ oshiki ni afɔ̃ lɛ gbee Yosef ni jɛ Asafbii ateŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbee Gedalia kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ ebihii lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Zakur kɛ ebihii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji ejwɛ lɛ gbee Zeri kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji enumɔ lɛ gbee Netania kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji ekpaa lɛ gbee Bukia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee Asharela kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Yesaia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Matania kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ gbee Shimei kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Uzia kɛ ebii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Hashabia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Shubael kɛ ebihii kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Matitia kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ gbee Yeremot kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekpaa lɛ gbee Hanania kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo lɛ gbee Yoshbekasha kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ gbee Hanani kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ gbee Maloti kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ lɛ gbee Eliata kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ gbee Hotir kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enyɔ lɛ gbee Gidalti kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ gbee Mahaziot kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Oshiki ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ gbee Romamti-Ezer kɛ ebihii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he Bulɔi Naa Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni ajara Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hebuu nitsumɔi lɛ ahã lɛ: Meshelemia, Koranyo ni ji Kore bi ni jɛ Asafbii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Meshelemia fɔ bihii kpawo, ni amɛgbɛii nɛ yɛ fɔmɔ naa: Zakaria kɛ Yediael kɛ Zebadia kɛ Yatniel, kɛ Elam kɛ Yehohanan kɛ Eliehoenai.
Mɔ ko hu ji Obed-Edom ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ lɛ, ni eduro lɛ bihii kpaanyɔ lɛ.
Ebihii nɛɛ agbɛii yɛ fɔmɔ naa baa nɛɛ: Shemaia kɛ Yehozabad kɛ Yoa kɛ Sakar kɛ Netanel, kɛ Amiel kɛ Isakar kɛ Peuletai.
Obed-Edom bi Shimei fɔ bihii ekpaa ni tsɔ̃mɔ amɛtsɛwe lɛ shĩai amli onukpai ejaakɛ hiɛwalɔi ji amɛ lɛ.
Shimei bii nɛɛ agbɛii yɛ fɔmɔ naa ji Otni kɛ Refael kɛ Obed kɛ Elzabad ni enyɛmimɛi ji Elihu kɛ Semakia kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi, ni ji Obed-Edom bii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ayibɔ fee hii kãkãlɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ ni eshɛ kɛhã bulɔi anitsumɔ.
Ana hii hiɛwalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ kɛhã buu nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ Meshelemia shwiei lɛ ateŋ.
Hosa ni jɛ Meraribii ateŋ lɛ hu yɛ bihii ejwɛ; Shimri, ni ji onukpa lɛ.
Jeee lɛ ji kromɔbi moŋ, shi etsɛ wo lɛ onukpa; kɛ Hilkia kɛ Tebalaia kɛ Zakaria.
Hosa shwiei fɛɛ ni aŋɔ awo buu nitsumɔ lɛ mli ayibɔ fee nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Ajara bulɔi nɛɛ amli kuikui, ku fɛɛ ku kɛ enukpa; ni ahã amɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli tamɔ ahã amɛnyɛmimɛi Levibii krokomɛi lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Tsɛmɛi ashĩaishĩai lɛ fɔ̃ oshiki koni akɛna nɔ agbonaa ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa baabu; ayakwɛɛɛ mɛi ni ayi fa kɛ mɛi ni ayi faaa.
Oshiki ni afɔ̃ yɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia nɔ; ni nɔ ni afɔ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ hewɔ lɛ gbee Shelemia bi Zakaria, nuu nilelɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni afɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ, hewɔ lɛ gbee Obed-Edom nɔ; ni nitoohe lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ gbee ebihii lɛ anɔ.
Anaigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛ Shaleket agbo lɛ, nɔ ni kã gbɛjegbɛ ni yaa gɔŋ nɔ gbɛ lɛ he lɛ, anaibulɛ lɛ gbee Shupim kɛ Hosa nɔ.
Aja buube lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ ni eko faaa fe eko.
Mɛi ekpaa buɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ daa gbi; mɛi ejwɛ buɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ejwɛ hu buɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ; shi mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ buɔ nitoohe lɛ daa gbi.
Mɛi ejwɛ buɔ he ni anaigbɛ agbo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ he lɛ, ni mɛi enyɔ buɔ agba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ajara agbonaabulɔi ni jɛ Korabii lɛ kɛ Meraribii lɛ ateŋ lɛ amli kuikui ahã.
Levibii lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, Ahia ji mɔ ni kwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ nitoohei lɛ kɛ nibii ni akɛbake Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ hu atoohe lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Gershon bi Ladan shwiei na shĩai babaoo ni eko ji ebinuu Yehiel shĩa lɛ.
