Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ehã gbɔmɔ fɔŋ nɛ, gboshinii ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã lɛ nɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Hiob hã hetoo ekɛɛ: “Nyɛboa nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ toi jogbaŋŋ, ni no afee nɔ ni nyɛkɛaashɛje mimii.
Nyɛnaa tsui nyɛhãa mi, ni mi hu mawie; ni kɛji miwie migbe naa lɛ, koni nyɛye mihe fɛo.
Ani gbɔmɔ mikɛna lɛ?
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mato tsui shi?
Nyɛkwɛa mi, ni nyɛhe aaajɔ̃ nyɛhe; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnine aaato nyɛnaabu.
Kɛji mijwɛŋ he lɛ, miwerɛ hoɔ, ni ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi.
Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ayi naa wala, amɛgbɔlɔɔ, ni amɛjeɔ agbo kɛ hewalɛ?
Amɛnaa amɛbii ashweremɔ, ni amɛnabii daraa yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Asheee gbeyei yɛ amɛshĩai amli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ edɔɔɔ kpãa etooo amɛnɔ.
Amɛtsina hii lɛ kwɔɔ; ni efeee yaka, ni amɛtsina yei lɛ sharakeee.
Amɛhãa amɛbii jeɔ kpo, ni amɛtumɔɔ kɛ shwɛmɔ tamɔ toobii.
Amɛlaa kɛnyiɛɔ milɛ̃ kɛ saŋku sɛɛ; ni amɛnyaa kɛji blɛ gbɛɛ.
Amɛyeɔ ejurɔ yɛ amɛwala mli, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje kpoo kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Yiwalɔi kɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Jee wɔnɔ!
Wɔtaooo wɔle bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ aba jeŋ ahã.
Namɔ ji Ofe lɛ, ni esa akɛ wɔsɔmɔ lɛ lɛ?
Ni mɛni sɛɛ wɔɔna kɛji wɔsɔle wɔkpa lɛ fai?” Naa, amɛshweremɔ lɛ aso jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ mli eyɔɔ?
Shi yiwalɔi asusumɔ nɛɛ lɛ, mi lɛ miŋɔɔɔ nɔ.
Shii enyiɛ agbe mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ, ni amanehulu eba amɛnɔ, aloo Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛpiŋ yɛ emlifu naa ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa, loo tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa?
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ etĩa amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ anaa eto ehã amɛbii.
Dabida!
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala efɔŋfeelɔ toi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ, koni amɛna amɛle nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛfee lɛ.’ Hã ena lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ ehiŋmɛii ni esa enaa Ofe lɛ mlifu lɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ ŋkɔmɔ eyeɔ yɛ ebii ni eshi he, kɛji egbii asɛɛ efo yɛ jeŋ?
Aso mɔ ko aaanyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee etsɔ̃ɔ, lɛ mɔ ni ekojoɔ ŋwɛibii tete po lɛ?
Mɔ ko gboɔ ni eyɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ be mli ni eyɔɔ hejɔlɛ, ni etoiŋ hu ejɔ lɛ, ni egbɔmɔtso eshwi ni ewui amli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fɔ tsɔtsɔɔ tsɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ko hu gboɔ yɛ awerɛhoo mli, ni eyeko ŋɔɔmɔ ko kwraa dã.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛyajwereɔ su mli, ni gɔgɔmii haa amɛhe.
Naa, mile nyɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛ ŋaa ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ kɛgba minaa fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ lumɔ lɛ we lɛ yɔɔ agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ ni ji yiwalɔ lɛ?’ Nyɛbiko gbɛfalɔi lɛ anii, ni odase ni amɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ, akɛ abaa yiwalɔ yi yɛ amanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ahereɔ eyiwala?
Namɔ kãa yiwalɔ hiɛ, ni namɔ woɔ lɛ nɔ ni efee he nyɔmɔ?
Kɛji atere lɛ ni ayaafu lɛ, abuɔ esaŋ lɛ he tete.
Nakai mɛi fɛɛ aaanyiɛ esɛɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee ayifa babaoo.
Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛaasumɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ yaka wiemɔi ashɛje mimii lɛ?
Nyɛwiemɔi lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.”
Sanegbaa ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ Elifaz wiemɔ Kɛkɛ ni Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, here Hiob nɔ ekɛɛ, “Aso adesa ko he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ?
Anɔkwa, nilelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ enaa.
Ani eji miishɛɛ sane hã Ofe lɛ kɛji ofeɔ nii ni ja?
Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ naa he sɛɛ kɛji ohi shi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ohe?
Ani gbeyei ni osheɔ lɛ hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kãa ohiɛ, ni ekojoɔ bo nɛɛ?
Ani jeee oyiwalɛ nifeemɔi ni naa wa kɛ onifɔɔjianii ni aleee naa lɛ hewɔ ekɛ bo yeɔ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ onyɛ onyɛmimɛi anɔ, ni amɛto bo awaba yakatswaa; ni oshɔ̃ amɛheboi oŋmɛ amɛyayai.
Mɔ ni etɔ lɛ lɛ, ohãaa lɛ nu ni enu; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ hu okamaa lɛ niyenii.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, lɛ eŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mɔ ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ, lɛ ehiɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yei okulafoi lɛ, ashwieɔ amɛ, amɛyaa kɛ amɛdɛ̃ folo.
No hewɔ lɛ, tsɔnei ebɔle bo kɛkpe, ni ŋmiŋmi emɔ bo trukaa, duŋ ewo bo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, onaaa nii, ni nu afua eha onɔ.
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ?
Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni ŋulamii lɛ ekomɛi yɔɔ shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ hã.
No hewɔ lɛ, okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni ji nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ le?
Ani eeenyɛ etsɔ̃ duŋ kpii lɛ mli ekojo lo?’ Osusuɔ akɛ atatui kabitii etsimɔ enɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaaa nii, ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ husu lɛ naa esharaa shi yɛ?
Ani obaaba blema jeŋba gbonyo ni yiwalɔi lɛ ba lɛ eko?
Mɛi ni ashara amɛ kɛtee dani eshɛ amɛbe, ni afɔ amɛshishitoo ashwie kɛ nu?
Amɛkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, ‘Jee wɔnɔ!’ Ni ‘Mɛni Ofe lɛ baanyɛ wɔ efee?’ Tsɛbelɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hã amɛshĩai shwere kɛ nii.
Minuuu mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ashishi!
Mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii naa, ni efeɔ amɛ miishɛɛ; mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ yeɔ amɛhe fɛo.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, akpãtã wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni nii ni amɛshi hu la ekpãtã hiɛ.’ Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akpãtã, koni otoiŋ ajɔ bo; no nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ni oooye ejurɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ enaa wiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ato otsuiŋ.
Kpalemɔ kɛya Ofe lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni oba ohe shi.
Kpa nibii ni ejaaa feemɔ lɛ yɛ owe lɛ mli.
Kɛ okɛ oshika yawo mlu mli, ni okɛ Ofir shika yawo faa ni hoɔ shishi tɛi amli, ni oŋɔ Ofe lɛ ofee oshika, kɛ ojwiɛtɛi ni jara wa lɛ, no dani omli aaafli bo yɛ Ofe lɛ hiɛ, ni ooowo ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ!
Sɔlemɔ okpa lɛ fai ni eeebo bo toi; ni oooye oshiwoi lɛ anɔ.
Nɔ ni oooto oyiŋ akɛ ooofee lɛ eeeye omanye ehã bo, ni la aaakpɛ ahã bo yɛ ogbɛ nɔ!
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baa mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ shi, ni heshibalɔ lɛ, ehereɔ eyiwala.
Ehereɔ mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko yiwala.
Eeehere oyiwala kɛji ofeko esha.”
Hiob wiemɔ Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ hu mikɔmɔyeli lɛ naa wa; minyɛɛɛ mitsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ naa mamɔ.
Oo, mile he ni mana lɛ yɛ kulɛ maya esɛi lɛ hiɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mikɛ misane lɛ baafɔ̃ ehiɛ, ni mibakɔlɔ misane lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
Mana male nɔ hetoo ni eeehã mi ni mana manu nɔ ni eeekɛɛ mi lɛ shishi.
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi aaatao naa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ naa?
Dabida; eeebo mi toi kɛ̃.
Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaayiyi yɛ jɛi; ni mikojolɔ lɛ aaabu mi bem ni maye mihe kɛaatee naanɔ.
Naa, kɛji mitee bokãgbɛ lɛ, ebɛ jɛi, ni miba anaigbɛ hu, minaaa lɛ.
Mitao lɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ, shi minaaa lɛ; mitsɔ̃ mihe kɛtee wuoyigbɛ hu, shi mihiŋmɛi gbaaa enɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ le minanefaamɔi fɛɛ; kɛji eka mi ekwɛ lɛ ebaana mi akɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Minyiɛ enanefãamɔ sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; no mli minyiɛ; migbako afã.
Mitswako Nyɔŋmɔ naa wiemɔ ko mifɔ̃ko afã dã; mikɛto mitsui shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Etsakeee; ni Lɛ lɛ eyɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ sa, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa eku.
Nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
Nɔ ni eto ehã mi lɛ, ebaafee kɛgbe naa; ni nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi pii yɛ eyiŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ mi yɛ ehiɛ; kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ, misheɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Nyɔŋmɔ ehã mitsui efã; Ofe lɛ ewo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ duŋ ebɔle mi kɛkpe ni duŋ kabitii ha mihiɛ.
Hiob wiemɔ “Mɛɛba Ofe lɛ etooo be pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ekojoɔ, ni mɛɛba mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ tete leee ekojomɔ bei lɛ?
Mɛi tsirɛɔ husui kɛyaa sɛɛ, amɛshɔ̃ɔ mɛi akooloi ni amɛkɛshiɔ amɛkooloi anɔ amɛlɛɔ.
Amɛshɔ̃ɔ awusãi atejii yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛyaa; amɛhãa okulafo kɛ etsina toɔ amɛ awaba.
Amɛtsirɛɔ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ gbɛteŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shitswialɔi fɛɛ teeteɔ amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, ohiafoi lɛ nyiɛ ŋa nɔ ni amɛmiitao niyenii tamɔ ŋaŋ teji amɛhã amɛbii koni amɛye.
Ŋa nɔ amɛfolɔɔ kooloi aniyenii yɛ; ni yiwalɔi awaintromi amli amɛyeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ.
Amɛkamɔɔ shi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai, ni fɛ̃i be hu amɛbɛ hehaanɔ.
Gɔji lɛ anɔ nyɔŋmɔ eyi amɛ, ni amɛhɔlɔ tɛkploi amli, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ abobaahe yɛ he ko he ko.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tseɔ abifao ni kã fufɔ naa awusã; ni amɛbiɔ, ni ohiafo kɛ ebi abifao tete batoɔ amɛ awaba.
Ohiafoi nyiɛ yayai ni mama bɛ amɛhe; ni amɛtereɔ jatsu kɛ hɔmɔ.
Amɛfeɔ mu yɛ yiwalɔi amutsei ateŋ; amɛŋaa wain kɛ wain tsɔnei nɛ, shi kumai yeɔ amɛ.
Aanu mɛi ni miigboi akɛ̃ɛmɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni pilafoi miibolɔ kɛmiitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
Mɛi yɛ ni amɛkwa la lɛ, amɛnuuu egbɛjianɔtoo shishi, ni amɛhiii shi yɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ hu.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔ lɛ teɔ shi leebi mra ni eyaa eyagbeɔ ohiafo kɛ shitswialɔ, ni kɛji je na hu lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ julɔ.
Ni gbãlãfitelɔ hu mɛ̃ɔ hiɛbulɛ ni ekɛ nɔhaanɔ haa ehiɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ko yooŋ mi.” Amɛjwaraa shĩai yɛ duŋ mli nyɔɔŋ; ni shwaneshwane lɛ amɛŋmɛɔ amɛyi amɛwoɔ tsuŋ; ni amɛkɛ hulu la lɛ bɛ sane ko.
Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ duŋ kpii lɛ ji amɛleebi; ejaakɛ duŋ kpii mli gbeyei nibii lɛ ji amɛnanemɛi.
[Zofa] Yiwalɔ lɛ, faa shaa lɛ kɛyaa shwiaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ lomɔɔ eshikpɔŋ ni eshi lɛ; eyaaa ewaintrom lɛ mli gbɛ dɔŋŋ eyaŋaaa wain.
Jeŋ gbimɔ kɛ dɔlɛ hereŋŋ hãa snoo nu miiɔ, nakai gbohiiaje hu loɔ eshafeelɔi kɛyaa.
Hiɛkpaa amɛ nɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, akaiii amɛgbɛii tete dɔŋŋ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, akuɔ yiwalɛ mli tamɔ tso.
Amɛyeɔ yoo kene ni bɛ bi dɛŋ nii, ni amɛfeee yoo okulafo ejurɔ ko kwraa.
Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ehewalɛ nɔ ehãa hewalɔi awala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; amɛteɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ, kɛji jeŋshihilɛ je amɛtsine.
Nyɔŋmɔ hãa amɛhiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ no nɔ, shi ehiŋmɛi kã amɛjeŋba he daa.
Awoɔ amɛ nɔ be kukuoo ko, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛlaaje; amɛgbiɔ tamɔ jwɛi, ni afolɔɔ amɛ ashwieɔ tamɔ akuɔ abele.
Kɛji jeee nakai ji sane lɛ, namɔ baanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ amalelɔ ji mi, asaŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ekome nɛkɛ bɛ mli?”
Kɛkɛ ni Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ashe lɛ gbeyei; ehã toiŋjɔlɛ ehe shi yɛ eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ani aaanyɛ etabilɔi ayibɔ akane?
Namɔ kwraa nɔ ela lɛ etsooo yɛ?
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ hu ni adesa aaaja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu?
Te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni gbɔmɔ ni jɛ yoo musuŋ lɛ he aaatse hu?
Naa, yɛ ehiɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛɛɛ, ni ŋulamii lɛ hu ahe tseee; mbasroo adesa ni ji omlɛgɛ, adesa fɔmɔbi ni ji gɔgɔmi nɛɛ?”
Hiob wiemɔ Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ei, bɔ ni oyeɔ obuaa mɔ ni bɛ hewalɛ nɛ?
Ei, bɔ ni ohereɔ mɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ yiwala nɛ?
Kwɛ, bɔ ni owoɔ mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ŋaa ni ojieɔ nilee babaoo kpo otsɔ̃ɔ nɛ?
Namɔ wa bo kɛwie lɛ, ni namɔ mumɔ jɛ omli je kpo nɛɛ?
[Bildad] Gbohii asusumai lɛ miikpokpo, ni fai lɛ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ miikpokpo.
Gbohiiaje kã shi kpetekplee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; nɔ ko nɔ ko ehaaa nɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Elɛɛ kooyigbɛ ŋwɛi lɛ mli eha shi yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni eŋɔ je lɛ etsotsoro shi ni etsotsorooo nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tiaa nu naa yɛ atatu mli, kɛ̃lɛ nu lɛ tsiimɔ fɛɛɛ atatu lɛ.
Ehãa atatu lɛɔ shi, ni ehaa nyɔɔŋtsere hiɛ fɛɛ.
Efo akrabatsa yɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ ni no etsɔ̃ husu ni kã la kɛ duŋ lɛ teŋ.
Akulashiŋi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe kpokpoɔ, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ɔ amɛhe kɛji ekã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Ejɔɔ ŋshɔ he yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ekɛ enilee kpãtãa sasabonsam lɛ hiɛ.
Emumɔ ji nɔ ni hãa ŋwɛi tseɔ, ni ekɛ enine kpãtãa onufu ni miijo foi ni eya lɛ hiɛ.
Naa, ehewalɛ lɛ he okadii nyɔkɔsiɔ̃ɔi komɛi kɛkɛ nɛ; ni ewiemɔ ablɛbi fioo kɛkɛ wɔnuɔ lɛ.
Shi namɔ aaanyɛ ele Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛwula shi.”
Hiob wie ekoŋŋ Kɛkɛ ni Hiob wo ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tswa misane lɛ efɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ Ofe lɛ, mɔ ni hã miwerɛ ho mihe lɛ, akɛ, gbii abɔ ni wala yɔɔ mimli, ni Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ hãa mimuɔ nɛɛ, amale ejeŋ minaa, ni mililɛi lakaŋ mɔ ko.
Enɛ akagbale mi akɛ mabu nyɛ bem; kɛyaashi magbo lɛ, miŋmɛŋ mibemyeli lɛ he.
Mihiɛ mijalɛ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni miŋmɛŋ he; mihenilee ebuuu mi fɔ yɛ miwalaŋ gbii lɛ eko kwraa ahe.
Hã mihenyɛlɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ yiwalɔ, ni hã mɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ mi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛni ji mɔ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ, be ni Nyɔŋmɔ efo ewala sɛɛ, ni eshɔ̃ ewala yɛ edɛŋ lɛ?
Kɛji fimɔ ba enɔ lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaabo ebolɔmɔ toi?
Ani emii shɛɔ yɛ Ofe lɛ hewɔ, aloo esɔleɔ ebiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ be fɛɛ be?
Matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ tsuɔ; mikɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ Ofe lɛ he eteŋ nyɛ.
Naa, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛna; mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni nyɛwieee wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ?
Nɔ ni mɔfɔŋ naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nɛ; nɔ ni Ofe lɛ yɔɔ hã yiwalɔ nɛ.
Kɛji ebii ayi fa babaoo lɛ, klante amɛyi fa amɛhã, ni eshwiei lɛ aboloo shɛŋ amɛnaa.
Bii ni eshiɔ yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, gbele hela gbeɔ amɛ; ni amɛkulafoi lɛ foŋ amɛ tete.
Yiwalɔ buaa jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu, ni eeebua atadei anaa eto tamɔ mɛ; eeebua naa nɛ, shi mɔ ni baawo ji jalɔ, ni mɔ ni fɔbuu bɛ ehe ji mɔ ni baaja ejwiɛtɛi lɛ.
Shĩa ni emaa lɛ etamɔ anaanu ntaŋ, loo asese ni bulɔ efee.
Eyakãa shi akɛ niiatsɛ, shi ebaŋ lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ; be ni eeegbele ehiŋmɛi lɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ŋmiŋmi mɔɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eje ŋa loɔ nibii; ahum woɔ lɛ kɛyaa nyɔɔŋ.
Bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ woɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ebɛɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ eshĩaŋ kɛyaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa enɔ ni enaaa lɛ mɔbɔ, be ni etaoɔ foi ejo kɛjɛ edɛŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tswaa edɛŋ eshwieɔ enɔ, ni eboɔ lɛ ‘tsiaa!’ kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ mli.
Nilee kafomɔ “Anɔkwa, bui yɛ ni atsaa jwiɛtɛi yɛ mli, ni hei yɛ ni anaa shika ni asereɔ yɛ.
Atsaa dade yɛ shikpɔŋ ni asereɔ akɔɔble kɛjɛɔ tɛ mli.
Mɛi sheee duŋ gbeyei, ni amɛboteɔ duŋ mli amɛyataoɔ tɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ kabitii lɛ mli kɛyaa duŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Mɛi yatsaa shika bui yɛ hei ni gbɔmɔ bɛ.
Gbɛfalɔi ahiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ; amɛtsotsoroɔ kpãa naa kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ shika bui lɛ amli.
Shikpɔŋ mli niyenii jɛɔ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ shishi lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ ni la eshã.
Emli tɛi amli anaa safiro yɛ, ni shika futru hu yɛ mli.
Okropɔŋ leee jɛigbɛ lɛ, akroma ko hiŋmɛi enako jɛi dã.
Kooloi kakawuai lɛ eko kwraa nane yiko gbɛ lɛ nɔ dã, ni jata tsɔ̃ko enɔ kɛhoko dã.
Gbɔmɔ kɛ enine tsaa tswɛrɛbo tɛ, ni etsaa gɔji ashishi ekɛwuleɔ amɛ eshwieɔ shi.
Be mli ni ekpɛɔ gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tɛsai amli lɛ, ehiŋmɛi naa ojarawatɛi fɛɛ.
Etsĩɔ fai anaa koni amɛkanyɛ amɛho, ni nii ni akɛtee shishi lɛ, ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ.
Shi nɛgbɛ abaana nilee yɛ?
Ni nɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
Gbɔmɔ leee ejarawalɛ; ni anaaa lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ŋshɔŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ mimli!’ Ni ŋshɔ hu kɛɛ, ‘Ebɛ miŋɔɔ!’ Atseee shika aheee, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi ni baashɛ enyɔmɔwo.
Ofir shika shɛɛɛ ejara; nakai nɔŋŋ ji ojarawatɛ onike loo safiro.
Shika kɛ ashwishwɛ kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ; ni akɛtsakeŋ shika jwinei kpakpai diɛŋtsɛ.
Atsiŋ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o kɛ kɔli tã yɛ he ni eyɔɔ; nilee jara wa fe adiagba.
Etiopia ojarawatɛ topasiɔn kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ, ni anyɛŋ aŋmɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni baashɛ ejara.
Belɛ nɛgbɛ nilee jɛɔ mɔ, ni nɛgbɛ ji he ni niiashishinumɔ yɔɔ?
Aŋɔ tee, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hiŋmɛi enaŋ; akɛtee loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi tete.
Gbele kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛɛ, ‘He kɛkɛ wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi ni aawie.’ Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ni le gbɛ ni kã kɛyaa he; ni lɛ ele he ni eyɔɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ, enaa jeŋ naagbee hei bluublu, ni enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi.
Be ni eŋmɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hewalɛ ehã lɛ, ni esusu ŋshɔi kɛ fai afalɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nu anɛ ahã, kɛ bɔ ni srawa agba kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi ahã lɛ; no mli Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji nilee; ni eka etɛ naa ekwɛ ni eŋɔ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ adesã akɛ, ‘Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, no ji nilee, ni hewii kɛ efɔŋ hejee ji jwɛŋmɔ.’ ”
Hiob naagbee naajiemɔ Hiob bɔ̃i wiemɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ, “Oo, mina ni kulɛ mitsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ be ko ni eho lɛ, be mli ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ mihe lɛ, be ni ela lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ miyiteŋgbɛ ni minaa nii yɛ duŋ mli lɛ.
No be mli lɛ, minibii shwere, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ bu miwe lɛ he.
Ofe lɛ kɛ mi yɛ, ni mimusuŋbii hu bɔle mihe kɛkpe.
Mitsinai kɛ mitoi hãa mi fufɔ babaoo, ni mimutsei shwere yɛ tɛsai amli.
Kɛji mije kpo kɛtee maŋ koi lɛ shi, ni miyata shi yɛ blohuŋ lɛ, oblahii lɛ hãa mi gbɛ kɛji amɛna mi, ni onukpai lɛ teɔ shi hãa mi, lumɛi tete fɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji toɔ amɛnaabu; abladei agbei laajeɔ, ni amɛlilɛi kpɛtɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ mihe lɛ jɔɔ mi, ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛkafoɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ mihereɔ ohiafo ni foɔ kɛ awusã ni bɛ bualɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã lɛ jɔɔmɔ baninaa mi, ni mihãa okulafo tsui nyɔɔ emli kɛ nyamɔ.
Jalɛ ji mimama ni mibuɔ, ni mijalɛ saneyeli ji mitade kɛ akekre.
Mitsɔ̃ hiŋmɛi mihã shwilafo, ni mitsɔ̃ naji mihã obubuafo.
Mitsɔ̃ tsɛ mihã ohiafoi ni mɛi ni mileee amɛ tete mitao amɛsaji amli mihã amɛ.
Mikumɔ mɔfɔŋ lɛ nyanyɔji yɛ edaaŋ, ni ehã eŋmɛɛ nɔ ni kɔ̃ enaa ni eyaaye lɛ he efɔ̃ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Mishĩa teŋ magbo yɛ ni migbii baafa tamɔ shia.
Mitamɔ tso ni efãi etsɛ̃rɛ kɛtee kɛyanina nu, ni bɔ nyɔɔ ebai anɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mɛi ahiɛ sɔɔ mi be fɛɛ be, ni migãi lɛ hu naa hewalɛ hee yɛ midɛŋ.” Mɛi bo mi toi, ni amɛmɛ, ni amɛfee kpoo kɛmɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ.
Kɛji miwie sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieee dɔŋŋ; ni miwiemɔi lɛ boteɔ amɛmli.
Amɛkwɛɔ miwiemɔ gbɛ tamɔ okwaafonyo kwɛɔ nunɛmɔ gbɛ.
Miŋmɔɔ kɛji mina akɛ amɛtsui miiye, ni mihiɛ ŋmɔlɔ lɛ woɔ amɛ hewalɛ.
Mi, mito amɛshihilɛ lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ni mihi shi mihã amɛ akɛ yitso; mihi shi yɛ etabilɔi ateŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Mihi shi akɛ mɔ ni shɛjeɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi amii.
Shi agbɛnɛ mɛi ni miye amɛ onukpa miiŋmɔ mi; mɛi ni mibuŋ amɛtsɛmɛi bɔ ni maŋɔ amɛ mafata gbei ni buɔ tookui tete ahe lɛ anɔ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ mibana yɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ ahe?
Ohia kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa hãa amɛkpeɔ ŋa gbiŋ nɔ tsei ashishifãi.
Amɛfamɔɔ shiaŋaŋ tsei, ni amɛtsɛrɛɔ koowie bai ni amɛshɛreɔ blɔtsei amɛwereɔ.
Ashwieɔ amɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni awɔɔ amɛyi tamɔ awɔɔ julɔ yi.
Nujɔi ajɔi amli kɛ shikpɔŋ bui kɛ tɛkploi amli amɛaahi.
Koowiei ashishi amɛbolɔɔ yɛ; sɔŋsrɔ shishi amɛbuaa amɛhe naa yɛ.
Kwashiai yakagbɔmɛi abii; ayi amɛ, ashwie amɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, mitsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ kotsa, ni mitsɔ̃ fɛoyeli wiemɔ mihã amɛ.
Amɛnyaŋeɔ mi; amɛwiɔ amɛhe yɛ mihe, kɛji amɛna mi lɛ amɛtsɛ̃ɔ lajɔ̃.
Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã migbɔjɔ ni eba mi shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gbooo nɔ ni amɛfeɔ he yɛ mihiɛ.
Yakagbɔmɛi teɔ shi yɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, ni amɛshwieɔ mi kɛyaa sɛɛ, ni amɛkaa mihiɛ kpãtãmɔ tete.
Amɛtsimɔɔ migbɛ ni matsɔ̃ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛbɔɔ mihiɛkpãtãmɔ he mɔdɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ebooo amɛ tswai!
Amɛkeɔ kɛbaa tamɔ mɛi ni egbu gbogbo ewo mli ni amɛbashwieɔ minɔ.
Adɔ gbeyei nibii ayi kɛba minɔ, minunyam etã oookɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni etswa kɛtee; kɔɔyɔɔ etswa nii ni mina fɛɛ kɛtee tamɔ atatu.
Agbɛnɛ eshɛ migbele be, ni mikã nɔnaa mli gbii abɔ nɛɛ.
Duŋ lɛ hãa miwui amli kpeɔ mi, mipiŋmɔ lɛ ejɔɔɔ.
Enaawalɛ lɛ kpitiɔ mitade lɛ: efiɔ lɛ kɛmɔɔ misɛ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ mi efɔ̃ ŋmɔtɔ mli, ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu kɛ lamlu.
Mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, shi ohereee mi nɔ; mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi misɔleɔ; shi okwɛɛɛ mi po.
Oowa mi yi; okɛ ohewalɛ fɛɛ miipiŋ mi.
Owoɔ mi owoɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni etswaa mi kɛfoɔ shi; ni otswiaa mi shi kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ahum mli.
Hɛɛ, mile akɛ okɛ mi baaya ayahã gbele, ni ji shĩa ni ato ahã hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ aso mɔ ni kã hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kpãaa enineŋ yɛ emanehulu lɛ mli ni ebi yelikɛbuamɔ lo?
Ani mifooo mihãaa mɔ ni yɔɔ haomɔ mli?
Ani misusuma werɛ hooo hãaa ohiafo?
Shi be ni mikwɛ nɔ kpakpa gbɛ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ moŋ ni ba; ni be ni mimɛ la lɛ, duŋ moŋ wo mi.
Mitsui miitswa kɛ hejaramɔ, ni enyɔɔɔ shi; amanehulu gbii enina mi.
Duŋ ewo mi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba; ni hulu etsooo ehãaa mi kwraa, mihoɔ midamɔɔ shi yɛ maŋ, ni mibiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ.
Mitsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei anyɛmi kɛ okpɔŋɔloofɔji anaanyo.
Mihewolo edĩ, ni eekpɔlɔ yɛ mihe eeshwie shi; ni miwui amli miishã mi.
Mikpãa saŋku lɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli, ni mibɛlɛ gbɛɛmɔ etsɔ̃ yaafolɔi agbee.
Mikã mihiŋmɛi kitã ni no hewɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ mahã oblayoo foro he afee mi akɔnɔ hu?
Mɛni mana kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi nɛɛ dɛŋ?
Ni mɛni aaafee migbɛfaŋ nɔ ni Ofe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ baahã mi?
Ani jeee hiɛkpãtãmɔ kã shi hã mɛi ni feɔ nɔ fɔŋ?
Kɛ osharã hã mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ leee mijeŋba, ni ekaneee minanefaamɔi?
Kɛji miba mijeŋ kɛ kutumpɔo, ni miye oyai mishishiu mɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nsɛni ni ja aŋmɛ mi koni ena akɛ kpako bɛ mihe.
Kɛji migba afã yɛ minyiɛmɔŋ, ni mitsui eyadi mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ, ni muji ko kpɛtɛ miniji ahe lɛ, no lɛ nii ni madu lɛ, mɔ kroko aaaye, ni ŋmɔshinii ni aaakwɛ̃ ahã mi lɛ, afãmɔ ashwie.
Kɛji minaanyo ŋa he efee mi akɔnɔ pɛŋ, ni miyawo ka yɛ minaanyo shinaa shi pɛŋ lɛ, no lɛ hã miŋa ahoo nii ahã nuu kroko, ni mɛi krokomɛi kɛ lɛ ana bɔlɛ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛgbeji asane kpeteŋkple ni; eji nɔ fɔŋ ni kojolɔi lɛ baagbala etoi, ejaakɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ la ni baashã nii kɛshɛ abonsamiiaje, ni ebaashã nii ni miyɔɔ fɛɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Kɛji miyeee mitsulɔ nuu loo mitsulɔ yoo jalɛ sane be ni amɛ kɛ mi ena lɛ, no lɛ te mafee tɛŋŋ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ te shi wo mi lɛ?
Kɛji eba kojomɔ lɛ, te majie minaa makɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani mɔ ni bɔ mi ewo musuŋ lɛ jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ ebɔ amɛ?
Ani jeee mɔ koome shɔ̃ wɔ fɛɛ yɛ musuŋ?
Kɛji mikãma ohiafoi anii ni amɛtaoɔ, aloo mihã jeŋ fee okulafo awerɛho, aloo miye nii mikome pɛ, ni mihãaa awusãi eko tsɛbelɛ mi mihiɛ lɛ akɛ tsɛ kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ, ni kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ mi miwa lɛ.
Kɛji mina mɔ ko ni efĩ lɛ ni mama bɛ ehe, loo ohiafo ko ni bɛ nɔ ni ehaa lɛ, no lɛ mahã lɛ mama ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoo he tsɔi lo koni ehe afee kulɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ebaajie miyi kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Kɛji miwo minine nɔ yɛ awusã ko nɔ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ abaabu mi bem yɛ kojomɔhe lɛ, no lɛ mikɔ̃ŋ lɛ akpɔ yɛ mikɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he, ni minine hu atse kɛje kɔ̃ŋ wu lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ misheɔ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni minyɛŋ Ofe lɛ hiɛ madamɔ.
Kɛji miŋɔ shika mifee mihiɛnɔkãmɔ, aloo mitsɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi mihiɛnɔkãmɔ, ni minya ejaakɛ minii ni mina fa babaoo, ni minine eshɛ nii babaoo nɔ kɛji mikwɛ hulu ni eetso, loo nyɔɔŋtsere bɔ ni ekpɛɔ fɛɛfɛo kɛhoɔ.
Kɛji nɔ ko elaka mitsui ni miwo amɛ yɛ teemɔŋ ni mishwɔ minine naa kɛ hiɛsɔlɛ mihã amɛ lɛ, no hu nifɔɔjianii ni esa akɛ kojolɔi lɛ awo he nyɔmɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ kulɛ miyeko Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anɔkwa.
Minyako yɛ osharã ni esharã mihenyɛlɔ hewɔ, ni mimli efiliko mi be ni amanehulu eba enɔ.
Miŋmɛko minaabu gbɛ ni efee esha, ni mitaoko egbele kɛ kitãkãmɔ.
Mishĩaŋbii ekɛŋ akɛ, ‘Wɔteŋ namɔ yeko edɛŋ niyenii etɔko dã?’ Gbɔ ko gbɔ ko etooo blohuŋ; migbeleɔ mishinaa mihãa gbɔ be fɛɛ be.
Mitsimɔko mitɔ̃mɔi anɔ tamɔ Adam, ni mikɛ minɔsha lɛ etoko mimli.
Miishe mɛi asafo lɛ gbeyei, ni bɔ ni wekui baanyaŋe mi hu woɔ mihe gbeyei, ni no hewɔ ni mifee diŋŋ, ni mishiii shĩa mijeee kpo ejaakɛ miishe amɛ gbeyei.
Oo, mina mɔ ko ni aaabo mi toi!
Naa, minine naa okadi!
Ofe lɛ ahã mi hetoo!
Oo, mina ni kulɛ mɔ ni kɛ mi ena lɛ eŋmala saji ni ekɛshiɔ mi lɛ ewo wolo hiɛ!
Anɔkwa, kulɛ makɔ matswa mikɔŋ, ni mikɛbaafee akekre mafi miyitso.
Kulɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nibii fɛɛ ni mifee, ni matsi mabɛŋkɛ lɛ tamɔ lumɔ kɛji shikpɔŋ ni mihu nɔ bolɔ wo mi ni enɔ akofii wo yara kutuu; kɛji mikpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yibii miye ni miwooo nyɔmɔ, ni no nɔ tsɔ̃ ni nɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gboi lɛ, no lɛ ŋmei akwɛ̃ yɛ ŋmãa najiaŋ, ŋmei gbohii akwɛ̃ yɛ abele najiaŋ.” Hiob wiemɔ lɛ naagbee nɛ.
Elihu wiemɔ Kɛkɛ ni hii etɛ̃ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Hiob hetoohãmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ Hiob wiemɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko.
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel ni jɛ Ram weku lɛ mli lɛ, mli wo la.
Emli wo la ewo Hiob, ejaakɛ Hiob bu ehe jalɔ ni eshwa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Emlifu Hiob nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa hetoo ko amɛhã Hiob, tsɛbelɛ amɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ amɛbua he akɛ Hiob yeɔ fɔ.
Elihu mɛ be fioo dani ekɛ Hiob wie, ejaakɛ Hiob nanemɛi lɛ ye lɛ onukpa.
Be ni Elihu na akɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ bɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛɔ Hiob lɛ, emli wo la.
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu, Buznyo Barakel bi lɛ, here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbekɛ ji mi yɛ afii amli, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛdara; no hewɔ lɛ, mishe gbeyei ni mikɛ misusumɔ aŋmɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ nyɛ ji mɛi ni esa akɛ nyɛwie; nyɛ waŋtsɛmɛi nyɛwieɔ ni akaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ adesa mli, Ofe lɛ mumɔ ni ekɛmuɔ lɛ, no hãa enaa jwɛŋmɔ.
Jeee dalɛ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii, ni jeee gbɔlɛ hu ni hãa anuɔ sane shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi koni mi hu mawie mijwɛŋmɔ.
Naa, mito mitsui shi mibo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi, mimɛ beiaŋ ni nyɛtaoɔ nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ lɛ.
Mibo nyɛ toi aahu; ni naa, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu ewooo Hiob naa; aloo nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ehã ewiemɔi lɛ ahetoo.
Nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakɛa akɛ, ‘Wɔle nii.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni aaaku enaa, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.’ Ewieko eshiko mi, ni mikɛ nyɛnaa wiemɔi lɛ haŋ lɛ hetoo.
Ashi amɛ shi, amɛhãaa hetoo dɔŋŋ; amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni esa akɛ mimɛɔ ejaakɛ amɛwieee; amɛdamɔ shi diŋŋ ni amɛhãaa wiemɔ ko hetoo dɔŋŋ?
Mi hu makɛɛ minɔ; ni mi hu mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
Ejaakɛ minyɛɛɛ mamua minaa dɔŋŋ; mumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ mi dɔŋŋ.
Naa, mitsui etsɔ̃ tamɔ wain ni atsi naa kpɛŋŋ, ni ebɛ mumɔhe, etamɔ wain wolotɔi hei ni heɔ aflɛ.
Mawie koni mana hejɔlɛ.
Ja migbele minaa mihã hetoo.
Mikwɛŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ, ni midɔkɔŋ minaa mihaŋ mɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ mileee mɔhɔlɔmɔ; nakai ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ, aaafo miwala sɛɛ biɛ be kukuoo mli.”
“Ni agbɛnɛ, Hiob, bo toi, ni ofee toi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Naa, migbele minaa ni mawie nɔ ni misusuɔ.
Wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mawie lɛ jɛ mitsui mli krɔŋŋ; ni mawie nɔ ni mile anɔkwaleŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni bɔ mi, ni Ofe lɛ mumɔ lɛ hãa miyi naa wala.
Kɛji ooonyɛ lɛ, too he ohã mi; saamɔ ohe; saamɔ nɔ ni obaakɛɛ lɛ oto.
Naa, mi kɛ bo yeɔ hegbɔ yɛ Yehowa gbɛfaŋ; mi hu sũ nɔŋŋ akɛshɔ̃ mi.
Naa, mihe ŋmiŋmi akawo ohe gbeyei; minyɛŋ onɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, owie owo mitoiiaŋ, ni minu owiemɔi lɛ.
Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mihe tse, tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe; miyeɔ bem, ni mifeko esha ko.
Naa, eetao sane efo eŋmɛ minɔ; ebuɔ mi akɛ ehenyɛlɔ.
Ebɔ minaji apã, ejie ehiɛ eka mi.’ Naa, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, enɛ mli lɛ osane lɛ ejaaa; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ da aahu fe adesa.
Mɛni hewɔ oshwaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ehãaa miwiemɔi lɛ eko kwraa hetoo lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wieɔ shii abɔ, fɛɛ ni adesa ediii sɛɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ be ni wɔ ni tsii enyɔ adesai anɔ yɛ amɛsai amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔ kɛ nyɔɔŋ ninaa nɔ ni egbeleɔ adesai atoiiaŋ ni ekɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ woɔ amɛhe gbeyei koni ehã adesa akpale kɛjɛ enifeemɔnii ahe, ni ehã adesa akpa ehenɔwomɔ lɛ.
Etsiɔ adesa susuma naa koni ekayagbee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli; ebuɔ ewala hu he koni akakpãtã hiɛ kɛ klante.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbalaa adesa toi kɛ saa mli piŋmɔ kɛ ewuiaŋ kpemɔ, ni no hãa edaaŋ gboɔ kɛ niyeli, ni ekpoɔ niyenii ni kpɔɔ ewɔlɔmɔ tete.
Etãa loo ni ehiii lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni egbɔmɔtsoŋ wui ni kulɛ anaaa lɛ bajwereɔ shi faŋŋ.
Ebɛŋkɛɔ gbohiiaje, ni ewala bɛŋkɛɔ gbele bɔfoi lɛ.
Kɛji ena bɔfoi akpe lɛ ateŋ eko damɔ mli hã lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ ni hi hã lɛ, ni ena gbɔmɔ mɔbɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Jiemɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gbohiiajeyaa mli, mina eyinii ni akɛkpɔ̃ lɛ.’ No lɛ eheloo aaatsɔ̃ efɔ́ tamɔ gbekɛ nɔ, ni eeeku sɛɛ etsɔ̃ oblanyo ekoŋŋ.
Eeekpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, ni eeeduro lɛ; ni eeeba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ nyamɔ.
Eeegba eyiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi.
Ni eeela yɛ adesai ahiɛ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mifee esha, ni mikɔ̃dɔ̃ nɔ ni ja; ni akɛ mihe fa mi; Ehere misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje ni mihiɛ kã lolo.’ Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ shii abɔ ehãa gbɔmɔ, koni ehere eyiwala kɛjɛ gbohiiaje, koni wala afee enɔ.
Oo Hiob, ka otoi!
Bo mi toi, feemɔ diŋŋ, mibawie!
Kɛji oyɛ nɔ ko ni oookɛɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi!
Wiemɔ, shi miitao bo bem mabu.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo moŋ bo mi toi; feemɔ diŋŋ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee.”
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, nyɛboa miwiemɔ toi, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi, ejaakɛ toi akɛŋmɛɔ wiemɔ akwɛɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛ lilɛi saa niyenii anaa akwɛɔ lɛ.
Nyɛhãa wɔkɔa nɔ ni ja, nyɛhãa wɔsusua he yɛ wɔteŋ wɔna nɔ ni hi.
Ejaakɛ Hiob ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miyeɔ bem’ shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mi yeee yɛ jalɛ naa; bem ni miyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abu mi amalelɔ: Mifala lɛ bɛ tsabaa, tsɛbelɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ mihe.
Namɔ ena mɔ ko tamɔ Hiob, mɔ ni bɔɔ musu tamɔ anuɔ nu pɛŋ?
Mɔ ni kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii bɔɔ naanyo, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nyiɛɔ?
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaabɔ naanyo!’ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi.
Enɛ akagbale Nyɔŋmɔ fɔɔŋfɔ akɛ eeefee nɔ fɔŋ, aloo Ofe lɛ, eeefee nɔ ko ni ejaaa hu.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa, ni ekɛ gbɔmɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa.
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ yeee toikɔdɔmɔ sane; ni Ofe lɛ tsɔ̃ɔɔ sane hiɛ ebuuu shi.
Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛ je lɛ nɔkwɛmɔ hã lɛ?
Namɔ kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hã lɛ?
Kɛji eeeŋɔ emumɔ lɛ yɛ je lɛŋ, ni eeehã mumɔ lɛ akpale kwraa kɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ, no lɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo hiɛ aaakpãtã; ni gbɔmɔ aaatsɔ̃ sũ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji oyɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ bo toi!
Bo nɔ ni makɛɛ lɛ toi!
Ani mɔ ni taooo jalɛ saneyeli baanyɛ mɛi anɔ eye?
Ani ooobu mɔ ni ja ni eyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ fɔ?
Ani ooobu mɔ ni kɛɔ maŋtsɛ akɛ ‘Yakagbɔmɔ’ kɛ lumɛi hu akɛ, ‘Yitsoŋwalɔi?’ Ni ekwɛɛɛ lumɛi ahiɛ ni ebuuu niiatsɛ fe ohiafo, ejaakɛ lɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii ji amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ bem?
Trukaa gbɔmɔ gboɔ; ahosoɔ gbɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ehoɔ eyaa; hewalɔi hoɔ amɛyaa, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ adesa nine nɔ.
Ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba nɔ, ni onaa enyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ.
Duŋ kabitii bɛ he ko he ko ni mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii aaanyɛ atee amɛhe yɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ etoko be pɔtɛɛ ko ehãko adesa ko ni eeeya kojomɔ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ.
Ekpãtãa hewalɔi ahiɛ ni etaooo amɛsaji amli, ni eholeɔ mɛi krokomɛi etoɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
Akɛni ele amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ, ebutuɔ amɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
Egbalaa mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛkpale yɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛbuuu egbɛi lɛ ekoeko; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhã ohiafoi ayaafo yashɛ eŋɔɔ; ni enu mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ abolɔmɔ.
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ fee diŋŋ lɛ, namɔ baanyɛ lɛ ashwa?
Kɛji ekɛ ehiɛ tee lɛ namɔ baanyɛ ehiɛ lɛ ena?
Nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ afee koni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ akaye maŋ nɔ, ni ekahã maŋbii bote kaa mli.
Ejaakɛ ani mɔ ko ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dã akɛ ‘Agbala mitoi.
Mifeŋ nɔ ni ehiii dɔŋŋ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi nibii ni minaaa; koni kɛji mifee nɔ ni ehiii lɛ mikafee nakai dɔŋŋ?’ Akɛni okwa egbɛi lɛ, ani Nyɔŋmɔ baafee nɔ ni otaoɔ ehã bo lo?
Kɛɛmɔ nɔ ni ole lɛ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ esa akɛ okɔɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ; shi jeee mi matsɔ̃ɔ bo.
Mɛi ni nuɔ nii ashishi lɛ baakɛɛ mi; ni nilelɔi ni nuɔ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiob wieɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli; nilee bɛ ewiemɔ mli.’ Mina ni kulɛ aka Hiob akwɛ kɛyashi naagbee, ejaakɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ tamɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anaa wiemɔ.
Ejaakɛ eetse atua efata esha ni efee lɛ he, eetswa edɛ̃ eshwie wɔnɔ ni eewie babaoo eeshi Nyɔŋmɔ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Elihu saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Aso osusuɔ akɛ eja gbɛ akɛ oookɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ohe, hewɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?
Mɛɛ ejurɔ miyeɔ kɛji mifee esha lɛ?’ Mahã bo kɛ onanemɛi ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ hetoo.
Kwɛmɔ ŋwɛi!
Kwɛmɔ bɔ ni atatui lɛ yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ yɛ oyiteŋ!
Kɛji ofee esha lɛ, mɛni ona ofee Nyɔŋmɔ?
Kɛji ofee esha lɛ shii abɔ po, mɛɛ awui no yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ?
Kɛji jalɔ ji bo lɛ, mɛni okɛwa Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo mɛni enaa kɛjɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ?
Esha ni ofeɔ lɛ, adesa tamɔ bo awui eyeɔ, ni ojalɛ lɛ, gbɔmɔ eyeɔ ebuaa.
Yiwaa babaoo hãa maŋbii lɛ bolɔɔ; amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ yɛ ojei ayiwalɛ nifeemɔnii ahewɔ.
Shi mɔ ko kwraa ekɛɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, miBɔlɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɔ ni hãa hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ fĩmɔbe mli kɛ mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii fe bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ, ni ehãa wɔleɔ nii fe ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ?’ Amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ yelikɛbuamɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ efooo amɛdaaŋ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ hewɔ.
Anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ booo yaka yaafo toi, ni Ofe lɛ ebuuu hu.
Nɔ ni wa fe fɛɛ ji akɛ, oookɛɛ akɛ onaaa lɛ, ni sane lɛ kã ehiɛ, ni oomɛ lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbalaaa mɔ toi, ni ediii tɔ̃mɔ sɛɛ yrɛdɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, Hiob, oowie huu, oowie babaoo ni nilee bɛ mli.”
Elihu tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Na tsui ohã mi fioo, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ko naa, ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔ ko lolo ni mibawie mahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Minilee babaoo lɛ mli majɛ matsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miBɔlɔ lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa wiemɔ miwieɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ko ni le nii jogbaŋŋ damɔ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo, ni enyaŋeee mɔ ko mɔ ko; eniiashishinumɔ naa wa jogbaŋŋ.
Ehãaa mɔ fɔŋ yi ana wala, shi ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ.
Ehiŋmɛi kãa jalɔ he, ni ehãa amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ tamɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni tara sɛii anɔ ni awoɔ amɛnɔ gojoo.
Kɛji awo amɛ gboklɛi ni amanehulu efĩmɔ amɛ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni amɛfee, amɛtɔ̃mɔi kɛ amɛhenɔwomɔ lɛ.
Egbeleɔ amɛtoiiaŋ, ni amɛnuɔ kãmɔ ni ekãa amɛ akɛ amɛkpa nishaianii feemɔ lɛ.
Kɛji amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ, amɛaaye amɛwala be lɛ yɛ ejurɔyeli mli, kɛ amɛfii lɛ hu yɛ miishɛɛ mli.
Shi kɛji amɛbooo toi lɛ, no lɛ amɛleŋ nii, ni amɛaagboi yɛ klante naa.
Mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ mlifu he; kɛji efĩ amɛ tete lɛ amɛbiii Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
Amɛgboiɔ yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ foɔ kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ tɔlɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔseɔ gbɔmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amanehulu nɔ, ni ekɛ nɔnaa gbeleɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie bo kɛje jaramɔ mli kɛba he ko ni ohe jɔ bo yɛ, ni okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ niyenii.
Shi agbɛnɛ aagbala otoi bɔ ni sa bo pɛpɛɛpɛ; aagbala otoi yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni akɛ nyɔɔŋnihamɔ akalaka bo; ni kaahã ninamɔ miihã oodu gbɛ.
Aso oyaafo baanyɛ bo ahere, aloo ohewalɛ kɛ oshika aaanyɛ nɔ ko afee?
Kaashwe ni duŋ awo, be ni maji ahiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.
Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ ni okabɔ̃i eshafeemɔ: ejaakɛ oosumɔ enɛ moŋ fe nɔnaa.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo yɛ ehewalɛ lɛ naa; ni mɛɛ tsɔɔlɔ kɛ lɛ yeɔ hegbɔ?
Namɔ baanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ efee, aloo namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, ‘Ofee nɔ ko ni ejaaa’.
Kaimɔ koni okafo enifeemɔ ni adesai fɛɛ ewo he lala lɛ.
Adesai fɛɛ miikwɛ enifeemɔ kɛmiijɛ shɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ adesa nuuu shishi.
Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ da, shi wɔleee lɛ; ni wɔnyɛŋ efii ni eye wɔkane.
Ejaakɛ egbalaa nu kulibii kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa afua tsɔ̃ɔ nu, ni ŋwɛi fɔseɔ shwieɔ shi, ni ebashwieɔ adesai fɛɛ anɔ babaoo.
Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ anu bɔ ni atatui ha ŋwɛi lɛ shishi, aloo eeenu ŋwɛi shiimɔ shishi?
Naa, egbɛ ŋwɛi srawa mli kɛbɔle ehe; shi ehã ŋshɔ shishi wo duŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ elɛɔ adesai nɛ, ni ekumaa amɛ niyenii babaoo.
Ekɛ enine mɔɔ ŋwɛi srawa mli ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ he ni egba kɛyayi.
Ŋwɛi srawa gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni eji, akɛ mɔ ko ni mli fũɔ yɛ nishaianii hewɔ.”
“Ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ hãa mitsui tswaa ni tse po eheɔ etse yɛ mimli nɛɛ.
Nyɛboa Nyɔŋmɔ gbee ni ji ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ toi, kɛ shiimɔ ni jɛ edaaŋ lɛ.
Eŋmɛɔ he ewoɔ ŋwɛi shishi fɛɛ, ni ŋwɛi srawa gbalaa kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ewoɔ egbee kɛ agbojee; ni etsiii srawa naa be mli ni eshiɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbeeshiimɔ yɛ naakpɛɛ ni efeɔ nibii wuji ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.
Ekɛɔ snoo akɛ, ‘Nɛɛ oshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛɔ nu kɛ futufuli akɛ, nɛɛ waa!’ Ejieɔ gbɔmɔ nine yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ he, koni adesai fɛɛ ana ale akɛ lɛ efeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋaŋ kooloi yaa amɛbuiaŋ, ni amɛhɔlɔ amɛshihilɛhei lɛaŋ.
Ahum jɛɔ wuoyigbɛ ebaa, ni fɛ̃i hu jeɔ kooyigbɛ.
Mumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ muɔ lɛ hãa nu fĩɔ kpɔ, ni fai fɛɛ fĩɔ tɔo tsɔ̃ɔ aisi.
Ehãa atatui yiɔ kɛ nu ni ehãa srawa kpɛlɛɔ yɛ atatui lɛaŋ.
Amɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ egbɛjianɔtoo naa; amɛyeɔ efãmɔ nɔ yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Bei komɛi lɛ, ehãa enɛɛmɛi baa koni egbala gbɔmɛi atoi, bei komɛi lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ yibaamɔ hewɔ, ni bei komɛi hu koni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Oo, bo enɛ toi, Hiob, da gãa koni ojwɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ feɔ efãa amɛ ehãa, ni ehãa la kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu mli?
Ani ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni le nii kɛwula shi lɛ feɔ etsuɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔ ni hãa atatu sɛŋɔ shi lɛ?
Ele bo bɔ ni otadei amli dɔɔ la, be ni ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ efee shiŋŋ yɛ wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ?
Ani obaanyɛ olɛɛ ŋwɛi, ni tamɔ dade kaŋkaŋ ni ashwie nɛɛ, mli oha shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ?
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ naa etã, wɔbɛ nɔ ko ni wɔbaakɛɛ.
Akakɛɛ lɛ akɛ masumɔ mawie; mɔ ko bɛ ni baasumɔ akɛ ekpãtã ehiɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ adesa nyɛɛɛ la lɛ ekwɛ kɛ jeŋ tse tete, ejaakɛ atatui eha hiɛ; shi kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa lɛ eloɔ atatui lɛ kɛyaa.
La tsuru fɔɔ kpɛɔ kɛjɛɔ kooyigbɛ kɛbaa.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ he anunyam lɛ hãa wɔsheɔ gbeyei.
Ofe lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ lɛ wɔna; ehewalɛ da, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane; ekpaŋ jalɛ saneyeli.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ adesai fɛɛ, nyɛshea lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi lɛ, ebuuu amɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ehã Hiob hetoo ekɛɛ, “Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli ehã mijwɛŋmɔ hiɛ ehua nɛɛ?
Feemɔ kralo odamɔ shi tamɔ nuu, shi mibabi bo sane ni ohã hetoo.
Be ni mito je lɛ shishi lɛ, nɛgbɛ oyɔɔ?
Kɛji ole he nɔ ko lɛ, kɛɛmɔ mi!
Namɔ ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni eda ehã; aloo namɔ ji mɔ ni mɔ kpãa mli kɛsusu edalɛ lɛ?
Bɛ ole?
Mɛni nɔ ato je lɛ shishi ama?
Namɔ ji mɔ ni to ekoŋtɛ lɛ?
Be ni leebi ŋulamii lɛ fɛɛ la kutuu ni ŋwɛibii lɛ bɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ lɛ?
Aloo namɔ ŋamɔ agboi lɛ ekɛtsi ŋshɔ lɛ naa, be ni etue kɛjɛ je lɛ shishitoo he lɛ.
Be ni mihã atatui tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hebo, ni mihã duŋ kpii hu tsɔ̃ mama ni mikɛbala lɛ lɛ?
Be ni mito je lɛ husui ni mikɛ agboi kɛ amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi tsi enaa, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Biɛ nɛɛ obaawa, ni okafo mli; ni biɛ oshɔkei wuji lɛ baawa.’ Hiob, ni oba jeŋ nɛɛ, ofã ni je etsɛre dã?
Ni otsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ egbɛhe pɛŋ?
Ani ofã jetsɛremɔ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ amli koni ehwanya mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ kɛjɛ nɔ eshwie dã lo?
Jetsɛremɔ hãa gɔji kɛ jɔi jeɔ shi faŋŋ tamɔ atade ni akumɔ mli loo tamɔ naasɔomɔnɔ ni ta magbɛ hiɛ.
Ehãa mɛi fɔɔji enãaa hei ni amɛaatsɔ̃, ni amɛniji ni amɛkɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kumɔɔ yɛ amɛhe.
Aso oshɛ he ni ŋshɔ jɛɔ lɛ pɛŋ; ni oshara shi kɛnyiɛ ŋshɔ shishi dã?
Ani ajie gbohiiaje agboi lɛ akpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo, aloo ajie duŋ kpii lɛ naa agboi lɛ akpo atsɔ̃ɔ bo?
Ani ole je lɛ dalɛ?
Kɛji ole nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, wiemɔ!
Nɛgbɛ atsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa he ni la jɛɔ, loo nɛgbɛ ji duŋ shihilɛhe, koni otsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ ni kã shi kɛyaa eshihilɛhe lɛ mli, koni oŋɔ lɛ oyato ehusu nɔ?
Bɛ ole, ejaakɛ ofii fa babaoo ni no mli lɛ afɔ bo!
Obote tsui ni mito snoo yɛ mli, lɛ mli pɛŋ loo ona tsui ni mito nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi yɛ mli, ni ji nii ni mito mihã amanehulu be loo nɔmɔ kɛ ta be lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ gbɛ ni yaa he ni hulu la lɛ jɛɔ egbɛɔ eshwãa, loo he ni bokãgbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ jɛɔ eshwãa je lɛ mli lɛ kã?
Namɔ egba nujɔɔ efɔ̃ shi koni nu ni miinɛ anyiɛ mli, ni eje gbɛ ehã srawa, bɔ ni afee ni nu anɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ nɔ, kɛ shiaŋa he ni adesa ko bɛ hu nɔ?
Namɔ hãa shikpɔŋ olɛŋlɛ ni kã shi efolo naa ofɔ̃, ni jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ nɔ?
Ani nu ni nɛɔ yɛ tsɛ, loo namɔ ni fɔ bɔ́?
Namɔ musuŋ aisi jɛ, ni namɔ fɔ ŋwɛi bɔ́ ni efimɔ kpɔbii.
Nu fiɔ, ni ewaa tamɔ tɛ, ni ŋshɔ hiɛ fɛɛ waa keketee.
“Ani obaanyɛ okɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ afimɔ Wuɔ kɛ ebii?
Aloo obaanyɛ kpãi ni fimɔ Oŋwɛ ofɛne?
Ani obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ lɛ he ni amɛtsɔ̃ kɛya kɛji amɛje, aloo obaanyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Jeŋ Kpawo kɛ ebii lɛ gbɛ?
Ani ole akpɔi ni hiɛ ŋwɛi, aloo obaanyɛ ohã nakai akpɔi lɛ aye shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ?
Ani obaanyɛ owo ogbee nɔ ni ofã atatui lɛ koni amɛnɛ nu amɛshwie onɔ?
Ani obaanyɛ ofã srawai akɛ amɛgbala, ni ani amɛaaba oŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Naa wɔ?’ Namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ loofɔlɔ ibis be ni Nilo baasraŋ nɔ?
Aloo namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ wuɔ nuu akɛ nu baanɛ?
Namɔ yɔɔ nilee ni ekɛbaanyɛ atatui lɛ ekane?
Aloo ebaanyɛ ekpoo amɛnaa shi koni amɛnɛ nu ni baahã su akpɔtɔ ni efimɔ kukulibii efee tɔo?
Ani bo omiɔ milɛloo ohãa jata, aloo ohãa jatabii loo amɛyeɔ shɛɔ amɛnaa be ni amɛbumɔ amɛbui amli, aloo amɛhɔlɔ odɔtɔi amli amɛwo ka lɛ?
Namɔ hã kwãakwãalabite niyenii, be ni ebii bibii bolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtsomloɔ ejaakɛ niyenii bɛ lɛ?
“Ani ole be mli ni afɔɔ gɔji anɔ abotiai lo?
Ona ofrote ni eefɔ dã?
Ole nyɔji abɔ ni amɛhiɛɔ musu?
Ole amɛfɔmɔ be lo?
Ani ole be mli ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ shi amɛfɔɔ amɛbii lo?
Amɛbii lɛ naa hewalɛ, ni amɛdaraa yɛ jwɛiiaŋ; amɛjeɔ kpo, ni amɛkuuu amɛsɛɛ amɛbaaa dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ ŋmɛ̃ɛ ŋaŋ teji he koni eye ehe?
Namɔ fɛne kpãa lɛ ehã teji?
Ni miŋɔ ŋa kplanaa lɛ mihã lɛ akɛ eshĩa, ni miŋɔ mukpo shikpɔŋ lɛ mihã lɛ akɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.
Esumɔɔɔ hoo ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ni enuuu mɔ ko ni miikpala lɛ gbee.
Gɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ɔ eniyelihe, ni etaoɔ nii ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɛ jɛi eyeɔ.
Ani koo mli tsina aaakpɛ̃lɛ ni esɔ̃mɔ bo?
Aloo eeesumɔ ni ebawɔ kooloi awɔɔhe?
Ani obaanyɛ owo tsinanuu kpãa ni etsa akofii, aloo eninɛ ŋmɔ yɛ jɔi amli kɛnyiɛ osɛɛ?
Ani okɛ ohe aaafɔ̃ enɔ yɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ, aloo oooshi nitsumɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ oŋmɛ enɔ?
Ani oheɔ lɛ oyeɔ akɛ ekɛ onikpamɔnii lɛ baaku esɛɛ; naa, ni ebua obele lɛ naa ewo aboŋo mli?
Duguma tswaa efijiaŋ kɛ ntɛŋ; shi hewalɛ kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli ni ekɛaa sumɔ bo.
Ejaakɛ eshiɔ ewɔji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ koni shikpɔŋ mlu mli dɔlɛ lɛ ahã amɛhe adɔ la.
Ni ehiɛ kpaa nɔ akɛ mɔ ko kɛ enane aaanyɛ ajwara amɛ; ni ŋaŋ kooloi aaanyɛ amɛnaanaa nɔ.
Ewaa ebii bibii lɛ ayi, tamɔ nɔ ni jeee ebii ni; etɔlɛ lɛ aaanyɛ afee yaka kɛ̃lɛ esheee no gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã nilee ebɔ lɛ, ni jwɛŋmɔ hu ehãaa lɛ eko.
Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ, ni ebaabɔ̃i foijee lɛ, eŋmɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
“Hiob, bo ji mɔ ni hã okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ?
Ekuɛ he tsɔi funyaŋŋ lɛ bo ohã lɛ?
Ani bo ohãa okpɔŋɔ huluɔ tamɔ baalabi tuɔ lɛ?
Etsinemɔ gbɛɛmɔ yɛ gbeyei!
Ekɛ enane gbɛɔ shi yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli, eshwaa efɔɔ ehewalɛ nɔ; ejeɔ kpo ekɛ tabilɔi yakpeɔ.
Eleee nɔ ni ji gbeyei, no haaa ekpokpo tete; ejooo foi yɛ klante naa.
Gãimlibii gbɛɔ woɔ lɛ, akplɔ kɛ damfojai kpɛlɛɔ woɔ lɛ.
Ekɛ hiɛdɔɔ kɛ grimɔ kpitiɔ shi; enyɛɛɛ shi edamɔ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ.
Kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yiɛ, eshɛ!’ Enyiɛ shɔŋŋ ni enuɔ ta he fu, kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ afaamɔi kɛ blɔmɔ he.
Ani bo onilee naa ni laalɔɔ filikiɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni egbɛɔ efijiaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ wuoyigbɛ?
Ani bo ofamɔ naa ni okropɔŋ woɔ ehe nɔ ni eyafeɔ etsu yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ?
Tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe fɛɛ nɔ he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, efeɔ eshihilɛhe yɛ.
Jɛi ejɛɔ ni enaa kooloo ni eeemɔ; ehiŋmɛi naa shɔŋŋ nii.
He ni gbohii jwere lɛ, jɛi okropɔŋ yɔɔ; ni ebii bibii lɛ nuɔ gbohii lɛ alá.”
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Hiob akɛ, “Aso mɔ ni miitao mɔ he tɔ̃mɔ ekɛɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ ekɛ Ofe lɛ ataa naa?
Mɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitaa naa lɛ, hã ehã hetoo.” Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, mijeee mɔ ko; mɛɛ hetoo mahã?
Mikɛ minine eto minaabu.
Miwie shi kome, ni mitoŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Miwie shii enyɔ; ni miyaŋ nɔ dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa jɛ ahum lɛ mli ekɛ Hiob wie ekoŋŋ, “Miamɔ tamɔ nuu; mibabi bo sane koni ojie mi naa.
Aso ooka ni otsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mitɔ̃?
Oobu mi fɔ koni oye bem?
Aso ohewalɛ shɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, ni obaanyɛ ohã ogbee ashi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ lo?
Kɛji nakai lɛ, no lɛ wulamɔ ohe koni ogbojee akwɔ ni onunyam ada kpele.
Grimɔ kɛ mlifu ni okɛnina hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ koni oba lɛ shi; hɛɛ hewolɔ fɛɛ hewolɔ lɛ oba lɛ shi, ni otsirɛ yiwalɔi otswia shi yɛ hei ni amɛdamɔ.
Tsiimɔ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ owo shikpɔŋ, ni ofimɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yɛ gbohiiaje, kɛkɛ lɛ mi hu makplɛ̃ nɔ mahã bo akɛ oyɛ hewalɛ ni baanyɛ ehã oye kunim.
Kwɛmɔ nuŋshwuɔ; mi mibɔ lɛ tamɔ mibɔ bo.
Ekpeɔ jwɛi tamɔ tsina, shi kwɛmɔ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehɛ mli, kɛ hewalɛ ni yɔɔ ehewojiaŋ fãi lɛ mli.
Ehãa elei shɔ̃ɔ keketee tamɔ tsenedru, ni atswɛ̃tswɛ̃ fãi ni yɔɔ eshuɔji amli lɛ.
Ewui wa tamɔ akɔɔble, ni eniji kɛ enaji tamɔ dade adabãŋ.
Lɛ ji Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ titri ko; mɔ ni bɔ lɛ lɛ pɛ nyɛɔ enɔ eyeɔ, Ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ he ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ yashwɛɔ yɛ lɛ.
Ehoɔ ekãa shi yɛ ŋmei tsei ashishi, ni eteɔ ehe yɛ glãi amli yɛ ŋmiamɔ mli, ejaakɛ ŋmei tsei lɛ hãa lɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ ni faa lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ bɔleɔ ehe kɛkpeɔ.
Naa, kɛji faa lɛ fee hamahama tete ewooo ehe gbeyei; kɛji Yordan yi kɛbata esɛ̃ tete po eyoyrooo.
Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ eje ehiɛgbɛ ni emɔ lɛ, aloo ekɛ tsɔne adu egugɔ?”
“Obaanyɛ okɛ kpoŋ asha leviatan aloo okɛ kpãa afi elilɛi akpɛtɛ edaaŋ?
Ani ooonyɛ owo egugɔŋ taŋkpee aloo okɛ kpoŋ ala ekadaa?
Ani eekpa bo fai babaoo?
Aloo ekɛ bo aaawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔi?
Ani ekɛ bo aaakpãŋ akɛ oŋɔ lɛ ofee otsulɔ kɛya naanɔ lo?
Ani okɛ lɛ baashwɛ tamɔ akɛ loofɔlɔ shwɛɔ, aloo obaafi lɛ ohã oblayei lo?
Ani wolɛi baaba amɛbaye enaa?
Ani amɛfolɔ emli amɛhã jarayelɔi lo?
Ani ooonyɛ otsulɔ akplɔi owo ehewojiaŋ obɔ̃, aloo oootsulɔ eyitso kɛ wuoyaa akplɔ?
Kɛ onine ata ehe okwɛ, ni ofeŋ nakai ekoŋŋ; ohiɛ kpaŋ nɔmɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ nɔ.
Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baana leviatan lɛ enijiaŋ jeɔ wui, ni egbeɔ shi.
Kãkãlɔ ko kãkãlɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awo ehiɛ la.
Belɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ mi mihiɛ adamɔ mɔ?
Namɔ kwraa etsɔ̃ hiɛ efee nɔ ko ehã mi, koni mato lɛ najiaŋ?
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jeŋ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Mibawie eniji kɛ enaji kɛ ehewalɛ kpele kɛ egbɔmɔtso he daa.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni baanyɛ ehewolo lɛ ekpɔ; aloo eta enyanyɔji nta lɛ ahe.
Namɔ baanyɛ agbele edaa kɛyanina enyanyɔji ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ.
Ehe totoi ni ato amɛ klɛmpɛiklɛmpɛi tsara nɔ ha ekoto sɛɛ, ni atsara amɛ tamɔ nɔ ni asɔo amɛnaa.
Eko tsa eko nɔ tsikitsiki, bɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ tete nyɛɛɛ amɛteŋ etsɔ̃.
Akɛ eko etsa eko nɔ, amɛkpɛtɛ amɛhe bɔ ni ehiii amɛteŋ tsemɔ.
Kɛji etsine lɛ ekpɛlɛɔ la, ni ehiŋmɛiiaŋ tamɔ leebi hulu haai.
La fãa kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ tamɔ haai; la srɛmii fɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edaaŋ.
Egugɔŋ fãa lasu tamɔ lamɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ kukwɛi ni ma la nɔ mli, loo tamɔ jwɛi ni miishã lasu.
Egugɔŋ mumɔ tsɛ̃ɔ ŋai, ni edaaŋ fãa la.
Ekuɛ mli ehewalɛ yɔɔ, hewɔ lɛ eyɛ gbeyei kɛji oyaje ehiɛgbɛ.
Eheloo lɛ kpɛtɛ ehe kpɛŋŋ bɔ ni anyɛɛɛ akpɔ.
Etsui wa tamɔ tɛ, ewa tamɔ wiɛ.
Kɛji ewo ehe nɔ lɛ, kãkãlɔi sheɔ gbeyei; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ amɛ kɛji ekãnya ehe.
Kɛji abã lɛ klante lɛ, efooo; ni akplɔ loo gãi loo loogbee akplɔ nyɛɛɛ lɛ afo.
Dade tamɔ jwɛi ni egbi, ni akɔɔble tamɔ tso ni ekpɔtɔ hã lɛ.
Gãimlibi wooo lɛ foi; ni aklomia mli tɛ tsɔ̃ɔ gbetseli hãa lɛ.
Tsokpoti tamɔ gbetseli, ni efeɔ lɛ ŋmɔlɔ kɛji atsɛ̃rɛ lɛ akplɔ.
Emlishi totoi lɛ tamɔ gbɛ ko naabu sakasaka lɛ, ni ehoɔ ekãa ŋmɔtɔ lɛ mli tamɔ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso.
Ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa tamɔ nula; ni afui ni etswaa lɛ tamɔ mu ni ma la nɔ.
Esɛɛ mo kpɛɔ ni ehãa ŋshɔ lɛ tswaa afui tamɔ waŋ.
Esaso kooloo ni sheee nɔ ko nɔ ko gbeyei bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ebuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he wa, lɛ ji kooloi hewalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ.”
Kɛkɛ ni Hiob here Yehowa nɔ ekɛɛ, “Yehowa, mile akɛ onyɛɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ofeɔ, ni oyiŋtoo ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ naa aku.
Namɔ hu ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nilee bɛ mli teɔ nilee nɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, miwie nibii ni minuuu shishi, nibii ni ahe yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi bɔ ni minuuu amɛshishi.
Okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bo toi; ni mawie.
Mibabi bo sane koni ohã mi hetoo!’ Mitoi kɛkɛ mikɛnu ohe, shi agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛi ena bo.
No hewɔ lɛ, eedɔ mi, ni miishwa mihe yɛ sũ kɛ lamlu mli.” Sane lɛ fɛɛ naagbee Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hiob ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, akɛ, “Mimli ewo bo kɛ onanemɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ ala, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ mitsulɔ Hiob fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛmɔmɔa tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii hu kpawo kɛyaa mitsulɔ Hiob ŋɔɔ koni nyɛkɛyashãa shãa afɔle nyɛhãa nyɛhe.
Mitsulɔ Hiob baakpa fai ehã nyɛ ni mibabo efaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni mikɛ nyɛ yeŋ yɛ nyɛkooloofeemɔ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛwieee mihe bɔ ni ja tamɔ Hiob fee lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Elifaz, Temannyo lɛ, kɛ Bildad, Shuhinyo lɛ, kɛ Zofar, Naamanyo lɛ, yiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyafee bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ amɛ lɛ; ni Yehowa mɔ Hiob faikpamɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni Hiob ekpa fai ehã enanemɛi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa hã Hiob saa eshwere ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa ku nii fɛɛ ni Hiob yɔɔ sa lɛ ebɔ he toi enyɔ ehã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hiob nyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le lɛ sa lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni amɛ kɛ lɛ ye nii, ni amɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛshɛje emii yɛ sane fɔŋ ni Yehowa hã ye lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ke Hiob jwiɛtɛi kuku kɛ shika ga. Yehowa jɔɔ Hiob yɛ enaagbee wala beiaŋ fe bɔ ni ejɔɔ lɛ tsutsu lɛ.
Hiob na gwantɛŋi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ yoomai akpei ekpaa kɛ tsinai akpei enyɔ kɛ teji yei akpe kome.
Esaa efɔ bihii kpawo kɛ biyei etɛ̃.
Ewo ebiyoonukpa lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yemima, ebiyoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ ewo lɛ Kezia, ni ebiyoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ewo lɛ Keren-Hapak.
Yoo ko kwraa bɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ amɛ.
Amɛtsɛ Hiob hã amɛ egboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ ehã amɛnyɛmimɛi hii lɛ.
Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Hiob saa ehi shi afii oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni ena eshwiei kɛyashi amɛyinɔ ni ji ejwɛ nɔ bii.
Ni Hiob gbo be ni eji nuumo kotokoto ni eye afii babaoo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Lalai Awolo nɛɛ ji lala wolo kɛ sɔlemɔ wolo ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɛi srɔtoisrɔtoi ŋmala; ni amɛye bei babaoo yɛ he dani amɛgbe naa.
Israelbii bua lalai kɛ sɔlemɔi nɛɛ anaa, ni nomɛi amɛkɛja Nyɔŋmɔ; ni nosɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ ni akɛfata amɛŊmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he.
Nɛkɛ jamɔ lalai nɛɛ srɔtoisrɔtoi ni: akɛ lalai nɛɛ ekomɛi jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni akɛ ekomɛi jaa lɛ; akɛ ekomɛi sɔleɔ kɛbiɔ yelikɛbuamɔ loo hebuu loo yiwalaheremɔ.
Akɛ lalai lɛ ekomɛi biɔ eshaifaa; ni akɛ ekomɛi daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ ejɔɔmɔi ahewɔ.
Yudafoi lɛ kɛ lalai nɛɛ ekomɛi kpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai bɔ ni afee ni egbla henyɛlɔi atoi.
Akɛsɔleɔ ahãa he, ni akɛsɔleɔ ahãa maŋ hu.
Sɔlemɔi lɛ ekomɛi tsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nuɔ nii ahe ehãa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ; ni ekomɛi hu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nibii ahe hiãa Nyɔŋmɔ webii, kɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ webii fɛɛ nuɔ nii ahe hu hãa amɛnyɛmimɛi gbɔmɛi.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ lalai nɛɛ tsu nii, ni mɛi hu ni ŋmala Kpãŋmɔ Hee lɛ tsĩ lalai lɛ ekomɛi atã yɛ amɛniŋmãa mli.
Hewɔ lɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ batsɔ̃ Kristo Asafo lɛ wolo ni jra wa kɛjɛ Kristo Asafo lɛ shishijee mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Mlijaramɔi Lalai oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ ajra mli enumɔ.
Nomɛi ji: Lalai — Lalai — Lalai — Lalai — Lalai —
KLƐŊKLƐŊ WOLO LƐ Miishɛɛ Krɔŋŋ Ajɔɔ mɔ ni booo mɛi fɔ̃ji aŋaawoo toi, ni ekɛ eshafeelɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni etaaa hefɛoyelɔi ateŋ.
Shi moŋ emii shɛɔ Yehowa Mla lɛ he, ni ejwɛŋɔ he daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ.
Etamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ fai atoi, ni woɔ yibii yɛ amɛbe mli, ni amɛbai kpalaaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji bɛ nakai; amɛ lɛ amɛtamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, eshafeelɔi nyɛŋ kojomɔ naa amɛdamɔ; amɛnaŋ gbɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kudɔɔ jalɔi agbɛ lɛ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ ekɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
Maŋtsɛ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ toɔ atuatsemɔ he ajina?
Ni maŋbii lɛ kpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi fɔ̃ji?
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tseɔ atua, ni lumɛi lɛ hu feɔ ekome; amɛkpãŋɔ Yehowa kɛ maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yinɔ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkumɔa amɛgboklɛi lɛ; ni wɔtserɛ amɛkpai lɛ yɛ wɔhe.” Mɔ ni ta ŋwɛi lɛ miiŋmɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miiye amɛhe fɛo po; ni eyeɔ amɛhe fɛo hu.
Ekɛ amɛ aaawie yɛ emlifu naa, ni ekɛ mlila aaawo amɛhe gbeyei.
Ekɛɛ, “Miwo mimaŋtsɛ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” “Mashiɛ akpɔ ni Yehowa ewo mi lɛ,” Ekɛɛ, “Mibi ji bo, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ mifɔ bo.
Bi mi, ni maŋɔ majimaji lɛ mahã bo akɛ ogboshinii; ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ ogbɛfaŋnɔ.
Okɛ dade dɛhiɛmɔtso aaakumɔ amɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni ooojwara amɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Oo, nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, nyɛlea nii; Oo, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ gbeyeishemɔ; nyɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ akotoa lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ emli baafu nyɛ oya, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Leebi sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ Oo Yehowa, kwɛ mɛi abɔ sɔŋŋ ni haoɔ mi!
Mɛi babaoo ni teɔ shi woɔ mi!
Mɛi pii kɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ lɛ, enaŋ yiwalaheremɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.” Sela Shi Yehowa, bo ji mihebuu tsɛŋ, bo ji minunyam, bo ohãa mihiɛ baa nyam.
Miwoɔ migbee nɔ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ Yehowa, ni ejɛɔ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ehereɔ mi nɔ.
Mikãa shi miwɔɔ, ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃ɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa buɔ mihe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Misheee mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ni ebɔ nsra ewo mihe lɛ gbeyei.
Oo Yehowa, tee shi, miNyɔŋmɔ, baahere miyiwala, ejaakɛ bo otswiaa mihenyɛlɔi anii; ni okumɔɔ amɛnyanyɔji owoɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Kunimyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ, Yehowa, ojɔɔmɔ aba omaŋ lɛ nɔ.
Sela
Gbɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa.
Mijalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, kɛ mitsɛ lɛ heremɔ mi nɔ.
Kɛ efi mi lɛ bo ofɛneɔ mi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ toi.
Nyɛ gbɔmɛi adesai, mɛɛ beyinɔ nyɛaagbe minunyam lɛ he guɔ kɛyaashi?
Shii enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛaasumɔ yakanii ni nyɛaatao amale sɛɛgbɛ?
Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa eŋɔ jalɔ lɛ ehã ehe; hewɔ lɛ kɛ́ mitsɛ lɛ lɛ, eboɔ mi toi.
Kɛji agba nyɛnaa lɛ, nyɛkafea esha; nyɛjwɛŋa enɛ he jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛsai anɔ, ni nyɛfea dioo.
Nyɛshãa afɔlei ni sa, ni nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.
Mɛi pii kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ aaafee wɔ ejurɔ!
Oo Yehowa, tse ohiɛ ohã wɔ.” Ohã mimli efili mi aahu fe bɔ ni amɛbele kɛ amɛwain pii aaanyɛ ahã amɛmli afili amɛ.
Hejɔlɛ mli makã shi mawɔ yɛ, ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, okoome pɛ ohãa mihiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã hebuu David Lala kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ bɛlɛ akpa.
Oo Yehowa, bo miwiemɔi lɛ toi, koni onu mikɔmɔ ni miyeɔ lɛ he ohã mi!
Mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ bo fai mikpaa nɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, leebi lɛ bo migbee toi; leebi lɛ bo fai mikpaa, ni bo ohetoo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
Ejaakɛ ojeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni naa efɔŋfeemɔ he tsui; ni mɔ fɔŋ hu kɛ bo ehiii shi.
Hewolɔi nyɛɛɛ ohiɛ amɛdamɔ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔi fɛɛ.
Okpãtãa amalelɔi ahiɛ.
Lashishwielɔi kɛ shishiulɔi lɛ Yehowa miihi amɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa lɛ maba owe lɛ; mikɛ woo aaaja bo yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ.
Oo, Yehowa, kplamɔ mi yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Hã ogbɛ akã shi faŋŋ ahã mi.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kome nɛkɛ bɛ amɛdaaŋ; amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ fitemɔ; amɛsɛ̃ lɛ gbonyobu ni agbele naa ni; amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi wieɔ dɔkɔbii.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, hã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛyiteŋ.
Hã amɛyiŋshai lɛ nɔŋŋ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Shɛrɛmɔ amɛ oshwie, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ onɔ babaoo, ni amɛtse ohiɛ atua.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni baa bo abo lɛ, amɛmli filiɔ amɛ.
Hã amɛla lalai be fɛɛ be kɛ miishɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ ogbɛi lɛ, fã amɛhe ni ohã amɛnya.
Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ojɔɔ, ni okɛ mlihilɛ buɔ ehe tamɔ tsɛŋ.
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ yɛ haomɔ beiaŋ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa yɛ Sheminth gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
Oo Yehowa, kaakã mihiɛ yɛ omlifu mli, ni okɛ mlila hu akagbala mitoi.
Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ miigbɔjɔ.
Oo Yehowa, tsa mi ejaakɛ miikpokpo kɛ gbeyei.
Misusuma hu miikpokpo naakpa.
Shi ao Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Oo Yehowa, kuu osɛɛ, heremɔ miyiwala, baakpɔ̃ mi yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ akaiii bo yɛ gbele mli; ni gbohiiaje hu namɔ aaajie oyi yɛ jɛi?
Etɔ mi kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ; mifɔɔ misaa tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ daa nyɔɔŋ kɛ yaafonu.
Awerɛhoo ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu, ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, mihiŋmɛii anɔ eha.
Nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa enu miyaafo gbee lɛ.
Yehowa enu mifaikpamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ebo misɔlemɔ toi.
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaahao naakpa.
Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ be kuku mli.
Jalɛ saneyeli he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko ni ela eha Yehowa ni kɔɔ Benyaminnyo Kush wiemɔ ko he.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo abo mibaa!
Heremɔ miyiwala ni ojie mi yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
Heremɔ mi koni henyɛlɔi lɛ akagbala mi kɛtee he ni jielɔ ko bɛ, ni amɛyatserɛ mimli tamɔ jata.
- Oo Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ, kɛji mitɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ, kɛji mifee naanyo ko efɔŋ, kɛji miwa mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ ayi lɛ, no lɛ, hã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ atiu mi ni amɛmɔ mi, ni amɛnaanaa minɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni magbo, ni makã mlu mli.
Oo, Yehowa, tee shi kɛ mlila, wo ohe nɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ agirimɔ lɛ hewɔ; Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃; bo ni oto kojomɔ ofɔ shi.
Buamɔ asafokui lɛ anaa kɛbɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni ojɛ ŋwɛi oye amɛnɔ.
Yehowa, bo okojoɔ mɛi fɛɛ!
Oo Yehowa, kojomɔ mi yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa, ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeko efɔŋ ko.
Oo, hã mɛi fɔ̃ji anɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo; Shi jalɔi lɛ, ojuro amɛ; ejaakɛ bo ji jalɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni okaa tsui kɛ jwɛŋmɔ okwɛɔ.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsɛŋ!
Lɛ ehereɔ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jalɛ naa kojolɔ ni; ebuɔ efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ be fɛɛ be.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ tsakeee etsui lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔ eklante naa; ni edɔ egãi lɛ mli ni eta.
Esaa emɔgbee dadei lɛ eto bo, ni ehã egãimlibii lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ la.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji jwɛŋɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛŋɔɔ efɔŋ hɔ, ni amɛfɔɔ amale.
Etsaa bu, ni ehãa emli kwɔɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ egbeɔ bu ni etsa lɛ mli; emusu buaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ, ni eyiwalɛ lɛ wulaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eyiteŋ.
Mada Yehowa shi yɛ ejalɛ naa, ni mala majie Yehowa, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ gbɛi lɛ yi.
Nyɔŋmɔ Agbojee kɛ gbɔmɔ anunyam David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ gbee ko ala. Oo Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ!
Okɛ onunyam eha ŋwɛi flooflo.
Ohenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, osaa hewalɛ oto yɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ohã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa ni amɛfee diŋŋ.
Kɛ mikwɛ oŋwɛi kɛ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii ni obɔ lɛ, mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?
Namɔ po ji gbɔmɔbi ni ogbaa ohenaa yɛ ehe?
Kɛ̃lɛ, shwɛ shrao ni ohã ekɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ aye hegbɔ; ni okɛ anunyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre.
Bo ohã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛyeɔ onine naa nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Oŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ oto enajiaŋshi ni eye amɛnɔ: toi kɛ tsinai fɛɛ tswɛm kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hu, kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ kɛ bɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ mli hu.
Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ je agbo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ jalɛ saneyeli hewɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni akɛ Muth-labben gbee ala. Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni magba onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
Ohewɔ lɛ manya; ni mimli aaafli mi.
Bo Ofe ni oyɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo, mala, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ; amɛgbeegbee shi, ni amɛplene yɛ ohiɛ.
Anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ji bo yɛ okojomɔ mli.
Ota omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ ni oye jalɛ sane ohã mi.
Okã majimaji lɛ ahiɛ, okpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahiɛ.
Ogbe amɛgbɛi kwrakwra kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ; obutu amɛmaji wuji lɛ; ni kaimɔ po, akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, eeye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã kojomɔ.
Ekojoɔ je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ekwɛɛɛ hiɛaŋ ekojooo mɛi.
Yehowa ji abobaahe hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ, eji abobaahe yɛ fimɔ bei amli.
Ni mɛi ni le ogbɛi lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ onɔ; ejaakɛ bo Yehowa, okwaaa mɛi ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ yi!
Nyɛgbaa enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ lɛ mɔ ni etɔɔ lá he owele lɛ, ekaiɔ mɛi ni piŋɔ; ni ehiɛ kpaaa nɔnalɔi abolɔmɔ nɔ.
Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ!
Kwɛmɔ mimanehulu ni minaa yɛ mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ.
Oo, bo mɔ ni owoɔ minɔ kɛjɛɔ gbohiiaje agboi lɛ amli, koni majaje oyijiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ agboi lɛ amli, mimli aaafli mi, ejaakɛ ohere miyiwala.
Jeŋ maji lɛ egbee bu ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛtsa lɛ mli.
Tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛtee lɛ edu amɛ.
Yehowa kɛ ejalɛ kojomɔ ehã ale lɛ; mɛi fɔ̃ji edu tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kpaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje.
Shi ohiafo lɛ, jeee daa hiɛ aaakpa enɔ, ohiafo hiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka, kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Oo, Yehowa, tee shi; kaahã adesa miiye kunim.
Hã ni akojo majimaji lɛ yɛ ohiɛ.
Oo Yehowa, wo amɛhe gbeyei koni majimaji lɛ ana ale akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ.
Sɔlemɔ hã jalɛ saneyeli Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba okɛ mi teŋ ejekɛ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba otee ohe yɛ fimɔ bei amli nɛɛ?
Mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ ntɛŋ haoɔ ohiafoi.
Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ etsuiŋ sɛɛdii nibii anɔ; ni amimyelɔ lomɔɔ, ni ekwaa Yehowa.
Mɔ fɔŋ hewoo mli lɛ etaooo Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; eyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.” Egbɛi fɛɛ shwereɔ be fɛɛ be; okojomɔ lɛ kwɔ fe lɛ, ejwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he; eyeɔ ehenyɛlɔi ahe fɛo.
Ekɛɔ ehe akɛ, “Eshiii mi kpu!
Amanehulu ko baŋ minɔ gbi ko gbi ko.” Loomɔ kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ yiwaa eyi edaaŋ obɔ̃; haomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ hɔ elilɛi shishi.
Ewoɔ ka yɛ akrowai amli; egbeɔ mɔ ni efeko nɔ ko yɛ nififiaŋ; ejieɔ ehiɛ ekaa mɔ ni efĩ lɛ.
Edɛkeɔ shi tamɔ jata yɛ olɔtɔ mli; ewoɔ ka koni emɔ ohiafo; ekɛ akpa duɔ ohiafo; ni eshãtãa lɛ kɛyaa.
Ekotoɔ shi, edɛkeɔ shi, ni mɛi ni he waaa lɛ gbeɔ ekaa mli.
Mɔ fɔŋ susuɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa nɔ, ekɛ ehiɛ etee; ni enaŋ gbi ko gbi ko.” Oo Yehowa, tee shi!
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jiemɔ ohewalɛ kpo, ohiɛ akakpa nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ.
Mɛni hewɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ kwaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ekɛɔ yɛ etsuiŋ akɛ, “Etsɛŋ wɔ akɔntaabuu?” Shi bo lɛ onaa nii, lɛɛlɛŋ bo lɛ okadiɔ haomɔ kɛ awerɛhoo fɛɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ tu ehe ewo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, oye obua lɛ, ejaakɛ bo ji awusai abualɔ.
Fitemɔ yiwalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hewalɛ lɛ; kolimɔ enifɔɔjianii lɛ amli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni onaaa eko dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa ji maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã kɛaaje eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Oo Yehowa, oboɔ humii asɔlemɔ toi; owoɔ amɛ hewalɛ; ni obaa otoi shi ohãa mi, koni oye awusai kɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛyi lɛ asane ohã amɛ, koni gbɔmɔ adesa ni jɛ su mli, akawo mɔ he gbeyei dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; mɛɛba nyɛkɛɔ mi akɛ, “Filikimɔ tamɔ loofɔlɔ kɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, yiwalɔi edɔrɔ amɛgãii, ni amɛkɛ gãimlibii lɛ emamɔ kpãi lɛ anɔ koni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ mɛi kpakpai yɛ dujiaŋ.
Kɛji afite shishitoo lɛ, mɛni jalɔ aaanyɛ afee dɔŋŋ?” Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, Ŋwɛi emaŋtsɛ Sɛi lɛ ma.
Ehiŋmɛi jwere nɔ ni gbɔmɛi adesaiabii feɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa kaa jalɔ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ, shi yiwalɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi lɛ.
Eeehã la ni tsoɔ glegle kɛ swɔɔ anɛ ashwie mɔ fɔŋ nɔ; kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la ekɛaagbala etoi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ni, ni esumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; mɔ ni ja aaana ehiɛ.
Sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ yɛ Sheminith gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
Yehowa, ye obua wɔ!
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; ni anɔkwafoi etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lakaa enaanyo.
Amɛnaa dɔkɔbii kɛ amɛlilɛi nta.
Yehowa ahã mɛi ni wieɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ afee dioo, kɛ lilɛi ni shwãa nibii wuji lɛ, mɛi hu ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi aaana nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ.
Wɔnaabui lɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnɔ ni.
Namɔ yeɔ wɔnɔ Nuŋtsɔ?” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni awaa ohiafoi ayi, ni mɛi ni efĩ amɛ lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mate shi, ni mɔ ni shweɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ mahere eyiwala.” Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, shiwoi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ ni; amɛtamɔ jwiɛtɛi ni aka yɛ shikpɔŋ flɔnɔɔ mli, ni atsuu he nɔtoonɔtoo shii kpawo.
Oo Yehowa, buu wɔhe; baamɔ wɔyi daa kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji foɔ sa kɛkpeɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ji nyaa yaka saji ahe yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ.
Sɔlemɔ hã yelikɛbuamɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni ohiɛ aaakpa minɔ?
Kɛyaashi naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ lo?
Okɛ ohiɛ baatee mi kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Mɛɛbe misusuma aaapiŋ, ni maye awerɛho yɛ mitsuiŋ gbi muu fɛɛ.
Mɛɛbe mihenyɛlɔ aaawo ehe nɔ yɛ minɔ kɛyashi?
Oo, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ mi ni ohere mi nɔ; tsiɛ̃mɔ mi koni mikawɔ gbele wɔ.
Kaahã mihenyɛlɔ miikɛɛ akɛ, “Miye enɔ”, ni mihaolɔi lɛ akanya yɛ mishigbeemɔ hewɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Manya kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ obaahere miyiwala.
Oo Yehowa, mala mahã O, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.
Gbɔmɛi ayitsoŋwalɛ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ!” Amɛfite, ni amɛfeɔ nyaŋemɔ nii; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ nɔ̃ kpakpa.
Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ aleee nɔ eeena akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni le nii ni etaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛdu gbɛ, amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfite.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa.
Dabida, mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ.
Ani nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ amɛleee nii?
Mɛi ni yeɔ mimaŋbii tamɔ ayeɔ kɔmi, ni amɛsɔleee amɛtsɛɛɛ Yehowa lɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ!
Gbeyei kpele aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ jalɔi lɛ yɛ.
Nɔfɔŋfeelɔi aaanyɛ afite ohiafo yiŋtoo nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Yehowa ji ebobaahe.
Oo, kulɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ajɛ Zion aba!
Kɛji Yehowa hã emaŋ lɛ ku sɛɛ na nii ekoŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ ehe.
Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ David Lala.
Yehowa, namɔ aaabote obuu lɛŋ?
Namɔ aaaja yɛ Zion, ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ?
Namɔ baaba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni ewieɔ anɔkwale kɛ etsuiŋ fɛɛ; mɔ ni kɛ elilɛi yeee mɔ he osheku ni efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko; ni ebɔɔɔ enaanyo gbɔmɔ ahora.
Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ, shi moŋ ewoɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ ahiɛ nyam; mɔ ni kɛ ekã kitã ni eeena amane yɛ he po lɛ, etsakeee.
Mɔ ni kɛ eshika efaaa eheee hekpa ni fe nine; ni eheee nyɔɔŋnii koni ewie eshi mɔ ni yeɔ bem.
Mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, edidãŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, buu mihe, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
Mikɛɔ Yehowa akɛ, “Bo ji miNuŋtsɔ; osɛɛ lɛ mibɛ nɔ kpakpa ko.” Hetselɔi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ lɛ, anunyam gbɔmɛi ji amɛ, ni miyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
Shi mɛi ni yanyiɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ kroko sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhaomɔi faa.
Mifɔseŋ lá ni amɛkɛba afɔleshãa lɛ mishwieŋ shi akɛ afɔle; ni mikɛ minaabu etsiŋ amɛgbɛii atã tete.
Yehowa, bo ji minɔ fɛɛ nɔ, bo ohãa mi mihiamɔ nii fɛɛ.
Bo odɛ̃ŋ miwala yɔɔ.
Mihusu kpãi eyaje he ni yɔɔ fɛo ehã mi; lɛɛlɛŋ, mina gboshinii ni hi naakpa.
Majie Yehowa mɔ ni woɔ mi ŋaa lɛ yi; Mitsui tete kɛ mi wieɔ nyɔɔŋ.
Mikɛ Yehowa ema mihiɛ daa; akɛni eyɔɔ mininejurɔ nɔ nɛɛ, mididaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui enyɔ mimli, ni misusuma tete miinya; migbɔmɔtso hu yɛ shweshweeshwe.
Ejaakɛ oŋmɛŋ mihe ohaŋ gbohiiaje, ni mɔ ni heɔ onɔ eyeɔ lɛ enaŋ gbohiiaje.
Bo otsɔ̃ɔ mi wala gbɛ.
Ohiɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ; ni mimii eshɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Mɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko sɔlemɔ David sɔlemɔ ko.
Oo Yehowa, bo jalɛ sane toi; too otoi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ.
Feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ ni jeee amale ni lɛ.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ buu mi bem, ejaakɛ bo onaa nɔ ni ja.
Kɛji oka mitsui okwɛ, kɛ otao mimli nyɔɔŋ, ni oka mi okwɛ lɛ, onaŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa yɛ mimli; mikɛ minaabu efeee efɔŋ.
Yɛ gbɔmɛi adesai anifeemɔnii agbɛfaŋ lɛ, mibo odaaŋ wiemɔ toi, ni minyiɛɛɛ yiwalɔi agbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Minane emɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni mishaneko.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, miibo miitsɛ bo, ejaakɛ ooohere mi nɔ; ba otoi shi ohã mi ni obo miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.
Jiemɔ onaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Oo, bo yiwalaherelɔ ni okɛ ohewalɛ hereɔ mɛi ni taoɔ abobaa lɛ ayiwala kɛjɛɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Baamɔ miyi tamɔ abaa hiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ yi.
Okɛ mi atee ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni waa mi yi, kɛ mihenyɛlɔi kakawuai ni ebɔle mi kɛkpe lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabui wieɔ hewoo wiemɔi.
Amɛjaa misɛɛ mo, amɛbɔleɔ mihe kɛkpeɔ kpula; amɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka mi koni amɛtsi mi amɛtswa shi.
Amɛtamɔ jata ni kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baatserɛ emilɛ loo; amɛtamɔ jatabi ni ewo antɛo yɛ odɔtɔ mli.
Oo Yehowa, tee shi owo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni obutu amɛ.
Okɛ oklante lɛ ajie misusuma yɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.
Yehowa, kɛ onineshiwalɛ ajie mi kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ni amɛna amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ wala be nɛɛ mli lɛ adɛŋ.
Hã amɛmusui ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ toigbalamɔ ni osaa oto ohã amɛ lɛ; ni pii ashwɛ ahã amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii.
Mi lɛ, mana ohiɛ, yɛ jalɛ mli; ni kɛ mihiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, mitsui aaatɔ, ejaakɛ mina bɔ ni oyɔɔ.
David kunimyeli lala David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa be mli ni Yehowa jie lɛ yɛ ehenyɛlɔi kɛ Saul dɛŋ.
Oo Yehowa, miisumɔ bo; bo ji mihewalɛ.
Yehowa ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ kɛ mitɛsaa, mɔ mli ni mibaa abo yɛ; bo ji mitsɛŋ kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ akloŋto.
Bo ji mimɔɔ ni wa.
Mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni sa yijiemɔ lɛ, ni ehere miyiwala kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Gbele kpãi lalaa mi, ni ŋshɔkei wuji lota mi.
Gbohiiaje kpãi lalaa mi kɛkpe, migbee gbele tsɔnei amli.
Mifĩmɔ mli lɛ, mitsɛ Yehowa; mibo mitsɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, koni eye ebua mi.
Ejɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tɔ̃ɔ ni enu migbee; ni mibolɔmɔ lɛ bote etoiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni gɔji lɛ ashishitoo lɛ hu hoso, ni amɛjo bliblibli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli efu.
Lasu fã kɛjɛ egugɔ mli kɛtee ŋwɛi; ni la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ jɛ edaaŋ; ŋai ni miitso jɛ edaaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã ŋwɛi kpoo enaa shi, kɛkɛ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebayi shi ni duŋ kabitii yɛ enajiaŋshi.
Eta kerub nɔ, ni efiliki; eta kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ kɛkpeleke shi oya.
Ekɛ duŋ ha ehe; oblɔtu kpii ni eshi lutulutu eshi yɛ eyiteŋ tamɔ akatamanso.
Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ ŋai ni miitso kpɛlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ oblɔtu kabitii lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa shi yɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ ŋwɛi shiimɔ, ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ wo egbee.
Etsɛ̃rɛ egãimlibii lɛ, ni ekɛgbɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ eshwã.
Ehã srawa gbalagbalai ni ekɛgbɛ amɛ eshwã kɛ foi.
Oo Yehowa, oyiŋaa naa kɛ ogugɔŋ mumɔ gbɛɛmɔ naa hã ŋshɔ mli ŋkajai lɛ je kpo, ni je lɛ shishitoo lɛ bakamɔ shi faŋŋ.
Ekpã enine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni ebawo mi, ni egbala mi kɛjɛ nui babaoo mli.
Ejie mi kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni he wa lɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni hetsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ; ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi kwraa.
Amɛbatua mi yɛ mimanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã mihe.
Ejie mi kɛtee he ni lɛɛ lɛkɛtɛɛ.
Ejie mi, ejaakɛ eyɛ mihe tsui.
Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ lɛ naa; ejuro mi, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ mihe.
Ejaakɛ miba mijeŋ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni mijeko miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
Ejaakɛ miye emlai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mikuko ekpɔi lɛ ekoeko mli.
Shwamɔ ko bɛ mihe yɛ ehiɛ, ni miwiɔ mihe kɛjeɔ nɔsha he.
Yehowa to mi najiaŋ yɛ mijalɛ naa, ejaakɛ muji ko bɛ midɛŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa, mɛi ni yeɔ bo anɔkwa lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ oyeɔ amɛ anɔkwa; ni mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ shwamɔ bɛ ohe.
Mɔ ni he tse lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ oyɛ krɔŋŋ; ni mɔ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yeee.
Mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ, ohereɔ amɛ; shi hiŋmɛii ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ, obaa amɛ shi.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, lɛɛlɛŋ bo ohãa mi kane; ni ohãa miduŋ mli kpɛɔ kɛ la.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, ohewalɛ naa lɛ, mabutu henyɛlɔi asafo.
MiNyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, mahuru gbogbo.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, enifeemɔinii fɛɛ hi kɛwula shi.
Yehowa yeɔ eshiwoi anɔ.
Eji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Shi namɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa sɛɛ?
Ni namɔ ji wɔbobaahe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni miãa mi kɛ hewalɛ; ni ehãa mifeɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ migbɛi fɛɛ amli.
Ehã minajiaŋ wa tamɔ ofrote, ni eŋɔ mi edamɔ gɔji anɔ shweshweeshwe.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi tawuu, koni manyɛ akɔɔble gãi po mli madɔ.
Oo Yehowa, okɛ oyiwalaheremɔ tsɛŋ lɛ ehere miyiwala; ni ohewalɛ hiɛ mimli, ni oyibaamɔ lɛ ehã mije agbo.
Ohãa mifamɔɔ minaji zãaŋzãaŋ, ni mishaneee.
Mitiu mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni minina amɛ; mikpaleee kɛjeee amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi miplenee amɛ.
Mitswia amɛ nii bɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.
Amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ minaji anaa.
Ejaakɛ omia mi, ni mina hewalɛ kɛhã tawuu, ni ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔnyɔɔi yɛ mihiɛ.
Ohã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã mi, ni mikpãtã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaaa amɛ.
Amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efooo amɛdaaŋ.
Miwiɛ amɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mlu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛyaa.
Miloo amɛ mishwie tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Ohãaa maŋsɔ̃ aba mi kɛ maŋbii ateŋ.
Ofee mi majimaji lɛ atsɛ; mɛi ni mileee amɛ po basɔmɔ mi.
Maŋsɛɛbii ba amɛhe shi amɛhã mi; amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanu mihe lɛ, amɛkotoɔ mi.
Maŋsɛɛbii atsui fã, ni amɛkɛ hekpokpomɔ je kpo kɛjɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli kɛba.
Yehowa hiɛ kã; ajie mitɛsaa lɛ yi; ni awo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni tɔɔ mihe owele, ni ebaa maji ashi ewoɔ mishishi lɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni ehereɔ mi kɛjɛɔ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Hɛɛ, bo owoɔ minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi anɔ; bo ojieɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Yehowa hãa emaŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ kunim kpelekplei, ni ejieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; ni ji David kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ mli David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Ŋwɛi gbaa Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni atatu jieɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ kpo.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi gbaa anunyam lɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔɔŋ shiɛɔ enilee lɛ.
Anuuu gbee ko, anuuu wiemɔ ko.
Ni anuuu amɛgbee ko nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ kpeleɔ jeŋ fɛɛ, ni anuɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Nyɔŋmɔ eshi buu yɛ ŋwɛi ehã hulu, ni hulu fãa kɛjeɔ kpo, tamɔ ayɛmforowu jeɔ kpo kɛjɛɔ epia mli; ni emliflimɔ lɛ, etamɔ foidalɔ mliflimɔ ni ekɛdaa foi.
Ejeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome, ni ebɔleɔ shi kɛyaa naagbeehe kroko, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eteee ehe yɛ enaa la lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa Mla lɛ Yehowa mla lɛ hi kɛwula shi; ehãa gbɔmɔ susuma naa hewalɛ hee.
Yehowa mla lɛ maa shi shiŋŋ; ehãa humii leɔ nii.
Yehowa akpɔi lɛ ja pɛ, amɛhãa mɔ tsui nyaa.
Yehowa kitãi lɛ yɛ krɔŋŋ, amɛhãa mɔ hiŋmɛi gbeleɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ he tse, ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Yehowa kojomɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, fɛɛ ja kɛmɔ shi.
Amɛyɛ akɔnɔ fe shika, amɛfe shika krɔŋŋ tete; amɛŋɔɔ fe wo hu, amɛŋɔɔ fe wo agbaku po.
Asaŋ nomɛi bɔɔ otsulɔ kɔkɔ; amɛnɔyeli lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ kpele yɛ mli.
Namɔ aaanyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etɔmɔi ena?
Yehowa, jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ midujiaŋ tɔ̃mɔi amli.
Baamɔ mi otsulɔ, miyi kɛjɛ eshai ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ kã he ni efeɔ lɛ mli.
Kaahã eshai lɛ miiye minɔ; no dani mahi kɛwula shi, ni mihe aaaje tɔ̃mɔi kpelei amli.
Yehowa, hã midaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ mitsuiŋ susumɔi asa ohiɛ; bo mitɛsaa kɛ mikpɔlɔ lɛ!
Kunimyeli he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Yehowa abo bo toi yɛ ofimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ!
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu ohe.
Ejɛ ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eye ebua bo, ni ejɛ Zion ewaje bo.
Ekai afɔlei lɛ fɛɛ kwa, ni oshãa afɔlei lɛ asa ehiɛ.
Ehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ, ni ehã oyiŋtoi fɛɛ aba mli.
Wɔɔbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ yɛ okunimyeli hewɔ; ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi mli wɔɔshi wɔflaŋai yɛ.
Yehowa ahã bo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni obiɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mina mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ ebuaa maŋtsɛ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ, ni eeejɛ eŋwɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ebo lɛ toi, ni Yehowa aaahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye kunim.
Mɛi komɛi shwãa fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ, ni mɛi komɛi hu okpɔŋɔi anɔ; shi wɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hewalɛ nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ.
Nakai mɛi lɛ, amɛaatswia shi, ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi; shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔte shi, wɔɔdamɔ shi shiŋŋ.
Oo Yehowa, hã maŋtsɛ lɛ aye kunim; kɛ wɔfo wɔtsɛ bo lɛ, heremɔ wɔ nɔ.
Yijiemɔ yɛ kunimyeli hewɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Yehowa, ohewalɛ lɛ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ; ni oyelikɛbuamɔ mli maŋtsɛ lɛ nyaa yɛ.
Nɔ ni etsui shweɔ lɛ, ohãa lɛ; ni nɔ ni ebiɔ lɛ, okamãaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ okɛ nii kpakpai amli jɔɔmɔi kumaa lɛ, ni okɛ shika krɔŋŋ akekre fiɔ eyitso.
Eba wala yɛ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohã lɛ; wala kakadaŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Oyelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ lɛ, enunyam lɛ da; oduro lɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
Ojɔɔ lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Na ni enaa bo hãa emii shɛɔ ehe.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ; ni ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, edidãŋ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ nine aaashɛ ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ anɔ; mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ, onine aaashɛ amɛnɔ.
Kɛ ojie ohe kpo lɛ, oooŋala amɛ tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ mli la.
Yehowa aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ emlifu lɛ naa, ni la lɛ aaashã amɛ wɛɛ.
Oookpãtã amɛshwiei lɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; oookpãtã amɛbii lɛ hu ahiɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi adesai ateŋ.
Kɛ amɛjwɛŋ ohe efɔŋ, ni amɛto ohe ŋaa gbonyo lɛ, amɛyeŋ kunim.
Ejaakɛ ooota ogãi lɛ oma amɛhiɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛjo foi.
Oo, Yehowa, wɔmiiwo onɔ gojoo yɛ ohewalɛ kpele lɛ hewɔ!
Wɔbaala kɛjie ohewalɛ lɛ yi.
Piŋmɔŋ blɔmɔ kɛ yijiemɔ lala David Lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?
Mɛɛba okɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba okɛ mikɛ̃ɛmɔ teŋ jɛkɛ nɛkɛ?
Oo, miNyɔŋmɔ, mibolɔɔ shwane, shi ohereee mi nɔ.
Mibolɔɔ nyɔɔŋ hu, ni mijɔɔɔ mihe.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ji bo; mɔ koome pɛ yi ni Israel jieɔ kɛ lalai lɛ.
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he bo ye, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ onɔ ni ojie amɛ.
Bo amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ, ni ohere amɛ.
Bo onɔ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ ni amɛhiɛ gboiii!
Shi mi lɛ, gɔgɔmi kɛkɛ ji mi, mishɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ.
Mɛi bɔɔ mi ahora, ni mɛi nyaŋeɔ mi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa mi lɛ yeɔ mihe fɛo; amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ, ni amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei, Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Tuu osane lɛ owo Yehowa dɛŋ; hã ni lɛ ehere bo, hã ni lɛ ehere mɔ he miishɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ.” Bo ojie mi kɛjɛ minyɛ musu mli, ohiɛ mi shweshweeshwe, be ni mikã minyɛ fufɔ naa.
Kɛjɛ mifɔmɔ mli beebe, aŋɔ mi aŋmɛ onɔ.
Kɛjɛ be ni minyɛ fɔ mi nɛɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.
Okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ, ejaakɛ shi haomɔ ebɛŋkɛ, ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
Henyɛlɔi babaoo ebɔle mi kɛkpe kpula, tamɔ tsina hii, amɛtamɔ Bashan tsina hii hewalɔi, ni efo sa ewo mihe.
Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatohatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛtamɔ jata kramakrama ni miihuu.
Aloo mi ashwie tamɔ nu, ni mitalɔi amli egoi: ni mitsui esere yɛ mimli tamɔ wo agbaku.
Misɛŋ egbi tamɔ ŋɛsuko mli, mililɛi ekpɛtɛ midaaŋ; ni oshi mi oŋmɛ su mli tamɔ gbonyo.
Henyɛlɔi ebɔle mi kɛkpe tamɔ shifɔji; mɛi fɔ̃ji asafo efo sa ewo mihe kpula, amɛtserɛ miniji kɛ minaji.
Manyɛ makane mimli wui fɛɛ; mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taa gãa amɛkwɛɔ mi.
Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki.
Oo Yehowa, kaahi sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Oo, bo mihewalɛ, feemɔ oya ni oye obua mi.
Jiemɔ misusuma kɛjɛ klante naa gbele mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ shifɔji lɛ adɛŋ.
Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ jatai adaaŋ, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje wuoi akoji ateŋ.
Majaje onifeemɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni majie oyi yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
Nyɛ Yehowa gbeyeishelɔi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Nyɛ Yakob shwiei fɛɛ, nyɛwoa ehiɛ nyam; ni nyɛ Israel shwiei bluublu, nyɛkɛ woo ahãa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekwaaa nɔnalɔ nɔnaa lɛ, ni ekuuu ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ nɔnalɔ nɔ.
Shi be ni nɔnalɔ bo etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehere lɛ nɔ.
Bo ohãa mijieɔ oyi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei ni amɛjaa bo lɛ ahiɛ.
Ohiafoi aaaye nii, ni amɛaatɔrɔ; mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, aaajie eyi.
Amɛyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.
Jeŋ koji kpawo lɛ aaakai, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ; ni majimaji lɛ amli akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaakula shi amɛja lɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Yehowa nɔ ni, ni lɛ eyeɔ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewolɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaakoto.
Mɛi ni egboi momo, kɛ mɛi ni baagboi fɛɛ baakoto lɛ.
Yinɔbii fɛɛ aaasɔmɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baagba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he sane atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.
Abaajaje atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni afɔko tete lɛ akɛ lɛ, Yehowa lɛ, ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala.
Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ David Lala ko.
Yehowa ji mikwɛlɔ nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiaŋ mi.
Ehãa mibuɔ shi yɛ lɛɛhei ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃.
Ewaa mi kɛyaa nui ni he jɔ lɛ ahe.
Ehãa minaa hewalɛ hee.
Ekpalaa mi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ jalɛ gbɛi anɔ yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ kɛ minyiɛ gbele hɔ̃ɔŋ jɔɔ lɛŋ tete lɛ, misheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okɛ mi yɛ.
Otookplamɔtso kɛ odɛhiɛmɔtso lɛ, nomɛi shɛjeɔ mimii.
Oŋmɛɔ mi okplɔ̃ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ahiɛ.
Okɛ mu fɔɔ miyitso mikpulu lɛ eyi kɛteke nɔ.

Maŋtsɛ Wulu lɛ David Lala ko.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa nɔ ni; ni je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, enɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ lɛ eto shishi yɛ ŋshɔi ashishi tɔ̃ɔ̃ ni ehã ema shi shiŋŋ yɛ fai anɔ.
Namɔ aaakwɔ Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ?
Ni namɔ aaadamɔ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
Mɛi ni amɛdɛŋ bɛ esha ko ni amɛtsuii amli tse.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei hãaa yakayaka nifeemɔ, ni amɛkãaa amale kitã.
Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛaana jɔɔmɔ kɛaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.
Amɛaana bembuu kɛaajɛ amɛyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.

Oo nyɛ agboi, nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ!

Namɔ ji anunyam maŋtsɛ nɛɛ?
