Oo Yehowa, bo miwoɔ misusuma nɔ mihãa.
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mihiɛ kã, kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ, ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko hiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
Mɛi ni ji yaka atuatselɔi lɛ moŋ ahiɛ aaagboi.
Oo Yehowa, hã male ogbɛ̃i lɛ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otempɔ̃ŋi lɛ.
Kplamɔ mi kɛnyiɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii; ejaakɛ bo ji miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Bo onɔ mihiɛ kã daa nɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ omɔbɔnalɛ kɛ omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe.
Oo Yehowa, kaakai miblahiaŋ eshai kɛ tɔ̃mɔi lɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ mi yɛ omlihilɛ kɛ okpakpafeemɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa hi, ni jalɔ ji lɛ, hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ eshafeelɔi gbɛ ni ja.
Ekpalaa heshibalɔi kɛnyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ egbɛ lɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo, kɛ anɔkwayeli sɔŋŋ ji Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ, kɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ kɛ ekpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ mihe esha lɛ ofa mi, ejaakɛ eda.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, lɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ ni enyiɛ nɔ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeshwere, ni eshwiei aaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, amɛ ekɛbɔɔ naanyo, ni ehãa amɛleɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Mihiŋmɛii kwɛɔ Yehowa gbɛ daa nɛɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ eeejie minaji kɛaaje yaa mli.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ kome mɔ ji mi; minii yɛ mɔbɔ.
Mitsui mli haomɔi lɛ fa; jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ mifimɔi lɛ amli!
Kwɛmɔ minɔnaai lɛ, kɛ mihaomɔi lɛ; ni okɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ afa mi.
Kwɛmɔ mihenyɛlɔi, ejaakɛ amɛyi fa; kwɛ bɔ ni amɛkɛ yiwaa nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ.
Oo, buu miwala he ni ohere mi; kaahã mihiɛ miishwie shi, ejaakɛ bo abo mibaa.
Emuuyeli kɛ jalɛ abaa miyi; ejaakɛ bo gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ Israel kɛje ehaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ko sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, buu mi bem, ejaakɛ miiba mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ kwraa ni migbaŋ afã.
Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli ni oka mi okwɛ.
Kaa mitsui kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ, ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ mihiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni minyiɛɔ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ mli.
Mikɛ yakayaka gbɔmɛi taraaa shi; ni mikɛ osatofoi hu ebɔɔɔ.
Minyɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji agwabɔɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ yiwalɔi hu taraaa shi.
Oo Yehowa, mifɔɔ midɛ̃ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ miyeko sɔ̃ ko, ni mibɔleɔ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mijaa bo.
Milaa shidaa lala waa, ni migbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, misumɔɔ owe he ni ohiɔ lɛ, kɛ he ni onunyam lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kaakpãtã mihiɛ oshi eshafeelɔi anɔ, ni kaakpãtã miwala hiɛ ofata láshishwielɔi ahe.
Kaaŋɔ mi ofata mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii, ni amɛheɔ nyɔɔŋnii lɛ ahe.
Shi mi lɛ, mibaa mijeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ emuuyeli mli; heremɔ mi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ.
Midamɔ he ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe.
Majie Yehowa yi, yɛ gwabɔɔ kpele lɛ mli.
Yijiemɔ sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Yehowa ji mila kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, namɔ po gbeyei mashe?
Yehowa ji miwala hewalɛ ni wa, namɔ hiɛ po mihe aaakpokpo yɛ?
Kɛji efɔŋfeelɔi ni ji mihaolɔi kɛ mihenyɛlɔi ba amɛbatua mi, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe po, amɛaatɛrɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi.
Kɛji asafo ko gba ta ewo mi po, mitsui efaŋ.
Kɛji ta te shi wo mi tete lɛ, no mli po lɛ, mana ekãa.
Nɔ koome mibiɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni no sɛɛgbɛ mitiuɔ: akɛ mahi shi yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, miwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ; ni mana Yehowa lɛ, ni makase nii hu yɛ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ejaakɛ fimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, eeeŋɔ mi ehɔ ebuu lɛ mli; eeeŋɔ mi etee ebuu lɛŋ teemɔhe lɛ, eeewo mi edamɔ tɛsaa nɔ.
Ni eeewo minɔ yɛ mihenyɛlɔi ni ebɔle mi lɛ anɔ; ni mikɛ mliflimɔ aaabɔ oshe, ni mashã afɔle yɛ ebuu lɛŋ.
Mala, ni matswa saŋku mahã Yehowa.
Oo Yehowa, kɛji mibo mitsɛ bo lɛ, bo mi toi.
Naa mi mɔbɔ, ni ohere mi nɔ.
Owiemɔ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛtaoa mihiɛgbɛ.” “Yehowa, bo ohiɛgbɛ lɛ mitaoɔ nɛɛ.” Kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi.
Kaashwie otsulɔ yɛ mlifu naa.
Bo ji miyelikɛbualɔ.
Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃, ni kaakwa mi hu, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kɛji mitsɛ kɛ minyɛ kwa mi tete lɛ, bo Yehowa ooobaa miyi.
Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi ogbɛ lɛ, ni okpala mi kɛtsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋ ni kã shi faŋŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi fa.
Kaaŋmɛɛ mihe ohã tamɔ bɔ ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ taoɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amale odasefoi ete shi ewo mi, ni amɛmiishwe ni amɛwa mi yi.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ mana Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Kwɛmɔ Yehowa gbɛ; wajemɔ ohe, ni ona tsui, ni okwɛ Yehowa gbɛ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, bo mitɛsaa, kaatsimɔ otoi.
Kɛji ofooo midaaŋ lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.
Kɛji mibo mitsɛ bo koni ohere mi, ni mihole miniji anɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi.
Kaaloo mi kɛ yiwalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ oshwie.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛnanemɛi wieɔ toiŋjɔlɛ wiemɔi shi amɛtsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Nakai nɔfɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, wo amɛ nyɔmɔ, yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii kɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anaa.
Wo amɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Too amɛ najiaŋ bɔ pɛ ni sa amɛ.
Akɛni amɛbuuu Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, eeebutu amɛ, ni amɛteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo mifaikpamɔ gbee toi.
Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ mitsɛŋ; enɔ mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ɔ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa mi ni minaa tsuijurɔ.
Mikɛ milala aaada lɛ shi.
Yehowa ji ewebii lɛ ahewalɛ, ni lɛ ji mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwalaheremɔ mɔɔ.
Yehowa, heremɔ omaŋbii lɛ ayiwala, ni ojɔɔ owebii ni oŋɔ akɛ onɔ lɛ.
Lɛɛ amɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ, ni ohiɛ amɛ mli kɛya naanɔ.
Yehowa gbee yɛ ahum mli David Lala ko.
Oo nyɛ ŋwɛibii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛkɛ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ ahãa Yehowa.
Nyɛkɛ anunyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ hewulamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ajaa Yehowa.
Anuɔ Yehowa gbee yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ.
Anunyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ miishi; Yehowa yɛ ŋshɔi wuji anɔ tete.
Yehowa gbee lɛ yɛ hewalɛ.
Yehowa gbee eyi obɔ̃ kɛ agbojee.
Yehowa gbee lɛ kumɔɔ tsenedrui lɛ, Yehowa kumɔɔ Lebanon tsenedrui lɛ.
Ehãa Lebanon gɔji lɛ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsinabii; ni Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ tumɔɔ tamɔ tsina oblanyo.
Yehowa gbee lɛ hãa srawai gbalaa.
Yehowa gbee hosoɔ shiaŋa lɛ, Yehowa hosoɔ Kadesh ŋa lɛ.
Yehowa gbee hãa odum hosoɔ ni ehãa koo mli tsei ayibai kpalaa; ni yɛ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ bolɔɔ akɛ, “Anunyam!” Yehowa ta nu afua nɔ eeye maŋtsɛ; Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Yehowa aaahã ewebii lɛ hewalɛ; Yehowa aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Shidaa lala David Lala ni ekɛ jɔɔ sɔlemɔtsu lɛ nɔ.
Oo Yehowa, makafo O, ejaakɛ ojie mi, ni ohãaa mihenyɛlɔi aye mi yɔɔ.
Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ, mibolɔ mitsɛ bo, ni otsa mi.
Yehowa, ojie misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje, Kulɛ mifata mɛi ni yaa gbonyobu lɛŋ lɛ ahe; shi mi lɛ, okpale mi kɛba walaŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Ejaakɛ hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ emlifu hiɔ shi; shi emlihilɛ lɛ hiɔ shi ewala be fɛɛ.
Yaafo toɔ mɔ gbɛkɛ, shi miishɛɛ baa leebi.
Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ yɛ mishweremɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Mididaŋ gbi ko gbi ko.” Oo Yehowa, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, ohã mima shi shiŋŋ tamɔ gɔŋ.
Shi moŋ be ni okɛ ohiɛ tee mi pɛ, ni mitsui fã.
Bo Yehowa mibolɔ mitsɛ, ni bo Yehowa fai mikpa.
“Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ migbele he, kɛji mikpeleke shi kɛbote gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli?
Ani su aaajie oyi lo?
Aloo eeejaje onɔkwale lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ?
Oo Yehowa, bo toi, ni ona mi mɔbɔ.
Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi.” Ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ miishɛɛ joo ehã mi.
Ojie mihe kpekpe lɛ, ni okɛ miishɛɛ ebu mi tamɔ mama.
No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma aaajie oyi, ni emuaŋ enaa.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, mada bo shi daa kɛya naanɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, bo abo mibaa, kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko.
Okɛ ojalɛ lɛ ahere mi.
Ba otoi shi ohã mi.
Feemɔ oya ni ohere mi.
Tsɔ̃ mibobaahe tɛsaa, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala.
Hɛɛ!
Bo ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ.
Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ mihiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ.
Jiemɔ mi kɛjɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ ji mibobaahe.
Miitu mimumɔ miiwo bo odɛ̃ŋ, ejaakɛ bo okpɔ̃ mi.
Oo Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo.
Minyɛɔ mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ yaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, shi mi lɛ, Yehowa nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Mimli aaafli mi, ni manya yɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ ona minɔnaa lɛ, ni ole mihaomɔ lɛ.
Oŋmɛko mihe owoko henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; shi moŋ, ohã minane ena maahe.
Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, shi efi mi; mihiŋmɛii kɛ mikla kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ egbɔjɔ kɛ awerɛho sɔŋŋ.
Shi miyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ miwalabeiaŋ fɛɛ, ni midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ mifii lɛ amli.
Mihe esha hewɔ lɛ, mihewalɛ nɔ egbɔ ni miwui lɛ amli hu egbɔjɔ.
Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã mihenyɛlɔi.
Mitsɔ̃ jatsu kpele mihã mihe gbɔmɛi; mitsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ minanemɛi ahiɛ.
Mɛi ni naa mi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ, joɔ minaa foi.
Hiɛ ekpa minɔ tamɔ gbonyo ni ajie jwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɔ, Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛ́ ko.
Hɛɛ!
Miinu mɛi pii miiwie ablɛbi.
Gbeyei ebɔle mi kɛkpe be ni amɛtee miyi nɔ ajina ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyi nɔ koni amɛkpãtã mihiɛ lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, bo Yehowa onɔ mihiɛ kã.
Mikɛɔ akɛ, “Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ!” Miwala be lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; jiemɔ mi kɛje mihenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ adɛŋ.
Osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ miyiwala.
Kwɛmɔ mi otsulɔ koni ona mi mɔbɔ.
Oo Yehowa, kaahã ashwie mihiɛ shi, ejaakɛ bo miboɔ mitsɛɔ.
Hã miyiwalɔi lɛ moŋ ahiɛ ashwie shi.
Hã amɛtɔ mu kɛya gbohiiaje.
Hã amalelɔi lɛ amua amɛnaa, mɛi ni kɛ hewoo kɛ heguɔgbee wieɔ wiemɔi ni esaaa shiɔ jalɔi lɛ.
Oo, kwɛ bɔ ni omlihilɛ ni oyɔɔ kɛhã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ fa babaoo hã.
Ojieɔ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni baa bo abo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Oŋɔɔ amɛ oteɔ yɛ ohiɛ teemɔhe lɛ mli.
Kɛjeɔ mɛi ayinɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni okɛ amɛ toɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ obuu lɛ mli.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa ejaakɛ ejie enaakpɛɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, be ni atua mi tamɔ maŋ ko ni asa eyi lɛ.
Yɛ mitsuifãa mli lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ kɛtee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.” Kɛ̃lɛ, be ni mibo mitsɛ bo lɛ, obo mifaikpamɔ toi.
Nyɛsumɔa Yehowa, nyɛ hetselɔi fɛɛ.
Yehowa baa anɔkwafoi ayi, shi henɔwolɔi lɛ, ewoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ babaoo.
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛhiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe, ni nyɛfea ekãa.
Eshajajemɔ kɛ eshaifaa David Lala ko.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni akɛ etɔmɔ efa lɛ, ni atsumɔ ehe eshai lɛ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni Yehowa enaaa nɔ sha ko yɛ ehe; ni ebɛ mɔlakamɔ mumɔ lɛ.
Be ni mitsimɔ mihe esha nɔ lɛ, mitã loo yɛ huumɔ ni mihuuɔ daa jenamɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, onine tsii yɛ minɔ.
Mimli hewalɛ fɛɛ tã tamɔ bɔ ni latsaa be mli jeŋ dɔlɛ hãa nii amli nu ŋaa lɛ.
Mijaje mihe esha lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ bo, ni minifɔɔjianii lɛ mitsimɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Majaje mitɔmɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa.” Kɛkɛ ni okɛ mihe esha kɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ fa mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã anɔkwafoi fɛɛ asɔle atsɛ bo; ni kɛji haomɔ babaoo ba tamɔ faa ni etue lɛ, eninaŋ amɛ.
Bo ji mibobaahe.
Amanehulu mli lɛ, bo obaa miyi.
Okɛ miishɛɛ oshebɔɔ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe.
Mi, Yehowa, mawo bo ŋaa, ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni onyiɛ nɔ; mihiŋmɛi aaakã ohe.
Nyɛkatamɔa okpɔŋɔ loo tejiokpɔŋɔ ni leee nii ni akɛ manyoflɛ kɛ esɛɛ kpãa woɔ amɛ dani amɛhiɔ kudɔmɔ lɛ.
Piŋmɔi babaoo yɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo ebɔle ehe kɛkpe.
Oo nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛmii ashɛa nyɛhe, yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ.
Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nyɛja kɛmɔ shi.
Yijiemɔ lala Nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa Yehowa he!
Jalɔi anɔ ji akɛ amɛ jie Yehowa yi.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi kɛ saŋku; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãanyɔŋma saŋku.
Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa lɛ, nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛbɔa oshe waa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni, ni etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli.
Esumɔɔ jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli; Yehowa mlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Yehowa wiemɔ naa abɔ ŋwɛi yɛ, ni ekɛɛmɔ naa abɔ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii fɛɛ yɛ.
Ebua ŋshɔ mli nu fɛɛ naa, efee lɛ bibioo tamɔ tɔ mli nii; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli nu babaoo lɛ, etsi naa eto nitoohe.
Hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei.
Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ he akpokpo yɛ ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ewie ni eba mli; lɛ efã ni je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ.
Yehowa hãa majimaji lɛ ayiŋtoi lɛ feɔ yaka; ni etswaa ayiŋtoi lɛ efɔ̃ɔ.
Yehowa yiŋtoi lɛ, hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni etsuiŋ susumɔi lɛ yɛ hã yinɔbii fɛɛ.
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni eNyɔŋmɔ ji Yehowa kɛ maŋ ni ehala akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ.
Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ, ni enaa gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ.
Ejɛɔ he ni eta yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ enaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.
Lɛ eshɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ atsuii, ni enaa amɛnifeemɔi fɛɛ.
Jeee tabilɔi babaoo hãa maŋtsɛ yeɔ kunim; jeee tawulɔ ekãalɔ hewalɛ kpele lɛ hereɔ eyiwala.
Yakatswaa ni akɛ hiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛhã kunimyeli; ehewalɛ kpele lɛ nyɛŋ mɔ yiwala ahere Yehowa hiŋmɛii yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ kã esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe.
Yehowa aaajie amɛ kɛaaje gbele mli, ni eeehã amɛyi ana wala yɛ hɔmɔ be mli.
Wɔmiikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; lɛ ji wɔbualɔ kɛ wɔtsɛŋ.
Emli wɔnaa miishɛɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã.
Oo Yehowa, hã osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ kɛwɔ ahi shi bei abɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã onɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Mlihilɛ yijiemɔ David Lala be mli ni etsake ejwɛŋmɔ ni eshwie lɛ.
Majie Yehowa yi be fɛɛ be; eyijiemɔ aaakã midaaŋ daa nɛɛ.
Mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ.
Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim anu he, koni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe.
Oo, nyɛ kɛ mi akafoa Yehowa agbojee, ni nyɛhãa wɔfea ekome kɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Mitao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni ehere mi nɔ; ni ejie mi kɛje migbeyeishemɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ enɔ, ni ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ ohiɛ aaaba nyam.
Ohiafo bolɔ etsɛ Yehowa, ebo lɛ toi, ni ehere lɛ kɛjɛ ehaomɔi fɛɛ amli.
Mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ bɔleɔ amɛhe kɛkpeɔ, ni ejieɔ amɛ.
Nyɛsaa nyɛnaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nyɛaana akɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Nyɛshea Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko fiŋ amɛ.
Efĩɔ jatabii ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ehiaŋ amɛ.
Oo mibii, nyɛbaa, nyɛboa mi toi; mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ bɔ ni asheɔ Yehowa gbeyei ahãa.
Namɔ taoɔ akɛ eyi ana wala?
Namɔ sumɔɔ akɛ etsɛ yɛ jeŋ ni ena nɔ kpakpa?
Mɔ olilɛi mli ni ekafee efɔŋ; mɔ onaabu hu mli ni ekamale.
Wii ohe kɛje efɔŋ he, ni ofee ekpakpa.
Taomɔ toiŋjɔlɛ ni onyiɛ no sɛɛ.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi kã jalɔi ahe, ni efeɔ toi ehãa amɛblɔmɔi.
Yehowa jieɔ ehiɛ ekaa efɔŋfeelɔi, koni akakai amɛ kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛ jalɔi fo tsɛ Yehowa lɛ, eboɔ amɛ toi; ni ehereɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ amɛfimɔi fɛɛ amli.
Yehowa bɛŋkɛɔ mɛi ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ etã, ni ehereɔ mɛi ni werɛ eho amɛhe lɛ.
Jalɔ naa amanehulu babaoo, shi Yehowa jieɔ lɛ kɛjɛɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ebaa ewui ayi shweshweeshwe; ewu kome folo nɛkɛ ekuŋ.
Efɔŋ nɔŋŋ aaagbe efɔŋfeelɔ, ni mɔ ni nyɛɔ jalɔ lɛ aaabu lɛ fɔ.
Yehowa hereɔ etsuji ayiwala; ni mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ, ebuŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko fɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, okɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ ana; okɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi wuɔ lɛ awu!
Kɔ tsɛŋ wulu kɛ tsɛŋ bibioo ni ote shi oye obua mi.
Gbalamɔ akplɔ kɛ lema owo mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ misusuma akɛ, “Mi ji oyiwalaheremɔ.” Mɛi ni nyiɛ misɛɛ ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo.
Mɛi ni jwɛŋɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.
Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ shwieɔ amɛ kɛyaa lɛ hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.
Be ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ, hã amɛgbɛ nɔ awo duŋ ni enɔ ashãmɔ.
Mifeko amɛ efɔŋ ko kwraa shi amɛtsɔ mi tsɔne amɛtee; koni edu mi, ni amɛtsa bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ koni magbee mli ni magbo.
Hã amɛhiɛ akpãtã trukaa.
Hã tsɔne ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ adu amɛ.
Hã amɛgbee bu ni amɛtsa lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, mimii aaashɛ mihe, ejaakɛ ehere mi.
Migbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, namɔ tamɔ bo, bo mɔ ni ohereɔ gbɔjɔlɔi kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni he wawaa fe amɛ lɛ adɛŋ; ni ohereɔ gbedelɔi kɛ ohiafoi kɛjeɔ mɛi ni yeɔ amɛ amim lɛ adɛŋ.” Odasefoi yiwalɔi teɔ shi woɔ mi.
Amɛbiɔ mi nibii ni mileee he nɔ ko.
Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ; mikla tete etɔ biti.
Shi mi lɛ, be ni amɛhe yeɔ lɛ, mibu kpekpe; mikɛ ŋmaahilɛ wa mihe yi, ni mima miyi shi misɔle, tamɔ nɔ ni minaanyo loo minyɛminuu he ŋkɔmɔ miyeɔ lɛ.
Minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ ni mima miyi shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni enyɛ egbo ni eeye enyɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, kɛ mitɛ lɛ, amɛbuaa amɛhe naa kɛ miishɛɛ; amɛbuaa amɛhe naa amɛwoɔ mi; niiahetswialɔi ni mileee amɛ lɛ, kpaaa miheguɔ gbee.
Amɛyeɔ mihe fɛo ni amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ; amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi amɛwoɔ mi.
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛbe oookwɛ enɛ kɛyashi?
Jiemɔ mi kɛje amɛdɛŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, heremɔ miyiwala kɛjɛ jatai nɛɛ adɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mada bo shi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; majie oyi yɛ mɛi pii ahiɛ.
Kaahã mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ; ni kaahã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ mikpɛkpɛɛ mi.
Ejaakɛ amɛwieee hejɔlɛ wiemɔ; shi moŋ amɛfoɔ saji amɛshwieɔ mɛi ni he jɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgbɛɔ amɛdaaŋ hatoo amɛwoɔ mi; amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, yiɛ, wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi.” Oo Yehowa, bo diɛŋtsɛ ona, kaafee diŋŋ!
Oo Yehowa, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ kwraa.
MiNyɔŋmɔ kɛ miNuŋtsɔ, kojomɔ ohã mi.
Wo ohe nɔ ni oye misane lɛ ohã mi.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, buu mi bem yɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa, ni kaahã mihenyɛlɔi lɛ miiye mi yɔɔ.
Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ yɛ amɛyiŋ akɛ, “Gbeebi akle, nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ nɛ.” Kaahã amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnine egbe lɛ.” Mɛi ni nyaa yɛ mimanehulu hewɔ lɛ hã ashwie amɛhiɛ shi ni amɛhiɛ agboi.
Mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ, ni amɛtsɛɔ amɛhe yɛ minɔ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛgbele kɛ heguɔgbee lɛ atsɔ̃ amɛhe bo.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi ejurɔ lɛ, hã amɛbɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ ni amɛkɛɛ daa akɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo; lɛ enyaa etsulɔ ejurɔyeli he kɛ miishɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ, majaje ojalɛ lɛ, ni majie oyi daa nɛɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Adesa yitsoŋwalɛ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Efɔŋ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ yɛ etsuiŋ tɔ̃ɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ yiwalɔ mli.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lakaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anaŋ enifɔɔji anii lɛ ni anyaŋe.
Edaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, efɔŋ kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; eshi nilee kɛ ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ.
Etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa be ni ekã esaa nɔ; ni eyiɔ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ; nɔ fɔŋ ko kwraa bɛ ni enyaŋeɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Mlihilɛ Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, kwɔ kɛshɛɔ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ.
Onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ojalɛ nɔkwɔlɛ tamɔ gɔŋ, ni okojomɔ mlikwɔlɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ mli kwɔlɛ.
Oo Yehowa, bo ohereɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ yiwala.
Oo Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ jara wa naakpa, ni gbɔmɛi abii baa abo yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛyeɔ owe lɛŋ nii babaoo amɛtɔrɔɔ naakpa; ni amɛnuɔ omlihilɛ lɛ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ.
Ejaakɛ bo ji wala fɛɛ nubu; ni ola lɛ hãa wɔnaa nii faŋŋ.
Oo, hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni le bo, ni oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ hu ahi shi daa ahã mɛi ni ja kɛmɔ shi lɛ.
Kaahã hewolɔ lɛ naanaa minɔ, ni kaahã yiwalɔ hu miiwo mi foi.
Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ jwere shi butuu nɛɛ; atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi, ni amɛnyɛɛɛ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ kɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa naagbee David Lala.
Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ; asaŋ ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ eyeŋ be ko ni aaafolɔ amɛ ashwie tamɔ jwɛi; ni amɛaaŋala tamɔ baa fɔ.
Ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ ni ofee nɔ kpakpa, bɔ ni afee ni ohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe.
Hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni eeehã bo nii ni otsui shweɔ lɛ.
Tuu ohe owo Yehowa dɛŋ.
Hemɔ lɛ oye, ni eeeye ebua bo.
Eeehã ojalɛ akpɛ hɛŋŋ tamɔ hulu la; ni obemyeli hu aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ shwane.
Feemɔ dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni oto otsui shi omɛ lɛ.
Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni egbɛ eja ehã lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Kaawo otsui he la yɛ mɔ ni toɔ ŋaai fɔ̃ji ni etsuɔ amɛhenii hu lɛ hewɔ.
Kaahã omli miifu, ni omli akawo la kwraa.
Kaawo otsui he la, efɔŋfeemɔ mli pɛ ekɛ mɔ yaa.
Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ, aaafolɔ amɛ ashwie; shi mɛi ni mɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eshwɛ be fioo kɛkɛ, ni mɔ fɔŋ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, oootao lɛ yɛ eshihilɛhe tete; shi onaŋ lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe yɛ amɛshweremɔ babaoo hewɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji kpãŋɔ jalɔi ayinɔ, ni amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔjiashi amɛwoɔ amɛ; shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋmɔɔ yiwalɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ enaa akɛ enaagbee miiba.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji egbala klante ni amɛdɔrɔ amɛgãi lɛ, ni amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ nɔnalɔi kɛ ohiafoi ni amɛgbe mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja.
Amɛkɛ amɛklante lɛ aaagbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, ni aaakumɔ amɛgãii lɛ amli dukuduku.
Nii fioo ni jalɔ yɔɔ lɛ hi fe mɛi fɔ̃ji babaoo anii.
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahewalɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baakpãtã hiɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ Yehowa hiɛɔ amɛmli shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛhe lɛ, Yehowa le amɛwalabe, ni amɛshwiei aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Fimɔ bei amli lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboŋ, ni hɔmɔ bei amli hu lɛ, amɛaatɔrɔ.
Shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã!
Yehowa henyɛlɔi lɛ amɛnunyam tamɔ jwɛiaŋ fɔfɔi, amɛaatã tamɔ lasu.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ faa shika yɛ mɔ dɛŋ, ni ewooo; shi jalɔ dɛŋ kpɔɔ, ni ehãa mɔ nɔ.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ; shi mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ lɛ, aaaplenee amɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi fɛɛ lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ, ni mɔ ni Yehowa miishɛɔ ehe lɛ, ehãa enane mɔɔ shi.
Kɛ nakai gbɔmɔ gbee shi lɛ, ekãŋ jɛi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ enine mli.
Sa lɛ, gbekɛ ji mi, ni agbɛnɛ mitsɔ̃ nuumo; shi minako jalɔ ko ni akwa lɛ, ni eshwiei miisisɛ̃ aboloo pɛŋ.
Ehãa mɔ nɔ daa nɛɛ, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni eshwiei tsɔ̃ɔ jɔɔmɔ.
Wii ohe kɛje efɔŋ he, ni ofee ekpakpa; ni ooohi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ekwaŋ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Abaabaa jalɔi ayi kɛya naanɔ, shi mɛi fɔ̃ji ashwiei lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Jalɔi lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ kɛya naanɔ.
Jalɔ naabu wieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni elilɛi wieɔ nɔ ni ja.
Etoɔ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ yɛ etsui mli, ni eshiii sɛɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔ gbɔbiɔ jalɔ, ni etaoɔ lɛ egbe; shi Yehowa eŋmɛŋ jalɔ lɛ he ewoŋ ehenyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni abuŋ jalɔ lɛ fɔ hu yɛ kojomɔ mli.
Mɛɛ Yehowa ni onyiɛ egbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eeewo onɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ onɔ; ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ.
Mina mɔ fɔŋ yiwalɔ ko ni eewa yi ni eewo ehe nɔ tamɔ Lebanon tsenedrutso.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ mitsɔ̃ jɛi ekoŋŋ kɛho, ni naa, ebɛ jɛi; mitao lɛ moŋ shi anaaa lɛ.
Kadimɔ mɔ ni hi kɛwula shi; ni okwɛ mɔ ni ja; toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ eshwiei shwereɔ babaoo.
Shi efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei lɛ hu aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Yehowa hereɔ jalɔi ayiwala.
Lɛ ji amɛbobaahe yɛ haomɔ be mli.
Yehowa yeɔ buaa amɛ, ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala.
Ekpɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛjɛɔ yiwalɔi adɛŋ, ni ehereɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaa lɛ abo.
Mɔ ni ehao sɔlemɔ David Lala kɛha kaimɔ afɔle.
Oo Yehowa, kaakã mi yɛ omlifu naa, ni kaagbala mitoi yɛ omlila naa, ejaakɛ ogãimlibii lɛ etsulɔ mimli, ni onine etsii yɛ minɔ.
Omlifu hewɔ lɛ, mihewojiaŋ ejɔɔɔ mi; mihe eshai ewo mi hela.
Ejaakɛ minishaianii lɛ esu mi, etamɔ jatsu ni tsii yɛ minɔ.
Mikwashiafeemɔ hewɔ lɛ, mifaji lɛ ekpɔtɔ, amɛmiije fu.
Midɔ kɔmɔɔ ni mikumɔ, jenamɔ muu fɛɛ lɛ minyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ mihɛ mli miishã mi, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ.
Migbɔjɔ, ni mikumɔ kwraa; mitsui miiwa mihe, no hewɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, ole mishwee nii fɛɛ; mihuumɔ lɛ, akɛ teko bo.
Mitsui tswaa kplakpla; mihewalɛ miitã; ni mihiŋmɛii amli la egbo.
Minanemɛi kɛ misuɔlɔi tsiɔ amɛhe kɛjeɔ mihe yɛ mihe faji lɛ ahewɔ; ni miwekumɛi hu damɔɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, etsɔ̃ amɛtsɔnei lɛ.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ amɛkɛ amɛlilɛi fiteɔ mi, ni amɛkpãŋɔ miyinɔ be fɛɛ be.
Mitamɔ toimulɔ, minuuu nii; ni mitamɔ mumui, minyɛɛɛ mawie.
Hɛɛ!
Mitamɔ mɔ ko ni nuuu nii, mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ sane po naa ejie.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, bo Yehowa, onɔ mihiɛ kã.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo obaahã mi hetoo.
Shi mifaikpamɔ ji akɛ, kɛ mishane migbee shi lɛ, kaahã mihenyɛlɔi, mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ yɛ minɔ lɛ, miiye mi yɔɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, miihe magbee shi, ni mikãhe miipiŋ lolo.
Miijaje mitɔ̃mɔ lɛ; mihe esha lɛ miidɔ mi naakpa.
Mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ, amɛhe wa fe mi; ni mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi efolo lɛ, ayi fa naakpa.
Mɛi ni ŋɔɔ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa ni mifeɔ najiaŋ lɛ, ete shi ewo mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ, mifeɔ ekpakpa.
Oo Yehowa, kaakwa mi; Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ, ofainɛ, ba mramra ni obaye obua mi.
Mɔ ni miipiŋ he eshajajemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ kɛha Jeduthun.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Male mihenɔkwɛmɔ koni mikɛ mililɛi akafee esha.
Mawo minaabu manyoflɛ; be mli ni mɛi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ mihiɛ nɛɛ.” Mitɔ mu, ni mitswaaa misɛŋ; mimua minaa, shi fɛɛ yakatswaa, mipiŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ mi.
Mitsui mli miishã mi.
Babaoo ni misusuɔ miyiŋ lɛ, babaoo ni mitsuimlishãa lɛ woɔ wu ji no; Kɛkɛ ni migbele minaa mikɛɛ “Yehowa, hã male minaagbee, kɛ miwala gbii lɛ ayibɔ, bɔ ni ji, hã male tsɛ ni mitsɛŋ lɛ.” Naa, ofee miwala gbii kuku lɛ tamɔ dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ, ni miwala be lɛ, jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ ohiɛ.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ adesa yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ efee floŋŋ tamɔ mɛ, lamɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ, ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ hɔɔŋ.
Anɔkwa, egbaa ehe naa yakatswaa.
Etĩaa nii anaa, tsɛbelɛ eleee mɔ ni baaye.
“Ni agbɛnɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni mimɛɔ?
Mihiɛnɔkãmɔ fɛɛ ji bo.
Kpɔ̃ mi yɛ mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli; kaahã kwashia miibɔ mi ahora.
Mitɔ mu: mitswaaa misɛŋ, ejaakɛ bo ohã mipiŋ.
Kaagwao mi dɔŋŋ; yii ni oyiɔ mi lɛ, ehã migbede.
Okãa gbɔmɛi adesai ahiɛ yɛ esha hewɔ, ni ofiteɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jara wa hã amɛ tamɔ omlɛgɛ fiteɔ nii.
Lɛɛ lɛŋ, gbɔmɔ lɛ lamɔ kɛkɛ ji lɛ.
Sela Oo Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi ni ofee toi ohã mikɔmɔyeli lɛ.
Mihiɛ yaafonu lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaamua onaa; ejaakɛ oshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔ kɛkɛ ji mi, mɔkpɔŋ tamɔ mitsɛmɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Foo omlifu lɛ sɛɛ koni mana miishɛɛ fioo dani mashi biɛ maya.”
Yijiemɔ lala David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Mikɛ tsuishitoo kwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; eba etoi shi, ni enu mibolɔmɔ lɛ.
Efã mi kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ mli, ejie mi kɛjɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ minaji mamɔ tɛsaa nɔ, ni ehã minane mɔ shi.
Etsɔ̃ɔ mi lala hee ko lamɔ, no ji lala ni akɛjieɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Mɛi babaoo aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei; ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni ŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni ekɛ hewolɔi ebɔɔɔ, ni ekɛ mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ kɛyanyiɛɔ amale nyɔŋmɔi asɛɛ lɛ hu ebɔɔɔ lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, Onaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ fa babaoo hã wɔ; ni ojwɛŋmɔ ni oyɔɔ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hu fa naakpa.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni akɛ lɛ aaato ohe.
Kɛji majaje ni mawie he lɛ, amɛfa fe bɔ ni aaanyɛ akane.
Lá afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ, onyaaa he, shi moŋ ogbele mitoiŋ faŋŋ.
Shãa afɔle kɛ esha afɔle hu otaooo.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mi; miba; mi ni aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolo kpo lɛ mli lɛ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ, eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mafee osuɔmɔnaanii; Omla lɛ yɛ mitsui mli.” Oo Yehowa, mijaje kpɔ̃mɔ jurɔ sane lɛ, yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli; naa, ole hu akɛ mimuako minaa.
Oyelikɛbuamɔ ni okɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ, mitsimɔko nɔ yɛ mitsui mli.
Mijaje onɔkwayeli kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ; Mishiuko osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ nɔ yɛ asafo kpele lɛŋ.
Oo Yehowa, kaakãmã mi omɔbɔnalɛ lɛ; hã osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwale lɛ abaa miyi daa.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Ejaakɛ efɔ̃ji ni anyɛŋ akane ebɔle mi kɛkpe.
Mihe eshai lɛ fa fe mi, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni minyɛɛɛ mihiɛ nɔ mawo.
Amɛfa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi, mitsui po efã yɛ mimli.
Oo Yehowa, ofainɛ ni ojie mi.
Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi oya.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ akpãtã lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ agboi; ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi awui aye lɛ, hã amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛheguɔ agbo.
Mɛi ni kɛɔ mi akɛ, “Gbeebi akle” lɛ, hã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ amɛhiɛgbele lɛ hewɔ.
Shi moŋ, hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya, ni amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe yɛ omli.
Mɛi ni sumɔɔ odɛ̃ŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, “Yehowa je agbo.” Tsɛbelɛ, ohiafo ji mi ni efi mi moŋ nɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋɔ minɔ.
Oo, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mibualɔ kɛ mikpɔlɔ, kaatsɛ kwrakwra!
Helatsɛ ko sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni jwɛŋɔ ohiafo he; gbi fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaahere lɛ.
Yehowa aaabaa eyi, ni eeena wala, ni aaajɔɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔŋ lɛ owoŋ ehenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ lɛ lɛ adɛŋ.
Yehowa aaatsɔmɔ lɛ yɛ ehela saa nɔ, ni eeetsa ehelai lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehã lɛ.
Mi lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsa mi, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi bo.” Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wieɔ mihe kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛbe eeegbo ni egbɛi aaalaaje kwraa hu!” Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ba mi saramɔ lɛ, amɛkwaa amɛwieɔ osato wiemɔi, be mli ni amɛmiijwɛŋ efɔŋ yɛ amɛtsuiaŋ, ni kɛ amɛje kpo lɛ, amɛyagbaa no.
Mɛi fɛɛ kwa ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛwieɔ mihe ablɛbi, ni amɛsusuɔ efɔŋ amɛhãa mi.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Gbele hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni shi ni ekã nɛɛ eteŋ shi.” Mi diɛŋtsɛ mishieŋtsɛ po ni miheɔ lɛ miyeɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ efã ntia eshi mi.
Shi bo Yehowa, naa mi mɔbɔ, ni otee mi shi, koni mawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Enɛ mikɛaale akɛ oyɛ mihe tsuijurɔ lɛɛlɛŋ, ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi yeko minɔ kunim.
Owoɔ minɔ, ejaakɛ mifeɔ nɔ ni ja; ni oto mi yɛ ohiɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ.

WOLO NI JI ENYƆ Mɔ ko ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ Bɔ ni ofrote shweɔ faa ni hoɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ misusuma shweɔ bo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Misusuma miiye bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he kumai.
Te be po ni maba, ni mabana Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ hu?
Mihiɛ yaafonu etsɔ̃ miniyenii shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, be mli ni mɛi biɔ mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ?” Miwerɛ hoɔ mihe, kɛji mikai enɛɛmɛi: bɔ ni mi kɛ asafo yuu nyiɛɔ, bɔ ni amɛtoɔ yuu, ni minyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ; bɔ ni asafo lɛ bɔɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ shidaa lalai yeɔ gbijurɔ lɛ.
Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ?
Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Misusuma efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli, no hewɔ ni mikaiɔ bo, yɛ Yordan shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ, kɛ Mizar gɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.
Onujɔi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ jijeɔ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ.
Oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mlɛ̃i lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ, ni esu miyi.
Shwane lɛ, Yehowa jieɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi; ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ milaa Yehowa he lala; ni misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ miNyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni miwala yɔɔ lɛ.
Mikɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitɛsaa lɛ, akɛ, “Mɛɛba ohiɛ ekpa minɔ?
Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?” Ahora ni mihenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mi lɛ, shãa mi tamɔ fala, be mli ni amɛbiɔ mi daa akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?” lɛ.
Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ mimli nɛkɛ?
Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ?
Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ejaakɛ majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ko ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli sɔlemɔ Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ni obu mi bem.
Fã mihe yɛ maŋbii ni sheee bo gbeyei lɛ adɛŋ.
Jiemɔ mi yɛ shishiulɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ adɛŋ!
Ejaakɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ abo ni mibaa.
Mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃?
Mɛɛba sa akɛ manyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ haomɔ ni henyɛlɔ haoɔ mi lɛ hewɔ?
Oo, hã ola kɛ onɔkwale lɛ aba; koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ.
Hã amɛ kɛ mi aba Zion ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ oSɔlemɔwe lɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ maya Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he; maya Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa mi miishɛɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni matswa saŋku mikɛaajie oyi.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ.
Oo misusuma, mɛɛba ofee mɔbɔmɔbɔ nɛkɛ?
Ni mɛɛ yeyeeye ofee yɛ mimli nɛɛ?
Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; shi majie eyi ekoŋŋ kɛ̃, mɔ ni ji miyelikɛbualɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Hebuu he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni jɛ Maskil bii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔnu kɛ wɔtoi; wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ egba wɔ nibii ni otsu yɛ amɛyinɔ, yɛ blema bei lɛ amli.
Bɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oshwie maji lɛ, ni otɛo owebii yɛ jɛi; bɔ ni ohao maji krokomɛi lɛ, shi owebii lɛ ohã amɛshwere.
Ejaakɛ jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛklante nɔ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ; asaŋ jeee amɛnineshiwalɛ hã amɛye kunim; shi moŋ ohewalɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ naa, kɛ ohiɛ ni kã amɛhe lɛ hã amɛye kunim; ejaakɛ oyɛ amɛhe tsuijurɔ.
Bo ji mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ, bo ohã Israel ye kunim srɔtoi lɛ.
Ohewalɛ naa wɔtsirɛɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi wɔtswiaa shi yɛ; ogbɛi mli wɔnaanaa mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ wɔ lɛ anɔ yɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee migãi nɔ mihiɛ kã, asaŋ jeee miklante aaahere miyiwala.
Shi moŋ bo ohere wɔyiwala yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni ohã mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ ahiɛ gboi.
Bo Nyɔŋmɔ, onɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ daa nɛɛ, ni wɔɔɔda bo shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, okwa wɔ, ni oba wɔ shi; ni okɛ wɔ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ.
Ohãa wɔjoɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi anaa foi, ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ haa wɔnii.
Ofee wɔ tamɔ toi ni akɛ amɛ miiya gbeehe; ni ogbɛ wɔ oshwã majimaji lɛ amli.
Ohɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii lɛ ofoo, ni ahe amɛ mlɛo.
Ohã mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ bɔɔ wɔ ahora, mɛi ni bɔle wɔ lɛ yeɔ wɔhe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ.
Ohã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ hefɛoyelinii wɔhã majimaji lɛ.
Minaa mihiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ tuu; ni hiɛgbele hu emɔ mi, yɛ ahorabɔlɔi lɛ kɛ sopalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ahewɔ ni hiɛgbele hu mɔɔ mi kɛ mina mihenyɛlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eba wɔnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kpako onɔ, ni wɔkuko wɔkɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Wɔkwako bo, ni jeee akɛ wɔbako wɔjeŋ tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ okumɔ wɔ butubutu yɛ ŋaŋgbei ahilɛhe ni okɛ duŋ kabitii eha wɔnɔ nɛɛ.
Eji wɔhiɛ ekpa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaja maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kulɛ, ani bo Nyɔŋmɔ oleŋ lo?
Ejaakɛ ole tsuiiaŋ teemɔŋnii.
Naa, ohewɔ lɛ akpãtãa wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be, ni abuɔ wɔ tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, tee shi, mɛɛba owɔɔ?
Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, kaashɛrɛ wɔ oshwie kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ okɛ ohiɛ etee?
Mɛɛba ohiɛ ekpa wɔmanehulu kɛ yi ni awaa wɔ lɛ nɔ?
Ejaakɛ anaanaa wɔnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ; ni wɔgbɔmɔtso eka su mli.
Tee shi ni obaye obua wɔ.
Yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ wɔyiwala.
Odehe yookpeemɔ lala David Lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni atswa.
Mitsui eyi tɔ kɛ wiemɔi kpakpai.
Maŋtsɛ lala nɛ.
Mililɛi tamɔ niŋmalɔ ni he esa niŋmaatso.
Ohe yɛ fɛo fe gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ.
Odaaŋ wiemɔ he tse, hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ bo kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Oo, bo hewalɛtsɛ maŋtsɛ, miamɔ kɛ oklante yɛ ogbojee kɛ onunyam mli.
Fãa kɛ agbojee kɛyaye kunim, kɛfã anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ he.
Ohewalɛ aaahã oye kunim wulu.
Ogãimlibii anaa ba; amɛgbulɔɔ maŋtsɛ henyɛlɔi atsuiiaŋ; ni majimaji pleneeɔ yɛ onaji anaa.
Omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni, ni ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Olumɔyeli tsi lɛ, jalɛ saneyeli tsi ni.
Osumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ.
No hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehã oyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ fe onanemɛi maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.
Otadei amli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ anuatrɛ kɛ kashia ŋma.
Kpãa saŋkui atswaa akɛshɛjeɔ omii yɛ shuɔwu mɔji amli.
Maŋtsɛmɛi abiyei futu oyei hiɛnaanɔbii ateŋ.
Maŋnyɛ lɛ ewula kɛ Ofir shika kɛdamɔ oninejurɔ nɔ Ee!
biyoo, bo toi, jwɛŋmɔ he; ohiɛ akpa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ otsɛ we lɛ anɔ.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakɔ̃ ohefɛo lɛ nɔ.
Akɛni lɛ ji onuŋtsɔ lɛ, kotomɔ lɛ.
Tirobii kɛ maŋ lɛŋ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tete kɛ nikeenii aaaba koni amɛkɛtao ohiɛ gbɛ?
Maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ ewula kiŋkaŋŋ yɛ opia lɛŋ.
Etade lɛ akɛ shika kpãa elo mli.
Ewula kɛ atadei ni aye ŋaabii kɛ amɛsui srɔtoi awo mli; ni akpala lɛ kɛyahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, esɛɛbii enanemɛi oblayei froi krokomɛi nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ boteɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛŋ.
Obihii lɛ aaabaye oblematsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ.
Ooowo amɛ lumɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Mahã akai onumnyam gbɛi lɛ yinɔi fɛɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, jeŋ gbɔmɛiabii fɛɛ aaajie oyi daa kɛaatee naanɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ David Lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni atswa yɛ Alamoth gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe kɛ wɔhewalɛ, wɔyelikɛbualɔ krɔŋŋ yɛ fimɔ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji shikpɔŋ hiɛ tsɔ̃ bu shi, kɛji gɔji famɔ yagbee ŋshɔŋ teŋteŋ tete po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.
Kɛji ŋshɔ lɛ hũu, ni efee hamahama; kɛji gɔji tete hoso yɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ naa po lɛ, wɔsheŋ gbeyei.
Faa ko yɛ ni eniji lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe.
Ehãa Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ shihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe.
Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ emaŋ lɛ mli; nɔ ko nɔ ko haŋ maŋ lɛ afite.
Nyɔŋmɔ aaaye abua lɛ leebi maaŋkpa.
Majimaji lɛ feɔ hoo; maŋtsɛyelii lɛ hosoɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ egbee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ sereɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbobaahe; Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; Nyɛbakwɛa bɔ ni ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ehãa tawuu sɛɛ foɔ kɛyashɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ.
Ekumɔɔ gãii amli ni efiteɔ akplɔi.
Ekɛ la shãa tsɛŋi lɛ.
“Nyɛfea dioo, ni nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi, mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ; Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, Awo minɔ gojoo yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ wɔ yɛ; Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji wɔbobaahe.
Nɔyeli ni kwɔ fe fɛɛ Korabii alala.
Nyɛ maji fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛtswaa nyɛdɛ̃; nyɛkɛ nyamɔ lala abɔa oshe waa ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo lɛ, ehe yɛ gbeyei.
Maŋtsɛ kpele ji lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Eba maŋbii ashi ewo wɔshishi, ni ehã wɔye majimaji anɔ.
Eŋɔ wɔgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã wɔ, Yakob, mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, shwãanii lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ etee ŋwɛi kɛ oshebɔɔ.
Yehowa kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ jijemɔ etee ŋwɛi.
Nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ; nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai koo!
Nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa wɔmaŋtsɛ, nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai koo.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ lalai!
Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ maŋtsɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maji lɛ amli lumɛi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa kɛba; ni amɛbatsɔ̃mɔ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii.
Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tawuu nibii lɛ, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni.
Awo enɔ gojoo.
Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋ Zion lɛ Korabii alala.
Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ kpele, yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ maŋ lɛŋ, yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion shimaa yɛ fɛo.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tsui he nɔ ni.
Zion Gɔŋ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ji maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ maŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ale akɛ kɛji oyɛ emaŋ lɛŋ mɔji lɛ amli lɛ, oyɛ abobaahe shweshweeshwe.
Shi naa, maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ bua amɛhe naa amɛba kutuu kɛba Zion Gɔŋ lɛ he.
Amrɔ ni amɛna Zion lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe; ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ amɛ, Kɛkɛ ni tswrao amɛjo foi.
Gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛhe jara amɛ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ, loo tamɔ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ, ni miijwara Tarshish lɛji.
Bɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔna yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, maŋ wulu lɛŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã emaŋ lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ kɛya naanɔ.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔsusu osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he yɛ oSɔlemɔ we lɛŋ.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔ ni ogbɛi lɛ jijeɔ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ oyijiemɔ jijeɔ, kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei.
Oninejurɔ eyi obɔ kɛ kunimyeli.
Hã Zion Gɔŋ lɛ anya, hã Yuda maji lɛ amli afili amɛ yɛ ejalɛ kojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛnyiɛa kɛbɔlea Zion he kpula; nyɛkanea emli mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ.
Nyɛtɛ̃jea nyɛhiɛ nyɛkwɛa gbogboi lɛ; nyɛkpaa emli mɔji wuji lɛ amli, koni nyɛgbaa yinɔbii ni baaba lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ gbɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Hiɛ ni akɛfɔɔ ninamɔ nɔ lɛ kwashiafeemɔ ni Lala ko ni akɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni jɛ Korahbii adɛŋ.
Nyɛboa enɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ!
Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi, nyɛ mɛi ni abuɔ kɛ mɛi ni abuuu, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi fɛɛ!
Nilee wiemɔ baajɛ midaaŋ; mitsuiŋ susumɔ lɛ niiashishinumɔ ni.
Mafee toi mahã abɛbuaiaŋ wiemɔ, ni mikɛ saŋku aaatsɔ̃ɔ mijenu lɛ shishi.
Mɛni hewɔ mashe gbeyei yɛ haomɔ bei amli; be ni mishishinyiɛlɔi kɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii ebɔle mi, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛninamɔ nɔ ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛyɛ shika babaoo?
Ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyi nyɔmɔ ewo; aloo enyɛ ekpɔ̃ ehe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ; ejaakɛ wala kpɔ̃mɔ nii lɛ ejara wa tsɔ̃, bɔ ni enyɛŋ he nyɔmɔ ewo kɔkɔɔkɔ, koni ehi shi kɛya naanɔ ni ekana gbohiiaje.
Hɛɛ!
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ nilelɔi tete gboiɔ; asaŋ kwashia kɛ buulu fɛɛ hu gboiɔ; ni amɛshĩɔ amɛjwetrii fɛɛ amɛhãa mɛi krokomɛi.
Amɛyiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛgbonyobui lɛ ji amɛshĩai kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Jɛi ji amɛshihilɛhei kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ; tsɛbelɛ, amɛtsɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi akɛ amɛnɔ pɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa, ekaŋ enunyam mli, ebaagbo tamɔ kooloo nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhewalɛ nɔ, ni nɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa amɛhiɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee yɔɔ nɛ: gbohiiaje kã shi hã amɛ tamɔ toi, gbele baatsɔ̃ amɛkpalalɔ.
Amɛaakpeleke shi oya kɛaatee gbonyobu mli; ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaakpɔtɔ.
Gbohiiaje aaatsɔ̃ amɛwe Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ misusuma kɛjɛ gbohiiaje hewalɛ dɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ eeehe mi eto.
Kaashe mɔ ko ni etsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, ni ewe lɛŋ anunyam efa babaoo lɛ gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ kɛ egbo lɛ, eŋɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ.
Eninamɔ lɛ ekoeko enyiɛŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ be ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ, ebuɔ ehe akɛ eyi tɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; ni mɛi hu jieɔ eyi akɛ “eyɛ jogbaŋŋ” moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, eeetee etsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ gbohiiaje; mɛi ni enaŋ la kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa nyɛŋ ehi enunyam shihilɛ mli sɔŋŋ; etamɔ kooloo ni hiɛ kpãtãa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Jamɔ krɔŋŋ Asaf lala ko.
Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa Ofe lɛ, miiwie, ni eetsɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛmiijɛ hulu shiteehe kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe.
Nyɔŋmɔ miikpɛ kɛmiijɛ Zion ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛwula shi lɛ mli.
WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba, ebaaa lɛ kpoo.
La ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ; ni ahum kpele bɔle ehe.
Etsɛ ŋwɛi, ni etsɛ shikpɔŋ, akɛ ebaakojo emɛi lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa mimɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ anaa nyɛhãa mi; mɛi ni etsɔ̃ afɔle nɔ amɛkɛ mi ekpãŋ lɛ.
Ŋwɛi tete jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ji kojolɔ lɛ.
Oo mimɛi, nyɛboa toi, mibawie.
Oo Israel, maye odase mashi bo.
Mi ji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Jeee afɔlei lɛ ahewɔ mikãa bo; oshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa!
Mitaooo owe lɛŋ tsinanuu ko loo otoi atsu lɛŋ too kpakpo ko.
Ejaakɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ koo mli, kɛ tsinai ni yɔɔ gɔji akpe nɔ lɛ, mi, minɔ ni.
Mile ŋwɛi loofɔji fɛɛ, ni kooloi ni nyiɛ ŋa mli fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye mi lɛ, mikɛŋ bo, ejaakɛ je lɛ kɛ emli nii fɛɛ lɛ, minɔ ni.
Ani miyeɔ tsina loo, aloo minuɔ too abotiai alá?
Ŋɔɔ shidaa afɔle ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; koni oye oshi ni owo ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ nɔ; Tsɛ mi yɛ fimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ!
Majie bo, ni ooowo mihiɛ nyam.” Shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hegbɛ oyɔɔ akɛ ojaje mikpɔi lɛ aloo akɛ ohã mikpãŋmɔ lɛ akã olilɛi nɔ?” Ejaakɛ osumɔɔɔ tsɔsemɔ, ni otswaa miwiemɔ ofɔ̃ɔ afã.
Kɛji ona julɔ ko lɛ, onaanyo ni; ni okɛ gbãlãfitelɔi bɔɔ.
Ohãa onaabu gbɛ, ni ewieɔ nɔ fɔŋ; ni olilɛi foɔ amale etãa.
Otaa shi oyeɔ onyɛmi he osheku; onyɛ musuŋbi tete po, ofiteɔ egbɛi.
Enɛɛmɛi ofee, shi akɛni mifee dioo hewɔ lɛ, osusuɔ akɛ mitamɔ bo nɔŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miikã ohiɛ, ni mikɛmiimamɔ ohiɛ faŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ lɛ, nyɛkadia enɛ kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mibatserɛ nyɛmli dukuduku ni mɔ ko bɛ ni baahere nyɛyiwala.
Mɔ ni shãa shidaa afɔle lɛ, eewo mihiɛ nyam.
Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, mibahere eyiwala.
Sɔlemɔ hã eshaifaa David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa be ni Gbalɔ Nathan ba eŋɔɔ yɛ Bathsheba hewɔŋ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
Omɔbɔnalɛ babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, gbee mitɔmɔi lɛ.
Fɔ mihe nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ oshwie, koni ohã mihe atse, Ejaakɛ mitɔmɔi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mile; ni mihe eshai fɛɛ ma mihiɛ daa.
Bo okoome pɛ mifee esha mishi, ni mifee efɔŋ yɛ ohiɛ.
Oyeɔ bem kɛji ooobu mi fɔ, ni tɔ̃mɔ bɛ okojomɔ he.
Naa, afɔ mi yɛ esha mli, ni esha mli minyɛ ŋɔ mi hɔ yɛ.
Naa, nɔ ni otaoɔ yɛ midɛŋ ji anɔkwayeli; no hewɔ lɛ, hã male nii yɛ mimligbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mihe esha lɛ okɛ awrɔke afɔ, koni mihe atse; juu mihe, ni mayɛ futaa fe ayilɔ.
Hã manu nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ he; hã wui ni bo okumɔ lɛ amli afili amɛ.
Kaakwɛ eshai ni mifee lɛ; fɔ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bɔɔ tsui ni mli tse ohã mi; dromɔ mi mumɔ hee ni gbugbãaa.
Kaashwie mi yɛ ohiɛ, ni kaajie oMumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ mimli.
Hã manu miishɛɛ ni yɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ mli lɛ he ekoŋŋ; baamɔ mimli toiboo mumɔ lɛ yi, Koni matsɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃lɔi okitãi lɛ, koni eshafeelɔi aku amɛsɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, kpɔ̃ mi kɛjɛ lashishwiemɔ he fɔyeli mli, ni mala waa kɛjaje okpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ minaa, ni minaabu ajaje oyijiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ onyaaa afɔle he; kɛji mishã shãa afɔle tete lɛ onyaŋ he.
Afɔle ni sa ohiɛ ji mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, tsui ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ, okpooŋ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ Zion ejurɔ yɛ oduromɔ naa; tswaa Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooona afɔlei ni sa ahe tsui, shãa afɔlei jio, kooloo muu afɔle ni jio, no ni akɛ tsina hii baashã afɔle yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ kojomɔ kɛ dromɔ Lala ko ni akɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ be mli ni Doeg yakɛɛ Saul akɛ, “David etee Ahimelech we lɛ.” Oo bo gbɔmɔ kãkãlɔ, mɛɛba okɛ onifɔɔjianii ni ofee oshi mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ shwãa lɛ?
Bo yiŋshatsɛ, olilɛi naa ba tamɔ asooyi; gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, nifitemɔ he kpãŋmɔ okpãŋɔ.
Onyaa efɔŋ he fe ekpakpa; onyaa amale he fe anɔkwale.
Oo, amalelɔ, onyaa mɔfitemɔ wiemɔi ahe!
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo aaatswa shi; ni oteŋ shi dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ebaasha bo kɛjɛ obuu lɛ mli, ni ebaatserɛ omli.
Ebaafã bo kɛ oshishi fã kɛaaje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jalɔi lɛ aaana, ni amɛaashe gbeyei, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaaŋmɔ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Naa nuu lɛ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee ebobaahe lɛ, shi moŋ eŋɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ eninamɔ babaoo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ eshweshweeshwefeemɔ fɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Shi mi lɛ, mitamɔ mutso kɛ enɔ baa ŋmɔŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ ni tsakeee lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, mibada bo shi kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nɔ ni ofee lɛ hewɔ.
Mibakafo ogbɛi yɛ owebii ahiɛ ejaakɛ ohi.
Gbɔmɔ Adesa yitsoŋwalɛ Lala ko kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa yɛ Mahalath gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
Kwashiai kɛɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.” Amɛfite, ni nibii ni ahiɔ pɛ amɛfeɔ, amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa.
Nyɔŋmɔ jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekwɛɔ gbɔmɛi abii, akɛ eeena mɛi komɛi ni le nii, mɛi ni taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lo?
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã, amɛ fɛɛ amɛje amɛŋlɛ nɔ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni feɔ nɔ kpakpa.
Dabida!
Mɔ kome nɛkɛ folo bɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ miibi akɛ, “Aso nakai efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ni yeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ tamɔ ayeɔ aboloo, ni amɛjaaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛleee nii?
Naa amɛ ni ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ, ŋmiŋmi ni anako ehenɔ dã!
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baagbɛ amɛwui lɛ eshwã.
Abaahã amɛhiɛ agboi ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa amɛ.
Oo, kulɛ ajɛ Zion ahere Israel yiwala!
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ hã ewebii ba amɛblema ekoŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ Yakob aaanya, ni Israel mii aaashɛ!
Sɔlemɔ hã hebuu yɛ henyɛlɔi ahewɔ Lala ko kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni atswa yɛ kpaa saŋku nɔ be mli ni Ziphitebii yakɛɛ Saul, “Ani David etee yɛ wɔteŋ?” Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere miyiwala, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ aye misane lɛ ohã mi.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ntɛŋfeelɔi ete shi ewo mi, yiwalɔi miitao mihiɛ amɛkpãtã, ejaakɛ jeee amɛhe sane ko ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyelikɛbualɔ; Yehowa dɛŋ miwala yɔɔ.
Eeewo mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ, yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ejaakɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ.
Mibashã tsuijurɔ naa afɔle mahã bo.
Oo Yehowa, majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ omli hi.
Ejaakɛ ohere mi kɛjɛ mihaomɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli, ni mihiŋmɛi ena mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim ni aye lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ sɔlemɔ Lala ko ha lalatsɛ nukpa ni atswa yɛ kpaa saŋku nɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni kɛji mikpa bo fai lɛ, hã mana bo.
Bo mi toi, ni ohã mi hetoo; mihejaramɔ lɛ eye minɔ.
Henyɛlɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ ehã mitsui efã; yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ piŋmɔ ehã mifee yeyeeye; ejaakɛ amɛmiiba amɛbawo mi hejaramɔ; amɛmli efu mi, ni amɛmiinyɛ mi naakpa.
Mitsui ehao yɛ mimli; gbele he ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi.
Gbeyei emɔ mi, ni mihe miikpokpo, ni tsuifãa esu miyi.

Naa, kulɛ!
Majo foi kɛya shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni mayato shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Sela Kulɛ maye oyai majo lasuogbele kɛ ahum lɛ naa foi, mayatao abobaahe mahã mihe.” Oo Nuŋtsɔ, futumɔ amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, kaahã amɛmiikpã gbee, ejaakɛ miina basabasafeemɔ kɛ nɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛnyiɛɔ maŋ gbogboi lɛ anɔ kɛbɔleɔ maŋ lɛ, shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; nifɔɔjianii kɛ haomɔ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ maŋ lɛŋ.
Akpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ mli, yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ kpaaa yɛ eblohui lɛ amli.
Henyɛlɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ kulɛ, mamɔ mli nakai; ni asaŋ mɔ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi lɛ ni kulɛ, maŋɔ mihe matee lɛ.
Shi moŋ bo, mitipɛŋfonyo, bo, minaanyo, mishieŋtsɛ ni.
Mikɛ bo yeɔ yitsoŋ sane, ni bo ji mɔ ni mikɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Hã amɛgboi, hã amɛya gbohiiaje hiɛkãalɔi, ejaakɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ kɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ bo Nyɔŋmɔ, ni bo Yehowa ooohere mi.
Leebi kɛ shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ miwerɛho lɛ aaaŋmɛ ehiɛ kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ, ni eeebo mi toi.
Eeehere misusuma shweshweeshwe yɛ ta ni miwuɔ lɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ ayi fa.
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, aaabo mi toi; ni eeeba amɛ shi ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee, ni amɛsheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.
Mitsutsu naanyo lɛ ewo enine nɔ yɛ enanemɛi anɔ; ni eku eshiwoo lɛ mli.
Enaa jɔ fe shwie, shi ebɔɔ yɛ etsui mli; ewiemɔ he jɔ fe mlɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ klante ni naa ba ni.
Shɛ ojatsu lɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, ni lɛ eeehiɛ omli; eŋmɛŋ gbɛ gbi ko gbi ko ni jalɔ adidãa.
Shi, ao, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, obaashɛrɛ amɛ oshwie bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɔgbelɔi kɛ kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛyeŋ amɛwala gbii amli fã tete.
Shi, mi lɛ, bo onɔ maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko ni akɛ Miktam gbɛjianɔtoo tswa be mli ni Filistine bii mɔ lɛ lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi miinaanaa minɔ, henyɛlɔi miihao mi gbi muu fɛɛ.
Be fɛɛ be lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ naanaa minɔ; mɛi pii kɛ mi tswaa kɛ henɔwomɔ.
Kɛji gbeyei mɔ mi lɛ, mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ bo onɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni daaŋ wiemɔ ni mijieɔ yi lɛ, Lɛ enɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃; ni misheee gbeyei.
Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesa aaanyɛ mi afee?
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mi awui pɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛye; efɔŋ sɔŋŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.
Amɛbuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛwoɔ mi antɛo, ni amɛjaa misɛɛ mo koni amɛgbe mi.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo amɛ esha ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Okɛ mlifu atsirɛ amɛ atswia shi.
Ole bɔ ni mitsomloɔ mihãa, Ole miyaafonu falɛ.
Ani aŋmãko yɛ owolo mli lo?
Gbi ni mibabolɔ matsɛ bo lɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ; mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, oyɛ misɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ daaŋ wiemɔ ni mijieɔ yi lɛ, Yehowa, mɔ daaŋ wiemɔ ni mikafoɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ nɔ ni mihiɛ kã; misheee gbeyei.
Mɛni gbɔmɔ adesã aaanyɛ mi afee?
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, maye shii ni miwo bo lɛ anɔ.
Mibashã shidaa afɔlei mahã bo.
Ejaakɛ ohere misusuma kɛje gbele mli, ni ohãaa aye minɔ, koni manyiɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ yɛ wala la lɛ mli.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni atswa yɛ Miktam gbɛjianɔtoo naa be mli ni ejo foi kɛjɛ Saul tɛkpolo lɛ mli.
Naa mi mɔbɔ!
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo abo misusuma baa nɛɛ.
Ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli maba abo yɛ kɛyaashi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ahum lɛ aaaho.
Mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni feɔ nii fɛɛ hãa mi lɛ.
Ebaatsu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni abahere miyiwala; ebaawo mɛi ni haoɔ mi lɛ hiɛgbele.
Nyɔŋmɔ baajie esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwale lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Mikã jatai ni kɛ hɔmɔ tserɛɔ gbɔmɛi amli ateŋ.
Amɛnyanyɔji lɛ akplɔi kɛ gãimlibii ni; ni amɛlilɛii lɛ klantei ni naa ba ni.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
Hã onunyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Mihenyɛlɔi ŋmɛ mi yaa koni amɛdu mi; misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ awerɛho.
Amɛtsa bu yɛ migbɛ nɔ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ amɛyagbee mli.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, omli hemɔkɛyeli ni miyɔɔ lɛ, ema shi shiŋŋ etsakeko kwraa!
Mala, majie oyi!
Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, misusuma!
Nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, obenta kɛ saŋku!
Mibahã je atsɛre mra.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, mibada bo shi yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ.
Mibala kɛjie oyi yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛyashɛɔ ŋwɛi; ni onɔkwayeli yashɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
Hã onunyam lɛ akple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Yiwalɔi atoigbalamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko ni atswa yɛ kpaa saŋku nɔ yɛ Miktam gbɛjianɔtoo naa.
Nyɛ lumɛi, aso nyɛbuɔ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lo?
Ani nyɛkojoɔ gbɔmɛi abii fɛɛ yɛ jalɛ naa lo?
Dabida!
Nɔ fɔŋ ni nyɛbaafee he nyɛjwɛŋɔ; yiwalɛ nii nyɛfeɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji gbaa jwɛi kɛjɛɔ musuŋ beebe; kɛji ashwie amɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ amɛbɔi malemɔ.
Ebɔɔ yɛ amɛmli tamɔ onufu, amɛtsimɔɔ amɛtoi tamɔ ble koni amɛkanu ŋkunyaayelɔ gbee loo ashwãifeelɔ tsɛmɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kuumɔ amɛdaaŋ nyanyɔji.
Oo Yehowa, fãamɔ jata oblahii atsoji.
Hã amɛlaaje tamɔ nu ni hoɔ kɛyaa, ni anaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ jwɛi koni amɛgboi.
Hã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waa mli nu kplãnaa; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ bi ni ashrake ni enaaa hulu.
Dani nyɛkukwɛi aaanu laitso dɔlɛ he lɛ, tso ŋmɔŋ jio, tso ni la efu he momo jio, Yehowa abɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ ashwie.
Jalɔi aaanya be ni amɛaana oweletɔɔ lɛ; amɛaanyiɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ala mli kɛho.
Mɛi aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nyɔmɔwoo ko yɛ hã jalɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ ni kojoɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Shweshweeshwefeemɔ he sɔlemɔ Lala ko ni akɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ be mli ni Saul tsu mɛi ni amɛtɛo David ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Kpɔ̃ mi yɛ mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ mi lɛ adɛŋ.
Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ; heremɔ miyiwala yɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi adɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ naa, amɛwo ka yɛ mi mihewɔ; yiwalɔi ebua amɛhe naa amɛwo mi.
Oo Yehowa, jeee esha ni mifee loo tɔ̃mɔ ko ni mitɔ̃ hewɔ ni amɛjoɔ foi kɛyaa amɛyafeɔ kralo amɛtoɔ mi.
Wo ohe nɔ, baakwɛ ni oye obua mi.
Yehowa, bo Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, bo ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ.
Wo ohe nɔ koni ogbala maji fɛɛ atoi; kaana efɔŋfeelɔi kutumpɔfoi lɛ ekoeko kwraa mɔbɔ.
Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛbolɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛ amɛyɔɔ jɛi lɛ, amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃.
Amɛnaa jaraa tamɔ klante, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ nuɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɔ lɛ?” Shi Oo, bo Yehowa, oŋmɔɔ amɛ; oyeɔ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ahe fɛo.
Oo miHewalɛ, bo pɛ gbɛ mikwɛɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji mimɔɔ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ aaabakpee mi; kɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; miNyɔŋmɔ aaahã mihiŋmɛi ana mihenyɛlɔi anɔ kunimyeli lɛ.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtsɛ, kaagbe amɛ, no lɛ mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ aaakpa nɔ; shi moŋ gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã yɛ ohewalɛ naa, ni okɛ amɛ atswia shi.
Esha wiemɔi ni jeɔ amɛnaa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã amɛhewoo lɛ afimɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ.
Loomɔ kɛ amale wiemɔi ni amɛwieɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, okɛ mlifu akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ kɛyaashi amɛyi aaatã, koni mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ naagbeehei fɛɛ ana ale akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ Israel nɔ.
Daa gbɛkɛ lɛ, amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa; amɛbolɔɔ tamɔ gbei, ni amɛnyiɛɔ tsoŋtsoŋ yɛ maŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛkpaa shi amɛtaoɔ niyenii, ni kɛ eshɛɛɛ amɛnaa lɛ, amɛhuuɔ kɛ mlifu.
Shi mi lɛ, mala ohewalɛ lɛ he lala; leebi lɛ, mala osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he lala; ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ mɔɔ ohã mi, ni otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mi, yɛ mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Oo, miHewalɛ, mala majie oyi, ejaakɛ, Oo, bo Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mimɔ̃ɔ.
Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni ojieɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ David lá be ni ekɛ Arambii ni jɛ Naharaim kɛ Zoba lɛ wu ni Yoab ku esɛɛ eyagbe Edombii lɛ ateŋ mɛi , yɛ Ŋoo Jɔɔ lɛŋ lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okwa wɔ, okumɔ wɔhe afabaŋ, omli efu wɔ.
Kuu osɛɛ oba wɔŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ohã shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso, ni ohã emli egbala; tsaramɔ hei ni egbala lɛ, ejaakɛ ewɔtsɔ.
Ohã owebii lɛ ena nɔ naakpa.
Wɔmiililaa shi tamɔ mɛi ni etɔ wain.
Oshi aflaŋaa akɛ okadi ohã mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ, koni amɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli kɛbaanyiɛ anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ.
Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala.
Bo wɔ toi bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahere amɛyiwala.
Nyɔŋmɔ ejɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ miishɛɛ baaja Shekem mli, ni majara Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã mimaŋ lɛ.
Minɔ ji Gilead, ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji miyitso dade fai; Yuda ji mimaŋtsɛ tsi.
Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota mashwie Edom kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi, minɔ ni, ni mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mashwie Filistia nɔ.” Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni awaje lɛ lɛ mli?
Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaaya Edom?
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwako wɔ?
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔta lɛ efãaa ta dɔŋŋ?
Oo, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ akpe; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesã dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.
Akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ wɔɔye kunim kɛ̃.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.
Hebuu he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo mibolɔmɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ.
Kɛ mitsui miisu lɛ, mabo matsɛ bo, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe.
Wa mi kɛya tɛsaa ni kwɔ fe mi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji mibobaahe, mɔɔ ko ni wa fe henyɛlɔ lɛ.
Hã mahi obuu lɛŋ kɛya naanɔ, koni mafee shweshweeshwe yɛ ofiji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛŋ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ onu mishiwoi lɛ.
Okɛ mɛi ni sheɔ bo gbeyei lɛ agbɛnaanii ehã mi.
Hã maŋtsɛ lɛ wala sɛɛ atsɛ, ni ehi shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ, hã eye lumɔ yɛ ohiɛ kɛya naanɔ; ni okɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli lɛ abu ehe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mala majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa nɛɛ, be ni miyeɔ mishiwoi lɛ anɔ daa nɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ hebuu hiɛnɔkãmɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ yɛ Jeduthun gbɛjianɔtoo naa lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ nɛɛ; lɛ edɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ jɛɔ.
Ekoome pɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa.
Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaahao gbɔmɔ kome kɛyashi?
Kɛyaashi mɛɛ be po, nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛaatswia lɛ nii, mɔ ko ni tamɔ gbogbo loo afabaŋ ni ekpa kɛyaagbee shi lɛ?
Eyi nɔ ajina sɔŋŋ amɛyaa koni amɛkpa lɛ ni egbojee aŋmɛɛ lɛ.
Amɛnyaa amale he; amɛkɛ amɛnaabu jɔɔ, shi amɛlomɔɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ji mɔ ni misusuma efee kpoo emɛɔ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Lɛ ekoome ji mitɛsaa kɛ miyiwalaheremɔ, mimɔɔ ni wa.
Mididaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ miyiwalaheremɔ kɛ minunyam jɛɔ; mitɛsaa ni wa kɛ mibobaahe ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nyɛ maŋbii, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔ̃a Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be; nyɛfɔsea nyɛtsuiiaŋ saji fɛɛ nyɛshwiea ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔbobaahe.
Mɛi bibii fɛɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, mɛi wuji hu jeee fɛifɛi kɛji aŋmɛ amɛ yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛtsiii.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsiimɔ shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, amɛtamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a amimyeli nɔ; nyɛyitsei hu akafũa yɛ juukɛfɔ̃ nibii agbɛfaŋ.
Kɛji nii ni nyɛna miifa tete lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛtsuii akafɔ̃a nɔ.
Minu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ fe shii abɔ akɛ Lɛ edɛŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo oyɔɔ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee, ejaakɛ owoɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔi anaa.
Shwee ni gbɔmɔ shweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ David Lala be mli ni eyɔɔ Judah ŋa lɛ mli.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, miitao bo!
Misusuma miiye ohe kumai, migbɔmɔtso miishwe bo, tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbi keketee shweɔ nu.
Nɛkɛ mikwɛ bo gbɛ yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni mana ohewalɛ kɛ onunyam lɛ.
Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni hi fe wala tete po hewɔ lɛ makafo bo.
Bei abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, majie oyi; mahole miniji anɔ masɔle matsɛ bo.
Misusumɔ aaaye wuiaŋ fɔ etɔ, ni minaabu aaala miishɛɛ lala kɛjie oyi.
Kɛji mikai bo yɛ misaa nɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ ohe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ bo ji miyelikɛbualɔ daa, ni ofiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛŋ mala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ.
Misusuma kpɛtɛ bo gbagbalii, ni oninejurɔ hiɛ mimli tswɛ.
Shi mɛi ni taoɔ misusuma hiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ, aaaya gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ.
Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei aaatsɔ̃mɔ ŋaŋgbei anaa loo.
Shi maŋtsɛ lɛ aaanya yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi mli aaanya, ejaakɛ aaahã amalelɔi amua amɛnaa.
Hebuu he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo migbee toi, yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ mli.
Gbeyei ni misheɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ baamɔ miwala yi.
Ŋɔɔ mi otee yɛ ajina fɔŋ ni efɔŋfeelɔi yaa yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ hewɔ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔi ayiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ klante; amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ni joɔ gbulɔɔ mi tamɔ gãimlibii.
Amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ɔ amɛwiemɔi lɛ kɛjɛɔ amɛteemɔhe lɛ amɛtswiaa mɔ ni eye emuu lɛ; amɛtsɛ̃rɛ̃ɔ lɛ amɛgãi lɛ trukaa, ni amɛsheee gbeyei.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsuii yɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ nɛɛ mli; amɛkpɛɔ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi atsɔne yɛ teemɔ mli; ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ po aaana wɔ?” Namɔ aaanyɛ ajie nishaianii ni wɔfee wɔtee lɛ kpo?
Wɔkɛ ŋaa kpɛ mli jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ kwɔ, ni etsui mli hu ewo duŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ amɛ gãi, ni eeepila amɛ trukaa.
Ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛlilɛi hewɔ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ lɛ aaahoso amɛyitso.
Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kwa aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛaagba nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu lɛ; ni amɛaasusu enifeemɔnii lɛ he.
Hã jalɔi lɛ anya yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni amɛba lɛ abo!
Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ anya.
Yijiemɔ kɛ shidaa David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, esa akɛ ajieɔ oyi yɛ Zion; ni bo abaaye shiwoi anɔ ahã!
Oo, bo ni oboɔ sɔlemɔ toi, bo oŋɔɔ adesai fɛɛ baa.
Kɛji wɔnishaianii miipiŋ wɔ lɛ, bo okɛfaa wɔ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ohala ni ohãa ebɛŋkɛɔ bo, koni ehi ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Wɔɔtɔrɔ kɛ owe lɛŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ, ni ji oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ nibii lɛ.
Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ onifeemɔ nii ni yɔɔ gbeyei anɔ ohereɔ wɔyiwala!
Bo ji shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋshɔ sɛɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Bo mɔ ni ojɛ ohewalɛ kpele lɛ mli obɔ gɔji lɛ, ohã amɛmamɔ shi shiŋŋ kɛ hewalɛ.
Bo ji mɔ ni ojɔɔ ŋshɔhũumɔ he, kɛ ŋshɔkei ahũumɔ he, ni ojɔɔ adesai ahoofeemɔ hu he.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ lɛ sheɔ naakpɛɛ nii ni ofeɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Onifeemɔnii lɛ hãa anyaa yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ohãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni odɔɔ ehe ohãa, ni ebaa nii babaoo.
Nyɔŋmɔ faa lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ nu.
Ohãa abele baa hãa gbɔmɛi, ejaakɛ nakai ji bɔ ni oto.
Oshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akofii lɛ anɔ nu babaoo, ni ohãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ su kukulii lɛ kpɔtɔɔ.
Ohãa nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ, ni emli jɔɔ, ni ebaa nii.
Omlihilɛ hãa afi lɛ yiɔ obɔ kɛ niyenii babaoo.
He fɛɛ he ni oootsɔ̃ kɛho lɛ, niyenii babaoo baa jɛi.
Ŋa nɔ jwɛi fũɔ babaoo, ni gɔji lɛ nyaa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ŋa nɔ jwɛi fɔ lɛ ewula kɛ too kui ni jɔi lɛ hu ewula kɛ abele; amɛmiibɔ oshe, ni amɛmiila kɛ miishɛɛ.
Yijiemɔ kɛ shidaa he lala David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ abɔa oshe nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ!
Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa enunyam gbɛi lɛ; nyɛkɛ yijiemɔ ni sa lɛ lɛ awoa ehiɛ nyam.
Nyɛkɛa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ gbeyei pam!
Ohewalɛ lɛ dalɛ naa sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, ohenyɛlɔi kotoɔ bo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.
Hã je lɛŋ bii fɛɛ kwa aja bo, amɛla kɛjie oyi, amɛla kɛkafo ogbɛi lɛ.” Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu, naakpɛɛnii ni etsu yɛ gbɔmɛi abii ateŋ!
Ehã ŋshɔ tsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, ni wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ nyiɛ nɔ kɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ.
Jɛi wɔnya yɛ, yɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Eeye maŋtsɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni ehiŋmɛii kã majimaji fɛɛ ahe.
Atuatselɔi akawo amɛhe nɔ!
Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi!
Nyɛhãa anua eyijiemɔ gbɛɛmɔ he.
Lɛ ehã wɔhiɛ kã nɛɛ, ni eŋmɛko gbɛ ni wɔshane tete.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, oka wɔ okwɛ; bɔ ni akaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ lɛ nakai oka wɔ okwɛ.
Ohã wɔyadu yaa, ni okɛ jatsui ni tsiitsii tere wɔ.
Ohã wɔhenyɛlɔi naanaa wɔnɔ; wɔtsɔ̃mɔ la kɛ fai amli, shi ojie wɔ kɛba he ni wɔfee shweshweeshwe yɛ.
Mikɛ shãa afɔlei aaaba owe lɛ; mibaye mishiwoi anɔ mahã bo!
Mikɛ nibii ni je minaa ni miwo bo shi yɛ he, be mli ni miyɔɔ haomɔŋ lɛ, aaaba!
Mikɛ gwantɛŋi ni ewo fɔ aaashã shãa afɔle; ni ojwɛnii ni akɛshãa afɔle lɛ alasu lɛ aaakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi.
Mikɛ tsina hii kɛ abotiai hu aaashã afɔle.
Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni magba nyɛ nɔ ni efee ehã mi!
Mibo waa mitsɛ lɛ, mikafo lɛ kɛ mililɛi!
Eji minya nɔ sha ko he yɛ mitsuiŋ kulɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ boŋ mi toi.
Shi anɔkwa, Nyɔŋmɔ ebo mi toi, efee toi ehã misɔlemɔ lɛ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ etswaaa misɔlemɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ, ni ehãaa esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ abɔ mi.
Shidaa lala David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ana wɔ mɔbɔ, ni ejɔɔ wɔ, ni efee wɔ ejurɔ koni je lɛ fɛɛ ale osuɔmɔnaanii koni majimaji fɛɛ ale oyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ!
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ ajie oyi; hã adesai fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!
Hã majimaji lɛ amii ashɛ amɛhe, koni amɛla kɛ miishɛɛ; ejaakɛ okojoɔ majimaji lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni otsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji lɛ agbɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hã adesãi ajie oyi, hã adesãi fɛɛ kwa ajie oyi!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ eba enii.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ wɔ!
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ aya nɔ ajɔɔ wɔ!
Hã adesãi ni yɔɔ je lɛŋ hei fɛɛ awo lɛ.
Jakumaŋ kunimyeli he lala David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, ni egbɛɔ ehenyɛlɔi eshwãa.
Mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ joɔ enaa foi.
Bɔ ni ahuuɔ lasu kɛyaa lɛ, nakai ehuuɔ amɛ kɛyaa; bɔ ni wo agbaku sereɔ yɛ la he lɛ, nakai mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛ kpãtãa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi jalɔi lɛ nyaa, ni amɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; amɛmli filiɔ amɛ kɛ nyamɔ!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi.
Nyɛjea gbɛ nyɛhãa mɔ ni ta shwiili mli kɛbaa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Egbɛi ji Yehowa; nyɛnyãa yɛ ehiɛ!
Awusaiatsɛ kɛ okulafoi ahebulɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hãa mɔ kome mɔ lɛ shihilɛhe.
Ekpalaa gboklɛfoi, ni ehãa amɛyeɔ ejurɔ; shi atuatselɔi lɛ, shikpɔŋ gbiŋ keketee nɔ amɛhiɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni onyiɛ owebii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, be ni otsɔ̃ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ŋwɛi nɛ nu shwie shi, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ bo Sinai Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso yɛ bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ohiɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ohã nu babaoo nɛ, ni okɛtsĩɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ hiɛ ohã owebii ni etɔ biti lɛ.
Owebii lɛ na shihilɛhe yɛ jɛi.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, omlihilɛ naa lɛ, osaa nibii kpakpai ohã mɛi ni ehĩa amɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã, ni yei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ gbɛ kunimyeli wiemɔ lɛ shwã.
“Naa, tai lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ejo foi, amɛjwa saŋ!” Yei ni ashi yɛ shĩaŋ lɛ, ja haanii lɛ; tsɛbelɛ too kui lɛ anɔ amɛkwɛ.
Nibii ni amɛha lɛ ji okpo fiji ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi, kɛ etsɛji ni akɛ shika fɛɛfɛo eha he.
Be ni Ofe lɛ gbɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ shwã yɛ Zalmon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, snoo nɛ jɛi.
Oo Bashan Gɔŋ kpeteŋkple!
Gɔŋ kɛ onɔ gɔŋkpɔi gojogojoo.
Mɛɛba ojɛɔ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ okɛ hiŋmɛitsuu kwɛɔ gɔŋ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ akɛ ehi jɛi lɛ?
Yehowa baahi jɛi kɛya naanɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ Sinai eba He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ kɛ tayaa shwiilii wuji akpe toi akpei abɔ.
Okwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ grɔŋŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nomii ni nyiɛ osɛɛ, ohe nikee kɛjɛ mɛi, mɛi tete ni te shi wo bo lɛ adɛŋ, Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, baahi jɛi.
Ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, mɔ ni hiɛ wɔmli daa lɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni hereɔ mɔ yiwala ni.
Lɛ ji Yehowa, wɔNuŋtsɔ, ni hereɔ wɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele mli lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaajwara ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ayitsei, mɛi ni baa jeŋ fɔŋ ni amɛto amɛyi kusukusuu lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibakpala amɛ kɛaajɛ Bashan kɛba ekoŋŋ; mibakpala amɛ kɛaajɛ ŋshɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛba ekoŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ amɛlá afɔ nyɛnaji ahe, koni nyɛgbei ana henyɛlɔi lɛ alá amɛlɛmɔ.” Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, anaa oyaakɛbaa kpoo lɛ, MiNyɔŋmɔ, miMaŋtsɛ lɛ, nyiɛmɔ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yaa lɛ, anaa.
Lalɔi lɛ nyiɛ hiɛ, saŋkutswalɔi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, ni oblayei ni shaa fabii lɛ nyiɛ teŋ.
Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ asafo kpele lɛ mli.
Oo, nyɛ Yakob shwiei, nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi.
Benyamin, amɛteŋ gbekɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, nyiɛ hiɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ amɛsafoi lɛ; ni Zebulon lumɛi lɛ kɛ Naftali lumɛi lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ohewalɛ lɛ, hewalɛ ni okɛtsu nii ohã wɔ pɛŋ lɛ.
OSɔlemɔ we ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi tereɔ nikeenii amɛkɛbahãa bo.
Kã Ijipt hiɛ; nakai ŋaŋ kooloo ni hɔ glãi lɛ amli lɛ.
Kã majimaji lɛ ni lɛɔ tsina hii kɛ tsinabii lɛ kɛyashi amɛ fɛɛ amɛaakoto bo, ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi aaahã bo.
Gbɛɛ majimaji lɛ ni sumɔɔ ta lɛ oshwã.
Hã lumɛi kɛ akɔɔble ajɛ Ijipt aba; ni Kushbii ahe afee oya ni amɛhole amɛniji anɔ ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ.
Oo, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ!
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, mɔ ni taa okpɔŋɔ nɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Nyɛboa toi, ewoɔ egbee, egbee ni wa lɛ.
Nyɛshiɛa Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ, mɔ ni egbojee teke Israel agbojee, ni ehewalɛ lɛ yɔɔ atatui lɛ amli lɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ he yɛ gbeyei kɛji eeba kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ehãa ewebii ahewalɛ ni ewoɔ amɛ ekãa.
Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi!
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ miyiwala, shi nu lɛ ebata misɛ̃!
Miishiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ ni mli kwɔ ni shidaamɔhe bɛ mli mli.
Miyaje nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ mli, ni nu lɛ miisu mi.
Etɔ mi kɛ blɔmɔ, ni misɛŋ egbi.
Mikwɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛ aahu; agbɛnɛ mihiŋmɛii eshiu.
Mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ, amɛyi fa fe miyiteŋ tsɔi; mihenyɛlɔi ni maleɔ mihe, mɛi ni taoɔ mihiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ amɛyi fa.
Nɔ ni mijuko lɛ aso esa akɛ mato najiaŋ lo?
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ole mikwashiafeemɔ; tɔ̃mɔi ni mitɔ̃ lɛ, akɛteko bo.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, kaahã mɛi ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ ahiɛ miigboi yɛ mi, mihewɔ.
Oo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, kaahã mɛi ni jaa bo lɛ ahiɛ miishwie shi yɛ mi mihewɔ.
Bo ohewɔ ni abɔ mi ahora, ni mihiɛ egbo kpɔtɔɔ nɛɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ gbɔ mihã miwekumɛi, kɛ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ minyɛbii ateŋ, ejaakɛ owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ tsoɔ yɛ mimli tamɔ la; ni ahorai ni mɛi bɔɔ bo lɛ ebashwie minɔ.
Kɛji mifo, ni mikɛ ŋmaahilɛ piŋ misusuma po, no hu tsɔ̃ɔ ahorabɔɔ hãa mi.
Kɛji mibu kpekpe po, amɛboɔ mi “tsia!” Nɔyelɔi kɛ kojolɔi yɛ koishi, tãa mihe sane ni dãatɔlɔi tete foɔ mihe lala.
Oo Yehowa, shi mi lɛ, masɔle matsɛ bo.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni sa mli lɛ, jɛɛ osuɔmɔ kpeteŋkple ni tsakeee lɛ naa ohã mi hetoo.
Yɛ onɔkwayeli naa lɛ heremɔ mi koni mikashiu yɛ ŋmiamɔ lɛ mli.
Heremɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi adɛŋ, kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ hu mli.
Kaahã nu lɛ miisu mi, kaahã mishiu yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, loo gbonyobu miimi mi.
Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ, yɛ osuɔmɔ kpakpa ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Omɔbɔnalɛ ni fa babaoo lɛ naa lɛ, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã mi.
Okɛ ohiɛ akatee otsulɔ, ejaakɛ miyɛ jaramɔ mli, heremɔ mi nɔ mra.
Tsi obɛŋkɛ mi ni okpɔ̃ mi; mihenyɛlɔi ahewɔ lɛ, heremɔ mi.
Ole ahora ni abɔɔ mi, mihiɛgbele kɛ mihe guɔ ni egbo lɛ.
Ole mihenyɛlɔi fɛɛ.
Ahorabɔɔ ehã mitsui ekumɔ, ni ehã miyoyoro.
Mikwɛ mɔbɔnalɛ gbɛ, shi eko baaa; mikwɛ miishɛjelɔi hu gbɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa.
Amɛhãa mi ebɔɔ akɛ niyenii, ni be ni kumai ye mi lɛ amɛhã mi ashiŋ akɛ minu.
Hã okplɔ̃ ni amɛŋmɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ tsɔne ahã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛgbiijuji anɔ niyenii lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa ahã amɛ.
Hã amɛhiŋmɛii anɔ afee kusuu koni amɛkana nii; ni ohã amɛhɛ agbɔjɔ be fɛɛ be.
Fɔsemɔ omlila lɛ oshwie amɛnɔ, ni okɛ omlifu ni naa wa lɛ anina amɛ.
Amɛshitoohe atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kaahã mɔ ko miihi amɛbui amli.
Ejaakɛ amɛwaa mɔ ni otswia lɛ nii momo lɛ yi; ni mɔ ni opila lɛ momo lɛ, amɛyaa nɔ amɛpiŋɔ lɛ.
Too amɛtoigbalamɔ lɛ nɔ ohã amɛ; amɛkaye amɛhe kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ!
Hã agbe amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli; akaŋmala amɛgbɛii ashi jalɔi anɔ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, apila mi, ni miipiŋ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo minɔ koni ohere miyiwala.
Mikɛ lala aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ yi!
Mikɛ shidaa aaakafo lɛ!
Enɛ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ pam fe tsina oblayoo, loo tsinanuu kɛ eklontoi.
Hã mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ana koni amɛmii ashɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛ mli; ejaakɛ Yehowa boɔ ohiafoi atoi, ni enyaŋeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ gboklɛ mli lɛ.
Hã ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔi kɛ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ajie eyi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baahere Zion yiwala, ni eeesaa Yuda maji wuji lɛ ema; etsuji lɛ aaahi amɛmli, ni eeetsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃ etsuji lɛ ashwiei anɔ, ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ aaahi amɛmli.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala kɛha kaimɔ afɔleshaa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ heremɔ miyiwala!
Oo Yehowa, ye obua mi nɔŋŋ!
Hã mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ ashwie shi.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã ashwie amɛ koni amɛhe guɔ agbo.
Hã mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, Yiɛ!” lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.
Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni taoɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ anya; ni amɛmli afili amɛ yɛ ohewɔ.
Hã mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ akɛɛ daa akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ je agbo.” Shi mi lɛ, minii yɛ mɔbɔ, ni efĩ mi.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ba miŋɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.
Bo ji mibualɔ kɛ miherelɔ!
Oo Yehowa, kaatsɛ kwraa!
Nuumo ko sɔlemɔ Oo Yehowa, bo abo mibaa; kaahã mihiɛ miigbo gbi ko gbi ko!
Akɛni jalɔ ji bo hewɔ lɛ, ye obua mi koni ohere mi.
Ba otoi shi ohã mi ni ohere miyiwala.
Tsɔ̃ abobaa tɛkplo ohã mi, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa ni okɛhere miyiwala, ejaakɛ mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ ji bo!
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi yɛ yiwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ, yɛ nɔshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ yitsoŋwalɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji mihiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Oo Yehowa, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ.
Bo mikpasa kɛjɛ fɔmɔ mli.
Bo nɔŋŋ obu mihe be mli ni afɔɔ mi.
Bo oyi majie daa.
Mitsɔ̃ naakpɛɛ nɔ ko mihã mɛi pii; ejaakɛ bo ji mibobaahe ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe.
Midaa eyi obɔ̃ kɛ oyijiemɔ gbi muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni majaje onunyam lɛ.
Kaashɛ mi ofɔ̃ yɛ migbɔlɛ beiaŋ; kaakwa mi be ni migbɔjɔɔ, ejaakɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ wie mihe; mɛi ni taoɔ mi agbe lɛ yaa miyinɔ apam, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ekwa lɛ; nyɛtiua lɛ, ni nyɛmɔa lɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere lɛ.” Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi teŋ akajekɛ!
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ mi nɔŋŋ!
Hã mɛi ni foɔ sane fɔ̃ɔ minɔ lɛ ahiɛ agboi, ni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.
Mɛi ni taoɔ mi efɔŋ lɛ, hã amɛhiɛ ashwie shi, ni amɛhe guɔ agbo; kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ, mihiɛ aaakã onɔ daa, ni majie oyi kɛteke nɔ.
Minaabu aaagba jalɛ nibii ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ oyiwalaheremɔ nifeemɔi lɛ gbi muu fɛɛ; tsɛbelɛ mijwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.
Maba mabagba naakpɛɛnii wuji ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efee lɛ; mibakafo bo okoome too ojalɛ lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ; ni miijaje onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ lolo.
Belɛ migbɔlɛ kɛ miwaŋjee nɛɛ mli lɛ, Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, kaakwa mi, kɛyaashi majaje ohewalɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ojalɛ kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ kwɔ kɛshɛɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, bo ofee nibii wuji osaso bɛ.
Bo mɔ ni ohã mina amanehului babaoo ni jaraa lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ ooowo mi hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ooojie mi kɛje gbonyo bu mli, ni okɛ mi aaaba kpo nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ooohã minunyam afa, ni oooshɛje mimii ekoŋŋ.
Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, matswa saŋku hu mikɛjie oyi yɛ onɔkwayeli hewɔ.
Oo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ matswa obenta mikɛkafo bo.
Be ni milaa mijieɔ oyi lɛ minaabu kɛ misusuma ni okpɔ̃ lɛ, aaanya babaoo.
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, mililɛi aaagba ojalɛ, mɔyelikɛbuamɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni ka mi efɔŋ feemɔ lɛ, awo amɛ hiɛgbele, ni amɛhiɛ eshwie shi.
Sɔlemɔ hã maŋtsɛ lɛ Solomon lala nɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, koni ekɛ ojalɛ akojo; ni otsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛbi lɛ ojalɛ saneyeli lɛ.
Hã ekojo omaŋ lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa koni eye jalɛ sane ehã omɛi ni ji ohiafoi.
Hã hejɔlɛ ajɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ aba ahã omaŋ lɛ; ni jalɛ sane ajɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ anɔ aba.
Efã maŋbii ohiafoi lɛ ahe, ehere ohiafoi ayiwala; ni wieyelɔ lɛ, ekpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.
Amɛshe bo gbeyei gbii abɔ ni hulu yɔɔ nɛɛ; amɛshe bo gbeyei gbii abɔ ni nyɔɔŋtsere yɔɔ nɛɛ yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ kwa mli.
Maŋtsɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni nɛɔ jwɛi ni ashwao nɔ; etsɔ̃ tamɔ futufuli ni shwãa shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli ashwere yɛ elumɔyeli be lɛŋ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ aba babaoo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɔɔŋtsere bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Elumɔyeli aaahe shi kɛaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa; kɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbeehei kɛ̃.
Shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii aaakoto lɛ, ni ehenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛ amɛhe aaakoklo shi yɛ mlu mli.
Tarshish kɛ ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsu onia abahã lɛ.
Sheba kɛ Seba maŋtsɛmɛi aaabake nii.
Maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaakoto lɛ, majimaji fɛɛ kwa aaasɔmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekpɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ kɛji ebolɔ etsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekpɔ̃ɔ ohiafo kɛ mɛi ni bɛ yelikɛbualɔ ko.
Enaa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɔ ni efĩ lɛ lɛ mɔbɔ, ni ehereɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ yiwala.
Ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ yiwalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ mli; amɛwala jara wa yɛ ehiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ yi ana wala!
Ajɛ Sheba abake lɛ shika!
Asɔle ahã lɛ be fɛɛ be; ni aba jɔɔmɔ ahã lɛ jenamɔ tuu.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ aba abele babaoo kɛyashwie gɔji lɛ anɔ; eba nii tamɔ Lebanon.
Gbɔmɛi afrɔke yɛ maji lɛ amli tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛi ahe shi kɛya naanɔ; gbii abɔ ni hulu yɔɔ nɛɛ, enunyam akagbo.
Gbɔmɛi aaanya yɛ ehewɔ; ni majimaji fɛɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ.
Ajie Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, yi!
Lɛ ekoome too efeɔ naakpɛɛnii.
Ajie enunyam gbɛi lɛ yi kɛya naanɔ!
Jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ayi tɔ kɛ enunyam lɛ!
Amen!
