David, Ishai bi lɛ, sɔlemɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ.
WOLO NI JI ETƐ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ saneyeli Asaf lala ko.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hi hã Israel; ehi ehã mɛi ni atsuiiaŋ tse lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ eshwɛ shrao ni minane atɔ̃tɔ̃; shwɛ shrao kulɛ mishane.
Ejaakɛ be ni mina bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji eshwere lɛ, mihiɛ kɔ̃ yiwalɔi lɛ aninamɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛbɛ piŋmɔ ko lɛ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ.
Adesãi ahaomɔ lɛ eko kwraa gbaaa amɛnaa lɛ, amɛpiŋŋ tamɔ adesãi krokomɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, hewoo etsɔ̃ kuɛnii ni amɛwo, ni yiwaa ji amɛhebo.
Fɔ sɔŋŋ ehã amɛhiŋmɛii ekɛ̃lɛ̃ emamɔ shi; amɛtsuii eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ kwashiaianii.
Amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe fɛo, ni nishaianii he amɛwieɔ; amɛfaa amɛhe amɛwieɔ, ni mɛi apiŋmɔ pɛ he amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Amɛhãa amɛnaa yasaa Nyɔŋmɔ tete he; amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi ekpele shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ; hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ekpale kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛkafoɔ amɛ; ni amɛnaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Te Nyɔŋmɔ aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ele hu?
Ani Ŋwɛinyo lɛ aaale?” Naa, bɔ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ nɛ: Daa nɛɛ amɛhe ejɔ amɛ, ni nii lɛ, na kɛkɛ amɛnaa.
Yakatswaa po mihiɛ mitsuiŋ keŋkeŋ, ni miwooo miniji ahe muji kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ ko lɛ.
Minaa nɔ daa jenamɔ, ni agbalaa mitoi daa leebi.
Eji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mawie nɛkɛ” kulɛ, miyeŋ owebii lɛ ashwiei lɛ anɔkwa.
Shi be ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ misusu he koni manu sane lɛ shishi lɛ, mina akɛ ewa tsɔ̃ hã mi.
Kɛyashi mibote Nyɔŋmɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ, dani mina bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ hã.
Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ okɛ amɛ eto hei ni shamɔɔ trotro; ohãa amɛtswiaa shi, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa.
Amɛhiɛ kpãtãa shwiaa, ni ŋmiŋmi loɔ amɛ kɛyaa kwrakwra.
Amɛtamɔ lamɔ ni alaa.
Kɛji hiɛ tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛjeee fɛifɛi dɔŋŋ.
Be ni edɔ mi, ni mitsui mli shã mi lɛ, asomoaŋ kwashia mifee lɛ, ni mileee nii.
Mitamɔ kooloo yɛ ohiɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ miyɛ omasɛi daa, ni ohiɛ mininejurɔ mli.
Okɛ oŋaawoo tsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ; ni kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ ooohere mi owo onunyam mli.
Namɔ miyɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi fe bo?
Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ bo osɛɛ.
Miheloo kɛ mitsui aaagbɔjɔ nɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mitsui hewalɛ kɛ migbɛfaŋnɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni ekwa bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaakpãtã.
Okpãtãa mɛi ni yeee bo anɔkwa lɛ ahiɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ masɛi hilɛ hi hã mi.
Mikɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee mibobaahe, bɔ ni afee ni magba onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Maŋkpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ Asaf lala ko ni atswa yɛ kpaa saŋku nɔ yɛ Maskil gbɛjianɔtoo naa lɛ.
Oo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba oshɛrɛ wɔ oshwie kwraa nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba omlifu lɛ jɛleɔ woɔ olɛɛhe lɛ toi nɛɛ?
Kaimɔ osafo ni oŋɔ fee onɔ kɛjɛ blema lɛ!
Kaimɔ Zion Gɔŋ, he ni obahiɔ lɛ.
Dɔɔ ohe kɛya naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli.
Henyɛlɔ lɛ efite nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ lɛ.
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ebɔ kunimyeli oshe yɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛŋ; amɛshi amɛflaŋaai yɛ jɛi akɛ kunimyeli he okadi.
Amɛkɛ lemai miikumɔ yiteŋgbɛ agbo lɛ he tsei lɛ; ni agbo lɛ tsei ni ayeyee samai awo he lɛ, amɛkɛ lemai kɛ hamle ekumɔ.
Ni amɛma Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni amɛbule he ni ajaa bo yɛ lɛ kwrakwra.
Amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Wɔbaaye amɛnɔ kɛwula shi.” Amɛshãshãa Nyɔŋmɔ kpeehei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Wɔnaaa wɔkadii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ!
Gbalɔ ko gbalɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ wɔteŋ ni ele bɔ ni sane nɛɛ naa aaayakpa ahã.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni henyɛlɔ lɛ aaabɔ ahora kɛyashi?
Ani henyɛlɔ lɛ aaagbe ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ kɛaaya naanɔ lo?
Mɛɛba osu onine?
Mɛɛba osu ohewalɛ ninejurɔ lɛ owo omlishi?
Kɛ̃lɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mimaŋtsɛ lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ yiwalaheremɔ nitsumɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ogba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ ohewalɛ naa; ojwara ŋshɔŋ bonsoi lɛ ayitsei.
Ojwara kooloo leviatan lɛ yitsei lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ; ni oŋɔ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ohã ŋaŋ kooloi koni amɛye.
Ohã nuhiŋmɛii kɛ faa niji tue; ni ohã faa ni hoɔ daa lɛ ŋala.
Shwane lɛ onɔ ni, ni nyɔɔŋ hu onɔ ni.
Bo obɔ ŋulamii kɛ hulu.
Bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ fɛɛ; bo obɔ latsaa be kɛ fɛ̃i be fɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni henyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ bo ahora amɛhãa; kɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ gbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ.
Kaaŋmɛɛ omɛi ni ahe waaa lɛ ahe ohã kooloi kakawuai lɛ; ohiɛ akakpa omɛi nɔnalɔi lɛ anɔ kwraa.
Ohiɛ akakpa okpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei ni ewowoo duŋ lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ.
Kaahã mɔ ni awaa lɛ yi lɛ hiɛ miishwie shi.
Hã ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ fɛɛ ajie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wo ohe nɔ koni ofã ohe.
Kaimɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei bɔɔ bo ahora gbi muu fɛɛ.
Ohiɛ akakpa ohenyɛlɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ, amɛhoofeemɔ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi be fɛɛ be lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji kojolɔ Asaf lala ko ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔmiida bo shi!
Wɔmiida bo shi!
Ejaakɛ obɛŋkɛ wɔ; wɔgbaa onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
“Kɛji be ni mito lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibakojo yɛ jalɛ naa.
Kɛji je lɛ hoso kɛ enɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ lɛ, mi, mihiɛ ekulashii lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ.” Mikɛɔ mɛi ni shwãa lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashwãa!” Ni mikɛɔ yiwalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkafea ntɛŋ; nyɛkafea ntɛŋ kwraa, nyɛkawiea kɛ kuɛŋtilɛ.” Ejaakɛ kojomɔ jɛɛɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ anaigbɛ; asaŋ ejɛɛɛ ŋanɔgbɛ hu ebaaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji kojolɔ!
Ebaa mɔ ko shi, ni ewoɔ mɔ ko nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa hiɛ kpulu ko yɛ edɛŋ kɛ emli wain kpakpa ni miitswa afui.
Ebaafo eko ehã, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yiwalɔi lɛ fɛɛ baanu; amɛaashoo wain lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, mibanya kɛaatee naanɔ.
Mala majie Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Ebaaba yiwalɔi ahewalɛi fɛɛ shi; shi jalɔi ahewalɛ lɛ ebaawo nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji kunimyelɔ Asaf Lala ni ekɛha lalatsɛ nukpa ni akɛ kpaa saŋku atswa.
Ale Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Yuda!
Egbɛi tsii yɛ Israel.
Eshihilɛhe yɛ Salem, ni Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ.
Jɛi ekumɔ henyɛlɔ lɛ gãimlibii lɛ kɛ tsɛŋi lɛ kɛ klantei lɛ kɛ tawuu nibii lɛ amli yɛ.
Ohiɛ yɛ nyam, ni ogbojee kwɔ fe naanɔ gɔji lɛ.
Nibii fɛɛ ni hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ha lɛ, ashɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ; tabilɔi lɛ gboi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ enine nɔ ewo ekɛfã ehe.
Oo Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, oŋa amɛyi, okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ fɛɛ tswia shi ni amɛgboi.
Shi bo lɛ, ohe yɛ gbeyei naakpa.
Kɛji omli efu lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ ohiɛ adamɔ?
Ojɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ obu atɛŋ; je lɛ she gbeyei ni efee diŋŋ, be ni Bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, ote shi okojo kɛhere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔnalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ adesã mlila tete aaajie oyi.
Mɛi ni aaaje gbele mli yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ, aaaye ogbii juji lɛ.
Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ni nyɛyea nyɛshiwoi lɛ anɔ.
Nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ kɛ nikeenii abahã, mɔ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei naakpa lɛ, lɛ mɔ ni ebaa lumɛi ashi, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.
Miishɛjemɔ yɛ jaramɔ be mli Asaf lala ko ni atswa yɛ Jeduthun gbɛjianɔtoo naa lɛ.
Mibolɔɔ waa mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ waa akɛ ebo mi toi!
Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, mitaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, miholeɔ miniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli, ni etɔɔɔ mi; misusuma ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ.
Kɛji misusu Nyɔŋmɔ he lɛ, midɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi; ni kɛji mishwie miyiŋ lɛ, mimumɔ tɔɔ biti.
Okɔ wɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛi mli; haomɔ sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɛɛ mawie.
Mijwɛŋɔ blema gbii lɛ ahe, ni mikaiɔ teteete afii lɛ hu.
Mitaoɔ mitsuiŋ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; mishwieɔ miyiŋ, ni mikpaa mimli.
“Aso Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpooɔ mɔ kɛyaa naanɔ, ni enaŋ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ lo?
Aso esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa kɛmiiya naanɔ lo?
Aso eshiwoi lɛ hu asɛɛ efo kɛmiiya naanɔ lo?
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ekpa edromɔ lɛ nɔ lo?
Aso emlifu ehã ekpa mɔ mɔbɔnalɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Midɔlɛ sane ji akɛ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hewalɛ lɛ etsake.” Mibakai Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ!
Hɛɛ!
Mibakai oblema naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
Majwɛŋ onitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahe; masusu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ahe.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛ lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko je agbo tamɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ?
Bo ji Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsuɔ naakpɛɛ nii, Bo mɔ ni ohã ana ohewalɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Okpɔ̃ owebii ni ji Yakob shwiei kɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, be ni nu lɛ na bo!
Hɛɛ be ni nu lɛ na bo, eshe gbeyei; Ni, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ kpokpo kɛtee eshishi tɔ̃ɔ.
Atatui lɛ nɛ nu shwie shi, ni ŋwɛi shimɔ, ni srawai gbala yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Oŋwɛi shiimɔ lɛ gbɛɛ kɛnyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛho, ni osrawai kpɛlɛ ni je lɛ mli tse, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpokpo, ni ehoso.
Ofo ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ.
Onyiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkei lɛ amli; shi anaaa onanemaamɔhei.
Otsɔ̃ Mose kɛ Aaron nɔ, okpala omaŋbii lɛ tamɔ akpalaa tooku.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii lɛ Asaf lala ko.
Oo mimaŋ, nyɛboa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ atoi; nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ!
Magbele minaa mawie yɛ abɛbuaiaŋ, magbala blema teemɔŋ saji amli, nii ni wɔnu, ni wɔle, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gba wɔ lɛ.
Wɔshiuŋ amɛbii lɛ saji lɛ ekoeko nɔ; shi wɔɔgba yinɔbii ni baa lɛ Yehowa anunyam nitsumɔi lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ naakpɛɛ nii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.
Ewo mlai ehã Yakob shwiei kɛ akpɔi ehã Israelbii.
Ewo amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii mlai nɛɛ; bɔ ni afee ni nyɛbii ni baaba lɛ ana ale nii nɛɛ; bii ni anako afɔ tete, koni amɛ hu amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛbii.
Ewo mlai nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ afɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, koni amɛhiɛ akakpa Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ, shi amɛye ekitãi lɛ anɔ, koni amɛkatamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi kaniŋkajelɔi kɛ yinɔbii atuatselɔi lɛ, yinɔbii ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli fiii shi kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ.
Tawuu gbi lɛ, Efraimbii ni emia kɛ gãi lɛ jo foi.
Amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaaba amɛjeŋ yɛ emla lɛ naa.
Amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni etsu kɛ naakpɛɛnii ni efee etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Egba ŋshɔ lɛŋ, ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛho; ni ehã ŋshɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni ma shi.
Shwane lɛ ekɛ atatu tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ la gboŋaa tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ.
Ehã tɛsai amli gbalagbalai yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛ nu babaoo ni jɛ shikpɔŋ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ amɛnu.
Ehã nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ tɛsaa lɛŋ, ni ehã nu ho tamɔ faa.
Shi amɛkã he amɛfee esha amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛtse Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ kɛ niyenii ni baa amɛtsine ni amɛbi lɛ.
Amɛwie amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkɛɛ: “Ani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ lo?
Etswa tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛi tsɛ̃ kɛjɛ mli; ni eyi kɛteke nɔ etsɔ̃ faa tete.
Ani eeenyɛ niyenii hu eduro, aloo ehã emaŋ lɛ loo lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yehowa nu lɛ, emli fu naakpa eje la ewo Israel he; emlifu te shi ewo Israel naakpa, ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ eyiwalaheremɔ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ efã ŋwɛi, ni egbele ŋwɛi agboi lɛ anaa, ni enɛ mana eshwie amɛnɔ koni amɛye; ehã amɛ ŋwɛiŋmãa lɛ eko.
Gbɔmɔ adesã ye ŋwɛi bɔfoi aniyenii; ehã amɛ niyenii babaoo amɛye amɛtɔrɔ.
Ehã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa yɛ ŋwɛi, ehã wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
Enɛ loo eshwie amɛnɔ tamɔ mlu; enɛ loofɔji hu tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia.
Ehã loofɔji lɛ shwie shi yɛ amɛshitoohe lɛ teŋ kɛbɔle amɛwɔɔhei lɛ.
Amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ kɛteke nɔ, ejaakɛ ehã amɛ nɔ ni baa amɛtsine lɛ.
Shi amɛtsinebaanii lɛ nako eje amɛtsine, amɛmiiye nii lɛ lolo, kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ te shi wo amɛ, ni egbe amɛteiaŋ oblaŋi lɛ, ni ji Israel oblahii kãkãlɔi lɛ.
Enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛkã he amɛfee esha; enaakpɛɛnii lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛheee lɛ amɛyeee.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛwala sɛɛ fo tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ; amɛfii lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ haomɔ.
Kɛ egbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, fãbii lɛ taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ; amɛshwaa amɛhe, ni amɛtaoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Amɛkaiɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛbobaahe, ni Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ji amɛkpɔ̃lɔ.
Shi amɛhɔlɔ lɛ kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi, ni amɛmale amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛfi shi kɛye lɛ anɔkwa, amɛyeee ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli anɔkwa.
Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛnɔsha lɛ fa amɛ, ni ekpãtãaa amɛhiɛ.
Bei pii lɛ, emiɔ ŋɔɔ, ni ehãaa emli awo la kɛteke nɔ.
Ekai akɛ adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ ni hoɔ eyaa ni ekuuu esɛɛ ebaaa dɔŋŋ.
Kwɛ shii abɔ ni amɛtse ehiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfee lɛ nidɔɔnii yɛ shiaŋa lɛŋ.
Amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ nɔtoonɔtoo, ni amɛwo Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli la.
Amɛhiɛ kpa ehewalɛ lɛ, kɛ gbi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛhiɛ kpa ekadii lɛ ni efee yɛ Ijipt, kɛ enaakpɛɛ nibii lɛ yɛ Zoan ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ehã amɛfai lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ lá ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ fai lɛ amli nu amɛnu.
Ehã ofɔii bashwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛye amɛ; ni ehã kɔkɔdenei hu, kpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ehã gɔgɔmii ye amɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã amɛnitsumɔnii ahiɛ.
Ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi bibii kpãtã amɛwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji gbe amɛsikamore tsei lɛ.
Ekpãtã amɛtsinai lɛ ahiɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛtoi ahiɛ kɛ srawai.
Ehã emlifu ni naa wa lɛ, kɛ egrimɔ kɛ emlila kɛ hejaramɔ ba amɛnɔ; ehã bɔfoi fɔ̃ji asafo bakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii kwraa, ni ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ekeee lɛ, shi ejɔɔ amɛnɔ ehã gbele hela.
Egbe Ijiptbii akromɔbii fɛɛ, Ham shwiei akromɔbii lɛ fɛɛ hu lɛ.
Ejie emaŋbii lɛ kɛje kpo tamɔ toi, ni ekpala amɛ kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ tooku.
Ekpala amɛ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni amɛsheee gbeyei; shi ŋshɔ lɛ gbe amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ba Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, gɔŋ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ shɔ̃ lɛ he.
Eshwie majimaji lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni eja shikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii, ni ehã Israel akutsei lɛ hi nɔ akɛ amɛshihilɛhe.
Kɛ̃lɛ amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ni amɛtse ehiɛ atua, ni amɛyeee ekitãi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛgba afã, ni amɛyeee anɔkwa tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ; amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãi ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃.
Amɛkɛ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ wo emli la, ni amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ hã eye awuŋã.
Nyɔŋmɔ mli wo la be ni ena amãgãi lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, ekwa Israel kwrakwra.
Ekwa eshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, ni ji buu mli ni ehi yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ.
Eŋmɛ gbɛ ni henyɛlɔi shɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ, enunyam kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ he okadi lɛ, kɛtee.
Emli wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ la, ni ehã amɛgboi yɛ klante naa.
La kpãtã oblahii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛblayei lɛ, alaaa yookpeemɔ lala ko ahãaa amɛ.
Amɛsɔfoi nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, ni amɛkulafoi lɛ wooo yara amɛfooo amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ te shi, tamɔ mɔ ko ni jɛ wɔ mli, oookɛɛ kãkãlɔ ni dãa eba ehiɛ.
Eshwie ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, ewo amɛ naanɔ hiɛgbele.
Shi egbɛ Yosef shwiei lɛ eshwã, ni eŋɔ̃ɔɔ Efraim akutso lɛ hu.
Shi moŋ eŋɔ Yuda akutso lɛ, Zion Gɔŋ lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ.
Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ shihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Eto lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ebɔ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
Ehala etsulɔ David, eŋɔ lɛ kɛje ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ekpala lɛ kɛjɛ toi yei ni hãa fufɔ lɛ asɛɛ, koni ebakpala emaŋ Israelbii, Israelbii ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ.
David jie etsuiŋ fɛɛ kɛlɛ amɛ, ni ekɛŋaa kpakpa kpala amɛ.
Maŋ lɛ kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ Asaf lala ko.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, jeŋmajiaŋbii ebabote oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛbule oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛfee Yerusalɛm koikoi.
Amɛkɛ otsuji lɛ agbohii hã ŋwɛi loofɔji, ni amɛye; amɛkɛ omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbohii hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi.
Amɛshwie omɛi lɛ alá shi tamɔ nu kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm; ni anaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko po afu amɛ.
Wɔhewɔ maji lɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; amɛŋmɔɔ wɔ, ni amɛyeɔ wɔhe fɛo.
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ omli aaafu kɛyaashi?
Ani omli aaafu kɛya naanɔ lo?
Ani owuŋayeli atso tamɔ la lo?
Okɛ omlila lɛ atua maji ni leee bo lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ ni jaaa bo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛgbe omaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
Kaakwɛ wɔblema tsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ogbala wɔtoi.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, ni oba wɔŋɔɔ mra, ejaakɛ aba wɔ shi naakpa.
Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam hewɔ lɛ, heremɔ wɔyiwala!
Ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ maji lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?” Hã majimaji lɛ ale, ni hã wɔ hu wɔna kɛ wɔhiŋmɛi, nɔ owele ni obaatɔ yɛ otsuji lɛ ala shi ni ashwie lɛ hewɔ.
Bo gboklɛfoi lɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi atoi; ni yɛ ohewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, heremɔ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ahora ni maji ni yɔɔ wɔmasɛi ebɔ bo lɛ, bɔɔ he nakai toi kpawo oshãkã amɛtsitsi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ owebii, olɛɛhe lɛ toi lɛ, wɔɔda bo shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni wɔɔgba onifeemɔi lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ kɛjie oyi kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyashi yinɔ.
Israel shitee ekoŋŋ he sɔlemɔ Odaseyeli.
Asaf lala ko.
Oo Israel Kpalalɔ, bo toi!
Bo ni okpala Yosef tamɔ tooku, Bo ni ota kerubim anɔ, baajie ohe shi faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ.
Yɛ Efraim kɛ Benyamin kɛ Manase hiɛ.
Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi ni oba obahere wɔ!
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala!
Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ po ni omlifu aaajɛle awo omaŋ, ni oboŋ omaŋbii asɔlemɔ toi?
Ohã yaafo tsɔ̃ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa, ni ohã yaafonu pii tsɔ̃ amɛnu ni amɛnu.
Ohã wɔhewɔ maji lɛ pele wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ he; ni wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ŋmɔ wɔ.
Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ!
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ koni wɔyi ana wala.
Wɔba tamɔ waintso kɛjɛ Ijipt; oshwie maji lɛ, ni obatɛo wɔ yɛ jɛi.
Osaa shikpɔŋ ohã lɛ; etsɛ̃rɛ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni ekpele shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ ha gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eniji lɛ ha tsenedrui wuji lɛ anɔ; ekpã eniji lɛ amli kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ, aahu kɛyanina Eufrate Faa lɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ okumɔ waintso lɛ he afabaŋ lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tserɛɔ enɔ yibii nɛɛ?
Batafo jeɔ koo mli ebakpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi hu miiye eyibii.
Oo Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛmɔ wɔ!
Jɛɛ ŋwɛi okwɛ ni ohere omaŋbii ayiwala.
Ba koni obabaa waintso lɛ ni otɛo yɛ ohewalɛ naa lɛ yi!
Wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ema enaa la amɛshã, ni amɛtoo amɛfɔ̃ shi.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo amɛ kɛ mlifu koni okpãtã amɛhiɛ!
Baamɔ omaŋbii ni ji owebii ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ ayi, maŋ ni ohã ena hewalɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ wɔkpaleŋ yɛ osɛɛ dɔŋŋ!
Hã wɔyi ana wala, ni wɔɔja bo.
Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, okɛ wɔ ato wɔtoohe lɛ ekoŋŋ ni ona wɔ mɔbɔ, koni wɔyi ana wala.
Gbijurɔyeli lala Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ ni atswa yɛ Gittith gbɛjianɔtoo naa lɛ.
Nyɛlaa waa nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji wɔhewalɛ lɛ; nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ nyamɔ nyɛhãa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛwoa lala, ni nyɛtswaa ŋoŋo; nyɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta atswaa lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ wɔgbijurɔyeli gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni nyɔŋ hee eje, kɛ be hu ni nyɔŋ lɛ eye emuu, ejaakɛ eji akpɔ hã Israel, akpɔ ni jɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Eŋɔ hã Israelbii lɛ, be ni ete shi ewo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Minu gbee ko ni mileee kɛɛ akɛ, “Miwo jatsu lɛ yɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji anɔ, ni mijie nyɛniji yɛ kɛntɛŋ he.
Nyɛhaomɔ mli lɛ, nyɛtsɛ mi, ni mihere nyɛ.
Mihere nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔhe lɛ.
Mika nyɛ mikwɛ yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he.
Oo mimaŋbii, nyɛboa toi, be mli ni mibɔɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ!
Oo Israel, mina ni obo mi toi!
Nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko kwraa akahi nyɛteŋ; nyɛkajaa maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko kwraa.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie nyɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbɛɛ odaaŋ hatoo ni mawo lɛ obɔ̃ mahã bo.
“Shi mimaŋ lɛ booo migbee toi; Israel baaa ehe shi ehãaa mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛɛ amɛhe koni amɛhi shi yɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ mli, koni amɛhi shi bɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ.
Mina ni mimaŋ lɛ bo mi toi, ni Israel ba ejeŋ bɔ ni, mi, mitaoɔ.
Kulɛ etsɛŋ ni mibaba amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ashi, ni maye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni nyɛɔ Yehowa lɛ, aaaba abakoto lɛ, ni amɛtoigbalamɔ lɛ aaakã he aya nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Malɛ nyɛ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni mahã nyɛ tɛsaa mli wo ni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ nɔyelɔ kpele lɛ Asaf lala ko.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ta ŋwɛi gwabɔɔ wulu lɛŋ; eta nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ eekojo.
“Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni nyɛaakwɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛiaŋ kɛyaashi?
Nyɛyea ohiafo kɛ awusã sane nyɛhãa amɛ; nyɛfãa nɔnalɔ kɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ he.
Nyɛherea gbɔjɔlɔ kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ lɛ; nyɛjiea amɛ yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
“Amɛleee nii lɛ, amɛnuuu nii ashishi hu; dujiaŋ amɛnyiɛ ni jalɛ saneyeli etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ; Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii ji nyɛ blublu kwa;’ kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbaagboi tamɔ gbɔmɛi adesai gboiɔ, nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ tamɔ abladei lɛ ekomɛi nɔŋŋ.” Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ba!
Ba ni obaye je lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, onɔ ni.
Israel henyɛlɔi anɔkunimyeli he sɔlemɔ Asaf lala ko.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, kaafee dioo!
Kaamua onaa, ni kaafee kpoo, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ!
Ejaakɛ, naa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mifee hoo; mɛi ni he tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ amɛhole amɛhe nɔ.
Amɛyaa omaŋ lɛ yinɔ apam yɛ ŋaa mli; amɛkpãŋɔ mɛi ni obuɔ amɛhe lɛ ayinɔ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãtãa amɛhiɛ, koni amɛkafee maŋ dɔŋŋ; ni akakai Israel gbɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.” Naa, amɛkpãŋ, amɛfee gbee kome, amɛkpãŋ oyinɔ: Edombii lɛ kɛ Ishmaelbii lɛ kɛ Moabbii lɛ kɛ Hagarbii lɛ, kɛ Gebalbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ kɛ Amalekbii lɛ kɛ Filistiabii lɛ kɛ Tirobii lɛ hu.
Asiriabii lɛ hu eyafata amɛhe; amɛwo mli nine amɛhã Lot shwiei lɛ.
Feemɔ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ofee Midianbii lɛ kɛ Sisera kɛ Yabin lɛ yɛ Kishon Faa lɛ naa lɛ, mɛi ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ En-Dor ni amɛtsɔ̃ tumo amɛhã shikpɔŋ.
Feemɔ amɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ ofee Oreb kɛ Zeeb lɛ; ye amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kunim tamɔ ofee Zeba kɛ Zalmuna, mɛi ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔŋɔa Yehowa ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ wɔfea wɔnɔ lɛ.” Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, gbɛɛ amɛ oshwã tamɔ lasuogbele mlu, tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ naa.
Bɔ ni la shãa koo wɛɛ, bɔ ni lalilɛi maa gɔji anaa la lɛ, nakai okɛ ahum ashwie amɛ, ni okɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ awo amɛhe gbeyei.
Hã amɛhiɛ agboi bɔ ni afee ni amɛtao bo, Yehowa, ogbɛi sɛɛgbɛ.
Hã amɛhiɛ agboi koni amɛye hejaramɔ kɛya naanɔ; hã amɛgboi kɛ hiɛgbele.
Hã amɛna amɛle akɛ bo mɔ ni ogbɛi ji Yehowa lɛ, bo pɛ ji Ofe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shwe ni ashweɔ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Korahbii alala ko.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni oSɔlemɔ we lɛ yɔɔ akɔnɔ hã!
Misusuma hiɛ miitse Yehowa kpoi lɛ anɔ; hiɛtselɛ lɛ hãa misusuma tɔɔ biti po.
Mikɛ mitsui kɛ migbɔmɔtso fɛɛ laa kɛ miishɛɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ.
Aflimata po naa eshihilɛhe; ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte hu naa etsu he ni ekɛ ebii aaato yɛ ofɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe!
Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mimaŋtsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ, kwɛ bɔ ni mɛi ni hiɔ owe lɛ yɔɔ miishɛɛ hã, ni amɛlaa daa kɛjieɔ oyi.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni odɛ̃ŋ amɛhewalɛ jɛɔ, mɛi ni gbɛfãa kɛyaa Zion Gɔŋ nɔ lɛ kã amɛtsui nɔ.
Kɛji amɛnyiɛ Baka jɔɔ lɛŋ kɛmiiho lɛ, amɛhãa jɛi tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi; ni Agbiɛnaa nu taraa shi yɛ jɛi.
Amɛnyiɛɔ ni amɛhewalɛ nɔ gbɔɔɔ; amɛyanaa nyɔŋmɔi amli Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ Zion.
Oo Yehowa, Tai aNyɔŋmɔ, bo misɔlemɔ lɛ toi!
Oo Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ, feemɔ toi ohã mi!
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, jɔɔmɔ wɔmaŋtsɛ lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Gbi kometoo shihilɛ yɛ oSɔlemɔ we lɛ, ehi fe gbii akpe ni aaaye yɛ he kroko.
Masumɔ matsɔ̃ shinaa naabulɔ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, fe nɔ ni mahi efɔŋfeelɔi awe mli.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hulu kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ ji lɛ; eduroɔ mɔ, ni ewoɔ mɔ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ Yehowa kãmãaa amɛ nɔ kpakpa ko nɔ kpakpa ko.
Oo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ onɔ lɛ!
Sɔlemɔ hã maŋ ejurɔyeli Korahbii alala ko.
Yehowa, ona oshikpɔŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; ohã Israel esaa eshwere ekoŋŋ.
Okɛ omaŋ lɛ he eshai lɛ efa amɛ, ni okɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa amɛ.
Ofo omli ni fu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oŋmɛɛ omlila kpele lɛ he.
Oo wɔyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋɔɔ wɔ oto wɔtoohe ekoŋŋ ni ofo omli ni efu wɔ lɛ sɛɛ!
Aso omli aaafu wɔ kɛaatee naanɔ?
Oookã omlifu lɛ he kɛaaya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ?
Aso ohaŋ wɔyi ana wala ekoŋŋ, koni omaŋ lɛ anya kɛkafo bo?
Oo Yehowa, hã wɔna osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, ni ohã wɔyi ana wala!
Hã mabo nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawie toi, ejaakɛ ekɛ emaŋ lɛ kɛ ehetselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa eŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ, baawie hejɔlɛ wiemɔ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ efee kralo kɛbaahere mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ayiwala koni anunyam ahi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Suɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ anɔkwayeli baakpe; ni jalɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aaafua amɛhe atuu.
Anɔkwayeli aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ, ni jalɛ aaajɛ ŋwɛi egboo ehiɛ shi ekwɛ.
Hɛɛ!
Yehowa aaaŋɔ nɔ kpakpa ehã, ni wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii babaoo.
Jalɛ saneyeli aaatsɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ eba; ni ebaasaa gbɛ ehã lɛ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David sɔlemɔ ko.
Oo Yehowa, gboo otoi shi ohã mi, ni ohã mi hetoo!
Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni efĩ mi!
Baamɔ miwala yi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ji mi.
Heremɔ otsulɔ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ yiwala.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ; naa mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ daa jenamɔ.
Hã otsulɔ susuma mii ashɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, bo misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ ohi, ni oŋɔɔ tɔ̃mɔ ofaa; ni suɔmɔ ni osumɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo lɛ fa babaoo.
Oo Yehowa, feemɔ toi ohã misɔlemɔ, ni obo mifaikpamɔ blɔmɔ toi!
Mihaomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo, ejaakɛ ohereɔ mi nɔ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ eko eko bɛ ni tamɔ bo; ni nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ onitsumɔ yeɔ hegbɔ.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ni bo obɔ lɛ aaaba abakoto bo; ni amɛbaawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Ejaakɛ oje agbo, ni ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii.
Bo okoome pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Oo Yehowa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi bɔ ni miba mijeŋ mihã koni maba mijeŋ yɛ onɔkwale lɛ naa.
Hã mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ashe bo gbeyei.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ni mawo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ kpele ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ fa hã mi.
Ohere misusuma kɛje gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, hewolɔi ete shi ewo mi; yiwalɔi asafo miitao misusuma sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛkwɛɛɛ bo kwraa.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, shi bo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋtsɔlɔ kɛ durolɔ ji bo!
Omli fuuu mra, ni osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ fa babaoo.
Kwɛmɔ mi ni oduro mi, ŋɔɔ ohewalɛ ohã otsulɔ; heremɔ oweyoo bi lɛ yiwala.
Too mi suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔɔ mi lɛ he okadi ko, koni mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ ana, ni amɛhiɛ agboi; ejaakɛ bo, Yehowa, oye obua mi, ni oshɛje mimii.
Yerusalɛm yijiemɔ Korahbii alala ko.
Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to lɛ ma!
Yehowa sumɔɔ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ fe Israel shihilɛhei fɛɛ!
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ, agbaa ohe anunyam saji lɛ.
Matsi Ijipt kɛ Babilon tã mafata maji ni le mi lɛ ahe.
Makane Filistibii kɛ Tirobii kɛ Kush mafata mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ: “Mɔnɛ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, jɛi afɔ lɛ yɛ.” Shi Zion lɛ, aaakɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii yɛ ni jɛi afɔ amɛ yɛ;” ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baahã ema shi shiŋŋ.
Yehowa aaaŋmala maŋ lɛŋ bii agbɛii ewo woloŋ akɛ Yerusalɛmbii.
Mɛi ni laa kɛ mɛi ni joɔ fɛɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ: “Wɔjɔmɔi fɛɛ kwa jɛɔ Zion.”
Aafo aatsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ Korabii alala.
Oo Yehowa, miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, mibolɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ.
Hã misɔlemɔ ashɛ ohiɛ; gboo otoi shi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ haomɔi babaoo eba minɔ, ni miwala miibɛŋkɛ gbohiiaje.
Abuɔ mi ashiɔ mɛi ni yaa gbohiiaje anɔ.
Mihewalɛ fɛɛ etã.
Mitamɔ mɛi ni akwa amɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ eko.
Mitamɔ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi ni amɛkamɔ amɛgbonyobuiaŋ, tamɔ mɛi ni ohiɛ ekpa amɛnɔ kwraa lɛ eko, ejaakɛ obɛ wamɔ ko ni okɛbaawa amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Oshɛ mi ofɔ gbonyobu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, he ni mli kwɔ ni ewo duŋ kpii lɛ.
Omlifu lɛ kã minɔ, ni ohã oshɔkei lɛ fɛɛ ekumɔ eshwie minɔ.
Ohã minanemɛi ekwa mi; ohã mitsɔ̃ musumɔ mihã amɛ; aŋa miyi koni mikanyɛ kpo mije.
Awerɛho ehã mihiŋmɛi eshiu.
Oo Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo daa gbi, ni mikpãa miniji amli mihãa bo.
Ani ofeɔ naakpɛɛnii ohãa gbohii lo?
Ani sisai teɔ shi amɛ jieɔ oyi lo?
Ani agbaa omlihilɛ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he sane yɛ gbonyobu mli lo?
Aloo awieɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ he yɛ he ni hiɛkpãtãmɔ yɔɔ?
Ani anaa onaakpɛɛnii yɛ he ni ewo duŋ lo?
Aloo akaiɔ oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni hiɛ kpaa nii anɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ?
Oo Yehowa, mi lɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo; daa leebi maŋkpa lɛ misɔleɔ mitsɛɔ bo.
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛba oshɛ mi ofɔ̃?
Mɛɛba ni okɛ ohiɛ etee mi?
Kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi beebe lɛ minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni miihe magbo.
Ohe ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi, ni mijijaa.
Omlifu ni naa wa lɛ esu mi!
Ohe ŋmiŋmi ekpãtã mihiɛ!
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ, ohe ŋmiŋmi lɛ ebɔle mihe tamɔ nu afua, efo mihe sa kɛkpe.
Ohã shieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ nanemɛi fɛɛ ekwa mi, ni duŋ pɛ ji minaanyo ni eshwɛ.
Maŋ amanehulu be mli lala Ethan Maskil lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, mala osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ he lala kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Mikɛ minaabu baajaje onɔkwayeli lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ tamɔ ŋwɛi.
Okɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ mɔ ni mihala lɛ ekpãŋ.
Mikã mitsulɔ David kitã akɛ, ‘Oshwiei ji mɛi ni baaye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ; ni mahã omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ama shi kɛya yinɔi fɛɛ.’ ” Oo Yehowa, hã ŋwɛi ajie onaakpɛɛnii yi; ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajie onɔkwayeli lɛ hu yi yɛ asafo lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ namɔ yɔɔ atatuiaŋ ni ekɛ bo, Yehowa, ye hegbɔ?
Ŋwɛibii lɛ ateŋ namɔ yɔɔ ni etamɔ Yehowa?
Nyɔŋmɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi agwabɔɔ lɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, Oo!
Namɔ ji hewalɛtsɛ tamɔ bo, Yehowa?
Onɔkwayeli ebɔle ohe kpula kɛkpe!
Oyɛ ŋshɔ grimɔ nɔ hewalɛ!
Kɛji emli ŋshɔkei lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, bo ojɔɔ amɛhe.
Otserɛ Rehab ni ji ŋshɔŋ kooloo awuiyelɔ lɛ mli, ni ogbe lɛ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ gbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.
Ŋwɛi lɛ onɔ ni, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu onɔ ni; je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ, bo nɔŋŋ obɔ.
Bo obɔ kooyi kɛ wuoyi fɛɛ.
Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ miishɛɛ jieɔ ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Okɔ̃ɔjiaŋ wa waa!
Onineshi wa naakpa!
Ohewalɛ lɛ nɔ kwɔ gojoo!
Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ato shishi ama jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.
Anaa suɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwayeli yɛ onɔ fɛɛ nɔ feemɔ mli.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni le gbijurɔyeli lala lɛ, mɛi ni baa amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa bo, Yehowa, ohiɛ lɛ; mɛi ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ gbi muu fɛɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ ni amɛkafoɔ ojalɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ bo ji amɛhewalɛ lɛ nyam.
Oduromɔ hãa wɔyeɔ kunim.
Ejaakɛ bo Yehowa ji mɔ ni fã wɔhe lɛ; ni bo, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, bo owo maŋtsɛ ohã wɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ wo David shi Blema ko lɛ okɛ otsuji anɔkwafoi lɛ wie yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Miye mibua kãkãlɔ ko, miŋɔ mɔ ko yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ ni miwo enɔ.
Mina mitsulɔ David; mifɔ lɛ mimu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mikɛto lɛ maŋtsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, minine aaahiɛ emli daa; mihewalɛ lɛ aaahã efi shi.
Ehenyɛlɔ nine tsɔŋ enɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; yiwalɔ ko yeŋ enɔ kunim.
Mibakpãtã ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ yɛ ehiɛ, ni mibatswia mɛi ni nyɛɔ lɛ lɛ nii.
Maye lɛ anɔkwa, ni masumɔ lɛ kɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehewalɛ lɛ nɔ aaakwɔ.
Mibagbele emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kɛjɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyamɔ Eufrate Faa lɛ.
Eeebo, ni eeekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Bo ji miTsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ mihebuu Tɛsaa!’ Mafee lɛ mikromɔbi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ wulu fe fɛɛ.
Majɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ mli mana lɛ mɔbɔ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ aaama shi shiŋŋ.
Mahã eseshi ahi shi daa, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi, beiaŋ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
Kɛji eshwiei lɛ kwa mimla lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, kɛji amɛbule mikpɔi lɛ, ni amɛyeee mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ mikɛ dade tete aaagwao amɛ, yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ; ni mikɛ kpelebi aaayi amɛ, yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ misuɔmɔ ni tsakeee ni miyɔɔ hã David lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ, ni shi ni miwo lɛ lɛ, mikwaŋ.
Mikuŋ mi kɛ lɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni eje minaa lɛ, mikpaleŋ.
“Mina mikɛ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekã mihe kitã momo; milakaŋ David.
Eshwiei aaahi shi daa kɛaatee naanɔ, ni emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ aaahi shi gbii abɔ ni hulu teɔ shi ni enyɔɔ shi nɛɛ.
Eeehi shi kɛya naanɔ tamɔ nyɔɔŋtsere; ni eeeye odase yɛ ŋwɛi kɛya naanɔ.” Maŋtsɛ butumɔ he ŋkɔmɔyeli Shi agbɛnɛ okwa lɛ, ni oshɛ lɛ ofɔ̃; omli efu mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Oku okɛ otsulɔ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, okɛ ekekre lɛ eshwishwia shikpɔŋ, ni obule lɛ.
Okumɔ emaŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ oshwie shi, ni ofee emɔji lɛ koikoi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ lɛ haa enii; ni ehe gbɔmɛi tete bɔɔ lɛ ahora.
Ohã ehenyɛlɔi anine etsɔ̃ enɔ; ohã ehenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miinya.
Ohã eklante lɛ naa fee kutuushii yɛ ta mli, ni owaaa lɛ yɛ ta naa.
Oshɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli tsi lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni oŋɔ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ otswa shi.
Ohã esha egbɔ; ohã hiɛgbele eloo lɛ.
Kpɔmɔ he sɔlemɔ Oo Yehowa, kɛyaashi mɛɛbe?
Oooŋɔ ohe otee kɛyashi naanɔ lo?
Mɛɛbe omlifu lɛ aaatso tamɔ la kɛyashi?
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ wala be shɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni obɔ adesã akɛ yaka nɔ ko kɛkɛ.
Mɛɛ adesã yɔɔ jeŋ, ni lɛ lɛ esaŋ enaa gbele?
Namɔ aaanyɛ ehe ehere yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ?
Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oblema suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɔ ni ojɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ mli okã David ehe kitã lɛ?
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ bɔ ni abɔɔ otsulɔ ahora ahãa lɛ, bɔ ni mɛi adɛŋ ahorabɔɔ hãa migbigbliɔ mimli lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, ohenyɛlɔi lɛ bɔɔ mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ ahora; amɛbɔɔ lɛ ahora yɛ he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ kɛhoɔ.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa kɛya naanɔ!
Amen!
Amen!
WOLO NI JI EJWƐ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ Mose sɔlemɔ Mose sɔlemɔ ko.
Oo Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji wɔbobaahe yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ mli.
Be ni onako obɔ gɔji lɛ, ni onako obɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋ lɛ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Okɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa!” Ni ohãa adesa kuɔ esɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ sũ.
Ejaakɛ ohiɛ lɛ, afii akpe tamɔ nyɛ kpaakpa nyɛ, ni ebaho kɛtee; etamɔ nyɔɔŋ buu be pɛ.
Oloɔ adesai kɛyaa tamɔ faa loɔ nii; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ lamɔ ni alaa; amɛtamɔ jwɛi ni feɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ leebi mli; amɛfeɔ floŋŋ, ni amɛgbaa afofro; gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ amɛgbiɔ, ni amɛkpalaa.
Wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; ni omlila lɛ he ŋmiŋmi emɔ wɔ.
Oŋɔ wɔnishaianii lɛ oto ohiɛ, ni wɔdujiaŋ eshai lɛ, yɛ ohiɛ faŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ wɔgbii lɛ hoɔ oya yɛ omlifu lɛ naa; wɔyeɔ wɔfii lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli.
Wɔwalaŋ afii lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo ni.
Kɛji efa aahu lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛji gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ yɛ; shi amɛmli shwãanii lɛ, tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme sɔŋŋ ni.
Wɔwala sɛɛ foɔ oya, ni wɔlaajeɔ kwraa.
Namɔ le omlifu lɛ mli walɛ?
Namɔ le gbeyei ni esa akɛ asheɔ bo yɛ omlila lɛ hewɔ?
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ koni wɔle wɔwalagbii lɛ ayibɔ koni wɔhiɛ akã shi?
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ be yinɔ nɔŋŋ omli aaafu kɛyashi?
Naa otsuji mɔbɔ.
Hã wɔtɔrɔ leebi kɛ osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ, koni wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Hã wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe gbii babaoo; tamɔ ohao wɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe afii babaoo tamɔ gbii abɔ kɛ afii abɔ ni wɔye jaramɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Hã wɔ ni ji otsuji lɛ ana onitsumɔi wuji lɛ, ni wɔshwiei hu ana onunyam kpele lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ana wɔ mɔbɔ; ehã wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi ashwere ahã wɔ!
Hɛɛ!
Wɔniji anaa nitsumɔi lɛ hã amɛshwere.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔyibaalɔ Mɔ ni hiɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ teemɔhe lɛ, ni ehiɔ Ofe lɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, eeekɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Mibobaahe kɛ mimɔɔ ji bo, miNyɔŋmɔ hu ni mihiɛ kã enɔ.” Ejaakɛ lɛ ebaajie bo kɛje henyɛlɔi adujiaŋ tsɔne kɛ gbele hela ni naa wa mli.
Ekɛ etsɛji aaaha onɔ, ni ooona abobaahe yɛ efiji ashishi.
Enɔkwayeli lɛ, tsɛŋ kɛ dama ni.
Osheŋ nyɔɔŋ ŋmiŋmi loo gãimlibi ni atsɛ̃ shwane gbeyei; loo gbele hela ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli, loo hela ni kpãtãa mɔ hiɛ shwane lɛ.
Kɛji mɛi akpe nyɔ yɛ omasɛi, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋma nyɔ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ po lɛ, bo lɛ ebɛŋkɛŋ bo.
Ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ okɛaakwɛ, ni ooona mɛi fɔ̃ji anyɔmɔwo.
Ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa efee ohebulɔ; Ofee Ŋwɛinyo lɛ oteemɔhe, no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ko efeŋ bo, ni haomɔ ko haomɔ ko bɛŋkɛŋ oshihilɛhe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaawo ebɔfoi lɛ kitã yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe, koni amɛbaa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.
Amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛ̃, koni okaŋɔ onane oshi tɛ ko.
Ooonyiɛ jata kɛ shikpãa nɔ po, ooonaanaa jatabi kɛ jeŋ nɔ.
Mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, majie amɛ, ni mɛi ni le migbɛi lɛ mabu amɛhe.
Kɛji amɛtsɛ mi lɛ, mahere amɛ nɔ.
Mi kɛ amɛ aaahi shi yɛ haomɔ mli; mahere amɛ, ni mawo amɛhiɛ nyam.
Mahã amɛtɔ kɛ walasɛɛtsɛlɛ, ni mahã amɛna miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
Yijiemɔ lala Lala ko.
Lala kɛha Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ.
Ehi akɛ ada Yehowa shi, ni ala kɛjie, bo Ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Ehi akɛ ashiɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he sane daa leebi, koni agba onɔkwayeli lɛ he sane daa gbɛkɛ kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ obenta.
Ejaakɛ, bo Yehowa, onifeemɔ nii ehã mimii eshɛ mihe, ni oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ hãa milaa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni onitsumɔi lɛ dara hã!
Ni ojwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.
Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni buulu nyɛɛɛ ale, ni kwashia hu nyɛɛɛ shishi anu, akɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji miifu gblɔ̃gblɔ̃ tamɔ jwɛi, ni efɔŋfeelɔi miishwere; kɛ̃lɛ naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni kã shi hã amɛ; ejaakɛ, bo, Yehowa ji Ofe kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ Oo Yehowa!
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã kɛ̃.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nishaianii lɛ, aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã.
Shi ohã mihe ewa tamɔ wuo, ni ohã mimii eshɛ mihe.
Mina mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ kɛ mihiŋmɛi, ni mikɛ mitoi hu enu mɛi ni te shi wo mi lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.
Jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ tɛŋ, ni eeeda tamɔ tsenedru ni ma Lebanon.
Amɛtamɔ tsei ni atɛo yɛ Yehowa we lɛŋ; amɛfrɔkeɔ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaakã he amɛwo yibii yɛ amɛgbɔlɛ beiaŋ tete, ni amɛaahi frɔ̃frɔ̃ kɛ amɛmli nu daa koni amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yehowa lɛ jalɔ ni.
Lɛ ji mitɛsaa, ni nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ egbɛfaŋ.
Yehowa ji Maŋtsɛ Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; ewula kɛ agbojee; Yehowa ewula; emia kɛ hewalɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ ahoso.
Oo Yehowa, omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ kɛjɛ teteete, ni bo oyɔɔ kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe.
Oo Yehowa, fai lɛ ewo amɛhe nɔ; fai lɛ ewo amɛgbee nɔ, fai lɛ ewo amɛhũumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ je agbo fe fɛɛ.
Eje agbo fe nui babaoo lɛ agbɛɛmɔ; efe ŋshɔkei ahewalɛ.
Yehowa, okpɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni, Owe lɛ he tse krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɛi fɛɛ akojolɔ Oo Yehowa, bo Nuŋtsɔ ni otɔɔ owele, bo Nyɔŋmɔ ni otɔɔ owele, hã ana omlifu.
Oo je lɛ kojolɔ, wo ohe nɔ, koni owo hewolɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa amɛ.
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaanya kɛyashi?
Amɛwieɔ amɛdaa obɔ̃, amɛwieɔ hewoo wiemɔi; mɛi ni feɔ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ shwãa.
Oo Yehowa, amɛmiinaanaa owebii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmiipiŋ omɛi lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, amɛgbeɔ yoo okulafo kɛ gbɔi, ni amɛgbeɔ awusai hu, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ “Yehowa enaaa, ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yooo sɛɛ.” Oo, nyɛ maŋ lɛŋ kwashiai, nyɛyoa sɛɛ!
Ni nyɛ, buului, te be ni nyɛaale nii lɛ?
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ toi lɛ, aso enuuu nii?
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, aso enaaa nii?
Lɛ mɔ ni ekuneɔ jeŋ maji lɛ, aso etsɔseee mɔ lo?
Lɛ mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anii lɛ, lɛ Yehowa lɛ, eleee akɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛkɛ ni lo?
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni bo, Yehowa, otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, gbɔmɔ ni ojɛɔ omla lɛ mli otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ohã ehe ajɔ lɛ fioo, yɛ fimɔ gbii amli, kɛyaashi aaatsa bu ni akɛdu mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa kwaŋ emaŋ lɛ, ejeŋ emɛi lɛ asɛɛ, ejaakɛ aaaku sɛɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔhei lɛ, ni jalɔi fɛɛ aaafĩ sɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ fɛɛ.
Namɔ aaate shi awo efɔŋfeelɔi ahã mi?
Namɔ aaadamɔ shi ashi mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii ahã mi?
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni ye bua mi lɛ, kulɛ benɛ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje kpoo.
Be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miishane lɛ!” Yehowa, osuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ mɔ mimli.
Kɛji mikɔmɔyeli fa yɛ mimli lɛ, oshɛjeɔ mimii, ni mimii shɛɔ mihe.
Ani kojolɔi fɔ̃ji aaanyɛ amɛkɛ bo abɔ, amɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla moŋ nɔ kɛfeɔ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ?
Amɛkpãŋɔ jalɔ yinɔ, ni amɛbuɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko gbele fɔ.
Shi Yehowa ji mimɔɔ ni wa, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mibobaa tɛsaa.
Ebaahã amɛnishaianii lɛ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ; ni eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabɛɛ amɛ ashwie.
Yijiemɔ lala Oo nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔlaa wɔhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa oshe wɔhãa wɔYiwalaheremɔ Tɛsaa lɛ!
Nyɛhãa wɔbaa ehiɛ kɛ shidaa, wɔkɛ lala abɔa oshe kɛjiea eyi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ji Yehowa, Maŋtsɛ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Edɛŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi yɔɔ, gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ hu enɔ ni.
Ŋshɔ lɛ enɔ ni, ni lɛ ebɔ; ni shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ hu eniji ni shɔ̃.
Oo, nyɛbaa!
Nyɛhãa wɔkotoa lɛ, ni wɔjaa lɛ!
Nyɛhãa wɔkulaa shi yɛ Yehowa, wɔBɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ, ni wɔji elɛɛhe lɛŋ mɛi kɛ edɛŋ toi.
Oo, mina ni kulɛ ŋmɛnɛ nyɛbo egbee toi!
Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsuii tamɔ eba lɛ yɛ Meriba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛfee yɛ Masa gbi lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, amɛka mi amɛkwɛ, tsɛbelɛ, amɛna nibii ni mifee mihã amɛ lɛ.
Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ asane je mitsine, ni mikɛɛ akɛ “amɛ ji maŋ ko ni yeee anɔkwa, ni amɛbuuu mimlai lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu mli akɛ, “Kɛ amɛna amɛshɛ hejɔlɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ fĩĩ!”
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Maŋtsɛ Ofe Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Jeŋ fɛɛ, nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Nyɛgbaa wɔyiwala ni ehere he sane lɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi.
Nyɛshiɛa enunyam lɛ, yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!
Nyɛgbaa naakpɛɛnii ni efee lɛ nyɛtsɔa mɛi fɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni esa akɛ asheɔ lɛ gbeyei fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maji krokomɛi anyɔŋmɔi lɛ, amãgãi ni; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Anunyam kɛ agbojee ebɔle ehe, hewalɛ kɛ fɛo eyi ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ obɔ̃.
Oo maji amli wekui, nyɛkafoa Yehowa; nyɛkafoa enunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ!
Nyɛkɛ anunyam ni sa Yehowa gbɛi lɛ ahãa lɛ; nyɛhiɛa afɔlei kɛbaa, nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ!
Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛkotoa kɛjaa Yehowa kɛji epue yɛ egbojeiaŋ!
Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa yɛ ehiɛ!
Nyɛkɛa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, “Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!
No hewɔ je lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni anyɛŋ lɛ ahoso.
Eeekojo gbɔmɛi yɛ jalɛ naa.” Ŋwɛi anya!
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ!
Hã ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ!
Ŋa abɔ oshe kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ emli!
Kɛkɛ lɛ kooŋ tsei fɛɛ aaala kɛ miishɛɛ, yɛ Yehowa hiɛ ejaakɛ eeba; eeba koni ebakojo shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ebaakojo adesa yɛ anɔkwayeli naa.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Nɔyelɔ Ofe lɛ Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ!
Ŋshɔkpɔi babaoo lɛ anya!
Oblɔtu kɛ duŋ kpii ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe!
Emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli nɔ.
La tsoɔ kɛnyiɛɔ ehiɛ, ni ekpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Esrawai lɛ hãa jeŋ tseɔ, je lɛ naa enɛ, ni ekpokpoɔ.
Gɔji lɛ sereɔ tamɔ wo agbaku yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ŋwɛi jajeɔ ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni maji fɛɛ tswɛm naa enunyam lɛ.
Amãgã jalɔi fɛɛ, mɛi ni shwãa fɔ̃ɔ yakayaka amãgãi anɔ lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi.
Nyɛ nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ tswɛm, nyɛkotoa Yehowa.
Oo Yehowa, Zion nu he, ni emii shɛ ehe; ni Yuda maji lɛ amli fili amɛ, yɛ okojomɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, bo ji Ofe, mɔ ni kwɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Awo onɔ gojoo kɛteke nyɔŋmɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsumɔɔ Yehowa lɛ, nyɛnyɛa efɔŋ!
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa emɛi anɔkwafoi lɛ awala yi; ehereɔ amɛyiwala kɛjeɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ.
La aaakpɛ ahã jalɔ, ni miishɛɛ aaaba ahã mɔ ni ja yɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.
Oo, nyɛ jalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ nɔ ni Yehowa efee hewɔ!
Ni nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi kɛ shidaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Je lɛ Nɔyelɔ Lala ko.
Oo, nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee naakpɛɛnii.
Ejɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ krɔŋŋ lɛŋ eye kunim ehã ehe.
Yehowa ehã ale kunim ni eye lɛ; ejie edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.
Ekai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ enɔkwayeli ni eyɔɔ hã Israel we lɛ.
Je lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ ena kunim ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ye lɛ.
Je lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa miishɛɛ lalai, nyɛlaa yijiemɔ lalai!
Nyɛkɛ kpãa saŋku alaa yijiemɔ lalai nyɛhãa Yehowa.
Hɛɛ!
Nyɛtswaa kpãa saŋku kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi, nyɛkpãa koofɛŋi!
Ni nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ abɔa oshe yɛ wɔmaŋtsɛ Yehowa hiɛ!
Ŋshɔ ahũu kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ; je lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli abɔ oshe!
Fai atswa amɛdɛ̃, ni gɔji bluublu ala kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; ejaakɛ eeba ebaye je lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Ebaakojo je lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ebaakojo gbɔmɛi bɔ ni sa pɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ji Maŋtsɛ Ofe Yehowa miiye maŋtsɛ; maji lɛ ahe akpokpo!
Eta maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ kerubim anɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ahoso!
Yehowa je agbo yɛ Zion, awo enɔ gojoo fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Aaajie ogbɛi kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ yi.
Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ!
Maŋtsɛ Ofe ni sumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli, ohã jalɛ saneyeli ema shi; ni aafee nɔ ni ja yɛ Israel.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; nyɛjaa yɛ enaneshi maaŋoo lɛ hiɛ!
Ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mose kɛ Aaron fata osɔfoi lɛ ahe; ni Samuel hu shi mɛi ni ja Yehowa lɛ anɔ.
Amɛbo amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere amɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ amɛ wie yɛ atatu kutuu lɛ mli; amɛye emlai kɛ akpɔi ni eŋɔ hã amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, ohere amɛ nɔ; otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ŋɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ efaa ji bo; tsɛbelɛ ogbala amɛtoi yɛ eshai ni amɛfeefee ahewɔ.
Nyɛkafoa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛjaa yɛ egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Yijiemɔ lala Lala kɛha shidaa.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛhãa Yehowa!
Nyɛsɔmɔa Yehowa kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛbaa ehiɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala!
Nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Yehowa lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ!
Lɛ ebɔ wɔ, ni lɛ enii ji wɔ; emaŋ kɛ elɛɛhe lɛ toi ji wɔ.
Nyɛbotea egboi lɛ amli kɛ shidaa!
Nyɛbaa ekpoi lɛ anɔ kɛ yijiemɔ!
Nyɛdaa lɛ shi, nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa hi; esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ yɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; ni enɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ anɔ!
Jalɛ saneyeli he shiwoo David Lala ko.
Mala anɔkwayeli kɛ jalɛ saneyeli he lala!
Hɛɛ, bo Yehowa, oyi mala majie.
Mikɛ nilee baaba mijeŋ koni shwamɔ ko akahi mihe.
Te be ni manyɛ enɛ he mashɛ hu?
Mikɛ tsui krɔŋŋ aaaba mijeŋ yɛ miwe lɛŋ.
Mikɛ nɔ ko gbonyo ko emaŋ mihiɛ.
Mihiɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji anifeemɔnii; egbaleŋ mi fɔŋfɔ̃.
Tsui ni yeee anɔkwa akagbale mi fɔŋfɔ̃.
Miyeŋ kɛyaŋ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ enaanyo he osheku yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ, makpãtã ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ gegeege kɛ henɔwomɔ tsui lɛ mikɛ lɛ yeŋ.
Mana shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anɔkwafoi lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛ mi ahi shi.
Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ eeesɔmɔ mi.
Shishiulɔ ko ehiŋ miwe lɛŋ; ni amalelɔ ko damɔŋ mihiɛ.
Daa leebi lɛ, makpãtã mɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ, mafolɔ amɛ fɛɛ mashwie kɛje Yehowa maŋ lɛŋ.
Oblanyo ni ehao sɔlemɔ Sɔlemɔ kɛha mɔ ko ni efee yeyeeye ni ejaje ehaomɔi lɛ etsɔɔ Yehowa.
Oo, Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi; hã mibolɔmɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ.
Mifimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi.
Ba otoi shi ohã mi.
Gbi nɔ ni mabɔlɔ matsɛ bo lɛ, heremɔ mi nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ migbii lɛ hoɔ yaa tamɔ lasu, ni miwui ahe edɔ tamɔ latɛŋ.
Mitsui eboo, ni egbi tamɔ jwɛi.
Mihiɛ kpaa miniyeli tete po nɔ.
Mikɛ̃mɔɔ waa; mitã loo kanyakanya.
Mitsɔ ŋa nɔ patu, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ amaŋfɔ̃i amli patu.
Mibɛɛɛ mihiŋmɛi nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔlɔ ni ekome too eyɔɔ tsu yiteŋ.
Mihenyɛlɔi bɔɔ mi ahora gbi muu fɛɛ.
Mɛi ni yeɔ mihe fɛo lɛ kɛ migbɛi lomɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ lamlu etsɔ̃ miniyenii tamɔ aboloo; ni midãa lɛ mikɛ yaafonu futuɔ mli, yɛ omlila kɛ omlifu lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ owo mi, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ̃.
Miwala gbii hoɔ tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔɔŋ ni migbi tamɔ jwɛi; shi, bo Yehowa, ooye maŋtsɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Obaate shi, ni obaana Zion mɔbɔ; ejaakɛ omɔbɔnalɛ be nɛ; be ni ato lɛ eshɛ.
Ejaakɛ Zion mli tɛi lɛ ajara wa yɛ otsuji lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛmusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ.
Majimaji lɛ aaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaashe onunyam lɛ.
Kɛji Yehowa tswa Zion ema shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, eeepue yɛ enunyam mli.
Eeegboo etoi shi ehã shitswialɔi asɔlemɔ; ni enyaŋeŋ amɛfaikpamɔ lɛ.
Hã aŋma enɛ afɔ shi ahã yinɔbii ni baa lɛ, koni mɛi ni afɔko amɛ tete po ajie Yehowa yi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa jɛɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Koni ebo gboklɛfoi lɛ akɛ̃ɛmɔ toi koni ekpɔ̃ mɛi ni abu amɛ gbele fɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni ashiɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yɛ Zion; ni ajie eyi hu yɛ Yerusalɛm; be mli ni majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛyelii aaabuabua amɛhe naa amɛja Yehowa lɛ.
Yehowa egbɔjɔ mi yɛ miblahiaŋ; etse miwala gbii lɛ anɔ.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo miNyɔŋmɔ, Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ lɛ, kaaŋɔ mi kɛmiiya yɛ miwala be lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Blema beebe oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ, onijianaa nitsumɔ ni.
Nomɛi ahiɛ aaakpãtã, shi bo lɛ oyɛ daa.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaatserɛ tamɔ atade; otsakeɔ amɛ tamɔ mama, ni amɛhoɔ amɛyaa.
Shi bo lɛ oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ bɛ naagbee.
Otsuji abii aaahi shi, ni amɛshwiei hu aaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ohiɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ suɔmɔ David Lala ko.
Jiemɔ Yehowa yi misusuma, ni nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mimli, nyɛjiea egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Oo, misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi, ni ohiɛ akakpa nibii juji ni efeɔ lɛ fiaa nɔ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ onishaianii fɛɛ faa; ni etsaa ohelai fiaa kwa lɛ.
Lɛ ehereɔ oyiwala kɛjeɔ gbonyobu mli, ni ekɛ mlihilɛ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ fiɔ bo akekre.
Lɛ ekɛ nii kpakpai duroɔ bo owalabeiaŋ fɛɛ; ni oblahiiaŋ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee tamɔ okropɔŋ.
Yehowa kojoɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim.
Lɛ ehã Mose le eyiŋtoi lɛ, ni ehã Israelbii lɛ le enifeemɔnii lɛ.
Mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ durolɔ ji Yehowa, emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
Jeee be fɛɛ be ekãa mɔ, ni ebɛɛɛ mɔ ewooo emli.
Ekɛ wɔ yeee yɛ wɔhe eshai anaa, ni ewooo wɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ anaa.
Shi moŋ, bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ.
Bɔ ni bokã kɛ anai teŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, nakai ehãa wɔ kɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ateŋ jekɛɔ.
Bɔ ni tsɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebii ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ ele wɔsu kɛ wɔbaŋ; ekaiɔ akɛ sũ kɛkɛ ji wɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ, egbii tamɔ jwɛi; efeɔ floŋŋ tamɔ jwɛiiaŋ fɔfɔi.
Kɛji kɔɔyɔɔ tswa nɔ kɛho pɛ, ebɛ dɔŋŋ; ni he ni ema lɛ leee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ eyɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Eyɛ hã mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ yɛ hã bii abii.
Eyɛ hã mɛi ni toɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ, ni amɛkaiɔ ekitãi lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa lɛ, ekɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi; ni lɛ eyeɔ jeŋ fɛɛ nɔ.
Oo, nyɛ ebɔfoi ni he wa, ni nyɛyeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛboɔ egbee toi, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ etai lɛ fɛɛ kwa, nyɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa bɔ ni yɔɔ enɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.

Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, oda naakpa!
Owula naakpa kɛ woo kɛ agbojee.
Oha la tamɔ ahaa mama, ni olɛɛ ŋwɛi mli oha shi tamɔ buu.
Oma oshĩa lɛ yɛ nui anɔ; oŋɔ atatui okɛfee oshwiilii; otaa kɔɔyɔɔ fiji anɔ okɛsheraa shi.
Oŋɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ofeɔ otsuji; ni oŋɔɔ la kɛ la srɛmi ofeɔ osɔ̃ɔlɔi.
Oto shikpɔŋ lɛ oma shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo nɔ koni ekahoso kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Okɛ nu ha he tamɔ mama, ni nu lɛ su gɔji lɛ ayi.
Oŋa nui lɛ ayi, ni amɛjo foi; oŋwɛi shiimɔ naa lɛ, amɛjo foi oya.
Gɔji lɛ holeholee amɛhe nɔ, ni jɔi lɛ hu babaa shi kɛtee he ni oto ohã amɛ lɛ.
Oto husu ohã nui koni amɛkateke ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ohãa nuhiŋmɛii tueɔ kɛjɛɔ jɔi amli, ni amɛhoɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ.
Amɛhãa ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ nu amɛnuɔ, ni ŋaŋ tejii lɛ kɛgbeɔ amɛkumai.
Loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ fai lɛ ahe; ni amɛlaa yɛ tsei aniji lɛ ateŋ.
Ojɛɔ oshihilɛhe ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, onɛɔ nu oshwieɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Onitsumɔi amli yibii lɛ hãa shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔɔ.
Ohãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ hãa kooloi ni tsei kwɛ̃ɔ hãa gbɔmɛi koni niyenii ajɛ shikpɔŋ aba; kɛ wain ni hãa adesa tsui nyɔɔ emli, kɛ mu ni hãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ kpɛɔ; kɛ aboloo ni hãa gbɔmɔ adesa hewalɛ lɛ.
Lebanon tsei lɛ ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo lɛ, eshwie amɛnɔ nu jogbaŋŋ.
Tsei nɛɛ anɔ loofɔji feɔ amɛtsui yɛ.
Gɔ̃dɔ̃i lɛ, sɛsɛoi lɛ amli amɛtsui yɔɔ.
Gɔji somromoi lɛ anɔ ji duji abobaahe; ni afutuɔkɔi anɔ ji tɛsai amli.
Oto nyɔɔŋtsere koni ekadi nyɔji lɛ; hulu hu le eshinyɔɔ be.
Ohãa duŋ woɔ, ni je naa; no mli kooŋ kooloi fɛɛ jeɔ kpo.
Jatabii hũɔ kɛtaoɔ milɛ loo; amɛkɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Kɛji hulu je lɛ amɛgbalaa amɛhe shi; ni amɛyabumɔɔ amɛwɔɔhei.
Kɛkɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ jeɔ kpo eyaa enitsumɔ, ni eyagboɔ deŋme kɛyashiɔ gbɛkɛ.
Oo Yehowa, onitsumɔi lɛ fa naakpa, fɛɛ jɛ onilee mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ onibɔɔnii sɔŋŋ.
Ŋshɔ nɛ, eda, ni elɛɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ; nibii ni anyɛɛɛ akane wamɔɔ yɛ mli, loi bibii kɛ ewuji fɛɛ.
Lɛji nyiɛɔ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ; emli nɔŋŋ leviatan ni obɔ lɛ shwɛɔ yɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ bo pɛ gbɛ amɛkwɛɔ, koni ohã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ohãa amɛ nii, ni amɛbuaa naa; Ogbeleɔ odɛ̃, ni amɛtɔrɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
Kɛ okɛ ohiɛ tee lɛ, amɛhaoɔ, kɛ oŋɔ amɛmumɔ lɛ, amɛgboiɔ; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa amɛsu ni amɛjɛ mli lɛŋ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji okɛ omumɔ lɛ wo amɛmli lɛ, wala baa amɛmli; ni wala hee baa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa anunyam lɛ aaahi shi kɛya naanɔ.
Yehowa aaanya enitsumɔi lɛ ahe!
Lɛ ji mɔ ni kɛ ekwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ hosoɔ, kɛ eta gɔji lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛjeɔ lasu.
Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mala mahã Yehowa.
Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ wala mli nɛɛ, mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Miyiŋsusumɔ asa Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ ehãa minaa miishɛɛ.
Hã eshafeelɔi atã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni efɔŋfeelɔi akahi shi dɔŋŋ.

Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, Nyɛtsɛa lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ.
Nyɛhãa alea enifeemɔnii lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa lɛ; nyɛlaa nyɛjiea eyi.
Nyɛgbaa enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ fiaa.
Nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃a egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi ni taoɔ Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ lɛ atsui anyɔ amɛmli.
Nyɛtaoa Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa ehiɛgbɛ daa.
-Oo nyɛ, etsulɔ Abraham shwiei, nyɛ Yakobbii ni ehala, nyɛkaia naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi ni etsu lɛ; kɛ kojomɔi ni ekojo lɛ.
Lɛ ji Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, emlai lɛ yɛ hã jeŋ muu fɛɛ.
Ehiɛ yɛ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Ehiɛ yɛ ewiemɔ ni ekɛ ma shi ehã yinɔi akpe lɛ nɔ; kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ Abraham kpãŋ lɛ, kitã ni ekã Isak lɛ; kpãŋmɔ ni Yehowa ma nɔ mi ehã Yakob akɛ akpɔ lɛ; nɔ ni ekɛhã Israel hu akɛ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bo maŋɔ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ mahã akɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛ gboshinii.” No be mli be ni amɛyi faaa ko, ni amɛyi shɛɛɛ nɔ ko, ni gbɔi ji amɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛtsomlo kɛjɛ maŋ kome nɔ kɛtee maŋ kroko nɔ; kɛjɛ maŋtsɛyelihe kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko mli lɛ.
Yehowa eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ, ni efee amɛ efɔŋ ko; ni ekã majiatsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkataa mimɛi ni mifɔ amɛmu lɛ ahe; ni migbalɔi lɛ hu, nyɛkafea amɛ efɔŋ ko.” Be ni Yehowa hã hɔmɔ ba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anaaa nii aye lɛ, etsu nuu ko kɛtsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ, Yosef mɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ lɛ.
Awo enaji gboklɛ, ni apiŋ lɛ, ni awo ekuɛ dade kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni ewiemɔ lɛ ba mli, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ ma ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mi.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu ni ayafɛne lɛ; maji anɔyelɔ lɛ hã eye ehe tswaa.
Ewo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewe lɛ, ni efee lɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔyelɔ; koni etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ amɛfee, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋ onukpai lɛ hu nilee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yakob tee Ijipt, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Ham shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni Yehowa hã Yakobbii lɛ shwere naakpa; ni ehã amɛhe wa hu fe amɛhenyɛlɔi kwraa.
Yehowa hã Ijiptbii lɛ nyɛ Yakob webii lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛ ye ŋaa mli.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu etsulɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, mɛi ni ehala lɛ.
Amɛtsu Nyɔŋmɔ naakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ Ijipt; amɛfee naakpɛɛ nii lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã duŋ wo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wo duŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ Ijiptbii lɛ booo efamɔ lɛ toi.
Ehã amɛfai amli nui lɛ tsɔ̃ lá, ni amɛmli loi lɛ gboi.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yi tɔ kɛ kɔkɔdenei; amɛbote amɛmaŋtsɛ we lɛ piai amli tete.
Nyɔŋmɔ fã, kɛkɛ ni adɔdɔji kɛ ofɔii bayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Ehã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ nɛ yɛ nu najiaŋ; ni srawa gbala yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ.
Ekumɔ amɛwaintsei kɛ agbãmitsei lɛ; ekpãtã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Efã, kɛkɛ ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi ni aleee amɛyibɔ ba.
Amɛye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bai fɛɛ, ni amɛ ye ŋmɔjiashi nii fɛɛ hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtã kromɔbi fɛɛ ni ji amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ shishijee lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛhiɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika, ni Israelbii lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hewalɛ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ Ijipt nya yɛ amɛjɛijee lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ ahe ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ.
Yehowa lɛɛ atatu mli ekɛha amɛnɔ.
Ehã amɛ la ni hã jeŋ tse nyɔɔŋ.
Amɛbi, ni ehã trakɔkɔi ba; ni ehã amɛ niyenii, babaoo ni jɛ ŋwɛi.
Egbele tɛsaa naa, ni nu tue kɛho; nu lɛ ho kɛnyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ tamɔ faa.
Ejaakɛ ekai eshiwoo krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ewo etsulɔ Abraham lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ ejie emaŋ lɛ kɛje kpo kɛ miishɛɛ, ehalamɔbii lɛ kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Eŋɔ majimaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ ehã amɛ, ni amɛŋɔ mɛi lɛ adeŋmegbomɔ mli nitsumɔnii lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛto ekpɔi lɛ ni amɛye nɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Yehowa mlihilɛ hã ewebii Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ Yehowa hewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ agba?
Namɔ aaanyɛ eyijiemɔ lɛ agba kɛwula shi?
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ja be fɛɛ be lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ mi kɛji ona omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛji oohere amɛyiwala lɛ, ye obua mi, koni mana ohalamɔbii lɛ ashweremɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ mli afili lɛ, koni mi kɛ omaŋ lɛ fɛɛ anya kɛ yijiemɔ.
Wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, wɔfee esha; wɔfee efɔŋ, ni wɔye yiwalɛ sane.
Be ni wɔblematsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ, amɛyooo onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ asɛɛ, amɛkaiii osuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ; shi moŋ, amɛtse Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ hiɛ atua, yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ naa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ ehere amɛyiwala yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ; koni ehã ale ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ.
Eŋa Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ yi, ni egbi; ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, oookɛɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala kɛjɛ mɔ ni hetsɛ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Nu lɛ su amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ayi gbidigbidi, eshwɛɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe ewiemɔi lɛ amɛye; amɛla amɛ jie eyi.
Shi yeee be ko, ni amɛhiɛ kpa nii ni etsu ehã amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni amɛmɛɛɛ eŋaawoo dɔŋŋ.
Amɛyadi amɛkɔnɔnii asɛɛ fe nine yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛka Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ehã amɛ amɛnitaomɔnii lɛ, shi ehã lootãa hela ko ni naa wa babote amɛteŋ.
Amɛkɔlɔ Mose kɛ Aaron, Yehowa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, lɛ nɔ, yɛ shitoohe lɛŋ, ni shikpɔŋ gba, ni emi Datan, ni etsimɔ Abiram kɛ eŋa kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ anɔ gbidigbidi.
La je yɛ amɛsafo lɛ mli, ni la lilɛi shã mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ.
Amɛfee shika tsinabi amãgã hu yɛ Sinai, ni amɛja amãgã ni ashwie lɛ.
Amɛŋɔ anunyam lɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛhã tsina ni kpeɔ jwɛi amãgã lɛ moŋ.
Amɛhiɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, mɔ ni fee nii wuji yɛ Ijipt lɛ, nɔ.
Lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni efee naakpɛɛnii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efee gbeyei nibii yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ to akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; shi etsulɔ Mose, mɔ ni eŋɔ lɛ lɛ, damɔ mli ehã amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ejɔɔ mlifu lɛ he koni ekakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Amɛgbe shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he guɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ amɛyeee.
Amɛwie huhuuhu yɛ amɛbuui amli; ni amɛbooo Yehowa gbee toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni eshɛrɛ amɛshwiei lɛ eshwã majimaji lɛ amli; egbɛ amɛ eshwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛhe yabɔ jemawɔŋ Baal jalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Peor; ni amɛye nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã gbohii.
Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii wo Yehowa mlifu; ni gbele hela bote amɛteŋ.
Shi Finehas te shi, ni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ; kɛkɛ ni gbele hela lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Hewɔ lɛ, abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ kɛjɛ yinɔ kome nɔ kɛtee ekroko nɔ, aahu kɛya shi naanɔ fɛɛ.
Amɛwo Yehowa mlifu yɛ Meriba nu lɛ he, ni amɛhewɔ lɛ, Mose na amane.
Amɛwo Mose mli la, ni amɛhã enaa tɛ shi.
Amɛkpãtãaa jeŋbii lɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã amɛ lɛ, shi moŋ amɛfutu amɛ ni amɛkase amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ.
Yehowa webii lɛ ja maŋsɛɛbii amãgãi lɛ, ni no hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.
Amɛŋɔ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ, amɛkɛshãshãa afɔlei amɛhã wɔji.
Amɛshwie amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi amɛkɛshã afɔle amɛhã Kanaan amãgãi lɛ ni amɛkɛ lá lɛ bule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ wo amɛhe muji, ni amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu emaŋ lɛ, ni enyaŋe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewebii lɛ.
Etu amɛ ewo jeŋbii adɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ye amɛnɔ.
Amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ wa amɛyi waa, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ba amɛ shi amɛwo amɛhewalɛ shishi.
Yehowa jie amɛ shii abɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛkuɛŋtilɛ tse ehiɛ atua; ni aba amɛ shi yɛ amɛhe esha lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, be ni enu amɛbolɔmɔ lɛ, enu amɛhaomɔ lɛ he ehã amɛ.
Ekai ekɛ amɛteŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Ehã majimaji fɛɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ na amɛ mɔbɔ.
Oo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala; ni obua wɔnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛba, koni wɔda bo shi, ni wɔjie ogbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashi naanɔ; ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Amen!” Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
WOLO NI JI ENUMƆ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kafomɔ Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ akɛɛ nakai, mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ haomɔ mli lɛ.
Mɛi ni ebua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, akɛɛ nakai.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi tsomlo yɛ shiaŋa ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ; amɛnaaa gbɛ ko ni kã kɛyaa maŋ ni gbɔmɛi yɔɔ mli mli.
Hɔmɔ kɛ kumai ye amɛ, ni amɛtɔ biti.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli; ni enyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ trɔmɔɔ nɔ, kɛyashɛ maŋ ni gbɔmɔ hiɔ mli mli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ, yɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi abii lɛ hewɔ.
Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nu enuɔ; ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, ehãa etɔɔ kɛ nii kpakpai.
Mɛi komɛi hu tara duŋ kɛ awerɛho mli, gboklɛfoi ni awo amɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni amɛyɔɔ amanehulu mli.
Ejaakɛ amɛte shi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛnyaŋe Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ ŋaawoo lɛ.
Akɛ nitsumɔ keketee jɔɔ amɛhe; amɛgbeegbee shi ni bualɔ ko bɛ.
Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Ejie amɛ kɛjɛ duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo mli, ni etserɛ amɛkɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ amli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ ekumɔ akɔɔble agboi lɛ, ni efolɔ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.
Mɛi komɛi lɛ, amɛnishaianii wo amɛ hela; ni amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ amɛna nɔ.
Niyenii ko niyenii ko baaa amɛtsine, ni amɛbɛŋkɛ gbonyobu naa kpaakpa, ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Efã, ni ewiemɔ lɛ tsa amɛ; ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi, yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛshã shidaa afɔlei, ni amɛkɛ nyamɔ lalai agba enitsumɔi lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛji yanyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛtsu nii yɛ nui wuji lɛ ahiɛ; amɛ amɛna Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ; amɛna enaakpɛɛnii lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ lɛ efã ni ehã ahum ni naa wa tswa; ni ehã ŋshɔkei lɛ fee hamahama.
Ŋshɔkei lɛ holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni amɛnyɔɔ shi kɛyaa ŋshɔ kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ, ni amlakui lɛ atsui fãa yɛ amɛmanehulu lɛ mli.
Amɛkpaa, ni amɛdidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔi, ni amɛŋaa fɛɛ laajeɔ amɛ.
Ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa yɛ amɛfimɔ lɛ mli, ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛmanehului lɛ amli.
Ehã ahum lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa kwraa, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ ŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.
Amɛmii shɛ amɛhe ejaakɛ haomɔi lɛ asɛɛ efo, ni ekɛ amɛ eshɛ amɛbele ni amɛshweɔ lɛ mli shweshweeshwe.
Esa akɛ amɛda Yehowa shi yɛ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ enaakpɛɛnii ni etsuɔ ehãa gbɔmɛi adesai abii lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛkafo lɛ yɛ maŋ asafo lɛŋ, ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ onukpai akpee lɛŋ.
Ehãa fai tsɔ̃mɔɔ shiaŋa; ni ehãa he ni nuhiŋmɛi baa yɛ tsɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
Ehãa shikpɔŋ ni baa nii tsɔ̃ɔ ŋoo shikpɔŋ yɛ mɛi ni hiɔ jɛi lɛ anifeemɔnii hewɔ.
Ehãa shiaŋa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo ni ehãa nuhiŋmɛi tueɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli.
Ehãa mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ hiɔ jɛi, ni amɛtoɔ maŋ amɛhiɔ mli.
Amɛfeɔ ŋmɔji, ni amɛduɔ nii; amɛfeɔ waintromi, ni amɛkpaa nii babaoo.
Ejɔɔ amɛ, ni amɛyi faa naakpa; ehãaa amɛtsinai ayifalɛ nɔ agbɔ.
Kɛji akɛ yiwalɛ kɛ haomɔ kɛ awerɛho hã amɛnɔ gbɔ, ni aba amɛshi tete lɛ, egbeɔ lumɛi ahiɛ, ni ehãa amɛtsomloɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni gbɛ kadimɔ nɔ bɛ nɔ; shi ejieɔ ohiafoi kɛjɛɔ amanehului amli, ni ehãa amɛshwiei shwereɔ tamɔ tookui.
Jalɔi naa kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi, ni amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe, shi efɔŋfeelɔi tɔɔ mu.
Hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji nilelɔ lɛ ekase nii kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi amli; Hã amɛsusu Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he.
Henyɛlɔi anɔkunimyeli he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mitsui enyɔ mimli!
Mala lala kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ mahã bo.
Misusuma, ohiɛ atsɛ̃!
Obenta kɛ saŋku, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a!
Mahã leebi hiɛ atsɛ̃ mra!
Oo Yehowa, mada bo shi, yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ, ni majie oyi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ!
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kwɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onɔkwayeli lɛ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, awo onɔ kɛteke ŋwɛi, ni onunyam lɛ ekpele shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ ahere wɔyiwala.
Bo mifaikpamɔ toi, bɔ ni afee ni ohere mɛi ni osumɔɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Nyɔŋmɔ ewie yɛ Ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ: Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mikɛ miishɛɛ aaaja Shekem mli, ni maja Sukot Jɔɔ lɛ mahã miwebii.
Minɔ ji Gilead; ni minɔ ji Manase; Efraim ji midade fai, ni Yuda lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ tsi ni.
Moab ji mihejuu goga; majie mitokota matswa Edom; Mabɔ kunimyeli oshe mawo Filistia.” Namɔ aaaŋɔ mi kɛaatee maŋ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ mli?
Namɔ aaanyiɛ mihiɛ kɛaatee Edom?
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, ani okwa wɔ lɛɛlɛŋ?
Onyiɛɛɛ wɔtai lɛ ahiɛ kɛyaaa ta dɔŋŋ?
Oo, ye obua wɔ koni wɔkɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi awu; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ jeee fɛifɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa lɛ wɔɔye kunim, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ aaanaanaa wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kɛmɔ shi.
Mɔ ko ni ehao mligbigblimɔ David Lala kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa lɛ.
Oo bo Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ yi ni mijieɔ, kaamua onaa!
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ osatofoi miitswa mi lilɛi; amɛmiimale mihe.
Amɛhetsɛ̃ wiemɔi efo sa ewo mihe; amɛtua mi yakatswaa ni mifeko nɔ ko.
Be ni miisumɔ amɛ ni miisɔle miihã amɛ lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi moŋ.
Amɛkɛ efɔŋ toɔ mi ekpakpa najiaŋ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛɛ toɔ misuɔmɔ lɛ najiaŋ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Fãa yiwalɔ ko owo ehe, hã naafolɔlɔ ko afolɔ enaa.
Kɛ akojo lɛ lɛ, hã abu lɛ fɔ; ni aŋɔ esɔlemɔ po akɛ eshafeemɔ.
Afo ewala gbii anɔ kuku; ni enii fɛɛ atsɔ̃ mɔ kroko nɔ.
Hã ebii atsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, ni eŋa atsɔ̃ okulafo.
Hã ebii akpa shi amɛsisɛ̃; hã ashwie amɛ yɛ amaŋfɔ̃i tete ni amɛyɔɔ mli lɛ amli.
Enyɔmɔtsɛ ashɔ̃ nii ni eyɔɔ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ; ni gbɔi hu aha edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nii fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akafee lɛ ejurɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hu akana ebii awusãi lɛ mɔbɔ.
Hã aplenee eshwiei fɛɛ, ni agbe egbɛi yɛ yinɔi ni baaba lɛ ateŋ.
Yehowa akai etsɛmɛi lɛ anishaianii lɛ, ni akɛ enyɛ he esha lɛ hu akafa lɛ.
Yehowa akai amɛhe eshai lɛ daa; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, akakai amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ejwɛŋŋ ejurɔfeemɔ he; shi moŋ ewa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ yi, kɛyashiɔ egbele mli.
Esumɔɔ loomɔ; hewɔ lɛ loomɔ aba enɔ; esumɔɔɔ jɔɔmɔ; hewɔ lɛ ekɛ jɔɔmɔ teŋ ajekɛ.
Ewo loomɔ tamɔ atade; loomɔ lɛ abote ehewojiaŋ tamɔ nu, ni ebote ewuiaŋ tamɔ mu.
Loomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni ebu daa; kɛ mlifiinɔ, ni ekɛfi emli daa.
Hã enɛ afee nyɔmɔwoo ni aaajɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ahã minaaflɔlɔi kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ mihe efɔŋ lɛ.
Oo miNuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ ye misane lɛ ohã mi; ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ lɛ heremɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafo ji mi, ni minii yɛ mɔbɔ; ni mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.
Milaaje tamɔ gbɛkɛnaashi hɔ̃ɔŋ ahwanya mi tamɔ baalabi.
Ŋmaahilɛ sɔŋŋ ehã minakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ, mitã loo, ni mifee kanyakanya.
Mitsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔnɔ mihã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ; ni kɛji amɛna mi lɛ, amɛhosoɔ amɛyitsei.
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ye obua mi.
Heremɔ miyiwala yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ naa.
Hã amɛle akɛ, bo Yehowa, oninenaa nitsumɔ nɛ, akɛ bo ohere miyiwala.
Hã amɛ lɛ, amɛlomɔ mi; shi bo lɛ ojɔɔ mi!
Hã mɛi ni heɔ mi agbe lɛ ahiɛ agboi.
Shɛjemɔ otsulɔ mii.
Hã minaaflɔlɔi lɛ awula kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ; ni amɛhiɛgbele lɛ akpɛtɛ amɛhe tamɔ mama.
Mikɛ minaabu aaada Yehowa shi babaoo, ni majie eyi yɛ mɛi babaoo ateŋ, ejaakɛ lɛ efãa ohiafo he, ni ehereɔ eyiwala kɛjɛɔ mɛi ni buɔ lɛ gbele fɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
Yehowa kɛ Emaŋtsɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ David Lala ko.
Yehowa kɛɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.” Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ekɛ omaŋtsɛ tsi wulu lɛ ahã bo.
Eeekɛɛ akɛ, “Ye lumɔ yɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.” Gbi nɔ ni ooofã ta lɛ, omaŋbii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa.
Oblahii lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ tamɔ leebi bɔ yɛ ogɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ekã kitã, ni etsakeŋ ejwɛŋmɔ, “Bo ji osɔfo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ; eeetswia maŋtsɛmɛi ashi yɛ emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Eeekojo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛmli aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbohii.
Eeeplenee maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Eeenu faa ni yɔɔ gbɛ toi mli nu, no hewɔ lɛ, eeeye omanye.
Yehowa yijiemɔ Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Mada Yehowa shi kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, yɛ jalɔi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli, yɛ asafo lɛ mli.
Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni naa he tsui lɛ kaseɔ.
Enitsumɔ lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ woo kɛ agbojee; ni ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Ehãa akaiɔ enaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ.
Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa.
Ehãa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ yeɔ nii tɔrɔɔ; be fɛɛ be lɛ ekaiɔ ekpãŋmɔ lɛ.
Ehãa emaŋ lɛ leɔ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ashikpɔji lɛ hãa emaŋ lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii.
Eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ, anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ saneyeli ni; ni ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Amɛma shi shiŋŋ daa kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ; koni akɛ anɔkwaleyeli kɛ jalɛ atsu he nii.
Ehã akpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛkpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, Egbɛi lɛ he tse, ni egbɛi lɛ he yɛ gbeyei.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ amɛnaa niiashishinumɔ kpakpa.
Eyijiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa miishɛɛnamɔ Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni eyɔɔ ekitãi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ lɛ.
Eshwiei aaatsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi wuji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; aaajɔɔ jalɔ lɛ shwiei.
Ninamɔ kɛ shika aaahi ewe lɛ, ni ejalɛ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaaya naanɔ.
Jalɔi lɛ, la tsoɔ yɛ duŋ mli hãa amɛ; durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ jalɔ ji lɛ.
Mɔ ni mli hi, ni efaa mɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ anɔkwayeli feɔ enii fɛɛ lɛ, aaahi ahã lɛ.
Jalɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko tsakeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko; aaakai lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Esheee sane fɔŋ ko he adafitswaa gbeyei, ehemɔkɛyeli mli wa, ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa nɔ.
Etsui efãaa, ni esheŋ gbeyei kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anaagbee.
Edɛŋ kpɔɔ pam hãa ohiafoi, ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; aaahã ena hewalɛ, ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji naa enɛ, ni amɛmli woɔ la, amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛlaajeɔ; mɛi fɔ̃ji ataomɔnii fɛɛ feɔ yaka.
Ajie Yehowa mlihilɛ yi Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Oo nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea, nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi!
Ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, kɛjɛ benɛ mli aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ!
Esa akɛ ajie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi kɛjɛ hulu shiteehe aahu kɛyaashi eshinyɔɔhe!
Yehowa kwɔ gojoo kɛteke majimaji fɛɛ, ni enunyam lɛ teke ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi.
Namɔ tamɔ Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi, ni emaa ehiɛ shi, ni ekwɛɔ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ?
Eteɔ ohiafo shi kɛjɛɔ mlu mli, ni ewoɔ mɔ ni efi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛɔ tumo nɔ, koni ehã ekɛ abladei ni ji emaŋ lɛ mli abladei lɛ atara shi.
Ehãa yoo kene tsɔ̃ɔ shĩanyɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ biianyɛ ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Hehoo Gbijurɔ lala Be ni Israelbii lɛ je Ijipt ni Yakob shwiei lɛ je maŋ ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ lɛŋ lɛ, Yuda tsɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Israel tsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ na, ni ejo foi; Yordan hu kpa hoo.
Gɔji lɛ tumɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu tumɔ tamɔ gwantɛŋbii.
Oo Ŋshɔ, te aye tɛŋŋ, ni ojoɔ foi nɛɛ?
Bo Yordan hu, ni okpa hoo nɛɛ?
Oo nyɛ gɔji, mɛni eba ni nyɛtumɔɔ tamɔ ojwɛnii nɛɛ?
Bo shikpɔŋ, ohe akpokpo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ, mɔ ni hãa tɛsaa tsɔ̃ɔ kpaakpo, ni ehãa tswɛrɛbo tsɔ̃ɔ nuhiŋmɛi lɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ Anɔkwafo koome lɛ Jeee wɔ, Yehowa, jeee wɔ, shi ogbɛi lɛ moŋ aŋɔ anunyam ahã, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ!
Mɛɛba majimaji lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?” WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ eyɔɔ; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, no efeɔ.
Amɛmãgãi lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni; gbɔmɔ adesa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni.
Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.
Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii; amɛyɛ gugɔji, shi amɛfuuu nii.
Amɛyɛ niji, shi amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ mli; amɛyɛ naji hu, shi amɛnyiɛɛɛ; ni amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ tete.
Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ hu tamɔ amɛ.
Oo Israelbii, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃a Yehowa nɔ!
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
Oo Aaronwe, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ!
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa Yehowa nɔ.
Lɛ ji nyɛbualɔ kɛ nyɛtsɛŋ.
Yehowa ekai wɔ, ni eeejɔɔ wɔ; Eeejɔɔ Israel we lɛ; eeejɔɔ Aaron we lɛ.
Eeejɔɔ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ.
Yehowa aaahã nyɛshwere babaoo, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii fɛɛ.
Yehowa, ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ bɔlɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ nyɛ.
Ŋwɛi lɛ, Yehowa ŋwɛi ni; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ, eŋɔ ehã gbɔmɛi abii.
Jeee gbohii jieɔ Yehowa yi, ni jeee mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ; shi wɔ, hiɛkãalɔi lɛ moŋ wɔɔjie Yehowa yi, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli, aahu kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Mɔ ko ni ahere lɛ miijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi Miisumɔ Yehowa, ejaakɛ ebo migbee kɛ mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.
Akɛni egboo etoi shi ehã mi hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ mabolɔ matsɛ.
Gbele tsɔnei lɛ bɔle mi kɛkpe, gbohiiaje gbeyei lɛ mɔ mi; mina nɔ̃, ni miwerɛ ho mihe.
Kɛkɛ ni mibo mitsɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, heremɔ miyiwala!” Durolɔ kɛ jalɔ ji Yehowa; wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ni.
Yehowa baa humii ayi; be ni aba mi shi lɛ ehere miyiwala.
Oo, misusuma, kuu osɛɛ ni oyajɔɔ ohe, ejaakɛ Yehowa efee bo ejurɔ pii.
Ejaakɛ ojie mi yɛ gbele dɛŋ, ofo mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu sɛɛ, ni ohãaa mashane ni magbee shi.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi aaakã mihe yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mihiɛ mihemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, be ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ahao mi naakpa” lɛ.
Mikɛ tsuifãa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaaŋɔ he afɔ enɔ.” Mɛni maŋɔ to Yehowa najiaŋ, yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni efee mi lɛ hewɔ?
Mawo yiwalaheremɔ kpulu lɛ nɔ, ni matsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ.
Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbele jara wa yɛ ehiɛ.
Oo Yehowa, otsulɔ ji mi; otsulɔ kɛ oweyoo bi ji mi.
Okpɔlɔ migboklɛi lɛ.
Mashã shidaa afɔle mahã bo, ni maja Yehowa.
Maye mishiwoi lɛ anɔ mahã Yehowa yɛ emaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ, yɛ Yehowa we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ yɛ bo omli.
Oo Yerusalɛm!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Yehowa yijiemɔ Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ maji anɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛkafoa lɛ!
Ejaakɛ esuɔmɔ kpele ni tsakeee lɛ fa yɛ wɔnɔ; ni Yehowa anɔkwayeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Kunimyeli he shidaa Oo, nyɛdaaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.
Hã Israelbii akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.” Hã Aaronwe lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.” Hã mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.” Mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni Yehowa here mi nɔ, ni ehã miye mihe.
Akɛni Yehowa yɛ misɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, misheee gbeyei!
Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaanyɛ mi afee?
Yehowa damɔ mimasɛi akɛ mibualɔ; ni mana mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ anaagbee.
Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo, fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.
Ehi akɛ abaa Yehowa abo, fe nɔ ni akɛ hiɛ aaafɔ̃ abladei anɔ.
Majimaji bɔle mihe kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Amɛbɔle mi, hɛɛ, amɛbɔle mi kɛkpe kpula; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Amɛbɔle mi tamɔ wobii; amɛtso grigri tamɔ ŋmei la; Yehowa gbɛi mli lɛ, mifolɔ amɛmli mishwie.
Atsi mi waa, ni kulɛ miyagbee shi; shi Yehowa ye ebua mi.
Yehowa ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala; Yehowa etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
Nyɛboa toi, kunimyeli nyamɔ lalai miigbɛɛ yɛ jalɔi abuui amli.
Yehowa hewalɛ kpele lɛ ni fee enɛ!
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ehã wɔye kunim.
Ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ehã wɔye ta mli kunim.
Migboŋ, shi moŋ miyi aaana wala, ni majaje Yehowa nitsumɔi lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
Yehowa egbala mitoi waa moŋ, shi eŋɔko mi ehãko gbele.
Nyɛgbelea jalɛ agboi lɛ nyɛhãa mi, koni matsɔ̃ mli ni mayada Yehowa shi.
Yehowa agbo lɛ nɛ.
Jalɔi lɛ baatsɔ̃ mli kɛbote mli.
Miida bo shi akɛ ohere mi nɔ, ni otsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ kwa lɛ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
Yehowa nifeemɔnii nɛ; eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiɛ.
Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi ni Yehowa fee lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmli afilia wɔ, ni wɔnyaa yɛ mli.
Oo Yehowa, ofainɛ, heremɔ wɔyiwala koo!
Oo Yehowa, hã omanye aba koo!
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛŋ lɛ!
Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ kɛmiijɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Yehowa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehã la etso ehã wɔ.
Nyɛhiɛa gbijurɔ blɛo lɛ kɛyaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ koji lɛ ahe tɔ̃ɔ.
Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, mada bo shi.
Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ, makafo bo.
Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa.

Owiemɔ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, anɔkwale sɔŋŋ ni; ni ojalɛ kojomɔi lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
Henɔjɔɔmɔ kɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ hãmɔ Lumɛi folɔɔ minaa yakatswaa kɛ yiwalɛ shi mijɛɔ mitsui mli mibuɔ owiemɔi lɛ.
Minaa owiemɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni eto jwetri wulu ahuu.
Minyɛɔ, ni mihiɔ apasa; shi misumɔɔ omla lɛ.
Mijieɔ oyi shii kpawo daa gbi, yɛ ojalɛ mlai lɛ ahewɔ.
Mɛi ni sumɔɔ omla lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ babaoo naakpa ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ amɛnajiaŋ.
Oo Yehowa, mihiɛ kã oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ; ni miyeɔ okitãi lɛ anɔ.
Misusuma yeɔ omlai lɛ anɔ; miisumɔ mlai lɛ naakpa.
Miyeɔ omlai kɛ okpɔi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mifeɔ nɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔmɔ toi; hã mi niiashishinumɔ yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa.
Hã mifaikpamɔ lɛ ashɛ oŋɔɔ; heremɔ mi yɛ oshiwoo lɛ naa.
Minaabu aaafɔse oyijiemɔ, ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi omlai lɛ.
Mililɛi aaala omla lɛ he lala, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ fɛɛ ja.
Feemɔ kralo ni oye obua mi, ejaakɛ miŋɔ omlai lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, miishwe odɛ̃ŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; ni omla lɛ ji nɔ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.
Hã miyi ana wala bɔ ni afee ni majie oyi; ni ohã omlai lɛ aye abua mi.
Midu gbɛ tamɔ too ni elaaje; blɛ baatao mi, otsulɔ, ejaakɛ okitãi lɛ mihiɛ kpako nɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ mibo mitsɛ Yehowa, koni ebo mi toi.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Oo Yehowa, heremɔ miyiwala kɛje amalelɔi kɛ shishiulɔi adɛŋ.
Bo shishiulɔ, mɛni Yehowa baahã bo, ni mɛni hu ebaafee efata he ehã bo?
Etamɔ tabilɔ gãimlibii ni naa ba kɛ ŋai la ni tsoɔ!
Kpoo hã mi akɛ mibato gbɔ yɛ Mesek, ni mibahi Kedar bui lɛ amasɛi.
Mibahi mɛi ni miihi toiŋjɔlɛ ateŋ be babaoo tsɔ̃.
Mi lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɔmɔ ji mi; shi kɛji miwie pɛ, amɛ lɛ, amɛto ta amɛwo mi.
Yehowa wɔhebulɔ lɛ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Miiwo mihiɛ nɔ makwɛ gɔji lɛ; nɛgbɛ miyelikɛbuamɔ aaajɛ aba?
Miyelikɛbuamɔ jɛɔ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ!
Ehaŋ oshane; mɔ ni buɔ ohe lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i.
Naa, mɔ ni buɔ Israel he lɛ, ewɔɔɔ wɔdɔ̃i, ni esaa ewɔŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
Yehowa ji ohebulɔ!
Yehowa ji ohɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ oninejurɔ nɔ.
Shwane lɛ hulu eshaŋ bo, ni nyɔɔŋ hu nyɔɔŋtsere efeŋ bo nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Yehowa aaabu ohe kɛje efɔŋ fɛɛ mli.
Eeebu owala he shweshweeshwe.
Yehowa aaabu okpojee kɛ omlibaa he, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ.
Yerusalɛm kafomɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala.
David Lala ko.
Mimii shɛɔ mihe kɛji akɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ba ni wɔtee Yehowa we lɛ.” Oo Yerusalɛm, wɔnaji mamɔ ogboi lɛ mli.
Yerusalɛm, bo maŋ ni atswa ama shi kɛtsara nɔ kɛkpe maŋ ni ama lɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Jɛi akutsei ni ji Yehowa akutsei lɛ yaa, taakɛ bɔ ni awo amɛ mla lɛ, koni amɛyada Yehowa shi.
Jɛi akɛ kojomɔ sɛii emamɔ, David we lɛ kojomɔ sɛii lɛ.
Nyɛbaa hejɔlɛ nyɛhãa Yerusalɛm.
“Mɛi ni sumɔɔ bo lɛ ashwere.” Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi ogbogboi lɛ amli, ni shweshweeshwefeemɔ ahi omɔji lɛ amli.
Minyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ minanemɛi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, makɛɛ bo Yerusalɛm akɛ, “Toiŋjɔlɛ ahi omli.” Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, we lɛ hewɔ lɛ, matao bo ekpakpa.
Sɔlemɔ kɛhã mɔbɔnalɛ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Oo, bo miwoɔ mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛɔ, bo mɔ ni ota maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛi lɛ.
Naa, bɔ ni tsuji kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ nɔ, ni weyoo hu kɛ ehe fɔ̃ɔ ewula nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔ hu wɔkwɛɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeena wɔ mɔbɔ.
Naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Oo Yehowa, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!
Ejaakɛ agbe wɔhe guɔ babaoo kɛteke nɔ.
Wɔhe fɛo ni mɛi ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ yeɔ, kɛ wɔhe guɔ ni hewolɔi lɛ gbeɔ lɛ miisu wɔtsui fe nine.
Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ ewebii ahe Zion Gɔŋ lala.
David Lala ko.
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, hã Israel akɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛjeee Yehowa ni yɔɔ wɔsɛɛ lɛ kulɛ be ni wɔhenyɛlɔi te shi wo wɔ, ni amɛmli wo la wo wɔ lɛ, amɛaamimii wɔ hiɛkãalɔi; kulɛ nu afua lɛ su wɔyi, ni fai lɛ ha wɔnɔ; kulɛ fai ni fee hamahama lɛ su wɔyi.” Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa akɛ ekɛ wɔ hãaa ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ amɛnyanyɔji anaa loo.
Wɔwala eje amɛdɛŋ tamɔ loofɔlɔ jeɔ loofɔlɔdulɔi atsɔne mli.
Tsɔne kpãa lɛ etse ni wɔje mli.
Wɔyelikɛbuamɔ yɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ webii shweshweeshwefeemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛtamɔ Zion Gɔŋ ni hosooo, shi moŋ ema shi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni gɔji ebɔle Yerusalɛm kɛkpe kpula lɛ, nakai Yehowa hu ebɔle emɛi lɛ ahe kɛkpe, kɛjɛ benɛ mli kɛmiiya naanɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, eyeŋ jalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ, koni jalɔi lɛ akafee efɔŋ.
Oo Yehowa, feemɔ mɛi ni hi kɛ mɛi ni ja yɛ amɛtsuii amli lɛ ejurɔ.
Shi mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa amɛgbɛi gbohii anɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaloo amɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ kɛaatee.
Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!
Kpɔ̃mɔ he sɔlemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Be ni Yehowa kpala wɔ, Zion nomii lɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ lɛ, efee wɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lamɔ wɔlaa.
No mli lɛ wɔdaaŋ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ, ni wɔbɔ oshe hu kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ, “Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã amɛ.” Lɛɛlɛŋ, Yehowa efee nibii wuji ehã wɔ, ni wɔmii eshɛ wɔhe nɛɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔblema nibii ni ŋmɛɛ wɔ lɛ kɛba, tamɔ nunɛmɔ hãa faa ni emli egbi yiɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ.
Hã mɛi ni duɔ nii kɛ amɛhiɛ yaafonu lɛ, akpa kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Mɛi ni kɛ hiɛ yaafonu hiɛɔ dumɔ wui kɛyaa dumɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ ŋmãa yiteremɔi aaaba shĩa kɛ nyamɔ.
Akɛjie Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ yi Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Solomon lala.
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni mãa tsu lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa mɛi ni mãa lɛ gboɔ he deŋme lɛ!
Kɛjeee Yehowa ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ, no lɛ yakatswaa bulɔ lɛ shiɔ he kpe lɛ.
Yakatswaa nyɛteɔ shi maŋkɛ mra, ni nyɛgboɔ deŋme aahu dani nyɛyawɔɔ.
Nyɛgboɔ deŋme kɛtaoɔ nyɛdaaŋ ŋmaa; shi mɛi ni Yehowa sumɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ amɛhiamɔ nibii kɛji amɛwɔ po tete.
Naa, Yehowa gboshinii ni ehãa ji bii; nikeenii kpele ji musuŋbii.
Bɔ ni gãimlibii yɔɔ yɛ tabilɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai oblahiiaŋ bihii ji.
Ajɔɔ nuu ni nɛkɛ gãimlibii eyi ekotoku mli tɔ lɛ.
Kɛji ekɛ ehenyɛlɔi kpe yɛ koishi lɛ, ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
Sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ Yehowa toiboo mli Zion Gɔŋ lala.
Ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa, ni eyeɔ emlai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Oooye oninenaa nitsumɔ mli nii, omii aaashɛ, ni aaahi ahã bo!
Oŋa aaatamɔ waintso ni woɔ yibii yɛ owe lɛ.
Obii aaatamɔ mutsei bibii kɛaabɔle okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Naa, nuu ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, bɔ ni abaajɔɔ lɛ nɛ.
Yehowa aaajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!
Ooona Yerusalɛm shweremɔ lɛ owala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ooohi shi, ni ooona obii abii.
Toiŋjɔlɛ aba Israel!
Israel henyɛlɔi ahe sɔlemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
“Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ!” Israel akɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛwa mi yi aahu kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ mi.
Amɛkplebii fãmɔ mikotosɛɛ, ni faji lɛ tamɔ ŋmɔ mli akofii kakadaji.” Yehowa lɛ, jalɔ ji lɛ; efolɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ataŋkpei lɛ amli.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ Zion lɛ ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
Hã amɛfee tamɔ tsu yiteŋ jwɛi ni ŋalaa dani edaa lɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ jwɛi ni yiii jwɛiflɔlɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni mɔ ni fimɔɔ lɛ hu kɛshakãaa etsitsiŋ.
Mɛi ni hoɔ tete ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ajɔɔ nyɛ!
Wɔmiijɔɔ nyɛ yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli!”
Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛŋ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ bo kɛjɛɔ nɛɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, bo migbee toi; ka otoi ohã migbee ni mikɛkpaa bo fai lɛ.
Oo Yehowa, kɛji okɛɛ ooodi wɔnishaianii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ po aaaŋɔ ehe eye?
Shi bo odɛ̃ŋ eshaifaa yɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ashe bo gbeyei.
Miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ!
Misusuma miikwɛ Yehowa gbɛ!
Ni ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ mihiɛ kã.
Misusuma miimɛ Yehowa fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Eemɛ fe bɔ ni bulɔi mɛɔ jetsɛremɔ.
Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ; ejaakɛ Yehowa dɛŋ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee yɔɔ, ni edɛŋ kpɔmɔ ni fa yɔɔ.
Lɛ eeekpɔ̃ Israel kɛaajɛ enishaianii lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Heshibaa hemɔkɛyeli he sɔlemɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
David lala.
Oo Yehowa, mitsui wooo ehe nɔ, ni mitsɛɛɛ mihe hu.
Ni misaa minyiɛɛɛ nibii wuji loo nibii ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃ hã mi lɛ asɛɛ.
Shi moŋ, migbe mitsui, ni misusuma efee kpoo tamɔ abifao feɔ yɛ enyɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ.
Misusuma efee kpoo yɛ mimli tamɔ abifao ni atse lɛ fufɔ.
Oo Israel, ŋɔɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kafomɔ Zion lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ David kɛ amanehului fɛɛ ni ena lɛ: bɔ ni ekã bo Yehowa kitã, ni ewo bo, Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ shi akɛ, “Miboteŋ miwe lɛ mli, ni mikwɔŋ misaatso lɛ hu; mibɛŋ mihiŋmɛi, ni mijieŋ mihiŋmɛi sɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mana he ko mahã Yehowa.
Hɛɛ, kɛyaashi mana shihilɛhe mahã Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ Koome lɛ.” Naa, wɔnu Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he yɛ Betlehem, ni wɔyana yɛ Yearim ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔbotea Yehowa we lɛŋ; nyɛhãa wɔjaa yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ hiɛ!” Oo Yehowa, wo ohe nɔ ni oya ohejɔɔmɔhe lɛ, bo kɛ ohewalɛ Adeka lɛ.
Hã osɔfoi lɛ awula kɛ jalɛ tamɔ atade, ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ abɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
Otsulɔ David hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa maŋtsɛ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ.
Yehowa kã David kitã yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni ekuŋ mli.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋɔ omusuŋbii lɛ eko mata omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.
