Kɛji obii lɛ ye mikpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mimlai ni matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ amɛ hu amɛbii aaata omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ daa.” Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Zion, ni eesumɔ akɛ ekɛfee eshihilɛhe.
“Mihejɔɔmɔhe nɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ; biɛ mahi, ejaakɛ biɛ misumɔɔ.
Majɔɔ niyenii babaoo nɔ mahã Zion, ni ohiafoi lɛ hu, mahã amɛtɔrɔ kɛ ŋmaa.
Esɔfoi lɛ, mikɛ miyiwalaheremɔ aaawo amɛ tamɔ atade; ni emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aaabɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ.
Mahã Maŋtsɛ wulu ko ajɛ David shwiei lɛ amli, ni mahã mɔ ni mifɔ lɛ mu lɛ lumɔyeli lɛ ama shi.
Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ, mawo amɛ hiɛgbele, shi lɛ lɛ, ekekre lɛ aaakpɛlɛ.”
Akɛkafoɔ nyɛmi suɔmɔ Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Kwɛ bɔ ni ehi, bɔ ni eyɔɔ fɛo, kɛji nyɛmimɛi fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ!
Etamɔ mu kpakpa ni jara wa ni yɔɔ yiteŋ ni tsereɔ eshwieɔ tsɛŋ mli, ni ji Aaron tsɛŋ lɛ.
Etsereɔ kɛbashwieɔ etade yuu lɛ naamuu lɛ nɔ.
Etamɔ Hermon bɔ ni nyɔɔ Zion gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ewo Zion jɔɔmɔ kɛ wala he shi kɛyaashi naanɔ.
Nyɛbaa wɔjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi Zion Gɔŋ lala ko.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ ni sɔmɔɔ nyɔɔŋ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ!
Nyɛholea nyɛniji anɔ yɛ sɔlemɔ mli yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Yehowa ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ajɛ Zion ajɔɔ bo!
Yijiemɔ lala Nyɛjiea Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi!
Nyɛ Yehowa tsuji fɛɛ, nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdamɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi, ejaakɛ Yehowa hi!
Nyɛlaa nyɛjiea egbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ emli hi!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa eŋɔ Yakob ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, eŋɔ Israel efee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ Yehowa je agbo, ni wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, efe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ ŋshɔ kɛ bui voovoi lɛ amli lɛ, no efeɔ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa atatui woɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ.
Lɛ ehãa srawa gbalaa kɛfataa nunɛmɔ he ni ehãa kɔɔyɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ enitoohe lɛ.
Etswia Ijipt kromɔbii lɛ nii kɛjɛ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi kooloo nɔ.
Ijipt lɛ efee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ mli ekɛgbala Farao kɛ etsuji lɛ fɛɛ toi; ni etswia majimaji pii anii; ni egbegbee majiatsɛmɛi hewalɔi.
Egbe Sihon, Amorbii lɛ amaŋtsɛ, kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ hu, kɛ Kanaan maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã akɛ gboshinii, akɛ gboshinii ehã emaŋ Israelbii lɛ.
Oo, Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ!
Oo Yehowa, ohiɛ nyam lɛ yɛ kɛmiiya yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaabu emaŋbii lɛ bem, ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ etsuji lɛ ahe.
Jeŋmaji lɛ amãgãi lɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni, gbɔmɛi aninenaa nitsumɔi ni.
Amɛyɛ naabui, shi amɛwieee; amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii.
Amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii, asaŋ wala bɛ amɛmli.
Mɛi ni fee amɛ lɛ tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ ji mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ lɛ.
Oo Israel we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Oo Aaron we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Oo Levi we, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Ajɛ Zion ajie Yehowa yi, lɛ mɔ ni eyɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Shidaa lala Oo, nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, ejaakɛ ehi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Oo, nyɛdaa nyɔŋmɔi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Oo, nyɛdaa nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Mɔ koome ni efeɔ naakpɛɛnii wuji lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ekɛ nilee bɔ ŋwɛi amli ŋwɛii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli eha nui lɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ebɔ hulu koni eye shwane nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ebɔ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii koni amɛye nyɔɔŋ nɔ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni etswia Ijipt kromɔbii lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ ejie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ekɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ kpɔiaŋwalɛ tsu enɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni egba Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa; ni ekpala Israelbii kɛtsɔ̃ teŋ kɛho lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Shi eplenee Farao kɛ eta lɛ yɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛŋ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni ekpala emaŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ mɔ ni etswia maŋtsɛmɛi wuji nii lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ni egbegbee maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Sihon, Amorbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Kɛ Og, Bashan maŋtsɛ lɛ, hu; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Ni eŋɔ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã ewebii akɛ gboshinii lɛ ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Eŋɔ ehã etsulɔ Israel akɛ gboshinii; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ ji mɔ ni ekai wɔ be ni wɔfee butuu lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ ejie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Lɛ elɛɔ heloo fɛɛ; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Oo, nyɛdaa Ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi; ejaakɛ naanɔ esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa!
Israelbii nomii lɛ awerɛho Babilon fai lɛ anaa wɔ ho wɔtara shi yɛ ni wɔfofoo, be ni wɔkai Zion lɛ.
Jɛi faa naa gãlãi lɛ anɔ wɔŋɔ wɔsaŋkui lɛ wɔtsotsoro.
Ejaakɛ jɛi mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ bi wɔ koni wɔla lalai yɛ.
Wɔhaolɔi lɛ tao akɛ wɔjie amɛhiɛtserɛ: Amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛlaa Zion lalai lɛ eko nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ!” Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔla Yehowa lala yɛ mɛi kpɔji aje hu?
Oo Yerusalɛm, kɛji mihiɛ kpa onɔ lɛ, no lɛ, hã mininejurɔ agbo yɛ mihe.
Yerusalɛm, kɛji mikaiii bo, ni mibuuu bo fe mimiishɛɛ nɔ titri ko lɛ, hã mililɛi akpɛtɛ midaaŋ.
Oo Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni Edombii lɛ fee lɛ, gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, bɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkumɔa, nyɛkumɔa kɛyamɔa eshishitoo lɛ tɔ̃ɔ” lɛ!
Oo, Babilon, abaakpãtã ohiɛ; Aaajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ nɔ ni ofee wɔ lɛ he owele.
Aaajɔɔ mɔ ni aaaŋɔ obii bibii lɛ atswia tɛsaa lɛ!
Shidaa sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, mikɛ mitsui muu lɛ fɛɛ miida bo shi, mala majie oyi yɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ahiɛ!
Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mahã oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni makula shi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi, yɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kɛ onɔkwayeli lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ohã ogbɛi lɛ kɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehehe fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Gbi nɔ ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, ohere mi nɔ; owo mi ekãa, ni misusuma na hewalɛ.
Oo Yehowa, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaajie oyi; ejaakɛ amɛnu onaa wiemɔi lɛ.
Amɛaala Yehowa nifeemɔi lɛ ahe lala, ejaakɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ da!
Yehowa yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛ kã humi he; shi hewolɔ nyɛɛɛ ehe etee yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛji minyiɛ haomɔ mli lɛ, ohãa miyi naa wala.
Kɛji mihenyɛlɔi amli fu mi lɛ, owoɔ onine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni okɛ ohewalɛ lɛ hereɔ miyiwala.
Yehowa aaahã eyiŋtoo lɛ aba mli ahã mi.
Oo Yehowa, naanɔ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa; gbee bo diɛŋtsɛ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ nilee kɛ emɔkuramɔ Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa.
David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, taomɔ mimli koni ole mi.
Ole mishitamɔ kɛ mishitee mli fɛɛ; oyoɔ miyiŋtoo yɛ shɔŋŋ beebe.
Ole minyiɛmɔ kɛ mishikãmɔ fɛɛ mli, ni ole minifeemɔi fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko bɛ mililɛi nɔ ni bo Yehowa oleee oto.
Ofo afabaŋ owo mihe kɛkpe, ni okɛ onine eŋmɛ minɔ.
Onilee nɛɛ miifee mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃; emli kwɔ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ shɛɛɛ he.
Nɛgbɛ maje omumɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛaatee; ni nɛgbɛ majo foi kɛaajɛ ohiɛ kɛaatee?
Kɛji mikwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, oyɛ jɛi; ni kɛji miyaŋmɛ misaa yɛ gbohiiaje tete, oyɛ jɛi.
Kɛji miŋɔ leebi fiji ni miyahi ŋshɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, jɛi tete lɛ, onine aaakpala mi, ni oninejurɔ aaamɔ mimli tswɛ.
Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Duŋ kabitii abaha minɔ, ni la ni bɔle mihe lɛ atsɔ̃ duŋ” lɛ, no tete po lɛ, duŋ wooo duŋ yɛ ohiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋ tseɔ heŋŋ tamɔ shwane nɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛ; ejaakɛ duŋ jio, la jio fɛɛ lɛ ekome ni yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ bo obɔ mimli nibii fɛɛ; bo oshɔ̃ mi yɛ minyɛ musuŋ.
Miijie oyi, ejaakɛ bɔ ni obɔ mi lɛ, eyɛ naakpɛɛ kɛ gbeyei fɛɛ.
Onitsumɔi lɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ; mile enɛ krɛdɛɛ.
Aŋɔɔɔ mi ateee bo, be ni abɔɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ teemɔ mli, ni ashɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Be ni mi ji lá kukuli tete po lɛ, ohiŋmɛi ena mi momo.
Wala gbii ni ato ahã mi lɛ, aŋma fɛɛ yɛ owolo lɛ mli dani mije wala shishi tete.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, oyiŋtoi lɛ ajara wa yɛ mihiɛ akɛ nɔ ko; efa babaoo naakpa.
Kɛji mika akɛ makane lɛ, amɛyi fa fe ŋshɔnaa shia.
Be ni mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ omasɛi nɔŋŋ miyɔɔ.
Oo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, mina ni ogbe mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, gbɔmɛi lashishwielɔi akabɛŋkɛ mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃.
Amɛwieɔ ohe kɛ yiŋsha, ni amɛteɔ shi amɛwoɔ bo.
Oo Yehowa, aso mɛi ni nyɛɔ bo lɛ mikanyɛ amɛ?
Ni mɛi ni teɔ shi woɔ bo lɛ, mikate shi miwo amɛ?
Minyɛɔ amɛ naakpa, miŋɔɔ amɛ mihenyɛlɔi.
Oo Nyɔŋmɔ, taomɔ mimli koni ole mitsuiŋ.
Kaa mi okwɛ, koni ole mijwɛŋmɔi.
Kwɛmɔ akɛ minyiɛ gbɛ fɔŋ ko nɔ lo, koni okpala mi kɛya naanɔ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Hebuu sɔlemɔ Kɛha lalatsɛ nukpa.
David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ; baamɔ miyi yɛ yiwalɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkpãŋɔ nifɔɔjianii yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛhãa ta teɔ shi daa.
Amɛjɔ amɛlilɛii anaa tamɔ onufu, ni shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi.
Oo Yehowa, buu mihe kɛje mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ, ni obaa miyi kɛje gbɔmɛi yiwalɔi adɛŋ, mɛi ni ekpãŋ koni amɛtɔ̃tɔ̃ minane lɛ.
Hewolɔi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ni amɛŋmɛ mi yaa, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi akpa yɛ gbɛ toi.
Mikɛɛ Yehowa akɛ, “Bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.” Oo Yehowa, bo mifaikpamɔ gbee lɛ toi!
Oo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, miyiwalaherelɔ ni he wa, bo obaa miyi yɛ ta gbi nɔ.
Oo Yehowa, kaahã mɔ fɔŋ nine shɛ nɔ ni eshweɔ lɛ nɔ; ni kaahã eyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ miiba mli miihã lɛ.
Mɛi ni efo sa ewo mihe lɛ, hã efɔŋ ni jɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnaa lɛ abua amɛyiteŋ.
Hã ŋãi la atso yɛ amɛyiteŋ, hã ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie bui kwɔŋkwɔŋi amli, ni amɛkate shi dɔŋŋ.
Kaahã oshekuyelɔ ko he shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; hã efɔŋ akpãtã yiwalɔ lɛ hiɛ mra.
Mile akɛ Yehowa yeɔ nɔnalɔ sane ehãa lɛ; ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ehãa mɔ ni efi lɛ.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, jalɔi aaajie oyi, ni mɛi ni feɔ jalɛnii aaahi shi yɛ ohiɛ.
Gbɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, bo mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ; ba miŋɔɔ mra!
Ba otoi shi ohã mi kɛji mitsɛ bo lɛ.
Hã mifaikpamɔ afee tamɔ tsofakɛŋma yɛ ohiɛ; ni miniji anɔholemɔ afee tamɔ gbɛkɛ afɔle!
Oo Yehowa, wo mililɛi manyoflɛ; ni ahã mamɔ minaabu mli.
Kaadɔ mitsui kɛmiiya nɔ fɔŋ ko he, ni mikafata mɛi fɔ̃ji ahe kɛtsu yiwalɛnii; ni kaahã miye amɛdɔkɔdɔkɔ nii lɛ eko.
Hã jalɔ agbala mitoi kɛ mlihilɛ; hã anɔkwafoi akã mi; shi kɛji mɔ fɔŋ miiwo mihiɛ nyam lɛ, hã makwa; ejaakɛ misɔleɔ daa mishiɔ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ.
Kɛji aŋɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji ahã kojolɔi, ni amɛbu amɛ fɔ lɛ, no dani amɛaale akɛ miwiemɔi lɛ anɔkwale ni.
Bɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko miihu ni egbɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai agbɛ wɔwui ashwã gbonyobu toi.
Shi bo Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, bo onɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ɔ.
Bo nɔŋŋ abo mibaa!
Kaashi mi tamɔ mɔ ni bɛ hefãlɔ.
Buu mihe yɛ tsɔne ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ he buu mihe kɛjɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nishaianii akpai lɛ ahe.
Hã mɛi fɔ̃ji adu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsɔne lɛ, ni mi lɛ, hã maje mli sɔkee.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko be mli ni eyɛ tɛkpolo lɛ mi.
Sɔlemɔ ko.
Miiwo migbee nɔ miibolɔ miitsɛ Yehowa, mikɛ migbee miikpa Yehowa fai.
Miifɔse mikɔmɔi lɛ miishwie ehiɛ, miijaje mihaomɔi lɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
Be ni mimumɔ tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, bo ole migbɛ lɛ.
Mihenyɛlɔi etsɔ̃ tsɔne kɛtee mi yɛ gbɛ ni minyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kwɛ mininejurɔgbɛ, ni ooona akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni le mi.
Abobaahe ebɔ mi; Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋŋ mihe.
Oo Yehowa, miibolɔ miitsɛ bo!
Mikɛɛ akɛ bo ji mibobaahe, bo ji migbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Feemɔ toi ohã mibolɔmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aba mi shi fe nine.
Jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa fe mi.
Jiemɔ mi kɛje gboklɛfoi atsuŋ, koni mada bo shi.
Jalɔi aaabɔle mi kɛkpe, ejaakɛ ofee mi ejurɔ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ David Lala ko.
Oo Yehowa, bo misɔlemɔ toi, feemɔ toi ohã mifaikpamɔ lɛ; heremɔ mi nɔ yɛ onɔkwayeli kɛ ojalɛ lɛ naa.
Okɛ otsulɔ akakojo, ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔ ko hiɛkãalɔ ko yeŋ bem yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ etiu mi, ekpãtã miwala hiɛ kɛmɔ shi; ehã mita duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mimumɔ etɔ biti yɛ mimli; mitsui efee shikplikpii yɛ mimli.
Mikaiɔ blema gbii lɛ, mijwɛŋɔ nii ni ofee lɛ fiaa he; misusuɔ oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Miholeɔ miniji anɔ mihãa bo yɛ sɔlemɔ mli; ohe kumai yeɔ misusuma tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ.
Oo Yehowa, heremɔ mi nɔ oya; mimumɔ miitɔ biti; kaaŋɔ ohiɛ otee mi, kɛjee nakai lɛ, matamɔ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ.
Leebi lɛ hã manu osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ he, ejaakɛ bo onɔ mihiɛ kã.
Hã male gbɛ ni sa akɛ manyiɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ bo miŋɔɔ misusuma mihãa.
Oo Yehowa, jiemɔ mi yɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ!
Bo oŋɔɔ mijoɔ foi kɛbaa mibatee yɛ!
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi koni mafee osuɔmɔnaanii, ejaakɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ.
Hã omumɔ kpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mi gbɛ kɛnyiɛ gbɛ tɛ̃ɛ nɔ.
Oo Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, hã miyi ana wala!
Ojalɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, jiemɔ mi kɛje haomɔ mli.
Osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee hã mi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, folɔmɔ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwie; ni okpãtã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ; ejaakɛ otsulɔ ji mi.
Maŋtsɛ ko da Nyɔŋmɔ shi David Lala.
Yijiemɔ ahã Yehowa, mitɛsaa lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ miniji tawuu kɛ miwaobii nɔmɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ji mitɛsaa kɛ mimɔ̃ɔ, mibobaa mɔɔ ni wa, kɛ mijielɔ, mitsɛŋ kɛ mɔ abo ni mibaa lɛ.
Lɛ ebaa mimaŋbii shi ewoɔ mishishi.
Oo Yehowa, mɛɛ ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni obuɔ ehe akɔntaa, loo gbɔmɔ bi ni ojwɛŋɔ ehe?
Gbɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, egbii lɛ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ ni hoɔ.
Oo Yehowa, kpoo oŋwɛi lɛ naa shi koni oyi shi!
Taramɔ gɔji lɛ ahe koni amɛje lasu!
Hã srawai agbala, koni ogbɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ oshwã.
Tsɛ̃rɛ̃mɔ ogãimlibii lɛ koni owo amɛ foi.
Kpã onine mli kɛjɛ ŋwɛi; shɔ̃ mi koni ojie mi kɛjɛ nu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, kɛjɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ, mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
Oo, Nyɔŋmɔ, mala lala hee mahã bo!
Kpãi nyɔŋma saŋku matswa kɛjie oyi.
Bo ohãa maŋtsɛmɛi yeɔ kunim, ni ohereɔ otsulɔ David yiwala.
Shɔ̃ mi kɛje yiwalɔ klante naa; kpɔ̃ mi kɛje mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ, mɛi ni maleɔ, ni amɛwoɔ amɛninejurɔ nɔ amɛkãa amale kitã lɛ.
Wɔbihii adara yɛ amɛblahiiaŋ, tamɔ tsei ni atɛo ni amɛdara; ni wɔbiyei lɛ hu atãmɔ koŋtɛ ni ako ni akɛmaa maŋtsɛ we.
Wɔboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔbɔ̃, kɛ niyenii srɔtoi fɛɛ; wɔtoi hu afɔfɔɔ akpekpei, kɛ akpei nyɔŋmanyɔŋmai yɛ ŋa nɔ.
Wɔtsinai hu afɔ babaoo; amɛkasharake, ni amɛkalaaje; akanu haomɔ blɔmɔ ko yɛ wɔblohuiaŋ.
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni naa nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ!
Ajɔɔ maŋ ni Yehowa ji eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Yijiemɔ lala Yijiemɔ lala.
David Lala.
Makafo bo, miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ miMaŋtsɛ, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Daa gbi lɛ majie oyi, ni majie ogbɛi lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Yehowa je agbo; ni esa yijiemɔ babaoo, ni egbojee lɛ anaaa naa.
Yinɔ kome aaakafo onitsumɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yinɔ kroko; ni amɛaajaje ohewalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Majwɛŋ onunyam falɛ kɛ ogbojee kɛ onaakpɛɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Mɛi aaagba ohewalɛ nitsumɔi ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, ni majaje ogbojee lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ.
Amɛaajaje omlihilɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ; amɛaala ojalɛ lɛ he lala waa.
Durolɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji Yehowa; emli fuuu mra, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ fa babaoo.
Yehowa hi hã mɛi fɛɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ebɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ he.
Yehowa, obɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaada bo shi; ni omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ aaajie oyi.
Amɛaawie omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ anunyam lɛ he, ni amɛaagba ohewalɛ lɛ, koni amɛhã gbɔmɛi adesai abii ale ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, kɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyam kɛ egbojee.
Omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni; ni olumɔyeli lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Yehowa sɔoɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni miigbee shi lɛ, ni eholeɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ.
Bɔɔnii fɛɛ kwɛɔ bo gbɛ, ni bo ohãa amɛ niyenii yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ogbɛɔ odɛ̃ŋ, ni ohãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã tɔɔ kɛ nii ni etaoɔ.
Yehowa ja yɛ egbɛi fiaa mli, ni emli hi yɛ enifeemɔi fiaa mli.
Yehowa bɛŋkɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ; ebɛŋkɛɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ, efeɔ amɛnitaomɔnii ehãa amɛ; eboɔ amɛbolɔmɔ toi ni ehereɔ amɛyiwala.
Yehowa baa mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ayi; shi yiwalɔi lɛ, eeekpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Minaabu aaajie Yehowa yi ni bɔɔnii fɛɛ aaajie egbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yi daa kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ yijiemɔ Jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Oo misusuma, jiemɔ Yehowa yi!
Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, majie Yehowa yi!
Mala majie miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi miwala be fɛɛ.
Nyɛkaŋɔa nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa lumɛi loo gbɔmɔ adesa bi ko ni yelikɛbuamɔ bɛ edɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji emumɔ je emli lɛ, ekuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa esu lɛ mli ekoŋŋ; nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ eyiŋtoo fɛɛ laajeɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji eyelikɛbualɔ, mɔ ni ehiɛ kãa Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ebɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; lɛ lɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa kɛyaa naanɔ.
Mɛi ni ayeɔ amɛ amim lɛ, eyeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ lɛ, ehãa amɛ niyenii.
Yehowa fɛneɔ gboklɛfoi agboklɛi.
Yehowa gbeleɔ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii; Yehowa holeɔ mɛi ni edɔrɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ anɔ; Yehowa sumɔɔ jalɔi.
Yehowa baa gbɔi ayi; efĩɔ awusa kɛ okulafo sɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ, ebutuɔ.
Yehowa baaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ, Zion, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ yijiemɔ Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Ehi akɛ ala ajie wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi; ejaakɛ durolɔ ji lɛ, ni yijiemɔ lala sa lɛ.
Yehowa ji mɔ ni maa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ; ebuaa Israelbii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa.
Lɛ etsaa mɛi ni tsuii ekumɔ lɛ, ni efimɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ.
Lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ ŋulamii lɛ ayibɔ, ni ewoɔ eko fɛɛ eko gbɛi lɛ.
WɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ je agbo; ni ehewalɛ fa naakpa, ni enilee lɛ anaaa naa.
Yehowa woɔ heshibalɔi anɔ, shi yiwalɔi lɛ etsirɛɔ amɛ etswiaa shi.
Nyɛlaa shidaa lala nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛkɛ saŋku alaa kɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi.
Lɛ ekɛ atatui haa ŋwɛi, ni ehãa nu nɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ehãa jwɛi kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi anɔ.
Lɛ ehãa kooloi niyenii, ni elɛɔ kwãakwãalabitei abii ni bolɔɔ lɛ hu.
Emiishɛɛnamɔ bɛ okpɔŋɔ hewalɛ mli, ni ebɛ tabilɔi ahewalɛ he miishɛɛ hu.
Shi moŋ Yehowa naa mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ esuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Oo Yerusalɛm, kafomɔ Yehowa!
Oo Zion, jiemɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi!
Ejaakɛ lɛ ewajeɔ ogboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ kpɛŋŋ; ejɔɔ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ.
Ehãa ohusui anɔ jɔɔ; ehãa otɔɔ kɛ ŋmãa kpakpa.
Efãa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ afeɔ lɛ oya.
Ehãa snoo nyɔɔ futaa tamɔ too he tsɔi yɛŋ; egbɛɔ bɔ́ ni efĩ eshwãa tamɔ lamlu.
Eshɛrɛɔ enutɛi lɛ eshwieɔ shi tamɔ fɔbitɛi.
Namɔ aaanyɛ efɛ̃i lɛ naa edamɔ?
Efãa, ni ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nutɛi lɛ sereɔ.
Ehãa ekɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa, ni nui lɛ hoɔ.
Ejajeɔ ewiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel, ekɛ ekpɔi kɛ emlai lɛ hãa Israel.
Efeko nakai nɔ ko ehãko maŋ ko maŋ ko dã; emlai lɛ hu, amɛleee.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Jeŋ fɛɛ ajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi!
Nyɛjɛa ŋwɛi nyɛjiea Yehowa yi; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!
Nyɛ, ebɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛ, etai lɛ fɛɛ nyɛjiea eyi!
Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛŋulamii ni kpɛlɛɔ fiaa, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi, kɛ nui ni yɔɔ ŋwɛii amli ŋwɛi lɛ, nyɛjiea eyi!
Hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ lɛ efã, ni abɔ amɛ.
Eŋɔ amɛ emamɔ shi kɛmiiya naanɔ; ewo amɛ akpɔ, ni amɛnyɛŋ nɔ amɛku.
Nyɛjɛa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nuŋ loi wuji ni he yɔɔ gbeyei, bui ni mli kwɔlɔ fɛɛ, la kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ, snoo kɛ afua, ahum ni yeɔ efãmɔ nɔ.
Nyɛjiea eyi nyɛ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi fiaa, tsei ni woɔ yibii kɛ tsenedrui fɛɛ!
Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ shĩa kooloi fɛɛ, waamɔ nibii kɛ loofɔji.
Shikpɔŋ nɔ majiatsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ, lumɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kojolɔi fɛɛ, oblahii kɛ oblayei fɛɛ, onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii bluublu, hã amɛ jie Yehowa gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ ekoome egbɛi lɛ nɔ awo gojoo fe gbɛii fɛɛ.
Lɛ enunyam lɛ kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi fɛɛ tete.
Ekɛ ehewalɛ kpele lɛ ewo emaŋbii anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ajie eyi, Israelbii, ni ji emaŋ ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Yijiemɔ lala Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa, nyɛjiea eyi yɛ anɔkwafoi agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Hã Israel anya ebɔlɔ lɛ he, ni Zion bihii lɛ amli afili amɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Hã amɛkɛ joo ajie egbɛi lɛ yi, ni amɛkɛ miji kɛ saŋku ala amɛkɛjie eyi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa naa emaŋbii lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ; ehãa humii yeɔ ta mli kunim.
Hã anɔkwafoi lɛ anya yɛ anunyam mli; hã amɛla nyamɔ lala yɛ amɛsai anɔ.
Hã Nyɔŋmɔ kafomɔ akã amɛlilɛi nɔ, ni amɛhiɛ klante kɛ enaa nta yɛ amɛdɛ̃, koni amɛkɛtɔ owele yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ, koni amɛkɛgbala maŋbii lɛ atoi, koni amɛkɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi afimɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛwo amɛbladei lɛ dade gboklɛi, koni amɛkɛ toigbalamɔ ni aŋma ato agbala amɛtoi.
Enɛ ji anunyam hã emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Kafomɔ Yehowa Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛjiea Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ atatu lɛŋ!
Nyɛjiea eyi yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ; nyɛjiea eyi yɛ egbojee kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kpãmɔ; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ obenta kɛ saŋku!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ miji kɛ joo, nyɛjiea eyi kɛ kpãa saŋku kɛ bɛji!
Nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋo ni naa wa; nyɛjiea eyi kɛ ŋoŋoi ni jijeɔ!
Nyɛhãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni muɔ ajiea Yehowa yi!
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Abɛi ni abua naa ni yɔɔ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ kɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ nitsɔ̃ɔmɔi ahe.
Saŋŋ kɔɔ nɔ ni sa akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa afee daa gbi he.
Abɛi awolo lɛ kaiɔ wɔ akɛ, “Dani mɔ ko baale nii lɛ, ja ena Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ.” Jeee Nyɔŋmɔ jamɔ kɛ jeŋba kpakpa kɛkɛ he abɛi nɛɛ wieɔ, shi moŋ amɛwieɔ hiɛshikamɔ kɛ agwaseiaŋ nifeemɔnii hu ahe.
Abɛi lɛ aŋmala amɛ kukujikukuji moŋ nɛ, shi pii tsɔ̃ɔ niiashikpamɔ jogbaŋŋ ni blema Israel tsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ na yɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ nilelɔ afee kɛji sane ba enɔ.
Abɛi lɛ ekomɛi kɔɔ wekumɛi ashihilɛ he; ekomɛi kɔɔ nitsumɔ he; ekomɛi tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaa jeŋ ahãa yɛ adesai ateŋ.
Ekomɛi hu tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni esa akɛ aye he nɔ ahã.
Nibii ni abɛi nɛɛ wieɔ he ji heshibaa kɛ tsuishitoo kɛ bulɛ ni sa akɛ akɛhã ohiafoi; asaŋ abɛi lɛ wieɔ nanemɛi ateŋ anɔkwayeli hu he babaoo.
Mlijaramɔi Nilee yijiemɔ .—.
Solomon Abɛi lɛ .—.
Agur wiemɔi lɛ .- Wiemɔi kukuji krokomɛi .-
Abɛi ahe sɛɛnamɔ Israel Maŋtsɛ Solomon, David bi lɛ, abɛi nɛ.
Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ nilee, ni amɛhãa mɔ naa tsɔsemɔ.
Amɛhãa mɔ nuɔ wiemɔi ni jwɛŋmɔ yɔɔ mli ashishi faŋŋ hu.
Amɛhãa mɔ leɔ nii, eleɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eleɔ anɔkwayeli.
Abɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni nako jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃ɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblanyo hu nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nilelɔ hu nuɔ, ni ekaseɔ nii efataa enilee he.
Amɛhãa mɔ ni nuɔ niiashishi hu leɔ ŋaa.
Ebaanu abɛi kɛ wiemɔi ni amɛshishinumɔ wa kɛ nilelɔi awiemɔi kɛ amɛjenui ashishi.
Ŋaawoo kɛhã oblahii Nilee fɛɛ shishijee ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ; shi kwashiai gbeɔ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
Mibi, bo otsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi, ni kaashɛ mla ni onyɛ woɔ bo lɛ ofɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ nomɛi ji anunyam akekre ni fi oyitso kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni kã okuɛ.
Mibi, kɛji eshafeelɔi miilaka bo lɛ, kaakpɛlɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛkɛɛ bo akɛ, “Ba wɔtee ni wɔyawo mɔ ko antɛo, ni wɔyawo mɔ ko lá ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ ko ka yakatswaa lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ bo akɛ hã wɔmĩĩ amɛ hiɛkãalɔi tamɔ bɔ ni gbohiiaje mĩiɔ mɛi emuu, aloo tamɔ akpelekeɔ shi aboteɔ gbonyobu mli, ni akuuu sɛɛ abaaa dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ no wɔbaana nibii srɔtoi wɔwo wɔshĩai amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.
Kɛji amɛaakɛɛ akɛ bo lɛ kɛ ohe abɔ wɔhe kɛkɛ; wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaato fotro kome, ni nɔ ni wɔbaana lɛ wɔbaaja lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ kaakpɛlɛ̃.” Mibi, okɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi akabɔ.
Tsi ohe kɛje amɛhe kwraa.
Gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ; amɛhe feɔ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ.
Eji yaka nɔ ko feemɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ loofɔlɔ tsɔne be mli ni eekwɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe tsɔne amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwala antɛo.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni shɔ̃ɔ nii ekãa naa yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛnaagbee tamɔ nɛ, nɔ ni amɛkɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ diɔ sɛɛ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ.
Nilee miitsɛ kwashiai Bo toi!
Nilee miibolɔ waa yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni eewo egbee yɛ jaji anɔ.
Ebolɔɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ he fɛɛ he ni mɛi ebua amɛhe naa kutuu yɛ.
Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa waaa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaahiɛ nyɛkwashiafeemɔ nɛɛ mli kɛyashi?
Ni mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ kwashiai hu aaanyɛ nilee kɛyashi?
Kɛji mikã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa toi.
Naa, mafɔse mimumɔ mawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛyoo minilee wiemɔi lɛ hu.
Mitsɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛbooo mi toi; mikpã miniji amli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔɔɔ mli.
Miŋaawoo lɛ hu nyɛkwa fɛɛ, ni nyɛbuuu mikãmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu nyɛmanehulu mli lɛ, maŋmɔ nyɛ; ni kɛji gbeyei nɔ ko ba lɛ, maye nyɛhe fɛo.
Kɛji tsuifãa nɔ ko batua nyɛ tamɔ ahum, ni nyɛmanehulu te shi tamɔ lasuogbele; ni kɛji hejaramɔ kɛ tsuiyeli ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, no mli lɛ nyɛaatsɛ mi, shi mihereŋ nɔ; nyɛaatao misɛɛgbɛ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃, shi nyɛnaŋ mi.
Akɛni amɛsumɔɔ nilee, ni amɛsheee Yehowa gbeyei; asaŋ akɛni amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ ŋaa ni miwoɔ amɛ lɛ ekoeko, ni amɛgbe mikãmɔ lɛ fɛɛ he guɔ hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛdu lɛ, no yibii amɛaakpa, ni ŋaa ni amɛtotoo lɛ he sɛɛ amɛaana.
Mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa kpaleɔ kɛjeɔ nilee he kɛyaa nɔ kroko he, ni no nɔŋŋ gbeɔ amɛ; ni jwɛŋmɔ ni kwashiai jwɛŋɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boɔ mi toi lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe, ehe aaajɔ lɛ, ni esheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei.
Nilee he nyɔmɔwoo Mibi, mɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.
Ba otoi shi ohã nilee, ni oto otsui shi ohã sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Mibi, fo otsɛ́ niiasɛɛyoomɔ, ni odi niiashishinumɔ sɛɛ.
Taomɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ tamɔ ataoɔ jwiɛtɛi aloo jwetri ko ni akɛtee.
No dani ooonu Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ shishi, ni ooona Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee; ejaakɛ Yehowa hãa aleɔ nii; edaaŋ nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jɛɔ.
Ehãa jalɔi leɔ nii jogbaŋŋ ni eji tsɛŋ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ.
Ebuɔ jalɔi ajalɛ saneyeli he, ni ebaa emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ agbɛi ayi.
No dani obaanu jalɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ anɔkwayeli kɛ nɔ ni ji jeŋba kpakpa shishi.
Ni obaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni nilee baahã osusuma mii ashɛ ehe.
Jwɛŋmɔ aaabaa oyi, ni niiashishinumɔ aaabu ohe.
Eeejie bo kɛjɛ jeŋba fɔŋ gbɛ nɔ, kɛaajɛ mɛi ni wieɔ yaka wiemɔ adɛŋ, kɛ mɛi ni ekwa jalɛ gbɛi ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dujiaŋ gbɛi anɔ lɛ.
Eeejie bo kɛjɛ mɛi ni nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ yɛ nɔ fɔŋ feemɔ he lɛ adɛŋ.
Eeejie bo kɛjɛ mɛi ni amɛgbɛi ekɔ̃dɔ̃ ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ adɛŋ.
Nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ; nilee baajie bo kɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ yoo kɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Eeejie bo kɛjɛ yoo ni ekwa eblayeiaŋ wu, ni ehiɛ ekpa kpãŋmɔ ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ yoo lɛ, ewe lɛ gbele gbɛ ni; egbɛi fɛɛ anaa kã kɛmiiya gbohiiaje.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa eŋɔɔ, ni eku esɛɛ eba pɛŋ, walagbɛ bɔɔ mɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kasemɔ mɛi kpakpai ajeŋba koni ojeŋba atamɔ jalɔi anɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ja lɛ, amɛaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ ji mɛi ni aaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi yiwalɔi lɛ aaafolɔ amɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ashwie, ni kutumpɔfoi lɛ aaafamɔ amɛ kɛ amɛshishifãi kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ŋaawoo kɛhã oblahii kɛ oblayei Mibi, ohiɛ akakpa mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato otsui mli, ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ baahã owala sɛɛ atsɛ afii babaoo, ni obaashwere yɛ wala mli.
Kaahã mlihilɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli miishi bo; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ, ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ; no dani ooona nyam kɛ bulɛ kpakpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Okɛ ohiɛ afɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ kɛ otsui fɛɛ, ni okɛ ohe akakpasa bo diɛŋtsɛ ojwɛŋmɔ; kaimɔ lɛ yɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ amli, ni lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ ni ja ni onyiɛ nɔ.
Kaabu ohe nilelɔ; she Yehowa gbeyei, ni owi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.
Enɛ aaafee tsamɔ ahã bo, ni eeewo owui amli hewalɛ.
Okɛ onii ni oyɔɔ kɛ onibaanii fɛɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ awo Yehowa hiɛ nyam; no dani aaahã oboŋoi lɛ ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmãa, ni owain gbɛi lɛ hu aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ wain.
Mibi, kaagbe Yehowa tsɔsemɔ lɛ he guɔ, ni kaahã ekãmɔ hu miije otsine.
Bɔ ni tsɛ kãa ebi ni eyɔɔ ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ, nakai pɛ Yehowa kãa ebi ni esumɔɔ lɛ hu.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni leɔ nii, ni enaa niiashishinumɔ hu lɛ, ejaakɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ no mli lɛ, ehi fe sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika mli.
Nilee kɛ niiashishinumɔ jara wa aahu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ akɛto nilee he.
Wala sɛɛtsɛlɛ yɛ eninejurɔ kɔkɔŋ, ni ninamɔ kɛ anunyam yɛ ebɛku kɔkɔŋ.
Miishɛɛ yɛ etɛmpɔŋi anɔ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ egbɛi anɔ.
Nilee lɛ wala tso ni hã mɛi ni kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛɔ lɛ, ni mɛi ni hiɛ emli kpɛŋŋ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ.
Yehowa kɛ nilee to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni jwɛŋmɔ ni mli kwɔ ekɛhã ŋwɛi ma shi shiŋŋ.
Enilee naa hãa fai tueɔ, ni ehãa atatui lɛ nyɔɔ bɔ shwieɔ shi.
Mibi, kɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ ato; kaahã ohiɛ miije nɔ kwraa, ni eeehã ona wala kɛ hewulamɔnii.
No dani ooonyiɛ ogbɛ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, ni otɛŋ onane.
Kɛ oho okã shi lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; shi moŋ oookã shi, ni owɔ lɛ aaaŋɔɔ.
Kaashe kpatu nɔ ko ni baahã otsui afã, aloo bɔ ni ahum fɔŋ tswaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ Yehowa ji ohiɛnɔkãmɔ, ni lɛ eeebu ohe, ni ooofee shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi ni esa amɛ ejurɔfeemɔ lɛ, kaakãmã amɛ, kɛji eyɛ ohewalɛ mli akɛ ooonyɛ ofee lɛ.
Kɛji nɔ ko yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛfee onaanyo lɛ ejurɔ lɛ, kaafee lɛ “Yaa ni oba, yaa ni oba”.
Kaato onaanyo ko he ŋaa fɔŋ, be mli ni lɛ lɛ ehiɛ kã onɔ akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ omasɛi.
Okɛ mɔ ko akabe yakatswaa, kɛji efeko bo efɔŋ ko.
Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ yiwalɔ ko nɔ, ni egbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ hu kaakɔ amɛmli ekoeko; ejaakɛ Yehowa miihi nɔfɔŋfeelɔ, shi jalɔi lɛ eheɔ amɛ eyeɔ.
Yehowa loomɔ kã mɛi fɔ̃ji awe nɔ; shi jalɔi awe lɛ, ejɔɔ nɔ.
Yehowa yeɔ hefɛoyelɔi ahe fɛo, shi mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ enaa amɛ mɔbɔ.
Nilelɔi ahiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashiai naa hiɛshishwiemɔ.
Nilee he sɛɛnamɔ Bii, nyɛboa nyɛtsɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛfea toi ni nyɛlea sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Jeŋba kpakpa he ŋaa miwoɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; nyɛkakwaa mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ.
Be ni mi ji gbekɛnuu yɛ mitsɛ masɛi, ni minyɛ bi koome ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe ji mi lɛ, mitsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hã otsui amɔ miwiemɔi amli, ye mikitãi ni miwoɔ bo lɛ anɔ, ni oyi aaana wala.
Na nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Ohiɛ akakpa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni kaaŋmɛɛ he hu.
Kaakwa nilee, ni eeebaa oyi; suɔmɔ lɛ, ni eeebu ohe.
Nilee shishijee ji ona nilee, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ona lɛ okɛtao sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Buu nilee akɛ nɔ ko ni jara wa, ni eeewo onɔ; kɛji oloo lɛ atuu lɛ, eeewo ohiɛ nyam.
Nilee aaafi bo anunyam akekre, ni eeebu bo maŋtsɛ fai ni yɔɔ fɛo.” Mibi, bo toi, ni omɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli koni owala sɛɛ atsɛ.
Mitsɔ̃ɔ bo nilee gbɛ lɛ; mikɛ bo etsɔ̃ jalɛ tɛmpɔŋi anɔ.
Kɛji onyiɛ gbɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ onane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ, ni kɛji ojo foi yɛ nɔ po, otɛŋ.
Mɔ tsɔsemɔ mli waa, kaaŋmɛɛ he.
Okɛto jogbaŋŋ, shi no ji owala.
Kaayi yiwalɔi agbɛ nɔ, ni mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ hu okanyiɛ nɔ.
Wii ohe kɛje gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ, kaayi nɔ; tsi ohe kɛje nɔ kwraa, ni ofo mli kɛya.
Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji wɔɔɔ akɛ ja amɛfee efɔŋ dã.
Wɔ po tseɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ ja amɛna mɔ ko awui amɛye dã.
Ejaakɛ efɔŋfeelɔi aŋmãa ji yiwalɛ, ni amɛwain ji basabasafeemɔ.
Shi jalɔi agbɛ lɛ etamɔ leebi la ni kpɛɔ, ni eyaa nɔ ekpɛɔ aahu kɛyashiɔ shwane.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ lɛ etamɔ duŋ kabitii; amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛnaaa nibii ni amɛtɛrɛɔ lɛ.
Mibi, ka otoi ohã miwiemɔi lɛ; ba otoi shi ohã nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ.
Ohiɛ akaje nɔ.
Kɛto otsui mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ wala eji hã mɔ ni nine shɛɔ nɔ, ni eji tsabaa hã ehewojiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ohiɛ akã otsui he fe nii fɛɛ; ejaakɛ no mli wala jɛɔ.
Wiemɔ gbonyo akaje onaa; ni kaaye kutumpɔo.
Too ohiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ohiɛ ama he ni oyaa lɛ nɔ.
Le onanefãamɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ ogbɛi fɛɛ aaaja ahã bo.
Kaagba ejurɔ loo abɛku.
Tsi ohe kɛje efɔŋ he.
Gbãlãfitemɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ Mibi, bo minilee lɛ toi, ni oka otoi ohã miniiashishinumɔ; koni ole sanesɛɛkɔmɔ, ni odaaŋ wiemɔi aaajie onilee kpo.
Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, enaa ŋɔɔ tamɔ wo, ni edaaŋ shamɔɔ fe eŋmɔmi.
Ni naagbee mli lɛ ejoɔ tamɔ taatso; enaaba tamɔ klante kɛ enaa nta.
Enyiɛ gbele gbɛ, ni ebaakpala bo kɛya gbohiiaje.
Enyiɛɛɛ wala gbɛ, hewɔ lɛ eduɔ gbɛ ni eleee.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mibi, bo mi toi, ni kaashi miwiemɔi lɛ asɛɛ.
Tsi ohe kɛje nɛkɛ yoo he kwraa.
Kaabɛŋkɛ ewe lɛ shinaa lɛ naa tete.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ obulɛ baalaaje, ni yiwalɔi aaafo owala sɛɛ; asaŋ nii ni okɛ ohewalɛ tsu lɛ gbɔi baaye amɛtɔrɔ; ni nibii ni ogbo deŋme yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaaya mɔkpɔŋ ko we.
Ni onaagbee mli lɛ, be ni ohewolo kɛ ogbɔmɔtso hiɛ ekpãtã lɛ obaakɛ̃mɔ.
No be mli oookɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ kwraa minyɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni mikpoo kamɔ̃ kɛjɛ mitsui mli tɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?
Mibooo mitsɔ̃ɔlɔi atoi, ni mikaaa mitoi mihãaa mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii lɛ.
Shwɛ shrao ni mihiɛ akpãtã kwraa yɛ asafo lɛ mli.” Ye oŋa anɔkwa, ni oŋɔ suɔmɔ ohã lɛ ekoome pɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ mli nu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bii ni okɛ yei krokomɛi aaafɔ lɛ, onaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ.
Obii lɛ adara yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owe, koni amɛye amɛbua bo diɛŋtsɛ, shi jeee mɛi kpɔ̃ji.
No hewɔ lɛ, na oŋa he miishɛɛ koni omii ashɛ oblahiiaŋ yoo ni oyakpee lɛ he.
Ehe fɛo tamɔ ofrote, ni ehe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ yɔɔ; ehe akɔnɔ lɛ ashɛje omii be fɛɛ be; hã ni esuɔmɔ aŋɔ bo nom.
Shi mibi, mɛɛba yoo ni bɛ jeŋba he feɔ bo akɔnɔ, ni oloɔ yoo mɔkpɔŋ atuu?
Ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ, enaa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ, ni eekwɛ oyaa kɛ obaa fɛɛ.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ enifɔji anii lɛ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni eshai ni efeɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ fimɔɔ lɛ tamɔ kpãa.
Egboɔ ejaakɛ ebɛ tsɔsemɔ, ni ekwashiafeemɔ babaoo hewɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.
Mibi, kɛji owo onaanyo ko shi yɛ sane ko mli, aloo okɛ mɔ ko ta abasa yɛ onaanyo ko hewɔ, ni atsɔ̃ olilɛi nɔ adu bo, aloo atsɔ̃ odaaŋ wiemɔ nɔ amɔ bo lɛ, mibi, feemɔ enɛ ni okɛjie ohe; ejaakɛ onaanyo lɛ nine egbe bo.
Yaa oya mramra ni oyakpa onaanyo lɛ fai.
Kaahã ohiŋmɛii miina wɔ miiwɔ.
Kaahã wɔ miiba ohiɛsɛɛ kwraa.
Jiemɔ ohe kɛjɛ edɛŋ tamɔ soŋai jieɔ ehe yɛ gbɔbilɔ dɛŋ, aloo tamɔ loofɔlɔ jieɔ ehe yɛ loofɔlɔdulɔ dɛŋ lɛ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ, yaa tsatsu ŋɔɔ, jwɛŋmɔ enifeemɔi ahe ni ole nii.
Lɛ po ni ebɛ maŋtsɛ loo nɔkwɛlɔ loo nɔyelɔ ko kwraa lɛ, etaoɔ eniyenii etoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli, ni ebuaa eŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli.
Hejɔ̃lɔ, mɛɛbe oookã shi owɔ kɛyashi?
Mɛɛbe nɔŋŋ ooote shi kɛaajɛ owɔ mli?
Hejɔ̃lɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mawɔ fioo; majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo; makota miniji majɔɔ mihe fioo.” Be ni ooohɛle shi lɛ, ohia ebatua bo tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ aaatua bo tamɔ tabilɔ ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.
Yakagbɔmɔ, nɔfɔŋfeelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, enyiɛɔ eyeɔ kutumpɔo.
Ebɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi, ekɛ enaji tete wieɔ, ni ekɛ ewaobii toɔ okadi.
Etoɔ nibii fɔ̃ji yɛ etsui mli, eshwieɔ eyiŋ ŋaa fɔŋ daa, bei sɔŋŋ ewoɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakpãtã trukaa, ni aaakumɔ lɛ trukaa ashwie shi bɔ ni ebɛ tsabaa.
Yehowa miihi nibii kpawo: hewoo; amale lilɛi kɛ niji ni shwieɔ lá ni efeko efɔŋ ko shi.
Tsui ni shwieɔ yiŋ fɔŋ, naji ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase, ni efoɔ sane ni bɛ mli etãa; mɔ ni woɔ nanemɛi ateŋ bei.
Gbãlãfitemɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ Mibi, ye otsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ, ni nii ni onyɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ kaakwa ekoeko.
Ŋɔɔ kitãi lɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ oto otsui mli daa nɛɛ; ŋɔɔ ofi okuɛ.
Kɛji onyiɛ lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ; kɛji okã shi owɔ lɛ, eeebu ohe, ni kɛji ohiɛ tsɛ̃ lɛ, ekɛ bo aaagba sane.
Ejaakɛ kitã lɛ, kane ni, ni mla lɛ, la ni, ni tsɔsemɔkãmɔ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ aaabaa oyi kɛje yoo fɔŋ dɛŋ, eeekpɔ̃ bo kɛje yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lilɛi dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Kaadi ehe fɛo sɛɛ yɛ otsui mli, ni kaahã ekɛ ehiɛsɛɛ miimɔ bo.
Abaanyɛ akɛ aboloo akwaabɔ abɔ yoo ajwamãŋ apaa, shi yoo gbãlãfitelɔ aaahã nuu wala tete abɔ lɛ.
Aso mɔ ko aaaje la ashwie emiinaa, ni etadei eshãŋ?
Aloo mɔ ko aaanyiɛ ŋai kɛ la nɔ, ni enaji eshaŋ?
Nakai eji hã nuu ni nyiɛɔ mɔ kroko ŋa sɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaata ehe ni eeeye ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Kɛji hɔmɔ naa kɛkɛ ni julɔ yaju lɛ, agbeee ehe guɔ.
Shi kɛji amɔ lɛ lɛ, ani ahaŋ eto najiaŋ toi kpawo lo?
Ekɛ ewe nii fɛɛ tswɛm hãa.
Shi nuu ni fiteɔ gbãlã lɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ; mɔ ni feɔ nakai lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efiteɔ.
Pilamɔ kɛ heguɔgbee eeena, ni ehiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ atsumɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejaakɛ awuŋayeli hãa nuu mlifu naa waa, ni kɛji eetɔ owele lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔɔ efiliii.
Eheŋ kpãtãmɔ nii ko, ni nyɔɔŋnii pii po ebaakwa.
Mibi, ye miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mikitãi lɛ ato.
Ye mikitãi lɛ anɔ ní oyi ana wala; ni obu mitsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tamɔ ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ.
Hã ehi owaobii anaa.
Ŋmãa yɛ otsuiŋ tao lɛ nɔ.
Tsɛ nilee akɛ, “Minyɛmi yoo,” koni otsɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ akɛ oshieŋnyɛ.
Amɛ amɛaabaa oyi kɛjɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba dɛŋ, amɛaakpɔ̃ bo kɛjɛ yoo ni naa yɔɔ dɔkɔbii lɛ dɛŋ.
Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ Ejaakɛ mitsɔ̃ miwe lɛ samflɛ lɛ mli mikwɛ, ni mina oblanyo ko ni bɛ yitsoŋ, yɛ oblahii komɛi ni ajwɛŋmɔ esako komɛi ateŋ.
Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ gbɛjegbɛ ko ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo nɛɛ shĩa lɛ koŋ lɛ nɔ; ni eyi yoo lɛ we lɛ gbɛ.
Gbɛkɛ ni, ni hiɛ efee tuutuu, ni duŋ kpii miihe awo.
Ni naa, yoo ko kɛ oblanyo lɛ bakpe.
Yoo lɛ wo ajwamãŋ atade, ni etsui esa.
Enaa wa, ni etoi egbo, ni etaaa shĩa.
Bianɛbianɛ etee agbo lɛ naa; bianɛbianɛ etee jara lɛ nɔ, ni ewoɔ ka yɛ tsu koŋ fɛɛ tsu koŋ.
Yoo nɛɛ mɔ oblanyo lɛ ni eshwɔ enaa, ni yoo lɛ mia ehiɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kulɛ esa akɛ mashã afɔle, shi ŋmɛnɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ miyawo mishiwoonii lɛ.
No hã mije kpo koni mabɔ mɔdɛŋ matao bo ni mikɛ bo akpe, ni trukaa mibana bo nɛɛ.
Mikɛ saanɔboi ni akɛ kpãi sui srɔtoi ni akɛjɛ Ijipt loo eha misaa lɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ mire kɛ aloe kɛ sinamon ewo misaa lɛ mli ŋma.
Ba ni wɔkɛ suɔmɔ ajie wɔkɔnɔ kɛyashi leebi.
Wɔkɛ suɔmɔ anya kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ miwu bɛ, efã gbɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Ehiɛ shika pii kɛ kotoku kɛtee.
Nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ baaye emuu dani ebaaba.” Yoo lɛ kɛ ewiemɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ kɔne oblanyo lɛ yiŋ, ni eyitsoŋ tsɔ̃.
Ekɛ enaa dɔkɔbii lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ewe.
Oblanyo lɛ nyiɛ yoo lɛ sɛɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ kɛtee ewe lɛ tamɔ tsina ni ayaagbe lɛ, aloo ofrote ni tsɔne edu lɛ kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni gãimlibi tsuɔ emusuŋ nii amli.
Etamɔ loofɔlɔ ni shaa foi kɛyaduɔ tsɔne ni eleee akɛ lɛ ewala hewɔ atsɔ̃ tsɔne lɛ.
Oo, mibii, nyɛboa mi toi agbɛnɛ.
Nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ.
Kaahã otsui mɔ nɛkɛ yoo.
Kaadu gbɛ kɛyaje egbɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ yoo ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ, mɛi ni egbe lɛ ayi fa naakpa.
Ewe lɛ, gbohiiaje gbɛ ni, ekã kɛmiiya gbele piai amli tɔ̃ɔ.
Nilee yijiemɔ Ani jeee blɔmɔ nilee bolɔɔ kɛtsɛɔ lɛ; ni jeee niiashishinumɔ hu woɔ egbee lɛ?
Edamɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ he yɛ ŋmaŋmashai lɛ.
Ebolɔɔ gegeege yɛ maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ lɛ klotia yɛ shinaa lɛ shi akɛ, “Oo, nyɛ hii, nyɛ mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ, ni nyɛ gbɔmɛi abii, nyɛ miwoɔ migbee nɔ mihãa.
Oo, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnako jwɛŋmɔ, nyɛkasea hiɛtɛ̃ɛ.
Oo, nyɛ hii kwashiai hu, nyɛboa toi jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛboa toi, ejaakɛ mibawie wiemɔi wuji ni he jaraa; ni minaa ni magbele nɛɛ, wiemɔi ni ja sɔŋŋ aaajɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ aaajɛ midaaŋ; minaabu miihi nɔ fɔŋ.
Midaaŋ wiemɔi fɛɛ lɛ, jalɛ ni, ekoeko bɛ mli ni ji amale loo kutumpɔo.
Fɛɛ kã shi faŋŋ hã mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛja yɛ nilelɔ hiɛ.
Nyɛmɔa mitsɔsemɔ lɛ moŋ mli fe jwiɛtɛi, kɛ nilee hu mli fe shika ŋmiiŋmi.
Ejaakɛ nilee hi fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o, ni nɔ ko bɛ ni obaatao ni kɛ lɛ ye hegbɔ.
Mi, nilee, mihiɛ tɛ̃; mile nii, ni mibuɔ atɛŋ kpakpa.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji ohi nɔ fɔŋ.
Hewoo kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ miihi.
Minɔ ji ŋaawoo kɛ nilee kpakpa, miyɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ; miyɛ hewalɛ hu.
Minɔ maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nɔyelɔi hu woɔ jalɛ mla.
Minɔ lumɛi tsɔ̃ɔ yeɔ lumɔ, ni abladei yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Misumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɛi ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ taoɔ mi lɛ, naa mi.
Ninamɔ kɛ anunyam fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; ninamɔ ni sɛɛ tsɛɔ kɛ shweremɔ fɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
Miyibii hi fe shika, efe shika ŋmiiŋmi; ni minibaanii lɛ hu hi fe jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ.
Minyiɛɔ jalɛ gbɛ nɔ, ni mikojoɔ jalɛ naa.
Ni mɛi ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, mifeɔ amɛ niiatsɛmɛi, ni miwoɔ amɛfotroi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mi Yehowa bɔ kɛje enitsumɔ shishi; mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ yɛ eblema nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe abɔ mi klɛŋklɛŋ dani aje jeŋbɔɔ shishi.
Be ni ŋshɔ tete po bɛ lɛ, afɔ mi momo, be ni nuhiŋmɛi bɛ lɛ, miyɛ momo.
Dani ashɔ̃ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ, afɔ mi momo.
Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ nako ebɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ jwɛii kɛ je lɛ mli mlu tete lɛ, mi lɛ, abɔ mi momo.
Be ni ebɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, miyɛ jɛi; be ni efo ŋshɔ he akrabatsa lɛ, miyɛ.
Be ni eŋɔ atatui lɛ esɛŋ shi shiŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi, ní etsi ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ naa lɛ, miyɛ.
Be ni efo husu ewo ŋshɔ lɛ he, ni nu akaku ekitã lɛ nɔ, be ni eto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, miyɛ emasɛi akɛ ŋaawolɔ.
Ni mi ji emiishɛjelɔ daa.
Ni mimii shɛɔ mihe yɛ ehiɛ.
Minaa je lɛ he miishɛɛ, minaa gbɔmɛiabii ahe tsuijurɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibii nyɛboa mi toi!
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ mimlai anɔ lɛ!
Nyɛboa tsɔsemɔ toi koni nyɛle nii; ni nyɛkakwaa lɛ kwraa.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni boɔ mi toi ni ebuɔ migboi lɛ anaa daa ní emɛɔ daa yɛ mishinai lɛ anaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni aaaná mi lɛ, ena wala ni ehiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi mɔ ni nine shɛɛɛ minɔ lɛ, eeye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma awui.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ, amɛmiisumɔ gbele.”
Nilee kɛ kwashiafeemɔ Nilee ema etsu kɛ ehe akulashiŋi kpawo.
Egbe elɛɛ kooloi; efutu ewain lɛ, ni eŋmɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ lɛ hu.
Etsu etsuji yei lɛ kɛtee maŋ lɛ mli hei grɔŋŋi fe fɛɛ lɛ, ni amɛyatsɛ mɛi akɛ, “Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, ebatsɔ̃ biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni obaye miniyenii lɛ eko ni obanu wain ni mifutu lɛ eko.
Kaaŋɔ ohe obɔ kwashia he, koni oyi ana wala; ni dii sanesɛɛkɔmɔ sɛɛ.” Mɔ ni jajeɔ hefɛoyelɔ jeŋba lɛ, enaa jɛmɔ; ni mɔ ni kãa yiwalɔ lɛ, enaa pilamɔ.
Hɛfɛoyelɔ lɛ kɛ okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaanyɛ bo; shi nilelɔ lɛ kɛji okã ehiɛ lɛ, ebaasumɔ bo.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nilelɔ nii, ni eeele nii efata nɔ ni ele momo lɛ he; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ jalɔ nii, ni enilee aaafa.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji nilee shishijee; ni Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ lee ji sanesɛɛkɔmɔ.
Ejaakɛ minɔ baatsɔ̃ ni ogbii baafa; ni owala afii lɛ asɛɛ baatsɛ.
Kɛ ole nii lɛ, ole ohã ohe; shi kɛ hefɛoyelɔ ji bo lɛ, bo okome obaatere.
Yoo kwashia lɛ, naawalɔ ni, ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehiɛgbele tɔ ejwa.
Etaa shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshinaa shi; etaa hei grɔŋŋi lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni etsɛɔ mɛi ni hoɔ ni amɛnyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛ nɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ.
Ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ, eba biɛ,” ni mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nu ni ayaju lɛ, enumɔ ŋɔɔ.
Ni aboloo ni ateɔ ayeɔ lɛ eyɛ akɔnɔ.” Mɛi ni ekpeɔ kɛyaa ewe lɛ leee akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yaa jɛi lɛ gboiɔ; amɛleee akɛ mɛi ni akpee kɛtee jɛi momo lɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ amɛyɔɔ lɛ.
Solomon Abɛi Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi bi kwashia lɛ, ehãa enyɛ tsui yeɔ.
Efɔŋfeemɔ mli ninamɔ lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi jalɛ hereɔ mɔ yiwala yɛ gbele dɛŋ.
Yehowa hãaa hɔmɔ aye jalɔi; shi nɔ ni efɔŋfeelɔi shweɔ akɛ amɛna lɛ, etswaa yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Mɔ ni nijiaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ohia hiaa lɛ, shi mɔ ni nine kãaa shi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ.
Bi ni buaa ŋmãa naa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi bi ni wɔɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgbele ni.
Ajɔɔ mɛi ni feɔ jalɛ nii, shi efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ haa amɛyitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
Kɛ akai jalɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ lɛ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ atsiŋ egbɛi tã ajɔŋ lɛ.
Nilelɔ kpɛlɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ; shi kwashia naafuutsɛ hiɛ kpãtãa.
Anɔkwayelɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe, shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, aaayoo lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ekãa kãa mɔ lɛ hãa toiŋjɔlɛ baa.
Jalɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; shi efɔŋfeelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ haa yitsoŋwalɛ nɔ.
Nyɛɛ teɔ bei shi; shi suɔmɔ haa tɔ̃mɔi fɛɛ anɔ.
Niiashishinulɔ daaŋ anaa nilee yɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ kpãa kã ekotosɛɛ.
Nilelɔ tiaa nilee, shi kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa.
Niiatsɛ nii ji emɔ̃ɔ ni wa lɛ, shi ohia kpãtãa ohiafo hiɛ.
Jalɛ nitsumɔ he nyɔmɔwoo lɛ wala ni, efɔŋfeemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji esha.
Mɔ ni boɔ tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, enyiɛɔ gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli nɔ; shi mɔ ni kwaa kãmɔ lɛ, eduɔ gbɛ.
Mɔ ni kɛ nyɛɛ teɔ lɛ, amalelɔ ni; mɔ ni yeɔ mɔ he osheku lɛ, kwashia ji lɛ.
Wiemɔ babaoo yɔɔ nɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ kpaaa yɛ mli; shi mɔ ni le enaabu mli mɔmɔ lɛ, nilelɔ ni.
Jalɔ lilɛi lɛ, etamɔ jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ; shi mɔ fɔŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
Jalɔ naabu lɛɔ mɛi babaoo, shi kwashia lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ ni ebɛ hewɔ lɛ egboɔ.
Yehowa jɔɔmɔ lɛ, no feɔ mɔ niiatsɛ; shi odeŋmegbomɔ nyɛŋ ekɛ nɔ ko afata he.
Kwashia lɛ efɔŋfeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ, shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, nilee feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ.
Nɔ ni mɔ fɔŋ sheɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba enɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ enine aaashɛ etaomɔnii anɔ.
Kɛ ahum tswa pɛ, mɔ fɔŋ yi etã, shi jalɔ hiɔ shi shweshweeshwe kɛyaa naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Bɔ ni ashiŋ feɔ nyanyɔji ni lasu feɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ feɔ mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ hãa wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji afii lɛ, aaafo nɔ.
Jalɔi ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ baafee miishɛɛ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔ lɛ baafee yaka.
Yehowa ji mɔɔ ni wa hã mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, shi eji hiɛkpãtãmɔ hã efɔŋfeelɔ.
Jalɔ lɛ eeehi shi shweshweeshwe; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ ehiŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jalɔi alilɛi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi kutumpɔo lilɛi lɛ, aaafo ashɛ afɔ̃.
Jalɔi anaabu le nɔ ni sa wiemɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ wieɔ kutumpɔo wiemɔ.
Yehowa miihi shishiumɔ nsɛni, shi nsɛnitɛ shishiishi lɛ enaa he miishɛɛ.
Kɛ hewoo ba pɛ, hiɛgbele nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, shi heshibalɔ lɛ nilelɔ ni.
Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; shi kutumpɔfo lɛ eshishiumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kpãtãa ehiɛ.
Mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ninamɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko; shi jalɛ jieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele dɛŋ.
Jalɔ lɛ enɔkwayeli hãa egbɛ jaa ehãa lɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ gbeɔ lɛ shi.
Mɛi ni ja lɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aajie amɛ, shi kutumpɔfoi lɛ, amɛkɔnɔ ŋɔɔ amɛ nom.
Kɛ mɔ fɔŋ gbo lɛ; ehiɛnɔkãmɔ laajeɔ; ni mɔ ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeɔ yaka.
Ajieɔ jalɔi kɛjɛɔ haomɔ mli; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji yanyɔɔ haomɔ mli.
Mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi fiteɔ amɛnanemɛi; shi atsɔ̃ɔ nilee nɔ, ni ajieɔ jalɔi.
Kɛji nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tee nɔ jogbaŋŋ hã jalɔ lɛ maŋ fɛɛ nyaa; ni kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji ahiɛ kpãtã lɛ, maŋ fɛɛ bɔɔ oshe kɛ miishɛɛ.
Jalɔi adɛŋ jɔɔmɔ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji anaabu butuɔ maŋ.
Mɔ ni gbeɔ enaanyo he guɔ lɛ, ebɛ yitsoŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ efeɔ diŋŋ.
Mɔ ni tãa sane kɛfoɔ shi lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ anɔkwale mumɔ lɛ etsimɔɔ sane nɔ.
He ni maŋ kudɔmɔ bɛ lɛ, maŋ gbeɔ shi; shi he ni ŋaawolɔi pii yɔɔ lɛ, maŋ feɔ shweshweeshwe.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeeshwa ehe; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe wooo mli lɛ ehi hã lɛ.
Yoo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam tiuɔ woo sɛɛ, ni nuu yiwalɔ tiuɔ ninamɔ sɛɛ.
Mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ejurɔ efeɔ; shi mɔ ni yitsoŋ wa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe efɔŋ efeɔ.
Mɔ fɔŋ naa shishiumɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ enaa anɔkwale mli nyɔmɔwoo.
Mɔ ni fiɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ jalɛ mli lɛ, eyi aaana wala; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ sɛɛ lɛ egboɔ.
Yehowa miihi mɛi ni hiɛ yitso fɔŋ; shi Yehowa sumɔɔ mɛi ni shwamɔ bɛ amɛjeŋba he.
Na ole akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ efɔŋfeelɔ yeŋ ehe; shi jalɔ lɛ aaahere eyiwala.
Yoo ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ebɛ jeŋba kpakpa lɛ etamɔ kplotoo ni awo egugɔ mli shika ga. Jalɔi shweɔ nibii kpakpai sɔŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛkwɛmɔnii lɛ mlifu ni.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ, shi eyaa nɔ eshwereɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ kɛ̃, mɔ ko hu feɔ kpɛkpɛɛ, shi eyeɔ ohia moŋ.
Mɔ ni edɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, enaa nii, ni mɔ ni hãa mɛi tɔrɔɔ lɛ, lɛ hu etɔɔ.
Mɔ ni tiaa abele etoɔ lɛ, maŋ lomɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni hɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ maŋ jɔɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni tiuɔ nɔ kpakpa sɛɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ naa nɔ kpakpa; shi mɔ ni diɔ efɔŋ sɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ blaa lɛ.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ eninamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ baa gbiŋ ni kpalaa; shi jalɔ aaafrɔke tamɔ baa ŋmɔŋ.
Mɔ ni gbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩaŋbii anaa lɛ, eyeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ; ni buulu tsɔ̃ɔ tsulɔ hãa nilelɔ be fɛɛ be.
Jalɛ yibii lɛ wala ni; shi mla kwamɔ lɛ wala hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.
Kɛji jalɔ lɛ enaa enyɔmɔwoo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ kɛ eshafeelɔ lɛ te amɛnyɔmɔwoo aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ nilee; shi mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, kwashia ni.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa hiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, shi mɔ ni toɔ yiŋ fɔŋ lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ fɔ.
Efɔŋfeemɔ hãaa mɔ afi shi; shi jalɔi ashishi fã lɛ, anyɛŋ afã kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Yoo kpakpa lɛ ewu akekre ji lɛ; shi yoo ni shwieɔ ewu hiɛ shi lɛ, etamɔ wuiaŋ sasabro.
Jalɔ jwɛŋmɔ ja; shi mɔ fɔŋ ŋaawoo lɛ, kutumpɔo ni.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji woɔ lá antɛo, shi jalɔi awiemɔ hereɔ mɔ yiwala.
Abutuɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ; shi jalɔi awe maa shi shiŋŋ.
Gbɔmɔ nilee akɛjieɔ eyi, shi mɔ ni hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, abuuu lɛ.
Ohiafo humi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko.
Jalɔ nuɔ he ehãa eshĩa kooloo tete; shi mɔ fɔŋ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete lɛ, yiwaa ni.
Mɔ ni huɔ eŋmɔ lɛ eeetɔ kɛ ŋmãa pii; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakanii asɛɛ lɛ ebɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Mɔ fɔŋ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa; shi jalɔ shishifã maa shi shiŋŋ.
Mɔ fɔŋ diɛŋtsɛ daaŋ wiemɔ nɔŋŋ ni duɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejeɔ haomɔ mli.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni nɔ ni gbɔmɔ tsuɔ lɛ no he nyɔmɔ awoɔ lɛ.
Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ, egbɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi nilelɔ lɛ, eboɔ ŋaawoo toi.
Kwashia yɔɔ nɛɛ anaa emlifu oya; shi nilelɔ lɛ ebuuu jɛmɔ tete.
Mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, eyeɔ anɔkwa odase; shi amale odasefonyo lɛ mɔ elakaa.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni ewiemɔ bambam dumɔɔ mɔ tamɔ kakla; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ etsaa mɔ.
Anɔkwale wiemɔ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; shi amale lɛ, ehiɔ shi hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ.
Mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ eyi kɛ mɔshishiumɔ; shi mɛi ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ amɛmii shɛɔ amɛhe.
Haomɔ baaa jalɔ nɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ haomɔi jwere enɔ.
Yehowa miihi amalelɔ; shi mɔ ni yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ enaa ehe miishɛɛ.
Nilelɔ kɛ enilee teɔ; shi kwashia jieɔ ekwashiafeemɔ kpo.
Mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ yeɔ onukpa; shi hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ ayeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ.
Mligbigblimɔ dɔɔ mɔ kɔmɔɔ; shi wiemɔ kpakpa yɔɔ nɛɛ ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe.
Jalɔ tsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo gbɛ; shi mɔ fɔŋ hãa mɛi duɔ gbɛ moŋ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ nɔ; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ lɛ enaa nii ni jara wa.
Jalɛ lɛ wala gbɛ ni; shi gbɛ gbonyo lɛ, gbele gbɛ ni.
Bi nilelɔ boɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ toi; hefɛoyelɔ lɛ ebooo kãmɔ toi.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa daaŋ wiemɔ aaahã etɔ kɛ nii kpakpai; shi nɔ ni kutumpɔfoi taoɔ ji basabasafeemɔ.
Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni mɔɔɔ enaabu mli lɛ, eekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ shweɔ nɔ ko, ni enaaa; shi mɔdɛŋbɔlɔ naa nii kɛtekeɔ nɔ.
Jalɔ miihi amale, shi mɔ fɔŋ feɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni ebɔɔ ehe ahora.
Jalɛ buɔ mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ he; shi eshafeemɔ butuɔ mɔ fɔŋ.
Mɔ ko yɛ ni feɔ ehe niiatsɛ, tsɛbelɛ ebɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; mɔ ko hu yɛ ni feɔ ehe ohiafo, tsɛbelɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Gbɔmɔ kpɔ̃mɔ nii ji enii ni eyɔɔ; shi ohiafo bɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛkpɔ̃ɔ ehe.
Jalɔi akane tsoɔ hɛŋŋ; shi mɛi fɔ̃ji akane lɛ aaagbo.
Hewoo lɛ bei kɛkɛ ekɛbaa; shi mɛi ni boɔ ŋaawoo toi lɛ, amɛleɔ nii.
Nii ni anaa oya lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa; shi nii ni akpɛteɔ shi anaa lɛ eshwereɔ.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni baaa mli mra lɛ, ewoɔ mɔ tsui hela; shi kɛji nɔ ni ashweɔ lɛ na ba mli lɛ, ehãa wala.
Mɔ ni gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kitã lɛ, ebaana he sɛɛ.
Nilelɔ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ, wala nubu ni; ejieɔ mɔ kɛjɛɔ gbele akpa mli.
Nilee kpakpa hãa mɔ hiɛ baa nyam; shi kutumpɔfoi agbɛ lɛ ekpãtãa amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ feɔ enii kɛ nilee; shi kwashia gbɛɔ ebuulufeemɔ eshwãa.
Tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ ekɛ mɛi woɔ haomɔ mli; shi bɔfo anɔkwafo lɛ ekɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baa.
Mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ ohia kɛ hiɛgbele ji enɔ; shi mɔ ni buɔ kãmɔ lɛ awoɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Kɛji susuma na nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ; shi kwashiai sumɔɔɔ akɛ amɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
Mɔ ni kɛ nilelɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ kwashiai bɔɔ lɛ eeena jaramɔ.
Eshafeelɔi lɛ efɔŋ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ; shi jalɔi lɛ amɛshwereɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa shiɔ gboshinii ehãa ebii abii; shi eshafeelɔ nii lɛ jalɔ atiaa ahãa.
Ohiafoi ashikpɔŋ ni kã shi efolo baa niyenii pii; shi jalɛ sane ni ayeee hewɔ lɛ, nii lɛ ŋmɛɔ amɛ.
Mɔ ni emiii ni etsɔseɔ ebi kɛ kpãa lɛ, eenyɛ ebi lɛ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔ ebi lɛ, ejeɔ mra etsɔseɔ lɛ.
Jalɔ yɛ nii pii ni eyeɔ etɔɔ; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ musuŋ hɔmɔ po yeɔ lɛ.
Yoo nilelɔ kpɛɔ eshĩa; shi yoo kwashia jwaa eshĩa.
Mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ efeɔ jalɛnii; shi mɔ ni gbeɔ Yehowa he guɔ lɛ efeee jalɛ nii.
Buulu daaŋ wiemɔ gwaoɔ lɛ; shi nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ baa eyi.
He ni tsina hii bɛ lɛ, niyenii bɛ jɛi; shi he ni tsinanuu hewalɔ yɔɔ lɛ jɛi ŋmãa babaoo yɔɔ.
Odasefonyo anɔkwafo maleee; shi apasa odasefonyo maleɔ pam.
Hefɛoyelɔ taoɔ nilee, shi enaaa; shi nilee taomɔ waaa hãaa niiashishinulɔ.
Jee kwashia hiɛ; ejaakɛ onaŋ nilee wiemɔ yɛ edaaŋ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ ni ehiɛ tɛ̃ lɛ, ele he ni eyaa; shi kwashiai abuulufeemɔ hãa amɛduɔ gbɛ.
Kwashia ebuuu eshafeemɔ akɛ eji nɔ fɔŋ; shi jalɔi tiuɔ eshaifaa sɛɛ.
Tsui pɛ ni le enidɔɔnii; ni nɔ ni ji emiishɛɛ lɛ ekɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko ejaaa.
Mɔ fɔŋ we hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi jalɔ we aaashwere.
Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
Ŋmɔlɔ mli tete lɛ, tsui werɛ hoɔ ehe; ni miishɛɛ naagbee lɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baa.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ eeena ejeŋba he nyɔmɔwoo; ni mɔ kpakpa lɛ, eeena enifeemɔnii kpakpa he nyɔmɔwoo.
Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ heɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eyeɔ; shi hiɛtɛ̃lɔ leɔ enanenaa kwɛmɔ.
Nilelɔ sheɔ ehe gbeyei, ni ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; shi kwashia feɔ kakampu ni efeɔ anyagbã.
Mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, efeɔ kwashiaianii, ni yitsofɔŋtsɛ lɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔɔɔ lɛ, abuɔ lɛ buulu fai; shi nilelɔ lɛ afiɔ lɛ nilee akekre.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji kotoɔ mɛi kpakpai, ni efɔŋfeelɔi kotoɔ jalɔi yɛ agboi anaa.
Ohiafo lɛ, enaanyo tete sumɔɔɔ lɛ, shi niiatsɛ lɛ, esuɔlɔi faa babaoo.
Mɔ ni nyaŋeɔ enaanyo lɛ, eshafeelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni feɔ ohiafo ekpakpa lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ŋaa fɔŋ lɛ ani jeee tɔ̃ etɔ̃ɔ lɛ lo?
Shi mɔ ni toɔ ŋaa kpakpa lɛ, afiɔ esɛɛ, ni ayeɔ lɛ anɔkwa.
Sɛɛnamɔ yɛ deŋmegbomɔ mli; shi ohia kɛkɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naabu folo wiemɔ mli.
Nilelɔi akekre ji amɛnilee.
Shi kwashiai akekre ji amɛbuulufeemɔ.
Anɔkwa odasefonyo lɛ ehereɔ gbɔmɛi ayiwala; shi amalelɔ lɛ mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ mli hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mli wa yɔɔ; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ no lɛ ebii naa abobaahe.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ lɛ nuhiŋmɛi ni hãa wala ni, ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbele tsɔnei amli.
Maŋbii ayifalɛ ji maŋtsɛ anunyam; shi kɛji maŋbii bɛ lɛ, lumɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni.
Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, eyɛ niiashishinumɔ kpele; shi mɔ ni mli fuɔ mramra lɛ ejieɔ ebuulufeemɔ kpo.
Toiŋjɔlɛ hãa gbɔmɔtso naa hewalɛ; shi awuŋayeli woɔ wuiaŋ hela.
Mɔ ni waa ohiafo yi lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahora; shi mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, eewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enifɔjianii lɛ nɔŋŋ butuɔ lɛ; shi jalɔ lɛ, ejalɛ ji ebobaahe.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ ele nii; shi kwashia lɛ, ebɛ niiashishinumɔ.
Jalɛ woɔ maŋ nɔ; shi esha lɛ, maŋ ahorabɔɔ ni.
Tsulɔ nilelɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛ sɔɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ, emli fuɔ lɛ.
Naajɔlɛ hetoo kuɔ mlila naa; shi mlila wiemɔ teɔ mlifu shi.
Nilelɔi wieɔ nilee wiemɔi; shi buului awiemɔi jɛɔ kwashiai adaaŋ.
Yehowa hiŋmɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he; ni ekwɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai fɛɛ.
Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ walatso ni; shi kutumpɔo wiemɔ lɛ efiteɔ mɔ mumɔ.
Kwashia gbeɔ etsɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ; shi mɔ ni kpɛlɛ̃ɔ kãmɔ lɛ ehiɛ tɛ̃ɔ.
Jwetri babaoo yɛ jalɔ we, shi mɔ fɔŋ ninamɔ lɛ, ehiɛ kpãtãa.
Nilelɔi awiemɔ gbɛɔ nilee shwãa; shi kwashiai anɔ efeee nakai.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji afɔle lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi jalɔi asɔlemɔ lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.
Mɔ fɔŋ jeŋba lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi mɔ ni tiuɔ jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, esumɔɔ lɛ.
Toigbalamɔ kpele kã shi hã mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ, ni mɔ ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, gbo eeegbo.
Gbohiiaje kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ bu lɛ tete po naa kã yɛ Yehowa hiɛ; aahu ni gbɔmɛi adesai atsuii.
Hefɛoyelɔ yɔɔ nɛɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ akãa lɛ; ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ nilelɔi hu.
Tsui ni eyi kɛ miishɛɛ lɛ, ehãa mɔ tseɔ ehiɛ; shi tsui ni eyi kɛ awerɛho lɛ ehãa mɔ feɔ gblinii.
Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ; shi kwashiai anaabu tiuɔ buulufeemɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Nɔnalɔ gbii fɛɛ lɛ, gbii fɔ̃ji sɔŋŋ ni; shi mɔ ni tsui enyɔ emli lɛ, lɛ lɛ daa nɛɛ eeye gbijurɔ.
Nii fioo ni Yehowa he gbeyeishemɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe jwetri babaoo ni haomɔ yɔɔ he.
Shwie folo ni akɛŋmɛ okplɔ̃ ni suɔmɔ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe tsina ni ewo fɔ ni nyɛɛ yɔɔ he.
Mlilatsɛ teɔ bei shi; shi mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ, ekpãtãa bei.
Anihaolɔ gbɛ tsaa kɛ ŋmei; shi jalɔ gbɛ lɛ gbɛjegbɛ ni.
Bi nilelɔ hãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi kwashia gbeɔ enyɛ he guɔ.
Mɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ feɔ lɛ miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ebaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ.
He ni ajinatoo bɛ lɛ, yiŋtoi feɔ yaka; shi ŋaawolɔi pii hãa yiŋtoi yeɔ omanye.
Wiemɔ hetoohãmɔ ni sa lɛ, ehãa mɔ naa miishɛɛ; ni wiemɔ ni awie yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ, ehi pam.
Nilelɔ gbɛ lɛ, wala gbɛ ni kɛ mɔ yaa ŋwɛi ni; ni ejieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ gbohiiaje bu lɛ mli.
Yehowa wuleɔ hewolɔ we; shi ehãa okulafo husu hiɔ shi.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji ayiŋtoi lɛ, Yehowa miihi; shi wiemɔi ni he tse lɛ, enaa he miishɛɛ.
Hiɛjoolɔ hãa haomɔ baa ewe nɔ; shi mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ nyɔɔŋnii hemɔ lɛ, eyi aaana wala.
Jalɔ jwɛŋɔ bɔ ni eeehã sane hetoo ehã; shi wiemɔi gbohii jɛɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji adaaŋ.
Yehowa kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ateŋ jɛkɛ; shi eboɔ jalɔi afaikpamɔ toi.
Hiɛtsemɔ kɛ mɔhamɔ lɛ, ehãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe; ni sanekpakpa hãa mɔ wuiaŋ woɔ fɔ.
Mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ krɔŋŋ toi lɛ, ehiɔ nilelɔi ateŋ.
Mɔ ni booo tsɔsemɔ toi lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe guɔ; shi mɔ ni boɔ kãmɔ toi lɛ, enaa niiashishinumɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ ji tsɔsemɔ ni hãa mɔ leɔ nii; ni anunyam yɔɔ nɛɛ heshibaa nyiɛɔ ehiɛ.
Yiŋtoo lɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ ni; shi nɔ ni lilɛi wieɔ lɛ, Yehowa ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.
Gbɔmɔ gbɛi fɛɛ ja yɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, ekwɛɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ.
Tuu onitsumɔi owo Yehowa dɛŋ, ni oyiŋtoi aaama shi shiŋŋ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa fee lɛ, eyɛ nɔ hewɔ ni efee; gbi fɔŋ tete lɛ, ekã shi ehã mɔ fɔŋ.
Yehowa miihi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe; kɛ ata abasa yɛ nɔ po, abaagbala etoi.
Anɔkwayeli nɔ Yehowa damɔɔ ni ekɛ eshai faa; ni mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, ewiɔ ehe kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ adesa jeŋba sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ, ehãa ehenyɛlɔi tete kɛ lɛ kpãtãa.
Nii fioo ni ana yɛ anɔkwayeli mli lɛ, ehi fe nii babaoo ni atsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ana.
Gbɔmɔ adesa toɔ egbɛi ahe ŋaa; shi Yehowa ji mɔ ni kudɔɔ enanefãamɔi.
Ŋwɛi hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ wiemɔ mli; ni maŋtsɛ naa kpaaa yɛ atɛŋbuu mli.
Nsɛni kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni yɔɔ shishiishi lɛ, Yehowa nii ni; ni kotoku lɛ mli nsɛnitɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enitsumɔnii ni.
Eji nihiinii akɛ maŋtsɛ aaafee efɔŋ; ejaakɛ jalɛ ni hãa maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i maa shi shiŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛ nyaa mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ he, ni esumɔɔ mɔ ni wieɔ jalɛ wiemɔ.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ mli fu lɛ, gbele aaanyɛ ajɛ mli aba; shi nilelɔ jɔɔ maŋtsɛ tsui he.
Maŋtsɛ hiɛ ni etseɔ ehãa mɔ lɛ, no mli wala yɔɔ, ni emɔhetsuinamɔ tamɔ atatu ni nɛɔ gbo nu.
Kɛji ole nii lɛ ehi aahu fe shika; ni kɛji oyɛ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, ehi fe jwiɛtɛi.
Jalɔi agbɛ gbaa kɛjeɔ efɔŋ he; mɔ ni kwɛɔ ejeŋba jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi.
Hewoo tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; ni hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ mumɔ tsɔ̃ɔ shigbeemɔ hiɛ.
Ehi akɛ ohi shi akɛ humi yɛ ohiafoi ateŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ hewolɔi aaaja nomŋɔɔnii.
Mɔ ni yeɔ Yehowa wiemɔ nɔ lɛ, eeeshwere; ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.
Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ; ni wiemɔ ni ŋɔɔ lɛ, no tsakeɔ mɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nilee lɛ wala nubu ni hã nilelɔ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ buulu nii lɛ, eefee kwashiaianii.
Nilelɔ susuɔ nii ahe dani ewieɔ, ni ehãa ewiemɔ ŋɔɔ mɔ naa.
Naajɔlɛ wiemɔ lɛ, etamɔ wo agbaku; eŋɔɔ susuma naa, ni ehãa gbɔmɔtso hewalɛ.
Gbɛ ko yɛ ni ja yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ; shi enaagbee lɛ gbele gbɛ ni.
Nitsulɔ lɛ, nii ni baa etsine lɛ, no hãa etsuɔ nii waa, ni no nɔŋŋ woɔ lɛ ekãa.
Yakagbɔmɔ toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa fɔŋ, ni edaaŋ wiemɔ shãa mɔ tamɔ la.
Kutumpɔfo gbɛɔ bei eshwãa, ni oshekuyelɔ tserɛɔ nanemɛi ateŋ.
Basabasafeelɔ lakaa ehe gbɔmɔ, ni ekpalaa lɛ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ.
Mɔ ni bɛɔ mɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ, etoɔ yiŋ fɔŋ; ni mɔ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaa ablafa lɛ, ehãa efɔŋ baa mli.
Waŋ lɛ, anunyam akekre ni; jalɛ shihilɛ mli pɛ anaa yɛ.
Mɔ ni mli fuuu mra lɛ ehi fe kãkãlɔ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ emumɔ nɔ lɛ, ehi fe mɔ ni yeɔ maŋ nɔ kunim.
Afɔ̃ɔ oshiki kɛtaoɔ nii anaa; shi bɔ ni eeetamɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ.
Atrɔma gbiŋ ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɔɔ he lɛ, ehi fe niyenii kpɔtɔɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa ni bei yɔɔ mli lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋ ni le nii lɛ, eeeye bi ni feɔ hiɛgbejianii lɛ nɔ; ni eeena gboshinii lɛ eko tamɔ musuŋbi lɛ.
Akɛ kukwɛi kaa jwiɛtɛi akwɛɔ, ni akɛ flɔnɔɔ kaa shika; shi gbɔmɔ tsui lɛ Yehowa ji mɔ ni kaa ekwɛɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔi boɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji awiemɔ toi, ni amalelɔ kaa etoi ehãa wiemɔi ni fiteɔ mɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo he fɛo lɛ, eebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ ohiafo lɛ ahora; ni mɔ ni naa miishɛɛ yɛ mɔ ko amanehulu he lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.
Hiimeji akekre ji amɛnabii; ni bii ahiɛnyam ji amɛtsɛmɛi.
Wiemɔ ni bɛ hiŋmɛi nɔ esaaa kwashia po, aahu ni apasa wiemɔ aaasa ablade.
Nyɔɔŋnihamɔ yɛ mɔ ni hãa lɛ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ ashwã awuja; ni he fɛɛ he ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, efeɔ lɛ akɛ ebaashwere.
Mɔ ni kɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa lɛ, lɛ ehãa naanyobɔɔ mli waa; shi mɔ ni niɔ sane he lɛ, efiteɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ ni kɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enuɔ kãmɔ he fe kwashia ni amãmɔ lɛ atswɛrɛi oha.
Gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ atuatsemɔ pɛ amɛtaoɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, tsulɔ ni yitsoŋ wa atsuɔ kɛyaninaa amɛ.
Ehi akɛ gbɔmɔ kɛ oshishibrishi yoo ni amɔ ebi akpe, fe nɔ ni ekɛ kwashia moŋ aaakpe yɛ ebuulufeemɔ mli.
Mɔ ni kɛ efɔŋ toɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ lɛ, efɔŋ kpaŋ yɛ ewe.
Beibɔ̃imɔ lɛ etamɔ nu ni miitsere kɔikɔi; no hewɔ lɛ, be ni naataamɔ mli wako nɛɛ lɛ, ŋmɛɛmɔ he.
Mɔ ni buɔ efɔŋfeelɔ bem, kɛ mɔ ni buɔ jalɔ fɔ lɛ, Yehowa miihi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ kwashia baana, kɛji ekɛ shika yahe nilee; ejaakɛ ebɛ yitsoŋ.
Naanyo sumɔɔ mɔ be fɛɛ be; ni nyɛmi hu fimɔ be hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ lɛ, lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɔ nɔ akɛ eeedamɔ enaanyo sɛɛ.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eshafeemɔ lɛ, esumɔɔ bei; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ pupuupu lɛ, ejieɔ amane.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, ehiŋ haŋ lɛ; ni mɔ ni yeɔ kutumpɔo lɛ egbeɔ haomɔ mli.
Bi kwashia lɛ eji awerɛho kɛhã etsɛ; ni tsɛ ni efɔ bi kwashia lɛ enaaa miishɛɛ ko.
Tsuijurɔ lɛ tsofa kpakpa ni; shi ŋkɔmɔyeli lɛ egbeɔ mɔ blɛoo.
Efɔŋfeelɔ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii koni etsɔ̃ jalɛ hiɛ ebu shi.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ, etiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ, shi kwashia woɔ ehiɛ emaa he fɛɛ he.
Bi kwashia lɛ etsɛ awerɛho ji lɛ; ni eji tsuiyeli hã enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ.
Ehiii akɛ agbala jalɔ toi aloo ayi ablade yɛ jalɛ sane hewɔ.
Mɔ ni wiemɔ faaa lɛ ele nii, ni mɔ ni mumɔ he jɔ lɛ, enuɔ nii ashishi.
Kwashia tete ni feɔ dioo lɛ, abuɔ lɛ nilelɔ; ni kɛji emua enaa lɛ abuɔ lɛ hiɛtɛ̃lɔ.
Mɔ ni tseɔ ehe kɛjeɔ mɛi ahe lɛ, lɛ pɛ enɔ mli efoɔ; ni jalɛ sane ko bɛ ni abaawie ni ebaaŋɔ nɔ.
Kwashia naaa mɛi ashishinumɔ he miishɛɛ, fe akɛ eeewie nɔ ni etsui kɛɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Be ni efɔŋfeemɔ baa lɛ, heguɔgbee hu miiba.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ lɛ nubu ni mli kwɔ ni; nilee hu tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ.
Ehiii akɛ akwɛ efɔŋfeelɔ hiɛ ni abu lɛ bem, aloo atsɔ̃ jalɔ sane hiɛ abu shi.
Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ bei; ni ewiemɔ hãa ayiɔ lɛ.
Kwashia daaŋ wiemɔ kpãtãa ehiɛ, ni ewiemɔ nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tamɔ tsɔne.
Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii; ekpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbɔmɔ musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mɔ ni kɛ enitsumɔ shashaoɔ shi lɛ, nifitelɔ nyɛmi ni.
Mɔɔ ni wa ji Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, ni no mli jalɔ shaa foi kɛyaa, ni ehiɔ shi shweshweeshwe.
Niiatsɛ nii ni eyɔɔ lɛ ji emɔɔ ni wa; ni etamɔ gbogbo grɔŋŋ ni buɔ ehe?
Henɔwomɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hiɛ; shi heshibaa tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛnyam hiɛ.
Bo sane toi jogbaŋŋ dani ohã hetoo, kɛjee nakai lɛ, obaafee kwashia kɛ buulu.
Gbɔmɔ mli ekãa hãa enyɛɔ hela naa edamɔɔ; shi mumɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ, mɛni no aaanyɛ etsu?
Jwɛŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã shi naa nilee; ni nilelɔ toi tiuɔ nilee sɛɛgbɛ.
Gbɔmɔ dɛŋ nikee jeɔ gbɛ hãa lɛ; ni ekɛ lɛ yaa mɛi wuji ahiɛ.
Mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jajeɔ esane lɛ, efeɔ tamɔ nɔ ni lɛ esane ja; shi kɛ mɔ ni ekɛna lɛ ba ni ebabɔi lɛ sanebimɔ lɛ, no dani akpaa lɛ shi.
Oshikifɔ̃ɔ hãa bei sɛɛ foɔ, ni ebuɔ atɛŋ ehãa kãkãlɔi ni peleɔ nɔ ko he.
Kɛ ofee onyɛmi ekpakpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ maŋ ni wa ehãa bo; shi kɛji okɛ lɛ be lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ agbo sɛɛ adabãŋ ehãa bo.
Gbɔmɔ daaŋ wiemɔ woɔ yibii hãa lɛ; ni edaaŋ wiemɔ hãa etɔɔ.
Gbele kɛ wala yɛ gbɔmɔ lilɛi dɛŋ; amɛteŋ nɔ ni gbɔmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ no eŋɔɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni naa ŋa lɛ, ena nɔ kpakpa, ni ehiɛ baa nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Ohiafo lɛ fai ekpaa kɛ naajɔlɛ; shi niiatsɛ lɛ ewieɔ kpɛŋkpɛŋ.
Nanemɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛfeɔ amɛnii oookɛɛ nanemɛi ji amɛ; shi naanyo krɔŋŋ lɛ ekpɛtɛɔ mɔ gbãgbãlii fe nyɛmi tete.
Ohiafo anɔkwafo lɛ, ehi fe kwashia kutumpɔfo.
Shwe ni ashweɔ nɔ ko ni nilee bɛ mli lɛ ehiii; ni mɔ ni nyiɛɔ kplakpla lɛ eduɔ gbɛ.
Gbɔmɔ buulufeemɔ kɛ lɛ woɔ haomɔ mli, ni eshwaa Yehowa moŋ.
Ninamɔ hãa anaa nanemɛi pii; shi ohiafo lɛ enaanyo tete tsiɔ ehe yɛ ehe.
Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ he ejeŋ sane mli.
Mɛi pii taoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛɔ mlijɔlɔ dɛŋ; ni mɔ ni dɛŋ kpɔɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naanyo ni.
Ohiafo nyɛmimɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ; enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni enanemɛi tsiŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ?
Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛ wiemɔ, shi amɛfooo mli.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, esumɔɔ ehe; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ niiashishinumɔ lɛ eshwereɔ.
Amale odasefonyo yeŋ ehe; ni amalelɔ hiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ninamɔ kpɔtɔɔ esaaa kwashia, aahu ni nyɔŋ aaaye lumɛi anɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ mlifũuu mra; ni ehiɛ ni ekuɔ efɔ̃ɔ tɔ̃mɔ nɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Maŋtsɛ mlifu tamɔ jata huumɔ; shi kɛ ena mɔ he tsui lɛ, etamɔ bɔ ni jwere jwɛi nɔ.
Bi kwashia lɛ ekpãtãa etsɛ hiɛ; ni yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi eshwieɔ shi.
Shĩa kɛ nii lɛ, fɔlɔi ni gboɔ shiɔ hãa mɔ; shi yoo nilelɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
Anihaofeemɔ hãa wɔ ni tsii nyɔɔ mɔ nɔ; ni hejɔ̃lɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaa ewala yi; shi mɔ ni kwaa wiemɔ lɛ, eeegbo.
Mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ, ekɛ miifa Yehowa; ni ejurɔ ni efee lɛ, Yehowa aaato lɛ najiaŋ kɛteke nɔ.
Tsɔsemɔ obi egbekɛbiiashi be ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɔɔ lɛ; shi ekaba oyiŋ akɛ oookpãtã ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni mlifu naa wa lɛ, enaa he nyɔmɔwoo; kɛji ojie lɛ kɛje haomɔ kome mli lɛ, ebaabote ekroko hu mli.
Bo ŋaawoo toi, ni okpɛ̃lɛ tsɔsemɔ koni wɔsɛɛ lɛ, ole nii.
Yiŋtoi pii yɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔŋ; shi nɔ ni Yehowa eto lɛ, no baa mli obɔ̃.
Anɔkwayeli ataoɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; ni ohiafo hi fe amalelɔ.
Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ enɛ lɛ etsui tɔɔ; efɔŋ ko baŋ enɔ.
Anihaolɔ kɛ enine tĩɔ nii yɛ kã mli, ni emiii po ni ekɛ enine lɛ woɔ edaaŋ tete.
Tswaa hefɛoyelɔ nɔ, ni mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako lɛ eeekase nɔ ko yɛŋ.
Kã mɔ ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ hiɛ, ni eeele nii.
Mɔ ni yiɔ etsɛ, ni ewoɔ enyɛ foi kɛjeɔ shĩa lɛ, bi ni woɔ mɔ hiɛgbele ni ebɔɔ mɔ ahora ni.
Mibi, tsɔsemɔ ni hãa aduɔ gbɛ kɛjeɔ nilee he lɛ, kpa toiboo.
Odasefonyo fɔŋ ŋmɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; ni efɔŋfeelɔ naabu nyaa nɔ fɔŋ he.
Fɔbuu kã shi hã hefɛoyelɔi; ni kpãa hu kã shi hã kwashiai akotosɛɛ.
Wain lɛ hefɛoyelɔ ni, ni dãa ni wa lɛ hoofeelɔ ni; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni dãa hãa eduɔ gbɛ lɛ, eleee nii.
Maŋtsɛ mlifu ni naawa lɛ etamɔ jata huumɔ; mɔ ni woɔ maŋtsɛ mlifu lɛ, ewala ŋmɛɔ lɛ.
Eji hiɛ nyam kɛhã nuu kɛji enyaaa bei he; shi kwashia fɛɛ kwashia lɛ, bei ebeɔ.
Hejɔ̃lɔ ni huuu yɛ humɔ be mli lɛ, nikpamɔ be mli lɛ enaŋ nɔ ko ekpa.
Adesa yiŋtoo mlikwɔ tamɔ nubu, shi nilelɔ jieɔ yiŋtoi lɛ kpo.
Mɛi babaoo tsɛɔ amɛhe anɔkwafoi; shi anɔkwafo lɛ namɔ yoɔ lɛ?
Gbɔmɔ ni ji jalɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ajɔɔ eshwiei.
Maŋtsɛ ni taa kojomɔ sɛi nɔ lɛ, enaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ akɛɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, mitsuu mitsui he, ni esha ko be mihe?” Nsɛnitɛi srɔtoi kɛ susumɔ nii srɔtoi lɛ Yehowa miihi fɛɛ.
Gbekɛbii tete hãa akɛ amɛnifeemɔnii yoɔ amɛ, nifeemɔnii lɛ he tse jio, eja jio.
Toi ni nuɔ nii kɛ hiŋmɛi ni naa nii lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni fee enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Wɔ akaŋɔɔ onaa, kɛjeee nakai lɛ obaaye ohia.
Gbelemɔ ohiŋmɛii, ni ooona nii oye otɔ.
Nihelɔ kɛɔ akɛ nɔ ni eheɔ lɛ, “Ehiii, ehiii!” Shi kɛji eyi gbɛ pɛ, eeshwã akɛ ena lɛ ofoo.
Shika kɛ ojarawatɛi babaoo yɛ; shi nilee wiemɔ lɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o ni.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.
Ŋmaa ni akɛ kutumpɔo na lɛ eŋɔɔ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ daaŋ yiɔ tɔ kɛ ŋmlitsa.
Ŋaawoo akɛtoɔ yiŋ, ni nilee akɛwuɔ ta.
Sanetãlɔ lɛ, ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo; no hewɔ lɛ, okɛ naa blɛblɛtsɛ akabɔ.
Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, ewala sɛɛ foɔ tamɔ kane ni agbe yɛ duŋ kpii mli.
Gboshinii ni ana lɛ gidigidi yɛ shishijee mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ baaa nɔ yɛ naagbee mli.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Matɔ efɔŋ he owele.” Mɛɛ Yehowa, ni eeeye ebua bo.
Nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ lɛ Yehowa miihi.
Shishiumɔ nsɛnii ehiii.
Gbɔmɔ nanefaamɔi lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ eyɔɔ; te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni eeele nɔ ni yɔɔ egbɛ nɔ hu?
Eji tsɔne hã gbɔmɔ akɛ eeesha ehe ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni!
Ni shiwoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ kpaako dani ejwɛŋɔ he” ni naashiwoo sɛɛ dani ejwɛŋ he.
Maŋtsɛ nilelɔ shaa efɔŋfeelɔi amli, ni ekɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ kɛgbɛlɛɔ amɛ.
Gbɔmɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, Yehowa kane ni; ni ekpaa gbɔmɔ mligbɛ fɛɛ ekwɛɔ.
Anɔkwayeli baa maŋtsɛ yi, ni jalɛ saneyeli hãa emaŋtsɛ sɛi maa shi shiŋŋ.
Oblahii anunyam ji amɛhewalɛ; shi hiimeji ahefɛo ji amɛyiteŋ waŋ lɛ.
Yii pilamɔ fala lɛ etsumɔɔ esha; ni kpãa yii hu tsuɔ tsui mli fɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ tsui lɛ etamɔ faa ni hoɔ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.
Etsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ.
Gbɔmɔ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ja yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ; shi Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ, tsui mli ekwɛɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli kɛ kojomɔ kpakpa lɛ, esa Yehowa hiɛ fe afɔleshãa.
Henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo tsui lɛ, efɔŋfeelɔi akane ni, ni esha ni.
Hiɛshikãlɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ekɛ shweremɔ baa; shi mɔ ni kɛ hejojomɔ feɔ nɔ lɛ, ekɛ ohia baa.
Jwetri ni akɛ lakamɔ na lɛ, lamɔ ni hoɔ ni, ni gbele taomɔ ni.
Efɔŋfeelɔi anifeemɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, no nɔŋŋ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛfee nɔ ni ja.
Mɔ ni eye fɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, egbɛ ejaaa; shi bemyelɔ lɛ, lɛ egbɛ ja.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shĩa komeŋ.
Yiwalɔi nyaa efɔŋfeemɔ he, amɛnanemɛi po anii efeee amɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛ agbala hefɛoyelɔ toi lɛ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kaseɔ nii kɛjɛɔ mli; ni kɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nilelɔ nii lɛ, eleɔ nii.
Nyɔŋmɔjalɔ lɛ, enaa nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ mɔ fɔŋ we; etsiɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ etswaa shi, ni ekpãtãa ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi ni ekanu ohiafo blɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eeebolɔ ni aboŋ lɛ toi.
Teemɔŋ nikeenii kpãtãa mlifu; ni nikeenii ni jɛ tsui mli hu kuɔ mlila ni naa wa naa.
Kɛ aye jalɛ sane lɛ, jalɔi naa miishɛɛ; shi edɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi.
Mɔ ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ, enaagbeehe ji gbohiiaje; eeeyahi gbohii agwabɔɔ lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni daaŋ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eyeɔ pɔkũu nii lɛ, ohĩa hiaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ wain lɛ, enaŋ nii.
Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, jalɔ kpɔ̃mɔnii ni; ni kutumpɔfo lɛ, mɔ ni eye emuu kpɔ̃mɔnii ni.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi shiaŋa nɔ moŋ fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ yrɛdɛɛ aaahi shi.
Abaa jwetri ni jara wa kɛ mu yi yɛ nilelɔ we; shi kwashia lɛ, kpãtãmɔ ekpãtãa hiɛ.
Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ jalɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enaa wala kɛ hiɛnyam.
Nilelɔ kwɔɔ kãkãlɔi amaŋ he gbogbo, ni ekumɔɔ mɔɔ ni amɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni mɔɔ enaabu kɛ elilɛi mli lɛ, ejieɔ ehe kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli.
Mɔ ni woɔ ehe, ni etsɛɔ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ ehe lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ “hefɛoyelɔ.” Anihaolɔ nitaomɔnii gbeɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eniji ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ nitsumɔ.
Daa gbi lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ miikɔ̃ nii nɔ; shi jalɔ lɛ ehãa, ni ekãmãaa.
Efɔŋfeelɔ afɔle lɛ, nihiinii ni; blɔblɔ ni ekɛba kɛ yiŋsha.
Amale odasefonyo hiɛ aaakpãtã; shi wiemɔ ni jɛɔ mɔ ni nu sane daaŋ lɛ, ehiɔ shi daa.
Mɔ fɔŋ kwaa ehãhãa ehiɛ, shi jalɔ toɔ egbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nilee loo eniiashishinumɔ, loo eŋaawoo ko bɛ ni kɛ Yehowa nɔ lɛ aaafu daa.
Asaa okpɔŋɔ atoɔ tawuu gbi; shi kunimyeli lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe ninamɔ babaoo, ni hiɛnyam hi fe jwiɛtɛi loo shika.
Niiatsɛ kɛ ohiafo lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ amɛ fɛɛ.
Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa osharã miiba ni eteɔ ehe; shi mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ esako kɛ lɛ yakpeɔ, ni ehiɛ kpãtãa.
Heshibaa kɛ Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ he sɛɛnamɔ ji ninamɔ kɛ hiɛnyam kɛ wala.
Ŋmeii kɛ tsɔnei yɛ kutumpɔfo gbɛ nɔ; mɔ ni leɔ ehenɔkwɛmɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛteŋ aaajekɛ.
Tsɔsemɔ gbekɛ bɔ ni eba ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ ehã, ni edalɛ mli lɛ etsakeŋ.
Niiatsɛ yeɔ ohiafo nɔ; ni mɔ ni yafaa nii tsɔ̃ɔ nyɔŋ ehãa mɔ ni fa lɛ nii lɛ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ toikɔdɔmɔ sane lɛ, enaa amanehulu, ni eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ sɛɛ foɔ.
Mɔ ni mli jɔ lɛ aaajɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ eniyenii lɛ eko kumaa ohiafo.
Shwiemɔ hefɛoyelɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ blɔmɔ kɛ bei kɛ jɛmɔ sɛɛ aaafo.
Mɔ ni tsui mli tse, ni ewiemɔ he tse lɛ, maŋtsɛ kɛ lɛ bɔɔ naanyo.
Yehowa hiŋmɛii baa nilee yi; shi amalelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ebaaa yi.
Anihaolɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Jata yɛ agbo lɛ naa; kɛji mije kpo kɛtee blohuŋ lɛ magbo.” Yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ edaa tamɔ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ, mɔ ni Yehowa mli efu lɛ lɛ eeegbee mli.
Buulufeemɔ kpɛtɛ gbekɛ tsui he; shi tsɔsemɔ kpãa lɛ aaashwie buulufeemɔ lɛ kɛaaje ehe kɛya sɛɛ flooflo.
Mɔ ni yeɔ ohiafo amim koni ekɛna nii, shi ekeɔ niiatsɛ nii lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ohia kɛ̃ hiaa lɛ.
Nilee wiemɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ Ba otoi shi koni obo nilelɔi awiemɔi toi; ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ akase nii kɛjɛ minilee lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛji okɛto ojwɛŋmɔ mli, ni onyɛ okai yɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, eyɛ fɛo pam.
Miihã bo tuuŋtu ole enɛɛmɛi ŋmɛnɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ona hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli.
Miŋma nilee wiemɔi kɛ ŋaawoi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ miha bo.
Wiemɔi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale; koni okɛ anɔkwa hetoo ayahã mɛi ni tsu bo lɛ.
- - Kaatswa ohiafo ojo yɛ ohiafo ni eji lɛ hewɔ; asaŋ kaagba nɔnalɔ naa yɛ saneyelihe; ejaakɛ Yehowa yeɔ amɛsane ehãa amɛ; ni mɛi ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ amɛ hu Yehowa aaahao amɛ.
- - Okɛ mlifutsɛ akabɔ naanyo, ni okɛ mlilatsɛ akanyiɛ; koni okɔ amɛjeŋba lɛ ni oyadu tsɔne.
- - Kaafee ohe mɛi ni woɔ shi, loo mɛi ni damɔɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ eko; kɛji obɛ nɔ ko ni okɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashɔ̃ osaa tete yɛ odɛ̃ŋ.
- - Kaatsi blema shikpɔŋ husu kadimɔ nɔ ni otsɛmɛi lɛ eto efɔ̃ shi lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ.
- - Nuu ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, ni ele ŋaa jogbaŋŋ yɛ enitsumɔ mli lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ tete eeedamɔ; edamɔŋ mɛi ni abuuu amɛ ahiɛ.
- - Kɛ ota shi, ni okɛ lumɔ ko baaye nii lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ mɔ hiɛ ni ota lɛ he jogbaŋŋ.
Kɛ oji mɔ ni yeɔ ŋmaa lɛ, kaaye pii, tse nɔ.
Kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miitsɛ̃ onaa, ejaakɛ niyenii ni lakaa mɔ ni.
- - Kaagbo deŋme yɛ ninamɔ he; Okɛ jwɛŋmɔ ato he.
Ohiŋmɛi ni aaagba nɔ pɛ etee; ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ fiji oya, ni efilikiɔ tamɔ okropɔŋ kɛyaa ŋwɛi.
- - Kaaye kpɛkpɛɛlɔ dɛŋ nii, ni kaaha edɔkɔdɔkɔnii lɛ miiba otsine.
Ejaakɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni buɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he akɔntaa yɛ eyitsoŋ.
Ekɛɔ bo akɛ, “Ye ni onu!” Shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.
Atrɔmai abɔ ni oye lɛ oooshwe oshwie, ni owiemɔi dɔkɔbii lɛ aaafee yaka.
- - Kaawie ni kwashia nu; ejaakɛ eeegbe onilee wiemɔi lɛ ahe guɔ.
- - Kaatsi blema husu nɔ̃ okadi hu kɛtee sɛɛ, ni kaaŋɔ awusãi ashikpɔŋ yɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ amɛkpɔ̃lɔ lɛ hewalɔ ni; ni ekɛ bo baaye ehã amɛ.
- - Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ tsɔsemɔ nɔ, ni obo nilee wiemɔi atoi.
- - Kaatsi gbekɛ tsɔsemɔ naa, ejaakɛ kɛ oyi lɛ kɛ kpãa lɛ egboŋ.
Bo lɛ okɛ kpãa ayi lɛ, ni ooohere eyiwala.
- - Mibi, kɛji ooona jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mi hu mitsui aaanyɔ mimli.
Kɛji wiemɔi ni ja miije onaa lɛ, mi hu mimli aaafli mi.
- - Kaahã ohiɛ miikɔ̃ eshafeelɔi anɔ; shi moŋ kã he oshe Yehowa gbeyei daa nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ wɔsɛɛ ko yɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka.
- - Mibi, bo lɛ, bo toi, koni ole nii, ni oba ojeŋ jogbaŋŋ.
Okɛ ohe akabɔ dãatɔlɔi loo ŋmaayelɔi ahe.
Ejaakɛ dãatɔlɔi kɛ ŋmaayelɔi lɛ amɛaaye ohia, ni wɔdɔiwɔlɔi aaabu mama shwɛishwɛi.
- - Bo otsɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ toi, ni kaagbe onyɛ he guɔ kɛji egbɔ lɛ.
Tse shika ohe anɔkwale kɛ nilee kɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ, ni okahɔ̃ɔ eko eko.
Jalɔ tsɛ aaanya babaoo, ni mɔ ni fɔɔ bi nilelɔ lɛ aaana ebi lɛ he miishɛɛ.
Hã otsɛ kɛ onyɛ mii ashɛ amɛhe, ni hã onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ anya.
- - Mibi ŋɔɔ otsui ohã mi, ni okɔ minane.
Ejaakɛ yoo ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni, ni mɔ kroko ŋa lɛ bu kplokotoo ni.
Ewoɔ ka tamɔ ojotswalɔ, ni ehãa mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa ayi faa yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
- - Namɔ naa nɔ?
Namɔ yeɔ awerɛho?
Namɔ naa bei?
Namɔ naa sane?
Namɔ naa pilamɔ yakatswaa?
Namɔ hiŋmɛii tsuɔ faa?
Mɛi nɛɛ ji mɛi ni tsɛɔ yɛ wain he lɛ; mɛi ni yaa yasaa amɛnaa wain ni afutu mli lɛ.
Kaakwɛ wain bɔ ni etsu faa lɛ, bɔ ni ehiɛ yɔɔ fɛo yɛ kpulu lɛ mli lɛ, bɔ ni eyaa kpoo lɛ.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, ekɔ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ onufu, ni efɛ̃ɔ mɔ tamɔ blikã.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ohiŋmɛii ebɔi naakpɛɛ nibii namɔ, ni wiemɔi gbohii aaaje onaa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooofee tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã ŋshɔ teŋ, loo tamɔ mɔ ko ni kã aŋmala nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni oookɛɛ ji, “Amɛtswia mi nii, shi ewaaa mihe; amɛyi mi, shi minuuu he.
Mɛɛbe mihiɛ aaatsɛ̃?
Mibaya ekoŋŋ.”
- - Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji anɔ, ni okashwe hu akɛ okɛ amɛ aaabɔ naanyo tete.
Ejaakɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi ahe ŋaa amɛjwɛŋmɔ toɔ, ni amɛwieɔ wiemɔi gbohii.
- - Nilee akɛmaa tsu, ni niiashishinumɔ akɛhãa emaa shi.
Ni nilee akɛhãa piai amli yimɔɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni jara wa ni yɔɔ fɛo.
- - Nuu nilelɔ lɛ ehe wa fe nuu kakabãŋ; ni nuu ni le nii lɛ efe nuu ni he wa.
Ejaakɛ ŋaa akɛwuɔ ta, ni ŋaawolɔi pii aŋaawoo akɛyeɔ kunim.
- - Nilee mli kwɔ tsɔ̃ hã kwashia, hewɔ lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ yɛ koi shi.
- - Mɔ ni toɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa lɛ, lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ ablofo.
Mɔ buulufeemɔ he ŋaatoo lɛ esha ni; ni hefɛoyelɔ hu gbɔmɛi miihi.
- - Kɛji otɔ biti yɛ haomɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ohewalɛ faaa.
- - Mɛi ni aakpala amɛ ayagbe amɛ yakatswaa lɛ, heremɔ amɛyiwala; ni mɛi hu ni miididãa, ni akɛ amɛmiiya gbeehe lɛ, okaku ohiɛ ofɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Kɛji okɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔleee enɛ wɔto” lɛ, ani mɔ ni naa tsuiaŋnii lɛ, mɔ ni buɔ osusuma he lɛ, eleee, eleee akɛ ole oto lo?
Ani ewooo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa?
- - Mibi, ye wo ejaakɛ ehi, ni bɔ ni wo ni tsereɔ kɔikɔi kɛjɛɔ wo agbaku mli ŋɔɔ onaa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nilee ŋɔɔ osusuma diɛŋtsɛ naa.
Kɛ ona nilee lɛ aaahi aha bo wɔsɛɛ, ni ohiɛnɔkãmɔ efeŋ yaka.
- - Gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kaawo jalɔ shihilɛhe lɛ he ka, ni kaahao ehejɔɔmɔhe lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ jalɔ gbeɔ shi shii kpawo, ni eteɔ shi ekoŋŋ; shi efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ amanehulu butuɔ lɛ kwrakwra.
- - Kɛji ohenyɛlɔ gbee shi lɛ, kaanya, ni kɛji etɛ lɛ, omli akafili bo.
No lɛ, Yehowa aaana, ni eeedɔ lɛ, ni ebaafo emli ni efu lɛ lɛ sɛɛ.
- - Kaawo otsui he la yɛ efɔŋfeelɔi ahewɔ, ni ohiɛ akakɔ̃ mɛi fɔ̃ji anɔ.
Nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã mɔ fɔŋ wɔsɛɛ, ni efɔŋfeelɔi akane lɛ hu aaagbe.
- - Mibi, she Yehowa gbeyei, kɛ maŋtsɛ hu; ni kaatse amɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ atua.
Ejaakɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkpãtã ohiɛ trukaa; ni namɔ le nɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni aaajɛ amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ?
Nilee wiemɔi krokomɛi hu nɛ Nilelɔi awiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi hu nɛ.
Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ yɛ kojomɔ mli lɛ, ehiii.
Mɔ ni kɛɔ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, “Oye bem” lɛ, mɛi aaalomɔ lɛ; majimaji aaanyaŋe lɛ.
Mɛi ni kãa efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ aaana miishɛɛ; ni jɔɔmɔ kpakpa aaaba amɛnɔ.
Mɔ ni hãa hetoo ni ja lɛ, ohe suɔlɔ ni.
Too onitsumɔ he gbɛjianɔ jogbaŋŋ, feemɔ oŋmɔshinii fɛɛ kralo, no sɛɛ dani obɔi otsu maa.
Kaaye odase oshi onaanyo yakatswaa, ni okɛ onaabu hu akashishiu mɔ ko.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni efee mi lɛ, nakai mafee lɛ mato najiaŋ, nɔ ni efee mi lɛ, mawo lɛ he nyɔmɔ.” Mitsɔ̃ anihaolɔ ko ŋmɔ he, kɛ mɔ ni bɛ yitsoŋ waintrom he; shi, naa, ŋmɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ etsi kɛ ŋmeii; ni sɔnsrɔ̃ sɔŋŋ eha shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni ŋmɔ lɛ he lɛ gbogbo lɛ ekumɔ eshwie shi.
Kɛkɛ ni mikwɛ gãa, ni mijwɛŋ he jogbaŋŋ.
Mikwɛ, ni mikase nɔ ko kɛjɛ mli.
Mawɔ fioo, majie mihiɛsɛɛ fioo, makota miniji fioo; be mli ni owɔɔ lɛ, ohia aaabanina bo tamɔ ojotswalɔ; ni fimɔ hu aaaba tamɔ nuu ni hiɛ tsɛŋ.
Solomon Abɛi lɛ anɔtsamɔ Solomon abɛi lɛ ekrokomɛi hu ni Yuda maŋtsɛ Hezekia webii lɛ ŋmala nɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam ji akɛ ekɛ sane atee; shi maŋtsɛmɛi anunyam ji akɛ amɛtao sane mli.
Bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hu mli kwɔ lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛmɛi ayitsoŋ kwɔ; anyɛɛɛ ana emli nii.
Jiemɔ jwiɛtɛi fei lɛ kɛje jwiɛtɛi lɛ mli, ni ŋaalɔ lɛ baana jwiɛtɛi krɔŋŋ ni ekɛtsu nii lɛ.
Jiemɔ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ kɛje maŋtsɛ he, ni jalɛ sane aaahi sɛi lɛ he.
Kɛji oyɛ maŋtsɛ hiɛ lɛ, kaafee pupuupu; ni kaadamɔ mɛi wuji agbɛhe.
Ejaakɛ ehi moŋ akɛ aaakɛɛ bo akɛ, “Ba yitsogbɛ nɛɛ,” fe nɔ ni aaatsi bo kɛaatee najiashigbɛ ni lumɔ lɛ miikwɛ.
Kaaye oyai ni okɛ nɔ ni okɛ ohiŋmɛi kɛkɛ na tee saneyelihe, ejaakɛ naagbee mli kɛji onaanyo lɛ wo bo hiɛgbele lɛ, te obaafee tɛŋŋ?
Kɛji okɛ onaanyo na sane lɛ, bo kɛ lɛ sɔŋŋ atao naa; shi kaajie mɔ kroko teemɔŋ sane kpo; koni mɔ ni aaanu he lɛ akabawo bo hiɛgbele ni ogbɛi gbonyo lɛ miika ohe.
Wiemɔ ni aaawie be ni sa mli lɛ, etamɔ shika kpɔbii ni tara jwiɛtɛi mli.
Bɔ ni shika ga kɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi hewulamɔnii yɔɔ hã mɔ lɛ, nakai kãlɔ ni le nii yɔɔ hã toibolɔi.
Bɔ ni snoo mli jɔɔ ŋanii yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ji bɔfo anɔkwafo hã mɛi ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
Ehãa enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atsui nyɔɔ amɛmli.
Mɔ ni woɔ nikee he shi, tsɛ, eyeee shiwoo lɛ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ oblɔtu kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni nu bɛ mli.
Aaanyɛ akɛ tsuishitoo blɛoo atsake nɔyelɔ jwɛŋmɔ; ni naajɔlɛ wiemɔ kuɔ wu.
Kɛ ona wo lɛ, kaaye fe nine, koni eti bo, ni oshwe oshwie.
Kaafɔ onaanyo we shwɛmɔ koni osane miije etsine, ni ehe miitsɛ̃ bo.
Mɔ ni yeɔ amale odase yɛ enaanyo he lɛ, etamɔ tsokpoti loo klante loo gãimlibi ni naa ba.
Hiɛ ni akɛfɔ̃ɔ kutumpɔfo nɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli lɛ, etamɔ nyanyɔŋ ni ewɔtsɔ loo nane ni elɔŋe.
Mɔ ni jieɔ mɔ he atade yɛ fɛ̃i be mli, aloo ekɛ ashiŋ toɔ pilamɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni laa lalai kɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii, shi jeee kɛ etsui mli fɛɛ.
Kɛji hɔmɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye, ni kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji ofee nakai lɛ, ooowo lɛ hiɛgbele kpɔtɔɔ, ni Yehowa aaawo bo he nyɔŋmɔ.
Bɔ ni kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ nunɛmɔ baa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔhewiemɔ kɛ hiɛtumɔ baa.
Faŋ nɔ ni oyahi tsu yiteŋ kpokplobiiaŋ, fe nɔ ni okɛ yoo beilɔ aaahi shĩa kome mli.
Bɔ ni nu hɔɔŋ yɔɔ hã mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nakai ji sanekpakpa ni akɛjɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba.
Jalɔ ni nyɛɛɛ shi afi yɛ mɔ fɔŋ hiɛ lɛ, etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ní anyiɛ mli kɛ nubu ni akpɔtɔ lɛ.
Woyeli tsɔ̃ ehiii, hiɛtaomɔ tsɔ̃ hu ehiii.
Mɔ ni nyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye lɛ, etamɔ maŋ ni akumɔ ehe gbogboi ashwie shi.
Snoo enɛɛɛ yɛ latsa be mli, ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ nikpamɔ beiaŋ, nakai hiɛnyam esaaa kwashia.
Bɔ ni aflimata filikiɔ ni nyɔŋmɔbitɛte filikiɔ lɛ, nakai yaka loomɔ mɔɔɔ mɔ.
Kpelebi sa okpɔŋɔ, ni manyoflɛ sa teji, ni kpãa sa kwashia kotosɛɛ.
Kaakwɛ kwashia sanebimɔ ni ohã lɛ nakai hetoo, no lɛ oootsɔ̃ tamɔ lɛ.
Kwɛmɔ kwashia sanebimɔ ni oha lɛ hetoo, koni ekabu ehe nilelɔ.
Mɔ ni kɛ shɛɛ tsuɔ kwashia lɛ, eetɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane, ni eetao sane ehã ehe.
Bɔ ni obubuafo naji tsotsoroɔ ehe ni hewalɛ bɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kwashia daaŋ abɛ yɔɔ efolo.
Mɔ ni woɔ kwashia hiɛ nyam lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni ekɔ tɛ ewo akromia mli.
Bɔ ni ŋmei tso yɔɔ yɛ dãatɔlɔ dɛŋ lɛ, nakai abɛ yɔɔ yɛ kwashia daaŋ.
Mɔ ni bɔɔ kwashia loo dãatɔlɔ ni miiho apaa lɛ, etamɔ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ni miipila mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛkɛ.
Kwashia ni kuɔ esɛɛ eyafeɔ ebuuluianii ekoŋŋ lɛ, etamɔ gbee ni kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa eshwee he.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ ha kwashia fe gbɔmɔ ni buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Anihaolɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Jata yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ; jata yɛ blohui lɛ amli.” Bɔ ni shinaa tsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ esɛɛ sai anɔ pɛ lɛ, nakai anihaolɔ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɔɔ yɛ esaa mli.
Anihaolɔ kɛ enine woɔ kã mli, shi ewaa ehãa lɛ akɛ, ekɛ enine lɛ aaawo edaaŋ tete.
Anihaolɔ buɔ ehe nilelɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ, fe nilelɔi kpawo ni hãa sane hetoo ni ja.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehe woɔ bei ni kɔɔɔ ehe eko mli lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ko ni mɔɔ gbee gbɔ ni miiho toi mli.
-Mɔ ni shishiuɔ enaanyo, ni ekɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Shwɛmɔ kɛkɛ mikɛ bo shwɛɔ” lɛ, etamɔ sɛkɛyelɔ ni kɛ latsei kɛ gãii kɛ gbele shwɛɔ.
Kɛji lai tã lɛ, la gboɔ; ni kɛji ablɛbiwielɔ bɛ lɛ bei sɛɛ foɔ.
Bɔ ni ŋai hãaa lasrɛmi agbo, ni lai hãaa la agbo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ beilɔ hãa bei mli waa.
Ablɛbiwielɔ wiemɔ tamɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔnii ni ŋɔɔ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔsumɔɔ akɛ wɔye wɔwo wɔmusuŋ obɔ̃.
Naa dɔkɔbii wiemɔ ni jɛɛɛ tsuijurɔ mli lɛ, etamɔ ŋɛsuko ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi ekpa he.
Nyɛlɔ kɛ enaabu saa ewiemɔ he, shi etsuiŋ lɛ, eelaka mɔ.
Kɛji eewie dɔkɔbii lɛ, kaahe lɛ oye, ejaakɛ yiŋtoi fɔ̃ji eyi etsui mli obɔ̃.
Ekɛ emɔnyɛɛ teɔ nɛ, shi aaajie egbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo hiɛ kɛ̃.
Mɔ ni kɛ yiŋtoo fɔŋ tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli; ni mɔ ni kɛ yiŋsha kokloɔ tɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ enɔ tɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ agbee.
Kɛji oonyɛ mɔ ko lɛ, no owieɔ omaleɔ ehe efɔŋ; ni mɔ yiteŋ mluwoo lɛ ekɛ shigbeemɔ baa.
Kaashwã ofɔ̃ wɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ oleee nɔ ni baaba wɔ.
Hã mɔ kroko ajie oyi, shi kaajie bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yi.
Hã gbɔ ajie oyi, shi ekaje bo diɛŋtsɛ onaa.
Tɛ tsii, ni shia hu, jatsu kɛ tsiimɔ ni; shi buulu mlifu tsii fe nibii enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ.
