Mlila yi wa, ni mlifu tamɔ faa ni esram nɔ; shi namɔ aaanyɛ awuŋayeli hiɛ adamɔ?
Ehi akɛ akã mɔ ko hiɛ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ fe nɔ ni akɛ suɔmɔ aaatsimɔ etɔmɔ nɔ.
Naanyo anɔkwafo ejeee gbɛ epilaaa mɔ; shi henyɛlɔ mɔ atuuloomɔ lɛ, shishiumɔ ni.
Mɔ ni eye nii etɔ lɛ, ekwaa wo agbaku tete; shi mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni joɔ po ŋɔɔ yɛ edaaŋ.
Nuu ni jeɔ ewe eyakpaa shi lɛ, etamɔ loofɔlɔ ni jeɔ etsu mli eyatsomloɔ.
Muŋma kɛ ojeŋma hãa mɔ mii shɛɔ ehe, shi haomɔ hãa mɔ tsui yeɔ.
Kaakwa bo diɛŋtsɛ onaanyo kɛ otsɛ naanyo.
Ofimɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, kaaya onyɛmi we.
Ohe gbɔmɔ ni bɛŋkɛ bo lɛ, ehi aahu fe onyɛmi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ.
Mibi, feemɔ nilelɔ, ni ohã mitsui anyɔ mimli; bɔ ni afee ni mana hetoo mahã mɔ ni bɔɔ mi ahora lɛ.
Hiɛtɛ̃lɔ naa efɔŋ ni baa, ni ewiɔ ehe; shi mɛi ni jwɛŋmɔ naa waaa lɛ, amɛyaboteɔ mli.
Mɔ ni damɔɔ gbɔ sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ etade ato bo awaba; ni mɔ ni damɔɔ maŋsɛɛnyo sɛɛ lɛ, hã ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ato awaba.
Mɔ ni kɛ gbee ni wa jɔɔ enaanyo leebi maŋkpa lɛ, aaasusu akɛ loomɔ moŋ elomɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Yoo beilɔ lɛ etamɔ tsu yiteŋ nu ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi kɔikɔi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛji nu miinɛ.
Kɛji aaaka akɛ aaatsi enaa ni efɔ̃ɔ bei lɛ, etamɔ nɔ ni aatsi kɔɔyɔɔ naa ni ekatswa, aloo aamia mu yɛ ninejurɔ dɛ̃kɔkɔ mli.
Dade jɔɔ dade naa, ni gbɔmɔ hu hãa enyɛmi gbɔmɔ leɔ nii.
Mɔ ni baa yelitso yi lɛ, eyeɔ eyibii lɛ eko; ni mɔ ni buɔ enuŋtsɔ he lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ woɔ ehiɛ nyam.
Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa ehiɛ yɛ nu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hãa enaa bɔ ni eji.
Bɔ ni gbohiiaje kɛ gbonyobu etɔko dã lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ hiŋmɛi hu etɔko dã.
Niiahetsuumɔ kukwɛi lɛ, eyɛ kɛhã jwiɛtɛi, ni flɔnɔɔ hu yɛ kɛhã shika, ni gbɔmɔ lɛ eyijiemɔ akɛyoɔ lɛ.
Kɛji okɛshi buulu yɛ fufuitso mli tamɔ ashiɔ abele tete lɛ, ebuulufeemɔ lɛ ejeŋ ehe kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ole bɔ ni otoi lɛ yɔɔ, ni okwɛ okooloo kui lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ninamɔ ehiii shi kɛyaaa naanɔ; ni maŋtsɛyeli akekre hu ehiii shi kɛyaaa yinɔi fɛɛ.
Kɛji jwɛi gbiŋ be ho, ni jwɛi fɔ ba, ni tsei fu bai lɛ, afolɔɔ, ni abuaa naa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Onaa omama kɛjɛɔ too gwantɛŋbii lɛ amli, ni onaa shika kɛjɛɔ too abotiai ni ohɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli okɛheɔ shikpɔŋ.
Ooona abotia fufɔ bɔ ni aaashɛ bo kɛ owe lɛ yeli, kɛ nɔ ni okɛaalɛ otsuji yei lɛ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji joɔ foi be mli ni mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ, shi jalɔi lɛ amɛfeɔ ekãa tamɔ jata.
Nɔsha hãa shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lumɛi ayi faa; shi kɛ emli mɛi lɛ yɛ niiashishinumɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, lumɔyeli maa shi shiŋŋ, ni esɛɛ tsɛɔ.
Ohiafo ni waa enaanyo ohiafo yi lɛ, etamɔ nunɛmɔ ni loɔ nii kɛyaa, ni ehãaa niyenii aba.
Mɛi ni kwaa mla lɛ, amɛ jieɔ mɔ fɔŋ yi; shi mɛi ni yeɔ mla nɔ lɛ teɔ shi amɛwoɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji nuuu jalɛ shishi; shi mɛi ni jaa Yehowa lɛ, amɛnuɔ shishi jogbaŋŋ.
Ohiafo ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehi fe niiatsɛ ni bɛ jeŋba.
Mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ lɛ, bi nilelɔ ni; shi mɔ ni kɛ fulɔi bɔɔ naanyo lɛ, ewoɔ etsɛ hiɛgbele.
Mɔ ni kɛ hekpa ni fe nine kɛ wieyeli hãa enii faa lɛ, eebua naa ehã mɔ ni naa ohiafo mɔbɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni booo mla toi ni eye nɔ lɛ, esɔlemɔ tete lɛ, nihiinii ni.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hãa jalɔ nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ lɛ, eeegbee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebu mli; shi mɛi ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ aaana gboshinii kpakpa.
Niiatsɛ buɔ ehe nilelɔ; shi ohiafo ni yɔɔ niiashishinumɔ kpaa lɛ shi.
Kɛ jalɔi ye kunim lɛ, eyɛ nyam naakpa; shi kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji wo amɛhe nɔ lɛ, mɛi teeteɔ amɛhe.
Mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etɔ̃mɔi anɔ lɛ, eshwereŋ; shi mɔ ni jajeɔ, ni efɔ̃ɔ efɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, anaa lɛ mɔbɔ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei daa; shi mɔ ni wajeɔ etsui lɛ, egbeɔ haomɔ mli.
Nɔyelɔ fɔŋ ni yeɔ maŋbii ni anii yɔɔ mɔbɔ nɔ lɛ, etamɔ jata ni huuɔ loo oshishibrishi ni hiɛ ewo la.
Nɔyelɔ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, yiwalɔ kpele ji lɛ; shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ hiɛjoomɔ lɛ, ehãa egbii asɛɛ tsɛɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko eye mɔ ko lá yi sɔ̃ lɛ, etsɔ̃ kobɔfo kɛmiiya gbonyobu mli; mɔ ko akaye ebua lɛ.
Mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala; shi mɔ ni bɛ jeŋba lɛ, eeegbee bu mli.
Mɔ ni hũɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ, eeena nii eye etɔ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yakayaka nii asɛɛ lɛ eeeye ohia kadikadi.
Nuu anɔkwafo aaana jɔɔmɔ babaoo; shi mɔ ni yeɔ oyai koni ena nii lɛ, eyeŋ ehe.
Hiɛaŋkwɛmɔ ehiii, ejaakɛ aboloo atrɔma kome pɛ hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ aaafee efɔŋ.
Kpɛkpɛɛlɔ yeɔ oya ni ena nii; shi eleee akɛ ohia miiba enɔ.
Mɔ ni kãa mɔ lɛ, fee sɛɛ lɛ ehiɛ baa nyam fe mɔ ni kɛ ewiemɔ woɔ mɔ yiteŋ mlu.
Mɔ ni tswaa etsɛ loo enyɛ ojo ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Enɛ jeee esha” lɛ, mɔ hiɛkpãtãlɔ naanyo ji lɛ.
Hiɛjoolɔ lɛ, ewoɔ bei; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, enaa nii.
Mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe nɔ lɛ, kwashia ni; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ yɛ nilee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.
Mɔ ni hãa ohiafo nɔ lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaŋ lɛ; shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ ehiɛ etoɔ afã lɛ, aaalomɔ lɛ babaoo.
Kɛji yiwalɔi te shi lɛ, mɛi teeteɔ amɛhe; shi be ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãa lɛ, belɛ jalɔi ayi miifa.
Mɔ ni afɔɔ lɛ kãmɔ, shi loloolo lɛ ekuɛŋ ti lɛ, trukaa ni aaakumɔ lɛ bɔ ni anaŋ ehe tsabaa.
Kɛji jalɔi miiye maŋ nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ nyaa; shi kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji miiye nɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ dɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ nilee lɛ, ehãa etsɛ naa miishɛɛ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ajwamãŋi bɔɔ lɛ, ekpãtãa enii ahiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli hãa maŋ damɔɔ shi, mɔ ni balaa maŋbii adɛŋ nii lɛ, ebutuɔ maŋ.
Mɔ ni woɔ enaanyo yiteŋ mlu lɛ, eeŋmɛ yaa ehã mɔ lɛ.
Efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esha nɔŋŋ duɔ lɛ tsɔne; shi jalɔ lɛ, elaa, ni enyaa.
Jalɔ le ohiafoi agbɛnaa; shi mɔ fɔŋ lɛ, enuuu ohiafoi agbɛnaa nɛɛ shishi.
Hefɛoyelɔi woɔ maŋ bei; shi nilelɔi kuɔ mlifu naa.
Kɛji nilelɔ kɛ buulu gba kadaa lɛ, buulu lɛ griɔ ni eŋmɔɔ kɛkɛ, ni hejɔlɛ baaa.
Lashishwielɔi nyɛɔ mɔ ni tɔ̃mɔ ko bɛ ehe; ni efɔŋfeelɔi taoɔ egbele.
Kwashia jieɔ emlifu fɛɛ kpo; shi nilelɔ miɔ ŋɔɔ.
Nɔyelɔ ni boɔ amale toi lɛ, etsuji fɛɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji.
Ohiafo kɛ yiwalɔ kpeɔ; Yehowa ni hãa amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiŋmɛii naa nii.
Maŋtsɛ ni kojoɔ ohiafo yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, emaŋtsɛsɛi lɛ aaama shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Kpãa kɛ kãmɔ hãa mɔ leɔ nii; shi gbekɛ ni akpoo ejeŋ ahã lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ enyɛ hiɛgbele.
Kɛji mɛi fɔ̃ji miiye mɛi anɔ lɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ faa: shi jalɔi aaana amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhiŋmɛi.
Tsɔsemɔ obi, ni eeehã ohe ajɔ bo; eeehã otsui anyɔ omli.
He ni gbalɛ wiemɔ ko bɛ lɛ, maŋbii ebuuu nɔ; shi ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ mla nɔ.
Akɛ wiemɔ kɛkɛ tsɔseee tsulɔ; ejaakɛ enuɔ shishi moŋ, shi ebuuu.
Ani ona nuu ni enaa yɔɔ blɛblɛ kɛ wiemɔ lo?
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã kwashia fe lɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛɔ etsulɔ fɔfɔɔle kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi lɛ, naagbee lɛ ebuuu nɔ.
Mɔ ni mli fuɔ lɛ, eteɔ bei shi; ni mɔ ni mli etsɛɛɛ fumɔ lɛ, etɔ̃ɔ babaoo.
Gbɔmɔ hewoo nɔŋŋ aaaba lɛ shi; shi mɔ ni baa ehe shi yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ, aaawo ehiɛ nyam.
Mɔ ni kɛ julɔ jaa nii lɛ, eenyɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewala; enuɔ akɛ aalomɔ nɛ, shi enyɛɛɛ ejaje.
Gbɔmɔ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tsɔne ehãa mɔ; shi mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, eyɛ shweshweeshwe.
Mɛi pii taoɔ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛjɛɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ; shi jalɛ saneyeli lɛ Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.
Jalɔi miihi mɛi fɔ̃ji; ni mɛi fɔ̃ji hu miihi jalɔi.
Agur Abɛi Yake bi Agur abɛi nɛ.
Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ kɛɛ Itiel kɛ Ukal akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, mifaŋ kooloo; mijeee gbɔmɔ, ni mibɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ hu.
Mikaseko nilee, ni asaŋ mileee Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he nɔ ko.
Namɔ ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni esaa ekpeleke shi?
Namɔ ebua kɔɔyɔɔ naa yɛ ekɔkɔŋ dã?
Namɔ efi nu yɛ emama mli dã?
Namɔ ŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji lɛ emamɔ shi?
Te egbɛi hu?
Ni mɛni ji ebi lɛ hu gbɛi?
Bɛ ole?
Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ, anɔkwale ni; Nyɔŋmɔ ji tsɛŋ kɛhã mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ.
Kaaŋɔ nɔ ko ofata ewiemɔi lɛ ahe, kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeekã ohiɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ amalelɔ.” Abɛi krokomɛi hu Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mibiɔ nibii enyɔ yɛ; kaakãmã mi dani migbo.
Hã mi kɛ kutumpɔo kɛ nablaba teŋ ajekɛ.
Kaahã miye ohia lɛ, asaŋ kaahã mina nii hu.
Lɛɛ mi kɛ niyenii pɛ ni ehĩa mi, koni mikatɔ tsɔ̃, ni mikwa bo, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji Yehowa”.
Ni kaahã miye ohia, ni miyaju, ni mikɛgbe miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛi he guɔ.
Kaaye tsulɔ ko he osheku ohã enuŋtsɔ, koni tsulɔ lɛ akabalomɔ bo, ni ebu bo fɔ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛlomɔɔ amɛtsɛmɛi, ni amɛjɔɔɔ amɛnyɛmɛi hu.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛbuɔ amɛhe akɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛhe tse; tsɛbelɛ, amɛhe ewo muji kpɔtɔɔ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ; lɛɛlɛŋ amɛsusuɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi wuji ji amɛ.
Mɛi komɛi yɛ ni amɛnyanyɔji lɛ klantei ni; amɛnyanyɔji lɛ kaklai ni; ni amɛkɛtserɛɔ ohiafoi amli kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛkɛtserɛɔ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ kɛjeɔ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Shiti yɛ biyei enyɔ, atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ, “Hã mi, Hã mi”.
Nibii etɛ̃ etɔɔɔ amɛ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ tete kplokaaa amɛ.
Nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ni amɛtɔrɔko dã; nomɛi ji gbohiiaje kɛ musu ni fɔɔɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni etɔɔɔ nu, kɛ la ni esraŋ nɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ etsɛ he fɛo ni egbeɔ enyɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ lɛ, kwãakwãalabitei aaafãmɔ ehiŋmɛii, ni akpaŋai aaaye eloo.
Nibii etɛ̃ yɛ ni feɔ mi naakpɛɛ tsɔ̃, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ minuuu shishi; nomɛi ji, okropɔŋ filikimɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, kɛ onufu nyiɛmɔ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, kɛ meele nyiɛmɔ yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, kɛ bɔ ni feɔ ni suɔmɔ baa nuu kɛ yoo teŋ.
Nɛkɛ pɛ yoo ajwamãŋ yɔɔ; eyeɔ nii ni etsumɔɔ enaa, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko efɔŋ ko.” Nibii etɛ̃ hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ mli emɔ, Nomɛi ji, nyɔŋ ni etsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ; kɛ buulu ni eye nii etɔ; kɛ yoo ni akpoo lɛ, ni ena wu; kɛ tsulɔyoo ni etsɔ̃ enuŋtsɔ ŋa.
Nibii ejwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni amɛdaraaa; shi amɛle nii pam.
Amɛ ji tsatsubii; amɛ lɛ kooloi bibii ni he waaa ni, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtaoɔ amɛniyenii amɛtoɔ yɛ latsaa be mli.
Afutuɔkɔi hu kooloi ni he waaa ni, kɛ̃lɛ amɛfeɔ amɛtsui yɛ tɛsai amli.
Baalabii hu amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛfãa yɛ amɛnɔkwɔlɛi anaa.
Ooonyɛ okɛ onine amɔ tsunyɛ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋtsɛmɛi amɔjiaŋ ehiɔ.
Nibii etɛ̃ yɛ ni amɛfamɔɔ amɛnaji abladeiaŋ; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, enyiɛmɔ yɛ fɛo.
Nomɛi ji jata, ni ji kooloi ateŋ ekãalɔ fe fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔɔ esɛɛ ehãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ wuɔnuu saase, kɛ too kpakpo kɛ maŋtsɛ ni nyiɛ ewebii ahiɛ abladeiaŋ.
Kɛji ofee buuluianii, ni owo ohe nɔ, aloo ojwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ fɔŋ lɛ, okɛ onine ato onaabu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji osha fufɔ yɛ tɔ mli lɛ, onaa butru; kɛji oka gugɔ̃ atswɛrɛ lɛ lá jeɔ; ni kɛji owo mɔ ko mli la lɛ bei baa.
Ŋaa ni awo Maŋtsɛ ko Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Maŋtsɛ Lemuel nyɛ kɛtsɔse lɛ nɛ.
Ao mibi!
Ao mimusuŋbi!
Ao mishiwoi abi, kaafite ohewalɛ yɛ yei ahe, ni kaanyiɛ maŋtsɛmɛi afitemɔ gbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Oo, Lemuel, esaaa maŋtsɛmɛi akɛ amɛnu wain; aloo nɔyelɔi akɛ amɛaadi dãa ni wa sɛɛ.
Kɛji amɛnu lɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpa mla nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nɔnalɔi fɛɛ asane hiɛ amɛbu shi.
Okɛ dãa ni wa ahã mɔ ni hiɛ heɔ akpãtã, ni okɛ wain ahã mɛi ni amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe lɛ; hã amɛnu koni amɛhĩɛ akpa amɛhia nɔ, ni amɛkakai amɛhaomɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Wiemɔ ohã mumuii ni nyɛɛɛ awie lɛ; ni ofã mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfã lɛ ahe.
Wiemɔ ni okojo ohã amɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ye ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ asane ohã amɛ.
Yoo kpakpa Yoo kpakpa lɛ namɔ aaana?
Ejara wa aahu fe tɛ̃ŋlɛ̃o.
Ewu kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ; ni lɛ wu lɛ, sɛɛnamɔ ko ebɔŋ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ, ewalabeiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ, ejurɔ efeɔ ewu lɛ; shi jeee efɔŋ.
Ebɔɔ toohetsɔi kɛ odonti he mɔdɛŋ; ekɛ enine tsuɔ nii kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Etamɔ jarayeli lɛji ni yaa shɔŋŋ yaŋɔɔ niyenii kɛbaa.
Be ni je tsɛreko po lɛ, eteɔ shi ni efeɔ niyenii ehãa eshĩaŋbii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ eweyei lɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔ.
Ekwɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni hi ni eheɔ, ni ejɛɔ eninenaa nitsumɔ mli efeɔ abɔɔ.
Emiaa, ni etsuɔ nii kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ.
Ekwɛɔ jogbaŋŋ dani eheɔ jarayeli nii ni sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he; ekane tete gbooo nyɔɔŋ.
Ekɛ enine mɔɔ odonti mlijiemɔ tso mli, ni ekɛ enine nɔŋŋ hiɛɔ akeke lɛ ni ekɛloɔ mama.
Egbeleɔ edɛŋ ehãa nɔnalɔ, ni ekpãa enine mli ehãa ohiafo.
Esheee snoo gbeyei yɛ eshĩaŋbii lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ shĩaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ bumɔɔ mama tsuji fɛɛfɛji.
Eloɔ saanɔboi ehãa ehe; klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ afaseo mama ji ehe bo.
Ayoɔ ewu yɛ koi shi, kɛji ekɛ maŋ onukpai tara shi lɛ.
Ekpɛɔ klala atadei kɛ hɛfiinɔ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ ehãa guɔyelɔ.
Ehewulamɔ mli ehewalɛ kɛ ehiɛnyam yɔɔ; ni eŋmɔɔ be ni baaba lɛ.
Ewieɔ nilee wiemɔ, ni etsɔseɔ mɔ kɛ mlihilɛ wiemɔ.
Ekwɛɔ eshĩaŋbii lɛ ayaa kɛ baa jogbaŋŋ, ni efeee hejɔ̃ kwraa.
Ebii teɔ shi ni amɛjɔɔ lɛ daa; ni ewu hu kafoɔ lɛ.
Ewu kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Yei pii ebɔ mɔdɛŋ moŋ, shi bo lɛ ota amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ!” Hiɛnyam lɛ lakamɔ ni; ni hefɛo hu, yakayakanɔ ni; shi yoo ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ, aaakafo lɛ.
Nyɛŋɔa eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ eko nyɛhãa lɛ, ni hã enitsumɔi lɛ ajie eyi yɛ koii lɛ ashi.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Wolo nɛɛ gbɛi ji Jajelɔ Wolo lɛ.
Jajelɔ lɛ Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ Nilelɔ ni.
Nilelɔ nɛɛ na akɛ adesa wala sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ yɛ jeŋ; ni wala nɛɛ mli saji fa babaoo bɔ ni anuuu shishi ekpakpa ko; ni emli eyi kɛ toikɔ̃dɔ̃mɔ kɛ nijiaŋwuijee saji.
Naagbee mli lɛ Nilelɔ nɛɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wala he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.” Enuuu Naa Nyɔŋmɔ shishi, Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni adesa walaŋ saji fɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ nɛɛ wo gbɔmɛi aŋaa akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsu nii waa, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ mii ashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenii ahe bɔ ni eeenyɛ, gbii abɔ ni ehiɛ kã nɛɛ.
Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ babaoo wooo mɔ ekãa; ni amɛhãa mɔ nijiaŋ jeɔ wui moŋ.
Akɛ akɛ wolo nɛɛ hu fata Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ woji lɛ ahe lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ da.
No hewɔ lɛ eyɛ gbɛhe hã susumɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kaneɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ lɛ nuɔ he akɛ lɛ akɛwieɔ lɛ.
Eyɔseɔ akɛ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kometoo lɛ ni wieɔ Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wiemɔi ni eŋɔɔɔ mɛi anaa he lɛ, no nɔŋŋ hãa anaa hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ejaakɛ ehãa anuɔ wala shishi.
Mlijaramɔi Mɛni kwraa hewɔ wala yɔɔ?
.—.
Wala he wiemɔi komɛi .—.
Naagbee ŋaawoo .—.
Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ akukufoo .-
Wala he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ Nilelɔ lɛ, ni ji David binuu lɛ, ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ wiemɔi nɛ, “Yakanii amli yakanɔ!” Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Yakanii amli yakanɔ!
Fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.” Mɛni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ jeŋ he?
Yinɔ hoɔ eyaa, ni yinɔ baa; shi je lɛ yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Hulu lɛ teɔ shi, ni hulu lɛ saa eyanyɔɔ shi, ni eyeɔ oyai kɛyaa he ni eteɔ shi yɛ lɛ.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛyaa wuoyigbɛ; ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswaa kɛbaa kooyigbɛ; kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔleɔ shi kɛyaa kɛbaa.
Faa fɛɛ faa naa yaboteɔ ŋshɔ mli, kɛ̃lɛ ŋshɔ yiii.
Hei ni fai lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛhoɔ kɛyaa be fɛɛ be.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, henaagbamɔ sɔŋŋ ni; shi adesa nyɛɛɛ ekɛɛ.
Etɔɔɔ hiŋmɛi kɛ nikwɛmɔ, ni etɔɔɔ toi hu kɛ ninumɔ.
Nɔ ni eba dã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baaba ekoŋŋ; ni nɔ ni afee dã lɛ, no nɔŋŋ abaafee ekoŋŋ; nɔ hee ko nɔ hee ko bɛ jeŋ.
Ani nɔ ko yɛ jeŋ ni aaanyɛ akɛɛ yɛ he akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ, enɛ lɛ nɔ hee ni?” Eba jeeŋmɔ yɛ yinɔi ni etsɔ̃ wɔhiɛ lɛ amli.
Akaiii blema nibii, ni akaiŋ nii ni baaba, ni yinɔi ni baaba lɛ kaiŋ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ mli sane.
Jajelɔ lɛ niiashikpamɔ Mi, Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ, miye Israel maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mikɛ nilee baagbugbuu shi, kɛtao nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ; ni naa, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ yakanii ni.
Etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Nii ni ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ ehiii jajemɔ trɔmɔɔ dɔŋŋ; ni nii ni eko bɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ akane efalɛ.
Mikɛɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe akɛ, “Mile nii jogbaŋŋ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm dã lɛ, ni nibii ashi ni mikpa egbele mijwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee mli pam.” Mikɛma mihiɛ akɛ mibatao male nɔ ni ji nilee kɛ nɔ ni ji sɛkɛyeli kɛ nɔ ni ji kwashiafeemɔ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nilee tuutu lɛ, ekɛ naagba nyiɛ, ni mɔ ni hãa nilee faa lɛ, ehaomɔi hu faa.
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ maka nɔ ni ji mliflimɔ makwɛ; shwɛ oyinɔ!” Shi naa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.
Mikɛɛ yɛ ŋmɔlɔ he akɛ, “Sɛkɛyeli ni”; ni mikɛɛ yɛ miishɛɛ hu he akɛ, “Mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ he?” Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ tao mli mikwɛ akɛ wain baahã mana miishɛɛ lo?
Asaŋ mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ nilee tao mli bɔ ni mafee mamɔ buulufeemɔ koŋ mli kɛdamɔ shi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mana nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɛi abii akɛ amɛfee yɛ jeŋ, yɛ amɛwala be kukuoo lɛ mli.
Mitsu nitsumɔi wuji: mimamɔ shĩai mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mifee waintromi hu mihã mihe; mifee abɔi kɛ tromi mihã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, ni mitɛo aduawa tsei srɔtoi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ mli; mije bukoi ni akɛ amɛmli nu shwieɔ tsei ni atɛo lɛ anɔ; mihe hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji fɛɛ, ni afɔfɔɔ nyɔji hu ahã mi yɛ miwe lɛ mli; mina toi kɛ tsinai fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalɛm.
Mibua shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ mishishi maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ shikpɔji anɔ bii adɛŋ jwetri naa mihã mihe.
Mina hii lalɔi kɛ yei lalɔi fɛɛ ni laa kɛjieɔ mihiɛtserɛ; ni miyɛ nuu tsuinaa nii ni ji shieŋnyɛmɛi babaoo hu.
Mibatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ wulu, ni migbojee bakwɔ fe mɛi fɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ amɛhi Yerusalɛm dã lɛ, ni nilee hu ebɔɔɔ mi.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni fee mi akɔnɔ lɛ, mikamaaa mihe.
Mitsiii mihe naa yɛ miishɛɛ ko miishɛɛ ko gbɛfaŋ, ejaakɛ mina nibii fɛɛ ni migbo amɛhe deŋme lɛ ahe miishɛɛ.
Deŋme ni migbo lɛ he sɛɛnamɔ ji no.
Shi be ni misusu nibii fɛɛ ni mikɛ minine etsu, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔ mi kɛtsu nii lɛ hu fɛɛ he lɛ, nɔ ni mina ji akɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Anɔkwa, nɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni adesa naa he sɛɛ yɛ jeŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛni po maŋtsɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ kroko sɛɛ baanyɛ efee?
Nɔ ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ fee lɛ, no nɔŋŋ pɛ lɛ hu ebaafee.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miku sɛɛ misusu nilee kɛ sɛkɛyeli kɛ kwashiafeemɔ he.
Mina akɛ nilee hi fe kwashiafeemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni la hi fe duŋ lɛ, ni nilelɔ lɛ enyiɛɔ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ; shi kwashia lɛ, enyiɛɔ duŋduŋ tamɔ mɔ ni nyiɛ duŋ mli; shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshɛɛ mli ekome.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Sane koome ni baa kwashia nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ni baaba minɔ.
Nɛgbɛ mɔ mikɛ nilee pii nɛɛ yaa?” Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni akaiii kwashia kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ, nakai akaiii nilelɔ bei fɛɛ, ejaakɛ be ni wɔsɛɛ ko baashɛ lɛ hiɛ ekpa amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ jeeŋmɔ.
Bɔ ni nilelɔ gboɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kwashia hu gboɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, jeŋshihilɛ je mitsine, ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ hao mi, ejaakɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Deŋme fɛɛ ni migbo yɛ jeŋ je mitsine, ejaakɛ mina akɛ mibashi fɛɛ kwa mibahã mɔ ni baaba ebaye misɛɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafee nilelɔ jio, kwashia ni jio, namɔ le?
Ni kɛ̃lɛ nii fɛɛ ni migbo he deŋme ni mina yɛ nilee naa, yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaaye.
Enɛ hu yakanii ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, minijiaŋ je wui akɛ migbo deŋme kɛtsu nii nɛkɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli; ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ mɔ ko ni egbo deŋme kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ ŋaa shiɔ egboshinii lɛ ehãa mɔ ni gboko nii lɛ he deŋme ko, ni ebayeɔ.
Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ nɔ fɔŋ kpele ni.
Mɛni ji nɔ ni gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ kɛ etɔlɛ he yɛ je nɛɛ mli?
Ejaakɛ ewala gbii fɛɛ lɛ piŋmɔ ni, ni enitsumɔ fɛɛ lɛ mlifu sɔŋŋ tɔ, ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ tete ewɔɔɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hu yakanii ni.
Nɔ ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ adesa fe akɛ nii ni egbo he deŋme ni ena lɛ, eye eko, ni enu eko, ni ena ehe miishɛɛ.
Enɛ hu mina akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ, ejaakɛ namɔ ji mɔ ni baanyɛ eye nii aloo ena miishɛɛ ko kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ nine bɛ mli?
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ duroɔ lɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãa ebuaa, ni etĩaa nii anaa emaa shi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhãa mɔ ni feɔ esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ.
Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ ebe Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ ebe ni ato ahã lɛ; ni sane fɛɛ sane ni baa je nɛɛ mli yɛ ebe ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto.
Fɔmɔ be yɛ, ni gbele be hu yɛ; nidumɔ be yɛ, ni nikpamɔ be hu yɛ.
Be yɛ ni agbeɔ, ni be yɛ hu ni atsaa; be yɛ ni akumɔɔ nɔ ni ama, ni be yɛ hu ni atswaa amaa shi.
Yaafo be yɛ, ni ŋmɔlɔ be hu yɛ; awerɛhoyeli be yɛ, ni be yɛ ni ajoɔ.
Be yɛ ni akɔlɔɔ tɛi ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ, ni be yɛ hu ni akɛbuaa tɛi anaa; be yɛ ni aloɔ mɔ atuu, ni be yɛ hu ni alooo mɔ atuu.
Be yɛ ni ataoɔ nii, ni be yɛ hu ni aŋmɛɔ nii ahe; be yɛ ni akɛ nii toɔ, ni be yɛ ni ashɛɔ nii afɔ̃ɔ.
Be yɛ ni atserɛɔ nii amli, ni be hu yɛ ni akpɛɔ nii; be yɛ ni afeɔ dioo, ni be hu yɛ ni awieɔ.
Suɔmɔ be yɛ, ni nyɛɛ be hu yɛ; ta be yɛ, ni toiŋjɔlɛ be hu yɛ.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa yɛ deŋme ni egboɔ he?
Mina nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfɔ̃ adesai anɔ koni amɛgbo he deŋme lɛ.
Ehãa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ feɔ akɔnɔ yɛ ebe mli, asaŋ ekɛ naanɔ he susumɔ ewo adesa mli, kɛ̃lɛ adesa nyɛŋ ena ele nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo kɛyaagbee naanɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mina akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni hi hã gbɔmɛi, beiaŋ ni amɛyɔɔ wala mli, fe akɛ amɛmii ashɛ amɛhe, ni amɛye jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ni amɛshwɛ amɛyinɔ; asaŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɔɔmɔ ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye, ni enu, ni ena deŋme ni egboɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.
-Miyoo akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fee lɛ, ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; anyɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko afata he lɛ, anyɛŋ ajie nɔ ko kɛje mli hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ efee nɔ lɛ nakai, bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ adesa ashe lɛ gbeyei.
Nɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ebaho etee dã, ni nɔ hu ni baaba lɛ eba dã.
Nyɔŋmɔ tiuɔ nɔ ni eba ni ewo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee momo lɛ sɛɛ.
Toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli Asaŋ mina akɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, afeɔ efɔŋ yɛ he ni akojoɔ yɛ tete, ni afeɔ yiwalɛ nii yɛ he ni esa akɛ ayeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ tete.
Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo jalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eto be ehã sane fɛɛ sane kɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ.” Mikɛɛ mihe akɛ, yɛ adesai agbɛfaŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ miika amɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ amɛtamɔ kooloi nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ adesa naagbee kɛ kooloo hu naagbee lɛ fɛɛ ekome; bɔ ni mɔ nɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ nɛ hu gboɔ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔ kome amɛyɔɔ, ni gbɔmɔ ehiii fe kooloo, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ji amɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ he koome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyaa; amɛ fɛɛ lɛ su mli amɛjɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaatsɔ̃ su ekoŋŋ.
Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛɛ akɛ adesa mumɔ lɛ eyaa ŋwɛi, ni kooloo mumɔ lɛ eyaa su mli?
No hewɔ lɛ, miyoo akɛ nɔ ko ehiii fe enɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ aye enitsumɔ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ.
Namɔ baanyɛ ekɛ adesa aku sɛɛ kɛba jeŋ koni ebana nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?
Asaŋ mikwɛ yiwalɛ nibii ni afeɔ yɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Naa yaafonui jwere mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahiɛ, shi amɛbɛ mɔ ko ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii.
Mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ yɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ amɛmii.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni misusu ji akɛ mɛi ni egboi momo lɛ anɔ hi fe mɛi ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo nɛɛ.
Shi mɔ ni nɔ hi fe mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni anako afɔ lɛ, ni ebanako nibii fɔ̃ji ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ miyoo akɛ deŋme ni gbɔmɔ gboɔ fɛɛ, kɛ tɔlɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, fɛɛ jɛɔ ehiɛ ni kɔ̃ɔ enaanyo nɔ.
Enɛ hu yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Kwashia kotaa eniji ekɛtaa shi, ni hɔmɔ gbeɔ lɛ.
Dɛ̃kɔkɔ kome mli nii ni toiŋjɔlɛ yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe niji enyɔ ni akɛmiigbo yaka deŋme tamɔ ayeɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔ.
Asaŋ mina yakanii ko yɛ jeŋ.
No ji mɔ ko ni ebɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ebɛ bi lɛ, ebɛ nyɛminuu hu, kɛ̃lɛ ekpaaa deŋmegbomɔ, ni nii ni ena hu esaaa ehiɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ biko ehe dã akɛ, “Kwɛ, namɔ kwraa hewɔ ni migboɔ deŋme, ni mikamaa mihe jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔ nɛɛ?” Enɛ hu yakanii ni, kɛ awerɛho sane fɛɛ.
Mɛi enyɔ hi fe mɔ kome, ejaakɛ mɛi enyɔ naa deŋme ni amɛgboɔ lɛ he sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji shi amɛgbee lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome kɛ̃ aaawo enaanyo nɔ.
Shi mɔ ni ekoome lɛ, kpoo hã lɛ ejaakɛ kɛji egbee shi lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni aaawo enɔ.
Asaŋ kɛji mɛi enyɔ kamɔ shi lɛ, amɛhe dɔɔ la; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni ekome lɛ ehe aaadɔ la hu?
Kɛji mɔ ko tua mɔ ni ekome lɛ, mɔ lɛ nine nyɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ enɔ; shi kɛji mɛi enyɔ ni lɛ, amɛbaaye mɔ ni tua amɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kpãa ni akɛ kpãa blawai etɛ̃ elo lɛ emlitsemɔ wa.
Oblanyo ohiafo nilelɔ hi fe maŋtsɛ nuumo kwashia ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ŋaawoo dɔŋŋ, tsɛbelɛ gboklɛfoiatsuŋ ejɛ ni ebaye maŋtsɛ lɛ, aloo afɔ lɛ ohiafo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Misusu gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ ni yaa baa yɛ jeŋ kɛ oblanyo hu, mɔ ni baaba ebaye maŋtsɛ sɛɛ lɛ he.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ayi fa bɔ ni anyɛŋ amɛ akane, shi maŋtsɛ ta amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ yinɔ ni baaba lɛ nyaŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ he.
Anɔkwa, enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni, ni etamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli.
Kaawo shi oya Kwɛmɔ jogbaŋŋ kɛji ooya Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ.
Kɛji ooya jɛi oyabo wiemɔ toi lɛ, ehi fe oooya jɛi oyashã afɔle ni kwashiai yaa amɛyashãa lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛleee akɛ amɛmiifee nɔ fɔŋ.
Kaahã onaa miifee blɛblɛ, ni kaahã otsui miihã osha ohe owie yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, ni bo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oyɔɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, kaahã owiemɔ miifa.
Ejaakɛ kɛji odi lamɔ sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ nitsumɔ pii shwieɔ onɔ; wiemɔ pii akɛyoɔ kwashia.
Kɛ owo Nyɔŋmɔ shi lɛ, kaahã shiwoo lɛ nɔyeli sɛɛ miitsɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɛ kwashiai ahe tsui; shi ni owo lɛ ye nɔ.
Faŋ nɔ ni owooo shi kwraa, fe nɔ ni owo shi ni oyeee nɔ.
Kaaŋmɛ onaabu gbɛ ni ehã ofee esha; ni kaakɛɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ akɛ onaa ni etɛ shi.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli afu yɛ owiemɔ hewɔ ni efite oninenaa nitsumɔ lɛ?
Kɛji lamɔi fa pɛ, wiemɔi hu efa; shi bo lɛ oshe Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.
Wala lɛ yaka nɔ ko ni Kɛji ona akɛ aawa ohiafo ko yi, asaŋ aatsɔ̃ jalɛ saneyeli hiɛ aaabu shi, ni afeee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ lɛ, kaahã enɛ miifee bo naakpɛɛ, ejaakɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ, tsulɔnukpa ko ni fe lɛ yɛ ni kwɛɔ enɔ, ni tsulɔi krokomɛi hu yɛ lolo ni amɛgbɛnaa kwɔlɔ fe klɛŋklɛŋ tsulɔi lɛ.
Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ŋmɔji yɔɔ nɔ nɔ.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ shika lɛ, etɔɔɔ shika; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ ninamɔ etɔɔɔ ninamɔ.
Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii ni.
Kɛ ninamɔ fa lɛ, naabui ni yeɔ nii lɛ hu faa.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ nɔtsɛ lɛ naa?
Sɛɛ ni enaa ji akɛ kɛji ekɛ ehiŋmɛi kwɛ enii lɛ, enaa miishɛɛ.
Apaafonyo na nii babaoo eye jio, fioo ena eye jio, ewɔɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; shi niiatsɛ nii ni ena lɛ he jwɛŋmɔ hãaa ena wɔ ewɔ.
Awerɛho sane ko ni mina yɛ jeŋ nɛ: gbɔmɔ adesa tiaa nii naa ehãa ehe, shi no nɔŋŋ moŋ ni yeɔ lɛ awui.
Nii nɛɛ fɛɛ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛji akɛtee jarayeli.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ bi nɛ, shi nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ edɛŋ ni ebaashi ehã ebi lɛ.
Bɔ ni ejɛ enyɛ musuŋ eba kɛ ehe yayai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeeku esɛɛ kɛaatee bɔ ni eba lɛ, ni ekɔŋ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli nɔ ko nɔ ko kɛyaŋ.
Awerɛho sane nɛ: bɔ pɛ ni eba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eeetee.
Mɛɛ sɛɛ ena fe akɛ egbo deŋme folo; ni ewala gbii fɛɛ amli lɛ, ehi duŋ kɛ awerɛho kɛ mlila kpele kɛ hela mli, ni jeŋshihilɛ je etsine?
Naa, nɔ ni mikpa shi mina akɛ ehi, ni esa hã gbɔmɔ adesa feemɔ ji akɛ eye, ni enu; ni deŋme fɛɛ ni egboɔ yɛ ewala kukuoo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eye emli ŋɔɔmɔ koni ena miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji egbɛfaŋ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã ena shika kɛ nii kɛ hewalɛ koni eye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ, emɔ egbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ mli, ni emii ashɛ edeŋmegbomɔ he.
Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikeenii ni.
Ejaakɛ esusuŋ ewala gbii lɛ ahe tsɔ̃, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã etsui eyi obɔ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Nɔ fɔŋ ko yɛ ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni ebu yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Mɔ ko hiɔ shi, ni Nyɔŋmɔ hãa enaa shika kɛ nii kɛ anunyam bɔ ni nɔ ko bɛ ni eshweɔ ni enaaa; shi kɛ̃lɛ edurooo lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛye eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ; shi moŋ mɔkpɔŋ ji mɔ ni bayeɔ eninamɔ lɛ mli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ.
Enɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ni eji hejaramɔ sane kpele.
Kɛji mɔ ko fɔ bii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛ, ni eye afii babaoo, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai amli ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ eko, ni enaaa fuu kpakpa hu lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ abifao ni ashrake tete nɔ hi fe lɛ.
Sharakemɔ bi lɛ yaka eba jeŋ lɛ; enyiɛ duŋ mli kɛba, ni duŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ kɛyaa, ni hiɛ jeɔ enɔ.
Enaaa hulu lɛ, eleee nɔ ko nɔ ko hu; kɛ̃lɛ lɛ moŋ enaa hejɔlɛ fe mɔ ni aaaye afii akpei enyɔ tete, shi eyeee jeŋ nibii kpakpai lɛ amli ŋɔɔmɔ ko.
Ani jeee he koome mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ yaa lo?
Gbɔmɔ tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme fɛɛ lɛ, emusu kɛkɛ hewɔ; kɛ̃lɛ gbɔmɔ leee mitɔ.
Mɛni ji nɔ ni nilelɔ kɛfe kwashia?
Ni mɛni ohiafo naa kɛji ele bɔ ni ahiɛɔ he ahãa yɛ mɛi ahiɛ?
Nɔ ni onaa kɛ ohiŋmɛii lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni oshweɔ.
Enɛ hu lɛ yakanii kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ abɔyeli ni.
Nɔ ni eba dã lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi momo; ni ale nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ, asaŋ akɛ gbɔmɔ nyɛɛɛ ekɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ fe lɛ afu daa.
Wiemɔ pii lɛ ekɛ yakanii pii nyiɛ; ni mɛni ji sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ mli hã gbɔmɔ?
Namɔ le nɔ ni hi hã gbɔmɔ adesa ni eyɔɔ yaka wala be kukuoo nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ lamɔ nɛɛ mli?
Ni namɔ baanyɛ egba gbɔmɔ nɔ ni baaba jeŋ yɛ egbele sɛɛ?
Wala he susumɔi Gbɛi kpakpa hi fe mu ni jara wa, ni gbele gbi hi fe fɔmɔ gbi.
Kɛji otee shĩa ni aafee yara yɛ mli lɛ, ehi fe nɔ ni otee shĩa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ esa akɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ahi nɔ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anaagbee ji gbele.
Awerɛho hi fe ŋmɔlɔ; ejaakɛ awerɛho baahã ohiɛ afee mɔbɔmɔbɔ moŋ nɛ, shi ehãa jwɛŋmɔ mli gbeleɔ.
He ni nilelɔ tsui kãa ji shĩa ni yara yɔɔ mli; shi he ni kwashia tsui kãa ji shĩa ni mliflimɔ yɔɔ mli.
Ehi akɛ ooonu ni nilelɔi miikã bo, fe nɔ ni ooonu ni kwashiai miila kɛmiikafo bo.
Ejaakɛ kwashiai aŋmɔlɔ lɛ, etamɔ ŋmei fɛlɛmɔ yɛ kukwɛi shishi la mli.
No hu yakanii ni.
Niseniianii hãa nilelɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kwashia, ni nyɔɔŋnihamɔ fiteɔ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Nɔ ko naagbee hi fe eshishijee; ni tsuishitoo mumɔ hi fe hewoo mumɔ.
Kaahã omli fu oya, ejaakɛ kwashiai amiinaa ji he ni mlifu yɔɔ.
Kaakɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsɛɛ ŋɔɔ fe ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ?” Ejaakɛ jeee nilee mli obaajɛ obi nɛkɛ sane.
Nilee ni gboshinii fata he he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã hiɛkãalɔi; ejaakɛ nilee baa mɔ yi tamɔ shika baa mɔ yi lɛ, shi nɔ ni nilee kɛfe shika ji akɛ nilee baa mɔ ni yɔɔ eko yi.
Susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ he.
Namɔ baanyɛ ejaje nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɔ̃dɔ̃ lɛ.
Be ni nibii eshwere lɛ, nya; ni kɛji joomɔ be ba lɛ susumɔ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ, bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ adesa akanyɛ ele nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ.
Mina mihiɛ nii yɛ yaka je nɛɛ mli.
Jalɔ gboɔ yɛ ejalɛ nifeemɔ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ lɛ moŋ wala sɛɛ tsɛɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni efeɔ mli.
Kaafee ohe jalɔ tuutu; asaŋ kaafee ohe nilelɔ tuutu.
Mɛɛba oookpãtã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiɛ?
Kaafee ohe yiwalɔ tuutu, ni asaŋ kaafee kwashia.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ ogbo be ni ogbele be shɛko.
Ehi akɛ omɔɔ enɛ mli, ni kaajie onine yɛ he; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ebaaje fɛɛ mli shweshweeshwe.
Nilee hãa nilelɔ kome naa hewalɛ ni fe nɔyelɔi nyɔŋma ahewalɛ yɛ maŋ.
Anɔkwa, adesa ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni ekpakpa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ efeɔ, ni efeee esha.
Kaadi gbɔmɛi anaa wiemɔi fɛɛ asɛɛ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ooonu ni otsulɔ miilomɔ bo; ole yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyitsoŋ akɛ bo hu olomɔ mɛi komɛi shii abɔ pɛŋ.
Mikɛ nilee eka enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ mikwɛ.
Mitswa fai shi akɛ male nii; shi miyanyɛɛɛ.
Namɔ baanyɛ ena?
Esɛɛ jɛkɛ, ni emli kwɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ mibagbɛlɛ shi matao nilee kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Mitao akɛ male yitsoŋwalɛ ni yɔɔ buulufeemɔ mli, kɛ bɔ ni buulufeemɔ lɛ sɛkɛyeli ni.
Mina nɔ ko ni joɔ fe gbele tete; no ji yoo.
Etsui mli eyi kɛ tsɔnei kɛ yai ni akɛduɔ mɔ, ni eniji lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni fimɔɔ mɔ ni.
Mɔ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei jeɔ yoo akpa mli; shi eshafeelɔ lɛ yoo duɔ lɛ.
Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mihiɛ taomɔ mli ekomekome lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ.
Nibii ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ etao aahu lɛ, minako.
Mɛi akpe mli lɛ, mina nuu kome pɛ ni yɔɔ hiɛsɔɔ; shi minaaa yoo kome nɛkɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Naa, nɔ ni kɛkɛ ni mina ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ gbɔmɔ adesa koni ehi shi krɔŋŋ; shi gbɔmɔ adesa ni eto ŋai srɔtoi.
Namɔ kɛ nilelɔ ye egbɔ; ni namɔ nuɔ nibii ashishi?
Nilee hãa gbɔmɔ saa ehiɛ kɛ ŋmɔlɔ, ni ehiɛtumɔ laajeɔ.
Ye Maŋtsɛ gbee nɔ Ye maŋtsɛ lɛ fãmɔ nɔ; yɛ okitã krɔŋŋ ni okã lɛ hewɔ lɛ kaahã enɔyeli hao bo.
Kɛji sane lɛ eŋɔɔɔ enaa lɛ kaashashao shi; oshi ehiɛ oya, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ feɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
Kɛji maŋtsɛ kɛɛ lɛ, akɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ; ni namɔ po baanyɛ lɛ ebi akɛ, “Mɛni po ofeɔ nɛɛ?” Mɔ ni yeɔ famɔ nɔ lɛ, enaaa amane.
Nilelɔ le beyinɔ kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ efee nɔ ni yɔɔ feemɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ be kɛ gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ atsuɔ ehenii; kɛ̃lɛ naagba kpaaa yɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ko leee nɔ ni baaba; ni namɔ hu aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ bɔ ni ebaaba lɛ ehã?
Mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaatsĩ gbɔmɔ wala mumɔ naa koni ekafã yɛ emli; ni gbi ni gbɔmɔ gboɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ.
Ta ko ni wɔnyɛŋ naa foi wɔje ni; ni nɔ ko hu nyɛŋ ehã mɛi ni ahe yɔɔ mli aje mli.
Mɔ ni efeee nɔ ni ja kɛ Mɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni ja Be ni mitao nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ jeŋ ni gbɔmɔ adesa kpɔfuɔ enyɛmi gbɔmɔ yɛ mli nɛɛ mli fitsofitso lɛ, nɔ ni mina nɛ: Mina mɛi fɔ̃ji ni egboi ni afu amɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awalabeiaŋ lɛ, anaa amɛ amɛyaa amɛbaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; shi amɛgbele mli lɛ, ajie amɛyi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, he nɔŋŋ ni amɛfee nakai efɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Enɛ hu shishinumɔ bɛ he.
Akɛ ni awooo esha he nyɔmɔ oya hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahe ehomɔ kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ.
Yɛ mli akɛ eshafeelɔ feɔ esha shii oha, ni ewala sɛɛ tsɛɔ moŋ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mile akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei; shi yiwalɔ lɛ ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ni ewala sɛɛ etsɛŋ tamɔ hɔ̃ɔŋ, ejaakɛ esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei.
Nɔ ko hu ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ni shishinumɔ bɛ he nɛ: gbɔmɛi kpakpai komɛi naa amanehului ni sa gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji moŋ; ni yiwalɔi komɛi yɛ ni amɛna dromɔ ni sa gbɔmɛi kpakpai moŋ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɛ ji akɛ enɛ hu lɛ shishinumɔ bɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni mikafo miishɛɛ ejaakɛ nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ hã gbɔmɔ yɛ hulu shishi nɛɛ, fe akɛ eye nii ni enu nɔ ko, ni ena miishɛɛ.
Eeenyɛ ekã he efee enɛ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ.
Be ni mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ fɔ̃ nɔ akɛ matao male nii koni manu nii ni yaa nɔ, yɛ je nɛɛŋ shishi, hewɔ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ naaa wɔ ewɔ lɛ, mina mile Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ nitsumɔi fɛɛ; shi mina akɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ baagba ehe naa ehã lɛ, enuŋ nii ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ shishi kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Tsɛbelɛ nilelɔ aaakɛɛ akɛ ena ele nii fɛɛ nɛ, shi anɔkwale ji akɛ enyɛŋ ele nɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ mitsui fɔ̃ nibii nɛɛ anɔ, ni mitao fɛɛ mli.
Nɔ ni mina ji akɛ jalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ amɛnifeemɔi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ fɛɛ yɔɔ; suɔmɔ ni jio, nyɛɛ ni jio, gbɔmɔ ko leee.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kã gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ yakanii ni, ejaakɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ ni ejaaa, kɛ gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ gbɔmɔ fɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ni he tse kɛ mɔ ni he tseee, kɛ mɔ ni shãa afɔle kɛ mɔ ni eshãaa afɔle fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛnaagbee kome.
Nɔ ni baa gbɔmɔ kpakpa nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ baa efɔŋfeelɔ nɔ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ baa mɔ ni kãa kitã kɛ mɔ ni kãaa kitã fɛɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ko ni ejaaa yɛ nii fɛɛ ni afeɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ ji akɛ mɛi fɛɛ anaagbee afee ekome.
Gbɔmɛi atsuiiaŋ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ efɔŋ kɛ sɛkɛyeli nifeemɔi, beiaŋ ni amɛyɔɔ walaŋ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni amɛyaa gbohiiaje.
Shi mɔ ni hiɛ kã lɛ, eyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko kɛ̃ ejaakɛ gbee hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ehi fe jata ni egbo.
Ejaakɛ hiɛkãalɔi lɛ amɛle akɛ amɛbaagboi, shi gbohii lɛ amɛleee nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko hu ni amɛbaana dɔŋŋ, ni hiɛ kpaa amɛnɔ kwraa.
Amɛsuɔmɔ kɛ amɛnyɛɛ kɛ amɛwuŋayeli fɛɛ eho etee momo; ni kɛyaashi naanɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ amɛhe bɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
Yaa nɔ oye oboloo kɛ miishɛɛ, ni onu owain hu kɛ mliflimɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejɔɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ nɔ momo.
Hã otadei ahiɛ ayɛ be fɛɛ be; wo oyiteŋ mu be fɛɛ be hu.
Okɛ oŋa ni osumɔɔ lɛ ahi shi yɛ miishɛɛ mli, bei abɔ ni oyɔɔ yaka wala ni Nyɔŋmɔ eduro bo yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ deŋme ni ogbo yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, ogbɛfaŋ nɔ ni ona yɛ jeŋ ji no.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ tsumɔ ni ooomɔ mli lɛ, tsu kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbohiiaje he ni oyaa lɛ, nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ nitsumɔ loo yiŋshwiemɔ loo nilee loo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ eko bɛ jɛi.
Asaŋ mina akɛ jeŋ ni ayɔɔ mli nɛɛ lɛ, jeee be fɛɛ be mɔ ni najiaŋ wa yeɔ foidamɔ mli kunim, aloo kãkãlɔ yeɔ ta mli kunim; aloo nilelɔ naa edaaŋŋmaa, aloo hiɛshikãlɔ tsɔ̃ɔ niiatsɛ, aloo mɔ ni he esa yɛ nitsumɔ ko mli hiɛ baa nyam; shi amɛ fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ naa kɛkɛ ni.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ adesa leee ebe.
Kɛji be lɛ banina lɛ trukaa lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ faaŋ loo ni ahiɛ, loo loofɔji ni akɛ tsɔne edu amɛ.
Nilee kɛ Kwashiafeemɔ he susumɔ Nilee sane ko hu ni mina yɛ jeŋ ni enɔ bɛ hã mi nɛ: Be ko lɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ko tee akɛ eyaatua maŋ bibioo kɛ emli bii fioo ko.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ sa maŋ bibioo lɛ yi, ni etswa kawoo gbogboi ekɛbɔle maŋ lɛ.
Nuu ohiafo ko yɛ maŋ bibioo lɛ mli, ni lɛ etsɔ̃ enilee nɔ ehere maŋ lɛ yiwala.
Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko kaiii nuu ohiafo nɛɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ nilee hi fe hewalɛ, tsɛbelɛ abuuu ohiafo nilee, ni akɛ ewiemɔ efeee nɔ ko.
Nilelɔ wiemɔ ni ewieɔ lɛ ablɛbi lɛ, anuɔ, ni ehi fe bolɔmɔ ni nɔyelɔ bolɔɔ yɛ kwashiai ateŋ.
Nilee he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ fe tawuu nii; shi eshafeelɔ kome kpãtãa nii kpakpai babaoo hiɛ.
Adɔdɔji ni egboi hãa ojeŋma feelɔ ojeŋma tete shaa, ni ejeɔ fu; no hewɔ lɛ, buulufeemɔ fioo lɛ efiteɔ nilee kɛ nyam nitsumɔ fɛɛ.
Nilelɔ tsui kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ja he; shi kwashia tsui kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa nɔ ni ejaaa he.
Kɛji kwashia nyiɛ tɛmpɔŋ nɔ tete po lɛ, enaaa jwɛŋmɔ, ni ehãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ naa akɛ kwashia ji lɛ.
Kɛji onɔyelɔ mli fu bo lɛ, no akahã oshi ogbɛnaa ni ohiɛ yɛ eshishi lɛ, ejaakɛ saneheŋmɛɛmɔ lɛ ejɔɔ tɔ̃mɔi wuji tete ahe.
Mina nɔ ko ni ejaaa gbɛ yɛ je nɛɛ mli ni nɔyelɔi feɔ.
Aholeɔ kwashiai anɔ ataraa hei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ; ni akɛ niiatsɛmɛi taraa hei ni bɛ nyam.
Ni mina nyɔji tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ be ni lumɛi nyiɛ amɛnane nɔ tamɔ nyɔji.
Mɔ ni tsaa bu lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbee mli, ni mɔ ni gbuɔ gbogbo ewoɔ mli lɛ, lɛ onufu aaakɔ̃.
Mɔ ni tsaa tɛ lɛ, lɛ tɛ pilaa, ni mɔ hu ni gbaa lai lɛ, lɛ awui lai yeɔ.
Kɛji mɔ ko lema naa egbo, ni ejɔɔɔ naa lɛ, no lɛ ja emia ekpɔiaŋ waa.
Nilee akɛtoɔ nifeemɔ he dani ayeɔ kunim.
Akamɛ ni onufu kɔ̃ mɔ dani akɛ ŋkunyaayeli kũ enaa; no lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔ hãa ehiɛ baa nyam, shi kwashia naabu kpãtãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ.
Ejeɔ ewiemɔ shishi kɛ kwashiai awiemɔi, ni egbeɔ naa kɛ sɛkɛyelɔi awiemɔ.
Kwashia wieɔ babaoo.
Gbɔmɔ ko leee nɔ ni baaba; ni mɔ ko hu nyɛŋ egba lɛ nɔ ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ.
Kwashia deŋmegbomɔ hãa etɔɔ lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋ gbɛ tete laajeɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo, maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ gbekɛ ni, ni olumɛi tsɛɔ yelikɛnumɔ leebi.
Shi ajɔɔ bo, bo maŋ ni omaŋtsɛ lɛ abladei abi ni, ni olumɛi lɛ tsɛɔ okplɔ̃ yɛ be ni sa mli koni amɛye nii ni amɛna gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ, shi jeee koni amɛtɔrɔ dãa.
Hejɔ̃ hãa tsu duɔ, ni anihao hãa tsu wuleɔ ewoɔ mli.
Ŋmaa hãa mɔ miishɛɛ, ni wain hãa mɔ mli filiɔ lɛ, shi eko fɛɛ eko lɛ shika akɛfeɔ.
Kaalomɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ oyitsoŋ tete, ni kaalomɔ niiatsɛ hu yɛ osɛɛtsu mli, ejaakɛ gbogbo he yɛ folɔ.
Nilelɔ nifeemɔ Feemɔ ejurɔ oto, ni wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ aaafee bo ejurɔ.
Feemɔ mɛi kpawo loo kpaanyɔ ejurɔ, ejaakɛ oleee sane gbonyo ni nyiɛ gbɛ baa yɛ jeŋ.
Kɛji atatuiaŋ yi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ, amɛnɛɔ nu amɛshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji tso yaagbee shi, ni eyagbee wuoyigbɛ loo kooyigbɛ lɛ, eshigbeemɔhe lɛ nɔŋŋ ekãa.
Mɔ ni saraa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, eduŋ nii, ni mɔ hu ni kwɛɔ atatui lɛ, ekpaŋ nii.
Bɔ ni onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni feɔ ni mumɔ baa bi ni yɔɔ yoohɔlɔ musuŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ onyɛŋ ole bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ tsuɔ enii fɛɛ.
Du odumɔwui leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ole wui lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni baahi, enɛ loo enɛ, loo kɛji fɛɛ aaahi.
La ŋɔɔ, ni kɛji hiŋmɛi miina hulu lɛ, gbɔmɔ naa miishɛɛ.
Kɛji gbɔmɔ ye afii babaoo lɛ, ena miishɛɛ yɛ fɛɛ mli; shi moŋ ekai akɛ gbele duŋ be fa.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ yakanii ni.
Ŋaa kɛhã Oblahii kɛ Oblayei Oblanyo, nya yɛ oblahiiaŋ; hã omii ashɛ ohe yɛ oblahiiaŋ fɛɛ; ye otsui naa sane; feemɔ nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ; shi moŋ kaimɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ bo baakojo yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ofee lɛ ahewɔ.
Jiemɔ mlifu kɛje oyiŋ, ni kaapiŋ ohe yɛ nɔ ko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ogbekɛbiiashi kɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ yakanii be ni.
Kaimɔ obɔlɔ lɛ yɛ oblahiiaŋ, be ni gbii fɔ̃ji lɛ kɛ afii fɔ̃ji lɛ nako ashɛ, be mli ni obaakɛɛ akɛ, “Jeŋshihilɛ eŋɔɔɔ” lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ hulu la lɛ kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere lɛ kɛ ŋulamii lɛ baafee sulii, ni atatui baabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ sɛɛ.
Nakai be lɛ ogbɔmɔtso shĩa lɛ he bulɔi, ni ji oniji lɛ baakpokpo, ni onaji kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ lɛ egbɔjɔ, ni onyanyɔji, nigbɛlɛlɔi lɛ, nyɛɛɛ nii amɛgbɛlɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ eshwɛ amɛyi fioo ko kɛkɛ, ni hiŋmɛii lɛ ni kwɛɔ samfɛji lɛ amli nii lɛ anɔ eha.
Toii lɛ ni anaa kamɔ ni boɔ blohuiaŋ toi lɛ nuŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ; amɛnuŋ nigbɛlɛmɔ tsɔne lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni naa eba shi lɛ he ekpakpa ko.
Loofɔlɔ gbee aaatsĩɛ bo yɛ wɔ mli moŋ, shi ooonu yei lalɔi agbei, ejaakɛ osharãi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ gbɛteŋ.
Oooshe hei ni kwɔlɔ gbeyei, ni onyiɛmɔ tete baatsɔ̃ osharã ahã bo.
Oyiteŋ baayɛ tamɔ odonti ni egba, ni ohetsimɔ baawa ahã bo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ bo akɔnɔ dɔŋŋ.
Akɛni gbɔmɔ adesa miiya enaanɔ shĩa lɛ, no hewɔ ni yarafeelɔi foɔ shi yɛ blohuiaŋ lɛ.
Jwiɛtɛi kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ lɛ baatse, ni shika kane lɛ baatswa shi ni ejwa, ni faaŋyaa gbɛ lɛ baajwa yɛ nubu lɛ naa.
Wɔsũ gbɔmɔtsei lɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ sũ mli ekoŋŋ, he ni amɛjɛ lɛ, ni mumɔ lɛ hu baaku esɛɛ eya Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni ejɛ eba lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yakanii mli yakanii, Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ; fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.
Wiemɔi lɛ anaamuu Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ le nii, ni etsɔ̃ɔ emaŋbii lɛ nii ni ele lɛ eko.
Ekase abɛi ahe nii, ejwɛŋ amɛhe ni ekɛ amɛ to shihilɛ he ekwɛ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ.
Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ etao wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ, asaŋ ni ja, ni eŋmala anɔkwale wiemɔi.
Nilelɔ daaŋ wiemɔi lɛ etamɔ kplamɔ tso.
Tookwɛlɔ koome ni yɔɔ lɛ, ewiemɔi ni abua naa lɛ yɛ kpɛŋŋ tamɔ plɛkoo ni aka awo tso mli.
Mibi, kwɛmɔ ni ahi yɛ enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ.
Woloŋmaa bɛ naagbee, ni nikasemɔ tuutu lɛ gbɔmɔtso tɔlɛ ni.
Sane tso muu lɛ ni onu lɛ fɛɛ naagbee nɛ.
She Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni oye ekitãi lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ enɛ ji nitsumɔ kwraa ni gbɔmɔ yɔɔ tsumɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo wɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔfee gbɛfaŋ, ehi jio, ehiii jio, teemɔŋ nibii fɛɛ fata he.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Lalawiemɔi ni abua naa nɛɛ kɔɔ suɔmɔ he.
Yɛ lalawiemɔi nɛɛ pii amli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo miiwie; ni ekomɛi amli hu lɛ, yoo kɛ nuu miiwie.
Yɛ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔi komɛi amli lɛ, gbɛi ni awo nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ ji Solomon Lala, ejaakɛ nakai atsɛ lɛ yɛ Hebri Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Yudafoi tsɔ̃ɔ lalawiemɔi nɛɛ ashishi akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ naanyobɔɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii ateŋ; ni Kristofoi hu tsɔ̃ɔ shishi akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ naanyobɔɔ ni kã Kristo kɛ asafo lɛ teŋ.
Mlijaramɔi Klɛŋklɛŋ lala .—.
Lala ni ji Enyɔ .—.
Lala ni ji Etɛ̃ .—.
Lala ni ji Ejwɛ .—.
Lala ni ji Enumɔ .—.
Lala ni ji Ekpaa .-
Solomon lalai amli lala nɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lala Yoo lɛ Ao, mina ni kulɛ ooobashwɔ minaa; ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ fe wain.
Omui ni okpaa jeɔ ŋma naakpa, ogbɛi jeɔ ŋma tamɔ muŋma ni afɔse ashwie shi.
No hewɔ ni oblayei lɛ sumɔɔ bo lɛ.
MiMaŋtsɛ, hã manyiɛ osɛɛ; hã wɔye wɔhe oyai kɛya opiai lɛ amli.
Wɔɔnya, ni wɔmii aaashɛ.
Wɔɔkafo osuɔmɔ lɛ fe wain; ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ, no hewɔ yei sumɔɔ bo lɛ.
Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, midiɔ nɛ, shi mihe yɛ fɛo; midiɔ tamɔ Kedar bui lɛ, mitamɔ muhɔi ni yɔɔ Solomon we lɛ.
Kaakwɛ mi gãa yɛ dimɔ ni midiɔ, kɛ hulu ni eshã mi hewɔ.
Minyɛ bihii lɛ amli fu mi, ni amɛfee mi waintromi anɔkwɛlɔ.
Tsɛbelɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikwɛɛɛ.
Bo mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi otoi alɛɛhe lɛ, kɛ he ni ohãa amɛbumɔɔ shwane.
Mɛni hewɔ matamɔ mɔ ni tsomloɔ kɛtaoɔ bo yɛ onanemɛi atookui ahe?
Nuu lɛ Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, kɛ oleee jɛi lɛ, bo lɛ jaa tooku lɛ asɛɛ mo kɛya, ni oyalɛ abotiai abii lɛ yɛ tookwɛlɔi abuui lɛ amasɛi.
Mishieŋnyɛ, mikɛ bo toɔ okpɔŋɔi ni yɔɔ Farao shwiilii lɛ ateŋ eko he.
Odabii yɛ fɛo kɛ wulamɔnii; okuɛ hu yɛ fɛo kɛ jwinei ni atsɛ̃rɛ.
Wɔbaafee shika hewulamɔnii ni akɛ jwiɛtɛi eholɔ mli wɔhã bo.
Yoo Lɛ Be ni maŋtsɛ kã ekpasa mli lɛ, belɛ minuatrɛ lɛ miije ŋma.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ he jeɔ ŋma krɔbɔo kɛji ekã mifufɔi ateŋ lɛ.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ fɔfɔi yɛ En-Gedi waintromii lɛ amli hã mi.
Nuu Lɛ Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, mishieŋnyɛ!
Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo.
Ohiŋmɛi tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛi.
Yoo lɛ Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, ohe yɛ akɔnɔ hu; jwɛifɔ ji wɔsaa ni wɔkãa nɔ.
Wɔtsu mplaŋi lɛ tsenedru ni.
Ni wɔŋmɔŋmloi lɛ sɛsɛo ni.
Mi lɛ, Sharon fɔfɔi ji mi, mi ji jɔi amli oflɔ fɔfɔi.
Nuu lɛ Bɔ ni oflɔ fɔfɔi yɔɔ yɛ ŋmei ateŋ lɛ, nakai mishieŋnyɛ yɔɔ yɛ oblayei ateŋ.
Yoo lɛ Bɔ ni akututso yɔɔ yɛ kooŋtsei ateŋ lɛ, nakai misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ oblahii ateŋ.
Miishɛɛ mikɛtaa ehɔ̃ɔŋ, ni eyibii lɛ ŋɔɔ minaa.
Ekɛ mi ba shĩa ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛŋ ni ekɛ suɔmɔɔ aflaŋaa ha minɔ.
Kɛ wainyibii ni aka lɛ fã kɛ fã awaje mi; kɛ aduawai ajɔɔ mitsui he; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ewo mi hela.
Mina ni kulɛ, enine abɛku hɔ miyitso shishi, ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.
Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋa nɔ ofrote yei akɛ, nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa; ni nyɛkatsĩɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli, kɛyaashi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ.
Lala ni ji enyɔ Yoo lɛ Minu misuɔlɔ lɛ gbee!
Naa, eeba, eehuru yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ehiɛ foi waa yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ tamɔ soŋai, loo ofrote oblanyo.
Naa, edamɔ wɔgbogbo lɛ sɛɛ; eekwɛ samfɛji lɛ amli gãa, eefili kɛ miitsɔ̃ samfɛji fɔji lɛ amli.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, Nuu lɛ “Mishieŋnyɛ, mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo!
Tee shi, ni oba wɔtee.
Shi, naa, fɛ̃i be lɛ eho etee; nunɛmɔ be lɛ sɛɛ efo kwraa.
Fɔfɔii egba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lala be lɛ eshɛ, ni aanu kosɛɛ okpo gbee yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Agbãmitso miiwo yibii, ni waintsei lɛ hu egba afofroi kɛ ŋma.
No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔlɔ, tee shi ni oba wɔtee, bo ji mimɔ ni he yɔɔ fɛo.
Mikosɛɛ okpo ni hiɔ tɛsaa fɔjiaŋ, yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ, hã mana ohiɛ, ni manu ogbee; ejaakɛ ogbee ŋɔɔ, ni ohiɛ hu yɛ fɛo.
Nyɛmɔmɔa osɔi lɛ, osɔi bibii ni fiteɔ waintromii lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔwaintsei lɛ egba afofro.” Yoo lɛ Minɔ ji misuɔlɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu enɔ ji mi.
Elɛɔ etoi lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.
Kuu osɛɛ, misuɔlɔ, tamɔ soŋai loo ofrote oblanyo, yɛ Beta gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni oba dani je atsɛre, ni duŋ alaaje.
Be ni mikã misaa nɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, mitao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ; mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ.
Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mate shi mayakpa maŋ lɛ mli gbɛjegbɛi kɛ blohuiaŋ.
Mayatao mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ.
Bulɔi ni buɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, na mi.
Mibi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛna mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ lo?” Miho amɛhe fioo pɛ, kɛkɛ ni mina mɔ ni mitsui sumɔɔ lɛ.
Mimɔ emli; ni miŋmɛɛɛ ehe kwraa kɛyashi mikɛ lɛ ba minyɛwe lɛ, kɛtee minyɛ, mɔ ni fɔ mi lɛ sɛɛtsuŋ.
Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, mina soŋai kɛ ŋa nɔ ofrote akɛ nyɛkagbaa wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ naa, ni nyɛkatsĩɛa ehiɛ kɛjɛ ewɔ mli kɛyaashi be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui aaatɔ.
Lala ni ji etɛ̃ Yoo lɛ Mɛni ji nɔ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa tamɔ lasu kusuu ni teɔ shi nɛɛ?
Namɔ nɛ ni mire kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ jarayelɔi atsofãi srɔtoi fɛɛ jeɔ ŋma yɛ ehe nɛɛ?
Naa, Solomon ji mɔ ni atere yɛ akpãkãi lɛ mli lɛ.
Asraafoi kakabãŋi nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni jɛ Israel kãkãalɔi ateŋ lɛ ebɔle ehe.
Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛmia kɛ tawuu klantei, ni amɛhe esa kɛ tawuu.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ klante ŋmɔ ehɛ, yɛ nyɔɔŋ tuamɔ hewɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Solomon kɛ Lebanon tsei fee akpakãi hã ehe.
Ehe tsei lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee.
Emli kpasamɔnɔ lɛ akɛ shika fee.
Emli sɛi lɛ akɛ mama afaseo ha he.
Yerusalɛm biyei lɛ kɛ suɔmɔ wula emligbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛ Zion biyei, nyɛjea kpo nyɛbakwɛa Maŋtsɛ Solomon, kɛ akekre ni enyɛ kɛfi lɛ yɛ eyookpeemɔ gbi kɛ emliflimɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nuu lɛ Naa, ohe yɛ fɛo, misuɔlɔ, naa, ohe yɛ fɛo.
Ohiŋmɛiŋ kpɛlɛɔ kɛ suɔmɔ tamɔ okpo hiŋmɛii, kɛtsɔ̃ɔ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli.
Oyitsɔi bua onɔ tamɔ abotiai aku ni bua shi yɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ ahe.
Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futafuta tamɔ gwantɛŋi ni aku amɛhetsɔi ni aju amɛhe.
Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni eko eko gboko.
Onaabu tamɔ kpãa tsuru, ni onaabu yɛ fɛo kɛ wiemɔ.
Odabii yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli tamɔ maŋo tsuru.
Okuɛ tamɔ David mɔɔ ni kwɔ, ni ato tawuunii yɛ mli lɛ, ni tawulɔi atsɛŋi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsoro shi yɛ mli fɛɛ tamɔ kuɛnii.
Ofufɔi tamɔ soŋai bii enyɔ.
Tamɔ ofrotebii hãaji ni yeɔ nii yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ.
Mayatee mihe yɛ mire gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mayashera shi yɛ krɔbɔo gɔŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni je aaana ni hiɛ aaabu.
Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo kɛmɔ shi; kpa ko kpa ko bɛ ohe.
Miyɛmfro, okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon; okɛ mi ajɛ Lebanon ni wɔya.
Jɛɛ Amana gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ oba; Jɛɛ Senir kɛ Hermon gɔji lɛ anɔ, jatai kɛ mlaŋtswii ashihilɛhe lɛ, oba ni wɔtee.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, oŋɔ mitsui; okɛ okwɛmɔ ni okwɛ mi shi kome kɛ ojarawatɛ kome ni yɔɔ okuɛnii lɛ mli lɛ eŋɔ mitsui kwraa.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, osuɔmɔ yɛ akɔnɔ.
Osuɔmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ aahu fe wain.
Omui lɛ jeɔ ŋma aahu fe tsofakɛŋmai srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Miyɛmfro, onaabu tsereɔ wo shwieɔ shi; wo kɛ fufɔ yɛ olilɛi shishi.
Ohebo mli ŋma tamɔ Lebanon ŋma.
Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro lɛ, etamɔ trom ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ abɔɔ ni aŋmɛ naa; etamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni tueɔ ni asɔo naa.
Otsei fɔbii lɛ tamɔ trom ni maŋo tsei yɔɔ mli, ni amɛwoɔ yibii srɔtoi ni yɔɔ fɛo naakpa tamɔ kofer fɔfɔi kɛ nardo fiaa.
Trom ni nardo kɛ safron kɛ kalamo kɛ sinamon kɛ krɔbɔo tsei fɛɛ kɛ mire kɛ aloe kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai titrii lɛ fɛɛ kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ omli.
Bo oji abɔɔ ni nuhiŋmɛi kɛ wala nubu yɔɔ omli, fai ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ Lebanon ji bo.
Yoo lɛ Bo, kooyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ohiɛ atsɛ̃, ni bo wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ, ba ni obatswa yɛ mitrom lɛ mli, koni anu emli ŋma gbalaŋŋ lɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ.
Hã misuɔlɔ lɛ aba ebɔɔ lɛ mli ni ebaye etsei ayibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Nuu lɛ Minyɛmi yoo, miyɛmfro, miba mitrom lɛ mli, miibua mimire kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai anaa.
Miiye miwo agbaku kɛ emli wo lɛ.
Miinu miwain kɛ mifufɔ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ Minanemɛi, nyɛyea ni nyɛnua, ni nyɛ, suɔlɔi, nyɛnua ni nyɛtɔrɔa!
Lala ni ji ejwɛ Yoo lɛ Be ni miwɔ lɛ, mitsui hiɛ kã.
Naa!
Mishieŋtsɛ miishi shinaa lɛ.
Nuu lɛ Minyɛmi yoo, misuɔlɔ!
Mikosɛɛ okpo, misuɔlɔ ni fe fɛɛ, bɔ efɔ miyitsei ahe fɛɛ; miyitsɔi akuklui lɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɔɔŋ bɔ.
Yoo lɛ Mijie mitade lɛ; mɛni hewɔ mawo ekoŋŋ?
Mifɔ minaji ahe, mɛni hewɔ mawo amɛhe muji ekoŋŋ?
Misuɔlɔ lɛ kpã enine mli ekɛmɔ klɔklɔ lɛ mli, kɛkɛ ni mitsui tswa kɛ miishɛɛ.
Mite shi ni mayagbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, mire tsere yɛ miniji ahe, mire ŋleŋle tsere yɛ miwaobii ahe shwie shinaa klɔklɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni migbele misuɔlɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe etee momo.
Mishwe akɛ manu egbee.
Mitao lɛ, shi minaaa lɛ.
Mitsɛ lɛ, shi ehereee mi nɔ hu.
Bulɔi lɛ na mi be ni amɛnyiɛ amɛbuɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛtswia mi nii, ni amɛpila mi.
Gbogbo nɔ bulɔi lɛ shɔ̃ mihiɛhaanɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, nyɛwoa mi shi veveeve akɛ kɛji nyɛna misuɔlɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, suɔmɔ ewo mi hela.
Yei lɛ Bo yoo ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe yei fɛɛ, Mɛni osuɔlɔ lɛ kɛfe suɔlɔ kroko, hewɔ ni obiɔ akɛ wɔwo bo shi veveeve nɛɛ?
Yoo lɛ Misuɔlɔ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni ehewolo kã.
Esoro lɛ yɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma he.
Ehiɛ tsuɔ oo, eyitsɔi edɔrɔdrɔi; ni ediɔ tamɔ kwãakwãalabite.
Ehiŋmɛii tamɔ fai ahe okpoi ahiŋmɛii; okpoi ni amɛju amɛhe kɛ fufɔ ni amɛdamɔ fai atoi.
Edabii tamɔ tsofakɛŋma akofii ni miije ŋma.
Enaabu yɛ fɛo tamɔ Oflɔ fɔfɔi ni efɔ kɛ krɔbɔo ŋleŋle.
Eniji yɛ fɛo, ni ewo gai ni ojarawatɛi tara mli.
Egbɔmɔtso tamɔ nɔ ko ni akɛ shuɔ wu fee, ni akɛ safiro etara he.
Eshuɔji tamɔ alabastro akulashiŋi, ni mamɔ shika nibii anɔ.
Eje agbo tamɔ Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ, ni eje oblaŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsenedrutso lɛ.
Edaaŋ wiemɔ ŋɔɔ naakpa, ni enɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ akɔnɔ.
Naa, nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, bɔ ni misuɔlɔ, mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ.
Yei lɛ Bo mɔ ni ohe yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ yɛ yei ateŋ, nɛgbɛ osuɔlɔ lɛ etee?
Nɛgbɛ osuɔlɔ lɛ etsɔ̃, koni wɔ kɛ bo fɛɛ ayatao lɛ?
Yoo lɛ Misuɔlɔ lɛ etee etrom lɛ mli, yɛ tsofakɛŋma akofii lɛ ahe, koni eyalɛ etooku lɛ yɛ jɛi, koni etserɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii hu.
Misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi, ni mi hu minɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni elɛɔ etooku lɛ yɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii ateŋ lɛ.
Nuu lɛ Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo tamɔ Tirza maŋ, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ Yerusalɛm.
Ohe yɛ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai.
Tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oto afã ejaakɛ ohiŋmɛii gbaa minaa.
Oyitsɔi tamɔ abotiai aku ni miikpeleke Gilead gɔji lɛ ahetsɔi.
Onyanyɔji yɛɔ futaa tamɔ gwantɛŋi ni aju amɛhe ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛfɔfɔɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni amɛteŋ ekome folo gboko.
Odabii yɛ fɛo tamɔ maŋo ni etsu yɛ ohiɛhaanɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ aaahi maŋnyɛmɛi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ hemɛi nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ, kɛ oblayei ni aleee amɛyibɔ moŋ nɛ; shi mɔ koome pɛ ji misuɔlɔ, ni ehe yɛ fɛo tamɔ okpo.
Enyɛ suɔmɔ bi koome ji lɛ.
Enyɛ enaaa kpa ko yɛ ehe.
Oblayei lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛna ehe miishɛɛ.
Maŋnyɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi jie eyi.
Namɔ pueɔ tamɔ leebi hulu nɛɛ, ni ehe yɔɔ fɛo tamɔ nyɔɔŋtsere, ni ehe tse tamɔ hulu, ni ehe yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ tabilɔi ni hiɛ aflaŋai nɛɛ?
Mikpeleke shi kɛtee tsoyibii atrom lɛ mli koni mayakwɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli jwɛi frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ.
Mitee koni mayakwɛ akɛ waintsei lɛ kɛ maŋotsei lɛ hu egba afofro lo?
Be ni mihɛleɔ shi lɛ, naa mi, ni mita shwiili mli, ni mi yɛ misuɔlɔ lɛ masɛi.
Yei lɛ Kuu osɛɛ, kuu osɛɛ bo Shulamyoo!
Kuu osɛɛ, kuu osɛɛ, koni wɔkwɛ bo.
Yoo lɛ Mɛni hewɔ nyɛbaakwɛ Shulamyoo?
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ majo joo enyɔ hu?
Nuu lɛ Bo lumɔ biyoo, Onajifãamɔi yɛ otokotai amli yɛ fɛo naakpa!
Oshuɔji yɛ fɛo tamɔ jwinei ni ŋaalɔ nukpa kɛ eniji fee.
Olaŋmɔ tamɔ likɔlikɔ kokroo ni wain ni ŋɔɔ etãko yɛ mli dã.
Omusu tamɔ ŋmãa ku, ni akɛ oflɔ fɔfɔii etserɛ he.
Ofufɔi tamɔ ofrote bii enyɔ, loo tamɔ soŋaibii hãaji.
Okuɛ kɛ tamɔ shuɔwu mɔɔ.
Ohiŋmɛii tamɔ Heshbon kpaakpoi ni yɔɔ Bat-Rabbim maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ he lɛ.
Ogugɔ yɛ fɛo tamɔ Lebanon mɔɔ ni kwɔ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ Damasko gbɛ lɛ.
Oyitso ni ma onɔ tamɔ Karmel Gɔŋ; Oyitsɔi akuklui tamɔ mama afaseo.
Oyitsɔi fɛo lɛ ŋɔɔ maŋtsɛ nom.
Mishieŋnyɛ, ohe yɛ fɛo, ni ohe yɛ akɔnɔ akɛ nɔ ko.
Oje oblaŋ tamɔ tɛŋ, ni ofufɔi tamɔ ŋmedurui.
Mikɛɛ, “Makwɔ tɛŋ lɛ, ni mamɔmɔ eniji lɛ amli.
Ao, mina ofufɔi tamɔ waintso yibii ŋmedurui, ni mumɔ ni jɛɔ ogugɔ mli jeɔ ŋma tamɔ aadɔŋ.” Yoo lɛ Mina ni onaashwɔmɔ ŋɔɔmɔ tamɔ wain kpakpa fe fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ naabu kɛ nyanyɔŋ teŋ, kɛyaa omusuŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mi lɛ, misuɔlɔ lɛ nɔ ji mi.
Ni mi ji mɔ ni eshweɔ.
Misuɔlɔ, ba ni wɔtee ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyato gbɔ yɛ akrowai lɛ amli.
Hã wɔte shi maŋkɛ mra, ni wɔya waintromii lɛ amli, ni wɔyakwɛ akɛ waintso lɛ miifrɔke ni eegba afofro, ni maŋotsei lɛ hu egba afofro lo?
Jɛi mikɛ misuɔmɔ baahã bo yɛ.
Ao!
Misuɔlɔ suɔmɔ yibii lɛ miije ŋma, ni tso yibii ni jara wa srɔtoi fɛɛ yɛ wɔshinaa lɛ shi.
Mikɛ ememeji kɛ ehei fɛɛ eto ehã bo.
Ao, mina ni kulɛ minyɛmi nuu ni ye minyɛ fufɔ ji bo.
Kulɛ kɛ mina bo yɛ agbo naa ni mishwɔ onaa lɛ, mɔ ko shwaŋ mi po.
Kulɛ manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ we lɛ, manyiɛ ohiɛ kɛya minyɛ awo ni fɔ mi sɛɛtsuŋ.
Ni mahã bo wain ni jeɔ ŋma onu; ni tamɔ migranata dãa.
Mina ni kulɛ miyitso tsɔle enine abɛku ni ekɛ eninejurɔ efua mi atuu.
Nyɛ Yerusalɛm biyei, nyɛwoa mi shi veveeve akɛ, nyɛhosoŋ misuɔlɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkatsiɛ̃a ehiɛ hu, kɛyaashi be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ.
Lala ni ji ekpaa Yei lɛ Namɔ ji yoo nɛɛ ni jɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ baa ni ekɛ esuɔlɔ ela kɛ baa nɛɛ?
Mi mitsiɛ̃ ohiɛ yɛ akututso lɛ shishi, jɛi ji he ni onyɛ kɔ̃mɔ bo yɛ, jɛi onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ kɔ̃mɔ bo yɛ.
Yoo lɛ Sɔomɔ minaa owo otsui mli tamɔ adikiɔ nine he lɛ.
Okɛ yoo ko yoo ko akala, ja mi pɛ.
Ejaakɛ suɔmɔ he wa tamɔ gbele; ni awuŋayeli hu yi wa tamɔ gbele.
Ehereɔ tamɔ la, ni etsoɔ grigri.
Nu babaoo po nyɛɛɛ suɔmɔ agbe, ni nu afua tete nyɛɛɛ lɛ ashiu.
Kɛji mɔ ko ŋɔ eshĩaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ehã ekɛmiihe suɔmɔ lɛ, ŋmɔ abaaŋmɔ lɛ.
Yoo lɛ nyɛmimɛihii lɛ Wɔyɛ nyɛmi yoo fioo ko ni ejeko fufɔ.
Mɛni wɔɔfee wɔhã wɔnyɛmi yoo nɛɛ, gbi ni aaaba akɛ abaatsɛ ehebaa lɛ?
Eji gbogbo ji lɛ kulɛ wɔɔma jwiɛtɛi mɔɔ ni kwɔ wɔma enɔ.
Eji shinaa ji lɛ kulɛ wɔkɛ tsenedrutsei ŋmoŋmolo aaaha ehe.
Yoo lɛ Mi lɛ, gbogbo ji mi, ni mifufɔi mamɔ shi tamɔ mɔji.
Ni yɛ misuɔlɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, mitsui nyɔɔ mimli, ni minaa hejɔlɛ.
Nuu lɛ Solomon yɛ waintrom ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Baal-Hammon.
Ekɛ waintrom lɛ hã mɛi ni amɛhu mli.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ woɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpe akɛ adɔde.
Miwaintrom, ni ji mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ lɛ, mikoome minɔ ni.
Bo Solomon, ooona akpe lɛ, ni mɛi ni ji apaafoi lɛ aaana ohai enyɔ.
Ao, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ abɔi lɛ amli, minanemɛi lɛ miibo ogbee toi.
Hã mi hu manu ogbee lɛ.
Yoo lɛ Ohe afee oya, misuɔlɔ, ofoi awa tamɔ soŋai, tamɔ ofrote oblanyo yɛ tsofakɛŋma gɔji lɛ anɔ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ kpanaa ko ni hi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yesaia lɛ gbɛi akɛwo wolo nɛɛ.
Gbalɔ nɛɛ hi shi yɛ afii Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli.
Aaanyɛ ajara wolo lɛ mli etɛ̃: .
Yitsei -.
Yitsei nɛɛ kɔɔ be ni Yuda ni ji wuoyigbɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ she gbeyei akɛ Asiria baaba ebatua lɛ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Asiria ji maŋ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Yesaia na akɛ gbeyei ni Yuda sheɔ lɛ lɛ, ejɛɛɛ hewalɛ kple ni Asiria yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ ejɛ enɛɛmɛi, eshai ni Yuda jaku lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efee, Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi ni amɛgbo lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hu.
Gbalɔ nɛɛ kɛ edaaŋ wiemɔi kɛ enifeemɔnii tsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai nibii anaa fitsofitso, ni ebi amɛ akɛ amɛfee nɔ ni ja, ni amɛye jalɛ sane hu.
Asaŋ ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ kɛji amɛbooo Nyɔŋmɔ toi lɛ, no lɛ amɛyi baatɔ̃, ni amɛjaku lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
Yesaia gba hu akɛ be ko baaba ni toiŋjɔlɛ baaba jeŋjeŋ hei fɛɛ, ni mɔ ko baajɛ David shwie mli ni ebaye maŋtsɛ krɔŋŋ.
.
Yitsei -.
Biɛ sane lɛ kɔɔ be mli ni Yudabii babaoo yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli yɛ Babilon lɛ he.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ efee bliboo, ni amɛhiɛnɔkãmɔ fɛɛ etã.
Gbalɔ lɛ gba akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni Nyɔŋmɔ baakpɔ̃ ewebii lɛ koni amɛye amɛhe, asaŋ ebaakpla amɛ kɛya amɛmaŋ ni ji Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaje shihilɛ hee shishi.
Sane kome ko ni ama nɔ mi yɛ yitsei nɛɛ amli ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ ni yeɔ jeŋ maji fɛɛ anɔ, ni gbɛjianɔ ni eto yɛ ewebii lɛ ahe ji akɛ ebaatsu amɛ jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ koni amɛyashiɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ Israel nɔ lɛ, ebaajɔɔ maji lɛ.
Wiemɔi ni kɔɔ “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Tsulɔ” lɛ he ni ale jogbaŋŋ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli lɛ, titri yɛ Yesaia wolo nɛɛ mli.
.
Yitsei -.
Mɛi ni ejɛ nomŋɔɔ mli eba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ lɛ titri ahe yitsei nɛɛ amli wiemɔi lɛ kɔɔ.
Ehia akɛ ahã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ana hiɛnɔkãmɔ hee akɛ shi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo amɛjaku lɛ ebaaye nɔ.
Akpã awo maŋbii lɛ atoiŋ veveeve akɛ amɛfee nɔ ni ja, ni amɛye jalɛ sane; asaŋ amɛye hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa kɛ sɔlemɔ he mlai lɛ anɔ.
Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔ ko ni yɔɔ .- lɛ, no ji wiemɔ ni Yesu kɛje enitsumɔ lɛ shishi, ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ tsumɔ ni eba lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Kɔkɔbɔi kɛ shiwoi .—.
Maji lɛ atoigblamɔ .—.
Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo je lɛ aha .—.
Kɔkɔbɔi kɛ shiwoi krokomɛi .—.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Asiriabii .—.
Shiwoi kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ he wiemɔi .—.
Kɔkɔbɔi kɛ shiwoi .—.
Ninaa ni ajie atsɔ̃ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hu he, yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi nɛɛ, Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia, ayinɔ nɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ kã ewebii ahiɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋwɛi, bo toi, ni shikpɔŋ bo hu feemɔ toi, ejaakɛ mi Yehowa, miiwie.
Milɛ bii ni amɛdara, shi amɛ lɛ, amɛtse mihiɛ atua.
Tsina le mɔ nɔ̃ ni ji lɛ, ni teji hu le he ni enuŋtsɔ eto eniyenii adeka yɛ.
Shi Israel lɛ, lɛ lɛ eleee enɛ mli ekoeko; miwebii lɛ bɛ niiashishinumɔ.” Ao!
Eshafeelɔi amaŋ, gbɔmɛi ni eyi tɔ kɛ eshafeemɔ, efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei, gbɔmɛi nifitelɔi ni amɛkwa Yehowa, ni amɛgbe Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ, ni amɛ kɛ lɛ teŋ etserɛ kwraa.
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛyaa nɔ nyɛtseɔ atua koni aya nɔ agbala nyɛtoi lolo nɛɛ?
Nyɛyitso muu lɛ fɛɛ he miiye, ni nyɛtsui fɛɛ hu etɔ biti.
Kɛjɛ yiteŋ aahu kɛyashi naneshi lɛ, he ko he ko bɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ he ni atswã bɛ jɛi fe pilamɔi kɛ faji kɛ faji ni amɛmli miihohoo lá.
Anyamɔko faji lɛ, afimɔko lɛ, akɛ mu etoko amɛnɔ hu.
Nyɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni amãmɔ nyɛmaji wuji lɛ anaa la ashãshãai.
Gbɔi miiye nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii yɛ nyɛhiɛ; amɛbutu nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛhã etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Yerusalɛm pɛ eshwɛ, ni lɛ hu asa eyi.
Etsɔ̃ tamɔ asese ko yɛ waintrom mli, loo agba ni ma kukumba ŋmɔ mli.
Yehowa eshwɛɛɛ hiɛkãalɔi fioo ko hãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔsane lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora.
Nyɛ Sodom maŋnɔyelɔi, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi; ni nyɛ Gomorabii, nyɛboa nɔ ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nyɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfɔlei babaoo lɛ ji hã mi?
Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ gwantɛŋ hii shãa lɛ kɛ kooloi ni eshwishwii afɔi lɛ eje mitsine.
Tsinahii kɛ gwantɛŋbii kɛ tookpakpoi alá lɛ, mitaooo dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛba mi jamɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi aba mikpoi lɛ anɔ?
Nyɛkabanyiɛa mikpoi lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ!
Nyɛkɛ nyɛyakayaka afɔlei akabaa dɔŋŋ; amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Miihi tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ hee gbii juji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi kɛ gwai ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ.
Eshai efite gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mitaooo.
Misusuma miihi nyɔŋ hee gbii juji kɛ gbii juji krokomɛi ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ jatsu amɛhã mi, ni etɔ mi kɛ teremɔ.
Kɛji nyɛhole nyɛniji anɔ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã; nyɛbaasɔle kakadaŋŋ nɛ, shi miboŋ nyɛ toi.
Lá ewu nyɛniji ahe tsɔ̃.
Nyɛjua nyɛhe koni nyɛhãa nyɛhe atsea; nyɛkɛ nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ajea mihiɛ, ni nyɛkpaa efɔŋfeemɔ.
Nyɛkasea ekpakpafeemɔ, nyɛtaoa jalɛ sane sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛkwɛa koni akayea amim, nyɛfãa awusa he, ni nyɛwiea nyɛhãa okulafo.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ; nyɛhãa wɔtaoa naa.
Kɛji nyɛhe eshai lɛ tsuɔ tamɔ lá tete po, amɛbaayɛ futaa tamɔ snoo; ni kɛji amɛtsuɔ fɔɔ tamɔ kɔɔjaŋ po, amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ too he tsɔ̃i yɛŋ.
Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ, ni nyɛfee toibolɔi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaaye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii kpakpai lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ, ni nyɛtse atua lɛ, no lɛ akɛ klante baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Maŋ ni eyi kɛ eshafeelɔi Te fee tɛŋŋ ni maŋ ni kulɛ eyeɔ anɔkwa lɛ etsɔ̃ ehe ajwamãŋ nɛɛ.
Sa lɛ aye jalɛ sane yɛ ehe fɛɛ he, ni jalɛ saneyelɔi pɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi; shi agbɛnɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi sɔŋŋ yɔɔ jɛi.
Ojwiɛtɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ jwiɛtɛi shishi, ni owain lɛ ashi mli nu.
Omli lumɔi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ atuatselɔi kɛ julɔi ananemɛi.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miinya nyɔɔŋnihamɔ he ni amɛhiŋmɛii etsu kɛnyiɛ mɛi adɛŋ nikee sɛɛ.
Amɛfãaa awusa he lɛ, amɛyeee okulafo sane amɛhãaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Ofe Koome lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Mikɛ mimlifu lɛ baashãkã mihenyɛlɔi anɔ, ni mibatɔ mihe owele yɛ nyɛ, mihenyɛlɔi lɛ, anɔ.
Mikɛ bo baaye, ni mibasere ojwiɛtɛifei lɛ fɛɛ, ni majie omli muji nii fɛɛ mashwie.
Mato kojolɔi mahã bo tamɔ eyɔɔ tsutsu ko lɛ, kɛ ajinafoi hu tamɔ blema lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, bo Yerusalɛm, aaatsɛ bo jalɛ maŋ.” Jalɛ saneyeli ji nɔ ni aaahere Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ emli mɛi fɛɛ ni aaashwa amɛhe lɛ ayiwala.
Shi maŋ lɛ atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ aaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni mɛi ni baakwa Yehowa lɛ, abaaplene amɛ.
Ebaafee nyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ nyɛja tsei wuji; asaŋ nyɛhiɛ aaashwie shi akɛ nyɛfeefee tromi komɛi, ejaakɛ nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ tso wulu, ni eyi baa eboo loo trom ni nu bɛ mli.
Hewalɔ hewalɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ anaanu kpãa; enifeemɔnii baatsɔ̃ lasrɛmi, ni lasrɛmi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ baasɔo anaanu kpãa lɛ naa la, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe.
Naanɔ Toiŋjɔlɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm he sane ni Amoz bi Yesaia na nɛ.
Ebaaba mli akɛ naagbee mli lɛ, gɔŋ lɛ ni Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ma nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni kwɔ fe gɔji fɛɛ.
Abaawo enɔ fe gɔji lɛ fɛɛ, ni aaajɛ jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ aba jɛi.
Ni mɛi babaoo baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔyaa Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ We lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ bɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ wɔhi shi wɔhã, koni wɔba wɔjeŋ nakai, Ejaakɛ mla lɛ, Zion ebaajɛ, ni Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ, Yerusalɛm ebaajɛ.” Ni ebaakojo majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni ebaakã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ, ni ebaabu atɛŋ ehã mɛi babaoo.
Amɛbaatswia amɛklantei lɛ amɛkɛsɔ̃ kɔii ni amɛkɛ amɛkpɔlɔi lɛ hu baasɔ̃ adidai.
Maŋ ko kɛ maŋ ko wuŋ ta, ni amɛkaseŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.
Ao, nyɛ Yakob we, nyɛbaa agbɛnɛ koni wɔnyiɛ Yehowa la lɛ mli.
Abaaba Henɔwolɔi ashi Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa ewebii ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ, ejaakɛ bokãgbɛ shikpɔji klalɔi babaoo ebafutu amɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ klalɔi tamɔ Filistibii lɛ, ni maŋsɛɛbii moŋ amɛkɛbɔɔ.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni anyɛɛɛ naa abu.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi kɛ okpɔŋɔi, ni amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa akpa.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ yakayaka amãgãi, ni amɛkotoɔ shi amɛjaa amɛninenaa nitsumɔnii, nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, adesa diɛŋtsɛ ebɔ ehe ahora ni eba ehe shi kwraa.
Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ enɛ akafa amɛ.
Botemɔ tɛsaa tɛkplo mli, ni yaatee ohe yɛ su mli ni ojo Yehowa he gbeyei lɛ kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ naa foi.
Gbi ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hewoo kɛ henɔwomɔ fɛɛ shi, ni gbi lɛ Yehowa koome pɛ hiɛ baaba nyam, ni aaawo enɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ gbi ko ni eto ni ekɛbaaba ntɛŋfeemɔ kɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ shi.
Gbi nɛɛ lɛ abaaba Lebanon tsenedrutsei gojogojoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Bashan tsei wuji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mɔji gojogojoo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gbogboi ni awaje lɛ fɛɛ ashi, ni abaashwie Tarshish lɛji lɛ kɛ amɛmli ŋaa nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.
Gbi lɛ abaaba gbɔmɔ adesa hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ ntɛŋfeemɔ fɛɛ shi, ni Yehowa koometoo pɛ nɔ abaawo gojoo, ni yakayaka amãgãi lɛ baaho aya kwraa.
Gbi nɔ ni Yehowa aaaba ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ, gbɔmɛi baabote tɛsaa tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ bui amli koni amɛtee amɛhe yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ gbɔmɛi baasherɛ amɛshika amãgãi kɛ jwiɛtɛi amãgãi ni amɛfee amɛhã amɛhe ni amɛjaa lɛ amɛshwie amɛhã obishii kɛ aputupatai.
Amɛbaaya amɛyabote tɛkploi kɛ tɛsaa amli fɔji amli bɔ ni afee ni amɛnyɛ amɛjo foi yɛ Yehowa he gbeyei kɛ egbojee anunyam lɛ naa be ni Yehowa aaate shi ebahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Nyɛwia nyɛhe kɛjea gbɔmɔ ni wala mumɔ yɔɔ emli nɛɛ he, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nɔ ko mli.
Yerusalɛm yɛ basabasa Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baajie mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda kpasa akɛ sɛɛtso lɛ kɛya.
Ebaajie amɛdaaŋ ŋmãa, ni ebaahã amɛye nuhɔmɔ.
Ebaajie nuu ekãalɔ lɛ kɛ tabilɔ lɛ kɛ kojolɔ lɛ kɛ gbalɔ lɛ kɛ okɔmfo lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpa lɛ.
Ebaajie tabilɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ nɔ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ gbɛnaahiɛlɔ lɛ kɛ maŋ ajinafonyo lɛ.
Ebaajie ashwãifeelɔ ni he esa lɛ kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔ ni he esa lɛ fɛɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mibahã gbekɛbii hii atsɔmɔ amɛnɔ lumɛi, ni fufɔbii baaye amɛnɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ aaawawaa amɛhe yi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawa enyɛmi yi.
Oblahii ebuŋ amɛnukpai, ni maŋ bii yakagbɔmɛi ebuŋ mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam.
Be miiba, be ni tsɛmɛi awe bii baamɔ amɛteŋ mɔ kome, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmi, bo lɛ oyɛ hebo, no hewɔ lɛ, obaaye wɔlumɔ koni okwɛ wɔwe ni ekumɔ nɛɛ nɔ.” Shi gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baakɛɛ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mibɛ niyenii loo hehaabo yɛ mishĩaŋ ni mikɛaanyɛ mikɛwa nyɛ.
Nyɛkafea mi nyɛlumɔ.” Ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm ejwa, ni Yuda hu egbee shi, ejaakɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yehowa, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee ehiɛiaŋ tete.
Amɛmɛiahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ baaye odase eshi amɛ.
Eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ amɛkɛteee, shi moŋ amɛkɛshwãa tamɔ Sodom fee lɛ.
Kpoo hã amɛ!
Ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe efɔŋ.
Kɛɛmɔ jalɔi lɛ akɛ ebaahi ehã amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaye amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ mli yibii.
Shi kpoo ha efɔŋfeelɔ; ehiŋ ehaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛfee mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, no nɔŋŋ akɛbaafee lɛ.
Naa, shikafalɔi miiwa mimaŋbii lɛ ayi, ni amɛnyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ shishiuɔ amɛ.
Ao!
Miwebii, nyɛmaŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ miihã nyɛmiidu gbɛ, ni amɛmiihã nyɛnane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.
Yehowa kojo ewebii lɛ Yehowa eho eta esɛi nɔ, ni ekɛ ewebii lɛ baaye sane.
Yehowa kɛ emaŋ onukpai kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ miikojo akɛ, “Nyɛ ji mɛi ni nyɛkpa waintrom lɛ mli nii ni nyɛye lɛ.
Ohiafoi adɛŋ nibii ni nyɛhahaa lɛ yɛ nyɛshĩai lɛ amli.
Te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ hewɔ ni nyɛmiaa mimaŋ lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ ohiafoi ahiɛ shwishwiaa shi nɛɛ lɛ?
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, miibi nyɛ!” Abɔ Yerusalɛm yei lɛ kɔkɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yerusalɛm yei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, amɛtsĩaa kɛ amɛkuɛkuumɔ kɛ ahoshwibɔɔ hiŋmɛii kɛ amɛnanetalɔŋ gai ni miigbɛɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mibahã gbɛ̃i ashwie Yerusalɛm biyei ayiteiaŋ, ni ebaahã amɛyitsei ahe akpekpei, ni mi Yehowa, mahã amɛnyiɛ yayai.” Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakpɔlɔ amɛhewulamɔ nibii lɛ yɛ amɛhe nanetalɔŋ gai lɛ kɛ yifii dukui lɛ, kɛ amɛkuɛnii lɛ kɛ kuɛnii kɛ enaa kpɔbii lɛ kɛ nineshinii lɛ kɛ dukui lɛ, kɛ yitsɔisaamɔ nibii lɛ kɛ nineshi gai kɛ mlifiinii lɛ kɛ ojeŋma tɔi lɛ kɛ sɛbɛi lɛ; kɛ wolonaasɔomɔ waogai lɛ kɛ gugɔŋ gai lɛ, kɛ afiyeli hewulamɔ atadei lɛ kɛ atadei wuyawuyai lɛ kɛ nɔhaa atadei lɛ kɛ kotokui bibiibii ni amɛhiɛɔ lɛ, kɛ atadei ni akɛ mama ni mli yɔɔ haŋŋhaŋŋ ekpɛ lɛ kɛ klala atadei lɛ kɛ bɔndukui lɛ kɛ hiɛhaanii lɛ.
Amɛjeŋmai lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni jeɔ fu, amɛkɛ taŋkpee baafi amɛmli yɛ mlifiinii najiaŋ, ni yiteŋ ni ekpe aaabaye yi ni ahɔ najiaŋ, ni kpekpe aaabaye atade wuyaa najiaŋ, ni amɛhe fɛo lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgbele nɔ.
Omli hii lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa, ni ohii kãkãlɔi lɛ hu yɛ ta mli.
Maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ baaye ŋkɔmɔ kɛ awerɛho, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni afee lɛ shwɛm ni eshwata shikpɔŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ yei kpawo baamɔ nuu kome kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni amɛbaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔlɛ wɔhe, ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔɔnyɛ wɔhe mama wɔbu.
Nɔ ni wɔtaoɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ akɛ ogbɛi atsɛ wɔ koni okɛjie wɔhiɛgbele.” Yerusalɛm baaba eblema ekoŋŋ Nakai be lɛ Yehowa tso nine lɛ baafee fɛo, ni ebaashwere, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibaanii aaafee shwãanɔ kɛ nyam ahã Israelbii ni eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashwɛ yɛ Zion, ni eeehi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaŋma egbɛi afata hiɛkãalɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa lɛ ebaakojo ni ebaatsuu Israelbii ahe, ebaafɔ Yerusalɛm he muji lɛ kɛ lá shi ni ashwie yɛ jɛi lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baahã atatu aha Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ asafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi anɔ shwane, ni gbɛkɛ lɛ ebaahã amɛ lasu ni kpɛɔ tamɔ la, ejaakɛ enunyam lɛ baaha amɛnɔ tamɔ agba.
Ebaatsɔ̃ hɔ̃ɔŋ shwane koni hulu akashã amɛ, ni eeefee abobaahe kɛ teemɔhe yɛ ahum kɛ nunɛmɔ mli.
Waintrom he lala Hã mala suɔmɔ lala mahã mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ ewaintrom lɛ he.
Mishieŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ waintrom yɛ gɔŋ ni baa nii jogbaŋŋ nɔ.
Etsa mli, ni efamɔ emli tɛi ni etɛo waintsei kpakpai yɛ mli; ema mɔɔ yɛ teŋ, ni etsa wain bu hu yɛ mli.
Ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ trom lɛ baawo wainyibii kpakpai, shi ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mishieŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii kɛ nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛ fai nɛ, nyɛkojoa mi kɛ miwaintrom lɛ teŋ.
Mɛni esa akɛ afee mitrom lɛ lolo ni mifeko?
Be ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ewo wainyibii kpakpai lɛ, mɛni hewɔ ni ewo kooŋ wainyibii moŋ nɛɛ?
“Agbɛnɛ mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ ni mibafee miwaintrom lɛ.
Mibajie ehe afabaŋ lɛ koni kooloi akpãtã ehiɛ.
Mibakumɔ ehe gbogbo lɛ hu koni anaanaa enɔ kɛho.
Mibahã emli atsa; akpɔlɔŋ emli tsei lɛ ahe, ni ahuŋ he; kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii baatsa yɛ mli.
Mibawo atatui lɛ kitã akɛ amɛkanɛ nu amɛshwie nɔ.” Israel ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, waintrom lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ ji waintsei kpakpai ni etɛo lɛ; ni ekwɛ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ ni naa lashishwiemɔ moŋ ena, ni yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ najiaŋ lɛ, yaafo moŋ afo!
Efɔŋ ni adesa feɔ Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheheo mɛi ashĩai nyɛfataa shĩai ni nyɛyɔɔ ahe, ni nyɛŋɔɔ mɛi aŋmɔji nyɛfataa nyɛŋmɔji ahe.
Nyɛhiɛ nɛkɛ ni eshwɛŋ shikpɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ he ko ni abaashi nyɛ pɛ koni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wie yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoiŋ akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, shĩai pii baatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃, shĩai wuji fɛɛfɛji baakamɔ shi ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ waintrom kpãi nyɔŋma dalɛ, wain litai kpaanyɔ pɛ abaana kɛjɛ mli, ni abele kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ ni adu lɛ, abaana abele kiloi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ pɛ kɛjɛ mli.” Ni kpoo hã mɛi ni teɔ shi maŋkɛ mra ni amɛyanyiɛɔ dãatseiaŋ, mɛi ni taraa shi yɛ dãa he kɛyashiɔ jenamɔ yi waa, ni wain hãa amɛhiɛ feɔ laŋlaŋ.
Amɛkɛ saŋku kɛ obenta kɛ milɛ̃ kɛ blɛ kɛ wain yeɔ amɛgbiijuji lɛ, shi amɛbuuu Yehowa, nifeemɔnii, ni amɛnãaa eninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, abaaŋɔ miwebii lɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛleee nii.
Hɔmɔ miigbe amɛhiɛnaanɔbii lɛ, ni maŋbii babaoo baagboi kɛ kumai.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbohiiaje elɛɛ esɛŋ, ni egbɛ edaaŋ hatoo fe nine kɛmiimɛ Yerusalɛm lumɛi lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ kɛ mɛi ni feɔ hoo lɛ kɛ mɛi ni mli filiɔ amɛ lɛ koni emi amɛ.
Abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛgbele, ni abaaba nuu fɛɛ nuu shi, ni hewolɔi lɛ hu aaaba amɛ shi.
Shi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jieɔ egbojee kpo kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛnii ni efeɔ nɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ehe tse krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ kɛtsɔ̃ jalɛ sane ni eyeɔ lɛ nɔ.
Too gwantɛŋbii aaaye nii yɛ ŋa nɔ he ni jwɛifɔ yɔɔ, ni abotiabii ni eshwishwii aaaye nii kɛnyiɛ amaŋfɔ̃ tsui koi lɛ ateŋ.
Kpoo hã mɛi ni kɛ amale kpãa gbalaa nɔsha, ni amɛkɛ shwiili he taŋkpee diɛŋtsɛ gbalaa esha lɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa he afee oya; nɔ ni eto akɛ ebaafee lɛ, efee koni wɔkwɛ.
Ha ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ yiŋ ni eto lɛ abɛŋkɛ wɔ ni aba mli koni wɔle.” Kpoo hã mɛi ni tsɛɔ nɔ fɔŋ akɛ nɔ kpakpa ni amɛtsɛɔ nɔ kpakpa akɛ nɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɛi ni ŋɔɔ duŋ amɛfeɔ la, ni amɛŋɔɔ la hu amɛfeɔ duŋ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɛi hu ni ŋɔɔ nɔ ni joɔ amɛfeɔ nɔ ni ŋɔɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ŋɔɔ amɛfeɔ nɔ ni joɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɛi ni buɔ amɛhe nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ amɛhe hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni feɔ ekãa kɛ wainnumɔ!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni waa amɛ kɛ dãa ni wa futumɔ!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni heɔ nyɔɔŋnii ni no hãa amɛŋmɛɔ mɔ ni efe efɔŋ he tswaa lɛ, ni amɛhãa mɔ ni sane ja gbɛnaanii ŋmɛɔ lɛ lɛ!
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni lalilɛi shãa gbetseli, ni la ni tsoɔ shãa jwɛi gbiŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfãi lɛ aaakpɔtɔ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛfofro lɛ ashwie, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mla lɛ, ni amɛgbe Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he guɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa mli fu ewebii lɛ, ni ewo enine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni egbala amɛtoi.
Gɔji lɛ hoso, ni amɛgbohii lɛ jwere blohui amli oookɛɛ shĩaŋ jwɛi ni abɛɛ ashwie.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa bako shi, shi ekpã enine lɛ mli lolo.
Yehowa baato okadi ekɛtsɛ maŋ ko ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ; ebaakpã blɛ ekɛtsɛ lɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ naagbeehe lɛ.
Ni naa, maŋ nɛɛ baafee oya aba mramra.
Etɔŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tɛŋ; amɛteŋ mɔ ko hɛfiinii fɛneŋ, mɔ ko mɔ ko tokota naa kpãa tseŋ.
Amɛgãimlibii anaa ba, ni amɛtataa amɛgãi lɛ; amɛkpɔŋɔ akoklotoi tamɔ tswɛrɛbo, ni amɛshwiilii anaji lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe oyaoya tamɔ lasuogbele.
Amɛhuuɔ tamɔ jata, amɛhuuɔ tamɔ jata oblahii pɛ; amɛshiɔ amɛsɛŋ ni amɛyeɔ kooloo ni amɛgbɔbiɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa, ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ kooloo ni amɛmɔ lɛ yiwala ahere.
Amɛaashi amɛsɛŋ amɛwo Israel nakai gbi lɛ, ni amɛsɛŋshimɔ lɛ aaagbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ.
Ni kɛji akwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nɔ ni aaana ji duŋ kɛ awerɛhoo sɔŋŋ, ni oblɔtu aaaha hulu la hiɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Yesaia koni ebafee Gbalɔ Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Uzia gbo lɛ, mina Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni eta maŋtsɛ sɛi ni kwɔ gojoo ko nɔ.
Atade yuu ni ewo lɛ eyi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ obɔ̃.
Serafim damɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he kɛbɔle.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji ekpaaekpaa.
Ekɛ enyɔ haa ehiɛ, ni ekɛ enyɔ haa enaji ahe, ni ekɛ enyɔ hu filikiɔ.
Mɔnɛ boɔ ekɛɔ mɔnɛ akɛ, “Krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ, krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ!
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ eyi obɔ kɛ enunyam lɛ.” Serafim lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ ha Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinai lɛ ashishi hoso, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yi tɔ kɛ lasu.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã mi, shi milaaje!
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni naabu he tseee ji mi; ni miyɛ maŋ ni emli bii awiemɔi ahe tseee ateŋ, ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛii ena maŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni serafim lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome filiki kɛba miŋɔɔ.
Ehiɛ ŋai ni miitso ni ekɛ abɛɛle yakɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ekɛ ŋai ni tsoɔ lɛ sa minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, akɛni enɛ esa onaabu he nɛɛ lɛ, ajie onɔsha lɛ, ni akɛ ohe esha efa bo.” Kɛkɛ ni minu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni miikɛɛ akɛ, “Namɔ matsu, ni namɔ aaatee ahã wɔ?” Mikɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mi!
Tsu mi!” Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ maŋbii nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ nyɛtoi aaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnuŋ shishi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hã nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ akpliŋ amɛtsui, ni ohã amɛtoi awa; asaŋ shwilamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii koni amɛkana nii; amɛkanu nii, asaŋ amɛkanu sane shishi ni amɛmiikpale ni amɛna tsamɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ, kɛyaashi mɛɛ beyinɔ?” Eto he akɛ, “Kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maji lɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i ni adesa ko bɛ amɛmli, ni shĩai lɛ aaajwere shi efoji ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kwraa.
Yehowa aaakpala maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee shɔŋŋ, ni hei pii aaakamɔ shi efoji yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni kɛji eshwɛ maŋbii lɛ amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome tete yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaaku sɛɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Shi amɛaatsɔ tamɔ tso kpele ni atoo agbee shi ni eshwɛ ekuku yɛ su mli.
Tso kuku nɛɛ lɛ dumɔ wu krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.”
Akɛ wiemɔ bahã Maŋtsɛ Ahaz Be ni Ahaz ni ji Uzia bi Yotam bi lɛ ji Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, Siria maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Israel maŋtsɛ Peka ni ji Remalia bi lɛ fã ta kɛba, ni amɛbatua Yerusalɛm, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ maŋ lɛ amɛŋɔ.
Be ni Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Aram kɛ Efraim efee ekome lɛ, Ahaz kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atsui fã, ni amɛkpokpo tamɔ kooŋ tsei ni ahum ebote amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, “Bo kɛ obi Shear-Yashub nyɛyaa.
Nyɛ kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz baakpe yɛ yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa, yɛ niiahefɔlɔi abɔɔ lɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛɛmɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ ohe ni ahi, ni ofee dioo; kaashe gbeyei, ni otsui hu akafã yɛ grimɔ waa ni Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii kɛ Remalia bi Maŋtsɛ Peka egri lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ tsei kukuji ni miije lasu kɛkɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Siriabii lɛ kɛ Israel kɛ emaŋtsɛ, Remalia bi lɛ, etee oyinɔ ajina fɔŋ.
Amɛkpãŋ akɛ amɛbaatua Yuda koni amɛwo ehe gbeyei ni amɛŋɔ eshikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe koni amɛto Tabeel binuu akɛ maŋtsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” “Shi mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, miikɛɛ akɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ baŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ, ejaakɛ Siria he waaa fe Damasko, ni Damasko he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Rezin.
Yɛ Israel gbɛfaŋ lɛ biɛ afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enumɔ mli lɛ abaabutu lɛ, ni efeŋ maŋ dɔŋŋ.
Israel he waaa fe Samaria, emaŋ wulu lɛ, ni Samaria he waaa fe Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia binuu lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhiŋ shi akɛ maŋ.” Imanuel he Okadi lɛ Yehowa saa ekɛ wiemɔ tsu yaha Maŋtsɛ Ahaz akɛ, “Bi Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadi.
Ooonyɛ oyabi yɛ gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ, loo yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tete.” Shi Ahaz to he akɛ, “Mibiŋ ni ahã mi okadi ko, ni mikaŋ Yehowa mikwɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia to he akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi koo, agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Maŋtsɛ David shwiei!
Aso gbɔmɛi ni nyɛhao lɛ faaa hãaa nyɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhao miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hu nɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ okadi.
Naa, Oblayoo foro ko baana musu, ni ebaafɔ binuu, ni eeewo lɛ gbɛi Imanuel Be ni binuu nɛɛ hiɛ aaafã ni eeele nɔ ni ji ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ lɛ, no mli lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɔ, ni aana fufɔ kɛ wo aye.
Ejaakɛ be ni gbekɛ nɛɛ aaada ni ekwa nɔ fɔŋ ni ekɔ nɔ kpakpa lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei nɛɛ lɛ ashi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
“Yehowa baahã bo kɛ omaŋbii lɛ kɛ David shwiei fɛɛ atsɔ̃ gbii kɛ joomɔ komɛi amli ni eko bako dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni Israel tse ehe yɛ Yuda he nɛɛ, eeekpala Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛbanina nyɛ.
“Nakai be lɛ Yehowa baakpã blɛ kɛtsɛ Ijiptbii, ni amɛaabu kɛba tamɔ adɔdɔji kɛjɛ Nilo Faa lɛ jɛɛhe kɛ̃.
Ni ebaatsɛ Asiriabii, ni amɛaake tamɔ wobii kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaaba amɛbasɔmɔ jɔi voovoi kɛ tɛsai amli fɔji lɛ amli kɛ ŋmei tsei fɛɛ anɔ amɛbaatsĩ jwɛi fɛɛ jwɛi nɔ.
“Nakai be lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaabɔ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ apaa kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ sɛɛ tamɔ asooyi, ni eeebashɛ nyɛyiteiaŋ tsɔi kɛ nyɛnaji ahe tsɔi kɛ nyɛtsɛŋi hu fɛɛ.
“Nakai be lɛ mɔ ni aaalɛ tsina biyoo kome kɛ gwantɛŋi enyɔ lɛ, fufɔ ni eeena lɛ falɛ naa sɔŋŋ lɛ, eeena butru eye, ejaakɛ butru kɛ wo sɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaye.
“Nakai be lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni sá lɛ waintsei akpe ŋmɔ yɔɔ, nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ jwiɛtɛi talentai akpe lɛ, jɛi baatsa kɛ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii sɔŋŋ shikpɔŋ.
Mɛi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii aaaya ayagbɔbi yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii shikpɔŋ.
Ni gɔji fɛɛ ni akɛ kɔi hu amɛnɔ sa lɛ, nyɛyaŋ amɛnɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaashe kpitikpiti kɛ ŋmei lɛ gbeyei.
Jɛi baatsɔ̃ tsinai kɛ gwantɛŋi aniyelihe.”
Akɛ Yesaia Binuu to okadi ahã maŋbii Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɔ tao kpeteŋkple koni akɛ niŋmaa okadii ni dara aŋma wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ nɔ, ‘Haanii yaa oya!
Ofɔ̃yelinii yaa mramra.’ ” Mina odasefoi anɔkwafoi enyɔ, ni ji Osɔfo Uria kɛ Zakaria, Yeberekia bi lɛ, ye mi odase.
Mitee yoo, ni ji gbalɔyoo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni ena musu, ni efɔ binuu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ ‘Oya Haanii,’ ‘Ofɔ̃yeli mramra,’ ejaakɛ dani gbekɛ lɛ aaale ‘Ataa loo Awo tsɛmɔ lɛ,’ aaaloo nii ni Damasko yɔɔ kɛ haanii ni Samaria yɔɔ hu kɛnyiɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ hiɛ kɛaatee.” Asiria Maŋtsɛ miiba Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Maŋ nɛɛ kwa Shiloa Faa lɛ mli nu ni hoɔ blɛoo lɛ, ni amɛkpokpo yɛ Maŋtsɛ Rezin kɛ Maŋtsɛ Peka, Remalia bi lɛ, hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ kɛ eta lɛ fɛɛ miiba koni amɛbatua amɛ.
Amɛbaashwie amɛnɔ tamɔ faa wulu Eufrate.
Emli nu babaoo lɛ aaasram nɔ boboobo, ni eeeha nujɔi fɛɛ anɔ, ni eeeje ŋa kɛaayabote Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaayi kɛyaashi eeeyata gbɔmɔ kuɛ, ni eeekple shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ fɛɛ, Ao Imanuel.” Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛ tsuifãa!
Nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe.
Nyɛkpãŋa; shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka.
Nyɛkɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛɛmɔ, shi fɛɛ aaafee yaka, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.
Yehowa bɔ Gbalɔ lɛ kɔkɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie kɛ hiɛdɔɔ, ni ebɔ mi kɔkɔ akɛ mikaba mijeŋ tamɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni maŋbii nɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ apam lɛ, nyɛkatsɛa lɛ apam; asaŋ nyɛkashea nɔ ni amɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni nyɛtsuii akafãa hu.
Shi moŋ nyɛbua Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, akɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni lɛ moŋ gbeyei nyɛshea, ni lɛ ehe ŋmiŋmi amɔa nyɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ he krɔŋkrɔŋ ehã nyɛ; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ehã Israel akutsei enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ yaa kɛ tsɔne hu ehã Yerusalɛmbii lɛ.
Mɛi babaoo aaatɛrɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ, ni amɛaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Aaadu amɛ yɛ tsɔne mli, ni aaamɔmɔ amɛ.” Abɔ Sisatsɛmɔ he kɔkɔ Nyɛ mikaselɔi lɛ, nyɛbaa tsɔsemɔ wiemɔi lɛ ayi yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Miikwɛ Yehowa, mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ etee Yakob we lɛ gbɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ enɔ.
Naa, mi kɛ bii ni Yehowa ehã mi lɛ, wɔji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni hiɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, dɛŋ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii hã Israel.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabia okɔmfoi kɛ klamɔfoi ni wieɔ gugɔjiaŋ kɛ akroma gbee lɛ nii lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ aso esaaa akɛ maŋbii biɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ moŋ nii?
Aso esa akɛ abiɔ gbohiinii ahaa hiɛkãalɔi moŋ?” Nyɛtoa he akɛ, “Nyɛmɔa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ kɛ ehe odaseyeli lɛ mli.
Anɔkwa, nɔ ni nifeelɔi lɛ kɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nɔ kpakpa ko ejɛŋ mli.” Haomɔ be Amɛaakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ hejaramɔ kɛ hɔmɔ ni naa wa, ni amɛbaalomɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Amɛaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ amɛkwɛ ŋwɛi, ni amɛaakwɛ shikpɔŋ hu.
Shi naa, amɛnaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko fe hejaramɔ kɛ duŋ kabitii; ni aaatsi amɛ awo duŋ kabitii lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ duŋ kabitii lɛ woŋ mɔ ni aaahi jaramɔ mli lɛ he gbeyei.
Wɔsɛɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ Sa lɛ eha Zebulon kɛ Naftali fɛɛ hiɛ shwie shi; shi agbɛnɛ eeewo ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ, Yordan sɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, jeŋmaji Galilea lɛ, hiɛ nyam.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ duŋ mli lɛ, ena la kpeteŋkple ko; mɛi ni hi duŋ kabitii shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, la ekpɛ ehã amɛ.
Ohã maŋbii lɛ ayi efa, Ohã amɛnyamɔ efa.
Amɛmiinya yɛ ohiɛ tamɔ anyaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli, loo tamɔ mɛi nyaa kɛji amɛmiija haanii.
Ejaakɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni tsɔ̃ jatsu lɛ, kɛ amɛkpalamɔ tso lɛ kɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ dɛŋ kpãa lɛ okumɔ fɛɛ mli, tamɔ ofee Midian ta lɛ.
Ejaakɛ aspaatre fɛɛ aspaatre ni tabilɔ kɛbaashimɔ shi yɛ ta lɛ mli kɛ atade fɛɛ atade ni lá ewu mli lɛ, akɛbaafee lai ni ashã.
Ejaakɛ afɔ bi ahã wɔ!
Afɔ binuu ahã wɔ.
Elumɔyeli kã ekɔŋ.
Abaatsɛ lɛ “Naakpɛɛ Ŋaawolɔ,” “Nyɔŋmɔ Hewalɔ, Naanɔtsɛ, Hejɔlɛ Lumɔ.” Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ shweremɔ kɛ edɛŋ toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ, esɛɛ efoŋ yɛ David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli hei fɛɛ.
Ekɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ nɔ ni ja feemɔ baahã emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi kɛya naanɔ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hiɛdɔɔ baafee enɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Israel toi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ emaje ekɛmiishi Israel, ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ, ni Efraimbii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Samaria fɛɛ aaana ale, amɛ mɛi ni amɛkɛ henɔwomɔ kɛ hewoo jwɛŋmɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Brikisi tsui lɛ ekumɔ, shi wɔ lɛ wɔkɛ tɛ ni ako baatswa tsui lɛ, ni atoo sikamore tsei lɛ ashwie shi, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔɔtɛo tsenedru tsei yɛ amɛnajiaŋ.” Yehowa aaatee henyɛlɔi ashi awo amɛ.
Siriabii miijɛ bokãgbɛ, ni Filistibii hu miijɛ anaigbɛ amɛba kɛ amɛdaaŋ ni amɛgbɛ hatoo amɛkɛbami Israel.
Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ naa ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Israelbii lɛ kpaleee amɛbaaa mɔ ni gbala amɛtoi lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛtaooo Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ gbi kometoo nɔ lɛ Yehowa baafo Israel yitso kɛ elei fɛɛ; ebaafo blɛo kɛ glã fɛɛ gbi kome.
Maŋ onukpa kɛ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ ji yitso lɛ, ni gbalɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji lei lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ maŋbii lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ehã maŋbii lɛ edu gbɛ, ni amɛ mɛi ni anyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ naŋ amɛblahii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛwusãi kɛ amɛkulafoi lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, ebɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ, ni asaŋ efɔŋfeelɔ ni, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Maŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋwalɛ tsoɔ tamɔ la.
