Eshãa kpitikpitii kɛ ŋmeii fɛɛ; esɔoɔ koo hayii anaa la, ni elasu pukɔŋŋ lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu lɛ naa lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ shã.
Maŋbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ latso ni tsoɔ; mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee buaa enyɛmi.
Amɛaashara nii amɛye yɛ ninejurɔgbɛ, shi hɔmɔ aaaye amɛ kɛ̃, ni amɛaaye nii yɛ amɛbɛkugbɛ hu, shi amɛtɔrɔŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaye enaanyo loo.
Manase aaate shi awo Efraim, ni Efraim hu aaatua Manase, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaate shi amɛwo Yuda.
Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ, ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Kpoo ha mlawolɔi ni woɔ mlai ni ejaaa, kɛ mɛi ni ŋmalaa mlai ni akɛfeɔ mɛi niseniianii lɛ.
Mlai nɛɛ hãa atsɔ̃ɔ ohiafo sane hiɛ abuɔ shi, ni akɛshɔɔ mimaŋbii ateŋ ohiafoi lɛ agbɛnaanii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni aha okulafoianii, ni ashɔ̃ awusãi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ yɛ nakai toigbalamɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni ahum baatswa kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛba lɛ?
Namɔ ŋɔɔ nyɛaajo foi kɛaaya nyɛyatao yelikɛbuamɔ; ni nɛgbɛ nyɛaashi nyɛnii ni nyɛna lɛ yɛ?
Eshwɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ fe akɛ amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ yɛ gboklɛfoi ateŋ, aloo amɛ hu amɛnyɔnyɔi.
Kɛ̃lɛ enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa mlifu lɛ ejɔŋ; ni etoigbalamɔ nine lɛ ekpã mli lolo.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ baatsu nii Ao!
Asiria, mimlifu kpoti, mimlila tso!
Mifã lɛ miwo maŋ ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ he.
Mifã lɛ koni eyatua mɛi ni mimli efu amɛ lɛ, koni eyaha amɛ, koni eshɔ̃ amɛdɛŋ nii, koni enaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa blohuŋ ŋmiamɔ.
Shi jeee nakai ji Asiria yiŋtoo, ni jeee nakai ejwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ.
Shi moŋ nɔ ni yɔɔ eyiŋ ji akɛ eyaakpãtã maji ahiɛ wɛɛ, ni jeee maji fioo ko hu, ejaakɛ nɔ ni ekɛɔ ji akɛ, “Ani mitatsɛmɛi lɛ jeee maŋtsɛmɛi sɔŋŋ ni?
Ani Kalno tamɔɔɔ Karkemish, ni Hamat tamɔɔɔ Arpad, ni Samaria tamɔɔɔ Damasko hã mi?
Bɔ ni miye shikpɔji ni jaa amãgãi ni tsiitsii fe Yerusalɛm kɛ Samaria amãgãi anɔ lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni mifeŋ Yerusalɛm kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ tamɔ mifee Samaria kɛ emli amãgãi lɛ?” Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbe enitsumɔ lɛ fɛɛ naa yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ebaagbala Asiria maŋtsɛ toi yɛ eshwãa kɛ ehewoo lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ kɛ minilee naa mitsu enɛ yɛ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã shi, Mitsirɛ majimaji ahusui kɛtee sɛɛ, ni mishɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ amɛmli jwetri; mitsirɛ mɛi ni tara maŋtsɛ sɛii anɔ mitswia shi tamɔ tsina feɔ.
Minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii ni amɛna anɔ tamɔ aloɔ loofɔlɔ wɔji yɛ etsu mli be ni ebɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai minine eshɛ majimaji lɛ anii anɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni baatswa efijiaŋ aloo etswa esɛŋ ekɛɛ nɔ ko.” Shi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, “Ani lema baanyɛ eshwã ewo mɔ ni hiɛ emli lɛ lo?
Aloo ani saalai baanyɛ ete shi ewo mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ?
Ani tso nyɛɔ mɔ ni hiɛ lɛ lɛ moŋ nɔ ewoɔ?
Aloo kplamɔ tso moŋ nyɛɔ mɔ ni ejeee tso nɔ ewoɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lootãa hela aye etabilɔi ni eshwishwii lɛ, ni aaawo enyam lɛ shishi la, ni eeetso tamɔ la.
Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel kane lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ la lilɛi, ni ebaatso, ni ebaashã ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ fɛɛ gbi ko.
Israel koo ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ, Yehowa baakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ kɛmɔ shi wɛɛ tamɔ gbele hela kpãtãa helatsɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Kooŋ tsei ni aaashwɛ afalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko bɔ sɔŋŋ ni gbekɛ tete aaanyɛ amɛyibɔ akane.
Mɛi fioo kɛ̃ aaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba Be miiba, ni nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel kɛ Yakob shwiei ni ahe eje gbele mli lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ efɔŋ mɔ ni tswia amɛ nii lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ, nɔ yɛ anɔkwale mli.
Mɛi fioo ni eshwɛ aaaba Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛwebii, Israelbii, ayi fa tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia moŋ, shi nyɛyi fioo ko pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba.
Hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni ato miimɛ nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ jalɛ yɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baakpãtã nibii ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛmɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Asiria toi Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Ao mimɛi ni yɔɔ Zion, nyɛkashea Asiriabii lɛ gbeyei kɛji amɛkɛ dadei kɛ amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtsei tswia nyɛ tamɔ Ijiptbii lɛ fee nyɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eshwɛ be fioo, kɛkɛ lɛ mimli ni efu nyɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni mibatsɔ̃ mlifu lɛ mahã amɛ, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mibadɔ kpelebi mato amɛnɔ magwao amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Midianbii lɛ yɛ Oreb Tɛsaa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Mibawó tso nɛɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ tamɔ mifee yɛ Ijipt lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibawo Asiria jatsu lɛ kɛje nyɛkɔŋ, ni abaakumɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ.” Henyɛlɔi lɛ ebatua Henyɛlɔ lɛ ejɛ Rimon ebashɛ Ai.
Etsɔ̃ Migron kɛho, ni ekɛ Mikmash efee ejatsutoohe.
Amɛtsɔ̃ gɔji ateŋ tsɔ̃mɔhe lɛ, ni amɛwɔ yɛ Geba.
Rama miikpokpo, ni Maŋtsɛ Saul maŋ Gebea ejo foi.
Ao Galimbii, nyɛbolɔa!
Ao Laishabii, bo toi!
Anatotbii, nyɛhãa amɛ hetoo.
Madmenabii hiɛ foi, ni Gebim maŋ lɛ mli bii miijo foi kɛyatao abobaahe.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ ebaato shi yɛ Nob, ni ebaawo atswɛrɛ nɔ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ Zion Gɔŋ, ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ hewalɛ ko baafolɔ tsei aniji lɛ eshwie shi.
Nii ni ekwɔlɔ gojogojoo lɛ, abaafolɔ amɛ ashwie shi; ni nii ni ehole amɛhe nɔ lɛ, abaafolɔ nɔ.
Yehowa kɛ lema baagba koo hayii lɛ, ni Lebanon baagbee shi kɛ etsei wujiwuji lɛ fɛɛ.
Toiŋjɔlɛ Maŋtsɛyeli Tso fɔ aaakwɛ̃ kɛaajɛ Ishai tso kuku lɛ mli, ni tso nine ko aaahere kɛaajɛ eshishi fã lɛ mli awo yibii.
Ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ baahi enɔ, ni ebaaduro lɛ nilee kɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ mumɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ hewalɛ mumɔ kɛ Yehowa he nilee kɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ.
Eeena Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ he miishɛɛ.
Bɔ ni ehiŋmɛii naa lɛ, jeee nakai ebaakojo; bɔ ni etoi nuɔ lɛ, jeee nakai ebaakojo.
Shi moŋ eeekojo ohiafoi lɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ni eeebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ humii lɛ atɛŋ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Ekɛ edaaŋ wiemɔ aaaplene shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni ekɛ emumɔ lɛ aaagbe mɔ fɔŋ lɛ.
Ni eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli.
Klaŋ kɛ gwantɛŋbi baahi shi, ni kootsɛ kɛ abotiabi baabumɔ shi, ni tsinabi kɛ jatabi baahi he kome, ni gbekɛ bibioo baakpala amɛ.
Tsinayoo kɛ oshishibrishi baaye nii yɛ he kome, ni amɛbii hu baabumɔ shi yɛ he kome, ni jata baakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina nɔŋŋ.
Gbekɛ fufɔoo baashwɛ yɛ shikpãa bu naa, ni bi ni atse lɛ fufɔ kɛ enine baawo onufu bu mli, ni efeŋ lɛ nɔ ko.
Afeŋ efɔŋ, ni afiteŋ nii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, nɔ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa he nilee baayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi obɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
Nomii baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba Be miiba be ni maŋtsɛ ni aaajɛ Ishai mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ashi ahã majimaji lɛ.
Lɛ esɛɛgbɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ aaatao, ni eshihilɛhe lɛ hiɛ baaba nyam.
Nakai be mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ baakpɔ̃ ewebii ni eshwɛ lolo lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, kɛjɛ Asiria kɛ Ijipt kɛ Patros kɛ Kush kɛ Elam kɛ Babilon kɛ Hamat, asaŋ kɛ ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ kɛaaba.
Yehowa aaashi aflaŋaa etsɔ̃ɔ maji lɛ kɛto okadi akɛ eebua Israelbii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ Yudabii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ kɛbakpe.
Ni Israel yeŋ Yuda he awuŋã dɔŋŋ, ni Yuda hu efeŋ Israel henyɛlɔ dɔŋŋ.
Shi amɛbaafee ekome amɛyatua Filistibii yɛ anaigbɛ, ni amɛbaafee ekome amɛyaha bokãgbɛbii lɛ anibii.
Amɛbaaye Edom kɛ Moab nɔ kunim, ni Amonbii baabo amɛtoi.
Yehowa baafite he ni Ijipt Faa lɛ kɛ enaa woɔ ŋshɔŋ yɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baahã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ atswa yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ nɔ, ni ebaaŋala Faa lɛ niji kpawo lɛ, ni mɛi aaanyiɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ kɛfo.
Ni eeetsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋ ehã emaŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, mɛi ni eshwɛ ni aaajɛ Asiria aba lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni jɛi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ha Israel be ni amɛje Ijipt lɛ.
Shidaa Lala Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ obaala okɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, miida bo shi, ejaakɛ omlifu mi moŋ, shi omlifu lɛ enaa ejɔ, ni oshɛje mimii.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ ji miyiwalaherelɔ.
Mihiɛ baakã enɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mihewalɛ kɛ milala, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ.
Nyɛkɛ nyamɔ aaayɛ nu yɛ yiwalaheremɔ bui lɛ amli.’ Ni nakai gbi lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛdaa Yehowa shi, nyɛtsɛa egbɛi lɛ.
Nyɛhãa majimaji lɛ alea nibii ni efee; nyɛhãa alea akɛ egbɛi tsii.
Nyɛlaa kɛkafoa Yehowa, ejaakɛ efee nibii wuji.
Nyɛhãa alea enɛ yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ.
Ao, nyɛ Zion maŋbii, nyɛbolɔa, ni nyɛnyaa, ejaakɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome ni da lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Babilon toi Babilon toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Amoz bi Yesaia nɔ nɛ.
Nyɛshĩa aflaŋaa yɛ gɔŋ kɛ eyiteŋ kpataa nɔ, nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa amɛ, nyɛfɔa amɛ nine, koni amɛbabote lumɛi agboi amli.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mifã mimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni ji mitabilɔi kakabãi lɛ, koni amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyaa kɛ hewoo lɛ aye yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.
Nyɛboa toi!
Aafee hoo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ mɛi babaoo ahoofeemɔ.
Naa jeŋ majimaji ni jɛ maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔji anɔ ahoofeemɔ ni; Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, miibua tabilɔi asafo naa kɛha tawuu.
Amɛjɛ shikpɔji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ anɔ; Yehowa miiba kɛ mlifu kɛ tawuunii koni ebakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛwɔa lele ejaakɛ gbi ni Yehowa to lɛ eshɛ shi etã.
Akɛni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ jɛ Ofe lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, ebaaba mli kɛ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ niji baagboi yɛ ehe, gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ atsuii baafã, ni amɛbaajijaa; ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaababla shi tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; amɛaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛhiŋmɛii aaatsu tamɔ lá.
Naa, gbi ni Yehowa eto lɛ miiba.
Gbi lɛ baafee yiwalɛ gbi ni jɛ mlila kɛ mlifu ni naa wa mli.
Ebaaha je lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakpãtã emli eshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛje je lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ gbi lɛ ŋulamii krokomɛi lɛ kɛ oŋwɛ̃i fɛɛ kpɛŋ, ni hulushitee mli tɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ehiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.
Mibagbala je lɛ toi yɛ emli nifɔɔjianii hewɔ, ni mibagbala mɛi fɔ̃ji atoi yɛ amɛnɔshai lɛ ahewɔ.
Mibaha hewolɔi ahetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo, ni mibaba yiwalɔi ahenɔwomɔ lɛ shi.
Mibahã gbɔmɔ adesa he asɛ̃ fe shika ŋmiiŋmi; adesa he baasɛ̃ fe Ofir shika ŋmiiŋmi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mlifu ni naa wa lɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, yɛ emlila naa lɛ, ebaahã ŋwɛi he akpokpo, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaakpokpo kɛjɛ egbɛhe.
“Gbɔmɔ adesa baatsɔ tamɔ soŋai ni afã lɛ, loo tamɔ too gwantɛŋi ni mɔ ko bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛmaŋbii aŋɔɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo foi kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana lɛ lɛ, aaatsu lɛ nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaamɔ lɛ lɛ, eeenyɔ yɛ klante naa.
Amɛmiikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni aaaŋɔ amɛbii atswia shi yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛshĩa lɛ, aaahahaa amɛmli nii, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ abaato amɛ kabonaa.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitee Midiabii ashi mawo Babilon.
Amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu jwiɛtɛi, ni shika ekɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɛ.
Amɛgãii baagbe oblahii lɛ, amɛmusuŋ etsɔŋ amɛ yɛ bii ni yɔɔ musuŋ tete he, ni amɛnaŋ gbekɛbii mɔbɔ.
Babilon, maŋtsɛyelii amli oje lɛ ni ji Babilonbii anunyam kɛ shwãanii lɛ, baatsɔ tamɔ Sodom kɛ Gomora be ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu amɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ, asaŋ akɛ jɛi efeŋ shihilɛhe yɛ yinɔ ko yinɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Arabnyo ko eshiŋ ebuu yɛ jɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔ ko kɛ etoi eyaŋ niyeli yɛ jɛi.
Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋ kooloi ashibumɔhe, ni tsui ni yɔɔ jɛi aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ patui.
Dugumai kɛ jɛi aaafee amɛshihilɛhe, ni sasabonsami aaajo kɛnyiɛ jɛi.
Klãji aaabolɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛmɛi ashĩai fɛɛfɛji lɛ amli.
Babilon be lɛ eshɛ etã; atsiŋ ebe lɛ kɛyaŋ sɛɛ ahaŋ lɛ.”
Sɛɛkuu kɛjɛ Nomŋɔɔ mli Yehowa musuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ Yakob he, ni eeena Israel he tsuijurɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛ Israelbii lɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Maŋsɛɛbii aaabafata amɛhe, ni amɛaadɔmɔ Yakob we lɛ.
Maŋsɛɛbii aaawa Israelbii lɛ kɛaayashɛ Israelbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ hii nyɔji kɛ yei nyɔji aha Israelbii lɛ.
Israelbii lɛ aaaŋɔ mɛi ni ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ nom, ni amɛaaye mɛi ni fee amɛ niseniianii lɛ anɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi.
Babilon Maŋtsɛ yɛ gbohiiaje Kɛji Yehowa ha nyɛ hejɔlɛ kɛjɛ piŋmɔ kɛ tɔlɛ kɛ nyɔŋ keketee ni aye nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkɛ wiemɔi aaabɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ ahora akɛ, “Te aye tɛŋŋ ni mlifu ni shimɔɔ shi lɛ sɛɛ efo nɛɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni haolɔ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ nɛɛ?
Yehowa efo yiwalɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni Yehowa ekumɔ nɔyelɔi adɛŋ tsi lɛ mli, mɔ ni kɛ mlila tswia majimaji lɛ nii babaoo ni etooo enine shi lɛ, yɛ maji ni eye amɛnɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ena hejɔlɛ, ni enɔ ejɔ; ni amɛmiila nyamɔ lalai.
Sɛsɛoi lɛ miiye bo yɔɔ, ni Lebanon tsenedru lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛjɛ ni aba bo shi nɛɛ lɛ, tsotoolɔ ko bɛŋkɛko wɔ.’ “Gbohiiaje ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi esaa ehe eeba ebakpee bo.
Ekanya mɛi fɛɛ ni ye onukpa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ ohewɔ; ni mɛi ni ye maŋtsɛ yɛ maji amli miihole amɛhe nɔ kɛmiijɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ.
Amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛbaabi bo akɛ, ‘Bo hu ogbɔjɔ nɛkɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ?
Otsɔ̃ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ, pɛpɛɛpɛ?’ Aba ogbojee shi kɛba gbohiiaje, bo kɛ osaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu.
Omlɛgɛ ji saa ni obaakã nɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ji mama ni obaaha.
“Bo Tooloo, Jetsɛremɔ okadi, te aye tɛŋŋ ni ojɛ ŋwɛi obaagbee shi nɛɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni, bo ni oba majimaji ashi lɛ, akɛ bo etswa shi nɛɛ?
Shi bo lɛ okɛɛ ohe akɛ, ‘Mibakwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi kɛho Nyɔŋmɔ ŋulamii lɛ ahe.
Mawo mimaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ, ni mata nɔ yɛ kpee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Makwɔ kɛteke atatui lɛ, ni mibafee mihe tamɔ Ŋwɛi Grɔŋŋnyo lɛ.’ Shi moŋ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee gbohiiaje, kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ.
“Mɛi ni aaana bo lɛ, aaakwɛ bo gãa, ni amɛaabi amɛhe akɛ, ‘Kwɛɛ nuu lɛ ni hã shikpɔŋ lɛ hoso, ni ehã maŋtsɛyelii ahe kpokpo lɛ, mɔ ni kpãtã maji ahiɛ, ni ehã je lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa kpataa, ni eŋmɛɛɛ enomii ahe koni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ?’ Jeŋ maji lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kamɔ shi kɛ anunyam, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ egbonyobu mli.
Shi bo lɛ ashɛ bo afɔ̃ kɛjɛ ogbonyobu lɛ mli tamɔ bi ni ashrake lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, aaanyaŋe lɛ.
Nɔ ni ona okɛha ohe ji mɛi ni akɛ klante egbe amɛ lɛ agbohii, ni amɛkpeleke shi kɛtee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ gbohii ni anaanaa amɛnɔ lɛ.
Akɛ bo fataŋ amɛhe afuŋ, ejaakɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ okpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ogbe omaŋbii lɛ.
Atsiŋ efɔŋfeelɔi ashwiei atã dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko.
Nyɛsaa gbɛhe nyɛtoa maŋtsɛ nɛɛ bii lɛ yɛ amɛtsɛmɛi anɔsha lɛ hewɔ koni amɛkate shi amɛmiiŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛmiifee amɛnɔ, ni amɛmiimamɔ maji amɛmiiwo je lɛ mli obɔ̃.” Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Babilon hiɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibate shi mawo Babilonbii, ni makpãtã amɛhiɛ, egbɛi kɛ enii ni eyɔɔ kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ.
Mibahã jɛi atsɔ̃ shadeboai ashihilɛhe kɛ kpaakpoi ashikpɔŋ.
Mikɛ bolɔ baabɛɛ lɛ mashwie.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Asiriabii ahiɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ bɔ ni misusu lɛ, nakai ebaaba mli; ni bɔ ni mito miyiŋ lɛ, ja ena eba mli nakai.
No ji akɛ mibakpãtã Asiriabii ni yɔɔ mishikpɔŋ, Israel, nɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
Mibanaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ migɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛbaawó Asiriabii apã ni kã Israelbii anɔ lɛ kɛje amɛkuɛ.” Enɛ ji yiŋ ni ato yɛ je lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, ni ji minine ni akpã mli kɛtee maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ nɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto eyiŋ, ni namɔ baaku naa?
Ekpã enine mli, ni namɔ aaanyɛ enaa aku?
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Filistibii ahiɛ Afi nɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz gbo lɛ, ajie ninaa nɛɛ ahã.
Ao Filistia, kaanya, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkanyaa akɛ tso ni yi nyɛ lɛ eku; ejaakɛ blikã baajɛ klɛŋklɛŋ onufu lɛ mli eba, ni lɛ ebi lɛ aaafee onufu filikilɔ.
Ohiafoi amli ohiafo lɛ aaana nii eye, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehia lɛ aaakamɔ shi yɛ hejɔlɛŋ shweshweeshwe; shi mikɛ hɔmɔ baagbe nyɛ, ni nyɛmɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ mibagbe amɛ.
Nyɛ Filistia maji fɛɛ, nyɛwoa yara; nyɛbolɔa, nyɛfoa, nyɛtsui afãa, ejaakɛ lasu ko efã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ; ni tabilɔi ni baa lɛ, yakagbɔmɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ.
Mɛɛ hetoo aaahã Filistia bɔfoi lɛ?
Aaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yehowa eto Zion shishi akɛ maŋ, ni jɛi ewebii shitswialɔi lɛ aaababa abo yɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baakpãtã Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ: Akɛni akpãtã Ar maŋ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ, Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.
Ni Kir maŋ lɛ hiɛ ni akpãtã nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ hewɔ lɛ Moab bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.
Dibonbii lɛ ekwɔ kɛtee amɛwɔŋjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyafo.
Moabbii ewɔ lele yɛ Nebo kɛ Medeba maji lɛ ahewɔ.
Amɛshɛ yi fɛɛ yi kɛ tsɛŋ fɛɛ tsɛŋ.
Amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛnyiɛ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛwo lele kɛ yaafo tsoo yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ kɛ jaji anɔ.
Heshbon kɛ Eleale majiaŋbii lɛ miibolɔ, ni aanu amɛgbee yɛ Yahaz tɔ̃ɔ.
Moab tabilɔi lɛ miibolɔ waa; amɛyoyro.
Mitsui miiye miihã Moab.
Emli foijelɔi eshɛ Zoar kɛ Eglat Shelishiya; mɛi kɛ yaafo miikwɔ kɛmiiya Luhit, ni mɛi hu ewo maŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he yara yɛ Horonaim gbɛjegbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nimrim Faa lɛ egbi; jɛi jwɛi eŋala, ni jwɛfɔ bɛ he ko he ko, ni baa ŋmɔŋ hu bɛ he ko he ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtereteree nii babaoo ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ nii ni amɛtĩa fɛɛ kɛmiifo faa naa kpãi ajɔɔ lɛ kɛya.
Ejaakɛ Moab husui anaa fɛɛ lɛ yaafo sɔŋŋ.
Yaafo lɛ shɛ Eglaim kɛ Beer-Elim tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Dibon Faa lɛ eyi kɛ lá.
Shi mibahã Dibon ana amanehulu ni naa wa fe nakai.
Mɛi ni na foijee hegbɛ kɛje Moab lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibafã jata mawo amɛhe.
Moab sane lɛ yɛ mɔbɔ Amɛkɛ toobii emaje kɛjɛ Sela maŋ lɛ mli, yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni akɛyahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Moabbii lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ loofɔji ni miitsomlo kɛmiiya kɛmiiba, amɛtamɔ loofɔji abii ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ faafoohe lɛ.
Amɛmiikɛɛ Yudabii akɛ, “Nyɛwoa wɔ ŋaa, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane nyɛhãa wɔ.
Nyɛfea tamɔ shwane fintiŋŋ hɔ̃ɔŋ nyɛhãa wɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ lɛ atea, ni nyɛkatsɔa foijelɔi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ.
Nyɛhãa Moabbii ni ashwie amɛ lɛ abato nyɛ gbɔ; nyɛfea nyɛhe teemɔhe nyɛhãa amɛ yɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ni haoɔ amɛ lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni mɔ ni naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ elaaje yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaajɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee mli afo maŋtsɛyeli sɛ̃i ko ama shi.
Mɔ ko baajɛ David shwiei ateŋ eta sɛ̃i nɛɛ nɔ, ni ebaaye maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwayeli; ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ kojomɔ mli, ni ebaakwɛ akɛ aaye jalɛ sane.” Yudabii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe ehã; ewo ehe tsɔ̃.
Wɔnu ehetsɔɔmɔ kɛ ehewoo kɛ ehetsɛmɔ.
Shwãa ni eshwã lɛ fɛɛ asomoaŋ efolo ni.” Belɛ nyɛhãa Moab awoa yara; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ awo yara ahã Moab.
Aye ŋkɔmɔ waa yɛ Kir-Heres wainyibii ni abɔlɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Heshbon ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã, ni Sibma waintsei lɛ hu ahiɛ ekpãtã.
Waintso ni eyibii hã majimaji alumɔ tɔrɔ dãa lɛ niji eyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ, ni egba bokãgbɛ kɛtee shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni etee anaigbɛ kɛyashɛ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mifo miha Sibma waintsei lɛ taakɛ mifo miha Yazer wainyibii lɛ.
Ao Heshbon kɛ Eleale, mikɛ yaafonu baaju nyɛhe, ejaakɛ miishɛɛ ni okɛkpaa wainyibii kɛ oŋmãa lɛ sɛɛ efo.
Nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ etã yɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni alaaa yɛ waintromi lɛ amli lɛ, abɔɔɔ oshe yɛ jɛi; wainŋalɔ ko eŋaaa wain lɛ, lala emu shi kɔ̃i yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, misusuma miifo emli tamɔ kpãa saŋku yɛ Moab hewɔ, ni mitsui mli miishã mi miihã Kir-Heres.
Kɛji Moabbii gba amɛhe naa kɛtee amɛwɔjamɔhei lɛ koni amɛyasɔle yɛ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, nɔ ko jɛŋ mli baŋ.
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Moab he nyɛsɛɛ ko nɛ.
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ afii etɛ̃ mli lɛ, tamɔ afii ni apaafonyo yeɔ yɛ apaayelihe lɛ, Moab anunyam lɛ he guɔ baagbo, tsɛbelɛ amɛyi fa babaoo, ni emɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayifalɛ shɛŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni amɛnaŋ hewalɛ ko.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Siria kɛ Israel toi Damasko he gbalɛ nɛ, “Naa, abuŋ Damasko ashiŋ maji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Abaashi Siria maji lɛ ashwie shi kɛya naanɔ.
Toi kɛ tsinai kɛ jɛi baafee amɛniyelihe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.
Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko ni wa eshwɛŋ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Damasko yeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ; ni mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Siria lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi tamɔ Israel.
Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Gbi miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ Israel anunyam lɛ nɔ baagbɔ, ni eninamɔ ni ehã eshwi lɛ baatsɔ̃ ohia, ni ebaatã loo.
Israel baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmɔ ni ŋmãakulɔ efolɔ emli abeletsei lɛ eshwie shi, ni eku amɛyi abele lɛ; ebaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Refaim Jɔɔ lɛ mli ŋmɔ ni aye emli ŋmãa kpɛkpɛo butuu.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi fioo yɛ Israel tamɔ bɔ ni kɛji ahoso mutso ni eshwɛɔ yibii enyɔ loo etɛ̃ kɛ̃ yɛ tso lɛ yiteŋ fɔfɔoo lɛ; loo bɔ ni eshwɛɔ yibii ejwɛ loo enumɔ oo ko yɛ aduawa tso ni ewo babaoo nɔ lɛ.
Mi Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Nakai gbi lɛ mɛi ahiɛ baasɔ amɛ-Bɔlɔ lɛ; ni amɛbaakwɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ.
Amɛbuŋ afɔleshãa latɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛniji fee lɛ amɛhaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Amɛkɛ nii ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛniji fee tamɔ Asherim wɔŋkoi lɛ loo tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi lɛ efeŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛmaji ni he wa lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ maji ni Hivbii lɛ kɛ Amorbii lɛ jo foi shi ni amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i be ni amɛjoɔ Israelbii lɛ anaa foi lɛ, ni nibii ahiɛ baakpãtã lɛ.
Israel, ohiɛ ekpa oyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni okaiii obobaa Tɛsaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ mli akɛ oootɛo tsei fɛɛfɛji, ni ooofee wɔŋkoo oha maŋsɛɛ wɔŋ, ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ ahere gbi nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ, ni ooohã tsei nɛɛ agba afofro gbi leebi lɛ nɔŋŋ ni otɛo amɛ lɛ nɔ, shi nikpamɔ lɛ baaje odɛ̃ŋ, ni gbi lɛ aaatsɔ ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ hejaramɔ ni naa wa gbi.
Aye Henyɛlɔi amaji anɔ Ao!
Mɛi babaoo ahoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛhoofeemɔ lɛ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ!
Ao!
Maji ahoofeemɔ nɛ; amɛmiigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔkei wuji agbɛɛmɔ.
Maji lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔi agbɛɛmɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋa amɛyi, ni amɛaajo foi kɛaatee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni aaawo amɛ foi tamɔ gɔŋ nɔ tutuu yɛ lasuogbele mli.
Ni gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ aaahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ mɛi, shi be ni je aaatsɛre lɛ anaŋ amɛ yɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ!
Mɛi fɛɛ ni tswaa wɔ ojo kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni haa wɔ nii lɛ, nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni amɛnaagbee aaatamɔ ahã.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Kush toi Ao!
Shikpɔŋ ko yɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ ni anuɔ fijiaŋtswaa yɛ nɔ, ni etsuɔ ebɔfoi ni taraa ada lɛji amli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nilo faa lɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛ bɔfoi ni nyɛhe yɔɔ oya, nyɛyaa maŋ ko ni emli bii kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Asheɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ ji amɛ.
Fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɛ jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛji ashi aflaŋaa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa, ni kɛji akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ nyɛboa toi.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Majɛ mishihilɛhe lɛ makwɛ kpoo tamɔ hulutsoo mli dɔlɛ, loo tamɔ atatu mli bɔ yɛ nikpamɔ be mli.
Dani aaashɛ nikpamɔ be lɛ, be ni afofro lɛ ekpala, ni wainyibii bibii lɛ epue lɛ, ekɛ klante aaafolɔ niji lɛ ni etsɛ̃rɛ lɛ kɛ niji ni egbalagbalai lɛ eshwie.
Abaashi gbohii lɛ ashwie shi ahã gɔji lɛ anɔ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi; ni loofɔji lɛ baaye amɛ hulutsoobe mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ baaye amɛ yɛ fɛibe mli.” Nakai be lɛ gbɔmɛi ni kwɔlɔ ni amɛhe yɔɔ trotro ni asheɔ amɛ gbeyei yɛ kpaakpa kɛ shɔŋŋ, jaku ko ni he wa pam ni naanaa mɛi anɔ, ni fai ejara amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ mli baatere nikeenii kɛbaha Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ajaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Ijipt toi Ijipt toigbalamɔ he gbalɛ nɛ.
Naa, Yehowa ta atatu ni hiɛ foi nɔ kɛmiiba Ijipt.
Ijipt amãgãi lɛ atsui efã yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã Ijiptbii ate shi awo Ijiptbii nɔŋŋ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛhe baawu: mɔ kɛ enyɛmi, mɔ kɛ enaanyo, maŋ kɛ maŋ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli kɛ maŋtsɛyeli.
Mahã Ijiptbii awerɛ aho amɛhe fe nine, ni amɛyiŋtoi fɛɛ baafee yaka.
Amɛbaaya amãgãi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ sisai aŋɔɔ amɛyabi nii.
Mibaŋɔ Ijiptbii mawo nɔyelɔ yitsoŋwalɔ ko dɛŋ, ni maŋtsɛ ko ni esane wa baaye amɛnɔ.
Mi Yehowa, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu baaŋala, ni faa lɛ baagbi; nujɔi ni agbala awo faa lɛ he lɛ amli nu baasha; ni Ijipt Nilo Faa lɛ niji lɛ amli nu baakpɔŋ ni ebaagbi, ni neŋ kɛ glãi lɛ hu baakpɔtɔ.
Nilo Faa lɛ toi hei komɛi baakamɔ shi efoji, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshi nii ni adu yɛ Nilo Faa lɛ toitoi lɛ baaŋala, ni kɔɔyɔɔ baatswa amɛ kɛya.
Mɛi ni ji wolɛi ni hɛɔ baaye ŋkɔmɔ; mɛi fɛɛ ni shaa loo yɛ Nilo Faa lɛ mli lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ŋmɛɔ yaa yɛ faa lɛ mli anine baanyɛ shi.
Mɛi ni kpooɔ ananaŋse anijiaŋ baaje wui, ni mɛi fɛɛ hu ni loɔ klala aaaye jaramɔ.
Mamalolɔi kɛ ninenaa nitsulɔi fɛɛ atsui baaye.
Zoan maŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ni.
Farao ŋaawolɔi ni le nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ aŋaawoo lɛ etsɔ buuluiaŋaawoo.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ Farao akɛ, “Nilelɔi abii ji wɔ, ni blema maŋtsɛmɛi ashwiei ji wɔ lɛ?” Agbɛnɛ Ijipt, nɛgbɛ onilelɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Hã amɛgba koni amɛhã ole nɔ yiŋtoo ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, eto yɛ ohe.
Zoan lumɛi lɛ etsɔmɔ kwashiai, ni Memfis lumɛi hu alaka amɛ.
Mɛi ni ji Ijipt akutsei lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ehã Ijipt edu gbɛ.
Yehowa ehã awo Ijipt ŋaa gbonyo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Ijipt yiŋ feɔ lɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni edidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ didãa kɛji eeshwe.
Belɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ awa Ijipt.
Maŋ lɛ mli niiatsɛ jio, ohiafo jio, gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi jio, mɛi ni bɛ gbɛi jio amɛnyɛŋ lɛ amɛwa.
Ijipt baaja Yehowa Be miiba ni Ijiptbii baatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei.
Amɛhe baakpokpo kɛ gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ ni ebaawo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Yudabii ahe baaba gbeyei ahã Ijiptbii.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aatsĩ Yuda gbɛi tã yɛ etoiŋ lɛ, eeeshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yiŋ ni eto yɛ Ijiptbii ahe lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai be lɛ abaawie Hebribii awiemɔ lɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji enumɔ amli; ni amɛaakã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kitã.
Abaatsɛ nɛkɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ ekome akɛ, “Hulu Maŋ.” Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaama afɔleshãa latɛ ahã Yehowa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ tuuŋtu, ni abaatswa akulashiŋ amã shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ ahã Yehowa.
Akulashiŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ okadi kɛ odaseyeli nɔ ahã Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni kɛji amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ mɛi ni waa amɛ yi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeetsu yiwalaherelɔ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eeebafã amɛhe, ni eeehere amɛyiwala.
Yehowa aaajie ehe shi etsɔ̃ɔ Ijiptbii, ni Ijiptbii aaana ale Yehowa nakai be lɛ, ni amɛkɛ afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle aaabasɔmɔ lɛ, ni amɛaawo Yehowa shi, ni amɛaye nɔ.
Yehowa aaagbala Ijiptbii atoi, eeetswia amɛ nii, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ eeetsa amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaakpale kɛaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeebo amɛfaikpamɔ toi, ni eeetsa amɛ.
Kɛji eshɛ nakai be lɛ, gbɛjegbɛ aaakã shi kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛya Asiria; ni Asirianyo aaaba Ijipt, ni Ijiptnyo hu aaaya Asiria, ni Ijiptbii kɛ Asiriabii aaaja Yehowa yɛ he kome.
Nakai be lɛ Israel kɛ Ijipt kɛ Asiria aaatsɔ̃mɔ tipɛŋfoi; ni maji etɛ̃ nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ahã je lɛ mli maji fɛɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaajɔɔ amɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ Ijipt, ni ji mimaŋ lɛ, kɛ Asiria, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ, kɛ Israel, mi diɛŋtsɛ mimaŋ ni mihala lɛ.”
Gbalɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ okadi lɛ Afi nɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sargon tsu etatsɛnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ebatua Filistibii amaŋ Ashdod, ni eŋɔ maŋ lɛ, Yehowa etsɔ̃ hiɛ afii etɛ̃ momo ekɛɛ Amoz bi Yesaia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyajie kpekpe lɛ yɛ ohɛ, ni ojie otokotai lɛ hu.” Yesaia fee nakai, ni enyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo hu.
Be ni aŋɔ Ashdod sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni mitsulɔ Yesaia nyiɛ yayai kɛ enane folo afii etɛ̃ ekɛto Ijipt kɛ Kush naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ aaakpala Ijipt kɛ Kush akɛ nomii kɛaatee.
Abaakpala gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ amɛdukui ahe ni kã kɛ amɛnane folo hu; ni Ijipt hiɛ aaashwie shi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaahao ni amɛnaa aaakpɛ amɛhe yɛ Kush ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ enɔ lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ Ijipt hu ni amɛshwã amɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nɛkɛ ŋshɔ nɛɛ naa bii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa nɔ ni eba mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ, mɛi ni wɔjo foi kɛtee wɔyaba abo yɛ amɛŋɔɔ koni ahere wɔ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ anɔ.
Belɛ, wɔ lɛ, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔje mli hu?’ ”
Babilon shigbeemɔ he ninaa Babilon he gbalɛ nɛ.
Bɔ ni lasuogbele tswaa kɛjɛɔ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, nakai haomɔ aaajɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni he yɔɔ gbeyei nɔ aba.
Ajie ninaa ko ni yɔɔ gbeyei atsɔ̃ɔ mi: mɔsɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko sɛɛgbɛ, kɛ nifitelɔ ni miifite nii.
Elam, kwɔɔ kɛya!
Media, yaasa maji lɛ ayi!
Mahã ŋkɔmɔi fɛɛ ni Babilon eha eyeɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo!
No hewɔ lɛ, mihɛ mli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ piŋmɔ, kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe; kɔ̃ɔmɔ eta mihe tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ.
Mishɔ kwekweekwe, hewɔ lɛ minuuu nii.
Mijijaa hewɔ lɛ minaaa nii.
Mihiɛ miidi mi; ŋmiŋmi emɔ mi; gbɛkɛ ni mishweɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ moŋ ehã mi.
Ninaa lɛ mli lɛ mina ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃, akɛ kuŋtui lɛɛ shi, aaye nii, ni aanu nii.
Trukaa lɛ abo akɛ, “Tatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea shi; nyɛfɔa tsɛŋi lɛ ahe mu.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Yaa!
Hã ni mɔ ko ayabu, ni nɔ ni eeena lɛ, ehã ni ale.
Kɛji ena mɛi tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ, ni ena mɛi hu ni tara tejii kɛ yoomai anɔ lɛ, etɛ̃je ehiɛ, ni ebo nɔ ni ebaanu lɛ toi jogbaŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ bo waa ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, midamɔ buuhe nɛɛ gbi muu fɛɛ, ni mibu nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ hu.
Trukaa lɛ, naa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi komɛi ni miiba; amɛnyiɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ!” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Babilon egbee shi!
Hɛɛ!
Egbee shi!
Emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ akumɔ ashwie shi nɛɛ!” Ao mimaŋ Israel, ni otamɔ ŋmãa ni agbee ni asha mli.
Nɔ ni minu yɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, no mikɛɛ bo nɛɛ.
Edom he gbalɛ Edom he ninaa nɛ.
Abo atsɛ mi kɛjɛ Edom akɛ, “Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ?
Bulɔ, mɛɛ nyɔɔŋ ŋmɛlɛtswaa be mli nɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni bulɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Je miitsɛre shi moŋ je baana ekoŋŋ.
Kɛji nɔ ko otaoɔ obi lɛ, bi!
Kuu osɛɛ ni obabi!” Arabia he gbalɛ Arabia he ninaa nɛ.
Nyɛ Dedan gbɛnyiɛlɔi asafo, Arabia ŋa lɛ mli nyɛbaaya nyɛyato shi yɛ.
Nyɛ Temabii, nyɛhaa mɛi ni kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ nu ni amɛnu, ni nyɛhaa abobalɔi lɛ niyenii ni amɛye, ejaakɛ amɛjo foi kɛjɛ ta mli gbele naa, kɛjɛ klante ni agbala awo amɛ kɛ gãi ni abaatsɛ̃ kɛ ta mli osharãi fɛɛ anaa.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Biɛ afi mli, tamɔ apaafonyo apaayeli afi be lɛ, Kedar anunyam fɛɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Kedar hii kãkãlɔi gãitsɛ̃lɔi ni aaashwɛ lɛ ayi faŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekɛɛ.”
Yerusalɛm he gbalɛ Ninaa ni kɔɔ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ he nɛ.
Mɛni ji tsui ayiteŋ ni bo kɛ omɛi fɛɛ ekwɔ kɛtee nɛɛ?
Maŋ kɛ emli kiŋkaŋŋ, maŋ ni mli efili lɛ, omli eyi kɛ hoofeemɔ.
Omɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔi lɛ, jeee klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ, ni jeee ta mli hu amɛgboi yɛ.
Olumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kwa ejo foi; ahiɛɛɛ gãi tete ni amɔmɔ amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni ana amɛ lɛ, amɔmɔ amɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛjojoo foi kɛtee shɔŋŋshɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, nyɛfɔa mi kwɛmɔ; nyɛhãa mafoa kɛ dɔlɛ.
Nyɛkagbaa nyɛhe naa nyɛshɛjea mimii yɛ maŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ gidigidifeemɔ kɛ nibii ni anaanaa nɔ kɛho kɛ nibii ni afee basaa yɛ Ninaa Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ jɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ.
Akumɔ gbogboi ashwie shi, ni blɔmɔ ni maŋbii lɛ bolɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, ejije kɛtee gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Elam tabilɔi ba kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãi kɛ gãimlibii; ni Kirbii hu ba ni amɛhiɛ amɛtsɛŋi.
Ojɔi kpakpai lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ tayaa shwiilii, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ gba sa yɛ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ anaa.
Akpa Yuda he mama.
Nakai gbi lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ tawuu nibii ni yɔɔ tawuu nibii atoohe lɛ anɔ, nyɛna akɛ David maŋ Yerusalɛm hei ni agbugbuu awo mli lɛ fa, ni nyɛtswa nubu koni nyɛkɛto nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shishigbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli lɛ eko.
Nyɛkane Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ, ni nyɛkumɔ shĩai lɛ ekomɛi koni nyɛna tɛ nyɛkɛwaje maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ.
Nyɛgba nujɔɔ yɛ gbogboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ koni nyɛkɛbua kpaakpo momo lɛ mli nu lɛ naa yɛ jɛi.
Shi nyɛyakwɛɛɛ ni nyɛyabuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni to nɔ ni ba lɛ hegbɛjianɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ, ni asaŋ ehã eba mli lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, tsɛ koni nyɛfo ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛshɛshɛɛ nyɛyi ni nyɛmia kɛ kpekpe.
Shi moŋ nyɛnya, ni nyɛmli fili nyɛ.
Nyɛgbegbee tsinai kɛ toi, ni nyɛye, ni nyɛnu dãi, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua dãi ejaakɛ wɔ bɛnɛ wɔgboi.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ ni wie, ni minu kɛ mitoi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwa, aŋɔŋ nɛkɛ nɔsha nɛɛ afaŋ nyɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaagboi.” Abɔ Shebna kɔkɔ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Ba, yaa Shebna, tsulɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ yɛ biɛ; ni namɛi ji owekumɛi yɛ biɛ, hewɔ ni okpɛɔ yɛ he grɔŋŋ nɛɛ, ni okpɛɔ tɛsaa mli otoɔ okɛfeɔ ofũuhe lɛ?
Naa, bo nuu hewalɔ, Yehowa baawo bo eshɛ efɔ̃.
Ebaamɔ omli tswɛ, ni eeefɔ̃ bo kɛbɔle yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ, ni eeeshɛ bo efɔ̃ tamɔ bɔɔlo ni ashɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ.
Jɛi ooogbo yɛ, bo, onuŋtsɔ we lɛ mli hiɛgbejiatsɛ; ni jɛi otayaa shwiilii fɛɛfɛji lɛ aaaka.
Mashwie bo yɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli, ni oyelihe aaabɔ bo.” Nakai gbi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Shebna akɛ, “Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mibatsɛ mitsulɔ Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, ni maŋɔ otade yuu lɛ mawo lɛ, ni mikɛ ohɛfiinɔ lɛ baafi ehɛ, ni maŋɔ ohewalɛ lɛ mahã lɛ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ tsɛ eha Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yuda we lɛ.
Maŋɔ David we lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ naa samfee mawo edɛŋ: kɛji egbele lɛ, mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ aŋa; ni kɛji eŋa lɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbele.
Mahã emã shi shiŋŋ tamɔ shiŋmlitso ni aka sɛɛ kpɛŋŋ; ni ebaahã etsɛ we lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.
“Eweku lɛ mli bii kɛ hɔi asaji fɛɛ baakã enɔ.
Amɛbaatsotsro enɔ tamɔ kɔɔpoi bibii kɛ ewuji tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ.
Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, shiŋmlitso lɛ ni aka akɛma shi shiŋŋ lɛ, aaawɔtsɔ, ni ebaagbee shi, ni jatsu ni tsotsoro nɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ.
Tiro he gbalɛ Nyɛ Tiro lɛji amli asrɛfoi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmaŋ Tiro lɛji amaamɔhe lɛ hiɛ.
Ajɛ Kipro shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahã amɛle nɔ ni eba lɛ.
Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaabii, Ao Sidon jarayelɔi, nyɛfea kpoo!
Nyɛtsulɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ ŋshɔ hiɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ fai wuji hu ahiɛ amɛye jara.
Amɛye Shihor abele, ni ji Nilo Faa lɛ he nikpamɔnii lɛ, jara.
Nyɛ kɛ majimaji ye jara.
Ao Sidon, ohiɛ agbo; ejaakɛ ŋshɔ ewie, ŋshɔ shishi diɛŋtsɛ ewie akɛ, “Mikɔ̃mɔko dã, asaŋ mifɔko dã.
Milɛko oblahii dã lɛ, milɛko oblayei hu dã.” Kɛji sane lɛ yashɛ Ijipt lɛ, jɛibii baahao yɛ Tiro sane ni abagba lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛ Foinikiabii ni kã ŋshɔnaa, nyɛwoa lele, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa Tarshish.
Kwɛ, nyɛmaŋ ni ji blema maŋ Tiro kɛ emli miishɛɛ babaoo lɛ ni yato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɛ.
(Tiro) Namɔ to nɛkɛ yiŋ yɛ Tiro he, lɛ maŋ ni etoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi, maŋ ni ejarayelɔi lɛ lumɛi sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, ni eguɔyelɔi ahiɛ ba nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ?
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni to nɛkɛ yiŋ.
Eto yiŋ nɛɛ koni ekɛba amɛhe ni amɛwoɔ, yɛ hiɛnyam ni amɛna hewɔ lɛ shi, bɔ ni afee ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ anunyam gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ agboi.
Ao Tarshishbii, nyɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyahua; nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni tsĩɔ nyɛ gbɛ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa ewo enine nɔ yɛ ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ehoso maŋtsɛyelii.
Efã akɛ afite Kanaan mɔji lɛ.
Ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Sidon, ni awaa obii yi, omli akafili bo dɔŋŋ!
Sidonbii, nyɛtea shi koni nyɛyaa Kipro, shi jɛi hu nyɛnaŋ hejɔlɛ.” Naa Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Babilonbii lɛ ji mɛi ni hã jwɛiaŋ kooloi kakawuai kpãtã Tiro maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, shi jeee Asiriabii lɛ.
Babilonbii lɛ mamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmɔji ni kwɔlɔ, ni amɛkumɔ Tiro mɔji ni yɔɔ sa lɛ, ni amɛhã Tiro fee koikoi.
Ao Tarshish lɛji amli bii, nyɛwoa lele, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ ahiɛ.
Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ, hiɛ aaakpa Tiro nɔ kɛyaashi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo, ni ji be ni maŋtsɛ kome yeɔ yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ lɛ.
Afii kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Tiro sane baatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni alaa yɛ yoo ajwamãŋ he akɛ, “Ajwamãŋ ni hiɛ ekpa onɔ, kɔ saŋku koni okɛyakpa maŋ lɛ mli.
Tswaa saŋku lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni ola lalai babaoo bɔ ni afee ni akai bo ekoŋŋ.” Afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ naagbee lɛ, Yehowa baahã Tiro aku sɛɛ ebɔi ejarayeli lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ebaafee ehe apaafonyo ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ.
Tiro baajɔɔ ejarayeli mli nii kɛ apaa ni abaabɔ lɛ mli nii hu nɔ ehã Yehowa.
Atĩaŋ esɛɛnamɔ lɛ naa amaŋ shi, shi ejarayeli lɛ mli nii baahã ana niyenii babaoo kɛ mamai fɛɛfɛji ahã mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ Yehowa lɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Je lɛ toi Naa, Yehowa baakpãtã je lɛ hiɛ koni efee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃?
Ebaatsɔ̃ je lɛ hiɛ ebu shi, ni ebaagbɛ enɔ bii lɛ eshwã.
Bɔ ni abaafee maŋbii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee osɔfo lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nyɔŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee enuŋtsɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee weyoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee ewula lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee nihelɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee nihɔɔlɔ lɛ; bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni kɛ nii filiɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni filiɔ nii lɛ; ni bɔ ni abaafee mɔ ni ahiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee mɔ ni hiɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Abaakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni abaashi lɛ shwɛm, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekɛɛ, ni ja ena eba mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ miigbi, ni eeŋala; je lɛ miigbede, ni eeŋala; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ miigbede.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ he muji, ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃ mlai lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyeee akpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛku naanɔ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, loomɔ miikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni enɔ bii miina nɔ yɛ amɛfɔyeli hewɔ.
Enɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi etã ni eshwɛ mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ.
Wain tete miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni waintso lɛ miigbi.
Mɛi ni mli fili amɛ fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ.
Miji kɛ kpãa saŋkui agbɛɛmɔi kɛ nyamɔ lɛ ejɔ, ni mliflilɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ sɛɛ efo.
Wainnumɔ kɛ lala sɛɛ efo, ni dãa ni wa miijoo yɛ dãanulɔ daaŋ.
Maŋ kɛ emli basabasa nifeemɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã; aŋamɔ emli shĩai fɛɛ ashinai koni mɔ ko akabote eko mli.
Aabolɔ yɛ blohui lɛ amli yɛ wain hewɔ; miishɛɛ fɛɛ naa eba shi; afo miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Afee maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni akumɔ agboi lɛ amli dukuduku.
Nɔ ni baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ nɛ.
Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mutso ni akpa enɔ yibii loo waintso ni akpa enɔ wainyibii atã.
Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaahole amɛgbei anɔ amɛaala kɛ miishɛɛ.
Mɛi aaajɛ anaigbɛ amɛbɔ oshe kɛkafo Yehowa agbojee, No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam yɛ bokãgbɛ.
Ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛwoa Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Wɔmiinu yijiemɔ kɛ Jalɔ Koome lɛ hiɛ nyamwoo lalai kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ.
Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miitã loo!
Miitã loo!
Kpoo ha mi, ejaakɛ kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo!
Kutumpɔfoi miiye mihe kutumpɔo waa diɛŋtsɛ!
Ao shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, gbeyei nii kɛ bu ni atsa kɛ tsɔne ni atsɔ̃ miimɛ nyɛ!
Mɔ ni baajo foi kɛji anu gbeyei sane lɛ, ebaagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni baakwɔ kɛje kpo yɛ bu lɛ mli lɛ, ebaadu tsɔne; ejaakɛ aaagbele ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo lɛ aaahoso.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ewule, shikpɔŋ lɛ egbala, shikpɔŋ lɛ ehoso waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ ni miididãa, ebaahoso tamɔ aboŋo yɛ ahum mli.
Etɔmɔ lɛ tsii yɛ enɔ, ni ebaatsi lɛ egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
“Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa baagbala ŋwɛi asafo lɛ toi yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebaagbala shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu atoi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Abaabua amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa awo bu ko mli tamɔ gboklɛfoi.
Abaaŋa amɛyi awo gboklɛfoi atsu ko mli, ni be kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, abaagbala amɛtoi.
Nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛŋ, ni hulu etsoŋ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, baaye nɔ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni ebaajie enunyam lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ.”
Yijiemɔ Lala Ao Yehowa, bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ; mibakafo bo, mibajie ogbɛi lɛ yi.
Ejaakɛ otsu naakpɛɛnii.
Oyiŋ ni oto kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ oye ehe anɔkwa.
Oha maŋ lɛ fee koikoi; maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ koikoi; Maŋsɛɛbii amaŋtsɛ we lɛ ekumɔ, ni akuŋ sɛɛ amaŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋ ko ni he wa baawo ohiɛ nyam; ni yiwalɔi amaji lɛ baashe bo gbeyei.
Ejaakɛ otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã ohiafo, otsɔ̃ abobaahe ohã mɔ ni ehĩa yɛ ehĩamɔ be mli.
Otsɔ̃ abobaahe yɛ ahum mli, kɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ latsa be mli; ejaakɛ yiwalɔi amlifu lɛ, etamɔ ahum ni miitswa, loo lamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Shi bo Yehowa, ojɔɔ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ he, ni yiwalɔ lɛ he ejɔ tamɔ bɔ ni atatu jɔɔ jeŋ dɔlɛ he lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ fɔŋ niyenii sɔkɔɔ kɛ wain momo ni adoo nɔ jogbaŋŋ baaŋmɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni yɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ, ebaajie ŋkɔmɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ atatu ni ha majimaji fɛɛ anɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ; eeewo awerɛho ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ muhɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ.
Eeekpãtã gbele hiɛ kɛaatee nanɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ hiɛiaŋ yaafonui fɛɛ.
Ebaafo emaŋ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ sɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ wiemɔ nɛ.
Nakai be lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɛ.
Wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ enɔ akɛ eeehere wɔ.
Yehowa ni wɔhiɛ kã enɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa, ni wɔnyaa yɛ edɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ hewɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Moab toi Yehowa kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ baafã gɔŋ nɛɛ he.
Shi Moabbii lɛ abaanaanaa amɛnɔ tamɔ anaa jwɛi nɔ yɛ bu ni yɔɔ tumo nɔ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Moabbii aaakpã amɛniji amli yɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ serelɔ kpãa eniji amli ekɛsereɔ lɛ.
Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa baaba Moab hewoo kɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ fɛɛ shi.
Ebaakumɔ Moab mɔji grɔŋŋi kɛ ehe gbogboi lɛ; eeekumɔ fɛɛ eshwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ mlu aaaye egbɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baahã emaŋ lɛ aye kunim Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaala lala nɛɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔmaŋ ni wa, Yehowa tswaa kunimyeli tamɔ gbogboi kɛ kawoohei ewoɔ he.
Nyɛgbelea maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ koni maŋ ni emli bii feɔ jalɛnii asaŋ yeɔ anɔkwa lɛ abote mli.
Yehowa ohãa maŋ ni hiɛ kã onɔ lɛ naa toiŋjɔlɛ krɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ bo onɔ amɛhiɛkãa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ afɔa Yehowa nɔ daa ejaakɛ Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, naanɔ tɛsaa ni.
Ejaakɛ eba mɛi ni tara hei grɔŋŋi lɛ ashi; ni maŋ ni kwɔ lɛ, eba lɛ shi, ni ekɛ shikpɔŋ eye egbɔ; ewo lɛ etswa mlu mli.
Mɛi ni aye amɛnɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ, amɛmiinaanaa enɔ agbɛnɛ; ohiafoi miinaanaa enɔ.
Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ, egbɛ jaa hãa lɛ.
Ao, Jalɔ Koome, ohãa jalɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ feɔ trɛtrɛ hãa lɛ.
Yehowa, wɔmiikwɛ bo gbɛ yɛ okojomɔi lɛ amli; wɔmiishwe ogbɛ́i ni kaiɔ wɔ saji lɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ lɛ, misusuma shweɔ bo, mimumɔ ni yɔɔ mimli taoɔ bo kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ ojalɛ saneyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, je lɛ mli bii kɛkaseɔ jalɛ nifeemɔ.
Kɛji ana efɔŋfeelɔi amɔbɔ lɛ, amɛkɛkaseee nɔ ni ja feemɔ; shi moŋ amɛyeɔ saji fɔ̃ji yɛ he ni afeɔ jalɛnii yɛ, ni enaaa Yehowa agbojee lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, owo onine nɔ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnaaa.
Hã amɛna joomɔ ni ojoɔ yɛ omaŋbii ahe lɛ koni amɛhiɛ agboi.
Hã la ni oto hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, oooha wɔna toiŋjɔlɛ ejaakɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni wɔtsu lɛ, bo ji mɔ ni otsu.
Ao Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, nuŋtsɔmɛi krokomɛi ebaye wɔnɔ kɛho; shi bo pɛ ogbɛi lɛ kɛkɛ wɔle.
Amɛgboi, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ; amɛtsɔmɔ sisai ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ogbala amɛtoi, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni akaiŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ao Yehowa, ohá maŋ lɛ eshwere, olɛɛ maŋ lɛ husui amli ni enɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam.
Ao Yehowa, amɛhejaramɔ mli lɛ, amɛtao osɛɛgbɛ; amɛsɔle amɛkpa bo fai be ni ogbalaa amɛtoi lɛ.
Ao Yehowa, bɔ ni yoo ni hiɛ musu kɛ̃mɔɔ ni ebolɔɔ yɛ enɔnaa lɛ mli kɛji fɔ̃mɔ eshɛ shi etã lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔyɔɔ yɛ ohiɛ nɛɛ.
Wɔhiɛ musu, ni wɔmiikɛ̃mɔ; wɔfɔɔɔ gbɔmɔ; shi wɔfɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Wɔnyɛko shikpɔŋ lɛ yiwala wɔhere; wɔnyɛko nɔ ko wɔtsu.
Omɛi ni egboi lɛ ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ aaate shi.
Ao nyɛ su mli bii, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a, ni nyɛlaa kɛ miishɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ obɔ ni nyɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni kpɛlɛɔ ni, ni ooohã gbohii lɛ ate shi.
Mimaŋbii, nyɛbaa!
Mimaŋbii, nyɛbotea nyɛpiai lɛ amli, ni nyɛŋamɔa nyɛshinai lɛ nyɛwoa nyɛyi.
Nyɛtea nyɛhe hiŋmɛitswaa fioo ko kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.
Ejaakɛ, naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛmiijɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ koni ebagbala je lɛ mli bii atoi yɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaajie lá shi ni ashwie yɛ enɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni ehaŋ mɛi ni agbe yɛ enɔ lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.”
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ klante agbo ni naa ba ni wa hu baabamɔ Leviatan, onufu lɔgɔligi lɛ, ni eeegbe ogboole ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛlaa yɛ waintrom fɛɛfɛo lɛ he nyɛkɛa akɛ, “Mi, Yehowa, misaa mli; mishwieɔ enɔ nu be fɛɛ be.
Mibuɔ ehe nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akafite emli nɔ ko.
Mimli fuko.
Eji ŋmeii kɛ kpitikpitii baawo mi naagba kulɛ, mate shi mawo amɛ, ni mibashã fɛɛ tswɛm.
Kɛji miwebii ahenyɛlɔi lɛ miitao mihebuu lɛ, ja amɛbaba mi abo, ni amɛkɛ mi kpãtã.
Hɛɛ!
Ja amɛna amɛkɛ mi kpãtã!” Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel aaatsɛ̃rɛ̃ fãi tamɔ tso, ni Israel aaagba afofro hu, ni eyibii aaayi jeŋ fɛɛ.
Ani Yehowa eyi Israel tamɔ eyi mɛi ni yi Israel lɛ?
Aloo egbe Israel tamɔ egbe mɛi ni gbe Israel lɛ?
Okɛ amɛ ye bɔ ni ja gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnomŋɔɔ nɔ.
Yehowa kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ loo amɛ kɛtee be ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Yakob gbɛlɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ amli tɛi lɛ munyɔmunyɔ tamɔ kaaloo tɛi ni afuflu, ni Ashera wɔŋkoi kɛ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛi bɛ he ko he ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, no nɔ baatsɔ̃ ni akɛ Yakob tɔ̃mɔ lɛ baafa lɛ, ni no aaatsɔ̃ yibii ni etɔ̃mɔkɛfaa lɛ aaawo ahã lɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shihilɛhe ni ashi afɔ shi ni akwa lɛ tamɔ shiaŋa.
Tsinabii miiye nii yɛ jɛi; amɛbumɔɔ shi yɛ jɛi, ni amɛyeɔ nii.
Kɛji emli tsei aniji lɛ gbi lɛ, akumɔɔ ni yei baa ni amɛbalɛɔ akɛ lai kɛyaa, ni amɛyashãa.
Ejaakɛ amɛjeee maŋ ni nuɔ nii ashishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni bɔ amɛ lɛ musuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni enaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ao Israel, nakai gbi lɛ, Yehowa aaahala nyɛ ekomekome kɛjɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyaashi Ijipt husu lɛ nɔ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni miigbee ŋmãa.
Aaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ wulu ko nakai gbi lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni elaaje yɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaba, ni amɛaabaja Yehowa yɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Abɔ Kooyigbɛ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɔkɔ Kpoo hã Israel dãatɔlɔi hewolɔi lɛ!
Kpoo hã Israel anunyam fɔfɔi fɛɛfɛo ni kã ekuɛ lɛ!
Kpoo hã fɔfɔi akekre ni yɔɔ Israel lumɛi ni etɔrɔ kɛ ŋmãa kɛ wain lɛ ayitsei ahe lɛ.
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ hewalɔ kɛ kãkãlɔ ko; etamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ ni miinɛ kɛ ahum ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ; etamɔ nu ni eje ŋa ni eeho boboobo, ni ekɛ ehewalɛ baaloo nibii etswia shi.
Nibii ni Efraim dãatɔlɔi lɛ kɛwulaa amɛhe lɛ akɛ nane aaanaanaa nɔ; ni Efraim lumɛi lɛ anunyam fɛɛfɛo ni ŋalaa lɛ baalaaje tamɔ agbãmi ni shaa etsuɔ dani eshɛɔ etsulɛ be, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana nɔŋŋ lɛ, etseɔ eyeɔ oya.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, aaatsɔ̃ anunyam fɔfɔi kɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo ehã ewebii ni aaashwɛ lɛ.
Eeehã kojolɔ lɛ mumɔ ni hãa ayeɔ jalɛ sane; ni eeewo mɛi ni fãa maŋ agbo lɛ he hewalɛ.
Yesaia kɛ Yuda gbalɔi dãatɔlɔi lɛ wie Wain ehã osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahiɛ miidĩ amɛ; dãa ni wa ehã amɛmiididã.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ miididã kɛ dãa ni wa.
Wain ehã amɛlului, ni amɛmiididãa kɛ dãa ni wa.
Amɛnãaa ninaa kpakpa koni amɛgba pɛpɛɛpɛ; dãa hãaa amɛnyɛ amɛbua sane he jogbaŋŋ.
Amɛshwe amɛkpa okpɔlɔi ni amɛtara sɛɛ lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ; he ko kwraa bɛ ni muji bɛ jɛi.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ kwraa nii ebaatsɔ̃ɔ mɔ, ni namɔ kwraa ebaagbala sane mli etsɔ̃ɔ?
Abifabii ni atse amɛ fufɔ, loo mɛi ni ayahole amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa?
Ebaatsɔ̃ɔ nii bɔ ni mla nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, ni akpɔ nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo lo?” Dabida; shi mɛi ni naa tseee kɛ maŋsɛɛbii anɔ Yehowa baatsɔ̃ ekɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ awie.
Mɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ nɛ.
Nyɛhãa mɛi ni etɔ amɛ anaa hejɔlɛ; ni naa tsuiwoohe, kɛ̃lɛ amɛbooo toi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ “Mla ni nyiɛ mla sɛɛ, kɛ akpɔ ni nyiɛ akpɔ sɛɛ, kɛ liamɔ ni nyiɛ liamɔ sɛɛ, kɛ biɛ fioo kɛ jɛi hu fioo” ahã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛya sɛɛsɛɛ koni amɛyagbeegbee shi ni akumɔ amɛ ni tsɔne adu amɛ ni amɔmɔ amɛ.
Zion Koŋtɛ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhefɛoyelɔi ni yeɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii anɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi!
Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔ kɛ gbele ekpãŋ, ni wɔ kɛ gbohiiaje hu eye efua, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miigwao mɛi kɛmiiho lɛ, ebaŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ amale efee wɔbobaahe, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ teɔ kutumpɔo sɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tɛ ko miima shi akɛ Zion shishitoo tɛ; eji tɛ ni aka akwɛ, koŋtɛ ni jara wa ni ma shi shiŋŋ; ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ehe kpokpoŋ.’ ” Mikɛ jalɛ saneyeli baafee nɔ ni akɛbaasusu shishitoo lɛ, ni mikɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ baafee kpãa ni akɛbaana ejalɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi baaloo amalei ni nyɛkɛfee abobaahe lɛ kɛya, ni nu baafite nyɛteemɔhe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ aaafo nyɛ kɛ gbele teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni bɔ ni nyɛ kɛ gbohiiaje eye efua lɛ sɛɛ baafo, ni kɛji ekpelebii ni naa wa lɛ miiho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ.
Shii abɔ ni ebaaho lɛ, ebaagwao nyɛ ejaakɛ ebaaho daa leebi kɛ daa shwane kɛ daa nyɔɔŋ, ni sane lɛ shishinumɔ lɛ ebaafee gbeyei pam.
Ejaakɛ saatso lɛ baafee kuku tsɔ̃ bɔ ni aaanyɛ mli akpã yɛ nɔ; ni saanɔbo lɛ hu elɛŋ bɔ ni aaanyɛ akota he awo mli.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa aaaho edamɔ shi tamɔ bɔ ni efee yɛ Perazim Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni eeegri tamɔ egri yɛ Gibeon Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni eeetsu enaakpɛɛ nii.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛkafea fɛoyeli dɔŋŋ koni akamia kpãi ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli kpɛŋŋ moŋ; ejaakɛ minu akpɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, wo yɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ he lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Nilee Nyɛboa toi koni nyɛnu migbee; nyɛfea diŋŋ koni nyɛnu nɔ ni mawie lɛ!
Ani okwaafoi ni miitao amɛdu nii lɛ, humɔ lɛ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛhuɔ daa lo?
Aloo shi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛtsaa, ni amɛjwaraa emli kpɔi lɛ?
Kɛji amɛsaa shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ani amɛshwãaa kowɛ, ni amɛduuu sulu?
Ani amɛduuu ŋmãa lɛ srɛnɛɛ kɛ akoko lɛ yɛ gbɛhe ni sa lo?
Ani amɛduuu abele yɛ husui lɛ anɔ lo?
Amɛduɔ, ejaakɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii, ni egbalaa mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Akɛ ŋmãagbeemɔ tso egbeee kowɛ, ni akɛ shwiili nane tsɔ̃ɔɔ sulu nɔ kɛhooo; shi moŋ akɛ tso gbeɔ kowɛ lɛ, ni akɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso gbeɔ sulu lɛ.
Agbɛlɛɔ abele akɛshãa aboloo; agbɛlɛɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa.
Kɛji aha okpɔŋɔi gbala shwiili kɛtsɔ ŋmãa nɔ kɛho blɛoo lɛ, eflɛɛɛ lɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ji mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee nɛɛ hu jɛ.
Enilee yɛ naakpɛɛ, ni ejwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ naakpa.
Yerusalɛm naagbee Ni Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kpoo hã Nyɔŋmɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm diɛŋtsɛ lɛ.
Kpoo hã maŋ he ni David kɛ etabilɔi lɛ to shi yɛ lɛ!
Nyɛyea afi mli gbii juji lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; daa afi lɛ nyɛyea!
Kɛ̃lɛ mi, Nyɔŋmɔ mahã hejaramɔ aba Yerusalɛm nɔ.
Ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ kɛ̃ɛmɔ aaaba maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni Yerusalɛm baayi obɔ̃ kɛ lá tamɔ afɔleshãa latɛ ni lá ewu he kpɔtɔɔ.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni David fee lɛ, mibatua bo, ni mibabɔle ohe kɛkpe, ni mibasa oyi, ni mibatswa kawoo gbogbo mabɔle ohe.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooojɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ owie; owiemɔi lɛ aaajɛ su mli agbɛɛ blɛoo; ogbee aaajɛ shikpɔŋ egbɛɛ tamɔ sisa gbee, ni obaawie ablɛbi kɛajɛ su mli.
“Ohenyɛlɔi gbɔi lɛ ayifalɛ aaatamɔ mlu, ni yiwalɔi lɛ aaafee tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa.
Ni trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi shiimɔ kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ kɛ gbɛɛmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ lasuogbele kɛ ahum kɛ la ni kpãtãa nii hiɛ aaakpɔ̃ bo.
Ni maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ he ni afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mã lɛ wuɔ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebatua lɛ kɛ emɔji ni amɛhaoɔ lɛ lɛ, asane lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ lamɔ̃, tamɔ nyɔɔŋ ninaa kɛkɛ.
Bɔ ni mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ laa ni ena nii eeye, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ hɔmɔ lɛ miiye lɛ lolo, aloo bɔ ni mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ laa ni eenu nu, shi be ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃ lɛ efee gbedee, ni kumai lɛ miiye lɛ lolo lɛ, nakai maji fɛɛ ni kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ wuɔ lɛ asane aaafee.
“Nyɛhãa nyɛhe ajɔ̃a nyɛhe, ni nyɛlua!
Nyɛshwilaa nyɛhe koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa shwilafoi!
Nyɛtɔrɔa dãa, shi jeee kɛ wain; nyɛdidãa, shi jeee kɛ dãa ni wa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã wɔ ni mli tsii mumɔ enyɔ nyɛnɔ.
Nyɛ gbalɔi, Yehowa eŋamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛ ninalɔi, Yehowa kɛ nɔ̃ eha nyɛhiɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahe ninaa lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ wolo ni asɔo naa mli wiemɔi eha nyɛ.
Kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni eeenyɛ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ, ejaakɛ asɔo naa.’ Ni kɛji akɛ wolo lɛ hã mɔ ko ni nyɛŋ ekane, ni afã lɛ akɛ, ‘Kanemɔ wolo nɛɛ’ lɛ, ebaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Minyɛŋ makane.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni maŋbii nɛɛ bɛŋkɛɔ mi kɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛ amɛnaabu kɛkɛ woɔ mi, shi amɛtsui kɛ miteŋ jɛkɛ kwraa, ni jamɔ ni amɛjaa mi lɛ ejeee fɛifɛi fe wiemɔi ni amɛkase amɛwo amɛyitseiaŋ kɛkɛ amɛwieɔ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibafee naakpɛɛ nibii yɛ nɛkɛ maŋbii nɛɛ ahiɛ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe.
Amɛhii nilelɔi lɛ anilee lɛ baafee yaka, ni amɛhii hiɛtɛ̃lɔi lɛ ahiɛtɛ̃ɛ lɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ amɛ.” Wɔsɛɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ Kpoo hã mɛi ni kaa akɛ amɛkɛ amɛyiŋtoi aaatee Yehowa, ni amɛfeɔ dujiaŋnii, mɛi ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ naa wɔ?” loo “Namɔ le wɔ?
lɛ!” Nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nibii ahiɛ nyɛbuɔ shi.
Ani abaaŋɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ akɛ nishɔ̃ɔ su?
Ani nɔ ko ni mɔ ko fee aaanyɛ ekɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni fee nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Jeee lɛ efee mi!” lo?
Aloo nɔ ko ni ashɔ̃ aaakɛɛ yɛ mɔ ni shɔ̃ nɔ lɛ he akɛ, “Eleee nɔ ko?” Te etsɛŋ ni Lebanon koo lɛ baatsɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe ni baa nii, ni aaaŋɔ ŋa nɔ humɔhe lɛ akɛ koo?
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, toimulɔi tete baanu wolo lɛ mli wiemɔi ni shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii anɔ ni ewo duŋ lɛ aaatse, ni amɛaana nii.
Humii baana miishɛɛ hee yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni ohiafoi amli aaafli amɛ yɛ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ yiwalɔi aaatã, ni hefɛoyelɔi asɛɛ aaafo, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni shiɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he kpe lɛ, aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ, mɛi ni hãa mɔ yeɔ fɔ yɛ saneyeli mli, kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ kojolɔ tsɔne yɛ koishi, kɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɔ ni bɛ mli ni no hãa atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sane ja sane hiɛ abuɔ shi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni kpɔ̃ Abraham lɛ kɛɔ yɛ Yakob we lɛ he nɛ, “Agbɛnɛ Yakob we lɛ hiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ eshwieŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji ena ebii lɛ, ni ji mininenaa nitsumɔnii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ Yakob Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛɛlɛŋ, ni amɛaashe Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni mɛi ni duɔ gbɛ yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaana jwɛŋmɔ, ni mɛi ni wieɔ huhuuhu lɛ aaakase nii.”
Akɛ Ijipt kpãŋ yaka Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã bii kaniŋkajelɔi ni yaa ajina ni mi, mibɛ mli, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi ni jeee mitsui naa yiŋtoi ni, ni amɛkɛfeɔ esha amɛshiɔ esha nɔ.
Amɛyiŋ amɛtee Ijipt, be mli ni amɛbiii mi ŋaawoo, koni amɛyaba Ijipt maŋtsɛ abo koni amɛyatao teemɔhe yɛ Ijipt.
Shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi, ni Ijipt abo ni nyɛyaabɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛhiɛ agboi.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ eshɛ Zoan, ni amɛbɔfoi lɛ hu eshɛ Hanes, ni ji Ijipt maji wuji lɛ anɔ nɛ, kɛ̃lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi yɛ maŋbii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hã amɛ lɛ hewɔ; amɛyeŋ amɛbuaŋ amɛ, ni amɛnaŋ amɛhe sɛɛ ko; shi hiɛgbele kɛ ahorabɔɔ moŋ amɛaana.” Kooloi ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ ahe ninaa nɛ, “Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ haomɔ kɛ hejaramɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni jatayoo kɛ jatanuu hũuɔ yɛ, he ni shinɔ kɛ onufu filikilɔ yɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛloɔ amɛnii ni amɛna lɛ amɛtereɔ tejibii ni amɛkɛ amɛjwetrii tereɔ yoomai kɛyaa maŋ ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ kɛha amɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Akɛni Ijipt dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ bɛ fɛifɛi, ni enyɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko etsu hewɔ lɛ, mitsɛɔ lɛ ‘Naafuutsɛ ni etĩii ehe.’ ” Maŋbii toigbolɔi Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa ni oyaŋma yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni oŋma owo wolo mli koni ekã shi akɛ odaseyelinɔ ehã wɔsɛɛ be kɛya naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi atuatselɔi, bii amalelɔi ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ Yehowa toiboo ji amɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ ninalɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkanaa nii’ ni amɛkɛɔ gbalɔi lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛkagbaa anɔkwale gbalɛ nyɛtsɔa wɔ; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ wɔ awiea wiemɔi ni ŋɔɔ; nyɛgbaa shishiumɔ gbalɛi moŋ; nyɛshĩa gbɛ lɛ, nyɛgbaa afã kɛjea tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nyɛ kɛ wɔ akawiea Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he dɔŋŋ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nɔ ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛkwa wiemɔ nɛɛ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ yiwalɛ kɛ kutumpɔo nɔ, asaŋ nyɛshwãa hu nyɛfɔɔ nɔ, hewɔ lɛ nɔsha ni nyɛfee nɛɛ aaahã nyɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo gojoo ni mli egba, ni ekpa, ni eehe egbee shi, ni trukaa hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ eeekumɔ eshwie shi.
Ekuumɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ gbɛ ni ajwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ bɔ ni anaaa eŋɛsuko kome po nɛkɛ kɛkɛ yɛ ekoi lɛ amli ni aaanyɛ akɛje la yɛ latɛ mli, aloo akɛyɛ nu yɛ dudɔ mli tete.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Sɛɛkuu kɛbaa kɛ diŋŋfeemɔ mli nyɛyi aaana wala yɛ; kpoofeemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli nyɛhewalɛ yɔɔ.
Shi moŋ nyɛkwa, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Dabida!
Wɔɔtara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛjo foi.’ No hewɔ lɛ, foi kɛ̃ nyɛaajo.
Ni nyɛkɛɛ hu akɛ ‘Wɔɔtara okpɔŋɔi ni foijee naa wa nɔ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni aaatiu nyɛ lɛ hu afoijee naa baawa.
Gbɔmɔ kometoo yiŋaa naa lɛ, mɛi akpe aaajo foi; nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaajo foi kɛji mɛi enumɔ ŋa nyɛyi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni aaashwɛ mɛi fioo tamɔ aflaŋaa tso ni ma gɔŋ yiteŋ, loo tamɔ aflaŋaa ni ma gɔŋkpɔ yiteŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa miimɛ koni eduro nyɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, efee kralo koni ena nyɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane ni.
Ajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baajɔɔ emɛi lɛ Ao nyɛ Zionbii ni nyɛyɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛwoŋ yara nyɛfoŋ dɔŋŋ.
Emusuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe kɛji nyɛbolɔ nyɛtsɛ lɛ.
Kɛji enu blɔmɔ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ hetoo.
Yɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã amanehulu kɛ haomɔ eba nyɛnɔ moŋ nɛ, shi nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ eteŋ ehe dɔŋŋ, shi nyɛhiŋmɛii aaana nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ.
Ni ninejurɔgbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, abɛkugbɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ jio, nyɛtoii aaanu wiemɔ ko yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ akɛ, “Gbɛ lɛ nɛ, nyɛyia nɔ!” Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaabule nyɛmãgãi ni ashwie he jwiɛtɛi kɛ amãgãi ni ashwie he shika lɛ hu.
Nyɛaashɛrɛ amɛ nyɛshwie tamɔ nibii ni ahe tseee; nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Aloo amɛ ashwie kɛje wɔhiɛ.” Eeehã nu anɛ ashwie nyɛdumɔ wui ni nyɛdu lɛ nɔ, kɛ ŋmãa ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaawo yibii babaoo.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛtsinai lɛ aaaye nii yɛ ŋa ni lɛɛ nɔ, ni nyɛtsinai kɛ tejii ni akɛhuɔ lɛ aaaye nii ni ŋoo yɔɔ mli, ní akɛ sofi kɛ ŋmɔshi faka esha mli.
Ni gbi nɔ ni aaaplene gbɔmɛi babaoo, ni amɛmɔji lɛ aaagbeegbee shi lɛ, faa baaho yɛ gɔji grɔŋŋi fɛɛ kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu tsoɔ, ni hulu aaatso bɔ ni etsoɔ daa lɛ toi kpawo, tamɔ gbii kpawo mli hulutsoo ni abua naa, gbi ni Yehowa aaafimɔ emaŋ lɛ pilamɔi anɔ, ni eeetsa faji ni ewo amɛ be ni etswia amɛ nii lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Asiria toi Naa Yehowa hewalɛ jɛ shɔŋŋ miiba!
Emlifu miitso, ni eeje lasu kpɔŋŋ; enaa miitswa afui kɛ mlila, ni elilɛi tamɔ la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.
Emumɔ ni emuɔ lɛ tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛbata kuɛ, ni ebaakpãtã maji ahiɛ koni ekɛsha amɛmli tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa nii amli lɛ.
Ebaawo majimaji lɛ adaaŋ manyoflɛ koni ekpala amɛ kɛya.
Nyɛaala lala ko tamɔ bɔ ni alaa nyɔɔŋ kɛji aaye gbijurɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛtsui aaayimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ tamɔ mɛi ni aakpã blɛ aahã amɛ, be mli ni amɛnyiɛ kɛyaa Yehowa, ni ji Israel Tɛsaa lɛ, we lɛ.
Ni Yehowa aaahã anu enunyam gbee lɛ, ni eeehã ana ehewalɛ nine ni kpelekeɔ shi lɛ kɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ; la ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ aaatso, ni atatui aaaflɛ, ni nu kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi aaanɛ.
Asiriabii aaayoyoro kɛji amɛnu Yehowa gbee lɛ, be ni ebaatswa amɛ nɔ kɛgbala amɛtoi lɛ.
Bɔ ni miji kɛ saŋkui agbɛɛmɔ nyiɛɔ lɛ, nakai Yehowa baatswa amɛ kpãa kɛgbala amɛtoi.
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Asiriabii lɛ baawu.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ni asaa he ko ato kɛha Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ shãa.
Jɛi kwɔ, ni elɛɛ, ni eyi kɛ la kɛ lai babaoo.
Ni Yehowa mumɔ ni emuɔ ni tamɔ la lɛ baama laii lɛ anaa la.
Nyɔŋmɔ baabu Yerusalɛm he Kpoo hã mɛi ni yaa Ijipt amɛyataoɔ yelikɛbuamɔ ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, mɛi ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ tayaa shwiilii anɔ ejaakɛ amɛfa, kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi hu anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛhe wa naakpa, shi amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ nɔ, loo amɛbiii Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ po!
Tsɛbelɛ, lɛ ji nilelɔ, ni ehãa efɔŋ baa, ni ekpaleee enaa, shi eteɔ shi ewoɔ efɔŋfeelɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ buaa efɔŋfeelɔi.
Ijiptbii lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ; jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji amɛ, ni amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ heloo kɛ lá ni, shi jeee mumɔi ni.
Kɛji Yehowa wo enine nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mɔ lɛ aaatɛ, ni mɔ ni ayeɔ abuaa lɛ lɛ hu aaagbee shi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi nɛ, “Bɔ ni kɛji jata loo jatabi miihũu yɛ emilɛ loo he, ni atsɛ tookwɛlɔi asafo tete awo ehe, ni amɛbolɔmɔ wooo ehe gbeyei, ni ebuuu hoo ni amɛaafee lɛ tete lɛ, nakai Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaaba abawu yɛ Zion Gɔŋ kɛ ehewɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Bɔ ni loofɔji filikiɔ kɛbɔleɔ shi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛbuɔ amɛtsui ahe lɛ, nakai Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, baabu Yerusalɛm he; ebaabu ehe, ni ebaabaa eyi, ekɛ ehe baake lɛ, ni ebaahere lɛ.
“Ao Israelbii, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔ ni nyɛtse ehiɛ atua lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashɛrɛ ejwiɛtɛi amãgãi kɛ eshika amãgãi ni ekɛ eniji fee ni no hã nyɛfee esha lɛ eshwie.
Asiria hiɛ baakpãtã yɛ klante ni jɛɛɛ adesa dɛŋ naa; klante ni jeee adesa ko sɔ̃ baakpãtã ehiɛ, ni ebaajo klante naa foi; ni eblahii lɛ aaanyɛ amɛnɔ koni amɛtsu nii keketee.
Emaŋtsɛ lɛ baajo foi kɛ tsuifãa, ni elumɛi lɛ aaajo foi kɛ hekpokpomɔ amɛshi amɛflaŋaa lɛ.” Yehowa, mɔ ni ajaa lɛ yɛ Zion ni efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli la tsoɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ekɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Anɔkwafo lɛ Naa, maŋtsɛ ko baaba ebaye nɔ; ebaaye jalɛ sane; ni lumɛi hu baaba abaye jalɛ sane.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ teemɔhe be mli ni kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa, loo abobaahe be mli ni ahum miitswa; eeetsɔ̃ tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa nɔ, loo tamɔ tɛsaa kpele hɔ̃ɔŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi ni hiŋmɛi nɔ tse baana nɔ fɛɛ nɔ faŋŋ, ni mɛi hu ni toiiaŋ tse baabo nɔ fɛɛ nɔ toi jogbaŋŋ.
Mɛi ni kulɛ amɛtsuii yɔɔ floflo lɛ aaakase nilee kpakpa, ni mumɔhalɔi awiemɔ mli aaatse pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni amɛlilɛii tɛrɛŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Atsɛŋ kwashia akɛ ablade dɔŋŋ ni shishiulɔ hu abuŋ lɛ oje dɔŋŋ.
Kwashia wieɔ kwashiai awiemɔ, ni nishaianii ahe ejwɛŋɔ, ni enifeemɔ etsɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ; ewieɔ eshiɔ Yehowa.
Ehãaa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ niyenii, ni egbeɔ mɔ ni kumai miiye lɛ kumai.
Shishiulɔ nifeemɔ lɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni; etoɔ efɔŋfeemɔ he ŋaa koni ekɛ amale wiemɔi akpãtã ohiafo hiɛ kɛji ohiafo sane ja tete po lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni ji ablade lɛ, efeɔ abladei anii, ni efãa nɔ kpakpa he hu.
Toigbalamɔ kɛ Shweremɔ ekoŋŋ Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛtea shi, nyɛboa mi toi!
Nyɛ biyei hu ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ̃ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa miwiemɔ lɛ!
Nyɛ yei ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, biɛ afi kɛ nɔ ko fioo mli lɛ, nyɛhe aaakpokpo, ejaakɛ wainyibii aaakpala, ni eko baŋ dɔŋŋ ni aaana atse.
Nyɛ yei ni nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyitsei kãmɔ nyɛyisɛɛ, nyɛhe akpokpoa!
Nyɛkpɔlɔa nyɛtadei koni nyɛnyiɛ yayai koni nyɛkɔlɔa kpekpe nyɛŋmɔlɔ nyɛhɛ.
Nyɛyia nyɛtsitsi nɔ ma yɛ ŋmɔji ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ waintsei ni woɔ yibii pii lɛ ahewɔ; yɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpiti ni aaakwɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Hɛɛ!
Yɛ shĩai ni eyimɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ maji ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ aaajo foi ashi mɔɔ, ni aaashi maŋ ni emli eyi kɛ gbɔmɛi lɛ afɔ̃ shi.
Gɔŋkpɔ kɛ buumɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kooloi abui kɛ ŋaŋ tejii amiishɛɛnamɔhe kɛ toi hu aniyelihe kɛaatee naanɔ.
Be miiba ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaafɔse Mumɔ lɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi eshwie wɔnɔ, ni shiaŋa lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii, ni shikpɔŋ ni baa nii aaatsɔ̃ koo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ abaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni abaafee nɔ ni ja yɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ nɔ.
Jalɛ saneyeli lɛ hesɛɛnamɔ baafee toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ shihilɛ kɛ nyɛmi hemɔkɛyeli.
Mimaŋbii ashihilɛhei baayi kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe kɛ kpoo.
Nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ aaanɛ koo lɛ nɔ, ni ebaatsɔ̃ lakpatsa, ni aaafite maŋ lɛ kwrakwra.
Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛduduu nii yɛ fai fɛɛ atoii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛ tsina kɛ teji he koni amɛyanyiɛ hei ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.
Yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Kpoo hã bo, fitelɔ, bo mɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afiteko bo.
Kpoo hã bo, bo mɔshishinyiɛlɔ ni mɔ ko enyiɛko oshishi.
Kɛji ogbe onifitemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaakpãtã ohiɛ; ni kɛji ogbe mɔshishinyiɛmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, bo hu abaanyiɛ oshishi.
Ao Yehowa, dromɔ wɔ, shi bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ.
Daa gbi lɛ bo ofeɔ wɔhewalɛ kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ yɛ fimɔ be mli.
Kɛji oshi yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, mɛi joɔ foi; ni kɛji owo ohe nɔ lɛ maji gbɛɔ shwãa.
Aaaha nyɛnomŋɔɔnii tamɔ baalabii; ni abaake kɛba onɔ tamɔ otukpɛi.
Awo Yehowa nɔ, ejaakɛ lɛ eyeɔ nii fɛɛ nɔ.
Eeehã Yerusalɛm ayi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ, ni eeehã nyɛyinɔ afee shweshweeshwe, ni eeeduro nyɛ nilee kɛ ŋaa babaoo.
Ninamɔ kpele ji Yehowa gbeyeishemɔ.
Naa, kãkãlɔi lɛ miibolɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ, ni bɔfoi ni bɔ mɔdɛŋ koni toiŋjɔlɛ aba lɛ miifo bloblo.
Gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kã efolo, ni gbɛnyiɛlɔi eyaaa baaa.
Akumɔ kpãŋmɔi amli, ni abuuu fuamɔi ni aye afua, ni abuuu gbɔmɔ adesa ahãaa fɛifɛi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni eeŋala.
Labanon kooŋ tsei ayibii ekpala, ekoi lɛ miigbi.
Sharon jɔɔ shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Bashan kɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ tsei ayibai miikpala.
Yehowa miibɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɔkɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, mibate shi!
Agbɛnɛ mibawo mihe nɔ!
Agbɛnɛ abaawo minɔ!
Nyɛhiɛ tutuu musu, ni nyɛbaafɔ jwɛi; mumɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛgugɔŋ lɛ, la ni, ni no nɔŋŋ baashã nyɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ kaaloo ni ashã; amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmei ni afolɔ ashwie shi ni awoɔ mli la ni ashãa.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mifee lɛ toi, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbɛŋkɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛa mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.” Eshafeelɔi ni yɔɔ Zion lɛ miishe gbeyei, ni mɛi ni sheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ ahe miikpokpo.
Amɛkɛɛmɔ ji, “Wɔteŋ namɔ baanyɛ la naa edamɔ kɛyashi naanɔ?” Mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii, ni ewieɔ nɔ ni ja, mɔ ni nyaaa wieyeli mli nii he, ni eheee nyɔɔŋ nii, mɔ ni tsimɔɔ etoi koni ekanu láshishwiemɔ yiŋtoi ahe, ni eŋamɔɔ ehiŋmɛii koni ekana nɔfɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni baahi gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni tɛsai aaatsɔ̃ mɔji ahã lɛ.
Ebaana nii eye, ni ebaana nu enu.
Wɔsɛɛ shihilɛ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ Okɛ ohiŋmɛii baana maŋtsɛ lɛ he fɛo, kɛ shikpɔŋ ko ni kã shi shwaŋŋ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Kaimɔ kɛkɛ oookai nyɛsɛɛ ko gbeyei ni oshe lɛ.
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane shika lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ŋmɛ too ni aye lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni kane mɔji lɛ yɔɔ?
Onaŋ gbɔmɛi hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ dɔŋŋ, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔ ni wa ni anuuu shishi, ni amɛwieɔ kɛ mumɔhaa ni anuuu shishi lɛ.
Kwɛmɔ Zion, maŋ he ni wɔyeɔ wɔgbii juji lɛ yɛ lɛ!
Ohiŋmɛii aaana Yerusalɛm akɛ toiŋjɔlɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe.
Eyɛ tamɔ buu ni ma shi shiŋŋ, buu ni afamɔŋ ehe shiŋmlitsei lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni ehe taŋkpei lɛ ekoeko tseŋ.
Jɛi Yehowa aaahi yɛ enunyam mli ahã wɔ.
Fai wuji kɛ bibii fɛɛ aaahi jɛi; shi moŋ lɛlɛ agbo ni awiriɔ ko kɛ meele ko nyɛŋ fai lɛ ekoeko mli etsɔ̃ kɛho.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ji wɔkojolɔ, Yehowa ji wɔnɔyelɔ.
Yehowa ji wɔmaŋtsɛ; lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaahere wɔyiwala.
Otaŋkpei lɛ amli egbɔjɔ, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhã shimaatso lɛ ama shi shiŋŋ; amɛnyɛɛɛ abalaa lɛ amɛshi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshwiea amɛnɔ, nyɛhaa amɛnii; nyɛjaa nyɛhãa bɔ ni obubuafoi tete aaana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekɛŋ akɛ, “Mihe miiye.” Akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe eshai aaafa amɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala ehenyɛlɔi atoi Ao nyɛ majimaji, nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa koni nyɛbaboa toi.
Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, nyɛboa toi.
Hã jeŋ muu lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ, je lɛ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ mli afee toi.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa mli efu majimaji lɛ fɛɛ; egri ewo amɛtai lɛ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ nɔ, ni eŋɔ amɛ eha koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Abaashɛrɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ashwie, ni gbohii lɛ aaaje fu, ni amɛlá aaakpa gɔji lɛ anɔ kpɔtɔɔ.
Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii aaasere, ni aaakota ŋwɛi tamɔ wolo.
Amɛtabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaatswiatswia shi tamɔ baa kpalaa yɛ waintso nɔ loo agbãmitso nɔ lɛ.
Yehowa esaa klante lɛ eto yɛ ŋwɛi.
Naa, klante lɛ baayi Edom nɔ, maŋ ni ajɔɔ enɔ aha hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ.
Yehowa klante lɛ amɛlá kɛ fɔ ewu he kpɔtɔɔ; tamɔ too gwantɛŋi kɛ too kpakpoi alá kɛ agbɛnɛ ojwɛnii asabai ahe fɔ ni akɛshã afɔle.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa miishã afɔle yɛ Bozra, ni ebaakpãtã wala hiɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Edom.
Gbɔmɛi baanyɔnyɔi tamɔ wuoi kɛ tsina hii kɛ tsina ajebui.
Lá baakpa amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kpɔtɔɔ, ni amɛshikpɔŋ su baafee ŋɛlɛŋŋ kɛ fɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ ni, be ni ebaaye Zion sane lɛ ehã lɛ koni eto lɛ najiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ lɛ.
Edom fai lɛ baadi tuŋŋ tamɔ kootaa, ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ su aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ swɔɔ.
Eshikpɔŋ tso muu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ kootaa ni miitso.
Ebaatso nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ shwaneshwane fɛɛ, ni ebaaje lasu kɛya naanɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yinɔi fɛɛ; mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ kpokukpokui kɛ kɔtɔkɔi agboshinii; ni patui kɛ kwãakwãalabitei aaahi jɛi.
Yehowa baaha eshikpɔŋ lɛ agbo koni etsɔ̃ olɛŋlɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko ehiŋ nɔ.
Aaawo jɛi akɛ, “Maŋnɔyeli bɛ”, ni akɛ emli lumɛi fɛɛ efeŋ fɛifɛi.
Ŋmei kɛ sansrɔ kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ fɛɛ aaakwɛ̃kwɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛmɔji lɛ kɛ amɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli.
Jɛi aaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe kɛ dugumai hu ahilɛhe.
Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ klãji aaabakpe yɛ jɛi, ni sasabonsami hu aaatsɛtsɛɛ amɛhe yɛ jɛi.
Jɛi nɔŋŋ sisai aaaya koni amɛyatao hejɔɔmɔhe.
Patu aaafee etsu yɛ jɛi, eeeŋmɛ yɛ jɛi ni eeebu nɔ; eeefɛlɛ, ni eeebu ebii lɛ anɔ yɛ hɔ̃ɔŋ mli.
Akromai aaayabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi ekomekome.
Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yehowa wolo lɛ mli koni nyɛkanea.
Kooloi nɛɛ ateŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ ni eyaŋ jɛi, ni eko eko hefatalɔ ebɔŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eje Yehowa naa, ni efã, ni Emumɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni baabua amɛnaa.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ oshiki eha amɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ kɛaatee naanɔ, ni amɛaahi nɔ yinɔi fɛɛ.
Krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ gbɛ Shiaŋa lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ aaanya, shiaŋa lɛ mii aaashɛ ehe ni eeegba afofro tamɔ fɔfɔi.
Shiaŋa lɛ aaagba afofro babaoo, ni emli aaafli lɛ, ni eeenya kɛ lala.
Aaaŋɔ Lebanon anunyam lɛ ahã lɛ, kɛ Karmel kɛ Sharon wulamɔ lɛ hu.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana Yehowa anunyam lɛ, kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ agbojee lɛ.
Nyɛwajea mɛi ni anijiaŋ eje wui lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni anakutseiaŋ egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkɛa mɛi ni tsui fãa lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfea ekãa, nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Naa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ baaba koni ebatɔ nyɛhe owele.
Ebaaba koni ebahere nyɛyiwala.” Kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbele shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni aaagbele toimulɔi hu atoii; obubuafoi aaatumɔ tamɔ ofrote, ni mumuii baala kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ nu aaatue, ni eeeho tamɔ faa yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
Shiaŋa ni enɔ edɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kpaakpo, ni shikpɔŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ baayi obɔ̃ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii.
Ŋaŋgbei ashibumɔhei lɛ baatsɔmɔ hei ni nu tara, ni glã kɛ ntoo aaakwɛ̃ yɛ jɛi.
Gbɛjegbɛ aaakã jɛi, ni aaatsɛ gbɛ lɛ, “Gbɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.” Mɔ ko ni he tseee enyiɛŋ nɔ, ni kwashiai tete eduŋ gbɛ yɛ nɔ.
Jata ko jata ko ehiŋ jɛi; kooloo kakawua ko kwraa tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ, akɛ ja mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛyiwala lɛ kɛkɛ.
Mɛi ni Yehowa ehere amɛ lɛ, aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ nyamɔ lala.
Amɛmii aaashɛ kɛya naanɔ; amɛaayi kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ nyamɔ, amɛyeŋ ŋkɔmɔ, ni amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.
Asiria fã Yerusalɛm tsui Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib fã ta, ni ebatua Yuda maji fɛɛ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, ni eŋɔ maji lɛ.
Asiria maŋtsɛ nɛɛ wo etsulɔnukpa kɛ tabilɔi babaoo gbɛ kɛjɛ Lakish kɛbanina Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Tsulɔnukpa lɛ wa yɛ tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni mamalolɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, yɛ nujɔɔ ni yiteŋgbɛ kpaakpo lɛ mli nu lɛ nyiɛɔ mli lɛ masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni tsuji nɛɛ, Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ shĩa tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, maŋtsɛ we lɛ woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ woji ni aŋmala lɛ anɔ lɛ, je kpo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛtee eŋɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia akɛ, bɔ ni maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɛni po nɔ ohiɛ kã nɛɛ?’ Osusuɔ akɛ naabu wiemɔ kɛkɛ ji ŋaa kɛ hewalɛ ni akɛwuɔ ta lo?
Namɔ po nɔ ohiɛ kã hewɔ ni otse mihiɛ atua nɛɛ?
Ohiɛ kã Ijipt nɔ.
Naa, Ijipt lɛ glã dɛhiɛmɔtso ni eku ni, ni mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ, etsuɔ edɛ̃.
Nakai Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ji hã mɛi fɛɛ ni hiɛ kãa enɔ lɛ.” Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛji oookɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ’, ani jeee lɛ ehei grɔŋŋi kɛ efɔleshãa latɛi lɛ Hezekia kumɔ be ni ekɛɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ koome nɛɛ he nyɛbaaja yɛ lɛ?’ Agbɛnɛ ba koni okɛ minuŋtsɔ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ, abata abasa.
Maha bo okpɔŋɔi akpei enyɔ kɛji obaana bo diɛŋtsɛ omɛi, hii tabilɔi, otara amɛnɔ.
Te ooofee tɛŋŋ onyɛ minuŋtsɔ tsuji, asafoiatsɛmɛi bibii fe fɛɛ, lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome po hiɛ odamɔ be mli ni okɛ ohiɛ efɔ̃ Ijipt tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ lɛ?
Osusuɔ akɛ ba ni miba mibatua shikpɔŋ nɛɛ koni makpãtã hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa fataaa mihe?
Yehowa moŋ ni kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Fãa kɛya koni oyatua shikpɔŋ lɛ ni okpãtã hiɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim kɛ Shebna kɛ Yoa kɛɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, okɛ otsuji awie yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli moŋ, ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ no hu.
Okɛ wɔ akawie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli yɛ maŋbii ni jwere gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ atoiŋ.” Shi tsulɔnukpa lɛ to he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Aso nyɛ kɛ nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ŋɔɔ minuŋtsɔ tsu mi kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ?
Dabida!
Miba maŋbii nɛɛ ni tara gbogbo lɛ nɔ lɛ hu kɛ wiemɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛbaaye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwamɔ ni amɛbaanu amɛshãmɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ ho edamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ waa, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Nyɛboa maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ni ji Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ toi!
Bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ, ejaakɛ enyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ehere.’ Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miihã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ miifɔ Yehowa nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ Yehowa baahere wɔyiwala; atuŋ maŋ nɛɛ awoŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ Nyɛkaboa Hezekia toi.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nyɛjea kpo nyɛbaa koni nyɛ kɛ mi abakpãtãa, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aye ewaintso kɛ egbamitso yibii, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ anu enubu mli nu, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni maba mabaloo nyɛ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni tamɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni abelei kɛ wain yɔɔ nɔ, aboloo kɛ waintromi ashikpɔŋ.
Nyɛkahãa Hezekia miilakaa nyɛ akɛ Yehowa baahere nyɛyiwala.’ Ani jeŋmaji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ eko ehere eshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ pɛŋ?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat kɛ Arpad nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ Sefarwaim nyɔŋmɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Ani amɛhere Samaria yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ?
Te nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ehere amɛshikpɔŋ yiwala kɛje midɛŋ pɛŋ, hewɔ ni Yehowa lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehere Yerusalɛm yiwala kɛjɛ midɛŋ lɛ?” Shi Yerusalɛmbii lɛ etswaaa amɛsɛŋ, ni amɛfooo edaaŋ, ejaakɛ shi ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ewo amɛ ji, “Nyɛkahãa lɛ hetoo ko kwraa.” Kɛkɛ ni Eliakim, Hilkia bi lɛ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ Yoa, Asaf bi lɛ, blema woji ni aŋmala anɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, ba Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ amɛhe atadei ni egbala, ni amɛbagba lɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ wiemɔi lɛ.
Hezekia bi Yesaia dɛŋ ŋaawoo Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia nu sane lɛ, egbala ehe atadei, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni etsu Eliakim, mɔ ni kwɛɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, kɛ Shebna, woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kɛ osɔfonukpai ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe kɛtee Gbalɔ Yesaia ŋɔɔ.
Amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Hezekia kɛɛ nɛ, “Haomɔ kɛ ahorabɔɔ kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ gbi ji ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Wɔtsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eshɛ elagbaŋ, shi ebɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛbaafɔ.
Ekolɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu tsulɔnukpa lɛ, mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu lɛ koni ebaye Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ he fɛo lɛ, wiemɔi lɛ.
Aba mli akɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, enu ahorabɔɔ wiemɔi lɛ, ni ebaagbala mɔ ni wie lɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, sɔlemɔ okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai yɛ wɔmaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahewɔ.” Be ni Maŋtsɛ Hezekia tsuji lɛ ba Yesaia ŋɔɔ lɛ, Yesaia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei yɛ wiemɔi ni onu ni Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ kɛbabɔ mi ahora lɛ hewɔ.
Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ mumɔ ko baawo emli ni aaahã enu sane ko, ni no aaahã eku esɛɛ kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mibahã enyɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ ” Asiria bafã Hezekia tsui ekoŋŋ Asiria maŋtsɛ tsulɔnukpa lɛ ku esɛɛ etee, ejaakɛ enu akɛ emaŋtsɛ lɛ eshi Lakish.
Eyanina Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛ Libna miiwu.
Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ nu akɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ kɛ Kush Maŋtsɛ Tirhaka efã kɛmiiba koni amɛkɛ lɛ abawu.
Be ni enu sane nɛɛ lɛ, Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu bɔfoi kɛ wolo kɛtee Hezekia ŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Hezekia, Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, akɛ, ‘Kaahã oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ohiɛ kã enɔ lɛ miilaka bo akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ yeŋ Yerusalɛm nɔ kunim.’ Bɛ onu nɔ ni Asiria maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ efee shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ, bɔ ni amɛkpãtãa hiɛ butuu lɛ?
Ani osusuɔ akɛ abahere oyiwala?
Majimaji lɛ ni mitsɛmɛi lɛ kpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ, ani amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ehere amɛyiwala?
Ekomɛi ji Gozan kɛ Haran kɛ Rezef kɛ Betlehembii lɛ ni kulɛ amɛhi Telasar lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ Hamat maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Arpad maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Sefarwaim maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Hena maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Iva maŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?” Hezekia he wolo lɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ adɛŋ, ni ekane, kɛkɛ ni eyiŋ kɛtee Yehowa we lɛ, ni eyagbele wolo lɛ mli efɔ̃ Yehowa hiɛ, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “Ao Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ ni omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma kerubim anɔ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hã maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ, bo okoome pɛ obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ao Yehowa, ba otoi shi ni obo toi.
Ao Yehowa, gbɛɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ ni okwɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ lɛ.
Bo wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Sankerib kɛtsu kɛba koni akɛbabɔ bo, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, ahora lɛ toi.
Ao Yehowa, eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ ekpãtã majimaji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛhole maji lɛ anyɔŋmɔi lɛ amɛshɛrɛ amɛshwie la mli ni ashãshãai, ejaakɛ nomɛi lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi kwraa ni, shi moŋ gbɔmɛi aniji anaa nitsumɔnii ni, tso kɛ tɛ ni, ni no hewɔ afite amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Ao wɔNyɔŋmɔ, heremɔ wɔ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛna ale akɛ bo okoome ji Yehowa.” Yesaia kɛ wiemɔ tsu yaha Maŋtsɛ Hezekia Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, kɛ wiemɔ tsu ayahã Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, akɛni okpa mi fai yɛ Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib he hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Sankerib he nɛ, Zion biyoo oblayoo foro, Yerusalɛm ebuuu bo, Sankerib, ehãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Namɔ ahora obɔ, ni asaŋ ojɛ lɛ lɛ?
Namɔ obolɔ owo, ni ogbɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ owo lɛ lɛ?
Mi, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni.
Otsɔ̃ otsuji anɔ, ni obabɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahora, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mikwɔ kɛtee gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, kɛtee Lebanon sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mifolɔ emli tsenedrui ni kwɔlɔ lɛ kɛ emli sɛsɛoi kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Mibote ekoo ni mli ti lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli.
Mitsatsaa bui, ni minu amɛmli nu, ni mikɛ minaneshi hã Ijipt shikpɔŋ nɔ fai fɛɛ tswɛm ŋala.’ “Ani onuko kwraa akɛ mi, mito nibii nakai kɛjɛ blema beebe lo?
Ni nibii ni mito kɛjɛ blema lɛ mihã eba mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ akɛ okpãtã maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe ahiɛ koni amɛtsɔmɔ nii ni akumɔ abua shi kuikui.
Amɛmli bii ahewalɛ eyashɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; amɛtsui fã, ni amɛyoyro, ni amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ ŋa nɔ jwɛi loo bai fɔbii ni etsɛ̃ yɛ tsu yiteŋ ni amɛdaraaa, shi amɛŋalaa oya lɛ.
“Mile oshitee kɛ oshitamɔ, kɛ oyaa kɛ obaa mli fɛɛ, kɛ ogrimɔ ni ogri owo mi lɛ.
Akɛni ogri owo mi, ni minu shwãa ni oshwã lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ kpoŋ baatsɛ̃rɛ ogugɔ mli, ni mikɛ mimanyoflɛ baawo odaaŋ, ni mibakpale bo kɛku osɛɛ kɛya; mikɛ bo baatsɔ̃ gbɛ ni otsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Nɔ ni baaba lɛ he okadi mitoɔ bo nɛɛ: afi nɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋmãa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekwɛ̃; wɔsɛɛ afi hu nakai ŋmãa nɔŋŋ nyɛaaye.
Shi afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛdua nii ni nyɛkpaa, ni nyɛfea waintromii hu, ni nyɛyea amɛmli yibii.
Yudabii ni eshwɛ, ni ji mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ, baashwere tamɔ tsei ni etsɛ̃rɛ fãi kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni amɛwo yibii.
Ejaakɛ eeeshwɛ mɛi kɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aaaje gbele mli.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, hiɛdɔɔ lɛ baatsu enɛ.” “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ he nɛ, ‘Ebaŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni etsɛ̃ŋ gãi kome nɛkɛ tete ewoŋ mli, ni ekɛ etsɛŋ ko baŋ jɛi, ni asaŋ etswaŋ kpoku ko ewoŋ he.
He ni etsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ eeetsɔ̃ kɛaaku esɛɛ kɛaatee; ni eboteŋ maŋ nɛɛ mli.’ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mibabu maŋ nɛɛ he koni mahere eyiwala yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ kɛ mitsulɔ David hu hewɔ.” Yehowa bɔfo ko tee Asiria tabilɔi lɛ ashitoohe lɛ mli, ni eyagbe mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Be ni ate shi leebi maŋkpa lɛ, naa gbɔmɛi lɛ jwere shi ni amɛgboi.
Kɛkɛ ni Asiria Maŋtsɛ Sankerib gbala ehe shi, ni eku esɛɛ etee shĩa, ni eyahi Nineve.
Ni gbi ko pɛ ni etee ejaa yɛ enyɔŋmɔ ni egbɛi ji Nisrok we lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ebihii, Adramelek kɛ Sharezer, kɛ klante gbe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebihii nɛɛ jo foi kɛtee Ararat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni bihii lɛ eko ni egbɛi ji Esa-Hardon lɛ baye Sankerib sɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he ye Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, hela mɔ̃ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia, ni eehe egbo.
Gbalɔ Yesaia, Amoz bi lɛ, tee eyasara lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Too owe lɛ he gbɛjianɔ, ejaakɛ oyi naŋ wala; obaagbo.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia tsɔ̃ ehiɛ eha gbogbo lɛ, ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa fai, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Yehowa, miikpa bo fai, kaimɔ bɔ ni misɔmɔ bo kɛ anɔkwa kɛ mitsuiŋ fɛɛ, ni mifee nɔ ni hi yɛ ohiɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Hezekia fo blobloblo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yesaia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa, otsɛ David Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ: Minu ofaikpamɔ lɛ, ni mina oyaafo lɛ; maŋɔ afii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ mafata owala be lɛ he.
Asaŋ mahere bo kɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ yiwala kɛjɛ Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.
Ni mabu maŋ nɛɛ he.’ ” Yesaia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia akɛ eŋɔ agbãmi ni awiɛ eto esane lɛ nɔ, ni ehe baawa lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Yesaia akɛ, “Mɛɛ okadi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ manyɛ maya Yehowa we lɛ ekoŋŋ?” “Enɛ ji okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ bo akɛ mibafee nii ni mikɛɛ lɛ.
Naa, mibahã atrakpoi lɛ asusuma ni hulu ni nyɔɔ shi hãa ebakãa atswere ni Maŋtsɛ Ahaz tswa lɛ nɔ lɛ atsi kɛya sɛɛsɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.” Kɛkɛ ni susuma lɛ tsi kɛtee sɛɛ nanefaamɔi nyɔŋma.
Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eŋma yijiemɔ lala nɛɛ: Misusu akɛ miwala teŋ tuuŋtu lɛ, mashi kɛya gbohiiaje agboi lɛ anaa, mayaye mifii ni eshwɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Misusu akɛ minaŋ Yehowa dɔŋŋ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Minaŋ gbɔmɔ adesa ko hu dɔŋŋ yɛ jeŋ.
Afo miwala sɛɛ tamɔ akpaa tookwɛlɔ buu ni ashi, tamɔ mamalolɔ kotaa ni efoɔ mama nɔ yɛ mamaloo tsɔne nɔ.
Gbi kome jenamɔ lɛ miwala sɛɛ efo.
Mifo mitsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ.
Ojwara miwui amli tamɔ jata, Ofo miwala sɛɛ gbi kome jenamɔ.
Mibolɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte loo kpokukpoku; miye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpo.
Ŋwɛikwɛmɔ sɔŋŋ hã mihiŋmɛii shiu.
Ao Yehowa, efĩ mi, daamɔ mli oha mi.
Te makɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ ekɛ mi ewie; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efee nɔ ni ba lɛ.
Ehiii mi wɔɔ, ejaakɛ misusuma miiye awerɛhoo.
Ao Nuŋtsɔ, enɛɛmɛi anɔ adesai tsɔ̃ɔ amɛhiɔ shi; ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ amli mimumɔ yɔɔ.
Ao tsa mi, ni oha miyi ana wala.
Naa, mijurɔyeli hewɔ jɛ ni mina hejaramɔ babaoo lɛ, Ojie miwala kɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, ejaakɛ osherɛ mihe eshai lɛ fɛɛ oshwie osɛɛ.
Gbohiiaje ejieŋ oyi, ni gbele hu kafoŋ bo; gbohii eŋɔŋ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔŋ onɔkwayeli lɛ nɔ.
Hiɛkãalɔi hɛɛ, hiɛkãalɔi moŋ ji mɛi ni jieɔ oyi, tamɔ bɔ ni mifeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Tsɛmɛi ni hãa bii leɔ onɔkwayeli lɛ.
Yehowa ohere miyiwala, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ saŋku aaala milalai lɛ, wɔwala gbii abɔ fɛɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Tsuji ni jɛ Babilon lɛ Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ, Merodak-Baladan, Baladan bi lɛ, tsu tsuji koni amɛkɛ woji ni eŋmala kɛ nikeenii baha Hezekia, ejaakɛ enu akɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia he eye, ni ehe ewa lɛ.
Hezekia here tsuji lɛ atuu, ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛtee shĩa ni etoɔ ejwetri yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni ekɛ jɛi nii yatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ: jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mu ni jara wa kɛ etawuunii fɛɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ enitoohei lɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ enitoohei loo enɔyelihe lɛ mli ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Yesaia ba Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ŋɔɔ, ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ jɛ ba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛɛ amaniɛ amɛkɛba?” Hezekia here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Shɔŋŋ he ko amɛjɛ amɛba miŋɔɔ nɛɛ; amɛjɛ Babilon.” Yesaia tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mɛni amɛna yɛ owe lɛ?” Hezekia ha hetoo akɛ, “Amɛna nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ mli; nɔ ko nɔ ko kwraa bɛ minitoohei lɛ amli ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesaia kɛɛ Hezekia akɛ, “Bo nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ toi, ‘Naa gbii miiba, ni abaaloo nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ owe lɛ mli kɛ nii ni otsɛmɛi lɛ ebua naa eto kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ kɛaatee Babilon bɔ ni ashiŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, Yehowa kɛɛ.
Asaŋ aaaŋɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ obii ni ooofɔ lɛ ateŋ ekomɛi kɛaatee, ni amɛaatsɔmɔ piafoi yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.” Hezekia to he ha Yesaia ekɛɛ, “Yehowa naa wiemɔ ni owie nɛɛ hi,” ejaakɛ esusu akɛ elumɔyeli be lɛ baafee shweshweeshwe kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ Wiemɔi “Nyɛshɛjea, nyɛshɛjea mimaŋ lɛ mii!” WɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
“Nyɛkɛ Yerusalɛmbii awiea tsuijurɔ naa; ni nyɛkɛa Yerusalɛmbii akɛ amɛtawuu be lɛ sɛɛ efo, ni akɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ efa.
Eshai ni amɛfee lɛ amɛna he nyɔmɔwoo toi enyɔ kɛjɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.” Gbee ko miibo akɛ, “Nyɛsaa gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛjajea gbɛjegbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ nyɛhãa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Awó jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ nɔ, ni aba gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ shi; Ahã hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ, ni hei ni yɔɔ gɔjigɔji lɛ afee kplanaa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ abaajie Yehowa anunyam kpo, ni gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ baana, ejaakɛ enɛ jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ naa.” Gbee ko miibo akɛ, “bolɔmɔ!” Ni mikɛɛ, “Te mibolɔ mikɛɛ tɛŋŋ?” “Bolɔmɔ akɛ heloo fɛɛ heloo lɛ jwɛi ni; ni ehoɔ eyaa tamɔ ŋa nɔ fɔfɔi.
