Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kpalaa kɛji Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ tswa kɛtsɔ̃ nɔ.
Eji anɔkwale akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ jwɛi ni.
Jwɛi gbiɔ, ni fɔfɔi hu kpalaa shi wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.” Ao Zion, miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, kwɔɔ kɛya gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ.
Yerusalɛm, miishɛɛ saneshiɛlɔ, wo ogbee nɔ kɛ hewalɛ, wo nɔ, kaashe gbeyei!
Kɛɛmɔ Yuda maji lɛ akɛ “Naa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miiba!” Naa, Nuŋtsɔ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ miibaa kɛ hewalɛ, ni eeeye nɔ kɛ nineshiwalɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛmiiba.
Eeelɛ etooku lɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ; eeehiɛ etoobii lɛ yɛ ekpɔkɔiaŋ; Eeeloo amɛ eshãkã etsitsiŋ ni eeekpala toonyɛmɛi lɛ blɛoo.
Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ saso bɛ Namɔ kɛ edɛ̃ kɔkɔ esusu ŋshɔ falɛ pɛŋ; ni ekɛ edɛ̃lɛɛmɔ esusu ŋwɛi dã?
Namɔ kɛ nikaakpolu eka shikpɔŋ su pɛŋ, ni eŋmɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ ŋmeŋmei lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli dã?
Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ bɔ ni efee dã, loo namɔ etsɔ̃ eŋaawolɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii dã?
Namɔ Yehowa kɛtoɔ ajina bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii, ni namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ jalɛ saneyeli?
Namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nilee pɛŋ; namɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sanesɛɛkɔmɔ dã?
Naa, majimaji lɛ tete tamɔ nu kɔi kome yɛ goga mli ha Yehowa, ebuɔ amɛ tamɔ nsɛni he mlu.
Ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ tamɔ mlu kulibii yɛ ehiɛ.
Lebanon kooloi lɛ afalɛ lɛ efaaa ha shãa afɔle, ni emli tsei shɛɛɛ lai ni akɛshãa afɔle.
Majimaji lɛ fɛɛ jeee nɔ ko nɔ ko, yɛ ehiɛ, ni ebuɔ amɛ akɛ yakanii, ni amɛjeee fɛifɛi hu yɛ ehiɛ.
Belɛ namɔ nyɛkɛaato Nyɔŋmɔ he, ni mɛni yɔɔ su ni tamɔ esu?
Amãgã?
No lɛ ŋaalɔ ni shwieɔ, ni shikaŋaalɔ kɛ shika haa he; ni esɔ̃ɔ jwiɛtɛi kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi ewoɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ jwiɛtɛi loo shika lɛ, eŋɔɔ tso ni wa, ni etaoɔ ŋaalɔ ni he esa, ni egbɔɔ amãgã ni nyɛɛɛ ehe etsi.
Ani nyɛleee?
Ani nyɛnuko dã?
Ani agbako nyɛ je lɛ shishijee sane?
Ani nyɛnuko bɔ ni ato eshishi ahã?
Mɔ ni ta emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ yɛ je lɛ yiteŋ, yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ ni enaa je lɛ mli gbɔmɛi tamɔ agãi pɛ lɛ, lɛ efee, mɔ ni kpa ŋwɛi mli eha shi tamɔ muhɔɔ, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli tamɔ buu ni ahiɔ mli lɛ.
Lɛ ehãa lumɛi feɔ shwɛm, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɔyelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ yaka nɔ ko.
Amrɔ pɛ ni aaatɛo amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni aaadu amɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni amɛaatsɛ̃ fã yɛ su mli lɛ, Yehowa tswaa kɔɔyɔɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛŋalaa, ni ahum loɔ amɛ kɛyaa tamɔ tutuu.
Namɔ nyɛkɛaato mi mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ?
Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ.
Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi ni nyɛkwɛa!
Namɔ bɔ ŋulamii nɛɛ?
Lɛ mɔ ni ejieɔ amɛsafoi lɛ kpo, ni ekaneɔ amɛyibɔ, ni ewoɔ amɛ fɛɛ gbɛi lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni fee.
Ehewalɛ kpele kɛ enyɛmɔ naa lɛ, amɛteŋ ekome folo nɛkɛ elaajeee.
Ao Israel, mɛɛba okɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa leee mihaomɔi, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kwɛɛɛ koni aye mi jalɛ sane” lɛ?
Ani oleee?
Ani onuko dã Yehowa ji naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔlɔ lɛ.
Etɔɔɔ lɛ, ni egbɔjɔɔɔ hu, ni aleee ejwɛŋmɔ mlikwɔlɛ.
Ehãa mɔ ni egbɔjɔ naa hewalɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ, ehãa lɛ nyɛmɔ ni mli wa.
Oblahii bibii aaagbɔjɔ, ni eeetɔ amɛ; ni oblahii ni edara saŋŋ tete aaagbeegbee shi, ni amɛaafee bliboo.
Shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ lɛ, amɛaana hewalɛ hee: amɛaafliki tamɔ okropɔŋ amɛaajo foi, ni etɔŋ amɛ amɛaanyiɛ hu, ni amɛgbɔjɔŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ: “Ao nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea diŋŋ, nyɛboa mi toi!
Majimaji anɔ bii ana hewalɛ hee!
Hã amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ koni amɛwie amɛsane lɛ.
Nyɛhãa wɔ fɛɛ wɔkpea koni wɔkojoa!
Namɔ ji mɔ ni tee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ, mɔ ni yeɔ kunim yɛ he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ?
Namɔ hãa eyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ majimaji anɔ lɛ?
Ekɛ eklante lɛ hãa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ mlu, ni egãi lɛ gbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa tamɔ tutuu yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ hiɛ.
Enyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ, ni ehoɔ amɛhe shweshweeshwe ni enane esaaa shikpɔŋ tete.
Namɔ tsu enɛ, ni namɔ fee enɛ?
Namɔ tsɛɔ yinɔbii kɛjɛɔ jeŋ shishitoohe tɔ̃ɔ?
Mi, Yehowa, mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ; ni mi, Yehowa, mi kɛ naagbee mɔ aaafee naagbelɔ.
Ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ ena, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ miikpokpo!
Amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ, ni amɛba.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miiye miibua enaanyo.
Amɛmiikɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Na tsui.’ Kapintafonyo woɔ shikaŋaalɔ ekãa, ni mɔ ni kɛ hamle jajeɔ nii ahiɛ lɛ hu feɔ mɔ ni tswiaa nii yɛ sɔ̃ŋmɛtɛ nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ekɛɔ yɛ nii ni asɔ̃ɔ lɛ he akɛ ‘Ehi!’ Ni amɛkalaa mli plɛkoo koni ekakpɔ!
Shi bo Israel, mitsulɔ Yakob, mishieŋtsɛ Abraham shwie, ni miŋɔ bo; bo ni miŋɔ bo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba, bo ni mitsɛ bo kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ koji shɔŋŋ, ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Mitsulɔ ji bo, miŋɔ bo; ni mishɛŋ bo mifɔŋ.’ Kaashe gbeyei, shi mi mi kɛ bo yɔɔ; kaakwɛkwɛɛ ohe ejaakɛ mi ji oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!” Mibawaje bo, mibaye mabua bo; mibahiɛ omli kɛ mikunimyeli ninejurɔ lɛ!
“Naa, mɛi fɛɛ ni mli efu bo lɛ, ahiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi!
Mɛi ni kɛ bo tswaa lɛ, aaafee shwɛm, ni amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Obaatao mɛi ni kɛ bo ena lɛ, shi onaŋ amɛ; mɛi ni kɛ bo wuɔ lɛ aaafee shwɛm.
Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mihiɛ oninejurɔ mli.
Mi, mikɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei, mibaye mabua bo lɛ.’ ” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, bo gɔgɔmi Yakob!
Kaashe gbeyei, bo Israel, gɔgɔmi bibioo!
Miikɛɛ bo akɛ maye mabua bo!
Okpɔlɔ lɛ ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Naa, mibafee bo gbɛlɛmɔ tsɔne kɛ enyanyɔji hei ni naa ba; ni obaagbɛlɛ gɔji lɛ, ni oooshimɔ amɛ muɛmuɛ, ooohã gɔŋkpɔi lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ tutuu.
Ooosha amɛmli ni kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee, ni ahum aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã.
Shi bo lɛ, omii aaashɛ ohe yɛ Yehowa hewɔ, ni oooshwã ofɔ̃ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” “Kɛji ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ ye nu he kumai, shi nu bɛ, ni amɛlilɛii anɔ gbi kɛ kumai lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mibabo amɛ toi, kɛji amɛtsɛ mi.
Mi, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikwaŋ amɛ.
Mibahã fai aho yɛ gɔŋ kpataai anɔ, ni nuhiŋmɛii baatsɛ̃rɛ yɛ nujɔi lɛ amli, Mahã kpaakpo abua shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli, ni nu baaho yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ nɔ.
Mahã tsenedru kɛ yɔɔyi kɛ mirtotsei kɛ mu tso akwɛ̃ yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Mibatɛo sɛsɛo kɛ papao kɛ wawa koni amɛtsɔ̃ koo yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Ni mɛi baana, ni amɛaasusu he, ni amɛaanu shishi, ni amɛaale akɛ Yehowa ninenaa nitsumɔ ni, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji mɔ ni fee.” Yehowa tswa amale nyɔŋmɔi lɛ mpoa Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nyɛsane lɛ abaa, nyɛ jemawɔji!” Yakob Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nyɛklamɔ nibii lɛ abaa koni amɛgba nɔ ni baaba amɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ blema nibii lɛ, nɔ ni amɛ ji, koni wɔsusu he, koni wɔle nɔ ni baajɛ mli aba, aloo nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛgbaa wɔ nibii ni baaba lɛ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a wɔ wɔsɛɛ nibii ni baaba koni wɔkɛna wɔle akɛ nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ.
Nyɛfea nɔ kpakpa loo nɔ fɔŋ ko koni wɔtsui afã ni wɔshe gbeyei.
Naa, nyɛjeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi.
Mɔ ni jaa nyɛ lɛ, musubɔlɔ ni.
“Mitee mɔ ko shi kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ, ni eeba; eeeja mi kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli, ni eeenaa nɔyelɔi anɔ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ naa su.
Namɔ gba kɛjɛ shishijee mli koni wɔle?
Ni namɔ tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba dani eba mli, koni wɔkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ewiemɔ lɛ ja.’ Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni lɛ ekɛɛ; mɔ ko kwraa ejajeko nɔ ko; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni nuɔ nyɛwiemɔ lɛ.
Mi tsuutsu mikɛɛ Zion akɛ, “Mitsu bɔfo kɛ sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ kɛtee Yerusalɛm akɛ ebii miiba.
Shi be ni mikwɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ, ŋaawolɔ ko bɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ ni kɛji mibi lɛ sane ko ni eeehã mi hetoo.
Naa, nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, lakamɔnii ni; amɛnitsumɔi lɛ hu jeee fɛifɛi, ni amɛmãgãi lɛ hu kɔɔyɔɔ folo ni.”
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Tsulɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mitsulɔ, mɔ ni mihiɛ emli, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ, ni minaa ehe tsuijurɔ lɛ.
Mihã eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, Ebaahã majimaji lɛ ale nɔ ni ji jalɛ saneyeli.
Ebolɔŋ, ni ewoŋ egbee nɔ, ni ehaŋ anu egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.
Glã ni edɔ lɛ, ekuŋ, ni kane ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ; eeejie jalɛ kpo anɔkwayeli mli.
Enitsumɔ naa baŋ shi, ni enijiaŋ ejeŋ wui kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ saneyeli amã shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ miikwɛ emla gbɛ.” Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ji Yehowa lɛ, mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekpã mli, mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ elɛɛ shi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ, mɔ ni hãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mumɔ, kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ nɔ lɛ wala lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa; mi mitsɛ bo yɛ jalɛ naa.
Mimɔ onine mli, ni mibaa oyi; miŋɔ bo mifee kpãŋmɔ mihã maŋ lɛ kɛ la hã majimaji lɛ, koni ogbele shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii, ni ojie gboklɛfoi yɛ gboklɛfoi atsuŋ; koni ojie gboklɛfoi ni tara kpabuŋ duŋ mli lɛ.
“Mi, mi ji Yehowa, migbɛi ji no; mikɛ minunyam haŋ mɔ kroko, ni mikɛ miyijiemɔ haŋ amãgãi.
Naa, tsuutsunii ni migba lɛ eba mli; agbɛnɛ nii hee mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ; miikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli.” Yijiemɔ Lala Nyɛlaa lala hee nyɛhãa Yehowa; nyɛlaa nyɛkɛjiea eyi kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ!
Nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ; nyɛjiea eyi, nyɛ ŋshɔ mli bɔɔnii fɛɛ!
Nyɛlaa, nyɛ ŋshɔ naa shikpɔji, ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ ŋshɔ naa shikpɔji lɛ anɔ hu, nyɛjiea eyi!
Nyɛhãa shiaŋa lɛ kɛ enɔ maji lɛ ahole amɛgbei anɔ; nyɛhãa mɛi ni yɔɔ Kedar akrowai lɛ ajiea eyi!
Nyɛhãa mɛi ni yɔɔ Sela maŋ wulu lɛ mli lɛ alaa nyamɔ lala; nyɛhãa amɛbɔa oshe kɛjɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ.
Nyɛhãa amɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam, ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli.
Yehowa efã tamɔ tabilɔ; etee emlifu shi tamɔ kãkãlɔ.
Eebo waa; eebɔ oshe!
Eetsɔ̃ɔ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ ehewalɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ wo shi akɛ ebaaye ebua ewebii Mimua minaa be kplaŋŋ nɛ, mifee dioo; migbe mitsui.
Shi agbɛnɛ mibabolɔ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ; mamu kɛ tsuisuu, mimumɔ shiŋ shi.
Makpãtã gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnɔ jwɛi fɛɛ agbi, mahã fai atsɔ̃mɔ faakpɔi, ni mahã kpaakpoi hu amii.
Ni makpala shwilafoi kɛtsɔ̃ tɛmpɔŋi ni amɛtsɔ̃ko nɔ dã nɔ; mabu amɛhe kɛtsɔ̃ nanegbɛ ni aleee nɔ.
Mahã amɛhiɛ duŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ la, ni hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi lɛ afee trɛnɛɛ.
Nii nɛɛ mafee mahã amɛ, ni mikwaŋ amɛ.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔɔ amãgãi anɔ, ni amɛkɛɔ amãgãi ni ashwie lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ ji wɔnyɔŋmɔi lɛ,” aaashwie amɛ kɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Israel nyɛɛɛ nii ekase Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ toimulɔi, nyɛboa toi!
Ni nyɛ shwilafoi, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ koni nyɛna nii!
Namɔ eshwila tamɔ mitsulɔ lɛ, ni namɔ emu toi tamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ?
Namɔ eshwila tamɔ mɔ ni ajɔɔ enɔ ahã mi lɛ?
Namɔ eshwila tamɔ Yehowa tsulɔ lɛ?
Israel, ona nibii babaoo, shi otɛ̃jeee ohiɛ okwɛɛɛ amɛ.
Otoii anaa kã nɛ, shi onuuu nii.” Esa Yehowa hiɛ, yɛ ejalɛ lɛ hewɔ akɛ egbala mla lɛ mli koni ehã mla lɛ hiɛ aba nyam.
Shi emaŋbii lɛ aju amɛ, ni aha amɛ, ni amɔmɔ amɛ awo bui amli, ni aŋɔ amɛ atee gboklɛfoi atsuiaŋ; amɔmɔ amɛ ni jielɔ ko bɛ he ko ni mɔ ko hu bɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Akɛ amɛnii ni aha lɛ ahã amɛ”.
Nyɛteŋ namɔ baabo enɛ toi, namɔ eka etoi koni enu nii ni baaba lɛ?
Namɔ ŋɔ Israel ehã nihalɔ lɛ; ni namɔ ŋɔ Yakob ehã ojotswalɔi lɛ?
Ani jeee Yehowa?
Mɔ ni wɔfee esha wɔshi lɛ, mɔ ni wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ, ni wɔbooo emla lɛ toi lɛ ni?
No hewɔ lɛ, efɔse emlifu ni naa wa lɛ eshwie wɔnɔ, ni ehã wɔna ta joomɔ.
Eshɛre la ewo wɔhe kpula, shi wɔnuuu shishi, eshã wɔ, shi no gbaaa wɔnaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ baahere emaŋbii lɛ Shi agbɛnɛ Yakob, bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.
Ao Israel, bɔ ni mɔ ni shɔ̃ bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei ejaakɛ makpɔ̃ bo.
Mikɛ ogbɛi etsɛ bo; mi, minɔ ji bo!
Kɛji oofo faa ni mli kwɔ lɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ; ni oofo faa hu nu lɛ esuŋ bo; Kɛji onyiɛ la mli lɛ, eshaŋ bo, ni lalilɛi lɛ kpãtãŋ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, oYiwalaherelɔ lɛ.
Miŋɔ Ijipt miha akɛ okpɔmɔnii; miŋɔ Kush kɛ Sheba miha mikɛtsake bo.
Akɛni ojara wa ha mi, ni ohiɛ yɛ nyam, ni misumɔɔ osane hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ gbɔmɛi maha yɛ onajiaŋ ni maŋɔ majimaji maha kɛtsake bo.
Kaashe gbeyei, ejaakɛ mi mikɛ bo yɔɔ.
Maŋɔ oshwiei kɛaajɛ bokã kɛba, ni mabua onaa kɛaajɛ anai.
Makɛɛ kooyigbɛ akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛɛmɔ amɛhe!’ Ni makɛɛ wuoyigbɛ akɛ, ‘Kaatsi amɛnaa;’ ŋɔɔ mibihii lɛ kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ kɛ mibiyei lɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei kɛba, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ mi, migbɛi awo lɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi, mibɔ lɛ, koni ehã mihiɛ aba nyam lɛ.” Israel ji Yehowa odasefonyo Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Tsɛ mimaŋbii lɛ kɛba kojomɔ.
Amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii, shi amɛnuuu nii.
Ha majimaji fɛɛ naa abakpe ni gbɔmɛi fɛɛ abua amɛhe naa.
Te amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni aaanyɛ agba nɔ ni baa hu?
Te amɛteŋ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ egba nɔ ni yaa nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ?
Amɛhã amɛdasefoi lɛ aba amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ koni abu amɛ bem; asaŋ amɛbaye odase akɛ amɛwiemɔ lɛ eba mli anɔkwaleŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, nyɛ ji midasefoi, mɛi ni miŋɔ akɛ mitsuji koni nyɛle mi ni nyɛhe mi nyɛye, ni nyɛnu shishi akɛ, mi, mi koome ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Mi, misɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ; eko bako dã ni ekoeko baŋ hu.
“Mi, mi nɔŋŋ mi ji Yehowa lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛɛ nɔ ni baaba mito, ni mibahere nyɛyiwala Maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko efeko nakai dã; nyɛ ji midasefoi.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mi ni.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ ashɔ̃ mɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ.
Kɛji miifee nɔ ko lɛ, namɔ aaanyɛ naa atsi?” Israel je Babilon dɛŋ Bɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔlɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛ, nyɛhewɔ lɛ, mibatsu ta kɛya koni eyatua Babilon.
Mibakumɔ amɛgboi lɛ fɛɛ mashwie shi, ni Babilonbii anyamɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ awerɛhoo.
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛMɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛMaŋtsɛ, mɔ ni bɔ Israel lɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Be ko lɛ Yehowa gba gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; egba tɛmpɔŋ kɛtsɔ̃ nu hamahama mli.
Ekpala ta kpele kɛtee hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, tawuu shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔi babaoo.
Amɛjwere shi, amɛnyɛŋ shi amɛte dɔŋŋ; amɛgboi tamɔ kane mli odonti.” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea nyɛjwɛŋmɔ yɛ tsutsu saji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkahiɛa blema nibii lɛ amli.
Naa, mibafee nɔ ko hee ko.
Amrɔ nɛɛ po epue.
Aso nyɛnaaa lo?
Mibaje gbɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ mli, ni mahã faa atue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
Ŋaŋkooloi tete aaawo mihiɛ nyam, ŋaŋ gbei kɛ okpɔŋɔ loofɔji fɛɛ, ejaakɛ mahã nu aba ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni fai hu baatue yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, koni mimaŋ, mɛi ni mihala lɛ, ana nu amɛnu.
Koni mɛi ni mibɔ mihã mihe lɛ ajie miyi.” Israel fee esha Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israel, ojaaa mi!
Israel, ogbaaa ohe naa yɛ mihe!
Okɛ otoo lɛ ebahãaa mi koni akɛshã shãaafɔle; ni okɛ oshãa afɔlei lɛ wooo mihiɛ nyam.
Mikɛ niyenii afɔle gbako onaa, ni mihãaa etɔ bo kɛ krɔbɔohamɔ.
Okɛ oshika heee tsofakɛŋma obahãaa mi; ni okɛ okooloi amli fɔ lɛ ebashɛjeee mimii.
Moŋ okɛ ohe eshai lɛ ehao mi, ni okɛ onishaianii lɛ eha etɔ mi.” “Kɛ̃lɛ mi, mi nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋɔɔ ohe eshai lɛ efaa, yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, ni mikaiŋ ohe eshai lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Kaimɔ mi.
Ha ni wɔkojo.
Jajemɔ osane lɛ akɛ aaabu bo bem lo!
Oklɛŋklɛŋ tsɛ fee esha, ni mɛi ni damɔɔ mli hãa bo lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ.
Mikɛ Israel hã ni akpãtã ehiɛ, Israel he guɔ gbo.”
Yehowa kome pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao mitsulɔ Israel, Yakob shwiei, miwebii ni mihala, nyɛboa toi agbɛnɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ bo, mɔ hu ni shɔ̃ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe, ni ebaaye ebua bo lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Kaashe gbeyei, mitsulɔ Yakob, miwebii ni mihala, ni misumɔɔ, Ejaakɛ mibanɛ nu mashwie shikpɔŋ ni yeɔ nu kumai nɔ, ni mahã fai atue yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mahã oshwiei ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mimumɔ lɛ, ni mijɔɔmɔ aaahi oshwiei anɔ.
Amɛaakwɛ̃ tamɔ jwɛi ni ena nu, tamɔ faa toi ŋɔi.
Mɔnɛ baakɛɛ mɔnɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa nɔ ji mi;’ ni mɔ kroko aaaŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi awo ehe, ni mɔ ko hu aaaŋma yɛ enine he akɛ, ‘Yehowa nɔ nɛ’, ni eeeŋɔ Yehowa gbɛi ewo ehe.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel maŋtsɛ, Israel Kpɔlɔ, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ kɛ naagbee mɔ; kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Namɔ kɛ mi ye egbɔ?
Ha mɔ lɛ akɛɛ, ha ejaje yɛ mihiɛ.
Kɛjɛ blema, namɔ egba nii ni nyiɛ gbɛ kɛbaa dã.
Amɛgba wɔ nii ni baaba hu.
Nyɛhe akakpokpoa ni nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Ani jeee blema beebe mijɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛnu kɛjɛ minaa?
Nyɛ ji midasefoi!
Ani misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ?
Tɛsaa ko bɛ he ko he ko, mileee eko.” Jwɛŋmɔ bɛ amãgãjamɔ mli Mɛi ni feɔ amãgã bɛ nɔ ko mli, ni nibii ni amɛnaa he miishɛɛ lɛ ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Mɛi ni jaa amãgãi nɛɛ lɛ eshwila, ni amɛleee nii, ni aaawo amɛ hiɛgbele.
Namɔ hu gbaa ehe naa efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ aloo eshwieɔ amãgã ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ?
Naa, amɛjalɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ aaagboi.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi lɛ, adesai kɛkɛ ji amɛ.
Hã amɛ fɛɛ amɛbabua amɛhe naa; hã amɛ jie amɛhiɛ; amɛbaakpokpo, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi.
Sɔ̃lɔ ji mɔ ni sɔ̃ɔ.
Ekɛ ŋai kɛ la tsuɔ he nii, ni ekɛ hamle tswiaa kɛ ekɔjiaŋ hewalɛ, ni esɔ̃ɔ.
Hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni ehewalɛ tãa, shi enuuu nu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etɔɔɔ biti.
Kapintafonyo ŋmɔɔ kpãa yɛ tso he; eyereɔ kpãa lɛ mli, ni ekɛ pɛnsil kadiɔ he.
Egbɔɔ tso lɛ he kɛ dade, ni ekɛ kɔmpas tɛŋɔ nii yɛ tso lɛ nɔ; egbɔɔ tso lɛ gbɔmɔ su pɛpɛɛpɛ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛyawoɔ gbatsu mli.
Etoɔ tsenedrutsei, aloo eyahalaa kooŋ tsei loo odum, ni ehaa edaa ni enaa hewalɛ yɛ kooŋ tsei lɛ ateŋ.
Etɛoɔ tsenedrutso, ni nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nɔ, ni edaa.
Gbɔmɔ ŋɔɔ tso lɛ eko ekɛfeɔ lai, ni ekɛ eko hu feɔ amãgã.
Ekɛ eko shɛreɔ la ewereɔ, ni ekɛshãa aboloo hu; kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛ tso lɛ eko nɔŋŋ feɔ nyɔŋmɔ, ni ejaa.
Ekɛ eko gbɔɔ amãgã, ni ekotoɔ shi ejaa lɛ.
Ekɛ tso lɛ eko shɛreɔ la, ni ekɛshãa loo eyeɔ ni etɔɔ; asaŋ ewereɔ tso lɛ la, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Yiɛ, mihe edɔ, mina la!” Tso ni eshwɛ lɛ ekɛgbɔɔ amãgã efeɔ enyɔŋmɔ, ni ekotoɔ lɛ, ni ejaa lɛ, ni esɔleɔ etsɛɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ, “Heremɔ mi, ejaakɛ bo ji minyɔŋmɔ.” Amɛleee nii, asaŋ amɛkɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ hu, ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii eshwila ni amɛnaaa nii; ni amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa eŋamɔ hu, ni amɛnuuu nii ashishi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko jwɛŋmɔ baaa nɔ, asaŋ nilee loo sanesɛɛkɔmɔ hɛleee mɔ ko kwra shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ tso lɛ fã shã ŋai, ni mikɛ ŋai lɛ shã aboloo kɛ loo fɛɛ ni miye.
Esa akɛ makoto tsoku lɛ lo?” Mɔ ni yeɔ lamlu tete po, aaanu lɛ shishi.
Esusumɔ kɔɔdɔŋ lɛ eha edu gbɛ, ni enyɛŋ eyiwala ehere, ni ekpɛlɛŋ nɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ mininejurɔ mli lɛ, jeee lakamɔnii ni lo?” Yehowa ji Bɔlɔ kɛ Kpɔlɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao Israel, kaimɔ enɛ, kaimɔ akɛ mitsulɔ ji bo.
Mi mibɔ bo; mitsulɔ ji bo.
Ao Israel, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ!
Mihã ohe eshai lɛ ekpalaŋ kɛtee tamɔ atatu, ohe eshai lɛ emii tamɔ afua.
Kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ mi, mikpɔ̃ bo.” Ao ŋwɛi, la ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu enii!
Ao shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, bɔɔ oshe!
Ao gɔji, nyɛwoa lala nɔ!
Ao koo kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni yɔɔ mli, nyɛlaa!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpɔ̃ Israel ni aawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ Israel.” “Bɔ ni Yehowa, oKpɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ, mɔ ni ekome too ekpã ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni ekome pɛ elɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni hãa amalelɔi agbalɛi feɔ yaka, ni ehãa klamɔi tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai, mɔ ni kũɔ nilelɔi anaa, ni ehãa amɛnilee lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ kwashiai anii lɛ.
Emaa etsulɔ wiemɔ nɔ mi, ni ehãa ebɔfoi agbalɛ baa mli taakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm he akɛ, ‘Mɛi baahi mli ekoŋŋ’, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji wuji lɛ ahe akɛ, ‘Abaasaa amãmɔ amɛ, ni maha tsui ni akumɔ ate shi ekoŋŋ’ lɛ.
Lɛ ekɛɔ ŋshɔ akɛ, ‘Omli nu agbi, mibahã ofai lɛ hu amii?’ Ekɛɛ yɛ Koresh he akɛ, ‘Mitookwɛlɔ ji lɛ, ni ebaafee nii ni sa mihiɛ’; ni ekɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm he akɛ, ‘Abaasaa ama’, ni ekɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hu he akɛ, ‘Abaato oshishi ekoŋŋ.’ ”
Yehowa fã Koresh Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Koresh mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu, mɔ ni mimɔ eninejurɔ mli koni maba majimaji ashi yɛ ehiɛ, koni maba maŋtsɛmɛi ashi, ni magbele shinai yɛ ehiɛ, koni akaŋamɔ agboi awo lɛ lɛ nɛ, “Manyiɛ ohiɛ, ni maha hei ni yɔɔ dokoidokoi afee trɛnɛɛ, ni majwara akɔɔble agboi lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni makumɔ amɛsɛɛ dade adabaŋi lɛ amli.
Maŋɔ jwetrii ni aŋɔ tee duŋ mli kɛ ojarawa nibii ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔhei lɛ mahã bo, koni ona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ ogbɛi tsɛ bo lɛ.
Mitsulɔ Yakob ni ji Israel, mɔ ni miŋɔ lɛ lɛ hewɔ ni Kuros, mikɛ ogbɛi tsɛ bo, ni miwo bo gbɛi, tsɛbelɛ oleee mi lɛ.” “Mi ji Yehowa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; mi misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ.
Mahã ona hewalɛ tsɛbelɛ oleee mi, koni kɛjɛ hulushiteehe kɛyashwie anaigbɛ fɛɛ lɛ, adesa ana ale akɛ mi misɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mi mihãa la kɛ duŋ fɛɛ baa; mihãa anaa hejɔlɛ, ni mihãa jaramɔ baa.
Mi ji Yehowa, mɔ ni feɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ.” “Ao Ŋwɛi, nɛɛ nu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi!
Ha atatui afɔse jalɛ ashwie shi!
Shikpɔŋ agbele enaa koni yiwalaheremɔ aba, koni eha jalɛ saneyeli hu akwɛ̃ Mi, Yehowa, mafee enɛ!
Adebɔɔ kɛ Jeŋ sane Nuŋtsɔ Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ fuɔ daa!
Sũ ni yɔɔ nishɔ̃lɔ dɛŋ ji lɛ.
Ani shikpɔŋ sũ biɔ nishɔ̃lɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni okɛ mi shɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?’ Aloo, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni oshɔ̃ lɛ niji bɛ he?’ Kpoo ha bi ni kɛɔ etsɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni bi obaafɔ?’ Aloo ebiɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ akɛ, ‘Ni okɔmɔɔ nɛɛ mɛɛ bi obaafɔ?’ Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Ebɔlɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ nyɛyɔɔ akɛ nyɛaabi mi mibii lɛ ahe sane, aloo nyɛaatsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ ni esa akɛ mikɛ miniji afee?’ Mi mibɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, mi mibɔ gbɔmɔ mito nɔ.
Mi mikɛ minine kpã ŋwɛi mli miha shi.
Hulu, nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ŋwɛi nibii lɛ, mi mifamɔ naa ni amɛba.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mitee Koresh shi koni etsu miyiŋtoo lɛ he nii, asaŋ koni ejaje nibii.
Mahã egbɛi fɛɛ aja aha lɛ; eeesaa etswa mimaŋ lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ minomii lɛ ahe jeee yɛ yinii loo sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israel nɛ, “Nii ni Ijipt yɔɔ lɛ kɛ Kush hu jarayeli mli sɛɛnamɔnii lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ onii; ni Sebahii, hii gojogojoo lɛ, aaatsɔmɔ onyɔji.
Amɛaakamɔ gboklɛi amli kɛaanyiɛ osɛɛ; amɛaaba ni amɛaakoto bo.
Amɛaakpa bo fai amɛkɛɛ, ‘Bo pɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ yɔɔ, ni Lɛ esɛɛ lɛ, mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni etee ehe.
Ao, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, Yiwalaherelɔ!
Mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ amãgãi lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaagboi, ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaanyiɛ kɛ hiɛgbele.
Shi Yehowa aaahere Israel yiwala kɛya naanɔ; nyɛhiɛ gboiŋ, ni asaŋ nyɛhiɛ eshwieŋ shi kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ.’ ” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni shɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ewaje lɛ ema shi shiŋŋ, ni ebɔɔɔ lɛ koni ekã shi efolo, shi ebɔ lɛ koni ahi nɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, ni kɛjɛ mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” Jeee teemɔ mli miwie yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ ko nɔ.
Mikɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaoɔ mi yaka; nyɛtaoɔ mi yɛ he ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ.
Mi Yehowa, miwieɔ anɔkwale.
Nɔ ni ja lɛ, no mikɛɔ.” Je lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ Babilon Amãgãi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni nyɛbaa, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaa kutuu, nyɛ, maji lɛ amli bii ni nyɛje hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli!
Mɛi ni tereɔ amɛtso amãgãi lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, ni amɛsɔleɔ amɛhãa nyɔŋmɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere lɛ, amɛleee nii.
Nyɛbaa koni nyɛbajajea nyɛsane lɛ; nyɛhãa amɛyaa ajina!
Namɔ ji mɔ ni jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ egba nɔ ni eba nɛɛ?
Namɔ kɛɛ enɛ kɛjɛ blema?
Aso jeee mi, Yehowa, ni?
Ni misɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ kɛ Yiwalaherelɔ?
Misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” “Jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, koni ahere nyɛyiwala.
Ejaakɛ mi pɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni kɛjɛ misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ekã mihe kitã: Jalɛ wiemɔ ko eje minaa, ni ekuŋ esɛɛ efolo.
Nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakũla mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaakã kitã akɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛkɛ mli jalɛ kɛ hewalɛ yɔɔ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni te shi wo lɛ lɛ, aaaba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ kɛ hiɛgbele.
Yehowa mli Israel shwiei fɛɛ aaaye bem yɛ, ni enɔ amɛaashwã amɛfɔ̃.
“Babilon nyɔŋmɔi lɛ anaagbee nɛ!
Be ko ni eho lɛ, aja Bel kɛ Nebo.
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ afimɔ amɛ ashwie tejii akotosɛɛ akɛ jatsu ni kooloi tere ni etɔ amɛ.
Amãgãi lɛ kotokotoo shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmamɔmamɔɔ amɛhiɛ shi; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛfɛne, ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛmiiya.
“Ao, Yakob shwiei, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ, nyɛboa mi toi.
Nyɛ mɛi ni mihiɛ nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛfɔmɔ mli, ni mikura nyɛ kɛjɛ nyɛhɔŋɔɔ mli beebe, ni kɛyaashi gbɔlɛ mli lɛ mi nɔŋŋ ni; ni kɛyaashi nyɛwaŋjee mli tete mi nɔŋŋ ni.
Mi, mibɔ nyɛ, ni mi nɔŋŋ mahiɛ nyɛ; mi miwa nyɛ, ni mahere nyɛyiwala.
Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaaye egbɔ?
Namɔ nyɛkɛbaato mihe, ni ekɛ mi aaafee pɛ?
Mɛi ni fɔseɔ shika kɛjɛɔ flɔtɔ mli shwieɔ shi, ni amɛŋmɛɔ jwiɛtɛi yɛ nsɛni mli lɛ, amɛbɔɔ shikaŋaalɔ apaa, ni efeɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko ehãa amɛ, ni amɛhoɔ amɛkotoɔ shi, ni amɛjaa lɛ.
Amɛwoɔ lɛ amɛtswaa amɛkɔŋ, ni amɛtereɔ lɛ kɛyaa; amɛkɛ lɛ yamaa shi yɛ he ko, ni jɛi emaa; enyɛɛɛ ehe etsi kɛjɛ emaahe lɛ.
Kɛji abolɔ atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehereee mɔ nɔ; ni ehereee mɔ yiwala kɛjɛɛɛ ehaomɔ mli.
“Nyɛ eshafeelɔi, nyɛkaia sane nɛɛ, ni nyɛsusua he.
Nyɛkaia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛkaia blema teteetenii lɛ.
Mi nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ sɛɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ mi.
Mi, mijɛ shishijee lɛ mli ni mitsɔ̃ɔ naagbee mli nibii ni baaba; Mi, mijɛ blema beebe mitsɔ̃ɔ nibii ni anako afee tete.
Mi, mikɛɔ akɛ; ‘Miyiŋtoi aaaba mli, ni mibafee nibii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ miyiŋ.’ Miitsɛ miyiŋtoo naa nuu ko kɛmiijɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ebaagba shi kɛba tamɔ okropɔŋ.
Mina miwie, ni mahã eba mli; mito miyiŋ, ni mafee hu.
Nyɛ tsuisalɔi, nyɛboa mi toi, nyɛ ni nyɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ teŋ ejekɛ!
Miha miyiwalaheremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; ebɛ shɔŋŋ.
Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ etsɛŋ.
Mibahere Yerusalɛm, ni mahã Israel hiɛ aba nyam.”
Abaakojo Babilon Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Babilon, oblayoo foro, kpelekemɔ shi koni obata mlu mli!
Ta shikpɔŋ; maŋtsɛ sɛi ko bɛ ha bo, bo Kaldeabii abiyoo, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo oje kɛ mɔ ni ahiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ dɔŋŋ.
Kɔlɔmɔ wiɛbii ni owiɛ ma, jiemɔ ohiɛhaa nɔ lɛ, jiemɔ otade yuu lɛ, dɔrɔmɔ onaji ahe mama kɛya ŋwɛi koni ofo faa lɛ.
Aaajie oyayaiaŋ kpo, ni ohiɛgbele aaabakã shi.
Matɔ owele, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ minaa.” Wɔ-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ao Babilon, ta shi kpoo yɛ duŋ mli, ejaakɛ atsɛŋ bo nɔyelihei amaŋnyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mimli wo mimaŋ lɛ la, ni mibule minɔyeli nɔ lɛ, ni miŋɔ amɛ miwo odɛ̃ŋ.
Omusuŋ etsɔ̃ɔɔ bo yɛ amɛhe; hiimeji tete po okɛ amɛ ye kɛ joomɔ.
Osusu akɛ obaaye maŋnyɛ kɛya naanɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ sane nɛɛ wooo otsuiŋ, ni oyajwɛŋŋ bɔ ni naagbee lɛ aaatamɔ ahã.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo enɛ toi, bo ni onyaa jeŋ ŋɔɔmɔyeli he, ni ota shi ni ohe ejɔ bo, ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, mitsɔŋ okulafo, ni migboŋ bi hu.” Nibii enyɔ nɛɛ aaaba onɔ trukaa yɛ gbi kome nɔ.
Okunyaayeli babaoo kɛ osɛbɛi babaoo lɛ ahewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, aaakpakpaa obii yɛ ohe, ni oootsɔ̃ okulafo hu.
Onifɔɔjianii lɛ mli lɛ, efee bo akɛ oyɛ shweshweeshwe; ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Mɔ ko enaaa mi.” Oŋaa kɛ onilee lɛ ha odu gbɛ, ni okɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi, misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.” Shi sane fɔŋ baaye bo, ni oleŋ bɔ ni ooofee ni oje mli.
Osharã aaasharã bo, ni onyɛŋ okpa oshwie.
Hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabanina bo trukaa bɔ ni okpaaa gbɛ.
“Yaa nɔ kɛ okablɛfiimɔ kɛ okunyaayeli babaoo ni ogbo he deŋme kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ lɛ, akɛ aleee nɔ eeenyɛ eye ebua bo lo; akɛ aleee nɔ ohe aaafee gbeyei.
Ŋaawoo pii lɛ eje otsine.
Ha mɛi ni le ŋwɛi nibiiaŋ lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛji nyɔŋ je ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba onɔ lɛ, ate shi koni amɛhere oyiwala!
Naa, amɛtamɔ gbetseli, ni la aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ wɛɛ; amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe amɛhere kɛje la lɛ naawalɛ mli.
Enɛ jeee ŋai la ni awereɔ, loo la ni ataa he awereɔ.
Mɛi ni ogbo amɛhe deŋme lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ amɛha bo nɛ; oŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi ni wo bo ŋaa lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaashi bo; mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaahere oyiwala.”
Nyɔŋmɔ pɛ ni le wɔsɛɛ sane Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛ mɛi ni akɛ Israel gbɛi ewo nyɛ, ni nyɛjɛ Yuda mli, nyɛboa enɛ toi!
Nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, shi anɔkwale kome nɛkɛ bɛ mli.
Nyɛtsɛɔ nyɛhe maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli bii, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛkpasa Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mijɛ jeeŋmɔ ko mitsɔ̃ɔ nii ni baaba.
Eje minaa, ni miha ana ale, ni trukaa lɛ mifee, ni amɛba mli.
Akɛni mile akɛ ofeɔ ntɛŋ, ni okuɛŋ ti tamɔ dade, ni ohiɛŋtso wa keketee tamɔ akɔɔble hewɔ lɛ, mijɛ jeeŋmɔ ni migba bo.
Mikɛɛ bo dani aba mli, koni okakɛɛ akɛ, mimãgã ni akɛ tso gbɔ loo amãgã ni ashwie lɛ fã, ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba.
Onu momo, ni agbɛnɛ ona nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Belɛ bɛ obaakpɛlɛ nɔ?
Kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ mibaha onu nibii hei, nibii ni akɛtee nibii ni oleee.
Kpaako mifeɔ, amɛbɛ sa.
Onuko amɛhe sane lɛ dã ja ŋmɛnɛ, koni okakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, mile mito’.
Onuko dã, ni oleee otooo sa; otoi egbeko dã kɛjɛ blema beebe; ejaakɛ mile akɛ kutumpɔfoi anii ofeɔ, ni kɛjɛ ofɔmɔ mli beebe lɛ ale bo akɛ atuatselɔ.
Migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, miitsi mimlifu lɛ mato.
Mi, miyijiemɔ hewɔ lɛ, miito mitsui shi maha bo koni mikakpãtã ohiɛ.
Naa, mitsuu ohe, shi oshɛɛɛ jwiɛtɛi.
Mikɛ amanehulu fee la mikɛtsuu ohe, ni mikɛka bo mikwɛ akɛ oshɛɔ lo.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewɔ ni mifeɔ enɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni hewɔ aaagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ?
Mikɛ minunyam lɛ haŋ mɔ kroko.” Kuros ji Hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã “Ao, Yakob, bo mi toi; Israel, bo mɔ ni mitsɛ, bo mi toi.
Mi ni, mi ji klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ, ni mi nɔŋŋ ji naagbee mɔ lɛ!
Mi, minine to shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni mi, mihewalɛ lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli ha shi.
Kɛji mitsɛ amɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ blublu amɛbadamɔɔ mihiɛ.
“Nyɛ fɛɛ, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa koni nyɛbaboa toi.
Te nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni egba enɛɛmɛi eko lɛ?
Mɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, lɛ ebaatsu yiŋ ni Yehowa eto yɛ Babilon he lɛ he nii; ebaate shi ewo Babilon.
Mi, mi nɔŋŋ miwie, ni mifɔ̃ minaa mitsɛ lɛ.
Mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ lɛ ba, ni egbɛ aaaja aha lɛ.
Nyɛtsia nyɛbɛŋkɛa mi nyɛbaboa enɛ toi.
Kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ miwieee yɛ dujiaŋ; ni dani nɔ ko baaba mli lɛ, miyɛ jɛi.
Ni agbɛnɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ etsu mi kɛ Emumɔ lɛ.” Yehowa yiŋtoo yɛ Ewebii ahe Bɔ ni Yehowa, bo-Kpɔ̃lɔ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo nii ni hi ha bo, mɔ ni tsɔɔ bo gbɛ ni esa akɛ onyiɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ao, eji oye mikitãi lɛ anɔ kulɛ, oooshwere tamɔ faa; ni okunimyeli aaatsara nɔ tamɔ ŋshɔkei.
Omusuŋbii aaafa tamɔ shia, ni oshwiei aaafa tamɔ mlu.
Agbeŋ amɛgbɛi, ni akpãtãŋ amɛhiɛ yɛ mihiɛ.” Nyɛshia Babilon nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Kaldea nyɛyaa.
Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛ miishɛɛ; nyɛhaa anua yɛ je lɛ naagbeehe akɛ, “Yehowa ekpɔ̃ etsulɔ Israel.” Be ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, kumai yeee amɛ.
Eha nu jɛ tɛsaa mli ho hã amɛ; egba tɛsaa lɛ mli, ni nu lɛ tue kɛje kpo.
“Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ hã mɛi fɔ̃ji” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Israel ji jeŋ majimaji lɛ ala Ao, nyɛ ŋshɔnaa maji, nyɛboa mi toi; ni nyɛ majimaji ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, nyɛfea toi.
Yehowa tsɛ mi dani afɔ mi.
Be ni miyɔɔ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni Yehowa wo mi gbɛi.
Ehã miwiemɔ naa ba tamɔ klante; ekɛ mi tee yɛ dɛkɔkɔ teŋ.
Eha mitsɔ tamɔ gãimlibi ni asha he kaŋkaŋ; ni eŋɔ mi etee egãimlibii akotoku lɛ mli.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel, mitsulɔ ji bo; bo onɔ baatsɔ̃ ni abaawo mihiɛ nyam.
Shi mi lɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, “Migbo deŋme yakatswaa; mifite mihewalɛ efolo yakatswaa.” Kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ kã Yehowa nɔ, ni minyɔmɔwo yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, Yehowa mɔ ni shɔ̃ mi yɛ musuŋ koni mibatsɔ̃ etsulɔ ni maŋɔ Israel kɛba eŋɔɔ, koni abua Israel naa abaha lɛ.
Akɛni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsɔ mihewalɛ.
Ekɛɛ, “Efaaa akɛ ooofee mitsulɔ ni otee Israel akutsei lɛ ashi, ni okɛ Israelbii ni abaa amɛyi lɛ aku sɛɛ kɛba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ nɔ kɛkɛ; shi moŋ miiŋɔ bo mafee jeŋ majimaji lɛ ala, koni midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ayashɛ je lɛ naagbeehe.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Kpɔ̃lɔ, kɛ eMɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ mɔ ni agbe ehe guɔ, ni jeŋ majimaji lɛ hi ehiɛ, nɔyelɔi anyɔŋ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Maŋtsɛmɛi aaana lɛ ni amɛaate shi amɛhã lɛ; ni lumɛi hu aaana lɛ ni amɛaakamɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ejaakɛ Yehowa ehala lɛ, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eji anɔkwafo.” Abaasaa atswa Yerusalɛm Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibo bo toi yɛ be ni sa mli, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ, ni mibaa oyi koni kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, mi kɛ maji fɛɛ akpãŋ, koni otee shikpɔŋ lɛ shi oma shi, ni oja amɛgboshinii ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ oha amɛ.
Okɛɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjea kpo koni nyɛye nyɛhe;’ ni mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ kɛɛmɔ amɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa la hiɛ.’ Amɛaaye nii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi atoi, ni gɔji ni koo bɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛniyelihe.
Hɔmɔ yeŋ amɛ, ni kumai hu yeŋ amɛ.
Hulu eshaŋ amɛ, ni shiaŋa nɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ hu esaŋ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ ni musuŋtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ amɛhe lɛ aaakpala amɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛaatee nubui ahe.
“Maha migɔji lɛ anɔ atsɔ gbɛ, ni aaasaa migbɛjegbɛi lɛ afee amɛ tɛmpɔŋi.
Naa, miwebii aaajɛ shɔŋŋ aba; ni naa, aaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu aba, ni mɛi aaajɛ Aswan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ wuoyigbɛ aba.” “Ŋwɛi, lá kɛ miishɛɛ!
Shikpɔŋ, bɔɔ oshe kɛ nyamɔ!
Gɔji, nyɛlaa nyamɔ lala!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mii; ni emɛi ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ lɛ, emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe.
Shi Yerusalɛm kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ekwa mi, miNuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ!” Yehowa to he akɛ, “Aso yoofɔyoo hiɛ aaakpa ebi fufɔoo nɔ, ni emusuŋ etsɔŋ lɛ yɛ emusuŋbi he?
Kɛji yoofɔyoo tete hiɛ aaakpa ebi nɔ lɛ, mi lɛ, mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ.
Yerusalɛm, naa, miŋma ogbɛi yɛ midɛkɔkɔŋ; mihiɛ kpaŋ onɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” “Mɛi ni baasaa atswa bo ama shi lɛ miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mɛi ni fee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ baashi omli ni amɛya.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; Owebii lɛ miibua amɛhe naa; amɛmiiba oŋɔɔ.
Gbii abɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ tamɔ jwine, ni okɛ amɛaawula ohe tamɔ ayɛmforo feɔ lɛ.” “Eyɛ mli akɛ afite oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni afee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ moŋ nɛ, shi agbɛnɛ, mɛi baaba omli aahu bɔ ni onaŋ gbɛ ohã amɛ; ni mɛi ni ha afee bo amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ kɛ bo teŋ aaajekɛ shɔŋŋ.
Bii ni ofɔ yɛ ojaramɔ be lɛ mli lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ otoiŋ akɛ, ‘Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ yɛ fintɔŋŋ tsɔ ha wɔ; tsi oya koni wɔna shihilɛhe.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobi ohe akɛ ‘Namɔ fɔ bii nɛɛ ha mi?
Akpakpaa mibii yɛ mihe ni mitsɔ̃ kene ni bɛ bi.
Aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.
No hewɔ lɛ, namɔ lɛ amɛ?
Naa, ashi mi koome pɛ kɛkɛ; belɛ nɛgbɛ Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛ mɔ?’ ” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mawo minine nɔ mafɔ majimaji lɛ anine, ni amɛaahiɛ obihii lɛ yɛ amɛkpɔkɔiaŋ kɛaaba.
Maŋtsɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ tsɛmɛi aha nyɛ, ni maŋnyɛmɛi aaatsɔmɔ tamɔ yei fufɔhalɔi ahã nyɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ aaabumɔ shi, amɛaakoto nyɛ, ni amɛaalɛmɔ nyɛnaji ahe mlu.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa.
Mɛi ni hiɛ kã minɔ lɛ, amɛhiɛ gboiŋ.” Ani anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nii ni kãkãlɔ eyaha yɛ edɛŋ?
Aloo anyɛɔ ashɔ̃ɔ nomii ni hewalɔ emɔmɔ yɛ edɛŋ?
Shi bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Aashɔ̃ kãkãlɔ dɛŋ nomii lɛ, ni hewalɔ haanii lɛ, aaahe yɛ edɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni kɛ bo aaana lɛ, mi kɛ lɛ ena, ni mahere bii lɛ ayiwala.
Maha ohaolɔi lɛ agbegbee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛlá aaatɔ amɛ dãa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ adesai fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛ-Kpɔ̃lɔ kɛ Yiwalaherelɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ.”
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛnyɛ shwiemɔ wolo ni mikɛshwie lɛ lɛ yɔɔ?
Minyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ namɔ mihɔɔ nyɛ miha?
Dabida!
Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ ni ahɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ ashwie nyɛnyɛ.
“Mɛɛba miba, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ?
Mɛɛba mibo mitsɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee mi nɔ lɛ?
Ani minine efo kuku bɔ ni minyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala mahere?
Aloo mibɛ hewalɛ ni mikɛaakpɔ̃ mɔ?
Naa, mifãa, ni ŋshɔ miiɔ.
Mihãa fai gbiɔ ni amɛtsɔmɔɔ tamɔ shiaŋa, ni amɛmli loi gboiɔ ni amɛshaa, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa nu.
Mihãa ŋwɛi dĩɔ, ni ebuɔ kpekpe.” Su ni sa ni Yehowa Tsulɔ ahi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ eha mi nilelɔ lilɛi bɔ ni afee ni male bɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ akanya mɔ ni egbede aha.
Daa leebi lɛ, ehɛleɔ mi shi, ni egbeleɔ mitoiŋ koni mibo nɔ ni eyɔɔ mi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ toi akɛ kaselɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eha mi niiashishinumɔ, ni mitseko ehiɛ atua, asaŋ minaaa sɛɛsɛɛ.
Mitsɔ mikotosɛɛ miha yilɔi kɛ midabii hu miha mɛi ni famɔɔ tsɛŋ; ni mijooo hiɛgbele kɛ lajɔ̃ naa foi.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ ebuaa mi; no hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ eshwieko shi; no hewɔ ni mimia mihiɛ kɛdamɔ naa; ni mile akɛ mihiɛ eshwieŋ shi.
Mɔ ni buɔ mi bem lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Namɔ kɛ mi aaaye sane?
Ha wɔ fɛɛ wɔdamɔ shi.
Namɔ ji mɔ ni ekɛ mi ena?
Ha ekɛ mi akpe!
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni yeɔ buaa mi.
Namɔ aaabu mi fɔ?
Naa, amɛ fɛɛ amɛaasuu tamɔ atade ni omlɛgɛ aaaye amɛ.
Nyɛteŋ namɔ sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei?
Namɔ boɔ etsulɔ lɛ gbee toi?
Kɛji mɔ lɛ nyiɛ duŋ mli, ni la etsooo hãaa lɛ po, hã ekɛ ehiɛ afɔ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ ehe akpasa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Naa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛwoɔ la koni eshã mɛi, nyɛ moŋ nyɛhiɛ aaakpãtã.
Nɔ ni nyɛbaana kɛaajɛ midɛŋ nɛ, Haomɔ mli nyɛaajwere.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛaanyiɛ la ni nyɛwo lɛ mli.
Yerusalɛm miishɛjemɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛboa mi toi!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa tɛsaa ni agba nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ, kɛ tɛ bu ni atsa nyɛ kɛjɛ mli lɛ he.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛ Abraham kɛ Sara, mɛi amli ni nyɛjɛ lɛ.
Be ni mitsɛ Abraham lɛ, ekome ni; shi mijɔɔ lɛ, ni mihã ewo shwiei babaoo.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa baashɛje Yerusalɛm mii; ebaashɛje hei fɛɛ ni efee koikoi lɛ amii; ebaahã eŋa lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ tamɔ Eden; ni eshiaŋa lɛ baatsɔ tamɔ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ abɔɔ.
Jɛi baasɔ kɛ mliflimɔ kɛ nyamɔ kɛ shidaa lalai.
“Mimaŋbii, nyɛboa mi toi!
Mimaŋ, nyɛfea toi nyɛhãa mi!
Ejaakɛ mibawo mla, ni mijalɛ saneyeli aaatso la aha majimaji lɛ.
Midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã; miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ baaje kpo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ maye majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ miikwɛ mi gbɛ, ni amɛhiɛ kã mihewalɛ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi; ni nyɛkwɛa shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi hu.
Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi baalaaje tamɔ lasu, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baasuu tamɔ atade ni enɔ gbɔmɛi aaagboi tamɔ adɔdɔji; shi miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ, ni mikpɔmɔ lɛ bɛ naagbee.
“Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni le nɔ ni ji jalɛ, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ maŋbii ni mimla lɛ yɔɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ, nyɛkashea adesa dɛŋ ahorabɔɔ gbeyei!
Asaŋ nyɛtsuii akafãa yɛ limɔ ni aaali nyɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã tamɔ mama ni omlɛgɛ eye, loo kuŋtu ni gɔgɔmii eye.
Shi mikpɔmɔ lɛ aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ; ni miyiwalaheremɔ lɛ aaahi shi yinɔi fɛɛ.
Tee shi, tee shi koo!
Yehowa, wo ohewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ.
Tee shi tamɔ ofee blema ko lɛ, tamɔ yɛ jeeŋmɔ yinɔi komɛi anɔ lɛ.
Aso jeee bo ofolɔ ŋshɔŋ kooloo Rahab lɛ mli dukuduku lɛ?
Aso jeee bo ofolɔ kooloo drako gbeyeigbeyei lɛ mli lɛ?
Aso jeee bo oha ŋshɔ mii lɛ?
Ani jeee bo oha bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli nu mii, ni ogba gbɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli oha mɛi ni okpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛfo mli kɛho lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛaaba Zion kɛ lala.
Amɛaanya, ni amɛmii aaashɛ; amɛyeŋ awerɛho lɛ, amɛdɔmɔŋ ŋtsɔi dɔŋŋ.” Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, “Mi mishɛjeɔ nyɛmii!
Mɛɛba osheɔ adesa ni baagbo, adesa ni etamɔ jwɛi gbeyei, ni ohiɛ ekpa Yehowa, obɔlɔ lɛ, moŋ nɔ?
Ohiɛ ekpa mɔ ni lɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha shi, ni eto je lɛ shishi lɛ nɔ?
Mɛɛba osheɔ gbeyei jenamɔ tuu yɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ kɛ ehe ni esaa kɛkpãtã ohiɛ lɛ hewɔ?
Ni nɛgbɛ haolɔ lɛ grimɔ lɛ yɔɔ po?
Etsɛŋ kwraa ni aaaŋmɛɛɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ahe; amɛgboiŋ, ni amɛwala sɛɛ baatsɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛaaye ebɔŋ amɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni teɔ ŋshɔ shi, ni emli ŋshɔkei feɔ hamahama lɛ.
Migbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
Mi milɛɛ ŋwɛi mli miha shi, ni mito je lɛ shishi.
Mikɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, ‘Miwebii ji nyɛ!
Mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ minine miibu nyɛhe.’ ” Yerusalɛm nɔnaa naagbee Ao Yerusalɛm, wo ohe nɔ!
Wo ohe nɔ!
Tee shi odamɔ shi!
Onu toigbalamɔ kpulu lɛ mli dãa ni jɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ dɛŋ lɛ.
Ni onu owo omli, ni olɛmɔ kpulu lɛ mli, ni eha oodidãa.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ebii ni efɔ lɛ ateŋ ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ; mɔ kome folo nɛkɛ bɛ bii ni elɛ lɛ ateŋ ni aaamɔ enine mli.
Saji enyɔ nɛɛ eba onɔ: ta ekpãtã oshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni hɔmɔ hu eye omaŋbii.
Namɔ aaashɛje omii?
Obii lɛ etɔ biti; amɛkamɔkamɔɔ shi yɛ blohui lɛ fɛɛ akoji tamɔ baayelɔ ni adu lɛ yɛ tsɔne mli.
Amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Yehowa mlila kɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kãmɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Yerusalɛm nɔnalɔi ni nyɛdidãa tsɛbelɛ nyɛtɔrɔko dãa, nyɛboa toi, Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ emaŋ lɛ sane ehaa lɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mihe didãamɔ dãa kpulu lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ; nyɛnuŋ mimlifu naa kpulu lɛ mli dãa lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Maŋɔ maha nyɛhaolɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkamɔa shi koni wɔnyiɛa nyɛnɔ kɛhoa.’ Ni nyɛtsɔ tamɔ gbɛjegbɛ koni wɔnyiɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baahere Yerusalɛm Ao Yerusalɛm, ohiɛ atsɛ̃!
Ohiɛ atsɛ̃!
Teemɔ ohewalɛ lɛ shi!
Ao Yerusalɛm, maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, wulamɔ kɛ otadei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ejaakɛ foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni he tseee boteŋ ogboi lɛ mli dɔŋŋ!
Ao Yerusalɛm ni aŋɔ bo nom, tee shi?
Kpokpomɔ ohe mlu lɛ, Tee shi ota shi!
Zion biyoo ni aŋɔ bo nom, fɛnemɔ kpãa ni yɔɔ okuɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Be ni ahɔɔ nyɛ lɛ aheee nyɛyi shika ko; ni jeee shika hu akɛbaakpɔ nyɛ.
Shi bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ, mimaŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tee Ijipt ni eyahi jɛi akɛ gbɔi.
Shi Asiriabii lɛ wa amɛyi yakatswaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mɛni mafee yɛ he akɛni miina mimaŋ lɛ ni Babilonbii ŋɔ amɛ nom yakatswaa lɛ?
Amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ shwãa kɛkɛ amɛshwãa, Yehowa kɛɛ, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ amɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mimaŋbii lɛ aaale migbɛi lɛ; ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛaale akɛ mi ji mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Naa, mi nɛ lɛ.’ ” Kwɛ bɔ ni sanekpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ hejɔlɛ, sanekpakpashiɛlɔ ni shiɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ naji yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, mɔ ni kɛɔ Zion akɛ, “Naa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ agbɛnɛ.” Bo toi!
Omɛi ni buɔ maŋ lɛ he lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm ehole amɛgbei anɔ, ni amɛmiila kɛ miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina faŋŋ akɛ Yehowa eku esɛɛ kɛmiiba Zion!
Yerusalɛm tsui koikoi, nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛwoa nyamɔ lala nɔ!
Ejaakɛ Yehowa eshɛje emaŋ lɛ mii, ehere Yerusalɛm yiwala.
Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaana wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtereɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nibii lɛ, nyɛkataa nɔ ko ni he tseee he; nyɛtsuua nyɛhe, ni nyɛshĩa, nyɛshĩa Babilon nyɛyaa.
Shi moŋ nyɛshĩŋ nyɛyaŋ yɛ hejojomɔ naa; ni asaŋ jeee yɛ foijee naa hu; ejaakɛ Yehowa baanyiɛ nyɛhiɛ ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ baanyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ.
Tsulɔ Nɔnalɔ lɛ Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mitsulɔ lɛ baashwere, aaawo ehiɛ nyam, ni aaawo enɔ; aaawo enɔ gojoo.
Mɛi babaoo ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ehewɔ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ efite bɔ ni ehiɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ dɔŋŋ; egbɔmɔtso su tamɔɔɔ gbɔmɛi adesai anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eeehã maji babaoo anaa akpɛ amɛhe; Maŋtsɛmɛi aaamua amɛnaa yɛ ehewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbaana nii ni agbako amɛ dã, ni amɛbaanu nɔ ni amɛnuko dã lɛ shishi.”
Maŋbii lɛ to he akɛ, “Namɔ aaahe sane ni wɔnu lɛ eye?
Ni namɔ Yehowa ejie ehewalɛ nine lɛ kpo etsɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ ekwɛ̃ yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ tso fɔ, tamɔ tso shishi fã ni etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ mli.
Ehe bɛ nyam lɛ, ebɛ su ko hu ni aaaha wɔkwɛ lɛ; ni ehe bɛ fɛo ko hu ni aaaha ehe afee wɔ akɔnɔ.
Agbe ehe guɔ, ni gbɔmɛi kwa lɛ, eye awerɛho, ni ele hejaramɔ etamɔ mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ atoɔ afã kɛ ana lɛ lɛ.
Agbe ehe guɔ, ni wɔbuuu lɛ wɔhãaa fɛifɛi.
“Anɔkwa, wɔhelai lɛ, lɛ etere, ni wɔhejaramɔi lɛ, lɛ ehole eshwie enɔ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔbu lɛ akɛ mɔ ko kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbala etoi, ni ena nɔ.
Shi apila lɛ yɛ wɔ moŋ wɔtɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ; atswia lɛ nii yɛ wɔnishaianii lɛ ahewɔ.
Agbala etoi koni wɔna hejɔlɛ, ni ehe faji lɛ akɛtsaa wɔ.
Wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm wɔtamɔ toi ni edu gbɛ.
Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ, ni Yehowa kɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnɔsha lɛ fɔ̃ enɔ.
Afee lɛ niseniianii, ni apiŋ lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ etswaaa esɛŋ.
Bɔ ni too gwantɛŋbi ni akɛ lɛ yaa ayagbe lɛ, loo too gwantɛŋbi feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔi ahiɛ lɛ, nakai etswaaa esɛŋ lɛ.
Aye lɛ toikɔdɔmɔ sane, ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee.
Namɔ aaanyɛ asusu nɔ ni aaaba enɔ?
Ejaakɛ asha lɛ kɛje hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.
Mimaŋbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔi ahewɔ apiŋ lɛ lɛ!
Atsa ebu yɛ eshafeelɔi ateŋ, tsɛbelɛ efeko esha ko lɛ, emaleko hu dã, ni afu lɛ yɛ niiatsɛmɛi ateŋ.
“Eji Yehowa yiŋtoo akɛ atswa lɛ nɔ, ni apila lɛ.
Kɛji eŋɔ ehe eshã afɔle yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ, ebaana shwiei ni ewala sɛɛ aaatsɛ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ lɛ enɔ lɛ, nɔ ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ aaashwere.
Esusuma haomɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeena nii ni aaahã etsui anyɔ emli.
Kɛtsɔ̃ mitsulɔ jalɔ lɛ nilee nɔ lɛ, eeehã aŋɔ mɛi babaoo akɛ jalɔi, ni eeetere amɛnishaianii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, maha lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi wuji ateŋ; ni ekɛ hewalɔi aaaja haanii, ejaakɛ eŋɔ ehe eha gbele, ni abu lɛ ashi mlanɔtɔlɔi anɔ, kɛ̃lɛ etere mɛi pii ahe eshai, ni edamɔ mli eha eshafeelɔi.”
Bɔ ni Yehowa sumɔɔ Israel ehãa “Yerusalɛm, yoo kene, wó nyamɔ lala nɔ!
Bo ni okɔ̃mɔko dã, blɔmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni ewu kwa lɛ lɛ, ebii ayi baafa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ bii.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Lɛɛmɔ obuu lɛ mli, kpã oshihilɛhe lɛ mamai lɛ amli.
Kaalɛte he; ha etaŋkpei lɛ akɛlɛ, ni okala oshiŋmlitsei lɛ ni awa.
Ejaakɛ ooolɛɛ shi kɛya ninejurɔgbɛ kɛ abɛkugbɛ fɛɛ; ni oshwiei aaaye majimaji anɔ, ni amɛaahe shi yɛ maji ni kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli.
Kaashe gbeyei!
Ejaakɛ ohiɛ eshwieŋ shi; ni ohe akajara bo, ejaakɛ agbeŋ ohiɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ohiɛ aaakpa oblayeiaŋ hiɛgbele lɛ nɔ, ni okulafeemɔ mli hejaramɔ lɛ okaiŋ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ obɔlɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ wu aha bo.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ ji egbɛi, ni Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome lɛ ji Okpɔ̃lɔ lɛ.
Je lɛ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji egbɛi.
Yehowa miitsɛ bo kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Israel, otamɔ yoo ni ewu ekwa lɛ, ni eeye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ mumɔ mli, tamɔ oblahiiaŋ ŋa ni ashwie lɛ.
Hiŋmɛitswaa kɛkɛ mikwa bo, shi mikɛ mlitsɔlɛ kpele baabua onaa.
Mikɛ mihiɛ tee bo hiŋmɛitswaa yɛ mlifu ni eteke nɔ naa; shi mikɛ naanɔ suɔmɔ aaahã mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohewɔ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, bo-Kpɔ̃lɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Be nɛɛ tamɔ Noa be lɛ ha mi.
Bɔ ni mikã kitã akɛ Noa be lɛ mli nu afua lɛ ebahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai mikãa kitã akɛ mimli fuŋ bo, ni mikaŋ ohiɛ.
Gɔji lɛ aaaje amɛshihilɛhei lɛ aya, ni gɔŋkpɔi lɛ hu aaafamɔ kɛaatee nɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ ha bo lɛ tsakeŋ, ni mi kɛ bo teŋ toiŋjɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mikuŋ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni musuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ ohe lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Ao Yerusalɛm ni apiŋ bo, maŋ ni ahum tswa bo, shi ashɛjeee omii, naa, mikɛ ojarawatɛi baatswa bo mama shi, ni mikɛ safiro tɛ baatswa oshishitoo lɛ.
Mikɛ rubi tɛ baatswa omɔji lɛ, ni mikɛ ojarawa tɛ baafee ogboi lɛ, ni ohe gbogbo lɛ hu, mikɛ tɛi ni jara wa baatswa.
Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ omli bii lɛ nii, ni amɛbaashwere jogbaŋŋ.
Jalɛ shihilɛ aaahe shi yɛ omli.
Yiwalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ bo teŋ baajekɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, osheŋ gbeyei; ni tsuifãa nifeemɔ bɛŋkɛŋ bo; no hewɔ lɛ otsui efaŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ko aaabatua bo lɛ, jeee mi ejɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaate shi awo bo lɛ, lɛ moŋ ebaagbee shi.
“Naa, mi, mibɔ sɔ̃lɔ mɔ ni huɔ ŋai la ekɛsɔ̃ɔ tawuunii lɛ.
Ni mi nɔŋŋ mibɔ tabilɔ mɔ ni kpãtãa nibii ahiɛ lɛ.
Shi tawuunii ko kwraa bɛ ni asɔ̃ ni aaanyɛ bo awui aye.
Ooona hetoo oha wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni aaawie ashi bo.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni asaa ato.
Yehowa tsuji agboshinii kɛ amɛjalɛ ni jɛ midɛŋ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ Mɔbɔnalɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui!
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kumai yeɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaa nu he!
Nyɛ mɛi hu ni bɛ shika, nyɛbaa nyɛbahea ŋmãa nyɛyea!
Nyɛbaa!
Nyɛbahea wain kɛ fufɔ, jeee kɛ shika shi moŋ kɛ nyɛdɛ folo.
Mɛɛba nyɛkɔɔ shika nyɛkɛheɔ nɔ ni jeee ŋmãa?
Ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsumɔŋ nyɔmɔwoo heɔ nɔ ni hãaa mɔ atɔ?
Nyɛboa mi toi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni makɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛaaye niyenii kpakpa fe fɛɛ, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ.
“Nyɛfea toi, ni nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ!
Nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛyi aaana wala.
Mi kɛ nyɛ baakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ, ni ji mimɔbɔnalɛ ni sɛɛ efooo ni mikɛwo David shi lɛ.
Naa, mifee lɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ tatsɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mihe odaseyelɔ ehã majimaji lɛ.
Naa, ooofɔ̃ nine otsɛ maji ni oleee; ni maji ni leee bo hu aaahiɛ foi kɛaaba oŋɔɔ, yɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo ohiɛ nyam!
Nyɛtaoa Yehowa be mli ni eeehã ana lɛ.
Nyɛtsɛa lɛ be mli ni ebɛŋkɛ.
Ha mɔ fɔŋ lɛ akwa ejeŋba fɔŋ lɛ; ni nɔshafeelɔ atsake ejwɛŋmɔ.
Ha eku esɛɛ kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ lɛ yɛ ehewɔ.
Ekpale kɛba wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛaafa lɛ aahu.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ejaakɛ jeee mijwɛŋmɔi ji nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ni jeee nyɛgbɛi lɛ ji migbɛi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ŋwɛi kwɔ fe shikpɔŋ lɛ, nakai migbɛi lɛ kwɔ fe nyɛgbɛi lɛ, ni mijwɛŋmɔ kwɔ fe nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ.
“Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nu kɛ snoo nɛɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi shwieɔ shi, ni ekuuu esɛɛ kɛyaaa ŋwɛi, akɛ ja eha shikpɔŋ lɛ nu, ni eha eba nii, ni ewo yibii, ni eha nidulɔ wui, ni ekɛ niyenii eha mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ni wiemɔ ni jɛɔ midaaŋ lɛ hu aaafee.
Ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛbaŋ miŋɔɔ efolo, shi moŋ eeetsu nɔ ni mito mihã lɛ lɛ; ni eeeye kunim yɛ nɔ hewɔ ni mitsu lɛ lɛ mli.
“Ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi Babilon kɛ nyamɔ, ni aaakpala nyɛ kɛshi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli.
Gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ aaawo nyamɔ lala nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaatswa amɛdɛ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ŋmeitso najiaŋ lɛ, sɛsɛo aaakwɛ̃, ni aklati najiaŋ lɛ, shɔ̃ aaakwɛ̃.
Enɛ baatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaimɔ nɔ, kaimɔ nɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.”
Jeŋmaji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ bii Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛfea nɔ ni ja, ejaakɛ midɛŋ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni abaajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ adesa ni feɔ enɛ.
No ji mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni eyeɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni ebuleee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ni ewiɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ efɔŋ he.” Gbɔ ni kɛ ehe ebakpɛtɛ Yehowa lɛ ekakɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa baajie mi yɛ emɛi lɛ ateŋ.” Osai hu akakɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, tso gbiŋ kɛkɛ ji mi, ni abuŋ mi ashiŋ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ anɔ.” Osaii ni yeɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni amɛfeɔ nii ni sa mihiɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli tswɛ lɛ, maha amɛna gbɛi yɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ, gbɛi ni hi fe bihii kɛ biyei.
Maha amɛna gbɛi ni baahi shi kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ, ni agbeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Gbɔi ni kɛ amɛhe baakpɛtɛ Yehowa koni amɛsɔmɔ lɛ ni amɛsumɔ egbɛi lɛ, asaŋ koni amɛtsɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni toɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛɔ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni mikɛaaba Zion, ni ji migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni maha amɛnya yɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Amɛshãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ amɛfɔlei krokomɛi lɛ aaasa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ aaatsɛ miwe lɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aSɔlemɔ we.
Bɔ ni Yehowa Ofe mɔ ni kpala emaŋ Israel kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛku sɛɛ kɛba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Masaa makpala mɛi krokomɛi kɛba kɛbafata mɛi ni mikpala kɛba momo lɛ ahe.” Abu Israel Maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ fɔ Nyɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi kɛ nyɛ koo mli kooloi hu fɛɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛbayea nii!
Israel maŋhebulɔi lɛ eshwila; amɛleee nii.
Gbei mumui ji amɛ; amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛbolɔ; amɛwieɔ yɛ wɔ mli; amɛkamɔɔ shi, ni amɛsumɔɔ wɔdɔiwɔɔ.
Gbei fulɔi ni; amɛleee mitɔ!
Nɛkɛ tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi nɛɛ lɛ hu, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɔlɔ amɛgbɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miifo ekome enɔ mli.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa, nyɛhaa wɔwoa wain wɔmaa shi ni wɔnua bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ.
Wɔ hu baatamɔ ŋmɛnɛ, ni eeeteke nɔ po.”
Akã Israel hiɛ yɛ emagãjãmɔ hewɔ Jalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kɛ esane lɛ wooo etsuiŋ.
Aŋɔɔ gbɔmɛi kpakpai kɛjeɔ jeŋ kɛyaa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu shishi.
Ejaakɛ aŋɔɔ gbɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛyaa kɛjeɔ haomɔ mli, ni eboteɔ hejɔlɛ mli.
Mɛi ni ba amɛjeŋ yɛ jalɛ naa lɛ, amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli yɛ gbohiiaje.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsia nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ klamɔfoi abii kɛ gbalafitelɔi abii kɛ ajwamãŋi abii.
Namɛi ahe fɛo nyɛyeɔ lɛ.
Namɛi nyɛgbɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ hatoo nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛliɔ lɛ?
Ani jeee toigbolɔi kɛ amalelɔi ashwiei ji nyɛ lo?
Nyɛkɛ heloo akɔnɔ fɔŋ feɔ yakayakanii yɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi.
Nyɛgbeɔ nyɛmusuŋbii nyɛkɛshãa afɔle yɛ jɔi amli kɛ tɛsaa fɔji amli.
Nyɛkɔlɔɔ fai anaa fɔbitɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛjaa amɛ akɛ wɔŋ.
Nyɛfɔseɔ dãa nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhaa amɛ akɛ afɔle, ni nyɛshãa niyenii afɔle nyɛkɛhaa amɛ.
Aso mitsui aaanyɔ mimli yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ?
Nyɛyaa gɔji ni kwɔlɔ somromoo lɛ anɔ nyɛyashãa afɔle, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe wɔɔ yɛ jɛi.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛmãgãi ni anyaŋeɔ lɛ mamɔɔ nyɛshinai ashi.
Nyɛkwaa mi, nyɛjieɔ nyɛyayai amli, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛsuɔlɔi kwɔɔ kɛyaa nyɛsaatsei ni lɛɛlɛɛ anɔ; nyɛwoɔ amɛ nyɔmɔ koni amɛkɛ nyɛ awɔ; jɛi nyɛgbeɔ nyɛkɔnɔ yɛ.
Nyɛwoɔ ojeŋmai, ni nyɛkpaa muŋma kɛyaa, ni nyɛyajaa wɔŋ Molek.
Otsuɔ obɔfoi kɛyaa shɔŋŋ, kɛyaa gbohiiaje tete.
Ogba ohe naa kɛtao wɔji krokomɛi, shi okɛɛɛ ohe akɛ, “Sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he.
Ona hewalɛ hee, no hewɔ lɛ, ogbɔjɔɔɔ.
“Namɔ gbeyei oshe, ni otsui fã, hewɔ ni omale, ni okaiii mi, ni oyasusuuu mihe lɛ?
Aso diŋŋ ni mifee ni miŋamɔ mihiŋmɛii nɛɛ lɛ hewɔ ni osheee mi gbeyei lɛ?
Mibajaje ojalɛ ni osusuɔ akɛ oja lɛ kɛ onifeemɔnii hu fɛɛ matsɔ̃ɔ, shi ooona akɛ onaŋ sɛɛ ko yɛ mli.
Kɛji obolɔ waa lɛ, ha owɔji lɛ ni obua naa lɛ ahere bo!
Kɔɔyɔɔ aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee; gugɔ mli kɔɔyɔɔ tete aaaloo amɛ kɛaatee.
Shi mɛi ni baa mi abo lɛ aaaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ amɛye, ni migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, Zion, lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baaye ebua Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea gbɛ lɛ, nyɛjea!
Nyɛjajea gbɛ lɛ.
Nyɛjiea pampi fɛɛ pampi yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ agbɛ lɛ nɔ.
“Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Mɔ Koome ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi flooflo, naanɔ Mɔ ni gbɛi ji Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ kɛ He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mihiɔ; asaŋ mikɛ mɔ ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ ni ebaa ehe shi yɛ mumɔ mli lɛ hiɔ shi,’ koni maha heshibalɔi amumɔ ana wala hee, ni mɛi ni tswiaa shi kɛ dɔlɛ lɛ atsuii ana wala hee.’ Ejaakɛ mibeŋ kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni jeee daa mimli aaawo la, ejaakɛ mi midɛŋ mumɔ jɛɔ, ni mi mibɔ wala mumɔ.
Nɔ sha ni yɔɔ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo la; migwao lɛ, ni mikɛ mihiɛ tee lɛ, ni mimli fu; shi etee nɔ ekwa mi, ni eye etsui naa sane.
“Mina gbɛ fɔŋ ni enyiɛ lɛ, shi mibatsa lɛ.
Mibakpala lɛ, ni mibashɛje lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ amii.
Hejɔlɛ, hejɔlɛ aha mɔ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ fɛɛ.
Mibatsa miwebii lɛ.
Shi mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ amɛtamɔ ŋshɔ ni efee hamahama, ejaakɛ enyɛɛɛ eŋmɛ dɛmm, ni ŋshɔkei lɛ loɔ muji kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ebubuaa shi.
Hejɔlɛ ko bɛ ha mɛi fɔ̃ji.” MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
Anɔkwa ŋmaahilɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bolɔmɔ waa!
Kaaha onaa miiba shi.
Wo ogbee nɔ tamɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ.
Jajemɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe eshai lɛ otsɔɔ amɛ; tsɔɔmɔ Israel we lɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛtaoɔ misɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛshweɔ akɛ amɛle migbɛi lɛ tamɔ maŋ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni amɛkwako amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mlai lɛ.
Amɛtaoɔ akɛ mabu amɛ bem akɛ jalɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛtsi amɛbɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.” Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔhiɔ ŋmaa, ni bo, Yehowa, onaaa lɛ?
Mɛɛba wɔhumiɔ shi, ni onaaa lɛ?” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ mli nyɛfoɔ, ni nyɛwaa nyɛnitsulɔi fɛɛ ayi.
Naa, nyɛŋmãahilɛ be mli lɛ, nɔ ni eshwɛ nyɛ kɛkɛ ji bei kɛ nɔmɔ, ni nyɛmamɔɔ nyɛhe atswɛrɛi kɛ yiwalɛ.
Nɛkɛ ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ haŋ anu nyɛgbee yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ani nɛkɛ ŋmaahilɛ mito lɛ?
Enɛ ji ŋmaahilɛ ni gbɔmɔ kɛhumiɔ shi lɛ?
Ani no ji yishimaa kɛ kpekpebumɔ kɛ lamlumlikamɔ lo?
Enɛ nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ ŋmaahilɛ gbi ni sa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ?
“Ani jeee enɛ moŋ ji ŋmaahilɛ ni mito lɛ: akɛ akpa toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli koni akplɔ toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli kɔŋtso lɛ he ŋmei lɛ koni aha mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ aye amɛhe koni akumɔ apã fɛɛ apã?
Ani jeee no ji akɛ okɛ oboloo akuma mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ, ni oŋɔ ohiafoi ni bɛ shihilɛhe lɛ kɛba owe lɛ, ni kɛji ona mɔ ko ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ohã lɛ mama, ni okɛ ohe akatee bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe gbɔmɔ.
“No lɛ ojalɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni otsamɔ hu aaafee oya, ni ojalɛ lɛ aaanyiɛ ohiɛ, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ aaanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ooobo otsɛ, ni Yehowa aaahere bo nɔ; ooobo otsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ, ni eeekɛɛ akɛ ‘Naa mi!’ “Kɛji nyɛkpa mɛi gboklɛwoo yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛkpa wao kɛmɔtsɔɔmɔ kɛ mɔ he efɔŋ wiemɔ, kɛji oha mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ niyenii, ni oha mɔ ni ehĩa lɛ lɛ nɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ, no dani ola lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni oduŋ kpii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ shwane.
Ni Yehowa aaakpala bo daa, ni eeeha bo ohiamɔnii yɛ fimɔ be mli, ni eeeha bo hewalɛ, ni oootsɔ̃ tamɔ trom ni nu hoɔ yɛ mli, loo tamɔ nuhiŋmɛi ni nu kpaaa yɛ mli.
Omɛi lɛ aaasaa oblema tsui koi lɛ atswa; amɛaatswa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ blema shishitoo srɔtoi lɛ anɔ.
Aaatsɛ nyɛ mɛi ni saa gbogboi lɛ amɛtswa kɛ mɛi ni saa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ koni mɛi anyɛ nɔ ahi.” Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ he sɛɛnamɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Kɛji oto hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ofɔ̃ɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ mlifomɔ yɛ migbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji obu Yehowa gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ohiɛ sɔ Yehowa gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, kɛji owo gbi lɛ, ni ofeee bo diɛŋtsɛ otsuinaa nii, ni ofooo bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ mli, ni otsuuu bo diɛŋtsɛ onii lɛ, loo otiuuu otsuinaanii sɛɛ, aloo owieee yaka wiemɔi yɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ maha oye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi fɛɛ anɔ, ni omii aaashɛ Yehowa he, ni oooye otsɛ Yakob gboshinii lɛ!” Yehowa kɛ enaabu ekɛɛ.
Akã maŋbii ahiɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai ahewɔ Naa, Yehowa nine efoko kuku bɔ ni no hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ yiwala ehere; asaŋ etoii hu tsimɔko bɔ ni enuuu nii.
Shi moŋ nyɛnishaianii lɛ ji nii ni egbala nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ.
Nyɛhe eshai lɛ ji nii ni etsĩ nyɛhiɛ, hewɔ ni ebooo nyɛ toi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ lá ebule nyɛniji, ni nyɛkɛ nishaianii ebule nyɛwaobii; nyɛnaabu wieɔ amale wiemɔi, kutumpɔo wiemɔi ji nɔ ni kã nyɛlilɛi nɔ.
Mɛi ni asane ejaaa lɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni samaa mɛi, ni mɔ ni sane bɛŋ moŋ ni kɛ sane yaa kojomɔ sɛi hiɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ amale naajiemɔi anɔ, ni amɛtoɔ abla; amɛtoɔ yiŋ sha, ni no kɛ nɔshafeemɔ baa.
Yiŋ shai ni amɛtoɔ lɛ yeɔ awui tamɔ shinɔ ni naa joɔ wɔji.
Kɛji wɔji lɛ eko fɛ lɛ, onufu ji nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ wɔlɔ lɛ eko lɛ gbo egboɔ.
Amɛnifeemɔ tamɔ anaanu ntaŋ; ni ntaŋi lɛ nyɛɛɛ atsɔ̃ mama ni aaanyɛ aha.
Nishaianii pɛ amɛfeɔ, ni niseniianii pɛ amɛkɛ amɛniji tsuɔ.
Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛyeɔ oyai kɛshwieɔ mɔ ni fɔbuu ko bɛ ehe lɛ lá shi.
Nɔ he pɛ ni amɛjwɛŋɔ ji nɔsha, ni nifitemɔ kɛ niihiɛkpãtãmɔ anaa yɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Toiŋjɔlɛ ni ji toiŋjɔlɛ lɛ amɛleee eko, ni jalɛ saneyeli bɛ he ni amɛyɔɔ.
Amɛkɔ̃dɔkɔdɔ̃ɔ amɛgbɛi, ni mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ nakai gbɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ he ejɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ jaje amɛhe esha Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ ni jalɛ saneyeli kɛ wɔteŋ jɛkɛ lɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ bɛŋkɛɛɛ wɔ lɛ.
Wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ la akpɛ aha wɔ, shi moŋ duŋ mli wɔnyiɛɔ.
Wɔtatraa yɛ gbogbo he tamɔ shwilafoi, ni wɔgbugbuɔ shi tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ hiŋmɛii; wɔtɛrɛɔ shwane fintiŋŋ tamɔ nɔ ni hiɛ ebu, ni wɔnyiɛɔ hiɛkãalɔi ateŋ tamɔ mɛi ni egboi.
Wɔ fɛɛ wɔhuuɔ tamɔ oshishibrishii, wɔyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpoi; wɔkwɛɔ jalɛ saneyeli gbɛ, shi ekoeko ejeee gbɛ; wɔshweɔ yiwalaheremɔ, shi ekɛ wɔteŋ jɛkɛ.
“Nuŋtsɔ, wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa tsɔ yɛ ohiɛ, ni wɔhe eshai lɛ yeɔ odase shiɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ jwere wɔhiɛ, ni wɔnishaianii lɛ hu wɔle fɛɛ.
Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔkwa Yehowa, ni wɔkpale yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Yiwalɛ kɛ atuatsemɔ wiemɔi wɔwieɔ; amale wiemɔi ni wɔtoɔ yɛ wɔtsuiiaŋ lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ wɔnaa.
Jalɛ saneyeli ekpale kɛtee sɛɛ, ni jalɛ eyadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ anɔkwale etã yɛ blohuŋ, ni anɔkwale bɛ nɔ ko mli.
Anɔkwale elaaje, ni mɔ ni wiɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ efɔŋ he lɛ ayɔseɔ moŋ akɛ lɛ moŋ etɔ̃.” Yehowa saa Emaŋbii aheremɔ eto Yehowa na, ni edɔ lɛ akɛ ayeee jalɛ sane.
Ena, ni enaa kpɛ ehe akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni edamɔ mli eha mɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ amim; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ here eyiwala, ni ejalɛ lɛ ye bua lɛ.
Jalɛ aaatsɔ dama ni eeewo, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaatsɔ dade fai ni eeebu, ni oweletɔɔ aaatsɔ bo ni eeeha, ni hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa ekɛaafee emama.
Bɔ ni amɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee amɛ eto najiaŋ.
Emli aaawo la awo mɛi ni kɛ lɛ ena lɛ, ni eeewo henyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛyanina ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛaashe Yehowa gbɛi lɛ gbeyei yɛ anaigbɛ; aaashe ehewalɛ lɛ gbeyei yɛ hulushiteehe, ejaakɛ ebaaba tamɔ faa ni etue ni Yehowa mumɔ lɛ etsi eyisɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Mibaba Zion taakɛ kpɔ̃lɔ, akɛ kpɔ̃lɔ ha Yakob shwiei ni ekpale kɛje nifɔɔjianiifeemɔ mli lɛ.
Ni naa, mi lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛ kpãŋɔ nɛ: Mimumɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, kɛ miwiemɔi ni mikɛwo onaa lɛ, ha akã bo kɛ oshwiei ashwiei fɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ.”
Yerusalɛm hee lɛ Tee shi ni otso ejaakɛ ola lɛ eshɛ shi etã, ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ miikpɛ yɛ onɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, duŋ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni duŋ kpii aaaha majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Shi bo lɛ, Yehowa la aaate lɛ shi aha bo, ni enunyam lɛ aaakpɛ yɛ onɔ.
Ni maji aaatsi kɛbɛŋkɛ ola lɛ, ni maŋtsɛmɛi aaaba ola ni kpɛɔ yɛ onɔ lɛ he.
Wo ohiɛ nɔ, koni okwɛ ohe kɛkpe; ooona amɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ.
Obihii lɛ aaajɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ aba, ni obiyei lɛ, aaahiɛ amɛ yɛ ŋmawuiaŋ kɛaaba.
Nakai be lɛ ohiŋmɛi aaana; ooona miishɛɛ kɛteke nɔ, ni otsui aaatɔ, ni ooonya.
Ejaakɛ akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ajwetrii aaabahã bo; akɛ amɛjwetrii lɛ aaajɛ ŋshɔsɛɛ aaabahã bo.
Yoomai asafo yuu aaabua ohe kutuu, ni ji Midian kɛ Efa yoomai oblahii lɛ.
Amɛaatere shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛaajɛ Sheba kɛaaba; ni mɛi aaagba nɔ ni Yehowa efee lɛ he sane kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ.
Aaabua Kedar toi fɛɛ anaa abaha bo, kɛ Nebaiot too ojwɛnii lɛ hu akɛ afɔle.
Akɛ amɛ aaashã afɔle ni sa mihiɛ yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mawo minunyam Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛɛ ji nibii nɛɛ ni hoɔ tamɔ atatu loo tamɔ okpoi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba amɛtsu naa nɛɛ?
Lɛji ni jɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔji anɔ ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii miiba ni.
Amɛkɛ obihii lɛ kɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii kɛ amɛshika miiba kɛbawo Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam; ejaakɛ eha ohiɛ eba nyam.
Yehowa miikɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, “Gbɔi aaatswa ohe gbogboi lɛ, ni amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaasɔmɔ bo; ejaakɛ mitswa bo nɔ yɛ mimlifu mli; shi mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe yɛ mimlihilɛ lɛ naa.
Ogboi lɛ anaa aaakamɔ be fɛɛ be; shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aŋamɔŋ, koni maŋtsɛmɛi anyiɛ amɛwebii ahiɛ, koni amɛkɛ majimaji lɛ ajwetrii lɛ abaha bo.
Shi maji ni sɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ; nakai maji lɛ, kpãtãmɔ aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.
Lebanon kooŋ tsei kpakpai, ni ji sɛsɛo kɛ odum kɛ odanta, akɛaaba akɛbawula mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni mawo he ni midamɔɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Mɛi ni wa bo yi lɛ abii lɛ hu aaaba abakoto bo; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni gbe ohe guɔ aaaba abakula onaji anaa.
Amɛaatsɛ bo ‘Yehowa maŋ wulu,’ ‘Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ Zion lɛ.’ “Kulɛ akwa bo, ni anyɛ bo; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ omli kɛhooo; shi no najiaŋ lɛ, maha oje agbo, ofee naanɔ anunyam kɛ naanɔ nyamɔ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛya yinɔ.
Oooye majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi anii tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ, ni okɛaana ole akɛ, mi, Yehowa, mi ji oyiwalaherelɔ; ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ ji okpɔ̃lɔ.
“Maha bo shika yɛ akɔɔble najiaŋ, ni maha bo jwiɛtɛi yɛ dade najiaŋ; tso najiaŋ lɛ, maha bo akɔɔble; ni tɛi anajiaŋ lɛ, maha bo dade.
Onɔyelɔi lɛ waŋ bo yi dɔŋŋ, ni maha amɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ aye onɔ.
Anuŋ yiwalɛ he dɔŋŋ yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo nifitemɔ loo niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he yɛ ohusui amli he ko he ko; mafa ohe ni mabu ohe; matsɔ yiwalaheremɔ gbogbo maha bo.
Ni ooojie miyi, ejaakɛ mikpɔ̃ bo.
“Jeee hulu ni baatso la dɔŋŋ aha bo shwane, ni jeee nyɔɔŋtsere ni baakpɛ koni jeŋ atse aha bo gbɛkɛ; shi moŋ Yehowa ni aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaatee naanɔ, ni oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ onunyam.
Ohulu lɛ enyɔŋ shi dɔŋŋ, ni onyɔɔŋtsere lɛ hu woŋ duŋ; ejaakɛ Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ ola kɛaatee naanɔ, ni okɔmɔyeli gbii lɛ hu sɛɛ aaafo.
Omaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aaafee nɔ ni ja, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ kɛya naanɔ, amɛ ji tso ni mitɛo akɛ mi mininenaa nitsumɔ nii koni akɛwo mihiɛ nyam.
Mɔ bibioo fe fɛɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ weku muu, ni weku bibioo lɛ aaatsɔ̃ jaku muu.
Kɛji be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Mi, Yehowa, maha eba mli oya.”
Kpɔ̃mɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ.
Efɔ mi mu, ni etsu mi koni mibashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
Etsu mi koni mibashɛje mɛi ni efee bliboo kɛ awerɛho lɛ amii, koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ.
Etsu mi koni mibashiɛ akɛ Yehowa dromɔ afi lɛ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oweletɔɔ gbi lɛ eshɛ, koni mishɛje ŋkɔmɔyelɔi fɛɛ amii.
Etsu mi koni mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Zion lɛ mibaha amɛ ayilɔ yɛ lamlu najiaŋ, ni yɛ awerɛho najiaŋ lɛ, mibaha amɛmii ashɛ.
Amɛaafee tamɔ tsei ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ tɛo.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee nii ni ja, ni aaajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi yɛ nii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛaatswa blema tsui koi lɛ; ni amɛaasaa tsutsubii lɛ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ, ni amɛaato maji ni efite lɛ ehee ekoŋŋ ni ji yinɔi pii anɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ.
Maŋsɛɛbii aaalɛ nyɛtoi lɛ, ni mɛi kpɔji aaahu nyɛŋmɔji amɛha nyɛ, ni amɛaasaa nyɛwaintsei ahe aha nyɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, aaatsɛ nyɛ Yehowa osɔfoi, ni mɛi aaatsɛ nyɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi.
Nyɛaabaye jeŋ maji lɛ anii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ yɛ jeŋ majiaŋbii lɛ anii lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛhiɛgbele kɛ hiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ aaafo, nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe, yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛninamɔ lɛ aaaku abɔ he, ni nyɛaana miishɛɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ jalɛ saneyeli; miihi juu kɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ feemɔ.
Mibato amɛ najiaŋ shishiishi, ni mi kɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Amɛshwiei agbɛi aaahehe yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni amɛbii hu aaana gbɛi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaana amɛ aaakpɛ̃lɛ nɔ akɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ amɛ ji amɛ.
Manya waa yɛ Yehowa hewɔ; ni misusuma mli aaafli lɛ yɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ewo mi yiwalaheremɔ atade, ni ekɛ jalɛ mama eha mi, tamɔ bɔ ni ayɛmforo wu wulaa ehe loo bɔ ni ayɛmforo wulaa kɛ jwine lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ hãa nii kwɛ̃ɔ, ni trom hãa nii ni adu yɛ mli lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, nakai Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã jalɛ kɛ yijiemɔ akwɛ̃ yɛ majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Zion hewɔ lɛ mimuaŋ minaa, ni Yerusalɛm hewɔ lɛ mijɔŋ mihe kɛyaashi bem ni eye lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ tamɔ leebi hulu, ni eyiwala ni ahere lɛ aaatso tamɔ kɔti.
Jeŋ maji lɛ aaana obemyeli lɛ, ni maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ aaana onunyam; ni akɛ gbɛi hei ni Yehowa aaawo bo lɛ aaatsɛ bo.
Oootsɔ̃ tamɔ akekre fɛɛfɛo yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; oootsɔ̃ tamɔ maŋtsɛ fai yɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Atsɛŋ bo “Mɔ ni akwa lɛ” dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ aaatsɛ bo “Mitsui naa gbɔmɔ”; ni aaatsɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu “Kpeemɔ yoo”; ejaakɛ Yehowa ena ohe tsuijurɔ ni oshikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaakpee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni oblanyo kpeɔ oblayoo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni bɔ bo lɛ aaakpee bo; ni bɔ ni ayɛmforo wu nyaa ayɛmforo he lɛ, nakai oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanya ohe.
Ao Yerusalɛm, mito bulɔi yɛ ogbogboi lɛ anɔ.
Shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛmuaŋ amɛnaa.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkaiɔ Yehowa shiwoi lɛ, nyɛkajɔa nyɛhe; ni nyɛkahãa ejɔa ehe kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã Yerusalɛm ama shi, ni eeehã ena gbɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ewo ehewalɛ nine lɛ nɔ ekɛkã ehe kitã akɛ, “Anɔkwa, mikɛ obele lɛ haŋ ohenyɛlɔi amɛye dɔŋŋ, ni maŋsɛɛbii enuŋ owain ni ogbo he deŋme lɛ dɔŋŋ; shi mɛi ni buaa naa woɔ aboŋo mli lɛ, amɛ amɛaaye, ni amɛaajie Yehowa yi; ni mɛi ni buaa wainyibii lɛ anaa kɛbaa shĩa lɛ, amɛ amɛaanu wain lɛ, yɛ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpoi lɛ anɔ.” Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛjea kpo nyɛtsɔa agboi lɛ amli; nyɛjea maŋ lɛ gbɛ lɛ nyɛtoa maŋbii lɛ.
Nyɛsaa, nyɛsaa gbɛjegbɛ lɛ; nyɛkɔlɔa enɔ tɛi lɛ; nyɛshia aflaŋaa kɛtoa okadi nyɛhãa maŋbii lɛ.
Naa, Yehowa eha ashiɛ kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe lɛ akɛ, Nyɛkɛa Zion bi yoo lɛ akɛ, “Naa, oyiwalaheremɔ lɛ miiba; naa, ehiɛ enyɔmɔwoo kɛmiiba, ni mɛi ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛmiiba.” Ni ebaatsɛ amɛ akɛ “Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, Mɛi ni Yehowa ekpɔ̃ amɛ,” ni bo hu aaatsɛ bo, “Mɔ ni ataoɔ esɛɛgbɛ Maŋ ni akwaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.”
Edom nɔ oweletɔɔ Namɔ ji mɔ ni jɛ Bozra, maŋ ni yɔɔ Edom lɛ, baa nɛɛ?
Namɔ nɛ, ni ewula kɛ atade ni tsuɔ faa, ni etsĩaa yɛ ehewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli nɛɛ?
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi Yehowa ni; mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ jalɛ mli, mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛhereɔ yiwala lɛ.” Mɛɛba ohe bo lɛ tsuɔ nɛkɛ; mɛɛba otadei lɛ tamɔ mɔ ni ŋaa wain atade nɛɛ?
Yehowa to he akɛ, “Mi koome too miŋa, minaanaa jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ tamɔ anaa wain lɛ.
Minaanaa amɛnɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, ni amɛmli nu tsɛŋe wo mitadei lɛ amli, ni ewu mitadei lɛ amli fɛɛ nɛ.
Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbi ko yɛ mitsui mli, ni mikpɔ̃mɔ afi lɛ eshɛ.
Mikwɛ mihe, shi yelikɛbualɔ ko bɛ; ni minaa kpɛ mihe akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni mɔɔ mli haa mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mihewalɛ ni here miyiwala, ni mimlila lɛ ni mɔ mli hã mi.
Minaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli, mikpɔtɔ amɛ yɛ mimlila lɛ mli, ni mifɔse amɛlá mishwie shikpɔŋ.” Akai Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ Mibagba Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ kɛ Yehowa yijiemɔ lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa efee eha wɔ lɛ kɛ ejurɔ pii ni efee Israel we lɛ yɛ emusuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ emlihilɛ ni fa lɛ naa lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mimaŋ ji amɛ, bii ni lakaŋ mi.” No hewɔ ehere amɛ yɛ amɛhaomɔi fɛɛ amli lɛ.
Jeee tsulɔ loo ŋwɛi bɔfo ni here amɛyiwala, shi Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ jɛ esuɔmɔ kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ mli ehere amɛyiwala, ni ehole amɛ, ni ehiɛ amɛ yɛ blema beiaŋ fɛɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtse atua, ni amɛfee Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii.
No hewɔ lɛ, etsɔ amɛhenyɛlɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛ amɛ wu.
Kɛkɛ ni emaŋ lɛ kai Mose blema be lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni jie amɛ kɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni to Emumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni ha enunyam hewalɛ lɛ tsɔ Mose nɔ etsu nibii wuji lɛ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ ni gba ŋshɔ lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛna naanɔ gbɛi eha ehe lɛ, mɔ ni kpala amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?
Amɛtɛrɛɛɛ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ tɛrɛɔ yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.” Yehowa mumɔ lɛ ha amɛna hejɔlɛ tamɔ tsinai ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa jɔɔ mli jwɛfɔ he.
Nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Yehowa kpala emaŋ lɛ, ni ekɛna anunyam gbɛi ehã ehe.
Mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ yelikɛbuamɔ he sɔlemɔ Yehowa, maa oyi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi koni ojɛ ohe krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ onunyam shihilɛhe lɛ okwɛ!
Nɛgbɛ ohiɛdɔɔ kɛ ohewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Otsuiŋshãlɛ kɛ omusuŋtsɔlɛ babaoo lɛ eŋmɛɛ wɔ.
Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ, tsɛbelɛ Abraham leee wɔ, ni Israel hu eŋɔɔɔ wɔ akɛ bii; shi bo Yehowa lɛ bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ kɛ wɔkpɔ̃lɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe ejaakɛ nakai ji ogbɛi.
Ao Yehowa, mɛɛba ohaa wɔduɔ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ anɔ?
Mɛɛba owajeɔ wɔtsui koni wɔkashe bo gbeyei lɛ?
Otsuji kɛ okutsei lɛ ahewɔ lɛ kuu osɛɛ.
Be fioo pɛ Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hi omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ; shi agbɛnɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi lɛ enaanaa Ohe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni oyeko amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔ pɛŋ, kɛ mɛi ni akɛ ogbɛi tsɛko amɛ dã.
Ao, kulɛ otserɛ ŋwɛi mli, ni okpeleke shi koni gɔji lɛ ana bo ni amɛhe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni la hãa lai tsoɔ, ni ehaa nu tswaa lɛ, koni eha ohenyɛlɔi ale ogbɛi.
Ba koni obajie ohewalɛ lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ, koni eha jeŋ maji lɛ ahe akpokpo yɛ ohiɛ!
Be ni ofee naakpɛɛnii ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni wɔhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ, okpeleke shi, ni gɔji lɛ kpokpo yɛ ohiɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ anuko dã, ni efoko mɔ ko mɔ ko toi naa dã, ni hiŋmɛi hu enako Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ bo osɛɛ ni feɔ nɔ ehaa mɛi ni hiɛ kã enɔ lɛ!
Ohereɔ mɛi ni kɛ miishɛɛ feɔ jalɛnii, mɛi ni kaiɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ akɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛha lɛ atuu.
Omli fu wɔ, shi wɔkã he wɔfee esha lɛ lolo.
Yɛ omlifu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, wɔkã he wɔfee esha lɛ lolo.
Wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɔmɔ tamɔ mɔ ko ni he tseee, ni wɔjalɛ nifeemɔnii lɛ tamɔ takoshwɛ.
Wɔnishaianii lɛ ehã wɔfee tamɔ baa gbiŋ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa wɔ kɛyaa.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni sɔleɔ tsɛɔ bo; mɔ ko bɛ ni baa odɛ̃ŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, ejaakɛ okɛ ohiɛ etee wɔ, ni oŋmɛɛ wɔhe oha wɔnishaianii lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ bo, Yehowa, bo nɔŋŋ ji wɔtsɛ.
Wɔ lɛ su ji wɔ, ni bo ji wɔshɔ̃lɔ, ni oninenaa nitsumɔ ji wɔ fɛɛ.
Ao Yehowa, kaaha omli miifu wɔ fe nine, ni kaakai wɔhe eshai lɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Omaŋbii ji wɔ; naa wɔ mɔbɔ.
Omaji krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ etsɔmɔ ŋa nɔ: Zion etsɔ ŋa nɔ, Yerusalɛm etsɔ amaŋfɔ̃.
Wɔsɔlemɔ we ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ fɛo lɛ, nɔ mli ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ jie oyi yɛ lɛ, ama naa la ashã.
Akpãtã wɔhei fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ao Yehowa, aso enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ooosu ohe lo, ooofee diŋŋ, ni ooowa wɔ yi tuutu lo?
Nyɔŋmɔ gbala atuatselɔ toi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mihaa mɛi ni biko mi nii lɛ hetoo, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mihaa mɛi ni taoko mi lɛ naa mi.
Mikɛɔ maŋ ni sɔleko tsɛko mi lɛ akɛ, Naa mi!
Naa mi!
Migbɛɔ miniji amli daa nɛɛ mihaa maŋ atuatselɔi ni nyiɛɔ gbɛ ni ehiii nɔ, mɛi ni nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi anaa lɛ.
Atuatselɔi nɛɛ jeɔ kpetekplee amɛwoɔ mimli la daa.
Amɛshãa afɔle yɛ abɔi amli amɛhaa wɔji, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ ntayai anɔ amɛhãa wɔji.
Amɛyataraa tɛkploi ni afu gbohii yɛ mli amli, ni amɛyatsɛɔ sisai gbɛkɛgbɛkɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛyeɔ kplotoo loo tete, ni amɛfaa wonu ni akɛ wɔŋ naa loo hoo.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Tsi ohe kɛya sɛɛ.
Kaabɛŋkɛ mi ejaakɛ mihe tse fe bo.’ Mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ amɛsukɔɔ mi, amɛtamɔ la ni tsoɔ gbi muu fɛɛ.
“Naa, aŋma afɔ̃ mihiɛ akɛ, ‘Mifeŋ dioo; mibatɔ he owele; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ; mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ kɛ̃ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anishaianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ,’ ” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa saa ekɛɛ nɛ, “Bɔ ni anaa yɛ wainyibii amli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, akɛɔ akɛ, ‘Akafite lɛ, ejaakɛ abaana ehe sɛɛ’ lɛ, nakai mafee yɛ mitsuji lɛ ahewɔ; mikpãtãŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Mibajɔɔ Israelbii ni jɛ Yuda mli lɛ, ni amɛshwiei aaabaŋɔ migɔji ashikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, ni jɛi mitsuji ni sɔmɔɔ mi lɛ aaahi.
Amɛaaja mi, ni amɛaakpala amɛtoi kɛ tsinai kɛya Sharon ŋa ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛkooloi aaaya Akor Jɔɔ ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ hu mli koni amɛyaye nii.
“Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwa Yehowa, ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa egɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ Zion lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃ nyɛkɛhãa shade wɔŋ, ni nyɛfɔseɔ wain ni afutu mli nyɛshwieɔ shi nyɛhãa shɛɛ mli wɔŋ lɛ, mibajɔɔ nyɛnɔ mahã klante.
Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛbaagbo otɔfo gbele, ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛhereee minɔ, miwie ni nyɛbooo toi; shi nyɛfee nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni nyɛkɔ nɔ ni nyɛle akɛ misumɔɔɔ lɛ moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ.
Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaaye nii atɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hɔmɔ baaye nyɛ.
Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaana nu amɛnu, shi nyɛ lɛ kumai aaaye nyɛ Naa mitsuji lɛ aaanya, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Naa, mitsuji lɛ aaala kɛ tsuijurɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaafo kɛ tsuiŋshãlɛ, ni nyɛaafo yoo kɛ mumɔ ni werɛ eho ehe.
Mihalamɔbii lɛ aaatsi nyɛtã amɛkɛlomɔ, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaagbe nyɛ.
Shi etsuji lɛ eeewo amɛ gbɛi kroko.
Koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa jɔɔmɔ aha ehe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kãa kitã yɛ shikpɔŋ, akã anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kitã, ejaakɛ mihiɛ ekpa tsuutsu haomɔi lɛ anɔ, ni aŋɔ atee yɛ mihiɛ.” Jeŋ hee lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miibɔ ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee, ni akaiŋ tsuutsu nii lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ ebaŋ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mli dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛnyaa, ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ kɛya naanɔ, yɛ nii ni mibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, miibɔ Yerusalɛm hee koni etsɔ̃ mliflimɔ kɛ emli bii hu ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.
Mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yerusalɛm he, ni manya mimaŋbii lɛ ahe, ni anuŋ yaafo kɛ blɔmɔ he yɛ Yerusalɛm dɔŋŋ.
Bi fufɔoo ko bɛ jɛi ni aaaye gbii fioo kɛkɛ yɛ wala mli, loo onukpa ko ni eyi yɛŋ yɛ jeŋ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa aaaye afii oha nɛ, shi aaana lɛ akɛ oblanyo; ni mɔ fɔŋ ni naa afii oha lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni alomɔ lɛ.
Amɛaamamɔ shĩai, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛaahi mli; amɛaafee wain abɔi, ni amɛaaye amɛmli wain tsei lɛ ayibii.
Amɛmamɔŋ shĩai ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ ahi mli, ni amɛhuŋ hu ni mɛi krokomɛi moŋ aye, ejaakɛ bɔ ni odum tsɛɔ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mimaŋbii awala sɛɛ aaatsɛ; ni mihalamɔbii lɛ aaaye amɛnine naa nitsumɔ mli nii daa.
Amɛgboŋ yaka deŋme, ni amɛfɔŋ bii amɛhaŋ osharã, ejaakɛ mɛi ni Yehowa ejɔɔ lɛ ashwiei ji amɛ, ni ajɔɔ amɛ hu amɛshwiei.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ dani amɛaatsɛ mi lɛ mahere amɛ nɔ, ni be ni amɛwieɔ lolo lɛ, mabo amɛtoi.
Klaŋ kɛ too gwantɛŋbi aaakpe nii yɛ he kome, ni jata aaaye jwɛi tamɔ tsina; ni onufu lɛ sũ aaafee eniyenii.
Ayeŋ awui ko, ni akpãtãŋ nii ahiɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yehowa majimaji lɛ Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Ŋwɛi lɛ, mimaŋtsɛ sɛi ni; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni; belɛ mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛha mi mɔ, ni nɛgbɛ aaafee mihejɔɔmɔ he?
Mi, minine bɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ minɔ ni,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Shi mɔ he tsui ni minaa nɛ, mɔ ni ji humi, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ etsui mli, ni ehe kpokpoɔ yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ naa.” “Mɔ ni gbeɔ tsina lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni kɛ toobi shãa afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ gbee shãa afɔle nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa niyenii afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni kɛ kplotoo lá bahãa nɔŋŋ; mɔ ni shãa krɔbɔo afɔle lɛ, etamɔ mɔ ni jaa wɔŋ nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ ekɔlɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi, ni amɛnaa nihiinii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ he miishɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu maha amanehulu aba amɛ nɔ, ni maha nɔ gbeyei ni amɛsheɔ lɛ aba amɛnɔ.
Ejaakɛ mitsɛ, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hereee nɔ; miwie ni amɛbooo toi; shi moŋ amɛfee nɔ ni ji efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni amɛfee nɔ moŋ ni esaaa mihiɛ.” Nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhe kpokpoɔ yɛ ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ.
“Nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni miihi nyɛ, ni amɛkwa nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, yeɔ nyɛ he fɛo amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛwoa Yehowa hiɛ nyam akɛ ehere nyɛ, koni wɔna nyamɔ ni nyɛaanya lɛ.’ Shi amɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi.
Nyɛboa toi, aafee hoo yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Gbee ko miijɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Yehowa mɔ ni baawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ gbee ni.
“Mimaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ yoohɔlɔ ni dani eeebɔ̃i kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efɔ momo, mɔ ni dani fɔmɔ piŋmɔ lɛ aaata ehe lɛ, efɔ binuu momo.
Namɔ enu nɛkɛ sane pɛŋ?
Namɔ ena nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ?
Ani gbi kome abɔɔ maŋ lo?
Ani gbi kome akɛnaa jaku lo?
Kɛ̃lɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Zion bɔi kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni efɔ ebii lɛ.
Aso mahã ajwa awoso, ni mihaŋ afɔ?
Aso mi ni mihãa afɔɔ lɛ, maŋa musu lɛ naa lo?” oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
“Nyɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm anyaa, ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ yɛ ehewɔ.
Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ kɛ lɛ anaa miishɛɛ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ!
Nyɛbaana eshweremɔ lɛ eko nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ, tamɔ abifao yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ etɔɔ lɛ.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Maha nyɛshwere babaoo tamɔ faa ni hoɔ, ni majimajiaŋbii lɛ anii ni amɛna lɛ aaayiridi, tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛteke nɔ, kɛba nyɛdɛŋ.
Nyɛaatamɔ abifao ni yeɔ enyɛ fufɔ; aaahiɛ nyɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ kɛ suɔmɔ yɛ kpɔkɔiaŋ.
Bɔ ni binyɛ shɛjeɔ ebi mii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mashɛje nyɛmii, ni nyɛmii aaashɛ nyɛhe yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaana kɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli, ni nyɛgbɔmɔtsei aaafrɔke tamɔ jwɛifɔ, ni aaana ale akɛ Yehowa nine kã etsuji ahe, shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ emli aaafu amɛ.” Ejaakɛ naa, Yehowa aaaba kɛ la, ni eshwiilii lɛ aaanyiɛ lasuogbele mli kɛaaba, ni ekɛ mlila kpele aaawo ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anyɔmɔ; ni ekɛ la lilɛii aaakã ehenyɛlɔi.
Ejaakɛ la Yehowa kɛbaakojo, ni ekɛ klante aaakojo jeŋ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ni mɛi ni Yehowa aaagbe lɛ ayi aaafa babaoo naakpa.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni feɔ amɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsuuɔ amɛhe kɛha tsei kɛ tɛi ajamɔ ni amɛtoɔ srɛnɛɛ kɛyaa wɔkoiaŋ, ni amɛyayeɔ kplotoo kɛ obishi kɛ kwakwe loo lɛ, amɛnaagbee eshɛ.
Ejaakɛ mile amɛnitsumɔi kɛ amɛsusumɔi, ni miiba koni mibabua jeŋ maji fɛɛ anaa, ni amɛaaba, ni amɛaabana minunyam lɛ; ni amɛaana okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mi ji mɔ ni gbalaa amɛtoi lɛ.
“Ni matsu mɛi ni ahe baaje toigbalamɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛaatee Tarshish kɛ Libia kɛ Lud, ni ji gãitsɛ̃lɔi amaŋ lɛ.
Matsu kɛya Tubal kɛ Helabii ŋshɔkpɔi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ ni amɛnuko mihe, asaŋ amɛnako minunyam lɛ bii hu aŋɔɔ.
Amɛaajaje minunyam lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.
Ni amɛ kɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaaba akɛ nikee abahã Yehowa.
Amɛaatara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛ shwiilii kɛ akpakãii amli kɛ teji kɛ yoomai anɔ kɛba Yerusalɛm, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, taakɛ bɔ ni Israelbii hiɛɔ amɛnikeenii yɛ nibii ni mli tse amli kɛbaa Yehowa we lɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Maŋɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi mafee osɔfoi kɛ Levibii,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Bɔ ni ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee ni mafee lɛ aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ nyɛshwiei kɛ nyɛgbɛi aaahi shi yɛ mihiɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ni aaaba mli akɛ nyɔŋ hee fɛɛ nyɔŋ hee kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ aaaba abaja yɛ mihiɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Ni amɛaaje kpo amɛyakwɛ mɛi ni tse mihiɛ atua lɛ agbohii lɛ.
Gɔgɔmii ni yeɔ amɛ lɛ gboiŋ, ni la ni baashã amɛ lɛ agbeŋ.
Amɛhe aaafee heloo fɛɛ heloo nyaŋemɔ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Yeremia hi shi yɛ afii ohai kpawo lɛ naagbee kɛ afii Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ shishijee, be lɛ mli.
Yeremia hi shi be kplaŋŋ, ni ebɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ kɔkɔ yɛ gbalɛi ni egba lɛ mli akɛ amɛkwɛ jogbaŋŋ, ejaakɛ piŋmɔ ko nyiɛ gbɛ kɛmiiba abanina amɛ yɛ amãgãi ni amɛjaa lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ahe esha hu hewɔ.
Yeremia gbalɛ nɛɛ ba mli yɛ ewala be mli be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baye Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim, ni ekpãtã maŋ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Eŋɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi babaoo nom kɛtee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Wolo lɛ gba hu akɛ naagbee mli aahu lɛ maŋbii lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaajɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba, ni amɛjaku maŋ lɛ baaba eblema ekoŋŋ.
Aaanyɛ ajara sane ni yɔɔ Yeremia wolo lɛ mli lɛ mli enumɔ: .
Yeremia tsɛmɔ .
Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã Yuda maŋbii kɛ emli lumɛi yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi Yosia kɛ Yehoiakim kɛ Yehoiakin kɛ Zedekia ayinɔi.
.
Saji srɔtoi komɛi ni Baruk, ni ji Gbalɔ Yeremia woloŋmalɔ lɛ, kai yɛ Yeremia he kɛ egbalɛi komɛi kɛ ewala mli saji krɛdɛɛ komɛi hu.
.
Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛhã yɛ maŋsɛɛ maji komɛi ahe.
.
Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ butumɔ kɛ maŋbii lɛ anomŋɔɔ lɛ he blema saji komɛi.
Yeremia ji mɔ ko ni yɛ henumɔ nii jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ, ni eyɛ suɔmɔ kple hã ejaku maŋbii.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ ewaa hãa lɛ dani ekɛɔ emaŋbii lɛ akɛ abaagbla maŋ lɛ toi.
Ewie kɛ musuŋshãlɛ ni naa wa yɛ egbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi amli akɛ tsɛmɔ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ koni ebafee gbalɔ lɛ ehã ena nɔ yɛ nibii babaoo amli.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ boɔ yɛ Yeremia mli; enyɛɛɛ naa etsi.
Wiemɔi wuji ni yɔɔ Yeremia Wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ekomɛi kɔɔ yinɔ ko ni baanyiɛ Yeremia yinɔ kɛ emli haomɔi lɛ asɛɛ.
No ji be ko miiba ni kpãŋmɔ hee ko baaba abakã Naa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ewebii lɛ ateŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Naa Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ emɛŋ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko ni ebakai amɛ bɔ ni amɛba amɛjeŋ amɛhã; ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ maŋbii lɛ atsuiaŋ diɛŋtsɛ ji he ni abaaŋma kpãŋmɔ lɛ yɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Yeremia Tsɛmɔ lɛ .- Maŋtsɛmɛi Yosia kɛ Yehoiakim kɛ Yehoiakin kɛ Zedekia ayinɔi gbalɛi .—.

Maŋsɛɛ maji ahe gbalɛi .—.
Yerusalɛm butumɔ .-
Yeremia he sane Yeremia, Osɔfo Hilkia ni hi shi yɛ Anatot yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bi lɛ, wiemɔi nɛ: Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia, Amon binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia binuu lɛ, yinɔ hu lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ekoŋŋ kɛyashi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia, Yosia binuu lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ naagbee.
Nakai afi lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ mli aŋɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ nom.
Yeremia tsɛmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Dani mibɔ bo yɛ onyɛ musuŋ beebe lɛ, mile bo; ni dani afɔ bo lɛ, mifee bo krɔŋkrɔŋ momo, ni miwo bo gbalɔ mihã majimaji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mito he akɛ, “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ!
Naa, mileee wiemɔ, ejaakɛ gbekɛ̃ kɛkɛ ji mi.” Shi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Gbekɛ kɛkɛ ji mi’, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ŋɔɔ ni mibatsu bo lɛ, yaa, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mafã bo akɛ owie lɛ, no ji nɔ ni owie.
Kaashe mɛi aŋɔɔ ni obaaya lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ, mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere bo.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kpã enine mli, ni ekɛta minaabu he, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ewo onaa.
Ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, mihã bo hewalɛ yɛ maji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ anɔ, koni ofãmɔ nii, ni okumɔ oshwie shi, koni okpãtã hiɛ, ni obutu, ni osaa otswa oma shi ni otɛo ekoŋŋ.” Ninai Enyɔ komɛi Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Yeremia, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Blɔfoŋkatiɛtso nine ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ miishi miwiemɔi lɛ ahe kpe bɔ ni afee ni mahã aba mli.” Yehowa kɛ mi wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa lɛ?” Mihere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Miina kukwɛi ko ni emli nii miitswa.
Kukwɛi lɛ hiɛ miikwɛ biɛgbɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Sane fɔŋ baajɛ kooyigbɛ aba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, miitsɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji srɔtoi lɛ anɔ bii koni amɛba, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi aaama Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ anaa kɛ egbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpe.
Amɛbaatua Yuda maji wuji lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Mibagbala miwebii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ akɛni amɛkwa mi, ni amɛyashã tsofakɛŋmai amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji efee amãgãi, ni amɛja amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo Yeremia miamɔ, tee shi koni oyakɛɛ amɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mibafã bo akɛ okɛɛ lɛ.
Otsui akafã yɛ amɛhewɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mahã ojija yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Naa, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ mihã otsɔ̃ tamɔ maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo he, tamɔ dade akulashiŋ, tamɔ akɔɔble gbogbo koni okɛ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ elumɛi kɛ esɔfoi kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ana.
Amɛbaate shi amɛwo bo, shi amɛyeŋ onɔ kunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ koni mahere bo.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɔ Israelbii Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa, koni oyashiɛ owo Yerusalɛmbii atoiiaŋ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mikaiɔ oblayeiaŋ anɔkwa ni oye mi lɛ, kɛ osuɔmɔ tamɔ ayɛmforo suɔmɔ lɛ.
Mikaiɔ bɔ ni onyiɛ misɛɛ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni aduko nii yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji Israel hã Yehowa, eŋmãakpamɔ mli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaata ehe lɛ baaye sɔ̃.
Ni sane fɔŋ baaye amɛ, Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.’ ” Esha ni Israelbii ablema tsɛmɛi lɛ fee Nyɛ Yakob shwiei, nyɛ Israel akutseiaŋ wekui, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ na yɛ mihe; hewɔ ni amɛtse amɛhe yɛ mihe kɛtee flɛŋŋ, ni amɛyadi yakayakanii asɛɛ ni ehã amɛtsɔ̃mɔ yakayakanii nɛɛ?
