Amɛbiii akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ Yehowa mɔ ni jie wɔ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɔ ni nyiɛ wɔhiɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni nyiɛ wɔhiɛ yɛ shiaŋa kɛ enɔ buibui lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ko ni nu bɛ nɔ ni enɔ ewo duŋ kpii, shikpɔŋ ko ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ kɛho, he ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ahi lɛ?’ Mikɛ nyɛ ba shikpɔŋ ni baa nii nɔ koni nyɛye enɔ ŋmãa kɛ enɔ nibii kpakpai lɛ.
Shi be ni nyɛbashɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛbule mishikpɔŋ lɛ, ni nyɛhã migboshinii lɛ tsɔ̃ musubɔɔnii.
Osɔfoi lɛ po biii akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ Yehowa yɔɔ?’ Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi mla lɛ tete leee mi; maŋnɔyelɔi lɛ tɔ̃ minɔ, ni gbalɔi lɛ gba yɛ Baal hewalɛ naa; ni amɛyadi nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ asɛɛ.” Sane ni Yehowa kɛshiɔ ewebii “Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ lɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛbii abii hu baatao naa.
Nyɛfoa mli kɛyaa Kipro ŋshɔnaa maji amli nyɛyakwɛa, aloo nyɛtsua kɛyaa Kedar hu, ni nyɛyatao mli fitsofitso nyɛkwɛa akɛ nɛkɛ sane ko eba jɛi dã lo?
Ani maŋ ko yɛ ni etsake enyɔŋmɔi pɛŋ?
Tsɛbelɛ nakai nyɔŋmɔi lɛ jeee fɛifɛi!
Shi miwebii lɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ etsake nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Ao!
Ŋwɛi, onaa akpɛ ohe yɛ enɛ hewɔ; ŋmiŋmi amɔ bo, ni ohe ajɔ̃ ohe babaoo, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ miwebii lɛ efee nifɔɔjianii srɔtoi enyɔ: amɛkwa mi, mi, ni mi ji wala nu fɛɛ jɛɛhe lɛ; ni amɛyakpɛkpɛɛ nubui amɛhã amɛhe, nubui ni ejwra ni nyɛɛɛ nu ato.” Nɔ ni anɔkwa ni Israel yeee lɛ gbala kɛba “Ani Israel lɛ, nyɔŋ ni?
Ani nyɔŋ bi ni afɔ yɛ enuŋtsɔ we ni lo?
Mɛɛba mɔ ni etsɔ̃ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ milɛ loo nɛɛ?
Jatai bolɔ wo lɛ; amɛbolɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Amɛkpãtã eshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, emaji lɛ kamɔ shi amaŋfɔ̃i ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.
Asaŋ Memfis kɛ Tahpanhes hii lɛ ejwa opampam.
Israel, aso jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ oyatao nɛkɛ sane ohã ohe akɛ okwa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, be mli ni ekpalaa bo yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ni agbɛnɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ obaana kɛ Ijipt ni oyaa koni oyanu Nilo Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko lɛ?
Loo mɛɛ sɛɛ obaana kɛ Asiria ni oyaa koni oyanu Eufrate Faa lɛ mli nu lɛ eko lɛ?
Bo diɛŋtsɛ onifɔɔjianii lɛ baagbala otoi, ni kwamɔ ni okwa mi lɛ baabu bo fɔ.
Na ole, ni oyoo akɛ kwamɔ ni okwa mi, Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ fɔŋ ni, ni ebaajoo ehã bo.
Mihe gbeyeishemɔ bɛ omli.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.” Israel ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ ejaa Yehowa “Blema ko beebe ni oku opã lɛ, ni otserɛ kpãi ni fimɔ bo lɛ mli, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Misɔ̃mɔɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko!’ Shi gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ yiteŋ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi oyakotoɔ shi ojaa, ni okwaa mi yɛ.
Mitɛo bo akɛ wain tso kpakpa ni jɛ wu kpakpa mli.
Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni ofite otsɔ̃ kooŋ wain tso kwraa nɛɛ?
Kɛji oju ohe ni osha ohe kɛ samla ni naa wa akɛ mɛ tete, mibana otɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ekadi ohe kɛ̃.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɛ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mibuleko mihe, miyajako wɔŋ Baal lɛ?’ Kwɛmɔ ojeŋ ni oba yɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ni ooona ole nɔ ni ofee.
Otamɔ ŋaŋ yooma oblayoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Otamɔ ŋaŋ teji yoo ni ele ŋanɔhilɛ, ni miifu kɔɔyɔɔ mli kɛmitao nuu.
Namɔ baanyɛ ekɔnɔ naa etsi?
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni miitao lɛ ni etɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji etsuiasɛɛyaa be shɛ pɛ, mɛi anine shɛɔ enɔ.
Israel, kwɛmɔ koni okahiɛ onane folo, asaŋ koni osɛ̃ŋ akagbi kɛ kumai.
Shi okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ?
Ejaakɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi misumɔɔ, ni amɛsɛɛ manyiɛ.’ ” Israel sa toigbalamɔ “Bɔ ni kɛji amɔ julɔ ni ehiɛ gboɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ Israelbii ahiɛ baagbo, maŋbii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ amɛlumɛi kɛ amɛsɔfoi kɛ amɛgbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛɔ tso akɛ, ‘Mitsɛ ji bo’ kɛ mɛi hu ni kɛɔ tɛ akɛ, ‘Bo ofɔ mi’ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baagbo, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ, shi jeee amɛhiɛ amɛhã mi.
Shi amɛfimɔ be mli lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Tee shi, ni ohere wɔyiwala.’ “Shi Yuda, nɛgbɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni ofee ohã ohe lɛ yɔɔ?
Amɛte shi akɛ amɛaanyɛ oyiwala amɛhere yɛ ofimɔ be lɛ mli lo?
Ao!
Yuda, te nyɔŋmɔi ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ maji ni oyɔɔ lɛ ayibɔ nɔŋŋ?
Mɛɛba mɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ mi lɛ?
Nyɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nyɛtse mihiɛ atua.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yakatswaa po ni mitswia nyɛbii lɛ anii lɛ ejaakɛ no tsakeee amɛ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛdɛŋ klante ni gbegbee nyɛgbalɔi lɛ tamɔ jata kakawua ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ.
Nyɛ, yinɔ nɛɛ nɔ bii, nyɛjwɛŋa Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ ahe.
Ani mitsɔ̃ ŋa nɔ mihã Israelbii lo; loo shikpɔŋ ni enɔ ewo duŋ kpii?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni miwebii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔye wɔhe; wɔbaaa oŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ?” Ani oblayoo hiɛ kpaa ehewulamɔnii anɔ, ani ayɛmforo hiɛ kpaa ekpeemɔ atade nɔ?
Shi mi lɛ miwebii lɛ ahiɛ ekpa minɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ.
Anɔkwa, ole gbɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ ni nine shɛɔ suɔlɔ nɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, yei fɔ̃ji tete po ekase nii kɛjɛ odɛ̃ŋ.
Ohiafoi ni efeko nɔ ko lɛ alá yɛ otade namui lɛ amli, jeee nififiaŋ mina enɛ yɛ shi moŋ, he fɛɛ he; ni okɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko efɔŋ ko.
Eji anɔkwale akɛ Yehowa efo emli ni fu mi lɛ sɛɛ.” Shi naa, mi Yehowa, mibagbala otoi yɛ kɛɛmɔ ni okɛɔ akɛ, “Mifeko esha ko lɛ hewɔ.” Mɛɛba ni olilaa shi sɔŋŋ nɛkɛ, ni otsakeɔ onane nakai?
Ijipt baahã ohiɛ agbo tamɔ bɔ ni Asiria hã ohiɛ gbo lɛ.
Obaajɛ Ijipt oba ni oniji jwere oyiteŋ kɛ awerɛhoo, ejaakɛ mɛi ni ohiɛ kã amɛnɔ lɛ, Yehowa ekwa amɛ, ni nɔ kpakpa ko bɛ ni obaana yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Israel yeee anɔkwa Mi, mibi akɛ, “Kɛji nuu ko shwie eŋa, ni yoo lɛ shi nuu lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ nuu kroko ŋa lɛ, ani nuu lɛ kuɔ esɛɛ eyaŋɔɔ nakai yoo lɛ ekoŋŋ?
Nɔ ko ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ ebuleɔ shikpɔŋ, nɔ ni mimɛi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ lɛ.
Israel te okɛ shieŋtsɛmɛi babaoo eyabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ooku osɛɛ oba miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ?
Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni yɔɔ kpataa lɛ.
Te amɛteŋ he ni akɛ bo ebɔko ajwamãŋ yɛ lɛ?
Otaa gbɛi atoii omɛɔ shieŋtsɛmɛi tamɔ Arabianyo woɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa mli kɛmɛɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ.
Okɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ ni atsi nunɛmɔ naa; ni gbo nu enɛɛɛ nɛɛ; shi ohiɛ yoo ajwamãŋ hiŋmɛi lolo, ni ohiɛ gbooo he.
“Ani otsɛko mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mitsɛ Ataa, bo ji mitsɛ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi, omli fuŋ mi kɛyaŋ naanɔ, ni obɛŋ mi owoŋ omli kɛyaŋ naanɔ?’ Israel, nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ofee nɔ fɔŋ fɛɛ nɔ fɔŋ ni obaanyɛ ofee.” Esa akɛ Israel kɛ Yuda aje amɛhe sɛɛ Yehowa bi mi yɛ Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ akɛ, “Bɛ ona nɔ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ fee lɛ?
No ji bɔ ni etee gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi eyabɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ?
Mi, misusu akɛ kɛji efee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ tete sɛɛ lɛ, ebaaku esɛɛ eba miŋɔɔ; shi ebaaa; ni enyɛmiyoo Yuda hu ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ na nɔ ni Israel fee lɛ.
Ena akɛ ajwamãŋ ni Israel ni yeee anɔkwa bɔ hewɔ lɛ mishwie lɛ akɛ miŋa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israel nyɛmiyoo Yuda ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, eyasheee gbeyei; shi moŋ lɛ hu etee ni eyabɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ eko.
Shi akɛni ajwamãŋbɔɔ efeee lɛ hiɛgbele hewɔ lɛ ekɛ tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ fite gbãlã, ni ebule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Ni yɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Israel nyɛmiyoo ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ, kpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ, shi moŋ kwa ekwa eba miŋɔɔ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa po etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ mlɛo fe Yuda nɔ lɛ.
Yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni oyashiɛ yɛ jɛi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Israel ni yeee ewu anɔkwa, kpalemɔ kɛba miŋɔɔ!
Mituŋ mihiɛ miwoŋ nyɛ ejaakɛ mɔbɔnalɔ ji mi.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Mibɛŋ nyɛ miwoŋ mimli kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ otɔ̃mɔi lɛ anɔ kɛkɛ akɛ oyakpa shi yɛ heihei kɛnyiɛ maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi asɛɛ yɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, ni asaŋ obooo mi toi.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ao!
Nyɛ bii ni yeee anɔkwa, nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa, ejaakɛ mi ji nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ; ni nyɛmaŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɔ kome, ni weku fɛɛ weku mli lɛ maŋɔ gbɔmɛi enyɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba Yerusalɛm.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ni mahã nyɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsui naa nɔkwɛlɔi.
Amɛbaalɛ nyɛ kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ nakai be mli, be ni nyɛfɔfɔi, ni nyɛyi efa pii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, awieŋ Yehowa Kpãŋmɔ Adeka lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ajwɛŋ ehe lɛ, akaiŋ lɛ ni ataoŋ lɛ, ni akpɛŋ ekroko dɔŋŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ abaatsɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ Yehowa Maŋtsɛ Sɛi, ni majimaji bluublu aaabua amɛhe naa kɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm amɛbaja mi.
Amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ efeŋ nɔ ni amɛtsui fɔŋ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Yuda akutso lɛ baaya ayafata Israel akutso lɛ he ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kutuu kɛaaba shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ akɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ nɔ.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ Webii lɛ amãgãjamɔ “Misusu he bɔ ni maŋɔ bo mashi mibii anɔ, ni mahã bo shikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo, gboshinii ko ni yɔɔ fɛo fe majimaji fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni efee mi akɛ oootsɛ mi akɛ, “Mitsɛ Ataa,” ni okpaleŋ yɛ misɛɛ dɔŋŋ; shi bɔ ni yoo ni yeee ewu anɔkwa jeɔ ewu sɛɛ lɛ, Ao!
Israel, nakai oyeko mi anɔkwa.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Anu gbee ko gbɛɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpatai lɛ anɔ.
Israelbii ayaafo kɛ faikpamɔ ni, ejaakɛ amɛba amɛjeŋ gbonyo, ni amɛhiɛ ekpa Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ.
“Ao!
Bii ni yeee anɔkwa nyɛkpalea nyɛbaa!
Matsa anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee hela lɛ.” Nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiba oŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ bo ji Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eji anɔkwa akɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ jamɔ hoo lɛ lakamɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni.
Anɔkwa, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ edɛŋ Israel yiwalaheremɔ yɔɔ.
Shi kɛjɛ wɔblahiiaŋ beebe lɛ nakai hiɛgbejianii, ni ji Baal jamɔ lɛ, eye wɔdɛŋnii fɛɛ ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ gbo he deŋme: amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ.
Nyɛhãa wɔhiɛshishwiemɔ lɛ aha wɔnɔ tamɔ mama, ejaakɛ wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, kɛjɛ wɔblahiiaŋ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔfee esha wɔshi Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni wɔboko Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbee toi.”
Tsuitsakemɔ he ehia Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Israel, kɛji ooku osɛɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ lɛ, ba!
Kɛji ojie omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ kɛje mihiɛ, ni oshashaooo shi, ni kɛji okã kitã akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa’ kɛ onɔkwale fɛɛ, ni okojo yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ohi shi krɔŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ jeŋ maji lɛ aaayɔse amɛjɔɔmɔ yɛ Yehowa mli, ni amɛaajie mi, Yehowa, miyi.” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli bii nɛ, “Nyɛhua nyɛshikpɔŋ ni ahuko nɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkadua nyɛwui lɛ yɛ ŋmei ateŋ.
Nyɛjiea nyɛtsuii amli muji lɛ nyɛshwiea tamɔ afoɔ ketia kɛjieɔ foo koni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahã Yehowa.
Nyɛ Yudahii kɛ nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii, kɛjeee nakai lɛ mimlila lɛ baanina nyɛ tamɔ la yɛ nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ, ni ebaashã nii, mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe.” Aaba abatua Yuda Akɛɛ yɛ Yuda, ni ashiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm hu akɛ, “Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, Abɔ oshe waa akɛ, ‘Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛhãa wɔyaa maji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe lɛ amli!’ Nyɛhãa aflaŋaa atsɔ̃a nyɛ Zion gbɛ, nyɛjoa foi, nyɛyabaa abo!
Nyɛkashashaoa shi, ejaakɛ miihã sane fɔŋ ajɛ kooyigbɛ aba abakpãtã nyɛhiɛ wɛɛ.
Jata ko efã kpo kɛjɛ ekoowie mli kɛmiiba, maji ahiɛkpãtãlɔ ko efã kɛmiiba; Eshi eshihilɛhe lɛ kɛmiiba, ni ebaakpãtã nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, koni nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, hei ni gbɔmɛi ehiŋ dɔŋŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiaa kɛ kpekpe nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ, ni nyɛwoa yara, ejaakɛ Yehowa efoko emli ni fu wɔ waa lɛ sɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ekãafeemɔ baaŋmɛɛ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi; osɔfoi lɛ ahe baajɔ̃ amɛhe, ni gbalɔi ahiɛ baafee amɛ yaa.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ lakamɔ olaka gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii fɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaana toiŋjɔlɛ; no moŋ ji klante ni akɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ nɛɛ?’ ” Be miiba be ni abaakɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii fɛɛ akɛ, “Kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ la efã kɛjɛ shiaŋa kɛ gɔji kɛ amɛyiteiaŋ kplanai lɛ anɔ; eeba ebashwie miwebii lɛ anɔ.
Eeba koni ebasha ŋmaa mli tutuu eshwie koni ŋmaa lɛ he atse.
Kɔɔyɔɔ ni baaba ahã mi lɛ naa wa kwraa fe enɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ji mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaagbala amɛtoi ahã nɛɛ.” Henyɛlɔi basa Yuda yi Naa, henyɛlɔ lɛ efã kɛmiiba tamɔ atatu; etayaa shwiilii lɛ tamɔ lasuogbele; ni ekpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ.
Kpoo hã wɔ.
Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã!
Ao!
Yerusalɛm, fɔ otsuiŋ nishaianii lɛ oshwie, bɔ ni afee ni ahere oyiwala.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po susumɔ fɔ̃ji aaahi oyiŋ kɛyashi?
Gbee ko miigbɛɛ waa kɛjɛ Dan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eekɛɛ akɛ sane fɔŋ ko miijɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ aba.
Akɛɛ maji lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ miiba; asaŋ akɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ mɛi jɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ amɛbasa eyi.
Henyɛlɔi nɛɛ baabolɔ amɛwo Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ayi.
Amɛbaabɔle Yerusalɛm he kɛkpe tamɔ ŋmɔ he bulɔi, ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm tse mihiɛ atua.
Yuda, ojeŋba kɛ onifeemɔnii ji nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ sane eba onɔ nɛɛ.
Ohiɛkpãtãmɔ nɛ, ni eejoo pam, ni eetsu otsui mli.
Yeremia ye emaŋbii ahe ŋkɔmɔ Miigbo!
Miigbo!
Miigbo kɛ ŋkɔmɔ!
Ao!
Mitsui miiwa mihe, mitsui miitswa kplakpla!
Minyɛɛɛ dioo mafee, ejaakɛ miinu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ ta oshebɔɔ.
Amanehulu nyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ tuuŋtu, akpãtã shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ hiɛ; afite mibuui lɛ trukaa, ni hiŋmɛitswaa mli lɛ agbala mibuui lɛ ahe mamai lɛ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ makã he mana ta aflaŋaa, ni manu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛyashi?
Ejaakɛ kwashiai ji miwebii lɛ, amɛleee nii; bii kwashiai ji amɛ, amɛbɛ jwɛŋmɔ.
Amɛhe esa kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ shi ekpakpafeemɔ ebɔ amɛ.
Yeremia ninaa yɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he Mikwɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, naa, ekã shi olɛŋlɛ; ni efee floŋŋ; ni mikwɛ ŋwɛi hu lɛ, la ko bɛ jɛi.
Mikwɛ gɔji lɛ, naa, amɛmiihoso, ni gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ miitsi kɛmiiya kɛmiiba.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, gbɔmɔ kome flo nɛkɛ bɛ he ko he ko; ni loofɔji buublu efiliki kɛtee.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ etsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni enɔ maji lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, yɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ; “Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ moŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mifiteŋ lɛ butuu kɛgbeŋ naa.
Ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni ŋwɛi baadi tũu, ejaakɛ mi, mina mikɛɛ, ni mito miyiŋ momo.
Mishwaŋ mihe, ni mikpaleŋ miyiŋtoo lɛ hu.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ joɔ foi kɛji anu okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi ahe; amɛboteɔ koowieiaŋ, amɛkwɔlɔɔ tɛsai, ajoɔ foi ashiɔ majiaŋ ashwieɔ shi, ni ashiii gbɔmɔ kome nɛkɛ yɛ amɛmli.
Ao!
Yerusalɛm ni oyi etɔ̃, Mɛɛba moŋ ni owula kɛ mama tsuru kɛ shika jwine ni ofolɔ ohiŋmɛii asɛɛ?
Yakatswaa ofeɔ ohe fɛɛfɛo lɛ.
Osuɔlɔi lɛ ekwa bo, ni amɛmiitao bo amɛgbe.
Ejaakɛ minu yoo ni miikɔmɔ he.
Kɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ ekromɔbi kɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Yerusalɛm ni tsui miisu lɛ gbee ni; ni ekpã enijiaŋ eebo akɛ, ‘Kpoo hã mi!
Miinyɔ yɛ mɛi ni gbeɔ mi ahiɛ.’ ”
Esha ni Yerusalɛm fee Nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ Yerusalɛm gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, koni nyɛkadi nɔ ni nyɛbaana.
Nyɛtaoa yɛ Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ akɛ nyɛaana mɔ ko ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane ni taoɔ akɛ eye anɔkwa lo?
Kɛji nyɛaana lɛ, no lɛ mikɛ Yerusalɛm he aaafa lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Wɔna Yehowa” shi amale kitã amɛkãa lɛ.
Ao, Yehowa, aso jeee anɔkwayeli gbɛ okwɛɔ kɛjɛ amɛdɛŋ?
Otswia amɛ nii, shi ewaaa amɛhe.
Oplenee amɛ, shi amɛkɛkaseee nii.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui moŋ fe kũatɛ, ni amɛmiii tsuitsakemɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi ni bɛ gbɛi nɛ: no hewɔ lɛ, amɛleee nii; ejaakɛ amɛleee bɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ akɛ gbɔmɔ aba ejeŋ ehã; amɛleee amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ.
Maya gbɔmɛi wuji lɛ aŋɔɔ koni mikɛ amɛ ayawie; ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛle jeŋba gbɛ ni Yehowa kpaa, ni ji amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ.” Shi amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛkwa Yehowa nɔyeli lɛ.
amɛtserɛ nɔyeli kpãi ni fimɔ amɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, jata ko aaafã kɛaajɛ koo lɛ mli ebagbe amɛ; Klaŋ ko aaajɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ aba ni ebakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Mlaŋtswi ko ewo ka yɛ amɛmaji lɛ ahe; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaajɛ amɛmli aje kpo lɛ, eeetserɛ emli; ejaakɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa tsɔ̃, kwamɔ ni amɛkwa mi lɛ naa wa.
“Te aaafee tɛŋŋ manyɛ mikɛfa bo hu?
Obii lɛ kwa mi, ni amɛtsɛɔ nibii ni jeee nyɔŋmɔi amɛkɛkãa kitã.
Kɛji mihã amɛ nii amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛje mi, amɛwu lɛ, sɛɛ amɛtee ajwamãŋi awe.
Okpɔŋɔhii ni alɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ni, ni eko fɛɛ eko bolɔɔ kɛnyiɛɔ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, ‘Mikagbala amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni mikɛtɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ nɔ lo?’ “Abote ewain tromi lɛ amli ni afolɔ waintsei lɛ ashwie, shi moŋ akafite tromi lɛ kwraa kɛmɔ shi.
Akplɔ etsei aniji lɛ ashwie.
Ejaakɛ amɛjeee mi, Yehowa, minii.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ yeee mi anɔkwa kwrakwra, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa kwa Israel Yehowa webii lɛ emale yɛ Yehowa he, ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Efeŋ wɔ nɔ ko; nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ; ta ko ebaninaŋ wɔ, ni wɔyeŋ hɔmɔ hu.
Gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔ baatsɔ̃ kɔɔyɔɔ, ejaakɛ jeee Yehowa naa wiemɔi amɛwie lɛ.
Bɔ ni abaafee amɛ nɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Akɛni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ewie wiemɔi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa Yeremia, miihã miwiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ la yɛ odaaŋ, ni maŋbii lɛ baatsɔ̃ lai, ni la lɛ baashã amɛ wɛɛ.
Nyɛ Israelbii, naa, miihã maŋ ko ajɛ shɔŋŋ aba koni ebatua nyɛ.
Eji blema maŋ, ni ehe wa naakpa; maŋ ko ni nyɛnuuu ewiemɔ, ni kɛji awie tete lɛ nyɛnuuu shishi.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Amɛgãimlibii akotoku lɛ tamɔ gbonyobu ni naa kã.
Hii kãkãlɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ, ni amɛbaaye nyɛŋmɔshinii ni nyɛkpa kɛ niyenii fɛɛ, ni amɛbaagbegbee nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ amɛye; amɛbaagbegbee nyɛtoi kɛ tsinai amɛye, ni amɛbaaye nyɛwaintsei kɛ agbãmitsei ayibii fɛɛ; ni nyɛmaji ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ, amɛbaafite fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛ̃lɛ nakai be lɛ mli po lɛ, mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ kɛwulaŋ shi.
Ni, Yeremia, kɛji omaŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “ni mɛni hewɔ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ye wɔ nɛkɛ sane?” lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkwa mi, Yehowa, ni nyɛyaja maŋsɛɛbii anyɔŋmɔi yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nyɛbaaya nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ maŋsɛɛbii yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ejeee nyɛnɔ nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ewebii kɔkɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ, ni nyɛkɛa Yuda shwiei lɛ hu akɛ, nyɛboa enɛ toi koo!
Kwashiai ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni nyɛyɔɔ hiŋmɛii shi nyɛnaaa nii, asaŋ nyɛyɔɔ toii hu shi nyɛnuuu nii.
Ani nyɛsheee mi gbeyei; nyɛhe kpokpooo yɛ mi, mihiɛ?
Mi, ni mikɛ shia fo husu mikɛsa ŋshɔ naa, naanɔ husu ko ni ŋshɔ nyɛŋ eteke kɔkɔɔkɔ, husu ko ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ŋshɔkei aaashimɔ lɛ ahã lɛ, amɛnyɛŋ amɛwule lɛ, ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ŋshɔ aaafee hamahama ahã lɛ enyɛŋ lɛ eteke lɛ?
Shi nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni atuatselɔi ni; amɛgba afã, ni amɛshi mi amɛtee.
Amɛkɛɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔshea Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbeyei, lɛ mɔ ni ehãa nu nɛɔ Gbo kɛ Agbiɛnaa yɛ ebe mli hãa wɔ lɛ, ni ehãa nikpamɔ bei baninaa wɔ lɛ.’ Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ eŋmɛɛ nyɛ, ni nyɛhe eshai lɛ ehã nɔ kpakpa ebɔ nyɛ.
“Ejaakɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ; amɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi ka tamɔ loofɔlɔdulɔi woɔ antɛo lɛ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔnei amɛkɛduɔ gbɔmɛi.
Amɛshĩai amli eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ mɔshishiumɔ tamɔ loofɔlɔ tsu ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ loofɔji.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛna nii, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi wuji, amɛshwishwii, ni amɛhewolo hiɛ kpɛlɛɔ; amɛyeɔ sane fɔŋ hoɔ he, ni amɛkojooo yɛ jalɛ naa amɛhãaa awusa, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã lɛ; amɛfãaa ohiafo gbɛnaa he amɛhãaa lɛ hu.
“Mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, ‘Mikagbala amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ, ni mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo?
Afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ gbeyeinii yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Gbalɔi lɛ gbaa amale gbalɛi, ni nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ osɔfoi lɛ no osɔfoi lɛ feɔ, ni nɔ ni afeɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ hu anaa.
Shi kɛji naagbee be lɛ shɛ lɛ, te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ?’ ”
Henyɛlɔi basa Yerusalɛm yi Ao!
Nyɛ Benyaminbii, nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Yerusalɛm ni nyɛhere nyɛyiwala.
Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Tekoa, nyɛkɛ lasu pukɔŋŋ atoa okadi yɛ Bet-Hakerem, ejaakɛ sane fɔŋ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ kpeteŋkple miibu tamɔ oblɔtu kɛmiijɛ kooyigbɛ kɛmiiba.
Mibakpãtã Zion maŋ Yerusalɛm ni he yɔɔ fɛo ni ehe yɔɔ akɔnɔ lɛ hu hiɛ.
Lumɛi kɛ amɛwebii baaba abatua lɛ; amɛbashishii amɛbuui kɛbɔle Yerusalɛm kpula, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baato eniyenii he ni esumɔɔ.
Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhoa ta nyɛwoa lɛ; nyɛtea shi koni wɔfã ta lɛ kɛyatua lɛ shwane!” Shi amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã wɔ kɛji wɔtee benɛ ejaakɛ je miina, ni hiɛ miibu ni gbɛkɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ elɛɛ shi kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Belɛ nyɛhãa wɔtea shi, ni wɔfã nyɔɔŋ kɛyatuaa lɛ, ni wɔkpãtã emɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ ahiɛ!” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛtoa Yerusalɛm he tsei lɛ nyɛshwiea shi, koni nyɛkɛtswaa kpokui nyɛkɛsaa Yerusalɛm yi.
Maŋ ni abaagbala etoi ni, ejaakɛ anaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ mli fe yiwalɛ saneyeli sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.
Bɔ ni nubu baa emli nu yi koni ehi krɔŋŋ lɛ, nakai Yerusalɛm baa enifɔɔji anii lɛ ayi.
Henitswiamɔ kɛ niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ he anuɔ yɛ mli; ni hela kɛ pilamɔi sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ minaa yɛ mli.
Ao, Yerusalɛm, kwɛmɔ ni ahi; kɛjeee nakai lɛ mibashi bo, ni mibafee bo amaŋfɔ̃, ni oootsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ nɔ.” Israel tse atua Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Abɛɛ Israelbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ashishi kwraa tamɔ ayeɔ kpɛkpɛo yɛ waintsei anɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkpaa tso niji lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ koni nyɛtserɛ yibii fɛɛ yibii yɛ tsei lɛ anɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wainyibiitselɔ feɔ lɛ.
“Namɛi mikɛaawie, ni mabɔ amɛ kɔkɔ, ni amɛaabo mi toi?
Naa, amɛtoii etsimɔ no hewɔ lɛ, amɛnuuu nɔ.
Naa, Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli sane ehã amɛ, ni amɛnaaa he miishɛɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ mi hu mimli ewo la naakpa tamɔ Yehowa nɔŋŋ; ni mlila lɛ naatsii etɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Fɔsemɔ mimlila lɛ oshwie gbekɛbii ni yɔɔ blohuiaŋ kɛ oblahii akui lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ.
Abaamɔmɔ nuu kɛ eŋa fɛɛ kɛya, ni hiimeji kɛ mɛi ni egbɔlɔ kotokoto hu abaamɔmɔ amɛ.
Amɛshĩai kɛ amɛŋmɔji kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ aaatsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krokomɛi moŋ anii, ejaakɛ mibagbala shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii lɛ atoi.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miishishiu mɛi koni ekɛna nii; ni kɛjɛ gbalɔ nɔ kɛyashi osɔfo nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shihilɛ mli lɛ kutumpɔo sɔŋŋ ni.
Amɛtsaa miwebii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Omanye ei!
Omanye ei!’ Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.
Kɛji amɛfee nihiinii lɛ, ani amɛhiɛ gboɔ he?
Dabida, amɛhiɛ gbooo he ekome folo nɛkɛ; amɛhiɛgbele tɔ ejwa.
No hewɔ lɛ, be mli ni mibagbala miwebii lɛ atoi lɛ, amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe.
No baafee amɛnaagbee.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Israel kwa Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyadamɔa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛkwɛ.
Nyɛbia he ni blema gbɛi ni ja lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni ji gbɛ kpakpa lɛ yɔɔ koni nyɛnyiɛ no nɔ, ni nyɛsusumai atsuii aaanyɔ amɛmli.” Shi hetoo ni amɛhã ji, “Wɔnyiɛŋ nɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miito bulɔi mahã nyɛ, ni miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ toi, ni nyɛye nɔ.’ Shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔboŋ toi!’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ, majimaji kɛ asafoi, nyɛboa nɔ ni baaba gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ toi.
Shikpɔŋ, bo toi!
Miihã hiɛkpãtãmɔ abanina gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ no ji yibii ni amɛjeŋba ewo; ejaakɛ miwiemɔi lɛ amɛboko toi, ni amɛkwa mimlai lɛ.
Mɛni mifeɔ krɔbɔo ni jɛ Sheba, kɛ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ sinamon ni jeɔ ŋma he?
Shãa afɔlei ni nyɛshãa nyɛhãa mi lɛ, miheee; nyɛkooloo afɔlei lɛ hu esaa mihiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mato gbɔmɛi nɛɛ pampi, ni amɛbatɛrɛ ni tsɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ kuuŋnyo kɛ naanyo fɛɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã.’ ” Aaajɛ kooyigbɛ abatua Yerusalɛm Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mɛi komɛi miijɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba; maŋ wulu ko miifã kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe tɔ̃ɔ kɛba.
Amɛhiɛ gãi kɛ akplɔ, amɛyi wa, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ ni amɛnyiɛmɔ gbɛɔ hoo tamɔ ŋshɔ.
Amɛtara okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛgba ta kɛmiiba; amɛkɛ bo Zion, miiba abawu.” Yerusalɛm kɛɛ, “Wɔnu amɛhe momo; ni no ehã wɔnijiaŋ eje wui, ni wɔtsui efã, ni tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ ni ebaafɔ!
Ehiii wɔ kpojee kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ yaa, tɛmpɔŋi lɛ anɔ nyiɛmɔ hu ebɔ wɔ, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ efã klante, ni he fɛɛ he efee gbeyei.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ao, mimaŋbii, nyɛkɔlɔa kpekpe nyɛbumɔa, nyɛkokloa shi yɛ lamlu mli, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa waa tamɔ afoɔ bi koome ni egbo, ejaakɛ hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ baaba ebatua nyɛ trukaa.” “Mifee bo tamɔ shikakalɔ yɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ koni okpa amɛ shi ni ona bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.
Kaniŋkajelɔi kpanakui sɔŋŋ ji amɛ, ni amɛtsui wa tamɔ akɔɔble loo dade.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔfitelɔi ji amɛ, amɛyeɔ mɛi ahe osheku kɛfoɔ shi.
Afoto lɛ miihuu la lɛ waa diɛŋtsɛ, ni la lɛ eŋãla sumui lɛ fɛɛ.
Yakatswaa akã he atsuuɔ sumui lɛ he lɛ, ejaakɛ anyɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi gbohii lɛ ajie yɛŋ ashwie.
Atsɛɔ amɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi shishi, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpoo amɛ.”
Yeremia shiɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ, -“Yaadamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ mli koni owie wiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi.
Nyɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɛkɛ agboi nɛɛ amli nyɛyajaa Yehowa, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ toi.
Nyɛsaa nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii hu, ni mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ biɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ akafɔ̃a nɛkɛ lakamɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ!
Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ!
Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we nɛ!’ “Shi moŋ kɛji nyɛtsake nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛji nyɛkojo mɔ kɛ enaanyo teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa, kɛji nyɛyeee gbɔ loo awusã loo okulafo amim, ni nyɛshwieee mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ ko lá shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ biɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyajaaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi nyɛkɛfeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe efɔŋ lɛ, no lɛ mahã nyɛhi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mijɛ jeeŋmɔ mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ kɛya naanɔ.
“Naa, nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ lakamɔ wiemɔi ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ anɔ.
Aso nyɛaaju, ni nyɛaagbe gbɔmɔ, ni nyɛaafite gbãlã, ni nyɛaakãmɔ amale kitãi, ni nyɛaashã tsofakɛŋma nyɛkɛhã Baal, ni nyɛaayaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni nyɛleee, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛba nyɛbadamɔ mihiɛ yɛ mishĩa nɛɛ ni nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhe eje mli;’ kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nyɛtee nyɛyafee nihiinii ni mihiɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ lo?
Aso nɛkɛ mishĩa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ julɔi ateemɔhe yɛ nyɛhiɛ lo?
Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mina nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ momo.
Nyɛyaa miwe lɛ ni yɔɔ Shilo lɛ, he ni aja mi yɛ tsuutsu lɛ, nyɛyakwɛa nɔ ni mifee yɛ jɛi yɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ hewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛfee nibii gbohii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie aahu, shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni mitsɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhereee mi nɔ lɛ, hewɔ lɛ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mifee Shilo lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mibafee mishĩa nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Mibashwie nyɛ kɛje mihiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mishwie nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Efraim shwiei lɛ fɛɛ kɛje mihiɛ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ atoigbele lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Bo lɛ kaasɔle okpa fai ohã nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ.
Kaafo, ni okasɔle hu ohã amɛ; kaadamɔ mli ohã amɛ yɛ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ miboŋ bo toi.
Ani onaaa nibii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli, kɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ amli lɛ?
Gbekɛbii lɛ yalɛɔ lai kɛbaa, ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛreɔ la lɛ, ni yei lɛ kpɔtɔɔ ma lɛ ni akɛshãa aboloo akɛyahãa jemawɔŋ yoo ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ Ŋwɛi Maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni amɛfɔseɔ dãa amɛshwieɔ shi akɛ afɔle amɛkɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi koni amɛkɛwo mimli la.
Shi mi, Yehowa, miibi akɛ, ‘Aso mi, mimli la amɛwoɔ lɛ lo?’ Ani jeee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe mlila amɛwoɔ, ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hiɛgbele lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mimli baafu, ni mimli baawo Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ, gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ŋa nɔ tsei kɛ ŋmɔshi niyenii fɛɛ la.
Mimlila lɛ naa baawa tamɔ la ni miitso, ni anyɛŋ agbe.’ ” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛkɛ shãa afɔlei lɛ afata kooloo afɔlei lɛ ahe koni nyɛye loo lɛ; ejaakɛ be ni miyajie nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ ewieee he, ni asaŋ miwooo amɛ kitã ko yɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloo afɔle shãa he.
Shi moŋ miwo amɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Nyɛyea migbee nɔ, ni matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛbaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ kitãi ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã nyɛ.’ Shi amɛbooo mi toi lɛ, amɛyeee migbee nɔ hu; shi moŋ amɛyanyiɛ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ amɛtsuii fɔ̃ji ni wa lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ sɛɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛjeŋba fite fe tsutsu lɛ.
Kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mikã he miitsu mitsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ amɛŋɔɔ be fɛɛ be, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛbooo mi toi, ni amɛyeee migbee nɔ; shi moŋ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛfee nifɔɔjianii fe amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete.
“No hewɔ lɛ, Yeremia, okɛ amɛ baawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛ, shi amɛboŋ bo toi; ni kɛji otsɛ amɛ hu amɛhereŋ bo nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe maŋ ni booo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ.
Anɔkwale egbo yɛ nyɛteŋ, atsiii tã dɔŋŋ po.’ ” Eshai ni afeɔ yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli “Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛkua nyɛyi nyɛshwiea, nyɛwoa yara yɛ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ekwa, ni ekpoo yinɔbii ni emli efu amɛ nɛɛ!
“Ejaakɛ Yudabii lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi ni mihiɔ lɛ eyamamɔ miSɔlemɔ we ni ajaa mi yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛbule jɛi.
Ni amɛyama afɔleshãa latɛ yɛ Tofet yɛ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni amɛgbe amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei amɛkɛshã afɔle.
Enɛ ji nɔ ko ni mifãko akɛ afee; ebako miyiŋ tete po.
Naa, gbii miiba, ni atsɛŋ jɛi akɛ Tofet loo Hinom Jɔɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ abaatsɛ jɛi Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ, akɛni jɛi abaafu gbohii yɛ; ejaakɛ he kroko bɛ ni aaafu amɛ yɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ gbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwieŋ amɛ.
Mafo nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohui fɛɛ amli.
Anuŋ ayɛmforo kɛ ayɛmforo wu gbee dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.”
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, abaaloo Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii akromɔbii fɛɛ awui yɛ amɛgbonyobui lɛ amli.
Abaagbɛ wui nɛɛ amli aka hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii, ni ji nibii ni amɛsumɔ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ ni amɛja amɛ lɛ.
Abuaŋ amɛwui nɛɛ anaa, ni afuŋ hu; shi moŋ amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ yɛ tumo nɔ.
Jaku fɔŋ nɛɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni aaashwɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ, amɛaashwe akɛ amɛgboi fe nɔ ni amɛaahi wala mli.
Mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɛ.” Esha kɛ ehe toigbalamɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Aso kɛji agbee shi lɛ, ateee shi?
Aloo kɛji adu gbɛ lɛ akuuu sɛɛ?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ, ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ egba afã, ni amɛka jɛi kwraa nɛɛ?
Amɛhiɛ shishiumɔ mli kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kpalemɔ.
Mikɛ tsuishitoo bo amɛ toi; shi amɛwieee anɔkwale.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni nifɔɔjianii ni efee lɛ edɔ lɛ, ni no ehã etsake etsui.
Shi moŋ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni mifee?’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ tamɔ bɔ ni okpɔŋɔ shaa foi kitikiti kɛboteɔ ta mli lɛ.
Klitso ni ji loofɔlɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi tete le be ni esa akɛ eku esɛɛ eba; nakai nɔŋŋ kosɛɛ okpo hu kɛ nyɔŋmɔbitɛte kɛ kpokukpoku fɛɛ le amɛbaabe; shi mimɛi lɛ leee mi, Yehowa, mimlai lɛ.
Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔ lɛ wɔle nii, ni Yehowa mla lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ’ lɛ?
Naa, woloŋmalɔi lɛ kɛ amɛmale niŋmaa ehã mla lɛ etsɔ̃ amale mla.
Nilelɔi nɛɛ abaawo amɛ hiɛgbele, amɛbaajijaa, ni abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ.
Belɛ nɛgbɛ amɛnilee lɛ yɔɔ mɔ?
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛŋamɛi lɛ mahã mɛi krokomɛi; ni mikɛ amɛŋmɔji lɛ baahã mɛi ni baaye amɛnɔ kunim lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ joɔ; ni kɛjɛ gbalɔ nɔ kɛyashi osɔfo nɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shishiuɔ mɔ.
Amɛmiitsa mimaŋbii lɛ apilamɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ, ni amɛkɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Omanye ei!
Omanye!’ Be mli ni omanye ko kwraa bɛ.
Ani kɛji amɛfee musubɔɔnii lɛ, efeɔ amɛ hiɛgbele?
Dabida!
Efeee amɛ hiɛgbele kome folo nɛkɛ, ejaakɛ amɛhiɛgbele tɔ ejwa.
Be mli ni mibagbala amɛtoi lɛ, abaabutu amɛ, ni amɛbaafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi lɛ ahe.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ, “Be ni miba miwebii lɛ anaabuamɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ waintsei ni wainyibii bɛ nɔ, loo agbãmi tsei ni agbãmi bɛ nɔ, ni amɛnɔ bai tete eŋãla; ni nii ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ hu eje amɛdɛŋ.” Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba mɔ wɔtara shi nɛkɛ lolo?
Nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa; nyɛhãa wɔbotea maji ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ amli koni wɔhiɛ ayakpãtã yɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ wɔhe ehã hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ehã wɔ nu ni awo mli ebɔɔ koni wɔnu, ejaakɛ wɔtɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ.
Wɔkwɛ toiŋjɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa, wɔkwɛ tsamɔ gbɛ, shi naa, tsuifãa moŋ ni pue.
Anuɔ henyɛlɔi lɛ akpɔŋɔi lɛ atsinemɔ kɛjɛɔ Dan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ kpokpoɔ kɛji amɛkpɔŋɔhii lɛ bolɔ.
Amɛmiiba amɛbakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ, naa, miiwo onufui agbɛ kɛba nyɛteŋ, ni ji blikai, ni ŋkunyaayeli ko ŋkunyaayeli ko nyɛɛɛ amɛhe ajɔɔ koni amɛbakɔ̃mɔ nyɛ.” Yeremia ye emaŋbii ahe ŋkɔmɔ Mikɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ anyɛŋ atsa, mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli.
Naa, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei fɛɛ, minuɔ mimaŋbii abolɔmɔ akɛ, “Ani Yehowa bɛ Zion lo?
Zion maŋtsɛ lɛ bɛ Zion?” Yehowa, amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, to he akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛwo mi mlifu kɛ maŋsɛɛ amãgãi ni nyɛkotoɔ ni nyɛjaa lɛ?” Maŋbii lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Nikpamɔbe lɛ eho, ni atse nii agbe naa, ni ahereko wɔyiwala.” Mitsui ekumɔ yɛ mimli, yɛ mimaŋbii ahejaramɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Miiye ŋkɔmɔ; mihe ejɔ̃ mihe.
Ani tsofa bɛ Gilead lo?
Tsofatsɛmɛi bɛ jɛi lo?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni atsako mimaŋbii lɛ?
Mina ni kulɛ miyitso lɛ nubu ni; ni mihiŋmɛii hu nuhiŋmɛii ni koni mikɛfo mimaŋbii ni enyɔnyɔi lɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ gbɛnyiɛlɔi atoohe yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ he ko, koni mashi mimaŋbii ateŋ maya jɛi.
Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ gbãlãfitelɔi ji amɛ; kutumpɔfoi asafo ji amɛ.
Amɛlilɛi edɔrɔ tamɔ gãitso; amale ehe shi waa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fe anɔkwayeli moŋ.
“Amɛjɛɔ nɔ fɔŋ kome he kɛyaa ekroko he, ni amɛleee mi po.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ehe ni ahi yɛ enaanyo hewɔ; mɔ ko kɛ ehe akafɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ etsɔ̃ ehe shishiulɔ, ni naanyo fɛɛ naanyo etsɔ̃ mɔ he oshekuyelɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ shishiuɔ enaanyo, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ewieee anɔkwale; amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛlilɛi malemɔ; amɛfeɔ efɔŋ, ni amɛmiii tsuitsakemɔ.
Yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔnii ni amɛfeɔ nɔtoonɔtoo hewɔ lɛ, amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛaale mi.
Yehowa kɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, matsuu amɛhe koni maka amɛ yɛ la mli makwɛ, ejaakɛ mɛni dɔŋŋ manyɛ mafee yɛ miwebii nɛɛ ahewɔ?
Gãimlibi ni gbeɔ mɔ ji amɛlilɛi; kutumpɔo wiemɔ pɛ ele.
Mɔ kɛ enaanyo wieɔ kɛ naajɔlɛ tsɛbelɛ ewo lɛ ka yɛ etsuiŋ.
Aso mikagbala amɛtoi yɛ enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ?
Mikatɔ mihe owele yɛ maŋ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɔ lo?
Mi, Yehowa, miibi.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mawo yara mafo gɔji lɛ waa, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ kooloi aniyelihei lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ jɛi fɛɛ eŋãla, ni mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ jɛi kɛhooo dɔŋŋ.
Anuuu tsinai agbee yɛ jɛi; ni jwɛiaŋ loofɔji kɛ kooloi tete ejo foi kɛshi jɛi amɛtee.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ maŋ koikoi, ebaatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe.
Yuda maji lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.” Kɛkɛ ni mibi akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ mɛɛ hewɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã, ni etsɔ̃ shiaŋa ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo nɛɛ?
Namɔ ji nilelɔ ni aaanu enɛ shishi?
Namɔ ji mɔ ni bo Yehowa ojie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni egba?” Yehowa here nɔ akɛ, “Enɛ fɛɛ hewɔ ni mimɛi lɛ ekwa mimlai ni miwo amɛ lɛ; ni amɛbooo migbee toi, ni amɛfeee bɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Shi moŋ amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ fee nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ, ni amɛyaja Baal amãgã lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ amɛfee lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ ji enɛ, “Naa, mibalɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ taatso, ni mahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu.
Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã maji anɔ, hei ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee; mahã henyɛlɔi afã klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maplenee amɛ kwraa.” Yerusalɛm maŋbii bolɔ amɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa sane lɛ he, ni nyɛtsɛa yarayei kɛbaa; nyɛtsua koni ayaŋɔa yei ni ahe esa kɛ yara nɔ lala kɛba.” Maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa amɛhe afea oya ni amɛla yarafeemɔ lala yɛ wɔ wɔhewɔ, koni wɔhiŋmɛii afɔse yaafonu ashwie shi, ni wɔhiŋmɛinaatsɔi atsere kɛ yaafonu.” Ejaakɛ wɔnu yaafo blɔmɔ kɛjɛ Zion akɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni akpãtã wɔhiɛ ahã.
Ashwie wɔhiɛ shi naakpa, akɛ ahã wɔshi wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni akumɔ wɔshĩai lɛ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Awomɛi nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ni nyɛhãa ewiemɔ lɛ abotea nyɛtoiiaŋ.
Nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛbiyei lɛ yarawoo, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ɔ enaanyo yaafo lala.
Ejaakɛ gbele ekwɔ kɛtsɔ̃ samfɛji amli kɛbatua wɔ, ni ebote wɔmaŋtsɛ wei amli ebaplenee gbekɛbii yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni ekpãtã oblahii hu ahiɛ yɛ blohui amli.” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mikɛɛ nɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbohii baajwere shi yɛ ŋa nɔ tamɔ tumo ni ashwã awo ŋmɔ mli, loo tamɔ ŋmaa nyaŋkui jwereɔ shi yɛ ŋmaakpalɔi asɛɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaabua naa.
Nilelɔ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ enilee nɔ.
Hewalɔ hu akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ ehewalɛ nɔ, ni niiatsɛ akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ eninamɔ nɔ; shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ̃, enɛ moŋ nɔ; akɛ ele mi, ni enuɔ mi shishi, akɛ mi ji Yehowa ni misuɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo, ni miyeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahe moŋ minyaa.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, be miiba ni mibagbala Israelbii ni efo ketia lɛ atoi ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ mɛi ni efoko ketia lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Mibagbala Ijipt kɛ Yuda kɛ Edombii kɛ Amonbii kɛ Moabbii kɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ bii ni shɛɔ amɛyitsei ahe lɛ hu atoi, ejaakɛ maji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni Israelbii lɛ hu tsuiŋ foolɔi ji amɛ.”
Amãgãjamɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ lɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkakasea maji krokomɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni nyɛkashea ŋwɛi okadii gbeyei, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ji mɛi ni sheɔ nomɛi gbeyei.
Amɛkusumi lɛ lakamɔ ni; amɛyafoɔ tso yɛ koo mli kɛbaa ni ŋaalɔ kɛ lema gbɔɔ, amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika shwieɔ he kɛwulaa lɛ, ni akɛ hamle kɛ plɛkoo kalaa lɛ kpɛtɛɔ shi koni ekagbee shi.
Amɛmãgãi nɛɛ tamɔ blantu ni akɛshwieɔ kooloi yɛ waatrɛ ŋmɔ mli, amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛwie; ni holemɔ aholeɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛnyiɛ.
Nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ efɔŋ ko amɛfee lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ ekpakpa hu amɛfee.
Yehowa, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo.
Bo lɛ oje agbo, ni ogbɛi hu je agbo, ni eyɛ hewalɛ.
Bo majimaji fɛɛ amaŋtsɛ, namɔ po ni sheŋ bo gbeyei?
Ejaakɛ bo nɔŋŋ pɛ osa woo.
Majimaji lɛ anɔ nilelɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi anɔyelihei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni tamɔ bo.
Buului kɛ kwashiai sɔŋŋ ji amɛ; yakanii amɛkaseɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ tso amãgã dɛŋnii amɛkaseɔ lɛ.
Akɛ jwiɛtɛi ni atswia jɛɔ Tarshish baa, ni akɛ shika jeɔ Ufaz baa.
Tsoŋaalɔ kɛ shikaŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔi ni.
Abuɔ amɛ mama bluu kɛ mama afaseo tsuru, ŋaalɔi ni ahe esa aninenaa nitsumɔ sɔŋŋ ni.
Shi Yehowa ji anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ kɛ Naanɔ Maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Emlifu hãa shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni maji nyɛɛɛ emlila lɛ naa adamɔ.
“Bɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ amɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ ni jeee amɛ amɛbɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ atatuiaŋ fɛɛ.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ lala Yehowa ji mɔ ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ebɔ je lɛ yɛ enilee naa, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli eha nɔ yɛ eŋaa naa.
Kɛji ewo egbeiaŋ lɛ, nu shimɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ; ni ehãa afua teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei lɛ kɛbaa.
Lɛ ehãa srawa gbalaa yɛ nunɛmɔ mli, ahum fãa kɛjɛɔ hei ni ekɛ lɛ eto.
Gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ kwashia ni leee nii ni; shikaŋaalɔ fɛɛ shikaŋaalɔ hiɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ emãgã hewɔ, ejaakɛ emãgãi ni eshwie lɛ apasa ni; ni wala mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.
Yakayaka nibii ni; mɔ akɛlakaa, be ni abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ; ni eŋɔ Israel ekɛfee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
Nomŋɔɔ miiba Bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ maŋ ni asa eyi mli, buamɔ onibii ni jwere shikpɔŋ anaa, ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mibafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ bii tamɔ afɔ̃ɔ aklomia mli tɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ; ni mibahã amɛhe ajara amɛ bɔ ni amɛbaanu he.” Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Kpoo hã wɔ!
Wɔpilamɔ lɛ naa wa!” Shi wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Hejaramɔ nɛ moŋ; shi esa akɛ wɔdamɔ naa.” Afite wɔbuui lɛ ni amɛhe taŋkpei lɛ fɛɛ etserɛ.
Wɔbii lɛ fɛɛ eshi wɔ amɛtee; amɛbɛ he ko he ko.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaashi wɔbuui lɛ dɔŋŋ asaŋ ni eeewo amɛhe mamai lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, “Wɔmaŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kwashiai ni; amɛbiii Yehowa dɛŋ gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni jeŋ ehiii hãaa amɛ, ni wɔmaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ egbɛ eshwã lɛ.
Naa, sane eba, onu he?
Kooyigbɛ maŋ ko miihũu kɛmiiba, eeba koni ebafee Yuda maji lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ koni maji lɛ atsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe.” Ao!
Yehowa, mile akɛ gbɔmɔ adesã gbɛ bɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ; ni adesa bɛ ewala nɔ hewalɛ.
Ao!
Yehowa, kã owebii; shi bɔ ni sa kɛkɛ; jeee yɛ omlifu naa, koni okaplenee wɔ.
Gbalamɔ majimaji lɛ ni leee bo lɛ atoi, ni okɛ mɛi hu ni jaaa bo lɛ aye, ejaakɛ amɛkpãtã Yakob shwiei lɛ ahiɛ, amɛplenee amɛ butuu, ni amɛfee amɛshihilɛhei lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
Yeremia kɛ Kpãŋmɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Bo kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi koni okɛ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ awie.
Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.
Mɔ ni yeee kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ alomɔ lɛ.
Kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, asaŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni amɛhe dɔ la yɛ, tamɔ dade flɔnɔɔŋ lɛ.
Mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛbo migbee toi, ni nyɛye nibii ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ, bɔ ni afee ni matsu kitã ni mikã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ he nii, no ji akɛ mahã amɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni baa nii koni amɛhi nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mihere nɔ akɛ, “Yehowa, aba mli nakai.” Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaashiɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yuda maji kɛ Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa nɛkɛ kpãŋmɔ nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ toi, ni nyɛyea nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mikpã miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoiŋ gbi nɔ ni mijie amɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni mikã he miikpã miiwo amɛtoiŋ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛboa migbee toi.
Shi amɛbuuu, ni amɛbooo toi hu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ tsuiwalɛ fee nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ kpãŋmɔ kome too nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni miwo amɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ amɛye nɔ, shi amɛyeee nɔ lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbala amɛtoi.’ ” Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ etse mihiɛ atua.
Amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛmiifee nibii fɔ̃ji ni amɛblematsɛmɛi ni booo miwiemɔ toi lɛ fee lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Amɛtee amɛmiija nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi.
Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ ekũ mikpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ ji akɛ mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ, ni amɛhe ejeŋ mli.
Amɛbaablɔ amɛtsɛ mi nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛ toi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli bii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ hu baaya amɛyabolɔ amɛtsɛ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa lɛ, shi nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala amɛhere kwraa yɛ amɛfimɔ be lɛ mli.
Ao!
Yuda, onyɔŋmɔi lɛ ayi efa tamɔ omaji lɛ ayifalɛ, ni bɔ ni gbɛjegbɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli lɛ fa lɛ, nakai nyɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nyɛkɛfeɔ hiɛgbejianii, no ji nyɛkɛshãa tsofakɛŋma nyɛhãa Baal.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo, Yeremia, kaakpa mi fai ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; asaŋ kaabolɔ osɔle ohã amɛ, ejaakɛ miboŋ toi be mli ni amɛaatsɛ mi yɛ amɛfimɔ mli lɛ.” Etee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɛnaa misuɔlɔ yɔɔ yɛ miSɔlemɔ we be mli ni eyafee nifɔɔjianii ni mihiɔ lɛ?
Ani naashiwoo kɛ kooloo afɔleshãa baanyɛ atsi hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni baa lɛ naa lo?
Ani omii aaashɛ ohe lo?
Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Yehowa wo bo gbɛi, ‘Mutso ni ebu fɛɛfɛo ni woɔ yibii kpakpai.’ Shi agbɛnɛ Yehowa baahã ahum kpeteŋkple ko agba ni ebaasɔo tso nɛɛ naa la, ni ebaashã kɛ ehe niji fɛɛ.
“Naa, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mɔ ni batɛo bo yɛ biɛ lɛ ewie efɔŋ eshi bo, ejaakɛ Israelbii kɛ Yudabii efee nɔ fɔŋ, no ji akɛ amɛshã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã Baal amɛkɛwo mimli la.” Akpãŋ Yeremia yinɔ Yehowa hã mile, ni esaa eka nɔ ehã mi ekoŋŋ akɛ atee miyinɔ apam, ni miyoo yiŋtoo lɛ.
Mitamɔ too gwantɛŋ ni he jɔ, ni akpala lɛ kɛtee koni ayagbe lɛ.
Shi mileee kwraa akɛ mi mihe ŋaa fɔŋ amɛto be ni akɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔkpatãa tso lɛ kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; nyɛhãa wɔjiea lɛ yɛ hiɛkãalɔi aje lɛ mli koni akakai lɛ kwrakwra dɔŋŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni misɔle nɛkɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bo ni okojoɔ yɛ jalɛ naa, bo ni okaa gbɔmɔ susumɔ kɛ etsui fɛɛ okwɛɔ, hã mana owele ni obaatɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ bo odɛ̃ŋ mitu misane lɛ fɛɛ miwo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Anatotbii lɛ ni tao mi amɛgbe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kaagba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli dɔŋŋ, no lɛ wɔbaagbe bo” lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe nɛ, “Naa, mibagbala amɛtoi, amɛblahii lɛ baagboi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛbihii lɛ kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ baagboi kɛ hɔmɔ, bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko ehaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni mibagbala Anatotbii lɛ atoi lɛ, mibahã sane fɔŋ aye amɛ pam.”
Yeremia bi Yehowa sane Yehowa, kɛji mi kɛ bo taa naa tete lɛ onɔ jaa; kɛ̃lɛ mikɛ mi sane nɛɛ miifɔ̃ ohiɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji agbɛ jaa hãa amɛ, ni kutumpɔfoi shwereɔ lɛ?
Otɛoɔ amɛ, ni amɛfãi mɔmɔɔ shi, amɛdaraa, ni amɛwoɔ yibii.
Amɛwieɔ ohe ekpakpa kɛ amɛnaabu shi amɛtsui mli lɛ, amɛ kɛ bo teŋ jɛkɛ.
Shi, Yehowa, mi lɛ ole mi, ni onaa minifeemɔnii; ni okaa bɔ ni mijwɛŋɔ yɛ ohe okwɛɔ.
Shatãmɔ amɛ kɛya tamɔ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ, ni ojɔɔ amɛnɔ oto kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni abaagbe amɛ lɛ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaagbi, ni ŋa lɛ nɔ jwɛi aaaŋalã kɛyashi?
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ehã enɔ kooloi kɛ loofɔji fɛɛ etã; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Enaŋ bɔ ni wɔnaagbee aaatamɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yeremia, kɛji okɛ gbɔmɛi da foi ni amɛhã eje otsine lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ okɛ okpɔŋɔi ashi mple hu?
Ni kɛji shikpɔŋ trɛnɛɛ nɔ tete ogbee shi yɛ lɛ, te ooofee tɛŋŋ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he koo hayii lɛ amli hu?
Ejaakɛ onyɛmimɛi kɛ otsɛ we lɛ, amɛ tete po amɛkwa bo; ni amɛmiitao bo efɔŋ waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Kɛji amɛdɔkɔ amɛnaa amɛhã bo tete lɛ, kaahe amɛ oye.” Yehowa ye ewebii lɛ ahe ŋkɔmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikwa mimaŋ Israel, mishi migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ sɛɛ, miŋmɛɛ mimaŋ ni misumɔɔ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ lɛ he miwo ehenyɛlɔi adɛŋ.
Mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛwo mi tamɔ koo mli jata, ni amɛbolɔɔ amɛwoɔ mi, no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛɔ amɛ.
Ani mimɛi lɛ etsɔ̃ loofɔlɔ looyelɔ kɛ ehe ŋwãtãŋwãtã ehã mi lo?
Ani loofɔji looyelɔi ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe kpula?
Yaa koni oyabua ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ anaa ni okɛ amɛ aba koni amɛbaye nii.
Tookwɛlɔi babaoo ekpãtã miwain abɔɔ lɛ hiɛ, amɛnaanaa migbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ; amɛhã migbɛfaŋnɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋa kpataa.
Amɛhã etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ekã shi amaŋfɔ̃ eefo eetsɛ mi.
Shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, shi jeee mɔ ko mɔ ko he sane ko ni.
Niiahiɛkpãtãlɔi eba shiaŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji kpataai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã klante miiye nii kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyagbee enaagbeehe kome; adesa ko adesa ko kwraa bɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.
Mimɛi lɛ du ŋmaa; shi amɛkpa ŋmei.
Amɛgbo deŋme; shi amɛnaaa he sɛɛ ko.
Yehowa mlifu lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛbaakpa lɛ baafee amɛ hiɛgbele.” Yehowa wo Israel maji lɛ shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Miyɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛɔ yɛ Israel hewɔ maji fɔ̃ji ni efite shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mimaŋ Israel lɛ ahe.
Naa, mibashwie nakai gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mibahere Yudabii lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Shi be ni mishwie amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe, ni mibaku sɛɛ mikɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni kɛji be ni aaashɛ nakai be lɛ amɛkase mimɛi lɛ ajeŋba, ni amɛkɛ migbɛi aaakã kitã akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ Baal gbɛi kɛ kitãkãmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibaŋɔ amɛ mashi mimɛi lɛ anɔ.’ Shi kɛji maŋ ko booo toi lɛ, no lɛ mafã nakai maŋ lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ he abɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa koni oyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo koni okɛŋmɔ ohɛ; okɛ mama nɛɛ akatsɔ nu mli.” Yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naa lɛ, mitee miyahe hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ, ni mikɛŋmɔ mihɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa Eufrate Faa lɛ naa koni okɛ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ ni oyahe ni ŋmɔ ohɛ lɛ ayatee tɛsaa fɔlɔ ko mli yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, miyi mli mitee, ni mikɛ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ yatee yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa fã mi lɛ.
Gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Tee shi!
Yaa Eufrate Faa lɛ naa koni oyakɔ hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ ni mifã bo akɛ okɛyatee yɛ jɛi lɛ kɛba.” Kɛkɛ ni miyiŋ mitee Eufrate Faa lɛ naa, ni miyatsa hɛŋmɔɔ bo lɛ yɛ he ni mikɛyato lɛ; ni naa bo lɛ efite bɔ ni ehiii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ.
Nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni mibafo Yuda hewoo lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm hu hewoo babaoo lɛ sɛɛ mahã.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ efee amɛhe gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji ni booo miwiemɔi toi.
Amɛkɛ kuɛŋtimɔ feɔ nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsumɔɔ, ni amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ moŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbaatsɔ̃ tamɔ hɛŋmɔɔ bo nɛɛ ni ehiii hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Bɔ ni hɛŋmɔɔ bo kpɛtɛɔ mɔ he lɛ, nakai mihã Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ kpɛtɛ mihe koni amɛtsɔ̃ mimaŋ, koni amɛhã mana gbɛi kɛ yijiemɔ, koni amɛhã mihiɛ aba nyam; shi amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.” Wain Kpulu he abɛ lɛ “Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ: Awo kpulu fɛɛ kpulu obɔ̃ kɛ wain.
Amɛbaakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Aso wɔ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ wɔleee akɛ kpulu fɛɛ kpulu baayi obɔ̃ kɛ wain lo?’ Kɛkɛ lɛ obaakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Naa, mibahã shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atɔrɔ dãa kpɔtɔɔ, kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni ji David shwiei ni bayeɔ esɛɛ anɔ kɛyashi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni mibamɔmɔ tsɛmɛi kɛ bii fɛɛ mikɛtswiatswia amɛhe; ni mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ minaŋ mɔbɔ, ni mikɔ̃ŋ mifiliŋ, ni mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ŋ mi akɛ mikpãtã amɛhiɛ.’ ” Yeremia bɔ hewoo he kɔkɔ Nyɛfea toi ni nyɛbo toi!
Nyɛkawoa nyɛhe ejaakɛ Yehowa ewie.
Nyɛwoa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, hiɛ nyam, be ni ehãko duŋ awo nyɛ, be ni nyɛbɔ̃iko tɛrɛmɔ yɛ gɔji ni anɔ ewo duŋ lɛ anɔ; ni be mli ni okwɛɔ la gbɛ lɛ, ehãa duŋ moŋ woɔ, ni duŋ lɛ woɔ kabitii.
Shi kɛji nyɛbooo toi lɛ, mibafo yɛ teemɔ mli yɛ nyɛhewoo lɛ hewɔ; mibafo bloblo kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ aŋɔ Yehowa webii lɛ nom.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi, ejaakɛ akpa nyɛ lumɔyeli.
Nyɛtaraa humi sɛ̃i nɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnunyam akekre lɛ eje nyɛyitso egbee shi.
Asa Yuda wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ayi, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛ ahere.
Aŋɔ Yuda fɛɛ nom; aŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nom kɛtee.
“Yerusalɛm, wo ohiɛ nɔ koni okwɛ henyɛlɔi ni jɛ kooyigbɛ baa nɛɛ.
Nɛgbɛ mɛi ni akɛhã bo akɛ okwɛ amɛnɔ lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ni ji onunyam lɛ?
Mɛni oookɛɛ kɛji mɛi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ otsɔse amɛ koni amɛfee onanemɛi lɛ, awo amɛ moŋ onukpa yɛ onɔ?
Ani ewaŋ ohe tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ piŋɔ lɛ?
Ni kɛji obi ohe akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nɛkɛ sane eba minɔ?’ lɛ, na ole akɛ onishaianii ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ ni akpa ohe mama, ni ashwie ohiɛ shi nɛɛ.
Ani mɔdiŋ aaanyɛ ehewolo su etsake, aloo mlaŋtswi aaanyɛ ehe truntrãi lɛ etsake?
Kɛji amɛaanyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ mɛi ni efɔŋfeemɔ eka nyɛnɔ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛfee.
Mibagbɛ nyɛ mashwã tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ etswa kɛjɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni mito akɛ mibafee bo, ejaakɛ ohiɛ kpa minɔ, ni okɛ ohiɛ fɔ̃ amale nyɔŋmɔi moŋ anɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ koni ohiɛ ashwie shi.
Mina nii ni mihiɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, kɛ misɛɛ ni ojeɔ ni oyajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi lɛ, kɛ onyɛnyɛŋtswi ni obɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ajwamãŋ ni obɔɔ nyaŋemɔnyaŋemɔ yɛ ŋa nɔ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo, bo Yerusalɛm!
Mɛɛbe abaakã he atsuu ohe kɛyashi?”
Nu hɔmɔ ni naa wa lɛ Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ nu hɔmɔ he nɛ, “Yuda miiye ŋkɔmɔ, egboi anaabulɔi lɛ etɔ biti; amɛjwere shikpɔŋ amɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ, ni Yerusalɛm miibolɔ waa.
Emaŋ abladei lɛ tsuɔ amɛtsuji lɛ faŋŋ; amɛyashɛɔ nubui lɛ anaa, shi amɛnaaa nu; ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaa; kɛ amɛgbɛi foji; amɛhiɛ gboiɔ, amɛluɔ ni amɛhaa amɛyiteiaŋ.
Akɛni nu enɛɛɛ, ni shikpɔŋ egbi keketee hewɔ lɛ, okwaafoi ahiɛ egboi; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛnine etsi amɛhiɛ.
Ofrote yoo tete shiɔ ebi ŋmɔŋ, ejaakɛ jwɛi bɛ he ko he ko ni ayeɔ.
Ŋaŋ tejii damɔɔ gɔji kpataai anɔ, ni amɛhakuɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tamɔ ŋaŋgbei; amɛhiŋmɛii eshiu, ejaakɛ baa kome folo bɛ he ko he ko.
‘Wɔnishaianii lɛ miibu wɔ fɔ moŋ; shi Yehowa, ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ he eko ohã wɔ; tsɛbelɛ wɔsɛɛsɛɛyaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃, ni wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ao!
Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, bo ni ohereɔ eyiwala yɛ fimɔ be mli, mɛɛba ofee tamɔ gbɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, loo tamɔ gbɛnyiɛlɔ ni gbaa eyatoɔ gbɛkɛ toohe nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba ofee tamɔ nuu ni elu tamɔ kãkãlɔ ni nyɛɛɛ mɔ yiwala ehere nɛɛ?
Ao!
Yehowa oyɛ wɔteŋ tuuŋtu ni ogbɛi akɛwo wɔ; kaashi wɔ.’ ” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe nɛ, “Nɛkɛ amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛkpa shi, ni etɔɔɔ amɛ kɛ shikpaa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mihereŋ amɛ atuu dɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ mibakai amɛnishaianii lɛ moŋ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaakpa ejurɔyeli he fai ohã maŋ nɛɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ amɛbaahi ŋmaa nɛ, shi miboŋ amɛfaikpamɔ blɔmɔ lɛ toi; ni amɛbaashã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔle hu nɛ, shi mimɔŋ mli; ni mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ hela baaplenee amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, naa, gbalɔi lɛ kɛɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛnaŋ ta ko, ni nyɛnaŋ hɔmɔ ko; shi moŋ mahã nyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni sɛɛ efooo yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbalɔi lɛ miigba amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛi mli.
Jeee mi mitsu amɛ lɛ, jeee mi mifã amɛ lɛ, jeee mi, mikɛ amɛ ewie hu.
Amɛmiigba amale ninai kɛ yaka klamɔi kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiŋ lakamɔi amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ ni gbaa yɛ mi migbɛi mli, tsɛbelɛ mitsuko amɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ta kɛ hɔmɔ ko baŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ,’ lɛ ahe nɛ: Ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã gbalɔi nɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ni ta kɛ hɔmɔ nɔŋŋ nɔ abaatsɔ̃ akpãtã mɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu ahiɛ.
Ni abaashɛrɛ amɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei agbohii ashwie Yerusalɛm gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni anaŋ mɛi ni baafu amɛ tete.
Mibawo amɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ he nyɔmɔ.” Yehowa fã mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Ahã mihiŋmɛiiaŋ akpala nu shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ ni esɛɛ akafo; ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ epila, aye amɛ awui ablaŋ.
Kɛji miyiŋ mitee ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, naa, gbohii ni enyɔnyɔɔi yɛ ta mli, kɛji miku misɛɛ kɛba maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa, gbɔmɛi ni hɔmɔ egbe amɛ.
Ni gbalɔi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ miitsu amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛ; shi amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ kpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai Yehowa, aso oshɛ Yuda ofɔ̃ kwrakwra?
Ani onyaŋe Zionbii lo?
Mɛɛba mɔ otswia wɔ nii ni opila wɔ bɔ ni ehiii tsamɔ nɛɛ?
Wɔkwɛ hejɔlɛ gbɛ, shi nɔ kpakpa ko baaa; wɔhiɛ kã tsamɔ nɔ; shi gbeyei nii moŋ ba.
Ao!
Yehowa, wɔmiikpɛ̃lɛ wɔnifɔ̃ɔjianii kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hu anifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kaakwa wɔ; kaahã Yerusalɛm hiɛ miishwie shi; he ni ogbojee maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Kaimɔ kpãŋmɔ ni okɛ wɔ kpãŋ lɛ; ni okaku mli.
Ani majimaji lɛ alagbãalagbã wɔji lɛ ateŋ eko nyɛɔ ehãa nu nɛɔ?
Loo ŋwɛi tete nyɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehãa nu nɛɔ?
Ao!
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo pɛ gbɛ wɔkwɛɔ, ejaakɛ bo pɛ otsuɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kwa.
Sane fɔŋ baaye Yudabii Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛji Mose kɛ Samuel tete po damɔ mihiɛ lɛ, minaŋ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe tsui.
Shwiemɔ amɛ kɛje mihiɛ ni amɛya!
Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ wɔya?’ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ ji enɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele hela lɛ, gbele hela nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ baagbe amɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã klante lɛ, klante nɔŋŋ baagbe amɛ.
Ni mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã hɔmɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ naa nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛbaagboi yɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã nomŋɔɔ lɛ, nomŋɔɔ mli nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaate.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, mibahã nibii srɔtoi ejwɛ komɛi aba amɛnɔ.
Ta baaba abakpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni gbei baashãtã amɛ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi baaye amɛloo.
Mahã jeŋ majimaji fɛɛ ahe ajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni Hezekia bi Manase, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, fee yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ hewɔ.’ ” Yehowa tee nɔ akɛ, “Ao Yerusalɛm, namɔ baana bo mɔbɔ, ni namɔ baaye bo ŋkɔmɔ?
Namɔ baaba ebabi oshi?
Okwa mi, ni sɛɛsɛɛ kɛkɛ oyaa; no hewɔ ni miwo minine nɔ yɛ onɔ ni mikpãtã ohiɛ lɛ; ohe musuŋtsɔlɛ etɔ mi.
Misha nyɛmli yɛ agbonaa tamɔ ashaa ŋmãa mli koni kɔɔyɔɔ abaloo nyɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ amli kɛya tamɔ tutuu.
Migbe miwebii abii yɛ amɛhe, mikpãtã miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsakeee amɛjeŋba gbonyo lɛ.
Mihã amɛyei okulafoi ayi efa fe ŋshɔnaa shia.
Mihã sane fɔŋ eye oblahii anyɛmɛi, ejaakɛ mihã hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ekpãtã amɛblahii ahiɛ shwane fintiŋŋ.
Mihã ŋmiŋmi kɛ tsuifãa sane eba amɛnɔ trukaa.
Yoo ni efɔ kpawo lɛ etɔ biti; nɔ nyɔ enɔ, ni egbo; ehulu enyɔ shi shwane fintiŋŋ; awo lɛ hiɛgbele, ni ashwie ehiɛ shi.
Ni amɛteŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, majɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã amɛhenyɛlɔi aklante.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yeremia ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Minyɛ Awo, kpoo hã mi akɛ ofɔ mi!
Naa mi ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mi miibe, ni akɛ mi miitaa naa sɔŋŋ.
Mifako mɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, mɔ ko hu efako nɔ ko yɛ midɛŋ; shi loomɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lomɔɔ mi.
Ao!
Yehowa, kɛji mikpako bo fai mihãko amɛ bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã amɛ; aloo eji yɛ amɛfimɔ kɛ hejaramɔ bei amli lɛ, mitutɔko bo mihãko amɛ kulɛ, hã amɛloomɔ lɛ aba mli.
Ani mɔ ko baanyɛ kooyigbɛ dade ni akɛ akɔɔble efutu mli lɛ mli aku lo?
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Eshai fɛɛ ni amɛfee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he fɛɛ he hewɔ lɛ, mahã henyɛlɔi abaha amɛjwetri kɛ amɛnii fɛɛ yaka.
Mahã amɛyasɔ̃mɔ amɛhenyɛlɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni amɛleee jɛi nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, ole misane lɛ fɛɛ.
Kaimɔ mi koni obaye obua mi, ni otɔ mihe owele yɛ mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ anɔ.
Kaaŋmɛ otsui shi ohã amɛ, ni no hã amɛnine shɛ minɔ.
Kaimɔ akɛ bo ohewɔ abɔɔ mi ahora nɛɛ.
Ao!
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, be ni minu owiemɔi lɛ mimɔ mli, ni ehã mina miishɛɛ, ni mimli fili mi, ejaakɛ akɛ ogbɛi ewo mi.
Mitaaa mɛi ni amɛmli efili amɛ ateŋ, ni mimli efiliii mi.
Mi koome mita shi yɛ ofãmɔ naa, ejaakɛ ohã mimli efu naakpa.
Mɛɛba minɔnaa nɛɛ kã he daa, ni mifala lɛ ehiii tsamɔ, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tãlɛ nɛɛ.
Ani ofee tamɔ faa ni lakaa mɔ loo faa ni ŋalaa ohã mi?” Shi Yehowa to he akɛ, “Kɛji okpale lɛ, mibaŋɔ bo ekoŋŋ, ni obaasɔ̃mɔ mi.
Kɛji owie wiemɔi ni ahe yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ, shi jeee nɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ lɛ, no lɛ obaawie minaa ekoŋŋ.
Amɛ amɛaakpale kɛba oŋɔɔ, shi jeee bo ni obaakpale kɛya amɛŋɔɔ.
Mahã otsɔ̃ tamɔ gbogbo ni wa, tamɔ akɔɔble ohã gbɔmɛi nɛɛ; amɛkɛ bo baawu nɛ, shi amɛyeŋ onɔ kunim, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ, ni mibahere oyiwala.
Mibahere bo yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ, ni mibakpɔ̃ bo yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Yehowa yiŋtoo yɛ Yeremia wala he Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaakpee yoo yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni okafɔ bihii loo biyei yɛ biɛ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni baaba bihii kɛ biyei ni afɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ ni fɔfɔɔ amɛ yɛ biɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nɛ.
Gbele helai baagbegbee amɛ; ayeŋ amɛhe ŋkɔmɔ, ni afuŋ amɛgbohii lɛ tete; ni amɛbaajwere shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ wamɔ.
Amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante kɛ hɔmɔ naa, ni amɛgbohii lɛ baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã loofɔji kɛ jwɛiiaŋ kooloi.
“Kaaya shĩa ko ni afeɔ yara yɛ mli mli, ni kaaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni kaaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ hu, ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ ni mihã amɛ kɛ mimlihilɛ kɛ mimusuŋtsɔlɛ ni miyɔɔ hã amɛ lɛ mifo fɛɛ sɛɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi wuji kɛ mɛi bibii lɛ fɛɛ baagboi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Afuŋ amɛ, ni afeŋ amɛyara hu.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko bãmɔŋ ehe kɛ kakla aloo eshɛŋ eyiteŋ kɛyeŋ amɛgbohii lɛ ahe ŋkɔmɔ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaŋ ekɛ ŋkɔmɔyelɔ ko ayaye nii koni ekɛshɛje emii yɛ mɔ ko ni egbo hewɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko haŋ mɔ ko ni etsɛ loo enyɛ egbo nɔ ko ni enu ekɛsheje mɔ lɛ mii.
“Kaaya shĩa ko ni aŋmɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ mli mli ni okɛ mɛi yata shi oye nii ni ayeɔ lɛ eko, ni onu nɔ ni anuɔ lɛ hu eko.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ gbee kɛ ayɛmforowu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ, kɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ.’ “Kɛji okɛ maŋbii lɛ wie wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa to eyiŋ ni egbala wɔtoi waa nɛkɛ?
Mɛni tɔ̃mɔ wɔtɔ̃?
Mɛɛ esha po ji nɔ ni wɔfee wɔshi Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ?’ lɛ, no lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kwa mi, ni amɛtee amɛyanyiɛ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛja amɛ; amɛkwa mi ni amɛyeee mimla lɛ nɔ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee efɔŋ fe nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete, ejaakɛ naa nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ nɔ ni etsui fɔŋ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ eboɔ mi toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mashɛrɛ nyɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ mashwie shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee koni nyɛyasɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ minaŋ nyɛ mɔbɔ.’ ” Abaajɛ Nomŋɔɔ mli aba Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, be miiba ni akɛ Yehowa gbɛi kãŋ kitã lɛ, akɛŋ hu dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ,’ shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie Israelbii kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ mibakpala amɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ.” Toigbalamɔ ni baa lɛ “Naa, miitsu koni ayaŋɔ wolɛimɛi pii abahã mi koni amɛbahɛ amɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ gbɔbilɔi abahã mi ni amɛbagbɔbi amɛ yɛ gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi kɛ tɛkploi afɔji blublu amli.
Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ mihiŋmɛii jwere nɔ, eko eko bɛ ni minaaa.
Mibawo tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛtɔ̃ kɛ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ toi enyɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛyakayaka amãgãi foji lɛ ebule mishikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhã enɔ eyi tɔ kɛ amɛmusubɔɔ nii lɛ.” Yeremia sɔle kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ “Yehowa, bo ji mihewalɛ kɛ mimɔɔ ni wa kɛ mibobaahe yɛ fimɔ be mli.
Bo oŋɔɔ maji aaajɛ je lɛ naagbeehei aba, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ebanaaa gboshinii ko akɛ ja lakamɔ kɛ yaka nibii ni ahe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko.
Aso gbɔmɔ adesa aaanyɛ nyɔŋmɔi efee ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe?
Nɔ ni eeefee lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibahã amɛna amɛle shi kome nɛɛ kɛwula shi nɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ ni miyɔɔ koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi ji Yehowa.”
Yuda tɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ ehe toigbalamɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Yuda he esha lɛ akɛ dade niŋmaatso kɛ enaa daiamɔnd piɔpiɔ kpɛ wo amɛtsui tao lɛ nɔ; akpɛ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ akoji lɛ anɔ.
Amɛbii lɛ kaiɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ kɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔ Ashera lɛ amãgãi ni yɔɔ tsei ni ebu kusukusuu ashishi kɛ gɔŋkpɔi anɔ, kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ hu anɔ lɛ.
Yuda, ojwetrii kɛ onii ni oyɔɔ fɛɛ hu lɛ, mibajɔɔ nɔ mahã henyɛlɔi koni amɛbaha kɛya.
No baafee eshai ni ofee yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ he toigbalamɔ.
Obaaŋmɛɛ ogboshinii ni mikɛhã bo lɛ he ofɔ̃ shi, ni mibahã oyasɔ̃mɔ ohenyɛlɔi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni oleee nɔ, ejaakɛ mimlifu lɛ tamɔ la ni ashɛre, ni ebaatso kɛya naanɔ.” Wiemɔi Srɔtoi Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔ, mɔ ni shiɔ Yehowa sɛɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpasaa adesa hewalɛ.
Etamɔ tso fɔ ni ma shiaŋa nɔ; yɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋooŋoo ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ jɛi; ebɛ ekpakpa ko ni ebaafee.
Ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni kɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yehowa nɔ, mɔ ni Yehowa ji ehiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Etamɔ tso ni atɛo yɛ faa toi; etsɛ̃rɛɔ eshishi fãi kɛyaninaa nu lɛ.
Esheee gbeyei kɛji jeŋdɔlɛ be shɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ lɛ eyaa nɔ ewoɔ yibii, etsui yeee kɛji nu enɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ eyibaa hiɔ shi frɔ̃frɔ̃.
Tsui yɔɔ nɛɛ elakaa mɔ fe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; efite kwraa.
Namɔ aaanu lɛ shishi?
Mi, Yehowa, mitaoɔ gbɔmɔ yitsoŋ, ni mikaa tsui mikwɛɔ.
Mikɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeɔ yɛ ejeŋba naa; mikɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeɔ yɛ yibii ni ewoɔ naa.
Mɔ ni taoɔ nii ni jeee gbɛ kpakpa nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, etamɔ afi ni yabuɔ wɔji ni jeee lɛ eŋmɛ nɔ.
Eninamɔ lɛ ŋmɛɔ lɛ yɛ ewala teŋ, ni enaagbee mli lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ kwashia.
He ni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i gojoo lɛ ma kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, jɛi ji wɔjamɔhe lɛ.
Ao!
Yehowa, bo Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ, mɛi fɛɛ ni kwaa bo lɛ ahiɛ baagboi; mɛi ni kpaleɔ yɛ osɛɛ lɛ agbɛi aaalaaje tamɔ nɔ ni aŋma yɛ mlu mli, ejaakɛ amɛshi Yehowa ni ji wala nubu lɛ sɛɛ.” Yeremia bi Yehowa dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ Ao!
Yehowa, tsa mi, ni mihe aaatã; heremɔ miyiwala koni miyi ana wala, ejaakɛ bo oyi mijieɔ.
Naa, maŋbii lɛ biɔ mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ yɔɔ?
Hã aba mli koo!” Yehowa, minyɛko onɔ pɛŋ akɛ ohã nɔ fɔŋ aba maŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni mishweko hu akɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ aba.
Yehowa, bo ole enɛ, ni nii fɛɛ ni je minaa lɛ jwere ohiɛ.
Kaawo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ bo ji mibobaahe.
Hã mɛi ni waa mi yi lɛ ahiɛ agboi; shi mi lɛ kaahã mihiɛ miigbo.
Hã amɛtsui afã, shi mi lɛ kaahã mitsui miifã.
Hã gbi fɔŋ lɛ abanina amɛ; kpãtãmɔ amɛhiɛ, ni oku sɛɛ okpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.
Hejɔɔmɔgbiyeli Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyadamɔ Maŋbii Agbo lɛ naa, he ni Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi tsɔ̃ɔ kɛbaa maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ jɛi kɛjeɔ kpo lɛ.
Yaadamɔ Yerusalɛm agboi fɛɛ hu anaa, koni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi, nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yudabii kɛ nyɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ agboi nɛɛ amli lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwala hewɔ koni nyɛkatere jatsu ko yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, aloo nyɛtere jatsu ko kɛtsɔ̃ Yerusalɛm agboi nɛɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛkatere jatsu ko kɛmiijɛ shĩa ko mli kɛmiije kpo yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkatsua nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko; shi moŋ nyɛyea hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ amɛfee lɛ.
Shi moŋ kɛ̃lɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ booo mi toi, ni amɛyeee nɔ; shi amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi ni amɛbooo mi toi koni amɛkase nii.’ “Shi mi, Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛbo mi toi, ni nyɛkɛ jatsu ko jatsu ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ agbo ko mli kɛboteee maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsuuu nitsumɔ ko nitsumɔ ko yɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛmɛi ni taa David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ baaya nɔ atsɔ̃ agboi nɛɛ amli ni amɛtara tayaa shwiilii amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ, ni amɛshishi lumɛi lɛ hu aaatara okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ agboi lɛ amli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli; ni Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii hu aaafee nakai, ni gbɔmɛi baahi Yerusalɛm maŋ nɛɛ mli kɛaate naanɔ.
Mɛi kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ tsofakɛŋmai aaaba kɛaajɛ Yuda maji lɛ anɔ kɛ heihei ni bɔle Yerusalɛm lɛ; mɛi baajɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ wuoyigbɛ ŋa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba Yehowa we lɛ abada lɛ shi.
Shi kɛji nyɛbooo mi toi akɛ nyɛye hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akɛ gbi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni no gbi lɛ nɔ, mɔ ko tere jatsu ko kɛtsɔ̃ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ eko mli kɛba maŋ lɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibama maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Yerusalɛm mli mɔji lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbe.’ ”
Yeremia yɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ shĩa Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo baawie yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, miyiŋ mitee gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shĩa lɛ mli, ni miyanina lɛ ni eta egbɛshɔ̃ɔ tsɔne lɛ sɛɛ eetsu nii.
Mina akɛ kɛji nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ shɔ̃ɔ lɛ fite yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, esaa ekpɔtɔɔ su lɛ mli ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛshɔ̃ɔ nɔ kroko ni saa ehiɛ bɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ao!
Israelbii, aso esaaa akɛ mifeɔ nyɛ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ fee sũ lɛ lo?
Israelbii, naa, nyɛtamɔ sũ ni gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
Be fɛɛ be ni makɛɛ yɛ maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli ko he akɛ mafã lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ koni majwara lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lɛ, kɛji nakai maŋ ni miwie ehe lɛ kpa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ feemɔ lɛ, mitsakeɔ mijwɛŋmɔ, ni efɔŋ ni mito akɛ mibafee amɛ lɛ mifeee.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni makɛɛ yɛ maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli ko he akɛ mamã lɛ mamã shi, ni eshwere lɛ, kɛji nakai maŋ lɛ loo maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fee efɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ, ni ebooo migbee toi lɛ, no lɛ mibafo ekpakpa ni mito akɛ mibafee lɛ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Yudabii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ akɛ nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, misusu nyɛhe efɔŋ, ni mikɔ nyɛyi tɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni etsake esu kɛ enifeemɔnii fɔŋ lɛ.’ Shi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Oowie efolo; nɔ ni wɔfeɔ lɛ, wɔbaafee ŋmɛnɛ wɔbaafee wɔ.
Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui naa sane bɔ ni esumɔɔ.’ ” Maŋbii lɛ kwa Yehowa No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbia yɛ majimaji lɛ amli akɛ namɔ enu nɛkɛ sane dã?
Israel, oblayoo foro lɛ efee nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ gbeyei.
Ani snoo ekpa nyɔɔ yɛ Lebanon gɔji anɔ pɛŋ?
Ani gɔji lɛ anɔ nu egbi dã, ani nu ŋanii ni hoɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo dã?
Shi mi lɛ, mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpa minɔ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa yaka nyɔŋmɔi.
Amɛtɛrɛtɛrɛɛ yɛ blema gbɛ ni amɛnyiɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛje tɛmpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyanyiɛ nane gbɛi anɔ.
Amɛhã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ ‘tsia!’ daa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni eeehoso eyitso.
Mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ mlu ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ etswa.
Mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã, ni mikwɛŋ amɛ kwraa yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.” Atee Yeremia yinɔ apam Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpãŋa Yeremia yinɔ, akɛni osɔfoi yɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔyɛ mɛi ni baatsɔ̃ɔ wɔ mla lɛ naa, ni nilelɔi yɛ ni baawo wɔ ŋaa, ni gbalɔi hu baahi shi amɛgba amɛhã wɔ.
Nyɛbaa koni wɔkɛ wɔlilɛi afite lɛ, ni nyɛkahãa wɔbo ewiemɔ kome folo toi.” No hewɔ lɛ, misɔle mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, ofainɛ, bo mi toi; asaŋ obo mɛi ni kɛ mi ena lɛ hu toi.
Aso efɔŋ moŋ akɛtoɔ ekpakpa najiaŋ?
Shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli.
Yehowa, kaimɔ bɔ ni midamɔ ohiɛ ni mikpa fai mihã amɛ koni omli ni efu amɛ lɛ sɛɛ afo.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã amɛbii lɛ aye hɔmɔ, ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa; hã amɛŋamɛi lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi kɛ mɛi ni amɛmusuŋbii egboi yɛ amɛhe.
Gbele hela abagbe amɛteŋ hii lɛ, ni amɛblahii lɛ anyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa yɛ ta mli.
Be ni ooohã henyɛlɔi aaabashwie amɛnɔ trukaa lɛ, hã ni anu blɔmɔ yɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ, ejaakɛ amɛtsa bu amɛhã mi koni migbee mli, ni amɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ mi tsɔnei hu koni madu.
Shi Yehowa, bo lɛ ole miyinɔ apam ni amɛyaa lɛ.
Okɛ efɔŋ ni amɛfee nɛɛ akafa amɛ; kaaku ohiɛ ofɔ̃ amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ.
Hã abutu amɛ yɛ ohiɛ, ni okɛ amɛ aye be mli ni omli efu lɛ.”
Kpulu ni ejwa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyahe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ sũ kpulu, ni oŋɔ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ofata ohe, ni okɛ amɛ atsɔ̃ Gbɛshɔ̃lɔ Agbo lɛ mli kɛya Hinom bi lɛ Jɔɔ lɛ mli, koni oshiɛ wiemɔi ni makɛɛ bo lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.
Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ, mibahã sane fɔŋ aye maŋ nɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baanu nɔ ni ba lɛ he baajɔ̃ ehe.
Ejaakɛ maŋbii lɛ ekwa mi, ni amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋma ni amɛshãa amɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ tete hu leee lɛ ebule maŋ lɛ; asaŋ amɛfɔse mɛi ni efeko nɔ ko fɔŋ lɛ alá amɛshwie biɛ obɔ̃.
Ni amɛmamɔ afɔleshãa latɛi yɛ Baal jamɔhei lɛ, ni amɛshãa amɛmusuŋbii yɛ nɔ akɛ shãa afɔle amɛhãa Baal.
Mifãko amɛ, ni nakai nɔ ko bako mijwɛŋmɔ mli tete dã.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, be miiba, ni atsɛŋ he ni wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ Tofet loo Hinom Jɔɔ dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ biɛ akɛ Gbɔmɔgbee Jɔɔ.
Mahã Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii ayiŋtoi fɛɛ afee yaka yɛ biɛ.
Mahã amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni taoɔ amɛ efɔŋ amɛfee lɛ ahiɛ.
Mahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi aye amɛgbohii lɛ.
Mahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ, ni abaabo lɛ ‘tsia!’ Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho lɛ he aaajɔ̃ ehe, ni ebaabo ‘tsia’ yɛ amanehulu ni maŋ lɛ ena lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ henyɛlɔi baasa maŋ lɛ yi, ni ebaafĩ maŋbii lɛ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni fɔlɔi baaye amɛmusuŋ bihii kɛ amɛbiyei, ni mɛi baagbe amɛnanemɛi amɛye.’ “No sɛɛ lɛ, ojwa kpulu lɛ yɛ hii ni kɛ bo baaya jɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.
‘Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ majwa maŋ nɛɛ, ni mibakpãtã emli bii ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ajwaa gbɛshɔ̃lɔ kpulu ni ehiii tsaramɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Tofet nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ he ni mɛi baafu amɛgbohii yɛ, ejaakɛ anaŋ he ko he ko ni abaafu gbohii yɛ dɔŋŋ.
Bɔ ni mibafee maŋ nɛɛ kɛ emli bii lɛ nɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Tofet.
Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli shĩai kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi awei fɛɛ he ni ashãshãa tsofakɛŋma yɛ amɛtsui lɛ ayiteiaŋ akɛhã ŋulamii, asaŋ ni akɛ dãa shwie shi ahã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ jɛi lɛ, abaabule amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm tamɔ Tofet.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia jɛ Tofet, he ni Yehowa tsu lɛ akɛ eyagba yɛ lɛ eba, ni ebadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, efɔŋ fɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mibafee maŋ nɛɛ kɛ ehe majimaji lɛ, mibafee amɛ kɛ̃, ejaakɛ amɛfee amɛhe kuɛŋtilɔi, ni amɛbooo miwiemɔ toi.’ ”
Osɔfo Pashur mli fu Yeremia Be ni Yeremia gba nɛkɛ gbalɛi nɛɛ lɛ, Osɔfo Pashur, Imer bi lɛ, ni lɛ ji Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli tsulɔnukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ, nu nɔ ni Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pashur hã agwao Gbalɔ Yeremia, ni no sɛɛ lɛ abɔ lɛ apã yɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yiteŋgbɛ lɛ naa.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni Pashur fɛne Yeremia yɛ apã lɛ mli sɛɛ lɛ, Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa tsɛŋ ogbɛi akɛ Pashur dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ abaatsɛ bo ‘Gbeyeinɔ,’ yɛ he fɛɛ he; ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, mahã otsɔ̃ gbeyeinɔ ohã bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ, ni ohiŋmɛi jwere nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi aklante naa.
Majɔɔ Yuda fɛɛ nɔ mawo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni ebaaŋɔ maŋbii lɛ kɛaatee Babilon ni ebaaya eyagbe amɛ kɛ klante.
Asaŋ maŋ nɛɛ nii ni eyɔɔ kɛ nii ni egbo he deŋme kɛna kɛ enibii ni jara wa hã lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi ajwetrii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ majɔɔ nɔ mahã maŋbii lɛ ahenyɛlɔi lɛ, ni amɛbaaha ni amɛbaashɔ̃ yɛ maŋbii lɛ adɛŋ ni amɛbaaloo kɛya Babilon.
Ni bo Pashur tuuŋtu lɛ, abaaŋɔ bo kɛ oshĩa mli bii fɛɛ nom kɛaatee Babilon.
Jɛi oooyagbo yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ aaafu bo kɛ onanemɛi fɛɛ ni ogba amale gbalɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ yɛ.
Yeremia ye ŋkɔmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa Ao!
Yehowa, olaka mi, ni mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni alaka lɛ.
Oyɛ hewalɛ fe mi, ni oye minɔ.
Mitsɔ̃ mɔ ni aŋmɔɔ lɛ daa jenamɔ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ po yeɔ mihe fɛo.
Be fɛɛ be ni miwieɔ lɛ, ja mibolɔ; mibolɔɔ akɛ, “Yiwalɛ sɔŋŋ!” Kɛ “niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ.” Ejaakɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ abɔɔ mi ahora, ni ayeɔ mihe fɛo daa jenamɔ.
Kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsiŋ Yehowa tã, ni miwieŋ yɛ egbɛi mli dɔŋŋ lɛ,” minuɔ he yɛ mitsuiŋ akɛ nɔ ko miitso tamɔ la ni atsi naa awo miwui amli.
La nɛɛ naatsii etɔ mi, ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.
Minuɔ akɛ aawie ablɛbi akɛ, “He fɛɛ he efee gbeyei.
Nyɛfolɔa enaa, nyɛhãa wɔfolɔ enaa!” Minanemɛi tete ni kɛɔ enɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛmiikwɛ akɛ minane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ lo.
Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Eko lɛ aaalaka lɛ ni wɔnine aaashɛ enɔ, ni wɔɔtɔ wɔhe owele yɛ enɔ.” Shi Yehowa kɛ mi yɛ eji kãkãlɔ ni asheɔ lɛ gbeyei.
No hewɔ lɛ, miyiwalɔi lɛ baatɛrɛ; amɛhiɛ baagbo kpɔtɔkpɔtɔɔ, ejaakɛ amɛyeŋ minɔ kunim.
Amɛhiɛgbele lɛ, hiɛ kpaŋ nɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ao, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ ni okaa jalɔ okwɛɔ, ni onaa etsuiŋ kɛ eyitsoŋ saji fɛɛ, hã mana amɛnɔ owele ni obaatɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mitu misane lɛ miwo odɛ̃ŋ.
Nyɛlaa nyɛhãa Yehowa.
Nyɛjiea Yehowa yi.
Ehereɔ ohiafo yiwala yɛ yiwalɔi adɛŋ.
Alomɔ gbi ni afɔ mi lɛ, gbi nɔ ni minyɛ fɔ mi lɛ akajɔɔ nakai gbi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Alomɔ nuu ni bakɛɛ mitsɛ akɛ, “Afɔ binuu ahã bo,” ni no hã emii shɛ ehe lɛ.
Nakai nuu lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ maji ni Yehowa kpãtã amɛhiɛ, ni amɛnii efeee lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ.
Hã enu blɔmɔ he leebi kɛ tayaa oshebɔɔ he shwane, ejaakɛ egbeee mi ewooo minyɛ musuŋ koni minyɛ musuŋ atsɔ̃ migbonyobu koni musu lɛ ahi ehe kɛya naanɔ.
Mɛɛba kwraa mijɛ musuŋ mije kpo koni mibagbo deŋme ni maye awerɛhoo ni mijeŋshihilɛ naagbee afee hiɛgbele nɛkɛ?
Agba akɛ henyɛlɔi baaŋɔ Yerusalɛm Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ, be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu Malkia bi Pashur kɛ Maaseia bi Osɔfo Zefania kɛtee Yeremia ŋɔɔ ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, bi Yehowa nii ohã wɔ, ejaakɛ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ efã ta ebatua wɔ.
Eko lɛ aleenɔ Yehowa aaafee enaakpɛɛnii lɛ eko yɛ wɔhewɔ koni no ahã Nebukadnezar kɛ eta lɛ aku esɛɛ kɛya.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakɛa Maŋtsɛ Zedekia akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibakpãtã tawuunii ni nyɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ lɛ ahiɛ, tawuunii ni nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛkɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi Kaldeabii ni esa nyɛyi yɛ Yerusalɛm gbogboi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ wuɔ lɛ; mibabua fɛɛ naa kɛba maŋ lɛ teŋ.
Mibagri, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ moŋ mikɛ nyɛ baawu kɛ nineshiwalɛ yɛ mlifu kɛ mlila naa.
Ni mibatswia maŋ nɛɛ mli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ nii, ni gbele hela ni yɔɔ gbeyei baagbegbee amɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ etsuji kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni ahe baaje gbele hela lɛ loo klante naa gbele lɛ loo hɔmɔ naa gbele lɛ mli lɛ, majɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ maŋbii ahenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ maŋbii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ, ni Nebukadnezar baagbe amɛ yɛ klante naa.
Enaŋ mɔbɔ lɛ, emusuŋ eshaŋ lɛ, ni ehaŋ mɔ ko aye ehe hu.’ “Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mikɛ wala gbɛ kɛ gbele gbɛ fɛɛ miishwie nyɛhiɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahi maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ta mli loo kɛtsɔ̃ hɔmɔ nɔ loo kɛtsɔ̃ gbele hela nɔ.
Shi mɔ ni baaje kpo eya koni ekɛ ehe ayahã Babilonbii ni ebasa nyɛyi yɛ nyɛmaŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã ni ewala aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ ahuutoonii ni ena yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ mijie mihiɛ mika maŋ nɛɛ akɛ efɔŋ ji nɔ ni mibafee amɛ; shi jeee ekpakpa.
Aaatu maŋ lɛ awo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, ni eeema enaa lá, ni eeeshã lɛ wɛɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Yuda Maŋtsɛwe lɛ toigbalamɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi koni mikɛɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ we lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi, Nyɛ David shwiei!
Nyɛyea jalɛ sane be fɛɛ be.
Mɔ ni ayeɔ lɛ amim lɛ nyɛhea lɛ yɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ amim lɛ dɛŋ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ no lɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, mimlila aaatso yɛ nyɛnɔ tamɔ la, ni ebaatso, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ agbe.” Naa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nyɛ mɛi hu ni yɔɔ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ tɛsaa lɛ nɔ, mikɛ nyɛ ena.
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Namɔ baanyɛ wɔ ebatua, ni namɔ baanyɛ egbu kɛbabote wɔmaŋ lɛ mli?” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Shi naa, mibagbala nyɛtoi yɛ yibii ni nyɛjeŋba ewo lɛ naa.
Mibama nyɛkoo lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni bɔle lɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Abɔ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Weku lɛ kɔkɔ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ aya Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni oyakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bo Yuda maŋtsɛ ni ota Maŋtsɛ David sɛi lɛ nɔ, bo kɛ otsuji kɛ omaŋbii ni tsɔ̃ɔ agboi nɛɛ amli kɛyaa kɛbaa, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛkojo yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛye jalɛ sane; ni nyɛhere mɔ ni aaye lɛ amim lɛ yɛ mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ amim lɛ dɛŋ; ni nyɛkafee gbɔ loo awusa loo okulafo efɔŋ; asaŋ nyɛkawa amɛyi; ni nyɛkashwie mɔ ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá shi yɛ biɛ.
Anɔkwa, kɛji nyɛye wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ David shwiei lɛ baaya nɔ ata David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ akɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛtsuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋbii lɛ baaya nɔ atara tayaa shwiilii amli kɛ okpɔŋɔi anɔ kɛtsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ agboi nɛɛ amli kɛya kɛba.
Shi kɛji nyɛbuuu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.’ ” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ he ji akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ we nɛɛ, otamɔ Gilead kɛhã mi; asaŋ otamɔ Lebanon gɔji lɛ hu moŋ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mahã otsɔ̃ shiaŋa, maŋ ni adesa ko adesa ko ehiii mli.
Majie nifitelɔi ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ elema mawo bo; ni amɛbaatoo otsenedru tsei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛbaaloo amɛwo la mli.
“Ni majimaji anɔ bii pii aaabatsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ he kɛho, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaabi akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ni Yehowa fee maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?’ Abaajie naa akɛ, ‘Ejaakɛ amɛkwa kpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛ kɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, teŋ lɛ, ni amɛyaja nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi moŋ, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ.’ ” Maŋtsɛ Yoahaz he wiemɔ ni Yeremia wie Nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkafoa Maŋtsɛ Yosia mɔ ni egbo lɛ, ni nyɛkayea ehe ŋkɔmɔ hu.
Shi moŋ nyɛfoa waa nyɛhãa Yoahaz mɔ ni yaa nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ dɔŋŋ.
Ni enaŋ ejaku shikpɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Yoahaz mɔ ni baye etsɛ sɛɛ akɛ, “Yuda maŋtsɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee lɛ he nɛ, ekuŋ esɛɛ ebaŋ biɛ dɔŋŋ, shi he ni aŋɔ lɛ nom kɛtee lɛ jɛi eeegbo yɛ, ni ehiŋmɛi enaŋ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ!” Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim he wiemɔ ni Yeremia wie Kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ juu kɛfɔ̃ nɔ emaa eshĩa, ni egbeleɔ mli kɛtsɔ̃ɔ shishiumɔ nɔ; mɔ ni hãa enaanyo tsuɔ nii hãa lɛ efolo, ni ewooo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, “Mama shĩa kpeteŋkple kɛ emli ŋwɛitsui ni dara.” Ejieɔ samfɛji ewoɔ he ni ekɛ tsenedrutso kaa mli, ni eshaa he kɛ ama tsuru fɔɔ.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ tsenedru mple ni oshiɔ lɛ no feɔ bo maŋtsɛ?
Otsɛ hi shi, ni eye nii, ni enu nii, ni ekojo jalɛ naa, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehi ehã lɛ!
Eye nɔnalɔ kɛ ohiafo sane ehã lɛ; ni no hã ehi ehã lɛ lɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ohiŋmɛi kɛ otsui kã juukɛfɔ̃ nii kɛ mɛi ni efeko efɔŋ lá shishwiemɔ nɔ.
Ni owaa mɛi ayi keketee.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia bi Yehoakim he nɛ, “Awoŋ yara afoŋ lɛ; akɛŋ lɛ akɛ ‘Kpoo Nuŋtsɔ!
Ao, kpoo, Maŋtsɛ!’ Aaafu lɛ tamɔ afuɔ teji; aaashãtã lɛ ayashɛ afɔ̃ Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ asɛɛ.” Yeremia tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni baaba Yerusalɛm nɔ Yerusalɛm maŋbii, nyɛkwɔa nyɛyaa Lebanon ni nyɛyabolɔa; nyɛyaa Bashan nyɛyabolɔa, kɛ Moab gɔji lɛ hu anɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã nyɛsuɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Be ni oyɔɔ nii pii lɛ, mikɛ bo wie; shi okɛɛ akɛ obooo mi toi.
Ojeŋba kwraa nɛ kɛjɛ oblahiiaŋ, oboko mi toi dã.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ baaloo olumɛi lɛ kɛya, abaaloo onanemɛi akɛ nomii kɛya; kɛkɛ lɛ ohiɛ aaagbo ni ohiɛ aaashwie shi yɛ onifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkãmɔ Lebanon tsenedru tsui amli shweshweeshwe ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ, kɛji hejaramɔ ba lɛ, nyɛaana nɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Yehoiakim toi Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ lɛ, kɛji bo Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim bi Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin tete po ji wolonaasɔomɔ ga ni yɔɔ mininejurɔ lɛ, mibakpɔ bo yɛ miwao, ni matu bo mawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ emaŋbii Babilonbii ni taoɔ bo amɛgbe ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei hu lɛ adɛŋ.
Mibashɛ bo kɛ onyɛ ni fɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ mafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, he ni jeee jɛmɛ afɔ nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nyɛbaagboi yɛ.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ ni amɛbaashwe akɛ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba nɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛkuŋ amɛsɛɛ kɛbaŋ jɛi dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Aso Yehoiakin etsɔ̃ mɔ ni abuuu tamɔ nu gbɛ ko ni mɔ ko taooo dɔŋŋ lo?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ kɛ ebii ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie shikpɔŋ ko ni amɛleee nɔ nɛɛ?” Ao Shikpɔŋ, Shikpɔŋ, Shikpɔŋ!
Bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ toi.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa nuu nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni bɛ bi; mɔ ko ni shwereŋ ewala be mli fɛɛ, ejaakɛ eshwie ko eshwie ko naŋ David sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ eta eye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yuda dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Wɔsɛɛ ko hiɛnɔkãmɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã lumɛi ni kpãtãa miwebii lɛ ahiɛ, ni amɛgbɛɔ mitoi lɛ amɛshwãa lɛ.
Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɔ yɛ lumɛi ni kwɛɔ miwebii lɛ anɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, ‘Nyɛkuraaa miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛgbɛ amɛ nyɛshwã, ni nyɛshwie amɛ kɛtee.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ mibawo nyɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mibabua miwebii ni eshwɛshwɛɛ yɛ majimaji ni mishwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ fɛɛ anɔ lɛ anaa, ni mikɛ amɛ baaba amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; ni amɛaafɔfɔi, ni amɛyi aaafa pii.
Mato lumɛi, mɛi ni baalɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ; ni amɛsheŋ gbeyei, ni amɛtsui hu efaŋ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeŋ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ “Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, naa be ko miiba ni matee maŋtsɛ jalɛ saneyelɔ ko shi ni jɛ David mli.
Ebaaye maŋtsɛ yɛ nilee naa, ni ebaakojo jalɛ naa ni ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Lɛ eyinɔ lɛ abaahere Yuda yiwala, ni Israel baahi shi shweshweeshwe; ni gbɛi ni akɛbaatsɛ lɛ ji, ‘Yehowa ji wɔjalɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, naa, be ko miiba ni akɛŋ dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa mɔ ni jie Israelbii lɛ kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ;’ shi moŋ abaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa, mɔ ni jie ni ekpala Israelbii ashwiei lɛ kɛje kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, hei ni eshwie amɛ kɛtee lɛ kɛba lɛ.’ Nakai be mli lɛ amɛbaahi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Nɔ ni Yeremia wie yɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahe Mitsui fɛɛ ejwra, ni miwui miikpokpo bliblibli.
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ dãatɔlɔ, mɔ ni dãa ekploka lɛ yɛ Yehowa kɛ ewiemɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahewɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ mɛi ni jeɔ Yehowa sɛɛ.
Jeŋba fɔŋ amɛbaa, ni nɔ fɔŋ mli ekãa amɛfeɔ.
Yehowa loomɔ hewɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye awerɛho, ni ŋa lɛ nɔ hei ni yɔɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ fɛɛ egbigbii.
Amɛjeŋba lɛ efɔŋ ni, ni amɛhewalɛ lɛ amɛkɛfeee nɔ kpakpa.
Gbalɔ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ lɛ, amɛjeee Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi; ni minaa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ yɛ miwe lɛ mli tete.
Yehowa kɛɛ.
Amɛnyiɛmɔhei fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ shikpɔŋ ni shamɔɔ yɛ duŋ mli ahã amɛ; jɛi abaatsirɛ amɛ awo, ni amɛbaatswiatswia shi, ejaakɛ afi nɔ ni abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ mahã sane gbonyo aye amɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mina esha ni Samaria gbalɔi lɛ fee lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ Baal nɔ amɛgba, ni amɛhã mimaŋ Israel du gbɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mina yɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ ahe lɛ, eyɛ gbeyei.
Amɛfiteɔ gbãlã, ni amɛmaleɔ; amɛwo efɔŋfeelɔi hewalɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko kpaaa efɔŋ feemɔ.
Amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni maŋbii lɛ tamɔ Gomora hã mi.
