No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ mikɛɔ yɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe nɛ, “Naa, mibahã amɛ tatso akɛ amɛniyenii, ni mibahã amɛ nu ni ebɔɔ yɔɔ mli amɛnu, ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ efɔŋfeemɔ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɔ maŋbii nɛ, “Nyɛkaboa gbalɔi ni gbaa tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ toi; amɛmiihã nyɛ yaka hiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Nɔ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa lɛ, shi jeee nɔ ni jɛ mi, Yehowa, minaa.
Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ mɛi ni ebuuu mi, Yehowa, miwiemɔ lɛ ji, ‘Nɔ ko gbaŋ nyɛnaa;’ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni efee ehe kuɛŋtilɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko bɛ ni baaba onɔ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛteŋ namɔ Yehowa kɛto ajina dã, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ena, ni enu Yehowa naa wiemɔ?
Loo amɛteŋ namɔ ebo owiemɔ lɛ toi, ni eye nɔ?
Naa, Yehowa mlifu lɛ, ahum ni, ni efã kɛje kpo tamɔ lasuogbele, ni ebaawula mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ ayi.
Yehowa mlifu lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ena efee egbe naa.
Wɔsɛɛ ko dani nyɛaanu sane nɛɛ shishi jogbaŋŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mitsuko gbalɔi nɛɛ; amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni amɛgbaa; mikɛ wiemɔ ko woko amɛnaa; shi amɛmiigba yɛ migbɛi mli.
Eji mikɛ amɛ eto ajina lɛɛlɛŋ kulɛ, amɛaahã maŋbii lɛ anu minaa wiemɔi lɛ, ni kulɛ amɛaahã maŋbii lɛ akpa amɛjeŋba fɔŋ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ.
“Aso kɛji mibɛŋkɛ lɛ no dani Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi?
Shi kɛji miyɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi lo?” Aso mɔ ko baanyɛ atee ehe yɛ teemɔhe ko ni minaŋ lɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lo?
Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Ani jeee mi ni miyi ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ obɔ̃ lɛ?
Mi, Yehowa, miibi.
Minu nɔ ni gbalɔi ni gbaa amale gbalɛi yɛ mi, migbɛi mli ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mila lamɔ ko; mila lamɔ ko lɛ.’ Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ po ni gbalɔi nɛɛ baajɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ amɛgba amale gbalɛ kɛyashi?
Ani amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lamɔi ni amɛgbaa amɛnanemɛi lɛ baahã mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ akpa minɔ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ kpa minɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhã Baal lɛ?
Gbalɔ ni ela lamɔ ko lɛ, egba lamɔ lɛ; ni gbalɔ ni mikɛ miwiemɔ ewo enaa lɛ, ewie wiemɔ lɛ anɔkwale mli.
Mɛni tutuu kɛ abele yɔɔ jaa?
Ani miwiemɔ lɛ etamɔɔɔ la; ni etamɔɔɔ hamle ni jwaraa tɛsaa mli wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ yɛ amɛnanemɛi gbalɔi krokomɛi anaa wiemɔ amɛfeɔ amɛnɔ lɛ ena.
Naa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni wieɔ wiemɔi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsɔ̃, shi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ’ lɛ ena.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Naa, mi Yehowa, mikɛ gbalɔi ni gbaa amale lamɔi lɛ ena.
Malemɔ ni amɛmaleɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ miwebii lɛ kɛ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ lɛ hãa miwebii lɛ duɔ gbɛ.
Mitsuko amɛ, ni mifãko amɛ nɛkɛ nitsumɔ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko kwraa hã maŋ nɛɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yeremia, kɛji maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ eko loo gbalɔ ko loo osɔfo ko bi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni ji Yehowa jatsu lɛ’, ohere nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ, nyɛ nɔŋŋ ji jatsu lɛ; ni Yehowa baashɛ nyɛ efɔ̃.’ Ni gbalɔ loo osɔfo loo maŋnyo ni kɛ wiemɔ ‘Yehowa jatsu lɛ’ baafee edaaŋ kotsa lɛ, mibagbala mɔ lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ hewɔ.
Nɔ ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ abi enaanyo kɛ enyɛmi moŋ ji akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hetoo Yehowa hã,’ loo ‘Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?’ Wiemɔ ni ji ‘Yehowa jatsu’ lɛ, ekaje mɔ ko naa kwraa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ no etsɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ adaaŋ kotsa, ejaakɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, lɛ wiemɔi lɛ ahiɛ nyɛbu shi.
Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yeremia, bi gbalɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hetoo Yehowa ehã nyɛ?’ loo ‘Te Yehowa kɛɛ tɛŋŋ?’ Kɛji wiemɔ ‘Yehowa jatsu lɛ’ je nyɛnaa, be mli ni mitsu abakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ wiemɔ ni ji ‘Yehowa jatsu lɛ’ akaje nyɛnaa dɔŋŋ, ni wiemɔi nɛɛ eje nyɛnaa lɛ, naa, nyɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibawo mashɛ mafɔ̃ kɛje mihiɛ.
Nyɛhe ahora ni nyɛbaabɔ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni baagbo kɛya naanɔ lɛ hiɛ ejeŋ nɔ gbi ko gbi ko.”
Agbãmi kɛ kɛntɛŋi enyɔ lɛ Be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ebaŋɔ Yehoiakim bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin kɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi: Mina agbãmi kɛ kɛntɛŋi enyɔ mamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛntɛŋi lɛ ateŋ ekome lɛ agbãmii kpakpai ni tamɔ agbãmi ni tsu klɛŋklɛŋ sɔŋŋ yɔɔ mli.
Shi kɛntɛŋ kroko lɛ agbãmii gbohii yɔɔ mli, ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete.
Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Yeremia, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere nɔ akɛ, “Agbãmii; ni amɛteŋ agbãmii kpakpai lɛ, amɛhi jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ; shi amɛteŋ gbohii lɛ, amɛhiii, ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mikɛɔ ji akɛ bɔ ni agbãmii kpakpai lɛ hi lɛ, nakai nomi ni jɛ Yuda, mɛi ni mijie kɛjɛ biɛ nɛɛ kɛtee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ yɛ mihiɛ; majie mlijɔlɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Mahã mihiŋmɛi akã amɛhe ni mafee amɛ ekpakpa; ni mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Matswa amɛ mamã shi tamɔ amãa tsu, ni mikumɔŋ amɛ; matɛo amɛ tamɔ atɛoɔ tso, ni mifamɔŋ amɛ mishwieŋ.
Mibahã amɛ tsui ni baahã amɛle mi akɛ mi ji Yehowa; ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mibatsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ.
“Shi nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, bɔ ni mibafee agbãmii gbohii nɛɛ ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli tete lɛ, nakai mibafee Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni shwɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibahã amɛtsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ; ni abaaye amɛhe fɛo, ni abaabɔ amɛ ahora, ni amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya lɛ.
Mibahã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela abote amɛteŋ kɛyashi abaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ.”
Kooyigbɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ Afi nɔ ni Yosia bi Yehoiakim na afii ejwɛ akɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Nebukadnezar hu na afi akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie Yuda maŋbii fɛɛ ahe; ni mikɛɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ hu akɛ, “Afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nɛ, kɛjɛ Amon bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yosia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wieɔ, ni mi hu mikɛɔ nyɛ be fɛɛ be nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, shi nyɛbooo toi.
Yehowa etsu etsuji fɛɛ ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ; shi nyɛbooo toi lɛ, nyɛyeee nɔ hu.
Amɛbakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akpa ejeŋba gbonyo kɛ enifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhi shikpɔŋ ni Yehowa kɛhã nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ aahu kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkasɔ̃mɔa ni nyɛkajaa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛniji akafee amãgãi ni nyɛja amɛ nyɛkɛwo mimli la, ni mifee nyɛ efɔŋ.’ ‘Shi Yehowa kɛɛ nyɛbooo lɛ toi, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛninenaa amãgãi ni nyɛfee lɛ wo emli la, ni nyɛkɛye nyɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛhe awui.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛni nyɛbooo miwiemɔi lɛ toi hewɔ lɛ, naa, mibatsu koni ayaŋɔ kooyigbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ kɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hu abahã mi, ni mahã amɛfã ta kɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kɛ enɔ bii lɛ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ.
Mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ nyaŋemɔnɔ ni aboɔ lɛ ‘tsia!’ Ni amɛhiɛ aaashwie shi kɛya naanɔ.
Asaŋ mibahã nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ ayɛmforowu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo yɛ jɛi; anaŋ mɔ ko ni koto wiɛ sɛɛ yɛ jɛi lɛ, anaŋ kane ni asu yɛ jɛi he ko he ko.
Shikpɔŋ tso muu nɛɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa tete; ni majimaji nɛɛ baasɔ̃mɔ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ afii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Shi afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mibagbala Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ toi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛbaafee lɛ hewɔ; ni mahã amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mahã wiemɔi fɛɛ ni miwie mishi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, ni ji nii fɛɛ ni Yeremia gba shi majimaji lɛ, ni aŋmã yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ, aba mli.
Ejaakɛ mawo Babilonbii lɛ nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii kɛ amɛninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji baaye amɛ nyɔŋ.’ ” Fɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bu maji lɛ Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hemɔ wain kpulu nɛɛ yɛ midɛŋ; mlifu ji wain ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; ni ohã majimaji fɛɛ ni mibatsu bo amɛŋɔɔ lɛ anu eko.
Amɛbaanu, ni amɛbaadidãa, ni amɛbaaye sɛkɛ tete yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua amɛ lɛ hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni mihe kpulu lɛ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; ni mihã majimaji fɛɛ ni Yehowa tsu mi amɛŋɔɔ lɛ nu wain lɛ.
Mɛi ni nu ji, Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji wuji lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ shiaŋa kɛ nɔ ni aboɔ lɛ ‘tsia!’ Kɛ loomɔnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi hu ni nu Yehowa mlifu lɛ eko nɛ: Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etsuji lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ maŋsɛɛbii ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ hu.
Uz shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Ashkelon kɛ Gaza kɛ Ekron kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hu fɛɛ nu eko.
Mɛi komɛi hu ji Edombii kɛ Moabbii kɛ Amonbii lɛ, kɛ Tiro maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Sidon maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ Dedan maŋ lɛ kɛ Tema maŋ lɛ kɛ Buz maŋ lɛ hu kɛ gbɔmɛi komɛi ni shɛɔ amɛyitsei ahe lɛ.
Mɛi krokomɛi hu ji Arabia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ futufutu gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shiaŋa lɛ mli lɛ amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ Zimri maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Elam maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Media maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ.
Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ asa amɛnaa mlifu wain lɛ eko.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hu aaanu eko.
“Kɛkɛ lɛ okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, nyɛnua, nyɛtɔrɔa dãa, ni nyɛshwea, ni nyɛgbegbea shi ni nyɛkanyɛ shi nyɛte dɔŋŋ yɛ ta ni mibahã afã kɛbatua nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.’ Shi kɛji amɛmiii akɛ amɛaahe kpulu lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni amɛnu lɛ, no lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ, kɛɛ ji, ‘Ja nyɛna nyɛnu kɛ̃!
Ejaakɛ naa, kɛ mije shishi miifee maŋ wulu ni akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛŋɔɔ nyɛhe nyɛyeɔ tswaa hu?’ Nyɛŋɔŋ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ nakai, ejaakɛ miihã afã ta kɛbatua nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.
Mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ mikɛɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bo Yeremia, gbaa nɛkɛ gbalɛ nɛɛ oshi gbɔmɛi nɛɛ.
Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa aaajɛ ŋwɛi ehũu, ni ebaawo egbee kɛaajɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Eeehũu waa ewo ewebii lɛ ni eeebolɔ tamɔ wainŋalɔi, eeehũu ewo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ.
Ehũumɔ lɛ aaajije kɛaashɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ; ejaakɛ Yehowa yɛ sane ni ekɛbaashi majimaji lɛ.
Ekɛ heloo fɛɛ baakojo, ni eeehã mɛi fɔ̃ji anyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa.
Yehowa kɛɛ.’ ” Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa sane fɔŋ miijɛ maŋ kome nɔ kɛyanina maŋ kroko.
Ahum kpeteŋkple ko aaate shi kɛaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe tɔ̃ɔ.
Ni Yehowa baagbe mɛi yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe kome kɛyashi enaagbeehe kroko.
Afoŋ amɛ, ni abuaŋ amɛnaa, ni afuŋ amɛ tete; amɛaatsɔ̃ wamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Nyɛ maŋ onukpai, ni ji miwebii lɛ akwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akoklo lamlu mli ejaakɛ be ni abaagbegbee nyɛ, asaŋ be ni abaagbɛ nyɛ ashwã lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛbaagboi tamɔ too gwantɛŋi osaii.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ naŋ abobaahe ko lɛ, miwebii lɛ alumɛi lɛ naŋ he ko atsɔ̃ kɛjo foi hu.
Bo maŋbii akwɛlɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ lɛ toi kɛ lele ni miwebii lɛ alumɛi lɛ hu ewo lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa miikpãtã amɛjwɛifɔ shikpɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ewebii ni yɔɔ kpoo lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã yɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Yehowa eshi emɛi lɛ tamɔ jata shiɔ ebu efɔ̃ɔ shi; ejaakɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ klante ni henyɛlɔ fã yɛ amɛnɔ kɛ Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ hewɔ.”
Ayakojo Yeremia Yosia bi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ ba; ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, koni okɛ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mifã bo akɛ owie lɛ ashwie Yuda maji lɛ amli bii fɛɛ ni baa amɛbajaa yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ahiɛ.
Kaashi wiemɔ ko wiemɔ ko.
Eko lɛ aleenɔ amɛaabo toi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baakpa ejeŋba fɔŋ lɛ koni efɔŋ ni mito akɛ mafee amɛ yɛ amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mafo mli.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Esa ni nyɛboɔ mi toi koni nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimla ni miwo nyɛ lɛ naa, koni nyɛye mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ ni mitsuɔ amɛ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ anɔ, shi nyɛbooo amɛ toi, hewɔ lɛ mafee Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ tamɔ mifee Shilo lɛ, ni mahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ loomɔ nɔ̃ ahã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ.’ ” Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ Yeremia miiwie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Be ni Yeremia wie wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa fã lɛ akɛ ekɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ awie lɛ egbe naa lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, ni amɛbolɔ akɛ, “Ja ogbo!
Mɛɛba ogba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ Shilo, ni maŋ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni gbɔmɔ ehiŋ mli dɔŋŋ lɛ?’ ” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kpe wo Yeremia he yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Be ni Yuda lumɛi lɛ nu wiemɔi ni eje Yeremia naa lɛ, amɛjɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛbatara shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo ni gbɛi ji Agbo Hee lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ sa gbele, ejaakɛ egba yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiŋ eshi maŋ nɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɛɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ji mɔ ni kɛ wiemɔi ni nyɛnu lɛ fɛɛ tsu mi koni mibagba mashi Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛjeŋba kɛ nyɛnifeemɔnii; asaŋ nyɛboa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni lɛ hu ebaatsake ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, naa miyɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
Nyɛfea mi nɔ ni hi, kɛ nɔ ni ja yɛ nyɛhiɛ; shi moŋ nyɛnaa nyɛlea krɛdɛɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛgbe mi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ ko ni efeko nɔ fɔŋ ko lá yi sɔ̃ nyɛbaaloo nyɛbua nyɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ emli bii bluublu ayiteŋ, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, Yehowa ji mɔ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ akɛ mibawie nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛtoiaŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ esaaa gbele, ejaakɛ ekɛ wɔ wie yɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi mli.” Maŋ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi, ni amɛkɛɛ asafo muu ni ebabɔ gwa lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Be ko lɛ Mika ni jɛ Moreshet lɛ gba yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia yinɔ, ni ekɛɛ Yudabii fɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ji,’ ‘Abaahu Zion tamɔ ahuɔ ŋmɔ, Yerusalɛm baatsɔ̃ koikoi, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ koo ni etsa sulaŋŋ.’ Ani gbe Yuda Maŋtsɛ Hezekia kɛ Yuda fɛɛ gbe Mika lo?
Ani jeee gbeyei moŋ Hezekia she Yehowa ni efee nɔ ni hã Yehowa na ehe tsui, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa tsake ejwɛŋmɔ ni efee akɛ ebaakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ?
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔmiitao wɔloo musu kpele nɛɛ wɔbua wɔyiteŋ.” Nuu kroko hu hi shi, ni egba yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.
Egbɛi ji Uria, Shemaia ni jɛ Kiriat-Yearim lɛ bi lɛ.
Egba eshi Yerusalɛm maŋ nɛɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ tamɔ bɔ pɛ ni Yeremia gba nɛɛ.
Be ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim kɛ esraafoi lɛ kɛ maŋ lumɛi lɛ nu Uria wiemɔi lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ tao Uria egbe.
Shi be ni Uria nu maŋtsɛ yiŋtoo lɛ he lɛ eshe gbeyei, ni ejo foi etee Ijipt.
Shi Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim tsu hii komɛi ni ji Akbor bi Elnatan kɛ mɛi komɛi ni fata ehe kɛtee Ijipt.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tee ni amɛyamɔ Uria yɛ Ijipt kɛba amɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hã akɛ klante gbe Uria, ni ashɛ egbonyo lɛ afɔ̃ mɛi foji agbonyobu lɛ mli.
Shi akɛni Shafan bi Ahikam fã Yeremia he, ni eyɛ esɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, anaaa aŋmɛɛ Yeremia he ahã maŋbii lɛ koni amɛgbe lɛ.
Yeremia kɛ kɔŋtso fɔ̃ ekuɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia, ni ji Yosia bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi ji akɛ, “Okɛ kooloo wolo ni afolɔ lɛ blawai blawai kɛ tso afee kɔŋtso koni okɛfɔ̃ okuɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛ wiemɔ amaje Maŋtsɛmɛi abɔfoi ni eba Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia ŋɔɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ koni amɛkɛyahã Edom maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Moab maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ Sidon maŋtsɛ lɛ.” Okɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛyakɛɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mi, Yehowa, mi mibɔ je lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi bluublu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ mihewalɛ kpeteŋkple kɛ minineshiwalɛ naa; ni mikɛhãa mɔ ni misumɔɔ.
Amrɔ nɛɛ miŋɔ shikpɔji nɛɛ fɛɛ miwo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar mitsulɔ lɛ dɛŋ; ni mikɛ jwɛiiaŋ kooloi tete ewo eshishi koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Majimaji fɛɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ ebinuu kɛ enabi nuu tete kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni lɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu, eshikpɔŋ lɛ be aaashɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ maji babaoo kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji baaye lɛ nyɔŋ.
“Naa, kɛji maŋ ko loo maŋtsɛyeli shikpɔŋ ko emiii akɛ esɔ̃mɔ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɛɛ koni ekɛ ehe awo enɔyeli shishi lɛ, no lɛ, mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela baagbala nakai maŋ lɛ toi, kɛyashi mahã Nebukadnezar akpãtã nakai maŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkaboa nyɛgbalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛklalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛlalɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛkɔmfoi lɛ kɛ nyɛkunyaayelɔi lɛ ni kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ toi.’ “Ejaakɛ gbalɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, amale sɔŋŋ ni.
Nɔ ni no kɛbaaba ji akɛ abaaloo nyɛ kɛje nyɛshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ kɛya maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Mibashwie nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaŋɔ ehe ewo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyeli shishi, ni eeesɔ̃mɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã ehi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ, ni ehu nɔ, ni ehi nɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Mikɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ shwie Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia hiɛ, ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, nyɛŋɔa nyɛhe nyɛwoa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔyeli shishi, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ ewebii lɛ; ni nyɛyi aaana wala!
Mɛni hewɔ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela aaakpãtã bo kɛ omaŋbii ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ewie yɛ maŋ ni sɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ?
Kaabo gbalɔi lɛ ni kɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Nyɛsɔ̃mɔŋ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ’ awiemɔi lɛ toi, ejaakɛ gbalɛi ni amɛgbaa lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mitsuko amɛ.
Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmiigba amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛiŋ.
Nɔ ni baaba ji akɛ mibashwie nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛhiɛ aaakpatã, nyɛ kɛ nyɛgbalɔi lɛ ni gbaa tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ nyɛkaboa nyɛgbalɔi ni gbaa ni amɛkɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ‘etsɛŋ ni akɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii ni aloo kɛtee Babilon lɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba,’ lɛ awiemɔi lɛ toi, ejaakɛ amale gbalɛ amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛkaboa amɛ toi; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala.
Mɛɛba aaahã maŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃?
Kɛji gbalɔi ji amɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni mi Yehowa, mikɛ miwiemɔi ewo amɛnaa lɛ, no lɛ amɛkpa mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, fai koni nibii ni eshwɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli hu lɛ akaŋɔ kɛmiiya Babilon.” -Be ni Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baŋɔ Yehoiakim bi Yekonia lɛ, ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm abladei lɛ hu nom lɛ, eshi akulashiŋ lɛ kɛ nutoo akɔɔble gbudugbaŋ agbo lɛ kɛ nibii anɔ ni ema lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii krokomɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ yɛ nibii ni eshwɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli hu he nɛ, “Abaaloo amɛ kɛya Babilon, ni amɛbaahi jɛi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni makai amɛ, ni mikɛ nibii nɛɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba amɛtsuutsu toohe lɛ mli yɛ biɛ ekoŋŋ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yeremia kɛ Gbalɔ Hanania Nakai afi lɛ mli nɔŋŋ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli, yɛ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Azur bi Hanania ni ji gbalɔ ko ni jɛ Gibeon maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛɛ mi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli yɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii muu lɛ ahiɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mifite Babilon maŋtsɛ hewalɛ ni tamɔ apã ni kã nyɛkuɛ lɛ.
Biɛ afii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mibaŋɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii fɛɛ ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baloo yɛ biɛ kɛtee Babilon lɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.
Asaŋ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yekonia, Yehoiakim bi lɛ, kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Yuda kɛtee Babilon lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ mibafite Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ ni tamɔ apã lɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni, mi Yeremia, mihere Gbalɔ Hanania nɔ yɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni damɔdamɔɔ shi yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ; ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amen!
Yehowa aaafee nakai.
Yehowa ahã ogbalɛ ni ogba nɛɛ aba mli akɛ ebaaŋɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nibii lɛ kɛ nomii lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Babilon kɛba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ agbɛnɛ bo wiemɔ ni miwieɔ yɛ bo kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ toiŋ nɛɛ toi.
Gbalɔi ni tsɔ̃ mi kɛ bo fɛɛ wɔhiɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ, amɛgba tai kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela ni baaba shikpɔji babaoo kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi wuji amaŋtsɛyelihei anɔ ahe gbalɛi.
Gbalɔ ni gbaa hejɔlɛ he gbalɛ lɛ, nɔ ni akɛleɔ akɛ Yehowa ni tsu lɛ lɛɛlɛŋ mli ji kɛji egbalɛ lɛ na eba mli anɔkwaleŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Gbalɔ Hanania wo kɔŋtso lɛ yɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia kuɛ, ni ekumɔ mli; ni Gbalɔ Hanania wie yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ mibakumɔ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ apã lɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ akuɛ biɛ afii enyɔ mli.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia shi jɛi ni etee.
Be fioo ko sɛɛ be ni Gbalɔ Hanania kumɔ kɔŋtso lɛ yɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia kuɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ Hanania akɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ, okumɔ kɔŋtso ni akɛ tso fee lɛ, shi mibafee dade kɔŋtso mikɛto tso nɔ lɛ najiaŋ; ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛ dade apã efɔ̃ nɛkɛ majimaji nɛɛ fɛɛ akuɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar.
Mikɛ jwɛiiaŋ kooloi tete ehã lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ Gbalɔ Hanania akɛ, “Hanania, bo toi!
Yehowa tsuko bo; ni ohã maŋbii nɛɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ efɔ̃ amale nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibajie bo yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Afi nɛɛ nɔŋŋ mli lɛ obaagbo, ejaakɛ owie atuatsemɔ wiemɔ oshi Yehowa.’ ” Ni nakai afi lɛ nɔŋŋ mli nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gbalɔ Hanania gbo.
Yeremia ŋma wolo emaje Yudabii ni yɔɔ Babilon lɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia ŋma wolo ekɛmaje kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ni akɛyahã Yudabii maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon lɛ.
Aŋma wolo nɛɛ be ni amɔmɔ Maŋtsɛ Yekonia kɛ emaŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ piafoi lɛ kɛ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm abladei hu kɛ ŋaalɔi srɔtoi lɛ kɛ sɔ̃lɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli sɛɛ.
Mikɛ wolo nɛɛ maje Shafan bi Elasa kɛ Hilkia bi Gemaria, ni ji bɔfoi komɛi ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia etsu amɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon lɛ.
Wolo lɛ mli wiemɔ nɛ, “Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nomi fɛɛ ni ehã aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon nɛ, ‘Nyɛmamɔa tsui, ni nyɛhi mli; nyɛfea abɔi ni nyɛye amɛmli yibii; nyɛŋɔŋɔa yei ni nyɛfɔfɔɔ bihii kɛ biyei; nyɛŋɔa ŋamɛi hu nyɛhãa nyɛbihii; nyɛkɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahãa gbãlã koni amɛ hu amɛfɔfɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi afa yɛ jɛi, koni nyɛnɔ akagbɔ!
Shi nyɛtaoa maŋ nɔ ni mihã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛtee lɛ nɔyaa kɛ eshweremɔ; ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛkpaa Yehowa fai nyɛhãa maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛji maŋ lɛ he jɔ lɛ lɛ, no dani nyɛ hu nyɛhe baajɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ ji, nyɛkaŋmɛa nyɛgbalɔi kɛ nyɛklamɔfoi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ gbɛ ni amɛlakaa nyɛ; asaŋ nyɛkahea lamɔi ni amɛlaa lɛ nyɛye, ejaakɛ gbalɛi ni amɛgbaa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ amale sɔŋŋ ni.
Mitsuko amɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ “Ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji Babilon ye afii nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ etã lɛ, mibakwɛ nyɛsane lɛ maye mahã nyɛ, ni mibahã shiwoo jurɔ ni miwo yɛ nyɛhe, akɛ mibahã nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, aba mli.’ “Mi pɛ mile jwɛŋmɔi ni mijwɛŋɔ yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛhe jwɛŋmɔi kpakpa, shi jeee efɔŋ, nɔ ni baahã nyɛ wɔsɛɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ aba mli ahã nyɛ.
Nakai be lɛ nyɛaafo nyɛtsɛ mi, ni nyɛaaba nyɛbasɔle nyɛkpa mi fai, ni mibabo nyɛ toi.
Nyɛaatao mi, ni nyɛaana mi, kɛji nyɛtao misɛɛgbɛ kɛ nyɛtsui fɛɛ lɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ nyɛaana mi; ni nyɛnii fɛɛ ni laaje lɛ, nyɛnine baashɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Mibabua nyɛnaa kɛjɛ majimaji anɔ kɛ hei fɛɛ ni mishwie nyɛ kɛtee lɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba biɛ nɛɛ he ni mihã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛjɛ kɛtee lɛ ekoŋŋ.
“Shi kɛɛmɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa etee gbalɔi ashi yɛ Babilon ehã wɔ, hewɔ lɛ,’ naa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ maŋtsɛ ni ta David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, ni ji nyɛwekumɛi ni aŋɔɔɔ amɛ nom afataaa nyɛhe kɛyaaa nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ ahe.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ‘Naa, miihã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela abote amɛteŋ, ni mahã amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ agbãmii gbohii ni hilɛ ni amɛhiii sɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛhiii yeli.
Mibahã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela anyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni jeŋ maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe baajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛbaatsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ amɛhã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyelihei fɛɛ, ni abaaye amɛhe fɛo, ni abaabɔ amɛ ahora, ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ mɛi ni alomɔ amɛ yɛ hei fɛɛ ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã kɛya lɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛbooo miwiemɔ lɛ toi, ni ji wiemɔi ni mikɛtsuɔ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ amɛŋɔɔ be fɛɛ be lɛ.
Amɛkwa, ni amɛbooo toi.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ Nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi, nyɛ nomii fɛɛ ni mihã nyɛshi Yerusalɛm kɛtee Babilon, “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ yɛ Kolaia bi Ahab kɛ Maaseia bi Zedekia ni gbaa amale gbalɛi yɛ migbɛi mli amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ ahe nɛ, ‘Mibahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar amɔmɔ amɛ, ni ebaagbe amɛ yɛ nyɛhiɛ,’ koni Yuda nomii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Babilon, kɛ amɛ alomɔ mɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa afee bo tamɔ bɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ shã Zedekia kɛ Ahab lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛfee hiɛgbejianii pam yɛ Israel.
Amɛkɛ amɛnanemɛi aŋamɛi fite gbãlã, ni amɛwie amale wiemɔi yɛ migbɛi mli, be mli ni mikɛ nakai wiemɔi tsuko amɛ.
Mi pɛ mile nibii ni amɛfee lɛ; ni mi miiye he odase.
Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.’ ” Shemaia wolo lɛ Asaŋ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Shemaia, Nehelamnyo lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛni oŋmala woji yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ogbɛi mli okɛmaje abahã Yerusalɛm maŋbii blublu kɛ Maaseia bi Zefania, ni ji osɔfo lɛ, kɛ osɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, Yehowa ewo bo osɔfo yɛ Osɔfo Yehoiada najiaŋ koni otsɔ̃ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nɔkwɛlɔ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yiŋ kãa lɛ ni efeɔ ehe gbalɔ lɛ, obɔ lɛ apã ni owo lɛ gboklɛ lɛ, mɛɛba ni okãaa Yeremia, Anatotnyo lɛ, ni egbaa etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ ekɛ wiemɔ emaje akɛbahã wɔ yɛ Babilon nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛnomŋɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ baatsɛ; nyɛmamɔa tsui ni nyɛhia mli; ni nyɛfea abɔi koni nyɛye amɛmli yibii.’ ” Osɔfo Zefania kane nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ yɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia toiŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsu kɛya ni ayakɛɛ nomii lɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Shemaia, Nehelamnyo lɛ he ji enɛ: Shemaia egba gbalɛi etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ be mli ni mitsuko lɛ, ni ehã nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ efɔ amale nɔ.’ Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, mibagbala Shemaia, Nehelamnyo lɛ, kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ atoi.
Eshwiei ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ ni ehiŋmɛii baana ejurɔ ni mibafee miwebii lɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ, ejaakɛ ewie wiemɔ ni baahã maŋbii lɛ atse atua awo mi Yehowa.’ ”
Shii ni Yehowa wo ewebii Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɛ.
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Ŋmãa wiemɔi ni mikɛ bo ewie lɛ fɛɛ owo wolo mli.
Shi naa, gbii miiba ni mibahã miwebii Israelbii kɛ Yudabii anine ashɛ amɛnibii fɛɛ ni amɛlaaje lɛ anɔ.
Mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ koni amɛbaŋɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.” Wiemɔi ni Yehowa wie yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda he nɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Minu tsuifãa blɔmɔ he, gbeyeishemɔ blɔmɔ ni, ejeee hejɔlɛ blɔmɔ.
Nyɛbia nyɛkwɛa; Ani nuu ekɔ̃mɔ efɔ bi pɛŋ?
Mɛɛba mɔ ni minaa nuu fɛɛ nuu efua emusu tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ nɛɛ?
Mɛɛba mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ eshale nɛkɛ?
Ao!
Nakai gbi lɛ, gbi wulu ni; ehenɔ bako pɛŋ.
Yakob hejaramɔ gbi ni, kɛ̃lɛ abaahere eyiwala yɛ gbele mli.” Ni mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ nakai gbi lɛ mibakumɔ apã lɛ yɛ amɛkuɛ, ni mibatserɛ kpãi ni fimɔ amɛ lɛ; ni mɛi kpɔji yeŋ amɛ nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ David shwie ni mibato lɛ maŋtsɛ mibahã amɛ lɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bo, mitsulɔ Yakob, kaashe gbeyei; ni Israel, otsui akafã, ejaakɛ mibahere nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei hu, kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ amɛnomŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yakob baaku esɛɛ eba ni ebahi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ ehe gbeyei.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ koni mahere nyɛyiwala.
Mibakpãtã majimaji fɛɛ ni migbɛ nyɛ mishwã amɛnɔ lɛ ahiɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Shi bo lɛ, mikpãtãŋ ohiɛ kɛmɔŋ shi; shi kɛ̃lɛ mibagbala otoi bɔ ni sa kɛkɛ, ni mihaŋ oŋɔ ohe oye tswaa.” Ejaakɛ, mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛpilamɔ lɛ bɛ tsabaa, ni nyɛfala lɛ ewo wu.
Mɔ ko bɛ ni baaye nyɛsane lɛ; nyɛfala lɛ he tsofa bɛ lɛ, nyɛhela lɛ bɛ tsabaa.
Nyɛsuɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ ekpa nyɛnɔ, jeee amɛhe sane ko ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mitswa nyɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni henyɛlɔ baatswa nyɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ da.
Mɛɛba nyɛfoɔ yɛ nyɛpilamɔ hewɔ?
Nyɛpiŋmɔ lɛ bɛ tsabaa.
Akɛni nyɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ da, ni nyɛhe eshai lɛ fa lɛ, no hewɔ ni mifee nyɛ enɛ nɛɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kpãtãa nyɛhiɛ lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ; ni abaaŋɔ nyɛhenyɛlɔi ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nom.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaaha nyɛ nii lɛ aaaha amɛ nii; ni mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ niseniianii lɛ, mahã afee amɛ niseniianii.
Ejaakɛ mahã nyɛna hewalɛ ekoŋŋ, ni matsa nyɛfaji lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsɛ bo mɔ ni ashwie lɛ, ‘Zion ni jeee mɔ ko he sane ji lɛ.’ Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Naa, mibahã miwebii ashwere ekoŋŋ; ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ shĩa fɛɛ shĩa he.
Abaasaa Yerusalɛm atswa ama egɔ̃ŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni mɔɔ lɛ aaama etsutsu maahe lɛ.
Shidaa lalai aaagbɛɛ kɛjɛ mli, mɛi ni miinya agbee aaajije kɛjɛ jɛi.
Mibahã amɛyi afa, ni amɛnɔ gbɔŋ; mibawo amɛhiɛ nyam; abuŋ amɛ akɛ maŋ bibioo.
Amɛbii ashihilɛ aaafee tamɔ sa shihilɛ, ni amɛsafo lɛ baahe shi yɛ mihiɛ, ni mibagbala mɛi fɛɛ ni waa amɛyi lɛ atoi.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko nɔŋŋ baatsɔ̃ amɛlumɔ; amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ baajɛ amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛteŋ.
Mahã etsi ebɛŋkɛ mi, ni ebaaba mimasɛi, ejaakɛ namɔ aaanyɛ ashi etsitsi, ni eba mi, mimasɛi?
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Nyɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mi hu mibatsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ.” Naa, Yehowa mlifu lɛ, ahum ni, ni efã kɛje kpo tamɔ lasuogbele, ni ebaalota mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ kɛya.
Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee lɛ, ena efee kɛgbe naa.
Wɔsɛɛ ko dani nyɛaanu sane nɛɛ shishi faŋŋ.
Israel sɛɛkuu kɛ shĩabaa Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Be ko miiba, ni nakai be lɛ mibatsɔ̃ Israel akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii.
Maŋbii ni je klante naa gbele mli lɛ, mina amɛ mɔbɔ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli.
Be ni Israel shwe ni ena hejɔlɛ lɛ, mi Yehowa, mijie mihe kpo yɛ shɔŋŋ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Misumɔ bo kɛ naanɔ suɔmɔ; no hewɔ ni mikã he misumɔɔ bo lolo lɛ.
Ao!
Oblayoo foro Israel!
Mibasaa matswa bo tamɔ tsu mama shi ekoŋŋ, ni oooma shi hu.
Oookɔlɔ omiji lɛ otsotsoro ekoŋŋ ni oooje kpo okɛ mɛi ni amli efili amɛ aaayajo kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ooofee waintromii yɛ Samaria gɔji lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ, ni mɛi ni tɛoɔ waintsei lɛ baaye tsei lɛ ayibii.
Ejaakɛ be ko miiba, ni bulɔi aaabolɔ yɛ Efraim gɔji lɛ anɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtea shi koni wɔya Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ yɛ Zion.’ ” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛlaa waa kɛ miishɛɛ nyɛhãa Israel nyɛbɔa oshe nyɛhãa maji fɛɛ ayitso lɛ.
Nyɛshiɛa, nyɛkafoa, ni nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Yehowa ehere ewebii Israelbii ni shwɛ lɛ ayiwala.’ Naa, mibakpala amɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei tɔ̃ɔ.
Mikɛ asafo yuu ni shwilafoi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ yeihɔlɔi kɛ yeifɔyei fɛɛ tswɛm futu mli aaaku sɛɛ aba biɛ nɛɛ ekoŋŋ.
Amɛbaaba kɛ yaafo kɛ faikpamɔ ni mibakpala amɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba.
Mibahã amɛnyiɛ fai atoii kɛ gbɛ trɔmɔɔ nɔ, he ni amɛtɛrɛŋ yɛ.
Ejaakɛ Israel Tsɛ ji mi, ni mikromɔbi ji Efraim.
“Nyɛ majimaji, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛgbaa yɛ shɔŋŋ yɛ ŋshɔnaa majiaŋ.
Nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni gbɛ Israel shwã lɛ ebaabua amɛnaa, ni ebaakwɛ amɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ kwɛɔ etoo ku pɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa ekpɔ̃ Israel, ni ehere lɛ yɛ mɔ ni he wa tsɔ̃ fe lɛ lɛ dɛŋ.
Amɛbaaba ni amɛbala waa kɛ nyamɔ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛmii baashɛ Yehowa mlihilɛ lɛ he, yɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu, kɛ toobii kɛ tsinai ahewɔ.
Amɛshihilɛ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ abɔɔ ni ashwie emlinii nɔ nu, ni amɛtɔŋ biti dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ oblayei lɛ baajo kɛ nyamɔ, ni oblahii kɛ hiimeji amii aaashɛ amɛhe.
Mibahã amɛkɔmɔyeli atsɔ̃ mliflimɔ; mibashɛje amɛmii, ni yɛ awerɛho najiaŋ lɛ mahã amɛnya.
Mibahã osɔfoi ana nii babaoo amɛye amɛtɔrɔ, ni mimaŋbii lɛ atsui aaatɔ kɛ mimlihilɛ lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Yehowa na Israel mɔbɔ Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Anu gbee ko yɛ Rama, yarawoo kɛ yaafo ni mli wa; Rahel miifo ebii ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kpãtãmɔ yɛ ebii lɛ ahewɔ ejaakɛ amɛbɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Fɔ̃ɔmɔ yaafo lɛ, ohiŋmɛiŋ akakpala nu; ejaakɛ abaawo bo onii ni otsu lɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ akɛ, Obii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ hã owɔsɛɛ ko; obii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” “Minu ni Israel ye ŋkɔmɔ akɛ, ‘Ogbala mitoi, ni okɛtsɔse mi tamɔ tsinabi ni atsɔseko lɛ.
Kpalemɔ mi kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni mibakpale, ejaakɛ bo ji Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Be ni mikwa bo lɛ, mishwa mihe; ni be ni atsɔ̃ɔ mi nii sɛɛ lɛ, miyi mishuɔ he ma; mihiɛ gbo, ni mihiɛ shwie shi, ejaakɛ miblahiaŋ hiɛgbele lɛ kpɛ misɛɛ lolo.’ Israel ji mibinuu kpakpa lɛ.
Lɛ ji misuɔmɔ bi lɛ.
Shii abɔ fɛɛ ni miwieɔ mishiɔ lɛ lɛ, mikaiɔ lɛ kɛ̃ kɛ dɔlɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui shweɔ lɛ.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mana lɛ mɔbɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mãamɔ gbɛkadimɔ nii ohã ohe; too okadii ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo gbɛ.
Jwɛŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ he jogbaŋŋ, gbɛ ni onyiɛ nɔ kɛtee lɛ.
Ao!
Oblayoo foro Israel!
Kpalemɔ kɛba omaji nɛɛ amli.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ oooshashao shi kɛyashi, bo, biyoo ni yeee anɔkwa?
Ejaakɛ naa, mi, Yehowa, mikɛ nɔ hee ko eba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yoo dedenyɛ miibu nuu he.” Nyɔŋmɔ Webii baashwere wɔsɛɛ Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Kɛji mihã amɛnine shɛ amɛnibii ni amɛlaaje lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ, amɛbaakɛɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ enɔ maji lɛ amli akɛ, ‘Bo shihilɛhe ni ayeɔ jalɛ sane yɛ omli, Yehowa ajɔɔ bo, bo Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.’ Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji fɛɛ amli baahi shi akɛ gbɔmɛi kome, okwaafoi kɛ tookwɛlɔi ni kɛ amɛtoi kpaa shi; ejaakɛ mibahã mɔ ni etɔ lɛ mii ashɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hɔmɔ ehã etɔ biti lɛ mahã ena nii eye ni etɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni mihiɛ tsɛ̃, ni mina akɛ miwɔ wɔ kpakpa.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, be ko miiba, ni nakai be lɛ mahã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi hu afɛo yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda fɛɛ tamɔ dumɔwu.
Ni ebaaba mli akɛ bɔ ni mishi amɛhe kpe ni mifamɔ amɛ mishwie, ni mikumɔ amɛ mishwie shi, ni mibutu amɛ, ni mikpãtã amɛhiɛ ni mifee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ mashi amɛhe kpe ni matɛo amɛ, ni matswa amɛ mama shi.
“Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛkɛŋ dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Tsɛmɛi eye wainyibii ŋmilikitii, ni bii moŋ anyanyɔji eshɔ̃.’ Shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ wainyibii ŋmilikiti lɛ, lɛ enyanyɔŋ baashɔ̃, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baagbo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔsha hewɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Naa be miiba, ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mi kɛ Israel kɛ Yuda hu baakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ hee.
Kpãŋmɔ hee nɛɛ tamɔɔɔ kpãŋmɔ ni mi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ be ni mimɔ amɛnine shi ni mikpala amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nakai mikpãŋmɔ lɛ amɛku mli, tsɛbelɛ mi ji amɛwu.
Kpãŋmɔ hee ni mikɛ Israel baakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbi lɛ sɛɛ nɛ: Mibaŋɔ mimla lɛ mawo amɛmli, ni mibaŋmã mlai lɛ mawo amɛtsuii amli, ni mibatsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛbaatsɔ mimaŋ.
Ni mɔ ko etsɔŋ enaanyo, ni mɔ ko hu etsɔŋ enyɛmi dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Le Yehowa’, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛaale mi, kɛjɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ, ejaakɛ mikɛ amɛnishaianii lɛ baafa amɛ, ni mikaiŋ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Lɛ mɔ ni ebɔ hulu koni etso shwane; ni eto nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii gbɛjianɔ koni amɛkpɛ nyɔɔŋ; Lɛ mɔ ni etaa ŋshɔ mli ni ehãa ŋshɔkei huuɔ ni egbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Miikɛɛ akɛ ja gbɛjianɔ ni ato nɛɛ sɛɛ efo yɛ mihiɛ, no dani Israelbii ashwiei ayi aaatã, ni amɛfeŋ maŋ yɛ mihiɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kɛji aaanyɛ ŋwɛi ni yɔɔ wɔyiteŋ nɛɛ asusu, ni aaanyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo shi akpa lɛ, no lɛ, mi hu makwa Israel fɛɛ kwa yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, be miiba, ni abaasaa atswa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ ahã mi, Yehowa, kɛjɛ Hananel Mɔɔ ni kwɔ lɛ he kɛyashi Koŋ Agbo lɛ naa.
Abaatsa husu lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ jɛi tɛ̃ɛ kɛyatsɔ̃ Gareb Gɔ̃ŋkpɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaadɔ eyi kɛya Goa.
Jɔɔ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ gbohii kɛ tumo lɛ, kɛ ŋmɔji lɛ fɛɛ aahu kɛyashi Kidron Faa lɛ naa, kɛyashi Okpɔŋɔi Agbo lɛ koŋ ni ye bokãgbɛ lɛ he lɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa.
Akumɔŋ, ni abutuŋ maŋ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.”
Yeremia he shikpɔŋ ko Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma, ni ji Nebukadnezar yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, lɛ nɔ.
No mli lɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tabilɔi miisa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yi, ni atsi Gbalɔ Yeremia naa yɛ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ nɔ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia ewo Yeremia kpabuŋ ejaakɛ ekɛɛ Yeremia kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa miijɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ miihã Babilon Maŋtsɛ, ni ebaaŋɔ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia ejeŋ Babilonbii lɛ adɛŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ; shi abaamɔ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ baawo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ, Ebaana lɛ kɛ ehiŋmɛitsei enyɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ baawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ baakpala Zedekia kɛya Babilon; ni Zedekia baaya eyahi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mibana lɛ mɔbɔ.
Kɛji nyɛ kɛ Babilonbii lɛ wu tete po lɛ, nyɛyeŋ kunim.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Yeremia kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, Naa, Hanamel ni ji otsɛkwɛ Shalum binuu lɛ baaba oŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Miihɔ̃ɔ mishikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Anatot lɛ.
Hemɔ, ejaakɛ bo oyɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ okpɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ.’ Kɛkɛ ni Hanamel, mitsɛkwɛ binuu lɛ ba miŋɔɔ yɛ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ nɔ, bɔ pɛ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ebakɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Miihɔ̃ɔ mishikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Anatot yɛ Benyaminbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Hemɔ, ejaakɛ bo oyɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ oyeɔ gboshinii; ni no hewɔ lɛ, bo oyɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ okpɔ̃ɔ, hewɔ lɛ hemɔ ohã ohe.’ Kɛkɛ ni mina akɛ Yehowa kɛ mi ewie lɛɛlɛŋ.
Miŋmɛ shika ni naa shɛɔ jwiɛtɛi shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ kpawo, ni mikɛhe shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Anatot lɛ yɛ mitsɛkwɛ binuu Hanamel dɛŋ.
Mikɛ minine wo shikpɔŋ lɛ hɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ wolo lɛ shishi, ni misɔo naa, ni mitsɛ mɛi amɛbaye he odase; miŋmɛ shika lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wolo ni asɔo naa ni ji shikpɔŋ lɛ jara kɛ wolo lɛ henɔ ni asɔoko naa lɛ fɛɛ, ni mikɛ woji lɛ hã Baruk, ni ji Maesia bi Neria bi lɛ, yɛ mitsɛkwɛ binuu Hanamel hiɛ.
Odasefoi lɛ ni kɛ amɛgbɛii wo nihɔɔmɔ nɔ woji lɛ shishi lɛ kɛ Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ koi lɛ shi lɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni mifã Baruk yɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ji akɛ, ohe nɛkɛ woji nɛɛ ni ji nihɔɔmɔ nɔ wolo ni asɔo naa kɛ nɔ ni asɔoko naa nɛɛ fɛɛ koni okɛyato gbɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni wolo lɛ atsɛ be babaoo.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, abaatse shika akɛhe shĩa kɛ ŋmɔ kɛ waintrom ekoŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.’ ” Yeremia sɔlemɔ lɛ Be ni mikɛ shikpɔŋhɔ̃ɔmɔ nɔ wolo lɛ ehã Neria bi Baruk sɛɛ lɛ, misɔle yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, bo obɔ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ yɛ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ naa; nɔ ko nɔ ko shɛɛɛ bo feemɔ.
Osuɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛ efooo hã mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ; shi okɛ tsɛmɛi anishaianii lɛ ahe toigbalamɔ hãa amɛbii ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Ao!
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɔ kpele, bo ni ogbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ, oŋaalee mli kwɔ, ni ofeɔ nibii wuji.
Bo ni onaa gbɔmɛi ajeŋbai fɛɛ, ni bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nifeemɔ yɔɔ lɛ nakai he nyɔmɔ owoɔ lɛ; ni nɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ duɔ lɛ no yibii ohãa ekpaa.
Ofee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ oofee nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ Israel kɛ majimaji blublu anɔ, ni okɛhe gbɛi tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Otsɔ̃ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii kɛ ohewalɛ lɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ ni hã ashe gbeyei lɛ nɔ ni ojie owebii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oŋɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni okã amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ okɛbaahã amɛ lɛ ohã amɛ, eji shikpɔŋ kɛ emli fɔ ni baa nii.
Amɛba ni amɛbaŋɔ ni amɛkɛfee amɛnɔ.
Shi amɛyeee ogbee nɔ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ omla lɛ naa.
Nibii fɛɛ ni owo amɛ kitã yɛ he akɛ amɛfee lɛ, amɛfeee ekome folo nɛkɛ.
No hewɔ ni ohã nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ ba amɛnɔ nɛɛ.
“Naa, kpokui ni maŋ lɛ yisalɔi lɛ tswaa amɛkɛsa maŋ lɛ yi lɛ, enina maŋ lɛ etã; ni abaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela baahã Babilonbii ni ebatua maŋ lɛ aye maŋ lɛ nɔ kunim.
Owiemɔ lɛ eba mli, ni oona.
Tsɛbelɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, bo nɔŋŋ okɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Tse shika okɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ; ni otsɛ mɛi abaye he odase; asomoaŋ ojɔɔ maŋ lɛ nɔ owo Babilonbii lɛ adɛŋ momo!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie akɛ, “Naa, mi ji Yehowa, gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Ani nɔ ko shɛɔ mi feemɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, naa, miijɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ miiwo Babilonbii kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar dɛŋ, koni amɛbaŋɔ.
Babilonbii ni ebatua maŋ lɛ baana abote maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbaama maŋ lɛ naa la koni amɛshã.
Amɛbaashã shĩai ni maŋbii lɛ shã tsofakɛŋma yɛ amɛyiteiaŋ amɛkɛhã Baal, asaŋ ni amɛfɔse wain hu amɛshwie shi akɛ afɔle yɛ jɛi amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi, ni amɛkɛ nakai feemɔ wo mimli la lɛ.
Ejaakɛ yɛ mi, mihiɛ lɛ, Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ efɔŋ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛfeɔ kɛjɛ amɛblahiiaŋ beebe; ni mimli la sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ Israelbii woɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Kɛjɛ gbi ni ato maŋ nɛɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, mlifu kɛ mlila sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ woɔ mi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã ehiɛ, yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ amɛlumɛi kɛ amɛsɔfoi kɛ amɛgbalɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ fɛɛ fee ni amɛkɛwo mimli la lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã mi, ni amɛkwɛɛɛ mihiɛ tete; tsɛbelɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mikã he mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii aahu, shi amɛbooo toi ni amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ tsɔsemɔ.
Amɛkɛ amɛnihiinii lɛ yamamɔ shĩa ni ajaa mi yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛbule jɛi.
Amɛmamɔ Baal jamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ ni yɔɔ Hinom Jɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ koni amɛgbe amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei yɛ jɛi amɛkɛshã afɔle amɛkɛhã jemawɔŋ Molek lɛ.
Tsɛbelɛ mifãko amɛ, ni asaŋ ebako miyiŋ tete akɛ amɛfee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ ni amɛkɛhã Yuda fɛɛ agbee esha mli.” Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shiwoo Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yeremia, nɔ ni mikɛɔ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ ni okɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ enɔ ahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela nɔ’ lɛ he nɛ.” Naa, mi nɔŋŋ mabua maŋbii ni mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila kɛ grimɔ ni naa wa jogbaŋŋ eshwie amɛ kɛtee maŋsɛɛ lɛ anaa kɛjɛ nakai shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ baaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; ni mahã amɛhi shi shweshweeshwe; ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mibatsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
Mahã amɛna jwɛŋmɔ koome kɛ jeŋba koome, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe mi gbeyei kɛya naanɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã amɛ kɛ amɛbii ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ.
Mikɛ amɛ baakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ akɛ, mikpãŋ amɛ ejurɔfeemɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛ mihe gbeyeishemɔ baawo amɛmli koni amɛkaje misɛɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mibafee amɛ ejurɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, ni anɔkwale mli lɛ, mikɛ mitsui kɛ mimumɔ fɛɛ baahã amɛhe shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
“Bɔ ni, mi Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, bɔ ni mihã nɛkɛ efɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ ba gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu mibahã ekpakpa fɛɛ ekpakpa ni miwo amɛ he shi lɛ aba amɛnɔ.
Nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ yɛ he akɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo tete bɛ nɔ, asaŋ ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã Babilonbii lɛ, abaatse shika akɛhe shikpɔŋ yɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Abaahɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ, ni abaahe shikpɔŋ, ni abaafee nɔ woji, abaasɔo woji nɛɛ anaa, ni abaatsɛtsɛɛ mɛi amɛbayeyee he odase yɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm niiaŋ kɛ Yuda maji lɛ amli kɛ gɔji anɔ maji lɛ amli kɛ ŋa nɔ maji lɛ amli kɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ hu amli, ejaakɛ mibahã amɛnibii fɛɛ ni amɛlaaje lɛ amɛnine ashɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shiwoo kroko Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ be ni eyɔɔ kpabuŋ yɛ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ.
Yehowa, mɔ ni bɔ jeŋ, ni etee lɛ shi ema shi, lɛ mɔ ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Tsɛ mi, ni mahere bo nɔ, ni magba bo teemɔŋ nibii ni oleee.
Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɔ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli shĩai ni akumɔ bɔ ni afee ni ana nibii akɛtswa kpokui akɛfã maŋ lɛ he yɛ ta mli lɛ he nɛ: Babilonbii lɛ miiba amɛbawu ta; ni amɛbaahã maŋ nɛɛ ayi obɔ̃ kɛ mɛi ni mibagbe yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila lɛ naa lɛ agbohii.
Ejaakɛ mikwɛɛɛ maŋ nɛɛ sane dɔŋŋ yɛ emli bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ahewɔ.
Shi naa, mi nɔŋŋ mibasaa maŋ lɛ ni matee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ni mahã emli bii ana toiŋjɔlɛ babaoo, amɛbaashwere ni amɛbaafee shweshweeshwe.
Ni mahã Yuda kɛ Israel nine ashɛ amɛnibii ni amɛlaaje lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni matswa amɛ ekoŋŋ mama shi taakɛ amɛyɔɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Eshai fɛɛ ni amɛfee amɛshi mi hewɔ lɛ mibatsuu amɛhe; ni eshai fɛɛ ni amɛfee amɛshi mi kɛtsɔ̃ tɔ̃mɔ ni amɛtɔ̃ minɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ shi ni amɛte amɛwo mi lɛ, mikɛ fɛɛ baafa amɛ.
Ni maŋ nɛɛ gbɛi baahã mimli afili mi, ni ebaatsɔ̃ miyijiemɔ kɛ mihiɛ nyam yɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni aaanu ejuji fɛɛ ni mifee amɛ lɛ he lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛtsui baafã, ni amɛhe baakpokpo yɛ ejuji fɛɛ ni mifeɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ shweremɔ ni mihãa amɛshwereɔ lɛ hewɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ nɛɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ yɛ he akɛ ehiɛ ekpãtã, ni gbɔmɔ loo kooloo bɛ biɛ dɔŋŋ, kɛ Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ni etsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni gbɔmɛi loo kooloi bɛ amɛmli lɛ, abaanu nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ kɛ ayɛmforowu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee ekoŋŋ yɛ jɛi.
Abaanu mɛi ni kɛ amɛshidaa afɔlei baa Yehowa we lɛ he ni amɛmiila akɛ, ‘Nyɛdaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, shi ejaakɛ Yehowa hi, ni esuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ!’ Ejaakɛ mibahã shikpɔŋ lɛ ashwere tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsuutsu lɛ.
Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.” Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Biɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ maji ni hiɛ ekpãtã ni gbɔmɔ loo kooloo tete bɛ nɔ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ shihilɛhei ahã tookwɛlɔi, ni amɛtoi hu baana shibuumɔhei yɛ jɛi.
Ni tookwɛlɔi ni yɔɔ gɔji anɔ maji lɛ kɛ ŋa nɔ maji lɛ kɛ Yuda wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ kɛ Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ akrowai ni bɔle Yerusalɛm he lɛ kɛ Yuda maji lɛ hu amli lɛ, baakane amɛtoi ayifalɛ ekoŋŋ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Naa, be miiba, ni mahã shi ni miwo Israelbii kɛ Yudabii lɛ hu aba mli.
Nakai be lɛ mibahã David shwie jalɔ ko abaye esɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ; ebaakojo yɛ jalɛ naa, ni ebaaye jalɛ sane yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ aaahere Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm yiwala, ni amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe; ni gbɛi ni akɛaatsɛ Yerusalɛm ji ‘Yehowa ji wɔjalɛ.’ Ejaakɛ bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nuu ni baata Israel maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ ebɔŋ David kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Asaŋ Levinyo ni aaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ mihiɛ koni eshã shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ ebɔŋ Levibii ni ji osɔfoi lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbaanyɛ nyɛku kpãŋmɔ ni mi, mikɛ shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ ekpãŋ akɛ amɛba ni amɛya yɛ be ni mito mihã amɛ naa mli lɛ, no lɛ aaanyɛ aku kpãŋmɔ ni mi, mikɛ mitsulɔ David ekpãŋ lɛ mli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, enaŋ binuu ko ni aaata esɛi lɛ nɔ eye maŋtsɛ.
Ni nakai nɔŋŋ aaanyɛ aku mi kɛ Levibii, ni ji misɔ̃ɔlɔi osɔfoi lɛ, akpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mli.
Bɔ ni anyɛŋ ŋwɛi ŋulamii afalɛ akane, ni anyɛŋ ŋshɔnaa shia falɛ akane lɛ, nakai mahã mitsulɔ David shwiei kɛ Levibii ni ji misɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu ayi afa.” Yehowa kɛ Yeremia, wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Oyɔseko nɔ ni mɛi nɛɛ wieɔ akɛ mi Yehowa, mikwa Israel kɛ Yuda, ni ji wekui enyɔ ni mihala lɛ lo?
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ efee shikpɔŋ, ni amɛjeee shikwɛ̃ɛ maŋ ko yɛ amɛhiɛ?
-Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: Kɛji mihãko mishwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ he kpãŋmɔ lɛ ama shi, ni mitoko ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ he gbɛjianɔ no dani makwa Yakob shwiei lɛ kɛ mitsulɔ David hu shwiei lɛ, ni miŋɔŋ David shwiei lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko koni eye Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ anɔ.
Shi agbɛnɛ mahã amɛshwiei lɛ anine ashɛ nibii ni amɛŋmɛɛ lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ, ni mimusuŋ baatsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe.”
Wiemɔ ni akɛbahã Maŋtsɛ Zedekia Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie be mli ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ tabilɔi krokomɛi ni jɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ enɔyeli shishi kɛ mɛi krokomɛi fɛɛ eba, ni amɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ ehe maji lɛ fɛɛ miiwu ta lɛ.
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Yaa koni okɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia ayawie, ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, miijɔɔ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ miihã Babilon maŋtsɛ, ni ebaama maŋ lɛ naa la ni eshã.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ojeŋ edɛŋ; shi mɔ kɛ̃ aaamɔ bo, ni akɛ bo baaya ayawo edɛŋ.
Okɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ baakpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, ni okɛ lɛ baawie hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, bo Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ bo tuuŋtu ohe toi.
Ogboŋ yɛ klante naa.
Obaagbo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ni bɔ ni maŋbii shãshãa ohɛ amɛhã otsɛmɛi ni ji maŋtsɛmɛi ni ebaye nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋbii baashãshãa ohɛ amɛhã bo kɛfee oyara; ni amɛaawo yara amɛfo bo akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, kpoo oŋ!’ Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia hã wiemɔ lɛ shɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia dɛŋ yɛ Yerusalɛm, be ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tabilɔi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda maji ni eshwɛ, ni ji Lakish kɛ Azeka, wuɔ ta lɛ; ejaakɛ nomɛi pɛ ji Yuda maji ni eshwɛ ni atswa gbogbo awo amɛhe.
Ayeee anɔkwa yɛ nyɔji agbɛfaŋ Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie be ni Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpãŋ akɛ, lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ebaawo heyeli he akpɔ ehã maŋbii lɛ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enyɔŋ ni ji Hebrinuu loo Hebriyoo aye ehe tswaa koni mɔ ko akaye enyɛmi Hebrinyo nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ.
Lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ maŋbii fɛɛ ni kpãŋ akɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enyɔŋnuu kɛ enyɔŋyoo aye amɛhe koni mɔ ko mɔ ko akaye enyɛmi Hebrinyo nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ ye kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛŋmɛɛ nyɔji lɛ ahe.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ amɛku sɛɛ ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛnyɔji ni kulɛ amɛhã amɛye amɛhe lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbaye amɛ nyɔŋ ekoŋŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mikɛ nyɛblematsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ be mli ni miyakpɔ̃ amɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni aye amɛ nyɔŋ yɛ lɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enyɛmi Hebrinyo ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔŋ ahã lɛ, ni esɔmɔ lɛ afii ekpaa lɛ aŋɔ ehe eye tswaa yɛ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ; aŋmɛɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ he, ni eŋɔ ehe eye.
Shi nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ booo mi toi, ni amɛyeee miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ.’ “Nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛje nyɛhe sɛɛ, ni nyɛfee nɔ ni sa mihiɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛye nyɛfua akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baahã enyɛmi Israelnyo aŋɔ ehe eye tswaa; ni nyɛkpãŋ yɛ enɛ he yɛ mihiɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he ni ajaa mi yɛ lɛ.
Shi nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ nyɛtsake nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, ni nyɛwo migbɛi lɛ he muji.
Ejaakɛ nyɛyaŋɔ nyɛwehii kɛ nyɛweyei ni nyɛhã amɛye amɛhe yɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ ni nyɛbaye amɛ nyɔŋ ekoŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛgbo minɔ toi, ejaakɛ nyɛhãko nyɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii kɛ nyɛnanemɛi aŋɔ amɛhe amɛye tswaa.
Shi naa, mi lɛ mahã ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela kɛ nyɛ aye.
Jeŋ shikpɔji fɛɛ ahe aaajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni mafee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Ni hii lɛ ni yeee mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibafee amɛ tamɔ afee kpãŋmɔ tsinabi lɛ ni agba emli enyɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ fãfãafãi lɛ ateŋ kɛho lɛ.
Yuda lumɛi lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli nitsulɔi lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ tsinabi lɛ fãfãafãi lɛ ateŋ kɛho lɛ ahe miwieɔ nɛɛ.
Mibaŋɔ amɛ mawo amɛhenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ amɛgbele lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛgbohii baatsɔ̃ niyenii ahã ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi kakawuai.
Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ elumɛi lɛ mibaŋɔ amɛ mawo amɛhenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ amɛgbele lɛ adɛŋ.
Mibajɔɔ amɛnɔ mahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tabilɔi ni ba amɛbatua nyɛ shi amɛku amɛsɛɛ lɛ.
Naa, mibafã, Yehowa kɛɛ, ni mahã amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba ni amɛbaatua maŋ nɛɛ, ni amɛbaaye nɔ, ni amɛbaama maŋ lɛ naa la amɛshã.
Mibahã Yuda maji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli.”
Yeremia kɛ Rekabbii lɛ Be mli ni Yosia bi Yehoiakim yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa Rekab webii lɛ aŋɔɔ koni okɛ amɛ ayawie; ni okɛ amɛ aba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli piai lɛ eko mli koni ohã amɛ wain amɛnu yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, mitee, ni miyaŋɔ Yaazania, ni atsɛɔ etsɛ Yeremia, Habazinia bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Rekab weku lɛ fɛɛ, ni mikɛ amɛ ba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni wɔtee Igdalia bi Gbalɔ Hanan kaselɔi lɛ apia lɛ mli, yɛ lumɛi apia lɛ masɛi, yɛ Shalum, shinaanaabulɔ lɛ, bi Maaseia pia lɛ yiteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ gbɛi ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ wain kɛ kɔɔpoi bamamɔ Rekab weku lɛ hiɛ, ni mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnua wain koo!” Shi amɛto he akɛ, “Wɔnuuu wain ejaakɛ wɔtsɛ Yonadab, ni ji Rekab bi lɛ, wo wɔ kitã akɛ, ‘Nyɛkanua wain gbi ko gbi ko, nyɛ kɛ nyɛshwiei fɛɛ.
Nyɛkamamɔa tsui, ni nyɛkadua nii, ni nyɛkafea wain trom nyɛhãa nyɛhe, shi moŋ nyɛwala bei amli fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛhia bui amli bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhi shi be babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛbato gbɔ yɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Wɔye kitã ni wɔtsɛ Yonadab, Rekab bi lɛ, wo wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ jio, wɔŋamɛi jio, wɔbihii jio, wɔbiyei jio, wɔkanu wain wɔwala be fɛɛ lɛ nɔ; ni asaŋ ekɛɛ akɛ wɔkamamɔ tsui hu wɔhi mli lɛ.
Wɔbɛ wain trom loo ŋmɔji loo abele.
Shi wɔhi bui amli, ni bɔ ni wɔtsɛ Yonadab wo wɔ kitã lɛ wɔbo toi, ni wɔye nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛba ebatua shikpɔŋ lɛ, wɔye wɔfua akɛ wɔɔba Yerusalɛm yɛ gbeyei ni wɔshe Babilon ta lɛ kɛ Siria ta lɛ hu hewɔ.
No ji Yerusalɛm ni wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakɛɛ Yudahii lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ akɛ mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, miibi akɛ, ‘Aso nyɛkpɛlɛŋ tsɔsemɔ koni nyɛbo miwiemɔ lɛ toi?’ Kitã ni Rekab bi Yonadab, wo eshwiei akɛ amɛkanu wain lɛ, amɛye nɔ, ni amɛnuuu wain kɛ ŋmɛnɛ, ejaakɛ amɛye amɛtsɛ kitã lɛ nɔ.
Mitee nɔ mikɛ nyɛ ewie shii abɔ, shi nyɛbooo mi toi.
Mitsu mitsuji, ni ji gbalɔi lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ shii abɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashi ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ sɛɛ koni etsake, ni nyɛkayanyiɛa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi asɛɛ ni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ; ja no dani nyɛaahi shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhãa nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ nɔ.
Shi nyɛbooo mi toi, ni nyɛfeee nɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ.
Rekab bi Yonadab shwiei lɛ eye kitã ni amɛtsɛ lɛ wo amɛ lɛ nɔ; shi nyɛ maŋ nɛɛ nyɛbooo mi toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi Yehowa, Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibahã saji fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mahã aye Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛmbii fɛɛ lɛ aba amɛ amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ miwie mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni amɛbooo mi toi, ni mitsɛ amɛ, ni amɛhereee mi nɔ.’ ” Shi Yeremia kɛɛ Rekabbii lɛ akɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe nɛ; “Akɛni nyɛye kitã ni nyɛtsɛ Yonadab wo nyɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛhiɛ akpɔi ni ewo lɛ amli, ni nyɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni ekɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ, hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ, miikɛɛ akɛ be ko baŋ ni anaŋ Rekab bi Yonadab shwie ni aaasɔmɔ mi.”
Baruk kane wolo kpo lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɔ wolo kpo ko koni oŋmã wiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛ bo ewie yɛ Israel kɛ Yuda kɛ maji krokomɛi fɛɛ ahe, kɛjɛ Yosia yinɔ aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, owo mli.
Aleenɔ, ekolɛ kɛji Yudabii aaanu efɔŋ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mafee amɛ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpa enifɔɔji anii ni efeɔ lɛ, ni no aaahã mikɛ amɛnishaianii kɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia tsɛ Neria bi Baruk kɛba, ni Yeremia wie wiemɔi fɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛ lɛ, Yeremia, ewie lɛ, ni Baruk ŋmã ewo wolo kpo lɛ mli.
Ni Yeremia fã Baruk akɛ, “Mi lɛ atsi mi gbɛ, ni ehiii mi Yehowa we lɛ mli yaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, bo yaa koni oyakane Yehowa wiemɔi ni onu kɛjɛ minaa ni oŋmã owo wolo kpo lɛ mli lɛ, faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ, yɛ ŋmaahilɛ gbi lɛ eko nɔ.
Asaŋ okane faŋŋ otsɔ̃ɔ Yudabii ni jɛɔ amɛmaji krokomɛi amli amɛbaa lɛ hu.
Eko lɛ amɛfaikpamɔ aaashɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpa enifɔɔji anii ni efeɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa mli ni efu kɛ emli ni ewo la lɛ naa wa naakpa.” Baruk, Neria bi lɛ, fee bɔ ni Gbalɔ Yeremia fã lɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Eyakane Yehowa wiemɔi ni yɔɔ wolo kpo lɛ mli lɛ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia bi lɛ, maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enumɔ lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yerusalɛmbii kɛ mɛi ni jɛɔ Yuda maji amli amɛbaa Yerusalɛm lɛ hi ŋmaa yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Baruk kane wiemɔi ni Yeremia wie ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ, yɛ woloŋmalɔ Shafan bi Gemaria pia lɛ mli, yɛ Yehowa we lɛ yiteŋgbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, yɛ Agbo Hee lɛ naa.
Akane Wolo kpo lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ Maŋ Lumɛi lɛ Be ni Mikaia, ni ji Shafan bi Gemaria bi lɛ, nu Yehowa naa wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ wolo ni akane lɛ mli lɛ, eyiŋ etee maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni ebote woloŋmalɔ lɛ pia lɛ mli.
Eyanina woloŋmalɔ lɛ kɛ Delaia, Shemaia bi lɛ, kɛ Elnatan, Akbor bi lɛ, kɛ Gemaria, Shafan bi lɛ, kɛ Zedekia, Hanania bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lumɛi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi.
Mikaia gba amɛ nibii fɛɛ ni enu be ni Baruk kane wolo lɛ faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋ lumɛi lɛ tsu Kushi bi Shelemia bi Netania bi Yehudi kɛtee Baruk ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi lɛ koni ekɔ wolo kpo lɛ ni ekane emli sane etsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ.
Baruk, Neria bi lɛ, kɔ wolo kpo lɛ ehiɛ edɛ̃ kɛtee lumɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛɛ Baruk akɛ, “Ta shi koni okane wolo lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Baruk kane wolo lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Be ni amɛnu wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ, amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ tsuifãa, ni amɛkɛɛ Baruk akɛ, “Ja wɔyakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ wolo nɛɛ mli sane lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi Baruk akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni oŋmã wiemɔi nɛɛ hu?
Kɛɛmɔ wɔ.
Ani Yeremia diɛŋtsɛ naa wiemɔi ni?” Baruk to he akɛ, “Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enaa wiemɔi ni.
Lɛ ewie; ni be mli ni ewieɔ lɛ belɛ mikɛ blɛgi miiŋma miiwo wolo lɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni lumɛi lɛ kɛɛ Baruk akɛ, “Ole sane ko?
Bo kɛ Yeremia fɛɛ, nyɛyaa koni nyɛyatee nyɛhe yɛ he ko; ni nyɛkahãa mɔ ko mɔ ko leɔ he ni nyɛyatee yɛ lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ shã Wolo kpo lɛ Maŋ lumɛi lɛ shi wolo kpo lɛ yɛ woloŋmalɔ Elishama pia lɛ mli, ni amɛtee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ yɛ ekoi lɛ shi, ni amɛyagba lɛ wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ fɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu Yehudi akɛ eyakɔ wolo lɛ yɛ woloŋmalɔ Elishama pia lɛ mli kɛba.
Yehudi kane wolo lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lumɛi ni damɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ he lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ ni; ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ta efɛ̃i be tsu lɛ mli, ni ŋɛsu kɛ emli la ni atsɛ̃ ma ehiɛ.
Kɛji Yehudi kane wolo lɛ baafãi etɛ̃ loo ejwɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ kakla bibioo ko folɔɔ wolo baafãi ni akane lɛ mli, kɛkɛ lɛ eshɛrɛ eshwie ŋɛsu kɛ la lɛ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wolo kpo lɛ fɛɛ shã wɛɛ!
Maŋtsɛ lɛ ni jio, etsuji lɛ fɛɛ ni nu wolo kpo lɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ ni jio, amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko sheee gbeyei aloo egbalaaa ehebo ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ewerɛ eho ehe.
Yɛ mli akɛ Elnatan kɛ Delaia kɛ Gemaria kpa maŋtsɛ lɛ fai akɛ ekashã wolo kpo lɛ nɛ, shi ebooo amɛ toi.
Shi moŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ fã Yerameel, maŋtsɛ binuu lɛ, kɛ Seraia, Azriel bi lɛ, kɛ Shelemia, Abdeel bi lɛ, akɛ amɛyamɔ Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ woloŋmalɔ Baruk kɛba; shi Yehowa kɛ amɛ to.
Yeremia ŋma wolo kroko Agbɛnɛ be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ shã wolo kpo lɛ ni Gbalɔ Yeremia naa wiemɔi ni woloŋmalɔ Baruk ŋmã lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɔ wolo kpo kroko koni oŋmã tsuutsu wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wolo kpo lɛ ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim shã lɛ mli lɛ owo mli.
Ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim lɛ, nɔ ni okɛɛ yɛ ehe nɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Bo lɛ oshã nɛkɛ wolo kpo nɛɛ, ni obi Yeremia akɛ mɛni hewɔ oŋma yɛ wolo kpo lɛ mli akɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ baaba kɛ̃ koni ebafite shikpɔŋ nɛɛ, koni ekpãtã enɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, mi Yehowa, nɔ ni mikɛɔ yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim he ji akɛ eshwie ko eshwie ko taŋ David maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ; ni abaashɛ egbonyo afɔ̃ he ko ni baahã hulu ashã lɛ shwane, ni bɔ baanyɔ enɔ nyɔɔŋ.
Mibagbala lɛ kɛ eshwiei kɛ etsuji lɛ atoi yɛ nishaianii ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ; ni mibahã haomɔi fɛɛ ni mi kɛ amɛ ewie he, shi amɛbuuu lɛ aba amɛ kɛ Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yudabii anɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɔ wolo kpo kroko, ni ekɛhã Neria bi Baruk ni ji ewoloŋmalɔ lɛ.
Yeremia saa ewie wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ tsuutsu wolo kpo ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim shã lɛ mli lɛ, ni Baruk ŋmã fɛɛ ewo wolo hee lɛ mli.
Ni Yeremia kɛ wiemɔi krokomɛi ni tamɔ wiemɔi ni ewie ni Baruk ŋmã lɛ shi nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Zedekia bi Yeremia koni esɔle ehã maŋ lɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar to Zedekia, Yosia bi lɛ, Yuda maŋtsɛ, yɛ Yehoiakin, Yehoiakim bi lɛ, najiaŋ.
Shi Zedekia ni jio, etsuji lɛ ni jio, maŋbii lɛ ni jio, mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu Yehukal, Shelemia bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfo Zefania, Maaseia bi lɛ, Yeremia ŋɔɔ akɛ esɔle ekpa Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ehã maŋ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yeremia yaa baa yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, ejaakɛ anako awo lɛ tsuŋ.
Farao tabilɔi efã kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba.
Be ni Babilonbii ni amɛba amɛmiisa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yi lɛ nu akɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo tabilɔi agbɛ kɛmiiba lɛ, Babilonbii lɛ gbala amɛhe shi kɛje Yerusalɛm.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɔ nɛ.
Yaakɛɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ ni tsu bo miŋɔɔ koni obabi mi nii lɛ akɛ, Naa, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ tabilɔi ni ba koni amɛbaye amɛbua bo lɛ, miiku amɛsɛɛ kɛya Ijipt amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Babilonbii baaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛbatua maŋ nɛɛ.
Amɛbaaye maŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbaama enaa la amɛshã.
Nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Nyɛkashishiua nyɛhe ni nyɛmiikɛɛ akɛ Babilonbii lɛ etee kwraa; ejaakɛ jeee tee amɛtee lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛye Babilonbii ni kɛ nyɛ wuɔ nɛɛ anɔ, ni eshwɛ amɛpilafoi sɔŋŋ ni kamɔ amɛbuui amli kɛkɛ po, pilafoi nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baate shi, ni amɛbaama maŋ lɛ naa la amɛshã.’ ” Awo Yeremia tsuŋ Be ni Babilon tabilɔi lɛ egbala amɛhe shi amɛshi Yerusalɛm amɛtee yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ ta ni fã kɛbaa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yeremia je Yerusalɛm akɛ eeya Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni eyaŋɔ egbɛfaŋnii ko yɛ eweku gboshinii mli.
Be ni eyashɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ naa lɛ, asafoiatsɛ ni kwɛɔ agbo lɛ naa bulɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Iriya ni eji Shelemia binuu kɛ Hanania nabi lɛ, mɔ Gbalɔ Yeremia, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te Babilonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ ojoɔ foi kɛyaa nɛɛ bɛɛ?” Yeremia jie naa akɛ, “Dabida!
Jeee Babilonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ mijoɔ foi kɛya.” Shi Iriya eŋɔɔɔ nɔ ehãaa Yeremia, ni emɔ lɛ kɛba lumɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Lumɛi lɛ gri wo Yeremia, ni amɛhã agwao lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ awo lɛ kpabuŋ yɛ woloŋmalɔ Yonatan shĩa lɛ mli, ejaakɛ akɛ eshĩa lɛ efee tsuŋwoohe.
Awo Yeremia kpabuŋ yɛ shĩa lɛ shishigbɛ, ni eye gbii pii yɛ jɛi.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu ayaŋɔ Yeremia nigii abahã lɛ, ni ebi Yeremia yɛ teemɔ mli yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani Yehowa kɛ bo ewie nɔ ko lo?” Yeremia to he akɛ, “Hɛɛ, ekɛɛ mi nɔ ko.” Asaŋ Yeremia kɛɛ akɛ, “Aaaŋɔ bo awo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia bi Maŋtsɛ Zedekia akɛ, “Mɛɛ tɔ̃mɔ mitɔ̃ bo loo otsuji lɛ loo maŋ nɛɛ mli bii anɔ, hewɔ ni nyɛwo mi tsuŋ nɛɛ?
Nɛgbɛ nyɛgbalɔi lɛ ni gba tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ baŋ ebatuaŋ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ?
Agbɛnɛ, minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ ni ona tsui fioo ohã mi koni omɔ fai ni mikpaa bo nɛɛ mli ohã mi, koni okahã akɛmi ku sɛɛ kɛtee woloŋmalɔ Yonatan we lɛ dɔŋŋ koni mikayagbo yɛ jɛi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Zedekia fã, ni agbɛnɛ awo Yeremia kpabuŋ yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hebulɔi lɛ akpo lɛ nɔ.
Jɛi ehi, ni daa gbi lɛ ahãa lɛ aboloo akwaabɔ kome kɛjɛɔ abolooshãlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni afee aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋ lɛ mli aboloo fɛɛ tã.
Akɛ Yeremia wo nubu folo ko mli Shefatia, Matan bi lɛ, kɛ Gedalia, Pashur bi lɛ, kɛ Yukal, Shelemia bi lɛ, kɛ Pashur, Malkia bi lɛ, nu wiemɔi ni Yeremia wieɔ ewoɔ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ atoiiaŋ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, ebaanyɔ yɛ klante loo hɔmɔ loo gbele hela naa; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashi maŋ lɛ mli kɛya Babilonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ egboŋ; ebaato ewala ahu tamɔ ta mli haanii, ni ehiɛ aaakã.” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Tu kɛ̃ abaatu maŋ nɛɛ awo Babilon maŋtsɛ tabilɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni lumɛi nɛɛ tee ni amɛyakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia akɛ, “Hã agbe nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, ejaakɛ tabilɔi ni eshwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ anijiaŋ miije wui yɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ni ewieɔ ewoɔ amɛtoiiaŋ lɛ ahewɔ.
Nuu nɛɛ taooo maŋbii lɛ ekpakpa, fe efɔŋ moŋ.” Maŋtsɛ Zedekia here amɛnɔ akɛ, “Naa, eyɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ nyɛŋ nyɛsɛɛ eje efee nɔ ko.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmɔ Yeremia, ni amɛkɛ taŋkpee shiu lɛ amɛwo maŋtsɛ binuu Malkia nubu lɛ mli yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ hebulɔi akpo lɛ nɔ.
Nu bɛ bu lɛ mli fe ŋmɔtɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ; ni Yeremia fũ yɛ ŋmɔtɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni Ebed-Melek, Kushnyo lɛ, ni eji piafonyo yɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli lɛ, nu akɛ akɛ Yeremia ewo bu lɛ mli lɛ, (no mli lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ta Benyamin Agbo lɛ naa) eje kpo kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ, ni etee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ Maŋtsɛ, hii nɛɛ efee Gbalɔ Yeremia efɔŋ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ shɛmɔ ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ nubu lɛ mli lɛ.
Ebaagbo kɛ hɔmɔ yɛ jɛi ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ niyenii bɛ maŋ lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Zedekia fã Ebed-Melek, Kushnyo lɛ, akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ hii etɛ̃ ofata ohe kɛjɛ biɛ kɛya koni nyɛyajie Gbalɔ Yeremia yɛ bu lɛ mli dani egbo.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ebed-Melek ŋɔ hii lɛ efata ehe, ni eyiŋ etee mamai kɛ atadei atoohe lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Eyakɔlɔ mamashwɛi kɛ atadei ni etserɛ yɛ jɛi; ni ekɛ taŋkpee shiu nibii nɛɛ ekɛhã Yeremia yɛ bu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Ebed-Melek, Kushnyo lɛ, kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Okɛ mamashwɛi lɛ kɛ atadei tserɛitserɛi lɛ ahɔlɔ oŋaashi kɛ taŋkpei lɛ ateŋ.” Yeremia fee nakai, kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ taŋkpee lɛ sha Yeremia, ni amɛ jie lɛ yɛ bu lɛ mli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yeremia hi maŋtsɛ we lɛ he bulɔi akpo lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Zedekia bi Yeremia dɛŋ ŋaawoo Be ko lɛ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia tsu, ni ayaŋɔ Gbalɔ Yeremia abahã lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ naa agbo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ naa.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Mibabi bo nɔ ko; kaashiu mi sane ko nɔ!” Yeremia kɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia akɛ, “Kɛji migba bo anɔkwale lɛ, ani oyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ ogbeŋ mi?
Ni kɛji miwo bo ŋaa hu lɛ te oboŋ toi.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kã Yeremia kitã, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Yehowa, mɔ dɛŋ ni wɔwala nɛɛ yɔɔ akɛ migbeŋ bo, ni asaŋ miŋmɛŋ ohe mihaŋ hii nɛɛ ni taoɔ bo amɛgbe nɛɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɛɛ Zedekia akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, “Kɛji okɛ ohe hã Babilon maŋtsɛ lumɛi lɛ, oyi aaana wala, ni amaŋ maŋ nɛɛ naa la ashaŋ, ni bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yi aaana wala.
Shi kɛji okɛ ohe hãaa Babilon maŋtsɛ lumɛi lɛ, no lɛ aaaŋɔ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ awo Babilonbii lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbaama naa la amɛshã, ni ojeŋ amɛdɛŋ.” Shi Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Miishe wɔmaŋ Yudabii ni eyafata Babilonbii lɛ ahe lɛ moŋ gbeyei, akɛ eko lɛ Babilonbii lɛ kɛ mi baawo amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛbaashwie mihiɛ shi.” Yeremia to he akɛ, “Akɛ bo haŋ amɛ.
Bo lɛ, ye wiemɔi ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ minɔ ni mikɛ bo ewie lɛ anɔ kɛkɛ, ni ebaahi ehã bo, ni oyi aaana wala.
Shi kɛji okpɛ̃lɛɛɛ akɛ okɛ ohe aaahã henyɛlɔi lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa ejie etsɔ̃ɔ mi yɛ ninaa mli nɛ.
Naa, mina yei fɛɛ ni eshwɛ yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli lɛ ni aakpala amɛ ayahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ; ni amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Onanemɛi ni okɛ ohiɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ elaka bo, ni amɛye onɔ; ni agbɛnɛ ni onaji efu ŋmɔtɔ mli nɛɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã bo.’ ” “Abaakpala oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ obihii lɛ hu fɛɛ ayahã Babilonbii lɛ; ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ojeŋ amɛdɛŋ.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ aaamɔ bo, ni aaama maŋ nɛɛ naa la, ashã.” Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Kaahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miile wɔsanegbaa nɛɛ, ni obaana akɛ owala tɔ̃ŋ.
Kɛji lumɛi lɛ na le akɛ mi kɛ bo egba sane, ni amɛba oŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Kɛɛmɔ wɔ nɔ ni okɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ; bo lɛ kaashiu wɔ sane ko nɔ, ni wɔgbeŋ, bo’ lɛ, okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mibakpa maŋtsɛ fai yɛ heshibaa mli akɛ akɛ mi akaya kpabu ni yɔɔ Yonatan we lɛ mli dɔŋŋ koni mikayagbo yɛ jɛi.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ ba Yeremia ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ sane, ni ekɛɛ amɛ bɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ eta ewo enaa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, lumɛi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ Yeremia daaŋtaa ejaakɛ Yeremia kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ sanegbaa lɛ mli nɔ ko ejeee kpo.
Ni Yeremia hi bulɔi akpo lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni henyɛlɔi ŋɔ Yerusalɛm.
Henyɛlɔi ŋɔ Yerusalɛm Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ ba, ni amɛbasa Yerusalɛm yi; ni Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, agbu Yerusalɛm he gbogbo lɛ awo mli.
Be ni henyɛlɔi lɛ ŋɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ ba, ni amɛbatara shi yɛ Teŋ Koi lɛ shishi.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji: Nergal-Sarezer kɛ Samgar-Nebo kɛ Sarsekim piafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nergal-Sarezer kroko ko hu kɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Be ni Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia kɛ etabilɔi lɛ na Babilon maŋtsɛ tsuji lɛ, amɛka foijee; amɛshi maŋ lɛ mli nyɔɔŋ; amɛtsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ ni yɔɔ maŋ gbogboi enyɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyi Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ.
Shi Babilon tabilɔi lɛ tiu amɛ, ni amɛyanina Zedekia yɛ Yeriko ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ.
Amɛkɛ lɛ ba Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋɔɔ yɛ Ribla, yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nebukadnezar bu Zedekia fɔ yɛ jɛi.
Egbe Zedekia bihii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Zedekia hiɛ.
Asaŋ egbe Yuda lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Nebukadnezar hã afamɔ Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni ehã awo lɛ gboklɛ koni akɛ lɛ aya Babilon.
Babilonbii lɛ ma maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ ashĩai lɛ anaa la, ni amɛshã; ni amɛkumɔ Yerusalɛm he gbogboi lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Naagbee mli lɛ Nebuzaradan, Babilon tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ, ŋɔ maŋbii ni ashi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ maŋbii ni kɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ nom kɛtee Babilon.
Shi Nebuzaradan, tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ, shi maŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi ni bɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ehã amɛ wain tromi kɛ shikpɔji nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni amɛhu nɔ.
Aŋmɛɛ Yeremia he Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, fã Nebuzaradan, tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Yeremia hewɔ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ Yeremia, ni okwɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Okafee lɛ efɔŋ ko, shi moŋ bɔ ni eeekɛɛ bo lɛ, ofee nakai ohã lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan, tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nebushazban, piafoiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nergal Sarezer kɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tsuji nukpai lɛ fɛɛ tsu ni ayaŋɔ Yeremia kɛjɛ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ nɔ kɛba.
Amɛkɛ lɛ bahã Shafan bi Ahikam bi Gedalia koni ekɛ lɛ aya ewe lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yeremia hi maŋbii lɛ ateŋ.
Ebedmelek na hiɛnɔkãmɔ Be ni atsi Yeremia naa yɛ Bulɔi Akpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa koni oyakɛɛ Ebed-Melek, Kushnyo lɛ, akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibahã nɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ he lɛ aba mli, ebaana nɔ fɔŋ, shi jeee nɔ kpakpa; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ baaba mli, ni okɛ ohiŋmɛi baana.
Shi, mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mibahere oyiwala yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ, ni aŋɔŋ bo awoŋ hii ni osheɔ amɛ gbeyei lɛ adɛŋ; shi oyi baana wala, ni onyɔŋ yɛ ta lɛ naa, shi owala baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ta mli haanii ahã bo, ejaakɛ ohiɛ kã minɔ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ”
Yeremia kɛ Gedalia hi shi Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie be ni Nebuzaradan tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ ehe yɛ Rama lɛ sɛɛ.
Nebuzaradan eŋɔ Yeremia, ni ewo lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ efata Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda nomi fɛɛ ni abaŋɔ kɛyaa Babilon lɛ ahe.
Tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Yeremia kɛtee afã ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ewie nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ ni baaba biɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ he eto momo, ni Yehowa ehã ena eba mli hu, ni efee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ eba nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛfee esha nyɛshi Yehowa, ni nyɛbooo lɛ toi.
Naa, agbɛnɛ miifɛne kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ni awo oniji lɛ ŋmɛnɛ.
Kɛji okwɛ, ni esa ohiɛ akɛ okɛ mi aaatee Babilon lɛ, ba; ni makwɛ bo jogbaŋŋ; shi kɛji okwɛ, ni esaaa ohiɛ akɛ okɛ mi aaatee Babilon lɛ, no lɛ hii shi.
Kwɛ, shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã ohiɛ nɛɛ; he fɛɛ he ni okwɛ ni ehi, asaŋ ni esa ohiɛ lɛ, yaahi jɛi.” Yeremia nako ehã hetoo kɛkɛ ni Nebuzaradan kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji obaahi shi lɛ, no lɛ kuu osɛɛ mɔ koni oya Ahikam bi kɛ Shafan bi Gedalia, mɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ ewo lɛ Yuda maji lɛ anɔ amralo lɛ ŋɔɔ, koni okɛ lɛ ayahi shi yɛ maŋbii lɛ ateŋ, aloo yaahi he fɛɛ he ni sa ohiɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, tabilɔiatsɛ lɛ hã Yeremia gbɛ nɔ niyenii kɛ nikeenii, ni ewo lɛ gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia tee Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ, ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa, ni ekɛ lɛ hi shi yɛ maŋbii ni eshwɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Yuda Amralo Gedalia Be ni Yuda tabilɔi ni yaje kpokpai lɛ anɔ lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtabilɔi lɛ nu akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ, Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amralo, ni eŋɔ hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ohiafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni anaaa aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛya Babilon lɛ ewo eshishi lɛ, amɛtee Gedalia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa.
Asafoiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ ji Ishmael, Natania bi lɛ, kɛ Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ Seraia, Tanhumet bi lɛ, kɛ Netofatnyo Efai bihii lɛ kɛ Yezania, Maakanyo lɛ.
Amɛ kɛ amɛshishi tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ tee.
Gedalia, Shafan bi Ahikam bi lɛ, kã amɛ kɛ amɛwebii lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei akɛ nyɛaasɔ̃mɔ Babilonbii lɛ.
Nyɛhia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni aaahi ahã nyɛ.
Mi lɛ mibahi Mizpa, koni madamɔ nyɛnaa kɛji Babilonbii lɛ ba wɔŋɔɔ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia maji ni nyɛŋɔŋɔɔ lɛ amli, ni nyɛbuaa wain kɛ aduawai kɛ mu naa nyɛwoa nyɛnibii amli nyɛtoa.” Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Amonbii lɛ ateŋ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi anɔ lɛ nu akɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ eshwɛ mɛi kɛ̃ ehã Yuda, asaŋ akɛ ewo Ahikam bi kɛ Shafan nabi Gedalia akɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ anɔ amralo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ hei fɛɛ ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee lɛ, ni amɛba Gedalia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Amɛbua wain kɛ aduawai babaoo diɛŋtsɛ naa amɛto.
Agbe Gedalia Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ Yuda asafoiatsɛmɛi ni yaje kpokpai lɛ anɔ lɛ fɛɛ ba Gedalia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani ole akɛ Baalis, Amonbii amaŋtsɛ lɛ, etsu Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, koni ebagbe bo lo?” Shi Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ heee amɛ eyeee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛɛ Gedalia yɛ teemɔ mli yɛ Mizpa akɛ, “Ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ koni mayagbe Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ nigii.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ egbe bo koni Yudafoi fɛɛ ni ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ oŋɔɔ nɛɛ agbɛ ashwã, koni mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã lo?” Shi Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ, kɛɛ Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ akɛ, “Kaafee nakai nɔ ko; ejaakɛ nɔ ni owieɔ yɛ Ishmael he nɛɛ ebɛ mli.”
Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Elishama bi Netania bi Ishmael ni ejɛ maŋtsɛyeli weku mli, asaŋ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ he onukpai lɛ eko ji lɛ lɛ, ŋɔ hii nyɔŋma komɛi efata ehe kɛba Ahikam bi Gedalia ŋɔɔ yɛ Mizpa.
Be ni amɛtara shi amɛyeɔ nii yɛ Mizpa lɛ, Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, kɛ hii nyɔŋma ni fata ehe lɛ te shi, ni amɛbamɔ Gedalia, Ahikam bi kɛ Shafan nabi lɛ, ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Gedalia ji mɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ewo lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɔ.
Ishmael gbe Yudafoi fɛɛ hu ni kɛ Gedalia yɔɔ Mizpa lɛ kɛ Babilon tabilɔi fɛɛ hu ni yaje jɛi.
Gbi ni agbe Gedalia lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ be mli ni mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa nuko he lɛ, hii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ komɛi jɛ Shekem kɛ Shilo kɛ Samaria ba.
Amɛshɛshɛɛ amɛtsɛŋ, ni amɛgbalagbalaa amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe, ni amɛbãmɔbãmɔɔ amɛhe hu.
Amɛhiɛ ŋmaa kɛ krɔbɔo amɛkɛyaashã afɔle yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, jɛ Mizpa etee eyakpee amɛ.
Be ni eyaa lɛ fɛɛ lɛ belɛ eefo.
Be ni ekɛ amɛ kpe lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfainɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛbaŋaa Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ.” Be ni amɛshɛ maŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, kɛ hii lɛ ni fata ehe lɛ gbe amɛ, ni amɛshɛrɛ amɛgbohii lɛ amɛshwie nubu ko mli.
Shi hii gbɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi nyɔŋma komɛi kɛɛ Ishmael akɛ, “Ofainɛ, kaagbe wɔ!
Wɔyɛ ŋmaa kɛ akoko kɛ mu kɛ wo babaoo ni wɔkɛto yɛ wɔŋmɔjiashi.” No hewɔ lɛ, Ishmael kɛ amɛhe ke amɛ, ni egbeee amɛ kɛ amɛnanemɛi lɛ.
Nubu lɛ ni Ishmael shɛrɛ hii lɛ ni egbe lɛ agbohii lɛ eshwie mli lɛ, no ji nubu agbo ko ni Maŋtsɛ Asa je koni ekɛfã ehe be mli ni Maŋtsɛ Baasha, Israel maŋtsɛ, baa ebatua lɛ lɛ.
Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, loo gbohii lɛ ewo mli obɔ̃ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Ishmael ŋɔ maŋtsɛ biyei lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tatsɛ Nebuzaradan eŋɔ ewo Gedalia nɔkwɛmɔ shishi yɛ Mizpa kɛ maŋbii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ yɛ Mizpa lɛ nom, ni ekɛ amɛ yi mli, ni efo mli kɛtee Amonbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tatsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ nu nibii gbohii fɛɛ ni Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, efee lɛ he lɛ, amɛbua tabilɔi fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ naa, kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee koni amɛ kɛ Ishmael ayawu.
Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ nubu wulu lɛ ni yɔɔ Gebeon lɛ he.
Be ni mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ Ishmael nyiɛ lɛ na Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ ni fata ehe lɛ amɛnya.
Kɛkɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni Ishmael eyaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ Mizpa lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi Ishmael kɛ esɛɛ hii kpaanyɔ komɛi je Yohanan dɛŋ, ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Amonbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi anɔ tatsɛmɛi fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ ŋɔ tabilɔi kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ piafoi lɛ ni ji maŋbii ni shwɛ ni Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ yakpala amɛ, akɛ nomii kɛjɛ Mizpa, be ni egbe Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ, sɛɛ lɛ.
Aŋɔ tabilɔi kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ piafoi lɛ, mɛi ni eyakpɔ̃ lɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyato shi yɛ Kinham Gbɔiatoohe ni bɛŋkɛ Betlehem lɛ koni amɛtsa amɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ kɛfee sɛɛ kɛya Ijipt; ejaakɛ gbee ni Ishmael, Netania bi lɛ, gbe Gedalia, Ahikam bi lɛ, mɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ eto akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amralo lɛ ehã amɛmiishe gbeyei yɛ Babilonbii lɛ ahewɔ.
Maŋbii lɛ bi Yeremia akɛ esɔle ehã amɛ Kɛkɛ ni tabilɔi lɛ atatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Yohanan Karea bi lɛ, kɛ Azaria, Hoshaia bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ, tsi bɛŋkɛ Yeremia gbalɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, ni obo wɔfaikpamɔ nɛɛ toi.
Kpa Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai ohã wɔ kɛ maŋbii ni eshwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ kulɛ wɔyi babaoo, shi wɔyi fioo nɛɛ pɛ eshwɛ bɔ ni onaa wɔ nɛɛ, koni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ gbɛ ni wɔtsɔ̃ kɛ nɔ ni sa akɛ wɔfee hu.” Yeremia, gbalɔ lɛ, hã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Minu!
Naa, mibakpa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛbi lɛ; ni hetoo ni Yehowa aaahã nyɛ lɛ, mibagba nyɛ; mishiuŋ nyɛ sane ko nɔ.” Amɛ hu amɛkɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Yehowa afee odasefonyo anɔkwafo ashi wɔ kɛji wɔyeee wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛaatsu bo okɛbahã wɔ lɛ nɔ.
Wiemɔ kpakpa ni jio, wiemɔ fɔŋ ni jio, wɔbaabo nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ŋɔɔ ni wɔtsuɔ bo lɛ, baakɛɛ toi, bɔ ni afee ni ahi ahã wɔ kɛji wɔbo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, gbee toi.” Hetoo ni Yehowa hã Yeremia Gbii nyɔŋma sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie.
Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia tsɛ Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi lɛ atatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe kɛbana lɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ, kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ŋɔɔ ni nyɛtsu mi koni mikɛ nyɛfaikpamɔ ayafɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛbaahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ mibahã nyɛhe shi, ni mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ; mibatɛo nyɛ tamɔ atɛoɔ tso, ni mifamɔŋ nyɛ mishwieŋ; efɔŋ ni mifee nyɛ lɛ edɔ mi.
Nyɛkashea Babilon maŋtsɛ, mɔ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ, gbeyei dɔŋŋ.
Nyɛkashea lɛ gbeyei, mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ nyɛ; ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ yɛ koni mahere nyɛyiwala, ni makpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ edɛŋ.
Mana nyɛ mɔbɔ, ni mahã emusuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni ebaahã nyɛhi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ “Shi kɛji nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhiii shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ’, ni nyɛbooo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi, ni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Dabida, wɔɔtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ta ko gbaŋ wɔnaa, ni wɔnuŋ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ, asaŋ daaŋ ŋmaa ebɔŋ wɔ yɛ koni wɔyahi jɛi’ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ Yudabii ni eshwɛ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nyɛ toi, bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nyɛ nɛ, ‘Kɛji nyɛtswa nyɛfai shi akɛ nyɛmiiya Ijipt nyɛyahi jɛi lɛ, no lɛ ta ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ aaaba abanina nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Musuŋ hɔmɔ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ aaanyiɛ nyɛsɛɛ tuuŋtu kɛya Ijipt tɔ̃ɔ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ nyɛaayagboi yɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni aaatswa amɛfai shi, ni amɛaaya Ijipt amɛyahi jɛi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ ta loo hɔmɔ loo gbele hela nɔ amɛgboi; ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko eshwɛŋ ni ehe baaje sane fɔŋ ni mikɛaaye amɛ lɛ mli.’ ” “Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mimli fu Yerusalɛmbii, ni mimli wo amɛ la lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mimli baafu nyɛ kɛji nyɛtee Ijipt.
Akɛ nyɛ baakã kitã, ni akɛ nyɛ baalomɔ; nyɛhe baafee mɛi naakpɛɛ, ni abaabɔ nyɛ ahora; ni nyɛnaŋ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.’ ” Gbalɔ Yeremia tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa ekɛɛ nyɛ, Yudabii ni eshwɛ, akɛ, ‘Nyɛkayaa Ijipt.’ Nyɛnaa nyɛlea krɛdɛɛ akɛ miibɔ nyɛ kɔkɔ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛwala ta abasa, ejaakɛ nyɛtsu mi, Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kpa Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai ohã wɔ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaakɛɛ wɔ lɛ wɔbaaye nɔ.’ Ni migba nyɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ; shi nyɛyeee nɔ ni Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛtsu mi koni mibakɛɛ nyɛ lɛ eko eko nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea krɛdɛɛ akɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela baakpãtã nyɛhiɛ yɛ he ni nyɛshweɔ akɛ nyɛaatee nyɛyahi lɛ.”
Akɛ Yeremia tee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Be ni Yeremia kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ewie wiemɔi ni Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛtsu lɛ amɛŋɔɔ lɛ egbe naa lɛ, Azaria, Hoshaia bi lɛ, kɛ Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ hii hewolɔi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Oomale!
Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, tsuko bo koni obakɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkayaa Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɛyahi jɛi.’ Baruk, Neria bi lɛ, moŋ ji mɔ ni ehã ote shi owo wɔ nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni eŋɔ wɔ ewo Babilonbii lɛ adɛŋ koni amɛgbe wɔ aloo amɛŋɔ wɔ nom kɛya Babilon.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tabilɔi lɛ anɔ tatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ yeee Yehowa wiemɔ akɛ amɛhi shi yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi Yohanan, Karea bi lɛ, kɛ tai lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ Yudabii ni shwɛ lɛ, mɛi ni ku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ kɛba ni amɛbahi Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee Ijipt.
Mɛi nɛɛ ji hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ maŋtsɛ biyei kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni Nebuzaradan tu ewo Gedalia, Shafan bi Ahikam bi lɛ, nɔkwɛmɔ shishi lɛ.
Amɛkɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ Baruk, Neria bi lɛ, hu fata gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe, ni amɛŋɔ amɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbooo Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ toi.
Amɛtee, aahu kɛyashɛ Tahapanes maŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Tahapanes, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Holemɔ tɛi wuji koni okɛyahɔlɔ su ni akɛtsara ntayai ni akɛka Farao shinaa lɛ shi lɛ mli yɛ Tahapanes, yɛ Yuda hii lɛ ahiɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Yuda hii lɛ akɛ, mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ mibaŋɔ mitsulɔ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛba, mikɛ emaŋtsɛyeli sɛi lɛ baama nɛkɛ tɛi ni mikɛhɔlɔ shi nɛɛ anɔ, ni ebaashi ekatamanso lɛ ema amɛnɔ.
Eeeba ekɛ Ijipt abawu, ni ebaaye nɔ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni amɛshɛɛ mli ji akɛ hela ni baagbe amɛ lɛ, hela baagbe amɛ; mɛi ni amɛshɛɛ mli ji akɛ abaaŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ, abaaŋɔ amɛ nom; ni mɛi ni amɛshɛɛ mli ji akɛ amɛbaanyɔ yɛ ta mli lɛ, amɛbaanyɔ yɛ ta lɛ mli.
Mibamamɔ Ijiptbii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ awei lɛ anaa la mashã, ni abaaŋɔ amɛ nom.
Mibabɛɛ muji ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tamɔ tookwɛlɔ gbeɔ etade mli ŋmoŋ.
Ni Nebukadnezar baashi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eku esɛɛ eya yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Eeekumɔ shiui ni akɛ tɛi nsuji wuji mamɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ awei lɛ hu.”
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Israelbii lɛ wie yɛ Ijipt Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt yɛ Migdol kɛ Tahapanes kɛ Memfis kɛ Ijipt wuoyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ahe.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ Yeremia akɛ, “Bɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛna sane fɔŋ ni mihã eye Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda maji lɛ fɛɛ?
Naa, ŋmɛnɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiii amɛmli, yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee amɛkɛwo mimli la lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛtee, ni amɛyashãshãa tsofakɛŋma, ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɔŋmɔi ni amɛ kɛ nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ leee.
Kɛ̃lɛ mitee nɔ mitsu mitsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, ‘Ao, nyɛkafea nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ ni mihiɔ lɛ.
Shi amɛyabooo mi toi, ni amɛyabuuu miwiemɔ lɛ koni amɛkpa amɛnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ, ni amɛkashã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mifɔse mimlila lɛ kɛ mimlifu lɛ mishwie amɛnɔ, ni ehere tamɔ la, ni eshã Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ tete; kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃i bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ nɔ fɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ nyɛkɛshiɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe koni nyɛkɛplenee hii kɛ yei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ fufɔbii fɛɛ yɛ Yudabii ateŋ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛmaŋbii lɛ eko kwraa akashwɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ.
Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ nyɛninenaa nitsumɔi woɔ mimli la?
Nyɛshãa tsofakɛŋma nyɛhãa nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ nɔ he ni nyɛba nyɛbato gbɔ yɛ lɛ ni nyɛhiɛ akpãtã bɔ ni afee ni jeŋ majimaji lɛ abɔ nyɛ ahora, ni atsɛ nyɛ gbɛi akɛlomɔ lo?
