Ani nyɛhiɛ ekpa nibii fɔ̃ji ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛŋamɛi lɛ feefee yɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ amli lɛ anɔ lo?
Ni kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbako nyɛhe shi, ni nyɛsheko gbeyei, ni asaŋ nyɛbako nyɛjeŋ yɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi ni miwo nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anaa.
“No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, Naa, mibajie mihiɛ maka nyɛ, ni mibaplenee Yuda muu fɛɛ.
Ni Yudabii ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni etswa fai shi akɛ amɛaatee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyahi jɛi lɛ, mahã, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ta kɛ hɔmɔ baahã amɛplenee; kɛjɛ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ lɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ baakpãtã amɛhiɛ; ni amɛsane lɛ baatsɔ̃ musu kɛ tsuifãa sane ni akɛbaalomɔ, ni akɛbaabɔ amɛ ahora.
Mibagbala mɛi ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ atoi tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela gbala Yerusalɛmbii lɛ atoi lɛ, bɔ ni baahã Yudabii ni shwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eba amɛbahi Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko he ejeŋ mli; eyi naŋ wala; ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni amɛshweɔ akɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛya koni amɛyahi jɛi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛkuŋ amɛsɛɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ akɛ ja mɛi komekomei kɛkɛ ni aaana foijee hegbɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni hii fɛɛ ni le akɛ amɛŋamɛi eshã tsofakɛŋma amɛhã nyɔŋmɔi krokomɛi pɛŋ lɛ, kɛ yei fɛɛ ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛ Israelbii amaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Patros maŋ lɛ mli, yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, asafo babaoo diɛŋtsɛ, to he amɛhã Yeremia akɛ, “Wiemɔ ni okɛ wɔ ewie yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli nɛɛ lɛ, wɔboŋ toi.
Shi moŋ nɔ ni wɔwo he shi akɛ wɔbaafee lɛ, no nɔŋŋ wɔbaafee.
Wɔbaashã tsofakɛŋma wɔkɛhã jemawɔŋ yoo ŋwɛi maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni wɔbaafɔse dãa wɔshwie shi wɔhã lɛ tamɔ wɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔwulɔmɛi lɛ fee yɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ amli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nakai be mli lɛ wɔyɛ niyenii, ni wɔshwere, ni wɔnaaa efɔŋ ko yɛ mli.
Shi kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni wɔfɔ̃ɔ tsofakɛŋma shãa, asaŋ ni wɔfɔ̃ɔ dãa fɔsemɔ kɛ shishwiemɔ kɛ ŋwɛi maŋnyɛ lɛ hãmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ eŋmɛɛ wɔ, ni ta kɛ hɔmɔ ekpãtã wɔhiɛ.” Yei lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛ keekii ni abɔlɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ŋwɛi maŋnyɛ lɛ su yɔɔ shã afɔle, ni wɔshã tsofakɛŋma wɔkɛhã lɛ, ni wɔfɔse dãa wɔshwie shi wɔkɛhã lɛ lɛ, ani wɔwumɛi lɛ leee mli eko lo?” Kɛkɛ ni Yeremia kɛɛ hii kɛ yei ni ji maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni hã lɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hetoo lɛ akɛ, “Tsofakɛŋma ni nyɛ kɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ nyɛlumɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ shãshãa yɛ Yuda maji lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm blohui lɛ amli lɛ, ani Yehowa kaiii?
Ani ebaaa ejwɛŋmɔ mli lo?
No hã be ni Yehowa nyɛɛɛ nifɔɔji kɛ musubɔɔ nibii ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, ehã nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, shikpɔŋ ni hiɛ ekpãtã, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ jɛi, ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛlomɔɔ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ amanehulu nɛɛ eba nyɛnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛshãshãa tsofakɛŋma, ni nyɛfee esha nyɛshi Yehowa; ni nyɛbooo Yehowa toi lɛ, nyɛbaaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ emlai kɛ ekpɔi kɛ ehe odasei ni aye lɛ anaa.” Yeremia tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ kɛ yei lɛ fɛɛ hu akɛ, “Nyɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛŋamɛi lɛ, eje nyɛnaa nyɛkɛɛ, ni nyɛfee hu.
Nyɛkɛɛ akɛ ‘Wɔwowoo shi akɛ wɔbaashã tsofakɛŋma wɔkɛhã ŋwɛi maŋnyɛ lɛ, ni wɔbaafɔse dãa wɔshwie shi wɔkɛhã lɛ, ni ja wɔye nɔ.’ Belɛ nyɛyea nyɛshiwoi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛfea bɔ ni nyɛwowoo shi lɛ!
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Yudabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛboa nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ toi, naa, mikã migbɛi wulu lɛ akɛ Yudanyo ko Yudanyo ko naŋ naabu ekɛtsɛ migbɛi kɔkɔɔkɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɔ ekɛkã kitã akɛ, ‘Mina Yehowa’.
Naa, miishi amɛhe kpe koni sane fɔŋ aye amɛ; shi jeee sane kpakpa.
Yudabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ta kɛ hɔmɔ baaplenee amɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaatã.
Mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ ji mɛi ni aaaje ta gbele mli, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mli Yudabii ni tee yato gbɔ yɛ Ijipt lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ aaana ale kɛji mi miwiemɔ lɛ jio, amɛ amɛnɔ lɛ jio ji nɔ ni ena eba mli shiishi nɛɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ akɛ mibagbala nyɛtoi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ efɔŋ ni mikɛɛ akɛ ebaaba nyɛnɔ lɛ, ebaana eba nyɛnɔ kɛ̃.
No ji akɛ mibaŋɔ Maŋtsɛ Hofra, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, mawo ehenyɛlɔi ni taoɔ lɛ agbe lɛ adɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miŋɔ Zedekia, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, miwo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ni ji ehenyɛlɔ ni taoɔ lɛ egbe lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ wo Baruk shi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim, Yosia bi lɛ, yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ Baruk, Neria bi lɛ, wie, ni Baruk ŋma Yeremia naa wiemɔi lɛ ewo wolo mli akɛ, “Baruk, nɔ ni Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ bo nɛ.
Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kpoo hã mi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ ŋkɔmɔ ebashi minɔnaa lɛ nɔ ehã mi!
Etɔ mi kɛ kɔ̃ɔmɔ, ni minaaa hejɔlɛ.’ ” Bɔ ni okɛɛ Baruk nɛ.
Nɔ ni, Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, nii ni mima mima shi lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ miikumɔ mashwie shi, ni nii ni mi nɔŋŋ mitɛo lɛ, miifamɔ mashwie.
Nakai ji bɔ ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ nɛɛ.
Ani bo lɛ nibii wuji otaoɔ ohã ohe nɛɛ?
Kaadi nomɛi asɛɛ, ejaakɛ mibahã sane fɔŋ aye gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ.
Shi bo lɛ mibaŋɔ owala make bo tamɔ ta mli juromɔ nii yɛ he fɛɛ he ni oootee.
Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.”
Aye Ijipt nɔ kunim yɛ Karkemish Yehowa kɛ gbalɔ Yeremia wie yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji lɛ ahe.
Nɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ Ijipt he nɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Ijipt Maŋtsɛ Neko tabilɔi ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ye amɛnɔ kunim, yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa yɛ Karkemish, yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛsaa tsɛŋi bibii kɛ tsɛŋi wuji; ni nyɛfãa ta.
Nyɛ Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi, nyɛwoa okpɔŋɔi anɔ nii; nyɛhoa nyɛtaraa nyɛkpɔŋɔi anɔ, nyɛbumɔa nyɛdade faii; Nyɛtoa kɛdamɔa shi, nyɛjɔa nyɛkplɔi anaa nyɛwoa nyɛdade damai lɛ!
“Shi mɛni po minaa nɛɛ?
Amɛtsui efã, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiya.
Atswia amɛhii kãkãlɔi lɛ nii, ni amɛjo foi kɛ he oyaiyeli; amɛkwɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ, he fɛɛ he efee gbeyei.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Mɔ ni le foijee nyɛŋ foi aje, ni nuu kakabãŋ he ejeŋ mli; amɛtɛrɛtɛrɛi, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ kooyigbɛ, yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa.
Namɔ po ji mɔ ni efã kɛbaa tamɔ Nilo Faa nɛɛ, ni tamɔ faa ni esram nɔ nɛɛ?
Ijipt ni efã kɛbaa tamɔ Nilo Faa nɛɛ, etamɔ faa ni esram nɔ.
Ijipt kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mibasram nɔ, ni maha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mibakpãtã maji kɛ amɛmli bii ahiɛ.’ Okpɔŋɔi, nyɛfãa kɛyaa, Ta shwiilii, nyɛwoa foi kɛyaa!
Nyɛhãa kãkãlɔi lɛ afã; Etiopiabii kɛ Libiabii ni hiɛɔ tsɛŋi, kɛ Ludiabii ni le gãitsɛ̃mɔ, nyɛfãa.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, gbi nɛ, gbi nɛɛ ji oweletɔɔ gbi ni ekɛbaatɔ ehe owele yɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ.
Klante baaye nii ni etɔ, klante baanu lá ni etɔ lɛ dãa, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ miigbe ehenyɛlɔi tamɔ afɔle kooloi yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ he.
Ao!
Ijipt biyoo, yaa Gilead oyahe tsofa kpakpa; yakatswaa po ofeɔ tsofai pii nɛɛ; nɔ ko bɛ ni baatsa bo.
Majimaji lɛ enu ohiɛgbele lɛ he, ni obolɔmɔ lɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ; ejaakɛ kakabãŋ kɛ kakabãŋ ehãlã mli ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛyagbeegbee shi.
Nebukadnezar tua Ijipt Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia wie be ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baa ebatua Ijipt lɛ nɛ, “Nyɛbɔa oshe yɛ Ijipt kɛ Migdol; nyɛshiɛa yɛ Memfis kɛ Tahpanhes, akɛ, ‘Nyɛfea kralo, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ klante baaye nii kɛbɔle nyɛ.’ Mɛɛba ni Apis, tsina wɔŋ lɛ, jo foi ni edamɔɔɔ shi lɛ?
Ejaakɛ Yehowa tsi lɛ etswa shi.
Otabilɔi lɛ tɛrɛtɛrɛi, ni amɛgbeegbee shi, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔkua wɔsɛɛ kɛyaa wɔmaŋbii aŋɔɔ; wɔtee wɔjaku shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, yɛ henyɛlɔ klante lɛ hewɔ.’ “Gbɛi ni okɛtsɛ Farao, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ji ‘Naafuutsɛ ni hã be ho yaka.’ Gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, mi Maŋtsɛ ni migbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ mikɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Tabor Gɔŋ yɔɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ ateŋ, ni Karmel yɔɔ yɛ ŋshɔnaa lɛ, nakai mɔ ni aaabatua bo lɛ hewalɛ aaatamɔ.
Ao, Ijiptbii, nyɛsaa nyɛjatsui nyɛtoa nyɛnomŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ Memfis baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.
Ijipt tamɔ tsina biyoo fɛɛfɛo; shi ofɔi ejɛ kooyigbɛ ebatsɛ̃ lɛ.
Tabilɔi ni eyabɔ amɛ apaa lɛ tamɔ tsinabii ni eshwishwii yɛ amɛteŋ; amɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛhe amɛjo foi amɛtee; amɛdamɔɔɔ shi kwrakwra, ejaakɛ amanehulu gbi ebanina amɛ, amɛtoigbalamɔ gbi ebanina amɛ.
Ijipt daaŋ baagbɛɛ tamɔ onufu ni miijo gbeyei naa foi, ejaakɛ ehenyɛlɔ miiba kɛ hewalɛ, amɛkɛ lema miiba abatua bo tamɔ tsotoolɔi.
Amɛbaagba koo hayii lɛ ni kulɛ emli ehiii tsɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyi fa fe baalabii, anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane.
Abaashwie Ijiptbii ahiɛ shi, ni abaaŋɔ amɛ awo kooyigbɛbii lɛ adɛŋ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mibagbala Amon, ni ji Tebes wɔŋ lɛ kɛ Farao kɛ Ijipt kɛ enyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ enɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ atoi, ni mibaŋɔ Farao kɛ mɛi ni ahiɛ kã enɔ lɛ, ni mibatu amɛ mawo mɛi ni taoɔ amɛ amɛgbe lɛ adɛŋ, mɛi nɛɛ ji Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ etsuji lɛ.
Shi naagbee mli aahu lɛ, Ijipt nine baashɛ nibii fɛɛ ni ŋmɛɛ lɛ lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi aaabahi emli.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa baahere Ewebii lɛ “Miwebii Yakob shwiei, nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Ao Israel!
Kaaye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ, naa, mibahere oyiwala kɛjɛ shɔŋŋ; mibahere oshwiei ayiwala hu kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yakob shwiei aaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛba amɛbaana hejɔlɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, ni mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei dɔŋŋ.
Miwebii Yakob shwiei, nyɛkashea gbeyei, Yehowa kɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ yɛ.
Mibakpãtã maji fɛɛ ni mishwie nyɛ kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ lɛ ahiɛ butuu, shi nyɛ lɛ mikpãtãŋ nyɛhiɛ kɛmɔŋ shi.
Mibagbala nyɛtoi bɔ ni sa kɛkɛ, mikɛ nyɛhe ekeŋ nyɛ efolo tswaa nakai.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Filistia he Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia wie yɛ Filistibii ahe dani Ijipt maŋtsɛ yatua Gaza nɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa!
Fai miiyimɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni amɛbaaje ŋa kɛba; amɛbaaha shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ enɔ nibii fɛɛ kɛ maji kɛ amɛmli bii fɛɛ anɔ.
Gbɔmɛi baabolɔ kɛtsɛ yelikɛbuamɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ baawɔ lele.
Okpɔŋɔi ananeshi gbɛɛmɔ kɛ ta shwiilii agbɛɛmɔ kɛ shwiilii ananeshi jijemɔ hewɔ lɛ tsɛmɛi tete efoŋ amɛhe amɛkwɛŋ he ni amɛbii yɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛnijiaŋ eje wui yɛ Filistibii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ ni baa lɛ hewɔ; gbi ni abaaplenee Tiro kɛ Sidon ni ji Filistibii abualɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa baakpãtã Filistibii ni ji Kreta ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Ŋkɔmɔyeli ehã Gaza yiteŋ ekpa, ni akpãtã Ashkelon hiɛ.
Ao!
Nyɛ jɔɔŋbii ni eshwɛ, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛaabamɔ nyɛhe kakla kɛye awerɛhoo kɛyashi?
‘Yehowa klante!
Mɛɛ beyinɔ ohe aaajɔ?
Kuu osɛɛ oyahɔ ohebo lɛ mli, ni ojɔɔ ohe, ni ofee kpoo!’ Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ehe aaajɔ hu, be mli ni Yehowa efã lɛ lɛ?
Efã lɛ ewo Ashkelon kɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ ahe.”
Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ Nɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛ yɛ Moab he nɛ, “Kpoo hã Nebobii ejaakɛ akpãtã amɛmaŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Aŋɔ Kiriataim nom, ni ehiɛ eshwie shi; akumɔ emɔji gojogojoo lɛ ashwie shi.
Moab hiɛ nyam lɛ sɛɛ efo; ato ehe ŋaa fɔŋ yɛ Heshbon; Akɛɛ akɛ, nyɛhãa wɔbule eshishi koni ekatsɔ̃ maŋ yɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ!
Bo Madmen maŋ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaakpãtã ohiɛ; akɛ ta baanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Naa, aaawɔ lele kɛjɛ Horonaim akɛ, ‘Niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ Nifitemɔ.’ Akpãtã Moab hiɛ, ebii bibii lɛ miibolɔ.
Amɛmiifo kɛmiikwɔ Luhit ŋmeŋme lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiinu niiahiɛkpãtãmɔ blɔmɔ he kɛjɛ Horonaim shikpelekemɔhe lɛ.
Nyɛjoa foi!
Nyɛherea nyɛyiwala!
Nyɛjoa foi tamɔ ŋaŋ teji yɛ shiaŋa nɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ Moabbii, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛhewalɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛjwetrii lɛ anɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu abaaŋɔ nyɛ nom.
Abaaŋɔ nyɛwɔŋ Kemosh lɛ kɛ ewulɔmɛi kɛ ehe lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm hu nom.
Hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ baafite maŋ fɛɛ maŋ.
Maŋ ko maŋ ko he ejeŋ mli, jɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã, ni abaafite ŋa kplanaa lɛ hu.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Nyɛhãa Moab fiji koni ekɛfiliki kɛya, ejaakɛ emaji lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.
(Alomɔ mɔ ni tsuɔ Yehowa nitsumɔ lɛ jabejabe ko kɛkɛ lɛ, ni alomɔ mɔ hu ni kɛ eklante egbeŋ mɔ lɛ!
)” Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã “Moab yɛ hejɔlɛ mli kɛjɛ eblahiiaŋ ni eyɛ shweshweeshwe; atsɔ̃ko lɛ kɛjɛko nɔ kome mli awoko nɔ kroko mli dã; Aŋɔko lɛ nom dã, no hewɔ lɛ, etamɔ dãa ni enaanu gboko dã, ni eŋma hu tsakeko.
“No hewɔ lɛ, gbi ko miiba, Yehowa kɛɛ, be ni mibawo mɛi agbɛ kɛba koni amɛbafɔse Moab amɛshwie tamɔ afɔseɔ dãa ashwieɔ shi ni amɛjwara lɛ dukuduku tamɔ ajwaraa tɔi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Kemosh baawo Maobbii hiɛgbele tamɔ bɔ ni Betel, ni Israelbii ahiɛ kã enɔ lɛ, wo Israel hiɛgbele lɛ.
“Moabbii, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, kãkãlɔi kɛ ta mli kãkãlɔi ji wɔ?
Moab kɛ emaji lɛ ahiɛ akpãtã nɛɛ; ni amɛmli hii kãkãlɔi lɛ hu ni enyɔnyɔi nɛɛ.
Mi, Maŋtsɛ ni atsɛɔ mi Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mi, mikɛɛ.
Moab hiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, ni emanehulu lɛ eshɛ shi etã.
“Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛŋkɛ Moab, nyɛyea lɛ ŋkɔmɔ; kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛle bɔ ni egbɛi ehehe, nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Te aye tɛŋŋ ni otsi wulu lɛ kɛ otsiamɛtso ekumɔ nɛɛ?’ Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Dibon, nyɛshia nyɛgbojee sɛɛ nyɛkpelekea shi nyɛbataraa shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ejaakɛ Moab hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ete shi ewo nyɛ, ni ekumɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ eshwie shi.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Aroer, nyɛdamɔa gbɛ lɛ he nyɛsaraa koni nyɛbia mɔ ni ena foijee he gbɛ nuu ni jio, yoo ni jio, akɛ ‘Mɛni eba?’ Amɛbaahere nɔ akɛ, ‘Ashwie Moab hiɛ shi, ejaakɛ akpãtã ehiɛ; Nyɛgbaa yɛ Arnon Faa lɛ kpokpai anɔ akɛ akpãtã Moab hiɛ!’ “Akpãtã maji ni jwere gɔji lɛ ayiteŋ shikpɔŋ kplanaa lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
Amɛ ji Holon kɛ Yaza kɛ Mefat, Dibon kɛ Nebo kɛ Bet-Diblataim, kɛ Kiriataim kɛ Bet-Gamul kɛ Bet-Meon, kɛ Keriot kɛ Bozra kɛ Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ kɛ kpaakpa fɛɛ.
Moab akloŋto ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ, akpɔ, ni akpãtã ehewalɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Abaaba Moab shi Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa Moab atɔa dãa, ejaakɛ ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa nɔ.
Moab baakoklo shi yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwee ni eshwe mli, ni abaaŋmɔ lɛ.
Te oŋmɔ Israel?
Ani ona Israel akɛ efutu julɔi ateŋ hewɔ ni be fɛɛ be ni oootsi etã lɛ ohosoɔ oyitso lɛ?
“Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Moab, nyɛshia nyɛmaji wuji lɛ amli koni nyɛbahia tɛkploi amli.
Nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe tamɔ okpo ni feɔ etsu yɛ gɔji afɔjiaŋ.
Wɔnu bɔ ni Moab wo ehe nɔ ehã; etsɛ ehe tsɔ̃.
Anu ehenɔwomɔ kɛ ntɛŋfeemɔ kɛ ehetsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ ekuɛŋtimɔ lɛ.
Mile shwãa ni eshwã lɛ.
Eshwãa ni eshwã lɛ kɛ enifeemɔnii fɛɛ lɛ yakanii ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, mawo yara yɛ Moabbii ahewɔ; mafo Moabbii fɛɛ; mafo, maye Kir-Heresbii ŋkɔmɔ.
Ao Sibma, mafo bo fe bɔ ni mafo Yazer.
Sibma, otamɔ waintso, ni ohe niji eteke Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ kɛtee kɛyashɛ Yazer tɔ̃ɔ.
Shi naa, otsei ayibii kɛ owainyibii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
Nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ sɛɛ efo yɛ Moab shikpɔŋ ni baa nii lɛ nɔ.
Mihã wain tsereee yɛ wain bui amli dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko eŋaaa wain yɛ jɛi kɛ nyamɔ lala; blɔmɔ ni anuɔ lɛ ejeee miishɛɛ blɔmɔ.
“Heshbonbii kɛ Elealebii miibolɔ, ni aanu amɛbolɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ Yahaz.
Anu blɔmɔ lɛ kɛjɛ Zoar aahu kɛtee Horanaim kɛ Eglat-Shelishiya tɔ̃ɔ, ejaakɛ Nimrim Faa lɛ tete eŋala.
Mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mibahã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shãa afɔle yɛ hei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shãa tsofakɛŋma hãa Moab nyɔŋmɔi lɛ akpa feemɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, Moabbii kɛ Kir-Heresbii ahe ŋkɔmɔ miibo yɛ mitsui mli tamɔ awerɛho lala ni aakpã kɛ bɛlɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjwetrii fɛɛ ni amɛtĩa lɛ efee yaka.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eshɛ eyi, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ eku etsɛŋ, abamɔbamɔɔ niji ahe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ekɔ kpekpe eŋmɔ ehɛ akɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli he okadi.
Moab tsui ayiteiaŋ fɛɛ kɛ eblohuiaŋ fɛɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ayeɔ yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ mijwara Moab tamɔ kpulu ni mɔ ko mɔ ko taooo.
Te akpãtã Moab hiɛ ahã tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?
Kwɛ bɔ ni emli bii lɛ ewo yara!
Kwɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ esɛɛ ehã henyɛlɔ kɛ hiɛgbele.
Etsɔ̃ fɛoyeli nɔ kɛ gbeyei nɔ ehã maji fɛɛ ni bɔle lɛ lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Moab naŋ foijee hegbɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa mɔ ko baaba ebayi Moab nɔ gleŋ tamɔ okropɔŋ ni egbɛ efijiaŋ, ni ebaaŋɔ Moab maji ni ebaashɔ̃ emɔji lɛ.
Ni nakai be lɛ Moab hii kãkãlɔi lɛ atsui aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ tsui.
Abaakpãtã Moab hiɛ bɔ ni etsɔŋ maŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ewo ehe nɔ yɛ Yehowa nɔ.
Ao, Moabbii, tsuifãa saji kɛ bui ni atsatsaa kɛ tsɔnei ni atsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔ miimɛ nyɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mɔ ni aaajo gbeyei lɛ naa foi lɛ, eeeyagbee bu lɛ mli; ni mɔ ni aaakwɔ kɛje bu lɛ mli lɛ, eeeyadu tsɔne lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mahã nɛkɛ jaramɔi nɛɛ aba Moabbii anɔ, afi nɔ ni mibagbala amɛtoi lɛ.
Foijelɔi ni amɛtɔ biti tao hejɔɔmɔhe yɛ Heshbon hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, shi la efã kɛjɛ Heshbon; la lilɛi efã kɛjɛ Maŋtsɛ Sihon we lɛ.
Eshã Moab hiɛnaa ni ji bii hoofeelɔi lɛ apampam.
Ao Moab, kpoo hã bo.
Kemosh egbe ejeŋ naa, ejaakɛ aŋɔ emli bihii lɛ nom, ni amɔmɔ yei lɛ hu nyɔji.
Shi naagbee mli aahu lɛ, mibahã Moab nine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ lɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mikɛ Moab baaye mahã kɛyata nɛ.’ ”
Yehowa baagbala Amon toi Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Amonbii ahe nɛ, “Ani Israel bɛ bihii, aloo Israel bɛ mɛi ni yeɔ enii hewɔ ni mɛi ni jaa wɔŋ Molek lɛ ebaŋɔ Gadbii ashikpɔŋ, ni amɛbahi jɛi maji lɛ amli lɛ?
Naa, mi Yehowa, miikɛɛ akɛ be miiba, be ni mahã mɛi ni yɔɔ Amonbii amaŋ wulu Raba lɛ mli anu ta oshebɔɔ he.
Ebaatsɔ̃ koikoi, ni abaashã ekrowai lɛ wɛɛ kɛmɔ shi, ni Israel baaye mɛi ni baye enɔ lɛ anɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Ao Heshbon, wɔ lele, shi akpãtã Ai maŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛ Raba yei, nyɛfoa, nyɛmiaa kɛ kpekpe, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ; nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ koowieiaŋ, ejaakɛ abaaloo nyɛwɔŋ Molek kɛ ewulɔmɛi lɛ kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ kɛya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Nyɛ ni nyɛkwa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli, mɛɛba ni nyɛshwãa nyɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛhewalɛ ni miigbɔjɔ nɔ, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Namɔ baanyɛ shi ete ewo wɔ?’ Naa, nɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nyɛ ji akɛ mibahã mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle nyɛ abahɛŋ nyɛ kɛ tsuifãa sane, ni abaashwie nyɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baajo foi bɔ ni ekwɛŋ esɛɛ tete, ni mɔ ko ehiŋ shi ni baabua foijelɔi lɛ anaa.
Shi naagbee mli lɛ mibahã Amonbii anine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ amɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa baagbala Edombii atoi Nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Edombii ahe nɛ, “Ani nilee bɛ Teman dɔŋŋ?
Ani ŋaawoo elaaje hiɛshikãlɔi lo?
Ani amɛnilee etã?
Nyɛ Dedanbii, nyɛdɔa nyɛyi, ni nyɛjoa foi nyɛyatea nyɛhe yɛ nififiaŋ bui amli, ejaakɛ mibahã amanehulu aba Esaubii anɔ.
Kɛji wainyibiitselɔi ba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, ani amɛshiii yibii lɛ ashishi ni aye lɛ kpɛkpɛo lo?
Aloo kɛji julɔi tete ba oŋmɔshinii juu nyɔɔŋ lɛ, amɛjuuu bɔ pɛ ni amɛtaoɔ lo?
Shi naa, mi lɛ mifee Esaubii pasaa; mijie amɛteemɔhei lɛ kpo, ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe amɛtee dɔŋŋ.
Akpãtã Edombii kɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi kɛ amɛshwiei kɛ amɛnanemɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ŋmɛnɛ, Edom bɛ nɔ ko mli dɔŋŋ.
Shi owusai lɛ ohã mi; mibakwɛ amɛnɔ shweshweeshwe; ni hã okulafoi lɛ ahe mi aye.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kɛji mɛi ni kulɛ esaaa akɛ agbalaa amɛtoi lɛ abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ, ani bo lɛ obaaye ohe?
Oŋɔŋ ohe oyeŋ tswaa; esa akɛ agbala otoi kɛ̃.
Ejaakɛ mikã mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ Bozra sane lɛ baafee gbeyei, abaabɔ lɛ ahora, ni abaakpãtã ehiɛ ni akɛ egbɛi baakã kitã ni emaji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.” Minu saji ni jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ; ni awo bɔfo hu gbɛ kɛtee majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛ wiemɔ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa kɛkpea koni nyɛbatua Edom.
Ejaakɛ naa, mibaba bo shi kwraa yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni ohe guɔ baagbo yɛ mɛi ahiɛ.
Bo mɔ ni ohɔ tɛkplo mli, kɛ bo mɔ hu ni oyɔɔ gɔŋ yiteŋ, oshishiu bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ gbeyei ni owo ohe kɛ ohe ni owo lɛ.
Kɛji oshihilɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ niiaŋ tete po tamɔ okropɔŋ feɔ lɛ, mibaba bo shi.” Yehowa, kɛɛ.
“Edom sane baatsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ Edom he kɛho lɛ baashe gbeyei, ni ebaabo lɛ ‘gbeeakle’.
Bɔ ni atsɔ abutu Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ amɛhewɔ maji lɛ, mi, Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee Edom bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi, ni mɔ ko hu eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi.
Naa, bɔ ni jata fãa kɛjɛɔ Yordan Faa he koo hayii mli kɛbaa ebatuaa too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe lɛ, nakai mibaba trukaa, ni mahã Edombii ajo foi amɛshi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mi, mibato mɔ ni misumɔɔ koni eye Edom nɔ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ kɛ mi ye egbɔ?
Namɔ baanyɛ mi sane ebi?
Mɛɛ maŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔ baanyɛ mihiɛ edamɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa yiŋ ni mi, Yehowa, mito yɛ Edom he, kɛ nɔ ni mikpãŋ akɛ mafee Temanbii toi.
Abaashãtã amɛbii bibii lɛ tete po kɛaatee, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he baajara lɛ yɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ hewɔ.
Edom shigbeemɔ lɛ baahã shikpɔŋ tete ahoso, ni blɔmɔ ni amɛbaablɔ lɛ abaanu yɛ Akaba Bele lɛ kpokpai anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Naa, nakai be lɛ mɔ ko baagba shi shwiaa kɛba tamɔ okropɔŋ ni egbɛ efijiaŋ kɛbatua Bozra, ni Edom hii kãkãlɔi lɛ atsui baatsɔ̃ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ tsui.” Yehowa baagbala Damaskobii atoi Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Damaskobii ahe nɛ, “Hamatbii kɛ Arpadbii ejijaa, ejaakɛ amɛnu sane fɔŋ; amɛtsui efã fe nine, ni amɛyoyro; amɛfee tamɔ ŋshɔ ni efee hamahama ni amɛnaaa hejɔlɛ.
Damaskobii egbɔjɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛsɛɛ koni amɛjo foi; ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ amɛ; amɛhe miijara amɛ, ni amɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ.
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni maŋ ni miishɛɛ yɔɔ mli sa lɛ, ajwa sam ashi lɛ nɛɛ?
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ eblahii lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ eblohuiaŋ, ni abaaplenee etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.
Mama Damasko maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji lɛ blublu.” Agbala Kedar kɛ Hazar Maŋ wulu lɛ toi Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ yɛ Kedar kɛ maji bibii ni yɔɔ Hazor maŋ lɛ shishi ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ye amɛnɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, Bɔ ni, Yehowa, kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛyatuaa Kedar, ni nyɛkpãtãa bokãgbɛbii lɛ ahiɛ!
Ashɔ̃ amɛbuui lɛ kɛ amɛbuui lɛ ahe mamai lɛ, aŋɔ amɛtoi lɛ kɛ amɛnibii fɛɛ kɛya.
Ashɔ̃ amɛfukpɔŋɔi lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛya; ni mɛi baabolɔ awo amɛ akɛ, ‘He fɛɛ he efee gbeyei!’ “Nyɛ Hazorbii, nyɛjoa foi kɛyaa shɔŋŋ nyɛyahɔlɔa bui amli, ejaakɛ naa, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar eto nyɛhe yiŋ fɔŋ.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛyatuaa maŋ ni he ejɔ lɛ ni eyɔɔ shweshweeshwe, maŋ ni agboi loo agbosɛɛ adabaŋi ahe ehiaaa amɛ, maŋ ko ni ekɛ ehe ebɔɔɔ maŋ ko he, shi ekome eyɔɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
“Abaahã amɛfukpɔŋɔi lɛ, ni amɛtsinai lɛ baatsɔ̃ ojoyelinii.
Mibagbɛ mɛi ni kuɔ amɛyi fãfãafãi lɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ he ni kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa kɛjɛɔ kɛbaa lɛ; mibahã amɛmanehului ajɛ he fɛɛ he abanina amɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Hazor baatsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe; ebaatsɔ̃ naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃, ni adesa ko adesa ko ehiŋ jɛi, ni mɔ ko hu eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa baagbala Elam toi Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Yeremia wie yɛ Elambii ahe nɛ, yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shishijee mli.
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mibakpãtã Elam gãitsɛ̃lɔi ni ji Elam hewalɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã kɔɔyɔɔ atswa kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ abashwie Elam nɔ, ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ ni ji kɔɔyɔi lɛ ajɛɛhei lɛ, ni maŋ ko ehiŋ shi ni Elambii ni mibagbɛ amɛ mashwã lɛ eyajeŋ jɛi.
Mahã Elambii atsui afã yɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni taoɔ amɛhiɛ amɛkpãtã lɛ ahiɛ.
Mibafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ mimlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mibahã agbala klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni mibakpãtã amɛhiɛ; Makpãtã amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ ahiɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ mikɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli sɛi lɛ aaabama Elam.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Shi naagbee mli aahu lɛ, mibahã Elam nine ashɛ nibii ni eŋmɛɛ lɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.”
Aye Babilon nɔ kunim Nɔ ni Yehowa tsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Yeremia nɔ ewie yɛ Babilon maŋ lɛ kɛ emli bii lɛ ahe nɛ, “Shiɛmɔ koni okɛɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ, shii aflaŋaa, ni oshiɛ; okashiu nɔ ko nɔ; kɛɛmɔ akɛ Aye Babilon nɔ kunim.
Awo lɛ hiɛgbele Mardruk werɛ eho ehe.
Ashwie Babilon amãgãi lɛ ahiɛ shi, amɛnaa diɛŋtsɛ ekpɛ amɛhe.
“Ejaakɛ maŋ ko efã ta kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛmiiba ebatua Babilon, ni ebaahã Babilon atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ bɔ ni gbɔmɔ ni jio, kooloo ni jio, fɛɛ baajo foi ashi jɛi, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.” Israelbii asɛɛkuu Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm baabua amɛhe naa amɛba kɛ yaafo amɛbatao Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ.
Amɛbaabi he ni gbɛ ni yaa Zion lɛ kã, ni amɛbaatsɔ̃ amɛhiɛ amɛhã jɛi gbɛ, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa koni wɔ kɛ Yehowa ayakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni akuŋ mli asaŋ ni hiɛ kpaŋ nɔ kɛaatee naanɔ.’ “Mimaŋbii lɛ tamɔ toi ni elaaje; amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ ehã amɛdu gbɛ, amɛkpala amɛ kɛnyiɛ gɔji anɔ, amɛkɛ amɛ ejɛ gɔŋ wulu nɔ kɛtee gɔŋ bibioo nɔ, ni shĩagbɛ elaaje amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni naa amɛ lɛ kpãtãa amɛhiɛ, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔyeee fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛfee esha amɛshi Yehowa, mɔ ŋɔɔ ni amɛshihilɛhe diɛŋtsɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ni ji amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.’ “Nyɛjoa foi yɛ Babilon; nyɛshia Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛfea nyɛhe tamɔ tookpakpoi kɛnyiɛ tookui lɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ naa, mitee maji wuji shi yɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ miiba abatua Babilon.
Amɛbaagba ta amɛwo Babilon, ni jɛigbɛ abaajɛ aye Babilon nɔ kunim.
Amɛgãii lɛ tamɔ hii kãkãlɔi ni jɛɛɛ ta mli baaa shĩa kɛ amɛniji nyɔŋma.
Abaaha Babilon, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baayaha Babilon lɛ baana nii bɔ ni amɛtsuii baatɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Babilon shigbeemɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛha miwebii anii, eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛmiinya, ni nyɛmli efili nyɛ tamɔ tsinabi oblayoo ni miigbɛlɛ abele; ni nyɛmiibolɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ nuu moŋ nɛ, shi naa, nyɛ nyɛhiɛ baagbo kpɔtɔɔ; yoo ni fɔ nyɛ lɛ, ehiɛ baashwie shi pam.
Naa, nyɛmaŋ wulu lɛ baatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ; ebaatsɔ̃ ŋa kpataa ni enɔ egbi tamɔ shiaŋa.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa mlifu naa lɛ, adesa ko ehiŋ jɛi, shi ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kwrakwra.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ Babilon he kɛho lɛ naa aaakpɛ ehe, ni eeebo lɛ ‘gbeeakle’ yɛ bɔ ni afee lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
“Nyɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔi, nyɛgbaa ta kɛbɔlea Babilon he kɛkpea.
Nyɛtsɛ̃rɛa lɛ nyɛgãii lɛ, nyɛkasɛ̃sɛ̃a gãimlibii lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ Babilon efee esha eshi Yehowa.
Nyɛbɔa oshe kɛbɔlea lɛ.
Babilon ehole eniji anɔ akɛ enyɛɛɛ ta lɛ dɔŋŋ; ehe gbogboi lɛ ewule, akumɔ amɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ ji no.
Nyɛtɔa nyɛhe owele yɛ enɔ; bɔ ni efee mɛi komɛi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Nyɛkaŋmɛa mɔ ko gbɛ ni edu nii yɛ Babilon, ni nyɛkaŋmɛa mɔ ko gbɛ ni ekpã ŋmɔshinii yɛ Babilon.
Henyɛlɔi aklante hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatao emaŋbii asɛɛgbɛ, ni ebaajo foi kɛya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.” Israelbii lɛ asɛɛkuu kɛbaa “Israel tamɔ toi ni gbɔbimɔ ni jatai gbɔbiɔ amɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛgbɛ amɛshwã.
Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ji mɔ ni ye eloo, ni sɛɛkpee be nɛɛ mli lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ji mɔ ni ekpe ewui lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa, mibagbala Babilon maŋtsɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ fɛɛ toi tamɔ bɔ ni migbala Asiria maŋtsɛ lɛ toi lɛ.
Mibakpale Israel kɛba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni ebaaye Karmel kɛ Bashan shikpɔji lɛ anɔ nii, ni eeetɔ kɛ Efraim kɛ Gilead gɔji lɛ anɔ nii lɛ.
Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, aaatao nishaianii yɛ Israel, shi anaŋ eko, ni anaŋ esha ko yɛ Yuda hu, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni mibahã ashwɛ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛhe mafa amɛ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala Babilon toi “Nyɛfãa nyɛyatuaa Merataimbii kɛ Pekodbii lɛ.
Nyɛgbea amɛ, nyɛnyiɛa amɛsɛɛ, nyɛplenea amɛ kwrakwra.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ; nyɛfea bɔ ni mifã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Aanu tawuu he yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni aakpãtã nibii ahiɛ pam.
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ hamle lɛ ajwara lɛ ni akumɔ lɛ ashwie shi nɛɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni Babilon etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ maji ateŋ nɛɛ?
Ao, Babilon, mitsɔ̃ bo tsɔne, ni odu; shi oleee; ana bo, ni amɔ bo, ejaakɛ okɛ Yehowa fu daa.
Yehowa egbele etawuu nibii atoohe lɛ naa, ni ejie emlifu tawuu nibii lɛ kpo, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, yɛ nitsumɔ ni ebaatsu yɛ Babilonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjɛa hei fɛɛ nyɛbatuaa lɛ, nyɛjwaraa eboŋoi ashinai lɛ; nyɛbuaa haanii lɛ anaa tamɔ ŋmaa kei, ni nyɛkpãtãa maŋ lɛ hiɛ butuu, ni nyɛkashĩa enɔ ko nɔ ko.
Nyɛgbea Babilon hii lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ tsina hii; nyɛkpalaa amɛ kɛyaa nyɛyagbea amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm.
Kpoo hã amɛ!
Ejaakɛ amɛtoigbalamɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
“Naa, mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ ejo foi kɛjɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee Yerusalɛm, ni amɛmiigba akɛ Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etɔ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ he owele.
“Nyɛtsɛa gãitsɛ̃lɔi lɛ nyɛwoa Babilon he, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni le gãitsɛ̃mɔ aya eko.
Nyɛsaa maŋ lɛ yi kɛkpea; ni nyɛkahãa mɔ ko naa fɔijee hegbɛ.
Bɔ ni Babilon fee mɛi komɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ lɛ ayea nakai nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ Yehowa, Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, fũ daa.
No hewɔ lɛ, abaagbegbee eblahii lɛ ashwã eblohuiaŋ, ni abaaplene etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nakai be lɛ mli.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
“Bo maŋhewolɔ, naa, mi kɛ bo ena.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ogbi lɛ eshɛ be ni mibagbala otoi lɛ.
Hewolɔ lɛ baatɛ, ni ebaagbee shi, ni enaŋ mɔ ko awo enɔ.
Mibama emaji wuji lɛ anaa la, ni ebaashã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni bɔle lɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Aaye Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ hu fɛɛ anɔ keketee; ni mɛi ni baŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ hiɛ amɛ kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ koni amɛya amɛmaŋ.
Shi amɛ-Kpɔlɔ lɛ he wa, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ.
Ye kɛ̃ ebaaye amɛsane lɛ ehã amɛ koni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi Babilonbii lɛ, haomɔ ji nɔ ni baanina amɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Ta baanina Babilon, gbele baanina emaŋbii kɛ elumɛi lɛ kɛ enilelɔi lɛ.
Ta baanina okɔmfoi nifeelɔi lɛ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai.
Ta baanina ehii kãkãlɔi lɛ, koni amɛhiɛ akpãtã.
Ekpɔŋɔi kɛ taayaa shwiilii lɛ ahiɛ baakpãtã; maŋsɛɛ tabilɔi ni futu amɛ lɛ, hu ahiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yei!
Abaagbɛ amɛ ashwã koni aha amɛ.
Nu enɛŋ, hewɔ lɛ fai fɛɛ baaŋala, ejaakɛ Babilon eyi tɔ kɛ amãgãi, ni amãgãi nɛɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ eye amɛ sɛkɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, Babilon baatsɔ̃ klaŋ odigblɛmi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi krokomɛi ashihilɛhe; duguma baahi jɛi, gbɔmɛi ehiŋ jɛi dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni asaŋ gbɔmɔ adesa yinɔ ko yinɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi dɔŋŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ butu Sodom kɛ Gomora kɛ amɛhewɔ majimaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko ehiii jɛi, ni asaŋ mɔ ko ni jɛ yoo musuŋ eyatoŋ gbɔ yɛ jɛi lɛ, mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.
“Naa, maŋ wulu ko miijɛ kooyigbɛ aba, maŋ ko ni he wa, kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi babaoo miijɛ je lɛ naagbeehei shɔŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ amɛba kɛ ta.
Amɛhiɛ amɛgãi kɛ akplɔi; amɛyi wa, ni amɛnaaa mɔbɔ.
Kɛji anu amɛkpɔŋɔi ni amɛtara amɛnɔ lɛ ahe lɛ, egbɛɔ tamɔ ŋshɔ.
Amɛmia tamɔ nuu ni miiya ta.
Ao!
Babilon, amɛmiiba amɛkɛ bo abawu.
Babilon maŋtsɛ nu amɛhe pɛ, kɛkɛ ni enijiaŋ je wui, ni etsui fã tamɔ yoo ni miikɔmɔ ni ebaafɔ.
“Naa, mafã tamɔ jata ni ejɛ Yordan Faa lɛ he koo hayii lɛ mli ni ebatua kooloi yɛ jwɛifɔ ŋa nɔ, ni mahã amɛjo foi trukaa kɛje jɛi; ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã mɔ ko koni eye maŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ tamɔ mi?
Namɔ baanyɛ mi ekɛfu daa?
Namɔ baanyɛ mi mihiɛ edamɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛboa bɔ ni Yehowa esusu yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ he kɛ bɔ ni eto eyiŋ ni ebaafee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii ehã lɛ toi.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ abaashãtã amɛbii bibii kɛya maŋsɛɛ, ni maŋbii ahe baajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni baaba amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛji anu he akɛ aŋɔ Babilon nom lɛ, shikpɔŋ baahoso, ni abaanu Babilon awerɛho blɔmɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ.”
Babilon toigbalamɔ lɛ nɔtsamɔ Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Matee mumɔ ko ni fiteɔ nii shi mawo Babilon kɛ emli bii ni ji Kaldeabii lɛ, ni matsu mɛi kpɔ̃ji kɛya Babilon koni amɛsha emli tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ.
Nakai gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaajɛ Babilon hewɔ hei fɛɛ abatua lɛ, ni amɛbaafee eshikpɔŋ lɛ shwɛm.
Akaŋmɛ gãitsɛ̃lɔ ko gbɛ ni etsɛ̃ egãi lɛ, ni akaŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ ni ewo edade dama tete.
Akɛ eblahii lɛ eko kwraa he akake lɛ; akpãtã etabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ butuu.
Mɛi baanyɔnyɔi yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni pilafoi baajwere blohui lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ kɛ Yudabii lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekwako amɛ; shi Babilonbii lɛ, amɛ lɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nifɔɔjianii babaoo ni amɛkɛtɔ̃ Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛjoa foi kɛjea Babilon teŋ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala.
Nyɛkahãa aplenea nyɛ yɛ Babilon toigbalamɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ Yehowa oweletɔɔ be lɛ eshɛ, no ji Babilon toi ni egbalaa nɛɛ.
Babilon tamɔ shika kpulu yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ, ni kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ ehã jeŋ maji fɛɛ tɔrɔ dãa; jeŋ maji lɛ nu edɛŋ wain lɛ eko, no hewɔ lɛ, jeŋ maji lɛ ye sɛkɛ.
Babilon egbee shi trukaa, ni ehiɛ ekpãtã; nyɛfoa lɛ; akɛ tsofa ato epilamɔ lɛ nɔ, eko lɛ aaatsa lɛ.
Kulɛ wɔɔtsa Babilon, shi ehiii lɛ tsamɔ.
Nyɛshia lɛ, ni nyɛhãa wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ nɔ he ni ejɛ, ejaakɛ Babilon toigbalamɔ lɛ eshɛ ŋwɛi, ni awo nɔ kɛyashɛ atatuiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛa akɛ Yehowa ehã wɔjalɛ lɛ eje kpo; nyɛbaa koni wɔyagba yɛ Yerusalɛm nɔ ni Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsu lɛ.
“Yehowa etsiɛ Mediabii amaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ amumɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Babilon maŋ lɛ he ji akɛ ebaakpãtã ehiɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ no baatɔ eSɔlemɔ we lɛ he owele.
Tabilɔi ni eba maŋ lɛ tuamɔ lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ fã akɛ, ‘Nyɛjɔa gãimlibii lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkɔlɔa tsɛŋi!’ Nyɛfãa kɛ aflaŋaa, nyɛyatuaa Babilon maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ; nyɛbua jogbaŋŋ, nyɛtoa bulɔi; nyɛtoa mɛi ni baawo Babilon maŋ lɛ he ka, ejaakɛ nɔ ni Yehowa to eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee Babilonbii lɛ ena efee.
Ao!
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ he ni nu babaoo yɔɔ, ni nyɛyɔɔ jwetri babaoo, nyɛnaagbee eshɛ, ni afo nyɛwala sɛɛ.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã akɛ, ‘Mahã tabilɔi tamɔ baalabii afalɛ abayi omli obɔ̃ tɔ, ni amɛbaabɔ kunimyeli oshe.’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ lala “Yehowa bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, yɛ ehewalɛ naa, ni ejɛ nilee mli ebɔ je lɛ, ni elɛɛ ŋwɛi mli kɛ ŋaa.
Kɛji ewo egbee lɛ, nu ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shimɔɔ, ni ehãa afua teteɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehei fɛɛ.
Ehãa srawa gbalaa yɛ nunɛmɔ mli, ni ehãa ahum fãa kɛjɛɔ he ni eto amɛ yɛ.
Adesa lɛ kwashia ni, enilee faaa; shikaŋaalɔ fɛɛ shikaŋaalɔ hiɛ egbo, yɛ amãgãi ni efee lɛ ahewɔ; lakamɔ nibii ni, ni mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.
Amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, mɔ akɛlakaa; be ni abaagbala amɛtoi lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ lɛ ebɔ nibii fɛɛ kwa; ni Israel ji maŋ ni eŋɔ akɛ enɔ.” Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ji egbɛi.
Yehowa hamle lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Babilon, bo ji mihamle, bo ji mitawuunii.
Bo mikɛjwaraa majimaji wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, bo mikɛkpãtãa maŋtsɛyelii ahiɛ.
Bo mikɛkumɔɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ enɔtalɔ lɛ, ni bo mikɛkumɔɔ tayaa shwiilii, ni bo mikɛkumɔɔ shwiilii kɛ kudɔlɔi lɛ.
Bo onɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ migbeɔ nuu kɛ yoo, kɛ onukpa kɛ gbekɛ, kɛ oblanyo kɛ oblayoo; Bo mikɛkpãtãa tookwɛlɔ kɛ etoi ahiɛ, kɛ okwaafonyo kɛ ehumɔ kooloi ahiɛ, kɛ amraloi kɛ lumɛi hu ahiɛ.” Babilon toigbalamɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibawo Babilon maŋ lɛ kɛ Babilonbii fɛɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfee Yerusalɛm lɛ he nyɔmɔ yɛ nyɛhiɛ.
Ao, Babilon ni otsɔ̃ ohe gɔŋ ni oofite shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, naa, mikɛ bo ena; mawo minine nɔ yɛ onɔ, ni makoklo bo kɛjɛ tɛsai lɛ anɔ matswa shi, ni mahã otsɔ̃ gɔŋ ni eshã.
Akɔŋ omli tɛ ko akɛtswaŋ koŋtɛ loo akɛto tsu shishi; shi moŋ obaatsɔ maŋ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.
Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” “Nyɛshia tayaa aflaŋaa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Nyɛsaa maji lɛ nyɛhãa ta nyɛwoa Babilon.
Nyɛwoa maŋtsɛyeli ni ji Ararat kɛ Mini kɛ Ashkenaz ŋaa koni amɛfã ta amɛwo Babilon.
Nyɛfãa tatsɛ koni enyiɛ tabilɔi lɛ ahiɛ kɛyatua lɛ.
Nyɛkɛ okpɔŋɔi abaa babaoo tamɔ baalabii.
Nyɛsaa maji lɛ kɛhã ta nyɛwoa Babilon.
Maji nɛɛ ji, Media maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛshishi amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amɛshishi lɛ afee kralo.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ ejijaa, ni eekpokpo, ejaakɛ Yehowa miitsu eyiŋ ni eto akɛ ebaahã Babilon atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi lɛ he nii.
Babilon tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ ekpa ta lɛ wuu; amɛhɔlɔ amɛmɔji lɛ amli, amɛhewalɛ egbɔjɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ yei.
Akumɔ amɛgboi lɛ asɛɛ adabãi lɛ, ni eshĩai lɛ miitso kɛ la.
Tsulɔ ni hiɛ foi kɛ tsulɔ kroko hu ni hiɛ foi kpeɔ, ni bɔfo ni hiɛ foi kɛ bɔfo kroko ni hiɛ foi kpeɔ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ wiemɔ ni amɛkɛmiiya amɛkɛyatswa Babilon maŋtsɛ adafi akɛ aŋɔ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm!
Aŋɔ maŋ lɛ faafoohe lɛ, ni hebuu mɔji lɛ ashã, ni tabilɔi lɛ atsui efã.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Babilon kɛ emli bii etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe ni aagbee ŋmaa yɛ jɛi; eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni be lɛ baashɛ, ni abaaloo amɛ kɛya tamɔ ŋmɔshinii ni akpa.’ ” Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar eye mi, ni ekpãtã mihiɛ; ehã mitsɔ̃ tsɛnsi folo; ni emi mi tamɔ jeŋ miɔ nii; ewo emusu obɔ̃ kɛ minibii ni ŋɔɔŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eŋa mimli nu fɛɛ tswɛm.
Zionnyo akɛɛ akɛ, “Yi ni awa mi kɛ miwekumɛi lɛ yi sɔ̃ atere Babilon.” Yerusalɛm akɛɛ akɛ, “Babilonbii aye milá yi sɔ̃!” Yehowa baaye ebua Israel No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mibaye osane lɛ mahã bo, ni mibatɔ ohe owele.
Mibahã he ni Babilon naa enu kɛjɛɔ lɛ agbi, ni mahã emli fai lɛ aŋala; ni Babilon baatsɔ̃ koikoi kɛ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛho naa baakpɛ ehe, ni ebaabo lɛ ‘gbeeakle,’ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ jɛi.
Babilonbii fɛɛ baahuu tamɔ jatai, ni amɛbaablɔ tamɔ jatabii.
Be mli ni amɛmli ewo la lɛ, mibaŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃, ni mahã amɛtɔrɔ dãa koni amɛmli afili amɛ, ni wɔ baanyɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Mibakpala amɛ tamɔ gwantɛŋbii kɛ gwantɛŋhii kɛ tookpakpoi kɛya koni agbe amɛ.” Bɔ ni Babilon naagbee baatamɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Te aye tɛŋŋ ni aŋɔ Babilon nɛɛ, ni ashɔ̃ he ni jeŋjeŋ fɛɛ kafoɔ nɛɛ lɛ?
Te aye tɛŋŋ ni Babilon sane etsɔ̃ gbeyei nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ nɛɛ?
Ŋshɔ tete egri ewo Babilon, ni ŋshɔkei wujiwuji ni gbɛɔ lɛ ebaha enɔ.
Emaji wuji lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ gbeyei nɔ; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hei ni nu enɛɛɛ yɛ kɛ shiaŋa, shikpɔŋ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiii nɔ, ni gbɔmɔ adesa ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ jɛi kɛhooo.
Mibagbala Bel, Babilonbii awɔŋ lɛ toi, ni mahã egɔi nibii fɛɛ ni emimii.
Majimaji anɔ bii eloŋ amɛhe kɛyaŋ eŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.
Babilon maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ ekumɔ eshwie shi.
Miwebii Israelbii, nyɛshia Babilon.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ajo Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa foi ni ehere eyiwala.
Nyɛtsui akafãa, ni nyɛkashea gbeyei kɛji nyɛnu sane ko yɛ afi ko nɔ, ni afi kroko hu nɔ lɛ nyɛnu sane kroko.
Nyɛtsui akayea, ni nyɛkashea gbeyei kɛji nyɛnu henitswiamɔ ni maŋtsɛmɛi tswiaa amɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be lɛ miiba be ni mikɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amãgãi lɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ lɛ.
Abaashwie Babilon shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ shi, ni emli gbɔmɛi lɛ baanyɔnyɔi yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ amɛmli nibii fɛɛ baala kɛ miishɛɛ kɛye Babilon he fɛo, ejaakɛ mɛi baajɛ kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ abakpãtã ehiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Esa akɛ Babilon agbee shi yɛ Israelbii ni egbegbee lɛ ahewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Babilon hewɔ lɛ agbegbee jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii lɛ.” Wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã Israelbii ni yɔɔ Babilon Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛje klante naa gbele mli, nyɛyaa, nyɛkadamɔa shi.
Nyɛkaia Yehowa yɛ shɔŋŋ he ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ tete, ni nyɛkaia Yerusalɛm hu.
Nyɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhiɛ egboi ejaakɛ wɔnu wɔhorabɔɔ lɛ kɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔtoi, ni wɔhiɛ eshwie shi kpɔtɔɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ebabote Yehowa we lɛ mli hei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, naa, be miiba ni mikɛ Babilon amãgãi lɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pilafoi fɛɛ baakɛ̃mɔ.
Kɛ Babilon kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi tamɔ mɛ, ni kɛ ewaje emɔji lɛ akɛ mɛ, kɛ̃lɛ mibawo mɛi gbɛ kɛyakpãtã ehiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Babilon hiɛkpãtãmɔ kroko hu Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi!
Aabolɔ kɛjɛ Babilon!
Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ he blɔmɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa miifee Babilon amaŋfɔ̃, ni eefo efuufeemɔ sɛɛ.
Henyɛlɔi tabilɔi keɔ kɛbaa kɛ blɔmɔ tamɔ ŋshɔke gbɛɛmɔ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ eba Babilon nɔ, ni amɔmɔ etabilɔi lɛ, ni akumɔ amɛgãii amli dukuduku, ejaakɛ Yehowa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toigbalalɔ ji lɛ, ni ewoɔ nifeemɔ fɔŋ he nyɔmɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mibahã Babilon lumɛi lɛ kɛ nilelɔi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ tatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ atɔrɔ dãa, ni naanɔ wɔ baanyɔ amɛnɔ, ni amɛhiɛ etsɛ̃ŋ dɔŋŋ.
Mi, Maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Abaakumɔ Babilon gbogbo lɛkɛtɛɛ lɛ ashwie shi shwɛtɛɛ, ni egboi gojogojoo lɛ abaashã.
Majimaji lɛ miigbo deŋme yaka, ni amɛhenaagbamɔ lɛ la baashã.
Mi, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Yeremia wiemɔ yashɛ Babilon Yuda Maŋtsɛ Zedekia yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ etee Babilon.
Ekɛ epiafonyonukpa Seraia ni ji Maseia bi Neria bi lɛ tee.
Gbalɔ Yeremia kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ maje Seraia.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia ŋma efɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ ni baaba Babilon nɔ lɛ ewo wolo mli; wiemɔi fɛɛ ni eŋmala lɛ kɔɔ Babilon he.
Yeremia kɛɛ Seraia akɛ, “Kɛji oshɛ Babilon lɛ kwɛmɔ koni okane wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ osɔle akɛ, ‘Ao Yehowa, okɛɛ yɛ maŋ nɛɛ he akɛ obaakpãtã ehiɛ butubutu kɛmɔ shi bɔ ni adesa loo kooloo ko ehiŋ mli, ni ebaakã shi amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ.’ Kɛji okane wolo nɛɛ ogbe naa lɛ, fii wolo lɛ okpɛtɛ tɛ, koni oshɛ ofɔ̃ Eufrate Faa lɛ teŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni Babilon baashiu, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ ni mi, Yehowa, mibakpãtã lɛ hewɔ.’ ” He ni Yeremia kɛ ewiemɔ lɛ wa nɛ.
Aŋɔ Yerusalɛm Zedekia eye afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome be ni ebabɔ̃i maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; ni eye maŋtsɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Enyɛ gbɛi ji Hamutal, Yeremia ni jɛ Libna lɛ biyoo lɛ.
Zedekia fee efɔŋ eshi Yehowa tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim fee lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Anɔkwa, akɛni Yehowa mli efu waa hewɔ lɛ, ekpoo Yerusalɛmbii kɛ Yudabii fɛɛ, ni eshwie amɛ kɛje ehiɛ.
Zedekia tse Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ atua, ni no hewɔ lɛ, Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã kɛ etabilɔi fɛɛ kɛba, ni amɛbatua Yerusalɛm.
Amɛsa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yi, ni amɛtswatswaa kpokui amɛkɛbɔle Yerusalɛm kɛkpe.
Asa Yerusalɛm yi aahu kɛyashi Zedekia maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ.
Afi nɛɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ ni eba Yerusalɛm lɛ naa bawa bɔ sɔŋŋ ni maŋbii naaa nɔ ko nɔ ko amɛye.
Kɛkɛ ni agbu gbɛ awo maŋ gbogbo lɛ mli, ni maŋ lɛ mli hii tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kɛje maŋ lɛ mli nyɔɔŋ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ agbo ko ni enaa kã maŋ lɛ he gbogboi enyɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ trom lɛ masɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ mli, tsɛbelɛ Babilon tabilɔi lɛ ebɔle Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛkpe nɔŋŋ.
Tabilɔi foijelɔi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.
Shi Babilon tabilɔi lɛ tiu Maŋtsɛ Zedekia.
Amɛyanina lɛ yɛ Yeriko ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, ni Zedekia tabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ yɛ ehe amɛshwã.
Amɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ bahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yɛ Ribla, yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekojo Zedekia.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ gbe Zedekia bihii lɛ yɛ ehiɛ; asaŋ egbe Yuda lumɛi lɛ hu fɛɛ yɛ Ribla.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Nebukadnezar hã afamɔ Maŋtsɛ Zedekia hiŋmɛii, ni ewo lɛ gboklɛ, ni ekpala lɛ kɛtee Babilon, ni eyawo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Zedekia gbo.
Akumɔ Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nebuzaradan ni ji Nebukadnezar hebulɔi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ bote Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni eshã Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm shĩai fɛɛ.
Eshã shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu, ni Babilon tabilɔi ni fata maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan he lɛ kumɔ gbogboi fɛɛ ni bɔle Yerusalɛm he kɛkpe lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Nebuzaradan ŋɔ maŋbii lɛ ekomɛi nom kɛtee Babilon: ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateiaŋ mɛi komɛi, kɛ maŋbii ni shwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ekomɛi, kɛ tabilɔi ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛtee amɛkɛ amɛhe yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli ŋaalɔi ni eshwɛ lɛ.
Shi Nebuzaradan, maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ lɛ, shi maŋ lɛ mli ohiafoi kposakposai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛtsɔmɔ waintrom mlisaalɔi kɛ okwaafoi.
Babilonbii lɛ kumɔ akɔɔble akulashiŋi ni yɔɔ Yehowa we lɛ, kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble nutoo gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ dukuduku, ni amɛloo akɔɔble lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Amɛŋɔ kukwɛii lɛ kɛ sofii lɛ kɛ lajee tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ okpolui lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma lɛ kɛ akɔɔble tsɛnsii krokomɛi fɛɛ ni akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛtee.
Nebuzaradan loo nibii fɛɛ hu ni akɛ shika loo jwiɛtɛi fee lɛ hu kɛtee: enɛɛmɛi ji okpolui bibii lɛ kɛ lajee tsɛnsii lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛsɔoɔ kooloi alá lɛ, kɛ kukwɛii kɛ kanetsei lɛ kɛ tsɛnsii ni akɛshãa tsofakɛŋma lɛ kɛ okpolui ni akɛshãa daa gbi afɔle lɛ.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ji shikanii lɛ eŋɔ kɛtee akɛ shika, ni nɔ ni ji jwiɛtɛi nii lɛ eŋɔ kɛtee akɛ jwiɛtɛi.
Shi akɔɔble ni akɛfee akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ kɛ gbudugbaŋ wulu lɛ, kɛ akɔɔble okpɔŋɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni gbudugbaŋ lɛ ma amɛnɔ lɛ kɛ amɛshishi nibii ni amɛmamɔ nɔ lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Solomon fee ewo Yehowa we lɛ lɛ, anyɛɛɛ etsiimɔ aŋmɛ.
Akulashiŋi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ ekome kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni edalɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni akɔɔble lɛ diɛŋtsɛ timɔ feɔ waobii ejwɛ timɔ.
Akɔɔble kpɔ ko ma akulashiŋ lɛ yiteŋ.
Kpɔ nɛɛ kwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ, ni akɔɔble ntaŋ kɛ emli kpɔbii kokrobii ha yiteŋ kpɔ lɛ he kɛkpe.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ji bɔ ni akulashiŋ kome lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Kpɔbii kokrobii nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ ekpaa yɛ akulashiŋ lɛ kponɔgbɛ.
Kpɔbii kokrobii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ntaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe feɔ ohã.
Aŋɔ Yudabii nom kɛtee Babilon Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ Nebuzaradan mɔmɔ Osɔfonukpa Seraia kɛ esɛɛmɔ Osɔfo Zefania kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ agbo lɛ naabulɔi etɛ̃ lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi hu ni emɔmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli nɛ: maŋ lɛ mli tabilɔi atatsɛ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaawolɔi kpawo komɛi ni nine shɛ amɛnɔ kɛ tatsɛ lɛ woloŋmalɔ ni ji esɛɛmɔ hu ni buaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tabilɔi anaa lɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hiɛnaanɔbii nyɔŋmai ekpaa komɛi ni ana yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Nebuzaradan, maŋtsɛ hebulɔi asafoiatsɛ lɛ, kpala amɛ kɛtee, ni ekɛ amɛ yahã Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ yɛ Ribla.
Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ tswia amɛ nii, ni egbe amɛ yɛ Ribla yɛ Hamat shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni aŋɔ Yudabii lɛ nom kɛjɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee.
Gbɔmɛi abɔ ni Nebukadnezar ŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ nɛ: yɛ efi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, eŋɔ Yudafoi akpei etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃.
Afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaŋɔ mɛi ohai kpaanyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enyɔ nom yɛ Yerusalɛm; ni Nebuzaradan, asafoiatsɛ lɛ, baŋɔ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ohai kpawo kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enumɔ nom kɛtee yɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Nomii lɛ fɛɛ ayikulɛ fee akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai ekpaa.
Afi nɔ ni Ewil-merodak baye maŋtsɛ yɛ Babilon lɛ, ena Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin mɔbɔ, ni ejie lɛ yɛ gboklɛfoi atsu lɛ mli.
Sane nɛɛ ba yɛ Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin nomŋɔɔ lɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpawo lɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Ewil-merodak hiɛ sɔ Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin pam, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnaa ni nɔ kwɔ fe maŋtsɛmɛi nomii krokomɛi ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ lɛ yɔɔ Babilon lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehoiakin tsake gboklɛfoi atade lɛ yɛ ehe; ni ekɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ yeɔ nii yɛ ekpɔlɔ̃ he daa gbi ewala gbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Daa gbi lɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ hãa lɛ shika fioo ko ni ekɛheɔ nii ni he hiaa lɛ kɛyashi egbele be.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Lalawiemɔi srɔtoi enumɔ ni abua amɛnaa yɔɔ Ŋkɔmɔyeli Wolo lɛ mli.
Akɛ lalawiemɔi lɛ fó Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ ni ba yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli lɛ.
Lalawiemɔ lɛ kɔɔ Yerusalɛm fitemɔ kɛ emli bii lɛ anomŋɔɔ he.
Eyɛ mli akɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli fa yɛ lalawiemɔ lɛ mli moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ anaa Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wɔsɛɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ hu yɛ mli.
Yudafoi lɛ kaneɔ lalawiemɔ nɛɛ yɛ jamɔ be mli, ni amɛkɛkaiɔ amɛhe sane kɛ joomɔ ni ye amɛjaku lɛ yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi Yerusalɛm awerɛhoi lɛ .- Yerusalɛm toigblamɔ .- Toigblamɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ .- Yerusalɛm tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ .- Mɔbɔnalɛ he sɔlemɔ .-
Yerusalɛm awerɛhoi lɛ Kwɛ bɔ ni maŋ ni kulɛ emli bii fa babaoo lɛ, ta shi ekometoo!
Kwɛ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ okulafo; lɛ maŋ ni kulɛ eje agbo yɛ majimaji ateŋ lɛ.
Lɛ ni kulɛ lumɔ ji lɛ yɛ maji ateŋ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni atsuɔ lɛ onia.
Fo sɔŋŋ efoɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ; yaafonu jwere ehiɛ be fɛɛ be; shi enaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ esuɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ ni shɛjeɔ emii.
Enanemɛi lɛ fɛɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa; amɛtsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.
Yuda eshi eshikpɔŋ nɔ yɛ amanehulu kɛ nyɔŋyeli tuutu hewɔ; eyahi majimaji lɛ ateŋ; shi enaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ he ko he ko.
Ehenyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ anine eshɛ enɔ yɛ nififiaŋ.
Gbɛjegbɛi ni yaa Zion lɛ miiye awerɛho, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko baaa ebayeee gbii juji ni ato lɛ.
Emaŋ agboi lɛ kãmɔ efolo esɔfoi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, eblayei lalɔi lɛ efee mɔbɔmɔbɔ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, eena nɔ naakpa.
Ehenyɛlɔi lɛ etsɔ̃ yitso agbɛnɛ, ni amɛmiishwere, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã eena nɔ yɛ etɔ̃mɔi babaoo lɛ ahewɔ.
Ebii etee; amɛnyiɛ henyɛlɔi ahiɛ kɛtee akɛ nomii.
Yerusalɛm anunyam fɛɛ etã.
Elumɛi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ ofrotei ni naaa niyelihe ko; amɛjo foi yɛ henyɛlɔi ni nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ wrɔmiiwrɔmii kɛtee.
Yerusalɛm kaiɔ, yɛ emanehulu kɛ haomɔ gbii lɛ amli, ojarawa nibii ni eyɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ.
Be ni emaŋbii gbee henyɛlɔi adɛŋ, ni bualɔ ko bualɔ ko bɛ lɛ, henyɛlɔi lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ yɛ eshigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Yerusalɛm fee esha kpele ni no hewɔ lɛ, ehe wo muji.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni kulɛ amɛwoɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ miibu lɛ shikpɔŋ agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna eyayaiaŋ.
Naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eekɛ̃mɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ eto afã.
Ehe muji kpa etadei amli; shi ejwɛŋŋ bɔ ni enaagbee baatamɔ.
Eshigbeemɔ lɛ yɛ gbeyei, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni shɛjeɔ emii!
“Ao!
Yehowa, kwɛ bɔ ni minaa amanehulu, ejaakɛ henyɛlɔi eye kunim.” Ehenyɛlɔ ekpã enine mli ewo Yuda nibiiaŋ, ni eloo ejwetri ni jara wa fɛɛ kɛtee.
Ena jeŋbii bote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, mɛi ni ogu amɛ owebii ateŋ futumɔ tete po lɛ.
Emaŋbii lɛ bluublu dɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi be ni amɛtao niyenii; amɛkɛ amɛjwetri tsakeɔ niyenii, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkagboi; “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ mi ni mihe guɔ egbo.
“Nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ biɛ kɛhoɔ, ani jeee nyɛhe sane ko ni lo?
Nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛaana akɛ awerɛho ko yɛ ni etamɔ miwerɛho ni kã minɔ nɛɛ, awerɛho ni Yehowa ehã eba minɔ yɛ emlifu ni naa wa gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
“Ehã la jɛ ŋwɛi ebote miwui amli; ekɛ yaa lɛɛ shi etsɔ̃ mi tsɔne; ehã mikpale; eshi mi, ni mifee butuu, ni gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mifee vii.
“Abua mitɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa afee apã, ekɛ enine fi amɛ ke, ni ewo efɔ̃ mikuɛ; ehã mihewalɛ gbɔjɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi ewo mɛi ni minyɛŋ amɛhiɛ madamɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
“Nuŋtsɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hii kãkãlɔi ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ akɛ amɛhewalɛ jeee fɛifɛi; ni etsɛ asafo ewo mihe koni amɛbakpãtã miblahii lɛ ahiɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ enaanaa Yuda biyoo oblayoo lɛ nɔ tamɔ waintsɔne ŋaa wain.
“Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ mifoɔ, ni yaafonu tsereɔ yɛ mihiŋmɛii amli shwieɔ shi lɛ; ejaakɛ miishɛjelɔ ni aaawo mi ekãa ekoŋŋ lɛ, ekɛ mi teŋ ejɛkɛ.
Mibii lɛ efee pasaa ejaakɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ eye amɛnɔ.
“Migbɛ mifijiaŋ; shi mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shɛjeɔ mimii.
Yehowa efã akɛ Yakob nanemɛi maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.
Yerusalɛm etsɔ̃ muji nii yɛ maji nɛɛ ateŋ.
“Yehowa sane ja, ejaakɛ miyeee ewiemɔ nɔ.
Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ, nyɛboa mi toi, ni nyɛkwɛa nɔnaa mli ni miyɔɔ.
Miblahii kɛ miblayei lɛ, aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee.
“Mitsɛ misuɔlɔi lɛ shi amɛlaka mi.
Misɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ kpãtã yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, be ni amɛtaoɔ niyenii amɛye koni amɛkagboi lɛ.
“Ao!
Yehowa, kwɛmɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyɛ hejaramɔ mli; misusuma miina nɔ, ni mitsui miitse yɛ mimli ejaakɛ mitse ohiɛ atua fe nine.
Klante miikpãtã mɛi ahiɛ yɛ blohuŋ, ni shĩa teŋ hu, gbele miimɛ.
“Bo bɔ ni mikɛ̃mɔɔ toi ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni shejeɔ mimii.
Mihenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ enu mimanehulu lɛ he, ni amɛmiinya akɛ bo odɛ̃ŋ ejɛ.
Hã gbi ni owo ehe shi lɛ aba, koni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ mi.
“Kwɛmɔ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ koni okɛ amɛ aye tamɔ bɔ ni okɛ mi ye yɛ minifɔɔjianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ.
Mikɛ̃ɛmɔ lɛ naa wa, ni mitɔ biti.”
Yehowa gbala Yerusalɛm toi Kwɛ bɔ ni Yehowa eŋɔ atatu eha Zion nɔ yɛ emlifu naa.
Eshɛ Israel anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Emlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaiii Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ji enajiaŋshi maaŋoo lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekpãtã Yuda shihilɛhei fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni enaaa mɔbɔ.
Ekumɔ Yuda biyoo lɛ mɔji eshwie shi yɛ emlifu naa.
Etsi emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi etswia shi, ni ewo amɛ hiɛgbele.
Efite Israel hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Wamɔ ni ekɛbawa Israel lɛ ehã eŋmɛɛ Israel, yɛ Israel henyɛlɔi ahiɛ.
Ekpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ Israel tamɔ la ni miitso grigri.
Egbala egãi tamɔ henyɛlɔ feɔ; ekɛ eninejurɔ eta gãi lɛ tamɔ henyɛlɔi, ni egbe mɛi fɛɛ ni ji wɔshwãanii.
Ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm shĩai lɛ amli tamɔ la.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ henyɛlɔ, ni ekpãtã Israel hiɛ.
Efite emaŋtsɛ wei lɛ fɛɛ, ni ekpãtã emɔji ni wa lɛ ahiɛ; efee amɛ koikoi, ni ehã ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ yaafo efa yɛ Yuda.
Ekumɔ ejamɔhe lɛ eshwie shi tamɔ trom mli asese.
Ekpãtã he ni ayeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbiijuji ni eto yɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Yehowa efo gbii juji kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii asɛɛ yɛ Zion, ni ekwa maŋtsɛ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ yɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyaŋe afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ; ni ekwa Ehe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eŋɔ ehe mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ.
Abolɔ yɛ Yehowa we lɛ mli tamɔ abolɔɔ yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ etswa efai shi akɛ ebaakpãtã Zion maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ hiɛ.
Eŋmɔ kpãa ekɛsusu gbogbo lɛ, eŋmɛko efitemɔ he kwraa.
Ehã kpoku kɛ gbogbo fɛɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛjwere shi butuu.
Zion agboi lɛ enyɔ kɛbote su mli, akumɔ ni afite amɛsɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Emaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ eyaje jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.
Mla lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, egbalɔi lɛ enaaa Yehowa dɛŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ.
Zion maŋ onukpai lɛ shwata shikpɔŋ, ni amɛfee diŋŋ.
Amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteiaŋ, ni amɛbumɔ kpekpe.
Yerusalɛm oblayei lɛ emamɔ amɛhiɛ shi.
Mihiŋmɛiŋ nu etã kɛ yaafo, ni misusuma miifo emli.
Mitsui ekumɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã mimaŋbii ahiɛ; ejaakɛ gbekɛbii kɛ abifabii etɔ biti yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli.
Amɛmiifo amɛmiitsɛ amɛnyɛmɛi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ aboloo kɛ wain yɔɔ?” Be mli ni amɛtɔtɔɔ biti, tamɔ pilafoi yɛ maŋ lɛ blohui amli, ni amɛnyɔnyɔi yɛ amɛnyɛmɛi lɛ akpɔkɔiaŋ lɛ?
Ao!
Yerusalɛm biyoo, mɛni makɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mɛni he mikɛ bo baato?
Ao!
Zion biyoo, oblayoo foro, mɛni he mikɛ bo aaato bɔ ni afee ni manyɛ omii mashɛje?
Ejaakɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ falɛ lɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ dalɛ, ni namɔ po aaanyɛ bo atsa?
Ninai ni ogbalɔi lɛ egba bo lɛ, apasa kɛ shishiumɔ sɔŋŋ ni; amɛkpako onifɔɔjianii lɛ ahe mama koni no ahã oje nomŋɔɔ mli; shi moŋ amale kɛ lakamɔ ninai sɔŋŋ amɛna.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni hoɔ tswaa amɛdɛŋ amɛshwieɔ onɔ; amɛboɔ Yerusalɛm biyoo lɛ “tsiaa”.
Amɛbiɔ akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ ni akɛɔ akɛ ehe yɛ fɛo (fe fɛɛ) lɛ nɛ, jeŋ fɛɛ nyamnii lɛ nɛ?” Ohenyɛlɔi fɛɛ ŋmɔɔ bo, ni amɛboɔ bo ‘tsiaa!’ Amɛkpeɔ amɛnyanyɔji ashishi, ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, “Wɔkpãtã ehiɛ pɛ!
Yiɛ!
Gbi lɛ ni wɔshwe aahu lɛ nɛ; eshɛ wɔdɛŋ, ni wɔna hu!” Yehowa etsu eyiŋtoo lɛ he nii; nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni eto jeeŋmɔ ko lɛ.
Ekpãtã nibii ahiɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli; ehã henyɛlɔ lɛ eye bo yɔɔ.
Ni ehã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ena onɔ hewalɛ.
Ao!
Yerusalɛm biyoo blɔmɔ waa otsɛ Yehowa!
Hã yaafonu aho yɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tamɔ faa, shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ fɛɛ.
Kaajɔɔ ohe; kaafɔ̃ɔ yaafo!
Tee shi koni obo yaafo nyɔɔŋ be fɛɛ be ni bulɔi jeɔ buu shishi.
Fɔsemɔ otsuiŋ fɛɛ oshwie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, tamɔ afɔseɔ nu ashwieɔ shikpɔŋ.
Holemɔ oniji anɔ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ obii bibii ni hɔmɔ ehã amɛtɔ biti yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu koŋ lɛ awala hewɔ.
Ao!
Yehowa, kwɛmɔ koni oyoo mɔ ni ofee lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Aso ehi akɛ yeifɔyei aye amɛmusuŋbii ni ahiɛ amɛ yɛ fufɔ naa lɛ?
Aso ehi akɛ agbe osɔfo kɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lo?
Gbekɛbii kɛ onukpai fɛɛ jwere mlu mli yɛ blohuiaŋ; miblayei kɛ miblahii lɛ enyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa.
Oye awui yɛ omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ; ogbe amɛ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.
Okpee henyɛlɔi ni misheɔ lɛ tamɔ akpeɔ mɛi kɛyaa gbijurɔyeli okɛbabɔle mi kpula; ni omlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ejeee mli, ni hiɛkãalɔ ko hu eshwɛɛɛ.
Henyɛlɔ lɛ plene mɛi ni milɛ misumɔɔ lɛ.
Toigbalamɔ kɛ hesɛɛjee kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ Mi ji gbɔmɔ ni mina amanehulu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ naa.
Ekpala mi, ni ekɛ mi ba duŋ ni la ko kwraa bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Anɔkwa, be fɛɛ be nɛɛ lɛ, mi pɛ minɔ ewoɔ enine nɔ yɛ daa.
Ehã miheloo diɛŋtsɛ etã yɛ migbɔmɔtso he, ni ekumɔ miwui yɛ mimli Ehã saji kɛ joomɔ kɛ nɔnaa ebɔle mi kpula kɛsa miyi.
Ehã mihi duŋ mli tamɔ mɛi ni egboi jeeŋmɔ lɛ.
Etswa gbogbo ekɛsa miyi bɔ ni minyɛŋ foi maje; ekɛ gboklɛi ni tsii ewo mi.
Tsɛbelɛ mibo mitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ koni ebawa mi, shi ebooo mifaikpamɔ lɛ toi.
Ekɛ tɛi ni ako eshwie migbɛ nɔ; ehã migbɛ ekɔdɔ̃; tsɔ̃mɔhe bɛ.
Etamɔ oshishibrishi ni ewo ka, loo jata ni etee ehe.
Ekpala mi kɛje migbɛ nɔ, ni etserɛ mimli dukuduku, ni efee mi pasaa.
Eta egãi lɛ ema minɔ ni ebaatsɛ̃ mi.
Etsɛ̃rɛ egãi kotoku lɛ mli gãimlibii lɛ ewo mitsuiŋ.
Mitsɔ̃ hefɛoyeli nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, kɛ amɛdaaŋ lala gbi muu fɛɛ.
Ehã miyi obɔ̃ kɛ joomɔ; ehã jeŋshihilɛ ejoo ewo mi tamɔ taatso.
Ehã mikpe ŋmlitsa; ehã mikoklo shi yɛ lamlu mli.
Mileee nɔ ni toiŋjɔlɛ ji lɛ, mihiɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekpa nɔ ni ji miishɛɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, minunyam etã, ni mibɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ Yehowa dɛŋ.
Kaimɔ minɔnaa kɛ mishitwiamɔ ni joɔ tamɔ taatso kɛ kɔlikɔ lɛ.
Misusuma jwɛŋɔ he daa nɛɛ, ni ehã misusuma edɔ kɔmɔɔ kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli yɛ mimli.
Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ kɛ mikai akɛ.
Yehowa suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ sɛɛ efooo kɔkɔɔkɔ, ni emɔbɔnalɛ bɛ naagbee.
Daa leebi lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hee; Yehowa anɔkwayeli da kpele.
Misusuma kɛɔ akɛ, “Migbɛfaŋnɔ ji Yehowa ni no hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ baakã enɔ.” Yehowa mli hi hã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ, kɛ mɔ ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu.
Ehi akɛ atoɔ tsui shi kpoo amɛɔ Yehowa yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.
Ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ etereɔ ekɔŋtso lɛ yɛ eblahiiaŋ.
Kɛji awo kɔŋtso lɛ atere lɛ, ekome eta shi, ni efee dioo.
Eba ehe shi kpoo, ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ̃ aaahi shi.
Agbala etoiiaŋ ma, ni abɔ lɛ ahora kpɔtɔɔ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shɛɛɛ mɔ efɔ̃ɔɔ kɛyaaa naanɔ; ejaakɛ ehãa mɔ he jaraa lɛ moŋ, kɛ̃lɛ emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ suɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ hewɔ.
Jeee esuɔmɔnaa ji akɛ ehã gbɔmɔ he ajara lɛ, asaŋ akɛ efee gbɔmɔ nidɔɔnii.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le kɛji wɔsusumai etɔ bahao tamɔ gboklɛfoi ni yɔɔ kpabui amli.
Ele kɛji aye mɔ ko toikɔdɔmɔ sane; Kɛji atsɔ̃ mɔ ko sane hiɛ abu shi lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le.
Namɔ efã ni eba mli pɛŋ akɛ ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eŋmɛ gbɛ dã?
Ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ daaŋ ejeɔ?
Mɛni hewɔ gbɔmɔ gbigbliɔ emli kɛji agbala etoi yɛ ehe eshai ahewɔ lɛ?
Nyɛhãa wɔtaoa wɔjeŋba mli wɔkwɛa koni wɔkpale kɛba Yehowa ŋɔɔ.
Nyɛhãa wɔgbelea wɔtsuii amli ni wɔholea wɔniji anɔ wɔhãa Nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ni wɔkɛhã akɛ, “Wɔtɔ̃, ni wɔtse atua, ni, Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛfako wɔ.
“Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, ni onyiɛ wɔsɛɛ, ni ogbe wɔ ni mɔbɔnalɛ bɛ mli.
Okɛ mlifu ha ohe, koni faikpamɔ ko akanyɛ egbu kɛtsɔ̃ mli kɛbashɛ oŋɔɔ.
Ohã wɔtsɔ̃ kponɔ muji kɛ tumo yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
“Wɔhenyɛlɔi fɛɛ miibɔ wɔ ahora; ni amɛmiijɛ wɔ.
Wɔyoyoro, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ osharãi amli wɔtswia shi, ni wɔnibii ahiɛ ekpãtã kɛho.
“Mihiŋmɛi miifɔse yaafonu tamɔ faa yɛ mimaŋbii ahiɛ ni ekpãtã lɛ ahewɔ.
“Mihiŋmɛiŋ yaafonu baaho daa, ni efɔŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Yehowa aaajɛ ŋwɛi ema ehiɛ shi ekwɛ wɔ.
Miyeɔ hejaramɔ kɛji mina sane ni eye mimaŋ oblayei lɛ.
“Mɛi ni nyɛɔ mi yakatswaa lɛ gbɔbi mi, tamɔ agbɔbiɔ loofɔlɔ.
Amɛshɛ mi, hiɛkãalɔ, amɛfɔ̃ bu mli ni amɛkɛ tɛi shwie minɔ!
Nu su miyi, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘milaaje’.
“Ao!
Yehowa, mijɛ bu lɛ shishi tɔ̃ɔ mibo mitsɛ bo, ni onu mifaikpamɔ lɛ.
‘Kaakɛɛ akɛ obooo mibolɔmɔ kɛhã yelikɛbuamɔ lɛ toi.’ Be ni mitsɛ bo lɛ, otsi obɛŋkɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei!’ “Ao!
Yehowa, otsu misane lɛ he nii ohã mi; ohere miyiwala.
Ao!
Yehowa, ona sane fɔŋ ni akɛye mi lɛ, ye misane lɛ ohã mi.
Ona owele ni amɛtɔ kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.
“Ao!
Yehowa, onu ahora ni amɛbɔɔ mi lɛ, kɛ yiŋshai fɛɛ ni amɛto yɛ mihe lɛ.
Gbi muu fɛɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔi lɛ anaabu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwere minɔ.
Naa, leebileebi jenamɔ fɛɛ lɛ mi ji amɛdaaŋ kotsa.
“Ao!
Yehowa, feemɔ amɛ otse, yɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii lɛ anaa.
Kaahã amɛmii shɛ amɛhe; oloomɔ akã amɛnɔ.
Ao!
Yehowa, okɛ mlifu atiu amɛ, ni okpãtã amɛhiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Yerusalɛm fitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ sane Kwɛ bɔ ni shika edĩ tuŋŋ; bɔ ni shika ŋmiiŋmi etsake ehã!
Agbɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ashwã gbɛjegbɛ fɛɛ gbɛjegbɛ koŋ.
Zion, oblahii ni ajara wa tamɔ shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ.
Ŋaŋgbei tete hãa amɛbii fufɔ amɛkɛlɛɔ amɛ; shi mimaŋbii lɛ ayitsoŋ wa; amɛwaa amɛbii ayi, amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ okpɔŋɔloofɔlɔ̃.
Gbekɛ fufɔoo sɛŋ gbiɔ kɛ kumai; gbekɛbii baa niyenii, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko hãaa amɛ.
Mɛi ni ye amɛnaa nii lɛ, ahiɛ ekpãtã yɛ blohuiaŋ; mɛi ni alɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔle lɛ jwere tumo nɔ lamlu mli.
Ejaakɛ mimaŋbii ahe esha lɛ da fe Sodom he esha lɛ, Sodom ni abutu lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa mli ni gbɔmɔ adesa nine bɛ mli lɛ.
Ebladei lɛ ahe tse keŋkeŋ, amɛyɛɔ fe ayilɔ, amɛgbɔmɔtsei yɛ hewalɛ fe teŋɛ̃lɛo, amɛhe fɛo tamɔ safiro.
Shi agbɛnɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ miidi fe ŋai, ni ayooo amɛ yɛ blohuiaŋ; amɛheloo egbi ekpɛtɛ amɛwui ahe, heloo lɛ egbi keketee tamɔ tso.
Mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ ta lɛ mli lɛ anɔ hi kwraa fe mɛi ni gboɔ yɛ hɔmɔ naa lɛ, fe mɛi ni ŋmɔshi nibaanii ni amɛnaaa amɛye ni no hã amɛtã loo ni amɛpiŋ lɛ.
Be ni akpãtãa mimaŋbii ahiɛ lɛ, yeifɔyei ni yɔɔ musuŋtsɔlɛ tete hoo amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusuŋbii amɛye.
Yehowa gri kɛ mlila ni naa wa ni efã emlifu lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ eshwie Zion nɔ; ni eshã maŋ lɛ kɛmɔ eshishitoo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Je lɛ mli maŋtsɛmɛi heee yeee, ni gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ hu heee yeee, akɛ henyɛlɔ ko aaanyɛ Yerusalɛm agboi amli ebote.
Shi eba mli, ejaakɛ Yerusalɛm gbalɔi lɛ fee esha, ni esɔfoi lɛ fee nɔ fɔŋ; amɛshwie jalɔi ala shi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Amɛfo shi kɛnyiɛ blohui lɛ amli tamɔ shwilafoi.
Lá ewu amɛhe kpɔtɔɔ bɔ sɔŋŋ ni mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ amɛtadei ahe eta.
Mɛi bolɔɔ woɔ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjea jɛi!
Nyɛmɛi ni he tseee!
Nyɛjea jɛi!
Nyɛjea jɛi!
Nyɛkataa nɔ ko he!” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi, ni majimajianɔbii kɛɛkɛɛ yɛ amɛteiaŋ akɛ, “Amɛkahi wɔteŋ dɔŋŋ!” Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã, ni ebuuu amɛhe akɔntaa dɔŋŋ; ebuuu osɔfoi lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ehiɛ esɔɔɔ onukpai lɛ hu dɔŋŋ.
Wɔhiŋmɛi shiu kɛ yaka yelikɛbuamɔ gbɛ ni wɔkwɛɔ lɛ; wɔbu, ni wɔkwɛ jaku ko ni nyɛɛɛ wɔ ehere gbɛ.
Henyɛlɔi wɔɔ wɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔblohuiaŋ tete wɔnyiɛ.
Wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ, gbii lɛ etã; ejaakɛ wɔnaagbee lɛ eshɛ.
Mɛi ni nyiɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ ahe yɛ oya fe okropɔŋ; amɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni amɛwo wɔ ka yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
Mɔ dɛŋ ni wɔwala yɔɔ, ni ji maŋtsɛ ni Yehowa efɔ lɛ mu lɛ; amɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ ŋaa mli.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni wɔkɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Yɛ lɛ eshishi lɛ, wɔɔhi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ” lɛ.
Edombii kɛ Uzbii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nyɛmli afilia nyɛ, ni nyɛnyaa, shi moŋ nyɛ hu amanehulu miiba.
Nyɛaatɔ dãa, ni nyɛaajie nyɛyayaiaŋ nyɛfɔ̃ shi.
Ao!
Zion, agbe otoigbalamɔ yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ naa.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ haŋ ohi nomŋɔɔ mli dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ bo Edom, ebaagbala otoi yɛ onishaianii lɛ ahewɔ; ebaahã ohe eshai lɛ abakã kpo nɔ.
Mɔbɔnalɛ he sɔlemɔ Ao!
Yehowa, kaimɔ nɔ ni eba wɔnɔ lɛ; kwɛmɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ eshwie shi!
Wɔgboshinii etsɔ̃ gbɔi anɔ, ni wɔshĩai eyaje gbɔi adɛŋ nɛɛ.
Wɔtsɔ̃mɔ awusãi, wɔbɛ tsɛmɛi, ni wɔnyɛmɛi etsɔ̃mɔ okulafoi.
Nu ni wɔnuɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shika heɔ, ni lai hu ni wɔshãa lɛ, ja wɔhe.
Ataa wɔkuɛ nɔ kɛ nitsumɔ, ni etɔ wɔ, shi ahãaa wɔ mumɔhe.
Daaŋŋmãa hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔhe hã Ijipt kɛ Asiria.
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fee esha, ni amɛho amɛtee; ni wɔ moŋ amɛsɔ̃ ebatere wɔ.
Wɔnyɔji miiye wɔnɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni kpɔ̃ɔ wɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔgbelɔi hiɛ klante yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ wɔwala shwɛɔ asɔ dani wɔnaa nii wɔyeɔ.
Hɔmɔ ni yeɔ wɔ lɛ naawalɛ ehã wɔhe edɔ tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli.
Ato yei lɛ kabonaa yɛ Zion, ni Yuda oblayei froi lɛ hu ato amɛ kabonaa.
Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsɛŋɔ maŋ lumɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ eshwieee onukpai ahiɛiaŋ.
Anyɛɔ oblahii anɔ ni amɛwiɛɔ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ tamɔ nyɔji; ni gbekɛbii hii didãa yɛ lai kei ni amɛtereteree ashishi.
Hiimeji ekpa koishi yaa, ni oblahii hu ekpa amɛsaŋkutswaa.
Wɔtsuiiaŋ miishɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ efo, ni joo ni wɔjoɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ ŋkɔmɔyeli.
Wɔnunyam akekre eje wɔyitso egbee shi.
Kpoo hã wɔ!
Ejaakɛ wɔfee esha.
Wɔtsui ekumɔ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ wɔhiŋmɛii anɔ efee tuutuu.
Ejaakɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃.
Jɛi etsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashikpaahe.
Shi Ao!
Yehowa, bo lɛ bo ji maŋtsɛ kɛyaa naanɔ; omaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɛ kɛjɛ yinɔ kɛyaa yinɔi fɛɛ.
Mɛɛba ohiɛ aaakpa wɔnɔ kɛya naanɔ?
Mɛɛba ni okwa wɔ be babaoo nɛkɛ?
Ani okaiŋ wɔ kwraa dɔŋŋ?
Ao!
Yehowa, kpalemɔ wɔ kɛba oŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni wɔɔkpale lɛɛlɛŋ.
Daimɔ wɔblema shihilɛ lɛ ohã wɔ!
Aloo okwa wɔ kwrakwra?
Ani omli efu wɔ waa fe nine?
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Ezekiel hi shi yɛ nomŋɔɔ mli yɛ Babilon.
Eyɛ jɛi dani afite Yerusalɛm yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo mli; ni no sɛɛ hu ehi shi yɛ jɛi.
Ezekiel gbalɛ lɛ mli lɛ ekɛ Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom ni yɔɔ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mɛi hu ni eshwɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ fɛɛ wie.
Wolo nɛɛ hiɛ mlijai ejwɛ.
.
Ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala amɛtoi, ni abaafite Yerusalɛm hu.
.
Gbalɛ ni jɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ akɛ abaagbala maji srɔtoi ni wa Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ayi, ni asaŋ amɛhã amɛdu gbɛ lɛ atoi.
.
Israel miishɛjemɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm fitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ, kɛ wɔsɛɛ ko hiɛnɔkãmɔ kpakpa ni yɔɔ hã amɛ lɛ he.
.
Gbalɔ lɛ ninaa ni kɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ Israel maŋ lɛ saamɔ he.
Gbalɔ Ezekiel ji mɔ ko ni eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli kple, ni ejwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔ jogbaŋŋ hu.
Nibii ni ena yɛ eninai lɛ amli lɛ, ekɛ mfonirii srɔtoi tsɔ̃ɔ naa faŋŋ.
Oti ni Ezekiel ma nɔ mi waa ji akɛ, ehia akɛ ana tsuitsakemɔ kɛ mumɔ hee; asaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai ahe nyɔmɔwoo ebaana.
Egba hu akɛ eyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ abaatee Israel maŋ lɛ shi ekoŋŋ.
Akɛni gbalɔ kɛ osɔfo fɛɛ ji Ezekiel hewɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he sane kã etsui nɔ, ni ema krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ hu nɔ mi.
Mlijaramɔi Ezekiel tsɛmɔ .—.
Yerusalɛm fitemɔ lɛ he gbalɛ .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ baagbla jeŋmaji lɛ atoi .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ wo ewebii lɛ ashi .—.
Gog he gbalɛ .—.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he ninaa .—.
EZEKIEL NA NYƆŊMƆ KLƐŊKLƐŊ YƐ NINAA MLI Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni miyɔɔ nomii lɛ ateŋ yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ, agbele ŋwɛi naa, ni mina Nyɔŋmɔ he ninai.
Nakai nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be mli ni Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakin eye afii enumɔ yɛ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi, osɔfo Ezekiel, Busi bi lɛ, wie yɛ Babilon yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi minɔ yɛ jɛi.
Be ni mikwɛɔ lɛ, naa, ahum ko ni naa wa fã kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ehewɔ fɛɛ miikpɛlɛ, ni la miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram kɛmiijɛ mli, nɔ ko tamɔ akɔɔble ni miitso yɛ la lɛ mli.
Ni mina nibii ejwɛ komɛi yɛ ahum lɛ mli, amɛhiɛ gbɔmɔ su.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ hiɛi ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ, kɛ fiji hu ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ.
Amɛniji ja trɔmɔɔ, amɛnanetokotai tamɔ tsina koklotoi; ni amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he.
Amɛyɛ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji ashishi yɛ amɛŋmawuiaŋ ejwɛ lɛ; ni amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ, bɔ ni amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛ amɛfiji lɛ yɔɔ nɛ: Amɛfiji lɛ eko kɛ eko kpeɔ; kɛ amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Bɔ ni amɛhiɛi yɔɔ nɛ: amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ yɛ ehiɛgbɛ; eninejurɔ hiɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ ni; ni ebɛku hiɛ lɛ, tsina hiɛ; ni esɛɛ hiɛ lɛ, okropɔŋ hiɛ.
Amɛgbɛ amɛfiji amli kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ, ni fiji lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko saa enaanyo nɔ he; ni amɛyɛ fiji enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ hu; ni nomɛi lɛ amɛkɛ hahaa amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahe.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ lɛ kwɛɔ hei srɔtoi ejwɛ shi kome; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛyaa amɛhiɛ tɛ̃ɛ shi kome; ni he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ, jɛi amɛyaa; ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Agbɛnɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ ŋai la ni miitso yɛ nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ateŋ, tuuŋtu, ni enyiɛ amɛteŋ kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ kɔti ni miitso; la lɛ kpɛmɔ naa wa, ni srawa gbalaa kɛjɛɔ la lɛ mli.
Nibii nɛɛ ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ shaa foi kɛyaa kɛbaa tamɔ srawa.
Agbɛnɛ be ni mikwɛɔ nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ, mina kokolontoi ejwɛ mamɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nii lɛ amasɛi, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ ekome.
Bɔ ni afee kokolontoi lɛ nɛ.
Kɛ okwɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛtamɔ ojarawatɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram oookɛɛ ashwishwɛ.
Amɛyi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ henɔ kome.
Ni bɔ ni afee amɛ lɛ tamɔ kokolonto ni hɔ kokolonto mli.
Kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ lɛ amɛnyiɛɔ kɛyaa amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ eko nɔ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Gai yɛ kokolontoi ejwɛ lɛ ahe, asaŋ gai lɛ eyimɔ tɔ kɛ hiŋmɛii ni bɔle amɛhe fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ; ni kɛji amɛhole amɛhenɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu ehole amɛhe nɔ.
Akɛni nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ mumɔ yɛ kokolontoi lɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni mumɔ lɛ yaa lɛ jɛi amɛyaa, ni amɛkɛ kokolontoi lɛ holeɔ amɛhenɔ shi kome.
Kɛji nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu fɛɛ nyiɛɔ; ni kɛji amɛwa lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ hu waa.
Shi kɛji amɛhole amɛhe nɔ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, koklolontoi lɛ hu holeɔ amɛhe nɔ kɛjeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ, nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su lɛ mumɔ lɛ yɛ koklolontoi lɛ hu amli.
Nɔ ko ni alɛɛ mli akete nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ayiteŋ, eha shi tamɔ ŋwɛi, ni ekpɛlɛɔ nyramnyram tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
Nɛkɛ nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su nɛɛ ekpã amɛfiji amli trɔmɔɔ yɛ nɔ ni ha shi lɛ shishi, fine kɛ fine miikpe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ fiji enyɔ ni ekɛha egbɔmɔtso he.
Kɛji amɛmiifliki lɛ minuɔ ni amɛfijiaŋ miigbɛɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; asaŋ etamɔ ta mli hoofeemɔ jijemɔ lɛ: etamɔ Ofe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ gbee.
Kɛ amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfiji lɛ baa shi.
Kɛji amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi, ni amɛba amɛfiji lɛ ashi lɛ, gbee ko gbɛɔ kɛjɛɔ atatu ni yɔɔ amɛyiteŋ lɛ mli.
Nɔ ko ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni esu tamɔ safiro ojarawatɛ ma nɔ lɛ ni ha shi lɛ yiteŋ.
Ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ su ta nɔ ni tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ.
Mina akɛ kɛjɛ he ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛyaa eŋwɛigbɛ lɛ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ akɔɔble; ekpɛlɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la ni ebɔ tɔo.
Mina hu akɛ kɛjɛ nɔ ni tamɔ ehɛ lɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ lɛ tamɔ la.
Ehewɔ fɛɛ etse haŋŋ.
Bɔ ni anaa kwaabuɛtɛ su kɛji efo yɛ atatuiaŋ yɛ nunɛmɔ be mli lɛ, nakai ehe ni ekpɛ haŋŋ lɛ yɔɔ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa anunyam su yɔɔ nɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ Ezekiel koni efe gbalɔ Ni be ni mina enɛ lɛ miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, kɛkɛ ni minu mɔ ko gbee ni miiwie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tee shi odamɔ shi, mikɛ bo baawie.” Be ni ekɛ mi wie lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ bote mimli, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni minu ni ekɛ mi miiwie.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, miitsu bo Israelbii, ni ji maŋ atuatselɔi ni etse mihiɛ atua lɛ, aŋɔɔ.
Amɛ kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ etɔ̃ minɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti, ni amɛbuuu mi hu.
Miitsu bo amɛŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ nɛ; ni akɛni toigbolɔi ji amɛ nɛɛ, amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, amɛaana amɛle kɛ̃ akɛ gbalɔ ko ebahi amɛteŋ.’ ‘Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa, kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaashe amɛwiemɔi lɛ hu gbeyei.
Eyɛ mli akɛ oyɛ ŋmei kɛ kpitikpitii ateŋ, ni ota nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, kaashe amɛdaaŋ wiemɔi gbeyei ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni.
Bo lɛ ŋɔɔ miwiemɔ lɛ ohã amɛ; amɛbo toi jio, amɛbooo toi jio, na ole akɛ toigbolɔi ji amɛ.’ ” “Shi, bo gbɔmɔ adesa, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo lɛ toi; kaafee ohe toigbolɔ tamɔ nakai toigbolɔi amaŋbii lɛ; gbɛɛ odaaŋ ni oye nɔ ni mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ.” Ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina nine ni akpã mli ni hiɛ wolokpo ni aŋma nii yɛ mli ni akɛmiihã mi.
Egbele mli elɛɛ shi yɛ mihiɛ.
Aŋma nii yɛ ehiɛ kɛ esɛɛ fɛɛ; ni aŋma yaafo kɛ awerɛho kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli wiemɔi yɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, nɔ ni akɛhã bo lɛ ye; ye wolokpo nɛɛ, ni oya ni okɛ Israel we lɛ ayawie.” Kɛkɛ ni migbɛ midaaŋ, ni ekɛ wolokpo lɛ hã mi ni maye.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, ye wolokpo ni mikɛhã bo lɛ; ye, ni okɛwo omusu obɔ̃ tɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni miye; ni eŋɔɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, yiŋ ni oya Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ ni okɛ miwiemɔ lɛ ayahã amɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi aŋɔɔ ni mitsuɔ bo lɛ, amɛjeee mɛi ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ko ni wa; shi moŋ miitsu bo Israelbii aŋɔɔ.
Amɛjeee majimaji babaoo ni wieɔ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔ ni wa, ni onuuu shishi.
Anɔkwa, kɛji nakai gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ tete po mitsu bo lɛ, amɛaabo bo toi.
Shi Israel we lɛ boŋ bo toi, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛboɔ mi toi; ejaakɛ Israelbii lɛ akuɛŋ ti ni amɛtsui hu wa.
Naa, mihã ohiɛ etsii hu fe amɛhiɛ, ni ohiɛ hu ewa fe amɛhiɛ.
Bɔ ni daiamɔnd wa fe tswɛrɛbo lɛ, nakai mihã ohiɛ ewa fe amɛhiɛ.
Kaashe amɛ gbeyei, ni kaahã hiŋmɛi ni amɛkɛbaakwɛ bo lɛ miihao bo; ejaakɛ atuatselɔi amaŋ ni.” Gbee lɛ saa ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, bo miwiemɔi fɛɛ ni mikɛ bo wieɔ lɛ toi, ni okɛto otsuiŋ.
Agbɛnɛ yi mli ni oya omaŋbii ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.
Amɛbo bo toi jio, amɛbooo bo toi jio bo lɛ okɛɛ amɛ.’ ” Agbɛnɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko gbɛɛmɔ yɛ misɛɛgbɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ, ni gbee lɛ kɛɛ, “Jiemɔ miijie Yehowa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ anunyam lɛ yi yɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ.” Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su lɛ afiji ni saa eko kɛ eko he lɛ agbɛɛmɔ kɛ kokolontoi ni yɔɔ amɛŋmawuiaŋ lɛ amli gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hu tamɔ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ kpeteŋkple.
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ewo mi kɛtee.
Mitee kɛ mlila ni naawa naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni miba nomii ni yɔɔ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Tel-Abib lɛ aŋɔɔ; ni miho mita shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni minaa ekpɛ mihe gbii kpawo sɔŋŋ.
Yehowa to Ezekiel bulɔ Gbii kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ; ni be fɛɛ be ni ooonu minaa wiemɔ lɛ, obɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ohã mi.
“Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, gbo ooogbo, ni obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni osaa owieee otsɔ̃ɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ ni eje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, koni ehere eyiwala lɛ, nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ baagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ.
Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ, ni ekpaaa efɔŋ lɛ feemɔ, ni ejeee egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ mli nɛ, shi bo lɛ ohere oyiwala.
“Miikɛ bo ekoŋŋ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ni feɔ nɔ ni ja kpa ejalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni efee nɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, ni mito lɛ pampi lɛ, ebaagbo; ejaakɛ obɔɔɔ lɛ kɔkɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ ehe esha lɛ hewɔ, ni ejalɛ nii ni efee pɛŋ lɛ akaiŋ; shi elá lɛ, bo odɛ̃ŋ mabi shi yɛ.
“Shi kɛ̃lɛ, kɛji obɔ mɔ ni feɔ jalɛ nii lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekafee esha, ni efeee esha lɛ, no lɛ eyi baana wala ejaakɛ ebo kɔkɔbɔɔ toi, ni bo hu ohere oyiwala.” Ezekiel baatɔ mu Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni jɛi mikɛ bo aya wie yɛ.” Hewɔ lɛ mite shi ni mitee jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ ni tamɔ anunyam ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Shi Mumɔ lɛ babote mimli ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni ekɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaŋa oyi owo owe lɛ.
Ni bo, gbɔmɔ adesa naa, akɛ kpãi baashwie onɔ ni akɛfi bo, koni okanyɛ oje kpo otee mɛi ateŋ.
Asaŋ mahã olilɛi akpɛtɛ odaaŋ, ni otɔ mu bɔ ni afee ni okanyɛ okã amɛ; tsɛbelɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.
Shi kɛji mikɛ bo bawie ekoŋŋ lɛ, magbele onaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ: Mɔ ni sumɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ebo toi, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ enu lɛ, ekabo toi; ejaakɛ toigbolɔi amaŋbii ji amɛ.’ ”
Ezekiel fee ehe tamɔ Yerusalɛm tualɔ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ adesa, kɔ ntayaa ni okɛfɔ ohiɛ, ni otɛŋ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yɛ nɔ.
Tɛŋmɔ nibii nɛɛ kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe: kawoo gbogbo kɛ mɔji kɛ kpoku kɛ tabilɔi ni baatua maŋ lɛ, kɛ gbogbokuumɔ nibii ni mamɔ he.
Okɛ dade ni atswia lɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ afee gbogbo koni efo bo okɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ; ni ojie ohiɛ oka lɛ.
Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ atua maŋ lɛ, ni bo otuaa maŋ lɛ nɛɛ.
Enɛ ji okadi hã Israelbii lɛ.
“Agbɛnɛ kã obɛku nɔ, ni okɛ Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔ lɛ aŋmɛ onɔ ni gbii abɔ ni okã obɛku nɔ lɛ obaatere amɛtɔmɔ lɛ.
Miiŋɔ amɛ afii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu toigbalamɔ be lɛ mafee gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu mahã bo.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ obaatere Israelbii lɛ atɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Kɛ ogbe nakai gbii lɛ anaa lɛ, obaakã shi ekoŋŋ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, agbɛnɛ lɛ kã oninejurɔ nɔ, ni okɛtere Yuda we lɛ tɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Mihao gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ni okɛkã shi, ni gbi kome lɛ afi ni.
“Jiemɔ ohiɛ oka Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ; ni ojie onine he efolo koni ogba oshi lɛ.
Mikɛ kpãi baafimɔ bo akpɛtɛ shi, ni onyɛŋ ohe otsɔ̃ kɛjɛ abɛku nɔ kɛya ninejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi be ni ooogbe okawoo gbii lɛ anaa dã.
“Agbɛnɛ, ŋɔɔ ŋmãa kɛ akoko kɛ akpatramɔ kɛ yɔɔ kɛ blɔfoakoko kɛ abele, ni okɛwo nɔ kome mli, ni okɛshã aboloo ohã ohe.
Ye aboloo nɛɛ be ni okã obɛku nɔ gbii ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu lɛ.
Oniyenii ni obaaye lɛ ŋmɛɛ kiloi nyɔŋmai enyɔ gbi kome; ye nii shi kome daa gbi.
Ni nu hu ni obaanu lɛ susumɔ kpuji enyɔ; nuu nu shi kome daa gbi.
Ni okɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ afee lai ni okɛshã akoko aboloo lɛ, ni oye yɛ amɛhiɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai pɛ Israelbii lɛ baaye amɛniyenii ni amɛhiɔ lɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei, ni mashwie amɛ kɛya lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mibuleko mihe dã, kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ aahu kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Miyeko nɔ ko ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbo loo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ dã.
Asaŋ hu loo ko ni ahiɔ esako minaa dã.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, mahã okɛ tsina wamɔ ashã oboloo lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ wamɔ najiaŋ.” Esaa ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mahã niyenii he asɛ̃ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛkɛ tsuiyeli baaŋmɛ aboloo amɛye, ni amɛkɛ hejaramɔ baasusu nu amɛnu.
Mafee enɛ koni aboloo kɛ nu he ahia amɛ, ni amɛbaakwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ, ni amɛaatãra loo yɛ amɛtoigbalamɔ mli.”
Ezekiel ku eyi Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ klante ni naa ba ni okɛfee yikulɔi asooyi, ni okɛshɛ oyi kɛ otsɛŋ.
Agbɛnɛ kɔ nsɛni ni oŋmɛ tsɔi lɛ yɛ nsɛni mli, ni oja mli etɛ̃.
Mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, shãa yɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, be ni agbe kawoo gbii lɛ anaa lɛ.
Kɔ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome hu ni okɛ klante afolɔ mli dukuduku be ni obɔleɔ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe lɛ; ni okɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni eshwɛ lɛ ashwã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli, ni magbala klante kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ.
Ŋɔɔ yitsɔi lɛ fioo ko kɛkɛ ni okɛŋmɔ otade lɛ naa.
Ŋɔɔ no nɔŋŋ mli eko ni oshɛrɛ oshwie la lɛ mli ni oshã.
La baajɛ enɛ mli ebote Israel we lɛ fɛɛ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Yerusalɛm nɛ; mikɛ lɛ ema majimaji ateŋ, ni shikpɔji krokomɛi ebɔle he kɛkpe.
Yerusalɛm eku mimlai lɛ amli fe majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ; eku mimlai wuji lɛ hu amli fe shikpɔji krokomɛi ni bɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ.
Ekwa mimlai lɛ ni eyeee mikpɔi lɛ hu anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, “Nyɛfeɔ basabasa fe majimaji krokomɛi ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ, ni nyɛyeee akpɔi kɛ mlai ni miwo nyɛ lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛye jeŋmaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ lɛ, hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛ bo ena, mi magbala otoi yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ.
Musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mafee bo nɔ ko ni mifeko dã, ni asaŋ mifeŋ enɔ eko dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, tsɛmɛi baagbe amɛbii amɛye yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni bihii baagbe amɛtsɛmɛi amɛye; magbala nyɛtoi!
Hiɛkãalɔi ni baashwɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
“Asaŋ gbii abɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛni okɛ taŋtaŋnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ ebule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ makpãtã ohiɛ; mikuŋ mihiɛ mifɔŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko nɔ; ni minaŋ bo mɔbɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ baaplene oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome yɛ omli, mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ maŋ lɛ sɛɛ; ni oyikulɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ni mafã klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Bɔ ni mimlifu naa aaawa ahã nɛ, ni mimli baawo amɛ la waa; ni matɔ mihe owele; koni amɛna amɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie yɛ miwuŋayeli naa, be ni mimli fu amɛ waa lɛ.
Asaŋ mahã otsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ ahorabɔɔ nɔ yɛ majimaji ni bɔle bo lɛ ateŋ, kɛ mɛi hu ni hoɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
“Kɛ mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila kojo bo lɛ, magbala otoi, ni oootsɔ̃ ahorabɔɔ nɔ kɛ heguɔgbee nɔ kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɔ kɛ hejɔ̃mɔ nɔ ohã jeŋmaji ni bɔle ohe kɛkpe lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.
Be ni mikɛ hɔmɔ aaakpãtã ohiɛ tamɔ gãimlibii ni atsɛ̃rɛ kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ, no ni hɔmɔ aaaye bo waa, mi mafo nyɛniyenii namɔ sɛɛ.
Mibahã hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuyelɔi aba nyɛnɔ ni amɛaakpakpaa obii lɛ yɛ ohe kɛya, ni gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ hu aaaba, ni mikɛ ta aaabakpãtã ohiɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Yehowa miihi wɔŋjamɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ, Nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ toi.
Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi kɛ nujɔi kɛ jɔi voovoi lɛ nɛ.
Naa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mafã klante mawo nyɛ, ni mafite nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ.
Nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei aaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aaakumɔ nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ.
Mashɛrɛ nyɛmɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ mashwie nyɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ.” Mikɛ Israelbii lɛ agbohii lɛ aaashwie amɛwɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni magbɛ gbohii lɛ awui lɛ mashwã nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Hei fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ nyɛmaji lɛ aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni aaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi kɛ nyɛjamɔhei grɔŋgrɔŋŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, abaafite nyɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ baakpãtã.
Abaakumɔ nyɛmãgãi lɛ, ni abaakpãtã hiɛ, ni nyɛtsofakɛŋma afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, abaakumɔ, ni nyɛnitsumɔi lɛ abaagu.
Mɛi aaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa yɛ nyɛteŋ.
No nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji, Yehowa.
“Shi mashwɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hiɛkãalɔi.
Nyɛaana mɛi komɛi ni eje klante naa gbele mli yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Kɛji agbɛ nyɛ ashwã majimaji lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi ni eje gbele mli lɛ aaakai mi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ hei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee lɛ.
Kɛji mikumɔ amɛyiŋ flɛflɛ tsuii ni hã amɛkɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ yanyiɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, amɛaanyaŋe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
No dani amɛaana amɛle lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, jeee wiemɔ folo kɛkɛ miwie akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ lɛ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Tswaa odɛ̃ ni okɛ onane ashi shi, ni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kpoo ha Israel we lɛ yɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii fɔ̃ji lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela naa.’ Mɔ ni yɔɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ gbele hela baagbe lɛ, ni mɔ ni bɛŋkɛ hu baagbo yɛ klante naa, ni mɔ ni abaa eyi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu, hɔmɔ baagbe lɛ.
Bɔ ni mimlifu ni naawa lɛ baatsu amɛhe nii kɛyata nɛ.
Ni nyɛaana nyɛle mi, akɛ mi ji Yehowa, be ni nyɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ jwere nyɛwɔji lɛ ateŋ yɛ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛkpe; ekomɛi aaajwere gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ nɔ, kɛ gɔji fɛɛ ayiteiaŋ hu, kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni ebu kusuu shishi, kɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso fɛɛ blɔfo oduŋ tso kusuu shishi; he fɛɛ he ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amɛwɔji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ lɛ mɛi aaajwere jɛi.
Mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ yɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ fiaa kwa, ni mafite amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛjɛ shiaŋa ni yɔɔ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ kɛyaashi Ribla yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ; no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Israel naagbee ebɛŋkɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Israel gɔji lɛ ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, mikɛɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɛ: Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ naagbee lɛ eshɛ!
Shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee lɛ eshɛ etã.
Naagbee lɛ ebanina bo, ni majie mimlifu lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ bo agbɛnɛ, ni makojo bo yɛ ojeŋba naa; ni magbala otoi yɛ omusubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ hewɔ.
Bei abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, amanehulu nyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ kɛmiiba.
Naa eeba, naagbee lɛ eshɛ; naagbee lɛ eba kɛ̃, eshɛ etã, ete shi ewo bo.
Naa eeba.
Naa eeba!
Nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii nyɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ enina nyɛ!
Be lɛ eshɛ; gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, gbi ni abaanu bolɔmɔ, ni ejeee miishɛɛ bolɔmɔ, shi moŋ hejaramɔ bolɔmɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
“Agbɛnɛ etsɛŋ ni mafɔse mimlila lɛ mashwie onɔ, ni mafã mimlifu kɛ eshishi fɛɛ mashwie onɔ, ni magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba naa, ni mikɛ bo aaaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ omusubɔɔ nibii lɛ fia ahewɔ.
Be abɔ ni nyɛmusubɔɔ nibii lɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mihiŋmɛi baakã nyɛhe, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi magbala otoi yɛ ojeŋba hewɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa ni tswaa mɔ nɔ lɛ.
Naa, gbi lɛ nɛ!
Naa, eeba!
Ohiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli egba afofro; ni hewoo hu egba ahwanya.
Yitsoŋwalɛ eda aahu esa etsɔ̃ dade.
Amɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛninamɔ kɛ amɛnunyam fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko eshwɛŋ.
Be lɛ eshɛ, gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Nihelɔ akanya, ni nihɔɔlɔ lɛ hu akaye ŋkɔmɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nɔ.
