Jarayelɔ ko ni yɔɔ wala mli lolo lɛ eyaŋ nɔ ni ehɔ̃ɔ lɛ he dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kã asafo mu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu nɛɛ ekpaleŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hereŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala yɛ nishaianii ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Akpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, afee kralo hu atã; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko eyaaa ta lɛ, ejaakɛ mimli efu asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ.” Israel maŋ lɛ he eshai ahenyɔmɔwoo “Aawuu yɛ gbɛjegbɛi anɔ, gbele hela kɛ hɔmɔ yɛ shĩa mli; mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ nyɔɔ yɛ klante naa; mɔ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela kpãtãa ehiɛ.
Shi kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaaje mli lɛ, amɛaayahi gɔji lɛ anɔ tamɔ okpoi ni jɛ jɔɔ mli.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baaye ehe esha he ŋkɔmɔ.
Nijiaŋ fɛɛ tswɛm baaje wui, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawa mli nu.
Amɛaabumɔ kpekpe, ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, amɛyiteaŋ aaakpa ni amɛhiɛ aaagboi hu.
Amɛjwiɛtɛi lɛ amɛaashɛrɛ amɛshwie blohuiaŋ, ni amɛaabu amɛshika lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni anyaŋeɔ.
Amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika lɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nomɛi haŋ amɛtɔrɔ, ni ehaŋ amɛmusu ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ.
Amɛjwinei fɛɛfɛji ni amɛkɛsaa amɛhe kɛtaoɔ yaka anunyam lɛ, amɛkɛfee amɛmusubɔɔ amãgãi kɛ nibii ni ahiɔ lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, mi, Yehowa, miha etsɔ̃ nɔ ko ni he tseee ehã amɛ.
“Mikɛ amɛnii aaawo mɛi kpɔji adɛŋ koni amɛhã; ni maha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ aŋɔ akɛ nomnii, ni amɛaabule lɛ.
Matsɔ̃ mihiɛ mato afã koni amɛbule mihe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; julɔi aaabote mli ni amɛaabule lɛ ni amɛaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
“Akɛni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni maŋ lɛ mli eyi tɔ kɛ yiwalɛ lɛ, mahã majimaji lɛ ateŋ mɛi fɔ̃ji fe fɛɛ abaŋɔ amɛshĩai lɛ amɛfee amɛnɔ.
Mibafo amɛhewalɛ ni amɛkɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ; ni aaabule amɛhei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Kɛ hejaramɔ ba lɛ amɛaatao toiŋjɔlɛ, shi amɛnaŋ eko.
Amanehulu aaanyiɛ amanehulu sɛɛ; akɛɛ akɛɛ sane aaanyiɛ akɛɛ akɛɛ sane sɛɛ.
Amɛbaabi gbalɔ lɛ ni egba amɛ ninaa, nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ tete ahiɛ lɛ, mla lɛ jeee fɛifɛi, ni onukpai lɛ wooo ŋaa kpakpa.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaaye ŋkɔmɔ.
Ni lumɔ lɛ nijiaŋ aaaje wui, ni gbeyei aaahã gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he aaakpokpo.
Bɔ ni amɛjeŋba yɔɔ lɛ nakai mikɛ amɛ baaye; ni bɔ ni amɛkojoɔ mɛi lɛ nakai makojo amɛ; ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi mi ji Yehowa.”
GBALƆ EZEKIEL NINAA NI JI ENYƆ YƐ NYƆŊMƆ HE Amãgãjamɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm Israelbii anomŋɔɔ afi ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, be ni mita miwe lɛ, ni Yuda onukpai lɛ tara mihiɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa hewalɛ yi minɔ yɛ jɛi.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, mina nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ.
Kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛbaa eshishigbɛ su lɛ anaa lɛ tamɔ la; ni kɛjɛ ehɛgbɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛigbɛ su lɛ kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he.
Ekpã nɔ ko ni esu tamɔ nine mli ni ekɛmɔ̃ miyiteŋ tsɔi ni efi tɔo lɛ mli.
Mumɔ lɛ wo minɔ kɛtee shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ekɛ mi tee Yerusalɛm yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he ninai lɛ amli.
Ekɛ mi ba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo ni kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ shinaa lɛ naa, he ni amãgã ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋã lɛ ma lɛ.
Ni naa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ jɛi tamɔ ninaa ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ kooyigbɛ.” Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni naa, afɔleshãa latɛ ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, nakai amãgã lɛ ni haa Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ awuŋã lɛ ma jɛi.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ?
Musubɔɔnii wuji ni Israelbii lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ bɔ ni afee ni maje mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛya sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji krokomɛi ni fe enɛ.” Ekɛ mi ba kpo lɛ nɔ shinaa lɛ naa, ni be ni mikwɛ lɛ mina folɔ ko yɛ gbogbo lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli.” Ni be ni migbu gbogbo lɛ mli lɛ mina shinaa ko.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Botemɔ mli ni oyakwɛ nɔ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfeɔ yɛ biɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, mibote mli ni miyakwɛ; ni mina akɛ atɛŋ waamɔnii kɛ kooloi ni ahiɔ srɔtoi abɔ, kɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ fɛɛ amɛfonirii yɛ gbogbo lɛ he kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Ni Israel we lɛ mli hii onukpai nyɔŋmai kpawo damɔ wɔji lɛ ahiɛ, ni Shafan bi Yaazania damɔ amɛteŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ etsofakɛŋmashaa ŋɛsu yɛ edɛŋ, ni tsofakɛŋma ni ashãa lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa ŋwɛi tamɔ atatu.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, oona nɔ ni Israel we lɛ onukpai lɛ feɔ yɛ dujiaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miija amãgãi yɛ esɛɛtsu mli lo?
Nɔ ni amɛkɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Yehowa enaaa wɔ.
Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ.’ ” Ekɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii krokomɛi ni fe enɛ ni amɛfeɔ.” Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa shĩa lɛ agbo lɛ shinaa ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ naa; ni naa, yei tara jɛi ni amɛmiifo jemawɔŋ Tamuz.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ?
Osaa ooona musubɔɔnii wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi.” Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba Yehowa we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ, hii aaafee nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛtsɔmɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛhã Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, be mli ni amɛhiɛiaŋ miikwɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ, amɛmiija hulu yɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ?
Ani nihiinii ni Yuda we lɛ feɔ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ lɛ efaaa ehãaa amɛ lo?
Ni amɛhã yiwalɛ eyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ kɛmiiwo mimli la amɛfata he nɛɛ lo?
Naa, amɛmaa mi gɔnti amɛjɛɔ mi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baaye kɛ joomɔ yɛ mimlifu lɛ naa.
Mihaŋ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛye; minaŋ amɛ mɔbɔ.
Amɛaabolɔ amɛwo mitoiŋ kɛ gbee ni wa shi miboŋ amɛ toi.”
Agbala Yerusalɛm toi Minu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nyɛbaa biɛ, nyɛ, maŋ blafoi; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahiɛ gbɔmɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ.” Ni naa, hii ekpaa jɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ agbo ni ye kooyigbɛ lɛ naagbɛ amɛba.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ emɔgbee dade yɛ edɛŋ.
Nuu ko hu fata amɛhe ni ewo niyɛŋ, ni etsotsoro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɛ mli.
Amɛtee mli ni amɛyadamɔ akɔɔble afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ masɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ bɔɔ nibii kɛ amɛfiji lɛ anɔ, he ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi: Etsɛ nuu lɛ ni wo niyɛŋ ni etsotsoro nɔ ko ni akɛŋmãa nii lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaakpa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ; hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ musubɔɔnii ni afeɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kadimɔ amɛhiɛnai.” Ni minu akɛ ekɛɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛkpaa maŋ lɛ mli; nyɛtswiaa mɛi anii; nyɛkakua nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔa nɔ ko nɔ, ni nyɛkanaa mɔbɔ hu.
Nyɛgbea onukpai kɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei kɛ gbekɛbii kɛ yei blublu, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni akadi ehiɛnaa lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛkataa ehe.
Nyɛjea shishi kɛjɛa mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbɔi kɛjɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbulea Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni egboi lɛ agbohii lɛ ashwiea kpoi lɛ anɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Agbɛnɛ, nyɛjea kpo!” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛbote maŋ lɛ mli amɛyatswia mɛi anii ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Be ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi lɛ ni ashi mikome too lɛ, miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi ni mibo mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ, Yehowa ani ookpãtã Israel mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ omli ni efu Yerusalɛm waa lɛ naa lo?” Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Israel kɛ Yuda efee esha kpele, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ lashishwiemɔ, ni toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli hu eyi maŋ lɛ mli obɔ̃; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ekwa shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni Yehowa enaaa wɔ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, mihaŋ mɔ ko aŋɔ ehe aye; minaŋ mɔbɔ; shi moŋ mahã amɛmusu abua amɛyiteŋ.” Ni naa, nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ, mɔ ni tsotsoro nɔ ko ni nibii ni akɛŋmãa nii yɔɔ mli lɛ, ku esɛɛ eba, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Mifee bɔ ni ofã mi lɛ.”
Yehowa anunyam lɛ je Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Agbɛnɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni naa nɔ ko pue yɛ atatu ni yɔɔ bɔɔ nibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ lɛ mli, nɔ lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi ni akɛ safiro ojarawatɛ fee.
Kɛkɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nuu lɛ ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa kokolontoi ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ashishi lɛ ateŋ ni oyakpiti ŋai ni miitso owo okɔkɔi amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni okɛshwã maŋ lɛ mli.” Ni etee yɛ mihiɛ.
Adebɔɔ nibii lɛ damɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ he ni nuu lɛ bote mli yɛ lɛ; kɛkɛ ni atatu ko yi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa anunyam lɛ kpɛmɔ lɛ wo ehe nɔ yɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ anɔ kɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni atatu lɛ yi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ obɔ̃, ni Yehowa anunyam kpɛmɔ lɛ yi kpo lɛ nɔ obɔ̃.
Anu adebɔɔ nibii lɛ afijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Ni gbɛɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbee kɛji eewie lɛ.
Be ni Yehowa fã nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyakpiti la ni yɔɔ kokolontoi lɛ ateŋ, yɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ lɛ”, etee kpo lɛ nɔ, ni eyadamɔ kokolontoi lɛ ateŋ ekome masɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ ekome kpã enine mli kɛjɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ateŋ ewo la ni yɔɔ adebɔɔ nibii ateŋ lɛ mli, ni ekpiti la lɛ eko, ni ekɛwo nuu ni bu niyɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔiaŋ; nuu lɛ he, kɛkɛ ni eje kpo.
Mina akɛ adebɔɔ nibii nɛɛ yɛ niji tamɔ gbɔmɛi aniji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi.
Mikwɛ ni mina akɛ kokolontoi ejwɛ yɛ adebɔɔ nibii lɛ ahe; kokolonto kome yɛ bɔɔnɔ kome he.
Kokolontoi lɛ ahe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ ojarawatɛ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ krisolito lɛ.
Kɛji okwɛ amɛ lɛ, kokolontoi ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ su kome, tamɔ nɔ ni eko hɔ eko mli.
Kɛji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ, amɛnyiɛɔ amɛkoji ejwɛ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko nɔ, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ ehe.
Shi moŋ koŋ fɛɛ koŋ kokolonto lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni ayaa lɛ, lɛ esɛɛ ekrokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa; ni ekrokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ amɛhe kɛji amɛmiinyiɛ.
Hiŋmɛii yɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ fɛɛ ahe: amɛkotosɛɛ kɛ amɛniji ahe kɛ amɛfiji ahe fɛɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ.
Kokolontoi ni adebɔɔ nibii ejwɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ tete ahe eyi obɔ̃ kɛ hiŋmɛii sɔŋŋ.
Ni kokolontoi lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minu kɛ mitoi akɛ atsɛ amɛ ni amɛtsɔmɔ̃ɔɔ amɛhe.
Nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɛi asu nɛɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ hiɛ lɛ tsinanuu hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji enyɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ jata hiɛ, ni hiɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okropɔŋ hiɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛhe nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛigbɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni hiɛ gbɔmɔ su ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Kɛji bɔɔ nibii lɛ miinyiɛ lɛ kokolontoi lɛ hu nyiɛɔ, ni kɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kokolontoi lɛ fɔ̃ɔ koklomɔ.
Kɛji bɔɔ nibii lɛ wa damɔ shi lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ kokolontoi lɛ hu ewa kɛdamɔ shi, kɛ amɛfliki kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ amɛkɛ kokolontoi lɛ fɛɛ yaa ŋwɛi, ejaakɛ bɔɔ nibii lɛ amumɔ yɛ amɛmli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ je Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ni eyadamɔ bɔɔ nibii lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ.
Miikwɛ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni amɛfliki kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee, ni kokolontoi lɛ kpɛtɛ amɛhe.
Amɛyadamɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi; ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ kpɛ yɛ amɛnɔ.
Nibii ni tamɔ gbɔmɛi asu ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa yɛ Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shishi lɛ nɛ; miyoo akɛ bɔɔ nibii ni.
Amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ hiɛi srɔtoi ejwɛ kɛ fiji hu ejwɛ; ni nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ niji yɛ amɛfiji lɛ ashishi.
Shi amɛhiɛi lɛ tamɔ hiɛi ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ kɛyaa ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ.
Abu Yerusalɛm fɔ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Ni naa, mina hii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ shi.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Azur bi Yaazania kɛ Benaia bi Pelatia, maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ.
Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni toɔ yiŋshai, ni amɛwoɔ ŋai gbohii yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Be ni akɛmaa tsu shɛko.
Maŋ nɛɛ tamɔ dadesɛŋ ni ma la nɔ, ni wɔji emli loo lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ yi minɔ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, ‘Nyɛ Israelbii, nakai nyɛsusuɔ; mile nibii ni nyɛsusuɔ yɛ nyɛyitseiaŋ fɛɛ.
Nyɛha mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee lɛ ayi efa yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni eblohuiaŋ eyi tɔ kɛ gbohii babaoo.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Mɛi ni nyɛgbegbee nyɛshwie maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛ ji loo lɛ, ni maŋ nɛɛ ji dadesɛŋ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, abaashwie nyɛ kɛje maŋ nɛɛ mli.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛshe klante gbeyei, shi klante nɔŋŋ mahã afa awo nyɛyi.
Mibashwie nyɛ kɛbaaje maŋ nɛɛ mli, ni mikɛ nyɛ baawo gbɔi adɛŋ, ni makojo nyɛ.
Ni klante naa nɔŋŋ nyɛanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ; makojo nyɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ husu nɔ, ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Maŋ nɛɛ tsɔŋ dadesɛŋ ehaŋ nyɛ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛtsɔŋ emli loo.
Mikɛ nyɛ baaye yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ husui lɛ fɛɛ anaa.
Ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa, ejaakɛ nyɛhiko shi yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbako nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa; shi moŋ maŋsɛɛbii ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ moŋ amlai lɛ anɔ nyɛye.” Ni eba mli akɛ be ni migbaa lɛ, Benaia bi Pelatia tswa shi egbo trukaa.
Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, ni mibo waa akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, ani obaakpãtã mɛi ni eshwɛ yɛ Israel lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ?” Nyɔŋmɔ wo nomii lɛ ashi Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ miiwie bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi, ojakubii ni ji Israelbii fɛɛ ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ ahe.
Amɛkɛɛ, ‘Nomii lɛ eyaje shɔŋŋ bɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ Yehowa amɛja.
Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ehã wɔ akɛ wɔnɔ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ nomii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, yɛŋ akɛ mijie amɛ kɛtee shɔŋŋ kɛyafutu maji krokomɛi amli bii, ni migbɛ amɛ mishwã shikpɔji anɔ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsɔ̃ teemɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋ mihã amɛ be fioo ko kɛ̃ yɛ hei ni amɛtee lɛ.” “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mikɛɛ nɛ, mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ maji amli ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ, shikpɔji hu ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba, ni maŋɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ maha amɛ.’ Ni kɛji amɛba lɛ amɛaajie taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛaaje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni mahã amɛ tsui kroko, ni mikɛ mumɔ hee baawo amɛmli; majie amɛtsui ni wa tamɔ tɛ lɛ kɛje amɛmli ni mahã amɛ loo tsui; bɔ ni afee ni amɛba amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni amɛye mimlai lɛ anɔ, koni amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
Shi mɛi ni atsui nyiɛ taŋtaŋnii kɛ musubɔɔnii asɛɛ lɛ, magbala amɛtoi, ni mahã amɛsɔ̃ abua amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiteŋ.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ je Yerusalɛm Kɛkɛ ni bɔɔ nibii lɛ hole amɛfiji anɔ, ni kokolontoi lɛ kɛ amɛ hole amɛhe nɔ, ni Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ shĩ yɛ amɛyiteŋgbɛ.
Yehowa anunyam lɛ wo ehe nɔ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ teŋ, kɛtee gɔŋ ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli akɛ Mumɔ lɛ wo mi, ni ekɛ mi tee nomii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon; kɛkɛ ni mumɔ lɛ je minɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni migba nomii lɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yehowa jie kpo tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ.
Gbalɔ lɛ yaba abo Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛi ni toi egbo ateŋ oyɔɔ lɛ; shi amɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, shi amɛnaaa nii; amɛyɛ toii hu shi amɛnuuu nii, ejaakɛ maŋ ni toi egbo ji amɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɔ adesa, too onibii tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, koni ofã shwane be ni amɛmiikwɛ bo.
Jee he ni oyɔɔ lɛ kɛya he kroko ni amɛmiikwɛ bo.
Eko lɛ amɛaakɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ sɛɛ, tsɛ, gbɔmɛi toigbolɔi ji amɛ.
Okɛ onibii ni tamɔ nomŋɔɔ jatsu lɛ aje kpo shwane yɛ amɛhiɛ; shi yi mli gbɛkɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ooya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Gbuu gbogbo lɛ mli yɛ amɛhiɛ koni otsɔ̃ jɛi kɛje kpo yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Kɛji hiɛ bu lɛ, wo ogbɛfaa jatsu lɛ otswa okɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ ni okɛje kpo.
Haa ohiɛ koni okana shikpɔŋ ni oyaa nɔ lɛ.
Mikɛ bo miito okadi mahã Israel we lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni mifee bɔ ni Yehowa fã mi lɛ.
Mikɛ minibii lɛ je kpo shwane tamɔ mɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ nom, ni gbɛkɛ mli lɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbu gbogbo lɛ mli; ni be ni hiɛ bu lɛ miwo mijatsu lɛ mitswa mikɔŋ ni mije kpo yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani Israel we lɛ, ni ji toigbolɔi awe lɛ, biko bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ lo?’ Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ gbalɛ ni; ni ekɔɔ lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, kɛ Israel we lɛ mli bii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ahe.
Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni ofee nɛɛ ji okadi hã amɛ; bɔ ni ofee otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ, nakai abaafee amɛ; abaaŋɔ amɛ nom, ni amɛbaatsɔmɔ nomii.’ Amɛteŋ lumɔ lɛ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ebaawo ejatsu etswa ekɔŋ kɛje kpo be mli ni hiɛ ebu.
Ebaatsɔ̃ gbogbo ni agbu aha lɛ mli kɛje kpo.
Ebaaha ehiɛ, ni ekana shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni eyaa lɛ kɛ ehiŋmɛi.
“Maŋmɛ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu lɛ tamɔ tsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ baaba Babilon maŋ wulu lɛ mli.
Shi jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ tete ehiŋmɛi enaŋ, tsɛbelɛ jɛi nɔŋŋ eeegbo yɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ, kɛ eyelikɛbualɔi lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, magbɛ amɛ mashwã kɔɔyɔŋ yɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni magbala klante kɛnyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.” “Kɛji migbɛ amɛ mishwã majimaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ no amɛkɛaale akɛ, mi mi ji Yehowa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mashi mɛi fioo ko ni amɛaaje klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ gbele hela gbele mli.
Amɛaajaje nihiinii ni amɛfee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ majimaji ni amɛyaa mli lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Gbalɔ ni miikpokpo lɛ Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye nii; kɛji ooye lɛ, ha ohe akpokpo ni kɛji oonu nu lɛ, ha ohe ajo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ kɛɛmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ yɛ Yerusalɛmbii ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe nɛ, amɛniyenii lɛ, tsuiyeli amɛkɛaaye, ni amɛnu lɛ hu, hejɔ̃mɔ amɛkɛaanu; ejaakɛ yiwalɛnii ni maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ fee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ aba niyenii dɔŋŋ.
Maji ni ahi mli dã lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Abɛi ni ale kɛ gbalɛ ni aleee Yehowa kɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni ji abɛ ni nyɛbuɔ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, ‘Gbii miiho kɛmiiya, ni gbalɛ ko baaa mli lɛ?’ No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, mibaha nɛkɛ abɛ ni abuɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ afo, ni abuŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel.’ Shi moŋ kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ be ni eshɛ, ni gbalɛ fɛɛ gbalɛ baana aba mli.
Ejaakɛ amale ninaa ko ejeŋ kpo dɔŋŋ, ni gbalɛ ni akɛlakaa mɔ ko hu baŋ mli dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel we lɛ.
Shi mi, Yehowa, mibawie, ni wiemɔ ni mibawie lɛ baaba mli.
Atsiŋ atoŋ dɔŋŋ.
Ao!
Nyɛ toigbolɔi awe, nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ mibawie, ni mibafee hu.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Oninaa lɛ yeɔ bei pii dani ebaa mli, ni ogbalɛi lɛ hu kɔɔ be ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ he.’ No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, atsiŋ miwiemɔ lɛ eko atoŋ dɔŋŋ, shi wiemɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ baaba mli.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.”
Agba ashi amale gbalɔi Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi Israel gbalɔi lɛ ni sɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɛi lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kpoo ha gbalɔi kwashiai lɛ ni nɔ ni amɛmumɔ kɛɔ amɛ lɛ, no amɛgbaa, tsɛ amɛnako nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ.
Ao, Israelbii, nyɛgbalɔi lɛ etsɔmɔ osɔi ni hɔlɔ tsukoi amli.
Amɛbuuu fɔji lɛ anaa, ni amɛtswaaa gbogbo amɛwooo Israel we lɛ he, bɔ ni eeenyɛ ekpee ta naa yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ.
Amɛfoɔ amale saji amɛtãa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi.
Amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ,’ be mli ni Yehowa tsuko amɛ; ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpaa gbɛ akɛ amɛwiemɔi lɛ aba mli.
Ani kɛji miwieko, shi nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa kɛɛ’ lɛ, no lɛ ani jeee yaka ninaa nyɛnaa, ni amale gbalɛ nyɛgbaa lɛ lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ amɛ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛkɛɔ nibii ni bɛ mli, ni nyɛmaleɔ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
Mate shi mawo gbalɔi ni naa ninai ni bɛ mli, ni amɛmaleɔ lɛ; amɛhiŋ mimaŋ lɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ mli, ni asaŋ aŋmaŋ amɛgbɛii yɛ Israel we lɛ wolo lɛ mli, ni amɛyiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu; ni nyɛkɛale akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ.
“Naa!
Akɛni amɛlakaa mimaŋ lɛ akɛ ‘Omanye eba,’ be mli ni omanye ko bɛ lɛ.
Mimaŋbii lɛ tswaa gbogbo ni amale gbalɔi lɛ shaa he kaaloo; Kɛɛmɔ mɛi ni kɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo lɛ he lɛ akɛ ebaagbee shi.
Nu baanɛ waa, nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji baanɛ, ni ahum baatswa, Ni no lɛ gbogbo lɛ baagbee shi; ani abiŋ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Kaaloo lɛ ni nyɛkɛsha gbogbo lɛ he lɛ, nɛgbɛ ehe sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ?’ “No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mikɛ mlifu aaahã ahum atswa, ni mikɛ mlila aaahã nu anɛ waa, ni mahã nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi wuji aaanɛ kɛkpãtã nii ahiɛ.
Makumɔ gbogbo ni nyɛkɛ kaaloo esha he lɛ mashwie shi; ni eshishitoo lɛ aaaje kpo faŋŋ.
Eshigbeemɔ mli lɛ eeegbee nyɛ nɔ, ni eeekpãtã nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“No ni mimli baafu gbogbo lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni sha he kaaloo lɛ.
No ni makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbogbo lɛ bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni mɛi ni sha he lɛ hu bɛ dɔŋŋ, mɛi ni ji Israel gbalɔi ni gba yɛ Yerusalɛm he, ni amɛna omanye ninai yɛ ehe, tsɛbelɛ, omanye ko bɛ lɛ; mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ.” Gbalɛ ni kɔɔ yei amale gbalɔi ahe Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo omaŋ lɛ mli biyei lɛ ni kaa amɛhiɛ amɛgbaa lɛ; gbaa oshi amɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kpoo ha yei ni kpɛɔ sɛbɛi amɛŋmɔlɔɔ mɛi anijiashi, ni amɛkpɛɔ yitso fɛɛ yitso dalɛ he yiteŋhaa mama amɛhãa mɛi, ni amɛkɛlakaa gbɔmɛi kɛjeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee he.
Ani nyɛbaadu miwebii lɛ, ni nyɛbaa susumai krokomɛi ayi yɛ nyɛsɛɛnamɔ hewɔ?
Akoko dɛ kɔkɔi obɔ̃bɔ̃i kɛkɛ kɛ aboloo atrɔmai kɛkɛ ahewɔ lɛ, nyɛbuleɔ mi yɛ mimaŋ mli, ni nyɛgbeɔ mɛi ni esaaa akɛ amɛgboiɔ, ni nyɛhereɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ amɛgboi lɛ moŋ ayiwala.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmaleɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ni boɔ toi lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mitaooo sɛbɛi ni nyɛkɛlakaa mɛi lɛ, ni matserɛ amɛ yɛ nyɛnijiashi mashwie, ni mibaha susumai ni nyɛdu tamɔ loofɔji lɛ aye amɛhe.
Ni matserɛ nyɛyiteŋhaa mamai lɛ hu, ni makpɔ̃ miwebii lɛ kɛjɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni amɛhiŋ nyɛdɛŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” “Nyɛkɛ amale hãa jalɔ nijiaŋ jeɔ wui, tsɛbelɛ, mi lɛ mihako enijiaŋ aje wui; ni nyɛwoɔ mɔ fɔŋ moŋ ekãa, no hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ahere eyiwala.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ lakamɔ ninai dɔŋŋ, ni klamɔ hu nyɛklaŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ makpɔ̃ mimaŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Nyɔŋmɔ miihi wɔŋjamɔ Agbɛnɛ Israel onukpai lɛ ekomɛi ba amɛbabi Yehowa nii.
Amɛtara shi yɛ mihiɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛ amɛtsuii eŋmɛ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛhã amɛnishaianii lɛ etsɔ̃ pampi ma amɛhiɛ.
Ani esa akɛ maŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbabi mi nii kwraa lo?” “No hewɔ lɛ, okɛ amɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we ni kɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ emãgãi anɔ, ni ehaa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi maa ehiɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ, ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ebabiɔ nii lɛ, mi, Yehowa, mi diɛŋtsɛ mahã lɛ hetoo yɛ emãgãi lɛ ayikulɛ lɛ naa, bɔ ni afee ni matsake Israelbii lɛ atsui, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ amɛmãgãi lɛ anɔ amɛtse amɛhe kɛje mihe.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuii ni nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛmãgãi lɛ ahe, ni nyɛjiea nyɛhe kɛjea nihiinii lɛ fɛɛ ahe.” “Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ Israel we, loo gbɔi ni ebato gbɔ yɛ Israel he ko ni tseɔ ehe kɛjɛɔ mihe, ni ekɛ etsui ŋmɛɔ amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni ehãa enishaianii tsɔ̃ɔ pampi ehaa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ ebaa gbalɔ ŋɔɔ ni ebi mi nii eha lɛ lɛ, mi, Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ maha lɛ hetoo.
Majie mihiɛ maka nakai mɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ baafee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni akɛbuɔ abɛ, ni majie lɛ yɛ miwebii lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“Ni kɛji nɔ ko aaalaka gbalɔ lɛ ni ewie wiemɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ji mɔ ni laka nakai gbalɔ lɛ, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaye; makpãtã ehiɛ kɛaaje mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Abaagbala amɛ fɛɛ amɛtoi.
Gbalɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni yabiɔ gbalɔ lɛ nii lɛ fɛɛ aaana toigbalamɔ kome.
Mibafee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni Israel we lɛ akatse amɛhe kɛmiije mihe ni amɛyadu gbɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛ nifɔɔjianii lɛ miibule amɛhe dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ amɛtsɔ̃ miwebii, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Noa, Daniel kɛ Hiob Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛji shikpɔŋ ko nɔ bii fee esha shi mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa, ni mite shi miwo amɛ, ni mifo amɛniyeniinamɔ sɛɛ, ni mihã hɔmɔ ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji nɛkɛ hii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, ni ji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob, futu amɛ tete po lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ aaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Kɛji miha kooloi awuyelɔi bakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ̃ ni amɛplenee enɔ bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ kɛhooo yɛ kooloi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, kɛji nɛkɛ jalɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei po yiwala amɛhere.
Amɛaahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
“Aloo kɛji mifã klante miwo nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii, ni mikɛɛ akɛ, akɛ klante akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛji nɛkɛ hii jalɔi etɛ̃ nɛɛ yɛ jɛi tete lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ binuu loo biyoo po yiwala ahere; shi amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala amɛaahere.
“Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛji mihã gbele hela ko ba nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ mlifu hã lá shwie shi koni makpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ; kɛji Noa kɛ Daniel kɛ Hiob tete po yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ, mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ akɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛbihii loo amɛbiyei tete po ayiwala amɛhere; amɛkɛ amɛjalɛ lɛ baahere amɛ pɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyiwala.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Te eeetamɔ tɛŋŋ kɛji miha nibii ejwɛ ni mikɛgbalaa toi, ni ji klante kɛ hɔmɔ kɛ kooloi awuiyelɔi kɛ gbele hela lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni miha amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ahiɛ yɛ mli?
“Ni kɛji hiɛkãalɔi komɛi aaashwɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaanyɛ amɛhere amɛbihii kɛ biyei ayiwala lɛ, kɛji nakai bihii kɛ biyei lɛ ba nyɛŋɔɔ ni nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔi pɛ, nyɛbaanu shishi akɛ toigbalamɔ ni mikɛba Yerusalɛm yɛ enifɔɔji anii ni efee lɛ he lɛ, esa lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛna amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ pɛ nyɛbaanu shishi, no aaahã nyɛle akɛ nii fɛɛ ni mifee Yerusalɛm lɛ mifee ni shishinumɔ yɛ he.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Waintso he abɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mɛni waintso kɛfe tso kroko?
Mɛni waintso nine kɛfe tsei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ koo lɛ mli lɛ?
Ani akɛ etso lɛ feɔ nɔ ko kwraa?
Ani gbɔmɔ kɛ eko gbɔɔ shiŋmlitso ni akɛ nii tsotsoroɔ nɔ lo?
Naa, akɛfeɔ lai ni ashãa.
Kɛji enaabu biɛ kɛ biɛ shã, ni eteŋ hu fɛɛ eshã etsɔ̃ ŋai lɛ, ani ehiɔ kɛhã nɔ ko feemɔ kwraa lo?
Naa, be ni eji waintso muu po, akɛtsuuu nɔ ko, ni kɛji la ŋala lɛ ni etsɔ ŋai lɛ, no lɛ ani aaanyɛ akɛtsu nɔ ko kwraa lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Bɔ ni mihãa la shãa waintso kɛ tsei krokomɛi fɛɛ yɛ koo mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋɔ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ mahã.
Majie mihiɛ maka amɛ, ni kɛji amɛje la lɛ mli tete lɛ, la lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ baakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
No ni nyɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, kɛji mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ lɛ.
Mibaha shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yerusalɛm ni yeee anɔkwa Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, jajemɔ musubɔɔnii ni Yerusalɛm efee lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni okɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Yerusalɛm nɛ, ojɛ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ nɔ, ni jɛi afɔ bo yɛ.
Amornyo ji otsɛ, ni Hityoo ji onyɛ.
Asaŋ yɛ ofɔmɔ mli lɛ, gbi ni afɔ bo lɛ, afooo olaŋmɔ, akɛ nu hu juuu ohe ni ohe aje, akɛ ŋoo kpaaa ohe hu, ni akɛ mama hu ebalaaa ohe.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko enaaa bo mɔbɔ ni emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ ni eeefee nibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko ehã bo, shi moŋ ashɛ bo afɔ ŋa kplanaa nɔ, ejaakɛ anyaŋe bo kɛjɛ gbi ni afɔ bo lɛ beebe.
“No ni be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho lɛ, mina bo ni ookoklo shi yɛ ola mli.
Mikɛ bo wie yɛ ola lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Oyi ana wala koni oda tamɔ ŋanɔtso.’ Kɛkɛ ni oda, ni okwɔ, ni oshɛ oblayoo, ni oje fufɔ, ni oyitsɔi kɛlɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa.
“Be ni mibatsɔ̃ omasɛi kɛho ekoŋŋ lɛ, naa, mina akɛ oda ni oshɛ gbãlã, ni miha bo mimama lɛ eko ni mikɛtsi oyayai nɔ.
Hɛɛ, misumɔ bo kɛha gbãlãshihilɛ, ni mikɛ bo kpãŋ, ni otsɔ̃ minɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Kɛkɛ ni mikɛ nu ju ohe ni mifɔ ohe lá lɛ fɛɛ yɛ ohe, ni mikpa bo mu.
Mibu bo mama hu ni aye samai yɛ mli, ni miwo bo nuŋgbee wolo tokota; mifi bo duku yɛŋ, ni mibu bo sliki mama.
Misaa miwula bo kɛ jwinei, miwo onineshi gai, ni mikɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ ŋmɛ okuɛ.
Miwo ogugɔŋ ga, ni miwo otoiiaŋ toiiaŋnii.
Mikɛ akekre fɛɛfɛo fi oyitso.
Nɛkɛ awula bo kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi ni owoɔ.
Ni ohebo ji klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ sliki kɛ mama ni alo nii awo mli.
Oye shikishaŋnii kpakpa kɛ wo kɛ mu, ni ohe fee fɛo jogbaŋŋ naakpa, ni otsɔ̃ maŋnyɛ.
Ogbɛi hu hehe kɛtee jeŋ maji srɔtoi anɔ yɛ ohe fɛo lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ bɔ ni miwula bo lɛ hã ohe fee fɛo kɛmɔ shi.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Shi odi ohe fɛo kɛ ogbɛi ni ehehe lɛ sɛɛ ni obɔ ajwamãŋ; ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ wɔɔ kɛkɛ.
Okɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ otadei lɛ ekomɛi wulaa ohei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obɔɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ amɛnɔ, nɔ ni afeko eko dã, ni asaŋ afeŋ nakai nɔ ko hu.
Osaa oŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji ni ji mishika kɛ mijwiɛtɛi ni mihã bo lɛ eko okɛfee hii amãgãi ohã ohe, ni okɛ amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ.
Okɛ otadei ni aye ŋaabii awo amɛmli lɛ ha amãgãi lɛ anɔ, ni okɛ mimu kɛ mitsofakɛŋma lɛ mamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Asaŋ milɛ bo kɛ ashikishaŋ kpakpa kɛ mu kɛ wo, ni miniyenii ni mikɛhã bo lɛ, nomɛi okɛmamɔ amãgãi lɛ ahiɛ koni eje ŋma ewo amɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Asaŋ obihii kɛ obiyei ni ofɔ ohã mi lɛ hu ogbe amɛ okɛshã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ ni amɛye.
Ani ajwamãŋbɔi nɛɛ faaa hãaa bo hewɔ ni ogbe mibii lɛ, ni okɛ amɛ shã afɔlei ohã amãgãi lɛ?
Be ni ofeɔ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ ni obɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ, okaiii be ni oji abifao ni onyiɛ yayai kɛ ohe pasaa, ni okokloɔ yɛ olá mli lɛ.” Yerusalɛm Ajwamãŋbɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Kpoo, kpoo hã bo!
Ejaakɛ onifɔɔjianii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ofo akrabatsa fɛɛfɛo ohã ohe, ni ofee otutui wuji ohã ohe yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli.
Omamɔ otutui wuji lɛ yɛ ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha nɔ, ni okɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hoɔ kɛkɛ wɔɔ shii abɔ.
Okɛ Ijiptbii, mɛi ni amɛkɔnɔ fa, ni okɛ amɛ je husu lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; ni obɔ ajwamãŋ shii abɔ ni okɛwo mimli la.
“Naa, agbɛnɛ, mite shi miwo bo, ni magbala otoi; ni mitse nɔ ni ji ogbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ bo hã ohenyɛlɔi fulɔi ni ji Filistibii lɛ abiyei lɛ ni hiɛ gboɔ yɛ onifɔɔji anifeemɔi lɛ ahe lɛ.
“Osaa okɛ Asiriabii lɛ hu bɔ ajwamãŋ ejaakɛ otɔɔɔ; okɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ eshɛɛɛ onaa.
Nakai nɔŋŋ okɛ Babilonbii ni ji jarayelɔi lɛ hu bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni no tete hu shɛɛɛ onaa.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni akɔnɔ eyi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni okɛbɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ohiɛ gbooo he; ni omamɔɔ opiai lɛ omaa ŋmaŋmasha fɛɛ ŋmaŋmasha ni ofeɔ ojamɔhe krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ blohu fɛɛ blohu mli; tsɛ ofeee onii tamɔ ajwamãŋ tete; ejaakɛ bo lɛ oheee shika.
Bo lɛ, oji ohe ŋã gbãlãfitelɔ ni jeɔ ewu sɛɛ.
Hii keɔ ajwamãŋi fɛɛ anii, shi bo lɛ bo moŋ oŋɔɔ onikeenii lɛ okeɔ osuɔlɔi fɛɛ, ni ohãa amɛ nyɔɔŋnii koni amɛjɛ he fɛɛ he amɛba oŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ bo ababɔ.
Bo lɛ, esoro bo kwraa yɛ yei ajwamãŋbɔlɔi krokomɛi ahe, ejaakɛ bo lɛ, mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ etɔɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ bo wɔɔ; asaŋ mɔ ko wooo bo nyɔmɔ akɛ ekɛ bo ewɔ, shi bo moŋ owoɔ mɛi anyɔmɔ, no hewɔ ni soro bo kwraa lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Yerusalɛm toi Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, bo ajwamãŋ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Oshwie ohiɛ shi, yɛ osuɔlɔi kɛ wɔji ahiɛ, ni ojie oyayaiaŋ kpo yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli.
Ni ogbe obii okɛshã afɔle oha wɔji.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, mabua osuɔlɔi ni okɛ amɛ ye ŋɔɔmɔ lɛ anaa, mɛi ni osumɔɔ kɛ mɛi ni osumɔɔɔ hu fɛɛ naa kɛkpe.
Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ hei fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ mawo bo, ni majie oyayaiaŋ matsɔɔ amɛ, koni amɛna oyayaiaŋ fɛɛ.
Asaŋ makojo bo tamɔ akojoɔ yei ni kuɔ gbãlã mli ni amɛshwieɔ lá shi hu lɛ; ni mikɛ mlifu kɛ awuŋayeli aaatɔ lá he owele yɛ onɔ.
Ni maŋɔ bo mawo osuɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛbaakumɔ opiai lɛ, ni amɛbaafite ohei grɔŋŋi ni oja yɛ lɛ.
Osuɔlɔi lɛ aaakpɔlɔ ohe atadei hu, ni amɛaaŋɔ ojwinei fɛɛfɛji lɛ, ni amɛaashi bo kɛ ohe yayai kɛ ohe pasaa.” “Osuɔlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi asafo yuu aaate shi awo bo ni atswia bo tɛi, ni amɛ kɛ amɛklantei aaafolɔ omli dukuduku.
Amɛkɛ la aaashã oshĩai lɛ, ni amɛaakojo bo yɛ yei babaoo ahiɛ; ni maha ofɔ̃ɔ ajwamãŋbɔɔ, ni owoŋ osuɔlɔi ni kɛ bo wɔɔ lɛ anyɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni maha mimli ni ewo bo la lɛ naa ajɔ, ni miyeŋ ohe awuŋã, mafee diŋŋ, ni mimli fuŋ bo dɔŋŋ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Akɛni okaiii bɔ ni mikɛ bo hi shi hã yɛ oblayeiaŋ, shi moŋ okɛ onifɔɔjianii nɛɛ fɛɛ wo mi mlifu hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, naa, maha onifɔɔjianii lɛ abua oyiteŋ.
Bɛ obɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi hu oshi nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ nɔ?
“Naa, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni buɔ abɛ lɛ, aaabu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ashi bo akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni nyɛ (awo) yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ebiyoo yɔɔ.’ Onyɛ ni nyaŋe ewu kɛ ebii lɛ, ebiyoo ji bo; ni onyɛmimɛi yei ni nyaŋe amɛwumɛi kɛ amɛbii lɛ amɛnyɛmi yoo ji bo.
Hityoo ji nyɛnyɛ, ni Amornyo ji nyɛtsɛ.
“Onyɛmi yoo nukpa ji Samaria, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai yɔɔ okooyigbɛ lɛ; ni onyɛmi yoo gbekɛ ji Sodom, mɔ ni kɛ ekrowai lɛ yɔɔ owuoyigbɛ lɛ.
Shi obaaa ojeŋ tamɔ amɛ, ni ofeee amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ eko moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, be fioo mli lɛ ofite fe amɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, onyɛmi yoo Sodom kɛ okrowai lɛ efeee nɔ fɔŋ tamɔ bɔ ni bo kɛ obiyei lɛ fee lɛ.
Naa, efɔŋ ni onyɛmi yoo ni ji Sodom fee lɛ ji akɛ ekɛ ebiyei lɛ woɔ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛyɛ ŋmãa babaoo ni amɛyɛ toiŋjɔlɛ hu, shi amɛyeee amɛbuaaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ.
Amɛwo amɛhe, ni amɛfee musubɔɔnii yɛ mihiɛ, hewɔ lɛ be ni mina lɛ, mishwie amɛ.
“Samaria hu efeee eshai ni ofee lɛ mli fã tete po, shi bo lɛ ofee musubɔɔnii babaoo ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ, ni kɛji akɛ omusubɔɔnii lɛ to onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ anɔ lɛ he lɛ abuɔ amɛ jalɔi fe bo.
Agbɛnɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ hu ohiɛgbele aaatere bo; ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ bem, ejaakɛ musubɔɔnii ni mihiɔ ni ofee lɛ fa fe amɛnɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛja fe bo.
Agbɛnɛ hã ohiɛ agbo ni otere ohiɛgbele, ejaakɛ obu onyɛmimɛi yei lɛ abem.” Abaasaa Sodom kɛ Samaria ekoŋŋ “Makpale Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ anibii lɛ mahã amɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ maha Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ anine ashɛ amɛnibii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ, ni makpale bo hu onibii lɛ maha bo yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Koni otere ohiɛgbele lɛ ni ohiɛ agbo yɛ musubɔɔnii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ, koni onyɛmimɛi lɛ ana akɛ amɛhi fe bo.
Onyɛmimɛi yei ni ji Sodom kɛ ekrowai lɛ kɛ Samaria kɛ ekrowai lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu okɛ okrowai lɛ aaaku nyɛsɛɛ kɛaaba nyɛsa shihilɛhe lɛ.
Te be mli ni okɛ hewoo yeɔ omle lɛ, onyɛmi yoo ni ji Sodom lɛ ji odaaŋ kotsa, dani ajie onifɔɔjianii lɛ kpo.
Agbɛnɛ okɛ lɛ eye hegbɔ, ni Edombii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɔle lɛ lɛ, aaaye ohe fɛo, ni nakai nɔŋŋ Filistibii kɛ amɛkrowai ni amɛhe tsɛ̃ɔ bo lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo.
Aaagbala otoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii kɛ nihiinii ni ofeɔ lɛ hewɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kpãŋmɔ ni aaahi shi kɛaatee naanɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni ofee lɛ nakai pɛ mikɛ bo baaye, ejaakɛ otswa okitã lɛ ofɔ̃ afã, ni oku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ makai kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ bo kpãŋ yɛ oblayeiaŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ bo aaakpãŋ naanɔ kpãŋmɔ.
“No dani oookai ojeŋba fɔŋ lɛ, ni ohiɛ aaagbo, kɛji miŋɔ onyɛmimɛi yei onukpai kɛ onyɛmimɛi yei gbekɛbii lɛ mibahã bo akɛ obiyei lɛ, shi jeee akɛ mikɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
“Maha mikɛ bo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ ama shi, ni obaale akɛ mi ji, Yehowa; Oookai enɛ ni ohiɛ aaagbo, ni okatswa odaaŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ ohiɛgbele lɛ hewɔ, be ni mikɛ nifɔɔjianii ni ofee lɛ fɛɛ efa bo lɛ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Okropɔŋ lɛ kɛ Waintso lɛ he abɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gba Israelbii lɛ ajenu, ni obu amɛ abɛ akɛ bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kɛ efiji agboi kɛ etsɛji kakadaji ko ni yɔɔ.
Eyɛ tsɛji fɛɛfɛji bibii kɛ emli samaisamai.
Eba Lebanon gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ebaku tsenedrutso lɛ yiteŋ.
Eku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔoo lɛ eko ni ekɛkɔ̃ enaa kɛtee jarayeli shikpɔŋ ko nɔ.
Ekɛtee eyatɛo yɛ guɔyelɔi amaŋ ko mli.
Agbɛnɛ esaa ekɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dumɔ wu lɛ eko ni ekɛtee eyadu yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ.
Ekɛ dumɔ wu lɛ tee he ni nu pii yɔɔ, ni edu yɛ faa lɛ toi kpaakpa.
Wu lɛ kwɛ̃ ni eda etsɔ waintso agbo ni ebu gbidii; eniji lɛ kwɔlɔ kɛtee okropɔŋ lɛ ŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni tso lɛ shishifãi lɛ he shi.
Kɛkɛ ni etsɔ̃ waintso, ni egbala niji, ni etsɛ̃rɛ bai hu.
“Shi okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple kroko hu ni yɔɔ kɛ efiji kpelei kɛ etsɛji pii.
Ni naa, nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ dɔrɔ eshishifãi lɛ kɛ eniji lɛ kɛba okropɔŋ kroko nɛɛ ŋɔɔgbɛ, koni okropɔŋ nɛɛ ashwie waintso lɛ nɔ nu pii fe he ni eyɔɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ.
Okropɔŋ lɛ fã waintso lɛ kɛjɛ akofi nɔ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni eyatɛo yɛ shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni nu pii yɔɔ no nɔ, koni egbala niji, ni ewo yibii ni etsɔ̃ waintso kpakpa.
“Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa biɔ nɛ.
Ani nɛkɛ waintso nɛɛ aaahere?
Ani klɛŋklɛŋ okropɔŋ lɛ baŋ ni ebafã waintso lɛ kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ, ni efolɔ eniji lɛ eshwie, koni eyibaa fɔbii lɛ fɛɛ aŋala?
Ebiŋ hewalɛ tsɔ̃ loo mɛi babaoo ni akɛfã tso lɛ kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ afɔ̃ shi.
Naa, kɛji afã ayatɛo lɛ, ani eeehere?
Ani kɛ bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ tswa lɛ lɛ jeee ŋalamɔ eeeŋala kwraa yɛ akofi nɔ he ni atɛo lɛ yɛ lɛ!” Atsɔ̃ɔ Abɛi lɛ shishi Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Bi atuatselɔi awe lɛ akɛ, ani nyɛnaaa abɛ nɛɛ shishi?
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, naa, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm ni ebaŋɔ emli maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ emli lumɛi lɛ, ni ekpala amɛ eshwie esɛɛ kɛtee Babilon.
Ni eŋɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ odehei lɛ eko, ni ekɛ lɛ kpãŋ; ni ehã odehe lɛ kã lɛ kitã akɛ ebaaye lɛ anɔkwa.
Kɛkɛ ni emɔmɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛtee, koni ekɛba jɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi ni ekawo ehe nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni kɛ eye ekpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ama shi.
Shi Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ tse Babilon maŋtsɛ nɛɛ hiɛ atua, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee Ijipt, koni ahã lɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tabilɔi babaoo.
Ani eeehi ehã lɛ?
Aso gbɔmɔ ni feɔ nibii tamɔ enɛɛmɛi lɛ eeeye ehe lo?
Ani eeeku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni kɛ̃lɛ eeeye ehe lo?” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, Babilon, he ni maŋtsɛ, mɔ ni wo lɛ maŋtsɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ekwa ekitã lɛ, kɛ mɔ kpãŋmɔ mli ni eku yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ eeegbo yɛ.
Kɛji Babilonbii lɛ tswa kpokui, ni amɛtswa kawoo gbogboi koni akɛkpãtã mɛi pii ahiɛ lɛ, Farao kɛ eta kpele lɛ kɛ esafo babaoo lɛ nyɛŋ Yuda eye ebua yɛ ta mli.
Akɛni ebuuu kitã ni ekã lɛ, ni eku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, akɛni ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ efee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ejeŋ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mikitã ni ebuuu lɛ, kɛ mikpãŋmɔ lɛ ni eku mli lɛ, mikɛ he sɔ̃ aaabua eyiteŋ.
Mafɔ̃ enɔ miyaa lɛ, ni eeedu mitsɔne, ni mikɛ lɛ aaaba Babilon, ni magbala etoi yɛ jɛi, yɛ shi ni ete ewo mi lɛ hewɔ.
Ni akɛ klante aaakpãtã etabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaagbɛ amɛ ashwã jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ wo hiɛnɔkãmɔ he shi Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mi diɛŋtsɛ maku tsenedrutso yiteŋ kɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ ni mayatɛo.
Maku eniji fɔbii lɛ ayiteŋ fɔflɔooi lɛ, ni mayatɛo yɛ gɔŋ ni kwɔ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ.
Israel gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ matɛo yɛ; ni eeegbala niji, ni eeewo yibii, ni eeetsɔ̃ tsenedrutso fɛɛfɛo, ni loofɔji srɔtoi fɛɛ aaabahi enɔ, amɛaahi eniji ashishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli.
Ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ aaana ale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mihãa tso ni kwɔ lɛ baa shi, ni miwoɔ tso tɛkɛɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa ŋwɛi; Mihãa tso ŋmɔŋ gbiɔ ni mihãa tso gbiŋ fɛoɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni mafee hu.”
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛni ji shishinumɔ ni nyɛkɛbuɔ abɛ nɛɛ yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he akɛ, ‘Tsɛmɛi lɛ eye wainyibii ŋmilikitii, ni bii lɛ moŋ anyanyɔji eshwã’ lɛ?
“Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛbuŋ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ Israel.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Naa, gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala lɛ, minɔ ni.
Bɔ ni tsɛ wala ji minɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ bi hu nɔ ji minɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeegbo.
“Ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko yɛ ni ji jalɔ, ni eyeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja.
Eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ni ewooo ehiɛ nɔ ekwɛɛɛ Israel we lɛ wɔji lɛ tete, ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ, ni ebɛŋkɛɛɛ yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ.
Ewaaa mɔ yi; shi ekpaleɔ nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãa lɛ; ni etswaaa ojo; ehaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko, shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ nii eyeɔ; asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ ebuɔ lɛ mama.
“Ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa fe nine.
Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekojoɔ mɔ kɛ mɔ teŋ yɛ jalɛ naa.
Ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu yiwalɔ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ.
Bi nɛɛ efeee nii ni sa feemɔ nɛɛ ateŋ ekoeko; shi moŋ eyeɔ nii ni akɛshãa afɔle ahãa wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ; ni enyiɛɔ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Ewaa ohiafo kɛ mɔ ni efi lɛ yi.
Etswaa ojo, ni ekpaleee nyɔmɔtsɛ awabatoonii ehãaa lɛ.
Ejaa amãgã, ni efeɔ musubɔɔnii.
Efaa shika ni eheɔ hekpa fe nine.
Aso nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ yi aaana wala?
Eyi naŋ wala.
Akɛni efee nɛkɛ musubɔɔnii nɛɛ fɛɛ eko hewɔ lɛ gbo kɛ̃ eeegbo; ela aaabua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
“Shi agbɛnɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ fɔ binuu ko, ni ebinuu nɛɛ na eshai fɛɛ ni etsɛ lɛ efee lɛ, ni eshe gbeyei, ni efeee nakai eshai lɛ eko.
Ni eyeee nii ni akɛshã afɔle ahã wɔji yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni ejaaa Israel we lɛ amãgãi lɛ ekoeko.
Ni enyiɛɛɛ enaanyo ŋa sɛɛ.
Ni efeee mɔ ko efɔŋ, eheee mɔ ko awabatoonii; etswaaa mɔ ko ojo.
Shi moŋ ehãa mɔ ni hɔmɔ yeɔ lɛ aboloo, asaŋ mɔ ni nyiɛ yayai lɛ, ebuɔ lɛ mama.
Ewiɔ ehe yɛ eshafeemɔ he, ni ekɛ shika efaaa ni ehe hekpa ni fe nine.
Ni eyeɔ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni ebaa ejeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ egboŋ yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee lɛ ahewɔ, shi moŋ eyi aaana wala kɛ̃.
Shi etsɛ lɛ, akɛni etswaa ojo, ni ejuɔ enyɛmi, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ehiii yɛ emaŋbii ateŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ ehe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ esaaa akɛ bi naa amanehului yɛ esha ni etsɛ efee hewɔ?’ Kɛji bi lɛ yeɔ jalɛ sane, ni efeɔ nɔ ni ja, ni eyeɔ mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, no lɛ esa akɛ eyi ana wala kɛ̃.
Gbɔmɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ gbo eeegbo.
Bi enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni etsɛ efee ahewɔ, ni tsɛ hu enaŋ amanehulu yɛ eshai ni ebii efee ahewɔ.
Jalɔ aaana ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo, ni mɔ fɔŋ hu aaana efɔŋ ni efee lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo.
“Shi kɛji eshafeelɔ fɔ̃ɔ eshai fɛɛ ni efeɔ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni eye jalɛ sane, ni efee nɔ ni ja lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Tɔ̃mɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ akaiŋ ekoeko dɔŋŋ, akɛaafa lɛ.
Ejalɛnii ni efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ eyi aaana wala.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi akɛ, “Aso minyaa efɔŋfeelɔ gbele he lo?
Dabida, nɔ ni mitaoɔ moŋ ji akɛ etsake ejeŋba koni eyi ana wala.” “Shi kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ ni efee esha, ni efee musubɔɔ nii ni mɔfɔŋ feɔ lɛ, aso eyi aaana wala lo?
Jalɛnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akaiŋ ekoeko.
Etɔmɔi ni etɔ̃ lɛ kɛ eshai ni efee lɛ, eeegbo yɛ nomɛi ahewɔ.
“Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane.
Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa toi ko!
Ani mi, miyeee jalɛ sane?
Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛ sane?
Kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ, ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, gbo eeegbo yɛ no hewɔ.
Ebaagbo yɛ efɔŋ ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ kɛji mɔ fɔŋ fɔ̃ɔ eshai ni efeɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni eye mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ ekɔ eyiŋ, ni efɔ̃ɔ enifɔɔji anii lɛ fɛɛ ni efee lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, Israelbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yeee jalɛ sane.’ Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, ani mi ni miyeee jalɛ sane lo?
Ani jeee nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛyeee jalɛ sane?
“No hewɔ lɛ, Ao, nyɛ Israelbii, makojo nyɛ, makojo nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔ nii anaa.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ, ni nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ; koni nyɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ akakpãtã nyɛhiɛ.
Nyɛkpaa efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛshi mi lɛ feemɔ, ni nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ ni nyɛnaa mumɔ hee.
Ao, Israelbii, shi mɛɛba ni nyɛaagboi?
Minyaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko gbele he.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsuiiaŋ koni nyɛyi anaa wala.”
Awerɛho lalawiemɔ Wo yaafo lala nɔ okɛfo Israel lumɛi lɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, “Ani onyɛ lɛ jeee jatayoo ni?
Ni ebu jata oblahii ateŋ ni elɛ ebii lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ?
Ni etsɔse ebii lɛ ateŋ ekome ni etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo; ekase loomɔmɔ, ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete?
Jeŋmaji lɛ bɔ ehe oshe; ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli; ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbala lɛ kɛtee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni enyɛ mɛ aahu lɛ, ehiɛnɔkãmɔ tã.
Esaa eŋɔ ebii lɛ ateŋ ekroko efee jata oblanyo.
Be ni eda etsɔ̃ jata oblanyo lɛ ekɛ jatai lɛ nyiɛ aahu.
Ekase gbɔbimɔ ni eyeɔ gbɔmɔ tete.
Ejwra amɛ mɔji, ni efite maji hu; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ she gbeyei yɛ ehuumɔ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni jeŋmaji lɛ gba wo lɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛfɔ̃ enɔ yaa, ni adu lɛ yɛ amɛbu lɛ mli.
Ni amɛkɛ kpoji gbala lɛ amɛwo kooloi adeka mli; ni amɛkɛ lɛ yahã Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni akɛ lɛ to mɔɔ lɛ mli; bɔ ni afee ni akanu egbee yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Onyɛ tamɔ waintso ni atɛo yɛ faa toi; egbala niji, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ejaakɛ enaa nu pii.
Eniji lɛ na hewalɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ tsi.
Ni ewo ekwɔlɛ nɔ yɛ niji kusukusuu lɛ ateŋ.
Ni ana ekwɔlɛ kɛ eniji kusukusuu lɛ.
Shi akɛ mlila fã lɛ kɛ eshishi fɛɛ ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ gbi lɛ, ni eyibii lɛ kpala, ni etso ni wa lɛ gbi, ni eshã wɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ afã lɛ ayatɛo yɛ ŋa nɔ, yɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni la jɛ tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli ni eshã eniji lɛ kɛ eyibii lɛ fɛɛ; ni tso bɛ emli dɔŋŋ ni aaanyɛ akɛfee maŋtsɛ tsi dɔŋŋ.
Awerɛho lala nɛɛ alaa akɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ daa.
Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kɛ gbɔmɔ atuatsemɔ Yɛ wɔnomŋɔɔ afi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Israel onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba miŋɔɔ koni amɛbabi Yehowa nii.
Amɛbatara shi yɛ mihiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, okɛ Israel maŋ onukpai nɛɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani mi nibimɔ nyɛbaa nɛɛ?
Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, Mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii.
Ani oookojo amɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa?
Ani oookojo amɛ?
Belɛ hã amɛle musubɔɔnii ni amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, gbi ni miŋɔ Israel lɛ mikã Yakob shwiei lɛ akitã ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mikã amɛ kitã akɛ, ‘Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Nakai gbi lɛ mikã amɛ kitã akɛ majie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛya shikpɔŋ ko ni mito miha amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
Mikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ashɛrɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwie; ni nyɛkɛ Ijipt wɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe!
Mi ji Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Shi amɛtse mihiɛ atua, ni amɛbooo mi toi.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko shɛrɛɛɛ musubɔɔnii ni ehiŋmɛii nyaa he lɛ eshwieee, ni Ijipt wɔji lɛ hu ahewɔ lɛ, mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mlila kɛ mlifu aaafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mifeee; mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ yɛ migbɛi hewɔ, bɔ ni afee ni mikagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ, mɛi ahiɛ ni mihã amɛle mi yɛ, be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikɛ amɛ ba ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Miwo amɛ mlai kɛ akpɔi lɛ, ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ.
Asaŋ miŋɔ mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ mihã amɛ, koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ amɛteŋ, koni amɛkɛle akɛ mi Yehowa, mi ji mɔ ni tsuɔ amɛhe.
“Shi Israel we lɛ tse mihiɛ atua yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ anaa, shi moŋ amɛkwa mikpɔi ni kɛ gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ hu naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, mito miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ mimlila aaaplene amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kwrakwra.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi mijie Israel kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Asaŋ mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ mikɛ amɛ baŋ shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ nɔ; shikpɔŋ ni hi ni ebaa nii, ni eji shikpɔji lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ.
“Ejaakɛ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa.
Ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ hã amɛwɔji lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ mina amɛ mɔbɔ, ni mikpãtãaa amɛhiɛ ni mipleneee amɛ kwrakwra yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
“Mikɛɛ amɛbii yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ amlai lɛ anaa, ni nyɛkayea amɛkpɔi lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkɛ amɛwɔji lɛ akabulea nyɛhe.
Yehowa, mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ; nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ mimlai lɛ moŋ anaa; ni nyɛyea mimlai lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni nyɛfea mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ koni nomɛi atsɔ̃ okadi yɛ mi kɛ nyɛ teŋ; koni nyɛkɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ “Shi nyɛbii lɛ hu tse mihiɛ atua; amɛbaaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mlai lɛ anaa, ni amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; mlai ni kɛji gbɔmɔ ye nɔ ni eyi aaana wala lɛ; amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ hu.
Kɛkɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mafee amɛ efɔŋ yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila naa yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, Shi kɛ̃lɛ, mitsake miyiŋtoo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe migbɛi lɛ he guɔ yɛ jeŋmaji ni amɛyɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ ahiɛ; mɛi ahiɛ ni mi, mijie Israelbii lɛ yɛ, kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, mikã amɛ kitã yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ magbɛ amɛ mashwã jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpɔi lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ amɛkwa mimlai lɛ, ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ yakɔ̃ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ awɔji lɛ anɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miwo amɛ mlai ni ehiii, kɛ akpɔi ni haŋ amɛna wala.
Mibule amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnikeenii anɔ, no ji amɛkromɔbii ni amɛgbe kɛshã afɔle lɛ, koni mahã amɛhe ajɔ̃ amɛhe.
Mifee enɛ, koni amɛkɛna amɛle akɛ, mi ji Yehowa.
“No hewɔ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, enɛ mli hu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ bɔ musu amɛshi mi yɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.
Ejaakɛ be ni mihã amɛyashɛ shikpɔŋ ni mikã kitã akɛ mikɛaahã amɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, gɔŋkpɔ fɛɛ gɔŋkpɔ ni kwɔ, loo tso kusuu fɛɛ tso kusuu ni amɛaana lɛ, amɛyashãa amɛ afɔlei lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nɛɛ wo mimli la; jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛshãa amɛtsofakɛŋmai lɛ yɛ, ni jɛi nɔŋŋ amɛfɔse amɛdãa afɔle lɛ amɛshwie shi yɛ.
Mibi amɛ akɛ, mɛni ji nakai he grɔŋŋ lɛ ni nyɛyaa lɛ?
No hewɔ atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ ‘He Grɔŋŋ’ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ani nyɛaabule nyɛhe tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; ani nyɛaanyiɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ asɛɛ ni nyɛdu gbɛ?
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii yahãa wɔji, ni nyɛgbeɔ nyɛbihii nyɛkɛshãa afɔlei nyɛhãa amɛ lɛ, nyɛmiibule nyɛhe kɛ nɛkɛ nyɛwɔji nɛɛ ajamɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Ao, Israel we, nyɛmiiba ni nyɛbabi mi nii?
Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mihaŋ nyɛbi mi nii!
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, wɔɔtamɔ jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji anɔ wekui lɛ, ni wɔsɔmɔ tso kɛ tɛ lɛ, ebaŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ gbalaa toi, ni ekɛfaa Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila ni naa wa baaye nyɛnɔ maŋtsɛ.
Mikɛ nineshiwalɛ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ mlila baajie nyɛ kɛaajɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã amɛnɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ni mikɛ nyɛaaba majimaji lɛ ateŋ ni mabua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni jɛi magbala nyɛtoi yɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni migbala nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ Ijipt ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ magbala nyɛ hu nyɛtoi.
“Maha nyɛtsɔ̃ kplamɔtso lɛ shishi, ni makane nyɛ ekomekome mawo kpãŋmɔ mli.
Ni majie atuatselɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni etɔ̃ minɔ lɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ.
Majie amɛ kɛaajɛ he ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi amɛnane yiŋ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No dani nyɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ao, nyɛ Israel we, (nyɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛboŋ mi toi lɛ, kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ) nyɛyaa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ayasɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewɔji lɛ; shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ nyɛabo mi toi kɛ̃, ni migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ kɛ nyɛwɔŋjamɔ lɛ babuleŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Shi migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji Israel Gɔŋ ni kwɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jɛi Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaasɔmɔ mi yɛ; mana amɛhe tsui yɛ jɛi, ni mabi nyɛfɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛnikeenii kpakpai lɛ kɛ nyɛkeenii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ shi.
Kɛji mijie nyɛ kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ amli, ni mibua nyɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji ni agbɛ nyɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ anɔ kɛba lɛ, mana nyɛhe tsui tamɔ nɔ ko ni jeɔ ŋma, ni majie mikrɔŋkrɔŋ ni mi ji lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni majimaji aaana.
Kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bashɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikã he kitã akɛ maŋɔ hã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa.
Ni jɛi nyɛaakai nyɛjeŋba kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee ni nyɛkɛbule nyɛhe lɛ yɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe aaafee nyɛ nyaŋemɔ yɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, nyɛ Israel we, kɛji mikɛnyɛ ye yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ, shi jeee yɛ nyɛjeŋba gbohii lɛ ahewɔ, loo nyɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Wuoyigbɛ la lɛ Yehowa kɛmi wie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã wuoyigbɛ; wiemɔ oshi Yuda wuoyigbɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ Yuda wuoyigbɛ koo lɛ akɛ, bo Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ: naa, mawo la yɛ omli, ni eeeshã omli tso ŋmɔŋ fɛɛ tso ŋmɔŋ, kɛ tso gbiŋ fɛɛ tso gbiŋ.
La ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ agbeŋ, ni eeeshã he fɛɛ he kɛaajɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baana akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi miwo la lɛ, ni anyɛŋ agbe.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, amɛkɛɔ yɛ mihe akɛ, ‘Ani jeee abɛbuaŋ sɔŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ?’ ”
Yehowa klante lɛ Yehowa kɛ miwie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oha Yerusalɛm ni oshiɛ oshi hei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, he ni ajaa yɛ lɛ; gbaa oshi Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni okɛɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ bo ena, ni magbala miklante lɛ kɛaaje ehebo lɛ mli, ni mikɛaagbe jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Akɛni makpãtã jalɔ kɛ mɔfɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ kɛaaje nyɛteŋ hewɔ lɛ mafã miklante lɛ kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli mawo gbɔmɛi kɛjɛ wuoyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ.
No gbɔmɛi fɛɛ kɛaana ale akɛ, mi Yehowa mifã miklante kɛjɛ ehebo lɛ mli; ni akɛwoŋ ehebo lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bo, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, hũumɔ kɛ tsui ni ekumɔ, hũumɔ kɛ awerɛho kpele yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛbi bo akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ ohũɔ lɛ?’ Okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Saji ni minu lɛ hewɔ ni.
Kɛji eba mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baashe gbeyei, ni kɔ̃ɔji fɛɛ baakplɔke, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baatsɔ̃ feetɔ, ni nakutsei fɛɛ tswɛm baakpokpo tamɔ ayawaŋ nu.
Naa, be lɛ eshɛ, ni ebaaba mli kɛ̃;’ ” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ, nɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ, mikɛɔ nɛ, Klante!
Klante!
Ajɔ klante naa, ni asha he kaŋkaŋ.
Ajɔ naa koni akɛgbe mɔ; asha he ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ tamɔ srawa.
Aso wɔmli afili wɔ?
Mibi, ogbe kpãa kɛ tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ he guɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ akɛ klante lɛ ehã ni asha he, koni afee lɛ kralo kɛhã nitsumɔ.
Ajɔ naa, ni asha he kaŋkaŋ koni akɛwo mɔgbelɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔ Adesa, wo yara ni ofo, ejaakɛ afã klante awo miwebii lɛ.
Afã klante awo Israel lumɛi fɛɛ.
Ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ miwebii lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ahã klante; hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyia nyɛhe ma.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa miibi, akɛ, ‘Nyɛjwɛŋa he jogbaŋŋ, ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛkwa tsɔsemɔ lɛ toigbalamɔ lɛ baŋ lo?’ ” “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, no hewɔ lɛ, gbaa.
Tswaa odɛ̃ koni klante lɛ ni baagbe mɛi lɛ abamɔ amɛ nɔtonɔto.
No ji klante ni baakpãtã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ lɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, gbele ebɔle amɛhe kɛkpe; koni amɛshe gbeyei, ni mɛi babaoo agbeegbee shi hewɔ mitsɔ̃ klante lɛ naa mihã maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ anaa.
Mikɛ klante ni kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ srawa lɛ ehã.
Ehe miikpɛ tamɔ srawa.
Asha he kɛha mɔgbee.
Klante, bãa kɛya ninejurɔ ni obã kɛya abɛku, tsɔ̃ ohe ni ofo kɛya he fɛɛ he.
Hã enyɔ loo mli.
Mi hu matswa midɛ̃, ni mimlifu lɛ naa aba shi.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie.” Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ klante lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kadimɔ gbɛjegbɛi enyɔ nɔ ni Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ eklante lɛ aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba lɛ.
Gbɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ aaanyɛ ajɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ kɛba.
Too gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ okadi oma maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ.
Okadi lɛ ekome atsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ eklante lɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ kɛba Raba, ni ji Amonbii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli; okadi kroko lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ gbɛ kɛya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbote Yerusalɛm ni atswa gbogbo awo ehe lɛ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Ejaakɛ Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ damɔ gbɛnta lɛ naa, yɛ he ni gbɛi enyɔ lɛ gbaa akloŋta yɛ lɛ.
Ebaahoso gãimlibii kɛkla ni eeebi emãgãi lɛ anii, ni eeekwɛ afɔle kooloo ni agbe lɛ mlɛbo mli fitsofitso.
Eklamɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ ninejurɔgbɛ kɛya Yerusalɛm, koni ebɔ ta oshe, ni awo naa nɔ abolɔ, ni aŋɔ gbogbokuumɔnii apiŋ agboi lɛ ahe, ni atswa kpokui ni amãmɔ mɔji ni wa.
Eeefee Yerusalɛmbii lɛ akɛ klamɔ ni bɛ mli ni, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ maji ekpãŋ, shi moŋ esa akɛ amɛkai amɛnɔsha lɛ akɛ abaamɔmɔ amɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Akɛni nyɛha ana eshai ni nyɛfee lɛ, ni nyɛnifɔɔjianii eje kpo yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ mli, ni mikai nyɛ hewɔ lɛ abaamɔmɔ nyɛ kɛya nomŋɔɔ mli.
Bo Israel lumɔ, yiwalɔ ni he tseee, bo ni obe eshɛ kɛhã onaagbee toigbalamɔ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ bo nɛ, Jiemɔ oyifiinɔ lɛ, ni jiemɔ okekre lɛ yɛ oyitso.
Nibii ehiŋ shi tamɔ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ nɛɛ dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eba shi lɛ, awo nɔ; ni nɔ ni awo nɔ lɛ, aba lɛ shi.
Butumɔ!
Butumɔ!
Butumɔ mabutu maŋ lɛ.
Anaŋ he okadi ko kwraa kɛyaashi mɔ gbɛnaa ni ji lɛ aaaba, ni lɛ maŋɔ hã.” Klante lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ “Ni bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ Amonbii lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nyɛ yɛ ahora ni amɛbɔɔ Israel lɛ he nɛ; kɛɛmɔ akɛ: ‘Klante, agbala klante kɛhã gbɔmɔgbee; asha he kaŋkaŋ, ni ekpɛ tamɔ srawa.’ ” “Nii ni nyɛnaa lɛ amale ninaa ni, ni nyɛgbalɛi hu amale gbalɛi ni, koni nyɛkɛ sɔ̃ lɛ afɔ̃ lumɛi kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji ni egboi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛ lɛ, amɛnaagbee hiɛkpãtãmɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
Kɛ klante awo ehebo lɛ mli, Makojo bo yɛ he ni abɔ bo yɛ, kɛ shikpɔŋ ni ojɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ.
Mimli baawo bo la, ni mimlifu ni naa wa ni tsoɔ tamɔ la lɛ aaaba onɔ; ni majie bo mawo hii dikalɔi yitsoŋwalɔi ni le nifitemɔ he ŋaa lɛ adɛŋ.
Nyɛbaatsɔ̃ latɛ naa lai; aaashwie nyɛlá shi akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni akaiŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.”
Nifɔɔjianii ni Yerusalɛm fee lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ani oookojo, ani oookojo maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ mli lɛ?
Belɛ hã ele emusubɔɔnii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ emli, asaŋ ni efeɔ amãgãi ni ekɛbuleɔ ehe lɛ; ebe aaashɛ, lá shi ni oshwie kɛ amãgãi ni ofee okɛbule ohe lɛ hewɔ lɛ oye fɔ; ehã ogbii lɛ ebɛŋkɛ; afii ni ato ahã bo lɛ eshɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miha jeŋmaji lɛ miibɔ bo ahora, ni shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ miiye ohe fɛo.
Mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ bo kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ aaaye ohe fɛo, bo mɔ ni ohe guɔ egbo, ni basabasafeemɔ eyi omli obɔ̃.
Naa, Israel lumɛi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tswaa efai shi akɛ ebaashwie lá shi yɛ omli, bɔ ni eeenyɛ.
Abuuu tsɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ omli, ayeɔ gbɔ amim yɛ omli; awaa awusa kɛ okulafo yi yɛ omli.
Obuuu minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni obuleɔ mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ.
Mɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni yeɔ osheku, bɔ ni afee ni ashwie mɛi alá shi; mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ afɔlei ni ashã ahã amãgãi lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi hu yɛ nyɛteŋ ni bɔɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi.
Mɛi komɛi kɛ amɛtsɛmɛi aŋamɛi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli, ni mɛi komɛi tuaa yei ni etee tsuiasɛɛ, ni amɛhe tseee lɛ yɛ omli.
Mɔ kɛ enaanyo ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ ebinuu ŋa naa bɔlɛ; mɔ ko hu kɛ enyɛmiyoo ni ji etsɛbi naa bɔlɛ yɛ omli.
Mɛi heɔ nyɔɔŋnii, koni ashwie lá shi yɛ omli; aheɔ hekpa ni fe nine, ni atswaa nanemɛi ojo.
Nyɛhiɛ ekpa minɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, mitswa midɛ̃ mishwie onɔ yɛ shishiumɔnii ni ona kɛ lá shi ni oshwie yɛ omli lɛ hewɔ.
Gbi ni mikɛ bo aaaye lɛ, aso ooonyɛ naa odamɔ?
Aloo ooonyɛ onine nɔ po owo?
Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni mafee.
Magbɛ omlibii lɛ mashwã jeŋmaji kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛaatsuu ohe muji lɛ mashwie.
Ni ohe guɔ baagbo yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ, ni ooona ole akɛ mi ji Yehowa lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ niiahetsuumɔ flɔnɔɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, Israel we lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ shika shishi ehã mi.
Amɛ fɛɛ kwa lɛ, jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ sanyaa kɛ dade kɛ sumui ni asere yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ shishi muji ji amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Akɛni nyɛ blublu nyɛtsɔmɔ shika shishi hewɔ lɛ, naa, mabua nyɛnaa mawo Yerusalɛm, taakɛ bɔ ni mɛi buaa jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ sumui kɛ tsɛnsi naa amɛwoɔ flɔnɔɔ mli ni ahuɔ la awoɔ he, ni asereɔ lɛ, nakai mikɛ mlifu kɛ mlila aaabua nyɛnaa, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaawo la mli ni masere nyɛ.
Mabua nyɛnaa ni mahuu mimlifu mlila lɛ mashwie nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛbaasere.
Bɔ ni jwiɛtɛi sereɔ yɛ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaasere nyɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm; ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mihuu mimlila lɛ mishwie nyɛnɔ.’ ” Israel Hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ ahe eshai lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel akɛ, bo ji shikpɔŋ ko ni ohe tseee, ni nu hu enɛŋ onɔ yɛ mimlifu be lɛ mli.
Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ jatai ni huuɔ ni amɛmiitserɛ amɛmilɛ loo mli; amɛkpãtã gbɔmɛi awala ahiɛ; amɛshɔ̃ mɛi ajwetri kɛ nii ni jara wa yɛ amɛdɛŋ; amɛhã yei pii etsɔmɔ okulafoi yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Omli osɔfoi lɛ ku mimlai lɛ amli, ni amɛbule minii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ; amɛhãaa ana srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni abule teŋ; asaŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tse kɛ nɔ ni he tseee teŋ, ni amɛbuuu mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, abule mi yɛ amɛteŋ.
“Emli lumɛi lɛ tamɔ klãji ni tserɛɔ milɛloo mli, amɛshwieɔ lá shi, amɛkpãtãa mɛi ahiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo shishiumɔ ninamɔ.
Emli gbalɔ lɛ maleɔ ekɛhaa eshai nɛɛ anɔ tamɔ akɛ kaaloo shaa gbogbo he lɛ.
Amɛnaa amale ninaa, ni amɛgbaa amale gbalɛi akɛ, ‘Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ.’ Be mli ni mi, Yehowa miwieko tete.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ tswaa ojo, ni amɛjuɔ; amɛwaa ohiafoi kɛ mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ ayi, ni amɛyeɔ gbɔ amim, ni atooo lɛ najiaŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ, mitao akɛ mana mɔ ko kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ni eeetswa gbogbo ni ewule lɛ, ni eeebu folɔ lɛ naa yɛ mihiɛ ehã shikpɔŋ lɛ, koni mikafite lɛ; shi minaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo amɛ la, ni mikɛ mlifu plenee amɛ, ni miha amɛmusu ebua amɛyiteŋ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɛmimɛiyei eshafeelɔi lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, yei enyɔ komɛi, ni ji yoo kome musuŋbii hi shi.
Be ni amɛ ji oblayei yɛ Ijipt lɛ amɛbɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi, ni jɛi atara amɛfufɔi ahe yɛ, ni jɛi hu afite amɛ yɛ.
Onukpa lɛ gbɛi ji Ohola, ni fioo lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Oholiba.
Mikɛ amɛ hi shi, ni mikɛ amɛ fɔfɔɔ bihii kɛ biyei.
Ohola damɔ shi kɛha Samaria, ni Oholiba damɔ shi kɛhã Yerusalɛm.
Ohola je misɛɛ ni eyabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ehiɛ yakɔ̃ esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii lɛ anɔ.
Tabilɔi ni woɔ afaseo atadei ji amɛ; amraloi kɛ lumɛi kɛ oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi sɔŋŋ ji amɛ.
Asiria hii ni ajegbɛ ahala lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛ amɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ, eja amɛwɔji lɛ, ni ekɛbule ehe.
Efɔ̃ko ajwamãŋbɔɔ ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Ijipt lɛ, ejaakɛ hii kɛ lɛ wɔ eblayeiaŋ ni amɛmiamia eblayeiaŋ kpokpoai lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ lɛ basabasa tamɔ ajwamãŋ ko.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitu lɛ miwo esuɔlɔi lɛ ni ji Asiriabii ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛ jie eyayaiaŋ kpo amɛmɔmɔ ebihii kɛ ebiyei lɛ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛkɛ klante gbe lɛ; ni etsɔ wiemɔ ni yei kɛyeɔ fɛo akɛ akojo lɛ.
“Oholiba na nɔ ni ba enyɛmi yoo Ohola nɔ lɛ nɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ehiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ naa wa fe Ohola nɔ lɛ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ hu fe enyɛmi yoo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Oholiba hiɛ kɔ̃ Asiriabii ni ji amralofoi kɛ lumɛi kɛ tabilɔi ni ewula kɛ tayaa atadei kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi, ni ji oblahii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mina akɛ ebule ehe, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kome nɔ.
“Shi Oholiba tee nɔ lolo kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ; ena Babilon hii mfonirii ni akɛ atiifɔ tsuru etɛŋ yɛ gbogbo he.
Ena akɛ amɛkɛ hɛfiinii efimɔ amɛhɛi, ni amɛkɛ yitsofiinii kakadaji efimɔ amɛyitsei; mfoniri nɛɛ mli bii lɛ tamɔ Babilon lumɛi ni afɔ yɛ Kaldea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni ena amɛfonirii lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ kɔ̃ amɛnɔ, ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtee lumɛi nɛɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ Babilon.
Kɛkɛ ni Babilon hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ bawɔ, ni amɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ bule lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛ amɛ ewo ehe muji egbe naa lɛ amɛje etsine.
Bɔ ni ebɔ ajwamãŋ faŋŋ lɛ, ni ejie eyayaiaŋ kpo lɛ hã esane je mitsine tamɔ bɔ ni enyɛmi yoo lɛ sane je mitsine lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ etee nɔ ebɔ ejwamaŋ lɛ fe nine, ni ekai eblayeiaŋ bei amli ni eyɔɔ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni ebɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ.
Ehemɛi ni ehiɛ kɔ̃ɔ amɛnɔ nɛɛ anuutso tamɔ teji nɔ, ni amɛhenu hu tamɔ okpɔŋɔ he nu.
Bo, Oholiba, nɛkɛ oshwe oblayeiaŋ basabasa nyiɛmɔi ni onyiɛ, be ni Ijiptbii lɛ miamia ofufɔi, ni amɛfite bo lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ kojo Oholiba “No hewɔ lɛ, bo Oholiba, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa mibatee osuɔlɔi ni amɛje otsine lɛ shi mawo bo, ni maha amɛte shi amɛwo bo kɛjɛ he fɛɛ he.
Maha hii ni he yɔɔ akɔnɔ ajɛ Babilon kɛ Kaldea kɛ Pekod kɛ Shoa kɛ Koa kɛ Asiria fɛɛ aba.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ oblahii kɛ amraloi kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi kɛ gbɛnaahiɛlɔi kɛ tabilɔi ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ ji amɛ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ ta shwiilii kɛ tsɔnei ni gbalaa nii aaajɛ kooyigbɛ aba; ni amɛaagba amɛwo ohe kɛ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ dade fai, ni maha amɛ hegbɛ ni amɛkojo bo yɛ amɛmlai anaa.
Mimli aaafu bo koni amɛkɛ bo aye yɛ mlila naa.
Amɛaafolɔ ogugɔ kɛ otoii, ni amɛkɛ klante aaagbegbee omɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ.
Amɛaaloo obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ kɛaaya, ni omɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ la aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Amɛaakpɔlɔ otadei lɛ yɛ ohe, ni amɛaajie ojwinei fɛɛfɛji lɛ.
Bɔ ni mafee ni mikɛku ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ni obɔi kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa nɛ; no aaahã owoŋ ohiɛ nɔ okwɛ Ijiptbii lɛ, ni okaiŋ amɛ hu dɔŋŋ.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mibatu bo mawo ohenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni eje otsine lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛkɛ bo aaaye yɛ yiwalɛ naa.
Amɛaaloo nii ni ogbo deŋme yɛ he lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛaashi bo yayai kɛ ohe pasaa: ni amɛaajie ojwamaŋbɔɔ yayaiaŋ kpo.
Ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ ji nɔ ni kɛ enɛ ba onɔ.
Aaafee bo enɛɛmɛi ejaakɛ okɛ jeŋmaji lɛ yabɔbɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni oyanyiɛ amɛwɔji lɛ asɛɛ ni okɛwo ohe muji, Onyiɛ onyɛmi yoo lɛ nanefaamɔi lɛ asɛɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, magbala otoi tamɔ migbala etoi lɛ nɔŋŋ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Ooonu nii kɛaajɛ onyɛmi yoo lɛ kpulu lɛ mli; emli kwɔ, ni eda.
Abaaŋmɔ bo, ni abaaye ohe fɛo.
Ejaakɛ emli nii lɛ fa.
Dãa aaatɔ bo, ni owerɛ aaaho ohe.
Onyɛmi yoo Samaria toigbalamɔ lɛ gbeyei kɛ fitemɔ kpulu ni.
Obaanu nii yɛ mli, ni ooolɛmɔ mli.
Ooofamɔ oyitsɔi tete, ni oootserɛ ofufɔi ahe; ejaakɛ mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ nɛ, “Akɛni ohiɛ ekpa minɔ, ni oshɛ mi ofɔ osɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, obaana ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ ojwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ he nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ kojo yei enyɔ lɛ Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa ani obaakojo Ohola kɛ Oholiba?
Belɛ jajemɔ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfee lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛfite gbãlã, ni amɛshwie lá shi; amɛkɛ amɛwɔji lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni bii ni mikɛ amɛfɔ lɛ, tete amɛkɛ amɛ fee niyenii amɛkɛhã amɛwɔji.
Asaŋ nɔ hu ni amɛfee mi nɛ: amɛwo mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, ni amɛbule mihejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ gbi ni amɛgbe amɛbii lɛ amɛhã amɛwɔji lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛbabule mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛbafee miwe lɛ.
“Asaŋ, amɛtsu bɔfoi kɛtee majiasɛɛ shɔŋŋ tete po ayaŋɔ hii abaha amɛ; ni kɛ amɛba lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ yei enyɔ nɛɛ juɔ amɛhe, ni amɛdikiɔ amɛhiŋmɛii asɛɛ kɛ adibri, ni amɛwulaa amɛhe kɛ jwinei.
Amɛtaa saa fɛɛfɛo nɔ, ni aŋmɛɔ okplɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ mitsofakɛŋma kɛ mimu lɛ mamɔɔ nɔ.
Anu mɛi babaoo anyamɔ gbee yɛ jɛi, ni ayaŋɔ dãatɔlɔi kɛjɛ ŋa nɔ kɛba ni amɛkɛ nineshigai bawo yei lɛ aniji, ni amɛkɛ akekrei fɛɛfɛji fimɔ amɛyitsei.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, hii ni kɛ yoo nɛɛ wɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee ajwamãŋ amɛbɔɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ amɛkɛ lɛ yawɔɔ tamɔ akɛ yoo ajwamãŋ wɔɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ amɛkɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ Ohola kɛ Oholiba ni ji yei nyɛnyɛŋtswii lɛ yawɔ.
Shi kojolɔi jalɔi baabu amɛ fɔ akɛ gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ yei láshishwielɔi, ejaakɛ gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ láshishwielɔi ji amɛ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Mahã asafo yuu abatua amɛ ni awo amɛhe gbeyei ní aha amɛ.
Asafo lɛ atswia amɛ tɛi, ni amɛkɛ amɛklantei lɛ ashwie amɛ; ni amɛaagbegbee amɛbihii kɛ biyei lɛ, ni amɛaashãshãa amɛshĩai lɛ.
Nɛkɛ mafee ni mikɛku ahoshwibɔɔ naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kwraa koni akɛbɔ yei fɛɛ kwa kɔkɔ ni amɛkabɔ ajwamãŋ nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ tamɔ nyɛfee lɛ.
Ni mawo nyɛ yei enyɔ nɛɛ, nyɛjwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛ nyɛwɔji lɛ bule lɛ he nyɔmɔ, ni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa.”
Dadesɛŋ ni edɔ ŋkanale lɛ Nomŋɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ afi ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ŋmãa ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ ofɔ̃ shi, ejaakɛ ŋmɛnɛ ji gbi krɛdɛɛ nɔ ni Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ sa Yerusalɛm yi lɛ.
Buu weku ni toi egbo lɛ abɛ nɛɛ, ni okɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Okɛ dadesɛŋ ama la nɔ, ni okɛ nu awo mli.
Okɛ loo ni afolɔ lɛ kukulii awo mli: hei ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ eshuɔ lɛ kɛ ekɔŋ lɛ akɛ wui ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ afata he ni eyi obɔ̃.
Ŋɔɔ too ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ ateŋ ekome, too lai owo latɛŋ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ shishi.
Ha ni nu lɛ atswa, hoomɔ, ni wui lɛ tete abe.” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Kpoo hã maŋ ni ashwieɔ lá shi yɛ emli; nakai maŋ lɛ, etamɔ dadesɛŋ ni mli edɔ ŋkanale, ni ŋkanale lɛ yɛ mli lolo.
Kɔlɔmɔ loi lɛ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ mli ekomekome, kaahala mli.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni agbe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ alá yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lolo.
Lá nɛɛ jwere tɛsaa kpataa nɔ, jeee shikpɔŋ nɔ eshwie bɔ ni akɛ su aaanyɛ aha nɔ.
Mihã mɛi ahiɛ ni akpãtã lɛ alá lɛ shwie tɛsaa kplanaa lɛ nɔ, koni akanyɛ nɔ su aha, bɔ ni afee ni etee mimlifu shi ni ehã matɔ he owele.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, kpoo ha maŋ ni ashwie lá shi yɛ emli lɛ.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ hu mato laii pii mawo eshishi.
Ha lai lɛ afa, shɛremɔ la lɛ, hoomɔ loo lɛ ni ebe jogbaŋŋ, ni otsɔ̃ wonu lɛ yɛ dadesɛŋ lɛ mli; ha wui lɛ tete aŋala.
Agbɛnɛ kɛ dadesɛŋ folo lɛ ama ŋai la lɛ nɔ koni edɔ klakla, ni akɔɔble dadesɛŋ lɛ atsu hɛŋŋ, bɔ ni afee ni emli muji lɛ asere, ni ŋkanale lɛ aje kwraa.
Migbo he yaka deŋme, shi kɛ̃lɛ, emli ŋkanale titrii lɛ, lá tete nyɛɛɛ ajie.
Ohiɛkɔ̃ɔ kɛ mujinii lɛ no ji ŋkanale lɛ.
Akɛni kulɛ mitsuu ohe ni ohe atse shi ohe tseee hewɔ lɛ, hii shi yɛ ohe muji lɛ mli kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni matɔ mihe owele, ni mimii aaashɛ mihe.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie, ni ebaaba mli, ni mafee hu, mifɔŋ, ni minaŋ mɔbɔ, ni mishwaŋ mihe hu; bɔ ni ojeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni onifeemɔnii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ nakai naa makojo bo yɛ; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Gbalɔ lɛ ŋa gbo Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, naa, mibaŋɔ mɔ ni ji ohiŋmɛi mli ajaŋmalaatɛ lɛ trukaa kɛje ohe kɛya.
Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ kaawo yara, ni okafo hu, ni ohiŋmɛiŋ akakpala nu tete.
Fo yɛ osɛŋ, kaahã oyaafo je kpo ni anu yɛ onaabu.
Kaafee yara ko.
Okɛ obɔnduku lɛ afi oyitso, ni owo otokotai lɛ; okɛ mama ko akabala onaabu, ni kaaye yara nɔ niyenii hu.” Mikɛ maŋ lɛ wie leebi mli, ni gbɛkɛ mli lɛ, miŋa lɛ gbo.
Hewɔ lɛ enɔ jetsɛremɔ leebi lɛ, mifee bɔ ni afã mi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ?
Ani oootsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni ofeɔ nɛɛ shishi?” Mihã amɛ hetoo akɛ, “Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, Kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Naa, mibabule mihekrɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji nyɛhewalɛ ni nyɛkɛwoɔ nyɛhe nɔ lɛ; he krɔŋkrɔŋ ni ji nyɛhiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ lɛ kɛ nyɛsusumai ashwee lɛ.
Nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei ni nyɛshi yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, akɛ klante baagbe amɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ bɔ ni mifee mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ: nyɛkɛ mama eblaŋ nyɛnaabui, ni nyɛyeŋ yara nɔ niyenii hu.
Nyɛbaafimɔ nyɛbɔnduku lɛ, ni nyɛtokotai lɛ aahi nyɛnaji, nyɛwoŋ yara, asaŋ nyɛfoŋ, shi moŋ yɛ nyɛnishaianii ahewɔ lɛ, nyɛaatãrã loo, ni nyɛaakɛ̃mɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛhe.
Enɛ baaha Ezekiel atsɔ̃ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ahã nyɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeefee lɛ, nakai nyɛaafee.
Kɛji enɛ ba mli lɛ, no dani nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa lɛ.
“Agbɛnɛ lɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbi nɔ ni mafite amɛSɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ji amɛmiishɛɛ kɛ amɛhiɛnyam, amɛhiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ kɛ amɛtsuiŋ nitaomɔnii lɛ, ni makpãtã amɛbihii kɛ amɛbiyei lɛ hu ahiɛ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ni lɛ lɛ ehe eje hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ mli lɛ aaaba oŋɔɔ abatswa bo adafi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ aaagbele onaabu, ni okɛ mɔ ni he eje mli lɛ aaawie, ni otɔŋ mu dɔŋŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, oootsɔ̃ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ oha amɛ, ni amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Amon he Gbalɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ ohã Amonbii lɛ, ni ogba oshi amɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ Amonbii lɛ akɛ, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa wiemɔ toi, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, akɛni nyɛnya, ejaakɛ abule miHe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni afee Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni aŋɔ Yuda we lɛ nom lɛ hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ bo maha mɛi ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ni amɛye onɔ.
Amɛbaafee tabilɔi ashitoohei yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, amɛbaato maji amɛhi mli yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; amɛbaaye otsei ayibii lɛ, ni amɛaanu otsina fufɔ lɛ.
Maha Rama atsɔ̃ yoomai aniyelihe, ni maha Amonbii amaji wuji lɛ baatsɔ toi atsu.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni otswa odɛ̃, ni otumɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, ni okɛ yiŋsha ni yɔɔ omli fɛɛ nya, ni oye Israel yɔɔ waa hewɔ lɛ, naa, mite shi miwo bo, ni maŋɔ bo mahã jeŋmaji lɛ ni amɛha onibii.
Makpãtã ohiɛ yɛ majimaji fɛɛ ateŋ; ni mafite bo yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; makpãtã ohiɛ, ni ooona ole akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Moab he gbalɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Akɛni Moab kɛɛ akɛ, naa, Yuda tamɔ shikpɔji krokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, mifite Moab anunyam maji wuji ni buɔ ehusu nɔ lɛ.
Maji nɛɛ ji Bet-Yeshimot kɛ Baal-Meon kɛ Kiriataim.
No baahã Moab he akã aha henyɛlɔi.
Mikɛ Moab baafata Amonbii lɛ ahe maha bokãgbɛbii lɛ ni amɛŋɔ, ni akaiŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ.
Mibagbala Moabbii atoi, ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Edom he Gbalɛ “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni Edom tɔ ehe owele yɛ Yuda we lɛ nɔ, ni yɛ oweletɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ etɔ̃ babaoo lɛ, hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mate shi mawo Edom, ni makpãtã emli gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ hiɛ; ni mafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃; ni kɛjɛ Teman aahu kɛyashi Dedan lɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa.
Mibatsɔ̃ mimaŋ Israelbii anɔ matɔ mihe owele yɛ Edom nɔ.
Israelbii kɛ Edom baaye yɛ mimlifu kɛ mimlila naa.
Ni amɛaale bɔ ni mitɔɔ owele mihãa.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Filistia he Gbalɛ “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni Filistibii lɛ to yiŋsha yɛ amɛtsuiŋ ni amɛkɛtɔ mɛi ni ji amɛhenyɛlɔi kɛjɛ teteete lɛ anɔ owele, ni amɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ kwraa kɛmɔ shi hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa mate shi mawo Filistibii lɛ, ni maplene Keretibii lɛ, ni makpãtã mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ ahiɛ.
Mikɛ mlifu kpele baakã amɛ, ni matɔ mihe owele jogbaŋŋ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, kɛji mitɔ mihe owele yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ.”
Tiro he Gbalɛ Be ni wɔyɔɔ wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, akɛni Tiro kɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm he akɛ, ‘Yiɛ, akumɔ maŋbii agbo lɛ, enaa kã hã mi.
Ni akɛni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ nɛɛ lɛ, mibashwere!’ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Bo Tiro, naa, mikɛ bo ena, ni mahã majimaji babaoo ate shi awo bo tamɔ ŋshɔkei kumɔɔ lɛ.
Amɛbaafite Tiro gbogboi lɛ, ni amɛbaakumɔ emɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ amɛshwie shi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mabɛɛ enɔ su tete, ni mafee lɛ tɛsaa kpataa.
Eeetsɔ̃ mɔ ni jeŋmaji aaaha enii.
Ni eshikpɔji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔ hu akɛ klante baagbe maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ Tirobii aaana ale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, maha Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, ni ji maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi kɛ asraafoi babaoo ajɛ kooyigbɛ abatua Tiro.
Ekɛ klante baakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ ohewɔ maji ni jwere ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ ahiɛ, eeetswa ka gbogbo ewo ohe, ni eeetswa kpoku ewo ohe; ni ekɛ tsɛŋi babaoo baaba abatua bo.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baahã akɛ gbogbokuumɔnii lɛ ashimɔ ogbogboi lɛ, ni akɛ lemai aaakumɔ omɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ.
Ekpɔŋɔi ayifalɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ, amɛnaneshi mlu kpɔŋŋ lɛ aaatsi onɔ.
Kɛji eetsɔ̃ ogboi lɛ amli kɛbote omaŋ lɛ mli tamɔ aboteɔ maŋ ni ajwa egbogbo awo mli lɛ, ekpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ abolɔmɔ kɛ enigbalamɔ shwiilii kɛ eta shwiilii agbɛɛmɔ naawalɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ ogbogboi lɛ aaahoso.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ kɛ ekpɔŋɔi lɛ akoklotoi lɛ aaanaanaa oblohuŋ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ekɛ klante aaakpãtã omaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ, ni okulashiŋi ni wa lɛ aaagbeegbee shi.
Ohenyɛlɔi lɛ baaha ojwetrii kɛ oguɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, amɛbaakumɔ ogbogboi lɛ, ni amɛbaafite oshĩai fɛɛfɛji lɛ; ni tɛi lɛ kɛ tsei lɛ kɛ sũ lɛ tete amɛbaaloo amɛyawo ŋshɔ mli.
Mahã olalai lɛ agbɛɛmɔ sɛɛ afo, ni anuŋ okpãa saŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ dɔŋŋ.
“Mahã otsɔ̃ tɛsaa kpataa, he ni akaa yaa yɛ.
Asaŋ bo amaŋ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, miwie.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Tiro nɛ, ani ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ ahe kpokpoŋ yɛ oshigbeemɔ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ naa, be ni pilafoi miikɛ̃mɔ, ni aakpãtã omɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ omli lɛ?
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋshɔhiɛ lumɛi fɛɛ aaajɛ amɛsɛ̃ii anɔ akpeleke shi, amɛaajie amɛtadei lɛ, amɛaakpɔlɔ amɛheboi wuji ni alo nii awo mli lɛ, amɛaabu hekpokpomɔ tamɔ abuɔ mama, amɛaashwata shikpɔŋ ni amɛhe baakpokpo blibli; be fɛɛ be lɛ amɛhe baajɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ohewɔ.
Amɛaawo yara yɛ ohewɔ amɛaakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Bo maŋ ni ogbɛi ehehe, ni okɛ omlibii fɛɛ hiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ hewalɛ; bo, ni ohe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɔle bo yɛ shikpɔŋ, te aye tɛŋŋ ni osha shi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ nɛɛ?
Agbɛnɛ, ŋshɔkpɔi lɛ ahe miikpokpo gbi nɔ ni ogbee shi lɛ.
Hɛɛ, ŋshɔkpɔi ni yɔɔ ŋshɔŋ anaa ekpɛ amɛhe yɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ hewɔ.’ “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kɛji mifee omaŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, tamɔ maji ni gbɔmɛi bɛ mli lɛ eko, kɛji mihã ŋshɔŋ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ baha onɔ, ni nu babaoo tsimɔ onɔ lɛ, no ni manyɛ onɔ koni okɛ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ ayafata blemabii ni yɔɔ jɛi momo lɛ ahe.
Maha bo kɛ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ ahi shi yɛ gbohiiaje yɛ naanɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ko akahi omli dɔŋŋ, aloo ona gbɛhe ko yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu.
Maha onaagbee afee gbeyei, ni ohiŋ shi dɔŋŋ; tsɛbelɛ mɛi aaatao bo nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ, anaŋ bo dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Tiro yarafeemɔ lala Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Tiro ŋkɔmɔ, ni okɛɛ Tiro, maŋ ni kã ŋshɔnaa, ni ekɛ ŋshɔnaa majimaji yeɔ guɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Ao Tiro, okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mihe yɛ fɛo kɛwula shi.’ Ohusu yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ.
Mɛi ni kpɛ bo akɛ lɛlɛ lɛ kpɛ bo fɛɛfɛo kɛwula shi.
Amɛkɛ Hermon Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ sɛsɛotsei sɔŋŋ hɛhɛ bo, ni Lebanon tsenedru akɛfee oshimaatso lɛ.
Bashan tsei wuji akɛgbɔ tablɔi lɛ.
Kipro tsei akɛfee odɛke, ni akɛ shuɔ wu ka mli.
Obalaa lɛ Ijipt klala fɛɛfɛo ni alo nii awo mli akɛfee; no nɔŋŋ ji oflaŋaa Onɔhaa buu lɛ, mama bluu kɛ afaseo ni akɛjɛ Kipro ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ akɛfee.
Sidonbii kɛ Arvadbii ji owirilɔi.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ omli ŋaalɔi ji okudɔɔtsɛmɛi.
Gebal onukpai kɛ ŋaalɔi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji srɛŋkifoi ni tsimɔɔ omli fɔ̃ji lɛ.
Ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛji kɛ amɛsraafoi fɛɛ baa omli amɛbayeɔ bo jara.
“Persiabii kɛ Ludbii kɛ Libiabii yɛ otabilɔi lɛ ateŋ; amɛkɛ tsɛŋ kɛ dade fai tsotsoroɔ shi yɛ otabilɔi ashihilɛhei lɛ amli; amɛ amɛhãa ohiɛ baa nyam.
Arvadhii kɛ Helekhii buɔ yɛ ogbogboi lɛ anɔ kɛkpeɔ, ni Gamad hii buɔ yɛ omɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ anɔ.
Amɛkɛ amɛtsɛŋi lɛ tsotsoroɔ ogbogboi lɛ ahe kɛkpeɔ.
Amɛ amɛhãa ohe feɔ fɛo kɛwulaa shi.
“Tarshishbii kɛ bo ye jara, ejaakɛ oyɛ guɔ nibii babaoo; amɛkɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ dade kɛ tsɛnsi kɛ sumui baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Helabii kɛ Tubalbii kɛ Meshekbii kɛ bo ye jara.
Amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ akɔɔble nibii baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔyeli nibii lɛ.
Togarmabii kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tawuu okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi baa ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Rodobii kɛ bo ye jara.
Ŋshɔnaa maji babaoo kɛ bo ye jara krɛdɛɛ ko; amɛ lɛ amɛkɛ shuɔ wu kɛ ebɔnetsei bawoɔ oguɔ nibii ni amɛbaheɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ.
Siria hu kɛ bo ye jara ejaakɛ oyɛ nii babaoo.
Amɛkɛ kafuŋklei, mama afaseo tsuru ni alo nii awo mli, kɛ klala kpakpa, kɛ tɛ̃ŋlɛo kɛ rubitɛi baa, ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ bo ye jara, amɛkɛ ŋmãa kɛ mu kɛ agbãmi kɛ wo kɛ mu kɛ tsofakɛŋma baa, ni amɛkɛbatsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Damasko kɛ bo ye oguɔ nibii babaoo lɛ he jara.
Ekɛ bo ye jara yɛ guɔ nibii srɔtoisrɔtoi babaoo ni oyɔɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
Ekɛ wain jɛɔ Helbon, ni akɛ toi ahetsɔi yɛŋ futaa jɛɔ Shar baa.
Amɛkɛ wain jɛɔ Uzal batsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Akɛ dade nibii kɛ kashia kɛ sinamon batsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Dedan kɛ bo ye okpɔŋɔtamɔ sɛi nɔ mama jara.
Arabiabii kɛ Kedar lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ ji mɛi ni osumɔ amɛ kɛ gwantɛŋbii kɛ ojwɛnii kɛ abotiai ajarayeli jogbaŋŋ.
Sheba kɛ Rama jarayelɔi kɛ bo ye jara.
Amɛkɛ tsofakɛŋmai fɛɛ mli ekpakpai kɛ tɛi ni jara wa fɛɛ kɛ shika baa batsakeɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
Haran kɛ Kane kɛ Eden kɛ Sheba kɛ Ashur kɛ Kilmad kɛ bo ye jara.
Maji nɛɛ kɛ bo ye atadei kpakpai kɛ mama bluu ni alo nii awo mli atadei, kɛ tsu mli kapɛtii ni hiɛ sui srɔtoi ni akɛ taŋkpee kpãa efimɔ mli kpɛŋŋ jara.
Tarshish lɛji lɛ woɔ oguɔ nibii lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, otamɔ lɛlɛ ni awo lɛ nii obɔ̃ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ.
Mɛi ni wiriɔ bo lɛ kɛ bo etee ŋshɔ teŋ tɔ̃ɔ; shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ ejwra bo yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ.
Oshika kɛ oguɔnii kɛ ojarayelinii kɛ osrafoi kɛ okudɔɔtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni tsimɔɔ ofɔji lɛ, kɛ oguɔyelɔi kɛ otabilɔi fɛɛ kɛ osafo muu fɛɛ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ shiu yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ, yɛ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Be ni okudɔɔtsɛmɛi lɛ bolɔ waa lɛ, shikpɔŋ hoso ni wirilɔi lɛ fɛɛ kpeleke shi kɛjɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli.
Asrɛfoi lɛ kɛ kudɔɔtsɛmɛi lɛ badamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Amɛwo ohe yara ni amɛfo bo waa.
Amɛloo mlu amɛwo amɛyiteŋ ni amɛkoklo lamlu mli.
Amɛshɛ amɛyi yɛ ohewɔ, ni amɛbu kpekpe.
Amɛwo yara, ni amɛfo bo waa kɛ dɔlɛ naakpa.
Yɛ amɛlelewomɔ lɛ mli lɛ amɛwo yaafo lala amɛkɛfo bo akɛ, ‘Namɔ akpãtã ehiɛ pɛŋ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ tamɔ Tiro?
Be ni akɛ oguɔ nibii jɛ ŋshɔŋ kɛba lɛ oha mɛi pii tɔrɔ; onii ni ona babaoo kɛ ojarayeli nibii lɛ, oha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi na nii.
Agbɛnɛ, ŋshɔ ejwra bo, ni oshiu kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi; oguɔ nibii kɛ osrafoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ bo eshiu.’ “Ŋshɔnaa majiaŋbii fɛɛ ahe ejɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ohewɔ, ni gbeyei ni naa wa emɔmɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ hu efee amɛ yaa.
Majimaji anɔ jarayelɔi miibo bo ‘tsiaa’, ejaakɛ onaagbee lɛ efee gbeyei, ni olaaje kɛmiiya naanɔ.”
Gbalɛ ni shiɔ Tiro Maŋtsɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa kɛɛmɔ Tiro lumɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Owoɔ ohe nɔ ni otsɛɔ ohe nyɔŋmɔ,’ Okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, ni mita nyɔŋmɔi lɛ alumɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋshɔteŋ;’ tsɛbelɛ gbɔmɔ adesa kɛkɛ ji bo, shi jeee nyɔŋmɔ ko.
Tsɛbelɛ obuɔ ohe akɛ ole nii tamɔ nɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ ji bo.
Efeɔ bo akɛ ole nii fe Daniel, ni teemɔŋ sane ko bɛ ni oleee.
Onilee kɛ oniiashishinumɔ eha ona nii; ona shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi owo ofotroi amli.
Jarayeli he nilee kpele ni oyɔɔ eha onii ni oyɔɔ efa babaoo; ni oninamɔ lɛ eha oowo ohe nɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ: akɛni efeɔ bo akɛ ole nii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔ ko hewɔ lɛ, naa, mahã gbɔi amaji lɛ ateŋ maŋ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe fɛɛ, abatua bo; amɛkɛ klante aaabakpãtã nibii fɛɛfɛji ni okɛ onilee na lɛ ahiɛ, amɛaahã onunyam aaaba shi.
Amɛbaanyɛ onɔ amɛwo gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni obaagbo; obaagbo mɛi ni gboiɔ yɛ ŋshɔ teŋ lɛ agbele lɛ eko.
Be ni oyɔɔ mɛi ni gbeɔ bo lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, ani ooonyɛ okɛɛ akɛ ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ko ji mi?’ Be mli ni gbɔmɔ kɛkɛ ji bo, shi ojeee nyɔŋmɔ ko lɛ?
Obaatsɔ gbɔi anine nɔ ni ogbo foolɔi agbele, ejaakɛ mi, miwie.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Tiro Maŋtsɛ lɛ butumɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Tiro maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, koni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ: bo lɛ, osɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ, ole nii jogbaŋŋ, ni ohe yɛ fɛo kɛwula shi.
Ohi Eden, Nyɔŋmɔ abɔɔ lɛ mli.
Okɛ tɛ fɛɛ tɛ ni jara wa wula ohe: ojarawatɛi ni ji, rubi kɛ daiamɔnd kɛ topasiɔn kɛ beril kɛ sardio kɛ yaspi kɛ safiro kɛ smaragdo kɛ gaanɛt.
Oyɛ fabii kɛ bɛji ni ashwie amɛhe shika.
Gbi nɔ ni abɔ bo lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ afee amɛ ahã bo.
Miha mibɔfo ni mifɔ lɛ mu bu ohe; ohi shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni onyiɛ tɛi ni tsoɔ tamɔ la ateŋ.
Kɛjɛ be ni abɔ bo lɛ shwamɔ ko bɛ ojeŋba he kɛyashi obɔi efɔŋfeemɔ.
Ojarayeli shweremɔ hewɔ lɛ awuiyeli yi bo obɔ̃, ni ofee esha; ni no hewɔ ni mishwie bo kɛje Nyɔŋmɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni bɔfo ni buɔ ohe lɛ shwie bo kɛje tɛi ni tsoɔ tamɔ la lɛ ateŋ.
Owo ohe ejaakɛ ohe yɛ fɛo.
Onilee ha ofee onii tamɔ buulu.
Miŋɔ bo mitswa shi; miŋmɛ bo yayai yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛkwɛ bo.
Onishaianii lɛ afalɛ yɛ ojarayeli mli anɔkwa ni oyeee lɛ, okɛbule ohei krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Mihã la je yɛ omli ni eshã bo wɛɛ, ni mihã otsɔ̃ lamlu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni na bo lɛ ahiɛ.
