Ni Maji ni le bo fɛɛ she gbeyei, ejaakɛ onaagbee yɛ gbeyei, ni olaaje kɛmiiya naanɔ.” Gbalɛ ni shiɔ Sidon Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ oha Sidon koni ogba oshi lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo Sidon, naa mikɛ bo ena, ni mawo mihiɛ nyam yɛ ohewɔ, ni omaŋbii kɛaale akɛ mi ji Yehowa, kɛji migbala mɛi ni yɔɔ omli lɛ atoi ni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ miha lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mibaha gbele hela abote omli, ni maha ashwie lá shi yɛ oblohui lɛ amli.
Gbohii aaajwere shi yɛ oblohui lɛ amli; mɛi aaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante ni akɛjɛ okoji anɔ fɛɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Aaajɔɔ Israel “Maji ni bɔle Israel we lɛ, ni amɛbɔ lɛ ahora lɛ ateŋ eko eteŋ shi epilaŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ, tamɔ ŋmei loo aklati.
No amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Kɛji mibua Israel we lɛ naa kɛjɛ majimaji ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã nɔ lɛ amli, ni miwo mihiɛ nyam kɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, no lɛ, amɛaahi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mitsulɔ Yakob lɛ.
Amɛbaahi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe, amɛbaamamɔ tsui, ni amɛbaafee waintromi.
Amɛbaahi shi shweshweeshwe be ni magbala majimaji ni bɔle amɛ, mɛi ni bɔ amɛ ahora lɛ atoi lɛ; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Ijipt he gbalɛ Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma lɛ mli nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ, gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Farao, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ogba oshi lɛ kɛ Ijipt muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mi kɛ bo ena, bo Farao ni ji, Ijipt Maŋtsɛ, bo baa wulu kpele ni yɔɔ efai lɛ amli ni oshwãa okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nilo Faa lɛ, minɔ ni, ni mi mibɔ mihã mihe.’ Mikɛ kpoŋ baala okadaa, ni mahã ofaa lɛ mli loi lɛ akpɛtɛ ohetotoi lɛ ahe; ni magbala bo kɛjɛ ofaa lɛ mli kɛ faa lɛ mli loi lɛ fɛɛ ni kpɛtɛ ohetotoi lɛ ahe lɛ kɛba.
Mibashɛ bo mafɔ ŋa lɛ nɔ, bo okɛ oloi ni jɛ ofaa lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ.
Obaaya oyagbee ŋa kplanaa nɔ, ni awoŋ bo, ni afuŋ bo hu.
Mikɛ bo eha shikpɔŋ kooloi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji ni amɛye bo.
Enɛ baaha Ijiptbii fɛɛ ana ale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa; ejaakɛ amɛtsɔmɔ glã amɛhã Israel we lɛ.” “Be ni amɛkɛ amɛnine mɔ omli lɛ, omli kumɔ, ni okpɔlɔ amɛkoji fɛɛ; be ni amɛkpasa bo lɛ, oku, ni amɛhɛ lɔŋe.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mafã klante mawo bo, ni maplene omli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi fɛɛ.
Ni maha Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ olɛŋlɛ.
No Ijiptbii kɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Akɛni okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nilo Faa lɛ minɔ ni, ni mi mibɔ lɛ,’ no hewɔ lɛ, naa, mi kɛ bo ena, ni mikɛ ofaa Nilo lɛ hu ena; ni mafee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ olɛŋlɛ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kwraa, kɛjɛ Migdol ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ kɛyashi Aswan ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ aahu kɛyashi Kush husui anɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Gbɔmɔ adesa ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ ni kooloo ko hu tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ.
Ahiŋ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.
Mafee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ shikpɔji amaŋfɔ̃i amli amaŋfɔ̃; ni emaji wuji lɛ hu aaatsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ maji ni akpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ ateŋ.
Mashwie Ijiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ.” Hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, “Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mabua Ijiptbii lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ mɛi ateŋ ni agbɛ amɛ ashwã lɛ.
Makpale Ijiptbii lɛ, ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba Patros ni ji Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛjɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ; ni amɛaahi jɛi akɛ mɛi ni aba amɛlumɔyeli shi.
Ebaatsɔ̃ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni aba lɛ shi fe fɛɛ, ni ewoŋ ehe nɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni maha ehewalɛ nɔ agbɔ bɔ ni eyeŋ maŋ ko maŋ ko nɔ lumɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ijipt efeŋ maŋ bɔ ni Israel we lɛ kɛ ehe baafɔ̃ enɔ dɔŋŋ, bɔ ni aaafee Ijipt ahã lɛ, eeehã Israel we lɛ akai akɛ etɔ̃ akɛ eyabi Ijipt dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ.
No Israel kɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa.” Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar baaye Ijipt nɔ kunim Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ kpawo lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, Babilon maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hã etabilɔi lɛ gbo deŋme ni naa wa yɛ Tiro tuamɔ hewɔ.
Ewebii lɛ tsu nii waa ni yiteŋ fɛɛ yiteŋ kpa, ni kɔŋ fɛɛ kɔŋ nɔ kpɔlɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ nãaa nɔ ko kɛjɛɛɛ Tiro akɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdeŋme ni amɛgbo yɛ Tiro tuamɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar dɛŋ; ni ebaaha emli nii, ni ebaakpãtã maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni emli jwetri lɛ ekɛbaaya; ni no baatsɔ̃ etabilɔi lɛ anyɔmɔwoo.
Mikɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ eha lɛ akɛ edeŋmegbomɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo, ejaakɛ mi etsu nii lɛ eha.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ maha hewalɛtsɛ ko ate shi yɛ Israel we lɛ ni magbele bo Ezekiel onaa ni owie yɛ amɛteŋ.
No amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Yehowa baagbala Ijipt toi Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛwoa lele!
Kpoo hã nakai gbi lɛ.
Gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ, Yehowa gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Gbi lɛ aaafee oblɔtu gbi.
Eeefee majimaji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ be.
Aaafã klante awo Ijipt ni ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ mɛi yɛ Kush.
Mɛi baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ Ijipt, ni abaaloo enii babaoo ni eyɔɔ lɛ kɛya; ni abaafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃.
“Akɛ klante baaplene Etiopiabii kɛ Ludbii kɛ Libiabii kɛ Arabbii kɛ Kubbii kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ hu ni kɛ Ijipt efee ekome lɛ.
“Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni fi Ijipt sɛɛ lɛ aaaplene, ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛshwãa lɛ baaba shi kɛjɛ Migdol ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛyashi Aswan yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ; amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa.
Mi, Yehowa miwie.
Eshikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔji ni ji amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli amaŋfɔ̃, ni emaji wuji lɛ hu baafata maji wuji ni abutu amɛ lɛ ahe.
Kɛji mima Ijipt naa la mishã, ni mikpãtã mɛi ni ye bua lɛ lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“Gbi nɔ ni mafite Ijipt lɛ, matsu tsuji kɛtsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli ni amɛyawo Etiopiabii ni kpaaa ta ko gbɛ lɛ ahe gbeyei.
Ijipt butumɔ lɛ baahã ŋmiŋmi amɔmɔ amɛ, ejaakɛ, naa, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ baana aba.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, matsɔ̃ Nebukadnezar, Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, nine nɔ mafo Ijipt ninamɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ.
Lɛ kɛ emɛi lɛ ji maŋ ni he yɔɔ gbeyei fe maji fɛɛ.
Amɛbaaba amɛbakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; amɛbaafã klante amɛwo Ijipt, ni amɛbaahã gbohii ayi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ obɔ̃ tɔ.
Ni mahã Nilo Faa lɛ amii; ni mikɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ baawo mɛi fɔ̃ji adɛŋ.
Matsɔ̃ mɛi kpɔ̃ji anine nɔ, ni mahã shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni mafite nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mafite amɛmɔji lɛ; ni mahã akumɔ amɛmãgãi ni yɔɔ Memfis lɛ.
Ayeŋ lumɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ Ijipt, ni mahã Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aba gbeyei.
Mahã Patros, ni yɔɔ Ijipt wuoyigbɛ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni mawo la mashã Zoan ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ; ni magbala Tebes maŋ wulu lɛ toi.
Mimli baawo la waa awo Pelusium ni ji Ijipt mɔɔ ni wa lɛ, ni maplene asafo yuu ni yɔɔ Tebis lɛ.
Mawo la mashã Ijipt, ni Pelusium baakɛ̃mɔ.
Abaawule ni akumɔ Tebes gbogboi lɛ ashwie shi.
Oblahii ni yɔɔ Awen kɛ Pi-Beset baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, ni aaaŋɔ amɛyei lɛ nom.
Duŋ baawo shwane yɛ Tehafnehes, gbi nɔ ni mafite Ijipt nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ, ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛwoɔ ehe lɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Atatu ko baaha Ijipt nɔ, ni abaaŋɔ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ nom.
Bɔ ni magbala Ijipt toi maha nɛ, ni no ekɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.” Ijipt Maŋtsɛ hewalɛ fitemɔ Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ mli klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, miku Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nine; ni naa, akɛ flanɔfii mama efiko nɔ, koni etsa ni emli awa bɔ ni eeenyɛ klante mli emɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ Farao ni ji, Ijipt Maŋtsɛ lɛ, ena, ni makumɔ eniji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akumɔ momo lɛ fɛɛ, ni maha klante lɛ aje edɛŋ agbee shi.
Mashwie Ijiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ, ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ.
Ni mawo Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ, ni mikɛ miklante lɛ baawo edɛŋ; shi Farao lɛ, lɛ lɛ maku enine, ni eeekɛ̃mɔ yɛ Babilon Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ mɔ ni apila lɛ gbele nɔ.
Mawaje Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ, shi Farao niji aaakpɔlɔ; ni amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji, Yehowa.
Kɛji mikɛ miklante lɛ wo Babilon maŋtsɛ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ, eeefã ewo Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mashwie Ijiptbii lɛ mawo majimaji lɛ anɔ ni magbɛ amɛ mashwã shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; ni amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Akɛ Ijipt to Seda tso he Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, bi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, Namɔ nyɛtamɔ yɛ agbojee mli?
Naa, nyɛtamɔ Asiria, ni mikɛ miito Lebanon tsenedru kɛ eniji fɛɛfɛji kɛ eshishi hɔɔŋ, tso grɔŋŋ ni eyiteŋ shɛɔ atatuiaŋ he.
Ena nu, shikpɔŋ ofɔ̃ ehã eda, ni ekwɔ grɔŋŋ Fai lɛ hã he ni atɛo tso lɛ yɛ lɛ nu, ni nu lɛ gbala niji kɛtee kooŋ tsei lɛ fɛɛ ashishi.
Akɛni ena nu hewɔ lɛ ekwɔ fe kooŋ tsei lɛ fɛɛ.
Eniji wuji lɛ dara, ni eniji bibii lɛ kɛlɛ; ejaakɛ eshishi fãi lɛ na nu babaoo.
Ŋwɛi loofɔji fɛɛ fee amɛtsui yɛ eniji wuji lɛ ateŋ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ fɔ amɛbii yɛ eniji bibii ashishi; ni eshishi hɔɔŋ lɛ mli jeŋmaji wuji fɛɛ hi.
Edalɛ lɛ yɛ fɛo naakpa.
Eniji bibii akɛlɛmɔ hu yɛ akɔnɔ, ejaakɛ eshishi fãi lɛ tee shikpɔŋ tɔ̃ɔ kɛyanina nu pii.
Tsenedrui ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli lɛ, eko eko kɛ lɛ yeee hegbɔ; sɛsɛo lɛ kɛ eniji wuji lɛ yeee hegbɔ, ni papaoi lɛ jeee fɛifɛi kɛ okɛ amɛto bibii lɛ ahe.
Tso ko tso ko bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli ni kɛ lɛ ye egbɔ kɛ he fɛo.
Mi mifee, ni mihã eniji bibii lɛ abumɔ hã ehe fee fɛo lɛ, ni Eden tsei fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ trom lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ kɔ̃ enɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, akɛni ekwɔ grɔŋŋ, ni eyiteŋ shɛ atatuiaŋ hewɔ lɛ, efee ntɛŋ; hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ lɛ ewo jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ eko ni he wa lɛ dɛŋ; ekɛ lɛ aye waa; bɔ ni sa eyitsoŋwalɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mishwie lɛ.
Gbɔi ni ji jeŋmajimaji lɛ ateŋ yiwalɔi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ too lɛ fɔ̃ shi, ni amɛshi lɛ.
Eniji bibii lɛ shwie gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ jɔi lɛ amli, ni eniji wuji lɛ kumɔ shwie nujɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ mɛi fɛɛ bashi ehɔɔŋ lɛ mli amɛtee.
Ŋwɛi loofɔji basɔ̃mɔ etsokuku ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔ; ni ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ banyiɛ eniji bibii lɛ anɔ.
Afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni tso fɛɛ tso ni ma shi yɛ faa toi akakwɔ kakadaŋŋ, ni ebai yashɛ atatuiaŋ nɛkɛ dɔŋŋ; bɔ ni afee ni tso fɛɛ tso ni shishifã naa nu lɛ akakwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi kɛyanina amɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ ahã gbele; akɛ amɛ eshi gbɔmɛi adesai kɛ mɛi hu ni yaa gbohiiaje lɛ anɔ.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, kɛ ekpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje lɛ, mahã bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ awo yara yɛ ehewɔ ni matsi efai lɛ anaa, ni nu ko nu ko hoŋ.
Mahã Lebanon gɔji lɛ anɔ awo duŋ, ni ŋa nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ baatɔ biti yɛ ehewɔ.
Kɛ mitsi lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ ayisɛɛ miwo gbohiiaje bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Mahã majimaji lɛ ahoso yɛ eshigbeemɔ gbɛɛmɔ lɛ naa.
Eden tsei fɛɛ kɛ Lebanon tsei kpakpai ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ ni naa nu kpakpa lɛ amii baashɛ amɛhe yɛ gbohiiaje.
Amɛ hu amɛkɛ lɛ baaya gbohiiaje kɛyanina mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa lɛ.
Hɛɛ!
Nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni hi tso lɛ hɔɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
“Belɛ yɛ anunyam kɛ agbojee gbɛfaŋ lɛ, namɔ po otamɔ yɛ Eden tsei lɛ ateŋ?
Aaatoo bo kɛ Eden tsei krokomɛi lɛ, ni akɛ nyɛ baawo gbohiiaje; ni oookã foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ ateŋ.
Bɔ ni Farao kɛ emaŋbii lɛ fɛɛ anaagbee baatamɔ nɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
Akɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ to baa he Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ye Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ Obuɔ ohe akɛ jata ko yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, shi moŋ, otamɔ báa yɛ faa mli, otswaa aŋmɔ yɛ onui lɛ amli, okɛ onaji taa nu mli ni okpɔtɔɔ fai lɛ.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, maŋmɛ onɔ adrã yaa yɛ majimaji ateŋ, ni aaagbala bo kɛba shia nɔ.
Mashɛ bo mafɔ̃ shikpɔŋ; ni mafɔ̃ bo mashɛ mafɔ shikpɔŋ kplanaa nɔ, ni mahã ŋwɛi loofɔji abasɔmɔ onɔ, ni mahã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kooloi aye bo amɛtɔrɔ.
Mikɛ oheloo baashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mikɛ ogbohii lɛ aaawo jɔi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mikɛ olá ni hoɔ lɛ baafɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ kɛyashi gɔji lɛ anɔ tete, ni olá lɛ aayi nujɔi lɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Kɛji mikpãtã ohiɛ lɛ, mahã ŋwɛi hiɛ aha, ni eŋulamii lɛ awo duŋ.
Mikɛ atatu aaaha hulu lɛ hiɛ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ.
Magbe ŋwɛi kanei ala ni kpɛɔ lɛ yɛ onɔ; ni mahã duŋ awo yɛ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Kɛji mikpãtã ohiɛ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mikpala bo kɛtee shikpɔji ni oleee anɔ lɛ, no baahã mɛi pii atsuii aye.
Kɛji mifɔ̃fɔ̃ɔ miklante lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, mahã majimaji pii ahe ajɔ̃ amɛhe ni ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ hu yɛ ohewɔ.
Gbi nɔ ni ooogbee shi lɛ amɛteŋ amɛhe, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he aaakpokpo hiŋmɛitswaa fɛɛ hiŋmɛitswaa, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he aaakpokpo yɛ ewala hewɔ.
“Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ Ijipt nɛ, Babilon maŋtsɛ kɛ eklante aaabatua bo.
Mahã asraafoi kãkãlɔi kɛ klante abakpãtã omaŋbii babaoo lɛ ahiɛ; asraafoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, yiwalɔi fe fɛɛ ni jɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ ji amɛ.
Amɛbaafite nibii ahewɔ ni Ijipt wo ehe lɛ, ni abaakpãtã maŋbii kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Maplene emli shĩa kooloi fɛɛ kɛaajɛ fai lɛ anaa.
Ni gbɔmɔ nane ko etaŋ mli dɔŋŋ; asaŋ shĩa kooloi akoklotoi etaŋ mli dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mahã amɛnu fɛɛ nu hiɛ atɛ̃, ni mahã amɛfai lɛ aho nyaa tamɔ mu.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kɛji mifee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni mikpãtã emli nii fɛɛ hiɛ, ni miplenee emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, no dani amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Nɛkɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ yarafeemɔ lala, ni majimaji lɛ amli biyei lɛ baala amɛkɛfo Ijipt kɛ emlibii babaoo lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Yɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, fo Ijipt kɛ emaŋbii babaoo lɛ, mɛi ni abaatsirɛ amɛ kɛ maji wuji abiyei lɛ hu awo gbohiiaje kɛyafata mɛi ni etee gbohiiaje momo lɛ ahe lɛ.
Bi akɛ ‘Ohe yɛ fɛo fe namɔ?’ Kpelekemɔ shi kɛya gbohiiaje ni akɛ bo ayaŋmɛ foolɔi lɛ amasɛi!
Ijiptbii lɛ baafata mɛi ni baanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa lɛ ahe, ni aaafu emɛi babaoo lɛ afata ehe.
Ijipt kãkãlɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni wa amɛ yɛ ta mli lɛ baakɛɛ yɛ amɛhe yɛ gbohiiaje akɛ, ‘Foolɔi lɛ ni nyɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛba gbohiiaje, ni amɛkamɔ shi diŋŋ!’ “Asiria yɛ jɛi ni esafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ asaŋi ebɔle lɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ.
Amɛsaŋi lɛ yɛ gbohiiaje teŋteŋ tɔ̃ɔ, asafo lɛ asaŋi lɛ ebɔle lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esaŋ lɛ he kɛkpe; amɛ mɛi ni amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ.
“Elam yɛ jɛi ni esafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ asaŋi ebɔle lɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ klante naa amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ.
Foolɔi ni kpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje ni.
Amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ hiɛkãalɔi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, agbɛnɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi.
Elam kã mɛi ni nyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa lɛ ateŋ.
Esafo yuu lɛ asaŋi lɛ ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa.
Amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; agbɛnɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi.
Amɛkamɔ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ ateŋ.
“Meshek kɛ Tubal yɛ jɛi, kɛ amɛsafo yuu lɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛsaŋi lɛ ebɔle amɛhe kɛkpe.
Amɛ fɛɛ lɛ foolɔi ni, ni amɛnyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa; ejaakɛ amɛhã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Amɛ lɛ, afuuu amɛ tamɔ afu blema kãkãlɔi lɛ, mɛi ni kpeleke shi kɛtee gbohiiaje kɛ amɛtawuunii lɛ; mɛi ni ahã amɛtsɔle amɛtawuu klantei, ni akɛ amɛtsɛŋi eshwie amɛnɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kãkãlɔi nɛɛ ehã ŋmiŋmi emɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ pɛŋ.
Nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ, bo Ijipt, abaakumɔ bo, ni oooyakã foolɔi ni nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ ateŋ.
“Edom yɛ jɛi; emaŋtsɛmɛi kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi.
Mɛi ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛkamɔ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ ateŋ.
Amɛ hu amɛkamɔ foolɔi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ ateŋ.
“Kooyigbɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ Sidonbii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi.
Amɛmɛi ni amɛhe wa lɛ hã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛkɛ mɛi ni nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ hu fɛɛ etee gbohiiaje kɛ hiɛgbele.
Foolɔi ni kɛ mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ kamɔ shi, ni amɛkɛ mɛi ni kpelekeɔ shi kɛyaa gbohiiaje lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi.
“Kɛji Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ na amɛ lɛ emii aaashɛ ehe yɛ esafo yuu lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ hu nyɔŋyɔɔ yɛ klante naa.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Akɛni ehã ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔ mɛi yɛ hiɛkãalɔi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, abaafu lɛ kɛ esafo yuu lɛ ashi foolɔi kɛ mɛi ni akɛ klante gbegbee amɛ yɛ ta mli lɛ anɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ to Ezekiel bulɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛ omaŋbii lɛ awie ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji mihã ta ba shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ fã amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ bulɔ, ni ena akɛ ta miiba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ kɛtswa maŋ lɛ adafi lɛ, no lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaanu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni ebooo adafitswaa lɛ toi lɛ, kɛji ta lɛ banina lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, elá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
Ejaakɛ enu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ gbɛɛmɔ, shi ebooo adafitswaa lɛ toi; elá abua lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiteŋ.
Eji ebo adafitswaa lɛ toi kulɛ eeehere eyiwala.
Shi kɛji bulɔ lɛ na ta lɛ miiba, ni ekpãaa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni etswaaa maŋ lɛ adafi, ni ta lɛ ba ni mɔ ko tsɔ̃ mli egbo lɛ, no lɛ, mɔ ni gbo lɛ, egbo yɛ enishaianii ahewɔ moŋ nɛ, shi mabi elá shi yɛ bulɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mito bo bulɔ mihã Israel we lɛ.
Be fɛɛ be ni ooonu wiemɔ ko kɛaajɛ minaa lɛ, bɔɔ amɛ kɔkɔ oha mi.
Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ, ‘Bo efɔŋfeelɔ, gbo ooogbo!’ Ni owieee obɔɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ; nakai efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ, eeegbo yɛ enishaianii lɛ ahewɔ moŋ nɛ, shi mabi elá shi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ.
Shi kɛji obɔ efɔŋfeelɔ lɛ kɔkɔ koni ekpale kɛje egbɛ fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ ekpaleee lɛ, eeegbo yɛ enishaianii lɛ ahewɔ, shi bo lɛ ooohere oyiwala.” Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nifeemɔnii kɛ ehe nyɔmɔwoo “Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ nɔ ni nyɛkɛɛ pɛŋ ji akɛ, ‘Wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ miisu wɔtsui, ni ehã wɔtãra loo.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ, ni wɔyi ana wala hu?’ Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ gbii abɔ ni mi, mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, minaaa efɔŋfeelɔ gbele he miishɛɛ; shi moŋ minaa miishɛɛ kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ tsake ejeŋba, ni eyi na wala.
Ao Israel we, nyɛkpalea, nyɛkpalea kɛjea nyɛgbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛyi ana wala.
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛaagboi?
“No hewɔ lɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ omaŋbii lɛ akɛ jalɔ lɛ ejalɛ nyɛŋ lɛ ajie kɛji etɔ̃; ni kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ hu kpa efɔŋfeemɔ lɛ, adamɔŋ efɔŋ ni efee momo lɛ nɔ ni abu lɛ fɔ.
Ni jalɔ hu etsutsu jalɛ haŋ eyi ana wala kɛji efee esha.
Kɛ mikɛɛ jalɔ akɛ eyi aaana wala, ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ ejalɛ lɛ nɔ, ni efee esha lɛ, ejalɛnii fɛɛ ni efee kɛho lɛ, akaiŋ ekoeko; shi moŋ ebaagbo yɛ esha ni efee lɛ hewɔ.
Asaŋ, kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋfeelɔ akɛ ‘Gbo kɛ̃ ooogbo,’ ni ekpa eshafeemɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ kpale nɔ ni akɛbato lɛ awaba eha nɔtsɛ, ni ekpale nɔ ni ekɛ ojotswaa shɔ̃ lɛ ehã; kɛji eye mlai ni hãa wala lɛ anɔ, ni efeee efɔŋ lɛ, eyi aaana wala kɛ̃, egboŋ.
Esha fɛɛ esha ni efee kɛho lɛ akɛ ekoeko ebuŋ lɛ fɔ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ eyi aaana wala, egboŋ.
“Shi, omaŋbii lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ ejaaa;’ tsɛbelɛ amɛ moŋ, nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ni ejaaa.
Kɛji jalɔ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ja feemɔ ni efee efɔŋ lɛ, ebaagbo yɛ no hewɔ.
Ni kɛji efɔŋfeelɔ fɔ̃ɔ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni efee nɔ ni ja ni ehi lɛ, eyi baana wala.
Kɛ̃lɛ, nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ ejaaa.’ Bo Israel we, makojo nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enifeemɔnii anaa.” Yerusalɛm fitemɔ he adafitswaa Wɔnomŋɔɔ lɛ mli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nɔ, nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nuu ko ni ejo foi kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ba miŋɔɔ ni ebakɛɛ mi akɛ abutu maŋ lɛ.
Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ ba minɔ gbɛkɛ, ni mitɔ mu dani foijelɔ lɛ ba, shi leebi mli be ni foijelɔ lɛ ba miŋɔɔ lɛ, agbele minaa ni mitɔko mu dɔŋŋ.
Esha ni maŋbii feɔ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, maŋbii ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Abraham lɛ, gbɔmɔ kome too ni, kɛ̃lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ enɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔyi fa; akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ eha wɔ akɛ wɔŋɔ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛyeɔ loo ni emli lá tsereko; ni amãgã jamɔ kɔ̃ɔ nyɛhiɛ, ni nyɛshwieɔ lá shi; aso shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ kɛ̃?
Nyɛfãa klante nyɛwoɔ nyɛhe, nyɛfeɔ musubɔɔnii; nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo ŋa bɔɔ ajwamãŋ; Aso shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ kɛ̃?
“Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi, mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ akɛ klante baakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli lɛ ahiɛ, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa kplanaa nɔ lɛ, maŋɔ lɛ maha ŋaŋ kooloi ni amɛye.
Mɛi ni yɔɔ mɔji kɛ tɛkpoji amli lɛ, gbele hela aaagbe amɛ.
Makpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni ebaatsõ amaŋfɔ̃; ni ehewalɛ ni ekɛshwãa lɛ sɛɛ baafo; ni Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ.
Amɛaana amɛle akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, kɛji mikpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ musubɔɔnii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.” Gbalɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ sane “Shi bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, omaŋbii lɛ wieɔ ohe yɛ gbogboi ahe kɛ shĩai ashinai ashi, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa nyɛbaboa nɔ wiemɔ ni jɛ Yehowa ŋɔɔ toi.’ Ni amɛbuaa amɛhenaa kɛbaa oŋɔɔ akɛ maŋ, ni amɛbataraa ohiɛ akɛ mimaŋbii, ni amɛboɔ owiemɔ lɛ toi, shi amɛyeee nɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ amɛnaabu, shi amɛkɛ amɛtsui fɔɔ amɛsɛɛnamɔ nɔ.
Shi, naa, bo lɛ otamɔ mɔ ko kɛkɛ ni kɛ gbee ni ŋɔɔ laa suɔmɔ lalai, ni etswaa saŋku jogbaŋŋ ohã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛnuɔ owiemɔ lɛ nɛ, shi amɛyeŋ nɔ.
Kɛ enɛ ba mli lɛ, naa, ebaana eba mli kɛ̃, no dani amɛkɛaale akɛ gbalɔ ko ehi amɛteŋ pɛŋ.”
Israel maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa oshi Israel tookwɛlɔi lɛ.
Gbaa ni okɛɛ amɛ, amɛ mɛi ni ji maŋhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ, ni amɛ ji tookwɛlɔi lɛ.
Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, Ao, nyɛ Israel tookwɛlɔi ni nyɛlɛɔ nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛhe.
Ani esaaa akɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ alɛ toi lɛ?
“Nyɛyeɔ amɛfɔ, ni nyɛkɛ amɛhetsɔi feɔ mama nyɛbuɔ, ni nyɛgbeɔ nii ni eshwishwii lɛ nyɛyeɔ; shi nyɛlɛɛɛ toi lɛ.
Toi ni egbɔjɔ lɛ, nyɛwajeee amɛ; nii ni he yeɔ lɛ, nyɛtsaaa amɛ; nii ni epila lɛ nyɛfimɔɔɔ amɛpilamɔi lɛ anɔ; nii ni edu gbɛ lɛ, nyɛyakpalaaa amɛ kɛbaaa shĩa; ni nii ni elaaje lɛ nyɛyataooo amɛ; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nɔnyɛɛ kɛ yiwalɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛgbɛ amɛshwã ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ; ni amɛtsɔ̃ niyenii amɛha ŋaŋ kooloi awuiyelɔi fɛɛ.
Mitoi lɛ gbɛ shwã, ni amɛtsomlo kɛnyiɛ gɔji kɛ gɔŋkpɔi ni kwɔlɔ lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Mitoi lɛ egbɛ eshwã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni diɔ amɛsɛɛ aloo etaoɔ amɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ tookwɛlɔi, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Mitoi lɛ etsɔ̃ milɛloo; amɛtsɔmɔ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ aniyenii; amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ ejaakɛ mitookwɛlɔi lɛ eyataooo amɛ; shi moŋ amɛyeɔ nii amɛtɔɔ, shi amɛlɛɛɛ mitoi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi, mi ji Yehowa Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikɛ tookwɛlɔi lɛ ena, ni mabi mitoi lɛ ashi kɛjɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Magu amɛ toi lɛ akwɛmɔ, ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ elɛŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ.
Mahe mitoi lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ koni amɛkana amɛ amɛye dɔŋŋ.” Tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Naa, mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ madi mitoi lɛ asɛɛ ni matao amɛsɛɛgbɛ.
Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ taoɔ etooku ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ matao mitoi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ.
Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛgbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee, yɛ gbi ni atatu kɛ duŋ kpii ewo nɔ tete.
Maŋɔ amɛ kɛaajɛ majimaji anɔ bii ateŋ, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ; ni maŋɔ amɛ kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Malɛ amɛ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ, kɛ gɔji ateaŋ jɔi lɛ amli kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shihilɛhei fɛɛ.
Mikɛ jwɛfɔ kpakpa aaalɛ amɛ; Israel gɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ anɔ aaafee amɛniyelihe.
Amɛaabumɔ shi yɛ niyelihe kpakpa shikpɔŋ nɔ; ni Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni jwɛfɔ frɔ̃frɔ̃ yɔɔ lɛ amɛaaye nii yɛ.
Mi diɛŋtsɛ mafee mitoi lɛ akwɛlɔ, ni mahã amɛbumɔ shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Too fɛɛ too ni elaaje lɛ, matao lɛ, ni nɔ ni edu gbɛ lɛ, makpala lɛ kɛba shĩa; ni nɔ ni epila lɛ, mafi epilamɔ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni egbɔjɔ lɛ mawaje lɛ.
Nɔ ni ewo fɔ, kɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ makpãtã ehiɛ.
Mikɛ amɛ baaye yɛ jalɛ naa.
“Nyɛ mitoi, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, mikojoɔ gwantɛŋ kɛ gwantɛŋ teŋ; mikojoɔ ojwɛni kɛ too kpakpo teŋ.
Ani jwɛi kpakpa ni nyɛnaa nyɛyeɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛtsui etɔ̃ɔɔ hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji naanaa nyɛjwɛi kpakpa ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ani nu hu ni hiɛ tɛ̃ kɔtekɔte ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ, nyɛtsui etɔ̃ɔɔ hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji kpɔtɔɔ nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ!
Ani esa akɛ mitoi lɛ aye niyenii ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji enaanaa nɔ lɛ, ni amɛnu nu ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnaji ekpɔtɔ lɛ?
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ amɛ nɛ, naa, Mi, mi diɛŋtsɛ mibakojo too ni ewo fɔ kɛ too ni etã loo lɛ teŋ.
Akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔ̃ji tsirɛɔ toi lɛ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkoji hɛlɛɔ amɛmli helatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛyashiɔ nyɛgbɛɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwãa majiasɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, mibahere mitoi lɛ ayiwala, ni amɛtsɔŋ kooloi anaa loo dɔŋŋ.
Mibakojo gwantɛŋ kɛ gwantɛŋ teŋ.
Mibato tookwɛlɔ kome maha amɛ, ni ji mitsulɔ David, ni lɛ eeelɛ amɛ; ebaalɛ amɛ ni eeetsɔ̃ amɛkwɛlɔ.” “Ni mi, Yehowa, matsɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ; ni mitsulɔ David baatsɔ lumɔ aha amɛ.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Mikɛ amɛ baakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ ni baahã amɛhe ajɔ amɛ, ni mashwie kooloi awuiyelɔi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛhi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ ŋa nɔ; amɛaawɔ yɛ koo mli.
“Ni mibajɔɔ amɛ kɛ hei ni bɔle migɔŋkpɔ lɛ he lɛ, ni maha nu anɛ yɛ ebe mli, ni nu lɛ aaatsɔ jɔɔmɔ aha amɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ŋa nɔ tsei baawo amɛyibii ni shikpɔŋ lɛ baaba nii babaoo, ni amɛaahi shi shweshweeshwe yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji mikumɔ amɛkɔŋtsei ni akɛbɔ amɛ apã lɛ, ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ mɛi ni yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Amɛtsɔŋ tamɔ kooloo naa loo amɛhaŋ jeŋmaji lɛ dɔŋŋ; ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kooloi lɛ yeŋ amɛloo.
Amɛaabahi shi shweshweeshwe, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.
Maha niyenii babaoo aba amɛŋmɔji ashi bɔ ni afee ni hɔmɔ akaplene amɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni maji krokomɛi lɛ hu egbeŋ amɛhe guɔ dɔŋŋ.
Amɛaana amɛle akɛ, mi, Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ yɛ, ni amɛ Israel we lɛ amɛ ji mimaŋ.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ!
Ni nyɛ lɛ, mitoi ji nyɛ, milɛɛhe toi ji nyɛ.
Mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ!
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi kɛɛ!”
Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Edom toi Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ogba oshi lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, Edom shikpɔŋ, mikɛ bo ena, ni makpãtã ohiɛ, mafee bo amaŋfɔ̃ butubutu.
Makpãtã omaji wuji lɛ ahiɛ, ni obaatsɔ shikpɔŋ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ooona ole akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
“Akɛni onyɛ Israel hiɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe, ni yɛ Israel amanehulu be mli lɛ, oŋɔ amɛ oha ni akɛ klante kpãtã amɛhiɛ, be mli ni agbalaa amɛtoi nɔ ni ji naagbee nɔ lɛ, yɛ amɛhe eshai ahewɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ, masaa bo maha láshishwiemɔ, ni láshishwiemɔ baanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Oshwie lá shi, no hewɔ lɛ, láshishwiemɔ baanyiɛ osɛɛ.
Maha Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ butubutu, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɔŋ jɛi kɛhoŋ.
Maha ogɔji lɛ anɔ ayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii, ni mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa lɛ agbohii aaayimɔ ogɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ ojɔi kɛ onujɔi lɛ amli.
Maha otsɔ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ omaŋ wuji lɛ ekoeko mli.
Enɛ okɛaana ole akɛ mi, mi ji, Yehowa.
“Nɔ ni okɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Yuda kɛ Israel maji enyɔ lɛ minii ni, ni amɛshikpɔji enyɔ lɛ hu minii ni hewɔ lɛ maŋɔ amɛ;’ tsɛbelɛ, mi, Yehowa, miyɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, gbii abɔ ni mi ji Nyɔŋmɔ Hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɛɛ, mi hu mikɛ nyɛ baaye tamɔ bɔ pɛ ni nyɛkɛ mimaŋbii lɛ ye kɛ mlifu kɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Ni maha amɛle akɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ he toigbalamɔ nyɛnaa lɛ.
Maha nyɛle akɛ mi, Yehowa, minu musubɔɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni nyɛwieɔ nyɛshiɔ Israel gɔji lɛ akɛ ‘amɛtsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i, ni ajɔɔ nɔ ahã wɔ ni wɔkpãtã hiɛ lɛ.’ Mi diɛŋtsɛ minu bɔ ni ejɛ nyɛnaa ni nyɛkɛ henɔwomɔ wie wiemɔi babaoo nyɛshi mi lɛ.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, maha otsɔ amaŋfɔ̃ koni je lɛ mli fɛɛ anya!
Bɔ ni onya yɛ Israel we lɛ gboshinii lɛ ahewɔ ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ mafee bo.
Obaatsɔ amaŋfɔ̃; ni Seir gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ Israelbii Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ Israel gɔji lɛ, ni nɔ ni okɛɛ amɛ nɛ, nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa, Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, akɛni Israel henyɛlɔ lɛ nya ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yiɛ, agbɛnɛ blema gɔji lɛ etsɔmɔ wɔgbɛfaŋnɔ,’ hewɔ lɛ, gbaa ni okɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ!
Majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ fee nyɛ maŋ lɛ amaŋfɔ̃, ni amɛwiɛ nyɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ, ni eha nyɛtsɔmɔ majimaji krokomɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ agbɛfaŋnɔ.
Amɛsopa nyɛ ni amɛye nyɛhe osheku hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ Israel gɔji, nyɛboa Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ kɛ nujɔi lɛ kɛ jɔi lɛ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ, kɛ maji wuji ni ashi ashwie shi efolo lɛ, ni amɛtsɔmɔ kooloo naa loo kɛ hefɛoyeli nii amɛha majimaji ni eshwɛ ni bɔle amɛ kɛkpe lɛ nɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikɛɔ nɛ, miiwie kɛ awuŋayeli ni naa wa miishi maji ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ Edom fɛɛ, mɛi ni kɛ miishɛɛ ŋɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ kɛfee amɛnɔ, ni amɛbuuu akɛ minɔ ni.
Amɛŋɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ amɛhã amɛhe akɛ haanii ni amɛhi nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbaa yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ he ni okɛɛ gɔji lɛ kɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ kɛ nujɔi lɛ kɛ gɔji ateŋ jɔi lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, nyɛkɛɛ awuŋã ni miyeɔ hewɔ lɛ, miiwie kɛ mlifu akɛ, nyɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ eshwie mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɔ nɛ, Miikã midiɛŋtsɛ mihe kitã akɛ, majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ hu hiɛ baashwie shi nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi nyɛ, Israel gɔji lɛ nyɛnɔ tsei lɛ baagbala niji, ni amɛbaawo yibii nyɛha mimaŋ Israel lɛ; ejaakɛ etsɛŋ ni Israelbii aaku amɛsɛɛ kɛba amɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ.
Shi naa, miyɛ mihã nyɛ, ni matsɔ mihiɛ mahã nyɛ, gɔji lɛ, ni abaahu nyɛnɔ, ni abadu nii yɛ nyɛnɔ.
Maha Israel we lɛ fɛɛ tswɛm yi afa toi abɔ.
Abaahi maji wuji lɛ amli ekoŋŋ, ni amɛaatswa tsu koi lɛ.
Maha gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ayi afa yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ; amɛaafɔfɔi, ni amɛyi aaafa.
Ni mahã gbɔmɛi ahi nyɛnɔ tamɔ tsutsu lɛ; ni mafee nyɛ ejurɔ pii fe tsutsu lɛ.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Naa, mahã gbɔmɛi anyiɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ, ni mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ tete anyiɛ yɛ onɔ.
Amɛaaŋɔ bo akɛ amɛnɔ ni oootsɔ̃ amɛgboshinii kwraa, ni ogbeŋ amɛbii lɛ hɔmɔ dɔŋŋ.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mɛi kɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ kpãtãa gbɔmɔ hiɛ ni gbekɛbii tɛooo yɛ nɔ moŋ, shi agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛkpãtãŋ gbɔmɔ hiɛ dɔŋŋ ni gbekɛbii hu gboiŋ yɛ nyɛnɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Majimaji ni yeɔ ohe fɛo lɛ, mihaŋ onu oheguɔ ni amɛgbeɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ, ni onaŋ amɛ maŋbii ahorabɔɔ lɛ, ni mihaŋ omaŋ lɛ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Israel wala hee lɛ Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, be ni Israelbii lɛ yɔɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii bule shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛjeŋba yɛ mihiɛ lɛ tamɔ yoo ni etee tsuiasɛɛ ni ehe tseee.
No hewɔ lɛ, mimli wo amɛ la naakpa yɛ lá shi ni amɛshwie yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã amãgãi ni amɛkɛbule shikpɔŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Migbɛ amɛ mishwã majimaji lɛ ateŋ kɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ.
Amɛjeŋba kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii ahewɔ lɛ migbala amɛtoi.
Be ni amɛtee majimaji lɛ amli lɛ, he fɛɛ he ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛgbe migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni mɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛhe ji akɛ, ‘Yehowa webii nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ naa amɛ ni amɛje amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.’ Shi migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni Israel we lɛ hã agbe he guɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ he ni amɛtee lɛ dɔ mi.
“No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ Israel we lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, nyɛ Israel we, jeee nyɛhewɔ mafee nɔ ko, shi moŋ, migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ ni nyɛgbe he guɔ yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, hei ni nyɛyahi lɛ, hewɔ.
“Masaa mafee minunyam gbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ ni abule lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛgbe he guɔ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Kɛji kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛnɔ lɛ, misaa mifee minunyam gbɛi kpeteŋkple lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ, no amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋɔ nyɛ kɛaajɛ maji lɛ amli, ni mabua nyɛnaa kɛaajɛ shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mikɛ nu ni mli tse baashwã nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛhe baatse.
Ni matsuu nyɛwɔji ahe muji ni yɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ hu.
“Mahã nyɛ tsui hee ni mikɛ mumɔ hee baawo nyɛmli, ni majie nyɛtsui ni wa tamɔ tɛ lɛ kɛje nyɛmli ni mahã nyɛ heloo tsui ni he jɔ.
Mikɛ miMumɔ lɛ baawo nyɛmli, ni mahã nyɛba nyɛjeŋ yɛ mikpɔi lɛ anaa, ni nyɛbaaye mimlai lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛbaahi shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ; ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni mi hu matsɔ̃ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ.
Majie nyɛ kɛjɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni woɔ nyɛhe muji lɛ mli; mafã, ni ŋmãa aaaba babaoo, ni mihaŋ nyɛye hɔmɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Mahã tseiayibii kɛ ŋmɔshinii afa pii koni hɔmɔ akaha nyɛhiɛ shwie shi yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Enɛ baahã nyɛkai nyɛjeŋba fɔŋ ni nyɛba kɛ nii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ; ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe aaafe nyɛ nyaŋemɔ yɛ eshai ni nyɛfee lɛ kɛ musubɔɔ nii ni nyɛfeefee lɛ ahewɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, bo Israel we, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ jeee nyɛhewɔ mafee enɛ nɛɛ; nyɛhiɛ agboia ni nyɛhiɛ ashwiea shi yɛ nyɛjeŋba hewɔ.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, gbi nɔ ni matsuu nyɛhe kɛjɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ, mahã mɛi ahi maji wuji lɛ amli, ni abaasaa tsu koi lɛ amãmɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni kulɛ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ lɛ ekã efolo lɛ, abaahu nɔ, bɔ ni ekaŋ shi efolo dɔŋŋ.
Mɛi baana, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ni kulɛ ekã shi efolo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ tamɔ Eden trom nɛɛ; ni maji ni tsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛmli lɛ, nomɛi amli gbɔmɛi ebahi ni atswa gbogboi awo amɛhe nɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ jeŋmaji ni eshwɛ ni bɔle nyɛ kɛkpe lɛ aaana ale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi ni misaa tsu koi lɛ mitswa, ni he ni ka shi efolo lɛ, mitɛo nii yɛ jɛi.
Mi, Yehowa miwie ni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni ji lɛ, mafee.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, mahã Israel we lɛ abi mi enɛ hu ni mafee mahã amɛ; no ji akɛ mahã amɛyi afa tamɔ toiku.
Mahã maji wuji ni etsɔmɔ amaŋfɔ̃i lɛ amli aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbɔmɛi babaoo tamɔ toi kui ni akɛyaashã afɔle yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ egbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Enɛ amɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.”
Wui ni ekwakwao lɛ Yehowa hewalɛ lɛ bayi minɔ, ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔ mi kɛje kpo, ni eyayi mi shi yɛ jɔɔ ko mli.
Wui eyi jɔɔ lɛ mli obɔ̃ tɔ.
Enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛbɔle wui lɛ kɛkpe; ni naa, amɛfa naakpa; asaŋ amɛhe ekwakwao hu naakpa.
Ebi mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, aso wala aaanyɛ wui nɛɛ amli aba ekoŋŋ.” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “Ao, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, bo pɛ ole.” Ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Gbaa ni okɛɛ wui nɛɛ akɛ, nyɛ wui ni nyɛhe ekwakwao, nyɛboa Yehowa wiemɔ toi.
Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ wui nɛɛ nɛ, naa maha mumɔ abote nyɛmli ni wala baaba nyɛmli.
Maha nyɛna fãi, ni mahã loo aba nyɛhe ni mahã hewolo aha nyɛhe.
Mikɛ mumɔ baawo nyɛmli ni wala baaba nyɛmli, ni nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.” No hewɔ lɛ, migba, taakɛ afã mi lɛ.
Be ni migbaa lɛ, minu gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hetsirɛmɔi ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni wui lɛ bua amɛhe naa, ni wu kɛ ewu tsa.
Be ni mikwɛ lɛ amɛna fãi kɛ hewolo; shi mumɔ bɛ amɛmli.
Agbɛnɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛ mumɔ lɛ awie ni okɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo mumɔ, jɛɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ mli ni obamu oshwie nɛkɛ mɛi ni agbegbee nɛɛ anɔ koni amɛna wala.” No hewɔ lɛ, migba taakɛ afã mi lɛ, ni mumɔ ba amɛmli, ni wala ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, amɛyi fa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa nɛkɛ wui nɛɛ Israel we muu lɛ fɛɛ ni.
Naa, amɛwieɔ akɛ ‘wɔwui ahe ekwakwao, ni wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ etã, ni abɛɛ wɔ kwraa ashwie.’ No hewɔ lɛ, gbaa ni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, Ao, mimaŋbii, naa, mibagbele nyɛgbonyobui lɛ anaa, ni matee nyɛ shi kɛaajɛ nyɛgbonyobui lɛ amli, ni mikɛ nyɛ aaaba nyɛmaŋ, ni ji Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ao, mimaŋbii, kɛji migbele nyɛgbonyobui lɛ anaa ni mitee nyɛ shi kɛjɛ nyɛgbonyobui lɛ amli lɛ, no nyɛkɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Mikɛ miMumɔ lɛ baawo nyɛmli, ni wala baaba nyɛmli, ni maŋɔ nyɛ kɛya nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛbaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ, ni mifee hu.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yuda kɛ Israel yɛ Maŋtsɛyeli kome shishi Yehowa kɛ mi wie, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɔ tso kome koni oŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Yuda kɛ Israelbii ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ nɛ.’ Agbɛnɛ kɔ tso kroko hu koni oŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ ‘Yosef tso,’ ni ji Efraim kɛ Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ni fata ehe lɛ nɔ nɛ.
“Agbɛnɛ lɛ okɛ tso kome atsa tso kome nɔ, koni amɛtsɔ tso kome yɛ odɛ̃ŋ.
Ni kɛji omaŋbii lɛ bi bo akɛ, ‘Otsɔ̃ɔɔ wɔ enɛ shishi lo?’ lɛ.” Kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Naa mibakɔ Yosef tso ni yɔɔ Efraim kɛ Israel akutsei ni fata ehe lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, ni mikɛ no kɛ Yuda tso lɛ baatsa.
Mafee amɛ tso kome koni amɛfee tso kome yɛ midɛŋ.’ “Hiɛmɔ tsei ni oŋma nii yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ ni amɛna, koni okɛɛ amɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, naa, majie Israelbii lɛ kɛaajɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ hei ni amɛtee lɛ, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ hei fɛɛ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mafee amɛ maŋ kome yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaahi maŋtsɛ kome shishi ni amɛfeŋ maji enyɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mligbalamɔ hu baŋ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli mli dɔŋŋ.
“Amɛkɛ amɛmãgãi kɛ amɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ kɛ eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ekoeko buleŋ amɛhe dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ mahere amɛyiwala kɛaajɛ eshai ni amɛfee ni etse amɛ kɛje mihe lɛ amli, ni matsuu amɛhe; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaatsɔ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ.
Mitsulɔ David baaye amɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛaana lumɔ kome.
Amɛbaakwɛ koni amɛye mimlai lɛ kɛ mikpɔi lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Amɛaahi shikpɔŋ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hi nɔ lɛ nɔ, shikpɔŋ ni mikɛhã mitsulɔ Yakob lɛ.
Amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛbii abii baahi nɔ kɛya naanɔ; ni mitsulɔ David baaye amɛnɔ lumɔ kɛya naanɔ.
Mikɛ amɛaakpãŋ toiŋjɔlɛ kpãŋmɔ; ni ebaafee naanɔ kpãŋmɔ yɛ mi kɛ amɛ teŋ.
Majɔɔ amɛ ni mahã amɛshwere, ni mikɛ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni ji Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, baama amɛteŋ, ni ebaahi jɛi kɛya naanɔ tɔ̃ɔ.
Mi kɛ amɛ baahi jɛi, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Kɛji mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni ji Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ, no majimaji kɛaale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mitsuɔ Israel he, mifeɔ lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Gog tsu nii Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa tsɔ̃ ohiɛ owo Gog, ni ji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa ni yɔɔ Magog shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbaa oshi lɛ ni okɛɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, bo Gog, ni oji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa, naa, mikɛ bo ena, ni madɔ oyi, ni mawo okadaaŋ kpoŋ, ni magbala bo kɛ ota lɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo.
Magbala okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtalɔi ni wo amɛdamai fɛɛ; asafo kpele ni hiɛ amɛtsɛŋi wuji kɛ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ klante.
Magbala Persiabii kɛ Etiopiabii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ni amɛhiɛhiɛ tsɛŋi ni amɛbu dadefai lɛ hu mafata amɛhe.
Tabilɔi ni jɛ Gomer kɛ Bet-Togarma ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ fɛɛ aaashi onɔ; asafo kpele diɛŋtsɛ.
Saamɔ ohe ni ofee kralo, bo kɛ ta ni bua shi kɛbɔle ohe lɛ fɛɛ, koni obu amɛhe.
Afii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ abaabua omɛi lɛ anaa.
No sɛɛ lɛ, obaate shi oshi shikpɔŋ ni akpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ ta mli kɛba lɛ, shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ ni kã shi efolo daa, he ni abua mɛi pii anaa kɛjɛ majimaji anɔ kɛba lɛ.
Ajie emaŋbii lɛ kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ amli, ni agbɛnɛ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm amɛfee shweshweeshwe.
Bo okɛ ota lɛ fɛɛ aaafã kɛaaba tamɔ ahum, ni majimaji pii aaafata ohe ni ooofee tamɔ atatu ni baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ susumɔi pii baaba oyiŋ, ni obajwɛŋ efɔŋfeemɔ he.
Obaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mafa kɛyatua akrowai ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe lɛ, ni mayatua mɛi ni yɔɔ kpoo ni amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe, maji ni atswako gbogbo awoko amɛhe, ni amɛbɛ agbosɛɛ adabaŋi kɛ agboi hu lɛ.
Oooyaha nii, ni oooyatswa ojo.
Ooote shi oyatua amaŋfɔ̃i ni agbɛnɛ mɛi yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni abua amɛnaa kɛjɛ majimaji lɛ anɔ ni amɛyɔɔ tsinai kɛ nibii pii yɛ majimaji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ ateŋ lɛ.’ Shebabii kɛ Dedanbii kɛ jarayelɔi ni jɛ Tarshish kɛ ehe akrowai lɛ baabi bo akɛ, ‘Nihaa obaa nɛɛ?
Ani oba ni obaha nii lo?
Ani obua ota asafo lɛ naa kɛkpe kɛbatswa ojo ni nyɛkɛha nii koni nyɛkɛloo jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika kɛ tsinai kɛ nibii pii kɛya?’ “No hewɔ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbaa ni okɛɛ Gog akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, gbi nɔ ni mimaŋ Israel aaahi shi shweshweeshwe lɛ, no ooote shi owo amɛ.
Bo okɛ mɛi babaoo ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ ni fata ohe lɛ kɛaajɛ ojɛɛhe ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaaba, ta asafo kpele diɛŋtsɛ.
Ooote shi owo mimaŋ Israel; nyɛyifalɛ baaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ mahã otua mishikpɔŋ lɛ, ni bɔ ni mafee bo yɛ majimaji lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, baahã amɛle mi akɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
“Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, ani bo ohe miwie yɛ blema gbii lɛ amli kɛtsɔ̃ mitsuji, ni ji Israel gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛi ni gba afii babaoo yɛ nakai beiaŋ akɛ mahã obatua amɛ lɛ?” Nyɔŋmɔ gbala Gog toi Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbi nɔ ni Gog baate shi abatua Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ, mimli baawo la waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikɛ awuŋayeli kɛ mlila miigba mli kpoo makɛɛ akɛ, nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kukrudu ni naa wa baashi yɛ Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋshɔŋloi kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ waamɔnii fɛɛ ni wamɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ he baakpokpo yɛ mihegbeyei naa.
Abaatsirɛ gɔji atswia shi, ni tɛsai ni kwɔlɔ lɛ baagbeegbee shi, ni aaawule gbogbo fɛɛ gbogbo ashwie shi.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, mikɛ hejaramɔ aaaba Gog nɔ, ni nuu fɛɛ nuu baawo klante nɔ yɛ enaanyo nɔ.
Mikɛ gbele hela kɛ láshishwiemɔ baagbala etoi; ni mahã nu ni naa wa kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ anɛ ashwie lɛ kɛ etai lɛ kɛ mɛi babaoo ni fata ehe lɛ anɔ.
Ni enɛ mikɛaahã maji fɛɛ ale akɛ mida ni mihe tse; ni amɛaana amɛle hu akɛ mi ji Yehowa.”
Aye Gog nɔ kunim “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, agbɛnɛ, gbaa oshi Gog ni okɛɛ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, bo Gog, ni bo ji Meshek kɛ Tubal lumɔnukpa, naa mikɛ bo ena, ni madɔ oyi ni mikɛ bo aaajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ kooyigbɛ tɔ̃ɔ kɛaaba, ni makpala bo hu kɛaaba Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ matswa ogãitso lɛ kɛaaje onine abɛku dɛŋ, ni mahã ogãimlibii lɛ aje oninejurɔ dɛŋ ashwie shi.
Bo Gog, mahã okɛ otai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ majimaji ni fata ohe lɛ fɛɛ anyɔnyɔɔ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Mikɛ nyɛgbohii lɛ baahã loofɔji ni yeɔ gbɔmɔ loo kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi awuiyelɔi ni amɛtserɛ nyɛloo.
Obaanyɔ yɛ ŋa kplenee nɔ; ejaakɛ mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.
Asaŋ mawo Magog kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli lɛ la.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ kɛaale akɛ, mi, mi ji Yehowa.
Ni maha mimaŋ Israelbii ale migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Mihaŋ agbe migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ majimaji baale akɛ mi, Yehowa, mi mi ji Israel Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbi ni miwie ehe lɛ, gbi lɛ miiba, ni ebaaba nɔŋŋ kɛ̃.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Israel maji lɛ amli lɛ baaje kpo amɛyaloo tawuu nibii lɛ ni amɛaama naa la amɛshã fɛɛ.
Amɛaaŋɔ tsɛŋi bibii kɛ ewuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ gãitsei kɛ gãimlibii lɛ kɛ kpotii kɛ akplɔi ni amɛkɛbaafee lai amɛshã afii kpawo.
Bɔ ni afee ni amɛkayalɛ lai kɛjɛ ŋa nɔ, ni amɛkayafolɔ tsei hu kɛjɛ koo mli; ejaakɛ amɛkɛ tawuu nibii lɛ baafee lai amɛshã.
Mɛi ni ha amɛnibii lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛ hu amɛaaha amɛ nibii amɛtse; ni mɛi ni tswa amɛ ojo lɛ, amɛ hu amɛaatswa amɛ ojo amɛtse.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Gog fuu Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mahã Gog fuuhe ko yɛ Israel, yɛ Gbɛnyiɛlɔi Ajɔɔ ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ bokãgbɛ lɛ.
Gbɛnyiɛlɔi Ajɔɔ nɛɛ mli abaafu Gog kɛ esafo yuu lɛ yɛ, ni gbohii lɛ ayifalɛ baatsi gbɛnyiɛlɔi agbɛ, ni no aaahã awo jɛi gbɛi akɛ Hamon-Gog Jɔɔ.
Israel we lɛ aaaye nyɔji kpawo sɔŋŋ kɛfu amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛtsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he.
Israelbii fɛɛ baafata he kɛfu gbohii lɛ, ni no baahã amɛgbɛi ahehe, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ majie minunyam lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ; Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɔji kpawo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baafamɔ mɛi krɛdɛɛ koni nakai mɛi lɛ, akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bei fɛɛ koni amɛfu gbohii ni eshwɛ ni jwere shi ni afuko amɛ lɛ koni akɛtsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he.
Ni kɛji amɛmiikpa shi ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko na gbonyo wu lɛ, eto okadi ko yɛ gbonyo wu lɛ he; okadi lɛ ahi jɛi kɛyashi be ni fulɔi lɛ aaaba abafu wu lɛ yɛ Gog Asafo Yuu Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ ‘Asafo Yuu’ hi shi.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaafee atsuu shikpɔŋ lɛ he.” Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, kɛɛmɔ loofɔji srɔtoi fɛɛ kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi fɛɛ akɛ, nyɛjɛa he fɛɛ he nyɛbaa nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ migbee afɔle kpeteŋkple ni misaa mito mihã nyɛ yɛ Israel gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ he.
Nyɛbaaye loo ni nyɛbaanu lá.
Nyɛbaaye kãkãlɔi aloo, ni nyɛbaanu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɛi alá.
Nyɛbaaye ojwɛnii kɛ too gwantɛŋbii kɛ too kpakpo kɛ tsinahii, ni ji Bashan kooloi sɔŋŋ ni ewo fɔ lɛ aloo.
Migbee afɔle ni misaa mito nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaaye fɔ aahu kɛyaashi nyɛbaatɔrɔ, ni nyɛbaanu lá aahu kɛyaashi ebaatɔ nyɛ tamɔ dãa.
Ni yɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ, nyɛbaaye okpɔŋɔi kɛ okpɔŋɔnɔtaralɔi kɛ kãkãlɔi kɛ tabilɔi srɔtoi aloo nyɛtɔrɔ.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.” Abaakpale Israel kɛba ekoŋŋ “Maha majimaji lɛ fɛɛ ana minunyam lɛ; amɛbaana bɔ ni miye jalɛ sane mihã, kɛ bɔ ni mikɛ minine ŋmɛ amɛnɔ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ, Israel we lɛ baale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Majimaji lɛ hu baale akɛ eshai ni Israel we lɛ fee lɛ hewɔ amɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ.
Akɛni amɛtɔ̃ minɔ lɛ, no hewɔ ni mitsi mihe yɛ amɛhe, ni mitu amɛ miwo amɛhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ ni akɛ klante gbegbee amɛ yɛ ta mli lɛ.
Mujinii ni amɛfee lɛ kɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa mikɛ amɛ ye yɛ, ni mitsi mihe yɛ amɛhe lɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ makpale Yakob shwiei ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ kɛba ekoŋŋ, ni mana Israel we lɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Maye migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he awuŋã.
Kɛji amɛbahi amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shweshweeshwe bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko wooo amɛhe gbeyei lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpa nɔ akɛ be ni amɛtɔ̃ minɔ lɛ amɛhiɛ shwie shi.
Makpale amɛ kɛaajɛ majiasɛɛ kɛaaba, ni mabua amɛnaa kɛaajɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi ashikpɔji lɛ anɔ hei ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni maha majimaji lɛ ale akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji mi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaale akɛ mi, mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mihã aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee majiasɛɛ, ni misaa miyabua amɛnaa kɛba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ni mishiŋ amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yɛ jɛi.
Mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ mashwie Israel we lɛ nɔ, ni mitsiŋ mihe kɛjɛŋ amɛhe dɔŋŋ,” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
WƆSƐƐ SƆLEMƆ WE LƐ HE NINAA Aŋɔ Gbalɔ Ezekiel kɛtee Yerusalɛm Yerusalɛm fitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ, wɔna afii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ nomŋɔɔ mli.
Afi nɛɛ shishijee nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa hewalɛ ba minɔ yɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ tuuntu.
Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ mi kɛba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ ninaa mli, ni ekɛ mi yadamɔ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ ko nɔ.
Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mina nɔ ko tamɔ maŋ ni ato yɛ mihiɛgbɛ.
Be ni ekɛ mi ba jɛi lɛ, naa, nuu ko ni egbɔmɔtso su tamɔ akɔɔble su yɛ jɛi.
Ehiɛ kpekpe kpãa kɛ susumɔtso yɛ edɛŋ, ni edamɔ shinaa lɛ shi.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, gbelemɔ ohiŋmɛi ni okwɛ nii jogbaŋŋ; ni ogbɛ otoiŋ hu ni onu nii jogbaŋŋ, ni okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mikɛbaatsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ no hewɔ akɛbo ba biɛ.
Nibii ni onaa nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ Israel we lɛ.” Mina Sɔlemɔ we ko ni atswa gbogbo kɛbɔle lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Susumɔtso ni nuu lɛ hiɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa, emli ninetalɔ kome feɔ ninetalɔ kɛ dɛ̃lɛɛmɔ.
Nuu lɛ susu gbogbo lɛ, etimɔ fee ninetalɔ kome kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni ekwɔ atrakpoi lɛ kɛtee bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ he; ni esusu agbo lɛ kpoku lɛ, efee ninetalɔ kome.
Gbɛ ko kã ablanaa lɛ naa; tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ gbɛ lɛ biɛ, ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ.
Tsui bibii lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Gbɛ ni kã tsu bibioo kɛ tsu bibioo teŋ lɛ feɔ ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Agbo lɛ kpoku lɛ ni yɔɔ koi lɛ naagbɛ ni kã kɛyaa shĩa lɛ mligbɛ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome.
Kɛkɛ ni esusu agbo lɛ koi lɛ, efee ninetalɔ kome; agbɛnɛ esusu agbo lɛ ni etimɔ ji ninetalɔi kpaanyɔ, ni eshimaamɔnii lɛ ninetalɔi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ.
Agbo lɛ koi lɛ ye mligbɛ kɛbɛŋkɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ he lɛ, tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ; ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ; ni tsui etɛ̃ lɛ adaramɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ shimaamɔnii lɛ ni yɔɔ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ hu adaramɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni esusu agbo lɛ lɛɛmɔ ni efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, ni gbɛ ni kã kɛboteɔ mli lɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ etɛ̃.
Atswa kpoku yɛ tsui bibii lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Kpoku fɛɛ kpoku lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔ kome ni etimɔ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Agbɛnɛ esusu agbo lɛ kɛjɛ tsui bibii lɛ ateŋ ekome sɛɛgbɛ kɛyashi ekroko hu sɛɛgbɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛjɛ gbogbo kome he kɛtee ekroko he.
Esaa esusu gbɛ ni kã koi lɛ shi kɛboteɔ agbo lɛ naa kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hu fee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Kɛjɛ agbo ni atsɔ̃ɔ mli kɛboteɔ mli lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi mligbɛ agbo lɛ koi lɛ hiɛ lɛ, efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Samfɛji yɛ agbo lɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛbɔle; ni samfɛji yɛ mligbɛ koi lɛ hu he kɛkpe; ni akpɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ mligbɛ tsui bibii lɛ ahe.
Agbonaa kpo lɛ Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, piai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ yɛ mli, ni aka kpo lɛ nɔ tɛ kɛkpe yɛ piai lɛ ahiɛ.
Agboi lɛ ahiɛ fɛɛ lɛ aka jɛi tɛ kɛkpe.
Agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ jɔɔ mligbɛ fe mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Nuu lɛ susu kɛjɛ shishigbɛ agbo lɛ hiɛ kɛyashi mligbɛ kpo lɛ hiɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi oha.
Kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ Agbɛnɛ eyi mihiɛ kɛtee kooyigbɛ.
Agbo ko yɛ jɛi ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ mli kɛyaa agbonaa kpo lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni esusu ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ.
Ehiɛ tsui bibii etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, ni etɛ̃ hu yɛ biɛ, ni eshimaamɔ nii kɛ ekoi lɛ adaramɔ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ agbo lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Esamfɛji lɛ kɛ ekoii lɛ kɛ bɔ ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi awo he lɛ adaramɔ tamɔ agbo ni hiɛ kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Asaŋ akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpawo kɛyaa he, ni ekoi lɛ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni agbo yɔɔ bokãgbɛ kpo lɛ he lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ agbo ko yɔɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ ŋlɛnɔ; ni eboteɔ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Esusu kɛjɛ agbo kome he kɛtee agbo kome he, ni efee ninetalɔi oha.
Wuoyigbɛ Agbo lɛ Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee wuoyigbɛ; ni naa, agbo kroko yɛ jɛi hu.
Esusu eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ, ni amɛdaramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Samfɛji yɛ tsui lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ he kɛbɔle kɛkpe, tamɔ eyɔɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ ahe lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Agbo lɛ mligbɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Atrakpoi kpawo akwɔɔ kɛyaa he; ni ekoi lɛ yɛ mligbɛ.
Akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi yɛ mligbɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ahe, eko yɛ biɛ ni eko hu yɛ biɛ.
Agbo ko hu yɛ mligbɛ kpo ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ he; ni nuu lɛ susu kɛjɛ agbo kome he kɛtee agbo kroko he yɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, ni no hu fee ninetalɔi oha.
Mligbɛ kpo lɛ, kɛ Agbo lɛ Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Esusu wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ, ni edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ adaramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ adaramɔ nɔŋŋ.
Samfɛji yɛ etsui lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Koii ebɔle lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Ekoi lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi yɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ahe, ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpaanyɔ kɛyaa agbo lɛ he.
Mligbɛ kpo lɛ kɛ Bokãgbɛ Agbo lɛ Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi bote mligbɛ kpo ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli, ni esusu agbo lɛ; ni edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoii lɛ adaramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni samfɛji yɛ he fɛɛ kɛkpe kɛ koi lɛ hu kɛkpe.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Ekoi lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ ahe biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni atrakpoi kpaanyɔ akwɔɔ kɛyaa he.
Mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tee kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni esusu; edalɛ lɛ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Etsui bibii lɛ kɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ kɛ ekoi lɛ adaramɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni samfɛji bɔle he kɛkpe.
Ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
Eshimaamɔnii lɛ kwɛɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni akpɛkpɛɛ tɛŋi samai yɛ eshimaamɔnii lɛ ahe biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni akwɔɔ atrakpoi kpaanyɔ kɛyaa he.
Tsui ni bɛŋkɛ Kooyigbɛ Agbo lɛ Pia ko kɛ enaa shinaa yɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ ni yɔɔ agboi lɛ ahe lɛ amasɛi.
Jɛi ji he ni afɔɔ kooloi ni akɛbaashã afɔlei lɛ ahe yɛ.
Okpɔlɔi enyɔ mamɔ agbo lɛ koi lɛ fã kome lɛ mli, ni okpɔlɔi enyɔ mamɔ afã kroko lɛ hu mli.
Okpɔlɔi nɛɛ anɔ agbeɔ kooloo ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle kɛ esha afɔle kɛ sɔ̃ he afɔlei lɛ yɛ.
Koi lɛ sɛɛ, yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naagbɛ lɛ, okpɔlɔi enyɔ mamɔ jɛi.
Koi lɛ mligbɛ yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ nɔŋŋ naa lɛ, okpɔlɔi enyɔ hu yɛ jɛi.
Okpɔlɔi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ ayibɔ ji kpaanyɔ; ejwɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ejwɛ hu yɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Okpɔlɔi nɛɛ anɔ agbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ.
Tɛ ni ako okpɔlɔi ejwɛ yɛ jɛi, ni akɛshãa shãa afɔle.
Tɛ ni ako okpɔlɔi lɛ ekome kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔ kome kɛ fã, ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ, kɛ ekwɔlɛ ninetalɔ kome.
Nɛkɛ tɛi nɛɛ anɔ akɛ dadei ni akɛgbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshãa shãafɔle lɛ kɛ gbee afɔle lɛ shwieɔ.
Akla tso akɔtɔkloi ni hiɛ dɛ̃lɛɛmɔ kome yɛ mligbɛ kɛbɔle kɛkpe kpula.
Loo ni akɛshãa afɔle lɛ, akɛshwieɔ okpɔlɔi lɛ anɔ.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi jɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ kɛba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni naa piai enyɔ yɛ jɛi, ekome yɛ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ masɛi, ni ekroko lɛ hu yɛ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ masɛi.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ ni hiɛ kwɛɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni tsuɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nii lɛ anɔ ni.
Ni tsu ni hiɛ kwɛɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ, osɔfoi ni tsuɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he nii lɛ anɔ ni.
Osɔfoi nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Zadokbii ni jɛ Levi shwiei lɛ amli ji amɛ.
Amɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa, ni amɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ.” Mligbɛ Kpo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Kɛkɛ ni esusu kpo lɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha ni elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; koji ejwɛ ni.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ anaigbɛ ni afɔleshãa latɛ ma Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ mi ba shĩa lɛ koi lɛ shi, ni esusu koi lɛ shimaamɔnii lɛ, efee ninetalɔi enumɔ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Agbo lɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Koi lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Akwɔɔ atrakpoi nyɔŋma kɛyaa he.
Akulashiŋi mamɔ shimaamɔnii lɛ amasɛi ekome yɛ biɛ ni ekome hu yɛ biɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi ba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni esusu akulashiŋi lɛ, ni eko fɛɛ eko timɔ biɛ kɛ biɛ fɛɛ lɛ ji ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Enaagbɛ lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma; ni gbogbo ni yɔɔ naa gbɛ lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ timɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni etee mligbɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni esusu akulashiŋi ni mamɔ shinaa lɛ shi lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko timɔ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Enaagbɛ lɛ lɛɛmɔ fee ninetalɔi kpawo.
Esusu tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛlɛ, efee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ; nɛkɛ tsu nɛɛ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Biɛ ji He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ.” Tsui ni kpɛtɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gbogboi lɛ Kɛkɛ ni esusu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gbogbo lɛ, etimɔ fee ninetalɔi ekpaa; ni piai ni bɔle Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi ejwɛ.
Piai ni amãmɔ kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he kɛkpe lɛ srɔdoi etɛtɛ̃ɛtɛ ni; ni srɔdo kome hiɛ piai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Gbogbo ni atswa kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, be ni eyaa ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ, belɛ aabɛ he bɔ ni afee koni tsui bibii lɛ atsiimɔ akakã Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gbogbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔ tsɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ ajɛ sɛɛgbɛ aakwɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gbogbo lɛ, anaa akɛ fɛɛ tilɛ ekome kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ kɛyashiɔ ŋwɛi.
Atswere agboi enyɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gbogbo lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛɔ ajɛɔ shishi srɔdo lɛ nɔ kɛyatsɔ̃ɔ teŋ srɔdo lɛ nɔ kɛyaa srɔdo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Mina hu akɛ atswa kpoku kɛbɔle Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he kɛkpe.
Piai lɛ ashishitoo gbogbo lɛ tilɛ fee tso kome, ni ji ninetalɔi ekpaa.
-Agbonaagbɛ piai lɛ agbogbo lɛ tilɛ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ.
Piaipiai lɛ anaa shinaa lɛ miikwɛ gbɛ ni ashi lɛ.
Shinaa kome naa ka kooyigbɛ ni shinaa kroko hu naa ka wuoyigbɛ, ni gbɛ ni ashi lɛ lɛɛmɔ hiɛ ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛbɔle kɛkpe.
Anaigbɛ tsu lɛ Tsu ko yɛ ni kwɛɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ anaigbɛ.
Elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai kpawo, ni egbogbo lɛ timɔ ji ninetalɔi enumɔ kɛbɔle kɛkpe kpula, ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fɛɛ susumɔ Nuu lɛ susu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ekɛlɛ fee ninetalɔi oha, ni kpo lɛ kɛ tsu lɛ kɛ egbogboi lɛ hu fee ninetalɔi oha.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛgbɛ kɛyaa bokãgbɛ lɛ kɛ jɛi kpo lɛ lɛɛmɔ lɛ fee ninetalɔi oha.
Agbɛnɛ esusu tsu ni kwɛɔ kpo ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ lɛ kɛ ehe ablanai ni ye ebiɛ kɛ ebiɛ lɛ akɛlɛ; efee ninetalɔi oha.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he nibii Sɔlemɔ we lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ ŋmoŋmolo eka fɛɛ mli kɛbɔle kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ aahu kɛyashi samfɛji lɛ ahe.
Samfɛji nɛɛ hu ahahaa amɛhe.
Ayeyee kerubim kɛ tɛŋ samai awo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mligbɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ.
Ayeyee samai nɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ aahu kɛtee shinai lɛ ayiteŋgbɛ.
Ato samai lɛ anaa.
Tɛŋ nyiɛ kerub sɛɛ; nakai sɔŋŋ yɛ gbogboi lɛ ahe fɛɛ kɛbɔle.
Kerub fɛɛ kerub yɛ hiɛi enyɔ: gbɔmɔ hiɛ kɛ jata hiɛ.
Be ni gbɔmɔ hiɛ lɛ miikwɛ tɛŋ lɛ afã biɛ lɛ, jata hiɛ lɛ hu miikwɛ tɛŋ lɛ afã kroko lɛ hu.
Aye samai nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli gbogboi lɛ ahe kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ kɛyashi shinaa lɛ yiteŋ tɔ̃ɔ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinaatsei lɛ amli lɛɛmɔ kɛ kɛlɛ fɛɛ ye hegbɔ.
Tso Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ Nɔ ko ma shi yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni etamɔ tso afɔleshãa latɛ.
Ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi etɛ̃, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi enyɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi enyɔ.
Ekoji lɛ kɛ eshishi lɛ kɛ nɔ ni akɛha he lɛ tso akɛfee.
Nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Enɛ ji okplɔ̃ ni maa Yehowa hiɛ lɛ.” Shinai lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ lɛ eko fɛɛ eko yɛ shinaa nta.
Ni shinaa nta lɛ agbeleɔ yɛ teŋ tuuntu.
Ni ayeyee kerubii kɛ tɛŋi asamai yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ shinai lɛ ahe, taakɛ aye awo gbogboi lɛ ahe lɛ.
Akɛ tso efee agba yɛ koi lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ.
Samfɛji ni afolɔfolɔɔ mli yɛ koi lɛ shishi biɛ kɛ biɛ, ni aye tɛŋi asamai yɛ piai lɛ kɛ kpokui lɛ ahe.
Tsui enyɔ ni bɛŋkɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi je kpo ni ekɛ mi tee agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ.
Ni ekɛ mi tee tsu ko ni ye Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ mli.
Tsu nɛɛ kɛ tsu ko ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ anaigbɛ lɛ jekɛɛɛ.
Tsu lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Tsu nɛɛ afã kome miikwɛ kpo ko ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Tsu nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he.
Tsu lɛ afã kroko lɛ miikwɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo ni aka nɔ tɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ama tsu nɛɛ srɔdoi etɛ̃, ni eko fɛɛ eko lɛ srɔdoi ni ye shikpɔŋgbɛ lɛ mli lɛɛ fe nɔ ni ma enɔ lɛ.
Ablanaa ko kã piai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋma, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi oha.
Piai lɛ ashinai lɛ ye kooyigbɛ.
Piai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛigbɛ srɔdo lɛ mli lɛ daraaa tamɔ nii ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shikpɔŋgbɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ ablanaa ni yɔɔ ŋwɛigbɛ srɔdo lɛ nɔ lɛ lɛɛ fe ablanaa ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shishigbɛ srɔdoi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ama tsu lɛ srɔdoi etɛ̃, shi moŋ amɛbɛ akulashiŋi tamɔ bɔ ni tsui krokomɛi ni yɔɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ eko lɛ.
No hewɔ abɛ ŋwɛigbɛ piai lɛ amli fe piai ni yɔɔ teŋ kɛ shishigbɛ lɛ.
Gbogbo ko yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ, ni eyɛ piai lɛ aŋlɛnɔ kɛyaa agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ.
Eekwɛ piai lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Piai ni yɔɔ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ; shi tsui ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛgbɛ lɛ ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi oha.
Kɛjɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ he ni gbogbo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, gbɛ ko kã shi kɛboteɔ piai lɛ amli.
Gbɛ ko hu kã piai lɛ ni yɔɔ tsu lɛ kɛ kpo lɛ ni ye wuoyigbɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Wuoyigbɛ piai lɛ tamɔ kooyigbɛ piai lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Amɛkɛlɛmɔ kɛ amɛlɛɛmɔ tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ; amɛnaagbɛi kɛ amɛhe shinai kɛ bɔ ni ato amɛ ahã lɛ hu tamɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ nɔŋŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Gbɛ ko kã wuoyigbɛ piai lɛ ashishigbɛ yɛ bokãgbɛ he ni atsɔ̃ɔ kɛboteɔ mli lɛ.
Gbogbo ko fo wuoyigbɛ piai nɛɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ piai lɛ ateŋ.
Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Piai ni yɔɔ kooyigbɛ lɛ kɛ piai ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ ni amɛhiɛ kwɛɔ kpo lɛ nɔ gbɛ lɛ, nomɛi ji piai krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Jɛi osɔfoi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa lɛ yeɔ afɔle krɔŋkrɔŋi ni fe fɛɛ lɛ yɛ.
Afɔlei nɛɛ ji niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ esha afɔle lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ, ejaakɛ hei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni.
Kɛji osɔfoi lɛ bote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, amɛkaje kpo kɛmiiya agbonaa kpo lɛ nɔ, be mli ni amɛ jieko amɛtadei ni amɛwo kɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ amɛshwieko shi, ejaakɛ atadei krɔŋkrɔŋi ni.
Amɛkɔlɔ atadei krokomɛi amɛwo dani amɛbɛŋkɛ he ni maŋbii lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” Sɔlemɔ we lɛ dalɛ yɛ ekponɔgbɛ Agbɛnɛ be ni nuu lɛ gbe Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mligbɛ lɛ susumɔ naa lɛ, ekɛ mi je kpo kɛtsɔ agbo ni hiɛ kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ mli.
Eyasusu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ lɛ dalɛ.
Ekɛ susumɔkpãa lɛ susu bokãgbɛ lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Etsɔ ehe ni esusu kooyigbɛ lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Esaa esusu wuoyigbɛ lɛ hu, ni efee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Asaŋ esusu anaigbɛ lɛ ni no hu fee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Esusu ehei ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Atswa gbogbo kɛbɔle he fɛɛ kɛkpe.
Gbogbo lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Akɛ gbogbo lɛ fo he ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ, kɛ he ni bɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tɛŋ.
Yehowa ku esɛɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Fee sɛɛ lɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi ba bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ naa, ni naa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ jɛ bokãgbɛ miiba.
Ebaa lɛ jijemɔ ni ekɛba lɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ; kɛkɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ kpɛ kɛ enunyam lɛ.
Ninaa ni mina lɛ tamɔ ninaa ni mina be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ba koni ebafite Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ ninaa nɛɛ etamɔ nɔ ni mina yɛ Kebar Faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Yehowa anunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli.
Mumɔ lɛ wo mi ni ekɛ mi ba mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ; ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ yi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli obɔ̃ tɔ.
Be mli ni nuu lɛ damɔ mimasɛi lɛ, minu akɛ Yehowa miiwie kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, mimaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ shimaahe ji biɛ nɛɛ, ni biɛ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ji minane maahe.
Biɛ nɛɛ mahi yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; ni Israel we lɛ woŋ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji dɔŋŋ.
Amɛ, loo amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔji krokomɛi ajamɔ kɛ amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi agbohii buleŋ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tswa amɛkpoku lɛ yɛ mikpoku lɛ masɛi; ni amɛkɛ amɛshinaatso lɛ ma mishinaatso lɛ masɛi; gbogbo kɛkɛ fo mikɛ amɛteŋ.
Amɛkɛ musubɔɔnii ni amɛfee lɛ wo migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he muji, no hewɔ lɛ, miplene amɛ yɛ mimlifu naa.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, amɛkpa amɛnyɔŋmɔi lɛ jamɔ, ni amɛ jie amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbohii lɛ kɛje mimasɛi, hewɔ lɛ mahi amɛteŋ kɛaatee naanɔ.” Agbɛnɛ, bo Gbɔmɔ Adesa, susumɔ bɔ ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɔɔ hã, kɛ esu fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Israel we lɛ koni amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ eshai ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Ni kɛji amɛhiɛ gboi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, no lɛ ojie Sɔlemɔ we lɛ su lɛ kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛ ehe gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ kɛ ekpojeehei lɛ kɛ emlibotemɔhei lɛ kɛ esu lɛ fɛɛ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ŋmãa yɛ amɛhiɛ ni amɛna, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkwɛ ni amɛye mlai lɛ fɛɛ kɛ akpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he mla nɛ.
No ji akɛ, “Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ni ema lɛ, kɛ ehewɔ shikpɔŋ fɛɛ ni kã he kɛbɔle lɛ lɛ fɛɛ baafee he ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ.
Naa, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he mla lɛ nɛ.
“Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hu dalɛ lɛ nɛ.
Susumɔnɔ ni akɛsusu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ no nɔŋŋ akɛsusu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.
Eshishigbɛ lɛ, awo nɔ ninetalɔ kome, ni elɛɛmɔ hu afee ninetalɔ kome; ni etoi lɛɛmɔ afee dɛ̃ lɛɛmɔ kɛbɔle.
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kwɔlɛ afee nɛkɛ.
Kɛjɛ eshishi ni ma shikpɔŋ kɛyamɔ eshishi sɛi lɛ, ninetalɔi enyɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome; kɛjɛ sɛi fioo lɛ nɔ kɛyashi sɛi wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ afee ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ kome.
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yiteŋ he ni akɛ afɔle lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni ashãa lɛ, ninetalɔi ejwɛ, ni kɛjɛ jɛi kɛyaa ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ he.
Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ yiteŋ he ni akɛ afɔle lɛ fɔ̃ɔ ni ashãa lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ: ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Eshishi sɛi lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ: ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Etoi lɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔ fã, kɛ eshishigbɛ nɔ lɛ ninetalɔ kome kɛbɔle.
Atrakpoi ni akwɔɔ kɛyaa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ aye bokãgbɛ.” Afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hetsuumɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he mlai nɛ: gbi nɔ ni aaama afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni aaashã shãaafɔle ni akɛ lá ashwã nɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ tsina oblanyo ohã osɔfoi ni ji Levibii ni jɛ Zadok weku lɛ mli lɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ mi ni amɛsɔmɔɔ mi lɛ, koni amɛkɛshã esha he afɔle.
Ŋɔɔ elá lɛ eko ni okɛdiki afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he aklontoi ejwɛ lɛ koji ejwɛ lɛ ahe, kɛ etoi ni bɔle lɛ kpula kɛkpe lɛ he.
Bɔ ni ofee; ni okɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he, ni okɛkpãtã hu oha lɛ lɛ nɛ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ tsinanuu ni akɛbaashã esha he afɔlei lɛ ni ashã yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ sɛɛ, he ni ato akɛ ashã yɛ lɛ.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, okɛ too kpakpo hu ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã esha he afɔle, ni akɛjie afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he esha lɛ tamɔ akɛ tsinanuu lɛ nɔ lɛ tsuu he lɛ.
Kɛji ogbe hetsuumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, okɛ tsinanuu ni kpako bɛ ehe kɛ too ojwɛni ni kpako bɛ ehe ashã afɔle.
Okɛ amɛ aba mi, Yehowa mihiɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ ŋoo ashwã amɛnɔ koni ashã akɛ shãa afɔle ahã mi, Yehowa.
Daa gbi lɛ oha too kpakpo kɛ tsina oblanyo kɛ ojwɛni ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe ashã esha he afɔle ahã mi kɛyashi gbii kpawo.
Osɔfoi lɛ aŋɔ gbii kpawo ni amɛkɛtsuu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he koni amɛha ehe atse.
Kɛji hetsuumɔ gbii lɛ anaa tã lɛ, kɛjɛ gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛyaa lɛ osɔfoi lɛ ashã nyɛshãa afɔlei lɛ kɛ nyɛshidaa afɔlei lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ mana nyɛhe tsui.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni ahiɛ bokãgbɛ shinaa lɛ Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛ mi ku sɛɛ kɛba He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ shinaa ni yɔɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ naa.
Aŋa shinaa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Shinaa nɛɛ aŋa daa; akagbele, ni mɔ ko akatsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote mli; ejaakɛ Yehowa, ni ji Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbote mli, hewɔ lɛ aŋa daa.
Lumɔ lɛ pɛ ji mɔ ni aaanyɛ ayata jɛi eyaye aboloo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Lɛ pɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koishi gbɛ lɛ kɛbote mli ni etsɔ̃ jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo.” Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mlibotemɔ he mlai Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ naa gbɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛ.
Mikwɛ, ni naa, Yehowa anunyam lɛ eyi Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ obɔ̃.
Kɛkɛ ni miho migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ nɔ, okɛ ohiŋmɛi akwɛ, ni okɛ otoi anu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni makɛɛ bo yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he akpɔi kɛ mlai lɛ ahe lɛ.
Kadimɔ koni ole jogbaŋŋ mɛi ni sa akɛ amɛboteɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, kɛ mɛi ni esaaa akɛ amɛboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
“Kɛɛmɔ toigbolɔi lɛ, ni ji Israel we lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɔ nɛ, ao Israel we, nyɛmusubɔɔnii lɛ, nyɛkpaa!
Kɛji nyɛkɛ miniyenii afɔle ni ji fɔ kɛ lá lɛ miiba lɛ, nyɛkaŋmɛa maŋsɛɛbii ni ji tsuiŋ foolɔi lɛ gbɛ ni amɛmiiba miHe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni amɛbule lɛ.
Nyɛmusubɔɔnii fɛɛ lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, nyɛku mikpãŋmɔ lɛ hu mli nyɛfata he.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛtsuuu minibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahe nii yɛ miHe Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛto maŋsɛɛbii ni amɛtsu.
“Maŋsɛɛbii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israelbii ateŋ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ni ji tsuiŋ foolɔ kɛ helooŋ foolɔ akabote miHe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Atse Levibii lɛ kɛje Osɔfoi lɛ ahe “Shi moŋ Levibii ni shi mi kɛtee sɛɛ shɔŋŋ ni amɛyanyiɛ amɛwɔji asɛɛ be ni Israelbii du gbɛ lɛ, abaagbala amɛtoi.
Amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ miHe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, amɛbaabu miSɔlemɔ we lɛ agboi lɛ anaa, ni amɛbaasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli hu.
Amɛ amɛbaagbe kooloi ni akɛbaashã shãaafɔlei lɛ, kɛ maŋbii lɛ afɔlei lɛ; ni amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛbaawa maŋbii lɛ ni amɛsɔmɔ amɛ.
Akɛni Levibii lɛ sɔmɔ Israelbii lɛ yɛ amɛwɔji lɛ anaa, ni no hã Israel we lɛ fee esha hewɔ lɛ, mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa, mikã mihe kitã akɛ mibagbala amɛtoi.
Amɛbɛŋkɛŋ mi koni amɛbasɔmɔ mi akɛ osɔfoi; ni amɛbɛŋkɛŋ minibii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ nibii ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ lɛ ekoeko kwraa he.
Shi moŋ, amɛhiɛ baashwie shi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛ̃lɛ, mikɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli nitsumɔ baawo amɛdɛŋ koni amɛtsu nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni sa ni atsu yɛ mli lɛ.” Osɔfoi lɛ “Osɔfoi lɛ ni jɛ Levi akutso lɛ mli, ni amɛ ji Zadok shwiei, mɛi ni kã he amɛsɔmɔ mi yɛ miHe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, be mli ni Isrealbii lɛ du gbɛ kɛje mihe lɛ, amɛ amɛbaabɛŋkɛ mi ni amɛsɔmɔ mi.
Amɛ amɛbaashã fɔ kɛ lá afɔle lɛ amɛha mi.
Yehowa kɛɛ.
Amɛ amɛbaabote miHe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛ amɛbaabɛŋkɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ ni amɛsɔmɔ mi; ni amɛ amɛbaatsu minii amɛhã mi.
Kɛ amɛmiiya Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛwo klala atadei.
Amɛkawo kuntu nɔ ko nɔ ko be mli ni amɛsɔmɔɔ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ agboi lɛ anaa kɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
“Amɛfi klala bɔnduku, ni amɛwo klala tswakoto.
Amɛkafi amɛmli kɛ nɔ ko ni baahã latsa baatsa amɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛmiije kpo kɛya maŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛ jie amɛtadei ni amɛwo kɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛshwie He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ piai lɛ amli.
Amɛwo atadei krokomɛi koni nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akatsɛŋe maŋbii lɛ.
Osɔfoi lɛ akashɛ amɛyi, ni amɛkato amɛyi hu; shi moŋ amɛshwao nɔ kɛkɛ.
Osɔfo ko osɔfo ko akanu wain kɛji eeya mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Amɛkaŋɔ yoo okulafo loo yoo ni ashwie lɛ; shi moŋ osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ oblayoo foro ni jɛ Israel we lɛ shwiei lɛ amli, loo okulafo ni ji osɔfo ko ŋa okulafo.
“Osɔfo lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mimaŋbii lɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nɔ ni jeee krɔŋkrɔŋ teŋ.
Amɛha amɛle srɔto ni yɔɔ nɔ ni he tseee kɛ nɔ ni he tse teŋ.
Kɛji naataamɔ ko te shi lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ nɔŋŋ afee kojolɔi ni amɛkura sane lɛ yɛ mimlai kɛ akpɔi lɛ anaa.
Amɛye mimlai kɛ mikpɔi ni kɔɔ migbii juji ni mito lɛ ahe lɛ anɔ.
Amɛfee mihejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Amɛkaya gbonyo ko he ni amɛkɛbule amɛhe; kɛ̃lɛ yɛ tsɛ loo nyɛ loo binuu loo biyoo, loo nyɛmi nuu loo nyɛmi yoo ni bɛ wu pɛ he amɛaanyɛ amɛbule amɛhe yɛ.
Kɛji ebule ehe lɛ emɛ kɛyashi gbii kpawo dani ehe aaatse.
Gbi nɔ ni eyaa He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ koni eyasɔmɔ yɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eyashã ehe esha afɔle.
Mi, Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa mikɛɛ.
“Osɔfoi lɛ bɛ gboshinii ko; mi ji amɛgboshinii.
Amɛkana gboshinii ko kwraa yɛ Israel.
Mi ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Nii ni amɛye ji niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ esha he afɔle lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ afɔle lɛ.
Asaŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ajɔɔ nɔ yɛ Israel atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Nyɛŋmɔshinii fɛɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛshãa afɔlei nyɛhãa mi lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ anɔ ni.
Asaŋ klɛŋklɛŋ ma aboloo ni nyɛaashã lɛ, akɛhã osɔfoi lɛ, koni mijɔɔmɔ ahi nyɛwe.
Osɔfoi lɛ akaye loofɔlɔ ko aloo kooloo ko ni gbo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edɛŋ gbele, aloo kooloo ko tserɛ lɛ ni egbo.”
Yehowa gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ jaa mli Kɛji nyɛmiija shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhã nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛfoa eko nyɛhãa Yehowa, akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko.
Eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he fɛɛ he afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Afo eshikpɔŋ ni ji egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli eko ni ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ekɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi ohai enumɔ.
Biɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ama.
Shikpɔŋ ni akã he kɛbɔle lɛ lɛ afee ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shikpɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ, afo emli eko; no kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma.
Ni jɛi afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ, no mli Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ama.
Shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he ni shwɛɔ lɛ, akɛhã osɔfoi lɛ ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛɔ Yehowa ni amɛsɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Etsɔ he ni abaamamɔ amɛshĩai yɛ, ni jɛi hu afee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ fã ko ni ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma lɛ akɛhã Levibii ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
Amɛmamɔ maji yɛ nɔ ni amɛhi mli.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ mli he krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ masɛi lɛ nyɛfoa shikpɔŋ ko hu ni lɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi akpei enumɔ, kɛ ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ; ni ama maŋ yɛ nɔ, ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanyɛ jɛi ahi.
Lumɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ Afo shikpɔŋ lɛ eko ahã lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ nɛɛ baajɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ yɛ anai.
Ni ebokãgbɛ husu lɛ eyamɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni eshikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni aha Israel weku lɛ ateŋ eko fɛɛ eko afee pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ atsɔ̃ lumɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ Israel, koni milumɛi lɛ akawa mimaŋbii lɛ ayi dɔŋŋ; shi moŋ lumɛi lɛ aha Israel we lɛ ana shikpɔŋ lɛ eko yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ anaa.
Mlai ni awoɔ lumɔ lɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Ao, nyɛ Israel lumɛi, bɔ ni nyɛfee lɛ efa.
Nyɛfɔ̃a yiwalɛ kɛ nɔnyɛɛ nifeemɔi lɛ, ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane koni nyɛfee nɔ ni ja.
Nyɛkpaa mimaŋbii lɛ shwiemɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Nyɛkɛ ŋsɛnii ni ja kɛ efa ni ja kɛ bat ni ja asusua nii.
“Efa kɛ bat aye hegbɔ, koni bat lɛ aye homer mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni efa lɛ hu homer mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome; homer, afee tɛ ni afo.
“Susumɔnii krokomɛi nɛ: Gerai nyɔŋmai enyɔ feɔ shekel kome.
Shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ, shekeli nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ shekeli nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ afee mina kome ahã nyɛ.
“Afɔle ni nyɛbaashã nɛ: Ŋmãa efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome ni ji homer mlijaa nyɔŋmai ekpaa mli ekome.
Akoko hu efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome, ni ji homer mlijaa nyɔŋmai ekpaa mli ekome.
Mu he mla nɛ: Mu bat kome mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekome, ni ji mu kor mlijaa oha mli ekome.
(Kor tamɔ homer nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ bat nyɔŋma feɔ homer kome) Too he mla nɛ: Israel weku fɛɛ weku ajie too kome yɛ toi ohai enyɔ mli ekɛbashã afɔle.
Akɛ nibii nɛɛ ashã niyenii afɔle kɛ shãa afɔle kɛ shidaa afɔle koni akɛkpãtã nyɛhe eshai lɛ aha nyɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Israel shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ aŋɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ ahã lumɔ ni yɔɔ Israel lɛ.
Lumɔ lɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ, lɛ eha kooloi ni akɛbaashã afɔlei ni ji shãa afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei kɛ dãa afɔlei lɛ yɛ gbii juji kɛ nyɔji hei kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii kɛ Israelbii agbii juji krokomɛi ni amɛyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eha nɔ ni akɛbaashã esha afɔle lɛ kɛ niyenii afɔle lɛ kɛ shãaafɔle lɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ afɔle lɛ, koni akɛkpãtã aha Israel we lɛ.” Gbii juji lɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ tsina oblanyo ni kpa ko kwraa bɛ ehe, koni okɛtsuu He krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he.
Osɔfo lɛ aŋɔ kooloo ni akɛshã esha he afɔle lɛ lá lɛ eko, koni ekɛdiki Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaatsei lɛ ahe kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ shishitoo koji ejwɛ lɛ ahe; ekɛdiki shinaatsei ni yɔɔ agbo ni kã kɛyaa mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe hu.
Nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mɔ ni jeee kwa ekwa efee esha, loo mɔ ni leee ni efee esha ko lɛ, koni akɛtsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he.
“Asaŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛyea Hehoo lɛ.
Aye aboloo ni akɛ mã akpiti shã gbii kpawo.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ ahã tsinanuu kome ni akɛshã esha afɔle ahã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Gbijurɔyeli gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ lɛ, ehã tsinahii kpawo kɛ ojwɛnii kpawo ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe, ni akɛshã shãa afɔle aha Yehowa.
Daa gbi lɛ ehã kpakpo kome hu ni akɛshã esha he afɔle.
Nɔ ni ehã ni akɛshã niyenii afɔle nɛ ŋmãa efa kome afata tsinanuu kome he, ni ŋmãa efa kome afata ojwɛni kome he; ni ŋmãa efa fɛɛ efa lɛ akɛ mu hiŋ kome afata he.
Nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛ abaaye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ, gbii kpawo lɛ mli gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, lumɔ lɛ ahã nibii nɛɛ ni akɛshã esha afɔlei kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ ŋmãa afɔlei kɛ mu lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.”
Lumɔ lɛ kɛ Gbii juji lɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mligbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ agbo lɛ ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ, aŋa daa nitsumɔ gbii ekpaa lɛ; shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ agbele, ni nyɔŋ hee gbi lɛ nɔ hu agbele.
Ni lumɔ lɛ ajɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koi lɛ shi kɛbote mli, ni eyadamɔ agbo lɛ shinaatso lɛ he.
Osɔfoi lɛ ashã eshãa afɔle lɛ kɛ etoiŋjɔlɛ afɔlei lɛ ahã lɛ; ni eja Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ naa; ni eje kpo.
Shi agbo lɛ, akaŋa kwraa kɛyashi gbɛkɛnaashi.
Maŋbii lɛ aba Yehowa hiɛ ni amɛbaja lɛ yɛ agbo lɛ shinaa lɛ naa yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ kɛ nyɔji hei lɛ anɔ.
Shãa afɔle ni lumɔ lɛ kɛba ebaha Yehowa yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ ji too gwantɛŋbii ekpaa ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe kɛ ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ ehe.
Niyenii afɔle ni afata ojwɛni kome he ji, ŋmãa efa kome; ni niyenii afɔle ni afata gwantɛŋbii lɛ ahe ji bɔ ni lɛ eeenyɛ.
Ekɛ mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.
Nyɔŋ hee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ baahã tsina oblanyo kome kɛ too gwantɛŋbii ekpaa kɛ ojwɛni kome ni kpa ko bɛ amɛhe.
Niyenii afɔle ni baafata tsinanuu kome he ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ojwɛni kome hu ŋmãa efa kome; ni gwantɛŋbii lɛ hu ŋmãa bɔ ni lɛ eeenyɛ ehã.
Ni ekɛ mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.
Kɛji lumɔ lɛ baabote mli lɛ etsɔ̃ agbo lɛ koi lɛ shi gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛya mli, ni etsɔ̃ jɛi nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo.
“Kɛji maŋbii lɛ miiba abaja Yehowa yɛ gbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli kɛbote mli ni ebaja lɛ, etsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛje kpo.
Ni mɔ ni aaatsɔ wuoyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛbote mli lɛ, etsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ kɛje kpo.
Mɔ ko akatsɔ̃ agbo ni etsɔ̃ kɛba mli lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛje kpo.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛje kpo.
Kɛji maŋbii lɛ miibote mli lɛ, lumɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ abote mli; ni kɛ amɛmiije kpo hu, ekɛ amɛ aje kpo.
Gbijurɔ fɛɛ gbijurɔ nɔ lɛ niyenii afɔle ni afata tsina oblanyo kome he ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ojwɛni kome hu nɔ lɛ ji ŋmãa efa kome; ni ekɛ ŋmãa bɔ ni eeenyɛ afata gwantɛŋbii lɛ ahe.
Ni mu hin kome afata ŋmãa efa kome fɛɛ efa kome he.
“Kɛji lumɔ lɛ baashã tsuijurɔ naa afɔle ehã Yehowa lɛ, shãa afɔle jio, shidaa afɔle jio, agbele agbo ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ ahã lɛ koni ekɛ eshãa afɔlei lɛ loo shidaa afɔle lɛ ayahã tamɔ efeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ eje kpo; ni kɛ eje kpo sɛɛ lɛ, aŋa agbo lɛ.” Daa gbi afɔle lɛ “Daa gbi leebi lɛ, ekɛ gwantɛŋbi kome ni eye afi ni kpa ko bɛ ehe ashã shãa afɔle ahã Yehowa.
Eshã afɔle nɛɛ daa leebi.
Ekɛ niyenii afɔle afata he daa leebi.
Eŋɔ ŋmãa mamu efa mlijaa ekpaa mli ekome, ni ekɛ mu hin mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome afata he, ni akɛkpɔtɔ akɛ niyenii afɔle ahã Yehowa.
Akpɔ ni akã shi daa ji no.
No hewɔ lɛ, aha gwantɛŋbi lɛ kɛ ŋmãa mamu lɛ kɛ mu ni akɛbaasha shãa afɔle lɛ daa leebi.
Daa shãa afɔle ji no.” Lumɔ lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Kɛji lumɔ lɛ kɛ egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli eko ke ebihii lɛ eko lɛ, no atsɔ̃ ebi lɛ nɔ; egboshinii ni ena ji no.
Shi kɛji lumɔ lɛ fo egbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ eko eke etsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko lɛ, no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ ahi tsulɔ lɛ dɛŋ kɛyashi heyeli afi lɛ nɔ; kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛku sɛɛ ehã lumɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Shi ebihii lɛ pɛ baanyɛ aŋɔ gboshinii ni akɛke amɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Asaŋ lumɔ lɛ akashɔ̃ maŋbii lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ ekɛ nɔ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ lɛ mli eko ahã ebihii lɛ ni etsɔ̃ amɛnɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ eko gboshinii yɛ edɛŋ.” Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli Kpatai lɛ Agbɛnɛ nuu lɛ kɛ mi tsɔ̃ gbɛ ko ni kã agbo lɛ masɛi lɛ mli kɛtee kooyigbɛ he ni osɔfoi lɛ atsui krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Ni jɛi lɛ mina he ko yɛ tsui lɛ anaigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Biɛ nɛɛ ji he ni osɔfoi lɛ baahoo sɔ̃ afɔlei kɛ esha afɔlei lɛ yɛ; ni biɛ amɛaashã niyenii afɔlei lɛ yɛ; bɔ ni afee ni amɛkɛkaje kpo kɛmiiya agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akatsɛŋe maŋbii lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mi je kpo kɛba agbonaagbɛ kpo lɛ nɔ, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛbɔle kpo lɛ nɔ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni koŋ fɛɛ koŋ lɛ kpo yɛ jɛi.
Ni koŋ fɛɛ koŋ lɛ afo kpo bibioo ko yɛ jɛi; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃; kpoi bibii ejwɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ amɛdaramɔ ekome.
Atswa tɛ gbogbo kɛbɔle kpo fɛɛ kpo he kɛkpe kpula, ni afee latɛi akpɛtɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ shishigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni nuu lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Biɛ nɛɛ ji kpatai, he ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli suɔlɔi lɛ baahoo loo ni maŋbii kɛbashã afɔlei lɛ yɛ.”
Nu ni hoɔ kɛjɛɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Nuu lɛ kɛ mi ku sɛɛ kɛba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa lɛ shi ekoŋŋ; ni naa, nu miiho kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa kpoku lɛ shishi kɛmiiya bokãgbɛ he ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hiɛgbɛ kwɛɔ lɛ.
Nu lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ wuoyigbɛ yɛ shinaa lɛ kpoku lɛ shishi, yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ mi je kpo kɛtsɔ kooyigbɛ agbo lɛ mli, ni ekpala mi kɛlɔgɔ shi kɛba agbonaagbɛ agbo ni kwɛɔ bokãgbɛ lɛ naa.
Ni nu lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Nuu lɛ hiɛ susumɔ kpãa yɛ edɛŋ ni etee bokãgbɛ eyasusu nu lɛ ni efee ninetalɔi akpe, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo nu lɛ, ni nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta nane kpɔ nɔ.
Esaa esusu nu lɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi akpe; ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo nu lɛ, ni nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta nakutso.
Esusu ninetalɔi akpe kroko hu, ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛfo.
Nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ ta hɛ.
Esusu nu lɛ mlikwɔlɛ, ni efee ninetalɔi akpe, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ faa ni minyɛɛɛ mafo.
Ejaakɛ nu lɛ mli kwɔ ni etsɔ̃ faa ni anyɛɛɛ afo, shi seremɔ asereɔ kɛfoɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi mi akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Adesa, ona enɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni enyiɛ mihiɛ kɛku sɛɛ kɛba faa lɛ naa ekoŋŋ.
Ni be ni miku misɛɛ miba lɛ, mina tsei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ yɛ faa lɛ toi biɛ kɛ biɛ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nɛkɛ nu nɛɛ hoɔ kɛyaa bokãgbɛ, ni emaa eyi shi kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yordan Jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ enaa yawoɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛji nu lɛ bote Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ehãa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu tsɔ̃ɔ nuŋma.” “He fɛɛ he ni nujɔɔ nɛɛ hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ, jɛi kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni hiɛ kã lɛ yi baana wala, ni emli loi baafa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ejaakɛ nujɔɔ nɛɛ hoɔ ewoɔ Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ehãa Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli nu lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nuŋma, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ enaa wala.
Wolɛi aaadamɔ shi kɛjɛ En-Gedi ŋshɔnaa aahu kɛyagbee En-Eglaim ŋshɔnaa tɔ̃ɔ, ni jɛi aaatsɔ yaa kamɔhe.
Emli loi srɔtoisrɔtoi aaafa babaoo diɛŋtsɛ tamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli loi lɛ.
Shi nu ni yɔɔ emukpoi kɛ ehewɔ ŋmiamɔi lɛ amli lɛ tsɔŋ nuŋma.
Nomɛi baanyɔ ŋoo.
Yelitsei srɔtoisrɔtoi fɛɛ baakwɛ̃ yɛ faa lɛ toi biɛ kɛ biɛ; ni amɛyibai kplaŋ ni amɛyibii hu kplaŋ shi moŋ nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ lɛ, amɛbaawo yibii hei, ejaakɛ nuŋma ni jɛɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hãa amɛ nu.
Amɛyibii aaatsɔ̃ niyenii, ni amɛyibai lɛ aatsɔ̃ tsabaa.” Shikpɔŋ lɛ husui lɛ “Shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛbaaja nyɛhã Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ehusui nɛ: Yosef akutso lɛ ana toi enyɔ.
Mikã shikpɔŋ nɛɛ he kitã akɛ mikɛbaahã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ nyɛgbɛfaŋnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjaa lɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana pɛpɛɛpɛ tamɔ enyɛmi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ husu lɛ nɛ: Kooyigbɛ lɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛyatsɔ Hetlon kɛ Lebo-Hamat kɛ Zedad, kɛ Berota kɛ Sibraim ni kã Damasko kɛ Hamat husu lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Husu lɛ atsa nɔ aahu kɛyashi Hazer-Hatikon ni kã Hauran husu naa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kooyigbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he kɛtsɔ bokãgbɛ kɛya Hazar-Enon ni kã Damasko kɛ Hamat husui lɛ anaa yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ.
Enɛ aaatsɔ kooyigbɛ husu lɛ.
“Bokãgbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Hazar-Enon ni kã Hauran kɛ Damasko teŋ lɛ.
Aŋɔ Yordan Faa lɛ akɛ husu, bɔ ni Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ aye anaigbɛ, ni Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ hu aye bokãgbɛ.
Husu lɛ akã shi aahu kɛyashi Tamar tɔ̃ɔ yɛ bokãgbɛ ŋshɔ lɛ he.
Enɛ baatsɔ̃ bokãgbɛ husu.
“Wuoyigbɛ husu lɛ nɛ.
Kɛjɛ Tamar kɛtsɔ̃ Meribat-Kadesh Faa lɛ he, kɛtsɔ̃ Ijipt nujɔɔ lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Enɛ baatsɔ̃ wuoyigbɛ husu.
“Anaigbɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he, ni etsɔ̃ kooyigbɛ aahu kɛyashi he ko yɛ Lebo-Hamat ŋlɛnɔ.
Enɛ baatsɔ̃ anaigbɛ husu lɛ.
Nɛkɛ nyɛjaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhaa nyɛhe yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa.
Nyɛfɔ̃a oshiki kɛjaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhãa nyɛhe, ni etsɔ̃ gboshinii eha nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni ebato gbɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni amɛfɔɔ bii yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ.
Amɛtsɔmɔ tamɔ Israel fɔmɔbii nɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ koni amɛ kɛ nyɛ aja shikpɔŋ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ akɛ gboshinii hã nyɛ yɛ Israel akutsei lɛ anaa.
“Akutso fɛɛ akutso mli ni gbɔ ko yɔɔ lɛ, aha lɛ gboshinii lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ akutso lɛ mli.” Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
