Aja shikpɔŋ lɛ ahã akutsei lɛ “Bɔ ni aja shikpɔŋ lɛ aha Israel akutsei lɛ nɛ: Dan akutso lɛ na kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ yɛ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa kɛtsɔ Hetlon maŋ wulu lɛ kɛtsɔ Lebo-Hamat kɛyamɔ Hazar-Enon yɛ Damasko kooyigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ.
Dan shikpɔŋ nɛɛ kã shi kɛjɛ bokã kɛtee anai.
Asher shikpɔŋ lɛ tsa Dan nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Naftali nɔ tsa Asher nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Manase nɔ lɛ tsa Naftali nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Efraim nɔ lɛ tsa Manase nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Ruben nɔ lɛ tsa Efraim nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
Yuda nɔ lɛ tsa Ruben nɔ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa kɛtee anaigbɛ.
He ko krɛdɛɛ yɛ Shikpɔŋ lɛ teŋ “Nyɛfoa shikpɔŋ lɛ he ko krɛdɛɛ ni kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ nyɛfɔa shi.
No lɛɛmɔ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, ni ekɛlɛ atamɔ gbɛfaŋnii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anai husu lɛ nɔ.
He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama teŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ he krɛdɛɛ ni nyɛbaafo nyɛfɔ̃ shi kɛha Yehowa lɛ kɛlɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ.
Shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ, bɔ ni ajara lɛ nɛ: Asusu ekɛlɛ ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ yɛ kooyigbɛ ni wuoyigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ bokãgbɛ ni anaigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ama shikpɔŋ nɛɛ teŋ.
Akɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ ahã osɔfoi ni afɔ amɛ mu ni jɛ Zadok shwiei lɛ amli lɛ.
Amɛ amɛ ji mɛi ni sɔmɔ mi anɔkwale mli be ni Israelbii kɛ Levibii lɛ du gbɛ lɛ.
Enɛ afee amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ ni ji krɔŋkrɔŋ fe fɛɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni afo lɛ mli, ni ebɛŋkɛ Levibii lɛ ahusu lɛ.
Levibii lɛ hu ana amɛgbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ osɔfoi lɛ ahusu lɛ ŋlɛnɔ, yɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Ekɛlɛ kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛyashi wuoyigbɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma.
Amɛkahɔ̃ɔ eko, ni amɛkɛkatsake eko hu.
Amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ krɛdɛɛ ni akɔ nɛɛ he ko he ko akahã mɔ ko, ejaakɛ eji shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ha Yehowa.
“Agbɛnɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni shwɛɔ, ni elɛɛmɔ ji ninetalɔi akpei enumɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ hu ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ lɛ akã shi akɛ kwamaŋnɔ, ni akɛfee shihilɛhei kɛ maŋ he shikpɔŋ, ni maŋ lɛ ahi shikpɔŋ nɛɛ teŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ fɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, no ji ninetalɔi akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ kɛjɛ koŋ kome kɛyamɔ koŋ kome.
“Shikpɔŋ ni akã shi efolo yɛ maŋ lɛ he fɛɛ kɛbɔle lɛ kɛjɛ kooyigbɛ kɛtee wuoyigbɛ afee ninetalɔi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ, kɛjɛ bokã kɛtee anai hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shikpɔŋ ni shwɛɔ ni kã shi yɛ he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ afee ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma yɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ anaigbɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Akɛ no afee ŋmɔ koni ana niyenii kɛjɛ mli aha nitsulɔi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ maŋ lɛ he nii lɛ.
Maŋ lɛ mli nitsulɔi ni jɛ Israel akutsei lɛ amli lɛ, ahu jɛi.
“Belɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛfo nyɛfɔ̃ shi kɛha he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ, no ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ enumɔ.
-“Agbɛnɛ shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ ni kã Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ lɛ he biɛ kɛ biɛ, kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ kɛyashi anaigbɛ lɛ, afee lumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ekã shi kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he kɛtee bokãgbɛ husu lɛ naa, ni anaigbɛ hu ekã kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Ekooyigbɛ husu ji he ni Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ kã lɛ, ni ewuoyigbɛ husu ji Benyamin shikpɔŋ lɛ husu naa.” Akutsei krokomɛi lɛ ashikpɔŋ “Ni akutsei ni eshwɛ lɛ nɛ: kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Benyamin nɔ ni.
Ni Benyamin husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Simeon nɔ ni.
Ni Simeon husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Isakar nɔ ni.
Ni Isakar husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zebulon nɔ ni.
Ni Zebulon husu lɛ masɛi kɛjɛ bokãgbɛ husu lɛ nɔ kɛyashi anaigbɛ husu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Gad nɔ ni.
Shikpɔŋ ni akɛha Gad akutso lɛ wuoyigbɛ lɛ husu lɛ ajɛ Tamar kɛnyiɛ wuoyi anaigbɛ kɛyamɔ Meriba-Kadesh Faa lɛ kɛtsɔ Ijipt nujɔɔ lɛ he kɛyamɔ Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ.
Enɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nyɛbaaja nyɛha Israel akutsei lɛ; amɛgboshinii kɛ amɛgbɛfaŋnii ji enɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.” Yerusalɛm agboi lɛ - “Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ gbogbo kome koŋ kɛyashi gbogbo kroko koŋ lɛ kɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei ejwɛ kɛ ohai enumɔ, ni eko fɛɛ eko hiɛ agboi etɛ̃; ni akɛ Israel akutsei lɛ agbɛi ewo agbo fɛɛ agbo.
Kooyigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Ruben kɛ Yuda kɛ Levi.
Bokãgbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Yosef kɛ Benyamin kɛ Dan.
Wuoyigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Simeon kɛ Isakar kɛ Zebulon, ni anaigbɛ agboi lɛ akɛwo Gad kɛ Asher kɛ Naftali.
Hewɔ lɛ gbogbo ni bɔle maŋ lɛ he kpula kɛkpe lɛ ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ maŋ lɛ gbɛi ji: ‘Yehowa yɛ jɛi!’ ”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Aŋma Daniel Wolo lɛ be mli ni Yudafoi lɛ miina nɔ waa yɛ maŋtsɛ wɔŋjalɔ kɛ yitsoŋwalɔ ko nɔyeli shishi.
Mɔ ni ŋma wolo lɛ ŋɔ jeŋ saji kɛ ninaa he saji, ni ekɛwo eyinɔbii lɛ hewalɛ.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ baahã amɛnɔyelɔ yitsoŋwalɔ lɛ nɔyeli lɛ sɛɛ afo, ni naagbee lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ baaye amɛhe.
Aja wolo lɛ mli enyɔ.
.
Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi nomii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ahe saji.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tsɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ toiboo nɔ amɛye amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ kunim.
Aŋma saji nɛɛ yɛ Babilonbii kɛ Persiabii amaŋtsɛyeli beiaŋ.
.
Ninai komɛi ni Daniel na kɛtsɔ̃ okadi nibii anɔ.
Ninai nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni nɔyelɔi srɔtoi baaba abaye nɔ, kɛ bɔ hu ni amɛbaagbee shi amɛhã.
Akɛ Babilon nɔyeli je shishi; ni agbaa bɔ ni baafee ni jeŋnyo yiwalɔ lɛ baagbee shi ahã, ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ baaye kunim.
Mlijaramɔi Daniel kɛ enanemɛi lɛ .—.
Daniel ninai lɛ .—.
a. Kooloi Ejwɛ lɛ .- b. Gwantɛŋ kɛ Abotia lɛ .—.
d. Ŋwɛi Bɔfo lɛ .—.
Naagbee be ni ato lɛ .-
DANIEL KƐ ENANEMƐI LƐ AHE SANE LƐ Oblahii lɛ yɛ Nebukadnezar koishi Yuda Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Babilon Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã ta kɛba, ni ebasa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yi.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã eye Maŋtsɛ Yehoiakim nɔ kunim.
Kɛkɛ ni emɔ Yehoiakim kɛ nomii komɛi hu, ni eloo Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli nibii lɛ ekomɛi, ni ekɛ nomii lɛ kɛ nibii nɛɛ tee Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ nibii lɛ yawo enyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ mli nitoohe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã Ashpenaz, epiafonyonukpa ni fe fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ ehala Israelbii nomii lɛ ateŋ maŋtsɛmɛiabii lɛ kɛ abladei ashwiei lɛ ateŋ oblahii komɛi.
Esa akɛ oblahii nɛɛ ahe yɛ fɛo, kpa ko kpa ko akahi amɛgbɔmɔtsei ahe; amɛyɛ tsɔsemɔ, amɛyɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni amɛjwɛŋmɔŋ kã shi kɛhã nikasemɔ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli.
Efã hu akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Babilonbii awiemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛwoloŋ hu.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar to akɛ daa gbi lɛ ahã oblahii nɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii kɛfɔkɛfɔ ni eyeɔ kɛ wain hu ni enuɔ lɛ eko.
Ekɛɛ akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii afii etɛ̃; ni no sɛɛ lɛ akɛ oblahii lɛ aba abatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Oblahii ni ahala lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji Daniel kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛjɛ Yuda akutso lɛ mli.
Piafonyonukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ wo oblahii ejwɛ nɛɛ gbɛii krokomɛi.
Ewo Daniel Belteshazar, ni ewo Hanania Shadrak, ni ewo Mishael Meshak, ni ewo Azaria Abednego.
Shi Daniel tswa efai shi akɛ eyeŋ maŋtsɛ niyenii ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ni enuŋ maŋtsɛ wain lɛ hu koni ekabule ehe.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekpa Ashpenaz, piafonyonukpa fe fɛɛ lɛ, fai akɛ eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ koni ekabule ehe.
Nyɔŋmɔ hã Ashpenaz hiɛ sɔ Daniel, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe.
Shi moŋ ekɛɛ Daniel akɛ, “Miishe gbeyei akɛ aleee nɔ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eto niyenii kɛ wain ni akɛhã nyɛ lɛ, baana akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei bɛ akɔnɔ tamɔ nyɛtipɛŋfoi oblahii krokomɛi lɛ agbɔmɔtsei.
Enɛ aaahã miwala atɔ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Daniel kɛɛ mɔ ni piafonyonukpa lɛ efã akɛ ekwɛ lɛ Daniel lɛ kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ofainɛ, hã wɔ tsei ayibii kɛ baibai kɛkɛ koni wɔye kɛ nu folo hu kɛkɛ ni wɔnu kɛyashi biɛ gbii nyɔŋma koni okɛka wɔ, otsuji, okwɛ; koni no sɛɛ lɛ okɛ wɔ ato oblahii ni yeɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ niyenii ni ewo fɔ lɛ ahe.
Bɔ ni ooona lɛ odamɔ no nɔ koni ofee wɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ.” Nuu lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ sane ni Daniel kɛfɔ̃ ehiɛ lɛ nɔ, ni eka Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aniyenii hamɔ lɛ gbii nyɔŋma lɛ ekwɛ.
Gbii nyɔŋma lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ana akɛ Daniel kɛ enanemɛi lɛ ahiɛ efee fɛo, ni amɛgbɔmɔtsei eshwishwii fe oblahii krokomɛi lɛ ni yeɔ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli niyenii kpakpai ni ewo fɔ lɛ agbɔmɔtsei.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkwɛlɔ lɛ shi niyenii kɛ wain ni ato akɛ akɛhã amɛ lɛ sɛɛ, ni ehã amɛ tsei ayibii kɛ baibai lɛ kɛkɛ, ni amɛye.
Nyɔŋmɔ duro nɛkɛ oblahii ejwɛ nɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni amɛnyɛ amɛkase woloŋ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ.
Yɛ Daniel gbɛfaŋ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã enu ninaa fɛɛ ninaa kɛ lamɔ fɛɛ lamɔ hu shishi efata he.
Be ni be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ eto lɛ shɛ lɛ, Ashpenaz, piafonyo lɛ, kɛ oblahii lɛ fɛɛ tee Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ ekɛ amɛ yatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ wie, ni Daniel kɛ Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria ji mɛi ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ sɔ fe fɛɛ yɛ oblahii lɛ ateŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ehala amɛ koni amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli.
Nilee fɛɛ nilee kɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni maŋtsɛ lɛ bi Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, ena akɛ amɛle nii shii nyɔŋma toi abɔ fe emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ninalɔi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Daniel sɔ̃mɔ yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ mli aahu kɛyashi afi nɔ ni Persia Maŋtsɛ Koresh baye Babilon nɔ kunim lɛ.
Nebukadnezar lamɔ lɛ Nebukadnezar maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ela lamɔi komɛi.
Lamɔi nɛɛ hã etsui bɔ̃i yeli, ni wɔ tserɛ yɛ ehiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã akɛ ayatsɛ ashwãifeelɔi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ ŋkunyaayelɔi ni yɔɔ Babilonbii ateŋ lɛ abaha lɛ koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ elamɔi lɛ ashishi.
Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ shɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mila lamɔ ko, ni mitsui miiye akɛ male lamɔ lɛ shishi.” Amɛto he yɛ Aram wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!
Jajemɔ lamɔ lɛ otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, otsuji, ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ bo shishi.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni mito miyiŋ akɛ mibabi nyɛ ji akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi hu.
Kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ, no lɛ mahã atserɛ nyɛmli, ni aaahã nyɛshĩai lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ tumo.
Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ eshishi hu lɛ, no lɛ mibake nyɛ nibii babaoo; asaŋ mibawo nyɛhiɛ nyam hu jogbaŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛtsɔa mi nɔ lamɔ ni mila lɛ kɛ eshishi hu.” Amɛha hetoo ekoŋŋ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Nii atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lamɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ eshishi.” Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miina anɔkwale mli akɛ be kɛkɛ nyɛtaoɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛna faŋŋ akɛ miwo akpɔ akɛ kɛji nyɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi lamɔ lɛ, toigbalamɔ kome kã shi hã nyɛ.
Nyɛto nyɛyiŋ akɛ nyɛbaamale, ni nyɛbaashishiu mi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nibii aaatsake.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsɔa mi lamɔ lɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ no baahã male akɛ nyɛbaanyɛ eshishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ.” Babilonbii lɛ to he amɛhã Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, “Nii, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ je nɛɛ mli ni ebaanyɛ bo osane nɛɛ naa etsɔ̃ɔ.
Maŋtsɛ ko kwraa ehiko shi pɛŋ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni eje agbo ehã, ni eyɔɔ hewalɛ hu ehã, ni ekɛ nɛkɛ sane efɔ̃ ashwãifeelɔi loo klamɔfoi loo ŋkunyaayelɔi loo Babilonbii ahiɛ dã.
Sane ni Maŋtsɛ biɔ nɛɛ mli wa bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ naa etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ja wɔnyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ni nyɔŋmɔi nɛɛ hu ashihilɛhe bɛ adesai ateŋ.” Hetoo nɛɛ hã Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar mli fu, ni emli wo la naakpa.
Kɛkɛ ni efã akɛ agbe nilelɔi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ he lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, awo akpɔ koni agbe nilelɔi lɛ.
Atao Daniel kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ asɛɛgbɛ koni agbe amɛ hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ Daniel maŋtsɛ lamɔ lɛ shishi Kɛkɛ ni Daniel kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ bi maŋtsɛ blafoiatsɛ ni egbɛi ji Ariok, mɔ ni afã lɛ koni egbe Babilon nilelɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni eba hewɔ ni Maŋtsɛ ewo akpɔ ni naa wa nɛkɛ nɛɛ?” Ariok gba Daniel nɔ sane ni eba lɛ.
Daniel tee, ni eyakpa Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fai akɛ eto lɛ be, ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lamɔ ni ela lɛ shishi.
Daniel tee ewe lɛ, ni eyabɔ enanemɛi Hanania kɛ Mishael kɛ Azaria amaniɛ; ni ebi amɛ akɛ amɛsɔle amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ fai akɛ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe; asaŋ amɛbi lɛ koni egbele teemɔŋ sane lɛ hiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akagbe amɛ hu afata Babilonbii nilelɔi krokomɛi lɛ ahe.
Ajie teemɔŋ sane lɛ shishi atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel yɛ ninaa mli nyɔɔŋ, ni Daniel jie Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ yi.
Daniel wo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ajie Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ dɛŋ ni nilee kɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ, yi kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ.
Lɛ etsakeɔ bei kɛ yinɔi lɛ; ekpaa maŋtsɛmɛi, ni etoɔ maŋtsɛmɛi.
Lɛ eduroɔ jwɛŋmɔ, ni eduroɔ nilelɔi niiashishinumɔ; ejieɔ saji ni mli kwɔlɔ kɛ nibii ni akɛtee kpo etsɔ̃ɔ; ele nii ni yɔɔ duŋ mli, ni he ni eyɔɔ lɛ jɛi la yɔɔ.
Mitsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi, ni miijie oyi, ejaakɛ oduro mi jwɛŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ; ni otsɔ̃ɔ mi nii ni wɔkpa bo ehe fai lɛ, ejaakɛ oha wɔle maŋtsɛ sane lɛ.” Daniel tsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ lamɔ lɛ kɛ eshishi hu No hewɔ lɛ, Daniel yiŋ etee Ariok, mɔ ni maŋtsɛ efã lɛ akɛ ekpãtã Babilon nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaakpãtã nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, shi moŋ okɛ mi aya maŋtsɛ ŋɔɔ, ni matsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ elamɔ lɛ shishi.” Kɛkɛ ni Ariok nyiɛ Daniel hiɛ kɛtee Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hiɛ oya, ni Ariok kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ, miyana nuu ko yɛ Yudabii nomii lɛ ateŋ ni ebaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ elamɔ lɛ shishi.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ bi Daniel ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar hu lɛ akɛ, “Ani ooonyɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mi lamɔ ni mila lɛ kɛ eshishi hu?” Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nii, klamɔfonyo ko klamɔfonyo ko loo ashwãifeelɔ loo ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔ ko bɛ ni ebaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔŋ sane ni Nii taoɔ lɛ.
Shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ko yɛ ŋwɛi ni ejieɔ teemɔŋ nibii kpo etsɔ̃ɔ; ni lɛ ji mɔ ni ejie nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar lɛ.
Lamɔ lɛ ni ola, ni ji ninaa ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ bo be ni okã osaa lɛ nɔ, lɛ nɛ, “Be mli ni Maŋtsɛ kã shi ni ewɔɔ lɛ, ela nibii ni baaba wɔsɛɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni jieɔ teemɔŋ nibii akpo lɛ miihã ole nɔ ni baaba lɛ.
Mi lɛ jeee minii ni mile fe adesai fɛɛ hewɔ ni ajie nɛkɛ teemɔŋ sane nɛɛ shi atsɔ̃ɔ mi; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ɔ Nii, oyitsoŋ saji lɛ kɛ lamɔ ni ola lɛ shishi.
“Nii, olamɔ lɛ mli lɛ ona amãgã kpeteŋkple ko; amãgã nɛɛ da, ni eekpɛ waa, ni ema ohiɛ, ni kɛji ookwɛ lɛ ehe yɛ gbeyei naakpa.
Amãgã nɛɛ yitso lɛ akɛ shika fee, etsitsi kɛ eniji lɛ akɛ jwiɛtɛi fee, emusu kɛ ehɛ lɛ akɛ akɔɔble fee; eshuɔji lɛ akɛ dade fee, ni enaji lɛ fã dade kɛ fã hu su.
Ohiɛ amãgã nɛɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni tɛ ko ni jeee gbɔmɔ adesa nine ta he tse kɛjɛ he ko ni ebatswa amãgã lɛ nane dade fã kɛ su fã lɛ nɔ, ni ejwra naji lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amãgã lɛ he dade lɛ kɛ su lɛ kɛ akɔɔble lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ kɛ shika lɛ hu fɛɛ tswɛm jwara wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni amɛfuflu, ni amɛtsɔ tamɔ abelenaashaji ni bua gbo abeleshaahe.
Kɛkɛ ni kɔɔyɔɔ loo fɛɛ kɛtee, ni eshwɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Shi tɛ lɛ ni batswa amãgã lɛ da, ni etsɔ̃ gɔŋ kpeteŋkple, ni ekpele jeŋ fɛɛ.
“Lamɔ lɛ nɛ.
Agbɛnɛ wɔɔtsɔ̃ɔ Nii lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Maŋtsɛ, bo ji maŋtsɛmɛi amaŋtsɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ, ni to bo nakai, ni eduro bo hewalɛ kɛ agbojee kɛ anunyam fɛɛ.
Ewo bo hei fɛɛ ni gbɔmɛi adesai kɛ kooloi kɛ loofɔji yɔɔ lɛ nɔyelɔ.
Amãgã lɛ shika yitso lɛ bo ni.
Bo osɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛyeli kroko aaate shi ni kɛ bo yeee egbɔ; maŋtsɛyeli ko hu ni ji etɛ̃ baaba abaye nɔ.
Ekadi ji akɔɔble lɛ; ni eeeye je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛyeli ni baafee ejwɛ lɛ he baawa tamɔ dade.
Bɔ ni dade jwaraa, ni egbɛlɛɔ nibii fɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ baajwara, ni ebaagbɛlɛ nibii fɛɛ.
Bɔ ni ona amãgã lɛ naji kɛ waobii lɛ ni fã lɛ gbɛshɔ̃lɔ su ni, ni fã kroko lɛ dade ni lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli baagba; ni dade hewalɛ lɛ eko baahi emli kɛ̃, tamɔ bɔ ni ona dade kɛ su ni akpɔtɔ lɛ afutu lɛ.
Bɔ ni enine waobii lɛ fã ko dade ni fã ko hu su lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ fã ko he baawa, ni fã ko hu he waŋ.
Bɔ ni ona dade ni efutu su ni akpɔtɔ mli lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi lɛ awekui srɔtoi lɛ kɛ amɛhe baabote gbãlãshihilɛ mli moŋ nɛ; shi no tsaŋ amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni dade nyɛɛɛ ekɛ su atsa lɛ.
Maŋtsɛyelii nɛɛ amli maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ayinɔi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ baatee maŋtsɛyeli ko ni sɛɛ efoŋ dɔŋŋ shi ema shi.
Maŋ ko maŋ ko nyɛŋ enɔ kunim eye.
Ebaakpãtã maŋtsɛyelii nɛɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ butuu, ni amɛnɔyelii lɛ asɛɛ aaafo; shi lɛ lɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baama shi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Bɔ ni ona tɛ ko ni jeee gbɔmɔ adesa nine ni kpɔ lɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ ko he, ni ebafuflu amãgã ni akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɛ su kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ ejie nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo, Nii.
Lamɔ ni migba Nii nɛɛ, eji anɔkwale; ni eshishi ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hu yɛ mli nyɔŋma shiishi.” Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar juro Daniel Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni eja Daniel, ni efã akɛ ashã afɔle kɛ tsofakɛŋma ahã Daniel.
Ekɛɛ Daniel akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fe nyɔŋmɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ anuŋtsɔ lɛ; ni lɛ ejieɔ teemɔŋ saji akpo, ejaakɛ onyɛ ojie nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ kpo.” Agbɛnɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar wo Daniel nɔ, ni ehã lɛ gbɛnaa grɔŋŋ, ni ekekee lɛ nibii wuji babaoo hu, ni efee lɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔkwɛlɔ, asaŋ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ he ŋaawolɔi lɛ fɛɛ anukpa yɛ maŋtsɛwe lɛ.
Daniel bi maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego eto Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ; shi Daniel lɛ, lɛ lɛ ehi maŋtsɛwe lɛ.
Nebukadnezar fã akɛ aja shika amãgã Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar hã afee shika amãgã ko ni ekwɔlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ elɛɛmɔ hu ninetalɔi ekpaa.
Afee amãgã nɛɛ ama shi yɛ Dura ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar fã akɛ atsu koni atsɛ maŋ nitsulɔi blublu kɛba: amraloi kɛ lumɛi kɛ amraloi asɛɛmɛi kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi, kɛ maŋtsɛ he ŋaawolɔi kɛ kojolɔi kɛ nitoohei anɔkwɛlɔi, kɛ kpokpai lɛ fɛɛ anɔ nitsulɔi koni amɛbaye amãgã lɛ naagbelemɔ kɛ ekpojiemɔ lɛ he odase.
Amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi asɛɛmɛi lɛ kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ he ŋaawolɔi lɛ kɛ kojolɔi kɛ nitoohei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsulɔi lɛ fɛɛ ba amãgã ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ehã afee lɛ naagbelemɔ kɛ ekpojiemɔ lɛ.
Be ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ eyabua shi yɛ amãgã lɛ hiɛ lɛ, sɔ̃ɔlɔ ko bo waa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Shikpɔji kɛ maji srɔtoi anɔ bii kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛwieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ, nyɛbaanu tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ he, kɛkɛ lɛ koofɛŋ kɛ saŋku kɛ kete kɛ obenta kɛ bɛji kɛ lalai srɔtoi baagbɛɛ kɛnyiɛ sɛɛ.
Lalai lɛ he ni nyɛaanu nɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛkulaa shi nyɛjaa amãgã lɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar efee ema shi lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kulaaa shi koni eja amãgã lɛ, nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ abaashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ pɛ ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ nu koofɛŋ kɛ saŋku kɛ kete kɛ obenta kɛ bɛji kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, amɛho amɛkula shi, ni amɛja shika amãgã ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛma shi lɛ.
Afo Daniel nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ anaa akɛ amɛgbo toi Babilonbii komɛi tsɔ̃ amãgã nɛɛ jamɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛfo Yudafoi lɛ anaa.
Amɛyakɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, “Nii yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ.
Nii, bɛ owo akpɔ akɛ be fɛɛ be ni tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kɛ koofɛŋ kɛ bɛji kɛ saŋkui kɛ obentai kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ aaagbɛɛ pɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akula shi koni eja shika amãgã lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kulaaa shi koni eja lɛ lɛ, abaashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri mli?
Yudafoi lɛ ni oŋɔ amɛ oto Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ yeee okpɔ nɛɛ nɔ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego.” Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛ mlifu kɛ mlila fã akɛ ayaŋɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego kɛba; ni ayaŋɔ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, ani eyɛ mli anɔkwale akɛ nyɛsɔmɔ̃ɔɔ minyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni nyɛjaaa shika amãgã lɛ ni mifee mima shi lɛ lo?
Agbɛnɛ kɛji nyɛfee kralo nyɛto akɛ kɛji nyɛnu koofɛŋ lɛ kɛ blɛ kɛ saŋku kɛ kete kɛ obenta kɛ lalai srɔtoi lɛ agbɛɛmɔ lɛ, nyɛaaho nyɛkula shi, ni nyɛja amãgã ni mifee lɛ, belɛ no lɛ sane etã.
Shi kɛji nyɛjaaa lɛ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ abaashɛrɛ nyɛ ashwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri lɛ mli!
Mɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ aaanyɛ nyɛyiwala ahere yɛ mi midɛŋ?” Kɛkɛ ni Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar akɛ, “Nii, ehĩaaa akɛ wɔhã nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hetoo.
Kɛji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ miisumɔ akɛ ehere wɔ yɛ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni miitso grigri lɛ mli lɛ, ebaahere wɔ; ni ebaahere wɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ hu.
Shi kɛji ehereee wɔ po, Nii, na ole akɛ wɔsɔmɔŋ onyɔŋmɔi lɛ, ni wɔjaŋ shika amãgã ni ofee oma shi lɛ.” Abu Daniel nanemɛi etɛ̃ lɛ gbele fɔ Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar mli wo la fe nine, ni ehiɛ tsake ewo Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego.
Amrɔ nɔŋŋ pɛ ni efã akɛ awo flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli la koni edɔ toi kpawo fe bɔ ni ahãa edɔɔ daa lɛ.
Efã asraafoi hewalɔi komɛi hu akɛ amɛfimɔ Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego koni amɛyashɛrɛ amɛ amɛshwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, afimɔ amɛ kɛ amɛheboi kɛ flakai kɛ faii kɛ atadei krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la grigri lɛ mli.
Akɛni yɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ famɔ naa lɛ ahã flɔnɔɔ lɛ edɔ waa naakpa hewɔ lɛ, flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli lalilɛii lɛ gbe hii lɛ ni hole gbɔmɛi lɛ amɛyawo flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi etɛ̃, ni ji Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, nɛɛ yashwie flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la ni tsoɔ grigri lɛ mli bɔ ni afimɔ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar naa kpɛ ehe, ni ete shi oya, ni ebi ejinafoi lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ wɔfimɔ ni wɔshɛrɛ amɛ wɔshwie la lɛ mli lɛ?” Ajinafoi lɛ here nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, nakai ni.” Nebukadnezar kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miina gbɔmɛi ejwɛ yɛ la lɛ mli.
Afimɔko amɛ, ni la lɛ efeee amɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni mɔ ni gbe yi fee ejwɛ lɛ, su tamɔ bɔfo.” Ajie Hii etɛ̃ lɛ ni aha amɛ gbɛnaa Kɛkɛ ni Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar tsi bɛŋkɛ flɔnɔɔ kɛ emli la grigri lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni ewo enaa nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego, Nyɔŋmɔ ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ tsuji, nyɛjea kpo yɛ la lɛ mli kɛbaa.” Kɛkɛ ni Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego je kpo yɛ la lɛ mli kɛba.
Amraloi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ akutsei anɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ajinafoi lɛ bua amɛhe naa koni amɛbakwɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ.
Amɛyiteŋ tsɔi ŋalako lɛ, amɛtadei lɛ he ko eshãko lɛ, lasu tete po ejeee fu yɛ amɛhe.
Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar kɛɛ akɛ, “Ajie Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, ejaakɛ etsu ebɔfo, ni ebahere etsuji lɛ ni kɛ amɛhiɛ fɔ̃ enɔ lɛ kɛje gbele mli.
Amɛtse mifãmɔ lɛ hiɛ atua, ni amɛkã kitã akɛ nɔ ni amɛaaja he ko bii anyɔŋmɔ fe amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ amɛkɛ amɛwala moŋ baatse.
“No hewɔ lɛ, miiwo akpɔ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ he wiemɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, he fɛɛ he maŋ loo shikpɔŋ nɔ ni mɔ lɛ jɛ, loo wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni mɔ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, atserɛ egbɔmɔtso mli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ, asaŋ afite eshĩa hu koni jɛi atsɔ tumo.
AmɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko kwraa bɛ dɔŋŋ ni baanyɛ ehere gbɔmɔ yiwala tamɔ nɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ hã Shadrak kɛ Meshak kɛ Abednego gbɛnaa yɛ Babilon kpokpai lɛ anɔ.
Nebukadnezar lamɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar ŋma eyahã mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ majimaji kɛ jakui fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, yɛ amɛwiemɔi amli akɛ, “Nyɛhea omanye!
Esa mihiɛ akɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ, ŋwɛi flooflonyo lɛ, efee yɛ mihe lɛ magba nyɛ.
“Kwɛ bɔ ni okadii ni Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ tsiitsii hã.
Kwɛ bɔ ni enifeemɔ nii yɔɔ naakpɛɛ naakpa.
Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ, naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni, ni ejɛɔ yinɔ kɛyaa yinɔ!
“Mi, Nebukadnezar, miyɛ hejɔlɛ yɛ mishĩa lɛ mli, ni miishwere yɛ mimɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli hu.
Shi mila lamɔ ko ni wo mihe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nibii ni mina yɛ lamɔ lɛ mli, be mli ni mikã shi miwɔ lɛ, yɛ gbeyei.
No hewɔ lɛ, mifã akɛ atsɛ nilelɔi ni yɔɔ Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛba mihiɛ, koni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ mi lamɔ lɛ shishi.
Kɛkɛ ni klamɔfoi lɛ kɛ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ bashɛ mihiɛ.
Migba amɛ lamɔ lɛ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ mi lamɔ lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Be ni yi yaawula shi lɛ, Daniel, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar tamɔ bɔ ni atsɛɔ minyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɔɔ emli lɛ ba mihiɛ, ni migba lɛ lamɔ ni mila lɛ.
Mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Belteshazar, klalɔi fɛɛ atsɛ, mile akɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɛ omli, ni teemɔŋ sane ko teemɔŋ sane ko waaa hãaa bo; lamɔ ni mila lɛ nɛ; tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi eshishi.’ “Nɔ ni mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli, yɛ wɔ lɛ mli, ji tso kpeteŋkple ko ni ma je lɛ teŋ.
Tso nɛɛ kwɔ naakpa.
Tso lɛ wo dalɛ nɔ, ni ekwɔ kɛtee kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi bɔ ni anaa lɛ yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he.
Eyi bai yɛ fɛo, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ni mɛi fɛɛ naa eko amɛyeɔ.
Ŋaŋ kooloi yabumɔɔ ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, ni loofɔji hiɔ eniji lɛ anɔ; ni no gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ yeɔ.
“Mina yɛ ninaa lɛ mli ni bɔfo saralɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi.
Ebo waa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtoa tso lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a shi, ni nyɛfolɔa eniji lɛ; nyɛkpaa eyi bai lɛ nyɛshwiea shi, ni nyɛgbɛa eyibii lɛ nyɛshwãa koni ŋaŋ kooloi lɛ ajo foi yɛ shishi aya, ni loofɔji lɛ hu aje eniji lɛ anɔ aya.
Shi ashi etsoku kɛ eshishifãi lɛ yɛ su lɛ mli; akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ afi tsoku lɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ jwɛi fɔ lɛ mli.
Ŋwɛi bɔ anyɔ enɔ; egbɛfaŋnɔ ayaje ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ yɛ jwɛiaŋ koni ekɛ amɛ ahi shi.
Ebaaye afii kpawo, ni abaatsake egbɔmɔ adesa jwɛŋmɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ, ni abaahã lɛ kooloo jwɛŋmɔ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni ŋwɛi saralɔi lɛ ekpɛ mli ehã, ni mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ hu kɛ amɛ kpãa gbee nakai nɔŋŋ, koni adesai fɛɛ kɛna amɛle akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ adesa nɔyeli fɛɛ nɔyeli nɔ, asaŋ akɛ eŋɔɔ hewalɛ ehãa mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ, ni ekɛ gbɔmɛi amliwoo tete po taa maŋtsɛ sɛi nɔ.’ “Lamɔ ni mi, Nebukadnezar mila nɛ; agbɛnɛ, Belteshazar, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi shishi, ejaakɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli nilelɔi fɛɛ nyɛɛɛ eshishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi bo lɛ obaanyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɛ omli.” Daniel tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔ lɛ shishi Daniel ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar hu lɛ he jɔ̃ ehe be kplaŋŋ, ni ehao.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Belteshazar, kaahã lamɔ lɛ loo eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ miihao bo.” Belteshazar here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, mina ni kulɛ lamɔ nɛɛ kɛ eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɔɔ ohenyɛlɔi ahe, shi jeee bo.
Tso lɛ ni ona ni eda mlɛmlɛ, ni ekwɔ kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, anaa lɛ yɛ je lɛ mli hei fɛɛ.
Eyi baa yɛ fɛo, ni ewo yibii babaoo, ni mɛi naa eko amɛyeɔ, ni ŋaŋ kooloi yabumɔɔ ehɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli, ni loofɔji hiɔ eniji lɛ anɔ.
“Nii, bo ji nakai tso lɛ.
Bo lɛ oda, ni ohe wa.
Oda aahu kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi, ni ohewalɛ miiye je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ, ookwɛ ninaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni bɔfo saralɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi.
Ekɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Nyɛtoa tso lɛ koni afite lɛ!
Shi ashi eshishifã kɛ etsoku yɛ su lɛ mli.
Akɛ dade kɛ akɔɔble kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ afi tsoku lɛ, ni ashi lɛ yɛ ŋa nɔ jwɛfɔ mli koni bɔ anyɔ enɔ, ni ehi ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ yɛ jwɛiiaŋ kɛyashi afii kpawo.’ “Nii, ninaa lɛ shishi nɛ; ni no ji yiŋ ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ eto yɛ minuŋtsɔ maŋtsɛ he.
Abaashwie bo kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni obaaya oyahi ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ, ni obaakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina.
Ŋwɛi bɔ baanyɔ onɔ yɛ jwɛiaŋ, afii kpawo, kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni oooyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, yɛ hewalɛ yɛ adesa maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ; asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli hãa.
Akɛ bɔfo saralɔ lɛ fã akɛ ashi tsoku kɛ eshishifã lɛ yɛ su lɛ mli lɛ, no tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ obaaku sɛɛ obaye omaŋtsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ, kɛji ona oyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni yeɔ je lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ, mɔ ŋaa ni mawo bo nɛɛ mli.
Kpa eshafeemɔ koni ofee nɔ ni ja.
Naa ohiafoi amɔbɔ akɛ aleenɔ no aaahã ohe ajɔ bo lo.” Enɛ fɛɛ ná ba Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɔ.
Lamɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ nyɔji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, be ni Nebukadnezar miishara shi yɛ Babilon maŋtsɛwe lɛ yiteŋ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kwɛ Babilon maŋ nɛɛ dalɛ.
Mikɛ mihewalɛ tswa lɛ ma shi akɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ; ni eeye mihewalɛ lɛ kɛ agbojee he odase.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ naa enyɔ̃ɔɔ shi, ni gbee ko gbɛɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, bo nɔ ni mikɛɔ bo nɛɛ toi!
Ashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; asaŋ aaashwie bo kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ kɛya ŋaŋ kooloi ateŋ koni okɛ amɛ ayahi shi.
Obaakpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina afii kpaw, ni ooona oyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, yɛ hewalɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi amaŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ, asaŋ akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli hãa.” Nɔ ni gbee lɛ wie lɛ ba mli yɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar nɔ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ashwie lɛ kɛje gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni ekpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina.
Ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔ egbɔmɔtso nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eyi tsɔi tsa kusuu tamɔ okropɔŋ tsɛji, ni ewaobii anaa tsa oookɛɛ loofɔlɔ waobii anaa.
Nebukadnezar kafo Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar he sane wolo lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Afii kpawo sɛɛ lɛ, mi, Nebukadnezar, miwo mihiɛ nɔ mikwɛ ŋwɛi kɛ heshwamɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni mijwɛŋmɔ ku sɛɛ eba mimli ekoŋŋ, ni mihiɛ tserɛ mi.
Kɛkɛ ni mikafo Nyɔŋmɔ, Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ, ni miwo mɔ ni yɔɔ kɛyaashi naanɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam; ejaakɛ, Lɛ ebaaye nɔ kɛya naanɔ fɛɛ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi jeee fɛifɛi yɛ ehiɛ, ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ adesai fɛɛ yɛ eshishi.
Mɔ ko nyɛŋ enine etswa efɔ̃, loo eeebi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni ofeɔ nɛɛ?’ “Be ni mihiɛ etserɛ mi sɛɛ lɛ, woo ni awoɔ mi kɛ migbojee kɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ he anunyam te shi ekoŋŋ.
Misɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ tao misɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛhere mi atuu akɛ maŋtsɛ ekoŋŋ.
Amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ hewalɛ lɛ wo midɛŋ ekoŋŋ, ni amɛbu mi akɛ lumɔ fe tsutsu lɛ po.
“No hewɔ lɛ, mi, Nebukadnezar, miijie Ŋwɛi Maŋtsɛ lɛ yi, ni miiwo lɛ, ni miiwo ehiɛ nyam.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni efeɔ hi, ni eja hu, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ, enyɛɔ ebaa mɔ lɛ shi.”
Maŋtsɛ Belshazar tsɛ okplɔ̃ Gbi ko lɛ Maŋtsɛ Belshazar tsɛ enukpai lɛ ateŋ mɛi akpe okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple ko, ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ nu dãa kutuu.
Be mli ni anuɔ dãa lɛ, Belshazar fã akɛ ayahole shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kpuji lɛ ni etsɛ Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar yaloo yɛ Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛba, koni lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ, kɛ enukpai lɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ kɛ ehemɛi lɛ kɛnu dãa.
Kɛkɛ ni ayahole shika kpuji lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kpuji lɛ ni ayaloo yɛ Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔ we, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ mli lɛ kɛba.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ kɛ eŋãmɛi lɛ kɛ ehemɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛnu dãa, Be ni amɛnuɔ dãa lɛ, amɛkafo nyɔŋmɔi ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso kɛ tɛ efee lɛ fɛɛ.
Be ni amɛta niyeniiashi lɛ, trukaa lɛ gbɔmɔ nine je kpo, ni ebaŋma nii yɛ asa lɛ gbogbo lɛ he, he ni akɛ kaaloo esha lɛ, yɛ kanetso ni ma shi lɛ ŋlɛnɔ.
Maŋtsɛ Belshazar miikwɛ nine lɛ be ni eŋmãa nii lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ tsake amrɔ, ni etsui fã, ni eshe gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni etalɔiaŋ jɔ biɛɛ, ni enakutsei kpokpo.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ bo waa akɛ ayaŋɔ ashwãifeelɔi lɛ kɛ klalɔi lɛ kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi lɛ abahã lɛ.
Be ni Babilon nilelɔi nɛɛ ba lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni baanyɛ gbogbo nɛɛ he niŋmaa nɛɛ ekane, ni asaŋ etsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi lɛ, abaawula lɛ kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo kɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ kuɛnii.
Ebaatsɔ̃ nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ka niŋmaa lɛ kanemɔ kɛ eshishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ.
Sane lɛ hao Maŋtsɛ Belshazar naakpa, ni ehã ehiɛ tsake.
Ehe onukpai lɛ hu fee yaa.
Wiemɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ wieɔ yɛ asa lɛ nɔ lɛ hã jɛi fee hoo.
Enɛ hã maŋnyɛ lɛ ba okplɔŋmɛɛ asa lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋnyɛ lɛ wo enaa nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!
Kaahao, ni kaahã nɔ ko miigba onaa.
Nuu ko yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ mli ni nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ yɔɔ emli.
Otsɛ yinɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jie hiɛshikãmɔ kɛ nilee kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpo tamɔ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ anilee yɔɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, otsɛ, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar, wo lɛ woloŋlelɔi kɛ klamɔfoi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi kɛ ŋulamiiaŋkwɛlɔi fɛɛ anukpa.
Enilee lɛ naa wa jogbaŋŋ.
Ehiɛ kã shi, ni ele nii bɔ ni enyɛɔ lamɔi kɛ ajenui kɛ teemɔŋ saji fɛɛ ashishi etsɔ̃ɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hã ayaŋɔ nuu nɛɛ ni egbɛi ji Daniel, ni otsɛ wo lɛ Belteshazar lɛ, kɛba.
Ebaanyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo niŋmaa lɛ shishi.” Daniel tsɔ̃ɔ Niŋmaa lɛ shishi Ayaŋɔ Daniel oya abahã maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Daniel lɛ, Yudabii nomii ni mitsɛ yaŋɔ kɛjɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ?
Minu ohe akɛ nyɔŋmɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amumɔ ni yɔɔ omli lɛ naa wa naakpa; anaa akɛ ohiɛ kã shi, ni ole nii, ni oyɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu pam.
Mikpee nilelɔi kɛ ashwãifeelɔi nɛɛ kɛba biɛ koni amɛbakane nɛkɛ niŋmaa nɛɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ niŋmaa lɛ shishi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Minu ohe akɛ onyɛɔ onaa teemɔŋ nibii, ni otsɔ̃ɔ shishi.
Kɛji ooonyɛ niŋmaa nɛɛ okane koni otsɔ̃ɔ mi eshishi lɛ, abaawula bo kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo kɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ kuɛnii, ni obaatsɔ nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nii, nikeenii lɛ ahi shi koni okɛhã mɔ kroko.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mibakane niŋmaa lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ Nii, koni matsɔ̃ɔ Nii eshishi hu.
“Maŋtsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hã otsɛ Nebukadnezar tsɔ̃ maŋtsɛ wulu ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ agbojee kɛ anunyam kpeteŋkple; ni agbojee ni aduro lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ shikpɔji kɛ asafoi kɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi anɔ bii bluublu sheɔ lɛ gbeyei, ni mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ egbe lɛ lɛ, egbeɔ lɛ, ni mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ehi wala mli lɛ, ehãa ehiɔ wala mli.
Mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ewo enɔ lɛ, ewoɔ enɔ; ni mɔ hu ni esumɔɔ akɛ eba lɛ shi lɛ, ebaa lɛ shi.
Shi be ni ewo ehe nɔ, ni ekpliŋ etsui, ni etsɛ ehe lɛ, akpa lɛ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni enunyam lɛ bɔ lɛ.
Ashwie lɛ kɛje adesai ateŋ; ejwɛŋmɔ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kooloo jwɛŋmɔ, ni eyahi ŋaŋ tejii ateŋ, ni ekpe jwɛi tamɔ tsina.
Ŋwɛi bɔ nyɔ egbɔmɔtso nɔ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɔ, ni mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ maŋtsɛ ewoɔ.
“Bo Belshazar, Maŋtsɛ Nebukadnezar bi lɛ, ole sane nɛɛ fɛɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ obaaa ohe shi; shi moŋ owo ohe nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.
Otee oyaloo kpuji kɛ okpolui ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ kɛba, ni bo kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ oŋamɛi lɛ kɛ ohemɛi lɛ kɛbanu dãa.
Enɛ sɛɛ hu lɛ nyɛjie wɔji srɔtoi ni akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ tso kɛ tɛ efee lɛ ayi, nibii ni amɛnãaa nii, ni amɛnuuu nii, ni amɛleee nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ yi.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni lɛ edɛŋ owala kɛ oyaakɛbaa fɛɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ojieee lɛ moŋ eyi.
No hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsu nine nɛɛ, ni ebaŋma nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ.
“Ni nii ni aŋma lɛ nɛ, ‘MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN.’ Niŋmaa lɛ shishi ji akɛ, ‘Akane, akane, aŋmɛ akwɛ, ni aja mli’.
Wiemɔi lɛ ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ diɛŋtsɛ nɛ: ‘Akane,’ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekane omaŋtsɛyeli gbii lɛ; oye omle otã.
‘Aŋmɛ akwɛ’ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aŋmɛ bo yɛ nsɛni mli akwɛ, ni ana akɛ otsiimɔ shɛɛɛ nɔ ko; ni ‘aja mli’ lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aja omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni akɛhã Medianbii lɛ kɛ Persiabii lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ Belshazar fã amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, akɛ awula Daniel kɛ lumɔ atade afaseo, kɛ shika kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ kuɛnii hu; asaŋ ashiɛ akɛ Daniel ji nɔyelɔ ni ji etɛ̃ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ agbe Babilon Maŋtsɛ Belshazar; ni Dario, Medianyo lɛ, ŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Nakai be mli lɛ Dario eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ.
Akɛ Daniel wo Jatai abu mli Esa Maŋtsɛ Dario hiɛ, ni eto amraloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ akɛ amɛkwɛ emaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Eto maŋ onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi wuji etɛ̃ hu koni amraloi lɛ abu amɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ ahe akɔntaa, bɔ ni afee ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ ko hiɛ akakpãtã.
Onukpai etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Daniel.
Daniel mumɔ kɛ emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa wa, ni ana akɛ ehe esa fe onukpai krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ to eyiŋ akɛ ebaaŋɔ Daniel eto emaŋtsɛyeli muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi krokomɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ amɛaana tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ Daniel he lo, koni amɛkɛfolɔ enaa.
Shi akɛni Daniel yeɔ anɔkwa hewɔ lɛ amɛnaaa sane ko loo tɔ̃mɔ ko yɛ ehe.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Wɔnaŋ sane ko sane ko wɔkɛshi nɛkɛ Daniel nɛɛ akɛ ja yɛ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ jamɔ mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ kɛkɛ wɔɔna eko yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, onukpai lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Dario yi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!
Nii, wɔ, omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli onukpai nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ kɛ akutseiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amraloi lɛ kɛ ajinafoi lɛ, wɔtee ajina, ni wɔkpɛ mli akɛ Nii, awo akpɔ ko, ni akwɛ akɛ aye akpɔ nɛɛ nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Akpɔ nɛɛ afee akɛ kɛyaashi gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashi bo, Nii, osɛɛ, ni esɔle ebi nyɔŋmɔ ko loo gbɔmɔ adesa ko dɛŋ nɔ ko lɛ, ashɛ nakai mɔ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ, Maŋtsɛ, ofainɛ ni owo akpɔ nɛɛ, ni aŋmã awo woloŋ, ni osɔo naa koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla ni atsakeee hiɛ lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ Dario hã aŋmã akpɔ lɛ awo woloŋ, ni esɔo naa.
Be ni Daniel na ele akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ enine ewo akpɔ ni aŋmã lɛ shishi lɛ, eyiŋ etee ewe.
Eŋwɛi pia lɛ he samfɛji lɛ kwɛɔ Yerusalɛm gbɛ kɛji agbele.
Ekulaa shi esɔleɔ shii etɛ̃ daa gbi, ni edaa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi.
Gbi ko lɛ Daniel yasɔle nakai nɔŋŋ.
Daniel henyɛlɔi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba, ni amɛbanina Daniel ni eesɔle eekpa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi nɛɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛtee maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, bɛ owo akpɔ ko akɛ kɛyaashi biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baashi bo osɛɛ, ni eeebi nyɔŋmɔ ko loo gbɔmɔ adesa ko nii lɛ ashɛ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli?” Maŋtsɛ lɛ to he akɛ, “Nakai ni.
Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla ni, ni atsakeee hiɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Amɛhere nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, Daniel, Yuda nomii lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, ebuuu bo, Nii, kɛ akpɔ ni owo lɛ fɛɛ; ni no hewɔ lɛ, esɔleɔ shii etɛ̃ daa gbi.” Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ naakpa be ni enu sane nɛɛ, ni esusu he bɔ ni eeefee ehere Daniel yiwala.
Esusu sane lɛ he aahu kɛyashi hulushinyɔɔ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni gbɔmɛi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛbanina maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nii, na ole akɛ yɛ Mediabii kɛ Persiabii amla naa lɛ akpɔ loo kitã ni maŋtsɛ ena ewo lɛ atsakeee.” No hewɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni atee ayaŋɔ Daniel kɛba, ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ jatai abu lɛ mli.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Daniel akɛ, “ONyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni osɔmɔɔ anɔkwale mli lɛ; lɛ eeejie bo.” Ayawo tɛ kɛba, ni akɛbatsi jatai abu lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewolonaasɔomɔ ga lɛ sɔo tɛ lɛ naa; elumɛi lɛ hu sɔosɔoo bu lɛ naa kɛ amɛwolonaasɔomɔ gai lɛ koni akatsake yiŋ ni ato yɛ Daniel he lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛtee emaŋtsɛ we lɛ mli.
Ehi ŋmãa nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni ehãaa akɛ hiɛtserɛjiemɔ nɔ ko abɛŋkɛ lɛ.
Wɔ tserɛ kwrakwra yɛ ehiŋmɛiaŋ.
Be ni hiɛ bɔ̃i gbelemɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛ lɛ te shi mra, ni ehe fee oya kɛtee jatai abu lɛ naa.
Be ni ebɛŋkɛ bu lɛ naa he ni Daniel yɔɔ lɛ, ewo egbee nɔ, ni ekɛ awerɛho gbee bo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Daniel, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ tsulɔ, ani oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni osɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ daa lɛ enyɛ ejie bo yɛ jatai lɛ adɛŋ lo?” Daniel here maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Nii, oyi ana wala kɛya naanɔ!
MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ etsu ebɔfo lɛ kɛba, ni ebaŋamɔ jatai lɛ anaabu, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyeko mi awui ko, ejaakɛ yɛ lɛ ehiɛ lɛ miyeɔ bem, ni bo Nii hu, mitɔ̃ko onɔ.” Maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛ ehe naakpa, ni efã akɛ ajie Daniel yɛ bu lɛ mli.
Ajie Daniel yɛ bu lɛ mli ni apilako ehe ko he ko, ejaakɛ ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ fã, ni ayamɔmɔ mɛi ni yafolɔ Daniel naa hã maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie jatai abu lɛ mli, amɛ kɛ amɛbii kɛ amɛŋamɛi fɛɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ shɛɛɛ bu lɛ shishi tete ni jatai lɛ mɔmɔ amɛ ni amɛjwara amɛwui amli.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario ŋmã wolo ekɛmaje majimaji kɛ asafoi kɛ je lɛ mli wiemɔi srɔtoi ashikpɔji anɔ bii fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhea omanye!
Miiwo kitã akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ minɔyeli nɛɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ, ehe akpokpo, ni eshe Daniel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbeyei.” “Lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ; anyɛŋ emaŋtsɛyeli hiɛ akpãtã, ni ehewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.
Jielɔ kɛ herelɔ ji lɛ; etoɔ okadii, ni efeɔ naakpɛɛ nii yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ehere Daniel yɛ jatai lɛ adɛŋ.” Daniel nɛɛ shwere yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ kɛ Maŋtsɛ Koresh, Persianyo lɛ, hu yinɔ.
DANIEL GBA ENINAI ETSƆ̃Ɔ Kooloi Ejwɛ ahe ninaa Babilon Maŋtsɛ Belshazar klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Daniel la lamɔ ko, ni ena ninaa ko be mli ni ekã shi ewɔ.
Eŋma lamɔ lɛ efɔ̃ shi; ni lamɔ nɛɛ mli saji titrii ji enɛ.
Daniel ŋma akɛ, “Mina yɛ mininaa lɛ mli akɛ nyɔɔŋ kɔɔyɔɔ efã kɛjɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ehã ŋshɔ fee hamahama.
Kɛkɛ ni kooloi wuji ejwɛ ni soro amɛteŋ eko fɛɛ eko famɔ kpo kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ tamɔ jata, shi eyɛ fiji tamɔ okropɔŋ fiji.
Mihiɛ kooloo nɛɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni akplɔ efiji lɛ yɛ ehe, ni awo enɔ, ni akɛ lɛ damɔ enaji enyɔ nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ damɔɔ shi.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ahã lɛ gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ.
Kooloo ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ oshishibrishi.
Awo lɛ adamɔ efã kome nɔ; ŋmawutsei etɛ̃ kɔ̃ enaa yɛ enyanyɔji ateŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa nɔ ni oye loo babaoo bɔ ni obaanyɛ.” Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mihiɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ ni kooloo kroko ko hu fã kpo.
Etamɔ kootsɛ; shi eyɛ fiji ejwɛ, ni etamɔ nɔ ko ni aŋɔ nɔyeli hewalɛ kpeteŋkple ahã lɛ.
Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fã kpo.
Ehe yɛ gbeyei kɛ naakpɛɛ fɛɛ; eyɛ hewalɛ naakpa.
Eyɛ dade nyanyɔji kpakpatakpakpataa, ni ekɛjwara eniyenii lɛ amli dukuduku ni eye; ni fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ ekɛ enaji naanaa nɔ.
Esoro lɛ kwraa yɛ kooloi krokomɛi ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ ba lɛ ateŋ.
Lɛ lɛ eyɛ aklontoi nyɔŋma.
Mihiɛ aklontoi lɛ kwɛmɔ kɛkɛ lɛ naa aklonto hee bibioo ko ekwɛ̃ kɛje kpo yɛ amɛteŋ.
Aklonto bibioo nɛɛ fãmɔ aklontoi memeji lɛ ateŋ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ eshwie.
Aklonto nɛɛ yɛ hiŋmɛii tamɔ gbɔmɔ hiŋmɛii ni eyɛ naabu, ni ekɛmiiwie shwãa wiemɔi agboiagboi.
Mɔ ko ni yɛ kɛjɛ blema he ninaa Mihiɛ ninaa lɛ kwɛmɔ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni akɛ maŋtsɛ sɛii bamamɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni mɔ ko ni onaa akɛ afɔ lɛ etsɛ naakpa baho eta shi.
Etade yɛɔ futaa, ni eyiteŋ waŋ hu yɛɔ futaa.
Emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ miitso kɛ la, ni sɛi lɛ naji ahe kokolonto lɛ hu miitso grigri.
La miiho yɛ ehiɛ tamɔ faa hoɔ.
Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei akpei abɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛi huuhaa abɔ hu damɔ ehiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni kojolɔi lɛ batara shi, ni agbele woji lɛ anaa, ni abɔi kojomɔ.
Mitee nɔ mikwɛ ninaa lɛ, yɛ wiemɔi agboiagboi ni minuɔ aklonto bibioo lɛ wieɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ aahu kɛyashi mina akɛ agbe kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, ni afite egbɔmɔtso lɛ, ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ la lɛ mli koni eshã.
Kooloi krokomɛi lɛ ni shwɛ lɛ, ashɔ̃ hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ; shi akɛ amɛhe ke amɛ kɛyashi be kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa pɔtɛ̃ɛ ko.
Mina yɛ nyɔɔŋ ninaa lɛ mli nɔ ko ni tamɔ gbɔmɔ adesa.
Ekpeleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi ni atatu ebɔle ehe kɛba mɔ ni Etsɛ Naakpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ebadamɔ ehiɛ.
Ahã lɛ nɔyeli kɛ anunyam kɛ maŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ koni majimaji kɛ asafoi srɔtoi kɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi ashikpɔji anɔ bii fɛɛ asɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ naanɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni, ni esɛɛ efoŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ hiɛ akpãtã.
Ninai lɛ ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ Ninai lɛ wo mihe gbeyei, ni mimumɔ hao yɛ mi, Daniel, mimli.
Mitsi mibɛŋkɛ mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni mibi lɛ koni etsɔ̃ɔ mi ninaa lɛ shishi kɛ anɔkwale krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ mli lɛ; ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi nibii lɛ ashishi.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nɛkɛ kooloi gbeyeigbeyei ejwɛ nɛɛ damɔ shi ha maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ komɛi ni baate shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wɔsɛɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ bii hetselɔi lɛ anine baashɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni eeehi amɛdɛŋ kɛya naanɔi anaanɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni mitao akɛ male kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, nɔ ni esoro lɛ kwraa yɛ kooloi krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ he sane.
No he yɔɔ gbeyei naakpa kɛ enyanyɔji ni wa tamɔ dade kɛ ewaobii tamɔ akɔɔble ni ekɛjwara kooloi ni ena ebaaye lɛ amli dukuduku lɛ, ni fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ hu ekɛ enaji naanaa nɔ lɛ.
Mitao hu akɛ male aklontoi nyɔŋma ni mamɔ kooloo lɛ yitso he lɛ ahe sane.
Mitao hu akɛ male aklonto kome lɛ nɔ ni fã kpo, ni be ni eje kpo lɛ efãmɔ aklontoi lɛ ateŋ etɛ̃ kɛ amɛshishifãi fɛɛ eshwie lɛ hu he sane.
Lɛ eyɔɔ hiŋmɛii, ni eyɛ naabu, ni ekɛwieɔ wiemɔi agboiagboi tamɔ nɔ ni efe aklontoi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Mihiɛ kwɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni nɛkɛ aklonto nɛɛ fã ta ewo Nyɔŋmɔ webii krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni eye amɛnɔ kunim, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mɔ ni Etsɛ Naakpa lɛ ba, ni ebabu Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ bem.
Kɛkɛ ni be bashɛ, ni aŋɔ nɔyeli hewalɛ awo mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ.
Mɔ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kooloo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ damɔ shi hã maŋtsɛyeli ni ji ejwɛ ko ni baaba abaye nɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ebaasoro lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛyeli krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahe.
Ebaafite shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebaanaanaa nɔ, ni ebaakpãtã hiɛ.
Aklontoi nyɔŋma lɛ damɔ shi hã maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋma komɛi ni baate shi yɛ maŋtsɛyeli nɛɛ yinɔ.
Amɛsɛɛ lɛ maŋtsɛ kome kroko hu ko baate shi.
Ebasoro lɛ yɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ ahe, ni ebaaba maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ komɛi ãshi.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baawie eshi Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, ni ebaahã etɔ Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Eeeto eyiŋ po akɛ eeetsake Ŋwɛi Flooflonyo lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ajamɔ mlai lɛ kɛ gbii juji ni amɛyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ, ni ebaaye amɛnɔ kɛyashi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ŋwɛi kojolɔi aaatara shi akojo lɛ, ni abaashɔ̃ nɔyeli hewalɛ lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaakpãtã ehiɛ butubutu.
Kɛkɛ lɛ abaatu shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ lɛ kɛ egbojee lɛ fɛɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ adɛŋ.
Amɛmaŋtsɛyeli hewalɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ efoŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lumɛi fɛɛ baasɔ̃mɔ amɛ, ni amɛbaabo amɛ toi.” Sane lɛ naagbee nɛ.
Sane nɛɛ gba, mi Daniel, minaa naakpa, ni ehã migbɔmɔtso tsake; shi mikɛ sane lɛ to minakutsoŋ.
Gwantɛŋ kɛ Abotia he ninaa Maŋtsɛ Belshazar yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ajie ninaa ko ekoŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ mi, Daniel, yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ninaa lɛ sɛɛ.
Mina yɛ ninaa nɛɛ mli akɛ miyɛ maŋtsɛmaŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Susa ni yɔɔ Elam kpokpai anɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli.
Midamɔ Ulai Faa lɛ naa.
Be ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ lɛ, mina gwantɛŋ nuu agbo ko damɔ faa lɛ naa.
Eyɛ aklontoi enyɔ; aklontoi nɛɛ kwɔlɔ naakpa, ni ekome kwɔ fe ekome; shi aklontoi lɛ ateŋ nɔ ni kwɔ lɛ no moŋ ji aklonto ni gwantɛŋ nuu lɛ je sɛɛkpee.
Mina akɛ gwantɛŋ nuu nɛɛ miishi kɛmiiya anaigbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ kɛ wuoyigbɛ.
Kooloo ko kooloo ko kwraa nyɛɛɛ ehiɛ edamɔ; mɔ ko hu nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko ashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, efee nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ, ni efee ehe agbo.
Miisusu ninaa nɛɛ he nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ lɛ naa too kpakpo ko epue kɛjɛ anaigbɛ kɛmiiba.
Efo mli kɛ foi waa kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni enane diɛŋtsɛ esaaa shikpɔŋ.
Aklonto agbo kome ma too kpakpo nɛɛ hiŋmɛii ateŋ.
Etsɛ̃ kɛbanina gwantɛŋ nuu ni yɔɔ aklontoi enyɔ lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ faa lɛ naa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ fɛɛ tua lɛ.
Be ni too kpakpo lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ gwantɛŋ nuu lɛ, emli ewo lɛ la naakpa.
Eshi gwantɛŋ nuu lɛ, ni ekumɔ eklontoi enyɔ lɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ.
Gwantɛŋ lɛ nyɛɛɛ too kpakpo lɛ hiɛ adamɔ.
Too kpakpo lɛ tsi gwantɛŋ nuu lɛ etswa shi, ni enaanaa enɔ.
Mɔ ko kwraa bɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaashɔ̃ gwantɛŋ nuu lɛ yɛ edɛŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni too kpakpo nɛɛ bɔ̃i ehenɔwomɔ, ejaakɛ esusu akɛ eje agbo.
Shi be ni ehe kɛɛ ewaa kwraa lɛ, aku eklonto agbo lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni aklontoi ejwɛ krokomɛi je kpo faŋŋ yɛ aklonto agbo kome lɛ najiaŋ ni amɛmiikwɛ jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ.
Aklonto bibioo kome ko kwɛ̃ kɛjɛ aklontoi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ ekome mli.
Aklonto nɛɛ bada kpeteŋkple, ni ekpã emli kɛtee wuoyigbɛ kɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɛ fɛɛ.
Ebada aahu kɛyashɛ ŋulamiiaŋ, ni etserɛ ŋulamii lɛ ekomɛi etswia shikpɔŋ, ni enaanaa amɛnɔ.
Ewo ehe nɔ aahu kɛyashɛ ŋwɛi asafo lɛ lumɔ lɛ tete nɔ; ni eshɔ̃ daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni efite He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Aŋɔ asafo lɛ ahã lɛ kɛ daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ hu; ni enɛ lɛ eji tɔ̃mɔ; ashɛ anɔkwale afɔ̃; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni aklonto lɛ fee lɛ shwere.
Kɛkɛ ni minu mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ko gbee miiwie, ni minu ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ kroko hu bi mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wie lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ninaa nɛɛ baakã he kɛyashi?
Mɛɛ be mlatɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ baatsĩ daa gbi afɔleshãa krɔŋŋ lɛ naa kɛyashi?
Ni mɛɛ be nɔŋŋ abaanaanaa ŋwɛi asafo lɛ nɔ, ni abaabule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛyashi.” Ejie naa, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ebaaya nɔ kɛyashi gbii akpe kɛ oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ abaatsuu He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he koni etsɔ̃ bɔ ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ.” Bɔfo Gabriel tsɔ̃ɔ ninaa lɛ shishi Be ni mi, Daniel, mina nɛkɛ ninaa nɛɛ, ni miitao eshishi male lɛ, mina mɔ ko tamɔ gbɔmɔ badamɔ mihiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni minu gbɔmɔ gbee bo kɛjɛ Ulai Faa lɛ teŋgbɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Gabriel ei!
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɔnɛ ninaa lɛ shishi.” Gabriel tsi eba he ni midamɔ lɛ; shi gbeyei mɔ mi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Gabriel kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ao!
Gbɔmɔ Adesa bi, na ole akɛ je lɛ naagbee he ninaa nɛ.” Ekɛ mi hiɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛkɛ ni wɔ ni tsii banyɔ minɔ.
Shi Gabriel ta mihe, ni ewo minɔ edamɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni baaba yɛ mlifu lɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli.
Je lɛ naagbee be ni ato lɛ he ninaa nɛ.
“Gwantɛŋ nuu agbo ni ona kɛ eklontoi enyɔ lɛ damɔ shi hã Media kɛ Persia maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ.
Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he okadi ji too kpakpo lɛ; ni aklonto wulu kome lɛ ni ma ehiŋmɛii ateŋ lɛ ji eklɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni aklonto kome nɛɛ kũ, ni aklontoi ejwɛ baye enajiaŋ lɛ, nakai Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli baagbala ejwɛ; shi amɛteŋ eko eko hewalɛ shɛŋ klɛŋklɛŋ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewalɛ lɛ.
“Kɛji maŋtsɛyelii ejwɛ nɛɛ anaagbee be lɛ bɛŋkɛ, ni yiwalɛ saji ni amɛyeyee hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ agbala amɛtoi lɛ, maŋtsɛ hiɛwalɔ ko ni le ŋaa fɔŋ baate shi.
Ebaana hewalɛ kpele; shi ehewalɛ lɛ jɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli.
Ebaakpãtã nibii ahiɛ butuu, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeefee lɛ, ebaaye omanye yɛ mli.
Ebaakpãtã hewalɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ tete ahiɛ.
Eŋaalee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ lakamɔ baafa pii, ni ebaawo ehe nɔ.
Ebaakpãtã mɛi babaoo ahiɛ, be mli ni amɛleee amɛhe be.
Ebaate shi ewo jeŋ fɛɛ Lumɔi alumɔ lɛ; shi abaakpãtã ehiɛ, be mli ni adesa nine etako ehe tete.
Naa, daa leebi kɛ gbɛkɛ afɔle ni ashãa lɛ he ninaa ni agbala mli atsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ, anɔkwale ni.
Shi bo lɛ okɛto onakutsoŋ, ejaakɛ be kplaŋŋ baaho aya dani sane nɛɛ baaba mli.” Sane nɛɛ hã, mi Daniel, mifee vii; ni mihe ye be saŋŋ; kɛkɛ ni mite shi, ni mitee miyatsa nitsumɔ ni maŋtsɛ kɛwo midɛŋ lɛ nɔ.
Mihe jɔ̃ mihe yɛ ninaa nɛɛ hewɔ; ni minuuu shishi.
Daniel sɔle ehã emaŋbii lɛ Ahashwerosh bi Dario, Media fɔmɔbi lɛ, ye Kaldeabii amaŋtsɛ.
Eklɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ mli, be ni, mi Daniel, mihiɛ woji amli kwɛmɔ lɛ, mina akɛ afii abɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Gbalɔ Yeremia akɛ Yerusalɛm baakã shi amaŋfɔ̃ kɛyashi lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai kpawo.
Mihi ŋmãa, ni mibu kpekpe, ni mita lamlu mli kɛmiitao Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛgbɛ yɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ mli.
Mikpa Yehowa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni mijaje tɔ̃mɔi mikɛɛ, “Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple ni he yɔɔ gbeyei ni yeɔ ekpãŋmɔ nɔ, mɔ ni suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo hã mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ, ni amɛyeɔ ekitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ.
“Wɔfee esha, ni wɔtɔ̃; wɔfee yitsoŋwalɛ nibii, ni wɔtse ohiɛ atua, ni wɔyeee okitãi kɛ omlai lɛ anɔ.
Wɔboko otsuji gbalɔi lɛ ni kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔlumɛi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔjaku muu lɛ fɛɛ wie yɛ ogbɛi mli lɛ toi.
Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, bo lɛ onɔ ji jalɛ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔnɔ ji hiɛgbele tamɔ eyɔɔ wɔnɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni ji Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ kɛ Israelbii fɛɛ, mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ mɛi hu ni eyaje shɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔji anɔ ni ogbɛ amɛ oshwã, yɛ anɔkwa ni amɛyayeee bo hewɔ lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ, hiɛgbele nɛɛ sa wɔ, wɔ kɛ wɔmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ wɔlumɛi lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, musuŋtsɔlɔ ji bo, ni okɛ esha faa tsɛbelɛ wɔtse ohiɛ atua, ni wɔbooo bo Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, owiemɔ toi, ni wɔhiii shi bɔ ni otsɔ̃ otsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ owo wɔ mla akɛ wɔhi shi lɛ.
Israel tso muu fɛɛ etɔ̃ omla lɛ, ni amɛyeee omla lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛgba afã.
Enɛ ehã amɛloo musu ni aŋmã yɛ Mose, otsulɔ lɛ, Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔfee esha wɔshi bo.
Ekɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ni eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ lɛ ema wiemɔ ni ewie eshi wɔ lɛ nɔ mi.
Ogbalako maŋ ko toi nɛkɛ pɛŋ dã, yɛ je nɛɛ mli fɛɛ, tamɔ ogbala Yerusalɛm toi nɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ efɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ wɔkpako bo Yehowa fai, ni wɔkpaleko kɛjeko wɔnifɔ̃ɔjianii lɛ ahe, ni wɔboko anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, enɛ hewɔ ni ohã efɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ bo lɛ jalɔ ji bo yɛ nii fɛɛ ni ofeɔ gbɛfaŋ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔbooo bo toi.
“Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ ni okɛ nineshiwalɛ jie wɔ, omaŋ lɛ, kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni okɛna gbɛi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, wɔfee esha, ni wɔwa yi.
Ao!
Nuŋtsɔ, yɛ ojalɛ saneyeli hewɔ lɛ, ofainɛ, foo omli ni efu Yerusalɛm kɛ omli ni ewo lɛ la lɛ sɛɛ.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ kɛ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Eshai ni wɔfee kɛ eshai hu ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, omaŋ Yerusalɛm kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ahiɛ eshwie shi yɛ majimaji ni bɔle wɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo otsulɔ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ nɛɛ pɛ toi.
Nuŋtsɔ, ohiɛ aba nyam ekoŋŋ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Ao!
MiNyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ ni obo mi toi; wo ohiɛ nɔ koni okwɛ wɔmaŋfɔ̃i lɛ kɛ maŋ ni akɛ ogbɛi ewo lɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔbaaa ohiɛ kɛ wɔfaikpamɔ yɛ wɔjalɛ naa; shi moŋ wɔmiikpa bo fai yɛ omusuŋtsɔlɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ.
Ao!
Yehowa, bo wɔ toi koni ofee he eko ohã wɔ.
Ao!
MiNyɔŋmɔ, ofainɛ, kaatsɛ kwraa ni ofee he eko ohã wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ogbɛi kpɛtɛ omaŋ lɛ kɛ omaŋbii lɛ ahe.” Gabriel tsɔ̃ɔ gbalɛ lɛ shishi Be ni misɔleɔ, ni mijajeɔ mihe eshai lɛ kɛ mimaŋbii, Israelbii lɛ, hu ahe eshai lɛ, ni mikpaa Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, fai yɛ gɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ mli miisɔle lolo kɛkɛ lɛ naa bɔfo Gabriel, mɔ ni mina yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ninaa lɛ mli lɛ ni efiliki kɛba mimasɛi trukaa.
No mli lɛ eshɛ be mli ni ashãa gbɛkɛnaashi afɔle lɛ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Daniel, miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo gbalɛ lɛ shishi.
Be ni oje shishi ni obɔi Nyɔŋmɔ faikpamɔ lɛ, afã mi, ni no hewɔ miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo shishi nɛɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ bo naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ he koni onu ninaa lɛ shishi.
“Be ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto ni ekɛbaafo omaŋbii lɛ kɛ omaŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eshai kɛ nifɔɔjianii ni afee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ji afii nyɔŋmai kpawo toi kpawo; abaafo eshafeemɔ sɛɛ; abaakpãtã eshafeelɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ; ni jalɛ saneyeli aaabaye nɔ kɛya naanɔ; abaawo ninaa kɛ gbalɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃; ni abaasaa ajɔɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Na ole, ni onu shishi, akɛ kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni afã akɛ ayatswa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala, ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ aaashɛ shi lɛ, afii kpawo toi kpawo baaho.
Abaasaa atswa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ, ni abaasaa emli gbɛjegbɛi lɛ, ni abaasaa atswa egbogboi lɛ.
Ebaahi shi nɛkɛ kɛyashi afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ enyɔ toi kpawo; shi nɛkɛ be nɛɛ baafee fimɔ bei.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ naagbee mli lɛ, abaagbe hiɛnyiɛlɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efɔ lɛ mu lɛ trukaa, ni enaŋ mɔ ko; ni lumɔ ni baa abaye nɔ lɛ webii lɛ baafite Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ta kɛ nibii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba tamɔ nu afua yɛ be lɛ naagbee nɛɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo shi eto lɛ.
Lumɔ nɛɛ kɛ mɛi babaoo baakpãŋ kɛyashi afii kpawo; shi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã sɛɛ lɛ, lumɔ nɛɛ baagu shãa afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle shãa kwraa.
Abaafee amãgã ni buleɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ama he ni yɔɔ grɔŋŋ fe fɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli; ni amãgã nɛɛ baama jɛi kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto kɛbaagbala mɔ ni kɛ amãgã lɛ bama jɛi lɛ toi aaashɛ.”
Tigris Faa lɛ toi ninaa Persia Maŋtsɛ Koresh yinɔ afi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ajie ninaa kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Belteshazar hu lɛ.
Sane lɛ yɛ mli anɔkwa, ni ekɔɔ haomɔ kpeteŋkple ko he.
Atsɔ̃ɔ Daniel, ni enu sane lɛ shishi.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mi Daniel, mina otsii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ ni miiye ŋkɔmɔ.
Miyeee niyenii ni ŋɔɔ, miyeee loo lɛ, minuuu wain, ni mikpaaa mu hu kɛyashi otsii etɛ̃ lɛ fɛɛ shɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, midamɔ faa wulu ni gbɛi ji Tigris lɛ naa.
Miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina nuu ko ni ewo klala atade, ni Ufaz shika kpãa fi emliteŋ.
Egbɔmɔtso miikpɛlɛ oookɛɛ ojarawatɛ, ni ehiɛ miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram tamɔ srawa; ehiŋmɛii tamɔ kɔtii ni asu.
Eniji kɛ enaji ahe miikpɛlɛ tamɔ akɔɔble ni asha he; ni egbee jije tamɔ asafo yuu gbee.
Mi Daniel, mi koome mina ninaa lɛ.
Hii ni fata mihe yɛ jɛi lɛ enaaa ninaa nɛɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ŋmiŋmi ni naa wa mɔmɔ amɛ, kɛkɛ ni amɛjojoo foi, ni amɛyateetee amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ, ebashwɛ mi, mi koome ni miikwɛ ninaa kpeteŋkple nɛɛ.
Migbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ fɛɛ tã, ni mihiɛ fɛɛ tsake, ni hewalɛ ko bɛ mimli dɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni minu nuu lɛ gbee ni eewie.
Be ni minu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni migbee shi, ni mikɛ mihiɛ bu shi, ni nɔ nyɔ minɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni nine ko bata mihe, ni ewo minɔ.
Mikula shi yɛ minakutsei anaa, ni mikɛ miniji nyɛmɔ shi, ni mikpokpo.
Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Daniel, Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ bo naakpa.
Tee shi ni odamɔ shi, koni obo wiemɔi ni mikɛ bo baawie lɛ toi, ejaakɛ atsu mi oŋɔɔ.” Be ni bɔfo lɛ kɛ mi ewie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mite shi midamɔ shi kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Daniel, kaashe gbeyei!
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ enu sɔlemɔi ni osɔle kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni okpɛ oyiŋ akɛ obaaba ohe shi ohã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Anu osɔlemɔ lɛ, ni no hewɔ miba nɛɛ.
Be ni mibaa lɛ bɔfo ni buɔ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he lɛ batsi mi gbɛ gbii nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfoi onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni gbɛi ji Mikael lɛ ba, ni ebaye ebua mi.
Mishi Mikael kɛ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ bɔfo lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni miba koni mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni baaba omaŋbii lɛ anɔ wɔsɛɛ, ejaakɛ nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ninaa ona lɛ.” Be ni bɔfo lɛ kɛ mi ewie nɛkɛ egbe naa lɛ, mima mihiɛ shi, ni mitɔ mu.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ ni esu tamɔ gbɔmɔ adesa lɛ kɛ enine sa minaabu he.
Kɛkɛ ni mibɔi wiemɔ, ni mikɛɛ bɔfo ni damɔ mihiɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ninaa lɛ eha mihewojiaŋ fɛɛ miiwa mihe, ni mifee gbedee.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mi, minuŋtsɔ tsulɔ, kɛ minuŋtsɔ aaawie hu?
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ ni jio, mumɔŋ nɔ jio, eko fɛɛ eko etã yɛ mimli.” Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ ba, ni ebata mihe, ni mina gbɔmɔtsoŋ hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ao!
Gbɔmɔ ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ bo pam, kaashe gbeyei; otsui anyɔ omli, ni ofee ekãa.” Be ni ekɛ mi wie nɛkɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mina ekãa, ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, wiemɔ, ejaakɛ owo mi hewalɛ.” Bɔfo lɛ to he ni ekɛɛ, “Ole nɔ hewɔ ni miba oŋɔɔ nɛɛ lo?
Miiku misɛɛ koni mikɛ bɔfo ni buɔ Persia maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he lɛ ayawu.
Kɛji miye enɔ kunim sɛɛ lɛ, Hela maŋtsɛyeli bɔfo lɛ hu baaba koni ekɛ mi abawu.
Shi mibagba bo nɔ ni aŋmã yɛ Anɔkwale Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli lɛ.
No ji akɛ mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni waa mi ni mikɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi wuɔ akɛ ja Mikael, nyɛ Israel lumɔ lɛ.”
“Maŋtsɛ Dario, Medianyo lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ mli lɛ, mi hu midamɔ shi, ni mifi Mikael sɛɛ kɛwo lɛ hewalɛ.
Nɔ ni magba bo agbɛnɛ nɛɛ lɛ anɔkwale ni.” Ijipt Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ Siria Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tee nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, maŋtsɛmɛi etɛ̃ krokomɛi baaba abaye Persia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Maŋtsɛ mɔ ni baanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ akɛ maŋtsɛ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ, ebaana nii fe mɛi krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni kɛji etsɔ̃ enii ni ena lɛ nɔ ena hewalɛ lɛ, ebaawo majimaji ayiŋ, ni abaate shi awo Hela maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
“Maŋtsɛ kãkãlɔ ko baate shi nɛkɛ be mli, ni emaŋtsɛyelihe lɛ baada kpeteŋkple, ni ebaaye etsuinaa sane.
Shi be mli ni egbojee lɛ ehe shi jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ baagbee shi.
Emli baagbala srɔtoi ejwɛ kɛya jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ.
Mligbalamɔi nɛɛ anɔyeli baaya ayaje mɛi ni amɛjeee maŋtsɛ nɛɛ shwiei adɛŋ; shi moŋ nɔyelɔi hei nɛɛ ahewalɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ hewalɛ yeŋ hegbɔ; ni abaashɔ̃ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ mɛi nɛɛ adɛŋ ahã mɛi krokomɛi.
“Wuoyigbɛ, ni ji Ijipt, maŋtsɛ lɛ he baawa, shi eshishi lumɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ko baana hewalɛ fe lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, ni naagbee mli lɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kpeteŋkple nɔyelɔ.
Shi afii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ maŋtsɛ, ni ji Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ, baakpãŋ amɛfee ekome, ni Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ebiyoo baahã Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ gbãlã yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ namɔ hewɔ.
Shi ekomefeemɔ nɛɛ sɛɛ etsɛŋ, ni abaamɔ maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ kɛ etsuji kɛ ebi lɛ kɛ ewu lɛ fɛɛ ni abaagbe amɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, maŋtsɛ biyoo lɛ wekunyo ko baate shi, ni ebaaye maŋtsɛ.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ baafã ta kɛbatua Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ etabilɔi lɛ kɛyabote maŋtsɛ lɛ mɔɔ wulu lɛ mli, ni ebaaye amɛnɔ kunim.
Ebaaloo Siriabii anyɔŋmɔi lɛ kɛ dade amãgãi lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika nibii ni jara wa lɛ fɛɛ kɛya Ijipt.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baahi shi afii komɛi ni efãaa ta ewooo Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Shi Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ moŋ ni baafã ta be ko kɛbatua Ijipt; shi abaashwie lɛ, ni ebaaku esɛɛ kɛaatee eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
“Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ bihii baabua tabilɔi babaoo anaa amɛkɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã ta.
Ta ku lɛ eko baafã, ni ebaakpãtã nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ egbɛ nɔ hiɛ, tamɔ faa ni eyi kɛteke nɔ.
Abaawu ta lɛ aahu kɛyanina Ijipt maŋtsɛ mɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ mlila baafã kɛbanina Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ baawu, ni ebaaye enɔ.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ ta kpele baaya ta lɛ, shi abaaye enɔ kunim.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ nine baatsɔ̃ Siria tabilɔi akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ lɛ anɔ.
No baahã maŋtsɛ lɛ awo ehe nɔ akɛ ekpãtã tabilɔi babaoo ahiɛ; shi ekunimyeli nɛɛ sɛɛ etsɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baaya esɛɛ eyabua tabilɔi babaoo fe tsutsubii lɛ anaa, ni afii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ ebaaku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ kɛ ta kpele kɛ tawuu nibii.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ mɛi babaoo baate shi ashi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii lɛ ateŋ kakawuai komɛi hu aaate shi awo Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ koni ninaa nɛɛ aba mli; shi amɛyeŋ kunim.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baafã ta kɛba, ni ebaaba ebasa maŋ ni atswa gbogbo awo ehe yi.
Ebaaye maŋ nɛɛ nɔ kunim, ni ebaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ.
Ijipt tabilɔi lɛ nyɛŋ ehiɛ adamɔ.
Etabilɔi kakabãŋi lɛ tete naŋ hewalɛ amɛkɛdamɔ shi amɛkɛ lɛ awu.
Siria maŋtsɛ ni batua shikpɔŋ lɛ baafee Ijipt tabilɔi lɛ bɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ shi ate awo lɛ.
Ebaaba ebahi shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ tso muu lɛ fɛɛ baahi lɛ ehewalɛ shishi.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baato eyiŋ akɛ ekɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli tabilɔi bluublu baaba abatua Ijipt.
Shi ebaatsɔ̃ ŋaa, ni ekɛ Ijipt baakpãŋ, ni ebaaŋɔ ebiyoo ehã Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ gbãlã koni ekɛgbɔjɔ Ijipt maŋtsɛyeli lɛ; shi moŋ eyiŋtoo nɛɛ yeŋ omanye.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baatsɔ̃ ehiɛ ewo ŋshɔnaa shikpɔji lɛ.
Ebaaye shikpɔji nɛɛ babaoo anɔ kunim.
Shi tatsɛ ko hu baate shi awo lɛ, ni ebaaye enɔ kunim, ni ebaafo Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ henɔwomɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Enɛ baahã Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ henɔwomɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛgbele ahã lɛ.
Siria maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baaku esɛɛ eyatua mɔji ni yɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi abaaye enɔ kunim yɛ jɛi, ni biɛ enaagbee baaba yɛ.
“Maŋtsɛ ko baaba yɛ esɛɛ.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ baawo etsulɔ gbɛ akɛ eyanyɛ maŋbii lɛ anɔ koni etsu amɛ onia pii ewo maŋtsɛ fotro lɛ mli.
Shi be kukuoo ko sɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni abaagbe lɛ, jeee yɛ mlifu naa loo ta mli.” Siria Maŋtsɛ fɔŋ lɛ Bɔfo lɛ tee ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni baanyiɛ sɛɛ ebaye Siria maŋtsɛ agbɛnɛ lɛ ji gbɔmɔ gbonyo ko ni bɛ hegbɛ akɛ eyeɔ maŋtsɛ; shi be ni aaahɛle shi lɛ etsɔ̃ juukɛfɔ̃ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ nɔ enine eshɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
Tabilɔi fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo lɛ lɛ, ebaabɛɛ amɛ eshwie.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaafee kpãŋmɔ lɛ lumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Ekɛ majimaji baakpãŋ, shi eyeŋ anɔkwa.
Ebaana hewalɛ kpele, tsɛbelɛ emaŋbii ayi faaa.
Ebaafã ta trukaa kɛya shikpɔŋ ko ni hi jogbaŋŋ nɔ, ni ebaaya eyafee nii ni etsɛmɛi kɛ eniimɛi tete efeko eko dã yɛ jɛi.
Nii ni ebaaha yɛ jɛi lɛ, ebaajara ehã tabilɔi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ ebaato eyiŋ akɛ ebaafãfãa tai kɛyatua maji tamɔ mɔji; shi eyeŋ omanye.
“Hewalɛ kɛ ekãa ni yɔɔ emli lɛ baakãnya lɛ koni ebua ta kpele naa koni ekɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ ayawu.
Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ hu kɛ ta kpele baaba ekɛ lɛ abawu; shi Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ yeŋ kunim, ejaakɛ abaato eshigbeemɔ he ŋai srɔtoi ashi lɛ.
Mɛi po ni naa edɛŋ niyenii jurɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ tete baagbee lɛ shi eko.
Etabilɔi lɛ babaoo baanyɔnyɔɔ, ni abaabɛɛ eta lɛ ashwie.
Maŋtsɛmɛi enyɔ nɛɛ baatara shi yɛ okplɔ̃ kome he amɛye nii, shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ yiŋsha yɛ enyɛmi he; ni amɛaalaka amɛhe yɛ niyenii lɛ shishi tete.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiŋtoo lɛ baŋ mli haŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni ato lɛ shɛko.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ nii babaoo ni ena, yɛ taitai ni ewu lɛ amli, lɛ baaku esɛɛ ekɛya eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi etsui baasu jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ebaafee nɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ, kɛkɛ lɛ eku esɛɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ.
“Kɛji be ni ato lɛ shɛ lɛ, ebaaba ebatua Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ; shi nibii ejaŋ haŋ lɛ tamɔ tsuutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ Romabii kɛ lɛji baaba abatua lɛ, ni ebaashe gbeyei.
Ebaagbala ehe shi, ni ebaaku esɛɛ kɛ mlila, ni ebaaya ni eyaka akɛ eeefite jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ebaabo mɛi ni ekwa jamɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ moŋ aŋaawoo toi.
Ebaawo etabilɔi lɛ ekomɛi agbɛ koni amɛyabule Sɔlemɔ we Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɔɔ lɛ hu.
Amɛbaagu daa gbi afɔlei ni ashãa lɛ, ni amɛkɛ amãgã ni buleɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baama jɛi.
Ekɛ naadɔkɔmɔ baalaka mɛi ni ekwa jamɔ lɛ; shi mɛi ni miiye amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anɔkwa lolo lɛ baadamɔ shi kpɛŋŋ amɛshi lɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ ekomɛi baatsɔ̃ɔ maŋbii lɛ nii, tsɛbelɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, abaashãshãa mɛi komɛi, abaaha amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anii, ni abaaŋɔ mɛi komɛi nom kɛyashi be ko.
Be mli nɔŋŋ ni agbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ, abaaye abua amɛ fioo ko kɛ̃, ni mɛi pii baaba abafata amɛhe, shi jeee kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ.
Abaagbe maŋbii lɛ ateŋ nilelɔi lɛ ekomɛi; shi akɛ amɛgbele lɛ baatsuu Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ahe koni amɛyɛ futafuta.
Nii nɛɛ baaya nɔ kɛyashi naagbee be lɛ baashɛ, ni ji be ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto lɛ.
“Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baafee nɔ ni lɛ etsui taoɔ, ni ebaawo ehe nɔ.
Ebaatsɛ ehe agbo fe nyɔŋmɔ fɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeewie hepupuumɔ wiemɔ tete eshi nyɔŋmɔi aNyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ.
Ebaaya nɔ nɛkɛ aahu kɛyaashi Nyɔŋmɔ emiŋ ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ, ni agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala etoi.
Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto akɛ ebaafee lɛ lɛ, ebaana efee lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ ebuŋ nyɔŋmɔ ni etsɛmɛi lɛ ja lɛ tete loo nyɔŋmɔ ni yei sumɔɔ lɛ hu.
Ebuŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko, ejaakɛ ebaawo ehe nɔ yɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ ebaabu nyɔŋmɔ ni buɔ maji ahe.
Ebaahiɛ edɛŋ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ tɛi ni jara wa kɛ nikeenii ni jara wa ekɛyahã nyɔŋmɔ ko ni etsɛmɛi lɛ tete leee koni ekɛwo nakai nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Nakai ebaafee yɛ mɔji ni wala lɛ amli ehã maŋsɛɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko ni eeekpɛlɛ̃ ehewalɛ nɔ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni buɔ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔyelɔ lɛ, ebaawo amɛhiɛ nyam, ni eeehã amɛye mɛi pii anɔ; ebaajara shikpɔji lɛ amli ehã amɛ akɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo.
“Kɛji Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ naagbee be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ baaya eyatua lɛ.
Siria maŋtsɛ lɛ baafã tamɔ ahum ekɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ lɛ abakpe kɛ tayaa shwiilii kɛ okpɔŋɔtalɔi kɛ lɛji babaoo.
Ebaatua shikpɔji babaoo, ni ebaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ kɛho tamɔ faa ni eje ŋa.
Ebaatua Shiwoo Shikpɔŋ lɛ tete, ni mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ baanyɔnyɔɔ; shi hei ni baaje edɛŋ nɛ: Edom kɛ Moab kɛ Amonbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ kpotoo.
Kɛji efã ta nɛɛ ewo nakai shikpɔji lɛ, Ijipt diɛŋtsɛ po yeŋ ehe.
Ebaaloo Ijipt shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ejwetri fɛɛ kɛya.
Ebaaye Libia kɛ Etiopia hu fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi saji ni baajɛ bokãgbɛ kɛ kooyigbɛ aba lɛ baawo ehe gbeyei; ni ekɛ mlila kpele baaya eyakpãtã gbɔmɛi babaoo ahiɛ butuu.
Ebaamamɔ abladei abui ni eyɔɔ lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ kɛ Gɔŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ teŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ jɛi enaagbee baaba yɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko yeŋ ebuaŋ lɛ.”
Naagbee be lɛ Bɔfo lɛ tsa ewiemɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Mikael, lumɔ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ omaŋbii lɛ ahe lɛ, aaate shi adamɔ shi; kɛkɛ lɛ fimɔ be ko aaaba ni anako ehenɔ dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni aje maŋtoo shishi kɛbashi nakai be lɛ mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, aaahere omaŋ lɛ mli mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaana akɛ aŋma egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ yiwala.
Ni mɛi ni egboi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ahiɛ aaatsɛ̃; mɛi komɛi aaatee naanɔ wala mli; shi mɛi komɛi hu aaatee naanɔ hiɛgbele mli.
Ni mɛi ni le nii lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ atatu kpɛmɔ, ni mɛi ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi pii agbɛ kɛtee jalɛ mli lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ ŋulamii kɛaatee naanɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Bo, Daniel, tsiimɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔ, ni osɔo wolo nɛɛ naa kɛyashi naagbee be lɛ.
Ni mɛi pii aaagba amɛhe naa kɛya kɛba kɛtao nɔ ni eba lɛ shishi; ni nilee aaafa.” Kɛkɛ ni mi, Daniel, mikwɛ ni naa, mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ damɔ shi, mɔ kome yɛ faa lɛ naa biɛ nɛɛ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ faa lɛ sɛɛ.
Ni mɔ kome kɛɛ nuu lɛ ni wo klala ni yɛɔ, mɔ ni yɔɔ faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ aaagbe nɛkɛ naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ anaa?” Ni nuu ni wo klala ni yɔɔ faa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wo eninejurɔ kɛ ebɛku nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekã mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ kitã.
Minu ni ekɛɛ, “Ebaakã he kɛyashi afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, beyinɔ ni aaakumɔ hewalɛ ni waa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ayi lɛ agbe naa; kɛkɛ lɛ aaagbe enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ naa.” Minu nɔ ni bɔfo lɛ wie lɛ, shi minuuu shishi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibi akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, ofainɛ, te enɛɛmɛi anaagbee lɛ aaatamɔ tɛŋŋ?” Eto he ekɛɛ akɛ, “Daniel, kwɛmɔ ohiɛgbɛ ni oya!
Wiemɔi lɛ atsimɔ nɔ, ni asɔo amɛnaa kɛyaashi naagbee be lɛ aaaba.
Mɛi pii baatsuu amɛhe koni amɛyɛ futafuta ni amɛhe atse.
Shi yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuŋ shishi, ni amɛaaya nɔ amɛye yitsoŋwalɛ sane; shi nilelɔi lɛ, amɛ lɛ, amɛbaanu nɔ ni yaa nɔ lɛ shishi.
“Kɛji agu daa gbi afɔle ni ashãa lɛ, be ni akɛ amãgã ni buleɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baama shi lɛ, gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu baaho.
Aaajɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baato amɛtsui shi koni amɛye anɔkwa kɛyashi gbii akpe kɛ ohai etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ enumɔ lɛ.
“Ni bo Daniel, ye anɔkwa kɛyashi naagbee; ni no sɛɛ lɛ obaagbo; shi ooote shi, ni ooona aekoo ni sa bo yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Hosea gba yɛ Israelbii akooyi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Lɛ ji gbalɔ ni baye Amos sɛɛ.
Egba be mli ni maŋ sane hãaa Samaria ajɔ dani maŋsɛɛbii baye Samaria nɔ kunim, yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli.
Sane ni ye Hosea tsui jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔŋjamɔ ni etsɔ̃ maŋbii asubaŋ lɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛ anɔkwayeli jaaa lɛ lɛ.
Hosea fee ekãa, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbalãshihilɛ mli anɔkwa ni eŋa Gomer yeee lɛ lɛ fee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ emaŋbii lɛ anii akɛ nakai amɛyeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa yɛ ejamɔ mli.
Bɔ ni Gomer jeɔ lɛ Hosea sɛɛ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ amɛ hu ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ amɛjeɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ Israel baana amanehulu ni akɛbaagbla etoi.
Shi suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛsumɔɔ emɛi lɛ baahã Nyɔŋmɔ musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ kɛ̃ yɛ Israel he, ni ebaaba ebahere Israel, ni ekɛ amɛ baaba emasɛi ekoŋŋ koni ekɛ amɛ atsa tamɔ sa ko lɛ.
Gbalɛ nɛɛ jieɔ suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, “Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu?
Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu?
Mitsui eŋmɛŋ mi gbɛ ni mafee nakai …Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe” .
Mlijaramɔi Hosea gblãshihilɛ .—.
Saji ni akɛshi Israel .—.
Israel tsuitsakemɔ kɛ shiwoo .-
Yehowa wiemɔ ni ekɛ Hosea, ni ji Beeri bi lɛ, wie yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi Uzia kɛ Yotam kɛ Ahaz kɛ Hezekia ayinɔ lɛ nɛ.
No mli lɛ Yeroboam, Yoash bi lɛ, miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Israel.
Hosea ŋa kɛ ebii Be ni Yehowa kɛ Hosea bɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Yaa ni oyaŋɔ yoo ajwamãŋ koni okɛ lɛ afee oŋa; ni bii ni okɛ lɛ baafɔ lɛ baafee ajwamãŋ bii tamɔ bɔ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ekwa mi, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Hosea tee ni eyaŋɔ Diblaim biyoo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gomer lɛ.
Gomer na musu ni efɔ binuu.
Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, ‘Yezreel’, ejaakɛ eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni lá shi ni Yehu shwie yɛ Yezreel maŋ lɛ mli lɛ mibatɔ he owele yɛ eshwiei anɔ, ni mibagu Yehu we lɛ maŋtsɛyeli yɛ Israel.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibafite Israel tawuu hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yezreel jɔɔ lɛ mli.” Gomer na musu ekoŋŋ, ni efɔ biyoo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ruhama: ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ etã’, ejaakɛ mikaŋ he mihaŋ mimusuŋ atsɔ̃ mi yɛ Israelbii ahe, ni mikɛfaŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ Yuda he, ni mi Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mibahere amɛyiwala; shi moŋ mitsɔ̃ŋ gãi loo klante loo ta loo okpɔŋɔi loo tayaa okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi anɔ mihereŋ amɛyiwala.” Be ni Gomer etse ebi Lo-Ruhama fufɔ lɛ, esaa ena musu, ni efɔ binuu ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Hosea akɛ, “Wo abifao lɛ gbɛi akɛ, Lo-Ammi ‘Nyɛjeee mimaŋ,’ ejaakɛ Israelbii jeee mimaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni mi hu jeee amɛNyɔŋmɔ ji mi.” Abaatee Israel shi ekoŋŋ Shi kɛ̃lɛ Israelbii ayikulɛ aaatamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia ni anyɛŋ asusu aloo akane.
Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjeee mimaŋ lɛ,’ jɛi nɔŋŋ abaakɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii ji nyɛ.” No mli Yudabii kɛ Israelbii anaa aaabakpe shi kɛfee ekome, ni amɛaato mɔ koome akɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔ, ni amɛaashwere yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ Yezreel gbi lɛ gbi wulu ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛa nyɛnyɛmimɛi hii, Israelbii, lɛ akɛ Ammi, “Mimaŋ ji amɛ” kɛ nyɛmimɛi yei lɛ hu akɛ Ruhama, “Mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe.” Gomer yeee anɔkwa lɛ, Israel hu yeee anɔkwa “Mibii, nyɛkɛ nyɛnyɛ awiea, ejaakɛ jeee miŋa ji lɛ dɔŋŋ; ni mi hu jeee ewu ji mi.
Nyɛkɛ lɛ awiea koni ekpa ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ, ni efo egblãfitemɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ maŋmɛ lɛ yayai tamɔ gbi ni afɔ lɛ lɛ; mahã etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋa nɔ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ egbi, ni mikɛ kumai baagbe lɛ.
Asaŋ minaŋ emusuŋbii lɛ hu amɔbɔ, ejaakɛ yoo ajwamãŋ bii ji amɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛnyɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ; efee hiɛgbejianii kɛna amɛ musu.
Ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Hã maya mayatiu mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; amɛ amɛhãa mi niyenii kɛ nu kɛ mikuntu kɛ klala lɛ kɛ mimu kɛ dãa.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mikɛ ŋmei baafo ehe afabaŋ, ni matswa gbogbo kɛsa eyi koni matsi lɛ gbɛ.
Eeetiu eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, shi eninaŋ amɛ; ni eeetao amɛ, shi enaŋ amɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Hã makpale kɛya miklɛŋklɛŋ wu lɛ ŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ be ni mikɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ehi hã mi moŋ fe amrɔ nɛɛ.’ Te eŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi ji mɔ ni hã lɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ fɛɛ ni amɛkɛjaa jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mashɔ̃ mibele lɛ kɛ wain lɛ hu kɛ kuŋtu kɛ klala ni enaa ebuɔ lɛ.
Maŋmɛ lɛ yayai agbɛnɛ matsɔ̃ɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ lɛ ahere yɛ midɛŋ.
Mafo mliflimɔ gbii juji ni eyeɔ lɛ fɛɛ asɛɛ, nyɔji hei kɛ afi gbii juji lɛ, kɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ.
Ni maŋala ewaintsei lɛ kɛ agbãmi tsei lɛ ni ekɛɔ akɛ nomɛi ji nɔ ni enaa yɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ adɛŋ akɛ enyɔmɔwo lɛ.
Mahã fɛɛ atsɔ̃ koo koni ŋaŋ kooloi aye amɛnɔ nii.
Magbala etoi yɛ tsofakɛŋma ni etee eyashã ehã Baal jemawɔji yɛ amɛgbii juji lɛ anɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ewula kɛ jwinei kɛtee eyanyiɛ eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ asɛɛ, ni ehiɛ kpa minɔ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ hã ewebii “No hewɔ lɛ, mibagbe eyitso ni mi kɛ lɛ aaatee ŋa lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ; mi kɛ lɛ aaayawie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ yɛ jɛi koni eyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba shĩa.
Makpale ewain tromi lɛ mahã lɛ, ni mahã Amanehulu Jɔɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ Agbo ahã lɛ.
Eeehere mi nɔ tamɔ efee yɛ eblayeiaŋ lɛ be ni ejɛ Ijipt eba lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ ebaatsɛ mi ‘Miwu’ ekoŋŋ, shi jeee ‘MiBaal’ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ mibakɔ jemawɔji Baali lɛ agbɛii yɛ edaaŋ; ni etsiŋ amɛtã tete po dɔŋŋ.
“Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mikɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni wamɔɔ fɛɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ koni amɛkaye nyɛ awui; ni makumɔ gãi kɛ klante amli, ni mahã tawuu sɛɛ afo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛbaahi shi shweshweeshwe.
“Israel, mibatsɛ ohe baa akɛ miŋa kɛaatee naanɔ; Maye bo anɔkwa, ni maye bo jalɛ sane, Masumɔ bo, ni mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
Maye mishiwoo nɔ, ni mafee bo miŋa, ni ooole akɛ mi ji Yehowa.
Nakai be lɛ mahã mimɛi, Israelbii, asɔlemɔ lɛ hetoo.
Mahã nu anɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ aba abele kɛ wain kɛ mu ahã Israel.
Mahã mimɛi lɛ ahe shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mahã amɛshwere.
Mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ etã’ lɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni atsɛ amɛ akɛ ‘Nyɛjeee mimɛi’ lɛ, mibana amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Ni makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mimɛi ji nyɛ,’ ni amɛaahere nɔ akɛ ‘bo ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ”
Hosea kɛ Yoo ni yeee anɔkwa lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Yaa ekoŋŋ ni oyasumɔ yoo ni ewu sumɔɔ lɛ, shi lɛ lɛ ekɛ nuu kroko miifite gbãlã.
Osumɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, misumɔɔ mimɛi Israelbii lɛ; tsɛbelɛ amɛ lɛ, amɛkwa mi, ni amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ wain yibii yashãa afɔle amɛhãa amãgãi.” No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ kɛ akoko kiloi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ yahã yoo lɛ; ni mikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ hii shi kɛjɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ ohã mi; okabɔ ajwamãŋ, ni okayagbã nuu ko; ni mi hu mahi shi mahã bo.” Ejaakɛ nakai pɛ Israel baahi shi gbii pii ni amɛbɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ lumɛi hu; asaŋ amɛshãaa afɔle; ni amɛbɛ shiu lɛ amɛbɛ efod kɛ terafim hu ni akɛbiɔ nii.
Kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ Israelbii baaku amɛsɛɛ, amɛaakpale, ni amɛaabatao Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, amɛaabatao amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji David shwie ko hu sɛɛgbɛ.
Nakai be lɛ amɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ aaaba Yehowa ŋɔɔ, ni eeejɔɔ amɛ kɛ nibii kpakpai yɛ naagbee bei lɛ amli.
Yehowa kɛ sane shi Israel Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ena.
“Anɔkwayeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ etã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni aleee Nyɔŋmɔ hu yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nɔ ni eshwɛ amɛ pɛ ji kitãkãmɔ kɛ amale kɛ mɔgbee kɛ juu kɛ gbãlãfitemɔ; amɛkuɔ mla fɛɛ mla mli, ni amɛshwieɔ lá shi ni eko nyiɛ eko sɛɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baagbi, ni enɔ nibii fɛɛ baagboi.
Ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ loofɔji kɛ nuŋ loi tete baagboi.” Yehowa kɛ sane shi Osɔfoi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko akashwa mɔ ko, ni mɔ ko akakã mɔ ko hiɛ hu, ejaakɛ nyɛ, Osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛ moŋ ji mɛi ni mikɛyɔɔ sane.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛaatɔ̃ shwane, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛ baatɔ̃ nyɔɔŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Israel, nyɛnyɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Mimaŋ lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛleee nii.
Akɛni okwa nilee hewɔ lɛ, mi hu miikwa bo akɛ misɔfo; ni akɛni ohiɛ ekpa oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mla lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mihiɛ miikpa obii lɛ anɔ.
“Bɔ ni amɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, ayi faa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛfeɔ esha babaoo amɛshiɔ mi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibahã amɛhiɛ nyam lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛgbele.
Amɛtsɔ̃ esha ni mimɛi lɛ feɔ lɛ nɔ amɛna nii, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛshweɔ akɛ mɛi aya nɔ afee esha.
Magbala osɔfoi lɛ atoi tamɔ maŋbii lɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ amɛjeŋba hewɔ; mawo amɛnishaianii ni amɛfee lɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Amɛbaaye nii nɛ, shi amɛtɔrɔŋ, ni amɛaabɔ ajwamãŋ nɛ, shi amɛshwereŋ kɛ bii, ejaakɛ amɛkwa mi, Yehowa, ni amɛtee wɔji moŋ aŋɔɔ.” Yehowa wie eshi wɔŋjamɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Wain momo kɛ wain hee fɛɛ hãa nilee ŋmɛɔ mɔ.
Mimɛi biɔ tso akɛ egba, ni amɛdɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ gbaa amɛ teemɔŋ saji, ejaakɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mumɔ ehã amɛkwa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni amɛdu gbɛ, amɛtee wɔji aŋɔɔ.
Amɛshã afɔlei yɛ gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ, ni amɛshã tsofakɛŋma yɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ; amɛshã yɛ odum kɛ onyai kɛ papao tsei ashishi, ejaakɛ tsei lɛ ahɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli hi.
“Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ fiteɔ gbãlã lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛbiyei lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ migbalaŋ amɛtoi, ni kɛji nyɛbihii aŋamɛi lɛ hu fite gbãlã lɛ migbalaŋ amɛtoi, ejaakɛ nyɛ, hii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete lɛ nyɛ kɛ ajwamãŋi ni yɔɔ jamɔhe lɛ yabɔɔ ajwamãŋ, ni nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ shãa wɔŋjamɔ afɔlei lɛ.
Naa, maŋ ni bɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ kpãtãa.
“Kɛji nyɛ, Israelbii, yeee mi anɔkwa yɛ mi jamɔ mli lɛ, nakai su lɛ akabala Yuda hu.
Nyɛkayaa Gilgal, ni nyɛkayaa Bet-Aven hu nyɛyajaa; ni nyɛkɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ akakãa kitã akɛ ‘Gbii abɔ ni Yehowa ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ nɛɛ!’ Israelbii akuɛŋ ti tamɔ tsina oblayoo.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Yehowa aaalɛ amɛ tamɔ alɛɔ toobii yɛ ŋa shwaŋŋ nɔ hu?
Israel ekɔ wɔŋjamɔ efɔ enɔ; nyɛŋmɛa ejeŋ he nyɛhãa lɛ.
Kɛji amɛnunuu dãi ni amɛtɔrɔ sɛɛ lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ lɛ etsa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛsumɔɔ hiɛgbele moŋ fe hiɛnyam.
Kɔɔyɔɔ fɔŋ ko baatswa amɛ waa, ni ebaahã amɛhiɛ agboi yɛ wɔŋjamɔ afɔleshãa hewɔ.”
“Nyɛ Osɔfoi, nyɛboa sane nɛɛ toi!
Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkaa toi!
Nyɛ maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli bii, nyɛfea toi, shi naa, abaakojo nyɛ fɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe tamɔ akpa ni atsɔ̃ yɛ Mizpa, kɛ yaa ni akɛlɛɛ shi yɛ Tabor Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ ebote nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli vii yɛ Akasia maŋ lɛ mli, mibagbala amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ toi waa diɛŋtsɛ.
Mile Efraim bɔ ni eyɔɔ tsɔ̃; no hewɔ lɛ, Israel kɛ ehe eteko mi.
Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Efraim, oje misɛɛ, ni Israel ebule ehe.” Hosea bɔ wɔŋjamɔ he kɔkɔ “Amɛnifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛsɛɛ amɛku kɛba amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mumɔ ebote amɛmli, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛleee mi, Yehowa dɔŋŋ.
Israel shwãa nii lɛ miiye odase moŋ eeshi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Israel kɛ Efraim hiɛ baakpãtã, ni Yuda hu kɛ amɛ fɛɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
Amɛkɛ amɛtoi kɛ amɛtsinai baaya ayashã afɔle kɛtao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, shi amɛnaŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Yehowa egbala ehe shi eshi amɛ.
Akɛni amɛje Yehowa sɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyafɔ gbɔi abii.
Shi nyɔŋ hee ni baaje lɛ mli lɛ abaakpãtã amɛ kɛ amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛ hiɛ.” Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ amɛhe wu ta “Akpã ta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Gibea!
Akpã koofɛŋ lɛ yɛ Rama!
Abɔ oshe yɛ Bet-Aven!
Ohe akpokpo, Benyamin!
Gbi nɔ ni abaagbala Efraim toi lɛ, ebaatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Naa, nɔ ni baaba Israel akutsei lɛ anɔ lɛ no mikɛɛ nɛɛ.
“Yuda lumɛi lɛ tsiɔ husu kɛyaa sɛɛ kɛjuɔ shikpɔŋ.
Mahã mimlifu ate shi awo amɛ tamɔ nu ni etue.
Efraim kã piŋmɔ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ ebu lɛ fɔ ejaakɛ etswa efai shi akɛ eyaanyiɛ yaka nii asɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ mitsɔ̃ omlɛgɛ ni baaye Efraim, kɛ fala ni baakpãtã Yuda hiɛ.
“Be ni Israel na hela ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ni Yuda hu na fala ni efã lɛ, Efraim tee Asiria maŋtsɛ kpanaa lɛ ŋɔɔ eyabi edɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ, shi Asiria nyɛɛɛ amɛ tsofa efee aloo etsa amɛ.
Mibahuru tamɔ jata mayi Israel kɛ Yuda hu nɔ, ni mi diɛŋtsɛ mibatserɛ amɛmli, kɛkɛ lɛ mishi amɛ mitee.
Mashãtã amɛ kɛya ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ehere.
“Mibagbala mihe shi mashi amɛ kɛyaashi amɛaakpɛlɛ̃ amɛtɔ̃mɔ nɔ, ni amɛaabatao misɛɛgbɛ.
Ekolɛ fimɔ be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaatao mi.”
Maŋbii ejeee amɛhe sɛɛ anɔkwale mli Maŋbii lɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa koni wɔkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ.
Akɛni lɛ etserɛ wɔmli lɛ, lɛ eeetsa wɔ; ni akɛni lɛ etswia wɔ nii lɛ, lɛ eeefi nɔ ehã wɔ.
Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, eeetsĩɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ eeetee wɔ shi, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ aaahi shi.
Nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ wɔlea Yehowa.
Bɔ ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ daa gbi lɛ je tsɛreɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ Yehowa baajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ.
Ebaaba wɔŋɔɔ tamɔ Agbiɛnaa nunɛmɔ tueɔ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Shi Yehowa kɛɔ akɛ, “Ao!
Israel, mɛni mafee ohe?
Ao!
Yuda, te mafee bo tɛŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ etamɔ leebi atatu; etamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa oya.
No hewɔ ni mitsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ migbala amɛtoi, ni mikɛ midaaŋ wiemɔi lɛ kã amɛ, ni kojomɔ ni mikojo amɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ kane.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ ji suɔmɔ ni tsakeee shi jeee afɔle; nɔ ni mitaoɔ ji lee ni aleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shi jeee shãaafɔle.
“Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtɔ̃ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam fee lɛ, ni amɛyeee mi anɔkwa.
Gilead lɛ nɔfɔŋfeelɔi amaŋ ni, ni lá ewu amɛhe.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ojotswalɔi woɔ mɔ ka lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ pɛ osɔfoi lɛ efee ekome amɛgbeɔ mɛi, ni amɛfeɔ nishaianii yɛ Shekem gbɛteŋ.
Mina gbeyei nii ko yɛ Israel: Efraim kɛ amãgãjamɔ miibɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ jɛi; abule Israel.
“Ni bo, Yuda, hu mito be ni nɔ ni oduɔ amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ, obaakpa eyibii.
“Kɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ matsa mimɛi Israelbii lɛ koni amɛshwere pɛ, kɛkɛ lɛ Efraim kɛ Samaria nifɔɔjianii lɛ eje kpo: no ji mɔshishiumɔ kɛ juu kɛ ojotswaa yɛ gbɛteŋ.
Efeee amɛ kwraa akɛ miina amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi naa amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ ebɔle amɛ, ni miikwɛ.” Atoɔ yitso fɔŋ nigii yɛ Maŋtsɛ we lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ nifeemɔi lɛ hãa maŋtsɛ lɛ mii shɛɔ ehe, ni amɛkɛ mɔshishinyiɛmɔ wiemɔ hãa lumɛi hu naa miishɛɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ashishinyiɛlɔi kɛ mɛi ni yeee anɔkwa yɛ jamɔ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la ni awo ni nishãlɔ eŋmɛɛ he koni etso kɛyashi ma ni akpɔtɔ lɛ aaafu kɛha shãa.
Gbi nɔ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ye egbi jurɔ lɛ, lumɛi lɛ kɛ dãatɔɔ wo amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhe hela.
Maŋtsɛ ta fɛoyelɔi tete po adɛ̃.
Yitso fɔŋ ni amɛto yɛ amɛtsui mli lɛ sukɔɔ yɛ amɛmli nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, ni leebi lɛ etsoɔ grigri tamɔ flɔnɔɔ mli la.
“Amɛkɛ mlila ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ gbegbee amɛnɔyelɔi lɛ.
Amɛmaŋtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ nyɔnyɔi, shi amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko kwraa ebooo etsɛɛɛ mi.” Israel kɛ maji krokomɛi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Israel kɛ ehe fufuaa maŋsɛɛ maji anɔbii lɛ, ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ aboloo ni ebe fã kɛ fã.
Gbɔi lɛ ehã ehewalɛ etã, shi eyooko; eyiteŋ eje waŋ, shi ekɔɔɔ sɛɛ.
Israel shwãanii lɛ miiye odase miishi lɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ maŋbii lɛ kpaleee koni amɛba mi, Yehowa amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ, aloo koni amɛtao misɛɛgbɛ.
Israel etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpo kwashia ni bɛ yitso: ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eetsɛ Ijipt koni ebawa lɛ; wɔ lɛ eetsɛ Asiria.
Shi kɛji amɛshi kɛmiiya nɔŋŋ lɛ mibafɔ̃ amɛ nɔ yaa madu amɛ tamɔ aduɔ loofɔlɔ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi yɛ nifɔɔjianii ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
“Kpoo hã amɛ ejaakɛ amɛshi mi, ni amɛbɔ ko.
Amɛhiɛ ekpãtã ejaakɛ amɛtse mihiɛ atua.
Mi lɛ mitao akɛ mahere amɛyiwala; shi amɛ lɛ amɛmalemaleɔ mihe.
Amɛfooo amɛtsɛɛɛ mi kɛjɛɛɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ; shi moŋ amɛsai anɔ amɛfoɔ waa yɛ.
Kɛji amɛmiisɔle yɛ abele kɛ wain he lɛ, amɛkɛ kakla folɔɔ amɛhe tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua.
Yɛ mli akɛ mi ji mɔ ni tsɔse amɛ, ni mihã amɛna hewalɛ nɛ, shi daa nɛɛ lɛ efɔŋ pɛ amɛjwɛŋɔ yɛ mihe.
