Amɛkã he amɛmiija Baal lolo, ni amɛtsɔ̃ tamɔ gãitso ni waaa.
Naafuu wiemɔi ni amɛlumɛi lɛ wieɔ lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, amɛaanyɔnyɔi yɛ klante naa.
Ni enɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛaaye amɛhe fɛo yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
Yehowa bu Israel fɔ yɛ amãgãjamɔ hewɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Kpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ okɛhɛle mɛi ashi.
Henyɛlɔ miiba tamɔ okropɔŋ ebayi Yehowa we lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mimaŋbii lɛ eku mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtɔ̃ mimla lɛ nɔ.
Mi amɛbolɔɔ amɛtsɛɔ akɛ, ‘WɔNyɔŋmɔ, bo ji mɔ ni wɔ, Israelbii, wɔle.’ Israelbii ekwa nɔ kpakpa lɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, henyɛlɔi aaanyiɛ amɛsɛɛ.
“Amɛto maŋtsɛmɛi, shi jeee mi minɔ amɛtsɔ̃; ni amɛhole lumɛi hu ni mileee mli eko kwraa.
Amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi kɛ amɛshika fee amãgãi ni baakpãtã amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ.
Mitaooo tsinabi ni ajaa yɛ Samaria maŋ lɛ mli lɛ kwrakwra.
Mimli ewo amɛ la naakpa.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ po amɛaaba amɛjeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Israel?
Ŋaalɔ ko ni fee tsinabi lɛ; shi naa, jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ni.
Nakai tsinabi lɛ ni ajaa yɛ Samaria lɛ, aaajwara lɛ dukuduku.
Ejaakɛ akɛni amɛdu kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ lasuogbele ji yibii ni amɛbaakpa.
Abele ekpɛŋ bi kome nɛkɛ ni aaana aye.
Ni kɛji abele lɛ aaaba tete lɛ, gbɔi moŋ aaabaye.
Majimaji lɛ emi Israel momo, ni enɛ ehã etsɔ̃ tamɔ tsɛnsi ko ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Ejaakɛ Israel tsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋaŋ teji ni miifo shi.
Etee eyabi Asiria dɛŋ yelikɛbuamɔ; asaŋ Efraim bɔ maŋsɛɛbii apaa koni amɛbu ehe.
Amɛbɔ majimaji apaa moŋ, shi agbɛnɛ mibabua amɛnaa kɛkpe, ni magbala amɛtoi.
Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ amɛbaakpa maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi too.
“Israelbii mamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi koni amɛkɛdãi esha ni amɛfee lɛ, shi afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ moŋ etsɔ̃ eshafeemɔ nɔ.
Kɛji miŋma mimlai lɛ shii akpei abɔ tete mihã amɛ lɛ, amɛbaaŋɔ mlai lɛ akɛ mɔkpɔŋ dɛŋ nii.
Amɛsumɔɔ afɔleshãa.
Amɛgbeɔ kooloi amɛkɛshãa mifɔlei lɛ akɛ loo kɛkɛ ni ayeɔ.
Eji nɔ ko ni esaaa mihiɛ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibakai eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ni mibawo amɛ he nyɔmɔ.
Ijipt kɛ̃ amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee.
“Ejaakɛ Israel hiɛ kpa ebɔlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni emamɔ mɔji moŋ ehã ehe; ni Yuda hu tswa gbogbo ewo emaji pii ahe.
Shi mawo amɛmaji lɛ amli la ni mashã amɛmɔji lɛ.”
Hosea tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni abaagbala Israel toi ahã Israel, omli akafili bo, ni kaanya tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bo lɛ oje oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɛɛ, ni oyeee lɛ anɔkwa.
Ohɔ̃ɔ ohe tamɔ ajwamãŋ yɛ he fɛɛ he ohã jemawɔŋ Baal lɛ, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ no hãa anaa abele lɛ.
Biɛ be kukuoo mli lɛ abele kɛ mu lɛ shɛŋ nyɛnaa, ni anaŋ wain hu.
Asaŋ Israel ehiŋ Yehowa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, shi ebaaku sɛɛ eya Ijipt nyɔŋyeli mli; ni amɛaayaye nii ni he tseee yɛ Asiria.
Amɛnyɛŋ amɛfɔse wain amɛshwie shi yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛhã Yehowa, aloo amɛshã afɔlei ni sa amɛhã lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nii ni amɛaaye lɛ aaabule mɛi fɛɛ ni aaaye eko tamɔ yara nɔ nii buleɔ mɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nii ni amɛaaye lɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhɔmɔ kɛkɛ amɛkɛaagbe, shi ekoeko shɛŋ Yehowa hiɛ.
Te nyɛbaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji eshɛ gbijurɔyeli be loo Yehowa gbijurɔ lɛ hu?
Ejaakɛ amɛbaashi kɛya Asiria, ni Ijipt aaabua amɛgbohii lɛ anaa ni aaafu amɛ yɛ Memfis.
Hei ni amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛi nibii fɛɛfɛji lɛ toɔ lɛ amli baatsa kɛ sɔ̃nsɔ̃rɔ̃i, ni ŋmeitsei hu aaatsa yɛ amɛshĩai amli.
Toigbalamɔ gbii lɛ eshɛ, be ni abaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa lɛ lɛ eshɛ.
Israel baana ele akɛ gbalɔ lɛ buulu ni, ni mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛkɛyelɔ ni yɛ enishaianii hewɔ.
Gbalɔ lɛ ato lɛ akɛ bulɔ ahã Israel, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ webii lɛ.
Shi he fɛɛ he ni eeetsɔ̃ lɛ atsɔ̃ lɛ tsɔne, ni eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shĩa diɛŋtsɛ mli lɛ nyɛɛ anyɛɔ lɛ.
Amɛbote eshafeemɔ mli vii tamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Gibea lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mibani eshai ni amɛfee lɛ ahe, ni mibawo amɛ nyɔmɔ.
Esha ni Israel fee lɛ kɛ ehe nyɔmɔwoo lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mina Israel lɛ etamɔ wain yibii ni atoɔ lɛ ahuu yɛ ŋa nɔ.
Mina nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ni tsu yɛ agbãmi tso nɔ.
Shi be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ shɛ Poer Gɔŋ le he lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i jemawɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Poer lɛ jamɔ.
Enɛ hã amɛsane je migugɔŋ fu tamɔ wɔji ni amɛjaa lɛ nɔŋŋ asane.
Israel agbojee sɛɛ aaafo tamɔ loofɔlɔ filikiɔ lɛ.
Afɔŋ bi dɔŋŋ lɛ, ahiɛŋ musu dɔŋŋ, asaŋ anaŋ musu tete dɔŋŋ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni kɛji amɛna bii amɛlɛ tete mibagbe bii nɛɛ, ni mishwɛŋ ekome nɛkɛ.
Anɔkwa, kɛji miŋmɛɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe lɛ sane kɛ joomɔ baaye amɛ pam.
“Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni minaa kã shi hã Efraimbii ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nɔŋŋ eeekpala ebii lɛ eyahã koni akpãtã amɛhiɛ.” Mɛni masumɔ akɛ ofee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ?
Yehowa, hã amɛmusu ashrake, ni amɛfufɔi fɛɛ agbi.
Yehowa bu Israel fɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Amɛto amɛnifɔɔjianii lɛ fɛɛ feemɔ shishi yɛ Gilgal, ni jɛi mibɔ̃i amɛ nyɛɛ yɛ.
Amɛnifeemɔnii gbohii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ mibashwie amɛ kɛje mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Misumɔŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ!
Amɛlumɛi lɛ fɛɛ etse mihiɛ atua.
Israel lɛ etsɔ̃ tamɔ tso ni egbo; hela emɔ lɛ, ni eha eshishi fãi fɛɛ egboi; ni no hewɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii dɔŋŋ.
Kɛji amɛna amɛfɔ lɛ, mibagbe amɛmusuŋbii ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ.” Gbalɔ lɛ miiwie Israel he MiNyɔŋmɔ ni misɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ, baakwa emɛi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛbooo lɛ toi.
Amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ kobɔfoi yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ anɔ bii lɛ ateŋ.
Israel tamɔ wain tso ni efũ baa ni eewo.
Babaoo ni Israelbii lɛ shwereɔ lɛ babaoo ni amɛmamɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi ji no.
Bɔ ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baa nii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ amɛsaa shiui ni amɛkɛjaa lɛ hu ahe.
Amɛyeee anɔkwa, ni no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, amɛbaana he nyɔmɔwoo.
Yehowa baakumɔ amɛfɔleshãa latɛi lɛ eshwie shi, ni ebaafite amɛshiui lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ejaakɛ wɔsheee Yehowa gbeyei.
Shi kɛji wɔyɛ maŋtsɛ po lɛ mɛni ebaanyɛ efee ehã wɔ?” Amɛwieɔ huu kɛkɛ ni amɛleee nɔ ni amɛwieɔ lɛ.
Amɛwoɔ shi babaoo ni amɛle akɛ amɛyeŋ nɔ, ni amɛkpãŋɔ kpãŋmɔi yaka ni sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, toigbalamɔ baatsɔ̃ tamɔ ebɔɔ ŋmei ni efɛ̃ shi yɛ ŋmɔshi akofii anɔ ahã amɛ.
Samaria maŋ bii lɛ aaashe gbeyei, ni amɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ Bet-Aven shika tsinabi lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛ kɛ wulɔmɛi lɛ ni jaa tsinabi lɛ baawo yara amɛfo yɛ enyam ni afo sɛɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Anɔkwa, abaawo shika tsinabi lɛ kɛya koni akɛyake Asiria maŋtsɛ kpele lɛ.
Ni no baahã hiɛgbele amɔ Israel, ni ehiɛ baashwie shi yɛ ŋaa gbonyo toi ni ebo lɛ hewɔ.
Samaria maŋtsɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tso kuku ni kplaŋɔ yɛ faa hiɛ.
Betel gɔji lɛ ayiteiaŋ hei ni Israelbii lɛ jaa amãgãi yɛ ni amɛkɛgbo toi lɛ, aaakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ.
Ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛi baakwɛ̃ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ anɔ yɛ jɛi.
Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baabolɔ amɛkɛɛ gɔji lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhaa wɔnɔ!” Ni amɛaakɛɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, “Nyɛbashwiea wɔnɔ!” Yehowa bu Israel fɔ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israel, ofee esha kɛjɛ Gibea esha lɛ nɔ beebe, ni ohiɛ esha lɛ mli oofee lolo.
Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ ta ni afã ashi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ninaa bo yɛ Gibea?
Mibate shi mawo toigbolɔi lɛ, ni mibagbala amɛtoi bɔ ni misumɔɔ.
Maji baafee ekome awo Israelbii, ni abaagbala amɛtoi yɛ eshai enyɔ lɛ ni amɛfee lɛ ahewɔ.
“Nyɛsɛɛ ko lɛ Israel tamɔ tsina oblayoo ni atsɔse lɛ, ni enyaa he kɛ̃, akɛ akɛ lɛ miigbee ŋmaa lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, miwooo ekuɛ fɛɛfɛo lɛ kɔŋtso.
Shi agbɛnɛ mibawo Israel kuɛ kɔŋtso.
Yuda baashãtã tsina kɔi ekɛhu; ni Israel baaninɛ nɔ ni ehu lɛ.” Nyɛfea nii ni ja tamɔ aduɔ wu kpakpa, ni nyɛaakpa misuɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ yibii.
Nyɛjea wala hee shishi tamɔ asaa shikpɔŋ atoɔ nidumɔ, ejaakɛ be yɛ lolo bɔ ni sa ni nyɛkɛaatao Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ kɛyaashi eeeba ebajɔɔ nyɛ tamɔ nu nɛɔ shwieɔ nii anɔ.
Nyɛdu efɔŋ, ni nyɛkpa nɔsha, ni nyɛye yibii ni amale wo: “Ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhiɛ fɔ̃ nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ kɛ hii kãkãlɔi lɛ ayifalɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ta aaabanina nyɛ, ni aaakpãtã nyɛmɔji lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Maŋtsɛ Shalman kpãtã Bet-Arbel maŋ lɛ hiɛ yɛ ta mli, ni eplenee emli yeifɔyei kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ lɛ.
Nakai nɔ ko pɛpɛɛpɛ baaba nyɛnɔ, nyɛ Betelbii.
Efɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmaŋtsɛ baagbo leebi maŋkpa.”
Suɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ hã toigbolɔi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israel gbekɛbiashi beebe misumɔ lɛ kɛjɛ; Ijipt tɔ̃ɔ eyɔɔ ni mitsɛ lɛ akɛ mibi.
Shi shii abɔ ni mitsɛɔ lɛ lɛ, shii abɔ ni eyaa sɛɛsɛɛ moŋ eshiɔ mi ji no; ni amɛyaa nɔ amɛshãa afɔlei amɛhãa Baal, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛhãa amãgãi.
Tsɛbelɛ mi mifee Israel tataa ni ele nyiɛmɔ.
Mihole amɛ mifɔ̃ mikpɔkɔiaŋ, shi amɛŋɔɔɔ nɔ akɛ mi mihere amɛ.
Mikɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlitsɔlɛ gbala amɛ kɛba miŋɔɔ; ni mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ni fãa amɛdaaŋ manyoflɛ, ni mikɛ niyenii ma amɛhiɛ.” “Amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni Asiria aaaye amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ amɛkpaleɔ kɛbaa miŋɔɔ.
Taitai baate shi yɛ amɛmaji lɛ anɔ, ni abaakumɔ amɛmaji lɛ agboi lɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnilee nɔ.
Beiaŋ ni mimɛi lɛ ekã akɛ shimɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaashi mi lɛ, kɛ̃ɛmɔ nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛaakɛ̃mɔ yɛ amɛkɔŋtso ni kã amɛkuɛ lɛ hewɔ, shi mɔ ko woŋ yɛ amɛnɔ.
“Ao Israel, te mafee tɛŋŋ maŋmɛɛ ohe hu?
Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwa bo hu?
Aso manyɛ ohiɛ makpãtã tamɔ bɔ ni mifee Adma lɛ; aloo tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛ Zeboim ye lɛ?
Mitsui miitswa yɛ mimli, ni mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ ohe.
Mikɛ mlifu yeŋ osane lɛ.
Mikpãtãŋ Israel hiɛ dɔŋŋ ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi, shi jeee gbɔmɔ.
Mi, Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ, mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ mlifu.
“Mimɛi lɛ baanyiɛ, mi Yehowa, misɛɛ; beyinɔ ni mabo tamɔ jata lɛ amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Amɛhe aaakpokpo kɛaajɛ anaigbɛ kɛba.
Amɛaaba kɛaajɛ Ijipt kɛ hekpokpomɔ tamɔ loofɔji; amɛaaba tamɔ okpoi kɛaajɛ Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛaaba amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai amli ekoŋŋ.
Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.” Abu Yuda kɛ Israel fɔ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Israelbii ebɔle mihe kɛkpe kɛ amale kɛ mɔshishiumɔ, ni Yudabii kã he amɛmiitse miihiɛ atua, mi ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwafo kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.”
“Israelbii agbi muu mli tɔlɛ kɛ deŋme lɛ, ehe baaa sɛɛnamɔ ko, shi moŋ efiteɔ nii.
Amɛhã amale kɛ yiwalɛ ebu yɛ amɛteŋ.
Amɛ kɛ Asiria ekpãŋ, ni amɛ kɛ Ijipt miiye mu jara.” “No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Yudabii lɛ yɛ sane.
Ebaawo Israelbii nyɔmɔ yɛ amɛjeŋba naa; eeegbala amɛtoi yɛ amɛnifeemɔnii anaa.
Amɛtsɛ Yakob lɛ ekɛ enyɛmi lɛ na be ni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɔɔ musuŋ; ni be ni eda lɛ Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu.
Yakob kɛ bɔfo lɛ nɔ, ni eye kunim; efo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo lɛ ni ebi edɛŋ jɔɔmɔ.
Yakob kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpe yɛ Betel, ni jɛi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie yɛ.
Ni Yehowa, ji Tai aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni Yakob kɛwie lɛ, ni egbɛi ji Yehowa, ni no akɛkaiɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ hu, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛhea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa eŋɔɔ.
Nyɛnaa mɛi amɔbɔ; nyɛyea jalɛ sane, ni nyɛyea anɔkwa daa kɛkwɛa lɛ gbɛ.” Fɔ kroko hu ni abu Israel kɛ Yuda Yehowa kɛɛ, “jarayelɔ ni kɛ nsɛni ni atse etɛ nɔ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, shishiulɔ ji lɛ.
Israel kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Shi bɛ mitsɔ̃ niiatsɛ, bɛ mina nii babaoo?’ Mideŋmegbomɔ mli nii lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ anaaa tɔ̃mɔ ko ni tamɔ esha yɛ mihe?
Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛ jɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe kɛba lɛ.
Mahã nyɛhi bui amli ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfee yɛ gbii juji anɔ lɛ.
“Mi mikɛ gbalɔi lɛ wie, ni mijie ninaa srɔtoi mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ; asaŋ mitsɔ̃ amɛnɔ mibubuu mimɛi lɛ abɛi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ aaja amãgãi yɛ Gilead; shi mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa amɛ lɛ aaagboi.
Aagbe tsinai akɛmiishã afɔle yɛ Gilgal; shi afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tɛi kuikui kɛkɛ yɛ amɛŋmɔjiashi akofii lɛ ateŋ.” Yakob jo foi kɛtee Mesopotamia.
Eyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ jɛi yɛ ŋa hewɔ; eyakwɛ mɔ ko toi yɛ ŋa hewɔ.
Yehowa tsu gbalɔ ni eyahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala kɛje Ijipt kɛba, ni gbalɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ ekura amɛ.
Israelbii ewo Yehowa mli la naakpa; ni no hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ amɛgboi; ni amɛmusu aaatere amɛ.
Yehowa baagbala amɛtoi ejaakɛ amɛwo lɛ hiɛgbele.
Naagbee fɔ ni abu Israel Kulɛ kɛji Efraim shwiei lɛ wie lɛ, mɛi ahe kpokpoɔ yɛ Israel.
Awo Efraim nɔ yɛ Israel; shi kɛtsɔ̃ jemawɔŋ Baal jamɔ nɔ lɛ, Efraim shwiei lɛ tɔ̃, ni no hewɔ amɛgboi.
Amɛkã he amɛmiifee esha lɛ lolo kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛ amɛjwiɛtɛii yahãa ŋaalɔi, ni amɛhãa akɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ shwieɔ amãgãi kɛ wɔji ahãa amɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Ashã afɔle ahã amɛ!” Mɛi ni yashãa afɔlei lɛ shwɔɔ tsinabi amãgãi lɛ anaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baalaaje tamɔ tutuu ni kɔɔyɔɔ loɔ kɛjɛɔ ŋmãagbeemɔhe kɛyaa lɛ, aloo tamɔ leebi bɔ ni kpalaa, loo afua ni hoɔ oya.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni here nyɛyiwala kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beebe lɛ.
Nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ ko akɛ ja mi; ni mi misɛɛ hu lɛ yiwalaherelɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mikwɛ nyɛnɔ yɛ shiaŋa ni nu bɛ nɔ lɛ nɔ, shi be ni nyɛna nii nyɛye ni nyɛtɔrɔ pɛ, kɛkɛ ni nyɛwo nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kpa minɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibahuru mayi nyɛnɔ tamɔ jata; mibawo nyɛ ka tamɔ mlaŋtswi yɛ gbɛtoi.
Mibatua nyɛ oookɛɛ oshishibrishi ni amɔmɔ ebii yɛ ehe tuaa mɔ, ni mibatserɛ nyɛmli maye yɛ minajiaŋ tamɔ jata.
No ji akɛ mibatserɛ nyɛmli mɛnyɛmɛnyɛ tamɔ ŋaŋ kooloo awuyelɔ tsɛrɛɔ loo mli lɛ.
“Kwɛ, Israel!
Mibakpãtã ohiɛ; ni namɔ aaanyɛ oyiwala ahere?
Nɛgbɛ omaŋtsɛ lɛ yɔɔ koni ehere oyiwala; aloo nɛgbɛ nyɛlumɛi lɛ ni baafã nyɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, mɛi ahewɔ ni nyɛbi akɛ, ‘Ahã wɔ maŋtsɛ kɛ lumɛi lɛ?’ Mihã nyɛ maŋtsɛmɛi, shi yɛ mlifu naa; ni miŋɔ amɛ kɛtee yɛ mlila naa.
“Abua Israel nishaianii lɛ kɛ etɔ̃mɔi lɛ anaa ato ahã lɛ.
Yoofɔyoo kɔ̃ɔmɔ be miiba ehã Israel; shi ehe bi kwashia ni eji hewɔ lɛ, emaaa eyi shi ebaaa awosojwaahe lɛ.
Mibahereŋ amɛ yɛ gbohiiaje dɛŋ; mibaŋ amɛyi yɛ gbele mli?
Gbele, nɛgbɛ otsɛŋemɔ hela yɔɔ; ni Gbohiiaje, nɛgbɛ oniiahiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?
Minaŋ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ.
Israel aaafrɔke tamɔ ŋɔi, shi bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ la lɛ, ni ji Yehowa kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, baafã kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba; ebaŋala amɛnuhiŋmɛii kɛ nubui fɛɛ amli nu; asaŋ eeekpãtã amɛnɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ jara hiɛ.
Samaria yi sɔ̃ lɛ baatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; emli bii lɛ ahiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ ta mli, akɛ emli abifabii lɛ aaatswiatswia shi; ni aaagbala amɛyeihɔlɔi lɛ amli.”
Sane ni Hosea kɛfɔ̃ Israel hiɛ Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛkpalea kɛbaa Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
Nyɛnishaianii lɛ ehã nyɛtɛrɛ, ni nyɛgbee shi.
Nyɛkpalea kɛyaa Yehowa ŋɔɔ, nyɛyakpaa lɛ fai kɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛ efɔŋ ni wɔfee lɛ afa koni omɔ wɔfaikpamɔ nɛɛ mli, ni wɔɔkafo bo.
Asiria nyɛŋ wɔyiwala ahere gbi ko gbi ko; ni tayaa okpɔŋɔi hu nyɛŋ afã wɔhe.
Asaŋ amãgã ni wɔkɛ wɔniji fee lɛ wɔtsɛŋ lɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa, bo lɛ omusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ awusãi ahe.” Yehowa wo Israel shi yɛ wala hee he Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mibahã amɛkpa anɔkwa ni amɛyeee lɛ.
Mibasumɔ amɛ kɛ mitsui fɛɛ, ejaakɛ miŋmɛɛ mimli ni fu amɛ lɛ he.
Mibatsɔ̃ tamɔ bɔ ni enyɔ shiaŋa nɔ mahã Israelbii.
Amɛbaagba floŋŋ tamɔ fɔfɔi; ni amɛfãi aaaya su mli shɔŋŋ tamɔ Lebanon tsei.
Eniji ni ebaatsɛ̃rɛ aaalɛɛ shi, ni ehe fɛo aaatamɔ mu tso nɔ.
Eeeje ŋma tamɔ Lebanon seda tsei lɛ.
Amɛbaaba amɛbahi mifiji ashishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Amɛaafɛo tamɔ abɔɔ, ni amɛaafrɔke tamɔ wain tso, ni amɛgbɛi aaahehe tamɔ Lebanon wain.
Israelbii kɛ wɔji naŋ nɔ ko feemɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mibabo amɛsɔlemɔ toi.
Mibatsɔ̃ tso ni eyi baa kpalaaa mahã amɛ, ni mibabaa amɛyi; nyɛjɔɔmɔi fɛɛ baajɛ mi midɛŋ.” Sane lɛ naamuu Mɔ ni le nii lɛ, enu saji nɛɛ ashishi; ni hiɛshikãlɔ lɛ ekɔ sɛɛ.
Naa, Yehowa gbɛi fɛɛ ja, ni nomɛi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii kɛbaa ejeŋ; nomɛi anaa mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii hiɔ shi yɛ; shi eshafeelɔi tswaa egbɛi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛtɛrɛɔ, ni amɛgbeɔ shi.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Yoel lɛ aleee ehe nɔ ko tsɔ̃; aleee be pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni ehi shi.
Shi eeefee akɛ aŋma wolo nɛɛ yɛ afii loo Dani Afɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Persiabii ji mɛi ni yeɔ jɛigbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ.
Yoel gbaa baalabii gbeyeigbeyei komɛi ni batua Palestina shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ nuhɔ̃mɔ ni fite nii babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe sane.
Kɛ Gbalɔ Yoel kwɛ nibii ni ba nɛɛ lɛ, enaa lɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa gbi lɛ he okadi ni.
Eji gbi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbla mɛi ni teɔ shi shiɔ jalɛ sane ni etaoɔ akɛ eye lɛ atoi.
Gbalɔ Yoel hã maŋbii lɛ le akɛ Yehowa miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba, ni Yehowa miiwo amɛ shi akɛ kɛji amɛtsake lɛ, ebaahã amɛshihilɛ afee tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ dani amanehului lɛ ba lɛ, ni ebaajɔɔ amɛ.
Nɔ titri kome ni wɔbaana yɛ wolo lɛ mli ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ shi akɛ ebaahã Emumɔ lɛ aba mɛi fɛɛ anɔ, hii kɛ yei kɛ onukpai kɛ gbekɛbii fɛɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Baalabii atuamɔ lɛ .—.
Shiwoo akɛ be kpakpa baaku sɛɛ aba .- Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ .—.
Naa shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhã Yoel, Penuel binuu lɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ ye ŋmɔshinii ni afite he ŋkɔmɔ Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛdara, nyɛboa toi, nyɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi.
Nɔ ni eba nɛɛ, ani eko eba dã yɛ nyɛyinɔ, loo yɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi ayinɔ tete?
Nyɛgbaa nyɛbii, koni nyɛbii lɛ agba amɛbii, ni amɛbii lɛ hu agba yinɔ ni baa yɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ.
Baalabii baha wɔŋmɔshinii; nɔ ni ku kome shwɛ lɛ, ku ni nyiɛ sɛɛ baye.
Nyɛ gaalei, nyɛhiɛ atsɛ̃a ni nyɛfoa; nyɛ wainnulɔi, nyɛwɔa lele, ejaakɛ nyɛwain dɔkɔdɔkɔ lɛ eje nyɛdaaŋ.
Baalabii, ta muu, ebatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ; amɛhe wa, ni anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane; amɛnyanyɔji anaa ba tamɔ jata nyanyɔji.
Amɛkpãtã wɔwaintsei lɛ ahiɛ; amɛkpe wɔgbãmitsei lɛ ahe.
Amɛkpɔlɔ tsei lɛ ahe totoi lɛ, kɛyashi niji lɛ ahe yɛ sakoo.
Wo yara tamɔ oblayoo ni foɔ eblayeiaŋ wu.
Niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa sɛɛ efo yɛ Yehowa we lɛ.
Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ afɔlei bɛ hã Yehowa.
Akpãtã ŋmɔji lɛ ahiɛ; shikpɔŋ lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ akpãtã ŋmaa lɛ hiɛ; wainyibii lɛ egbi, mutsei lɛ eŋala.
Nyɛ okwaafoi, nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ.
Nyɛ waintromkwɛlɔi, nyɛwoa yara yɛ ŋmaa kɛ akoko hewɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmɔshinii lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
Waintsei lɛ eŋala; agbãmitsei lɛ egboi; akututsei kɛ tɛŋi kɛ atĩatsei, yelitsei fɛɛ egbigbii.
Nyamɔ etã yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.
Osɔfoi, nyɛbua kpekpe, ni nyɛwoa yara; Nyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi, nyɛwɔa lele.
Nyɛbotea Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni nyɛyea ŋkɔmɔ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ, nyɛ miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, ejaakɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle ni akɛyaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, atsi naa.
Nyɛfãa koni ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, nyɛtsɛa kpee hu.
Nyɛbuaa onukpai lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ anaa kɛyaa Yehowa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ we lɛ, ni nyɛbolɔa nyɛtsɛa lɛ.
Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ shi etã!
Gbi ni Ofe lɛ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baa lɛ, nakai gbi lɛ baafee gbeyei!
Bɛ wɔhiŋmɛi kã nɔ nɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni akpãtãa wɔniyenii hiɛ, ni nyamɔ kɛ mliflimɔ hu sɛɛ efo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ?
Dumɔwui lɛ egboi yɛ su kukulii lɛ ashishi, aboŋoi lɛ kamɔ efolo, ŋmaatoohei lɛ ekumɔ, ejaakɛ ŋmaa lɛ eŋala.
Kwɛ bɔ ni tsina kui lɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ kɛ nɔnaa, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ jwɛifɔ, ni toikui lɛ hu miina nɔ.
Bo, Yehowa, mibolɔɔ mitsɛɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni lalilɛi eshã ŋa lɛ nɔ tsei lɛ fɛɛ.
Ŋaŋ kooloi tete miibolɔ miitsɛ bo, ejaakɛ fai lɛ egbi, ni la ekpãtã ŋa nɔ jwɛifɔ hiɛ.
Baalabii akɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ he Kɔkɔbɔɔ Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion; nyɛbɔa oshe yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ!
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii fɛɛ ahe akpokpo, ejaakɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ miiba; eshɛ shi etã.
Duŋ kɛ jeŋ tuutuufeemɔ gbi ni, atatu kɛ oblɔtu kpii gbi ni.
Baalabii ta muu miiba tamɔ duŋ gbɛɔ shwãa gɔji anɔ lɛ.
Nɔ ko ni tamɔ enɛ bako dã, ni asaŋ esɛɛ lɛ eko baŋ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee yinɔi ayinɔ.
Baalabii lɛ yeɔ tsei lɛ tamɔ la yeɔ nii.
Amɛhiɛgbɛ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ tamɔ Eden trom, shi amɛsɛɛgbɛ lɛ etamɔ ŋa kpataa.
Nɔ ko nɔ ko ejeee amɛdɛŋ.
Amɛsu tamɔ okpɔŋɔi, amɛshaa foi tamɔ ta okpɔŋɔi.
Kɛji amɛmiitumɔ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, egbɛɔ tamɔ shwiilii; egbɛɔ tamɔ lalilɛi ni miishã gbetseli fɛlɛɔ; amɛtamɔ ta kpeteŋkple ni eto kɛbaagba ta.
Kɛ amɛmiiba lɛ, maji ahe kpokpoɔ, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ shaleɔ.
Amɛtsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ kãkãlɔi, amɛkwɔɔ gbogboi tamɔ tabilɔi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛɔ egbɛ nɔ; amɛtsakeee amɛgbɛ koni eeeba akɛ mɔ ko aaayaje mɔ ko gbɛ nɔ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyiɛ egbɛ nɔ.
Amɛgbaa shi kutuu kɛtsɔ̃ɔ tawuu afabaŋi amli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko etsiii amɛ gbɛ.
Amɛyatuaa maŋ; amɛjoɔ foi yɛ gbogboi anɔ; amɛkwɔɔ kɛboteɔ shĩai amli, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ samfɛji amli tamɔ julɔi.
Kɛji amɛmiiba lɛ, shikpɔŋ hosoɔ, ni ŋwɛi kpokpoɔ bliblibli.
Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere woɔ duŋ, ni ŋulamii fɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
Yehowa woɔ egbee, ni efãa eta lɛ.
Esra lɛ da naakpa, ni mɛi ni yeɔ efãmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, anyɛɛɛ amɛ akane.
Yehowa gbi lɛ, ebaafee gbeyei!
Namɔ po aaanyɛ naa adamɔ?
Aatsɛ mɛi koni amɛtsake amɛtsui “Shi amrɔ nɛɛ po Yehowa kɛɛ, nyɛshwaa nyɛhe anɔkwale mli, ni nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli.” Nyɛtsɛrɛa nyɛtsuii, shi jeee nyɛtadei; nyɛkpalea kɛbaa nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ durolɔ kɛ mlitsɔ̃lɔ ji lɛ; emli fuu mra, ni eyeɔ eshiwoo nɔ; ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni eshwaa ehe yɛ nɔ fɔŋ hewɔ.
Ekolɛ Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsake ejwɛŋmɔ, ni eeejɔɔ nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni nyɛkɛ niyenii afɔle kɛ dãa afɔle aaabahã Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkpãa tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ yɛ Zion; nyɛfãa akɛ ahi ŋmaa krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni nyɛtsɛa kpee ni mli wa.
Nyɛbuaa maŋ lɛ naa, nyɛsaa amɛ nyɛhãa kpee krɔŋkrɔŋ; nyɛbuaa gbekɛbii kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ anaa!
Ayɛmforo wu tete aje kpo yɛ esɛɛtsuŋ, ni ayɛmforo hu aje kpo yɛ epiaŋ.
Osɔfoi ni ji Yehowa sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ afo, ni amɛsɔle yɛ koi lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Yehowa, naa bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ; kaahã maji krokomɛi miiye wɔhe fɛo amɛkɛɛ.
‘Nɛgbɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ?’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ ba nii ekoŋŋ Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa ye shikpɔŋ lɛ he awuŋã ni ena emaŋ lɛ mɔbɔ.
Ehere amɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ mibahã nyɛ abele kɛ wain kɛ mu, koni nyɛye nyɛtɔrɔ; maji krokomɛi ebɔŋ nyɛ ahora dɔŋŋ.
Nɔ ni jɛ kooyigbɛ ba lɛ, majie yɛ nyɛhe kɛaatee shɔŋŋ, ni mashwie lɛ kɛaatee shikpɔŋ gbiŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ nɔ.
Eta ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ mashwie amɛ mawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli; ni amɛta ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ matsi amɛ mawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Amɛgbohii lɛ ahe sã kɛ fu aaate shi; makpãtã amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
“Shikpɔŋ, kaashe gbeyei, omii ashɛ ohe ni onya, ejaakɛ Yehowa etsu nii wuji.
Nyɛ ŋaŋ kooloi, nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ niyelihe lɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ miifrɔke, ni tsei miiwo amɛyibii, agbãmi kɛ waintso hu ewo pii.
“Nyɛ Zionbii, nyɛmli afilia nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ efee ehã nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Ehã nu enɛ ehã nyɛ bɔ ni sa, ehã Gbo kɛ Agbiɛnaa enɛ ehã nyɛ tamɔ efeɔ daa lɛ.
Ŋmãagbeemɔhei lɛ aaayimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ŋmaa, amɛhe bui lɛ aaateke nɔ kɛ wain kɛ mu.
Nii ni baalabii kɛ otukpɛi kɛ gɔgɔmii lɛ eye, yɛ afii ni amɛba lɛ mli lɛ, mato nyɛ najiaŋ.
Mi mihã baalabii ta babaoo lɛ ba batua nyɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛaana nii pii nyɛaaye nyɛaatɔrɔ.
Nyɛaajie Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, gbɛi lɛ yi, ejaakɛ etsu naakpɛɛ nii ehã nyɛ.
Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ dɔŋŋ.
No lɛ Israelbii, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ; nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi ji nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbeŋ mimaŋ lɛ he guɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
Yehowa Gbi lɛ “Enɛɛmɛi asɛɛ lɛ mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ; nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, nyɛhiimeji lɛ aaala lamɔi, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai.
Nyɛtsuji hii tete kɛ nyɛtsuji yei hu mafɔse mimumɔ lɛ mashwie amɛnɔ yɛ nakai be lɛ mli.
“Mahã ana gbi lɛ he okadii yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, láshishwiemɔ kɛ la kɛ lasu kpɔŋŋ.
Hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsu faa tamɔ lá.
Dani Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ aaaba.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaasɔle atsɛ Yehowa gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yehowa ekɛɛ lɛ.
Mɛi komɛi ahe aaaje mli, yɛ Zion Gɔŋ, Yerusalɛm; mɛi ni mahala lɛ ayi aaana wala.”
Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo Jeŋmaji lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mahã Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm aku sɛɛ ashwere ekoŋŋ.
Mabua maji lɛ fɛɛ anaa ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpeleke shi kɛaatee Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Makojo amɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ nii fɛɛ ni amɛfee mimaŋ lɛ hewɔ.
Amɛgbɛ mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ amɛshwã maji lɛ amli, ni amɛja Israel shikpɔŋ ni ji mishikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja nomii lɛ amɛhã amɛhe.
Amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii hii amɛkɛhe ajwamãŋi, ni amɛhɔ̃ɔ gbekɛbii yei amɛkɛhe wain amɛnu.
“Tiro kɛ Sidon kɛ Filistia shikpɔji fɛɛ, mɛni nyɛtaoɔ nyɛfee mi?
Ani nɔ ko ni mifee najiaŋ nyɛtaoɔ nyɛto mi?
Kɛji nakai ni lɛ, no lɛ shwiaa, ni mahã nii ni nyɛfee lɛ aku sɛɛ ababua nyɛyiteŋ; ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔ mijwiɛtɛi kɛ mishika lɛ, ni minibii ni jara wa lɛ nyɛloo kɛtee nyɛjamɔhei lɛ.
Nyɛhɔ̃ɔ Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ nyɛhã Helabii, ni nyɛjie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ mibahã amɛshi he ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ amɛ kɛtee lɛ.
Mibafee nyɛ nɔ ni nyɛfee amɛ lɛ.
Mahã ahɔ̃ɔ nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ ahã Yudabii lɛ, ni Yudabii lɛ aaahɔ̃ɔ amɛ ahã Shebabii ni ji maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ bii lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, miwie enɛ.
“Nyɛshiɛa shiɛmɔ nɛɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛhãa ta; nyɛtsɛa nyɛtabilɔi lɛ; nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi fɛɛ anaa ni nyɛfãa.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛkɔii asɔ̃a klantei ni nyɛkɛ adɔi lɛ asɔ̃a akplɔi; mɔ ni yɔɔ wudɔwudɔ tete akɛɛ akɛ, Mihe wa.’ Nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛkpe, nyɛhe afea oya kɛbaa, ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli.’ ” Yehowa, hã ota lɛ aba abatua amɛ.
“Maji lɛ asaa amɛhe koni amɛba Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Jɛi, mi Yehowa, mibata makojo maji fɛɛ ni jwere shi kɛbɔle lɛ yɛ.
Nyɛfolɔa amɛ nyɛshwiea shi tamɔ afolɔɔ ŋmaa yɛ nikpamɔ be mli lɛ; nyɛnaanaa amɛ tamɔ aŋaa wainyibii yɛ wain tsɔne ni eyi tɔ mli kɛyashiɔ wain lɛ bɔ̃iɔ hoo lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyitsoŋ wa tsɔ̃.” Gbɔmɛi akpeiakpei abɔ yɛ Kojomɔ Jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Jɛi ji he ni Yehowa Gbi ni eshɛ etã lɛ baaba yɛ.
Hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere ewo duŋ, ni ŋulamii efɔ̃ɔ kpɛmɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ aaajɔɔ emaŋ lɛ Yehowa miihuu kɛjɛ Zion, ni egbee miijije kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ miihoso.
Shi Yehowa ji abobaahe hã emaŋ lɛ, kɛ mɔɔ ni wa hu hã Israelbii lɛ.
“Kɛkɛ lɛ nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ, mi ji Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Mihiɔ Zion, migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ maŋ wulu krɔŋkrɔŋ; gbɔi nyɛŋ enɔ amɛye kɔkɔɔkɔ dɔŋŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ, gɔji lɛ anɔ aaayi tɔ kɛ waintromii, ni aaana tsinai yɛ gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ nɔ; ni nu aaaho yɛ Yuda jɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli.
Nuhiŋmɛi aaaho kɛaajɛ Yehowa We lɛ, ni eeeyahã Akasia Jɔɔ lɛ nu.
“Ijipt aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa, ni Edom aaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ ni egbo; ejaakɛ amɛbatua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛshwie enɔ bii ni efeko efɔŋ ko lɛ alá shi.
-Matɔ mɛi ni agbe lɛ alá he owele.
Mikɛ mɛi ni yeɔ fɔ lɛ ahe ekeŋ amɛ.
Shi kɛyaashi naanɔ fɛɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi aaahi Yuda kɛ Yerusalɛm, ni mi, Yehowa, mahi Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Amos ji Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni aŋmala egbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ pii.
Yudanyo ji Amos moŋ, shi eyashiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii.
Amos hi shi afii Dani Afɔ Kristo.
Nakai be mli lɛ maŋbii eshwere, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli jogbaŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ shweshweeshwe.
Shi moŋ Amos na akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ pɛ ji mɛi ni yaa nɔ shwereɔ, ni niiatsɛmɛi nɛɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni no nɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ lɛ.
Jamɔ ni amɛjaa lɛ ejeee anɔkwa jamɔ, ni shweshweeshwe ni asusuɔ akɛ maŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, ebɛ mli nakai kwraa.
Amos fee ekãa, ni eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii akɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala amɛtoi.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛfee nii ni ja koni jalɛ saneyeli atsɔ̃ “tamɔ faa ni hoɔ”.
Ni no baahã “eko lɛ Yehowa musuŋ atsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ maŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahe.” Mlijaramɔi Abaagbala mɛi ni bɔle Israel lɛ atoi .—.
Abaagbala Israel toi .—.
Ninai srɔtoi Enumɔ lɛ .—.
Amos, ni ji tookwɛlɔ ko ni jɛ Tekoa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛ.
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jie ninaa nɛɛ yɛ Israel he etsɔ̃ɔ Amos afii enyɔ dani shikpɔŋ hoso, be mli ni Uzia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ, ni Yeroboam, Yehoash bi lɛ, hu yeɔ Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ.
Amos kɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa miihũu tamɔ jata yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni egbee miishi yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Shikpɔji lɛ anɔ jwɛi fɔ aaaŋala, ni Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ aaagbi.” Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala mɛi ni bɔle Israel he lɛ atoi Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Damaskobii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛgbɛlɛ Gileadbii tamɔ akɛ dade gbɛlɛɔ nii.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Maŋtsɛ Hazael maŋtsɛ we lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Maŋtsɛ Ben-Hadad mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibakumɔ Damasko maŋ lɛ naa agboi lɛ mashwie shi; mibaplene Aven Jɔɔ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi lɛ kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Bet-eden nɔ lɛ hu, ni mibaŋɔ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ anom kɛya Kir shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa ni kɛɛ.” Filistia Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Gazabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ jaku muu fɛɛ nom kɛtee amɛyahã Edombii.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Gaza maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibaplene Ashdod maŋ lɛ mli bii kɛ lumɔ ni yeɔ Ashkelon nɔ lɛ hu; ni mibatsɔ̃ mihiɛ mawo Ekron hu, ni mibakpãtã Filistibii ni baashwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Tiro Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Tiro etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛŋɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo Edom dɛŋ, ni amɛkaiii kwraa nyɛmimɛi akpãŋmɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Tiro maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã maŋ lɛ mli mɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ fɛɛ.” Edom Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Edombii tɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛtse klante yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛgbe amɛ bɔ ni musuŋtsɔlɛ ko bɛ mli kwraa; amɛniŋ nii ahe aahu, ni amɛŋmɛɛɛ mlifu he kwrakwra.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Teman maŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Bazra mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.” Amon Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Amonbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ taitai ni amɛfãfãa bɔ ni afee ni amɛlɛɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ husui amli hewɔ lɛ, amɛgbalagbalaa Gilead yeihɔlɔi amusui amli, ni bii lɛ je shwie shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Raba maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã emli mɔji lɛ.
Gbi lɛ abaabɔ tawuu oshe, ni ta lɛ naa baawa tamɔ ahum ni efã.
Abaaŋɔ amɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ elumɛi lɛ fɛɛ nom kɛaatee.
Yehowa ni kɛɛ.”
Moab Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Moabbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛshã Edom maŋtsɛ gbonyo wui kɛyashi etsɔ̃ lamlu, ni amɛkɛshwie ehiɛ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Moab shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni la nɛɛ baashã Keriot maŋ lɛ mli mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.
Moabbii lɛ baagboi yɛ oshebɔɔ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ hoofeemɔ lɛ mli.
Mibaplene Moab maŋ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni mibagbe emli lumɛi lɛ fɛɛ hu mafata he.” Yuda Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Yudabii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkwa Yehowa mlai lɛ, ni amɛyeee ekpɔi lɛ anɔ.
Apasa jemawɔji asɛɛ ni amɛyanyiɛ, tamɔ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yanyiɛ lɛ, hã amɛdu gbɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibama Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ naa la, ni ebaashã Yerusalɛm mɔji lɛ fɛɛ.” Israel toigbalamɔ Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Tɔ̃mɔi babaoo ni Israelbii etɔ̃ hewɔ lɛ, miŋmɛŋ amɛtoi ni mito akɛ mibagbala lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ jalɔi amɛhe jwiɛtɛi, ni ohiafo lɛ amɛhɔ̃ɔ lɛ tokota jara naa.
Amɛnaanaa ohiafoi ayitsei anɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ mlu mli, ni amɛtsirɛɔ mɛi ni ehao kɛyaa gbɛsɛɛ.
Mɔ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsɛ fɛɛ kɛ oblayoo kome lɛ nɔŋŋ naa bɔlɛ, ni amɛkɛbuleɔ migbɛi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛkãmɔɔ atadei ni akɛbato amɛ awaba anɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ fɛɛ afɔleshãa latɛ naa, ni amɛnuɔ wain ni ahe yɛ mɛi ni abu amɛ fɔ adɛŋ yɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
“Shi kɛ̃lɛ mikpãtã Amorbii ni kwɔlɔ tamɔ tsenedru tsei, ni amɛhe wa hu tamɔ odum lɛ ahiɛ yɛ amɛ, Israelbii, ahiɛ.
Mikpãtã amɛnɔ yibii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mifite amɛshishi fãi lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Mijie nyɛ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpala nyɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛba koni nyɛbaŋɔ Amorbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Mitee nyɛbihii lɛ ekomɛi ashi, ni mifee amɛ gbalɔi, ni mifee nyɛblahii lɛ ekomɛi hu Nazirifoi.
Israelbii, ebɛ mli nakai lo?
Mi Yehowa mikɛɛ.
Shi nyɛhã Nazirifoi lɛ bɔ̃i dãanumɔ, ni amɛkɛku kitã ni amɛkã Nyɔŋmɔ mli, ni nyɛwo gbalɔi lɛ akitã akɛ amɛkagba gbalɛ ni mikɛhã amɛ lɛ.
Naa, mibamia nyɛ makpɛtɛ shi tamɔ shwiili ni ewo ŋmaa tɔtɔɔtɔ miaa nii kpɛtɛɔ shi.
Foijee aaalaaje mɔ ni he yɔɔ oya kɛ foijee, hewalɛ aaaŋmɛɛɛ hewalɔ, ni kãkãlɔ hu nyɛŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala po ehere.
Gãitsɛ̃lɔi nyɛŋ shi amɛdamɔ lɛ, foijelɔ he ejeŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ nɔ hu hereŋ eyiwala.
Nakai gbi lɛ kãkãlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ni tsui esa tete aaajo foi kɛ ehe yayai.” Yehowa ni kɛɛ.
Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni Yehowa wie yɛ nyɛhe lɛ toi, nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jaku muu ni eyajie kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ, “Jeŋ maji fɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, nyɛ pɛ ji maŋ ni mile, ni no hewɔ lɛ, mibawo nyɛ nibii gbohii ni nyɛfee lɛ ahe nyɔmɔ.” Gbalɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ Ani mɛi enyɔ feɔ ekome kɛnyiɛɔ gbɛ kɛji amɛkpãŋko he?
Ani jata hũuɔ yɛ koo mli be mli ni enako kooloo ko ni eeemɔ lo?
Ani jata oblayoo woɔ egbee yɛ ebu mli kɛji emɔko loo ko lo?
Ani loofɔlɔ duɔ tsɔne yɛ shikpɔŋ kɛji atsɔ̃ko lɛ tsɔne yɛ jɛi lo?
Ani tsɔne fɛɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ be mli ni eduko nɔ ko?
Ani tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɔ yɛ maŋ ni maŋbii lɛ hɛleee shi lo?
Ani amane baa maŋ ko nɔ ni jeee Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛ lo?
Eji anɔkwale akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ efeee nɔ ko ni ejieee eyiŋtoo lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔɔ etsuji gbalɔi lɛ.
Kɛji jata miihuu lɛ, namɔ sheee gbeyei?
Kɛji Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ewie lɛ, namɔ baakwa akɛ eshiɛɛɛ gbalɛ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ?
Samaria hiɛkpãtãmɔ Kɛɛmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Ashdod kɛ Ijipt mɔji lɛ amli lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Samaria gɔji lɛ anɔ koni nyɛkwɛa basabasa ni afeɔ kɛ niseniianii ni yaa nɔ yɛ Samaria.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛ yiwalɛ kɛ juu buaa nibii anaa yɛ mɔji lɛ amli.
Amɛleee nɔ ni ja gbɛ feemɔ tete.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Henyɛlɔi aaabɔle shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛaakpe, ni amɛaakumɔ nibii ni akɛfãa shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ amɛshwie shi, ni amɛaaha mɔji lɛ amli nii ofɔ̃ kɛya.’ ” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ shɔ̃ɔ too shuɔji enyɔ loo etoi kuku kɛkɛ po yɛ jata daaŋ lɛ, nakai kɛji eshwɛ saatso tso kuku kɛkɛ loo saashwɛ tete akɛbaahere Israelbii ni yɔɔ Samaria lɛ ayiwala.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, ni nyɛkɛa Yakob shwiei lɛ akɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibagbala Israelbii atoi yɛ amɛtoigbele hewɔ lɛ, mibakpãtã Betel afɔleshãa latɛi lɛ hu ahiɛ.
Abaakumɔ akloŋtoi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛi nɛɛ akoji lɛ ashwie shi.
Shĩa ni ama ato fɛ̃i be kɛ nɔ ni ama ato latsaa be hu mibakpãtã fɛɛ hiɛ shi kome; shĩai ni akɛ shuɔ wu esaa amɛmli fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃; ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu hiɛ baakpãtã,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Nyɛ Samaria yei ni nyɛshwishwii tamɔ Bashan tsinayei ni yɔɔ Samaria gɔji anɔ lɛ, nyɛboa wiemɔ nɛɛ toi.
Te nyɛwaa ohiafoi ayi, ni nyɛshwishwiaa mɛi ni efĩ amɛ shi, ni nyɛkɛɔ nyɛwumɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyataoa nɔ ni wɔɔnu kɛba!” Naa, beiaŋ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ, “Gbii miiba ni akɛ kpoŋ baalalaa nyɛ, ni akpala nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛya.
Nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ loi ni tsɛ̃rɛ kpoji anaa.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baanyiɛ kɛya ehiɛ tɛ̃ɛ, kɛyashɛ fɔji ni egbulɔ yɛ maŋ gbogboi lɛ amli lɛ ahe, ni aaahole nyɛ kɛtsɔ̃ fɔji nɛɛ amli atsirɛ ashwie Harmon,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Israel ekaseee nii “Nyɛ Israelbii, nyɛbaa Betel nyɛbatɔ̃a mla; nyɛyaa Gilgal nyɛyahãa mlanɔtɔ̃mɔ lɛ afaa; nyɛkɛ nyɛfɔlei abaa koni ashã daa leebi; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛnibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ abaa daa gbii etɛ̃.
Nyɛkɛ ma ni esha abashãa shidaa fɔlei lɛ, ni nyɛshiɛa kɛfoa shi akɛ nyɛshãa tsuijurɔ naa afɔlei hu, ejaakɛ nakai feemɔ ji nɔ ni ŋɔɔ nyɛnaa.
Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Mi, mihã hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, ni daaŋtaa bɔ nyɛ yɛ nyɛmaji lɛ amli lɛ; aboloo hɔmɔ ye nyɛ, shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Asaŋ be ni eshwɛ nyɔji etɛ̃ ni akɛkpaa ŋmɔshinii lɛ tete mihãaa nu anɛ nyɛ.
Mihã nu nɛ maŋ kome ko nɔ, shi mihãaa enɛ maŋ ko hu nɔ.
Nu nɛ ŋmɔ ko shi, ni nu enɛɛɛ ŋmɔ ko hu shi, no hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɔ ni enɛɛɛ mli lɛ mli nii ŋala.
Maji enyɔ loo etɛ̃ mli bii didãa kɛ kumai kɛyagbee maŋ ko nɔ koni amɛyatao nu ni amɛnu; shi nu ni amɛyana lɛ eyashɛɛɛ amɛnaa.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Mihã kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ emli dɔlɛ fã, ni eŋala nyɛŋmɔshinii, ni baalabii kpãtã nyɛbɔ̃ɔi kɛ nyɛwain tromi kɛ nyɛgbami tsei kɛ nyɛmu tsei bluublu ahiɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Mihã gbele hela tamɔ Ijipt hela lɛ bote nyɛteŋ, ni mihã nyɛblahii lɛ nyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli, ni ashɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ nyɛkpɔŋɔi yɛ nyɛdɛŋ kɛtee.
Mihã nyɛgbohii ni jwere nyɛnsrai amli lɛ je fu wo nyɛ.
Shi fɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ahiɛ tamɔ mifee Sodom kɛ Gomora lɛ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyi na wala lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ la tso ni afã yɛ la naa; ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkpaleko kɛbako miŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Israelbii, agbɛnɛ mibagbala nyɛ toi.
Ni akɛni mibafee nyɛ nakai hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛkɛkpea nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ toigbalamɔ naa.” Naa, mɔ ni shɔ̃ gɔji lɛ, ni ebɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, ni egbaa gbɔmɔ nɔ ni ji lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eyiŋtoo.
Lɛ mɔ ni ehãa jetsɛremɔ tsɔ̃ɔ duŋ, ni enyiɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hei grɔŋŋi lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ.
Tsuitsakemɔ he ehĩa Israelbii, nyɛboa yaafo lala ni miwoɔ nɔ yɛ nyɛhe nɛɛ toi.
Israel oblayeiaŋ etã, egbee shi, ni eteŋ shi dɔŋŋ.
Akwa lɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ nɔ, ni mɔ ko bɛ ni woɔ enɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Maŋ ni baawo asraafoi akpe gbɛ kɛya ta lɛ, eeeshwɛ asraafoi oha pɛ ahã lɛ, ni maŋ ni woɔ asraafoi oha gbɛ lɛ, eeeshwɛ emɛi nyɔŋma pɛ ni aaaku amɛsɛɛ aba Israel we lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ Israelbii ji akɛ, “Nyɛtaoa mi misɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi aaana wala, shi nyɛkataoa Betel sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛkayaa Gilgal hu, aloo nyɛmitse mli kɛmiiya Beersheba; ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ Gilgalbii nom, ni Betel hiɛ baakpãtã.” Nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ, ni nyɛyi baana wala.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ Yehowa aaaba tamɔ la ni eje yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, ni eeeshã nii.
La nɛɛ baakpãtã Betel hiɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni aaanyɛ agbe ahã Betel.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni jalɛ saneyeli joɔ hãa nyɛ tamɔ taatso, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkɛ jalɛ saneyeli shwishwia shikpɔŋ!
Naa, mɔ ni bɔ ŋulamii, “Wuɔ kɛ ebii kɛ Oŋwɛ” mɔ ni hãa duŋ kpii tsɔ̃ɔ jetsɛremɔ, ni ehãa shwane woɔ duŋ ni etsɔ̃ɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ.
Lɛ mɔ ni efãa ŋshɔ mli nu, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, Yehowa ji egbɛi.
Ehãa hewalɔ hiɛ kpãtãa kɛkɛ lɛ mɔɔ ni wa lɛ hu hiɛ ekpãtã.
Amɛnyɛɔ mɔ ni kãa mɔ hiɛ yɛ koishi, ni mɔ ni wieɔ anɔkwale lɛ, amɛhiɔ ehiɛ.
Akɛni nyɛnaanaa ohiafo nɔ, ni nyɛtsuɔ lɛ abele onia fe bɔ ni sa hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ tɛ ni ako emamɔ shĩai; shi moŋ nyɛhiŋ amɛmli; ni nyɛfeefee wain tromi fɛɛfɛji moŋ, shi nyɛnuŋ amɛmli wain.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmlanɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fa, ni mile eshai ni nyɛfeefee anaawalɛ.
Nyɛgbaa jalɔ naa, ni nyɛheɔ nyɔŋnii, ni nyɛŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ koni ohiafo kɛ esane ashɛ koishi koni aye ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni le nii lɛ, efeɔ diŋŋ nɛkɛ be mli, ejaakɛ be lɛ be fɔŋ ni.
- Nyɛtaoa nɔ kpakpa, shi jeee nɔ fɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛyi ana wala, kɛkɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kpakpa; ni nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ koishi akɛ aleee nɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaadro Yosef shwiei ni eshwɛ lɛ lo!
-No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, kɛɔ ji akɛ, “Abaawo yara yɛ blohui fɛɛ amli, ni aaabolɔ, ‘Ao, ao!’ Kɛnyiɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Abaatsɛ okwaafoi koni amɛbaye ŋkɔmɔ, ni abaatsɛ mɛi ni le yara nɔ yaafo jogbaŋŋ hu koni amɛbafo.
Abaawo yara yɛ wain trom fɛɛ wain trom mli ejaakɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛteŋ kɛho kɛgbala nyɛ toi,” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛshweɔ Yehowa gbi lɛ.
Mɛni nyɛbaana yɛ Yehowa gbi lɛ nɔ?
Naa, duŋ gbi ni, shi jeee la gbi ni: nɔ ni baaba lɛ etamɔ mɔ ko ni joɔ jata naa foi, ni ekɛ oshishibrishi kpeɔ, loo be ni eba shĩa ni ekɛ enine mɔ gbogbo mli lɛ onufu kɔ̃ lɛ.
Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ duŋ aaawo, ni hulu etsoŋ; nakai gbi lɛ duŋ kpii aaawo bɔ ni la bɛ he ko he ko.
Miihi nyɛgbii juji lɛ; amɛjeee nɔ ko kɛhã mi; ni nyɛhe naa ni nyɛbuaa kɛjaa mi lɛ tete, mibɛ he miishɛɛ.
Nyɛshãa shãa afɔlei kɛ nyɛniyenii afɔlei tete nyɛhãa mi nɛ, shi miheee.
Shidaa afɔlei ni nyɛkɛ nyɛkooloi ni eshwishwii shãa lɛ hu, mikwɛɛɛ po.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛlalai lɛ ajea minɔ; mitaooo nyɛsaŋkui lɛ agbɛɛmɔ hu toi mabo.
Nyɛyea jalɛ sane moŋ koni etsɔ̃ tamɔ nu ni hoɔ; nyɛhãa jalɛ ahea shi, ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ faa ni hoɔ daa.
“Israelbii, mɛɛ kooloi afɔlei kɛ niyenii afɔlei nyɛshã nyɛhã mi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
Nyɛbaawo nyɛmãgãi ni nyɛfee nyɛhã nyɛhe ni ji nyɛmaŋtsɛ Sakut kɛ Kaiwan hu nyɛtere; ni mahã aŋɔ nyɛ nom kɛya Damasko sɛɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni gbɛi ji Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ.
Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ Kpoo hã mɛi ni ahe ejɔ amɛ yɛ Zion, kɛ mɛi ni nyɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛyɛ shweshweeshwe yɛ Samaria Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, mɛi ni ji lumɛi wuji yɛ maŋ wulu, Israel mli lɛ, mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Israelbii lɛ baa lɛ.
Nyɛhoa kɛyaa Kalne maŋ lɛ mli nyɛyakwɛa jɛi; ni nyɛjɛa jɛi nyɛyaa Hamat maŋ wulu lɛ mli; nyɛtsaa nɔ kɛkpelekea shi kɛyaa Filistibii amaŋ ni ji Gat lɛ mli hu.
Ani amɛhi fe maŋtsɛyelihei nɛɛ lo; aloo amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ da fe nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsiɔ gbi fɔŋ lɛ kɛyaa sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nakai feemɔ moŋ hãa gbi fɔŋ lɛ bɛŋkɛɔ nyɛ lɛ?
Kpoo hã mɛi ni kãmɔɔ shuɔ wu saatsei anɔ amɛwɔɔ, ni amɛkpãa amɛmli yɛ saatsei bibii anɔ, ni amɛyeɔ too ku lɛ mli gwantɛŋbii kɛ tsina tsui amli tsinabii lɛ.
Mɛi ni kɛ saŋku laa yakayaka lalai, ni amɛsɔ̃ɔ saŋkui tamɔ David nɔ lɛ amɛhãa amɛhe.
Mɛi ni kɛ kpuji wuji nuɔ wain, ni mu ni hi fe fɛɛ amɛkpaa, shi Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ edɔɔɔ amɛ kwraa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ tsutsu aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee, ni no baahã ahoshwibɔlɔi lɛ ahoofeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ afo.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihi Israelbii ahewoo lɛ; ni miinyaŋe amɛmɔji fɛɛfɛji lɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ kɛ emli nii lɛ fɛɛ mahã.” Aaaba mli akɛ kɛji shwɛ shĩa kome mli hii nyɔŋma kɛkɛ po lɛ, amɛbaagboi kɛ̃.
Ni kɛji mɛi ni egbo lɛ eko wekunyo, mɔ ni fuɔ lɛ, baaba koni ebawo gbonyo lɛ kɛje shĩa lɛ, wekunyo nɛɛ baabi mɔ ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani eshwɛ mɔ ko lolo hɔ shĩa lɛ mli fata ohe lo?” Mɔ lɛ aaahere nɔ akɛ, “Dabida!” Gbonyo lɛ wekunyo lɛ baakɛɛ akɛ, “Feemɔ diŋŋ.
Wɔkwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni wɔkatsi Yehowa gbɛi tã.” Ejaakɛ Yehowa efã ni shĩa wulu fɛɛ shĩa wulu baawule butuu, ni shĩa bibioo hu baajwa.
Ani okpɔŋɔ joɔ foi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, aloo akɛ tsinahii huɔ yɛ ŋshɔ mli?
Shi nyɛhã jalɛ etsɔ̃ ebɔɔ, ni jalɛ yibii etsɔ̃ taatso.
Nyɛnyaa yɛ Lo-Debar maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Ani jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ mli wɔjɛ ni wɔshɔ̃ Karnaim maŋ lɛ?” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Israelbii, naa, mibatee maŋ ko shi mawo nyɛ koni amɛbaŋɔ nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ.
Maŋ nɛɛ baahao nyɛ kɛjɛ Lebo-Hamat yɛ kooyigbɛ, aahu kɛyashi ŋa kplenee ni atsɛɔ lɛ Araba Nujɔɔ lɛ naa yɛ wuoyigbɛ.”
Balabii ahe ninaa Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ.
Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ baalabii ku ko.
Be nɛɛ mli lɛ afɛ̃ maŋtsɛ jwɛi momo, ni jwɛi lɛ eje shishi eefu kɛmiiba ekoŋŋ.
Be ni baalabii lɛ eye shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛfɔ lɛ amɛgbe naa lɛ, mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa Ofe, ofainɛ, okɛ Israelbii ahe ake amɛ.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛyi aaana wala hu?
Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.” Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ona nɛɛ baŋ mli.” La he ninaa Nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jie etsɔ̃ɔ mi nɛ.
Mina akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miitao akɛ ekɛ la agbala ewebii lɛ atoi.
La lɛ ŋala nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ, kɛkɛ ni la lɛ bɔ̃i shikpɔŋ lɛ hu shãa.
Kɛkɛ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Ao!
Yehowa, ofainɛ, foo sɛɛ.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Israelbii, owebii lɛ, ayi aaana wala hu?
Ejaakɛ amɛhe waaa.” Yehowa tsake eyiŋtoo, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hu baŋ mli.” Plomo he ninaa Yehowa jie ninaa nɛɛ hu etsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Mina Yehowa ni edamɔ gbogbo ni akɛ plomo susu ni atswa he; ni ehiɛ plomo yɛ edɛŋ.
Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mito he akɛ, “Plomo.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ plomo nɛɛ miisusu mimaŋ Israelbii ajalɛ.
Mihaŋ amɛye amɛhe dɔŋŋ.
Hei ni Isak shwie lɛ jaa yɛ lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃, ni hei ni Israelbii jaa yɛ lɛ hu baafee koikoi; ni mibafã ta mawo Yeroboam we lɛ.” Amos kɛ Osɔfo Amazia Kɛkɛ ni Amazia, Betel osɔfo lɛ, tsu kɛtee Yeroboam, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, ŋɔɔ akɛ, “Amos etee oyinɔ apam yɛ Israelbii lɛ ateŋ.
Ewiemɔi lɛ baafite maŋ lɛ.” Nɔ ni Amos kɛɛ ji, “Yeroboam baanyɔ yɛ ta mli, ni nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ Israelbii kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.” Osɔfo Amazia kɛɛ Amos akɛ, “Gbalɔ, jee biɛ ni oya Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni oyaye nii yɛ jɛi koni ogba yɛ jɛi.
Kaakã he oogba yɛ Betel nɛɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ biɛ ji he ni maŋtsɛ lɛ jaa yɛ, ni biɛ nɔŋŋ ji he ni maŋtsɛyelihe nɛɛ Sɔlemɔ we wulu ni fe fɛɛ lɛ hu yɔɔ.” Amos here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ Osɔfo Amazia akɛ, “Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, ni asaŋ jeee gbalɔ bi hu ji mi.
Shi moŋ koolookwɛlɔ ji mi, ni misaa sikamore tsei ahe hu; ni kooloo mikpalaa ni Yehowa tsɛ mi; ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa, ni oyagba otsɔ̃ɔ Israelbii lɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, bo nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi ejaakɛ okɛɛ mikagba mishi Israel lɛ, ni mikashiɛ mishi Isak we lɛ.
Amazia, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Oŋa baatsɔ̃ ajwamãŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, ni obihii kɛ obiyei lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta naa; abaaŋɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ, ni abaaja ahã mɛi kpɔji.
Bo diɛŋtsɛ lɛ maŋsɛɛ obaaya oyagbo yɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ ni ajaaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ; ni Israelbii lɛ nom kɛ̃ aaaŋɔ amɛ kɛaaje amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ kɛaatee.’ ”
Kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii he ninaa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jie ninaa nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi, Mina kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bi mi akɛ, “Amos, mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ kɛ emli tsei ayibii ni etsu.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mimaŋ Israelbii akpulu eyi agbɛnɛ; mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ dɔŋŋ; mibagbala amɛtoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ, lalai ni amɛlaa yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli lɛ baatsɔ̃ yara ni awo.
Gbɔmɛi babaoo baaplene, ni abaashɛrɛ gbohii ashwie hei fɛɛ nigii, shi mɛi baafee diŋŋ kɛkwɛ.” Israel hiɛkpãtãmɔ Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnaanaa mɛi ni efi amɛ lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛkpãtãa ohiafoi ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɛɛbe po nyɔŋ hee lɛ aaanyɔ shi koni wɔbɔ̃i ŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ?
Ni mɛɛbe po abaagbe hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yeli naa koni wɔbɔ̃i wɔŋmaa hɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ susumɔnɔ ni shɛɛɛ, asaŋ kɛ nsɛnitɛ ni atse nɔ?
Wɔkɛ jwiɛtɛi aaahe ohiafo nyɔmɔtsɛ, ni wɔkɛ tokota aaahe mɔ ni efi lɛ, ni ŋmaa shishi tutuu tete wɔɔhɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ jarawalɛ.” Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ekã kitã akɛ; “Anɔkwa, mihiɛ kpaŋ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ eko nɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ni no hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ baahoso, ni enɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ baaye awerɛhoo.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baafee hamahama tamɔ bɔ ni Nilo Faa lɛ yiɔ, ni ekuɔ, ni asaŋ ekpɔŋɔ lɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibahã hulu anyɔ shi shwane koni duŋ awo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ shwane fintiŋŋ.
Mahã gbii juji ni nyɛyeɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ yarafeemɔ, ni lalai kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni nyɛlaa lɛ baatsɔ̃ yaafo.
Nyɛbaabumɔ kpekpe, ni nyɛaashɛshɛɛ nyɛyi, ni nyɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ fɔlɔi ni miiye amɛbi koome ni egbo he awerɛho.
Nakai gbi lɛ naagbee mli baajoo pam.
“Naa, gbii miiba, ni mahã hɔ̃mɔ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Jeee daaŋŋmãa hɔ̃mɔ mɛi baaye lɛ, ni jeee nu hɔ̃mɔ hu, shi moŋ abaaye Yehowa wiemɔi lɛ he kumai.
Mɛi baafo shi kɛjɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛya ŋshɔnaa, ni amɛaajɛ kooyigbɛ kɛya bokãgbɛ ni amɛmiitao Yehowa naa wiemɔ lɛ, shi amɛnaŋ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, oblayei hefɛotsɛmɛi kɛ oblahii fɛɛ baatɔtɔɔ biti kɛ kumai, ni mɛi ni kɛ Samaria jemawɔji lɛ kãa kitã amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mina Dan jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ loo ‘Mina Beersheba jemawɔŋ lɛ,’ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi.”
Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbala toi ehã Mina Yehowa damɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he.
Ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛ nii atswia Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ akulashiŋi lɛ ayiteiaŋ kpɔbii lɛ waa koni kpokui lɛ ahoso, ni ewule eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni ahe baaje mli lɛ mibagbe amɛ yɛ ta mli.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko ejoŋ minaa foi lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko hu he ejeŋ mli.
Kɛji amɛtsa shi kɛtee gbohiiaje tete lɛ, minine baashɛ amɛnɔ yɛ jɛi; ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi hu, mibamɔmɔ amɛ kɛkpeleke shi kɛjɛ jɛi.
Kɛji amɛyatee amɛhe yɛ Karmel Gɔŋ lɛ yiteŋ tete lɛ, mibatao amɛ, ni mibamɔmɔ amɛ; ni kɛ amɛtee ŋshɔ shishi amɛyatee mi yɛ jɛi hu, mibafã ŋshɔŋ onufu gbeyeigbeyei lɛ, ni ebaakɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛhenyɛlɔi baŋɔ amɛ nom tete lɛ, mibafã, ni henyɛlɔi lɛ baafã klante yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛaagbe amɛ.
Mijie mihiɛ mika amɛ koni makpãtã amɛhiɛ; ejurɔ ko bɛ ni mibafee amɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ́ enine sa je lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ miihoso, ni emli gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeɔ awerɛhoo, mɔ ni hãa je lɛ yiɔ ni ekpɔ̃ŋɔ tamɔ Nilo Faa lɛ, mɔ ni ŋwɛiniiaŋ ji he ni epiai yɔɔ, ni ekɛ ŋwɛi ebu shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛɔ ŋshɔŋ nu lɛ kɛyaa ŋwɛi, ni efɔseɔ eshwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Egbɛi ji Yehowa!
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Israelbii, mijwɛŋɔ nyɛhe tamɔ mijwɛŋɔ Etiopiabii ahe lɛ.
Bɔ ni mijie Israelbii kɛje Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai mijie Filistibii lɛ kɛjɛ Kreta kɛ Siriabii lɛ hu kɛjɛ Kir.
Naa, mi, Yehowa Ofe, mijie mihiɛ mika Israel, maŋ ni feɔ esha lɛ, ni mibakpãtã ehiɛ kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi moŋ mikpãtãŋ Yakob shwiei lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ kwrakwra, Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Naa, mibafã, ni mibasha Israelbii lɛ amli yɛ je lɛ mli maji lɛ ateŋ tamɔ akɛ shaanii shaa ŋmaa mli lɛ, ni ŋmaa kuli nɛkɛ egbeŋ shi.
Mimaŋbii lɛ ateŋ gbɔmɛi eshafeelɔi ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ haŋ nɔ fɔŋ ko anina wɔ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaanyɔnyɔi yɛ ta mli.’ ” Abaasaa Israel wɔsɛɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Be ko miiba, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibatee David maŋtsɛyeli ni egbee shi lɛ shi mama shi ekoŋŋ.
Mibatsimɔ fɔji ni eba maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni masaa matswa lɛ mama shi tamɔ eyɔɔ blema lɛ.
Ni Israelbii lɛ baaku amɛsɛɛ amɛbashɔ̃ Edom shikpɔŋ ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ shikpɔji krokomɛi fɛɛ ni tsutsu ko lɛ migbɛi kã amɛnɔ lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa, mɔ ni baatsu nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ekɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, gbii miiba,” Yehowa kɛɛ “ni nidulɔi kɛ nidumɔ baanina nikpalɔ ni ekpako nii egbeko naa; ni wain yibii baawo babaoo bɔ ni wainŋalɔ nyɛŋ fɛɛ eŋa, ni wain baatsere kɛbaajɛ gɔji lɛ amli, ni eeeho yɛ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ anɔ tamɔ faa.
Mibakpale mimaŋ Israelbii lɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba koni amɛbasaa amɛmaji ni efee koikoi lɛ ni amɛhi mli ekoŋŋ; amɛaafee wain tromi ni amɛaanu amɛmli wain; ni amɛaahu abɔi ni amɛaaye abɔi lɛ amli nii.
Mibadu amɛ yɛ amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni anyɛŋ amɛ afã yɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.” Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ena ekɛɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Aleee be pɔtɛɛ mli ni aŋma wolo kukuoo nɛɛ; ekolɛ aŋma be ni abutu Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ yɛ afi ni ji Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli lɛ sɛɛ.
Yuda akutso lɛ teteete henyɛlɔi ni ji Edombii, ni amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ kã Yudabii awuoyi-bokãgbɛ lɛ, nyaaa akɛ ana aye Yerusalɛm nɔ, ni abutu maŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ be ni ta lɛ ba lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyawa Yuda henyɛlɔi ni batua Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Edombii lɛ tsɔ̃ tuamɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛha Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli nii kɛtee amɛmaŋ.
Gbalɔ Obadia gba akɛ be miiba ni abaaye Edombii nɛɛ kɛ Israel henyɛlɔi krokomɛi fɛɛ anɔ kunim kɛgbala amɛtoi.
Mlijaramɔi Edom toigbalamɔ lɛ - Yehowa Gbi lɛ -
Gbalɔ Obadia gbalɛ lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yehowa kɛhã lɛ yɛ Edom shikpɔŋ lɛ he lɛ nɛ.
Yehowa baagbala Edom toi Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo kɛtee majimaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni wɔnu wiemɔ ni ekɛtee lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtea shi!
Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔ kɛ Edom ayawua ta!” Yehowa kɛɛ Edom akɛ, “Naa, mibaba ohewalɛ shi yɛ majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ebuŋ bo kwraa.
Ohenɔwomɔ lɛ elaka bo.
Omaŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ yɛ tɛsaa nɔ, ni oshihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gɔŋ grɔŋŋ nɔ; ni no hewɔ ni okɛɔ ohe akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaanyɛ mi shi aba?’ Kɛji oyato oshihilɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ tamɔ okropɔŋ tsu, ni shihilɛhe lɛ hɔ ŋulamii ateŋ tete, kɛ̃lɛ majie bo yɛ jɛi kɛyi shi.
“Kɛji julɔi ba bo juu nyɔɔŋ, loo ojotswalɔi bashwie onɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, te amɛaakpãtã onii ahiɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani julɔi lɛ ejuŋ onii bɔ pɛ ni aaashɛ amɛnaa?
Kɛji wainyibii kpalɔi ni ba lɛ, ani amɛshiŋ yibii lɛ kpɛkpɛbii lo?
Shi naa, bo lɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ ekpãtã ohiɛ butuu.
Esau shwiei, kwɛ bɔ ni aha nyɛ, kwɛ bɔ ni afãmɔ nyɛjwetrii ni akɛtee lɛ.
Nyɛhefatalɔi lɛ elaka nyɛ; amɛshwie nyɛ kɛtee husu lɛ nɔ tɔ̃ɔ; mɛi ni kɛ nyɛ yɔɔ gbee jurɔ lɛ hu eye nyɛnɔ kunim.
Nanemɛi ni nyɛkɛye nii lɛ tsɔ̃ nyɛ tsɔne; nɔ ko ni anuuu shishi.
Ni Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ magbala Edom toi, mibakpãtã enilelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛnilee hiɛ akpãtã.
Ŋmiŋmi baamɔmɔ Teman hii kãkãlɔi lɛ, ni Edom tabilɔi fɛɛ baanyɔnyɔi.” Edom toigbalamɔ lɛ shishi “Efɔŋ ni nyɛfee nyɛnyɛmimɛi ni ji Yakob shwiei lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ohe baafee hiɛgbele, ni aaakpãtã ohiɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Odamɔ shi yɛ afã banee, gbi ni gbɔi baloo ejwetri kɛtee lɛ.
Odamɔ afã ni gbɔi bote maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki kɛja emlinii amɛhã amɛhe lɛ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ bo hu oyi awa tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ.
Oyeɔ onyɛmimɛi Yudabii lɛ ayɔɔ yɛ amanehulu ni banina amɛ lɛ hewɔ; ni ebɛ akɛ ooonya yɛ amɛhiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oshwãa yɛ haomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ oboteɔ miwebii lɛ amaŋ lɛ mli, yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ebɛ akɛ oyeɔ amɛ yɔɔ yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ; ni esaaa akɛ oyahaa amɛnii yɛ amɛmanehulu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Kulɛ esaaa akɛ nyɛdamɔɔ gbɛnta ni nyɛgbegbeɔ mɛi ni joɔ foi lɛ; ni esaaa akɛ nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi hiɛkãalɔi lɛ hãa henyɛlɔi lɛ yɛ hejaramɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.” Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo maji lɛ “Ejaakɛ be lɛ eshɛ etã, be ni, mi, Yehowa mibakojo majimaji lɛ.
Bɔ ni ofee lɛ, nakai aaafee bo, Esau.
Onifeemɔnii lɛ baaku sɛɛ abawula oyiteŋ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni nyɛnunuu dãi yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai majimaji ni bɔle nyɛ lɛ aaamiimii dãa, ni amɛaadidãa, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni ebablako dã.” Israel baaye kunim “Shi mɛi ni aaaje mli lɛ, aaayato maŋ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eeetsɔ̃ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni Yakob shwiei lɛ anine aaashɛ amɛgbɛfaŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yakob shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là, ni Yosef shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ là lilɛi, ni Esau shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ gbetselii, ni aaashã amɛ ni aaakpãtã amɛhiɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ mɔ ko yɛ Esau we lɛ.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
“Yuda wuoyigbɛbii lɛ aaabashɔ̃ Edom Gɔŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ; ni mɛi ni yɔɔ anaigbɛ gɔji lɛ ashishi lɛ baashɔ̃ Filistibii ashikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛbaaŋɔ Efraim shikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛ Samaria hu; ni Benyamin baaŋɔ Gilead.
Israelbii ni aŋɔ amɛ nom lɛ baaŋɔ Kanaanbii ashikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛjɛ Foinikia kɛyashi Zarefat; ni nomii ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ni akɛ amɛ etee Sarde lɛ baaŋɔ wuoyigbɛ maji lɛ.
Tabilɔi kunimyelɔi aaajɛ Yerusalɛm ayatua Edom, ni amɛaaye enɔ; ni Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaaye Maŋtsɛ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Esoro Yona wolo lɛ yɛ gbalɛ woji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ wolo lɛ gbaa nibii amli ni Yona, Gbalɔ ni ka akɛ egbo Nyɔŋmɔ fãmɔ nɔ toi lɛ, tsɔ̃mɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eya Nineve, ni ji Asiria, ni eji Israel henyɛlɔ ni ekɛfuuu kwraa lɛ, maŋ wulu lɛ mli.
Shi Yona sumɔɔɔ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yaa jɛi, ejaakɛ eyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kpãtaŋ Nineve maŋ wulu lɛ hiɛ.
Yona shashao shi be saŋŋ, kɛ̃lɛ eye tsumɔ lɛ nɔ, ni etee Nineve.
Naagbee mli lɛ Yona werɛ ho ehe be ni ena akɛ hiɛkpãtamɔ ni eyashiɛ akɛ ebaaba Nineve lɛ baaa mli.
Wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji Ofe yɛ adebɔɔ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi nɔ ni fe fɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛtsɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni ekɛ tɔ̃mɔ faa, ni ehereɔ emaŋbii ahenyɛlɔi ayiwala fe nɔ ni eeegbala amɛtoi kɛkpãtã amɛhiɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Yona tsɛmɔ kɛ etoigbele .- Yona tsui tsakemɔ kɛ ekpɔmɔ .- Yona gbalɛ ni egba eshi Nineve lɛ .- Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ na Nineve mɔbɔ .-
Yona gbo Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ toi Gbi ko lɛ Yehowa kɛ Yona, Amitai bi lɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli koni oyashiɛ oshi maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni emli bii lɛ feɔ lɛ miina fɛɛ.” Shi be ni Yona yi mli lɛ, ewo ehiɛ ema Tarshish gbɛ moŋ.
Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ eejo Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa foi.
Etee Yopa; eyana lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Tarshish.
No hewɔ lɛ, ewo lɛlɛ lɛ mlitamɔ he nyɔmɔ, kɛkɛ ni ebote mli koni ekɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli bii lɛ aya Tarshish, koni ejo foi yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Shi Yehowa hã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni naa wa jogbaŋŋ tswa yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ahum fã waa, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni lɛlɛ lɛ baajwa.
Amlakui lɛ she gbeyei, kɛkɛ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bolɔ etsɛ nɔ ni ejaa akɛ ebahere amɛ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ jie lɛlɛ lɛ mli jatsu lɛ amɛwo ŋshɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni lɛlɛ lɛ afee huyɛhuyɛ ahã amɛ.
Nɛkɛ be mli lɛ Yona etee lɛlɛ lɛ shishigbɛ eyakã shi, ni lɛ lɛ, ewɔ vii diɛŋtsɛ.
Lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ yana Yona yɛ eshikamɔhe lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, bo lɛ wɔɔ owɔɔ lo?
Tee shi ni osɔle otsɛ nɔ ni ojaa akɛ aleenɔ emusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔhe koni ebahere wɔ koni wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo.” Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ amlakui lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a oshiki kɛtao mɔ koome hewɔ ni nɛkɛ sane fɔŋ nɛɛ eba wɔnɔ nɛɛ.” Amɛfɔ̃ oshiki lɛ; ni oshiki lɛ gbee Yona nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ gbaa wɔ.
Te bo ohewɔ jɛ ni osharã nɛɛ fɛɛ ebasharã wɔ nɛɛ?
Mɛni otsuɔ?
Nɛgbɛ ojɛ yɛ biɛ nɛɛ?
Mɛɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ojɛ, ni mɛɛ maŋ nɔ fɔmɔbi ji bo?” Yona jie naa akɛ, “Hebrinyo ji mi; ni Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi ni lɛ ebɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ fɛɛ lɛ mijaa.” Be ni Yona egba amɛ akɛ eejo foi yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ naa lɛ, amlakui lɛ she gbeyei jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni ofee nɛɛ?” Nakai be mli fɛɛ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ miiya nɔ eefee hamahama sɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Mɛni kɛ̃ wɔfee bo, ni eeeha ŋshɔ lɛ aŋmɛ ahã wɔ?” Yona hã hetoo akɛ, “Nyɛwoa mi, ni nyɛshɛa mi nyɛfɔa ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni ŋshɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ ahã nyɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ mi mihewɔ ni nɛkɛ ahum kpeteŋkple nɛɛ tswaa nyɛ nɛɛ.” Amlakui lɛ mia amɛhiɛ amɛwiri kɛ amɛnyɛmɔ fɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ ejaakɛ ŋshɔ lɛ tee nɔ efee hamahama ekpee amɛ.
Enɛ hã amlakui lɛ sɔle amɛtsɛ Yehowa, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, wɔmiikpa bo fai, kaahã wɔhiɛ miikpãtã yɛ nuu nɛɛ wala hewɔ.
Ela yi sɔ̃ akatere wɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa, wɔle akɛ bo lɛ, ofeɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni amlakui lɛ wo Yona, ni amɛshɛ lɛ amɛfɔ̃ ŋshɔ lɛ mli; kɛkɛ ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ.
Amlakui lɛ she Yehowa gbeyei bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ehã amɛshã afɔle amɛhã Yehowa, asaŋ mɛi wowoo shii srɔtoi hu.
Yɛ Yehowa fãmɔ naa lɛ, ŋshɔŋloo kpeteŋkple ko mi Yona, ni Yona hi loo nɛɛ musuŋ shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃.
Yona sɔlemɔ lɛ Yona yɛ ŋshɔŋloo lɛ musuŋ, kɛkɛ ni esɔle ekpa Yehowa eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ fai, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mifimɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mibolɔ mitsɛ Yehowa, ni ehere mi nɔ; mibolɔ kɛjɛ gbohiiaje musuŋ tɔ̃ɔ, ni Yehowa, obo migbee toi.
Oshɛ mi ofɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtee ŋshɔ shishi tɔ̃ɔ, ni nu babaoo bɔle mihe kɛkpe; ni oshɔkei kɛ omlɛ̃mɛ̃i lɛ kumɔ shwie minɔ.
Misusu akɛ ashwie mi kɛje ohiɛ, ni te mafee tɛŋŋ mana oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?
Nu lɛ su mi, ni mitsui bɔ̃i suu; ŋshɔ lɛ su mi emuu, ni wosuma bla miyitso fɛɛ.
Mikpeleke shi kɛtee gɔji ashishitoo hei diɛŋtsɛ po, shikpɔŋ ni enaa agboi lɛ sa miyi kɛmiiya naanɔ lɛ.
Shi Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ, ohere miyiwala kɛjɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Be ni misusuma tɔ biti yɛ mimli lɛ, mikai Yehowa, ni misɔle, ni onu misɔlemɔ lɛ yɛ oSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mɛi ni jaa yaka amãgãi lɛ, amɛyeee bo anɔkwa.
Shi mi lɛ, mala makafo bo, ni mashã afɔle mahã bo; shi ni miwo lɛ, maye nɔ.
Yiwalaheremɔ lɛ, Yehowa dɛŋ ejɛɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa fã ŋshɔŋ loo lɛ, ni eyashwe Yona eŋmɛ shikpɔŋ.
Yona ye Nyɔŋmɔ fãmɔ nɔ Yehowa kɛ Yona wie ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya Nineve maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli, koni okɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛhã bo lɛ ayahã amɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yona te shi, ni eyiŋ etee Nineve yɛ Yehowa wiemɔ lɛ naa.
Nineve lɛ, maŋ kpeteŋkple jogbaŋŋ ni, ejaakɛ ayeɔ gbii etɛ̃ dani anyiɛɔ kɛjɛɔ maŋ lɛ krotia kome kɛyashɛɔ ekrotia kroko.
Yona je shishi koni etsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli kɛho.
Be ni enyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ lɛ, ewo eshiɛmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, biɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, abaabutu Nineve.” Ninevebii lɛ he Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye; ni no hewɔ lɛ, amɛfã akɛ, kɛjɛ mɔ wulu nɔ aahu kɛyashi mɔ bibioo nɔ lɛ, ahi ŋmaa, ni abu kpekpe kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛhe sɛɛ.
Be ni Nineve maŋtsɛ lɛ nu wiemɔ lɛ, ete shi yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni ejie etade fɛɛfɛo ni ewo lɛ yɛ ehe efɔ̃ shi, ni ekɔ kpekpe ebu, ni eho eta lamlu mli.
Ewo akpɔ, ni ehã ashiɛ yɛ Nineve maŋ lɛ mli akɛ, “Maŋtsɛ kɛ enukpai lɛ miiwo akpɔ akɛ, ‘Gbɔmɔ jio, kooloo jio, tsina kɛ too hu, amɛteŋ ekoeko akasa enaa nɔ ko; akaye nɔ ko nɔ ko lɛ, akanu nu hu; shi moŋ gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo fɛɛ abu kpekpe, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asɔle kɛ hiɛdɔɔ atsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ; asaŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsake ejeŋba gbonyo lɛ, ni akpa yitsoŋwalɛ sane ni akɛyeɔ mɛi lɛ, akɛ aleenɔ Yehowa hu aaatsake eyiŋ ni eto lɛ, ni eeeŋmɛɛ emli ni efu waa lɛ he, ni no aaahã wɔhiɛ akakpãtã lo!’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ na nɔ ni Ninevebii lɛ fee lɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛjeŋba fɔŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ efɔŋ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaafee amɛ lɛ he, ni egbalaaa amɛtoi.
Yona mli fu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ena mɔbɔ Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ fee yɛ Ninevebii ahe lɛ eŋɔɔɔ Yona naa kwraa, ni efee lɛ mlifu tete.
No hewɔ lɛ, esɔle, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, ani jeee nɔ ni mikɛɛ be mli ni miyɔɔ mimaŋ lɛ eba mli nɛɛ?
Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni mijɛ mra mijo foi kɛmiiya Tarshish lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ bo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ durolɔ kɛ musuŋtsɔlɔ ji bo; omli fuuu mra, ni omɔbɔnalɛ fa, ni otsakeɔ oyiŋtoo yɛ toigbalamɔ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, Yehowa, foo miwala nɔ ohã mi, ejaakɛ faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ.” Yehowa bi Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?” Sane nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yona shi Nineve maŋ lɛ mli.
Etee ni eyafee asese fioo ko yɛ maŋ lɛ bokãgbɛ, ni eho eta eshishi hɔ̃ɔŋ lɛ mli koni emɛ kɛyashi eeena nɔ ni baaba maŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yehowa hã adedeŋkruma ko kwɛ̃, ni eha Yona yiteŋ koni ehã lɛ hɔɔŋ koni efo ehehiamɔ lɛ sɛɛ ehã lɛ.
Yona na adedeŋkruma lɛ he miishɛɛ naakpa.
Shi gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã gɔgɔmi baye adedeŋkruma lɛ, ni egbe lɛ.
Ni be ni hulu te shi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hã bokã kɔɔyɔɔ ko ni mli edɔ batswa, ni Yona tɔ biti yɛ hulu ni shã epampam lɛ naawalɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yona shwe gbele, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ fe nɔ ni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ.” Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Kolɛ omli ni ewo la yɛ adedeŋkruma lɛ he nɛɛ lɛ, eja bɛɛ?” Yona here nɔ akɛ, “Eja gbɛ akɛ mimli awo la bɔ sɔŋŋ po ni kɛji gbele tete lɛ magbo.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ Yona akɛ, “Adedeŋkruma lɛ ni gbi kome nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ ni ekwɛ̃, asaŋ ni nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ kɛ jetsɛremɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ ehiɛ ekpãtã, tso ni ogboko ehe deŋme ko, ni jeee bo hu ohã ekwɛ̃ lɛ, esane miidɔ bo.
Mɛɛba esaaa akɛ mi lɛ Nineve sane adɔ mi, maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛkɛ kɛ emli gbɔmɛi fe akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ ni efeko efɔŋ ko kɛ emli toi kɛ tsinai babaoo hu lɛ?”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Mika ni kɛ Yesaia fɛɛ hi shi yɛ be kome mli lɛ, ejɛ Yuda maji lɛ eko mli.
Mika na krɛdɛɛ akɛ amanehulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei ni Amos gba akɛ ebaaba kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ eko miiba ŋshɔŋgbɛ shikpɔŋ ni ji Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ nɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ.
Srɔto pɛ ni yɔɔ Amos kɛ Mika gbalɛi lɛ mli ji akɛ, Mika gbalɛ lɛ yɛ faŋŋ fe Amos nɔ lɛ, ni okadii titrii komɛi hu yɛ Mika nɔ lɛ mli ni hãa anaa hiɛnɔkãmɔ akɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ nibii baahi.
Wolo lɛ mli saji ni esa akɛ akadi ato lɛ ateŋ eko ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔsɛɛ kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ je lɛ mli lɛ, hejɔlɛ baaba je lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ ; eko hu ji gbalɛ ni agba akɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ko baajɛ David weku lɛ mli aba, ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ; ekroko hu ji wiemɔ ni wɔnaa yɛ wolo lɛ yitso kuku lɛ mli lɛ.
Nibii pii ni Israel gbalɔi lɛ ewie lɛ, yitso kuku nɛɛ foɔ fɛɛ kuku akɛ, “Nɔ ni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ ji akɛ wɔfee nɔ ni ja, wɔmli ahi ahã wɔnyɛmimɛi gbɔmɛi bei fɛɛ, ni wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ abɔ naanyo kɛ heshibaa.” Mlijaramɔi Abaakojo Israel kɛ Yuda .—.
Israel kɛ Yuda baana hejɔlɛ ekoŋŋ .—.
Kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ he shɛɛ .—.
Maŋtsɛ Yotam kɛ Maŋtsɛ Ahaz kɛ Maŋtsɛ Hezekia ni ji Yuda maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, ayinɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ shɛɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hã Mika ni jɛ maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Moreshet lɛ mli lɛ.
Yehowa jie nibii ni kɔɔ Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he nɛɛ fɛɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Mika.
Samaria kɛ Yerusalɛm he ŋkɔmɔ Nyɛ majimaji fɛɛ kwa, nyɛboa toi; shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ bii fɛɛ, nyɛfea toi!
Nyɔŋmɔ, Yehowa, aaajɛ eSɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli eye odase eshi nyɛ.
Naa, Yehowa miije kpo kɛjɛ ehe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni eeeyi shi ni ebanyiɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
Gɔji lɛ aaasere yɛ enaneshi tamɔ wo-agbaku sereɔ yɛ la hiɛ lɛ; gɔji lɛ aaayiridi awo jɔi lɛ amli ni jɔi lɛ aaagbalagbalai tamɔ nu ni jɛ gɔŋ yiteŋ eebote jɔɔ mli.
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baaba yɛ esha ni Israelbii efee eshi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ehiɛ atua ni amɛtse lɛ hewɔ.
Israelbii atuatsemɔ lɛ, namɔ ejɛ?
Ani jeee Samaria, maŋtsɛmaŋ lɛ?
Wɔŋjamɔ ni yɔɔ Yuda lɛ, namɔ ejɛ?
Ani jeee Yerusalɛm?
No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, “Mahã Samaria akumɔ abua shi yɛ ŋa kplanaa lɛ nɔ tamɔ he ko ni atɛoɔ waintsei yɛ.
Matsi egbogbo koi lɛ mawo jɔɔ lɛ mli, ni mahã tɛi ni akɛto maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ ashishi lɛ ahe akã.
Aaajwara emãgãi lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔwɔtsɔ, ni nii ni akɛbawoɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔ lɛ, aaashã fɛɛ.
Makumɔ ewɔji lɛ fɛɛ mabua shi ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gɔŋ.
Ajwamãŋi anyɔmɔwo mli Samaria bua nii nɛɛ anaa kɛjɛ, ni agbɛnɛ Samaria henyɛlɔi aaaloo fɛɛ kɛaatee amɛjamɔhei yɛ hei krokomɛi.” Kɛkɛ ni Mika kɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, maye ŋkɔmɔ ni mawo yara; manyiɛ pasaa kɛ mihe yayai.
Mawo yara tamɔ ŋaŋgbei, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ loofɔlɔ, ejaakɛ Samaria pilamɔi lɛ ni ehiii tsamɔ lɛ eko miiba Yuda nɔ.
Hiɛkpãtãmɔ eshɛ Yerusalɛm agboi anaa tɔ̃ɔ; eshɛ he ni mimaŋ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” Henyɛlɔi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm Nyɛkagbaa yɛ Gat; nyɛkahãa amɛnaa nyɛ ni nyɛmiifo.
Bet-Leafrabii, nyɛkokloa mlu mli.
Nyɛ Shafirbii, nyɛjea kpo kɛhoa kɛ hiɛgbele kɛ nyɛhe yayai.
Zaananbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ kpo aje.
Kɛji nyɛnu ni Bet-Ezelbii miiye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, nyɛaana nyɛle akɛ abobaahe bɛ jɛi.
Marotbii lɛ miishwe heremɔ, ejaakɛ Yehowa ehã efɔŋ eshɛ Yerusalɛm agbo lɛ naa etã.
Nyɛ Lakishbii, nyɛfimɔa shwiilii nyɛkpɛtɛa okpɔŋɔi ni he yɔɔ oya ahe.
Israel eshai lɛ nyɛkase feemɔ, ni nyɛkɛhã Yerusalɛm efee esha.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ, nyɛ Yudabii, nyɛkɛ Moreshet-Gat maŋ lɛ ayea shɛɛ.
Israel maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ naŋ yelikɛbuamɔ kɛjɛŋ Akzib maŋ lɛ mli shĩai adɛŋ.
Mareshabi, Yehowa baajie mɔ ehã ni ebaye nyɛnɔ kunim.
Ebaaŋɔ nyɛmaŋ lɛ, ni Israel hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ aaajo foi ayatee yɛ Abdulam tɛkplo lɛ mli.
Yudabii, nyɛshɛa nyɛyi kɛyea ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɛbii ni nyɛsumɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛkpɔa nyɛyi kuekue tamɔ akpaŋa yiteŋ, ejaakɛ abaaŋɔ nyɛbii lɛ anom kɛaaje nyɛhe kɛya.
Nɔ ni baaba mɛi ni waa ohiafoi ayi nɔ Kpoo hã mɛi ni toɔ efɔŋ he ŋaa yɛ amɛsai anɔ lɛ.
Kɛji je tsɛre, ni amɛna hegbɛ lɛ, amɛfeɔ efɔŋ ni amɛto he ŋaa amɛfɔ shi lɛ ejaakɛ efɔŋ lɛ nɔ hewalɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ.
Amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ ŋmɔji anɔ, ni amɛshɔ̃ɔ; amɛhiɛ kɔ̃ɔ shĩai anɔ, ni amɛŋɔɔ.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko gboshinii kɛ ewe fɛɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Mito ni mibahã sane fɔŋ aye nyɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ enaa foi nyɛjo; amanehulu baaba nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛnyiɛ kɛ nyɛhetsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Kɛji nakai be lɛ shɛ lɛ, mɛi kɛ nyɛsane lɛ aaabu abɛ, ni amɛaala nijiaŋwujee lala amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔhiɛ ekpãtã kwrakwra!
Yehowa ehe wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ; ni ekɛhã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ, ni eja wɔŋmɔji ehã mɛi ni ŋɔ wɔ nom lɛ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ be shɛ, ni akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ miiku sɛɛ ahã Yehowa bii lɛ, kɛji afɔ̃ oshiki lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ ko naŋ eko.
Mɛi shiɛɔ ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Kaashiɛ owo wɔ.
Kaashiɛ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ owo wɔ; hiɛgbele ko bɛ ni baaba wɔnɔ.
Ani osusuɔ akɛ alomɔ Israelbii?
Ani Yehowa tsuishitoo lɛ etã?
Ani ebaafee nibii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi?
Mɛi ni feɔ nɔ ni ja lɛ, ani jeee hi miwiemɔ lɛ hi hã amɛ?” Yehowa to he akɛ, “Nyɛteɔ shi nyɛwoɔ mimaŋ lɛ tamɔ ateɔ shi awoɔ henyɛlɔi.
Mɛi kuɔ amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛɔ ta naa kɛbaa, ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛfee shweshweeshwe yɛ shĩa.
Shi naa nyɛ ni nyɛmiimɛ amɛ koni nyɛkpɔlɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe.
Nyɛshwieɔ mimaŋ lɛ mli yei lɛ yɛ amɛshĩai ni amɛsumɔɔ lɛ; ni jɔɔmɔi ni mikɛjɔɔ amɛbii lɛ, nyɛshɔ̃ yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛmiiya naanɔ.
Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛyaa.
Biɛ bɛ shweshweeshwe dɔŋŋ yɛ nyɛhe eshai ni kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ baaba lɛ hewɔ.
“Gbalɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ sumɔɔ ji gbalɔ ni nyiɛɔ ni ewieɔ fuu ni emaleɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wain kɛ dãa ni wa baabu ahã nyɛ.’ “Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, mabua nyɛnaa, nyɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ni eshwɛ.
Mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ku kome; mabua nyɛnaa tamɔ too ku yɛ amɛniyelihe yɛ ŋa nɔ; nyɛshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baashi hoo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbɔmɛi.” Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni gbeleɔ gbɛ baagbele gbɛ ahã amɛ, ni eeenyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba.
Amɛaajwa maŋ lɛ agboi lɛ kɛje kpo kɛya heyeli mli.
Amɛmaŋtsɛ ni ji Yehowa diɛŋtsɛ aaanyiɛ amɛhiɛ kɛje kpo.
Mika wie shi Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ Nyɛ Israel onukpai ni ji Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛboa toi!
Ani jeee nyɛgbɛnaa ji akɛ nyɛaale nɔ ni ja?
Shi nyɛnyɛɔ ekpakpa, ni nyɛsumɔɔ efɔŋ.
Nyɛkpɔɔ mimaŋbii lɛ ahe wolo yɛ amɛhe be mli ni amɛhiɛ kã; ni nyɛjieɔ amɛheloo yɛ amɛwui ahe.
Nyɛyeɔ mimaŋbii lɛ aloo.
Nyɛkpɔɔ amɛhe wolo yɛ amɛhe; nyɛkumɔɔ amɛwui, ni nyɛdukuɔ mli tamɔ loo ni akɛyaawo kukwɛi wulu mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛaablɔ nyɛtsɛ Yehowa, shi efoŋ nyɛdaaŋ; shi moŋ ekɛ ehiɛ aaatee nyɛ yɛ efɔŋ ni nyɛfee lɛ hewɔ.
Gbalɔi lɛ lakaa mimaŋ lɛ.
Mɛi ni hãa gbalɔi nɛɛ nɔ ko lɛ, gbalɔi lɛ shiɛɔ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ hejɔlɛ miiba; shi mɛi ni hãaa amɛ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛwoɔ amɛhe gbeyei akɛ ta baaba abatua amɛ.
Yehowa miikɛɛ gbalɔi nɛɛ akɛ, “Gbalɔi, eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni nyɛbe baaho.
Hulu aaanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛnɔ.
Akɛni nyɛhã mimaŋ lɛ du gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaŋ ninaa ko dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɛŋ gbalɛ ko hu nyɛgba dɔŋŋ.” Mɛi ni gbaa nɔ ni baaba wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ ahiɛ aaashwie shi, ni klamɔfoi lɛ hu ahiɛ aaagboi.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ aaagboi ni amɛaamu shi kɔ̃i, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hereee amɛ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, Yehowa kɛ emumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ woɔ mimli obɔ̃, ni ehãa mileɔ nɔ ni ji jalɛ, ni ehãa mi ekãa ni akɛkɛɔ Israelbii lɛ nɔ ni hi kɛ nɔ ni ji eshai ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.
Nyɛ Yakob we onukpai, nyɛ Israel nɔyelɔi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛhiɔ jalɛ, ni nyɛhãa jalɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ejaaa, nyɛboa toi koo!
Nyɛmiima Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ wulu ni ji Yerusalɛm lɛ, nyɛmiima lashishwiemɔ kɛ kutumpɔo.
Maŋ onukpai lɛ, nyɔɔŋnii amɛheɔ dani amɛbuaa sane he; osɔfoi lɛ, nyɔmɔwoo hewɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni gbalɔi lɛ shika hewɔ amɛgbaa nɔ ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe kpasaa Yehowa ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Yehowa kɛ wɔ yɛ; nɔ fɔŋ ko nɔ fɔŋ ko baŋ wɔnɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ, aaatsa Zion ashwie shi tamɔ atsaa ŋa akɛfeɔ ŋmɔ.
Yerusalɛm aaatsɔ̃ tsu koi ni bua shi tamɔ gɔŋ, ni Sɔlemɔ we lɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaatsa atsɔ̃ koo hayii.
Yehowa hejɔlɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ Sɔlemɔ We lɛ gɔŋ lɛ aaakwɔ fe gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ, ni eeeta gɔŋkpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Majimaji aaabu kɛaaba enɔ.
Ni maji amli bii pii aaaba abakɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔyakwɔa Yehowa gɔŋ lɛ, kɛya Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɔ ni etaoɔ ni wɔfee; koni wɔnyiɛ egbɛi lɛ anɔ.
Ejaakɛ Yehowa Mla lɛ, Yerusalɛm ebaajɛ; ekɛ emaŋ lɛ wieɔ kɛjɛɔ Zion.” Eeekojo maji pii ateŋ, eeebua maji wuji ni bɛŋkɛ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ fɛɛ anaa.
Amɛkɛ amɛklantei aaasɔ̃ kɔii, ni amɛkɛ amɛkpɔlɔi lɛ hu aaasɔ̃ kaklai adɔi ni akɛkpɔlɔɔ tso he.
Maŋ ko woŋ klante nɔ yɛ maŋ ko nɔ ni amɛsaŋ amɛhe amɛhaŋ tawuu dɔŋŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaata lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewaintsei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbãmitsei ashishi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ ni kɛɛ enɛ.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ jaa, ni eboɔ enyɔŋmɔ toi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔja ni wɔɔbo Yehowa, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ toi kɛaatee naanɔ.
Israelbii lɛ aaajɛ nomŋɔɔ mli aba “Be miiba,” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Ni mabua obubuafoi ni egbɔjɔ kɛ mɛi ni ashwie amɛ, mɛi ni migbala amɛtoi lɛ fɛɛ anaa kɛaaba.
Ni mikɛ akpaketsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ maŋ, mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaje shishi, ni mafee amɛ maŋ ni da agbo.
Ni Yehowa aaaye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛaajɛ nakai be lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ fɛɛ.” Ni bo, Yerusalɛm, tooku lɛ mɔɔ ni kwɔ, Zion biyoo lɛ gɔŋkpɔ, oootsɔ̃ maŋtsɛmaŋ ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni oyɔɔ tsutsu lɛ.
Mɛɛba obolɔɔ?
Mɛɛba okɛ̃mɔɔ tamɔ yoo ni baafɔ?
Maŋtsɛ ni obɛ hewɔ ni, aloo oŋaawolɔ ni egbo hewɔ ni?
Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛkɛ̃mɔa, ni nyɛkɔ̃mɔa tamɔ yoo ni fɔmɔ eta ehe; ejaakɛ nyɛbaashi maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛaayahi ŋa lɛ nɔ; nyɛbaaya Babilon tɔ̃ɔ.
Shi jɛi lɛ Yehowa aaahere nyɛ yɛ nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ adɛŋ.
Maji pii ekpe ewo nyɛhe, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Afite Yerusalɛm koni wɔna ni ejwere shi koikoi.” Shi maji nɛɛ leee Yehowa jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, amɛyooo eyiŋtoo lɛ sɛɛ hu akɛ Yehowa ebua amɛnaa tamɔ abuaa ŋmãakei anaa yɛ ŋmãagbeemɔhe.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛtea shi; ni nyɛgbea nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ tamɔ agbeɔ ŋmãa!
Mahã nyɛhe awa tamɔ tsinanuu kɛ eklontoi ni wa tamɔ dade kɛ ekoklotoi hu ni wa tamɔ akɔɔble.
Nyɛaaye maji pii anɔ kunim; ni nyɛaajɔɔ haanii ni amɛshɔ̃ aklanaŋ naa lɛ nɔ nyɛhã mi, mi ni ji je lɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”
Yerusalɛmbii, nyɛbuaa nyɛtabilɔi anaa!
Asa wɔyi!
Atua Israelbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ wo nɔyelɔ ni baajɛ Betlehem he shi Yehowa kɛɛ, “Betlehem Efrata, maji bibii fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ ekome ji bo, shi omli majie Israel nɔyelɔ kɛaajɛ.
Nɔyelɔ nɛɛ weku kpãa aaajɛ blema beebe.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa aaaŋmɛɛ emaŋ lɛ he ehã amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni yoofɔyoo lɛ aaafɔ ebinuu lɛ, ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni yɔɔ nomŋɔɔ mli lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba amɛnyɛmɛi Israelbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Kɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ ba lɛ, eeeye emaŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eeelɛ amɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni jɛ Yehowa dɛŋ; eeeye nɔ kɛ agbojee hu ni ji Yehowa, eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ agbojee.
Nɔyelɔ lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ aaahi shi shweshweeshwe, ejaakɛ aaakpɛ̃lɛ nɔ akɛ eje agbo yɛ je lɛ mli he fɛɛ he; ni ekɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba.
Jiemɔ kɛ Toigbalamɔ Kɛji Asiriabii lɛ aaabatua wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ, kɛji amɛaafite wɔmɔji ni buɔ wɔhe lɛ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mli kɛho lɛ, no lɛ wɔɔtee hiɛnyiɛlɔi kãkãlɔi babaoo shi wɔwo amɛ.
Amɛkɛ klante aaaye Asiria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Nimrod Shikpɔŋ lɛ.
Amɛaahere wɔ kɛaajɛ Asiriabii lɛ adɛŋ, kɛji amɛba amɛbashimɔshimɔɔ shi yɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Israelbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔ ni Yehowa hãa enyɔɔ maji pii anɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaatamɔ futufuli ni shwãa jwɛfɔ nɔ.
Amɛkɛ amɛhe aaafɔ̃ Yehowa nɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ adesa ko nɔ.
Israelbii ni aaashwɛ yɛ maji lɛ ateŋ lɛ aaatamɔ jata yɛ kooŋ kooloi ateŋ, aloo tamɔ jata oblanyo yɛ tookui ateŋ.
Kɛji eegbɔbi kɛbote kooloi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, ehuruɔ eyiɔ amɛnɔ, ni etserɛɔ amɛmli, ni jielɔ ko bɛ.
Israelbii lɛ aaaye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, ni amɛaakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ makpãtã okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni mafite oshwiilii lɛ.
Mafite maji ni yɔɔ oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni makumɔ mɔji ni buɔ ohe lɛ mashwie shi.
Makpãtã okunyaayelɔi lɛ ahiɛ, ni okɔmfo kome nɛkɛ eshwɛŋ haŋ bo.
Mafite omãgãi lɛ kɛ owɔŋtɛi lɛ, ni ojaŋ nibii ni okɛ oniji fee lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Wɔŋyoo Ashera wɔŋkoi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, makwao mashwie shi, ni mafite omaji lɛ.
Mikɛ mlifu kpele kɛ mlila aaatɔ owele yɛ maji fɛɛ ni booo mi toi ni egbo minɔ toi lɛ anɔ.”
Sane ni Yehowa kɛ Israel yɔɔ Nyɛboa nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ toi, “Tee shi ni okɔlɔ ogbee!
Hã gɔji kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ anu osane lɛ.
“Nyɛ gɔji, nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishitoo ni yɔɔ daa, nyɛboa Yehowa sane lɛ toi!
Yehowa kɛ emaŋ Israel ena; ekɛ sane ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ baashi lɛ.” Yehowa miibi emaŋ lɛ akɛ, “Mimaŋ, mɛni mifee bo?
Mɛni mli mihã etɔ bo yɛ?
Hã mi hetoo.
Ejaakɛ mi mijie bo kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mikpɔ̃ bo yɛ nyɔŋyeli mli.
Mitsu Mose kɛ Aaron kɛ Miriam kɛba akɛ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi.
Mimaŋbii, nyɛkaia nɔ yiŋ ni Moab maŋtsɛ Balak to yɛ nyɛhe, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni Bileam, Beor bi lɛ, hã lɛ.
Nyɛkaia nibii ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Akasia shitoohe lɛ kɛtee Gilgal tɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkaia nibii nɛɛ bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna nibii ni mi, Yehowa, mitsu ni mikɛhere nyɛyiwala lɛ.” Nɔ ni Yehowa taoɔ Mɛni mikɛaaba Yehowa hiɛ, ni mɛni mikɛaabakoto Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ hiɛ?
Miba ehiɛ kɛ shãa afɔlei?
Mikɛ tsinabii ni eye afifi abashã shãa afɔlei ahã lɛ?
Ani toi agboi akpekpei aloo mu tsɛnsii akpei nyɔŋmai abɔ aaasa Yehowa hiɛ?
Aso mikɛ mikromɔbi, mimusuŋbi lɛ ahã yɛ mihe esha hewɔ?
Dabida!
Ao Adesa, Yehowa etsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni hi.
Nɔ ni ebiɔ yɛ odɛ̃ŋ nɛ, akɛ ofee nɔ ni ja gbɛ, osumɔ onyɛmimɛi, okɛ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ anyiɛ yɛ heshibaa mli.
Ehi akɛ ashe Yehowa gbeyei.
Eeetsɛ maŋ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛboa toi, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa kɛkpeɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli!
Nɔ ni yɔɔ efɔŋfeelɔi ashĩai amli ni ji jwetri ni atsɔ̃ shishiumɔ gbɛi anɔ ana, kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ni akɛŋmɛɔ nii lɛ, ani mihiɛ aaakpa nɔ?
Dabida, miihi!
Ani mikɛ mɛi ni kɛ susumɔnii kɛ nsɛnitɛi ni shɛɛɛ ŋmɛɔ nii lɛ ahe esha aaafa amɛ lo?
Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lɛ shishiuɔ ohiafoi lɛ; ni nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ amalelɔi ji nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mije nyɛ nitswiamɔ kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ shishi momo yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
Nyɛaaye nii, shi nyɛtɔrɔŋ; ni hɔmɔ aaakã he aye nyɛ.
Nyɛaaloo nii nyɛto, shi efeŋ shweshweeshwe, ni nɔ ni nyɛaabaa yi tete lɛ, makpãtã hiɛ yɛ ta mli.
Nyɛaadu nii, shi nyɛkpaŋ eko.
Nyɛaaŋa mu, shi nyɛnaŋ mu nyɛkpa, ni nyɛaaŋa wain hu, shi nyɛnuŋ wain.
Enɛ baaba mli, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ Omri nibii gbohii lɛ kɛ ebi Ahab nibii fɔ̃ji lɛ, nomɛi anɔ nyɛtsa.
No hewɔ lɛ, mahã nyɛmaji lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni abuŋ nyɛ, ni aaabo nyɛ ‘tsia’!”
Fitemɔ ni Israel efite Kpoo hã mi!
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni hɔmɔ miiye lɛ ni eetao tsoyibii loo wainyibii ko eye, ejaakɛ akpa wainyibii kɛ agbãmii ni ŋɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ atã, ni shao ko bɛ ni aaana aye; agbãmi hee ni mitsui shweɔ lɛ eko bɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ; mɔ ko bɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miitao akɛ ena hegbɛ ni eshwie lá shi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ miigbɔbi enaanyo.
Amɛhe esa kɛ efɔŋfeemɔ, ni amɛfeɔ lɛ kɛ ŋaa.
Lumɛi kɛ kojolɔi lɛ heɔ nyɔɔŋnii.
Nɔ fɔŋ ni yɔɔ hiɛnaanɔ gbɔmɔ tsuiŋ lɛ, ejeɔ enaa; kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãŋ amɛto.
Mɔ ni kɛɛ ehi fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ lɛ, etamɔ kpitikpiti ŋmei, ni mɔ ni kɛɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ fe fɛɛ lɛ, ŋmei afabaŋ po hi fe lɛ.
Shi gbi ni Nyɔŋmɔ baagbala amɛtoi lɛ eshɛ taakɛ ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ kɛtsɔ̃ egbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ amɛ jijaa.
Kaahe onaanyo oye; ni kɛ ohiɛ akafɔ̃ oshieŋtsɛ nɔ.
Yoo ni kãa osɛɛ tete po lɛ, jwɛŋmɔ he jogbaŋŋ dani okɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ binuu ebuuu etsɛ, biyoo teɔ shi woɔ enyɛ; ni shaayoo teɔ shi woɔ eshaayoo.
Gbɔmɔ henyɛlɔi ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩa teŋ bii.
Shi mi lɛ, makwɛ Yehowa gbɛ; mamɛ miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ni miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaabo mi toi.
Yehowa kɛ Yiwalaheremɔ eba Ao mihenyɛlɔ, kaaye mi yɔɔ.
Kɛ migbee shi lɛ, mibate shi ekoŋŋ; kɛ duŋ wo mi lɛ, Yehowa aaatsɔ̃ la ahã mi.
Makplɛ̃ Yehowa mli ni efu mi lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mifee esha mishi lɛ; mamɛ kɛyashi eeefã mihe, ni eeebu mi bem.
Eeejie mi kɛaaba la hiɛ ni mana ekpɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ mihenyɛlɔ mɔ ni ebi mi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɔɔ” lɛ?
Aaana, ni ehiɛ aaagbo kpɔtɔɔ.
Mihiŋmɛi aaana lɛ; agbɛnɛ aaanaanaa enɔ tamɔ blohuŋ ŋmɔtɔ.
Yerusalɛmbii, be miiba ni aaasaa maŋ lɛ gbogboi lɛ atswa ni aaalɛɛ ehusui amli kɛaatee sɛɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaaba.
Aaajɛ Asiria ni yɔɔ bokã lɛ kɛ Ijipt ni yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ lɛ kɛaaba.
Amɛaajɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ he kɛ ŋshɔi anaa kɛ gɔji anɔ kɛaaba.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ shiaŋa yɛ enɔ bii lɛ anifɔ̃ɔjianii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ ahewɔ.
Yehowa aaana Israel mɔbɔ Yehowa, feemɔ tookwɛlɔ ohã omaŋ lɛ, ni olɛ amɛ, maŋ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ ohala lɛ.
Amɛyɛ ŋa kplanaa nɔ banee yɛ Gɔŋ Karmel lɛ yiteŋ, tsɛbelɛ shikpɔŋ ni baa nii bɔle amɛ kɛkpe.
Hã ni amɛhi Bashan kɛ Gilead shikpɔŋ frɔ̃frɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛye enɔ nii tamɔ blema ko lɛ.
Mafee naakpɛɛnii matsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tamɔ be ni mijie amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Maji lɛ aaana, ni yɛ amɛhewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛnijiaŋ aaaje wui.
Amɛkɛ amɛnine aaato amɛnaabu ni amɛaatsimɔ amɛtoii.
Amɛaalɛmɔ shikpɔŋ su, ni amɛaawamɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ tamɔ onufu.
Amɛaajɛ amɛmɔji lɛ amli amɛaaba kɛ hekpokpomɔ.
Yehowa wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ he ŋmiŋmi aaamɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛaashe bo gbeyei.
Nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ ni kɛ esha faa tamɔ bo.
Okuɔ ohiɛ ofɔ̃ɔ omaŋbii ni eshwɛ lɛ amlatɔ̃mɔ nɔ.
Ohiɛɛɛ mlifu mli kɛyaaa naanɔ, ejaakɛ onaa mɔbɔnalɛ he tsui.
Oooku sɛɛ omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo yɛ wɔhe.
Okɛ onane aaashwishwia wɔnishaianii lɛ anɔ ni osherɛ oshwie ŋshɔ shishi bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Obaajie onɔkwayeli kɛ osuɔmɔ ni tsakeee lɛ kpo otsɔ̃ɔ omaŋ lɛ, ni ji Abraham kɛ Yakob shwiei lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni owo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ashi blema bei lɛ amli beebe lɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Nahum wolo lɛ mli sane lɛ eji lalawiemɔ ni kɔɔ Nineve maŋ lɛ shigbeemɔ he.
Nineve ji Asiriabii ni ji Israelbii teteete ahenyɛlɔi lɛ amaŋtease.
Nineve gbee shi kɛyaa afii Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ naagbee mli.
Anaa eshigbeemɔ lɛ akɛ nyɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ woɔ maŋ ni yitsoŋ wa ni ewoɔ ehe nɔ hu.
Mlijaramɔi Fɔ ni abu Nineve .- Nineve shigbeemɔ .—.
Nineve shigbeemɔ he gbalɛ nɛɛ, ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Nahum, Elkoshnyo lɛ.
Yehowa mli efu Nineve Yehowa lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ awuŋã ni, ni asaŋ etɔɔ owele.
Oweletɔlɔ ji Yehowa, ni emlifu naa wa.
Yehowa tɔɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tswaa anɔ, ni ekɛ emlifu shakãa ehenyɛlɔi anɔ.
Yehowa mli fuuu mra, ni ehewalɛ da kpele; ehãaa tɔ̃lɔ aŋɔ ehe aye.
Ahum kɛ lasuogbele teɔ shi yɛ he ni Yehowa etsɔ̃ kɛho, ni enaneshi mlu ji atatui.
Eŋãa ŋshɔ yi, ni emiɔ; ehãa fai fɛɛ miɔ.
Bashan kɛ Karmel gɔji lɛ anɔ ŋãlãa, ni Lebanon ŋã floŋŋ lɛ hu ŋãlãa.
Gɔji hosoɔ yɛ ehiɛ, gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ sereɔ: Shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ ehiɛ, ni je lɛ kɛ emli bii fɛɛ hu ahiɛ kpãtãa.
Namɔ aaanyɛ emlila naa adamɔ?
Namɔ aaanyɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ naa ekpee?
Emlifu tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaa tamɔ la, ni efɛlɛɔ tɛsai amli.
Yehowa hi, etsɔ̃ɔ teemɔhe yɛ amanehulu be mli, ni ebaa mɛi ni baa lɛ abo lɛ ayi.
Shi ebaa tamɔ faa ni eje ŋã, ni ebakpãtãa ehenyɛlɔi ahiɛ; etiuɔ ehenyɛlɔi kɛyashiɔ egbeɔ amɛ.
Mɛɛ shi nyɛte nyɛwo Yehowa lɛ?
Ebaakpãtã nyɛhiɛ kwraa.
Etɔɔɔ owele shii enyɔ.
Abaashã amɛ wɛɛ tamɔ ŋmei ni eloloo, loo gbetseli gbiŋ.
Nineve, ani mɔ ko jɛɛɛ omli ni jwɛŋ Yehowa he efɔŋ, ni to ehe yiŋ fɔŋ?
Israelbii, nɔ ni Yehowa kɛɔ nɛ, “Yɛ mli akɛ Asiriabii lɛ ayi fa po nɛ, shi amɛhiɛ baakpãtã; ni amɛsɛɛ baafo.
Mipiŋ nyɛ kɛho; mipiŋŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, apã lɛ ni Asiria kɛfɔ̃ nyɛkuɛ lɛ mibakumɔ mli; ni mibatserɛ kpãai ni fimɔ nyɛ lɛ amli.” Kitã ni Yehowa ewo yɛ Asiria he ji enɛ, “Onaŋ shwiei ni baahã akai ogbɛi.
Makumɔ sũ amãgãi kɛ dade amãgãi lɛ ni yɔɔ ojemawɔji lɛ awei lɛ amli lɛ.
Masaa gbonyobu mato bo, Asiria ejaakɛ ohiii kwraa.” Naa, bɔfo ko miiba yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ kɛ sane kpakpa; eeba kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ sane.
Yudabii, nyɛyea nyɛgbii juji lɛ; ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋnii ni nyɛwo he shi lɛ, nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ.
Yitsoŋwalɔi lɛ baŋ abatuaŋ nyɛ dɔŋŋ; akpãtã amɛhiɛ butuu.
Nineve Hiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ Nineve, nifitelɔ lɛ eba ebaatua bo!
Mɔ ni baakpãtã ohiɛ lɛ eshɛ shi.
Abu maŋ lɛ he gbogbo lɛ he!
Nyɛmiaa; buamɔ otabilɔi blublu anaa!
(Yehowa miihã Israel hiɛ aba nyam ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ baye enɔ, ni amɛkpãtã eblema nyam lɛ hiɛ.)
Henyɛlɔi tabilɔi kãkãlɔi lɛ hiɛ tsɛŋi tsuji, ni amɛwowoo atadei tsuji.
Amɛmiisaa amɛhe kɛhã maŋ lɛ tuamɔ.
Kɛji amɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ to kɛdamɔ shi lɛ, amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ la ni miitso; amɛkpɔŋɔi lɛ miitumɔtumɔɔ.
Tayaa shwiilii lɛ gbaa shi yɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ; amɛyaa amɛbaa kɛ foi yɛ maŋ lɛ mli blohui lɛ amli.
Amɛhe kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ kɔtii, ni amɛfoɔ hiŋmɛi naa tamɔ srawa.
Atsɛɔ tabilɔi asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ; shi amɛnaji tɛrɛɔ shi kɛyaa, be mli ni henyɛlɔi lɛ tsɛ̃ɔ kɛbaninaa maŋ gbogbo lɛ; ni amɛmamɔɔ nibii kɛtsĩɔ amɛhiɛ.
Agbele faa lɛ naagbɛ agboi lɛ, maŋtsɛ we lɛ mli yiɔ kɛ hejaramɔ.
Aŋɔ maŋnyɛ lɛ nom kɛtee, ni eweyei lɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ; amɛgbei etsɔ̃ tamɔ okpoi agbee; amɛmiiyi amɛtsitsii anɔ mã.
Ninevebii eke kɛ foi tamɔ faa ni etue, amɛke kɛ blɔmɔ akɛ, “Nyɛdamɔa shi!
Nyɛdamɔa shi!” Shi mɔ ko mɔ ko ekuuu esɛɛ.
Nyɛhaa jwiɛtɛi!
Nyɛhaa shika!
Jwinei srɔtoi ni abua naa ato yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.
Akpãtã Nineve hiɛ, afee lɛ butuu etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃!
Gbeyei emɔmɔ tsuii, nakutsei miikpokpo hewalɛ etã yɛ mɛi amli, ni hiɛiaŋ fɛɛ eshale.
Nɛgbɛ maŋ lɛ ni tsɔ̃ tamɔ jata oblahii ashihilɛhe lɛ yɔɔ, he ni jata shãtã eniyenii kɛtee ebii aŋɔɔ yɛ, ni mɔ ko gbaaa enaa lɛ?
Jata nuu lɛ gbe loo bɔ ni baashɛ jata yoo kɛ ebii anaa; ewo etɛkplo lɛ mli obɔ̃, kɛ ebui lɛ amli kɛ loo ni egbe.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ nyɛ ena.
Mibama nyɛtayaa shwiilii lɛ anaa la mashã.
Nyɛtabilɔi ni tamɔ jata lɛ baanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ ta mli.
Mashɔ̃ nibii fɛɛ ni nyɛshɔ̃shɔ̃ɔ yɛ mɛi adɛŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, asaŋ anuŋ ohewalɛ he yɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ.
Kpoo hã maŋ ni shwieɔ lá shi ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amale kɛ yiwalɛ kɛ mɛi anii ni ayaha.
Bo toi!
Okpɔŋɔ gwaomɔ kpãa miigbɛɛ, tayaa shwiilii anaji miigbɛɛ; okpɔŋɔi esha foi, ni tayaa shwiilii miihɛlɛ shi!
Okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi ewo foi kɛmiiba, klante miikpɛlɛ nyramnyram, ni akplɔ miikpɛlɛ tamɔ srawa!
Gbohii bua shi tsãa; mɛi ni enyɔnyɔɔ lɛ, babaoo, amɛyi fa fe nine, mɛi miitɛrɛtrɛɛ amɛ!
Fɛɛ jɛ Nineve ajwamãŋbɔɔ.
Ehe yɛ fɛo bɔ ni ekɛ ehe fɛo duɔ maji kɛ gbɔmɛi ni ekɛyeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ.
Yehowa, Tatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji, “Naa, Nineve, mi kɛ bo ena!
Mibawo ohiɛ mama nɔ, ni mahã maji ana oyayaiaŋ; amɛbaana ohiɛshishwiemɔ.
Mibanyaŋe bo, ni matsi muji mashwie onɔ, ni mɛi aaakwɛ bo gãa.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni baana bo baasu amɛhe kɛya sɛɛ.
Amɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nineve etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃!
Namɔ yeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ koo!
Nɛgbɛ mana mɛi aaajɛ abashɛje emii?’ ” Nineve, ani ohi fe Tebes, Nilo Faa lɛ toi maŋ lɛ ni nu efo ehe sa kɛbɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni ŋshɔ ewaje lɛ kɛfo ehe, ni nu etsɔ̃ gbogbo ehã lɛ lɛ lo?
