Tebes na hewalɛ kɛjɛ Kush kɛ Ijipt fɛɛ dɛŋ, nakai ehewalɛ lɛ anyɛɛɛ naa adamɔ.
Putbii kɛ Libiabii fɛɛ ye bua lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ ana aŋɔ lɛ nom hu, ni akɛ emli bii abifabii tswiatswia shi, ni agbɛgbɛɛ amɛ ashwãshwãa gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoii fɛɛ.
Emli hiɛnaanɔmɛi lɛ, amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki kɛja amɛ hã amɛhe, ni awo amɛ gboklɛ, ni akpala amɛ kɛtee nomŋɔɔ mli.
Nineve, nakai bo hu obaatɔ dãa, ni ohiɛ baaha; ni obaatao abobaahe kɛjo ohenyɛlɔ lɛ naa foi.
Omɔji lɛ, naa, amɛbaatsɔ̃mɔ agbãmitsei ni amɛklɛŋklɛŋ yibii etsu yɛ amɛnɔ.
Hosomɔ nɛkɛ ni aaahoso tsei lɛ, yibii lɛ baakpala ashwie yelɔ lɛ daaŋ.
Naa, otabilɔi lɛ yei sɔŋŋ ji amɛ.
Oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ anaa agboi lɛ anaa kãmɔ hã ohenyɛlɔi lɛ.
La baashã ogboi nɛɛ asɛɛ adabaŋi lɛ.
Nyɛyɛa numɔ nu nyɛtoa be ni abaasa nyɛmaŋ lɛ yi lɛ; nyɛwajeɔ nyɛmɔji lɛ; nyɛnaa su ni akɛfoɔ brikisi lɛ, ni asaa brikisifoo adeka lɛ ato.
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛbaanyɔnyɔɔ, kɛjeee yɛ la mli lɛ no lɛ yɛ ta mli.
Abaaplene nyɛ tamɔ baalabii kpãtãa ŋmɔshinii ahiɛ.
Nyɛhãa nyɛyi afaa tamɔ baalabii, nyɛyi afaa tamɔ otukpɛi.
Nyɛhã nyɛteiaŋ jarayelɔi ayi efa fe ŋwɛi ŋulamii tete!
Shi bɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ amɛnɔ egbɔ tamɔ baalabii ni bayeɔ nii ni amɛflikiɔ kɛyaa lɛ?
Nyɛlumɛi lɛ tamɔ agãi, ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tamɔ baalabii ni basɔ̃mɔɔ afabaŋi ahe gbi nɔ ni fɛi miiye.
Kɛji hulu lɛ te shi pɛ amɛfliki kɛtee, ni aleee he ni amɛyaa.
Ao!
Asiria Maŋtsɛ, omraloi lɛ egboi; ni wɔ enyɔ ohiɛnaanɔbii lɛ anɔ.
Agbɛ owebii lɛ ashwã gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɔ ko kwraa bɛ ni buaa amɛnaa.
Pilamɔ ni opila lɛ bɛ tsabaa; ni ofaji lɛ ehiŋ tsamɔ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni nuɔ ohiɛkpãtãmɔ lɛ he lɛ tswaa amɛdɛ̃ amɛshwieɔ onɔ kɛ nyamɔ; ejaakɛ namɔ po ni yɔɔ ni oyeko lɛ sane fɔŋ dã?
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Habakuk gba egbalɛ lɛ aaafee afii Dani Afɔ Kristo.
Nakai be mli lɛ Babilonbii ahewalɛ ma shi.
Bɔ ni Babilonbii lɛ ayitsoŋ wa yɛ mɛi anɔ lɛ hã Habakuk he jra lɛ waa, bɔ sɔŋŋ ni ebi Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?” Hetoo ni Naa Nyɔŋmɔ hã lɛ ji akɛ kɛji be ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eto lɛ shɛ lɛ, ebaatsu sane lɛ he nii; shi kɛyaashi nakai be lɛ, “Mɛi ni feɔ nii ni ja yi aaana wala, ejaakɛ amɛye Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa” Wolo lɛ mli sane ni eshwɛ lɛ kɔɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ gbalɛ ni kɔɔ mɛi ni efeee jalɛnii ahe.
Amu wolo lɛ naa kɛ lala ni akɛmiikafo Naa Nyɔŋmɔ agbojee, asaŋ ni akɛmiiye hemɔkɛyeli kpeteŋkple ni lalawiemɔŋmalɔ lɛ yɔɔ hu he odase.
Mlijaramɔi Habakuk ŋkɔmɔi lɛ kɛ hetoo ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hã .—.
Mɛi ni efeee jalɛ nii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ .- Habakuk sɔlemɔ .-
Ninaa ni Yehowa jie etsɔ̃ɔ Gbalɔ Habakuk lɛ nɛ.
Habakuk wie eshi toikɔdɔmɔ saneyeli “Ao, Yehowa, mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mabɔlɔ kɛyashi dani ooobo mi toi?
Mɛɛ beyinɔ matsɛ bo kɛyashi dani ooobahere wɔ kɛje yiwalɛ mli?
Mɛɛba ohãa minaa nifɔɔjianii nɛɛ, ni bo hu okwɛɔ haomɔi nɛɛ lɛ?
Nifitemɔ kɛ henitswiamɔ sɔŋŋ ebɔle mihe kɛkpe, ni nɔmɔ kɛ bei ete shi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Ejaakɛ mla lɛ hewalɛ egbo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ayeee jalɛ sane.
Mɛi fɔ̃ji ebɔle jalɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, atsɔ̃ jalɛ sane hiɛ abu shi.” Hetoo ni Yehowa hã Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ emɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa majimaji lɛ ateŋ, ni nyɛhe baajɔ̃ nyɛhe jogbaŋŋ yɛ nii ni nyɛbaana lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ miitsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ amɛteŋ yɛ nyɛyinɔ nɛɛ, ni kɛji agba nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ!
Naa, mitee Babilonbii lɛ ni yi wa, asaŋ ni amɛhe ejɔɔɔ lɛ ashi.
Amɛfãa kɛkpaa je lɛ mli shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ kɛyaŋɔɔ shikpɔji lɛ.
Amɛhe ŋmiŋmi kɛ gbeyei mɔmɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ, ni nɔ ni amɛ amɛsumɔɔ lɛ, no amɛfeɔ, ni no ji nɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mla.
“Amɛkpɔŋɔi ahe yɛ oya fe mlaŋtswi, ni amɛhiɛ yɛ kramakrama fe klãji ni je ena amɛ kɛ hɔmɔ.
Amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ jɛɔ shɔŋŋ amɛbaa; amɛshaneɔ shi kɛ foi tamɔ okropɔŋ shaneɔ shi eshaa eniyenii.
“Amɛtai lɛ fãa kɛbaa kɛ yiwalɛ kɛbayeɔ shikpɔji anɔ; ni amɛhe ŋmiŋmi mɔmɔɔ mɛi kɛji amɛmiiba.
Amɛnomii ni amɛbuaa naa lɛ ayifalɛ tamɔ shia.
Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ahe fɛo; ni lumɛi ahe feɔ amɛŋmɔlɔ.
Mɔɔ ko mɔɔ ko shɔ̃mɔ waaa hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtereɔ sũ amɛkɛbaa mɔɔ lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ amɛshɔ̃.
Ni amɛfoɔ mli kɛhoɔ shwiaa kɛyaa tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ, amɛ ji amɛhe efɔŋfeelɔi, ni hewalɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ no ji nɔ ni amɛjaa.” Habakuk gbigbli emli etsɔ̃ɔ Yehowa ekoŋŋ “Yehowa, kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ bo ji miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Koome!
Ohaŋ wɔgboi!
Ao, Yehowa, okɔ Babilonbii lɛ, ni bo ohã amɛma shi shiŋŋ kɛhã wɔtoigbalamɔ.
Shi te aaafe tɛŋŋ ni okwɛ ni efɔŋ aya nɔ hu?
Ohiŋmɛi yɛ krɔŋŋ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni okɛaakwɛ koni nifɔɔjianii aya nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛba ni ofee dioo be mli ni efɔŋfeelɔi kpãtãa mɛi ni hi fe amɛ hiɛ?
“Ejaakɛ ohã gbɔmɛi etsɔ̃ tamɔ ŋshɔŋloo loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waamɔnii ni bɛ nɔyelɔ.
Babilonbii lɛ kɛ kpoŋ shaa gbɔmɛi oookɛɛ loi ji amɛ; amɛfɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yaa, ni amɛgbalaa amɛ tamɔ adrã; ni amɛnyaa ni amɛmli filiɔ amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshãa afɔle amɛkɛjaa amɛyaa lɛ, ni amɛshãa tsofakɛŋma amɛkɛhãa amɛtsãani lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi hãa amɛnaa nii kpɔtɔɔ amɛyeɔ.
“Aso Babilonbii nɛɛ baakã he aye amɛhewalɛ nɛɛ mli nii daa, koni amɛya nɔ nɛkɛ sɔŋŋ kɛplenee majimaji lɛ amli bii ni mɔbɔnalɛ ko kwraa bɛ mli lo?”
Hetoo ni Yehowa hã Habakuk Mibakwɔ mayadamɔ shi kɛbu yɛ mɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ koni makwɛ nɔ ni Yehowa baakɛɛ mi, kɛ nɔ hetoo ni ebaahã mi yɛ mikɔmɔyeli lɛ hewɔ.
Yehowa hã mi hetoo nɛɛ, “Kpɛ ninaa nɛɛ faŋŋ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii anɔ koni anyɛ akane oya.
Ninaa nɛɛ be lɛ shɛko moŋ, shi eeye ehe oyai kɛba.
Kɛji eshashao shi tete po jiŋŋ, bo lɛ mɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaaba kɛ̃ ni etsɛŋ.
Ni shɛɛ wiemɔ lɛ nɛ: ‘Naa, mɔ ni efeee jalɛnii lɛ, eyi naŋ wala; shi mɔ ni feɔ jalɛnii lɛ ehemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni eyi ana wala.’ ” Mɛi ni efeee jalɛnii ahiɛkpãtãmɔ Naa, wain lakaa mɔ.
Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ ehe lɛ, enyɛɛɛ shi ehi.
Efeɔ fuu tamɔ gbohiiaje; ni etamɔ gbele, etɔko dã.
Ebuaa majimaji fɛɛ anɔ bii anaa kɛbaa, ni etiãa amɛ ehãa ehe.
Aso majimaji nɛɛ fɛɛ yeŋ lɛ yɔɔ amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Kpoo hã mɔ ni haa nii ni ele faŋŋ akɛ jeee enɔ ni, kɛ mɔ ni loɔ awabatoonii eshwieɔ enɔ lɛ.
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ni?” Naa, trukaa ni onyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaate shi awo bo.
Mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ lɛ aaaha onii.
Akɛ ni oha majimaji babaoo anii hewɔ lɛ, bo hu majimaji lɛ amli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ baaha onii yɛ gbɔmɛi ala shi ni oshwie, kɛ yi ni owa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ahewɔ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ gbɛ fɔŋ nɔ ena nii ehã ewe, ni ebɔ mɔdɛŋ eyama etsu yɛ he ko grɔŋŋ bɔ ni afee ni efee shweshweeshwe koni efɔŋ ko akasa ehe lɛ.
Ogbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eyagbala hiɛgbele ebashwie owe lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ majimaji lɛ ni oplenee lɛ ehã bo diɛŋtsɛ owala hiɛ ekpãtã moŋ.
Gbogbo mli tɛ tete miibolɔ kɛmiishi nyɛ, ni tsu yiteŋ mplaŋ lɛ hu miihere tɛ lɛ blɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Kpoo hã mɔ ni kɛ lashishwiemɔ toɔ maŋ, ni ekɛ efɔŋfeemɔ tswaa maŋ lɛ.
Naa, aso jeee Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, dɛŋ sane nɛ, akɛ gbɔmɔ atsu nii, ni là abakpãtã hiɛ lo, ni majimaji lɛ agbo deŋme yaka lo?
Moŋ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ baayi tɔ kɛ Yehowa anunyam lɛ he nilee, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋshɔ eyi tɔ kɛ nu lɛ.
Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni ojɛɔ mlifu mli ohãa onaanyo dãa enuɔ, ni etɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni okwɛ eyayaiaŋ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ bo hu, yɛ hiɛnyam najiaŋ lɛ, hiɛgbele baamɔ bo.
Bo hu obaanu eko koni odidãã.
Kpulu ni yɔɔ Yehowa ninejurɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ kɛbashɛ onɔ, ni ohiɛnyam lɛ baatsɔ̃ hiɛgbele ni naa wa.
Awui ni nyɛye Lebanon lɛ baasu nyɛtsui fe nine; emli kooloi lɛ hiɛ ni nyɛkpãtã lɛ baahã nyɛshe gbeyei, ejaakɛ nyɛshwie gbɔmɛi alá shi, ni nyɛwa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maji lɛ kɛ amɛmli bii lɛ fɛɛ ayi.
Mɛni ji amãgã he sɛɛnamɔ?
Ŋaalɔ ninenaa nitsumɔ kɛkɛ ni; ni egbaaa mɔ ko nɔ ko fe amale.
Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mɔ ni fee amãgã lɛ kɛ ehiɛ afɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eninenaa nitsumɔnii, ni ji amãgã mumui nɔ?
Kpoo hã bo mɔ ni okɛɔ tso akɛ, “Ohiɛ atsɛ̃!” Ni okɛɔ tɛ mumui hu akɛ, “Tee shi!” Ani amãgã baanyɛ ejie ninaa atsɔ̃ɔ bo?
Naa, akɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi baaha ehe nɛ, shi moŋ wala kome nɛkɛ bɛ emli.
Naa, Yehowa yɛ eSɔlemɔ we krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Sɔlemɔ ni Habakuk sɔle Sɔlemɔ ni Gbalɔ Habakuk sɔle nɛ, “Ao Yehowa, minu nii ni otsu lɛ he, ni miishe gbeyei.
Yehowa, tsu onitsumɔi wuji lɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔyinɔ nɛɛ hu nɔ.
Hã ale yɛ afii nɛɛ amli nɔŋŋ.
Omlifu mli tete lɛ, hã omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo!
Naa Nyɔŋmɔ jɛ Edom kɛmiiba; Nyɔŋmɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miiba kɛjɛ Paran Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Enunyam lɛ ha ŋwɛi, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyi tɔ kɛ eyijiemɔ.
Ekpɛmɔ lɛ tamɔ la; la kpɛlɛɔ kɛjɛɔ edɛŋ he ni ji ehewalɛ teemɔhe lɛ.
Tsɛŋemɔ hela nyiɛɔ ehiɛ, ni gbele hela nyiɛ esɛɛ tuuŋtu.
Ewa edamɔ shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, Ekwɛ, ni maji lɛ ahe kpokpo.
Naanɔ gɔji lɛ gbɛ shwã ni naanɔ gɔŋkpɔi lɛ ba shi, yɛ hei ni enyiɛ blema ko lɛ.
Mina, Kushanbii miishe gbeyei, ni Midianbii ahe miikpokpo.
Yehowa, ani fai omli wo la wo?
Fai ni omli fu, loo ŋshɔ ni ogri owo?
No hewɔ ota kunimyeli okpɔŋɔ kɛ tayaa shwiili mli kɛbaa nɛɛ?
Ojie ogãi lɛ hebo lɛ, ni ofee kralo kɛbaatsɛ̃.
Okɛ fai egbala shikpɔŋ lɛ mli.
Gɔji lɛ na bo, ni amɛhosohosoo; nu tue kɛbaho yoo.
Bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ wo egbee; ehole eniji anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
La ni ogãimlibii lɛ kpɛlɛ kɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ hu akpɛlɛmɔ hã hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere wa damɔ shi.
Okɛ mlila shi shi kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni onaanaa majimaji lɛ anɔ kɛho yɛ mlifu naa.
Otee oyahere omɛi lɛ ayiwala, koni oyahere mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ yiwala.
Ojwara mɔ fɔŋ lɛ weku lɛ yitso, ni oŋmɛ lɛ yayai kɛjɛ eshuɔ kɛyata ekuɛ.
Okɛ okpɔlɔ lɛ gbulɔ etabilɔi ni ba tamɔ lasuogbele koni amɛbagbɛ mi amɛshwã kɛ mliflimɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni amɛba ohiafo piŋmɔ yɛ teemɔ mli lɛ.
Okɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ naanaa ŋshɔ ni ji nu kpeteŋkple ni kumɔɔ lɛ nɔ.
Minu enɛɛmɛi, ni mihe kpokpo; gbɛɛmɔ lɛ hã minaabu jo bliblibli.
Mikpɔiaŋ fee gbedee, ni minaji tɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Mibata shi kpoo mamɛ gbi ni abaahao mɛi ni baa koni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ abawu lɛ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ agbãmi tso gbaŋ afofro, ni yibii ehiŋ wain tsei anɔ; eyɛ mli akɛ mu tsei ayibii baafee yaka, ni anaŋ ŋmɔshi niyenii; eyɛ mli akɛ toi fɛɛ aaagboi, ni tsinai aaatã yɛ tsina tsui amli nɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ mi lɛ mibanya, ni mimli aaafli mi yɛ Yehowa miyiwalaheremɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ woɔ mi hewalɛ; ehãa minaji feɔ tamɔ ofrote naji kɛnyiɛɔ shweshweeshwe yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ.
(Akɛhã Lalatsɛnukpa lɛ koni akɛ kpãa saŋku atswa.)
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Zefania gba yɛ afii Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ naagbee be lɛ mli.
Eeefee akɛ egba egbalɛ nɛɛ afii nyɔŋma dani Maŋtsɛ Yosia tsake emaŋbii ajamɔ mli gbɛjianɔtoi ahiɛ yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ mli lɛ.
Ewolo lɛ wieɔ nibii ni gbalɔi lɛ fɔɔ amɛhe wiemɔ lɛ ekomɛi ahe.
Nibii nɛɛ ekomɛi nɛ: Akɛ Hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ nɔnaa be miiba; akɛ abaagbla Yudabii atoi yɛ jemawɔji ni amɛjaa hewɔ; akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baagbla maji krokomɛi hu atoi; akɛ eyɛ mli akɛ abaakpãtã Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ hiɛ moŋ, shi be baashɛ kɛ̃ ni abaasaa maŋ lɛ atswa ekoŋŋ ahã gbɔmɛi humii kɛ jalɛ saneyelɔi koni amɛhi mli.
Mlijaramɔi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kojomɔ Gbi lɛ .—.
Israel hewɔ maji ahiɛkpãtãmɔ .- Yerusalɛm hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ ekpɔ̃mɔ .-
Wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛ Zefania wie be mli ni Amon bi Yosia yeɔ Yuda maŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ.
Zefania Kush bi lɛ, enii ji Gedalia, Maŋtsɛ Hezekia bi Amaria bi lɛ.
Yehowa Kojomɔ gbi lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, Mibakpãtã nibii fɛɛ ahiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
“Mibakpãtã gbɔmɔ kɛ kooloo hiɛ; mibakpãtã loofɔji kɛ ŋshɔŋ loi fɛɛ ahiɛ, mibakpãtã yiwalɔi ahiɛ; mibaplene gbɔmɛi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.
“Mibagbala gbɔmɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ atoi.
Mibafã Baal jamɔ shishi fɛɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni akaiŋ wulɔmɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jemawɔji lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɔɔ kɛyaa tsui ayiteiaŋ amɛyajaa hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii yɛ jɛi lɛ ahiɛ.
Mibakpãtã mɛi hu ni kotoɔ Yehowa lɛ, ni amɛkãa lɛ kitã akɛ amɛbaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi amɛkɛ jemawɔŋ Molek gbɛi lɛ kãa kitã ahiɛ.
Mibakpãtã mɛi fɛɛ ni ekpale, ni amɛjaaa Yehowa lɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ ahiɛ, ni ji mɛi ni taooo mi, Yehowa lɛ, misɛɛgbɛ aloo amɛbiii mi nii dɔŋŋ lɛ.” Naa, Yehowa gbi lɛ eshɛ etã, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea diŋŋ yɛ ehiɛ.
Yehowa esaa afɔle lɛ eto, ni etsuu emɛi ni ekpee lɛ ahe.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbi ni mibaplene mɛi lɛ, mibagbala maŋ lumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛ bihii lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni feɔ maŋsɛɛbii akusum lɛ atoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mibagbala mɛi fɛɛ ni jaa tamɔ wɔŋjalɔi jaa lɛ, kɛ mɛi hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ yiwalɛ kɛ shishiumɔ nɔ amɛkɛnaa nii amɛwoɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi awei amli obɔ̃bɔ̃ lɛ atoi.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, abaanu yaafo he kɛbaajɛ Loo Agbo lɛ naa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni abaawo lele yɛ maŋ lɛ akutso hee lɛ mli, ni gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ ayiteiaŋ baashimɔ.
Nyɛ, maŋ lɛ Jɔɔnaabii, nyɛwoa yara nyɛfoa kɛji nyɛnu gbɛɛmɔi nɛɛ; ejaakɛ akpãtã jarayelɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni aplene mɛi ni yeɔ jwiɛtɛi jara lɛ.
“Nakai be lɛ mikɛ kane baakpa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni mibagbala emli mɛi ni amɛtsui enyɔ amɛmli, ni amɛheɔ amɛhe amɛyeɔ lɛ atoi.
No ji mɛi ni kɛɔ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yehowa efeŋ ekpakpa, ni esaa efeŋ efɔŋ hu lɛ’.
Abaaha amɛjarayeli nibii, ni amɛshĩai hu baatsɔ̃mɔ amaŋfɔ̃.
Amɛaamamɔ tsui nɛ, shi amɛwɔŋ mli, ni amɛaafee waintromi, shi amɛnuŋ amɛmli wain lɛ eko.” Yehowa gbi wulu lɛ ebɛŋkɛ etã, eeba nɔŋŋ.
Gbi lɛ baajoo naakpa, ejaakɛ nakai gbi lɛ, kãkãlɔi tete baafo waa.
Nakai gbi lɛ, mlifu kɛ amanehulu gbi ni, nifitemɔ kɛ nihiɛkpãtãmɔ gbi ni; duŋ baawo, ni jeŋ baafee kpii; atatu kɛ oblɔtu kabitii hu gbi ni.
Gbi lɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni abaabɔ oshe kɛtua maji ni atswatswaa gbogboi awo amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɔji ni kwɔlɔ lɛ hu.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibahao gbɔmɛi, ni amɛbaanyiɛ tamɔ shwilafoi.
Akɛni amɛgbo Yehowa nɔ toi lɛ, aaashwie amɛlá shi tamɔ nu, ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ wamɔ.” Nakai Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ajwiɛtɛi kɛ shika fɛɛ nyɛŋ amɛyiwala ahere.
Emlifu ni jɛ awuŋayeli mli lɛ naa la lɛ naawalɛ baakpãtã je lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ejaakɛ trukaa ni eeeplene shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Hesɛɛjee he ehia Ao, maŋ ni hiɛgbele tɔ ejwa, nyɛbuaa nyɛhe naa, ni nyɛsusua nyɛhe, dani aba mli akɛ aaakpala nyɛ kɛya tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ tswaa tutuu, dani Yehowa mlifu ni naa wa lɛ aba nyɛnɔ, dani ashɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ!
Nyɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ heshibalɔi fɛɛ ni feɔ Yehowa suɔmɔnaa nii, nyɛtaoa Yehowa sɛɛgbɛ; nyɛtaoa jalɛ sɛɛgbɛ; ni nyɛtaoa heshibaa sɛɛgbɛ, ni eko lɛ aaaŋɔ nyɛ atee yɛ Yehowa mlifu gbi lɛ nɔ.
Israel hewɔ maji lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ Abaashi Gaza maŋ lɛ afɔ̃ shi, ni Ashkelon baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Abaashwie Ashdod maŋbii lɛ shwane fintiŋŋ, ni abaafã Ekronbii lɛ hu kɛ amɛshishi fɛɛ.
Kpoo ha nyɛ, nyɛŋshɔnaabii, bo Keretibii amaŋ.
Kanaan, Filistibii ashikpɔŋ, Yehowa ebu bo fɔ; ni mibakpãtã ohiɛ, bɔ ni eshwɛŋ omɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.
Ni bo, ŋshɔnaa niiaŋ, obaatsɔ shikpɔŋ kɛ enɔ kooloi alɛɛhei kɛ tookwɛlɔi asesei kɛ toi atsui kɛkɛ.
Ŋshɔnaa shikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ Yudabii ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ.
Jɛi amɛbaalɛ amɛkooloi yɛ, ni Ashkelon maŋ lɛ shĩai lɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ kooloi lɛ awɔɔhei; ejaakɛ Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ni ebaahã amɛshwere ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Minu jɛmɔi ni Moabbii jɛɔ mimaŋbii lɛ, kɛ ahora ni Amonbii hu bɔɔ miwebii lɛ, kɛ shwãa ni amɛshwãa akɛ amɛbaashɔ̃ mimaŋbii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ.
Beiaŋ ni mi tuuŋtu ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ akɛ ja Moab tsɔ̃ tamɔ Sodom, ni Amonbii lɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ Gomora.
Amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋoo bui ashikpɔŋ kɛ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛya naanɔ; ni sansrɔ baatsa yɛ enɔ.
Mimaŋbii ni aaashwɛ lɛ aaaha Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ hu anii, ni amɛaaŋɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ.” Enɛ akɛaagbala Moabbii lɛ kɛ Amonbii lɛ atoi yɛ amɛhenɔ ni amɛwo lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛbɔ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, webii lɛ ahora.
Amɛbaashe Yehowa gbeyei naakpa.
Yehowa baashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jemawɔji fɛɛ ahiɛ shi; ni kɛkɛ lɛ maji fɛɛ baaja Yehowa yɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Ni nyɛ, Etiopiabii, Yehowa baaplene nyɛ hu.
Yehowa baakpã enine mli kɛshɛ kooyigbɛ kɛkpãtã Asiria hiɛ; ni ebaahã Nineve maŋ lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni enɔ baagbi wesewese tamɔ shiaŋa nɔ.
Jɛi baatsɔ̃ kooloi kui kɛ kooloi srɔtoi fɛɛ ashibuumɔhe.
Akpaŋai kɛ shadeboai kɛ tsui koi lɛ amli baafee amɛshihilɛhei.
Patui baabolɔ yɛ samfɛji lɛ anaa, ni kwãakwãalabitei baabolɔ yɛ shinaa kpokui lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ shĩai lɛ fɛɛ ewulewulee ewowoo mli.
Naa, maŋ lɛ ni emli fili lɛ, ni esusu akɛ eyɛ shweshweeshwe, ni no hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ehe akɛ, “Mi ji mi, ni mi misɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ lɛ, te tɛŋŋ ni etsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ kɛ kooloi kakawuai ashihilɛhe nɛɛ?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatsɔ̃ ehe kɛho lɛ aaahoso eyitso, ni ehe aaajɔ̃ ehe.”
Yerusalɛm he esha kɛ eheremɔ Kpoo ha Yerusalɛm, maŋ ni yi wa, maŋ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebule ehe!
Ebooo mɔ ko mɔ ko wiemɔ toi lɛ, ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ tsɔsemɔ hu; ekɛ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ Yehowa nɔ lɛ, etsiii ebɛŋkɛɛɛ eNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Emli lumɛi lɛ jatai ni huuɔ ni, emli kojolɔi lɛ hu klãji hɔmɔwɔlɔi ni shiii niyenii ko niyenii ko ni je atsɛre nɔ.
Emli gbalɔi lɛ yiŋflɛflɛtsɛmɛi kɛ kutumpɔfoi sɔŋŋ ni; ni emli osɔfoi lɛ ebule nii ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni amɛtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.
Yehowa mɔ ni yɔɔ amɛteŋ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni ja pɛ efeɔ; efeee nɔ ko ni ejaaa.
Daa leebi lɛ efeɔ nɔ ni ja yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, leebi ko kwraa bɛ ni efɔ̃ɔ jalɛ nii feemɔ.
Shi nɔshafeelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble tɔ ejwa.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mikpãtã maji ahiɛ dã.
Mikumɔ amɛtabilɔi atasui lɛ mishwie shi; ni amɛblohui amli kamɔ shi efoji, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko hooo yɛ mli; afite amɛmaji lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ mli, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ehiŋ amɛmli dɔŋŋ.
Mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwa, eeeshe mi gbeyei, ni eeekpɛlɛ̃ mitsɔsemɔ lɛ, ni ekuŋ ehiɛ efɔŋ mimlai ni miwo lɛ lɛ eko eko nɔ.’ Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ babaoo moŋ ni amɛfee nibii gbohiigbohii ji no.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa mi gbɛ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mate shi maye odase mashi jeŋ maji lɛ; ejaakɛ mito miyiŋ akɛ mabua majimaji lɛ anaa, ni mabua maŋtsɛmɛi hu anaa kɛkpe, koni amɛsa mimlifu kɛ mimlila ni naa wa lɛ naa amɛkwɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwuŋayeli lɛ mli mlifu la lɛ baakpãtã jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
“Nakai be lɛ mibatsake majimaji lɛ adaaŋ wiemɔ koni amɛwiemɔ he atse; ni amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛbaaja mi, Yehowa, kɛ wiemɔ ni he tse.
Mijalɔi ni ji mimɛi ni agbɛ ashwã lɛ ashwiei baajɛ Kush fai lɛ asɛɛ niiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ amɛkɛ afɔlei abahã mi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ gboŋ dɔŋŋ yɛ nibii ni nyɛfeefee nyɛkɛtse mihiɛ atua lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ majie ntɛŋfeelɔi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni nyɛwoŋ nyɛhe nɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ migɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ mibashi gbɔmɛi omlɛfoi kɛ humii pɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Amɛbaatao abobaahe yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli, amɛ mɛi ni baashwɛ yɛ Israel lɛ.
Amɛfeŋ nɔfɔŋ lɛ, amɛmaleŋ lɛ, mɔshishiumɔ wiemɔ ko ejeŋ amɛnaa.
Amɛbaahi shi, ni amɛbaashwere, ni mɔ ko woŋ amɛhe gbeyei.” Nyamɔ lala Zion biyoo, la nyamɔ lala waa!
Israel, bɔɔ oshe!
Yerusalɛm biyoo, nya; omli afili bo kɛ otsui fɛɛ!
Yehowa efo otoigbalamɔ lɛ sɛɛ; eshwie ohenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛtee.
Yehowa, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ, yɛ nyɛteŋ; nyɛsheŋ efɔŋ ko gbeyei dɔŋŋ!
Be miiba, be ni abaakɛɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ, “Kwɛ, Zion, kaashe gbeyei!
Kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui!
Yehowa, oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ bo yɛ, Taiatsɛ ni hãa ayeɔ kunim lɛ.
Eeenya ohe kɛ miishɛɛ, eeeku sɛɛ esumɔ bo ekoŋŋ.
Ebaala kɛ mliflimɔ yɛ ohewɔ, tamɔ alaa yɛ gbijurɔ nɔ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibawo amanehulu kɛje onɔ koni ohiɛ akashwie shi yɛ no hewɔ!
Be lɛ miiba!
Mikɛ mɛi ni haoɔ bo lɛ fɛɛ aaaye; Mahere mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔɔ oshii ayiwala, ni makpala mɛi ni ashwie lɛ kɛba shĩa ekoŋŋ.
Mahã amɛhiɛgbele lɛ atsɔ̃ hiɛsɔlɛ, ni amɛaana gbɛi yɛ shikpɔji fɛɛ anɔ.
Nakai be lɛ mikɛ nyɛ baaba shĩa, be mli ni mibabua nyɛnaa lɛ.
Mahã nyɛgbɛi ahehe, ni abaakafo nyɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji fɛɛ anɔ, ni mahã nyɛshwere ekoŋŋ yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛiŋ.” Yehowa wiemɔ nɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɛ wiemɔi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Hagai nɔ, yɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo mli lɛ naa abua yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Maŋbii lɛ ejɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba amɛbahi shi yɛ Yerusalɛm afii saŋŋ, shi Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kã shi koikoi lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Wiemɔi nɛɛ kanya maŋbii ahiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ koni amɛsaa amɛtswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo shi akɛ akɛni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ gbɔmɛi hei ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ, amɛbaashwere ni amɛbaana toiŋjɔlɛ hu.
Mlijaramɔi Afã akɛ asaa atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ .- Miishɛjemɔ kɛ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shɛi .-
Yehowa fã akɛ atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario, Persia nɔyelɔ lɛ yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ hã Gbalɔ Hagai ekɛbahã Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ.
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ kɛɔ akɛ be ni sa akɛ asaa atswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shɛko.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsu Hagai kɛyahã maŋbii lɛ akɛ, “Miwebii, aso esa nyɛhiɛ akɛ nyɛhi nyɛtsui ni asɛŋ nɔ amli, be mli ni miwe nɛɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃ lɛ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛjwɛŋa nyɛjeŋba he jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛduɔ nii babaoo, shi fioo pɛ nyɛnaa nyɛkpaa.
Nyɛyeɔ nii, shi nyɛtɔrɔɔɔ; ni nyɛnuɔ dãa shi nyɛtɔrɔɔɔ dãa.
Nyɛbuɔ mama, shi mɔ ko mɔ ko he efeee kulɔɔ.
Ni mɔ ni yeɔ apaa ni awoɔ lɛ nyɔmɔ hu lɛ, ekɛwoɔ kotoku ni shishi egbulɔ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa, nyɛjeŋba he jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛyaa gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛyafolɔa tsei kɛbaa nyɛkɛbamaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni mimii baashɛ mihe, ni mapue yɛ minunyam mli.
“Nyɛkwɛɔ ŋmɔshi nii babaoo gbɛ, shi ebafeɔ fioo kɛkɛ.
Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ nikpamɔnii lɛ ba shĩa hu lɛ, mifiliɔ nii lɛ mishwãa.
Mɛni hewɔ mifeɔ nakai lɛ?
Ejaakɛ miSɔlemɔ we lɛ kã shi amaŋfɔ̃, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ edɔ kɛmiitsu ewe he nii.
No hewɔ ni ŋwɛi etsi nu naa ni enɛɛɛ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu baaa niyenii lɛ.
No hewɔ mihã nuhɔmɔ eba shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni esa abele kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ nibaanii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi kɛ ninenaa nitsumɔi fɛɛ ahe nɛɛ.” Maŋbii lɛ ye Yehowa fãmɔ lɛ nɔ Kɛkɛ ni Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ lɛ mli kɛba lɛ fɛɛ, bo Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wiemɔi lɛ atoi.
Amɛshe gbeyei yɛ Yehowa hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Hagai, Yehowa bɔfo lɛ, kɛɛ maŋbii lɛ yɛ Yehowa tsumɔ lɛ naa akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa tee Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋ lɛ mli bii ni shwɛ kɛjɛ nomŋɔɔ mli kɛba lɛ hu fɛɛ amumɔ shi, ni amɛtee amɛyatsu Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he nii.
Amɛtsu nii nɛɛ yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ.
Sɔlemɔ we hee lɛ fɛo Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ekome lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi lɛ, kɛ maŋbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Namɔ eshwɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ ni na bɔ ni nɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ tsutsu anunyam lɛ yɔɔ hãa.’ Te nyɛnaa lɛ tɛŋŋ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ?
Bɛ ejeee fɛifɛi yɛ nyɛhiɛ?
Shi agbɛnɛ Zerubabel, wajemɔ ohe!
Bo Osɔfonukpa Yoshua, Yehozadak bi, bo hu wajemɔ ohe!
Nyɛ, maŋbii fɛɛ, nyɛwajea nyɛhe.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛtsua nii, ejaakɛ mi kɛ nyɛ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi be ni nyɛshi Ijipt lɛ.
Mimumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ yɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ be, be kukuoo ko kɛkɛ ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Mibahoso je lɛ mli majimaji lɛ, ni abaaloo amɛmli jwetrii lɛ kɛaaba biɛ mikɛbawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, ni eeeyi obɔ̃ tɔ kɛ anunyam sɔŋŋ.
Je lɛ mli jwiɛtɛi fɛɛ kɛ shika fɛɛ lɛ mi, minɔ ni.
Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Sɔlemɔ we nɛɛ sɛɛkpee anunyam lɛ baafe etsutsu anunyam lɛ, ni biɛ majɛ mahã miwebii lɛ ashwere, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.” Gbalɔ lɛ kɛ Osɔfoi lɛ yasusu saji ahe Nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Hagai wie.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ Hagai akɛ, “Bi osɔfoi lɛ koni amɛhã bo sane nɛɛ hetoo: ‘Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ loo ni ekɛmiishã afɔle mli eko ehɔ etade naamuu mli, ni atade lɛ naamuu lɛ yasa aboloo loo niyenii ni ahoo loo wain loo mu loo niyenii fɛɛ niyenii ko he lɛ, ani no feɔ nii lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lo?’ ” Sane nɛɛ hetoo ni osɔfoi lɛ hã ji akɛ, “Dabida”.
Kɛkɛ ni Hagai bi osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Shi kɛji mɔ ni eyata gbonyo he ni ekɛbule ehe ta nibii nɛɛ eko he hu lɛ, ani ebule nii lɛ lo?” Osɔfoi lɛ to he akɛ, “Hɛɛ”.
Kɛkɛ ni Hagai kɛɛ, “Yehowa miikɛɛ akɛ nɛkɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ji bɔ ni maŋ nɛɛ kɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli bii lɛ ebule amɛhe yɛ mihiɛ ni nakai pɛ hu ji bɔ ni abule amɛninenaa nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛkɛbashãa afɔle amɛkɛhãa mi lɛ.” Yehowa baajɔɔ ewebii lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ lɛ nyɛsusua nɔ ni eba nyɛnɔ kɛho lɛ he.
Dani nyɛbɔ̃i Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tswaa lɛ, te nyɛyaa ŋmãakuu, ni be mli ni nyɛmiikwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaana ŋmãa kei ohai enyɔ lɛ, nyɛyaninaa kei oha pɛ?
Mɔ ni baa wain bu naa akɛ eeba ebayɛ wain gbɛi oha lɛ, ebaninaa wain gbɛi nyɔŋmai enumɔ pɛ?
Mihã hela kɛ lamɔ kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi fite nyɛninenaa nitsumɔnii fɛɛ, shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛkpaleee kɛbaaa miŋɔɔ.
Nyɛkadia kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nɔ ni baaba, ŋmɛnɛ ji nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ, ni ji gbi ni nyɛto Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shishi lɛ.
Bɛ dumɔ wu ko bɛ aboŋo mli, ni wain tso kɛ agbãmi tso kɛ akutu tso kɛ mu tso woko?
Shi naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ mibajɔɔ nyɛ.” Yehowa wo Zerubabel shi Nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ji nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ wiemɔ ni ji enyɔ tsu Gbalɔ Hagai, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ Yuda Amralo Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi lɛ, akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni mibahoso ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ hu, ni mibakpa maŋtsɛmɛi fɛɛ, ni mibafo amɛlumɔyeli sɛɛ.
Mibakpãtã tayaa shwiilii kɛ shwiilii lɛ amlitaralɔi fɛɛ ahiɛ, ni mahã amɛkpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ adɔ amɛhe amɛgbegbee amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛhe.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Zerubabel, Shealtiel bi, mitsulɔ, mibaŋɔ bo koni oye maŋbii lɛ alumɔ yɛ mi migbɛi mli, ejaakɛ bo ji mɔ ni mihala.” Mi, Taiatsɛ, mi mikɛɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Zakaria wolo lɛ hiɛ mlijai srɔtoi krɛdɛɛi enyɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ ji, kɛjɛ Yitso -.
No kɔɔ gbalɛi ni gbalɔ Zakaria gba eto yɛ bei srɔtoi, kɛjɛ afi Dani Afɔ Kristo lɛ amli lɛ ahe.
Gbalɛi nɛɛ ji ninai ni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ Zakaria; ni amɛkɔɔ bɔ ni asaa atswa Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama shi ekoŋŋ lɛ he, kɛ bɔ ni atsuu Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ ahe ahã.
Ekɔɔ Kpɔ̃lɔ kɛ yinɔ ni baaba lɛ hu ahe.
Mlijaa ni ji enyɔ lɛ ji Yitsei - kɔɔ shɛi srɔtoi ni abua naa yɛ Kpɔlɔ ni akwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ kɛ adesai anaagbee kojomɔ lɛ hu ahe.
Mlijaramɔi Kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ Hiɛnɔkãmɔ he Shɛi .—.
Kojomɔ ni kã shi hã maji ni kɛ Israel bɛŋkɛ lɛ .- Wɔsɛɛ shweremɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ .—.
Yehowa tsɛ ewebii akɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Persia Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ gbalɔ Zakaria ni ji Berekia bi ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mi Yehowa, mimli efu nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waa naakpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ amɛ akɛ bɔ ni mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ amɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni mi hu makpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ.
Nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ; mɛi ni tsutsu gbalɔi lɛ shiɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛje amɛgbɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ kɛ amɛnifeemɔ nii gbohii lɛ ahe lɛ.
Ni amɛbooo toi, shi moŋ amɛkwa mi.
Nɛgbɛ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ yɔɔ?
Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ani amɛhiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ lo?
Shi miwiemɔi kɛ mikpɔi lɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mitsuji gbalɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ shɛ amɛdɛŋ, shi amɛyabuuu, ni amɛna he toigbalamɔ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshwa amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, bɔ ni mito akɛ mikɛ amɛ baaye yɛ amɛjeŋba kɛ nifeemɔnii hewɔ lɛ, nakai pɛpɛɛpɛ mikɛ amɛ eye nɛɛ.’ ” Gbalɔ lɛ ninaa yɛ okpɔŋɔi ahe Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ, ni ji Shebat nyɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Gbalɔ Zakaria, Berekia bi lɛ, ni eji Ido nabi lɛ wie ekoŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Zakaria gba ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mina ninaa ko nyɔɔŋ ni nuu ko ta okpɔŋɔ tsuru nɔ, ni edamɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei ateŋ yɛ jɔɔ ko mli.
Ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji kɛ okpɔŋɔi okɔbɛŋi kɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji hu damɔ shi yɛ esɛɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni, mi Zakaria, mibi nuu lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, “Mibatsɔ̃ɔ bo amɛshishi.” No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ lɛ hã hetoo akɛ, “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni Yehowa tsu koni amɛyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛ hu amɛ jie Yehowa bɔfo lɛ ni damɔ shi yɛ mirto tsei lɛ ateŋ ni wie lɛ naa amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔtee wɔyasara shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nɔ ni wɔna ji akɛ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kã shi butuu ni hewalɛ ko bɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ wo egbee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ao, Yehowa, afii nyɔŋmai kpawo sɔŋŋ nɛ ni omli fu Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda maji lɛ.
Mɛɛbe omusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ bo yɛ amɛhe?” Yehowa kɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ wie miishɛjemɔ wiemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Gbaa akɛ bɔ ni Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, Yerusalɛm kɛ Zion maji lɛ fɛɛ asane kã mitsui nɔ jogbaŋŋ diɛŋtsɛ.
Shi mimli efu maji ni he ejɔ amɛ lɛ naakpa, ejaakɛ be ni mimli fu mimaŋ lɛ fioo lɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ kã amɛnɔnaa lɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ eku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm; aaama miwe lɛ yɛ emli, ni aaatswa Yerusalɛm ama shi ekoŋŋ.” “Shiɛmɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Mimaji lɛ aaashwere ekoŋŋ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni aaashɛje Zion mii, ni eeeŋɔ Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ efee emaŋ.’ ” Akloŋtoi lɛ ahe ninaa Ni miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina akloŋtoi ejwɛ yɛ ninaa kroko mli, ni mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi?” Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi ji akloŋtoi ni ji nɔyelɔi ahewalɛi ni gbɛ Yuda kɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalɛm shwã lɛ.” Agbɛnɛ Yehowa jie sɔ̃lɔi ejwɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mi.
Ni mibi akɛ, “Mɛni mɛnɛɛmɛi hu baa amɛbafee?” Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo akɛ, “Amɛba koni amɛbawo akloŋtoi ejwɛ ni gbɛ Yuda shwã bɔ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko wooo eyitso nɔ lɛ ahe gbeyei; amɛbakpɔlɔ maji lɛ akloŋtoi ni amɛkɛshilɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni amɛkɛgbɛ Yuda amɛshwã lɛ.”
Susumɔ kpãa lɛ he ninaa Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ, ni mina nuu ko ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa yɛ edɛŋ.
Mibi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oyaa?” Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ, “Miyasusu Yerusalɛm koni mana ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ.” Ni naa, bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ je kpo; ni bɔfo kroko hu je kpo tee kɛ lɛ yakpe.
Klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ fã bɔfo kroko lɛ ekɛɛ, “Sha foi ni oyakɛɛ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ ni hiɛ susumɔ kpãa lɛ akɛ, Yerusalɛm he baakã efolo tamɔ akrowa ni atswako gbogbo awoko he yɛ emli gbɔmɛi kɛ kooloi ayifalɛ hewɔ.
Mi, Yehowa, matsɔ̃ la kɛbɔle maŋ lɛ he kɛkpe, tamɔ gbogbo, ni matsɔ̃ emli anunyam.
Mi, Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Atsɛ Nomii lɛ akɛ amɛba shĩa Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui!
Nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa Yerusalɛm; ejaakɛ mi, migbɛ nyɛ mishwã tamɔ ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ.” Yehowa kɛɛ, “Huui!
Kuu osɛɛ oba Zion, bo mɔ ni okɛ Babilon biyoo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Enunyam lɛ sɛɛ lɛ etsu mi kɛtee maji ni hahaa nyɛnii lɛ aŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko ta nyɛhe lɛ eta mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛiŋ ajaŋmalaatɛ he.
Naa, mawo minine nɔ yɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ haanii amɛhã amɛtsuji ni sɔ̃mɔ amɛ lɛ.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ.” “Nyɛlaa, ni nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛ Yerusalɛmbii, shi naa, miba mibahi nyɛteŋ.” Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, maji babaoo kɛ amɛhe aaahã Yehowa ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimɛi, ni mahi amɛteŋ.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ hu Yehowa aaaŋɔ Yuda akɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ; asaŋ eeeŋɔ Yerusalɛm hu akɛ emaŋ ekoŋŋ.
Gbɔmɛi fɛɛ afee dioo yɛ Yehowa hiɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi kɛjɛ eshihilɛhe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Gbalɔ lɛ ninaa yɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ he Agbɛnɛ ehã mina Yoshua ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ ni edamɔ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ hiɛ, ni satan hu damɔ Yoshua ninejurɔ ni ebaafolɔ enaa.
Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Satan akɛ, “Satan, Yehowa akã ohiɛ.
Yehowa mɔ ni eŋɔ Yerusalɛm akɛ enɔ lɛ aaakã ohiɛ.
Ani oleee akɛ latso ni afã yɛ la naa ji mɔ nɛ?” No mli lɛ Yoshua wo atadei mujimuji kɛdamɔ bɔfo lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ ehiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea atadei mujimuji lɛ yɛ ehe.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ Yoshua hu akɛ, “Bɔ ni ajie ohe atadei nɛɛ lɛ, nakai ajie ohe eshai lɛ ashwie, ni mawula bo kɛ atadei ni jara wa.” Ni mikɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛ fai ni he tse abu lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ fai ni he tse bu lɛ, ni amɛwula lɛ kɛ atadei.
Ni Yehowa bɔfo lɛ damɔ shi yɛ jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ Yoshua akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Kɛji oooba ojeŋ bɔ ni mitaoɔ, ni oooye mimlai ni miwo lɛ anɔ lɛ, no lɛ bo obaakwɛ misɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ ehe kpoi lɛ anɔ.
Asaŋ mahã bo hegbɛ ni ofata mimɛi ni damɔɔ biɛ lɛ ahe.
Agbɛnɛ, bo osɔfonukpa Yoshua, bo toi, bo kɛ onanemɛi osɔfoi krokomɛi ni yɔɔ oshishi lɛ fɛɛ.
Mɛi nɛɛ ji shade ni baaba lɛ he okadi lɛ.
Naa, mibawo mitsulɔ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tsonine, gbɛ kɛba.
Asaŋ mikɛ tɛ koome ni yɛ hiɛi kpawo ema Yoshua hiɛ, ni makpɛ niŋmaa yɛ nakai tɛ lɛ nɔ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ.
Ni mikɛ gbi kome baagbe shikpɔŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔ fɛɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaakpee enaanyo kɛaaba ewaintso kɛ agbãmitso shishi, Yehowa kɛɛ.’ ”
Kanetso lɛ he Ninaa Bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ batsiɛ mi ekoŋŋ tamɔ atsiɛɔ mɔ yɛ ewɔ mli.
Ni ebi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “Miina kanetso ni akɛ shika sɔŋŋ fee; ni emutɔ ko ma eyiteŋ.
Kanetso nɛɛ yɛ kanei kpawo mamɔ eyiteŋ; ni kanei nɛɛ, eko fɛɛ eko hu yɛ odontii kpawo ni asuɔ.
Asaŋ mutsei enyɔ mamɔ kanetso lɛ masɛi; ekome yɛ mutɔ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni ekome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ.” Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Minuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Ani oleee nɔ ni nibii nɛɛ ji?” Ni mikɛɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, dabida.” Shi ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo Zerubabel Bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Shɛɛ ni Yehowa kɛhãa Zerubabel nɛ, ‘Jeee onyɛmɔ baahã oye kunim, loo ohewalɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mimumɔ lɛ ni baahã oye kunim,’ Mi Yehowa, mikɛɛ.” Shi bo gɔŋ kpeteŋkple, mɛni mli oyɔɔ?
Obaatsɔ ŋa kplanaa yɛ Zerubabel hiɛ.
Ebaakɔ oyiteŋ tɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛba, ni aaabɔ oshe kɛaaba akɛ, “Dromɔ, dromɔ naa sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ.” Yehowa saa ekɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Zerubabel eto shĩa nɛɛ shishi, ni ebaatswa egbe naa hu.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbe nitsumɔ lɛ ni eyaaa nɔ lɛ he guɔ lɛ baana Zerubabel ni ehiɛ tsumalɔi akulomulo lɛ yɛ edɛŋ ekɛ miitswa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛbaanya.
Kanetsei kpawo nɛɛ ji Yehowa hiŋmɛii ni ekɛkwɛɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.” Agbɛnɛ mibi bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ ni yɔɔ kanetso lɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku lɛ?
Misaa mibi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ nɔ akɛ, te mutsei enyɔ ni yɔɔ shika bɛji enyɔ lɛ ni mu hoɔ yɛ mli lɛ ashishi hu?” Bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Ani oleee enɛɛmɛi ashishi?” Mihã hetoo akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ Dabida.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nibii nɛɛ damɔ shi hã mɛi enyɔ ni ahala amɛ, ni afɔ amɛ mu koni amɛsɔmɔ Yehowa mɔ ni ji jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.”
Wolokpo ni filikiɔ lɛ he ninaa Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki.
Ni bɔfo lɛ bi mi akɛ, “Mɛni onaa nɛɛ?” Mihã lɛ hetoo mikɛɛ akɛ, “Miina wolo kpo ko ni miifiliki; ekɛlɛ ji ninetalɔi nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ elɛɛmɔ ninetalɔi nyɔŋma.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Enɛ ji loomɔ ni gbɛɔ eshwãa shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ.
No ji akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni juɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakã kitã ni eyeŋ nɔ lɛ aaana nakai toigbalamɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.” Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Miihã loomɔ nɛɛ asa julɔ fɛɛ julɔ we he, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ migbɛi ekɛkãa kitã ni eyeee nɔ lɛ hu we he.
Loomɔ nɛɛ aaahi mɔ lɛ we lɛ nɔ kɛyaashi eeekpatã shĩa lɛ kɛ emli tsei kɛ tɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Yoo ni yɔɔ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli lɛ he ninaa Agbɛnɛ bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ ba ekoŋŋ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wo ohiɛ nɔ ni okwɛ nɔ ni baa lɛ.” Mibi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ni?” Ni ehere nɔ akɛ, “Kɛntɛŋ ni, ni edamɔ shi hã je lɛ fɛɛ he esha lɛ.” No sɛɛ lɛ, agbele kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa; enaanɔ lɛ sumui akɛfee; ni yoo ko ta shi yɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ damɔ shi hã yiwalɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni enyɛ yoo lɛ nɔ ewo kɛntɛŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ naanɔ ni akɛ sumui fee lɛ bu kɛntɛŋ lɛ naa.
Miwo mihiɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ ni mina yei enyɔ ni miifiliki kɛmiiba kɛ fiji ni tamɔ faanaa oka nɔ.
Amɛbawo kɛntɛŋ lɛ kɛnyiɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ kɛtee.
Mibi bɔfo ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ yaa nɛɛ?” Ehã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛkɛmiiya Babilon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; koni amɛyama tsu yɛ jɛi amɛha lɛ.
Kɛji agbe tsu lɛ maa naa lɛ amɛkɛ kɛntɛŋ lɛ baayi shi kɛyama egbɛhe.”
Tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ lɛ ahe ninaa Misaa miwo mihiɛ nɔ ni mina tayaa shwiilii ejwɛ komɛi fã kpo kɛjɛ akɔɔble gɔji enyɔ komɛi ateŋ kɛba.
Klɛŋklɛŋ tayaa shwiili lɛ okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni gbalaa; ni shwiili ni ji enyɔ lɛ okpɔŋɔi diji ni gbalaa; shwiili ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ okpɔŋɔi yɛji ni gbalaa; ni nɔ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ okpɔŋɔi truntrãi ni he wa gbalaa.
Kɛkɛ ni mibi bɔfo lɛ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ, mɛni ji enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” Bɔfo lɛ hã mi hetoo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi damɔ shi hã ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ.
Amɛmiiya amɛkɛ amɛhe ayatsɔ̃ɔ jeŋ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, koni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛya ŋwɛi kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.” Tayaa shwiili lɛ ni okpɔŋɔi diji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi yɛji lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya anaigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ni okpɔŋɔi truntrãi lɛ gbalaa lɛ miiya wuoyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni okpɔŋɔi tsuji ni he wa lɛ fã kpo lɛ, amɛhe tswa shi koni amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni bɔfo lɛ fã amɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyakpaa shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee amɛyakpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Naa, okpɔŋɔi ni yaa kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ejɔɔ mi, Yehowa, mitsui he yɛ nakai kooyigbɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.” Afã akɛ abu Yoshua akekre Yehowa kɛ mi wie ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ jwiɛtɛi nibii kɛ shika nibii hu ni nomii lɛ ni ji Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛjɛ Babilon kɛbake lɛ, ni okɛya Zefania bi Yosia we lɛ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Okɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika ni oŋɔ yɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ afee maŋtsɛ fai ni okɛbu Yehozadak bi Yoshua, ni ji osɔfonukpa lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, okɛɛ lɛ akɛ bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Naa, nuu lɛ ni egbɛi ji Tsonine lɛ, ebaada yɛ enajiaŋ, ni lɛ ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni ebaama Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni abaawo ehiɛ nyam akɛ lumɔ, ni ebaata emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ kɛye elumɔ lɛ.
Osɔfo ko hu baahi emaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ he, ni shishinumɔ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ baahi amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛteŋ.’ Ato nɛkɛ maŋtsɛ fai nɛɛ yɛ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ mli, koni akɛkai Heldai kɛ Tobia kɛ Yedaia kɛ Yosia ni ji Zefania bi lɛ.” Mɛi baajɛ maji asɛɛ shɔŋŋ abaye abua kɛma Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
No nyɛkɛaale akɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, ni tsu mi nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ.
Kɛji nyɛaabo Yehowa, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, toi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, enɛ aaaba mli ahã nyɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Dario yinɔ afi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ nyɔŋ ni ji nɛɛhu, ni ji Kislev nyɔŋ, lɛ nɔ gbi ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie.
No mli lɛ Betelbii lɛ etsu Sharezer kɛ Regem-Melek kɛ amɛmɛi kɛba Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ koni amɛbasɔle amɛkpa fai.
Asaŋ koni amɛbi osɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔfo ni wɔhi ŋmãa yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ hu nɔ tamɔ wɔfeɔ yɛ afii babaoo ni eho lɛ amli lɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Bi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ nɔ bii lɛ kɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, be ni nyɛhi ŋmãa ni nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ hu nɔ, yɛ afi nyɔŋmai kpawo nɛɛ mli lɛ, ani mi, Yehowa nyɛhi ŋmãa lɛ nyɛhã lo?
Be ni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii lɛ, ani jeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu nii nyɛhã lɛ?” Be ni mɛi yɔɔ Yerusalɛm ni ekɛ emaji kɛ eshikpɔji ni bɔle ehe lɛ shwereɔ lɛ, be mli ni mɛi yɔɔ wuoyigbɛ kɛ ŋa nɔ gbɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani jeee nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɔŋŋ Yehowa hã ashiɛ kɛtsɔ̃ eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ lo?
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛ Zakaria wie ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nyɛkojoa yɛ jalɛ naa, ni nyɛkɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ahia shi akɛ nyɛmimɛi.
Nyɛkawaa okulafo loo awusa loo gbɔ loo ohiafo yi.
Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akasusu enyɛmi he efɔŋ ko yɛ emli.’ “Shi moŋ mimaŋ lɛ waje amɛtsui ni amɛkɛ kuɛŋtilɛ booo toi; amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii koni amɛkanu wiemɔ lɛ.
Amɛkpliŋ amɛtsui koni amɛkabo mla lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ emumɔ lɛ nɔ ekɛtsu eklɛŋklɛŋ gbalɔi lɛ ni eŋɔ hã lɛ toi.
No hewɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ mlifu amɛ naakpa lɛ.
Akɛni mitsɛ amɛ shi amɛfooo mli lɛ, no hewɔ ni amɛbolɔ amɛtsɛ mi ni mi hu mibooo amɛ toi lɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ, lɛ kɛɛ nɛ.
Ni no hã mi kɛ lasuogbele gbɛ amɛshwã kɛtee majiasɛɛ hei ni amɛleee lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ ni amɛshi nɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ yɛ amɛsɛɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko eyaaa mli, ni mɔ ko ejeee mli hu lɛ.
Amɛshikpɔŋ fɛɛfɛo lɛ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.”
Yehowa kɛɛ, ebaatswa Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi, Zakaria, wie akɛ, “Bɔ ni mi, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɛ nɛ, miiye awuŋã ni naa wa naakpa yɛ Zion he; mikɛ hiɛdɔɔ ni naa wa miiye ehe awuŋã nɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, mibaku misɛɛ kɛba Zion, ni mibahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni abaatsɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ anɔkwale maŋ, kɛ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ gɔŋ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Krɔŋkrɔŋ.’ Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, hiimeji kɛ yeimeji ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hiɛ dɛhiɛmɔtso yɛ egbɔlɛ hewɔ baatara Yerusalɛm blohuiaŋ ekoŋŋ; Ni maŋ lɛ mli blohuiaŋ aaayimɔ tɔ kɛ gbekɛbii hii kɛ gbekɛbii yei ni miishwɛ.
Kɛji gbalɛ nɛɛ yɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, ani mi hu eeefee naakpɛɛ yɛ mihiɛ lo?
Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, naa, mibahere mimaŋbii lɛ ayiwala kɛaajɛ bokã kɛ anai shikpɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ; ni mikɛ amɛ aaaba koni amɛbahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ, ni matsɔ amɛNyɔŋmɔ yɛ anɔkwale kɛ jalɛ mli.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnuɔ gbalɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ be ni ato Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, Sɔlemɔ we lɛ maa shishi nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnijiaŋ akajea wui bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ama.
Ejaakɛ be ni nakai be lɛ shɛko lɛ gbɔmɔ nitsumɔ feɔ yaka, ni kooloo nitsumɔ hu feɔ yaka, ni mɔ ni jeɔ kpo loo ebaa mli lɛ naaa hejɔlɛ yɛ haolɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mihã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ete shi ewo enaanyo.
Shi agbɛnɛ mikɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ nɛɛ yeŋ kɛ joomɔ tamɔ mifee tsutsu bii lɛ.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
“Ejaakɛ aaadu nii yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ mli, waintsei lɛ aaawo yibii, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ aaaba nii, bɔ aaajɛ ŋwɛi anyɔ ashwie nɔ, ni mibahã enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ maŋ lɛ mli mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ anɔ.
Naa, Yuda we kɛ Israel we, bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ akɛ majimaji, ni amɛkɛ nyɛgbɛi lomɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mahere nyɛyiwala, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃ jɔɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛgbɛi baajɔɔ.
Nyɛkashea gbeyei, shi moŋ nyɛwajea nyɛhe ni nyɛfea ekãa kɛkɛ.” Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ nɛ, “Bɔ ni mito miyiŋ ni mafee nyɛ efɔŋ ni mishwaŋ mihe be ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ wo mi mlifu lɛ, nakai mito miyiŋ bei nɛɛ amli akɛ mibafee Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda we ejurɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea gbeyei.
Nyɛfea nibii nɛɛ: nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awiea anɔkwale; asaŋ nyɛyea jalɛ sane yɛ nyɛkoii ashi bɔ ni baahã toiŋjɔlɛ aba.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akabɛ enaanyo ewo emli.
Nyɛkasumɔa amale kitãkãmɔ; ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi ji nibii ni minyɛɔ.
Mi, Yehowa mikɛɛ.” Ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, Bɔ ni, Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, mikɛɔ nɛ, “Ŋmãa ni nyɛhiɔ yɛ nyɔŋ ni ji ejwɛ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji enumɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ, kɛ nyɔŋ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ nɔ lɛ baatsɔ̃ nyamɔ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ mliflimɔ gbii juji ahã Yudabii.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsumɔa anɔkwale kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Mɛi aaakã he ajɛ majimaji babaoo anɔ aba.
Ni maŋ kome mli bii aaaya maŋ kroko mli ayakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔyaa wɔyakpaa Yehowa fai, ni asaŋ wɔyatao esɛɛ gbɛ hu.
Mi hu maya.’ Mɛi babaoo kɛ majimaji ni ahe wa tete aaba Yerusalɛm abatao Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, sɛɛgbɛ ni amɛaakpa lɛ fai.” Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ nɛ, “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma ni jɛ majimaji ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi anɔ baamɔ Yudanyo kome atade mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ha wɔkɛ bo aya, ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ yɛ.’ ”
Yehowa kojo jeŋmaji lɛ Yehowa wie eshi Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ ni nakai wiemɔ lɛ saa Damasko hu he; ejaakɛ Siria maji wuji lɛ hu Yehowa nɔ ji fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni enɔ ji Israel akutsei lɛ.
Enɔ ji Hamat hu ni kɛ Hadrak shikpɔŋ lɛ je husu lɛ, kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon fɛɛ, tsɛbelɛ amɛnilee naa wa naakpa.
Tiro etswa gbogbo ewo ehe ni ebua jwiɛtɛi naa tamɔ mlu kɛ shika tsuru hu naa tamɔ blohuŋ shia.
Shi naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baashɔ̃ enii ni ena nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni aaashɛrɛ enii kpakpai lɛ fɛɛ ashwie ŋshɔ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ akɛ la aakpãtã ehiɛ.
Ashkelon maŋ lɛ aaana ni eeeshe gbeyei; Gaza hu aaana ni ehe aaakpokpo naakpa.
Ekron hu aaana ejaakɛ ehiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ aaafee yakatswaa.
Gaza maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã, ni Ashkelon hu baatsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃.
Yoo ajwamãŋbii aaahi Ashdod; Filistibii lɛ ahewoo lɛ, mafo sɛɛ.
Mahã amɛkpa loo ni emli lá fɛɛ tsereko yeli kwraa, ni amɛnihiinii tekeŋ amɛtsɛ̃ŋ, ni emli mɛi komɛi kɛ̃ aaashwɛ ahã wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yuda akutsei lɛ eko; ni Ekronbii hu aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Yebusbii.
No sɛɛ lɛ, mabu miwebii lɛ ahe tamɔ bulɔ, koni asraafoi akuu ko kuu ko akatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛtee kɛba.
Miŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni haolɔ ko agba miwebii lɛ anaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ agbɛnɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiŋmɛi kã amɛhe.
Wɔsɛɛ ko Maŋtsɛ Omli afili bo, bo Zion biyoo; Bɔɔ oshe waa, bo Yerusalɛm biyoo!
Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ; Eeba kɛ agbojee kɛ kunimyeli.
Eta teji oblanyo ni ji teji yoo bi ko nɔ.
Makpãtã ta shwiilii fɛɛ ni aaajɛ Efraim aba lɛ ahiɛ; ni majie ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ hu kɛje Yerusalɛm.
Makumɔ tawuu gãii lɛ amli dukuduku.
Eeeshi maji lɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni elumɔyeli aaajɛ ŋshɔnaa kɛyagbee ŋshɔnaa.
Ni eeejɛ Eufrate Faa lɛ naa kɛyashi je lɛ naagbee hei tɔ̃ɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ akpɔ̃mɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ saa kɛɛ, “Bo Zion biyoo hu, Milá ni mikɛsɔo mikɛo teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa hewɔ lɛ, majie obii ni etsɔ̃mɔ gboklɛfoi lɛ yɛ bu ni nu bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Nyɛ gboklɛfoi ni nyɛyɔɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ, nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ nyɛbaa mɔɔ ni wa lɛ mli.
Ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mibato nyɛ najiaŋ toi enyɔ.
Ejaakɛ midɔ Yuda mli tamɔ gãitso, ni mikɛ Efraim efee egãimlibi.
Bo Zion, matee obihii lɛ ashi, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ klante yɛ midɛŋ, yɛ bo, Hela, obihii lɛ anɔ.” Agbɛnɛ Yehowa aaapue yɛ ewebii lɛ anɔ ni egãimlibii lɛ aafliki tamɔ srawa gbalaa lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni aaakpã eta tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ, ni eeefã tamɔ wuoyigbɛ lasuogbele.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, aaabu emɛi ahe; Amɛaatserɛ amɛhenyɛlɔi amli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛ nɔ.
Amɛaashwie amɛhenyɛlɔi alá shi ni lá lɛ aaaho tamɔ afɔleshãa kooloo lá ni afɔse kɛmiijɛ okpolu mli aashwie afɔleshãa latɛ nɔ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahere amɛyiwala; ejaakɛ etooku ji amɛ; Amɛaakpɛlɛ yɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tamɔ akekre he ojarawatɛi.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ aaaŋɔɔ, eeefee fɛo; abele aaahã oblahii afrɔke ni wain hee hu aaahã oblayei afrɔke.
Yehowa wo kpɔ̃mɔ he shi Nyɛbia Yehowa koni ehã Agbiɛnaa nu anɛ nyɛ.
Nyɛbia Yehowa mɔ ni hãa ahum fãa ni ehãa nu nɛɔ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋa nɔ tsei fɛɛ anɔ lɛ.
Nɔ ni amãgãi lɛ kɛɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ bɛ mli, ni klamɔfoi lɛ aninaa lɛ apasa sɔŋŋ ni.
Mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ lamɔi ashishi lɛ maleɔ, ni amɛshɛjeɔ mɔ mii yakatswaa; no hewɔ lɛ, maŋbii lɛ kpaa shi tamɔ toi, amɛnaa nɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ kwɛlɔ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Mimli efu tookwɛlɔi ni ji maŋsɛɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, ni magbala amɛhiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ atoi; ejaakɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, jwɛŋɔ etooku ni ji Yudabii lɛ ahe; ni eeehã amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ etayaa okpɔŋɔ ni eshwãa efɔ̃ɔ enɔ lɛ.
Koŋtɛ lɛ aaajɛ Yuda mli, emli nɔŋŋ buu lɛ shiŋmlitso lɛ hu aaajɛ, kɛ tawuu gãitso lɛ kɛ lumɛi srɔtoi fɛɛ hu.
Yudabii lɛ aaatsɔmɔ kãkãlɔi yɛ ta mli, ni amɛaanaanaa amɛhenyɛlɔi anɔ yɛ blohuiaŋ tamɔ anaa ŋmiamɔ.
Amɛbaawu tai ni amɛaahã amɛhenyɛlɔi tabilɔi okpɔŋɔianɔtralɔi ahiɛ ashwie shi, ejaakɛ Yehowa kɛ amɛ yɛ.
“Mibahã Yuda he awa, ni mahere Israel yiwala.
Mikɛ amɛ aaaku sɛɛ kɛba ejaakɛ mimusuŋ etsɔ̃ mi yɛ amɛhe.
Amɛaatsɔ̃ tamɔ mɛi ni mikwako amɛ dã, ejaakɛ mi ji Yehowa, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ni mabo amɛfaikpamɔ toi.
Nakai be lɛ Efraim aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ tatsɛ kpaanaa, ni emlibii amli aaafli amɛ tamɔ mɛi ni enu wain.
Amɛshwiei aaana nɔ ni Yehowa etsu lɛ; ni amɛmii aaashɛ amɛhe; ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ.
“Mikɛ okadi aaatsɛ amɛ, ni mabua amɛnaa ejaakɛ mi mikpɔ̃ amɛ, ni amɛyi aaafa ekoŋŋ tamɔ sa.
Migbɛ amɛ mishwã maŋsɛɛ maji anɔ moŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, amɛaakai mi, yɛ hei ni amɛyɔɔ yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ.
Amɛ kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ yi aaana wala, ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ amɛaaba ekoŋŋ.
Makpala amɛ kɛjɛ Ijipt kɛba.
Mabua amɛnaa kɛjɛ Asiria hu.
Mikɛ amɛ aaaba Gilead shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛ Lebanon shikpɔŋ lɛ hu nɔ kɛyaashi anaŋ gbɛ yɛ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ahã amɛ.
Amɛbaafo amanehulu ŋshɔ lɛ, mahã ŋshɔkei lɛ aŋmɛ dɛŋŋ.
Nilo Faa lɛ fɛɛ kwa baagbi.
Abaaba Asiria hetsɛmɔ lɛ shi, ni Ijipt hewalɛ lɛ sɛɛ baafo.
Mawo amɛ hewalɛ lɛ yɛ Yehowa mli, ni amɛbaanya yɛ egbɛi mli.
Mi, Yehowa, mi mikɛɛ.”
Yiwalɔi lɛ ashigbeemɔ “Ao, Lebanon, gbelemɔ oshinai lɛ, koni la ashã otsenedrui lɛ.
Ao, sɛsɛo, wo yara ni ofo, ejaakɛ tsenedru lɛ eku egbee shi; ejaakɛ tsei ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ ahiɛ ekpãtã.
Bashan odum, wo yara nyɛfoa, ejaakɛ agba koo haii lɛ tete.
Bo toi, tookwɛlɔi lɛ ewo yara.
Bo toi, jatai miihuu, Naa, Yordan he koo lɛ hiɛ ekpãtã.
ejaakɛ amɛnunyam sɛɛ efo.
Tookwɛlɔi enyɔ lɛ Bɔ ni Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Feemɔ ohe tamɔ tookwɛlɔ ni kwɛɔ tooku ni ayaagbe amɛ.
Mɛni hewɔ tookwɛlɔi lɛ gbeɔ toi nɛɛ ni agbalaaa amɛ toi.
Mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ toi nɛɛ hu kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ajie Yehowa yi ejaakɛ wɔtsɔmɔ niiatsɛmɛi.’ Ni amɛkwɛlɔi lɛ tete po enaaa kooloi lɛ amɔbɔ.” “No hewɔ lɛ, minaŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko mɔbɔ dɔŋŋ yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ; naa, maŋmɛɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ he mawo enɔkwɛlɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛ hu dɛŋ.
Ni nɔkwɛlɔi nɛɛ baakpãtã shikpɔŋ lɛ hiɛ ni mihereŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yiwala.
“Hewɔ lɛ mitsɔ̃ toi ni abaagbe ahã tookwɛlɔi nɛɛ akwɛlɔ.
Mikɔlɔ kplamɔtsei enyɔ.
Miwo ekome gbɛi akɛ, ‘Dromɔ’ kɛ ekome hu akɛ, ‘Ekomefeemɔ!’ Nomɛi mikɛkpalaa tooku lɛ.
Mikpãtã tookwɛlɔi etɛ̃ ahiɛ yɛ nyɔŋ kome mli, ejaakɛ minaaa amɛhe tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛnyaŋe mi.
No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ mifeŋ nyɛkwɛlɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Too ni baagbo lɛ, egbo, nɔ ni hiɛ baakpãtã hu, ehiɛ akpãtã; ni nɔ ni aaashwɛ lɛ, amɛyeyee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi aloo.” Kɛkɛ ni mikɔ mikplamɔtso ni gbɛi ji ‘Dromɔ’ lɛ, ni miku mli, ni mikɛku kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ miwebii lɛ ekpãŋ lɛ mli.
Hewɔ lɛ aku kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli nakai gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni too jarayelɔi lɛ ni kwɛɔ mi lɛ nu shishi akɛ Yehowa wiemɔ naanii ni.
Agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ jarayelɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji esa nyɛhiɛ lɛ no lɛ nyɛwoa mi nyɔmɔ; shi kɛji esaaa nyɛhiɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ahi shi.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋmɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Okɛyawo Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, mikɛ jwiɛtɛi talentai nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni amɛkɛwo mi nyɔmɔ lɛ yawo Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fotro lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ miku kplamɔtso ni ji enyɔ lɛ ni gbɛi ji ‘Ekomefeemɔ’ lɛ mli, ni mikɛfo nyɛmimɛi anaanyobɔɔ ni kã Yuda kɛ Israel teŋ lɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ Yehowa kɛɛ mi akɛ, “kɔlɔmɔ tookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ nitsumɔ nibii ohiɛ, Shi naa, miitee tookwɛlɔ ko shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; lɛ lɛ, jeee ehe sane ko ji too ni miigbo lɛ.
Toi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ ebuaŋ amɛnaa.
Nɔ ni epila lɛ, etsaŋ lɛ; ni toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ lɛ ehaŋ amɛ niyenii amɛyeŋ; shi moŋ gbe eeegbe toi ni ewowoi fɔ lɛ eye, belɛ eekpɔlɔ amɛnaji ahe koklotoi lɛ eeshwie.
Kpoo hã mitookwɛlɔ yakagbɔmɔ lɛ, mɔ ni shiɔ etooku lɛ; lɛ lɛ, aaafo eninejurɔ yɛ ta mli, ni aaajwa eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi hu yɛ ta mli.
Enine agbo kwraa yɛ ehe, ni eninejurɔ hiŋmɛi lɛ hu ashwila kwrakwra.”
Yerusalɛm kpɔ̃mɔ̃ ni baaba lɛ Wiemɔ ni Yehowa wie yɛ Israel he lɛ nɛ.
Bɔ ni Yehowa mɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi ni ha shi nɛɛ, ni bɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni ebɔ mumɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, “Naa, mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tamɔ dãa yɛ kpulu mli mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabasa enaa ekwɛ lɛ aaadidãa tamɔ dãatɔlɔ.
Kɛji maŋ ko fã ta basa Yerusalɛm yi lɛ, belɛ ekɛ ta lɛ etua Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã Yerusalɛm atsɔ̃ tɛ ni tsii mahã maji ni bɔle lɛ lɛ.
Maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni aaaka tɛ nɛɛ nɔ womɔ lɛ aaapila.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ majimaji krokomɛi fɛɛ aaafee ekome amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mahã henyɛlɔi lɛ akpoŋɔi fɛɛ ajijaa, ni okpɔŋɔnɔtalɔi lɛ hu aye sɛkɛ.
Shi be ni mashwila henyɛlɔi lɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahiŋmɛii lɛ mahã mihiŋmɛii akã Yudabii lɛ ahe.
Mi Yehowa, mi, mikɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yuda akutsei lɛ baakɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahewalɛ lɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, ni ji amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ ejɛ.’ “Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ, mahã Yuda akutsei lɛ atsɔ̃ tamɔ la kɛ ŋɛsu yɛ laii ateŋ; amɛaatamɔ jatɛŋ ni tsoɔ ni shãa abelebaa gbiŋ; ni amɛaakpãtã maji krokomɛi ni yɔɔ amɛninejurɔ kɛ amɛbɛku gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Yerusalɛmbii aaafee shweshweeshwe yɛ Yerusalɛm.
“Yehowa baahã Yuda akutso lɛ mli tabilɔi tsutsu aye amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ anɔ kunim, bɔ ni afee ni hiɛ akasɔ David shwiei lɛ, kɛ Yerusalɛmbii lɛ hu akunim ni amɛye lɛ fe kunim ni Yudabii baaye lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa kɛ tsɛŋ ko aaabu Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ahe, ni mɔ ni he waaa kwraa yɛ amɛteŋ he aaawa tamɔ David; ni David shwiei lɛ aaatsɔ̃ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ; amɛaatamɔ Yehowa bɔfo ni nyiɛ amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ maji fɛɛ ni aaate shi awo Yerusalɛm lɛ makpãtã amɛhiɛ.
“Mafɔse mimɔbɔnalɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ mumɔ mashwie David shwiei lɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm maŋbii lɛ anɔ bɔ ni kɛ amɛna mɔ ko ni amɛye lɛ awui ko lɛ, amɛaaye mɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ ayeɔ bi koome ni egbo he ŋkɔmɔ; ni amɛaafo lɛ kɛ mlishãlɛ tamɔ afoɔ kromɔbi ni egbo.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ yara ni abaawo yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ baatamɔ yara ni awo kɛfo Hadad-Rimmon yɛ Megido ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ baawo yara wekuiaŋwekuiaŋ.
Davidwe lɛ baawo yara lɛ enɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu bawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro; Nakai nɔŋŋ Natanwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.
Leviwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.
Shimeiwe lɛ baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo yara amɛnɔ aŋkro.
Ni wekui krokomɛi fɛɛ ni eshwɛ lɛ baawo amɛyara aŋkroaŋkro, ni amɛŋamɛi lɛ hu baawo amɛnɔ aŋkroaŋkro.”
“Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ abaagbele nu hiŋmɛi naa ahã David we lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ, koni akɛfɔ amɛhe eshai kɛ amɛhe muji ashwie.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ tee nɔ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mibagbe wɔji lɛ agbɛii kwraa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akakai amɛ dɔŋŋ; nakai nɔŋŋ majie gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mumɔi ni ahe tseee lɛ hu kɛje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaaba ekoŋŋ akɛ gbalɔ ji lɛ lɛ, etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ tete aaakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Gbalɔ amalelɔ ji bo, ni osa gbele, ejaakɛ oomale yɛ Yehowa gbɛi mli.’ Ni kɛji ekã he eegba lolo lɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni fɔ lɛ lɛ baatsu lɛ nɔ̃, koni amɛgbe lɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ gbalɔ fɛɛ gbalɔ hiɛ baagbo yɛ eninaa ni egba lɛ hewɔ, ni ewoŋ gbalɔi atade kɛ ehiɛ fɛŋfɛŋ ni amɛwoɔ kɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ nɔ ni ebaakɛɛ ji akɛ, ‘Jeee gbalɔ ji mi, okwaafonyo ji mi, mibɔ̃i humɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ tɔ̃ɔ.’ Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni faji anaa yɔɔ osɛɛ nɛɛ lɛ?’ Eeehã hetoo akɛ, ‘Minanemɛi ni pila mi nɛɛ.’ ” Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo klante, wo ohe nɔ owo mitookwɛlɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji misɛɛ mɔ lɛ, koni toi lɛ agbɛ ashwã.
Mawo minine nɔ yɛ too bibiibii tete anɔ ni maplenee amɛ.
Aaakpãtã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ amlijaa etɛ̃ mli enyɔ hiɛ, ni amɛaagboi; ni mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ lɛ yi aaana wala.
Nɛkɛ mlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome ni aaashwɛ nɛɛ lɛ, mikɛ amɛ baawo la mli ni matsuu amɛhe, tamɔ akɛ la tsuɔ jwiɛtɛi he; makpa amɛ shi makwɛ tamɔ akpaa shika shi akwɛɔ lɛ.
Amɛaasɔle kɛtsɛ mi, ni mahere amɛ nɔ.
Makɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mimɛi ji amɛ,’ ni amɛ hu amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yehowa ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ.’ Mi Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, mikɛɛ.”
Yerusalɛm kɛ maji krokomɛi Naa, Yehowa gbi ko miiba, ni ta mli nii ni henyɛlɔi ha yɛ bo Yerusalɛm omli lɛ, abaaja yɛ bo nɔŋŋ omli.
Ejaakɛ mi, Yehowa, mabua maji lɛ anaa koni amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm ni amɛkɛ lɛ awu.
Amɛbaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ, ni abaashã shĩai lɛ amli nii, ni amɛbaato amɛmli yei lɛ kabonaa.
Abaaŋɔ maŋ lɛ mlijaa fã nom, shi mlijaa fã ni baashwɛ lɛ abaashi amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli, afeŋ amɛ nɔ ko.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yehowa kɛ nakai maji lɛ baawu tamɔ efeɔ yɛ ta beiaŋ lɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baadamɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni ma Yerusalɛm bokãgbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Mugɔŋ nɛɛ mli baagba enyɔ kɛjɛ bokã kɛyashi anai, ni jɔɔ kpeteŋkple diɛŋtsɛ baakã teŋ.
Gɔŋ lɛ fã baaye kooyigbɛ, ni fã hu baaye wuoyigbɛ.
Nyɛbaajo foi kɛtsɔ̃ jɔɔ ni kã migɔŋ ni emli egba enyɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛbaajo foi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ jo foi be ni shikpɔŋ hoso yɛ Yuda maŋtsɛ Uzia yinɔ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, Yehowa, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ baaba abapue.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛ̃i yeŋ, ni afua hu woŋ.
Asaŋ je naŋ; anaŋ be ni ji shwane kɛ be ni ji gbɛkɛ, ejaakɛ gbɛkɛ tete lɛ hulu miitso.
(Yehowa pɛ ji mɔ ni le nɛkɛ gbi nɛɛ).
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ wala nu baaho kɛaajɛ Yerusalɛm; fã kome kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Ŋoo Ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni fã kome lɛ hu kɛ enaa baaya ayawo Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Hulutsoobe kɛ fɛ̃ibe mli fɛɛ lɛ nu nɛɛ baakã he eho.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaale lɛ akɛ Yehowa kome kɛ egbɛi hu koome; ejaakɛ lɛ ebaaye shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ.
Shikpɔŋ muu lɛ ni kã shi kɛjɛ Geba yɛ kooyigbɛ lɛ aahu kɛtee Rimon yɛ Yerusalɛm wuoyigbɛ lɛ fɛɛ baatsɔ̃ ŋa kplanaa; shi Yerusalɛm baahi shi grɔŋŋ yɛ eblema shimaahe lɛ.
Ebaajɛ Benyamin Agbo lɛ naa kɛyashi he ni agbo yɔɔ tsutsu lɛ, ni ji Koŋ Agbo lɛ; ebaatsa nɔ kɛyamɔ Hananel Mɔɔ grɔŋŋ lɛ, aahu kɛyanina maŋtsɛ wainŋaahe lɛ.
Mɛi baahi Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛ mli, ni musu ko yeŋ amɛ, ni Yerusalɛm mlihilɛ baafee shweshweeshwe.
Majimaji fɛɛ ni baafa tã kɛtua Yerusalɛm lɛ bɔ ni Yehowa kɛ amɛ baaye ahã nɛ: amɛheloo baakpɔtɔ be mli ni amɛhiɛ kamɔ; amɛhiŋmɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛyitsei ahe, ni amɛlilɛii baakpɔtɔ yɛ amɛdaaŋ.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ Yehowa baahã ehe ŋmiŋmi kpeteŋkple amɔ̃mɔ amɛ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baawo enine nɔ yɛ enaanyo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ nɔ.
Shi Yuda tete po baafata Yerusalɛm he kɛwu ta kɛfã Yerusalɛm he, ni abaaha jwetri ni maji ni bɔle amɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ atadei babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Hela gbonyo aaamɔmɔ okpɔŋɔi kɛ tejiokpɔŋɔi kɛ yoomai kɛ tejii kɛ kooloo fɛɛ kooloo ni yɔɔ nakai henyɛlɔi lɛ shitoohei lɛ amli lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ maji ni kulɛ amɛte shi amɛwo Yerusalɛm lɛ mli mɛi ni baashwɛ lɛ baaya Yerusalɛm daa afi koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, ni ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, koni amɛye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ hu.
Kɛji maŋ ko yɛ ni emli bii lɛ eyaaa Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaja maŋtsɛ, Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ, nu enɛŋ amɛ.
Ni kɛji Ijiptbii lɛ hu eyaaa Yerusalɛm koni amɛyaye Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ amɛhu haomɔ ni Yehowa ha eba maji lɛ ni yayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ anɔ lɛ aaaba amɛ hu amɛnɔ.
Nɛkɛ ji bɔ ni abaagbala Ijiptbii kɛ maji fɛɛ ni amɛyayeee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ eko lɛ atoi.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaŋmalã yɛ ŋmɛji ni tsotsoroɔ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahe lɛ anɔ akɛ; “Eyɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hã Yehowa.” Ni kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tamɔ kãi ni yɔɔ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Kukwɛi fɛɛ kukwɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda fɛɛ hu baatsɔ̃ nɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Yehowa Taiatsɛ lɛ; bɔ ni afee ni mɛi fɛɛ ni baashã afɔle ahole amɛ kɛhoo afɔleshãa loo lɛ.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ jarayelɔ ko jarayelɔ ko eyayeŋ jara yɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ we lɛ dɔŋŋ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Gbalɔ Maleaki Wolo nɛɛ mli saji lɛ je kpo afii Dani Afɔ Kristo.
No mli lɛ asaa ama Yerusalɛm Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ.
Sane kome ni kã gbalɔ lɛ tsui nɔ ji akɛ etsɛ osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ hu fɛɛ atoi sɛɛ akɛ amɛkpale, ni amɛye anɔkwa yɛ kpãŋmɔ ni kã amɛ kɛ Naa Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Ekɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii lɛ jaaa Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni ji amɛgbɛnaa, ni anɔkwayeli bɛ amɛshihilɛ mli yɛ maŋ lɛ mli hu.
Osɔfoi lɛ kɛ maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ miishishiu Naa Nyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ afɔle lɛ mli nɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ni sa akɛ akɛbahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, akɛbahãaa lɛ.
Asaŋ maŋbii lɛ baaa amɛjeŋ yɛ mlai ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo amɛ lɛ anaa.
Gbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baaba kɛ̃ koni ebakojo ewebii lɛ, asaŋ ebaatsuu amɛhe efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Shi moŋ ebaawo etsulɔ ko gbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛba koni tsulɔ nɛɛ abasaa shi eto lɛ, asaŋ koni ebakai emaŋbii lɛ kpãŋmɔ ni kã shi yɛ amɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Eshai ni Israel fee lɛ .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ kojomɔ kɛ emusuŋtsɔ̃lɛ .—.
Gbalɛ wiemɔ ni Yehowa kɛtsɔ̃ Gbalɔ Maleaki nɔ koni ekɛhã Israelbii lɛ nɛ.
Suɔmɔ ni Yehowa yɔɔ hã Israel Yehowa kɛɛ ewebii lɛ akɛ, “Misumɔ nyɛ.” Shi amɛto he akɛ, “Mɛni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ osumɔ wɔ?” Yehowa here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Te Esau nyɛmi nuu ji Yakob; shi bɛ misumɔ Yakob kɛ eshwiei, ni minyɛ Esau kɛ eshwiei fɛɛ.
Mihã egbɛfaŋ gɔŋ shikpɔji lɛ anɔ tsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃, ni ashi jɛi, ni jɛi tsɔ̃ ŋaŋgbei ashihilɛhe?” Kɛji Esau shwiei, ni ji Edombii, lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Akpãtã wɔhiɛ moŋ, shi wɔbaaku wɔsɛɛ kɛya ni wɔyasaa wɔtswa wɔtsui ni efee koikoi lɛ,” no lɛ Yehowa baato he akɛ, “Amɛbaanyɛ amɛsaa tsui lɛ amɛmamɔ nɛ, shi mi hu makumɔ tsui lɛ mashwie shi kɛyaashi mɛi aaatsɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ gbonyo ni Yehowa mli efu amɛ kɛmiiya naanɔ nɛ.’ ” Nyɛbaana nɔ ni baaba lɛ kɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhiŋmɛii; ni nyɛbaakɛɛ akɛ, “Yehowa da kɛteke Israel kɛ ehusui fɛɛ.” Yehowa kã osɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, miikɛɛ osɔfoi lɛ akɛ, “Bi woɔ etsɛ, ni tsulɔ woɔ enuŋtsɔ.
Kolɛ, kɛji tsɛ ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ miwoo lɛ yɔɔ?
Ni kɛji nuŋtsɔ hu ji mi lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbeyei ni nyɛsheɔ mi yɔɔ?
Nyɛgbeɔ migbɛi lɛ he guɔ; shi nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛgbeɔ ogbɛi lɛ he guɔ lɛ?’ Nyɛkɛ aboloo ni abule bashãa afɔle yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ hu nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔfeɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ wɔhiɛ esɔɔɔ bo?’ Nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, ‘Nyɛnifeemɔ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛbuuu mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ.’ Kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloi shwilafoi bashã afɔle lɛ aso ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo?
Ni kɛji nyɛkɛ kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ bashã afɔle lɛ, no hu ejeee nɔ fɔŋ lo?
Kɛji omɔ nakai kooloo okɛyake amralo lɛ, ani eeena ohe tsuijurɔ, aloo eeekwɛ ohiɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, osɔfoi, agbɛnɛ nyɛkpaa Naa Nyɔŋmɔ fai koni eduro wɔ.
Ani nɛkɛ nikeenii ni jɛ nyɛdɛŋ nɛɛ baahã ekwɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ?
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mina ni kulɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ŋamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinai lɛ koni nyɛkayashɛre la yakatswaa yɛ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Minaaa nyɛhe miishɛɛ, ni mimɔŋ nikeenii ni nyɛkɛbahãa mi lɛ hu mli.
Kɛjɛ hulu shitee mli aahu kɛyashi eshinyɔɔ mli lɛ, mɛi miikafo mi yɛ jeŋ majimaji amli.
Ni aashãshãa tsofakɛŋma aahã mi, ni akɛ nibii ni ahe tsetsee miishãshãa afɔle miihã mi, ejaakɛ migbɛi ehehe yɛ jeŋ majimaji lɛ anɔ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbuleɔ mifɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛji nyɛkɛɛ akɛ abule Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ momo, ni no hewɔ ni nyɛkɛ niyenii ni nyɛnyaŋeɔ baa bashãa afɔle yɛ nɔ lɛ.
Nɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ ji, ‘Mɛɛ tɔlɛ po ji enɛ, ni nyɛshoɔ nyɛgugɔŋ nyɛwoɔ mi.’ Bɔ ni Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɔ nɛ, ‘Mɔ ko nii ni ayashɔ̃ akranaŋ naa, loo kooloo akpaketsɛ loo helatsɛ nyɛkɛbahãa akɛ nyɛfɔle.
Aso nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mamɔ nɛkɛ afɔle mli kɛ miishɛɛ lo?
Alomɔ shishiulɔ ni yɔɔ too nuu yɛ etoo ku mli, shi kɛji ewo shi lɛ, ekɛ kooloo ni kpa yɔɔ ehe moŋ bashãa afɔle ehãa Yehowa lɛ, ejaakɛ Maŋtsɛ kpeteŋkple ji mi,’ Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, ‘Ni jeŋ majimaji anɔ bii fɛɛ sheɔ mi gbeyei.’ ”
“Agbɛnɛ nyɛ, osɔfoi, kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ nɛ.
Kɛji nyɛbooo wiemɔ nɛɛ toi ni nyɛkɛaato nyɛtsui mli, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkɛ nyɛjeŋba awo migbɛi hiɛ nyam lɛ, no lɛ mibalomɔ nyɛ; mibalomɔ nibii ni ahãa nyɛ ni nyɛkɛkwɛɔ nyɛhe lɛ fɛɛ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ, milomɔ nibii nɛɛ momo ejaakɛ nyɛbuuu mikitã lɛ.
Naa, mibakã nyɛshwiei ahiɛ, ni mikɛ nyɛfɔleshãa kooloi lɛ awamɔ lɛ aaakpa nyɛhiɛ; ni aaaloo nyɛ kɛ wamɔ lɛ fɛɛ ayashwie tumo nɔ.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni nyɛkɛaana nyɛle akɛ mi mikɛ kitã nɛɛ tsu kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ; ni asaŋ koni kpãŋmɔ ni kã mi kɛ osɔfoi, ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ, ateŋ lɛ akaku mli,” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ kɛɛ.
“Mi kɛ amɛ kpãŋmɔ mli lɛ, miwo shi akɛ madro amɛ wala kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ, ni mifee hu, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshe mi gbeyei, ni amɛhiɛ hu asɔ migbɛi lɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nii ni ja, shi jeee nii ni ejaaa; ni amɛkɛ mi hi shi yɛ toiŋjɔlɛ kɛ jalɛ mli.
Amɛfee nii ni ja, ni amɛkpale mɛi babaoo kɛje nɔsha he.
Ejaakɛ osɔfoi agbɛnaa nitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee krɔŋŋ lɛ.
Amɛ amɛŋɔɔ esa akɛ mɛi aya koni amɛyakase mla lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ amɛ ji Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ.
“Shi nyɛ, osɔfoi lɛ, nyɛgba afã kɛje gbɛ ni ja lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ ehã mɛi babaoo etɔ̃ mimlai lɛ anɔ, ni nyɛku mi kɛ nyɛ, Levi shwiei ateŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ mli.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, bei abɔ ni nyɛyeee mimlai lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkwɛɔ mɛi ahiɛiaŋ yɛ nyɛnifeemɔ mli lɛ, mibahã nyɛhe guɔ agbo yɛ Israelbii fɛɛ ahiɛ.” Anɔkwa ni maŋbii yeee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Ani jeee tsɛ kome wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɔɔ lo?
Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni bɔ wɔ lo?
Mɛni hewɔ mɔ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yeee enyɛmi anɔkwa, ni wɔyeee kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Yuda yeee Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa, ni musubɔɔ nibii sɔŋŋ kɛkɛ afeɔ yɛ Israel kɛ Yerusalɛm.
Yuda ebule Yehowa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni esumɔɔ lɛ.
Yudahii lɛ eyaŋɔŋɔɔ ŋamɛi ni jaa maŋsɛɛ wɔji.
Yehowa aaaplene nuu fɛɛ nuu ni feɔ nɛkɛ nɔ ko yɛ Israelbii ateŋ, koni ekahã ena hegbɛ efata he dɔŋŋ kɛshã afɔlei ni maŋbii lɛ shãa hãa Yehowa, Taiatsɛ, lɛ.
Asaŋ nɔ ni ji enyɔ hu ni nyɛfeɔ nɛ.
Nyɛwoɔ yara ni nyɛdɔmɔɔ ŋtsɔi, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛyaafonu fɔɔ Yehowa afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛfɔleshãa nibii lɛ esaaa Yehowa hiɛ dɔŋŋ aahu po ni eeemɔ mli kɛ tsuijurɔ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
Nyɛbiɔ nɔ hewɔ ni nibii baa lɛ nakai akɛ Yehowa mɔɔɔ nikeenii lɛ amli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni okɛ oblahiiaŋ ŋa lɛ kpãŋɔ lɛ, Yehowa ji nyɛdasefonyo.
Owo oŋa lɛ shi akɛ obaaye lɛ anɔkwa, shi onyɛɛɛ lɛ anɔkwa lɛ oye; tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji onaanyo kɛ oŋa fɛɛ yɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ naa.
Aso jeee Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ ji mɔ ni bɔ wala, asaŋ ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ebaa wala mumɔ lɛ yi ehã wɔ lɛ lo?
Ni mɛni etaoɔ yɛ wɔdɛŋ mɔ?
Eekwɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛbaafɔ bii ni baatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ webii anɔkwale mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni shi ni nyɛwo nyɛblahiiaŋ ŋamɛi lɛ nyɛkaku mli kɛtsɔ̃ anɔkwa ni nyɛyeee nɔ.
Yehowa, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ ji akɛ, “Miihi mligbalamɔ.
Miihi kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ ko ye eŋa nɛkɛ sane.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni shi ni nyɛwo lɛ nyɛkakwaa.” Kojomɔ gbi lɛ ebɛŋkɛ “Nyɛhã etɔ Yehowa kɛ nyɛwiemɔi lɛ.” Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔkɛhã etɔ lɛ?’ Ejɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ lɛ, ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni Yehowa yɛ mɔ lɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.’ Ni nyɛbiɔ hu akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni yeɔ jalɛ sane lɛ yɔɔ?”
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ koni ebasaa gbɛ lɛ eto mi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ baaba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ trukaa.
Kpãŋmɔ Bɔfo lɛ ni nyɛshwe lɛ aahu lɛ aaashɛ shi.” Shi namɔ baanyɛ ekpee ebaa lɛ naa?
Ni namɔ aaanyɛ shi adamɔ be ni eeebapue lɛ?
Ejaakɛ etamɔ niiahetsuulɔ la loo niiahefɔlɔ samla.
Ebaata shi tamɔ jwiɛtɛi hetsuulɔ ni hãa jwiɛtɛi he tseɔ keŋkeŋ lɛ.
Nakai ebaatsuu osɔfoi ni ji Levi shwiei lɛ ahe keŋkeŋ tamɔ atsuɔ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi he lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaanyɛ amɛkɛ afɔleshãa nikeenii ni kpa bɛ he aba abahã Yehowa.
No dani Yudabii kɛ Yerusalɛmbii anikeenii ni amɛkɛbaahã Yehowa baasa ehiɛ tamɔ esa ehiɛ blema yɛ tsutsu afii lɛ amli lɛ.
Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ akɛ, “Mibatsi mabɛŋkɛ nyɛ koni makojo gbɔmɛi abii; mikɛ sane baashi mɛi ni sheee mi gbeyei lɛ oya nɔŋŋ, ŋkunyaayelɔi kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ mɛi ni kãmɔɔ amale kitã lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ maye odase mashi mɛi ni shishiuɔ apaafoi yɛ nyɔmɔwoo mli kɛ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ yoo okulafo kɛ awusa kɛ gbɔ sane hiɛ buɔ shi lɛ.” “Yehowa ji mi, mitsakeee; ni no hewɔ ni nyɛ, Yakob shwiei, nyɛpleneko kɛbashi benɛ nɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛgba afã yɛ mikpɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, tamɔ nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ hu fee kɛjɛ blema lɛ, ni nyɛyeee amɛnɔ.
Nyɛkpalea kɛbaa miŋɔɔ, ni mi hu mibakpale kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ gbɛ nɔ wɔɔtsɔ̃ wɔkpale?’ Shi nɔ ni mibiɔ nyɛ ji akɛ, aso eja gbɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ adesa ashishiu Nyɔŋmɔ lo?
Dabida!
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi.
Nyɛaabi akɛ, ‘Yɛ mɛni mli?’ Yɛ nibii amlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ kɛ afɔlei ni nyɛkɛbahãa lɛ mli.
Naa, nyɛmiilomɔ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛ maŋtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmiishishiu mi.
Nyɛkɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mli ekomekome lɛ fɛɛ abaa nitoohe lɛ koni niyenii ahi miwe lɛ!
Nyɛkɛ enɛ akaa mi nyɛkwɛa akɛ migbeleŋ ŋwɛi samfɛji lɛ, ni mifɔseŋ jɔɔmɔ mishwieŋ nyɛnɔ ni ateke nɔ lo?
Nyɛhewɔ lɛ mibatsi baalabii ni kpãtãa nii ahiɛ lɛ anaa mahã nyɛ koni amɛkafite nyɛŋmɔshi nibii; ni nyɛwain tsei ni yɔɔ ŋa nɔ lɛ baawo babaoo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ je lɛ mli majimaji fɛɛ baabu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni ajɔɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛbaatsɔ̃ maŋ ni mii eshɛ ehe.” Yehowa, Taiatsɛ lɛ, kɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Musuŋ baatsɔ̃ lɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwie wiemɔi ni naa wa yɛ mihe.
Shi nyɛbiɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛni mli wɔwieɔ wɔshiɔ bo yɛ?’ Nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Sɛɛnamɔ bɛ he akɛ asɔmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kɛji wɔye egbee nɔ, aloo wɔnyiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kwraa po tamɔ mɛi ni agbo yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ mli?
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa jeŋ moŋ ji akɛ mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe lɛ, amɛ ji mɛi ni yɔɔ miishɛɛ.
Ni jeee shweremɔ kɛkɛ mɛi ni feɔ nifɔɔjianii shwereɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛnifɔɔji lɛ kaa Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkwɛɔ, ni amɛjeɔ toigbalamɔ mli sɔkee.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni maŋbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei lɛ kɛ amɛhe wie.
Yehowa bo amɛ toi, ni enu nɔ ni amɛtao.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ Yehowa gbeyei, ni asaŋ amɛjwɛŋɔ egbɛi lɛ hiɛnyamwoo he lɛ aŋmala amɛgbɛii awo wolo mli koni akɛkai amɛ.
Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi nɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ mimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ minɔ krɛdɛɛ, gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii lɛ.
Mikɛ amɛhe baake amɛ tamɔ bɔ ni tsɛ Ataa kɛ ebi ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ lɛ he keɔ lɛ lɛ.
No dani nyɛbaana ekoŋŋ nɔ srɔto ni yɔɔ jalɔ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔ teŋ, kɛ srɔto ni yɔɔ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ.”
Yehowa Gbi lɛ miishɛ Yehowa kɛɛ akɛ, “Naa, gbi ko miiba; ni emli edɔ la tamɔ flɔnɔɔ.
Eshishɛɛ lɛ gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ baatsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ abele gbetselii; ebaashã amɛ bɔ ni eshwɛŋ eko eko shishifã loo tso nine.
Shi nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sheɔ mi gbeyei lɛ, mihewalɛ lɛ baate shi tamɔ jalɛ hulu ahã nyɛ, ni eeetsa nyɛ.
Nyɛaaje kpo kɛ nyamɔ kɛ tuumɔ tamɔ tsinabii ni agbele amɛ.
Gbi nɔ ni mibatsu minii nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛbaanaanaa mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ yɛ nyɛnajiashi ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ lamlu.” Yehowa kɛɛ.
“Nyɛkaia nibii ni mitsulɔ Mose etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni ji mlai kɛ akpɔi kɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni mikɛhã lɛ yɛ Horeb Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛbahã Israelbii koni amɛye nɔ lɛ.
“Shi dani nakai Yehowa gbi wulu ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ baashɛ lɛ, mibatsu Gbalɔ Elia kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ebaahã tsɛmɛi asumɔ amɛbii ekoŋŋ, ni bii hu aaasumɔ amɛtsɛmɛi ekoŋŋ, koni mikaba mibakpãtã shikpɔŋ muu lɛ hiɛ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ, Yesu ji yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ji mɔ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ eye shi ni ewo ewebii lɛ yɛ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli lɛ nɔ.
Sanekpakpa nɛɛ ejeee Yudafoi, mɛi ateŋ ni afɔ Yesu yɛ kɛ mɛi ateŋ ni ehi lɛ, kɛkɛ anɔŋ; shi moŋ eji je nɛɛŋ bii fɛɛ anɔ.
Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ ato emli sane lɛ naa aŋma lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Akɛ Yesu fɔmɔ he sane lɛ je shishi; bɔ ni asɔle lɛ kɛ bɔ ni aka lɛ ahã.
Atsa nɔ kɛ Yesu shiɛmɔ nitsumɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɛi atsamɔ yɛ Galilea lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ sane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Yesu fã gbɛ kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm; nɔ ni ba enɔ yɛ jɛi, yɛ nakai otsi lɛ mli, egbele kɛ eshitee yɛ Yerusalɛm.
Mateo Sanekpakpa lɛ jieɔ Yesu kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kpanaa ji lɛ.
Tsɔ̃ɔlɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ shishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli he sane faŋŋ.
Enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ ajara mli enumɔ.
.
Gɔŋ nɔ shiɛmɔ ni kɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he.
Etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋba kpakpa, gbɔmɔ gbɛnaa, nitsumɔ kɛ nɔ ni baaba ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeliŋ bii lɛ anɔ yɛ jeŋ nɛɛ mli .
.
Kaselɔi lɛ asane-kpakpashiɛmɔ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ .
Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he abɛi lɛ .
.
Kaselɔfeemɔ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ .
.
Je nɛɛŋ naagbee kɛ wɔsɛɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli ni baaba lɛ he sane .
Mlijaramɔi Nuŋtsɔ Yesu fɔmɔ kɛ eweku kpãa .—.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ .- Yesu baptismɔ kɛ ekaa .—.
Yesu shiɛmɔ nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea .—.
Yesu jɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm .—.
Naagbee otsi lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm .—.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehekpojiemɔi .-
Yesu Kristo Wekukpãa Wolo wekukpãa Yesu Kristo, bi David, bi Abraham bi.
Abraham fɔ Isak, Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob fɔ Yuda kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ; Yuda kɛ Tamar fɔ Perez kɛ Zera, Perez fɔ Hezron, ni Hezron fɔ Ram; Ram fɔ Aminadab, Aminadab fɔ Nahashon, ni Nahashon fɔ Salmon; Salmon kɛ Rahab fɔ Boaz, Boaz kɛ Rut fɔ Obed, ni Obed fɔ Ishai; Ishai fɔ Maŋtsɛ David, ni David kɛ Uria ŋa lɛ fɔ Solomon.
Solomon fɔ Rehoboam, Rehoboam fɔ Abia, ni Abia fɔ Asa; Asa fɔ Yehoshafat, Yehoshafat fɔ Yoram, ni Yoram fɔ Uzia; Uzia fɔ Yotam, Yotam fɔ Ahaz, ni Ahaz fɔ Hezekia; Hezekia fɔ Manase, Manase fɔ Amon, ni Amon fɔ Yosia; Yosia fɔ Yekonia kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, be ni abaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ.
Ni be ni aŋɔ amɛ nom kɛtee Babilon lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yekonia fɔ Shealtiel ni Shealtiel, fɔ Zerubabel, Zerubabel fɔ Abiud, Abiud fɔ Eliakim, ni Eliakim fɔ Azor; Azor fɔ Sadok, Sadok fɔ Akim, ni Akim fɔ Eliud; Eliud fɔ Eleazar, Eleazar fɔ Matan, ni Matan fɔ Yakob; Yakob fɔ Yosef ni ji Maria ni fɔ Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ wu lɛ.
Belɛ yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Abraham nɔ kɛbashi David nɔ lɛ feɔ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ; ni kɛjɛ David nɔ kɛbashi Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ, ni kɛjɛ Babilon nomŋɔɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Kristo nɔ lɛ yinɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ.
Yesu fɔmɔ Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni Yesu Kristo fɔmɔ lɛ yɔɔ nɛ.
Enyɛ Maria lɛ, be ni Yosef etsɛ ehe baa ni amɛnako amɛhi shi lɛ, ana akɛ ehiɛ musu kɛjɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi Yosef, ewu lɛ, akɛni jalɔ ji lɛ ni etaooo akɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora lɛ eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe kpoo.
Shi be ni ejwɛŋɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yosef, David bi, kaashe oŋa Maria lɛ ŋɔɔ gbeyei, shi musu ni ehiɛ nɛɛ ejɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ebaafɔ binuu, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ejaakɛ lɛ ebaahere emaŋ lɛ yiwala kɛjɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ amli.” Shi enɛ fɛɛ ba, koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Naa, oblayoo foro lɛ aaana musu, Ni eeefɔ binuu, ni amɛaawo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Imanuel, eshishi ji Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔ yɛ.” Ni be ni Yosef te shi kɛjɛ wɔ lɛ mli lɛ, efee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ eŋa lɛ; shi eleee lɛ aahu kɛyashi beyinɔ ni efɔ binuu.
Ni Yosef wo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.
Nilelɔi ni jɛ bokã lɛ Be ni afɔ Yesu yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea, yɛ Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ, nilelɔi jɛ bokã ba Yerusalɛm babi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ ni afɔ lɛ yɔɔ?
Wɔna eŋulami lɛ yɛ bokã ni wɔba ni wɔbaja lɛ.” Shi be ni Maŋtsɛ Herode nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛ Yerusalɛm fɛɛ yoyoro; ni ebua maŋ lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa, ni ebi amɛ he ni aaafɔ Kristo lɛ yɛ.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea; shi bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ ŋma nɛ, ‘Ni bo, Betlehem ni oyɔɔ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, jeee bo ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ Yuda lumɛi lɛ ateŋ kwraa, shi omli lumɔ ni aaakwɛ mimaŋ Israel lɛ aaajɛ!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni Herode tsɛ nilelɔi lɛ nigii, ni ebi amɛ fitsofitso beyinɔ ni ŋulami lɛ pue.
Ni ehã amɛtee Betlehem ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyataoa abifao lɛ fitsofitso; ni kɛ nyɛna lɛ lɛ, nyɛbakɛa mi, koni mi hu maya ni mayaja lɛ.” Be ni amɛnu maŋtsɛ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
Ni ŋulami lɛ ni amɛna yɛ bokã lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ aahu, kɛyashi ebadamɔ he ni abifao lɛ yɔɔ lɛ yiteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛna ŋulami lɛ, amɛna miishɛɛ babaoo diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni amɛtee shĩa lɛ, ni amɛna abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ Maria lɛ; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ.
Amɛfɛne amɛkotokui anaa, ni amɛkekee lɛ nii: shika kɛ krɔbɔo kɛ mire.
Ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli akɛ amɛkaku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee Herode ŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ gbɛ kroko nɔ kɛtee amɛshikpɔŋ nɔ.
Foijee kɛ Ijipt yaa Ni be ni amɛtee lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi; ŋɔɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni ojo foi oya Ijipt, ni ohi jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni makɛɛ bo nɔ ko; shi Herode baatao abifao lɛ ni egbe lɛ,” Ni ete shi eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ, ni eyiŋ etee Ijipt.
Ni ehi shi yɛ jɛi kɛyashi Herode gbo; koni nɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ lɛ naa lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Ijipt mitsɛ mibi lɛ kɛjɛ.” Betlehem abifabii lɛ ahiɛkpãtãmɔ Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode na akɛ nilelɔi lɛ yeee lɛ anɔkwa lɛ, emli fu waa, ni etsu ayagbe gbekɛbii hii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Betlehem kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, mɛi ni eye afii enyɔ kɛ mɛi ni yeko nakai lɛ, kɛji abu kɛjɛ be ni ebi nilelɔi lɛ sane lɛ fitsofitso lɛ.
No ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yeremia kɛɛ lɛ ba mli akɛ, “Anu gbee ko yɛ Rama, yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli babaoo; Rahel miifo ebii, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ miishɛjemɔ, ejaakɛ amɛbɛ.” Sɛɛkuu kɛ Ijipt jɛɛ Shi be ni Herode egbo lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yosef yɛ wɔlamɔ mli yɛ Ijipt, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ ni oya Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni taoɔ abifao lɛ amɛgbe lɛ amɛgboi.” Ni Yosef te shi ni eŋɔ abifao lɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ, ni eba Israel shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Shi be ni enu akɛ Arkelao miiye maŋtsɛ yɛ Yudea yɛ etsɛ Herode sɛɛ lɛ, eshe jɛiyaa gbeyei; ni akɛni ajie atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ wɔlamɔ mli lɛ, edɔ eyi kɛtee Galilea niiaŋ.
Ni eba ebahi maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli, koni nɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Aaatsɛ lɛ Nazarenyo.”
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ebashiɛ yɛ Yudea ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.” Shi mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie akɛ, “Mɔ ko gbee miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ!
Ni nyɛfea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!’ ” Shi lɛ Yohane lɛ, yooma hetsɔi akɛlo etade, ni wolo kpãa fĩ emliteŋ, ni eniyenii ji baalabii kɛ ŋa nɔ wo.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni ebaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan faa lɛ mli, be ni amɛjajeɔ emɛhe eshai lɛ.
Shi be ni ena Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii baa ebaptisimɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Shinɔi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baaba lɛ naa foi?
Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ mɔ!
Ni nyɛkasusua ni nyɛkɛɛ yɛ nyɛmli akɛ, ‘Wɔ lɛ wɔtsɛ ji Abraham;’ shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ etee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham.
Shi lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifã lɛ nɔ momo; hewɔ lɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ atoɔ afɔɔ shi, ni ashɛɔ afɔɔ la mli.
Mi lɛ, nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ hã tsuitsakemɔ; shi mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ehe wa fe mi; etokotai tete misaaa mɔ ni hiɛɔ.
Lɛ eeebaptisi nyɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la.
Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni ebaabɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni ebaabua eŋmaa lɛ naa eto eboŋo mli; shi tutuu lɛ, ekɛ la ni gbooo baashã.” Yesu baptisimɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jɛ Galilea eba Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ Yordan naa, koni ebaptisi lɛ.
Shi Yohane tsi lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi moŋ ni ehia mi akɛ bo obaptisiɔ mi lɛ, ni bo obaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpɛlɛ̃mɔ kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ sa akɛ wɔgbeɔ jalɛ fɛɛ naa.” Kɛkɛ ni ekpɛlɛ̃.
Ni be ni abaptisi Yesu lɛ, ejɛ nu lɛ mli amrɔ eje kpo; ni naa, agbele ŋwɛi naa ahã lɛ, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ miikpeleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ.
Ni naa, gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni mina ehe tsui lɛ.”
Yesu kaa Kɛkɛ ni Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee ŋa nɔ, koni abonsam ayaka lɛ.
Ni be ni ehi ŋmaa shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni abonsam lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, fã koni tɛi nɛɛ atsɔ̃mɔ aboloo.” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Jeee aboloo kɛkɛ hãa gbɔmɔ yi naa wala; shi mɔŋ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ ni jɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ daaŋ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yiteŋ he ni yɔɔ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, kɛ ohe atswa shi; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Ohewɔ lɛ eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ ni amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.’ ” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma ekoŋŋ akɛ, ‘Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ, bo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ” Asaŋ abonsam lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni kwɔ somromoo ko nɔ, ni ekɛ jeŋ maŋtsɛyelii fɛɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ; ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ baahã bo, kɛji okula shi oja mi lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan!
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!’ ” Kɛkɛ ni abonsam lɛ shi lɛ, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi ba ni amɛbasɔmɔ lɛ.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee Shi be ni Yesu nu akɛ amɔ Yohane lɛ, eyiŋ etee Galilea.
Ehiii shi yɛ Nazaret shi moŋ ebahi Kapernaum maŋ ko ni kã ŋshɔ naa, yɛ Zebulon kɛ Naftali niiaŋ, koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Zebulon shikpɔŋ kɛ Naftali shikpɔŋ, Ŋshɔnaagbɛ lɛ, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ lɛ, Galilea, jeŋmaji ashikpɔŋ lɛ, Maŋ ni ta duŋ mli lɛ, ena la kpeteŋkple, ni mɛi ni tara gbele shikpɔŋ, kɛ ehɔ̃ɔŋ mli lɛ, la ete shi ehã amɛ!” Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i shiɛmɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui; shi ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ!” Wolɛi ejwɛ atsɛmɔ Be ni Yesu kpaa shi yɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi enyɔ, Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea, ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ.
Ni etsɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbanyiɛa misɛɛ, ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɔmɛi.” Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni eje jɛi eyaa lɛ, ena nyɛmimɛi krokomɛi enyɔ, Zebedeo bi Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni amɛkɛ amɛtsɛ Zebedeo yɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ; ni etsɛ amɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi lɛlɛ lɛ kɛ amɛtsɛ lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii, eshiɛ ni etsa helai Ni Yesu kpa Galilea muu lɛ fɛɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ, ni etsaa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni ehe sane gbɛ shwã Siria fɛɛ, ni akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni bɛ hewalɛ ni helai kɛ piŋmɔi srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ gbligbli kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ba eŋɔɔ, ni etsa amɛ.
Ni asafoi pii jɛ Galilea kɛ Dekapoli kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Yordan sɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Gɔŋ nɔ shiɛmɔ Shi be ni ena mɛi pii lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Eho eta shi ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni egbele enaa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ mumɔ lɛ mli ohiafoi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ; shi aaashɛje amɛmii.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni he jɔ lɛ; shi shikpɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ amɛnɔ.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ he hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ amɛ lɛ; shi amɛaatɔrɔ.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni naa mɔbɔ; shi aaana amɛ mɔbɔ.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni tsuii amli tse lɛ; shi amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni kpãtãa lɛ; shi aaatsɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ bii.” “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni jalɛ hewɔ ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ; shi amɛnɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.” “Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji ajɛ nyɛ ni awa nyɛ yi ni amale awie nyɛhe efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyaa ni nyɛmli afilia nyɛ ejaakɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; shi nakai amɛwa gbalɔi ni tsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ lɛ ayi.” Ŋoo kɛ la “Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋoo ji nyɛ.
Shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ?
Ehiii hãaa nɔ ko dɔŋŋ, akɛ ja atsi ashwie, ni gbɔmɛi naanaa nɔ.
Nyɛ ji je lɛ mli la lɛ.
Maŋ ni ma gɔŋ nɔ lɛ, anyɛŋ akɛtee.
Asaŋ asuuu kane amaaa tsese shishi; shi moŋ akɛmaa kanetso nɔ, ni etsoɔ ehãa mɛi ni yɔɔ shĩa lɛ fɛɛ.
Nakai nyɛhãa nyɛla atsoa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, koni amɛna nyɛnifeemɔnii kpakpai lɛ, ni amɛwo nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam.” Mla lɛ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba Mla lɛ loo gbalɔi lɛ aguu; mibaaa guu shi moŋ miba ni mabahã eye emuu.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ hoko nɛɛ, yota kome loo kuli kome ejeŋ Mla lɛ mli hoŋ, ja fɛɛ eba mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagoi kitãi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ ekome ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nakai lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaye Mla lɛ nɔ ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, lɛ lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ agbo yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛjalɛ lɛ faaa kɛtekeee mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.” Mlifu he nitsɔɔmɔ “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaagbe gbɔmɔ!
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbe gbɔmɔ lɛ eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli.’ Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mli fuɔ enyɛmi lɛ, eeeye fɔ yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ enyɛmi akɛ, ‘Yaka gbɔmɔ’ lɛ eeeye gwabɔɔ lɛ hiɛ fɔ; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Buulu’ lɛ eeeye abonsamiiaje la lɛ mliyaa fɔ.
