No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ baaŋmɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ, ni okai yɛ jɛi akɛ onyɛmi kɛ bo yɛ sane ko lɛ, shi onɔkeenɔ lɛ yɛ jɛi yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ hiɛ, ni oya okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ayakpãtã dã, koni oba ni okɛ onɔkeenɔ lɛ abahã.
Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa mra, be ni okɛ lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ, koni obelɔ lɛ kɛ bo akahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ kɛ bo hã tsuŋwolɔ lɛ, ni akɛ bo wo tsuŋ.
Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale mli akɛ ojeŋ jɛi ojeŋ kpo kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni ooowo naagbee pesewa lɛ.” Gbãlãfitemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaafite gbãlã!’ Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ yoo ni ehe feɔ lɛ akɔnɔ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ efite gbãlã momo yɛ etsui mli.
Shi kɛji oninejurɔ hiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ fãa ni oshɛ ofɔ; ejaakɛ ehi hã bo akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni akashɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje.
Ni kɛji oninejurɔ miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo ni oshɛ ofɔ̃; ejaakɛ ehi hã bo akɛ ohenii lɛ eko fiteɔ, koni ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ akaya abonsamiiaje.” Gbãlã mligbalamɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Asaŋ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaashwie eŋa lɛ ehã lɛ shwiemɔ wolo.’ Shi mi lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ sane hewɔŋ lɛ ehãa yoo lɛ fiteɔ gbãlã; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, fiteɔ gbãlã.” Kitãkãmɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Asaŋ nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ blemabii lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaakã amale kitã, shi ye okitãi lɛ anɔ ohã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkakãa kitã kwraa!
Kaakã ŋwɛi, shi Nyɔŋmɔ sɛi ni; loo shikpɔŋ, shi enajiaŋshi maaŋoo ni; loo Yerusalɛm, shi Maŋtsɛ agbo lɛ maŋ ni.
Ni okakã oyitso tete, ejaakɛ onyɛŋ ofee yitsɔi kome eyɛŋ loo ediŋ.
Shi nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ afea: ‘Hɛɛ, hɛɛ!’ ‘Dabi, dabi!’ Shi nɔ ni fe enɛɛmɛi lɛ ejɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ mli.” Oweletɔɔ “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hiŋmɛi yɛ hiŋmɛi najiaŋ; nyanyɔŋ yɛ nyanyɔŋ najiaŋ.’ Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛkatsia mɔ fɔŋ lɛ gbɛ, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagba oninejurɔ toiŋ lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko tao akɛ ekɛ bo aye sane ni eshɔ̃ oflaka lɛ, hã eŋɔ ohebo lɛ hu.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko aaanyɛ onɔ akɛ okɛ lɛ anyiɛ shitoo kome lɛ, okɛ lɛ aya enyɔ.
Mɔ ni baa bo nɔ ko lɛ hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ofa lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, kaatsɔ̃ ohe oshi lɛ.” Henyɛlɔi asuɔmɔ “Nyɛnu akɛ akɛɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo, ni onyɛ ohenyɛlɔ.’ Shi mi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ bii, ejaakɛ ehãa ehulu teɔ shi yɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai anɔ.
Ni ehaa nyɔŋmɔ nɛɔ yɛ jalɔi kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa lɛ anɔ.
Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ nyɔmɔwoo nyɛyɔɔ?
Ani toohelɔi lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ?
Ni kɛji nyɛ ŋaa nyɛnyɛmimɛi kɛkɛ lɛ, mɛni nyɛfeɔ ni teke nɔ?
Ani jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ tete efeee nakai nɔŋŋ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhia kɛwulaa shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hi kɛwula shi lɛ.”
Ejurɔfeemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa ni nyɛkafea nyɛjalɛnii lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ koni amɛna nyɛ; no lɛ, nyɛbɛ nyɔmɔwoo ko yɛ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ dɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaashiɛ otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi, tamɔ osatofoi lɛ feɔ yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ blohui lɛ amli koni gbɔmɛi ajie amɛyi.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oofee ejurɔ lɛ, kaahã obɛku le nɔ ni oninejurɔ feɔ, koni ojurɔfeemɔ lɛ ahi teemɔ mli, ni oTsɛ lɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.” Sɔlemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ “Ni kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛsumɔɔ akɛ amɛdamɔ kpeehei lɛ kɛ gbɛjegbɛi lɛ atoi amɛsɔle, koni mɛi ana amɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oosɔle lɛ, botemɔ opia mli, ni oŋa oshinaa lɛ, ni osɔle otsɛ oTsɛ yɛ teemɔ mli; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.
“Shi kɛji nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkawiea trilii tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ; shi amɛsusuɔ akɛ amɛwiemɔ babaoo lɛ hewɔ aaabo amɛ toi.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛnii tamɔ amɛ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le nii ni hiaa nyɛ dani nyɛbiɔ lɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ lɛ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsɔlea nɛkɛ, ‘WɔTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ogbɛi lɛ he atse; omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba.
Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, tamɔ afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Hã wɔ ŋmɛnɛ wɔdaaŋmaa; ni okɛ wɔnyɔji lɛ ake wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔkɛkeɔ mɛi ni hiɛ wɔ nyɔji lɛ.
Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli; shi jiemɔ wɔ kɛjɛ efɔŋ mli.
[Shi onɔ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ anunyam lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.
Amen.’] “Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi fa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛaafa nyɛ hu.
Shi kɛji nyɛkɛ mɛi atɔ̃mɔi efaaa amɛ lɛ, nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.” Ŋmaahilɛ “Shi kɛji nyɛmiihi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛkafea nyɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ tamɔ osatofoi lɛ; shi amɛfeɔ amɛhiɛ nyanyaanya, koni mɛi ana akɛ amɛmiihi ŋmaa.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ amɛnine eshɛ amɛnyɔmɔwoo nɔ momo.
Shi bo lɛ, kɛ oohi ŋmaa lɛ, kpa oyi mli mu ni ofɔ ohiɛ; koni mɔ ko akana akɛ oohi ŋmaa, akɛ ja oTsɛ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ; ni oTsɛ ni naa teemɔ mli nii lɛ aaawo bo nyɔmɔ.” Ŋwɛi jwetri “Nyɛkabɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteɔ nii ni julɔi gbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli kɛbajuɔ yɛ lɛ.
Shi nyɛbɔa jwetri nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni omlɛgɛ kɛ ŋkanale fiteee nii ni julɔi egbuuu kɛboteee mli kɛyajuuu yɛ lɛ.
Shi he ni ojwetri yɔɔ lɛ jɛi otsui aaahi.” Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane “Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji hiŋmɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaayi kɛ la.
Shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tseee lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ aaawo duŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ ji duŋ lɛ, te no duŋ lɛ aaafa ahã tɛŋŋ!” Henaagbamɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ “Mɔ ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kroko lɛ; aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeebu mɔ kroko lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko.
Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mamona (ninamɔ) nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛkafea yeyeeye yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaanu hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ.
Ani wala efeee ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso efeee atade?
Nyɛkwɛa ŋwɛi loofɔji lɛ: amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, asaŋ amɛbuaaa naa amɛwooo aboŋoi amli; shi nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ lɛɔ amɛ kɛ̃.
Ani nyɛhiii aahu fe amɛ?
Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekwɔlɛ nɔ ninetalɔ kome?
Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛfeɔ yeyeeye yɛ atade hewɔ?
Nyɛjwɛŋa ŋa nɔ fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, bɔ ni amɛdaraa; amɛgbooo deŋme, asaŋ amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome.
Shi kɛji ŋa nɔ jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ eyɛ ni wɔ ni ashɛ afɔ̃ flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani efeŋ nɔ ni fe enɛ ehaŋ nyɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa lɛ lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Mɛni wɔɔye, aloo mɛni wɔɔnu, mɛni hu wɔkɛ aha wɔhe?’ Ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ.
Shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ he miihia nyɛ.
Shi nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ ejalɛ lɛ tsutsu ni akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaafata he ahã nyɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛtoa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ aaahao yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Gbi fɛɛ gbi nɔ efɔŋ lɛ fa hã lɛ.”
Kojomɔ “Nyɛkakojoa, koni akakojo nyɛ.
Shi nɔ kojomɔ ni nyɛkɛkojoɔ lɛ, akɛaakojo nyɛ; ni nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, akɛasusu ahã nyɛ.
Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni yɔɔ onyɛmi hiŋmɛi mli lɛ, shi bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli mplaŋ lɛ oyooo lɛ?
Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni oookɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Hã majie kuli lɛ yɛ ohiŋmɛi mli,’ be mli ni mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ?
Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛi mli.
Nyɛkɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ akahãa shifɔji; asaŋ nyɛkashɛrɛa nyɛdiagbai nyɛshwiea kplotoi ahiɛ, ni amɛbanaana nɔ yɛ amɛnajiashi, ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe amɛbatserɛ nyɛ.” Bimɔ, taomɔ kɛ shimɔ “Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa, ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagbele ahã nyɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ, enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagbele ahã lɛ.
Aloo nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ?
Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ ŋshɔŋloo, ni eeehã lɛ onufu?
Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ nyɛkɛ nikpakpai hãa nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ nikpakpai ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?
Mla ni jara wa lɛ “No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ enɛ ji Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ.” Agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ “Nyɛbotea agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ agbo ni lɛɛ kɛ gbɛ tɛtɛrɛɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli, ni mɛi ni boteɔ mli lɛ fa.
Shi agbo fintɔŋŋ kɛ gbɛ ni etsa ji nɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli lɛ, ni mɛi fioo ji mɛi ni naa no.” Amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛaale amɛ “Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ amale gbalɔi lɛ ahe; amɛkɛ too wolo haa amɛhe kɛbaa nyɛŋɔɔ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ klãji fulɔi ji amɛ.
Amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛaale amɛ.
Ani atseɔ wainyibii yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, aloo atseɔ agbãmii yɛ aŋlɛŋlɛi anɔ?
Nakai nɔŋŋ tso fɛɛ tso ni ji ekpakpa lɛ woɔ yibii kpakpai; shi tso gbonyo woɔ yibii gbohii.
Tso kpakpa nyɛɛɛ awo yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo nyɛɛɛ awo yibii kpakpai.
Tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ, atoɔ lɛ ni ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛyibii lɛ nyɛkɛale amɛ.” Mileee nyɛ kwraa “Jeee mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kɛɔ mi akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!’ lɛ, aaabote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; shi moŋ mɔ ni feɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ.
Mɛi pii aaakɛɛ mi nakai gbi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!
Ani jeee bo ogbɛi lɛ mli wɔfee hewalɛnii pii yɛ lo?’ Ni no lɛ magba mli makɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Mileee nyɛ kwraa, nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtsuɔ nibii ni ejaaa gbɛ!’ ” Tsumalɔi enyɔ lɛ “No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔi nɛɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nilelɔ ni ma etsu yɛ tɛsaa nɔ lɛ he.
Ni nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni fai ba, ni kɔɔyɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, shi ewuleee; ejaakɛ ato shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔi nɛɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ aaato nuu kwashia ni ma etsu yɛ shia nɔ lɛ he.
Ni nyɔŋmɔ tue, ni fai ba, ni kɔɔyɔi tswa, ni amɛshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni ewule, ni ewulemɔ lɛ da!” Ni be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he; ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hegbɛ, shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ.
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ Shi be ni Yesu jɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekpeleke shi lɛ, asafoi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa, kpitiyelɔ ko ba ebakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse!” Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ, ohe atse!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ekpiti lɛ tã.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni ohã keenii ni Mose to lɛ, ni no aaafee odase ahã amɛ.” Asraafoiohaatsɛ ko wenuu tsamɔ Shi be ni Yesu bote Kapernaum lɛ, asraafoiohaatsɛ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakpa lɛ fai, ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, miwenuu kã shi yɛ shĩa kɛ kuumɔhela, eena nɔ naakpa.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miiba ni mabatsa lɛ.” Ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, esaaa mi akɛ obaa mikoi lɛ shi; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa miwenuu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Yaa!’ Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Ba!’ Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ, ‘Feemɔ enɛ!’ Ni efeɔ.” Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ yɛ Israel!
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai aba, ni amɛkɛ Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob aaabatara okplɔ̃ he yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ, aaashwie amɛ awo gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, bɔ ni ohe oye lɛ, afee nakai ahã bo.” Ni atsa ewenuu lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ Ni be ni Yesu ba Petro we lɛ, ena eshaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii.
Ni emɔ enineshi, ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ete shi ni esɔmɔ amɛ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, akɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni ekɛ ewiemɔ fãmɔ mumɔi lɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni he yeɔ fɛɛ.
Koni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewo wɔhejaramɔi lɛ, ni etere wɔhelai lɛ.” Mɛi ni taoɔ Yesu sɛɛ anyiɛ Shi be ni Yesu na mɛi pii yɛ ehewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ afo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya esɛɛgbɛ.
Ni mlatsɔɔlɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛya he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ.” Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni mayafu mitsɛ dã.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ, ni ohã gbohii afu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbohii.” Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa Ni ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa; ŋshɔ lɛ fee hamahama aahu ni ŋshɔkei miikumɔ miiwo lɛlɛ lɛ mli; shi Yesu, ewɔ.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ wɔyiwala, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa?” Kɛkɛ ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ yi, ni eŋmɛ dɛmm.
Shi gbɔmɛi lɛ ahiɛ fee amɛ yaa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?” Yesu tsa hii enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli Be ni eyashɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbɛ yɛ Gadarabii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ mɛi enyɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli ni amɛjɛ gbohii afũuhe lɛ kɛ lɛ bakpe; amɛhiɛ ewo la tsɔ̃ bɔ ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃.
Ni naa, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ?
Ani oba biɛ ni obawo wɔ hejaramɔ dani be lɛ ashɛ?” Ni kplotoi akuu kpele ko miiye nii yɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji ofã wɔ lɛ hã wɔyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa!” Ni amɛje kpo amɛyabote kplotoi akuu lɛ mli; ni naa, kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ nu lɛ mli.
Ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ jo foi, amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyagba saji lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ anɔ lɛ hu.
Ni naa, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ je kpo ni amɛkɛ Yesu ayakpe; ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.
Kuumɔ helatsɛ ko tsamɔ Yesu bote lɛlɛ mli, ni efo ŋshɔ lɛ, ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli.
Ni naa, akɛ mɔ ko ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela ni kã saa nɔ ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, “Bi, hã otsui anyɔ omli, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo!” Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ yɛ amɛmli akɛ, “Musu mɔ nɛ bɔɔ nɛɛ.” Ni be ni Yesu na amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ nii fɔ̃ji yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nɛɛ?
Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, akɛ aaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Aŋɔ ohe eshai lɛ afa bo,’ aloo ‘Tee shi ni onyiɛ’ lɛ?
Shi be ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ,” — kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ kuumɔ hela lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shĩa!” Ni ete shi etee shĩa.
Shi be ni asafo lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam akɛ ekɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ ehã gbɔmɛi.
Mateo tsɛmɔ Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi eyaa lɛ ena nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mateo ta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni eta niyenii ashi yɛ shĩa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi babaoo ba, ni amɛkɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ batara okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ kɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii nɛɛ?” Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ.
Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakasea nɔ ni ji enɛ shishi.
‘Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ, ni jeee afɔle!’ Ejaakɛ mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ.” Ŋmaahilɛ he sane Kɛkɛ ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ wɔ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ, shi okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ aye ŋkɔmɔ gbii abɔ ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ?
Shi gbii aaaba momo ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaaje amɛteŋ kɛaatee, ni no dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.
“Shi mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ nɔ ni akɛta lɛ yeɔ atade lɛ, ni folɔ lɛ lɛɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Asaŋ akɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli; no lɛ, wolo tɔi lɛ aaaflɛ, ni wain lɛ aaashwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ aaafite; shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli moŋ akɛwoɔ, ni enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ feɔ shweshweeshwe.” Onukpa lɛ biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ Be ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, onukpa ko ba bakoto lɛ ekɛɛ, “Mibiyoo eje mli amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ba ni okɛ onine abaŋmɛ enɔ, ni ehiɛ aaatsɛ̃.” Ni Yesu te shi ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni naa, yoo ko ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ baje esɛɛgbɛ eta etade naamuu lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Kɛji mina mita etade lɛ he kɛkɛ lɛ, mihe aaawa mi.” Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Biyoo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala!” Ni yoo lɛ he wa lɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni Yesu ba onukpa lɛ we lɛ ni ena blɛkpalɔi kɛ mɛi pii ni feɔ hoo lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa sɛɛ, ejaakɛ oblayoo lɛ gboko, shi wɔ kɛkɛ ewɔɔ.” Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni ashwie mɛi lɛ, etee tsu lɛ mli, ni emɔ oblayoo lɛ nineshi, ni ete shi.
Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ jije yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shwilafoi enyɔ lɛ atsamɔ Ni be ni Yesu je jɛi ehoɔ lɛ, shwilafoi enyɔ nyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛmiibolɔ akɛ, “Naa wɔ mɔbɔ, David Bi!” Ni be ni ebote shĩa lɛ, shwilafoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ akɛ manyɛ enɛ mafee lo?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe ni ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ, afee nakai ahã nyɛ.” Ni amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ gbele.
Ni Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni mɔ ko akalea!” Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛje jɛi lɛ, amɛyagbɛ ehe sane lɛ amɛshwã yɛ jɛi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Mumui ko tsamɔ Shi be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, akɛ mumui ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, mumui lɛ wie.
Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe amɛkɛɛ, “Anako nɛkɛ nɔ ko pɛŋ yɛ Israel!” Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ!” Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ Ni Yesu kpa maji lɛ kɛ akrowai lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni eshiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa lɛ, ni etsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ.
Shi be ni ena mɛi babaoo lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ejaakɛ etɔ amɛ ni amɛfee yuuyaa tamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpaa nikpamɔ nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni ewo nitsulɔi agbɛ kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli!”
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ Ni Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba, ni ehã amɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ hewalɛ ni amɛfamɔ amɛ ni amɛtsa hela fɛɛ hela kɛ hejaramɔ fɛɛ hejaramɔ.
Shi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane; Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo, Toma kɛ Mateo, tóohelɔ lɛ, Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo; Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Nɛkɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɛɛ Yesu tsu, ni efã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkagbalea jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkabotea Samariabii amaŋ ko mli hu; shi moŋ nyɛyaa Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Shi ni nyɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛshiɛa nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ shi etã.’ Nyɛtsaa helatsɛmɛi, nyɛtea gbohii ashi, nyɛhãa kpitiyelɔi ahe atsea, nyɛfamɔa mumɔi fɔ̃ji; yaka nyɛna, yaka nyɛkɛhãa.
Nyɛkataoa shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo akɔɔble nyɛwoa nyɛhɛfiinii amli; asaŋ nyɛkataoa gbɛfãa kotoku, loo flakai enyɔ, loo tokotai loo tso; shi nitsulɔ lɛ eŋmaa sa lɛ.
“Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo akrowa fɛɛ akrowa mli ni nyɛaabote lɛ, nyɛbia mɔ ni sa shi yɛ jɛi, ni nyɛto jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaatee.
Shi kɛ nyɛmiibote shĩa lɛ, nyɛŋaa shĩa lɛ.
Ni kɛji shĩa lɛ sa lɛ, nyɛhãa nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ abaa enɔ; shi kɛji esaaa lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ akpale aba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko hereee nyɛ, ni ebooo nyɛwiemɔi lɛ atoi lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai shĩa lɛ loo nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Sodom kɛ Gomora shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, tamɔ nakai maŋ lɛ.” Kaselɔi lɛ ayiwaa “Naa miitsu nyɛ tamɔ too Gwantɛŋi yɛ klãji ateŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ atɛ̃a tamɔ onufui, ni nyɛfea kpoo tamɔ okpoi.
“Shi nyɛhĩɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee kojomɔhei, ni amɛaayi nyɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Shi kɛji amɛŋɔ nyɛ kɛtee lɛ nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaawie aloo nɔ ni nyɛakɛɛ hewɔ; shi akɛ nɔ ni nyɛawie aahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ jeee nyɛ ji mɛi ni wieɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛTsɛ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni wieɔ yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.
“Shi nyɛmi kɛ nyɛmi aaahã gbele, ni tsɛ kɛ bi aaahã, ni bii aaate shi awo amɛfɔlɔi, ni amɛaahã agbe amɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.
Shi kɛ amɛmiiwa nyɛ yi yɛ maŋ ko mli lɛ, nyɛjoa foi nyɛyaa ekroko mli; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ nyɛgbeŋ Israel maji lɛ fɛɛ naa dani Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba.
Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ni asaŋ nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ.
Efa hã kaselɔ akɛ eeetamɔ enuŋtsɔ.
Kɛji shĩatsɛ lɛ amɛtsɛ Beelzebul lɛ, ewebii lɛ shii enyiɛ amɛtsɛŋ amɛ nakai?” Mɔ gbeyei ni sa akɛ ashe “Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkashea amɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ, ni agbeleŋ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni atee nɔ ni aleŋ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ yɛ duŋ mli lɛ, nyɛwiea yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni miwoɔ nyɛtoiŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛshiɛa yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ.
Ni nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ susuma lɛ amɛgbe lɛ gbeyei; shi moŋ nyɛshea mɔ ni nyɛɔ susuma kɛ gbɔmɔtso fɛɛ hiɛ ekpãtãa yɛ abonsamiiaje lɛ gbeyei.
Ani aflimatai enyɔ lɛ jeee pesewa ahɔ̃ɔ aheɔ?
Shi amɛteŋ ekome flo enyɔŋ shikpɔŋ, ja ejɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ dɛŋ.
Shi nyɛyiteŋtsɔ̃i po lɛ akane fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjara wa aahu fe aflimatai babaoo.” Kristo he odaseyeli yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ “Hewɔ lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa mli tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu magba mli matsi etã yɛ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, mi hu makwa lɛ yɛ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ.” Jeee hejɔlɛ, shi klante “Nyɛkasusua akɛ miba ni mabahã hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; jeee hejɔlɛ hamɔ miba shi klante moŋ.
Ejaakɛ miba ni mabahã mɔ ate shi ashi etsɛ, biyoo ate shi ashi enyɛ, shaayoo ate shi ashi eshaayoo.
Ni mɔ diɛŋtsɛ shĩateŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ ehenyɛlɔi.
Mɔ ni dɔɔ tsɛ loo nyɛ he fe mi lɛ, esaaa mi; ni mɔ ni dɔɔ binuu loo biyoo he fe mi lɛ, esaaa mi.
Ni mɔ ni wooo esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, esaaa mi.
Mɔ ni baa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ.” Mɛi ni hereɔ Yesu kaselɔi anyɔmɔwo “Mɔ ni hereɔ nyɛ lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mɔ ni hereɔ gbalɔ yɛ gbalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, gbalɔ nyɔmɔwoo eeena; ni mɔ ni hereɔ jalɔ yɛ jalɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, jalɔ nyɔmɔwoo eeena.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã mɛi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nuhɔ̃ɔ kpulu kome pɛ enu yɛ kaselɔ gbɛi mli lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwoo eŋmɛŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.”
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ Be ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ nibii nɛɛ egbe naa lɛ, eje jɛi eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii ni eshiɛ yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli.
Shi be ni Yohane nu Kristo nitsumɔi lɛ ahe yɛ gboklɛfoiatsu lɛ mli lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?” Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ kɛ nɔ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ: shwilafoi miina nii, ni obubuafoi miinyiɛ; kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, ni toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni ohiafoi lɛ aajaje sane kpakpa lɛ aatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni ajɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔtɔŋ enane.” Yesu ye Yohane he odase Shi be ni mɛi ni atsu nɛɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛyaa lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i Yohane he wiemɔ kɛ mɛi babaoo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, “Mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Glã ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ?
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee?
Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ?
Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ.
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee?
Gbalɔ?
Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete.
Ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji mɔ hewɔ ni aŋma akɛ, ‘Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato bo lɛ!
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko eteko shi ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo kwraa yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ fe lɛ.
Shi kɛjɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yinɔ kɛbaa nɛɛ, hewalɛ naa aŋɔɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, ni hewalɔi gbalaa lɛ hewalɛ naa.
Shi gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Mla lɛ gba kɛbashi Yohane nɔ.
Ni kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛmɔ mli lɛ, mɔ nɛ ji Elia ni baaba lɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!
“Shi namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato?
Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tara jaji anɔ ni amɛtsɛtsɛɔ amɛnanemɛi akɛ, ‘Wɔkpã blɛ wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo; Wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛfooo.’ Ejaakɛ Yohane ba, ni eyeee nii, ni esaa enuuu nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli.’ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba, ni eyeɔ nii ni esaa enuɔ nɔ ko lɛ, amɛkɛɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, nuu fulɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, tóohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashieŋtsɛ nɛ!’ Ni abu nilee bem yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.” Maji ni tsakeee amɛtsui lɛ Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i maji, hei ni etsu ehewalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ amli tsiimɔ yɛ lɛ, ahiɛ wiemɔ, yɛ amɛtsui ni amɛtsakeee lɛ hewɔ, ekɛɛ, “Kpoo hã bo, Korazin!
Kpoo hã bo, Betsaida!
Ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon kulɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli jeeŋmɔ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ nyɛ.
Ni bo Kapernaum, ani aaawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi?
Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee; ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ omli lɛ, eji atsu yɛ Sodom kulɛ ema shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ejaraŋ haŋ Sodom shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ tamɔ bo.” Yesu mli fili lɛ ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu kɛɛ, “Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ okɛ nii nɛɛ etee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii.
Hɛɛ, Ataa, bɔ ni sa ohiɛ ji no.
MiTsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee Bi lɛ, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ, asaŋ Tsɛ lɛ hu, mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ, akɛ ja Bi lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejieɔ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ.” Nyɛbaa ni mahã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔ “Nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni etɔ nyɛ ni nyɛjatsui fe nyɛ lɛ, ni mahã nyɛ hejɔɔmɔ.
Nyɛwoa mipã lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a nyɛnɔ, ni nyɛkasea mi; shi mihe jɔ, ni mibaa mihe shi kɛjɛ mitsui mli; ni nyɛaana hejɔɔmɔ nyɛhã nyɛsusumai lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mipã lɛ teremɔ waaa, ni mijatsu lɛ etsiii.”
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji amli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ; ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i abele lɛ kuumɔ kɛ kpemɔ.
Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ na lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, okaselɔi lɛ miifee nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afee yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ: bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyaye aboloi ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni aŋmɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ loo mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ yeɔ, akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?
Aloo nyɛkaneko yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ osɔfoi buleɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni amɛyeee fɔ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ ko ni fe Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Shi eji nyɛle wiemɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔbɔnalɛ mitaoɔ shi jeee afɔle’ lɛ shishi kulɛ, nyɛbuŋ mɛi ni yeee fɔ lɛ afɔ.
Ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.” Nuu ni nine kome egbo lɛ Ni eje jɛi eyabote amɛkpeehe lɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo.
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ?” Bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo enaa folɔmɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ too kome, ni too lɛ yagbee bu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni emɔŋ emli ni ejie lɛ?
Ani gbɔmɔ jara waaa babaoo fe too?
No hewɔ ni eja gbɛ akɛ afeɔ ejurɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ni ekpã mli ni eye emuu tamɔ ekome lɛ.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ je kpo tee eyi nɔ apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Tsulɔ ni ehala lɛ Shi be ni Yesu kpa enɛ shi lɛ, egbala ehe shi kɛje jɛi.
Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni etsa amɛ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkahã anu ehe; bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Naa, mitsulɔ ni mihala lɛ, misuɔlɔ ni misusuma naa ehe tsui lɛ; mikɛ miMumɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ enɔ, ni eeejaje kojomɔ etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ebeŋ, ni ebolɔŋ hu, ni mɔ ko nuŋ egbee yɛ blohuiaŋ.
Glã ni amia lɛ, ekuŋ, ni kane mli tako ni tsoɔ sulii lɛ, egbeŋ, Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeehã jalɛ aye kunim.
Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ jeŋmaji lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃.” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Kɛkɛ ni akɛ mɔ ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli ni ji shwilafo kɛ mumui fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ; ni etsa lɛ ni shwilafo ni ji mumui hu lɛ wie ni ena nii.
Ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee David Bi lɛ nɛ?” Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ Beelzebul hewalɛ kɛkɛ mɔ nɛ kɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” Shi akɛni Yesu yoo amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, ejwaa; ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ loo shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ edamɔɔɔ shi.
Ni kɛji Satan fã Satan lɛ, egba ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; belɛ te emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaafee tɛŋŋ adamɔ shiŋ?
Ni kɛji mi lɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ naa mifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɛ lɛ, nyɛbihii lɛ, namɔ hewalɛ naa amɛfamɔ amɛ yɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ.
Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa mifãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ lɛ, no lɛ ninamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ lɛ.
Shi kulɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ko aaanyɛ hewalɔ we abote ni eyaha enibiiŋ, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dani eeewo ewe lɛ haa?
Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, shi ete ewo mi; ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ, gbɛ egbɛɔ eshwãa.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, akɛ esha kɛ musubɔɔ fɛɛ aaafa gbɔmɛi; shi Mumɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ lɛ akɛfaŋ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ, shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie ashi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ yɛ je nɛɛŋ loo jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli.” Tso kɛ eyibii “Nyɛhãa tso lɛ afea tso kpakpa, ni ewo yibii kpakpai; aloo nyɛhãa afea tso gbonyo, ni ewo yibii gbohii; ejaakɛ tso yibii akɛleɔ tso.
Nyɛ shinɔi ashwiei!
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni nyɛaanyɛ ekpakpa nyɛwieŋ?
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ kɛteke nɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ naabu wieɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nikpakpai kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli; ni gbɔmɔ fɔŋ hu jieɔ nifɔɔji kɛjɛɔ etsuiŋ jwetri fɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, yaka wiemɔ fɛɛ yaka wiemɔ ni gbɔmɛi wieɔ lɛ, amɛbaabu he akɔntaa yɛ kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Shi owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu bo bem, ni owiemɔi lɛ amli aaajɛ abu bo fɔ.” Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔmiitao onine naa okadi ko wɔkwɛ.” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yinɔbii fɔ̃ji kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi miitao okadi; shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona ye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ ŋshɔŋ loo kpeteŋkple lɛ musuŋ lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaye shwaneshwane kɛ nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ gbii etɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ mli tɔ̃ɔ.
Nineve hii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ebabo Solomon nilee lɛ toi; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee lɛ yɛ biɛ.” Mumɔ fɔŋ sɛɛkuu kɛ gbɔmɔ mli botemɔ “Shi mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ, kɛ eje gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, shi enaaa eko.
Ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ.’ Ni kɛ eba lɛ, enaa akɛ ekã shi efolo, ni abɛɛ mli, ni awula mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mɛi fɔ̃ji fe lɛ ekɛfataa ehe, ni amɛbaa amɛbahiɔ jɛi; ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ naagbee shihilɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ebaaba mli yɛ yinɔ fɔŋ nɛɛ hu gbɛfaŋ.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi Shi be ni ekɛ asafoi lɛ wieɔ lolo lɛ, enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ badamɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ lɛ awie.
[ Ni mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛkɛ bo awie.”] Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ mɔ ni bakɛɛ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji minyɛ, ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi?” Ni ekpã enine mli etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ ekɛɛ, “Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, lɛ ji minyɛmi nuu kɛ minyɛmi yoo kɛ minyɛ.”
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu je shĩa lɛ eyata ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni asafo babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, etee lɛlɛ ko mli eyata shi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni ewie wiemɔi pii etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli ekɛɛ, “Nidulɔ yiŋ etee nidumɔ.
Ni be ni eduɔ lɛ, wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ he, ni loofɔji ba bakɔlɔ.
Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie tesai anɔ, he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ; ni amrɔ lɛ, akɛni amɛbɛ sũ ni mli kwɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛkwɛ̃ oya; shi be ni hulu te shi lɛ, amɛshã: ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã ko hewɔ lɛ amɛŋalã.
Ni ekomɛi hu yashwie ŋmei ateŋ ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Shi ekomɛi hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ewo yibii: eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛ nuɔ nii lɛ, enu!” Nɔ̃ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ okɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ?” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ akɛhã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ, shi amɛ lɛ akɛ hãko amɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ ni ena kɛteke nɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ tete lɛ, aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.
Enɛ hewɔ mikɛ amɛ wieɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiina nɛ shi amɛnaaa, ni amɛmiinu nɛ shi amɛnuuu, ni amɛnaaa shishi hu.
Ni Yesaia gbalɛ lɛ eba mli yɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi; ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ, ni amɛtoii ewa, ni amɛŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii; koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii, ni amɛkanu kɛ amɛtoii, ni amɛtsui hu akana shishi, ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.’ “Shi nyɛ lɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiina nii, kɛ nyɛtoii lɛ, akɛ amɛmiinu nii.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbalɔi kɛ jalɔi pii shwe ni amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, shi amɛyanaaa, aloo ni amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu.” Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi “Agbɛnɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛboa nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi toi.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he wiemɔ lɛ ni eyooo sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɔŋ lɛ baa bashaa nɔ ni adu yɛ etsui mli lɛ.
Mɔ nɛ ji gbɛ he he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Shi tɛsaa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ damɔ shi hã mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ehereɔ amrɔ kɛ miishɛɛ; shi akɛni ebɛ shishifã lɛ, ehiɔ shi fioo kɛkɛ; ni kɛji haomɔ loo yiwaa ba yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ lɛ enane etɔ̃tɔ̃.
Ni ŋmei ateŋ he ni adu wu lɛ yɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ nii pii ahe lakamɔ lɛ gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ, ni ewooo yibii.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa ni adu wu lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni eyoɔ sɛɛ, ni esaa ewoɔ yibii hu, eko oha, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃.” Jwɛi kɛ ŋmaa ni efutu lɛ Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko hu ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu ko ni duɔ wui kpakpai yɛ eŋmɔ mli.
Shi be ni mɛi wɔ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔ ko ba ebadu jwɛi efutu ŋmaa lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni ŋmaa lɛ kwɛ ni ewo yibii lɛ, kɛkɛ ni jwɛi lɛ hu pue.
Ni shĩatsɛ lɛ tsuji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, ani jeee wui kpakpai odu yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?
Nɛgbɛ ekɛ jwɛi nɛɛ jɛ mɔ?’ Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Henyɛlɔ ko bafee enɛ nɛɛ.
Ni etsuji lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, Be lɛ ooosumɔ akɛ wɔya ni wɔyafãmɔ lo?’ Shi ekɛɛ, ‘Dabi, ekolɛ aleenɔ jwɛi lɛ fãamɔ mli lɛ, nyɛaafãmɔ ŋmaa lɛ hu nyɛfutuŋ.
Nyɛŋmɛa enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ ni amɛdara kɛyashi ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ, ni ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ makɛɛ nikpalɔi lɛ akɛ, nyɛbuaa jwɛi lɛ anaa tsutsu, ni nyɛfimɔa amɛ keikei, koni ashã; shi ŋmaa lɛ nyɛbuaa naa nyɛyawoa miboŋo lɛ mli.’ ” Sinapi wu kɛ mãsha lɛ Yesu bu amɛ abɛ kroko ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ sinapi wu ni mɔ ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ eŋmɔ mli; eji wui ateŋ bibioo fe fɛɛ, shi kɛ ekwɛ̃ lɛ, edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ; ni efeɔ tso, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji baa bafeɔ tsui yɛ eniji ateŋ.” Ebu amɛ abɛ kroko akɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ mãsha ni yoo ko kɔ ni ekɛhɔ mã tsesei etɛ̃ mli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha.” Abɛbuai amli Yesu kɛ asafoi lɛ wie nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ ewieee nɔ ko akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli kɛkɛ; koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Magbele minaa yɛ abɛbuai amli; magba nii ni akɛtee kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ.” Jwɛi kɛ ŋmaa ni efutu abɛ lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni etee shĩa lɛ.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli jwɛi lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi.” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wui kpakpai adulɔ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ; ŋmɔ lɛ ji je lɛ; wui kpakpai lɛ ji maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli bii lɛ; jwɛi lɛ ji mɔ fɔŋ lɛ bii lɛ; henyɛlɔ ni du amɛ lɛ ji abonsam; ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ ji je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ; ni ŋmaakpalɔi lɛ ji ŋwɛi bɔfoi.
Agbɛnɛ bɔ ni abuaa jwɛi anaa ni akɛ la shãa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafee yɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔnii fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii ni shiɔ mla lɛ anaa kɛaaje emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ amɛaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.
No ni jalɔi lɛ aaakpɛ tamɔ hulu yɛ amɛ-Tsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!” Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he abɛi etɛ̃ “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ jwetri ni akɛtee yɛ abɔɔ mli, ni be ni mɔ ko yana lɛ, ekɛtee, ni no he miishɛɛ ni ena hewɔ lɛ etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe nakai abɔɔ lɛ.
“Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ guɔyelɔ ko ni taoɔ adiagbai fɛɛfɛji, ni be ni eyana adiagba kome ni jara wa lɛ, etee ni eyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni ekɛhe.
“Asaŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ yaa ni afɔ̃ yɛ ŋshɔ mli ni edu loi srɔtoi fɛɛ eko; ni be ni eyi lɛ, wolɛi lɛ gbala kɛba shia nɔ, ni amɛtara shi amɛbua ekpakpai lɛ anaa amɛwo kpaii amli; shi nii ni ehiii lɛ amɛshɛrɛ amɛshwie.
Nakai nɔŋŋ abaafee yɛ je lɛ naagbee lɛ.
Ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ aaaje kpo aba ni amɛbaahala mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ yɛ jalɔi lɛ ateŋ; ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaawo la flɔnɔɔ lɛ mli.
Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.” Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ ashishi lo?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ!” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔ fɛɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ ni afee lɛ kaselɔ, ahã ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, etamɔ shĩatsɛ ko ni jieɔ nii hei kɛ nii memeji kɛjeɔ ejwetri lɛ mli.” Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe abɛbuai nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje jɛi; ni be ni eba lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ mli lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ amɛkpeehe lɛ, ni ehã amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ.
“Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nilee kɛ hewalɛnii nɛɛ kɛjɛ?
Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ bi lɛ nɛ?
Ani jeee enyɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Maria lɛ, kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii ni ji Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Simon kɛ Yuda lɛ?
Ni enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ, ani jeee amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ wɔ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ mɔ?” Ni etsɔ̃ pampi ehã amɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abuɔ gbalɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe kɛkɛ.” Ni akɛni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ etsuuu hewalɛnii pii ko yɛ jɛi.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ gbele Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ lumɔ Herode nu Yesu he sane; ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛi lɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ.” Ekɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ emɔ Yohane efi lɛ ni ewo lɛ tsuŋ yɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ hewɔ.
Efee enɛ, ejaakɛ Yohane kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ.” Ni kulɛ etao akɛ egbe lɛ, shi eeshe asafo lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ amɛbuɔ Yohane gbalɔ.
Shi be ni ayeɔ Herode fɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Herodia biyoo lɛ bajo yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ, ni efee Herode fɛo; no hewɔ lɛ, ekã kitã ekɛwo lɛ shi akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeebi lɛ lɛ eeehã lɛ.
Ni enyɛ wo lɛ ŋaa, ni ebakɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso ofɔ̃ kã mli ohã mi yɛ biɛ!” Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ; shi ekitãi ni ekãmɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, efã akɛ akɛhã lɛ.
Ni etsu ayafo Yohane yitso yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Ni akɛ eyitso lɛ fɔ̃ kã mli kɛba, ni akɛhã oblayoo lɛ, ni ekɛyahã enyɛ.
Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ ba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ ni amɛyafu, ni amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ Yesu.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛje jɛi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko banee.
Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛje maji lɛ amli amɛnyiɛ amɛnane kɛtiu lɛ.
Ni be ni Yesu kpeleke lɛ, ebana mɛi babaoo, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhewɔ, ni etsa amɛhelatsɛmɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Ŋa nɔ ji biɛ, ni je miina; jiemɔ asafoi lɛ agbɛ ni amɛya akrowai lɛ amli ni amɛyahe niyenii amɛye.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ehiaaa akɛ amɛaatee; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nii amɛyea.” Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ pɛ ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ biɛ ji aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛbahãa mi yɛ biɛ!” Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtaratara shi yɛ jwɛi lɛ anɔ.
Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ, ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ; ni ekumɔ aboloi lɛ amli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛhã asafoi lɛ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye, ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛkɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaashɛ hii akpei enumɔ, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Yesu yasɔle Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ, ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛya ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, kɛyashi eeewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ.
Ni be ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ lɛ, ekwɔ kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni eyasɔle.
Be ni je na lɛ, ekometoo eyɔɔ jɛi.
Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ Shi lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ momo ni ŋshɔkei lɛ miihɛlɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ eekpee kɔɔyɔɔ.
Ni maŋkɛ hima, aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛtsui fã, ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Sisaŋ!” Ni amɛbolɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ.
Shi amrɔ lɛ Yesu fã enaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛnaa tsui, miŋ; nyɛkashea gbeyei.” Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji bo ni lɛ, fã mi koni matsɔ̃ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Ba!” Ni Petro je lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni enyiɛ nu lɛ hiɛ kɛmiiya Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Shi be ni ena akɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ miitswa waa lɛ, eshe gbeyei ni ebɔ̃i shiumɔ, ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, heremɔ mi!” Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu kpã enine mli esɔo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo ni ohemɔkɛyeli faaa, mɛni hewɔ oje ŋwane?” Ni be ni amɛbote lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ bakoto lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛɛlɛŋ!” Yesu tsa helatsɛmɛi yɛ Genesaret Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesaret shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni jɛibii lɛ yoo lɛ lɛ, amɛtsu atee jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni ayaŋɔ helatsɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ; ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ehã amɛna etade lɛ naamuu lɛ he amɛtara kɛkɛ; ni mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni tara he lɛ he wa amɛ kwraa.
Onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi Kɛkɛ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni okaselɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ̃ dani amɛyeɔ nii.” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ tɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ!’ Kɛ ‘Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!’ Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaakɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, mikɛke Nyɔŋmɔ’ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekawo etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ nyɛgu Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ.
Osatofoi!
Gbɛ naa pɛ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛhe akɛ, ‘Maŋ nɛɛ kɛ amɛnaabu woɔ mi; shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛjɛ mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ, Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.’ ” Nibii ni buleɔ mɔ Ni etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛboa toi ni nyɛna shishi!
Jeee nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni jeɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, no buleɔ gbɔmɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ole akɛ be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ewo amɛ mlila waa?” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Tso fɛɛ tso ni jeee miŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ tɛoɔ lɛ, fã aaafã.
Nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ!
Shwilafoi ni tsɔ̃ɔ shwilafoi agbɛ ji amɛ; ni kɛ shwilafo miitsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ lɛ, amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaagbee bu mli.” Ni Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ abɛ nɛɛ shishi!” Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛnako nii ashishi lolo?
Ani nyɛkpako shi akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni boteɔ mɔ daaŋ lɛ, musuŋ eyaa ni ajieɔ awoɔ tiafi mli?
Shi nii ni jɛɔ daaŋ jeɔ kpo lɛ, tsui mli ejɛɔ, ni nomɛi buleɔ mɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ tsui mli ni susumɔi fɔ̃ji, gbɔmɔgbee, gbãlãfitemɔ, ajwamãŋbɔɔ, juu, amale odaseyeli kɛ oshekuyeli jɛɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ; shi dɛ̃ ni afɔɔɔ dani ayeɔ nii lɛ, no buleee mɔ.” Kanaanyoo ko hemɔkɛyeli Kɛkɛ ni Yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ.
Ni naa, Kanaanyoo ko jɛ jɛi niiaŋ nɔŋŋ babolɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa mi mɔbɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, David Bi; mibiyoo miina nɔ kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ.” Shi efooo edaaŋ.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba bakpa lɛ fai akɛ, “Wo lɛ gbɛ ni eya, shi eebolɔ kɛnyiɛ wɔsɛɛ!” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Israel we toi ni elaaje lɛ aŋɔɔ kɛkɛ atsu mi.” Shi yoo lɛ ba bakulã shi yɛ ehiɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, feemɔ he eko ohã mi!” Shi ekɛɛ, “Ejaaa akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ shifɔji abii.” Shi ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ; shi bɛ shifɔji abii lɛ hu yeɔ fufuji ni shwieɔ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ eko!” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “O yoo, ohemɔkɛyeli da!
Afee ahã bo tamɔ bɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ!” Ni atsa ebiyoo lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Yesu tsa mɛi pii Ni Yesu je jɛi eba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni ekwɔ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyata shi yɛ jɛi.
Ni asafoi pii ba eŋɔɔ; amɛhiɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ obubuafoi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ mumuii kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii, ni amɛkɛ amɛ bashwie enaji anaa; ni etsa amɛ.
Ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, be ni amɛna akɛ mumuii miiwie, ni obubuafoi ahe ewa amɛ, ni akpaketsɛmɛi miinyiɛ, ni shwilafoi miina nii lɛ; ni amɛwo Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei ejwɛ niyenii Shi Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ, “Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafoi lɛ ahe, akɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛyeɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ miwoɔ amɛ gbɛ kɛ musuŋ hɔ̃mɔ, ni ekolɛ amɛyatɔ biti yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔbaana aboloi ni fa pii yɛ, yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ, bɔ ni aaashɛ asafo babaoo nɛɛ naa?” Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpawo, kɛ loi bibii fioo ko.” Ni efã asafoi lɛ akɛ amɛtara shi yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi kpawo lɛ kɛ loi lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛhã asafoi lɛ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ; ni amɛkɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtɔi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Mɛi ni ye lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei ejwɛ, soro yei kɛ gbekɛbii.
Ni ewo asafoi lɛ agbɛ, ni ebote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Magadan niiaŋ.
Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi Ni Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ baka Yesu, amɛbi lɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ŋwɛi okadi ko.
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɛkɛ mli lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Jeŋ baatse, ejaakɛ ŋwɛi etsu.’ Ni leebi lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛnɛ nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ’, ejaakɛ ŋwɛi etsu ni ehiɛ eha.
Osatofoi, nyɛle ŋwɛi atatuiaŋ nibii ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, shi bei lɛ ahe okadii lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ shishi nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ!
Yinɔbii fɔ̃ji kɛ gbãlãfitelɔi miitao okadi, shi ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko, akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.” Ni eshi amɛ eyiŋ etee.
Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi amãsha lɛ Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ kpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo amɛhiɛ amɛdɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!” Shi amɛwiewie he yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ!” Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa!
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛwiewieɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ?
Nyɛnako nii anaa lolo?
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkaiii mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ kafui abɔ ni nyɛkɔlɔ lɛ, aloo mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ aboloi kpawo lɛ kɛ flɔtɔi abɔ ni nyɛkɔlɔ lɛ?
Te tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa naa akɛ jeee aboloo he mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ?
Nyɛhiɛ ahĩa nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ amasha lɛ he!” Agbɛnɛ amɛyoo akɛ jeee aboloo masha hewɔ ekɛɛ amɛhiɛ ahi amɛhe nɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Farisifoi kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Petro odase ni eye yɛ Yesu he Shi be ni Yesu ba Kaisarea Filipi niiaŋ lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji?” Amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ni; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia ni; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ Yeremia loo gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni.” Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Simon Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Kristo lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Bi lɛ!” Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo, Simon, Yona bi; ejaakɛ jeee heloo kɛ lá jie enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bo, shi moŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ni mi hu miikɛɛ bo akɛ, bo ji Petro lɛ, ni nɛkɛ tɛsaa nɛɛ nɔ matswa misafo lɛ mama, ni gbohiiaje agboi lɛ nyɛŋ enɔ aye.
Ni maŋɔ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa samfei lɛ mahã bo; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooofɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni etswa ekaselɔi lɛ anaa mã akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he Kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ ja etee Yerusalɛm ni eyana amanehulu pii yɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ ete shi.
Ni Petro ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee afa, ebɔ̃i lɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ akahã enɛ ba mli, Nuŋtsɔ; enɛ akagbale bo fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃!” Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan!
Ootɔ̃tɔ̃ minane; ejaakɛ ojwɛŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ.” Hekwamɔ Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, enine aaashɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ baana, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, shi elaaje esusuma lɛ?
Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ kɛaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma lɛ?
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba yɛ eTsɛ anunyam lɛ mli kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ; ni no mli lɛ eeewo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ yɛ enitsumɔ naa.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiba yɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.”
Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ enyɛmi Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ekɛ amɛ pɛ.
Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ehiɛ kpɛ tamɔ hulu, ni etadei lɛ yɛ tamɔ la.
Ni naa, Mose kɛ Elia bajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ miiwie.
Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔyɛ biɛ!
Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, mafee bui etɛ̃ yɛ biɛ, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome.” Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, atatu halaŋŋ ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi ni minaa ehe tsui lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!” Ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Ni Yesu ba ni ebatara amɛhe ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtea shi, nyɛkashea gbeyei!” Shi be ni amɛwo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja Yesu kome pɛ.
Ni be ni amɛkpelekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa mã ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkagbaa ninaa nɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a mɔ ko, akɛ ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã.” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, ja Elia eba dã lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ mli lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ Elia miiba, ni ebaato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Elia eba momo, ni amɛyooo lɛ, shi moŋ amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baana amanehulu yɛ amɛdɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ kɔ sɛɛ akɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.
Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli Be ni amɛshɛ asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, nuu ko ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa mibi nuu lɛ mɔbɔ, shi eeye gbligbli ni eena nɔ po ni ehiii, ejaakɛ bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee la mli, ni bianɛ bianɛ eyagbee nu mli.
Ni mikɛ lɛ ba okaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ amɛtsa.” Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋlɛnɔ!
Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi?
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi?
Nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa biɛ nyɛbahãa mi!” Ni Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi, ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ jɛ emli je kpo, ni gbekɛ lɛ he wa lɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni faaa lɛ hewɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni tamɔ sinapi wu lɛ, nyɛaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa yɛ biɛ kɛya jɛi!’ Ni eeefã; ni nɔ ko bɛ ni nyɛnyɛŋ nyɛfee.
[ Shi nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã akɛ ja sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa kɛkɛ.
]” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he ekoŋŋ Shi be ni amɛkpaa Galilea lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.” Ni amɛwerɛ ho amɛhe tsɔ̃.
Sɔlemɔtsu onia Be ni amɛba Kapernaum lɛ, oniatsulɔi lɛ ba Petro ŋɔɔ babi akɛ, “Ani nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ wooo Sɔlemɔtsu onia lɛ?” Ekɛɛ, “Ewoɔ.” Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, Yesu tsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ, “Te osusuɔ tɛŋŋ, Simon?
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, namɛi adɛŋ amɛheɔ too loo onia yɛ?
Yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛbii adɛŋ loo mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ?” Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji adɛŋ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ bii lɛ yeɔ amɛhe mɔ.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni wɔkato amɛ pampi lɛ, yaa ŋshɔ lɛ naa oyafɔ̃ kpoŋ, ni loo klɛŋklɛŋ ni aaabakɔ kpoŋ lɛ, sha lɛ, ni kɛ ogbɛ edaaŋ lɛ, ooona shika ni naa shiɔ yii enyɔ; kɔ ni okɛhã amɛ, ohã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ.”
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli?” Ni Yesu tsɛ gbekɛ bibioo ko kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ, ni ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛtsakeee ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbekɛbii bibii lɛ, nyɛboteŋ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa ehe shi tamɔ gbekɛ nɛɛ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo kome ni tamɔ mɔ nɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi.
Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ “Shi mɔ ni tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni akɛ lɛ yawo ŋshɔŋ.
Kpoo hã je lɛ yɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji ahewɔ!
Ejaakɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ saji lɛ baaba kɛ̃ moŋ nɛ; shi kpoo hã gbɔmɔ ni nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ̃ kɛbaa lɛ!
Shi kɛji onine loo onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni oyɛ niji enyɔ loo naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ naanɔ la lɛ mli.
Ni kɛji ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa yɛ ohe oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni oyɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje.” Too ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni nyɛkabu mɛi bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ejeee mɔ ko; ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, amɛbɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ kwɛɔ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hiɛ daa.
[ Shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ yiwalaheremɔ.]
“Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ, kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome du gbɛ lɛ, ani eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ ni eya eyatao nɔ ni edu gbɛ lɛ?
Ni kɛji ena lɛ lɛ, anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, emii shɛɔ ehe yɛ no he fe nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni eduko gbɛ lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome laajeɔ.” Mɔ kɛ enyɛmi ni etɔ̃ enɔ teŋsaamɔ “Shi kɛji onyɛmi ko tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, yaa ni oyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ etɔ̃mɔ lɛ, okɛ lɛ yi enyɔ kɛkɛ.
Kɛji ebo bo toi lɛ, nyɛmi efee nyɛmi.
Shi kɛji ebooo bo toi lɛ, kɛ mɔ kome loo mɛi enyɔ afata ohe, koni odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ daaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.
Ni kɛji amɛ hu ebooo amɛ toi lɛ, yaakɛɛ asafo lɛ, ni kɛji ebooo asafo lɛ hu toi lɛ, buu lɛ tamɔ wɔŋjalɔ kɛ toohelɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafi yɛ ŋwɛi; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaafɛne yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaafɛne yɛ ŋwɛi.
Asaŋ anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ kpãa gbee yɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ yɛ sane fɛɛ sane ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he lɛ, miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ aaafee ahã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ, yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, miyɛ amɛteŋ yɛ jɛi.” Tsulɔ ni enaaa mɔbɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Petro ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, shii enyiɛ minyɛmi atɔ̃ minɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ?
Kɛyashi shii kpawo lo?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ kɛyashi shii kpawo; shi moŋ shii kpawo toi nyɔŋmai kpawo.
No hewɔ lɛ, ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni taoɔ ekɛ etsuji ababu akɔntaa.
Ni be ni ebɔ̃i buu lɛ, akɛ mɔ ko ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai akpei nyɔŋma ba eŋɔɔ.
Shi akɛni ebɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛaawo lɛ lɛ, enuŋtsɔ lɛ fã akɛ ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ nii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ, ni akɛwo nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni tsulɔ lɛ ho gbee enaji anaa ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’ Ni tsulɔ nɛɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ ni eŋmɛɛ ehe, ni ekɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ ke lɛ.
Shi be ni nakai tsulɔ lɛ je kpo lɛ, eyana enanemɛi tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni hiɛ lɛ nyɔmɔ talentai oha; ni emɔ lɛ emia esɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ, ‘Wo mi nyɔmɔ ni ohiɛ mi lɛ!’ Kɛkɛ ni enaanyo tsulɔ lɛ ho kula shi ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, ‘Too otsui shi ohã mi, ni mawo bo nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ!’ Shi lɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛɛɛ; shi moŋ eyawo lɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni enanemɛi tsuji lɛ na nɔ ni ba lɛ, edɔ amɛ tsɔ̃, ni amɛbagba amɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ hã ayatsɛ lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔŋ!
Akɛni okpa mi fai hewɔ lɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ nyɔmɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ ke bo.
Ani kulɛ jeee bo hu ogbɛnaa ji akɛ ona onaanyo tsulɔ lɛ mɔbɔ, bɔ ni mi hu mina bo mɔbɔ lɛ?’ Ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni apiŋ lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeebawo lɛ nyɔmɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ miTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu aaafee nyɛ, kɛji nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi tɔ̃mɔ ekeee lɛ kɛjɛɛɛ etsuiŋ lɛ.”
Gbãlãtsemɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ anaa lɛ, eje Galilea eba Yudea kpokpai lɛ anɔ yɛ Yordan sɛɛ; ni mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ ni etsatsaa amɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbatsɔ̃ lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja akɛ nuu shwieɔ eŋa yɛ sane fɛɛ sane hewɔ?” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko akɛ, mɔ ni bɔ gbɔmɔ yɛ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo ebɔ amɛ?
Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome lɛ.’ Belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ heloo kome; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, akahã gbɔmɔ miigbala mli.” Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni Mose wo kitã akɛ ahã shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ?” Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ ni Mose hã nyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛshwie nyɛŋamɛi lɛ; shi shishijee lɛ mli lɛ ebɛ nakai.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ jɛ ni eeeshwie eŋa ni eyaŋɔ yoo kroko lɛ efite gbãlã; [ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ yoo ni ashwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efiteɔ gbãlã.”] Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nɛkɛ nuu kɛ eŋa sane yɔɔ lɛ, belɛ ehiii akɛ aŋɔɔ yoo mɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ mli amɔ, ja mɛi ni akɛhã lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ejaakɛ osaii komɛi yɛ ni afɔ amɛ nakai kɛjɛ amɛnyɛmɛi amusu mli; ni osaii komɛi yɛ ni gbɔmɛi sa amɛ; ni osaii lɛ ekrokomɛi hu yɛ ni ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsa amɛhe.
Mɔ ni aaanyɛ mli amɔ lɛ, emɔ mli!” Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii Kɛkɛ ni akɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba eŋɔɔ, koni ekɛ eniji ashwie amɛnɔ ni esɔle ehã amɛ.
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ amɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.” Ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ; ni eje jɛi.
Oblanyo niiatsɛ lɛ Ni mɔ ko ba eŋɔɔ ni ebabi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛɛ nɔ kpakpa po mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba obiɔ mi nɔ kpakpa he sane?
Mɔ kome yɔɔ ni ji mɔ kpakpa [lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ].
Shi kɛji ootao akɛ obote wala mli lɛ, ye kitãi lɛ anɔ.” Ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te nii ni jiŋ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaafite gbãlã; kaaju; kaaye amale odase; wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ; kɛ suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.” Oblanyo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ miye nɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi.
Mɛni shwɛɔ mi lolo?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji ootao akɛ ohi kɛwula shi lɛ, yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii ni oyɔɔ lɛ, ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” Shi be ni oblanyo lɛ nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ; ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ewa hã niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Shi asaŋ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.” Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe tsɔ̃ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” Shi Yesu kwɛ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ enɛ afee; shi Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ aaanyɛ nii fɛɛ afee.” Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fɛɛ, ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ; belɛ mɛni wɔbaana?” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛnyiɛ misɛɛ nɛɛ, be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ yɛ jeŋ hee lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛaatara sɛ̃ii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ nɔ, ni nyɛaakojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eshi shĩai loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi yei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii loo shikpɔji yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaato lɛ najiaŋ toi oha, ni eeena naanɔ wala.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋ bii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpee bii, ni sɛɛkpee bii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ bii.”
Waintrom mli nitsulɔi lɛ “Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ nuu shĩatsɛ ko ni je kpo maŋkɛ mra ni eyabɔ nitsulɔi apaa kɛya ewaintrom mli.
Ni be ni ekɛ nitsulɔi lɛ eye naa denario kome jenamɔ lɛ, ewo amɛ gbɛ kɛtee ewaintrom lɛ mli.
Ni kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli lɛ, eje kpo ekoŋŋ ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi damɔ shi efolo yɛ jaa lɛ nɔ; ni ekɛɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli, ni nɔ ni sa lɛ, mahã nyɛ,’ ni amɛtee.
Asaŋ kɛbaa ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli kɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ eje kpo, ni eyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛbaa gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ mli lɛ eje kpo ni eyana mɛi krokomɛi hu damɔ shi efolo, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nyɛdamɔ shi efolo yɛ biɛ jenamɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ nɛɛ?’ Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛni mɔ ko ebɔko wɔ apaa lɛ hewɔŋ.’ Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛ hu nyɛyaa waintrom lɛ mli.’ “Agbɛnɛ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, waintromtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsulɔ nukpa lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɛ nitsulɔi lɛ ni owo amɛ nyɔmɔ, ni obɔ̃i kɛjɛ sɛɛkpee bii lɛ anɔ kɛyashi klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ anɔ.’ Ni be ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji enumɔ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛna denario komekome.
Ni be ni klɛŋklɛŋ bii lɛ ba lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ amɛaana fe nakai; shi amɛ hu amɛna denario komekome.
Shi be ni eshɛ amɛdɛŋ lɛ, amɛshɛ tɔkemɔ kɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ woo akɛ, ‘Sɛɛkpee bii nɛɛ; ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛkɛ amɛtsu nii, ni ohã amɛ kɛ wɔ ni wɔtsu nii jenamɔ ni etɔ wɔ ni latsaa etsa wɔ lɛ fɛɛ pɛ!’ Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Naanyo, mifeko bo efɔŋ ko; ani jeee denario okɛ mi ye naa?
Ŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji onɔ lɛ ni oya.
Shi miisumɔ akɛ mahã sɛɛkpee mɔ nɛɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mihã bo lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Aloo mibɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minii feɔ nɔ ni misumɔɔ?
Ani mimlihilɛ lɛ hewɔ ohiŋmɛi etsu nɛɛ?’ Nɛkɛ ni sɛɛkpeebii aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii; [ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii, shi mɛi fioo ahala.
]” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ Ni be ni Yesu yaa Yerusalɛm lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee afã yɛ gbɛteŋ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ nigii akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaawo osɔfonukpai kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ.
Ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaahã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛkɛ kpelebii ayi lɛ ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ aaatee lɛ shi.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimɔ lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ kɛ ebihii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ebakula shi ni eba lɛ nɔ ko.
Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ?” Ehere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛɛmɔ ni mibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ bii lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ.
Ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛnu?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔɔnyɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mikpulu lɛ nyɛaanu moŋ shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ, ejeee minɔ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni miTsɛ esaa eto amɛ lɛ anɔŋ.” Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ, amɛmli wo nyɛmimɛi enyɔ lɛ la.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lumɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ hu yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛtsulɔ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa ni asɔmɔ lɛ, shi eba sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ ni ekɛ esusuma lɛ ahã yɛ mɛi pii akpɔ̃mɔ hewɔ lɛ.” Yesu tsa shwilafoi enyɔ Ni be ni amɛjɛ Yeriko amɛyaa lɛ, asafo babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni hii shwilafoi enyɔ tara gbɛ lɛ toi, ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Yesu miiho lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Shi asafo lɛ famɔ amɛyi akɛ amɛmua amɛnaa; shi amɛbolɔ moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ David Bi, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi ni etsɛ amɛ, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ agbele wɔhiŋmɛii lɛ.” Ni Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni etara amɛhiŋmɛii lɛ ahe, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛna nii, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ Be ni amɛbɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛshɛ Betfage yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ nyɛaana teji yoo ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi kɛ ebi; nyɛfɛnea amɛ nyɛbahãa mi.
Ni kɛ mɔ ko bi nyɛ sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Amɛhe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;’ ni amrɔ lɛ eeehã nyɛkɛ amɛ aba.” Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ wie lɛ aba mli akɛ, “Nyɛkɛa Zion biyoo lɛ akɛ, naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ.
Ehe jɔ, ni eta teji nɔ kɛ teji ni ji nitsumɔ kooloo lɛ bi nɔ.” Ni kaselɔi lɛ tee amɛyafee bɔ ni Yesu fã amɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ teji lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ ba, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei lɛ shwie amɛnɔ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi krokomɛi hu folɔ tsei aniji amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni asafoi ni nyiɛ ehiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ fɛɛ bolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Hosiana David Bi lɛ!
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!” Ni be ni ebote Yerusalɛm lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu hoo amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ nɛ?” Shi asafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji Yesu, gbalɔ lɛ ni jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea lɛ.” Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyashwie mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i lɛ kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswiatswia shi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔ we,’ shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu.” Ni shwilafoi kɛ obubuafoi ba eŋɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsa amɛ.
Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni efee kɛ gbekɛbii lɛ ni bolɔɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ, “Hosiana David Bi!” lɛ, amɛmli wo la, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oonu nɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɔ nɛɛ lo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, ani nyɛkaneko dã akɛ, ‘Abifabii kɛ fufɔbii anaa osaa yijiemɔ oto yɛ?’ ” Ni eshi amɛ eje maŋ lɛ mli etee Betania, ni eyawɔ jɛi.
Yesu lomɔ agbãmitso lɛ Shi leebi be ni eku esɛɛ eyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni ena agbãmitso ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ he, ni etsi eshɛ he, shi enaaa nɔ ko yɛ nɔ akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ tso lɛ akɛ, “Owoŋ yibii ko dɔŋŋ gbi ko gbi ko!” Ni agbãmitso lɛ ŋlã amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni agbãmitso lɛ ŋlã amrɔ nɛɛŋ?” Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛjeee ŋwane lɛ, jeee nɔ ni afee agbãmitso nɛɛ kɛkɛ nyɛaafee; shi kɛji nyɛkɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ tete akɛ, ‘Fãa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ lɛ’, eeeba mli nakai.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛaasɔle nyɛbi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, nyɛnine aaashɛ nɔ.” Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ Ni be ni eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, ni namɔ hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?” Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane kome, ni kɛji nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, mi hu matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nibii nɛɛ.
Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ, nɛgbɛ ejɛ?
Ŋwɛi ejɛ, loo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ?” Ni amɛtao mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ wɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛheee Yohane nyɛyeee mɔ?’ Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, no hu wɔmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛhere Yesu nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔleee.” Lɛ hu ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ.” Bihii enyɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ “Shi agbɛnɛ te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ?
Nuu ko yɛ bii enyɔ; ni etee mɔ kome ŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mibi; ŋmɛnɛ yaatsu nii yɛ miwaintrom lɛ mli.’ Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Miyaaa.’ Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ eshwa ehe, ni etee.
Ni etee mɔ kroko lɛ hu ŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi lɛ lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Ataa, matee!’ Shi eyaaa.
Te mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni fee nɔ ni amɛtsɛ lɛ sumɔɔŋ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsutsumɔ lɛ ni.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ toohelɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamãŋi lɛ miitsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiya Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ Yohane ba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ jalɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee; shi tóohelɔi kɛ ajwamãŋi lɛ he lɛ amɛye.
Ni fee sɛɛ, be ni nyɛyoo hu lɛ, nyɛshwaaa nyɛhe tete, koni nyɛhe lɛ nyɛye.” Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ “Nyɛboa abɛ kroko hu toi,” Yesu kɛɛ, “Shĩatsɛ ko yɛ, ni efee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he, ni etsa wainbu yɛ mli, ni emã mɔɔ yɛ mli; ni ekɛhã hulɔi apaayeli; ni edom.
Ni be ni wainyibii kpamɔ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, etsu etsuji kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, akɛ amɛyaŋɔ eyibii lɛ eko amɛbahã lɛ.
Ni hulɔi lɛ mɔmɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛyi mɔ kome, ni amɛgbe mɔ kome, ni amɛtswia mɔ kome hu tɛi.
Asaŋ etsu tsuji krokomɛi ni fa fe tsutsu bii lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ etsu ebinuu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Mibi lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛhiɛ aaasɔ lɛ.’ Shi hulɔi lɛ, be ni amɛna binuu lɛ moŋ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ!
Nyɛbaa, nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni wɔŋɔ egboshinii lɛ.’ Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛjɛ waintrom lɛ mli, ni amɛyagbe lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛji waintromtsɛ lɛ ba lɛ, mɛni eeefee hulɔi nɛɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eeekpãtã gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji nɛɛ ahiɛ butuu, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã hulɔi krokomɛi apaayeli, mɛi ni kɛ yibii aaabahã lɛ yɛ be ni sa mli.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli dã akɛ, ‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ, ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?’ No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ abaashɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ, ni akɛaahã jeŋmaŋ ko ni woɔ yibii.
[ Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ emli aaatsɛrɛ; shi mɔ ni tɛ lɛ aaagbee enɔ lɛ, eeegbɛlɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.”] Ni be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ nu ebɛi lɛ, amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛ amɛhe ewieɔ lɛ.
Ni kulɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ, shi amɛyashe asafoi lɛ agbeyei, ejaakɛ asafoi lɛ buɔ lɛ gbalɔ.
Yookpeemɔ okplɔŋmɛɛ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli ekɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ maŋtsɛ ko ni kpee yoo ehã ebinuu.
Ni etsu etsuji akɛ amɛyatsɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ kɛba yookpeemɔ lɛ, shi mɛi lɛ emiii baa.
Esaa etsu tsuji krokomɛi ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɛyakɛa mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, naa, migbe miniyenii lɛ anaa; agbe mitsinai lɛ kɛ milɛɛ kooloi lɛ, ni agbe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ naa: nyɛbaa yookpeemɔ lɛ!’ Shi amɛ lɛ amɛbuuu po, ni amɛtee amɛhei srɔtoi, mɔ kome tee ebɔɔ mli, ni mɔ kroko hu tee eguɔyeli.
Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ mɔ̃mɔ etsuji lɛ, ni amɛfee amɛ niseniianii, ni amɛgbe amɛ.
Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ nu lɛ, emli fu, ni etsu etabilɔi, ni amɛyagbe nɛkɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi nɛɛ, ni ashã amɛmaŋ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Ato yookpeemɔ lɛ he nii agbe naa moŋ, shi mɛi ni akpee lɛ amɛsaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa ŋmaŋmashai lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi abɔ ni nyɛaana lɛ, nyɛkpea amɛ kɛbaa yookpeemɔ lɛ.’ Ni tsuji lɛ je kpo tee gbɛi lɛ anɔ, ni amɛyabua mɛi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ anaa, mɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ mɛi kpakpai, ni yookpeemɔ he lɛ yi tɔ kɛ mɛi.
“Shi be ni maŋtsɛ lɛ ba mɛi lɛ akwɛmɔ lɛ, ebana mɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni wooo yookpeemɔ atade; ni ebi lɛ akɛ, ‘Naanyo, te fee tɛŋŋ ni oba biɛ nɛɛ ni owooo yookpeemɔ atade?’ Ni etɔ mu.
Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛfimɔa eniji kɛ enaji ni nyɛwoa lɛ nyɛyashɛa nyɛfɔ̃a gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli!
Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.’ Ejaakɛ atsɛ mɛi pii moŋ; shi mɛi fioo ahala.” Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hãmɔ Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ tee ajina, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ.
Ni amɛtsu amɛkaselɔi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ni otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli, ni osheee mɔ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ bɔ ni osusuɔ, ani eja akɛ atsuɔ onia ahãa Kaisare, aloo ejaaa?” Shi Yesu yoo amɛyiŋtoo fɔŋ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Osatofoi, mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi?
Nyɛkɛ shika ni akɛtsuɔ onia lɛ atsɔ̃a mi!” Ni amɛkɛ shika lɛ bahã lɛ.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ!” Ni be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko gbo ni ebɛ bii lɛ enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi wɔteŋ, ni kromɔbi lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni ebɛ bii, ni eshi eŋa lɛ ehã enyɛmi lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ eba mli yɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, kɛyashi mɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ.
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu gbo.
Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi kpawo lɛ ateŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ehi shi?” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmiitɔ̃ naa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ aŋɔɔɔ yei, ni asaŋ akɛ yei hãaa gbãlã; shi moŋ amɛtamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi yɛ ŋwɛi.
Shi ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he akɛ, ‘Mi lɛ, Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi lɛ?’ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ ni, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔ ni.” Ni be ni asafoi lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
Kitã Wulu lɛ Shi be ni Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ eku Sadukifoi lɛ anaa lɛ, amɛbabua amɛhe naa; ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ji mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ ka lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ te nɔ ni ji Mla lɛ mli kitã wuluŋ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ osusuma muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Kitãi lɛ amli oti kɛ ewulu nɛ.
Ni nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ tamɔ no, akɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo gbɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.’ Kitãi enyɔ nɛɛ nɔ Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ damɔ.” David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Ni be ni Farisifoi lɛ anaa ekpe shi lɛ, Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛsusuɔ yɛ Kristo lɛ he tɛŋŋ?
Namɔ bi ji lɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “David Biŋ.” Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba mɔ ni David, yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, tsɛɔ lɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, Ta mininejurɔ nɔ Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mikɛ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ aaawo onaji ashishi lɛ?’ Agbɛnɛ kɛji David tsɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebiŋ?” Ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ hetoo ko ahã, ni asaŋ kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ nɔ ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ asafoi lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wie ekɛɛ, “Mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ, Mose sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ amɛtara lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛye nɔ lɛ nyɛyea nɔ ni nyɛfea; shi nyɛkafea nibii ni amɛfeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛkɛɔ moŋ shi amɛfeee.
Shi amɛfimɔɔ jatsui kɛ tsiimɔ amɛŋmɛlɛɔ mɛi akɔ̃ji anɔ; shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, amɛsumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ amɛkɛ amɛwao saa he.
Shi amɛnii fɛɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ koni mɛi ana.
Ejaakɛ amɛhãa amɛsɔlemɔkaimɔ kotokui kɛ amɛtadei anaamui lɛ lɛɔ.
Amɛsumɔɔ yitsotamɔ kɛji atsɛ okplɔ̃, kɛ onukpai asɛii yɛ kpeehei lɛ, kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi, ni amɛsumɔɔ akɛ mɛi atsɛ amɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ!’ Shi nyɛ lɛ, akatsɛ nyɛ ‘Tsɔɔlɔ’; ejaakɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ-Tsɔɔlɔ; shi nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ.
Ni nyɛkatsɛa mɔ ko nyɛTsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛTsɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Asaŋ akatsɛ nyɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’; ejaakɛ mɔ kome pɛ ji nyɛNuŋtsɔ, lɛ ji Kristo.
Shi mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ nyɛtsulɔ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawo ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaaba ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛŋaa ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ naa nyɛwoɔ gbɔmɛi; nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛi ni taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛbote mli.” [ “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛ ablatoo sɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadaji.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkojomɔ aaafe nine.”] “Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛbɔleɔ ŋshɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ kpula, koni nyɛfee mɔ kome Yudafonyo; ni be ni mɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ nakai lɛ, nyɛfeɔ lɛ abonsamiiaje bi toi enyɔ fe nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi!
Nyɛ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’ Shwilafoi kwashiai!
Te nɔ ni feŋ, shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ, loo Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni hãa shika ŋmiiŋmi lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
Ni asaŋ, ‘Mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, no jeee nɔ ko; shi mɔ ni aaakã enɔ afɔle lɛ kitã lɛ, efiɔ lɛ.’ Shwilafoi kwashiai!
Te nɔ ni feŋ, afɔle lɛ, loo afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ ni hãa afɔle lɛ feɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaakã afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ nii ni yɔɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ kitã.
Ni mɔ ni kãa Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kitã lɛ, ekã no kɛ mɔ ni hiɔ mli lɛ kitã.
Ni mɔ ni kãa ŋwɛi kitã lɛ, ekã Nyɔŋmɔ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ hu kitã.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ anisi kɛ kumino mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, shi Mla lɛ mli nii ni he jaraa ni ji jalɛ saneyeli kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɛshiɔ; enɛɛmɛi sa akɛ nyɛfeɔ kɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.
Gbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi shwilafoi nyɛtsereɔ nɔ nɔ adɔ̃dɔ̃ŋ, shi nyɛmiɔ yooma!
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ; shi amɛmligbɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ ojotswaa kɛ adufudeyeli.
“Farisifonyo shwilafo, sha kpulu lɛ kɛ kã lɛ mli ni aje tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ esɛɛ hu aaaje!
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛtamɔ gbohii asaŋi ni asha he ni amɛhewɔ efee fɛo moŋ, shi amɛmligbɛ lɛ eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ gbohii awui kɛ muji nibii srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ lɛ, nyɛpueɔ akɛ jalɔi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi yɛ mligbɛ lɛ nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ osato kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ̃.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi, osatofoi!
Nyɛmãmɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ atoohei, ni nyɛwulaa jalɔi lɛ asaŋi lɛ, ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Eji wɔtsɛmɛi ayinɔ lɛ wɔyɛ jeŋ kulɛ, wɔfataŋ amɛhe kɛshwieŋ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.’ Belɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛhe odase akɛ mɛi ni gbe gbalɔi lɛ abii ji nyɛ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛwoa nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ asusumɔ tsene lɛ obɔ̃ mɔ!
Onufui, shikpãi ashwiei!
Te nyɛaafee tɛŋŋ nyɛjo abonsamiiaje fɔbuu lɛ naa foiŋ?
No hewɔ lɛ, naa, miitsu gbalɔi kɛ nilelɔi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni nyɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni nyɛaasɛŋ mɛi komɛi, ni mɛi krokomɛi lɛ nyɛaayi amɛ kpelebii yɛ nyɛkpeehei lɛ, ni nyɛaawa amɛ yi kɛaajɛ maŋ kome mli kɛaatee ekroko mli.
Bɔ ni afee ni jalɔi alá fɛɛ ni ashwie shi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Abel, jalɔ lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ kɛbashi Zakaria, Barakia bi lɛ, ni nyɛgbe lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ teŋ lɛ lá lɛ nɔ lɛ aba nyɛnɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba yinɔbii nɛɛ anɔ.” Yesu ye Yerusalɛm he jaramɔ “Yerusalɛm, Yerusalɛm, bo ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi; shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ kulɛ mabua obii anaa tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ!
Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ahã nyɛ!
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ.’ ”
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ Ni Yesu je kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni be ni eyaa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ tsui lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Te nyɛmiina nii nɛɛ fɛɛ?
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ eko nɔ yɛ biɛ ni akpãŋ aluŋ shi.” Amanehului ashishijee Shi be ni eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ yɛ afã amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ beyinɔ ni aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni mɛni ji obaa lɛ kɛ je nɛɛŋ naagbee lɛ he okadi?” Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia koni mɔ ko akabalaka nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii kɛ migbɛi aaabakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji Kristo lɛ!’ Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Shi nyɛaanu tai kɛ tai atatsĩĩ ahe; nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ esa akɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ aba mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko.
Shi maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli; ni hɔ̃ji kɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔi aaaba hei srɔtoi.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ ashishijee ni.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ amɛwo amanehulu mli, ni amɛaagbe nyɛ; ni migbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ.
Ni nakai be lɛ mli lɛ mɛi pii anane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ ni amɛaatsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛnanemɛi asɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛaanyɛnyɛɛ amɛhe.
Ni amale gbalɔi pii aaate shi, ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Ni akɛni mlakwamɔ baafa hewɔ lɛ, mɛi pii asuɔmɔ lɛ he aaajɔ.
Shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛyawulaa shi lɛ, lɛ eyiwala aaahere.
Ni aaashiɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane kpakpa nɛɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ, ni akɛye jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ odase; ni no dani naagbee lɛ aaaba.” Amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ “No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛna ‘Amaŋfɔ̃ nihiinii lɛ’ ni gbalɔ Daniel wie he lɛ akɛ ema he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ eyoo sɛɛ!)
No lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi amɛya gɔji lɛ anɔ; mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ, ekakpeleke shi eyakɔ nɔ ko kɛjɛ eshĩa; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ, ekaaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade.
Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ!
Shi nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛfoijee lɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃i be lɛ mli aloo yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ nakai be lɛ mli lɛ amanehulu kpele aaaba ni anako enɔ dã kɛjɛ je lɛ shishijee mli kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛ afooo nakai gbii lɛ anɔ lɛ, ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ aaafo nɔ.
No mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ loo biɛ lɛ’, nyɛkahea nyɛyea.
Ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii wuji kɛ ashwãi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ, bɔ ni kɛ aaaho lɛ amɛaalaka halamɔbii lɛ tete.
Naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ mito.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji amɛkɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ’, nyɛkayaa; aloo, ‘naa, eyɛ piai lɛ amli lɛ;’ nyɛkahea nyɛyea.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni srawa gbaa kɛjɛɔ bokã kɛyaa anai lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ.
Ejaakɛ he fɛɛ he ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpaŋai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ.” Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa “Shi nakai gbii lɛ amli amanehului lɛ asɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, hulu aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛŋ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ aaahoso.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ okadi lɛ aaapue yɛ ŋwɛi, ni no lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akutsei lɛ fɛɛ aaawo yara, ni amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ anɔ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anunyam babaoo.
Ni eeetsu ebɔfoi lɛ kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni gbee wa, ni amɛaabua ehalamɔbii lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛajɛ ŋwɛi naagbeehe kome kɛaaya naagbeehe kroko lɛ.” Agbãmitso he nikasemɔ “Shi nyɛkasea agbãmitso abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ, be ni eniji lɛ efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaa be lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi lɛ anaa etã.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã.
Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.” Mɔ ko leee gbi lɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ “Shi nakai gbi lɛ kɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ ko yɛ he, bɔfoi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tete leee, ni Bi lɛ leee, ja Tsɛ lɛ kome kɛkɛ.
Shi bɔ ni Noa gbii lɛ fee lɛ, nakai Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ hu aaatamɔ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ gbii ni nyiɛ nu afua lɛ hiɛ lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ hiɛ niyeli kɛ ninumɔ kɛ yooŋɔɔ kɛ gbãlãhamɔ mli aahu kɛyashi gbi ni Noa yabote adeka lɛ mli, ni amɛleee kɛyashi nu afua lɛ baloo amɛ fɛɛ kɛtee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa lɛ aaatamɔ.
No mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ.
