Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ wiɛ sɛɛ; aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee nɔ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnuŋtsɔ lɛ baa.
Shi nyɛkaia akɛ, kɛ shĩatsɛ ko le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeesra ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu ewe lɛ awoŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛsusuuu lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa.” Tsuji anɔkwafoi “Belɛ namɔ ji tsulɔ anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ mɔ ni enuŋtsɔ kɛ lɛ eto ewebii lɛ anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛŋmaa yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ?
Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni be ni enuŋtsɔ lɛ baa lɛ ni eeebana lɛ ni eefee nakai lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaato enii fɛɛ kwa nɔ.
“Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ fɔŋ lɛ aaakɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miitsi ebaabe lɛ eeto;’ ni eeebɔ̃i enanemɛi tsuji lɛ yii, ni ekɛ dãatɔlɔi lɛ aaaye, ni ekɛ amɛ aaanu lɛ, nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee, ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ osatofoi lɛ ateŋ.
Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi.”
Oblayei nyɔŋma lɛ he abɛ lɛ “No mli lɛ ŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaatãmɔ oblayei nyɔŋma ni hole amɛkanei ni amɛtee amɛkɛ ayɛmforowu ayakpe.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ lɛ kwashiai ji amɛ, ni mɛi enumɔ lɛ nilelɔi ni.
Kwashiai lɛ hole amɛkanei lɛ shi amɛŋɔɔɔ mu amɛhiɛɛɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Shi nilelɔi lɛ kɛ mu wo amɛtɔi amli amɛfata amɛkanei lɛ ahe.
Ni akɛni ayɛmforowu lɛ tsɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ ye amɛ fɛɛ ni amɛwɔwɔi.
Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ anu blɔmɔ akɛ, ‘Naa, ayɛmforowu lɛ miiba ee!
Nyɛjea kpo, nyɛkɛ lɛ ayakpea!’ Kɛkɛ ni oblayei lɛ fɛɛ te shi ni amɛsaa amɛkanei lɛ.
Ni kwashiai lɛ kɛɛ nilelɔi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛhãa wɔ nyɛmu lɛ eko, ejaakɛ wɔkanei lɛ miigboi.’ Shi nilelɔi lɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Ekolɛ ebashɛŋ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ; shi moŋ nyɛyaa mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ lɛ aŋɔɔ nyɛyahea eko nyɛhãa nyɛhe,’ Shi be ni amɛtee hemɔ lɛ, ayɛmforowu lɛ ba, ni mɛi ni esaa amɛhe eto lɛ kɛ lɛ tee yookpeemɔ lɛ, ni aŋa shinaa lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, oblayei krokomɛi lɛ hu ba ni amɛbakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ wɔ!’ Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ mileee nyɛ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ejaakɛ nyɛleee gbi lɛ loo ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ.” Tsuji etɛ̃ lɛ ahe abɛ lɛ “Shi etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni ebaadom lɛ, etsɛ etsuji, ni etu enibii ewo amɛdɛŋ; ni ehã mɔ kome talentai enumɔ, mɔ kome hu enyɔ, ni mɔ kome hu ekome, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni eeenyɛ he nii etsu; ni edom.
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ tee ni eyatsɔ̃mɔ he, ni ena talentai enumɔ ebɔ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni na enyɔ lɛ hu yana enyɔ ebɔ he.
Shi mɔ ni na ekome lɛ tee eyatsa shi, ni ekɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ shika lɛ tee.
“Shi yɛ mli aahu lɛ, tsuji nɛɛ anuŋtsɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ amɛ babu akɔntaa.
Ni mɔ ni na talentai enumɔ lɛ ba, ni ekɛ talentai enumɔ kroko hu babɔ he ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talentai enumɔ hã mi, naa, mina enumɔ hu mifata he.’ Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato bo nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.’ Ni mɔ ni na talentai enyɔ lɛ hu ba ni ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, okɛ talentai enyɔ hã mi, naa, mina talentai enyɔ hu mifata he.’ Enuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo, tsulɔ kpakpa kɛ anɔkwafo, oye anɔkwa yɛ nii fioo he, mato bo nii pii anɔkwɛlɔ; botemɔ onuŋtsɔ miishɛɛ lɛ mli.’ Shi mɔ ni na talenta kome lɛ hu ba bakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, mile bo akɛ yiwalɔ ji bo; okpaa nii yɛ he ni oduko nɔ ko yɛ, ni obuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni oshwãko nɔ ko yɛ; ni no hã mishe gbeyei, ni miyafu otalenta lɛ.
Naa onii.’ Shi enuŋtsɔ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔŋ kɛ anihaolɔ!
Ni ole akɛ mikpaa nii yɛ he ni miduko nɔ ko yɛ ni mibuaa nii anaa yɛ he ni mishwãko nɔ ko yɛ lɛ, kulɛ ogbɛnaa ji akɛ oŋɔɔ mishika lɛ owoɔ tsakelɔi adɛŋ, ni kɛ miba lɛ ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhea talenta lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ talentai nyɔŋma lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ aaahã lɛ, koni ena ni ateke nɔ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni tsulɔ ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko nɛɛ, nyɛtsia lɛ nyɛwoa gbɛsɛɛ duŋ lɛ mli; jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi!’ ” Jeŋmaji lɛ akojomɔ “Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba yɛ enunyam lɛ mli, ni bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ aaafata ehe lɛ, no mli lɛ eeeta enunyam sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ; ni aaabua jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anaa yɛ ehiɛ, ni eeegbala amɛmli tamɔ bɔ ni tookwɛlɔ gbalaa gwantɛŋi kɛ abotiai amli lɛ.
Ni ekɛ gwantɛŋi lɛ aaadamɔ eninejurɔ nɔ, shi abotiai lɛ ekɛ amɛ aaadamɔ ebɛku nɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Maŋtsɛ lɛ aaakɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ eninejurɔ nɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa, nyɛ mɛi ni miTsɛ ejɔɔ nyɛ, nyɛbaŋɔa maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ni asaa ato nyɛ kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ!
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nii miye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhã mi nu minu; gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhã mibato nyɛŋɔɔ; minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwo mi atade; mihe ye, ni nyɛbasara mi; awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛba miŋɔɔ.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ jalɔi lɛ aaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nii oyeŋ, aloo akɛ kumai miiye bo, ni wɔhã bo nɔ ko onuŋ?
Ni te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ gbɔ ji bo, ni wɔhã obato wɔŋɔɔŋ; aloo akɛ onyiɛ yayai ni wɔwo bo atade?
Asaŋ te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔba oŋɔɔŋ?’ Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ aaahere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ kɛ̃ ni nyɛfee nyɛhã minyɛmimɛi nɛɛ ateŋ bibioo kome lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ nyɛfee nyɛhã lɛ.’ “Kɛkɛ lɛ eeekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ebɛku nɔ lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛjea minɔ, nyɛ mɛi ni alomɔ nyɛ, nyɛyaa naanɔ la lɛ ni asaa ato abonsam kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nii maye; kumai ye mi, ni nyɛhãaa mi nu manu; gbɔ ji mi, ni nyɛhãaa mabato nyɛŋɔɔ; minyiɛ yayai, ni nyɛwooo mi atade; mihe ye ni asaŋ awo mi tsuŋ, ni nyɛbasaraaa mi.’ Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ hu amɛaahere lɛ nɔ amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, te gbi ni wɔna bo akɛ hɔmɔ miiye bo aloo kumai miiye bo aloo akɛ gbɔ ji bo aloo onyiɛ yayai aloo ohe miiye aloo awo bo tsuŋ, ni wɔbasɔmɔɔɔ bo lɛ?’ Kɛkɛ lɛ eeehere amɛ nɔ eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ ni nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mɛi bibii kwraa nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛfeee nyɛhãaa mi hu!’ Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi lɛ, amɛaatee naanɔ hejaramɔ mli; shi jalɔi lɛ aaatee naanɔ wala mli.”
Atee Yesu yinɔ apam Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu egbe wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ anaa lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ahã ni asɛŋ lɛ.” No mli lɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ eyabua amɛhe naa yɛ osɔfonukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kaiafa lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Ni amɛtee apam, bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu ŋaa mli ni agbe lɛ; shi amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni maŋ lɛ mli akabafee hirihiri.” Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ, yoo ko hiɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ni jara wa kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni be ni eta niyenii ashi lɛ, efɔse eshwie eyiteŋ.
Shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ; amɛmli wo la amɛkɛɛ, “Te yaka nifitemɔ nɛɛ shishiŋ?
Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ kulɛ aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ahe shika pii ni akɛhã ohiafoi.” Shi be ni Yesu na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛgbaa yoo lɛ naa?
Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, shi mi lɛ, jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Ejaakɛ mukɛŋma nɛɛ ni efɔse eshwie migbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, efee eto mifuu lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, he fɛɛ he ni aajaje sane kpakpa nɛɛ yɛ, yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ fee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ.” Yuda kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ Kɛkɛ ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda Iskariot lɛ yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni eyabi akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛaahã mi ni majie lɛ mawo nyɛdɛŋ?” Ni amɛkane jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ amɛhã lɛ.
Ni kɛjɛ no be lɛ nɔ lɛ etao ehe gbɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ewo amɛdɛŋ.
Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ anaagbee niyenii Shi akpiti gbii juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔhã bo ni oyaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ jɛi?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli ni nyɛyakɛa ashimashi akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, mibe lɛ eshɛ etã; owe lɛ mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ!’ ” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yafee bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ yatara niyenii lɛ ahe.
Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” Ni edɔ amɛ naakpa, ni amɛbɔ̃i lɛ bimɔ ekomekome yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, miŋ lo?” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ; faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ.” Ni Yuda, esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ani miŋ, Tsɔɔlɔ?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ!” Nuŋtsɔ niyenii lɛ shishitoo Shi be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea, nyɛyea!
Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ.” Ni ewo kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnua eko!
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mila ni ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ hã eshaifaa lɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ, kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ aaanu lɛ ehee yɛ miTsɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mu gɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ mihewɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni tooku lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.’ Shi mishitee sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea.” Shi Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ yɛ ohewɔ lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ gbi ko gbi ko.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ, dani wuɔ aaagbɛɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.” Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbo mikɛ bo aaagbo tete lɛ mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ.” Nakai nɔŋŋ kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ hu kɛɛ.
Yesu yɛ Getsemane Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Getsemane; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaraa shi yɛ biɛ, koni maya ni mayasɔle yɛ jɛi.” Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Zebedeo bihii enyɔ lɛ efata ehe ni ewerɛ bɔ̃i ehe hoo ni ehao.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Misusuma were eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli tɔ̃ɔ, nyɛhia shi yɛ biɛ ni nyɛkɛ mi ashia kpe!” Ni etee hiɛ fioo, ni ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji aaaho lɛ, hã ni kpulu nɛɛ aho mihe aya; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” Ni eba kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ena akɛ amɛwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛkɛ mi ashi kpe ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome pɛ?
Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli; mumɔ lɛ miikpɛ̃lɛ̃ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ egbede.” Eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni eyasɔle ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ, kɛji kpulu nɛɛ nyɛŋ mihe aho aya akɛ ja minu lɛ, afee bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” Ni be ni eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ena akɛ amɛwɔ; ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii.
Ni esaa eshi amɛ etee ekoŋŋ, ni eyasɔle nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni eba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ nɛɛ?
Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ etã, ni aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã.” Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɔmɔ Ni be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa, Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ ba, ni asafo pii ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ, kɛ lɛ nyiɛ, ni amɛhiɛ klantei kɛ kpotii.
Shi esɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ eto amɛ okadi akɛ, “Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Oshwiee, Rabi!
Ni eshwɔ enaa.” Shi Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, mɛni feemɔ oba yɛ biɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi lɛ batua Yesu ni amɛmɔ lɛ.
Ni naa, mɛi ni kɛ Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kpã enine mli egbala eklante, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ, ni efo etoi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ oklante lɛ ato etoohe; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɔlɔɔ klante lɛ, klante naa amɛhiɛ aaakpãtã yɛ.
Aloo osusuɔ akɛ minyɛŋ miTsɛ fai makpa ni amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ eeehã mi ŋwɛi bɔfoi fe asafoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ?
Shi no lɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja eba lɛ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaba mliŋ?” No ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, “Mimɔmɔ nyɛba kɛ klante kɛ kpotii, tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ ko nɛɛ?
Mitaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ daa mitsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni nyɛmɔɔɔ mi.
Shi afee enɛ fɛɛ koni nii ni gbalɔi lɛ ŋmala lɛ aba mli.” Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi shi lɛ.
Yesu yɛ Gwabɔɔ wulu lɛ hiɛ Agbɛnɛ mɛi ni mɔ Yesu lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee Kaiafa, osɔfonukpa lɛ; ŋɔɔ, yɛ he ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ.
Shi Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ yɛ shɔŋŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ebote jɛi ekɛ tsuji lɛ yata shi, koni ekwɛ bɔ ni naagbee aaatamɔ ahã.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ gwabɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ tao amale odase yɛ Yesu he, koni amɛgbe lɛ; shi amɛnaaa eko; tsɛbelɛ amale odasefoi pii ba.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ amale odasefoi enyɔ ba amɛbakɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Manyɛ makumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni mama lɛ gbii etɛ̃.’ ” Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi ebi lɛ akɛ, “Otooo he eko?
Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛi yeɔ shiɔ bo nɛɛ?” Shi Yesu etswaaa esɛŋ.
Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, akɛ kɛji bo ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ!” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli.” Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ gbala etadei ni ekɛɛ, “Ebɔ musu!
Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odasefoi wɔfee dɔŋŋ?
Naa, agbɛnɛ nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ!
Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ?” Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Esa gbele!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehiɛ, ni amɛgbala lɛ mai; ni mɛi komɛi hu tswia lɛ nii amɛkɛɛ, “Kristo, gbaa otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ, namɔ ji mɔ ni yi bo lɛ?” Petro kwa Yesu Shi Petro ta sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ kpo te lɛ mli; ni oblayoo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ, “Bo hu te okɛ Yesu, Galileanyo lɛ, yɔɔ!” Shi etso yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ.” Shi be ni Petro te shi etee koi lɛ shi lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ, ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ hu kɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, yɔɔ.” Ni etso ekoŋŋ kɛ kitãkãmɔ ekɛɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ.” Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ, mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ bakɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Anɔkwale ji akɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji bo; ejaakɛ owiemɔ tete jieɔ bo shi!” Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni Petro kai Yesu wiemɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Dani wuɔ aaagbɛ lɛ, oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃” lɛ.
Ni eje kpo eyafo blobloblo.
Akɛ Yesu ba Pilato hiɛ Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ tee Yesu yinɔ apam, koni amɛgbe lɛ.
Ni amɛfi lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee amɛyahã Amralo Pontio Pilato.
Yuda Iskariot gbele Agbɛnɛ be ni Yuda, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ lɛ, na akɛ abu lɛ fɔ lɛ, eshwa ehe, ni ekpale jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ eyahã osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mifee esha akɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lá ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “No jeee wɔhe sane ko; bo diɛŋtsɛ kwɛmɔ nɔ!” Ni eyashɛrɛ jwiɛtɛi lɛ eshwie Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee eyawo esɛ̃ kpãa.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ yaloo jwiɛtɛi lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Ejaaa akɛ akɛtoɔ (Sɔlemɔ we lɛ) nitoohe lɛ mli ejaakɛ lá yinii ni.” Ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, koni afu gbɔi yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ ‘Lá Abɔɔ’ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ.
No ni gbalɔ Yeremia wiemɔ lɛ ba mli akɛ, “Ni amɛŋɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ji mɔ ni aye enaa ni Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi wo eyi jara lɛ yinii lɛ; ni amɛkɛhe gbɛshɔ̃lɔ lɛ abɔɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fã mi lɛ.” Pilato bi Yesu nii Shi akɛ Yesu badamɔ Amralo lɛ hiɛ, ni Amralo lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” Shi be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ folɔɔ enaa lɛ, ejieee naa.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani onuuu saji sɔŋŋ ni amɛkɛshwieɔ onɔ nɛɛ?” Shi Yesu efooo edaaŋ kwraa; ni Amralo lɛ naa kpɛ ehe diɛŋtsɛ.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ Shi daa kɛ shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ, Amralo lɛ ŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni asafo lɛ sumɔɔ he ehãa amɛ.
No mli lɛ amɛyɛ gboklɛfonyo kpanaku ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛbabua amɛhe naa lɛ, Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ, Baraba, aloo Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ?” Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa amɛkɛ lɛ hã.
Shi be ni eta kojomɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ, eŋa tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ jalɔ nɛɛ akaye sane ko; ejaakɛ ehewɔ lɛ mihe ejara mi babaoo yɛ wɔlamɔ mli ŋmɛnɛ.” Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ wo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ akɛ, amɛbi Baraba moŋ, koni agbe Yesu.
Shi Amralo lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ he nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ mihã nyɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Baraba.” Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni mifee Yesu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ he mɔ?” Amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Hã ni asɛŋ lɛ!” Ni Amralo lɛ kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ efɔŋ efee?” Shi amɛbolɔ waa moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Hã ni asɛŋ lɛ!” Be ni Pilato na akɛ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee; shi moŋ basabasa feemɔ miiba lɛ, ekɛ nu fɔ edɛ̃ yɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Mi lɛ miyeee jalɔ nɛɛ lá yi sɔ̃; nyɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ!” Ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Elá aba wɔ kɛ wɔbii anɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; shi Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kpelebii yi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Asraafoi lɛ ye Yesu he fɛo Kɛkɛ ni Amralo lɛ asraafoi lɛ ŋɔ Yesu kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ, ni amɛyabua asraafoi aku lɛ fɛɛ naa kɛbabɔle lɛ; ni amɛ jie ehe atadei lɛ, ni amɛkɛ atade tsuru yuu ko wo lɛ; ni amɛfee ŋmei akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛkɛ tso hã lɛ ehiɛ yɛ eninejurɔ, ni amɛkula shi yɛ ehiɛ amɛye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ!” Ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛhe tso lɛ yɛ edɛ̃ ni amɛkɛtswia eyiteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛye ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛ jie atade yuu lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee koni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele Be ni amɛyaa lɛ; amɛna nuu Kirenenyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon, ni amɛnyɛ enɔ ni ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota ni eshishi ji “Yitsoŋoŋohe” lɛ, amɛkɛ wain ni akɛ drɔ efutu mli hã Yesu ni enu; shi be ni esa enaa lɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ enuɔ.
Be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja etadei lɛ.
Ni amɛho amɛtara jɛi, ni amɛbu ehe.
Ni amɛŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “Yesu, Yudafoi lɛ aMaŋtsɛ lɛ nɛ!” No mli lɛ asɛŋ ojotswalɔi enyɔ afata ehe; mɔ kome yɛ eninejurɔ nɔ, ni mɔ kome hu yɛ ebɛku nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ amɛshi lɛ, ni amɛhoso amɛyitsei, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni osaa omãa gbii etɛ̃ lɛ, heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala!
Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, jee sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpeleke shi koo!” Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ hu kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ye ehe fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala ehere, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere.
Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ ji lɛ!
Eje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ agbɛnɛ ekpeleke shi, ni wɔɔhe lɛ wɔye.
Ekɛ ehe fɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ; ejie lɛ amrɔ nɛɛ koo, kɛji eyɛ ehe tsui lɛ; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi.’ ” Nakai nɔŋŋ ojotswalɔi lɛ ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
Shi kɛjɛ shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ lɛ duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Shi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Eshishi ji, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?” Shi be ni mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Elia mɔ nɛ tsɛɔ nɛɛ.” Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɔ kome sha foi eyakɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa, ni ekɛtsɔ̃ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ahi shi!
Hã wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaaba abajie lɛ lo?” Shi Yesu bo ekoŋŋ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni ebu enaa.
Ni naa, Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbayi shi, ni shikpɔŋ hoso, ni tɛsai gbala; ni gbohii abui anaa gbelegblei, ni krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni ewɔ lɛ agbɔmɔtsei pii te shi; ni eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛje kpo kɛjɛ amɛbui lɛ amli, ni amɛtee maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli amɛyajie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi pii.
Shi be ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ buɔ Yesu he lɛ na shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ kɛ nii ni afee lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi nɛ!” Shi yei pii yɛ jɛi ni damɔ shɔŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛ ji mɛi ni nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria ni ji Yakobo kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.
Yesu fuu Shi be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, niiatsɛ ko ni jɛ Arimatia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef lɛ ba; lɛ hu Yesu kaselɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ eyatutɔ lɛ ni ekɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato fã akɛ akɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni Yosef ŋɔ gbonyo lɛ, ni ekɛ klala farefare bla lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbonyobu hee ni ekpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ kpeteŋkple ekɛtsi gbonyobu lɛ naa, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ yɛ jɛi, amɛtara gbonyobu lɛ hiɛgbɛ.
Ahã ayabu bu lɛ he Shi Hesaamɔ-kɛ-too-Gbi lɛ nɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ anaa bakpe shi yɛ Pilato ŋɔɔ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔkai akɛ, be ni shishiulɔ nɛɛ hiɛ kã lɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ mate shi ekoŋŋ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, fã ni ayabu bu lɛ he jogbaŋŋ kɛyashi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, koni ekaselɔi lɛ akabaju lɛ kɛtee, ni amɛyakɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ’; ni sɛɛkpee shishiumɔ lɛ bafee efɔŋ fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ.” Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, asraafoi nɛ, nyɛyaa ni nyɛyabua bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee; amɛsɔo tɛ lɛ amɛkpɛtɛ gbonyobu lɛ naa kpɛŋŋ, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ bu he.
Yesu shitee Shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ naagbee, be ni je bɔ̃i tsɛremɔ kɛbaa otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria mɔ kome lɛ ba bu lɛ saramɔ.
Ni naa, shikpɔŋ ehoso waa, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi, ni ebakoklo tɛ lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Ni ehiɛ kpɛɔ tamɔ srawa, ni etade lɛ hu yɛɔ futafuta.
Shi ehe gbeyei hã bulɔi lɛ ahe kpokpo ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii.
Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ yei lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei, ejaakɛ mile akɛ nyɛmiitao Yesu mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ; ebɛ biɛ, ejaakɛ ete shi, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ.
Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa hegbɛ ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛyaa mramra nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni eetsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛya Galilea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ; naa, mikɛɛ nyɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ kɛjɛ bu lɛ he mramra kɛ gbeyei kɛ nyamɔ babaoo, ni amɛhiɛ foi koni amɛyagba ekaselɔi lɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bakpe ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” Ni amɛbamɔmɔ enaji amli; ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa minyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni amɛya Galilea; ni jɛi amɛaana mi yɛ.” Onukpai lɛ hã bulɔi lɛ nyɔɔŋnii koni amɛmale Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, bulɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi eba maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛbagba nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ bɔ gwa ni amɛtee ajina, ni amɛhã asraafoi lɛ jwiɛtɛi pii, amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɛkɛa akɛ, nyɔɔŋ, be ni wɔwɔ lɛ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba baju lɛ kɛtee.
Ni kɛji enɛ bashɛ Amralo lɛ toiŋ lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔkɛ lɛ baawie ni wɔkwɛ ni akahao nyɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛhe jwiɛtɛi lɛ, ni amɛfee bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ.
Ni nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Yesu tu sane kpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ ewo kaselɔi lɛ adɛŋ Shi kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ yiŋ amɛtee Galilea gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, he ni Yesu etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ akpe yɛ lɛ, ni be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi je ŋwane.
Ni Yesu ba ekɛ amɛ bawie ekɛɛ, “Aŋɔ hegbɛ fɛɛ ahã mi yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafea jeŋmaji fɛɛ mikaselɔi, nyɛbaptisia amɛ nyɛwoa Tsɛ lɛ kɛ Bi lɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ gbɛi mli, ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛye nii fiaa ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni naa, mi lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ daa kɛyaashi jeŋ naagbee lɛ.”
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Marko Sanekpakpa lɛ jeɔ shishi kɛ wiemɔi ni baa nɛɛ, “Yesu Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ nɛ.” Anaa Yesu akɛ mɔ ko ni tsuɔ nii waa ni esaa eyɔɔ hewalɛ hu.
Ehewalɛ nɛɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔi kɛ hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni eŋɔɔ mɛi ahe eshai efaa amɛ lɛ amli.
Yesu lɛ etsɛɔ ehe akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi ni ba ekɛ ehe bashã afɔle ni ekɛkpɔ̃ mɛi kɛjɛ esha mli.
Marko wolo lɛ gbaa Yesu he sane lɛ faŋŋ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa hu, ni nɔ nɔ mi ni emaa titri ji enitsumɔ, shi jeee ewiemɔi loo etsɔ̃ɔmɔi.
Eje shishi ewie Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu sɔlemɔ kɛ ekaa lɛ he kukubɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ Yesu mɔtsamɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ tsa nɔ.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kaselɔi lɛ banu lɛ shishi fe tsutsu lɛ, shi ehenyɛlɔi lɛ hu bagri amɛwo lɛ fe tsutsu lɛ po.
Yitsei ni gbeɔ wolo lɛ naa lɛ gbaa nɔ ni ba Yesu nɔ yɛ eje nɛɛ mli shihilɛ naagbee otsi lɛ mli, titri lɛ esɛŋmɔ kɛ eshitee kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ.
Asusuɔ akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ naagbee wiemɔi srɔtoi enyɔ ni afo amɛhe akrabatsa lɛ jeee Marko ji mɔ ni ŋmala shi moŋ mɔ kroko.
Mlijaramɔi Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee .- Yesu nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea .—.
Kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm .- Naagbee otsi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ ekpokpai anɔ .—.
Yesu shitee kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ .- Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ete shi lɛ he kpojiemɔ kɛ mɛi atsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ eŋwɛiyaa .-
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ Yesu Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, he Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛmiitsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, nyɛjajea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ!’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, Yohane ba ni ebaptisi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ tee eŋɔɔ.
Amɛjaje amɛhe eshai, ni abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yordan Faa lɛ mli.
Kristo baa kɛ enitsumɔ he gbalɛ Yohane lɛ yooma hetsɔi atade ewoɔ, ni wolokpãa ekɛfiɔ emliteŋ; ni eyeɔ baalabii kɛ ŋa nɔ wo.
Eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni he wa fe mi; misaaa mɔ ni kotoɔ shi fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa tete.
Mi lɛ, nu mikɛ baptisi nyɛ; shi lɛ lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ekɛaabaptisi nyɛ.” Yesu Baptisimɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu jɛ Nazaret yɛ Galilea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eba ni Yohane baptisi lɛ yɛ Yordan mli.
Yesu je kpo kɛjɛ nu lɛ mli nɔŋŋ pɛ kɛkɛ ni ena ni ŋwɛi naa miigbele ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ miikpeleke shi tamɔ okpo kɛmiiba enɔ.
Ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Bo ji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ.
Bo ohe tsui minaa!” Yesu kaa Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Mumɔ lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Eye gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ jɛi, ni Satan ka lɛ, ni ekɛ ŋaŋ kooloi hi shi; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi basɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee Agbɛnɛ be ni amɔ Yohane sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu tee Galilea ni eyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ.
Ekɛɛ, “Be lɛ eshɛ; Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ enina nyɛ!
Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui, ni nyɛhea Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛyea.” Wolɛi ejwɛ atsɛmɔ Be ni Yesu nyiɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ena Simon kɛ enyɛmi Andrea ni amɛmiihɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli ejaakɛ wolɛi ji amɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbanyiɛa misɛɛ ni mafee nyɛ wolɛi ni baahɛ gbɔmɛi.” Ni amrɔ lɛ amɛshi amɛyai lɛ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni etee ehiɛ fioo lɛ, ena Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Yohane ni amɛ hu amɛyɛ lɛlɛ mli amɛmiikpɛ amɛyai lɛ.
Amrɔ lɛ etsɛ amɛ, ni amɛshi amɛtsɛ Zebedeo kɛ apaafoi lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli Amɛbote maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kapernaum lɛ mli, ni be ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ shɛ lɛ, Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii akɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ hegbɛ; shi jeee tamɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, naa nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli.
Ebo waa ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, Yesu Nazarenyo?
Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ?
Mile mɔ ni ji bo.
Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” Yesu fã eyi ekɛɛ, “Bu onaa ni oje emli!” Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ hã eshɔ̃, ni ebolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni eje emli!
Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ he jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni nɛ?
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hee ko nɛ!
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji po, ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ehe sane gbɛ shwã Galilea fɛɛ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ Amɛje kpeehe lɛ nɔŋŋ pɛ ni amɛkɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane tee Simon kɛ Andrea we lɛ.
Simon shaayoo lɛ kã shi kɛ atridii, ni Yesu jɛishɛɛ pɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ.
Etee eŋɔɔ, emɔ enineshi, ni ewo enɔ, kɛkɛ ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ Gbɛkɛ be ni hulu enyɔ shi lɛ, akɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli fɛɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bua amɛhe naa yɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Yesu tsa mɛi pii ni yeyeɔ helai srɔtoi, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii.
Eŋmɛɛɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ agbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle lɛ.
Yesu shiɛ yɛ Galilea Maŋkɛ mra be ni hiɛ gbeleko lɛ, Yesu te shi ni eje kpo kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko, ni eyasɔle yɛ jɛi.
Shi Simon kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ tiu lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛyana lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mɛi fɛɛ taoɔ nɛɛ.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa maji krokomɛi ni jwere wɔhewɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli, koni mayashiɛ yɛ jɛmɛ hu, ejaakɛ no hewɔ miba.” No hewɔ lɛ, eyashiɛ yɛ amɛkpeehei ni yɔɔ Galilea lɛ fɛɛ, ni efãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji hu.
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ Kpitiyelɔ ko ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni ebakula ehiɛ ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, “Kɛji oosumɔ lɛ ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse.” Yesu musuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekpã enine mli eta ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miisumɔ; ohe atse!” Amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe ni ehe tse.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ewo lɛ gbɛ ni etswa enaa ma ekɛɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni okakɛɛ mɔ ko nɔ ko; shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oshã afɔle ni Mose eto lɛ yɛ ohetsuumɔ hewɔ, ni no afee odase ahã amɛ.” Shi lɛ lɛ, be ni eje kpo lɛ, ebɔ̃i sane lɛ shiɛmɔ.
Enɛ hã sane lɛ gbɛ shwã bɔ ni Yesu nyɛɛɛ aje faŋŋ abote maŋ ko mli dɔŋŋ; shi ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ hei komɛi, ni mɛi jɛɔ he fɛɛ he baa eŋɔɔ.
Kuumɔhelatsɛ ko tsamɔ Gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ba Kapernaum ekoŋŋ, ni anu ehe akɛ eyɛ shĩa.
Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa bɔ ni anaaa gbɛ yɛ agbo lɛ naa tete.
Be ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, akɛ mɔ ko ni yeɔ kuumɔhela ni mɛi ejwɛ tere lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Shi akɛni mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛkɛ lɛ ashɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛyafã tsu ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛgbu folɔ ni amɛshiu helatsɛ lɛ kɛ saa ni ekã nɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ jɛi kɛbayi shi.
Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bi, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo!” Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi komɛi ni tara jɛi lɛ susu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ nɛ wieɔ wiemɔ ni tamɔ enɛ?
Eebɔ musu!
Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ?” Amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Yesu yoo yɛ emumɔ mli akɛ amɛmiisusu nɛkɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛtsuiiaŋ?
Te emli nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, akɛ aaakɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo’, aloo ‘Tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ’ lɛ?
Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛna akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ” ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo akɛ, tee shi, wo osaa lɛ ni oya shĩa.” Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni eje kpo yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnako enɛ eko dã!” Levi tsɛmɔ Ni Yesu je kpo ekoŋŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Asafo lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nitsɔɔmɔ.
Ni be ni ehoɔ lɛ, ena Levi ni ji Alfeo bi lɛ ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni ete shi enyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni Yesu ta niyenii ahe yɛ Levi shĩa lɛ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi pii hu fata ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahe ni ayeɔ nii lɛ ejaakɛ amɛyi fa, ni amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Be ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ na akɛ Yesu kɛ eshafeelɔi kɛ toohelɔi nɛɛ miiye nii lɛ, amɛbi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni ekɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii ni ekɛ amɛ nuɔ nɛɛ?” Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ tsofatsɛ he ehiaaa amɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ.
Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi eshafeelɔi moŋ.” Ŋmaahilɛ he sane Gbi ko be ni Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, mɛi komɛi ba Yesu ŋɔɔ babi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba ni Yohane kɛ Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hiɔ ŋmaa ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ ehiii ŋmaa lɛ?” Yesu to he ekɛɛ, “Ani ayɛmforowu lɛ bialɔi lɛ aaanyɛ ŋmaa ahi be mli ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ?
Gbii abɔ ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, amɛnyɛŋ ŋmaa amɛhi.
Shi be aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ; ni nakai gbi lɛ dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.
Mɔ ko kɛ mamanaa hee taaa atade momo; ejaakɛ mamanaa hee lɛ ni akɛta lɛ tserɛɔ emomo lɛ, ni fɔlɔ lɛ lɛɔ.
Asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolotɔi memeji amli; ejaakɛ wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolotɔi lɛ, ni wain lɛ aaashwie shi, ni wolotɔi lɛ aaafite; shi moŋ wain hee lɛ wolotɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ.” Hejɔɔmɔgbi lɛ Nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ Yesu yatsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji komɛi amli, ni be ni ekaselɔi lɛ yaa lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i abele lɛ kuumɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Kwɛ, mɛɛba okaselɔi lɛ feɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ?” Yesu to he akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee gbi ko be ni efi lɛ ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ dã.
Bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ yɛ Osɔfonukpa Abiatar yinɔ ni eyaye aboloo ni akɛmãa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni ekɛnyiɛ lɛ hu eko amɛye, tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ ni eyeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ hewɔ ato hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ hewɔ abɔ gbɔmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ po nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.”
Nuu ni nine egbo lɛ Ni Yesu tee kpeehe lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni enine kome egbo; ni amɛsra lɛ akɛ eeetsa lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo, koni amɛyafolɔ enaa.
Yesu kɛɛ mɔ ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni obadamɔ wɔteŋ!” Ni ebi mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Ani hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ eja akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa aloo afeɔ efɔŋ, akɛ ahereɔ gbɔmɔ yiwala aloo agbeɔ lɛ?” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ.
Ni ekwɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe kɛ mlifu, ejaakɛ edɔ lɛ akɛ amɛtsui wa nɛkɛ; ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ekpã mli, ni atsa enine lɛ ni eye emuu.
Farisifoi lɛ je kpo, ni amrɔ lɛ amɛkɛ Herodebii lɛ to eyinɔ apam bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ.
Asafo yuu lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ gbala amɛhe shi kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Mɛi pii ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Idumea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yordan sɛɛ kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ fɛɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Nɛkɛ asafo yuu nɛɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ejaakɛ amɛnu nibii ni efeɔ lɛ ahe.
Mɛi lɛ ayifalɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛsaa lɛlɛ bibioo ko amɛhã lɛ koni asafo lɛ akamia lɛ.
Etsa mɛi pii hewɔ lɛ mɛi ni helai hiɛhiɛ amɛ fɛɛ bu kɛba eŋɔɔ koni amɛbatara ehe.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ aaana lɛ lɛ, amɛhoɔ amɛgbeɔ shi yɛ ehiɛ ni amɛbolɔɔ akɛ, “Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.” Ni etswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkajie lɛ shi amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Yesu hala kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ Ni Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni etsɛ mɛi ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etaoɔ lɛ, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ.
Ni ehala mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ koni amɛkɛ lɛ abahi shi ni etsu amɛ shiɛmɔ, koni amɛna hewalɛ ni amɛkɛfamɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji.
Mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni ehala lɛ agbɛii nɛ: Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro lɛ, kɛ Yakobo, Zebedeo bi lɛ, kɛ Yohane, enyɛmi lɛ, ni ewo amɛ gbɛi akɛ Boanerges (eshishi ji nyɔŋmɔshimɔ bii); kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Toma kɛ Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Tadeo kɛ Simon, maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Ni Yesu ba shĩa.
Mɛi babaoo naa bakpe shi ekoŋŋ bɔ ni lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ wooo niyeli po.
Be ni ewekumɛi nu he lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyamɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi miikɛɛ akɛ eyiŋ miikã lɛ.
Mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Beelzebul yɛ emli, mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa efãmɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, “Te Satan aaafee tɛŋŋ afã Satan hu?
Kɛji maŋtsɛyeli ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, nakai maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ.
Ni kɛji shĩa ko gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, nakai shĩa lɛ nyɛŋ shi adamɔ.
Ni kɛji Satan te shi wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ni egba emli lɛ, enyɛŋ shi edamɔ, shi moŋ enaagbee ji no.
“Mɔ ko nyɛŋ hewalɔ ko we abote ni eyaha enii, akɛ ja efi hewalɔ lɛ dã kɛkɛ lɛ eeenyɛ ewe lɛ nii eha.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ akɛ, akɛ gbɔmɛi ahe eshai fɛɛ aaafa amɛ kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ ni amɛaawie hu; shi mɔ ni bɔɔ musu eshiɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko kɛyashi naanɔ, shi moŋ eye fɔ kɛmiiya naanɔ.” Yesu wie enɛ ejaakɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba, ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa, ni amɛtsu aba eŋɔɔ ni abatsɛ lɛ.
Asafo lɛ tara shi yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao bo.” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji minyɛ ni namɛi ji minyɛmimɛi lɛ?” Ekwɛ mɛi ni tara ehe lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi nɛ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, lɛ ji minyɛmi nuu kɛ minyɛmi yoo kɛ minyɛ.”
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Yesu bɔ̃i nitsɔɔmɔ ekoŋŋ yɛ Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa yɛ ehe, no hewɔ lɛ, ebote lɛlɛ ko mli ni eyata shi.
Lɛlɛ lɛ ma nu lɛ hiɛ, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ bua shi yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii pii yɛ abɛbuai amli; yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛboa toi!
Naa, nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee nidumɔ.
Ni eba mli akɛ be ni eshwãa wui lɛ, ekomɛi yashwie gbɛ toi, ni loofɔji ba amɛbakɔlɔ.
Ekomɛi yashwie tɛsai anɔ he ni amɛnaaa su pii yɛ, ni amɛkwɛ̃ oya, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa su ni mli kwɔ.
Shi be ni hulu je lɛ, eshã amɛ, ni akɛni amɛbɛ fã hewɔ lɛ amɛglã.
Wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kwɛ̃ kɛba ŋwɛi ni amɛgbe tsei lɛ, hewɔ lɛ amɛwooo yibii.
Shi wui lɛ ekomɛi yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛdara, ni amɛwo yibii: eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko oha.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, hã ni enu.” Nɔ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli Be ni shwɛ Yesu kome lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ehe lɛ kɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he teemɔ sane lɛ ehã nyɛ, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, abɛbuai amli akɛ amɛ wieɔ nii fɛɛ yɛ koni ‘Na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo, ni nu lɛ amɛnu nɛ, shi amɛkana shishi; ni eba lɛ akɛ amɛkpale ni akɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ afa amɛ.’ ” Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛnuuu abɛ nɛɛ shishi?
Belɛ te aaafee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni nyɛaanu abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishiŋ?
Nidulɔ lɛ duɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Gbɛtoi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni Satan baa ebasharaa wiemɔ ni adu yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ lɛ.
Tɛsaa shikpɔŋ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli mra kɛ miishɛɛ; shi amɛbɛ shishifã yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli hewɔ lɛ be fioo kɛkɛ amɛhiɔ shi, ni kɛ amanehulu loo yiwaa te shi yɛ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ.
Shikpɔŋ ni ŋmei yɔɔ nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ; shi je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔ kɛ ninamɔ he lakamɔ kɛ nii krokomɛi ahe akɔnɔ yaboteɔ amɛmli ni amɛgbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni ewooo yibii.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛmɔɔ mli, ni amɛwoɔ yibii, eko nyɔŋmai etɛ̃, eko nyɔŋmai ekpaa, kɛ eko hu oha.” Kane ni akɛhɔ tsese shishi Ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani akɛ kane maa tsese loo saatso shishi?
Ani jeee kanetso nɔ akɛmaa?
Nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ ni agbeleŋ nɔ, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ shi.
Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni ekɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu.” Ni esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ he jogbaŋŋ!
Nɔ susumɔ nɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no akɛaasusu ahã nyɛ, ni aaafata he ahã nyɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ eko afata he, shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahe fioo ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.” Dumɔwui ni kwɛ̃ lɛ Yesu tee nɔ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ nɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni shwãa dumɔwui yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Eyawɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni eteɔ shi kɛji je tsɛre, ni no mli fɛɛ lɛ dumɔwui lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa, ni eleee bɔ ni feɔ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ woɔ yibii: jwɛifɔ lɛ tsutsu, kɛkɛ lɛ ŋmãatso lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ŋmãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yɛ ŋmãatso yi.
Shi kɛ ŋmãa lɛ tsu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehãa akɛ nikpamɔ kakla lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ŋmaakpamɔbe lɛ eshɛ.” Sinapi wu lɛ Yesu bi akɛ, “Mɛni he wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato?
Aloo mɛɛ abɛ wɔɔbu yɛ he?
Etamɔ sinapi wu ni ji wu bibioo fe shikpɔŋ nɔ wui fɛɛ.
Shi kɛ adu lɛ, ekwɛ̃ɔ, ni edaa fe shwie bai fɛɛ.
Egbalaa niji kpelei, bɔ ni ŋwɛi loofɔji aaanyɛ afee tsui yɛ ehɔɔŋ lɛ shishi.” Yesu tsɔ̃ abɛbuai pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ eshiɛ wiemɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ amɛnu shishi.
Ekɛ amɛ ewieee akɛ ja yɛ abɛbuai amli; shi kɛ shwɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ sɔŋŋ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ abɛi lɛ fɛɛ shishi.
Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfoa ŋshɔ lɛ kɛyaa esɛɛgbɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshi asafo lɛ ni amɛŋɔ lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛtee; ni lɛji krokomɛi hu fata ehe.
Shi ahum kpele ko batswa, ni ŋshɔkei kumɔ wo lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eehe eyi.
Ni Yesu yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ; etsɔle sune ni ewɔ.
Ni kaselɔi lɛ tsĩɛ lɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ni wɔhiɛ heɔ akpãtã nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane koŋ?” Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ yi, ni ekɛɛ ŋshɔ lɛ akɛ, “Bu onaa ni ofee diŋŋ!” Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ dɛmm.
Kɛkɛ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsheɔ gbeyei nɛkɛ?
Mɛɛba ni nyɛbɛ hemɔkɛyeli?” Amɛshe gbeyei naakpa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ po nɛ, ni kɔɔyɔɔ kɛ ŋshɔ tete boɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?”
Yesu tsa nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli lɛ Ni amɛba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ yɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Be ni Yesu je lɛlɛ lɛ mli pɛ kɛkɛ ni nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli jɛ gbohii abui lɛ amli kɛ lɛ bakpe.
Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, gbohii abui amli ehiɔ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ awo dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ awo lɛ gboklɛi kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi shii abɔ, shi be fɛɛ be ni aaawo lɛ lɛ, etserɛɔ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ ni ekumɔɔ gboklɛi lɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ ehe ajɔɔ.
Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ lɛ, gbohii abui kɛ gɔji lɛ amli eyɔɔ, ni ebolɔɔ ni ekɛ tɛi folɔɔ ehe.
Shi be ni ena Yesu yɛ shɔŋŋ lɛ, ejo foi kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ebakula shi yɛ ehiɛ; ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ Bi, mɛni sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ?
Mina Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ kaapiŋ mi!” Ekɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee gbɔmɔ nɛɛ mli, bo mumɔ fɔŋ!” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Te ogbɛiŋ?” Nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Migbɛi ji Asafo, ejaakɛ wɔyi fa!” Ni ekpa Yesu fai waa akɛ ekashwie amɛ kɛmiije jɛi niiaŋ.
Kplotoo ku kpele ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ he.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ kpa Yesu fai amɛkɛɛ, “Hã wɔya kplotoi lɛ ateŋ ni wɔyabote amɛmli.” Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli.
Ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ — aaafee akpei enyɔ — wo foi kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛkpeleke shi kɛyashwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ ni kplotookwɛlɔi lɛ jo foi, ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ ŋmɔji lɛ amli, ni mɛi lɛ je kpo amɛbakwɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ.
Amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbana nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji asafo hi emli lɛ ta shi ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ; ni efee amɛ gbeyei.
Mɛi ni na lɛ gba amɛ nɔ ni ba nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hi emli lɛ nɔ kɛ kplotoi lɛ ahe sane lɛ.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu faikpamɔ akɛ eje amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ eya.
Be ni Yesu boteɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hi emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ehã ekɛ lɛ ahi shi.
Shi Yesu ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ; moŋ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa owe kɛ owekumɛi aŋɔɔ ni oyagba amɛ nii ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee ehã bo, kɛ mɔbɔ ni ena bo lɛ!” Ni nuu lɛ yiŋ etee, ni eyabɔ̃i nii ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ shiɛmɔ yɛ Dekapoli; ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.
Yairo biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ Be ni Yesu kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ fo ŋshɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛba esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, mɛi pii babua ehe yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yairo lɛ ba, ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ, eho egbee enaji anaa, ni ekpa lɛ fai pii ekɛɛ, “Gbo mibiyoo fioo heɔ agbo nɛɛ, hewɔ lɛ ba ni okɛ oniji abashwie enɔ koni ehe awa lɛ ni eyi ana wala!” Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ tee.
Mɛi pii nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmiififia lɛ.
Ni yoo ko ni eye láhoo hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni ena nɔ babaoo yɛ tsofatsɛmɛi pii adɛŋ; efite edɛŋ nii fɛ̃ɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ enaaa he sɛɛ ko kwraa shi wu kɛkɛ moŋ hela lɛ woɔ lɛ, be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, ebaje esɛɛgbɛ yɛ mɛi pii lɛ ateŋ, ni eta etade lɛ he; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Kɛji mita etade lɛ po he kɛkɛ lɛ mihe aaawa mi.” Ni amrɔ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ naa mɔ, ni enu he yɛ ehewojiaŋ akɛ atsa ehela lɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu yoo akɛ hewalɛ ko eje emli, ni etsɔ̃ ehe yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ ni ebi akɛ, “Namɔ ta mitade lɛ he lɛ?” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oona akɛ asafo lɛ miififia bo, ni osaa obiɔ akɛ, ‘Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?’ ” Shi Yesu kwɛ ehe koni ena mɔ ni fee nakai lɛ.
Shi akɛni yoo lɛ le nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ bagbee ehiɛ, ni egba lɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛ̃ɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli ehã ohe ewa bo; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni ohela lɛ ajɔ.” Be ni Yesu wieɔ lolo lɛ, kpeehe onukpa lɛ webii lɛ ekomɛi ba bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obiyoo lɛ egbo; mɛɛba ogbaa Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ naa lolo?” Shi be ni Yesu nu wiemɔ ni awie lɛ, ekɛɛ Yairo akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; he oye kɛkɛ!” Ni ehãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko anyiɛ esɛɛ akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛkɛ.
Amɛba kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ, ni Yesu bana hoofeemɔ kɛ mɛi ni foɔ ni amɛyeɔ ŋkɔmɔ babaoo lɛ.
Ni ebote shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ hoo ni nyɛfoɔ nɛkɛ?
Gbekɛ lɛ gboko; wɔ ewɔɔ!” Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi lɛ lɛ eshwie mɛi lɛ fɛ̃ɛ kɛje kpo, ni eŋɔ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata lɛ Yesu lɛ he lɛ kɛtee he ni gbekɛ lɛ kã lɛ.
Ni emɔ enine shi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Talita, kuumi!” Eshishi ji, “Gbekɛyoo, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, tee shi!” Ni amrɔ lɛ, gbekɛ lɛ te shi ni ebɔ̃i shisharamɔ; eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni mɛi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa; shi Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma veveeve akɛ amɛkahã mɔ ko le enɛ; ni efã akɛ ahã gbekɛ lɛ nɔ ko ni eye.
Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret Yesu je jɛi eyiŋ etee emaŋ lɛ mli, ni ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni shɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ebɔ̃i nitsɔɔmɔ yɛ kpeehe lɛ; ni mɛi pii ni nu lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛbi akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ yana nii nɛɛ kɛjɛ?
Mɛɛ nilee akɛhã lɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ enine nɔ atsuɔ nɛkɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi nɛɛ?
Ani jeee ŋaalɔ lɛ nɛ, Maria bi lɛ, kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yose kɛ Yuda kɛ Simon nyɛmi nuu lɛ, ni jeee enyɛmimɛi yei hu kɛ wɔ yɔɔ biɛ lɛ?” Ni ehe sane lɛ hã amɛnane tɔ̃tɔ̃.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Akpaaa gbalɔ woo akɛ ja yɛ emaŋ kɛ ewekumɛi ateŋ kɛ ewe kɛkɛ.” Ni enyɛɛɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko etsu yɛ Nazaret, fe akɛ ekɛ eniji ŋmɛlɛ helatsɛmɛi fioo ko nɔ, ni etsa amɛ.
Ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ.
Ni eyakpa akrowai lɛ amli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ Ni Yesu tsɛ kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsumɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ anɔ.
Ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkahiɛ nɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ ja tso kɛkɛ; amɛkahiɛ aboloo loo kotoku loo shika yɛ amɛhɛfiinii amli; shi amɛwo tokotai, ni amɛkawo flakai enyɔ.
Esaa ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “He fɛɛ he ni nyɛaabote shĩa ko yɛ lɛ, nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaaje jɛi.
He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ hereee nyɛ ni amɛbooo nyɛ toi yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije jɛi lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnane shi mlu nyɛshwiea shi nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyashiɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui.
Ni amɛfãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii ni amɛfɔfɔɔ helatsɛmɛi pii amu ni amɛtsa amɛ.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ gbele Ni maŋtsɛ Herode nu he, ejaakɛ Yesu gbɛi ehehee shi, Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, no hewɔ ni hewalɛ nɛɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ emli nɛɛ.” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Elia ni;” shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, “Gbalɔ ni, tamɔ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko.” Be ni Herode nu lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Yohane ni mifo eyi lɛ, lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ!” Ekɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ lɛ Herode lɛ etsu ayamɔ Yohane, ni efi lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ ewo tsuŋ.
Efee enɛ ejaakɛ ekɛ Herodia, enyɛmi Filipo ŋa lɛ, efee eŋa; ni Yohane kɛɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ejaaa gbɛ akɛ okɛ onyɛmi lɛ ŋa lɛ feɔ oŋa.” Hewɔ lɛ Herodia bɛ Yohane wo emli, ni eetao lɛ egbe; shi enyɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ Herode miishe Yohane gbeyei, akɛni ele akɛ jalɔ kɛ mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ lɛ, ni eto lɛ shweshweeshwe.
Kɛ ebo ewiemɔ toi lɛ, ehe jaraa lɛ pii, shi kɛ̃lɛ esumɔɔ akɛ ebo lɛ toi.
Ni gbi ni sa lɛ bashɛ, be ni Herode yeɔ efɔmɔ gbijurɔ ni eŋmɛ ebladei kɛ esafoiatsɛmɛi kɛ Galilea onukpai lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ: Herodia biyoo ba ebajo, ni esa Herode kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ahiɛ.
Ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛɛ gbekɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Bi mi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ, ni mahã bo!” Ni ekã lɛ kitã akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi mi lɛ mahã bo, kɛji mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ fã tete po lɛ!” Ni gbekɛ yoo lɛ je kpo yabi enyɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mibi?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso.” Ni amrɔ lɛ eba maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ oya ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miitao ni okɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ yitso ahã mi amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ yɛ kã mli.” Edɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ naakpa; shi ekitã lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii lɛ ashi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esumɔɔɔ akɛ ekãmaa lɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ tsu oblafo, ni efã lɛ akɛ ekɛ Yohane yitso aba.
Ni etee eyafo eyi yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛŋmɛ kã mli kɛba ekɛbahã gbekɛ yoo lɛ, ni lɛ hu ekɛyahã enyɛ.
Ni be ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛba amɛbawo egbonyo lɛ amɛyafu.
Bɔfoi lɛ asɛɛkuu Bɔfoi lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba lɛ nii ni amɛyafee kɛ nii ni amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ sɔŋŋ nyɛbaa ni wɔtea ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee ni nyɛyajɔa nyɛhe fioo.” Ejaakɛ mɛi ni baa yaa lɛ fa tsɔ̃ ni amɛnaaa dekã kɛye nii tete.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii Ni amɛtsɔ̃ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee.
Ni asafoi lɛ na amɛ ni amɛmiiya, ni mɛi pii yoo amɛ; ni amɛjɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli amɛjo foi kɛtsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ kɛtee jɛi, ni amɛho amɛnaa.
Be ni Yesu kpeleke lɛ, ena asafo kpele, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ toi ni bɛ kwɛlɔ; ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nibii pii tsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Ni be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋa nɔ ji biɛ, ni je hu miina; wo mɛi lɛ agbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ maji ni jwere wɔhewɔ nɛɛ amli ni amɛyahe nii amɛye.” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea.” Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔya wɔyahe aboloo denarioi ohai enyɔ wɔkɛhã amɛ amɛye?” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?
Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakwɛa.” Be ni amɛyakwɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ.” Ni efã amɛ akɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ atara shi kuikui yɛ jwɛifɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛtara shi kuikui, ohahai kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔenumɔi.
Ni Yesu kɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ejɔɔ nɔ.
Ekumɔ aboloi lɛ, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ.
Eja loi enyɔ lɛ hu ehã amɛ fɛɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ.
Ni amɛhala aboloo fufuji kɛ loo fufuji lɛ amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Ni mɛi ni ye aboloo lɛ ayibɔ ji hii akpei enumɔ.
Yesu yasɔle Ni amrɔ lɛ Yesu tsirɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ayisɛɛ ni amɛbote lɛlɛ mli koni amɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛya ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛya Betsaida, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeewo asafo lɛ gbɛ.
Ni be ni ewo amɛ gbɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyasɔle.
Yesu nyiɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ Be ni je na lɛ, lɛlɛ lɛ eshɛ ŋshɔ lɛ teŋ, ni Yesu kome yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Ena akɛ wirimɔ lɛ miitɔ kaselɔi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛmiikpee kɔɔyɔɔ; ni maŋkɛ hima aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ loo nɔ mli lɛ, enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛmiiba amɛŋɔɔ, ni eetao eho amɛhe.
Be ni amɛna lɛ ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ sisa ni, ni amɛbolɔ ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛna lɛ, ni amɛtsui fa.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ wie, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli; mi ni; nyɛkashea gbeyei!” Ni eba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tswaa.
Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa.
Ejaakɛ amɛyooko nɔ ni aboloo sane lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ sɛɛ; amɛjwɛŋmɔ kpleee he.
Yesu tsa helatsɛmɛi yɛ Genesaret Ni be ni amɛfo ŋshɔ lɛ, amɛba Genesaret shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛbakpeleke.
Ni be ni amɛje lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mɛi lɛ yoo Yesu, ni amɛsha foi kɛyakpa jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni amɛbɔ̃i mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ aholemɔ yɛ sai anɔ kɛ eŋɔɔbaa yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛnu akɛ eyɔɔ.
Ni he fɛɛ he ni ebote akrowai loo maji loo ŋmɔji amli yɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ helatsɛmɛi bashwieɔ blohuiaŋ, ni amɛkpaa lɛ fai koni ehã amɛna etade naamuu lɛ kɛkɛ he amɛtara; ni mɛi abɔ ni tara he lɛ, amɛhe wa amɛ.
Blematsɛmɛi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔi Agbɛnɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ bua amɛhe naa kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Amɛna akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi yeɔ nii kɛ dɛ̃ ni abule, ni ji dɛ̃ ni afɔko.
Ejaakɛ Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ja amɛkɛ nu efɔ amɛdɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ dani amɛyeɔ nii; amɛfeɔ enɛ amɛkɛyeɔ onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ.
Ni kɛ amɛjɛ jara nɔ amɛba lɛ, ja amɛju amɛhe dani amɛyeɔ nii.
Ni nibii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni ato ahã amɛ ni amɛfeɔ yɛ kpuji kɛ gbɛi kɛ ayawai amlifɔmɔ kɛ saatsei ahefɔmɔ he.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ bi Yesu akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ okaselɔi lɛ yeee onukpai lɛ ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ ni amɛfɔɔɔ amɛdɛ dani amɛyeɔ nii nɛɛ?” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ Yesaia gba yɛ nyɛ osatofoi nɛɛ ahe tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋ nɛɛ, amɛnaabui amɛkɛwoɔ mi; shi amɛtsui etsi ehe kɛje mihe kɛtee shɔŋŋ.
Shi yakatswaa amɛjaa mi lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni ji gbɔmɛi akitãi.’ “Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ, nyɛshi, ni gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anɔ nyɛyeɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ akɛ nyɛkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kitã lɛ koni nyɛye nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ anɔ!
Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ, ‘Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ’, kɛ ‘Mɔ ni lomɔɔ etsɛ loo enyɛ lɛ, gbe aaagbe lɛ!’ Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɛ etsɛ loo enyɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni kulɛ ooona yɛ midɛŋ lɛ, “Korban” (nɔ ni akɛke Nyɔŋmɔ) ni’ lɛ, belɛ nyɛhãaa efee nɔ ko ehã etsɛ loo enyɛ dɔŋŋ; ni nyɛkɛ nyɛblema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ egu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛfeɔ nibii pii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi.” Nibii ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ Ni Yesu tsɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛboa mi toi ni nyɛnua shishi!
Nɔ ko bɛ ni jɛɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli ni aaanyɛ lɛ abule, shi nɔ ni buleɔ gbɔmɔ ji nɔ ni jɛɔ emli lɛ.
[ Kɛ mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu.”] Ni be ni eje asafo lɛ ŋɔɔ eba shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ abɛ lɛ shishi.
Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nɛkɛ nyɛ hu nyɛnaaa nii ashishi?
Nyɛnaaa akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ boteɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ abule, ejaakɛ jeee etsui mli eboteɔ shi emusuŋ eyaa, ni eyajeɔ kpo yɛ tiafi mli?” (Yesu kɛɛ enɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ŋmaa fɛɛ ŋmaa he tse.)
Ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni jɛɔ gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, no nɔŋŋ buleɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mligbɛ ni ji gbɔmɛi atsuii amli lɛ, jɛi jwɛŋmɔi fɔ̃ji jɛɔ: ajwamãŋbɔɔ, juu, awuyeli, gbãlãfitemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, yiŋsha, shishiumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, hiŋmɛisha, oshekuyeli, hewoo, kwashiai asaneyeli.
Nii fɔ̃ji nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, mligbɛ amɛjɛɔ ni amɛbuleɔ gbɔmɔ.” Siro Foinikeyoo lɛ hemɔkɛyeli Ni Yesu je jɛi, ni eyiŋ etee Tiro kɛ Sidon niiaŋ.
Eyabote shĩa ko, ni esumɔɔɔ akɛ aleɔ, shi enyɛɛɛ ehe etee.
Ejaakɛ ejɛishɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni yoo ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ ebiyoo fioo mli nu ehe ni eba ebakula shi yɛ enaji anaa.
Shi yoo lɛ jeŋmajiaŋ yoo ji lɛ, ni he ni ejɛ ji Foinike ni yɔɔ Siria lɛ.
Ebakpa Yesu fai ni efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ ebiyoo lɛ mli.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã bii lɛ fɛɛ atɔrɔ dã; ejaaa akɛ aŋɔɔ bii aboloo lɛ ashɛrɛɔ ashwieɔ gbeebii.” Shi yoo lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ mli moŋ, shi bɛ gbeebii ni yɔɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ shishi lɛ hu yeɔ bii lɛ afufuji lɛ eko!” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Owiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, yaa!
Mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje obi lɛ mli.” Yoo lɛ yiŋ etee eshĩa ni eyana ebiyoo lɛ kã saa nɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ eje emli.
Yesu tsa mumui toimulɔ ko Yesu ku esɛɛ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ Tiro niiaŋ kɛfoŋ yɛ Sidon ni etsɔ̃ Dekapoli kpokpai lɛ anɔ kɛba Galilea Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni akɛ mɔ ko ni muɔ toi ni mumui hu ji lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni ekɛ enine aŋmɛ enɔ.
Ni Yesu kɛ lɛ je asafo lɛ teŋ kɛtee afã, ni ekɛ ewaobii wo etoii amli, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ekɛsa elilɛi he.
Ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ni ehuu yɛ emli ni ekɛɛ mumui toimulɔ lɛ akɛ, “Hefata!” Eshishi ji, “Gbelemɔ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ etoii lɛ gbele, ni elilɛi kpãa lɛ fɛne, ni ewie faŋŋ.
Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko; shi babaoo ni etswaa amɛnaa ma lɛ, babaoo ni amɛjajeɔ ji no.
Ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe babaoo diɛŋtsɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Efee nii fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ!
Ehãa toimulɔi nuɔ nii, ni mumuii hu wieɔ.”
Yesu hã mɛi akpei ejwɛ niyenii Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni mɛi pii ebabua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ ni amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛye lɛ, Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mimusuŋ miitsɔ̃ mi yɛ asafo lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ mi ehi shi gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛbaaye.
Ni kɛji mihã amɛkɛ amɛmusuŋ hɔmɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya amɛwe lɛ, amɛaayatɔ biti yɛ gbɛteŋ ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ajɛɛhe jɛkɛ.” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ aaanyɛ ana aboloo yɛ yɛ ŋa nɛɛ nɔ ni aaashɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi anaa?” Ebi amɛ akɛ, “Aboloi enyiɛ nyɛyɔɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kpawo.” Ni efa asafo lɛ akɛ amɛtara shikpɔŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɔlɔ aboloi kpawo lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli ekɛhã kaselɔi lɛ koni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ; ni amɛkɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Amɛyɛ loi bibii fioo hu, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni efã akɛ akɛ no hu amãmɔ amɛhiɛ.
Ni amɛye ni amɛtɔrɔ, ni amɛhala fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ flɔtɔi kpawo obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Shi mɛi ni ye lɛ aaafee mɛi akpei ejwɛ.
Ni ewo amɛ gbɛ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ bote lɛlɛ mli, ni eba Dalmanuta niiaŋ.
Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ ba ni amɛkɛ lɛ babɔ̃i ŋwanejee.
Amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi yɛ edɛŋ, kɛmiika lɛ.
Ni edɔmɔ ŋtsɔi yɛ emumɔ mli ekɛɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ taoɔ okadi?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, kɛ aaahã yinɔbii nɛɛ okadi ko fii!” Ni eshi amɛ, ni eyabote lɛlɛ mli ekoŋŋ ni etee faa lɛ sɛɛ.
Farisifoi lɛ amasha kɛ Herode masha lɛ Shi amɛhiɛ ekpa nɔ ni amɛŋɔ aboloo akwaabɔi amɛkɛhiɛ amɛdɛŋ, amɛhiɛɛɛ eko yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli, akɛ ja ekome pɛ kɛkɛ.
Yesu bɔ amɛ kɔkɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amasha kɛ Herode masha lɛ he!” Ni amɛtao naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Benɛ aboloo ni wɔhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ.” Ni be ni Yesu na le lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛsusuɔ akɛ aboloo ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ lɛ hewɔŋ?
Ani nyɛyooko sɛɛ ni asaŋ nyɛnako nii anaa lolo?
Ani nɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ naa eŋa?
Nyɛyɛ hiŋmɛii, ni nyɛnaaa nii?
Nyɛyɛ toii hu, ni nyɛnuuu nii?
Ni nyɛkaiii?
Be ni mikumɔ aboloi enumɔ lɛ amli miha mɛi akpei enumɔ lɛ, fufuji kafui enyiɛ nyɛhole?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.” “Ni be ni mikumɔ kpawo lɛ mli mihã mɛi akpei ejwɛ lɛ, fufuji flɔtɔi enyiɛ nyɛhole?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Kpawo.” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛnaaa nii anaa lolo nɛɛ?” Yesu tsa shwilafo ko yɛ Betsaida Amɛba Betsaida, ni mɛi komɛi kɛ shwilafo ko ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai koni eta ehe.
Ni emɔ shwilafo lɛ nineshi ni ekɛ lɛ je akrowa lɛ, ni etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ eshwie ehiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani oona nii lo?” Nuu lɛ wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Miina gbɔmɛi, shi amɛtamɔ tsei ni miinyiɛ.” No sɛɛ lɛ, esaa ekɛ eniji shwie shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ; agbɛnɛ shwilafo lɛ kwɛ nii hãa, ni atsa lɛ, ni ena nii fɛɛ faŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ni eya eshĩa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaaya akrowa lɛ mli tete!” Petro odase ni eye yɛ Yesu he Ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maji ni yɔɔ Kaisarea Filipi lɛ amli.
Ebi amɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi kɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Amɛto he akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji bo.” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Petro here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo ji Kristo lɛ!” Ni Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkakɛɛ mɔ ko ehe sane.
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ akɛ, “Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu pii, ni onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ekwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.” Ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ faŋŋ.
Enɛ hã Petro kɛ lɛ tee afã, ni ebɔ̃i ehiɛ kãmɔ.
Shi etsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, ekã Petro hiɛ ekɛɛ, “Jee mihiɛ, Satan, ejaakɛ osusuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahe, shi gbɔmɛi anibii ahe moŋ ojwɛŋɔ!” Hekwamɔ Agbɛnɛ etsɛ asafo lɛ kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ hu kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa, kɛji enine shɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ni elaaje lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma lɛ?
Aloo mɛni gbɔmɔ aaahã ni ekɛkpɔ̃ esusuma?
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgbele yɛ yinɔbii gbãlãfitelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi nɛɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgbele be ni eeeba yɛ eTsɛ anunyam lɛ mli kɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.”
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ hewalɛ mli.” Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake Gbii ekpaa sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ni ekɛ amɛ kɛkɛ tee gɔŋ ni kwɔ ko nɔ yɛ afã banee.
Ni egbɔmɔtso su tsake yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni etade lɛ kpɛ ni eyɛ futafuta bɔ ni niiahefɔlɔ ko bɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã eyɛ nakai.
Ni Elia kɛ Mose jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ Yesu miiwie.
Ni Petro here nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, ehi akɛ wɔhi biɛ!
Hã wɔfee bui etɛ̃, onɔ ekome, kɛ Mose nɔ ekome, kɛ Elia nɔ ekome.” Shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ ejaakɛ amɛ jijaa.
Ni atatu ko bakete amɛnɔ, ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji misuɔmɔ Bi lɛ, nyɛboa lɛ toi!” Ni amrɔ lɛ, be ni amɛkwɛkwɛɛ amɛhe kɛkpe lɛ, amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ akɛ ja Yesu pɛ kɛ amɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni be ni amɛkpelekeɔ gɔŋ lɛ, Yesu tswa amɛnaa ma ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkagbaa mɔ ko nii ni nyɛna lɛ, ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ dã.” Amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ to amɛyiŋ, shi amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Te shitee kɛ gbohii ateŋjɛɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?” Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te tɛŋŋ ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ ja Elia eba dã lɛ?” Eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Elia baaba dã lɛɛlɛŋ ni ebato nibii fɛɛ gbɛjianɔ ekoŋŋ.
Shi mɛɛba mɔ ni aŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he akɛ eeena amanehulu pii, ni aaaŋɔ lɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni abuuu lɛ lɛ?
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Elia eba momo, ni amɛfee lɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ.” Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli Be ni amɛbashɛ kaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛna mɛi pii ni bua amɛhe kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ni amɛmiibibii amɛhe nii.
Amrɔ ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na Yesu lɛ, efee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛsha foi kɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbafala lɛ.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛbibiɔ amɛ lɛ?” Ni mɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mikɛ mibinuu ni mumɔ ni ewieee yɔɔ emli ba oŋɔɔ.
He fɛɛ he ni eeemɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ, etsiɔ lɛ etswaa shi ni enaa kwɛ̃ɔ afui, ni ekpeɔ enyanyɔji ashishi ni eetã loo.
Mikɛɛ okaselɔi lɛ ni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ.” Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ao, yinɔbii ni heee yeee!
Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ mi kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi kɛyashi?
Mɛɛ beyinɔ mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi?
Nyɛkɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ.” Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni mumɔ lɛ na Yesu lɛ, amrɔ lɛ ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni egbee shi, ni ekoklo shi, ni enaa kwɛ̃ afui.
Yesu bi etsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ enɛ bɔ̃i lɛ feemɔ?” Ni eto he ekɛɛ, “Kɛjɛ egbekɛbiiashi.
Kpitiokpitio eshɛɔ lɛ efɔ̃ɔ la mli kɛ nui amli koni ekpãtã ehiɛ.
Shi kɛji ooonyɛ he nɔ ko ofee lɛ, omusuŋ atsɔ̃ bo yɛ wɔhe ni ofee he eko ohã wɔ!” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ, ‘Kɛ ooonyɛ?’ Aaanyɛ afee nii fiaa ahã mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ lɛ bo ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye; ye obua mihemɔkɛyeli ni mibɛ lɛ!” Shi be ni Yesu na akɛ asafo lɛ hiɛ foi kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, efã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yi ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mumɔ mumui kɛ toimulɔ, miifã bo akɛ, ‘Jee emli, ni kaabote emli dɔŋŋ.’ ” Ni mumɔ lɛ bolɔ, ni ehã gbekɛ lɛ shɔ̃ kwekweekwe, ni eje emli; ni gbekɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo bɔ ni mɛi pii kɛɛ akɛ egbo.
Shi Yesu mɔ enineshi, ni ewo enɔ, ni ete shi edamɔ shi.
Be ni Yesu ba shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ yɛ afã akɛ, “Mɛɛba wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛɛɛ mumɔ lɛ wɔfã lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ henɔ nɛɛ, anyɛɛɛ lɛ afã yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko naa, akɛ ja yɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ naa pɛ kɛkɛ.” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he ekoŋŋ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ je jɛi ni amɛyatsɔ̃ Galilea, ni esumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko ale; ejaakɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ anii; ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni kɛ agbe lɛ lɛ, eeete shi yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ.” Shi amɛnaaa nakai wiemɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei hu akɛ amɛaabi lɛ.
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
Ni amɛba Kapernaum.
Ni be ni eyɔɔ shĩa lɛ, ebi ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni he nyɛwieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?” Shi amɛtswaaa amɛsɛŋ; ejaakɛ be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtaa naa yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ.
Yesu ho eta shi ni etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miitao klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ sɛɛkpelɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ.” Ni eŋɔ gbekɛ bibioo ko ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛteŋ, ni eloo lɛ atuu, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛbii ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɔ kome yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, jeee mi ehereɔ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ!” Mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo wɔ lɛ eyɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ Yohane kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔna mɔ ko ni kɛ ogbɛi miifã mumɔi fɔ̃ji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ wɔ enyiɛɛɛ osɛɛ” Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni ekɛ migbɛi aaatsu hewalɛ nitsumɔ ko ni eeenyɛ mihe efɔŋ ewie oya.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo wɔ lɛ, eyɛ wɔgbɛfaŋ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaahã nyɛ nu kpulu kome nyɛnu yɛ migbɛi mli akɛ Kristo webii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ enyɔmɔwo eŋmɛŋ lɛ.” Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ mɛi bibii nɛɛ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni ayashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ.
Kɛ onine miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nine kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni okɛ niji enyɔ aaatee gehena (Abonsamiiaje) yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli, [ he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo, ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.]
Ni kɛ onane miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, foo; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ nane kome bote wala mli fe nɔ ni ohiɛ naji enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje yɛ la ni gbooo lɛ mli, [ he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo, ni amɛla hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.]
Ni kɛ ohiŋmɛi miitɔ̃tɔ̃ onane lɛ, fãa oshɛ ofɔ̃; faŋ nɔ ni okɛ hiŋmɛi kome bote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli fe nɔ ni ohiɛ hiŋmɛii enyɔ ni aaashɛ bo afɔ̃ abonsamiiaje la lɛ mli, he ni amɛgɔ̃gɔ̃mi lɛ gbooo ni amɛla lɛ hu gbooo yɛ lɛ.
“Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ akɛ la aaawo lɛ ŋoo.
Nɔ kpakpa ji ŋoo; shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni nyɛkɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ?
Nyɛhãa ŋoo ahĩa nyɛmli, ni nyɛhia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli yɛ nyɛteŋ.”
Gbãlãmligbalamɔ he nitsɔɔmɔ Ni Yesu je jɛi ni eyiŋ etee Yudea niiaŋ kɛ Yordan sɛɛgbɛ.
Ni mɛi pii babua amɛhe naa ekoŋŋ yɛ ehe, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekoŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani nuu yɛ hegbɛ akɛ eshwieɔ eŋa?” Amɛbi enɛ kɛmiika lɛ.
Shi ehere nɔ ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ kitã Mose wo nyɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ, “Mose hã hegbɛ akɛ aŋma shwiemɔ wolo ni ashwie lɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsuiwalɛ hewɔ eŋma kitã nɛɛ ehã nyɛ; shi kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, nuu kɛ yoo Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ amɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he; ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome; belɛ agbɛnɛ amɛjeee mɛi enyɔ dɔŋŋ, shi heloo kome.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsa lɛ, gbɔmɔ akagbala mli.” Ni be ni amɛshɛ shĩa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ nakai sane lɛ nɔŋŋ ekoŋŋ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni eyaŋɔɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, efite gbãlã.
Ni kɛji yoo shwie ewu ni eyagbã mɔ kroko lɛ efite gbãlã.” Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii Ni mɛi komɛi kɛ gbekɛbii bibii ba Yesu ŋɔɔ ko ni etara amɛhe; shi ekaselɔi lɛ fãmɔ mɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni Yesu na lɛ, emli fu, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heee Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ bibioo lɛ, eboteŋ mli kwraa.” Ni eloo amɛ atuu, ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ, ni ejɔɔ amɛ.
Nuu niiatsɛ lɛ Ni be ni eje kpo ni eyi gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko hiɛ foi kɛbanina lɛ ni ebakula ehiɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa?
Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ.
Te ole kitãi lɛ, ‘Kaagbe gbɔmɔ, kaafite gbãlã, kaaju, kaaye amale odase, kaashishiu mɔ, wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ!’ ” Shi nuu lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ.” Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni etsui mɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ bo nɔ kome: Yaa ni oyahɔ̃ɔ nii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ ni okɛhã ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba ni obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” Shi nuu lɛ hiɛ tsake yɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ, ni eyiŋ etee kɛ dɔlɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Ni Yesu kwɛ ehewɔ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛna bɔ ni ewa hã niiatsɛmɛi akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!” Kaselɔi lɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ ewiemɔi lɛ ahe.
Shi Yesu here nɔ ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bii, te nyɛna bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ nii anɔ lɛ akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!
Ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ.” Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe naakpa, ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” Yesu kwɛ amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɛi agbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛŋ afee, shi jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ anyɛɔ nii fiaa afeɔ.” Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ mli nyɔmɔwoo Petro bɔ̃i lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi nii fiaa ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shĩa loo nyɛmimɛi hii loo nyɛmimɛi yei loo tsɛ loo nyɛ loo ŋa loo bii loo shikpɔji yɛ mi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ, ni enaŋ shĩai kɛ nyɛmimɛi hii kɛ nyɛmimɛi yei kɛ nyɛmɛi kɛ bii kɛ shikpɔji toi oha yɛ benɛbe nɛɛ mli beebe, kɛ yiwalɛ hu; ni jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ eeena naanɔ wala.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋbii pii aaatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpelɔi, ni sɛɛkpelɔi aaatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii.” Yesu wie egbele he nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ Ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni Yesu nyiɛ amɛhiɛ; kaselɔi lɛ ahe ejɔ̃ amɛhe, ni mɛi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ miishe gbeyei.
Ni eŋɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛtee afã ni ebɔ̃i amɛ nɔ ni baaba enɔ lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ adɛŋ, ni amɛaabu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛaaŋɔ lɛ amɛhã jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ.
Ni amɛaaye ehe fɛo, ni amɛaafɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛaashwie ehe, ni amɛkɛ kpelebii aaayi lɛ, ni amɛaagbe lɛ; ni gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eeete shi ekoŋŋ.” Yakobo kɛ Yohane nibimɔ lɛ Ni Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ, ba Yesu ŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wɔbaaba bo lɛ ofee ohã wɔ.” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ mifee mihã nyɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã wɔ hegbɛ koni wɔteŋ mɔ kome ata oninejurɔ nɔ ni mɔ kome hu ata obɛku nɔ yɛ onumnyam lɛ mli.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛleee nɔ ni nyɛbiɔ lɛ; ani nyɛaanyɛ kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛnu, aloo nyɛaanyɛ ni akɛ mibaptisimɔ lɛ abaptisi nyɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔɔnyɛ.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kpulu ni mibanu lɛ nyɛaanu, ni baptisimɔ ni akɛaabaptisi mi lɛ akɛaabaptisi nyɛ nɛ; shi mininejurɔ kɛ mibɛku nɔ tamɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ ni mikɛhãa, shi moŋ mɛi ni asaa ato lɛ anɔŋ.” Ni be ni mɛi nyɔŋma lɛ nu lɛ amɛmli wo Yakobo kɛ Yohane la.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle akɛ mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anɔyelɔi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni amɛteŋ gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ yɛ amɛnɔ hewalɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ agbo atsɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, efee ehe nyɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ nyɛteŋ onukpa atsɔ̃ lɛ, efee ehe mɛi fɛɛ atsulɔ.
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu baaa ni asɔ̃mɔ lɛ, shi sɔ̃ɔmɔ moŋ eba, koni eŋɔ esusuma ehã akɛ kpɔmɔnɔ yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ.” Yesu tsa Bartimeo shwilafo lɛ Ni amɛshɛ Yeriko.
Ni be ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ asafo yuu jɛ jɛi amɛyaa lɛ, Timeo bi Bartimeo, shwilafo nibalɔ lɛ, ta gbɛjegbɛ lɛ toi eebala nii.
Ni be ni enu akɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni lɛ, ebɔi blɔmɔ akɛ, “Yesu, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Ni mɛi pii fãmɔ lɛ akɛ emua enaa.
Shi ebolɔ babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Yesu wa damɔ shi ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛtsɛa lɛ kɛbaa!” Ni amɛtsɛ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Na tsui, tee shi, eetsɛ bo!” Ni eshɛ etade nɔhaa lɛ efɔ̃, ni ete shi pa, ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo?” Ni shwilafo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabuni, (eshishi ji Minuŋtsɔ), akɛ mana nii.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo.” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ Ni be ni amɛkɛɛ amɛbɛŋkɛɔ Yerusalɛm ni amɛshɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, Yesu tsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni jɛi ni nyɛaashɛ pɛ, nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tako enɔ dã ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi; nyɛfɛnea lɛ kɛbaa.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ enɛ?’ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi etsɛŋ ni eeetsu ni akɛ lɛ aba ekoŋŋ.’ ” Ni amɛtee amɛyana tejibi lɛ ni aŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ agbo naa yɛ blohu lɛ mli, ni amɛfɛne lɛ.
Mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ, tejibi lɛ nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ bɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ tejibi lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie enɔ, ni eho eta nɔ.
Ni mɛi pii kɛ amɛtadei hahaa gbɛ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi komɛi hu folɔ tsei aniji kɛjɛ ŋa lɛ mli ni amɛkɛshwie gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni mɛi ni nyiɛ hiɛ kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ bolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Hosiana!
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Ajɔɔ wɔtsɛ David maŋtsɛyeli ni baa lɛ!
Hosiana yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!” Ni ebote Yerusalɛm, ni etee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ni be ni ekwɛ nibii fɛɛ kɛkpe lɛ, akɛni je ena momo hewɔ lɛ, eje jɛi ni etee Betania kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Yesu lomɔ agbãmitso lɛ Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛjɛ Betania amɛbaa lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Ni ena agbãmitso ko yɛ shɔŋŋ ni bai yɔɔ yi, ni etee eyakwɛ akɛ aleenɔ eeena nɔ ko yɛ nɔ lo.
Shi be ni eshɛ he lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko akɛ ja bai kɛkɛ, ejaakɛ agbãmiwoobe shɛko.
Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ekɛɛ agbãmitso lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko yeŋ onɔ yibii dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ!” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ nu.
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shwiemɔ, ni etsirɛ shikatsakelɔi lɛ akplɔ̃i kɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ asɛii lɛ etswia shi, ni eŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko atere nɔ ko kɛtsɔ̃ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii ekɛɛ, “Ani aŋmako akɛ, ‘Aaatsɛ miwe lɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ aSɔlemɔ we?’ Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu!” Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ nu, ni amɛtao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkpãtã ehiɛ; shi amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei ejaakɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ naa kpɛɔ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he.
Shi kɛ shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ ejeɔ maŋ lɛ mli.
Agbãmi tso lɛ he nikasemɔ Ni leebi maŋkpa, be ni amɛhoɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ agbãmitso lɛ eŋãla kɛ eshishifã fɛɛ.
Ni Petro kai ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Rabi, naa, agbãmitso lɛ ni olomɔ lɛ eŋãla!” Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛyea!
Miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, mɔ ni aaakɛɛ gɔŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa ni oyagbee ŋshɔŋ!’ Ni ejeee ŋwane yɛ etsui mli, shi moŋ eheɔ eyeɔ akɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ, aaafee ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nii abɔ fɛɛ ni nyɛkpaa he fai yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔ mli lɛ, nyɛhea nyɛyea akɛ nyɛna, ni akɛaahã nyɛ.
Ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛsɔleɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛyɛ mɔ ko he sane ko lɛ, nyɛkɛfaa lɛ, koni nyɛŋwɛi-Tsɛ lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ afa nyɛ.
[ Shi kɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛfaaa lɛ, nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ hu kɛ nyɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ efaŋ nyɛ.”] Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ Ni amɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ.
Ni be ni Yesu nyiɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hegbɛ oyɔɔ hewɔ ofeɔ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ, aloo namɔ hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ ni okɛfee nibii nɛɛ?” Shi Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mabi nyɛ sane kome ni nyɛhã mi hetoo, koni matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni mikɛfeɔ nii nɛɛ.
Yohane Baptisimɔ lɛ ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ ejɛ?
Nyɛhãa mi hetoo!” Ni amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe yiyii akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeebi wɔ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?’ Ni kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ,” amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ buɔ Yohane gbalɔ lɛɛlɛŋ.
Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Wɔleee.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ, mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ hewɔ ni mifeɔ nibii nɛɛ mɔ.”
Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ bɔ̃i wiemɔ yɛ abɛbuai amli akɛ, “Nuu ko fee waintrom, ni efo afabaŋ ewo he; etsa wainbu, ni etswa mɔɔ yɛ mli, ni ekɛhã bulɔi apaayeli, ni edom.
Be ni shɛ wain kpamɔbe lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee hulɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyaŋɔ waintrom lɛ mli yibii lɛ eko yɛ amɛdɛŋ kɛba.
Shi amɛmɔ lɛ ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛŋ folo.
Esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ; ni amɛjwarajwaraa eyitso, ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi.
Asaŋ etsu mɔ kroko ekoŋŋ; ni lɛ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii hu; amɛyiyii mɛi komɛi, ni amɛgbegbee mɛi komɛi.
Agbɛnɛ eshwɛ mɔ kome pɛ ni ebaatsu, ebinuu ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Naagbee lɛ etsu lɛ hu amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Amɛhiɛ aaasɔ mibi lɛ.’ Shi nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛbaa ni nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ ni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ!’ Ni amɛmɔ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ, ni amɛwo lɛ yɛ waintrom lɛ mli amɛshɛ amɛfɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ baafee?
Eeeba ebakpãtã okwaafoi lɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã mɛi krokomɛi.
Ani nyɛkaneko nɛkɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ, ‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɔ̃ koŋtɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ enɛ jɛ, ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ yɛ wɔhiŋmɛiiaŋ?’ ” Ni amɛmiitao lɛ amɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ amɛhewɔ ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, shi amɛmiishe asafo lɛ gbeyei.
Ni amɛshi lɛ amɛtee.
Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ Ni atsu Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Herodebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ koni amɛbamɔ enaa enyɔŋ yɛ wiemɔ mli.
Ni be ni amɛba lɛ, amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ anɔkwafo ji bo, ni osheee gbɔmɔ ko gbeyei, ejaakɛ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli.
Ani eja akɛ atsuɔ onia ahãa Kaisare aloo ejaaa?
Wɔhã, aloo wɔkahã?” Shi ni eyoo amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ mi?
Nyɛkɛ denario abaa ni makwɛa.” Ni amɛkɛba.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mfoniri nɛ, ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare, ni nyɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ.” Ni ehe fee amɛ naakpɛɛ.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ Ni Sadukifoi ni kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ hu ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛ mɔ ko nyɛmi gbo ni eshi eŋa, shi eshiii bi lɛ, enyɛmi lɛ aŋɔ eŋa lɛ ni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi; ni onukpa lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi; mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ hu ŋɔ yoo lɛ, ni egbo, ni lɛ hu eshiii bi ko yɛ esɛɛ; ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yoo lɛ hi shi, ni amɛshiii bii yɛ amɛsɛɛ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo.
Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli, be ni amɛaate shi lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ̃, ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ hi shi?” Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee ŋmalɛi lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni nyɛleee lɛ hewɔ nyɛtɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ be ni amɛaate shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, hii lɛ eŋɔŋ yei, ni yei lɛ hu egbãŋ; shi moŋ amɛaatamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi.
Shi akɛ gbohii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ani nyɛkaneko yɛ Mose wolo lɛ mli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ŋmeitso lɛ he sane lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Mi lɛ Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ ji mi,’ lɛ?
Enɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiitɔ̃ babaoo.” Kitã wulu lɛ Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni nu akɛ amɛmiibibii lɛ saji lɛ hu ba, ni be ni ena akɛ ehã amɛ hetoo jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te nɔ ni ji kitãi lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ klɛŋklɛŋ nɔŋ?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji, Bo toi, Israel!
Nuŋtsɔ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ kome ni; ni suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ!
Kitã ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɛ, ‘Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.’ Kitã ko bɛ ni fe enɛɛmɛi.” Mlatsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ, Tsɔɔlɔ, anɔkwale okɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ yɔɔ, ni mɔ kroko bɛ, ja lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ; ni lɛ suɔmɔ kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ nilee fɛɛ kɛ susuma fɛɛ kɛ nyɛmɔ fɛɛ mli kɛ naanyo suɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ sumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, efe shãa afɔlei kɛ afɔlei fɛɛ.” Ni be ni Yesu na akɛ eto he yɛ nilee naa lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ teŋ jekɛɛɛ.” Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ Lɛ Ni be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ta mininejurɔ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi mafee onaneshi maaŋoo.’ David diɛŋtsɛ tsɛɔ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ; belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi hu?” Ni mɛi babaoo bo lɛ toi kɛ miishɛɛ.
Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ Ni ekɛɛ amɛ yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ atadei wuyawuyaa woo kɛ shisheramɔ kɛ jaanɔ ŋamɔi lɛ ahe; mlatsɔɔlɔi ni sumɔɔ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ, kɛ okplɔ̃ yitso tamɔ yɛ niyeniiashi; amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛsɔleɔ sɔlemɔi kakadaji amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi; amɛfɔbuu lɛ aaafe nine!” Yoo okulafo lɛ onia lɛ Ni Yesu yata shikatoohe lɛ ŋlɛnɔ eekwɛ bɔ ni mɛi lɛ kɛ shika woɔ onia adeka lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni niiatsɛmɛi pii kɛ babaoo wo mli.
Ni yoo okulafo ko hu ba ni ekɛ kapɛji enyɔ ni shɛɛɛ pesewa bawo mli.
Ni etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nɛkɛ okulafo ohiafo nɛɛ kɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ni kɛ eko ebawo adeka lɛ mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛna ni eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo mli; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ ehia mli ni ekɛlɛɔ ehe lɛ fɛɛ ekɛbawo mli nɛɛ.”
Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ Be ni Yesu jeɔ kpo yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kwɛ tɛi kɛ tsui kpelekplei!” Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oona nɛkɛ tsui kpeteŋkplei nɛɛ?
Ashiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ atswaŋ shi.” Amanehului ashishijee Ni be ni eta shi yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ŋlɛnɔ lɛ, Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea bi lɛ yɛ afã nigii akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ be mli ni aaafee nii nɛɛ, ni kɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ kwa aaaba mli lɛ, mɛni ji ehe okadi?” Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni mɔ ko akalaka nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migbɛi mli, ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji lɛ!’ Ni amɛaalaka mɛi pii.
Shi kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ tai asaji ahe lɛ, nyɛkahaoa, ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ba mli, shi asaŋ naagbee lɛ shɛko.
Maŋ aaate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyeli aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli, ni shikpɔŋhosomɔi aaaba yɛ hei srɔtoi, ni hɔmɔ aaaba.
Enɛɛmɛi ji kɔ̃ɔmɔi abɔ̃imɔ.
“Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ, ejaakɛ amɛaaŋɔ nyɛ kɛaatee gwabɔi amli, ni aaayi nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ, ni akɛ nyɛ aaadamɔ lumɛi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi ahiɛ yɛ mihewɔ koni nyɛye odase nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni ja ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji fɛɛ dã.
Shi kɛ amɛkpala nyɛ kɛtee amɛyahã lɛ, nyɛkahaoa nyɛhe nyɛto yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawie hewɔ; shi moŋ nɔ ni akɛaahã nyɛ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, no nyɛwiea; ejaakɛ jeee nyɛ nyɛwieɔ lɛ, shi moŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni.
Shi nyɛmi aaaŋɔ nyɛmi ahã gbele, ni tsɛ hu kɛ bi aaahã; ni bii aaate shi awo amɛfɔlɔi, ni amɛkɛ amɛ aaahã ni agbe amɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; shi mɔ ni hiɛɔ mli kɛwulaa shi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.” Amanehulu kpeteŋkple lɛ “Shi kɛ nyɛna amaŋfɔ̃ nihiinii lɛ akɛ ema he ni esaaa akɛ emaa lɛ, (mɔ ni kaneɔ lɛ, ayoo sɛɛ), no lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ anɔ; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ lɛ akakpleke shi aloo ebote shĩa eyakɔ nɔ ko; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi lɛ ekaku esɛɛ eyakɔ etade.
Shi kpoo hã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ mɛi ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ!
Shi nyɛsɔlea koni enɛ akaba yɛ fɛ̃ibe mli!
Ejaakɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ amanehulu aaaba ni anãko enɔ dã kɛjɛ jeŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ shishijee mli aahu kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, ni asaŋ anaŋ enɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ni ja Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fo gbii lɛ anɔ, kɛjeee nakai lɛ ahereŋ heloo ko heloo ko yiwala; shi mɛi ni ehala lɛ ahewɔ lɛ eeefo gbii lɛ anɔ.
“Ni no mli lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, Kristo lɛ yɛ biɛ!’ Aloo, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ!’ lɛ, nyɛkahea nyɛyea, ejaakɛ amale kristoi kɛ amale gbalɔi aaate shi ni amɛaafee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii koni kɛ aaaho lɛ, amɛlaka mɛi ni ahala lɛ tete.
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ; mikɛɛ nyɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mito.” Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa “Shi no bei lɛ amli yɛ amanehulu nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, hulu hiɛ aaawo duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere hu kpɛŋ; ni ŋulamii aaatserɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi atswia shi, ni aaahoso hewalɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, aaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eeba yɛ atatuiaŋ kɛ hewalɛ kpele kɛ anunyam babaoo.
