No ni eeetsu ebɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛaabua mɛi ni ehala lɛ anaa kɛaajɛ kɔɔyɔi ejwɛ lɛ anɔ, kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ naagbeehe kɛyashi ŋwɛi naagbeehe.” Agbãmitso he nikasemɔ “Nyɛkasea agbãmitso he abɛ ni ebuɔ lɛ.
Kɛ shɛ be ni eniji efrɔke ni eefu baa lɛ, nyɛle akɛ latsaabe lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛna akɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ miiba mli lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ eshɛ agboi anaa etã.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, ja nii nɛɛ fɛɛ eba mli dã.
Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ baaho aya, shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.” Mɔ ko leee gbi lɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ “Shi no gbi lɛ loo ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mɔ ko leee; ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ leee, ni Bi lɛ hu leee, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni be lɛ shɛɔ.
Etamɔ nuu ko ni edom eshi ewe, ni ehã etsuji lɛ hegbɛ kɛ amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ enitsumɔ, ni efã agbonaakwɛlɔ lɛ akɛ ebu.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa; ejaakɛ nyɛleee beyinɔ ni shĩatsɛ lɛ baa, ekolɛ gbɛkɛ, loo nyɔɔŋteŋ, loo wuɔgbɛɛmɔ, loo leebi; koni ekaba trukaa ebana nyɛ akɛ nyɛmiiwɔ.
Nɔ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ, mɛi fɛɛ mikɛɔ, Nyɛsaraa!”
Ato Yesu yinɔ apam Be ni eshwɛ gbii enyɔ ni ayeɔ Hehoo kɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛmɔ Yesu yɛ ŋaa mli ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, koni basabasafeemɔ akaba maŋ lɛ mli.” Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania Be ni Yesu yɔɔ Betania yɛ Simon, kpitiyelɔ lɛ, we lɛ ni eta niyeniiashi lɛ, yoo ko ni hiɛ alabastro tɔ ni nardo mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jara wa naakpa yɔɔ mli ba; ni ejwa alabastro tɔ lɛ, ni efɔse mu lɛ eshwie Yesu yiteŋ.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ amli wo la ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ ni afite mu lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ kulɛ nɛkɛ mu nɛɛ, aaanyɛ ahɔ̃ɔ ana fe denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛhã ohiafoi!” Ni amɛwie yoo lɛ he huhuuhu.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a lɛ hiɛmɔ!
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛhaoɔ lɛ?
Etsu nitsumɔ fɛɛfɛo ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa, ni be fɛɛ be ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛaanyɛ amɛ ejurɔ nyɛfee; shi mi lɛ jeee daa mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Efee nɔ ni ebaanyɛ; etsɔ̃ hiɛ ebafɔ migbɔmɔtso lɛ mu eto mifuu.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, he fɛɛ he ni aaashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, aaagba nɔ ni yoo nɛɛ efee nɛɛ hu akɛkai lɛ.” Yuda kpɛlɛ̃ nɔ akɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ Kɛkɛ ni Yuda Iskariot, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, yiŋ etee osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ koni eyatsɔ̃ɔ amɛ Yesu sɛɛgbɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ be ni amɛnu lɛ amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika.
Hewɔ lɛ, etao bɔ ni eeefee ni ehã amɛnine ashɛ enɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ anaagbee niyenii Akpiti Gbii Juji lɛ amli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ, be ni agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ, Yesu kaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa nii wɔto wɔhã bo ni oye Hehoo lɛ yɛ?” Ni etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli, ni nuu ko ni hiɛ nu kɛ kpulu kɛ nyɛ aaakpe; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ; ni he ni eeeyabote lɛ, nyɛkɛa shĩatsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ, nɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mikɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?’ Ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛi asa kpeteŋkple ko ni awula mli ni asaa jɛi; nyɛsaa nii nyɛtoa wɔ yɛ jɛi.” Ni ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee maŋ lɛ mli ni amɛyana bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Ni be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tee jɛi.
Be ni amɛtara shi amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ kome ni kɛ mi miiye nii baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” Ni amɛbɔ̃i ŋkɔmɔyeli kɛ lɛ bimɔ ekomekome akɛ, “Miŋ lo?” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ komeŋ, mɔ nine ni kɛ minine kpeɔ yɛ kã lɛ mli lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ!
Faŋ nɔ ni anaaa afɔ nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ.” Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ shishitoo Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, Yesu kɔ aboloo, ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea!
Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso lɛ.” Ni ewo kpulu lɛ ni eda shi, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu eko.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ji milá ni ji kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ ni afɔse ashwie shi yɛ mɛi pii ahewɔ lɛ.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni manu lɛ ehee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Ni be ni amɛla yijiemɔ lala ko lɛ, amɛje kpo amɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Matswa tookwɛlɔ lɛ nɔ, ni toi lɛ aaagbɛ ashwã.’ Shi mishitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ matsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛaatee Galilea.” Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ nane aaatɔ̃tɔ̃ tete lɛ, mi lɛ minane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo yɛ anɔkwale mli akɛ; ŋmɛnɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃.” Shi Petro wie kɛ ekãa fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji gbo mikɛ bo aaagbo tete lɛ, mikpãŋ yɛ osɛɛ!” Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Yesu yɛ Getsemane Ni amɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Getsemane lɛ, ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtaraa biɛ koni mayasɔle dã.” Ni eŋɔ Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane efata ehe, ni ehe bɔ̃i kpokpomɔ kɛ haomɔ; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Misusuma werɛ eho ehe kɛyaashi gbele mli po; nyɛhia biɛ ni nyɛshia kpe!” Ni etee ehiɛ fioo, ni eho ebu shi, ni esɔle koni kɛ aaaho lɛ; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ aho ehe; ni ekɛɛ, “Abba, Ataa!
Onyɛɔ nii fɛɛ ofeɔ; jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ yɛ minɔ; shi kɛ̃lɛ, jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ!” Ni eba ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ, ni ekɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Simon, wɔ owɔɔ?
Onyɛ̃ɛɛ kpe oshi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome?
Nyɛshia kpe ni nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli.
Mumɔ lɛ miikpɛlɛ moŋ, shi heloo lɛ he waaa.” Ni eyiŋ etee ekoŋŋ ni eyasɔle, ni ewie nakai wiemɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni eku esɛɛ eba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebana akɛ amɛwɔ ejaakɛ amɛhiŋmɛii etsii, ni amɛleee nɔ hetoo ni amɛhãa lɛ.
Ni eba nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe ejɔ nyɛ ni nyɛwɔɔ lolo nɛɛ?
Efa!
Ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, naa, aaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aawo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ.
Nyɛtea shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa; naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ eshɛ shi etã.” Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ emɔmɔ Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ; Yuda, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ, ba kɛ mɛi babaoo ni jɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ ni hiɛ klantei kɛ tsei.
Shi sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ ehã amɛ okadi ko akɛ, “Mɔ naa ni mashwɔ lɛ, lɛ ni; nyɛmɔa lɛ ni nyɛkpalaa lɛ kɛyaa shweshweeshwe.” Ni be ni Yuda shɛ shi nɔŋŋ pɛ ni eba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Rabi!” Ni eshwɔ enaa.
Ni amɛbashwie enɔ ni amɛmɔ lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome gbala eklante, ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, ni efo etoi.
Ni Yesu fã enaa ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mimɔmɔ nyɛbaa kɛ klantei kɛ tsei tamɔ amɔɔ ojotswalɔ nɛɛ?
Daa ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, nyɛmɔɔɔ mi; shi bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛi lɛ ana aba mli hewɔŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ jo foi amɛshi lɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko ni kɛ klala ekete eyayaiaŋ nyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛmɔ lɛ; shi eshi klala lɛ ni ejo foi kɛ ehe yayai.
Yesu yɛ Gwabɔɔ wulu lɛ hiɛ Ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ eŋɔɔ.
Ni Petro nyiɛ esɛɛ flɛŋŋ kɛyabote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ kpo te lɛ mli, ni ekɛ tsuji lɛ yatara shi, ni ewere la.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ akwaashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tao Yesu he odase ko ni amɛwo lɛ gbee, shi amɛnaaa eko, ejaakɛ mɛi pii ye amale odase amɛshi lɛ moŋ nɛ; shi amɛdasei lɛ yeee hegbɔ.
Ni mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛye amale odase amɛshi lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi lɛ makumɔ Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ ni akɛ niji fee lɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mamã ekroko ni jeee niji akɛfee.’ ” Shi no tete hu, amɛdasei lɛ yeee hegbɔ.
Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi damɔ shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ebi Yesu akɛ, “Otooo he eko?
Mɛɛ odase mɛnɛɛmɛi yeɔ shiɔ bo nɛɛ?” Shi etswaaa esɛŋ ni etooo he eko.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ saa bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Kristo, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ Bi lɛ lo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Miŋ; ni nyɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ akɛ eta Ofe lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ ni eeba yɛ ŋwɛi atatui lɛ amli.” Shi osɔfonukpa lɛ gbala etadei ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ odasefoi wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ dɔŋŋ?
Nyɛnu emusubɔɔ lɛ; te nyɛjwɛŋɔ tɛŋŋ?” Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛbu lɛ fɔ akɛ esa gbele.
Ni mɛi komɛi bɔ̃i lajɔ̃fɛɛ kɛ ehe shwiemɔ, ni amɛfi ehiɛ, ni amɛyi lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbaa!” Ni tsuji lɛ shwie enɔ kɛ ma.
Petro kwa Yesu Be ni Petro yɔɔ shishi lɛ yɛ mɔɔ kpo te lɛ mli lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ weyei lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, ni be ni ena Petro ni eewere la lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Te bo hu okɛ Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ yɔɔ?” Shi etso ekɛɛ, “Mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ, ni minaaa shishi tete.” Ni eje kpo etee koi lɛ shi, kɛkɛ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni oblayoo lɛ na lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni esaa ebɔ̃i mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Amɛteŋ mɔ kome nɛ!” Shi Petro tso ekoŋŋ.
Ni fee sɛɛ fioo lɛ mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ kɛɛ Petro ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mli lɛ, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ji bo, ejaakɛ Galileanyo ji bo.” Kɛkɛ ni ebɔ̃i loomɔ kɛ kitãkãmɔ akɛ, “Mileee gbɔmɔ ni nyɛwieɔ ehe nɛɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ wuɔ gbɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ; ni Petro kai wiemɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ shii enyɔ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃” lɛ.
Ni be ni ekai lɛ, efo aahu.
Yesu yɛ Pilato hiɛ Ni be ni je kɛɛ etsɛreɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ akwaashɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ tee ajina, ni amɛfi Yesu, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛyahã Pilato.
Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ folɔ enaa pii.
Ni Pilato bi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Otooo he eko?
Kwɛ onaa sɔŋŋ ni amɛfolɔɔ.” Shi Yesu etooo he eko dɔŋŋ, ni Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ Shi daa kɛshɛ Gbijurɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɔ gboklɛfonyo kome ni amɛbiɔ lɛ he ehãa amɛ.
Shi mɔ ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Baraba ni awo lɛ niiaŋ kɛ atuatselɔi ni gbe gbɔmɔ yɛ atuatsemɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni asafo lɛ ba babɔ̃i lɛ faikpamɔ akɛ efee tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ daa lɛ ehã amɛ.
Shi Pilato here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?” Ejaakɛ ele akɛ hetsɛ̃ naa ni osɔfonukpai lɛ mɔ lɛ hã lɛ.
Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ wo asafo lɛ yiŋ akɛ amɛhã eŋmɛɛ Baraba moŋ he ehã amɛ.
Ni Pilato saa here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mifee mɔ ni nyɛtsɛɔ lɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mɔ?” Shi amɛbolɔ ekoŋŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Ni Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Shi mɛɛ efɔŋ po efee?” Shi amɛbolɔ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Ni akɛni Pilato taoɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni asafo lɛ taoɔ hewɔ lɛ, eŋmɛɛ Baraba he ehã amɛ; ni Yesu lɛ, ekɛ kpelebii yi lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ hã ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Asraafoi lɛ ye Yesu he fɛo Ni asraafoi lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee amralo mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛtsɛ asraafoiaku muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛbakpe.
Ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko, ni amɛfee ŋmei akekre amɛkɛfi eyitso.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i lɛ ŋamɔ akɛ, “Oshwiee, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ.” Ni amɛkɛ tso tswia eyiteŋ, ni amɛfɛ̃ lajɔ̃ amɛshwie ehe, ni amɛkula shi amɛja lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛyeyee ehe fɛo lɛ, amɛ jie atade tsuru lɛ yɛ ehe, ni amɛkɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etadei lɛ wo lɛ, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee ni amɛyasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele Ni asraafoi lɛ nyɛ Simon Kirenenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ ni ji Aleksandro kɛ Rufo tsɛ lɛ nɔ akɛ ewo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ.
Ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi Golgota lɛ, eshishi ji Yitsoŋoŋohe.
Ni amɛhã lɛ wain ni akɛ mire efutuŋ akɛ enu; shi enuuu.
Ni be ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ, amɛja etadei lɛ amli, ni amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki, nɔ ni mɔ akɔ.
Shi ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ.
Ni aŋma sane ni akɛfɔ̃ enɔ lɛ yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ.” Ni amɛsɛŋ ojotswalɔi enyɔ amɛfata ehe, mɔ kome ye eninejurɔ, ni mɔ kome ye ebɛku.
[ Ni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Ni abu lɛ ashi efɔŋfeelɔi anɔ” lɛ ba mli.]
Ni mɛi ni hoɔ lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi lɛ, ni amɛhoso amɛyitsei ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ei, bo ni okumɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ni osaa omaa lɛ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ nɛ!
Heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala, ni oje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ okpeleke shi!” Nakai nɔŋŋ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Ehere mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ehere; Kristo, Israel maŋtsɛ lɛ, aje sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ akpeleke shi koo, koni wɔna ni wɔhe wɔye!” Ni mɛi ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ hu bɔ lɛ ahora.
Ni be ni shɛ ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli.
Ni ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Eloi, Eloi, lama Sabaktani?” Eshishi ji, “MiNyɔŋmɔ, miNyɔŋmɔ, mɛɛba okwa mi?” Ni be ni mɛi ni damɔ jɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi nu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Naa, eetsɛ Elia.” Ni mɔ ko sha foi ni eyaŋɔ ŋshɔŋ kotsa etsɔ ashiŋ mli, ni ekɛma tso naa ehã lɛ akɛ enu ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔmɛa ni wɔkwɛ akɛ Elia aaabajie lɛ lo.” Ni Yesu bo waa ni ebu enaa.
Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba enyɔ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbayi shi.
Shi be ni asraafoiohaatsɛ ni damɔ eŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ na akɛ ebo nɛkɛ ni ebu enaa lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ni!” Ni yei komɛi hu yɛ jɛi ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yakobofio kɛ Yose nyɛ lɛ, kɛ Salome, mɛi ni be ni eyɔɔ Galilea ni amɛnyiɛɔ esɛɛ ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ, kɛ yei krokomɛi pii ni kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Yesu fuu Ni be ni shɛ gbɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni eji Hesaamɔ gbi ni nyiɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ hiɛ hewɔ lɛ, Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia, ni ji akwaashɔŋnyo ko ni yɔɔ gbɛi ni lɛ hu ekwɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛ lɛ, ba ni ekɛ ekãa yiŋ kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi Yesu gbonyo lɛ.
Shi Pilato hiɛ fee lɛ yaa akɛ egbo momo; ni etsɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ ni ebi lɛ akɛ egbo etsɛ lo?
Ni be ni enu kɛjɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛ gbonyo lɛ ke Yosef.
Ni Yosef yahe klala, ni ebajie lɛ kɛkpeleke shi, ni ekɛ klala lɛ ha ehe, ni ekɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli lɛ mli, ni ekoklo tɛ ekɛŋa bu lɛ naa.
Ni Maria Magdalena kɛ Maria, Yose nyɛ lɛ, miikwɛ, ni amɛna he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ lɛ.
Yesu shitee Ni be ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eho lɛ, Maria Magdalena kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ Salome yahe tsofai-kɛ-ŋma koni amɛba ni amɛkɛbakpa lɛ.
Ni otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maŋkpa, be ni hulu jeɔ lɛ, amɛba bu lɛ naa.
Ni amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Namɔ aaakoklo tɛ lɛ yɛ bu lɛ naa ahã wɔ?” Shi be ni amɛyaawo amɛhiɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ ni da naakpa lɛ kɛtee sɛɛ.
Ni be ni amɛbote bu lɛ mli lɛ, amɛna oblanyo ko ta ninejurɔgbɛ ni ewo atade yɛŋ kakadaŋŋ; ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei!
Nyɛmiitao Yesu Nazarenyo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ; ete shi, ebɛ biɛ; naa, he ni akɛ lɛ ŋmɛ nɛ!
Shi nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ Petro akɛ eetsɔ̃ nyɛhiɛ kɛmiiya Galilea; jɛi nyɛaana lɛ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.” Ni amɛje kpo, ni amɛjo foi kɛjɛ bu lɛ he; amɛhe kpokpo, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe; ni amɛkɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ ko, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe gbeyei.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Maria Magdalena [ Shi be ni Yesu te shi leebi maŋkpa yɛ otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ tsutsu ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ji Maria Magdalena, mɔ mli hu ni efã mumɔi fɔ̃ji kpawo yɛ lɛ.
Ni lɛ etee eyagba mɛi ni kɛ lɛ hi shi ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ lɛ.
Shi amɛ lɛ, be ni amɛnu akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ena lɛ lɛ, amɛheee amɛyeee.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi enyɔ Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo yɛ su kroko mli etsɔ̃ɔ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, be ni amɛsharaa shi kɛyaa kosɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛ hu amɛyiŋ amɛtee amɛyakɛɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi amɛheee nomɛi hu tete amɛyeee.
Sanekpakpa lɛ tuu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ adɛŋ woo Fee sɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, be ni amɛtara niyenii ashi lɛ, ni ekã amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee kɛ amɛtsuiwalɛ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛheee mɛi ni na lɛ yɛ eshitee lɛ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyeee.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa je lɛ mli fɛɛ kwa nyɛyashiɛa Sanekpakpa lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni abɔ lɛ.
Mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ ni aaabaptisi lɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, aaabu lɛ fɔ.
Shi okadi ni aaanyiɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ asɛɛ nɛ, migbɛi mli lɛ amɛaafãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji; amɛaawie wiemɔi hei; amɛaahole onufui anɔ; ni kɛji amɛnu nɔ ko ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ, efeŋ amɛ nɔ ko; amɛkɛ amɛniji aaashwie helatsɛmɛi anɔ, ni amɛhe aaawa amɛ.” Yesu ŋwɛiyaa Kɛkɛ ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ amɛ ewie sɛɛ lɛ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛ lɛ, amɛje jɛi, ni amɛyashiɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ amɛ tsu nii, ni ekɛ okadii ni fata wiemɔ lɛ he lɛ wo wiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ.]
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ gbaa akɛ Yesu lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni awo shi ato akɛ ebaaba ebahere Israelbii lɛ ayiwala ni ebakpɔ̃ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Luka wolo lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ tsu lɛ ni ebashiɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔɔ ohiafoi .
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa nɛɛ eyi obɔ̃ kɛ mɛi atutɔmɔi kɛ amɛhiamɔnii ahe nitsumɔ.
Nɛkɛ miishɛɛ sane nɛɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ mli.
Hei ni anaa enɛ yɛ titri ji yitsei ni jeɔ wolo lɛ shishi ni tswaa Yesu baa lɛ he adafi lɛ kɛ agbɛnɛ hu wolo lɛ naagbee ni wieɔ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa he lɛ.
Mɔ ni gba bɔ ni fee ni egbɛ eshwã yɛ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋma Bɔfoi lɛ asaji lɛ.
Wolo nɛɛ hiɛ mlijai enyɔ , ni nibii ahe ni amɛwieɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa nɛɛ pɛ mli anaa yɛ.
Nɔkwɛmɔnii ji .
Saji ni kɔɔ bɔfoi lɛ alalai ahe lɛ.
.
Tookwɛlɔi lɛ ni ba amɛbasra Yesu be ni afɔ lɛ lɛ.
.
Be ni Yesu yapue yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ gbekɛ nuu lɛ.
.
Abɛbuaŋ wiemɔi ni kɔɔ (a) Samarianyo Mɔbɔnalɔ lɛ kɛ (b) Bi ni laaje (aloo Bi nyenyeŋtswi) lɛ he lɛ.
Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Sanekpakpa lɛ maa nɔ mi veveeve ji (a) Sɔlemɔ.
(b) Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ (d) Yei ahe sane yɛ Yesu nitsumɔ mli (e) Fa ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ahe eshai faa amɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu fɔmɔ kɛ amɛgbekɛbiiashi saji .—.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ nitsumɔ .- Yesu baptisimɔ kɛ ekaa .—.
Yesu nitsumɔ yɛ Galilea .—.
Kɛjɛ Galilea kɛtee Yerusalɛm .—.
Naagbee otsi yɛ Yerusalɛm .—.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehe kpojiemɔ kɛ eŋwɛiyaa .-
Akɛni mɛi pii ekɔ efɔ̃ amɛnɔ akɛ amɛaaŋma saji ni eba mli yɛ wɔteŋ tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi ni na kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii kɛjɛ shishijee mli ni amɛ ji wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ jaje tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, Teofilo jurɔ, esa mihiɛ akɛ mi hu ni mitao nibii fɛɛ mli fitsofitso kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ, maŋma pɛpɛɛpɛ maha bo koni ona anɔkwale ni yɔɔ nii ni atsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ mli.
Agba Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ fɔmɔ ato Yudea Maŋtsɛ Herode yinɔ lɛ osɔfo ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakaria; ejɛ Abia osɔfoiaku lɛ mli, eŋa jɛ Aaron biyei lɛ ateŋ, ni egbɛi ji Elizabet.
Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jalɔi ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni amɛyeɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitãi kɛ ekpɔi lɛ fɛɛ anɔ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ amɛhe.
Shi amɛbɛ bi, ejaakɛ Elizabet lɛ kene ni, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛdara.
Shi gbi ko be ni eshɛ esɔfoiaku lɛ nɔ, ni esɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ahala lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni esɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ gbɛnaa yɔɔ lɛ, koni ebote Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni eyashã tsofakɛŋma.
Ni tsofakɛŋmashãa be lɛ mli lɛ, maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ miisɔle yɛ agbo lɛ naa.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ni edamɔ tsofakɛŋmashãa latɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Ni be ni Zakaria na lɛ lɛ, etsui fã ni gbeyei mɔ lɛ.
Shi bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Zakaria, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebo ofaikpamɔ lɛ toi, ni oŋa Elizabet aaafɔ binuu ahã bo, ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yohane.
Eeehã ona miishɛɛ, ni omli aafli bo, ni mɛi pii aaanya efɔmɔ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ eeetsɔ̃ agbo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni enuŋ wain loo dãa ni wa ko, Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaayi lɛ obɔ̃ kɛaajɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe.
Ni eeekpale Israelbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛaaba Nuŋtsɔ, amɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ; ŋɔɔ.
Ni eeetsɔ̃ ehiɛ yɛ Elia mumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ mli, ni eyadɔrɔ tsɛmɛi atsuii kɛba bii ahe, kɛ toigbolɔi hu kɛba jalɔi anilee mli, ni esaa maŋ ni efee klalo eto Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.” Ni Zakaria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni mikɛaale enɛ?
Mi lɛ nuumo ji mi, ni miŋa hu egbɔ.” Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ, “Mi ji Gabriel ni damɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, ni atsu mi akɛ mikɛ bo abawie ni migba bo sane kpakpa nɛɛ.
Ni naa, oootɔ mu ni onyɛŋ owie kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni nii nɛɛ aaaba mli, ejaakɛ oheee miwiemɔ lɛ ni baaba mli kɛ be shɛ lɛ oyeee.” Ni maŋ lɛ miimɛ Zakaria, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ etsɛ nɛkɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi be ni eje kpo lɛ, enyɛɛɛ ekɛ amɛ awie, ni amɛyoo sɛɛ akɛ eyana nii yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli; ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ekɛ enine fee okadi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etɔ mu lolo.
Be ni egbe esɔ̃ɔmɔ gbii lɛ naa lɛ, eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Shi nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ eŋa Elizabet na musu, ni etee ehe nyɔji enumɔ ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ efee mi nɛ akɛ agbɛnɛ ekwɛ ni ejie mihiɛgbele lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ.” Agba Yesu fɔmɔ ato Shi nyɔŋ ni ji ekpaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu bɔfo Gabriel kɛtee Galilea maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nazaret lɛ mli ni ekɛ wiemɔ ayahã oblayoo foro ko ni atsɛ ehe baa ahã nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef ni jɛ David we lɛ; oblayoo lɛ gbɛi ji Maria.
Ni bɔfo lɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã bo, bo ni aduro bo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ bo yɛ.” Etsui fã yɛ bɔfo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ he, ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, “Mɛɛ ŋamɔ po nɛ!” Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Maria; ejaakɛ ohiɛ eba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni naa, obaana musu, ni ooofɔ binuu ni ooowo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu.
Eeetsɔ̃ agbo, ni aaatsɛ lɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ Bi, ni Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ etsɛ David maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni eeeye Yakob we lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔ.
Ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ efoŋ.” Shi Maria kɛɛ bɔfo lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enɛ aaaba mli, akɛni mileee nuu nɛɛ?” Ni bɔfo lɛ to he ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaaba onɔ.
Ni Ŋwɛinyo lɛ hewalɛ aaabaha onɔ, No hewɔ lɛ, nakai bi krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni ooofɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.
Shi naa, owekunyo Elizabet lɛ hu, ena binuu musu yɛ egbɔlɛ mli, ni mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ kene lɛ ena nyɔji ekpaa.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ afee.” Ni Maria kɛɛ, “Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ weyoo ji mi; bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ aba mli nakai ahã mi!” Ni bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ etee.
Maria yasara Elizabet Ni yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ Maria kɛ oyaiyeli yiŋ kɛtee Yuda maŋ ko mli yɛ gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni eyabote Zakaria we lɛ ni eŋa Elizabet.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Elizabet nu Maria ŋamɔ lɛ, abifao lɛ tu yɛ Elizabet musuŋ; ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yi Elizabet obɔ̃; ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ bo yɛ yei ateŋ, ni ajɔɔ omusuŋbi lɛ!
Ni nɛgbɛ mina nyam nɛɛ kɛjɛ akɛ miNuŋtsɔ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ nɛɛ?
Shi naa, amrɔ pɛ ni oŋamɔ lɛ gbɛɛ yɛ mitoiŋ lɛ, abifao lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ tu yɛ mimusuŋ.
Ni ajɔɔ bo, bo ni ohe oye akɛ wiemɔi ni ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ aaaba mli lɛ.” Maria yijiemɔ lala lɛ Ni Maria kɛɛ, “Misusuma miikafo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni mimumɔ mli miifili lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hewɔ, akɛ ebakwɛ mi eweyoo ni ji humi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ naa, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, yinɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaabu mi akɛ mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ Ofe lɛ efee nii wuji ehã mi; ni krɔŋkrɔŋ ji egbɛi lɛ.
Emɔbɔnalɛ yɛ mɛi ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei lɛ anɔ kɛyashi yinɔi ayinɔi.
Ekɛ enine etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi; mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛtsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ mli lɛ egbɛ amɛ eshwã.
Ekpa ojei kɛjɛ amɛsɛ̃ii anɔ, ni ewo mɛi ni ji humii lɛ anɔ.
Ehã mɛi ni hɔmɔ yeɔ amɛ etɔrɔ kɛ nii kpakpai, ni niiatsɛmɛi lɛ eshwie amɛ efolo.
Eye ebua ewenuu Israel, koni ekai emɔbɔnalɛ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni yɔɔ hã Abraham kɛ eshwiei lɛ kɛya naanɔ.” Ni Maria kɛ lɛ hi shi aaafee nyɔji etɛ̃ ni eku esɛɛ etee eshĩa.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ fɔmɔ Agbɛnɛ Elizabet fɔmɔ be shɛ, ni efɔ binuu.
Ni ekuu lɛ mli bii kɛ ewekumɛi lɛ nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ babaoo, ni amɛkɛ lɛ nya.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛba gbekɛ lɛ ketiafoo, ni kulɛ amɛmiitao amɛkɛ etsɛ gbɛi Zakaria lɛ awo lɛ.
Shi enyɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabida, abaatsɛ lɛ Yohane moŋ!” Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko bɛ owɛku lɛ mli ni atsɛɔ lɛ nakai!” Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛnine fee okadi kɛbi etsɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ.
Ni ebi tao ko, ni eŋma akɛ, “Yohane ji egbɛi.” Ni efee amɛ fɛɛ naakpɛɛ.
Amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaabu gbele ni elilɛi fɛne, ni ewie ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.
Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛkuu lɛ mli bii lɛ fɛɛ, ni agba saji nɛɛ fɛɛ yɛ Yudea gɔji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ kɛto amɛtsuiŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni po gbekɛ nɛɛ baatsɔ̃?” Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã ehe.
Zakaria jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi Ni etsɛ Zakaria yi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni egba ekɛɛ, “Ajie Nuŋtsɔ, Israel Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, akɛ ebasara emaŋ lɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ amɛ.
Ni etee walaheremɔ aklonto shi ehã wɔ yɛ etsulɔ David we lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni etsɔ̃ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ anɔ ewie lɛ; akɛ eeehere wɔyiwala kɛaajɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni he tsɛ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ adɛŋ.
Ni ena wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amɔbɔ ni ekai ekpãŋmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Kitã ni ekã wɔtsɛ Abraham lɛ, akɛ eeehã ajie wɔ yɛ wɔhenyɛlɔi adɛŋ ni wɔsɔmɔ lɛ ni gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ mli yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ jalɛ mli yɛ ehiɛ wɔgbii abɔ fɛɛ.
Ni bo, gbekɛ nɛɛ, aaatsɛ bo Ŋwɛifloflonyo lɛ gbalɔ; ejaakɛ obaatsɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ ni oyasaa egbɛi lɛ oto, koni okɛ walaheremɔ he nilee ahã omaŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshaifaa ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ni hãa emusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ lɛ mli.
No hewɔ ni jetsɛremɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ ebasara wɔ lɛ.
Koni ehã jeŋ atse ahã mɛi ni tara duŋ kɛ gbele hɔɔŋ mli lɛ, Ni akudɔ wɔnaji kɛya hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.” Ni gbekɛ lɛ bada, ni ehe wa yɛ mumɔ mli, ni ehi ŋa lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni akɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Israel.
Yesu fɔmɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ akpɔ ko jɛ Kaisare Augusto ŋɔɔ ba, akɛ akane jeŋ fɛɛ ni aŋma.
Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ kanemɔ ni akane be mli ni Kirenio yeɔ amralo yɛ Siria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ tee amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ koni aŋma amɛgbɛi.
Ni Yosef hu jɛ Nazaret maŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea, ni etee David maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betlehem yɛ Yudea lɛ mli; ejaakɛ ejɛ David we kɛ eweku lɛ mli.
Etee koni aŋma ekɛ Maria, yoo ni etsɛ ehe baa ni hiɛ musu lɛ, gbɛi.
Be ni amɛyɔɔ Betlehem lɛ ebe shɛ ni ebaafɔ.
Ni efɔ binuu ni ji ekromɔbi lɛ, ni ekɛ mama bla ehe ni ekɛ lɛ ŋmɛ kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa gbɛ yɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ Tookwɛlɔi komɛi yɛ ŋa nɔ yɛ jɛi niiaŋ ni amɛmiishi kpe kɛmiibu amɛtoi ahe nyɔɔŋ.
Trukaa lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam kpɛ kɛbɔle amɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkashea gbeyei; ejaakɛ naa, mibagba nyɛ miishɛɛ sane kpeteŋkple ni ji maŋ fɛɛ nɔ; akɛ ŋmɛnɛ afɔ walaherelɔ ni ji Kristo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ahã nyɛ, yɛ David maŋ lɛ mli.
Enɛ afee okadi ahã nyɛ, nyɛaana abifao ni akɛ mama ebala ehe ni ekã kooloi aniyeniianɔ mli.” Ni trukaa lɛ ŋwɛi ta kpele bafata bɔfo lɛ he, ni amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi amɛkɛɛ, “Anunyam ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo, ni hejɔlɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ana gbɔmɛi ahe tsuijurɔ!” Be ni bɔfoi lɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ amɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ, tookwɛlɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Betlehem koo, ni wɔyakwɛa nɔ ni eba ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nɛɛ.” Ni amɛtee oya, ni amɛyana Maria kɛ Yosef kɛ abifao lɛ ni ekã kooloi aniyenii anɔ mli.
Be ni amɛna abifao lɛ amɛjaje sane ni agba amɛ yɛ gbekɛ lɛ he lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ fɔlɔi lɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nɔ ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ gba amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Maria kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsuiŋ ni esusuɔ he.
Ni tookwɛlɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛ jie eyi yɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ni amɛnu ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni agba amɛ lɛ.
Yesu gbɛiwoo Ni be ni gbii kpaanyɔ shɛ ni abaafo gbekɛ lɛ ketia lɛ, awo lɛ gbɛi akɛ Yesu, ni ji gbɛi ni bɔfo lɛ wo lɛ dani ana lɛ musu lɛ.
Akɛ Yesu yatsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Ni be ni agbe amɛhetsuumɔ lɛ naa yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛkɛ abifao lɛ tee Yerusalɛm, koni amɛkɛ lɛ ayatsɔ̃ɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni gbeleɔ musu naa lɛ aaatsɛ lɛ mɔ ni afee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ahã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ;” ni amɛyashã afɔle tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Kosɛɛ okpoi enyɔ loo shĩa okpoi bibii enyɔ” lɛ.
Simeon gbalɛ lɛ Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ Yerusalɛm ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Simeon; nakai nuu lɛ jalɔ ji lɛ, ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni eekwɛ Israel yiwalaheremɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ enɔ, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ egboŋ ja ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ dã.
Ni Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ Simeon ba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni be ni gbekɛ Yesu lɛ fɔlɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ ba koni amɛbafee bɔ ni Mla lɛ gbɛnaa yɔɔ amɛhã lɛ lɛ Simeon he lɛ efɔ̃ ekpɔkɔiaŋ, ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi ekɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ ooohã otsulɔ aya, Nuŋtsɔ, yɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa, yɛ hejɔlɛ mli; ejaakɛ mihiŋmɛii ena owalaheremɔ lɛ, nɔ ni osaa oma maji fɛɛ ahiɛ lɛ.
La ni aaahã jeŋmaji lɛ ahiɛ agbele, ni ewo omaŋ Israel hiɛ nyam lɛ.” Ni Yesu tsɛ kɛ enyɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ nii ni awie yɛ ehe lɛ ahewɔ.
Ni Simeon jɔɔ amɛ, ni ekɛɛ gbekɛ lɛ nyɛ, Maria, akɛ, “Naa, akɛ mɔ nɛ edamɔ shi ehã mɛi pii ashigbeemɔ kɛ shitee yɛ Israel, kɛ okadi ni awieɔ ashiɔ; (ni bo diɛŋtsɛ hu obaaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ nɔ ni akɛ akplɔ egbu otsuiŋ) ni aaajie tsuii pii amli susumɔi akpo.” Hana yijiemɔ lɛ Ni gbalɔyoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hana yɛ, ni ji Fanuel biyoo, ni jɛ Asher akutso lɛ mli; egbɔ naakpa, ni ekɛ ewu ehi shi afii kpawo kɛjɛ eblayeiaŋ, ni agbɛnɛ okulafo ji lɛ, ni eye afii nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni ejeee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kwraa, ejaa Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ faikpamɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Lɛ hu eba yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni ebajie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni ewie yɛ gbekɛ Yesu lɛ he etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kwɛɔ Yerusalɛm kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Sɛɛkuu kɛ Nazaret yaa Be ni amɛgbe nibii fɛɛ naa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Nazaret, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli yɛ Galilea.
Ni gbekɛ Yesu lɛ bada, ni ehe wa, ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ yɛ enɔ.
Gbekɛ Yesu lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Daa afi lɛ efɔlɔi lɛ yaa Yerusalɛm amɛyayeɔ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ.
Be ni eye afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ, amɛtee Yerusalɛm, tamɔ bɔ ni gbijurɔ lɛ kusum yɔɔ lɛ.
Shi be ni aye gbijurɔ lɛ agbe naa ni amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, gbekɛ Yesu lɛ hi shi yɛ sɛɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni efɔlɔi lɛ leee.
Amɛsusu akɛ efutu gbɛfalɔi krokomɛi lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ gbi kome gbɛ amɛtao lɛ yɛ amɛwekumɛi kɛ mɛi ni amɛle ateŋ.
Ni be ni amɛnaaa lɛ lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ ni amɛmiitao lɛ.
Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ amɛyana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eta shi yɛ tsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ eebo amɛ toi ni eebibii amɛ nii; ni mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ naa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enilee kɛ hetoi ni ehãa lɛ ahewɔ.
Be ni amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni enyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mibi, mɛɛba ofee wɔ nakai?
Naa, mi kɛ otsɛ etao bo kɛ tsuiyeli.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ mi?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ esa akɛ mihiɔ shi yɛ nii ni ji miTsɛ nɔ lɛ mli?” Shi amɛnuuu wiemɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wie lɛ shishi.
Ni ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee Nazaret, ni eba ehe shi ehã amɛ.
Enyɛ kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fɛɛ to etsui mli.
Ni Yesu tee hiɛ yɛ nilee kɛ dalɛ kɛ dromɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ shiɛmɔ Kaisare Tiberio maŋtsɛyeli afi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ lɛ mli, be ni Pontio Pilato yeɔ amralo yɛ Yudea, ni Herode yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Galilea, ni enyɛmi Filipo yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Iturea kɛ Trakoniti shikpɔji lɛ anɔ, ni Lisania yeɔ lumɔ yɛ Abilene, ni Ana kɛ Kaiafa yeɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ba Zakaria bi Yohane ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Ni eba Yordan niiaŋ fɛɛ, ni eshiɛɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ ni amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ, koni akɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ; tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Mɔ ko miibo yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛsaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛjajea etɛmpɔŋi lɛ trɔmɔɔ.
Aaatsĩ jɔɔ fɛɛ jɔɔ, ni aaahã gɔŋ fɛɛ gɔŋ, kɛ ŋmeŋme fɛɛ ŋmeŋme aba shi.
Ni aaajaje gbɛi kɔɔdɔji.
Ni gbɛ ni nɔ yɔɔ sakasaka lɛ nɔ aaabo.
Ni heloo fɛɛ aaana Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ ni je kpo ba eŋɔɔ ni ebaptisi amɛ lɛ akɛ, “Shikpãi ashwiei, namɔ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛjo mlifu ni baa lɛ naa foi?
Belɛ nyɛwoa yibii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ; ni nyɛkabɔia kɛɛmɔ yɛ nyɛyiŋ akɛ, ‘Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham;’ ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atee bii ashi kɛjɛ tɛi nɛɛ amli ehã Abraham.
Agbɛnɛ hu lema lɛ kã tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ anɔ momo; no hewɔ lɛ, tso fɛɛ tso ni wooo yibii kpakpai lɛ aaatoo ni aaashɛ afɔ̃ la mli.” Ni asafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni wɔfee mɔ?” Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ flakai enyɔ lɛ, ekɛ mɔ ni bɛ eko lɛ aja; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmaa hu, efee nakai nɔŋŋ.” Ni toohelɔi hu ba ni abaptisi amɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni wɔfee?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkahea mɔ ko too fe nine.” Ni asraafoi hu babi lɛ akɛ, “Ni wɔ hu mɛni wɔɔfee?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkafea mɔ ko soisoi; nyɛkafolɔa mɔ ko naa yakatswaa; ni nyɛhãa nyɛnyɔmɔwoo asaa nyɛhiɛ.” Shi be ni maŋ lɛ hiɛ kã nɔ, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ susuɔ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ yɛ Yohane he akɛ benɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ, Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ nu mikɛbaptisiɔ nyɛ; shi mɔ ko ni he wa fe mi miiba, ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai anaa kpãa; lɛ ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ la aaabaptisi nyɛ.
Ehiɛ eshaatsene yɛ edɛŋ, ni eeebɛɛ eshikpɔŋ lɛ fitsofitso, ni eeebua ŋmaa lɛ naa ewo eboŋo lɛ mli; shi tutuu lɛ ekɛ la ni gbooo aaasha.” Ewie nibii krokomɛi pii hu ekɛwo maŋ lɛ ŋaa, ni ekɛshiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Shi Lumɔ Herode lɛ, akɛni Yohane kãa lɛ yɛ enyɛmi Filipo ŋa Herodia lɛ hewɔ, kɛ nifɔɔjianii fɛɛ ni lɛ Herode lɛ efee lɛ hewɔ lɛ, esaa efee enɛ hu eshi nɔ, akɛ emɔ Yohane ewo tsuŋ.
Yesu baptisimɔ Agbɛnɛ be ni abaptisi mɛi lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ abaptisi Yesu hu; ni be ni esɔleɔ lɛ ŋwɛi naa gbele, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpeleke shi kɛ su ni tamɔ okpo su kɛba enɔ; ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Bo ji miSuɔmɔ Bi lɛ, bo ohe tsui minaa!” Yesu weku kpaa Be ni Yesu bɔ̃i enitsumɔ lɛ eye aaafee afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ni tamɔ bɔ ni asusuɔ lɛ, eji Yosef bi, Heli bi, Matat bi, Levi bi, Melki bi, Yanai bi, Yosef bi, Matatia bi, Amos bi, Nahum bi, Esli bi, Nagai bi, Maat bi, Matatia bi, Semein bi, Yosek bi, Yoda bi.
Yohanan bi, Resa bi, Zerubabel bi, Shealtiel bi, Neri bi, Melki bi, Adi bi, Kosam bi, Elmadam bi, Er bi, Yoshua bi, Eliezer bi, Yorim bi, Matat bi, Levi bi, Simeon bi, Yuda bi, Yosef bi, Yonam bi, Eliakim bi, Melea bi, Mena bi, Matata bi, Natan bi, David bi, Ishai bi, Obed bi, Boaz bi, Salmon bi, Nahashon bi, Aminadab bi, Ram bi, Admin bi, Arni bi Hezron bi, Perez bi, Yuda bi, Yakob bi, Isak bi, Abraham bi, Tera bi, Nahor bi, Serug bi, Reu bi, Peleg bi, Eber bi, Shela bi, Kainan bi, Arpakshad bi, Shem bi, Noa bi, Lamek bi.
Metusela bi, Henok bi, Yared bi, Mahalalel bi, Kainan bi, Enos bi, Set bi, Adam bi, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ bi lɛ.
Yesu kaa Yesu ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ ku esɛɛ kɛjɛ Yordan he, ni Mumɔ lɛ kpala lɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ; ni abonsam ka lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ eyeee nɔ ko nɔ ko; ni no sɛɛ lɛ hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, fã tɛ nɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ aboloo.” Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Jeee aboloo kɛkɛ nɔ gbɔmɔ tsɔ̃ɔ ni eyi naa wala.’ ” Ni abonsam ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ko nɔ, ni ekɛ je nɛɛŋ maŋtsɛyelii lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ hiŋmɛitswaa; ni abonsam kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo mikɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛnunyam lɛ baahã; ejaakɛ mi akɛhã, ni mikɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni misumɔɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, bo lɛ, kɛji oookula shi oja mi lɛ, fɛɛ kwa aaatsɔ̃ onɔ.” Yesu here nɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ oja, ni lɛ kɛkɛ osɔ̃mɔ!’ ” Ni Abonsam kɛ lɛ ba Yerusalɛm, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yiteŋ shɔ̃shɔ̃ɔshɔ̃ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji bo lɛ, jɛɛ biɛ okɛ ohe atswa shi; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Eeefã ebɔfoi lɛ yɛ ohewɔ ni amɛbu ohe jogbaŋŋ, ni amɛaahiɛ bo yɛ amɛdɛŋ, koni okɛ onane akashi tɛ ko.’ ” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Kaaka Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ ” Ni be ni abonsam gbe kaa lɛ fɛɛ naa lɛ, eshi lɛ dã.
Galilea nitsumɔ lɛ shishijee Ni Yesu ku esɛɛ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ mli kɛba Galilea; ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ amɛkpeehei lɛ, ni mɛi fɛɛ wo ehiɛ nyam.
Akwa Yesu yɛ Nazaret Ni Yesu ba Nazaret, he ni alɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, etee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni ete shi koni ekane Ŋmalɛ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Ni akɛ gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ hã lɛ, ni be ni egbele mli lɛ, ena he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɛ minɔ, ejaakɛ efɔ mi mu, koni mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
Etsu mi koni mishiɛ heyeli mitsɔ̃ɔ nomii lɛ, kɛ ninamɔ hã shwilafoi, koni mahã aŋmɛɛ mɛi ni awaa amɛ yi lɛ ahe, ni amɛye amɛhe, ni mishiɛ afi ko ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.” Ni ekota wolo lɛ ekɛhã sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ, ni eho eta shi, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ.
Ni ebɔ̃i amɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ eba mli yɛ nyɛtoiiaŋ.” Ni mɛi fɛɛ ye ehe odase, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ dromɔ wiemɔi ni jɛ enaa lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee Yosef bi lɛ nɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ nyɛaabu mi nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Tsofatsɛ, tsa bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe!
Nii abɔ ni wɔnu akɛ ofee yɛ Kapernaum lɛ, feemɔ yɛ biɛ ni ji omaŋ lɛ mli hu.’ ” Shi ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ ahereee gbalɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ okulafoi pii yɛ Israel yɛ Elia yinɔ, be mli ni aŋa ŋwɛi naa afii etɛ̃ kɛ nyɔji ekpaa sɔŋŋ ni hɔ̃mɔ kpele ba shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ; shi atsuuu Elia kɛyaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja yoo okulafo ko ni yɔɔ Zarefat yɛ Sidon shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni kpitiyelɔi pii hu yɛ Israel yɛ gbalɔ Elisha yinɔ, shi atsaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko, akɛ ja Naaman, Sirianyo lɛ kɛkɛ.” Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ fɛɛ mli fu naakpa, be ni amɛnu nii nɛɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛte shi ni amɛtsirɛ lɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee gɔŋ ni amɛmaŋ lɛ ma nɔ lɛ toi, koni amɛyatsi eyisɛɛ amɛwo jɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shi etsɔ̃ amɛteŋ kɛho, ni eyiŋ etee.
Nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli Ni Yesu tee Kapernaum, Galilea maŋ ko mli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbii lɛ anɔ.
Ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewalɛ yɛ mli.
Ni nuu ko yɛ kpeehe lɛ ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli, ni ebo waa ekɛɛ, “Ao!
Mɛɛ sane wɔkɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu Nazarenyo?
Oba wɔhiɛ kpãtãmɔ?
Mile mɔ ni ji bo, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” Ni Yesu fã eyi ni ekɛɛ, “Muamɔ onaa ni oje emli!” Ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ tsi lɛ etswa shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ ni eje emli, ni eyeee lɛ awui ko.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛɛ wiemɔ nɛ?
Ejaakɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ ekɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, ni amɛjeɔ kpo!” Ni ehe sane jije yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Petro shaayoo tsamɔ Ni Yesu je kpeehe lɛ ni eyabote Simon we lɛ.
Shi atridii ni naa wa emɔ Simon shaayoo lɛ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai ni ebakwɛ lɛ.
Ni eyadamɔ emasɛi, ni efã atridii lɛ yi, ni etse yɛ enɔ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi ni esɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Helatsɛmɛi pii atsamɔ Ni be ni hulu nyɔ shi lɛ, mɛi abɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mɛi ni helai srɔtoi hiɛ amɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ ba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛ eniji shwie amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ ekomekome ni etsa amɛ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji hu je mɛi pii amli, ni amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ!” Ni Yesu famɔ amɛyi ni eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Yesu shiɛmɔ yɛ Galilea Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko; ni asafoi lɛ tao lɛ ni amɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛtsi enaa, koni ekaje amɛŋɔɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Esa akɛ miyajajeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ maji krokomɛi hu, ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ atsu mi.” Ni eshiɛ yɛ Galilea kpeehei lɛ.
Kaselɔi ni atsɛ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ Gbi ko be ni Yesu damɔ Genesaret Kpaakpo lɛ naa ni mɛi pii jwere enɔ amɛboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ, ena lɛji enyɔ ŋmɔlɔ shi yɛ kpaakpo lɛ naa; wolɛi lɛ eje mli ni amɛmiifɔ amɛyai ahe.
Ni Yesu yabote lɛlɛ lɛ ekome ni ji Simon nɔ lɛ mli, ni ekpa lɛ fai akɛ etsi kɛya nu lɛ hiɛ fioo; ni Yesu ho eta shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ anii kɛjɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli.
Be ni egbe ewiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Nyɛwiria kɛyaa he ni kwɔ lɛ ni nyɛyafɔa nyɛyai lɛ, koni nyɛgbe loo.” Ni Simon here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onukpa, wɔtsu nii waa nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ fɛɛ ni wɔnaaa nɔ ko; shi kɛ̃lɛ owiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ maŋmɛ yai lɛ.” Ni be ni amɛfee nakai lɛ, amɛgbe loo babaoo bɔ ni amɛyai lɛ bɔ̃i gbalamɔ.
Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnanemɛi ni yɔɔ lɛlɛ kroko lɛ mli lɛ nine akɛ amɛba ni amɛbawa amɛ.
Ni amɛba ni amɛwo lɛji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ loo ni amɛmiihe amɛshiu.
Shi be ni Simon Petro na lɛ, eho ekula Yesu naji anaa, ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, jee mimasɛi; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ eshafeelɔ ji mi!” Ni ekɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ fɛɛ ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe yɛ loo pii ni amɛgbe lɛ hewɔ; ni nakai nɔŋŋ Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Zebedeo bii lɛ ni ji Simon hefatalɔi lɛ, hu ahe jɔ̃ amɛhe.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei!
Kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ obaahɛ gbɔmɛi.” Ni be ni amɛbakpeleke lɛ amɛshi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni amɛbanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Kpitiyelɔ ko tsamɔ Gbi ko lɛ Yesu yɛ maŋ lɛ eko mli, kɛkɛ lɛ naa nuu ko ni kpiti eshwie ehe kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
Be ni ena Yesu lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ bu shi ni ekpa lɛ fai ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, ooonyɛ ohã mihe atse.” Ni Yesu kpã enine mli eta ehe ni ekɛɛ, “Miisumɔ, ohe atse!” Ni amrɔ lɛ kpiti lɛ tã yɛ ehe.
Ni etswa enaa ma akɛ, “Kaakɛɛ mɔ ko, shi moŋ yaa ni okɛ ohe ayatsɔ̃ɔ osɔfo lɛ, ni oyashã afɔle yɛ ohetsemɔ lɛ hewɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mose to lɛ, koni no afee odase ahã amɛ.” Shi babaoo ni ehe sane lɛ gbɛ shwã moŋ ji no, ni mɛi pii babuaa amɛhe naa ni amɛbabo lɛ toi, ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ.
Shi egbalaa ehe shi kɛyaa ŋa nɔ ni eyasɔleɔ.
Kuumɔhelatsɛ ko tsamɔ Agbɛnɛ gbi lɛ eko be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii lɛ, Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi ni jɛ Galilea kɛ Yudea maji lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ tara jɛi; ni ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛtsáa mɔ lɛ kpo yɛ jɛi.
Mɛi komɛi kɛ nuu ko ni kã saa nɔ ni ekumɔ ba; ni amɛmiitao akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ aba shĩa lɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ abaŋmɛ ehiɛ.
Ni be ni amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛkɛ lɛ aba ehiɛ yɛ asafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkwɔ kɛtee tsu lɛ yiteŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛ esaa lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ntayai lɛ amli kɛyaŋmɛ amɛteŋ yɛ Yesu hiɛ.
Be ni Yesu na amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ekɛɛ helatsɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, akɛ ohe eshai lɛ efa bo.” Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ bɔ̃i susumɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni wieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔ nɛɛ?
Namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ eshai afa akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ koome pɛ.” Shi be ni Yesu yoo amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛsusuɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli lɛ?
Te nɔ ni kɛɛmɔ jaraaa hu, ‘Akɛ ohe eshai efa bo’ aloo ‘Tee shi ni onyiɛ’ lɛ?
Shi be ni afee ni nyɛle akɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ yɛ hegbɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ ekɛ eshai faa lɛ” — ekɛɛ mɔ ni ekumɔ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo akɛ tee shi ni owo osaa lɛ ni oya owe!” Ni amrɔ lɛ nuu lɛ te shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ewo nɔ ni ekã nɔ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam woo.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛshe gbeyei naakpa ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔna naakpɛɛnii ŋmɛnɛ!” Levi tsɛmɔ Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yesu je kpo, ni eyana toohelɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Levi ni eta toohemɔhe lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Ni Levi shi nɔ fɛɛ nɔ, ni ete shi ebanyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni Levi ŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple yɛ ewe lɛ, ni toohelɔi kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii kɛ amɛ baye nii.
Ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ amɛmlatsɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ wie ekaselɔi lɛ ahe huhuuhu ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛkɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi yeɔ nii ni nyɛkɛ amɛ nuɔ nii nɛɛ?” Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni yɔɔ kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ lɛ ehiaaa amɛ tsofatsɛ, shi mɛi ni he yeɔ lɛ moŋ ehia.
Mibaaa jalɔi atsɛmɔ, shi moŋ miba eshafeelɔi atsɛmɔ koni amɛtsake amɛtsui.” Ŋmaahilɛ he sane Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yohane kaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ ŋmaahilɛ kɛ sɔlemɔ, ni Farisifoi lɛ akaselɔi lɛ hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ, ni bo lɛ okaselɔi lɛ yeɔ nii ni amɛnuɔ nii.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhã yookpeemɔ he bialɔi lɛ ahi ŋmaa, be ni ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ?
Shi gbii aaaba ni aaaŋɔ ayɛmforowu lɛ kɛaajɛ amɛŋɔɔ, ni no mli dani amɛaahi ŋmaa.” Ni ebu amɛ abɛ hu ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko gbaaa mama hee naa ekɛtaaa atade momo; kɛji efee nakai lɛ, eeegbala ehee lɛ, ni mamanaa hee lɛ kɛ atade momo lɛ yeŋ.
Ni mɔ ko kɛ wain hee wooo wolo tɔi memeji amli, kɛ efee nakai lɛ, wain hee lɛ aaaflɛ wolo tɔi lɛ ni eeeshwie shi, ni wolo tɔi lɛ hu aaafite.
Shi wain hee lɛ, wolo tɔi hei amli akɛwoɔ.
Asaŋ mɔ ko enuuu wain momo ni amrɔ nɔŋŋ ni etao ehee, ejaakɛ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Emomo lɛ hi.’ ”
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, Yesu yatsɔ̃ abele ŋmɔji amli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ kumɔ abele lɛ, ni amɛkposa, ni amɛkpe.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ nyɛfeɔ nɔ ni aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ afeɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛkaneko nɔ ni David fee, be ni hɔ̃mɔ ye lɛ kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ: bɔ ni ebote Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ, ni eyakɔlɔ aboloi ni akɛmaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ ni eye eko ni ehã mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ eko, tsɛbelɛ aŋmɛɛɛ gbɛ akɛ mɔ ko yeɔ akɛ ja osɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nuŋtsɔ.” Nuu ni nine kome egbo lɛ Shi hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ ekroko nɔ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee kpeehe lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni eninejurɔ egbo.
Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ sara lɛ amɛkwɛ akɛ eeetsa hela yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo, koni amɛna nɔ ko nɔ amɛdamɔ amɛkɛfolɔ enaa.
Shi Yesu le amɛsusumɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ nuu ni nine egbo lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi obadamɔ teŋ!” Ni ete shi ebadamɔ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibabi nyɛ nɔ ko: ani eja gbɛ akɛ afeɔ ekpakpa loo efɔ̃ŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ ahereɔ susuma yiwala aloo akpãtãa ehiɛ?” Ni ekwɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ nuu lɛ akɛ, “Kpã onine lɛ mli!” Ni efee nakai ni enine lɛ ye emuu.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛmli fu waa, ni amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ nɔ po ni amɛaafee Yesu.
Kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ahalamɔ Agbɛnɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, eyiŋ etee sɔlemɔ yɛ gɔŋ ko nɔ, ni eshi kpe nyɔɔŋnyɔɔŋ fɛɛ eesɔle eetsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, etsɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ehala amɛteŋ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, mɛi hu ni etsɛ amɛ bɔfoi lɛ.
Simon, mɔ ni ewo lɛ Petro hu lɛ, kɛ enyɛmi Andrea; Yakobo kɛ Yohane, Filipo kɛ Bartolomeo; Mateo kɛ Toma; Yakobo, Alfeo bi lɛ, kɛ Simon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ maŋhedɔlɔ lɛ; Yuda, Yakobo nyɛmi lɛ, kɛ Yuda Iskariot, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Yesu shiɛ ni etsa helatsɛmɛi Ni ekɛ amɛ kpeleke shi kɛbadamɔ he ko ni yɔɔ trɛnɛɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi asafo lɛ kɛ mɛi pii ni jɛ Yudea fɛɛ kɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Tiro kɛ Sidon ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ amli ni ba lɛ toiboo kɛ amɛhelai atsamɔ lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ni etsa amɛ.
Ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ miitao ehe amɛta, ejaakɛ hewalɛ miije emli ni eetsa amɛ fɛɛ.
Jɔɔmɔi kɛ loomɔi Ni ehole ehiŋmɛi anɔ ekwɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ nyɛ ohiafoi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛnɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
“Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃mɔ yeɔ nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛaatɔrɔ.
Ajɔɔ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛfoɔ amrɔ nɛɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛaaŋmɔ.
“Ajɔɔ nyɛ, kɛji mɛi nyɛ nyɛ, ni amɛkɛ nyɛ tserɛ mli, ni amɛjɛ nyɛ ni amɛgbe nyɛgbɛi akɛ gbɛi fɔ̃ŋ yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Nyɛnyaa yɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ ni nyɛtumɔa, ejaakɛ naa, nyɛnyɔmɔwoo fa yɛ ŋwɛi; ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee gbalɔi lɛ.
“Shi nyɛ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ, kpoo hã nyɛ!
Ejaakɛ nyɛna nyɛmiishɛjemɔ momo.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtɔrɔ amrɔ nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ hɔ̃mɔ aaaye nyɛ.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛŋmɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ!
Ejaakɛ nyɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ ni nyɛaafofoi.
“Kpoo hã nyɛ, kɛji mɛi fɛɛ aaawie nyɛhe ekpakpa lɛ!
Ejaakɛ nakai nɔŋŋ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee amale gbalɔi lɛ.
Henyɛlɔi asuɔmɔ “Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛboɔ toi nɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi; nyɛfea mɛi ni nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ ejurɔ; nyɛjɔa mɛi ni lomɔɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ niseniianii.
Mɔ ni aaagba otoi kome mli lɛ, tsɔ̃ ekome lɛ hu ohã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ ohebo lɛ, kaakãmã lɛ oflaka lɛ hu.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa bo nii lɛ, hã lɛ, ni mɔ ni aaashɔ̃ onii lɛ, kaabi lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni bɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ mɛi afee ahã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa amɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛsumɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu sumɔɔ mɛi ni sumɔɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji mɛi ni feɔ nyɛ ejurɔ nyɛfeɔ ejurɔ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu feɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni kɛji nyɛfa mɛi ni nyɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ amɛaahã nyɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛ shidaa nyɛyɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ eshafeelɔi hu faa eshafeelɔi koni amɛna nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ.
Moŋ nyɛsumɔa nyɛhenyɛlɔi, ni nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nyɛfaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ ko nɔ dɔŋŋ, ni nyɛnyɔmɔwoo aaafa, ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ bii, shi lɛ lɛ emli hi hã trumui kɛ mɛi fɔ̃ji.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa mɔbɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛTsɛ lɛ hu naa mɔbɔ lɛ.” Kojomɔ “Nyɛkakojoa, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akakojo nyɛ; nyɛkabua fɔ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ akabu nyɛ fɔ; nyɛkɛfaa, ni akɛaafa nyɛ.
Nyɛhãa ni aaahã nyɛ; nii ni asusu jogbaŋŋ ni ahoso ni anyɛmɔ nɔ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛteke nɔ mɛi kɛaashãkã nyɛtsitsi, ejaakɛ nɔ susumɔnɔ ni nyɛkɛsusuɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaaku sɛɛ akɛsusu ahã nyɛ.” Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Ani shwilafo aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ shwilafo gbɛ?
Ani jeee bu mli amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaayagbee?
Kaselɔ efeee etsɔ̃ɔlɔ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni atsɔse lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ, eeetamɔ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ.
Shi mɛɛba onaa kuli ni kã onyɛmi hiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ, ni mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ, oyooo lɛ?
Aloo te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni ooonyɛ okɛɛ onyɛmi akɛ, ‘Anyɛmi, hã majie kuli ni kã ohiŋmɛi nɔ lɛ,’ be ni onaaa mplaŋ ni yɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛi mli lɛ?
Osatofo, jiemɔ mplaŋ lɛ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohiŋmɛiŋ tsutsu, ni no dani ooona nii faŋŋ ni ojie kuli lɛ yɛ onyɛmi lɛ hiŋmɛiŋ!” Amɛyibii nyɛkɛaale amɛ “Ejaakɛ tso kpakpa ko bɛ ni woɔ yibii gbohii, ni asaŋ tso gbonyo ko hu bɛ ni woɔ yibii kpakpai.
Ejaakɛ tso fɛɛ tso diɛŋtsɛ yibii akɛleɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ atseee agbãmi yɛ ŋmeitsei anɔ, ni asaŋ atseee wain yibii yɛ aklatei anɔ.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa jieɔ nɔ kpakpa kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri kpakpa lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɔ fɔ̃ŋ jieɔ nɔ fɔ̃ŋ kɛjɛɔ etsui mli jwetri fɔ̃ŋ lɛ mli, ejaakɛ nɔ ni eyi tsui obɔ̃ lɛ, no naabu wieɔ.” Tsumalɔi enyɔ lɛ “Shi mɛni hewɔ nyɛtsɛɔ mi akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ!’ Ni nyɛfeee nii ni mikɛɔ lɛ?
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ ni enuɔ miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ ni etamɔ: etamɔ nuu ko ni be ni emaa tsu lɛ etsa shi kwɔŋkwɔŋ ni eto shishi yɛ tɛsaa nɔ; ni nu afua ba, ni eshimɔ nakai tsu lɛ, ni enyɛɛɛ lɛ ehoso, ejaakɛ ato shishi jogbaŋŋ.
Shi mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, etamɔ nuu ko ni ma tsu yɛ shikpɔŋ hiɛ ni etswaaa shishitoo jogbaŋŋ; ni faa ba ni eshimɔ tsu lɛ, ni amrɔ lɛ ewule, ni nakai tsu lɛ wulemɔ lɛ da.”
Asraafoiohaiatsɛ ko wenuu tsamɔ Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu ewie wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ toiiaŋ lɛ, ebote Kapernaum.
Asraafoiohaiatsɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni etsulɔ ni eshwɛɛɛ ehe kwraa he miiye ni eehe egbo.
Ni be ni enu Yesu he lɛ, etsu Yudafoi lɛ anukpai kɛba eŋɔɔ akɛ eekpa lɛ fai ni eba ni ebatsa etsulɔ lɛ.
Be ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai naakpa amɛkɛɛ, “Mɔ ni obaafee enɛ ohã lɛ, esa lɛ; ejaakɛ esumɔɔ wɔmaŋ lɛ, ni kpeehe lɛ, lɛ ema ehã wɔ.” Ni Yesu kɛ amɛ tee.
Shi be ni eshwɛ fioo ni ebaashɛ shĩa lɛ, asraafoiohaiatsɛ lɛ tsu eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaagba ohe naa; ejaakɛ esaaa mi akɛ oboteɔ mikoi lɛ shi; no hewɔ hu ni mibuuu mihe akɛ misa mɔ ni baa oŋɔɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wiemɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, ni aaatsa mitsulɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi po ni mi ji gbɔmɔ ni yɔɔ nɔyeli shishi lɛ, miyɛ asraafoi yɛ mishishi, ni mikɛɔ mɔ kome akɛ, ‘Yaa!’ Ni eyaa; kɛ mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Ba!’ Ni ebaa; ni mikɛɔ mitsulɔ akɛ, ‘Feemɔ enɛ!’ Ni efeɔ.” Be ni Yesu nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ehewɔ, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ asafo ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Israel tete minako hemɔkɛyeli ni da tamɔ enɛ dã.” Ni be ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛba shĩa lɛ, amɛbana tsulɔ lɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ.
Nain oblanyo lɛ shiteemɔ Jetsɛre nɔ lɛ, eyiŋ kɛtee maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nain lɛ mli; ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kɛ asafo yuu kɛ lɛ nyiɛ.
Shi be ni eshɛ maŋ lɛ agbo lɛ naa etã lɛ, naa, awo gbonyo ko kɛmiije kpo, ni enyɛ bi kome ji lɛ; ni okulafo ji yoo lɛ, ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ.
Ni be ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ na lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafo!” Ni eba ebata adeka lɛ he; ni mɛi ni tere lɛ lɛ wa damɔ shi.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Oblanyo, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, Tee shi!” Ni mɔ ni egbo lɛ te shi eta shi, ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ; ni ekɛ lɛ hã enyɛ.
Ni gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ kpeteŋkple ete shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebasara emaŋ lɛ.” Ni ehe sane nɛɛ jije yɛ Yudea kɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu kɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ Ni Yohane kaselɔi lɛ yagba lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Ni etsɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ, ni etsu amɛ Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛyabi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?” Be ni hii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ tsu wɔ oŋɔɔ.
Ekɛɛ, ‘Ani bo ji mɔ ni baa lɛ, aloo wɔkwɛ mɔ kroko gbɛ?’ ” Shi nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ Yesu tsa mɛi pii ahelai kɛ amɛhejaramɔi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli, ni mɛi pii hu ni eshwila lɛ, ehã amɛna nii.
Ni Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yohane nibii ni nyɛna ni nyɛnu lɛ, akɛ shwilafoi miina nii, obubuafoi miinyiɛ, kpitiyelɔi ahe miitse, toimulɔi miinu nii, gbohii miite shi, ni aajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ aatsɔ̃ɔ ohiafoi.
Ni ajɔɔ mɔ ni mihe sane etɔ̃tɔ̃ŋ enane.” Yesu ye Yohane he odase Shi be ni Yohane bɔfoi lɛ yiŋ amɛtee lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i asafoi lɛ kɛɛmɔ yɛ Yohane he akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛje kpo nyɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ ni nyɛyakwɛ?
Glã ni kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ lɛ?
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee?
Gbɔmɔ ni woɔ atade bɔdɔɔ?
Naa, mɛi ni woɔ atade fɛɛfɛo ni amɛyeɔ nii kpakpai lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi awei amɛyɔɔ.
Aloo mɛni kwɛmɔ nyɛtee?
Gbalɔ?
Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ni fe gbalɔ tete.
Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ he ni aŋma yɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, miitsu mibɔfo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ ohiɛ, mɔ ni aaasaa ogbɛ lɛ ato bo lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɛi ni yei fɔ amɛ lɛ ateŋ lɛ mɔ ko bɛ ni fe Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ; shi mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ fe lɛ.” Ni be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ toohelɔi lɛ nu lɛ, amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ bem akɛni akɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ baptisi amɛ lɛ.
Shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kpoo Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni eyɔɔ yɛ amɛhe lɛ, akɛni amɛhãaa ni Yohane abaptisi amɛ lɛ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Namɔ he mikɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaato mɔ, ni namɔ amɛtamɔ?
Amɛtamɔ gbekɛbii ni tara jara nɔ ni tsɛtsɛɔ amɛhe amɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔkpã blɛ wɔha nyɛ, ni nyɛjooo; wɔwo yara wɔhã nyɛ, ni nyɛfooo!’ Ejaakɛ Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ba ni eyeee aboloo ni enuuu wain, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɛ emli.’ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba ni eyeɔ nii ni enuɔ nɔ ko, ni nyɛkɛɛ, ‘Naa nuu ŋmaayelɔ kɛ dãanulɔ, toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi ashieŋtsɛ!’ Ni abu nilee bem yɛ ebii lɛ fɛɛ anaa.” Yoo eshafeelɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu Ni Farisifoi lɛ eko kpee Yesu ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii, ni eyiŋ etee Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe.
Ni naa, be ni yoo ko ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli ni ji eshafeelɔ lɛ na ele akɛ Yesu miiye nii yɛ Farisifonyo lɛ we lɛ, ekɛ alabastro tɔ kɛ emli mukɛŋma ba; ni ebadamɔ enajiaŋshi yɛ esɛɛgbɛ, ni efo ni ekɛ eyaafonu lɛ bɔ̃i enaji ahe fɔɔ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ, ni eshwɔ enaji ahe, ni ekɛ mukɛŋma lɛ kpa he.
Shi be ni Farisifonyo ni kpee Yesu niyeli lɛ na lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ emli akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ jikulɛ, eeele nɔ gbɔmɔ kɛ nɔ yoo ni taa ehe nɛɛ akɛ eshafeelɔ ji lɛ.” Ni Yesu wo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Simon, miyɛ sane ko ni mibakɛɛ bo.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ!” “Niflilɔ ko yɛ ni yɔɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi enyɔ; mɔ kome hiɛ lɛ denarioi ohai enumɔ, ni mɔ kome hu hiɛ lɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Shi akɛni amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaawo nyɔmɔ lɛ, ekɛke amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, te amɛteŋ mɔ ni aaasumɔ lɛ fe enaanyoŋ?” Ni Simon to he ekɛɛ, “Misusuɔ akɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ pii ke lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obu atɛŋ jogbaŋŋ.” Ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã yoo lɛ, ni ekɛɛ Simon akɛ, “Oona nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ?
Ni mibabote owe lɛ nɛɛ, ohãaa mi nu ni mikɛfɔ minaji ahe, shi yoo nɛɛ kɛ yaafonu efɔ minaji ahe, ni ekɛ eyitsɔi etsumɔ.
Minaa hu oshwɔɔɔ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, kɛjɛ be mli ni miba nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, efɔ̃ko minaji ahe shwɔmɔ.
Mu hu okɛkpaaa miyiŋ; shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, ekɛ mukɛŋma ekpa minaji ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ehe eshai ni fa lɛ, akɛfa lɛ, ni no hewɔ esuɔmɔ fa babaoo lɛ; shi mɔ ni akɛ fioo efa lɛ lɛ, esuɔmɔ fioo.” Ni ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Akɛ ohe eshai efa bo!” Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ nɛ ni kɛ eshai faa po nɛɛ?” Shi ekɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Ohemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehere oyiwala, yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli!”
Yei ni kɛ Yesu nyiɛ lɛ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli eshiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi.
Ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ fata ehe, kɛ yei komɛi hu ni efamɔ amɛmumɔi fɔ̃ji ni etsa amɛhelai lɛ: Maria, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Magdalena ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji kpawo je emli lɛ, kɛ Yohana, Herode tsulɔnukpa Kusa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Susana, kɛ mɛi krokomɛi pii ni kɛ amɛnii ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ eko sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ.
Nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Ni be ni asafo babaoo naa ebakpe shi ni mɛi jɛ majimaji anɔ kɛmiiba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Nidulɔ ko yiŋ etee ewui shwãmɔ.
Eshwãmɔ mli lɛ, eko yashwie gbɛ toi, ni anaanaa nɔ, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bakɔlɔ.
Eko yashwie tɛsaa nɔ ni be ni ekwɛ̃ lɛ, eŋãla, ejaakɛ enaaa ofɔ̃.
Eko yashwie ŋmei ateŋ, ni ŋmei lɛ kɛ lɛ kwɛ̃ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Ni eko hu yashwie shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ, ni ekwɛ̃, ni ewo yibii toi oha.” Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!” Nɔ hewɔ ni Yesu wie yɛ abɛbuai amli Shi ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te abɛ nɛɛ shishiŋ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli teemɔ saji lɛ ehã nyɛ akɛ nyɛle; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ akɛhãa amɛ yɛ abɛbuai amli; ‘koni na lɛ amɛna nɛ, shi amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni nu hu amɛnu, shi amɛkanu shishi.’ Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nidulɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ shishi “Agbɛnɛ abɛ lɛ shishi nɛ; wu lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Gbɛ toi bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ, shi abonsam baa ni ebashaa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ, koni amɛkahe amɛye ni ahere amɛyiwala.
Tɛsaa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛheɔ amɛyeɔ be kuku kɛkɛ, ni kaa be mli lɛ amɛkwaa amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Ŋmei ateŋ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni nuɔ ni amɛyaa, ni je nɛɛŋ henaagbamɔi kɛ ninamɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔyeli gbeɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛmli; ni amɛwooo yibii ni hiɔ shi ni saa kɛgbeɔ naa.
Shi shikpɔŋ kpakpa nɔ bii lɛ ji mɛi ni kɛji amɛnu wiemɔ lɛ amɛkɛtoɔ tsui ni hi ni yɔɔ krɔŋŋ mli, ni amɛkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ woɔ yibii.” Kane ni akɛhɔ tsese shishi “Mɔ ko esuuu kane ni ekɛ nɔ ha nɔ aloo ni ekɛma saatso shishi; shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni boteɔ shĩa lɛ mli ana la lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ko bɛ ni akɛtee ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, ni asaŋ nɔ ko bɛ ni abu nɔ ni aleŋ ni ejeŋ kpo faŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia yɛ bɔ ni nyɛnuɔ wiemɔ lɛ nyɛhãa he; ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, aaahã lɛ; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, aaashɔ̃ nɔ ni efeɔ lɛ akɛ eyɔɔ lɛ tete yɛ edɛŋ.” Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ ba he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, shi asafo lɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ eŋɔɔ amɛshɛ.
Ni abakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onyɛ kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ damɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛmiitao amɛna bo.” Shi Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Minyɛ kɛ minyɛmimɛi ji mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ!” Yesu fã ahum yi ni efɔ̃ɔ tswaa Gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ eba mli akɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ gbɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ.
Shi be ni amɛyaa lɛ, wɔŋɔ lɛ.
Ni ahum batswa yɛ kpaakpo lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛlɛlɛ lɛ yi kɛ nu, ni amɛyɛ amanehulu mli.
Ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbatsiɛ̃ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, wɔhiɛ miikpãtã!” Ni ete shi ni efã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ kɛ nu ni efee hamahama lɛ yi, ni amɛfee diŋŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ ŋmɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli yɔɔ?” Ni amɛshe gbeyei ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛɛ gbɔmɔ srɔto po nɛ ni efãa kɔɔyɔi kɛ nui tete yi ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi nɛɛ?” Yesu tsa nuu mumui ko ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli Ni amɛshɛ Gerasebii ashikpɔŋ lɛ ni yɔɔ Galilea ŋɛlɛnɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni ebakpeleke lɛ, nuu ko jɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ lɛ bakpe ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni ewooo atade ni ehiii shĩa akɛ ja gbohii abui amli kɛkɛ.
Ni be ni ena Yesu lɛ ebo waa ni ebagbee enaji anaa, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ sane mikɛ bo yɔɔ, bo Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ, Bi?
Miikpa bo fai, kaapiŋ mi!” (Ekɛɛ enɛ), ejaakɛ Yesu fã mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ akɛ eje emli.
Shi emɔɔ lɛ kpitiokpitioo; ni awoɔ lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi kɛ gboklɛi ni abuɔ ehe; shi etsereɔ nii ni akɛfimɔɔ lɛ lɛ amli, ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ kpalaa lɛ kɛyaa ŋa lɛ mli.
Ni Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Te ogbɛiŋ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Asafo”; ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji pii ebote emli lɛ.
Ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekafã amɛ ni ehã amɛyabote bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Shi kplotoi akuu kpele ko yɛ jɛi amɛmiiye nii yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛkpa Yesu fai akɛ eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli.
Ni eŋmɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ je nuu lɛ mli, ni amɛyabote kplotoi lɛ amli, ni kuu muu lɛ fɛɛ wo foi kɛkpeleke gɔŋ lɛ kɛyashwie kpaakpo lɛ mli, ni amɛgboi.
Ni be ni mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛ lɛ na nɔ ni eba lɛ amɛjo foi ni amɛyagba yɛ maŋ lɛ mli kɛ akrowai lɛ amli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛje kpo amɛtee nɔ ni eba lɛ kwɛmɔ, ni amɛba Yesu ŋɔɔ ni amɛbana nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ.
Eta Yesu najianaa ni ewo atade ni ehiɛ etserɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛshe gbeyei.
Shi mɛi ni na lɛ hu gba amɛ bɔ ni fee ni atsa mɔ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ emli lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Gerasebii lɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpa lɛ fai akɛ eje amɛŋɔɔ eya; ejaakɛ gbeyei emɔmɔ amɛ naakpa.
Ni eyabote lɛlɛ lɛ mli kɛku esɛɛ.
Shi nuu lɛ ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ eje emli lɛ kpa lɛ fai ni ekɛ lɛ ahi shi.
Shi Yesu jie lɛ gbɛ ekɛɛ, “Kuu osɛɛ oya owe, ni oyagba nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efee eha bo lɛ.” Ni eyiŋ etee, ni eyajaje nii abɔ ni Yesu efee ehã lɛ lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Yairo biyoo lɛ kɛ yoo ni ta Yesu atade he lɛ Be ni Yesu ku esɛɛ eba kpaakpo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ nya ehe; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiimɛ lɛ.
Ni naa, nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yairo ni ji kpeehe lɛ onukpa lɛ ba, ni ebagbee Yesu najianaa ni ekpa lɛ fai, koni eba ewe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ biyoo kome pɛ ni eye aaafee afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni eehe egbo.
Shi be ni Yesu yaa lɛ, asafoi lɛ mia lɛ.
Ni yoo ko yɛ amɛteŋ ni eye láfɔsemɔ hela afii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ; efite enii fɛɛ ekɛwo tsofatsɛmɛi anyɔmɔ; shi mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lɛ atsa.
Ebaje Yesu sɛɛ gbɛ, ni ebata etade naamuu lɛ he, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ elá ni hoɔ lɛ lɛ sɛɛ fo.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni ta mihe lɛ?” Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tso lɛ, Petro kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, asafoi lɛ ebɔle ohe ni amɛmiimia bo, ni okɛɔ akɛ, Namɔ ta mihe lɛ?” Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Mɔ ko eta mihe, ejaakɛ minu he akɛ, hewalɛ ko eje mimli.” Shi be ni yoo lɛ na akɛ ehiii lɛ eheteemɔ lɛ eba kɛ hekpokpomɔ ni eho egbee Yesu najianaa ni ejaje nɔ hewɔ ni eta ehe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ehe wa lɛ amrɔ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Biyoo, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo; yaa yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.” Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, mɔ ko jɛ kpeehe onukpa lɛ we lɛ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obiyoo lɛ egbo; kaagba tsɔɔlɔ lɛ naa dɔŋŋ.” Shi be ni Yesu nu lɛ, ehere nɔ ni ekɛɛ Yairo akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei; hemɔ oye kɛkɛ, ni eyi aaana wala!” Ni be ni eba shĩa lɛ, eŋmɛɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko gbɛ ni ekɛ lɛ aya jɛi akɛ ja Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo kɛ gbekɛ lɛ tsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miifo ni amɛmiiye gbekɛ lɛ he ŋkɔmɔ.
Shi ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkafoa; egboko, shi wɔ ewɔ.” Ni amɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ egbo.
Shi Yesu mɔ enine shi, ni ebo akɛ, “Gbekɛyoo, tee shi!” Ni emumɔ ku esɛɛ ba emli ekoŋŋ, ni ete shi amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni Yesu fã akɛ ahã lɛ nɔ ko eye.
Ni efɔlɔi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe; shi etswa amɛnaa ma akɛ amɛkagba mɔ ko nɔ ni afee lɛ.
Yesu tsu kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ Agbɛnɛ Yesu tsɛ ekaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ehã amɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ yɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji fɛɛ anɔ ni amɛtsa helai hu.
Ni etsu amɛNyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shiɛmɔ kɛ helatsɛmɛi atsamɔ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkaŋɔa nɔ ko nyɛhiɛa nyɛdɛ̃ŋ yɛ nyɛgbɛfãa lɛ mli, nyɛkahiɛa tso loo kotoku loo aboloo loo shika loo atadei enyɔ.
Ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni nyɛaabote mli lɛ, nyɛhia jɛi kɛyashi nyɛaaje jɛi.
He fɛɛ he ni mɛi lɛ hereee nyɛ yɛ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmiije nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkpokpoa nyɛnajiashi mlu lɛ nyɛkɛyea odase nyɛshia amɛ.” Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyakpa maji lɛ anɔ amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni amɛtsa mɛi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Herode yeyeeyefeemɔ Lumɔ Herode nu nii ni afee lɛ fɛɛ he, ni efee yeyeeye, ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ Yohane ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ Elia ejie ehe kpo; mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ.
Ni Herode kɛɛ, “Yohane lɛ mifo eyi; shi namɔ ji mɔ ni minunuɔ nɛkɛ saji yɛ ehe nɛɛ?” Ni eetao Yesu ena.
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba lɛ, amɛbagba Yesu nibii fɛɛ ni amɛfee lɛ.
Ni ekɛ amɛ tee ŋa lɛ nɔ he ko banee yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Betsaida lɛ masɛi.
Be ni asafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, ni ehere amɛ atuu ni ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni etsa mɛi ni tsamɔ he ehia amɛ lɛ.
Be ni je bɔ̃i namɔ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wo asafo lɛ gbɛ koni amɛya akrowai kɛ ŋmɔji ni kamɔ wɔhewɔ lɛ amli, ni amɛyato jɛmɛi ni amɛna niyenii; ejaakɛ ŋa nɔ wɔyɔɔ nɛɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhãa amɛ nɔ ko amɛyea.” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔbɛ nɔ ko fe aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ pɛ, ni belɛ ja wɔtee wɔyahe niyenii wɔbahã asafo nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛyi aaafee hii akpei enumɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa amɛtaraa shi kuikui aaafee nyɔŋmai enumɔ enumɔ.” Amɛfee nakai, ni amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ tara shi.
Ni ekɔlɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi enyɔ lɛ ni ekwɛ ŋwɛi ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã ekaselɔi lɛ ni amɛkɛmamɔ asafo lɛ hiɛ.
Amɛye, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛtɔrɔ, ni akɔlɔ fufuji ni shwɛ lɛ awo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Petro ye Yesu he odase Gbi ko be ni Yesu kome sɔleɔ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ eŋɔɔ; ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ mɛi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Ni amɛto he akɛ, “Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ, ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ Elia; ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɔ akɛ, blema gbalɔi lɛ eko ete shi ekoŋŋ.” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Shi nyɛ lɛ, namɔ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ mi ji?” Ni Petro to he ekɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Kristo lɛ.” Shi etswa amɛnaa ma ni ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ amɛkatsi tã amɛkɛɛ mɔ ko.
Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Ja Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ na amanehulu babaoo, ni maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kwa lɛ, ni agbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.” Hekwamɔ Ni ekɛɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ enyiɛ misɛɛ lɛ, ekwa ehe, ni ewo esɛŋmɔtso lɛ daa gbi ni enyiɛ misɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ akɛ ebaa esusuma yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ ni laajeɔ esusuma yɛ mihewɔ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ gbɔmɔ naa kɛji ena jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ, shi eshɛ ehe efɔ̃ aloo ekpãtã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hiɛ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mi kɛ miwiemɔi lɛ ahe feɔ lɛ hiɛgbele lɛ, lɛ hu ehe aaafee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛgbele, be ni eeeba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam lɛ kɛ eTsɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ mɛi ni damɔ biɛ nɛɛ ateŋ ni amɛsaŋ amɛnaa gbele kɛyaashi beyinɔ ni amɛaana Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.” Yesu gbɔmɔtso su tsake Wiemɔi nɛɛ asɛɛ aaafee gbii kpaanyɔ lɛ Yesu ŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane kɛ Yakobo, ni ekɛ amɛ tee gɔŋ ko nɔ ni eyasɔle.
Be ni esɔleɔ lɛ, ehiɛ su tsake ni etade lɛ yɛ futaa ni ekpɛ kaŋkaŋ.
Ni naa, hii enyɔ kɛ lɛ bawie, amɛ ji Mose kɛ Elia, ni amɛbajie amɛhe kpo yɛ anunyam mli ni amɛwie ejeŋ naa ni ebaaya eyagbe yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he.
Shi wɔ ni tsii eŋɔ Petro kɛ mɛi ni fata ehe lɛ; ni be ni wɔ lɛ tserɛ yɛ amɛhiɛ kwraa lɛ, amɛna Yesu anunyam lɛ kɛ hii enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ.
Ni be ni hii lɛ kɛ lɛ gbalaa mli lɛ, Petro kɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ehi akɛ wɔhiɔ biɛ, ni hã ni wɔfee bui etɛ̃, onɔ ekome kɛ Mose nɔ ekome kɛ Elia nɔ ekome;” shi eleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ lɛ.
Be ni ewieɔ enɛ lɛ atatu ba bakete amɛnɔ; ni ekaselɔi lɛ she gbeyei be ni amɛbote atatu lɛ mli lɛ.
Ni gbee ko jɛ atatu lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji mi-Bi ni mihala lɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi!” Ni be ni gbee lɛ gbɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kome too ana.
Ni amɛfee dioo, ni nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ amɛgbaaa mɔ ko nii ni amɛna lɛ eko.
Yesu tsa gbekɛ nuu ko ni mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ yɔɔ emli Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni amɛjeɔ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkpelekeɔ shi lɛ, mɛi pii kɛ lɛ bakpe.
Ni nuu ko jɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ bo ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, miikpa bo fai, kwɛmɔ mibi lɛ, shi mibi kome ji lɛ.
Mumɔ ko mɔɔ lɛ, ni ekpakpa ko dani ejeɔ emli.
Mikpa okaselɔi lɛ fai koni amɛfã lɛ lɛ, amɛnyɛɛɛ.” Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ao yinɔbii ni heee yeee ni bɛ amɛŋɛlɛnɔ!
Mɛɛ beyinɔ mikɛ nyɛ aaahi shi, ni mato mitsui shi mahã nyɛ kɛyashi?
Kɛ obi lɛ aba biɛ!” Be ni ebaa ni eshɛko eŋɔɔ lɛ, mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ too lɛ etswa shi ni ehã eshɔ̃, shi Yesu fã mumɔ fɔ̃ŋ lɛ yi, ni etsa gbekɛ lɛ, ni eŋɔ lɛ ehã etsɛ lɛ ekoŋŋ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ hewɔ.
Yesu wie egbele lɛ he ekoŋŋ Shi be ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ efee amɛ yaa yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yesu fee lɛ he lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛhãa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ayaa nyɛtoiiaŋ; ejaakɛ aaaŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ.” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa wiemɔ nɛɛ shishi, ni akɛtee amɛ ni amɛkayoo sɛɛ, ni amɛmiishe gbeyei akɛ amɛaabi lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ he nɔ ko.
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
Shi ŋwanejee ko bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Be ni Yesu na amɛtsuiiaŋ susumɔi lɛ, ekɛ gbekɛ fioo ko badamɔ emasɛi; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hereɔ gbekɛ fioo nɛɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehereɔ mi; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni ji bibioo yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, lɛ ji agbo fe fɛɛ.” Mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo nyɛ lɛ eyɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ Ni Yohane here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔna mɔ ko kɛ ogbɛi miifa mumɔi fɔ̃ji, ni wɔtsi lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ ebɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛ osɛɛ lɛ ateŋ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkatsia lɛ gbɛ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni eteee shi ewooo nyɛ lɛ, eyɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.” Samaria maŋ ko ni hereee Yesu lɛ Be ni gbii ni abaaŋɔ Yesu lɛ kɛya ŋwɛi lɛ eshɛ etã lɛ, eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ eeya Yerusalɛm.
Ni etsu bɔfoi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ; ni amɛtee amɛyabote Samariabii amaŋ ko mli, koni amɛsaa he ko amɛto lɛ.
Shi amɛhereee lɛ, ejaakɛ eeya Yerusalɛm.
Ni be ni Yakobo kɛ Yohane, ekaselɔi lɛ, na enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, oosumɔ akɛ wɔkɛɛ ni la ajɛ ŋwɛi aba abashã amɛ?” Shi etsɔ̃ ehe ni ebɔ amɛ kɔkɔ [ni ekɛɛ, “Ani nyɛleee nɔ mumɔ ni nyɛhiɛ lɛ lo?
Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaa gbɔmɛi asusumai ahiɛkpãtãmɔ, shi moŋ amɛyiwalaheremɔ eba.”] Ni amɛtee maŋ kroko mli.
Mɛi ni taoɔ Yesu sɛɛ anyiɛ Be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ kɛyaa lɛ mɔ ko bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, manyiɛ osɛɛ kɛaatee he fɛɛ he ni oyaa.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔi yɛ bui, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji hu yɛ tsui; shi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ bɛ he ni ekɛ eyitso ŋmɛɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ mɔ kroko akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayafu mitsɛ dã.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã ni gbohii afu amɛgbohii, shi bo lɛ yaa ni oyashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ!” Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, “Manyiɛ osɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ; shi ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni maya mayashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ miwe lɛ dã.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni kɛ enine yamɔɔ tsina kɔi mli ni ekuɔ ekuɛ ekwɛɔ esɛɛ lɛ, esaaa Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.”
Yesu tsu mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ famɔ mɛi krokomɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo hu, ni etsu amɛ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ kɛtee maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ kɛ he fɛɛ he ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaaya lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nikpamɔ lɛ fa, shi nitsulɔi lɛ faaa; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkpaa nikpamɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai, koni etsu nitsulɔi kɛba enikpamɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛyaa!
Naa, miitsu nyɛ tamɔ toobii yɛ klãji ateŋ.
Nyɛkahiɛa fotro loo kotoku loo tokotai ni nyɛkaŋaa mɔ ko yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni shĩa fɛɛ shĩa ni nyɛaabote lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Hejɔlɛ aba shĩa nɛɛ!’ Ni kɛji hejɔlɛ bi ko yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛhejɔlɛ lɛ aaahi enɔ; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, eeeku esɛɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Ni nyɛhĩa nakai shĩa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ; ni nyɛye ni nyɛnu nii ni amɛaahã nyɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ nitsulɔ lɛ enyɔmɔwoo sa lɛ.
Nyɛkajɛa shĩa kɛyaa shĩa.
Ni maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛahere nyɛ lɛ, nyɛyea nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ; ni nyɛtsaa helatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ, ni nyɛkɛa amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.’ Shi maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli ni nyɛaabote ni amɛhereee nyɛ lɛ, nyɛjea jɛi nyɛyaa eblohui lɛ amli, ni nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Nyɛmaŋ nɛɛŋ mlu tete ni yɔɔ wɔnaji ahe lɛ wɔkpalaa wɔshwieɔ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ebɛŋkɛ nyɛ.’ Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaafaŋ Sodom fe nakai maŋ lɛ!’ Maji ni tsakeee amɛtsui lɛ “Kpoo hã bo, Korazin!
Kpoo hã bo, Betsaida!
Ejaakɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi ni atsu yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Tiro kɛ Sidon atsu yɛ jikulɛ amɛtara kpekpe kɛ lamlu mli amɛtsake amɛtsui jeeŋmɔ.
Shi kojomɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ aaafaŋ Tiro kɛ Sidon fe nyɛ!
Ni bo Kapernaum, ani aaawo onɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi?
Gbohiiaje tɔ̃ɔ aaaba bo shi kɛaatee!
“Mɔ ni boɔ nyɛ toi lɛ, mi toi eboɔ lɛ, ni mɔ ni kwaa nyɛ lɛ, mi ekwaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni kwaa mi lɛ, mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ekwaa lɛ.” Mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ asɛɛkuu Ni mɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛba kɛ miishɛɛ ni amɛbakɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mumɔi fɔ̃ji tete baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa wɔ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ hewɔ.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mina Satan jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi tamɔ srawa.
Naa, mihã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛnaanaa onufui kɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi kɛ henyɛlɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ; ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efeŋ nyɛ efɔ̃ŋ ko.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛkanaa enɛ he miishɛɛ, akɛ mumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa nyɛ lɛ; shi moŋ nyɛnaa miishɛɛ akɛ aŋma nyɛgbɛi yɛ ŋwɛi.” Yesu mli fili lɛ ni ejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ Yesu mli fili lɛ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli ni ekɛɛ, “Miijie oyi, Ataa; ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ oŋɔ nii nɛɛ otee nilelɔi kɛ jwɛŋlɔi, ni ojie otsɔ̃ɔ abifabii; hɛɛ, Ataa, ejaakɛ nakai sa ohiɛ.
“MiTsɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo midɛŋ, ni mɔ ko leee mɔ ni ji Bi lɛ, ja Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ hu, ja Bi lɛ kɛ mɔ ni Bi lɛ sumɔɔ akɛ ejie lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ehã ekaselɔi lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ kɔkrɔɔ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ hiŋmɛii ni naa nibii ni nyɛnaa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ gbalɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii tao akɛ amɛna nii ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, ni amɛyanaaa, ni asaŋ amɛnu nii ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ, ni amɛyanuuu.” Kitã wulu lɛ Ni naa, mlatsɔɔlɔ ko te shi damɔ shi, ni eka lɛ ekɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, mɛni mafee ni mana naanɔ wala?” Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ?
Te okaneɔ tɛŋŋ?” Ni eto he ekɛɛ, “Suɔmɔ Nuŋtsɔ oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛjɛ otsui fɛɛ kɛ osusuma fɛɛ kɛ onyɛmɔ fɛɛ kɛ ojwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ mli, kɛ onaanyo hu tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe.” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni oto he lɛ ja; feemɔ nakai, ni oyi aaana wala.” Shi lɛ lɛ, akɛni eetao ehe bem ebu hewɔ lɛ, ebi Yesu akɛ, “Ni namɔ ji minaanyo?” Samarianyo mɔbɔnalɔ lɛ Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko yiŋ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛmiiya Yeriko ni eyagbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ, ni amɛkpɔlɔ ehe atadei ni amɛtswia lɛ nii, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛshi lɛ ni egbo fã kɛ fã.
Shi eba mli akɛ osɔfo ko batsɔ̃ nakai gbɛ lɛ nɔ; shi be ni ena lɛ lɛ, egba afã kɛho.
Ni nakai nɔŋŋ Levinyo ko hu gba afã kɛho, be ni eshɛ jɛi ni ena lɛ lɛ.
Shi Samarianyo ko ni nyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ bashɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ yɛ ehe, ni etee eŋɔɔ ni eyafɔse mu kɛ wain eshwie epilamɔi lɛ anɔ ni efimɔ nɔ, ni esaa ewo lɛ eta lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekooloo lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ tee gbɔiatoohe ni eyakwɛ lɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni eyaa lɛ, ejie denarioi enyɔ ehã gbɔiatoohetsɛ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛmɔ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooosaa ofite lɛ, kɛ miku misɛɛ miba lɛ mawo bo nyɔmɔ.’ Agbɛnɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ nɛɛ ateŋ namɔ osusuɔ akɛ etsɔ̃ mɔ ni gbee ojotswalɔi ateŋ lɛ naanyo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ni na lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ ni.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo hu yaa ni oyafee nakai nɔŋŋ.” Marta kɛ Maria Be ni Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ nyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa lɛ eyabote akrowa ko mli.
Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marta lɛ kpee lɛ kɛtee ewe.
Eyɛ nyɛmi yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Maria; enyɛmi yoo nɛɛ bata Yesu najianaa ni ebo ewiemɔ toi.
Shi Marta gba ehe naa tuutu yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ pii he ni eba Yesu ŋɔɔ ebakɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ni minyɛmi lɛ eshi mi ni mi kome misɔ̃mɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee ohe sane ko ni lo?
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛɛmɔ lɛ ni ebafata mihe.” Shi Yesu to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Marta, Marta!
Oogba ohe naa, ni oohao ohe yɛ nibii pii ahe; nɔ kome ehia.
Nɔ ni hi lɛ no Maria ekɔ lɛ, ni no lɛ ashɔŋ yɛ edɛŋ.”
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔ lɛ Gbi ko lɛ Yesu miisɔle yɛ he ko; ni be ni egbe naa lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ sɔlemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yohane hu tsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛmiisɔle lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Wɔtsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, ogbɛi lɛ he atse; omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ aba.
Afee nɔ ni osumɔɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ hu; tamɔ bɔ ni afeɔ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Hã wɔ wɔdaaŋŋmaa daa gbi, ni okɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ afa wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔ hu wɔkɛfaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ.
Ni okɛ wɔ akaya kaa mli.’ ” Nyɛkãa he nyɛbia kɛyashi aaahã nyɛ Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni yɔɔ shieŋtsɛ ni eeetee eŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋteŋ, ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Shieŋtsɛ, faa mi aboloi etɛ̃, ejaakɛ mishieŋtsɛ ko ejɛ gbɛ ebato mi, ni mibɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛbaama ehiɛ’; ni mɔ ni yɔɔ tsuŋ lɛ hereŋ nɔ akɛ, ‘Kaagba minaa; aŋa shinaa lɛ momo ni mi kɛ mibii kamɔ saa nɔ, minyɛŋ shi mate ni mahã bo.’ Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ka eshieŋtsɛ ni ji lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ eteŋ shi ni ehã lɛ, shi enaagbamɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ eeete shi kɛ̃ ni eeehã lɛ bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ.
Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbia, ni aaahã nyɛ; nyɛtaoa ni nyɛaana; nyɛshia, ni aaagbele nyɛ.’ Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni biɔ lɛ, enine shɛɔ nɔ; ni mɔ ni taoɔ lɛ enaa; ni mɔ ni shiɔ lɛ aaagbele lɛ.
Shi nɛɛ tsɛ yɔɔ nyɛteŋ ni kɛji ebi bi lɛ aboloo, ni eeehã lɛ tɛ?
Aloo kɛji ebi lɛ loo lɛ, ni eeeŋɔ onufu ehã lɛ yɛ loo najiaŋ.
Aloo kɛji ebi wuɔ wɔlɔ lɛ, eeehã lɛ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro?
Belɛ kɛji nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ nyɛle bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ ni nyɛkɛ nikeenii kpakpai keɔ nyɛbii lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ nyɛTsɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ eŋɔŋ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ehaŋ mɛi ni biɔ lɛ lɛ?” Yesu kɛ Beelzebul Be ko lɛ Yesu miifã mumɔ fɔŋ ko ni ji mumui; ni eba mli akɛ, be ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je kpo lɛ, mumui lɛ wie, ni asafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Beelzebul, mumɔi fɔ̃ji alumɔ lɛ, hewalɛ naa efãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ.” Ni mɛi komɛi hu ka lɛ amɛmiitao ŋwɛi okadi ko yɛ edɛŋ.
Shi akɛni ele amɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛyeli fɛɛ maŋtsɛyeli ni gbaa woɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ ejwaa, ni tsu kumɔɔ shwieɔ tsu nɔ.
Ni kɛji Satan hu gba wo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ adamɔ shiŋ, akɛni nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ?
Shi kɛji mi lɛ, Beelzebul hewalɛ mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, namɔ nyɛbii lɛ kɛfãa amɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ amɛaakojo nyɛ.
Shi kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ wao mikɛfãa mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ, no lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Kɛ hewalɔ emia egbaja ni eebu emɔ̃ɔ he lɛ, enibii yɛ shweshweeshwe; shi kɛji mɔ ni he wa fe lɛ batua lɛ ni eye enɔ kunim lɛ, eshɔ̃ɔ etawuunii ni eŋɔɔ ehiɛ efɔ̃ɔ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ edɛŋ ni ejaa enomŋɔɔnii lɛ.
Mɔ ni bɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ ekɛ mi ena, ni mɔ ni kɛ mi buaaa naa lɛ eegbɛ eeshwã.” Mumɔ fɔŋ sɛɛkuu kɛ gbɔmɔ mli botemɔ “Kɛ mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ je gbɔmɔ mli lɛ, eyanyiɛɔ hei ni nu bɛ etaoɔ hejɔɔmɔ, ni kɛ enaaa eko lɛ, ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Maku misɛɛ matee miwe he ni mijɛ lɛ.’ Ni kɛ eba lɛ, ebanaa akɛ abɛɛ mli ni awula mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ eyaa ni eyaŋɔɔ mumɔi krokomɛi kpawo ni ji mumɔi fɔ̃ji fe lɛ efataa ehe, ni amɛyaboteɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛhiɔ jɛi, ni nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ sɛɛkpee shihilɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ efɔŋ fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ.” Anɔkwa jɔɔmɔ Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni Yesu wieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, yoo ko ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ wo egbee nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ musu ni hiɛ bo kɛ fufɔ ni oye lɛ!” Shi ehere nɔ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni nuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛyeɔ nɔ lɛ moŋ!” Farisifoi lɛ bi Yesu okadi Shi be ni asafoi lɛ ebabua amɛhe naa pii lɛ, Yesu bɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Yinɔbii nɛɛ yinɔbii fɔ̃ji ni; amɛmiitao okadi, ni ahaŋ amɛ okadi ko akɛ ja gbalɔ Yona okadi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Yona tsɔ̃ okadi hã Ninevebii lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaatsɔ̃ ahã nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ.
Wuoyigbɛ maŋnyɛ lɛ kɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli, ni eeebu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ ejɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbeehe ni ebabo Solomon nilee toi, ni naa nɔ ko ni fe Solomon nilee lɛ yɛ biɛ.
Ninevehii lɛ kɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ aaate shi yɛ kojomɔ lɛ mli ni amɛaabu amɛ fɔ, ejaakɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui yɛ Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ naa; ni naa, nɔ ko ni fe Yona shiɛmɔ lɛ yɛ biɛ.” Gbɔmɔtso lɛ kane “Mɔ ko esuuu kane emaaa kpokplobiiaŋ loo tsese shishi, shi moŋ kanetso nɔ ekɛmaa, koni mɛi ni baa shĩa lɛŋ ana ekpɛmɔ lɛ.
Ogbɔmɔtso lɛ kane ji ohiŋmɛi lɛ.
Kɛji ohiŋmɛi nɔ tse lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ hu mli tseɔ; shi kɛji ohiŋmɛi ehiii lɛ, ogbɔmɔtso lɛ hu woɔ duŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni la ni yɔɔ omli lɛ akatsɔ̃ duŋ.
Kɛji ogbɔmɔtso muu lɛ mli tse ni he ko he ko woko duŋ lɛ, tse nɔŋŋ emuu lɛ fɛɛ mli aaatse tamɔ bɔ ni kane kɛ ekpɛmɔ tsoɔ hãa bo lɛ.” Yesu wie shi Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ Ni be ni Yesu wieɔ lɛ, Farisifonyo ko bakpee lɛ akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abaye nii; ni etee shĩa lɛŋ, ni eyata niyenii lɛ ahe.
Shi be ni Farisifonyo lɛ na akɛ efɔflɔko ehe dani ebaaye nii lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Farisifoi lɛ nyɛtsumɔɔ kpulu he kɛ kã sɛɛ, shi nyɛmli eyi obɔ̃ kɛ juu kɛ fɔ̃.
Kwashiai!
Ani mɔ ni fee sɛɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ nɔŋŋ efee mli lɛ hu?
Moŋ nyɛŋɔa nibii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ nyɛfea ejurɔ, ni nibii fɛɛ he aaatse ahã nyɛ.
Shi kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisifoi, akɛ nyɛhãa kowɛ kɛ shwie kɛ bai srɔtoi fɛɛ mlijaa nyɔŋmanyɔŋma, ni nyɛshiɔ jalɛ saneyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ!
Kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ enɛɛmɛi hu nyɛkɛshiɔ ekrokomɛi lɛ anɔ.
Kpoo hã nyɛ, Farisifoi, akɛ nyɛsumɔɔ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ ŋamɔi yɛ jaji anɔ!
Kpoo hã nyɛ, akɛ nyɛtamɔ saŋi ni ejeee shi, ni mɛi ni nyiɛɔ nɔ lɛ leee!” Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛ oowie enɛɛmɛi lɛ okɛmiibɔ wɔ hu ahora.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ hu, kpoo hã nyɛ!
Akɛ nyɛkɛ jatsui ni teremɔ jaraa tereɔ mɛi, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛwao kome tete etaaa he.
Kpoo hã nyɛ akɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ gbalɔi lɛ anɔ, gbalɔi ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ gbe lɛ; belɛ nyɛmiiye nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ anitsumɔi lɛ ahe odase ni eŋɔɔ nyɛnaa; ejaakɛ amɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi nyɛ nyɛfeɔ saŋi nyɛmamɔɔ amɛnɔ.
Enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mibatsu gbalɔi kɛ bɔfoi kɛya amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛaagbe amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ni amɛaawa mɛi komɛi ayi,’ koni gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ alá ni afɔse ashwie shi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishitoo mli lɛ abi shi yɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ; kɛjɛ Habel lá lɛ nɔ kɛyashi Zakaria, mɔ ni agbe lɛ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ te lɛ mli lɛ, lá lɛ nɔ.
Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, aaabi shi yɛ nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ adɛŋ!
Kpoo hã nyɛ, mlatsɔɔlɔi, ejaakɛ nyɛkɔ nilee naa samfee!
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nyɛboteee mli, ni mɛi ni taoɔ mli abote lɛ hu, nyɛtsi amɛ gbɛ.” Ni be ni eje kpo kɛjɛ shĩa lɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi kɛ Farisifoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka lɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa saji bɛlɛmɔ babaoo, kɛmiitsɔ̃ lɛ koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ.
Osato he kɔkɔbɔɔ No mli nɔŋŋ, be ni mɛi akpeiakpei abɔ ebabua amɛhe naa ni mɛi naanaa mɛi anɔ lɛ, ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛmɔ akɛ, “Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ Farisifoi lɛ amãsha ni ji osatofeemɔ lɛ he.
Shi nɔ ko bɛ ni atsimɔ nɔ ni ajieŋ lɛ kpo, aloo ni akɛtee ni aleŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛwie yɛ duŋ mli lɛ, aaanu yɛ la hiɛ; ni nɔ ni nyɛwie ablɛbi yɛ piai amli lɛ, aaashiɛ yɛ tsui ayiteiaŋ.” Mɔ gbeyei ni sa akɛ ashe “Nyɛ, mishieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkashea mɛi ni gbeɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛaanyɛ amɛfee dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ mɔ gbeyei ni nyɛshe: nyɛshea mɔ ni kɛ egbe sɛɛ ni eyɔɔ hegbɛ akɛ eshɛɔ efɔ̃ɔ abonsamiiaje lɛ.
Hɛɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, lɛ gbeyei nyɛshea.
Ani jeee pesewai enyɔ ahɔ̃ɔ aflimatai enumɔ aheɔ?
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kpaaa amɛteŋ ekome flo nɔ.
Shi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi tete akane fɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashea gbeyei; nyɛjara wa fe aflimatai babaoo.’ ” Kristo he odaseyeli yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ “Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbaa mli tsiɔ mitã yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hu aaagba mli atsi etã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; shi mɔ ni kwaa mi yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, aaakwa lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaawie wiemɔ ko ashi Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ, akɛaafa lɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawie musubɔɔ wiemɔ ashi lɛ lɛ, akɛfaŋ lɛ.
Shi kɛ amɛkpala nyɛ kɛtee kpeehei lɛ kɛ lumɛi kɛ ogai ahiɛ lɛ, nyɛkahaoa yɛ bɔ ni nyɛaajie nyɛnaa nyɛhã aloo nɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ he, ejaakɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ, nɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛkɛɛ.” Niiatsɛ kwashia lɛ he abɛ lɛ Ni mɔ ko jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kɛɛmɔ minyɛmi lɛ ni ekɛ mi aja gboshinii lɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naanyo, namɔ womi kojolɔ loo nijalɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ ni nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ hiɛjoomɔi srɔtoi fɛɛ ahe; ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ nii ni ena ni eteke nɔ lɛ mli ewala yɔɔ.” Ni ebu amɛ abɛ ekɛɛ, “Nuu niiatsɛ ko shikpɔŋ ba nii babaoo.
