Ni esusu he ni ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Te mafee tɛŋŋ, akɛni mibɛ he ni mikɛ minibanii lɛ baato nɛɛ?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nɔ ni mafee nɛ: mibakumɔ miboŋoi lɛ mashwie shi, ni mamamɔ ewuji ni mato minibaanii kɛ minii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jɛi; ni makɛɛ misusuma akɛ, susuma, oyɛ nii kpakpai babaoo ni akɛto ahã bo afii pii; jɔɔmɔ ohe, ye ni onu, ni ona tsuijurɔ.’ Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwashia, nyɔɔŋ nɛɛŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ abaabi osusuma shi yɛ odɛ̃ŋ; ni nibii ni osaa oto lɛ, namɔ nɔ eeetsɔ̃?’ Nakai mɔ ni bɔɔ jwetri ehãa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi ejeee niiatsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ yɔɔ.” Henaagbamɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nyɛwala he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaaye hewɔ, aloo yɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ he, yɛ nɔ ni nyɛaawo hewɔ; ejaakɛ susuma lɛ fe ŋmaa, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu fe atade.
Nyɛjwɛŋa kwãakwãalabitei lɛ ahe, ejaakɛ amɛduuu nii, asaŋ amɛkpaaa nii, ni amɛbɛ nitoohe loo aboŋo po, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛɔ amɛ; nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛjara wa aahu fe loofɔji!
Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ aaanyɛ atsa ekɛlɛ naa ninetalɔ kome?
Shi kɛji nyɛnyɛɛɛ nɔ ni ji bibioo fe fɛɛ nyɛfee lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛgbaa nyɛhe naa yɛ nii ni eshwɛ lɛ ahe mɔ?
Nyɛjwɛŋa fɔfɔii lɛ ahe, amɛtsɛ̃ɛɛ kpãa; asaŋ amɛlooo mama; shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Solomon kɛ enunyam lɛ fɛɛ tete ewulaaa tamɔ enɛɛmɛi ateŋ ekome.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji jwɛi ni ŋmɛnɛ lɛ eyɛ ŋa nɔ ni wɔ ni akɛwo flɔnɔɔ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wulaa nɛkɛ lɛ, ani ewulaŋ nyɛ aahu fe amɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli faaa?
Shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkadia nɔ ni nyɛaaye aloo nɔ ni nyɛaanu sɛɛ, ni asaŋ nyɛkafea yeyeeye; ejaakɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ diɔ; shi nyɛTsɛ lɛ le akɛ nii nɛɛ ahe miihia nyɛ.
Moŋ nyɛtaoa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni aaaŋɔ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ afata he ahã nyɛ.
“Kaashe gbeyei, kuu bibioo; ejaakɛ nyɛTsɛ lɛ yɛ he tsuijurɔ akɛ eeeŋɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ehã nyɛ.
Nyɛhɔ̃a nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ ni nyɛkɛfea ejurɔ; nyɛfea fotroi ni tsɔ̃mɔɔɔ ememeji nyɛhãa nyɛhe, nyɛtoa jwetri ni etãaa yɛ ŋwɛi, he ni julɔ ko bɛŋkɛɛɛ ni omlɛgɛ kpeee nii yɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni nyɛjwetri lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi nyɛtsui hu aaahi.” Tsuji anɔkwafoi “Nyɛfea klalo, ni nyɛhãa nyɛkanei lɛ atsoa; ni nyɛfea tamɔ mɛi ni kwɛɔ amɛnuŋtsɔ gbɛ, be mli ni eeejɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eeba, koni, kɛ eba ni ebashi lɛ, ni amɛgbele lɛ oya.
Ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ ni be ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ eeebanina amɛ akɛ amɛmiishi kpe lɛ!
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeemĩa, ni eeehã amɛtara niyenii ahe, ni eeeba ebasɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
Ni kɛji eba yɛ buube ni ji enyɔ aloo nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ mli ni ebanina amɛ nakai lɛ, ajɔɔ nakai tsuji lɛ!
Shi nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, kɛji shĩatsɛ le nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni julɔ lɛ baa lɛ, kulɛ eeebu ni eŋmɛŋ gbɛ ni agbu eshĩa lɛ awoŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa, ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛhiɛ kãaa nɔ lɛ nɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baaba.” Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔ kɛkɛ obuɔ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi lɛ fɛɛ?” Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Shi namɔ mɔ ji tsulɔnukpa anɔkwafo kɛ nilelɔ, ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaawo lɛ onukpa yɛ ewebii anɔ, koni ehã amɛ amɛniyenii yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ?
Ajɔɔ nakai tsulɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ enuŋtsɔ lɛ ba ni eeebanina lɛ akɛ eefee nakai lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ eeewo lɛ onukpa yɛ enibii fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi kɛji nakai tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Minuŋtsɔ lɛ miihã ebaabe lɛ miigbala shi’ ni eeebɔ̃i wehii kɛ weyei lɛ yii kɛ niyeli kɛ numɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ lɛ, nakai tsulɔ lɛ nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba yɛ gbi nɔ ni ekwɛɛɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni eleee, ni eeefo emli enyɔ ni eeehã lɛ egbɛfaŋnɔ yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ.
“Shi nakai tsulɔ lɛ ni le enuŋtsɔ suɔmɔnaanii ni esaaa ehe etooo ni esaa efeee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ aaayi lɛ kpãi pii; shi mɔ ni leee ni eyafee yiinii lɛ, aaayi lɛ fioo.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋɔ pii ahã lɛ, pii aaatao yɛ edɛŋ; ni mɔ ni atu pii awo edɛŋ lɛ, aaabi nɔ ni teke nɔ shi yɛ edɛŋ.” Jeee hejɔlɛ shi mligbalamɔ “Lawoo miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mina ni kulɛ ehere momo!
Shi miyɛ baptisimɔ ko ni akɛbaabaptisi mi, ni kwɛ bɔ ni mihe hiaa mi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe naa!
“Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ hejɔlɛ hãmɔ miba yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, dabida, shi mligbalamɔ moŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ benɛ kɛyaa nɛɛ mɛi enumɔ aaagba yɛ shĩa kome, mɛi etɛ̃ aaate shi awo mɛi enyɔ, ni mɛi enyɔ hu aaate shi awo mɛi etɛ̃.
Mligbalamɔ aaaba tsɛ kɛ ebinuu, kɛ binuu hu kɛ etsɛ teŋ; nyɛ kɛ biyoo kɛ biyoo hu kɛ nyɛ teŋ; shaayoo kɛ shaayoo, ebi ŋa lɛ, teŋ, kɛ lɛ hu kɛ eshaayoo, ewu nyɛ lɛ, teŋ.” Bei lɛ ahe nilee Ni ekɛɛ asafoi lɛ hu akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛna akɛ atatu miiwo yɛ anai lɛ, amrɔ lɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ baanɛ;’ ni ebaa mli nakai; ni kɛ wuoyi kɔɔyɔɔ miitswa lɛ, nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Latsaa baaba;’ ni ebaa mli nakai.
Osatofoi, nyɛle atatuiaŋ kɛ shikpɔŋ nibii ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ; shi te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛleee yinɔ nɛɛ shishitsɔɔmɔŋ?
Okɛ obelɔ lɛ atsa “Ni mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkojooo nɔ ni ja gbɛ nyɛhãaa nyɛhe lɛ?
Shi kɛ okɛ obelɔ miiya lumɔ hiɛ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ lɛ asaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ, koni ekashãtã bo eyahã kojolɔ lɛ, ni kojolɔ lɛ hu ŋɔ bo ehã apãbɔlɔ lɛ hu, ni apãbɔlɔ lɛ wo bo tsuŋ.
Miikɛɛ bo akɛ, ojeŋ jɛi gbi ko gbi ko ja owo onaagbee pesewa lɛ dã.”
Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛhiɛ akakpãtã Nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ jɛi ni gba lɛ Galileabii ni Pilato kɛ amɛlá futu amɛfɔlei lɛ amli lɛ ahe sane.
Ni Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nɛkɛ Galileabii nɛɛ eshafeelɔi ji amɛ fe Galileabii krokomɛi lɛ fɛɛ, hewɔ ni amɛna nɛkɛ amanehulu nɛɛ?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai, shi moŋ kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ.
Aloo nyɛsusuɔ akɛ, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ lɛ ni Siloam mɔɔ lɛ ku shwie amɛnɔ ni egbe amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛ ji nɔtɔ̃lɔi fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ ebɛ mli nakai, shi moŋ, kɛ nyɛtsakeee nyɛtsui lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ baakpãtã nakai nɔŋŋ.” Agbãmitso lɛ he abɛ lɛ Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ko tɛo agbãmitso yɛ ewaintrom mli ni eba enɔ yibii taomɔ lɛ, enaaa eko.
Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ tromsaalɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, afii etɛ̃ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ mibaa mibataoɔ yibii yɛ agbãmitso nɛɛ nɔ, shi minaaa eko.
Toomɔ ofɔ̃ shi!
Mɛɛba hu ni egbeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ?’ Shi tromsaalɔ lɛ here nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, hã ni ehi shi afi nɛɛ hu, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni matsa ehewɔ kɛkpe ni mawo eshishi tumo, akɛ aleenɔ eeewo yibii afi nɛɛ lo; shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, dani otoo lɛ ofɔ̃ shi.’ ” Yoo ni edɔ kɔmɔɔ lɛ tsamɔ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ eko nɔ lɛ, eetsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ eko.
Yoo ko yɛ jɛi ni mumɔ ni hãa mɔ gbɔjɔɔ ehi emli afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ, ni edɔ kɔmɔɔ, ni enyɛɛɛ emli ekpã kwraa po.
Be ni Yesu na lɛ lɛ, etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yoo, afɛne bo kɛjɛ ohela lɛ mli!” Ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ yoo lɛ jaje trɔmɔɔ, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Shi kpeehe onukpa lɛ mli wo la akɛni Yesu tsa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ asafo lɛ akɛ, “Gbii ekpaa yɔɔ ni sa akɛ atsuɔ nii yɛ mli no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛbaa yɛ nomɛi amli, koni atsa nyɛ, shi jeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ!” Kɛkɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ here lɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Osatofoi!
Ani hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ fɛneee etsina loo eteji yɛ niyenii anɔ he ekpalaaa lɛ eyahãaa lɛ nu lo?
Shi nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ ni ji Abraham biyoo ni Satan efi lɛ nɛkɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ kpaanyɔ nɛɛ lɛ, ani ejaaa akɛ afɛneɔ lɛ yɛ nɛkɛ kpãa nɛɛ mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lo?” Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ehenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ gboi, ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ yɛ anunyam nibii ni efee lɛ fɛɛ hewɔ.
Sinapi wu kɛ masha lɛ Agbɛnɛ ekɛɛ, “Mɛni Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ, ni mɛni he mikɛaato?
Etamɔ sinapi wu kuli ni nuu ko kɔ ni eyadu yɛ etrom mli, ni ekwɛ̃, ni efee tso kpele, ni ŋwɛi loofɔji ba bafee tsui yɛ eniji ateŋ.” Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mɛni he mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaato?
Etamɔ masha ni yoo ko kɔ ni ekɛhɔ ma tsesei etɛ̃ amli kɛyashi beyinɔ ni fɛɛ sha.” Agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ Ni eyakpa maji kɛ akrowai amli etsɔ̃ɔ nii, ni etse mli kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm.
Ni mɔ ko bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani mɛi fioo kɛkɛ yiwala abaahere?” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛpelea agbo fintɔŋŋ lɛ mlibotemɔ he, ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɛi pii aaatao mli abote shi amɛnyɛŋ.
Be mli ni shĩatsɛ lɛ ete shi eyaŋa shinaa lɛ, ni nyɛaabɔ̃i sɛɛdaamɔ kɛ shinaa lɛ shimɔ, ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, Nuŋtsɔ, gbelemɔ wɔ!’ lɛ, eeehere nɔ ekɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mileee he ni nyɛjɛ.’ No lɛ nyɛbaabɔ̃i kɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔye nii ni wɔnu nii yɛ ohiɛ, ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ wɔblohui amli.’ Ni eeekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mileee he ni nyɛjɛ; nyɛjea minɔ nyɛyaa, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛtsuɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ!’ Jɛi yaafo kɛ nyanyɔji ashishikpemɔ aaahi, be ni nyɛaana Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob kɛ gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, ashwie nyɛ kɛje kpo lɛ.
Ni mɛi aaajɛ bokã kɛ anai kɛ kooyi kɛ wuoyigbɛ aaaba ni amɛaabatara okplɔ̃ he yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni naa, sɛɛkpeebii yɛ ni baatsɔ̃mɔ klɛŋklɛŋbii, ni klɛŋklɛŋbii hu yɛ ni baatsɔ̃mɔ sɛɛkpeebii.” Yesu fo shwie Yerusalɛm nɔ Nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ Farisifoi lɛ ekomɛi ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee biɛ nɛɛ ni oya, ejaakɛ Herode miitao bo agbe.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyakɛa nakai osɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, miifãmɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ni miitsa mɛi ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ magbe naa.’ Shi kɛ̃lɛ ja minyiɛ ŋmɛnɛ kɛ wɔ kɛ wɔsɛɛ, ejaakɛ ebaŋ mli akɛ aaagbe gbalɔ ko yɛ he ko akɛ ja Yerusalɛm.
Yerusalɛm, Yerusalɛm, bo mɔ ni ogbeɔ gbalɔi lɛ ni otswiaa mɛi ni atsuɔ amɛ oŋɔɔ lɛ atɛi, shii enyiɛ mitao akɛ mibuaa obii anaa, tamɔ bɔ ni wuɔ buaa ebii anaa ewoɔ efiji ashishi lɛ, ni nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ!
Naa, ashi nyɛwe lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ahã nyɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli’ lɛ.”
Yesu tsa nuu ko ni yeɔ fuumɔhela Be ni Yesu tee niyeli yɛ Farisifoi lɛ anukpai lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome we yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛwɔɔ lɛ.
Nuu ko yɛ ehiɛ ni eeye fuumɔhela.
Ni Yesu bi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ akɛ, “Ani eja gbɛ akɛ atsaa mɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ aloo ejaaa gbɛ?” Shi amɛhãaa lɛ hetoo.
Kɛkɛ ni emɔ helatsɛ lɛ mli ni etsa lɛ, ni ejie lɛ gbɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ kɛji eteji loo etsina yagbee nubu mli yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni eyajieŋ lɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ?” Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ lɛ enɛɛmɛi ahetoo amɛhã.
Ohiafoi ejurɔfeemɔ kɛ heshibaa he nitsɔɔmɔ Ni be ni eyoo bɔ ni amɛhalaa onukpai ataramɔhei lɛ, ebu mɛi ni akpee lɛ abɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko bakpee bo kɛtee yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ he lɛ, kaayata yitso gbɛ, ekolɛ aleee nɔ ekpee mɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe bo, ni mɔ ni bakpee bo kɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ akaba ni ebakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Hã mɔ nɛ gbɛ!’ No lɛ okɛ hiɛgbele aaayata shishi gbɛ.
Shi moŋ, kɛji akpee bo lɛ, yaa ni oyata shishi gbɛ, koni kɛ mɔ ni bakpee bo lɛ ba lɛ, ebakɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Shieŋtsɛ, ba yitso gbɛ.’ No lɛ ohiɛ aaaba nyam yɛ mɛi ni okɛtara shi lɛ fɛɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ, aaaba lɛ shi, ni mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ mɔ ni kpee lɛ lɛ hu akɛ, “Kɛ oŋmɛ shwane loo gbɛkɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kaatsɛ oshieŋtsɛmɛi loo onyɛmimɛi loo owekumɛi loo okutsoŋ niiatsɛmɛi ni aleenɔ amɛ hu amɛkpee bo eko amɛto najiaŋ.
Shi kɛ oŋmɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, kpeemɔ ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛ shwilafoi moŋ, ni aaajɔɔ bo, akɛni amɛ lɛ amɛbɛ nɔ ko ni amɛkɛaato bo najiaŋ lɛ; ejaakɛ aaato bo najiaŋ yɛ jalɔi ashitee lɛ mli.” Okplɔŋmɛɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara niyenii ashi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nu nii nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!” Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuu ko ŋmɛ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple, ni ekpee mɛi pii; ni be ni shɛ niyeli be lɛ, etsu etsulɔ akɛ eyakɛɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbaa, ejaakɛ agbe nibii lɛ fɛɛ naa.’ Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ̃i enaa jiemɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ ‘Mihe shikpɔŋ ko ni ehia akɛ maya ni mayakwɛ; miikpa bo fai ni ona ohã mi.’ “Ni mɔ kroko kɛɛ, ‘Mihe tsina ntai enumɔ, ni miiya mayaka amɛ makwɛ; miikpa bo fai ni ona ohã mi.’ Ni mɔ kroko hu kɛɛ, ‘Mikpee yoo, ni no hewɔ lɛ, minyɛŋ maba.’ Ni tsulɔ lɛ ba ni ebagba enuŋtsɔ lɛ nii nɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni shĩatsɛ lɛ mli fu, ni ekɛɛ etsulɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jee kpo mramra kɛya maŋ lɛ mli blohui lɛ kɛ fɔji lɛ amli, ni oyakpee ohiafoi kɛ kpajelɔi kɛ shwilafoi kɛ akpaketsɛmɛi kɛba biɛ!’ Ni tsulɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, afee bɔ ni okɛɛ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ gbɛ yɛ lolo.’ Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ tsulɔ lɛ akɛ ‘Jee kpo oya gbɛjegbɛi lɛ anɔ kɛ afãbai lɛ ahe ni oyanyɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛba, koni miwe lɛ ayi tɔ.
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ mɛi ni akpee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko sa miniyenii lɛ anaa fii!’ ” Yesu sɛɛnyiɛmɔ biɔ hekwamɔ Be ko be ni mɛi pii kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miiba miŋɔɔ ni enyɛɛɛ etsɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ eŋa kɛ ebii kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii kɛ enyɛmimɛi yei kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esusuma hu tete lɛ, enyɛŋ etsɔ̃ mikaselɔ.
Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tereee esɛŋmɔtso kɛnyiɛɛɛ misɛɛ lɛ, enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eetao mɔɔ ema lɛ, etaŋ shi ni ebu naa ekwɛ dã akɛ eyɛ nii bɔ ni ekɛaagbe naa lo?
Koni ekaba akɛ be ni eje shishi ni eyanyɛɛɛ naa egbe lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ ni na lɛ babɔ̃i ehefɛoyeli akɛ, ‘Nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ bɔ̃i mɔɔ maa, shi enyɛɛɛ naa egbe.’ Aloo mɛɛ maŋtsɛ ni kɛji ekɛ maŋtsɛ kroko yaawu lɛ etaŋ shi ni esusu he dã akɛ eeenyɛ ekɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋma kɛ mɔ ni kɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ baa eŋɔɔ lɛ ayakpe lo?
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, be ni mɔ kome lɛ nyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, eeetsu bɔfoi kɛya eŋɔɔ eyakpa kpãtãmɔ he fai.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwaaa nibii fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ lɛ enyɛŋ mikaselɔ etsɔ̃.” Ŋoo ni naanu egbo “Ŋoo hi; shi kɛji ŋoo naanu gbo lɛ, mɛni akɛaawo lɛ ŋoo dɔŋŋ?
Esaaa shikpɔŋ loo tumo nɔ tete; tsi atsiɔ ashwieɔ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu!”
Too ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ Agbɛnɛ toohelɔi kɛ eshafeelɔi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i tsimɔ kɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛmɔ ni amɛbabo lɛ toi.
Shi Farisifoi kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ hereɔ eshafeelɔi atuu ni ekɛ amɛ yeɔ nii.” Ni ebu amɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛteŋ namɔ ni kɛji eyɛ toi oha ni amɛteŋ ekome laaje lɛ, eshiŋ nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni eyatao nɔ ni elaaje lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena lɛ?
Ni kɛ ena lɛ lɛ, ewoɔ lɛ etswaa ekɔ̃ŋ, ni enaa miishɛɛ; ni kɛ eba shĩa lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋbii kɛkpeɔ, ni ekɛɔ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mitoo ni laaje lɛ.’ Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nakai nɔŋŋ miishɛɛ aaaba ŋwɛi yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ fe jalɔi nyɔŋmai nɛɛhu kɛ nɛɛhu ni tsuitsakemɔ he ehiaaa amɛ lɛ.” Jwiɛtɛi kuku ni laaje lɛ he abɛ lɛ “Aloo mɛɛ yoo ni yɔɔ jwiɛtɛi kukuji nyɔŋma, ni kɛji kuku kome laaje lɛ, ni esuŋ kane ni ebɛɛ shĩa lɛ mli fitsofitso ni etao kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeena?
Ni kɛ ena lɛ, etsɛɔ eshieŋtsɛmɛi kɛ ekuŋbii kɛkpeɔ ni ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛ mi anaa miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mina mijwiɛtɛi kuku ni laaje lɛ.’ Nakai nɔŋŋ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ naa miishɛɛ yɛ eshafeelɔ kome ni tsakeɔ etsui lɛ hewɔ.” Bi nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ Yesu saa ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko yɛ bihii enyɔ.
Ni amɛteŋ gbekɛ̃ lɛ kɛɛ etsɛ akɛ, ‘Ataa, hã mi onii lɛ amli nɔ ni ji migbɛfaŋnɔ.’ Ni eja nii lɛ amli ehã amɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, yeee gbi ko kɛkɛ ni gbekɛ̃ lɛ bua fɛɛ naa, ni edom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ he ko, ni jɛi ekɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ yakpãtã enii lɛ ahiɛ yɛ.
Shi be ni efite fɛɛ lɛ, hɔ̃mɔ ni naa wa ko bate shi yɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni ebɔ̃i lɛ fimɔ.
Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe yakpɛtɛ nakai shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ eko he; ni ehã etee ebɔi lɛ amli ni eyalɛ kplotoi.
Ni eba etsine akɛ kulɛ ena yɔɔ ni kplotoi lɛ yeɔ lɛ eko eye ni etɔ, shi mɔ ko hãaa lɛ.
Shi be ni ehiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, ‘Apaafoi enyiɛ mitsɛ bɛ ni naa niyenii yeɔ ni eko shwɛɔ, ni hɔ̃mɔ gbeɔ mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ!
Mate shi matee mitsɛ ŋɔɔ ni mayakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha mishi bo, ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ; ŋɔɔ mi ofee tamɔ opaafoi lɛ eko.” ’ Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ eba etsɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi be ni enyiɛ shɔŋŋ kɛbaa lɛ, etsɛ na lɛ, ni emusuŋ tsɔ̃ lɛ, ni esha foi ni eyafua lɛ atuu, ni eshwɔshwɔɔ enaa.
Ni ebi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Ataa, mifee Nyɔŋmɔ shishi esha ni mifee esha, mishi bo, ni misaaa mɔ ni atsɛɔ mi obi dɔŋŋ!’ Shi tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ etsuji lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛyajiea atade ni yɔɔ fɛo fe fɛɛ lɛ kɛbaa mramra, ni nyɛkɛbawoa lɛ, ni nyɛwo enine kpotia kɛ enaji hu tokotai; ni nyɛkɛ tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ abaa nyɛbagbea, ni nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnaa tsuijurɔ; ejaakɛ mibi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ; elaaje, ni ana lɛ.’ Ni amɛbɔ̃i nyamɔ.
“Shi ebi nukpa lɛ yɛ ŋmɔshi.
Ni be ni ebaa ni ebabɛŋkɛ shĩa lɛ, enu saŋkui kɛ joi ahe, ni etsɛ tsuji lɛ eko kɛba, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni afeɔ nɛɛ?’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Onyɛmi lɛ eba, ni otsɛ egbe tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eshɛ edɛŋ kpiŋtiŋŋ.’ Ni bi nukpa lɛ mli fu, ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ shĩa lɛ yaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, etsɛ je kpo ni ebakpa lɛ fai.
Shi ehere nɔ ni ekɛɛ etsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kwɛ afii abɔ sɔŋŋ ni misɔ̃mɔ bo, ni mitɔ̃ko okitã ko nɔ dã, ni mi lɛ, ohãko mi too abotiabi po dã, koni mi kɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ana tsuijurɔ; shi ŋmɛnɛ ni nɛkɛ obi nɛɛ ni kɛ ajwamãŋi eyaye onii lɛ ba lɛ, ogbe tsinabi ni ewo fɔ lɛ ohã lɛ.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mibi, bo lɛ, okɛ mi yɔɔ daa nɛɛ, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ onɔŋ; shi esa akɛ wɔnya ni wɔmii ashɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ onyɛmi nɛɛ gbo, ni ehiɛ etsɛ̃ ekoŋŋ, elaaje, ni ana lɛ.’ ”
Tsulɔnukpa kutumpɔfo lɛ he abɛ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Niiatsɛ ko ni yɔɔ, ni eyɛ tsulɔnukpa, ni abafolɔ enaa ahã lɛ akɛ eekpãtã enii ahiɛ.
Ni etsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛni minuɔ yɛ ohe nɛɛ?
Baabu onukpayeli lɛ he akɔntaa ejaakɛ onyɛŋ onukpa lɛ oye dɔŋŋ.’ Ni tsulɔnukpa lɛ kɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Akɛni minuŋtsɔ shɔ̃ɔ onukpayeli lɛ yɛ midɛŋ nɛɛ, te mafee tɛŋŋ?
Minyɛŋ shi matsa, ni sisɛ̃mɔ hu miifee mi hiɛgbele.
Mile nɔ ni mafee ni kɛ akpa mi onukpayeli lɛ ni mɛi ahere mi yɛ amɛshĩaiaŋ.’ Ni etsɛ enuŋtsɔ nyɔjiatsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛba ekomekome, ni ebi klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔmɔ enyiɛ ohiɛ minuŋtsɔ lɛ?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mu tɔi oha.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni ota shi mramra ni oŋma nyɔŋmai enumɔ.’ No sɛɛ lɛ, ebi mɔ kroko hu akɛ, ‘Shi bo hu enyiɛ ohiɛ?’ Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Ŋmaa flɔtɔi oha.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Hemɔ owolo lɛ ni oŋma nyɔŋmai kpaanyɔ.’ Ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie tsulɔnukpa kutumpɔfo lɛ yi akɛ eye sane lɛ ŋaa mli.
Ejaakɛ je nɛɛŋ bii lɛ kɛ amɛyinɔbii lɛ yeɔ yɛ ŋaa mli fe la bii lɛ.
“Ni mi hu miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛŋɔa kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ nyɛkɛfea shieŋtsɛmɛi nyɛhãa nyɛhe, koni, be ni nyɛbɛ nɔ ko dɔŋŋ lɛ, amɛhere nyɛ yɛ naanɔ bui lɛ amli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ ko bibioo mli anɔkwa lɛ, eyeɔ babaoo hu mli anɔkwa; ni mɔ ni yeee nɔ ko bibioo mli anɔkwa lɛ, eyeee babaoo hu mli anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛyeko kutumpɔo ninamɔ lɛ po mli anɔkwa lɛ, nɔ ni ji anɔkwa ninamɔ lɛ, namɔ aaatu no awo nyɛdɛŋ?
Ni kɛ nyɛyeko mɔ kroko nɔ mli anɔkwa lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, namɔ kɛaahã nyɛ?
Wenuu ko nyɛŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi enyɔ asɔ̃mɔ; ejaakɛ no lɛ eeenyɛ mɔ kome ni eeesumɔ mɔ kome lɛ, aloo eeekpɛtɛ mɔ kome he, ni eeegbe mɔ kome lɛ he guɔ.
Nyɛnyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ ninamɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔ.” Yesu kã Farisifoi lɛ ahiɛ Farisifoi lɛ hu ni ji shika suɔlɔi lɛ nu nii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni amɛye lɛ ahi.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ ji mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ nyɛhe bem yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ele nyɛtsuiaŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni ji gojoo yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ nihiinii ni.
“Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɔɔ nɔ kɛbashi Yohane nɔ; kɛjɛ nakai be lɛ nɔ nɛɛ aashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ boteɔ mli ekãa naa.
Shi ejaraaa akɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya fe nɔ ni Mla lɛ mli kuli kome aaaje mli.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ eŋa ni eyaŋɔɔ mɔ kroko lɛ efite gbãlã, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mɔ ni ewu eshwie lɛ lɛ, lɛ hu efite gbãlã.” Niiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Lazaro “Nuu niiatsɛ ko ni yɔɔ, ni ewoɔ atade tsuru kɛ atade yɛŋ fɛɛfɛo, ni ekɛ ŋɔɔmɔnii kpakpai ayeli naa tsuijurɔ daa gbi.
Ni ohiafo ko hu yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni akɛ lɛ ebaŋmɛ egbo lɛ naa kɛ ehe faji obɔ̃, ni ebaa etsine akɛ ena ŋmaa fufuji ni jɛɔ niiatsɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ shwieɔ shi lɛ eye; shi gbei tete baa balɛmɔ̃ɔ efaji lɛ anɔ.
Ni ohiafo lɛ bagbo, ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi bawo lɛ kɛtee Abraham mlishi; ni niiatsɛ lɛ hu bagbo ni afu lɛ.
Ni be ni eyɔɔ hejaramɔi amli yɛ gbohiiaje ni eyaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ, ena Abraham yɛ shɔŋŋ, kɛ Lazaro ni hɔ emlishi.
Ni ebo ekɛɛ, ‘Ataa Abraham, naa mi mɔbɔ ni otsu Lazaro ni ekɛ ewao naa ayatsɔ nu mli ni ekɛbajɔɔ mililɛi he, ejaakɛ miina nɔ yɛ lalilɛii nɛɛ amli!’ Shi Abraham kɛɛ, ‘Mibi, kaimɔ akɛ bo lɛ oye ejurɔ yɛ owalabe mli, shi Lazaro na nɔ; shi agbɛnɛ aashɛje emii yɛ biɛ, ni bo lɛ, aapiŋ bo.
Ni enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ hu lɛ, jɔɔ kpeteŋkple ko kã wɔ kɛ nyɛ teŋ, koni mɛi ni taoɔ ajɛ biɛ aya nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ, ni mɛi hu ni taoɔ ajɛ afoŋ kɛba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ akanyɛ.’ Shi niiatsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Belɛ miikpa bo fai mɔ, ataa, ni otsu lɛ mitsɛ we lɛ; ejaakɛ miyɛ nyɛmimɛi enumɔ, bɔ ni afee ni eyaye odase kɛbɔ amɛ kɔkɔ koni amɛ hu amɛkaba piŋmɔhe nɛɛ.’ Ni Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Amɛyɛ Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi; amɛbo amɛ toi!’ Shi lɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Dabi, Ataa Abraham, shi kɛji mɔ ko jɛ gbohii ateŋ tee amɛŋɔɔ lɛ, no amɛaatsake amɛtsui.’ Shi Abraham kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbooo Mose kɛ gbalɔi lɛ toi lɛ, no lɛ kɛji mɔ ko te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ tete lɛ, amɛyiŋ tsɔŋ.’ ”
Nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Be fɛɛ be ni fee lɛ nibii ni hãa nane tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ baaba; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa lɛ!
Aaawa ahã lɛ fe nɔ ni akɛ teji wiɛ ŋmɔ ekuɛ ni ayashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ kɛji mɔ ko tɔ̃tɔ̃ bibii nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ kome nane lɛ.” Mɔ kɛ enyɛmi ni etɔ̃ enɔ teŋ saamɔ “Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahia!
Kɛji onyɛmi tɔ̃ onɔ lɛ, kã ehiɛ; ni kɛji eshwa ehe lɛ kɛfa lɛ.
Ni kɛji etɔ̃ onɔ shii kpawo gbi kome, ni shii kpawo hu gbi kome esaa eku esɛɛ kɛba oŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Mishwa mihe’ lɛ, kɛfa lɛ.” Hemɔkɛyeli Ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Fatamɔ wɔhemɔkɛyeli he ohã wɔ!” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Kɛji nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli tamɔ sinapi wu kuli lɛ, kulɛ nyɛaakɛɛ oduŋ nɛɛ akɛ, ‘Fãa kɛ oshishifãi ni oyama ŋshɔŋ!’ Ni eeebo nyɛ toi.” Tsulɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔ “Shi nyɛteŋ namɔ yɔɔ tsulɔ ni ekɛ tsina kɔi miihu aloo eekwɛ kooloi, ni kɛji ejɛ ŋmɔshi eba pɛ lɛ, eeekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Baata shi mramra ni oye nii,’ shi ekɛŋ lɛ moŋ akɛ, ‘Too nii ohã mi ni omĩa koni osɔ̃mɔ mi kɛyashi maye nii ni manu nɔ ko; no sɛɛ koni bo hu oye nii ni onu nɔ ko lo?’ Ani eeeda nakai tsulɔ lɛ shi akɛ efee nɔ ni afã lɛ lɛ?
Mikpaaa shi.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, kɛ nyɛfee nibii fɛɛ ni afã nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛa akɛ, ‘Tsuji ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko ji wɔ; nɔ ni ji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔtsuɔ lɛ, no pɛ wɔtsu nɛɛ.’ ” Kpitiyelɔi nyɔŋma lɛ atsamɔ Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enyiɛ gbɛ kɛyaa Yerusalɛm lɛ, eyatsɔ̃ Samaria kɛ Galilea teŋ.
Ni be ni eyabote maŋ ko mli lɛ, hii kpitiyelɔi nyɔŋma kɛ lɛ kpe; ni amɛdamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, naa wɔ mɔbɔ!” Ni be ni ena amɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ayatsɔ̃a osɔfoi lɛ.” Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni amɛyaa lɛ, amɛhe tã.
Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ, be ni ena akɛ atsa lɛ lɛ, eku esɛɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa bawo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Ni ekɛ ehiɛ babu shi yɛ Yesu najianaa ni eda lɛ shi.
Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ Samarianyo ni.
Ni Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɛi nyɔŋma he tã lɛ?
Shi mɛi nɛɛhu lɛ, nɛgbɛ amɛyɔɔ?
Aso anaaa amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni kuɔ esɛɛ ekɛ anunyam bahãa Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ ja maŋsɛɛnyo nɛɛ?
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tee shi ni oya; ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo!’ ” Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ, eyɛ nyɛteŋ Ni Farisifoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Te be ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaba lɛ?” Eto he ehã amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baaa tamɔ nɔ ko ni anaa; ni asaŋ amɛkɛŋ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ!
Loo biɛ!’ Ejaakɛ naa, Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eyɛ nyɛteŋ.” Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbi lɛ Ni Yesu kɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Gbii aaaba ni nyɛaashwe ni nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ ekome, ni nyɛnaŋ.
Ni amɛaakɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, ‘Naa, eyɛ biɛ loo eyɛ jɛi!’ Nyɛkayaa ni nyɛkanyiɛa sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni kɛ srawa gba ni ekpɛɔ nyram kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi afã kome kɛyaa afã kroko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baatamɔ yɛ egbi lɛ nɔ.
Shi klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ ja ena amanehulu babaoo ni nɛkɛ yinɔbii nɛɛ kwa lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni eba yɛ Noa gbii lɛ amli lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ebaaba yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ gbii lɛ amli hu; amɛmiiyeyee nii, amɛmiinunuu dãi, amɛmiiŋɔŋɔɔ yei, ni akɛ yei miihãhãa gbãlã kɛyaashi gbi nɔ ni Noa bote adeka lɛ mli ni nu afua lɛ ba ni ebakpãtã amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Etamɔ bɔ ni eba yɛ Lot gbii lɛ amli hu lɛ, Amɛmiiyeyee nii, amɛmiinunuu dãi, amɛmiihehee nii amɛmiihɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ nii, amɛmiitɛo tsei ni amɛmiimamɔmamɔɔ tsui; shi gbi nɔ ni Lot je Sodom lɛ, la kɛ swɔɔ nɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, ni ekpãtã amɛ fɛɛ kwa amɛhiɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ ebaaba gbi ni aaajie Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ kpo lɛ.
“Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ tsu yiteŋ ni enii yɔɔ shĩa lɛ akakpleke shi ebakɔlɔ, ni mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋmɔshi hu akaku esɛɛ kɛmiiba.
Nyɛkaia Lot ŋa lɛ!
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni taoɔ akɛ ebaa ewala yi lɛ, eeelaaje lɛ; shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaalaaje lɛ lɛ, eeehere eyiwala.
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ mɛi enyɔ aaakãmɔ saa kome nɔ: aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.
Yei enyɔ aaawiɛ yɛ he kome, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.” [Mɛi enyɔ aaahi ŋmɔshi, aaaŋɔ mɔ kome, ni aaashi mɔ kome.]
Ni amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ?” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “He ni gbonyo kã lɛ, jɛi akpaŋai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ.”
Yoo okulafo lɛ kɛ kojolɔ lɛ he abɛ lɛ Yesu bu ekaselɔi lɛ abɛ ko ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ esa akɛ amɛsɔleɔ daa ni ekaje amɛtsine.
Ekɛɛ, “Kojolɔ ko yɛ maŋ ko nɔ, ni esheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni asaŋ ebuuu gbɔmɔ ko.
Ni yoo okulafo ko yɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli, ni eba eŋɔɔ shii abɔ ebakɛɛ, ‘Fã mihe kɛjɛ mihenyɛlɔ lɛ adɛŋ!’ Ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ aahu.
Shi fee sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ eyiŋ akɛ, ‘Yɛŋ akɛ misheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni mibuuu gbɔmɔ hu moŋ nɛ, shi akɛni yoo okulafo nɛɛ miigba minaa hewɔ lɛ, mafã ehe, koni, be ni yi aaawula shi lɛ, ekaba ni ebashwie mihiɛ ma.’ ” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛnu nɔ ni kojolɔ kutumpɔfo lɛ kɛɛ!
Ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɛ aahu tete kɛ ehalamɔbii ni bolɔɔ tsɛɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ ayelikɛbuamɔ lɛ, aso ebafãŋ amɛhe?
Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ eeefã amɛhe oya.
Shi be ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeebana hemɔkɛyeli yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?” Farisifonyo lɛ kɛ toohelɔ lɛ Asaŋ ebu mɛi komɛi ni ŋɔɔ amɛhiɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe nɔ akɛ jalɔi ji amɛ ni amɛgbeɔ mɛi krokomɛi ahe guɔ lɛ hu abɛ nɛɛ, “Mɛi enyɔ yiŋ tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni amɛyasɔle; mɔ kome lɛ Farisifonyo ji lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu lɛ toohelɔŋ.
Farisifonyo lɛ yadamɔ shi, ni esɔle nɛkɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ, miida bo shi akɛ mitamɔ̃ɔɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, ojotswalɔi, kutumpɔfoi, gbãlãfitelɔi, loo tamɔ nɛkɛ toohelɔ nɛɛ po; mihiɔ ŋmaa shii enyɔ yɛ otsi mli, miŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ni minaa lɛ mlijaa nyɔŋma mihãa.’ Shi toohelɔ lɛ damɔ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ, ni emiii ni ewoɔ ehiɛ nɔ kɛya ŋwɛi tete; shi moŋ eshimɔ etsitsi ni ekɛɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ, okɛ mi ni ji eshafeelɔ lɛ akpãtã!’ Miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ yiŋ etee ewe ni abu lɛ bem fe mɔ kome lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni woɔ ehe nɔ lɛ aaaba lɛ shi, shi mɔ ni baa ehe shi lɛ, aaawo enɔ.” Yesu jɔɔ gbekɛbii bibii Ni akɛ abifabii hu ba eŋɔɔ, koni etara amɛhe; shi be ni ekaselɔi lɛ na lɛ, amɛnyafi amɛ.
Shi Yesu tsɛ amɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa gbekɛbii lɛ abaa miŋɔɔ, ni nyɛkatsia amɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi anɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ tamɔ gbekɛ ko lɛ, eboteŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli kwraa.” Maŋ onukpa niiatsɛ lɛ Ni onukpa ko babi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ kpakpa, mɛni mafee, koni mana naanɔ wala?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni hewɔ otsɛɔ mi mɔ kpakpa?
Mɔ kpakpa ko bɛ akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kome kɛkɛ.
Ole kitãi lɛ akɛ, ‘Kaafite gbãlã; kaagbe gbɔmɔ; kaaju; kaaye amale odase; wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ.’ ” Shi ekɛɛ, “Miye enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ anɔ kɛjɛ migbekɛbiiashi.” Ni be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eshwɛ bo nɔ kome lolo; yaahɔ̃ɔ nibii fɛɛ ni oyɔɔ lɛ ni okɛ shika lɛ aja ohiafoi, ni ooona jwetri yɛ ŋwɛi; ni oba obanyiɛ misɛɛ.” Shi be ni enu enɛ lɛ, ewerɛ ho ehe naakpa, ejaakɛ eyɛ nii babaoo.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Yesu na akɛ ewerɛ eho ehe lɛ ekɛɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni ewa hã mɛi ni yɔɔ nii akɛ amɛaabote Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli!
Ejaakɛ ejaraaa hãaa yooma akɛ eeetsɔ̃ abui hiŋmɛi mli tamɔ bɔ ni ejaraa hãa niiatsɛ akɛ eeebote Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ, “Belɛ namɔ yiwala aaanyɛ ahere mɔ?” Shi ekɛɛ, “Nibii ni gbɔmɛi nyɛɛɛ afee lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ enyɛɔ efeɔ.” Ni Petro kɛɛ, “Naa, wɔ lɛ wɔshi wɔnii ni wɔbanyiɛ osɛɛ.” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ko bɛ ni eshi shĩa loo ŋa loo nyɛmimɛi loo fɔlɔi loo bii yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ hewɔ ni enaŋ najiaŋtoo shii abɔ yɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni jeŋ ni baa lɛ mli hu enaŋ naanɔ wala.” Yesu wie egbele kɛ eshitee he nɔ ni ji shi etɛ̃ Agbɛnɛ etsɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ kɛba emasɛi ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, wɔmiiya Yerusalɛm, ni aaagbe nibii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ eŋma yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ he lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ abaajie lɛ awo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ; ni aaaye ehe fɛo ni aaafee lɛ niseniianii ni aaafɛ̃ lajɔ̃ ashwie ehe, ni amɛkɛ kpelebii aaayi lɛ ni amɛaagbe lɛ, ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ eeete shi ekoŋŋ.” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛnaaa nii nɛɛ ateŋ ekomeflo shishi, ni akɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ etee amɛ, ni amɛyooo wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ asɛɛ!
Yesu tsa shwilafo ko Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ebɛŋkɛ Yeriko lɛ, shwilafo ko ta gbɛ lɛ toi eebala nii, Ni be ni shwilafo lɛ nu akɛ mɛi pii miiho lɛ, ebi nɔ ni ji.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ miiho.” Ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Yesu, David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Ni mɛi ni nyiɛ hiɛ lɛ fãmɔ eyi akɛ emua enaa; shi ebolɔ babaoo moŋ fe tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “David Bi, naa mi mɔbɔ!” Ni Yesu wa damɔ shi, ni efã akɛ akɛ lɛ aba.
Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ lɛ lɛ, Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee mihã bo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, akɛ mana nii ekoŋŋ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa nii, ohemɔkɛyeli etsa bo!” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ ena nii, ni enyiɛ esɛɛ ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam; ni be ni asafo lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛ jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi.
Yesu kɛ Zakeo Yesu yabote Yeriko ni eefoŋ.
Ni nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Zakeo, ni toohelɔ nukpa ji lɛ, ni ena nii hu.
Ni eetao Yesu ena ni ele lɛ, shi mɛi pii lɛ ahewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ kpitioo ji lɛ.
Ni esha foi kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ, ni eyakwɔ agbãmitso koni ena lɛ, ejaakɛ jɛi gbɛ ebaatsɔ̃.
Ni be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Zakeo, ohe afee oya ni okpeleke shi, ejaakɛ owe lɛ sa akɛ mato ŋmɛnɛ.” Ni ehe fee oya ni ekpeleke shi, ni ehere lɛ atuu.
Ni be ni mɛi na lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛwie huhuuhu amɛkɛɛ, “Eyato nuu eshafeelɔ ŋɔɔ.” Shi Zakeo ho damɔ shi ni ekɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, miiŋɔ minii fã make ohiafoi, ni kɛji mikɛ yaka naafolɔmɔ eshɔ̃ mɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ edɛŋ lɛ, miiku mabɔ he toi ejwɛ mahã lɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ eba shĩa nɛɛ, akɛni lɛ hu Abraham bi ji lɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ba nɔ ni elaaje lɛ taomɔ kɛ eyiwalaheremɔ.” Menai nyɔŋma lɛ he abɛ lɛ Shi be ni amɛboɔ nii nɛɛ toi lɛ, ebu abɛ ko eshi nɔ, ejaakɛ ebɛŋkɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛsusu akɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ baapue.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ablade ko dom etee maŋsɛɛ shɔŋŋ ni eyaŋɔ emaŋtsɛyeli ni eku esɛɛ eba.
Ni etsɛ etsuji nyɔŋma, ni ejie menai nyɔŋma ehã amɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛtsɔ̃mɔa he kɛyashi maba.’ Shi emaŋbii lɛ nyɛ lɛ, ni amɛtsu bɔfoi kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ ni amɛyakɛɛ akɛ, ‘Wɔsumɔɔɔ ni mɔ nɛ abaye wɔnɔ maŋtsɛ.’ “Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni enine eyashɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ ni eku esɛɛ eba lɛ, efã akɛ atsɛ tsuji lɛ ni ekɛ shika lɛ hã lɛ kɛba, koni ena nɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ena yɛ hetsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ ba ni ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai nyɔŋma ewoŋ.’ Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Aekoo tsulɔ kpakpa!
Akɛni oye anɔkwa yɛ nɔ ko bibioo mli hewɔ lɛ, ye maji nyɔŋma anɔ.’ Ni mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ba ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, omena lɛ efɔ menai enumɔ ewoŋ.’ Ni lɛ hu ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Bo hu ye maji enumɔ anɔ.’ Ni mɔ kroko hu ba ebakɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, naa, omena lɛ ni mifi miwo mama naa kɛto lɛ nɛ; miyashe bo gbeyei, ejaakɛ yiwalɔ ji bo, okɔɔ nɔ ni okɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni okpaa nɔ ni oduko.’ Shi ablade lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Tsulɔ fɔ̃ŋ, bo diɛŋtsɛ odaaŋ wiemɔ mikɛaakojo bo!
Ni ole akɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni mikɔɔ nɔ ni mikɛfɔ̃ko shi, ni mikpaa nɔ ni miduko lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ mɔ ni okɛ mishika lɛ eyawooo shikatoohe lɛ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, ni mibahe minii kɛ ehekpa?’ Ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛshɔ̃a mena lɛ yɛ edɛŋ, ni nyɛkɛhãa mɔ ni yɔɔ menai nyɔŋma lɛ.’ Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, eyɛ menai nyɔŋma.’ ‘Eyɛ mli nakai, shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yɔɔ nɔ ko lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ aaahã; shi mɔ ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ, nɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ tete aaashɔ̃ yɛ edɛŋ.’ “Shi nakai mihenyɛlɔi lɛ ni sumɔɔɔ akɛ miye amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ abaa biɛ ni nyɛbagbea amɛ yɛ mihiɛ nɛɛ!” Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, eho eyi hiɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm.
Be ni ebɛŋkɛ Betfage kɛ Betania yɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, etsu ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa akrowa ni tua nyɛhiɛ lɛ mli, ni kɛ nyɛbote mli lɛ nyɛaana tejibi ni mɔ ko tako enɔ pɛŋ ŋmɔ shi yɛ jɛi; nyɛfɛnea lɛ ni nyɛkɛ lɛ abaa.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko bi nyɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ lɛ?’ lɛ, nyɛkɛa lɛ akɛ, ‘Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ ” Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ yiŋ amɛtee, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ, mɛi anɔ ni ji lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛfɛneɔ tejibi lɛ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ehe miihia Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.” Ni amɛkɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ amɛtadei shwie tejibi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo Yesu amɛta nɔ.
Ni be ni eyaa lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛtadei ha gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni ebɛŋkɛ he ni akpelekeɔ Mugɔŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, ekaselɔi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bɔ̃i nyamɔ ni amɛkɛ gbee ni wa jie Nyɔŋmɔ yi, yɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi fɛɛ ni amɛna lɛ hewɔ, amɛkɛɛ, “Ajɔɔ maŋtsɛ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ!
Hejɔlɛ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni anunyam yɛ ŋwɛi flooflo!” Ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi jɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, kã okaselɔi lɛ.” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ nyɛɛ akɛ, kɛji mɛnɛɛmɛi aaamua amɛnaa lɛ, no lɛ tɛi aaabolɔ.” Ni be ni eshɛ etã ni ena maŋ lɛ, efo eshwie enɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Eji yɛ ogbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ona ole nii ni hi hã ohejɔlɛ lɛ kulɛ!
Shi agbɛnɛ akɛtee bo.
Shi gbii miiba, ni ohenyɛlɔi lɛ aaatsa bu awo ohe, ni amɛaabɔle bo kpula ni amɛaasa oyi yɛ he fɛɛ he, ni amɛaaŋɔ bo amɛtswa shi kɛ obii ni yɔɔ omli lɛ, ni amɛshiŋ tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ yɛ omli, ejaakɛ oyooo oduromɔ saramɔbe lɛ!” Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he Ni Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ebɔ̃i mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ nii kɛ mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ jɛi lɛ shwiemɔ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Aŋma akɛ, ‘Miwe lɛ Sɔlemɔ we ni’; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛfee ojotswalɔi abu.” Ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii daa nɛɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ miitao ehiɛ amɛkpãtã; shi amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee, ejaakɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ kpɛtɛ lɛ ni amɛboɔ lɛ toi.
Hegbɛ ni Yesu yɔɔ Gbi lɛ eko be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni ejajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ba, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ nɔ hegbɛ ni oyɔɔ hewɔ ni ofeɔ nii nɛɛ, ni namɔ ji mɔ ni hã bo nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ?” Ni eto he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibabi nyɛ sane ko, ni nyɛhãa mi hetoo: Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ, ani ŋwɛi ejɛ aloo gbɔmɛi adɛŋ?” Shi amɛhala mli yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Kɛji wɔkɛɛ ejɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, eeekɛɛ, ‘Mɛɛba ni nyɛheee lɛ nyɛyeee mɔ?’ Ni asaŋ kɛji wɔkɛɛ akɛ ejɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ aaatswia wɔ tɛi; ejaakɛ amɛyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ; Yohane lɛ, gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Ni amɛto he akɛ amɛleee he ni ejɛ.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mi hu mitsɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ nɔ hegbɛ ni miyɔɔ ni mifeɔ nii nɛɛ mɔ!” Waintrom mli apaafoi fɔ̃ji lɛ Ni ebɔ̃i maŋ lɛ nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ buu akɛ, “Nuu ko fee waintrom ni ekɛhã okwaafoi apaayeli, ni etee maŋsɛɛ ni eyatsɛ aahu.
Ni be ni shɛ be lɛ, etsu tsulɔ ko kɛtee okwaafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, koni amɛhã lɛ waintrom lɛ mli yibii lɛ eko; shi okwaafoi lɛ yi lɛ, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ŋ folo.
Ni esaa etsu tsulɔ kroko hu, shi amɛyi lɛ hu ni amɛshwie ehiɛ shi, ni amɛshwie lɛ kɛ edɛ̃ŋ folo.
Ni esaa etsu mɔ ni ji etɛ̃; shi lɛ hu amɛpila lɛ, ni amɛtsirɛ eyi sɛɛ kɛje kpo.
Ni waintrom lɛ tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mɛni sa akɛ mafee?
Matsu mibi ni misumɔɔ lɛ; ekolɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛ amɛna lɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ aaasɔ lɛ.’ Shi be ni okwaafoi lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, ‘Niyelɔ lɛ nɛ; nyɛhãa wɔgbea lɛ, koni gboshinii lɛ atsɔ̃ wɔnɔ.’ Ni amɛtsirɛ eyisɛɛ kɛje waintrom lɛ mli ni amɛyagbe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni waintromtsɛ lɛ aaafee amɛ?
Eeeba ebakpãtã nɛkɛ okwaafoi nɛɛ ahiɛ, ni ekɛ waintrom lɛ aaahã mɛi krokomɛi.” Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Enɛ akagbale wɔ fɔ̃ŋfɔ!” Shi ekwɛ amɛ kɛkpe ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛni nɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ akɛ, ‘Tɛ lɛ ni tsutswalɔi lɛ shɛ fɔ̃ lɛ, No nɔŋŋ etsɔ koŋtɛ lɛ?
’ “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaagbee tɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, emli aaatserɛ; shi mɔ nɔ ni eeegbee lɛ, eeegbɛlɛ lɛ mɔnyɔmɔnyɔ.” Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ miitao lɛ amɔ yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛyoo akɛ amɛhewɔ ebu nɛkɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ Ni amɛsra lɛ, ni amɛtsu saralɔi, mɛi ni fee amɛhe tamɔ jalɔi, koni amɛmɔ enaa enyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛŋɔ lɛ amɛhã amralo lɛ hewalɛ kɛ hegbɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, wɔle akɛ owieɔ ni otsɔ̃ɔ nii jalɛ naa, ni asaŋ okwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ, shi moŋ anɔkwale mli otsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ yɛ.
[Kɛɛmɔ wɔ]: Ani eja gbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ too wɔhãa Kaisare, aloo ejaaa?” Shi be ni ekpa amɛŋaa lɛ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ denario atsɔ̃a mi.
Namɔ mfoniri nɛ?
Ni namɔ he sane aŋma yɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛto he amɛkɛɛ, “Kaisare nɔŋ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ nyɛkɛ Kaisare nii ahãa Kaisare; shi Nyɔŋmɔ nii lɛ nyɛkɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.” Ni amɛnyɛɛɛ enaa enyɔŋ ko amɛmɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni ehetoo lɛ fee amɛ naakpɛɛ, ni amɛbu amɛnaa.
Gbohiiashitee he sanebimɔ Ni Sadukifoi lɛ hu ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbabi lɛ sane ko amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, Mose ŋma hã wɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko nyɛmi ni yɔɔ ŋa gbo ni eshiii bi lɛ, enyɛmi aŋɔ eŋa lɛ, koni ewo shwiei ehã enyɛmi lɛ.’ Agbɛnɛ nyɛmimɛi kpawo hi shi, ni amɛteŋ onukpa lɛ ŋɔ yoo, ni egbo ni eshiii bi.
Ni esɛɛho lɛ ŋɔ lɛ, ni lɛ hu egbo ni eshiii bi.
Ni mɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ hu ŋɔ lɛ, ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛyi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ amɛfee; ni amɛshiii bii ni amɛgboi.
Ni fee sɛɛ lɛ yoo lɛ hu bagbo.
“Belɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli lɛ, amɛteŋ namɔ ŋa eeetsɔ?
Ejaakɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ fɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ.” Ni Yesu to he ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Je nɛɛŋ bii ŋɔŋɔɔ yei ni amɛkɛ yei hãa gbãlã, shi mɛi ni aaasa jeŋ ni baa lɛ kɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ namɔ lɛ, amɛŋɔɔɔ yei, asaŋ amɛkɛ yei hãaa gbãlã, ni asaŋ amɛnyɛŋ amɛgboi dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛtamɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi; ni Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji amɛ, ejaakɛ shitee lɛ bii ji amɛ.
Shi akɛ gbohii baate shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, Mose diɛŋtsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ yɛ koowie lɛ sane lɛ mli, be ni etsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ ‘Abraham Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Isak Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ’ lɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, jeee gbohii aNyɔŋmɔ ni shi moŋ hiɛkãalɔi aNyɔŋmɔŋ; ejaakɛ ehiɛ lɛ mɛi fɛɛ hiɛkãmɔ.” Shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi here nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, owie jogbaŋŋ!” Ni amɛkaaa lɛ sane ko bimɔ dɔŋŋ.
David Bi ni ji David Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ akɛɔ akɛ Kristo lɛ, David biŋ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ David diɛŋtsɛ kɛɛ yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, Ta mininejurɔ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.’ Kɛ David tsɛ lɛ ‘Nuŋtsɔ’ lɛ, belɛ te feɔ tɛŋŋ mɔ ni efeɔ ebi?” Yesu wie shi mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ Shi maŋ lɛ fɛɛ toiiaŋ ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ yɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛsumɔɔ jara nɔ ŋamɔi kɛ onukpai ashitaramɔhei yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ yitsotamɔ kɛ atsɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ, amɛyeɔ okulafoi agboshinii yɛ amɛdɛŋ, belɛ amɛkwa amɛmiisɔle sɔlemɔi kakadaji.
Amɛfɔbuu lɛ aaafe nine.”
Yoo okulafo lɛ onia lɛ Yesu wo ehiɛ nɔ ni ena niiatsɛmɛi ni amɛkɛ amɛnikeenii miiwo onia adeka lɛ mli.
Shi ena yoo okulafo ohiafo ko hu ba ni ekɛ pesewai enyɔ bawo mli.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yoo okulafo nɛɛ, ekɛ pii ewo mli fe mɛi lɛ fɛɛ; ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, nɔ ni amɛna ni eteke nɔ lɛ eko amɛkɛbawo nikeenii lɛ amli nɛɛ, shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, ehia mli nii ni ekɛkwɛɔ ehe nɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekɛbawo mli nɛɛ.” Sɔlemɔ we lɛ fitemɔ he gbalɛ Ni be ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he, bɔ ni akɛ tɛi fɛɛfɛji kɛ keenii ewula lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛnaa nɛɛ, gbii aaaba ni ashiŋ emli tɛ kome yɛ ekroko nɔ ni atsiŋ atswaŋ shi.” Amanehului ashishijee Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, mɛɛ be nii nɛɛ aaaba mli?
Ni mɛɛ okadi abaana kɛ eshɛ be ni ebaaba mli lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ, koni akalaka nyɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi pii aaaba yɛ migbɛi mli ni amɛaakɛɛ, ‘Mi ni’, kɛ ‘Be lɛ eshɛ etã’.
Shi nyɛkanyiɛa amɛsɛɛ.
Ni kɛ nyɛnu tai kɛ atuatsemɔi ahe lɛ, nyɛtsui akafãa; ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ba mli dã, shi kɛ̃lɛ naagbee lɛ shɛko bianɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋ baate shi awo maŋ, ni maŋtsɛyɛli hu aaate shi awo maŋtsɛyeli; ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔi ni naa wa aaaba hei srɔtoi fɛɛ, kɛ hɔ̃ji kɛ gbele helai, ni gbeyei nibii kɛ okadii wuji aaajɛ ŋwɛi aba.
“Shi dani enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaaba lɛ, amɛaamɔmɔ nyɛ ni amɛaawa nyɛ yi ni amɛkɛ nyɛ aaahã ni akojo nyɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ ni awo nyɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛaakpala nyɛ kɛatee maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ lumɛi ahiɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Ni no aaahã nyɛ hegbɛ ni nyɛye odase.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhiɛ ahia nɔ ni nyɛkasusu nɔ ni nyɛkɛajie nyɛnaa he nyɛto; ejaakɛ mahã nyɛ naabu kɛ nilee ni nyɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛŋ naa adamɔ ni amɛnyɛŋ naa amɛku hu.
Shi fɔlɔi tete kɛ nyɛmimɛi kɛ wekumɛi kɛ shieŋtsɛmɛi aaaŋɔ nyɛ ahã, ni amɛaahã agbe nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi; ni mɛi fɛɛ aaanyɛ nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Shi nyɛyiteŋ tsɔi kome nɛkɛ elaajeŋ.
Hiɛmiamɔ nyɛkɛaahere nyɛsusumai lɛ.” Yesu gba Yerusalɛm fitemɔ eto “Shi kɛ nyɛna akɛ tai ebɔle Yerusalɛm lɛ, belɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ efitemɔ lɛ eshɛ.
No mli lɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ ajo foi aya gɔji lɛ anɔ, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ maŋ lɛ mli lɛ aje kpo, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ akrowai akaba mli.
Ejaakɛ oweletɔɔ gbii lɛ nɛ, koni nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli.
Shi miihã yei ni hiɛ musu kɛ yei ni hãa fufɔ yɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ kpoo!
Ejaakɛ fimɔ babaoo baaba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mlifu hu baaba nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛaanyɔnyɔɔ yɛ klante naa, ni aaaŋɔ amɛ nom kɛaatee jeŋmaji fɛɛ mli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanaanaa Yerusalɛm nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji abe lɛ aaashɛ.” Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ baa “Ni okadii aaaba hulu kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere kɛ ŋulamii amli, ni jeŋmaji lɛ ahe aaajara amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛaafee yeyeeye yɛ ŋshɔ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ ŋshɔkei akuumɔ hewɔ; ni nɔ aaanyɔnyɔɔ gbɔmɛi anɔ yɛ gbeyei kɛ nibii ni baa je lɛ nɔ lɛ agbɛkwɛmɔ hewɔ; ejaakɛ aaahoso ŋwɛi hewalɛi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛaana Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni eeba yɛ atatuŋ kɛ hewalɛ kɛ anunyam babaoo.
Shi be ni nibii nɛɛ aaatsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛjajea nyɛhe nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛholea nyɛyitsei anɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛkpɔ̃mɔ lɛ miibɛŋkɛ.” Agbãmitso lɛ he nikasemɔ Ni ebu amɛ abɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɛa agbãmitso kɛ tsei fɛɛ; be mli beebe ni amɛfuɔ baa lɛ kɛ nyɛna lɛ, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ latsaabe eshɛ etã.
Nakai nɔŋŋ hu, be ni nyɛaana akɛ nibii nɛɛ etsɔ̃ naa shi lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ eshɛ shi etã.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɛkɛ yinɔ nɛɛ hoŋ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli.
Ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ aaaho aya; shi miwiemɔi lɛ hoŋ eyaŋ.” Nyɛsaraa “Shi nyɛhiɛ ahia nyɛhe nɔ koni fufeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ kɛ yeyeeyefeemɔ yɛ wala nɛɛ mli nibii ahe akahe nyɛtsuii ni nakai gbi lɛ miibati nyɛ shi trukaa; ejaakɛ ebaaba mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ tamɔ tsɔne.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa ni nyɛsɔlea be fɛɛ be, koni nyɛnyɛ nii ni baaba nɛɛ fɛɛ mli nyɛje, ni nyɛnyɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyɛdamɔ.” Shi kɛ je tsɛre lɛ Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni kɛ je na lɛ, eyaa gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyawɔɔ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ teɔ shi leebi maaŋkpa kɛbaa eŋɔɔ amɛbaboɔ lɛ toi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Atee Yesu yinɔ apam ni agbe lɛ Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hehoo lɛ miishɛ.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ tao bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛgbe lɛ; shi amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Shi Satan yabote Yuda mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Iskariot ni ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ mli.
Ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ yawie, bɔ ni eeefee ni ejie lɛ ehã amɛ.
Ni amɛnya, ni amɛwo lɛ shi akɛ amɛaahã lɛ shika, ni ekpɛlɛ̃; ni etao be ni sa ni ekɛaajie lɛ ehã amɛ ni mɛi bɛ jɛi.
Yesu to gbɛjianɔ hã Hehoo lɛ yeli Agbɛnɛ Akpiti Gbijurɔ ni sa akɛ agbeɔ Hehoo toobi lɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ bashɛ; ni etsu Petro kɛ Yohane ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyasaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtoa wɔ, koni wɔbaye.” Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ osumɔɔ akɛ wɔyasaa wɔto yɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ, naa, nuu ko kɛ nyɛ aaakpe ni ehiɛ nu kɛ kpulu; nyɛnyiɛa esɛɛ kɛyaa shĩa he ni eeeyabote lɛ, ni nyɛyakɛa shĩatsɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsɔɔlɔ lɛ kɛɛ wɔbakɛɛ bo akɛ, Nɛgbɛ gbɔiatoohe lɛ ni mi kɛ mikaselɔi lɛ baaye Hehoo niyenii lɛ yɛ mli lɛ yɔɔ?’ Ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ŋwɛiasa kpele ko ni awula mli; nyɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ nyɛtoa yɛ jɛi.” Ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ lɛ, ni amɛsaa Hehoo niyenii lɛ amɛto.
Nuŋtsɔ niyenii lɛ shishitoo Ni be ni ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛ lɛ, eho eta niyenii lɛ ahe, ni bɔfoi lɛ fata ehe.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Taomɔ pam mitaoɔ akɛ mikɛ nyɛ aye nɛkɛ Hehoo nɛɛ dani mana amanehulu lɛ; ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miyeŋ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ aaaba mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.” Ni ewo kpulu lɛ, ni eda shi, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea ni nyɛjaa; ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ minuŋ waintso yibii nɛɛ eko dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaaba.” Ni ekɔ aboloo, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛhã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, [“Enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ mila ni akɛshwie shi ahã nyɛ lɛ mli.]
“Shi naa, mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ lɛ nine kɛ minine yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya, tamɔ bɔ ni akpɛ mli ato lɛ moŋ; shi kpoo hã mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ!” Ni amɛbɔ̃i amɛhe bimɔ akɛ amɛteŋ namɔ po baafee enɛ!
Namɔ ji agbo fe fɛɛ?
Shi naataamɔ hu bate shi yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ amɛteŋ namɔ sa akɛ abu lɛ agbo fe fɛɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ yeɔ amɛnɔ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ amɛnɔ hewalɛ lɛ, atsɛɔ amɛ ejurɔfeelɔi.
Shi nyɛ lɛ ebɛ nyɛ nakai; shi moŋ mɔ ni ji agbo yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, etsɔ tamɔ gbekɛ, ni mɔ ni ji onukpa hu tamɔ mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ te mɔ ni fe mɔ hu, mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ, aloo mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ lɛ?
Ani jeee mɔ ni taa okplɔ̃ he lɛ?
Shi mi lɛ miyɛ nyɛteŋ akɛ mɔ ni sɔmɔɔ.
Shi nyɛ ji mɛi ni kɛ mi ehi shi yɛ mikai lɛ amli.
Ni mi hu miito maŋtsɛyeli mahã nyɛ tamɔ bɔ ni miTsɛ eto ehã mi lɛ, koni nyɛye nii ni nyɛnu yɛ mikpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he yɛ mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli; ni nyɛaatara sɛii anɔ ni nyɛkojo Israel akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.” Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Simon, Simon, naa, Satan ena hegbɛ, koni esha nyɛ mli tamɔ ŋmaa.
Shi mi lɛ mikpa fai miha bo, koni ohemɔkɛyeli akatã; ni bo hu, kɛ okpale lɛ, wo onyɛmimɛi lɛ hewalɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, misaa mihe mito ni kɛ tsuŋ po, gbele mli po, mikɛ bo aya.” Ekɛɛ, “Petro, miikɛɛ bo akɛ ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni ootso shii etɛ̃ akɛ oleee mi.” Fotro, kotoku kɛ klante Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Be ni mitsu nyɛ ni nyɛhiɛɛɛ fotro kɛ kotoku kɛ tokotai lɛ, ani nɔ ko he hia nyɛ” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nɔ ko nɔ ko he ehiaaa wɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni yɔɔ fotro lɛ, ekɔ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yɔɔ kotoku hu akɔ; ni mɔ ni bɛ klante lɛ, ehɔ̃ɔ etade ni ekɛhe eko.
Ejaakɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nɔ ni aŋma nɛɛ hu, ja eba mli yɛ mihe, akɛ, ‘Ni abu lɛ ashi mlatɔlɔi anɔ’; ejaakɛ nibii ni aŋmala yɛ mihe lɛ miiba mli.” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, klantei enyɔ nɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Efa.” Yesu yasɔle yɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ Ni eje kpo, ni tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ eyiŋ kɛtee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ hu nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛsɔlea koni nyɛkabote kaa mli.” Ni egbala ehe shi kɛjɛ amɛŋɔɔ aaafee tɛfɔ̃ɔ jɛkɛmɔ, ni eho ekula shi, ni esɔle ekɛɛ, “Ataa, kɛji oosumɔ lɛ, jiemɔ kpulu nɛɛ kɛje minɔ!
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee bɔ ni mi misumɔɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni bo osumɔɔ.” [ Ni bɔfo ko jɛ ŋwɛi bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ, ni ebawo lɛ hewalɛ.
Ni be ni ehe jaraa lɛ lɛ, ehã esɔlemɔ lɛ mli wa.
Ni ehe latsaa tsɔ̃ tamɔ lákulibii ni tsereɔ shwieɔ shi.]
Ni be ni esɔle egbe naa ni ete shi kɛba ekaselɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ lɛ, ebana amɛ akɛ amɛmiiwɔ ejaakɛ amɛwerɛ eho amɛhe; ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛwɔɔ?
Nyɛtea shi ni nyɛsɔlea, koni nyɛkabote kaa mli.” Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ Be ni ewieɔ lolo lɛ, naa asafoku ko ni mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yuda lɛ nyiɛ amɛhiɛ!
Ni etsi ebɛŋkɛ Yesu, koni eshwɔ enaa.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yuda, okɛ naashwɔmɔ miitsɔ̃ɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ sɛɛgbɛ?” Ni be ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ na nɔ ni baaba lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔbamɔ klante lo?” Ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome bã osɔfonukpa lɛ tsulɔ lɛ klante ni efo eninejurɔ toi.
Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Awa biɛ!” Ni eta etoi lɛ he ni etsa lɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ni ba enɔ lɛ akɛ, “Mi minɔ nyɛje kpo kɛba kɛ klante kɛ kpotii tamɔ abaa awuyelɔ nɔ nɛɛ?
Daa ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, nyɛtaaa mihe; shi nyɛŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ nɛ!” Petro kwa Yesu Ni amɛmɔ lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ we lɛ.
Shi Petro nyiɛ sɛɛ shɔŋŋ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛre la yɛ mɔɔ teŋ lɛ mli ni amɛho amɛtara he lɛ, Petro hu ho yata amɛteŋ.
Ni tsulɔ yoo fioo ko na lɛ ni eta la lɛ he, ni ekwɛ lɛ totooto ni ekɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ.” Shi etso ekɛɛ, “Awo, mileee lɛ!” No sɛɛ etsɛɛɛ lɛ, mɔ kroko hu na lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Bo hu, amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji bo.” Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Ataa, jeee amɛteŋ mɔ ko ji mi!” No sɛɛ aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome lɛ mɔ kroko hu ma nɔ mi veveeve akɛ, “Asonɔkwa, nuu nɛɛ hu kɛ lɛ yɔɔ; ejaakɛ Galileanyo hu ni!” Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Ataa, mileee nɔ ni okɛɔ nɛɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, be ni ekã he ewieɔ lolo lɛ, wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ehe, ni ekwɛ Petro; ni Petro kai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookpa yɛ misɛɛ shii etɛ̃”, lɛ.
Ni Petro je kpo ni eyafo kɛ dɔlɛ.
Aye Yesu he fɛo ni ayi lɛ Shi hii ni hiɛ Yesu lɛ ye ehe fɛo ni amɛyi lɛ.
Ni amɛha ehiɛ ni amɛbibii lɛ akɛ, “Gbaa, namɔ ji mɔ ni gba bo ma lɛ?” Ni amɛwie nibii krokomɛi pii amɛkɛbɔ musu amɛshi lɛ.
Yesu yɛ Akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ, maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ anaa bakpe shi, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee amɛkwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛji bo ji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ; ni kɛ sane ko mibi hu, nyɛhaŋ mi hetoo.
Shi kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaata Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ?
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi ni.’ ” Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni wɔsaa wɔtaoɔ odase wɔfee dɔŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu yɛ enaa.”
Akɛ Yesu tee Pilato hiɛ Ni amɛsafo muu lɛ fɛɛ te shi, ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛtee Pilato ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛbɔ̃i enaa folɔmɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔna nuu nɛɛ ni eewo wɔmaŋ lɛ yiŋ ni eegu oniatsumɔ kɛ Kaisare hamɔ, ni ekɛɔ akɛ lɛ ji Kristo, maŋtsɛ lɛ.” Ni Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Ni eto he ehã lɛ akɛ, “Okɛɛ.” Ni Pilato kɛɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ asafoi lɛ akɛ, “Minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ nuu nɛɛ he.” Shi amɛka nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ “Ewoɔ maŋ lɛŋ hirihiri kɛ enii ni etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Yudea fɛɛ, ni ebɔi kɛjɛ Galilea kɛbashi biɛ nɛɛ.” Yesu yɛ Herode hiɛ Shi be ni Pilato nu Galilea gbɛi lɛ, ebi akɛ nuu lɛ Galileanyo lo?
Ni be ni ena ele akɛ ejɛ Herode nɔyelihe lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Herode, mɔ hu ni eba Yerusalɛm yɛ nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi be ni Herode na Yesu lɛ, ena miishɛɛ babaoo, ejaakɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ejɛ etaoɔ lɛ ena, ejaakɛ enu ehe saji pii, ni ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefee okadi ko ni ena.
Ni ebibii lɛ saji pii; shi ehãaa lɛ ekomeflo hetoo.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ badamɔ shi ni amɛfolɔ enaa naakpa.
Ni be ni Herode kɛ esraafoi lɛ ebɔ lɛ ahora ni amɛye ehe fɛo ni amɛwo lɛ atade kaŋkaŋ lɛ, ehã akɛ lɛ tee Pilato ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Shi nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ Pilato kɛ Herode bɔ naanyo, shikulɛ sa lɛ amɛkɛ amɛhe yeee.
Abu Yesu gbele fɔ Ni Pilato tsɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ bahã mi akɛ eewo maŋ lɛ yiŋ; ni naa, mitao esane lɛ mli yɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe yɛ saji ni nyɛkɛbafolɔ enaa lɛ ekoeko mli.
Ni Herode hu enaaa eko, ejaakɛ ekpale lɛ kɛbahã wɔ; ni naa, efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele.
No hewɔ lɛ, mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe.” [Shi ehia akɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛ mɔ kome he ehã amɛ.]
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛbolɔ shi kome amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ mɔ nɛ aya, ni oŋmɛɛ Baraba he ohã wɔ!” (Baraba nɛɛ ji nuu ko ni atua ko ni atse yɛ maŋ lɛŋ kɛ awui ko ni aye hewɔ lɛ awo lɛ tsuŋ.)
Shi akɛni Pilato miitao akɛ eŋmɛɛ Yesu he hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ.
Shi amɛbolɔ akɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!
Sɛŋmɔ lɛ” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɔ ni ji shi etɛ̃ akɛ, “Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, mɛɛ efɔŋ efee?
Minako nɔ ko ni sa gbele yɛ ehe, no hewɔ lɛ, mibayi lɛ ni maŋmɛɛ ehe.” Shi amɛka nɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛmiitao akɛ asɛŋ lɛ; ni amɛgbei kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ anɔ lɛ ye nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato gbe sane lɛ naa akɛ afee bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ; ni eŋmɛɛ mɔ ni atuatsemɔ kɛ awuyeli hewɔ ni awo lɛ tsuŋ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ lɛ he; shi Yesu lɛ, ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ amɛtaomɔ lɛ naa.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele Ni be ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛyaa lɛ amɛmɔ Simon Kirenenyo ko ni jɛ kosɛɛ baa lɛ, ni amɛwo Yesu sɛŋmɔtso lɛ amɛtere lɛ ni ekɛnyiɛ esɛɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ mli bii pii kɛ yei hu ni yeɔ ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛfoɔ yɛ ehewɔ lɛ nyiɛ esɛɛ.
Shi Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe ehã amɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Yerusalɛm biyei, nyɛkafoa yɛ mihewɔ; shi moŋ nyɛfoa yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ nyɛbii ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ naa, gbii miiba no mli ni amɛaakɛɛ, ‘Ajɔɔ kenei kɛ musui ni fɔko dã kɛ fufɔi ni ayeko dã!’ No mli lɛ amɛaabɔ̃i gɔji lɛ akɛɛmɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛbagbea wɔnɔ!’ Kɛ gɔ̃ŋkpɔi lɛ hu akɛ, ‘Nyɛbahaa wɔnɔ!’ Ejaakɛ kɛ tso ŋmɔŋ afeɔ enɛ lɛ, tso gbiŋ lɛ, te aaafee lɛ tɛŋŋ?” Ni akpala mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu ni ji efɔŋfeelɔi afata ehe kɛtee ni ayagbe amɛ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Yitsoŋoŋo lɛ, amɛsɛŋ lɛ kɛ efɔŋfeelɔi lɛ yɛ jɛi, mɔ kome ye ninejurɔgbɛ ni mɔ kome hu ye abɛkugbɛ.
Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Ataa, kɛfa amɛ; shi amɛleee nɔ ni amɛfeɔ lɛ.” Ni amɛfɔ̃ oshiki amɛkɛja etadei lɛ.
Ni maŋbii lɛ damɔ shi amɛmiikwɛ.
Ni maŋ onukpai lɛ hu ye lɛ ahi amɛkɛɛ, “Ehereɔ mɛi krokomɛi ayiwala; kɛ lɛ ji Kristo mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala lɛ, ehere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiwala!” Ni asraafoi lɛ hu ye ehe fɛo, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ ni amɛbahã lɛ ashiŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Kɛ bo ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ, heremɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiwala!” Shi aŋma ŋmalɛ ko hu yɛ eyiteŋ akɛ, “YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ NƐ!” Ni efɔŋfeelɔi ni asɛŋ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome wie musubɔɔ wiemɔ eshi lɛ ekɛɛ, “Jeee bo ji Kristo lɛ?
Jiemɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe kɛ wɔ hu!” Shi mɔ kome lɛ here nɔ ni ekã ehiɛ ekɛɛ, “Ani bo hu ni oyɔɔ fɔbuu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ mli nɛɛ osheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei?
Ni wɔnɔ lɛ sa wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔnifeemɔnii ahe nyɔmɔwoo wɔna nɛɛ; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ efeko nɔ ko ni esaaa.” Ni ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaimɔ mi be ni oooba yɛ omaŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ!” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale mli akɛ, ‘Ŋmɛnɛ okɛ mi aaahi Paradeiso!’ ” Agbɛnɛ aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli lɛ, duŋ wo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ kɛyashi gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli; ni hulu wo duŋ, ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli muhɔɔ lɛ mli gba kɛyi shi yɛ teŋ tuuŋtu.
Ni Yesu bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ, “Ataa, odɛ̃ŋ mituɔ mimumɔ miwoɔ nɛɛ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ ebu enaa.
Shi be ni asraafoiohaiatsɛ lɛ na nɔ ni efee lɛ, ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam ni ekɛɛ, “Yɛŋ lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ jalɔŋ!” Be ni mɛi fɛɛ ni ebabua amɛhe naa ni amɛkwɛɔ nii nɛɛ na nibii ni ba lɛ, amɛshimɔ amɛtsitsi ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shĩa.
Shi mɛi ni le lɛ fɛɛ kɛ yei ni nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛjɛ Galilea lɛ hu damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ amɛmiikwɛ nii nɛɛ.
Yesu fuu Ni naa, nuu ko yɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yosef, ni ji akwaashɔŋnyo; eji gbɔmɔ kpakpa kɛ jalɔ.
Ni ejɛ Arimatia, Yudafoi lɛ amaji lɛ eko nɔ, lɛ lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ amɛyiŋtoo kɛ amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ nɔ, ni eekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛ; lɛ eyiŋ etee Pilato ŋɔɔ ni eyakpa lɛ fai ni eŋɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ ehã lɛ.
Ni ejie lɛ kɛkpeleke shi, ni eŋɔ klala ebala ehe, ni eyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ni akpɛ yɛ tɛsaa mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli dã lɛ mli.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoo gbi ni, ni Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ miishɛ.
Ni yei lɛ ni kɛ Yesu jɛ Galilea ba lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ, amɛbakwɛ toohe lɛ kɛ bɔ ni ato egbonyo lɛ ahã.
Ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ, ni amɛyasaa tsofaikɛŋmai; ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛfee kpoo yɛ kitã lɛ naa.
Yesu shitee Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ leebi maaŋkpa lɛ amɛba bu lɛ he, ni amɛhiɛ tsofaikɛŋmai ni amɛsaa amɛto lɛ kɛba.
Amɛna akɛ akoklo tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa; ni be ni amɛbote mli lɛ, amɛnaaa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ.
Be ni amɛfee yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ badamɔ amɛmasɛi, ni amɛwo atadei kaŋkaŋi.
Shi be ni amɛsheɔ gbeyei ni amɛmamɔ amɛhiɛ shi lɛ, hii lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛtaoɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ yɛ gbohii ateŋ?
Ebɛ biɛ; ete shi!
Nyɛkaia bɔ ni ekɛɛ nyɛ be ni eyɔɔ Galilea lolo lɛ, akɛ, ‘Ja aŋɔ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ awo eshafeelɔi adɛŋ; ni asɛŋ lɛ ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ ete shi ekoŋŋ.’ ” Ni amɛkai ewiemɔi lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ bu lɛ naa, ni amɛyagba mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ.
Maria Magdalena kɛ Yohana kɛ Yakobo nyɛ Maria kɛ yei ni eshwɛ ni fata amɛhe lɛ ji mɛi ni bagba bɔfoi lɛ nii nɛɛ.
Ni nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ fee tamɔ kwashiai asane yɛ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛheee amɛyeee.
[Shi Petro te shi ni esha foi kɛtee bu lɛ he; ni be ni ekoto shi ekwɛ mli lɛ, enaaa nɔ ko nɔ ko akɛ ja klala lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni eje jɛi etee ewe, ni enaa kpɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni eba lɛ hewɔ].
Shisharamɔ kɛ Emao yaa Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ yiŋ kɛmiiya akrowa ko ni kɛ Yerusalɛm jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi kpawo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Emao lɛ.
Ni amɛmiigbagbaa nibii ni eba nɛɛ fɛɛ ahe saji yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni be ni amɛgbagbaa saji lɛ ni amɛtaoɔ mli lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ babɛŋkɛ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ; shi aŋamɔ amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛkayoo lɛ.
Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ saji nyɛgbaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni amɛwa amɛdamɔ shi kɛ amɛhiɛ mɔbɔmɔbɔ.
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kleopa lɛ to he ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani okome pɛ ji gbɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm ni leee saji ni eba jɛi yɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ?” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ saji ni?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ni ji gbalɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nitsumɔ kɛ wiemɔ mli yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ maŋ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ lɛ he saji lɛ; kɛ bɔ ni wɔsɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ wɔmaŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ lɛ hã ni abu lɛ gbele fɔ, ni amɛsɛŋ lɛ lɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kulɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni baakpɔ̃ Israel lɛ; ni enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii etɛ̃ ni afee nii nɛɛ.
Shi asaŋ wɔteŋ yei komɛi hu hã wɔnaa kpɛ wɔhe, ejaakɛ amɛtee bu lɛ he mra mli, ni be ni amɛnaaa egbonyo lɛ, amɛba ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ bɔfoi komɛi hu jie amɛhe kpo amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã.
Ni mɛi ni kɛ wɔ yɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi tee bu lɛ he, ni amɛyana tamɔ bɔ ni yei lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi lɛ ni amɛnaaa.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “O kwashiai ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔ̃ɔ yɛ nyɛtsui mli kɛ nii fɛɛ ni gbalɔi lɛ gba lɛ hemɔkɛyeli.
Ani jeee sa esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ ni ebote enunyam lɛ mli?” Ni ebɔ̃i kɛjɛ Mose kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nibii ni yɔɔ Ŋmalɛi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ ehe lɛ ashishi.
Ni amɛbɛŋkɛ akrowa ni amɛyaa mli lɛ; ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni eeya ehiɛgbɛ.
Ni amɛnyɛ enɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ wɔ ahi shi, ejaakɛ je miina ni eshɛ hiɛbulɛ etã.” Ni etee mli ni ekɛ amɛ yahi shi.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ekɛ amɛ tara niyenii ahe lɛ, ekɔ aboloo lɛ ni ejɔɔ nɔ, ni ekumɔ mli ni ekɛhã amɛ; kɛkɛ ni amɛhiŋmɛi gbele ni amɛyoo lɛ, ni elaaje yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani nɔ ko etaaa wɔmli be ni ekɛ wɔ wieɔ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ Ŋmalɛi lɛ amli lɛ?” Ni amɛte shi yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm, ni amɛbana mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ ni amɛbua amɛhe naa; amɛmiikɛɛ akɛ, “Eyɛ mli akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ete shi, ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Simon.” Ni amɛ hu amɛgba nɔ ni ba yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ bɔ ni fee ni amɛyoo lɛ yɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ Ni be ni amɛwieɔ nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Yesu diɛŋtsɛ badamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” Shi amɛhɛle shi ni amɛshe gbeyei, amɛsusu akɛ mumɔ ko amɛnaa lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛjijaa, ni mɛɛ hewɔ hu ni ŋwanejee teɔ shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli?
Nyɛkwɛa miniji kɛ minaji [ni nyɛaana akɛ] mi diɛŋtsɛ ni; nyɛtaa mihe nyɛkwɛa; shi mumɔ bɛ heloo kɛ wui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛnaa akɛ miyɔɔ nɛɛ.” [Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekɛ eniji kɛ enaji tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.]
Shi be ni amɛheee amɛyeee lolo yɛ miishɛɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ efee amɛ yaa lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛ nɔ ko ni ayeɔ yɛ biɛ lo?” Ni amɛhã lɛ loo kuku ni ashi, ni ehe, ni eye yɛ amɛhiɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛɛmɛi ji miwiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ, akɛ ja nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mose mla lɛ kɛ Gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Lalai lɛ amli yɛ mihe lɛ na ba mli.” Kɛkɛ lɛ egbele amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa, koni amɛna Ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ aŋma, ni nɛkɛ esa akɛ Kristo lɛ ana amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ; ni ashiɛ tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa yɛ egbɛi lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ maji fɛɛ, ni abɔ̃i kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm.
Ni nyɛ ji nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ahe odasefoi.
Ni naa, miiha miTsɛ shiwoo lɛ aba nyɛnɔ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛhia shi yɛ Yerusalɛm maŋ lɛŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaajɛ ŋwɛi awo nyɛ hewalɛ.” Yesu ŋwɛiyaa Ni eŋɔ amɛ kɛje kpo kɛtee Betania masɛi, ni ehole eniji anɔ ni ejɔɔ amɛ.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni ejɔɔ amɛ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ gbala mli, ni awo lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi.
Ni amɛja lɛ, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm kɛ miishɛɛ pii; ni amɛyɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ daa nɛɛ, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ kɛ lɛ jɔɔmɔ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanɔ Wiemɔ ji lɛ, “ni ebatsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ ni ebahi wɔteŋ” .
Tamɔ bɔ ni wolo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ yeɔ he odase lɛ, Sanekpakpa nɛɛ aŋma bɔ ni afee ni ekanelɔi lɛ ahe aye akɛ Yesu ji yiwalaherelɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi, ni awo ehe shi ato lɛ, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ aaana wala .
Mlibotemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanɔ Wiemɔ lɛ ji Yesu.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ anaa naakpɛɛ nibii srɔtoi ni Yesu fee yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu lɛ, lɛ ji Yiwalaherelɔ lɛ ni awo ehe shi ato lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ atee nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nibii ni naakpɛɛ nibii lɛ jie lɛ kpo lɛ naa faŋŋ.
Biɛ nɛɛ lɛ, wolo lɛ gbaa wɔ mɛi komɛi ni he Yesu nɔ ye ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ ekaselɔi, shi mɛi komɛi ni te shi shí lɛ lɛ, amɛheee enɔ amɛyeee.
Yitsei - wieɔ naanyobɔɔ ni wa ni yɔɔ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ gbi gbɛkɛ ni ayamɔ lɛ lɛ he jogbaŋŋ.
Esaa etsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie kɛsaa ekaselɔi lɛ ajwɛŋmɔ ni ekɛwo amɛ ekãa gbɛkɛ ni nyiɛ gbi ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Yitsei ni gbeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ naa lɛ wieɔ Yesu mɔmɔ kɛ ekojomɔ he, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ hu ni asɛŋ Yesu ni ete shi ni ejie ehe kpo faŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ ehã yɛ eshitee lɛ sɛɛ.
Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ maa naanɔ wala ni anaa akɛ nɔkeenɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ nɔ, mi.
Ni etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eji keenii ni anaa kɛjɛɔ amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ, ni mɛi ni naa ji mɛi ni eŋɔ Yesu akɛ lɛ ji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ.
Nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni akɛkadiɔ Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ jogbaŋŋ ji bɔ ni etsɔɔ ewieɔ nibii ni wɔle yɛ wɔdaadaa shihilɛ mli ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ mumɔŋ nii anaa lɛ he, taakɛ nu kɛ aboloo kɛ lá kɛ tookwɛlɔ kɛ etoi kɛ waintso kɛ eyibii nɛkɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Shishijee .- Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ kɛ Yesu klɛŋklɛŋ kaselɔi lɛ .- Yesu nitsumɔ .—.
Yesu naagbee gbi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ ekpokpai anɔ .—.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shitee kɛ ehekpojiemɔ .- Naagbee, ehekpojiemɔ kroko yɛ Galilea .-
Wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ heloo Shishijee mli lɛ Wiemɔ lɛ yɛ momo, ni Wiemɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ ni Wiemɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ shishijee mli lɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɔɔ.
Lɛ enɔ atsɔ̃ afee nibii fɛɛ, ni ashiii lɛ afeee nɔ ko nɔ ko ni afee.
Emli wala yɔɔ, ni wala lɛ ji gbɔmɛi ala lɛ; ni la lɛ tsoɔ yɛ duŋ lɛ mli, ni duŋ lɛ nyɛɛɛ enɔ eye.
Nuu ko yɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ kɛba, atsɛɔ lɛ Yohane.
Eba odaseyeli, ni ebaye la lɛ he odase koni mɛi fɛɛ atsɔ̃ enɔ ahe aye.
Jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji la lɛ; shi moŋ eba la lɛ he odaseyeli.
Anɔkwa la lɛ ni tsoɔ hãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ baa je lɛ mli nɛɛ.
Je lɛ mli la lɛ yɔɔ, ni enɔ atsɔ̃ afee je lɛ, shi je lɛ leee lɛ.
Lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi aŋɔɔ eba, ni mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋbii lɛ hereee lɛ.
Shi mɛi abɔ ni here lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye lɛ, ehã amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bii, mɛi ni jeee lá loo heloo loo nuu ko suɔmɔ naa afɔ amɛ yɛ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ fɔ amɛ.
Ni Wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ adesa, ni ebahi shi yɛ wɔteŋ, ni wɔna enunyam lɛ akɛ Tsɛ lɛ Bi koome lɛ anunyam, ni dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale eyi lɛ obɔ̃.
Yohane Baptisilɔ lɛ ye Yesu he odase Yohane ye ehe odase ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ efe mi, etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.’ ” Ejaakɛ ebɔ̃yimɔ lɛ mli jɛ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔna dromɔ wɔshi dromɔ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, Mose nɔ atsɔ̃ akɛhã; shi dromɔ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ, Yesu Kristo nɔ etsɔ̃ kɛba.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ ko enako lɛ pɛŋ; Bi koome ni yɔɔ Tsɛ lɛ mlishi lɛ, lɛ ebajie lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ.
Ni enɛ ji Yohane odase ni eye be ni Yudafoi lɛ tsu osɔfoi kɛ Levibii kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛbabi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” lɛ.
Ni egba mli faŋŋ ni eshiuuu nɔ, ni egba mli akɛ, “Jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ.” Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo mɔ?
Elia ji bo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee lɛ ji mi.” Gbalɔ lɛ ji bo?
Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Dabi.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?
(Kɛɛmɔ wɔ) koni wɔna hetoo ko wɔyahã mɛi ni tsu wɔ lɛ; Te okɛɔ yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe tɛŋŋ?” Ekɛɛ, “Mi ji mɔ gbee ni boɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛjajea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ,’ ” tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ Yesaia kɛɛ lɛ.
Ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ; ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjeee Kristo lɛ loo Elia loo gbalɔ lɛ ji bo lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ obaptisiɔ mɔ?” Yohane here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mi lɛ mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli, shi mɔ ko damɔ nyɛteŋ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni baa yɛ misɛɛ, mɔ tokota naakpãa ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ lɛ.” Afee nii nɛɛ yɛ Betania, yɛ Yordan sɛɛ, he ni Yohane baptisiɔ yɛ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane na Yesu miiba eŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ ni woɔ je lɛ esha lɛ kɛyaa lɛ!
Mɔ nɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Nuu ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ mihiɛ, ejaakɛ eyɛ dani miyɔɔ lɛ.’ Ni mi lɛ́ mileee lɛ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Israel hewɔ, ni miba mibaptisiɔ yɛ nu mli nɛɛ.” Ni Yohane ye odase ekɛɛ, “Mina Mumɔ lɛ yi shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ okpo, ni ebahi enɔ.
Ni mi lɛ mileee lɛ, shi mɔ ni tsu mi akɛ mibaptisi yɛ nu mli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Mɔ nɔ ni ooona akɛ Mumɔ lɛ yiɔ ni ehiɔ enɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni baptisiɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli lɛ.’ Ni mina, ni miye he odase akɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛ.” Kaselɔi ni atsɛ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ Asaŋ enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yohane kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ damɔ shi; ni be ni Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ekwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Naa Nyɔŋmɔ Toobi lɛ!” Ni kaselɔi enyɔ lɛ nu ewiemɔ lɛ, ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ.
Ni Yesu tsɔ̃ ehe, ni be ni ena akɛ amɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛni nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi” (eshishi ji: Tsɔɔlɔ), “Nɛgbɛ ohiɔ?” Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbakwɛa.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛtee ni amɛyana he ni ehiɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ hi shi nakai gbi lɛ.
Ni gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji ejwɛ mli ni.
Mɛi enyɔ lɛ ni nu ni Yohane wie ni amɛyanyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ji Andrea, Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ.
Lɛ eyana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɛmi Simon tsutsu, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna Mesia (ni eshishi ji Kristo,) loo (mɔ ni afɔ lɛ mu) lɛ.” Ni ekɛ lɛ ba Yesu ŋɔɔ.
Ni Yesu kwɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Bo ji Simon, Yona bi lɛ, aaatsɛ bo Kefa (eshishi ji Petro loo tɛsaa).” Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ Yesu miitao akɛ eyaa Galilea, ni ena Filipo; ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Shi Filipo jɛ Betsaida, Andrea kɛ Petro maŋ lɛ mli.
Filipo hu na Natanael, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna mɔ ni Mose ŋma ehe sane yɛ Mla lɛ mli, kɛ mɔ ni gbalɔi lɛ hu ŋma ehe sane lɛ, Yesu, Yosef bi ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ.” Ni Natanael kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani nɔ ko kpakpa ko aaanyɛ ajɛ Nazaret?” Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ba ni obakwɛ.” Yesu na Natanael miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Naa anɔkwa Israelnyo, mɔ mli ni apasa bɛ lɛ.” Natanael bi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ole mi yɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mina bo fɛɛ dã ni Filipo tsɛ bo, be mli ni oyɔɔ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ.” Natanael here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, bo ji Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ.” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ bo akɛ mina bo yɛ agbãmitso lɛ shishi lɛ hewɔ oheɔ oyeɔ nɛɛ?
Ooona nii wuji ni fe enɛ.” Ni etee nɔ ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛjɛ be nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaana akɛ ŋwɛi naa kã ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi lɛ miikwɔ miikpeleke yɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ.”
Yookpeemɔ yɛ Kana Enɔ gbii etɛ̃ lɛ akpee yoo yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea; ni Yesu nyɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni akpee Yesu hu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛtee yookpeemɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni wain lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu nyɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Amɛbɛ wain.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ohe sane mɛ ji no, Awo?
Miŋmlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.” Enyɛ kɛɛ tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeekɛɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛfea.” Ni tɛ botokui ekpaa mamɔ shi yɛ jɛi, yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ahetsuumɔ hewɔ, ekome yeɔ susumɔ gbɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛwoa botokui lɛ amli nu obɔ̃bɔ̃.” Ni amɛwo amɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛa eko nyɛyahãa piafonyo lɛ.” Ni amɛyɛ kɛtee.
Shi be ni piafonyo lɛ sa enaa nu ni etsɔ̃ wain, ni eleee he ni jɛ, shi tsuji lɛ ni yɛ nu lɛ kɛkɛ le lɛ, etsɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, wain kpakpa ekɛbamaa shi klɛŋklɛŋ, ni kɛ mɛi lɛ etɔrɔ lɛ, no dani ekɛ nɔ ni eŋɔɔɔ lɛ baa; shi bo lɛ okɛ wain kpakpa lɛ moŋ eto kɛbashi benɛ.” Enɛ Yesu fee yɛ Kana yɛ Galilea ekɛje ekadii ashishi ni ekɛ enunyam lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni ekaselɔi lɛ he enɔ amɛye.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ etee Kapernaum, lɛ kɛ enyɛ kɛ enyɛmimɛi kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ, shi amɛyeee gbii pii ko yɛ jɛi.
Yesu tsuu Sɔlemɔ we lɛ he Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHehoo lɛ eshɛ etã, ni Yesu tee Yerusalɛm.
Ni eyana mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpoi kɛ mɛi ni tsakeɔ shika hu tara shi yɛ amɛkpɔlɔ̃i ahe yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni ekɛ taŋkpei bibii fee kpelebii ni ekɛshwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛ toi kɛ tsinai lɛ kɛje Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ shikatsakelɔi lɛ ashika lɛ eshwie shi; ni etsirɛ okpɔlɔi lɛ etswia shi; ni ekɛɛ mɛi ni hɔ̃ɔ okpoi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛjiea nii nɛɛ kɛjea biɛ, nyɛkɛ miTsɛ we lɛ akafea jara nɔ.” Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ aŋma akɛ, “Owe lɛ he hiɛdɔɔ lɛ eye mi.” Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ okadi okɛtsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ oyɛ hegbɛ akɛ ofeɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkumɔa sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, ni gbii etɛ̃ mli lɛ mama ekoŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ekpaa akɛma Sɔlemɔtsu nɛɛ, ni bo lɛ gbii etɛ̃ okɛaama lo?” Shi lɛ lɛ, egbɔmɔtso akɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ he ewieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kai akɛ ekɛɛ enɛ, ni amɛhe ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni Yesu wie lɛ amɛye.
Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu yɔɔ Yerusalɛm yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ mli lɛ, mɛi pii na okadii ni efee lɛ, ni amɛhe egbɛi lɛ nɔ amɛye.
Shi Yesu diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ekɛ ehe efɔ̃ɔɔ amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ ele amɛ fɛɛ amɛsu.
Ni ehe ehĩaaa akɛ mɔ ko aye gbɔmɔ he odase ahã lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ tsui mli.
Yesu kɛ Nikodemo Nuu ko yɛ ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Nikodemo ni ji Yudafoi lɛ anukpa; lɛ eba Yesu ŋɔɔ nyɔɔŋ, ni ebakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, wɔle akɛ tsɔɔlɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba ji bo; ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ afee okadii ni ofeɔ nɛɛ, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ.” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ ŋwɛi afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ ena.” Nikodemo bi lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni be ni gbɔmɔ egbɔ lɛ ni aaafɔ lɛŋ?
Ani eeenyɛ ebote enyɛ musu mli ekoŋŋ ni afɔ lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, kɛji ajɛɛɛ nu kɛ Mumɔ mli afɔɔɔ mɔ ko lɛ, enyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli ebote.
Nɔ ni ajɛ heloo mli afɔ lɛ, heloo ni; ni nɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ, mumɔ ni.
Ohiɛ akafee bo yaa akɛ mikɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘ja ajɛ ŋwɛi afɔ nyɛ’ lɛ.
Kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ, he ni esumɔɔ etswaa kɛyaa, ni egbɛɛmɔ onuɔ, shi oleee he ni ejɛɔ kɛ he ni eyaa; nakai ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ajɛ Mumɔ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ.” Nikodemo here nɔ ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nii nɛɛ aaanyɛ aba mli hu?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te Israel tsɔɔlɔ ji bo?
Ni oleee enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ?
Miikɛɛ bo anɔkwale akɛ, nɔ ni wɔle lɛ, no wɔwieɔ; ni nɔ ni wɔna lɛ, no he odase wɔyeɔ; shi nyɛŋɔɔɔ wɔdase lɛ.
Kɛ mikɛ nyɛ wie shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ wie ŋwɛinii ahe ni nyɛaahe nyɛyeŋ?
Ni mɔ ko ekwɔko kɛyako ŋwɛi, akɛ ja mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi kpeleke shi lɛ, Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni Mose wo onufu lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala.” “Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ je lɛ, akɛ eŋɔ eBi koome lɛ ehã, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ hiɛ akakpãtã, shi moŋ ena naanɔ wala.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuuu eBi lɛ kɛbaaa je lɛ mli koni ebakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ koni atsɔ̃ enɔ ahere je lɛ yiwala.
Mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, akojooo lɛ; shi mɔ ni heee yeee lɛ, akojo lɛ momo, ejaakɛ eheko Nyɔŋmɔ Bi koome lɛ gbɛi lɛ nɔ eyeko.
Shi kojomɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ la lɛ eba je lɛ mli, ni gbɔmɛi sumɔɔ duŋ lɛ moŋ fe la lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ efɔ̃ɔji ni; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nyɛɔ la lɛ, ni ebaaa la lɛ he, koni akajie enitsumɔi lɛ ashi.
Shi mɔ ni feɔ anɔkwalenii lɛ baa la lɛ he, koni enitsumɔi lɛ aje kpo, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli atsu yɛ.” Yohane odase kroko ni eye yɛ Yesu he Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ba Yudea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ bahi jɛi, ni ebaptisiɔ.
Ni Yohane hu miibaptisi yɛ Ainon yɛ Salim masɛi, ejaakɛ nu pii yɛ jɛi, ni mɛi baa ni abaptisiɔ amɛ; ejaakɛ no mli lɛ anako awo Yohane tsuŋ.
Agbɛnɛ naataamɔ bate shi yɛ Yohane kaselɔi lɛ kɛ Yudafonyo ko teŋ yɛ hetsuumɔ he.
Ni amɛba Yohane ŋɔɔ ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, mɔ ni kɛ bo hi Yordan sɛɛ ni oye ehe odase lɛ, naa, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eebaptisi, ni mɛi fɛɛ miiya eŋɔɔ.” Yohane here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Gbɔmɔ nyɛŋ ana nɔ ko, akɛ ja ajɛ ŋwɛi akɛhã lɛ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmiiye mi odase akɛ mikɛɛ akɛ, jeee mi ji Kristo lɛ, shi moŋ atsu mi kɛtsɔ̃ ehiɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɛ ayɛmforo lɛ, lɛ ji ayɛmforowu; shi ayɛmforowu lɛ shieŋtsɛ ni damɔ shi boɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nya enyaa yɛ ayɛmforowu lɛ gbee hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ minyamɔ nɛɛ eba mli.
Lɛ lɛ, ja eshwere, ni mi lɛ, minɔ gbɔ.” Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ.
Mɔ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ejɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ he ewieɔ.
Mɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ, efe mɛi fɛɛ, ni nɔ ni ena ni enu lɛ, no he odase eyeɔ; ni mɔ ko mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ edase lɛ.
Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ edase lɛ, esɔo naa akɛ anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi ewieɔ; ejaakɛ jeee susumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ susuɔ Mumɔ lɛ ehãa lɛ.
Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ.
Mɔ ni heɔ Bi lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala; shi mɔ ni booo Bi lɛ toi lɛ, enaŋ wala; shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu hiɔ enɔ.
Yesu kɛ Samariayoo lɛ Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu na le akɛ Farisifoi lɛ enu akɛ eena kaselɔi, ni eebaptisi mɛi babaoo fe Yohane, tsɛbelɛ lɛ Yesu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaptisiii; shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ ni baptisiɔ lɛ, eje Yudea ni eyiŋ etee Galilea ekoŋŋ.
Shi ja etsɔ̃ Samaria.
Agbɛnɛ ebashɛ Samaria maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sikar ni bɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ kukuoo ko ni Yakob kɛhã ebi Yosef lɛ masɛi.
Shi Yakob nubu lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ni akɛni gbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ etɔ Yesu hewɔ lɛ, eho eshwata shi yɛ nubu lɛ he.
[Ebashɛ jɛi] aaafee ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli.
Ni Samariayoo ko ba nuyɛɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hã mi nu lɛ eko manu.” No mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ etee maŋ lɛ mli amɛyaahe niyenii.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Samariayoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te tɛŋŋ ni bo Yudanyo lɛ obaa mi Samariayoo lɛ nu ni onuŋ?” (Ejaakɛ Yudafoi kɛ Samariabii enuuu tsene kome naa nu.)
Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Eji ole Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kɛɔ bo akɛ, ‘Hã mi eko manu lɛ’ kulɛ, bo moŋ oooba lɛ ni eeehã bo wala nu.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, obɛ nɔ ni okɛaayɛ, ni bu lɛ mli kwɔ hu; nɛgbɛ ona wala nu lɛ yɛ mɔ?
Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Yakob ni hã wɔ nubu lɛ, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enu mli nu, kɛ ebii kɛ ekooloi lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nu nɛɛ lɛ, kumai baaye lɛ ekoŋŋ; shi mɔ ni nuɔ nu ni mi mahã lɛ lɛ, kumai yeŋ lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛaatee naanɔ; shi moŋ nu ni mahã lɛ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nu hiŋmɛi ni baa kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli yɛ emli.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã mi nu nɛɛ eko, koni kumai akaye mi, ni miba biɛ mibayɛ nu dɔŋŋ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa ni oyatsɛ owu, ni okɛ lɛ aba biɛ.” Yoo lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mibɛ wu” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ okɛɛ akɛ, ‘mibɛ wu’ lɛ; ejaakɛ ogbã hii enumɔ, ni mɔ ni ogbãa amrɔ nɛɛ tete, jeee owu ji lɛ; no lɛ owie anɔkwa.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mina akɛ gbalɔ ji bo.
Gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ sɔle yɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛkɛɛ akɛ Yerusalɛm ji he ni sa akɛ asɔle yɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Awo, he mi oye akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni jeee gɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ jeee Yerusalɛm ni nyɛaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee mɔ ni nyɛjaa; wɔ lɛ, wɔle mɔ ni wɔjaa, ejaakɛ walaheremɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ejɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ momo, be ni anɔkwa jalɔi lɛ aaaja Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli, ejaakɛ jalɔi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi Tsɛ lɛ taoɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔŋ, ni mɛi ni jaa lɛ lɛ, ja amɛja lɛ yɛ mumɔ kɛ anɔkwale mli.” Yoo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ Mesia ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kristo lɛ miiba; kɛ eba lɛ, eeegba wɔ nii fɛɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ni mikɛ bo wieɔ nɛɛ, mi ni.” Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ba, ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa akɛ ekɛ yoo miiwie, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko biii lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni obiɔ lɛ?” Aloo “Mɛni wiemɔ okɛ lɛ wieɔ?” Agbɛnɛ yoo lɛ shi enugbɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee maŋ lɛ mli, ni eyakɛɛ mɛi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa nyɛbakwɛa nuu ko ni ejaje nii fɛɛ ni mifee etsɔ̃ɔ mi, akɛ jeee Kristo lɛ ni lo?” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli amɛba eŋɔɔ.
Shi no mli lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ kpa lɛ fai amɛkɛɛ, “Rabi, ye nɔ ko.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miyɛ ŋmaa ni miyeɔ, ni nyɛleee.” No hewɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɔ ko ebahã lɛ nɔ ko eye?” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋmaa ji akɛ mafee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii, ni magbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa.
Ani nyɛkɛɛɛ akɛ, ‘Eshwɛ nyɔji ejwɛ ni abelekuumɔbe lɛ shɛɔ?’ Naa, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛwoa nyɛhiɛ nɔ ni nyɛkwɛa ŋmɔji lɛ bɔ ni amɛgba futaa momo ni sa kpamɔ.
Ni mɔ ni kpaa lɛ naa enyɔmɔwoo, ni ebuaa yibii anaa etoɔ naanɔ wala, koni mɔ ni duɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni kpaa lɛ fɛɛ anya shi kome.
Ejaakɛ enɛ mli ni wiemɔ ni awie akɛ, ‘Mɔ ko duɔ ni mɔ ko kpaa’ lɛ baa mli yɛ.
Mi lɛ mitsu nyɛ koni nyɛyakpa nɔ ni jeee nyɛ nyɛgbo he deŋme; mɛi krokomɛi egbo he deŋme, ni nyɛba amɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ mli.” Ni Samariabii lɛ ni jɛ nakai maŋ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye yɛ yoo lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛye odase akɛ, “Ekɛɛ mi nii fɛɛ ni mifee pɛŋ lɛ” hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Samariabii lɛ ba eŋɔɔ lɛ, amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi; ni ehi jɛi gbii enyɔ.
Ni mɛi pii ni fe tsutsubii lɛ saa he ye yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewiemɔ lɛ hewɔ; ni amɛkɛɛ yoo lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ wɔmiihe wɔmiiye, jeee bo owiemɔ lɛ hewɔŋ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔnu, ni wɔna wɔle akɛ, anɔkwale, mɔ nɛ ji je lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.” Maŋtsɛ wenuu lɛ binuu lɛ tsamɔ Gbii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ eyiŋ kɛjɛ jɛi etee Galilea, tsɛbelɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye odase akɛ gbalɔ ko hiɛ bɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ.
Be ni eba Galilea lɛ, Galileabii lɛ ni na nii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ here lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ hu amɛtee gbijurɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba Kana yɛ Galilea, he ni ehã nu tsɔ̃ wain yɛ lɛ, ekoŋŋ.
Ni maŋtsɛ wenuu ko yɛ Kapernaum ni ebi he miiye.
Ni be ni enu akɛ Yesu ejɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ, etee eŋɔɔ ni eyatutɔ lɛ akɛ eba ni ebatsa ebi lɛ, ejaakɛ eeehe egbo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ nyɛnaaa okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii lɛ, nyɛheee nyɛyeee.” Maŋtsɛ wenuu lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ba dani mibi lɛ agbo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, obi lɛ yi ena wala.” Ni nuu lɛ he nɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ lɛ eye, ni eyiŋ etee.
Shi be ni eyaa lɛ, etsuji kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obinuu lɛ he ewa lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, ebi amɛ nɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɔ ni ehe bɔ̃i lɛ waa, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ shwane ŋmɛlɛ kome mli ni atridii lɛ tse yɛ enɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni tsɛ lɛ kɛna akɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Obi lɛ he ewa lɛ” lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ ni; ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ he ye.
Enɛ ji okadi ni ji enyɔ ni Yesu fee, be ni ejɛ Yudea eba Galilea lɛ.
Betesda Kpaakpo lɛ naa helatsɛ lɛ tsamɔ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ ko bashɛ, ni Yesu tee Yerusalɛm.
Kpaakpo ko yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Toi Agboi lɛ masɛi, ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Betesda, ni koii enumɔ yɛ he.
Enɛɛmɛi amli helatsɛmɛi pii — shwilafoi, akpakei kɛ obubuafoi — kãmɔ [ni amɛmɛɔ nu lɛ mlitaa.
Ejaakɛ bei komɛi lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kpelekeɔ shi kɛbaa kpaakpo lɛ mli ni ebataa nu lɛ mli; kɛkɛ lɛ emlitaa lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yagbeɔ nu lɛ mli tsutsu lɛ, hela fɛɛ hela ni eyeɔ lɛ ehe tãa.]
Nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni ehe eye afii nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ kɛ kpaanyɔ.
Yesu na lɛ ni ekã shi, ni akɛni ele akɛ etsɛ aahu lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Oosumɔ akɛ ohe awa bo lo?” Helatsɛ lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ abata nu lɛ mli ni eeewo mi eyawo kpaakpo lɛ mli; shi kɛ miiya lɛ, mɔ kroko tsɔ̃ɔ mihiɛ eyagbeɔ mli.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi, kɔ osaa lɛ, ni onyiɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ he wa lɛ, ni ewo esaa lɛ ni enyiɛ.
Shi nakai gbi lɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ mɔ ni atsa lɛ akɛ, “hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɛ, obɛ hegbɛ akɛ otereɔ osaa.” Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni tsa mi lɛ, lɛ ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ.’ ” Amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji mɔ ni kɛɛ bo akɛ, ‘Kɔ osaa lɛ ni onyiɛ’ lɛ?” Shi mɔ ni atsa lɛ leee mɔ ni ji; ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni Yesu egbala ehe shi.
Fee sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yana lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, ohe ewa bo; kaafee esha dɔŋŋ, koni efɔŋ ni fe tsutsu nɔ lɛ akaba onɔ.” Nuu lɛ yiŋ etee ni eyagba Yudafoi lɛ akɛ Yesu ji mɔ ni tsa lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ jie amɛhiɛ amɛka Yesu, ejaakɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ efee nii nɛɛ.
Shi Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “MiTsɛ miitsu nii kɛbashi be nɛ, ni mi hu miitsu.” No hewɔ titri Yudafoi lɛ taoɔ lɛ agbe lɛ, ejaakɛ jeee akɛ ebule hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ etsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eTsɛ, ni efee ehe akɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye hegbɔ.
Hegbɛ ni Bi lɛ yɔɔ No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ eto eyiŋ efee nɔ ko, ja nɔ ni ena akɛ Tsɛ lɛ miifee; ejaakɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ feɔ lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu feɔ.
Ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ Bi lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nibii fiaa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ efeɔ lɛ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni fe enɛɛmɛi tete, ni nyɛnaa aaakpɛ nyɛhe.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ teɔ gbohii ashi ni ehãa amɛ wala lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Bi lɛ hu hãa mɛi ni esumɔɔ lɛ wala.
Ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ ekojooo mɔ ko, shi moŋ etu kojomɔ lɛ fɛɛ ewo Bi lɛ dɛŋ; koni mɛi fɛɛ abu Bi lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni amɛbuɔ Tsɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ni ebuuu Bi lɛ, ebuuu Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu lɛ lɛ hu.
“Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni nuɔ miwiemɔ ni eheɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ eyeɔ lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni ebaŋ kojomɔ mli, shi moŋ efo mli yɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ: ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, ni eshɛ etã, ni gbohii lɛ aaanu Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbee, ni mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ aaana wala.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ehã Bi lɛ wala yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli.
Ni ehã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekojo hu, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ.
Enɛ akafee nyɛ naakpɛɛ; ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba, nɔ mli ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ gbohii abui amli lɛ aaanu egbee, ni amɛaaje kpo, mɛi ni efee ekpakpa lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee wala mli, ni mɛi ni etsu nishaianii lɛ aaate shi kɛaatee kojomɔ lɛ mli.” Nii ni yeɔ Yesu he odase “Mi diɛŋtsɛ minyɛŋ miyiŋ mato mafee nɔ ko; bɔ ni minuɔ lɛ nakai mikojoɔ, ni mikojomɔ lɛ jalɛ kojomɔ ni, ejaakɛ mitaooo nɔ ni mi diɛŋtsɛ misumɔɔ, shi moŋ nɔ ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ sumɔɔ.
Kɛji mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase miyeɔ lɛ, midase lɛ jeee anɔkwale.
Mɔ kroko yɛ ni yeɔ mihe odase, ni mile akɛ odase ni eyeɔ yɛ mihe lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsu atee Yohane ŋɔɔ, ni eye anɔkwale lɛ he odase.
Shi mi lɛ, mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔ ko odase nɔ; shi bɔ ni afee ni ahere nyɛyiwala hewɔ miwieɔ enɛɛmɛi nɛɛ.
