Yohane ji kane ni tsoɔ ni ekpɛɔ lɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛmli afili nyɛ be kukuoo kɛkɛ yɛ elá lɛ mli.
Shi mi lɛ, miyɛ odase ni fe Yohane nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ ehã mi akɛ migbe naa lɛ, nakai nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ yeɔ mihe odase akɛ Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi.
Ni Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eye mihe odase.
Nyɛnuko egbee dã lɛ, asaŋ nyɛnako esubaŋ dã; ni ewiemɔ lɛ mɔɔɔ shi yɛ nyɛmli, ejaakɛ nyɛheee mɔ ni etsu lɛ nyɛyeee.
Nyɛtaoɔ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ nomɛi amli nyɛnaa naanɔ wala yɛ; ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ ji nii ni yeɔ mihe odase lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛsumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛbaa miŋɔɔ ni nyɛna wala.
“Mitaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam.
Shi moŋ mikpa nyɛ shi akɛ nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ yɛ nyɛmli.
Mi lɛ miba yɛ miTsɛ gbɛi mli, ni nyɛhereee mi; kɛji mɔ kroko ba yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ lɛ nyɛaahere lɛ.
Te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛaanyɛ nyɛhe nyɛyeŋ, nyɛ ni nyɛtaoɔ anunyam yɛ nyɛteaŋ, shi anunyam ni jɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ koome lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ nyɛdii sɛɛ lɛ?
Nyɛkasusua akɛ mi mibafolɔ nyɛnaa mahã Tsɛ lɛ; mɔ ko yɛ ni miifolɔ nyɛnaa, lɛ ji Mose, mɔ nɔ ni nyɛŋɔ nyɛhiɛ nyɛfɔ̃ lɛ.
Shi eji nyɛhe Mose nyɛye kulɛ, mi hu nyɛaahe mi nyɛye; ejaakɛ mihe sane eŋma lɛ.
Shi kɛji nyɛheee eŋmalɛi lɛ nyɛyeee lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛaahe miwiemɔi lɛ nyɛyeŋ?”
Yesu hã mɛi akpei enumɔ niyenii Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yesu yiŋ etee Galilea Ŋshɔ ni ji Tiberia Ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ.
Ni mɛi babaoo nyiɛ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna naakpɛɛ nii ni efee yɛ helatsɛmɛi lɛ ahe lɛ.
Ni Yesu tee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yatara jɛi.
Shi Hehoo lɛ, ni ji Yudafoi lɛ agbijurɔ lɛ, eshɛ etã.
Yesu yaawo ehiɛ nɔ lɛ ena akɛ mɛi babaoo miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ebi Filipo akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ wɔɔyahe aboloo yɛ wɔhã mɛnɛɛmɛi amɛye?” Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛka lɛ, ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ele nɔ ni ebaafee.
Filipo here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Denarioi ohai enyɔ naa aboloo shɛŋ amɛ, bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana fioo ko.” Ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni atsɛɔ lɛ Andrea lɛ, ni ji Simon Petro nyɛmi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Gbekɛ nuu ko yɛ biɛ ni yɔɔ aboloi enumɔ kɛ loi bibii enyɔ; shi mɛi pii nɛɛ, amɛnɛgbɛ enɛ shɛɔ?” Shi Yesu kɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa mɛi lɛ ataraa shi.” Shi jwɛi pii yɛ jɛi, ni hii ni amɛyibɔ aaashɛ akpei enumɔ lɛ ho tara shi.
Ni Yesu kɔlɔ aboloi lɛ, ni be ni eda shi lɛ, eja ehã mɛi ni tara shi lɛ, kɛ loi lɛ hu eko, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛtaoɔ.
Be ni amɛtɔrɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbuaa fufuji ni eshwɛ lɛ anaa, koni nɔ ko akalaaje.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbua aboloi enumɔ lɛ afufuji ni mɛi ni ye lɛ shwɛ lɛ anaa amɛwo kafui nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni gbɔmɛi lɛ na naakpɛɛnii ni Yesu fee lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Anɔkwa, mɔ nɛ ji gbalɔ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ!” Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ amɛbaaba ni amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛyawo lɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ, ekome too egbala ehe shi kɛtee gɔŋ lɛ nɔ ekoŋŋ.
Yesu nyiɛ nu hiɛ Be ni shɛ gbɛkɛnaashi lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ yiŋ kɛtee ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni amɛmiifo ŋshɔ lɛ kɛya Kapernaum.
Shi duŋ ewo fɛɛ lɛ, Yesu bako amɛŋɔɔ lolo; ni ahum ko ni batswa hewɔ lɛ ŋshɔ lɛ fite.
Be ni amɛwiri aaafee shitoi etɛ̃ loo ejwɛ lɛ, amɛna Yesu ni enyiɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ ni eebɛŋkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni amɛshe gbeyei.
Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miŋ, nyɛkashea gbeyei.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ miishɛɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛba lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni amrɔ lɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yakpeleke he ni amɛyaa lɛ.
Yesu, wala aboloo lɛ Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, asafo ni yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ na akɛ lɛlɛ kroko bɛ jɛi dɔŋŋ akɛ ja ekome kɛkɛ, ni amɛna hu akɛ Yesu kɛ kaselɔi lɛ eyaaa lɛlɛ lɛ mli, shi moŋ ekaselɔi lɛ kɛkɛ (kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ) yiŋ kɛtee; tsɛbelɛ lɛji krokomɛi jɛ Tiberia ba he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ da shi ni amɛye aboloo lɛ yɛ lɛ masɛi; no hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ na akɛ Yesu loo ekaselɔi lɛ bɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛ hu amɛbote lɛji amli, ni amɛba Kapernaum amɛmiitao Yesu.
Ni be ni amɛbana lɛ yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Rabi, te be ni oba biɛŋ?” Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee okadii lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nɛɛ, shi moŋ akɛni nyɛye aboloo lɛ eko ni nyɛtɔrɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Nyɛkatsua ŋmaa ni fiteɔ lɛ he nii, shi moŋ nyɛtsua ŋmaa ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ wala mli ni Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ aaahã nyɛ lɛ he nii, ejaakɛ lɛ enaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ esɔo.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te wɔfee tɛŋŋ ni wɔtsu Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ nɛ, akɛ nyɛhe mɔ ni etsu lɛ nɔ nyɛye.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛɛ okadi ofeɔ ni wɔna koni wɔhe bo wɔye?
Mɛni otsuɔ?
Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, ‘Ehã amɛ aboloo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi amɛye’ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, jeee Mose ji mɔ ni hã nyɛ aboloo lɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ, shi miTsɛ moŋ hãa nyɛ anɔkwa aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aboloo lɛ ji mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi ekpelekeɔ shi ni eŋɔɔ wala ehãa je lɛ.” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, hã wɔ aboloo nɛɛ daa.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ; mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, hɔmɔ yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko, ni mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kumai hu yeŋ lɛ gbi ko gbi ko.
Shi miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛna mi, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛhãa mi lɛ aaaba miŋɔɔ, ni mɔ ni baa miŋɔɔ lɛ, mishwieŋ lɛ kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ misuɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔ mijɛ ŋwɛi miba, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaa nifeemɔ hewɔŋ.
Shi enɛ ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, akɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni ekɛhã mi lɛ, mikahã amɛteŋ mɔ ko miilaaje, shi moŋ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji mí-Tsɛ suɔmɔnaanii, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kwɛɔ Bi lɛ ni eheɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ ana naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ mitee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ wie ehe huhuuhu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mi ji aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ;” ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee Yosef bi Yesu lɛ ni wɔle etsɛ kɛ enyɛ lɛ nɛ?
Mɛɛba mɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘Mijɛ ŋwɛi’ lɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkawiewiea huhuuhu yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Mɔ ko nyɛŋ aba miŋɔɔ, akɛ ja Tsɛ lɛ ni tsu mi lɛ gbala lɛ dã, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli akɛ, ‘Amɛ fɛɛ amɛaafee mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.’ Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni enu enɛ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ naa ni ekase hu lɛ, ebaa miŋɔɔ.
Jeee akɛ mɔ ko ena Tsɛ lɛ pɛŋ, ja mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ; lɛ ena Tsɛ lɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ eyɛ naanɔ wala.
Mi ji wala aboloo lɛ.
Nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye mana yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ ni amɛgboi.
Enɛ ji aboloo ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa lɛ, koni gbɔmɔ aye ni ekagbo.
Mi ji aboloo ni hiɛ kã ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba lɛ; kɛji mɔ ko ye aboloo nɛɛ eko lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ.
Shi aboloo ni mikɛbaahã lɛ ji miheloo ni mikɛbaahã yɛ je lɛ wala hewɔ lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ taataa naa yɛ amɛteŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ baafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ ekɛ eheloo ahã wɔ ni wɔyeŋ?” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ kɛji nyɛyeee Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ heloo ni nyɛnuuu elá lɛ, nyɛbɛ wala yɛ nyɛmli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, eyɛ naanɔ wala, ni mi lɛ matee lɛ shi yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ miheloo lɛ anɔkwa ŋmaa ni, ni milá lɛ anɔkwa numɔnɔ ni.
Mɔ ni yeɔ miheloo ni enuɔ mila lɛ, ehiɔ mimli, ni mi hu mihiɔ emli.
Bɔ ni Tsɛ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, tsu mi, ni Tsɛ lɛ hewɔ mihiɛ kã lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɔ ni yeɔ mi lɛ hu hiɛ aaakã yɛ mihewɔ.
Aboloo ni jɛ ŋwɛi ba nɛ; etamɔɔɔ nɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ ye ni amɛgboi lɛ; mɔ ni yeɔ aboloo nɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã kɛaatee naanɔ.” Ewie nii nɛɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehe ko yɛ Kapernaum lɛ.
Naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, be ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nu enɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Wiemɔ ni wa nɛ; namɔ aaanyɛ toi abo?” Be ni Yesu yoo akɛ ekaselɔi lɛ miihuhuu yɛ enɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ani enɛ tɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ nyɛnane nɛɛ?
Shi kɛji nyɛna Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ miiya ŋwɛi he ni eyɔɔ sa lɛ, no hu?
Mumɔ lɛ ji mɔ ni hãa wala lɛ; heloo lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko.
Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wie lɛ, mumɔ ni, ni wala ni.
Shi nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɛ ni heee yeee.” Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ Yesu le mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ kɛ mɔ hu ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ miŋɔɔ aba, ja Tsɛ lɛ ehã lɛ hegbɛ lɛ.” Jɛ no nɔ lɛ, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii ku amɛsɛɛ ni amɛkɛ lɛ enyiɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu bi mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee?” Simon Petro here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ŋɔɔ wɔɔtee?
Bo oyɔɔ naanɔ wala wiemɔi lɛ; ni wɔ lɛ wɔhe wɔye ni asaŋ wɔna wɔle akɛ bo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!” Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani jeee nyɛyi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mihala?
Shi nyɛteŋ mɔ kome lɛ abonsam ni!” Shi Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, he ewieɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ.
Yesu tee Asesei Agbijurɔ lɛ Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Yesu kpa shi yɛ Galilea.
Esumɔɔɔ akɛ eyakpaa shi yɛ Yudea, ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ miitao lɛ agbe.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ Asesei agbijurɔ lɛ eshɛ etã.
No hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Jee biɛ ni oya Yudea, koni okaselɔi lɛ hu ana onitsumɔi ni otsuɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko ni etao akɛ ale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ efeee nɔ ko yɛ teemɔ mli.
Akɛni oofee nibii nɛɛ lɛ, jiemɔ ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.” Shi enyɛmimɛi lɛ tete po heee enɔ yeee.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mibe lɛ nako ashɛ, shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛbe lɛ daa nɛɛ eshɛ.
Je lɛ nyɛɛɛ nyɛ anyɛ; shi mi lɛ enyɛɔ mi, ejaakɛ miyeɔ ehe odase akɛ enitsumɔi lɛ nitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ni.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛyaa gbijurɔ nɛɛ yeli; shi mi lɛ minako maya, ejaakɛ mibe lɛ nako ashɛ.” Be ni ekɛɛ amɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, ehi shi yɛ Galilea.
Shi be ni enyɛmimɛi lɛ etee gbijurɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu etee, shi ejieee ehe shi, shi moŋ efee tamɔ mɔ ko ni miitee ehe.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ bɔ̃i lɛ taomɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?” Ni huhuhuhu wiemɔi pii ete shi yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ ehe.
Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji lɛ;” ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ akɛ, “Dabi, hã moŋ ehãa asafo lɛ duduɔ.” Tsɛbelɛ mɔ ko ejeee faŋŋ ewieee ehe yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ.
Shi be ni shɛ gbijurɔ lɛ teŋ lɛ, Yesu tee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te mɔ nɛ ni ekaseko nii lɛ fee tɛŋŋ ni ele woji amli nii nɛkɛ?” Yesu here amɛ nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Minitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.
Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ebaayoo yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ jɛ aloo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ.
Mɔ ni toɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieɔ lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enunyam etaoɔ, shi mɔ ni taoɔ mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ, lɛ lɛ anɔkwafo ji lɛ, ni nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ bɛ emli.
Ani jeee Mose hã nyɛ Mla lɛ?
Ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko yeee Mla lɛ nɔ.
Mɛni hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ mi nyɛgbe lɛ?” Asafo lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli; namɔ taoɔ bo agbe?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nitsumɔ kome mitsu, ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnaa ekpɛ nyɛhe yɛ he.
Mose kɛ ketiafoo lɛ hã nyɛ — jeee akɛ lɛ Mose lɛ eŋɔɔ ejɛ, shi moŋ ejɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ — ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛfoɔ mɔ ketia.
Kɛji hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ afoɔ mɔ kɛtia bɔ ni afee ni akatɔ̃ Mose Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛmli fuɔ mi akɛ mitsa gbɔmɔ muu lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ?
Nyɛkakwɛa hiɛiaŋ nyɛkojoa, shi moŋ nyɛkojoa jalɛ kojomɔ.” Ani Kristo lɛ nɛ?
Kɛkɛ ni Yerusalɛmbii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ ni amɛtaoɔ amɛgbe lɛ nɛ?
Ni naa, faŋŋ ewieɔ yɛ nɛɛ, ni amɛkɛɛɛ lɛ nɔ ko.
Ekolɛ benɛ onukpai lɛ ena ele lɛɛlɛŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ?
Shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔle he ni ejɛ; shi Kristo lɛ, be ni eeeba lɛ, mɔ ko leŋ he ni ejɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ebo ekɛɛ, “Nyɛle mi, ni asaŋ nyɛle he ni mijɛ; ni mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ, ni nyɛleee lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ mile lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni lɛ etsu mi.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao amɛmɔ lɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.
Shi asafo lɛ mli mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Be ni Kristo lɛ aaaba lɛ, ani eeefee okadii pii fe nii ni mɔ nɛ feɔ nɛɛ?” Yesu gba eŋwɛiyaa eto Farisifoi lɛ nu akɛ asafo lɛ miiwie nii nɛɛ ahe huhuhuhu yɛ ehe; ni Farisifoi lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ tsu tsuji koni amɛyamɔ lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi, ni mibaya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ mɔ nɛ baaya ni wɔnaŋ lɛ?
Ani mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã Helabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ ebaaya, ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ anii?
Mɛɛ wiemɔ ewie nɛɛ, ‘Nyɛaatao mi ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba lɛ?’ ” Wala nu lɛ he shiwoo Shi naagbee gbi ni ji gbii juji lɛ ateŋ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yesu yadamɔ shi ni ebo ekɛɛ, “Kɛji kumai miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eba miŋɔɔ ni ebanu nu.
Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, fai ni wala nu yɔɔ mli aaajɛ emli aho.” Shi Mumɔ lɛ ni mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ baana lɛ he ewie nɛɛ; shi Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nako aba, ejaakɛ anako awo Yesu hiɛ nyam.
Mligbalamɔ ba mɛi lɛ ateŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ Be ni asafo lɛ mli mɛi komɛi nu wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Gbalɔ lɛ nɛ lɛɛlɛŋ!” Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Kristo lɛ nɛ!” Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ani Kristo lɛ, Galilea ebaajɛ?
Ani Ŋmalɛ lɛ ekɛɛɛ akɛ David shwiei lɛ mli kɛ Betlehem maŋ he ni David hi lɛ, jɛi Kristo lɛ baajɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni mligbalamɔ ba asafo lɛ mli yɛ ehewɔ.
Shi kulɛ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi miitao akɛ amɛmɔɔ lɛ shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ko etaaa ehe.
Yudafoi anukpai lɛ sumɔɔɔ akɛ mɔ ko heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ Kɛkɛ ni tsuji lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Amɛbi tsuji lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba nyɛkɛ lɛ baaa?” Tsuji lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Bɔ ni gbɔmɔ nɛɛ wieɔ lɛ, mɔ ko ewieko nakai dã.” Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani nyɛ hu alaka nyɛ?
Ani onukpai lɛ loo Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ehe enɔ eye?
Shi asafo ni leee Mla nɛɛ, alomɔ amɛ.” Nikodemo, amɛteŋ mɔ kome ni ba Yesu ŋɔɔ be ko lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ anuko mɔ ko daaŋ gbee ni aaale nɔ ni efee lɛ, wɔmla lɛ buɔ le fɔ lo?” Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo hu Galilea ojɛ?
Taomɔ mli okwɛ, shi gbalɔ ko eteko shi kɛjɛko Galilea pɛŋ.” [ Ni amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tee ewe.
Yoo gbãlãfitelɔ lɛ Shi Yesu yiŋ etee Mugɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni leebi maaŋkpa lɛ eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ ba eŋɔɔ, ni eho eta shi etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii.
Ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ŋɔ yoo ko ni amɔ lɛ yɛ gbãlãfitemɔ mli kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛhã edamɔ teŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, nɛkɛ yoo nɛɛ, gbãlãfitemɔ mli diɛŋtsɛ amɔ lɛ yɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ.
Mla lɛ mli lɛ Mose wo wɔ kitã akɛ atswia nɛkɛ yei atɛi.
Shi bo lɛ, te okɛɔ tɛŋŋ?” Shi enɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ amɛkɛtsɔ̃ lɛ, koni amɛna nɔ ko amɛkɛyafolɔ enaa.
Ni Yesu koto shi, ni ekɛ ewao ŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Shi be ni amɛhiɛ lɛ bimɔ lɛ, ewo ehe nɔ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛteŋ mɔ ni esha bɛ ehe lɛ, lɛ tsutsu etswa lɛ tɛ lɛ.” Ni esaa ekoto shi ekoŋŋ, ni eŋma nii yɛ shikpɔŋ.
Be ni amɛnu nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ, amɛbɔ̃i kpojee ekomekome, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ nɔ kɛyashi sɛɛkpee mɔ nɔ, ni bashwɛ Yesu kome kɛkɛ kɛ yoo lɛ ni edãmɔ te lɛ mli.
Shi be ni Yesu wo ehe nɔ ni enaaa mɔ ko akɛ ja yoo lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, nɛgbɛ onaafolɔlɔi lɛ yɔɔ, Ani mɔ ko ebuko bo fɔ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Mɔ ko ebuko mi fɔ, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi hu mibuuu bo fɔ; yaa, shi kaafee esha dɔŋŋ.”] Yesu ye lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odase Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛ amɛ wie ekoŋŋ ekɛɛ, “Mi ji je lɛ mli la lɛ.
Mɔ ni nyiɛɔ misɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛŋ duŋ mli gbi ko gbi ko, shi moŋ eeena wala la lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe odase oyeɔ; odase lɛ bɛ mli.” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Kɛ miiye mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase hu jiŋŋ, midase lɛ anɔkwale ni, ejaakɛ mile he ni mijɛ kɛ he ni miyaa, shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛleee he ni mijɛ aloo he ni miyaa.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛkojoɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɛi kojoɔ; mi lɛ mikojooo mɔ ko.
Ni kɛ mikojoɔ tete po, mikojomɔ lɛ anɔkwale ni; ejaakɛ jeee mi kome ni, shi moŋ mi kɛ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ ni.
Ni asaŋ nyɛmla lɛ mli hu aŋma akɛ, ‘Mɛi enyɔ odase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.’ Mi lɛ miyeɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe odase, ni Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ hu yeɔ mihe odase.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ oTsɛ lɛ yɔɔ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Nyɛleee mi ni nyɛsaa nyɛleee miTsɛ; nyɛle mi jikulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu.” Yesu wie wiemɔi nɛɛ yɛ nitoohe lɛ, be ni etsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ; ni mɔ ko mɔɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ shɛko.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mi lɛ miiya, ni nyɛaatao mi, ni nyɛhe esha lɛ mli nyɛaagboi yɛ; he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani eyaagbe ehe hewɔ ekɛɔ akɛ, ‘he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ shishi nɛɛ, mi lɛ mijɛ ŋwɛi; nyɛ lɛ nyɛjɛ je nɛɛ mli, mi lɛ mijɛɛɛ je nɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛheee nyɛyeee akɛ mi nɛɛ ji lɛ lɛ, nyɛaagboi yɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.” Agbɛnɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ni Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nɔ nɔŋŋ ni mikɛɔ nyɛ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ.
Miyɛ nyɛhe saji pii ni mawie ni mikɛaakojo nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ anɔkwafoŋ, ni mi lɛ, nii ni minu yɛ enaa lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ miwieɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.” Amɛleee akɛ Tsɛ lɛ he ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be ni nyɛaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ, no mli nyɛaale akɛ mi ni, ni akɛ mitooo miyiŋ mifeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ bɔ ni miTsɛ tsɔ̃ɔ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.
Ni mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ kɛ mi yɛ; Tsɛ lɛ shiko mi kome, ejaakɛ mi lɛ nɔ ni sa ehiɛ mifeɔ daa.” Be ni ewieɔ nii nɛɛ lɛ, mɛi pii he enɔ ye.
Anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe Kɛkɛ ni Yesu kɛɛ Yudafoi ni ehe lɛ eye lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛhi shi yɛ miwiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, minɔkwa kaselɔi ji nyɛ, ni nyɛaale anɔkwale lɛ, ni anɔkwale lɛ aaahã nyɛye nyɛhe.” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Abraham shwiei ji wɔ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ̃ko mɔ ko nyɔji pɛŋ; te tɛŋŋ ni bo okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛaaye nyɛheŋ?’ ” Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ esha lɛ, esha lɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ.
Nyɔŋ ehiii shĩa kɛyaaa naanɔ; shi bi hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Bi lɛ hã nyɛye nyɛhe lɛ, no nyɛaaye nyɛhe lɛɛlɛŋ.
Mile akɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, ejaakɛ miwiemɔ hooo nyɛmli.
Mi lɛ, nɔ ni mina yɛ miTsɛ he lɛ, no miwieɔ; ni nyɛ hu, nɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ nyɛtsɛ naa lɛ, no nyɛfeɔ.” Amɛhere nɔ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔtsɛ ji Abraham.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Abrahambii ji nyɛ jikulɛ, nyɛaatsu Abraham nitsumɔi.
Shi agbɛnɛ nyɛmiitao mi nyɛgbe, mi gbɔmɔ ko ni mikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale ni minu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa lɛ; Abraham efeee enɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɛ nitsumɔi nyɛtsuɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ afɔɔɔ wɔ yɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ mli; Tsɛ kome wɔyɔɔ, lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ji nyɛTsɛ kulɛ, nyɛaasumɔ mi; ejaakɛ mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba; ni asaŋ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mibaaa, shi moŋ lɛ etsu mi.
Shi mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛnaaa miwiemɔ naa lɛ?
Ejɛ miwiemɔ toi ni nyɛbooo lɛ.
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛ ni nyɛjɛ emli ji abonsam, ni nyɛtsɛ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii nyɛsumɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee.
Lɛ lɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔ ji lɛ kɛjɛ teteete, ni ekɛ anɔkwale lɛ bɛ sane ko, ejaakɛ anɔkwale bɛ emli.
Kɛ eemale lɛ, esu ni, ejaakɛ amalelɔ kɛ ablatsɛ ji lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, akɛni miwieɔ anɔkwale hewɔ lɛ, nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee.
Nyɛteŋ namɔ kãa mi yɛ esha ko he?
Shi kɛji anɔkwale miwieɔ lɛ, mɛɛ hewɔ ni nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ?
Mɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, enuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi; no hewɔ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛnuuu lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛjɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.” Miyɛ dani Abraham ba Yudafoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani jeee gbɛnaa wɔkɛɔ akɛ Samarianyo ji bo, ni mumɔ fɔŋ hu yɛ omli lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ bɛ mimli, shi miiwo miTsɛ, ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛmiishwie mihiɛ shi moŋ.
Mitaooo mi diɛŋtsɛ minunyam; shi mɔ ko yɛ ni taoɔ ni ekojoɔ ehãa mi.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, enaŋ gbele kɛaatee naanɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kpaako wɔna wɔle akɛ mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ omli.
Abraham gbo, ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi, ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ, ‘Kɛji mɔ ko ye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, esaŋ enaa gbele gbi ko gbi ko kɛaatee naanɔ.’ Ani ofe wɔtsɛ Abraham ni gbo lɛ?
Ni gbalɔi lɛ hu gboi.
Te otsɛɔ ohe tɛŋŋ nɛɛ?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji miwo mi diɛŋtsɛ mihiɛ nyam lɛ, minunyam lɛ jeee nɔ ko; miTsɛ ji mɔ ni woɔ mihiɛ nyam, mɔ ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ nyɛNyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, ni nyɛleko lɛ, shi mi lɛ mile lɛ; ni kɛji mikɛɛ akɛ mileee lɛ lɛ, matsɔ̃ amalelɔ tamɔ nyɛ; shi mile lɛ, ni miyeɔ ewiemɔ nɔ.
Nyɛtsɛ Abraham mli fili lɛ akɛ eeena migbi lɛ, ni ena ni emii shɛ ehe.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onako oye afii nyɔŋmai enumɔ, ni ona Abraham lo?” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, miyɛ momo dani afɔ Abraham.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɔlɔ tɛi ni amɛbaatswia lɛ; shi Yesu tee ehe, ni eje Sɔlemɔ we lɛ etee.
Yesu tsa nuu ko ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo Ni be ni Yesu hoɔ lɛ, ena nuu ko ni eshwila kɛjɛ efɔmɔ mli.
Ni ekaselɔi lɛ bi lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, namɔ fee esha, mɔ nɛ loo efɔlɔi, hewɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Jeee esha ni mɔ nɛ loo efɔlɔi fee hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔi lɛ ana aje kpo yɛ emli.
Mi lɛ, ni je etsɛre nɛɛ, ja mitsu mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, je baana, be ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ nii atsu.
Gbii abɔ ni miyɔɔ je lɛ mli nɛɛ, je lɛ la ji mi.” Be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, etsɛ̃ lajɔ̃ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ, ni ekɛ lajɔ̃ lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛ su lɛ kpa shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaaju ohe yɛ Siloam (eshishi ji, Mɔ ni atsu lɛ) Kpaakpo lɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni etee eyaju ehe, ni eba ni eena nii.
Kɛkɛ lɛ ekuŋbii kɛ mɛi ni na lɛ tsutsu ko akɛ sisɛ̃lɔ ji lɛ lɛ kɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ ni kulɛ etaa shi ni esisɛ̃ɔ lɛ nɛ?” Mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Lɛ ni.” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Jeee lɛ ni; etamɔ lɛ.” Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, “Mi ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni ohiŋmɛii lɛ gbeleŋ?” Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yesu lɛ kpɔtɔ su, ni ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii lɛ anɔ, ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa Siloam Kpaakpo lɛ mli ni oyaju ohe.’ Ni be ni mitee miyaju mihe lɛ, mina nii.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ eyɔɔ?” Eto he akɛ, “Mileee.” Farisifoi lɛ bibii saji yɛ etsamɔ lɛ he Ni amɛŋɔ mɔ ni tsutsu ni eshwila lɛ kɛtee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Shi gbi ni Yesu kpɔtɔ su ni ekɛgbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ Hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Farisifoi lɛ hu saa bi lɛ bɔ ni fee ni ena nii lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Su ni akpɔtɔ ekɛkpa mihiŋmɛii anɔ, ni miyaju mihe, ni minaa nii nɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyeee hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ mla lɛ nɔ.” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Te gbɔmɔ ko ni ji eshafeelɔ aaafee tɛŋŋ ni enyɛ efee naakpɛɛnii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi hu?” Ni mligbalamɔ ba amɛteŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbi shwilafo lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Bo hu, te okɛɔ yɛ ehe tɛŋŋ akɛni egbele ohiŋmɛii lɛ?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Gbalɔ ji lɛ.” Shi Yudafoi lɛ heee yeee akɛ shwilafo ji lɛ sa ni agbɛnɛ enaa nii nɛɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni amɛyatsɛ efɔlɔi ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛbi ni nyɛkɛɔ akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo lɛ nɛ?
Te fee tɛŋŋ mɔ ni agbɛnɛ enaa niiŋ?” Efɔlɔi lɛ here amɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔle akɛ wɔbi lɛ nɛ, ni wɔle akɛ afɔ lɛ shwilafo; shi bɔ ni fee ni enaa nii agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, wɔleee, asaŋ mɔ ni gbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ hu wɔleee; eda, nyɛbia lɛ; lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebaawie ehã ehe.” Efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ enɛ, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe Yudafoi lɛ agbeyei; shi Yudafoi lɛ ekpãŋ eto akɛ, kɛji mɔ ko gba mli kpoo kɛɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ, abaashwie mɔ lɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ.
No hewɔ ni efɔlɔi lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Eda, nyɛbia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ” lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɛ nuu ni sa ni eji shwilafo lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ŋɔɔ anunyam ohã Nyɔŋmɔ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔle akɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ eshafeelɔ ji lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Eshafeelɔ ji lɛ jiŋŋ, mileee; nɔ kome mile, akɛ kulɛ shwilafo ji mi, shi agbɛnɛ miina nii.” Ni amɛbi lɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Mɛni efee bo?
Te efee tɛŋŋ ni egbele ohiŋmɛii lɛ?” Ehere amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo, ni nyɛnuuu: mɛɛ hewɔ nyɛtaoɔ toi nyɛbo ekoŋŋ?
Ani nyɛ hu nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ekaselɔi?” Amɛjɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Bo ji ekaselɔ, shi wɔ lɛ Mose kaselɔi ji wɔ.
Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mose wie; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, wɔleee he ni ejɛ.” Nuu lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Enɛ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ, akɛ nyɛleee he ni ejɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ egbele mihiŋmɛii lɛ!
Wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ booo eshafeelɔi atoi; shi kɛji mɔ ko sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni efeɔ esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, eboɔ lɛ toi.
Kɛjɛ ni abɔ ade nɛɛ anuko akɛ mɔ ko egbele mɔ ni afɔ lɛ shwilafo hiŋmɛii dã.
Gbɔmɔ nɛɛ jɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kulɛ enyɛŋ nɔ ko efee.” Amɛhere nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Bo lɛ, esha mli kwraa afɔ bo yɛ, ni bo moŋ otsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii nɛɛ?” Ni amɛshwie lɛ.
Nuu ni atsa lɛ lɛ he Yesu nɔ eye Yesu nu akɛ amɛshwie lɛ; ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, ebi lɛ akɛ, “Oohe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ooye lo?” Ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Namɔ ji lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ koni mahe enɔ maye?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ona lɛ momo, ni asaŋ mɔ ni kɛ bo wieɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ni.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni ekula shi eja lɛ.
Mumɔŋ shwilamɔ Ni Yesu kɛɛ, “Kojomɔ hewɔ miba je nɛɛŋ, koni mɛi ni enaaa nii lɛ ana nii, ni mɛi ni naa nii lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ shwilafoi.” Ni Farisifoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu enɛ, ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔ hu shwilafoi ji wɔ?” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Eji nyɛshwila moŋ kulɛ, nyɛhe bɛ esha; shi agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛɔ akɛ, ‘Wɔmiina nii.’ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhe esha lɛ yɛ nyɛhe lolo.”
Toi atsu lɛ he abɛ lɛ “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔɔ shinaa lɛ ni ekɛbote toi atsu lɛ mli, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ɔ he kroko ekɛkwɔɔ lɛ, julɔ kɛ ojotswalɔ ji lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ shinaa lɛ mli kɛboteɔ mli lɛ, toi lɛ akwɛlɔ ji lɛ.
Lɛ shinaa naabulɔ lɛ gbeleɔ, ni toi lɛ nuɔ egbee, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etoi lɛ agbɛi tsɛɔ amɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ jeɔ kpo.
Ni kɛ ejie toi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ, ni toi lɛ nyiɛɔ esɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛle egbee.
Amɛnyiɛŋ mɔkpɔŋ sɛɛ, shi moŋ amɛaajo enaa foi, ejaakɛ amɛleee mɛi kpɔji agbee.” Yesu bu amɛ abɛ nɛɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛnuuu nɔ ni ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ shishi.
Yesu, Tookwɛlɔ Kpakpa lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Mi ji toi lɛ ashinaa lɛ.
Mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɔ̃ mihiɛ ba lɛ, julɔi kɛ ojotswalɔi ji amɛ; shi toi lɛ booo amɛ toi hu.
Mi ji shinaa lɛ.
Mi lɛ, kɛji mɔ ko tsɔ̃ minaa etee mli lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, ni eeetee mli ni eeeje kpo, ni eeena lɛɛnii.
Julɔ baaa yaka, shi juu kɛ gbee kɛ hiɛkpãtãmɔ hewɔ ebaa; mi lɛ miba bɔ ni afee ni amɛna wala ni amɛna ni ateke nɔ.
“Mi ji tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ.
Tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛ ewala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ etoi lɛ anajiaŋ.
Shi mɔ ni ji apaafonyo ni ejeee toi lɛ akwɛlɔ, mɔ ni toi lɛ jeee enɔ lɛ naa akɛ klaŋ miiba, ni eshiɔ toi lɛ, ni ejoɔ foi, ni klaŋ lɛ bamɔmɔɔ toi lɛ ni egbɛɔ amɛ eshwãa.
Apaafonyo lɛ joɔ foi ejaakɛ apaafonyo ji lɛ, ni toi lɛ ahe edɔɔɔ lɛ.
Mi ji tookwɛlɔ kpakpa lɛ; mile mi diɛŋtsɛ mitoi lɛ, ni mitoi lɛ hu le mi, tamɔ bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ le mi, ni mi hu mile Tsɛ lɛ.
Ni mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi yɛ toi lɛ anajiaŋ.
“Miyɛ toi krokomɛi ni jɛɛɛ toi atsu nɛɛ mli; ni nomɛi hu, ja miŋɔ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛbanu migbee, ni toi lɛ fee kuu kome kɛ kwɛlɔ kome.
No hewɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔɔ mi lɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ miwala ŋmɛɔ shi, koni maŋɔ ekoŋŋ.
Mɔ ko shɔ̃ɔɔ yɛ midɛŋ, shi moŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi; miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ mikɛŋmɛɔ shi, ni miyɛ hewalɛ akɛ miŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ; bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ kɛɛ mi nɛ.” Wiemɔi nɛɛ ahewɔ lɛ mligbalamɔ saa ba Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ ekoŋŋ.
Ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii kɛɛ, “Mumɔ fɔŋ yɛ emli ni eye sɛkɛ; mɛɛhewɔ nyɛboɔ lɛ toi?” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Jeee mɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ yɔɔ emli wiemɔi nɛ.
Ani mumɔ fɔŋ aaanyɛ shwilafoi ahiŋmɛii agbele?” Yudafoi lɛ ŋwã Yesu Agbɛnɛ aaye Sɔlemɔtsu Nɔjɔɔmɔ Gbijurɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni fɛ̃ibe mli ni.
Ni Yesu miishara shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ yɛ Solomon koi lɛ shi.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ babɔle ehe, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ beyinɔ nɔŋŋ ooohã wɔyiŋ afee wɔ kɔshikɔshi kɛyashi?
Kɛ bo ji Kristo lɛ, kɛɛmɔ wɔ faŋŋ.” Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ momo shi nyɛheee nyɛyeee.
Nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ yɛ miTsɛ gbɛi mli lɛ, nomɛi miiye mihe odase; shi nyɛ moŋ ni nyɛheee nyɛyeee, ejaakɛ nyɛjeee mitoi lɛ eko.
Mitoi lɛ nuɔ migbee, ni mile amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ misɛɛ, ni mihãa amɛ naanɔ wala, ni amɛhiɛ kpãtãŋ kɛaatee naanɔ, ni asaŋ mɔ ko shɔŋ amɛ yɛ midɛŋ.
MiTsɛ ni ŋɔ amɛ ehã mi lɛ fe mɛi fɛɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ashɔ̃ amɛ yɛ miTsɛ dɛŋ.
Mi kɛ Tsɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekomeŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɔlɔ tɛi ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛbaatswia lɛ.
Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai pii ni jɛ miTsɛ ŋɔɔ; te nakai nitsumɔi lɛ ateŋ nɔ hewɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ mi tɛi nyɛtswia nɛɛ?” Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee nitsumɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ wɔbaatswia bo tɛi lɛ, shi moŋ musubɔɔ hewɔŋ, ejaakɛ bo ni gbɔmɔ ji bo lɛ, ootsɛ ohe Nyɔŋmɔ.” Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Ani aŋmako yɛ nyɛMla lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Mikɛɛ, nyɔŋmɔi ji nyɛ?’ Kɛji mɛi aŋɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ba lɛ tete lɛ etsɛ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi, ni anyɛŋ ŋmalɛ lɛ mli aku lɛ, nyɛmiikɛɛ mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ efee lɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni etsu lɛ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ akɛ, ‘Obɔ musu’, akɛni mikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji mi’ lɛ?
Kɛjeee miTsɛ nitsumɔi mitsuɔ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛkahea mi nyɛyea; shi kɛji no mitsuɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea nitsumɔi lɛ kɛkɛ nyɛyea mɔ, koni nyɛle ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Tsɛ lɛ yɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli.” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao ekoŋŋ akɛ amɛmɔ lɛ, shi eje amɛdɛŋ.
Ni eyiŋ etee Yordan sɛɛ ekoŋŋ, he ni Yohane baptisi yɛ tsutsu lɛ, ni eyahi jɛi.
Ni mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane efeee naakpɛɛnii ko moŋ; shi nii fiaa ni ewie yɛ nuu nɛɛ he lɛ, anɔkwaŋ.” Ni mɛi pii he enɔ amɛye yɛ jɛi.
Lazaro gbele Nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lazaro ni jɛ Betania, Maria kɛ enyɛmi Martamɛi akrowa lɛ, he miiye.
[ Maria ni kɛ mukɛŋma kpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ lɛ nyɛmi Lazaro he yeɔ nɛɛ.]
No hewɔ lɛ, enyɛmimɛi yei lɛ tsu aba eŋɔɔ abakɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, naa, mɔ ni osumɔɔ lɛ he miiye.” Shi be ni Yesu nu enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ hela nɛɛ jeee gbele hela ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ hewɔ eba, bɔ ni afee ni atsɔ̃ nɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam.” Yesu sumɔɔ Maria kɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ kɛ Lazaro fɛɛ.
Shi be ni enu akɛ ehe miiye lɛ, emɛ yɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ gbii enyɔ.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyaa Yudea ekoŋŋ.” Kaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tsɔɔlɔ, eyeko gbi ko ni Yudafoi lɛ tao bo tɛi atswia lɛ, ni ooya jɛi ekoŋŋ lo?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Ani jeee ŋmɛlɛtswai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ yɔɔ gbi kome mli?
Kɛji mɔ nyiɛ shwane lɛ, etɛɛɛ, ejaakɛ enaa je nɛɛ mli la lɛ.
Shi kɛji mɔ nyiɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ, etɛɔ, ejaakɛ la bɛ.” Ewie nii nɛɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔshieŋtsɛ Lazaro ewɔ; shi miiya ni mayatsĩɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ ewɔ lɛ, no lɛ ehe baawa lɛ.” Shi egbele he Yesu wie lɛ; shi amɛ lɛ amɛsusu akɛ wɔ kpakpa he ewieɔ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ, “Lazaro egbo; ni nyɛ hewɔ lɛ eŋɔɔ minaa akɛ mibɛ jɛi, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhe nyɛye; shi nyɛhãa wɔyaa eŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Toma, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛɛ enanemɛi kaselɔi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔ hu wɔyaa, ni wɔ kɛ lɛ ayagboa.” Yesu, mɔ ni ji Shitee lɛ kɛ Wala lɛ Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu shɛ jɛi lɛ, ebana akɛ eye gbii ejwɛ momo yɛ bu lɛ mli.
Shi Betania kɛ Yerusalɛm teŋ jekɛmɔ aaafee shitoi enyɔ.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii eba Marta kɛ Mariamɛi aŋɔɔ, koni amɛbaye amɛ ŋkɔmɔ yɛ amɛnyɛmi nuu lɛ hewɔ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Marta nu akɛ Yesu miiba lɛ, etee eyakpee lɛ; shi Maria lɛ, lɛ lɛ eta shĩa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Marta bakɛɛ Yesu akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ hu mile akɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ooobi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaahã bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Onyɛmi lɛ baate shi.” Marta kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mile akɛ ebaate shi yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ mi ji shitee lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, kɛji egbo tete lɛ, ehiɛ aaakã; ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã ni eheɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, egboŋ gbi ko gbi ko kɛaatee naanɔ.
Oheɔ enɛ oyeɔ lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, miheɔ miyeɔ akɛ bo ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni baa je lɛ mli lɛ.” Yesu fo Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, eyiŋ etee ni eyatsɛ enyɛmi Maria lɛ nigii, ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eba; eetsɛ bo.” Be ni enu lɛ, ete shi oya ni eba eŋɔɔ.
Shi Yesu nako ashɛ akrowa lɛ, shi eyɛ hegbɛ ni Marta kɛ lɛ yakpe yɛ lɛ lolo.
Be ni Yudafoi lɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ shĩa lɛ ni amɛyeɔ lɛ ŋkɔmɔ lɛ na akɛ Maria ete shi oya kɛje kpo lɛ, amɛtiu lɛ, amɛsusu akɛ eeya fuuhe lɛ eyafo yɛ jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni Maria ba he ni Yesu yɔɔ lɛ ni ena lɛ lɛ, eho egbee enaji anaa, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, eji oyɛ biɛ kulɛ, minyɛmi lɛ gboŋ!” Agbɛnɛ, be ni Yesu na lɛ akɛ eefo, kɛ Yudafoi lɛ hu ni kɛ lɛ ba lɛ, akɛ amɛ hu amɛmiifo lɛ, ehũu yɛ emumɔ mli, ni ehao; ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛgbɛ nyɛto lɛ yɛ?” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ba ni obakwɛ.” Yesu fo.
Kɛkɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ!” Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Ani nuu nɛɛ ni gbele shwilafo lɛ hiŋmɛii lɛ nyɛŋ efee ni kulɛ nuu nɛɛ akagbo?” Yesu tee Lazaro shi Kɛkɛ ni Yesu saa hũu yɛ emli ekoŋŋ, ni etee fuuhe lɛ; shi tɛkplo ni, ni tɛ bu naa.
Yesu kɛɛ, “nyɛjiea tɛ lɛ.” Marta, mɔ ni egbo lɛ nyɛmi yoo lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, be nɛ mli lɛ efite, ejaakɛ eye gbii ejwɛ sɔŋŋ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani mikɛɛɛ bo akɛ kɛji ohe oye lɛ, ooona Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛ jie tɛ lɛ.
Ni Yesu hole ehiŋmɛii anɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa, miida bo shi akɛ obo mi toi lɛ.
Mile akɛ daa oboɔ mi toi, shi asafo lɛ ni damɔ biɛ lɛ hewɔ mikɛɔ enɛ, koni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi.” Ni be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Lazaro ee, jee kpo!” Ni gbonyo lɛ je kpo, fuu mamai lɛ fimɔ enaji kɛ eniji, ni duku fi ehiɛ.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɛnea lɛ, ni nyɛhãa eyaa.” Atee Yesu yi nɔ apam ni agbe lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ ni ba Maria ŋɔɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he Yesu nɔ amɛye, be ni amɛna nii ni efee lɛ.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yiŋ tee Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛyagba amɛ nii ni Yesu fee lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ tsɛ kpee, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Te wɔfeɔ tɛŋŋ, ejaakɛ nuu nɛɛ miifee naakpɛɛnii pii?
Kɛji wɔŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi fɛɛ aaahe enɔ aye; ni Romabii lɛ aaaba ni amɛaabashɔ̃ wɔsɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ wɔshikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ.” Shi amɛteŋ mɔ kome, Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ lɛ nyɛleee nɔ ko kwraa, ni nyɛsaa nyɛjwɛŋŋ hu akɛ ehi hã wɔ akɛ mɔ kome agbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ, fe nɔ ni maŋbii lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ aaakpãtã lɛ.” Shi enɛ lɛ, jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eto eyiŋ ewie, shi moŋ, akɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ, gba egba akɛ Yesu baagbo yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ; ni jeee yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ hewɔ kɛkɛ, shi bɔ ni afee ni ebua Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ hu naa efee kuu kome.
Ni kɛjɛ nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amɛkpɛ mli akɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu ejieee ehe kpo faŋŋ kɛnyiɛɛɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ dɔŋŋ, shi eje jɛi etee shikpɔŋ ko ni kã ŋa lɛ naa lɛ nɔ, yɛ maŋ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Efraim lɛ mli, ni ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yahi jɛi.
Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHehoo lɛ eshɛ etã.
Ni mɛi babaoo jɛ koi asɛɛ amɛtee Yerusalɛm, dani Hehoo lɛ ashɛ, koni amɛyatsuu amɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛbɔ̃i Yesu taomɔ, ni be ni amɛdamɔdamɔɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, amɛbibii amɛhe akɛ, “Te nyɛsusuɔ tɛŋŋ, ani ebaŋ gbijurɔ lɛ?” Shi osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Farisifoi lɛ ewo kitã akɛ, kɛ mɔ ko le he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, etswa adafi, koni ayamɔ lɛ.
Afɔ Yesu mu yɛ Betania Be ni eshwɛ gbii ekpaa ni ayeɔ Hehoo lɛ, Yesu ba Betania, he ni Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, yɔɔ lɛ.
Amɛŋmɛ lɛ okplɔ̃ yɛ jɛi, ni Marta sɔmɔ; ni Lazaro fata mɛi ni kɛ lɛ tara okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ahe.
Kɛkɛ ni Maria ŋɔ “nardo” mu ŋmiiŋmi ni jara wa naakpa ni etsiimɔ ji nsɛnitɛ kome, ni ekɛkpa Yesu naji ahe ni ekɛ eyitsɔi tsumɔ enaji lɛ ahe; ni mu lɛ ŋma yi shĩa lɛ mli tɔ.
Shi Yuda Iskariot, ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, kɛɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ ahɔ̃ɔɔ mu nɛɛ denarioi ohai etɛ̃ ni akɛ shika lɛ ahã ohiafoi?” Shi enɛ ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ, jeee ohiafoi lɛ ahe ni dɔɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ julɔ ji lɛ, ni lɛ etoɔ fotro lɛ, ni ejuɔ nɔ ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Kaagba enaa; efee enɛ eto mifuu gbi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ohiafoi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ yɛ daa; shi mi lɛ, jeee daa nyɛkɛ mi aaahi shi.” Atee Lazaro yinɔ apam Agbɛnɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii na le akɛ Yesu yɛ jɛi, ni amɛba, jeee Yesu kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ koni amɛna Lazaro, mɔ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hu.
Ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaagbe Lazaro hu, ejaakɛ ehewɔ jɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii tee ni amɛyahe Yesu nɔ amɛye lɛ.
Yesu Yerusalɛm botemɔ Enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni mɛi babaoo ni eba gbijurɔ lɛ nu akɛ Yesu miiba Yerusalɛm lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ blɛoi, ni amɛje kpo amɛyakpee lɛ, ni amɛbolɔ akɛ “Hosiana!
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni baa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi mli lɛ, Israel Maŋtsɛ lɛ!” Shi Yesu ena teji bi ko ni eho eta nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, Zion biyoo!
Naa, omaŋtsɛ lɛ miiba.
Eta tejibi nɔ.” Shi ekaselɔi lɛ enaaa nii nɛɛ ashishi mra mli, shi be ni awo Yesu hiɛ nyam lɛ, no dani amɛkai akɛ aŋma nii nɛɛ yɛ ehe, ni no afee ahã lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, asafo ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ be mli ni etsɛ Lazaro kɛjɛ gbonyobu lɛ mli ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohiiateŋ lɛ ye he odase.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni asafo lɛ yakpee lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ efee naakpɛɛnii nɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, Farisifoi lɛ kɛɛ yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Te nyɛna akɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ fɛi nyɛfee!
Naa, je lɛ efã kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ!” Helabii komɛi batao Yesu Shi Helabii komɛi yɛ mɛi ni ba koni amɛbaja Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ba Filipo ni jɛ Betsaida yɛ Galilea lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni amɛbakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔmiitao akɛ wɔna Yesu.” Filipo ba ni ebakɛɛ Andrea, ni Andrea kɛ Filipo bakɛɛ Yesu.
Ni Yesu here amɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni akɛbaawo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam lɛ eshɛ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛ ŋmaa kuli enyɔɔɔ shikpɔŋ ni egbo lɛ, no lɛ eyɛ akɛ ŋmaa kuli kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛji egbo lɛ, ewoɔ yibii pii.
Mɔ ni dɔɔ ewala he lɛ, elaajeɔ lɛ, shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ ewala yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, eeeto lɛ kɛaatee naanɔ wala mli.
Kɛji mɔ ko miisɔmɔ mi lɛ, enyiɛ misɛɛ, ni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ, jɛi misɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ hu aaahi; kɛji mɔ ko miisɔmɔ mi lɛ, miTsɛ aaawo lɛ.” Sa akɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ “Agbɛnɛ misusuma miihao, ni mɛni makɛɛ?
Ataa, heremɔ mi kɛjɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli!
Shi asaŋ enɛ hewɔ miba ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ataa, wo ogbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam!” Kɛkɛ ni gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi kɛɛ, “Mina miwo ehiɛ nyam, ni masaa mawo ehiɛ nyam ekoŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni asafo ni damɔ jɛi ni nu lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ eshi!” Mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie!” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Jeee mi hewɔ gbee nɛɛ ba, shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛhewɔ.
Agbɛnɛ je nɛɛŋ kojomɔ lɛ eshɛ; agbɛnɛ abaafã je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ ashɛ afɔ̃.
Ni mi lɛ, kɛji awo minɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, magbala mɛi fɛɛ kɛaaba miŋɔɔ.” Shi enɛ lɛ ekɛɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo.
Asafo lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔnu yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ Kristo lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ; ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni bo lɛ okɛɔ akɛ ja awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Namɔ ji nɛkɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi nɛɛ?” Kɛkɛ lɛ Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Be kukuoo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ehã la lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛnyiɛa koni duŋ akabanina nyɛ; shi mɔ ni nyiɛɔ duŋ mli lɛ, eleee he ni eyaa.
Gbii abɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ la lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhea la lɛ nɔ nyɛyea, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la bii.” Yesu wie nii nɛɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ ehe tee amɛ.
Yudafoi lɛ heee Yesu nɔ amɛyeee Efee naakpɛɛnii babaoo yɛ amɛhiɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛheee enɔ amɛyeee, koni gbalɔ Yesaia wiemɔ ni ewie lɛ ana aba mli akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye, Ni namɔ ajie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ?” Enɛ hewɔ ni amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ, ejaakɛ Yesaia saa kɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Eshwila amɛhiŋmɛii, ni ekpliŋ amɛtsui; koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii, ni amɛna naa kɛ amɛtsui, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ ni mitsa amɛ.” Nii nɛɛ Yesaia kɛɛ, ejaakɛ ena enunyam lɛ, ni ewie ehe.
Kɛ̃lɛ onukpai lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii he enɔ ye; shi Farisifoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ amɛjajeee faŋŋ, koni akashwie amɛ kɛjɛ kpeehe lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛmiisumɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛnyam fe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ.
Yesu wiemɔ kojoɔ Shi Yesu bo ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni heɔ minɔ yeɔ lɛ, jeee mi minɔ eheɔ eyeɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ; ni mɔ ni naa mi lɛ naa mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mi lɛ miba je lɛ mli akɛ la, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ akahi duŋ lɛ mli.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko nu miwiemɔi lɛ ni eyeee nɔ lɛ, mikojooo lɛ; ejaakɛ mibaaa koni mibakojo je lɛ, shi moŋ miba koni mibahere je lɛ yiwala.
Mɔ ni kwaa mi ni emɔɔɔ miwiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, eyɛ mɔ ko ni kojoɔ lɛ.
Wiemɔ ni miwie lɛ, no nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ yɛ naagbee gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitooo mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ miwieee; shi Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ, lɛ moŋ ewo mi kitã, nɔ ni mikɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni miwie.
Ni mile akɛ ekitã lɛ naanɔ wala ni; no hewɔ lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni miwieɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ ekɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai miwieɔ.”
Yesu fɔ ekaselɔi lɛ anaji ahe Dani Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ aaashɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa ni ekɛbaaje je nɛɛ mli kɛya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ eshɛ hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai esumɔ amɛ kɛyashi naagbee.
Ni be ni amɛyeɔ nii lɛ, belɛ abonsam kɛwo Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ, tsui mli momo, akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ — akɛni Yesu le akɛ Tsɛ lɛ etu nii fɛɛ ewo edɛŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ, ni esaa eeya Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ete shi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi, ni ejie etadei lɛ eshwie shi, ni ekɔ papaŋ ni ekɛŋmɔ ehɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, efɔse nu ewo okpolu mli, ni ebɔ̃i ekaselɔi lɛ anaji ahe fɔmɔ, ni ekɛ papaŋ ni ŋmɔ ehɛ lɛ tsumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni ebashɛ Simon Petro nɔ, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ofɔɔ minaji ahe nɛɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nɔ ni mifeɔ nɛɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ oleee, shi kɛfee sɛɛ lɛ, obaale.” Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaafɔ minaji ahe kɔkɔɔkɔ.” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mifɔɔɔ onaji ahe lɛ, obɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ miŋɔɔ.” Simon Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, jeee minaji ahe kɛkɛ mɔ, shi moŋ miniji kɛ miyitso hu.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni aju ehe lɛ, ehiaaa lɛ hefɔflɔmɔ, akɛ ja enaji ahe fɔmɔ kɛkɛ, shi ehe eje kɛmɔ shi; ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhe eje moŋ shi jeee nyɛ fɛɛ ni.” Ejaakɛ ele mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ; no hewɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe eje lɛ.” Agbɛnɛ, be ni efɔ amɛnaji ahe ni ekɔlɔ etadei lɛ ni ewo ni eho eta shi ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebi amɛ akɛ, “Ani nyɛnu nɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ shishi lo?
Nyɛ lɛ nyɛtsɛɔ mi Tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ; ni eja, ejaakɛ nakai ji mi.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛji mi, Tsɔɔlɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mifɔ nyɛnaji ahe lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛfɔfɔɔ nyɛnanemɛi anaji ahe.
Shi okadi mito mihã nyɛ, koni bɔ ni mifee nyɛ nɛɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfee nakai.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɔŋ efeee enuŋtsɔ, ni asaŋ bɔfo efeee mɔ ni tsu lɛ lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛle nii nɛɛ, ajɔɔ nyɛ kɛji nyɛye nɔ.
“Jeee nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe miwieɔ; mi lɛ mile mɛi ni mihala; shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli akɛ, ‘Mɔ ni yeɔ midɛŋ aboloo lɛ, ewo enanetsitsi eshi mi.’ Agbɛnɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ mato dani aba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ mi ni.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni hereɔ mɔ ni mitsuɔ lɛ, mi nɔŋŋ ehereɔ lɛ; ni mɔ ni hereɔ mi lɛ, ehereɔ mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.” Yesu tsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni baatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ Be ni Yesu kɛɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, ehao yɛ mumɔ mli, ni egba mli kpoo ekɛɛ, “Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛteŋ mɔ kome baatsɔ̃ɔ misɛɛgbɛ.” Kɛkɛ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ kwɛkwɛɛ amɛhiɛiaŋ, ni amɛnaaa mɔ koome he ni ewieɔ lɛ.
Shi kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ta emasɛi kpaakpa yɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ he.
Kɛkɛ ni Simon Petro bɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi akɛ ebi lɛ mɔ he ni ewieɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nakai kaselɔ lɛ ho kpasa Yesu tsitsi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ni?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “lɛ ji mɔ ni mikɛ atrɔma lɛ baatsɔ mli mahã lɛ lɛ.” Ni ekɛ atrɔma lɛ tsɔ mli ni ekɛhã Yuda Iskariot, Simon bi lɛ.
Ni atrɔma lɛ sɛɛ pɛ ni Satan bote Yuda mli.
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nɔ ni ofeɔ lɛ, feemɔ mramra!” Shi mɛi ni tara okpɔlɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee nɔ hewɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ nakai lɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi susu akɛ ni Yuda toɔ fotro lɛ, no hewɔ ni Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ eyahe nii ni he hiaa amɛ eto gbijurɔ lɛ, aloo akɛ ekɛ nɔ ko ahã ohiafoi lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni ehe atrɔma lɛ, amrɔ lɛ eje kpo.
Shi je ena.
Kitã hee lɛ Be ni Yuda je kpo lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ awo Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Kɛji atsɔ̃ enɔ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu aaawo ehiɛ nyam yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli, ni eeewo ehiɛ nyam oya.
Bii bibii, be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ baahi shi; nyɛaatao mi, ni bɔ ni mikɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, ‘He ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ jɛi nyɛba’ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ nyɛ hu agbɛnɛ nɛɛ.
Kitã hee mikɛhãa nyɛ akɛ, Nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe.
Kɛji nyɛsumɔɔ nyɛhe lɛ, no mɛi fɛɛ kɛaale akɛ mikaselɔi ji nyɛ.” Yesu gba bɔ ni Petro baakwa lɛ eto Simon Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, nɛgbɛ oyaa?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “He ni miyaa lɛ, onyɛŋ misɛɛ onyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ, shi ooonyiɛ misɛɛ wɔsɛɛ ko.” Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛɛ hewɔ minyɛŋ osɛɛ manyiɛ amrɔ nɛɛ?
Miwala tete mikɛaaŋmɛ shi yɛ ohewɔ.” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Okɛ owala aaaŋmɛ shi yɛ mihewɔ?
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, wuɔ naŋ agbɛɛ ni oookwa mi shii etɛ̃.”
Yesu ji gbɛ lɛ “Nyɛkayea nyɛtsui; nyɛhea Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyea, ni mi hu nyɛhea minɔ nyɛyea.
Shihilɛhei pii yɛ miTsɛ we lɛ; jeee nakai ni kulɛ makɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miiya ni mayasaa gbɛhe mato nyɛ lo?
Ni kɛji mitee ni miyasaa gbɛhe mito nyɛ lɛ, mibaba ekoŋŋ ni mibaŋɔ nyɛ kɛya he ni mi diɛŋtsɛ miyɔɔ lɛ, koni he ni miyɔɔ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛhi jɛi.
Ni he ni miyaa lɛ, nyɛle, ni gbɛ lɛ hu, nyɛle.” Toma kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, wɔleee he ni oyaa, ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔɔnyɛ gbɛ lɛ wɔle hu?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi ji gbɛ lɛ kɛ anɔkwale lɛ kɛ wala lɛ; mɔ ko baaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, akɛ ja etsɔ̃ minɔ.
Eji nyɛle mi kulɛ, nyɛaale miTsɛ hu; ni kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ nyɛle lɛ, ni nyɛna lɛ.” Filipo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni no fa hã wɔ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ, oleko mi lolo, Filipo?
Mɔ ni ena mi lɛ, ena Tsɛ lɛ, ni te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni okɛɔ akɛ ‘Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ wɔ Tsɛ lɛ?’ Ani oheee oyeee akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli?
Wiemɔi ni mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ lɛ, jeee mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ mitoɔ miwieɔ; shi Tsɛ lɛ ni hiɔ mimli lɛ, lɛ etsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ.
Nyɛhea mi nyɛyea akɛ miyɛ Tsɛ lɛ mli ni Tsɛ lɛ hu yɛ mimli; shi kɛji nyɛheee mi nyɛyeee lɛ, nyɛhea mi nyɛyea yɛ minitsumɔi lɛ ahewɔ.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, mɔ ni heɔ minɔ eyeɔ lɛ, nitsumɔi ni mitsuɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eeetsu, ni eeetsu nii ni fe nomɛi tete, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛɛakpa he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee, koni Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ aba nyam kɛtsɔ̃ Bi lɛ nɔ.
Kɛji nyɛkpa nɔ ko he fai yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, mafee.” Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo “Kɛji nyɛmiisumɔ mi lɛ nyɛaaye mikitãi lɛ anɔ.
Ni mi lɛ mabi Tsɛ lɛ ni eeehã nyɛ Hefatalɔ kroko, koni ekɛ nyɛ ahi shi kɛya naanɔ; Hefatalɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni je lɛ nyɛɛɛ lɛ aŋɔ, ejaakɛ enaaa lɛ ni asaŋ eleee lɛ lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛle lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ nyɛ yɔɔ, ni eyɛ nyɛmli.
Mishiŋ nyɛ awusai; miiba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Eshwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni je lɛ enaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; shi nyɛ lɛ nyɛaana mi; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã, ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aaakã.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛaale akɛ miyɛ miTsɛ mli, ni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ mimli, ni mi hu miyɛ nyɛmli.
Mɔ ni ŋɔɔ mikitãi lɛ ni eyeɔ nɔ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi; ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ mi lɛ, miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni mi hu masumɔ lɛ, ni majie mihe shi matsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.” Yuda, jeee Iskariot, bi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni eba hewɔ ni wɔ pɛ obaajie ohe shi otsɔ̃ɔ, ni jeee je lɛ?” Yesu here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ mi lɛ, eeeye miwiemɔ lɛ nɔ, ni miTsɛ aaasumɔ lɛ, ni wɔɔba eŋɔɔ, ni wɔkɛ lɛ aaahi shi.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔɔ mi lɛ, eyeee miwiemɔi lɛ anɔ; ni wiemɔ ni nyɛnuɔ lɛ jeee minɔŋ, shi moŋ Tsɛ ni tsu mi lɛ nɔŋ.
“Miikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ be mli ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ nɛɛ.
Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, mɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ baatsu yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, lɛ eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii fɛɛ, ni eeekai nyɛ nii fɛɛ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ.
“Hejɔlɛ mishiɔ mahã nyɛ, hejɔlɛ ni ji minɔ lɛ mikɛhãa nyɛ, jeee bɔ ni je lɛ hãa lɛ mihãa nyɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɛtsui akayea, ni asaŋ nyɛkashea gbeyei.
Nyɛnu akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, Miiya, ni mibaba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Nyɛmiisumɔ mi kulɛ, nyɛaana miishɛɛ akɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ miTsɛ da fe mi.
Ni agbɛnɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ dani eba mli, koni kɛ eba mli lɛ, ni nyɛhe nyɛye.
Mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ nibii pii dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ je lɛ mli lumɔ lɛ miiba, ni ebɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ; shi bɔ ni afee ni je lɛ ana ale akɛ miisumɔ Tsɛ lɛ, ni bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ wo mi kitã lɛ nakai mifeɔ lɛ.
Nyɛtea shi, nyɛhãa wɔjea biɛ wɔyaa.”
Yesu, anɔkwa waintso lɛ “Mi ji anɔkwa waintso lɛ, ni miTsɛ ji okwaafonyo lɛ.
Mihe nine fɛɛ nine ni wooo yibii lɛ, efolɔɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko ni woɔ yibii lɛ, ekpɔlɔɔ he, bɔ ni afee ni ewo yibii pii fe tsutsu lɛ.
Nyɛhe etse momo yɛ wiemɔ ni mikɛ nyɛ ewie lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛhia mimli, ni mi hu mahi nyɛmli.
Tamɔ bɔ ni tso nine nyɛŋ awo yibii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ akɛ ja ema waintso lɛ he lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛnyɛŋ akɛ ja nyɛhi mimli.
“Mi ji waintso lɛ, nyɛ ji niji lɛ.
Mɔ ni hiɔ mimli ni mi hu mihiɔ emli lɛ, lɛ ewoɔ yibii pii; ejaakɛ kɛjeee miŋ lɛ nyɛnyɛŋ nɔ ko nyɛfee.
Kɛji mɔ ko ehiii mimli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ tamɔ tso nine, ni egbiɔ, ni abuaa naa awoɔ la mli, ni ashãa.
Kɛji nyɛhi mimli ni miwiemɔi lɛ hi nyɛmli lɛ, nyɛaakpa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ he fai, ni aaafee ahã nyɛ.
Nɔ ni akɛwoɔ miTsɛ hiɛ nyam ji akɛ nyɛwo yibii pii, ni nyɛfee mikaselɔi.
“Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ sumɔ mi lɛ, nakai mi hu misumɔ nyɛ; nyɛhia misuɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Kɛji nyɛye mikitãi lɛ anɔ lɛ, nyɛaahi misuɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni miye miTsɛ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni mihiɔ esuɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
“Mikɛ nyɛ ewie enɛɛmɛi, koni mimiishɛɛ lɛ ahi nyɛmli, ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.
Mikitã ji akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni misumɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Mɔ ko bɛ suɔmɔ ni da fe enɛ, akɛ mɔ kɛ ewala aaaŋmɛ shi ahã eshieŋtsɛmɛi.
Kɛji nyɛfee nii ni miwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, no lɛ mishieŋtsɛmɛi ji nyɛ.
Mitsɛɛɛ nyɛ tsuji dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ tsulɔ leee nɔ ni enuŋtsɔ feɔ, shi moŋ shieŋtsɛmɛi matsɛ nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii fɛɛ ni minu yɛ miTsɛ naa lɛ, mitsi tã mikɛɛ nyɛ.
Jeee nyɛ nyɛhala mi, shi mi moŋ mihala nyɛ, ni mito nyɛ koni nyɛ hu nyɛya ni nyɛyawo yibii, ni nyɛyibii lɛ ahi shi, koni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ.
Enɛ ji kitã ni miwoɔ nyɛ, akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔa nyɛhe.” Je lɛ baanyɛ Yesu sɛɛnyiɛlɔi “Kɛji je lɛ miinyɛ nyɛ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mi tsutsu enyɛ.
Eji je lɛ mli nyɛjɛ kulɛ, je lɛ aaasumɔ nyɛ akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, shi akɛni nyɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ mihala nyɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli hewɔ lɛ, je lɛ nyɛɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛhiɛ ahia wiemɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ lɛ nɔ, akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋ efeee eNuŋtsɔ.’ Kɛ amɛwa mi yi lɛ, amɛaawa nyɛ hu yi; kɛ amɛye miwiemɔ nɔ lɛ, amɛaaye nyɛ hu nyɛnɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛkɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ aaafee nyɛ yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛleee mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ.
Mibaaa mikɛ amɛ ebawieee jikulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛbɛ amɛhe esha lɛ he naajiemɔ ko.
Mɔ ni nyɛɔ mi lɛ eenyɛ miTsɛ hu.
Eji mitsuuu nitsumɔi ni mɔ ko mɔ ko tsuko eko dã yɛ amɛteŋ kulɛ, esha ko bɛ amɛhe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛna, ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiinyɛ mi kɛ miTsɛ fɛɛ.
Shi afee enɛ bɔ ni afee ni wiemɔ ni aŋma yɛ amɛMla lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Amɛnyɛ mi yakatswaa’ lɛ ana aba mli.
“Shi Hefatalɔ lɛ ni mibatsu nyɛŋɔɔ kɛaajɛ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, mɔ ni ji anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ ni jɛɔ Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ baa lɛ, kɛ eba lɛ, eeeye mihe odase; ni nyɛ hu nyɛaaye odase, ejaakɛ nyɛkɛ mi yɔɔ kɛjɛ shishijee.”
“Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛnane akatɔ̃tɔ̃.
Amɛaashwie nyɛ kɛaajɛ kpeehei lɛ.
Ni be baaba tete, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni gbeɔ nyɛ lɛ aaasusu akɛ ekɛmiija Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni amɛaafee enɛɛmɛi, ejaakɛ amɛleee Tsɛ lɛ ni amɛleee mi hu.
Shi mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni kɛ be lɛ shɛ lɛ, ni nyɛkai akɛ mikɛɛ nyɛ.
Shi kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mikɛɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ.” Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nitsumɔ “Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, miiya mɔ ni tsu mi lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko biii mi akɛ, ‘Nɛgbɛ oyaa?’ Shi ni mitsi nii nɛɛ atã mikɛɛ nyɛ hewɔ lɛ; ŋkɔmɔyeli eyi nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃.
Kɛ̃lɛ miikɛɛ nyɛ anɔkwale, ehi hã nyɛ akɛ matee; ejaakɛ kɛji miyaaa lɛ, Hefatalɔ lɛ baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ; shi kɛji mitee lɛ, matsu lɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ni lɛ lɛ, kɛji eba lɛ, eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha kɛ jalɛ kɛ kojomɔ he.
Eeekã je lɛ yɛ esha he, ejaakɛ amɛheee minɔ amɛyeee; eeekã je lɛ yɛ jalɛ he, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni nyɛnaŋ mi dɔŋŋ; eeekã je lɛ yɛ kojomɔ he, ejaakɛ akojo je nɛɛŋ lumɔ lɛ momo.
“Miyɛ nibii pii lolo ni makɛɛ nyɛ, shi nyɛnyɛŋ mli nyɛmɔ amrɔ nɛɛ.
Shi kɛji lɛ, anɔkwale Mumɔ lɛ, ena eba lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ anɔkwale lɛ fɛɛ mli gbɛ; ejaakɛ etoŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋ ewieŋ; shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni eeenu lɛ, no eeewie, ni nii ni baa lɛ, eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Lɛ ebaawo mihiɛ nyam, ejaakɛ eeeŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko ni eeetsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nii fiaa ni Tsɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, minɔŋ; no hewɔ ni mikɛɛ akɛ, ebaaŋɔ minɔ lɛ eko, ni etsi tã etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.” Haomɔ sɛɛ lɛ, miishɛɛ “Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi, ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi bibii amɛhe akɛ, “Mɛni ji nɔ ni ekɛɔ wɔ nɛɛ, ‘Eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi kɛ ejaakɛ miiya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ?’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Mɛni ji ‘eshwɛ fioo’ lɛ ni ekɛɔ lɛ?
Wɔleee nɔ ni ekɛɔ nɛɛ.” Yesu na akɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛbiɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ni mikɛɛ akɛ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛnaŋ mi, ni asaŋ eshwɛ fioo ni nyɛbaana mi lɛ, no he nii nyɛbibiɔ nyɛhe nɛɛ?
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaafo ni nyɛbaawo yara, shi je lɛ baanya; nyɛ lɛ nyɛbaaye ŋkɔmɔ, shi nyɛkɔmɔyeli lɛ aaatsɔ̃ miishɛɛ.
Kɛji yoo miikɔmɔ lɛ, ehaoɔ, ejaakɛ eŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; shi kɛ efɔ bi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ekaiii hejaramɔ lɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ miishɛɛ ni enaa akɛ efɔ gbɔmɔ kɛba je lɛ mli lɛ hewɔ.
Nakai ji nyɛ hu; amrɔ nɛɛ nyɛmiiye ŋkɔmɔ; shi mibana nyɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsui aaanyɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko shɔŋ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
“Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛbiŋ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko.
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ nyɛ akɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ he fai ni nyɛaakpa Tsɛ lɛ yɛ migbɛi mli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ.
Kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ lɛ nyɛbiko nɔ ko yɛ migbɛi mli; nyɛbia, ni nyɛaana, koni nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ aye emuu.” Miye je lɛ nɔ kunim “Nii nɛɛ, abɛbuai amli mikɛ nyɛ wieɔ yɛ nɛɛ.
Be miiba, ni mikɛ nyɛ ewieŋ yɛ abɛbuai amli dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ faŋŋ majaje Tsɛ lɛ he sane matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nakai gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ nyɛaabi nɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ yɛ migbɛi mli, shi mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ mi mabi Tsɛ lɛ mahã nyɛ; ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ miisumɔ nyɛ, akɛni nyɛsumɔ mi, ni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ mijɛ lɛ.
Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ mijɛ miba je lɛ mli, ni miije je lɛ mli maya Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.” Ekaselɔi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, agbɛnɛ oowie faŋŋ ni owieee yɛ abɛbua mli.
Agbɛnɛ wɔna akɛ ole nii fɛɛ ni ehiaaa bo akɛ mɔ ko biɔ bo sane ko; enɛ wɔkɛheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ojɛ.” Yesu here amɛ nɔ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ nyɛmiihe nyɛmiiye?
Naa; ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ miiba ni eshɛ po, ni nyɛbaagbɛ nyɛshwã ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaaya emaŋ, ni nyɛaashi mi kome; shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mi kome ni, ejaakɛ Tsɛ lɛ kɛ mi yɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ nii nɛɛ, koni nyɛna hejɔlɛ yɛ mimli.
Je lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛbaana amanehulu, shi nyɛtsui anyɔa nyɛmli, miye je lɛ nɔ kunim.”
Osɔfonukpa sɔlemɔ ni Yesu sɔle.
Yesu sɔle hã ehe Be ni Yesu wie nii nɛɛ lɛ, ewo ehiɛ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataa, ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; wo oBi lɛ hiɛ nyam, koni oBi lɛ hu awo ohiɛ nyam; tamɔ bɔ ni ohã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, koni mɛi fɛɛ ni okɛhã lɛ lɛ, ehã amɛ naanɔ wala lɛ.
Shi enɛ ji naanɔ wala lɛ, akɛ amɛle bo, anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni otsu lɛ.
Miwo ohiɛ nyam yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, akɛni nitsumɔ lɛ ni okɛhã mi tsumɔ lɛ, migbe naa lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ, Ataa, kɛ anunyam ni miyɔɔ yɛ oŋɔɔ dani abɔ je lɛ awo mihiɛ nyam yɛ omasɛi.” Yesu sɔle hã ekaselɔi lɛ “Mijie ogbɛi lɛ shi mitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi ni okɛhã mi kɛjɛ je lɛŋ lɛ.
Onii ji amɛ, ni okɛ amɛ hã mi, ni amɛye owiemɔ lɛ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ amɛle akɛ nii fiaa ni okɛhã mi lɛ, oŋɔɔ ejɛ; ejaakɛ wiemɔi lɛ ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ; ni amɛmɔ mli, ni amɛna amɛle anɔkwale mli akɛ oŋɔɔ mijɛ, ni amɛhe amɛye akɛ bo otsu mi.
Amɛ mibiɔ mahã; jeee je lɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi moŋ mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ onii ji amɛ.
Minii fɛɛ lɛ onɔŋ, ni onii fɛɛ lɛ minɔŋ, ni mihiɛ eba nyam yɛ amɛmli.
Mibɛ je lɛ mli dɔŋŋ, shi mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ je lɛ mli, ni mi lɛ miiba oŋɔɔ.
Ataa Krɔŋkrɔŋ, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, too amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli, bɔ ni afee ni amɛfee ekome tamɔ wɔ.
Be ni mikɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mito amɛ yɛ ogbɛi lɛ mli.
Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mibu amɛhe, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko elaajeko, ja laajemɔ bi lɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma lɛ aba mli.
Ni agbɛnɛ miiba oŋɔɔ, ni miiwie nii nɛɛ yɛ je lɛ mli, koni amɛna mimiishɛɛ lɛ ni eye emuu yɛ amɛmli.
Mikɛ owiemɔ lɛ ehã amɛ, ni je lɛ miinyɛ amɛ, ejaakɛ amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Mibiii akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ je lɛ mli, shi moŋ akɛ ojie amɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ ni oto amɛ shweshweeshwe.
Amɛjɛɛɛ je lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mijɛɛɛ je lɛ mli lɛ.
Feemɔ amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli; owiemɔ lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni otsu mi je lɛ mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mi hu mitsu amɛ je lɛ mli.
Ni amɛhewɔ mi diɛŋtsɛ mifeɔ mihe krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, koni amɛ hu afee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ anɔkwale mli.” Yesu sɔle hã esɛɛnyiɛlɔi ni baaba “Shi jeee mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛkɛ mibiɔ mahã, shi miibi mahã mɛi ni baahe minɔ aye yɛ amɛwiemɔ naa lɛ hu; bɔ ni afee ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee ekome, tamɔ bɔ ni bo, Ataa, oyɔɔ mimli ni mi hu miyɔɔ omli lɛ, koni amɛ hu amɛfee ekome yɛ wɔmli, ni je lɛ ahe aye akɛ bo otsu mi.
Ni anunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mikɛhã amɛ, koni amɛfee ekome tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔyɔɔ ekome lɛ.
Miyɛ amɛmli, ni bo hu oyɛ mimli, koni amɛfee ekome kɛwula shi, ni je lɛ ale akɛ bo otsu mi, ni osumɔɔ amɛ tamɔ osumɔɔ mi lɛ.
Ataa, mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ he ni miyɔɔ lɛ amɛkɛ mi abahi jɛi, koni amɛna minunyam ni okɛhã mi lɛ, ejaakɛ osumɔ mi dani ato je lɛ shishi.
Ataa Jalɔ, je lɛ leee bo, shi mi lɛ mile bo, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi le akɛ bo otsu mi; ni mijie ogbɛi lɛ kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni masaa majie lɛ kpo matsɔ̃ɔ, koni suɔmɔ ni okɛsumɔ mi lɛ ahi amɛmli, ni mi hu mahi amɛmli.”
Yesu sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ sɔlemɔ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ ekaselɔi lɛ je kpo amɛyafo Kedron faa lɛ kɛtee he ni trom ko yɔɔ lɛ ni ekɛ amɛ tee mli.
Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu le jɛi, ejaakɛ Yesu kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ fɔɔ kpee yɛ jɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yuda yaŋɔ asraafoi kɛ tsuji kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai kɛ Farisifoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛhiɛhiɛ kanei kɛ hai kɛ awuiyeli dadei kɛba jɛi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le nii fiaa ni baa enɔ lɛ, eje kpo ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi nɛ.” Shi Yuda, mɔ ni yatsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ hu kɛ amɛ damɔ shi.
Agbɛnɛ be ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi nɛ” lɛ, amɛnaa sɛɛsɛɛ ni amɛyagbeegbee shi.
Kɛkɛ lɛ esaa ebi amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Namɔ nyɛtaoɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ.” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ miŋ no hewɔ lɛ, kɛji mi nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa mɛnɛɛmɛi ayaa.” (Ekɛɛ enɛ) koni wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ, “Mɛi ni okɛhã mi lɛ, mihako amɛteŋ mɔ ko alaaje” lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ lɛ Simon Petro gbala klante ni ehiɛ lɛ ni ekɛbã osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔŋ lɛ ni efo eninejurɔ toi; nyɔŋ lɛ gbɛi ji Malko.
No hewɔ lɛ, Yesu kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Kɛ oklante lɛ awo ehebo lɛ mli!
Ani kpulu ni miTsɛ kɛhã mi lɛ, mikanu?” Amɔ Yesu kɛtee Ana ŋɔɔ Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ atsuji lɛ mɔ Yesu ni amɛfi lɛ, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee Ana ŋɔɔ tsutsu, ejaakɛ Kaiafa ni yeɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ nakai afi lɛ nɔ lɛ shaanuu ji lɛ.
Shi Kaiafa ji mɔ ni wo Yudafoi lɛ aŋaa akɛ ehi akɛ mɔ kome gboɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ najiaŋ lɛ.
Petro kwa Yesu Ni Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kroko nyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ le nakai kaselɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ Yesu bote osɔfonukpa lɛ mɔɔ te lɛ mli; shi Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nakai kaselɔ kroko lɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ le lɛ lɛ je kpo ni eyakɛɛ yoo ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni eŋɔ Petro kɛba shĩa lɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ oblayoo lɛ ni buɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Te bo hu nuu nɛɛ kaselɔi lɛ eko ji bo?” Ekɛɛ, “Dabi.” Shi nyɔji lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ damɔ jɛi, amɛkɛ ŋãi eshɛre la, ejaakɛ fɛ̃i miiye ni amɛmiiwere; ni Petro hu kɛ amɛ damɔ shi eewere eko.
Osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Yesu nii Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Yesu ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ etsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he saji.
Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Faŋŋ miwie mitsɔ̃ɔ je lɛ.
Daa nɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ kpeehei lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, he ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ kpeɔ yɛ lɛ, ni miwieee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ dujiaŋ.
Mɛɛba obiɔ mi moŋ?
Bi mɛi ni baboɔ mi toi lɛ nɔ ni mikɛɛ amɛ; naa, mɛnɛɛmɛi le nii ni mikɛɛ.” Be ni Yesu wie nɛkɛ lɛ, tsuji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni damɔ jɛi lɛ gba lɛ ma ni ekɛɛ, “Hetoo ni ohã osɔfonukpa lɛ nɛ?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Kɛji mikɛɛ efɔŋ ko lɛ, ye efɔŋ lɛ he odase, shi kɛji ekpakpaŋ lɛ, mɛɛhewɔ oyiɔ mi?” Ni Ana hã akɛ lɛ tee osɔfonukpa Kaiafa ŋɔɔ yɛ kpãa mli.
Petro kwa Yesu ekoŋŋ Shi Simon Petro damɔ shi eewere la lolo.
Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te bo hu ekaselɔi lɛ eko ji bo?” Petro tso ni ekɛɛ, “Dabida.” Osɔfonukpa lɛ nyɔji lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni ji mɔ ni Petro fo etoi lɛ wekunyo, kɛɛ, “Ani minaaa bo kɛ lɛ yɛ trom lɛ mli?” Ni Petro tso ekoŋŋ, kɛkɛ nɔŋŋ ni wuɔ gbɛɛ.
Yesu yɛ Pilato hiɛ Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpala Yesu kɛjɛ Kaiafa ŋɔɔ kɛtee kojomɔhe lɛ.
Ni eshɛ maŋkɛ.
Ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ amɛboteee kojomɔhe lɛ, koni amɛkabule amɛhe, bɔ ni afee ni amɛwo Hehoo lɛ yeli.
No hewɔ lɛ Pilato je kpo ba amɛŋɔɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Mɛɛ naafolɔmɔ nyɛkɛba yɛ nuu nɛɛ he?” Amɛhere nɔ akɛ, “Jeee efɔŋfeelɔ ji lɛ kulɛ, wɔkɛ lɛ ebahaŋ bo.” Kɛkɛ lɛ Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛŋɔa lɛ, ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyakojoa lɛ yɛ nyɛmla lɛ naa.” Ni Yudafoi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔgbeɔ mɔ ko;” koni Yesu wiemɔ ni ewie ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni ebaagbo lɛ aba mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato saa bote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ Yesu, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bo ji Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ?” Yesu here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Bo diɛŋtsɛ oyiŋ oto owieɔ enɛ nɛɛ, aloo mɛi komɛi gba bo nakai yɛ mihe?” Pilato here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ani Yudafonyo ji mi?
Bo diɛŋtsɛ omaŋbii kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ bo hã mi.
Mɛni ofee?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ je nɛɛŋ; mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛ je nɛɛ mli kulɛ misɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ aaapele he, koni akaŋɔ mi ahã Yudafoi lɛ; shi enɛ lɛ, mimaŋtsɛyeli lɛ jɛɛɛ biɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Belɛ maŋtsɛ ji bo kɛ̃?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Okɛɛ; ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ ji mi.
Mi lɛ, enɛ hewɔ afɔ mi, ni enɛ hewɔ nɔŋŋ miba je lɛ mli, koni mibaye anɔkwale lɛ he odase.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni jɛ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ nuɔ migbee.” Pilato bi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni ji anɔkwale?” Abu Yesu gbele fɔ Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, eje kpo kɛtee Yudafoi lɛ aŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, ni eyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko kwraa yɛ ehe.
Shi nyɛyɛ gbɛnaa ko akɛ miŋmɛɔ mɔ kome he mihãa nyɛ yɛ Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ nɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ miŋmɛɛ Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ lɛ he mihã nyɛ lo?” Kɛkɛ lɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Jeee mɔnɛŋ, shi Baraba moŋ!” Shi Baraba lɛ, ojotswalɔŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato ŋɔ Yesu ni eyi lɛ kpelebii, ni asraafoi lɛ kɛ ŋmei fee akekre ni amɛkɛfi eyitso, ni amɛwo lɛ atade tsuru ko, ni amɛba eŋɔɔ amɛbakɛɛ, “Hã manye, Yudafoi amaŋtsɛ!” Ni amɛgbala lɛ mai.
Kɛkɛ ni Pilato je kpo ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ lɛ eje kpo kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛna nyɛle akɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe.” Kɛkɛ ni Yesu je kpo ni ŋmei akekre lɛ fĩ eyitso ni ewo atade tsuru lɛ.
Ni Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Naa gbɔmɔ lɛ!” Be ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ na lɛ lɛ, amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Sɛŋmɔ lɛ, sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Pilato kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋɔa lɛ ni nyɛyasɛŋa lɛ mɔ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ minaaa fɔbuu sane ko yɛ ehe.” Yudafoi lɛ here lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ mla, ni wɔmla lɛ naa lɛ esa gbele, ejaakɛ efee ehe Nyɔŋmɔ Bi.” Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ, eshe gbeyei fe tsutsu lɛ; ni ebote kojomɔhe lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni ebi Yesu akɛ, “Nɛgbɛ ojɛ?” Shi Yesu hãaa lɛ hetoo.
Ni Pilato kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ mi ewieee?
Ani oleee akɛ miyɛ hegbɛ akɛ miŋmɛɔ ohe, ni miyɛ hegbɛ hu akɛ misɛŋɔ bo?” Yesu here nɔ akɛ, “Kɛjeee ŋwɛi ajɛ akɛhã bo lɛ, kulɛ onaŋ hewalɛ ko yɛ minɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni jie mi wo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ he esha lɛ da fe onɔ lɛ.” Kɛjɛ no nɔ lɛ Pilato tao ehe eŋmɛɛ; shi Yudafoi lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Kɛji oŋmɛɛ mɔ nɛ he lɛ, ojeee Kaisare shieŋtsɛ; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni feɔ ehe maŋtsɛ lɛ ete shi ewo Kaisare.” Be ni Pilato nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, ekɛ Yesu je kpo, ni eyata kojomɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ, yɛ he ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ “Tɛkamɔ” ni Hebri wiemɔ mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ “Gabata” lɛ.
Shi Hehoo lɛ Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli ni.
Ni ekɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, “Naa nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ!” Shi amɛ lɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Okɛ lɛ aya, okɛ lɛ aya!
Sɛŋmɔ lɛ!” Pilato bi amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛmaŋtsɛ lɛ, misɛŋ lɛ lo?” Osɔfonukpai lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Wɔbɛ maŋtsɛ ko akɛ ja Kaisare.” Kɛkɛ ni ekɛ lɛ hã amɛ ni ayasɛŋ lɛ.
Yesu sɛŋmɔ kɛ egbele Ni amɛkɛ Yesu tee.
Ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etere esɛŋmɔtso lɛ kɛtee he ni atsɛɔ jɛi Yitsoŋoŋohe ni Hebri mli lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ “Golgota” lɛ.
Jɛi amɛyasɛŋ lɛ yɛ; ni amɛkɛ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ fata ehe, mɔ kome yɛ biɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ biɛ, ni Yesu yɛ teŋ.
Ni Pilato ŋma nɔ ko ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ yiteŋ; nɔ ni eŋma nɛ, “YESU NAZARENYO, YUDAFOI LƐ AMAŊTSƐ LƐ”.
Nɛkɛ nii ni aŋma nɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii kane, ejaakɛ he ni asɛŋ Yesu yɛ lɛ bɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ; ni aŋma yɛ Hebri kɛ Roma kɛ Hela wiemɔi amli.
Ni Yudafoi lɛ asɔfonukpai lɛ kɛɛ Pilato akɛ, “Kaaŋma akɛ, ‘Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ’, shi moŋ akɛ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji Yudafoi lɛ amaŋtsɛ lɛ.’ ” Pilato here nɔ akɛ, “Nɔ ni miŋma lɛ, miŋma.” Be ni asraafoi lɛ sɛŋ Yesu lɛ, amɛkɔlɔ etadei lɛ, ni amɛja mli ejwɛ, asraafonyo kome nɔ ekome; ni amɛkɔ eflaka lɛ hu.
Shi flaka lɛ bɛ tsamɔhe; alo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛyi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Nyɛkahãa wɔgbalaa no, shi nyɛhãa wɔfɔ̃a nɔ oshiki ni wɔna mɔ nɔ ni aaatsɔ̃.” Koni ŋmalɛ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛja mitadei lɛ amli amɛhã amɛhe, ni mihebo lɛ amɛfɔ̃ nɔ oshiki lɛ aba mli.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni asraafoi lɛ fee lɛ.” Shi Yesu nyɛ kɛ enyɛ nyɛmi yoo, Maria, Klopa ŋa lɛ, kɛ Maria Magdalena damɔ esɛŋmɔtso lɛ masɛi.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu na enyɛ kɛ kaselɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ damɔ shi lɛ, ekɛɛ enyɛ akɛ, “Awo, obi nɛ!” Fee sɛɛ lɛ ekɛɛ kaselɔ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, onyɛ nɛ!” Ni kɛjɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ lɛ kaselɔ lɛ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, akɛni Yesu le akɛ agbe nii fɛɛ naa momo lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ŋmalɛ lɛ aba mli lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Kumai miiye mi.” Nɔ ma jɛi kɛ emli ashiŋ obɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ŋshɔŋkotsa tsɔ ashiŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛkɛma hisopotso naa, ni amɛkɛto enaa.
Ni be ni Yesu he ashiŋ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Agbe naa!” Ni ema eyi shi, ni ebu enaa.
Atsu Yesu ŋmawuiaŋ akplɔ Shi Hesaamɔkɛtoo Gbi ni, ni bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbohii lɛ akahi sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ (ejaakɛ nakai hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ gbi wulu ni) hewɔ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yakpa Pilato fai akɛ akumɔ amɛnaji ni ajie amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, asraafoi lɛ tee, ni amɛyakumɔ mɛi ni asɛŋ afata ehe lɛ anaji, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi be ni amɛshɛ Yesu nɔ ni amɛna akɛ egbo momo lɛ, lɛ lɛ amɛkumɔ̃ɔɔ enaji; shi moŋ asraafoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ akplɔ tsu eŋmawuiaŋ, ni amrɔ lɛ lá kɛ nu jɛ mli ho.
Ni mɔ ni na lɛ, lɛ eye he odase nɛɛ, ni edase lɛ anɔkwaŋ, ni ele akɛ anɔkwale ewieɔ, koni nyɛhe nyɛye.
Ejaakɛ afee nii nɛɛ, koni nɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Akuŋ ewu ko” lɛ aba mli.
Ni asaŋ ŋmalɛ kroko kɛɛ, “Amɛaakwɛ mɔ ni amɛtsu lɛ nɔ lɛ.” Yesu fuu Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Yosef ni jɛ Arimatia ni ji Yesu kaselɔ shi Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ lɛ ejieee ehe shi lɛ, yabi Pilato koni ehã eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ; ni Pilato ŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, etee ni eyajie Yesu gbonyo lɛ kɛtee.
Ni Nikodemo, mɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ be ni ebaaba Yesu ŋɔɔ lɛ eba nyɔɔŋ lɛ, hu kɛ “mire” kɛ “aloe” ni afutu aaafee kiloi nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ ba.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛŋɔ Yesu gbonyo lɛ, ni amɛkɛ klalai lɛ kɛ tsofai lɛ fimɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Yudafoi feɔ fuɔ mɔ lɛ.
He ni asɛŋ lɛ yɛ lɛ, trom ko yɛ jɛi, ni gbonyobu hee ko yɛ trom lɛ mli ni atoko mɔ ko yɛ mli pɛŋ; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛyato Yesu yɛ jɛi yɛ Yudafoi lɛ aHesaamɔkɛtoo gbi lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ gbonyobu lɛ bɛŋkɛ.
Yesu shitee Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ maŋkɛ mra be ni hiɛ nako agbele lɛ, Maria Magdalena ba bu lɛ he, ni ena akɛ ajie tɛ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ naa.
Kɛkɛ ni esha foi, ni eba Simon Petro kɛ kaselɔ kome lɛ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni ebakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛje bu lɛ mli, ni wɔleee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Petro kɛ nakai kaselɔ kome lɛ je kpo, ni amɛyiŋ kɛmiiya bu lɛ he.
Ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛwo foi; shi kaselɔ kome lɛ ho Petro he, ni lɛ tsutsu eshɛ bu lɛ he; ni be ni ema eyi shi lɛ, ena klalai lɛ jwere shi, shi eyaaa bu lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni Simon nyiɛ esɛɛ kɛba, ni ebote bu lɛ mli, ni ena klalai lɛ jwere shi; shi duku ni akɛfi eyitso lɛ kãaa klalai lɛ amasɛi, shi moŋ akumɔ mli ni ekã he kroko banee.
Kɛkɛ ni agbɛnɛ kaselɔ lɛ ni ba bu lɛ he tsutsu lɛ hu bote mli, ni ena, ni ehe eye; ejaakɛ kulɛ amɛnuko ŋmalɛ lɛ ni kɛɔ akɛ ja ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ shishi lolo.
Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ ku amɛsɛɛ amɛtee shĩa.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Maria Magdalena Shi Maria damɔ bu lɛ sɛɛgbɛ eefo.
Ni be ni efoɔ lɛ, ema eyi shi ekwɛ bu lɛ mli, ni ena ŋwɛi bɔfoi enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji tara shi yɛ he ni kulɛ Yesu gbonyo lɛ kã lɛ, mɔ kome yɛ yitsogbɛ ni mɔ kome hu yɛ najiashigbɛ.
Ni amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ?” Ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ejaakɛ amɛwo miNuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛtee, ni mileee he ni amɛkɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ.” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ehe ekwɛ esɛɛ, ni ena Yesu damɔ shi, shi eleee akɛ Yesu ni.
Yesu bi lɛ akɛ, “Awo, mɛɛba ofoɔ?
Namɔ otaoɔ?” Lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ benɛ tromsaalɔ lɛ ni, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ bo owo lɛ kɛje biɛ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mi he ni okɛ lɛ eyaŋmɛ, koni mayawo lɛ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Maria!” Ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ lɛ yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ, “Rabuni!” (Eshishi ji, “Tsɔɔlɔ”).
Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kaata mihe; miyako ŋwɛi yɛ miTsɛ ŋɔɔ; shi yaa minyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, miiya ŋwɛi yɛ miTsɛ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛTsɛ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Maria Magdalena ba ni ebagba kaselɔi lɛ akɛ ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, ni bɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie nɛ.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ Kɛkɛ lɛ nakai gbi lɛ ni ji otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔŋŋ gbɛkɛ, be ni Yudafoi lɛ ashemɔ hewɔ lɛ aŋamɔ shinai he ni kaselɔi lɛ ebua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ Yesu ba ni ebadamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, ekɛ edɛ̃i lɛ kɛ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi lɛ na miishɛɛ akɛ amɛna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Yesu saa kɛɛ amɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!
Bɔ ni Tsɛ lɛ tsu mi lɛ, nakai mi hu mitsuɔ nyɛ nɛɛ.” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, emu eshwie amɛnɔ, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhea Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ!
Mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaafa amɛ lɛ, akɛfa amɛ; ni mɛi ahe eshai ni nyɛkɛaato lɛ, akɛto.” Toma ŋwanejee Shi Toma, mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo (eshishi ji, “hãaji”) lɛ, bɛ amɛteŋ ni Yesu ba lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kaselɔi krokomɛi lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔna Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.” Shi ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ja mina edɛ̃ŋ plɛkoobii lɛ anajiaŋ, ni mikɛ miwao ewo plɛkoobii lɛ anajiaŋ, ni mikɛ minine ehɔ eŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, dani mahe maye.” Ni gbii kpaanyɔ sɛɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ ekaselɔi lɛ yɛ tsu mli, ni Toma hu yɛ mli.
Ni aŋamɔ shinai lɛ ni Yesu ba, ni ebadamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!” No sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Toma akɛ, “Okɛ owao aba biɛ ni obakwɛ midɛ̃ lɛ mli, ni okɛ onine abahɔ miŋmawuiaŋ lɛ, ni okaje ŋwane, shi moŋ ohe oye.” Toma here nɔ ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “MiNuŋtsɔ kɛ miNyɔŋmɔ.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Toma, ni ona mi hewɔ lɛ, ohe oye; ajɔɔ mɛi ni enaaa ni kɛ̃lɛ amɛhe amɛye lɛ.” Yohane Sanekpakpa lɛ oti Agbɛnɛ naakpɛɛ okadii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee yɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ahiɛ ni aŋmaaa yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli; shi enɛɛmɛi lɛ aŋma koni nyɛhe nyɛye akɛ Yesu ji Kristo, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ni kɛ nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ, nyɛaana wala kɛtsɔ̃ egbɛi lɛ nɔ.
Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi kpawo Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ Yesu saa jie ehe kpo ekoŋŋ etsɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ yɛ Tiberia Ŋshɔ lɛ naa.
Ni bɔ ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nɛ.
Simon Petro kɛ Toma ni atsɛɔ lɛ Didimo lɛ, kɛ Natanael ni jɛ Kana yɛ Galilea lɛ, kɛ Zebedeo bii lɛ, kɛ ekaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi krokomɛi enyɔ hu yɛ he kome kutuu.
Simon Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Miiya wuo.” Amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ hu wɔkɛ bo miiya.” Amɛyiŋ ni amɛyabote lɛlɛ mli, ni nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ amɛgbeee nɔ ko.
Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yesu badamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, shi kaselɔi lɛ leee akɛ lɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu bi amɛ akɛ, “Bii, nyɛyɛ niyenii ko lo?” Amɛhere lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Dabi.” Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛfɔ̃a yaa lɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ ninejurɔ gbɛ, ni nyɛaana nɔ ko.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛfɔ̃, ni loi lɛ afalɛ hewɔ lɛ amɛanyɛɛɛ yaa lɛ amɛgbala.
No hewɔ lɛ, kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ kɛɛ Petro akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.” Be ni Simon Petro nu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni lɛ, ekɛ etade lɛ ŋmɔ ehɛ, ejaakɛ eta shi yayai, ni etu egbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kaselɔi krokomɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ lɛlɛ bibioo lɛ mli kɛba, ejaakɛ amɛkɛ shikpɔŋ jekɛɛɛ, shi aaafee ninetalɔi oha loo nɔ kɛkɛ, ni amɛmiigbala yaa lɛ kɛ loo lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛkpeleke lɛ, amɛbana ŋãi kɛ la yɛ jɛi, ni loo jwere nɔ, kɛ aboloo.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkɛ loo ni nyɛgbe bianɛ lɛ eko abaa.” Simon Petro tee lɛlɛ lɛ mli, ni eyagbala yaa lɛ kɛba shikpɔŋ kɛ emli loo wuji obɔ̃, oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ kɛ etɛ̃ ni loo lɛ fa nɛkɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ yaa lɛ gbalaaa.
Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa nyɛbakpaa nyɛnaa nɔ ko.” Ni kaselɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko ekaaa lɛ bimɔ akɛ, “Namɔ ji bo?” Ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni.
Kɛkɛ ni Yesu ba ni ebakɔ aboloo lɛ, ni ekɛhã amɛ, kɛ loo lɛ hu.
Enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni Yesu jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ekaselɔi lɛ, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ.
Yesu kɛ Petro Be ni amɛye nii lɛ tã lɛ, Yesu bi Simon Petro akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi fe mɛnɛɛmɛi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoobii lɛ!” Esaa ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ mitoi lɛ!” Ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Simon, Yona bi, oosumɔ mi lo?” Edɔ Petro akɛ ebi lɛ nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃ akɛ, “Oosumɔ mi lo?” lɛ; ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ole nii fiaa, ole akɛ miisumɔ bo.” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Lɛɛ mitoi lɛ!
Anɔkwale mikɛɔ bo akɛ, be ni oji oblanyo lɛ, bo diɛŋtsɛ omĩaa ni onyiɛɔ he ni osumɔɔ; shi kɛ ogbɔ lɛ, oookpã oniji amli, ni mɔ kroko aaamĩa bo, ni ekɛ bo aaatee he ni osumɔɔɔ.” Shi ekɛɛ enɛ ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ nɔ gbele ni Petro baagbo kɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ Shi be ni Petro tsɔ̃ ehe lɛ, ena kaselɔ ni Yesu sumɔɔ lɛ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ; lɛ ji mɔ ni kpasa Yesu tsitsi yɛ niyenii lɛ ashi ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ namɔ baatsɔ̃ɔ osɛɛgbɛ lɛ?” No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Petro na lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ Yesu akɛ “Nuŋtsɔ, shi mɔ nɛ hu?” Yesu kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe?
Bo lɛ nyiɛmɔ misɛɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni wiemɔ nɛɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ akɛ nakai kaselɔ lɛ gboŋ; tsɛ Yesu ekɛɛɛ lɛ akɛ egboŋ, shi moŋ ekɛɛ, “Kɛji miisumɔ akɛ ehi shi kɛyashi mibaabe lɛ, mɛni no kɔɔ yɛ ohe?” Mɔ nɛ ji kaselɔ ni yeɔ nii nɛɛ ahe odase lɛ, ni lɛ eŋma nii nɛɛ, ni wɔle akɛ edase lɛ anɔkwaleŋ.
Shi nii krokomɛi pii hu yɛ ni Yesu fee, ni kɛji akɛɛ aaaŋma fɛɛ ekomekome lɛ, misusuɔ akɛ je lɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛŋ woji ni kulɛ aaaŋma lɛ eto.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ Luka Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔtsamɔ ni.
Oti krɛdɛɛ ni akɛŋmã wolo nɛɛ ji bɔ ni afee ni anyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kpla mɛi ni banyiɛ Yesu sɛɛ klɛŋklɛŋ ni amɛkɛyagbɛ ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛshwã yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria niiaŋ fɛɛ aahu kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ fɛɛ lɛ .
Wolo lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni ato Kristo asafo lɛ shishi yɛ Yudafoi lɛ ateŋ kɛ bɔ hu ni etee nɔ ni etsɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛkple jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ.
Nɔ pɔtɛɛ hu ni woloŋmalɔ lɛ taoɔ ni ekanelɔi lɛ anu shishi faŋŋ ji akɛ Kristofoi lɛ amɛbaaa ni amɛkɛ amralofoi kɛ lumɛi ni yɔɔ Roma maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ abakede, shi moŋ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba ni ebawo Yudafoi lɛ ajamɔ lɛ obɔ.
Aaanyɛ adamɔ bɔ ni Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ fee ni eshwere ni egbɛ eshwa kɛ bɔ ni afee ato Kristo Asafo lɛ nɔ ni akɛja Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ amli etɛ̃.
.
Kristo Asafo lɛ shishitoo yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Yesu ŋwɛiyaa lɛ sɛɛ.
.
Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛɛkɛshwamɔ yɛ maji krokomɛi amli yɛ Palestina shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
.
Bɔ ni wiemɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã shikpɔji ni bɔle Mediterenia Ŋshɔ lɛ he aahu kɛyashɛ Roma.
Nɔ kome jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi ahe wolo nɛɛ mli, no ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nitsumɔ kɛ ehewalɛ ni ekɛbayi mɛi ni ehe Yesu nɔ amɛye yɛ Yerusalɛm yɛ Pentekoste gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ amli lɛ.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tee nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ Kristo Asafo lɛ kɛ asafonukpai lɛ agbɛ ni ewo amɛ hewalɛ hu yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni wolo lɛ yeɔ he odase akɛ amɛtsu lɛ mli.
Shiɛmɔwiemɔ ni akɛbahã klɛŋklɛŋ Kristofoi lɛ afolɔ lɛ kuku kuku yɛ shiɛmɔi srɔtoi amli.
Agbɛnɛ hu, nii ni tee nɔ fɛɛ ni aŋmala amɛhe saji yɛ Bɔfoi lɛ Anitsumɔi lɛ ahe wolo lɛ mli lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ hewalɛ kɛ ekãa ni shiɛmɔi srɔtoi nɛɛ wo mɛi ni he Kristo nɔ amɛye yɛ amɛwala mli lɛ, asaŋ kɛ amɛnaanyobɔɔ yɛ Kristo asafo lɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi Hesaamɔ kɛhã odaseyeli .- a. Yesu naagbee famɔ kɛ eshiwoo .- b. Yuda sɛɛyelɔ .- Odaseyeli yɛ Yerusalɛm .—.
Odaseyeli yɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria .—.
Paulo nitsumɔ .—.
a. Shiɛmɔ lɛ he klɛŋklɛŋ gbɛfãa .—.
b. Kpee yɛ Yerusalɛm .- d. Gbɛfaa ni ji enyɔ .—.
e. Gbɛfaa ni ji etɛ̃ .—.
ɛ. Paulo mɔŋwoo yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Kaisarea kɛ Roma .—.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo Teofilo, miklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ mli lɛ, migba nii fɛɛ ni Yesu babɔ̃i feemɔ kɛ enitsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi, be ni etsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ ewo ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ akitãi sɛɛ lɛ.
Emanehulu lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ odaseyeli nibii pii anɔ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bɔfoi nɛɛ akɛ ehiɛ kã, ni ehã amɛna lɛ gbii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ sɔŋŋ, ni ekɛ amɛ wie Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he.
Ni be ni ekɛ amɛnaa kpe shi lɛ, ewo amɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Nyɛkajea Yerusalɛm, shi moŋ nyɛmɛa Tsɛ lɛ shiwoo lɛ ni nyɛnu yɛ minaa lɛ; ejaakɛ Yohane lɛ, nu ekɛbaptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ eyeŋ gbii pii ko ni akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ.” Yesu ŋwɛiyaa No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi lɛ amɛbi lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ani nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli obaatee maŋtsɛyeli lɛ shi oma shi ohã Israel lɛ?” Shi Yesu kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Jeee nyɛnɔ ji akɛ nyɛaale bei loo gbii lɛ ni Tsɛ lɛ eto yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ mli lɛ.
Shi moŋ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ na ba nyɛnɔ lɛ, nyɛaana hewalɛ ni nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ midasefoi yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yudea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, kɛyashi jeŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ.” Be ni ewie nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmiikwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni awo lɛ, ni atatu ko ŋɔ lɛ kɛje amɛhiɛ kɛtee.
Ni be ni eyaa ni amɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi gãa lɛ, naa, hii enyɔ ni wo atadei yɛji damɔ amɛmasɛi, ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Galileabii, mɛɛba nyɛdamɔ shi nyɛkwɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛkɛ?
Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje nyɛŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi nɛɛ, ebaaba nakai nɔŋŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna akɛ eyaa ŋwɛi nɛɛ.” Ahala Matia ni eye Yuda najiaŋ Kɛkɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ gɔŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Mugɔŋ lɛ ni kɛ Yerusalɛm jɛkɛmɔ aaafee hejɔɔmɔ gbi gbɛfãa lɛ, nɔ amɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛtee ŋwɛitsu ko mli, he ni Petro kɛ Yakobo kɛ Yohane kɛ Andrea kɛ Filipo kɛ Toma kɛ Bartolomeo kɛ Mateo kɛ Alfeo bi Yakobo kɛ Simon, maŋ he hiɛdɔlɔ lɛ, kɛ Yakobo bi Yuda hiɔ lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛ yei lɛ kɛ Yesu nyɛ Maria kɛ enyɛmimɛi hii lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli waa.
Nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ Petro te shi edamɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ (mɛi fɛɛ ni ebabua amɛhe naa lɛ aaafee oha kɛ nyɔŋmai enyɔ) ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, esa akɛ nɔ ni aŋma ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ekɛɛ eto yɛ David naa yɛ Yuda, mɔ ni nyiɛ mɛi ni bamɔ Yesu lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, he lɛ aba mli, ejaakɛ abu lɛ ashi wɔnɔ, ni eyɛ egbɛnaa yɛ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli.” Shi nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ ŋɔ enɔsha ni efee lɛ mli nyɔmɔwoo lɛ ehe abɔɔ, ni eyama eyi shi, ni emli gba enyɔ ni emlinii fɛɛ tue shwie shi.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ na le enɛ, no hewɔ lɛ, atsɛɔ nakai abɔɔ lɛ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwiemɔ mli akɛ Akeldama, eshishi ji “Lá-Abɔɔ”.
Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Lalai Awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Eshihilɛhe lɛ atsɔ̃ amaŋfɔ̃ ni mɔ ko mɔ ko akahi mli,’ kɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, ‘Enɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ hu mɔ kroko aŋɔ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ hii ni kɛ wɔ nyiɛ be mli fɛɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ Yesu yaa baa yɛ wɔteŋ, kɛjɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ nɔ kɛyashi gbi nɔ ni aŋɔ lɛ kɛje wɔŋɔɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome atsɔ eshitee lɛ he odasefonyo afata wɔhe.” Ni amɛfamɔ mɛi enyɔ, Yosef ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba ni awo lɛ Yusto hu lɛ, kɛ Matia, amɛdamɔ shi.
Ni amɛsɔle amɛkɛɛ, “Bo, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ole gbɔmɛi fɛɛ atsuiiaŋ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ mɔ ni ohala ni eŋɔ nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ ni Yuda eje mli koni ekɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛ lɛ.” Ni amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ oshiki, ni oshiki lɛ yagbee Matia nɔ, ni abu lɛ ashi bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ anɔ.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɔsemɔ Be ni Pentekoste gbi (loo gbi ni ji nyɔŋmai enumɔ) lɛ shɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome.
Ni trukaa lɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko ni tamɔ ahum ni tswaa waa jɛ ŋwɛi ba, ni ebayi shĩa he ni amɛtara lɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃.
Ni lilɛii ni agbalagbalaa mli ni tamɔ la lilɛii pue; ni ebatara amɛyiteaŋ ekomekome; ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ bayimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃, ni amɛbɔ̃i wiemɔi krokomɛi awiemɔ tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwo amɛnaa lɛ.
Shi Yudafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛjɛ jeŋ maji fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi lɛ anɔ.
Ni be ni anu nɛkɛ gbɛɛmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi babaoo babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe, ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nu akɛ amɛmiiwie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋwiemɔ.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛhiɛ fee amɛ yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Ani mɛi ni wieɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee Galileabii ni?
Shi te fee tɛŋŋ ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nuɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ he ni afɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ?
Partiabii kɛ Mediabii kɛ Elambii kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mesopotamia kɛ Yudea kɛ Kapadokia, Ponto kɛ Asia, Frigia kɛ Pamfilia, Ijipt kɛ Libia niiaŋ yɛ Kirene masɛi kɛ gbɔi ni jɛ Roma, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni etsɔ̃mɔ Yudafoi, Kretabii kɛ Arabiabii: wɔmiinu akɛ amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ nibii wuji lɛ yɛ wɔwiemɔi lɛ amli.” Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe ni amɛfee yaa, ni amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Te enɛ shishiŋ?” Shi mɛi komɛi hu ye fɛo amɛkɛɛ, “Dãa dɔkɔdɔkɔ etɔrɔ amɛ.” Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ fɔsemɔ gbi lɛ nɔ Shi Petro kɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ te shi amɛdamɔ shi, ni ewo egbee nɔ ekɛ asafo lɛ wie ekɛɛ, “Yudahii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm, nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ, ni nyɛboa miwiemɔi lɛ atoi.
Jeee dãa mɛnɛɛmɛi etɔrɔ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛsusuɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ leebi ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu kɛkɛ nɛ; shi moŋ enɛ ji nɔ ni gbalɔ Yoel wie lɛ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Ni aaaba mli yɛ naagbee gbii lɛ anɔ akɛ, mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie gbɔmɛi fɛɛ anɔ, ni nyɛbihii kɛ nyɛbiyei lɛ aaagba, ni nyɛblahii lɛ aaana ninai, ni nyɛnukpai lɛ aaala lamɔi.
Ni asaŋ mitsuji hii kɛ mitsuji yei lɛ anɔ hu mafɔse miMumɔ lɛ eko mashwie yɛ nakai gbii lɛ anɔ, ni amɛaagba.
Ni mahã naakpɛɛnii aba ŋwɛi, ni okadii hu aba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, lá kɛ la kɛ lasu lamɔ.
Hulu aaatsɔ̃ duŋ, ni nyɔɔŋtsere aaatsɔ̃ lá, dani Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbi wulu ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ aaaba.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyiwala.’ “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛboa nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ atoi!
Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ ji nuu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii ni etsɔ̃ enine nɔ efee yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ ye ehe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle lɛ.
Yesu nɛɛ ni ajie lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kɛ enii ni ele eto lɛ naa ahã lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ mɛi ni bɛ mla lɛ anine nɔ nyɛsɛŋ lɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi ni efɛne lɛ kɛjɛ gbele piŋmɔi lɛ amli, akɛni gbele nyɛŋ enaa etsi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ David wie yɛ ehe ekɛɛ, ‘Minaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ mihiɛ daa, ejaakɛ eyɛ mininejurɔ nɔ, koni mikadidãa.
No hewɔ lɛ, mitsui nyɔ̃ mimli ni mililɛi nya, ni asaŋ migbɔmɔtso hu aaajɔɔ ehe yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli; ejaakɛ oshiŋ misusuma yɛ gbohiiaje, ni ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ.
Ohã mile wala gbɛ̃i lɛ, Ni ooowo mi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ ohiɛ.’ “Anyɛmimɛi, makɛɛ nyɛ faŋŋ yɛ blematsɛ David lɛ he akɛ egbo ni afu lɛ, ni asaŋ eyɛ wɔteŋ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ.
Akɛni gbalɔ ji lɛ ni ele akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekã lɛ kitã akɛ emusuŋbii lɛ eko baata esɛi lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, ena eto ni ewie Kristo shitee lɛ he akɛ ashiii esusuma yɛ gbohiiaje ni egbɔmɔtso hu fiteee.
Nɛkɛ Yesu nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi; no he odasefoi ji wɔ fɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ akɛni awo enɔ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ ni ena Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ he shiwoo lɛ kɛjɛ Tsɛ lɛ dɛ̃ŋ hewɔ lɛ, efɔse nɔ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛnuɔ nɛɛ eshwie shi.
