Ejaakɛ David eyaaa ŋwɛi, shi lɛ nɔŋŋ ekɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ miNuŋtsɔ lɛ akɛ, ta mininejurɔ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, Israel we lɛ fɛɛ ale krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ nɛkɛ Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ nɛɛ efee Nuŋtsɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ.” Shi be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkɛɛ Petro kɛ bɔfoi ni eshwɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, te wɔɔfee tɛŋŋ?” Ni Petro kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã abaptisi lɛ awo Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, koni akɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ afa nyɛ, ni nyɛaana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ shiwoo lɛ, nyɛ kɛ nyɛbii, kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ, mɛi abɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatsɛ kɛaaba lɛ anɔ ni.” Ni ewie wiemɔi krokomɛi pii ekɛye odase ni ekɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ, “Nyɛhãa aherea nyɛyiwala kɛjea yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ nɛɛ mli.” Kɛkɛ ni abaptisi mɛi ni he ewiemɔ lɛ, ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ akɛ susumai aaafee akpei etɛ̃ fata amɛhe.
Bɔ ni heyelɔi lɛ hi shi hã Ni amɛhiɛ bɔfoi lɛ atsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ kɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ abolookuumɔ lɛ kɛ sɔlemɔi lɛ amli.
Ni gbeyei mɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ, ni atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anɔ afee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii pii.
Ni mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ he kome, ni amɛfee amɛnii fɛɛ ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ekome; amɛhɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛshikpɔji kɛ amɛhenii, ni amɛja shika lɛ amɛhã mɛi lɛ fɛɛ bɔ ni he hiaa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛkumɔkumɔɔ aboloo yɛ shĩai, ni amɛkɛ miishɛɛ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yeɔ nii, ni amɛ jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ yi, ni amɛhiɛ ba nyam yɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ mɛi ni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ efataa asafo lɛ he gbi fɛɛ gbi.
Nuu obubuafo lɛ tsamɔ Gbi ko gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ ni ji sɔlemɔ be lɛ, Petro kɛ Yohane tsa mlu kɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni nuu ko yɛ ni ji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ, ni awoɔ lɛ daa abataa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ shinaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa, koni ebala nii yɛ mɛi ni yaa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ adɛ̃.
Ni be ni ena Petro kɛ Yohane boteɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, eba amɛ nɔ ko.
Shi Petro kɛ Yohane fɛɛ kwɛ lɛ gãa, ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ wɔhiɛ!” Ni edɔ ehiŋmɛii eto amɛnɔ, ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaana nɔ ko yɛ amɛdɛ̃.
Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Jwiɛtɛi kɛ shika lɛ mibɛ eko; shi nɔ ni miyɔɔ lɛ, no mikɛhãa bo nɛɛ, Yɛ Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, gbɛi mli lɛ, tee shi ni onyiɛ.” Ni emɔ̃ eninejurɔ mli ni ewo enɔ edamɔ shi; ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ enaji kɛ enanetalɔi lɛ amli wa lɛ; ni ehuru edamɔ shi ni ebɔ̃i nyiɛmɔ, ni ekɛ amɛ nyiɛ kɛbote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ tuumɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ na lɛ ni enyiɛ ni eejie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni be ni amɛyoo lɛ akɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni ta Sɔlemɔ We “Shinaa Fɛɛfɛo” lɛ naa ebalaa nii lɛ, amɛhe jɔ̃ amɛhe ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe babaoo yɛ nɔ ni afee ahã lɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Petro shiɛmɔ yɛ Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ Shi akɛni obubuafo ni atsa lɛ lɛ kpɛtɛ Petro kɛ Yohane hewɔ lɛ, maŋ lɛ fɛɛ jo foi kutuu kɛba amɛŋɔɔ yɛ ablanaa ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Solomon Ablanaa” lɛ nɔ ni amɛhe ejɔ̃ amɛhe.
Be ni Petro na enɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ Israelhii, mɛɛba nyɛhiɛ feɔ nyɛ yaa yɛ enɛ hewɔ, aloo mɛɛba nyɛkwɛɔ wɔ gãa nɛkɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhewalɛ loo wɔNyɔŋmɔjamɔ wɔkɛhã nuu nɛɛ nyiɛɔ nɛɛ?
Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ewo etsulɔ Yesu hiɛ nyam, Yesu mɔ ni nyɛjie lɛ nyɛhã ni nyɛkwa lɛ yɛ Pontio Pilato hiɛ, be ni lɛ lɛ ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeŋmɛɛ ehe lɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, nyɛkwa Mɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ Jalɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkpa fai akɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ awuyelɔ moŋ ake nyɛ, ni Wala Lumɔ lɛ, nyɛgbe lɛ; shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni no he odasefoi ji wɔ.
Ni egbɛi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa, ni egbɛi lɛ tsa nuu nɛɛ ni nyɛnaa ni nyɛle lɛ; ni enɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã efee kpiŋtiŋkpliŋŋ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
“Ni agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mile akɛ leee ni nyɛleee hewɔ ni nyɛfee, tamɔ nyɛnukpai lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ anaa akɛ eKristo lɛ aaana amanehulu lɛ, ehã eba mli nakai.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛtsakea nyɛtsui ni nyɛkua nyɛsɛɛ, koni agbe nyɛhe eshai lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mumɔŋ hewalɛwoo ko ajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ aba, ni eeetsu Yesu Kristo mɔ ni ejie eto ehã nyɛ momo lɛ; mɔ ni sa akɛ ŋwɛi aŋɔ lɛ kɛyashi be ni aaato nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewie he yɛ egbalɔi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ teteete lɛ gbɛjianɔ.
Ejaakɛ Mose kɛɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ; nyɛboa lɛ toi yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni eeewie etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ mli.
Ni aaaba mli akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni boŋ nakai gbalɔ lɛ toi lɛ, aaakpãtã ehiɛ kwraa kɛaaje mɛi lɛ ateŋ!’ Ni asaŋ gbalɔi fɛɛ hu ni wie kɛjɛ Samuel kɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ esɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛtsi nɛkɛ gbii nɛɛ atã amɛto.
Nyɛ ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ lɛ bii, kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ, be ni ekɛɛ Abraham akɛ, ‘Ni oshwei mli aaajɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ wekui fɛɛ yɛ’ lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee etsulɔ Yesu lɛ shi lɛ, nyɛ tsutsu nyɛŋɔɔ etsu lɛ ni ebajɔɔ nyɛ ni ekpale nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛjɛ enifɔɔji anii lɛ ahe.”
Petro kɛ Yohane yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ Shi be ni amɛkɛ maŋ lɛ wieɔ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ bashwie amɛnɔ, ejaakɛ efee amɛ mlifu akɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii, ni amɛmiijaje amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Yesu ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ.
Ni amɛmɔmɔ amɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ tsuŋ kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ, ejaakɛ je ena etã.
Shi mɛi ni nu lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii he ye, ni hii lɛ ayibɔ bashɛ aaafee akpei enumɔ.
Shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ amɛlumɛi lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ babua amɛhe naa yɛ Yerusalɛm, kɛ Osɔfonukpa Ana, kɛ Kaiafa kɛ Yohane kɛ Aleksandro kɛ mɛi abɔ ni jɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ weku lɛ mli lɛ; ni amɛyaŋɔ Petro kɛ Yohane amɛbadamɔ amɛhiɛ, ni amɛbi amɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewalɛ nyɛkɛfee enɛ, aloo mɛɛ gbɛi mli nyɛfee yɛ?” Kɛkɛ ni Petro ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Maŋ mli lumɛi kɛ onukpai, kɛji akɛ wɔ miiye sane ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ yɛ ejurɔ ni afee nɛkɛ helatsɛ nɛɛ hewɔ akɛ namɔ nɔ atsɔ̃ atsa lɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ fɛɛ kɛ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ana ale akɛ, Yesu Kristo, Nazarenyo lɛ, ni nyɛsɛŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, lɛ egbɛi mli nuu nɛɛ damɔ nyɛhiɛ ni ehe ewa lɛ nɛɛ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni ŋmalɛi lɛ wie yɛ ehe akɛ, ‘Tɛ lɛ ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji tsutswalɔi lɛ gbe ehe guɔ lɛ, no ebatsɔ̃ koŋtɛ nɛɛ.’ Ejaakɛ yiwalaheremɔ bɛ mɔ kroko mli; ni asaŋ gbɛi kroko hu bɛ ŋwɛi shishi ni akɛhã gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ atsɔ̃ nɔ ahere wɔyiwala.” Agbɛnɛ be ni amɛna Petro kɛ Yohane ekãa lɛ, ni amɛyoo akɛ jeee woloŋlelɔi kɛ nilelɔi komɛi ji amɛ lɛ, efee amɛhiɛ yaa, ni amɛkɔ sɛɛ akɛ amɛkɛ Yesu ehi shi.
Ni asaŋ akɛni amɛna gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ lɛ kɛ amɛ damɔ shi hewɔ lɛ, amɛnaaa nɔ ko amɛkɛɛ.
Shi amɛfã amɛ akɛ amɛje gwabɔɔ lɛ mli amɛje kpo fioo, ni amɛtee ajina amɛkɛɛ, “Te wɔɔfee gbɔmɛi nɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ okadi ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ ni atsɔ̃ amɛnɔ afee lɛ yɛ faŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ahiɛ, ni wɔnyɛŋ wɔtso.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekahehee tuutu ko dɔŋŋ yɛ mɛi lɛ ateŋ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔwoa amɛhe gbeyei, koni amɛkawie yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ.” Ni amɛtsɛ amɛ kɛba, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkatsi tã ni amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ Yesu gbɛi mli kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Shi Petro kɛ Yohane here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Kɛ eja gbɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ abo nyɛ moŋ toi fe Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛkojoa.
Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ wɔnyɛŋ akɛ ja wɔwie nii ni wɔna kɛ nii ni wɔnu lɛ.” Shi be ni gwabɔɔ lɛ saa wo amɛhe gbeyei lɛ, amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe, ejaakɛ amɛnaaa bɔ ni amɛaafee ni amɛpiŋ amɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ miiwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ nɔ ni afee lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni atsa lɛ naakpɛɛ tsamɔ nɛɛ eye fe afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Heyelɔi lɛ sɔle ni awo amɛ ekãa Shi be ni aŋmɛɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛba amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni amɛbagba nibii fɛɛ ni osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛɛ amɛ lɛ.
Be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hole amɛgbei anɔ amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, bo ni oji Nyɔŋmɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fiaa ni yɔɔ amɛmli, bo mɔ ni otsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ owie yɛ wɔtsɛ David, otsulɔ lɛ, naa okɛɛ akɛ, ‘Mɛɛba jeŋmaji lɛ feɔ hoo, ni maji lɛ hu jwɛŋɔ yakanii?
Shikpɔŋ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ete shi edamɔ shi, ni lumɛi lɛ hu anaa ebakpe shi ewo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni efɔ lɛ mu lɛ!’ “Lɛɛlɛŋ, Herode kɛ Pontio Pilato kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ Israel maji lɛ hu ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ maŋ nɛɛŋ amɛwo otsulɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu, mɔ ni ofɔ lɛ mu lɛ, koni amɛfee nii abɔ ni onine kɛ oyiŋtoo lɛ eto efɔ shi akɛ afee lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ hu, Nuŋtsɔ, kwɛmɔ amɛmɔhegbeyei ni amɛwoɔ lɛ, ni ohã otsuji lɛ kɛ ekãa pii ajaje owiemɔ lɛ, ni okpã onine mli ni ohã atsatsaa mɛi, ni atsɔ̃ otsulɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ Yesu lɛ gbɛi nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii.” Ni be ni amɛsɔle nɛkɛ lɛ, he ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi yɛ lɛ hoso, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ yimɔ amɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃; ni amɛkɛ ekãa jaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Heyelɔi lɛ fee amɛnii fɛɛ kwasafonii Shi mɛi babaoo lɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ tsui koome kɛ susuma koome, ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko tsɛɛɛ enii ni eyɔɔ lɛ amli eko akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, shi eyɛ hã amɛ fɛɛ.
Ni hewalɛ kpeteŋkple bɔfoi lɛ kɛye Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shitee lɛ he odase, ni dromɔ kpeteŋkple yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnɔ.
Ni mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ amɛteŋ ni efiɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ shikpɔji loo shĩai lɛ hɔ̃ɔhɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni amɛkɛ nii ni ahɔ̃ɔ lɛ ayinii lɛ ba, amɛkɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa, ni ajaa ahãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ bɔ ni hiaa lɛ.
Ni Yose, mɔ ni bɔfoi lɛ wo lɛ Barnaba (eshishi ji: Miishɛjemɔ bi) lɛ, ni ji Levinyo ni esɛɛ jɛ Kipro lɛ, yɛ shikpɔŋ, ni ehɔ̃ɔ, ni ekɛ shika lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.
Anania kɛ Safira Shi nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania kɛ eŋa Safira lɛ yahɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ ko, ni nuu lɛ kɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ, ni eŋa hu le he eko, ni ekɛ fã lɛ ba ni ekɛbashwie bɔfoi lɛ anajianaa.
Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Anania, mɛɛba Satan yi otsuiŋ obɔ̃, ni omale otsɔ̃ɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ni okɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ yinii lɛ eko to sɛɛ?
Ani be ni eyɔɔ lɛ, jeee bo onɔ ni?
Ni be ni ohɔ̃ɔ hu lɛ, shika lɛ jee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ ni?
Mɛɛba oto nɛkɛ yiŋ?
Jeee gbɔmɛi omale otsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ.” Ni be ni Anania nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, egbee shi, ni egbo.
Ni gbeyei kpele mɔmɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ.
Ni oblahii lɛ te shi, ni amɛbasaa lɛ kɛhã fuu, ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo ni amɛyafu lɛ.
Ni aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ, eba mli akɛ eŋa ni leee nɔ sane ni eba lɛ hu ba jɛi.
Ni Petro bi lɛ akɛ, “Ani bɔ ni nyɛhɔ̃ɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nyɛhe nɛ?
Kɛɛmɔ mi.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, nɛkɛŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Te fee tɛŋŋ ni nyɛfee naabu kome koni nyɛkɛka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ nɛɛ?
Naa, mɛi ni yafu owu lɛ anaji yɔɔ shinaa lɛ naa lɛ, ni amɛaawo bo hu kɛaatee.” Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ egbee shi yɛ Petro najianaa, ni egbo.
Ni be ni oblahii lɛ ba lɛ amɛbana akɛ egbo ni amɛwo lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amɛyafu lɛ yɛ ewu lɛ masɛi.
Ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nu nii nɛɛ.
Okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii Shi atsɔ̃ bɔfoi lɛ anine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii yɛ maŋ lɛ mli; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome hi Solomon Ablanaa lɛ nɔ.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko ekaaa akɛ ekɛ yiŋ flɛflɛ aaayakpɛtɛ amɛhe, shi maŋ lɛ buɔ amɛ naakpa.
Ni asaŋ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ yeɔ, hii kɛ yei babaoo, bafata amɛhe, aahu po ni aholeɔ helatsɛmɛi kɛbaa blohui amli abashwieɔ sai kɛ saatsei anɔ, koni kɛ Petro miiho lɛ, ehɔɔŋ kɛkɛ atsɔ̃ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi anɔ.
Ni mɛi pii jɛ maji ni jwere Yerusalɛm hewɔ lɛ amli babua amɛhe naa, ni amɛhiɛ helatsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji haoɔ amɛ kɛba, ni atsa amɛ fɛɛ.
Awa bɔfoi lɛ ayi Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ te shi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ ni ji Sadukifoi lɛ akuu lɛ, ni amɛhiɛ edɔ diɛŋtsɛ, ni amɛbamɔmɔ bɔfoi lɛ, ni amɛyawo amɛ maŋ kpabuŋ.
Shi nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo bagbele tsu lɛ shinai lɛ, ni ejie amɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa nyɛyadamɔa Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nyɛjajea nɛkɛ wala nɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ nyɛtsɔ̃a maŋ lɛ!” Ni be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛyiŋ leebi maŋkpa amɛtee Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛyatsɔ̃ɔ nii.
Agbɛnɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ba ni amɛbatsɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ kɛ Israelbii lɛ anukpai lɛ fɛɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛtsu kɛtee tsu lɛ mli koni ayajie bɔfoi lɛ kɛba.
Shi be ni tsuji lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, amɛnaaa amɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ amɛbagba akɛ, “Tsu lɛ wɔna akɛ aŋa naa kpɛŋŋ, ni bulɔi lɛ hu damɔ shinai lɛ anaa; shi be ni wɔgbele lɛ, wɔnaaa mɔ ko yɛ mli.” Shi be ni osɔfo lɛ kɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ nu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ, amɛfee yaa yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ahe [ni amɛbi] akɛ, “Te enɛ naa yaakpa tɛŋŋ?” Ni mɔ ko ba bagba amɛ akɛ, “Naa, hii lɛ ni nyɛwo amɛ tsuŋ lɛ damɔ shi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ nii.” Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ kɛ tsuji lɛ yiŋ ni amɛyaŋɔ amɛ kɛba, jeee nɔnyɛɛ naa, ejaakɛ amɛmiishe maŋ lɛ gbeyei, ni akabatswia amɛ tɛi.
Ni be ni amɛkɛ amɛ ba lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛ badamɔ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ; ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi amɛ akɛ, “Ani wɔwooo nyɛ kitã kadikadi akɛ nyɛkatsɔ̃ɔ nii yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛi nɛɛ mli?
Nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni nyɛhã Yerusalɛm eyi obɔ̃ kɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, ni nyɛmiitao akɛ nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ lá lɛ baa wɔnɔ.” Shi Petro kɛ bɔfoi lɛ here nɔ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esa akɛ aboɔ Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ toi fe gbɔmɛi.
Yesu ni nyɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni nyɛgbe lɛ lɛ, wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tee lɛ shi; lɛ enɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wo kɛtee eninejurɔ nɔ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ kɛ yiwalaherelɔ, koni ehã Israel ana tsuitsakemɔ kɛ eshaifaa.
Ni wɔji saji nɛɛ ahe odasefoi, nakai nɔŋŋ ji Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mɛi ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ.” Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ ewo amɛmli la ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ amɛaagbe amɛ.
Shi Farisifonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Gamaliel, mlatsɔɔlɔ ni maŋ lɛ fɛɛ buɔ lɛ lɛ, te shi damɔ shi yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ teŋ, ni efã akɛ akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aje kpo fioo, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ amɛ aaaye ahã.
Ejaakɛ nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ Teuda te shi ni ekɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ, ni hii aaafee ohai ejwɛ kɛ amɛhe yakpɛtɛ ehe; shi agbe lɛ, ni mɛi abɔ ni bo lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ gbɛ shwã ni amɛyi hɛ shi.
Mɔ nɛ sɛɛ lɛ Yuda, Galileanyo lɛ, te shi yɛ mɛi akanemɔ be lɛ mli, ni egbala asafo babaoo eshwie esɛɛ; lɛ hu ehiɛ kpãtã ni mɛi ni bo lɛ toi lɛ fɛɛ hu gbɛ shwã.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, nyɛŋmɛa gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ahe ni nyɛkadia amɛsɛɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ nɛkɛ yiŋtoo nɛɛ loo nɛkɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ jɛ lɛ, ebaafite; shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ lɛ, nyɛnyɛŋ lɛ nyɛfite, koni nyɛkabafee nyɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wuɔ.” Ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛba, ni amɛyi amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛkawie yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli; ni amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛje akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ amɛtee kɛ miishɛɛ, akɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ abu amɛ mɛi ni sa akɛ abɔ amɛ ahora.
Ni gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛ shĩai.
Ohiafoi akwɛlɔi kpawo lɛ ahalamɔ Nakai bei lɛ amli, be ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi faa lɛ, Helenibii lɛ wie huhuuhu amɛshi Hebribii lɛ, ejaakɛ Hebribii lɛ ahiɛ jeɔ Helenibii lɛ okulafoi lɛ anɔ yɛ daa kwɛmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Kɛkɛ ni kaselɔi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ tsɛ asafo lɛ kɛba, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Esaaa akɛ wɔshiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔyasɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ okpɔlɔi ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtaoa nyɛteŋ hii kpawo ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ nilee eyi amɛ obɔ̃, koni wɔkɛ amɛ ato nɛkɛ nitsumɔ ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔ; shi wɔ lɛ wɔɔhiɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ wiemɔ lɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.” Ni wiemɔ lɛ sa asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ; ni amɛfamɔ Stefano, nuu ko ni hemɔkɛyeli kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃, kɛ Filipo kɛ Prokoro kɛ Nikanora kɛ Timon kɛ Parmena kɛ Nikolao ni emɔ Yudafoi ajamɔ mli ni ejɛ Antiokia lɛ, ni amɛkɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi badamɔ bɔfoi lɛ ahiɛ; ni amɛsɔle ni amɛkɛ amɛniji shwie amɛnɔ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ shwere, ni kaselɔi lɛ ayi bafa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni osɔfoi lɛ tete ateŋ mɛi pii mɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Stefano mɔ̃mɔ Ni Stefano, mɔ ni dromɔ kɛ hewalɛ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, fee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii wuji yɛ maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ kpeehe ni atsɛɔ lɛ “Mɛi ni eye amɛhe” akpeehe lɛ, kɛ Kirenemɛi kɛ Aleksandriamɛi kɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kilikia kɛ Asia lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi te shi ni amɛkɛ Stefano taa naa; shi amɛnyɛɛɛ Stefano nilee kɛ mumɔ ni ekɛwieɔ lɛ naa amɛdamɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ mɛi komɛi yafi ni amɛbakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔnu akɛ ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Mose kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.” Ni amɛwo maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ kɛ mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛte shi kɛba enɔ amɛbamɔ lɛ ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ amale odasefoi badamɔ shi, ni mɛnɛɛmɛi kɛɛ akɛ, “Be fɛɛ be lɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ miiwie miishi he krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ Mose Mla lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔnu akɛ ekɛɛ akɛ Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ, aaafite biɛ, ni eeetsake kusumi ni Mose kɛhã wɔ lɛ.” Ni mɛi ni tara akwaashɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ tsu amɛhiŋmɛii amɛshwie enɔ, ni amɛna ehiɛ tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo hiɛ.
Stefano shiɛmɔ Ni osɔfonukpa lɛ bi Stefano akɛ, “Ani saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi kɛ Ataamɛi, nyɛboa toi!
Anunyam Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham be ni eyɔɔ Mesopotamia, ni enako ebahi Haran lɛ, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jee oshikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ owekumɛi ateŋ kɛya shikpɔŋ ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo lɛ nɔ.’ Kɛkɛ ni eje Kaldeabii lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni eyahi Haran.
Ni be ni etsɛ gbo sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ fã lɛ kɛjɛ jɛi kɛba nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ ni nyɛyɔɔ nɔ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔ; ni ehãaa lɛ nɔyelinɔ ni ji shikpɔŋ ni shɛɔ nane tokota lɛɛmɔ tete, shi ewo lɛ shi akɛ ekɛaahã lɛ kɛ eshwiei ni baaba yɛ esɛɛ lɛ akɛ amɛnɔ, tsɛ no mli lɛ ebɛ bi kwraa po.
Shi bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ wie ji akɛ, eshwiei lɛ aaayato gbɔ yɛ maŋsɛɛ shikpɔŋ ko nɔ, ni aaafee amɛ nyɔji ni aaawa amɛ yi afii ohai ejwɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, ‘Makojo nakai maŋ ni amɛaayasɔ̃mɔ lɛ, ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛaaje jɛi ni amɛaabaja mi yɛ biɛ nɛɛ.’ Ni ekɛ ketiafoo he kpãŋmɔ lɛ hã lɛ; ni no hewɔ efɔ Isak ni efo lɛ ketia gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ; ni Isak fɔ Yakob, ni Yakob hu fɔ blematsɛmɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
Ni blematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ hɔ̃ɔ Yosef kɛtee Ijipt, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ, ni ejie lɛ yɛ emanehului fiaa mli, ni ehã ehiɛ ba nyam, ni efee nilelɔ yɛ Ijipt maŋtsɛ Farao hiɛ, ni ewo lɛ lumɔ yɛ Ijipt kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
“Shi hɔmɔ kɛ amanehulu kpeteŋkple ba Ijipt kɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ naaa nii amɛye.
Ni be ni Yakob nu akɛ abele yɛ Ijipt lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ etsu wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛtee.
Ni nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Yosef hã enyɛmimɛi lɛ yoo lɛ, ni Farao hu bale Yosef weku lɛ.
Ni Yosef tsu ayakpee etsɛ Yakob kɛ eweku lɛ fɛɛ kɛba; amɛyi nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ enumɔ.
Ni Yakob yiŋ etee Ijipt, ni lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ yagboi yɛ jɛi.
Akɛ amɛgbohii lɛ ba Shekem, ni abato amɛ yɛ fuuhe ni Abraham tse shika he yɛ Hamorbii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Shekem lɛ mli.
“Shi be ni bè ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye eshi ni ewo Abraham lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ lɛ, maŋ lɛ shwere, ni amɛyi fa yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋtsɛ kroko ni leee Yosef lɛ bate shi yɛ Ijipt.
Maŋtsɛ nɛɛ, ekɛ wɔjakubii lɛ ye ŋaa mli ni efee wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ efɔŋ, akɛ ehã amɛshɛrɛ amɛbii abifabii amɛshwie, bɔ ni afee ni amɛkahi jeŋ.
Nakai be lɛ mli afɔ Mose, ni ehe yɛ fɛo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni alɛ lɛ yɛ etsɛ we lɛ nyɔji etɛ̃.
Ni be ni ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ lɛ, Farao biyoo lɛ yawo lɛ, ni elɛ lɛ ekɛ lɛ fee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebi.
Ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose Ijipt nilee fɛɛ, ni efee mɔ ko ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ ewiemɔi kɛ enitsumɔi amli.
“Be ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, eba eyiŋ akɛ eeeyasara enyɛmimɛi Israelbii lɛ.
Be ni ena akɛ aafee amɛteŋ mɔ ko efɔŋ lɛ, efã ehe, ni etɔ mɔ ni afeɔ lɛ efɔŋ lɛ he owele ni egbe Ijiptnyo lɛ.
Ni esusu akɛ kulɛ enyɛmimɛi lɛ aaayoo sɛɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miitsɔ enine nɔ ehere amɛ; shi amɛyooo sɛɛ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ebanina amɛteŋ mɛi enyɔ ni amɛmiinɔ, ni ekpãtã amɛ ekɛɛ, ‘Ataamɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji nyɛ; mɛɛba nyɛfeɔ nyɛhe efɔŋ nɛɛ?’ Shi mɔ ni feɔ enaanyo efɔŋ lɛ tsirɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ?
Ani ootao akɛ ogbe mi tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ lɛ ogbe Ijiptnyo lɛ?
Ni wiemɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ Mose jo foi, ni eyato gbɔ yɛ Midian shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni efɔ bihii enyɔ yɛ jɛi.
“Shi be ni shɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko bajie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ he ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmeitso ko lalilɛi mli.
Be ni Mose na lɛ, ehiɛ fee lɛ yaa yɛ ninaa lɛ hewɔ; ni be ni etsiɔ ebɛŋkɛ ni ekwɛ lɛ enu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbee ni eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Mi ji otsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Abraham kɛ Isak kɛ Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.’ Ni Mose he kpokpo ni ekaaa akɛ eeeyakwɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Jiemɔ otokotai lɛ yɛ onane, ejaakɛ he ni odamɔ lɛ shikpɔŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni.
Mina mimaŋ ni yɔɔ Ijipt lɛ amanehulu lɛ, amɛŋtsɔidɔɔmɔ lɛ hu minu; ni mikpeleke shi miba amɛ jiemɔ; no hewɔ lɛ, ba ni matsu bo Ijipt.’ “Nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ nɔŋŋ ni amɛkwa lɛ amɛkɛɛ, ‘Namɔ wo bo wɔnɔ lumɔ kɛ kojolɔ’ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ koo lɛ mli lɛ nine nɔ etsu lɛ akɛ lumɔ kɛ kpɔlɔ.
Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpala amɛ kɛje kpo, ni efee naakpɛɛnii kɛ okadii yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli kɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ.
Lɛ ji nakai Mose lɛ ni kɛɛ Israelbii lɛ akɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, nyɛNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatee gbalɔ ko ni tamɔ mi shi kɛaajɛ nyɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ ahã nyɛ’ lɛ.
Mose ji mɔ ni kɛ asafo lɛ hi ŋa lɛ nɔ, ni edamɔ bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ wie yɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ, ni ehe wala wiemɔi lɛ ni ekɛbahã wɔ lɛ.
“Shi wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ ni amɛbo lɛ toi, ni amɛtsi lɛ amɛto afã, ni amɛtsui kpale kɛtee Ijipt ekoŋŋ; ni amɛkɛɛ Aaron akɛ, ‘Feemɔ nyɔŋmɔi ohã wɔ ni amɛnyiɛ wɔhiɛ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ Mose nɛɛ ni kpala wɔ kɛjɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔleee nɔ ni efee lɛ.’ Nakai be lɛ mli amɛfee tsinabi amãgã, ni amɛshã afɔle amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛna amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe tsuijurɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsi ehe kɛjɛ amɛhe ni eŋmɛɛ amɛhe akɛ amɛja ŋwɛinii, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ gbalɔi lɛ awolo lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Nyɛ Israel we, ani nyɛshã kooloi afɔle kɛ niyenii afɔle nyɛhã mi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
Dabida, Molok buu lɛ moŋ nyɛwo nyɛtere kɛ nyɛnyɔŋmɔ Refan lɛ ŋulami lɛ ni ji amãgãi ni nyɛshɔ ni nyɛja amɛ lɛ.
Shi Babilon sɛɛ maloo nyɛ kɛaatee.’ “Wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛ Odase Buu lɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Afee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ni kɛ Mose wie lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ efee lɛ lɛ, no ji efee lɛ tamɔ nɔ ni ena lɛ.
Buu nɛɛ, be ni wɔtsɛmɛi ni ba yɛ sɛɛ lɛ hu anine shɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ Yoshua hiɛ kɛba jeŋmaji ni Nyɔŋmɔ shwie amɛ yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni ehi shi kɛbashi David yinɔ.
David nɛɛ hiɛ ba nyam yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni ekpa fai ni ahã emã shihilɛhe ko eha Yakob Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi Solomon ji mɔ ni mã tsu ehã lɛ.
“Tsɛbelɛ Ŋwɛinyo lɛ ehiii tsui ni akɛ niji fee amli, tamɔ bɔ ni gbalɔ lɛ hu kɛɛ lɛ, ‘Ŋwɛi lɛ, misɛ̃i ni,’ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘ni shikpɔŋ lɛ, minaneshi maaŋoo ni.
Mɛɛ tsu nyɛaama nyɛhã mi mɔ, Asaŋ nɛgbɛ ji mihejɔɔmɔhe lɛ?
Aso jeee minine fee enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ?’ “Nyɛ kuɛŋtilɔi kɛ tsuiiaŋ kɛ toiiaŋ foolɔi!
Nyɛ lɛ, daa nɛɛ nyɛkuɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ naa; bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfeɔ.
Gbalɔi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ waaa lɛ yi?
Amɛgbe mɛi ni gba yɛ jalɔ lɛ baa lɛ he amɛto lɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ nyɛ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ ni nyɛgbe lɛ, nyɛ ni nyɛna Mla lɛ kɛtsɔ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ, ni nyɛyeee nɔ lɛ.” Stefano gbele Shi be ni amɛnu nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, etsurɔ amɛtsuiiaŋ, ni amɛkpe amɛnyanyɔji ashishi kɛ mlifu.
Shi Stefano ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ kwɛ ŋwɛi gãa, ni ena Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ Yesu ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Naa, miina ŋwɛi naa ni egbele, kɛ Gbɔmɔ Bi lɛ ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Shi amɛbolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa, ni amɛtsimɔ amɛtoii, ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ke kɛbashwie enɔ, ni amɛtsirɛ eyi sɛɛ kɛje maŋ lɛ mli, ni amɛyatswia lɛ tɛi.
Ni odasefoi lɛ kɛ amɛmamai lɛ shwie oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul lɛ najianaa.
Ni be ni amɛtswiaa Stefano tɛi lɛ, ebo etsɛ Yesu ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, heremɔ mimumɔ lɛ!” Ni ekula shi, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, kaawo amɛ nɛkɛ esha nɛɛ he nyɔmɔ!” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ.
Saul wa Asafo lɛ yi Shi gbe ni agbe Stefano lɛ ŋɔɔ Saul hu naa.
Ni nakai gbi lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ yiwaa kpele te shi wo asafo ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛgbɛ amɛshwã Yudea kɛ Samaria shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; bɔfoi lɛ kɛkɛ shwɛ.
Hii Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi komɛi yato Stefano, ni amɛfo lɛ pam.
Shi Saul bɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã asafo lɛ hiɛ, ni ejɛɔ shĩa kɛyaa shĩa ni eyagbalaa hii kɛ yei ni eyawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ.
Ashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ Samaria Kɛkɛ ni mɛi ni egbɛ eshwã lɛ yakpa shi, ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ.
Ni Filipo tee Samaria maŋ ko nɔ, ni eyashiɛ Kristo he sane etsɔ̃ɔ jɛi bii lɛ.
Ni mɛi babaoo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome bo wiemɔi ni Filipo wieɔ lɛ toi be ni amɛnu ni amɛna okadii ni efee lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amumɔi lɛ bolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ni amɛje amɛmli, ni atsa mɛi ni ekumɔ kɛ obubuafoi pii hu.
Ni miishɛɛ babaoo ba nakai maŋ lɛ mli.
Simon ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ Shi nuu ko yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momosa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon ni eyeɔ ŋkunyaa ni ehãa Samariabii lɛ anaa kpɛɔ amɛhe, etsɔ̃ɔ ehe akɛ gbɔmɔ agbo ji lɛ; ni mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ boɔ lɛ toi amɛkɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ nɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Hewalɛ Kpeteŋkple lɛ.” Ni akɛni ejɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe ekɛ ekunyaayeli lɛ ehã amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛboɔ lɛ toi.
Shi be ni amɛhe Filipo ni jaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ amɛye lɛ, abaptisi hii kɛ yei fɛɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Simon diɛŋtsɛ hu he ye, ni abaptisi lɛ, ni ekɛ ehe kpɛtɛ Filipo, ni be ni ena okadii ni afee kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi wuji ni atsu lɛ, enaa kpɛ ehe.
Be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ nu akɛ Samariabii emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, amɛtsu Petro kɛ Yohane kɛtee amɛŋɔɔ.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ amɛkpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai amɛhã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ ebako amɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko nɔ, shi baptisimɔ kɛkɛ abaptisi amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmɛ̃lɛ amɛnɔ, ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.
Shi be ni Simon na akɛ bɔfoi lɛ aniji kɛ mɛi anɔ ŋmɛ̃lɛmɔ lɛ hãa anaa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, ekɛ shika ba ebahã amɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa mi hu nɛkɛ hewalɛ nɛɛ koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni mikɛ miniji aaaŋmɛ̃ enɔ lɛ ana Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Shi Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ oshika lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akpãtã, ejaakɛ osusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ shika akɛheɔ!
Obɛ gbɛnaa loo gbɛfaŋ nɔ ko yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli; ejaakɛ otsui ejaaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ shwa ohe yɛ onɔsha nɛɛ hewɔ, ni okpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, akɛ aleenɔ akɛ otsuiŋ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ aaafa bo lo.
Ejaakɛ mina akɛ hiɛkɔ̃ɔ eyi bo obɔ̃ tamɔ kɔlikɔ joomɔ ni nɔ̃ sha kpãa lɛ mli oyɔɔ nɛɛ.” Ni Simon here nɔ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkpaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai nyɛhãa mi koni nibii ni nyɛwie nɛɛ eko akaba minɔ.” Agbɛnɛ, be ni amɛye odase ni amɛshiɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛmiiba Yerusalɛm lɛ, amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Samariabii akrowai pii amli.
Filipo kɛ Etiopia piafonyo lɛ Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko kɛ Filipo bawie akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya wuoyigbɛ yɛ tɛmpɔŋ ni kã shiaŋa lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm kɛyaa Gaza lɛ nɔ.” Ni ete shi ni eyiŋ etee.
Ni naa, Etiopiabii amaŋnyɛ Kandake lɛ piafonyo ni ji esɔ̃ɔlɔnukpa ni kwɛɔ ejwetri fɛɛ nɔ lɛ nɛ; ebaho Yerusalɛm eyaja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni agbɛnɛ eku esɛɛ eta eshwiili mli kɛmiiya ni eekane gbalɔ Yesaia wolo lɛ.
Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ Filipo akɛ, “Yaa ni okɛ ohe ayakpɛtɛ shwiili lɛ he.” Shi be ni Filipo wo foi kɛtee lɛ, enu akɛ eekane Yesaia wolo lɛ, ni ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ani oonu nɔ ni okaneɔ lɛ shishi lo?
Ni ekɛɛ, “Te mafee tɛŋŋ ni manyɛ manu shishiŋ, akɛ ja mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ mi dã?” Kɛkɛ ni ekpa Filipo fai akɛ eba ni ekɛ lɛ abata shi.
Shi ŋmalɛ lɛ he ni ekaneɔ lɛ nɛ, “Akpala lɛ kɛtee tamɔ too gwantɛŋ ni ayaagbe lɛ, ni bɔ ni too gwantɛŋbi feɔ dioo yɛ ehetsɔikulɔ hiɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ etswaaa esɛŋ.
Be ni aba lɛ shi lɛ akojooo lɛ jalɛ naa; shi eshwiei lɛ, namɔ aaagba amɛhe sane?
Ejaakɛ afo ewala sɛɛ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni piafonyo lɛ bi Filipo akɛ, “Miikpa bo fai, namɔ he gbalɔ lɛ wieɔ nɛɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ loo mɔ kroko?” Ni Filipo gbele enaa ni eje shishi kɛjɛ ŋmalɛ nɛɛ nɔ, ni ejaje Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, amɛbashɛ nu ko he, ni piafonyo lɛ kɛɛ, “Naa nu; mɛni tsiɔ mibaptisimɔ gbɛ?” [ Shi Filipo kɛɛ, “Kɛji ohe oye kɛ otsuiŋ fɛɛ lɛ, oyɛ hegbɛ.” Ni ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Miihe miiye akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.”] Ni efã akɛ shwiili lɛ awa, ni Filipo kɛ piafonyo lɛ fɛɛ yimɔ shi kɛtee nu lɛ mli, ni ebaptisi lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛje nu lɛ mli lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ sha Filipo kɛtee; ni piafonyo lɛ enaaa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi eyi gbɛ kɛ nyamɔ.
Shi Filipo lɛ, ana lɛ yɛ Azotu; ni be ni efoɔ mli lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ mli kɛyashi ebashɛ Kaisarea.
Saul tsuitsakemɔ Shi Saul kã he ekɛ gbele miiwo Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kaselɔi lɛ ahe gbeyei lolo, ni eyiŋ kɛtee osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ni eyabi lɛ woji ni ekɛya Damasko kpeehei lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena mɛi komɛi ni hiɛ nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ mli lɛ, hii jio, yei jio, ni efimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm.
Shi be ni enyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni eebɛŋkɛ Damasko lɛ, trukaa lɛ la kpɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi kɛbabɔle lɛ, ni eflɛo egbee shi, ni enu gbee ko ni miikɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Mi Yesu, mɔ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ.
Ewa hã bo akɛ ooofã ntia oshi kooloi akpalamɔtso lɛ naa dade lɛ.” Ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ ŋmiŋmi kɛɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, mɛni otaoɔ akɛ mifee?” Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya maŋ lɛ mli, ni aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nɔ ni sa akɛ ofee.” Shi hii ni kɛ lɛ nyiɛ lɛ etɔ mu kɛdamɔ shi, amɛmiinu gbee lɛ moŋ, shi amɛnaaa mɔ ko mɔ ko.
Ni Saul te shi; shi be ni egbele ehiŋmɛii lɛ, enaaa nii; ni amɛmɔ enine mli, ni amɛkɛ lɛ tee Damasko.
Ni enaaa nii, ni asaŋ eyeee nii ni enuuu nɔ ko hu gbii etɛ̃.
Shi kaselɔ ko yɛ Damasko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Anania!” Ni ekɛɛ, “Naa mi, Nuŋtsɔ.” Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi ni oya blohu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Trɔmɔɔ lɛ mli, ni oyabi mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Saul ni jɛ Tarso lɛ shi yɛ Yuda we lɛ; ejaakɛ naa, eesɔle, ni Saul na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania lɛ miiba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛ enine miiŋmɛ enɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ena nii ekoŋŋ.” Shi Anania here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, minu nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ he sane yɛ mɛi pii anaa, akɛ efee omɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ efɔŋ babaoo; ni biɛ hu tete ena hegbɛ kɛjɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ akɛ ebafimɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsɛɔ ogbɛi lɛ.” Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Yaa, ejaakɛ mɔ nɛ ji midɛŋ dade ni mihala mihã mihe koni ehiɛ migbɛi lɛ kɛya jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ Israelbii lɛ hu ahiɛ.
Mibatsɔ̃ɔ lɛ amanehului abɔ ni sa akɛ ena yɛ migbɛi lɛ hewɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Anania yiŋ etee ni eyabote shĩa lɛ, ni ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmi Saul!
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu, mɔ ni jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ bo be ni obaa yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, etsu mi oŋɔɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ona nii ekoŋŋ ni oyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ.” Ni amrɔ lɛ nibii komɛi jɛ ehiŋmɛii anɔ shwie shi tamɔ loototoi, ni ena nii, ni ete shi ni abaptisi lɛ; ni eye nii, ni ehe wa lɛ.
Saul shiɛmɔ yɛ Damasko Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ eshiɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni nu lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani jeee mɔ nɛ kpãtã mɛi ni tsɛɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, ni jeee no hewɔ nɔŋŋ eba biɛ hu tete koni ebafimɔ amɛ ni ekpala amɛ kɛya osɔfonukpai lɛ aŋɔɔ?” Shi Saul lɛ, ena hewalɛ babaoo, ni ehã Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ anaa tã, ejaakɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ mɔ nɛ ji Kristo lɛ.
Saul je Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ Shi gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ to eyi nɔ apam akɛ amɛaagbe lɛ.
Ni Saul banu amɛkpãŋmɔ lɛ he.
Shi amɛbuɔ maŋ agboi lɛ anaa daa shwane kɛ nyɔɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi ekaselɔi lɛ kɛ lɛ wo kafu mli nyɔɔŋ, ni amɛshiu lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ gbogbo lɛ nɔ kɛyayi shi.
Saul yɛ Yerusalɛm Ni be ni Saul ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, eka kaselɔi lɛ ahe kpɛtɛmɔ, shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛmiishe lɛ gbeyei, amɛheee amɛyeee akɛ kaselɔ ji lɛ.
Shi Barnaba ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee bɔfoi lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni eyagba amɛ bɔ ni ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni ekɛ lɛ wie, kɛ bɔ ni efee ekãa yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli yɛ Damasko.
Ni ekɛ amɛ yaa baa yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni eshiɛ kɛ ekãa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ mli.
Ni ekɛ Helenibii lɛ wie ni ekɛ amɛ taa naa; shi amɛka lɛ gbee.
Be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ nu he lɛ amɛkɛ lɛ tee Kaisarea, ni amɛwo lɛ gbɛ kɛtee Tarso.
Agbɛnɛ asafo lɛ na hejɔlɛ yɛ Yudea kɛ Galilea kɛ Samaria fɛɛ, ni enane mɔ shi, ni enyiɛɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ mli, ni ekɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ miishɛjemɔ lɛ shwereɔ.
Petro tsa Ainea yɛ Lida Shi eba mli akɛ, be ni Petro eyakpa hei lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, eba mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Lida lɛ hu aŋɔɔ.
Ni ebana nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Ainea ni ekɛ kuumɔhela ekã saa nɔ afii kpaanyɔ sɔŋŋ.
Ni Petro kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo miitsa bo; tee shi ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oŋmɛ osaa lɛ!” Ni amrɔ lɛ ete shi.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Lida kɛ Sharon lɛ na lɛ, ni amɛtsake ni amɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Petro tee Dorka shi yɛ Yopa Shi yoo kaselɔ ko yɛ Yopa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tabita, eshishi ji Dorka.
Nitsumɔi kpakpai kɛ ejurɔfeemɔ eyi yoo nɛɛ obɔ̃.
Shi eba mli akɛ nakai bei lɛ amli lɛ, ehe baye ni egbo.
Ni amɛju ehe ni amɛkɛ lɛ yaŋmɛ ŋwɛitsu ko mli.
Lida kɛ Yopa jɛkɛɛɛ kwraa, ni be ni kaselɔi lɛ nu akɛ Petro yɛ Lida lɛ, amɛtsu hii enyɔ kɛtee eŋɔɔ amɛyakpa lɛ fai akɛ ekashashao shi, shi eba amɛŋɔɔ oya.
Ni Petro te shi ni ekɛ amɛ tee.
Ni be ni eshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛ tee ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli, ni yei okulafoi lɛ fɛɛ badamɔdamɔɔ emasɛi amɛmiifofoi, ni amɛkɛ flakai kɛ atadei ni Dorka fee be ni ekɛ amɛ yɔɔ lolo lɛ miitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Ni Petro shwie amɛ fɛɛ kɛje kpo, ni ekula shi esɔle, ni etsɔ̃ ehiɛ ehã gbonyo lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Tabita, tee shi!” Ni egbele ehiŋmɛii, ni be ni ena Petro lɛ, ete shi eta shi.
Ni Petro mɔ enine mli, ni ewo enɔ; ni etsɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ kɛ okulafoi lɛ kɛba, ni ekɛ lɛ damɔ amɛhiɛ hiɛkãalɔ.
Ni anu he yɛ Yopa fɛɛ, ni mɛi pii he Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ amɛye.
Ni Petro hi Yopa gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ wolokpoolɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Simon lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Kornelio Shi nuu ko yɛ Kaisarea ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kornelio ni ji asraafoiohaatsɛ yɛ asraafoi akuu ni atsɛɔ lɛ Italia kuu lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ni, ni ekɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, ni efeɔ maŋbii lɛ ejurɔ pii, ni ekpaa Nyɔŋmɔ fai daa.
Aaafee gbɛkɛ ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli lɛ, ena yɛ ninaa mli faŋŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo ko ba eŋɔɔ bakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kornelio!” Ni ekwɛ lɛ gãa ni eshe gbeyei ni ekɛɛ; “Mɛni, Nuŋtsɔ?” Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Osɔlemɔi kɛ onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ eshɛ ŋwɛi ni efee kaimɔnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ tsu mɛi kɛya Yopa ni ayakpee Simon mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba; eyato Simon, wolokpoolɔ ko ni shĩa yɔɔ ŋshɔ lɛ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ.” Be ni bɔfo ni kɛ lɛ bawie lɛ etee lɛ, etsɛ ewebii lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ kɛ asraafonyo ko ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni ji mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome, ni egba amɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ, ni etsu amɛ Yopa.
Petro na ninaa ko Enɔ jetsɛremɔ, be ni amɛnyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni amɛbɛŋkɛ maŋ lɛ, Petro tee sɔlemɔ yɛ tsu yiteŋ aaafee shwane ŋmɛlɛ nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ mli.
Ni hɔmɔ ye lɛ naakpa, ni eetao nɔ ko eye.
Shi be ni afeɔ niyenii lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ enyɔ enɔ, ni ena akɛ ŋwɛi egbele, ni nɔ ko miikpeleke shi ni tamɔ mama kpeteŋkple, ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shikpɔŋ; ni shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛ kɛ waamɔnii kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji srɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ eko yɛ mli.
Ni gbee ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye.” Shi Petro kɛɛ, “Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ miyeko nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ loo nɔ ko ni he tseee dã.” Ni gbee lɛ saa kɛɛ lɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, “Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ akɛ bulemɔnɔ.” Shi afee nakai shii etɛ̃; ni awo nɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.
Be ni Petro efee yaa akɛ te nii ni ena nɛɛ shishiŋ lɛ, hii lɛ ni Kornelio tsu lɛ miibibii Simon we lɛ gbɛ; ni amɛbadamɔ agbo lɛ naa amɛtsɛ ni amɛbi akɛ, “Ani biɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ bato lɛ?” Shi be ni Petro jwɛŋɔ ninaa lɛ he lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Naa, hii etɛ̃ komɛi miitao bo; no hewɔ lɛ, tee shi ni okpeleke shi okɛ amɛ aya, ni okaje ŋwane ko, ejaakɛ mi mitsu amɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Petro kpeleke shi, ni eyakɛɛ hii lɛ akɛ, “Naa, mi ji mɔ ni nyɛtaoɔ lɛ; mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛba?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Asraafoiohaatsɛ Kornelio, ni ji nuu jalɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔ ni Yudafoi amaŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ ehe odase lɛ, lɛ ŋwɛi bɔfo krɔŋkrɔŋ ko kɛɛ lɛ akɛ etsu ni abakpee bo kɛba ewe lɛ, koni ebo onaa toi.” Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ amɛ kɛba shĩa lɛ ni ebafee amɛ gbɔ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ ekɛ amɛ yiŋ kɛtee ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yopa lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi fata ehe kɛtee.
Petro yɛ Kornelio we lɛ Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ amɛyashɛ Kaisarea.
Shi Kornelio miikwɛ amɛ gbɛ, ni etsɛ ewekumɛi kɛ enanemɛi juji kɛkpe.
Ni be ni Petro boteɔ shĩa lɛ, Kornelio kɛ lɛ bakpe, ni eho egbee enaji anaa ni eja lɛ.
Shi Petro wo enɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi, shi mi diɛŋtsɛ hu gbɔmɔ ji mi.” Ni ekɛ lɛ hiɛ sanegbaa kɛbote shĩa lɛ, ni eyana mɛi pii ni ebabua amɛhe naa lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle bɔ ni Yudanyo bɛ hegbɛ akɛ ekɛ mɔ ko ni ji maŋ kroko nɔ nyo bɔɔ aloo ebaa eŋɔɔ; shi mi lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mi akɛ mikatsɛ mɔ ko mɔ ni he tseee loo mɔ ni buleɔ mɔ.
No hewɔ hu ni be ni atsu abatsɛ mi lɛ, mijieee naa ni miba nɛɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ miibi nyɛ, ‘Mɛɛ sane hewɔ nyɛbakpee mi nɛɛ?’ ” Ni Kornelio kɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ ji gbii ejwɛ aaafee ŋmɛji etɛ̃ mli nɛkɛ pɛ, miisɔle yɛ mishĩa nɛɛ; ni naa, nuu ko ni wo atade kaŋkaŋ badamɔ mihiɛ, ni ekɛɛ, ‘Kornelio, abo osɔlemɔ lɛ toi, ni onijuji ni ofeɔ lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ena.
No hewɔ lɛ, tsu kɛya Yopa, ni ayatsɛ Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba; eyato Simon wolokpoolɔ lɛ ni shĩa kã ŋshɔ naa lɛ ŋɔɔ.’ Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mitsu oŋɔɔ, ni ofee jogbaŋŋ akɛ oba.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ koni wɔbo nibii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã bo akɛ okɛɛ lɛ toi.” Petro shiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Kornelio kɛ eshĩabii lɛ Kɛkɛ ni Petro gbele enaa ni ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, miyoo akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɛiahĩɛiaŋkwɛlɔ; Shi moŋ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli lɛ, mɔ ni sheɔ lɛ gbeyei ni etsuɔ jalɛnii lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni saa ehiɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsu akɛ wiemɔ lɛ yahã Israelbii ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ejaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Yesu nɛɛ ji mɛi fɛɛ aNuŋtsɔ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle sane lɛ ni ba Yudea ni eje shishi kɛjɛ Galilea, yɛ baptisimɔ ni Yohane shiɛ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hewalɛ fɔ Yesu ni jɛ Nazaret lɛ mu, ni ekpaa shi efeɔ ekpakpa ni etsaa mɛi fɛɛ ni abonsam haoɔ amɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ lɛ yɛ.
Ni wɔji nibii fɛɛ ni efee yɛ Yudafoi ashikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ he odasefoi.
Amɛsɛŋ lɛ yɛ tso nɔ ni amɛgbe lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, ni ehã ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ; jeee mɛi lɛ fɛɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, shi moŋ odasefoi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehala eto momo lɛ, ni ji wɔ mɛi ni wɔkɛ lɛ ye nii ni wɔkɛ lɛ nu, be ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ.
Ni ewo wɔ kitã akɛ wɔshiɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ ni wɔye odase akɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ efã akɛ hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ehe odase gbalɔi lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ, akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ aaana ehe eshai faa yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.” Jeŋmajiaŋbii ni asɔle klɛŋklɛŋ Be ni Petro wieɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ lolo lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ba mɛi fɛɛ ni nu wiemɔ lɛ anɔ.
Ni heyelɔi abɔ ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ ni kɛ Petro ba lɛ anaa kpɛ amɛhe akɛ afɔse Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɔkeenɔ lɛ ashwie jeŋmajiaŋbii hu anɔ, ejaakɛ amɛnu akɛ amɛmiiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni amɛmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ agbojee lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Petro here nɔ akɛ, “Ani mɔ ko aaanyɛ nu naa atsi, ni akabaptisi mɛnɛɛmɛi ni na Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ wɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ?” Ni efã akɛ abaptisi amɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ mli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ ekɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii fioo ko.
Petro yabɔ Yerusalɛm asafo lɛ amaniɛ Agbɛnɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ fɛɛ nu akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu emɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli.
Ni be ni Petro ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi ateŋ lɛ kɛ lɛ ná amɛkɛɛ, “Otee hii foolɔi aŋɔɔ ni okɛ amɛ yaye nii.” Shi Petro je shishi ni egba amɛ nibii lɛ fɛɛ ekomekome ekɛɛ, “Miyɛ Yopa maŋ lɛ mli miisɔle, ni efee tamɔ nɔ ni nɔ enyɔ minɔ, ni mina ninaa ko akɛ nɔ ko jɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ mama kpele ni ahiɛ ekoji ejwɛ lɛ mli aashi kɛmiiba shi, ni eba miŋɔɔ kpaakpa.
Ni be ni mitɛ̃je mihiɛ ni mikwɛ mli lɛ, mina shikpɔŋ nɔ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi kɛ ŋaŋ kooloi kɛ kooloi ni wamɔɔ kɛ ŋwɛi loofɔji yɛ mli.
Ni minu gbee ko hu kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Petro, tee shi, gbee ni oye!’ Shi mikɛɛ, ‘Dabida, Nuŋtsɔ, ejaakɛ nɔ ko ni buleɔ mɔ aloo nɔ ko ni he tseee eyako midaaŋ dã.’ Shi gbee ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ here mi nɔ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, ‘Nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsuu he lɛ, kaabu lɛ nɔ ni he tseee.’ Afee nakai shii etɛ̃, ni agbala fɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ekoŋŋ.
Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hii etɛ̃ badamɔ shĩa he ni miyɔɔ lɛ agbo lɛ naa ní atsu amɛ kɛjɛ Kaisarea kɛba miŋɔɔ.
Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ mikɛ amɛ aya, ni mikashashao shi kwraa; ni nyɛmimɛi ekpaa hu kɛ mi tee, ni wɔyabote nuu lɛ we lɛ.
Ni egba wɔ bɔ ni ena bɔfo lɛ yɛ ewe lɛ ni edamɔ shi eekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Tsu kɛya Yopa ni oyakpee Simon ni atsɛɔ lɛ Petro hu lɛ kɛba, ni eeebakɛɛ bo wiemɔi ni aaatsɔ̃ nɔ ahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala.’ Shi be ni mibɔ̃i wiemɔ lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ bayi amɛnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eyi wɔ hu wɔnɔ tsutsu lɛ.
Ni mikai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Yohane lɛ ekɛ nu baptisi, shi nyɛ lɛ akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ aaabaptisi nyɛ lɛ.’ Agbɛnɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ nakai nɔkeenɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ni ehã wɔ ni wɔheɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ hu lɛ, namɔ ji mi ni manyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naa matsi?” Shi be ni amɛnu wiemɔi nɛɛ lɛ, amɛmua amɛnaa, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam moŋ amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ jeŋmaji lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni akɛhere amɛyiwala!” Antiokia Asafo lɛ Mɛi ni gbɛ shwa yɛ Stefano amanehulu lɛ mli lɛ fo mli kɛtee Foinikia kɛ Kipro kɛ Antiokia tɔ̃ɔ, shi amɛjajeee wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ ja Yudafoi lɛ kɛkɛ.
Shi amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi lɛ, Kiprobii kɛ Kirenebii ji amɛ, ni amɛba Antiokia amɛbawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ Helabii lɛ hu, ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewalɛ fata amɛhe, ni mɛi babaoo he ye, ni amɛkpale kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Ni amɛhe sane lɛ bashɛ Yerusalɛm asafo lɛ toiŋ, ni amɛtsu Barnaba kɛtee Antiokia.
Ni be ni ebashɛ jɛi ni ebana Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ, emii shɛ ehe, ni ewo amɛ fɛɛ ekãa akɛ amɛkɛ tsui ni fiɔ shi akpɛtɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he.
Gbɔmɔ kpakpa ji Barnaba ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli.
Ni ana mɛi babaoo afata Nuŋtsɔ lɛ asafo lɛ he.
Ni Barnaba yiŋ etee Tarso ni eyatao Saul, ni be ni ena lɛ lɛ, ekɛ lɛ ba Antiokia.
Ni eba mli akɛ amɛkɛ asafo lɛ hi shi afi naakplɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi babaoo anii, ni Antiokia klɛŋklɛŋ awo kaselɔi lɛ agbɛi yɛ akɛ Kristofoi.
Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ amli lɛ, gbalɔi komɛi jɛ Yerusalɛm ba Antiokia.
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Agabo lɛ te shi damɔ shi, ni etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa akɛ hɔmɔ waa baaba jeŋ fɛɛ, ni eba mli nakai yɛ Kaisare Klaudio yinɔ.
Shi kaselɔi lɛ kpɛ mli akɛ amɛaabua nɔ ko naa amɛkɛyahã nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaanyɛ.
Ni amɛfee nakai, ni amɛkɛmaje onukpai lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Barnaba kɛ Saul nine nɔ.
Agbe Yakobo ni awo Petro tsuŋ Nakai bei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ lɛ, maŋtsɛ Herode kpã enine mli eta Kristo asafo lɛ he koni efee asafo lɛ mli bii lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi efɔŋ.
Ni ekɛ klante gbe Yohane nyɛmi Yakobo.
Ni be ni ena akɛ eŋɔɔ Yudafoi lɛ anaa lɛ, etee nɔ ni emɔ Petro hu.
Shi akpiti Gbii lɛ amli ni.
Ni be ni emɔ lɛ lɛ, ewo lɛ tsuŋ, ni etu lɛ ewo asraafoi akui ejwɛ ni mɛi ejwɛɛjwɛ yɔɔ mli dɛŋ ni amɛbu ehe; ni esusu akɛ Hehoo lɛ sɛɛ lɛ eeejie lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ lɛ.
Be mli ni atsi Petro naa yɛ tsu lɛ mli fɛɛ lɛ, asafo lɛ hiɛ sɔlemɔ mli kɛ lɛ hãmɔ waa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Bɔfo ko jie Petro Shi gbi ni Herode taoɔ akɛ ekɛ Petro aba maŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ, ekã asraafoi enyɔ teŋ eewɔ, ni awo lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ, ni bulɔi hu damɔ shinaa lɛ naa amɛmiibu tsu lɛ he.
Ni naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo ko badamɔ emasɛi, ni la kpɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli ni egba Petro ŋmawu ma ni etsiɛ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Tee shi mramra!” Ni ekɔsɔŋkɔsɔi lɛ kpɔlɔ yɛ eniji.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Miamɔ ni owo otokotai lɛ!” Ni efee nakai.
Ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ obo lɛ akete ohe ni onyiɛ misɛɛ.” Ni enyiɛ esɛɛ kɛje kpo, ni eleee akɛ nɔ ni bɔfo lɛ feɔ lɛ yɛ mli, shi efeɔ lɛ akɛ nii enaa.
Shi be ni amɛho klɛŋklɛŋ bulɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni ji enyɔ lɛ ahe lɛ, amɛshɛ dade agbo ni kã kɛyaa maŋ lɛ mli lɛ he, ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbele ehe ehã amɛ, ni amɛje kpo ni amɛfo blohu kome mli, ni amrɔ lɛ bɔfo lɛ shi lɛ.
Ni be ni Petro hiɛ tserɛ lɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Kpaako mina mile krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsu ebɔfo lɛ kɛba, ni ebajie mi yɛ Herode dɛŋ kɛ nɔ ni Yudafoi lɛ amaŋ lɛ kwɛɔ gbɛ lɛ fɛɛ mli.” Ni be ni eyɔse enɛ lɛ, eba Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ nyɛ Maria we lɛ, he ni mɛi pii anaa ebakpe shi ni amɛsɔleɔ yɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni Petro shi agbo lɛ, oblayoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Roda lɛ ba toiboo; ni be ni eyoo Petro gbee lɛ, miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ naa lɛ egbeleee agbo lɛ, shi moŋ ejo foi kɛtee tsu lɛ mli eyakɛɛ akɛ Petro damɔ agbo lɛ sɛɛ.
Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Oye sɛkɛ!” Shi ema nɔ mi akɛ eyɛ mli nakai.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛkɛɛ, “Belɛ ebɔfo ni.” Shi Petro kã he eeshi; ni be ni amɛgbele lɛ, amɛna lɛ, ni amɛnaa kpɛ amɛhe.
Shi efɔ̃ amɛ nine akɛ amɛfee dioo, ni egba amɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fee ni ejie lɛ yɛ tsu lɛ mli lɛ; ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyagbaa Yakobo kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ.” Ni eje jɛi etee he kroko.
Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, yoyoromɔ ni asraafoi lɛ yoyoro yɛ le ni amɛleee nɔ ni eba Petro nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, jeee hiɛ nɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni Herode taoɔ lɛ ni enaaa lɛ lɛ, ekojo bulɔi lɛ ni efã akɛ ayagbe amɛ.
Ni Herode je Yudea etee Kaisarea ni eyahi jɛi.
Herode gbele Shi Herode mli efu Tirobii kɛ Sidonbii lɛ naakpa; no hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ba eŋɔɔ, ni amɛbatao maŋtsɛ lɛ piafonyo ni gbɛi ji Blasto lɛ hiɛgbɛ ni amɛyakpa hejɔlɛ he fai, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛnaa amɛniyenii kɛjɛɔ.
Gbi ni ato ko nɔ lɛ Herode wo emaŋtsɛ atade lɛ ni eyata kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ maŋ lɛ wie.
Ni mɛi lɛ bolɔ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ gbee nɛ, shi jeee gbɔmɔ gbee ni.” Ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ bɔfo tswa lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ekɛ anunyam lɛ hãaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni gɔgɔmii ye lɛ, ni egbo.
Agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni egbɛ eshwã eshwere.
Be ni Barnaba kɛ Saul egbe amɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ Yerusalɛm ni amɛŋɔ Yohane, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko hu lɛ, amɛfata amɛhe.
Atu shiɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ awo Barnaba kɛ Saul dɛŋ Shi gbalɔi kɛ tsɔɔlɔi komɛi yɛ Antiokia asafo lɛ mli, amɛ ji Barnaba kɛ Simeon, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Niger hu lɛ, kɛ Lukio, Kirenenyo lɛ, kɛ Manahen, mɔ ni alɛ lɛ kɛ lumɔ Herode lɛ kɛ Saul.
Shi be ni amɛjaa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni amɛhiɔ ŋmaa lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea Barnaba kɛ Saul nyɛhãa mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni mitsɛ amɛ yɛ hewɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni amɛhi ŋmaa ni amɛsɔle, ni amɛkɛ amɛniji ŋmɛ̃lɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛwo amɛ gbɛ.
Bɔfoi lɛ shiɛ yɛ Kipro Akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsu Saul kɛ Barnaba akɛ amɛya lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee Seleukia, ni amɛkɛ lɛlɛ jɛ jɛi kɛtee Kipro.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Salami lɛ, amɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ Yudafoi lɛ akpeehei lɛ.
Amɛkɛ Yohane hu nyiɛ akɛ amɛsɔ̃ɔlɔ.
Ni be ni amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ ŋshɔkpɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ kɛtee Pafo lɛ, amɛna Yudanyo ŋkunyaayelɔ ko ni ji amale gbalɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Bar-Yesu lɛ; ekɛ amralo Sergio Paulo ni ji nuu nilelɔ lɛ yɔɔ.
Amralo nɛɛ tsɛ Barnaba kɛ Saul kɛba eŋɔɔ, eetao akɛ enu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ.
Shi Elima ŋkunyaayelɔ lɛ (egbɛi lɛ shishi yɛ Hela wiemɔ mli ji no) ku amɛnaa, ejaakɛ eetao ni ekpale amralo lɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he.
Shi Saul, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Paulo hu, ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eyi lɛ obɔ̃ lɛ, kwɛ Elima gãa ni ekɛɛ, “Ao, bo abonsam bi ni shishiumɔ kɛ kutumpɔo fɛɛ eyi bo obɔ̃, bo jalɛ fɛɛ henyɛlɔ, aso ofɔŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi trɔmɔi lɛ akɔdɔmɔ̃?
Naa, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nine kã onɔ, ni oooshwila ni onaŋ hulu kɛyaashi be ko.” Ni amrɔ̃ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ afua kɛ duŋ baha enɔ, ni egbugbuu shi eetao mɔ ko amɔ enine mli ayajie lɛ gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ, be ni amralo lɛ na nɔ ni afee lɛ, ehe eye, ni ehe jɔ̃ ehe yɛ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ hewɔ.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba yɛ Antiokia Shi be ni Paulo kɛ emɛi lɛ fã kɛjɛ Pafo lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛlɛ ba Perga yɛ Pamfilia; ni Yohane shi amɛ, ni eku esɛɛ kɛtee Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛfo mli kɛjɛ Perga kɛtee Antiokia ni yɔɔ Pisidia lɛ, ni amɛtee kpeehe lɛ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyatara shi.
Ni be ni akane Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, kpeehe lɛ onukpai lɛ tsu abakɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji nyɛyɛ hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ko kɛhã mɛi lɛ, nyɛkɛ amɛ awiea.” Kɛkɛ ni Paulo te shi edamɔ shi, ni efɔ̃ enine ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelhii kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei, nyɛboa toi!
Nɛkɛ maŋ Israel nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hala wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ, ni be ni amɛyato gbɔ yɛ Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ewo maŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekɛ hewalɛ jie amɛ kɛjɛ jɛi.
Ni ekɛ tsuishitoo hiɛ amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ aaafee afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ, ni ekpãtã jeŋmaji kpawo ahiɛ yɛ Kanaan shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni eja amɛshikpɔŋ lɛ ehã amɛ akɛ amɛnɔ.
Enɛ fɛɛ ye aaafee afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
“Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ ehã amɛ kojolɔi kɛbashi gbalɔ Samuel nɔ.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ amɛbi maŋtsɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kish bi Saul, nuu ko ni jɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli, hã amɛ afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Ni be ni ekpa lɛ lɛ, etee David shi ni ewo lɛ amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ, ni eye ehe odase ekɛɛ, ‘Mina David, Ishai bi lɛ, nuu ni miyɔɔ ehe tsui ni eeefee misuɔmɔnaanii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.’ Mɔ nɛ shwie mli Nyɔŋmɔ jie Yesu kɛjɛ yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa ehã Israel akɛ yiwalaherelɔ.
Dani Yesu ba lɛ, Yohane eshiɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Israel maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni abaptisi amɛ.
Ni be ni Yohane egbe enitsumɔ lɛ naa etã lɛ, ekɛɛ, ‘Namɔ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ mi ji?
Jeee mi ji lɛ; shi naa, mɔ ko miiba yɛ misɛɛ ni misaaa mɔ ni fɛneɔ etokotai yɛ enaji.’ “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, Abraham shwiei kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛteŋ, wɔ atsu akɛ nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ sane nɛɛ bahã.” Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ kɛ amɛmaŋ onukpai lɛ, akɛni amɛleee Yesu, ni asaŋ amɛnuuu gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi ni akaneɔ hejɔɔmɔ gbi fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi nɔ lɛ ashishi hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ amɛfɔ ni amɛbu lɛ lɛ ehã gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi lɛ eba mli.
Ni tsɛ amɛnaaa sane ko yɛ ehe ni amɛaadamɔ nɔ kɛbu lɛ gbele fɔ moŋ, kɛ̃lɛ amɛkpa Pilato fai akɛ agbe lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛhã nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ ehe lɛ eba mli lɛ, amɛ jie lɛ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ, ni amɛyato lɛ yɛ gbonyobu ko mli.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; Ni ejie ehe kpo gbii pii etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ jɛ Galilea ba Yerusalɛm lɛ, ni amɛ ji odasefoi ha maŋ lɛ.
Ni wɔ lɛ, shi ni ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔjajeɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ, akɛ no nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ehã eba mli ehã wɔ ni wɔji amɛbii lɛ, akɛni etee Yesu shi, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma yɛ lala ni ji enyɔ lɛ mli hu akɛ, ‘Mi-Bi ji bo; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ bo lɛ.’ “Shi akɛni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni ekuŋ esɛɛ kɛyaŋ fitemɔ mli dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, ‘Maŋɔ David dromɔnii krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he shiwoo ma shi shiŋŋ lɛ mahã nyɛ.’ No hewɔ hu ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko akɛ, ‘Ohaŋ omɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ana fitemɔ’ lɛ.
“Ejaakɛ David lɛ, be ni esɔ̃mɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo naa yɛ eyinɔ lɛ, etsɔ̃ mli ewɔ, ni aŋɔ lɛ afata etsɛmɛi lɛ ahe, ni ena fitemɔ.
Shi mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi lɛ, enaaa fitemɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɔ nɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ajajeɔ eshaifaa atsɔɔ nyɛ lɛ; ni nibii fɛɛ ni anyɛŋ abu nyɛ bem yɛ he yɛ Mose Mla lɛ naa lɛ, mɔ nɛ mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, abuɔ lɛ bem.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni nɔ ni awie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli lɛ akaba nyɛnɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɛkwɛa, nyɛ heguɔgbelɔi, ni nyɛhiɛ afea nyɛ yaa, ni nyɛhiɛ akpãtãa, ejaakɛ mibatsu nitsumɔ ko yɛ nyɛyinɔ, nitsumɔ ko ni kɛ mɔ ko gba nyɛ tete lɛ, nyɛheŋ nyɛyeŋ kɔkɔɔkɔ.’ ” Shi be ni amɛje kpeehe lɛ, mɛi lɛ kpa amɛ fai akɛ amɛbajaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ yɛ hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni nyiɛ no sɛɛ lɛ nɔ.
Ni be ni mɛi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ ekpa lɛ, Yudafoi kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni emɔ Yudafoi lɛ ajamɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni amɛwo amɛ ŋaa akɛ amɛhi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ mli.
Ni hejɔɔmɔ gbi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, shwɛ fioo ni eba lɛ akɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ ji mɛi ni babua amɛhe naa ni amɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ toi lɛ.
Shi be ni Yudafoi lɛ na asafoi lɛ, awuŋayeli yi amɛ obɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi wie shi nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ.
Ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba wie kɛ ekãa amɛkɛɛ, “Kulɛ nyɛ tsutsu esa akɛ ajaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ; shi akɛni nyɛŋwã wiemɔ lɛ ni nyɛbuuu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛsa naanɔ wala lɛ hewɔ lɛ, naa, wɔdɔ wɔyi kɛmiiya jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ nakai Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wo wɔ kitã akɛ, ‘Miŋɔ bo midamɔ shi akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ala, koni otsɔ̃ yiwalaheremɔ kɛyashi shikpɔŋ lɛ naagbee hei lɛ.’ ” Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ nu enɛ lɛ amɛna miishɛɛ, ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, ni mɛi abɔ ni ajie ato naanɔ wala lɛ he ye.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ gbɛ shwã yɛ jɛi niiaŋ fɛɛ.
Shi Yudafoi lɛ wowoo yei Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛbɔ̃i Paulo kɛ Barnaba yiwaa ni amɛshwie amɛ kɛjɛ amɛkpokpai lɛ anɔ.
Shi amɛ lɛ amɛkpokpo amɛnajiashi mlu amɛshwie amɛnɔ, ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee Ikonium.
Ni kaselɔi lɛ yimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba yɛ Ikonium Yɛ Ikonium nɛɛ hu Paulo kɛ Barnaba tee Yudafoi lɛ akpeehe lɛ ni amɛyawie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ bɔ ni ehã Yudafoi lɛ kɛ Helabii lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo he ye.
Shi Yudafoi ni heee wiemɔ lɛ yeee lɛ wo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiŋ koni amɛte shi amɛwo nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ tsɛ yɛ jɛi ni amɛkɛ ekãa wie Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he, ni lɛ hu ehã atsɔ̃ amɛnine nɔ afee okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii pii ekɛye edromɔ wiemɔ lɛ he odase.
Shi maŋ lɛ mli bii lɛ amli gba enyɔ, fã fata Yudafoi lɛ ahe, ni fã hu fata bɔfoi lɛ ahe.
Shi be ni jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ kɛ Yudafoi lɛ kɛ amɛnukpai lɛ bu kɛba ni amɛbafee amɛ niseniianii koni amɛbatswia amɛ tɛ lɛ, bɔfoi lɛ na le ni amɛjo foi kɛtee Likaonia maji lɛ amli, Listra kɛ Derbe kɛ jɛi niiaŋ, ni jɛi hu amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba yɛ Listra Nuu ko yɛ Listra ni eji obubuafo kɛjɛ enyɛ musuŋ beebe ni enyiɛko dã, shi shi etaa.
Ni be ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ, ebo toi.
Paulo kwɛ lɛ gãa ni ena akɛ eyɛ hemɔkɛyeli akɛ aaatsa lɛ, hewɔ lɛ ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Tee shi odamɔ onaji lɛ anɔ trɔmɔɔ!” Ni ehuru eyi shi ni enyiɛ.
Ni be ni asafoi lɛ na nɔ ni Paulo efee lɛ, amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ yɛ Likaonia wiemɔ lɛ mli amɛkɛɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔi lɛ etsɔ̃mɔ amɛhe gbɔmɛi kɛyimɔ shi kɛba wɔŋɔɔ!” Ni amɛtsɛ Barnaba akɛ Dio, kɛ Paulo hu akɛ Herme, ejaakɛ lɛ ji mɔ ni wieɔ amɛnaa.
Shi Dio amãgã ni yɔɔ amɛmaŋ lɛ mli agbo lɛ naa lɛ osɔfo lɛ hiɛ tsinahii kɛ nyanyrã akekrei kɛba agbo lɛ naa, lɛ kɛ asafo lɛ miitao amɛshã afɔle.
Shi be ni bɔfoi lɛ ni ji Barnaba kɛ Paulo nu he lɛ, amɛgbala amɛtadei ni amɛsha foi amɛyabote asafo lɛ teŋ amɛhiɛ blɔmɔ akɛ, “Ataamɛi, mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ?
Wɔ hu gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ tamɔ nyɛ nɔŋŋ, ni wɔmiijaje Sanekpakpa wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, koni nyɛku nyɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ nɛkɛ yakayakanii nɛɛ ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ, mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ.
Yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli lɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɛi lɛ anɔ, Shi kɛ̃lɛ efɔɔɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe odaseyeli, shi moŋ efeɔ ejurɔ ni ehãa nu jɛɔ ŋwɛi nɛɔ hãa nyɛ, kɛ bei ni nii baa pii hu, ni ehãa nyɛtɔrɔɔ, ni miishɛɛ yiɔ nyɛtsuiiaŋ obɔ̃bɔ̃.” Ni ekpakpa ko dani amɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ tsi afɔle ni kulɛ mɛi lɛ baashã ahã amɛ lɛ naa.
Shi Yudafoi komɛi jɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium ba jɛi bawo asafoi lɛ ayiŋ, ni amɛtswia Paulo tɛi, ni amɛgbala lɛ kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ mli ejaakɛ amɛsusu akɛ egbo.
Shi be ni kaselɔi lɛ babɔle ehe kɛkpe lɛ, ete shi ni etee maŋ lɛ mli.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, ekɛ Barnaba yiŋ kɛtee Derbe.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba ba Antiokia ekoŋŋ Ni be ni amɛjaje Sanekpakpa lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Derbe ni amɛfee mɛi pii kaselɔi lɛ, amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee Listra kɛ Ikonium kɛ Antiokia.
Amɛsaa amɛwo kaselɔi lɛ amumɔŋ hewalɛ, ni amɛwie amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, akɛ amɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni asaŋ esa akɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amanehului pii amli kɛboteɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Ni amɛfãmɔ onukpai amɛto asafo fɛɛ asafo nɔ, ni amɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ ŋmaahilɛ tu amɛ amɛwo Nuŋtsɔ, mɔ nɔ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ dɛŋ.
Ni amɛfo mli kɛtsɔ̃ Pisidia kɛba Pamfilia.
Ni be ni amɛjaje wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Perga lɛ, amɛkɛshwie nɔ kɛba Atalia.
Ni amɛbote lɛlɛ mli yɛ jɛi, ni amɛfã kɛba Antiokia, he ni atu amɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ kɛhã nitsumɔ ni amɛtsu amɛgbe naa nɛɛ yɛ lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛba jɛi ni amɛbabua asafo lɛ naa lɛ, amɛgba amɛ nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ eyatsu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛ bɔ ni egbele gbɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ ni amɛhe amɛye lɛ.
Ni amɛkɛ kaselɔi lɛ hi shi gbii kplaŋŋ.
Akpe yɛ Yerusalɛm Ni mɛi komɛi jɛ Yudea ba ni amɛbatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji afolɔɔɔ nyɛ ketia yɛ gbɛnaa ni Mose eto lɛ naa lɛ, anyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ahere.” Ni be ni Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛ taa naa ni amɛkɛ amɛ je ŋwane aahu lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ to akɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛ amɛteŋ mɛi krokomɛi hu aya bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ aŋɔɔ yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni asafo lɛ ebajie amɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ Foinikia kɛ Samaria ni amɛgba jeŋmaji lɛ atsakemɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛhã nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ na miishɛɛ naakpa.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, asafo lɛ kɛ bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ here amɛ atuu, ni mɛi ni atsu lɛ gba amɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ amɛ etsu lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi mɛi komɛi ni jɛ Farisifoi lɛ akuu lɛ mli ni ehe eye lɛ te shi amɛkɛɛ akɛ, “Ja afolɔ amɛ ketia ni awo amɛ kitã akɛ amɛye Mose Mla lɛ nɔ.” Ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ babua amɛhe naa, koni amɛtao nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
Shi be ni amɛyiyii aahu lɛ, Petro te shi damɔ shi, ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ jeeŋmɔ beebe Nyɔŋmɔ hala wɔmli, ni eto akɛ minaa jeŋmaji lɛ anu Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ ni amɛhe amɛye.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni le tsuiiaŋ lɛ hã amɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni ehã wɔ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ nɔ, ni ejieee niiaŋ yɛ wɔ kɛ amɛ teŋ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hemɔkɛyeli tsuɔ amɛtsuii ahe.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ mɛɛba nyɛkaa Nyɔŋmɔ, ni nyɛkɛ kɔŋtso ni wɔji o, wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ ji o, wɔnyɛɛɛ wɔtere lɛ fɔ̃ɔ kaselɔi lɛ akɔŋ?
Shi wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ wɔyiwala tamɔ amɛ nɔŋŋ.” Kɛkɛ ni asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ fee diŋŋ ni amɛbo Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni gbaa amɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ efee yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ atoi.
Be ni amɛwie amɛgbe naa lɛ, Yakobo here nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi hii, nyɛboa mi toi.
Simeon egba bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ basara jeŋmaji lɛ tsutsu ko ni ehala maŋ kɛjɛ amɛteŋ ehã egbɛi lɛ.
Ni gbalɔi lɛ awiemɔi lɛ hu kɛ enɛ yeɔ hegbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, ‘Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ maku misɛɛ maba, ni masaa David buu ni egbee shi lɛ mama shi; ni etsukoi lɛ hu matswa ekoŋŋ, ni matee lɛ shi mama shi.
Bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ ni akɛ migbɛi ewo amɛ lɛ atao Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ.’ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni hã ale enɛ kɛjɛ teteete lɛ kɛɛ.
“No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ akagba mɛi ni eku amɛsɛɛ kɛjɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ anaa tuutu; shi moŋ aŋma amɛ akɛ amɛhi nii fɛɛ ni wɔji ewo he muji; amɛhi ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ lá.
Ejaakɛ kɛjɛ blema beebe lɛ Mose yɛ mɛi ni shiɛɔ lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ, ni daa hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ akaneɔ ewoji lɛ yɛ kpeehei lɛ.” Wolo ni jɛ kpee lɛ mli Kɛkɛ ni esa bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɛ akɛ amɛaafãmɔ hii komɛi yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛteŋ, ni atsu amɛ kɛ Paulo kɛ Barnaba kɛya Antiokia.
Hii nɛɛ ji Yuda, mɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Barsaba hu lɛ, kɛ Sila; gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ji hiɛnaanɔbii yɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ.
Ni amɛŋma wolo amɛhã amɛ akɛ, “Bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ miibi nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ ni yɔɔ Antiokia kɛ Siria kɛ Kilikia lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Akɛni wɔnu akɛ wɔteŋ mɛi komɛi bagba nyɛnaa kɛ wiemɔi komɛi, ni amɛkɛfutu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ, tsɛ jeee wɔ wɔfã amɛ akɛ amɛbafee nakai hewɔ lɛ, esa wɔhiɛ akɛ, ni wɔnaa efee ekome nɛɛ, wɔfãmɔ mɛi wɔfata Barnaba kɛ Paulo ni wɔsumɔɔ ni ji gbɔmɛi ni kɛ amɛwala eŋmɛ shi yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi hewɔ lɛ he, ni wɔtsu amɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔtsu Yuda kɛ Sila, ni amɛ hu amɛkɛ amɛdaaŋ wiemɔ abajaje nibii nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ esa Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni esa wɔ hu wɔhiɛ akɛ wɔkɛ jatsu kroko akatere nyɛ, akɛ ja nii ni he hiaa nɛɛ nɔŋŋ; akɛ nyɛhi loi ni agbe ahã wɔji kɛ lá kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ.
Kɛji nyɛwi nyɛhe kɛjɛ enɛɛmɛi ahe lɛ, nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ.
Nyɛhia shi jogbaŋŋ!” Be ni awo mɛi ni atsu lɛ gbɛ lɛ, amɛba Antiokia ni amɛbabua asafo muu lɛ naa ni amɛkɛ wolo lɛ hã amɛ.
Ni be ni amɛkane lɛ, amɛmii shɛ amɛhe yɛ hewalɛ ni ewo amɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Yuda kɛ Sila lɛ, akɛni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu gbalɔi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwie saŋŋ kɛshɛje nyɛmimɛi lɛ amii ni amɛkɛwo amɛ hewalɛ.
Ni be ni amɛye be fioo yɛ jɛi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ wo amɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli kɛtee mɛi ni tsu amɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ.
[ Shi Sila lɛ, esa ehiɛ akɛ eeehi jɛi.]
Shi Paulo kɛ Barnaba hi Antiokia amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ, ni mɛi krokomɛi pii hu fee nakai nɔŋŋ.
Paulo kɛ Barnaba gbala mli Shi gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo kɛɛ Barnaba akɛ, “Hã wɔku wɔsɛɛ wɔyasara wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ ni wɔjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli, ni wɔkwɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ.” Ni Barnaba tao akɛ amɛŋɔ Yohane ni atsɛɔ lɛ Marko lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.
Shi Paulo lɛ, lɛ lɛ esusu akɛ esaaa akɛ amɛaaŋɔ mɔ ni kpale yɛ amɛsɛɛ yɛ Pamfilia ni ekɛ amɛ eyaaa nitsumɔ lɛ amɛfata amɛhe.
No hewɔ lɛ, efee bei aahu po ni ehã amɛmli gbala, ni Barnaba ŋɔ Marko efata ehe ni amɛtsɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛtee Kipro.
Shi Paulo lɛ, efã Sila efata ehe, ni be ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ tu lɛ wo Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ Paulo yi mli.
Ni etsɔ̃ Siria kɛ Kilikia eyawo asafoi lɛ ahewalɛ.
Paulo kɛ Sila ŋɔ Timoteo Kɛkɛ ni Paulo ba Derbe kɛ Listra.
Kaselɔ ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Timoteo; enyɛ lɛ Yudayoo ko ni ehe wiemɔ lɛ eye ni, shi etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.
Ni nyɛmimɛi lɛ ni yɔɔ Listra kɛ Ikonium lɛ yeɔ ehe odase kpakpa.
Paulo miitao ni ekɛ kaselɔ nɛɛ aya, ni eŋɔ lɛ efo lɛ ketia yɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jɛi niiaŋ lɛ ahewɔ; ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛle akɛ etsɛ lɛ Helanyo ni.
Shi be ni amɛkpaa maji lɛ anɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ mlai ni bɔfoi lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ wo lɛ hã amɛ koni amɛye nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ asafoi lɛ na hewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni amɛyi faa daa gbi.
Paulo ninaa yɛ Troia Shi akɛni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ etsi amɛ gbɛ akɛ amɛkawie wiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Asia hewɔ lɛ, amɛfo mli yɛ Frigia kɛ Galatia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni amɛba Misia niiaŋ, ni amɛka akɛ amɛaatee Bitinia, shi Yesu Mumɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛtsɔ̃ Misia ni amɛba Troia.
Ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ Paulo na yɛ ninaa mli akɛ nuu Makedonianyo ko damɔ shi miikpa lɛ fai akɛ, “Ba Makedonia ni obaye obua wɔ!” Shi be ni ena nii lɛ pɛ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔya Makedonia, ejaakɛ wɔkɔ sɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ etsɛ wɔ kɛmiiya jɛi koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Lidia tsuitsakemɔ No hewɔ lɛ, wɔfã kɛjɛ Troia ni wɔnyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛtee Samotrake, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔba Neapoli.
Wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔtee Filipi ni ji Makedonia shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋ wulu kɛ Romabii ashimɔmɔhe lɛ.
Ni wɔhi nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli gbii kplaŋŋ.
Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, wɔjɛ maŋ lɛ mli wɔtee faa ko naa, he ni wɔjwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ wɔ akɛ asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, ni wɔyatara shi, ni wɔkɛ yei ni ebabua amɛhe naa yɛ jɛi lɛ wie.
Ni yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Lidia ni ji kɔɔjaŋhɔ̃ɔlɔ ko ni jɛ Tiatira maŋ lɛ mli ni sheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei lɛ hu nu; lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele etsui naa akɛ ebo nii ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ toi.
Ni be ni abaptisi lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ, ekpa wɔ fai akɛ, “Kɛji nyɛbu mi akɛ mihe Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miye anɔkwale mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbaa miwe lɛ, ni nyɛbahia jɛi.” Ni ehiɛ wɔ aahu, ni wɔkpɛ̃lɛ.
Paulo kɛ Sila tsuŋwoo Shi gbi ko be ni wɔyaa he ni asɔleɔ yɛ lɛ, tsulɔ yoo ko ni klámɔ mumɔ yɔɔ emli kɛ wɔ bakpe; ekɛ eklámɔ lɛ hãa enuŋtsɔmɛi naa nii pii.
Enyiɛ wɔ kɛ Paulo sɛɛ ni ebolɔɔ akɛ, “Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shɔŋŋ lɛ tsuji ji amɛ, ni amɛmiijaje yiwalaheremɔ gbɛ lɛ amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.” Ni efee nakai gbii pii.
Shi efee Paulo ahuntoo kɛho he, ni etsɔ̃ ehe ni ekɛɛ mumɔ lɛ akɛ, “Miifã bo yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli akɛ oje emli.” Ni eje emli yɛ nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ.
Be ni enuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ na akɛ amɛninamɔ nɔhiɛkãmɔnɔ lɛ elaaje lɛ, amɛmɔmɔ Paulo kɛ Sila ni amɛgbala amɛ kɛtee lumɛi lɛ ahiɛ yɛ jara lɛ nɔ; ni be ni amɛkpala amɛ kɛtee asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi nɛɛ ni ji Yudafoi lɛ ewo wɔmaŋ lɛ mli hirihiri, ni amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔtsɔ̃ɔ kusumi komɛi ni wɔ akɛ Romabii lɛ wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔmɔɔ mli loo wɔyeɔ nɔ.” Ni maŋbii lɛ hu te shi wo amɛ, ni asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ hã akplɔ amɛtadei yɛ amɛhe, ni amɛfã akɛ ayi amɛ kpãa.
Ni be ni amɛtswia amɛ kpãi pii lɛ, amɛwo amɛ tsuŋ, ni amɛwo gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ kitã akɛ ekɛ amɛ ato shweshweeshwe; ni akɛni awo lɛ nɛkɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛ ewo tsu ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mli tɔɔ, ni ebɔ amɛnaji apã.
Shi nyɔɔŋ teŋ lɛ Paulo kɛ Sila miisɔle ni amɛmiila amɛmiijie Nyɔŋmɔ yi; ni gboklɛfoi lɛ miibo amɛ toi.
Ni trukaa lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni tsu lɛ shishitoo lɛ hoso, ni amrɔ lɛ, shinai lɛ fɛɛ gbelegbelee, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkpãi lɛ kpɔlɔke.
Be ni gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ hɛle shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli ni ena akɛ tsu lɛ naa shinai lɛ fɛɛ kãmɔ lɛ, egbala eklante ni kulɛ ebaagbe ehe, ejaakɛ esusu akɛ gboklɛfoi lɛ ejo foi.
Shi Paulo bo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafee ohe efɔŋ ko, shi wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ biɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni etsɛ ni abahã lɛ kane, ni esha foi kɛbote tsu lɛ mli, ni ekɛ hekpokpomɔ ho egbee Paulo kɛ Sila hiɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ je kpo ni ekɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔmɛi, mɛni sa ni mafee ni ahere miyiwala?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Hemɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ oye, ni aaahere bo kɛ owe lɛ fɛɛ yiwala.” Ni amɛjaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.
Ni eŋɔ amɛ nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ mli nɔŋŋ, ni efɔ amɛkpãi lɛ anaa ehã amɛ, ni abaptisi lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ mli bii fɛɛ amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ; ni ekɛ amɛ tee ewe lɛ, ni eyaŋmɛ amɛ okplɔ̃, ni emli fili lɛ kɛ ewe lɛ fɛɛ akɛ ehe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ eye.
Be ni je tsɛre lɛ, asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ tsu asraafoi bakɛɛ, “Ŋmɛɛmɔ gbɔmɛi lɛ ahe ni amɛya.” Ni gboklɛfoiakwɛlɔ lɛ jaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Paulo akɛ, “Asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ etsu kɛba akɛ aŋmɛɛ nyɛhe, no hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛjea kpo, ni nyɛyabaa jogbaŋŋ.” Shi Paulo kɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Wɔ ni Romabii ji wɔ ni abuko wɔ fɔ lɛ, amɛyi wɔ yɛ jara nɔ, ni amɛwo wɔ tsuŋ hu; ni kpaako amɛshwieɔ wɔ nigii lo?
Dabida, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛba ni amɛbajie wɔ.” Ni asraafoi lɛ yajaje nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ; ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Romabii ji amɛ lɛ, amɛshe gbeyei.
Ni amɛba amɛbakpa amɛ fai, ni be ni amɛ jie amɛ lɛ, amɛtutɔ amɛ akɛ amɛje maŋ lɛ mli.
Shi be ni amɛje tsu lɛ mli lɛ, amɛtee Lidia we lɛ mli.
Amɛna nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni amɛshɛje amɛmii, ni amɛyiŋ amɛtee.
Paulo kɛ Sila yɛ Tesalonika Paulo kɛ Sila tsɔ̃ Amfipoli kɛ Apolonia, ni amɛba Tesalonika, he ni Yudafoi akpeehe ko yɔɔ lɛ.
Ni Paulo tee amɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ ni efɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, ni ekɛ amɛ yayiyii yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ ahe hejɔɔmɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mli ni ekɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli saji tsɔ̃ɔ naa akɛ ja Kristo lɛ na amanehulu ni ete shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni esaa ekɛɛ, “Yesu nɛɛ, mɔ he sane ni mijajeɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, lɛ ji Kristo lɛ.” Ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi he ye, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛ Paulo kɛ Sila he; nakai nɔŋŋ Helabii Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo kɛ yei hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ hu pii fee.
Shi efee Yudafoi krokomɛi lɛ atãŋ, ni amɛyakpala niiahetswialɔi lɛ ateŋ hii fɔ̃ji komɛi amɛfata amɛhe, ni be ni amɛfee asafo yuu lɛ, amɛwo maŋ lɛ mli hirihiri; ni amɛyatua Yason we lɛ amɛmiitao akɛ amɛkpala Paulo kɛ Sila amɛyahã maŋ lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛnaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛkpala Yason kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛtee maŋ lɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ ni amɛbolɔ akɛ, “Mɛnɛɛmɛi ni amɛtsɔ̃ jeŋ hiɛ ebu shi lɛ eba biɛ nɛɛ hu, ni Yason ehere amɛ yɛ eshĩa; ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛkuɔ Kaisare mla lɛ nɔ, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ maŋtsɛ kroko yɛ ni ji Yesu ko.” Ni amɛhã maŋbii lɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ mli onukpai lɛ fɛɛ ejijaa kɛ nɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ.
Ni be ni amɛhe sɛɛdaamɔnii yɛ Yason kɛ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, amɛŋmɛɛ amɛhe.
Paulo kɛ Sila yɛ Beroia Ni amrɔ̃ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ jie Paulo kɛ Sila gbɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛtee Beroia.
Ni be ni amɛshɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛyabote Yudafoi lɛ akpeehe lɛ mli.
Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi asu hi fe mɛi ni yɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ, ni amɛ lɛ amɛhere wiemɔ lɛ kɛ amɛtsui fɛɛ, ni daa gbi lɛ amɛkpaa ŋmalɛi lɛ amli amɛkwɛɔ akɛ nibii nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai lo.
Hewɔ lɛ amɛteŋ mɛi pii he ye, Helayei ni yɔɔ gbɛi kɛ hii hu pii.
Shi be ni Yudafoi ni yɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ nu akɛ Paulo eyajaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ Beroia hu lɛ, amɛba jɛi hu ni amɛbawo mɛi lɛ ayiŋ ni amɛhã amɛ jijaa.
Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ yajie Paulo gbɛ ni eya ŋshɔnaagbɛ; shi Sila kɛ Timoteo hi Beroia.
Mɛi ni yajie Paulo gbɛ lɛ kɛ lɛ tee Atene tɔ̃ɔ; ni be ni eshɛ amɛ akɛ Sila kɛ Timoteo aba eŋɔɔ oya lɛ, amɛyi mli amɛtee.
Paulo yɛ Atene Be ni Paulo mɛɔ Sila kɛ Timoteo yɛ Atene lɛ, ena akɛ eji maŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ amãgãi sɔŋŋ, ni ehao lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ kpeehe lɛ kɛ Helafoi Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishelɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni kɛ lɛ kpeɔ daa gbi yɛ jara lɛ nɔ lɛ yiyii.
Shi nilelɔi ni ji Epikuromɛi kɛ Stoamɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ lɛ taa naa ni mɛi komɛi kɛɛ, “Mɛni po naafuutsɛ nɛɛ taoɔ ekɛɛ?” Ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Etamɔ mɔ ni jajeɔ maŋsɛɛ jemawɔji ahe sane etsɔ̃ɔ.” Amɛkɛɛ enɛ ejaakɛ ejaje Yesu kɛ shitee lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ.
Ni amɛŋɔ lɛ kɛtee Areopago (kojomɔhe) lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Ani ooohã wɔle nɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hee ni owie he nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ ohã wɔtoii enu maŋsɛɛ saji; hewɔ lɛ wɔmiitao shishi wɔle.” Shi Atenebii fɛɛ kɛ gbɔi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ, nɔ ni eshwɛ amɛ pɛ ji sane hee ko gbaa kɛ sane toiboo.
Ni Paulo yadamɔ Areopago lɛ teŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Atenebii, miyoo yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli akɛ nyɛjaa wɔji pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni mihoɔ ni mikwɛ nii ni nyɛjaa lɛ, mina afɔleshãa latɛ ko hu ni aŋma yɛ nɔ akɛ, ‘Nyɔŋmɔ ni aleee lɛ nɔŋ.’ No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni nyɛleee lɛ ni kɛ̃ lɛ nyɛjaa lɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ehe sane mijajeɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni bɔ je lɛ kɛ emli nibii fɛɛ lɛ, lɛ ji ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ nuŋtsɔ lɛ; ehiii Sɔlemɔtsui ni akɛ niji ma amli, ni asaŋ akɛ gbɔmɛi aniji jaaa lɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni nɔ ko fiɔ lɛ; lɛ moŋ edɛŋ wala kɛ mumɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ jɛɔ hãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ; ni lá kome ekɛbɔ gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ, ni amɛhi shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, ni yinɔi ni eto lɛ kɛ amɛshihilɛhei lɛ ahusui lɛ ekpɛ mli eto momo, koni amɛtao Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ, akɛ aleenɔ, kɛ amɛgbugbuu shi lɛ, amɛaana lɛ lo; tsɛbelɛ ekɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko teŋ jɛkɛɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ, ‘Emli nɔŋŋ wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔtsiɔ wɔhe ni wɔyɔɔ yɛ;’ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛlalatsɛmɛi lɛ ekomɛi hu ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, ‘Shi lɛ nɔŋŋ eshwiei ji wɔ hu.’ Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwiei ji wɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ wɔsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su lɛ tamɔ shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo tɛ ko ni gbɔmɔ kɛ eŋaa kɛ ejwɛŋmɔ fee.
No hewɔ lɛ, bei ni aleee lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eku ehiɛ efɔ̃ nɔ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ eewo gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he kitã akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui, ejaakɛ eto gbi ko, no nɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ nuu ni eto lɛ nɔ ekojo jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ jalɛ naa; ni ekɛ shi ni etee lɛ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ maa enɛ nɔ mi ehãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.” Shi be ni amɛnu gbohiiashitee he lɛ, mɛi komɛi ye ehe fɛo, ni mɛi komɛi hu kɛɛ, “Wɔɔsaa wɔbo owiemɔ nɛɛ toi ekoŋŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Paulo shi amɛ.
Shi hii komɛi kɛ amɛhe kpɛtɛ ehe ni amɛhe amɛye; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Dionisio, Areopagonyo lɛ, kɛ yoo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Damari lɛ, kɛ mɛi krokomɛi ni fata amɛhe.
Paulo yɛ Korinto Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo je Atene ni eyiŋ etee Korinto.
Ni eyana Yudafonyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Akwila, ni afɔ lɛ yɛ Ponto, kɛ eŋa Priskila.
Akwila jɛ Italia ba etsɛko.
Eba ejaakɛ Kaisare Klaudio efã akɛ Yudafoi fɛɛ aje Roma.
Ni Paulo tee amɛŋɔɔ; ni akɛni ekɛ lɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nitsumɔ kome hewɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛ hi shi, ni etsuɔ nii; amɛnitsumɔ nɛɛ ji buufeemɔ.
Shi daa Hejɔɔmɔ gbi lɛ, Paulo yawieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi yɛ kpeehe lɛ, ni ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ etsake Yudafoi kɛ Helabii lɛ.
Shi be ni Sila kɛ Timoteo jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ, Paulo hiɛ dɔ yɛ wiemɔ lɛ he ni eye odase veveeve etsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ.
Shi akɛni amɛkuɔ enaa ni amɛwieɔ musubɔɔ wiemɔi hewɔ lɛ, ekpala ehe eshwie amɛnɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛlá abua nyɛyiteŋ; mi lɛ sɔ̃ ko wulaaa mi.
Kɛjɛ be nɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, matee jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ aŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni eje jɛi ni etee Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Titio Yusto ni eshĩa kpɛtɛ kpeehe lɛ ŋɔɔ.
Shi kpeehe lɛ onukpa lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Krispo lɛ kɛ ewe muu lɛ fɛɛ he Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ amɛye, ni Korintobii lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii hu ni nu wiemɔ lɛ, amɛhe amɛye, ni abaptisi amɛ.
Ni nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ Paulo yɛ ninaa mli akɛ, “Kaashe gbeyei, shi moŋ wiemɔ, ni okamua onaa, ejaakɛ mikɛ bo yɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etaŋ ohe ni efeŋ bo efɔŋ ko, ejaakɛ miyɛ mɛi pii yɛ maŋ nɛɛ mli.” Ni ehi jɛi afi kome kɛ nyɔji ekpaa etsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Shi be ni Galio yeɔ amralo yɛ Akaia lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome te shi wo Paulo, ni amɛkpala lɛ kɛtee kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, amɛkɛɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ woɔ mɛi lɛ ayiŋ ni amɛshi mla lɛ sɛɛ amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ.” Shi be ni Paulo baagbele enaa pɛ lɛ, Galio kɛɛ Yudafoi lɛ akɛ, “Yudafoi, eji juu kɛ fɔ̃ sane ko ni kulɛ, esa akɛ mabo nyɛ toi; shi kɛji wiemɔi loo gbɛii loo nyɛmla lɛ he saji komɛi ni lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛkwɛa nɔ; ejaakɛ misumɔɔɔ akɛ mikojoɔ nɛkɛ saji.” Ni eshwie amɛ kɛjɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni Helabii lɛ fɛɛ mɔ kpeehe lɛ onukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Sostene lɛ, ni amɛyi lɛ yɛ kojomɔ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ; shi Galio ebuuu enɛɛmɛi eko eko.
Paulo ku esɛɛ kɛtee Antiokia Be ni Paulo ehi jɛi gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ye shɛɛ, ni ebote lɛlɛ mli kɛmiiya Siria; ni Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ lɛ tee ni eyashɛ eyi yɛ Kenkrea, ejaakɛ ewo shi.
Ni amɛba Efeso, ni ekɛ amɛ gbala mli yɛ jɛi.
Ni etee kpeehe lɛ, ni ekɛ Yudafoi lɛ yayiyii.
Ni be ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ etsɛ yɛ amɛŋɔɔ fioo lɛ, ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ; shi moŋ ekɛ amɛ ye shɛɛ ekɛɛ, “Kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ lɛ, maku misɛɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.” Ni efã kɛjɛ Efeso.
Be ni eyakpeleke Kaisarea lɛ, etee Yerusalɛm ni eyaŋa asafo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee Antiokia.
Ni ehi jɛi fioo, ni no sɛɛ lɛ, eyi mli ekoŋŋ ni eyakpa Galatia kɛ Frigia shikpɔji lɛ anɔ ewo kaselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ahewalɛ.
Apolo yɛ Efeso kɛ Korinto Yudanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Apolo ni afɔ lɛ yɛ Aleksandria lɛ ba Efeso.
Apolo nɛɛ enaa tse ni ele ŋmalɛi lɛ jogbaŋŋ hu.
Atsɔ̃ɔ nuu nɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ he nii, ni eyɛ ekãa yɛ mumɔ mli ni ewieɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ Yesu he nii fitsofitso, tsɛ Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ kɛkɛ ele.
Ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ kɛ ekãa yɛ kpeehe lɛ.
Shi be ni Akwila kɛ Priskila nu ehe lɛ, amɛŋɔ lɛ kɛba amɛŋɔɔ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛ lɛ fitsofitso.
Agbɛnɛ etao akɛ eya Akaia, hewɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ŋma wolo amɛkɛwo kaselɔi lɛ aŋaa ni amɛhere lɛ atuu.
Ni be ni eba jɛi lɛ, ewa mɛi ni etsɔ̃ dromɔ lɛ nɔ ehe eye lɛ babaoo.
Ejaakɛ ekɛ hewalɛ ku Yudafoi lɛ anaa yɛ maŋ hiɛ ni ekɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ akɛ Yesu ji Kristo lɛ.
Paulo yɛ Efeso Be ni Apolo yɔɔ Korinto lɛ, Paulo yakpa gɔŋ nɔ maji lɛ anɔ kɛbaje Efeso.
Ni ebana kaselɔi komɛi, ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Ani be ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ nyɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lo?” Ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ko yɛ he ko jiŋŋ, wɔnuko tete.” Ni ebi amɛ akɛ, “Belɛ mɛni mli abaptisi nyɛ awo mɔ?” Ni amɛkɛɛ, “Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ mli.” Ni Paulo kɛɛ, “Yohane baptisimɔ lɛ, ekɛbaptisi mɛi ni etsake amɛtsui; shi ekɛɛ maŋ lɛ akɛ, amɛhe mɔ ni baa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ moŋ nɔ amɛye; lɛ ji Kristo Yesu lɛ.” Ni be ni amɛnu enɛ lɛ, abaptisi amɛ awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli; ni be ni Paulo kɛ eniji shwie amɛnɔ lɛ, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ba amɛnɔ, ni amɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni amɛgba.
Shi hii lɛ fɛɛ aaafee nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ.
Ni Paulo tee kpeehe lɛ, ni eyawie kɛ ekãa, ni etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ nii kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nyɔji etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ ni amɛhe Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ amɛye.
Shi be ni mɛi komɛi waje amɛtsui ni amɛbooo toi ni amɛwie tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he efɔŋ yɛ mɛi lɛ ahiɛ lɛ, eje amɛŋɔɔ ni ejie kaselɔi lɛ hu yɛ amɛteŋ, ni daa gbi lɛ eyawieɔ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi yɛ mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tirano lɛ nikasemɔhe lɛ.
Ehiɛ nakai feemɔ aahu afii enyɔ sɔŋŋ, ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ, Yudafoi kɛ Helabii lɛ fɛɛ, nu Nuŋtsɔ Yesu wiemɔ lɛ.
Skeva bihii lɛ Ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Paulo nine nɔ etsu hewalɛ nitsumɔi hu ni nɔ ekaaa, aahu po ni aŋɔɔ eklaladukui kɛ atade hiɛhaanii tete ayahaa helatsɛmɛi anɔ, ni amɛhelai lɛ tãa ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ hu jeɔ amɛmli.
Shi Yudafoi okɔmfoi ni nyiɛ kpaa shi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ka ni amɛkɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi afã mɛi ni mumɔi fɔ̃ji yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ ayi akɛ, “Mina Yesu ni Paulo shiɛɔ lɛ.” Osɔfonukpa Skeva, Yudanyo lɛ, bihii kpawo ji mɛi ni feɔ nakai nii lɛ.
Shi mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ here nɔ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Yesu lɛ, mile lɛ, ni Paulo hu, mile lɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, namɛi ji nyɛ?” Ni gbɔmɔ ni mumɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɔɔ emli lɛ tua amɛ ni enine tsɔ̃ amɛnɔ ni efee amɛ butuu, ni amɛkɛ amɛhe yayai kɛ pilamɔi jo foi kɛjɛ nakai shĩa lɛ.
Ni be ni Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, gbeyei mɔmɔ amɛ fɛɛ, ni awo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam naakpa.
Ni mɛi ni ehe eye lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii hu ba ni amɛbajaje amɛnifeemɔnii lɛ faŋŋ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Ni ŋkunyaayelɔi lɛ hu ateŋ mɛi babaoo ba ni amɛkɛ amɛwoji lɛ babua shi ni amɛshã yɛ mɛi fɛɛ hiɛ; ni be ni abu naa lɛ, efee jwiɛtɛi kukuji akpei nyɔŋmai enumɔ.
Nɛkɛ hewalɛ gbɛ nɛɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ ekɛshwere ni eye kunim.
Sakasakafeemɔ ba Efeso Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Paulo to eyiŋ yɛ mumɔ lɛ mli akɛ eeeyatsɔ̃ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛya Yerusalɛm, ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji mishɛ jɛi lɛ, ja miyakwɛ Roma hu.” Shi be ni etsu mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ, Timoteo kɛ Erasto, Makedonia lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ehi Asia be fioo.
Shi nakai be lɛ mli nɔŋŋ lɛ sakasakafeemɔ ko ni bate shi yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ejeee shwɛmɔ.
Ejaakɛ jwiɛtɛiŋaalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Demetrio lɛ kɛ jwiɛtɛi feɔ Artemi Sɔlemɔtsui ni hãa ŋaalɔi lɛ naa nitsumɔ pii.
Etsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ eko lɛ kɛkpe, ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi, nyɛle akɛ nɛkɛ ŋaa nɛɛ wɔkɛnaa wɔnii pii lɛ.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛmiina ni nyɛmiinu akɛ jeee Efeso nɛɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ shwɛ fioo ni Asia fɛɛ lɛ, Paulo nɛɛ ehã mɛi babaoo ayiŋ etsɔ̃, ni ekpale amɛ; ekɛɔ akɛ nii ni akɛ niji fee lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni.
Miishe gbeyei akɛ, jeee wɔnitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛkɛ he guɔ baagbo, shi moŋ nyɔŋmɔyoo Artemi kekenam lɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ hu abuŋ lɛ ahaŋ nɔ ko nɔ ko, ni enunyam kpeteŋkple lɛ ni Asia kɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ hu jaa lɛ baabutu.” Be ni ŋaalɔi lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, amɛmli wo la pam, ni amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Efesobii Artemi lɛ kekenam ni!” Ni maŋ lɛ mli fɛɛ fee sakasaka; ni amɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome tsɛ̃ kɛtee nikwɛmɔhe lɛ, ni amɛyamɔmɔ Gaio kɛ Aristarko ni ji Makedoniabii ni fata Paulo he kɛfã gbɛ lɛ.
Shi be ni Paulo tao akɛ eya mɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, kaselɔi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ; ni Asia lumɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ni ji Paulo shieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ tsu eŋɔɔ abawo lɛ ŋaa akɛ ekakwɛ ni etee nikwɛmɔhe lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ be ni mɛi komɛi bolɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi komɛi hu miibolɔ ekroko; ejaakɛ kpee lɛ efee basabasa ni mɛi kpotoo leee nɔ hewɔ ni amɛbakpe tete.
Akɛni Yudafoi lɛ tsirɛ Aleksandro yisɛɛ kɛba hiɛgbɛ hewɔ lɛ, mɛi pii susu akɛ lɛ ejɛ ni basabasa lɛ ba.
Shi Aleksandro fɔ̃ enine eetao akɛ ejieɔ enaa etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛyoo akɛ Yudanyo ji lɛ lɛ, amɛ fɛɛ amɛkɛ gbee kome bolɔ aaafee ŋmɛlɛtswai enyɔ sɔŋŋ akɛ, “Efesobii Artemi lɛ kekenam ni!” Ni be ni maŋ woloŋmalɔ lɛ ekpãtã mɛi lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi Efesobii, mɛɛ gbɔmɔ po leee akɛ Artemi kekenam lɛ kɛ amãgã ni kpeleke shi kɛjɛ Dio ŋɔɔ lɛ Efesobii amaŋ nɛɛŋ ewulɔmɔ yɔɔ?
Agbɛnɛ akɛni enɛ he bɛ ŋwanejee hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ nyɛfeɔ dioo, ni nyɛkafee gidigidi ko.
Nyɛkɛ hii nɛɛ eba biɛ; amɛjeee Sɔlemɔ we nii julɔi lɛ, amɛjeee nyɛnyɔŋmɔyoo lɛ he musubɔlɔi hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji Demetrio kɛ enanemɛi ŋaalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ ko yɛ sane ko lɛ, kojomɔ gbii yɛ, ni amralofoi hu yɛ; nyɛhãa amɛkɛ sane lɛ ayaa amɛhiɛ.
Shi kɛji saji krokomɛi anaa nyɛtaoɔ lɛ, akwaashɔŋ lɛ aaaye yɛ mla naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔkwɛɛɛ ni ahi lɛ, abaafolɔ wɔnaa yɛ ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ basabasafeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni wɔbɛ sane ko ni wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛjie wɔnaa yɛ hoofeemɔ nɛɛ he.” Ni be ni ekɛɛ enɛ lɛ, ewo asafo lɛ gbɛ.
Paulo tee Makedonia kɛ Hela Be ni gidigidifeemɔ lɛ sɛɛ efo lɛ, Paulo tsu ayatsɛ kaselɔi lɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ni ewie etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ ni ekɛ amɛ ye shɛɛ, ni eyi mli kɛmiiya Makedonia.
Ni be ni eyatsɔ̃ jɛi niiaŋ ni ekɛ wiemɔi pii wo amɛŋaa lɛ, eba Akaia.
Ni eye nyɔji etɛ̃ yɛ jɛi, ni akɛni Yudafoi lɛ ewo lɛ ka be ni eheɔ efã kɛya Siria hewɔ lɛ, eto eyiŋ akɛ eeeku esɛɛ eyatsɔ̃ Makedonia ekoŋŋ.
Ni Sopatre, Beroianyo lɛ ni ji Pirho bi lɛ, kɛ Aristarko kɛ Sekundo, Tesalonikabii lɛ, kɛ Gaio, Derbenyo lɛ, kɛ Timoteo, kɛ Asiabii ni ji Tihiko kɛ Trofimo lɛ, kɛ lɛ tee Asia.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi tsɔ̃ hiɛ, ni amɛyamɛ wɔ yɛ Troia.
Ni wɔ lɛ wɔfã kɛjɛ Filipi yɛ Akpiti Gbii lɛ asɛɛ, ni gbii enumɔ sɛɛ lɛ wɔyashɛ amɛŋɔɔ yɛ Troia, ni wɔhi jɛi gbii kpawo.
Paulo kɛ Troia asafo lɛ ye shɛɛ Shi otsi lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ be ni wɔbabua wɔhe naa koni amɛye suɔmɔ niyenii lɛ, Paulo wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni ekã wiemɔ lɛ he kɛyashi nyɔɔŋteŋ, ejaakɛ kɛ je tsɛre lɛ ebaayi mli.
Ni asu kanei pii yɛ ŋwɛitsu lɛ mli he ni amɛbua amɛhe naa yɛ lɛ.
Shi oblanyo ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Eutiko lɛ ta samflɛ naa, ni wɔ ni tsii loo lɛ, ejaakɛ Paulo wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ jɛkɛ, ni wɔ ni emɔ lɛ lɛ sɔŋŋ hã ekpa kɛjɛ sɔɔdoi etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ ebagbee shi, ni ayawo lɛ ni egbo.
Ni Paulo kpeleke shi, ni eyabu enɔ, ni efua lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛkafea hoo, ejaakɛ wala yɛ emli.” Ni be ni ekwɔ kɛba ekoŋŋ lɛ, ebakumɔ aboloo lɛ, ni eye eko, ni ekã he ewie aahu kɛyashi jetsɛremɔ wɛlɛŋŋ, kɛkɛ ni eyi mli.
Ni amɛkɛ gbekɛ lɛ tee shĩa ni ehiɛ kã, ni amɛmii shɛ amɛhe naakpa.
Paulo jɛ Troia Kɛtee Mileto Shi wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ kɛtee lɛlɛ mli, ni wɔfã kɛtee Aso ni wɔyaŋɔ Paulo yɛ jɛi, ejaakɛ Paulo lɛ, lɛ lɛ ebaatsɔ̃ shikpɔŋ hewɔ lɛ bɔ ni eto ji no.
Ni be ni ebanina wɔ yɛ Aso lɛ, wɔwo lɛ ni wɔba Mitilene.
Ni wɔfa yɛ jɛi, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔbashɛ Kio ŋlɛnɔ.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ ekoŋŋ lɛ wɔbashɛ Samo, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔba Mileto.
Ejaakɛ Paulo ekpɛ mli akɛ eeeho Efeso he, bɔ ni afee ni ekatsɛ yɛ Asia; ejaakɛ eeye oyai ni kɛ aaaho lɛ, eyashɛ Yerusalɛm Pentekoste gbi lɛ.
Paulo kɛ Efeso onukpai lɛ ye shɛɛ Ni ejɛ Mileto etsu Efeso ayakpee asafo lɛ mli onukpai lɛ abahã lɛ.
Ni be ni amɛba eŋɔɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛle bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ mikɛ nyɛ hi shi be muu lɛ fɛɛ, kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi nɔ ni miba Asia nɛɛ, ni mikɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ kɛ yaafonui pii kɛ kai ni ba minɔ yɛ Yudafoi akawoi lɛ amli lɛ sɔmɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ; bɔ ni mishiuuu nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ hã nyɛ nɔ, ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ faŋŋ kɛ shĩa fɛɛ shĩa hu; ni miye odase mitsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ akɛ amɛkpale kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni amɛhe wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu nɔ amɛye.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, naa, efi mi yɛ mumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ miiya Yerusalɛm, ni mileee nɔ ni baaba minɔ yɛ jɛi, akɛ ja nɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yeɔ odase faŋŋ yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ nɔ ekɛɔ akɛ tsuŋwoo kɛ amanehului mɛɔ mi lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ mibuuu miwala akɛ ejara wa hã mi, bɔ ni afee ni mikɛ miishɛɛ agbe migbɛnyiɛmɔ lɛ kɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni mina yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu dɛŋ akɛ miye Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ he odase faŋŋ lɛ naa.
“Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ naa, mile akɛ, nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni minyiɛ nyɛteŋ mishiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ, nyɛnaŋ mihiɛ dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, akɛ miyeee nyɛteŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko lá yi sɔ̃; ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo muu lɛ fɛɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni mishiuuu eko nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛlea nyɛhenɔkwɛmɔ kɛ toiku lɛ fɛɛ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ewo nyɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, koni nyɛlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá he lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ, kɛ mikpa mihe lɛ, klãji fulɔi baabote nyɛteŋ, ni amɛbaŋ toiku lɛ yi.
Ni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛteŋ hu lɛ, hii ni wieɔ nii ni ejaaa aaate shi, ni amɛaakpala kaselɔi lɛ amɛshwie amɛsɛɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛsaraa, ni nyɛkaia akɛ afii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ mikɛ yaafonui efɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɔkɔbɔɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ.
“Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, miitu nyɛ miiwo Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ wiemɔ lɛ dɛŋ; lɛ eyɔɔ hewalɛ ni ekɛaahã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni ekɛ gboshinii lɛ ahã nyɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ ateŋ.
Mihiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko jwiɛtɛi loo shika loo atade nɔ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nii ni hiaa mi kɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ, nɛkɛ niji nɛɛ nɔŋŋ tsu he nii.
