Mikɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nakai sa akɛ atsu nii ni akɛye abua mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ, ni akai Nuŋtsɔ Yesu wiemɔi ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewie lɛ akɛ, ‘Nɔhãmɔ mli yɛ jɔɔmɔ fe hemɔ.’ ” Be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, ekula shi ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ sɔle.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo bloblo naakpa, ni amɛgbeegbee Paulo kuɛ nɔ, ni amɛshwɔshwɔɔ enaa.
Ni nɔ ni dɔ amɛ titri ji wiemɔ ni ewie akɛ amɛnaŋ ehiɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Ni amɛyajie lɛ gbɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli.
Paulo tee Yerusalɛm Agbɛnɛ be ni wɔkɛ amɛ gbala mli lɛ, wɔfã ni wɔnyiɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛba Ko, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔkɛba Rodo, ni wɔjɛ jɛi wɔba Patara.
Wɔna lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Foinikia ni wɔbote mli ni wɔkɛshwie nɔ.
Shi be ni Kipro tua wɔhiɛ lɛ, wɔtswa lɛ wɔfɔ̃ abɛku ni wɔba Siria, ni wɔbakpeleke yɛ Tiro; ejaakɛ jɛi abaajie lɛlɛ lɛ mli nii yɛ.
Be ni wɔbana kaselɔi lɛ, wɔhi jɛi gbii kpawo; ni amɛtsɔ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ amɛkɛɛ Paulo akɛ ekaya Yerusalɛm.
Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni wɔye gbii lɛ tã lɛ, wɔkɛshwie nɔ, ni amɛ kɛ amɛŋamɛi kɛ amɛbii fɛɛ bajie wɔ gbɛ kɛyashi maŋ lɛ klotia; ni wɔkula shi yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni wɔsɔle.
Wɔyeyee shɛɛ ni wɔbote lɛlɛ mli; ni amɛ hu amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛtee amɛshĩai.
Shi wɔ lɛ wɔjɛ Tiro wɔba Ptolemai.
Ni wɔyaŋa nyɛmimɛi lɛ, ni wɔkɛ amɛ hi shi gbi kome.
Enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔyiŋ kɛtee Kaisarea, ni wɔyabote Sanekpakpashiɛlɔ Filipo ni ji mɛi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome lɛ we, ni wɔkɛ lɛ hi shi.
Ni eyɛ biyei oblayei ejwɛ ni gbaa.
Be ni wɔhi shi gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ, gbalɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Agabo lɛ jɛ Yudea ba; ni be ni eba wɔŋɔɔ lɛ, ekɔ Paulo hɛfiinɔ lɛ ni ekɛfi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji kɛ enaji ekɛɛ, “Bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ nɛ, ‘Nuu mɔ nɔ̃ ni ji hɛfiinɔ nɛɛ, nɛkɛ Yudafoi lɛ baafi lɛ yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni amɛaaŋɔ lɛ amɛwo jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ.’ ” Be ni wɔnu enɛ lɛ wɔkɛ jɛibii lɛ fɛɛ kpa Paulo fai akɛ ekaya Yerusalɛm lɛ.
Shi ehere nɔ ekɛɛ, “Mɛni nyɛfeɔ nɛɛ, nyɛmiifo ni nyɛkɛmiiwo mi awerɛho?
Mi lɛ, jeee fii kɛkɛ misaa mihe mito, shi moŋ gbele diɛŋtsɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi lɛ hewɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm.” Shi akɛni eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔfee diŋŋ wɔkɛɛ, “Afee bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ.” Ni nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ wɔto wɔnii, ni wɔyiŋ kɛtee Yerusalɛm.
Ni kaselɔi ni jɛ Kaisarea lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi kɛ wɔ tee, ni amɛhã wɔyato Mnason, Kipronyo ko ni ji kaselɔ kɛjɛ jeeŋmɔ lɛ, ŋɔɔ.
Paulo yasara Yakobo Be ni wɔshɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ, nyɛmimɛi lɛ here wɔ atuu.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Paulo kɛ wɔ tee Yakobo ŋɔɔ; ni onukpai lɛ fɛɛ hu yɛ jɛi.
Eŋa amɛ, ni egba amɛ nibii ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ etsu yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ ekomekome.
Shi be ni amɛnu lɛ, amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Anyɛmi, kwɛmɔ Yudafoi akpei abɔ ni ehe eye nɛɛ, ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Mla lɛ he hiɛdɔlɔi ji amɛ.
Shi abatã ohe sane ahã amɛ akɛ otsɔ̃ɔ Yudafoi ni yɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ akɛ amɛkwa Mose, ni okɛɔ akɛ amɛkafolɔ amɛbii aketia, ni asaŋ amɛkanyiɛ amɛkusumi asɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ?
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, amɛaanu akɛ oba.
No hewɔ lɛ, feemɔ nɔ ni wɔkɛɔ bo nɛɛ.
Wɔyɛ hii ejwɛ ni ewo shi.
Ŋɔɔ amɛ ni okɛ amɛ fɛɛ ayatsuu nyɛhe, ni owo nɔ ni ahãa lɛ ohã amɛ, koni amɛshɛ amɛyi, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ baana akɛ saji ni abagbaa yɛ ohe lɛ eko eko bɛ mli, shi moŋ bo diɛŋtsɛ tete obaa ojeŋ yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni oyeɔ nɔ.
Shi jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ehe eye lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔŋma ni wɔkpɛ mli akɛ amɛkaye nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ eko nɔ, shi moŋ amɛhi wɔji afɔlei kɛ lá kɛ kooloi ni ashɔ̃tɔ̃ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛkɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni Paulo ŋɔ hii lɛ, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ be ni ekɛ amɛ fɛɛ etsuu amɛhe lɛ, ebote Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni eyatsɔ̃ɔ beyinɔ ni hetsuumɔ gbii lɛ anaagbee lɛ baashɛ ni abaashã afɔle ahã amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Amɔ Paulo yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ Shi be ni eshwɛ fioo ni aaagbe gbii kpawo lɛ naa lɛ, Yudafoi ni jɛ Asia lɛ na lɛ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, ni amɛta asafo lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni amɛbamɔ lɛ; ni amɛbolɔ akɛ, “Ataamɛi Israelbii, nyɛbafataa wɔhe!
Naa nuu lɛ ni wieɔ maŋ nɛɛ kɛ Mla lɛ kɛ biɛ nɛɛ he efɔŋ etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ; ni esaa ekɛ Helabii eba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ekɛbabule He Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ hu.” Ejaakɛ amɛna lɛ kɛ Trofimo ni jɛ Efeso lɛ yɛ maŋ lɛ mli momo hewɔ lɛ amɛsusu akɛ Paulo kɛ lɛ ba Sɔlemɔ we lɛ.
Ni maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ bu, ni maŋbii lɛ sha foi kɛbabua mɛhe naa; ni amɛmɔ Paulo amɛgbala lɛ kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ kɛje kpo, ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ aŋamɔ shinai lɛ.
Shi be ni amɛheɔ lɛ amɛgbe lɛ, ayatswa asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ adafi akɛ Yerusalɛm fɛɛ efee gidigidi.
Ni amrɔ lɛ eŋɔ asraafoi kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi ni ekɛ amɛ kpeleke shi kɛ foi kɛbanina amɛ.
Be ni amɛna asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ɔ Paulo yii.
Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ tsi bɛŋkɛ ni emɔ emli, ni efã akɛ awo lɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔi enyɔ, ni ebi mɔ ni ji lɛ kɛ nɔ ni efee.
Shi be ni asafo lɛ mli mɛi komɛi miibolɔ miikɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, mɛi komɛi hu miibolɔ miikɛɛ nɔ kroko.
Ni akɛni hoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ enyɛɛɛ ena anɔkwale lɛ, efã akɛ akɛ lɛ aya mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Ni be ni eshɛ atrakpoi lɛ anaa lɛ, eba mli akɛ asafo lɛ gidigidifeemɔ hewɔ lɛ asraafoi lɛ wo lɛ, ejaakɛ maŋbii asafo yuu lɛ nyiɛ sɛɛ miibolɔ akɛ, “Akɛ lɛ aya!” Shi be ni akɛ Paulo baabote mɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ebi asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ akɛ, “Ani miyɛ hegbɛ akɛ mikɛ bo wieɔ wiemɔ ko lo?” Ebi lɛ akɛ, “Ole Hela wiemɔ?
Belɛ jeee bo ji Ijiptnyo lɛ ni nyɛsɛɛ nɛɛ ni ekɛ atuatsemɔ ba ni ekpala hii awuyelɔi akpei ejwɛ eshwie esɛɛ kɛtee ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ?” Ni Paulo kɛɛ, “Mi lɛ Yudanyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Tarso, Kilikia maŋ ko ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ mli.
Shi miikpa bo fai; ŋmɛɛ mi gbɛ ni mikɛ maŋ lɛ awie.” Ni be ni eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ lɛ, Paulo damɔ atrakpoi lɛ anɔ, ni efɔ̃ maŋ lɛ nine; ni be ni jɛi jɔ koniŋŋ lɛ, ewie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli ekɛɛ.
Paulo jie enaa “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, nyɛboa minaa ni mibajie matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ toi.” Ni be ni amɛnu akɛ Hebri wiemɔ ekɛ amɛ wieɔ lɛ, amɛfee diŋŋ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Yudanyo ji mi, ni afɔ mi yɛ Tarso yɛ Kilikia moŋ, shi maŋ nɛɛ mli alɛ mi yɛ, ni Gamaliel naji anaa atsɔse mi yɛ, yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ amla lɛ naa fitsofitso, ni mihiɛ dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sane he, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛfeɔ ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ; ni miwaa nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yi kɛyashiɔ gbele mli, ni mifimɔ̃ɔ hii kɛ yei fɛɛ mihãa ni ayawoɔ amɛ tsuŋ, bɔ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ tete kɛ onukpai lɛ fɛɛ aaanyɛ aye mi odase.
Amɛdɛŋ miŋɔ woji kɛjɛ ni kulɛ mikɛyaahã nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ, ni miyafimɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ hu kɛba Yerusalɛm koni agbala amɛ toi.
“Shi eba mli akɛ, be ni minyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ ni mibabɛŋkɛ Damasko aaafee huludãamɔ mli lɛ, trukaa lɛ la ko ni kpɛmɔ naa wa jɛ ŋwɛi babɔle mi; ni miflɛo migbee shi ni minu gbee ko kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?’ Ni mihere nɔ akɛ, ‘Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?’ Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Mi Yesu, Nazarenyo lɛ ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ ni.’ Shi mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ na la lɛ, shi mɔ ni kɛ mi wieɔ lɛ, amɛnuuu egbee.
Ni mikɛɛ, ‘Mɛni mafee, Nuŋtsɔ?’ Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Tee shi ni oya Damasko, ni jɛi aaatsɔ̃ɔ bo nibii fɛɛ ni ato akɛ ofee lɛ yɛ.’ Ni akɛni minaaa nii dɔŋŋ yɛ nakai la lɛ kpɛmɔ hewɔ lɛ, mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ mɔ minine mli amɛyawa mi Damasko.
“Shi nuu ko yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ Anania ni esheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ wieɔ ehe ekpakpa.
Lɛ eba miŋɔɔ, ni ebadamɔ mimasɛi ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Anyɛmi Saul, naa nii!’ Ni nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ mina lɛ faŋŋ.
Ni ekɛɛ, ‘Wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehala bo eto, ni ole esuɔmɔnaanii, ni ona Nyɔŋmɔ Jalɔ lɛ, ni onu edaaŋ gbee; ejaakɛ obaatsɔ ehe odasefonyo koni oye nii fiaa ni ona ni onu lɛ ahe odase otsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ mɛɛba oshashaoɔ shi?
Tee shi ni ohã abaptisi bo, ni afɔ ohe eshai lɛ ashwie ahã bo, ni osɔle otsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
“Ni eba mli akɛ, be ni miku misɛɛ kɛba Yerusalɛm ekoŋŋ ni misɔleɔ yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, efee tamɔ nɔ ni nɔ enyɔ minɔ, ni mina Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Feemɔ kpa ni oje Yerusalɛm oya, ejaakɛ amɛboŋ mihe odase ni oyeɔ lɛ toi.’ Ni mikɛɛ, ‘Nuŋtsɔ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛle akɛ mi ji mɔ nɔŋŋ ni sa lɛ miwoɔ mɛi ni heɔ onɔ yeɔ lɛ tsuŋ, ni miyiɔ amɛ yɛ kpeehe fɛɛ kpeehe lɛ.
Ni be ni ashwie Stefano, ohe odaseyelɔ lɛ, lá shi lɛ, mi hu midamɔ jɛi, ni mina egbele lɛ he tsui, ni mibu mɛi ni gbe lɛ lɛ atadei lɛ ahe.’ Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, ‘Yaa, ejaakɛ mibatsu bo jeŋmaji lɛ ni yɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ aŋɔɔ.’ ” Paulo, Romanyo lɛ Ni amɛbo lɛ toi kɛbashi nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ nɔ, ni amɛwo amɛgbee nɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Akɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ aje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ!
Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ ehiɔ jeŋ.” Shi be ni amɛbolɔɔ ni amɛkpɔlɔɔ amɛhe atadei ni amɛgbɛɔ mlu amɛshwãa kɔɔyɔɔ mli lɛ, asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ fã akɛ akɛ lɛ aya mɔɔ lɛ mli, ni ekɛɛ akɛ akɛ kpelebii atao eyitsoŋ koni ena ele nɔ sane hewɔ ni Yudafoi bolɔɔ amɛwoɔ lɛ nɛkɛ nɛɛ.
Shi be ni afi lɛ ni abaayi lɛ lɛ, Paulo bi asafoiatsɛ ni damɔ shi lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyɛ hegbɛ akɛ nyɛyiɔ Romanyo ko ni abuko lɛ fɔ kɛ kpelebii lo?” Be ni asafoiatsɛ lɛ nu enɛ lɛ, etee asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛni obaafee nɛɛ?
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ Romanyo ni.” Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ba ni ebabi lɛ akɛ “Kɛɛmɔ mi, ani Romanyo ji bo lo?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Hɛɛ.” Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ here nɔ akɛ, “Shika pii mikɛhe nɛkɛ maŋnyotsɔmɔ nɛɛ.” Ni Paulo kɛɛ, “Shi mi lɛ, fɔ akɛfɔ mi.” Kɛkɛ ni amrɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mɛi ni yaatao eyitsoŋ lɛ je emasɛi ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ hu, akɛni efi lɛ hewɔ lɛ, be ni ena ele akɛ Romanyo ji Paulo lɛ, eshe gbeyei.
Shi akɛni eetao ele nɔ hewɔ krɛdɛɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ folɔɔ enaa hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ efɛne lɛ, ni efã akɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ aba, ni ekɛ Paulo kpeleke shi, ni ekɛ lɛ yadamɔ amɛhiɛ.
Paulo kɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ wie Ni Paulo tɛje ehiɛ ekwɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ kɛkpe ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi!
Mi lɛ, henilee kpakpa sɔŋŋ mikɛba mijeŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ.” Shi osɔfonukpa Anania lɛ fã mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ akɛ agba enaabu ma.
Kɛkɛ ni Paulo kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Ma kɛ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ aaagba bo, bo gbogbo ni asha he!
Ota shi ookojo mi yɛ Mla lɛ naa, ni osaa ojeɔ Mla lɛ sɛɛ ofãa ni agba mi mã?” Shi mɛi ni damɔ emasɛi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ee!
Kwɛɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ osɔfonukpa lɛ ojɛɔ nɛɛ?” Ni Paulo kɛɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, mileee akɛ osɔfonukpa ni ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, ‘Kaawie omaŋ onukpa he efɔŋ.’ ” Shi be ni Paulo yoo akɛ amɛfã kome lɛ Sadukifoi ni, ni amɛfã kroko lɛ Farisifoi ni lɛ, ebo yɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ teŋ akɛ, “Anyɛmimɛi, naa, mi lɛ Farisifonyo ji mi kɛ Farisifonyo bi hu.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ hewɔ akojoɔ mi nɛɛ.” Be ni ewie nɛkɛ lɛ, bei ba Farisifoi lɛ kɛ Sadukifoi lɛ ateŋ, ni asafo lɛ mli gba enyɔ.
Ejaakɛ Sadukifoi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ ni asaŋ ŋwɛi bɔfo loo mumɔ ko hu bɛ; shi Farisifoi lɛ kɛɔ akɛ enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.
Ni blɔmɔ babaoo bate shi, ni mlatsɔɔlɔi lɛ ni yɔɔ Farisifoi lɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ te shi ni amɛbe amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔnaaa nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ he; shi kɛji aleenɔ mumɔ ko loo ŋwɛi bɔfo ko kɛ lɛ ewie lɛ, no lɛ (nyɛkahãa wɔkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miinɔa.
)” Shi be ni bei lɛ mli wa lɛ, asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ she gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ amɛaatserɛ Paulo mli hewɔ lɛ, efã asraafoi lɛ akɛ amɛkpeleke shi ni amɛyashɔ̃ lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aba mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Shi enɔ nyɔɔŋ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ badamɔ emasɛi ni ekɛɛ, “Paulo, hã otsui anyɔ omli, ejaakɛ bɔ ni oye mihe odase yɛ Yerusalɛm nɛɛ, ja oyaye odase nakai nɔŋŋ yɛ Roma hu.” Atee Paulo yinɔ apam Shi be ni je tsɛre lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ kpãŋ ni amɛkãmɔ kitãi akɛ amɛyeŋ nii ni asaŋ amɛnuŋ nɔ ko ja amɛgbe Paulo dã.
Mɛi ni kpãŋ ni amɛkãmɔ amɛhe kitãi nɛɛ fe gbɔmɛi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Ni amɛtee osɔfonukpai kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ aŋɔ̃ɔ amɛyakɛɛ, “Wɔkɛ kitãkãmɔ ekpãŋ akɛ wɔsaŋ wɔnaa nɔ ko nɔ ko ja wɔgbe Paulo dã.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ akwaashɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ ayakɛa asafoiatsɛ nukpa lɛ, koni (wɔ lɛ) ekɛ lɛ akpeleke shi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, tamɔ nɔ ni esane lɛ mli nyɛbaatao fitsofitso, shi wɔ lɛ, dani eeeshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, wɔsaa wɔhe ni wɔgbe lɛ.” Shi Paulo nyɛmi yoo bi ko nu amɛkawoo nɛɛ he, ni eyiŋ kɛtee mɔɔ lɛ mli eyatswa Paulo adafi.
Ni Paulo tsɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Ŋɔɔ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ ni okɛ lɛ aya asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyɛ sane ko ni eyaakɛɛ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni eŋɔ lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ tee asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ ni eyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ “Gboklɛfonyo Paulo lɛ tsɛ mi kɛtee eŋɔɔ, ni ekpa mi fai akɛ mikɛ nɛkɛ oblanyo nɛɛ aba oŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ eyɛ sane ko ni ebaakɛɛ bo” Ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ mɔ enine mli ni ekɛ lɛ tee afã, ni eyabi lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛ sane oyɔɔ ni obaakɛɛ mi?” Ni ekɛɛ, “Yudafoi lɛ efee ekome akɛ amɛbaakpa bo fai, ni wɔ ni okɛ Paulo akpeleke shi kɛba akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, tamɔ nɔ ni esane lɛ mli amɛbaatao fitsofitso.
Shi bo lɛ, kaakpɛlɛ̃ amɛ ejaakɛ amɛteŋ mɛi fe nyɔŋmai ejwɛ ewo lɛ ka, ni amɛkãmɔ amɛhe kitã akɛ amɛyeŋ nii ni asaŋ amɛnuŋ nɔ ko ja amɛgbe lɛ dã; ni agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛsaa amɛhe, ni amɛmiibo onaa wiemɔ toi.” Kɛkɛ ni asafoiatsɛnukpa lɛ wo oblanyo lɛ gbɛ, ni ewo lɛ akpɔ akɛ, “Kaakɛɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko akɛ otsi sane nɛɛ tã otsɔ̃ɔ mi.” Akɛ Paulo yahã Amralo Felike Ni etsɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi lɛ ateŋ mɛi enyɔ kɛba eŋɔɔ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛsaa asraafoi ohai enyɔ kɛ okpoŋɔiatsɛmɛi nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ akplɔiatsɛmɛi hu ohai enyɔ ni amɛya Kaisarea gbɛkɛ ŋmɛlɛ nɛɛhu mli.
Nyɛsaa kooloi hu nyɛtoa ni ahã Paulo ata nɔ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ ayahã Amralo Felike shweshweeshwe.” Ni eŋma wolo ni ekɛɛ yɛ mli akɛ, “Klaudio Lisia miibi amralo jurɔ Felike jogbaŋŋ!
Nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ, Yudafoi lɛ mɔ lɛ ni kulɛ amɛbaagbe lɛ, shi be ni mina mile akɛ Romanyo ji lɛ lɛ, mikɛ asraafoi lɛ tee miyashɔ̃ lɛ.
Shi akɛni miitao male nɔ sane hewɔ ni amɛfolɔɔ enaa lɛ, mikɛ lɛ tee amɛkuashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ, ni mina akɛ amɛmla lɛ he ŋwanejee saji komɛi ahewɔ amɛfolɔɔ enaa lɛ, shi sane ko ni sa gbele loo tsuŋwoo bɛ ehe.
Shi be ni abatswa mi adafi akɛ Yudafoi lɛ ewo nuu lɛ ka lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mitsu akɛ akɛ lɛ aba oŋɔ̃ɔ, ni mifã enaaflɔlɔi lɛ hu akɛ amɛba ohiɛ ni amɛbajaje saji ni amɛkɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.” Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ ŋɔ Paulo tamɔ bɔ ni afã amɛ lɛ, ni amɛnyiɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli amɛkɛ lɛ ba Antipatri.
Ni je tsɛre lɛ amɛhã okpɔŋɔiatsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ tee, ni amɛ lɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Be ni amɛshɛ Kaisarea ni amɛkɛ wolo lɛ yahã amralo lɛ, amɛkɛ Paulo hu badamɔ ehiɛ.
Amralo lɛ kane wolo lɛ, ni ebi lɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni ejɛ; ni be ni ena ele akɛ Kilikia ejɛ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Kɛ onaafolɔlɔi lɛ hu ba lɛ, no dani mabo bo toi jogbaŋŋ.” Ni efã akɛ akɛ lɛ ato Herode mɔɔ lɛ mli.
Yudafoi lɛ folɔ Paulo naa No sɛɛ gbii enumɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpa, Anania kɛ maŋ onukpai lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mlalelɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ Tertulo lɛ ba jɛi, ni amɛbajaje Paulo he sane amɛtsɔ̃ɔ amralo lɛ.
Ayatsɛ Paulo kɛba, ni Tertulo bɔ̃i enaaflɔmɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Lumɔ Felike, oyinɔ nɛɛ wɔtoiŋ ejɔ wɔ babaoo, ni asaŋ oshɔŋŋ ninamɔ naa lɛ, nibii pii eba hiŋmɛi nɔ yɛ nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ.
Wɔheɔ enɛ fɛɛ kɛ shidaa pii yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni misane sɛɛ akajɛkɛ tuutu ko hewɔ lɛ, miikpa bo fai ni obo wɔ toi fioo yɛ omlihilɛ naa.
Wɔna nuu nɛɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni fiteɔ mɛi ayiŋ ni emuɔ atuatsemɔ mumɔ ewoɔ Yudafoi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ eji Nazaremɛi akuu lɛ naa kpãa.
Eka Sɔlemɔ we lɛ bulemɔ, ni wɔmɔ lɛ, [ni kulɛ wɔmiitao wɔkojo lɛ yɛ wɔMla lɛ naa.
Shi asafoiatsɛnukpa Lisia ba ni ebashɔ̃ lɛ yɛ wɔdɛŋ ekãa naa, ni ekɛ lɛ tee, ni efã enaaflɔlɔi lɛ akɛ amɛba oŋɔɔ], ni kɛji bo diɛŋtsɛ obi enaa sane lɛ, ooona saji ni wɔfolɔɔ enaa yɛ hewɔ lɛ fɛɛ.” Ni Yudafoi lɛ hu ká mli wao ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ saji nɛɛ yɛ mli nakai.
Paulo naajiemɔ Kɛkɛ ni amralo lɛ fɔ̃ Paulo nine akɛ ewie, ni ewo enaa nɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Akɛni mile akɛ ojɛ oye shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ amralo etsɛ hewɔ lɛ, mina tsuijurɔ ni mikɛaajie minaa.
Kɛ obi mli lɛ, ooona akɛ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ pɛ nɛ ni mibaho Yerusalɛm akɛ miyaja Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni asaŋ amɛnako mi dã akɛ mikɛ mɛi miitaa naa aloo miibú mɛi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, loo kpeehei lɛ, loo maŋ lɛ mli, ni asaŋ saji ni amɛkɛshwieɔ minɔ nɛɛ, amɛnyɛŋ naa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Shi nɔ ni migbaa mli faŋŋ mikɛɔ bo ji enɛ akɛ, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni amɛtsɛɔ lɛ akɛ amaletsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ naa mijaa wɔtsɛmɛi aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ, miheɔ nibii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli lɛ miyeɔ, ni miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni mɛnɛɛmɛi hu kwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ gbohiiashitee baaba lɛ, ni jalɔi kɛ mɛi ni ejaaa fɛɛ baate shi.
Enɛ hewɔ mikɛ mihe efɔ̃ɔɔ shi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mana henilee ni sɔ̃ ko wulaaa lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ amli.
“Shi afii pii asɛɛ lɛ miba ni mikɛ nikeenii abahã mimaŋ lɛ ni mashã afɔle hu.
Enɛ feemɔ mli amɛna mi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ akɛ mitsuu mihe, shi amɛnaaa mi kɛ asafo ko lɛ, amɛnaaa mi kɛ hoofeemɔ ko hu.
Shi Yudafoi komɛi ni jɛ Asia lɛ yɛ jɛi, ni sa akɛ kulɛ amɛba ohiɛ, ni kɛ amɛyɛ mihe sane ko lɛ ni amɛbajaje.
Aloo mɛnɛɛmɛi diɛŋtsɛ po kɛ amɛna sane ko ni ejaaa yɛ mihe be ni midãmɔ akwaashɔŋ lɛ hiɛ lɛ, amɛkɛɛ; akɛ ja nɛkɛ wiemɔ kome ni be ni midamɔ amɛteŋ ni mibo akɛ, ‘Gbohiiashitee hewɔ nyɛkojoɔ mi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ’ lɛ kɛkɛ.” Shi akɛni Felike le nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sane pɛpɛɛpɛ hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛ eto, ni ekɛɛ, “Kɛji asafoiatsɛnukpa Lisia ba lɛ, makwɛ nyɛsane lɛ maye.” Ni efã asafoiatsɛ lɛ akɛ ekɛ Paulo ayato, ni ehã ena hejɔlɛ, ni kɛ ehe gbɔmɛi miiba lɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ loo saramɔ lɛ ekatsi amɛ gbɛ.
Paulo yɛ Felike kɛ Drusila hiɛ Gbii kplaŋŋ sɛɛ lɛ, Felike kɛ eŋa Drusila ni ji Yudayoo lɛ ba, ni ehã ayatsɛ Paulo kɛba, ni ebo Kristo nɔhemɔkɛyeli sane lɛ toi be ni Paulo wieɔ he lɛ.
Shi be ni ewieɔ jalɛ kɛ henɔkwɛmɔ kɛ kojomɔ ni baaba lɛ he lɛ, Felike she gbeyei pam, ni ekɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yaa fɛɛ da; shi kɛ mina mihe dekã jiŋŋ, matsɛ bo ekoŋŋ.” Shi asaŋ ehiɛ kã nɔ akɛ Paulo aaahã lɛ shika ni eŋmɛɛ ehe; no hewɔ lɛ, etsɛɔ lɛ kpitiokpitio ni ekɛ lɛ bagbaa sane.
Shi afii enyɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Porkio Festo ba baye Felike najiaŋ; ni akɛni Felike miisumɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni sa Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ hewɔ lɛ, eshi Paulo yɛ tsu lɛ mli.
Paulo kɛ esane lɛ hã Kaisare yeli Be ni Festo baye amralo lɛ, enɔ gbii etɛ̃ pɛ ni ejɛ Kaisarea etee Yerusalɛm.
Kɛkɛ ni osɔfonukpai kɛ Yudafoi lɛ anukpai lɛ bafolɔ Paulo naa amɛhã lɛ, ni amɛkpa lɛ fai akɛ amɛmiitao ni ekwɛ amɛhiɛ ni etsu ni ayaŋɔ Paulo kɛba Yerusalɛm ejaakɛ amɛwo ka koni amɛgbe lɛ yɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni Festo here nɔ akɛ Paulo yɛ tsuŋ yɛ Kaisarea, shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu etsɛŋ ni ebaaya jɛi.
Hewɔ lɛ ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhãa nyɛteŋ hiɛnaanɔbii lɛ kɛ mi ayaa jɛi ni kɛ sane fɔŋ ko yɛ nuu lɛ he lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ.” Ni be ni eye aaafee gbii kpaanyɔ loo nyɔŋma yɛ amɛŋɔ̃ɔ lɛ, eyiŋ etee Kaisarea, ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ eyata kojomɔsɛi lɛ nɔ, ni efã akɛ akɛ Paulo aba.
Be ni eba lɛ, Yudafoi ni jɛ Yerusalɛm ba lɛ babɔle lɛ kɛkpe, ni amɛkɛ naafolɔmɔi pii ni mli wa bashwie enɔ, shi amɛnyɛɛɛ naa amɛtsɔ̃ɔ.
Paulo jie enaa ekɛɛ “Mitɔ̃ko Yudafoi amla ko nɔ lɛ, asaŋ mitɔ̃ko Sɔlemɔ we lɛ loo Kaisare nɔ hu.” Shi akɛni Festo miisumɔ akɛ efee nɔ ni sa Yudafoi lɛ ahiɛ hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ Paulo akɛ, “Oosumɔ akɛ oya Yerusalɛm ni miyakojo bo yɛ jɛmɛ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ ahewɔ lo?” Shi Paulo kɛɛ, “Kaisare kojomɔsɛi lɛ hiɛ midamɔ nɛɛ, he ni sa akɛ akojoɔ mi yɛ lɛ.
Yudafoi lɛ, mitɔ̃ko amɛnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni ole jogbaŋŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miye sane fɔŋ ko ni mifee nɔ ko ni sa gbele lɛ, mikãmãaa gbele; shi kɛ saji ni mɛnɛɛmɛi folɔɔ minaa yɛ he nɛɛ eko eko bɛ mli lɛ, mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛ mi awo amɛdɛŋ.
Mikɛ misane lɛ miihã Kaisare yeli.” Kɛkɛ ni Festo kɛ ajinafoi lɛ hala mli ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ni okɛ osane lɛ ehã Kaisare yeli nɛɛ, Kaisare ŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ oootee.” Akɛ Paulo ba Agripa hiɛ Ni gbii komɛi asɛɛ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa kɛ Bernike ba Kaisarea ni amɛbaŋa Festo.
Be ni amɛye gbii kplaŋŋ yɛ jɛi lɛ, Festo jaje Paulo sane lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Nuu ko yɛ biɛ ni Felike shi lɛ yɛ tsuŋ, ni be ni mitee Yerusalɛm lɛ, osɔfonukpai lɛ kɛ Yudafoi anukpai lɛ ba miŋɔɔ kɛ ehe naafolɔmɔ ni amɛkpa mi fai akɛ mibu lɛ fɔ; ni mito he mihã amɛ akɛ ebɛ Romabii amla mli akɛ ajɔɔ mɔ ko nɔ ahãa enaaflɔlɔi, ja mɔ ni afolɔ enaa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yafolɔ enaa lɛ ekpe hiɛ kɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ lɛ ena hegbɛ ejie enaa yɛ sane ni akɛfɔ enɔ lɛ hewɔ dã.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni amɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ biɛ lɛ, mikɛshashaooo shi, shi enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, miyata kojomɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ, ni mifã akɛ akɛ nuu lɛ aba.
Shi be ni enaaflɔlɔi lɛ badãmɔ shi lɛ, amɛkɛ saji ni misusu lɛ ateŋ ekome flo baaa ebafolɔɔɔ enaa, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnyɔŋmɔjamɔ he ŋwanejee saji komɛi kɛ Yesu ko ni egbo ni Paulo mã nɔ mi akɛ ehiɛ kã lɛ he saji amɛhiɛ kɛba.
Ni akɛni mileee bɔ ni mafee matao nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli hewɔ lɛ, mibi lɛ akɛ eesumɔ akɛ eya Yerusalɛm ni ayaye nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ yɛ jɛi lo?
Shi akɛni Paulo bi akɛ akɛ lɛ ato ni Kaisare diɛŋtsɛ ayaye esane lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mifã akɛ akɛ lɛ ato kɛyashi beyinɔ ni mahã akɛ lɛ aya Kaisare ŋɔɔ.” Kɛkɛ ni Agripa kɛɛ Festo akɛ, “Kulɛ masumɔ akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ manu gbɔmɔ lɛ daaŋ wiemɔ.” Ni ekɛɛ, “Wɔ lɛ obaanu.” No hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, Agripa kɛ Bernike wula kiŋkaŋŋ kɛba ni amɛkɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi nukpai kɛ maŋ lɛ mli gbɔmɛi agboi lɛ babote sanetoiboohe lɛ, ni Festo fã, ni akɛ Paulo ba.
Ni Festo kɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Agripa kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛkɛ wɔ yɔɔ biɛ, nyɛmiina nuu nɛɛ ni Yudafoi asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ bakpa mi fai yɛ Yerusalɛm kɛ biɛ fɛɛ ni amɛbolɔ akɛ esaaa akɛ ehiɔ jeŋ dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi mi lɛ, mina akɛ efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele.
Ni akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu etu esane lɛ ewo Kaisare dɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, mikpɛ mli akɛ mahã akɛ lɛ aya.
Shi mibɛ sane krɛdɛɛ ko ni kulɛ maŋma mahã Kaisare; no hewɔ hu ni mikɛ lɛ ba nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ, ni titri lɛ bo Maŋtsɛ Agripa ohiɛ, bɔ ni afee ni kɛji atao sane lɛ mli lɛ, mana nɔ ko maŋma.
Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ ejaaa akɛ akɛ gboklɛfonyo ko majeɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔɔ nɔ ni akɛɛ efee.”
Paulo yɛ Agripa hiɛ Ni Agripa kɛɛ Paulo akɛ, “Aŋmɛ bo gbɛ akɛ okɔlɔ ogbee.” Kɛkɛ ni Paulo fɔ̃ enine ni ejie enaa ekɛɛ, “Maŋtsɛ Agripa, eji miishɛɛ sane kɛhã mi akɛ mibajie minaa ŋmɛnɛ yɛ ohiɛ, yɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Yudafoi lɛ folɔɔ minaa yɛ he lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ ole Yudafoi lɛ akusumi kɛ ŋwanejee saji lɛ fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa bo fai ni oŋmɛ otsui shi obo mi toi.
“Yudafoi lɛ fɛɛ le mijeŋba kɛjɛ miblahiaŋ, bɔ ni mihi mimaŋ lɛ mli kɛ Yerusalɛm mihã tsutsu lɛ.
Ni kɛji amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛaaye he odase lɛ, amɛle mi sa kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ akɛ miba mijeŋ yɛ wɔjamɔ lɛ mli kuu ni yɔɔ veveeve fe fɛɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ naa akɛ Farisifonyo.
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, shi ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ midãmɔ biɛ ni akojoɔ mi nɛɛ.
No nɔ wɔkutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ hiɛ kã akɛ amɛnine aaashɛ hewɔ ni amɛhiɛ jamɔ mli waa nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ.
Maŋtsɛ Agripa, nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ Yudafoi lɛ folɔɔ minãa nɛɛ.
Mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ ebɛ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teɔ gbohii ashi lɛ?
“Shi mi diɛŋtsɛ hu efee mi akɛ esa akɛ mafee nii pii kɛku Yesu Nazarenyo lɛ gbɛi lɛ naa; ni mina mifee nakai hu yɛ Yerusalɛm, ni akɛni mina hegbɛ yɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, miwo mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii atsuŋ, ni kɛ abaagbe amɛ lɛ minaa yɛ mli eko, ni mifɔɔ amɛ yiwaa yɛ kpeehei lɛ fɛɛ, ni minyɛɔ amɛnɔ akɛ amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi, ni miye amɛhe sɛkɛ ko ni wa, ni miwaa amɛyi kɛyaa majiasɛɛ.” Paulo gba etsuitsakemɔ he sane “Enɛ mli mihiɛ ni mifã gbɛ kɛmiiya Damasko yɛ osɔfonukpai lɛ ahewalɛ kɛ gbɛŋmɛɛ naa, ni shwane fintiŋŋ, be ni minyiɛ gbɛ lɛ nɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ, mina la ko ni kpɛɔ fe hulu jɛ ŋwɛi babɔle mi kɛ mɛi ni kɛ mi nyiɛ lɛ.
Ni be ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔgbeegbee shi lɛ, minu gbee ko kɛ mi wie yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Saul, Saul, mɛɛba owaa mi yi?
Ewa hã bo akɛ ooofã ntia oshi kooloi akpalamɔ tso lɛ naa dade lɛ.’ Ni mikɛɛ, ‘Bo namɔŋ, Nuŋtsɔ?’ Ni nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Mi Yesu ni owaa lɛ yi lɛ ni.
Shi tee shi ni odamɔ onaji anɔ; ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ bo nɛɛ, koni mafee bo sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ odasefonyo yɛ nibii ni ona kɛ nii ni mibajie mihe kpo matsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ hewɔ lɛ ahe.
Ni majie bo kɛjɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ni mitsuɔ bo kɛya amɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ adɛŋ, ni oyagbele amɛhiŋmɛii, koni amɛkpale kɛjɛ duŋ mli kɛba la he, kɛjɛ abonsam hewalɛ mli kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ̃ɔ, ni amɛna amɛhe eshaifaa kɛ gboshinii yɛ mɛi ni akɛ minɔ hemɔkɛyeli efee amɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ateŋ.’ ” Paulo gba enitsumɔ he sane “No hewɔ lɛ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa, migbooo nɔ ni ajie kpo kɛjɛ ŋwɛi atsɔɔ mi lɛ nɔ toi; shi moŋ mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ Damasko lɛ tsutsu, kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm kɛ Yuda shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ hu akɛ amɛtsake amɛtsui ni amɛkpale kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni amɛtsu nii ni sa tsuitsakemɔ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni Yudafoi lɛ mɔ mi yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ ni amɛka mi gbee.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yelikɛbuamɔ naa mikɛdamɔ shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ, ni miyeɔ odase mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji nɛɛ, ni miwieee wiemɔ ko akɛ ja nii ni gbalɔi lɛ kɛ Mose hu ewie akɛ ebaaba lɛ, bɔ ni Kristo lɛ baana amanehulu, bɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ mli ni ebaajaje la lɛ he sane etsɔɔ maŋ lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ.” Be ni Paulo jie enaa nɛkɛ lɛ, Festo kɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Paulo, sɛkɛ oyeɔ nɛɛ!
Woloŋkasemɔ sɔŋŋ ehã oyeɔ sɛkɛ nɛɛ!” Shi Paulo kɛɛ, “Miyeko sɛkɛ, Festo, lumɔ jurɔ, shi anɔkwale kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ wiemɔi miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ ni miwieɔ kɛ ekãa mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nɛɛ lɛ le saji nɛɛ amli; ni mikpaaa shi akɛ nibii nɛɛ eko yɛ ni akɛtee lɛ; ejaakɛ jeee teemɔ he ko afee enɛ yɛ.
Nto oheɔ gbalɔi lɛ oyeɔ, Maŋtsɛ Agripa?
Mile akɛ oheɔ oyeɔ.” Shi Agripa kɛɛ Paulo akɛ, “Shwɛ fioo ni ohã matsake mijwɛŋmɔ ni matsɔ̃ Kristofonyo.” Ni Paulo kɛɛ, “Mina ni kulɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hã ba mli akɛ, shwɛ fioo jio, shwɛ pii jio, jeee bo okome kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ mi toi ŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ hu tsɔ̃ tamɔ mi, shi gboklɛi nɛɛ eko kɛkɛ akawo amɛ!” Kɛkɛ ni maŋtsɛ lɛ kɛ amralo lɛ kɛ Bernike kɛ mɛi ni tara shi lɛ te shi, ni amɛtee afã ni amɛyawie yɛ amɛteŋ akɛ, “Nuu nɛɛ efeko nɔ ko ni sa gbele loo tsuŋwoo.” Ni Agripa kɛɛ Festo akɛ, “Eji nuu nɛɛ kɛ esane lɛ hãko Kaisare yeli kulɛ aaanyɛ ehe aŋmɛɛ.”
Akɛ Paulo tee Roma Ni be ni akpɛ mli akɛ wɔbaaya Italia lɛ, amɛŋɔ Paulo kɛ gboklɛfoi krokomɛi hu amɛwo asraafoiohaatsɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yulio ni jɛ Augusto asafo lɛ mli lɛ dɛŋ.
Shi be ni wɔbote Adramitio lɛlɛ ko ni baafã kɛyatsɔ̃ Asia ŋshɔnaa maji lɛ anɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔfã, ni Aristarko, Makedonianyo ni jɛ Tesalonika lɛ fata wɔhe.
Ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ wɔyamã Sidon, ni akɛni Yulio hiɛ Paulo dɔdɔɔdɔ hewɔ lɛ, eŋmɛ lɛ gbɛ akɛ eya eshieŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aŋɔɔ ni eyajɔɔ ehe.
Ni wɔfã yɛ jɛi lɛ wɔsharã Kipro meo lɛ ejaakɛ wɔmiikpee kɔɔyɔɔ.
Ni be ni wɔfo Kilikia kɛ Pamfilia ŋshɔ lɛ, wɔbamã Mira yɛ Likia.
Ni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ na Aleksandria lɛlɛ ko yɛ jɛi ni miiya Italia, ni ejie wɔ ewo no mli.
Wɔnyiɛ blɛoo gbii pii, ni ekpakpa ko dani wɔshɛ Knido ŋlɛnɔ, ni akɛni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ eŋmɛɛɛ wɔ gbɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔsharã Salmone meo lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Kreta shishigbɛ; ni ekpakpa ko dani wɔfo mli yɛ jɛi kɛba he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ Lɛji adaamɔhe Fɛɛfɛo ni bɛŋkɛ Lasea maŋ lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ wɔfite be pii, ni akɛni buadayeli be lɛ hu eho momo hewɔ lɛ; ŋshɔhiɛnyiɛmɔ efee gbeyei.
Hewɔ lɛ Paulo wo amɛ ŋaa ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi, mina akɛ amanehulu kɛ nilaajemɔ pii baaba gbɛfãa nɛɛ mli, ni jeee lɛlɛ mli nii lɛ kɛ lɛlɛ lɛ kɛkɛ hiɛ baakpãtã, shi moŋ wɔwala diɛŋtsɛ hu.” Shi asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ heɔ kudɔɔtsɛ lɛ kɛ lɛlɛtsɛ lɛ eyeɔ fe wiemɔi ni Paulo wieɔ lɛ.
Ni akɛni Lɛji adaamɔhe Fɛɛfɛo lɛ kãaa shi jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni aaanyɛ aye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ jɛi hewɔ lɛ, amɛteŋ mɛi pii wo ŋaa akɛ afã yɛ jɛi koni akwɛ akɛ aaanyɛ ashɛ Foinike ni ji Kreta Lɛji adaamɔhe ni kwɛɔ wuoyi-anai kɛ kooyi-anai gbɛ lɛ lo, koni aye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ jɛi.
Ahum fã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ Shi be ni wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ bɔ̃i tswaa nyrakee lɛ, efee amɛ akɛ nɔ ni amɛtaoɔ lɛ eba mli, ni amɛfã kɛsharã Kreta he kpaakpa.
Shi etsɛɛɛ kɛkɛ ni ahum ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ kooyi-bokã kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ fã kɛbakpee amɛ.
Ni be ni eta lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni enyɛɛɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ ekpee lɛ, wɔhã ekpala.
Ni be ni wɔkɛ foi sharã ŋshɔkpɔ fioo ni atsɛɔ lɛ Kauda lɛ meo lɛ, ekpakpa ko dani wɔnyɛ bonto lɛ wɔmɔ.
Amɛwo lɛ, ni amɛkɛ kpãi fimɔ lɛlɛ lɛ, ni akɛni amɛmiishe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ amɛaagbee shia nɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkpa abalaa lɛ, ni amɛkpala kɛkɛ.
Ni akɛni ahum lɛ miitswa wɔ gbeyeigbeyei naakpa hewɔ lɛ, enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, amɛ jie lɛlɛ lɛ mli nii lɛ eko amɛshwie; ni gbi ni ji etɛ̃ nɔ lɛ wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji jie lɛlɛ he nibii lɛ wɔshwie.
Wɔnaaa hulu loo ŋulamii gbii pii ni asaŋ jeee ahum fioo tswaa kɛkpeɔ wɔ lɛ, hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔhiɛ kãaa wala nɔ dɔŋŋ.
Shi be ni gbii pii eho ni wɔyeko nɔ ko lɛ, Paulo te shi edamɔ amɛteŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Ataamɛi, kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛboɔ mi toi ni akafã yɛ Kreta ni wɔbana amanehulu ni nibii laaje nɛkɛ.
Ni agbɛnɛ hu miiwo nyɛ ŋaa akɛ nyɛna tsui, ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yiwala tɔŋ, ja lɛlɛ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ nɛɛ mli lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ nɔ ni mi ji kɛ mɔ hu ni misɔ̃mɔɔ lɛ bɔfo badamɔ mimasɛi ni ekɛɛ, ‘Kaashe gbeyei, Paulo!
Ja akɛ bo yadãmɔ Kaisare hiɛ kɛ̃; ni naa, Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ bo yɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ eke bo.’ Hewɔ lɛ nyɛnaa tsui, Ataamɛi, ejaakɛ miheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ miyeɔ akɛ bɔ ni abakɛɛ mi lɛ, nakai baaba mli.
Shi bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, wɔɔyasha ŋshɔkpɔ ko nɔ kɛ̃.” Shi gbi ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ nyɔɔŋ lɛ wɔmiikpala kɛmiiya kɛmiiba yɛ Adria Ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni aaafee nyɔɔŋteŋ lɛ amlakui lɛ ajwɛŋmɔ kɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛbɛŋkɛ shikpɔŋ ko, ni amɛfɔ̃ susumɔ kpãa, ni amɛna abasaŋ nyɔŋmai enyɔ; ni be ni amɛtee amɛhiɛ fioo lɛ, amɛfɔ̃ ekoŋŋ ni amɛna abasaŋ nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛshe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ wɔɔyagbee tɛsai anɔ, ni amɛŋmɛ sɛkɛi ejwɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ sɛɛgbɛ, ni amɛmiishwe ni je atsɛre.
Shi be ni amlakui lɛ tao foi aje yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ mli ni amɛkwa amɛshi bonto lɛ amɛma ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ tamɔ nɔ ni sɛkɛi amɛyaaŋmɛ yɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yitsogbɛ lɛ, Paulo kɛɛ asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ kɛ asraafoi lɛ akɛ “Kɛji mɛnɛɛmɛi ehiii lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ anyɛŋ nyɛyiwala ahere.” Kɛkɛ ni asraafoi lɛ folɔ bonto lɛ he taŋkpei lɛ, ni amɛhã eyagbee shi.
Shi kɛbaa jetsɛremɔ mli lɛ, Paulo kpa amɛ fɛɛ fai akɛ amɛye nɔ ko ni ekɛɛ, “Gbii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ sɔŋŋ nɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko eyako nyɛdaaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛye nii ejaakɛ no aaahã nyɛyi ana wala, ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yitsɔi kome ejeŋ eyiteŋ enyɔŋ shi.” Ni be ni ekɛɛ nakai lɛ, ekɔ aboloo, ni eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ, ni ekumɔ mli ebɔ̃i yeli.
Kɛkɛ ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛna tsui, ni amɛ hu amɛye nii.
Shi wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ lɛlɛ lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ naa shiɔ mɛi ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai kpawo kɛ ekpaa.
Ni be ni amɛye nii ni amɛtɔrɔ lɛ, amɛshɛrɛ abele ni amɛwo lɛ amɛshwie ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛhã lɛlɛ lɛ fee huyɛhuyɛ.
Lɛlɛ lɛ sha shi Ni be ni je tsɛre lɛ amɛna akɛ amɛleee shikpɔŋ lɛ, shi amɛna ble ko kɛ enaa shia, ni amɛto amɛyiŋ akɛ, kɛ amɛaanyɛ lɛ, amɛaahã lɛlɛ lɛ ayasha shi yɛ jɛi.
Ni amɛfolɔ sɛkɛi lɛ amɛwo ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛfɛne kudɔɔ lɛ he kpãi lɛ hu, ni amɛshi hiɛgbɛ abalaa lɛ kɛkpee kɔɔyɔɔ ni tswaa lɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ eyi amɛmã shianɔgbɛ.
Shi akɛni amɛyagbee ŋshɔi enyɔ alɛwu nɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛkɛ lɛlɛ lɛ yasha shi; ni eyitsogbɛ lɛ yatsɛkɛ shi shiŋŋ, shi esɛɛgbɛ lɛ ŋshɔkei lɛ anaawalɛ lɛ jwara lɛ.
Shi asraafoi lɛ ayiŋtoo ji akɛ amɛaagbe gboklɛfoi lɛ, koni amɛteŋ mɔ ko akasere kɛmiiya ni ejo foi.
Shi akɛni asraafoiohaatsɛ lɛ taoɔ Paulo yiwala ehere hewɔ lɛ, etsi amɛyiŋtoo lɛ naa, ni efã akɛ mɛi ni le seremɔ lɛ tsutsu atu agbee ŋshɔ lɛ mli, ni amɛya shikpɔŋ; shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi abumɔ ŋmoŋmolo nɔ, ni mɛi komɛi hu abumɔ lɛlɛ koi lɛ anɔ.
Bɔ ni fee ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ yashɛ shikpɔŋ shweshweeshwe ji no.
Paulo yɛ Malita ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ Ni be ni wɔje mli sɔŋŋ lɛ, no dani wɔbale akɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ gbɛi ji Malita.
Jɛibii lɛ fee wɔ ejurɔ pii, ejaakɛ amɛshɛre la, ni amɛhere wɔ fɛɛ tswɛm hiɛmɛɛ yɛ nunɛmɔ babaoo kɛ fɛ̃i lɛ hewɔ.
Shi be ni Paulo bua lai ŋmɛŋmlɛbii anaa ni ekɛyawo la lɛ mli lɛ, shinɔ ko jɛ la grigri lɛ mli kpɛtɛ enine he.
Be ni jɛibii lɛ na kooloo lɛ kpɛtɛ enine he lɛ, amɛkɛɛkɛɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, nɛkɛ nuu nɛɛ awuyelɔ ni, ni ahere eyiwala kɛjɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli moŋ nɛ, shi oweletɔɔ eŋmɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ gbɛ ni eyi ana wala.” Ni ehwanya kooloo lɛ ewo la lɛ mli, ni eyeee lɛ awui ko.
Amɛhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ eeefuufuu loo eeetswa shi egbo trukaa.
Shi be ni amɛkwɛ aahu ni amɛna akɛ nɔ ko srɔto ko efeee lɛ lɛ, amɛtsake amɛjwɛŋmɔ ni amɛkɛɛ akɛ nyɔŋmɔ ko ji lɛ.
Ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ onukpa ni atsɛɔ lɛ Publio lɛ yɛ shikpɔji yɛ jɛi niiaŋ; gbɔmɔ nɛɛ here wɔ hiɛmɛɛ ni ekɛ tsuijurɔ fee wɔ gbɔ gbii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ.
Eba mli akɛ Publio tsɛ kã shi kɛ atridii kɛ fɔ kɛ la wamɔ; ni Paulo tee eŋɔɔ, ni esɔle ekɛ eniji shwie enɔ ni etsa lɛ.
Be ni afee enɛ lɛ, mɛi krokomɛi hu ni he yeɔ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ ba, ni atsa amɛ.
Ni amɛ hu amɛwo wɔhiɛ nyam babaoo, ni be ni wɔfã yɛ jɛi lɛ, amɛhã wɔ nibii ni he hiaa wɔ.
Paulo jɛ Malita kɛtee Roma Ni nyɔji etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ wɔyabote Aleksandria lɛlɛ ko ni ekadimɔ ji Dioskurioi (loo nyɔŋmɔi hãaji) ni ebaye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ mli, ni wɔfã kɛtee.
Wɔyadamɔ Sirakusa ni wɔhi jɛi gbii etɛ̃.
Ni wɔjɛ jɛi lɛ, wɔlɔgɔ shi kɛba Regio; ni enɔ jetsɛremɔ lɛ, be ni wuoyigbɛ kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ bɔ̃i tswaa lɛ, wɔyi mli, ni gbi ni ji enyɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ wɔshɛ Puteoli.
Jɛi wɔbana nyɛmimɛi komɛi yɛ; ni amɛkpa wɔ fai akɛ wɔkɛ amɛ ahi shi gbii kpawo.
Kɛkɛ ni wɔyashɛ Roma.
Nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ jɛi lɛ nu wɔhe, ni amɛbakpee wɔ yɛ Apio jara nɔ kɛ Gbɔiatoohei Etɛ̃ lɛ; ni be ni Paulo na amɛ lɛ, eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni etsui nyɔ emli.
Ni be ni wɔbashɛ Roma lɛ, aŋmɛ Paulo gbɛ akɛ ekome ehi shi kɛ asraafonyo kome ni miibu ehe.
Paulo shiɛ yɛ Roma Gbii etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ Paulo hã atsɛ Yudafoi lɛ anukpai ni yɔɔ lɛ kɛbakpe; ni be ni amɛnaa ebakpe shi lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Ataamɛi kɛ anyɛmimɛi, mitɔ̃ko maŋ lɛ loo wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ akusumi lɛ anɔ; kɛ̃lɛ akɛ mi wo Romabii lɛ adɛŋ yɛ Yerusalɛm akɛ gboklɛfonyo.
Be ni amɛtao misane lɛ mli lɛ, amɛsumɔ akɛ amɛŋmɛɛ mihe, ejaakɛ sane ko bɛ mihe kwraa ni sa gbele.
Shi akɛni Yudafoi lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, efi akɛ maŋɔ misane lɛ mahã Kaisare yeli, shi jeee akɛ miyɛ nɔ ko ni mikɛbaafolɔ mimaŋ lɛ naa.
Nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ hewɔ mitsɛ nyɛ kɛba koni mana nyɛ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie ejaakɛ Israel hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni awo mi nɛkɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ nɛɛ.” Shi amɛkɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Wɔ lɛ wɔnako woji komɛi kɛjɛko Yudea yɛ ohe, ni asaŋ nyɛmimɛi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko bako biɛ ebagbako ohe sane ko, ni mɔ ko ebawieko ohe wiemɔ fɔŋ ko.
Shi wɔmiisumɔ akɛ wɔle ojwɛŋmɔ, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ kuu nɛɛ wɔle akɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ awieɔ ashiɔ.” Ni be ni amɛto lɛ gbi lɛ, amɛteŋ mɛi pii ba eŋɔɔ yɛ etoohe lɛ, ni kɛjɛ leebi kɛyashi gbɛkɛ lɛ, ejaje Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni eye he odase faŋŋ, ni ejɛ Mose Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ amli etao ni amɛyiŋ atsɔ̃ kɛba Yesu gbɛfaŋ.
Ni mɛi komɛi he wiemɔi ni ewie lɛ amɛye, shi mɛi komɛi hu heee yeee.
Ni akɛni amɛyakpãaa gbee hewɔ lɛ, amɛyiŋ amɛtee be ni Paulo wie wiemɔ nɛɛ, “Ojogbaŋŋ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔ Yesaia naa akɛ, ‘Yaa maŋ nɛɛ ŋɔɔ ni oyakɛɛ, nu lɛ nyɛbaanu nɛ, shi nyɛnaŋ shishi.
Ni na lɛ nyɛbaana nɛ, shi nyɛyoŋ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ maŋ nɛɛ tsui ekpliŋ, ni amɛtoi wa kɛ ninumɔ, ni amɛmiamia amɛhiŋmɛii, koni amɛkana kɛ amɛhiŋmɛii ni amɛkanu kɛ amɛtoii.
Ni amɛtsui hu akana shishi, ni amɛkpale ni mitsa amɛ.’ “No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ, atsu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ eyahã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛ lɛ amɛaabo toi hu.” [ Ni be ni ewie wiemɔ nɛɛ lɛ, Yudafoi lɛ yi mli amɛtee, ni amɛjejee ŋwane babaoo yɛ amɛteŋ.]
Ni Paulo hi shĩa ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyaŋɔ mli afii enyɔ ni ehereɔ mɛi fɛɛ ni baa eŋɔɔ lɛ, ni eshiɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ he sane lɛ, ni ekɛ ekãa fɛɛ jajeɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo he saji lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ, ni mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiii lɛ gbɛ.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Paulo wolo ni eŋmã emaje Romabii lɛ, eŋmã koni ekɛyasaa gbɛ eto sramɔ ni eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaaya eyasara asafo lɛ yɛ Roma lɛ.
Eyiŋtoo ji akɛ ebaaya eyatsu nii fioo yɛ Kristofoi lɛ ateŋ bɔ ni afee ni kɛji ena amɛpĩamɔ lɛ, edãmɔ nɔ ni ekɛya Spain.
Wolo nɛɛ eŋmã ni ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni enuɔ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ shishi ehãa, kɛ bɔ hu ni hemɔkɛyeli nɛɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ Kristofoi awala shihilɛ mli.
Ni wolo nɛɛ mli ji he ni Paulo shɛɛwiemɔi lɛ yeɔ emuu fe fɛɛ yɛ.
Be ni Paulo ŋa Roma asafo lɛ ni ehã amɛle bɔ ni esɔleɔ ehãa amɛ sɛɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ oti krɛdɛɛ ni yɔɔ emajemɔ wolo lɛ mli; no ji akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ gbɔmɛi abem ehãa, akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔŋŋ akɛjeɔ shishi ni hemɔkɛyeli gbeɔ naa .
Agbɛnɛ Paulo gbala eshɛɛwiemɔ nɛɛ mli fitsofitso.
Etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, ajieɔ lɛ kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi adesai fiaa kwa: Yudafoi jio, Jeŋmajiaŋbii jio, ejaakɛ esha eŋɔ amɛ fɛɛ tswɛm nom.
Ni Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ nɛɛ kpo faŋŋ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, Paulo tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Wala Hee ni wɔnaa kɛjɛɔ wɔ kɛ Kristo naanyobɔɔ mli lɛ hãa wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanyobɔɔ hee lɛ yeɔ emuu.
Mɔ ni heɔ eyeɔ lɛ, ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ yɛ hejɔlɛ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hereɔ eyi wala kɛjɛɔ esha kɛ gbele hewalɛ dɛŋ.
Yɛ Yitsei - mli lɛ, Paulo saa etsɔ̃ɔ oti ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ mli kɛ hewalɛ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ yɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ wala mli.
Agbɛnɛ Bɔfo Paulo bɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ehã anu shishi faŋŋ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni ehiɛ hã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ lɛ kɔɔ Yudafoi kɛ Jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ tswɛm hu ahe pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Nɔ ni ekɛgbe naa ji akɛ Yudafoi lɛ akwa ni amɛkwa Yesu lɛ, no hu shi Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo lɛ nɔ, akɛni kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ gbɔmɛi adesai fɛɛ aaana Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ eko, ni eheɔ eyeɔ akɛ Yudafoi lɛ kaŋ he amɛkwaŋ Yesu kɛyaŋ naanɔ.
Naagbee lɛ, Paulo tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ pɛ ni sa akɛ Kristofoi aba amɛjeŋ amɛhã, titri lɛ akɛ amɛsumɔsumɔɔ amɛhe yɛ amɛ kɛ amɛhe naanyobɔɔ mli.
Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ komɛi ahe ni ewie ji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, Kristofoi agbɛnaa yɛ amɛmaŋ kɛ amɛ sɔŋŋ amɛteaŋ, kɛ henilee.
Nɔ ni ekɛgbe wolo lɛ naa ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋamɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ kɛ oti .- Yiwalaheremɔ ni he ehia .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ gbɛ .—.
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli .—.
Israelbii lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo mli .—.
Kristofoi ajeŋba .—.
Naamuu kɛ ŋamɔi .—.
Ŋamɔ Wolo nɛɛ jɛ mi Paulo, Yesu Kristo tsulɔ kɛ bɔfo ni atsɛ lɛ ni ajie lɛ ato ahã Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ, dɛŋ.
Sanekpakpa nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi eto momo yɛ egbalɔi lɛ anaa yɛ Ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli, Sanekpakpa nɛɛ kɔɔ eBi lɛ, mɔ ni yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ajɛ David shwiei lɛ mli afɔ lɛ lɛ, he.
EBi nɛɛ, hetsemɔ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, atsɔ̃ gbohiiashitee lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ hewalɛ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ni ji Yesu Kristo wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Enɔ mitsɔ̃ mina dromɔ kɛ bɔfo nitsumɔ koni mihã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ abo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi, yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ.
Jeŋmaji nɛɛ ateŋ nyɛ Romabii hu nyɛyɔɔ.
Nyɛ mɛi ni atsɛ akɛ nyɛbafee Yesu Kristo mɛi lɛ.
Miiŋma nyɛ mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ ni etsɛ nyɛ ni nyɛ ji mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Roma lɛ fɛɛ, dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, miitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ miida miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, akɛ agbaa nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ he sane yɛ je lɛ mli fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ midasefonyo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni misɔmɔɔ yɛ mimumɔ mli yɛ eBi lɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ, akɛ mifɔ̃ko nyɛ kaimɔ dã, ni mikpaa fai daa yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, akɛ aleenɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ wɔsɛɛ ko lɛ gbɛ aaaja ahã mi ni maba nyɛŋɔɔ lo.
Ejaakɛ miishwe akɛ mana nyɛ, koni mikɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii lɛ eko abahã nyɛ, bɔ ni afee ni akɛwaje nyɛ, no ji akɛ, atsɔ̃ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nɔ ashɛje mimii, ni atsɔ̃ mi hu minɔ lɛ nɔ ashɛje nyɛmii.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ mifɔɔ miyiŋtoo akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, koni mibana yibii komɛi yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ, tamɔ mina yɛ jeŋmaji krokomɛi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Mihiɛ Helabii kɛ jekɔ̃ji, nilelɔi kɛ mɛi ni leee nii fɛɛ anyɔmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miishwe akɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛyɔɔ Roma lɛ hu, mabajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Sanekpakpa lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ Ejaakɛ mihiɛ gbooo Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ he, ejaakɛ eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni akɛhereɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ yiwala, Yudanyo lɛ tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu.
Ejaakɛ no mli ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo yɛ, kɛjɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli kɛyaa hemɔkɛyeli mli, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Shi jalɔ ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala.” Fɔ ni gbɔmɛi eye Ejaakɛ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kpo kɛjɛɔ ŋwɛi kɛbaa gbɔmɛi ni kɛ nishaianii tsĩɔ anɔkwale lɛ gbɛ lɛ amusubɔɔ kɛ nishaianii lɛ fɛɛ nɔ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ he nii ni aaanyɛ ale lɛ yɛ faŋŋ hã amɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ejie etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ faŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ehenii ni anaaa ni ji enaanɔ hewalɛ kɛ nyɔŋmɔ ni eji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, kɛjɛ jeŋbɔɔ mli beebe lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ enii ni efee lɛ anɔ ayɔseɔ ni anaa faŋŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, amɛbɛ naajiemɔ ko; ejaakɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ, shi amɛwooo ehiɛ nyam akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛdaaa lɛ shi hu, shi amɛfee shwɛm yɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔi amli, ni amɛtsui ni kɔɔɔ sane sɛɛ lɛ ewo duŋ.
Amɛtsɛ amɛhe nilelɔi, shi amɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwashiai, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni gbooo lɛ anunyam lɛ amɛtsake amɛhã gbɔmɔ ni gboɔ lɛ subaŋ henɔ ko kɛ loofɔji kɛ kooloi naji ejwɛjwɛɛjwɛtsɛmɛi kɛ waamɔnii anɔ.
No hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã muji nitsumɔi yɛ amɛtsuiiaŋ akɔnɔi lɛ anaa, bɔ ni afee ni amɛshwie amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ ahiɛ shi yɛ amɛteaŋ.
Amɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ amɛtsakeɔ amale, ni amɛjaa ni amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ bɔɔnɔ lɛ yɛ bɔlɔ lɛ najiaŋ, bɔlɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ!
Amen.
Enɛ hewɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã hiɛgbejianii ahe hiɛdɔɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ adebɔɔ naanyobɔɔ ni ato lɛ, amɛyei lɛ etsake hiɛ ehã nɔ ni kɛ adebɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo eyaaa; ni nakai nɔŋŋ amɛhii lɛ hu eshi amɛyei lɛ asɛɛ, ni amɛkɛ akɔnɔ ni naa wa nyiɛɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe sɛɛ, ni hii kɛ hii tsuɔ hiɛgbejianii, ni amɛna amɛtɔ̃mɔ lɛ he nyɔmɔwoo ni sa yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmli.
Ni akɛni amɛbuuu akɛ esa akɛ amɛleɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ hu ŋmɛɛ amɛhe ehã jwɛŋmɔ ni esaaa koni amɛfee nibii ni esaaa; mɛi ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ fɛɛ, efɔŋfeemɔ, hiɛjoomɔ, nifɔɔjianii; amɛyimɔ tɔ kɛ hetsɛ̃, awuyeli, bei, shishiumɔ, nyɛɛ; amɛyeɔ amɛhe osheku, Nyɔŋmɔnyɛlɔi, mɛi ni hiɛ esɔɔɔ mɔ, hetsɔ̃ɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, nɔfɔŋ he ŋaatsɔlɔi, fɔlɔi anɔtoigbolɔi, mɛi ni bɛ henilee, kpãŋmɔ mli kulɔi, mɛi ni edɔɔɔ mɔ he, mɛi ni enaaa mɔbɔ.
Amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ mla lɛ krɛdɛɛ nɛ, akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ sa gbele, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ amɛfeɔ, shi moŋ amɛnaa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ ahe miishɛɛ hu.
Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kojomɔ lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, bo, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kojoɔ lɛ, obɛ naajiemɔ ko; ejaakɛ be mli ni okojoɔ mɔ kroko lɛ, oobu bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe fɔ; ejaakɛ bo ni okojoɔ lɛ otsuɔ nakai nii lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Shi wɔle akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni baa mɛi ni tsuɔ nakai nii lɛ anɔ lɛ ja.
Bo gbɔmɔ ni okojoɔ mɛi ni tsuɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ ni ofeɔ nakai nɔŋŋ lɛ, ani osusuɔ akɛ bo lɛ ohe aaaje Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ lɛ mli?
Aloo obuuu emlihilɛ kɛ eyishiŋmɛɛ kɛ etsuishitoo babaoo lɛ, ni oleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ lɛ gbɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bo kɛya tsuitsakemɔ mli?
Shi okɛ otsuiwalɛ kɛ ohe ni oshwaaa lɛ miitĩa mlifu naa ohã ohe oto Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu gbi lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni ebaatsɔ̃ ejie ejalɛ kojomɔ lɛ kpo lɛ; lɛ ebaawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔ̃mɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔi lɛ: mɛi ni kɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ hiɛɔ ekpakpafeemɔ mli ni amɛtaoɔ anunyam kɛ woo kɛ shihilɛ ni fiteŋ lɛ, eeehã amɛ naanɔ wala; shi mɛi ni sumɔɔ bei ni amɛbooo anɔkwale lɛ toi, shi amɛboɔ nii ni ejaaa moŋ toi lɛ, amɛnɔ ji mlifu kɛ mlila.
Amanehulu kɛ hejaramɔ aaaba gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ susuma nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu; shi anunyam kɛ woo kɛ hejɔlɛ aaaba mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nikpakpai anii lɛ nɔ, Yudanyo tsutsu kɛ Helanyo hu.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni bɛ Mla lɛ ni amɛfee esha lɛ amɛaalaaje akɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla; ni mɛi abɔ ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi ni amɛfee esha lɛ, Mla lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛaakojo amɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee Mla lɛ nulɔi ji jalɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, shi moŋ Mla lɛ nɔyelɔi ji mɛi ni aaabu amɛ akɛ jalɔi.
Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni bɛ Mla lɛ kɛ amɛfɔmɔŋ su lɛ tsuɔ Mla lɛ naanii lɛ, amɛ ni amɛbɛ Mla lɛ amɛ ji mla hã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe.
Amɛnifeemɔnii tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ aŋma Mla lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ amɛtsuii amli, ni amɛhenilee hu yeɔ odase, ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ folɔɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni ehiii aloo ejieɔ amɛnaa kɛ amɛfee nɔ ni hi.
Enɛ baaba mli gbi nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ akojo gbɔmɛi ateemɔŋnii lɛ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ naa lɛ.
Yudafoi kɛ Mla lɛ Shi kɛji bo lɛ atsɛɔ bo Yudanyo, ni okɛ ohe fɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ, ni oshwãa ofɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni ole esuɔmɔnaanii lɛ, ni ole nii ni hi, ejaakɛ ajɛ Mla lɛ mli atsɔ̃ɔ bo, ni obuɔ ohe akɛ oji shwilafoi agbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ duŋ mli lɛ ala, kɛ mɛi ni leee nii atsɔselɔ kɛ abifabii atsɔ̃ɔlɔ, ejaakɛ oyɛ nilee kɛ anɔkwale he mfoniri kɛjɛ Mla lɛ mli, bo ni otsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii lɛ, otsɔ̃ɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe nii?
Oshiɛɔ akɛ akaju, shi ojuɔ; okɛɔ akɛ akafite gbãlã, shi ofiteɔ gbãlã; ohiɔ amãgãi, shi ojuɔ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ nii.
Bo ni okɛ Mla lɛ shwãa lɛ okɛ Mla lɛ nɔtɔmɔ lɛ gbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ he guɔ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Nyɛhewɔ lɛ awieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔi yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.” Shi kɛ oyeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, kulɛ ketiafoo he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ; shi kɛ ofee ohe Mla lɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ lɛ, oketiafoo lɛ etsɔ̃ foo.
Shi kɛji foolɔ lɛ yeɔ Mla lɛ gbɛnai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ani abuŋ efoo lɛ akɛ ketiafoo?
Ni heloo gbɛfaŋ foolɔ lɛ ni yeɔ Mla lɛ nɔ lɛ, aaakojo bo ni ohiɛ Mla ni aŋma lɛ ni afo bo ketia hu ni ofee ohe mlatɔ̃lɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni anaa lɛ yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ akɛ Yudanyo doo ji Yudanyo, ni asaŋ jeee nɔ ni anaa yɛ kpo nɔ gbɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso he ji ketiafoo; shi moŋ mɔ ni ji Yudanyo yɛ mligbɛ lɛ ji Yudanyo, ni tsui mli ketiafoo ji nɔ ni atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ afo, shi jeee Mla lɛ nɔ, ni eyijiemɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛɔ.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ, mɛni Yudanyo kɛfe mɛi krokomɛi mɔ?
Aloo mɛɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɔɔ ketiafoo mli?
Efa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji akɛ atu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ awo amɛdɛŋ.
Shi kɛ mɛi komɛi heee yeee lɛ, mɛni?
Ani he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwayeli lɛ afee yaka?
Dabida!
Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ fee amalelɔ po, lɛ lɛ ja efee anɔkwafo tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Bɔ ni afee ni ana akɛ osane ja yɛ owiemɔi lɛ amli, ni oye kunim yɛ okojomɔ lɛ mli.” Shi kɛji wɔja ni wɔjaaa lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ jeɔ kpo lɛ, te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Aso Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ejaaa kɛji emlifu ba wɔnɔ lɛ?
(Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ).
Dabida!
Ejaakɛ kɛji nakai ni lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaakojo je lɛ?
Shi kɛ mimalemɔ lɛ hãa Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ faa kɛtekeɔ nɔ hã enunyam lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni akã he akojoɔ mi akɛ eshafeelɔ?
Ani jeee tamɔ bɔ ni afoɔ sane afɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ni mɛi komɛi kɛɔ yɛ wɔhe akɛ wɔkɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔfea efɔŋ koni ekpakpa aba” lɛ?
Nakai mɛi lɛ afɔbuu lɛ ja pɛ.
Jalɔ ko bɛ Belɛ mɛni?
Ani wɔ Yudafoi wɔhi fe mɛi krokomɛi?
Jeee nakai kwraa; ejaakɛ wɔfolɔ Yudafoi kɛ Helabii fɛɛ anaa momo akɛ amɛfɛɛ amɛyɛ esha shishi, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Jalɔ ko bɛ, mɔ kome folo bɛ; nilelɔ ko bɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni taoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sɛɛgbɛ.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛgba afã, amɛ blublu amɛhiii amɛhãaa nɔ ko; Mɔ ko mɔ ko bɛ ni feɔ ekpakpa, mɔ kome folo bɛ.
Gbonyobu ni agbele naa ji amɛsɛ̃ lɛ; amɛkɛ amɛlilɛii shishiuɔ mɔ, shikpãi anaa ebɔɔ yɛ amɛnaabu.
Loomɔ kɛ joomɔ eyi amɛdaaŋ obɔ̃.
Amɛhe yɛ oya kɛ láshishwiemɔ; hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ awerɛhoo yɛ amɛgbɛi anɔ.
Ni hejɔlɛ gbɛ lɛ amɛleee.
Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ko bɛ amɛhiɛ.” Shi agbɛnɛ wɔle akɛ nibii fɛɛ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla lɛ shishi lɛ ekɛwieɔ, koni mɔ ko mɔ ko akana naabu, ni jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ aye fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ adamɔŋ Mla lɛ nitsumɔ nɔ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem yɛ ehiɛ; ejaakɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ aleɔ nɔ ni ji esha.
Jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ashi Mla lɛ sɛɛ ajie Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ kpo faŋŋ, ni no he odase Mla lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ yeɔ; no ji Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ ni atsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi fɛɛ efee esha, ni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ebɔ amɛ, ni akɛ edromɔ lɛ buɔ amɛ bem yaka kɛtsɔ̃ɔ kpɔ̃mɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ nɔ.
Lɛ ji mɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jie to akɛ kpãtãmɔ nɔ kɛtsɔ̃ elá lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ koni ekɛjie ejalɛ lɛ kpo, yɛ ehiɛ ni eku efɔ̃ eshai ni afee sa lɛ anɔ yɛ etsuishiŋmɛɛ mli lɛ hewɔ; koni ejie ejalɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ benɛ be nɛɛ mli, ni eye bem ni ebu mɔ ni heɔ Yesu nɔ yeɔ lɛ hu bem.
Agbɛnɛ mɛni nɔ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ?
Nɔ ko bɛ.
Mɛɛ Mla nɔ atsɔ̃?
Nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ nɔ lo?
Dabi, shi hemɔkɛyeli mla lɛ nɔ moŋ atsɔ̃.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔbuɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ abuɔ gbɔmɔ bem, shi jeee Mla nitsumɔi anɔ.
Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Yudafoi kɛkɛ aNyɔŋmɔ ni?
Ani jeee jeŋmaji lɛ hu aNyɔŋmɔ ni?
Hɛɛ, jeŋmaji lɛ hu aNyɔŋmɔ akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome ni, ni hemɔkɛyeli naa ebuɔ ketiafoo bem, ni esaa edamɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ebuɔ foo bem lɛ.
Belɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔhã Mla lɛ afee yaka lo?
Dabida, shi wɔkɛmiima Mla lɛ nɔ mi moŋ.
Abraham hemɔkɛyeli akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ Belɛ mɛni wɔɔkɛɛ akɛ Abraham ni ji wɔtsɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ na mɔ?
Kɛ nitsumɔi anɔ adamɔ abu lɛ bem lɛ, kulɛ eyɛ shwãa nɔ, shi belɛ jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ te ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ tɛŋŋ?
“Ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ.” Mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, abuuu enyɔmɔwoo lɛ akɛ dromɔ nɔ ko, shi moŋ akɛ egbɛnaa nɔ ko.
Shi mɔ ni jeee nii etsuɔ, shi eheɔ mɔ ni buɔ eshafeelɔ bem lɛ nɔ eyeɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ buɔ ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ehãa lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni David hu kɛɔ akɛ ajɔɔ gbɔmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ shiɔ nitsumɔi asɛɛ ebuɔ lɛ jalɔ lɛ, “Ajɔɔ mɛi ni akɛ amɛmlatɔ̃mɔi lɛ efa amɛ, ni atsimɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Ajɔɔ nuu ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebuuu ehe esha lɛ ehãaa lɛ lɛ.” Agbɛnɛ nɛkɛ jɔɔmɔ nɛɛ, mɛi ni afo amɛ ketia kɛkɛ anɔ ni, aloo foolɔi lɛ hu anɔ̃ŋ?
Ejaakɛ wɔkɛɔ akɛ abu hemɔkɛyeli lɛ akɛ jalɛ ahã Abraham.
Agbɛnɛ te abu lɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ tɛŋŋ?
Be ni afo lɛ ketia lɛ aloo be mli ni afoko lɛ ketia lɛ?
Jeee be mli ni afo lɛ ketia, shi moŋ be ni eji foolɔ lɛ.
Ni enine shɛ ketiafoo okadi lɛ nɔ akɛ jalɛ naasɔomɔnɔ ni akɛsɔo ehemɔkɛyeli ni ena be mli ni eji foolɔ beebe lɛ naa, ni efee mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ be ni amɛ ji foolɔi lɛ atsɛ, ni abu hemɔkɛyeli ahã amɛ hu akɛ jalɛ; ni asaŋ efee ketiafolɔi atsɛ hu ehã mɛi ni amɛjeee ketiafolɔi kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛkɔ wɔtsɛ Abraham, mɔ ni he ye be mli ni eji foolɔ beebe lɛ, nane.
Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo ni anaa kɛtsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ Ejaakɛ jeee Mla nɔ ni Abraham ye hewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ loo eshwiei ashi akɛ je lɛ aaatsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, shi moŋ akɛni ehe eye ni Nyɔŋmɔ bu lɛ akɛ jalɔ lɛ hewɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ Mla shishibii lɛ ji niyelɔi lɛ, belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni shiwoo lɛ hu he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ dɔŋŋ.
Mla lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa, shi he ni mla bɛ lɛ, mlatɔ̃mɔ hu bɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ejɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni shiwoo lɛ afee dromɔ sane, ni ama shi shiŋŋ ahã eshwiei lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeee Mla shishibii lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mɛi ni jɛ Abraham, ni ji wɔ fɛɛ wɔtsɛ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ hu; tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mikɛ bo efee jeŋmaji pii atsɛ” yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni ehe eye lɛ hiɛ, mɔ hu ni tsiɛ̃ɔ gbohii ahiɛ, ni etsɛɔ nibii ni bɛ lɛ kɛbaa tamɔ nɔ ni amɛyɛ momo lɛ.
Ni he ni kulɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko bɛ lɛ, ena hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛ he ni ehe eye, mɔ ni etsɔ̃ jeŋmaji pii atsɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nakai oshwiei lɛ aaatamɔ.” Ni ehemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɔjɔɔɔ, ni ejwɛŋŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso gbo ni egbo momo, akɛni eye aaafee afii oha lɛ, kɛ Sara fɔ ni efɔɔɔ lɛ he; ni eyiŋ efeee lɛ kɔshikɔshi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo lɛ he tamɔ akɛ eheee eyeee, shi moŋ ena hewalɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ewo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam, ni eyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ewo he shi lɛ, eeenyɛ efee hu.
No hewɔ hu ni abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
Shi jeee lɛ kɛkɛ ehewɔ aŋma akɛ “abu no jalɛ ahã lɛ” lɛ, shi moŋ wɔ mɛi ni abaabu ahã wɔ lɛ hu hewɔ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ mɔ ni tee wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ; shi akɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ ahewɔ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ wɔbembuu hewɔ.
Nɔ ni jɛɔ bembuu mli kɛbaa Agbɛnɛ akɛni adamɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem hewɔ lɛ, wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ yɛ hejɔlɛ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ.
Lɛ enɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ena gbɛ hu kɛba dromɔ ni wɔyɔɔ mli nɛɛ mli, ni wɔnyaa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔnyaa yɛ amanehului amli hu, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ amanehulu lɛ tsɛɔ hiɛmiamɔ kɛbaa, ni hiɛmiamɔ tsɛɔ su ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛbaa; ni su nɛɛ tsɛɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛbaa; ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ efeee efolo; ejaakɛ atsɔ̃ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ nɔ afɔse Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ awo wɔtsuii amli.
Ejaakɛ be mli ni wɔhe waaa lɛ beebe Kristo bagbo yɛ be ni sa mli ehã mɛi ni efeee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ko dani mɔ ko aaagbo ahã jalɔ ko; ni mɔ kpakpa ko hewɔ lɛ, ekolɛ mɔ ko aaashi etsitsi akɛ eeegbo.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ jieɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ, akɛ be mli ni wɔji eshafeelɔi lɛ beebe ni Kristo bagbo yɛ wɔnajiaŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni abu wɔ bem yɛ elá lɛ hewɔ lɛ, aaatsɔ̃ enɔ ahere wɔyiwala kɛjɛ mlifu lɛ mli aahu.
Ejaakɛ kɛ be mli ni wɔji henyɛlɔi lɛ ni akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ gbele lɛ bakpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni akpãtã wɔteŋ nɛɛ, aaahere wɔyiwala yɛ ewala lɛ mli aahu.
Shi jeee no kɛkɛ, shi asaŋ wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hu yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, mɔ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni agbɛnɛ wɔna kpãtãmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Adam kɛ Kristo Agbɛnɛ, gbɔmɔ kome nɔ esha tsɔ̃ kɛba je lɛ mli, ni gbele tsɔ̃ esha nɔ kɛba.
Bɔ ni fee nɛ ni gbele lɛ tsɛŋe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛfee esha lɛ.
Esha yɛ jeŋ dani ahã Mla lɛ; shi akɛni mla bɛ hewɔ lɛ, abuuu esha lɛ he akɔntaa.
Kɛ̃lɛ gbele lɛ ye maŋtsɛ kɛjɛ Adam yinɔ kɛbashi Mose yinɔ yɛ mɛi po ni efeko esha ni tamɔ Adam nɔtɔmɔ lɛ anɔ, Adam ni ji mɔ ni baaba lɛ mfoniri lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ tamɔɔɔ shigbeemɔnɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ, kɛ mɔ kome lɛ shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mɛi pii lɛ gboi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ kɛ nɔkeenɔ ni tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ dromɔ nɔ ba lɛ fa kɛteke nɔ hã mɛi pii lɛ aahu.
Ni srɔto yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ lɛ kɛ esha ni tsɔ̃ mɔ kome nɔ kɛba lɛ mli; ejaakɛ mɔ kome he esha ni akojo lɛ, ehebuamɔ lɛ fee fɔbuu; shi dromɔ ni jɛ mɛi pii anɔtɔ̃mɔ mli lɛ tsɔ̃ bembuu.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ kome shigbeemɔ lɛ hewɔ jɛ ni gbele tsɔ̃ nakai mɔ kome lɛ nɔ ye maŋtsɛ lɛ, belɛ mɛi ni ena dromɔ kɛ jalɛ nɔkeenɔ ni fa kɛteke nɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ mɔ kome ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ yɛ wala mli aahu.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ mɔ kome shigbeemɔ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ fɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ atsɔ̃ mɔ kome jalɛ nɔ abu gbɔmɛi fɛɛ awala bem.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ kome lɛ toigbele lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii tsɔ̃mɔ eshafeelɔi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaatsɔ̃ mɔ kome lɛ toiboo lɛ nɔ ahã mɛi pii hu atsɔ̃mɔ jalɔi.
Shi Mla lɛ babote mli koni nɔtɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛteke nɔ.
Shi he ni esha fa yɛ lɛ, dromɔ lɛ fa kɛteke nɔ yɛ jɛi, koni bɔ nɔŋŋ ni esha lɛ ye maŋtsɛ yɛ gbele mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ dromɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ jalɛ nɔ aye maŋtsɛ kɛya naanɔ wala mli yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, hewɔ.
Esha bɛ wɔnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Aso wɔkã he wɔhi esha lɛ mli, koni dromɔ lɛ afa?
Dabida!
Wɔ ni esha gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni egboi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni wɔhiɛ aaakãmɔ yɛ emli loloŋ?
Aloo nyɛleee akɛ wɔteŋ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi wɔ awo Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, egbele lɛ mli abaptisi wɔ awo?
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛ baptisimɔ ni abaptisi wɔ awo egbele lɛ mli lɛ efu wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ, koni tamɔ bɔ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ yɛ Tsɛ lɛ anunyam naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔɔnyiɛ yɛ wala hee mli.
Ejaakɛ kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ efee ekome yɛ egbele lɛ henɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaafee ekome yɛ eshitee lɛ nɔ lɛ mli hu; ejaakɛ wɔle enɛ akɛ asɛŋ wɔgbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ lɛ, koni esha gbɔmɔtso lɛ hiɛ akpãtã ni wɔkasɔ̃mɔ esha lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ ni egbo lɛ, eye ehe yɛ esha dɛŋ.
Shi kɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo gbo lɛ, wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ ni atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ nɛɛ, egboŋ dɔŋŋ; gbele naŋ enɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ ni egbo lɛ, esha hewɔ egbo, shi kome pɛ; shi ni ehiɛ kã nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ehiɛ kã ehã.
Nakai nyɛ hu nyɛbua nyɛhe akɛ mɛi ni egboi yɛ esha gbɛfaŋ ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ hã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa esha miiyea nyɛgbɔmɔtso ni baagbo lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛ, ni nyɛbo lɛ toi yɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ amli; ni asaŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ akahãa esha akɛ esha lɛ tawuunii; shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe ahãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ mɛi ni hiɛ etsɛ̃ kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tawuunii nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ esha naŋ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ, ejaakɛ jeee Mla shishi nyɛyɔɔ, shi moŋ dromɔ shishi nyɛyɔɔ.
Jalɛ tsuji ji wɔ Belɛ mɛni?
Aso wɔfee esha akɛni wɔbɛ mla shishi shi dromɔ moŋ shishi wɔyɔɔ lɛ?
Dabida!
Ani nyɛleee akɛ, mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe feɔ tsuji nyɛhãa ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ, nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ni nyɛboɔ lɛ toi lɛ tsuji ji nyɛ; esha ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli lɛ tsuji jio, aloo toiboo ni kɛ mɔ yaa jalɛ mli lɛ tsuji jio?
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ kulɛ sa lɛ esha tsuji ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ nyɛjɛ nyɛtsui fiaa mli nyɛbo nɛkɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛ nyɛ ewo mli nɛɛ toi.
Ni akɛni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ jalɛ tsuji.
Miiwie akɛ gbɔmɔ yɛ nyɛgbedemɔ ni jɛ gbɔmɔfɔmɔ su mli lɛ hewɔ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ fee tsuji nyɛhã nyaŋemɔ nii kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ koni nyɛkɛtɔ̃ Mla lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhenii lɛ afea jalɛ tsuji ahãa krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ.
Be ni nyɛ ji esha tsuji lɛ, nyɛye nyɛhe kɛjɛ jalɛ dɛŋ.
Ni mɛni nyɛna kɛjɛ mli yɛ nakai be lɛ mli?
Yibii ni nyɛhiɛ egboi yɛ he agbɛnɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi anaagbee ji gbele.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, ni akpɔ̃ nyɛ yɛ esha dɛŋ ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji nɛɛ, nɔ ni nyɛnaa kɛjɛɔ mli ji krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ, ni enaagbee ji naanɔ wala.
Ejaakɛ esha dɛŋ nyɔmɔwoo lɛ gbele ni; shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ lɛ naanɔ walaŋ yɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli.
Kristofonyo eye ehe yɛ Mla lɛ dɛŋ Aloo nyɛleee, anyɛmimɛi, mɛi ni le Mla mikɛwieɔ nɛɛ, akɛ Mla lɛ yeɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ be mli ni eyɔɔ wala mli lɛ kɛkɛ?
Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ yoo ni yɔɔ wu gbɛfaŋ lɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni ewu lɛ hiɛ kã lɛ, mla efi lɛ ekpɛtɛ ewu lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, ekɛ ewu mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji ewu lɛ yɛ jeŋ lolo ni eyagbã mɔ kroko lɛ, atsɛɔ lɛ gbãlãfitelɔ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eye ehe kɛjɛ mla lɛ dɛŋ, ni kɛ eyagbã nuu kroko lɛ, ejeee gbãlãfitelɔ dɔŋŋ.
Minyɛmimɛi, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu atsɔ̃ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ nɔ ahã nyɛgboi yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɔ kroko ni ji mɔ ni atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nii, koni wɔwo yibii wɔhã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔhi shi yɛ wɔgbɔmɔfɔmɔ su lɛ naa lɛ, eshai ahe akɔnɔi lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ Mla lɛ nɔ tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔhenii lɛ amli ni wɔkɛwo yibii wɔhã gbele.
Shi agbɛnɛ wɔkɛ Mla lɛ bɛ sane ko dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ gbohii yɛ nɔ ni fi wɔ kpɛŋŋ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, bɔ ni afee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔ yɛ mumɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee mli, shi jeee yɛ gbɛ momo lɛ ni ji Mla ni aŋma lɛ nɔ.
Mla lɛ kɛ esha Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Aso Mla lɛ esha ni?
Dabida!
Shi moŋ jeee Mla lɛ hewɔŋ kulɛ mileee esha; ejaakɛ kulɛ mileee nɔ ni ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, kɛjeee Mla lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nii anɔ.” Shi esha lɛ tsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ ena hegbɛ ni eteɔ akɔnɔi fɛɛ ashi yɛ mimli; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla bɛ lɛ esha hu egbo.
Shi mihi shi pɛŋ ni mibɛ mla; shi be ni kitã lɛ ba lɛ, esha lɛ hiɛ tsɛ ekoŋŋ; shi mi lɛ migbo; ni mina akɛ kitã lɛ ni akɛhã mi yɛ wala hewɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ etsɛ gbele ehã mi.
Ejaakɛ esha lɛ na hegbɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ eshishiu mi, ni ekɛ no nɔŋŋ gbe mi.
Hewɔ lɛ Mla lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni kitã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ ni eja ni ehi hu.
Aso belɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele ehã mi lo?
Dabida!
Shi moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni esha lɛ aje shi akɛ esha; ni ekɛ nɔ kpakpa lɛ nɔŋŋ tsɛ gbele ehã mi, koni esha lɛ atsɔ̃ kitã lɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ esha kɛteke nɔ.
Gbɔmɔfɔmɔ sui enyɔ Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ mumɔŋ nɔ ni; shi mi lɛ heloo gbɔmɔ ji mi, ni ahɔ̃ɔ mi awo esha shishi.
Shi nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ mileee, ejaakɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔ lɛ, jeee no mifeɔ, shi nɔ ni mihiɔ moŋ lɛ, no mifeɔ.
Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ mikpɛ̃lɛ̃ɔ akɛ Mla lɛ hi.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni hiɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.
Ejaakɛ mile akɛ mimli, no ji migbɔmɔ su lɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ko kpakpa ko bɛ jɛi; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ lɛ miyɛ eko moŋ, shi ekpakpafeemɔ ni ebɔ mi.
Ejaakɛ ekpakpa ni misumɔɔ lɛ mifeee; shi efɔŋ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, no moŋ mifeɔ.
Shi kɛ nɔ ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ kɛ̃ mifeɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee mi mitsuɔ no dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ esha ni yɔɔ mimli lɛ tsuɔ.
Belɛ minaa mla ko akɛ mi ni misumɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ni hi lɛ, efɔŋ moŋ kpɛtɛ mihe.
Mimligbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ miishɛɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ he; shi minaa mla kroko yɛ mihe nii lɛ amli ni kɛ mla ni kɛ mijwɛŋmɔ yaa lɛ wuɔ ta, ni eŋɔɔ mi nom ehãa esha mla lɛ ni yɔɔ mihenii lɛ amli lɛ.
Gbɔmɔ ni nii yɔɔ mɔbɔ ji mi!
Namɔ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ gbele gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ dɛŋ?
Shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, nɔ.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ mi nɔŋŋ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ moŋ, shi mikɛ migbɔmɔ su sɔ̃mɔɔ esha Mla.
Shihilɛ yɛ mumɔ naa No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ fɔ ko fɔ ko bɛ ni abaabu mɛi ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mumɔ mla ni hãa wala yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ekpɔ̃ mi yɛ esha kɛ gbele mla lɛ dɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni Mla lɛ nyɛɛɛ afee yɛ gbedemɔ ni heloo lɛ ehã egbede hewɔ lɛ, no Nyɔŋmɔ fee: etsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ yɛ su ni tamɔ esha heloo su mli, yɛ esha hewɔ; ni ebu esha lɛ fɔ yɛ heloo lɛ mli, koni afee Mla lɛ taomɔnii ni ja lɛ yɛ wɔmli, wɔ mɛi ni wɔnyiɛɛɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa wɔnyiɛɔ lɛ.
Mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo naa lɛ, heloonii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ; shi mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ, mumɔnii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Ejaakɛ heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, gbele ni, shi mumɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, wala kɛ hejɔlɛ ni.
Heloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛɛ ni, akɛni ebaaa ehe shi ehãaa Nyɔŋmɔ Mla lɛ, ni esaa enyɛŋ tete lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛi ni hiɔ shi yɛ heloo mli lɛ nyɛɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ amɛsa.
Nyɛhiii shi yɛ heloo naa, shi moŋ mumɔ naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko bɛ Kristo Mumɔ lɛ, belɛ jeee Kristo nɔ ji lɛ.
Shi kɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, no lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ egbo yɛ esha hewɔ nɛ, shi Mumɔ lɛ hiɛ kã, yɛ jalɔi ni abu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ni tee Yesu shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ, mɔ ni tee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ aaahã nyɛgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ hu yi ana wala yɛ eMumɔ ni hiɔ nyɛmli lɛ hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɔjiatsɛmɛi ji wɔ, shi jeee heloo lɛ nyɔmɔ wɔhiɛ ni wɔɔhi shi yɛ heloo naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ heloo naa nyɛhiɔ shi yɛ lɛ, nyɛbaagboi shi kɛ nyɛkɛ Mumɔ lɛ gbeɔ heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ, nyɛhiɛ aaakãmɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa amɛ lɛ, amɛ amɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii.
Ejaakɛ jeee nyɔŋ mumɔ nyɛna ni aaahã nyɛshe gbeyei ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni hãa mɛi tsɔ̃mɔɔ bii ni hãa wɔboɔ wɔtsɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ, “Aba!
Ataa!” lɛ.
Lɛ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔmumɔ lɛ yeɔ odase akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji wɔ.
Ni kɛ bii ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ niyelɔi hu ji wɔ, Nyɔŋmɔ niyelɔi kɛ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi; kɛji wɔ kɛ lɛ na amanehulu lɛ, koni awo wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ nyam hu.
Wɔsɛɛ anunyam Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ amanehului lɛ kɛ anunyam ni wɔsɛɛ abaajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ lɛ yeee egbɔ.
Ejaakɛ bɔɔnii lɛ kɛ gbɛkwɛmɔ kpɛ̃kpɛ̃ɛkpɛ̃ miimɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ akpojiemɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ ewo yakayakanii ashishi, jeee yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, shi moŋ yɛ mɔ ni ba amɛ shi lɛ suɔmɔ naa; kɛ̃lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu abaahã amɛye amɛhe kɛjɛ fitemɔ ni yeɔ amɛ nyɔŋ lɛ shishi kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ bii lɛ anunyam heyeli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ̃mɔɔ ni amɛkɔ̃mɔ̃ɔ kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ.
Shi jeee amɛ kɛkɛŋ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ tete, wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ Mumɔ lɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii lɛ, wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu wɔkɛ̃mɔ̃ɔ yɛ wɔmli, ni wɔkwɛɔ gbɛ akɛ wɔbaatsɔ̃mɔ bii, no ji abaakpɔ̃ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Ejaakɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa ahere wɔyiwala yɛ.
Hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni anaa lɛ, ejeee hiɛnɔkãmɔ, ejaakɛ namɔ hiɛ kãa nɔ ni enaa nɔ?
Shi kɛ nɔ ni wɔnaaa lɛ nɔ wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, belɛ wɔkɛ tsuishiŋmɛɛ kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Mumɔ lɛ hu yeɔ buaa wɔ yɛ wɔgbedemɔi lɛ amli; ejaakɛ bɔ ni sa akɛ wɔsɔle lɛ wɔleee; shi moŋ Mumɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ ŋtsɔidɔɔmɔi ni anyɛŋ akɛɛ lɛ dãmɔɔ mli hãa wɔ.
Ni mɔ ni taoɔ tsuii amli lɛ le nɔ ni ji mumɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ edãmɔɔ mli ehãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.
Shi wɔle akɛ mɛi ni sumɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nibii fiaa yeɔ buaa amɛ ni ahi ahã amɛ, amɛ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ yɛ yiŋtoo naa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni ele amɛ eto momo lɛ, amɛ ejie eto ni amɛsubaŋ atamɔ eBi lɛ nɔ lɛ, koni efee nyɛmimɛi pii ateŋ kromɔbi.
Shi mɛi ni ejie eto lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ etsɛ; ni mɛi ni etsɛ lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ bem ebu; ni mɛi ni ebu amɛ bem lɛ, amɛ nɔŋŋ amɛhiɛ nyam ewo.
Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ yɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔŋ?
Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ wɔsɛɛ lɛ, namɔ aaate shi awo wɔ?
Lɛ mɔ ni kãmãaa wɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ, shi moŋ ekɛ lɛ hã yɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔnajiaŋ lɛ, ani eŋɔŋ nibii fiaa efataŋ ehe ekeŋ wɔ?
Namɔ aaafolɔ Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ anaa?
Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ bem.
Namɔ ji mɔ ni buɔ fɔ lɛ?
Kristo, mɔ ni gbo, shi nɔ ni fe no lɛ, mɔ ni atee lɛ shi ni eyɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ, ni esaa edamɔɔ mli ehãa wɔ lɛ?
Namɔ aaagbala wɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni Kristo kɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ mli?
Amanehulu loo fimɔ loo yiwaa loo hɔ̃mɔ loo yayainyiɛmɔ loo osharã loo klante?
Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Ohewɔ lɛ agbeɔ wɔ aahu jenamɔ tuu; abu wɔ akɛ toi ni ayaagbe amɛ.” Shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛɛmɛi fiaa mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ni sumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ wɔyeɔ kunim tsɔ̃.
Ejaakɛ miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ gbele jio, wala jio; ŋwɛi bɔfoi jio, nɔyelɔi jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio, hewalɛi jio, ŋwɛi jio, shishi jio, aloo nibii ni abɔ lɛ amli nɔ kroko jio, amɛnyɛŋ amɛgbala wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ emaŋ ni ehala lɛ Miiwie anɔkwale yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee, ni mihenilee hu miiye mi odase yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli, akɛ miiye ŋkɔmɔ babaoo, ni mitsui yeɔ daa.
Ejaakɛ mina ni kulɛ ajie mi yɛ Kristo he akɛ musumɔ yɛ minyɛmimɛi ni ji miwekumɛi yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ ahewɔ.
Amɛ ji Israelbii lɛ; ni amɛnɔ ji bitsɔ̃mɔ lɛ kɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔi lɛ kɛ mlahãmɔ lɛ kɛ jamɔ lɛ kɛ shiwoi lɛ, amɛnɔ ji tsɛmɛi lɛ, ni amɛmli hu Kristo tete jɛ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, lɛ ji nii fiaa nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ.
Amen!
Shi jeee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ efee yaka.
Ejaakɛ jeee mɛi ni jɛ Israel mli lɛ fɛɛ ji “Israel musuŋ bii”, ni asaŋ jeee akɛ ni Abraham shwiei ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ, bii ji amɛ fɛɛ, shi moŋ, “Mɛi ni jɛ Isak mli lɛ aaatsɛ amɛ oshwiei.” No ji akɛ, jeee heloo naa bii lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ bii, shi shiwoo naa bii lɛ moŋ abuɔ akɛ oshwiei.
Ejaakɛ shiwoo wiemɔ lɛ nɛ, “Wɔsɛɛ agbɔ be nɛ lɛ maba, ni Sara aaana binuu.” Shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ wɔtsɛ Isak kome lɛ nɔŋŋ Rebeka kɛna musu, shi be ni anako afɔ bii lɛ, ni amɛsaa amɛfeko nɔ kpakpa ko loo nɔ fɔŋ ko lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo ni akɛhalaa mɔ lɛ amã shi, ni ekajɛ nitsumɔi amli, shi moŋ ejɛ mɔ ni tsɛɔ mɔ lɛ, akɛɛ Rebeka akɛ, “Onukpa lɛ baasɔ̃mɔ gbekɛ lɛ.” Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Yakob lɛ, misumɔ lɛ, shi Esau lɛ minyɛ lɛ lɛ.” Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ yeɔ sane ko ni ejaaa?
Dabida!
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ Mose akɛ, “Mɔ ni minaa lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mɔbɔ mibana, ni mɔ ni mimusuŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mi hãa lɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ mimusuŋ aaatsɔ̃ mi ahã.” No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ko suɔmɔ loo emɔdɛŋbɔɔ naa ni, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa ni.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ Farao akɛ, “Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitee bo shi, koni majie mihewalɛ kpo kɛtsɔ̃ onɔ, koni atsi migbɛi tã yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.” Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni esumɔɔ akɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, enaa lɛ mɔbɔ, ni kɛ eesumɔ akɛ ewaje mɔ ko tsui lɛ, ewajeɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu kɛ emɔbɔnalɛ Shi agbɛnɛ ooobi mi akɛ, “Belɛ mɛɛba Nyɔŋmɔ shwaa mɔ̃ mɔ?
Ejaakɛ namɔ aaanyɛ eyiŋtoo naa aku?” Shi, bo gbɔmɔ, namɔ ji bo, ni okɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kaneɔ?
Ani nɔ ni ashɔ̃ lɛ aaabi mɔ ni shɔ̃ lɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mɛɛba oshɔ̃ mi nɛkɛ?” Aloo gbɛshɔ̃lɔ bɛ hegbɛ yɛ su lɛ nɔ, akɛ ekɛ su ni akpɔtɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ eko aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni yɔɔ nyam ni ekɛ eko hu aaashɔ̃ nɔ ko ni bɛ nyam?
Shi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ miisumɔ akɛ ejie emlifu kpo etsɔ̃ɔ ni ehã ale ehe ni wa lɛ, ni kɛ̃lɛ eŋmɛɔ etsui shi babaoo ehiɛɔ mlifu nii ni sa fitemɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni ehã ale enunyam falɛ lɛ hu yɛ emɔbɔnalɛ nii ni esaa eto ehã anunyam lɛ anɔ lɛ, mɛni obaakɛɛ?
Shi nakai etsɛ wɔ hu, jeee mɛi ni jɛ Yudafoi ateŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi mɛi ni jɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ lɛ hu.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ Hoshea wolo lɛ mli akɛ, “Matsɛ mɛi ni jeee mimaŋ lɛ akɛ mimaŋ, kɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔɔ lɛ lɛ akɛ mɔ ni asumɔɔ lɛ.” “Ni aaaba mli akɛ, he ni akɛɛ amɛ yɛ akɛ, ‘Jeee mimaŋ ji nyɛ’ lɛ, jɛi nɔŋŋ aaatsɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ bii yɛ.” Shi Yesaia bo yɛ Israel he akɛ, “Kɛ Israelbii lɛ ayibɔ tamɔ ŋshɔnaa shia lɛ, mɛi fioo ni baashwɛ lɛ yiwala aaahere.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsu ewiemɔ lɛ he nii kuku egbe naa pɛpɛɛpɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni tamɔ bɔ ni Yesaia ekɛɛ eto momo lɛ akɛ, “Eji Tai aNuŋtsɔ lɛ eshwɛɛɛ shwiei ko ehãaa wɔ kulɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ tamɔ Sodom, ni wɔfee tamɔ Gomora pɛ.” Israel nine shɛɛɛ jalɛ nɔ Belɛ te wɔɔkɛɛ tɛŋŋ?
Akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni ediii jalɛ sɛɛ lɛ ena jalɛ ni ji jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ; shi Israel moŋ ni diɔ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, enine shɛɛɛ nɔ.
Mɛɛ hewɔ ni?
Ejaakɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛtaooo, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ nitsumɔi anɔ taoɔ.
Ejaakɛ amɛtɛrɛ tɛmɔ tɛ lɛ; tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Naa, mikɛ tɛmɔ tɛ kɛ nanetɔ̃tɔ̃mɔ tɛsaa ko miima shi yɛ Zion, Ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ eyeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ.”
Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mitsui shweɔ kɛ fai ni mikpaa Nyɔŋmɔ mihãa Israel ji akɛ ahere amɛyiwala.
Ejaakɛ miiye amɛhe odase akɛ amɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he moŋ, shi jeee nilee naa.
Ejaakɛ amɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ, shi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛjalɛ moŋ amɛtaoɔ amɛkɛma shi, hewɔ lɛ amɛbaaa amɛhe shi amɛhãaa Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo ji Mla lɛ naagbee, ni lɛ ji jalɛ hã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Yiwalaheremɔ yɛ hã mɛi fɛɛ Ejaakɛ Mose ŋma yɛ jalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli lɛ he akɛ, “Gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ enɛɛmɛi anɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.” Shi bɔ ni jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ kɛɔ nɛ, “Kaakɛɛ yɛ otsui mli akɛ, ‘Namɔ aaakwɔ kɛaatee ŋwɛi?’ ” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛkpeleke shi.
Aloo, “Namɔ aaakpeleke shi kɛaatee bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli?” No ji, koni eyaŋɔ Kristo kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ kɛba.
Shi moŋ te ekɛɔ tɛŋŋ?
“Bɛŋkɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ bo yɛ odaa mli kɛ otsui mli fɛɛ,” no ji hemɔkɛyeli wiemɔ lɛ ni wɔshiɛɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛji okɛ onaabu jaje akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” lɛ, ni ohe oye yɛ otsui mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, aaahere oyi wala.
Ejaakɛ tsui akɛheɔ ayeɔ kɛshɛɔ jalɛ he, ni naabu akɛjajeɔ kɛshɛɔ yiwalaheremɔ he.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ, ehiɛ gboŋ.” Ejaakɛ srɔto ko bɛ Yudanyo kɛ Helanyo teŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome amɛ fɛɛ amɛyɔɔ, ni niiatsɛ hu ji lɛ ha mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ tsɛɔ lɛ lɛ.
“Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aaabo atsɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, aaahere eyi wala.” Shi te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaabo amɛtsɛ mɔ ni amɛheko lɛ amɛyeko lɛ hu?
Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaahe mɔ ni amɛnuko ehe sane lɛ amɛye hu?
Ni asaŋ te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaanu kɛ shiɛlɔ ko bɛ lɛ?
Ni te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni amɛaashiɛ, kɛ atsuko amɛ lɛ?
Tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Kwɛ bɔ ni Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi ni shiɛɔ nikpakpai lɛ anaji yɔɔ fɛo ha!” Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi, ejaakɛ Yesaia kɛɔ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, namɔ ehe wɔsane lɛ eye?” Belɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, sane toiboo mli jɛɔ, ni sane toiboo hu tsɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ nɔ kɛbaa.
Shi miibi akɛ, “Aso nu amɛnuuu?” Anɔkwale mli lɛ amɛnu, tamɔ bɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Amɛgbee ejije kɛtee shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛwiemɔi lɛ eshɛ jeŋ naagbeehei lɛ.” Shi miibi hu akɛ, “Aso le Israel leee?” Mose etsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Mahã nyɛye maŋ ni jeee maŋ ko he awuŋã, ni mikɛ maŋ ko ni leee nɔ ko aaawo nyɛ mlila.” Yesaia kɛ ekãa kɛɛ, “Mihã mɛi ni taooo mi lɛ na mi, Ni mijie mihe kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni biko mishi lɛ.” Shi Israel lɛ, ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Daa jenamɔ migbɛɔ minijiaŋ mihãa maŋ toigbolɔi kɛ sanenaajielɔi lɛ.”
Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ ha Israel lolo Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eshɛ emaŋ lɛ efɔ̃?” Dabida!
Ejaakɛ mi hu Israelnyo ji mi, ni mijɛ Abraham shwiei kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ shɛko emaŋ ni ele eto momo lɛ efɔ̃ko.
Aloo nyɛleee nɔ ni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɛ yɛ Elia yi nɔ lɛ, be ni edamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni efolɔɔ Israel naa akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ, ogbalɔi lɛ, amɛgbe amɛ, ni ofɔleshãalatɛi lɛ, amɛwule amɛshwie shi, ni eshwɛ mi kome too, ni amɛmiitao mi amɛgbe.” Shi mɛɛ hetoo Nyɔŋmɔ hã lɛ?
“Mishwɛ hii akpei kpawo ni kɛ amɛnakutsei kulako shi hãko Baal mihã mihe.” Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amrɔ nɛɛ hu eshwɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ dromɔ halamɔ naa.
Shi kɛji dromɔ lɛ naa ni lɛ, belɛ jeee nitsumɔi anaa ni dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ no lɛ dromɔ lɛ jeee dromɔ dɔŋŋ.
Belɛ te tɛŋŋ?
Nɔ ni Israel taoɔ lɛ enine shɛɛɛ nɔ; shi mɛi ni ahala lɛ anine shɛ nɔ, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, awaje amɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ ehã amɛ shɔ̃ɔfeemɔ ko, hiŋmɛii ni amɛkɛnaaa nii, kɛ toii ni amɛkɛnuuu nii kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ.” Ni David kɛɛ akɛ, “Hã amɛkpɔlɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ akpa kɛ loofɔlɔduu tsɔne kɛ tɛmɔnɔ kɛ toigbalamɔ ahã amɛ.
Hã amɛhiɛ awo duŋ, ni amɛkana nii, ni ohã amɛdɔ kɔmɔɔ daa.” Agbɛnɛ miibi akɛ, “Belɛ amɛtɛrɛ koni amɛgbee shi?” Dabida!
Shi moŋ atsɔ̃ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ nɔ ahere jeŋmaji lɛ ayi wala, koni Israel aye awuŋã.
Shi kɛ amɛshigbeemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ je lɛ ninamɔ, ni amɛnɔgbɔmɔ lɛ hu tsɔ̃ jeŋmaji aninamɔ lɛ, belɛ amɛyifalɛ lɛ te eeehã ninamɔ lɛ afee tɛŋŋ?
Jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ ayiwalaheremɔ Agbɛnɛ nyɛ ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiabii lɛ, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Gbii abɔ ni mi mi ji jeŋmaji abɔfo lɛ, mawo misɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam, akɛ aleenɔ mikɛaahã mijakubii lɛ aye awuŋã, ni mahere amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ayiwala lo.
Ejaakɛ kɛ amɛshɛmɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ je lɛ ekpãtã lɛ, belɛ amɛheremɔ lɛ, ani jeee wala ni jɛ gbohii ateŋ ni?
“Shi kɛji fioo ni ajie ahã Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai masui lɛ fɛɛ hu yɔɔ; ni kɛ tso shishifã lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, belɛ nakai niji lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Shi kɛji akumɔ tso niji lɛ ekomɛi, ni abatɛo bo ni oji ŋaŋmutso lɛ yɛ amɛnajiaŋ, ni ona mutso lɛ shishifã lɛ kɛ emlinu lɛ eko lɛ, kaashwã yɛ niji lɛ anɔ; shi kɛji oshwã yɛ amɛnɔ lɛ, naa, jeee bo ohiɛ shishifã lɛ, shi shishifã lɛ moŋ hiɛ bo.” Agbɛnɛ ekolɛ oookɛɛ akɛ, “Kuumɔ akumɔ niji lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni atɛo mi awo tso lɛ mli.” Ojogbaŋŋ!
He ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ akumɔ amɛ; ni bo lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli okɛdamɔ shi lɛ.
Kaawo ohe nɔ, shi moŋ she ohe gbeyei; ejaakɛ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ebaaa tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ ayi lɛ, bo hu ebaaŋ oyi.
No hewɔ lɛ, kwɛmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlihilɛ kɛ bɔ ni ekɛ mɔ yeɔ waa hu, ekɛ mɛi ni egbee shi lɛ yeɔ waa, shi bo lɛ, emli hi yɛ onɔ kɛji ohi emlihilɛ lɛ mli lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ, bo hu aaafo bo ashɛ afɔ̃.
Ni amɛ hu, kɛji amɛhiɛɛɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ mli lɛ, aaatɛo amɛ awo mli; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ atɛo amɛ awo mli ekoŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ, kɛji bo lɛ, fo afo bo yɛ tso ni yɛ bɔɔsu naa lɛ ŋaŋmutso ni lɛ he, ni atɛo bo awo mutso kpakpa lɛ mli, ni jeee adebɔɔ gbɛ ni lɛ, mɛnɛɛmɛi ni ji tso lɛ diɛŋtsɛ niji lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni atɛoŋ amɛ awoŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmutso lɛ mli!
Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Israel baawo egbɛhe ekoŋŋ Ejaakɛ misumɔɔɔ akɛ mishiuɔ nyɛ nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ nɔ, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛkabu nyɛhe oleetei, akɛ, wajemɔ awaje Israel tsui fã kɛ fã kɛyashi beyinɔ ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba mli.
Ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ aaatsɔ̃ ahere Israel fɛɛ yiwala, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Jielɔ lɛ aaajɛ Zion aba ni eeebajie nɔshafeemɔ yɛ Yakob he eshɛ efɔ̃; ni enɛ ji mi kɛ amɛ teŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ, akɛ majie amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛaatee.” Yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ henyɛlɔi ji amɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ; shi yɛ halamɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asumɔɔ amɛ yɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwaaa ehe yɛ edromɔ nii lɛ kɛ etsɛmɔ lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛbooo Nyɔŋmɔ toi, shi agbɛnɛ ana nyɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtoigbele lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ amɛ hu agbɛnɛ amɛtoi egbo, koni bɔ ni ana nyɛ mɔbɔ lɛ, amɛ hu ana amɛ mɔbɔ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋamɔ mɛi fɛɛ ayi ewo toigbele mli, bɔ ni afee ni ena amɛ fɛɛ mɔbɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ Ao, Nyɔŋmɔ nifalɛ kɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee mlikwɔlɛ!
Ekojomɔi lɛ anyɛɛɛ shishi ana, ni egbɛi lɛ hu anyɛɛɛ sɛɛ mo aja!
Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ, Aloo namɔ ewo lɛ ŋaa pɛŋ?
Aloo namɔ etsɔ̃ hiɛ ehã lɛ nɔ ko, ni kulɛ aaato lɛ najiaŋ?” Ejaakɛ edɛŋ nii fɛɛ jɛ, ni enɔ amɛtsɔ̃ kɛba, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛyɔɔ amɛhã.
Lɛ aaaŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛya naanɔ.
Amen!
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, mikɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlitsɔlɛ miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛŋɔ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ afɔle ni hiɛ kã ni he tse ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; enɛ ji jamɔ ni sa.
Ni nyɛkabaa nyɛjeŋ tamɔ jeŋbii, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni etsɔ̃ ehee lɛ afea nyɛhe gbɔmɛi hei, koni nyɛyoo nii ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii kpakpai ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni hi kɛwula shi lɛ.
Shi miitsɔ̃ dromɔ ni akɛduro mi lɛ nɔ miikɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akɛ, ekabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe tuutu fe bɔ ni sa; shi moŋ ejwɛŋ kɛ hiɛshikãmɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ehã lɛ lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni gbɔmɔtso kome he lɛ wɔyɛ henii pii, shi henii lɛ fɛɛ tsuuu nitsumɔ kome lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔyi pii nɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ yɛ Kristo mli, ni wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ enaanyohenɔ ji lɛ, ni dromɔ ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔyɛ dromɔ keenii srɔtoi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ; kɛji mɔ ko nɔ ji akɛ egba lɛ, egba yɛ hemɔkɛyeli bɔ ni akɛhã lɛ lɛ naa; kɛji sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni lɛ, ehiɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; kɛ tsɔɔlɔ ji mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ mli; mɔ ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi lɛ, ehiɛ wiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli; mɔ ni kɛ enii feɔ ejurɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ; mɔ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ; mɔ ni naa mɔbɔ lɛ, efee kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Jeŋba ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ Suɔmɔ lɛ osato akahi mli.
Nyɛhia efɔŋ kwraa; nyɛ kpɛtɛa ekpakpa he; nyɛkɛ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ni mli wa asumɔsumɔa nyɛhe; mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsɔ̃ hiɛ ekɛ woo ahã enaanyo.
Nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ naa akabaa shi; nyɛmumɔ lɛ he adɔa la; nyɛsɔ̃mɔa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Nyɛnyãa yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ mli; nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu mli; nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli daa.
Nyɛhãa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiamɔ lɛ afea nyɛ hu nyɛhiamɔ; nyɛbɔa gbɔfeemɔ he mɔdɛŋ.
Nyɛjɔa mɛi ni waa nyɛ yi lɛ, nyɛjɔa ni nyɛkalomɔa.
Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni nyãa lɛ anyãa, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi ni foɔ lɛ afoa.
Nyɛjwɛŋjwɛŋa nyɛhe jwɛŋmɔ kome; nyɛkajwɛŋa henɔwomɔ jwɛŋmɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibalɔi lɛ abɔa.
Nyɛkabua nyɛhe nilelɔi.
Nyɛkɛ efɔŋ akatoa mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ najiaŋ; nyɛjwɛŋa nɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo yɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ nyɛtoa.
Kɛ aaaho lɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahia shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli.
Suɔlɔi, nyɛkatɔa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe owele, shi moŋ nyɛŋmɛa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ gbɛ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, mi mato najiaŋ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji hɔ̃mɔ miiye ohenyɛlɔ lɛ, hã lɛ nii eye; kɛji kumai miiye lɛ lɛ, hã lɛ nu enu; ejaakɛ kɛ ofee nakai lɛ, obaabua ŋai kɛ la naa oshwie eyiteŋ.
Kaahã efɔŋ miiye onɔ kunim, shi moŋ okɛ ekpakpafeemɔ aye efɔŋ nɔ kunim.
Heshibaa hã maŋnɔyelɔi Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aba ehe shi ahã hegbɛi ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ hegbɛ ko bɛ ni jeee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ejɛ; hegbɛi ni yɔɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ to.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni kuɔ hegbɛ lɛ naa lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ eteɔ shi eshiɔ lɛ; ni mɛi ni teɔ shi nakai lɛ aaana amɛkojomɔ.
Ejaakɛ lumɛi lɛ, amɛhe bɛ gbeyei hã mɔ ni feɔ ekpakpa, shi hã mɔ ni feɔ efɔŋ moŋ; shi kɛji otaooo akɛ nɔyelɔ lɛ he ahi gbeyei ahã bo lɛ, feemɔ ekpakpa, ni ooona yijiemɔ yɛ edɛŋ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji lɛ yɛ ohewɔ, koni ahi ahã bo.
Shi kɛji ofee efɔŋ lɛ, she gbeyei; ejaakɛ jeee yaka ehiɛ tsi lɛ; shi eji Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ oweletɔlɔ ni hãa Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa mɔ ni tsuɔ nifɔɔjianii lɛ nɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, sa akɛ abaa he shi, jeee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu lɛ kɛkɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ henilee hewɔ hu.
Enɛ hewɔ ni nyɛtsuɔ onia hu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuji ji amɛ, ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ he amɛyɔɔ.
Bɔ ni ji mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhãa lɛ.
Mɔ nɔ ni ji onia lɛ, nyɛtsua onia; mɔ nɔ ni ji tóo lɛ, tóo; mɔ nɔ ni ji gbeyeishemɔ lɛ, gbeyeishemɔ; mɔ nɔ ni ji woo lɛ, woo.
Suɔmɔ ji Mla lɛ nɔyeli Nyɛkahiɛa mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔmɔ, akɛ ja suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛaasumɔsumɔ nyɛhe lɛ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ enaanyo lɛ eye Mla lɛ nɔ kɛwula shi.
Ejaakɛ kɛji akɛɛ akɛ, “Kaafite gbãlã!
Kaaju!
Ohiɛ akakɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ!” Ni kɛ kitã kroko hu yɛ lɛ, fɛɛ hɔ nɛkɛ wiemɔ nɛɛ ni ji “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe” lɛ mli.
Suɔmɔ efeee enaanyo efɔŋ ko, hewɔ lɛ suɔmɔ pɛ ji Mla lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli.
Ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ ebɛŋkɛ Ni nyɛle enɛ hu, no ji be lɛ, akɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa ni nyɛkɛaate shi kɛjɛ wɔ mli lɛ eshɛ; ejaakɛ wɔyiwalaheremɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ agbɛnɛ fe tsutsu be ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ.
Nyɔɔŋ lɛ eho etã, ni jetsɛremɔ ebɛŋkɛ; no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔjiea duŋ mli nitsumɔi lɛ wɔshwiea, ni wɔwo la tawuunii lɛ.
Nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa fɛɛfɛo bɔ ni sa shwane, jeee yɛ dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ dãatɔɔ mli; jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ mli, jeee bei kɛ awuŋayeli mli; shi moŋ nyɛwoa Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo tamɔ dama, ni nyɛkahãa heloo lɛ nɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ miitsɔ̃ heloo lɛ sɛɛdii.
Kaakojo onyɛmi Mɔ ni ji gbedelɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nyɛherea lɛ atuu; shi nyɛkɛ lɛ akakojoa yɛ esusumɔi ahe.
Mɔ ko yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ekɛyeɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ; shi mɔ ni egbede lɛ, shwie kɛkɛ eyeɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ akagbe mɔ ni yeee lɛ he guɔ, ni mɔ ni yeee lɛ akakojo mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehere lɛ atuu.
Namɔ ji bo ni okojoɔ mɔ kroko wenuu?
Edamɔ shi jio, egbee shi jio, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enuŋtsɔ sane ni; shi eeedamɔ shi, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni eeehã edamɔ shi.
Mɔ ko buɔ gbi ko fe gbi kroko, ni mɔ ko hu buɔ gbi fɛɛ gbi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejwɛŋmɔ yɛ enɛ he.
Mɔ ni buɔ gbi titri ko lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ efeɔ.
Mɔ ni yeɔ nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeɔ, ejaakɛ edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi; ni mɔ ni yeee nii lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyeee, ni lɛ hu edaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ wɔteŋ mɔ ko hiɛ kãaa hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, ni mɔ ko gbooo hu hãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Shi kɛji wɔhiɛ kã lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ kã wɔhã; ni kɛji wɔgboi hu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wɔgboi wɔhã.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ kã jio, wɔgboi jio, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nii ji wɔ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ Kristo gbo ni ete shi ni ehiɛ kã bɔ ni afee ni etsɔ̃ gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi fɛɛ aNuŋtsɔ.
Shi bo, mɛɛba okojoɔ onyɛmi?
Aloo bo hu, mɛɛba ogbeɔ onyɛmi he guɔ?
Ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaadamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ‘Akɛni mihiɛ kã nɛɛ nakutso fɛɛ nakutso aaakula shi ahã mi, ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi aaajaje Nyɔŋmɔ atsɔ̃ɔ.’ ” No hewɔ lɛ, wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ baabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɔntaa ehã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kaato onyɛmi pampi No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔkojokojoa wɔhe dɔŋŋ; shi enɛ moŋ nyɛkojoa, akɛ mɔ ko kɛ tɛmɔnɔ ko akama enyɛmi gbɛ nɔ aloo eto lɛ pampi.
Mile ni misaa miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni eji bulemɔnɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Mɔ ni buɔ nɔ ko akɛ bulemɔnɔ ni lɛ, lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ bulemɔnɔ ehãa.
Shi kɛji nɔ ko ni oyeɔ lɛ gbaa onyɛmi naa lɛ, belɛ jeee suɔmɔ naa obaa ojeŋ yɛ lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Okɛ oniyenii lɛ akakpãtã mɔ ni Kristo gbo hã lɛ lɛ hiɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa awiea nyɛnɔ kpakpa lɛ he efɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ jeee niyeli kɛ ninumɔ ni, shi moŋ jalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ ni; ni mɔ ni sɔ̃mɔɔ Kristo yɛ enɛɛmɛi amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ naa ehe tsuijurɔ ni esa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛhãa wɔtiua hejɔlɛ nibii kɛ nibii ni wɔkɛhã wɔnanemɛi anane amɔ shi moŋ sɛɛ.
Kaafite Nyɔŋmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ yɛ niyenii ko hewɔ.
Nibii fɛɛ he tse nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ eji efɔŋ hã gbɔmɔ ni yeɔ ekɛtoɔ pampi lɛ.
Ehi akɛ okaye loo ni asaŋ okanu wain loo nɔ ko ni aaato onyɛmi pampi.
Bo lɛ oyɛ hemɔkɛyeli?
Okɛto oha bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni ekojooo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yɛ nɔ ni ebuɔ akɛ ehi lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni yiŋ etɛ̃ɛɛ lɛ lɛ, kɛji eye lɛ, eyeɔ fɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ ejɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli eyeee; ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni jɛɛɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ esha ni.
Nyɛfea nɔ ni aaasa nyɛnanemɛi ahiɛ Wɔ mɛi ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔkɛ mɛi ni bɛ hewalɛ lɛ agbɔjɔmɔi lɛ kpeɔ amɛ, ni wɔhe akasa wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhiɛ.
Wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asa enaanyo hiɛ, koni ahi ahã lɛ ni enane amɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ Kristo hu hãaa ehe asa ehiɛ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɛi ni bɔɔ bo ahora lɛ ahorabɔi lɛ ebakã minɔ.” Ejaakɛ nibii abɔ ni aŋma ato momo lɛ, aŋma ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ nii, koni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ kɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ amli miishɛjemɔ lɛ ana hiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa wɔnyɛɔ wɔhiɛ wɔmĩaa ni eshɛjeɔ wɔmii lɛ ahã nyɛna jwɛŋmɔ kome yɛ nyɛteŋ tamɔ Kristo Yesu, koni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ naabu kome awo Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, hiɛ nyam.
Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ hã Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhereherea nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo ehere nyɛ kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ mli lɛ.
