Shi miikɛɛ akɛ Yesu Kristo tsɔ̃ sɔ̃ɔlɔ ehã Yudafoi lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwale lɛ hewɔ, koni ekɛmã shiwoi ni awo tsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ mi; ni jeŋmaji lɛ awo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mɔbɔnalɛ hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, majie oyi yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ni matsi ogbɛi tã mala.” Ni Ŋmalɛ lɛ saa kɛɛ, “Nyɛ jeŋmaji, nyɛ kɛ emaŋ lɛ mli afilia nyɛ!” Ni asaŋ, “Nyɛjiea Nuŋtsɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ jeŋmaji fɛɛ, ni nyɛkafoa lɛ, nyɛ maji fɛɛ!” Ni asaŋ Yesaia kɛɛ akɛ, “Ishai shishifã lɛ aaaba, mɔ hu ni aaate shi koni ebaye jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ lɛ; lɛ enɔ jeŋmaji lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ aaafɔ̃.” Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ kɛ miishɛɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ fɛɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni ateke nɔ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ mli.
Nɔ hewɔ ni Paulo kɛ ekãa ŋma wolo nɛɛ Shi anyɛmimɛi, mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miheɔ miyeɔ krɛdɛɛ yɛ nyɛhe akɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ɔbɔ̃ kɛ mlihilɛ; ni nilee fɛɛ eyimɔ nyɛ tɔ, ni nyɛnyɛɔ nyɛwieɔ nyɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛhe hu.
Shi, mikɛ ekãa pii ŋmala saji nɛɛ ekomɛi mihã nyɛ, koni mikɛkai nyɛ, yɛ dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro mi lɛ hewɔ; koni mitsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ mihã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni mitsu Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ he nii akɛ osɔfo, ni jeŋmaji lɛ atsɔ̃mɔ afɔle ni sa ehiɛ jogbaŋŋ ni atsuu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ shwãanɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nii ni mitsuɔ mihãa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ mikaŋ akɛ mawie nɔ ko akɛ ja nɔ ni Kristo tsɔ̃ minɔ etsu ehã jeŋmaji lɛ atoiboo yɛ wiemɔ kɛ nifeemɔnii amli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii ahewalɛ mli, yɛ Mumɔ hewalɛ mli; bɔ ni fee nɛ ni mijɛ Yerusalɛm mibɔle shi aahu kɛyashi Ilirikum ni mishiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ migbe naa.
Nɔ ni mikɛmã mihiɛ titri ji akɛ, he ni atsiko Kristo gbɛi tã yɛ lɛ, jɛi majaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mikayatswa mɔ kroko shishitoo nɔ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mɛi ni ajajeko ehe sane ko atsɔ̃ko amɛ lɛ, amɛaana, ni mɛi ni nuko lɛ, amɛaanu shishi.” Paulo to eyiŋ akɛ eeeya Roma Enɛ nɔŋŋ etsi mi gbɛ aahu ni mibako nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ akɛni mibɛ nɔ ko tsumɔ yɛ biɛ niiaŋ dɔŋŋ, ni misaa mije afii pii miitao akɛ mibaa nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni mafã gbɛ kɛaatee Tarshish lɛ, maba nyɛŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ miiho lɛ, mabakwɛ nyɛhiɛ, koni, kɛji mina miishɛɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tswɛm lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya jɛi.
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ mifã gbɛ kɛmiiya Yerusalɛm ni miyasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia fɛɛ kɛ tsuijurɔ etsu onia ko kɛhã krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ Yerusalɛm lɛ ateŋ ohiafoi lɛ.
Tsuijurɔ naa amɛfee yɛ lɛɛlɛŋ moŋ, shi asaŋ amɛhiɛ amɛ nyɔmɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ena amɛmumɔŋ nikpakpai lɛ eko lɛ, belɛ esa akɛ amɛ hu amɛkɛ heloo nikpakpai lɛ eko asɔ̃mɔ amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mina migbe enɛ naa ni misɔo nɛkɛ yibii nɛɛ anaa mihã amɛ lɛ, mabatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Tarshish.
Ni mile akɛ, kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli jɔɔmɔ falɛ mli maba yɛ.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hewɔ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, akɛ nyɛfata mihe kɛpele yɛ nyɛsɔlemɔi ni nyɛsɔleɔ nyɛhãa mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ amli, koni ajie mi yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ adɛŋ, ni misɔ̃ɔmɔ ni miyaa miyasɔ̃mɔ yɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ asa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ jogbaŋŋ; koni, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, mikɛ miishɛɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ, ni mabawo mitsui yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
Amen!
Ŋamɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi Miijie wɔnyɛmi yoo Foibe ni ji Kenkrea asafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ yi mahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhere lɛ hiɛmɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛfata ehe yɛ nitsumɔ fɛɛ nitsumɔ ni nyɛhe hiaa lɛ yɛ mli lɛ mli; ejaakɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu eji mɛi pii kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu miyelikɛbualɔ.
Nyɛŋaa Priskila kɛ Akwila, ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛhãa mi; amɛkɛ amɛhe wo gbele mli yɛ miyiwala hewɔ, ni jeee mi kɛkɛ midaa amɛ shi, shi moŋ jeŋmaji lɛ amli asafoi lɛ fɛɛ hu daa amɛ shi.
Nyɛŋaa asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ hu.
Nyɛŋaa misuɔlɔ Epaineto ni ji mɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni jɛ Asia ni kɛ ehe hã Kristo lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Maria ni gba ehe naa pii yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Androniko kɛ Yunia, miwekumɛi ni awo mi kɛ amɛ tsuŋ ni amɛyɔɔ gbɛi yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Amplia mɔ ni misumɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Urbano ni ji wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, kɛ misuɔlɔ Staki.
Nyɛŋaa Apele mɔ ni he emɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Aristobulo shĩabii lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa miwekunyo Herodion lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa mɛi ni jɛ Narkiso shĩabii lɛ ateŋ ni amɛyɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Trifaina kɛ Trifosa ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Persi mɔ ni asumɔɔ ni etsu nii pii yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Rufo mɔ ni ahala lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, kɛ enyɛ ni ji nyɛ hã mi hu lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Asinkrito, Flegon, Herme, Patroba, Herma kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Nyɛŋaa Filologo kɛ Yulia, Nerea kɛ enyɛmi yoo lɛ, kɛ Olimpa kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ni kɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ.
Nyɛkɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ aŋaŋaa nyɛhe.
Kristo asafoi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛhiɛ akã mɛi ni jeɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni nyɛkase lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛkɛ mligbalamɔi kɛ pampitoo baa lɛ ahe, ni nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛje amɛhe.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, jeee wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi moŋ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmusu; ni amɛkɛ naaŋɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔi lakaa mɛi ni leee efɔŋ lɛ.
Shi nyɛtoiboo lɛ mɛi fɛɛ enu he; no hewɔ lɛ, mina nyɛhe miishɛɛ; shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛfee nyɛhe nilelɔi yɛ ekpakpa gbɛfãŋ; shi efɔŋ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, mɛi ni leee nɔ ko.
Shi etsɛŋ ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaanaanaa Satan nɔ kwraa yɛ nyɛnajiashi.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi.
Minaanyo nitsulɔ Timoteo kɛ miwekumɛi Lukio kɛ Yason kɛ Sosipatre miibi nyɛ.
Mi Tertio ni miŋma nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ, miibi nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Gaio ni ji mi kɛ asafo lɛ fɛɛ shĩatsɛ lɛ miibi nyɛ.
Erasto ni ji maŋ shikatolɔ lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Kwarto miibi nyɛ.
[ WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi!
Amen.]
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ Shi mɔ ni aaanyɛ ahã nyɛfi shi shiŋŋ yɛ misanekpakpa lɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo shiɛmɔ lɛ naa, yɛ teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ naanɔ beebe lɛ kpojiemɔ naa, teemɔ sane ni agbɛnɛ ajie atsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ yɛ naanɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ famɔ naa, ni atsɔ̃ gbalɔi lɛ aŋmalɛi lɛ anɔ atsi tã atsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ koni amɛbo hemɔkɛyeli lɛ toi lɛ naa lɛ, lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji nilelɔ kometoo lɛ, aŋɔ anunyam ahã lɛ, yɛ Yesu Kristo mli kɛyashi naanɔ.
Amen!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Bɔfo Paulo ŋma eklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ eyahã Korintobii lɛ bɔ ni afee ni ekɛku naagbai komɛi ni ete shi yɛ Kristofoi awala kɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ naa yɛ asafo hee ni eyato shishi yɛ Korinto lɛ mli.
Nakai be lɛ mli lɛ Korinto lɛ eji Helabii amaŋ wulu ni maji srɔtoisrɔtoi anɔbii ebahi jɛi, ni esaa eji Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Akaia lɛ hu maŋ wulu.
Ehe gbɛi akɛ he ko ni ayeɔ jra waa yɛ, ni emlibii lɛ shwãa fɔ̃ɔ amɛkusum nɔ; eji he ko hu ni jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ ehe shi waa yɛ, ni asaŋ jamɔi srɔtoi babaoo hu yɛ jɛmɛ.
Nɔ hewɔ titri ni bɔfo lɛ ŋma ewolo lɛ ji naagbai srɔtoi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, tamɔ akɛ mligblamɔi kɛ jeŋba fɔŋ kɛ ajwamaŋbɔɔ nɛkɛ.
Asaŋ, nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ kɛ gblãshihilɛ, henilee, asafo lɛ gbɛjianɔtoo, Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ dromɔ keenii kɛ Kristo shitee kã etsui nɔ po ni ehiii.
Bɔfo lɛ kɛ niiasɛɛyoomɔ kɛ nilee ni mli kwɔ tsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Sanekpakpa lɛ wieɔ nibii nɛɛ ahe ni egblaa eko fɛɛ eko mli fitsofitso.
Yitso lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ suɔmɔ fe dromɔ keenii fɛɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛdro emɛi lɛ, ni tamɔ nɔ ni no ji yitso ni ale fe fɛɛ yɛ majemɔ wolo nɛɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Mligblamɔi yɛ asafo lɛ mli .—.
Nuu kɛ yoo bɔlɛ kɛ weku shihilɛ .—.
Kristofoi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi .—.
Kristo asafo lɛ wala kɛ jamɔ .—.
Kristo kɛ mɛi ni heɔ enɔ yeɔ lɛ ashitee .- Yelikɛbuamɔ onia kɛhã Yudea Kristofoi lɛ .- Bɔfo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ he sane kɛ wolo lɛ naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ kɛ shidaa Paulo, Yesu Kristo bɔfo ni atsɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Sostene, ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.
Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ he fɛɛ he ni tsɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo ni ji wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Miida miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa nɛɛ yɛ nyɛhewɔ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhã nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ emli, yɛ wiemɔ fɛɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee fɛɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni ama Kristo he odase lɛ nɔ mi yɛ nyɛmli, ni dromɔ nikeenii ko eshwɛɛɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛkwɛɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Lɛ nɔŋŋ eeewaje nyɛ kɛaatee naagbee ni nyɛhe akaba kpa ko yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbi lɛ nɔ.
Anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ kɛba eBi Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, naanyobɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Mligbalamɔi yɛ asafo lɛ mli Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛnaabu afee ekome ni mligbalamɔi akaba nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhiɛa jwɛŋmɔ kome kɛ susumɔ kome.
Ejaakɛ Kloe webii lɛ batswa mi adafi yɛ nyɛhe, minyɛmimɛi, akɛ bei yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ ji akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ, Paulo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Apolo nɔ ji mi;” “Mi lɛ, Kefa nɔ ji mi;” “mi lɛ, Kristo nɔ ji mi.” Ani agbala Kristo mli?
Ani Paulo asɛŋ ahã nyɛ lɛ?
Aloo Paulo gbɛi mli abaptisi nyɛ awo lɛ?
Miida Nyɔŋmɔ shi akɛ mibaptisiii nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akɛ ja Krispo kɛ Gaio, koni mɔ ko akakɛɛ akɛ mibaptisi lɛ yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ migbɛi mli.
Lɛɛlɛŋ, mibaptisi Stefana we lɛ, shi mikaiii akɛ mibaptisi mɔ ko mifata he dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo tsuuu mi baptisimɔ, shi moŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ, ni jeee yɛ nilee wiemɔi amli tete, koni Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ akafee yaka.
Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ enilee Ejaakɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he sane lɛ ji kwashiai asane hã mɛi ni hiɛ kpãtãa lɛ; shi wɔ mɛi ni ahereɔ wɔyiwala lɛ, eji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ hã wɔ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Mafite nilelɔi anilee, Ni ŋaalɔi aŋaa lɛ hu mahã afee yaka.” Nɛgbɛ nilelɔ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ mlatsɔɔlɔ yɔɔ?
Nɛgbɛ je nɛɛŋ naataalɔ yɔɔ?
Ani Nyɔŋmɔ hãko je lɛ mli nilee lɛ atsɔ̃ kwashiai asane?
Shi akɛni yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee naa lɛ je lɛ nyɛɛɛ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enilee nɔ kɛle Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ ekɛ kwashiai asane lɛ ni ashiɛɔ lɛ ahere mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ ayiwala.
Ejaakɛ Yudafoi lɛ, naakpɛɛ okadii ashi amɛbiɔ, ni Helabii hu taoɔ nilee; shi wɔ lɛ, Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ wɔshiɛɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ pampi ehã Yudafoi, kɛ kwashiai asane ehã jɛŋmaji lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ lɛ, Yudafoi jio, Helabii jio, Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee hã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kwashiai asane lɛ, nilee yɛ mli fe gbɔmɛi anilee, ni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔjɔmɔ lɛ he wa fe gbɔmɛi ahewalɛ.
Shi anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkwɛa nyɛtsɛmɔ lɛ, jeee heloo gbɛfaŋ nilelɔi pii, jeee hewalɔi pii, jeee abladei pii atsɛ; shi moŋ je nɛɛ mli kwashiaianii lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nilelɔi lɛ ahiɛgble; ni je nɛɛ mli gbɔjɔmɔnii lɛ hu Nyɔŋmɔ hala, koni ekɛwo nii ni he wa lɛ ahiɛgble; ni je nɛɛ mli nii ni abuuu kɛ nii ni agbe he guɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hala, kɛ nibii ni bɛ lɛ tete, koni ehã nibii ni yɔɔ lɛ afee yaka; bɔ ni afee ni gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko akashwã yɛ ehiɛ.
Shi lɛ ejɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ Kristo Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ nilee ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ hetsuumɔ kɛ kpɔ̃mɔ ehã wɔ lɛ mli; koni, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, eshwã efɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ.”
Paulo eshiɛɛɛ nilee shi Kristo ni asɛŋ lɛ Ni mi hu, anyɛmimɛi, be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, jeee wiemɔ flɛmii loo nilee tuutu mikɛba, ni mibajaje Nyɔŋmɔ sane lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ mitooo miyiŋ akɛ male nɔ ko yɛ nyɛteŋ, akɛ ja Yesu Kristo, mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ.
Ni mikɛ nyɛ hi shi yɛ gbɔjɔmɔ kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ pii mli; ni miwiemɔ kɛ mishiɛmɔ lɛ hu jeee gbɔmɛi anilee wiemɔi ni hãa mɔ yiŋ tsɔ̃ɔ mikɛshiɛ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni jieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hewalɛ kpo, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ akadamɔ gbɔmɛi anilee nɔ, shi moŋ edãmɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ nɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nilee Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔwieɔ nilee wiemɔ yɛ mɛi ni edara yɛ mumɔŋ lɛ ateŋ, shi jeee je nɛɛ mli nilee loo je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi ni jeee fɛifɛi lɛ anilee.
Shi moŋ wɔwieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni akɛtee yɛ teemɔ sane mli lɛ, nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ saa eto hã wɔnunyam dani aje jeŋ shishi, nilee ni je nɛɛ mli nɔyelɔi lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko leee lɛ; ejaakɛ amɛle kulɛ amɛsɛŋ anunyam Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ, “Nii ni hiŋmɛi enako ni toi hu nuko ni ebako gbɔmɔ ko tsuiŋ dã ji nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto mɛi ni sumɔɔ lɛ lɛ.” Shi wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ ejie kpo etsɔ̃ɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ Mumɔ lɛ taoɔ nibii fɛɛ mli, Nyɔŋmɔ nibii ni mli kwɔlɔ tete.
Shi gbɔmɛi ateŋ namɔ le nii ni yɔɔ gbɔmɔ mli, akɛ ja gbɔmɔ lɛ mumɔ ni yɔɔ emli lɛ?
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ hu mɔ ko mɔ ko leee, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee je nɛɛ mli mumɔ lɛ wɔna, shi moŋ Mumɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli lɛ, koni wɔle nii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro wɔ lɛ.
Nomɛi hu wɔwieɔ, jeee wiemɔi ni gbɔmɛi anilee tsɔ̃ɔ wɔwieɔ, shi moŋ wiemɔi ni Mumɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ, ni wɔkɛ mumɔŋnii toɔ mumɔŋnii ahe.
Shi gbɔmɔ su ni akɛfɔ lɛ lɛ heee Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ nii lɛ; ejaakɛ ebuɔ lɛ kwashiai asane, ni enyɛɛɛ naa ena, ejaakɛ mumɔ akɛtaoɔ naa.
Shi mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ kojoɔ nii fiaa, shi lɛ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko ekojooo lɛ.
Ejaakɛ “Namɔ le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jwɛŋmɔ, ni eeetsɔ̃ɔ lɛ nii?” Shi wɔ lɛ wɔhiɛ Kristo jwɛŋmɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ Shi, anyɛmimɛi, minyɛɛɛ mikɛ nyɛ awie tamɔ mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi, shi moŋ tamɔ helooŋ gbɔmɛi, tamɔ abifabii yɛ Kristo mli.
Fufɔ mihã nyɛ, shi jeee ŋmaa ni tsii, ejaakɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye; ni asaŋ amrɔ nɛɛ tete nyɛnyɛɛɛ lolo, ejaakɛ helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ lolo.
Shi gbii abɔ ni awuŋayeli kɛ bei yɔɔ nyɛteŋ lolo lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ ni gbɔmɛi ajeŋba nyɛbaa lɛ?
Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Paulo nɔ ji mi,” ni mɔ ko hu kɛɔ akɛ, “Mi lɛ Apolo nɔ ji mi,” lɛ, ani jeee helooŋ gbɔmɛi ji nyɛ?
Agbɛnɛ, Namɔ ji Apolo?
Namɔ ji Paulo?
Amɛ ji sɔ̃ɔlɔi ni nyɛtsɔ̃ amɛnɔ nyɛhe nyɛye, amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛhã lɛ.
Mi lɛ, mitɛo; Apolo shwie nɔ nu; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hã eda.
Belɛ agbɛnɛ jeee mɔ ni tɛo lɛ ji nɔ ko, ni jeee mɔ ni shwie nɔ nu lɛ hu, shi moŋ mɔ ni hã eda, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni tɛoɔ lɛ kɛ mɔ ni shwieɔ nɔ nu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ ekomeŋ; shi amɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enyɔmɔwoo yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edeŋmegbomɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi nitsulɔi ji wɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ ŋmɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsu ji nyɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni ekɛduro mi lɛ naa lɛ, mito shishi tamɔ tsutswalɔ ko ni hiɛ yɔɔ ŋaa, shi mɔ kroko tswaa nɔ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akwɛ ni ahi bɔ ni etswaa nɔ ehãa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko nyɛŋ shishi kroko ato fe nɔ ni ato momo ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko kɛ shika loo jwiɛtɛi loo tɛi ni jara wa loo tsei loo jwɛi loo gbetselii tswa shishitoo nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ baaje kpo faŋŋ; ejaakɛ Gbi lɛ aaajie lɛ kpo, ejaakɛ la mli eeeje kpo yɛ, ni bɔ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nitsumɔ yɔɔ lɛ, la lɛ baajie lɛ kpo.
Kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ ni ji nɔ ni etswa ema nɔ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, eeena nyɔmɔwoo; shi kɛ mɔ ko nitsumɔ aaashã lɛ, enine baanyɛ shi; shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, aaahere eyiwala, shi kɛ̃lɛ tamɔ mɔ ko ni tsɔ̃ la mli.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ hiɔ nyɛmli?
Kɛ mɔ ko fite Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ, fitemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ aaafite lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, ni no ji nyɛ.
Kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee he Mɔ ko akalaka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe.
Kɛji mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ nilelɔ ji lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli lɛ, efee ehe kwashia, koni etsɔ̃ nilelɔ.
Ejaakɛ je nɛɛ mli nilee lɛ ji kwashiai asane yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Emɔɔ nilelɔi lɛ yɛ amɛŋaa fɔŋ lɛ mli.” Ni asaŋ aŋma akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le nilelɔi ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ akɛ yakanii ni.” No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko akashwã kɛmiifɔ̃ gbɔmɛi anɔ.
Shi nii fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnɔ ni: Paulo jio, Apolo jio, Kefa jio, je lɛ jio, wala jio, gbele jio, nii ni yɔɔ nɛɛ jio, nii ni baaba lɛ jio; fɛɛ lɛ nyɛnɔ ni, Shi nyɛ lɛ Kristo nii ji nyɛ; shi Kristo lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔŋ.
Kristo bɔfoi lɛ Bɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɛi abu wɔ nɛ, akɛ Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ saji lɛ anɔ tsuji nukpai.
Shi nɔ ni eshwɛ ni ataoɔ yɛ tsuji nukpai adɛŋ ji akɛ ana amɛ akɛ anɔkwafoi.
Shi mi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko titri ko hã mi akɛ nyɛkojoɔ mi aloo akɛ akɛ gbɔmɛi akojomɔ aaakojo mi; mi diɛŋtsɛ tete mikojooo mihe.
Ejaakɛ mileee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee no hewɔ aaabu mi bem; shi mɔ ni kojoɔ mi ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkakojoa nɔ ko dani shɛ be lɛ, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaba, mɔ ni kɛ dujiaŋ nibii ni akɛtee lɛ tete aaaba la hiɛ, ni eeejie tsuiiaŋ ajinai lɛ ashi lɛ.
Ni no mli lɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaana eyijiemɔ kɛaajɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhewɔ mikɛ nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ toɔ mi kɛ Apolo he lɛ, koni nyɛkwɛ wɔ ni nyɛkase nɔ ni kɛɔ akɛ “mɔ ko akajwɛŋ fe nɔ ni aŋma lɛ” koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ henɔwomɔ akabu mɔ ko fe mɔ kroko.
Shi namɔ buɔ bo akɛ esoro bo?
Ni asaŋ, mɛni oyɔɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo?
Shi kɛji hã ahã bo lɛ, mɛɛba oshwãa tamɔ nɔ ni jeee hã ahã bo lɛ?
Nyɛtɔrɔ momo!
Nyɛna nii momo!
Nyɛshi wɔsɛɛ ni nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ!
Ni mina ni kulɛ nyɛmiiye maŋtsɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, koni wɔ hu wɔkɛ nyɛ aye!
Bɔ ni wɔsane tamɔ yɛ mɛi ahiɛ Ejaakɛ efeɔ mi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ eŋɔ wɔ ni ji bɔfoi lɛ moŋ efee sɛɛkpelɔi, tamɔ mɛi ni ajɔɔ amɛnɔ ahã gbele; ejaakɛ akɛ wɔ efee kwɛmɔnii ahã je lɛ kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi kɛ gbɔmɛi.
Wɔ lɛ, kwashiai ji wɔ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ, nilelɔi ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli; wɔ lɛ, gbɔjɔlɔi ji wɔ, shi nyɛ lɛ hewalɔi ji nyɛ; nyɛ nyɛhiɛ yɔɔ nyam, shi wɔ lɛ, wɔhiɛ bɛ nyam.
Kɛbashi be nɛ fɛɛ lɛ, hɔmɔ kɛ kumai yeɔ wɔ, ni wɔnyiɛɔ yayai, ni agbalagbalaa wɔ mãi, ni wɔbɛ hilɛhe krɛdɛɛ ko.
Ni wɔgboɔ deŋme wɔkɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔniji tsuɔ nii; be ni ajɛɔ wɔ lɛ, wɔmiijɔɔ; be ni awaa wɔ yi lɛ, wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ; be ni afiteɔ wɔgbɛi lɛ, wɔɔwie naajɔlɛ wiemɔ; afee wɔ tamɔ je lɛ tumonɔnii, mɛi fɛɛ ajwɛi kɛbashi be nɛ.
Paulo wie tsɔ̃ɔ Korintobii lɛ akɛ tsɛ Miŋmaaa enɛɛmɛi ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele, shi moŋ miiwie miitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ tamɔ mibii ni misumɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛyɛ kwɛlɔi akpei nyɔŋma tete yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, jeee tsɛmɛi pii nyɛyɔɔ; ejaakɛ mi mitsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ mifɔ nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkase mi.
No hewɔ hu ni mitsu Timoteo, ni ji misuɔmɔ bi kɛ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ni ebakai nyɛ bɔ ni mibaa mijeŋ mihãa yɛ Kristo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ asafo fɛɛ asafo mli yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Shi akɛni mɛi komɛi susuɔ akɛ mibaŋ nyɛŋɔɔ hewɔ lɛ, amɛwo amɛhe nɔ.
Shi kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miisumɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni maba ni mabana mɛi ni woɔ amɛhe nɔ lɛ ahewalɛ, shi jeee amɛwiemɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee wiemɔ mli Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ yɔɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ mli.
Te nyɛtaoɔ lɛ tɛŋŋ?
Mihiɛ kpãa kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, aloo miba yɛ suɔmɔ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ mli?
Ajwamãŋbɔɔ yɛ asafo lɛ mli Aakɛɛ kwraa po akɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, ajwamãŋbɔɔ ni bɛ jemajiaŋbii ateŋ tete akɛ mɔ ko kɛ etsɛ ŋa wɔɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛhe nyɛwoɔ, ni nyɛyeee ŋkɔmɔ moŋ, bɔ ni afee ni ajie mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ?
Mi ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, shi mumɔ mli miyɔɔ yɛ lɛ, mikojo mɔ ni tsu nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ momo, tamɔ nɔ ni miyɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɔŋŋ.
Kɛji nyɛnaa kpe shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu gbɛi mli ni miyɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ mumɔ mli, ní Nuŋtsɔ Yesu hewalɛ fata he lɛ, wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ awo Satan dɛŋ, koni epiŋ egbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ahere mumɔ lɛ yiwala yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Nyɛshwãa lɛ bɛ fɛo.
Nyɛleee akɛ masha bibioo shaa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea masha momo lɛ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ ma hee, tamɔ bɔ ni akpiti ji nyɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ agbe wɔHehoo Toobi ni ji Kristo lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔyea Hehoo Gbijurɔ lɛ, jeee kɛ masha momo, ni asaŋ jeee kɛ efɔŋ loo nɔshafeemɔ masha, shi moŋ kɛ anɔkwale akpiti ŋmiiŋmi.
Miŋma nyɛ yɛ wolo lɛ mli akɛ nyɛkɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi akabɔ; jeee jeŋbii ateŋ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo amimyelɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi ahe kwraa miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ ja nyɛje je lɛ mli.
Shi agbɛnɛ miŋma nyɛ akɛ kɛji mɔ ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ ji ajwamãŋbɔlɔ loo hiɛjoolɔ loo wɔŋjalɔ loo mɔjɛlɔ loo dãatɔlɔ loo amimyelɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, nyɛkɛ lɛ akayea nii tete.
Shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, mɛɛ amɛkojomɔ hu mina?
Ani jeee mɛi ni yɔɔ asafo lɛ mli lɛ nyɛkojoɔ, shi mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni kojoɔ amɛ?
Nyɛjiea mɔ fɔŋ lɛ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Heyelɔi kɛ amɛsaji akahã mɛi ni heee yeee Te kɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko kɛ enaanyo na sane ko lɛ, eshiɔ etsitsi ekɛ lɛ yayeɔ sane lɛ yɛ jeŋbii akojomɔhe, shi ekɛ lɛ eyaaa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ aŋɔɔ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ baakojo je lɛ?
Ani nyɛleee akɛ wɔbaakojo ŋwɛi bɔfoi tete, ni mbasroo walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji?
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji nyɛyɛ walashihilɛ nɛɛ mli saji komɛi ayeli lɛ, mɛɛba nyɛhãa mɛi ni asafo lɛ ebuuu amɛ lɛ kojoɔ mɔ?
Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele.
Aso nilelɔ kome flo bɛ nyɛteŋ, mɔ ni aaanyɛ enyɛmimɛi ateŋ ekojo?
Shi moŋ mɔ kɛ enyɛmi yayeɔ sane yɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ aŋɔɔ po?
Enɛ lɛ aye nyɛnɔ kunim momo, akɛni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe yeyeɔ saji lɛ.
Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi afee nyɛ nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ moŋ?
Mɛɛba nyɛhãaa mɛi aye nyɛ amim moŋ?
Shi nyɛ moŋ nyɛfeɔ nyɛmimɛi tete nɔ ni ejaaa gbɛ, ni nyɛyeɔ amɛ amim.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ efɔŋfeelɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ?
Nyɛkahãa alakaa nyɛ!
Ajwamãŋbɔlɔi loo wɔŋjalɔi loo gbãlãŋkulɔi loo hii ni tsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛhe yei hãa hii krokomɛi loo hii ni kɛ hii feɔ yakayakanii, loo julɔi loo hiɛjoolɔi loo dãatɔlɔi loo mɛi ajɛlɔi loo ojotswalɔi anine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
Ni nɛkɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi yɔɔ sa; shi agbɛnɛ aju nyɛhe, ni asaŋ atsuu nyɛhe, ni abu nyɛ bem hu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam Miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; miyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ moŋ, shi mihãŋ nɔ ko aye minɔ.
Ŋmaa yɛ hã musu, ni musu hu yɛ hã ŋmaa; shi Nyɔŋmɔ baahã enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ afo.
Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ, jeee ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ eyɔɔ, shi moŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hewɔ eyɔɔ; ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hu yɛ hã gbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ; ni ebaatee wɔ hu shi yɛ ehewalɛ naa.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ Kristo henii ni?
Belɛ miŋɔ Kristo henii lɛ mifee ajwamãŋ henii lo?
Dabida!
Aloo nyɛleee akɛ mɔ ni kɛ ehe yabɔɔ ajwamãŋ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ gbɔmɔtso kome?
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃ heloo kome.” Shi mɔ ni kɛ ehe bɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he lɛ, ekɛ lɛ feɔ mumɔ kome.
Nyɛjoa ajwamãŋbɔɔ naa foi!
Esha fɛɛ esha ni gbɔmɔ feɔ lɛ, jeee egbɔmɔtso lɛ mli eyɔɔ; shi mɔ ni bɔɔ ajwamãŋ lɛ, efeɔ esha eshiɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso lɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni yɔɔ nyɛmli ni nyɛna kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ni, ni nyɛjeee nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛnɔ lo?
Ejaakɛ ahe nyɛ kɛ jara ni wa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtsei lɛ awoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Nɔ ni Paulo susuɔ yɛ gbãlãshihilɛ he Agbɛnɛ, yɛ nii ni nyɛŋma nyɛbahã mi lɛ ahe lɛ, ehi hã nuu akɛ ekata yoo he; shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ hewɔ lɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo ahi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewu.
Wu lɛ atsu eŋa lɛ gbɛnaanii ehã lɛ, ni ŋa lɛ hu afee nakai nɔŋŋ ehã ewu.
Ŋa lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi moŋ ewu lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ; nakai nɔŋŋ wu lɛ bɛ hewalɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɔmɔtso nɔ, shi eŋa lɛ yɔɔ hewalɛ.
Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akakãmaa nyɛhe, akɛ ja nyɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛkpãa gbee akɛ nyɛaafee nakai kɛyashi be ko koni nyɛna dekã nyɛsɔle; ni nyɛfee ekome ekoŋŋ, koni Satan akatsɔ̃ nyɛnaa yɛ nyɛhe nɔ ni nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛye hewɔ.
Enɛ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, jeee kitã miwoɔ nyɛ, shi miiwie kɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ gbɛŋmɛɛ yɛ he.
Ka mihewɔŋ kulɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ahi shi tamɔ bɔ ni miyɔɔ nɛɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ keenɔ kɛjɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ, mɔ ko nɔ nɛkɛ, ni mɔ ko hu nɔ ekroko.
Shi oshijafoi kɛ okulafoi lɛ, miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, ehi hã amɛ kɛji amɛhi shi tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu miyɔɔ nɛɛ lɛ.
Shi kɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛhe nɔ amɛye lɛ, amɛbote gbãlãshihilɛ mli; ejaakɛ gbãlãshihilɛ hi fe nɔ ni akɔnɔ aaahao bo.
Shi mɛi ni ebote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, mi, ni jeee mi tete, shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ moŋ woɔ amɛ kitã akɛ; ŋa akatse ewu gbãlã; ni kɛji etse gbãlã lɛ tete lɛ, ehi shi akɛ mɔ ni bɛ wu, aloo ekɛ ewu lɛ ayakpãtã; ni wu hu akaŋmɛɛ eŋa he.
Shi mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, jeee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, shi mi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛmi ko yɛ ŋa ni jeee heyelɔ, ni yoo lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekaŋmɛɛ ehe.
Ni kɛ yoo ko hu yɛ wu ni jeee heyelɔ, ni nuu lɛ kpɛlɛ̃ akɛ ekɛ lɛ aaahi shi lɛ, ekatse lɛ gbãlã.
Ejaakɛ atsuɔ nuu ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ he yɛ eŋa lɛ mli, ni atsuɔ yoo ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ hu he yɛ ewu lɛ mli; ejaakɛ jeee nakai jikulɛ, nyɛbii lɛ hu ahe yɛ muji; shi amrɔ nɛɛ amɛhe tse.
Shi kɛ mɔ ni jeee heyelɔ lɛ miigbala ehe shi lɛ, egbala ehe shi; anyɛɛɛ nyɛmi nuu loo nyɛmi yoo nɔ tamɔ nyɔŋ yɛ nɛkɛ saji nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ hejɔlɛ mli Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ wɔ kɛba.
Shi, bo yoo, bo obaahere owu lɛ yiwala jio, ole?
Aloo bo nuu, bo hu obaahere oŋa lɛ yiwala jio, ole?
Bɔ ni atsɛ mɔ ko lɛ nakai ehi shi Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ eja nikeenii ehã lɛ, kɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ehi shi nakai.
Ni nakai mito hu yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Kɛ afo mɔ ko ketia ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, ekatsɔ̃ ehe foolɔ; foo mli atsɛ mɔ ko yɛ hu, ekafo ketia.
Ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔyeli moŋ ji nɔ ko.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ shihilɛ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi.
Ani nyɔŋ ji bo be ni atsɛ bo lɛ?
Kaahã miidɔ bo; shi kɛ ooonyɛ ohe okpɔ̃ lɛ, bɔɔ he mɔdɛŋ.
Shi mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni eji nyɔŋ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ odehe ni; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ mɔ ni atsɛ lɛ ni eji odehe lɛ, Kristo nyɔŋ ni.
Jara ni wa akɛhe nyɛ; nyɛkatsɔmɔa gbɔmɛi anyɔji.
Anyɛmimɛi, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nɔ mli ni eyɔɔ ni atsɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ ehi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ.
Oblayei kɛ oblahii kɛ okulafoi Shi oblayei foroi lɛ, mibɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ko yɛ amɛhe, shi nɔ ni misusuɔ mikɛɔ nɛɛ, tamɔ mɔ ko ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ena lɛ mɔbɔ koni eye anɔkwa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni misusuɔ akɛ ehi ji, hejaramɔ ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehi hã gbɔmɔ akɛ ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ.
Mla efi bo ekpɛtɛ yoo he?
Kaatao fɛnemɔ.
Afɛne bo yɛ yoo he?
Kaatao ŋa.
Shi kɛji oŋɔ yoo hu, ofeko esha; ni kɛji oblayoo foro hu bote gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efeko esha; shi gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ amanehulu mɛnɛɛmɛi baana; shi mi lɛ, nyɛhe mifoɔ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, be lɛ faaa dɔŋŋ; nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋamɛi tete afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ eko; ni mɛi ni foɔ lɛ hu afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni fooo; ni mɛi ni nyaa afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni nyaaa; ni mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni jeee nɔtsɛmɛi; ni mɛi ni tsuɔ je nɛɛ he nii lɛ afee amɛhe tamɔ mɛi ni tsuuu he nii; ejaakɛ je lɛ bɔ ni wɔnaa lɛ nɛɛ hoɔ eyaa.
Shi misumɔɔɔ akɛ nyɛfee yeyeeye.
Mɔ ni bɛ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esa eŋa lɛ hiɛ, ni efeɔ jwɛŋmɔ enyɔnyɔɔnyɔtsɛ.
Yoo ni bɛ wu loo oblayoo foro lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ, koni efee krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kɛ mumɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; shi mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ, ekɛ ehe fɛɛ hãa yɛ je nɛɛ mli nii ahewɔ, bɔ ni eeefee ni esane asa ewu hiɛ.
Shi enɛ lɛ, nyɛ ekpakpa hewɔ mikɛɔ, jeee nyɛkuɛ kpãa miwoɔ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni afee fɛo, koni nyɛsɔ̃mɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko wooo nyɛ najiaŋ.
Shi kɛji nuu ko susuɔ akɛ ebaaa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ yɛ eblayoo foro gbɛfaŋ, ni enyɛɛɛ ehe nɔ eye dɔŋŋ, ni asaŋ enyɛɛɛ he nɔ ko efee lɛ, efee bɔ ni esumɔɔ, efeee esha; amɛkpee amɛhe.
Shi mɔ ni ekpɛ mli yɛ etsui mli, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko efiii lɛ, shi enyɛɔ efeɔ nɔ ni lɛ esumɔɔ ni ekpɛ mli nɛkɛ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsui mli akɛ eeeya nɔ ehiɛ lɛ akɛ eblayoo foro lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ eblayoo foro lɛ boteɔ gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ moŋ, shi mɔ ni boteee gbãlãshihilɛ mli lɛ, efee jogbaŋŋ fe no.
Yoo lɛ, gbii abɔ ni ewu hiɛ kã nɛɛ, akɛ mla efi lɛ; shi kɛji ewu lɛ gbo lɛ, eyɛ hegbɛ akɛ egbã mɔ ni esumɔɔ; shi belɛ afee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Shi kɛji ehi shi bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, eyɛ hejɔlɛ aahu.
Mijwɛŋmɔ nɛ, ni efeɔ mi akɛ mi hu miyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ.
Niyenii ni akɛhã wɔji Agbɛnɛ yɛ wɔji afɔle gbɛfaŋ lɛ, wɔle akɛ “wɔ fɛɛ wɔyɛ nilee.” Nilee hãa mɔ woɔ ehe nɔ, shi suɔmɔ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi.
Kɛ mɔ ko susuɔ akɛ ele nɔ ko lɛ, eleko bɔ ni sa akɛ ele lolo.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko miisumɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ le lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nɔ ni kɔɔ wɔji afɔle nii ayeli he lɛ, wɔle akɛ wɔŋ ko wɔŋ ko jeee fɛifɛi yɛ je nɛɛ mli, ni asaŋ nyɔŋmɔ ko nyɔŋmɔ ko bɛ, akɛ ja Mɔ kome kɛkɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji nibii komɛi yɛ ni atsɛɔ amɛ nyɔŋmɔi lɛ; ŋwɛi amɛyɔɔ jio, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛyɔɔ jio, tamɔ bɔ ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nyɔŋmɔi ahe ni asɛ̃ɛɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi ahe lɛ, wɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ kome pɛ wɔyɔɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ mli ni nibii fɛɛ jɛ ni wɔyɔɔ wɔhã lɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ kome hu ni ji Yesu Kristo lɛ, mɔ nɔ ni nibii fɛɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba ni wɔ hu wɔtsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ le nii nɛɛ; shi mɛi komɛi yɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ ni wɔŋjamɔ efee amɛhenɔ, no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ amɛmiiye wɔji afɔle nii lɛ, amɛyeɔ lɛ akɛ wɔji afɔlenii, ni enɛ buleɔ amɛ ejaakɛ egbede amɛhenilee.
Shi jeee ŋmaa hãa wɔsaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; kɛ wɔyeee lɛ ehãaa wɔtɛ nɔ atse, ni asaŋ kɛ wɔye hu ehãaa wɔhi fe nine.
Shi nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni nyɛhegbɛ nɛɛ akabatsɔ̃ pampi miihã gbedelɔi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji mɔ ko na bo ni “ole nii” lɛ akɛ ota wɔŋtsu mli ooye nii lɛ, ani enɛ woŋ mɔ ni egbede lɛ henilee hewalɛ koni eyaye wɔji afɔlenii lɛ?
Ni no lɛ “onilee” lɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛmi gbedelɔ ni Kristo bagbo yɛ lɛ hu ehewɔ lɛ hiɛ baakpãtã.
Shi kɛji nyɛfee nyɛmimɛi lɛ esha nɛkɛ ni nyɛkɛpila amɛhenilee ni waaa lɛ, no lɛ Kristo nyɛfeɔ esha nyɛshiɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛji ŋmaa aaahã minyɛmi nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ lɛ, miyeŋ loo gbi ko gbi ko dɔŋŋ, koni mikahã minyɛmi lɛ nane miitɔ̃tɔ̃.
Paulo fa ebɔfo ni eji lɛ he Ani mihiɛɛɛ mihe?
Ani jeee bɔfo ji mi?
Ani minako Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ?
Jeee minine naa nitsumɔ ji nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lo?
Kɛji mijeee bɔfo mihãaa mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, nyɛ lɛ mi ji bɔfo mihã nyɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛ ji mibɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ naasɔomɔnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Enɛ ji nɔ ni mikɛfãa mihe yɛ mɛi ni kojoɔ mi lɛ ahiɛ.
Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔyeɔ nii ni wɔnuɔ?
Ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ nyɛmi yoo Kristofonyo ni ji wɔŋa lɛ kɛnyiɛɔ, tamɔ bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ hu kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ Kefa?
Aloo mi kɛ Barnaba kɛkɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔhiɔ shi ni wɔtsuuu nii?
Namɔ yaa ta ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewoɔ ehe nyɔmɔ?
Namɔ feɔ waintrom ni eyeee emli yibii lɛ eko?
Aloo namɔ lɛɔ kooloi ni enuuu amɛfufɔ lɛ eko?
Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, ani gbɔmɛi kɛkɛ wieɔ nakai?
Ani Mla lɛ hu ekɛɛɛ nakai nɔŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ aŋma yɛ Mose Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele lɛ naabu kotoku.” Ani tsinai ahe ni dɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo wɔhewɔ kwraa moŋ ewieɔ nɛɛ?
Wɔhewɔ nɔŋŋ aŋma, ejaakɛ esa akɛ mɔ ni huɔ lɛ, ekɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ahu, ni mɔ ni kpalaa abele hu hiɛ akã nɔ akɛ ebaaye eko.
Kɛ wɔdu mumɔŋnii wɔhã nyɛ lɛ, ani eji nɔ ko wulu akɛ wɔɔkpa nyɛheloŋnii lo?
Kɛ maji krokomɛi yɛ nɛkɛ hegbɛ yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, ani wɔbɛ hegbɛ fe amɛ?
Shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔfeee nɛkɛ hegbɛ nɛɛ he nɔ ko, shi moŋ wɔmiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, koni wɔkatsi Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛ.
Ani nyɛleee akɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ Sɔlemɔ we lɛ, Sɔlemɔ wenii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛyeɔ?
Ni mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ he lɛ, afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ eko nɔŋŋ amɛnaa?
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ to akɛ mɛi ni jajeɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ aye Sanekpakpa lɛ mli nii.
Shi mi lɛ, mifeko nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ ekome flo he nɔ ko.
Ni miŋmaaa enɛ koni afee nakai ahã mi; ejaakɛ kɛ ka nɔ ni mɔ ko aaahã mishwãa lɛ afee yaka lɛ, faŋ nɔ ni migbo moŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ po jiŋŋ, ejeee shwãanɔ hã mi; ejaakɛ akɛfi minɔ akɛ mijaje; kɛ mijajeee Sanekpakpa lɛ, kpoo hã mi!
Ejaakɛ kɛ mitsu yɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, miyɛ nyɔmɔwoo; shi kɛjeee suɔmɔ naa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ atu tsulɔnukpayeli awo midɛŋ.
Agbɛnɛ mɛni ji minyɔmɔwoo mɔ?
No ji akɛ, kɛ miijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ, majaje lɛ yaka ni miheee nɔ ko, bɔ ni afee ni mikafee nɔ ko tuutu yɛ mihegbɛ ni miyɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ he.
Bɔ ni Paulo fee etao mɛi ehã Kristo Mihiɛ mihe ni mijeee mɔ ko mɔ ko nyɔŋ, kɛ̃lɛ mifee mihe mɛi fɛɛ anyɔŋ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi babaoo anɔ.
Yudafoi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ Yudanyo mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ Yudafoi anɔ; mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ Mla shishi mihã amɛ, tsɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mibɛ Mla shishi, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ anɔ.
Mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ, mitsɔ̃ tamɔ mɔ ko ni bɛ Mla mihã amɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ mɛi ni bɛ Mla lɛ anɔ, tsɛ mijeee mɔ ko ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mla, shi moŋ miyɛ Kristo mla shishi.
Mitsɔ̃ tamɔ gbedelɔ mihã gbedelɔi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni minine ashɛ gbedelɔi lɛ anɔ; mitsɔ̃ mihe nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mihã mɛi fɛɛ, koni bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ mikɛhere mɛi komɛi ayiwala.
Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ mifeɔ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mi hu mana emli jɔɔmɔi lɛ eko.
Kristofoi akaŋshii Ani nyɛleee akɛ foidamɔ mli lɛ, foidalɔi lɛ fɛɛ daa moŋ, shi mɔ kome kɛkɛ naa emli juromɔ nɔ lɛ?
Nyɛdaa foi lɛ nakai, koni nyɛnine ashɛ nɔ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni shiɔ akaŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ehe nɔ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli.
Agbɛnɛ amɛ lɛ amɛfeɔ nakai, koni amɛna akekre ni fiteɔ, shi wɔ lɛ, koni wɔna nɔ ni fiteee.
No hewɔ lɛ, foi ni midaa nɛɛ, midaaa lɛ kɛkɛ ni oti emaaa mihiɛ; nɔmɔ ni minɔɔ nɛɛ, jeee kɔɔyɔɔ mikɛnɔɔ; shi moŋ mitswiaa migbɔmɔtso lɛ nii, ni miyeɔ lɛ nyɔŋ, koni mi ni mishiɛɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ akashɛ mi afɔ̃.
Wɔji ahe kɔkɔbɔɔ Shi, anyɛmimɛi, misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛhiɛ aje nɔ akɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ fɛɛ hi atatu lɛ shishi, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ, ni abaptisi amɛ fɛɛ awo Mose mli yɛ atatu lɛ kɛ Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ mli.
Ni amɛ fɛɛ lɛ mumɔŋ niyenii kome lɛ nɔŋŋ amɛye, ni amɛ fɛɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ nu kome lɛ nɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ amɛnu mumɔŋ tɛsaa ni kɛ amɛ nyiɛ lɛ mli nu, ni tɛsaa lɛ ji Kristo.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naaa amɛteŋ mɛi pii ahe tsui, ejaakɛ aplene amɛ yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ.
Shi akɛ enɛɛmɛi eto wɔ okadi, koni wɔkahã nibii fɔ̃ji miifee wɔ akɔnɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni efee amɛ lɛ.
Asaŋ nyɛkatsɔmɔa amãgãjalɔi tamɔ amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi fee lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Maŋ lɛ ho tara shi ni amɛye nii ni amɛnu nii, ni amɛte shi ni amɛshwɛ.” Ni wɔsaa wɔkabɔ ajwamãŋ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi bɔ ajwamãŋ ni gbi kome nɔ lɛ mɛi akpei nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ etɛ̃ nyɔnyɔɔ lɛ.
Ni asaŋ wɔkaka Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ka lɛ ni onufui bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛkawiea huhuuhu tamɔ bɔ ni amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi hu wie huhuuhu ni hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ bakpãtã amɛhiɛ lɛ.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ba amɛnɔ ni akɛto okadi ahã wɔ, ni aŋma ni akɛbɔ wɔ kɔkɔ, wɔ mɛi ni je lɛ naagbee bei lɛ enina wɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni susuɔ akɛ edamɔ shi lɛ akwɛ ehe ni ahi koni ekagbee shi.
Kaa ko bako nyɛnɔ ni jeee gbɔmɔ he nɔ; shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ehãŋ aka nyɛ fe bɔ ni nyɛaanyɛ; moŋ, yɛ kaa lɛ mli lɛ, ebaaje gbɛ ni nyɛkɛaaje mli koni nyɛnyɛ mli nyɛmɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, misuɔmɔ mɛi, nyɛjoa wɔŋjamɔ naa foi!
Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ akɛ nilelɔi wieɔ; nɔ ni mikɛɔ lɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli.
Jɔɔmɔ kpulu lɛ ni wɔjɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo lá lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni?
Aboloo ni wɔkumɔɔ lɛ, ani jeee Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ naanyobɔɔ lɛ ni?
Ejaakɛ aboloo kome ni, ni wɔyi pii moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ fɛɛ wɔyeɔ aboloo kome lɛ eko.
Nyɛkwɛa Israel!
Ani mɛi ni yeɔ afɔleshãanii lɛ, jeee naanyo amɛkɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ bɔɔ lɛ?
Belɛ mɛni mikɛɛ mɔ?
Akɛ amãgã afɔle ji nɔ ko, aloo akɛ amãgã ji nɔ ko?
Dabi, shi moŋ miikɛɛ akɛ afɔle ni wɔŋjalɔi lɛ shãa lɛ, mumɔi fɔ̃ji amɛshãa amɛhãa, shi jeee Nyɔŋmɔ; ni misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji bɔɔ naanyo.
Nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji akpulu fɛɛ nyɛnu shi kome; nyɛnyɛŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ okplɔ̃ lɛ nɔ nii kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji anɔ lɛ nɔ nii fɛɛ nyɛye shi kome.
Aloo wɔmiifee ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aye awuŋã?
Ani wɔhe wa fe lɛ?
Wɔŋ loo he ŋaawoo Wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hi; wɔyɛ nibii fɛɛ hegbɛ, shi jeee nibii fɛɛ hãa mɔ nane mɔɔ shi.
Mɔ ko mɔ ko akapele miihã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, shi moŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ apele ahã enaanyo.
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni ahɔ̃ɔ yɛ loo jara nɔ lɛ nyɛyea; shi henilee hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkabia mli; ejaakɛ “shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ emlinii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ ni.” Shi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɔ ko kpee nyɛ okplɔ̃ he ni nyɛmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛaatee lɛ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni akɛaama nyɛhiɛ lɛ, nyɛyea ni nyɛkabia mli, yɛ henilee hewɔ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko kɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, “Enɛ lɛ akɛshã afɔle ahã amãgã” lɛ, nyɛkayea yɛ mɔ ni tswa adafi lɛ kɛ henilee hewɔ.
Shi henilee ni mitsɔ̃ɔ nɛɛ, jeee bo diɛŋtsɛ onɔ lɛ, shi moŋ mɔ kroko lɛ nɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ mɛɛ hewɔ sa akɛ mɔ kroko henilee akojo mihe ni mihiɛ lɛ?
Kɛ shidaa mikɛye lɛ, mɛɛba awieɔ mihe efɔŋ yɛ nii ni mida shi yɛ he lɛ hewɔ?
No hewɔ lɛ, nii nyɛyeɔ jio, nii nyɛnuɔ jio, aloo nɔ kroko nyɛfeɔ jio, nyɛfea fɛɛ nyɛkɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɛkatsɔmɔa pampii nyɛhãa Yudafoi kɛ Helabii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ fɛɛ; tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni mi hu misumɔɔ akɛ nibii fɛɛ mli lɛ masa mɛi fɛɛ hiɛ, ni mitaooo nɔ ni hi hã mi diɛŋtsɛ, shi moŋ nɔ ni hi hã mɛi pii koni ahere amɛyiwala lɛ.
Yiteŋhaa he ŋaawoo Nyɛkasea mi, tamɔ bɔ ni mi hu mikaseɔ Kristo lɛ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miijie nyɛyi akɛ nyɛkaiɔ mi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, ni nyɛhiɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mli bɔ pɛ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ.
Shi miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ nuu fɛɛ nuu yitso ji Kristo, ni yoo fɛɛ yoo hu yitso ji nuu, ni Kristo yitso ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Nuu fɛɛ nuu ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ekɛ nɔ ko eha eyiteŋ lɛ, eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ.
Shi yoo fɛɛ yoo ni sɔleɔ loo egbaa ni ehiɛ eyitso folo lɛ, lɛ hu eegbe eyitso lɛ he guɔ; ejaakɛ etamɔ nɔ ni eshɛ eyi nɔŋŋ pɛ.
Kɛ yoo lɛ ehaaa eyi nɔ lɛ, eku eyi mɔ; shi akɛni eji hiɛgbele sane hã yoo akɛ eeeku eyi loo eeeshɛ eyi lɛ, eha eyi nɔ.
Shi nuu lɛ, esaaa akɛ ehaa eyiteŋ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ kɛ anunyam ji lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nuu jɛɛɛ yoo mli, shi yoo moŋ jɛ nuu mli.
Ni asaŋ abɔɔɔ nuu yɛ yoo hewɔ; shi yoo moŋ abɔ yɛ nuu hewɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ahewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ ana hewalɛ he okadi ko yɛ yoo lɛ yiteŋ.
Kɛ̃lɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, nuu nyɛŋ ashi yoo sɛɛ, ni yoo hu nyɛŋ ashi nuu sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni yoo jɛ nuu mli lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nuu hu tsɔ̃ yoo nɔ kɛba; shi nii fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhalaa mli yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Ani eyɛ fɛo akɛ yoo aaasɔle yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ni ehaaa eyi nɔ lo?
Ani adebɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nuu ŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgbele hã lɛ, shi yoo lɛ, kɛji eŋmɛ eyi kusuu lɛ, eji anunyam hã lɛ?
Ejaakɛ akɛ yitsɔi lɛ hã lɛ akɛ hehaanɔ.
Shi kɛji mɔ ko miisumɔ akɛ efee ehe naataalɔ yɛ enɛ he lɛ, wɔ lɛ jeee wɔkusum ji no, ni Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ Shi agbɛnɛ nibii ni mibatsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛfee nɛɛ, jeee nyɛyi mikɛjieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ nyɛkpe lɛ, jeee ekpakpa jɛɔ mli, shi moŋ efɔŋ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, minu akɛ, kɛ nyɛyabua nyɛhe naa yɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, mligbalamɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ, ni miheɔ miyeɔ fã kɛ fã.
Ejaakɛ sa akɛ mligbalamɔi aba nyɛteŋ koni mɛi kpakpai lɛ ajie amɛhe shi faŋŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Agbɛnɛ, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi yɛ he kome lɛ, jeee Nuŋtsɔ Niyenii lɛ yeli nyɛba lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛniyeli nɛɛ mli lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tsɔ̃ɔ hiɛ yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniyenii, ni be ni hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, belɛ mɔ ko etɔ dãa.
Aso nyɛbɛ shĩai ni nyɛaaye nii ni nyɛaanu yɛ jɛi?
Aloo Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ nyɛbuuu, ni nyɛwoɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko lɛ ahiɛgble?
Te makɛɛ nyɛ tɛŋŋ?
Ani mijie nyɛyi?
Enɛ lɛ, mijieee nyɛyi yɛ he.
Ejaakɛ nɔ ni mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ mina kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ, akɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu lɛ, nakai nyɔɔŋ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ni atsɔ̃ɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ, ekɔ aboloo, ni eda shi, ni ekumɔ mli, ni ekɛɛ, “Nyɛhea nyɛyea, enɛ ji migbɔmɔtso ni akɛhã yɛ nyɛhewɔ; nyɛfea enɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” Nakai nɔŋŋ ewo kpulu lɛ hu yɛ niyenii lɛ asɛɛ, ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ ji kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ yɛ milá lɛ mli; nyɛfea enɛ, shii abɔ ni nyɛaanu lɛ ni nyɛkɛkaia mi.” Ejaakɛ shii abɔ ni nyɛyeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni nyɛnuɔ nɛkɛ kpulu nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛmiijaje Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbele lɛ nyɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni eeeba.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ aboloo nɛɛ ni enuɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpulu lɛ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, eetɔ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ elá lɛ nɔ.
Shi gbɔmɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ekwɛ dani eye aboloo nɛɛ eko ni enu kpulu nɛɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni yeɔ ni enuɔ bɔ ni esaaa lɛ, kojomɔ moŋ eyeɔ ni enuɔ ehãa ehe lɛ, ejaakɛ ebuuu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ.
No hewɔ hu ni nyɛteŋ mɛi pii egbɔjɔ ni amɛhe yeɔ, ni mɛi babaoo hu egboi nɛɛ.
Shi kɛji wɔka wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔkwɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ekojoŋ wɔ.
Shi kɛji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ miikojo wɔ lɛ, ekɛmiitsɔse wɔ, bɔ ni afee ni akabu wɔ kɛ je lɛ fɛɛ fɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛbaaye nii lɛ, nyɛmɛmɛa nyɛhe.
Shi kɛ hɔ̃mɔ miiye mɔ ko lɛ, eye nii yɛ shĩa dã, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛkpee lɛ akatsɛ kojomɔ miihã nyɛ.
Shi nii ni eshwɛ lɛ, kɛ miba lɛ, mato amɛ gbɛjianɔ.
Mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ mahã nyɛle mumɔŋnii ahe nɔ ko.
Nyɛle akɛ be ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, amãgãi mumuii lɛ aŋɔɔ akpala nyɛ kɛtee, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni akpala nyɛ ahã lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miihã nyɛle akɛ mɔ ko ewieee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ naa ni ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji musumɔ”; ni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Yesu ji Nuŋtsɔ” hu, akɛ ja yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naa.
Dromɔ keenii srɔtoi yɛ, shi Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hãa; ni sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nuŋtsɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ akɛsɔ̃mɔɔ; ni nitsumɔi srɔtoi hu yɛ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ amli.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ahãa Mumɔ lɛ jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ emli koni ahi ahã mɛi fɛɛ.
Mɔ ko lɛ, atsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ ahã lɛ nilee wiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu ahã lɛ niiashishinamɔ wiemɔ yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa.
Mɔ ko lɛ, ahã lɛ hemɔkɛyeli yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ naa; ni mɔ kroko hu ahã lɛ tsamɔ dromɔ keenii yɛ nakai Mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.
Mɔ ko lɛ hewalɛnii atsumɔ; mɔ ko lɛ gbalɛ; mɔ ko hu mumɔi ashikpamɔ ni akɛnaa mumɔi amligbalamɔi; mɔ ko lɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ; ni mɔ ko hu wiemɔi ashishitsɔ̃ɔmɔ.
Shi nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ tsuɔ, ni ejaa ehãa bɔ ni esumɔɔ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enɔ.
Wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Gbɔmɔtso Kome henii ji wɔ Shi tamɔ bɔ ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ ekome ni, shi ehiɛ henii pii, ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii pii lɛ fɛɛ gbɔmɔtso kome ni lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ji Kristo.
Ejaakɛ Yudafoi ji wɔ jio, Helabii ji wɔ jio, nyɔji ji wɔ jio, wɔhiɛ wɔhe jio, wɔ fɛɛ lɛ Mumɔ kome nɔ atsɔ abaptisi wɔ awo gbɔmɔtso kome mli; ni wɔ fɛɛ lɛ, Mumɔ kome akɛhã wɔ ni wɔnu.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ hu jeee he nɔ kome ni, shi moŋ henii pii ni.
Kɛji nane aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee nine ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ he nii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?
Ni kɛji toi hu aaakɛɛ akɛ, “Akɛni jeee hiŋmɛi ji mi hewɔ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji mi” lɛ, ani enɛ hewɔ lɛ jeee gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ eko ji lɛ?
Kɛ gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ hiŋmɛi ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ ninumɔ yɔɔ?
Kɛ ninumɔ sɔŋŋ ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ nifuu yɔɔ?
Shi agbɛnɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henii lɛ eko fɛɛ eko ema gbɔmɔtso lɛ he, bɔ ni esumɔɔ.
Shi kɛ amɛ fɛɛ lɛ henɔ kome ni lɛ, nɛgbɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɔɔ?
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ henii pii ni moŋ, shi gbɔmɔtso kome ni.
Hiŋmɛi nyɛŋ ekɛɛ nine akɛ, “Ohe ehĩaaa mi;” ni asaŋ yitso nyɛŋ ekɛɛ naji akɛ, “Nyɛhe ehĩaaa mi.” Shi gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛhe waaa kwraa lɛ, amɛ moŋ amɛhe hiaa wɔ titri; ni nii ni efeɔ wɔ akɛ amɛ ji gbɔmɔtso henii ni hiɛ bɛ nyam kwraa lɛ, nomɛi titri ahiɛ nyam wɔwoɔ, ni wɔhenii ni bɛ fɛo lɛ moŋ naa hefɛo titri ko; shi wɔhenii ni yɔɔ fɛo momo lɛ, enɛ he ehĩaaa amɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ tsara gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ, ni nɔ ni shwɛɔ lɛ nɔ ko lɛ, no titri ekɛ woo hãa koni mligbalamɔ akaba gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli, shi moŋ henii lɛ abaabaa amɛhe yi pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ni kɛji henɔ kome miina nɔ lɛ, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa nɔ, ni kɛji henɔ kome hiɛ ba nyam hu, henii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ lɛ naa miishɛɛ.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, Kristo gbɔmɔtso ji nyɛ; ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ ehenii lɛ eko ji lɛ.
Ni klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ wo mɛi komɛi bɔfoi yɛ asafo lɛ mli, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, gbalɔi, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, tsɔɔlɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, hewalɛ nitsulɔi, no sɛɛ lɛ, mɛi ni yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ he dromɔ keenii, yelikɛbualɔi, hiɛnyiɛlɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi.
Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji bɔfoi?
Ani mɛi fɛɛ ji gbalɔi?
Ani mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ helaiatsamɔ dromɔ keenii?
Ani mɛi fɛɛ wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi?
Ani mɛi fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ wiemɔi ashishi?
Shi nyɛhiɛ adɔa dromɔ keenii ni fe fɛɛ lɛ ahe.
Ni masaa matsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ gbɛ ni hi fe fɛɛ.
Suɔmɔ fe dromɔ keenii fɛɛ Kɛji mikɛ gbɔmɛi kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi alilɛi wieɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mitsɔ̃ ayawa ni jijeɔ loo ŋmɛlɛ ni gbɛɔ.
Ni kɛji miyɛ gbalɛ dromɔ keenii, ni minaa teemɔŋnii fɛɛ naa, ni mile nii fɛɛ, ni kɛji miyɛ hemɔkɛyeli fɛɛ hu, bɔ ni manyɛ gɔji mafãmɔ, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ mijeee nɔ ko.
Ni kɛji mikɛ minii fɛɛ kuma mɛi, ni kɛji mikɛ migbɔmɔtso hã ni ashã mi, shi mibɛ suɔmɔ lɛ, no lɛ minaaa sɛɛ ko.
Suɔmɔ toɔ etsui shi; emli hi; suɔmɔ hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ mɔ nɔ; suɔmɔ eshwãaa; efeee pupuupu; efeee nii ni esaaa; epeleee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, emli wooo la; eniŋŋ efɔŋ he; enyãaa nɔ sha he; shi anɔkwale moŋ he enyãa; emiɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli; eheɔ nii fɛɛ eyeɔ; ehiɛ kãa nii fɛɛ nɔ; emĩaa ehiɛ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Suɔmɔ sɛɛ efooo gbi ko gbi ko.
Shi kɛji gbalɛi ni lɛ, amɛsɛɛ baafo; kɛji wiemɔi ni lɛ, abaafɔ̃ɔ; kɛji nilee ni lɛ, esɛɛ baafo.
Ejaakɛ wɔnii ni wɔle lɛ, fã kɛ fã ni, ni wɔgbalɛ hu fã kɛ fã ni.
Shi kɛ nɔ ni eye emuu lɛ ba lɛ, no lɛ nɔ ni ji fã kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ aaafo.
Be ni mi ji abifao lɛ, miwieɔ tamɔ abifao, mijwɛŋɔ tamɔ abifao, misusuɔ tamɔ abifao; shi be ni mitsɔ̃ nuu nukpa lɛ, mishɛrɛ abifabiianii lɛ mishwie.
Ejaakɛ amrɔ nɛɛ ashwishwɛ mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa nii tuutuu, shi no mli lɛ eeefee hiɛ kɛ hiɛ; amrɔ nɛɛ mile nii fã kɛ fã, shi no mli lɛ, male nii kɛyi shi tamɔ bɔ ni ale mi kɛyi shi lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ hemɔkɛyeli, hiɛnɔkãmɔ, suɔmɔ, nɛkɛ nibii etɛ̃ nɛɛ, hiɔ shi; shi suɔmɔ ji amɛteŋ nɔ ni fe fɛɛ.
Wiemɔi srɔtoi kɛ gbalɛ Nyɛdia suɔmɔ sɛɛ.
Ni nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ mumɔŋnii lɛ ahe, shi titri lɛ, gbalɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, jeee gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ shi Nyɔŋmɔ moŋ; ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko nuuu, akɛni mumɔ mli ewieɔ teemɔ saji yɛ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, gbɔmɛi ekɛwieɔ ni ekɛhã amɛnane amɔ shi, ni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ, ni ekɛshɛje amɛmii.
Mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enane ehãa mɔɔ shi; shi mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, asafo lɛ nane ehãa mɔɔ shi.
Miisumɔ ni nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛwie wiemɔi srɔtoi; shi nɔ ni misumɔɔ titri ji akɛ nyɛgba; ejaakɛ mɔ ni gbaa lɛ, efe mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi, belɛ ja mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi bɔ ni afee ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ̃ shi.
Shi agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji miba nyɛŋɔɔ mibawie wiemɔi srɔtoi ni jeee kpojiemɔ loo nilee loo gbalɛ loo nitsɔɔmɔ ko ni lɛ, mɛɛ sɛɛ mibahã nyɛna?
Tamɔ bɔ ni nii ni bɛ wala lɛ agbɛɛmɔ yɔɔ lɛ, blɛ jio, saŋku jio, kɛji egbɛɛɛ kɛ gbei srɔtoisrɔtoi lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akpãa loo nɔ ni atswaa lɛ?
Ejaakɛ kɛji tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ egbɛɛɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, namɔ aaasaa ehe ato ta?
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ nyɛ hu, yɛ wiemɔ srɔto wiemɔ mli lɛ, kɛji nyɛwieee nɔ ni shishi yɔɔ faŋŋ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni aaale nɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ?
Ejaakɛ no lɛ nyɛbaafee tamɔ mɛi ni wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ kɔɔyɔɔ.
Wiemɔi srɔtoi pii yɛ je lɛ mli moŋ, shi ekome flo bɛ ni bɛ shishi.
Shi kɛji minaaa wiemɔ lɛ shishi lɛ, belɛ mibatsɔ̃ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hiɛ, ni mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ hu baatsɔ mɔkpɔŋ yɛ mihiɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛ hu, akɛni nyɛhiɛ dɔɔ yɛ mumɔŋ nii ahe lɛ, nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛtekea nɔ ni asafo lɛ nane amɔ shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ wiemɔ srɔto ko lɛ, esɔle koni enyɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shishi hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛji misɔle kɛ wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, mimumɔ miisɔle nɛ, shi mijwɛŋmɔ lɛ, ewooo yibii.
Belɛ mɛni sa akɛ mafee?
Mikɛ mumɔ aaasɔle, shi mikɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu aaasɔle; mala lala kɛ mumɔ, shi mala kɛ jwɛŋmɔ hu.
Ejaakɛ kɛ okɛ mumɔ miijɔɔ lɛ, te aaafee tɛŋŋ ni mɔ ni leee mli eko lɛ aahere oshidaa lɛ nɔ akɛ “Amen”, akɛni eleee nɔ ni okɛɔ lɛ?
Bo lɛ, ooda shi jogbaŋŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mɔ kroko lɛ nane mɔɔɔ shi.
Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi akɛ mife nyɛ fɛɛ yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ mli; shi kɛ̃lɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ mikɛ mijwɛŋmɔ awie wiemɔi komekomei enumɔ, koni mikɛtsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi anii moŋ, fe nɔ ni mawie wiemɔi komekomei akpei nyɔŋma yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi amli.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkafea nyɛhe gbekɛbii yɛ jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ.
Efɔŋ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe abifabii; shi jwɛŋmɔ gbɛfãŋ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni edara.
Aŋma yɛ Mla lɛ mli akɛ, “Wiemɔi krokomɛi kɛ naabui krokomɛi anɔ matsɔ̃ mikɛ nɛkɛ maŋ nɛɛ aaawie, Shi no hu tete amɛboŋ mi toi, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ ejeee okadi hã heyelɔi, shi moŋ eji okadi hã mɛi ni heee yeee; ni gbalɛ lɛ, ejeee mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ anɔ, shi moŋ heyelɔi anɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ kɛji asafo muu lɛ fɛɛ naa bakpe shi yɛ he kome, ni mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miiwie wiemɔi srɔtoi, ni mɛi ni leee mli eko aloo mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi hu ba jɛi lɛ, ani amɛkɛŋ akɛ nyɛmiiye sɛkɛ?
Shi kɛji mɛi lɛ fɛɛ miigba, ni mɔ ko ni heee yeee aloo eleee mli eko lɛ ba jɛi lɛ, mɛi lɛ fɛɛ agbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ, ni aaakã lɛ, ni nomɛi nɔŋŋ aaakojo lɛ, aaajie etsuiŋ teemɔnii akpo faŋŋ, ni no aaahã ekɛ ehiɛ abu shi eja Nyɔŋmɔ, ni eeejaje akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛɛlɛŋ.” Mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahe gbɛjianɔtoo Belɛ te tɛŋŋ, anyɛmimɛi?
Kɛ nyɛnaa bakpe shi ni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko yɛ lala ko, mɔ ko hu yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ kpojiemɔ ko, mɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ srɔto ko, mɔ ko yɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ ko lɛ, afee fɛɛ bɔ ni mɛi anane aaamɔ shi.
Kɛji aawie wiemɔ srɔto lɛ, daa nɛɛ mɛi enyɔ loo, kɛ efa aahu lɛ, mɛi etɛ̃ pɛ awie, mɔ kome mɔ kome, ni mɔ kome hu atsɔ̃ɔ shishi; shi kɛji shishitsɔ̃ɔlɔ ko bɛ lɛ, mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafo lɛ mli, shi ewie ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Shi gbalɔi lɛ, mɛi enyɔ loo mɛi etɛ̃ awie, ni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ ahala mli.
Shi kɛji ajie nɔ ko kpo atsɔ̃ɔ mɔ ko ni ta shi lɛ, mɔ ni ebɔ̃i wiemɔ momo lɛ afee dioo.
Ejaakɛ kɛ afee lɛ mɔ kome mɔ kome lɛ, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛaanyɛ nyɛgba, koni mɛi fɛɛ akase nii, ni awo mɛi fɛɛ hewalɛ.
Gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ baa amɛhe shi amɛhãa gbalɔi lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, ejeee sakasakafeemɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, shi moŋ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji lɛ.
Tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ hetselɔi asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, yei lɛ afee dioo yɛ asafoi lɛ amli, ejaakɛ aŋmɛɛɛ amɛ gbɛ ni amɛwie, shi moŋ amɛba amɛhe shi, tamɔ bɔ ni Mla lɛ kɛɔ lɛ.
Shi kɛ amɛmiisumɔ akɛ amɛkase nɔ ko lɛ, amɛbi amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi yɛ shĩa.
Ejaakɛ eyɛ hiɛgbele hã yei akɛ amɛaawie yɛ asafo mli.
Aloo nyɛŋɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ?
Aloo nyɛ kɛkɛ nyɛŋɔɔ eba?
Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ gbalɔ loo mumɔŋ gbɔmɔ ji lɛ lɛ, sa akɛ ele akɛ nɔ ni miŋma nyɛ nɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã ni.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko enaaa enɛ lɛ, ashi lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛhiɛ adɔa yɛ gbalɛ he, ni wiemɔi srɔtoi awiemɔ lɛ hu nyɛkatsĩa naa.
Afee nii fɛɛ bɔ ni yɔɔ fɛo kɛ gbɛnaagbɛnaa.
Kristo shitee lɛ Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miihã nyɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni nyɛmɔ mli, ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ mli hu lɛ, no akɛhereɔ nyɛyiwala hu, kɛ nyɛmɔ mli bɔ ni mijaje mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; kɛjeee nakai lɛ nyɛhe nyɛye yakatswaa.
Ejaakɛ saji ni he hiaa fe fɛɛ ni akɛhã mi ni mi hu mikɛhã nyɛ lɛ ji akɛ Kristo gbo yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa; ni afu lɛ, ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ yɛ gbi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ nɔ yɛ ŋmalɛi lɛ anaa; ni ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Kefa, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi fe ohai enumɔ shi kome, mɛi ni amɛteŋ mɛi pii yɔɔ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ, shi mɛi komɛi hu ewɔ lɛ.
No sɛɛ lɛ, ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ Yakobo, no sɛɛ lɛ bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ.
Shi amɛ fɛɛ amɛsɛɛ lɛ ejie ehe kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi hu ni mitamɔ mɔ ko ni akpatu afɔ lɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mi ji bibioo fe fɛɛ yɛ bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ, ni misaaa tete akɛ atsɛɔ mi bɔfo, ejaakɛ miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa mi ji mɔ ni mi ji nɛɛ, ni edromɔ ni eduro mi lɛ efeee yaka; shi moŋ mitsu nii waa fe amɛ fɛɛ; shi jeee mi mitsu, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ, miŋ o, amɛŋ o, nakai wɔshiɛɔ ni nakai hu nyɛhe nyɛye.
Gbohiiashitee Shi kɛ aashiɛ yɛ Kristo he akɛ atee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ, mɛni hewɔ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi kɛɔ akɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ?
Kɛ gbohiiashitee ko bɛ lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi.
Shi kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, belɛ wɔshiɛmɔ lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ hu efee yaka; ni asaŋ akpa wɔ shi akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he amale odaseyelɔi ji wɔ, ejaakɛ wɔye Nyɔŋmɔ he odase akɛ etee Kristo shi, mɔ ni kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ eteee lɛ shi lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ ateee gbohii ashi lɛ, belɛ Kristo hu ateee lɛ shi.
Ni asaŋ kɛ ateee Kristo shi lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ efee yaka, ni nyɛkãmɔ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli lolo; no lɛ mɛi ni ewɔ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ hu elaaje.
Kɛ wala nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ wɔhiɛ kã Kristo nɔ yɛ lɛ, wɔnii yɛ mɔbɔ fe gbɔmɛi fɛɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ atee Kristo shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ateŋ.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni gbele tsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ shitee hu tsɔ gbɔmɔ nɔ kɛba.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Adam mli ni mɛi fɛɛ gboiɔ yɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo mli lɛ aaahã mɛi fɛɛ yi ana wala yɛ.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ egbɛhe.
Klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ ji Kristo, no sɛɛ lɛ mɛi ni ji Kristonii lɛ, yɛ ebaa lɛ mli; no sɛɛ dani naagbee lɛ baaba, be ni ekɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ aaahã Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, ni eeefo nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ.
Shi ja eye maŋtsɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ henyɛlɔi lɛ fɛɛ aaawo enajiaŋshi.
Naagbee henyɛlɔ ni abaakpãtã ehiɛ ji gbele.
Ejaakɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kwa ewo enajiaŋshi”.
Shi kɛ ekɛɛ akɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo eshishi” lɛ, belɛ ekãshi faŋŋ akɛ mɔ ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ bɛ mli.
Shi be ni akɛ nii fɛɛ ewo eshishi lɛ, no lɛ Bi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ ehe aaawo mɔ ni kɛ nii fɛɛ wo eshishi lɛ shishi, koni Nyɔŋmɔ afee nibii fɛɛ ayitso.
Kɛjeee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ, te amɛbaafee tɛŋŋ?
Kɛ gbohii eteŋ shi kwraa lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni abaptisiɔ amɛ yɛ gbohii anajiaŋ lɛ: Mɛɛba wɔ hu osharã sharãa wɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa fɛɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ?
Mina nyɛheshwãa ni miyɔɔ yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu mli, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ migboɔ daa gbi.
Kɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni akɛɔ lɛ, mikɛ “kooloi awuyelɔi” wu yɛ Efeso lɛ, no lɛ mɛɛ sɛɛ minaa?
Kɛ gbohii eteee shi lɛ, “Nyɛhãa wɔyea nii ni wɔnua nii, ejaakɛ wɔ́ lɛ wɔbaagboi!” Nyɛkahãa ashishiua nyɛ.
“Naanyobɔɔ fɔŋ fiteɔ jeŋba kpakpa.” Nyɛhãa nyɛhiɛ akãa shi jogbaŋŋ, ni nyɛkafea esha; ejaakɛ nyɛteŋ mɛi komɛi leee nɔ ko nɔ ko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he.
Miikɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛwo nyɛ hiɛgbele.
Shitee gbɔmɔtso lɛ Shi mɔ ko aaabi akɛ, “Te aaafee tɛŋŋ atee gbohii ashi?
Ni asaŋ mɛɛ gbɔmɔtso amɛkɛaaba?” Kwashia!
Nɔ ni bo diɛŋtsɛ oduɔ lɛ, ja egbo fɛɛ da ni eyi naa wala.
Ni asaŋ nɔ ni oduɔ lɛ, jeee tso ni baaba lɛ oduɔ lɛ, shi moŋ dumɔwu kuli ko kɛkɛ, kɛ ŋmaa ni jio, dumɔwu kroko ni jio; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hãa lɛ tso bɔ ni esumɔɔ, ni wu fɛɛ wu lɛ, ehãa lɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etso.
Jeee heloo fɛɛ ji heloo kome: esoro gbɔmɛi aheloo, ni esoro kooloi aheloo; esoro loofɔji aheloo, ni esoro nuŋloi anɔ.
Ni ŋwɛi gbɔmɔtsei yɛ, ni shikpɔŋ nɔ gbɔmɔtsei hu yɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ esoro ŋwɛi nii anunyam, ni esoro shikpɔŋ nɔ nii hu anɔ.
Esoro hulu anunyam, ni esoro nyɔɔŋtsere hu anunyam, ni esoro ŋulamii anunyam, ejaakɛ esoro ŋulami kome anunyam yɛ ekroko nɔ he.
Nakai nɔŋŋ ji gbohiiashitee lɛ hu.
Aduɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ yɛ fitemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ nɔ ni fiteee mli.
Aduɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ni bɛ nyam mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ anunyam mli.
Aduɔ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, ateɔ lɛ shi yɛ hewalɛ mli.
Aduɔ susuma gbɔmɔtso, ateɔ mumɔ gbɔmɔtso shi.
Kɛ susuma gbɔmɔtso yɛ lɛ, mumɔ gbɔmɔtso hu yɛ.
Nakai aŋma hu akɛ, “Adam ni ji klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ susuma ni hiɛ kã;” naagbee Adam lɛ tsɔ̃ mumɔ ni hãa mɔ yi naa wala.
Shi jeee mumɔ nɔ lɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ, shi moŋ susuma nɔ lɛ, no sɛɛ lɛ mumɔ nɔ lɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni jɛ shikpɔŋ mli lɛ, su ni; gbɔmɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ jɛ ŋwɛi.
Bɔ ni mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mɛi ni jɛ su mli lɛ yɔɔ; ni bɔ ni ŋwɛinyo lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, nakai ŋwɛibii lɛ hu yɔɔ.
Ni tamɔ bɔ ni wɔhiɛ mɔ ni jɛ su mli lɛ subaŋ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ wɔbaahiɛ ŋwɛinyo lɛ hu subaŋ.
Anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji akɛ, heloo kɛ lá nine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ, ni asaŋ fitemɔ hu nine shɛŋ nɔ ni fiteee lɛ nɔ.
Naa, teemɔ sane mikɛɔ nyɛ nɛɛ: Jeee wɔ fɛɛ wɔbaawɔ lɛ, shi abaatsake wɔ fɛɛ, trukaa, hiŋmɛitswaa mli, be ni aaakpã naagbee tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ abaakpã tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ, ni aaatee gbohii ashi ni amɛfiteŋ dɔŋŋ, ni wɔ lɛ, abaatsake wɔ.
Ejaakɛ ja nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ wo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ.
Shi be ni nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni fiteee lɛ, ni nɛkɛ gbele nɔ nɛɛ ewo nɔ ni gbooo lɛ, no lɛ wiemɔ ni aŋma lɛ aaaba mli akɛ, “Ami gbele yɛ kunim mli.” “Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ okunim lɛ yɔɔ?
Ao gbele, nɛgbɛ ogãi lɛ yɔɔ?” Shi gbele gãi lɛ ji esha; ni esha hewalɛ ji Mla lɛ.
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ ehãa wɔyeɔ kunim lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ, nyɛfĩa shi ni nyɛkagbugbãa ni nyɛtekea nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ mli daa nɛɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ efeŋ yaka yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Yelikɛbuamɔ onia hã hetselɔi lɛ Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ onia ni atsuɔ ayahã hetselɔi lɛ he lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mito mihã Galatia asafoi lɛ, nyɛ hu nyɛfea nakai.
Daa otsi mli klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ nɔ ko ato yɛ bɔ ni enaa lɛ naa, koni mikaba dani atsu onia.
Ni kɛji miba lɛ, matsu mɛi ni nyɛbuɔ akɛ amɛsa kɛ woji ni amɛkɛ nyɛnikeenii lɛ aya Yerusalɛm.
Kɛji esa akɛ mi hu matee lɛ, mikɛ amɛ aaatee.
Paulo gbɛfai ahe gbɛjianɔtoo Shi miyatsɔ̃ Makedonia dani maba nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ Makedonia miyatsɔ̃.
Shi ekolɛ mahi nyɛŋɔɔ fioo, ni ekolɛ maye fɛ̃ibe lɛ hu yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni he fɛɛ he ni maya lɛ, nyɛyajie mi gbɛ.
Ejaakɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ minaa nyɛ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ minyiɛ gbɛfãa nɔ kɛkɛ, shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ, matsɛ fioo yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Shi mibahi Efeso kɛyashi Pentekoste gbi lɛ.
Agbele shinaa kpeteŋkple ahã mi kɛhã nitsumɔ ni baawo yibii, shi mɛi ni kuɔ naa lɛ ayi fa.
Shi kɛji Timoteo ba lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni ekɛ gbeyeishemɔ akahi shi yɛ nyɛteŋ; ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nitsumɔ etsuɔ tamɔ mi nɔŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ mɔ ko akabu lɛ akɛ ejeee mɔ ko shi nyɛjiea lɛ gbɛ yɛ hejɔlɛ mli koni eba miŋɔɔ; shi miikwɛ lɛ gbɛ kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Shi wɔnyɛmi Apolo lɛ, mikpa lɛ fai aahu ni ekɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ aba nyɛŋɔɔ; shi ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kwraa akɛ eeeba amrɔ nɛɛ, shi kɛ ena hegbɛ jiŋŋ, eeeba.
Naagbee wiemɔi kɛ ŋamɔi Nyɛbua, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, nyɛfea hii, ni nyɛhe awaa!
Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛle Stefana shĩa bii lɛ, akɛ amɛ ji Akaia klɛŋklɛŋ yibii, ni amɛkɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ asɔ̃ɔmɔ amɛfɔ̃ amɛnɔ, koni nyɛ hu nyɛba nyɛhe shi nyɛhã mɛi ni tamɔ mɛnɛɛmɛi, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nii lɛ eko ni egboɔ deŋme yɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mina miishɛɛ akɛ Stefana kɛ Fortunato kɛ Akaiko eba, ejaakɛ ni nyɛbɛ miŋɔɔ nɛɛ, amɛ amɛbaye nyɛnajiaŋ.
Ejaakɛ amɛbahã mimumɔ kɛ nyɛ hu nyɛmumɔ ena ekãa.
No hewɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ nyɛlea amɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Asia asafoi lɛ miibi nyɛ.
Akwila kɛ Priskila kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ amɛwe lɛ miibi nyɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mi, Paulo diɛŋtsɛ, minine naa bimɔ nɛ.
Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sane lɛ, mɔ lɛ atsɔ̃ musumɔ!
Maran-ata: Nuŋtsɔ, ba.
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
Misuɔmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Bɔfo Paulo wolo ni ji enyɔ ni eŋma emaje Korintobii lɛ, eŋma be mli ni nibii amli ewa waa ehã lɛ yɛ ekɛ Korinto asafo lɛ naanyobɔɔ hewɔ.
Asafo lɛ mlibii lɛ ekomɛi ejie amɛhiɛ faŋŋ amɛka lɛ akɛ amɛkɛ lɛ baatswa.
Shi lɛ lɛ, ejie shwee kple ni eshweɔ akɛ asaa amɛteŋ lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ, ni be ni ana asaa amɛteŋ lɛ, ena miishɛɛ ho he ni enya kɛ tsuijurɔ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Paulo wie naanyobɔɔ ni yɔɔ ekɛ Korinto asafo lɛ teŋ lɛ he yɛ emajemɔ wolo lɛ mli, ni etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hewɔ ni etutu ehiɛ ewo amɛ ni ewieɔ jɛmɔi kɛ hiŋtihiŋti ni gbaa asafo lɛ naa lɛ he nyanyaanya lɛ.
Ehã amɛle akɛ emii eshɛ ehe waa ejaakɛ ekɔkɔbɔɔ lɛ efeee yaka, shi moŋ ekɛ tsuitsakemɔ kɛ kpãtãmɔ eba.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ, eba asafoŋbii lɛ ni amɛje amɛtsuiaŋ faa amɛye too koni akɛyaye abua Kristofoi ohiafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea lɛ.
Naagbee lɛ, Paulo fã ebɔfo ni eji lɛ he, ni ejie ehe yi ejaakɛ mɛi enyɔ oo ko yɛ Korinto ni amɛ kɛ shwãa miishi amɛtsitsi akɛ amɛ ji bɔfoi kpakpai lɛ, ni amɛmiigbe lɛ Paulo lɛ he guɔ akɛ lɛ lɛ jeee bɔfo kpakpa ji lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Paulo kɛ Korinto Asafo lɛ .—.
Onia ni akɛyawa Yudea Kristofoi lɛ .—.
Paulo fã hewalɛ ni eyɔɔ akɛ bɔfo lɛ he .—.
Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo lɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Nyɔŋmɔ asafo ni yɔɔ Korinto lɛ kɛ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Akaia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ yelikɛbuamɔ hewɔ Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ji musuŋtsɔlɛtsɛ kɛ miishɛjemɔ fɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Eshɛjeɔ wɔmii yɛ wɔmanehului lɛ fɛɛ mli, koni wɔ hu wɔnyɛ wɔkɛ miishɛjemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛshɛjeɔ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmii lɛ ashɛje mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ amii.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni Kristo amanehului lɛ baa wɔnɔ kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ Kristo hewɔ lɛ wɔmiishɛjemɔ hu faa kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ.
Shi kɛji amanehulu wɔna jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ kɛ yiwalaheremɔ hewɔ ni; ni kɛji wɔmii ashɛjeɔ hu jiŋŋ, nyɛmiishɛjemɔ ni hãa nyɛkɛ tsuishitoo mĩaa nyɛhiɛ kɛnaa nakai amanehului ni wɔnaa lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ ni.
Ni wɔhiɛ ni kã nyɛnɔ lɛ gbugbãaa, ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ bɔ ni nyɛnaa amanehului lɛ eko lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛnaa miishɛjemɔ lɛ hu eko.
Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ wɔkɛ wɔmanehului ni wɔna yɛ Asia lɛ atee nyɛ, akɛ wɔna nɔ tsɔ̃ fe bɔ ni wɔɔnyɛ po, ni wɔhiɛ kãaa wala nɔ tete, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔna faŋŋ akɛ gbele fɔbuu kã wɔnɔ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ akafɔ̃ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe nɔ, shi moŋ wɔkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ ni teɔ gbohii ashi lɛ nɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ gbele ni yɔɔ gbeyei tamɔ nɛkɛ nɛɛ mli, ni ebaajie wɔ, ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ ebaaya nɔ ejie wɔ, kɛji nyɛfata he kɛkpa fai nyɛhã wɔ, koni mɛi pii ada shi ahã wɔ yɛ dromɔ keenii ni akɛhã wɔ yɛ mɛi pii afaikpamɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Paulo tsake egbɛfãa lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo Shi wɔshwãa lɛ nɛ: wɔhenilee odase ni eyeɔ wɔ akɛ hetsemɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ yɛ je nɛɛ mli, titri lɛ yɛ wɔkɛ nyɛteŋ shihilɛ mli, ni jeee heloo gbɛfãŋ nilee naa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔŋmaaa nyɛ nibii krokomɛi fe nii ni nyɛkaneɔ ni asaŋ nyɛle, ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale kɛwula shi hu, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛna nyɛle wɔ hu fã kɛ fã akɛ nyɛshwãanɔ ji wɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛ hu nyɛ ji wɔshwãanɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Enɛ nɔ mikɛ mihiɛ fɔ̃ hewɔ mito miyiŋ akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ tsutsu lɛ koni nyɛna dromɔ shii enyɔ, no ji, ni mibatsɔ̃ nyɛŋɔɔ kɛya Makedonia, ni asaŋ maku misɛɛ kɛjɛ Makedonia maba nyɛŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ, koni nyɛyajie mi gbɛ kɛya Yudea.
Belɛ ni mito miyiŋ nakai lɛ, yiŋ flɛflɛ mikɛfee?
Aloo miyiŋ ni mito lɛ, gbɔmɔ jwɛŋmɔ mikɛto, ni makɛɛ “hɛɛ”, “hɛɛ”, kɛ “dabi” “dabi”, fɛɛ shi kome?
Shi anɔkwafo ji Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ wɔwiemɔ ni wɔkɛ nyɛ wie lɛ ejeee nɔ ni kɛɔ “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi Yesu Kristo mɔ ni mikɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo shiɛ ehe sane yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ, ejeee “hɛɛ” kɛ “dabi” fɛɛ shi kome, shi moŋ eji “hɛɛ”.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi abɔ ni yɔɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ “hɛɛ”; ni no hewɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ enɔ wɔkɛɔ “Amen” kɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam lɛ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni hãa wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ fiɔ shi yɛ Kristo mli, ni efɔ wɔ mu; lɛ nɔŋŋ esɔo wɔnaa, ni ekɛ Mumɔ lɛ ehã wɔ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu.
Shi mi lɛ, miitsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ebaye odase eshi mi kɛji ejeee anɔkwale akɛ nyɛyibaamɔ hewɔ minako maba Korinto lɛ.
Jeee akɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ nyɔŋ wɔyeɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, shi moŋ wɔfata nyɛhe kɛmiitsu nii kɛhã nyɛmiishɛɛnamɔ.
Shi mikpɛ mli yɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ miyiŋ akɛ mikɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli baŋ nyɛŋɔɔ dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mihã nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, namɔ baashɛje mimii akɛ mɔ nɔŋŋ ni mihã eye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ?
Ni miŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ, koni kɛ miba lɛ, mɛi ni kulɛ sa akɛ amɛhã mimii ashɛ mihe lɛ akahã miye ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛaana akɛ mimiishɛɛ ji nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ.
Shi mijɛ hejaramɔ pii kɛ tsuiyeli babaoo mli mikɛ yaafonui babaoo ŋma nyɛ, jeee ni nyɛwerɛ aho nyɛhe, shi moŋ ni nyɛna suɔmɔ babaoo ni misumɔɔ nyɛ.
Mɔ ni etɔ̃ yɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ akɛfa lɛ Shi kɛ mɔ ko ehã aye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, jeee mi ni ehã miye ŋkɔmɔ lɛ, shi, bɔ ni afee ni minaa akaya shɔŋŋ lɛ, ehã nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛye ŋkɔmɔ ko kɛ̃.
Nakai mɔ lɛ, ehiɛ ni mɛi pii ekã lɛ fa hã lɛ; hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛkɛfaa lɛ moŋ ni nyɛshɛjea emii koni ŋkɔmɔyeli tuutu lɛ akahã enijiaŋ je wui.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛma nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ mi nyɛhã lɛ; ejaakɛ enɛ hewɔ hu ni miŋma nyɛ wolo lɛ, koni mikɛna nɔ gbɔmɛi ni ji nyɛ, akɛ nyɛboɔ toi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ gbɛfaŋ lo.
Shi mɔ ni nyɛkɛ nɔ ko faa lɛ lɛ, mi hu mikɛfaa lɛ; ejaakɛ mi hu, nɔ ni mikɛfa lɛ, kɛ mikɛ nɔ ko efa lɛ, mikɛfa yɛ nyɛhewɔ yɛ Kristo hiɛ; koni Satan nine akashɛ wɔnɔ, ejaakɛ wɔle eŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ.
Shi be ni miba Troia ni mibashiɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ ni agbele gbɛ ahã mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, minaaa hejɔlɛ yɛ mimumɔ mli, ejaakɛ minaaa minyɛmi Tito hewɔ lɛ mishɛ amɛ, ni miyiŋ kɛtee Makedonia.
Kunimyeli yɛ Kristo mli Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ nyiɛɔ wɔhiɛ be fɛɛ be yɛ ekunimyeli lɛ mli lɛ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ wɔnɔ ehãa enilee ŋmajee lɛ jeɔ kpo yɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo ŋmajee ni ekɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ ji wɔ yɛ mɛi ni ahereɔ amɛyiwala lɛ kɛ mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ, eji gbele ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa gbele mli hã amɛ; shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, eji wala ŋma ni kɛ mɔ yaa wala mli hã amɛ.
Ni namɔ sa hã nɛkɛ nitsumɔ?
Ejaakɛ wɔtamɔɔɔ mɛi pii ni kɛ nibii krokomɛi futuɔ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwieɔ lɛ ŋmiiŋmi bɔ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, yɛ Kristo mli.
Kpãŋmɔ Hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi Aso wɔbɔ̃i wɔhe yijiemɔ ekoŋŋ?
Aloo ehĩa wɔ akɛ wɔhiɛɔ yijiemɔ woji kɛbahãa nyɛ loo kɛjɛɔ nyɛdɛŋ tamɔ bɔ ni ehĩaa mɛi komɛi lɛ lo?
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji wɔwolo ni aŋma yɛ wɔtsuii amli ni mɛi fɛɛ le ni amɛkaneɔ lɛ, ni ajie nyɛ faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nyɛ ji Kristo wolo ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he, ni jeee blɛgi akɛŋma, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ, jeee yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ, shi moŋ yɛ tsuii ni ji heloo taoi anɔ.
Shi Kristo hewɔ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nɛɛ.
Jeee akɛ wɔsa yɛ wɔnyɛmɔ naa, ní wɔɔjwɛŋ akɛ nɔ ko jɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmli, shi wɔsalɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli ejɛ; lɛ ehã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni sa akɛ akɛfee kpãŋmɔ hee lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi, jeee nɔ ni aŋma shi moŋ Mumɔ nɔ; ejaakɛ nɔ ni aŋma lɛ gbeɔ mɔ; shi Mumɔ lɛ hãa mɔ yi naa wala.
Shi kɛ gbele sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akpɛ yɛ tɛi tɛtɛrɛi anɔ lɛ yɛ nyam bɔ ni Israelbii lɛ nyɛɛɛ Mose hiɛ akwɛ yɛ ehiɛ nyam ni sɛɛ foɔ lɛ hewɔ po lɛ, ani Mumɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam fe no?
Ejaakɛ kɛ fɔbuu sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, ani jalɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ efeŋ nyam kɛtekeŋ nɔ aahu?
Ejaakɛ anunyam lɛ ni fa babaoo tsɔ̃ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, nɔ ni yɔɔ nyam lɛ bɛ nyam yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ yɛ nyam lɛ, belɛ nɔ ni hiɔ shi lɛ yɛ nyam aahu fe no.
Agbɛnɛ akɛni wɔyɔɔ nɛkɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔfeɔ ekãa babaoo, ni wɔfeee tamɔ Mose ni kɛ hiɛhaanɔ ha ehiɛ, koni Israelbii lɛ akwɛ nɔ ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ naagbee lɛ.
Shi moŋ aŋa amɛjwɛŋmɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ nakai hiɛhaanɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ ha kpãŋmɔ momo lɛ kanemɔ lɛ nɔ; ajieko shi akɛ Kristo mli esɛɛ foɔ yɛ.
Shi kɛbashi ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ nɔ lɛ, be fɛɛ be ni akaneɔ Mose wolo lɛ, hiɛhaanɔ ha amɛtsui nɔ; shi kɛ amɛku amɛsɛɛ kɛba Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ, aaajie hiɛhaanɔ lɛ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji Mumɔ lɛ, ni he ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Mumɔ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ, jɛi heyeli yɔɔ.
Shi wɔ fɛɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛ kpetekplee kwɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ anunyam lɛ tamɔ akwɛɔ ashwishwɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiitsake wɔmiitsɔ̃mɔ nakai subaŋ lɛ nɔŋŋ kɛmiijɛ anunyam mli kɛmiiya anunyam mli, tamɔ bɔ ni ejeɔ Nuŋtsɔ ni ji Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.
Mumɔŋ jwetri yɛ su kpuji amli No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni akɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ ehã wɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔbɔnalɛ naa lɛ, wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui, shi wɔkwa hiɛgbejianii ni akɛtee lɛ, ni wɔbaaa wɔjeŋ yɛ kutumpɔo mli; ni asaŋ wɔkɛ nibii futuuu Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ faŋŋ jieɔ wɔhe yi wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ henilee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi kɛ ha aha wɔsanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ tete lɛ, mɛi ni laajeɔ lɛ amli kɛkɛ aha hiɛ yɛ, amɛ ji mɛi amli ni je nɛɛ mli nyɔŋmɔ lɛ eshwila mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ajwɛŋmɔi lɛ yɛ, koni Kristo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa la lɛ akakpɛ miihã amɛ.
Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe wɔshiɛɔ, shi moŋ Kristo Yesu akɛ Nuŋtsɔ, kɛ wɔ hu akɛ nyɛtsuji yɛ Yesu hewɔ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ la ajɛ duŋ mli akpɛ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ ekpɛ yɛ wɔtsuii amli hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam he nilee la lɛ akpɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo hiɛ.
Shi wɔhiɛ nɛkɛ jwetri nɛɛ yɛ su kpuji amli, koni hewalɛ ni fa kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ afee Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ, ni jeee wɔnɔ.
Afĩfĩaa wɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔtsui esuuu; wɔfeɔ yaa, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeko wui, awaa wɔ yi, shi kɛ̃lɛ akwako wɔ; atswiaa wɔ shi, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔpleneko.
Daa nɛɛ wɔhiɛ Yesu gbele lɛ yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli kɛnyiɛ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtso lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ nɛɛ, daa nɛɛ atu wɔ awo gbele dɛŋ yɛ Yesu hewɔ, koni Yesu wala lɛ hu aje kpo yɛ wɔgbɔmɔtsei ni baagboi lɛ amli.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ gbele tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli, shi nyɛ lɛ, wala tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛmli.
Shi akɛni wɔyɔɔ nakai hemɔkɛyeli mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma akɛ, “Mihe miye hewɔ ni miwie” lɛ, wɔ hu wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ, ni no hewɔ lɛ, wɔwieɔ; ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ mɔ ni tee Nuŋtsɔ Yesu shi lɛ, eeetee wɔ kɛ Yesu shi, ni ekɛ wɔ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaadamɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛhewɔ afeɔ fɛɛ, koni dromɔ ni fa babaoo lɛ atsɔ̃ mɛi pii ashidaa nɔ atɛke nɔ ahã Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛnyamwoo.
Wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa No hewɔ ni wɔtsui efãaa lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ wɔkponɔgbɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ fiteɔ kwraa tete lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔmli gbɔmɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ ehee gbi fɛɛ gbi.
Ejaakɛ wɔmanehulu ni jaraaa ni asaŋ esɛɛ etsɛɛɛ nɛɛ, baahã wɔna naanɔ anunyam kpele ni jara wa aahu; ejaakɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni kwɛɔ nii ni anaa lɛ, shi moŋ nii ni anaaa lɛ wɔkwɛɔ; ejaakɛ nii ni anaa lɛ hiɔ shi be fioo kɛkɛ, shi nii ni anaaa lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyashiɔ naanɔ.
Wɔshweɔ wɔŋwɛi gbɔmɔtso hee kɛ ŋwɛi shĩa hee lɛ Ejaakɛ wɔle akɛ, kɛ akumɔ wɔbuu ni wɔyɔɔ mli ni ji wɔshikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ shĩa jiŋŋ, wɔyɛ tsu ko ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ, shĩa ko ni jeee niji akɛfee, ni hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ejaakɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔ ŋtsɔi tete yɛ wɔbuu nɛɛ mli, ni wɔshweɔ akɛ akɛ wɔtsu ni jɛ ŋwɛi lɛ awo wɔ, ni kɛ akɛwo wɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, no lɛ anaŋ wɔ akɛ mɛi ni nyiɛ yayai.
Ejaakɛ wɔ ni wɔyɔɔ buu lɛ mli lɛ hu, akɛni wɔhe jaraa wɔ hewɔ lɛ, wɔdɔ̃mɔɔŋtsɔi, ejaakɛ wɔsumɔɔɔ akɛ ajie wɔhenii, shi moŋ wɔsumɔɔ akɛ awo wɔ nii ashwie nɔ, koni wala lɛ ami nɔ ni gboɔ lɛ.
Shi mɔ ni saa wɔ hã enɛ nɔŋŋ ji Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni hã wɔ Mumɔ lɛ akɛ yibaafoo nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔyɛ tsui daa, ni wɔle akɛ gbii abɔ ni wɔyɔɔ gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli nɛɛ wɔdom kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa wɔnyiɛɔ yɛ, shi jeee ninamɔ naa, shi wɔyɛ tsui, ni esa wɔhiɛ moŋ akɛ wɔɔdom kɛjɛ gbɔmɔtso nɛɛ mli, ni wɔyahi shĩa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ, shĩa wɔyɔɔ jio, dommɔ wɔdom jio, esa ni wɔsa ehiɛ.
Ejaakɛ ja wɔ fɛɛ wɔpue faŋŋ yɛ Kristo kojomɔ sɛi lɛ hiɛ, koni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ana nii ni efee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli lɛ he nyɔmɔwobɔɔ ni efee lɛ, ekpakpa jio, efɔŋ jio.
Kristo ekpãtã wɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔle Nuŋtsɔ lɛ he ni yɔɔ gbeyei lɛ, wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɛi; shi wɔ lɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; ni mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ wɔyɛ faŋŋ yɛ nyɛhenilee mli hu.
Ejaakɛ jeee wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔhe yi wɔjieɔ wɔhãa nyɛ ekoŋŋ, shi moŋ wɔkɛmiihã nyɛ gbɛ ni nyɛkɛshwã nyɛfɔ̃ wɔnɔ, koni nyɛna eko nyɛkɛɛ mɛi ni shwãa yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ shi jeee yɛ tsui mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ sɛkɛ wɔyeɔ jiŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ hewɔ wɔyeɔ, ni kɛ wɔyɛ shishiishi hu jiŋŋ, nyɛ hewɔ ni.
Ejaakɛ Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ nyɛɔ wɔnɔ, ni wɔkojoɔ nɛkɛ akɛ, kɛ mɔ kome gbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele lɛ, belɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ egboi.
Ni egbo mɛi fɛɛ ayigbele, koni mɛi ni hiɛ kãmɔ lɛ ahiɛ akakãmɔ miihã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛhiɛ akãmɔ ahã mɔ ni gbo ni atee lɛ shi ekoŋŋ ahã amɛ lɛ.
Belɛ, kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ, wɔleee mɔ ko mɔ ko dɔŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa; ni kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumɔ naa wɔle Kristo yɛ tete lɛ, agbɛnɛ lɛ wɔleee lɛ nakai dɔŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ, kɛ mɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli lɛ, bɔɔnɔ hee ji lɛ; blema nii lɛ eho; naa, nibii fɛɛ etsɔ̃mɔ ehee.
Shi nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ ekɛ wɔ kpãtã, ni ekɛ kpãtãmɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ hã wɔ lɛ dɛŋ; no ji akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ ekɛ je lɛ kpãtã, ni ebuuu amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ ehãaa amɛ, ni etu kpãtãmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ewo wɔdɛŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔji bɔfoi yɛ Kristo najiaŋ, tamɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ wɔnɔ eewie eetsɔ̃ɔ mɛi: wɔdamɔ Kristo najiaŋ wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ, nyɛhãa akpãtã nyɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ teŋ!
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni leee esha lɛ, wɔhewɔ lɛ ehã etsɔ̃ esha, koni wɔ lɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ yɛ emli.
Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi anitsumɔ walɛ kɛ enyam Shi akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ hefatalɔi ji wɔ yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ mli lɛ, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni nyɛkahã Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni nyɛnine eshɛ nɔ lɛ fee yaka.
Ejaakɛ ekɛɛ akɛ, “Be ni sa mli mibo bo toi yɛ, ni yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɔ hu miye mibua bo yɛ.” Naa, be ni sa jogbaŋŋ nɛ; naa, yiwalaheremɔ gbi nɛ.
Ni wɔtooo mɔ ko mɔ ko pampi yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, koni akagbe wɔsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he guɔ.
Shi moŋ, nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji wɔ.
Wɔmĩaa wɔhiɛ babaoo.
Wɔtoɔ wɔtsui shi yɛ amanehului kɛ fimɔi kɛ jaramɔi amli.
Ayiɔ wɔ ni awoɔ wɔ tsuŋ kpitiokpitio.
Afeɔ wɔ soisoi.
Wɔtsuɔ nii kɛ kpeshii kɛ deŋmegbomɔ pii.
Wɔhiɔ ŋmãa, ni wɔbɔɔ hetsemɔ he mɔdɛŋ kɛ nilee.
Wɔŋmɛɔ wɔtsui shi; wɔmli hi.
Yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hewalɛ naa lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ lɛ osato bɛ mli.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ wɔwieɔ anɔkwale.
Ni wɔwoɔ jalɛ tawuunii yɛ ninejurɔ kɛ abɛku fɛɛ.
Mɛi komɛi woɔ wɔhiɛ nyam; ni mɛi komɛi gbeɔ wɔhe guɔ.
Mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe efɔŋ, ni mɛi komɛi wieɔ wɔhe ekpakpa.
Anaa wɔ akɛ shishiulɔi, kɛ̃lɛ, anɔkwafoi ji wɔ.
Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni aleee kɛ mɛi ni ale krɛdɛɛ; tamɔ mɛi ni gboiɔ, ni naa, wɔhiɛ kãmɔ.
Wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni agbalaa amɛtoi, ni kɛ̃lɛ agbeko wɔ.
Wɔ tamɔ ŋkɔmɔyelɔi, shi wɔmii shɛɔ daa.
Wɔ tamɔ ohiafoi, shi wɔfeɔ mɛi pii niiatsɛmɛi, ni wɔ tamɔ mɛi ni bɛ nɔ ko, ni kɛ̃lɛ wɔyɛ nii fiaa.
Nyɛgbelea nyɛtsui naa nyɛhãa wɔ Korintobii, wɔkɛ nyɛ ewie faŋŋ; wɔtsui mli egbele.
Gbɛ yɛ wɔmli hã nyɛ, shi nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ moŋ nyɛtsuii amli joɔ.
Nyɛ hu nyɛgbelea nyɛtsuii amli nakai nɔŋŋ, ni nyɛkɛto wɔ najiaŋ.
Mikɛ nyɛ miiwie tamɔ mibii.
Kristojamɔ kɛ wɔŋjamɔ bɛ nɔ ko feemɔ Nyɛkɛ mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ akagbalaa kɔŋtso kome, akɛni amɛkɛ nyɛ yeee hegbɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛɛ bɔɔ jalɛ kɛ mlatɔ̃mɔ yɔɔ?
Aloo mɛɛ yeli la kɛ duŋ yɔɔ?
Ni mɛɛ gbeekpãmɔ Kristo kɛ Belial yɔɔ?
Aloo mɛɛ nijaa mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ kɛ mɔ ni heee yeee yɔɔ?
Ni asaŋ mɛɛ ekomefeemɔ yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu kɛ amãgãi ateŋ?
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu ji nyɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ akɛ, “Mahi amɛmli, ni manyiɛ yɛ amɛteŋ.
Ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.” No hewɔ lɛ, Yehowa kɛɛ, “Nyɛjea amɛteŋ, ni nyɛtsea nyɛhe, ni nyɛkataa muji nɔ ko he, ni mahere nyɛ atuu.
Ni matsɔ̃ nyɛtsɛ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛaatsɔ̃mɔ mibihii kɛ mibiyei,” Yehowa, Ofe lɛ, kɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni asumɔɔ, akɛni wɔna nɛkɛ shiwoi nɛɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔtsua wɔhe kɛjɛa heloo kɛ mumɔ muji fɛɛ mli, ni wɔhã wɔhetsemɔ aye emuu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Paulo mii shɛ ehe akɛ asafo lɛ eshwa ehe Nyɛhãa wɔ gbɛ yɛ nyɛmli!
Wɔfeko mɔ ko mɔ ko efɔŋ ko; wɔyeko mɔ ko awui, wɔyeko mɔ ko amim.
Mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mikɛbu nyɛ fɔ; ejaakɛ mikɛɛ momo akɛ wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ yɛ wɔtsui mli bɔ ni gbele mli oo, wala mli oo, wɔkɛ nyɛ ekome.
Mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ waa, ni asaŋ mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ babaoo; miyi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛjemɔ, miyi kɛtɛke nɔ kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ wɔmanehulu lɛ fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ shi be ni wɔba Makedonia lɛ hu, wɔnaaa wɔgbɔmɔtso hejɔlɛ kwraa; shi moŋ he fɛɛ he lɛ amanehulu sɔŋŋ wɔnaa: wɔkponɔgbɛ lɛ nɔmɔi, wɔmligbɛ lɛ gbeyeishemɔi.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni shɛjeɔ mɛi ni baa amɛhe shi lɛ amii lɛ, kɛ Tito baa lɛ shɛje wɔmii; shi jeee ebaa lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ miishɛjemɔ ni nyɛkɛshɛje emii lɛ hu, ejaakɛ egba wɔ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ mi lɛ kɛ nyɛheshwamɔ lɛ kɛ mihe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ; enɛ hã mina miishɛɛ babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wolo ni miŋma nyɛ lɛ edɔ nyɛ lɛ, mishwaaa mihe; kɛji mishwa mihe po lɛ, ejaakɛ mina akɛ nakai wolo lɛ edɔ nyɛ, kɛ be kuku po, agbɛnɛ mimii eshɛ; jeee dɔ ni edɔ nyɛ lɛ hewɔ ni, shi moŋ akɛni dɔlɛ lɛ hã nyɛshwa nyɛhe lɛ hewɔ ni; ejaakɛ edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akajɛ wɔ ni nɔ ko bɔ nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ dɔlɛ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɛɔ tsuitsakemɔ kɛbaa, tsuitsakemɔ ni kɛ mɔ yaa yiwalaheremɔ ni ashwaaa he yɛ he lɛ mli; shi je nɛɛ mli dɔlɛ lɛ tsɛɔ gbele.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ dɔlɛ ni edɔ nyɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa nɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ, nɔ naajiemɔ, nɔ mlifu, nɔ gbeyeishemɔ, nɔ shwee, nɔ hiɛdɔɔ, nɔ jalɛ kojomɔ ni etsɛ ewo nyɛmli!
Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe tsɔ̃ɔ wɔ akɛ nyɛhe tse yɛ nɛkɛ sane nɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ miŋma nyɛ tete lɛ, jeee mɔ ni tɔ̃ lɛ, asaŋ hu jeee mɔ ni atɔ̃ enɔ lɛ hewɔŋ, shi moŋ bɔ ni afee ni wɔhe mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛbɔɔ lɛ apue faŋŋ ahã nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔmii eshɛ.
Shi miishɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ Tito miishɛɛ lɛ he lɛ hã wɔmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ babaoo, ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhã etsui enyɔ emli, ejaakɛ kɛ mishwã nyɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ yɛ nɔ ko mli lɛ, nyɛwooo mi hiɛgbele; shi tamɔ bɔ ni wɔwie nibii fɛɛ anɔkwale mli wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔshwãa hu ni wɔshwã wɔtsɔ̃ɔ Tito lɛ efee anɔkwale, ni eyɛ nyɛhe tsui babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ, ejaakɛ ekaiɔ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ here lɛ lɛ.
Mina miishɛɛ akɛ mikɛ mihe fɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Kristofoi atooyeli Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiihã nyɛle dromɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛduro Makedonia asafoi lɛ, akɛ aka amɛ yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛmiishɛɛ lɛ tɛke nɔ, ni amɛhĩa katekate lɛ mli po, amɛ jie mlihilɛ falɛ kpo; ejaakɛ miiye odase akɛ amɛhã bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ, ni amɛhã fe bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ tete yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛsuɔmɔ naa, ni amɛkɛ tutɔmɔ babaoo kpa wɔ fai ni ahã amɛ hu amɛna naanyobɔɔ ni akɛsumɔɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ mli gbɛ, ni jeee bɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ amɛŋɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe amɛhã Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu kɛ wɔ hu, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa.
No hã wɔkpa Tito fai, koni bɔ ni ebɔ̃i momo sa lɛ, nakai etsu dromɔ nitsumɔ nɛɛ kɛgbe naa hu yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtɛkeɔ nɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ wiemɔ kɛ nilee kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ fɛɛ kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛ wɔmli ni eyɔɔ nyɛmli lɛ mli lɛ, nyɛkwɛa koni nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ mli hu lɛ nyɛtɛke nɔ.
Miwieee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ mɛi krokomɛi amɔdɛŋbɔɔ mikɛkaa nyɛ hu nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ makwɛ akɛ eyɛ krɔŋŋ lo.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ, akɛ lɛ ni ji niiatsɛ lɛ, etsɔ̃ ohiafo yɛ nyɛhewɔ, koni nyɛtsɔ̃ ehia lɛ nɔ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi.
Nɔ ni mijwɛŋ yɛ sane nɛɛ he nɛ, enɛ hi hã nyɛ, ejaakɛ jeee feemɔ kɛkɛ, shi suɔmɔ ni akɛbaafee lɛ hu nyɛ tsutsu nyɛje shishi afi beebe nɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ nyɛgbea feemɔ lɛ naa, koni bɔ ni oya nɔŋŋ ni nyɛsumɔ akɛ nyɛfee lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nyɛjɛa nɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbea naa.
Ejaakɛ kɛ tsui yɛ he lɛ, no lɛ bɔ ni mɔ ko hãa kɛjɛɔ nɔ ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ saa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ; jeee kɛjɛ nɔ ni ebɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ mikɛɛɛ enɛ ni mɛi komɛi ahe ajɔ amɛ ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛhao, shi moŋ koni fɛɛ afee pɛpɛɛpɛ; nɛkɛ be nɛɛ mli lɛ, nɔ ni nyɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ ayaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ mɛi komɛi nyɛɛɛ ahã lɛ najiaŋ, koni be kroko lɛ nɔ ni amɛ hu amɛna kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ abaye nɔ ni fimɔ hewɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛɛɛ nyɛhã lɛ najiaŋ, koni aye hegbɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ; tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Mɔ ni bua pii naa lɛ, enaa eko yɛ sɛɛ, ni mɔ ni bua fioo naa hu lɛ, eshwɛɛɛ lɛ eko.” Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ ni kɛ nyɛhedɔɔ nɛɛ wo Tito tsui mli lɛ; ejaakɛ eyɛ mli akɛ wɔkɛŋmɛ ehiɛ ni eba ni ekpɛlɛ̃, shi akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ eyɛ he tsui waa hewɔ lɛ, eba nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa.
Shi nyɛmi ni wɔtsu wɔfata ehe nɛɛ yɛ yijiemɔ yɛ asafoi lɛ fɛɛ mli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ; shi jeee enɛ kɛkɛ, shi asafoi lɛ hala lɛ hu, ni ekɛ wɔ anyiɛ ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nitsumɔ ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ anunyam, ni akɛtsɔ̃ɔ he tsui ni wɔyɔɔ; ejaakɛ wɔmiikwɛ jogbaŋŋ ni mɔ ko akawie wɔhe efɔŋ yɛ tsuijurɔ naa nikee ni wɔsɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he nɛɛ hewɔ; ejaakɛ oti ni wɔkɛma wɔhiɛ ji akɛ efee fɛo, jeee yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ hu.
Shi wɔtsu wɔnyɛmi lɛ hu wɔfata amɛhe, mɔ ni wɔka lɛ kpitiokpitio yɛ nibii pii amli, ni wɔna akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ, shi agbɛnɛ eebɔ mɔdɛŋ po fe tsutsu lɛ, yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ pii lɛ hewɔ.
Shi Tito lɛ, mihefatalɔ ni mikɛtsuɔ nyɛhe nii ji lɛ, ni wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ hu, asafoi lɛ abɔfoi kɛ Kristo hiɛnyam ji amɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛsuɔmɔ kɛ shwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ kpo nyɛtsɔa amɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ ahiɛ.
Nihãmɔ mli jɔɔmɔ Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni akɛyaasɔ̃mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ mile bɔ ni nyɛna he tsui ni mishwãa mifɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ mitsɔ̃ɔ Makedoniabii lɛ akɛ Akaiabii esaa amɛhe amɛto kɛjɛ nyɛsɛɛ afi lɛ beebe; ni nyɛmɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ ewo mɛi pii ahiɛdɔɔ.
Shi mitsu nyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni wɔshwãa ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ lɛ akafee yaka yɛ enɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛhe bɔ ni mikɛɛ lɛ; ni kɛ Makedoniabii lɛ kɛ mi ba lɛ, amɛkabanina nyɛ akɛ nyɛsako nyɛhe, ni wɔhiɛ, misumɔɔɔ akɛ makɛɛ akɛ nyɛ nyɛhiɛ bagboi yɛ wɔhiɛ ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ nyɛnɔ nɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ makpa nyɛmimɛi lɛ afai ni amɛtsɔ̃ mihiɛ kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ ni amɛbasaa nɛkɛ nyɛjɔɔmɔ ni awo shi momo nɛɛ amɛto koni efee klalo akɛ jɔɔmɔ nɔ ko shi jeee nɔ ko ni akɛ hiɛjoomɔ miishɔ̃ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
Shi enɛ mikɛɔ akɛ, mɔ ni lɛteɔ nii ahe duɔ lɛ, ekɛ helɛtemɔ hu aaakpa; ni mɔ ni duɔ yɛ jɔɔmɔ mli lɛ, jɔɔmɔ mli nɔŋŋ eeekpa yɛ.
Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã bɔ ni ekpɛ mli momo yɛ etsui mli, ni ekajɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli loo nɔnyɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ tsuijurɔnaa halɔ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ akɛ eeehã dromɔ fɛɛ atɛke nɔ ahã nyɛ, koni nyɛhe atua nyɛ kwraa yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli daa nɛɛ ni nyɛna nii kɛtɛke nɔ hã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa; tamɔ bɔ ni aŋma lɛ akɛ, “Egbɛɔ eshwãa ehãa ohiafoi lɛ; ejalɛ lɛ hiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ.” Shi mɔ ni kɛ dumɔwui keɔ dulɔ ni ekɛ aboloo hu hãa yeli lɛ, eeehã nyɛ dumɔwui ni afa, ni eeehã nyɛjalɛ yibii lɛ hu ashwere; ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni nyɛfee mlihilɔi kwraa, ni nyɛmlihilɛ lɛ ahã atsɔ wɔnɔ akɛ shidaa aha Nyɔŋmɔ; ejaakɛ nɛkɛ yelikɛbuamɔ nɛɛ he sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee fɛnemɔ kɛkɛ efɛneɔ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ yɛ fimɔ mli, shi moŋ ehãa adaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi babaoo kɛtɛkeɔ nɔ hu.
Ejaakɛ odase kpakpa ni nɛkɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ yeɔ lɛ hãa amɛwoɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ ye ni nyɛyeɔ Kristo Sanekpakpa ni nyɛjajeɔ lɛ nɔ, kɛ mlihilɛ ni nyɛkɛyeɔ nyɛbuaa amɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛbaasɔle amɛhã nyɛ, ni amɛbaashwe nyɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni yɔɔ nyɛnɔ kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Shi shidaa ahã Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ enikeenii ni anyɛŋ agba lɛ hewɔ!
Paulo miifã ebɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ he Shi mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ miikpa nyɛ fai yɛ Kristo hejɔlɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ lɛ hewɔ, mi ni akɛɛ kɛ miyɛ nyɛhiɛ lɛ mifeɔ mihe humi yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi kɛ mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mijeɔ ekãa miwoɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Shi miikpa nyɛ fai ni kɛ miba lɛ, nyɛkahã mikɛ hewalɛ ni mito akɛ mikɛbaawie lɛ miijie ekãa kpo mitsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni susuɔ akɛ wɔtamɔ mɛi ni nyiɛɔ heloo naa lɛ.
Eyɛ mli akɛ gbɔmɛi adesai ji wɔ moŋ, shi wɔwuuu ta yɛ heloo naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔtawuunii lɛ jeee heloo mli nii ni, shi moŋ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ, hewalɛnii ni akɛkumɔɔ mɔji ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni, ni wɔkumɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi kɛ he nɔ ni awoɔ ashiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nilee lɛ, ni wɔŋɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ fɛɛ jwɛŋmɔ nom ni ebo Kristo toi, ni wɔsaa wɔhe wɔto koni, kɛ nyɛtoiboo lɛ ye emuu lɛ, wɔgbala toigbele fɛɛ he toi.
Nyɛkwɛa nibii bɔ ni nyɛnaa amɛ lɛ.
Kɛ mɔ ko heɔ yeɔ akɛ Kristo nɔ ji lɛ lɛ, esusu he ekoŋŋ, ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eji Kristo nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu wɔji Kristo nii.
