Ejaakɛ kɛ shwãa po mashwã kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ wɔhegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã wɔ ni wɔkɛhã nyɛnane amɔ shi ni jeee akɛ wɔkɛbutu nyɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ gboŋ, koni mikafee akɛ mɔ ko ni woɔ nyɛhe gbeyei kɛ woji.
Ejaakɛ akɛɔ akɛ, woji lɛ amli saji tsii ni amɛmli wa moŋ, shi kɛ lɛ gbɔmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyɛ biɛ lɛ, no lɛ ehe waaa ni ewiemɔ he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Nakai gbɔmɔ lɛ ana ale enɛ akɛ, bɔ ni wɔwiemɔ yɔɔ yɛ woji amli kɛ wɔbɛ jɛi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ kɛ wɔyɛ jɛi lɛ wɔnifeemɔnii hu yɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ wɔkaaa akɛ wɔɔbu wɔhe wɔshi mɛi komɛi ni jieɔ amɛhe yi lɛ anɔ, aloo akɛ wɔkɛ wɔhe aaato amɛhe.
Amɛ lɛ, akɛni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe susuɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe ni amɛkɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe toɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe hewɔ lɛ, amɛyooo sɛɛ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔshwãŋ fe nine, shi moŋ wɔshwãa yɛ susumɔ kpãa ni Nyɔŋmɔ esusu ehã wɔ ni kɛlɛ shɛɔ nyɛ hu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ wɔkpãaa wɔmli tsɔ tamɔ mɛi ni shɛɛɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, ejaakɛ wɔ klɛŋklɛŋ wɔkɛ Kristo he Sanekpakpa lɛ shɛ nyɛŋɔɔ; wɔshwãaa fe nine yɛ mɛi krokomɛi anitsumɔi ahewɔ; shi wɔhiɛ kã nɔ akɛ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ shwere lɛ, wɔnitsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli baagbele kɛtɛke nɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ wɔsusumɔ kpãa lɛ naa, koni wɔyajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ nyɛsɛɛgbɛ niiaŋ, ni wɔkashwã wɔfɔ̃ nii ni atsu momo yɛ mɔ kroko nɔ mli lɛ anɔ.
Shi mɔ ni shwãa lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nɔ eshwã efɔ̃!
Ejaakɛ jeee mɔ ni jieɔ ehe yi lɛ ji mɔ ni sa, shi moŋ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jieɔ eyi lɛ.
Eba lɛ akɛ Paulo ajie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe yi Mina ni kulɛ nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mikwashiafeemɔ fioo!
Shi anɔkwale nyɛnaa nyɛhãa mi.
Ejaakɛ nyɛhe awuŋã ni miyeɔ lɛ, miiye lɛ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ baaye; ejaakɛ mitsɛ nyɛhe baa mihã nuu kome ni mikɛ oblayoo foro ni he tse ayahã Kristo.
Shi miishe gbeyei akɛ aleenɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni onufu lɛ kɛ ekutumpɔo lɛ laka Hawa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ aaafite nyɛ hu nyɛjwɛŋmɔ ni nyɛŋmɛɛ suɔmɔ krɔŋŋ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ Kristo lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko ba ni ebashiɛ Yesu kroko ni wɔshiɛko, loo mumɔ kroko ni nyɛnako, loo Sanekpakpa kroko ni nyɛmɔko mli lɛ, no lɛ nyɛhere lɛ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ misusuɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ.
Shi kɛ mi ji gbɔmɔ ko ni leee nɔ ko yɛ wiemɔ gbɛfaŋ tete lɛ, mijeee nakai yɛ nilee gbɛfaŋ; shi moŋ wɔfee enɛ faŋŋ wɔhã nyɛ, yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ, yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Aloo belɛ akɛ miba mihe shi koni awo nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ mijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yaka lɛ mifee esha?
Mitswa asafoi krokomɛi ojo mihe nyɔmɔwoo yɛ amɛdɛŋ mikɛsɔ̃mɔ nyɛ.
Ni be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ ni efi mi tete lɛ, mifeee jatsu mihãaa mɔ ko mɔ ko, ejaakɛ nii ni hia mi lɛ, nyɛmimɛi ni jɛ Makedonia ba lɛ hã shɛ midɛŋ, ni mile mihenɔkwɛmɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli, ni masaa male mihenɔkwɛmɔ, koni mikatsɔ̃ jatsu mihã nyɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni Kristo anɔkwale lɛ yɔɔ mimli nɛɛ, mɔ ko mɔ ko etsiŋ mishwãa nɛɛ gbɛ yɛ Akaia niiaŋ.
Mɛɛ hewɔŋ?
Akɛ misumɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛ hewɔŋ?
Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Nɔ ni mifeɔ lɛ, mafee, koni mikɛtsi mɛi ni taoɔ mihe sane lɛ agbɛ, ni ana amɛ yɛ amɛshwãanii lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni anaa wɔ hu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ ji amale bɔfoi, nitsulɔi shishiulɔi ni tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ Kristo bɔfoi.
Ni enɛ bɛ naakpɛɛ tete ejaakɛ Satan diɛŋtsɛ tsakeɔ ehe etsɔ̃ɔ la bɔfo; no hewɔ lɛ, kɛ esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu tsakeɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ tamɔ jalɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ, ejeee nɔ ko wulu ko; amɛnaagbee baafee tamɔ bɔ ni amɛnitsumɔi lɛ yɔɔ lɛ.
Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ mɔ ko akabu mi kwashia, shi kɛjeee nakai lɛ, belɛ nyɛŋɔa mi akɛ kwashia kɛkɛ mɔ, koni mi hu mawo shwãa fioo ko.
Nɔ ni miwieɔ nɛɛ, miwieee lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baawie, shi moŋ tamɔ kwashia wieɔ, yɛ nɔmimaa ni miyɔɔ akɛ miyɛ shwãa nɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Akɛni mɛi pii shwãa yɛ heloo naa hewɔ lɛ, mi hu mashwã eko.
Akɛni nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ nilelɔi ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ toɔ nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi ni bɛ yitseiaŋ; ejaakɛ kɛ mɔ ko miiye nyɛ nyɔŋ, kɛ mɔ ko miitswa nyɛ ojo, kɛ mɔ ko miimɔ nyɛ, kɛ mɔ ko miiwó ehe nɔ yɛ nyɛnɔ, kɛ mɔ ko miigbala nyɛhiɛ ma lɛ, nyɛkpɛlɛ̃ɔ lɛ.
Miiwie kɛ hiɛgbele akɛ etamɔ nɔ ni wɔfee gbedee tsɔ̃.
Shi nɔ mli ni mɔ ko feɔ ekãa yɛ lɛ, miiwie tamɔ kwashia, mi hu mifeɔ ekãa yɛ mli.
Hebribii ji amɛ?
Mi hu eko ji mi.
Israelbii ni?
Mi hu eko ji mi.
Abraham shwiei ni?
Mi hu eko ji mi.
Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔi ji amɛ?
Miiwie tamɔ mɔ ni yitsoŋ kãa lɛ.
Mife amɛ yɛ tɔlɛ nitsumɔi ni tɛke nɔ amli, yɛ tsuŋwoi babaoi amli, yɛ yii ni fa tsɔ̃ amli, yɛ gbelei amli kpitiokpitio.
Yudafoi yi mi shii enumɔ, eko fɛɛ eko lɛ, shwɛ ekome ni afee kpãi nyɔŋmai ejwɛ.
Atswia mi kpãi shii etɛ̃, atswia mi tɛi shi kome, mikɛ lɛlɛ sha shi shii etɛ̃.
Miye jenamɔ kɛ jetsɛremɔ yɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli.
Mifã gbɛ kpitiokpitio kɛ emli osharãi yɛ fai ahiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ ojotswalɔi adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ mijakubii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii adɛŋ, emli osharãi yɛ maŋ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋa nɔ, emli osharãi yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ, emli osharãi yɛ nyɛmimɛi shiwodudui lɛ ateŋ.
Mitsu nii kɛ tɔlɛ, yɛ kpeshii amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ hɔ̃mɔ kɛ kumai mli, yɛ ŋmaahilɛi amli kpitiokpitio, yɛ fɛ̃i kɛ yayainyiɛmɔ mli.
Nibii ni yɔɔ sɛɛ ayakã; shi nɔ ni haoɔ mi daa gbi ji asafoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe susumɔ.
Namɔ gbedeɔ, ni mi lɛ migbedeee?
Namɔ nane atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ, ni mimli eshãaa mi?
Kɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ mashwã kɛ̃lɛ, mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedemɔnii anɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ, mɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ, le akɛ mimaleee.
Yɛ Damasko lɛ, lumɔ ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛ Areta shishi lɛ hã bulɔi bu Damaskobii amaŋ lɛ he ni amɔ mi, ni ashiu mi yɛ kafu mli kɛtsɔ̃ samflɛ ni yɔɔ gbogbo lɛ mli kɛyi shi, ni mijo foi yɛ edɛŋ.
Nii ni ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ Paulo Shwãa he ehĩa moŋ, shi ehĩii hãaa mi, kɛ̃lɛ mibawie ninai kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpojiemɔi ahe.
Mile gbɔmɔ ko yɛ Kristo mli.
Afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ nɛ lɛ, ashá nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ; ashá lɛ ni eyɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; ebɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Ni mile nɛkɛ gbɔmɔ nɛɛ akɛ ashá lɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, jeee yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli jio, mileee; Nyɔŋmɔ le.
Shi akɛ asha lɛ kɛtee Paradeiso ni eyanu wiemɔi ni anyɛŋ awie, ni gbɔmɔ ko bɛ hegbɛ akɛ etsĩɔ tã lɛ, no lɛ mile.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ hewɔ mashwã, shi mishwãŋ mihãŋ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe, akɛ ja yɛ migbedemɔi lɛ ahe.
Ejaakɛ kɛji miitao mashwã lɛ, mifeŋ kwashia, ejaakɛ anɔkwale mawie; shi mikuɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ɔ nɔ, koni mɔ ko akabu mi fe bɔ ni enaa mi aloo enuɔ yɛ minaa lɛ.
Shi bɔ ni afee ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu ko yɛ kpojiemɔi lɛ adaramɔ ni amɛdara kɛtɛke nɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ahã mi ŋmei ko yɛ miheloo mli, ni ji Satan bɔfo, koni egbala mi mai, ni mikawo mihe nɔ tuutu.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mikpa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fai shii etɛ̃ sɔŋŋ koni eje minɔ; ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Miduromɔ lɛ fa hã bo, ejaakɛ mihewalɛ lɛ, gbedeefeemɔ mli eyeɔ emuu yɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, misumɔɔ titri akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ migbedeefeemɔi lɛ anɔ moŋ, koni Kristo hewalɛ lɛ abu mihe.
No hewɔ lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ, mimii shɛɔ yɛ gbedeefeemɔi amli, yɛ hiɛnaanɔniinamɔi amli, yɛ fimɔ̃i amli, yɛ yiwaa mli, yɛ jaramɔ mli; ejaakɛ kɛ mifee gbedee lɛ, no minaa hewalɛ.
Paulo wie asafo lɛ hiɛ Mifee kwashia; nyɛ nyɛnyɛ minɔ ni mifee nakai.
Ejaakɛ kulɛ esa akɛ nyɛ moŋ nyɛjieɔ miyi; ejaakɛ kɛji mijeee nɔ ko tete po, eshwɛɛɛ mi nɔ ko ni mikɛ bɔfoi agboi lɛ aye hegbɔ.
Okadii ni tsɔ̃ɔ bɔfo nitsumɔ lɛ afee yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ mli, yɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛ nitsumɔi amli.
Ejaakɛ mɛni mli nyɛkpeɔ sɛɛ yɛ fe asafoi krokomɛi lɛ, fe akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ lɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ?
Nyɛkɛ nɛkɛ tɔ̃mɔ nɛɛ afaa mi!
Paulo fã ehe Naa, enɛ ji shii etɛ̃ ni misaa mihe akɛ maba nyɛŋɔɔ, shi mikɛ mihe ebafɔŋ nyɛnɔ, ejaakɛ jeee nyɛnii lɛ mitaoɔ, shi moŋ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ.
Ejaakɛ esaaa akɛ bii tiaa nii toɔ amɛfɔlɔi, shi moŋ fɔlɔi ni tiaa nii toɔ amɛbii.
Shi masumɔ babaoo akɛ mafite nii ni miyɔɔ lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni asaŋ mikɛ mihe ashã afɔle yɛ nyɛsusumai ahewɔ.
Ani esa akɛ bɔ ni suɔmɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛhã nyɛ lɛ faa lɛ, nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ nɔ agbɔ lo?
Nyɛaakɛɛ akɛ, eyɛ mli akɛ mikãaa nyɛnɔ nɛ; shi akɛni ŋaalɔ ji mi hewɔ lɛ, mimɔ nyɛ yɛ ŋaa mli.
Ani mitsɔ̃ mɛi ni mitsu nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ eko nɔ miye nyɛ amim lo?
Mikpa Tito fai ni mitsu lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi ko; ani Tito baye nyɛ amim ko?
Ani jeee nakai mumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ wɔkɛnyiɛ?
Jeee nakai najiamaamɔhei lɛ amli nɔŋŋ wɔnyiɛ?
Kɔkɔbɔɔ Asaŋ nyɛsusuɔ akɛ wɔnaa sɔŋŋ wɔjieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ lo?
Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ wɔwieɔ yɛ, yɛ Kristo mli; shi, suɔmɔmɛi, nii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, nyɛnaneshimɔmɔ hewɔ wɔwieɔ.
Ejaakɛ miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ kɛ miba lɛ, mibanaŋ nyɛ bɔ ni misumɔɔ, ni nyɛ hu nyɛnaŋ mi bɔ ni nyɛsumɔɔ; bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, pɛsɛŋkuminya, oshekuyeli, mɔhewiemɔ, hefaa, sakasakafeemɔ; ni misaa miishe gbeyei akɛ kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ, miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaaba mi shi yɛ nyɛhiɛ, ni maye ŋkɔmɔ mahã mɛi ni efee esha sa ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui lɛ ateŋ mɛi pii, yɛ amɛmujinii kɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋaawoo Nyɛŋɔɔ ni mibaa nɛɛ ji nɔ ni ji shii etɛ̃.
Odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ adaaŋ wiemɔ naa lɛ sane fɛɛ sane ama shi.
Mɛi ni efee esha sa lɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ, mikɛɛ amɛ mito momo, ni asaŋ miikɛɛ amɛ mato be mli ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ akɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ be ni miba nyɛŋɔɔ nɔ ni ji shi enyɔ lɛ, kɛ miba ekoŋŋ lɛ mikɛ amɛhe ekeŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛmiitao naakpɛɛ okadi ko ni nyɛkɛaana akɛ Kristo wieɔ yɛ mimli, Kristo mɔ ni gbedeee yɛ nyɛmli, shi moŋ ehe waa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ asɛŋ lɛ yɛ gbedemɔ mli, shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa lɛ, ehiɛ kã; ni wɔ hu wɔgbedeɔ yɛ emli; shi Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ lɛ naa lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ hiɛ aaakãmɔ ahã nyɛ.
Nyɛkaa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe nyɛkwɛa akɛ nyɛyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lo?
Nyɛtaoa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmli nyɛkwɛa.
Aloo nyɛleee yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛhe akɛ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛmli?
Kɛ nyɛleee nakai lɛ, mɛi ni esaaa kwraa ji nyɛ.
Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ nyɛaale akɛ wɔ lɛ wɔjeee mɛi ni esaaa.
Shi miikpa Nyɔŋmɔ fai, koni nyɛkafee nɔ ko fɔŋ ko kwraa, jeee koni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni sa hewɔŋ, shi moŋ koni nyɛ lɛ nyɛfee ekpakpa, ni wɔ lɛ wɔfee tamɔ mɛi ni esaaa.
Ejaakɛ wɔnyɛŋ nɔ ko wɔfee wɔshi anɔkwale lɛ, shi moŋ kɛ nɔ ko wɔɔfee lɛ, wɔɔfee wɔhã anɔkwale lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔnaa miishɛɛ kɛ wɔfee gbedee ni nyɛ lɛ nyɛyɛ hewalɛ lɛ; shi nɔ he fai ni wɔkpaa ji nyɛ emuuyeli.
No hewɔ hu ni miŋmaa enɛ be ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ, koni kɛ miba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, mikɛ nyɛ akaye waa, yɛ hegbɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ehã mi ni mikɛsaa shi jeee ni mikɛfite lɛ naa.
Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa, nyɛyea emuu, nyɛshɛjea nyɛhe mii, nyɛjwɛŋmɔ afea ekome, nyɛhĩa shi yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, ni suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Nyɛŋaŋaa nyɛhe kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ miibi nyɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ lɛ Kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ naanyobɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Be ni abɔ̃i Yesu he Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ yɛ mɛi ni jeee Yudafoi ji amɛ lɛ ateŋ ni amɛhere lɛ atuu lɛ, sanebimɔ kome ni bate shi ji akɛ, aso esa akɛ mɔ ko aye Mose Mla lɛ nɔ dani etsɔ̃ anɔkwa Kristofonyo lo?
Paulo etsɔ̃ɔ naa momo akɛ enɛ he ehĩaaa kwraa.
Anɔkwale moŋ ni yɔɔ mli ji akɛ nɔ kometoo pɛ nɔ mɔ ko baanyɛ edamɔ ni ekɛɛ akɛ eyɛ wala yɛ Kristo mli, no ji hemɔkɛyeli; no nɔ pɛ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ.
Emli tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ji akɛ, mɛi komɛi ejɛ asafoi ni yɔɔ Galatia ni ji Romabii ashikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ Asia Fio lɛ mli, amɛba amɛbate shi amɛshi Paulo ni amɛmiifi nɔ veveeve akɛ ja mɔ oye Mose Mla lɛ hu nɔ dani Nyɔŋmɔ aaanyɛ ahere oyiwala.
Nɔ krɛdɛɛ hewɔ ni Paulo ŋma wolo nɛɛ eyahã Galatiabii lɛ ji akɛ eetao ehã mɛi ni alakaa amɛ ni atɔ̃tɔ̃ɔ amɛnane kɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔi lɛ aku amɛsɛɛ amɛba anɔkwa hemɔkɛyeli kɛ jamɔ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ.
Paulo kɛ ehefãmɔ je shishi etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ hewalɛ tuuŋtu ni eyɔɔ akɛ atsɛ lɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ.
Egba mli kpoo kɛ nɔmimaa akɛ tsɛ́ ni atsɛ́ lɛ ni ebashiɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko hewalɛ mli, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ ejɛ, ni ekɛshi sɛɛ akɛ mɛi ahewɔ krɛdɛɛ ni atsɛ lɛ lɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ etee nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ pɛ atsɔ̃ɔ ajieɔ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɛ kpo faŋŋ.
Naagbee lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Kristofoi ajeŋba kɛ suɔmɔ ni jɛɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ ejɛɔ ebaa tswaa.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Hewalɛ ni Paulo yɔɔ akɛ Kristo bɔfo lɛ .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he Sanekpakpa .—.
Kristofonyo heyeli kɛ egbɛnaa .—.
Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Mi Paulo ni mi ji bɔfo ni mibɔfonitsumɔ lɛ jɛɛɛ gbɔmɛi adɛŋ, ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko nɔ hu etsɔ̃, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ nɔ etsɔ̃ lɛ, kɛ nyɛmimɛi ni mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ ŋma wolo nɛɛ yahã Galatia asafoi lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ ahã nyɛ; Yesu Kristo ni kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ, koni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ jeŋ fɔ̃ŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ nɛɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ suɔmɔ naa lɛ.
Enɔ ji anunyam lɛ kɛjɛ naanɔ kɛyashiɔ naanɔ lɛ.
Amen!
Sanekpakpa kroko bɛ Efee mihiɛ yaa akɛ amrɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ nyɛmiitsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ mɔ ni tsɛ nyɛ yɛ Kristo dromɔ mli lɛ he kɛya Sanekpakpa kroko he; shi jeee Sanekpakpa kroko ni, fe akɛ mɛi komɛi ni yɔɔ ni hãa nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futuɔ, ni amɛtaoɔ akɛ amɛtsɔ̃ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛ amɛbu shi.
Shi kɛji wɔ po aloo bɔfo ni jɛ ŋwɛi tete bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, yɛ nɔ ni wɔjaje wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!
Tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ momo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ mikɛɔ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko bajaje Sanekpakpa kroko etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ nɔ ni nyɛmɔ mli nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ebɔ musu!” Ejaakɛ be nɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ahiɛ gbɛ mitaoɔ loo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ gbɛ?
Aloo miitao gbɔmɛi ahiɛ masa?
Ejaakɛ kɛ mikã he miitao masa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, jeee Kristo tsulɔ ji mi.
Bɔ ni fee ni Paulo tsɔ̃ bɔfo Shi miihã nyɛle, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ Sanekpakpa ni mijaje lɛ, ejɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ dɛŋ; ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɔ ko dɛŋ mina kɛjɛ, ni jeee tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hu atsɔ̃ɔ mi, shi moŋ Yesu Kristo kpojiemɔ naa mina yɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛnu misa jeŋba lɛ he yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli.
Bɔ ni miwa Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ yi fe nine ni mibɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ makpãtã ehiɛ; ni mitee hiɛ yɛ Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ mli fe mitipɛŋfoi pii yɛ mijakubii ateŋ, ni mihiɛ dɔ naakpa yɛ wɔtsɛmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni akɛhã wɔ lɛ he.
Shi be ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni jie mi eto kɛjɛ minyɛ musuŋ beebe ni ekɛ edromɔ lɛ tsɛ mi kɛba lɛ hiɛ, akɛ eeejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ mi, koni mijaje ehe Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, amrɔ lɛ mibiii gbɔmɔ ko ŋaawoo yɛ he, ni misaa miyaaa Yerusalɛm hu yɛ mɛi ni ji bɔfoi dani mi hu mitsɔ̃ bɔfo lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi moŋ miyiŋ kɛtee Arabia ni misaa miku misɛɛ kɛba Damasko ekoŋŋ.
Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii etɛ̃ lɛ, mitee Yerusalɛm ni mayale Kefa, ni mihi eŋɔɔ gbii nyɔŋma kɛ enumɔ; shi minaaa bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ mɔ kroko akɛ ja Yakobo, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛmi lɛ.
Shi nii ni miŋmaa nyɛ nɛɛ, naa, Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ mikɛɔ yɛ akɛ mimaleee.
No sɛɛ lɛ, miba Siria kɛ Kilikia niiaŋ.
Shi aleee mihiɛ yɛ Yudea asafoi ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ amli; shi amɛnuɔ kɛkɛ akɛ akɛɔ akɛ, “Mɔ ni be ko mli ni ewa wɔ yi lɛ, agbɛnɛ eejaje hemɔkɛyeli ni tsutsu lɛ ebɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ ekpãtã hiɛ lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ eetsɔ̃ɔ.” Ni amɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyam yɛ mihewɔ.
Bɔfoi krokomɛi lɛ ŋɔ Paulo akɛ bɔfo Kɛkɛ lɛ no sɛɛ afii nyɔŋma kɛ ejwɛ lɛ misaa mikɛ Barnaba tee Yerusalɛm, ni miŋɔ Tito hu mifata mihe.
Shi mitee yɛ kpojiemɔ ko naa, ni mikɛ Sanekpakpa ni mishiɛɔ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ yaŋmɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ gbɛi lɛ sɔŋŋ ahiɛ bɔ ni afee ni foi ni midaa aloo ni mida lɛ akafee yaka.
Shi Tito tete ni kɛ mi yɔɔ ni eji Helanyo lɛ, anyɛɛɛ enɔ akɛ efo ketia.
Mɛi ni wo ketiafoo sane nɔ ji amale nyɛmimɛi komɛi ni ju shi kɛbafutu wɔ, ni amɛba nigii koni amɛbasara wɔhe ni wɔye yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, koni amɛye wɔ nyɔŋ; shi wɔkpɛ̃lɛɛɛ ni wɔbo amɛ toi ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome po tete, koni Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ ahi shi daa ahã nyɛ.
Shi mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ amɛyɔɔ gbɛi lɛ, bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ sa lɛ, jeee mihe sane ko ni, Nyɔŋmɔ kwɛɛɛ gbɔmɔ hiɛ ehalaaa lɛ, mɛi ni abuɔ amɛ lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔɔ mi nɔ ko amɛfataaa he; shi moŋ be ni amɛna akɛ atu foolɔi ateŋ Sanekpakpa lɛ jajemɔ lɛ awo midɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni atu ketiafolɔi anɔ lɛ awo Petro dɛŋ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsu nii yɛ Petro mli ni ehã eye bɔfo yɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ etsu nii yɛ mi hu mimli yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ lɛ, be ni amɛyoo dromɔ ni akɛhã mi lɛ, Yakobo kɛ Kefa kɛ Yohane ni abuɔ amɛ akɛ akulashiŋi lɛ, amɛkɛ naanyobɔɔ ninejurɔ lɛ ta mi kɛ Barnaba dɛ̃, koni wɔ lɛ wɔya jeŋmaji lɛ aŋɔɔ, shi amɛ lɛ amɛya ketiafolɔi lɛ aŋɔɔ; shi ohiafoi kɛkɛ amɛkɛɛ wɔkai, ni no nɔŋŋ he mɔdɛŋ mibɔ akɛ mafee.
Shi be ni Kefa ba Antiokia lɛ midamɔ ehiɛ miku enaa, ejaakɛ eye sane ni ejaaa.
Ejaakɛ dani mɛi komɛi aaajɛ Yakobo ŋɔɔ aba lɛ, ekɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ yeɔ nii; shi be ni amɛba lɛ, egbala ehe shi ni etse ehe, ejaakɛ eeshe mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni Yudafoi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu kɛ lɛ fee nakai osato lɛ, ni amɛsatofeemɔ lɛ gbala Barnaba kɛtee amɛgbɛfaŋ.
Shi be ni mina akɛ amɛnyiɛɛɛ trɔmɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale lɛ naa lɛ, mikɛɛ Kefa yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛhiɛ akɛ, “Kɛ bo ni oji Yudanyo lɛ ohiɔ shi tamɔ jeŋmajiaŋnyo ni jeee tamɔ Yudafonyo lɛ, mɛɛba onyɛɔ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhi shi tamɔ Yudafoi?” Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii fɛɛ lɛ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ ahereɔ amɛyiwala Afɔ wɔ Yudafoi akɛ ni wɔjeee eshafeelɔi ni jɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli, shi akɛni wɔle akɛ abuuu gbɔmɔ bem kɛjɛɛɛ Mla nitsumɔi amli, akɛ ja atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ kɛkɛ lɛ, wɔ hu wɔhe Kristo Yesu nɔ wɔye, koni abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni jeee Mla nitsumɔi amli, ejaakɛ abuŋ gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko bem kɛjɛŋ Mla nitsumɔi amli.
Shi agbɛnɛ kɛji wɔ ni wɔtaoɔ akɛ abu wɔ bem yɛ Kristo mli lɛ ana wɔ akɛ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu eshafeelɔi ji wɔ lɛ, belɛ Kristo ji esha sɔ̃ɔlɔ lo?
Dabida!
Ejaakɛ kɛ nii ni mikumɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ mimaa ekoŋŋ lɛ, belɛ mikɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mihe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nɔtɔ̃lɔ.
Ejaakɛ mi lɛ mitsɔ̃ Mla lɛ nɔ migbo yɛ Mla lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni mihiɛ akã ahã Nyɔŋmɔ.
Asɛŋ mi kɛ Kristo; hewɔ lɛ jeee mi mihiɛ kã dɔŋŋ, shi Kristo ni hiɛ kã yɛ mimli; shi mihiɛ ni kã yɛ heloo mli agbɛnɛ nɛɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ni sumɔ mi ni ekɛ ehe hã yɛ mihewɔ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli mli mihiɛ kã yɛ.
Mikwaaa Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ Mla nɔ jalɛ tsɔ̃ kɛba lɛ, belɛ Kristo lɛ yakatswaa egbo lɛ.
Mla loo hemɔkɛyeli O Galatiabii ni bɛ yitsoŋ!
Namɔ kpɛ nyɛ ayɛ, nyɛ ni atɛŋ Yesu Kristo yɛ nyɛhiɛ akɛ mɔ ni asɛŋ lɛ lɛ?
Enɛ kɛkɛ mitaoɔ male yɛ nyɛnaa: Mumɔ lɛ ni nyɛna lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi amli nyɛna kɛjɛ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛ bo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi mli?
Aso nɛkɛ nyɛbɛ yitsoŋ?
Ni nyɛkɛ mumɔ bɔ̃i lɛ, agbɛnɛ heloo nyɛkɛbaagbe naa lo?
Nɔ babaoo ni nyɛna nɛɛ, yakatswaa nyɛna lo (kɛ eyɛ mli akɛ yakatswaa nyɛna lɛ)?
Belɛ mɔ ni kɛ Mumɔ lɛ hãa nyɛ ni etsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, Mla nitsumɔi ahewɔ efeɔ, aloo hemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛkɛboɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ hewɔ ni?
Tamɔ bɔ ni Abraham he Nyɔŋmɔ eye, ni abu enɛ jalɛ ahã lɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛnaa nyɛlea akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, amɛ ji Abrahambii.
Shi akɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ ena momo akɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli Nyɔŋmɔ aaabu jeŋmaji lɛ abem yɛ hewɔ lɛ, ejaje Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ Abraham eto akɛ, “Omli aaajɔɔ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ yɛ.” Belɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, ajɔɔ amɛ kɛ Abraham heyelɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi abɔ ni kɛ amɛhe fɔ̃ɔ Mla nitsumɔi anɔ lɛ, loomɔ kã amɛnɔ; ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eyaaa nɔ efeee nii fɛɛ ni aŋma yɛ Mla Wolo lɛ mli lɛ.” Shi eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla mli lɛ abuŋ mɔ ko mɔ ko bem yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ejaakɛ “jalɔ lɛ, hemɔkɛyeli mli eyi aaana wala yɛ;” shi Mla lɛ, jeee hemɔkɛyeli sane ni, shi moŋ “Mɔ ni yeɔ nɔ lɛ yi aaana wala yɛ mli.” Kristo kpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ Mla lɛ loomɔ lɛ mli, akɛni etsɔ̃ loomɔ ehã wɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “Alomɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsotsoro tso nɔ lɛ;” koni Abraham jɔɔmɔ lɛ aba jeŋmaji lɛ anɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli, ni wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli ana Mumɔ ni awo he shi lɛ.
Mla lɛ kɛ shiwoo lɛ Anyɛmimɛi, miiwie lɛ gbɔmɛiaŋ: gbɔmɔ kpãŋmɔ tete, kɛji akpɛlɛ̃ nɔ lɛ, mɔ ko kwaaa, ni asaŋ mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fataaa he.
Shi Abraham lɛ, akɛ lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ wie shiwoo wiemɔi lɛ.
Ekɛɛɛ akɛ, “kɛ oshwiei lɛ” tamɔ nɔ ni ekɛ mɛi pii miiwie, shi moŋ tamɔ mɔ kome akɛ, “kɛ oshwie lɛ”, mɔ ni ji Kristo lɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ ji akɛ Mla ni awo yɛ afii ohai ejwɛ kɛ nyɔŋmai etɛ̃ sɛɛ lɛ eguuu kpãŋmɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ema nɔ aduatsɔ eto lɛ ni ehã shiwoo lɛ afee yaka.
Shi kɛ gboshinii lɛ jɛ Mla lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ jeee shiwoo lɛ mli ejɛ dɔŋŋ; shi Abraham lɛ, shiwoo nɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛke lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ mɛɛ ji Mla lɛ mɔ?
Akɛhã ni akɛna nɔtɔmɔi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni shwie ni awo lɛ shi lɛ aaaba; ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi anɔ atsɔ̃ awo Mla lɛ, ni akɛwo mlidaamɔlɔ dɛŋ.
Shi mlidaamɔlɔ sane lɛ, ejeee mɔ kome nɔ, shi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ kome ji lɛ.
Agbɛnɛ Mla lɛ shiɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoi lɛ lo?
Dabida!
Ejaakɛ eji awo mla ko ni aaanyɛ wala ahã kulɛ, anɔkwale mli lɛ wɔbembuu baajɛ mla nɔyeli mli.
Shi moŋ; ŋmalɛ lɛ eŋa nibii fɛɛ yi ewo esha shishi, koni atsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ akɛ shiwoo lɛ ahã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ehã wɔye wɔhe Shi dani hemɔkɛyeli lɛ ba lɛ, aŋa wɔyi tamɔ gboklɛfoi awo Mla shishi kɛyashi hemɔkɛyeli ni abaajie kpo lɛ aaaba.
No hewɔ lɛ, Mla lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔtsɔselɔ kɛmiiya Kristo ŋɔɔ koni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ abu wɔ bem.
Shi ni hemɔkɛyeli ba nɛɛ, wɔbɛ tsɔselɔ lɛ shishi dɔŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ bii ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ nɔ; ejaakɛ nyɛ mɛi abɔ ni abaptisi nyɛ awo Kristo mli lɛ, nyɛwo Kristo.
Yudanyo bɛ lɛ, Helanyo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nyɔŋ bɛ lɛ, odehe hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; nuu bɛ lɛ, yoo hu bɛ dɔŋŋ: ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mɔ kome ji nyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
Shi kɛji Kristo nii ji nyɛ lɛ, belɛ Abraham shwiei ji nyɛ, kɛ gboshiniiyelɔi hu yɛ shiwoo lɛ naa.
Shi miikɛɛ akɛ, gbii abɔ fɛɛ ni gboshiniiyelɔ lɛ ji abifao lɛ, srɔto ko bɛ ekɛ nyɔŋ teŋ, tsɛbelɛ lɛ ji nii lɛ fɛɛ tsɛ; shi moŋ eyɛ nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsuji nukpai ashishi kɛyashi beyinɔ ni tsɛ lɛ eto lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ wɔ hu, be ni wɔji abifabii lɛ, akɛ wɔ wo je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anyɔŋyeli lɛ shishi.
Shi be ni be lɛ shɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eBi lɛ kɛba, yoo fɔ lɛ, eba Mla shishi; koni ebakpɔ̃ mɛi ni yɔɔ Mla shishi lɛ, ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ bii.
Shi akɛni bii ji nyɛ hewɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ tsu eBi lɛ Mumɔ lɛ kɛba nyɛtsuii amli, ni eboɔ akɛ, “Aba, Ataa!” No hewɔ lɛ, ojeee nyɔŋ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ bi ji bo, ni kɛji bi ji bo lɛ, belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ efee bo niyelɔ hu.
Galatiabii asɛɛsɛɛyaa Shi be mli ni nyɛleee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, nyɛfee nyɛhe nyɔji nyɛhã nibii ni yɛ amɛbɔɔsu naa lɛ jeee nyɔŋmɔi ni lɛ; shi agbɛnɛ moŋ ni nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, aloo ni Nyɔŋmɔ ele nyɛ lɛ, te feɔ tɛŋŋ ni nyɛkuɔ nyɛsɛɛ kɛya shishijee nibii ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ nɔ ko afee ni bɛ hewalɛ ko lɛ aŋɔɔ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛje shishi nyɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ?
Nyɛyeɔ gbii kɛ nyɔji kɛ bei kɛ afii ahe gbɛjianɔ ni ato lɛ nɔ.
Miishe gbeyei akɛ ekolɛ yakatswaa migba mihe naa yɛ nyɛhe lɛ.
Miikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtamɔa mi, ejaakɛ mi hu mitamɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛfeko mi efɔŋ ko; shi nyɛle akɛ heloo gbedemɔ mli mijaje Sanekpakpa lɛ yɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ klɛŋklɛŋ be ni mijaje lɛ, ni nɔ ni ji naatsɔ̃ɔmɔ hã nyɛ yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛgbeee he guɔ ni asaŋ nyɛnyaŋeee; shi moŋ nyɛhere mi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfo, tamɔ Kristo Yesu diɛŋtsɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nɛgbɛ nyɛmiishɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ?
Ejaakɛ miiye nyɛhe odase akɛ ehiɔ feemɔ jikulɛ nyɛfamɔ nyɛhiŋmɛii tete nyɛhã mi.
Ani mitsɔ̃ nyɛhenyɛlɔ akɛ mikɛɔ nyɛ nɔ ni ji anɔkwale lɛ?
Jeee nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ kpakpa ko mɛi komɛi bɔɔ lɛ, amɛmiitao akɛ amɛtsi nyɛ wɔŋɔɔbaa gbɛ moŋ, koni nyɛbɔ amɛ moŋ amɛhe mɔdɛŋ.
Shi ehi akɛ abɔ nyɛhe mɔdɛŋ daa kɛji akɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa fee, ni jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Mibii bibii ni mikɔ̃mɔɔ kɛ nyɛfɔmɔ ekoŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaashɔ̃ Kristo subaŋ yɛ nyɛmli.
Mina ni kulɛ miyɛ nyɛmasɛi amrɔ nɛɛ ni mitsake gbɛ nɔ ni matsɔ̃ ni mikɛ nyɛ awie, ejaakɛ miyiŋ feɔ mi kɔshikɔshi yɛ nyɛhewɔ!
Mla lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ Nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ nyɛhi Mla shishi lɛ, nyɛkɛa mi, ani nyɛnuuu Mla lɛ lo?
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ Abraham yɛ bii enyɔ, mɔ kome lɛ, ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, ni mɔ kome hu ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ekɛ nyɔŋyoo lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa; shi mɔ ni ekɛ odehe lɛ fɔ lɛ, afɔ lɛ yɛ shiwoo naa.
Nibii nɛɛ abɛ ni.
Enɛɛmɛi ji kpãŋmɔi enyɔ lɛ.
Ekome lɛ jɛ Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋyeli mli efɔɔ ewoɔ: no ji Hagar; ejaakɛ Hagar ji Sinai Gɔŋ lɛ yɛ Arabia; shi ekɛ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ Yerusalɛm lɛ yaa, ejaakɛ ekɛ ebii lɛ ji nyɔji; shi ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ ji odehe lɛ, ni ji wɔnyɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ aŋma akɛ, “La nyamɔ lala, bo kene ni ofɔɔɔ; wo nyamɔ nɔ ni obolɔ kɛ miishɛɛ, bo ni okɔ̃mɔɔɔ; ejaakɛ mɔ ni bɛ mɔ ko lɛ moŋ bii fa fe mɔ ni yɔɔ wu lɛ po!” Agbɛnɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔ lɛ, shiwoo lɛ bii ji wɔ tamɔ Isak.
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni no be lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ heloo naa lɛ waa mɔ ni afɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ naa lɛ yi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ yɔɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ hu.
Shi mɛni ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ?
“Shwiemɔ nyɔŋyoo lɛ kɛ ebi lɛ; ejaakɛ nyɔŋyoo bi lɛ ekɛ odehe lɛ bi lɛ yeŋ gboshinii lɛ.” No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔjeee nyɔŋyoo lɛ bii, shi moŋ odehe lɛ bii.
Nyɛhiɛa nyɛheyeli lɛ mli Kristo ehã wɔye wɔhe, no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ, ni nyɛkahãa abɔa nyɛ nyɔŋyeli apã lɛ dɔŋŋ.
Naa, mi Paulo, miikɛɛ nyɛ akɛ, kɛji nyɛhã afolɔ nyɛ ketia lɛ, Kristo he baŋ sɛɛnamɔ haŋ nyɛ.
Shi misaa miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ni foɔ ketia lɛ akɛ ehiɛ nyɔmɔ, no ji akɛ eye Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.
Shi nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛtaoɔ akɛ abu nyɛ bem yɛ Mla mli lɛ, nyɛtse nyɛhe kɛjɛ Kristo he; nyɛjɛ dromɔ lɛ mli nyɛgbee shi.
Ejaakɛ wɔ lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔkɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɛɔ jalɛ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, jeee ketiafoo, ni asaŋ jeee foo hu ni nyɛɔ nɔ ko efeɔ, shi moŋ hemɔkɛyeli ni tsɔ̃ɔ suɔmɔ nɔ etsuɔ nii lɛ.
Kulɛ nyɛmiiya nɔ jogbaŋŋ; namɔ po tsi nyɛ gbɛ akɛ nyɛkabo anɔkwale lɛ toi?
Jwɛŋmɔ tsake mɔ nɛɛ, jeee mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ mli ejɛ.
Masha bibioo hãa ma sui lɛ fɛɛ shaa.
Mi lɛ mikɛ mihiɛ efɔ̃ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ ebaŋ lɛ akɛ nyɛaajwɛŋ jwɛŋmɔ kroko; shi mɔ ni haoɔ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ lɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ji lɛ, esɔ̃ abua eyiteŋ.
Shi mi lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, kɛji ketiafoo lɛ mishiɛɔ lolo lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni awaa mi yi lolo?
Nakai ni kulɛ, sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he pampi lɛ sɛɛ efo.
Ao mina ni kulɛ mɛi ni hãa nyɛgbugbãa lɛ folɔ amɛhenii tete po amɛshwie.
Heyeli mli shihilɛ kɛ Mumɔ naa nyiɛmɔ Ejaakɛ heyeli mli atsɛ nyɛ kɛba, anyɛmimɛi; shi nyɛheyeli lɛ kɛkɛ ni nyɛkahãa etsɔ̃a hegbɛ ehã heloo lɛ taomɔnii, shi moŋ nyɛtsɔa suɔmɔ nɔ nyɛsɔ̃mɔsɔ̃mɔa nyɛhe.
Ejaakɛ Mla muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔyeli yɛ wiemɔ kome nɛɛ mli akɛ, “Suɔmɔ onaanyo tamɔ bɔ ni osumɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe lɛ.” Shi kɛ nyɛkɔ̃mɔkɔ̃mɔɔ nyɛhe ni nyɛyeyeɔ nyɛhe lɛ, nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛkakpãtãa nyɛhe hiɛ.
Shi nɔ ni mikɛɔ ji, “Nyɛnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ naa, ni nyɛfeŋ heloo akɔnɔi lɛ anaa nii.” Ejaakɛ nii ni heloo lɛ taoɔ lɛ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ eyaaa, ni nii ni Mumɔ lɛ hu taoɔ lɛ kɛ heloo lɛ eyaaa; enɛɛmɛi kɛ amɛhe yeee, enɛ hewɔ lɛ nii ni nyɛsumɔɔ lɛ nyɛnyɛ̃ɛɛ nyɛfee.
Shi kɛ Mumɔ lɛ kpalaa nyɛ lɛ, no lɛ nyɛbɛ Mla lɛ shishi.
Shi heloo lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ: nomɛi ji ajwamãŋbɔɔ, mujinitsumɔ, nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, wɔŋjamɔ, suu, nyɛɛ, bei, awuŋayeli, mlilawoo, bei mumɔ, atuatsemɔ, mligbalamɔ, hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, dãatɔɔ, dãanumɔ mli basabasafeemɔ kɛ nii ni tamɔ enɛɛmɛi, nii ni miikɛɛ nyɛ mato, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ nyɛ momo lɛ, akɛ mɛi ni feɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lɛ, amɛnine shɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ nɔ.
Shi Mumɔ lɛ yibii ji suɔmɔ, miishɛɛ, hejɔlɛ, tsuishitoo, mlihilɛ, ejurɔfeemɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, kpoofeemɔ, henɔyeli.
Enɛɛmɛi lɛ mla ko eguuu.
Shi mɛi ni ji Kristo nii lɛ, amɛsɛŋ heloo lɛ kɛ ehiɛdɔɔnii kɛ ekɔnɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Kɛji wɔhiɛ kã yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔnyiɛa yɛ Mumɔ lɛ naa hu.
Wɔkatao yaka anunyam ni wɔwowoo wɔhe mlila ni wɔhiɛ kɔ̃ wɔnanemɛi anɔ.
Nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛterea nyɛjatsui lɛ Anyɛmimɛi, kɛji mɔ ko miitɔ̃ ni amɔ lɛ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛ ji mumɔŋ gbɔmɛi lɛ nyɛsaa nakai mɔ lɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ mlijɔlɛ mumɔ; ni ole ohe nɔ kwɛmɔ koni bo hu akaka bo.
Nyɛjatsui lɛ nyɛkpeekpea nyɛhe kɛterea, ni nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ nyɛaatsɔ nyɛye Kristo mla lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ kɛji efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ mɔ ko ji lɛ be mli ni ejeee mɔ ko lɛ eeshishiu ehe.
Shi mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aka lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enitsumɔ ekwɛ, ni no dani eeena nɔ ko yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli kɛkɛ ni eshwã efɔ̃ nɔ, ni jeee mɔ kroko nɔ́ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ aaatere lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ejatsu.
Shi mɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ekɛ etsɔ̃ɔlɔ lɛ aja nibii kpakpai fɛɛ ni eyɔɔ.
Nyɛkalakaa nyɛhe, Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aliii lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ pɛ ni gbɔmɔ duɔ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ ebaakpa.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo mli lɛ, eheloo lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa fitemɔ kɛjɛ; shi mɔ ni duɔ nii yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ, Mumɔ lɛ mli nɔŋŋ ebaakpa naanɔ wala kɛjɛ.
Shi nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa wɔ, ejaakɛ kɛ wɔnijiaŋ ejeee wui lɛ, wɔbaakpa hu yɛ be ni sa mli.
Belɛ be mli ni hegbɛ yɔɔ hã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔfea mɛi fɛɛ ejurɔ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni ji hemɔkɛyeli lɛ webii lɛ.
Naagbee kɔkɔbɔɔ kɛ ŋamɔ Nyɛkwɛa ni ŋmaa okadii adaramɔ ni mikɛŋma nyɛ wolo kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine!
Mɛi ni taoɔ akɛ amɛ hiɛ aba nyam yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ lɛ, amɛ, amɛnyɛɔ nyɛnɔ ni afolɔ nyɛ ketia, be ni afee kɛkɛ ni akawa amɛyi yɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ hewɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni afolɔ amɛ ketia lɛ diɛŋtsɛ tete yeee Mla lɛ nɔ; shi moŋ amɛmiitao akɛ afolɔ nyɛ ketia, koni amɛshwã amɛfɔ̃ nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nii nɛɛ nɔ.
Shi mi lɛ, akagbale mi fɔ̃ŋfɔ̃ akɛ mashwã mafɔ̃ nɔ ko nɔ akɛ ja wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni atsɔ̃ asɛŋ je lɛ ahã mi, ni mi hu asɛŋ mi ahã je lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ ketiafoo jeee nɔ ko, ni asaŋ foo hu jeee nɔ ko, shi moŋ nɔ ni ji nɔ ko ji bɔɔnɔ hee tsɔ̃mɔ.
Ni mɛi abɔ ni aaanyiɛ yɛ nɛkɛ jeŋba he mla nɛɛ naa lɛ, hejɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ aba amɛ kɛ “Nyɔŋmɔ Israel” lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ mɔ ko akagba minaa dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ mihiɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu pilamɔ okadii lɛ yɛ migbɔmɔtso lɛ he.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi, anyɛmimɛi.
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Oti kome ni ma Bɔfo Paulo hiɛ ni ekɛŋma Wolo eyahã Efesobii lɛ ji akɛ eetao etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ eto eyiŋ akɛ ebaaŋɔ adebɔɔ fɛɛ, no ji, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli .
Oti kroko hu ji akɛ Paulo miiba Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi fiaa kwa ni amɛhi shi yɛ nɛkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo kple nɛɛ naa bɔ ni afee ni kɛtsɔ̃ amɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ekomefeemɔ nɔ lɛ, gbɔmɛi adesai ni yɔɔ je lɛ mli fɛɛ afee ekome.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Paulo gbala ekomefeemɔ ni ewoɔ he ŋaa nɛɛ mli fitsofitso.
Etsɔ̃ɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ Tsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hala ehalamɔbii lɛ, bɔ ni kɛtsɔ̃ ebi Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, ekɛ amɛhe eshai afa amɛ ni ehã amɛye amɛhe, kɛ bɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ fo shi kple ni ewo wɔ lɛ yinɔbaa.
Enɛ sɛɛ lɛ eba emajemɔ wolo nɛɛ kanelɔi fɛɛ koni amɛba amɛjeŋ bɔ ni afee ni amɛ kɛ Yesu ekomefeemɔ lɛ aje kpo faŋŋ yɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛwala shihilɛ mli.
Paulo kɛ wiemɔi srɔtoisrɔtoi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ, kɛji Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɛi nyɛ fee ekome kɛhi shi lɛ, belɛ amɛ kɛ Kristo hu efee ekome.
Asafo lɛ tamɔ gbɔmɔtso ni Kristo ji eyitso, aloo etamɔ tsu ni Kristo ji ekoŋtɛ, aloo etamɔ ŋa ni Kristo ji ewu.
Nɛkɛ Wolo nɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ Bɔfo Paulo ji niŋmalɔ kpanaa, ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ yɛ Yesu Kristo mli ehã ena Nyɔŋmɔ yiŋtoo faŋŋ.
Enɛ hãa Kristo suɔmɔ, ehe afɔleshãa, eshaifãa kɛ dromɔ kɛ hetsemɔ feɔ faŋŋ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Kristo kɛ Asafo lɛ .—.
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli .—.
Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa lɛ ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ji heyelɔi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Nyɔŋmɔ yijiemɔ yɛ mumɔŋ dromɔ keenii ahewɔ Ajɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni kɛ mumɔŋ jɔɔmɔ ejɔɔ wɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ nɛɛ, lɛ ehala wɔ yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ emli dani ato jeŋ shishi, koni wɔfee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni wɔhe akahi kpa ko yɛ ehiɛ.
Ni ejɛ suɔmɔ mli ejie wɔ eto ni wɔtsɔ̃mɔ ebii yɛ Yesu Kristo hewɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ esuɔmɔ naa lɛ; koni akɛjie edromɔ ni ekɛduro wɔ yɛ mɔ ni esumɔɔ lɛ lɛ mli lɛ anunyam lɛ yi.
Lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ yɛ, ni ji nɔtɔmɔi afaa lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ elá lɛ nɔ, yɛ edromɔ falɛ lɛ naa.
Ehã dromɔ fa kɛteke nɔ ehã wɔ yɛ jwɛŋmɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ehã wɔle eyiŋtoo ni ji teemɔ sane lɛ ni ekpɛ mli eto bɔ ni sa ehiɛ yɛ Kristo mli.
Ebaahã egbɛjianɔtoo lɛ aba mli yɛ be ni sa lɛ mli, koni eŋɔ nibii fɛɛ eto yitso kome shishi yɛ Kristo mli, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ.
Lɛ emli wɔna gboshinii lɛ hu yɛ, wɔ mɛi ni ajie wɔ ato yɛ mɔ ni tsuɔ nibii fiaa lɛ gbɛjianɔtoo naa, yɛ eyiŋ ni eto bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esumɔɔ lɛ naa, bɔ ni afee ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔtsɔ̃ hiɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Kristo nɔ lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃mɔ enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ.
Lɛ emli akɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni awo he shi lɛ sɔo nyɛ hu nyɛnaa yɛ be ni nyɛnu anɔkwale lɛ wiemɔ lɛ ni ji yiwalaheremɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛhe nyɛye lɛ.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ji wɔgboshinii lɛ ayibaafoonɔ kɛyashi Nyɔŋmɔ aaakpɔ̃ mɛi ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enii lɛ hã enunyam lɛ yijiemɔ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ ni jeɔ kpo yɛ Kristo mli lɛ Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mi hu, be ni minu nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛyɔɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ he lɛ, mifɔ̃ɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shidaa, shi mikaiɔ nyɛ yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, koni wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni ji anunyam Tsɛ lɛ ahã nyɛ nilee kɛ kpojiemɔ mumɔ yɛ le ni nyɛaale lɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ mli.
Nyɛmligbɛ hiŋmɛii anɔ atse, koni nyɛna nyɛle nɔ ni ji hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni yɔɔ etsɛmɔ lɛ mli, kɛ egboshinii lɛ anunyam lɛ falɛ yɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi amli, kɛ nɔ ni ji ehewalɛ lɛ dalɛ ni tekeɔ nɔ babaoo hãa wɔ mɛi ni wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ lɛ yɛ enyɛmɔ hewalɛ nitsumɔ lɛ naa lɛ.
Hewalɛ nitsumɔ nɛɛ etsu yɛ Kristo mli, be ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ, ni ekɛ lɛ ta eninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ, yɛ onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔyeli fɛɛ kɛ gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi ni awo, jeee be nɛ be nɛɛ mli kɛkɛ, shi be ni baaba lɛ mli hu lɛ anɔ.
Ni ekɛ nibii fiaa ewo enajiaŋshi, ni ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yitso ehã asafo lɛ ni ji egbɔmɔtso lɛ kɛ lɛ mɔ ni ewoɔ mɛi fɛɛ obɔ̃ yɛ nii fɛɛ mli lɛ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ.
Kɛjɛ gbele mli kɛtee wala mli Nyɛ hu kulɛ gbohii ji nyɛ yɛ nyɛ nɔtɔmɔi kɛ nyɛhe eshai lɛ amli.
Ni nyɛnyiɛ yɛ mli sa yɛ no je nɛɛŋ su lɛ naa, yɛ lumɔ ni yɔɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli hewalɛ lɛ ni ji mumɔ ni tsuɔ nii amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ toigbele bii amli lɛ naa.
Amɛteŋ wɔ fɛɛ hu wɔhi wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ sa yɛ wɔheloo akɔnɔi lɛ amli, ni wɔtsu nii ni heloo kɛ jwɛŋmɔ sumɔɔ lɛ, ni wɔji bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu yɔɔ wɔnɔ yɛ wɔfɔmɔsu lɛ naa, tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni emɔbɔnalɛ fa babaoo lɛ, etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ babaoo ni ekɛsumɔ wɔ lɛ nɔ, ni wɔ ni kulɛ gbohii ji wɔ yɛ nɔtɔmɔi amli lɛ, etsiɛ wɔ kɛ Kristo fɛɛ hiɛ, dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala!
Ni etee wɔ kɛ lɛ shi, ni eŋɔ wɔ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ eta ŋwɛiniiaŋ yɛ lɛ Kristo Yesu lɛ mli.
Efee enɛ koni bei ni baaba lɛ amli lɛ ejie lɛ diɛŋtsɛ edromɔ falɛ ni teke nɔ lɛ kpo yɛ emli ni hi hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ dromɔ akɛhere nyɛyiwala kɛtsɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, ni enɛ lɛ, jeee nyɛmli ejɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ nɔkeenɔ ni, jeee nitsumɔi amli ejɛ koni mɔ ko akashwã.
Ejaakɛ enine naa nitsumɔnii ji wɔ, abɔ wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli ahã nitsumɔi kpakpai ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto koni wɔnyiɛ yɛ mli lɛ.
Kristo mli lɛ Yudafonyo kɛ jeŋmajiaŋnyo efee ekome No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkaia akɛ nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛ ji jeŋmajiaŋbii yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ ni mɛi ni atsɛɔ amɛ ketiafolɔi ni akɛ niji folɔ amɛ ketia yɛ heloo mli lɛ tsɛɔ nyɛ foolɔi lɛ, nyɛbɛ Kristo nakai be lɛ mli.
Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ yɛ Israel maŋ biyeli gbɛfaŋ kɛ gbɔi yɛ kpãŋmɔi ni damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo nɔ lɛ agbɛfaŋ hu, nyɛbɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko, ni nyɛbɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tete yɛ je nɛɛŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ, Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, nyɛ ni sa ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃ Kristo lá lɛ nɔ nyɛbɛŋkɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ ji wɔhejɔlɛ lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ kui enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ efee ekome, ni ekumɔ gbogbo afabaŋ ni yɔɔ teŋ ni ji nyɛɛ lɛ.
Ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo gu Mla lɛ kitãi kɛ akpɔi lɛ, koni ekɛ mɛi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ abɔ gbɔmɔ hee kome yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emli ni ehã hejɔlɛ aba, ni ekpãtã amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ nɔ, nɔ nɔ ni egbe nyɛɛ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Ni eba ebajaje hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ shɔŋŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ enɔ wɔyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔnaa gbɛ, yɛ Mumɔ kome mli, kɛyaa Tsɛ lɛ ŋɔɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ jeee gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji nyɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ananemɛi maŋbii kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ webii, ni atswa nyɛ ama bɔfoi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ shishitoo lɛ ni ekoŋtɛ ji Yesu Kristo lɛ nɔ.
Emli atswa tsu muu lɛ fɛɛ afee ekome yɛ, ni eeda eefee Sɔlemɔtsu krɔŋkrɔŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; ni emli atswaa nyɛ awoɔ afee Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe yɛ Mumɔ mli lɛ.
Paulo teemɔ sane lɛ bɔfo Enɛ hewɔ ni mi, Paulo, ni mi ji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo hã nyɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ, kɛji nyɛnu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ edromɔ ehã mi hã nyɛsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, kpojiemɔ nɔ etsɔ̃ ehã mile teemɔ sane lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni miŋma nyɛ fioo momo lɛ.
Kɛji nyɛkane lɛ, nyɛaanyɛ nyɛyoo akɛ mina Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ shishi.
Teemɔ sane nɛɛ, yinɔi ni eho lɛ mli lɛ ahãaa gbɔmɛiabii ale, tamɔ bɔ ni agbɛnɛ ajie kpo atsɔ̃ɔ ebɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
No ji akɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ hu niyelɔi lɛ ekomɛi kɛ gbɔmɔtso lɛ henii lɛ ekomɛi kɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ shi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ hu ekomɛi ji amɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Sanekpakpa lɛ nɔ.
No he sɔ̃ɔlɔ ji mi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ nikee nii ni atsɔ̃ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ nɔ akɛhã mi lɛ naa, mi ni mi ji bibioo fe hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, akɛ nɛkɛ dromɔ nɛɛ ehã mi, akɛ mijaje Kristo nifalɛ ni anyɛɛɛ shishi ana lɛ he Sanekpakpa lɛ mitsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ni mihã mɛi fɛɛ ana teemɔ sane lɛ he gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ faŋŋ, teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ yinɔi ni eho lɛ amli kɛbashi amrɔ nɛɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ ni bɔ nii fɛɛ lɛ mli lɛ, koni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ asafo lɛ nɔ ahã onukpai kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ hegbɛ yɛ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ ale Nyɔŋmɔ nilee ni jieɔ ehe kpo yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi pii anɔ lɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ fee nii nɛɛ yɛ enaanɔ yiŋ ni eto yɛ Kristo Yesu, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, mli lɛ naa.
Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ wɔtsɔ̃ ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ kɛ hewalɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai, ni nyɛnijiaŋ akaje wui yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ nyɛnunyam ni.
Kristo Suɔmɔ Enɛ hewɔ ni miyaa minakutsei anaa yɛ Tsɛ lɛ hiɛ, mɔ mli ni nɔ ni atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ “tsɛ” yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ fɛɛ jɛ lɛ.
Ni yɛ enunyam falɛ naa lɛ ehã nyɛtsɔ̃ eMumɔ lɛ nɔ nyɛhe awa kpiŋtiŋŋ yɛ nyɛmli gbɔmɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni atsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni Kristo ahi shi yɛ nyɛtsuii amli, ni nyɛshishifã amɔ shi ni nyɛma shi shiŋŋ yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Miisɔle ni nyɛna hewalɛ, ni nyɛkɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ ayoo Kristo suɔmɔ lɛ lɛɛmɔ kɛ ekɛlɛ kɛ enɔkwɔlɛ kɛ emlikwɔlɛ lɛ.
Ni nyɛle esuɔmɔ ni teke nilee fɛɛ lɛ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ obɔ̃yimɔ lɛ ayimɔ nyɛ fɛɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃.
Shi mɔ ni nyɛɔ efeɔ kɛtekeɔ nɔ babaoo fe nii fɛɛ ni wɔkpaa he fai loo wɔjwɛŋɔ, yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii yɛ wɔmli lɛ naa lɛ, lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã yɛ asafo lɛ mli kɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ yinɔi fɛɛ nɔ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ.
Amen!
Ekomefeemɔ yɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ mli No hewɔ lɛ, mi ni mi ji gboklɛfonyo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, miikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa tsɛmɔ ni akɛtsɛ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛnyiɛa kɛ heshibaa fɛɛ kɛ kpoofeemɔ fɛɛ kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ ni nyɛnanaa nyɛhã nyɛhe kɛ suɔmɔ.
Ni nyɛbɔa mɔdɛŋ ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ kpãa ni fiɔ nyɛ lɛ ato ekomefeemɔ ni jɛɔ Mumɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ lɛ.
Gbɔmɔtso kome kɛ Mumɔ kome yɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni hiɛnɔkãmɔ kome ji nɔ ni yɔɔ tsɛmɔ ni atsɛ nyɛ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nuŋtsɔ kome, hemɔkɛyeli kome, baptisimɔ kome, Nyɔŋmɔ kome, mɛi fɛɛ aTsɛ kome mɔ ni yɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli ni eyɔɔ mɛi fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Shi wɔteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, akɛ dromɔ lɛ ehã lɛ yɛ Kristo nikeenii asusumɔ lɛ naa.
No hewɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ, “Ekwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni eŋɔ nomi anom, ni ekɛ nikeenii hã gbɔmɛi.” Shi ni akɛɛ ekwɔ lɛ, te eshishiŋ, kɛjeee shi hu ekpeleke kɛtee shikpɔŋ lɛ shishiniiaŋ tsutsu lɛ?
Mɔ ni kpeleke shi lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ hu ji mɔ ni kwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛii fɛɛ ayiteŋ, koni eyi nii fiaa obɔ̃ lɛ.
Ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ehã mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃mɔ bɔfoi, mɛi komɛi lɛ gbalɔi, mɛi komɛi hu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔi, ni mɛi komɛi hu nɔkwɛlɔi kɛ tsɔɔlɔi.
Efee enɛ koni akɛsaa hetselɔi lɛ ahã sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ Kristo gbɔmɔtso lɛ tswaa, kɛyashi beyinɔ ni wɔ fɛɛ wɔɔshɛ ekomefeemɔ ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ ehe nilee mli lɛ he.
Ni wɔfee nuu ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo emuuyeli lɛ susumɔ naa; koni wɔkakã he wɔfee abifabii ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ hosoɔ amɛ tamɔ kɔɔyɔɔ hosoɔ nii, ni ekpalaa amɛ kɛyaa kɛbaa yɛ gbɔmɛi aŋaafɔŋtoo kɛ kutumpɔo ni akɛshishiuɔ mɛi lɛ naa.
Shi moŋ wɔfee anɔkwafoi yɛ suɔmɔ mli, ni wɔdara yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ tamɔ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ.
Lɛ emli gbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔ fɛɛ talɔ ni ahã lɛ lɛ nɔ emɔmɔɔ ehe eshimɔshimɔɔ ehe nɔ yɛ.
Ni ehe mɔɔ ehe, ni kɛ henɔ fɛɛ henɔ miitsu enii jogbaŋŋ lɛ, ehãa gbɔmɔtso lɛ daa, ni emaa ehe yɛ suɔmɔ mli.
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli No hewɔ lɛ, miikɛɛ ni miima nɔ mi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, akɛ nyɛkanyiɛ tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋbii lɛ nyiɛɔ yɛ amɛyaka jwɛŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ dɔŋŋ, ejaakɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli ewo duŋ.
Ni mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wala gbɛfaŋ, akɛni nilee ekaaa amɛ ni amɛtsui hu ekpliŋ lɛ.
Amɛbɛ henumɔnii dɔŋŋ hewɔ lɛ amɛŋɔ amɛhe amɛhã nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ, ni amɛkɛ hiɛjoomɔ tsuɔ nyaŋemɔ nii fɛɛ kwa.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, jeee nakai nyɛkase Kristo lɛ, kɛji eyɛ mli akɛ nyɛnu ehe, ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ nii yɛ emli hu, tamɔ bɔ ni ji anɔkwale yɛ Yesu mli lɛ, akɛ nyɛshɛ nɔ ni ji gbɔmɔ momo yɛ nyɛsa jeŋba lɛ naa gbɔmɔ ni efite yɛ shishiumɔ sɛɛdii lɛ anaa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃.
Ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi hei yɛ mumɔ ni nyɛkɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ, ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni abɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ subaŋ nɔ yɛ anɔkwa jalɛ kɛ hetsemɔ mli, tamɔ atade.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛshɛa amale nyɛfɔa ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ kɛ enaanyo awie anɔkwale, ejaakɛ gbɔmɔtso kome henii ji wɔ.
Nyɛmli afũa, shi nyɛkafea esha; hulu akanyɔ shi yɛ nyɛmlifu lɛ nɔ.
Asaŋ nyɛkaŋmɛa abonsam lɛ gbɛ.
Mɔ ni juɔ lɛ ekaju dɔŋŋ, shi ebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eniji atsu nitsumɔ kpakpa, koni ena nɔ ko ni ekɛhã mɔ ni ehia lɛ lɛ.
Wiemɔ sha ko wiemɔ sha ko akaje nyɛnaa kwraa; shi moŋ wiemɔ ni hi ni ehia koni ehã mɔ nane amɔ shi ni akɛduro mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkafea Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nidɔɔnii; lɛ emli asɔo nyɛnaa yɛ ato kpɔ̃mɔ gbi lɛ.
Nyɛhãa mlijoomɔ kɛ mlila kɛ mlifu kɛ blɔmɔ kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ sɛɛ afoa yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Shi nyɛmli ahia ahãhãa nyɛhe, nyɛmusuŋ atsɔ̃tsɔ̃a nyɛ yɛ nyɛhe, nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe, tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛfa nyɛ yɛ Kristo mli lɛ.
Nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛfea nyɛhe mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ bii ni asumɔɔ.
Ni nyɛnyiɛa yɛ suɔmɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔhewɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔle ni akɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ ni jeɔ ŋma krɔŋŋ lɛ.
Shi ajwamãŋbɔɔ kɛ nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ fɛɛ loo hiɛjoomɔ lɛ akatsĩ tã tete yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi.
Nakai nɔŋŋ akatsĩ hiɛgbejianitsumɔ kɛ kwashiai awiemɔ kɛ fɛoyeli ni ji nibii ni esaaa lɛ tã yɛ nyɛteŋ, shi moŋ nyɛ daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ nyɛnaa nyɛlea enɛ akɛ, ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko ajwamãŋbɔlɔ ko loo hiɛjoolɔ ko ni ji wɔŋjalɔ bɛ gbɛfaŋ nɔ yɛ Kristo kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ wiemɔi foji miishishiua nyɛ, ejaakɛ nii nɛɛ ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akabɔa amɛhe.
Ejaakɛ sa lɛ duŋ ji nyɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ la yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; nyɛnyiɛa tamɔ la bii.
Ejaakɛ la lɛ yibii jeɔ kpo yɛ ekpakpafeemɔ kɛ jalɛ kɛ anɔkwale fɛɛ mli.
Nyɛkaa nyɛkwɛa ni nyɛna nɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ; ni nyɛkatsua duŋ nitsumɔi ni wooo yibii lɛ eko, shi nyɛjiea amɛ shi.
Ejaakɛ nibii ni amɛfeɔ amɛteɔ lɛ, eyɛ hiɛgbele akɛ aaatsi tã tete.
Shi nii fɛɛ ni akɛ la jieɔ amɛ shi lɛ, anaa lɛ faŋŋ; ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni anaa lɛ faŋŋ lɛ, la ni.
No hewɔ ni ekɛɛ, “Ohiɛ atsɛ̃, bo mɔ ni owɔɔ lɛ, ni ote shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni Kristo aaatso ahã bo!” No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ bɔ ni nyɛaanyiɛ nyɛhã, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni leee nii, shi moŋ tamɔ nilelɔi, mɛi ni tsuɔ amɛbe he nii, ejaakɛ gbii nɛɛ gbii fɔ̃ji ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkafea nyɛhe mɛi ni bɛ yitsoŋ, shi moŋ nyɛyoa nii ni ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ.
Ni nyɛkatɔrɔa dãa, nɔ mli ni yakayaka jeŋba yɔɔ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛyimɔa obɔ̃ kɛ Mumɔ lɛ, Nyɛkɛ nyɛhe awiewiea yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, nyɛlaa ni nyɛtswaa saŋku yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Nyɛdaa Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa yɛ nii fiaa hewɔ yɛ wɔ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, ni nyɛbabaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛhe yɛ Kristo gbeyeishemɔ mli.
Ŋamɛi kɛ wumɛi Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛwumɛi lɛ, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛfeɔ nyɛhãa.
Ejaakɛ wu lɛ ji ŋa lɛ yitso, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu ji asafo lɛ yitso, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ ji gbɔmɔtso ni ji asafo lɛ yiwalaherelɔ lɛ.
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni asafo lɛ baa ehe shi ehãa Kristo lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ yei lɛ hu afee ahã amɛwumɛi lɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu sumɔ asafo lɛ ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ ehewɔ, koni ekɛ hejuu yɛ nu mli kɛ wiemɔ atsuu ehe ni ehã efee krɔŋkrɔŋ, koni eŋɔ lɛ edamɔ shi ehã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe akɛ anunyam asafo ni kpa ko loo nɔ kũaikũai ko loo nakai nɔ ko bɛ ehe, shi moŋ efee krɔŋkrɔŋ ni shwamɔ ko bɛ ehe lɛ.
Nakai sa akɛ wumɛi hu asumɔ amɛŋamɛi, tamɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbɔmɔtsei.
Mɔ ni sumɔɔ eŋa lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe esumɔɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ko enyɛko lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo dã, shi moŋ elɛɔ lɛ ni ehiɛɔ lɛ dɔdɔɔdɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ asafo lɛ; ejaakɛ egbɔmɔtso henii ji wɔ.
“Enɛ hewɔ ni nuu aaashi etsɛ kɛ enyɛ, ni eeekpɛtɛ eŋa he, ni amɛyi enyɔ lɛ fɛɛ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ heloo kome.” Teemɔ sane ni tsii nɛ; mi lɛ mikɛtoɔ Kristo kɛ asafo lɛ he.
Shi ekɔɔ nyɛ hu nyɛhe ekomekome; esa akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ asumɔ eŋa, tamɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe; koni ŋa lɛ ashe ewu.
Bii kɛ fɔlɔi Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi lɛ atoi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; ejaakɛ enɛ ja.
“Wo otsɛ kɛ onyɛ,” no ji klɛŋklɛŋ kitã ni hiɛ shiwoo akɛ, “Koni ahi ahã bo, ni otsɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, shi moŋ nyɛlɛa amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ kɛ ewiemɔkɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Tsuji kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ, tamɔ akɛ nyɛmiifee nyɛhã Kristo; jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛsalɛ, shi tamɔ Kristo tsuji ni jieɔ amɛmusuŋ amɛfeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, ni amɛkɛ tsuijurɔ sɔ̃mɔɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ amɛsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi jeee gbɔmɛi.
Ni nyɛle akɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ lɛ, nyɔŋ ji lɛ jio, odehe jio, nɔ ekpakpa ni efeɔ lɛ, no he nyɔmɔwoo ebaana kɛjɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ.
Ni nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, nyɛfea amɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ni nyɛfɔ̃a amɛhe gbeyeiwoo ni nyɛle akɛ nyɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛ egbɛfaŋ.
Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛhe awaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ nyɛmɔ lɛ mli.
Nyɛwoa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ abonsam ŋaatsɔ̃i lɛ ana nyɛdamɔ.
Ejaakɛ jeee gbɔmɛi wɔkɛna lɛ, shi moŋ wɔkɛ onukpayelii kɛ hegbɛi kɛ je nɛɛŋ duŋ lɛ mli lumɛi lɛ kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ni yɔɔ ŋwɛiniiaŋ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɔlɔa Nyɔŋmɔ tawuunii lɛ fɛɛ, koni nyɛnyɛ amɛnaa nyɛkpee yɛ gbi fɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni be ni nyɛgbe fɛɛ naa lɛ nyɛnyɛ shi nyɛdamɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛdamɔa shi ni nyɛkɛ anɔkwale afia nyɛhɛ ni nyɛwo jalɛ dama lɛ ni nyɛkɛ hejɔlɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ awo nyɛnaji; nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛhiɛa hemɔkɛyeli tsɛŋ lɛ mli; no nyɛkɛaanyɛ mɔfɔŋ lɛ gãimlibii ni tsoɔ lɛ fɛɛ nyɛgbe lɛ; ni nyɛŋɔa yiwalaheremɔ akɛ dadefai, kɛ mumɔŋ klante ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ fɛɛ asɔlea be fɛɛ be yɛ mumɔ mli, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ nyɛsaraa, ni nyɛkãa he daa nyɛkpaa fai nyɛhãa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ fɛɛ kɛ mi hu, koni kɛ migbele minaa lɛ, akɛ wiemɔ awo minaa ni mikɛ ekãa ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ mli teemɔ sane lɛ ni mitsuɔ he nii akɛ bɔfo yɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ mli nɛɛ.
Nyɛkpaa fai koni yɛ ejajemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mawie kɛ ekãa bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
Naagbee ŋamɔ Shi bɔ ni afee ni nyɛ hu nyɛle bɔ ni miyɔɔ kɛ nii ni mitsuɔ lɛ, wɔsuɔmɔ nyɛmi Tihiko ni ji sɔ̃ɔlɔ anɔkwafo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ aaagba nyɛ fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni ehã nyɛtsui anyɔ nyɛmli.
Hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛmimɛi lɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni sumɔɔ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ suɔmɔ ni sɛɛ efooo lɛ ahi shi.
Amen!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Filipibii awolo lɛ Bɔfo Paulo ji mɔ ni ŋma emaje eklɛŋklɛŋ asafo ni eyato shishi yɛ Ablotsiri yɛ Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Makedonia nɔ lɛ.
Be ni eŋma wolo nɛɛ, eyɛ mɔɔŋ, ni nɔ ni gbaa enaa ni ehãaa etsui anyɔ emli kwraa ji akɛ mɛi komɛi ni kɛɛ Kristo shiɛlɔi ji amɛ lɛ ete shi eshi lɛ Paulo, in asaŋ, amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi hu miitsɔ̃ɔ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ yɛ Filipi asafo lɛ mli.
Shi enɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, akɛni Paulo heɔ Kristo nɔ eyeɔ jogbaŋŋ hewɔ lɛ, ewolo lɛ eyi tɔ kɛ miishɛɛ sɔŋŋ.
Nɔ titri hewɔ ni eŋma wolo lɛ ji akɛ ekɛyada Filipi Kristofoi lɛ ashi akɛ be ni nibii amli yawa hã lɛ yɛ ehiamɔ beiaŋ lɛ, amɛmaje lɛ keenii babaoo.
Bɔfo Paulo tsɔ̃ wolo nɛɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ ekɛyawo amɛ ekãa, tsɛ nibii srɔtoi miigba lɛ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛnaa moŋ.
Ebi amɛ hu ni amɛba amɛhe shi tamɔ Yesu, fe nɔ ni amɛaaŋmɛ gbɛ ni ahi ahã ŋkome shihilɛ kɛ hewoo tridii afee amɛhe nɔ.
Ekai amɛ akɛ amɛ kɛ Yesu efee ekome yɛ amɛwala shihilɛ mli, ni enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenii ni amɛna kɛtsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ, shi moŋ jeee yɛ Yudafoi lɛ aMla kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi anɔ ni amɛyeɔ hewɔ ni.
Ema miishɛɛ kɛ toiŋjɔlɛ ni mɛi fɛɛ ni kɛ Yesu feɔ ekome kɛhiɔ shi lɛ naa lɛ nɔ aduatsɔ.
Nibii pɔtɛ̃ɛ ni Paulo ma nɔ mi yɛ ewolo lɛ mli lɛ nomɛi baa nɛɛ: miishɛɛ kɛ he ni aheɔ he ayeɔ, ekomefeemɔ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ yɛ Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli kɛ jeŋba mli.
Asaŋ wolo lɛ jie suɔmɔ kple ni Bɔfo Paulo yɔɔ hã asafo ni yɔɔ Filipi lɛ kpo faŋŋ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Nibii ni kɔɔ Paulo he krɛdɛɛ .- Wala yɛ Kristo mli .—.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito he gbɛjianɔtoo .- Kɔkɔbɔɔ yɛ henyɛlɔi kɛ oshrãi ahe .—.
Paulo kɛ enanemɛi ni yɔɔ Filipi lɛ .- Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo kɛ Timoteo, Yesu Kristo tsuji lɛ; ŋma yahã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni yɔɔ Yesu Kristo mli yɛ Filipi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔkwɛlɔi kɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ!
Paulo sɔle hã Filipibii lɛ Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi be fɛɛ be ni mikaiɔ nyɛ yɛ midaa faikpamɔi fɛɛ ni mikpaa mihãa nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ mli, ni mikɛ miishɛɛ kpaa fai, yɛ wa ni nyɛwa yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ gbɛfaŋ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ gbi lɛ nɔ kɛbashi be nɛ lɛ hewɔ; ni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔŋŋ nɔ, akɛ mɔ ni bɔ̃i nitsumɔ kpakpa yɛ nyɛmli lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eeekã he kɛyashi eeegbe naa yɛ Yesu Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Eja akɛ mijwɛŋɔ enɛ yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛkã mitsui nɔ, nyɛ ni yɛ migboklɛi kɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ kɛ enɔmimaa fɛɛ mli lɛ nyɛ kɛ mi fɛɛ lɛ dromɔ lɛ niyelɔi ji wɔ lɛ.
Bɔ ni mikɛ Yesu Kristo mlitsɔlɛ lɛ shweɔ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ ji midasefonyo.
Ni enɛ he fai mikpaa, akɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ afa kɛya nɔ, ni eteke nɔ yɛ nilee kɛ sɛɛyoomɔ fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ ni nyɛyoo nii ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ, koni nyɛfee krɔŋŋ ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe kɛyashi Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ; ni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ jalɛ yibii ni awoɔ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ, hã Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam kɛ yijiemɔ.
Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni Shi, anyɛmimɛi, miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle akɛ saji ni ba minɔ lɛ ehã Sanekpakpa lɛ eshwere moŋ.
Ni Asaŋ ehã migboklɛi lɛ eje shi faŋŋ yɛ Kaisare asraafoi amɔ̃ɔ lɛ mli fɛɛ kɛ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ fɛɛ ateŋ, akɛ Kristo hewɔ awo mi tsuŋ lɛ.
Ni nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi babaoo etsɔ̃ migboklɛi lɛ anɔ ena hewalɛ ni amɛkɛ ekãa babaoo fe tsutsu lɛ miijaje Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ ni amɛsheee gbeyei.
Mɛi komɛi lɛ, hetsɛ̃ kɛ bei hewɔ amɛshiɛɔ Kristo lɛ; shi mɛi komɛi hu kɛ jwɛŋmɔ kpakpa shiɛɔ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi jɛɔ suɔmɔ mli shiɛɔ, ejaakɛ amɛle akɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hefãmɔ lɛ hewɔ ni mikã biɛ nɛɛ.
Shi mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, amɛkɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ shiɛɔ Kristo, ni jeee krɔŋŋ ni, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ ji akɛ amɛtee amanehulu shi amɛwo mi yɛ migboklɛi lɛ amli.
No hewɔ lɛ, mɛni?
Bɔ fɛɛ bɔ ni fee lɛ, kwa akwaa jio, anɔkwale naa jio, Kristo kɛ̃ ashiɛɔ lɛ, ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ miyɛ miishɛɛ.
Ni asaŋ mana miishɛɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ enɛ baatsɔ̃ miyiwalaheremɔ yɛ nyɛfaikpamɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo Mumɔ lɛ yelikɛbuamɔ naa.
Migbɛkwɛmɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kɛkɛ ji akɛ mihiɛ akagbo yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli, shi moŋ, bɔ ni afeɔ daa lɛ, nakai agbɛnɛ hu akɛ ekãa fɛɛ aaawo Kristo hiɛ nyam yɛ migbɔmɔtso mli, yɛ wala mli jio, gbele mli jio.
Ejaakɛ yɛ migbɛfaŋ lɛ, Kristo ji wala, ni gbele lɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni.
Shi kɛji wala yɛ heloo nɛɛ mli hãa mitsuɔ nii ni woɔ yibii lɛ, mileee emli nɔ ni makɔ; shi miihao yɛ nibii enyɔ nɛɛ ateŋ; miishwe ni maje mli ni mikɛ Kristo ayahi shi, ejaakɛ no hi aahu; shi nyɛhewɔ lɛ heloo mli shihilɛ lɛ he ehĩa fe no.
Ni akɛni miŋɔ mihiɛ mifɔ̃ enɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, mile akɛ mahi shi, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaahi shi, koni nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ashwere, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ yɛ mli; koni nyɛmli ni baafli nyɛ yɛ mihewɔ kɛji mikɛ nyɛ bakpe ekoŋŋ lɛ ateke nɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
Nɔ kome kɛkɛ ji akɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ, koni kɛ miba mibana nyɛ jio, mikɛ nyɛ bɛ jio, manu nyɛhe akɛ nyɛdamɔ shi yɛ mumɔ kome mli, ni nyɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome miipele Sanekpakpa lɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he, ni nyɛkahãa henyɛlɔi lɛ miiwoa nyɛhe gbeyei yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko mli; nyɛgbeyei ni nyɛsheŋ lɛ ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ okadi hã amɛ; shi nyɛ lɛ, eji yiwalaheremɔ okadi hã nyɛ, ni enɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ aduro nyɛ yɛ Kristo hewɔ, jeee ni nyɛhe enɔ nyɛye kɛkɛ, shi moŋ akɛ nyɛna nɔ hu yɛ ehewɔ.
Ni nakai ta kome lɛ ni nyɛna ni miiwu, ni agbɛnɛ nyɛnuɔ akɛ miiwu lolo lɛ, no nɔŋŋ mli nyɛhiɛ nɛɛ.
Kristo heshibaa kɛ egbojee No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ Kristo mli hewalɛwoo ko yɛ, kɛ suɔmɔ miishɛjemɔ ko yɛ, kɛ mumɔŋ naanyobɔɔ ko yɛ, kɛ musuŋtsɔlɛ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ ko yɛ lɛ, nyɛhãa mimiishɛɛ lɛ ayia obɔ̃, akɛ nyɛmiijwɛŋ nɔ kome, nyɛhiɛ suɔmɔ kome, susuma kome, mumɔ kome.
Ni nyɛkafea nɔ ko kɛ mligbalamɔ mumɔ loo yaka anunyam taomɔ, shi moŋ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ abua nyɛnanemɛi akɛ amɛfe nyɛ.
Nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ akafo enɔ mli, shi moŋ efo enaanyo nɔ mli.
Nɔ ni Kristo Yesu hu jwɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ nyɛjwɛŋa.
Lɛ mɔ ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ su moŋ, shi ebuuu hegbɔ ni ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ye lɛ akɛ nɔ ko ni sa akɛ ehiɛ mli kpɛŋŋ, Moŋ ejie efɔ̃ shi.
Eŋɔ tsulɔ su efɔ̃ enɔ, Etsɔ̃ gbɔmɔ, ni enifeemɔ gbɛfaŋ hu ana lɛ akɛ gbɔmɔ.
Eba ehe shi ni ebo toi kɛtee gbele mli, kɛtee sɛŋmɔtso nɔ gbele mli tete.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo enɔ gojoo, ni eduro lɛ gbɛi ni ta gbɛi fɛɛ gbɛi nɔ, koni mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nakutso akula shi yɛ Yesu gbɛi lɛ mli; ni lilɛi fɛɛ lilɛi agba mli kpoo akɛ Yesu Kristo ji Nuŋtsɔ, kɛwo Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyam.
Nyɛtamɔ kanei yɛ je lɛ mli No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛboɔ toi daa nɛɛ, jeee be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ titri lɛ, agbɛnɛ ni mibɛ nyɛŋɔɔ nɛɛ hu lɛ, nyɛkɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ hekpokpomɔ atsua nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛyiwalaheremɔ lɛ he nii; ejaakɛ suɔmɔ ni aaasumɔ jio, feemɔ ni aaafee jio, Nyɔŋmɔ ji mɔ ni tsuɔ fɛɛ yɛ nyɛ mli bɔ ni lɛ etaoɔ.
Nyɛfea nyɛnii fɛɛ ni huhuuhu wiemɔi kɛ naataamɔ akahi mli; koni nyɛhe akahi shwamɔ, ni nyɛfee mɛi krɔŋŋ, Nyɔŋmɔ bii ni he bɛ kpa ko yɛ yinɔ kɔɔdɔŋ ni bɛ eŋɛlɛnɔ nɛɛ mli, mɛi ateŋ ni nyɛtsoɔ tamɔ kanei yɛ je nɛɛŋ lɛ.
Ni nyɛhiɛ wala wiemɔ lɛ mli, koni etsɔ̃ shwãanɔ ehã mi yɛ Kristo Gbi lɛ nɔ, akɛ mifoijee lɛ efeee yaka ni mideŋmegbomɔ lɛ hu efeee efolo.
Shi kɛji afɔse milá ashwie nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni akɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ nɔ tete lɛ, miyɛ he tsuijurɔ, ni mikɛ nyɛ fɛɛ aaana tsuijurɔ; nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nyɛ hu nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ, ni nyɛkɛ mi anaa tsuijurɔ.
Timoteo kɛ Epafrodito Shi mihiɛ kã nɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ etsɛŋ ni matsu Timoteo nyɛŋɔɔ, koni kɛji minu bɔ ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ, ni mi hu mitsui anyɔ mimli.
Ejaakɛ mibɛ mɔ ko ni kɛ mi hiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni nyɛhe sane dɔɔ lɛ krɔŋŋ tamɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnii amɛpleɔ, shi jeee Kristo Yesu nii.
Shi nyɛle etɛ naa, akɛ ekɛ mi sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ he tamɔ bi kɛ etsɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, mihiɛ kã enɔ, akɛ amrɔ ni mana misane lɛ naa lɛ, matsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ.
Shi miyɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ hu, etsɛŋ ni maba.
Kɛ̃lɛ mijwɛŋ akɛ ehĩa akɛ matsu wɔnyɛmi Epafrodito, ni ji minaanyo nitsulɔ kɛ minaanyo tabilɔ kɛ nyɛbɔfo kɛ mihiamɔnii ahe sɔ̃ɔlɔ hu lɛ, nyɛŋɔɔ; ejaakɛ eeshwe nyɛ fɛɛ, ni akɛni nyɛnu akɛ ehe miiye hewɔ lɛ eehao.
Ehe ye lɛɛlɛŋ, ni ebɛŋkɛ gbele tã, shi Nyɔŋmɔ na lɛ mɔbɔ, ni jeee lɛ kɛkɛ, shi moŋ mi hu, koni mikaye ŋkɔmɔ mito ŋkɔmɔ nɔ.
No hewɔ titri mikɛ oyaiyeli tsu lɛ lɛ, koni kɛ nyɛna lɛ ekoŋŋ lɛ, ni nyɛna miishɛɛ ni mi hu mikaye ŋkɔmɔ tuutu.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ aherea lɛ atuu yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, ni nyɛbua gbɔmɛi ni tamɔ nɛkɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo; ejaakɛ Kristo nitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ gbele kwraa, ni ekɛ ehe wo osharã mli, koni ebaye nyɛnajiaŋ kɛsɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni ehiii nyɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Anɔkwa jalɛ Naagbee lɛ, minyɛmimɛi, nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli!
Akɛ maŋma nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ nɔŋŋ lɛ, efeee mi ahuntoo, ni ehãa nyɛfeɔ shweshweeshwe.
Nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbei lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nitsulɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe, nyɛkwɛa jogbaŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso henii folɔmɔ lɛ he!
Ejaakɛ wɔ moŋ wɔji ketiafolɔi lɛ, wɔ mɛi ni wɔjaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mumɔ naa, ni wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ Kristo Yesu nɔ, ni wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ɔɔ gbɔmɔtso nifeemɔ nɔ lɛ, tsɛbelɛ miyɛ nɔ ko yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tete ni mikɛ mihiɛ aaafɔ̃ nɔ.
Kɛ efeɔ mɔ ko akɛ eyɛ nɔ ko ni ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ nɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, miyɛ nɔ ni fe no.
Gbi ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ nɔ afo mi ketia, Israel fɔmɔbi kɛ Benyamin akutso lɛ mli nyo ji mi, Hebrinyo krɛdɛɛ mli Hebrinyo, ni yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, Farisifonyo, ni jamɔ he hiɛdɔɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ asafo lɛ yiwalɔ ji mi, ni yɛ jalɛ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mihe bɛ shwamɔ ko.
Shi kɛ̃lɛ nii ni ji sɛɛnamɔ hã mi sa lɛ, yɛ Kristo hewɔ lɛ mibu amɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ.
Anɔkwale mli lɛ mibuɔ fɛɛ akɛ shigbeemɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu, miNuŋtsɔ lɛ, he nilee ni fe nii fɛɛ lɛ hewɔ; lɛ ehewɔ ni nii fɛɛ ebɔ mi, ni mibuɔ amɛ akɛ tumo nɔ nii, koni mana Kristo, ni ana mi yɛ emli, akɛ mibɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ mijalɛ ni jɛ Mla mli, shi moŋ jalɛ ni tsɔ̃ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dɛŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa miyɔɔ, ni male lɛ Kristo eshitee lɛ hewalɛ lɛ; ni mana emanehului lɛ eko, ni matamɔ lɛ yɛ egbele lɛ gbɛfaŋ; akɛ aleenɔ mana mashɛ gbohiiashitee lɛ he lo.
Foijee kɛ oti lɛ heshɛɛ Jeee akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ momo aloo mihi kɛwula shi momo, shi miipele mihiɛ gbɛ ni minine ashɛ nɔ, gbii abɔ ni Kristo Yesu nine eshɛ mi hu minɔ lɛ.
Anyɛmimɛi, mibuuu mihe akɛ minine eshɛ nɔ, shi nɔ kome kɛkɛ mifeɔ: Nii ni yɔɔ sɛɛgbɛ lɛ mijieɔ mihiɛ yɛ nɔ, shi nii ni yɔɔ hiɛgbɛ lɛ moŋ mikpãa mimli ni mashɛ he, ni miitiu oti lɛ kɛyashɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛmɔ ni jɛ ŋwɛi yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he juromɔ nɔ lɛ he.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔ mɛi abɔ ni wɔdara yɛ mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ wɔjwɛŋa nakai.
Ni kɛ nɔ ko yɛ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ ekroko lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie no hu kpo faŋŋ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Shi nɔ ni wɔkɛba wɔjeŋ kɛbashi he ni wɔshɛ nɛɛ, wɔya nɔ wɔkɛ no nɔŋŋ aba wɔjeŋ.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛkasea mi.
Nyɛkwɛa mɛi ni nyiɛɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔtoɔ nyɛ okadi lɛ.
Mikɛɛ nyɛ shii abɔ, ni miikɛɛ nyɛ ekoŋŋ kɛ yaafonui, akɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni baa amɛjeŋ akɛ Kristo sɛŋmɔtso lɛ henyɛlɔi.
Amɛnaagbee ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni amɛmusu taomɔnii ji amɛnyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛhiɛgbele mli amɛnunyam yɔɔ, shikpɔŋ nɔ nii ahe amɛjwɛŋɔ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, wɔmaŋ lɛ ŋwɛi eyɔɔ, he ni wɔkwɛɔ yiwalaherelɔ ni ji Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ebaatsake wɔgbɔmɔtso ni hiɛ bɛ nyam lɛ koni etamɔ enunyam gbɔmɔtso lɛ su, yɛ ehewalɛ nitsumɔ ni ekɛnyɛɔ eŋɔɔ nibii fɛɛ ewoɔ eshishi hu lɛ naa lɛ.
Ŋaawoi No hewɔ lɛ, minyɛmimɛi ni misumɔɔ ni mishweɔ, mimishɛɛ kɛ mikekre, nyɛdamɔa shi shiŋŋ nakai yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli, nyɛ mɛi ni misumɔɔ!
Miikpa Euodia fai, ni miikpa Sintike fai, akɛ amɛjwɛŋmɔ afee ekome yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli.
Hɛɛ, bo hu miibao, minaanyo sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ anɔkwaleŋ, ni oye obua yei nɛɛ; ejaakɛ amɛfata mihe kɛpele Sanekpakpa lɛ he, kɛ Klɛmente hu kɛ minanemɛi nitsulɔi krokomɛi ni amɛgbɛi yɔɔ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛmii ashɛa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli daa!
Miikɛɛ ekoŋŋ!
Nyɛmii ashɛa!
Nyɛmlijɔlɛ lɛ nyɛhãa gbɔmɛi fɛɛ alea!
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Nyɛkahaoa yɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko he, shi moŋ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ nyɛkɛ sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ shidaa atsĩa nyɛtaomɔnii lɛ atã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ hejɔlɛ ni fe jwɛŋmɔi fɛɛ lɛ aaabu nyɛtsuii kɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔi lɛ ahe yɛ Kristo Yesu mli!
Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nii abɔ ni ji anɔkwa, nii ni sa woo, nii ni ja, nii ni he tse, nii ni yɔɔ fɛo, nii ni yɔɔ gbɛi kpakpa lɛ fɛɛ, kɛji jeŋba kpakpa ko yɛ, kɛji yijiemɔ ko hu yɛ lɛ, enɛɛmɛi ahe nyɛjwɛŋa!
Nii hu ni nyɛkase ni nyɛmɔ mli ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna yɛ mihe lɛ, nomɛi nɔŋŋ nyɛfea, ni hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ aaahi shi.
Shidaa yɛ Filipibii anikeenii lɛ ahe Shi mina miishɛɛ babaoo yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ agbɛnɛ nyɛhã mi nɔ ni nyɛjwɛŋɔ lɛ efrɔke ekoŋŋ; nyɛjwɛŋɔ he, shi hegbɛ ni nyɛyanaaa.
Jeee akɛ fimɔ ni efi mi hewɔ miwieɔ nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mi lɛ mikase akɛ shihilɛ fɛɛ shihilɛ ni miyɔɔ mli lɛ mimii ashɛ he.
Mile ohia mli shihilɛ, ni mile kpɔtɔɔyeli hu; mihe ehomɔ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ kɛ nii fɛɛ mli: tɔɔ kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ninamɔ kɛ ohiayeli.
Minyɛɔ nii fɛɛ mifeɔ yɛ mɔ ni wajeɔ mi lɛ mli.
Kɛ̃lɛ nyɛfee jogbaŋŋ, akɛ nyɛbaye nyɛbua mi yɛ mimanehulu lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi nyɛ Filipibii diɛŋtsɛ hu nyɛle akɛ, Sanekpakpa lɛ shishijee lɛ mli, be ni miyiŋ kɛjɛ Makedonia lɛ, asafo ko bɛ ni kɛ mi bɔɔ naanyo yɛ hãmɔ kɛ hemɔ gbɛfaŋ, akɛ ja nyɛ kɛkɛ; ejaakɛ be ni miyɔɔ Tesalonika lɛ hu nyɛtsu shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ abahã mi nii ni hiaa mi lɛ.
Jeee akɛ nikeenii mitaoɔ; shi moŋ miitao yibii ni baahã nyɛkɔntaa lɛ afa.
Shi mina nii fɛɛ ni eteke nɔ; ni akɛni minine eshɛ nii ni nyɛkɛmaje Epafrodito kɛbahã mi lɛ nɔ nɛɛ, mina nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni mitaoɔ; eji ŋmajee kpakpa kɛ afɔle kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
MiNyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaahã nyɛ nii ni hiaa nyɛ lɛ fɛɛ yɛ enifalɛ lɛ naa yɛ anunyam mli, yɛ Kristo Yesu mli.
Shi anunyam ahã wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ.
Amen!
Naagbee ŋamɔi Nyɛŋaa hetselɔ fɛɛ hetselɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli nyɛhãa mi.
Nyɛmimɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ miibi nyɛ.
Hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ, shi titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ Kaisare we lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Bɔfo Paulo ŋma ewolo nɛɛ eyahã asafo ni yɔɔ Kolose lɛ.
Kolose lɛ eji Asia Fio maŋ ko ni ye Efeso bokãgbɛ.
Asafo nɛɛ, jeee Paulo ji mɔ ni yato shishi, shi moŋ eŋmɔ eyiŋ kpɔ akɛ ebaakwɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ he ni eyɔɔ lɛ, lɛ Paulo lɛ, etsuɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛlɔi ni yɔɔ Efeso lɛ kɛyaa jɛi.
Efeso lɛ, Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ maŋ wulu ni, ni Paulo ena ele akɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔlɔi komɛi ete shi yɛ Kolose ni amɛkɛ hiɛdɔɔ miijaje akɛ dani mɔ obaana ole Nyɔŋmɔ ni ona yiwalaheremɔ kɛ mɔ shi lɛ, sa ni doo oja “mumɔŋ nɔyelɔi kɛ onukpai komɛi.” Kɛshi enɛ nɔ lɛ, tsɔ̃ɔlɔi nɛɛ miifi nɔ veveeve akɛ sa ni ofee kusumi komɛi tamɔ akɛ ketiafoo nɛkɛ, ni asaŋ oye mlai fɛɛ ni kɔɔ niyenii srɔtoi kɛ nibii krokomɛi ahe lɛ hu nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Yɛ ewolo lɛ mli lɛ, Paulo wie eshi tsɔ̃ɔmɔi gbohii nɛɛ ni etsɔ̃ɔ nɔ ni ji anɔkwa Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ.
Eshɛɛwiemɔ lɛ mli agugu ji akɛ Yesu Kristo pɛ ji mɔ ni nyɛɔ hãa yiwalaheremɔ yeɔ obɔ̃.
Ehã anu shishi faŋŋ akɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔi nɛɛ amɛhãa hemɔkɛyeli gbugbãa ejaakɛ amɛshwieɔ mɔ kɛjeɔ Kristo he kɛyaa shɔŋŋ.
Asaŋ, Kristo nɔ tsɔ̃ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ je lɛ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ enɔ ebaatsɔ̃ ni ehã je lɛ aku esɛɛ kɛba eŋɔɔ ekoŋŋ.
Akɛ aaahere je lɛ yiwala lɛ, fɛɛ damɔ wɔ kɛ Kristo ekomefeemɔ nɔ.
Agbɛnɛ hu, Paulo gbla bɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni he jraa nɛɛ kɔɔ mɛi abɔ ni heɔ Kristo nɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ awala he lɛ mli fitsofitso.
Nɔ kome ni esaaa ni hiɛ kpaa nɔ ji akɛ Tihiko ni Paulo tsu kɛ ewolo lɛ akɛ ekɛahã Kolosebii lɛ, Onesimo kɛ lɛ tee, ni lɛ Onesimo nɛɛ nyɔŋ ji lɛ, ni lɛ ehewɔ tutuuŋtu Paulo ŋma wolo eyahã Filemon lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Kristo su kɛ enitsumɔ .—.
Wala hee yɛ Kristo mli .—.
Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo ŋma yahã nyɛmimɛi hetselɔi kɛ heyelɔi yɛ Kristo mli ni yɔɔ Kolose lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ ahã nyɛ.
Shidaa sɔlemɔ Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Tsɛ lɛ shi yɛ nyɛhewɔ daa nɛɛ yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.
Ejaakɛ wɔnu nyɛKristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛ sumɔɔ hetselɔi lɛ fɛɛ he yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni akɛto ahã nyɛ yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Nyɛnu enɛ momo yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ mli.
Sanekpakpa lɛ eshɛ nyɛŋɔɔ tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni eyɔɔ yɛ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ mli, ni eewo yibii ni eeshwere, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ yɛ nyɛ hu nyɛteŋ kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni nyɛnu ni nyɛna nyɛle Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ yɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Nyɛkase enɛ yɛ Epafra, wɔnaanyo tsulɔ ni wɔsumɔɔ, ni ji Kristo anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ hã nyɛ lɛ naa.
Lɛ ebagba wɔ nyɛsuɔmɔ ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛwoɔ nyɛmli lɛ he sane.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔ hu, kɛjɛ gbi nɔ ni wɔnu lɛ, wɔfɔ̃ko sɔlemɔ kɛ faikpamɔ kɛ nyɛ hãmɔ, koni nyɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ esuɔmɔnaanii alee yɛ mumɔŋ nilee kɛ shishinumɔ fɛɛ mli.
Koni nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ni asa ehiɛ kwraa ni nyɛwo yibii yɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa mli.
Enɛ ahã nyɛshwere yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he nilee mli ni awaje nyɛ kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ yɛ enunyam nyɛmɔ lɛ naa.
No ahã nyɛnyɛ nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ ni nyɛto nyɛtsui shi kɛ miishɛɛ yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Ni nyɛdaa Tsɛ lɛ shi, mɔ ni hã wɔfee mɛi ni sa krɔŋkrɔŋbii ni yɔɔ la lɛ mli lɛ agboshinii lɛ eko yeli.
Ni ejie wɔ kɛjɛ duŋ hewalɛ lɛ mli kɛtee esuɔmɔ Bi lɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ; lɛ emli wɔna kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ ni ji wɔhe eshai faa lɛ yɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ su ni Kristo hiɛ kɛ enitsumɔ Kristo ji Nyɔŋmɔ ni anaaa lɛ subaŋ, lɛ enɔ atsɔ abɔ nii fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ emli abɔ nii fiaa yɛ, nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, nii ni anaa kɛ nii ni anaaa, maŋtsɛ sɛii jio, nɔyelii jio, onukpayelii jio, hegbɛi jio, nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, enɔ atsɔ̃ abɔ, ni lɛ nɔŋŋ abɔ ahã.
Eyɛ dani nii fiaa yɔɔ, ni emli nii fiaa yɔɔ.
Ni lɛ ji gbɔmɔtso lɛ ni ji asafo lɛ yitso, lɛ ji shishijee lɛ, gbohii ateŋ kromɔbi lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni efee klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esu muu lɛ fɛɛ ahi emli.
Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ esɛŋmɔtso nɔ lá lɛ nɔ ekɛ hejɔlɛ ba, ni etsɔ̃ enɔ ekɛ nibii fɛɛ kpãtã, nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ.
Nyɛ ni sa ni yɛ nyɛjwɛŋmɔ kɛ nyɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji ahewɔ lɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji kɛ henyɛlɔi ji nyɛ.
Agbɛnɛ ekɛ egbɔmɔtso lɛ etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã nyɛ ni ekɛ nyɛ edamɔ shi akɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni he bɛ kpa ko ni sane ko bɛ amɛhe yɛ ehiɛ.
Shi esa ni nyɛhiɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli ni nyɛdamɔ shi shiŋŋ yɛ shishitoo lɛ nɔ, ni nyɛkatsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ he, Sanekpakpa lɛ ni nyɛnu ni ashiɛɔ atsɔ̃ɔ bɔɔnii fɛɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi shishi, ni mi Paulo misɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ he lɛ.
Sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni Paulo tsu hã Kristo Asafo lɛ Agbɛnɛ mimii shɛɔ yɛ mimanehului ni minaa yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ amli, ni mikɛ miheloo naa Kristo amanehului ni shwɛ lɛ mikɛwoɔ amɛ obɔ̃ hã egbɔmɔtso ni ji esafo lɛ.
Ni mitsɔ̃ esafo lɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ nitsumɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ etu ewo midɛŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ naa, akɛ mashiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ kɛwula shi lɛ.
Enɛ ji teemɔ sane ni akɛtee kɛjɛ teteete kɛ yinɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ajie lɛ kpo atsɔ̃ɔ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔ akɛ ahã amɛle nɔ ni ji nɛkɛ teemɔ sane nɛɛ anunyam falɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji lɛ ateŋ.
Teemɔ sane nɛɛ ji akɛ Kristo yɛ nyɛmli koni nyɛna anunyam lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.
Lɛ ehe sane wɔjajeɔ, ni wɔwoɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ ŋaa, ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ nilee nɛɛ fɛɛ, koni wɔkɛ gbɔmɔ fɛɛ gbɔmɔ adamɔ shi akɛ mɔ ni eye emuu yɛ Kristo mli.
No he deŋme migboɔ ni mipeleɔ yɛ ehewalɛ ni tsuɔ nii kɛ hewalɛ yɛ mimli lɛ naa.
Nyɛkaŋmɛa gbɛ ni mɔ ko hã nyɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbugbãa Ejaakɛ miisumɔ akɛ nyɛle nɔ pelemɔ ni mli wa ni mipeleɔ yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi abɔ ni enako mi hiɛ kɛ hiɛ lɛ ahewɔ.
Miifee enɛ koni amɛtsɛ amɛtsui amɛŋmɛ amɛmli ni amɛfee ekome yɛ suɔmɔ mli ni amɛna hewalɛ falɛ fɛɛ ni anaa kɛjɛɔ niiashishinumɔ mli lɛ ni amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ ni ji Kristo.
Mɔ mli ni akɛ ŋaa kɛ nilee jwetrii lɛ fɛɛ etee yɛ lɛ.
Shi miikɛɛ enɛ, koni mɔ ko kɛ naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko akashishiu nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ mikɛ nyɛ bɛ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli po, mumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ mikɛ nyɛ yɛ, ni mimii shɛɔ kɛ mikwɛ bɔ ni nyɛdamɔ shi pɛpɛɛpɛ kɛ nyɛ Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ shifimɔ lɛ.
Nyɛyia obɔ̃ kɛ Kristo wala No hewɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛhere Kristo Yesu, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ atuu lɛ, nyɛnyiɛa yɛ emli.
Ni nyɛshishifã amɔ̃ shi ni atswa nyɛ ama enɔ ni nyɛfi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ ni nyɛteke nɔ kɛ shidaa.
Nyɛkwɛa nyɛhe ni ahĩa, koni mɔ ko kɛ jeŋ nilee kɛ yaka shishiumɔ ni damɔ gbɔmɛi ablema tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ je nɛɛŋ shishijee nibii anɔ, shi jeee Kristo nɔ lɛ, akaŋɔ nyɛ nom.
Ejaakɛ Kristo mli Nyɔŋmɔ su muu lɛ fɛɛ hiɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso su mli; ni nyɛye emuu yɛ emli, lɛ mɔ ni ji onukpayeli kɛ hegbɛ fɛɛ yitso lɛ.
Lɛ emli afolɔ nyɛ ketia hu yɛ, jeee ketia ni akɛ nine fo, shi moŋ ketiafoo ni ji heloo gbɔmɔtso lɛ jiemɔ yɛ Kristo ketiafoo lɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ afu nyɛ kɛ lɛ yɛ baptisimɔ lɛ mli; ni emli hu atee nyɛ shi yɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni tee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ hewalɛ lɛ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli naa.
Ni nyɛ ni nyɛ ji gbohii yɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ kɛ nyɛheloofoo lɛ mli lɛ, ehã nyɛ kɛ lɛ fɛɛ wala, ni ekɛ nyɛnɔtɔ̃mɔi lɛ fɛɛ efa nyɛ.
Ni egbe wɔnyɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ ni aŋma kɛ ekpɔi lɛ, ni ejie kɛtee, ni ekala ekpɛtɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he.
Ni ekpɔlɔ onukpayelii kɛ hewalɛi lɛ ahe nii, ni ebɔ amɛ ahora faŋŋ, ni enyã yɛ amɛnɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miikojoa nyɛ yɛ niyeli loo ninumɔ loo gbii juji loo nyɔji hei loo hejɔɔmɔ gbii agbɛfaŋ, ejaakɛ nii ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ ni, shi nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ji Kristo.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko kɛ taomɔ ni etaoɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ aja ŋwɛi bɔfoi miishɔ̃ nyɛjuromɔnii lɛ yɛ nyɛdɛŋ.
Gbɔmɔ ni tamɔ nɛkɛ lɛ, nɔ nɔ ni edamɔ ji ninai, ni eheloo jwɛŋmɔ lɛ hãa ewoɔ ehe nɔ efolo, ni ehiɛɛɛ Kristo ni ji yitso lɛ mli, mɔ mli ni gbɔmɔtso lɛ fɛɛ tsɔ̃ɔ talɔi kɛ fai lɛ anɔ enaa nii ni hiaa lɛ kɛjeɔ ni emɔmɔ̃ɔ ehe kɛshimɔ̃ɔ ehe nɔ kɛdaa bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ taoɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ nyɛkɛ Kristo egbo ni je nɛɛŋ shishijeenii bɛ nyɛnɔ hewalɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mɛɛba mɔ ni nyɛhiɔ shi tamɔ nɔ ni nyɛhiɛ kamɔ̃ lolo yɛ je nɛɛŋ, ni nyɛhãa awoɔ nyɛ akpɔi akɛ, “Kaamɔ mli, ni kaasa onaa, ni kaata he tete” lɛ?
Enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ji nibii ni hiɛ kpãtãa yɛ amɛhe nitsumɔ mli; amɛ ji akpɔi ni awo yɛ gbɔmɛi akitãi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi anaa.
Suɔmɔnaa jamɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɔtso yiwaa hãa nibii nɛɛ feɔ tamɔ nɔ ni nilee yɛ mli nɛ, shi yɛ heloo akɔnɔ naatsii gbɛfaŋ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ.
Nyɛhia shi yɛ Kristo ni ete shi lɛ hewalɛ mli No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ atee nyɛ kɛ Kristo shi lɛ, nyɛtaoa nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, he ni Kristo yɔɔ ni eta Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ lɛ.
Nii ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe nyɛjwɛŋa, jeee nii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛgboi, ni akɛ nyɛwala lɛ kɛ Kristo etee yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Be ni Kristo, mɔ ni ji wɔwala lɛ, aaapue lɛ, no lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛkɛ lɛ aaapue yɛ anunyam mli.
Shihilɛ momo lɛ kɛ ehee lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛgbea nyɛhenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ: ajwamãŋbɔɔ, nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, mlila, akɔnɔ fɔŋ, kɛ hiɛjoomɔ ni ji wɔŋjamɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi ahewɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu baa toigbelebii lɛ anɔ lɛ.
Enɛɛmɛi amli nyɛ hu nyɛnyiɛ sa, be ni nyɛhi shi yɛ mli lɛ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ nyɛ hu nyɛshɛrɛa nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ nyɛshwiea: mlifu, mlila kɛ shwee ni ashweɔ mɔ efɔŋ, kɛ oshekuyeli kɛ hiɛgbejiawiemɔ ni jɛɔ nyɛdaaŋ.
Nyɛkamalemalea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe, ejaakɛ nyɛjie gbɔmɔ momo lɛ kɛ enitsumɔi lɛ yɛ nyɛhe, ni nyɛwo gbɔmɔ hee ni aafee lɛ ehee yɛ ebɔlɔ lɛ subaŋ nɔ, koni ele lɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
Enɛ mli lɛ Helanyo kɛ Yudanyo, ketiafolɔ kɛ foolɔ, gbɔ, Sikitianyo, nyɔŋ kɛ odehe ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ Kristo ji nii fiaa yɛ mɛi fɛɛ mli.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii, mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi kɛ suɔmɔ mɛi ji nyɛ nɛɛ lɛ, nyɛwoa musuŋtsɔlɛ, mlihilɛ, heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ, kpoofeemɔ, tsuishitoo.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko kɛ mɔ ko na sane ko lɛ, nyɛnanaa nyɛhãa nyɛhe ni nyɛkɛfafaa nyɛhe; tamɔ bɔ ni Kristo hu kɛfa nyɛ lɛ, nakai nyɛ hu nyɛfea.
Shi enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ nyɛwoa suɔmɔ ni ji kpãa ni fiɔ nibii fɛɛ feɔ lɛ ekome ni ehãa eyeɔ emuu lɛ.
Ni nyɛhãa Kristo hejɔlɛ lɛ ayea lumɔ yɛ nyɛtsuii amli; nɔ he ni atsɛ nyɛ kɛba yɛ gbɔmɔtso kome mli lɛ.
Ni nyɛlea shidaa.
Nyɛhãa Kristo wiemɔ lɛ ahia nyɛmli babaoo; ni nyɛkɛ nilee fɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛhe nii ni nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a nyɛhe yɛ saŋkutswai kɛ yijiemɔ lalai kɛ mumɔŋ lalai amli, ni nyɛkɛ shidaa alaa yɛ nyɛtsuii amli nyɛhãa Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ yɛ wiemɔ loo nitsumɔ gbɛfaŋ lɛ, nyɛfea fɛɛ yɛ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, ni nyɛtsɔ̃a enɔ nyɛdaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji Tsɛ lɛ shi.
Kristofoi ashĩa mli shihilɛ Nyɛ yeigbãyei lɛ, nyɛbaa nyɛhe shi nyɛhãa nyɛwumɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
Nyɛ wumɛi lɛ, nyɛsumɔa nyɛŋamɛi, ni nyɛmli akajoa yɛ amɛnɔ.
Nyɛ bii lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛfɔlɔi atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ; ejaakɛ no sa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Nyɛ tsɛmɛi lɛ, nyɛkawoa nyɛbii amli la, koni amɛnijiaŋ akaje wui.
Nyɛ tsuji lɛ, nyɛboa nyɛheloo gbɛfaŋ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ atoi yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli, jeee kɛ hiɛiaŋhiɛiaŋ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ amɛsa, shi moŋ yɛ tsui krɔŋŋ mli akɛ mɛi ni sheɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ, nyɛjiea nyɛmusuŋ nyɛtsua, tamɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ nyɛtsuɔ nyɛhã ni jeee gbɔmɛi, ni nyɛle akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ nyɛnine baashɛ gboshinii lɛ anɔ yɛ akɛ nyɛnyɔmɔwoo.
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Kristo nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ.
Shi mɔ ni feɔ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ, nii ni ejaaa gbɛ nɔŋŋ he nyɔmɔwoo eeena, ni hiɛiaŋkwɛmɔ ko bɛŋ.
Nyɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛkɛ nɔ ni ja kɛ nɔ ni sa pɛ ahãa nyɛtsuji lɛ, ni nyɛlea akɛ nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ Nuŋtsɔ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ŋaawoi Nyɛhiɛa sɔlemɔ mli, ni nyɛshia kpe yɛ mli kɛ shidaa.
Ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu, koni Nyɔŋmɔ agbele gbɛ ahã wɔ hã wiemɔ lɛ, ni wɔwie Kristo teemɔ sane lɛ, nɔ hewɔ hu ni mikã kpãa mli nɛɛ.
Nyɛsɔlea koni majie no shi faŋŋ bɔ ni sa akɛ mawie lɛ.
Nyɛbaa nyɛjeŋ yɛ nilee mli yɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ ahiɛ, ni nyɛtsu nyɛbe he nii.
Nyɛhãa nyɛwiemɔ he abaa nyam daa ni ŋoo ahi mli, ni nyɛle bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛhãa mɔ fɛɛ mɔ hetoo.
Naagbee ŋamɔi Tihiko, ni ji suɔmɔ nyɛmi kɛ anɔkwa sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ naanyo tsulɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, aaagba nyɛ mihe saji fɛɛ.
Enɛ nɔŋŋ hewɔ mitsu lɛ nyɛŋɔɔ, koni nyɛle bɔ ni wɔyɔɔ, ni eshɛje nyɛmii.
Mitsu lɛ kɛ Onesimo ni ji anɔkwa kɛ suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jɛ nyɛteŋ lɛ; amɛaagba nyɛ biɛ saji fɛɛ.
Aristarko, minaanyo gboklɛfonyo lɛ, miibi nyɛ; kɛ Marko ni ji Barnaba nyɛmi bi (mɔ ni miwo nyɛ shi yɛ ehe akɛ nyɛhere lɛ atuu kɛ eba nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ) Yoshua ni atsɛɔ lɛ Yusto lɛ, ni ji mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi pɛ ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ ni etsɔ̃mɔ tsuiwoo ehã mi.
Epafra ni jɛ nyɛteŋ ni ji Kristo tsulɔ ni daa nɛɛ ekɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ hiɛ sɔlemɔi amli waa kɛhã nyɛ, koni nyɛdamɔ shi akɛ mɛi ni eye emuu ni amɛyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii fɛɛ feemɔ lɛ, miibi nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ miiye ehe odase akɛ ebɔɔ mɔdɛŋ naakpa yɛ nyɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Hierapoli lɛ ahe.
Luka, tsofatsɛ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛ Dema miibi nyɛ.
Wɔmiibi nyɛmimɛi ni yɔɔ Laodikea lɛ, kɛ Nimfa kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ ewe lɛ.
Kɛ akane nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa akanea yɛ Laodikea asafo lɛ mli hu, ni nyɛ hu nyɛkane nɔ ni jɛ Laodikea lɛ.
Ni nyɛkɛa Arkipo akɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ogbe sɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ naa kwraa!” Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni miŋma nɛ.
Nyɛkaia mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃i lɛ!
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Tesalonika ji Roma shikpɔŋ lɛ gbene ni atsɛɔ lɛ Makedonia lɛ maŋ wulu.
Paulo yato asafo shishi yɛ jɛmɛ be ni eshi Filipi lɛ sɛɛ.
Shi eyeee be ko kwraa ni Yudafoi lɛ te shi shi lɛ ejaakɛ amɛmiiklɔ enɔ akɛni Paulo lɛ, Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ lɛ ehã ena hiɛ yɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ni kulɛ amɛnya Yudafoi ajamɔ lɛ he lɛ.
Enɛ hã Paulo kpatu eshi Tesalonika kɛtee Beroia.
Nosɛɛ be ni eyashɛ Korinto lɛ, enine shɛ shɛɛ nɔ kɛjɛ enaanyo Timoteo ni ekɛtsuɔ nii lɛ dɛŋ yɛ Tesalonika asafo lɛ hewɔ; ehã ele nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ jɛmɛ.
Enɛ hã Paulo ŋma eklɛŋklɛŋ wolo lɛ eyahã Tesalonika Kristofoi lɛ koni ekɛwo amɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛshɛje amɛmii.
Eda Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ adafi ni atswa lɛ yɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Ekai amɛ bɔ ni ehi shi ehã be ni ekɛ amɛ yɔɔ lɛ, ni saji ni gbaa asafo lɛ naa yɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, ehã amɛ hetoo: Ani mɔ ko ni ehe Kristo nɔ eye, shi egbo dani Kristo aaaba ekoŋŋ lɛ, eeena naanɔ wala ni Kristo kɛbaaba lɛ eko?
Ni mɛɛbe Kristo baaba ekoŋŋ?
Paulo tsɔ̃ enɛ nɔ ewo amɛ ekãa koni amɛya nɔ amɛkɛ dioofeemɔ atsu amɛnii, belɛ amɛkɛmiimɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ ni hiɛ kã nɔ lɛ.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .
Shidaa kɛ yijiemɔ .—.
Kristofoi ajeŋba he ŋaawoo .- Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ .—.
Naagbee ŋaawoo .- Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ, Tsɛ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ: Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ahã nyɛ!
Tesalonikabii ashihilɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli Wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛhewɔ, ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ nyɛtãtsii yɛ wɔsɔlemɔi amli.
Ni wɔkaiɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛhiɛ ni kã wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ lɛ mli hiɛmiamɔ lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ sumɔɔ, wɔle halamɔ ni ahala nyɛ lɛ, akɛ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ baaa nyɛŋɔɔ yɛ wiemɔ mli kɛkɛ, shi moŋ yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hewalɛ kɛ nɔmimaa babaoo mli, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, no ji bɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nyɛteŋ yɛ nyɛhewɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛ lɛ, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ wɔ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, akɛni nyɛkɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ mli miishɛɛ mɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli yɛ amanehulu babaoo mli lɛ.
Ni no ehã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ nyɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ni heɔ yeɔ yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛŋɔɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ jɛ ni egbɛ eshwã, jeee yɛ Makedonia kɛ Akaia kɛkɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhe ni nyɛheɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ejije kɛtee he fɛɛ he, ni ehĩaaa wɔ nɔ ko kɛɛmɔ tete.
Ejaakɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbaa wɔhe sane bɔ ni wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ kɛ bɔ ni nyɛkpale kɛjɛ amãgãi ahe kɛba Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ni nyɛbasɔ̃mɔ anɔkwa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ ni nyɛkwɛ eBi lɛ ni etee lɛ shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ lɛ gbɛ kɛjɛ ŋwɛi, Yesu ni jie wɔ kɛjɛ mlifu ni baaba lɛ mli lɛ.
Paulo nitsumɔ yɛ Tesalonika Ejaakɛ anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ni wɔba lɛ efeee yaka.
Wɔna nɔ momo, ni afee wɔ niseniianii hu yɛ Filipi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, kɛ̃lɛ wɔna ekãa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ mli ni wɔkɛjaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, tsɛbelɛ ate shi ashi wɔ babaoo.
Ejaakɛ wɔwiemɔ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ, jeee shishiumɔ loo nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ loo kutumpɔo mli ejɛ; shi moŋ tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ebu wɔ akɛ wɔsa akɛ atu Sanekpakpa lɛ awo wɔdɛŋ lɛ, nakai wɔwieɔ, jeee tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa gbɔmɛi ahiɛ, shi moŋ tamɔ mɛi ni taoɔ asa Nyɔŋmɔ ni kaa wɔtsuii kwɛɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔwieko naadɔkɔmɔ wiemɔ ko pɛŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛle lɛ, ni wɔtoko hiɛjoomɔ he abla ko hu, Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefonyo, asaŋ wɔtaooo gbɔmɛi ahiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ loo mɛi krokomɛi aŋɔɔ.
Tsɛ wɔyɛ hegbɛ akɛ wɔfeɔ wɔhe agboi yɛ nyɛnɔ, akɛni Kristo bɔfoi ji wɔ lɛ; shi moŋ wɔhe jɔ yɛ nyɛteŋ, tamɔ bɔ ni bii anyɛ hiɛɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebii dɔdɔɔdɔ lɛ.
Ni akɛni wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ jogbaŋŋ nɛkɛ hewɔ lɛ, wɔna he tsui akɛ jeee Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ kɛkɛ wɔkɛaahã nyɛ, shi moŋ wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔwala tete, ejaakɛ wɔmiisumɔ nyɛ naakpa.
Ejaakɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkaiɔ wɔtɔlɛ kɛ wɔdeŋmegbomɔ lɛ, akɛ bɔ ni afee ni wɔkatsɔ̃ jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko hewɔ lɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔmiitsu nii, ni wɔsaa wɔmiijaje Nyɔŋmɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ wɔmiitsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ.
Nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ji odasefoi akɛ wɔjeŋ ni wɔba yɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ ateŋ lɛ eyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋ, eja, ni shwamɔ ko bɛ he.
Tamɔ bɔ nɔŋŋ ni nyɛle akɛ wɔhiɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ tamɔ tsɛ hiɛɔ ebii.
Ni wɔwieɔ wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ, ni wɔshɛjeɔ nyɛmii hu, ni wɔkpaa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛnyiɛ bɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ kɛbaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋtsɛyeli kɛ enunyam lɛ mli lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni wɔ hu wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi ni wɔfɔ̃ɔɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ be ni nyɛnine shɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ ni nyɛnu yɛ wɔnaa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nyɛmɔ mli akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni eji hu lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ, shi jeee akɛ gbɔmɛi awiemɔ ko.
Wiemɔ nɛɛ tsuɔ hewalɛ nii yɛ nyɛ ni nyɛheɔ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nyɛmli.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni kaseɔ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi ni yɔɔ Yudea yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, ejaakɛ amanehului ni nyɛna yɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛmaŋbii lɛ adɛŋ lɛ, no nɔŋŋ amɛ hu amɛna yɛ Yudafoi lɛ adɛŋ; amɛgbe Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ gbalɔi lɛ hu, ni amɛwa wɔ yi.
Amɛsaaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, ni amɛkɛ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ yeee.
Amɛtsĩɔ wɔ gbɛ hu akɛ wɔkawie wɔtsɔ̃ɔ jeŋmaji lɛ ni ahere amɛyiwala.
Ni amɛkɛwoɔ amɛhe eshai lɛ obɔ̃ daa, shi mlifu lɛ enina amɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Paulo shwe akɛ eyasara asafo lɛ ekoŋŋ Shi wɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, akɛni wɔkɛ nyɛ mli egbala be kukuoo ko yɛ na ni wɔnaaa wɔhe yɛ heloo mli gbɛfaŋ, shi jeee yɛ wɔmumɔ mli hewɔ lɛ, wɔkɛ shwee pii tao akɛ wɔna nyɛhiɛ ekoŋŋ.
Hewɔ lɛ wɔtao akɛ wɔba nyɛŋɔɔ, mi Paulo, mitao akɛ maba shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ fɛɛ shi Satan tsĩ wɔ gbɛ.
Ejaakɛ namɔ ji wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ loo wɔmiishɛɛ loo wɔshwãa akekre yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo hiɛ, yɛ ebaa be lɛ mli lɛ?
Ani jeee nyɛ ni?
Ejaakɛ nyɛ nyɛ ji wɔnunyam kɛ wɔmiishɛɛ.
Atsu Timoteo kɛtee Tesalonika No hewɔ lɛ, be ni wɔnyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, wɔkpɛ mli akɛ ashi wɔ kome yɛ Atene, ni wɔtsu Timoteo ni ji wɔnyɛmi kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ sɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ yɛ Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ mli lɛ.
Wɔtsu lɛ ni ebawo nyɛ hewalɛ ni eshɛje nyɛmii yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ, koni nɛkɛ amanehului nɛɛ akahã mɔ ko mɔ ko miigbugbãa.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ nɔ ni kã shi hã wɔ nɔŋŋ ji no.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto akɛ wɔbaana amanehulu, tamɔ bɔ ni eba mli ni nyɛle lɛ.
Enɛ hewɔ ni mi hu, be ni minyɛɛɛ dɔŋŋ lɛ, mitsu Timoteo ni mikɛle nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ, akɛ aleenɔ kalɔ lɛ ebaka nyɛ, ni ehã wɔdeŋme ni wɔgbo lɛ efee yaka lo.
Shi agbɛnɛ ni Timoteo jɛ nyɛŋɔɔ ba wɔŋɔɔ ni ebagba wɔ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ kɛ nyɛsuɔmɔ lɛ he sane kɛ kaimɔ kpakpa ni nyɛkɛkaiɔ wɔ daa lɛ kɛ nyɛshwee ni nyɛshweɔ akɛ nyɛaana wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔshweɔ ni wɔna nyɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmanehulu kɛ wɔhejaramɔ lɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ ehã wɔmii eshɛ yɛ nyɛhe; ejaakɛ kɛji nyɛfi shi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ, no lɛ agbɛnɛ wɔna wala hee.
Paulo da Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ Tesalonikabii lɛ ahewɔ Ejaakɛ mɛɛ shidaa po wɔɔnyɛ wɔkɛda Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɛ hewɔ yɛ miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni wɔna yɛ nyɛhe yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ hewɔ?
Nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane fɛɛ wɔkpaa fai babaoo, koni wɔna nyɛhiɛ ni wɔhã nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ aye emuu.
Shi Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ aaahã wɔgbɛ aja kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ awo nyɛ obɔ̃bɔ̃ ni ehã nyɛteke nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛkɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔ hu wɔsumɔɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Bɔ ni afee ni ehã nyɛtsui afi shi ni shwamɔ ko akahi nyɛhe yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔTsɛ lɛ hiɛ, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ abaa be lɛ mli.
Nyɛhĩa shi yɛ krɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ kɛ suɔmɔ mli Naagbee lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkase yɛ wɔŋɔɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ nyɛba nyɛjeŋ ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Nyɛmiifee nakai, shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai ni wɔmiiwo nyɛ ŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli akɛ nyɛfee ni ateke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle kitãi ni wɔwo nyɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii, no ji, nyɛhetsemɔ akɛ nyɛtsi nyɛhe kɛjɛ ajwamãŋbɔɔ he; ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ale lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eŋa lɛ hiɛmɔ yɛ hetsemɔ kɛ woo mli, jeee yɛ akɔnɔ hiɛdɔɔ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni jeŋmajiaŋbii ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ feɔ lɛ.
Ni mɔ ko akatɔ̃ enyɛmi nɔ ni eye lɛ amim yɛ sane nɛɛ mli, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ ahe oweletɔlɔ ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni wɔkɛɛ nyɛ wɔto ni wɔye he odase lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛɛɛ wɔ ehãaa nyaŋemɔ nitsumɔ, shi moŋ hã hetsemɔ.
Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ, mɔ ni kwaa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ lɛ, jeee gbɔmɔ ko ekwaa, shi moŋ Nyɔŋmɔ ni kɛ eMumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hãa nyɛ lɛ.
Shi nɔ ni kɔɔ nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ he lɛ, ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ; ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ akɛ nyɛsumɔsumɔɔ nyɛhe; ejaakɛ nyɛfeɔ nakai hu nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ Makedonia muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, akɛ nyɛfee kɛteke nɔ fe tsutsu lɛ.
