Ni nyɛkɛfea nyɛ oti akɛ nyɛaahi shi dioo ni nyɛkɛ nyɛhe akawo mɛi asaji amli ni nyɛkɛ nyɛniji atsu nii, bɔ ni wɔwo nyɛ kitã lɛ, koni nyɛjeŋba afee mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ fɛo, ni nɔ ko nɔ ko akahĩa nyɛ.
Gbohii kɛ hiɛkãalɔi yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiisumɔ akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahe sane, koni nyɛkaye ŋkɔmɔ tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ ni bɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ko lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wɔheɔ wɔyeɔ akɛ Yesu gbo ni ete shi lɛ, belɛ nakai nɔŋŋ Nyɔŋmɔ baatsɔ̃ Yesu nɔ aŋɔ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ hu afata ehe kɛba.
Ejaakɛ wɔmiikɛɛ nyɛ enɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ naa akɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni wɔbaashwɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa be lɛ mli lɛ, wɔtsɔ̃ŋ mɛi ni ewɔ lɛ ahiɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ baakpleke shi kɛjɛ ŋwɛi yɛ oshebɔɔ mli ni ŋwɛi bɔfonukpa gbee kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ baagbɛɛ, ni gbohii ni yɔɔ Kristo mli lɛ tsutsu baate shi, no sɛɛ lɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, aaasha wɔ kɛ amɛ fɛɛ yɛ atatui amli kɛaatee Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kpeemɔ yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli, ni nakai wɔkɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaayahi shi daa.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ ashɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii.
Nyɛsaa nyɛhe nyɛtoa Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa lɛ Shi anyɛmimɛi, nɔ ni kɔɔ gbii lɛ kɛ bei lɛ ahe lɛ, ehe ehĩaaa akɛ aŋma nyɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle krɛdɛɛ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ baaba tamɔ julɔ baa nyɔɔŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be mli ni amɛaakɛɛ akɛ, “Wɔyɛ hejɔlɛ ni wɔyɛ shweshweeshwe!” lɛ, no mli nɔŋŋ hiɛkpãtãmɔ aaabatua amɛ trukaa, tamɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ tuaa yoo ni hiɛ musu lɛ, ni amɛjeŋ mli kɔkɔɔkɔ.
Shi, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛ lɛ nyɛbɛ duŋ mli ni Gbi lɛ aaabati nyɛ shi tamɔ julɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ fɛɛ lɛ, labii ji nyɛ kɛ shwanebii hu, wɔjeee nyɔɔŋ loo duŋ bii.
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkahãa wɔwɔa tamɔ mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ, shi moŋ nyɛhãa wɔshia kpe ni wɔhiɛ akãa shi.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wɔɔ lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛwɔɔ, ni mɛi ni tɔrɔɔ dãa lɛ, nyɔɔŋ mli amɛtɔrɔɔ.
Shi wɔ lɛ, akɛni shwanebii ji wɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔhiɛ akãa shi ni wɔwo hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ dama lɛ ni wɔbumɔ dade fai ni ji yiwalaheremɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ etooo wɔ ehãaa mlifu, shi moŋ hã yiwalaheremɔnamɔ kɛtsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo nɔ, mɔ ni gbo wɔyi gbele, koni wɔhiɛ kãmɔ jio, wɔwɔ jio, wɔkɛ lɛ ahi shi lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛshɛjeshɛjea nyɛhe mii, ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ahã enaanyo nane amɔ shi, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛfeɔ lɛ.
Naagbee ŋaawoi kɛ ŋamɔi Shi, anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai akɛ nyɛle mɛi ni tsuɔ nii yɛ nyɛteŋ ni amɛyeɔ nyɛnɔ onukpa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli ni amɛwieɔ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ.
Nyɛbua amɛ naakpa diɛŋtsɛ yɛ suɔmɔ mli, yɛ amɛnitsumɔ lɛ hewɔ.
Nyɛhãa hejɔlɛ ahĩa nyɛteŋ.
Ni wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a hejɔ̃lɔi lɛ, nyɛwoa gbeyelɔi lɛ ekãa; nyɛwaa mɛi ni yɔɔ gbedee lɛ; nyɛtoa nyɛtsui shi nyɛhãa mɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa koni mɔ ko kɛ efɔŋ akato efɔŋ najiaŋ, shi moŋ daa nɛɛ nyɛnyiɛa ekpakpafeemɔ sɛɛ nyɛhãhãa nyɛhe kɛ mɛi fɛɛ.
Nyɛnaa miishɛɛ daa, nyɛsɔlea ni nyɛkafɔa; nyɛdaa shi yɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli.
Ejaakɛ enɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii yɛ Kristo Yesu mli yɛ nyɛgbɛfaŋ.
Nyɛkagbea Mumɔ lɛ; nyɛkagbea gbalɛi lɛ ahe guɔ.
Nyɛkaa nii fiaa nyɛkwɛa, ni nɔ ni hi lɛ nyɛmɔa no mli.
Nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ efɔŋ su lɛ he.
Shi hejɔlɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ atsuu nyɛhe kwraa kɛmɔ shi, ni eto nyɛmumɔ kɛ nyɛsusuma kɛ nyɛgbɔmɔtso muu lɛ fɛɛ ni shwamɔ ko akahi he yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa be lɛ mli.
Anɔkwafo ji mɔ ni tsɛɔ nyɛ lɛ, ni eeefee hu.
Anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ hu.
Nyɛŋaa nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ naashwɔmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Miikã nyɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kitã akɛ nyɛhãa akanea nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ atsɔ̃a nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ!
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Mɛi ayiŋ ni etɛ̃ɛɛ amɛ yɛ Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ hewɔ lɛ kã he eegba mɛi anaa lolo yɛ Tesalonika asafo lɛ mli.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, Bɔfo Paulo ŋma ewolo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eyahã Tesalonikabii lɛ ni ekɛwie he ni mɛi heɔ yeɔ akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ baa gbi lɛ eshɛ momo lɛ he.
Paulo yasaa nɛkɛ jwɛŋmɔfutumɔ nɛɛ ni ehã anu shishi akɛ fɛɛdã ni Kristo baaba ekoŋŋ lɛ, eshafeemɔ kɛ yitsoŋwalɛ baakwɔ tso yɛ naakpɛɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni gbɛi ji Hiɛkpãtãlɔ lɛ ni baate shi eshi Kristo lɛ gbɛtsɔ̃ɔmɔ naa.
Bɔfo lɛ ma nɔ mi akɛ sa akɛ ewolo nɛɛ kanelɔi lɛ afi shi shiŋŋ ni amɛhemɔkɛyeli akagbugbãa, tsɛ amɛyɛ haomɔ kɛ nɔnaa mli moŋ nɛ, shi moŋ amɛtsu nii yɛ amɛdaaŋ ŋmaa hewɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ Paulo kɛ enanemɛi ni ekɛtsu nii lɛ fee lɛ, ni amɛmia amɛhiɛ amɛfee ekpakpa hu.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Yijiemɔ kɛ juromɔ .- Kristo baa ekoŋŋ lɛ he nitsɔ̃ɔmɔ .- Kristofoi ajeŋba he ŋaawoo .- Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo kɛ Silvano kɛ Timoteo ŋma yahã Tesalonikabii asafo ni yɔɔ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ!
Kojomɔ yɛ Kristo baa be lɛ mli Eji wɔgbɛnaa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi, tamɔ bɔ ni sa lɛ, ejaakɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ miida naakpa, ni nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ suɔmɔ ni ekɛsumɔɔ enanemɛi lɛ miifa kɛmiiya nɔ hu.
No hewɔ lɛ, wɔdiɛŋtsɛ tete wɔshwãa wɔfɔ̃ɔ nyɛnɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafoi lɛ amli, yɛ nyɛhiɛmiamɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli ni nyɛhiɛ yɛ nyɛyiwalɛi kɛ nyɛmanehului ni nyɛnaa lɛ amli lɛ hewɔ.
Eji Nyɔŋmɔ kojomɔ ni ja gbɛ lɛ he okadi, koni abu nyɛ akɛ nyɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛyeli ni nyɛnaa he nɔ lɛ, akɛni eja yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɛi ni haoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehao amɛ eto najiaŋ, ni nyɛ mɛi ni ahaoɔ nyɛ lɛ, eeehã nyɛ kɛ wɔ fɛɛ hejɔɔmɔ, be ni aaajie Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kpo kɛaajɛ ŋwɛi kɛ ebɔfoi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ lɛ.
Ekɛ lalilɛi aaatɔ owele yɛ mɛi ni leee Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ mɛi ni booo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo Sanekpakpa lɛ toi lɛ anɔ.
Amɛaana nyɔmɔwoo ni ji naanɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ, ni aaajie amɛ kɛaajɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ anunyam lɛ he, be ni eeeba koni awo ehiɛ nyam yɛ emɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ amli ni ana enaakpɛɛnii yɛ eheyelɔi lɛ fɛɛ amli yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ ahe wɔdase ni wɔye wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ aye.
Enɛ hewɔ hu ni wɔsɔleɔ daa wɔhãa nyɛ, koni wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ abu nyɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa tsɛmɔ lɛ ni ekɛ ehewalɛ lɛ ahã ekpakpafeemɔ he miishɛɛ fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ kɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli nitsumɔ lɛ ayi obɔ̃, bɔ ni afee ni awo wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi lɛ hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛmli ni nyɛ hu nyɛhiɛ aba nyam yɛ emli, yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ naa.
Mlakwalɔ lɛ Shi wɔmiikpa nyɛ fai, anyɛmimɛi, yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo baa lɛ kɛ wɔnaa ni abaabua yɛ eŋɔɔ lɛ hewɔ akɛ nyɛkahãa ahã nyɛjwɛŋmɔ futu oya, ni asaŋ nyɛkahãa akɛ mumɔ ko loo wiemɔ ko loo wolo ko ni aaakɛɛ akɛ ejɛ wɔŋɔɔ lɛ miihã nyɛhao akɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ Gbi lɛ eshɛ etã.
Nyɛkahãa mɔ ko miishishiua nyɛ yɛ gbɛ ko gbɛ ko nɔ; ejaakɛ ja jamɔkwamɔ lɛ eba fɛɛ dã ni aaajie mlakwamɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ ni ji hiɛkpãtãmɔ bi lɛ kpo.
Eteɔ shi ewoɔ ehe nɔ eshiɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni atsɛɔ nyɔŋmɔ loo jamɔ lɛ aahu bɔ ni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyataa Nyɔŋmɔ We lɛ ni ekɛ ehe tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ lɛ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Nyɛkaiii akɛ be ni mikɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ, mikɛɛ nyɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ lo?
Ni agbɛnɛ lɛ, nɔ ni tsiɔ ekpojiemɔ lɛ gbɛ kɛyashi ebe aaashɛ lɛ, nyɛle.
Ejaakɛ mlakwamɔ teemɔsane lɛ miitsu nii momo, shi kɛyashi mɔ ni tsɔ̃ɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ aaaje jɛi kɛkɛ.
Ni no dani aaajie mlakwalɔ lɛ kpo; Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ edaaŋ mumɔ lɛ aaagbe lɛ ni ekɛ ebaa lɛ puemɔ lɛ aaakpãtã ehiɛ.
Mlakwalɔ nɛɛ, Satan nitsumɔ nɔ ebaatsɔ̃ kɛba kɛ amale hewalɛ kɛ amale okadii kɛ amale naakpɛɛnii, kɛ efɔŋ mli shishiumɔ fɛɛ ni akɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni hiɛ baakpãtã ejaakɛ amɛmɔ̃ɔɔ anɔkwale suɔmɔ lɛ mli ni akɛhere amɛyiwala lɛ.
Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsuɔ shishiumɔ hewalɛ kɛbaa amɛŋɔɔ ni amɛhe amale amɛye, koni akojo mɛi fɛɛ ni heee anɔkwale lɛ amɛyeee, shi amɛnaa efɔŋ moŋ he tsui lɛ.
Ahala nyɛ kɛhã yiwalaheremɔ Shi wɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔdaa Nyɔŋmɔ shi daa yɛ nyɛhewɔ, anyɛmimɛi ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ehala nyɛ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii ehã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ nyɛhe ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ tsuɔ kɛ he ni nyɛheɔ anɔkwale lɛ nyɛyeɔ lɛ nɔ.
Enɛ mli etsɔ̃ wɔSanekpakpa lɛ nɔ etsɛ nyɛ kɛba, koni nyɛna wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo anunyam lɛ.
Belɛ no hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛfĩa shi, ni nyɛhiɛa nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ mli loo wolo mli lɛ mli.
Shi lɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni sumɔ wɔ ni ekɛ naanɔ miishɛjemɔ kɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ kpakpa hã wɔ yɛ dromɔ naa lɛ, lɛ nɔŋŋ eshɛje nyɛmii ni ewaje nyɛ yɛ wiemɔ kpakpa kɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ mli.
Nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ Nɔ ni eshwɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛsɔlea nyɛhãa wɔ koni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ wiemɔ lɛ agbɛ ashwã oyayaayai ni awo ehiɛ nyam, tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ nyɛŋɔɔ lɛ.
Ni ajie wɔ kɛjɛ yiwalɔi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji lɛ adɛŋ, ejaakɛ jeee mɛi fɛɛ yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli.
Shi anɔkwafo ji Nuŋtsɔ lɛ, mɔ ni aaawaje nyɛ ni eeebu nyɛhe ni ejie nyɛ kɛjɛ mɔ fɔŋ lɛ dɛŋ lɛ.
Wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli akɛ nii ni wɔwoɔ nyɛ he kitã lɛ, nyɛmiifee ni nyɛaafee hu.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ akudɔ nyɛtsuii kɛya Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ kɛ Kristo tsuishiŋmɛɛ lɛ mli.
Esa akɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ atsu nii Shi anyɛmimɛi, wɔmiiwo nyɛ kitã yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo gbɛi mli, akɛ nyɛtsia nyɛhe kɛjɛa nyɛmi fɛɛ nyɛmi ni feɔ hejɔ̃ ni ehiii shi yɛ nii ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ naa lɛ he.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ diɛŋtsɛ nyɛle akɛ esa akɛ nyɛkaseɔ wɔ; ejaakɛ wɔfeee wɔhe hejɔ̃lɔi yɛ nyɛteŋ.
Ni asaŋ wɔyeee mɔ ko ŋmaa yaka, shi moŋ wɔkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ kɛ tɔlɛ tsuɔ nii nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane bɔ ni afee ni wɔkafee jatsu wɔmiihã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.
Jeee akɛ wɔbɛ nakai hegbɛ, shi moŋ, koni wɔkɛ wɔhe afee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ wɔhã nyɛ ni nyɛkase.
Ejaakɛ be ni wɔkɛ nyɛ yɔɔ lɛ hu, wɔwo nyɛ kitã akɛ, “Kɛ mɔ ko sumɔɔɔ akɛ etsuɔ nii lɛ, belɛ ekaye nii hu.” Ejaakɛ wɔnuɔ akɛ mɛi komɛi yɛ nyɛteŋ ni feɔ hejɔ̃, ni amɛtsuuu nii, shi moŋ amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli.
Nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ wɔmiiwo amɛ kitã ni wɔmiiwo amɛŋaa yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo mli akɛ amɛtsu nii waa ni amɛye amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdɛŋ ŋmaa.
Shi nyɛ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, nyɛkahãa ekpakpafeemɔ miitɔa nyɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko booo wɔwiemɔ ni yɔɔ wolo lɛ mli lɛ toi lɛ, nyɛkadia lɛ, ni nyɛkɛ lɛ akabɔa, koni ehiɛ agbo; ni nyɛkabua lɛ akɛ henyɛlɔ, shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃a lɛ akɛ nyɛmi.
Naagbee wiemɔ Shi lɛ hejɔlɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ahã nyɛ hejɔlɛ daa yɛ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
Mi Paulo diɛŋtsɛ minine naa bimɔ ni ji okadi yɛ miwolo fɛɛ wolo mli nɛ; bɔ ni miŋmaa nɛ.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Timoteo ji Kristofonyo oblanyo ni jɛ Asia Fio.
Enyɛ lɛ Yudayoo ni kɛ etsɛ hu Helanyo ni.
Etsɔ̃ Paulo naanyo kɛ yelikɛbualɔ yɛ eshiɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Paulo Klɛŋklɛŋ Wolo ni eŋma Timoteo lɛ kɔɔ nibii etɛ̃ krɛdɛɛ ahe.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, wolo lɛ bɔɔ kɔkɔ yɛ amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ asafo lɛ mli lɛ he.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ Yudafoi kɛ jeŋmajiaŋbii ajwɛŋmɔ ni efutu ni, ni edãmɔ he ni aheɔ ayeɔ akɛ jeŋ ni wɔyɔɔ mli nɛɛ efɔŋ ni, ni nɔ pɛ ni baahã mɔ ko ana yiwalaheremɔ ji teemɔŋ nilee pɔtɛ̃ɛ ko, kɛ agbɛnɛ hu, shihilɛ yɛ gbɛ titri ko nɔ, tamɔ akɛ niyenii komɛi ahii kɛ oshijafeemɔ nɛkɛ.
Nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ wolo lɛ saa ewoɔ asafonɔkwɛmɔ kɛ jamɔ he ŋaa, ni etsɔ̃ɔ jeŋba ni sa asafonukpai kɛ yelikɛbualɔi.
Naagbee lɛ, awo Timoteo ŋaa bɔ ni ebaafee ni etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, kɛ egbɛnaa hu yɛ kui srɔtoisrɔtoi ni heɔ Kristo nɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ amli.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Ŋaawoo ni kɔɔ asafo lɛ kɛ enɔkwɛlɔi lɛ ahe .—.
Ŋaa ni awo Timoteo yɛ enitsumɔ lɛ he .—.
Ŋamɔ Paulo ni ji Yesu Kristo bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ, famɔ naa lɛ, ŋma yahã Timoteo ni ji ebi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ.
Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ, wɔTsɛ lɛ, kɛ Yesu Kristo, wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã bo!
Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ he kɔkɔbɔɔ Tamɔ bɔ ni be ni miyaa Makedonia ni mikpa bo fai akɛ ohi shi yɛ Efeso, koni obɔ mɛi komɛi akɔkɔ akɛ amɛkatsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi.
Ni asaŋ obɔ kɔkɔ akɛ amɛkadi adesãi kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ tsralaa lɛ sɛɛ, ejaakɛ enɛɛmɛi kɛ yaka hiɛklamɔ baa fe akɛ eeewa wɔ ni wɔle Nyɔŋmɔ yiwalaheremɔ he yiŋtoo, ni hemɔkɛyeli sane ni lɛ, nakai fai mikpaa bo ekoŋŋ.
Shi ŋaawoo lɛ oti ji suɔmɔ ni jɛ tsui ni mli tse kɛ henilee kpakpa kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni osato ko bɛ mli lɛ mli.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni mɛi komɛi eje sɛɛ, ni amɛkpale kɛtee yaka wiemɔ he.
Amɛmiitao amɛtsɔ̃mɔ mlatsɔɔlɔi, tsɛ amɛnaaa nii ni amɛkɛɔ lɛ loo nii ni amɛwieɔ kɛ nɔmimaa lɛ shishi.
Wɔle akɛ Mla lɛ hi kɛji mɔ ko kɛtsu nii bɔ ni Mla lɛ taoɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ale enɛ faŋŋ akɛ Mla lɛ, jeee jalɔ hewɔ awo, shi mɛi ahewɔ ni awo moŋ ji mlatɔ̃lɔi kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni he tseee kɛ hebulelɔi, tsɛgbelɔi kɛ nyɛgbelɔi, gbɔmɔgbelɔi, ajwamãŋbɔlɔi, hii ni kɛ hii wɔɔ, gbɔmɔ julɔi, amalelɔi, kitãmlikulɔi, kɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ yeee lɛ, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ajɔɔ lɛ lɛ anunyam Sanekpakpa ni atu awo midɛŋ lɛ naa.
Paulo daa Nyɔŋmɔ shi yɛ etsɛmɔ hewɔ Miida wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu ni wo mi hewalɛ lɛ shi, akɛ ebu mi anɔkwafo, ni eŋɔ mi ewo sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli, mi ni tsutsu lɛ mi ji musubɔlɔ kɛ mɛi ayiwalɔ kɛ mɛi aniseniianifeelɔ lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ ana mi mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ mileee ni mifee, yɛ he ni miheee miyeee hewɔ.
Shi wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ dromɔ lɛ fa hã mi aahu kɛteke nɔ, ni nɔ ni fata he kɛba ji hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ.
Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa, akɛ Kristo Yesu ba je nɛɛŋ eba eshafeelɔi ayiwalaheremɔ, mɛi ateŋ ni mi mi ji oti lɛ; shi kɛ̃lɛ enɛ hewɔ ni ana mi mɔbɔ lɛ, koni mi tsutsu mimli Yesu Kristo ajie etsuishitoo lɛ fɛɛ kpo yɛ, ni akɛto mɛi ni baahe enɔ aye ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ okadi.
Shi naanɔi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, mɔ ni gbooo, mɔ ni anaaa, mɔ ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ kome lɛ, aŋɔ woo kɛ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ.
Amen!
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ Kitã ni miwoɔ bo nɛ, mibi Timoteo, yɛ gbalɛi ni agba kɛtsɔ̃ hiɛ yɛ ohe lɛ anaa, koni okɛwu ta kpakpa lɛ, ni ohiɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ henilee kpakpa.
Nɔ ni mɛi komɛi shɛrɛ shwie ni amɛyasha shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Aleksandro, mɛi ni mitu miwo Satan dɛŋ, koni atsɔse amɛ ni amɛkawie musubɔɔ wiemɔi dɔŋŋ lɛ.
Asafo mli jamɔ Agbɛnɛ nɔ klɛŋklɛŋ ni miwoɔ he ŋaa ji akɛ ahiɛ faikpamɔi, sɔlemɔi, mlidaamɔi, shidai amli, ahã gbɔmɛi fɛɛ, ahã maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni yeɔ onukpa lɛ, koni wɔhi shi kpoo yɛ hejɔlɛ mli, yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kɛ jeŋba ni hiɛ sɔɔ fɛɛ mli.
Ejaakɛ enɛ hi ni esa Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ hiɛ.
Esumɔɔ akɛ ehere gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala, koni amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ lee mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kome yɔɔ, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋdamɔlɔ kome hu ni ji gbɔmɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ, mɔ ni ŋɔ ehe ehã akɛ kpɔmɔ nɔ ehã mɛi fɛɛ.
Enɛ ji odase ni aye yɛ be ni sa mli lɛ; ni no hewɔ awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo (anɔkwale miwieɔ yɛ Kristo mli, mimaleee), jeŋmaji atsɔ̃ɔlɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ anɔkwale mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, miitao akɛ hii asɔle yɛ he fɛɛ he ni amɛhole niji ni he tse nɔ ni mlifu loo naataamɔ akaba mli.
Nakai nɔŋŋ yei hu, amɛkɛ atade ni sa kɛ hiɛ ni gboɔ nɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ awula amɛhe, jeee kɛ yigbɔɔ loo shika loo adiagbai loo atade ni jara wa, shi moŋ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ni sa yei ni tsɛɔ amɛhe akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jalɔi lɛ.
Yoo afee dioo ni ekɛ heshibaa fɛɛ akase nii.
Shi mihãaa yoo hegbɛ akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ nii aloo eye nuu nɔ, shi moŋ efee dioo.
Ejaakɛ Adam tsutsu abɔ, no sɛɛ lɛ Hawa.
Ni jeee Adam alaka lɛ, shi yoo lɛ alaka lɛ, ni ebote nɔtɔmɔ mli.
Shi aaahere eyiwala kɛaatsɔ̃ bifɔmɔ nɔ, kɛji ehi shi kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hetsemɔ kɛ heshibaa jwɛŋmɔ.
Asafonɔkwɛlɔi Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ: kɛ mɔ ko miitao nɔkwɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, eetao nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Shi esa akɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ afee mɔ ni anaŋ ehe sane ko atã, mɔ ni yɔɔ ŋa kome, hiɛshikãlɔ, mɔ ni jwɛŋmɔ mli tse, mɔ ni baa ejeŋ jogbaŋŋ, gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni le nitsɔɔmɔ, jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, shi moŋ mɔ ni he jɔ, mɔ ni beee, mɔ ni hiɛ ekɔ̃ɔɔ shika nɔ, mɔ ni yeɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ jogbaŋŋ, ni ebii boɔ lɛ toi kɛ woo fɛɛ.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko leee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe nɔ yeli lɛ, te eeefee tɛŋŋ ekwɛ Nyɔŋmɔ asafo lɛ hu?
Asaŋ jeee mɔ ni bote Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli etsɛko, koni ekawo ehe nɔ ni egbee kojomɔ ni abonsam gbee mli lɛ mli.
Shi sa akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ sɛɛ lɛ hu aye ehe odase kpakpa, koni ehe guɔ akagbo ni ekagbee abonsam tsɔne mli.
Asafoŋ sɔ̃ɔlɔi Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu esa akɛ amɛfee gbɔmɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee lilɛintatsɛmɛi, jeee mɛi ni sumɔɔ dãa, jeee hiɛjoolɔi, shi mɛi ni hiɛɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ teemɔ sane lɛ yɛ henilee ni he tse mli.
Shi mɛnɛɛmɛi hu aka amɛ akwɛ fɛɛ dã; no sɛɛ lɛ, kɛ sane ko bɛ amɛhe lɛ, amɛsɔ̃mɔ.
Yei lɛ hu nakai nɔŋŋ; amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, jeee oshekuyelɔi shi mɛi ni hiɛ kã shi, ni amɛyeɔ anɔkwa yɛ nii fɛɛ mli.
Asafo mli sɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ amɛfee ŋa komekome tsɛmɛi, mɛi ni yeɔ amɛbii kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩai anɔ jogbaŋŋ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ jogbaŋŋ lɛ amɛnaa gbɛnaa kpakpa amɛhãa amɛhe, ni amɛnaa ekãa babaoo yɛ Kristo Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli.
Teemɔ sane wulu lɛ Mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ etsɛŋ ni maba oŋɔɔ; shi miiŋma bo enɛɛmɛi koni kɛ mitsɛ lɛ, ni ole bɔ ni sa akɛ oba ojeŋ ohã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ asafo lɛ, anɔkwale lɛ akulashiŋ kɛ nɔdaamɔnɔ lɛ mli.
Ni nɔ ko ni ŋwanejee ko bɛ he akɛ eda kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ teemɔ sane lɛ: Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe shi faŋŋ yɛ gbɔmɔtso mli, abu lɛ bem yɛ mumɔ mli, bɔfoi na lɛ, ashiɛ lɛ yɛ jeŋmaji ateŋ, ahe enɔ aye yɛ jeŋ, aŋɔ lɛ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ anunyam mli.
Amale tsɔɔlɔi Shi Mumɔ lɛ kɛɔ faŋŋ akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ mɛi komɛi aaakwa hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, ni amɛaabo lakamɔ mumɔi kɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji atsɔ̃ɔmɔi atoi kɛtsɔ̃ amalelɔi asatofeemɔ nɔ; amalelɔi ni ashã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhenilee, tamɔ akɛ dade kɛ la shãa nɔ lɛ; amɛtsiɔ yooŋɔɔ gbɛ, ni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ akɛ ahi ŋmaa ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ akɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ kɛ shidaa aye lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ lɛ ehi, ni ahiii nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛ shidaa yeɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kɛ sɔlemɔ tsuɔ he.
Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa Kɛji otsɔ̃ɔ nyɛmimɛi lɛ enɛɛmɛi lɛ, obaafee ohe Kristo Yesu sɔ̃ɔlɔ kpakpa, mɔ ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa ni onyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ wiemɔi lɛ lɛɔ ehe.
Shi yeimeji ayakayaka adesãi lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he.
Ni otsɔse ohe yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli moŋ.
Ejaakɛ hetsɔsemɔ yɛ gbɔmɔtso gbɛfaŋ he sɛɛnamɔ faaa, shi hetsɔsemɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ mli he yɛ sɛɛnamɔ yɛ nii fiaa mli, ni eyɛ wala ni yɔɔ amrɔ nɛɛ kɛ nɔ ni baaba lɛ he shiwoo.
Eji anɔkwa wiemɔ ni sa akɛ amɔ mli kwraa.
Enɛ hewɔ wɔgboɔ deŋme ni wɔpeleɔ wɔhiɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔkɛ wɔhiɛ efɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ nɔ, mɔ ni ji gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwalaherelɔ lɛ, titri lɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.
Wo nibii nɛɛ ahe kitã ni otsɔ̃ɔ.
Kaahã mɔ ko miibu akɛ ojeee mɔ ko yɛ oblanyo ni oji lɛ hewɔ, shi moŋ okɛ ohe ato okadi ohã mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ, yɛ wiemɔ mli, yɛ hetsemɔ mli.
Okɛ ojwɛŋmɔ afɔ̃ ŋmalɛi lɛ akanemɔ kɛ asafo lɛ hamɔ kɛ ŋaawoo kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maba.
Kaaŋmɛɛ dromɔkeenɔ ni yɔɔ omli ni atsɔ̃ gbalɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ aniji ni akɛshwie onɔ lɛ nɔ akɛhã bo lɛ he.
Tsu nii nɛɛ ahe nii, okɛ ohe awo mli kwraa, koni mɛi fɛɛ ana onɔyaa faŋŋ.
Ohiɛ ahi ohe nɔ, ohiɛ ahi tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ nɔ, hii shi yɛ nii nɛɛ amli; ejaakɛ kɛji ofee enɛ lɛ, ooohere bo diɛŋtsɛ kɛ mɛi ni boɔ bo toi lɛ fɛɛ ayiwala.
Bɔ ni akɛ onukpai kɛ oblahii kɛ oblayei wieɔ Kaafãmɔ onukpa ko, shi moŋ owie otsɔ̃ɔ lɛ akɛ tsɛ; oblahii hu akɛ nyɛmimɛi; yei onukpai lɛ akɛ nyɛmɛi; oblayei lɛ hu akɛ nyɛmimɛiyei yɛ hetsemɔ fɛɛ mli.
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã okulafoi Yei okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ wo amɛ.
Shi kɛ yoo okulafo ko yɛ bii loo nabii lɛ, amɛkase Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛshĩa tsutsu, ni amɛto amɛfɔlɔi lɛ anajiaŋ pɛpɛɛpɛ; ejaakɛ enɛ sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi mɔ ni ji yoo okulafo lɛɛlɛŋ ni eshwɛ ekome too lɛ, ekɛ ehiɛ fɔ̃ɔ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ ni ehiɛɔ faikpamɔi kɛ sɔlemɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Shi yoo okulafo ni bɔɔ ahoshwi lɛ, ehiɛ kã nɛ, shi egbo.
Wo amɛ kitãi nɛɛ, koni akana amɛhe sane ko atã.
Shi kɛ mɔ ko kwɛɛɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi, titri lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eshĩabii lɛ, ekpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ sɛɛ, ni efaŋ mɔ ni heee yeee fe lɛ.
Akaŋɔ yoo okulafo ko awo sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli akɛ ja mɔ ni eye afii nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni egbã nuu kome ni ayeɔ enitsumɔi kpakpai ahe odase, no ji: kɛ elɛ bii, kɛ efee mɛi agbɔ, kɛ efɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi anaji ahe, kɛ eye ebua mɛi ni naa amanehulu lɛ, kɛ edi nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa sɛɛ lɛ.
Shi yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ, kaaŋɔ amɛ; ejaakɛ kɛ akɔnɔ te shi yɛ amɛmli ni ejie amɛ kɛjɛ Kristo he lɛ, amɛtaoɔ gbãlã, ni amɛnaa kojomɔ ejaakɛ amɛku amɛklɛŋklɛŋ shiwoo lɛ mli.
Ni amɛsaa amɛkaseɔ hejɔ̃feemɔ, amɛkpaa shi yɛ shĩai, ni jeee hejɔ̃lɔi kɛkɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔɔ, shi amɛwiewieɔ mɛi ahe hu, amɛkɛ amɛhe woɔ mɛi asaji amli, amɛwieɔ nii ni esaaa.
No hewɔ lɛ, miisumɔ akɛ yei okulafoi ni drako lɛ agbã, ni amɛfɔ bii, ni amɛye amɛwe nɔ, ni amɛkahã henyɛlɔ lɛ miina hegbɛ ko kɛmiijɛ wɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi komɛi ekpale eyanyiɛ Satan sɛɛ momo.
Shi kɛ nuu loo yoo heyelɔ ko yɛ wekumɛi yei okulafoi lɛ, ekwɛ amɛ, ni jatsu akakã asafo lɛ nɔ, koni asafo lɛ akwɛ okulafoi ni ji okulafoi lɛɛlɛŋ lɛ.
Timoteo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ hã asafonukpai Onukpai ni tsuɔ amɛnii jogbaŋŋ akɛ nɔkwɛlɔi lɛ, abu amɛ akɛ amɛsa woo toi enyɔ, titri lɛ mɛi ni tsuɔ shiɛmɔ kɛ nitsɔɔmɔ he nii waa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Kaawo tsina ni gbɛlɛɔ abele naabu kotoku;” kɛ, “Nitsulɔ lɛ, enyɔmɔwoo sa lɛ.” Kɛ afolɔ onukpa ko naa lɛ, kaahe okpɛ̃lɛ akɛ ja yɛ odasefoi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ naa dã.
Mɛi ni feɔ esha lɛ, okã amɛ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, koni mɛi ni eshwɛ lɛ hu ashe gbeyei.
Miiwo bo kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo Yesu kɛ ebɔfoi ni ehala lɛ ahiɛ, akɛ oye nii nɛɛ anɔ ni okasha ohe okojo, ni asaŋ okafee nɔ ko kɛ niiaŋkpamɔ.
Kɛ oniji akashwie mɔ ko nɔ oya, ni asaŋ kaafata mɛi krokomɛi ahe kɛfee esha.
Too ohe krɔŋŋ.
Kaanu nu kɛkɛ dɔŋŋ, shi nuu wain fioo yɛ omusu kɛ ohelai ni yeɔ bo kpitiokpitio lɛ ahewɔ.
Mɛi komɛi ahe eshai jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni enyiɛɔ amɛhiɛ ekɛ amɛ yaa kojomɔ mli, shi mɛi komɛi anɔ hu nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ kɛ̃ nitsumɔi kpakpai hu jeɔ kpo faŋŋ, ni nii ni ejeee kpo lɛ hu anyɛŋ akɛtee.
Tsuji kɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi Tsuji abɔ ni yɔɔ apã shishi lɛ abu amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ akɛ mɛi ni sa woo fɛɛ, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ gbɛi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.
Shi tsuji ni yɔɔ nuŋtsɔmɛi heyelɔi lɛ akaŋɔ lɛ akɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ nyɛmimɛi ji amɛ hewɔ lɛ esaaa akɛ hiɛ sɔɔ amɛ, shi moŋ amɛsɔ̃mɔ amɛ jogbaŋŋ ejaakɛ mɛi ni naa sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɛɛ he sɛɛ lɛ nyɛmimɛi heyelɔi kɛ suɔmɔmɛi ji amɛ.
Tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii nɛɛ ni owo he ŋaa.
Amale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ anɔkwa ninamɔ Kɛ mɔ ko tsɔ̃ɔ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kroko ni ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo wiemɔi ni hi lɛ kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ naa lɛ nɔ lɛ, no lɛ ewo ehe nɔ, eleee nɔ ko, shi moŋ eeye ŋwanejee kɛ naataamɔ hela, ni nibii ni jɛɔ mli ji hiɛkɔ̃ɔ, bei, oshekuyeli, mɛi ahe susumɔi fɔ̃ji, yakayaka blɔmɔi — enɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ mɛi ateŋ ni anaa yɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni amɛjwɛŋmɔ efite ni ashɔ̃ anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛdɛŋ ni amɛsusuɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ ji ninamɔ lɛ.
Shi lɛɛlɛŋ, ninamɔ kpeteŋkple ji Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, kɛji mɔ ko miishɛ enii ahe lɛ.
Ejaakɛ wɔkɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko baaa je nɛɛŋ, no hewɔ lɛ, wɔnyɛŋ wɔkɛ nɔ ko aya hu.
Shi kɛ wɔyɛ ŋmaa kɛ hehaanii kɛkɛ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔmii ashɛ he.
Shi mɛi ni taoɔ afee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ gbeɔ kaa kɛ tsɔne kɛ kwashiai akɔnɔi pii ni fiteɔ mɔ, ni tsiɔ mɛi ewoɔ hiɛkpãtãmɔ kɛ laajemɔ mli lɛ amli.
Ejaakɛ nibii fɔ̃ji fɛɛ ashĩshifã ji shikasuɔmɔ ni mɛi komɛi di sɛɛ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli, ni amɛkɛ piŋmɔi babaoo egbulɔ amɛtsui lɛ.
Ŋaawoi Shi bo lɛ, Ao Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ, joo nibii nɛɛ anaa foi, ni onyiɛ jalɛ, Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ, hiɛmiamɔ, kɛ kpoofeemɔ sɛɛ.
Wuu hemɔkɛyeli he ta kpakpa lɛ, mɔ naanɔ wala lɛ mli, nɔ he hu ni atsɛ bo kɛba ni ojaje jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo yɛ odasefoi pii ahiɛ lɛ.
Miiwo bo kitã yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hãa nibii fiaa wala lɛ kɛ Kristo Yesu ni ye jajemɔ fɛɛfɛo lɛ he odase yɛ Pontio Pilato yinɔ lɛ hiɛ, akɛ oye kitã lɛ nɔ, ni kpa ko loo shwamɔ ko akahi he kɛyashi wɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo puemɔ lɛ mli, nɔ ni nɔyelɔ kome ni yɔɔ hewalɛ ni ajɔɔ lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ kɛ nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ lɛ baahã aba mli yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa mli lɛ.
Lɛ ekome eyɔɔ naanɔ shihilɛ ni gbele bɛ mli, ni ehiɔ la ni anyɛŋ abɛŋkɛ mli; gbɔmɔ ko gbɔmɔ ko enako lɛ dã, ni enyɛŋ lɛ ena hu lɛ.
Enɔ ji woo kɛ naanɔ hewalɛ lɛ.
Amen!
Niiatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ je nɛɛŋ lɛ, wo amɛ kitã ni amɛkabu amɛhe tsɔ̃, ni amɛkɛ amɛhiɛ akafɔ̃ ninamɔ ni anyɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ he afɔ̃ nɔ lɛ nɔ, shi moŋ amɛkɛfɔ̃ Nyɔŋmɔ, mɔ hu ni kɛ nibii fɛɛ hãa wɔ babaoo, akɛ wɔye mliŋɔɔmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni amɛfee ejurɔ ni amɛtsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai amli, amɛsumɔ nihãmɔ, amɛdɛŋ akpɔ.
Amɛbɔ jwetri amɛhã amɛhe ni efee shishitoo kpakpa ehã be ni baaba lɛ, koni amɛmɔ anɔkwa wala lɛ mli.
Ao Timoteo, nii ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ, baamɔ yi ni okwa yakayaka sanegbaa ni buleɔ mɔ kɛ wiemɔi ni bɛ ekome ni jɛ apasa nilee mli.
Ni mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ amɛyɔɔ ni amɛdu gbɛ kɛjɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ he lɛ.
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Paulo wolo ni ji enyɔ ni eŋma emaje Timoteo lɛ efã kpotoo ji ŋaa ni ewo Timoteo akɛ enaanyo fio ni fata ehe ni ekɛ lɛ tsuɔ nii.
Titri lɛ ewo lɛ ŋaa ni ekã he ena Sanekpakpa lɛ he amanehulu.
Ewo lɛ ŋaa kɛ hewalɛ hu ni eya nɔ eye Yesu Kristo he odase yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli, ni ehiɛ anɔkwale tsɔ̃ɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Sanekpakpa lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli lɛ mli gbãgbãlii, ni etsu enii tamɔ tsɔ̃ɔlɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ shiɛlɔ, tsɛ ebaana nɔ ni abaate shi ashi lɛ moŋ nɛ.
Paulo je gbɛ ebɔ Timoteo kɔkɔ ni etsi ehe kɛjɛ oshrãi ni yɔɔ kwashiai anaataamɔ ni akɛkaseee nɔ ko lɛ he, ejaakɛ amɛhe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko akɛ fe hiɛkpãtãmɔ moŋ amɛkɛbaa mɛi ni gboɔ toi lɛ anɔ.
Yɛ enɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ, Paulo kai Timoteo akɛ ekɛ lɛ Paulo diɛŋtsɛ ewala kɛ oti afee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ — no ji ehemɔkɛyeli, tsuishitoo, suɔmɔ, hiɛmiamɔ yɛ amanehulu mli kɛ nɔnaa yɛ yiwaa mli.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Yijiemɔ kɛ ŋaawoo .—.
Ŋaawoo kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ .—.
Nɔ ni kɔɔ Paulo diɛŋtsɛ kɛkɛ he .- Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ kɛ shidaa Paulo, ni ji Kristo Yesu bɔfo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔ naa kɛ wala ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ he shiwoo naa lɛ, ŋma yahã esuɔmɔ bi Timoteo.
Dromɔ, mɔbɔnalɛ, hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ Kristo Yesu lɛ dɛŋ ahã bo!
Midaa Nyɔŋmɔ ni mijaa lɛ kɛ henilee krɔŋŋ tamɔ bɔ ni miniimɛi ja lɛ lɛ shi daa kɛ mikai bo yɛ mifaikpamɔi amli nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.
Ni kɛ mikai ohiɛ yaafonui lɛ, mishweɔ akɛ mana bo, koni mayi obɔ̃ kɛ miishɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ mikaiɔ ohemɔkɛyeli ni osato bɛ mli lɛ, ni yɔɔ onaa Loise kɛ onyɛ Eunike mli tsutsu, ni miyɛ nɔmimaa akɛ eyɛ bo hu omli lɛ.
Timoteo kɛ edromɔ keenii No hewɔ lɛ, miikai bo ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ keenɔ ni yɔɔ omli yɛ miniji ni mikɛshwie onɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ, otee lɛ shi ni etso, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hãaa wɔ gbeyeishemɔ mumɔ, shi moŋ hewalɛ kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni sa mumɔ ekɛhã wɔ.
No hewɔ lɛ, ohiɛ akagbo yɛ wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ he odaseyeli lɛ he aloo yɛ mi ni mi ji egboklɛfonyo lɛ he, shi moŋ naa Sanekpakpa lɛ he amanehulu lɛ eko yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hewalɛ naa.
Lɛ ehere wɔyiwala ni ekɛ tsɛmɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ tsɛ wɔ, jeee wɔnitsumɔi anaa, shi moŋ yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eyiŋtoo kɛ edromɔ naa, nɔ ni ekɛ hã wɔ yɛ Kristo Yesu mli dani aje be shishi, ni agbɛnɛ atsɔ̃ wɔyiwalaherelɔ, Yesu Kristo, puemɔ lɛ nɔ ajie lɛ shi faŋŋ lɛ.
Lɛ efo gbele sɛɛ, ni ejie wala kɛ naanɔ shihilɛ kpo etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ mli.
Enɛ he awo mi shiɛlɔ kɛ bɔfo kɛ tsɔɔlɔ yɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ nɔŋŋ minaa amanehului nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ mihiɛ gbooo; ejaakɛ mile mɔ ni mihe miye lɛ, ni miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ akɛ eeenyɛ ebu nii ni mitu miwo edɛŋ lɛ he kɛyashi nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Hiɛmɔ wiemɔi ni hi ni onu yɛ minaa akɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ lɛ mli yɛ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ suɔmɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Nɔ kpakpa ni atu awo odɛ̃ŋ lɛ buu he yɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni hiɔ wɔmli lɛ hewalɛ naa!
Mɛi ni kpa yɛ Paulo sɛɛ kɛ mɔ ni damɔ esɛɛ kpɛŋŋ Ole enɛ akɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ Asia lɛ fɛɛ kpa yɛ misɛɛ; amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Figelo kɛ Hermogene.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ana Onesiforo we lɛ mɔbɔ, ejaakɛ ebahãa mi tsui kpitiokpitio, ni ehiɛ gbooo mikɔ̃sɔ̃ŋkɔ̃sɔ̃ lɛ he; shi be ni eba Roma lɛ, ebɔ mɔdɛŋ etao mi ni ena mi.
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ahã ena Nuŋtsɔ lɛ dɛŋ mɔbɔnalɛ yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ.
Ni bɔ ni etsɔ̃ esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ Efeso lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ole jogbaŋŋ.
Kristo Yesu tabilɔ kpakpa Agbɛnɛ mibi, bo lɛ ohe awa yɛ dromɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ mli.
Ni nii ni onu yɛ minaa yɛ odasefoi pii ahiɛ lɛ, tuu owo gbɔmɛi anɔkwafoi adɛŋ, mɛi ni aaanyɛ atsɔ̃ɔ mɛi krokomɛi hu lɛ.
Naa amanehulu lɛ eko, tamɔ Kristo Yesu tabilɔ kpakpa ko.
Mɔ ko enyiɛɛɛ ta gbɛ ni ekɛ ehe wo shĩa saji amli, koni esa mɔ ni fã lɛ kɛtee ta lɛ lɛŋ lɛ hiɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko miishi mple hu lɛ, afiŋ lɛ kunim akekre, akɛ ja eshi lɛ mla naa.
Okwaafonyo ni tsuɔ nii lɛ, lɛ tsutsu sa akɛ ena yibii lɛ eko.
Jwɛŋmɔ nɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ he, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaahã ona nii fɛɛ shishi.
Ohiɛ ahi Yesu Kristo ni te shi kɛjɛ gbohii ateŋ ni jɛ David shwie mli lɛ nɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ yɛ mi-Sanekpakpa lɛ shiɛmɔ mli lɛ.
No mli amane nɔŋŋ minaa, kɛyashi kpãi amli tete, tamɔ efɔŋfeelɔ ko nɛɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ awooo lɛ kpãa.
Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, mimiaa mihiɛ yɛ saji fɛɛ amli yɛ mɛi ni ahala amɛ lɛ ahewɔ, koni amɛ hu amɛnine ashɛ yiwalaheremɔ ni yɔɔ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ kɛ naanɔ anunyam lɛ nɔ.
Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ, “Kɛ wɔ kɛ lɛ gbo lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaana wala hu; kɛ wɔmia wɔhiɛ lɛ, wɔ kɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ hu; kɛ wɔkpa yɛ esɛɛ lɛ, lɛ hu eeekpa yɛ wɔsɛɛ.
Kɛ wɔfeee wɔhe anɔkwafoi lɛ, lɛ lɛ eeehi shi anɔkwafo, Enyɛŋ ekpa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe sɛɛ.” Nitsulɔ ni sa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ Kaimɔ amɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ, ni oma nɔ mí ohã amɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni amɛkawu naabu ta ni sɛɛnamɔ ko bɛ he, shi ebutuɔ mɛi ni nuɔ lɛ moŋ lɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni okɛ ohe adamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ akɛ mɔ ko ni sa, nitsulɔ ni hiɛ gbooo, ni tsɔ̃ɔ anɔkwale wiemɔ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Shi yaka wiemɔ ni buleɔ mɔ lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he; ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nɛkɛ lɛ aaaya nɔ awo wu yɛ bu ni abuuu Nyɔŋmɔ mli.
Ni amɛwiemɔ lɛ aaafee tamɔ fala fɔŋ ni yeɔ heloo.
Amɛteŋ mɛi komɛi ji Himeneo kɛ Fileto, mɛi ni edu gbɛ kɛjɛ anɔkwale lɛ he, ni amɛkɛɔ akɛ shitee lɛ eho momo, ni amɛbutuɔ mɛi komɛi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Kɛ̃lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shishitoo ni wa lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni ehiɛ nɛkɛ naasɔomɔnɔ nɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ le lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɛi lɛ,” kɛ “Mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni tsiɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ tã lɛ atsi ehe kɛjɛ nii ni ejaaa gbɛ lɛ ahe.” Shi shĩa wulu mli lɛ, jeee shikanii kɛ jwiɛtɛinii kɛkɛ yɔɔ jɛi, shi moŋ tsonii kɛ sunii hu yɛ mli, ni ekomɛi lɛ abuɔ amɛ, shi ekomɛi hu abuuu.
Agbɛnɛ kɛji mɔ ko tsuu ehe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ amli lɛ, eeetsɔ̃ nɔ ni akɛfeɔ nii ni yɔɔ nyam ni atsuu he krɔŋŋ, ni hi hã shĩatsɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ, ni asaa ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Shi oblahiiaŋ sɛɛdii lɛ hu, joo naa foi, ni okɛ mɛi ni tsɛɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛjeɔ tsui ni mli tse mli lɛ atiu jalɛ, hemɔkɛyeli, suɔmɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ.
Shi kwashiai aŋwanejee ni akɛkaseee nɔ ko lɛ tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ ole akɛ ekɛ bei baa; shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsulɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ ebeɔ, shi moŋ efee mɔ ni mli jɔ hã mɛi fɛɛ, mɔ ni le nitsɔɔmɔ, mɔ ni toɔ etsui shi, mɔ ni kɛ mlijɔlɛ wieɔ tsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni kuɔ enaa, akɛ aleenɔ Nyɔŋmɔ ahã amɛ tsuitsakemɔ ni amɛle anɔkwale lɛ.
Ni amɛhiɛ aaatserɛ amɛ ni amɛaaje abonsam tsɔne lɛ mli lo; ejaakɛ ekɛdu amɛ ni amɛfee esuɔmɔnaanii.
Naagbee gbii lɛ Shi na enɛ ole akɛ naagbee gbii lɛ amli lɛ jaramɔ bei baaba.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi aaatsɔ̃mɔ hesuɔlɔi, shikasuɔlɔi, shwãlɔi, hewolɔi, mɔjɛlɔi, fɔlɔi anɔ toigbolɔi, trumui, mɛi ni he tseee, mɛi ni edɔɔɔ mɔ he, kpãŋmɔmlikulɔi, oshekuyelɔi, mɛi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛkɔnɔ nɔ amɛye, mɛi ni hiɛ yɔɔ la, mɛi ni sumɔɔɔ ekpakpa, sɛɛgbɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni feɔ nii ni amɛjwɛŋŋ he, henɔwolɔi, mɛi ni sumɔɔ shwɛmɔ kɛ ŋɔɔmɔ fe Nyɔŋmɔ, mɛi ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ kpo nɔ gbɛ su lɛ mli, shi amɛkwa emli hewalɛ lɛ.
Tsi ohe kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbɔmɛi ahe.
Ejaakɛ mɛnɛɛmɛi ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji mɛi ni juɔ shi boteɔ shĩai ni amɛnine shɛɔ yei ni bɛ yitseiaŋ ni esha edɔdɔɔ amɛ ni akɔnɔi srɔtoi kpalaa amɛ lɛ anɔ.
Yei ni kaseɔ nii daa, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛnyɛɛɛ amɛshɛ anɔkwale lɛ he lɛ.
Shi tamɔ bɔ ni Yane kɛ Yambre ku Mose naa lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ nɛkɛ mɛi nɛɛ kuɔ anɔkwale lɛ naa; gbɔmɛi ni yitseiaŋ efite, mɛi ni jeee mɛi komɛi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ gbɛfaŋ.
Shi amɛyaŋ amɛhiɛ tuutu ko; ejaakɛ amɛkwashiafeemɔ lɛ aaaje kpo fãŋŋ yɛ mɛi fɛɛ ahiɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi enyɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ hu je kpo lɛ.
Nibii ni baahã Timoteo afi shi Shi bo lɛ, ole mitsɔ̃ɔmɔ, mijeŋba, miyiŋtoo, mihemɔkɛyeli, mitsuishitoo, misuɔmɔ, mihiɛmiamɔ, miyiwai, mimanehului ni mina yɛ Antiokia kɛ Ikonium kɛ Listra lɛ, nɔ yiwai srɔtoi abɔ ni mina ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ jie mi kɛjɛ fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Shi mɛi fɛɛ hu ni taoɔ akɛ amɛaahi shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ naa yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, aaawa amɛyi.
Shi gbɔmɛi fɔ̃ji kɛ shishiulɔi aaawo wu yɛ efɔŋ mli; amɛlakaa mɛi ni amɛ hu alakaa amɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, hii shi yɛ nii ni okase ni oyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ amli, ejaakɛ ole mɛi anaa ni okase yɛ, ni ogbekɛbiiashi ojɛ ole Ŋmalɛi Krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni aaanyɛ ahã ole nii hã yiwalaheremɔ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo nɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ.
Ŋmalɛ fɛɛ ŋmalɛ lɛ ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Mumɔ lɛ mli, ni ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ hiɛkãmɔ kɛ mɔsaamɔ kɛ tsɔsemɔ ni yɔɔ jalɛ mli lɛ, koni Nyɔŋmɔ gbɔmɔ lɛ aye emuu, ni asaa lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ahã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Paulo miitu nitsumɔ lɛ ewo Timoteo dɛŋ Miifã bo yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo ni baaba ebakojo hiɛkãalɔi kɛ gbohii lɛ ahiɛ, ni mikɛ epuemɔ kɛ emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ miifã bo akɛ, Shiɛmɔ wiemɔ lɛ, kã he, be ni hi jio, be ni ehiii jio, kã hiɛ, wo ŋaa, tsɔ̃ɔmɔ nii kɛ tsuishitoo fɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ko baaba ni gbɔmɛi ekpɛlɛŋ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ amɛaabua tsɔɔlɔi anaa amɛwo amɛhe yɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛkɔnɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ amɛtoiiaŋ miifɛlɛ̃ amɛ; ni amɛaakpala anɔkwale lɛ yɛ amɛtoii asɛɛ, ni amɛaakpale kɛyanyiɛ adesãi asɛɛ.
Shi bo lɛ, ohiɛ akã shi yɛ nii fɛɛ mli, miamɔ ohiɛ yɛ amanehului amli, tsu Sanekpakpashiɛlɔ nitsumɔ lɛ, gbee osɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa kwraa!
Paulo miiwie enitsumɔ kɛ ewala naagbee he Ejaakɛ mi lɛ, aafɔse mila aashwie shi momo akɛ afɔle, ni mimliyimɔ be lɛ eshɛ.
Ta kpakpa lɛ, miwu; foidamɔ lɛ, mida migbe naa; hemɔkɛyeli lɛ, mihiɛ mli tswɛ.
Nɔ ni eshwɛ ni kã shi hã mi ji jalɛ akekre lɛ, ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji jalɛ kojolɔ lɛ baahã mi yɛ nakai Gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni jeee mikome ebaahã, shi moŋ mɛi bluublu hu ni sumɔɔ epuemɔ lɛ.
Wiemɔi ni kɔɔ Paulo kɛkɛ he Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ oya.
Ejaakɛ ní Dema esumɔ amrɔmrɔ je nɛɛŋ hewɔ lɛ, eshi mi etee Tesalonika.
Kreske etee Galatia, Tito etee Dalmatia.
Luka pɛ kɛ mi yɔɔ.
Ŋɔɔ Marko ni okɛ lɛ aba, ejaakɛ ehe yɛ sɛɛnamɔ hã mi yɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ mli.
Tihiko lɛ, mitsu lɛ Efeso.
Atade lɛ ni mishi yɛ Troia yɛ Karpo ŋɔɔ lɛ, kɛ ooba lɛ okɛba, kɛ woji lɛ hu, titri lɛ amɛteŋ nii ni aŋmala yɛ kooloi ahewolo nɔ lɛ.
Aleksandro, sɔ̃lɔ lɛ, fee mi efɔŋ naakpa; Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ato lɛ najiaŋ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Bo hu kwɛ ohe ni ahi yɛ ehe ejaakɛ eku wɔwiemɔi lɛ anaa waa naakpa.
Miklɛŋklɛŋ naajiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko eyawaaa mi, shi moŋ amɛ fɛɛ amɛshi mi; akabu enɛ afɔ̃ amɛnɔ.
Shi Nuŋtsɔ lɛ fi misɛɛ ni ewo mi hewalɛ, koni atsɔ̃ minɔ ashiɛ shiɛmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ, ni jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ anu; ni ajie mi yɛ jata lɛ daaŋ.
Ni jiemɔ kɛ̃ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaajie mi kɛaajɛ efɔŋ fɛɛ efɔŋ mli, ni eeehere miyiwala kɛaatee eŋwɛi maŋtsɛyeli lɛ mli.
Lɛ aŋɔ anunyam ahã kɛyashi naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ.
Amen!
Shɛɛ kɛ ŋamɔi Miibi Priskila kɛ Akwila kɛ Onesiforo we lɛ.
Erasto yɛ Korinto lolo; shi Trofimo lɛ, mishi lɛ yɛ Mileto ni ehe miiye.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba dani fɛ̃i be lɛ ashɛ.
Eubulo kɛ Pude kɛ Lino kɛ Klaudia kɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ fɛɛ miibi bo Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo kɛ omumɔ lɛ ahi shi!
Dromɔ kɛ nyɛ ahi shi!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Tito lɛ Jeŋmajiaŋnyo ni etsɔ̃ Kristofonyo ji lɛ.
Ekɛ Paulo bɔ naanyo ni ekɛ lɛ tsu nii ni eye ebua lɛ yɛ esanekpakpashiɛmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ mli.
Paulo ŋma ewolo lɛ eyahã Tito ni ji oblanyo fioo ni fata ehe kɛtsu nii yɛ Kreta lɛ, ni eshi lɛ yɛ jɛmɛ koni ekwɛ jɛmɛ asafo lɛ nitsumɔ lɛ nɔ.
Nibii etɛ̃ jeɔ kpo faŋŋ yɛ wolo nɛɛ mli.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, Paulo kai Tito jeŋba ni sa asafoŋ nitsulɔi, titri lɛ yɛ subaŋ gbohii ni mɛi pii ni yɔɔ Kreta lɛ yɔɔ lɛ hewɔ.
No sɛɛ lɛ ewo Tito ŋaa bɔ ni etsɔ̃ɔ asafoŋ kui srɔtoi srɔtoi lɛ anii ehã: hiimeji kɛ yeimeji (amɛ hu amɛbaatsɔ̃ amɛnikasemɔ lɛ nɔ amɛkɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblayei anii) kɛ oblahii kɛ nyɔji.
Naagbee lɛ, Paulo wo Tito ŋaa yɛ Kristofoi ajeŋba hewɔ, titri lɛ akɛ sa ni amɛfee kpoo ni amɛsumɔsumɔɔ amɛhe, ni amɛkaŋmɛ gbɛ hu ni hetsɛ̃, niianaataamɔ kɛ mligblamɔ hi asafo lɛ mli.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ .- Asafoŋ nitsulɔi .- Asafo lɛ mli kui srɔtoi agbɛnaa .- Ŋaawoo kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ .- Naamuu .-
Ŋamɔ Paulo, ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ kɛ Yesu Kristo bɔfo lɛ, ŋma wolo nɛɛ.
Nyɔŋmɔ hala mi ni etsu mi koni mayawo Nyɔŋmɔ halamɔbii lɛ ahemɔkɛyeli kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ anɔkwale lɛ he nilee lɛ mli hewalɛ, ni amɛna naanɔ wala lɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ.
Naanɔ wala nɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo he shi dani abɔ je lɛ.
Shi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ebe ni sa lɛ mli lɛ ejie ewiemɔ lɛ shi etsɔ̃ɔ yɛ shiɛmɔ sane ni atuu awo midɛŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ fãmɔ naa lɛ mli.
Miŋma wolo nɛɛ miyahã Tito ni ji mibi krɔŋŋ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli koome ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ naa.
Dromɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ Tsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ, dɛŋ ahã bo.
Tito nitsumɔ yɛ Kreta Enɛ hewɔ mishi bo yɛ Kreta, koni oto nii ni eshwɛ lɛ gbɛjianɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ni owowoo onukpai yɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni mikɛɛ bo momo lɛ.
Onukpa afee mɔ ko ni kpa ko bɛ ehe, mɔ ko ni yɔɔ ŋa kome ni eyɔɔ bii ni heɔ Kristo nɔ yeɔ ni awieee amɛhe akɛ nyɛnyɛŋtswibɔlɔi loo toigbolɔi ji amɛ.
Ejaakɛ nɔkwɛlɔ lɛ, esaaa akɛ kpa ko hiɔ ehe, akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ we nɔ tsulɔnukpa ji lɛ lɛ.
Ekafee ehe mɔ ni feɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuinaanii, jeee mlifutsɛ, jeee dãanulɔ, jeee ninekpokpookpotsɛ, jeee hiɛjoolɔ.
Shi moŋ efee ehe gbɔfeelɔ, mɔ ni sumɔɔ ekpakpa, nilelɔ, jalɔ, mɔ ni he tse, mɔ ni yeɔ ehe nɔ.
Mɔ ni hiɛɔ anɔkwa wiemɔ lɛ yɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ naa lɛ mli, koni enyɛ ekɛ nitsɔɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ awo mɛi ahewalɛ, ni ehã mɛi ni wieɔ shiɔ wiemɔ lɛ ana amɛtɔ̃mɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi pii yɛ ni ji toigbolɔi, mɛi ni wieɔ nii ni he bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, kɛ shishiulɔi, titri lɛ mɛi ni jɛ ketiafolɔi lɛ ateŋ lɛ.
Amɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni sa akɛ awo amɛnaa manyoflɛ.
Amɛ, amɛbutuɔ shĩai muji fɛɛ, ni sɛɛnamɔ ni yɔɔ hiɛgbele hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃ɔ nii ni ejaaa.
Amɛteŋ mɔ ko ni ji amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛgbalɔ lɛ kɛɛ akɛ, “Kretabii maleɔ daa; kooloi fɔ̃ji ni; ŋmaayelɔi hejɔ̃lɔi ni.” Nɛkɛ odase nɛɛ anɔkwale ni.
No hewɔ lɛ, kã amɛhiɛ veveeve, koni amɛhemɔkɛyeli afee hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa, ni amɛkabo Yudafoi adesai lɛ kɛ gbɔmɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛjɛɔ anɔkwale lɛ mli lɛ akitãi lɛ atoi.
Mɛi ni he tse lɛ, nii fɛɛ he tse hã amɛ; shi mɛi ni he tseee ni amɛheee Nyɔŋmɔ amɛyeee lɛ, nɔ ko nɔ ko bɛ ni he tse hã amɛ, shi moŋ amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli kɛ amɛhenilee fɛɛ ewo muji.
Amɛjajeɔ akɛ amɛle Nyɔŋmɔ, shi amɛkɛ amɛnitsumɔi kwaa lɛ, ni amɛ ji gbɔmɛi ni ahiɔ, kɛ toigbolɔi, mɛi ni ehiii hãaa nitsumɔ kpakpa ko kwraa.
Jeŋba he nitsɔɔmɔi titrii komɛi Shi bo lɛ, wiemɔ nibii ni sa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kpakpa lɛ.
Hiimeji lɛ, amɛhiɛ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni hiɛ tsii, amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi, amɛfee mɛi ni yɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli kpakpa kɛ suɔmɔ kɛ hiɛmiamɔ.
Yeimeji hu nakai nɔŋŋ, amɛba amɛjeŋ bɔ ni sa mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ.
Amɛkafee amɛhe oshekuyelɔi, amɛkafee amɛhe mɛi ni dãa eŋɔ amɛ nom, amɛfee mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ nii kpakpai.
Koni amɛtsɔ̃ɔ oblayei lɛ ni amɛsumɔ amɛwumɛi, amɛsumɔ amɛbii, amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi, amɛhe atse, amɛtsu amɛshĩa nii jogbaŋŋ, amɛmli ahi, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛwumɛi, koni akawie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ he musubɔɔ wiemɔ.
Oblahii hu nakai nɔŋŋ, wiemɔ otsɔ̃ɔ amɛ koni amɛjwɛŋmɔ akã shi.
Ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli lɛ, ŋɔɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ ohe ofee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ohã amɛ yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai agbɛfaŋ.
Nitsɔɔmɔ mli lɛ hã ana bo akɛ mɔ ni miifee kɛ tsui krɔŋŋ kɛ hiɛdɔɔ.
Owiemɔ ahi bɔ ni anaŋ he sane ko atã, bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni kɛ wɔ yeee lɛ hiɛ agbo, yɛ na ni enaaa nɔsha ko ekɛɛ yɛ wɔhe lɛ hewɔ.
Tsuji lɛ, amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛnuŋtsɔmɛi lɛ, amɛsa amɛhiɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli.
Amɛkajie sane naa, amɛkashara nii, shi moŋ amɛhã ana amɛ akɛ mɛi ni yeɔ anɔkwa kɛmɔ shi, koni amɛkɛwula Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔ lɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ mli.
Nɔ nɔ ni Kristofoi ajeŋba damɔ Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ ni akɛhereɔ gbɔmɛi fɛɛ ayiwala lɛ epue.
Ni etsɔseɔ wɔ koni wɔkwa she ni asheee Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei kɛ je nɛɛŋ akɔnɔi lɛ ni wɔkɛ hiɛshikãmɔ kɛ jalɛ nifeemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ ahi shi yɛ je nɛɛŋ, be mli ni wɔmiikwɛ jɔɔmɔ ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ kɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ kpeteŋkple kɛ wɔyiwalaherelɔ Yesu Krito anunyam lɛ puemɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Lɛ ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe hã yɛ wɔnajiaŋ, koni ekpɔ̃ wɔ kɛjɛ nɔtɔmɔ fɛɛ mli, ni etsuu wɔhe ehã ehe akɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ, maŋ ni hiɛ dɔɔ yɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe lɛ.
Wiemɔ nii nɛɛ, ni owo amɛ ŋaa yɛ he, ni okã amɛhiɛ yɛ he kɛ hewalɛ fɛɛ.
Kaahã mɔ ko miigbe ohe guɔ.
Kristofoi ajeŋba Kaimɔ amɛ ni amɛba amɛhe shi amɛhã onukpai kɛ nɔyelɔi lɛ, amɛbo amɛ toi, amɛsaa amɛhe amɛhã nitsumɔ kpakpa fɛɛ nitsumɔ kpakpa.
Amɛkawie mɔ ko he efɔŋ, amɛkabe, shi moŋ amɛfee kpoo, ni amɛhã mɛi fɛɛ ana amɛ akɛ amɛhe jɔ kwraa.
Ejaakɛ sa lɛ, wɔ hu wɔfee wɔhe kwashiai, toigbolɔi, gbɛdulɔi, mɛi ni sɔmɔɔ akɔnɔi kɛ miishɛɛ nibii srɔtoi pii.
Ni wɔba wɔjeŋ yɛ nifɔɔjianifeemɔ kɛ hetsɛ̃ mli, wɔhe yɛ taŋ, ni wɔnyɛnyɛɔ wɔhe.
Shi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ mlihilɛ kɛ egbɔmɛiahedɔɔ lɛ pue lɛ, jeee jalɛ nitsumɔi ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔtsu naa, shi moŋ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emɔbɔnalɛ naa etsɔ̃ eheefɔmɔ hejuu kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ eheefeemɔ lɛ nɔ ehere wɔyiwala.
Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ nɛɛ etsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo, wɔyiwalaherelɔ lɛ nɔ, efɔse eshwie wɔnɔ babaoo, koni ahã wɔtsɔ̃mɔ niyelɔi yɛ naanɔ wala lɛ gbɛfaŋ yɛ hiɛnɔkãmɔ naa, akɛni abu wɔ bem yɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ edromɔ naa lɛ.
Anɔkwa wiemɔ nɛ.
Ni nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ anɔ mi mitaoɔ akɛ oma, koni mɛi ni ehe Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ amɛye lɛ akwɛ ni amɛbɔ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋ.
Enɛɛmɛi ji nii ni yɔɔ fɛo ni he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ hã gbɔmɛi.
Shi kwashiai aŋwanejei kɛ wekukpãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ naataamɔ kɛ Mla he bei lɛ, tsi ohe kɛjɛ he, ejaakɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ni ejeee fɛi hu.
Gbɔmɔ ko ni kɛ mligbalamɔ baa lɛ, kɛ obɔ lɛ kɔkɔ shi kome kɛ shii enyɔ lɛ, kwa lɛ.
Ejaakɛ ole akɛ mɔ ko ni yɔɔ nakai lɛ, eje eŋɛlɛnɔ ni efeɔ esha ni ekɛaabu lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe fɔ.
Naagbee nibii komɛi ni Paulo taoɔ Kɛ mitsu Artema loo Tihiko kɛba oŋɔɔ lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ ni oba miŋɔɔ yɛ Nikopoli, ejaakɛ jɛi mikpɛ mli akɛ mibaye fɛ̃ibe lɛ yɛ.
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ owo Zena, mlalelɔ lɛ, kɛ Apolo gbɛ jogbaŋŋ ni nɔ ko nɔ ko he akahĩa amɛ.
Shi hã ni wɔ diɛŋtsɛ wɔmɛi lɛ hu akase nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe mɔdɛŋbɔɔ yɛ fimɔ kɛ hiamɔ hewɔ, koni amɛkafee mɛi ni wooo yibii.
Mɛi ni kɛ mi yɔɔ lɛ fɛɛ miibi bo.
Wɔmiibi mɛi ni sumɔɔ wɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ.
Dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Filemon lɛ Kristofonyo ni ale lɛ jogbaŋŋ ji lɛ, ni eeenyɛ efee akɛ Kolose asafo lɛ mli nyo hu ji lɛ.
Eyɛ nyɔŋ ko ni gbɛi ji Onesimo.
Nɛkɛ nyɔŋ nɛɛ ejo foi kɛjɛ enuŋtsɔ ŋɔɔ, ni aleee bɔ ni ba kɛ bɔ ni baaa lɛ, ekɛ Paulo yana shrãmɔ be mli ni gboklɛfonyo ji lɛ Paulo lɛ.
Kɛtsɔ̃ Paulo nɔ lɛ, Onesimo batsɔ̃ Kristofonyo.
Paulo Wolo ni eŋma eyahã Filemon lɛ, eŋma koni ekɛyakpa lɛ fai ni ekɛsaa lɛ Filemon lɛ kɛ Onesimo teŋ ni ehere lɛ atuu.
Jeee akɛ nyɔŋ ni ekɛ ehe efa lɛ kɛkɛ; shi moŋ akɛ enyɛmi Kristofonyo hu.
Wolo lɛ, akɛwo Onesimo diɛŋtsɛ dɛŋ ni ekɛyahã Filemon.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ - Filemon yijiemɔ - Mlidãamɔ kɛhã Onesimo - Naamuu -
Ŋamɔ Paulo ni ji Kristo Yesu gboklɛfonyo lɛ kɛ wɔnyɛmi Timoteo ŋma yahã Filemon, wɔsuɔlɔ kɛ wɔnaanyo nitsulɔ, kɛ wɔnyɛmi yoo Apia, kɛ Arkipo ni ji wɔnaanyo tabilɔ lɛ, kɛ asafo ni yɔɔ owe lɛ fɛɛ.
Dromɔ kɛ hejɔlɛ ni jɛ wɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo lɛ dɛŋ ahã nyɛ!
Filemon suɔmɔ kɛ ehemɔkɛyeli Midaa miNyɔŋmɔ lɛ shi daa ni mitsiɔ otã, nyɛmi nuu Filemon, yɛ misɔlemɔi amli, akɛni minuɔ osuɔmɔ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni ohiɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ Yesu kɛ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ lɛ he lɛ; misɔleɔ akɛ naanyobɔɔ ni okɛ wɔ yɔɔ yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ atsu nii ahã ekpakpa fɛɛ ekpakpa ni yɔɔ wɔmli yɛ Yesu Kristo mli lɛ lee.
Ejaakɛ mina miishɛɛ pii kɛ ekãa yɛ osuɔmɔ lɛ hewɔ, anyɛmi, akɛni ohã mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ atsui enyɔ amɛmli lɛ.
Paulo kpa fai yɛ Onesimo hewɔ No hewɔ lɛ, miyɛ hewalɛ yɛ Kristo mli akɛ mawo bo kitã yɛ nɔ ni sa hewɔ, shi kɛ̃lɛ suɔmɔ hewɔ lɛ fai moŋ mikpaa bo, mi Paulo ni mi ji nuumo ni amrɔ nɛɛ mi ji Yesu Kristo gboklɛfonyo hu lɛ.
Miikpa bo fai yɛ mibi ni mifɔ yɛ Kristo mli yɛ mikpãi lɛ amli ni ji Onesimo lɛ hewɔ, mɔ ni sá lɛ ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hã bo, shi agbɛnɛ lɛ ehe eba sɛɛnamɔ ehã mi kɛ bo fɛɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ, miwo lɛ gbɛ kɛmiiba oŋɔɔ, lɛ ni ji mitsui lɛ.
Kulɛ miisumɔ akɛ ekɛ mi ahi shi, koni esɔ̃mɔ mi yɛ onajiaŋ be mli ni miyɔɔ kpãi amli yɛ Sanekpakpa lɛ hewɔ lɛ.
Shi misumɔ̃ɔɔ akɛ mafee nɔ ko ni okpɛ̃lɛko nɔ, bɔ ni afee ni ejurɔ ni obaafee lɛ okabafee yɛ nɔnyɛɛ naa, shi moŋ efee yɛ tsuijurɔ naa.
Ejaakɛ ekolɛ enɛ hewɔ agbala nyɛmli be kukuoo lɛ, koni agbɛnɛ oná lɛ ni ehi oŋɔɔ daa.
Jeee akɛ tsulɔ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ akɛ mɔ ni fe tsulɔ tete, suɔmɔ nyɛmi ni jara wa hã mi waa, shi bo lɛ ejara wa hã bo aahu fe nakai yɛ heloo kɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ gbɛfaŋ fɛɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ agbɛnɛ kɛ oŋɔɔ mi akɛ onaanyo lɛ, heremɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni obaahere mi diɛŋtsɛ.
Ni kɛji eye bo sane fɔŋ ko aloo ehiɛ bo nyɔmɔ ko lɛ, buu nakai akɔntaa lɛ ohã mi.
Mi, Paulo, miiŋma kɛ mi diɛŋtsɛ minine akɛ mawo; tsɛbelɛ manyɛ makɛɛ bo akɛ ohiɛ mi bo diɛŋtsɛ tete oyi nyɔmɔ.
Hɛɛ, anyɛmi, hã mana ohe sɛɛ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli; hã mitsui anyɔ mimli yɛ Kristo mli.
Akɛni mihiɛ kã onɔ akɛ ooobo mi toi hewɔ miŋmaa bo nɛɛ, ejaakɛ mile akɛ ooofee fe bɔ ni mikɛɔ nɛɛ tete po.
Shi asaŋ saamɔ gbɔiatoohe ko oto mi ejaakɛ mihiɛ kã nɔ akɛ aaatsɔ̃ nyɛsɔlemɔi lɛ anɔ akɛ mi aaake nyɛ.
Ŋamɔi Epafra, mɔ ni ji minaanyo gboklɛfonyo yɛ Kristo Yesu mli lɛ, kɛ Marko kɛ Aristarko kɛ Dema kɛ Luka, mɛi ni ji minanemɛi nitsulɔi hu miibi bo.
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu Kristo dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛmumɔ lɛ ahi shi!
Amen.
WOLO LƐ HE SANE Aŋma Hebribii awolo lɛ ayahã Kristofoi komɛi ni miihe aŋmɛɛ amɛ — Kristofoi ahemɔkɛyeli lɛ he, ejaakɛ daa gbi nɛɛ, belɛ nɛkɛ shi ni ateɔ awoɔ amɛ lɛ mliwaa ji no.
Woloŋmalɔ lɛ woɔ amɛ ekãa yɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli mli; titri lɛ etsɔ̃ɔ amɛ akɛ Yesu Kristo ji anɔkwale kɛ naagbee kpo ni Nyɔŋmɔ jie ehe.
Yɛ enɛfeemɔ mli lɛ, ema nibii srɔtoi etɛ̃ ni ji anɔkwale nɔ mí.
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ ji akɛ Yesu lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naanɔ Bi ji lɛ, ni ekase Tsɛ lɛ anɔkwa toiboo kɛtsɔ̃ amanehulu naadãamɔ nɔ.
Akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, Yesu fe Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli gbalɔi lɛ; efe bɔfoi lɛ, ni esaa efe Mose diɛŋtsɛ po tete.
Nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ egba mli kpoo akɛ Yesu lɛ naanɔ osɔfo ji lɛ, ni efe Kpãŋmɔ Momo lɛ mli osɔfoi lɛ.
Nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu nɔ lɛ abaahere mɔ ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ yiwala kɛje esha kɛ gbeyeishemɔ kɛ gbele mli.
Ni akɛ Osɔfo Nukpa lɛ, Yesu ji mɔ ni bahã ale anɔkwa yiwalaheremɔ nɛɛ ni Hebribii ajamɔ lɛ hã ana lɛ futɛ̃futɛ̃ kɛkɛ yɛ amɛkusumi kɛ kooloi afɔleshãa mli lɛ.
Woloŋmalɔ lɛ tsĩ mɛi komɛi ni agbɛi ehehee yɛ Israelbii ayinɔ sane mli lɛ tã ni ekɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli fee nɔkwɛmɔnɔ , ni eba ekanelɔi lɛ ni amɛhi shi yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli.
Yɛ Yitso lɛ mli lɛ, ewo ekanelɔi lɛ ahewalɛ ni amɛya nɔ amɛye anɔkwa kɛyashi naagbee; ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkɛ Yesu afee oti ni mã amɛhiɛ koni amɛnyɛ nɔnaa fɛɛ nɔnaa kɛ yiwaa fɛɛ yiwaa ni abaawa amɛ lɛ naa amɛdãmɔ kpɛŋŋ.
Ŋaawoo kɛ kɔkɔbɔɔ gbeɔ wolo lɛ naa.
Mlijaramɔi Mlibotemɔ: Kristo ni ji Nyɔŋmɔ he kpojiemɔ ni eye emuu lɛ .- Kristo fe bɔfoi lɛ fɛɛ .—.
Kristo fe Mose kɛ Yoshua .—.
Kristo ji osɔfonukpa fe fɛɛ .—.
Kristo kpãŋmɔ lɛ ta kpãŋmɔi fɛɛ anɔ .—.
Kristo he afɔleshãa fe afɔleshãi fɛɛ .—.
Hemɔkɛyeli ji nɔ ko titri .—.
Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛsaa .- Naagbee sɔlemɔ .- Naagbee wiemɔi .-
Nyɔŋmɔ wie kɛtsɔ̃ eBi lɛ nɔ Sa lɛ bei srɔtoi amli kɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔ̃ ekɛ wɔtsɛmɛi lɛ wie yɛ gbalɔi lɛ anaa.
Shi nɛkɛ bei nɛɛ anaagbee mli lɛ, eBi lɛ naa ekɛ wɔ wie yɛ.
Ekɛ lɛ efee nibii fɛɛ yelɔ, ni enɔ hu etsɔ̃ efee je lɛ.
Lɛ ji enunyam lɛ kpɛmɔ kɛ esu lɛ mfoniri lɛ, ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ wiemɔ lɛ hiɛɔ nibii fɛɛ.
Be ni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe etsuu wɔhe kɛjɛ wɔhe eshai lɛ amli lɛ, etee eyata shi yɛ anunyam-Tsɛ agbo lɛ nine jurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi, ni bɔ ni efe ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ hu ena gbɛi ni fe amɛnɔ lɛ.
Bi lɛ fe ŋwɛi bɔfoi Ejaakɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, “Mi-Bi ji bo; ŋmɛnɛ mifɔ bo?” Ni asaŋ, “Matsɔ̃ eTsɛ, ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mi-Bi.” Ni be ni ekɛ kromɔbi lɛ baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ, ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ bɔfoi fɛɛ aja lɛ.” Ni ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ekɛɛ yɛ amɛhe akɛ, “Mɔ ni feɔ ebɔfoi lɛ mumɔi, ni esɔ̃ɔlɔi lɛ hu efeɔ amɛ lalilɛii lɛ.” Shi Bi lɛ, ekɛɛ yɛ ehe akɛ, “Ao Nyɔŋmɔ, omaŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ma shi kɛmiiya naanɔi anaanɔ, ni omaŋtsɛ tso lɛ, jalɛ maŋtsɛ tso ni.
Osumɔɔ jalɛ, ni onyɛɔ efɔŋfeemɔ; hewɔ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji oNyɔŋmɔ lɛ kɛ mliflimɔ mu lɛ efɔ bo fe onanemɛi lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ, “Nuŋtsɔ, shishijee lɛ mli lɛ, bo oto shikpɔŋ lɛ shishi, ni ŋwɛi lɛ oninenaa nitsumɔ ni.
Amɛ lɛ, amɛhiɛ baakpãtã, shi bo lɛ, ohiɔ shi daa.
Amɛ fɛɛ amɛbaasuu tamɔ atade; ni oookota amɛ tamɔ mama.
Ni amɛaatsake; shi bo lɛ, oyɛ bɔ ni oyɔɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ, ni ofii lɛ etãaa.” Shi ŋwɛi bɔfoi lɛ ateŋ namɔ po ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekɛɛ lɛ pɛŋ akɛ, “Ta mininejurɔ nɔ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni maŋɔ ohenyɛlɔi lɛ mafee onajiashi maaŋoo?” Ani amɛ fɛɛ lɛ, jeee mumɔ bɔfoi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ ji amɛ, ni atsuɔ amɛ ni amɛbasɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni nine baashɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ amɛgboshinii lɛ?
Yiwalaheremɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ No hewɔ lɛ, esa akɛ wɔjwɛŋmɔ ahi nii ni wɔnu lɛ anɔ jogbaŋŋ, koni wɔkakplaŋ kɛje he be ko.
Ejaakɛ kɛ wiemɔ ni awie yɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi anaa lɛ ma shi shiŋŋ, ni awo nɔtɔmɔ fɛɛ nɔtɔmɔ kɛ toigbele fɛɛ toigbele he nyɔmɔ bɔ ni ja lɛ, te wɔ lɛ wɔbaafee tɛŋŋ wɔjo nyɔmɔwoo naa foi hu, kɛji wɔbuuu nɛkɛ yiwalaheremɔ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ lɛ?
Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsutsu wie he, ni mɛi ni nu lɛ hu ma nɔ mí amɛhã wɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ hu kɛ okadii kɛ naakpɛɛnii kɛ hewalɛnii srɔtoi kɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ hãmɔ lɛ miiye odase miishi nɔ, yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ esuɔmɔ naa.
Yiwalaheremɔ Tatsɛnukpa lɛ Ejaakɛ jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi ashishi akɛ jeŋ ni baaba ni wɔwieɔ he lɛ wo.
Shi mɔ ko ye odase faŋŋ yɛ he ko akɛ, “Mɛni ji gbɔmɔ adesa ni okaiɔ lɛ?
Aloo gbɔmɔ bi hu ni ojwɛŋɔ enɔ?
Shwɛ fioo kɛkɛ ni ohã ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ; okɛ anunyam kɛ woo efi lɛ akekre, Ni oŋɔ lɛ oto oninenaa nitsumɔi lɛ anɔ.
Oŋɔ nibii fɛɛ kwa owo enajiaŋshi.” Kɛ akɛɛ “ekɛ nibii fɛɛ ewo enajiaŋshi” lɛ, etsɔ̃ɔ akɛ eshwɛɛɛ nɔ ko nɔ ko ni akɛwooo eshishi.
Shi amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnako wɔna akɛ nibii fɛɛ yɛ eshishi.
Shi mɔ ni be kuku ko mli lɛ ahã shwɛ fioo ni ekɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi aye egbɔ lɛ, wɔna akɛ Yesu ni, mɔ ni gbele mli nɔnaa hewɔ ni akɛ anunyam kɛ woo fi lɛ akekre lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ naa lɛ esa enaa gbele ehã mɔ fɛɛ mɔ.
Ejaakɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ mɔ hewɔ ni nii fiaa yɔɔ kɛ mɔ nɔ ni tsɔ̃ ni nii fiaa yɔɔ lɛ akɛ, bɔ ni afee ni eŋɔ bii babaoo kɛba anunyam mli lɛ, ehã amɛyiwalaheremɔ Tatsɛnukpa lɛ atsɔ̃ amanehului amli ahi kɛwula shi.
Ejaakɛ mɔ ni tsuuɔ mɛi ahe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni atsuuɔ amɛhe lɛ fɛɛ jɛ mɔ ko mli; no hewɔ jɛ ni ehiɛ gbooo akɛ eeetsɛ amɛ nyɛmimɛi lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ, “Matsĩ ogbɛi lɛ tã matsɔ̃ɔ minyɛmimɛi lɛ; asafo mli hu mala majie oyi yɛ.” Ekɛɛ ekoŋŋ akɛ, “Maŋɔ mihiɛ mafɔ̃ enɔ.” Ni asaŋ, “Naa mi kɛ bii ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛhã mi lɛ!” No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni bii lɛ hiɛ heloo kɛ lá kome hewɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eŋɔ no nɔŋŋ eko tamɔ amɛ, koni etsɔ̃ gbele nɔ ekpãtã mɔ ni yɔɔ gbele nɔ hewalɛ ni ji abonsam lɛ hiɛ, ni ekpɔ̃ mɛi fɛɛ ni gbele gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ amɛtsɔ̃mɔ nyɔji yɛ amɛwala be fɛɛ mli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ lɛɛlɛŋ, jeee ŋwɛi bɔfoi eyeɔ ebuaa, shi moŋ Abraham shwiei.
No hewɔ lɛ, nibii fɛɛ gbɛfaŋ lɛ esa akɛ etamɔ enyɛmimɛi lɛ, koni etsɔ̃ mɔbɔnalɔ kɛ anɔkwa osɔfonukpa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni ekpãtã ehã maŋ lɛ yɛ amɛhe eshai lɛ ahewɔ.
Ejaakɛ akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ ena kaa mli amanehulu hewɔ lɛ, enyɛɔ eyeɔ ebuaa mɛi ni akaa amɛ lɛ.
Yesu fe Mose Enɛ hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi ni ena ŋwɛi tsɛmɔ lɛ eko, nyɛjwɛŋa wɔhemɔkɛyeli jajemɔ lɛ he bɔfo kɛ osɔfonukpa ni ji Kristo Yesu lɛ he, mɔ ni ye mɔ ni to lɛ nakai gbɛhe lɛ anɔkwa, tamɔ bɔ ni Mose hu ye anɔkwa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ fɛɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ tamɔ bɔ ni mɔ ko ni ema shĩa woo fa fe shĩa lɛ nɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Yesu hu hiɛ yɔɔ nyam fe Mose.
Ejaakɛ shĩa fɛɛ shĩa lɛ, mɔ ko kɛ̃ ma, shi mɔ ni maa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ.
Ni Mose lɛ, eye anɔkwa yɛ eshĩa muu lɛ fɛɛ mli akɛ sɔ̃ɔlɔ, koni eye nii ni abaawie lɛ ahe odase.
Shi Kristo lɛ, eye anɔkwa akɛ Bi yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewe; lɛ ewe ji wɔ, kɛji wɔhiɛ nɔhiɛkãmɔ mli ekãa kɛ shwãa lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ.
Ŋwanejee he kɔkɔbɔɔ Hewɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛɛ lɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo gbi lɛ nɔ lɛ, he ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ tsɔ̃ minaa, ni amɛka mi, ni amɛna minitsumɔi lɛ, afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ yɛ lɛ.
Hewɔ lɛ mimli wo nakai yinɔbii lɛ ala ni mikɛɛ, ‘Amɛduɔ gbɛ yɛ amɛtsui amli daa.
Shi amɛleee migbɛi lɛ.’ No hã mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!’ ” Nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, anyɛmimɛi, koni nyɛteŋ mɔ ko akahi tsui fɔŋ ni heee yeee ni ekpale kɛje Nyɔŋmɔ, hiɛkãalɔ lɛ, he.
Shi moŋ nyɛwiea nyɛtsɔ̃tsɔ̃ɔa nyɛhe gbi fɛɛ gbi ni atsɛɔ lɛ “ŋmɛnɛ” lɛ, koni esha lakamɔ akahã nyɛteŋ mɔ ko tsui kpliŋ.
Ejaakɛ wɔtsɔ̃mɔ Kristo nanemɛi niyelɔi, kɛji wɔhiɛ wɔhe ni wɔkɛfɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛjɛ shishijee lɛ mli kpɛŋŋ kɛyashi naagbee lɛ.
Ni akɛɛ akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, Nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui, tamɔ bɔ ni nyɛtsɛmɛi lɛ fee yɛ mlilawoo lɛ mli” lɛ, namɛi nu ni amɛwo emli la lɛ?
Ani jeee mɛi ni kɛ Mose je Ijipt lɛ fɛɛ ni?
Ni namɛi emli fu afii nyɔŋmai ejwɛ lɛ?
Ani jeee mɛi ni fee esha ni amɛtswia shi amɛgboi yɛ ŋa lɛ nɔ lɛ?
Ni namɛi akitã ekã akɛ amɛboteŋ ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?
Ani jeee mɛi ni gbo toi lɛ?
Ni wɔnaa akɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee lɛ hewɔ amɛnyɛɛɛ mli amɛbote lɛ.
Hejɔɔmɔ yɛ hã heyelɔi No hewɔ lɛ, ni ashi ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mlibotemɔ he shiwoo ahã wɔ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔkwɛa jogbaŋŋ koni ekaba akɛ eŋmɛɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ ko.
Ejaakɛ wɔ hu ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ wɔ tamɔ bɔ ni ajaje atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ; shi kɛ̃lɛ wiemɔ ni amɛnu lɛ he eyabaaa sɛɛnamɔ ko hãaa amɛ, ejaakɛ mɛi ni nu lɛ kɛ hemɔkɛyeli mɔɔɔ mli.
Ejaakɛ wɔ mɛi ni wɔhe wɔye lɛ wɔmiibote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “No hã mikã kitã yɛ mimlifu lɛ mli akɛ, ‘Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii’ ” tsɛ agbe nitsumɔi lɛ anaa kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee.
Ejaakɛ bɔ ni ewie yɛ he ko yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ he nɛ, “Ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe yɛ gbi ni ji kpawo lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ fɛɛ mli.” Ni biɛ nɛɛ esaa ekɛɛ, “Kɛ amɛbote mihejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli fii!” No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni ekã shi faŋŋ akɛ mɛi komɛi baabote mli, ni mɛi ni ajaje Sanekpakpa lɛ atsɔ̃ɔ amɛ tsutsu lɛ boteee mli yɛ he ni amɛheee amɛyeee hewɔ lɛ, esaa eto gbi ko ekoŋŋ, ni etsɛ lɛ “Ŋmɛnɛ” yɛ nɔ ni etsɔ̃ David nɔ ewie be babaoo nɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ mli, ni atsĩ tã momo lɛ, akɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ, kɛji nyɛnu egbee lɛ, nyɛkawajea nyɛtsui.” Ejaakɛ eji Yoshua na hã amɛ hejɔɔmɔ kulɛ, fee sɛɛ lɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ewieŋ yɛ gbi kroko he dɔŋŋ.
No hewɔ lɛ, hejɔɔmɔ gbiyeli ko kã shi kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni ebote ehejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli lɛ, lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu ejɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ enitsumɔi lɛ amli, tamɔ bɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔ ehe kɛjɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ mli lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔbɔa mɔdɛŋ koni wɔbote nakai hejɔɔmɔ lɛ mli, ni mɔ ko akagbee toigbele ni he okadi nɛ lɛ nɔŋŋ mli.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ hiɛ kã ni eyɛ hewalɛ ni enaa ba fe klante kɛ enaa nta, ni egbuɔ kɛboteɔ mli aahu kɛyashɛɔ susuma kɛ mumɔ lɛ, kɛ talɔi kɛ wuiaŋfɔi lɛ akpeehei lɛ ni eji tsuiiaŋ susumɔi kɛ jwɛŋmɔi lɛ akojolɔ.
Ni ateee bɔɔnɔ ko yɛ ehiɛ, shi nibii fɛɛ yɛ faŋŋ ni agbele nɔ yɛ lɛ mɔ ni wɔkɛyɔɔ sane lɛ hiɛ.
Wɔyɛ osɔfonukpa mɔbɔnalɔ Agbɛnɛ, akɛni wɔyɔɔ osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple, ni efoŋ kɛtsɔ̃ ŋwɛiiaŋ, ni ji Yesu, Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔmɔa jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa.
Ejaakɛ wɔsɔfonukpa ni wɔyɔɔ lɛ ejeee mɔ ni nyɛ̃ɛɛ anu wɔgbedemɔi lɛ ahe ahã wɔ, shi eji mɔ ko ni aka lɛ yɛ nibii fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ tamɔ wɔ, ni kɛ̃lɛ esha ko esha ko bɛ ehe.
Hewɔ lɛ nyɛhãa wɔkɛ ekãa atsia abɛŋkɛa dromɔ sɛi lɛ, koni wɔnine ashɛ mɔbɔnalɛ nɔ ni wɔna dromɔ ni aaaye abua wɔ yɛ be ni sa mli.
Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa ni ahala kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ lɛ, awo lɛ osɔfo ni edamɔ gbɔmɛi anajiaŋ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nii agbɛfaŋ, koni ekɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei abahã yɛ eshai ahewɔ, akɛ mɔ ko ni nyɛɔ ehiɛɔ mɛi ni leee nii kɛ mɛi ni edu gbɛ lɛ blɛoo, akɛni lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu lɛ gbedemɔ ebɔle lɛ kɛkpe lɛ.
Ni enɛ hewɔ lɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ eshã eshai ahe afɔle ehã ehe, tamɔ bɔ ni efeɔ ehãa maŋ lɛ.
Ni mɔ ko eŋɔɔɔ nyam nɛɛ ehãaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe, akɛ ja Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ lɛ, tamɔ etsɛ Aaron hu lɛ.
Nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, jeee lɛ ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe osɔfonukpa kɛna hiɛnyam, shi moŋ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Mi-Bi ji bo, mi, mifɔ bo ŋmɛnɛ gbi nɛɛ lɛ.” Tamɔ bɔ ni ekɛɛ yɛ he kroko hu akɛ, “Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa” lɛ.
Kristo lɛ, be ni eyɔɔ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ ekɛ blɔmɔ ni naa wa kɛ yaafonui ŋɔ sɔlemɔi kɛ faikpamɔi ehã mɔ ni baanyɛ eyiwala ahere kɛjɛ gbele mli lɛ, tamɔ afɔle, ni eNyɔŋmɔ gbeyeishemɔ hewɔ lɛ abo lɛ toi.
Ni tsɛ belɛ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi ji lɛ moŋ nɛ, shi kɛ̃lɛ ekase toiboo kɛjɛ amanehului ni ena lɛ amli.
Ni be ni ehi kɛwula shi lɛ, etsɔ̃ mɔ ni naanɔ yiwalaheremɔ jeɔ emli ehã mɛi fɛɛ ni boɔ lɛ toi lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wo lɛ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.
Kristofoi akahi shi tamɔ gbekɛbii yɛ mumɔŋ gbɛfaŋ Wɔyɛ wiemɔi pii ni wɔɔwie yɛ enɛ he ni shishitsɔɔmɔ wa, ni nyɛyɛ shɔ̃ɔ kɛ niiashishinumɔ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛ ni kulɛ benɛ lɛ esa akɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ tsɔɔlɔi moŋ lɛ, ehe ehĩa akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ amli shishijee nibii lɛ ekoŋŋ, ni nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni fufɔ he ehia amɛ, shi jeee niyenii ni tsii.
Ejaakɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni yeɔ fufɔ lɛ, eleee jalɛ he nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ he nɔ ko; ejaakɛ fufɔoo ji lɛ.
Shi mɛi ni edara lɛ anɔ ji niyenii ni tsii, mɛi ni fɔ ni amɛfɔɔ feemɔ lɛ ehã amɛhenumɔnii lɛ ele ekpakpa kɛ efɔŋ teŋ srɔto.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔshĩa Kristo he nitsɔɔmɔ lɛ shishijee nibii lɛ, ni wɔfo mli kɛya tsɔ̃ɔmɔi ni sa onukpai ahe; ni wɔkakã he wɔto nitsumɔi ni egboi ahe tsuitsakemɔ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ nɔ hemɔkɛyeli, kɛ baptisimɔi ahe nitsɔɔmɔ kɛ niji kɛ nɔshwiemɔ, kɛ gbohiiashitee kɛ naanɔ kojomɔ he saji lɛ ashishi ekoŋŋ.
Ni wɔɔfee enɛ aahu, kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋmɛ gbɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni la etso amɛnɔ pɛŋ ni amɛsa amɛnaa ŋwɛi nɔkeenɔ lɛ ni amɛna Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ eko ni amɛsa Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ kpakpa lɛ kɛ jeŋ ni baaba lɛ mli hewalɛi lɛ anaa, ni no sɛɛ ni amɛgbee shi lɛ, anyɛŋ amɛ atsake afee ehee ekoŋŋ ahã tsuitsakemɔ, akɛni amɛmiisɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ ekoŋŋ amɛmiihã amɛhe, ni amɛmiibɔ lɛ ahora amɛmiitsɔ̃ɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ ni miiɔ nu ni nɛɔ shwieɔ enɔ kpitiokpitio ni ebaa nii ni hi hã mɛi ni huɔ nɔ lɛ, enaa Nyɔŋmɔ jɔɔmɔ lɛ eko.
Shi kɛ ŋmei kɛ aŋlɛŋlɛ ekwɛ̃ɔ lɛ, ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ, ni ebɛŋkɛ Nyɔŋmɔ loomɔ, ni enaagbee ji shãa.
Shi wɔsuɔmɔ mɛi, wɔmiikɛɛ nɛkɛ moŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ wɔhiɛ kã nyɛnɔ akɛ nyɛsane hi fe nakai, ni yiwalaheremɔ aaanyiɛ sɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ jeee mɔ ni yeɔ sane ni ejaaa ni ehiɛ aaakpa nyɛnitsumɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ suɔmɔ ni nyɛjie kpo yɛ egbɛi lɛ hewɔ, ni nyɛkɛsɔ̃mɔ mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ, ni nyɛsaa nyɛsɔ̃mɔɔ amɛ lolo lɛ.
Shi wɔmiitao akɛ nyɛteŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ajie nɛkɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ nɛɛ nɔŋŋ kpo, koni nyɛna hiɛnɔkãmɔ lɛ nɔmimaa kɛyashi naagbee, koni nyɛkafee kpɔkee, shi moŋ nyɛkɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ hemɔkɛyeli kɛ tsuishitoo nɔ naa shiwoi lɛ anane.
Nyɔŋmɔ shiwoo ni ma shi shiŋŋ Ejaakɛ be ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo Abraham shi lɛ, akɛni ebɛ mɔ ko ni fe lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ni eeekã lɛ kitã hewɔ lɛ, ekã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe kitã ekɛɛ, “Lɛɛlɛŋ, jɔɔmɔ majɔɔ bo ni fa hu mahã oshwiei afa.” Ni akɛni Abraham to etsui shi hewɔ lɛ, enine shɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ gbɔmɛi yɔɔ nɛɛ, mɔ ni fe amɛ lɛ, lɛ kitã amɛkãa, ni amɛŋwanejee fɛɛ naagbee ji kitãkãmɔ ni akɛmaa sane nɔ aduatsɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ hu ni be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tao akɛ etsɔ̃ɔ shiwoo lɛ yelɔi lɛ akɛ eyiŋtoo lɛ tsakeee kwraa lɛ, ekɛ kitã damɔ mli koni wɔtsɔ̃ saji enyɔ ni tsakeee ni Nyɔŋmɔ nyɛŋ emale yɛ mli lɛ anɔ wɔna miishɛjemɔ ni wa, ni wɔ mɛi ni wɔyaba abo lɛ wɔkɛmɔ hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ mli; nɔ ni wɔhiɛ tamɔ wɔsusuma sɛkɛ ni tseee ni efi shi shiŋŋ ni ebote mli kɛtee muhɔɔ lɛ sɛɛ tɔ̃ɔ, he ni hiɛnyiɛlɔ lɛ ni ji Yesu, mɔ ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ osɔfonukpa yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa lɛ, bote hã wɔ lɛ.
Melkizedek fe Abraham kɛ Levibii lɛ Shi Melkizedek nɛɛ, lɛ ji Salem maŋtsɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ osɔfo, ni kɛ Abraham yakpe be ni eku esɛɛ kɛjɛ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ agbee ní ejɔɔ lɛ lɛ, ni Abraham hã lɛ nomŋɔɔnii lɛ fɛɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome.
Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ egbɛi lɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ ji “Jalɛ Maŋtsɛ;” no sɛɛ lɛ eji Salem Maŋtsɛ hu, ni no shishi ji “Hejɔlɛ Maŋtsɛ.” Ebɛ tsɛ lɛ, ebɛ nyɛ, ebɛ wekukpãa, ebɛ gbii ashishijee loo wala naagbee tete; shi tamɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ, ehiɔ shi akɛ osɔfo daa nɛɛ.
Agbɛnɛ nyɛkwɛa bɔ ni mɔ nɛ da hã, akɛ blematsɛ Abraham lɛ tete ŋɔ nomŋɔɔnii kpakpai lɛ amlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome ehã lɛ!
Levibii lɛ ateŋ mɛi ni tsuɔ osɔfoi anitsumɔ lɛ hu yɛ kitã ko akɛ amɛhe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome yɛ maŋ lɛ dɛŋ yɛ Mla lɛ naa, no ji yɛ amɛnyɛmimɛi lɛ adɛŋ, tsɛ amɛ hu amɛjɛ Abraham mli; shi mɔ ni bɛ wekukpãa ko yɛ amɛteŋ nɛɛ, ehe mlijai nyɔŋma lɛ mli ekome yɛ Abraham tete dɛŋ, ni ejɔɔ mɔ ni yɔɔ shiwoi lɛ tete.
Shi ebɛ ŋwanejee ko kwraa akɛ mɔ ni da fe mɔ lɛ, lɛ ejɔɔ mɔ ni edaaa lɛ.
Ni asaŋ, biɛ lɛ, gbɔmɛi ni gboiɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni heɔ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ, shi jɛi lɛ, mɔ ko ni aye ehe odase akɛ ehiɔ shi daa lɛ he.
Ni, kɛ makɛɛ nakai lɛ, kɛtsɔ̃ Abraham nɔ lɛ ahe mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome lɛ yɛ Levi ni heɔ no lɛ hu dɛŋ, ejaakɛ eyɛ etsɛ lɛ mli lolo, be ni Melkizedek kɛ lɛ bakpe lɛ.
Melkizedek osɔfoyeli lɛ guɔ Levibii anɔ lɛ Agbɛnɛ kɛji emuuyeli tsɔ̃ Levibii asɔfoyeli lɛ nɔ kɛba lɛ (ejaakɛ no nɔ atsɔ̃ awo maŋ lɛ Mla lɛ), mɛɛ hiamɔ ehia lolo akɛ osɔfo kroko ate shi yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa, ni awooo lɛ yɛ Aaron gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa?
Ejaakɛ kɛ atsake osɔfoyeli lɛ, belɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ atsake Mla lɛ hu.
Ejaakɛ mɔ he ni akɛɛ nii nɛɛ yɛ lɛ ejɛ akutso kroko mli, nɔ mli ni mɔ ko jɛko ebasɔ̃mɔko yɛ afɔleshãa latɛ he pɛŋ; ejaakɛ eyɛ faŋŋ akɛ Yuda mli wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ jɛ, shi nakai akutso lɛ Mose ewieee he nɔ ko yɛ osɔfoyeli hewɔ.
Ni ejeɔ kpo faŋŋ kwraa fe nɛkɛ kɛji osɔfo kroko te shi ni tamɔ Melkizedek, osɔfo ni jeee heloo kitã mla naa awo lɛ yɛ, shi moŋ wala ni fiteee lɛ hewalɛ naa.
Ejaakɛ aye odase akɛ, “Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ yɛ Melkizedek gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ naa.” Ejaakɛ kitã ni tsɔ̃ hiɛ lɛ, akɛni ebɛ hewalɛ ni ehe bɛ sɛɛnamɔ ko hewɔ lɛ agu, ejaakɛ Mla lɛ hãaa nɔ ko nɔ ko aye emuu, shi agbɛnɛ ahã hiɛnɔkãmɔ ni hi fe no eba, nɔ nɔ ni wɔtsɔ̃ɔ wɔbɛŋkɛɔ Nyɔŋmɔ.
Kristo osɔfoyeli lɛ damɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitã nɔ Ni babaoo ni ashiii kitãkãmɔ sɛɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛ lɛ, awo amɛ osɔfoi moŋ shi akãaa kitã ko, Shi Kristo lɛ, kitãkãmɔ akɛwo lɛ, yɛ mɔ ni kɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ekã kitã ni eshwaŋ ehe, akɛ, ‘Osɔfo ji bo kɛmiiya naanɔ,’ ” lɛ wiemɔ lɛ naa lɛ, babaoo ni kpãŋmɔ ni Yesu ji sɛɛdaamɔlɔ yɛ mli lɛ hi fe no ji no.
Ni amɛ lɛ, akɛni gbele hãaa amɛwo shihilɛ hewɔ lɛ, amɛyi pii amɛye osɔfoi; shi mɔ nɛ lɛ, akɛni ehiɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔ hewɔ lɛ, esɔfoyeli lɛ sɛɛ efooo.
No hewɔ hu lɛ enyɛɔ mɛi ni tsɔ̃ɔ enɔ kɛbaa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ ayiwala ehereɔ kwraa, akɛni eyɛ daa koni edamɔ mli ehã amɛ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Yesu lɛ Osɔfonukpa ni sa wɔ pɛ nɛ.
Mɔ ni he tse, ni efɔŋ ko bɛ ehe, ni ehe bɛ kpa ko, ni etse ehe kɛjɛ esha he, ni awo enɔ ahã ekwɔ fe ŋwɛii.
Ehe Ehĩaaa lɛ, tamɔ nakai osɔfonukpai lɛ, akɛ gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ eshã lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshai ahe afɔle tsutsu, dani eshã maŋ lɛ hu nɔ.
Ejaakɛ efee enɛ shi kome nyɔŋlo, be ni eŋɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe eshã afɔle lɛ!
Ejaakɛ Mla lɛ, gbɔmɛi gbedelɔi eŋɔ woɔ osɔfonukpai lɛ, shi wiemɔ ni akɛkã kitã yɛ Mla lɛ sɛɛ lɛ ewo Bi ni eye emuu kɛyaa naanɔ lɛ Osɔfonukpa.
Yesu, wɔŋwɛi osɔfonukpa lɛ Shi nii ni wɔwieɔ lɛ mli sane titri nɛ, nɛkɛ Osɔfonukpa wɔyɔɔ; Osɔfonukpa ni ta mɔ ni je agbo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ yɛ ŋwɛi akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ anɔkwa Buu lɛ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ shi ni jeee gbɔmɔ ko shi lɛ mli sɔ̃ɔlɔ.
Ejaakɛ osɔfonukpa fɛɛ osɔfonukpa lɛ, awo lɛ koni eŋɔ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ebahã; no hewɔ lɛ, ehĩa akɛ mɔ nɛ hu ana nɔ ko ni ekɛbahã.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ eyɔɔ kulɛ, eyeŋ osɔfo tete, ejaakɛ osɔfoi ni kɛ nikeenii yahãa yɛ Mla lɛ naa yɛ, tsɛ amɛ lɛ ŋwɛi He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ kɛ esusuma kɛkɛ mli amɛsɔ̃mɔ yɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ Mose, be ni ebaafee buu lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛɛ, “Kwɛmɔ ni ahi koni ofee nibii lɛ fɛɛ yɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ ni atsɔ̃ɔ bo yɛ gɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ naa.” Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ osɔfoyeli ni Kristo ena lɛ hi kwraa fe tsutsunɔ lɛ, tamɔ bɔ ni kpãŋmɔ ni eji emlidaamɔlɔ lɛ hi fe tsutsunɔ ni adamɔ shiwoi ni hi fe tsutsunii lɛ anɔ lɛ akpãŋ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ eji sane ko bɛ tsutsunɔ lɛ he kulɛ, ataooo gbɛ ahãaa nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ shwa amɛ ekɛɛ, “Naa, gbii miiba, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ kɛ Yuda we lɛ aaakpãŋ kpãŋmɔ hee, jeee tamɔ kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛtsɛmɛi lɛ kpãŋ Gbi nɔ ni mimɔ amɛnine shi ni mikɛ amɛ je Ijipt shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛyeee mikpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni mi hu mijwɛŋŋ amɛnɔ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
Shi enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ Israel we lɛ baakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ, Mikɛ mimlai aaawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli, Ni maŋma mawo amɛtsui mli, ni matsɔ̃ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ni amɛ hu amɛaatsɔ̃ mimaŋ.
Ni amɛteŋ mɔ ko etsɔ̃ŋ emaŋnyo loo enyɛmi dɔŋŋ akɛ, ‘Le Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.’ Ejaakɛ amɛ fɛɛ amɛaale mi, kɛaajɛ amɛteŋ mɔ bibioo nɔ kɛyashi mɔ wulu nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mana amɛ mɔbɔ yɛ amɛtɔ̃mɔi lɛ agbɛfaŋ, ni amɛhe eshai lɛ hu mikaiŋ dɔŋŋ.” Ekɛ wiemɔ “ehee” ni ekɛɛ nɛɛ ehã klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ efee emomo.
Shi nɔ ni efee emomo kɛ nɔ ni egbɔ lɛ, etsɛŋ ni eeelaaje.
Levibii asɔfoyeli ni yeee emuu lɛ Agbɛnɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ hu yɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ he gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ shikpɔŋ nɛɛ nɔ he krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Ejaakɛ ashi buu ko amã shi, ni he ni oyiɔ klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, kanetso kɛ okplɔ̃ kɛ hiɛmaa aboloi lɛ yɔɔ jɛi; atsɛɔ jɛi akɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ.
Shi muhɔɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ buu yɛ jɛi ni atsɛɔ lɛ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ Fe Fɛɛ!
Jɛi shika tsofakɛŋma shãa nɔ lɛ kɛ Kpãŋmɔ Adeka ni akɛ shika eha he fɛɛ lɛ yɔɔ; no mli shika kpulu kɛ emli mana lɛ kɛ Aaron tso ni gba afofro lɛ kɛ kpãŋmɔ tɛi tɛtɛrɛbii lɛ yɔɔ.
Ni no nɔ anunyam kerubim ni ha kpãtãmɔ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ yɔɔ; nii ni amrɔ nɛɛ wɔnyɛŋ amɛhe wɔwie ekomekome lɛ.
Ni be ni asaa nibii nɛɛ nɛkɛ lɛ, osɔfoi lɛ yaa klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mli daa gbi, amɛyatsuɔ sɔ̃ɔmɔ nitsumɔ lɛ; shi buu ni ji enyɔ lɛ, osɔfonukpa lɛ kɛkɛ yaa mli shi kome daa afi, ni eyaaa ni ehiɛɛɛ lá, ni ekɛyahãa yɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ lɛ tɔ̃mɔi ni amɛleee lɛ ahewɔ lɛ.
Enɛ Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ gbii abɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ buu lɛ mã shi lolo nɛɛ, belɛ gbɛ ni akɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ anako ajie shi atsɔ̃ɔ.
Eji benɛ be lɛ he okadi ni tsɔ̃ɔ akɛ nikeenii kɛ afɔlei ni akɛbahãa lɛ nyɛŋ ahã mɔ ni jaa lɛ aye emuu yɛ henilee gbɛfaŋ, ejaakɛ nibii nɛɛ kɔɔ niyenii kɛ ninumɔnii kɛ hejuu srɔtoi ni ji heloo gbɛnaanii ni ato akɛ afee kɛkɛ ahe kɛyashi be ni aaasaa nibii fɛɛ afee amɛ ehee.
Kristo osɔfoyeli ni ye emuu lɛ Shi Kristo ni ba akɛ nibii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ ahe Osɔfonukpa lɛ, etsɔ̃ buu ni da ni hi kɛwula shi fe klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ mli; buu ni jeee niji akɛfee, no ji akɛ jeee je nɛɛ mli bɔɔnii amli ejɛ; ni asaŋ jeee too kpakpoi loo tsinabii alá nɔ etsɔ̃, shi moŋ etsɔ̃ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ elá lɛ nɔ ebote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli shi kome nyɔŋlo ekɛna naanɔ kpɔ̃mɔ lɛ.
Ejaakɛ kɛ too kpakpo kɛ tsinai alá kɛ tsina yoo lamlu ni atsɔɔ ashwãa mɛi ni ebule amɛhe lɛ anɔ lɛ tsuuɔ amɛhe ni amɛhe tseɔ yɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ lɛ, enyiɛ nɔŋŋ ni Kristo ni tsɔ̃ naanɔ Mumɔ lɛ nɔ eŋɔ ehe ni kpa ko bɛ he lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ akɛ afɔle lɛ lá lɛ tsumɔŋ wɔhenilee lɛ he kɛjɛŋ nitsumɔi gbohii amli, koni wɔsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ?
Kristo ji kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ Ni enɛ hewɔ ni eji kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ lɛ, bɔ ni afee ni mɛi ni Nyɔŋmɔ etsɛ amɛ lɛ anine ashɛ naanɔ gboshinii lɛ ni ewo he shi lɛ nɔ, akɛni ekɛ egbele kpɔ̃ amɛ kɛjɛ klɛŋklɛŋ kpãŋmɔ lɛ nɔtɔmɔi lɛ amli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ he ni awo shamaŋsheo yɛ lɛ, ehe ehia akɛ atsɔ̃ɔ akɛ mɔ ni wo lɛ egbo, ejaakɛ shamaŋsheo lɛ, ja agbo dani enaa hewalɛ, akɛni kɛji mɔ ni wo lɛ hiɛ kã lolo lɛ, ebɛ hewalɛ lɛ.
No hewɔ ni klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ lɛ hu ashiii lá sɛɛ awooo lɛ.
Ejaakɛ be ni Mose ejaje kitã etsɔ̃ɔ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ, eŋɔ tsinabii kɛ too kpakpoi lɛ alá lɛ kɛ nu kɛ too gwantɛŋ hetsɔi tsuru kɛ hisopo, ni ekɛ shwã wolo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ maŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ ekɛɛ, “Naa, kpãŋmɔ lɛ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wo nyɛ he kitã lɛ lá lɛ nɛ.” Ni buu lɛ hu kɛ Nyɔŋmɔjamɔ he nii lɛ fɛɛ lɛ, ekɛ lá lɛ shwã nɔ nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni shwɛ fioo ni lá akɛtsuuɔ nii fɛɛ he yɛ Mla lɛ naa; ni kɛ ashwieee lá shi lɛ, akɛfaaa.
Kristo kɛ ehe shã afɔle shi kome nyɔŋlo Belɛ ehe ehĩa akɛ nii ni ji ŋwɛinii lɛ afoniri nɛɛ akɛ enɛɛmɛi atsuu he; shi ŋwɛinii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ, afɔlei ni hi fe nomɛi akɛtsuuɔ he.
Ejaakɛ jeee He Krɔŋkrɔŋ ni akɛ niji fee ni ji nii lɛ diɛŋtsɛ lɛ afoniri kɛkɛ lɛ mli Kristo yabote lɛ; shi moŋ ŋwɛi diɛŋtsɛ eyabote, koni agbɛnɛ eyapue yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ ehã wɔ.
Asaŋ eyaboteee jɛi koni eŋɔ ehe ehã shii abɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni osɔfonukpa lɛ yaboteɔ He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ daa afi kɛ lá ni jeee lɛ diɛŋtsɛ enɔ lɛ; ejaakɛ nakai ni kulɛ, esa akɛ ena amanehulu kpitiokpitio kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee beebe; shi agbɛnɛ lɛ shi kome kɛkɛ ajie lɛ kpo yɛ bei lɛ anaagbee lɛ mli, koni ekɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ni ekɛshã afɔle lɛ ajie esha lɛ.
Gbii abɔ ni ekã shi ehã gbɔmɛi akɛ shi kome amɛgboiɔ, shi no sɛɛ lɛ abaakojo amɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ Kristo hu, akɛni aŋɔ lɛ ahã shi kome koni etere mɛi pii ahe eshai kɛya lɛ, nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ lɛ eeeshi esha ebapue ehã mɛi ni kwɛɔ lɛ gbɛ lɛ ni ehere amɛyiwala.
Blema shãa afɔlei lɛ nyɛɛɛ nɔ ko atsu Ejaakɛ nii kpakpai ni baaba lɛ asusuma kɛkɛ Mla lɛ hiɛ, ni jeee nibii lɛ asubaŋ diɛŋtsɛ ni, hewɔ lɛ enyɛŋ ekɛ daa afi afɔlei ni ashãa nɔtonɔto lɛ ahã mɛi ni babɛŋkɛɔ lɛ ahi kɛwula shi gbi ko gbi ko.
Jeee nakai kulɛ ani afɔŋ afɔlei lɛ shãa?
Ejaakɛ kulɛ mɛi ni bajaa Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ, kɛ atsuu amɛhe shi kome pɛ lɛ, amɛbɛ eshai ahe nilee kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Shi moŋ afɔlei lɛ, kaimɔ akɛkaiɔ eshai daa afi, ejaakɛ anyɛŋ akɛ tsinai kɛ too kpakpoi alá ajie eshai.
No hewɔ lɛ, be ni Yesu baa je nɛɛ mli lɛ akɛɛ, “Afɔle kɛ nikeenii lɛ osumɔɔɔ, shi gbɔmɔtso osaa ohã mi.
Shãa afɔlei kɛ esha he afɔlei esaaa ohiɛ, No ni mikɛɛ, ‘Naa, miba, aŋma mihe sane yɛ wolokpo lɛ mli.
Ni mibafee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ.’ ” Be ni ekɛɛ tsutsu lɛ akɛ, “Afɔle kɛ nikeenii kɛ shãa afɔlei kɛ esha he afɔlei lɛ osumɔɔɔ, ni esaaa ohiɛ hu,” (nii ni akɛbahãa yɛ Mla lɛ naa lɛ); ni esaa ekɛɛ, “Naa, miba ni mibafee bo, Nyɔŋmɔ, osuɔmɔnaanii lɛ,” ejie tsutsu nɔ lɛ koni ekɛ nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ ama shi.
Nakai suɔmɔnaa nii lɛ mli atsuu wɔhe yɛ kɛtsɔ̃ Yesu Kristo gbɔmɔtso ni ekɛhã shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ nɔ.
Kristo afɔleshãa lɛ tsuɔ nii Ni osɔfo fɛɛ osɔfo lɛ, gbi fɛɛ gbi lɛ, edamɔɔ shi esɔ̃mɔɔ, ni eshãa nakai afɔlei lɛ nɔŋŋ kpitiokpitio, nii ni nyɛɛɛ eshai ajie gbi ko gbi ko lɛ.
Shi Kristo lɛ, lɛ lɛ, be ni eshã eshai ahe afɔle shi kome nyɔŋlo lɛ, eyata Nyɔŋmɔ ninejurɔ nɔ.
Ni nɔ ni eshwɛ ji akɛ eemɛ “Kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaaŋɔ ehenyɛlɔi lɛ afee enajiaŋshi maaŋoo.” Ejaakɛ afɔle kome ni eshã lɛ, ekɛhã mɛi ni atsuu amɛhe lɛ ehi kɛwula shi nyɔŋlo.
Ni Mumɔ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ hu yeɔ wɔ odase; ejaakɛ ekɛɛ momo akɛ, “Enɛ ji kpãŋmɔ ni mikɛ amɛ aaakpãŋ yɛ nakai gbii lɛ asɛɛ lɛ, Nuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛɛ.
Mikɛ mimlai lɛ aaawo amɛtsuii amli, ni maŋma mawo amɛjwɛŋmɔ mli, Ni amɛhe eshai lɛ kɛ amɛnɔ̃tɔ̃mɔi lɛ mikaiŋ kwraa dɔŋŋ.” Ni he ni akɛ enɛɛmɛi efa yɛ lɛ, eshai ahe afɔleshãa ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Gbɛ ni akɛyaa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ No hewɔ lɛ, anyɛmimɛi, wɔyɛ ekãa ni wɔkɛaabote He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ Yesu lá lɛ hewɔ.
Eji gbɛ hee ni ji wala gbɛ ni eje ehã wɔ kɛtsɔ̃ muhɔɔ lɛ ni ji lɛ diɛŋtsɛ eheloo lɛ mli.
Ni asaŋ akɛni wɔyɛ Osɔfonukpa kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ Nyɔŋmɔ we lɛ nɔ hewɔ lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔkɛ anɔkwa tsui ababɛŋkɛa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni wɔyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɔ lɛ mli, kɛ tsui hu ni atsuu he ni ebɛ henilee fɔŋ ko dɔŋŋ, kɛ gbɔmɔtso ni akɛ nu ni mli tse eju he.
Ni nyɛhãa wɔmɔa wɔhiɛnɔkãmɔ jajemɔ lɛ mli ni awaa ni ekagbugbãa, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ anɔkwafo ni.
Ni nyɛhãa wɔyɔseyɔsea wɔhe, koni wɔhiɛ adɔ suɔmɔ kɛ nitsumɔi kpakpai ahe.
Ni wɔkakwa wɔhe naabuamɔ, tamɔ bɔ ni mɛi komɛi fɔɔ feemɔ lɛ, shi moŋ wɔwowoo wɔhe ŋaa, ni titri lɛ akɛni nyɛmiina akɛ Gbi lɛ miibɛŋkɛ nɛɛ.
Wɔkanaanaa Kristo afɔle lɛ nɔ Ejaakɛ kɛ kwa wɔkwaa wɔfeɔ esha, be ni wɔna wɔle anɔkwale lɛ sɛɛ lɛ, belɛ eshai ahe afɔle ko bɛ dɔŋŋ; shi kojomɔ gbɛkwɛmɔ ni yɔɔ gbeyei kɛkɛ, kɛ la grigri ni baashã henyɛlɔi lɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko kwa Mose Mla lɛ, anaaa lɛ mɔbɔ, shi mɛi enyɔ loo etɛ̃ odaseyeli naa lɛ agbeɔ lɛ.
Belɛ gbɔmɔ ko ni enaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Bi lɛ nɔ ni ebu kpãŋmɔ lá ni akɛtsuu ehe lɛ akɛ yaka nɔ ko, ni efee dromɔ Mumɔ lɛ niseniianii lɛ, te nyɛsusuɔ akɛ toigbalamɔ ni sa lɛ mli baawa tɛŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ wɔle mɔ ni kɛɛ akɛ, “Minɔ ji oweletɔɔ, ni mawo he nyɔmɔ” lɛ; ni asaŋ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ aaakojo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ emaŋ lɛ.” Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ dɛŋ gbeemɔ yɛ gbeyei pam.
Nyɛdamɔa shi yɛ nyɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli Shi nyɛkaia be ni eho lɛ, be ni la etso yɛ nyɛnɔ lɛ, bɔ ni nyɛmia nyɛhiɛ yɛ amanehulu ta babaoo mli.
Eko mli lɛ akɛ jɛmɔ kɛ amanehului sɔŋŋ hã nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ kwɛmɔnii, ni eko hu mli lɛ nyɛtsɔ̃mɔ mɛi ni afee amɛ nakai lɛ ananemɛi nɔnalɔi; ejaakɛ nyɛmusuŋ shã nyɛ yɛ mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ ahewɔ, ni nyɛnii ni aha lɛ hu nyɛkɛ miishɛɛ kpɛlɛ̃, akɛni nyɛle akɛ nyɛyɛ jwetri ni hi fe no aahu ni hiɔ shi daa lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛkashɛa nyɛmli ekãa lɛ nyɛfɔ̃a ejaakɛ eyɛ nyɔmɔwoo kpeteŋkple.
Ejaakɛ tsuishitoo he ehĩa nyɛ, koni, be ni nyɛfee Nyɔŋmɔ suɔmɔnaanii lɛ, nyɛnine ashɛ shiwoo lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ, “Be fioo kɛkɛ eshwɛ ni mɔ ni baa lɛ aaaba, ni etsɛŋ kwraa.
Shi mɔ ni ja yɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ, yi aaana wala; ni kɛ ekpa yɛ misɛɛ lɛ misusuma naŋ ehe tsuijurɔ.” Shi wɔ lɛ, jeee mɛi ni kpaleɔ kɛyaa hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi ji wɔ, shi moŋ wɔji mɛi ni kɛ hemɔkɛyeli naa amɛsusuma yiwalaheremɔ lɛ ateŋ mɛi komɛi.
Hemɔkɛyeli Shi hemɔkɛyeli ji nii ni wɔhiɛ kã nɔ lɛ anɔ hewalɛnamɔ kɛ nii ni anãaa lɛ anɔmimaa.
Ejaakɛ no mli aye blemabii lɛ ahe odase kpakpa yɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli wɔkɛyoɔ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ wiemɔ bɔ je lɛ, hewɔ lɛ nibii ni anaa lɛ jɛ nibii ni anãaa lɛ mli.
Hemɔkɛyeli Habel kɛshã afɔle ni fe Kain nɔ lɛ ehã Nyɔŋmɔ, no hewɔ hu ni aye ehe odase akɛ jalɔ ji lɛ lɛ; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ he enikeenii lɛ; ni no nɔŋŋ nɔ etsɔ̃ɔ ewieɔ lolo, tsɛ egbo.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ aŋɔ Henok kɛtee (ŋwɛi), koni ekana gbele, ni anãaa lɛ dɔŋŋ akɛni Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔ lɛ kɛtee lɛ; ejaakɛ dani aaaŋɔ lɛ kɛya lɛ aye ehe odase akɛ esa Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ.
Shi kɛji hemɔkɛyeli bɛ lɛ anyɛŋ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ asa; ejaakɛ mɔ ni baa Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ lɛ, ja ehe eye akɛ eyɛ, ni eji mɛi ni taoɔ esɛɛgbɛ lɛ anyɔmɔwolɔ hu.
Hemɔkɛyeli Noa hu kɛbo Nyɔŋmɔ toi be ni ehã ele nii ni anako lɛ he nɔ ko lɛ, ni ekɛkpɛ adeka ehã ewe lɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ; no nɔ hu etsɔ̃ ebu je lɛ fɔ, ni enine shɛ jalɛ ni jɛ hemɔkɛyeli mli lɛ nɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Abraham kɛbo toi be ni Nyɔŋmɔ tsɛ lɛ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee he ni baatsɔ̃ enɔ lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee, tsɛ eleee he ni eyaa.
Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛyahi shiwoo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ akɛ gbɔ, ni ekɛ Isak kɛ Yakob ni ekɛ amɛ ji nakai shiwoo lɛ nɔŋŋ yelɔi lɛ hi bui amli; ejaakɛ eekwɛ maŋ ni yɔɔ shishitoo ni wa ni etolɔ kɛ emalɔ ji Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ gbɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Sara hu kɛna hewalɛ ni ekɛna musu, ni lɛ ni egbɔ eho he aahu lɛ efɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ni wo shi lɛ ebu lɛ anɔkwafo.
No hewɔ hu ni ajɛ mɔ kome ni tamɔ mɔ ni egbo momo lɛ mli afɔ mɛi ni fa babaoo tamɔ ŋwɛi ŋulamii loo ŋshɔ naa shia ni anyɛɛɛ akane lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli mli mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ gboi yɛ.
Shɔŋŋ kɛkɛ amɛna nii ni awo he shi lɛ yɛ ni amɛnya he, tsɛ amɛnine shɛko nɔ, ni amɛjaje akɛ gbɔi kɛ mɛi kpɔ̃ji ji amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ejaakɛ mɛi ni wieɔ nakai nibii lɛ, amɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ amɛmiishwe amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmaŋ.
Ni eji amɛhiɛ yɛ he ni amɛjɛ kɛba lɛ nɔ kulɛ, amɛyɛ hegbɛ ni amɛaaku amɛsɛɛ kɛaatee jɛi ekoŋŋ.
Shi agbɛnɛ lɛ amɛmiitao maŋ ni hi fe no, ni ji ŋwɛi nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, efeee Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛgbele akɛ aaatsɛ lɛ amɛNyɔŋmɔ, ejaakɛ esaa maŋ eto amɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli naa Abraham ŋɔ Isak eyashã afɔle be ni aka lɛ lɛ, ni ekɛ ebi kome lɛ ba ebahã, be ni enine eshɛ shiwoi lɛ anɔ momo lɛ.
Lɛ mɔ ni akɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Isak mli aaatsɛ oshwie yɛ” lɛ; ejaakɛ ebu akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛaatee lɛ shi kɛaajɛ gbohii ateŋ tete, ni lɛɛlɛŋ, kɛ aaawie lɛ abɛbuaŋ lɛ, enine shɛ enɔ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛ jɛi.
Hemɔkɛyeli Isak kɛjɔɔ Yakob kɛ Esau yɛ nii ni baaba lɛ ahewɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Yakob kɛjɔɔ Yosef bii lɛ ateŋ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ be ni egboɔ ni ehiɛ edɛ̃hiɛmɔtso lɛ mli kɛma eyi shi esɔle lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Yosef hu kɛtsĩ Israelbii lɛ Ijipt jee lɛ tã be ni ejeɔ jeŋ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ewui lɛ ahe kitã lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli Mose fɔlɔi lɛ kɛŋɔ lɛ tee nyɔji etɛ̃ be ni afɔ lɛ lɛ, ejaakɛ amɛna akɛ gbekɛ lɛ he yɛ fɛo, ni amɛsheee maŋtsɛ lɛ akpɔ lɛ gbeyei.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ be ni Mose da lɛ ekpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ akɛ atsɛɔ lɛ Farao biyoo lɛ bi, eeesumɔ moŋ akɛ ekɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋ lɛ ana amanehulu fe nɔ ni eeeye esha mli ŋɔɔmɔ be fioo ko lɛ; ebuɔ Kristo hewɔ ahorabɔɔ lɛ akɛ nii babaoo fe Ijipt jwetri lɛ, ejaakɛ wɔsɛɛ nyɔmɔwoo gbɛ ekwɛɔ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛje Ijipt ni esheee maŋtsɛ lɛ mlifu lɛ gbeyei, ejaakɛ emɔ mɔ ni anaaa lɛ lɛ mli tamɔ nɔ ni eena lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli ekɛto Hehoo lɛ kɛ ladikimɔ lɛ, koni mɔ ni kpãtãa kromɔbii lɛ ahiɛ akata Israelbii lɛ ahe.
Hemɔkɛyeli amɛkɛfo Ŋshɔ Tsuru lɛ tamɔ shikpɔŋ gbiŋ, nɔ ni Ijiptbii lɛ hu ka feemɔ, ni emii amɛ lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli naa Yeriko gbogboi lɛ kumɔ shwie shi be ni Israelbii bɔle lɛ gbii kpawo lɛ.
Hemɔkɛyeli hewɔ Rahab, ajwamãŋ lɛ, pleneee efataaa mɛi ni heee yeee lɛ ahe lɛ, ejaakɛ ehere saralɔi lɛ kɛ hejɔlɛ.
Ni mɛni makɛɛ dɔŋŋ?
Ejaakɛ minaŋ mihe dekã bɔ ni mikɛaagba Gideon kɛ Barak, Samson kɛ Yefta, David kɛ Samuel kɛ gbalɔi lɛ ahe sane: mɛi ni tsɔ̃ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ amɛye maŋtsɛyelii anɔ kunim, amɛtsu jalɛnii, amɛnine shɛ shiwoi anɔ, amɛtsimɔ jatai anaa, amɛgbe la hewalɛ, amɛje klantei anaa, amɛna hewalɛ kɛjɛ gbedemɔ mli, amɛhe wa yɛ ta mli, amɛwo mɛi kpɔ̃ji ata lɛ foi.
Yei anine shɛ amɛmɛi ni egboi lɛ anɔ ekoŋŋ kɛtsɔ̃ shitee nɔ.
Shi mɛi krokomɛi hu, akɛ piŋmɔ gbe amɛ, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ɛɛ kpɔ̃mɔ, koni amɛnine ashɛ shitee ni hi fe no lɛ nɔ.
Mɛi komɛi hu aye amɛhe fɛo ni ayi amɛ kpelebii ni awo amɛ gboklɛi ni awo amɛ tsuŋ; atswia amɛ tɛi, akɛ akpalala gbala amɛmli, aka amɛ, akɛ klante gbe amɛ; ahã amɛwo too gwantɛŋi kɛ too abotiai awoji kɛnyiɛ, ohĩa hia amɛ, awa amɛ yi, afee amɛ niseniianii; mɛi ni je nɛɛŋ esaaa amɛ lɛ, amɛtsomlo yɛ shiaŋai kɛ gɔji anɔ, kɛ tɛkploi kɛ shikpɔŋ fɔ̃ji amli.
Ni mɛnɛɛmɛi fɛɛ lɛ, aye amɛhe odase kpakpa yɛ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ hewɔ moŋ, shi amɛnine shɛɛɛ shiwoonii lɛ anɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ esaa nɔ ko kpakpa eto wɔ, koni amɛkaye emuu amɛshi wɔ.
Kristo ji nɔkwɛmɔnɔ No hewɔ lɛ, agbɛnɛ wɔ hu, akɛni wɔyɔɔ odasefoi babaoo ni ebɔle wɔ tamɔ atatu nɛɛ, nyɛhãa wɔshɛa jatsu fɛɛ jatsu kɛ esha ni ebɔle wɔ kpula lɛ wɔfɔ̃a.
Ni wɔkɛ hiɛmiamɔ ada foi ni kã wɔhiɛ lɛ.
Ni wɔkwɛ hemɔkɛyeli shishijelɔ kɛ naagbelɔ ni ji Yesu lɛ, mɔ ni nyamɔ ni kã ehiɛ lɛ hewɔ lɛ emia ehiɛ yɛ sɛŋmɔtso lɛ he amanehulu lɛ mli.
Ni ebuuu hiɛgbele lɛ, ni eyata shi yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ ninejurɔ nɔ lɛ.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛjwɛŋa mɔ ni ŋmɛ etsui shi ehã nibii ni eshafeelɔi kɛɛ kɛshi lɛ lɛ he, koni ekaje nyɛtsine ni nyɛsusumai miitɔ biti.
WɔTsɛ Nyɔŋmɔ tsɔsemɔ lɛ Nyɛnako nyɛgbee hiɛ kɛyashi lájee mli yɛ nyɛ kɛ esha tawuu lɛ mli; ni nyɛhiɛ ekpa hewalɛwoo wiemɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ nyɛ wieɔ bɔ ni akɛ bii wieɔ lɛ nɔ akɛ, “Mibi, kaabu Nuŋtsɔ lɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ akɛ nɔ ko bibioo, ni asaŋ, kɛ ekã ohiɛ lɛ, kaahã onijiaŋ miije wui; Ejaakɛ mɔ ni Nuŋtsɔ lɛ sumɔɔ lɛ, lɛ etsɔseɔ, ni eyiɔ bi fɛɛ bi ni ekɛfeɔ enɔ lɛ.” Nyɛmiaa nyɛhiɛ yɛ nɔnaa lɛ mli akɛ tsɔsemɔ; Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ nyɛ akɛ ebii; ejaakɛ mɛɛ bi yɔɔ ni etsɛ tsɔseee lɛ?
Kɛji nyɛnaaa tsɔsemɔ ni mɛi fɛɛ naa lɛ eko lɛ, no lɛ ajwamãŋbii ji nyɛ, shi jeee kpeemɔ yoo bii.
Asaŋ wɔyɛ heloo gbɛfaŋ tsɛmɛi ni tsɔseɔ wɔ, ni wɔbuɔ amɛ.
Ani esaaa akɛ wɔba wɔhe shi fe nakai wɔhã mumɔi aTsɛ lɛ koni wɔyi ana wala?
Amɛ lɛ, gbii fioo ko kɛkɛ amɛtsɔseɔ wɔ bɔ ni sa amɛhiɛ; shi lɛ lɛ, etsɔseɔ wɔ koni ahi ahã wɔ ni wɔna ekrɔŋkrɔŋfeemɔ lɛ eko.
Shi tsɔsemɔ fɛɛ tsɔsemɔ lɛ, amrɔmrɔ nɛɛ efeee mɔ akɛ miishɛɛ nɔ ni, shi dɔlɛ nɔ moŋ; shi kɛ fee sɛɛ lɛ ewoɔ hejɔlɛ yibii ni ji jalɛ lɛ ehãa mɛi ni tsɔsemɔ lɛ esaa amɛ lɛ.
Nitsɔɔmɔi kɛ kɔkɔbɔi Hewɔ lɛ nyɛwajea niji ni egbede kɛ nakutsei ni egbɔjɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛfea gbɛi ni yɔɔ trɔmɔɔ nyɛhãa nyɛnaji, koni otsɔɔlɔ nane akahwaŋ, shi moŋ atsa lɛ.
Nyɛtiua nyɛ kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ateŋ hejɔlɛ sɛɛ kɛ hetsemɔ ni kɛ mɔ ko shi ni enaŋ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ.
Ni nyɛkwɛa ni ahia, koni mɔ ko akaŋmɛɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ lɛ he; koni shishifã kɛ joomɔ ko akakwɛ̃ ni ehao nyɛ ni akɛbule mɛi pii.
Koni mɔ ko akafee ehe ajwamãŋbɔlɔ loo mɔ ni ebuuu Nyɔŋmɔ nii, tamɔ Esau ni hɔ̃ɔ ekromɔbi gbɛnaa lɛ ehe ŋmaa shikomeyeli lɛ.
Ejaakɛ nyɛle akɛ, be ni fee sɛɛ ni etao akɛ ena jɔɔmɔ lɛ, akwa lɛ; ni enaaa, tsɛbelɛ ekɛ yaafonui tao tsuitsakemɔ hegbɛ.
Jeee Sinai Gɔŋ ni tsoɔ kɛ la ni anaa kɛ hiŋmɛi kɛ atatu kpii kɛ duŋ kabitii kɛ ahum, kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ gbɛɛmɔ kɛ wiemɔi agbɛɛmɔ ni mɛi ni nu lɛ kpa fai akɛ akawie eko afata he dɔŋŋ lɛ he nyɛba; ejaakɛ kitã ni awo akɛ, “Kɛji kooloo ko tete ta gɔŋ lɛ he lɛ, atswia lɛ tɛ” lɛ, amɛnyɛɛ mli amɛhi.
Ni nɔ ni pue lɛ he yɛ gbeyei babaoo aahu bɔ ni Mose kɛɛ, “Miishe gbeyei, ni mihe miikpokpo.” Shi moŋ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛkãalɔ lɛ maŋ; ŋwɛi Yerusalɛm lɛ, kɛ ŋwɛi bɔfoi akpeiakpei abɔ ahenaabuamɔ lɛ, kɛ kromɔbii ni aŋma amɛgbɛii yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ asafo lɛ he nyɛba.
Kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni ji mɛi fɛɛ akojolɔ lɛ, kɛ jalɔi ni ehi kɛwula shi lɛ amumɔi lɛ, kɛ kpãŋmɔ hee mlidaamɔlɔ Yesu lɛ, kɛ lá ni atsɔ ashwã ni wieɔ wiemɔ kpakpa fe Habel nɔ lɛ, aŋɔɔ.
Nyɛkwɛa ni ahĩa, koni nyɛkakwa mɔ ni wieɔ lɛ, ejaakɛ kɛ mɛi ni kwa mɔ ni wie tsɔ̃ɔ amɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ahe ejeee mli lɛ, belɛ wɔ lɛ, wɔhe ejeŋ mli kwraa kɛji wɔkpale kɛjɛ mɔ ni jɛɔ ŋwɛi wieɔ lɛ he.
Lɛ egbee hoso shikpɔŋ lɛ yɛ no be lɛ mli, shi agbɛnɛ ewo shi ekɛɛ, “Mahoso shikpɔŋ lɛ shi kome ekoŋŋ, ni jeee shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛkɛ, shi ŋwɛi hu.” “Shi kome ekoŋŋ” ni ekɛɛ lɛ, ekɛtsɔ̃ɔ faŋŋ akɛ nii ni ahosoɔ lɛ aaaho aya, ejaakɛ nii ni afee ni, koni nii ni hosoŋ lɛ ahi shi.
No hewɔ lɛ, akɛni wɔna maŋtsɛyeli ni anyɛŋ ahoso lɛ, nyɛhãa wɔdaa shi ni wɔkɛsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ bɔ ni sa ehiɛ kɛ woo kɛ gbeyeishemɔ!
Ejaakɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ, la ni fiteɔ nii hu ji lɛ.
Kristofoi ashihilɛ Nyɛhãa nyɛmimɛi asuɔmɔ ahĩa shi daa.
Gbɔfeemɔ hu, nyɛhiɛ akakpaa nɔ; ejaakɛ no nɔ mɛi komɛi tsɔ̃ fee ŋwɛi bɔfoi agbɔ ni amɛleee.
Nyɛkaia mɛi ni awo amɛ gboklɛi lɛ tamɔ akɛ nyɛkɛ amɛ kãmɔ mli, kɛ mɛi ni afeɔ amɛ efɔŋ lɛ hu, akɛni nyɛ hu nyɛyɛ heloo mli lolo lɛ.
Awo gbãlã hiɛ nyam yɛ nyɛ fɛɛ nyɛteŋ, ni akabule gbãlã saa hu; shi ajwamãŋbɔlɔi kɛ gbãlãŋkulɔi lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ baakojo amɛ.
Shikasuɔmɔ akaba nyɛjeŋba mli; ni nyɛmii ashɛ nii ni nyɛyɔɔ lɛ he; ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ ekɛɛ, “Mishiŋ bo ni misaa mikwaŋ bo gbi ko gbi ko.” Bɔ ni afee ni wɔna ekãa ni wɔkɛɛ, “Nuŋtsɔ lɛ ji miyelikɛbualɔ, ni misheŋ gbeyei.
Mɛni gbɔmɔ aaafee mi?” Nyɛbua nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, titri lɛ Kristo Nyɛkaia nyɛtsɔ̃ɔlɔi, mɛi ni wie Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ tsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ lɛ; nyɛkwɛa amɛshihilɛ lɛ naagbee, ni nyɛkasea amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ.
Yesu Kristo lɛ, bɔ ni eyɔɔ nyɛ kɛ ŋmɛnɛ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ eyɔɔ kɛyaa naanɔ.
Nyɛkahãa tsɔ̃ɔmɔi srɔtoi kɛ tsɔ̃ɔmɔi krokomɛi kɛ nyɛ miililaa shi; ejaakɛ ehi akɛ akɛ Nyɔŋmɔ dromɔ awo tsui hewalɛ, shi jeee niyenii ni hãaa mɛi ni tsuɔ he nii lɛ ana sɛɛ ko yɛ mli lɛ.
Wɔyɛ afɔleshãa latɛ ko ni mɛi ni sɔ̃mɔɔ yɛ buu lɛ mli lɛ bɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛyeɔ enɔ nii.
Ejaakɛ kooloi ni osɔfonukpa lɛ ŋɔɔ amɛlá kɛyaa He Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ yɛ esha hewɔ lɛ agbohii lɛ ayashãa yɛ nsra lɛ sɛɛ.
