Ni bɔfo lɛ kɔ tsofakɛŋma shãanɔ lɛ, ni eje efɔleshãa latɛ lɛ nɔ la lɛ eko ewo lɛ obɔ̃, ni etsi eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kɛ gbɛɛmɔi kɛ srawagbalamɔi kɛ shikpɔŋhosomɔ ba.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi ejwɛ lɛ Ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛi kpawo lɛ saa amɛhe koni amɛkpã.
Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛ kɛ la ni lá futu mli ba ni ebashwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni tsei amlijaa etɛ̃ mli ekome shã, ni jwɛi fɔ fɛɛ shã.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ashɛ nɔ ko ni tamɔ gɔŋ kpeteŋkple ni shãa kɛ la afɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ, ni ŋshɔ lɛ mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ lá.
Ni ŋshɔ lɛ mli bɔɔnii ni yɔɔ wala lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome gboi, ni lɛji lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome fite.
Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni ŋulami kpeteŋkple ni tsoɔ tamɔ haa jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shi, ni egbee fai lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nubui lɛ anɔ.
Ni ŋulami lɛ gbɛi ji taatso, ni nui lɛ amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome tsɔ̃ taatso ni gbɔmɛi pii gboi yɛ nui lɛ ahewɔ, ejaakɛ amɛmiijoo.
Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ kpã etrɛtrɛmantrɛ, ni atswa hulu mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ nyɔɔŋtsere mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome kɛ ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome nɔ, amɛmlijai etɛ̃ mli ekomekome lɛ wo duŋ, ni shwane mlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome lɛ jeŋ tseee ni nyɔɔŋ hu nakai nɔŋŋ.
Ni mikwɛ, ni minu okropɔŋ ko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ teŋ, ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Kpoo!
Kpoo!
Kpoo hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ yɛ bɔfoi etɛ̃ ni eshwɛ lɛ atɛtrɛmantrɛi ni amɛbaakpã lɛ agbɛɛmɔi lɛ ahewɔ!”
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji enumɔ lɛ Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni mina ŋulami ko jɛ ŋwɛi bagbee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ hã lɛ.
Ni egbele bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa, ni lasu te shi kɛjɛ bu lɛ mli tamɔ flɔɔnɔɔ kpeteŋkple mli lasu, ni hulu kɛ atatuiaŋ wo duŋ yɛ bu lɛ mli lasu lɛ hewɔ.
Ni baalabii jɛ lasu lɛ mli kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni ahã amɛ hewalɛ tamɔ hewalɛ ni shikpɔŋ nɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi yɔɔ lɛ; ni akɛɛ amɛ akɛ amɛkafee shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jwɛi loo baaŋmɔŋ loo tso ko efɔŋ ko, akɛ ja gbɔmɛi ni bɛ Nyɔŋmɔ naasɔomɔnɔ lɛ okadi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Ni ahãaa amɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛgbe amɛ, shi moŋ akɛ amɛpiŋ amɛ nyɔji enumɔ.
Ni amɛnaajaramɔ tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakro naajaramɔ, kɛ etsɛ̃ mɔ lɛ.
Ni nakai gbii lɛ amli lɛ gbɔmɛi aaatao gbele, shi amɛnaŋ, ni amɛaashwe ni amɛgboi, shi gbele aaajo amɛnaa foi.
Ni baalabii lɛ asubaŋ tamɔ okpɔŋɔi ni asaa ahã ta, ni nibii komɛi fimɔ amɛyitsei tamɔ shika akekrei, ni amɛhiɛiaŋ tamɔ gbɔmɛi ahiɛiaŋ; ni amɛyitsɔi tamɔ yei ayitsɔi, ni amɛnyanyɔji tamɔ jatai anɔ; ni amɛwo damai tamɔ dade damai, ni amɛfijiaŋ gbɛɛmɔ tamɔ okpɔŋɔ kɛ shwiilii babaoo ni hiɛ foi kɛmiiya ta agbɛɛmɔ.
Ni amɛyɛ leii tamɔ nyɔŋmɔŋkrakroi aleii kɛ amɛnaa gãii, ni amɛyɛ hewalɛ yɛ amɛleii lɛ amli ni amɛkɛaafee gbɔmɛi efɔŋ nyɔji enumɔ.
Ni amɛnɔ maŋtsɛ ji bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ bɔfo lɛ, ni atsɛɔ egbɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ lɛ mli akɛ Abadon, ni Hela wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ Apolion.
Kpoo kome eho; naa, kpoi enyɔ miiba lolo yɛ nii nɛɛ asɛɛ.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji ekpaa lɛ Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ shika afɔleshãa latɛ ni ma Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ akloŋtoi ejwɛ lɛ mli ni miikɛɛ bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ ni hiɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ lɛ akɛ, “Fɛnemɔ bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni afimɔ amɛ yɛ Eufrate Faa kpeteŋkple lɛ naa lɛ!” Ni afɛne bɔfoi ejwɛ lɛ ni asaa ato ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ kɛ gbi lɛ kɛ nyɔŋ lɛ kɛ afi lɛ, koni amɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Ni tabilɔi ni tara okpɔŋɔi anɔ lɛ ayibɔ ji akpe toi akpei ohai enyɔ; minu amɛyibɔ lɛ.
Ni bɔ ni mina okpɔŋɔi lɛ kɛ amɛnɔtaralɔi lɛ yɛ ninaa lɛ mli nɛ: amɛwo damai ni hiɛ là kɛ safiro kɛ swɔɔ su; ni okpɔŋɔi lɛ ayitsei tamɔ jatai ayitsei, ni là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ.
Nɛkɛ haomɔi etɛ̃ ni ji là kɛ lasu kɛ swɔɔ ni fãa kɛjɛɔ amɛdaaŋ nɛɛ, akɛgbe gbɔmɛi amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome.
Ejaakɛ okpɔŋɔi lɛ ahewalɛ yɛ amɛdaaŋ kɛ amɛleii amli, ejaakɛ amɛleii lɛ tamɔ onufui aleii, ni yitsei yɛ he, ni nomɛi amɛkɛfeɔ efɔŋ.
Ni gbɔmɛi ni shwɛ ni nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ egbeee amɛ lɛ, amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛdiɛŋtsɛ amɛnine naa nitsumɔi lɛ ahe.
Amɛfɔ̃ɔɔ mumɔi fɔ̃ji kɛ shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi kɛ ayawa kɛ tɛ kɛ tso amãgãi ni nyɛɛɛ amɛna nii loo amɛnu nii loo amɛnyiɛ lɛ ajamɔ.
Ni asaŋ amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛgbɔmɔgbee kɛ amɛsuu kɛ amɛjwamaŋbɔɔ kɛ amɛjuu lɛ ahe.
Bɔfo lɛ kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ Ni mina bɔfo hewalɔ kroko jɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni eha atatu, ni kwaabuɛtɛ yɛ eyiteŋ, ni ehiɛ tamɔ hulu, ni enaji tamɔ la akulashiŋi.
Ni ehiɛ wolo bibioo ko ni agbele naa yɛ edɛŋ; ni ekɛ enanejurɔ ma ŋshɔ nɔ, ni ekɛ enane abɛku hu ma shikpɔŋ nɔ.
Ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa, tamɔ jata huuɔ; ni be ni eboɔ lɛ, nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei.
Ni be ni nyɔŋmɔ shiimɔi kpawo lɛ wo amɛgbei lɛ, kulɛ miiŋma; ni minu gbee ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Sɔomɔ nii ni nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi kpawo lɛ wie lɛ anaa oto, ni oka ŋma.” Ni bɔfo lɛ ni mina akɛ edamɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ wó eninejurɔ nɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi, ni etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ ni bɔ ŋwɛi kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nii ni yɔɔ mli lɛ gbɛi ekɛkã kitã akɛ, “Be ko be ko bɛ dɔŋŋ, shi moŋ be mli ni aaanu bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ gbee be ni eehé ekpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, no lɛ agbe Nyɔŋmɔ teemɔ sane lɛ hu naa, bɔ ni ejaje etsɔ̃ɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ etsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ.” Ni gbee ni minu kɛjɛ ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ mi wie ekoŋŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Yaa ni oyahe wolo lɛ ni agbele naa lɛ yɛ bɔfo ni damɔ ŋshɔ lɛ nɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ dɛŋ.” Ni mitee bɔfo lɛ ŋɔɔ ni miyakɛɛ lɛ akɛ, “Kɛ wolo bibioo lɛ ahã mi.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Hemɔ ni oye, ni eeejoo yɛ omusuŋ, shi odaaŋ moŋ lɛ eeeŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ tamɔ wo.” Ni mihe wolo bibioo lɛ yɛ bɔfo lɛ dɛŋ ni miye ni eŋɔɔ dɔkɔdɔkɔ yɛ midaaŋ tamɔ wo, shi be ni miye lɛ, ejoo yɛ mimusu mli.
Ni akɛɛ mi akɛ, “Esa akɛ ogba gbalɛ ni kɔɔ maji kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ majianɔ wiemɔi kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi pii ahe ekoŋŋ.”
Odasefoi enyɔ lɛ Ni ahã mi glã ko ni tamɔ nisusumɔ tso, ni ekɛɛ, “Tee shi ni oyasusu Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ kɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ, ni okane mɛi ni jaa Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ mli lɛ.
Ni kpo ni yɔɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ agbo lɛ naa lɛ, shi no sɛɛ ni okasusu no, ejaakɛ akɛhã jeŋmaji lɛ, ni amɛaanaanaa maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ nɔ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Ni mahã midasefoi enyɔ lɛ hegbɛ ni amɛgba gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa ni amɛwo kpekpe.” Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mutsei enyɔ lɛ kɛ kanetsei enyɔ lɛ ni damɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ hiɛ lɛ.
Ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao afee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, la jeɔ amɛdaaŋ ni ekpãtãa amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ ahiɛ; ni kɛ mɔ ko miitao akɛ efee amɛ efɔŋ lɛ, nɛkɛ gbɛ nɔ atsɔ̃ɔ nɔŋŋ agbeɔ lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi yɛ hegbɛ akɛ amɛŋaa ŋwɛi naa, koni nu akanɛ yɛ amɛgbalɛ bei lɛ amli; ni amɛyɛ hegbɛ hu yɛ nui lɛ anɔ akɛ amɛhãa etsɔ̃ɔ lá, ni amɛkɛ haomɔ fɛɛ haomɔ haoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ shii abɔ ni amɛsumɔɔ.
Ni kɛ amɛgbe amɛdaseyeli lɛ naa lɛ, kooloo lɛ ni jɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ kɛ amɛ baawu ta, ni eeeye amɛnɔ kunim, ni eeegbe amɛ; ni amɛgbohii lɛ aaajwere maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ blohu lɛ mli, maŋ ni atsɛɔ lɛ yɛ mumɔ mli akɛ Sodom kɛ Ijipt lɛ, he ni asɛŋ amɛNuŋtsɔ lɛ yɛ lɛ.
Ni mɛi komɛi ni jɛ maji lɛ kɛ akutsei lɛ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi lɛ kɛ jeŋmaji lɛ amli lɛ aaakwɛ amɛgbohii lɛ gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã, ni amɛkpɛlɛ̃ŋ ni afu amɛ.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaanya yɛ amɛnɔ ni amɛmli aaafli amɛ, ni amɛ aaamajemajee amɛhe keenii, ejaakɛ nɛkɛ gbalɔi enyɔ nɛɛ piŋ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ.
Ni gbii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ sɛɛ lɛ wala mumɔ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ ba amɛmli, ni amɛte shi amɛdamɔ amɛnaji anɔ, ni gbeyei kpeteŋkple mɔmɔ mɛi ni na amɛ lɛ.
Ni amɛnu gbee waa ko jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ amɛ akɛ, “Nyɛkwɔa kɛbaa biɛ nɛɛ!” Ni amɛkwɔ kɛtee ŋwɛi yɛ atatu mli, ni amɛhenyɛlɔi lɛ na amɛ.
Ni nakai ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ nɔ nɔŋŋ lɛ shikpɔŋ hoso waa, ni maŋ lɛ mlijai nyɔŋma mli ekome wule, ni shikpɔŋ hosomɔ lɛ mli lɛ agbe gbɔmɛi akpei kpawo, ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ she gbeyei, ni amɛkɛ anunyam hã ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ.
Kpoo ni ji enyɔ lɛ eho; naa, kpoo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ miiba oya.
Tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛ ni ji kpawo lɛ Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ kpã etɛtrɛmantrɛ lɛ, ni anu gbei wuji yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ akɛ, “Je nɛɛ mli maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNuŋtsɔ lɛ kɛ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ni eeeye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ!” Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ ni tara amɛmaŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii anɔ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ lɛ kɛ amɛhiɛ bumɔ shi, ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Wɔmiida bo shi, bo Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ, bo mɔ ni oyɔɔ ni oyɛ ni obaaba lɛ, akɛ oŋɔ ohewalɛ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni oye maŋtsɛ!
Ni jeŋmaji lɛ amli efu.
Ni omlifu be lɛ eshɛ kɛ be ni abaakojo gbohii lɛ.
Ni abaawo otsuji ni ji gbalɔi lɛ kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ mɛi ni sheɔ ogbɛi lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ anyɔmɔ.
Ni abaafite mɛi ni fiteɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ!” Ni agbele Nyɔŋmɔ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, ni ana ekpãŋmɔ adeka lɛ yɛ eSɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni srawai gbala kɛ gbɛɛmɔ ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ ni shikpɔŋ hoso ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi babaoo nɛ.
Yoo lɛ kɛ Drako lɛ Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kpeteŋkple ko yɛ ŋwɛi: yoo ko ni hulu ha ehe, ni nyɔɔŋtsere yɛ enajiaŋshi, ni ŋulamii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ akekre fi eyitso.
Ehiɛ musu ni fɔmɔ kɔ̃ɔmɔ kɛ nɔnaa ehã eebolɔ.
Ni ana naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, ni naa, drako tsuru kpeteŋkple ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma, ni maŋtsɛ faii kpawo bumɔ eyitsei lɛ.
Ni elei miigbala ŋwɛi ŋulamii amlijai etɛ̃ mli ekome; ni etsirɛ amɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.
Ni drako lɛ badamɔ yoo ni baafɔ lɛ hiɛ, koni kɛ efɔ lɛ, ni emi ebi lɛ.
Ni yoo lɛ fɔ binuu ni kɛ dadetso baakpala jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ lɛ; ni asha ebi lɛ kɛtee Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ masɛi.
Ni yoo lɛ jo foi kɛtee ŋa nɔ he ko, he ni Nyɔŋmɔ esaa eto ehã lɛ lɛ, koni ayalɛ lɛ yɛ jɛi gbii akpe kɛ ohai enyɔ kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa.
Ni ta te shi yɛ ŋwɛi, Mikael kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ fã drako lɛ nɔ ta.
Ni drako lɛ bɔfoi fata ehe kɛwu, ni aye drako kɛ ebɔfoi lɛ anɔ, ni asaŋ amɛnaaa gbɛ dɔŋŋ yɛ ŋwɛi.
Ni ashɛ drako kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ji blema onufu lɛ ni atsɛɔ lɛ Abonsam loo Satan lɛ ni shishiuɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ashɛrɛ ebɔfoi lɛ hu ashwie afata ehe.
Ni minu gbee wulu ko yɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Agbɛnɛ yiwalaheremɔ lɛ kɛ hewalɛ lɛ kɛ maŋtsɛyeli lɛ etsɔ̃ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ, ni hegbɛ lɛ etsɔ̃ eKristo lɛ nɔ, ejaakɛ ashɛ wɔnyɛmimɛi lɛ anaaflɔlɔ lɛ ni folɔɔ amɛnaa yɛ wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ hiɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane lɛ afɔ̃.
Ni amɛ lɛ, amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ lá lɛ kɛ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛdaseyeli wiemɔ lɛ eye enɔ kunim, ni amɛdɔɔɔ amɛwala he kɛyashi gbele mli tete.
No hewɔ lɛ, nyɛ ŋwɛii kɛ nyɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni nyɛyɔɔ jɛi, nyɛnaa tsuijurɔ!
Shi kpoo hã shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ ŋshɔ lɛ!
Ejaakɛ abonsam lɛ ekpeleke shi kɛba nyɛŋɔɔ, egri naakpa, ejaakɛ ele akɛ be fioo kɛkɛ eyɔɔ.” Ni be ni drako lɛ na akɛ ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ, etiu yoo lɛ ni fɔ binuu lɛ.
Ni akɛ okropɔŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ fiji enyɔ lɛ hã yoo lɛ, koni efiliki ni eshi onufu lɛ kɛya ŋa lɛ nɔ yɛ egbɛhe lɛ, he ni alɛɔ lɛ yɛ afii etɛ̃ kɛ fã lɛ.
Ni onufu lɛ fɛ̃ nu ni tamɔ faa ko kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie yoo lɛ sɛɛ, koni nu lɛ asha lɛ kɛya.
Shi shikpɔŋ lɛ ye bua yoo lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ gbele edaaŋ ni emii faa lɛ ni drako lɛ fɛ̃ kɛjɛ edaaŋ eshwie lɛ.
Kɛkɛ ni drako lɛ mli fu yoo lɛ, ni eyiŋ etee ni ekɛ yoo lɛ shwiei ni eshwɛ ni yeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ anɔ ni amɛhiɛ Yesu Kristo odase lɛ mli lɛ ayawu.
Ni eyadamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia lɛ nɔ.
Kooloi enyɔ lɛ Ni mina kooloo ko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli kɛmiiba kɛ eklontoi nyɔŋma kɛ eyitsei kpawo, ni maŋtsɛ faii nyɔŋma bumɔ eklontoi lɛ, ni musubɔɔ gbɛi yɛ eyitsei lɛ ahe.
Ni kooloo lɛ ni mina lɛ tamɔ mlaŋtswi, ni enaji tamɔ oshishibrishi naji, ni enaabu tamɔ jata naabu.
Ni drako lɛ kɛ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehewalɛ lɛ kɛ emaŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ kɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple hã lɛ.
Ni mina eyitsei lɛ ateŋ ekome tamɔ nɔ ni epila gbele pilamɔ, ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ nyiɛ kooloo lɛ sɛɛ ni amɛnaa ekpɛ amɛhe, ni amɛja drako lɛ, ejaakɛ ekɛ hegbɛ lɛ ehã kooloo lɛ, ni amɛja kooloo lɛ hu amɛkɛɛ, “Namɔ tamɔ kooloo lɛ, ni namɔ aaanyɛ ekɛ lɛ awu?” Ni ahã lɛ naabu ni wieɔ wiemɔi wuji kɛ musubɔɔ wiemɔi, ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee enɛ nyɔji nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ enyɔ.
Ni egbele enaa ewie musubɔɔ wiemɔi eshi Nyɔŋmɔ, ni ewie egbɛi lɛ kɛ eshihilɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ ahe musubɔɔ wiemɔi.
Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ ni ekɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ awu ni eye amɛnɔ kunim; ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ yɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ nɔ.
Ni mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ aaaja lɛ.
Ja mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee yɛ Toobi ni agbe lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.
Kɛji mɔ ko yɛ toi ni akɛnuɔ nii lɛ, enu nii.
Kɛji ato akɛ aŋɔ mɔ ko nom lɛ, aaaŋɔ lɛ nom; ni kɛ ato akɛ akɛ klante agbe mɔ ko lɛ, klante akɛaagbe lɛ.
Biɛ wɔnaa krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ kɛ amɛhemɔkɛyeli lɛ yɛ.
Ni mina kooloo kroko miije kpo kɛmiijɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ eklontoi enyɔ tamɔ toobi akloŋtoi, ni wieɔ tamɔ drako.
Ni etsuɔ klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ hegbɛ lɛ fɛɛ he nii yɛ ehiɛ, ni ehãa shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ enɔ lɛ jaa klɛŋklɛŋ kooloo lɛ ni atsa egbele pilamɔ lɛ.
Ni efeɔ okadii wuji, ni ehãa la po jɛɔ ŋwɛi baa shikpɔŋ yɛ gbɔmɛi ahiɛ.
Ni ekɛ okadii ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ efee yɛ kooloo lɛ hiɛ lɛ shishiuɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni ekɛɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ amɛfee amãgã amɛhã kooloo lɛ ni klante naa pilamɔ yɔɔ ehe ni ehiɛ kã lɛ.
Ni ahã lɛ gbɛ ni ekɛ mumɔ ahã kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ, koni kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ awie tete, ni ehã agbe mɛi fɛɛ ni jaaa kooloo lɛ amãgã lɛ.
Ni ehã akadiɔ mɛi fɛɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, niiatsɛmɛi kɛ ohiafoi, odehei kɛ nyɔji yɛ amɛninejurɔ loo amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ.
Koni mɔ ko nyɛŋ ehe nii aloo ehɔ̃ɔ nii, akɛ ja mɔ ni yɔɔ naakpɛɛ okadi lɛ yɛ ehe, ni ji kooloo lɛ gbɛi loo yibɔ ni damɔ shi hã egbɛi lɛ.
Biɛ nilee he ehia yɛ.
Mɔ ni yɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ lɛ abu kooloo lɛ yibɔ lɛ he akɔntaa; ejaakɛ gbɔmɔ yibɔ ni; ni eyibɔ lɛ ji ohai ekpaa kɛ nyɔŋmai ekpaa kɛ ekpaa.
Toobi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni akpɔ̃ amɛ lɛ Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, Toobi lɛ damɔ Zion Gɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ ni aŋma egbɛi kɛ eTsɛ gbɛi yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ fata ehe.
Ni minu gbee ko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi tamɔ nui pii agbɛɛmɔ, ni asaŋ etamɔ nyɔŋmɔshimɔ kpeteŋkple gbɛɛmɔ; ni gbee ni minu lɛ tamɔ saŋkutswalɔi ni miitswa amɛsaŋkui agbee.
Ni amɛlaa lala hee ko yɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ kɛ onukpai lɛ ahiɛ; ni mɔ ko nyɛɛɛ lala lɛ akase, akɛ ja mɛi akpei oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛkɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni kɛ yei buleko amɛhe, ejaakɛ oblahii ni he tse ji amɛ, ni amɛnyiɛɔ Toobi lɛ sɛɛ kɛyaa he fɛɛ he ni eyaa lɛ.
Mɛnɛɛmɛi ji mɛi ni akpɔ̃ kɛjɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ yibii kɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ.
Ni anaaa amale ko yɛ amɛdaaŋ ejaakɛ kpa ko bɛ amɛhe.
Ni mina bɔfo kroko miifiliki yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ, ni ehiɛ naanɔ Sanekpakpa ni eyaajaje etsɔ̃ɔ mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ kɛjɛ jeŋmaŋ fɛɛ jeŋmaŋ kɛ akutso fɛɛ akutso kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ maŋ fɛɛ maŋ mli.
Ni ekɛ gbee ni wa kɛɛ, “Nyɛshea Nyɔŋmɔ gbeyei ni nyɛkɛ anunyam ahãa lɛ ejaakɛ ekojomɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ; ni nyɛjaa mɔ ni fee ŋwɛi kɛ shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋshɔ kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ!” Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji enyɔ nyiɛ klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ sɛɛ ni ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ ni naa wa lɛ dãa lɛ eko.” Ni bɔfo kroko ni ji etɛ̃ nyiɛ amɛsɛɛ, ni ekɛ gbee wulu kɛɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko ja kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, ni ehe ekadi lɛ yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ loo enine nɔ lɛ, lɛ hu eeenu Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu dãa ŋmiiŋmi ni akɛwo emlifu kpulu lɛ mli lɛ eko, ni aaapiŋ lɛ yɛ la kɛ swɔɔ mli yɛ bɔfoi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ahiɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ hiɛ.
Ni amɛpiŋmɔ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ.
Ni mɛi ni jaa kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ, kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni eŋɔ egbɛi okadi lɛ, nãaa hejɔɔmɔ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane.” Biɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ni hiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kitãi lɛ kɛ Yesu nɔ hemɔkɛyeli lɛ mli lɛ ahiɛmiamɔ lɛ he ehia yɛ.
Ni minu gbee jɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa: Ajɔɔ gbohii lɛ ni gboiɔ yɛ Nuŋtsɔ lɛ mli lɛ kɛjɛ ŋmɛnɛ nɔ kɛyaa nɛɛ.
Hɛɛ, Mumɔ lɛ kɛɛ, koni amɛjɔɔ amɛhe kɛjɛ amɛdeŋmegbomɔi lɛ amli ejaakɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ nyiɛɔ amɛsɛɛ.” Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔ lɛ Ni mikwɛ, ni naa, atatu yɛŋ, ni mɔ ko ta nɔ tamɔ gbɔmɔ bi, ni shika akekre fi eyitso, ni ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli ni ebolɔ kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ akɛ, “Okɛ onikpamɔ kakla lɛ awo mli ni okpa nii, ejaakɛ nikpamɔ ŋmɛlɛtswaa lɛ eshɛ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nikpamɔnii lɛ etsu.” Ni mɔ ni ta atatu lɛ nɔ lɛ shɛ enikpamɔ kakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni akpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nii lɛ.
Ni bɔfo kroko je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ mli, ni lɛ hu ehiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba.
Ni bɔfo kroko ni yɔɔ la nɔ hewalɛ je kpo kɛjɛ afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ mli, ni ebo etsɛ mɔ ni hiɛ nikpamɔ kakla ni naa ba lɛ kɛ gbee ni wa akɛ, “Okɛ okakla ni naa ba lɛ awo mli ni okpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ ejaakɛ ewaintso yibii lɛ etsu!” Ni bɔfo lɛ shɛ ekakla lɛ efɔ̃ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ, ni ekpa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ waintso yibii lɛ, ni ekɛwo Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ wainŋaanɔ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli.
Ni anaanaa wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ maŋ lɛ ŋmaŋmasha lɛ, ni lá ho kɛjɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ mli ni ekɛlɛ ji shitoi ohai enyɔ.
Bɔfoi ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo lɛ Ni mina naakpɛɛ okadi kroko yɛ ŋwɛi, eda ni eyɛ naakpɛɛ: bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo ni ji naagbeenii lɛ, ejaakɛ nomɛi akɛgbeɔ Nyɔŋmɔ mlila lɛ naa.
Ni mina nɔ ko tamɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ ni akɛ lá efutu mli, ni mɛi ni eye kooloo lɛ kɛ emãgã lɛ kɛ ekadi lɛ kɛ egbɛi lɛ yibɔ lɛ nɔ kunim lɛ damɔ ashwishwɛ ŋshɔ lɛ naa, ni amɛhiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ saŋkui lɛ.
Ni amɛla Nyɔŋmɔ tsulɔ Mose lala lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ lala lɛ amɛkɛɛ, “Onitsumɔi lɛ dara ni amɛyɛ naakpɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe!
Ogbɛi lɛ ja ni anɔkwale ni, bo jeŋmaji lɛ aMaŋtsɛ!
Namɔ po sheŋ bo gbeyei, Nuŋtsɔ, ni ewoŋ ogbɛ́i lɛ hiɛ nyam?
Ejaakɛ bo okometoo ji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ; ejaakɛ jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ aaaba ni amɛbaja yɛ ohiɛ, ejaakɛ ajie ojalɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ashi faŋŋ.” Ni nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mikwɛ, ni agbele Odase Buu lɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ naa yɛ ŋwɛi, ni bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ haomɔi kpawo lɛ je kpo kɛjɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli, ni amɛwo klala ni he tse ni kpɛlɛɔ kaŋkaŋ, ni amɛfimɔ amɛtsitsii kɛ shika mlifiinii.
Ni hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome kɛ shika tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ni hiɛ kã kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ lɛ mlila lɛ hã bɔfoi kpawo lɛ.
Ni Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ yi obɔ̃ kɛ lasu ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kɛ ehewalɛ lɛ mli lɛ, ni mɔ ko nyɛ̃ɛɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli abote kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ahaomɔi kpawo lɛ anaa.
Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu tɔi kpawo lɛ Ni minu gbee ni wa ni jɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli miikɛɛ bɔfoi kpawo lɛ akɛ, “Nyɛyaa ni nyɛyafɔsea Nyɔŋmɔ mlifu tɔi kpawo lɛ nyɛshwiea shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.” Ni klɛŋklɛŋ bɔfo lɛ yi mli etee, ni eyafɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ; ni mɛi ni kooloo lɛ okadi yɔɔ amɛhe lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ famɔ faji fɔ̃ji ni waa mɔ he.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enyɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo ŋshɔ mli; ni etsɔ̃ tamɔ gbonyo lá, ni nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni hiɛ kã yɛ ŋshɔ lɛ mli lɛ gbo.
Ni bɔfo ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo fai kɛ nuhiŋmɛii lɛ amli, ni nu lɛ tsɔ̃ lá.
Ni minu nui lɛ anɔ bɔfo lɛ miikɛɛ, “Jalɔ ji bo, bo ni oyɔɔ, ni oyɛ, ni oji Mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, akɛni okojo nɛkɛ nɛɛ.
Ejaakɛ amɛshwie krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ alá shi.
Ni lá nɔŋŋ ohã amɛ ni amɛnu; esa amɛ nakai!” Ni minu afɔleshãa latɛ lɛ miikɛɛ, “Hɛɛ, Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe, anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji okojomɔi lɛ!” Ni bɔfo ni ji ejwɛ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie hulu nɔ; ni ahã lɛ hewalɛ ni ekɛ la ashã gbɔmɛi.
Ni la dɔlɛ ni naa wa lɛ shã gbɔmɛi, ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ nɛkɛ haomɔi nɛɛ anɔ lɛ gbɛi lɛ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui ni amɛwo ehiɛ nyam.
Ni bɔfo ni ji enumɔ lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ eshwie kooloo lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ, ni emaŋtsɛyeli lɛ wo duŋ, ni gbɔmɛi kɔ̃mɔ amɛlilɛii yɛ nɔnaa lɛ hewɔ.
Ni amɛwie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi ŋwɛi Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ yɛ nɔnai lɛ kɛ amɛfaji lɛ ahewɔ, ni amɛtsakeee amɛtsui yɛ amɛnitsumɔi fɔ̃ji lɛ ahe.
Ni bɔfo ni ji ekpaa lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo Eufrate Faa agbo lɛ mli.
Ni emli nu lɛ gbi, koni akɛsaa gbɛ ahã maŋtsɛmɛi ni jɛ hulu shiteehe lɛ.
Ni mina mumɔi etɛ̃ ni he tseee ni tamɔ kɔkɔdenei miije kpo kɛmiijɛ drako lɛ daaŋ kɛ kooloo lɛ daaŋ kɛ amalegbalɔ lɛ daaŋ.
Ejaakɛ mumɔi fɔ̃ji amumɔi ni, ni amɛfeɔ okadii, ni amɛyaa maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ jeŋ muu lɛ fɛɛ lɛ aŋɔɔ, koni amɛyabua amɛnaa amɛhã Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ gbi wulu lɛ nɔ ta lɛ.
“Naa, miiba tamɔ julɔ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni saraa ni ekwɛɔ etadei lɛ anɔ lɛ, koni ekanyiɛ yayai ni ana ehiɛgbele lɛ.” Ni mumɔi lɛ bua maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anaa kɛtee he ko ni atsɛɔ jɛi yɛ Hebri wiemɔ mli akɛ Harmagedon lɛ.
Ni bɔfo ni ji kpawo lɛ fɔse etɔ lɛ mli nii lɛ ewo kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni gbee ni wa ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli yɛ Sɔlemɔtsu lɛ mli kɛɛ akɛ, “Agbe naa!” Ni srawai gbala kɛ gbɛɛmɔ, ni nyɔŋmɔ shimɔ, ni shikpɔŋ hoso waa diɛŋtsɛ; nɛkɛ shikpɔŋ hosomɔ gbeyeigbeyei nɛɛ, asonɔkwa, anako eko dã kɛjɛ beyinɔ ni abɔ gbɔmɔ adesa kɛba shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nɛɛ.
Ni maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ mli gbala etɛ̃, ni jeŋmaji lɛ amaji lɛ fɛɛ wule, ni akai Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ hiɛ, koni akɛ emlifu ni naa wa lɛ dãa kpulu lɛ ahã lɛ.
Ni ŋshɔkpɔ fɛɛ ŋshɔkpɔ laaje, ni gɔji lɛ anãaa dɔŋŋ.
Ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi agboi ni amɛtsiimɔ tamɔ talenta jɛ ŋwɛi bashwie gbɔmɛi anɔ, ni gbɔmɛi lɛ wie musubɔɔ wiemɔi amɛshi Nyɔŋmɔ yɛ nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi lɛ ahaomɔ lɛ hewɔ, ejaakɛ haomɔ ni nyɔŋmɔŋtɛi nɛɛ kɛba lɛ yɛ gbeyei po ni ehiii.
Ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ Bɔfoi kpawo lɛ ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba, ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba ni matsɔ̃ɔ bo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni ta nui babaoo lɛ anɔ lɛ kojomɔ lɛ.
Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa lɛ hã mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ tɔrɔ dãa.” Ni bɔfo lɛ kpala mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee ŋa nɔ.
Ni mina yoo ko ta kooloo tsuru fɔɔ ko nɔ ni kooloo nɛɛ he fɛɛ lɛ musubɔɔ gbɛii sɔŋŋ, ni eyɛ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma.
Yoo lɛ wo atade afaseo diŋ kɛ etsuru fɔɔ, ni akɛ shika kɛ tɛi ni jara wa kɛ adiagbai ewula lɛ, ni ehiɛ shika kpulu yɛ edɛŋ ni eyi obɔ̃ kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ mli nihiinii kɛ mujinii.
Ni aŋma gbɛi ko ni ji teemɔ sane yɛ ehiɛŋtso nɔ, “Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ajwamãŋi lɛ kɛ nihiinii lɛ anyɛ lɛ.” Ni mina yoo lɛ akɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ alá lɛ kɛ Yesu he odasefoi lɛ alá lɛ etɔ lɛ dãa.
Be ni mina lɛ lɛ, minaa kpɛ mihe naakpa.
Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Mɛɛ hewɔ onaa ekpɛ ohe?
Mibagba bo yoo lɛ kɛ kooloo ni eta nɔ ni yɔɔ yitsei kpawo kɛ akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ahe teemɔ sane lɛ.
Kooloo lɛ ni ona lɛ be ko mli lɛ eyɛ, shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaajɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli eje kpo kɛya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.
Ni mɛi ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni aŋmako amɛgbɛii yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli kɛjɛ jeŋ shishijee lɛ anaa aaakpɛ amɛhe kɛ amɛna kooloo lɛ akɛ be ko mli lɛ, eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ, ni ebaaba lɛ.
“Biɛ jwɛŋmɔ ni nilee yɔɔ mli he ehĩa yɛ.
Yitsei kpawo lɛ ji gɔji kpawo ni yoo lɛ ta nɔ lɛ, ni asaŋ maŋtsɛmɛi kpawo hu ni.
Amɛteŋ mɛi enumɔ egbee shi, mɔ kome yɛ, ni mɔ kome lɛ nako aba, ni kɛ eba lɛ, ja ehi shi fioo.
Ni kooloo lɛ ni be ko mli lɛ eyɛ shi amrɔ nɛɛ ebɛ lɛ, lɛ ji mɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ, ni ejɛ mɛi kpawo lɛ amli, ni eeya hiɛkpãtãmɔ mli.” “Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma lɛ ni ona lɛ, maŋtsɛmɛi nyɔŋma ni, mɛi ni maŋtsɛyeli shɛko amɛdɛŋ, shi kɛ̃lɛ amɛbaana hegbɛ amɛye maŋtsɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome kɛ kooloo lɛ.
Amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome, ni amɛkɛ amɛhewalɛ kɛ amɛhegbɛ lɛ hãa kooloo lɛ.
Amɛkɛ Toobi lɛ baawu, shi Toobi lɛ baaye amɛnɔ kunim, ejaakɛ lɛ ji Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ kɛ maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ lɛ, ni mɛi ni kɛ lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ji mɛi ni atsɛ kɛ mɛi ni ahala kɛ mɛi ni heɔ yeɔ lɛ.” Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nui lɛ ni ona ni yoo ajwamãŋ lɛ ta nɔ lɛ ji maji kɛ asafoi kɛ jeŋmaji kɛ maji anɔ wiemɔi.
Ni akloŋtoi nyɔŋma ni ona lɛ kɛ kooloo lɛ amɛaanyɛ ajwamãŋ lɛ, ni amɛafee lɛ amaŋfɔ̃ ni amɛkɛ la aaashã lɛ kɛmɔ shi.
Ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛwo amɛtsuii amli koni amɛfee eyiŋtoonii lɛ ni amɛhiɛ jwɛŋmɔ kome ni amɛkɛ amɛmaŋtsɛyeli lɛ ahã kooloo lɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔi lɛ aaaba mli.” “Ni yoo lɛ ni ona lɛ ji maŋ kpeteŋkple ni yeɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ anɔ lɛ.”
Babilon shigbeemɔ Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ mina bɔfo kroko miikpeleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni eyɛ hegbɛ kpeteŋkple, ni enunyam lɛ hã shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ tse; ni ekɛ̃ ehe shi ebo ekɛɛ, “Egbee shi, Babilon kpeteŋkple lɛ egbee shi, ni etsɔ̃ mumɔi fɔ̃ji ashihilɛhe, kɛ mumɔi ni he tseee fɛɛ atsu kɛ loofɔlɔ fɛɛ loofɔlɔ ni he tseee ni anyaŋeɔ hu tsu.
Ejaakɛ ehã jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ enu ejwamaŋbɔɔ dãa ni naa wa lɛ eko, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ tsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi yɛ enyɛnyɛŋtswibɔɔ lɛ hewalɛ naa.” Ni minu gbee kroko kɛjɛ ŋwɛi miikɛɛ, “Nyɛjea emli, mimaŋ, koni nyɛkɛ lɛ akafea eshai ni efeɔ lɛ, ni nyɛkana ehaomɔi lɛ eko.
Ejaakɛ ehe eshai lɛ anɔ ekwɔ kɛshɛ ŋwɛi tɔ̃ɔ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ ekai enifɔɔji anii lɛ.
Nyɛwoa lɛ nyɔmɔ tamɔ bɔ ni lɛ hu ewo lɛ, ni nyɛkua nyɛbɔa he toi enyɔ nyɛhãa lɛ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Kpulu lɛ ni efutu dãa yɛ mli lɛ, nyɛfutua lɛ toi enyɔ nyɛwoa mli nyɛhãa lɛ.
Bɔ ni ewo lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehiɛ nyam ni ebɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ, nakai bɔ nɔŋŋ nyɛhãa epiŋmɔ kɛ ewerɛhoo lɛ afaa; ejaakɛ ekɛɔ yɛ etsui mli akɛ, ‘Mita shi akɛ maŋnyɛ, ni mijeee okulafo, ni minaŋ awerɛhoo.’ No hewɔ lɛ, gbi kome nɔ ehaomɔi lɛ aaaba, gbele kɛ awerɛhoo kɛ hɔ̃mɔ, ni akɛ la aaashã lɛ butuu, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ ni kojoɔ lɛ he wa.” Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ bii lɛ ayarawoo yɛ Babilon hewɔ Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi ni kɛ lɛ bɔ ajwamãŋ ni amɛkɛ lɛ bɔ nyɛnyɛŋtswi lɛ aaafo lɛ, ni amɛaawo yara yɛ hewɔ, be ni amɛaana eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ.
Ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao!
Ao!
Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ, Babilon, maŋ ni he wa lɛ!
Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni okojomɔ eba nɛɛ!” Ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ jarayelɔi lɛ aaafo lɛ ni amɛaaye lɛ ŋkɔmɔ, ejaakɛ mɔ ko mɔ ko heee amɛguɔ nii lɛ dɔŋŋ: shika kɛ jwiɛtɛi, ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai, kɛ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ, kɛ seda kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ kɛ tso fɛɛ tso ni jeɔ ŋma kɛ shwuɔwu nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni akɛ tso ni wa kɛ akɔɔble kɛ dade kɛ marmaratɛ fee, kɛ sinamon kɛ mrɔŋo kɛ tsofaikɛŋmai kɛ mire kɛ ohɛ kɛ wain kɛ mu kɛ shikishaŋ kɛ ŋmaa, kɛ tsinai kɛ toi kɛ okpɔŋɔi kɛ shwiilii kɛ nyɔji kɛ gbɔmɛi asusumai.
Jarayelɔi lɛ kɛɛ, “Ni yibii ni baa otsine lɛ eje odaaŋ, ni ŋɔɔmɔ nibii fɛɛ kɛ nibii fɛɛ ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram lɛ ebɔ bo, ni onaŋ amɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.” Ni nibii nɛɛ aguɔyelɔi ni etsɔ̃ maŋ nɛɛ nɔ etsɔ̃mɔ niiatsɛmɛi lɛ aaadamɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ yɛ epiŋmɔ lɛ gbeyeishemɔ lɛ hewɔ, ni amɛaafo ni amɛaaye ŋkɔmɔ ni amɛaakɛɛ, “Ao!
Ao!
Maŋ kpeteŋkple ni buɔ klala fɛɛfɛo kɛ mama afaseo diŋ kɛ mama tsuru fɔɔ, ni ewulaa kɛ shika kɛ ojarawatɛi kɛ adiagbai lɛ!
Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli lɛ nɛkɛ nifalɛ babaoo nɛɛ fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ.” Ni lɛlɛ kudɔɔtsɛ fɛɛ kudɔɔtsɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nyiɛɔ lɛlɛ mli kɛyaa he ko, kɛ amlãkui kɛ mɛi abɔ ni tsuɔ ŋshɔ hiɛ nii lɛ damɔ sɛɛ flɛŋŋ, ni be ni amɛna eshãa lɛ lasu lɛ amɛbolɔ amɛkɛɛ, “Aso maŋ ko ehi shi pɛŋ ni da tamɔ maŋ kpeteŋkple nɛɛ?” Ni amɛkɛ mlu wo amɛyiteaŋ, ni amɛkɛ yaafo kɛ ŋkɔmɔyeli bo amɛkɛɛ, “Ao!
Ao!
Maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni emli mɛi fɛɛ ni yɔɔ lɛji yɛ ŋshɔ hiɛ lɛ tsɔ̃ eninamɔ lɛ nɔ amɛfee niiatsɛmɛi lɛ!
Ejaakɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaa kome mli ni fɛɛ ebɔ lɛ nɛɛ!” Bo ŋwɛi, kɛ nyɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ bɔfoi kɛ gbalɔi, nyɛnyaa yɛ ehewɔ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ekojo lɛ ehã nyɛ!
Ni bɔfo ko ni he wa wo tɛ ko ni tamɔ wiɛ wulu, ni eshɛ efɔ̃ ŋshɔŋ ni ekɛɛ, “Nɛkɛ aaatsi Babilon maŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ atswa shi waa, ni anaŋ lɛ kwraa dɔŋŋ.
Ni anuŋ saŋkutswalɔi kɛ lalatsɛmɛi kɛ blɛkpãlɔi kɛ tɛtɛrɛmantɛrɛkpãlɔi lɛ agbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anaŋ ŋaalɔ ko ŋaalɔ ko ni le ŋaa ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ wiɛ gbɛɛmɔ ko hu kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli.
Ni anaŋ kane la ko kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli, ni anuŋ ayɛmforo wu kɛ ayɛmforo gbee kwraa dɔŋŋ yɛ omli; ejaakɛ ojarayelɔi lɛ ji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ gbɔmɛi wuji, ni okunyaayeli lɛ akɛshishiu jeŋmaji lɛ fɛɛ.” Ni emli ana gbalɔi kɛ krɔŋkrɔŋbii kɛ mɛi fɛɛ ni agbe yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ ala lɛ yɛ.
Nyamɔ yɛ ŋwɛi Nii nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ, minu gbee ni wa ni tamɔ asafo babaoo gbee yɛ ŋwɛi ni miikɛɛ, “Haleluya!
Yiwalaheremɔ kɛ anunyam kɛ hewalɛ lɛ ji wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ nɔ!
Ejaakɛ anɔkwa kɛ jalɛ ji ekojomɔi lɛ, akɛni ekojo ajwamãŋ kpeteŋkple lɛ ni kɛ ejwamaŋbɔɔ lɛ efite shikpɔŋ lɛ ni etɔ etsuji lɛ ala lɛ he owele yɛ enɔ lɛ.” Ni amɛkɛɛ nɔ ni ji shii enyɔ akɛ, “Haleluya!
Ni la ni shãa maŋ lɛ lasu lɛ teɔ shi kɛyaa naanɔi anaanɔ!” Ni onukpai nyɔŋmai enyɔ kɛ ejwɛ lɛ kɛ hiɛkãalɔi ejwɛ lɛ ho gbee shi ni amɛja Nyɔŋmɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ nɔ lɛ, ni amɛkɛɛ, “Amen!
Haleluya!” Ni gbee ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Nyɛjiea wɔNyɔŋmɔ lɛ yi, nyɛ mɛi ni ji etsuji lɛ fɛɛ kɛ nyɛ mɛi ni nyɛsheɔ lɛ gbeyei, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji lɛ fɛɛ!” Ni minu gbee ko tamɔ asafo kpeteŋkple gbee kɛ nui babaoo kɛ nyɔŋmɔshiimɔi ni naa wa agbɛɛmɔ miikɛɛ, “Haleluya!
Ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ, wɔNyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ miiye maŋtsɛ!” Toobi lɛ Yookpeemɔ lɛ “Nyɛhãa wɔmii ashɛa ni wɔmli afilia wɔ ni wɔwo ehiɛ nyam!
Ejaakɛ Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ lɛ eshɛ, ni eŋa lɛ esaa ehe eto.
Ni ahã lɛ hegbɛ akɛ ewo klala ni hetse ni kpɛlɛɔ nyɛramnyɛram.” Ejaakɛ klala lɛ ji krɔŋkrɔŋbii lɛ ajalɛnii lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, Ajɔɔ mɛi ni atsɛ amɛ kɛba Toobi lɛ yookpeemɔ okplɔ̃ lɛ he lɛ.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ anɔkwa wiemɔi nɛ.” Ni miho migbee enaji anaa koni maja lɛ.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai!
Bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ ni hiɛ Yesu odase lɛ mli lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi.
Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” Ejaakɛ Yesu he odase lɛ ji gbalɛ mumɔ lɛ.
Tatsɛ ni ta okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ nɔ lɛ Ni mina ni agbele ŋwɛi naa, ni mina okpɔŋɔ yɛŋ, ni mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ akɛ Anɔkwafo kɛ Anɔkwayelɔ; ni jalɛ naa ekojoɔ ni ewuɔ ta yɛ.
Ni ehiŋmɛii tamɔ lalilɛi, ni maŋtsɛ faii pii bumɔ eyitso, ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ he ni mɔ ko mɔ ko leee akɛ ja lɛ diɛŋtsɛ; ni ewo atade ni akɛtsɔ lá mli; ni atsɛɔ egbɛi akɛ, “Nyɔŋmɔ Wiemɔ lɛ.” Ni tai ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi lɛ tara okpɔŋɔi yɛji anɔ kɛnyiɛ esɛɛ, ni amɛwo klala yɛŋ futaa ni he tse.
Ni tsi ni naa ba jɛɔ edaaŋ, koni ekɛ no atswia jeŋmajiaŋbii lɛ anii; ni ekɛ dadetso aaakpala amɛ.
Ni eeenaanaa Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ mlifu ni naa wa lɛ wainŋaanɔ lɛ nɔ.
Ni aŋma gbɛi ko yɛ etade kɛ egboŋ nɔ akɛ, “Maŋtsɛmɛi aMaŋtsɛ kɛ Nuŋtsɔmɛi aNuŋtsɔ.” Harmagedon Ta lɛ Ni mina bɔfo ko damɔ hulu mli, ni ebo kɛ gbee ni wa ekɛɛ loofɔji ni filikiɔ yɛ ŋwɛi teŋ lɛ fɛɛ akɛ, “Nyɛbaa ni nyɛbabuaa nyɛhe naa yɛ Nyɔŋmɔ okplɔ̃ kpeteŋkple lɛ he, koni nyɛbaye maŋtsɛmɛi aloo kɛ asafoiatsɛmɛi aloo kɛ hewalɔi aloo kɛ okpɔŋɔi aloo kɛ mɛi ni tara amɛnɔ lɛ aloo kɛ odehei kɛ nyɔji kɛ mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji fɛɛ aloo.” Ni mina kooloo lɛ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ amɛtai lɛ ni abua amɛnaa ni amɛkɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛ eta lɛ ayawu.
Ni amɔ kooloo lɛ, ni amɔ amalegbalɔ lɛ afata ehe, amalegbalɔ lɛ ni fee okadii yɛ ehiɛ ni ekɛshishiu mɛi ni ŋɔ kooloo lɛ okadi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni jaa emãgã lɛ.
Ni aŋɔ kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ ni akɛ mɛi enyɔ nɛɛ fɛɛ wo la kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli ni amɛhiɛ kãmɔ.
Ni mɛi ni shwɛ lɛ, akɛ mɔ ni ta okpɔŋɔ lɛ nɔ lɛ tsi ni jɛɔ edaaŋ lɛ gbe amɛ, ni loofɔji fɛɛ ye amɛloo lɛ amɛtɔrɔ.
Afii Akpe Maŋtsɛyeli lɛ Ni mina bɔfo ko miikpeleke shi kɛmiijɛ ŋwɛi, ni ehiɛ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ naa samfee lɛ kɛ kɔsɔŋkɔsɔ kpeteŋkple ko yɛ edɛŋ.
Ni emɔ drako lɛ, blema onufu lɛ ni ji abonsam kɛ Satan hu lɛ, ni efi lɛ afii akpe, ni eshɛ́ lɛ efɔ̃ bu kwɔŋkwɔŋ lɛ mli, ni eŋa naa ni esɔo naa, koni ekashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ dɔŋŋ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni aaagbe afii akpe lɛ naa.
Ni no sɛɛ lɛ ja afɛne lɛ be fioo ko.
Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃ii ni mɛi ni akɛ kojomɔ ehã amɛ lɛ tara nɔ.
Ni mina mɛi ni afolɔ amɛyii yɛ Yesu he odaseyeli lɛ kɛ Nyɔŋmɔ wiemɔ lɛ hewɔ lɛ asusumai lɛ, kɛ mɛi ni jako kooloo lɛ loo emãgã lɛ ni amɛheko ekadi lɛ yɛ amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ loo amɛdɛ̃ lɛ.
Amɛtsɔ̃mɔ hiɛkãalɔi ekoŋŋ, ni amɛkɛ Kristo ye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.
Shi gbohii ni shwɛ lɛ ahiɛ etsɛ̃ɛɛ kɛyashi beyinɔ ni agbe afii akpe lɛ naa.
Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ.
Mɔ ni naa gbɛ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ shitee lɛ mli lɛ ajɔɔ lɛ ni mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ ji lɛ.
Gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ko yɛ nakai mɛi lɛ anɔ; moŋ amɛaatsɔ̃mɔ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Kristo osɔfoi, ni amɛkɛ lɛ aaaye maŋtsɛ afii akpe.
Satan nɔ kunimyeli Ni kɛji agbe afii akpe lɛ naa lɛ, aaafɛne Satan kɛaajɛ tsu lɛ mli, ni ebaaje kpo ni eyashishiu jeŋmaji lɛ ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ koji ejwɛ lɛ, Gog kɛ Magog, koni ebua amɛnaa kɛkpe ni amɛya ta.
Amɛyifalɛ tamɔ ŋshɔ naa shia.
Ni amɛyiŋ kɛtee kɛyaha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ fɛɛ, ni amɛyabɔle mɛi krɔŋkrɔŋi lɛ ansra lɛ kɛ maŋ ni asumɔɔ lɛ kɛkpe.
Ni la jɛ ŋwɛi, ni ebashã amɛ butuu.
Ni abonsam lɛ ni shishiuɔ amɛ lɛ, ashɛ lɛ afɔ̃ la kɛ swɔɔ kpaakpo lɛ mli, he ni kooloo lɛ kɛ amale gbalɔ lɛ hu yɔɔ lɛ, ni aaapiŋ amɛ nyɔɔŋ kɛ shwane kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Naagbee kojomɔ lɛ Ni mina maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i yɛŋ ko ni da, kɛ mɔ ni ta nɔ lɛ, ni shikpɔŋ kɛ ŋwɛi jo foi yɛ ehiɛ, ni amɛbɛ gbɛhe dɔŋŋ.
Ni mina gbohii lɛ, mɛi bibii kɛ mɛi wuji, damɔ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ hiɛ, ni agbele woji anaa; ni agbele wolo kroko ni ji wala wolo lɛ hu naa.
Ni adamɔ nibii ni aŋmala yɛ woji lɛ amli lɛ anɔ akojo gbohii lɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Ni ŋshɔ jie gbohii ni yɔɔ emli lɛ ehã, ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje hu jie gbohii ni yɔɔ amɛmli lɛ amɛhã; ni akojo amɛ, mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ enitsumɔi lɛ anaa.
Ni gbele kɛ gbohiiaje lɛ, ashɛrɛ amɛ ashwie la kpaakpo lɛ mli.
Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko yɛ ni anãaa akɛ aŋma egbɛi yɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ, ashɛɔ lɛ afɔ̃ɔ la kpaakpo lɛ mli.
Ŋwɛi Hee kɛ Shikpɔŋ Hee lɛ Ni mina ŋwɛi hee kɛ shikpɔŋ hee; ejaakɛ tsutsu ŋwɛi lɛ kɛ tsutsu shikpɔŋ lɛ eho etee, ni ŋshɔ bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni mina Maŋ Krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ji Yerusalɛm hee lɛ jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi miikpeleke shi, ni asaa lɛ ato tamɔ ayɛmforo ni awula lɛ ahã ewu.
Ni minu gbee kpeteŋkple ko jɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli kɛɛ, “Naa, Nyɔŋmɔ shihilɛhe lɛ yɛ gbɔmɛi ateŋ, ni eeehi shi yɛ amɛteŋ, ni amɛaatsɔ̃ emaŋ, ni Nyɔŋmɔ diɛŋtsɛ kɛ amɛ aaahi shi.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ aaatsumɔ amɛhiɛiaŋ yafonui fɛɛ.
Gbele bɛ dɔŋŋ, ni ŋkɔmɔyeli loo bolɔmɔ loo nɔnaa ko hu bɛ dɔŋŋ; ejaakɛ tsutsunii lɛ eho etee.” Ni mɔ ni ta maŋtsɛ sɛi lɛ nɔ lɛ kɛɛ, “Naa, miifee nii fɛɛ ehee.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Ŋmaa, ejaakɛ wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli.” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Agbe naa.
Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ.
Mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, mahã lɛ wala nubu lɛ mli nu lɛ eko yaka.
Kunimyelɔ lɛ aaatsɔ̃ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ fɛɛ yelɔ, ni matsɔ eNyɔŋmɔ ni lɛ hu eeetsɔ̃ mibi.
Shi gbeyelɔi kɛ mɛi ni heee yeee kɛ mɛi ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi kɛ sulɔi kɛ wɔŋjalɔi kɛ amalelɔi fɛɛ lɛ, amɛna amɛgbɛhe yɛ kpaakpo lɛ ni tsoɔ kɛ la kɛ swɔɔ lɛ mli.
Enɛ ji gbele ni ji enyɔ lɛ.” Yerusalɛm Hee lɛ Ni bɔfoi kpawo ni hiɛ tɔi kpawo ni eyimɔ obɔ̃bɔ̃ kɛ naagbee haomɔi kpawo lɛ ateŋ mɔ kome ba miŋɔɔ ni ekɛ mi bawie ekɛɛ, “Ba, ni matsɔ̃ bo ayɛmforo lɛ ni ji Toobi lɛ ŋa lɛ.” Ni eŋɔ mi yɛ mumɔ mli kɛtee gɔŋ kpele ni kwɔ ko nɔ, ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi maŋ kpeteŋkple ni ji Yerusalɛm krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ ni ejɛ Nyɔŋmɔ ŋɔɔ yɛ ŋwɛi eekpleke shi, ni ehiɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ ni ekpɛɔ tamɔ tɛ ni jara wa waa, tamɔ yaspi ni mli tse akɛ kristalo.
Eyɛ gbogbo kpeteŋkple ni kwɔ kɛ agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ damɔ agboi lɛ anaa, ni aŋmala gbɛii ni ji Israelbii lɛ akutsei nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ nɔ.
Agboi etɛ̃ yɛ bokãgbɛ ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ kooyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ wuoyigbɛ, ni agboi etɛ̃ yɛ anaigbɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ yɛ shishitoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ni Toobi lɛ bɔfoi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ agbɛii yɛ amɛnɔ.
Ni bɔfo ni kɛ mi wie lɛ hiɛ shika susumɔtso koni ekɛsusu maŋ lɛ kɛ egboi lɛ kɛ egbogbo lɛ.
Ni maŋ lɛ kã shi koji ejwɛ, ni ekɛlɛ tamɔ elɛɛmɔ nɔŋŋ.
Ni ekɛ susumɔtso lɛ susu maŋ lɛ, ni efee shitoi akpe kome kɛ ohai enumɔ.
Ekɛlɛ kɛ elɛɛmɔ kɛ ekwɔlɛ ye egbɔ.
Ni esusu egbogbo lɛ efee ninetalɔi oha kɛ nyɔŋmai ejwɛ kɛ ejwɛ yɛ gbɔmɔ nisusumɔtso naa, ni ji bɔfo lɛ tso lɛ.
Ni nɔ ni akɛtswa gbogbo lɛ ji yaspi, ni maŋ lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni tamɔ ashwishwɛ krɔŋŋ ni.
Ni maŋ lɛ gbogbo lɛ shishitoo lɛ awula amɛ kɛ tɛi ni jara wa srɔtoi fɛɛ.
Klɛŋklɛŋ shishitoo lɛ yaspi, nɔ ni ji enyɔ lɛ safiro, nɔ ni ji etɛ̃ lɛ kalkedɔn, nɔ ni ji ejwɛ smaragdo, nɔ ni ji enumɔ lɛ sardonike, nɔ ni ji ekpaa lɛ sardio, nɔ ni ji kpawo lɛ krisolito, nɔ ni ji kpaanyɔ lɛ berilo, nɔ ni ji nɛɛhu lɛ topasiɔn, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma lɛ krisopraso, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ ekome lɛ hiakinto, nɔ ni ji nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ amɛtisto.
Ni agboi nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ lɛ adiagbai nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ ni, agbo kome lɛ adiagba kome akɛfee.
Ni maŋ lɛ blohu lɛ shika ŋmiiŋmi ni, ni emli tse tamɔ ashwishwɛ.
Ni minaaa Sɔlemɔtsu yɛ mli, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ Ofe lɛ kɛ Toobi lɛ ji eSɔlemɔtsu.
Ni hulu loo nyɔɔŋtsere kpɛmɔ he ehĩaaa maŋ lɛ, ejaakɛ Nyɔŋmɔ anunyam lɛ kpɛɔ yɛ mli, ni Toobi lɛ ji ela.
Ni jeŋmaji lɛ aaanyiɛ yɛ ela lɛ mli, ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ aaaŋɔ amɛnunyam lɛ kɛaaba mli.
Ni egboi lɛ aŋamɔŋ kwraa shwane, ejaakɛ nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi.
Ni akɛ jeŋmaji lɛ anunyam lɛ kɛ amɛwoo lɛ aaaba mli.
Ni nɔ ko nɔ ko ni he tseee kɛ mɔ ni feɔ nihiinii kɛ mɔ ni maleɔ boteŋ mli kwraa akɛ ja mɛi ni aŋma amɛgbɛi yɛ Toobi lɛ wala wolo lɛ mli lɛ kɛkɛ.
Walanu Faa lɛ kɛ Walatso lɛ Ni etsɔ̃ɔ mi walanu faa ni hiɛ kpɛlɛɔ tamɔ kristalo ni jɛ Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ mli.
Ni eblohu lɛ teŋ kɛ faa lɛ biɛ kɛ biɛ lɛ walatso ma shi, ni ewoɔ yibii nyɔŋma kɛ enyɔ, ekome nyɔŋ fɛɛ nyɔŋ nɔ, ni tso lɛ yibai lɛ akɛtsaa jeŋmaji lɛ.
Ni musu ko musu ko bɛ dɔŋŋ.
Ni Nyɔŋmɔ kɛ Toobi lɛ maŋtsɛ sɛ̃i lɛ aaama maŋ lɛ mli; ni etsuji lɛ aaasɔ̃mɔ lɛ; ni amɛaana ehiɛ, ni egbɛi lɛ aaahi amɛhiɛŋtsei anɔ.
Ni nyɔɔŋ bɛ jɛi, ni kane la loo hulu la he ehiaŋ amɛ, ejaakɛ Nuŋtsɔ Nyɔŋmɔ lɛ aaatso ahã amɛ, ni amɛaaye maŋtsɛ kɛaatee naanɔi anaanɔ.
Yesu baa ni ji enyɔ lɛ Ni bɔfo lɛ kɛɛ mi akɛ, “Wiemɔi nɛɛ anɔkwa ni, ni amɛyɛ mli.
Ni Nuŋtsɔ ni ji gbalɔi amumɔi lɛ aNyɔŋmɔ lɛ tsu ebɔfo lɛ ni ebatsɔ̃ɔ etsuji nii ni sa akɛ aba nɔŋŋ.” “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ.
Ajɔɔ mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ.” Ni mi, Yohane, ji mɔ ni nu ni na nii nɛɛ.
Ni be ni minu ni mina lɛ miho mibu shi ni maja yɛ bɔfo lɛ ni tsɔ̃ɔ mi nii nɛɛ lɛ naji anaa.
Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kwɛ, kaafee nakai!
Ejaakɛ bo kɛ onyɛmimɛi lɛ kɛ gbalɔi lɛ kɛ mɛi ni yeɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ anɔ lɛ anaanyo tsulɔ ji mi.
Já Nyɔŋmɔ!” Ni ekɛɛ mi akɛ, “Kaasɔo nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ anaa, ejaakɛ be lɛ ebɛŋkɛ.
Mɔ ni ejaaa lɛ, eya nɔ efee nii ni ejaaa lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji mujiatsɛ lɛ, eya nɔ ewo ehe muji lɛ; ni mɔ ni ji jalɔ lɛ, eya nɔ efee jalɛnii, ni mɔ ni ji mɔ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ, eya nɔ ehi krɔŋkrɔŋ.” “Naa, miiba nɔŋŋ, ni mihiɛ minyɔmɔwo lɛ kɛmiiba, ni mawo mɔ fɛɛ mɔ nyɔmɔ bɔ ni sa enitsumɔ lɛ.
Mi ji Alfa lɛ kɛ Omega lɛ, shishijee lɛ kɛ naagbee lɛ, klɛŋklɛŋ mɔ lɛ kɛ naagbee mɔ lɛ.” Ajɔɔ mɛi ni fɔɔ amɛtadei lɛ ahe, koni amɛna hegbɛ yɛ walatso lɛ he ní amɛtsɔ̃ agboi lɛ amli kɛbote maŋ lɛ mli lɛ.
Shi maŋ lɛ sɛɛ lɛ gbei lɛ kɛ sulɔi lɛ kɛ ajwamãŋbɔlɔi lɛ kɛ gbɔmɔgbelɔi lɛ kɛ amãgãjalɔi lɛ kɛ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni sumɔɔ amale ni emaleɔ yɔɔ jɛi.
“Mi Yesu, mitsu mibɔfo lɛ koni ebaye nii nɛɛ ahe odase etsɔ̃ɔ nyɛ yɛ asafoi lɛ amli.
Mi ji David shishifã lɛ kɛ eshwie lɛ, tooloo ni kpɛɔ lɛ.” Ni Mumɔ lɛ kɛ Ayɛmforo lɛ kɛɔ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni nuɔ lɛ, ekɛɛ akɛ, “Ba!” Ni mɔ ni kumai yeɔ lɛ lɛ, eba, ni mɔ ni sumɔɔ lɛ, ebahe wala nu lɛ yaka.
Naagbee Mi miiye odase miitsɔ̃ɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ni nuɔ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli gbalɛ wiemɔi lɛ akɛ, “Kɛji mɔ ko kɛ nɔ ko fata nii nɛɛ ahe lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaaŋɔ haomɔi ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ afata he ahã lɛ.
Ni kɛji mɔ ko jie nɔ ko kɛjɛ nɛkɛ gbalɛ wolo nɛɛ mli wiemɔi lɛ amli lɛ, Nyɔŋmɔ aaajie egbɛnaa kɛaajɛ wala wolo lɛ kɛ maŋ krɔŋkrɔŋ lɛ kɛ nii ni aŋma yɛ nɛkɛ wolo nɛɛ mli lɛ amli.
Mɔ ni yeɔ nɛkɛ nii nɛɛ he odase lɛ miikɛɛ akɛ, ‘Hɛɛ, miiba nɔŋŋ!’ ” Amen!
Ba, Nuŋtsɔ Yesu!
WɔNuŋtsɔ Yesu dromɔ lɛ kɛ nyɛ fɛɛ ahi shi.
Amen!
